title_en: N-aryl substituted isoxazolidine glucocorticosteroid derivatives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel anti-inflammatory and antiallergic compounds of the glucocorticosteroid series, methods of preparing such compounds, pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, combinations and therapeutic uses thereof. More particularly, the invention relates to glucocorticosteroids that are derivatives of isoxazolidine.

title_en: Triazine based radiopharmaceuticals and radioimaging agents
abstract_en: Compounds according to Formula (I) and Formula (II) are potent inhibitors of PSMA. (I) or (II) Pharmaceutical compositions may include a complex of a radionuclide and a Formula (I) compound or a Formula (II) compound. Methods include using the radionuclide complex of a Formula (I) compound or a Formula (II) compound for treating or diagnosis of a disease or a condition associated with PSMA activity.

title_en: Chelates of lead (ii) and bismuth (iii) based on trans-di-n-picolinate tetraazacycloalkanes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chelate resulting from the complexing of a trans-di-N-picolinate tetraazacycloalkane ligand with a metal cation, said ligand corresponding to formula (A) wherein n is equal to 0 or to 1, R is H or a C1-C18 alkyl radical, and R' is H or a C1-C18 alkyl radical, said metal cation being a cation of a metal selected from the group consisting of lead (II) and bismuth (III). The invention is applicable in the field of lead trapping and alpha-radioimmunotherapy.

title_en: Process for the manufacture of hydrochlorofluoroolefins
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a process for the manufacture of trans 1-chloro3,3,3-trifluoropropene (trans 1233zd) by fluorinating 1230za and/or 240fa to a cis/trans mixture of 1233zd, separating the trans isomer followed by an isomerization of cis 1233zd to trans 1233zd in the fluorination step. The fluorination step is carried out in the gas phase or the liquid phase. The isomerization is carried out in the gas phase with a high surface area heterogeneous Cr catalyst, supported or unsupported.

title_en: Inhibitors of creatine transport and uses thereof
abstract_en: This invention relates to compounds of formula V, pharmaceutical compositions including such compounds, and methods of utilizing such compounds and compositions for the treatment of cancer.

title_en: Non-greasy personal care compositions
abstract_en: An anhydrous personal care composition, comprising: (a) 45 to 60 weight % of at least one ester, selected from (i) triglycerides, (ii) diglycerides, (iii) monoglycerides, (iv) monoesters of diols, and (v) diesters of diols; (b) a first wax having a melting point of from 35°C to 72°C present in an amount of 5 to 25 weight %; (c) a second wax having a melting point of 73 to 90°C present in an amount of 0.5 to 15 weight %; and (d) at least one plant oil having a saponification value of from 150 to 275 mg KOH/g present in an amount of 5 to 35 weight.

title_en: Process for preparing heonone (meth)acrylate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing Heonon(meth)acrylate via the transesterification of alkyl(meth)acrylate with Heonon, comprising the following steps: (i) permitting alkyl(meth)acrylate to react with Heonon in the presence of a catalyst containing titanium (IV) or zirconium (IV) and a stabiliser in the presence of an entrainer, forming an azeotrope with the alcohol bonded in the alkyl(meth)alcylate; (ii) continuous distilling off of the azeotrope from the entrainer and alcohol, wherein steps (i) and (ii) are carried out simultaneously, until heonon is substantially completely converted; (iii) adding water to the product mixture obtained in steps (i) and (ii) and containing heonon(meth)acrylate, and separating the hydrolysate from the catalyst containing titanium (IV) or zirconium (IV) by means of filtration; (iv) distilling off of non-converted alkyl(meth)acrylate and entrainer from the product mixture; (v) distilling off of water from the product mixture, wherein step (iv) can also be carried out before step (iii), and the steps (iv) and (v) can also be carried out in a distillation step, characterised in that the steps (i) and (ii) are carried out in the presence of an inorganic or organic acid.

title_en: Tricyclic fused derivatives of 1-(cyclo)alkyl pyridin-2-one useful for the treatment of cancer
abstract_en: The present disclosure described heterocyclic compounds of Formula I or, its stereoisomers, pharmaceutically acceptable salts, complexes, hydrates, solvates, tautomers, polymorphs, racemic mixtures, optically active forms and pharmaceutically active derivative thereof and pharmaceutical compositions containing them as the active ingredient. The present disclosure also describes the synthesis and characterization of aforementioned compounds to exhibit high anticancer activity. The compounds of the present disclosure are useful as medicaments and their use in the manufacture of medicaments for treatment, prevention or suppression of diseases, and conditions mediated by one or more BET family of bromodomains.

title_en: Compounds, compositions and methods of increasing cftr activity
abstract_en: The present disclosure features compounds such as those having the Formulae (I) and (II), which can increase cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) activity as measured in human bronchial epithelial (hBE) cells. The present disclosure also features methods of treating a condition associated with decreased CFTR activity or a condition associated with a dysfunction of proteostasis comprising administering to a subject an effective amount of a disclosed compound, such as a compound of Formula (I) or (II).

title_en: Heterocycle-containing amino acid compound and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided is a novel heterocycle-containing amino acid compound that has a metal uptake ability equivalent to mugineic acids and can be less expensively produced than mugineic acids. Also provided are a fertilizer and a plant growth regulating agent each comprising the novel heterocycle-containing amino acid compound. The present invention relates to a heterocycle-containing amino acid compound represented by general formula (1) [wherein: R1, R2 and R3 are the same or different and represent a hydrogen atom or a carboxyl-protecting group; R4 represents a hydrogen atom or a hydroxy-protecting group; R5 represents a hydrogen atom or an amino-protecting group; and n is an integer of 1-3] or a salt thereof and use of the same.

title_en: 8-phenoxy-quinoline derivatives for inhibiting chemokine activity and/or cancer cells growth
abstract_en: Compounds capable of, or usable in, inducing death of cancer cells and/or modulating a biological activity of a chemokine e.g., cell migration, and/or treating diseases and disorders associated with a biological activity of a chemokine and/or cell migration, and/or inhibiting a kinase and/or in treating a disease or disorder associated with an activity of a kinase, such as cancer and inflammatory diseases and disorders, are provided herein. The compounds are collectively represented by Formulae (Ia) or (Ib): wherein A, B D, E, G and R1-R5 are as defined in the specification.

title_en: Biologically active cannabidiol analogs
abstract_en: Biologically active cannabidiol analogs comprising a compound of the formula [ I ] wherein one of R1 or R2 or both is/are the residue of a moiety formed by the reaction of an amino group of the amino acid ester of R1 or R2 or both with a dicarboxylic acid or a dicarboxylic acid derivative and the other R1 or R2 (in the case of the mono) is the residue of a dicarboxylic acid or dicarboxylic acid derivative or Hydrogen (H), (i.e. underivatized), and salts thereof. These CBD analogs are be useful in pain management in oncology and other clinical settings in which neuropathy is presented. Furthermore, these CBD-analogs are useful in blocking the addictive properties of opiates.

title_en: Upgrading of a raw blend into a diesel fuel substitute: poly (dimethoxymethane)
abstract_en: A method for forming poly(dimethoxymethane) includes a step of separating a formaldehyde-containing blend into a first bottom stream and a first top stream. The first formaldehyde-containing blend includes methanol, formaldehyde, and water while the first bottom stream includes water. The first top stream includes dimethoxymethane that is produced from the reaction between methanol and formaldehyde. The first top stream is separated into a second bottom stream and a second top stream. The second bottom stream includes poly(dimethoxymethane) while the second top stream includes dimethoxymethane, methanol, and ethanol. The second top stream is separated into a third bottom stream and a third top stream. Third bottom stream includes methanol and ethanol while the third top stream includes dimethoxymethane. The third top steam can be recycled to form additional poly(dimethoxymethane). A system that implements the method is also provided.

title_en: Compounds for treating proliferative diseases
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I):                                         (I). The compounds described herein may be useful in treating and/or preventing proliferative diseases (e.g., cancer). Also provided in the present disclosure are pharmaceutical compositions, kits, methods, and uses including or using a compound described herein.

title_en: Sequencing adapter manufacture and use
abstract_en: Technology provided herein relates in part to methods, processes, machines and apparatuses for determining sequences of nucleotides for nucleic acid templates in a nucleic acid sample. The technology provide herein also relates in part to methods, processes, machines and apparatuses for counting nucleic acid templates. Nucleic acid templates of a sample are tagged with nonrandom oligonucleotide adapters that include predetermined non-randomly generated sequences. The use of these nonrandom oligonucleotide adapters provides an efficient method to reduce sequencing errors, and increase the sensitivity of detection of low-frequency single nucleotide alterations.

title_en: Psma-targeted radiopharmaceutical for diagnosing and treating prostate cancer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for diagnosing and treating prostate cancer, capable of targeting PSMA, and a compound of Formula 1 <DIG> comprising a glutamine-urea-lysine compound to which a radioactive metal-coupled chelator is structurally coupled and to which an aryl group that can additionally bind to PSMA protein is coupled. Coupling between the glutamine-urea-lysine compound and the chelator includes a polar spacer to serve the role of reducing in vivo nonspecific coupling and exhibit an effect of being rapidly removed from vital organs, but not from prostate cancer. These characteristics lower the radiation exposure, which is caused by a therapeutic radioisotope-coupled compound, to normal tissue and organs, and thus reduce side effects. In addition, a compound that contains a phenyl group having a coupling force with albumin has an increased residence time in the blood, thereby becoming more accumulated in prostate cancer.

title_en: Formulations containing cannabinoids
abstract_en: Provided herein are formulations comprising a nanogel comprising a first fraction of hyaluronic acid, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a second fraction of hyaluronic acid, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein the hyaluronic acid of the first fraction, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, has a molecular weight of greater than about 500 kilodaltons, and the hyaluronic acid of the second fraction, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, has a molecular weight of less than about 250 kilodaltons; lecithin liposomes within the nanogel, the lecithin liposomes having a d75 of from about 25 nm to about 250 nm; and one or more cannabinoids. The fommlations can be used to treat a variety of diseases, disorders or conditions beneficially treated by a cannabinoid.

title_en: Herbicidal compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds of Formula (I), (I) wherein R1, R2, R3 and R4 are as defined herein. The invention further relates to herbicidal compositions which comprise a compound of Formula (I), to their use for controlling weeds, in particular in crops of useful plants.

title_en: Process for the preparation of a nitric oxide donating prostaglandin analogue
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing the hexanoic acid, 6-(nitrooxy)-,(1S,2E)-3-[(1R,2R,3S,5R)-2-[(2Z)-7-(ethylamino)-7-oxo-2-hepten-1-yl]-3,5-dihydroxycyclopentyl]-1-(2-phenylethyl)-2-propen-1-yl ester of formula (I). In accordance with the present invention, the compound (I) can be efficiently prepared with high purity by coupling bimatoprost in a boronate protected form with 6-(nitrooxy)hexanoyl chloride having an high chemical purity and removing the boronate protecting group. The high chemical pure 6-(nitrooxy)hexanoyl chloride is prepared from 6-(nitrooxy)hexanoic acid having a high chemical purity. The invention also relates to a process for the preparation and purification of 6-(nitrooxy) hexanoic acid.

title_en: Stable crystalline apalutamide in pure form, and process for the preparation thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel non-solvated crystalline form of apalutamide in pure, stable form, and the process for the preparation thereof.

title_en: Process for preparing an activin receptor-like kinase inhibitor
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method of preparing a compound represented by formula (I). The method comprises reacting in a reaction mixture a first starting material represented by formula (II) and a second starting material represented by formula (III) under Negishi conditions: to form the compound of formula (I). R is an amine protecting group; Y is C1, Br or I; and Z is triflate, C1, Br or I.

title_en: Systemic formulation of a pyridinone derivate for tg2-related diseases
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a formulation in particular an oral formulation for the prophylaxis and treatment of TG2-related disorders like fibrosis in particular diabetic nephropathy and/or diabetic associated non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) and/or non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, and its use in the prophylaxis and/or treatment of fibrosis in particular nephropathy, NASH, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and cystic fibrosis. Further, the present application relates also to the use of (S,E)-methyl-7-(1-(2-(2- ethylbutylamino)-2-oxoethyl)-2-oxo-1,2-dihydro-pyridin-3-ylamino)-6-(1-methyl-1H- imidazole-5-carboxamido)-7-oxohept-2-enoate as hepatoprotectant, i.e. as hepatoprotective agent. In addition the present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising (S,E)-methyl-7-(1-(2-(2-ethylbutylamino)-2-oxoethyl)-2-oxo-1,2- dihydro-pyridin-3-ylamino)-6-(1-methyl-1H-imidazole-5-carboxamido)-7-oxohept-2- enoate for use as hepatoprotective agent and for use in the protection of the liver against liver toxicity, the improvement of liver function, and/or in the prophylaxis or treatment of a liver disease or liver disorder.

title_en: Dimers for use in synthesis of peptidomimetics
abstract_en: Dimers for use in synthesis of peptidomimetics are described. Uses of dimers as synthons in synthesis of azapeptides and other peptidomimetics, azapeptides and other peptidomimetics synthesized from the dimers and uses of azapeptides and other peptidomimetics are also described.

title_en: Rna-binding protein multimerization inhibitors and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: This disclosure provides compounds that inhibit RNA-binding proteins, such as Human antigen R protein (HuR). The compounds described herein have a high affinity for HuR multimers and inhibit the pathological processes that promote cancer and inflammation. The compounds are highly water-soluble and have good biodistribution for both systemic and central nervous system disease processes. The compounds provide a unique therapeutic option for disease processes related to neoplastic progression or acute or chronic inflammation.

title_en: Cbp/ep300 inhibitor and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a compound represented by formula (I), a stereoisomer thereof or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a use thereof in preparing a drug for diseases mediated by CBP and/or EP300.

title_en: Flame retardant treatment of lignocellulosic materials, resulting flame-retarded lignocellulosic materials, and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flame retardant treatment of a lignocellulosic material, characterized in that it comprises the following steps: - optionally steam explosion of the lignocellulosic material, - impregnation of the optionally steam-exploded lignocellulosic material, in or with an aqueous solution comprising from 0.5% to 10% of phytic acid and from 1% to 30% of urea, and preferably from 3% to 7% of phytic acid and from 15% to 22% of urea, said percentages being expressed by weight relative to the total weight of the aqueous solution, - optionally drying of the impregnated lignocellulosic material, until it has a moisture content ranging from 5% to 20%, said percentages being expressed by weight relative to the total weight of the impregnated lignocellulosic material, - cooking of the impregnated and optionally dried lignocellulosic material, the resulting flame-retarded lignocellulosic material comprising a content of phosphorus originating from the phytic acid ranging from 0.1% to 10%, preferably ranging from 0.3% to 3%, said percentages being expressed by weight relative to the total weight of the flame-retarded lignocellulosic material. The invention also relates to the resulting flame-retarded lignocellulosic material and the use thereof for manufacturing: - flame-retarded composite materials based on plant fibres, - woven or nonwoven flame-retarded flexible materials based on plant fibres, and particularly textiles, - flame-retarded materials based on wood fibres and/or on wood particles, and particularly flame-retarded wood panels.

title_en: Pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine derivatives having multimodal activity against pain
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pyrazolopyrimidine derivatives having dual pharmacological activity towards both the ?2? subunit of the voltage-gated calcium channel and the sigma-1 (?1) receptor, to processes of preparation of such compounds, to pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, and to their use in therapy, in particular for the treatment of pain.

title_en: Dna-encoded functionalized aptamers
abstract_en: It is provided the synthesis of an aptamer-like encoded oligomer (ALEnOmer), method of producing same and method of preparing a library of ALEnOmes. More particularly, the method of preparing ALEnOmer comprises coupling at least one phosphoramidite monomer with an orthogonal protecting group, and the ALEnOmer produces comprises a DNA coding strand covalently attached to an oligomer through a branching unit, wherein the oligomer has a degree of polymerization at least 5 and is an aptamer.

title_en: Use of phytocannabinoids for treating multiple myeloma
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the use of suitable phytocannabinoids such as cannabidivarin, cannabinol, cannabigerol or cannabichromene or combinations thereof for treatment of multiple myeloma and/or similar conditions, diseases or disorders.

title_en: Adjuvant with tlr4 agonist activity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound that is useful as a vaccine adjuvant, a method for producing the same, a pharmaceutical composition that contains the compound, and use of the compound as a vaccine adjuvant.

title_en: An improved highly efficient process for the prepration of nintedanib and pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improved highly efficient and economic process for large-scale production of Nintedanib and pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The present invention also relates to a single step process that form highly pure Nintedanib through novel intermediates. In this process, Nintedanib base [I] is prepared in a single step, in-situ process wherein the process is performed by formation of two novel intermediates namely, methyl-1-(bromoacetyl)-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-6-carboxylate and methyl-(3Z)-1-(bromoacetyl)-3-[methoxy(phenyl)methylidene]-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-6-carboxylate. This process avoids use of expensive and hazardous reagent and solvent such as methyl cyclohexane. Further, there is no isolation and analysis of any intermediate after every step completion that made the process easy to perform without much hurdles. Along with the ease of performance, present invention process also gives high-purity final product with high yield. This makes the process highly cost-effective and time-efficient.

title_en: Surfactant-free foamable oral care composition
abstract_en: A surfactant-free foamable oral care composition is provided. The oral care composition includes 0.1-10% (w/w/) ofhydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, asurface tension of an aqueous solution of the 0.1%hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose is less than 56 mN/m. The oral care composition includes no surfactant, while can generate foams during tooth brushing.

title_en: Dehydration of lactic acid and related compounds in solid acids via multifunctional flexible modifiers
abstract_en: A catalyst composition includes a solid acid catalyst having a multiplicity of acid sites on the surfaces and a multifunctional component coupled to the surfaces of the solid acid catalyst. Each multifunctional component includes at least two functional groups configured to accept a proton from an acid site of the multiplicity of acid sites. The catalyst composition can be used to dehydrate lactic acid, a lactic acid ester, a lactic acid salt, or a combination thereof, to yield a product comprising acrylic acid, an acrylic acid ester, an acrylic acid salt, or a combination thereof.

title_en: Enhanced sophorolipid derivatives
abstract_en: Novel sophorolipid derivatives with enhanced antimicrobial activity have been identified as disinfecting active ingredients. These derivatives are produced through a fermentation of Starmerella bombicola utilizing dextrose and an oleochemical feedstock that is high in oleic acid. A two-step synthetic scheme is used to generate a reactive aldehyde handle and then install nature-derived cationic biodegradable functional groups. These cationic sophorolipid derivatives are purified using ion exchange resins to afford high purity sophorolipid derivative salts for formulation into disinfecting consumer products.

title_en: Vinylated keto esters with applicability in signal enhanced magnetic resonance imaging and synthesis thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vinyl keto ester and intermediates of its synthesis, wherein the vinyl moiety of the vinyl hydroxy ester and of the intermediates is partly or fully deuterated. Furthermore, the present invention relates to two alternative methods of preparing said vinyl keto ester. The first method is a multi-step approach comprising the steps of providing a carboxylic acid that comprises a geminal diol moiety protected by a photolabile protecting group, vinylating said carboxylic acid using vinyl acetate, and cleaving the protecting group by applying UV light. The second method is a one-step approach of reacting a carboxylic acid that comprises an additional carbonyl moiety with acetylene in the presence of a metal catalyst. In both methods, the compounds used may be fully or partly deuterated.

title_en: Lipid nanoparticle compositions for delivering circular polynucleotides
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are novel lipids that can be used in combination with other lipid components, such as helper lipids, structural lipids, and cholesterols, to form lipid nanoparticles for delivery of therapeutic agents, such as nucleic acids (e.g., circular polynucleotides), both in vitro and in vivo.

title_en: Ifenprodil salts and therapeutic uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ifenprodil salt selected from the group consisting of ifenprodil oleate, ifenprodil nicotinate, ifenprodil pamoate, ifenprodil fumarate, and ifenprodil benzoate for the treatment of diseases or conditions associated with NR2B receptor activity in animals, in particular humans.

title_en: Compounds and their use in treating cancer
abstract_en: Compounds of Formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof are PROTAC compounds useful in the treatment of prostate cancer.

title_en: Process for producing alkyl sulfonic acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for producing alkyl sulfonic acid in a reaction apparatus (41) which contains a liquid phase comprising aqueous nitric acid, wherein dialkyl disulfide is fed into the liquid phase in the reaction apparatus (41) and a crude reaction product is formed in the reaction apparatus (41) by chemical reaction of tire dialkyl disulfide with the nitric acid, wherein feeding the dialkyl disulfide comprises at least one of: - the liquid dialkyl disulfide is fed into tire reaction apparatus (41) through an orifice (28, 29; 33) having a hydraulic diameter of less than 5 mm; - the liquid dialkyl disulfide is fed into the reaction apparatus (41) with an inlet velocity of at least 0.6 m/s.

title_en: Compositions
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are compositions that are formulated for topical use. The compositions may comprise microparticles, at least one bioactive compound, and optionally a penetration enhancer. Also disclosed herein are uses of the compositions for a method of treatment, comprising the administration of the composition to at least a portion of skin on a subject in need thereof. The compositions may be formulated for cosmeceutical purposes excluding skin malignancies.

title_en: Sunscreen agents containing titanium dioxide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sunscreen agent containing titanium dioxide. In particular, the present invention relates to a cosmetic preparation comprising: a) 2-ethylhexyl 2-cyano-3, 3-diphenylacrylate (octocrylene), b) ethanol, and c) titanium dioxide in the rutile crystal structure having a primary particle diameter of 2 to 100 nm.

title_en: Silicone-modified photoinitiators and photocurable adhesive compositions thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an organosilicon-modified photoinitiator represented by formula (I), wherein a substituent R is 1 、R 2 、R 3 、R 4 、R 6 、R 7 SIL2 is as described herein.

title_en: Liquiritigenin separation and purification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicine extraction, and discloses a method for separating and purifying liquiritigenin. Adding a mixed solvent of 1.4-dioxane and a solvent I or reflux extraction of 1.4-dioxane into a liquorice raw material, filtering, concentrating to obtain liquiritigenin enriched liquid, adding a solvent II, and crystallizing to obtain a crude liquiritigenin product; and adding a third solvent into the crude liquiritigenin product until the crude liquiritigenin product is completely dissolved, adding a fourth solvent, recrystallizing and filtering to obtain the liquiritigenin. The invention uses 1.4-dioxane and other proper solvents to form a solvent system for separating and purifying the liquiritigenin, realizes the preparation process of the liquiritigenin with higher purity and yield by a simple and effective solvent extraction process, has low requirements on equipment and reagents in the whole method, uses common and easily-obtained reagents, has simple equipment, realizes standardization and automation of the process easily, and can realize industrialized production.

title_en: Phosphorus-based sensor for detecting multiple solvents
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to monitoring an environment for the presence of a solvent by: (i) exposing the environment to the luminescent compound, wherein the relative fluorescence emission intensity of the luminescent compound changes upon interaction with the solvent; and (ii) monitoring a change in the relative fluorescence emission intensity of the luminescent compound, wherein the absence of the change indicates that the solvent is absent from the environment, and wherein the presence of the change indicates that the solvent is present in the environment. The luminescent compounds include a phosphorus atom having one or more carboxyl groups, where the carboxyl groups are coordinated with one or more metal ions (e.g., lanthanide ions and yttrium ions). The present disclosure also relates to a sensor for monitoring an environment for the presence of a solvent, wherein the sensor comprises one or more of the above luminescent compounds.

title_en: Compound, synthesis method thereof, kit prepared from compound and application of kit in glutathione detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound, a synthesis method thereof, a kit prepared by using the compound and application thereof in glutathione detection, wherein the compound is 7- (2-acylthiophene) -3H-phenoxazine-3-one, the compound is prepared by uniformly mixing 7-hydroxyphenyloxazinone sodium salt shown in a formula II and 2-thiophenecarbonyl chloride shown in a formula III in the presence of a catalyst for reaction, the compound can be used as a fluorescent probe, and the kit can be applied to the field of detection of endogenous glutathione and glutathione in cell lysate. And the kit of the compound is glutathione detection equipment with excellent performance and convenient use, and is expected to provide a powerful research tool for relevant fields of modern biology, physiology, medicine and the like.

title_en: Method for synthesizing aryl alkyl ether
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical industry, and particularly discloses a method for synthesizing aryl alkyl ether (Ar-O-R). The method takes aromatic phenol, strong alkaline solution and alkyl sulfate as raw materials, and completes the synthesis of asymmetric aryl alkyl ether through the processes of high-speed mixing, high-temperature reaction, pH regulation, liquid phase separation, oil phase alkaline washing, water phase alkaline distillation and the like. Compared with the traditional synthetic method, the method has the advantages of greatly shortened reaction time, high utilization rate of the sulfate, adoption of a material circulation process, 100% utilization rate of the aromatic phenol and more than 99% purity of the product.

title_en: Method for propylene disproportionation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for propylene disproportionation, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art is single, the technology for preparing propylene by disproportionation of ethylene and butylene can not be flexibly adjusted along with the fluctuation of product price in the market, and a catalyst in the propylene disproportionation reaction is easy to inactivate. The invention adopts the technical scheme that the metathesis catalyst and the isomerization catalyst are combined to be used on the same fixed bed reaction device and the same feeding process flow, thereby not only being capable of taking propylene as a raw material to prepare ethylene and butylene by self-disproportionation, but also being capable of taking the ethylene and the butylene as the raw material to prepare the propylene, and better solving the problem. The method can flexibly modulate the product structure according to the fluctuation of the product price on the market, the device, the catalyst and the process flow in the modulation process are kept unchanged, the economic cost is low, and the method can be used for the industrial production of the propylene disproportionation reaction.

title_en: Device and method for preparing tin-sugar intermediate through reactive distillation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for preparing a tin-sugar intermediate by reactive distillation, which comprises an E1 falling film evaporator, a V1 vapor-liquid separator, an E2 cyclohexane condenser, a V2 cyclohexane collecting tank, a P1 sugar liquid conveying pump, a T1 reactive distillation tower, an E4 tower top condenser, a V3 reflux tank, a P4 reflux pump, a DMF recycling station, a P2 tower bottom circulating pump, a P3 tower bottom extraction pump, an E3A reboiler and an E3B reboiler. Also discloses a method for preparing the tin-sugar intermediate by reactive distillation; the method utilizes the principle of reactive distillation to extract DMF and water from the top of the tower and to extract a relatively pure mixed solution of the tin-sugar intermediate and the DMF from the bottom of the tower, the water content is less than 2000ppm, the use amount of the DMF is greatly reduced, and the process is strong in controllability, continuous and stable.

title_en: Photo-thermal catalyst, preparation method thereof and method for catalyzing cyclohexane oxidation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for catalyzing cyclohexane oxidation, which comprises the following steps: cyclohexane reacts under the action of a light source and a photo-thermal catalyst to obtain KA oil; the catalyst comprises the catalyst in the technical scheme. Wherein the catalyst comprises a silver nanoparticle-supported monolayer of hydrated tungsten trioxide nanoplates. The catalyst and the method for catalyzing cyclohexane oxidation have the advantages that the catalyst synthesis method is simple, high-efficiency and easy to separate, the catalyst is adopted to catalyze cyclohexane, the selectivity is high, the selectivity is good, and the requirements of reaction on equipment and conditions are low.

title_en: Resin catalyst treatment process for preparing caprolactam through liquid phase Beckmann rearrangement
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin catalyst treatment process for preparing caprolactam through liquid phase Beckmann rearrangement, which comprises the following steps of 1) weighing resin, putting the resin into a reactor, pouring strong acid solution into a container, starting stirring, reacting for a period of time at room temperature, stopping stirring, and washing to be neutral by deionized water; after the reaction is finished, drying the resin; 2) putting the resin obtained in the step 1) into the reactor again, pouring the hydrofluoric acid solution into the reactor, starting stirring, reacting for a period of time at room temperature, stopping stirring, and washing with deionized water to be neutral; and after the reaction is finished, drying the resin to obtain the modified resin catalyst. The invention fundamentally solves the problem of lower yield of caprolactam prepared by resin in the previous research, and greatly saves the cost. Because the post-treatment temperature of the resin catalyst is room temperature, the post-treatment process is simple and easy to implement, and the development direction of national energy conservation and emission reduction is met.

title_en: Organic compound, light-emitting element, light-emitting device, electronic device, and lighting device
abstract_en: A novel substance which enables the life and emission efficiency of a light-emitting element to be increased is provided. Provided is a carbazole compound having a structure represented by general formula (G1). It should be noted that as each substituent (specifically, R) in the general formula (G1), a substituent capable of making the HOMO level of the compound deep and a substituent capable of making the LUMO level shallow are used, respectively 1 ,R 2 ,Ar 3 And alpha 3 ) Wherein the bond of the substituent is substituted with hydrogen. Further, as each substituent (specifically, R1) in the general formula (G1), a substituent capable of making the band gap (Bg) of the compound wide and the T1 level high is used 1 ,R 2 ,Ar 3 And alpha 3 ) Wherein the bond of the substituent is substituted with hydrogen.

title_en: Novel crystal form of biphenyl nucleoside phosphoramidate compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel crystal form of a biphenyl nucleoside phosphoramidate compound and a preparation method thereof. In particular, the invention relates to a crystal form and a preparation method of (S) -2- [ [ [ (S) - (1,1' -biphenyl-4-oxy) ] - [ ((2R,3R,4R,5R) -5- (2, 4-dioxo-3, 4-dihydropyrimidin-1 (2H) -yl) -4-fluoro-3-hydroxy-4-methyltetrahydrofuran-2-yl) methoxy ] phosphoryl ] amino ] isopropyl propionate, wherein the crystal form has excellent antiviral activity and low toxicity to cells, and can be used for treating flaviviridae virus, especially hepatitis C virus infection.

title_en: Benzoxazine oxazolidinone compound containing tetrahydropyridine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benzoxazine oxazolidinone compound containing tetrahydropyridine, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing infectious diseases caused by mycobacterium tuberculosis. In particular, the invention relates to a compound shown as a formula (I) and a stereoisomer thereof, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, wherein X, R 1 、R 2 As described in the specification. The present invention aims to prepare novel compounds having anti-mycobacterium tuberculosis activity, which are potential novel drugs, and at the same time, can be used to overcome the problems associated with drug resistance of mycobacterium tuberculosis, and improve the metabolic properties of drugs and enhance safety while maintaining anti-mycobacterium tuberculosis activity.

title_en: Metal amino acid complexes for bacterial aggregation
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods of promoting the aggregation and/or immune clearance of oral bacteria using oral care compositions comprising metal-amino acid complexes.

title_en: Cleaning agent composition for pump bubbler
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide: further improved foam quality, low temperature stability and excellent cleaning performance. The present invention provides a detergent composition which is discharged from a foamer container and contains (a) lauryl dimethyl glycine betaine and (b) 4-15 mass% of a higher fatty acid soap composed of a fatty acid having 5-25 carbon atoms, wherein the fatty acid having 5-25 carbon atoms comprises: (b-1) 30 to 80 mass% of lauric acid based on the total weight of fatty acids forming the higher fatty acid soap, (b-2) 5 to 30 mass% of myristic acid based on the total weight of fatty acids forming the higher fatty acid soap, and (b-3) 5 to 35 mass% of at least one selected from palmitic acid and stearic acid based on the total weight of fatty acids forming the higher fatty acid soap, wherein the ratio [ (a)/(b) ] of the amount of lauryl dimethyl amino acetic acid betaine (a) to the amount of higher fatty acid soap (b) is in the range of 0.4 to 1.5.

title_en: Block copolymer of cyclic ester and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel methods for preparing block polyester copolymers while precisely controlling the steric configuration (e.g., tacticity) of the chemical composition and/or the length of each unit (block). The present invention also provides block polyester copolymers characterized by desired combinations of two or more blocks having different stereo configurations (e.g., tacticity), chemical compositions and/or lengths, including tri-, tetra-and higher block copolymers. The invention also provides a family of novel organometallic magnesium complexes and various uses thereof in the preparation of polyesters and block polyester copolymers.

title_en: Industrial process for the preparation of (5S,10S) -10-benzyl-16-methyl-11, 14, 18-trioxo-15, 17, 19-trioxa-2, 7, 8-trithia-12-azaheneicosane-5-ammonium (E) -3-carboxy acrylate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an industrial process for the preparation of (5S,10S) -10-benzyl-16-methyl-11, 14, 18-trioxo-15, 17, 19-trioxa-2, 7, 8-trithia-12-azaheneicosane-5-ammonium (E) -3-carboxy acrylate of formula (I): wherein X ‑ Is fumarate. The process comprises the following continuous key steps: kinetic resolution, formation of disulfide compounds, peptide coupling and anion exchange reactions to obtain the desired product of formula (I).

title_en: Preparation method and application of tetrastigma hemsleyanum Diels et Gilg oligosaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and discloses a preparation method of tetrastigma hemsleyanum michaux oligosaccharide and an application preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) picking whole plant of radix tetrastigme, washing, drying in the sun, drying to constant weight, pulverizing, and sieving; weighing coarse powder of radix tetrastigme, adding into an ethanol solution, and performing ultrasonic extraction; carrying out suction filtration, and discarding filtrate; 2) adding the filter residue into double distilled water for reflux extraction, filtering the extracting solution after each extraction, combining the filtrates, concentrating under reduced pressure, and removing protein by Sevag method; 3) adding ethanol solution into the deproteinized extracting solution, standing overnight, centrifuging, and removing precipitate; adding ethanol solution into the supernatant, precipitating again, standing overnight, centrifuging, and drying the precipitate under reduced pressure to obtain radix Apioris Fortunei oligosaccharide. The tetrastigma hemsleyanum michaux oligosaccharide prepared by the method is safe and nontoxic, has the effects of resisting tumors, improving intestinal flora, protecting gastrointestinal tracts and the like, and expands the medicinal application of the tetrastigma hemsleyanum hemsle.

title_en: Hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material, preparation method thereof and application of hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material in synthesis of 2, 5-dimethylfuran
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material, which is a solid catalytic material obtained by taking a porous metal organic framework as a carrier, introducing a palladium simple substance by a dipping-reduction method and then treating the palladium simple substance by a polydimethylsiloxane coating. The invention also discloses a method for preparing 2, 5-dimethylfuran by selectively catalyzing hexose with the hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material, which comprises the following steps: dissolving hexose in alcohol, taking hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material as a catalyst and polymethylhydrosiloxane as a hydrogen donor, and reacting for 0.25-12 h at 70-130 ℃ under the action of an acidic additive; wherein the hexose concentration in the alcohol is 0.2-10 wt%, and the hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material contains Pd in an amount of 0.1-5 mol% relative to the hexose. The hydrophobic palladium/metal organic framework material has stable structure, and the catalytic efficiency is obviously higher than that of the commercial palladium carbon and common palladium/metal organic framework material under the same condition.

title_en: 2-imino-3- (4-nitrophenyl) -6- [2- (4-nitrophenyl) azo ] benzopyran
abstract_en: The invention discloses 2-imino-3- (4-nitrophenyl) -6- [2- (4-nitrophenyl) azo ] benzopyran. The plane conjugated molecule 2-imino-3- (4-nitrophenyl) -6- [2- (4-nitrophenyl) azo ] benzopyran provided by the invention is used as an electron acceptor material of a photovoltaic cell, and the contact area between an electron donor and an electron acceptor is increased, the diffusion distance of excitons is shortened, and the short-circuit current, the filling factor and the photoelectric conversion rate of the photovoltaic cell are improved through the pi-pi stacking effect between the electron donor material and the electron acceptor material; the manufacturing cost of the photovoltaic cell is reduced. An environment-friendly benzopyran derivative preparation method. By using the method, the synthesis cost of the benzopyran derivative is greatly reduced, and the application of the benzopyran derivative to photovoltaic cell materials is promoted.

title_en: 6-aryl-4-morpholin-1-ylpyridinone compounds useful for the treatment of cancer and diabetes
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel 6-aryl or 6-heteroaryl 4-morpholin-4-yl-pyridin-2-one compounds of formula (I), pharmaceutical compositions containing such compounds, and methods for using such compounds in the treatment of diseases including cancer, diabetes, inflammatory diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, cardiovascular disorders, and viral infections; wherein R is 1 、R 2 、R 3 And R 4 As defined in the specification.

title_en: Imidazole derivative having JNK inhibitory activity and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel imidazole derivative having C-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK) inhibitory activity and use thereof. The novel imidazole derivatives or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof according to the present invention show excellent inhibitory activity against C-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), and thus, it is predicted that more basic methods and targeted therapies may be employed in the prevention or treatment of degenerative cranial nervous system diseases.

title_en: 18/19F labeled compounds targeting prostate specific membrane antigen
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to novel compounds comprising zwitterionic trifluoroborate prosthetic groups that target Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA), such as prostate specific membrane antigen in prostate cancer. The compounds have the formula I, wherein each R1 is an anionic group, L is a linker, and R2B-F3 is-N (R) 3 ) 2 CH 2 BF 3 Is BF 3 Or methyl BF 3 A substituted pyridinium group, or an azole group substituted with methyl BF 3. Methods and uses for imaging and treating PSMA-expressing cancers are also disclosed.

title_en: Preparation method of 4,4' -di (2-bromoacetyl) biphenyl
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of 4,4' -di (2-bromoacetyl) biphenyl, comprising the following steps of (1) reacting bromoacetyl bromide with biphenyl in the presence of chlorinated alkane solvent and catalyst, thereby obtaining a first mixed system; (2) Providing an anti-solvent to react with the first mixed system, so as to obtain a second mixed system containing 4,4' -di (2-bromoacetyl bromide) biphenyl; (3) And (3) treating the second mixed system obtained in the step (2) to obtain 4,4' -bis (2-bromoacetyl bromide) biphenyl. The method has simple process and safe operation, avoids the use of toxic solvents, effectively inhibits the generation of monosubstituted byproducts, has the yield of the obtained product of more than 80 percent and the purity of 99.0 percent, and is a route applicable to industrial production.

title_en: Lapatiquinone compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to three novel lapachone compounds extracted from metabolites of endophytic microorganisms of fusarium, namely a compound I1-methoxyfusanaphthoquinones A, a compound II 5-dehydroxylolanol and a compound III 1-dehydroxylolanol; the invention is prepared from rhodiola sachalinensis (rhodiola rosea) Rhodiola angusta Nakai) microorganisms of the genus Fusarium endophytic in the leaf part ( Fusarium sp . HJT-P-5) as raw material, and obtaining three novel lapachone compounds by solvent extraction and separation by various chromatographic methods; the novel lapachone compound and the preparation method thereof have very important significance in research and development of antitumor drugs.

title_en: Cu-series catalyst precursor, method for regulating and controlling crystallinity of crystal phase of Cu-series catalyst precursor, Cu-series catalyst and preparation method of Cu-series catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of catalyst preparation, and discloses a Cu-series catalyst precursor, a method for regulating and controlling the crystallinity of a crystal phase of the Cu-series catalyst precursor, a Cu-series catalyst and a preparation method of the Cu-series catalyst, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sequentially washing and drying a Cu-based catalyst precursor prepared by a coprecipitation method, and controlling the drying process to regulate the crystal phase crystallinity of the Cu-based catalyst precursor to contain 5-80 wt% of crystal phase hydrotalcite-like compound, wherein the drying mode is a slow drying method or a quick drying method, and the slow drying method comprises drying the precursor at 40-120 ℃ for 10-100 hours; the quick drying method comprises the step of introducing the precursor into a spray dryer for drying at the temperature of 140-200 ℃. By adopting the method, the crystallinity of the crystal phase of the Cu-based catalyst precursor can be effectively regulated, so that the crystallinity of different phases in the coprecipitation precursor mixture can be effectively regulated, and the specific surface area, the activity and the stability of the catalyst are further increased.

title_en: 7-substituted amino-4-methylcoumarin derivative, preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and relates to 7-substituted amino-4-methylcoumarin derivatives, a preparation method thereof, and application of the derivatives as therapeutic agents in medical treatment, in particular to medical application of the derivatives as ALDH1A1 inhibitors in aspects of reducing blood sugar and the like.

title_en: Near-infrared fluorescent dye containing 4-dicyanomethylbenzopyran unit, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near-infrared fluorescence imaging agent containing 4-dicyanomethyl benzopyran and triphenylamine and a preparation method thereof. A modifiable group is introduced on triphenylamine of the fluorescent compound, and the added modifiable sites can be used for connecting different bioactive substances, so that the water solubility and the biocompatibility of the fluorescent compound are improved, and the application range of the fluorescent compound in the field of biomedicine is expanded. The fluorescence imaging agent has the advantages of high fluorescence intensity, no toxicity, good biocompatibility and the like, and has a good application prospect. The invention also discloses application of the fluorescence imaging agent in the field of tumor imaging. In addition, the imaging agent has good modifiability, and can be used for in vitro detection of various disease markers.

title_en: Middle-low pressure steam heating process and device in crude benzene distillation system
abstract_en: The device comprises a low-pressure steam heat exchanger, an oil-rich heat exchanger, a benzene removal tower and a regenerator; the external medium-pressure superheated steam pipeline is connected with an inlet at one side of the low-pressure steam heat exchanger, an outlet at one side of the low-pressure steam heat exchanger is connected with an inlet at one side of the rich oil heat exchanger, and an outlet at one side of the rich oil heat exchanger is connected with an external condensate water system; the external low-pressure steam pipeline is connected with the inlet of the other side of the low-pressure steam heat exchanger, and the outlet of the other side of the low-pressure steam heat exchanger is connected with the regeneration steam inlet of the regenerator; the external rich oil pipeline is connected with the inlet at the other side of the rich oil heat exchanger, and the outlet at the other side of the rich oil heat exchanger is connected with the rich oil inlet at the middle part of the benzene removal tower. The invention adopts steam heating to replace a tube furnace for heating and debenzolization, saves a great amount of fuel gas consumption, avoids the emission of nitrogen oxides and sulfur oxides, reduces the phenomenon of rich oil coking, and reduces the consumption of washing oil. The medium-pressure superheated steam and the low-pressure steam are adopted for combined heating, and about 40% of high-quality medium-pressure superheated steam is saved.

title_en: Thiazole derivative compound with IDO (indomethacin diphosphate) inhibitory activity, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemistry, in particular to thiazole derivative compounds with IDO (indoleamine-2, 3-dioxygenase) inhibitory activity, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention discloses thiazole derivative compounds with IDO (indoleamine-2, 3-dioxygenase) inhibitory activity, a preparation method of the thiazole derivative compounds and application of the thiazole derivative compounds in preparing antitumor drugs. Thiazole derivatives having IDO (indoleamine-2, 3-dioxygenase) inhibitory activity of the present invention have the general formula: wherein R represents H or 1-4 same or different F, cl, CF  3  ，CN，NO  2  . A series of thiazole derivative compounds are prepared by an organic synthesis method, and activity tests show that the series of compounds have IDO (indoleamine-2, 3-dioxygenase) inhibition activity and have application prospects in preparation of antitumor drugs.

title_en: Butynediol semi-hydrogenation bimetallic catalyst, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a butynediol semi-hydrogenation bimetallic catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst takes noble metal-non-noble metal as an active component, and the general formula can be expressed as M1-M2-M2O/S, wherein M1 represents one of Pd, Ru, Pt or Au, M2 represents one of Ni, Cu, Fe or Co, and S represents an inert carrier; in the catalyst composition, the weight ratio of M1 is 0.1-1%, the total weight ratio of M2 is 0.5-10%, and the balance is a carrier. The catalyst is applied to the selective semi-hydrogenation reaction of 1, 4-butynediol, the reaction conversion rate is as high as 100%, and the selectivity of the product butenediol is also as high as 100%, so that a plurality of obstacles in subsequent product separation are reduced to a great extent; and the reaction is carried out at normal temperature and normal pressure, the condition is mild, and compared with the conventional high-temperature high-pressure reaction condition, the requirement and the danger on reaction equipment are greatly reduced, so that the equipment cost and the production cost are greatly reduced.

title_en: Red light luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to synthesis and property determination of a red light luminescent material, which can effectively realize red light emission and belongs to the field of coordination chemistry of inorganic chemistry. The molecular formula is: c 40 H 22 Br 4 N 4 O 4 Pt 2 The molecular weight is: 1332.42, respectively; pt 2 L 3 Is a 3,3',4,4' -biphenyltetramine condensed 3-bromosalicylaldehyde platinum complex. The maximum ultraviolet absorption wavelength of the novel red light luminescent material designed by the invention is 554nm, the maximum phosphorescence emission wavelength is 642nm, and the decomposition temperature is 348 ℃. The highest occupied orbital (HOMO) energy level of the molecule of the luminescent material is-5.41 eV, the lowest unoccupied orbital (LUMO) energy level is-3.33 eV, and the preparation method adopted by the material is simple in reaction operation and mild in condition, and can be applied to the field of electroluminescence as a photoelectric material.

title_en: Calcium-metal-based organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a calcium-metal organic framework-based material, a preparation method and application thereof, which utilize Ca (NO) 3 ) 2 ·4H 2 O is used as an inorganic ion node, and the rigid and symmetrical (1,1':4', 1' -terphenyl-3, 3 ', 5,5 ' -tetracarboxylic acid) is used as an organic bridging ligand to be prepared and synthesized by adopting a simple one-pot method solvothermal technical means, wherein the chemical general formula is { [ Ca ] 1.5 (HL 1 )(DMF) 2 ]DMF }. The metal organic framework material provided by the invention is a novel porous coordination polymer fluorescent material with low toxicity, high chemical stability and good water solubility, and can be used as a chemical sensor to realize specific recognition of object molecules and ions. The invention also discloses a method for high-selectivity and high-sensitivity detection of L-cysteine based on a metal organic framework material as a fluorescent probe and a preparation and synthesis process of the metal organic framework material.

title_en: Ester compound and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided is a compound having excellent pest control efficacy. An ester compound represented by the general formula [ formula 1] and a pest control agent and a pest control method using the same](I) Represents: [ in the formula, R 1 Represents a hydrogen atom or a methyl group, R 1 R represents a methyl group 2 Also represents methyl, and R 1 R represents a hydrogen atom 2 Is represented by the following general formula [ formula 2]](II) (wherein X and Y are the same or different and each represents a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, a cyano group, an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms, an alkoxycarbonyl group having 2 to 5 carbon atoms or a haloalkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms), R 3 Represents a hydrogen atom, trifluoromethyl, methyl, methoxy, methoxymethyl, allyl, ethynyl or propargyl, R 4 R represents a fluorine atom 5 Represents an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms, or R 4 R represents an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms 5 Is represented by the formula 4 Same substituent]。

title_en: Method for preparing succinic acid by succinate anaerobic fermentation liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing succinic acid from succinate anaerobic fermentation liquor, which belongs to the field of biochemical separation. The purity of the recrystallized succinic acid can reach 99.5 percent, the nitrogen content is lower than 40 mu g/g, the light transmittance is higher than 99.5 percent, and the yield after circulation can reach more than 90 percent and is higher than the yield of 80 percent in the prior art.

title_en: Maleimide compound containing substituted or unsubstituted allyl group, process for producing the same, composition using the maleimide compound, and cured product
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound having a low melting point and excellent heat resistance. A maleimide compound containing a substituted or unsubstituted allyl group, characterized in that it is represented by the following formula (1) (in the formula (1), n and m are each independently an integer of 1 to 5, Aly is a group containing a substituted or unsubstituted allyl group represented by the following formula (2), wherein in the formula (2), Z is a hydrocarbon group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms directly bonded or optionally having a substituent, R is a group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms 1 、R 2 And R 3 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom or a methyl group, and MI is a maleimido group represented by the following formula (3), wherein R in the formula (3) 4 And R 5 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom or a methyl group, A represents a structure containing 2 benzene rings represented by the following formula (4-1) or (4-2), in which case the benzene rings optionally have a substituent, and X represents a direct bond or a 2-valent linking group. ).

title_en: Nitrite radical detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nitrite detection method, which uses a binuclear ruthenium complex as a visible light or near infrared light color developing agent for detecting nitrite, wherein the cation of the binuclear ruthenium complex has a structure shown as a formula I. The nitrite detection method is convenient and easy to implement, high in sensitivity and strong in anti-interference performance, and can be used for quickly detecting nitrite.

title_en: SnO (stannic oxide)2Solid alkali/MgAl-LDO (magnesium aluminum oxide-low dropout regulator) and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Synthesizing SnO with hydrotalcite structure by combining hydrotalcite induced hydrolysis and heat treatment rehydration method 2 (Ⅱ) the/MgAl-LDO solid base is used for catalyzing the condensation reaction of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural and acetone to synthesize an aviation fuel intermediate (E) -4- (5-hydroxymethyl-2-furyl) -3-butene-2-ketone, and the condensation reaction of the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, the acetone and SnO 2 The mass ratio of (II)/MgAl-LDO solid base is 1:4.6:0.1, the reaction temperature is 100 ℃, the reaction time is 2 hours, the product yield is 98.76%, the acetone self-condensation byproduct yield is less than 1%, stannous chloride is used as a tin source, the preparation cost is low, the catalytic activity is high, the stability is good, and the tin source can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Method for recovering propane from tail gas in polypropylene device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for recovering propane from tail gas generated by a polypropylene device. The method comprises the steps of directly conveying propane and triethyl aluminum at the bottom of a tail gas recovery tower to a quenching tower of a methanol-to-olefin device, and treating the triethyl aluminum by using water vapor in reaction gas of the quenching tower, so as to replace the original method of adding desalted water to hydrolyze the triethyl aluminum in the tail gas when the tail gas leaves a polypropylene device, and then cleaning the triethyl aluminum through a filter, thereby finally achieving the purpose of recovering the propane. The method provided by the invention reduces the labor intensity of workers, has high propane recovery efficiency and has no potential safety hazard.

title_en: Eyebrow pencil liquid and its production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses eyebrow pencil liquid and a production process thereof, wherein the eyebrow pencil liquid comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-90 parts of deionized water; 1.5-10 parts of a surfactant; 1-5 parts of bis-PEG-18 methyl ether dimethylsilane; 2-4 parts of glycerol; 0.02-0.05 part of sodium phytate; 0.2-0.3 part of pigment; the surfactant comprises at least two of PEG-20 glycerol triisostearate, polyglycerol-10 laurate and C14-16 olefin sodium sulfonate; also comprises pH regulator to make pH of eyebrow pencil liquid 6-6.5. The eyebrow pencil liquid has the advantages of smooth smearing process and uniform smearing color.

title_en: Method and device for preparing lycopene nano powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for preparing lycopene nano powder. The device consists of a raw material dissolver and a crystallization separator. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving lycopene in the lycopene raw material using supercritical carbon dioxide fluid; reducing the pressure and temperature of the supercritical carbon dioxide fluid dissolved with lycopene in a crystallization separator to form a subcritical state or a gaseous state, and crystallizing and separating out the lycopene in the supercritical carbon dioxide fluid; the particle size of lycopene crystal is controlled by adjusting the dissolving pressure and temperature of lycopene in carbon dioxide solvent, and the crystallization pressure and temperature difference, so as to prepare nano powder. The device and the method provided by the invention can prepare the lycopene in the lycopene raw material (with the content of 1-99 percent and the W/W) into powder with the particle size of 10nm-2 mu m. The solvent used in the method is carbon dioxide, the product safety is strong, the operation is safe, the environment is friendly, and the method is suitable for various food-grade lycopene raw materials, such as: comprises extracts of biological origin and chemical synthetics.

title_en: Method for producing perfluoroalkyl compound using monohydroperfluoroalkane as starting material
abstract_en: Provided is a simple process for producing a perfluoroalkyl compound which is a starting material of a monohydroperfluoroalkane and forms an important intermediate for organic electronic materials, pharmaceuticals, agricultural chemicals, functional polymer materials, and the like. An alcohol having a perfluoroalkyl group is produced by reacting a carbonyl compound with a base and a monohydroperfluoroalkane. For example, potassium hydroxide is reacted with trifluoromethane to react with a carbonyl compound, thereby producing an alcohol having a trifluoromethyl group.

title_en: Process for preparing spiroketal-substituted cyclic ketoenols
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel process for preparing spiroketal-substituted cyclic ketoenols which are useful as insecticides, acaricides or herbicides. Another subject of the invention is a novel intermediate for the preparation of spiroketal-substituted cyclic ketoenols.

title_en: 5' S-LNA nucleotides and oligonucleotides
abstract_en: The invention relates to compounds of formula (I) Wherein R is  2  And R  4  Combined together to form a group such as-CH  2  O-is formed. The compound of formula (I) may be used to prepare 5' S-LNA oligonucleotides as antisense drugs.

title_en: Method for preparing perfluoroolefin with high selectivity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fluorine-containing chemical preparation, and particularly relates to a method for preparing perfluoroolefin with high selectivity. The method comprises the following steps: 1) cooling hexafluoropropylene/perfluorobutene, anhydrous villiaumite, anhydrous polar aprotic solvent and phase transfer catalyst to below-30 ℃, keeping the temperature below-30 ℃ and slowly stirring; 2) slowly heating the mixed solution in the step 1) to-20 ℃, and adding a perfluoroolefin reactant into the mixed solution; 3) slowly heating the mixed solution in the step 2) to 30-50 ℃, stirring for a certain time, standing for layering, and separating to obtain an organic fluorine phase, namely a product. The method for preparing perfluoroolefin with high selectivity can take hexafluoropropylene/perfluorobutene and perfluorobutene reactants as raw materials to react under the action of basic fluorinion to prepare perfluoroolefin containing two olefin structures with high selectivity, and the reaction can greatly inhibit the self-polymerization reaction of the same perfluoroolefin and has few byproducts.

title_en: Heterocyclic amides as protein modulators
abstract_en: The present application relates to heterocyclic amides useful as protein modulators. Specifically, the application discloses compounds having the formula (I-N), or tautomers thereof, or salts thereof, particularly pharmaceutically acceptable salts, wherein q, R, s, a, B, C, R A1 、R A2 、R B1 、R B2 、R C1 、R C2 、R 3 、R 4 、R 5 、R 6 、R 14 、R 15 、R 16 And R 17 As defined herein.

title_en: Organic small molecule containing boron-nitrogen coordination bond, preparation method thereof and application of organic small molecule to fluorine ion sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic small molecule containing boron-nitrogen coordination bonds, a preparation method thereof and application of the organic small molecule to fluorine ion sensing, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of fluorescent compounds and preparation of fluorescent probes thereof. The invention utilizes 2- (3-bromobenzothiophene) -2' -benzothiazole to react with n-butyllithium to generate a lithium reagent, and then the lithium reagent reacts with triphenylboron to prepare the micromolecule containing boron-nitrogen coordination bonds. Experiments prove that the micromolecules containing boron-nitrogen (BN) coordination bonds successfully realize the selective recognition of fluorine ions. The preparation method of the fluorescent compound containing boron-nitrogen (BN) coordinate bonds is simple and convenient to operate, and the prepared fluorescent probe has the characteristics of photochemical stability, good selectivity and the like.

title_en: Method for directly olefination of ortho-position of phenol compound and olefination of phenol compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for directly olefination of ortho positions of phenol compounds and an olefination phenol compound prepared by the method. The method comprises the following steps: reacting a phenol compound shown as a formula (II) with an olefin compound shown as a formula (III) in an acetic acid solvent at the temperature of 20-100 ℃ for 10-20 hours under the action of a catalyst and an oxidant, and separating and purifying reaction liquid after the reaction is finished to obtain an alkene phenol compound shown as a formula (I); the invention provides a method for direct alkylation of phenol by palladium catalysis, which has the advantages of simple operation process, easily obtained commercialized raw materials, cheap and easily obtained catalyst, environmental friendliness, mild reaction conditions, high site selectivity and high reaction efficiency, and can prepare the phenol derivatives by one step.

title_en: Extraction method of tea saponin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting tea saponin, which uses water as a solvent, particularly uses a cross-linking agent to inhibit swelling of starch, thereby only using water as the solvent, efficiently extracting tea saponin degreased tea-oil camellia cakes, inhibiting swelling of starch after the tea saponin degreased tea-oil camellia cakes are acted by the cross-linking agent in a water phase, heating the water to 60-90 ℃ without gelatinization, and then extracting to obtain a tea saponin finished product through solid-liquid separation, concentration and drying. The method has the advantages of simple preparation, environment-friendly process, no use of organic solvent, no influence on the environment, and good economic, environment-friendly and social benefits.

title_en: 3-methylpyrido [1,2-a ] pyrimidone derivative containing 1- ((4-substituted benzyl) oxy) and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3-methylpyrido [1,2-a ] containing 1- ((4-substituted benzyl) oxy)]Pyrimidone derivatives and application thereof, wherein the general formula is as follows: r 1 Is methoxy, ethoxy, chlorine, bromine; r 2 Is hydrogen, sec-butyl, ethyl, propyl, chloroethyl, benzyl, 2, 4-dichlorobenzyl, 2-chlorobenzyl, 3-chlorobenzyl, 4-trifluoromethylbenzyl, 2-chloropyridine-5-methylene, 2-chlorothiazole-5-methylene, 4-bromobenzyl, 2-methoxybenzyl, 3-methoxybenzyl; 2-fluorobenzyl, 2-cyanobenzyl, 4-cyanobenzyl, 2-methylbenzyl, 3-methylbenzyl or 4-methylbenzyl. The compound can prevent and treat bacterial leaf blight of rice and citrus canker.

title_en: Pyrazolylquinoline compounds, process for their preparation and pharmaceutical compositions containing them
abstract_en: A pyrazolyl quinoline compound comprising a quinolinyl group, a C6 position and a substituent R  1  Are connected, and R  1  Is a halogen atom; a pyrazolyl group; a first phenyl group; and a second group; wherein the C2 position of the quinolinyl is attached to the C3 or C5 position of the pyrazolyl; when, in the first instance, the C2 position of the quinolinyl is attached to the C3 position of the pyrazolyl, the C5 position of the pyrazolyl is attached to the C4 position of the first phenyl; and when in the second instance the C2 position of the quinolinyl is attached to the C5 position of the pyrazolyl, the C3 position of the pyrazolyl is attached to the C4 position of the first phenyl; and the N1 position of the pyrazolyl is attached to the C4 position of the second phenyl group.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel carboxylate or sulfonate having 2 or more carbonyl groups and a surfactant.
