title_en: Novel iridoid compound and preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structure, a preparation method and application of a novel iridoid compound in the field of anti-inflammation. The invention extracts, separates and purifies the overground part of the pteris vittata (Camptosorus sibiricus Rupr) of the family ferulaceae to obtain a new compound which is named as camptoside. Pharmacodynamic experiments show that the camptoside has a strong inhibition effect on the release of RAW264.7 macrophage NO induced by Lipopolysaccharide (LPS), and the compound is suggested to have a certain anti-inflammatory effect.

title_en: Method for preparing chlorogenic acid from potato peels
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-purity chlorogenic acid from potato peels, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural product waste utilization. The method for preparing high-purity chlorogenic acid mainly comprises the following steps: (1) drying and crushing fresh potato peels, and extracting with an ethanol solution; (2) concentrating the extract under reduced pressure to dryness, and separating and purifying with macroporous resin; (3) and purifying by high-speed counter-current chromatography to obtain the high-purity chlorogenic acid. The method changes waste into valuable, creatively adopts a high-speed counter-current chromatography preparation method to prepare the high-purity chlorogenic acid from the potato peels, and has short preparation time, high efficiency and high purity. In addition, the ethanol, ethyl acetate and acetic acid solvents used in the extraction, separation and preparation of chlorogenic acid substances have low toxicity and good volatility, and the obtained high-purity chlorogenic acid has no residue and can be used as an ingredient in the industries of food, cosmetics, health-care tea, edible oil and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of cis-4-methylcyclohexylamine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of cis-4-methylcyclohexylamine, and belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis. 4-methyl phenylboronic acid/ester is taken as a raw material, a cis-trans mixture is obtained by hydrogenation under the action of a rhodium carbon catalyst, then, the cis-4-methyl cyclohexylboronic acid/ester is obtained by recrystallization, and then, the cis-4-methyl cyclohexylamine is obtained by performing amine substitution reaction by adopting sulfamic acid and an alkali aqueous solution. The method is simple and convenient to operate, the catalyst can be used for 7 times, the reaction yield is high, the purity of the obtained cis-form product can reach more than 99.5 percent, and the method has a potential process amplification prospect.

title_en: Method for preparing styrene from toluene and trioxymethylene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing styrene from toluene and trioxymethylene, which at least comprises the following steps: introducing raw material gas containing toluene and trioxymethylene into a reactor, firstly contacting with a catalyst I to depolymerize the trioxymethylene into formaldehyde, and then contacting the obtained mixed gas with a catalyst II to carry out side-chain alkylation reaction to prepare styrene. The method uses formaldehyde generated by depolymerization of trioxymethylene to replace methanol as a side chain alkylating reagent, can effectively avoid hydrogen transfer reaction between styrene and methanol when the methanol is used as the alkylating reagent, improves the ratio of styrene to ethylbenzene in the product, and has the characteristics of high toluene conversion rate, high styrene selectivity in the product and the like.

title_en: Method for recycling acyclovir condensation by-product and solvent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycling method of acyclovir condensation reaction byproducts and a solvent, which utilizes sodium hydroxide for toluene drying to neutralize and recycle acetic anhydride in the next batch of toluene and reduces the consumption of sodium hydroxide for toluene recycling treatment; the sodium acetate and impurities in the recovered toluene are thoroughly removed by adopting a mode of multiple water washing and layering, so that the quality of the finally recovered toluene is ensured, and the quality of the recovered toluene meets the requirements of process use; the water washing layered water is recycled in a gradient way to improve the concentration of the sodium acetate in the water washing layered water, the gradient recycling sleeve uses water as a solvent for sodium hydroxide alkali washing neutralization, the concentration of the sodium acetate is maximized after alkali washing, the preparation of the sodium acetate is convenient, and the preparation cost of the sodium acetate is reduced; the mother liquor generated by the preparation of sodium acetate is repeatedly used, so that the generation of waste water is reduced; acid toluene washing layering water gradient circulation is applied mechanically to eliminate the generation of high-salt and high-COD wastewater.

title_en: Process for preparing analgin magnesium by one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for preparing analgin magnesium by a one-pot method, which comprises the steps of preparing 4-methylamino antipyrine, formaldehyde and magnesium saltOr oxides thereof, with SO  2  Gas reaction is carried out to obtain a 1-phenyl-2, 3-dimethyl-4-methylamino pyrazoline-5-ketone-N-methyl magnesium sulfonate crude product, and the crude product is further refined through recrystallization to obtain 1-phenyl-2, 3-dimethyl-4-methylamino pyrazoline-5-ketone-N-methyl magnesium sulfonate hexahydrate. The method has the advantages of simple process steps, cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, high yield of the synthesized analgin magnesium finished product, good quality and stable process, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Method for efficiently extracting soybean isoflavone from umbilicus
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for efficiently extracting soybean isoflavone from a soybean navel, which comprises the following steps of high-pressure extraction: adding the defatted soybean navel powder into an ethanol water solution, uniformly mixing, and raising the pressure to 0.120-0.155 MPa for extraction. The soybean hilum is firstly treated by high pressure, and then is continuously extracted by other modes after high pressure treatment is found, so that the extraction efficiency of the soybean isoflavone can be greatly improved.

title_en: Novel material with chiral optical activity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to materials having strong Circular Dichroism (CD), circular polarized fluorescence (CPL) and high fluorescence quantum yield in the aggregate state, and methods of making and using the same.

title_en: Preparation method of ultraviolet absorbent UV-3030
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ultraviolet absorbent UV-3030, and particularly relates to a preparation method which comprises the steps of firstly using benzophenone and methyl cyanoacetate as raw materials, toluene as a water-carrying solvent and ammonium acetate as a catalyst, synthesizing 2-cyano-3, 3-diphenyl methyl acrylate through Knoevenagel condensation reaction under the condition of continuously dividing water by adopting a water divider, and then carrying out ester exchange reaction with pentaerythritol under the catalytic action of LiOH to synthesize the ultraviolet absorbent UV-3030. The method has the advantages of simple process and operation, easily obtained raw materials, less side reaction, easy recovery and recycling of the solvent, high reaction efficiency, high yield and purity of the product, low cost, less wastewater discharge and the like.

title_en: Febuxostat-indomethacin co-amorphous substance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a febuxostat-indometacin co-amorphous substance and a preparation method thereof; the febuxostat and indometacin are mixed according to a molar ratio of 1:0.5 to 2, and no sharp diffraction peak is observed in the powder X-ray diffraction spectrum expressed by a degree 2 theta by using Cu-Ka radiation. The research shows that after febuxostat and indometacin are prepared into a co-amorphous substance, the dissolution rates of the two medicines are obviously improved compared with those of the bulk drugs, and the two medicines have the characteristic of synergistic release and have better application prospects. The mode of combined medication provides a new idea for the subsequent preparation research.

title_en: R9And R10Linked hydrophilic berberine type derivatives and their use in the preparation of medicaments
abstract_en: The invention discloses an 8-dihalo methyl berberine type quaternary ammonium salt compound shown as general formulas I and II, a synthetic method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicaments. Compared with a substrate, the 8-dihalo methyl berberine type compound shows more obvious hydrophilicity under the condition of not containing conventional hydrophilic groups; the 8-dihalo methyl berberine type compound has remarkable antimicrobial activity, anti-inflammatory activity, anti-ulcerative colitis activity and anti-tumor activity; has clear and obvious regulation and control effects on target molecules related to tumorigenesis in colon cancer, liver cancer, lung cancer, breast cancer, osteosarcoma and glioma tumor cells, and has obvious anti-tumor activity. The pharmacological action strength of the compound is higher than that of a contrast medicament, and the compound has the characteristics of no toxicity or low toxicity and can be used for preparing medicaments for preventing, relieving and/or treating microbial infection, inflammation, ulcerative colitis and tumors.

title_en: Organic light emitting diode material
abstract_en: The present application relates to organic light emitting diode materials. The present application relates to organic light emitting diode materials. The material may be a compound having formula I. The compounds are suitable for use in organic light emitting diodes. The compounds are also useful for charge transport and charge blocking layers and as hosts in the emissive layer of organic light emitting devices OLED.

title_en: Catalyst for synthesizing diaminomethylcyclohexane, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst for synthesizing diaminomethylcyclohexane, which comprises a carrier, and an active component and an auxiliary agent which are attached to the carrier; the active component is selected from one or more of metal Ru, Rh, Ni, Co, Pt and Pd, preferably, the active component is selected from one or more of metal Rh, Ni, Co, Pt and Pd and the metal Ru; the auxiliary agent comprises a first auxiliary agent and a second auxiliary agent, wherein the first auxiliary agent is selected from one or more of Mn, Cr, Li and Ca; the second auxiliary agent is selected from one or more of Fe, Cu, Zn, Ag, Sn, La and Ce. Compared with the prior art, the catalyst has high activity, good selectivity and long service life, and can catalyze the hydrogenation of the xylylenediamine to obtain the diaminomethylcyclohexane with high activity and high selectivity without adding liquid ammonia or alkali metal hydroxide as a deamination inhibitor in a reaction system.

title_en: Chromatographic analysis detection method for compounds in sea buckthorn extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chromatographic analysis detection method of a compound in a sea buckthorn extract, which adopts a liquid chromatography to carry out qualitative detection on the compound I, wherein the compound I is discovered for the first time and successfully separated and purified from the sea buckthorn extract. The compound I has the effect of inhibiting the activity of alpha-glucosidase, and the further research on the compound and the comprehensive development and utilization of the sea buckthorn are convenient.

title_en: Heterocyclic compound and organic light-emitting element comprising same
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterocyclic compound having a novel structure and an organic light-emitting element including the same.

title_en: Method for reducing nitroolefin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly discloses a method for reducing nitroolefin. Adding the compound 1 into a mixed solvent of alcohol and water in a certain proportion, adding metal borohydride at 0-50 ℃, and stirring for reaction; concentrating the obtained solution to constant weight, and adding ethyl acetate and saturated ammonium chloride solution into the concentrate; separating to obtain an upper ethyl acetate layer, drying and concentrating to obtain a reduction product compound 2. The synthesis method is suitable for both aromatic ring and straight-chain alkane, dimer impurities can be controlled to be below 3.0%, and HPLC (high performance liquid chromatography) purity of aliphatic or aromatic nitro compounds is controlled to be above 95.0%. The synthesis method has the advantages of low raw material price, green and environment-friendly process, economy and practicability, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Process for preparing pentenoate esters
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of a compound of formula (1) Wherein R is  1  Independently selected from C  1  ‑C  6  Alkyl, cycloalkyl, aralkyl and aryl, and R  2  、R  3  And R  4  Independently selected from hydrogen and C  1  ‑C  6  Alkyl, cycloalkyl, aralkyl, and aryl groups; the method comprises the following steps: a) Reacting a compound of formula (2) Wherein R is  1  And R  2  As above, and M  +  Is a monovalent metal ion, is contacted with a compound of formula (3) Wherein R is  3  And R  4  As above, to form the compound of formula (4) And b) subsequently contacting the compound of formula (4) with an acid to obtain the compound of formula (1), wherein step (a) and/or step (b) is performed in a continuous mode.

title_en: Synthesis method of 3-aryl thiopropionamide derivative
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthesis method of a 3-aryl thiopropionamide derivative, which comprises the following steps: the aryl propyne derivative is taken as a substrate, alkali is taken as an accelerant, elemental sulfur is taken as a sulfur source, and the reaction is carried out for 12 hours in a formamide solvent at the temperature of 100-120 ℃. The invention uses odorless, easily available and cheap elemental sulfur as a sulfur source, and has the advantages of simple and easily available raw materials, simple reaction operation, relatively mild conditions, wide substrate universality, higher yield and good functional group compatibility.

title_en: Method for synthesizing quinoxaline compound by double-protein catalytic cascade reaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biocatalytic synthesis, and particularly discloses a method for synthesizing quinoxaline compounds by a two-protein catalytic cascade reaction, which comprises the following steps: dissolving beta-ketonic acid ester compounds, substituted o-phenylenediamine and p-methyl benzenesulfonyl azide serving as reactants in a solvent, adding a catalyst and a surfactant, stirring for reaction to obtain a product, and then sequentially drying, concentrating and purifying to obtain the beta-ketonic acid ester compound; wherein the solvent is water, and the catalyst is porcine chymotrypsin lipase and bovine hemoglobin. The process is simple and convenient, the heme protein catalyzed carbene reaction and the lipase protein catalyzed reaction are coupled together, a green method for synthesizing the quinoxaline compound by a two-protein one-pot method is constructed, the target product can be quickly, simply and conveniently synthesized, and the synthesis is completed in water, so that the problems that the existing quinoxaline compound preparation method has more synthesis steps and is not green enough are solved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of film cloth with tremella as base material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method and application of a film cloth with tremella as a base material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a coating liquid containing tremella polysaccharide; and uniformly coating the coating liquid on the non-woven fabric, and drying to obtain the membrane cloth. The problem of current membrane cloth quality not high, the effect is not good has been solved in this application.

title_en: Heterogeneous catalyst for the direct carbonylation of nitroaromatics to isocyanates
abstract_en: A process for preparing aromatic isocyanates by direct carbonylation of nitroaromatics by reaction with carbon monoxide in the presence of a catalyst, characterized in that the catalyst comprises a multimetallic material comprising one or more compounds of the general formula A  x  B  y  Wherein: a is one or more elements selected from Ni, ru, rh, pd, ir, pt and Ag, B is one or more elements selected from Sn, sb, pb, zn, ga, in, ge and As, x is In the range of 0.1-10, and y is In the range of 0.1-10.

title_en: Polycyclic aromatic compound, material for organic element, organic electroluminescent element, display device, and lighting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cyclic aromatic compound, a material for an organic element, an organic electroluminescent element, a display device, and a lighting device, wherein a polycyclic aromatic compound in which a specific aryl group is substituted with anthracene or the like and a plurality of aromatic rings are linked by a boron atom, an oxygen atom, a sulfur atom, or a selenium atom is used as a material for a light-emitting layer, and thus, one or more organic EL elements excellent in quantum efficiency and element lifetime can be provided.

title_en: Electronic device, display device, method for producing the same, and compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic device, a display device, a preparation method thereof and a compound. Specifically, the present invention relates to an electronic device, a display device including the same, a method of producing the same, and a compound, the electronic device including a hole injection layer and/or a hole transport layer and/or a hole generation layer, wherein at least one of the hole injection layer, the hole transport layer, and the hole generation layer includes a coordination complex including at least one electropositive atom M and at least one anionic methide ligand L represented by the following formula (I), wherein a  1 、A 2  and a  3  are independently selected from (I) a partially or fully halogenated C  4  to C  30  aliphatic or cycloaliphatic tertiary hydrocarbyl group, (ii) a C  6  to C  30  aryl group, (iii) a C  2  to C  30  heteroaryl group, (iv) H, (v) CN, (vi) a C  2  to C  30  acyl group, (vii) a C  1  to C  30  sulfonyl group, and (viii) a C  2  to C  30  phosphoryl, provided that only one of a  1 、A 2  and a  3  may be H.

title_en: Amine-based compound and organic light emitting device including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an amine-based compound and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same. The amine-based compound may be used as a material for an organic material layer of an organic electroluminescent device, and may achieve an improvement in efficiency, a low driving voltage, and/or an improvement in lifetime characteristics when applied to the organic electroluminescent device.

title_en: Toothpaste formula
abstract_en: The invention provides a toothpaste formula which comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 30-40% of glycerol, 15-20% of propylene glycol, 14-18% of calcium hydrophosphate, 0.1-0.2% of carrageenan, 0.2-0.3% of agar, 0.6-1.0% of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 1-2% of foaming agent, 1-3% of pullulan, 4-7% of xylitol, 1-2% of verbena extract and 3-5% of a cooling composition; the cooling composition consists of (lR,2S,5R) -N- (4- (cyanomethyl) phenyl) -2-isopropyl-5-methylcyclohexanecarboxamide, menthyl lactate and triacetin. According to the formula of the toothpaste, the components are selected and compounded, and are mutually matched and interacted, so that the prepared toothpaste is safe, mild, free of stimulation, moderate in friction force, good in sensory property, smooth and clean in paste, fine and smooth and good in cooling effect. Has antiinflammatory, antibacterial, and health protecting effects on teeth and oral cavity.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing diphenyl carbonate compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of diphenyl carbonate compound synthesis, and discloses a catalyst for preparing diphenyl carbonate compounds, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is shown as a formula (1-1) or a formula (1-2); r 1 、R 2 And R 3 Is selected from C 1 ‑C 14 Aliphatic hydrocarbon group of (2) 3 ‑C 14 Cycloalkyl of, C 6 ‑C 14 Aryl of (C) 7 ‑C 14 Alkylaryl of, C 7 ‑C 14 Aralkyl or C 10 ‑C 14 A condensed ring aryl group of (4); x is halogen. The catalyst used in the method has high catalytic activity, high selectivity and good stability for the reaction of preparing the diphenyl carbonate by the ester exchange method. title_en: Preparation method of L-theanine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic chemical synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of L-theanine. The preparation method of the L-theanine comprises the following steps: (a) Reacting L-glutamic acid with copper salt in a solvent to obtain a chelate A; (b) Carrying out esterification reaction on the chelate A and methanol to obtain a compound B; (c) And after the compound B and the ethylamine aqueous solution react, adding a decoppering reagent, stirring for reaction, and removing the solvent to obtain a crude product of the L-theanine. The preparation method of the L-theanine takes the L-glutamic acid as the starting material, and is easy to obtain; and moreover, residues in amino acid are protected by adopting a copper chelate manner, so that the reaction process is green and environment-friendly. In the step (c), safer ethylamine aqueous solution is used for reaction, so that the safety is improved, the requirement on equipment is reduced, the production cost is greatly saved, and the industrial production is easier.

title_en: Wrinkle-removing microneedle patch with high-load macromolecular hyaluronic acid and/or sodium salt particles thereof and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wrinkle-removing microneedle patch with high-load macromolecular hyaluronic acid and/or sodium salt particles thereof and a preparation method thereof. The wrinkle-removing microneedle patch comprises a needle body and a substrate, wherein the needle body is prepared from macromolecular hyaluronic acid and/or sodium salt particles thereof, an ethanol water solution, micromolecular substances and a carrier material, and the substrate is prepared from a degradable material; the molecular weight of the macromolecular hyaluronic acid and/or the sodium salt particles thereof is 1500KDa-3000KDa; the micromolecular substance consists of hydrolyzed collagen, tetrahydromethylpyrimidine carboxylic acid, tocopherol acetate, magnesium ascorbyl phosphate, polyethylene glycol and triethyl citrate; the carrier material is selected from at least one of glycerol, hydroxypropyl cellulose, povidone and dextran. The wrinkle-removing microneedle patch has high macromolecular hyaluronic acid and/or sodium salt loading capacity and a good wrinkle-removing effect.

title_en: High-efficiency polymerizable photoinitiator for photoresist
abstract_en: The application provides a high-efficiency polymerizable photoinitiator suitable for color photoresist and a preparation method thereof. The acrylate group can improve the solubility of the photoinitiator and the compatibility with resin, monomers and the like, and can enable the photoinitiator to participate in polymerization in the photo-curing process, improve the crosslinking density of color glue, improve the hardness and reduce the migration of small molecular photoinitiators caused by post-baking high temperature or extreme conditions; the hydrogen-donating group can significantly improve the initiation efficiency of the photoinitiator and the polymerization rate of the system.

title_en: Catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalysts for preparing fatty acid amide, and particularly relates to a catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst provided by the invention comprises the following components in parts by weight: 8-15 parts of cerium nitrate, 10-16 parts of metatitanic acid and 69-82 parts of chromatographic silica gel. According to the records of the examples, the catalyst has high activity (the product efficiency is more than 93.5 percent), high stability (the color of the product is less than or equal to 3.0Gardner), high melting point (more than or equal to 112 ℃) and easy separation from the product (the catalyst is solid, is incompatible with the product and can be separated by simple filtration); when the catalyst is applied to the process of preparing hexamethylene erucamide, the one-step synthesis can be ensured, and any solvent and other media do not need to be added in the reaction process, so that the process is simplified, the cost is reduced, and the catalyst is free of environmental pollution, green, environment-friendly and easy to realize industrialization.

title_en: Preparation method of cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin compound. The structure of the cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin compound is shown as a formula (1); wherein Ar is 1 And Ar 2 Each independently is phenyl, R 1 Mono-or polysubstituted phenyl, heterocyclic aryl or R 1 Mono-or polysubstituted heterocyclic aryl. The preparation method takes conveniently and easily obtained trans-diaryl monofluoroolefin as an initial raw material, takes an iridium complex or a ruthenium complex as a photocatalyst and acetonitrile as a solvent, and can obtain a cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin product through one-step reaction under the irradiation of blue light; the preparation method has wide applicability of reaction substrates, and can prepare various cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin compounds; meanwhile, the reaction condition of the method is mild, and the method can be carried out at room temperatureThe reaction does not need high temperature or high pressure, does not need additives such as acid or alkali and the like, does not need nitrogen protection, is simple and convenient to operate and simple in post-treatment, and is a method for efficiently synthesizing the cis-diaryl monofluoroolefin compound.

title_en: System for recycling low-temperature methanol washing air and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for recycling low-temperature methanol washing air and an operation method thereof. A hydrogen recovery pipeline, a regulating valve and a flowmeter are added on a synthetic ammonia low-temperature methanol washing and discharging pipeline; a bypass pipeline of the methanol conversion furnace and a CO regulating valve HV2 are additionally arranged between the inlet and the outlet of the methanol conversion furnace, so that the hydrogen-carbon ratio of the methanol synthesis gas is ensured to be 2.0-3.0, the cold energy of low-temperature methanol washing is not affected, and the sulfur content of the synthesis gas at the low-temperature methanol washing outlet is less than 0.1ppm. When the working pressure of the synthetic ammonia low-temperature methanol washing shift gas washing tower exceeds the working pressure, the purge gas vent valve HV1 is opened, vent gas is generated, the recycle gas front hand valve V2, the recycle gas rear hand valve V3 and the recycle gas regulating valve HV3 are opened, and vent gas is recycled to the methanol device through numerical calculation of the recycle flow meter FI1, the methanol synthesis flow meter FI2 and the hydrogen-carbon ratio analyzer AI2, and the like, so that the high-load production of the methanol device is ensured while the complete recycling of vent gas is ensured.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing glycol from carbohydrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst for preparing glycol from carbohydrate and a preparation method thereof, which mainly solve the problem of low efficiency of the catalyst for preparing glycol from carbohydrate in the prior art. The invention adopts a combined catalyst, which comprises a metal catalyst I and a multi-element transition metal oxide (M-N-W-O oxide) catalyst II containing M, N and W elements, wherein M is at least one of IVB elements, and N is at least one of VB elements. The combined catalyst used in the invention can better solve the problem and can be applied to the field of preparing ethylene glycol from carbohydrate.

title_en: Preparation method of supported silver-based multi-component nano catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a supported silver-based multi-component nano catalyst, which comprises the following steps: grinding the carrier using a mortar; preparing a precursor solution of Ag, wherein the precursor of the auxiliary agent adopts a metal cluster complex or a metal cluster complex and/or a combination thereof; stirring under ultrasonic to rapidly dissolve and mix the precursor solution of Ag and the standard solution of the metal cluster complex to obtain a mixed precursor solution. And slowly adding the treated carrier into the mixed precursor solution, and stirring to form uniform distribution. And (4) standing in vacuum, and carrying out suction filtration on the sample to obtain the impregnated carrier small particles. Drying in an oven, and then roasting at high temperature by using a tube furnace to obtain the catalyst after primary impregnation. And taking out the catalyst after the primary impregnation, placing the catalyst into a secondary impregnation solution, and impregnating for 1h in vacuum. Drying and high-temperature roasting to obtain the catalyst after secondary impregnation. The prepared Ag-loaded catalyst has the advantages of uniform particle distribution, uniform size and the like.

title_en: Synthesis method of tetrabromobisphenol S
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis method of tetrabromobisphenol S, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a mixed solvent of bisphenol S, dichloromethane and isobutanol and water, uniformly stirring, slowly and doubly dripping hydrogen peroxide and bromine at the temperature of 10-30 ℃, and heating to 35-40 ℃ for reaction after dripping is finished; (2) after the reaction is finished, cooling the reaction system to room temperature, adding sodium sulfite solution to neutralize excessive bromine, then adjusting the pH value of the system to 6-7, filtering, washing and drying to obtain tetrabromobisphenol S, and directly recycling the mother liquor obtained by filtering. The preparation method has the advantages of low cost, environmental friendliness, high product yield and purity and high safety.

title_en: Uracil compound containing aminomethyl thioacetyl fragment, preparation method and application thereof, and pesticide herbicide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pesticide compounds, and discloses uracil compounds containing aminomethyl thioacetyl fragments, a preparation method and application thereof, and a pesticide herbicide. The uracil compound containing the aminomethyl thioacetyl fragment provided by the invention has excellent effect on preventing and controlling weeds, especially broadleaf weeds and/or grassy weeds, and is safe to crops such as corn, wheat, rice and the like.

title_en: Synthesis method of N- (4 cyano-3- (trifluoromethyl) phenyl) -2-methyl epoxy propylene-2-amide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthetic method of N- (4 cyano-3- (trifluoromethyl) phenyl) -2-methyl epoxy propylene-2-amide, which comprises the following processing steps: s1, dissolving 4-amino-2-trifluoromethyl benzonitrile and a catalyst in dichloromethane, adding methyl methacrylate, heating to 10-65 ℃, and reacting for 1-10 hours; s2, after the reaction is finished, cooling, filtering and drying the dichloromethane to obtain N- (4-cyano-3-trifluoromethylphenyl) methacrylamide; s3, adding N- (4-cyano-3-trifluoromethylphenyl) methacrylamide into a solvent, adding a two-phase catalyst and manganese dioxide, and stirring for 1-3 hours; s4, introducing the mixed solution to react for 10-24 hours, cooling to 20-25 ℃, filtering and drying to obtain N- (4-cyano-3- (trifluoromethyl) phenyl) -2-methyl epoxy propylene-2-amide; the biphase catalyst is annular crown ether. The raw materials used in the method are easy to obtain and low in price, and the used reagents and solvents are in conventional industrial specifications, so that the method is suitable for industrial production, and has the advantages of little environmental pollution, low equipment requirement and high operation safety.

title_en: Preparation method of diphenyl sulfide compound
abstract_en: A method for preparing a biphenyl sulfide compound shown as a general formula (I) comprises the following steps: the groups in the formula are shown in the specification. The method comprises the step of carrying out coupling reaction on halogenated benzene shown in a general formula (V) under the combined action of a nickel compound and at least one ligand and metal zinc to prepare the biphenyl compound shown in a general formula (IV). The biphenyl can be subjected to further sulfonylation, reduction hydrolysis and etherification to prepare the biphenyl thioether compound shown in the general formula I with high yield.

title_en: Iridium complex constructed based on 8-hydroxyquinoline derivative and 1-phenylpyrazole iridium dimer as well as synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iridium complex constructed based on 8-hydroxyquinoline derivatives and 1-phenylpyrazole iridium dimers, and a synthesis method and application thereof. The synthesis method of the iridium complex comprises the following steps: putting the 1-phenylpyrazole iridium dimer and the 8-hydroxyquinoline derivative in an organic solvent, and reacting under heating or non-heating conditions to obtain the corresponding target complex. The test results of the applicant show that the complex of the invention has significant biological activity (the activity is significantly higher than that of the ligand and cisplatin) on cervical cancer and ovarian cancer cells, and simultaneously, the toxicity of the complex to normal human liver cells is very low (IC) 50 > 80. mu.M); on the other hand, the complex can also perform fluorescence localization on tumor cells, and can be developed into a targeted anti-cancer drug which targets mitochondria through fluorescence localization.

title_en: Application of compound in preparation of medicine for treating pancreatic cancer
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound of formula (I), formula (II) and formula (III), and also relates to a preparation method of the compound, wherein the synthesis route is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the industrial large-scale production can be conveniently realized. The compound provided by the invention has an inhibiting effect on pancreatic cancer tumors, has high survival rate and small weight reduction amplitude of mice in a mouse test, has small toxic and side effects, and is a compound medicine for treating pancreatic cancer, which is expected to be industrialized. The invention also comprises a pharmaceutical composition and a preparation of the compound, and application of the compound in preparing a medicament for treating pancreatic cancer.

title_en: Paeonol ester derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paeonol ester derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the paeonol ester derivative has the following structural formula: the invention designs potential paeonol derivatives with anti-inflammatory immunocompetence by a molecular docking technology based on molecular targets related to inflammatory diseases, synthesizes the derivatives by a chemical modification means on the basis, and compared with the traditional chemical modification based on improvement of pharmaceutical properties of paeonol, the technical means of the invention has the advantages of high efficiency of obtaining the high-biological-activity paeonol derivatives, stronger anti-inflammatory active drugs than paeonol and similar products, and solves the problems of weak anti-inflammatory immunocompetence, weak water solubility, easy oxidation, volatility and the like of the paeonol.

title_en: Transparent microbead essence containing water-soluble and fat-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide simultaneously
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent microbead essence containing water-soluble and fat-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide at the same time, which comprises the following substances in percentage by mass: 0.5 to 5.0 percent of vegetable fat, 0.0001 to 0.1 percent of fat-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide, 0.0001 to 0.9 percent of water-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide, 0.15 to 0.3 percent of water-phase thickening agent, 0 to 0.3 percent of pH regulator, 2.0 to 15.0 percent of humectant and the balance of deionized water. The micro-bead essence provided by the invention dissolves fat-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide in vegetable oil, is uniformly and stably suspended in the transparent aqueous essence in an oil drop form, does not contain an emulsifier, a solubilizer and a synthetic silicone oil component, and effectively solves the technical problem that the fat-soluble biological polypeptide cannot be directly added into the transparent aqueous essence because of insolubility in water. The microbead essence disclosed by the invention is transparent and attractive in appearance, clear in texture and clear and moist in skin feel, and meanwhile, the fat-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide and the water-soluble anti-wrinkle polypeptide are reasonably matched and synergized, so that the microbead essence has a better anti-wrinkle effect.

title_en: Preparation method of 3, 5-dimethylphenol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 3, 5-dimethylphenol, which takes isophorone as a raw material to carry out cracking reaction under the action of a catalyst, and specifically comprises the following steps: carrying out water removal treatment on isophorone by using a water absorbent until the water content of isophorone is less than or equal to 0.2%, adding a catalyst into isophorone after water removal, and uniformly mixing to obtain a raw material mixture; under the protection of inert gas, the raw material mixture is pumped into the tubular reactor from the top of the tubular reactor, and the retention time of the raw material mixture in the tubular reactor is 40-48 s; the reaction temperature is 480-520 ℃; the reaction pressure is normal pressure; the product is withdrawn from the bottom of the tubular reactor. The method for preparing the 3, 5-dimethylphenol has the characteristics of high reaction conversion rate, high selectivity, low catalyst price and the like.

title_en: Near-infrared lipid drop fluorescent dye and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a near-infrared lipid drop fluorescent dye, a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein the fluorescent dye is a high-brightness near-infrared fluorescent dye designed and synthesized by introducing cyclohexanediamine at one end of a power supply base based on perylene imide, the structural formula is shown as (1), the strong power supply property of the cyclohexanediamine greatly improves the fluorescence excitation and emission wavelength of the dye, so that the excitation wavelength of the dye in ethanol reaches over 710nm, and the fluorescence emission reaches 750 nm. In addition, the symmetry of molecules is improved while the rigidity structure of the molecules is increased by the cyclohexanediamine, so that the dye is not sensitive to the polarity of a solvent, and the half-peak width is only 45 nm. The fluorescence quantum yield of the dye in different solvents reaches over 0.4, and the molar extinction coefficient reaches 50000M ‑1 cm ‑1 Left and right. The high-brightness near-infrared dye designed by the project has small cytotoxicity and deep tissue penetration, and can be widely applied to tissue and living body imaging.

title_en: Triazole CYP51-HDAC double-target antifungal compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triazole CYP51-HDAC double-target antifungal compound, which has the following structural general formula: r is selected from one of the following structures: the triazole CYP51-HDAC double-target antifungal compound provided by the invention is a series of CYP51-HDAC double-target inhibitors obtained by introducing HDAC inhibitor fragments into the structure of the traditional triazole medicament, and the compounds are effective on azole sensitive fungi and more importantly have excellent in-vivo and in-vitro activities on azole medicament-resistant fungi.

title_en: Substituted pyridine-2-carboxamides and their use
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and relates to a substituted pyridine-2-formamide compound and application thereof. Specifically, the substituted pyridine-2-formamide compound has a structure shown in a formula I. Aiming at the excellent in-vitro inhibition activity and HUVEC cell inhibition activity of VEGFR-2 and PDGFR-beta kinases, the compound can be used as a small molecular tyrosine kinase (especially Raf kinase) inhibitor, has the effects of inhibiting cell proliferation and angiogenesis, has good antitumor activity, and has good effect of treating mammal (including human) tumor diseases.

title_en: Dioxopyrrolidine acetic acid derivative, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of bactericides and discloses a derivative of dioxopyrrolidine acetic acid, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structure of the compound is shown as the formula (I): the compound has simple preparation method, has the effect of preventing and treating plant pathogenic fungi, and can be used as a bactericide for plant protection.

title_en: Seaweed oligosaccharide composition with function of repairing skin after being exposed to sun, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seaweed oligosaccharide composition with a function of repairing skin after being exposed to the sun, a preparation method and application thereof. The seaweed oligosaccharide composition comprises seaweed oligosaccharide, plant polyphenol, biological selenium, a stabilizer, a solubilizer and water. The seaweed oligosaccharide composition provided by the invention has stronger repair capability on radiation-damaged cells, and can relieve damage and apoptosis of normal cells after sunburn.

title_en: Compound for preparing organic photoelectric device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, and particularly relates to a compound for preparing an organic photoelectric device, which has the following structural formula: the organic materials containing structures such as xanthone, thiazolone, acridone and the like synthesized by the application can have wider ultraviolet absorption through modification of different groups, and can be used as organic materials or stabilizers with high oxygen, heat, light and ultraviolet stability, in particular organic electronic and photoelectric materials or stabilizers for organic electronic materials. The material can be used as a hole type charge transport material in the field of OLED display.

title_en: 4-benzyl amino benzene sulfonamide derivative, preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound of formula (I) A 4-benzylaminophenylsulfonamide derivative represented by the formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, or metabolite thereof, R  1  、R  2  、R  3  、R  4  、R  5  And R  6  Each group is as defined in the specification. Also provided are methods for treating and/or preventing ischemia-reperfusion injury and related diseases, pathological myocardial hypertrophy and related diseases, fatty liver disease and related diseases, and/or metabolic diseases.

title_en: Inclusion type metal fluoride catalyst based on cyclodextrin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inclusion type metal fluoride catalyst based on cyclodextrin and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the inclusion type nano catalyst comprises the following steps: performing inclusion reaction on cyclodextrin and organic ligand metal salt to form an inclusion compound, placing the inclusion compound in an inert atmosphere for roasting and carbonizing to obtain a carbon-coated compound, performing decarbonization treatment on the carbon-coated compound in a special atmosphere to obtain a partially decarbonized carbon-coated compound, and performing fluorination treatment on the partially decarbonized carbon-coated compound in a fluorinated gas to obtain the inclusion type metal fluoride catalyst. Based on the characteristics of cyclodextrin, the prepared metal fluoride catalyst is confined in a carbon-based material in a nano-scale form, has the characteristics of strong sintering resistance, carbon deposition resistance and the like, and further shows good catalytic activity in the field of fluorine chemical industry.

title_en: Thermally activated delayed fluorescence molecules, materials comprising said molecules and devices comprising said materials
abstract_en: A Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence (TADF) molecule comprising: a central electron donor moiety formed from a conjugated polycyclic ring system containing three nitrogen atoms; and three electron acceptor moieties each bonded to the central electron donor moiety through one of the three nitrogen atoms, wherein at least one of the three electron acceptor moieties is twisted relative to the central electron donor moiety defining a twist angle of 40 ° to<90 DEG, thereby enabling the photoluminescence quantum yield of TADF molecules>60, and a reverse intersystem crossing rate from the lowest excited triplet state to the lowest excited singlet state of at least 1X 10  6   s  ‑1  。

title_en: External acne-removing traditional Chinese medicine composition, application thereof and acne-removing balancing essence containing composition
abstract_en: The invention provides an external acne-removing traditional Chinese medicine composition which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-40 parts of matrine, 24-30 parts of fructus cnidii extract, 20-28 parts of scutellaria baicalensis extract, 17-24 parts of honeysuckle extract, 12-20 parts of dandelion extract, 11-17 parts of phellodendron extract and 9-14 parts of stemona japonica extract. The matrine takes matrine with excellent performance as a core raw material, is compounded with a plurality of traditional Chinese medicine essences and plant essences with the functions of diminishing inflammation, sterilizing and anti-allergy repairing, is added with an efficient, safe and non-irritant salt synergistic acne removing component as a guiding agent, and adopts the original catalytic kinetics technology to ensure that the traditional Chinese medicine and the plant essences which have slow effect take effect quickly, thereby realizing quick acne removal and anti-allergy repairing. The acne removing cream adopts natural components to the maximum extent, does not hurt the skin, has no stimulation, is not allergic, does not contain antibiotics and hormones, and can not generate drug resistance on the skin after long-term use. Meanwhile, the immunity of the skin is improved, and skin allergy and acne regeneration are reduced.

title_en: Synthesis method of levonorgestrel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of levonorgestrel, belonging to the technical field of preparation and processing of medicines. The method takes DL-ethyl diketone as a starting material and prepares the levonorgestrel through three steps of protection, ethynylation and hydrolysis. The preparation method of the levonorgestrel avoids the use of a lithium ammonia reagent with larger potential safety hazard by improving the defects of the traditional process, has mild reaction conditions and safe operation, has high overall conversion rate, is simple and convenient to operate, is suitable for industrial production, and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of cyclic sulfate compound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a cyclic sulfate compound. The first aspect of the invention provides a preparation method of cyclic sulfate compounds, and the preparation raw materials comprise a compound A and sulfur-containing oxides; the structural formula of the compound A is Wherein R is selected from one of H, alkyl, alkenyl, substituted alkyl, aryl and halogen, X is C or S, Y is-CH  2  ‑CH  2  -or-CH = C-. The compound A and sulfur trioxide have reliable sources, low price, mild reaction conditions, simple operation, no wastewater generated in the reaction process, less three wastes and good product quality, are suitable for large-scale production, can obtain high-purity battery-grade vinyl sulfate compounds, and have great implementation value and social and economic benefits.

title_en: Trifluoro sulfonamide hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ] furan photoresist resin monomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trifluoro sulfonamide hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ]]Furan photoresist resin monomer and preparation method thereof, trifluoro sulfonamide hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ]]The furan photoresist resin monomer comprises the following structural general formula: wherein R is  1  And R  2  Respectively comprise C  1  ～C  12  Alkyl, heteroalkyl, or a linkage; r  3  Including hydrogen, halogen, C  1  ～C  12  Alkyl or heteroalkyl, a process for its preparation, comprising the steps of: adding trifluorosulfonyl compounds into amino hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ]]Reacting in a mixed solution of a furan alcohol compound and an alkali to obtain hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ] containing trifluoro sulfonamide]An intermediate product of a furanol structure; mixing the intermediate product with acrylic acid compound, esterifying, and purifying to obtain trifluoro sulfonamide hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ]]Furan-based photoresist resin monomer. The invention synthesizes trifluoro sulfonamide hexahydrofuro [3,2-b ]]The furan photoresist resin monomer has the advantages of anti-swelling property, alkali solubility and hydrophobicity, and the preparation method is simple and convenient.

title_en: Levosimendan sodium crystal form B and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a levosimendan crystal form B, a preparation method thereof and a stable pharmaceutical composition thereof, wherein Cu-Kalpha radiation is used, and an X-ray powder diffraction pattern expressed by a 2 theta angle has one or more characteristic diffraction peaks at positions of 12.2 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 14.6 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 18.3 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 27.4 degrees +/-0.2 degrees and 30.0 degrees +/-0.2 degrees of 2 theta. The yield of the levosimendan crystal form B is up to 98 percent.

title_en: Dihydrobenzofuran and indene analogs as myocardial segment inhibitors
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound of formula (I), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein A, Z, B, R  1  、R  2  、R  3  、G  1  、G  2  G (G)  3  As defined herein. Also provided are pharmaceutically acceptable compositions comprising a compound of formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Also provided are methods of using the compounds of formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof for treating heart disease via inhibition of the myocardial segments.

title_en: Crystal form of pyrazolo heteroaryl derivative hydrochloride and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crystal form of pyrazolo heteroaryl derivative hydrochloride and a preparation method thereof. The invention particularly relates to a crystal form I and a crystal form II of dihydrochloride of a compound shown in a formula (I), a crystal form A, a crystal form B and a crystal form C of monohydrochloride of the compound shown in the formula (I) and a preparation method thereof. The crystal form of the compound shown in the formula (I) has good crystal form stability, and can be better used for clinical treatment.

title_en: Preparation method of medicine for treating neurological diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a medicine for treating neurological diseases, which comprises the following steps: 1) Adding 1-bromo-3, 5-dimethyl adamantane, acetonitrile, a catalyst 1 and a catalyst 2 into a reaction kettle, stirring for reaction, adding a certain amount of water into a reaction liquid, cooling to separate out solid, and adding a certain proportion of alcohol water into the solid for hot melting and cold separation to obtain 1-acetamido-1, 3-dimethyl adamantane; 2) Reacting 1-acetamido-3, 5-dimethyl adamantane with sodium hydroxide in glycol at high temperature, adding a certain amount of purified water, extracting with dichloromethane, concentrating under reduced pressure, adding ethyl acetate hydrochloride solution into the concentrated solution, cooling, crystallizing, suction filtering, and drying to obtain memantine hydrochloride. The catalyst 1 and the catalyst 2 are used as reaction catalysts, so that the operation risk caused by the use of concentrated sulfuric acid is avoided, the reaction time is shortened, and the occurrence of side reactions is reduced. Simple post-treatment, high reaction yield and good product purity.

title_en: Use of fermented product of tea leaf for resisting aging and whitening skin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plant extracts, in particular to application of a tea leaf ferment in regulating gene expression and resisting aging, whitening, improving immunity and reducing fat accumulation. The invention provides an application of a tea leaf fermentation product in regulating and controlling expression quantity of CCT genes, pink1 genes, PARP2 genes, MITF genes, UNG genes, ERCC6 genes, TERC genes, CD40 genes, DYNLL2 genes, GRK5 genes, RELB genes, TNFSF14 genes, IL4R genes and RELA genes and reducing fat accumulation. The tea leaf ferment is prepared by the following steps: extracting tea leaves with a solvent to obtain tea leaf extract, and fermenting the tea leaf extract with Saccharomyces cerevisiae, rattshiella B, lactobacillus gasseri and Acetobacter xylinum to obtain tea leaf fermented product, wherein the solvent is water, alcohol or alcohol-water mixture.

title_en: Production method of alkyl phosphine
abstract_en: The invention provides a production method of alkyl phosphine, in particular to a production method of tripropyl phosphine, which comprises the following steps: mixing phosphine and propylene in a solvent, adding a photocatalyst, and reacting under the illumination of 20-50W for 1-12 h to obtain tripropyl phosphine, wherein the reaction temperature is 0-50 ℃. The photocatalyst can easily induce free radical reaction under the condition of illumination, so that the reaction activity of phosphine and olefin is enhanced, the reaction efficiency is greatly improved, the reaction can be rapidly carried out at the temperature of room temperature and normal pressure, the reaction time is short, the catalyst has low pollution and toxicity, the used solvent has lower toxicity compared with toluene and the like which are commonly adopted in the prior art, the post-treatment is relatively simple, and the yield and the purity of the product are higher.

title_en: Preparation method of methylamine
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of methylamine, which is characterized in that methylamine is prepared by using aminomethylation reaction; in the amine methylation reaction, the catalyst is dodecyl dimethyl amine caprolactone. The invention effectively reduces the additives required by the reaction and is beneficial to simplifying the post-treatment process after the reaction is finished.

title_en: Lanthanum complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of complexes, and provides a lanthanum complex and a preparation method and application thereof. The adsorbent provided by the invention realizes the high-efficiency adsorption of the oxygen-containing acid radical ions finally under the combined action of the empty orbit effect of the central metal lanthanum ions, the lone electron effect in the ligand dicarboxylic acid and the space effect of the obtained complex. The experimental result shows that the adsorption capacity of the oxygen-containing acid radical ion containing phosphorus can reach 50 mg.g ‑1 The adsorption capacity of the oxygen-containing acid radical ion containing heavy metal elements can reach 100 mg/g ‑1 The complex formed by the isophthalic acid and the lanthanum provided by the invention has the adsorption capacity of 756.8 mg/g for the oxyacid radical ion containing heavy metal antimony element ‑1 And has good selective adsorption compared with other oxygen acid radical ions.

title_en: Substituted enaminocarbonyl compounds, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a substituted enaminocarbonyl compound, a preparation method and application thereof; in particular, the present invention relates to substituted enaminocarbonyl compounds represented by formula (I) or stereoisomers, nitroxides and salts thereof of substituted enaminocarbonyl compounds represented by formula (I), and a process for the preparation of substituted enaminocarbonyl compounds, and their use in agriculture as pesticides, and forms of pesticide compositions thereof, and methods of controlling pests with these compounds or compositions; wherein the ring A, R  1  、R  2  、R  3  、R  4  、B、B  1  、B  2  、X、X  1  And n has the meaning described in the present invention.

title_en: Spiropiperidine allosteric modulators of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to compounds of formula I useful as modulators of α7 nAChR, compositions comprising such compounds, and the use of such compounds for the prevention, treatment, or amelioration of diseases, particularly cognitive impairment in central nervous system disorders such as alzheimer's disease, parkinson's disease, and schizophrenia, as well as for L-DOPA-induced dyskinesias and inflammation.

title_en: Preparation method of liquid crystal monomer compound containing difluoromethyl ether bridge bond
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid crystal monomer compound synthesis, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a liquid crystal monomer compound containing a difluoromethyl ether bridge bond. The compound containing the polyfluoro structure shown in the formula I is used as a raw material, imidazole basic ionic liquid shown in the formula II is used as a catalyst, the conversion rate of the polyfluoro structure raw material is effectively improved, the purity and the yield of a target product are further improved, the HPLC content of the prepared liquid crystal monomer compound containing the difluoromethyl ether bridged bond is more than 99.9%, the total yield of the product is more than 85%, meanwhile, the process flow for preparing the liquid crystal monomer compound containing the difluoromethyl ether bridged bond is shortened, a butyl lithium reagent with high cost is avoided, an ultralow temperature reaction is avoided, the requirement on equipment is low, the process difficulty is reduced, and the process is environment-friendly and suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Pyrido six-membered ring binuclear-metal complex, preparation method thereof and application thereof in ethylene polymerization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pyrido six-membered ring binuclear-metal complex shown in the following formula (I), and a preparation method and application thereof: the binuclear metal complex has the advantages of novel structure, high catalytic activity, low cost, stable performance and the like. The binuclear metal complex provided by the invention can catalyze ethylene polymerization with high activity under mild conditions, can regulate and control the types of cocatalysts to obtain different types of high molecular weight branched polyethylenes, and can regulate and control the microstructure of the obtained polymer to enable the obtained polymer to have the characteristic of double melting points or single melting points, thereby meeting the application requirements of different varieties of polyolefin. The binuclear metal complex of the invention shows very good catalytic activity in catalyzing olefin polymerization reaction, and has great industrial application prospect.

title_en: A method for preparing composition containing Spirulina polysaccharide extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composition containing spirulina polysaccharide extract, which comprises the steps of heating and dissolving phase A raw materials, heating and melting phase B raw materials, adding the melted phase B raw materials into the phase A, stirring while adding, homogenizing, sequentially adding phase C raw materials in the stirring process, homogenizing, and stirring to obtain the composition, wherein the phase A comprises the following components: caprylic capric triglyceride, Creamaker-Blead, GelmakerEMU, and vitamin E acetate; or comprises the following steps: jojoba oil, Creamaker-Blead, avocado oil, cetostearyl alcohol, vitamin E acetate, Gelmaker EMU; the phase B comprises: glycerol, sodium hyaluronate and deionized water; or comprises the following steps: glycerin, sodium hyaluronate, sodium pyrrolidone carboxylate, 1, 3-butanediol and deionized water; the phase C comprises: spirulina extract, flos Buddlejae extract, grape seed extract, Ulmus pumila extract, asiaticoside extract, benzyl alcohol-DHA, and essence. The product of the invention has good stability characteristics of heat resistance, cold resistance and the like, has good effect of removing DPPH and OH, and has good moisture retention.

title_en: Method for preparing pemetrexed disodium in high yield
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of pemetrexed disodium, which is characterized in that an alkali modified microporous-mesoporous molecular sieve catalyst is adopted as a catalyst to replace NaOH as a reaction catalyst, so that good yield and product purity can be obtained under the condition of reaction scale expansion.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped carbon-supported copper/cerium dioxide composite catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped carbon-loaded metal copper/cerium oxide composite catalyst, which is characterized in that nitrogen-doped carbon-coated cerium oxide is taken as a carrier, and metal copper particles are uniformly distributed on the surface of the carrier step by step; wherein the loading amount of the metal copper is 5-10 wt%, and the content of cerium oxide in the carrier is 10-20 wt%. The invention combines the carbothermic method and the dipping method, can obtain the composite catalyst which simultaneously has a metal copper active site and a nitrogen-doped carbon active site, and the formed biorthogonal active site composite catalyst has high selectivity, realizes higher reaction conversion rate on the basis of relatively mild reaction conditions and has good application effect; and the related preparation method is simple, convenient to operate and suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Preparation method of natural high-purity tea saponin with high decontamination efficiency
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation of tea saponin, in particular to a preparation method of natural high-purity tea saponin with high-efficiency decontamination. The method comprises the following steps: step one, placing the tea seed cake in a tea saponin preparation system for milling; step two, putting the powder into water to be mixed to obtain a mixed solution; step three, centrifuging the mixed solution to extract supernatant; and step four, preparing the tea saponin by using the supernatant as a raw material. The tea saponin comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 9 parts of tea saponin, 1 part of propylene glycol, 1 part of butanediol and 1 part of potassium glycyrrhetate.

title_en: Compound and organic light emitting device including the same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a compound of formula 1 and an organic light emitting device comprising the same.

title_en: O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent display, and particularly discloses a novel O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material and application thereof in an organic electroluminescent device. The O-containing organic electrophosphorescent material provided by the invention has a structure shown as a general formula (I). The organic electrophosphorescent material is applied to an organic electroluminescent device, and the prepared electroluminescent device has the superior performances of high purity, high brightness and high efficiency.

title_en: Self-repairing epoxy resin curing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of electrical materials, and particularly relates to a novel self-repairing epoxy resin curing agent, and a preparation method and application thereof. At present, a glass-like polymer is often constructed by introducing a reversible covalent bond into an epoxy resin matrix, the glass-like polymer can be reconstructed in a cross-linked structure under the heating condition to repair cracks, but the shape structure of the material is irreversibly damaged at the same time, the repair of the glass-like polymer is closer to recovery, and the requirement of maintaining the original structure of the insulating material after repair cannot be met. The application provides a novel self-repairing epoxy resin curing agent, which comprises an anhydride group, a carboxyl group and a group capable of undergoing a retro Diels-Alder reaction. The compound is a novel compound, can be used for curing epoxy resin, simultaneously endows the cured epoxy resin with intrinsic self-repairing capability, and can self-restore tiny mechanical cracks or electrical tree defects.

title_en: FOXM1 inhibitor compositions and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides compounds and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof that are useful for inhibiting FOXM1, inhibiting cancer growth, and/or treating cancer. In particular, these compounds and their corresponding quaternary ammonium salts are useful in the treatment of various forms of breast cancer.

title_en: Catalyst for hydrosilylation reaction and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for hydrosilylation and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dispersing amino silicone resin microspheres and amino acid anhydride in N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare amino silicone resin microsphere suspension and amino acid anhydride suspension; mixing the amino-silicone resin microsphere suspension and the amino-anhydride suspension and reacting to prepare amino-carboxyl-silicone resin microspheres; adding a chloroplatinic acid hexahydrate alcohol solution into the amino carboxyl silicon resin microspheres for reaction, distillation and drying to obtain the catalyst; the catalyst prepared by the preparation method has higher activity and selectivity, can efficiently catalyze the hydrosilylation reaction, improves the product content, can be recycled, has longer service life, and simultaneously avoids the problems of more byproducts and product pollution in the hydrosilylation catalysis process of the traditional catalyst.

title_en: Aryl carbon deposition inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aryl carbon deposition inhibitor, which mainly solves the problem that in the prior art, carbon deposition reduces the reaction efficiency when low-carbon alkane is dehydrogenated. The aryl carbon deposition inhibitor comprises the following components in parts by weight: a) 10-40 parts of a vulcanizing agent; b) 20-30 parts of a dispersing agent; c) 2.5-10 parts of an antioxidant; d) 20-67.5 parts of solvent, wherein the content of sulfur element in the aryl carbon deposition inhibitor is 1% -11% of the total weight of the aryl carbon deposition inhibitor, so that the problem is solved well, and the method can be used for industrial application of low-carbon alkane dehydrogenation.

title_en: Preparation method and application of metal modified SAPO-34 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a metal modified SAPO-34 molecular sieve, which comprises the following steps: (1) reacting water, orthophosphoric acid solution and an aluminum source to form mixture liquid; (2) cooling, washing and drying to obtain aluminum phosphate; (3) dynamically crystallizing aluminum phosphate, metal salt, a silicon source, an organic amine template, water and maleic acid; (4) cooling, washing and drying the reaction liquid to obtain a solid phase A; soaking the solid phase A in KH-570 to form a mixture, adding citric acid, stirring, filtering, washing, and drying to obtain a solid phase B; and mixing the solid phase B in an ethanol solution of aluminum nitrate, adding the mixture into an autoclave with a tetrafluoro lining, treating for 16-22 h at 120-180 ℃, cooling the treated liquid to the normal temperature along with the autoclave, filtering, washing the solid phase with deionized water, and roasting for 4-6 h at 450-600 ℃ to obtain the metal modified SAPO-34 molecular sieve. Compared with the common SAPO-34 molecular sieve, the metal modified SAPO-34 molecular sieve prepared by the invention has the advantage that the selectivity of ethylene is obviously improved in the reaction of preparing olefin from methanol.

title_en: Essence water composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly relates to an essence water composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the essence water composition comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 90-103 parts of water, 0.8-2.2 parts of witch hazel, 0.8-2.0 parts of dendrobium extract, 0.1-0.3 part of 1, 3-propylene glycol, 0.1-0.3 part of centella extract, 0.1-0.3 part of vine tea extract, 0.1-0.3 part of illicium verum fruit extract, 0.1-0.3 part of licorice root extract, 0.1-0.3 part of opuntia ficus-indica extract, 0.6-2.0 part of sodium hyaluronate, 0.03-0.1 part of tea saponin, 0.05-0.2 part of glycerol monostearate, 0.05-0.15 part of hydrogenated lecithin and 0.5-1.0 part of phenoxyethanol. The essence water composition disclosed by the invention adopts the optimized combination of the three emulsifiers, so that the skin can absorb essence components better and more quickly, and the effect is accelerated to appear.

title_en: Synthesis method of 3-methyl-2-butene-1-aldehyde diisopentenyl acetal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synthesizing 3-methyl-2-butene-1-aldehyde diisopentenyl acetal, which is characterized in that in the presence of a supported catalyst, the 3-methyl-2-butene-1-aldehyde diisopentenyl acetal is synthesized by carrying out aldol condensation reaction on isoamylene alcohol with high activity and high selectivity. The catalyst of the invention improves the activity of reactants and the selectivity of products, can obtain higher yield, simultaneously avoids the problem of equipment corrosion, prolongs the service life of the equipment, has obvious environmental protection benefit, is environment-friendly and is beneficial to industrialized mass production.

title_en: Dithienylethylene fluorescent molecular switch regulated and controlled by visible light, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of new materials, and particularly relates to a visible light controlled dithienyl ethylene fluorescent molecular switch, and preparation and application thereof. The dithienyl ethylene derivative takes aniline-alkynyl as a photosensitization group, and Perylene Monoimide (PMI) as a fluorescent group, and comprises a structural unit shown as a formula (I) or a formula (II): wherein R is 1 And R 2 Each independently is C1-C10 alkyl, C1-C10 alkyl alcohol or C6-C20 aryl. When the derivative is used as a fluorescent molecular switch, the introduction of the aniline-alkynyl group enables the fluorescence response wavelength of the molecular switch to be red-shifted to a visible light region, and the derivative has the advantages of good thermal stability, good fatigue resistance, high cyclization ratio, high fluorescence switch ratio and the like.

title_en: Fluorescent probe, nerve toxin detection element, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fluorescent probes, and particularly discloses a fluorescent probe, a nerve toxin detection element, a preparation method and application thereof. The structure of the fluorescent probe is shown as a formula 3. The invention provides a fluorescent probe with a novel structure, which is characterized in that salicylaldoxime group is bridged with a Borofluoric (BODIPY) fluorescent chromophore through alkynyl to form a rigid planar molecular structure, and a photoinduced electron transfer passage between the chromophore and a reaction group is constructed, so that the autofluorescence of probe molecules can be effectively reduced, background noise is weakened, and the detection effect is enhanced. The fluorescent probe molecule of the nerve toxicant provided by the invention has the advantages of high response speed, high detection sensitivity and detection limit of 4.0 multiplied by 10 ‑9 The detection element prepared by the fluorescent probe can simultaneously realize the separation of nerve toxicants in gas phase and liquid phaseThe detection of the nerve toxicant can be applied to the visual detection of the nerve toxicant in the real environment, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Bifunctional catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bifunctional catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of catalysts. The invention discloses a preparation method of a bifunctional catalyst, which comprises the following steps: adding a molecular sieve A into water to obtain uniform slurry; adding a metal salt solution M1 into the slurry; filtering, washing, drying and roasting the prepared slurry to obtain a catalyst semi-finished product I; adding the molecular sieve B into water to obtain uniform slurry; adding a metal salt solution M2 into the slurry; filtering, washing, drying and roasting the prepared slurry to obtain a catalyst semi-finished product II; and adding the catalyst semi-finished product I and the catalyst semi-finished product II into water, filtering, drying, kneading and molding to obtain the bifunctional catalyst. The invention also discloses the bifunctional catalyst prepared by the preparation method and application of the bifunctional catalyst in preparation of gasoline blending components by simultaneously catalyzing butene oligomerization and isobutane-butene alkylation. The preparation process is simple and easy to operate, and the process flow is simplified.

title_en: Method for producing polyphosphate with high polymerization degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing high-polymerization-degree polyphosphate, which is characterized in that a 15L fermentation tank is used for preparing an active microbial inoculum through high-density fermentation, and a bioreactor is combined to realize intracellular synthesis of the high-polymerization-degree polyphosphate by using the active microbial inoculum, wherein the polymerization degree of the prepared polyphosphate is 15-130. In the method provided by the invention, polyphosphates with different polymerization degrees in microbial cells are separated and purified to obtain polyphosphates with different chain lengths, and the method is applied to the fields of medical treatment, daily chemicals, food and the like. Compared with the existing preparation method, the polyphosphate prepared by the biological method has high polymerization degree, can meet the scientific research and market requirements of polyphosphates with different chain lengths, and is green and environment-friendly in production method. The invention is the first domestic pioneering advanced technology for industrially preparing and separating and purifying the polyphosphate with different polymerization degrees in a pilot scale manner, and has great significance for basic scientific research and market development.

title_en: Beautifying method for promoting skin microcirculation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cosmetic method for promoting skin microcirculation, which at least comprises the following steps: (1) cleaning the face; (2) applying the micro-current mask on the face; (3) the beauty instrument is worn on the head, two ends of the beauty instrument are contacted with the micro-current facial mask, and the beauty instrument provides power for the micro-current facial mask. The preparation raw materials of the micro-current facial mask comprise a conductive material, a facial mask sheet and essence, wherein the conductive material forms a conductive pattern on the facial mask sheet.
