The conductive material is silver paste material, and the raw materials for preparing the silver paste material comprise, by weight, 5-10 parts of silver powder, 30-60 parts of water-based resin, 0.5-2 parts of compatilizer and 0.2-1 part of cross-linking agent. According to the technical scheme, the conductive patterns are arranged on the whole facial mask sheet, the beauty instrument provides micro-current for the facial mask sheet through the conductive patterns, and the accelerated circulation of whole face blood is promoted.

title_en: Crystals of benzoxazole derivative
abstract_en: The application discloses a 1- ((2- (3, 6-diazabicyclo [ 3.1.1) shown in a formula (1)]Heptane-3-yl) -7- (thiazol-2-yl) benzo [ d]Oxazol-4-yl) oxy) -1, 1-difluoro-2-methylpropan-2-ol crystals.

title_en: Cream shower gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bath products, and discloses a cream shower gel and a preparation method thereof. The cream shower gel comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 18-25% of vegetable oil, 0.1-2% of yeast fermentation lysate, 18-25% of surfactant, 0.5-3% of antioxidant, 0.5-3% of thickening agent, 1-2% of emulsion stabilizer, 0.1-1% of preservative, 0.1-1% of essence, a proper amount of pH regulator and the balance of water. The lysate of the yeast fermentation product is added into the formula, so that the cream shower gel has the functions of strengthening the metabolism of the horny layer of the skin, whitening, resisting aging and nourishing.

title_en: Long-acting entecavir prodrug and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a long-acting entecavir prodrug, a preparation method and application thereof. The entecavir prodrug has a structure shown in a formula I, and the compound can be slowly, continuously and stably released in vivo and converted into an entecavir original drug, so that the long-acting purpose is achieved. In the formula I, R 1 、R 2 And R 3 The definition of (A) is as described in the specification.

title_en: Uracil compound and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a compound which has excellent weed control efficacy and is highly safe for useful plants. The compound represented by the formula (A) has excellent weed control efficacy and is highly safe for useful plants.

title_en: Organic semiconducting polymers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel Organic Semiconducting (OSC) polymers comprising polycyclic acceptor-donor-acceptor (ADA) -type repeating units, to methods for their preparation and educts or intermediates used therefor, and to compositions and formulations comprising them, and to the use of the polymers and compositions as organic semiconductors or for the preparation of Organic Electronic (OE) devices, in particular Organic Photovoltaic (OPV) devices, Perovskite Solar Cell (PSC) devices, Organic Photodetectors (OPD), Organic Field Effect Transistors (OFET) and Organic Light Emitting Diodes (OLED), and OE, OPV, PSC, OPD, OFET and OLED devices comprising these polymers or compositions.

title_en: Preparation method of impurity compound for defluorination of cinacalcet hydrochloride
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, and provides a preparation method of a defluorinated impurity of cinacalcet hydrochloride. The method comprises the following steps: the cinacalcet hydrochloride intermediate reacts with a reducing agent in an organic solvent, and the defluorinated impurity crude product obtained by post-treatment of a reaction system is subjected to column chromatography separation and salification to obtain the high-purity defluorinated impurity. The synthesis method can realize the synthesis of the defluorinated impurity compound of the cinacalcet hydrochloride, and has great promotion effects on deeply researching related substances of the cinacalcet hydrochloride, improving the medication safety, reliability and stability of related preparations and controlling the quality of raw medicines and related preparations in the production process.

title_en: Therapeutic heterocyclic compounds
abstract_en: The present application discloses compounds having the following formula (I), or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and methods of their use and preparation.

title_en: Human cell polypeptide extraction and application method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting and applying human cell polypeptide, and relates to the technical field of biology. The human source cell polypeptide extraction and application method comprises the following steps: s1, adjusting the pre-extraction environment: adding the prepared human cells into a hydrogen chloride solution, shaking uniformly, decocting the mixture until the mixture is gelatinized, and cooling for later use, S2, performing preliminary enzymolysis: and (4) adding pepsin and purified water into the mixture prepared in the step (S1), shaking uniformly, and placing into constant temperature equipment for primary enzymolysis for later use. According to the method for extracting and applying the human-derived cell polypeptide, the polypeptide in the human-derived cell can be efficiently extracted, so that the actual polypeptide yield is effectively improved, the production cost of the polypeptide derivative is effectively reduced, the economic benefit of the actual polypeptide derivative is improved, and meanwhile, the prepared cosmetic can have multiple skin care effects, the actual cosmetic purchase quantity of a user is reduced, and the actual purchase cost of the user is reduced.

title_en: Method for simultaneously synthesizing phenylhydrazine salt and pyruvic acid or glyoxylic acid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of chemical synthesis, and particularly relates to a method for simultaneously synthesizing phenylhydrazine salt and pyruvic acid or glyoxylic acid. The method can simultaneously obtain the phenylhydrazine salt and the pyruvic acid or the phenylhydrazine salt and the glyoxylic acid with high yield and high purity, and has little waste water amount and environmental protection; low cost, simple operation and convenient popularization and application in large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound and application thereof, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula (1); the electron transport material includes at least one compound represented by formula (1). The compound is applied to an organic electronic device. The organic electroluminescent device comprises a substrate, a first electrode, a second electrode and at least one organic layer positioned between the first electrode and the second electrode, wherein the organic layer comprises at least one compound shown as a formula (1). The compound of the invention adopts three electron-deficient groups, namely the triazine group and Ar  1 、Ar 2 , and the three groups are matched to ensure that the compound has good electron injection and migration performances, and when the compound is used as an electron transport layer material in an organic electroluminescent device, the electron injection and migration efficiency in the device can be effectively improved, thereby ensuring that the device obtains excellent effects of high luminous efficiency and low starting voltage.

title_en: Preparation method of important intermediate of roxasistat
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of pharmaceutical intermediates, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a important intermediate 3e of rosixsuprat; the method takes 3c as an initial raw material, and reacts with a hydrogen donor compound and palladium carbon or Raney nickel in a solvent to prepare 3e, wherein the hydrogen donor compound is selected from one or more of formate, formic acid, triethylsilylhydride and the like; the molar ratio of the hydrogen donor compound to the 3c raw material is 1-100, preferably 5-50, and more preferably 10-30; the method has mild reaction conditions, does not need high temperature and high pressure, can carry out reaction under normal pressure, is suitable for industrial amplification, and has the yield equivalent to that of the comparison document CN 103435546B.

title_en: Device for preparing methanol based on coal and methanol preparation process
abstract_en: The application discloses a device for preparing methanol based on coal and a methanol preparation process using the device. The device comprises: (1) an electrolytic water unit; (2) the coal gasification unit comprises a coal powder preparation device, a coal powder gasification device and a purification device; (3) the gas regulating unit comprises a detection unit, a mixing container and a regulating valve, wherein the detection unit is connected with the mixing container and a purification device of the coal gasification unit; the regulating valve is connected with the mixing container and a hydrogen pipeline of the water electrolysis unit; (4) and the methanol synthesis reaction zone is connected with the mixing container. The device and the process can reduce the energy consumption of the coal chemical process to a great extent, greatly improve the utilization efficiency of coal resources and realize the low-carbon and even zero-carbon emission process in the coal chemical process. The double benefits of energy saving and environmental protection are achieved, and sustainable development and ecological civilization construction are realized.

title_en: A radioactive label11C]Rosuvastatin compound, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a radioactive label 11 C]The rosuvastatin compound, the preparation method and the application have metabolic stability, can be used as a PET probe for evaluating hepatobiliary transport, can evaluate the activity and the function of a hepatobiliary transporter in vivo noninvasively, dynamically and quantitatively, and can simultaneously and accurately predict the degree and the risk of the hepatobiliary transporter-mediated DDIs. The chemical formula of the compound is shown as the following formula (I):

title_en: Method for reducing fluorobenzophenone isomer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing fluorobenzophenone isomers, which comprises the following steps: p-methylaniline is used as a raw material, and p-fluorobenzoic acid is prepared by a nitric acid oxidation method; taking p-fluorobenzoic acid as a raw material, and performing thionyl chloride acyl chlorination to obtain p-fluorobenzoyl chloride; using anhydrous aluminum chloride as a catalyst, dropwise adding p-fluorobenzoyl chloride into fluorobenzene, and heating in a water bath to obtain a crude product of 4, 4' -difluorobenzophenone; the 4, 4 '-difluorobenzophenone is prepared by washing a crude product of the 4, 4' -difluorobenzophenone with water, separating an oil phase, carrying out reduced pressure distillation, carrying out suction filtration crystallization and drying.

title_en: Preparation method of nonamercapto compound monomer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a nonamercapto compound monomer, which comprises the following steps: pentaerythritol tetramercaptoacetate is used as a parent reactant, ethyl acetate is used as a solvent to form a parent reactant solution, then the solution is magnetically stirred and heated in an oil bath, and triethylamine is used as a catalyst to perform Michael nucleophilic addition reaction with trimethylolpropane triacrylate to prepare the nonamercapto compound monomer. The preparation method successfully synthesizes the required super-dendritic polythiol compound through one-step reaction, and has the advantages of simple reaction, high efficiency, higher yield, energy conservation and environmental protection.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for visual detection of silver ions and 2,4, 6-trinitrophenol, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fluorescent probe preparation technology and application, and particularly relates to a fluorescent probe for detecting silver ions and 2,4, 6-trinitrophenol. The preparation method comprises the step of synthesizing the fluorescent probe by taking quinaldinic acid, 3' -diaminobenzidine and polyphosphoric acid as raw materials in one step. The fluorescent probe has good selectivity and visual color change for silver ions and 2,4, 6-trinitrophenol, the detection limit is 1.36 mu M and 0.82 mu M respectively, the fluorescent probe can be used for identifying the silver ions and the 2,4, 6-trinitrophenol in environmental water bodies such as tap water, river water and the like or soil respectively, and the fluorescent probe has good application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bamboo nano lignin sun-screening agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a green and environment-friendly bamboo nano lignin sun-screening agent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: after the bamboo is primarily processed, the bamboo is cooked in a p-toluenesulfonic acid solution, and filtrate is obtained after suction filtration and separation. Diluting the filtrate and centrifuging to obtain a bamboo nano lignin solution; and finally, exchanging the obtained bamboo nano lignin solution to be nearly neutral by deionized water, and performing air drying at room temperature to obtain the bamboo nano lignin sun-screening agent. Adding the obtained product into emulsion and varnish to obtain bamboo nano lignin sunscreen emulsion and varnish. The prepared bamboo nano lignin sun-screening emulsion and varnish are directly smeared on the surface of a leather material with sun-screening requirement, so as to achieve the purposes of ultraviolet resistance and sun-screening. The preparation method of the invention has simple preparation process and easy operation; the product can be prepared under the conditions of energy conservation and environmental protection, has the sunscreen effect, and has good development potential and application prospect.

title_en: pH nano probe capable of emitting wavelength response and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pH nano probe capable of emitting wavelength response, and belongs to the technical field of pH probes. The pH nanoprobe provided by the invention comprises NaYF 4 :Nd 3+ Nanoparticles and attachment to NaYF 4 :Nd 3+ Nanoparticle surface 4,7- (9, 9' -bis (4-carboxybutyl) -fluorenyl) -2,1, 3-benzothiadiazole (OFBT). In the present invention, OFBT has a high absorption cross section, its emission spectrum partially coincides with the excitation spectrum of Nd ions in the green region, and NaYF is used when the pH values of the solutions are different 4 :Nd 3+ The OFBT distribution on the surface of the nano-particles can be changed, so that the emission wavelength of the pH nano-probe is changed. Meanwhile, the pH nano probe provided by the invention responds depending on the emission wavelength, does not have the phenomenon of signal attenuation or even disappearance, and has good application value in the fields of biological imaging, detection and the like.

title_en: Liquid crystal amino acid facial cleanser and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to liquid crystal amino acid facial cleanser and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, by reasonably matching the glycine surfactant and other surfactants and adding the liquid crystal stabilizer capable of forming a liquid crystal system, the problem of poor high and low temperature stability of the amino acid facial cleanser can be well solved; the liquid crystal structure can also reduce the degreasing force of the surfactant on the skin, has good moisturizing effect, and ensures that the skin is moist and not tight after washing. The liquid crystal amino acid facial cleanser disclosed by the invention takes the glycine surfactant as a main surfactant, the liquid crystal thickening structure can obviously reduce the content of the surfactant and the content of the thickening agent, and meanwhile, the liquid crystal amino acid facial cleanser is rich in foam, easy to wash, mild, free of stimulation, free of pseudo-slip, easy to wash, free of residue and controllable in cost; the facial cleanser with different viscosities can be prepared by adjusting the proportion of the raw material components, the production and operation process is simple, and the facial cleanser is suitable for different packing materials of a pressure pump or a hose.

title_en: Heterocyclic compounds inhibiting SHP2 activity
abstract_en: A compound of formula (I) wherein ring A, Q, R is present 1 、R 2 、R 3 、R 4 、R 5 、R 6 、R 7 、R 8 、R 9 、R 10 、R 11 X, a, b, c and dAs defined in the specification.

title_en: Preparation method of D-phase emulsified emulsion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical production, and discloses a preparation method of a D-phase emulsion, which comprises the following steps of dispersing and uniformly mixing sodium surfactin and glycerol, heating to 75 ℃ in the mixing process, keeping the temperature stable, adding olive oil into the mixed solution after uniform mixing to form oleogel, slowly adding squalane, jojoba oil and tocopherol into the oleogel in sequence, slowly stirring in the adding process, cooling to 50 ℃ in the stirring process, keeping the temperature stable, and finally uniformly stirring. The preparation method of the D-phase emulsified emulsion has the advantages that the whole process is simple to operate, the production process difficulty can be effectively reduced, the production is carried out by using a simpler production method, the D-phase emulsified emulsion has better quality, the production is carried out under a strict environment, the stability of the production process is ensured, and the quality of the produced emulsion is ensured.

title_en: Antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant carex meyeriana extract, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant Meyer sedge extract, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of phytochemistry. Crushing the carex meyeriana, adding 50-95% ethanol with the volume and mass ratio of 8-12 times, soaking for 20-60 min, performing reflux extraction for 2 times, each time for 20-60 min, filtering, combining filtrates, concentrating, and drying to obtain the carex meyeriana. An application of Meyer sedge extract with antibacterial, antiinflammatory and antioxidant effects in preparing antibacterial, antiinflammatory or antioxidant agent is provided. The invention is an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and wula sedge extract, which is derived from wula sedge of carex of cyperaceae and is an ethanol extract of the whole wula sedge, has good antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and has the following effects on gram-negative bacteria, gram-positive bacteria and typical pathogenic bacteria of fungi: staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Candida albicans, etc.

title_en: 2, 2-dimethyl butyronitrile, derivative and synthetic method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, and particularly discloses 2, 2-dimethylbutyronitrile, a derivative thereof and a synthesis method. The synthesis method of the 2, 2-dimethyl butyronitrile comprises the following steps: in a solvent, under the ultrasonic condition, 2-chloro-2-methylbutane and cyanide carry out substitution reaction under the action of a catalyst and a cocatalyst or the catalyst, the cocatalyst and an acid-binding agent to obtain 2, 2-dimethylbutyranitrile; the catalyst is at least one of stearoyl sarcosinate, lauroyl sarcosinate or oleoyl sarcosinate, and the cocatalyst is crown ether compound or polyethylene glycol. The invention prepares the 2, 2-dimethyl butyronitrile with the purity of more than 99 percent and the yield of more than 88 percent by a specific synthesis process. 2, 2-dimethylbutyrate can be prepared by hydrolyzing 2, 2-dimethylbutyrate as a raw material, and the 2, 2-dimethylbutyrate can be prepared into a derivative of the 2, 2-dimethylbutyrate by acylation reaction or esterification reaction.

title_en: Quadrivalent manganese ion doped quaternary ammonium salt red light material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to aQuadrivalent manganese ion doped quaternary ammonium salt red light material and its preparation method and application. The material takes organic amine fluotitanate as a matrix and tetravalent manganese ions Mn 4+ As an activator, has a chemical composition of [ N (CH) 3 ) 4 ] 2 Ti 1‑x F 6 :xMn 4+ X is 0.1-5%; the fluorescent powder emits bright red light under the excitation of ultraviolet light and blue light, and has high luminous intensity, good stability and good color rendering property. The manufacturing method adopted by the invention is simple, the obtained product has stable quality, not only can supplement the red light missing part of the commercial cold white light LED to improve the color rendering index of the cold white light LED, but also can be fully compounded with the flexible organic glue to improve the moisture resistance of the fluorescent material, and can meet the requirement of white light LED illumination.

title_en: Rice washing water plant fermentation product capable of long-acting removing dandruff and relieving itching and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice washing water plant fermentation product capable of removing dandruff and relieving itching for a long time and a preparation method, belongs to the technical field of fermentation, and on the one hand, the invention provides a microbial composition for rice washing water fermentation, wherein the microbial composition is one or more of bifidobacterium longum, lactobacillus acidophilus and pediococcus pentosaceus, and provides application of the microbial composition in preparation of the rice washing water fermentation product.

title_en: Substituted quinazolinone derivatives and their use as positive allosteric modulators of MGLUR4
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel quinazolinone derivatives of formula (I) and pharmaceutical compositions containing these compounds. The compounds of formula (I) provided herein are useful as positive allosteric modulators of metabotropic glutamate receptor subtype 4 (mGluR 4), and thus are useful as therapeutic agents, especially in the treatment or prevention of disorders associated with altered glutamatergic signalling and/or functions and/or disorders which can be affected by altered glutamate levels or signalling.

title_en: Firming and anti-wrinkle essence cream and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics and discloses a firming and anti-wrinkle essence cream and a preparation method thereof, wherein the essence cream comprises 16-29% of a skin conditioner in percentage by mass; the skin conditioning agent comprises sodium hyaluronate, hydrogenated lecithin, tetrahydromethylpyrimidine carboxylic acid, hydrolyzed collagen, betaine, dipalmitoyl hydroxyproline, shea butter, tocopherol acetate, active ingredient A, active ingredient B, active ingredient C and bisabolol; the active component A comprises polydimethylsiloxane, cyclopentadidimethyl siloxane and polymethylsilsesquioxane, the active component B comprises cyclopentadidimethyl siloxane and polydimethylsiloxane/vinyl polydimethylsiloxane cross-linked polymer, and the active component C comprises sodium palmitoyl prolinate and a water lily extract. The essence cream has the remarkable effects of tightening skin and removing fine wrinkles.

title_en: Device and method for continuous liquid state alkyl passing in Grignard reaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for continuously introducing liquid alkane in a Grignard reaction, which are characterized in that: the bottom outlet of the liquid alkane storage tank is connected to the interior of the Grignard reaction kettle through a pipeline, a metering pump on the pipeline and an atomizer at the tail end of the pipeline; (1) pumping liquid methyl chloride or ethyl chloride into a liquid alkane storage tank, controlling the methyl chloride or the ethyl chloride to atomize the liquid alkane through a pipeline and an atomizer at the tail end of the pipeline by a metering pump, and then feeding the liquid alkane into a Grignard reaction kettle; (2) the temperature of the lattice reaction kettle is controlled to be 60-80 ℃ and the pressure is controlled to be below 0.40MPa by adjusting the input amount of liquid alkane. The invention has the advantages that: the emergency caused by manual operation errors is avoided, and the safety of the device is improved; the metering pump can accurately control the feeding speed and the feeding amount of the alkane, the Grignard reaction process is more stable, the reaction is more complete, and the Grignard production efficiency can be effectively improved; meanwhile, the liquid alkane absorbs the Grignard reaction heat and changes into a gas state to participate in the reaction, so that the reaction heat is absorbed, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Skin composition, bath lotion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a skin composition, a bath lotion and a preparation method thereof, wherein the skin composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 6.0-10.0 parts of lauric acid; 2.5-6.0 parts of palmitic acid; 3.0-6.0 parts of myristic acid; 0.2-2.0 parts of high molecular weight fatty acid; 2.5-6.0 parts of alkali; 4.0-7.5 parts of sodium lauroamphoacetate; the molecular weight of the high molecular weight fatty acid is more than or equal to 265 g/mol. The skin composition and the bath lotion realize the balance of cleaning power, mildness and stability, and are particularly suitable for the elderly people suffering from body odor.

title_en: Heterocyclic compound containing indolone and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent display, in particular to a heterocyclic compound containing indolone and application thereof. The indole ketone-containing heterocyclic compound has a structure shown as a general formula (I): the novel OLED material provided by the invention takes an indolone heterocyclic structure compound as a matrix, and an electron-donating group is introduced into the matrix structure, so that the novel OLED material which has a high triplet state energy level, a good carrier mobility, high thermal stability and high film forming stability and can be matched with an adjacent energy level is obtained; the material can be applied to the field of organic electroluminescence and used as a red light main body material.

title_en: Cinnamate compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cinnamyl carboxylate compound and application of agriculturally acceptable salts thereof as herbicides, wherein the compound is shown in a general formula (I): the definition of each substituent group in the general formula I is shown in the specification. The compound of the general formula I has excellent herbicidal activity and can be used for preventing and controlling agricultural weeds.

title_en: Synthesis of isocoumarin derivative by carbon-hydrogen bond activation reaction under catalysis of rhodium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fine chemicals, and particularly relates to a preparation method of an isocoumarin derivative, wherein the isocoumarin derivative is a compound shown in a formula (I).

title_en: Preparation method of A2A and/or A2B receptor inhibitor
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for preparing inhibitors of the A2A and/or A2B receptors. The compound prepared by the method of the invention has an inhibiting effect on A2A and/or A2B, and can be used for preventing or treating diseases related to the activity or expression level of A2A and/or A2B.

title_en: Substituted thiophenecarboxamides and analogs as antibacterial agents
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to thienyl oxazolones of formula (III) and analogs thereof, which are useful for protecting plants from bacterial diseases, particularly bacterial diseases caused by bacteria belonging to the genus xanthomonas.

title_en: Preparation process of ceftiofur sodium for vacuum freeze-drying injection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of ceftiofur sodium for vacuum freeze-drying injection, which comprises the following steps: instrument and reagent preparation: preparing an element analyzer, an infrared spectrometer, a nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer and a mass spectrometer, preparing a commercially available AR-grade reagent, and detecting the reagent (II): detecting and analyzing the prepared reagent by an element analyzer, an infrared spectrometer, a nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer and a mass spectrometer, and recording related data, (III) preparing 2-furanmethanethiol: adding 500 ml-700 ml of ethanol, 30 ml-40 ml of water and 35 g-45 g of NaHS into a reagent bottle, and dropwise adding 30 g-40 g of 2-furoyl chloride at the temperature of 24-28 ℃ while stirring. The preparation process of ceftiofur sodium for vacuum freeze-drying injection utilizes the following steps of 1: 1, the active carbon and the adsorption resin are combined with a filtering and recrystallization mode, so that oil products can be effectively removed, and the purity of the ceftiofur sodium in the subsequent preparation is improved.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for detecting Abeta oligomer as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent probe for detecting Abeta oligomer and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural general formula of the fluorescent probe is shown as a formula (I). The preparation method comprises the following preparation steps: (1) heating p-hydroxybenzaldehyde and N-acetylglycine in an organic solvent for reaction, and taking sodium acetate as a catalyst to obtain a yellow solid; then heating the yellow solid and a methylamine water solution in an organic solvent for reaction, wherein potassium carbonate is used as a catalyst, and obtaining an intermediate 1; (2) heating the intermediate 1 and boron tribromide dichloromethane in an organic solvent to react to obtain an intermediate 2; (3) reacting intermediate 2 withAnd p-dimethylaminobenzaldehyde is subjected to heating reaction in an organic solvent, piperidine is used as a catalyst, and the fluorescent probe for detecting the A beta oligomer is obtained. The fluorescent probe can be used for beta-amyloid plaque imaging, has high sensitivity, and has wide application prospect in early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease and disclosure of pathological mechanism.

title_en: Selective hydrocracking catalyst for polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a selective hydrocracking catalyst for polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises a metal active component, a molecular sieve and fibrous alumina, wherein the fibrous alumina is loaded with the metal active component and coated on the surface of a molecular sieve layer, the content of the metal active component is 0.005-10%, the content of the molecular sieve is 10-90%, and the content of the fibrous alumina is 5-80%. The catalyst has the functions of hydrogenation and acid catalysis, and the functions of the catalyst and the acid catalysis are relatively independent, so that the coordination of hydrogenation-cracking performance is high, the moderate hydrogenation selectivity of the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon is obviously improved, the loss of the monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbon is reduced, the yield of the monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbon with high added value is improved, the inactivation rate is reduced, and the catalyst can be used in industrial production.

title_en: Microbicidal oxadiazole derivatives
abstract_en: Compounds of formula (I) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim 1 are disclosed which are useful as pesticides, especially as fungicides.

title_en: Bisphenol metal complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bisphenol metal complex, which has a structure shown as a formula I: in the formula I, R 1 、R 1 ＇、R 2 、R 2 ' same or different, each independently selected from hydrogen and substituted or unsubstituted C 1 ‑C 20 A hydrocarbon group of (a); r 3 ‑R 7 、R 3 ＇‑R 7 ' same or different, each independently selected from hydrogen and substituted or unsubstituted C 1 ‑C 20 A hydrocarbon group of (a); r 8 And R 9 Same or different, each independently selected from hydrogen or substituted or unsubstituted C 1 ‑C 20 A hydrocarbon group of (a); m and M', which are identical or different, are selected from group IV metals; x is halogen;

title_en: Hydrogel flakes comprising alginate particles and methods of making the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrogel sheet comprising a hydrogel and alginate particles contained in the hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel sheet has high strength and excellent adhesion by containing alginate particles inside the hydrogel.

title_en: Oil-in-water type emulsified cosmetic
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising A) a carboxylic acid-modified silicone having a specific chemical structure, liquid at room temperature; (B) oiling agent; and (C) water-in-water type emulsified cosmetic. The cosmetic of the present invention has high stability and can be provided with a cosmetic film having excellent water resistance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of novel fluorescent probe capable of being used for iron ion specificity detection based on molecular isomerization mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation and application of a novel fluorescent probe for high-selectivity detection of iron ions, belonging to the technical field of analytical chemistry. The fluorescent molecular probe contains C = N double bonds, double bond cis-trans isomerization can be caused under the condition of light excitation, the yield of fluorescence quanta is reduced, and the probe does not emit fluorescence at 483 nm. When Fe 3+ After the probe reacts with the probe, the turnover of a C = N double bond is prevented, the rigidity of the whole molecule is increased, and the fluorescence at 483 nm is obviously enhanced, so that the probe can react with Fe 3+ High selectivity identification detection. In addition, the fluorescent probe can also be used for detecting iron ions in different systems such as environment, living cells and the like, and has good application prospect. Formula (I).

title_en: Preparation method of isopropyl citrate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of isopropyl citrate, which comprises the following steps: carrying out esterification reaction on citric acid and isopropanol under the catalysis of a solid acid catalyst to obtain isopropyl citrate; wherein the solid acid catalyst is selected from immobilized p-benzenesulfonic acid and/or strong acid type cation exchange resin. The preparation method of the isopropyl citrate is simple and feasible, the post-treatment is convenient, and the low-boiling-point substances are distilled out only by simple filtration; the preparation method can improve the reaction efficiency of the esterification reaction, has no corrosion to equipment, and the catalyst is easy to recycle and has basically unchanged activity.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent compound containing multi-heterocyclic structure, organic electroluminescent device and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic electroluminescent compound containing a multi-element heterocyclic structure, an organic electroluminescent device and application thereof, wherein the structural formula of the organic electroluminescent compound is shown as the following formula (I): the organic electroluminescent compound can greatly reduce the driving voltage of the device, greatly reduce the consumption of electric energy, remarkably improve the luminous efficiency, and remarkably improve the service life of the organic electroluminescent device by reducing the driving voltage.

title_en: Preparation method of thiamine oxidation liquid and thiamine nitrate preparation method applying same
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of thiamine oxide solution and a thiamine nitrate preparation method applying the same, and relates to the technical field of organic synthesis. The preparation method of the thiothiamine oxidizing solution comprises the step of introducing thiothiamine pulping liquid and hydrogen peroxide into a microchannel reactor for reaction to obtain the thiothiamine oxidizing solution. Compared with the existing kettle type intermittent feeding reaction, the method for preparing the thiamine oxidizing solution by adopting the microchannel reactor has the advantages of large specific surface area of a reaction section and high cooling efficiency, can accurately control the temperature of a reaction system aiming at the strong exothermic self-promotion reaction of the oxidation reaction, effectively avoids the over-temperature phenomenon caused by factors such as manual feeding and the like of the kettle type intermittent reaction and the side reaction caused by over-temperature, and ensures the quality and the yield of finished products.

title_en: Particle-containing droplet system with monodisperse fluid volume
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein that produce a dispersion volume bound to solid phase particles (e.g., droplet-carrier particles) suspended in an immiscible phase (e.g., droplet particles). One embodiment of the system includes a plurality of hydrogel-based droplet-carrier particles containing micro-scale voids or cavities that hold aqueous phase droplets of a fluid within each droplet-carrier particle. The plurality of hydrogel droplet-carrier particles combined with the aqueous droplets are suspended as separate elements in an immiscible oil phase. Micro-scale hydrogel droplet-carrier particles containing voids or cavities may be generated using a microfluidic droplet generator. The droplet particles can be used for analysis of single-entities (e.g., single-molecules and single-cells) and analytes.

title_en: Method for constructing encapsulated ionic liquid extraction material by Pickering emulsion and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of environment functional materials, and discloses a method for constructing a packaged ionic liquid extraction material by a Pickering emulsion; firstly, introducing GO nano sheets, and then preparing Janus nano sheets with one surface modified with octadecane and the other surface unmodified through Pickering emulsion oil-water interface electrostatic interaction; then taking the obtained Janus nanosheets as stable particles, respectively adding 1, 6-hexamethylene diamine and hexamethylene diisocyanate into a water phase and an ionic liquid 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium hexafluorophosphate phase, and preparing an ionic liquid packaging extraction material through interfacial imine chemical polymerization; according to the invention, the Pickering emulsion is used as a bridge to connect the ionic liquid and the solvent extraction method to construct the ionic liquid packaging material and extract 2, 6-dichlorophenol, so that the problems that the traditional solvent extraction method is easy to cause secondary pollution and is difficult to recover are solved; secondly, the defect that the traditional ionic liquid packaging method is unstable and easy to leak is overcome; meanwhile, the size of the obtained material is about 200 mu m, and the recovery effect of the extraction material is effectively improved.

title_en: Method for regulating vanadium valence state in vanadium-phosphorus-oxygen catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for regulating and controlling the vanadium valence state in a vanadium-phosphorus-oxygen catalyst, which comprises the following steps: preparing a vanadium phosphorus oxide precursor; mixing the vanadium-phosphorus-oxygen precursor and balls in a ball-milling tank according to a mass ratio of 1: 0.5-2, vacuumizing the ball-milling tank, introducing gas, and performing ball milling by using a ball mill to obtain a ball-milled product, wherein the gas is oxygen or a mixed gas of oxygen and inert gas, and the inert gas is inert gas and/or nitrogen; and activating the ball-milled product to obtain the vanadium-phosphorus-oxygen catalyst. The method remarkably improves the activity and selectivity of the vanadium phosphorus oxide catalyst product compared with the existing catalyst by regulating the valence state of vanadium of the catalyst.

title_en: 10-undecylenoyl amino ethyl propionate, preparation method thereof and application thereof in mosquito repelling
abstract_en: The invention discloses 10-undecylenoyl ethyl aminomethylpropionate, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in mosquito repelling. The compound 10-undecylenoyl ethyl aminomethylpropionate has a structural formula shown in formula I. The compound has the advantages of simple synthesis process route, easily obtained raw materials, low toxicity, no allergy, no irritation and safe use; the mosquito repellent agent has a good mosquito repellent effect, the effective protection time of 10-undecenoyl ethyl aminomethylpropionate with the mass fraction of 10% is 8.3 +/-1.0 h, and the mosquito repellent agent reaches the part 9 of GB/T13917.9-2009 pesticide registration sanitary insecticide indoor efficacy test and evaluation: the repellent has further research and expanded use value according to the A-grade standard.

title_en: Application of fibroin in preparation of anthocyanin nano-composite
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of fibroin in preparation of an anthocyanin nano compound. The fibroin is one or the combination of fibroin and sericin which are products after the hydrolysis of the silk, and the molecular weight of the fibroin or the sericin is 30000 Da. And mixing the protein solution with the anthocyanin solution, and preparing the anthocyanin nano compound in a vortex mode. The anthocyanin comes from the mulberry, belongs to a silkworm system together with the silk, has an obvious anthocyanin protection effect due to hydrolysis active ingredients of the silk, does not influence the activity of the anthocyanin, is simple in preparation method and controllable in conditions, is beneficial to large-scale industrialization, and promotes the development of the silkworm system.

title_en: Resin for adsorbing parachloroaniline in para-ester, synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resin for adsorbing parachloroaniline in para-ester, a synthetic method and application thereof. The synthesis method comprises the following steps: mixing a polystyrene polymer, aluminum trichloride and dimethyl fumarate for reaction to obtain a dimethyl fumarate modified polymer; and cleaning and drying the dimethyl fumarate modified polymer to obtain the resin for adsorbing the parachloroaniline. Through covalent bonding of dimethyl fumarate molecules on the surface of the polystyrene polymer, a hydrogen bond effect or an adsorption effect can be generated on the amino group of p-chloroaniline, and the p-chloroaniline has a very small adsorption effect on the p-ester, so that differential adsorption can be generated between the p-chloroaniline and the p-ester, and the p-chloroaniline in the p-ester product can be removed very conveniently.

title_en: Treatment method of 2-hydroxy-3-naphthoic acid postpartum wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment method of 2-hydroxy-3-naphthoic acid postpartum wastewater, which comprises the following steps: filtering, primary adsorption, secondary neutralization, primary desorption, secondary adsorption, secondary neutralization and secondary desorption, wherein the two works of the secondary neutralization in the step c and the primary desorption in the step d are carried out simultaneously. By adopting the technical measures, the invention fully treats the chemical wastewater in the production of the 2-hydroxy-3-naphthoic acid, and can directly discharge the chemical wastewater after reaching the environmental protection standard. Meanwhile, useful resources such as 2-naphthol, 2,3 acid, 2,6 acid and the like are recycled, the environment pollution caused by the emission to the environment is avoided, the practical significance is high, and the resources are recycled in production, so that the production cost can be reduced.

title_en: High-purity L-valine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-purity L-valine, which comprises the following steps: (1) filtering the L-valine solution to be purified, and collecting filtrate, wherein the concentration of the L-valine solution to be purified is not lower than 50 g/L; (2) adjusting pH of the filtrate to acidity, separating in weakly acidic cation resin, decolorizing the collected effluent, concentrating, cooling, crystallizing, separating, washing, and drying. The invention effectively separates the L-valine and the hetero amino acid, the content of the single hetero amino acid in the product is not higher than 0.01 percent, and the crystal purity of the L-valine is not lower than 99.9 percent. And pure water is adopted as an eluent, so that the method is environment-friendly and pollution-free, and is beneficial to subsequent wastewater treatment.

title_en: Fixed fragrance composition with fragrance of vegetarian cabbage, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of essence and flavor, and particularly discloses a fixed-flavor composition with the fragrance of Maoxinlan as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The fixed fragrance composition of the vegetarian cabbage fragrance comprises the following components: isoamyl salicylate; coumarin; iso-methyl ionone; synthesizing the oak moss; qianlong wood; fenmei sandalwood; musk T; and a mixture; methyl dihydrojasmonate; the preparation method comprises the following steps: heating and stirring coumarin, synthetic oak moss and methyl dihydrojasmonate until the coumarin, the synthetic oak moss and the methyl dihydrojasmonate are dissolved to obtain a first mixture; step (2), uniformly stirring the first mixture with the iso-methyl ionone, the Qianlong wood, the musk T, the Fengmen sandalwood, the isoamyl salicylate and the mixture to obtain a second mixture; and (3) refluxing and standing the second mixture to obtain the fixed fragrance composition with the fragrance of the Maoxinlan. The fragrance fixing composition with the fragrance of the Xinxin orchid can be used for essence, and has the advantage of keeping stable smell; in addition, the preparation method has the advantage of stabilizing the vegetarian orchid aroma.

title_en: Resource treatment device and method for industrial wastewater containing tetrabromobisphenol A
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial wastewater treatment, and particularly discloses a resource treatment device and a resource treatment method for industrial wastewater containing tetrabromobisphenol A, wherein the resource treatment device comprises a storage pool for storing industrial wastewater containing tetrabromobisphenol A and a resource treatment physical and chemical device connected with the storage pool; the resource processing device comprises a circulating adsorption component and a pyrolysis separation component; the method specifically comprises the following steps: pretreating wastewater; introducing the pretreated industrial wastewater into a circulating adsorption component to realize the separation of tetrabromobisphenol A; then tetrabromobisphenol A is pyrolyzed in a pyrolysis chamber to obtain CO and CO 2 HBr, a mixed gas; introducing the mixed gas into an ethanol solution to obtain a bromoethane solution; the device can be usedCarrying out composite treatment on tetrabromobisphenol A to realize resource recovery; the method has the advantages of high efficiency, low cost, no secondary pollution and convenient realization of industrial application.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nonlinear compound with D-pi-A structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a coumarin-based nonlinear material with a D-pi-A structure, which has an obvious multi-photon absorption effect, can be used as a photopolymerization initiator, and belongs to the field of organic chemical optics. Nonlinear materials have more and more applications, for example, two-photon polymerization additive manufacturing has great demand for new nonlinear materials with high-efficiency two-photon absorption initiators. In consideration, the invention designs and synthesizes a series of non-linear compounds with coumarin-based structures, and tests the two-photon polymerization performance. The result shows that the substance has good nonlinear performance, the compound can be used as a two-photon initiator to successfully initiate monomer polymerization, and the scanning rate can reach 100000 mu m/s in the polymerization process under the laser power of 50 mw.

title_en: Application of alkaloid arnodine and derivatives thereof in preventing and treating plant virus and bacterial diseases
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of alkaloid arnudine and derivatives thereof in treating plant virus and bacterial diseases, which are found for the first time that the arnudine and the derivatives I-1 to I-25 thereof show good activity against plant virus and bacterial diseases and can well inhibit Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV) and cucumber wilt, peanut brown spots, apple ring spots, wheat sharp eyespot, corn small spots, watermelon anthracnose, rice bakanae, tomato early blight, wheat scab, rice blast, phytophthora capsici, sclerotium napobum, cucumber botrytis cinerea and 14 plant pathogens of rice sharp eyespot.

title_en: Aza-aromatic compound used as electron transport material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a class of aza-aromatic compounds, which can be used as electron transport materials. The compound has a parent structure of asymmetrically substituted dibenzo heterocycle, has high bond energy among atoms, good thermal stability, is favorable for solid-state accumulation among molecules, has strong transition capability of electrons, and can effectively reduce the driving voltage of an organic electroluminescent device, improve the current efficiency and prolong the service life when used as an electron transmission material. The invention also provides an organic electroluminescent device and a display device containing the compound.

title_en: Preparation method of 6-dehydronandrolone acetate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of steroid drug intermediates. The invention provides a preparation method of 6-dehydro nandrolone acetate, which comprises the following steps: carrying out catalytic reaction on estra-4-ene-3, 17-dione, acetic anhydride and p-toluenesulfonic acid to obtain a compound 1; carrying out reduction reaction on the compound 1, borohydride and aluminum trichloride to obtain a compound 2; reacting the compound 2, N-bromosuccinimide with DMF to obtain a compound 3 solution; carrying out addition reaction on the compound 3 solution and alkali to obtain a compound 4; and carrying out catalytic reaction on the compound 4, acetic anhydride, triethylamine and dichloromethane to obtain 6-dehydronandrolone acetate. According to the invention, by adding borohydride and aluminum trichloride in a reasonable proportion, hydrolysis of 3-bit ester group is effectively avoided, and side reactions are less; meanwhile, the yield and the purity of the target product are obviously improved by reasonably setting the synthesis route and controlling the reaction temperature.

title_en: Repairing essence for regulating epithelial immune microenvironment stability based on adaptogen and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a repairing essence for regulating epithelial immune microenvironment stability based on an adaptogen and a preparation method thereof, wherein the repairing essence comprises the following components in parts by mass: beta-glucan 0.01-1%, yeast lysate 1-20%, organic agave extract 1-20%, tetrahydropyrimidic carboxylic acid 0.2-5%, tricholoma matsutake extract 0.3-10%, blue-green algae extract 0.5-10%, hydrolyzed royal jelly protein 0.5-5%, humectant 1.6-8.8%, preservative 0.15-1.2% and the balance of water. The repair essence provided by the invention is based on an immune regulation system of an organism, promotes the proliferation of fibroblasts and the production of extracellular matrix, and inhibits the expression of MMP-1 matrix metalloproteinase, thereby regulating the immune self-stability and the immune defense capability of skin, recovering the relatively stable internal and external environments of skin tissue immunity, and realizing the rapid relief and repair of skin inflammatory symptoms.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing isopropylbenzene by hydrogenolysis of alpha-dimethyl benzyl alcohol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalyst for preparing isopropylbenzene by hydrogenolysis of alpha-dimethyl benzyl alcohol and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a mode of impregnating carriers by different palladium sources step by step is adopted, so that the problem of low utilization rate of active components of the hydrogenolysis of the alpha-dimethyl benzyl alcohol is solved, the reaction temperature is reduced, the occurrence of side reactions is effectively inhibited, and the selectivity of the catalyst is improved.

title_en: Compound and triplet-triplet annihilation up-conversion system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of luminescent materials, in particular to a compound and a triplet-triplet annihilation up-conversion system. The invention discloses a compound, wherein a photosensitive unit and a masking agent unit are connected through a non-conjugated covalent bond. The compound can realize up-conversion luminescence under an excitation light source without additionally adding a photosensitizer or a masking agent. In addition, the triplet-triplet annihilation up-conversion luminescent material provided by the invention has good photo-thermal stability, can realize up-conversion luminescence under the condition of high excitation light power density in a solution, thereby obtaining higher up-conversion efficiency, and is a novel up-conversion luminescent material.

title_en: Benzodiazepine derivatives, and preparation method and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses benzodiazepines of formula (I) Derivatives, enantiomers, diastereomers, racemates and mixtures thereof, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts, crystalline hydrates and solvates thereof, and methods for preparing same, and pharmaceutical compositions for preparing an antidote for a GABAA receptor agonist, an analeptic agent after anesthesia, an antiepileptic drug, a pharmaceutical composition for treating epilepsy, a method for preparing same, and a pharmaceutical composition for treating epilepsy,The application of the medicine for resisting senile dementia, antidote for alcoholism and stimulant for treating mental loss caused by unknown reason.

title_en: Organic catalytic system with polyboron center and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic catalytic system with a polyborosity center, which comprises a main catalyst with a polyborosity center and a cocatalyst; the invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the organic catalytic system with the polyboronic center. The organic catalytic system disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high activity and easiness in preparation, and shows excellent reaction activity when applied to the preparation of small organic molecules and polymers.

title_en: Synthesis method of N-aryl nitrone derivative
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of N-aryl nitrone derivatives, which comprises the steps of reacting an aryl diazo ester compound 1 with a nitroso compound 2 in a solvent under the condition of illumination, removing a molecular of nitrogen from the aryl diazo ester compound 1 and generating an active carbene species, reacting the nitroso compound 2 with the active carbene species through a nucleophilic N-center of the nitroso compound to generate a zwitterionic intermediate, and then rearranging to generate the N-aryl nitrone derivatives 3. The method does not need any catalyst or additive, only needs visible light as green energy to drive, has mild reaction conditions and easy operation, and can carry out mass synthesis by a flow photochemical method.

title_en: Compound with dibenzo five-membered heterocycle as core and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound taking a dibenzo five-membered heterocycle as a core and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductors. The structure of the compound provided by the invention is shown as a general formula (1): the compound contains a dibenzo five-membered heterocyclic mother nucleus structure, has proper HOMO and LUMO energy levels, and has higher Eg and triplet state energy levels (T1). The compound provided by the invention also has higher glass transition temperature and molecular thermal stability; as OWhen the material of the luminous layer or the hole blocking or electron transport layer of the LED luminous device is used, the three-dimensional property of the structure can be effectively improved by matching the branched chain in the range of the invention; the whole molecule has large steric hindrance and is not easy to rotate, and the chemical stability of the material is improved. Therefore, after the compound is applied to an OLED device, the luminous efficiency of the device can be effectively improved, and the service life of the device can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Deprotection solution for side chain protecting group of DNA-labeled polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of polypeptides, in particular to a deprotection solution of a polypeptide side chain protecting group for DNA marking and application thereof. The deprotection solution for the polypeptide side chain protecting group for DNA marking provided by the invention comprises an organic salt buffer solution and/or an inorganic salt buffer solution; the pH value of the solution is 5.0-9.0. All the protective groups can be removed in the same solution, so that the degradation reaction of the polypeptide is reduced to the minimum, the waste of raw materials is greatly reduced, and the post-treatment of the reaction is simplified.

title_en: Preparation of photocatalytic hydrogel and application of photocatalytic hydrogel in synthesis of lactic acid by photocatalytic oxidation of xylose
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation of a photocatalytic hydrogel and application of the photocatalytic hydrogel in synthesis of lactic acid by photocatalytic oxidation of xylose, and belongs to the technical field of catalysis. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: and uniformly stirring the semiconductor, the chitosan and the alkali-urea system, then putting the mixture into an ultralow temperature refrigerator, and obtaining the photocatalytic hydrogel material doped with different semiconductors through a simple freeze thawing method. The application process of the catalyst in the synthesis of lactic acid by photocatalytic oxidation of xylose comprises the following steps: mixing the photocatalytic hydrogel, xylose and an alkaline solution, and carrying out photocatalytic reaction; filtering to remove catalyst, and measuring lactic acid content of filtrate by high performance liquid chromatograph. The method for preparing the catalyst has better universality, the used catalyst has the advantages of high catalytic activity, good stability, recycling and the like, the method is simple and efficient in catalyzing xylose to synthesize lactic acid, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of DL-lysine
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of DL-lysine. The preparation method comprises the following steps: taking L-lysine salt as a raw material, taking an organic acid aqueous solution as a solvent, carrying out racemization reaction under the action of a racemization agent, cooling to separate out and separating after the reaction is finished to obtain DL-lysine salt solid; then adding water to prepare a DL-lysine salt solution, decoloring and desalting to obtain a DL-lysine solution; concentrating to 50-80 wt%, maintaining the temperature at 30-65 deg.C for crystal growth to separate out DL-lysine crystal, maintaining the temperature at 0-30 deg.C for crystal growth, performing solid-liquid separation, and drying the solid product to obtain DL-lysine. The method provided by the invention improves the purity and yield of the DL-lysine solid product, does not need to use organic solvents such as absolute ethyl alcohol and the like for crystallization and washing, and is suitable for industrial production of the DL-lysine solid product.

title_en: Cycloalkane-1, 3-diamine derivatives
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound having an inhibitory effect on the interaction between the men and MLL proteins or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. A compound represented by formula (1) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. title_en: Substituted pyrazolopyrimidines and substituted purines and their use as inhibitors of ubiquitin-specific processing protease 1(USP1)
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compounds having formula I, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts and solvates thereof, wherein X 1 、X 2 、X 11 、X 12 、R 1 、R 3 、R 5 、R 5 '、R 6 And R 7 As defined in the specification. The present disclosure also relates to the use of compounds of formula I to inhibit USP1 protein and/or to treat disorders responsive to inhibition of USP1 protein and USP1 activity. The disclosed compounds are particularly useful for treating cancer.

title_en: Acne-removing and spot-fading plant compound hydrolat as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a acne-removing and speckle-lightening plant compound hydrolat which is an aqueous solution obtained by extracting essential oil from at least one of schizonepeta tenuifolia, bamboo, celery seeds and orange peels through ultrasonic-assisted distillation. The preparation method is simple and easy to operate, and the effective parts of the raw materials are fully utilized. The in vitro activity experiment is carried out on the plant compound hydrolat, and the result shows that the plant compound hydrolat has excellent acne-removing and spot-fading effects; and has no irritation to human skin, and can be directly used or applied in daily chemical product formula.

title_en: Preparation method of all-silicon type short b-axis ZSM-5 zeolite molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an all-silicon type short b-axis ZSM-5 zeolite molecular sieve, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a reaction solution: dropwise adding ethyl orthosilicate into an ultrapure water mixed solution of sodium hydroxide, tetrapropylammonium hydroxide, isopropanol and urea, and fully stirring; (2) homogeneous reaction: carrying out homogeneous reaction on the reaction liquid stirred in the step (1); (3) washing the solution reacted in the step (2), and taking out and drying the precipitate; (4) and (3) calcining: and (4) calcining the dried product in the step (3) to obtain the all-silicon type short b-axis ZSM-5 zeolite molecular sieve. The invention can prepare the all-silicon type short b-axis ZSM-5 zeolite molecular sieve at a lower temperature, and avoids aggregation in a high-temperature process. The preparation process is simple, and the prepared material is all-silicon and has a short b axis, so that the method has a further research prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of tetra-ester type gemini quaternary ammonium salt leather sterilization mildew inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a tetraethoxy gemini quaternary ammonium salt leather sterilization mildew preventive. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, taking hydroxyl-terminated diol and chloroacetyl chloride as reactants, and synthesizing ester-based dichlorides through nucleophilic substitution reaction; then the ester dichloride and diethylamine are subjected to nucleophilic substitution reaction to synthesize ester di-tertiary amine; then, taking fatty alcohol and bromoacetyl bromide as reactants, and synthesizing bromoacetate through acylation reaction; and finally, carrying out quaternization reaction on the obtained bromoacetate and esterditertiary amine to prepare the tetraestertype gemini quaternary ammonium salt sterilization mildewcide, wherein the ester groups are respectively distributed on the spacer and the hydrophobic chain of the gemini quaternary ammonium salt. The tetra-ester type gemini quaternary ammonium salt leather sterilization mildew inhibitor prepared by the method has good antibacterial mildew resistance, can be applied to the field of leather sterilization mildew prevention, and has good market application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of 4-ethyl-5-aminopyrimidine
abstract_en: The invention discloses 4-ethyl-5-aminopyrimidine, which comprises the following specific steps: (1) 4-bromo-5-aminopyrimidine and tributyl vinyl tin are used as initial raw materials, and the 4-vinyl-5-aminopyrimidine is prepared through a Steiller coupling reaction. (2) 4-vinyl-5-aminopyrimidine is used as a starting material, and is subjected to palladium-carbon hydrogenation reaction to prepare the 4-ethyl-5-aminopyrimidine. The method has the advantages of short process route, few types of reagents participating in the reaction, convenient operation, mild and easily controlled reaction conditions, easy realization of industrialization, easy purification of products and high yield, and the unreported molecules provide more possibilities for research and development of new drugs.

title_en: Furan-linked 1,3, 4-oxadiazole formamide compounds and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a furan-linked 1,3, 4-oxadiazole formamide compound and a preparation method and application thereof, which comprises the steps of taking 2-furancarboxylic acid and synthesizing 2-furancarboxylic acid ester through esterification; performing hydrazinolysis reaction on the 2-furanformic ether to prepare 2-furanformylhydrazine; reacting 2-furoyl hydrazine with oxalyl chloride monomethyl ester to generate a bisamide intermediate; reacting the bisamide intermediate with phosphorus oxychloride to prepare furan-linked 1,3, 4-oxadiazole formic ether; the furan-linked 1,3, 4-oxadiazole formic ether reacts with substituted benzylamine to synthesize furan-linked 1,3, 4-oxadiazole formamide. The compound has good control effect on botrytis cinerea, sclerotinia sclerotiorum and early blight of tomato under the in vitro condition, and can be used for controlling fungal diseases of agricultural or forestry plants. The preparation method of the compound is simple and convenient, the yield is high, and the product property is stable.

title_en: Methods of treating solid tumor cancers using cryptobrevicin and biomarkers
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods for determining the likelihood that an individual afflicted with a solid tumor cancer will benefit from treatment with a cryptoleptin. In addition, there are also treatment methods based on such determinations. In several embodiments, the markers prostaglandin reductase 1(PTGR1), protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor 14 (PTPN14), aspartate beta-hydroxylase (ASPH), together or alone, may be used to enhance or direct treatment with cryptobrecin. In certain embodiments, the protein or gene may be expressed or methylated.

title_en: Process for producing glucopyranosyl derivative and intermediate therefor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a glucopyranosyl derivative compound serving as a sodium-dependent glucose transporter (SGLT) inhibitor and an important intermediate thereof. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate, the obtained product has high optical purity, high total yield, simple and convenient post-treatment, easy purification and safe and controllable process, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Ma Dexin derivative compounds, compositions and uses thereof for the treatment of cancer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, in particular cancer therapy. More particularly, the present invention relates to novel compounds which are generally used as medicaments. In particular, the invention relates to the use of these novel compounds for increasing the presentation, typically the production and presentation, of an antigen of advanced translational product (PTP) origin by cells, in particular cancer cells, or for altering the immune peptide group in a subject and for inducing or stimulating an immune response in said subject. The disclosure also relates to the use of such compounds, in particular for preparing a pharmaceutical composition and/or allowing or improving the efficiency of a therapy in a subject in need thereof. Also disclosed are methods for treating a disease, particularly cancer, preventing or treating metastasis and/or recurrence of cancer in a subject. Furthermore, the invention provides kits suitable for use in preparing a composition according to the invention and/or for performing the methods described herein.

title_en: Benzopyrone compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benzopyrone compound and a preparation method and application thereof, which are characterized in that the structural formula of the benzopyrone compound is shown as I, and the molecular formula is C 13 H 14 O 4 The preparation method comprises the following steps of: the aspergillus of M2014086 is used for obtaining a fermentation product of a benzopyrone compound through microbial fermentation culture, then the fermentation product is soaked in ethyl acetate for extraction to obtain a crude extract, and the crude extract is separated and purified through reduced pressure silica gel column chromatography, medium pressure column chromatography and reversed phase semi-preparative high performance liquid chromatography.

title_en: Quinoline ring-substituted aminophenoxy zinc complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quinoline ring-substituted aminophenoxy zinc complex, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in catalyzing ring-opening polymerization of lactone with high activity and high selectivity. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the neutral ligand directly reacts with the metal raw material compound in an organic medium, and then the target compound is obtained through the steps of filtering, concentrating and recrystallizing. The quinoline ring-substituted aminophenoxy zinc complex is a high-efficiency lactone ring-opening polymerization catalyst and can be used for catalyzing the polymerization reaction of lactones such as lactide and the like; higher isotacticity of the polylactide is obtained especially for racemic lactide. The quinoline ring substituted amino phenol zinc oxide complex has obvious advantages: the raw materials are easy to obtain, the synthesis route is simple, the product yield is high, and the catalyst has high catalytic activityStereoselectivity, can obtain high-regularity and high-molecular-weight polyester materials, and can meet the requirements of industrial departments. The structural formula is as follows: 。

title_en: Chiral 3-methylene indoline compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a handled 3-methylene indoline compound, which directly takes alkynyl imine as a substrate to react with another part of terminal alkyne reagent in a catalytic system containing metal rhodium and chiral phosphine ligand to obtain chiral methylene terminal position containing extractionThe substituted indoline compound has the advantages of high yield, good enantioselectivity, mild reaction conditions, simple and easily obtained raw materials, wide substrate applicability, no need of adopting an N-protected substrate, and 100% atom economy. In addition, the invention also provides a chiral 3-methylene indoline compound shown in the formula (3), provides a methodological basis for the total synthesis of active molecules containing the core skeleton, and has important potential application value.

title_en: 17(15 → 16) -methyl abietane type diterpene compound, preparation method, pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antitumor compounds, and discloses a 17(15 → 16) -ambrosine diterpenoid compound with an antitumor effect, which is extracted from the dahlia bracteata dunn, a preparation method, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, wherein the 17(15 → 16) -ambrosine diterpenoid compound is a natural antitumor compound extracted from branches of the dahlia bracteata dunn, has the biological activity of inhibiting tumor cells, especially has an obvious effect of inhibiting human primitive myeloid leukemia cells HL-60 cells, has a very large application prospect in preparing antitumor drugs, and has an important effect of improving the medical and economic values of the dahlia bracteata dunn.

title_en: Anion cage-shaped compound with fluorescence property and synthetic method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anion cage compound with fluorescence property and a preparation method thereof, aiming at the defect that the supermolecular cage structure constructed by anion coordination lacks a more direct detection signal, a series of tetrahedral cage structures based on phosphate anion coordination are constructed. And a series of fluorescent materials which respond to halogenated alkane and freon gas molecules are obtained by utilizing the identification of the cage structures to a series of halogenated alkane and freon molecules. The ligand is reasonably designed, and the ligand and phosphate radical anions are self-assembled into the anion tetrahedral cage with the fluorescent property. The tetrahedral cage can realize the capture and response of a series of halogenated alkane and Freon molecules which are harmful to the environment, and has very important significance for environmental protection, especially air protection.

title_en: High-pressure dehydration device and method for TMA (mechanical action model) reactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure dehydration device of a TMA (three-dimensional model-based) reactor, wherein a first reaction condenser is arranged above the reactor, the top of the reactor is connected with a first reaction condenser pipeline through a gas phase pipeline, and the bottom of the first reaction condenser is connected with the reactor pipeline; the reaction system also comprises a reaction second condenser and a dehydration tower, wherein the reaction first condenser is connected with the pipeline of the dehydration tower at the top part of the reaction second condenser through a gas phase pipeline, and the dehydration tower is connected with the pipeline of the reactor at the bottom part of the dehydration tower through a return pipe; the upper end of the dehydration tower is internally provided with a liquid collecting tray which comprises a circular tray body and a conical dome, and the tray body is connected with a liquid drainage pipeline outside the dehydration tower through a valve. The invention also provides a method for dewatering by using the device. The method reduces the catalyst consumption in the preparation process of the trimellitic acid and reduces the corrosion of equipment.

title_en: Preparation method of phloroglucinol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of phloroglucinol, which comprises the steps of chlorinating resorcinol serving as a starting raw material by adopting N-chlorosuccinimide to obtain an intermediate 4-chlororesorcinol, and reacting the intermediate 4-chlororesorcinol with potassium hydroxide to obtain the phloroglucinol. The synthesis method has the advantages of few reaction steps, mild reaction conditions, safe operation, lower production cost and less amount of generated high-pollution waste compared with the existing preparation method. The invention also provides a new synthesis method of the intermediate 4-chlororesorcinol, and through optimization, the whole reaction process avoids using toxic solvents, and simultaneously well solves the problem that the finished phloroglucinol product has yellow color.

title_en: Nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supported nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the supported nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst comprises a catalytic center and a carrier, the catalytic center is non-noble metal nickel, and the carrier is a series of metal phosphates containing different metals; the nickel metal particles are uniformly distributed on the surface of the carrier and in the pore structure and are tightly combined with the carrier to form the catalyst. The catalyst takes metal phosphate with a porous structure formed by the reaction of different types of metal chloride and ammonium dihydrogen phosphate as a carrier, and the purpose of regulating and controlling Lewis acid sites and Bronsted acid sites of the carrier is achieved by regulating and controlling the types of metals in the metal phosphate carrier, so that the nickel-based metal phosphate catalyst with the optimal catalytic activity is obtained.
