Ni is uniformly loaded on the surface of the carrier and in the hollow structure by an impregnation method, and the strong metal-carrier interaction can effectively prevent the falling and sintering of active metal. The optimized carrier acidity can promote the hydrodeoxygenation of vanillin together with the active metal nickel to the maximum extent.

title_en: Method for preparing pure benzene by catalytic conversion of lignin by using metal-supported catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing pure benzene by catalytic conversion of lignin by using a metal-supported catalyst. It comprises the following steps: the lignin is prepared by taking a metal ruthenium-tungsten loaded high-silicon molecular sieve as a catalyst and carrying out catalytic conversion reaction. The method provided by the invention adopts the metal supported catalyst for catalysis, the product is mainly benzene, the catalyst system is simple, green and environment-friendly, the lignin is cheap and easy to obtain, and the possibility is provided for large-scale catalytic conversion and utilization of the lignin.

title_en: Method for preparing phenolic substances by photothermal pyrolysis of waste fan blades
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of waste fan blade treatment and resource utilization, and particularly relates to a method for preparing phenolic substances by photothermal pyrolysis of waste fan blades. The method for preparing the phenolic substances by photothermal pyrolysis of the waste fan blades comprises the following steps: s1, crushing the scrapped wind driven generator rotor blades to obtain crushed fan blades; s2, pyrolyzing the broken fan blades in a photothermal pyrolysis device to obtain pyrolysis coke and pyrolysis oil; s3, filtering and centrifuging the pyrolysis oil obtained in the S2 to remove a part of impurities, so as to obtain primarily purified tar; s4, rectifying the tar after primary purification to obtain three phenolic substances of phenol, p-isopropylphenol and 4-isopropenylphenol. The advantages are that: aims to realize the preparation of phenol chemical raw materials by treating waste fan blades in a photothermal pyrolysis mode and realize the resource utilization of the waste fan blades.

title_en: Lubricant Ethylene Bis Stearamide (EBS) and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lubricant synthesis, in particular to a lubricant Ethylene Bis Stearamide (EBS) and a preparation method thereof. The lubricant Ethylene Bis Stearamide (EBS) is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of stearic acid, 0.5-1.0 part of compound catalyst, 0.20-0.45 part of antioxidant and 11.7-12.8 parts of ethylenediamine; the antioxidant is one or more of 2, 6-di-tert-butyl-p-cresol, 2- (2-hydroxy-3, 5-ditert-amyl-phenyl) benzotriazole, poly (4-hydroxy-2, 2, 6, 6-tetramethyl-1-piperidineethanol) succinate, 4' methylenebis (2, 6-di-tert-butylphenol), n-octadecyl beta- (4-hydroxyphenyl-3, 5-di-tert-butyl) propionate and tris (2, 4-tert-butylphenyl) phosphite. The ethylene bis stearamide prepared in the application is not easy to yellow, is white and clean compared with a commercially available finished product, and has the advantages of good color and luster and high quality of the finished product.

title_en: Star-shaped compound of BODIPY (BODIPY) bridged triperylene diimide derivative and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure of a BODIPY (boron dipyrromethene) bridged triperylene diimide derivative star-shaped compound shown in a formula (I) and a preparation method thereof. The method is realized by the following steps: and carrying out a Sonogashira coupling reaction on the triethynyl boron dipyrromethene shown in the formula (II) and bay-position monobromoperylenediimide derivative (III) to generate a star-shaped compound of the boron dipyrromethene bridged tripylenediimide derivative shown in the formula (I). The compound is in a three-arm star shape, can effectively weaken the pi-pi interaction between molecules, inhibit the self-aggregation of the compound in the film forming process, has strong light absorption and fluorescence emission capability, and can be used for organic light-emitting diodes, solar cells and light absorption daysLines, etc.

title_en: Phytosterol isostearate microcapsule for water-based cosmetics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phytosterol isostearate microcapsule. The phytosterol isostearate microcapsule is a spherical microcapsule consisting of a phytosterol isostearate capsule core and a coating layer coating the capsule core. The phytosterol isostearate microcapsule has good water solubility, can be applied to various water-based cosmetics, and has very wide application prospect.

title_en: Porous cleaning soap and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a porous cleaning soap and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of preparation of cleaning soaps. The invention also provides the porous cleaning soap which has the advantages of high foaming speed, good moisturizing effect, strong dirt-removing power and sterilization and inflammation diminishing effects.

title_en: Synthetic method of 3-bromomethyl-7-chlorobenzo [ b ] thiophene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthetic method of 3-bromomethyl-7-chlorobenzo [ b ] thiophene, which comprises the following steps: adding a substrate of 3-methyl-7-chlorobenzo [ b ] thiophene into straight-chain alkane of C6-C8 serving as a solvent, irradiating by using a bulb, adding an initiator benzoyl peroxide while stirring, heating to boiling, adding a brominating agent N-bromosuccinimide in batches, and continuing stirring for reaction under boiling after the addition is finished. The invention takes C6-C8 straight-chain alkane as a reaction solvent to prepare 3-bromomethyl-7-chlorobenzo [ b ] thiophene through bromination reaction. Compared with carbon tetrachloride, the linear alkane of C6-C8 is less toxic and does not damage the ozone layer of the atmosphere. And the use of the catalyst is not limited, and the catalyst is more suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Preparation method of 2-chloro-4-nitrobenzene-alpha-L-fucoside
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 2-chloro-4-nitrobenzene-alpha-L-fucoside, belonging to the field of in vitro diagnosis. The method comprises the steps of taking L-fucose as an initial raw material, preparing 1,2,3, 4-tetraacetyl-alpha-L-fucose through acetylation, and then carrying out glycosylation reaction with 2-chloro-4-nitrophenol to prepare 2-chloro-4-nitrobenzene-2, 3, 4-triacetyl-alpha-L-fucoside, wherein the catalyst is selected from trimethylsilyl trifluoromethanesulfonate or boron trifluoride diethyl etherate; finally, performing deacetylation reaction to prepare the 2-chloro-4-nitrobenzene-alpha-L-fucoside. The method has a short reaction route, and a final product is prepared through three steps of reactions; the L-fucose is used as a raw material, the price of the initial raw material is relatively cheap, and the dosage of the 2-chloro-4-nitrophenol is obviously reduced; the post-treatment process is simple, the reaction reproducibility is good, and the industrial production can be realized.

title_en: Zanthoxylum bungeanum pain-relieving and inflammation-diminishing toothpaste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pricklyash peel and tsaoko amomum fruit pain-relieving and inflammation-diminishing toothpaste which comprises the following specific raw materials in parts by mass: 0.5-0.8% of pepper essential oil microcapsule, 0.2-0.5% of tsaoko essential oil microcapsule, 1-3% of adhesive, 22-65% of humectant, 1.5-1.8% of water-soluble additive, 20-50% of abrasive, 2-3% of foaming agent, 1-2% of essence, 1-1.5% of preservative and the balance of deionized water. The invention takes the pepper essential oil and the tsaoko essential oil as effective medicinal components, and other various auxiliary materials are added for mutual action to prepare the medicinal toothpaste with special effects of diminishing inflammation, resisting bacteria, preventing sensitivity, easing pain and the like; the effective essential oil components are prepared into microcapsules and then added into the toothpaste, so that the drug effect and the fragrance are kept without losing.

title_en: Process for preparing 3-methylenecyclobutyl derivatives
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a 3-methylene cyclobutyl derivative, which takes a propylene derivative and propadiene as initial raw materials, adopts a continuous flow chemical technology, ensures the conversion rate of products and solves the problem that the propylene derivative is polymerized to block a reaction channel by screening process conditions such as a polymerization inhibitor, a reaction solvent and the like, has safe and controllable reaction and low equipment cost, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Preparation and application of cyclized indigo receptor and polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclized indigo receptor and a preparation method and application of a polymer. The structure of the polymer is shown as a formula I, wherein R is C 1 ～C 40 Linear or branched alkyl. The invention also provides a preparation method of the polymer shown in the formula I. The raw materials of the invention are commercial products; the synthetic route is simple and efficient. The hole mobility of an organic field effect transistor prepared by taking the novel cyclized indigo polymer as an organic semiconductor layer is up to 1.22cm 2 V ‑   1 s ‑1 The electron mobility is 0.80cm at most 2 V ‑1 s ‑1 The preparation method has good application prospect in bipolar organic field effect transistor devices.

title_en: Mild non-irritating nursing handmade soap and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of daily cleaning, in particular to a mild non-irritating nursing handmade soap and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by weight: phase A: 20-90% of vegetable oil; phase B: 0.1-15% of neutralizer, 1-25% of natural surfactant and the balance of water; the sum of the weight percentages of the phase A and the phase B is 100 percent. The nursing handmade soap prepared by the invention has the following advantages: the handmade soap has strong cleaning capability and can quickly remove oil stains on the surface of skin; the handmade soap has the function of caring skin while cleaning, and after cleaning, the skin is moist and not tight, and has no dry, itching and irritating feeling, and the skin is smooth and compact; the handmade soap has strong stability, can keep a stable state under the change of high temperature and low temperature, is not easy to discolor, deform and smell, and can play a role for a long time; the handmade soap has the advantages of easily available raw materials, convenient process and strong practicability, and is suitable for being widely popularized in the field of daily washing products.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent material, electronic element and electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic electroluminescent material, an electronic element, and an electronic device. The structural formula of the organic electroluminescent material is shown as a chemical formula I, and the organic electroluminescent material is applied to an organic electroluminescent device and can obviously improve the performance of the device.

title_en: Organic compound and organic light-emitting device using same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an organic compound and an organic light emitting device using the same, and more particularly, to an organic compound having excellent light emitting efficiency and lifespan and an OLED device using the same. The structure of the organic compound provided by the invention is shown as formula 1: in the above structural formula, Ar 1 Selected from substituted or unsubstituted C6-C90 heteroaryl, heterocyclic or amine series containing more than two nitrogen atoms; r 1 And R 2 Each independently selected from substituted or unsubstituted C1-C20 alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted C6EC30 aryl, substituted or unsubstituted C10-C30 condensed ring group, substituted or unsubstituted C4-C30 heteroaryl, and substituted or unsubstituted C13-C30 amine series substances.

title_en: Methods for foam control and conditioning using in situ complexation of surfactants
abstract_en: A cleaning composition and method of using the same is disclosed, the cleaning composition comprising a first composition comprising an anionic surfactant and a second composition comprising a cationic surfactant, wherein the first composition and the second composition are held in separate containers and dispensed and combined to form a combined foam having a reduced volume for a desired time after combination.

title_en: Liquid crystal cream facial mask containing lees extract and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a liquid crystal cream facial mask containing a lees extract and a preparation method thereof. The formula of the mask comprises a wine lees extract, vitamin C, vitamin E, lecithin, cholesterol, jojoba oil, octadecanol, sodium alginate, carbomer 940, glycerol, propylene glycol, hyaluronic acid, tween-80, triethanolamine, ethyl p-hydroxybenzoate, essence, citric acid monohydrate and deionized water. The facial mask provided by the invention optimizes the extraction process of the cabernet sauvignon lees wine lees, improves the polyphenol content, and has a liquid crystal structure, so that the facial mask has good spreadability, is easy to apply, and is fresh and non-greasy. Thereby obtaining better effects of moisturizing, whitening and resisting oxidation of facial skin and improving the microenvironment of the skin.

title_en: Eutectic solvent, preparation method thereof and application of eutectic solvent in extraction of isofraxidin in acanthopanax senticosus
abstract_en: The invention provides a eutectic solvent, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in extracting isofraxidin from acanthopanax, belonging to the technical field of extraction of isofraxidin. The eutectic solvent is prepared from choline chloride, acid and water; the acid is citric acid or malic acid; the dosage ratio of the choline chloride, the acid and the water is (1-2) mol:2mol (200-400) mL. The eutectic solvent can effectively extract isofraxidin in acanthopanax senticosus and improve the yield of isofraxidin. The results of the examples show that the extraction of isofraxidin from acanthopanax senticosus by the eutectic solvent of the invention has higher yield compared with the extraction by ethanol.

title_en: Separation equipment for borneol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a separation device for borneol. Specifically, the invention provides separation equipment for borneol, which comprises a reaction kettle, a separation tower, a collecting tank and a liquid storage tank. The separation equipment for the borneol can be used for separating the borneol in the reaction liquid containing the borneol simply, rapidly and efficiently, and is beneficial to further purifying and obtaining the borneol with high purity and high yield.

title_en: Method and equipment for recovering and purifying MTBE waste solvent generated in synthesis of drug intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for recovering and purifying MTBE waste solvent generated by synthesizing a drug intermediate. The recovery and purification method provided by the invention separates the waste solvent of the synthetic drug intermediate through a series of low-energy-consumption processes of rectification and extraction, realizes the reutilization of the solvent with reuse value, reduces the pollution degree of the waste solvent in the pharmaceutical industry to the environment, and saves the production cost.

title_en: Continuous chlorination method and system for aniline intermediates
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous chlorination method and a continuous chlorination system of an aniline intermediate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Dissolving aniline intermediates in sulfuric acid phase to obtain a feed A; dissolving chlorine in an organic solvent phase to obtain a feed B; (2) Continuously feeding the feed A, B into a feed mixing unit respectively, exchanging heat of the feed A, B in the feed mixing unit to the reaction temperature by a heat exchanger, mixing in a micromixer, and starting chlorination reaction; (3) The material from the feed mixing unit continuously flows through the microreactor filled with the filler and then enters the circulating separation unit; (4) The organic phase and the acid phase are separated by a circulating separation unit, the separated organic phase is recycled for preparing the feed B in the step (1), the separated acid phase is decompressed to remove unreacted chlorine and hydrogen chloride gas generated in the reaction, the solid crude product of the aniline chloride is separated by cooling crystallization and is sent to subsequent refining, and the crystallization mother liquor is recycled for preparing the feed A in the step (1).

title_en: Method for extracting high-purity bamboo leaf flavone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting high-purity bamboo leaf flavone, which belongs to the field of bamboo leaf extracts and comprises the following steps: raw material treatment: cleaning, sterilizing and drying the collected bamboo leaves; preparing coarse powder; alcohol extraction; reducing pressure to recover alcohol; diluting with water and centrifuging; carrying out chromatography extraction; water-ethanol elution; alcohol is collected and concentrated; drying and detecting; the bamboo leaf flavone adsorption cylinder is added when the alcohol solution is recovered, so that the bamboo leaf flavone adsorption cylinder can adsorb the bamboo leaf flavone to the ethanol in the recovery process, the amount of the bamboo leaf flavone carried in the recovered ethanol is effectively reduced, the loss of the bamboo leaf flavone is reduced, the loss of the bamboo leaf flavone in the extraction process is reduced, the total extraction amount of the bamboo leaf flavone is effectively increased, the production cost of the bamboo leaf flavone is reduced, multiple independent cyclic adsorption separation is adopted, the loss of the bamboo leaf flavone is reduced, the extraction purity of the bamboo leaf flavone is effectively increased, and the quality of the bamboo leaf flavone is improved.

title_en: Recombinant protein and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant protein, which is prepared by connecting transdermal peptide with fibronectin through connecting peptide to form recombinant transdermal fibronectin, then carrying out N138Q, E174D, G230V and P292G site mutation construction on an amino acid sequence of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin to obtain a recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant, wherein the amino acid sequence of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the flexible tail end of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant is connected with elastase inhibitory peptide through connecting peptide. The recombinant protein provided by the invention has better stability, ensures the efficacy, is simple and convenient to prepare, has lower cost, and greatly expands the application of fibronectin and elastase inhibitory peptide in cosmetics.

title_en: Recombinant protein and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant protein, which is prepared by connecting transdermal peptide with fibronectin through connecting peptide to form recombinant transdermal fibronectin, then carrying out N138Q, E174D, G230V and P292G site mutation construction on an amino acid sequence of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin to obtain a recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant, wherein the amino acid sequence of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the flexible tail end of the recombinant transdermal fibronectin mutant is connected with elastase inhibitory peptide through connecting peptide. The recombinant protein provided by the invention has better stability, ensures the efficacy, is simple and convenient to prepare, has lower cost, and greatly expands the application of fibronectin and elastase inhibitory peptide in cosmetics.

title_en: Novel compound and organic light emitting device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel compound and an organic light emitting device including the same.

title_en: Preparation method of alpha-pyrrolidone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of alpha-pyrrolidone, which comprises the following steps of (1) respectively pumping gamma-butyrolactone and ammonia water into a pipeline from a material storage tank by a metering pump, and feeding the gamma-butyrolactone and the ammonia water into a mixer through the pipeline to be mixed to obtain a mixed material; (2) feeding the mixed material into a preheating device for preheating, then feeding the mixed material into a tubular fixed bed reactor for reaction, and simultaneously adding a catalyst into the reactor; (3) heating the tubular fixed bed reactor to fully react the mixed materials, and obtaining a reaction product after the reaction is finished; (4) and cooling the reaction product by a heat exchanger, then sending the reaction product into a constant pressure tank for depressurization treatment, releasing the pressure and then sending the reaction product into an intermediate storage tank to release the surplus ammonia, and returning the collected surplus ammonia to the reaction system again. The preparation method of the alpha-pyrrolidone with the structure has the advantages of small catalyst dosage, low price, reduced cost, high reaction speed, simple production process, mild reaction conditions and high safety.

title_en: Production process of 4-chloropyrrolo [2,3-d ] pyrimidine
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical intermediates, and particularly discloses 4-chloropyrrolo [2,3-d ]]The production process of the pyrimidine comprises the following steps: s1, adding the compound I and the compound II into the mixed solvent I, and carrying out temperature rise reaction under the catalysis of alkali I to obtain a compound III; s2, adding sodium alkoxide I into an alcohol solvent II, adding a compound IV and a compound III for heating reaction, adding an organic solvent III, an organic solvent IV and a compound V for heating reaction, and obtaining a crude product of 4-chloropyrrolo [2,3-d ] pyrimidine; wherein the compound I is (ii) a The compound II is (ii) a The compound III is (ii) a The compound IV is vinegar(ii) a formamidine acid; the compound V is POCl 3 . According to the method, bromoacetaldehyde dimethyl acetal and ethyl cyanoacetate are subjected to reflux reaction, and the prepared ethyl 2-cyano-4, 4-methoxybutyrate and formamidine acetate are subjected to one-pot chlorination reaction, so that the reaction period is greatly shortened.

title_en: Henbane hapten, artificial antigen, preparation methods of henbane hapten and artificial antigen, antibody and application of henbane hapten and artificial antigen
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of quality detection, and provides a hyoscyamine hapten, an artificial antigen, a preparation method, an antibody and application thereof; wherein, the structural formula of the hyoscyamine hapten is shown as follows: and n is any integer from 2 to 4. The invention directly introduces carboxyl group on hydroxyl group of the scopoletin, furthest retains the chemical structure and characteristics of the scopoletin, and can be directly coupled with carrier proteinThe method lays a foundation for the subsequent preparation of the antibody with strong specificity and high sensitivity; moreover, the antibody obtained from the hyoscyamine artificial antigen has higher titer, specificity and affinity, and can be applied to the rapid and specific detection of the hyoscyamine in agricultural products such as tobacco leaves and related foods.

title_en: Hair-care shampoo and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of shampoo preparation, in particular to a hair care shampoo and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hair care shampoo comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 parts of aloe, 10 parts of sodium dodecyl sulfate, 8 parts of propylene glycol, 1 part of glycerol, 0.5 part of coconut diethanolamide, 0.5 part of preservative and 30 parts of water; the preparation method of the hair care shampoo comprises the following steps: a. removing spines of folium Aloe by use of a spine removing device; b. crushing the spine-removed aloe into aloe pulp; c. mixing Aloe pulp with other materials, and making into hair caring shampoo; the deburring device comprises a support frame, a conveying mechanism, a blade and a blade frame, wherein the conveying mechanism is connected onto the support frame, the blade is fixed at the upper end of the blade frame, and the blade frame used for adjusting the distance between the blade and the conveying mechanism is connected onto the support frame.

title_en: Hair care shampoo and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of shampoo manufacture, in particular to a hair care shampoo and a hair care shampoo manufacture method, wherein the hair care shampoo comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 parts of aloe, 10 parts of sodium dodecyl sulfate, 8 parts of propylene glycol, 1 part of glycerol, 0.5 part of coconut diethanolamide, 0.5 part of preservative and 30 parts of water; the preparation method of the hair care shampoo comprises the following steps: a. taking aloe She Tong thorn removing device to remove thorns; b. crushing the thorn-removed aloe to prepare aloe pulp; c. mixing aloe pulp with other materials, and making into hair care shampoo; the deburring device comprises a supporting frame, a conveying mechanism, a blade and a knife rest, wherein the conveying mechanism is connected to the supporting frame, the blade is fixed to the upper end of the knife rest, and the knife rest used for adjusting the distance between the blade and the conveying mechanism is connected to the supporting frame.

title_en: Application of acylthiourea compound in preparation of anti-enterovirus drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of acyl thiourea compounds in preparation of an anti-enterovirus medicine, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The acyl thiourea compound has the structure shown in general formulas (I), (II) and (III), and is prepared by reacting substituted acyl chloride compound, ammonium thiocyanate and amine compound as raw materials to obtain acyl thiourea shown in general formula (I)A compound of the class; reacting acyl thiourea compound shown in general formula (I) and chloracetyl chloride in solvent to obtain acyl thiourea compound shown in general formula (II); acyl thiourea compounds shown in general formula (I) are used as raw materials to react with halogenated substrates in a solvent to obtain acyl thiourea compounds shown in general formula (III). The acyl thiourea compound has the activity of resisting the enterovirus and can be used for preparing medicines for resisting the enterovirus.

title_en: Compound, organic semiconductor layer containing the compound, organic electronic device, and display or lighting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound of formula (I), an organic semiconductor layer comprising the compound, an organic electronic device comprising the organic semiconductor layer, and a display device and a lighting device comprising the organic electronic device.

title_en: Solid forms comprising (S) -4- (4- (4- (((2- (2, 6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl) -1-oxoisoindolin-4-yl) oxy) methyl) benzyl) piperazin-1-yl) -3-fluorobenzonitrile and salts thereof, as well as compositions comprising and methods of using the same
abstract_en: Provided herein are formulations, processes, solid forms and methods of use that relate to salts of (S) -4- (4- (4- (((2- (2, 6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl) -1-oxoisoindolin-4-yl) oxy) methyl) benzyl) piperazin-1-yl) -3-fluorobenzonitrile and solid forms comprising a free base or salt of (S) -4- (4- (4- (((2- (2, 6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl) -1-oxoisoindolin-4-yl) oxy) methyl) benzyl) piperazin-1-yl) -3-fluorobenzonitrile.

title_en: Rheological additive based on hydroxylated diamides or triamides and mixtures thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fatty amides useful as organogelling agents and in particular as rheological additives, which are diamides or triamides based on polyether diamines or triamines, said amides comprising a specific mixture of hydroxylated fatty acids and hydroxylated short-chain acids. The invention also relates to a formulation composition using said fatty amide as a rheological additive and to the use thereof for this purpose in coating compositions, adhesive compositions or PVC plastisol compositions and in particular transparent or non-transparent cement compositions. Unlike other known fatty amide additives based on hydrogenated castor oil derivatives, the rheological additive has the advantage that no specific activation process is required before use.

title_en: Expanded polyacrylic acid composition
abstract_en: An intumescent composition based on modification of polyacrylic acid (PAA) and comprising certain additives is envisaged. Such compositions can be incorporated into epoxy resins and other resin-based coatings. The PAA may be modified by the use of one or more mineralisation additives to promote coke formation.

title_en: Preparation method of wrapped retinol essence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a wrapped retinol essence, wherein the wrapped retinol essence is prepared by mixing a component A and a component B, the component A is a cosmetic matrix of the wrapped retinol essence, the component A comprises water, glycerol, alkanol acrylate cross-linked polymer, hexanediol, pentanediol, isopentyl glycol, xanthan gum and dipotassium glycyrrhizinate, the component B is an active ingredient of the wrapped retinol essence, the component B comprises lecithin, triglyceride, retinol palmitate, retinol and tocopherol, and the weight ratio is as follows: 3-8% of glycerin and 0.1-1% of alkanol acrylate cross-linked polymer. The preparation method of the wrapped retinol essence provided by the invention mainly has the advantages that the preparation process is simple, the irritation is low, the activity ratio and the transdermal rate are high, the wrapped retinol can resist oxidation and high temperature, the stability of the formula is greatly improved, and the compatibility is good.

title_en: Method for preparing 9-acridine formic acid by one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing 9-acridine formic acid by a one-pot method, which comprises the following steps: 1) adding oxalyl chloride and a reaction solvent into a reaction kettle, dropwise adding a diphenylamine solution under the protection of nitrogen at 5-10 ℃, after adding, heating to 55-60 ℃ for reaction until the reaction is complete, absorbing gas generated by the reaction by alkali liquor, after the reaction is complete, evaporating under reduced pressure to remove unreacted oxalyl chloride and the reaction solvent, cooling to room temperature after evaporation, adding the reaction solvent, continuing to distill under reduced pressure until the reaction is complete, heating the residue to 120-130 ℃ under the protection of nitrogen after evaporation, continuing to preserve heat for 5-6 hours until the reaction is complete, 2) adding alkali and water into the reactant in the step 1) to form yellow suspension, heating for reflux reaction until the reaction is complete, then cooling to room temperature, adjusting the pH to 2-3 by hydrochloric acid, separating out a large amount of yellow solid, and filtering, washing and drying to obtain the product. The total yield is more than 90%, and the product purity is more than 99%. The whole synthesis process is simple to operate, environment-friendly, capable of saving the investment of a large amount of raw materials and suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Novel compound and organic light emitting device using the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel compound and an organic light emitting device using the same.

title_en: SIREMADLIN succinic acid ester
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of a pharmaceutical product comprising filling a powder of an active pharmaceutical ingredient into a pharmaceutical carrier with a vacuum assisted dosing and filling device. The methods disclosed herein can be used in a continuous process, such as in a high-throughput process for producing a pharmaceutical product. The invention further relates to a specific quality of the neat Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) HDM201 in the form of succinic acid co-crystals, i.e. siremadlin, that can be used in the preparation process of the invention.

title_en: Anti-wrinkle firming composition and cosmetic
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-wrinkle firming composition and cosmetics, and relates to the technical field of cosmetics, wherein the anti-wrinkle firming composition comprises the following components in percentage by weight: glycerol glucoside: 0.5-2 parts; hexapeptide-9: 1-5 parts; acetyl tetrapeptide-2: 0.5-2 parts; hydrolyzing collagen: 0.5-2 parts; the hydrolyzed collagen has a molecular weight of less than 3000 Da. The invention starts from the mechanism of wrinkle generation, specifically selects and compares various anti-wrinkle active substances from a plurality of layers such as an epidermal layer, a real epidermal connecting layer, a dermal layer and the like, further screens out a comprehensive anti-wrinkle compact composition with more comprehensive overall mechanism and more obvious effect through the optimization of components, and can achieve the effects of more quickly, continuously and effectively improving wrinkles and skin elasticity.

title_en: Supported cobalt monoatomic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a supported cobalt monoatomic catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out thermal polymerization reaction on urea to obtain graphitized carbon nitride; (2) reacting the graphitized carbon nitride obtained in the step (1) with cobalt salt to obtain a compound of cobalt and graphitized carbon nitride; (3) and (3) carrying out heat treatment on the compound obtained in the step (2) and hypophosphite to obtain the supported cobalt single-atom catalyst. The preparation method is simple, wide in raw material source and high in yield, and has a large-scale application prospect. The supported cobalt monoatomic catalyst is a phosphorus-doped graphitized carbon nitride-supported cobalt monoatomic catalyst, has the characteristics of adjustable band gap, good catalytic activity and high selectivity, can realize selective oxidation under photocatalysis with high conversion rate, and is particularly suitable for converting alcohol compounds into aldehyde compounds or ketone compounds through a photo-oxidation catalytic reaction.

title_en: Advanced method and system for automatic high performance identification of carbohydrate and carbohydrate mixture composition patterns based on novel fluorescent dyes and method for calibrating multi-wavelength fluorescence detection system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to improved (simplified/easier, more stable and more reproducible) methods for identifying carbohydrate composition (e.g. from complex carbohydrate mixtures) and determining carbohydrate mixture composition patterns (e.g. glycosylation patterns) and based on advanced internal standards to use novel fluorescent dye junctionsThe present invention relates to methods for automated determination and/or identification of carbohydrate and/or carbohydrate mixture composition pattern analysis, and methods for automated carbohydrate mixture composition pattern analysis, based on the use of at least a first and a second fluorescent marker for labeling migration/retention time alignment standards and samples or different samples, respectively, wherein at least one fluorescent dye is a compound as defined herein, furthermore, the present invention relates to methods for calibrating multi-wavelength fluorescence detection systems, as well as calibration systems or calibration standards, and novel compounds described as being suitable for use in calibration. The invention further relates to a kit or system for determining or identifying a pattern of composition of a carbohydrate mixture and a kit or system for determining and/or identifying a pattern of composition of a carbohydrate mixture. Further, there is provided a carbohydrate dye conjugate comprising a dye as defined herein for use in a method according to the invention. The dye used to form the carbohydrate dye conjugate has the following formula a or B:

title_en: Maleic anhydride selective hydrogenation catalyst, and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maleic anhydride selective hydrogenation catalyst, a preparation method and an application method thereof. The catalyst is a Pd-M/NHPC catalyst prepared by taking nitrogen-doped mesoporous carbon material NHPC as a carrier and loading Pd-M bimetal by adopting an impregnation method; the catalyst contains active component Pd 0.1-5 wt%, metal M0.5-10.0 wt% and specific surface area 80-1000M 2 (ii)/g; the metal M is one or more of iron, cobalt, zinc and copper. The catalyst has the advantages of low cost, large specific surface area, good catalytic stability and high activity and selectivity in the reaction of preparing succinic anhydride by catalyzing maleic anhydride hydrogenation.

title_en: Synthetic method, intermediate and application of 3- (3-hydroxyphenyl) -1, 1-dimethylurea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method, an intermediate and application of 3- (3-hydroxyphenyl) -1, 1-dimethylurea, which takes m-aminophenol as a raw material, generates 3-trimethylsiloxy phenylamino under the catalysis of HDMS and phosphotungstic acid, then reacts with dimethylcarbamoyl chloride to obtain 1, 1-dimethyl-3- (3-trimethylsiloxyphenyl) urea, and then removes TMS to obtain 3- (3-hydroxyphenyl) -1, 1-dimethylurea. The method has the advantages of simple synthetic route, simple operation, high yield and no pollution.

title_en: Non-supported mesoporous hydrodeoxygenation catalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: A non-supported mesoporous hydrodeoxygenation catalyst comprises elementary nickel and niobium pentoxide, wherein the molar ratio of the elementary nickel to the niobium pentoxide is 7:2-18: 1; the preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving nickel salt and citric acid in ethanol solution, dissolving niobium salt in water, mixing, adjusting the pH value to 1-4 by using nitric acid, placing in an oil bath at 80-100 ℃, heating and stirring until the niobium salt is viscous, carrying out ultrasonic oscillation for 15-30min, drying at 80-120 ℃ for 4-10H, roasting at 400-600 ℃ for 3-6H, and reducing at 300-500 ℃ for 3-5H under the atmosphere of 10 vol% H2/Ar, wherein the catalyst is in a mesoporous structure through BET (BET) determination. Then the catalyst and the bio-oil are put into an intermittent reactor to carry out hydrodeoxygenation reaction for 1-8h under the hydrogen pressure of 1-4MPa and the temperature of 180-250 ℃ to obtain a bio-oil hydrodeoxygenation product. The method has the advantages of simple and efficient synthesis and mild reaction conditions.

title_en: Amphiphilic compatilizer, preparation method thereof and polycarbonate-polypropylene alloy material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphiphilic compatilizer, a preparation method thereof and a polycarbonate-polypropylene alloy material. The structural formula of the compatilizer is as follows: the polycarbonate-polypropylene alloy material comprises the following components: polycarbonate, polypropylene, an amphiphilic compatilizer, an antioxidant, a lubricant and a hydrolysis resistance agent. The amphiphilic compatilizer can improve the interface binding force and the two-phase compatibility between the polycarbonate resin and the polypropylene resin, and meanwhile, the obtained alloy material has the advantages of excellent flame retardant property, hydrolysis resistance, low water discharge rate, good processability and low cost, and can be applied to the fields of catering industry, automobile industry and the like.

title_en: Tinidazole process impurity and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, and particularly discloses a tinidazole process impurity and a synthesis method thereof. The structure of the tinidazole process impurity is shown as a formula (I), and the synthesis method comprises the following steps: taking 4-nitroimidazole and hydroxyethyl sulfide as raw materials, taking benzene compounds as a solvent, and carrying out condensation reaction under the action of concentrated sulfuric acid to obtain a compound shown in a formula (II); oxidizing the compound shown in the formula (II) by hydrogen peroxide under the catalytic action of soluble molybdate to obtain tinidazole process impurities shown in the formula (I). The tinidazole technical impurity with the purity of more than 99.7 percent is prepared by a specific synthesis process, the problem of the source of the tinidazole technical impurity reference substance is solved, and the method is favorable for further synthesisAnd the quality standard of the tinidazole bulk drug or the preparation thereof is improved.

title_en: Control method and system for carbon three-liquid-phase hydrogenation reactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system for a carbon three-liquid-phase hydrogenation reactor. The control method of the carbon three-liquid phase hydrogenation reactor comprises the following steps: classifying and counting the operation data of the hydrogenation reactor to obtain classified and counted data; performing analysis fitting on the classified statistical data to obtain analysis fitting data, wherein the analysis fitting is based on an optimization mode and an operation rule set of the carbon three liquid phase hydrogenation catalyst and the acquired real-time operation data; establishing a state space model based on the characteristics of the carbon three-liquid phase hydrogenation catalyst; obtaining control parameters based on the state space model and the analysis fitting data; acquiring gain scheduling data based on the analysis fitting data; and generating control instructions based on the control parameters and the gain scheduling data. The method and the system can achieve the aim of obtaining the optimal propylene yield.

title_en: High-stability extraction equipment and process for extracting leucine from feathers
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-stability extraction equipment and a process for extracting leucine from feathers, and particularly relates to the technical field of leucine extraction, the extraction equipment and the process can achieve the purpose of discontinuously performing immersion treatment on the feathers through the long-distance transmission action of a chain, ensure the continuous treatment work of the feathers, perform high-pressure washing on the feathers through the action of a high-pressure spray head, keep the cleanliness of the feathers, achieve self-feeding operation through a control mechanism after drying treatment, and perform secondary liquid adding operation under the transmission action of a conveying mechanism, so that the device can achieve the pretreatment effect on the feathers through the operations of immersion, high-pressure washing, drying and secondary liquid injection, realize the operation of automatic treatment, simultaneously achieve the integrated continuous treatment operation on the feathers, ensure the centralization of the treatment, and simultaneously reduce the investment and the occupied area of the equipment, and the operation and maintenance both achieve the purpose of convenient treatment, and simultaneously reduce the expenditure of manpower and financial resources.

title_en: Preparation method of 5-fluoroalkyl substituted oxazole compound
abstract_en: A preparation method of a 5-fluoroalkyl substituted oxazole compound. The invention discloses a preparation method of a 5-fluoroalkyl substituted oxazole compound, which comprises the step of carrying out catalytic cyclization on fluoroalkyl substituted diazoketone and primary amide under the condition of copper tetraethyl hexafluorophosphate to obtain the corresponding 5-fluoroalkyl substituted oxazole compound. The method has the beneficial effects that: the preparation method has the advantages of simple process, mild reaction temperature, high yield, and cheap and easily-obtained raw materials and catalysts.

title_en: Method for synthesizing adipic acid by one-step direct oxidation of cyclohexane
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for synthesizing adipic acid by directly oxidizing cyclohexane in one step, which mainly solves the problems that in the prior art, organic solvents such as acetic acid and the like are needed in the homogeneous phase reaction process of preparing adipic acid by directly oxidizing cyclohexane, so that subsequent products are difficult to separate, equipment is severely corroded, a soluble metal catalyst is difficult to recycle, heavy metal pollution is caused, and industrial continuous production of adipic acid is difficult to realize. A process for synthesizing adipic acid by one-step direct oxidation using cyclohexane, comprising reacting cyclohexane with an oxygen-containing gas in the presence of a catalyst having a structure as shown below; wherein R is  1  、R  2  、R  3  、R  4  And R is  5  At least one of which is a fatty chain having an acidic group attached thereto, said fatty chain having a carbon number of at least 9. 。

title_en: Substituted pyrimidinediones and their use
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and relates to substituted pyrimidinedione compounds, application thereof and a pharmaceutical composition containing the compounds, wherein the substituted pyrimidinedione compounds can be used as gonadotropin-releasing hormone receptor antagonists. The invention also relates to methods for preparing such compounds and pharmaceutical compositions, and their use in the prevention or treatment of sex hormone dependent diseases, including but not limited to prostate cancer, endometriosis, uterine fibroids, precocious puberty, and the like.

title_en: Whitening and anti-aging composition, cosmetic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whitening anti-aging composition, a cosmetic and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of cosmetics, wherein the whitening anti-aging composition comprises the following components: arbutin: 0.05-3 parts; ascorbyl glucoside: 0.05-3 parts; glutathione: 0.001-0.1 part; nicotinamide: 0.5-5 parts; tranexamic acid: 0.1-2 parts; dipeptide diaminobutyrylbenzylamide diacetate: 0.0005-0.05 part; acetyl tetrapeptide-2: 0.00005-0.005 part; oligopeptide-4: 0.0001 to 0.005 portion. The whitening cream adopts arbutin, ascorbyl glucoside, glutathione, nicotinamide and tranexamic acid as whitening components; dipeptide diaminobutyrylbenzylamide diacetate, acetyl tetrapeptide-2 and oligopeptide-4 are selected as anti-aging components; the whitening component covers the whole melanin generation path, so that the full-path whitening is realized; the anti-aging component realizes multi-aspect anti-aging aiming at each aging performance, and the whitening component and the anti-aging component have synergistic interaction, so that the whitening and anti-aging effects of the composition can be remarkably improved under the combined action.

title_en: Fixed bed reaction device, synthesis system and synthesis method for methylamine synthesis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed bed reaction device, a synthesis system and a synthesis method for synthesizing methylamine, wherein the fixed bed reaction device comprises a tower body, a plurality of catalyst layers and a plurality of feeding pipes, wherein the catalyst layers are respectively arranged on cross sections of the tower body at different heights; the plurality of feeding pipes are arranged in parallel along the axial direction of the tower body and are uniformly distributed along the cross section of the tower body; the feeding end of the feeding pipe is arranged close to the bottom of the tower body, and the discharging end of the feeding pipe is arranged close to the top of the tower body; the synthesis gas outlet of the tower body is positioned at the lower end of the tower body. The inlet pipe can utilize reaction heat to heat the feed gas more fully, through the heat transfer, has improved the temperature of feed gas, because the synthetic reaction of methylamine needs to go on under certain temperature and pressure, consequently after improving the feed gas temperature, can make the reaction just can abundant catalytic reaction in one section packing of the top, can improve the utilization ratio of catalyst in the synthetic fixed bed reaction unit.

title_en: Synthetic method of 2,4, 6-tribromophenol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing 2,4, 6-tribromophenol, which comprises the following steps: dissolving phenol and metal bromide in water to obtain a mixed solution of the phenol and the metal bromide, and recording the mixed solution as a first mixed solution; dropwise adding bromate solution and hydrochloric acid into the first mixed solution for reaction; after the reaction is finished, adding sodium sulfite into the reaction liquid until the light brown color in the reaction liquid completely disappears, filtering, washing and drying to obtain the 2,4, 6-tribromophenol; the synthesis method of the invention takes bromide salt as bromine source to improve the full utilization of available resources and avoid the use of organic solvent; after the reaction is finished, the crude product is separated out in a water phase, and a product with enough purity is obtained after simple filtration treatment; the process method greatly reduces the production cost, simultaneously reduces the potential safety hazard in transportation and production and improves the working environment.

title_en: Succinic acid hydrogenation multi-step crystallization production process for degradable plastics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-step crystallization production process for hydrogenation of succinic acid for degradable plastics, which comprises the following steps of (1) adding maleic anhydride and water into a stirring maleic anhydride hydrolysis tank, uniformly mixing, and completing hydrolysis reaction to obtain maleic acid aqueous solution; (2) preheating a maleic acid aqueous solution by a preheater, adding the maleic acid aqueous solution into a maleic acid hydrogenation reactor, and introducing high-pressure hydrogen for reaction to obtain a succinic acid solution; (3) sequentially introducing the succinic acid solution into a plurality of crystallizers for gradually cooling and crystallizing; (4) and (3) performing solid-liquid separation on the crystallized material, recycling the separated liquid into a mother liquor tank for recycling, drying the separated solid, and storing the dried solid in a finished product bin for packaging. According to the invention, an independent gas-liquid separation device is not required, substances and a cold source in the mother liquor are recycled, and the redundant hydrogen is directly recycled from the flash evaporation heat of the crystallizer and then recycled and is introduced into the maleic acid hydrogenation reactor for recycling. Wherein, hydrogen, waste heat and mother liquor can be recycled, and zero emission is integrally realized.

title_en: Lutein water-soluble derivative and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lutein water-soluble derivative and a preparation process thereof. The lutein water-soluble derivative is prepared mainly through esterification reaction of lutein and stachyose. Compared with the lutein raw material, the lutein water-soluble derivative prepared by the invention has better hydrophilic property and bioavailability, maintains the original bioactivity of lutein, and can be added into various dosage forms or multifunctional foods. In addition, the preparation process has the advantages of simple flow, short period, low cost, easy expansion and easy industrialization.

title_en: Processing method and application for improving maltopentaose and maltohexaose in dendrobium officinale
abstract_en: The invention provides a special processing method and application for simultaneously improving maltopentaose and maltohexaose in dendrobium officinale. The method disclosed by the invention is used for processing the dendrobium officinale by using a special method, and in the processing process, after the fresh picked dendrobium officinale fresh strips are subjected to special treatment under the low temperature condition of-20 ℃, the dendrobium officinale fresh strips are baked for 12-36 hours under the temperature condition of 50-80 ℃, and then the dendrobium officinale processed products are obtained after cooling. The processed dendrobium officinale product is beneficial to the enrichment of maltopentaose and maltohexaose, has the content obviously higher than that of fresh strips, and can be directly eaten as functional food or used as a main raw material or an auxiliary material of functional cosmetics such as anti-aging and whitening cosmetics in the fields of cosmetics and medicine application.

title_en: Catalyst for synthesizing ethylene carbonate, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of ethylene carbonate, and provides a catalyst for synthesizing ethylene carbonate, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst is a composite oxide catalyst which consists of one or two of Zn, La and Co and is used for the reaction of synthesizing ethylene carbonate from urea and ethylene glycol. The catalyst is prepared by mixing an aqueous solution of zinc nitrate, an aqueous solution of lanthanum nitrate and an aqueous solution of cobalt nitrate in proportion, adding the mixture into an aqueous solution of a precipitator urea, controlling the pH of the solution, and carrying out coprecipitation reaction. The preparation process of the catalyst is simple and easy to implement, and the cost is low; the catalyst has high activity, high ethylene carbonate yield, mild reaction conditions, good stability and easy separation and regeneration.

title_en: Method and device for removing carbon deposition in quencher of hexafluoropropylene reaction equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for removing carbon deposition in a quencher of hexafluoropropylene reaction equipment, wherein upper control ends (1) of a plurality of upper ultrasonic vibration devices (14) are connected with an upper controller (2), a plurality of upper ultrasonic vibration devices (14) are uniformly arranged on the outer surface of a top cover (4) of the quencher (3), lower control ends (5) of a plurality of lower ultrasonic vibration devices (15) are connected with a lower controller (6), and a plurality of lower ultrasonic vibration devices (15) are uniformly arranged on the outer surface of a bottom cover (7) of the quencher (3). The invention provides a method for removing carbon deposition in a quencher, which can prevent carbon powder on the pipe wall of a vertical pipe (8) of the quencher (3) from being adsorbed by the carbon powder emitted by an upper ultrasonic probe (10) and a lower ultrasonic probe (12) so as to uniformly collect the fallen self-polymerized carbon powder into a dust collector (9) and realize the continuous operation of the system flow of hexafluoropropylene reaction equipment.

title_en: Synthesis process of film forming auxiliary agent for water-based paint
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis process of a film forming auxiliary agent for water-based paint, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing 2, 4-trimethyl-1, 3 pentanediol and propionic acid according to the mass ratio of 1:1-1:3, adding the mixture into a three-neck flask, adding 0.3 to 1 percent of catalyst at the same time, introducing nitrogen, reacting for 4 to 8 hours at 160 to 180 ℃, and carrying out suction filtration; s2, extracting the filtrate obtained in the step S1 through a separating funnel, washing, and removing impurities through rotary evaporation to finally obtain the film forming auxiliary agent. According to the synthesis process of the film forming auxiliary agent for the water-based paint, SO  4   2‑ /ZrO 2 -Nd 2 O 3  is used as a synthesis catalyst, nd  2 O 3  improves the surface property of ZrO  2 , the pore volume is increased, the reaction activity is improved, sc  2 O 3  can change the chemical state of the catalyst surface to improve the positive polarization degree of elements on the catalyst surface, SO that the activity and the service life of the catalyst are improved, and the yield of the film forming auxiliary agent is finally improved.

title_en: Methylene methanedisulfonate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses methylene methanedisulfonate and a preparation method thereof. By using the sulfur trioxide liquid as the liquid sulfonating agent and the liquid dehydrating agent, the use of the solid sulfonating agent and the dehydrating agent is avoided, the liquid phase reaction is carried out, the solid phase reaction or the solid-liquid reaction is avoided, the reaction efficiency is improved, the use of the organic solvent is avoided, the introduction of impurities such as diethyl methanedisulfonate, dichloromethane and the like due to the side reaction caused by the use of the organic solvent is avoided, the content of free acid such as sulfuric acid impurities is reduced, the purity of the product is improved, and in addition, the generation amount of three wastes is reduced by not using the organic solvent.

title_en: Lignans compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lignan compound and a preparation method and application thereof, relates to the field of natural medicines, and is named as (8- (2, 3-dihydroxy-4-methoxybenzyl) -8' - (4' -hydroxy-3 ' -methoxybenzyl) butyrolactone). the preparation method is obtained by separating and extracting lilac medicinal material, and also discloses application of the lignan compound in preparing medicines for treating acute liver injury, which can obviously reduce CCl 4 The transaminase of a rat with a chemical liver injury model induced by olive oil increases the contents of superoxide dismutase and glutathione in the serum of the rat, and has obvious effect of preventing and treating chemical liver injury.

title_en: 1,2, 4-triazole [3,4-b ] -1,3, 4-thiadiazine derivatives, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a triazolothiadiazine derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, in particular to a 1,2, 4-triazole [3,4-b ]]-1,3, 4-thiadiazine derivatives of the general formula VI: VI: the invention discloses a structural general formula of the compound, a synthesis method, application of the compound serving as an insecticide, a bactericide and a plant virus resisting agent, application of the compound in preventing and controlling plant insect pests, diseases and virus diseases of agriculture, forestry and gardening by combining the compound with an agriculturally acceptable auxiliary agent or synergist and a commercial insecticide, bactericide, plant virus resisting agent and acaricide, and a preparation method of the compound.

title_en: Isoquinoline ketone derivative as ROCK protein kinase inhibitor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a series of isoquinolinone derivatives serving as ROCK protein kinase inhibitors and application thereof in preparing medicaments for treating ROCK protein kinase inhibitor-related glaucoma or ocular hypertension diseases. Specifically disclosed is a compound represented by formula (I), an isomer thereof or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

title_en: Preparation method of soybean oil microemulsion capable of being infinitely diluted
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of soybean oil microemulsion capable of infinitely diluting. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, fully mixing soybean oil and a solubilizer, and then putting the mixture on a constant-temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed oil phase A; then, fully mixing the surfactant with the mixed oil phase A, and then putting the mixture on a constant temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed oil phase B; finally, mixing the mixed oil phase B with a cosurfactant, and placing the mixture on a constant-temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed phase C; and adding distilled water into the phase C until the system is clear and transparent, thus obtaining the soybean oil microemulsion which can be infinitely diluted. The soybean oil microemulsion which can be infinitely diluted and is prepared by the invention not only can still keep a clear and transparent state under the extreme conditions of centrifugation and high salinity, but also has the characteristics of infinite dilution by water and no demulsification, and the particle size test shows that the particle size is less than 30nm and the particle size distribution is more uniform; therefore, the utility model has higher practical value.

title_en: Niobium-loaded carbon nano tube solid acid catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a niobium-loaded carbon nano tube solid acid catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of furfural production. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving a niobium precursor in water; (2) Adding the carbon nano tube into the niobium precursor aqueous solution, and fully stirring; (3) Pouring the solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle, covering a kettle cover tightly, and raising the temperature of the reaction kettle to perform reaction; (4) Cooling and opening the reaction kettle after the reaction is finished, filtering and drying; (5) And (3) placing the obtained solid in a tubular reactor for calcination, and cooling to obtain the niobium-loaded carbon nano tube solid acid catalyst. The preparation method prepares the novel niobium-loaded carbon nano tube solid acid catalyst by hydrothermal and calcining loading of the niobium precursor and the carbon nano tube in a reaction kettle. Meanwhile, the niobium-loaded carbon nanotube solid acid has the advantages of good thermal stability, high catalytic reaction efficiency, high reuse efficiency, simple process and easy realization of industrialized popularization.

title_en: Methods and compositions for targeting protein degradation
abstract_en: Compounds of formula I are provided:  And pharmaceutically acceptable salts and compositions thereof, which are useful for treating cancer and related conditions.

title_en: Recovery method of dimeric ketone in cyclohexane oxidation byproduct X oil
abstract_en: The application provides a recovery method of dimeric ketone in cyclohexane oxidation byproduct X oil, which comprises the following steps: the cyclohexane oxidation byproduct X oil is subjected to normal pressure distillation, first reduced pressure rectification and second reduced pressure rectification in sequence to obtain concentrated dimeric ketone; wherein, distillate in the temperature section A-B is collected in atmospheric distillation; controlling reflux ratio in the first vacuum rectification to be 3-4:1, controlling pressure to be 2-3 kPa, and collecting fractions of C-D temperature sections at the top of the tower; controlling reflux ratio in the second vacuum rectification to 8-10:1, controlling pressure to 1-2 kPa, and collecting fractions in the temperature sections of the tower tops E-F. The application relieves the problem that the prior art can not recover the high-content dimer from the X oil with low dimer content, enriches the dimer in three steps, ensures the integrity of the dimer components, has no chemical decomposition, and improves the content of the dimer to more than 70 percent and the recovery rate to more than 20 percent.

title_en: Indolospiro [ benzofuran-2, 2' -pyrrolidine ] compound, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preventing and treating plant viruses
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and relates to an indole spiro [ benzofuran-2, 2' -pyrrolidine ] compound and a preparation method thereof, wherein an isatin derivative (A), an orange ketone derivative (B) and benzylamine are dissolved in a solvent according to a proportion, and the mixture is stirred, heated and refluxed, after 2-48 and h are reacted, the solvent is removed, and white, pink or pale yellow solid is obtained through recrystallization, wherein the ratio of the amount of the isatin derivative (A), the amount of the orange ketone derivative (B) and the amount of the benzylamine substance is 1-2:1:1-2. The invention also discloses application of the compound to control plant viruses, and the indole spiro [ benzofuran-2, 2' -pyrrolidine ] compound shows good inhibition activity on Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV) at the application rate of 500 mug/mL. The invention is simple and efficient to prepare the indole spiro [ benzofuran-2, 2' -pyrrolidine ] compound, has short reaction time, convenient post-treatment and good universality, is suitable for synthesizing a plurality of compounds, and provides a basis for the application of indole spiro pyrrolidines.

title_en: Lignan compound in lilac and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly discloses a lignan compound in lilac, and a preparation method and application thereof. The name of the compound is 2- (benzo [ D ] [1,3] dioxolane-5-methylidene) -3- (4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl) butane-1, 4-diol. The preparation method of the lignan compound is simple to operate, and the pure compound can be obtained by separation. Experiments show that the lignan compound obtained by the invention can obviously reduce the NO release amount of BV-2 cells induced by LPS, has the effect of relieving inflammation induced by inflammatory factor LPS, can prolong the sleeping time of mice and obviously reduce the autonomous activity times of the mice, has good sedative and tranquillizing effects, and can be used as a potential anti-inflammatory and sedative and tranquillizing medicament.

title_en: Electrolyte additive, electrolyte and lithium secondary battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium secondary batteries, and particularly relates to an electrolyte additive which is a compound with a structure shown as a structural formula I: wherein R1, R2 and R3 are respectively independent H or contain C 1 ‑C 3 Or 1-fluorodimethylsilyl group. The additive has good cycle performance and high-temperature storage and low-temperature performance under high voltage after being applied to lithium ion battery electrolyte. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses an electrolyte and a lithium ion battery.

title_en: Multi-kettle serial continuous hydrogenation method and device for sugar alcohol production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-kettle serial continuous hydrogenation method for sugar alcohol production, which comprises the following steps: the pH value of the raw material sugar solution is regulated to 6-7 by a mixer, and then the raw material sugar solution enters a first-stage reaction kettle, and a catalyst enters the first-stage reaction kettle by the mixer; hydrogen enters a gas feeding distributor from the bottom of the kettle and fully contacts with the raw material sugar liquid and the catalyst; heating and stirring respectively by using a heating coil and a stirrer to obtain a reaction liquid after the first hydrogenation reaction; repeating the steps in the reaction liquid after the first hydrogenation reaction, and continuously carrying out hydrogenation reaction in a next-stage reaction kettle connected in series to obtain a reaction liquid after the final hydrogenation reaction; cooling, filtering, decolorizing, ion exchanging, evaporating and crystallizing to obtain sugar alcohol product; wherein, the next-stage reaction kettle at least comprises a first-stage reaction kettle. The invention also discloses a multi-kettle serial continuous hydrogenation device for sugar alcohol production. The method and the device have high catalytic efficiency, the hydrogenation reaction is safer, continuous hydrogenation can be realized, and the reaction efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method of low-caramelization alkyl glycoside
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-caramelization alkyl glycoside, which comprises the following steps: step S1: acetalation reaction, namely placing glucose, fatty alcohol and a catalyst into a reaction kettle, mixing and stirring at the temperature of 80-90 ℃ and the pressure of 3-10kPa, filtering and separating the catalyst after the reaction is finished, and recycling the catalyst, wherein the catalyst is an ionic liquid; step S2: dealcoholizing, namely dealcoholizing the mixed solution obtained after the acetalation reaction under negative pressure to obtain a crude product; step S3: and (3) decoloring, namely adding a decoloring agent into the crude product obtained in the step (S2), and adding water to compound after decoloring to obtain a product. The preparation method of the low-caramelization alkyl glycoside can reduce the temperature condition required by acetalation reaction and reduce the caramelization of glucose, thereby improving the yield and purity of the alkyl glycoside; the catalyst consumption can be reduced, and the production efficiency of the alkyl glycoside is better, so that the production cost of the alkyl glycoside is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of 2-aminobenzaldehyde
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 2-aminobenzaldehyde, which comprises the following steps: taking o-nitrotoluene as an initial raw material, taking alcohol as a solvent, adding sodium polysulfide, stirring and reacting at 65-85 ℃ for 1-5h, and after the reaction is finished, carrying out post-treatment on reaction liquid to obtain 2-aminobenzaldehyde; the method takes the o-nitrotoluene as the starting material, realizes the one-step synthesis of the 2-aminobenzaldehyde under the condition of not using a catalyst, and has the yield up to 96.86 percent. The method realizes one-step synthesis of the 2-aminobenzaldehyde, effectively reduces the synthesis steps, reduces the dosage of reagents in the reaction, and is more efficient, environment-friendly and green. The post-treatment method adopted by the invention is steam distillation, so that the use of organic solvents is reduced, and the post-treatment method is simplified.

title_en: Catalyst for catalyzing dehydrogenation reaction of 1, 4-butanediol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a catalyst for catalyzing dehydrogenation reaction of 1, 4-butanediol, which comprises the following steps: dissolving metal salts of copper, zinc, nickel, aluminum and cerium in water to obtain a metal salt solution; then slowly adding an anhydrous sodium carbonate solution into the metal salt solution, controlling the temperature to be 60-70 ℃, continuously detecting the pH value of the solution in the adding process, and stopping dropwise adding when the pH value reaches 8.5-9.5 to obtain a suspension; continuing stirring the turbid liquid, then precipitating and aging at the constant temperature of 65 ℃, and introducing mixed gas of hydrogen and nitrogen into the turbid liquid in the precipitation and aging process to obtain mixed precipitation liquid; and finally, washing and suction-filtering the mixed precipitate, drying, and then roasting in a muffle furnace at 500-550 ℃ for 4-6 h to obtain the metal oxide catalyst. The catalyst can reduce the proper dehydrogenation temperature to 190-200 ℃, thereby being beneficial to energy conservation and consumption reduction in the production process, high efficiency and environmental protection.

title_en: Exonucleotidase inhibitors and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel heterocyclic compounds and pharmaceutical formulations thereof. The invention also relates to methods of treating or preventing cancer using the novel heterocyclic compounds of the invention.

title_en: Repairing lipstick and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a repairing lipstick and a preparation method thereof, and aims to provide a lipstick which has the functions of moistening and preserving skin and repairing skin barrier, can effectively improve the problem of dryness and water shortage of lip skin, can fade lip wrinkles, and has good spreadability and stability. The technical scheme comprises the following components in percentage by weight, based on 100 percent of the total weight: 58-76% of emollient, 16-24% of thickener, 2-5% of film-forming agent, 0.5-3% of efficacy component A, 3-8% of efficacy component B and 0.3-2% of efficacy component C; wherein the film-forming agent is a poly diethylene glycol adipate/IPDI copolymer; the functional component A is the hairless wampee seed oil; the effective component C is compound of semen Desmodii Trigonellae extract, phenoxyethanol, ethylhexyl glycerol, and caprylic/capric triglyceride. Belongs to the field of daily chemical articles.

title_en: PSMA (patterned beam-selective membrane antigen) targeted nuclide/fluorescent bimodal ligand, molecular probe and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nuclear medicine, and relates to a PSMA targeted nuclide/fluorescent bimodal ligand, a molecular probe and application. The PSMA targeted nuclide/fluorescent bimodal ligand has a structure shown in a formula I, and R is a nuclide chelating group; q is a fluorophore; n is 0 to 6. The invention takes dencichine-ureido as a target structure of PSMA, designs and synthesizes a series of bimodal molecular probes targeting PSMA by optimizing a linker and then performing nuclide/fluorescence double functionalization, and performs detailed evaluation in vitro and in vivo. The nuclide/fluorescence bimodal probe can be used for preoperative PET/CT imaging to formulate an operation route, perform fluorescence guidance during operation, perform accurate tumor positioning and boundary division, and improve postoperative curative effect.

title_en: Esterified monomer, esterified product, viscosity-reducing polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building additives, and provides an esterified monomer, an esterified product, a viscosity-reducing polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent and a preparation method thereof. The esterification monomer and the esterification product are generated by esterification reaction of unsaturated anhydride and hydroxyl phosphate betaine, and the molar ratio is (0.5-6): 1. the viscosity-reducing polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent is prepared by copolymerizing esterification products, polyether macromonomers, unsaturated carboxylic acid esters, unsaturated carboxylic acids and/or unsaturated carboxylic anhydrides and low-volatility monomer free radicals and adjusting the pH to 5-7 by using alkali. The viscosity-reducing polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent prepared by the invention introduces a monomer unit of phosphate betaine into a molecular structure, and a molecular chain simultaneously contains various functional groups and the like, so that the molecular structure is stable, the long-time slump retaining under a high-temperature condition can be realized, the slump retaining time can be more than 3h, the concrete segregation and bleeding phenomenon can not occur, the viscosity-reducing polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent also has the viscosity-reducing effect, and is particularly suitable for high-grade concrete projects.

title_en: Oral care compositions comprising tin ions
abstract_en: An oral care composition comprising tin, a polyol having five or six carbon atoms, a polyol having seven or more hydroxyl functional groups, and a pH greater than 7. Also disclosed is an oral care composition comprising a source of tin ions, a source of fluoride ions, a polyol having five or six carbon atoms, a non-reducing sugar or sugar alcohol having seven or more hydroxyl functional groups, and a pH greater than 7. These oral care compositions have high tin ion availability.

title_en: Tetrazole-substituted pyrazolopyrimidine JAK kinase inhibitor and application thereof
abstract_en: Compounds of formula (I) are described herein Wherein R  1 、R\R 3 、R4、R 5  and R  6  are as defined herein, and salts thereof, which are useful as JAK kinase inhibitors. Also provided herein are pharmaceutical compositions comprising such JAK inhibitors and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier, adjuvant or vehicle, and methods of treating or lessening the severity of a disease or disorder in a patient responsive to the inhibition of janus kinase activity.

title_en: Substituted pyrazoloquinazolinone compounds and uses thereof
abstract_en: A compound of formula I, or a stereoisomer, a tautomer, an N-oxide, a hydrate, an isotopically substituted derivative, a solvate, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, or a mixture of same, or a prodrug thereof. The compounds of formula I are kinase inhibitors and are useful for the treatment of clinical conditions, such as cancer, caused by deficient DDR function.

title_en: Novel copper-based halogen perovskite fluorescent powder and preparation method thereof
