abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel copper-based halogen perovskite fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a certain amount of MACl, CuCl powder and H at normal temperature  3  PO  2  Adding the solution into a certain amount of DMF solution, heating and stirring, stopping heating and stirring after complete dissolution, and filtering for later use; vacuum drying the obtained solution in a vacuum drying oven to obtain white powder, cleaning with n-hexane, and further drying in the vacuum drying oven to obtain white crystal MA  2  CuCl  3  And (3) single crystal. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple and convenient, the raw material cost is low, and the prepared novel copper-based halogen perovskite fluorescent powder MA  2  CuCl  3  The single crystal has a wider self-trap state exciton emission spectrum and a quantum fluorescence yield close to 100 percent, and has a great application prospect on the next generation of white light LEDs.

title_en: Synthetic method for preparing 5-amino-N-aryl-3-arylpyrazole compound by green one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel synthesis method of a 5-amino-N-aryl-3-arylpyrazole compound, which comprises the following steps: malononitrile, arylboronic acid, phenylhydrazine hydrochloride and Ni (dppp) Cl  2  And adding zinc chloride serving as an additive into tetrahydrofuran, heating under the nitrogen condition for reaction, and after the reaction is completed, carrying out post-treatment to obtain the 5-amino-N-aryl-3-arylpyrazole compound. The reaction substrate related by the method is simple in structure, cheap and easy to obtain, and the 5-amino-N-aryl-3-arylpyrazole compound is efficiently prepared by using green and environment-friendly nickel metal as a catalyst and performing addition of cyano groups, intramolecular condensation and subsequent cyclization reaction in one pot in the absence of an oxidant to realize domino conversion of three components. The conversion has the characteristics of high step economy, high conversion rate, mild reaction conditions, simple reaction operation, wide substrate application range, good functional group compatibility and the like.

title_en: High-dispersity sub-nanometer type bifunctional catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-dispersity sub-nanometer type bifunctional catalyst and application of the catalyst in a reaction route for preparing cyclohexylbenzene by benzene hydroalkylation. The catalyst takes one of Pd, ru or Ni as an active component of a metal site, adopts an in-situ synthesis method to uniformly wrap metal inside a molecular sieve in the process of generating a Y-type molecular sieve, prepares the bifunctional catalyst with high dispersion and uniform metal-acid site distribution, and shows higher yield and selectivity of cyclohexylbenzene in a benzene hydroalkylation route.

title_en: Sulfur-coordinated mononuclear cobalt monomolecular magnet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sulfur-coordinated single-core cobalt single-molecule magnet and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the single-molecule magnet is [ Co (Tbz) ] 2 ]Wherein Tbz ‑ Is tris (2-mercaptobenzothiazolyl) borate, and has the chemical structure: compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages: (1) the method utilizes 6 sulfur atoms for coordination to form the transition metal single ion magnet with an octahedral configuration, and has an important spin-orbit coupling effect, so that excellent magnetic performance is shown; (2) the mononuclear cobalt single-molecule magnet prepared by the method has the advantages of small volume, high yield, stable product, simple preparation process and the like, so the mononuclear cobalt single-molecule magnet has attractive application prospect in the preparation of high-density information storage solid devices.

title_en: Method for catalyzing, hydrogenating and dechlorinating polychlorinated chlorobenzene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for comprehensively utilizing mixed polychlorinated benzene, which uses toluene as a solvent, palladium-carbon as a catalyst, a fixed bed as a reactor, and a mixed polychlorinated benzene hydrogenation catalyst for dechlorination to generate benzene and hydrogen chloride, wherein the polychlorinated benzene conversion rate is 100%, the product is single, the separation is easy, and the process flow is simple and easy to operate.

title_en: N-naphthyl indole derivative and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel N-naphthyl indole derivative, and a synthetic method for preparing the N-naphthyl indole derivative from an o-alkynyl aniline compound and an o-alkynyl acetophenone compound by taking cuprous iodide as a catalyst, cesium carbonate as alkali and hexafluoroisopropanol as a solvent. According to the method, two intermediate alkynes are used for cross cyclization to construct a C-N bond connected five-membered pyrrole ring and a six-membered benzene ring in one step, and the N-naphthyl indole derivative with various structures is obtained.

title_en: Carbon black coupling agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon black coupling agent, a preparation method and application thereof, and a rubber composition containing the carbon black coupling agent. The carbon black coupling agent is prepared by mixing and reacting a polyamine compound and a fatty acid organic substance. The carbon black coupling agent structurally comprises at least one suspended amino functional group and at least one unsaturated double bond, and is used for preparing a rubber composition, wherein the suspended amino functional group can react with an active group existing on the surface of carbon black, so that the intermolecular force of the carbon black is weakened, and the dispersion of the carbon black in rubber is improved; the carbon black coupling agent can also generate coupling effect with rubber, improve the binding property of the rubber and the carbon black and prevent the rubber material from flocculating in the storage and vulcanization processes. The carbon black coupling agent of the invention has a crosslinking reaction with rubber in the rubber vulcanization process, and effectively improves the physical properties of rubber materials. The preparation method of the carbon black coupling agent is simple and efficient, and the raw materials are low in price and wide in source.

title_en: Elastic liposome composition containing sucrose-based surfactant and cosmetic composition containing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an elastic liposome composition containing an elastic liposome which has excellent deformability, softness, skin permeability and active ingredient trapping efficiency, and at the same time can maintain a stable state for a long period of time, since it contains lecithin and a Sucrose-based surfactant esterified with Sucrose (Sucrose) and at least one stearic acid (STEARIC ACID). In addition, there is provided a cosmetic composition having excellent stability and skin permeability by containing the above elastic liposome composition.

title_en: Synthesis and application of molecules containing alkenyl sulfonyl
abstract_en: The invention provides synthesis and application of molecules containing alkenyl sulfonyl. The synthetic method comprises a brand-new intermediate compound shown as a formula I, is simple, mild in reaction conditions, cheap and easily available in raw materials, high in yield, good in product purity and capable of realizing beta-aryl vinyl sulfonyl fluoride 18 F is marked, and the beta-aryl vinyl sulfonic acid difluoro methyl ester and the beta-aryl vinyl sulfonyl fluoride also have the activity of resisting liver cancer cells and lung cancer cells.

title_en: Catalyst carrier for olefin polymerization, preparation method and application thereof, catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of olefin polymerization catalysts, and discloses a catalyst carrier for olefin polymerization, a preparation method and application thereof, a catalyst and application thereof, wherein the carrier has a structure shown in a formula (1); when the catalyst prepared by the catalyst carrier is used for olefin polymerization, the activity and hydrogen regulation sensitivity of the catalyst are good, and the polymer prepared by catalysis has high isotacticity and low polymer fine powder content.

title_en: Processing technology and device for propylene glycol vacuum rectification production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical production, in particular to a processing technology and a device for propylene glycol vacuum rectification production, which comprises the steps of adopting propylene glycol as circulating liquid in a circulating liquid pump, keeping the vacuum degree in a rectification tower, and simultaneously separating and recovering methanol in a propylene glycol crude product; in addition, a rectifying tower for separating the methanol in the circulating liquid is added, the propylene glycol subjected to methanol removal is recycled, and the methanol can also be used as a raw material for production reaction, so that the production cost is further reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of 3-methyl-1, 5-pentanediol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 3-methyl-1, 5-pentanediol. And (2) carrying out hydrogenation reaction on the crude unsaturated dihydric alcohol under the action of a hydrogenation catalyst, wherein the unsaturated dihydric alcohol is one or more of 3-methylene-1, 5-pentanediol, trans-3-methyl-2-alkene-1, 5-pentanediol and cis-3-methyl-2-alkene-1, 5-pentanediol. The hydrogenation catalyst comprises 1-5 wt% of ruthenium and 0.1-0.5 wt% of molybdenum as active metal elements, and the carrier comprises Lu 2 O 3 、Fe 2 O 3 And Sc 2 O 3 . The process obviously improves the utilization value of the waste liquid and can reduce the running cost of the device.

title_en: Aromatic hydrocarbon alkylation reaction system and method with more than eight carbon atoms
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aromatic hydrocarbon alkylation reaction system with more than eight carbon atoms and a method thereof. The system comprises: the reactor comprises a feed inlet and a discharge outlet; the circulating flash evaporator comprises a feed inlet, a vapor outlet and a discharge outlet; wherein, the feed inlet of the circulating flash evaporator is connected with the discharge outlet of the reactor; the discharge port of the circulating flash evaporator is connected with the feed port of the reactor and is used for recycling part of flash evaporation liquid-phase products back to the reactor. The adoption of the reaction system for carrying out the alkylation reaction of aromatic hydrocarbon with more than eight carbon atoms solves the problems of overhigh reaction temperature, short service life of catalyst and low reaction conversion rate which are easy to occur in the traditional process.

title_en: Preparation method of trivalent rhodium acetate trimer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic synthesis, and discloses a preparation method of trivalent rhodium acetate trimer, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing rhodium powder and potassium chloride, and introducing chlorine for reaction; (2) dissolving the product obtained in the step (1) in water, filtering, adding potassium hydroxide into the filtrate for reaction, and filtering and washing to obtain rhodium hydroxide; (3) adding water, nitric acid and glacial acetic acid into rhodium hydroxide for reaction, evaporating the solution to dryness after the reaction is finished, removing nitrate by using the glacial acetic acid, and removing acid by using water to obtain trivalent rhodium acetate trimer. The invention adopts nitric acid and glacial acetic acid to dissolve rhodium hydroxide, and then uses glacial acetic acid to remove nitrate, so that the reaction can be obviously accelerated, thereby improving the yield of trivalent rhodium acetate trimer.

title_en: Environment-friendly d-alpha-tocopherol succinate refining preparation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly d-alpha-tocopherol succinate refining preparation process, which comprises the following steps: carrying out esterification reaction on S1 d-alpha-tocopherol and succinic anhydride to obtain d-alpha-tocopherol succinate, heating and dissolving the d-alpha-tocopherol succinate by using ethanol, cooling the d-alpha-tocopherol succinate, keeping the temperature below 0 ℃, adding a proper amount of water, and cooling the d-alpha-tocopherol succinate; s2, carrying out solid-liquid separation, adding a proper amount of water into the separated solid, mixing uniformly, and filtering to obtain hydrous d-alpha-tocopherol succinate; s3 freeze-drying to obtain d-alpha-tocopherol succinate powder. According to the invention, ethanol-water is firstly used as an organic solvent to carry out crystallization and refining on d-alpha-tocopheryl succinate, and the toxicity of the solvent is low; after solid-liquid separation, water is adopted to replace residual ethanol in the solid, so that only water is discharged in the drying process, and no organic solvent is discharged; and the subsequent freeze drying technology is adopted, so that the product is in a loose powder form, the subsequent crushing step is not needed, the generation of dust is reduced, and meanwhile, the low-temperature drying is favorable for reducing the oxidative deterioration of the product.

title_en: Fluorinating agent for fluorination reaction of bischlorosulfonimide, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorinating agent for a bis-chlorosulfonyl imide fluorination reaction, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the fluorinating agent comprises the following steps: (1) mixing Fe salt with PQ 3 (Q ═ Me, Et, or i Pr) is mixed and reacted in a solvent to prepare an intermediate B; (2) and carrying out C-F bond activation reaction on the intermediate B and the raw material A in a solvent to obtain the fluorinating agent for the fluorination reaction of the bischlorosulfonimide. The invention obtains the organic metal complex containing metal fluorine bond by screening the specific ligand, and applies the complex as the fluorinating agent to the fluorination reaction of the bis-chlorosulfonyl imine, thereby obtaining the high-purity bis-fluorosulfonyl imine with high yield. The fluorinating agent is applied to the fluorination reaction of the dichlorosulfonimide, has less side reaction, high product yield and high product yieldThe product is easy to purify, has low three wastes and low energy consumption under the condition of not using anhydrous hydrogen fluoride, and is a safe and environment-friendly synthetic method for preparing the bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide.

title_en: Lipid nanoparticle compositions
abstract_en: Provided herein are lipids that can be used in combination with other lipid components, such as neutral lipids, cholesterol, and polymer-bound lipids, to form lipid nanoparticles for delivering therapeutic agents (e.g., nucleic acid molecules) for therapeutic or prophylactic purposes, including vaccination.

title_en: Novel preparation method of epinastine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel preparation method for synthesizing an antihistaminic drug epinastine. According to the novel method for producing epinastine synthesis of the present invention, since the number of synthesis steps is small and the synthesis method is safe as compared with the conventional epinastine production method, it is expected that epinastine, an antihistaminic drug, can be synthesized inexpensively by the above-mentioned production method and supplied to the market.

title_en: Heterocyclic compound, and electronic component and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and provides a heterocyclic compound, an electronic element comprising the heterocyclic compound and an electronic device comprising the heterocyclic compound. The heterocyclic compound contains benzo [ b ] naphtho [2,3-d ] furan groups and triazine groups, and when the heterocyclic compound is used as a main body material of an organic light-emitting layer, the balance of electrons and holes in the light-emitting layer can be improved, and the performance of a device is obviously improved.

title_en: Method for preparing alpha, alpha-gem-difluoro carbonyl compound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fine chemical organic synthesis, and particularly relates to a method for preparing an alpha, alpha-gem-difluoro carbonyl compound. The method comprises the following steps: reacting the compound a and the compound b in an alkali environment by taking a metal silver salt as a catalyst to obtain the alpha, alpha-gem-difluoro carbonyl compound; the structural formula of the alpha, alpha-gem-difluoro carbonyl compound is shown as a formula III-1 or III-2. The method can be prepared by a one-pot method, is simple to operate, easily obtains raw materials and reagents, has mild reaction conditions, is environment-friendly in reaction system, is easy to separate and purify products, is suitable for synthesizing various highly functionalized alpha, alpha-gem-difluorocarbonyl compounds, is particularly suitable for large-scale industrial production, and can prepare high-purity alpha, alpha-gem-difluorocarbonyl compounds with high efficiency and high yield.

title_en: Diphosphites having open 2, 4-methylated exo-wing building blocks
abstract_en: Diphosphites having an open 2, 4-methylated exo-wing building block and their use for hydroformylation are disclosed.

title_en: Dual ATM and DNA-PK inhibitors for use in anti-tumor therapy
abstract_en: Provided herein are compounds of formula (I):  And pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, wherein the substituents are as described herein. These compounds and their pharmaceutical compositions are useful in the treatment of neoplastic diseases.

title_en: Experimental device for extract luteolin from plant
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental device for extracting luteoloside from plants, which comprises: the device comprises an extraction tank body, a liquid collecting tank, a blocking part, a material tank and a rotating shaft; the bottom of the extraction tank body can be used for heating, and the top of the extraction tank body can be used for refrigerating; the liquid collecting groove is arranged on the inner wall of the extraction tank body; a material inlet is formed in one side of the liquid collecting tank; the blocking component comprises an annular baffle and a conical apron plate, a plurality of drainage tubes radiating outwards are arranged on the periphery of the annular baffle, and one end of each drainage tube is communicated with the liquid collecting tank; the material groove is rotatably arranged on the annular baffle, and a plurality of filtering holes are formed in the side wall of the material groove; the other end of each drainage tube is arranged on the upper side of the material groove; one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the material groove, and the other end of the rotating shaft penetrates through the extracting tank body and is connected with the driving part; the driving member can drive the rotating shaft to rotate. The device can realize continuous extraction, improves extraction efficiency.

title_en: Syringopicroside aglycone derivative with bacteriostatic activity and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a syringopicroside aglycone derivative with bacteriostatic activity and a synthesis method thereof, which takes syringopicroside aglycone as a lead compound to carry out proper structural modification to synthesize the syringopicroside aglycone derivative with the bacteriostatic activity, wherein the derivative has good biological activity, and the structural general formula of the derivative is as follows: the synthesis method has the advantages of simple operation, few reaction steps, high yield and good application prospect.

title_en: Luminescent material based on 7-substituted benzothiazine phenothiazine oxide and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, and discloses a luminescent material based on 7-substituted benzothiazine phenothiazine oxide, and preparation and application thereof. The structure of the luminescent material is shown in formula I, wherein Ar is an aromatic amine group. According to the invention, the benzothiazine phenothiazine oxide is used as a framework unit, and groups with different push-pull electronic characteristics are connected to the 7 th position of the benzothiazine phenothiazine oxide, so that the adjustment of properties such as material molecular weight, pi electron conjugation degree and intramolecular charge transfer is realized. The luminescent material of the invention effectively enhances low-frequency vibration coupling, reduces high-frequency vibration coupling, and is beneficial to narrowing of half-peak width of a luminescent spectrum, thereby realizing high color purity on a molecular level. The luminescent material is used for the evaporation type organic micromolecule electroluminescent diode.

title_en: 3-ketone-bufadienolide compound and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medicines, and provides an inhibitor of cytochrome P4503A (CYP 3A). The compound is a 3-ketone-bufadienolide compound, and has the following structural formula: wherein the R is  1  、R  5  And R is  11  Each is selected from H or OH, R  14  Selected from OH or O or H, R  16  Selected from H or OAc. The 3-ketone-bufadienolide compound and the salt thereof can be used for preparing the CYP3A inhibitor and the sensitizer of the CYP3A substrate medicine.

title_en: Light-operated fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nucleic acid/nano particles/fluorescent probes, and particularly discloses a light-operated fluorescent probe, and a preparation method and application thereof. The fluorescent probe is formed by combining a DNA double strand and noble metal nano particles; the fluorescent probe based on double-labeled DNA and nano gold has high sensitivity and good biocompatibility, and realizes high-efficiency and sensitive monitoring of intracellular temperature.

title_en: Solid phosphazene compound, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solid phosphazene compound which has a structure shown in a formula (1): wherein R is a Is a crosslinking agent, R b is-N ═ PR 3 Or is R 1 、R 2 、R 3 、R 4 Each independently selected from H, C 1‑6 Alkyl radical, C 1‑6 Cycloalkyl radical, C 1‑6 Heterocycloalkyl, optionally substituted aryl, optionally substituted benzyl. TheThe compound has a plurality of guanidyl functional groups, can be used as a catalyst, can greatly reduce the technological process of separating and purifying the catalyst from the product, can be recovered only by simple filtration, can realize recycling after recovery, and has little change in catalytic activity after recovery.

title_en: Organic compound and organic electronic device
abstract_en: A nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound in the field of electroluminescence, an organic mixture and a composition containing the same and application thereof in an organic electronic device. The compound can be used as a host material to be applied to electroluminescent devices, particularly OLED devices. The compounds can improve the luminous efficiency and the service life of an electroluminescent device by being matched with a suitable guest, particularly a phosphorescent guest or a TADF luminophor, and also provides a solution for manufacturing a luminous device with low cost, high efficiency, long service life and low roll-off.

title_en: Pyridopyrimidinone CDK2/4/6 inhibitors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pyridopyrimidinone CDK2/4/6 inhibitors. More particularly, the present invention relates to compounds of formula (I) and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, wherein R 1 、R 2 、R 2A 、R 2B 、R 3 、R 4 、R 5A 、R 5B 、R 6 、R 7 、R 8 、R 9 、p、q and r are as defined herein, to pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds and salts, and to methods of using such compounds, salts, and compositions for treating abnormal cell growth, including cancer.

title_en: Preparation and antiviral application of baicalein derivatives
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and antiviral application of baicalein derivatives. The baicalein derivative is prepared from baicalein (5, 6, 7-trihydroxyflavone) by electrophilic substitution reaction. The reaction solvent is anhydrous acetone after drying and dehydration, the reaction process is that after the reaction is carried out for 1 hour under the condition of ice bath (0 ℃), the reaction liquid is added with ice water for quenching reaction, and then the mixture is filtered to obtain a yellowish or off-white crude product. Neuraminidase NA of baicalein derivative parainfluenza virus and main protease M of novel coronavirus  pro  The half inhibition concentration of the baicalein is less than 100 mu M, the synthesis method of the derivative is simple and easy, and the two hydroxyl groups of the baicalein C6-OH and the baicalein C7-OH are replaced by various sulfonyl chloride compounds in the reaction process.

title_en: Cumene hydroperoxide normal pressure tubular reactor and production process
abstract_en: A cumene hydroperoxide normal pressure tubular reactor and a production process belong to the technical field of organic peroxide oxidation devices and production processes, the reactor comprises a reactor, a spiral tube heat exchanger, a condenser and a connecting pipeline, wherein the number of the reactor (11) is more than or equal to 2, the reactor groups are formed by flange interconnection, the number of the reactor groups is more than or equal to 4, a feed inlet is formed on the tube wall of the first reactor group on the left, a discharge outlet is formed on the tube wall of the first reactor group on the right, one end of the connected reactor group is connected with the condenser through a reactor connecting tube and a condenser connecting tube, an air distributor is arranged in the tube wall of the other end and is connected with an air inlet tube connecting tube through an air inlet tube connecting tube flange, the air inlet tube connecting tube is connected with an air inlet tube, the air inlet tube is connected with an air compressor, and the spiral tube heat exchanger is arranged in the reactor. The reactor of the invention has simple structure, low cost, convenient use and high production efficiency, the product purity can reach about 95 percent, and the safety of the equipment is obviously improved.

title_en: Treatment of EGFR mutation-related cancers with combinations of EGFR and CDK4/6 inhibitors
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods of treating EGFR mutation associated cancers with a combination of an EGFR inhibitor of formula (I) and a CDK4/6 inhibitor of formula (II) and the use of these combinations of compounds in the preparation of medicaments for treating EGFR mutation associated cancers:

title_en: Gas phase preparation method of 1,1,1,2,4,4, 4-heptafluoro-2-butene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas phase preparation method of 1,1,1,2,4,4, 4-heptafluoro-2-butene, which comprises the following steps: under the action of a fluorination catalyst, 1,1,1,4,4, 4-hexafluoro-2-butyne and/or 1,1,2,3,4, 4-hexafluoro-1, 3-butadiene and hydrogen fluoride are subjected to gas-phase catalytic reaction to prepare 1,1,1,2,4,4, 4-heptafluoro-2-butene, wherein the fluorination catalyst comprises a main catalyst, a cocatalyst, a structural assistant and a forming assistant. The invention has the advantages of high conversion per pass, simple purification process, suitability for industrial production and the like.

title_en: Production process of deuterated acetonitrile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production process of deuterated acetonitrile, which belongs to the technical field of fine chemical engineering and comprises the following steps: adding acetonitrile, heavy water and a supported catalyst into a reaction bottle, then heating to 60 ℃, stirring and reacting for 5 hours, distilling a reaction product at 95 ℃, and collecting a distilled product to obtain a deuterated acetonitrile-water azeotrope; adding sodium sulfate into the deuterated acetonitrile-water azeotrope, stirring, separating liquid, collecting upper layer material to obtain deuterated acetonitrile finished product, adopting the property phenomenon of two phases of concentrated alkali method to separate out organic phase acetonitrile in the deuterated acetonitrile-water azeotrope so as to obtain deuterated acetonitrile with high purity and deuteration degree, adopting a supported catalyst to replace conventional alkali metal catalyst, increasing the contact area between the catalyst and reaction raw material, reducing the consumption of potassium carbonate catalyst and saving production cost.

title_en: Production process of guanidine phosphate
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of preparation of guanidyl compounds, and particularly discloses a production process of phosphoric acid-bis-guanidine, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing guanidine hydrochloride and phosphoric acid with the molar ratio of (1.1-2.0):1, and reacting for 1-48h at the temperature of 30-120 ℃ to generate a reaction product and hydrogen chloride gas; s2, cooling and crystallizing the reaction product prepared in the S1, and filtering to prepare a crude product of diguanidine phosphate; introducing hydrogen chloride gas into water to prepare hydrochloric acid; s3, recrystallizing the crude product of the guanidine phosphate prepared in the S2 to prepare a finished product of the guanidine phosphate; the chemical reaction for preparing the guanidine dihydrogen phosphate is simple and controllable, the impurities are less, and the product purity is high.

title_en: Heat exchanger, butylene oxidative dehydrogenation device and method for preparing butadiene through butylene oxidative dehydrogenation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat exchanger, a butylene oxidative dehydrogenation device and a method for preparing butadiene through butylene oxidative dehydrogenation. The heat exchanger comprises a shell, a hot material flow inlet, a hot material flow outlet, a gas-phase cold material flow inlet, a liquid-phase cold material flow inlet and a cold material flow outlet which are arranged on the surface of the shell, and a heat exchange tube and a shell space which are arranged inside the shell; heat exchange is performed between the hot stream, the gas-phase cold stream and the liquid-phase cold stream in the shell; the housing includes a connected horizontally disposed cylinder and a rectangle above the cylinder. When the heat exchanger is used for gas-liquid two-phase heat exchange, the gas-liquid two-phase heat exchanger can realize uniform distribution of the gas-liquid two-phase heat exchange and has a good heat exchange effect. The heat exchanger is used for preparing butadiene by oxidative dehydrogenation of butylene, and has the advantages of low system energy consumption, small steam consumption, no influence on a reaction system, low equipment investment and simple and convenient control.

title_en: A method for preparing water soluble Poria sclerotium extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a water-soluble poria cocos sclerotium extract, which comprises the following steps: pulverizing Poria sclerotium, adding ethanol solution, reflux extracting, filtering to obtain extractive solution, and concentrating to obtain extract; re-dissolving the extract with ethanol solution at room temperature, filtering to obtain extractive solution, and concentrating to obtain solid; re-dissolving the solid with water, heating to 75-85 deg.C, dissolving, cooling to room temperature in ice water bath, and centrifuging to obtain supernatant; and finally, filtering the supernatant by a ceramic membrane, concentrating and dehydrating by a nanofiltration membrane to obtain a concentrated solution, and further concentrating the concentrated solution to obtain the water-soluble poria cocos sclerotium extract. The poria sclerotium extract prepared by the method has obvious effect on eliminating DPPH free radicals and hydroxyl free radicals, reflects the dose-dependent anti-inflammatory effect in an NO inflammatory factor experiment, and is an effective supplement of the existing poria extract product and the comprehensive utilization of the plant extract in the field of beauty treatment.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of Pd-Cu alloy nanometer sea urchin, which comprises the steps of weighing a certain mass of ionic liquid, adding the ionic liquid into water to prepare an ionic liquid aqueous solution, taking a certain volume from the ionic liquid aqueous solution, adding a metal Pd precursor into a round-bottom flask, adding a metal Cu precursor, and fully and uniformly mixing to obtain a homogeneous reaction solution; adding the prepared reducing agent into the homogeneous reaction solution, slightly shaking the round-bottom flask to uniformly mix reactants, and standing at room temperature for reacting for a certain time to prepare a reaction mixture; and centrifugally separating the reaction mixture, discarding supernatant to obtain a lower-layer precipitate, centrifugally washing the precipitate with water, and finally, carrying out heat preservation and drying on the precipitate to obtain a black solid product, namely the Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin. The green aqueous phase method is simple and low in energy consumption, and the prepared Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin has a hierarchical structure and has excellent catalytic activity and selectivity in p-nitrobenzaldehyde hydrogenation reaction.

title_en: Method for extracting cannabigerol from microbial fermentation product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of extraction processes, and in particular relates to a method for extracting cannabigerol from a microbial fermentation product. The method comprises the following steps: s1, filtering microbial fermentation liquid for synthesizing cannabigerol to obtain thalli, extracting the obtained thalli with ethanol, removing the thalli after extraction, and concentrating the liquid from which the thalli are removed until the volume concentration of the ethanol is 40-50% to obtain concentrated extracting solution containing cannabigerol; s2, adding n-hexane into the concentrated extracting solution for extraction, and dividing into three layers: s21, collecting the n-hexane phase on the upper layer; s22, separating the intermediate layer substance, increasing the ethanol concentration, adding n-hexane for extraction, separating two layers, and collecting the upper n-hexane phase. The method separates high-purity cannabigerol from the microbial fermentation product, has simple process, convenient operation and low equipment cost, and can be popularized and applied in the industrial production of cannabigerol.

title_en: Preparation process of urapidil organic base raw material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of urapidil organic base raw material, which comprises the following steps of mixing 1- (2-methoxyphenyl) piperazine hydrochloride, Na2CO3 and H2O to obtain a mixture R1, heating and stirring the obtained mixture R1, adding 6- (3-chloropropyl) -1, 3-dimethyl uracil into the mixture R1, heating and stirring for continuous reaction, and finally carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the urapidil organic base raw material.

title_en: High-adhesion ionic liquid adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of adhesives, and particularly relates to a high-adhesion ionic liquid adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The ionic liquid comprises a cation and an anion, wherein the cation contains a tripolymer structure with carbamido; through introducing carbamido into the cationic structure of the ionic liquid tripolymer, independent ionic liquid units can be assembled through local hydrogen bonds to form a dynamic physical crosslinked three-dimensional network, and finally, the ionic liquid can show extremely strong adhesion in a macroscopic adhesion performance test; the physical and chemical properties of the ionic liquid adhesive can be selectively regulated and controlled by selecting cationic tripolymers with different end group types and anion collocation with different types, so that specific production requirements are met.

title_en: Silicone emulsions and personal care products containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a silicone emulsion and personal care products comprising the same that passes the preservative challenge test without preservatives listed in eu cosmetic code 1223/2009 appendix table V using the following novel preservative approach: i) the pH of the emulsion is 5 or less; and/or ii) the emulsion comprises at least one alcohol compound having two or more hydroxyl groups.

title_en: Triazolo hexa-nitrogen heterocyclic-3-amine compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triazolo hexa-nitrogen heterocycle-3-amine compound, and a preparation method and application thereof. The triazolo hexa-nitrogen heterocyclic-3-amine compound is obtained by reacting a triazolo [4,3-a ] pyridine-3-amine compound with a phenylboronic acid compound in the presence of a catalyst and a solvent, and has a certain antiproliferative activity on tumor cells and can induce apoptosis of the tumor cells. The preparation method of the triazolo hexa-nitrogen heterocyclic-3-amine compound has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, quick and efficient reaction, no need of adding an additional redox agent and the like, is green and environment-friendly, has low price, simple method and high yield, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Method for synthesizing furo [2,3-b ] quinoxaline derivative
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing furo [2,3 ] b ]The method for synthesizing the quinoxaline derivative comprises the following steps: adding different kinds of substrates quinoxaline-2 (1) into a glass reaction container according to the proportion H ) Ketone N 1 is hydrogen substituted) and alkyne, boric acid is used as an additive, copper triflate is used as a catalyst, potassium persulfate is used as an oxidant, 1, 2-dichloroethane is used as a solvent, the raw product is subjected to oil bath stirring reaction for 12 hours at 80 ℃, and the furo [2,3 ] is prepared after the crude product is separated and purified by column chromatography b ]Quinoxaline derivatives. The method uses the cheap and easily obtained copper salt as the catalyst, avoids the use of noble metal catalyst, and has the advantages of simple and convenient reaction operation, mild condition and excellent separation yield, and can realize gram-scale preparation.

title_en: Pentabenzocycloindoline compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a penta-annul indoline compound, belonging to the technical field of organic chemical synthesis, the compound has a structure shown in a formula (I), the invention also discloses a preparation method of the compound, 3-nitroindole (II) and 2-alkenyl indanone (III) are dissolved in an organic solvent, then alkali and a phase transfer catalyst are added, stirring reaction is carried out at room temperature, and after the reaction is finished, separation and purification are carried out to obtain a product (I); the penta-cyclo-indoline compound provided by the invention has structural units of cyclopentane-indoline and indanone, can provide more candidate molecules for research and development of new drugs and drug screening, and has good potential value in research of antitumor drugs; the preparation method has the advantages of novelty, simplicity, simple operation, mild reaction conditions, high yield, high non-stereoselective selectivity and the like; also, the process is the first example of a higher-order dearomatization reaction involving an electron-deficient aromatic heterocycle.

title_en: Temperature-control type ionic liquid and gold extraction method using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of noble metal separation, in particular to a temperature-control type ionic liquid and a method for extracting gold by using the same, wherein the temperature-control type ionic liquid has the following structure: the extractant has simple structure, simple and convenient synthesis process and good stability, does not need additional organic solvent, overcomes the problems of difficult mass transfer, environmental pollution and health hazard in the extraction process, has good extraction and separation effects on hardware, can realize separation between gold and other metals, and has the extraction rate of gold reaching 90 percent and the extraction rate of other metals being less than 5 percent in a selective extraction experiment. The extraction separation method provided by the invention is less influenced by the concentration of hydrochloric acid in the water phase, and has good gold extraction effect under different acidity.

title_en: Polycyclic compound for inhibiting Bruton's tyrosine kinase activity, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a series of novel small molecule inhibitors for overcoming BTK C481S mutation resistance, in particular discloses a compound of formula I, a stereoisomer or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition of the compound, and application of the compound and the pharmaceutical composition containing the compound in treating BTK dysfunction related diseases such as B cell proliferative diseases and autoimmune diseases. The inventor of the invention proves that the compound can inhibit wild type and 481-th cysteine-mutated BTK kinase at the same time through experiments. The inventor of the invention proves that the compound has the anti-proliferation inhibition effect on tumor cell strains such as MINO, OCI-LY10 and the like through experiments.

title_en: Stable bicontinuous phase cleansing oil and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of IPC A61K8/00, in particular to stable bicontinuous phase cleansing oil and a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise, by weight: 10-36 parts of surfactant, 20-48 parts of softener, 20-32 parts of polyol, 0.01-0.2 part of complexing agent, 0.1-5 parts of amphiphilic compound, 0.1-5 parts of bacteriostat and 0-60 parts of solvent. The invention has the following advantages: the cleansing agent can prevent secondary deposition of makeup, quickly dissolve various makeup products, and has stronger cleansing power and remarkable makeup removal effect compared with the traditional makeup removal oil products; the temperature resistance of the cleansing oil is improved, layering and deterioration phenomena are not easy to occur, and the cleansing oil can be stored for a long time; the skin care product has the advantages of fresh and cool texture, no greasiness, mild and clean skin, obvious moisturizing and nourishing effects on the skin, no stimulation to the skin in the use process, moist and tender skin after use, no dryness, tightness and comfortable sensory experience.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon from saturated hydrocarbon, preparation method of catalyst and method for preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon from saturated hydrocarbon
abstract_en: The application provides a catalyst for preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon from saturated hydrocarbon, a preparation method of the catalyst, and a method for preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon from saturated hydrocarbon, and relates to the technical field of chemical industry. And under the condition of illumination, the conversion rate of saturated hydrocarbon can be further improved. The preparation method of the catalyst for preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon from saturated hydrocarbon adopts soluble zinc salt and M metal salt as precursors, introduces the precursors into a silicon-aluminum phosphate molecular sieve carrier by an impregnation method or an ion exchange method, and prepares the supported catalyst by roasting.

title_en: Composition containing rehmannia root oligosaccharide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of skin care products, in particular to a composition containing rehmannia root oligosaccharides and application thereof. The invention discloses a composition containing rehmannia root oligosaccharides, which comprises the following components: tremella polysaccharide, aloe polysaccharide, fucoidin and radix rehmanniae oligosaccharide, wherein the radix rehmanniae oligosaccharide is one or more of raffinose, stachyose, mannotriose and calycosin. The invention provides a composition containing radix rehmanniae oligosaccharide and application thereof, wherein the radix rehmanniae oligosaccharide has the functions of resisting bacteria and diminishing inflammation, and can be used for repairing the problems of acnes, acnes and the like; the tremella polysaccharide, aloe polysaccharide and fucoidin have the effects of moisturizing; cordyceps polysaccharide, polyporus polysaccharide, and Achyranthis radix polysaccharide have skin whitening effect; chitin and Lycium barbarum polysaccharide have antiaging effect; the rhizoma Polygonati polysaccharide and Ganoderma polysaccharide have effects of improving skin blood microcirculation; the plant polysaccharide and the rehmannia root oligosaccharide are compounded, so that the effects of moisturizing and repairing skin aging, yi Zhimin, acne and the like can be achieved.

title_en: Anti-wrinkle anti-aging smearing mask and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-wrinkle anti-aging coating mask and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of skin care products. The invention relates to an anti-wrinkle and anti-aging smearing mask which comprises the following components in parts by mass: 0.25-1.5 parts of turmeric root extract, 0.05-0.2 parts of gentian root extract, 0.49-2 parts of agave leaf extract, 0.001-0.005 parts of palmitoyl tripeptide-5, 9.9-30 parts of sea water and 1-8 parts of nicotinamide; the anti-wrinkle and anti-aging coating mask disclosed by the invention is added with a plurality of high-content plant extracts matched with seawater and nicotinamide, so that collagen fibers and elastic fibers in a dermis layer can be effectively activated, the skin elasticity is improved, the skin is compacted, and wrinkles are reduced; the skin care cream can also supplement moisture for dry skin and repair dark skin, and can repair damaged skin, resist the irritation caused by unknown factors in the environment, and achieve the effects of moisturizing and repairing; in addition, the preparation method of the facial mask provided by the technical scheme of the invention is simple to operate and short in time consumption, so that the facial mask can be applied to practical application.

title_en: Method for preparing 2, 4-difluoroaniline through catalytic hydrogenation of 2, 4-difluoronitrobenzene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing 2, 4-difluoroaniline by catalytic hydrogenation of 2, 4-difluoronitrobenzene, which comprises the following steps: preparing a Zr-MOF/perlite composite material; dissolving palladium chloride and nickel chloride in deionized water to prepare a mixed solution, then adding the prepared Zr-MOF/perlite composite material, carrying out ultrasonic treatment, then drying, and finally placing in a muffle furnace for reduction treatment to prepare a catalyst; adding 2, 4-difluoronitrobenzene into a reactor filled with a catalyst, replacing air in the reactor with hydrogen, heating, introducing hydrogen for reaction, filtering reaction liquid to remove the catalyst after the reaction is finished, removing the solvent from the filtrate, and then carrying out reduced pressure distillation to obtain the target product. The method is simple to operate, and the prepared product has high yield.

title_en: Multifunctional hair tail oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses multifunctional hair tail oil and a preparation method thereof. Comprises 0.1-0.3% of additive; 0.1-0.5% of linear aspalaxyl extract; 0.05-0.2% of sophora flavescens root extract; 1-2% of a nutrient; 1-5% of dioctyl carbonate; adding the polysiloxane compound to 100%; the nutritional agent at least comprises shea butter and olive oil. The shea butter, the olive fruit oil, the sophora flavescens root extract and the linear aspalaxyl extract are matched according to a specific proportion, when the hair is repaired and is tough after absorbing nutrition, the hair is not easy to become oily and glossy, but can present natural matte feeling; meanwhile, the sophora flavescens root extract can be well compounded with the rest components in the hair tail oil, has the functions of antibiosis and anti-inflammation, and ensures that bacteria on hair are not easy to breed. The hair tail oil has multiple effects of strengthening and strengthening hair, keeping fluffy, keeping luster, resisting bacteria and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing saflufenacil intermediate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of synthesis of pesticide compounds, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a saflufenacil intermediate. The method comprises the following steps: 1) reacting 2, 4-dichlorotoluene serving as a raw material to obtain a formula II; 2) synthesizing a formula III by using a formula II and a formula IV under an alkaline condition, and 3) synthesizing a compound I by using the formula III through halogenation, hydrolysis and oxidation. The process for preparing the compound shown in the formula (I) avoids using expensive raw material 2-chloro-4-fluorobenzoic acid, effectively reduces the cost of raw materials, reduces three wastes generated in the process, has high total reaction yield, and is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Process for the preparation of travoprost intermediates
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a travoprost intermediate, which comprises the following steps: under the action of anhydrous potassium carbonate as a catalyst, the compound shown in the formula (1) and/or the isomer thereof and halogenated isopropyl alkyl are subjected to esterification reaction to obtain the compound shown in the formula (2) and/or the isomer thereof. The method for preparing the travoprost intermediate can be used for preparing the travoprost intermediate, has the advantages of short time, high yield, high purity, low production cost and the like, and is suitable for large-scale production and application.

title_en: Process method for preparing p-methylstyrene by reacting p-methyl-ethylbenzene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process method for preparing p-methylstyrene by reacting p-methyl ethylbenzene, which relates to the technical field of methylstyrene preparation and mainly comprises the following steps of heating and gasifying raw materials, carrying out two-step reaction, recovering steam condensate, recovering light and heavy aromatic hydrocarbons, extracting p-methylstyrene, recovering dehydrogenation tail gas and recycling p-methyl ethylbenzene. The raw material in the preparation method provided by the invention is high-purity p-methyl-ethyl benzene, and the raw material does not contain harmful substances for reaction, so that the effective yield of the catalyst per unit mass is improved; and the addition of water vapor in the process protects the catalyst and dilutes the reaction to a certain extent, reduces the partial pressure and is beneficial to improving the conversion rate of the reaction.

title_en: Heterocyclic compound, light-emitting device including the same, and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterocyclic compound, a light-emitting device including the heterocyclic compound, and an electronic apparatus. The light emitting device includes: a first electrode; a second electrode facing the first electrode; an interlayer between the first electrode and the second electrode and including an emission layer; and at least one heterocyclic compound of formula 1, as defined herein.

title_en: Application of piperlonguminine compound in preparation of medicine for treating schistosomiasis japonica and medicine composition
abstract_en: The invention provides application of piperlonguminine compounds in preparation of medicaments for treating schistosomiasis japonica and a medicinal composition, and belongs to the technical field of medicinal treatment. The invention introduces different substituent groups into alpha position of Michael double bond of piperlongumine, the obtained piperlongumine compound has high-efficiency treatment activity to schistosoma, and 72h IC of the piperlongumine compound for resisting schistosoma japonicum activity in vitro 50 The value is 1-5 times of piperlonguminine, wherein the IC of the compound 9 for resisting the schistosoma japonicum activity in vitro is 72h 50 Value and clinicalThe drug positive control praziquantel is equivalent.

title_en: Preparation method of azoxy compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an azoxy compound, belonging to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out reduction reaction on raw materials, and oxidizing to prepare the azoxy compound. The method provided by the invention can simply obtain high-quality products.

title_en: Reaction circulation rectification process method for producing ethyl methyl carbonate and diethyl ester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reaction circulating rectification process method for producing ethyl methyl carbonate and diethyl carbonate. In the gas phase operation stage, liquid is static on a tower tray, steam flows to a condenser from a reboiler, gas-liquid two phases are subjected to mass transfer on the tower tray and perform ester exchange reaction in a liquid phase of the tower tray; during the liquid phase operation phase, the vapor stops and the liquid moves between the trays; the cyclic operation of the gas phase and the liquid phase is realized by a tower internal part which is provided with a valve and a gate chamber positioned below the tower tray; during the gas phase operation phase, the valve on the tray is closed; in the liquid phase operation stage, a valve is opened, liquid flows to a lower lock chamber from a tray, the periodic feeding of raw materials dimethyl carbonate and ethanol is completed, an azeotrope of dimethyl carbonate and methanol is extracted from the top of a reaction rectifying tower, and ethyl methyl carbonate and diethyl carbonate are extracted from the bottom of the tower.

title_en: Synthetic method of taurine precursor 2-aminoethanol sulfate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthetic method of taurine precursor 2-aminoethanol sulfate, which comprises the following steps: adding ethanolamine and a phase transfer catalyst into toluene, controlling the temperature below 50 ℃, dropwise adding 98% concentrated sulfuric acid for at least 1 hour, and stirring for at least 30 minutes after the dropwise adding is finished, wherein the volume ratio of the toluene to the ethanolamine is 4: 1, the dosage of the sulfuric acid is 1.1 equivalent of that of the ethanolamine; heating to at least 110 ℃ for reflux dehydration, cooling the reaction liquid to below 30 ℃ when no water is separated from the oil-water separation equipment, filtering, washing a filter cake, and drying to obtain the 2-aminoethanol sulfate. The invention takes ethanolamine as a starting material, synthesizes the 2-aminoethanol sulfate in the presence of sulfuric acid, toluene and a phase transfer catalyst, and has good product purity and high yield.

title_en: Preparation method of umeclidinium bromide intermediate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a umeclidinium bromide intermediate. The method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, cheap and easily obtained raw materials, high reaction yield and high product purity, and is very suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Essence liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to essence water which adopts water as a main solvent and comprises nicotinamide, phyllanthus emblica (PHYLLANTHUS EMBLICA) fruit extract, panthenol, butanediol and 1, 2-hexanediol. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the essence water.

title_en: Device for producing n-propyl acetate by thermal coupling and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of chemical industry and discloses a device for producing n-propyl acetate by thermal coupling and a production method thereof. The rare earth modified solid super acidic catalyst is utilized for catalytic reaction, so that the requirements on the catalytic efficiency and the service life of the catalyst in the production process are met. The heat of the product discharged in the reaction process is fully utilized by utilizing the plurality of heat exchange units, the heat balance of the device is reasonably optimized, the safety of the device is improved, the operation efficiency of the device is improved, and the energy-saving effect is achieved.

title_en: Oral care composition containing inulin
abstract_en: Described herein are oral care compositions that include, in relevant part, an effective amount of inulin. Methods of making and using these compositions are also described.

title_en: Hyperbranched aminosilane anti-sloughing agent, water-based drilling fluid containing hyperbranched aminosilane anti-sloughing agent and preparation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyperbranched aminosilane anti-sloughing agent, a water-based drilling fluid containing the same and a preparation method thereof. The hyperbranched aminosilane anti-collapse agent structure comprises a structural unit A Structural unit B And structural unit C And at least one of (a) and (b) at least includes a structural unit A; and structural unit D Wherein the connecting keys in structural unit A, structural unit B and structural unit C are connected with the connecting key in structural unit D, and different connecting keys in structural units B and C are connected with different structural units D; r 1 、R 2 、R 3 Each independently selected from C1-60 alkyl. Compared with other conventional plugging type anti-collapse agents, the hyperbranched aminosilane anti-collapse agent has the characteristic of controllable scale, obviously improves the plugging effect of microcracks, particularly nanoscale micropores, and can meet the anti-collapse requirement of developed stratums of the nanopores such as shale.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity single-crystal 2,2 '-dimethyl-4, 4' -diaminobiphenyl
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-purity single-crystal 2,2 '-dimethyl-4, 4' -diaminobiphenyl, which comprises the following steps of subliming a product in a high vacuum environment to obtain white crystal powder with extremely high purity, single crystal and extremely low metal ion content 2,2 '-dimethyl-4, 4' -diaminobiphenyl.

title_en: Organic monomolecular dual-emission material based on phenothiazine and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phenothiazine-based organic monomolecular dual-emission material which is a compound with a structural formula shown as the following. According to the invention, through the research on the relationship between the photophysical property, excited state property and luminescence property of a donor-acceptor-donor type D-A-D' structure, a ketone derivative is selected as an electron acceptor, and the distance between phenothiazine and ketone is shortened, so that a larger steric hindrance locking phenothiazine conformation is constructed, and the phenothiazine conformation is insensitive to the stimulation response of external mechanical force, the emission performance is basically unchanged, and good stability is shown. The doped white light OLED device is prepared by taking the doped white light OLED device as a doped material in a luminescent layer material, the structure of the device can be effectively simplified, and the interface problem of the device is avoided。

title_en: Alkene-containing amide compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of an enamide compound and agriculturally acceptable salt thereof as a herbicide, wherein the compound is shown as a general formula (I)： The definition of each substituent in the general formula I is shown in the specification. The compound of the general formula I has excellent weeding activity and can be used for preventing and controlling agricultural weeds.

title_en: Bicontinuous phase cleansing lotion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bicontinuous phase cleansing lotion and a preparation method thereof, wherein the bicontinuous phase cleansing lotion comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 10-30% of surfactant, wherein the surfactant comprises nonionic surfactant and anionic surfactant, the ratio of the nonionic surfactant in the makeup remover is 10-30%, and the ratio of the anionic surfactant in the makeup remover is 0.1-5%; 5-30% of grease; 5-40% of polyol; water and the balance. According to the invention, the non-ionic surfactant is innovatively matched with the anionic surfactant to construct a bicontinuous phase system, and a proper amount of grease and polyol are matched, so that the obtained bicontinuous phase has the characteristics of high transparency, high stability and high makeup removing capability, the special microemulsion structure of the bicontinuous phase can be verified by a pigment method, and meanwhile, the bicontinuous phase has good makeup removing capability and fresh skin feel after washing.

title_en: Process and device for producing higher fatty alcohol by continuous rectification
abstract_en: The application relates to a process and a device for producing higher fatty alcohol by continuous rectification, and relates to the technical field of extraction, separation and deep processing of grease. A process for producing higher fatty alcohol by continuous rectification uses saponified crude alcohol as raw material, and adopts multistage rectification; the saponified crude alcohol is subjected to weight removal by a weight removal tower and then subjected to four-stage rectification to obtain high-purity higher fatty alcohol. The continuous rectification process of the process realizes full-automatic control, is simple and convenient to operate, runs more stably, reduces energy consumption by more than 90%, and greatly improves the stability of product quality; the continuous rectification process time is greatly shortened, and the total yield of the product with the purity of more than 98 percent reaches 2.7kg/hr, which is 20 times higher than batch rectification; the components in the rectifying section are thoroughly cut, and the primary yield (the product purity is 98%) reaches more than 80 percent, which is more than 3 times higher than batch rectifying. The device of the application circulates the reboiler to improve the mixing uniformity of the materials at the bottom of the tower and shortens the evaporation time under the condition of the same treatment capacity.

title_en: Method for synthesizing fluoro-olefine sulfone by one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a fluoro-olefine sulfone by a one-pot method, which comprises the following steps: taking 2- ((4-bromo-3-chloro-3, 4, 4-trifluorobutyl) thio) thiazole as an initial raw material, taking an alcohol-water mixed system as a reaction solvent, reacting dropwise hydrogen peroxide and concentrated hydrochloric acid to generate low-concentration chlorine, performing thiazole ring chlorination reaction on the low-concentration chlorine and the 2- ((4-bromo-3-chloro-3, 4, 4-trifluorobutyl) thio) thiazole, oxidizing hydrogen peroxide and thioether into sulfone, completing dropwise addition of hydrogen peroxide and concentrated hydrochloric acid, and adding sodium hydrosulfite into the system to perform dehalogenation reaction to prepare the fluoroolefin sulfone. The method has the advantages of simple process, mild reaction conditions, high yield and low raw material cost, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Spirocyclic indenes
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compounds represented by formula I, wherein R  3  ,R  8c  ,R  8d  ,A,A  1  ,A  2  ,A  3  ,A  4  ,E,E  1  L, Q, Z, and as defined in the specification, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts and solvates thereof. The compounds of formula I are KRAS inhibitors and are therefore useful in the treatment of cancer and other diseases. 。

title_en: Indolocarbazole-based compound and application thereof in organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic electroluminescent materials, in particular to a compound based on indolocarbazole and application thereof in an organic electroluminescent device. The chemical structure of the indolocarbazole-based compound is as follows: the indolocarbazole-based compound is applied to a hole transport material in an organic electroluminescent device, wherein the compound is based on five-membered condensed rings: indolocarbazoles have good planarity and conjugated ductility, can provide higher mobility, and meet the requirements of OLED hole transport materials.

title_en: Method for preparing D-biotin intermediate
abstract_en: The present invention provides a process for the preparation of a thiolactone compound of the formula (I) or a geometric isomer or a mixture of geometric isomers thereof, wherein R and R 'are independently H, lower alkyl, aryl or acyl groups, the R and R' being optionally substituted by one or more substituents. According to the present invention, the process surprisingly provides a stable reaction which gives higher purity and/or yield compared to prior art processes.

title_en: Catalyst and its use in ethylbenzene dealkylation
abstract_en: An ethylbenzene dealkylation catalyst composition comprising a ZSM-5 type zeolite as a support component, wherein the zeolite is synthesized from an aqueous reaction mixture comprising one or more alumina sources, one or more silica sources, one or more base sources and one or more primary and/or secondary amines, and wherein the ZSM-5 type zeolite has a number average crystallite size in the range of 1 to 10 μm and a silica to alumina molar ratio (SAR) in the range of 30 to 70; a process for reducing xylene loss during ethylbenzene dealkylation, said process comprising conducting an ethylbenzene dealkylation process in the presence of the above catalyst composition; and a process for dealkylation of ethylbenzene which comprises contacting a feed comprising ethylbenzene with the catalyst composition in the presence of hydrogen.

title_en: Improved method for synthesizing mecobalamin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improved method for synthesizing mecobalamin, comprising: under the protection of inert gas, dropwise adding an aqueous solution of ammonium formate into a mixed aqueous solution of cyanocobalamine and cobalt chloride in a darkroom to perform a reduction reaction; after the completion, methyl iodide is added into the reaction liquid to carry out methylation reaction, thus obtaining the catalyst. The invention has simple process operation, low manufacturing cost, economy, environmental protection and high product yield, and is worthy of industrialized popularization.

title_en: Novel dihydropyrimidine compound, intermediate or salt, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a compound shown in a formula (I), or stereoisomers, geometric isomers, tautomers, oxynitride compounds, hydrates, solvent compounds, metabolites, pharmaceutically acceptable salts and intermediates thereof. The application also provides application of the compound, stereoisomer or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing diseases related to the TRPA1 receptor, in particular to application in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing cough, asthma, pain and sleep apnea.

title_en: Method for producing coated zinc oxide particles by flame spray pyrolysis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of coated zinc oxide particles by flame spray pyrolysis techniques, coated zinc oxide particles and compositions comprising said particles. The invention also relates to specific zinc oxide particles obtained from such a process, compositions comprising such particles and also uses thereof.

title_en: Inula flower extract, preparation method and skin care application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inula flower extract, a preparation method and skin care application thereof. The inula flower extract is prepared by the following method: taking the inula flower powder with the particle size of less than 40 meshes, and extracting by adopting an ultrasonic auxiliary extraction method at the material-liquid ratio of 1g to (5-20) ml, wherein the extraction power is 100-300W, the extraction temperature is 50-120 ℃, and the extraction time is 0.5-10 h. Experiments prove that the inula flower extraction method provided by the invention improves the contents of flavone, polyphenol and polysaccharide in the inula flower, has good antioxidant, whitening and antibacterial effects, and has good application prospects in the fields of food, medicines and cosmetics.

title_en: Total synthesis method of vitamin A, derivative thereof and deuterated compound thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a total synthesis method of vitamin A and derivatives and deuterated compounds thereof, which takes beta-cyclic citral as an initial raw material to generate alkenyl borate, then the alkenyl borate (or hydrolyzed alkenyl borate) generates retinaldehyde or retinaldehyde with substituent groups through a series of reactions, and vitamin A or vitamin A with substituent groups is further obtained through reduction reactions; the vitamin A or the vitamin A with the substituent is subjected to esterification reaction to obtain vitamin A ester or the vitamin A ester with the substituent; or the retinol with the substituent is subjected to oxidation reaction to obtain retinoic acid or the retinoic acid with the substituent. When deuterated dienols are used, deuterated vitamin a and its derivatives are obtained. The invention has the advantages of short synthetic route, simple operation, easily available raw materials and reagents, modularization and divergence, and can synthesize deuterated vitamin A and derivatives thereof which are difficult to synthesize in the prior art.

title_en: Method for preparing 4-acetoxy butyraldehyde from allyl acetate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing 4-acetoxybutyraldehyde by allyl acetate under the action of a homogeneous rhodium catalyst. The homogeneous rhodium catalyst adopted by the method consists of a phosphorus-containing ligand, a rhodium compound or an auxiliary agent, and has the advantages of high catalytic activity, high product selectivity, recyclability and the like. The synthesis method improves the yield of the 4-acetoxy butyraldehyde by selecting the phosphorus-containing ligand and the auxiliary agent in the catalyst; the reaction condition is mild, the synthesis process is simple, and the method has good industrial application value. The invention provides a method for preparing 4-acetoxybutyraldehyde by taking allyl acetate as a raw material through hydroformylation reaction, wherein the most key first step reaction in a synthetic route for preparing important chemical butanediol by hydrogenation-hydrolysis is that allyl acetate is used for preparing 4-acetoxybutyraldehyde through hydroformylation reaction.

title_en: Catalyst for selectively reducing spinosad J and process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of spinosad preparation, in particular to a catalyst for selectively reducing spinosad J, wherein the active component of the catalyst accounts for 1-10% of the total weight, and the active component is Pd or Pt; or the active component is two metals, one is selected from Pd, pt or Rh, and the other is selected from Pd, pt, ru, ir; or the active components are three or more than three metals, the first active metal is selected from one of Pd, pt and Rh, the second active metal is selected from one of Pd, pt, ru, ir, the secondary active metal is selected from one or more of Pd, pt, ru, ir, and the weight ratio of the three is (6-12): (6-13): (1-2). The catalyst reacts for 5 to 10 hours under the conditions of 0.05 to 0.5MPa and 10 to 80 ℃ by using hydrogen, can reduce the double bonds at the 5 and 6 positions on the spinosad J four-membered ring lactone in the spinosad J/L mixture, and does not accompany the reduction of the double bonds 13 and 14 on the spinosad J four-membered ring lactone and spinosad L. The catalyst has higher conversion rate, selectivity and yield and lower cost.

title_en: Long-acting antibacterial agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a long-acting antibacterial agent, in particular to a method for preparing ester-group-containing quaternary ammonium salt through two steps of esterification and quaternization. The quaternary ammonium salt takes N, N-dimethylethanolamine as a raw material, and an ester-group-containing quaternary ammonium salt compound is prepared through two steps of esterification and quaternization. The compound prepared has N  +  And ester groups, two functional groups and alkyl long chains can effectively inhibit the growth of gram bacteria and fungi, meanwhile, the quaternary ammonium salt is easy to partially degrade, and the inhibition effect of the degraded quaternary ammonium salt compound on the gram bacteria is obviously enhanced, so that the long-acting sterilization effect is achieved. The quaternary ammonium salt compound can be used as a long-acting antibacterial agent and has good application prospect.

title_en: O-GlcNAc glycosylation probe Ac 3 6deoGlcNAz and synthesis process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological probes, and particularly relates to a novel O-GlcNAc glycosylation probe Ac  3  6deoGlcNAz and its synthesis process and application. We designed and synthesized a novel molecular probe Ac  3  6deoGlcNAz and its associated biological properties were analyzed. The experimental result proves that Ac  3  6deoGlcNAz has low cytotoxicity, the activation substrate of the 6deoGlcNAz can be identified by OGT for O-GlcNAc glycosylation protein modification, can be efficiently marked in various cell lines, and has concentration and time dependence; more importantly, compared with the classical probe Ac4GlcNAz, Ac4GalNAz, Ac  3  The 6deoGlcNAz metabolic marker can reduce interference with the results by triggering non-specific S-glycosylation.

title_en: Compound and optical film comprising same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a compound represented by chemical formula 1, a composition for forming an optical film and an optical film including the same, and a display device including the optical film.

title_en: Iron complexes and salts thereof as MRI contrast agents
abstract_en: The present invention relates to iron complexes having the general formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition formulated for oral and/or parenteral administration, preferably intravenous administration, preferably formulated as an aqueous solution comprising said complex or salt. The invention further relates to said complex or salt thereof or said pharmaceutical composition for use as a contrast agent for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), as well as to methods and kits for the in situ preparation of said complex or salt and said pharmaceutical composition.

title_en: Soothing moisturizing lotion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to A61K8, in particular to soothing and moisturizing water and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials of the soothing moisturizing lotion comprise an emollient, a humectant, a skin conditioner, a chelating agent, a colorant and a solvent. The obtained soothing moisturizing lotion has good stability, cold resistance and heat resistance, and can be stored for a long time without deterioration; can inhibit light injury and photoaging to skin, resist aging, moisturize skin, relieve inflammation and tranquilize skin inflammation caused by sunshine, and repair skin. Has low irritation, and is especially suitable for dry skin.

title_en: Nickel-based catalyst, preparation method thereof and application of nickel-based catalyst in maleic anhydride hydrogenation to prepare succinic anhydride
abstract_en: The invention provides a nickel-based catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in maleic anhydride hydrogenation to prepare succinic anhydride. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a Ni precursor, an alkaline earth metal precursor, a pore-forming agent and a carrier precursor with a solvent, and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor; wherein at least one of the Ni precursor, the alkaline earth metal precursor and the pore-forming agent is an organic matter; quickly heating the catalyst precursor to a roasting temperature in a protective gas atmosphere for roasting, and quickly cooling after roasting to obtain a catalyst finished product; wherein the temperature rising rate of the rapid temperature rising is not lower than 20 ℃/min, and the temperature reducing rate of the rapid temperature reducing is not lower than 50 ℃/min.
