The preparation method of the nickel-based catalyst is simple and suitable for large-scale industrial production, and the prepared nickel-based catalyst has the characteristics of high activity, high product selectivity and good stability when being used for the reaction of preparing succinic anhydride by maleic anhydride hydrogenation.

title_en: Solid acid catalyst for preparing D-galactose and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid acid catalyst for preparing D-galactose and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, synthesizing a skeleton carrier; s11, preparing a sodium aluminate solution and an organic template solution; s12, mixing the sodium aluminate solution with the organic template solution, and fully shaking up; s13, adding a zirconium source into the mixed solution obtained in the step S12, and uniformly mixing; s14, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the reaction solution obtained in the S13 to obtain mixed crystal ZrO  2  /Al  2  O  3  (ii) a S15, preparing mixed crystal ZrO from S14  2  /Al  2  O  3  Quickly heating to an organic template for ashing, and washing with absolute ethyl alcohol to obtain white solid ZrO  2  /Al  2  O  3­  ；S2、Immersing the skeleton carrier prepared by S1 into concentrated sulfuric acid loaded sulfonic acid group to obtain target solid acid; according to the invention, zirconium dioxide and aluminum oxide are matched to form a composite framework, so that the specific surface area of the carrier is increased, and the catalytic efficiency of the obtained solid acid is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium picosulfate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of sodium picosulfate, and belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry. The preparation method of the sodium picosulfate comprises the following steps: mixing a compound with a structure shown in a formula II, pyridine sulfur trioxide with a structure shown in a formula III and an organic solvent, and performing sulfonation reaction to obtain a sulfonation product; mixing the sulfonated product with sodium hydroxide solution, and neutralizing to obtain a neutralized product; mixing the neutralization product with a poor solvent, and crystallizing to obtain a solid product; and mixing the solid product with a desalting solvent, desalting, and sequentially concentrating, pulping, filtering and drying the obtained product to obtain the sodium picosulfate. The method has the advantages of easily obtained raw materials, simple process operation, no need of extraction and simple post-treatment process, and the prepared sodium picosulfate product has higher purity (more than 99 percent) and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Catalyst for catalytically synthesizing isoprene, preparation method thereof and preparation method of isoprene
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalyst for catalytically synthesizing isoprene, a preparation method thereof and a preparation method of isoprene. The preparation method of the catalyst provided by the invention comprises the following steps: a) mixing a Cr source, a P source, a non-metal-containing compound, a metal soluble compound, water and a modifier to obtain an active solution; b) mixing the active solution with a silica gel solution to obtain a catalyst slurry; c) after the catalyst slurry is subjected to spray drying, roasting to obtain a catalyst; the nonmetal element in the nonmetal-containing compound is at least one of B, F and Br; the metal element in the metal soluble compound is at least one of La, Ce, Pr, Gd, Nd, Ag, Fe, Ni, Cu, Co, Mo, Mn and W; the modifier is hydrogen peroxide and/or ammonia water. The catalyst provided by the invention can improve the stability of the catalyst on the basis of ensuring the catalytic activity of the catalyst for synthesizing isoprene.

title_en: Circular polarization phosphorescence platinum (II) complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circular polarization phosphorescence platinum (II) complex, the structure of which is shown as the following formula: wherein R is  1  Is one of hydrogen, deuterium, alkenyl, alkynyl, amido, nitryl, carbonyl, sulfuryl, halogen, cyano, alkyl, alkoxy, substituted aromatic ring group of C6-C60, unsubstituted aromatic ring group of C7-C60 and substituted or unsubstituted aromatic heterocyclic chiral alkyl chain of C3-C60;R  2  is an arylamine group. On one hand, 2, 6-bis (N-alkyl benzimidazolyl) benzene is used as a tridentate chelating ligand, so that certain interaction force exists between the molecules in an excited state to form an excimer; on the other hand, the unit with the chiral center is connected with the tridentate chelating ligand and/or the isonitrile part through a covalent bond, circular polarization luminescence is realized through chiral transmission, and convenience is provided for the improvement and application of the circular polarization luminescent material through the regulation and control of the molecular structure of the material.

title_en: Bismuth-based metal organic framework and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth-based metal organic framework and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: by BiPh  3  Taking MMTAA as an organic ligand and mixed solution of toluene and methanol as a reaction solvent to carry out reflux reaction; when precipitates just appear in the reaction solution, the reaction system is transferred to 55-80 ℃, and the reaction is kept stand for a set time to obtain a target product. The preparation method of the Bi-MMTAA provided by the invention is simple, and has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, low cost and the like; the prepared crystal has good quality and large size. In the reflux synthesis process, the temperature is reduced to a certain value, and after one week of standing growth, a single crystal with mm size can be obtained. In application, Bi-MMTAA is a photocatalyst to realize the high-efficiency oxidation of phenylboronic acid to phenol.

title_en: Composite enhanced PVC (polyvinyl chloride) power casing pipe and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power sleeves, and aims to solve the problem that the existing PVC power sleeve is poor in heat resistance and flame retardance, in particular to a composite enhanced PVC power sleeve and a production process thereof; the composite reinforced PVC electric power casing comprises the following raw materials: PVC resin, a reinforcing agent, a reinforcing auxiliary agent, a styrene-butadiene thermoplastic elastomer, an ultraviolet absorbent and an antioxidant; in the production process, the heat-resistant flame-retardant property of the PVC resin can be obviously enhanced by adding the reinforcing agent and the reinforcing auxiliary agent, and the prepared composite enhanced PVC power bushing has excellent heat-resistant flame-retardant property under the synergistic effect of the reinforcing agent and the reinforcing auxiliary agent.

title_en: Production process of N-fatty acyl disodium glutamate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of N-fatty acyl disodium glutamate, which comprises the following steps: A. mixing sodium glutamate, water, liquid caustic soda and cocoyl chloride, and performing condensation reaction to obtain a product A; B. carrying out acidification and water separation treatment on the hydrochloric acid and the product A to obtain a product B; C. performing neutralization reaction on the product B, liquid caustic soda and water in a neutralization kettle, and filtering to obtain a cocoyl glycine disodium water solution; in the step C, adding the liquid caustic soda into a neutralization kettle in a manner of slowly dripping in an overhead tank; the neutralization kettle comprises a kettle body (1), feed ports (2) are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the kettle body (1), and a liquid dropping port (3) is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the kettle body (1); a horizontal stirring device (4) is arranged in the kettle body (1). The invention has the characteristic of effectively improving the stirring effect.

title_en: Process for refining aminopyrine crude product
abstract_en: A process for refining aminopyrine crude product belongs to the technical field of chemical synthesis pharmacy. The method comprises the following steps: 1) First utilizing subcritical CO in a subcritical reactor  2  Washing the crude aminopyrine with subcritical CO  2  Washing the crude productResidual extractant of (2); 2) Dissolving aminopyrine with hot water at 99-111 ℃ after subcritical washing to obtain aqueous aminopyrine solution, feeding the aqueous aminopyrine solution into a centrifuge under the condition of heat preservation for high-speed centrifugation, collecting supernatant, concentrating, cooling, crystallizing and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain refined crude product material; 3) And mixing the refined crude product, ethanol and active carbon, heating and refluxing, filtering by a membrane to collect filtrate, cooling the filtrate, crystallizing, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a refined product. The method for processing the crude aminopyrine can solve the problem that the crude aminopyrine is difficult to digest due to relatively large yield of analgin.

title_en: 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 4, 5-dihydro-isoxazole derivative and a corresponding preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: under the catalytic action of acid, reacting acetyl hydroxylamine with a compound with a structure shown in a formula (I) to prepare the 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative. The preparation method of the 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative provided by the invention adopts cheap acetyl hydroxylamine as a raw material, so that the raw material cost is low; the reaction condition is mild, high-temperature and high-pressure conditions are not needed, the requirement on equipment is low, the reaction speed is high, and the purity and the yield of the prepared product are high; the whole reaction process is simple, extensive and strong in tolerance, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Synthetic method of ibrutinib
abstract_en: The invention provides a new synthesis method of ibrutinib, which carries out reaction through a new intermediate, has fewer reaction steps and high product yield and is beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: Compounds and flavor imparting compositions using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound represented by the following formula (1), a flavor imparting composition comprising the compound, a consumer product comprising the flavor imparting composition, a method for imparting a flavor to a flavor composition comprising a step of adding the flavor imparting composition to a flavor composition, and a method for imparting a flavor to a consumer product comprising a step of adding the flavor imparting composition to a consumer product.

title_en: Preparation method of zoysin intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a zoysia japonica intermediate. Specifically discloses a preparation method of a compound shown as a formula P6, which comprises the following steps: in a solvent, under the action of an acid binding agent, carrying out hydroxyl protection reaction on a compound shown as a formula P5 and tert-butyldimethyl chlorosilane (TBDMSCl) to obtain a compound shown as a formula P6; the acid binding agent is imidazole. The method has the advantages of low cost, high yield and purity, no column chromatography step and easy operation, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Latent heat storage material, latent heat storage body, electronic device, and electricity storage device
abstract_en: The application discloses a latent heat storage material, a latent heat storage body, an electronic device and an electric storage device. Specifically disclosed is a latent heat storage material which contains a compound represented by the following chemical formula (I). In the chemical formula (I), n and m are each independently an integer of 6 to 24, where n represents an odd number when n=m and n+.m. X  ‑  represents an anion. C  n H 2n+1 (C m H 2m+1 )N + H 2 X ‑  (I)

title_en: Anti-dandruff oil-control shampoo
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of washing and caring products, and particularly discloses an anti-dandruff and oil-control shampoo, which comprises the following components: solvent, surfactant, humectant, hair conditioner, antiseptic, aromatic, pearling agent, thickener, suspending agent, pH regulator, chelating agent, dandruff removing agent, and hair conditioner at least including fructus Cnidii extract, lactobacillus/soybean milk fermentation product filtrate, and radix Ipomoeae juice. The invention has the advantages of prolonging the effects of removing dandruff and controlling oil.

title_en: Sesquiterpenes compound containing peroxy group structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sesquiterpenoid compound containing a peroxy group structure, which comprises a compound with a structure shown in a formula (1), or a crystal form, a stereoisomer, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, a solvate, a prodrug or a metabolite of the compound. The invention provides the compound for the first time, and finds that the compound has wide application in the fields of pesticides and the like.

title_en: Process for preparing (Z) -1,1,1,4,4,4-hexafluoro-2-butene and intermediates
abstract_en: The present invention describes a process for the preparation of (Z) -1,1,1,4,4,4-hexafluoro-2-butene (Z-1336 mzz). The process utilizes readily available halogenated feedstocks including 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2,2-trifluoroethane (CFC-113 a) and carbon tetrachloride.

title_en: Composition for preventing alopecia and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition for preventing alopecia, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of daily necessities; the invention provides a composition for preventing alopecia, which comprises the following components: caffeine complex, glycollic acid, panthenol, nicotinamide, micellar root extract, pyrrolidinyl diaminopyrimidine oxide; the 6 components have synergistic effect and are matched with other components and a proper preparation method, so that the prepared composition can achieve excellent alopecia preventing effect; the composition can be applied to the preparation of products with different forms for preventing alopecia, and the preparation method of the composition is simple and controllable, and is convenient for practical production.

title_en: Device and process for treating ammonium chloride waste liquid in industrial glycine production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a process for treating ammonium chloride waste liquid in industrial glycine production, wherein a film evaporator is connected with an extraction kettle through a material transfer pump; the feed inlet of the extraction kettle is respectively connected with a solvent pipeline, a concentrate pipeline, a solvent reflux pipeline, an extraction condenser and a centrifugal filtrate circulating pipe, the outlet of the extraction kettle is connected with a centrifuge, and the jacket of the extraction kettle is connected with circulating water; the top of the single-effect heater is connected with the gas-phase rectifying tower through a Roots blower, and the lower part of the single-effect heater is connected with the secondary evaporation tank through a material transfer pump; the upper part of the secondary evaporation tank is respectively connected with the evaporation tank, the preheater and the secondary evaporation condenser, and the lower part of the secondary evaporation tank is connected with the organic matter tank. The recovered ammonium chloride can be mixed with normal ammonium chloride as a byproduct in the production of glycine for taking out, and the organic matter solution can be taken out to organic fertilizer enterprises to be mixed with yeast solution for large-scale use. The device can realize high-valued comprehensive utilization of the ammonium chloride waste liquid, no waste water is generated, zero clearing of the 'red waste liquid' in the glycine industry can be finally realized, and the device has remarkable environmental protection benefit.

title_en: Treatment process of ammonium chloride waste liquid in glycine production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a treatment process of ammonium chloride waste liquid in industrial grade glycine production, and mainly provides a treatment process of ammonium chloride waste liquid in glycine production from the thought of reducing chloride ion content and viscosity. The process can continuously recover the ammonium chloride product from the waste liquid, and simultaneously obtain the organic matter solution with better fluidity, wherein the ammonium chloride can be mixed with the byproduct normal ammonium chloride in glycine production for take-out, and the organic matter solution can be taken out to an organic fertilizer enterprise for mixing with the yeast solution for use in a large amount. The invention has simple process, can realize the high-value comprehensive utilization of the ammonium chloride waste liquid, has no waste water generation, can finally realize zero clearing of the red waste liquid in glycine industry, and has remarkable environmental protection benefit. Meanwhile, the recycled ammonium chloride and organic matter solution can produce economic benefits.

title_en: Spirobifluorene compound with terminal extension and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a spirobifluorene compound with terminal extension, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of hole transport materials. The invention takes the spirobifluorene spiral structure as a core, improves the conjugation performance of spirobifluorene molecules by extending the tail end structure, has strong intermolecular acting force of extending the tail end structure and high conductivity of the compound, and can reduce the HOMO energy level of the compound molecule, thereby reducing the open-pressure loss of the perovskite solar cell, having stronger hole extraction capability and improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency. Furthermore, the extended molecular terminal structure increases the volume of the compound molecule, and the glass transition temperature of the compound is higher, thereby improving the stability of the compound. The spirobifluorene compound with the terminal extension has low HOMO energy level, excellent conductivity and thermal stability, and has good application prospect as a hole transport material, especially a hole transport material of a perovskite solar cell.

title_en: Substituted isoxazole pyrimidinamine compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention disclosesA substituted isoxazole pyrimidinamine compound has a structure shown as a general formula I; the definition of each substituent group in the formula is shown in the specification. The compound has broad-spectrum bactericidal, insecticidal and acaricidal activities, and has excellent control effects on cucumber downy mildew, powdery mildew, corn rust, anthracnose, rice blast, aphid, tetranychus cinnabarinus and the like.

title_en: Fiber eyebrow pencil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fibrous eyebrow pencil, which comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 6-12 parts of polyethylene wax, 4-10 parts of ozokerite, 2-5 parts of microcrystalline wax, 25-40 parts of silicone oil, 20-30 parts of a film-forming agent, 2-8 parts of mica powder, 10-20 parts of a toner pigment, 0.1-1.0 part of fiber, 0.15-0.50 part of phenoxyethanol, 0.1-0.3 part of caprylyl glycol, 0.1-0.3 part of vitamin acetate and the balance of additives; the invention has the beneficial effects that: (1) The fiber eyebrow pencil obtained by the invention has excellent stability, can keep long-term non-staining and non-makeup, has better skin feeling and skin moistening property, good safety and strong makeup-keeping capability; (2) The eyebrow pencil has better fineness, is not easy to have the problems of large particles and uneven coloring, has better filling capacity and is suitable for people with sparse eyebrows; (3) The preparation process provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the color stability of the eyebrow pencil, the processing process is simple and convenient, and the prepared eyebrow pencil has less oil volatilization.

title_en: Synthetic process and device of bromine complexing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis process of a bromine complexing agent, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding a raw material A, a raw material B and a solvent into a reaction kettle; according to the parts by weight, the adding amount of the raw material A is 1-5 parts, the adding amount of the raw material B is 1-200 parts, the adding amount of the solvent is 1-1000 parts, and the reaction is started; s2, heating the reaction kettle to 80 ℃ from room temperature; adjusting the pressure in the reaction kettle to 100-400 kPa; controlling the temperature in the reaction kettle; repeating the process until the reaction is finished; controlling the condenser, and condensing and refluxing the raw material B; s3, finishing the reaction after 0.2-60 h, controlling the internal pressure of the reaction kettle to be 100-400 kPa, and enabling the reaction liquid to enter a reaction liquid storage tank to complete solid-liquid separation; directly discharging the solid product, and recycling the liquid; an apparatus for carrying out the process is also disclosed. The synthesis process provided by the invention can effectively reduce energy consumption and improve the utilization rate of raw materials; the device has simple structure and high system stability.

title_en: Extraction equipment and extraction method of momordica grosvenori sweet glycoside compounds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for extracting momordica grosvenori sweet glycoside compounds, which comprise the following steps: the device comprises a rack, a driving motor, an extraction device, a transmission mechanism, a filtering device, a foam separation device, a removal device, a pressurizing device and an atomization drying device, wherein the rack bears extraction equipment and is provided with the driving motor for providing power for the operation of the equipment; the extraction device is positioned above the side of the driving motor; the transmission mechanism is connected with the driving motor and the extraction device; the filtering device is arranged at the bottom of the extracting device and is rotatably connected with the transmission mechanism; the foam separation device is rotatably connected with the filtering device; the removing device is arranged below the foam separating device; the pressurizing device is fixedly connected with the removing device; the atomization drying device is fixed at the top of the extraction device. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of compact and efficient structure, simple process, sustainable production, reduced production cost, improved production efficiency and product quality meeting market demands.

title_en: Process for the preparation of steroids 16,17-epoxides
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a steroid 16,17-epoxy compound, which comprises the following steps: mixing the compound A Carrying out an ethynylation reaction to prepare a first intermediate product; carrying out dehydration reaction on the first intermediate product to prepare a second intermediate product, and then carrying out hydrolysis reaction on the second intermediate product in an acidic environment to prepare a third intermediate product; or the first intermediate product is subjected to Lu Pei rearrangement reaction to prepare a third intermediate product; the third intermediate product is, And performing ketal reaction to prepare a fourth intermediate product A; orReacting the third intermediate with Carrying out an ene etherification reaction to prepare a fourth intermediate product B; performing olefin epoxidation reaction on the fourth intermediate product A or the fourth intermediate product B to prepare a steroid 16,17-epoxy compound; the structure of the steroid 16,17-epoxy is shown as any of:

title_en: Hydrogen-carbon methane production method and system for linkage carbon capture and water electrolysis hydrogen production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen-carbon methane preparation method and system for linkage carbon capture and water electrolysis hydrogen production, wherein fluctuating renewable power is utilized to flexibly and quickly obtain fluctuating hydrogen as a reaction raw material for preparing methane from hydrogen and carbon, organic amine is used to capture carbon dioxide in fuel combustion flue gas, a storage tank is equipped to store carbon dioxide as a reaction raw material, input carbon dioxide is regulated and controlled in real time by utilizing fluctuating hydrogen feeding, the input carbon dioxide is catalytically converted into methane in a reactor, the fluctuation of the available generated power is adapted through regulating and controlling the feeding flow of the carbon dioxide, large-scale power and hydrogen storage are not needed, the method and system can be better used for absorption and utilization of the renewable power, heat emitted by a hydrogen-carbon methane preparation reactor is directly used for a carbon capture reboiler to realize thermal circulation, and the energy consumption is greatly reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of 4,4' -dimethylbiphenyl
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel method for preparing 4,4 '-dimethylbiphenyl, which uses p-chlorotoluene and magnesium chips to react in n-butyl ether, realizes the synthesis of 4,4' -dimethylbiphenyl by using three materials, and has high purity and yield of the obtained product. The preparation method of the 4,4' -dimethylbiphenyl not only greatly simplifies the quantity of reaction materials and greatly reduces the preparation cost, but also obviously improves the yield which is up to 98 percent compared with the prior synthesis method of p-bromotoluene and 4-methylphenylboronic acid. The method for preparing the 4,4' -dimethylbiphenyl has the advantages of less materials, simple reaction, low preparation cost, high yield and remarkably improved market competitiveness, and is particularly suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Thioxanthone single-component visible light initiator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thioxanthone single-component visible light initiator and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the N-hydroxysuccinimide ester is introduced into a thioxanthone structure, so that the maximum absorption wavelength of the formed thioxanthone-N-hydroxyformamide ester (TX-NHCIE) photoinitiator reaches 476nm, and the photoinitiator has a relatively high molar extinction coefficient at 422 nm. Under the irradiation of near ultraviolet and visible light, weak N-O bond in TX-NHCIEs generates active free radical through single electron reduction decarboxylation, so as to initiate monomer to cure. In addition, because the photoinitiator has a skeleton structure of thioxanthone, the photoinitiator can also be used as a Norrish II type photoinitiator. The photoinitiator has good initiation efficiency on free radical monomers under the irradiation of near ultraviolet and visible light.

title_en: Coumarin pyrazolone fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a coumarin pyrazolone fluorescent probe, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fluorescent probe has a chemical formula of C  21 H 16 N 4 O 4  and the structural formula is as follows:  the fluorescent probe adopts coumarin groups as fluorophores, adopts acylhydrazone structures as recognition receptors and quenching parts, has higher selectivity and sensitivity for detecting Cu  2+ , has quick response with Cu  2+  reaction time, has a larger pH application range and can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Method for preparing nitrogen-containing heterocyclic derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing nitrogen-containing heterocyclic derivatives and application thereof, relating to the technical field of organic synthesis. The method comprises the following steps: the novel method for preparing a series of N-substituted different dihydrooxazine, dihydrothiazine and tetrahydrobenzoquinazoline derivatives with caprolactam units by using a naphthalene-containing compound as a substrate and formaldehyde and DBU through multi-component cascade reaction in a solvent is simple and easy to operate, wide in application range of the reaction substrate, good in regioselectivity, high in yield, novel, environment-friendly and wide in application prospect in the aspects of bioscience, pharmaceutical industry and material science.

title_en: Modified sulfonic acid resin catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modified sulfonic acid resin catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst takes polystyrene sulfonic acid resin modified by a molecular sieve as a carrier, and the mass of the molecular sieve is 0.1 to 2.0 percent of that of the resin; the load is niobium oxide nano-particles with a specific crystal phase structure; the special crystalline phase structure is a pseudo-hexagonal phase (500 degrees), an orthorhombic phase (700 degrees) or a monoclinic phase (900 degrees). The method has the advantages of low ratio of ester to alcohol as reaction raw materials, high temperature resistance, high reaction rate, few byproducts and the like, thereby reducing equipment investment and operation, lowering cost and being suitable for large-scale industrial application.

title_en: Environment-friendly efficient synthesis process of p-hydroxybenzonitrile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic synthesis, in particular to the field of IPC 07D213, and more particularly relates to an environment-friendly and efficient synthesis process of p-hydroxybenzonitrile. Compare in traditional technology, this application the technology energy consumption is low, the input is fit for extensive industrial production greatly, choose for use low price para hydroxybenzoic acid to go to prepare the high p-hydroxy benzonitrile of high price, very high economic benefits has, and choose for use specific equipment as reaction unit, moreover, the operation is simple, can generate the high p-hydroxy benzonitrile of purity, on the one hand, the waste gas that the on the other hand reaction side effect produced, waste water, the waste residue can both obtain better processing, waste gas is with ammonia cyclic utilization reduce cost and pollution abatement after handling, waste water is sent into recovery workshop rectification, obtain xylene storage recycling, the waste residue of production is handled and is extracted the accessory substance ammonium phosphate, ammonium phosphate is fertilizer and chemical industry raw materials commonly used, economic value has, not only changing waste into valuables and reduced the cost of post processing, kill two birds with one stone.

title_en: Compound for organic electroluminescent device and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound for an organic electroluminescent device and application thereof, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula (I): L、L  1  、L  2  each independently selected from a single bond, a substituted or unsubstituted C6-C30 arylene, or a substituted or unsubstituted C3-C30 heteroarylene; ar (Ar)  1  ‑Ar  2  Each independently is a substituted or unsubstituted C6-C30 aryl or substituted or unsubstituted C3-C30 heteroaryl; x  1  ～X  11  Each independently selected from CR  1  Or N, said R  1  Each independently selected from one of hydrogen, cyano, nitro, hydroxyl, substituted or unsubstituted C1-C20 chain alkyl, C3-C20 cycloalkyl, C1-C20 alkoxy, C1-C20 silyl, C6-C60 aryl and C3-C60 heteroaryl, wherein R is  1  Each independently optionally linked to a linking aromatic or heteroaromatic ring to form a ring; when the above-mentioned substituted or unsubstituted group has a substituent, the substituent is selected from one or a combination of two or more of halogen, C1 to C20 chain alkyl, C3 to C20 cycloalkyl, C1 to C20 alkoxy, C1 to C20 thioalkoxy, C1 to C20 silyl, cyano, nitro, hydroxyl, C6 to C60 aryl, and C3 to C60 heteroaryl.

title_en: Preparation method of benzil and special venturi ejector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of benzil, which adopts a jet loop reactor, takes benzoin and air as raw materials, takes acetic acid as a solvent, takes acid and salt as catalysts, and carries out oxidation reaction; the acid is one or two of hydrochloric acid and sulfuric acid; the salt is one or more of sodium bromide, potassium bromide, sodium iodide and potassium iodide; inlet section opening inside diameter of venturi injector in jet loop reactor: nozzle inner diameter: air chamber closing-in inside diameter: mixing section length: the proportion of the length of the diffusion section is 34 (1.5-4.5): (2-6): (180-280): (1550-1850), wherein the opening angle of the diffusion section is 12-28 degrees; and controlling micro positive pressure of a reaction system in the reaction process. The method adopts the novel reactor-jet loop reactor to carry out air oxidation on benzoin to prepare benzil, and the method uses a cheap catalyst to carry out catalytic oxidation, so that the reaction time is short and the air consumption is low.

title_en: Related substance of canagliflozin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a related substance of canagliflozin and a preparation method and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of drug synthesis, and solves the problem that n-butyl impurities of canagliflozin are not researched in the prior art. The structure of the related substance of canagliflozin provided by the invention is shown as a formula I. The invention also provides a preparation method of the related substance and application of the related substance in detection of canagliflozin intermediates, bulk drugs and/or preparations.

title_en: Preparation method of 3-fluoro-3- (1-hydroxyethyl) pyrrolidine-1-carboxylic acid tert-butyl ester
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of 3-fluoro-3- (1-hydroxyethyl) pyrrolidine-1-carboxylic acid tert-butyl ester, which takes easily obtained N- (methoxymethyl) -N- (trimethylsilyl) benzylamine as a starting material, and the easily obtained N- (methoxymethyl) -N- (trimethylsilyl) benzylamine and 2-fluoro methyl acrylate undergo a 1, 3-dipolar cycloaddition reaction under the catalysis of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) to obtain a compound VI, the compound VI is condensed with N, O-dimethylhydroxylamine hydrochloride under the alkaline condition of Grignard reagent methyl magnesium chloride to obtain a compound Weinreb amide V, and then reacts with Grignard reagent methyl magnesium chloride to obtain a compound methyl ketone IV; the compound IV is reduced by the compound hydride to obtain a compound III, then benzyl protecting group is removed by Pd/C catalytic hydrogenation to obtain a compound II, and finally amino group is reacted with (Boc) under the catalysis of DMAP  2  O protection to obtain the target compound I. The invention has the advantages of low cost and easy availability of raw materials and reagents, mild reaction conditions, simple operation, no harsh reaction conditions, high yield and easy mass production.

title_en: Organic catalyst for non-aqueous aldol condensation
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method. In one embodiment, the method includes providing a first blend of a union aldehyde, a C  8  olefin, and a C  7 -C 9  alkane. The method includes adding a component selected from the group consisting of C  4  aldehydes, C  5  aldehydes, and combinations thereof to the first blend to form a non-aqueous reaction mixture having an initial water content of 0 wt% to 10 wt% water. The method includes introducing an organic base catalyst into the non-aqueous reaction mixture, heating the non-aqueous reaction mixture to a temperature from 30 ℃ to 100 ℃, and causing the non-aqueous reaction mixture to undergo a cross aldol condensation reaction. The method includes forming a cross aldol product comprised of components selected from the group consisting of C  8  enal, C  10  enal, C  13  enal, C  14  enal, and C  18  enal, and combinations thereof.

title_en: Organic molecules for optoelectronic devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to organic molecules, in particular for application in opto-electronic devices. According to the invention, the organic molecule is represented by a plurality of units, wherein each unit comprises or consists of a structure represented by formula (I): wherein n =0 or 1; and X is independently at each occurrence selected from the group consisting of a direct bond, CR  3  R  4  、C＝CR  3  R  4  、C＝O、C＝NR  3  、NR  3  、O、SiR  3  R  4  S, S (O) and S (O)  2  Group (d) of (a).

title_en: Antibacterial composition
abstract_en: Disclosed is a cleaning composition comprising a sulfate surfactant; a fatty acid soap; a silver compound; a thickener; and a nitrate salt. The cleaning composition has a pH of 5 to 10. Another cleaning composition is disclosed comprising a sulfate surfactant; a silver compound; a thickener; a nitrate salt; and a preservative. The cleaning composition has a pH of 4 to 5.5.

title_en: Compound essential oil containing ferulic acid derivative for removing acne, whitening skin and resisting oxidation, preparation method thereof and composition for removing acne, whitening skin and resisting oxidation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acne-removing, whitening and antioxidant compound essential oil containing ferulic acid derivatives, a preparation method thereof and an acne-removing, whitening and antioxidant composition, and belongs to the technical field of cosmetics. The product disclosed by the invention contains ferulic acid derivatives and plant essential oil, starts from the aspects of inhibiting the proliferation of propionibacterium and malassezia, reducing the probability of parakeratosis of pilosebaceous ducts, eliminating inflammation and the like, inhibits the growth of acne, achieves the aim of removing acne, and also has the effects of whitening skin, fading acne marks, delaying skin aging and restoring a healthy skin state. Moreover, the ferulic acid derivative serving as a full-wave-band light-resistant raw material can enhance the light stability of the plant essential oil, keep the long-acting activity of active substances, exert better effect and adapt to a wider application range. In addition, the performance of the compound essential oil can be enriched by adding an antioxidant, an alcohol auxiliary agent, skin moistening grease and a peony root bark extract.

title_en: Alkalization equipment and method for sinomenine hydrochloride
abstract_en: The application discloses an alkalization method of sinomenine hydrochloride, which comprises the following steps: A. uniformly mixing calcium hydroxide and water to obtain an alkaline suspension; B. pre-stirring the sinomenine hydrochloride percolate, and adding the alkaline suspension into the sinomenine hydrochloride percolate for reaction to obtain an alkaline mixed solution containing sinomenine; C. filtering the alkaline mixed solution, and removing filter residues to obtain sinomenine hydrochloride alkalization solution. In the alkalization equipment and the alkalization method for sinomenine hydrochloride, disclosed by the embodiment of the application, the dispersion degree of calcium hydroxide is improved by preparing the calcium hydroxide powder into the alkaline suspension in advance, and the reaction efficiency of the calcium hydroxide and sinomenine in hydrochloric acid can be improved by using the alkaline suspension to react with the sinomenine hydrochloride percolate; and the reaction efficiency of calcium hydroxide and sinomenine hydrochloride percolate is improved, so that the total amount of unreacted sinomenine and calcium hydroxide is reduced, the filtered solid waste is reduced, and the cost and the environmental emission are further reduced.

title_en: Aggregation-induced emission type chiral fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aggregation-induced emission type chiral fluorescent probe, which takes cyclohexanediamine and tetraphenyl ethylene as frameworks; meanwhile, the preparation method of the aggregation-induced emission type chiral fluorescent probe is provided, wherein p-bromobenzaldehyde, tetrahydrofuran, absolute ethyl alcohol, triphenylbromoethylene, bis-triphenylphosphine palladium dichloride, bispinacolatol borate, sodium phenolate, freshly distilled toluene, cyclopentyl methyl ether, cesium carbonate, tetra (triphenylphosphine) palladium and redistilled toluene are added on the basis of cyclohexanediamine, and the aggregation-induced emission type chiral fluorescent probe is prepared through a series of operations. The aggregation-induced emission type chiral fluorescent probe has a unique molecular structure, realizes visual identification and resolution of chiral acid, and is simple to operate and low in cost.

title_en: Synthesis method of topiramate intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of a haloxyfop-methyl intermediate, which comprises the following reaction steps: is prepared from compound A and compound B through reaction under the action of catalyst and alkali. The synthesis method has the characteristics of high reaction speed, high product purity and yield, few reaction steps and simple synthesis process, not only optimizes the reaction conditions, but also reduces the equipment cost of the reaction, and the obtained product is easy to separate and simplifies the production process.

title_en: Room-temperature synthesis method and application of bulk ZIF-8
abstract_en: The invention relates to a room temperature synthesis method and application of bulk ZIF-8, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing zinc salt and 2-methylimidazole in a polar solvent, stirring for reaction, centrifuging, washing, and drying at 20-35 ℃ to obtain the bulk ZIF-8. Compared with the prior art, the blocky ZIF-8 prepared by the invention can be used as a catalyst for catalyzing Knoevenagel condensation reaction and has catalytic activity equivalent to that of powdery ZIF-8; but compared with the powder ZIF-8, the blocky ZIF-8 is more beneficial to separation and recovery from a reaction system for cyclic utilization, so that the production cost is reduced, the impurity content of the product is reduced, and the product purity is improved.

title_en: Animal fibre product
abstract_en: A product having powder-like properties, the product comprising animal fibres, such as wool, having a length of less than 10mm, preferably less than about 3mm, more preferably less than about 2mm. Surprisingly, animal fibres with a length below a certain fibre length have powder-like properties, such as improved rheological properties, increased density, increased surface area and increased porosity. Also described are processes for preparing the compositions and composites thereof and uses thereof, for example, as filter aids, for dietary supplements, for fillers, and for hair thickeners.

title_en: Polyurethane flame-retardant coating for building outer wall and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyurethane coating, in particular to a polyurethane flame-retardant coating for an external wall of a building and a preparation process thereof. The scheme has reasonable process design, the proportion of each component in the coating is proper, the prepared polyurethane flame-retardant coating can be coated and modified on the surface of the building outer wall, and the coating has excellent flame retardance and waterproof performance and high practicability.

title_en: Micro-bead system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a microcoagulated bead system characterized by having: microcoagulated beads, which are disposed in an aqueous phase; also comprises a first emollient and an emulsifier. The micro-beads provided by the invention have good compatibility with a matrix, high centrifugal stability, good high and low temperature resistance stability and reduced process loss. The preparation method of the micro-coagulated beads provided by the invention is particularly suitable for forming the micro-coagulated beads by a formula system with higher viscosity.

title_en: Preparation method of fatty alcohol ether carboxylic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of fatty alcohol ether carboxylic acid, which belongs to the technical field of synthesis of anionic nonionic-anionic surfactants in organic chemistry, takes fatty alcohol as a raw material, under the protection of inert gas, organic alkali and fatty alcohol ether are firstly subjected to alkalization reaction, and then are subjected to carboxymethylation reaction with chloroacetate under the action of a phase transfer catalyst, and the fatty alcohol ether carboxylic acid is obtained through acidification and water washing. The preparation method of the fatty alcohol ether carboxylic acid has the advantages of simple process, easy control of production, high product purity and stable quality.

title_en: Eutectic material with laser and white light emission characteristics and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a eutectic material with laser and white light emission characteristics and a synthesis method thereof. The method is to carry out a cocrystallization reaction on a series of organic matters containing cyano, halogen and the like and biphenyl, and generate a series of novel crystalline substances with different luminescent colors through halogen bonds, charge transfer, pi-pi interaction or combination of the interaction. The invention introduces functional groups with supermolecule interaction on the basis of single-component biphenyl, changes dihedral angles and stacking modes of organic molecules of the biphenyl, optimizes or changes the photophysical properties of the biphenyl, generates a laser Amplified Spontaneous Emission (ASE) effect, and further utilizes the three-primary-color principle to modulate the obtained crystal material emitting at red, green and blue different wave bands into a white light emitting material. The invention improves the association knowledge between the structure and the optical performance of the biphenyl compound, and widens the thought and the space for synthesizing novel solid laser and white light materials.

title_en: Preparation method of 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane, which comprises the following steps: mixing an amine solvent and liquid ammonia to obtain a mixture; dropwise adding chloropropyltrichlorosilane into the mixture, and keeping the temperature for reaction after dropwise adding; and filtering the reaction liquid to remove a byproduct, and then removing the solvent to obtain the 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane. The method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, low reaction pressure, high safety, high product yield and obviously reduced by-product generation amount, and has industrial production value because the usage amount of liquid ammonia is greatly reduced compared with the conventional process and the feeding mode is adjusted, and the yield per unit product and the raw material conversion rate are obviously improved.

title_en: Hydroxyurea methyl-acylfulvenes for the treatment of brain or CNS cancer
abstract_en: A method of treating brain tumor cancer by administering hydroxyureylmethyl-acylfulvene. Some embodiments relate to the treatment of glioblastoma by administering hydroxyurea methyl-acylfulvene. The methods also include characterizing the subtype and genetics of the marker.

title_en: Method for continuously synthesizing isooctyl chloroformate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for continuously synthesizing isooctyl chloroformate, which comprises the following steps of preparing a continuous reaction device, wherein the continuous reaction device comprises an photochemical tower, a transfer kettle and a light-expelling tower which are mutually communicated, introducing isooctyl alcohol and phosgene into the photochemical tower for reaction, overflowing an obtained esterified liquid into the transfer kettle, separating gas from liquid outside the tower, delivering liquid light into the tower, controlling the temperature of the transfer kettle to be 30-40 ℃, collecting a certain esterified liquid in the transfer kettle, delivering the esterified liquid into the light-expelling tower, controlling the temperature of the light-expelling tower to be 40-80 ℃, introducing nitrogen into the light-expelling tower for light-expelling, and collecting high-purity isooctyl chloroformate in the light-expelling tower, wherein the content is more than or equal to 99%, and the yield is more than or equal to 97%. The method realizes continuous production on the premise of ensuring the quality and the yield of the product, has small production occupation area, small liquid holdup of a reaction system, small risk, high production efficiency, easy control of process conditions and little three wastes, accords with the environment-friendly production concept and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Cinchona alkaloid derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cinchona alkaloid derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the cinchona alkaloid derivative has a structure shown in a formula I: wherein R is  1  Selected from H or C  1～6  Alkoxy groups of (a); r is R  2  Selected from C  1～6  Alkyl or C of (2)  1～6  Alkenyl groups of (c). The cinchona alkaloid derivative provided by the invention has high anti-tumor activity, and has good inhibition effect on human leukemia cells K562, human promyelocytic acute leukemia cells HL60, gastric adenocarcinoma cells BGC-823 and human cervical cancer Hela cells. Therefore, the compounds can be used as antitumor agents for in-vitro antitumor activity screening and can also be used in medicines for preventing and treating tumors.

title_en: Preparation and application of steroid compounds in ailanthus altissima leaves
abstract_en: The preparation and application of steroid compounds in ailanthus altissima leaves belong to the technical field of medicines, and in particular relate to 4 novel steroid compounds chouchunsteride A-D extracted and separated from ailanthus altissima (Ailanthus altissima (Mill.) Swingle) leaves of ailanthus altissima, which have the same steroid parent nucleus and are obtained through repeated silica gel, ODS column chromatography and HPLC column chromatography separation. And the antitumor activity of the compounds is examined by testing the inhibition effect of the compounds on Hep3B and HepG2 liver cancer cells.

title_en: Miglitol crystal form
abstract_en: The invention provides a miglitol crystal form, and relates to the technical field of crystal form drug molecules. The miglitol crystal form uses Cu-Ka radiation, and an X-ray diffraction spectrogram expressed by 2 theta has characteristic peaks at 15.54 +/-0.2 degrees, 17.60 +/-0.2 degrees, 22.31 +/-0.2 degrees, 22.33 +/-0.2 degrees and 31.18 +/-0.2 degrees; and provides related preparation method and application. The miglitol crystal form of the invention has good stability and fluidity, no moisture absorption and high bioavailability, and is more suitable for the manufacture and long-term storage of pharmaceutical preparations.

title_en: Preparation method of initial amino acid Boc-Pip (Fmoc) -OH
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an initial amino acid Boc-Pip (Fmoc) -OH, which comprises the following steps: (1) Reacting N-benzyl-4-piperidone, ammonium carbonate and trimethylcyano silane in the presence of a solvent to prepare hydantoin; (2) Heating and hydrolyzing the hydantoin prepared in the step (1) to obtain corresponding amino acid; (3) Reacting the amino acid prepared in the step (2) with di-tert-butyl dicarbonic acid in the presence of an acid binding agent and a solvent to obtain an amino acid of which the amino group is protected by tert-butoxycarbonyl; (4) And (3) carrying out hydrogenation reaction on the amino acid with the amino group protected by the tert-butoxycarbonyl group prepared in the step (3) in the presence of a catalyst, and adding N- (9-fluorenylmethoxycarbonyl oxygen) succinimide to react after the system is cooled to obtain the initial amino acid Boc-Pip (Fmoc) -OH. The preparation method is simple to operate, raw materials are easy to obtain and safe, the yield can reach more than 60%, and the purity of the prepared initial amino acid Boc-Pip (Fmoc) -OH can reach more than 98%, so that the preparation method is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Low-volume-shrinkage multi-ring-structure acrylate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocuring, and particularly relates to low-volume shrinkage polycyclic structure acrylate and application thereof. The acrylate has the structure shown as the following formula: the coating has a plurality of annular structures, and can effectively counteract the problems that the photo-curing material is easy to peel and wrinkle caused by volume shrinkage during free radical polymerization reaction, thereby improving the performance of the coating.

title_en: Alcohol with floral scent
abstract_en: The invention relates to compounds of formula (I), said compound, in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or of a mixture thereof, and wherein one R represents a methyl group and the other R is a hydrogen atom, is useful as perfuming ingredient.

title_en: Preparation method and product of trimethylamine catalyst with high selectivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a product of a high-selectivity trimethylamine synthesis catalyst, which comprises the following steps of firstly, synthesizing materials; step two, exchanging, washing and drying; step three, exchanging and drying; step four, kneading, extruding, drying and roasting; step five, performance evaluation, packaging and storage; in the first step, selecting proper proportions of silicon oxide, aluminum oxide, sodium oxide, ammonia, sodium chloride and water, and screening; synthesizing mordenite with corresponding mole ratio of alumina to silica, then exchanging the synthesized mordenite, treating acid solution, exchanging alkali metal and alkaline earth metal, kneading with adhesive in a certain proportion, extruding into strips, finally drying and roasting to obtain the trimethylamine catalyst with high selectivity. The methylamine catalyst prepared by modifying the mordenite obtained by the invention can effectively improve the selectivity of trimethylamine in the methylamine synthesis process, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Supported noble metal catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supported noble metal catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, relating to the technical field of noble metal catalysts, wherein the supported noble metal catalyst comprises a carrier and a noble metal catalyst loaded on the carrier; the carrier comprises organic silicon resin microspheres with alkenyl groups grafted on the surfaces. The supported noble metal catalyst provided by the invention has high catalytic activity under the condition of low dosage, and when the mass concentration of noble metal in a catalytic reaction system is 15ppm, the highest conversion rate of reactants can reach 98%.

title_en: Heteropoly acid (salt) @ Zr-MOFs catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heteropoly acid (salt) @ Zr-MOFs catalyst, which relates to the technical field of catalytic chemistry, and comprises the steps of dissolving an organic ligand and zirconium tetrachloride in N, N-dimethylformamide, adding concentrated hydrochloric acid, a cosolvent and the heteropoly acid (salt) into the N, N-dimethylformamide, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment until solids are dissolved; placing the mixed solution in a supercritical medium environment, heating and pressurizing to enable the system to reach supercritical conditions and continue for 2-10 h, cooling, decompressing and discharging the kettle to obtain a catalyst crude product; the catalyst crude product is washed, centrifugally separated and dried to obtain the heteropolyacid (salt) @ Zr-MOFs catalyst. The esterification reaction of acetic acid and n-butanol catalyzed by the catalyst improves the conversion rate of acetic acid, effectively inhibits the loss of heteropolyacid (salt) and improves the reusability of the catalyst.

title_en: Tetrahydro-beta-carboline derivative and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tetrahydro-beta-carboline derivative and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of electrochemical synthesis, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Performing ring-closure reaction on a benzenesulfonamide derivative serving as a reaction initiator under the condition of electrolysis; 2) Concentrating the system after the reaction in the step 1) to obtain an intermediate; 3) Adding potassium carbonate and ethanol into the intermediate obtained in the step 2) to carry out elimination reaction, and generating the tetrahydro-beta-carboline derivative. The invention adopts an electrochemical method for the first time and prepares the tetrahydro-beta-carboline derivatives under the condition of no catalyst participation. The reaction system has the advantages of no heavy metal residue, good chemical stability, mild reaction conditions, high yield and the like.

title_en: Photoelectric conversion device, electronic device and power module
abstract_en: Disclosed are a photoelectric conversion device, an electronic device, and a power module. The photoelectric conversion device includes a first electrode, a photoelectric conversion layer, and a second electrode in this order. The photoelectric conversion device includes a sealing member on a non-facing surface side of one electrode selected from the first electrode and the second electrode, the non-facing surface side not facing the photoelectric conversion layer. The sealing member includes an insulating layer, a metal layer, and a substrate in this order from one electrode. At the end of the sealing member in the plane direction, the length of the insulating layer in the plane direction is equal to or longer than the length of the metal layer in the plane direction, and the length of the metal layer in the plane direction is longer than the length of the base in the plane direction by 0.1 μm or more.

title_en: Concentrated liquid esterquat compositions
abstract_en: Transparent, stable concentrated liquid compositions are disclosed that comprise from 30 to 90 wt% of an esterquat active and from 10 to 50 wt% of a specific solvent system. The esterquat active agent is a quaternized reaction product of a fatty acyl source having an iodine value of from 40 to 130 reacted with an alkanolamine in a fatty acyl to alkanolamine molar ratio of from 1.0:1 to 2.2:1. The concentrated liquid composition has a VOC content of less than 5%, a bio-renewable carbon index (BCI) of at least 20, and a viscosity of less than 5000cP at 25 ℃. The concentrated liquid composition can be readily diluted in water to form a stable aqueous dispersion.

title_en: Reference ladder and adapter
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to polynucleotides useful in calibration methods for determining the identity and/or quantity of polynucleotides in a sample. In particular, the disclosure relates to polynucleotides comprising calibration sequences for use as reference ladders or reference adaptors. The polynucleotides can be used to calibrate a variety of sequencing methods, including high throughput sequencing methods (e.g., those referred to as next generation sequencing or NGS methods). The present disclosure also relates generally to the use of these polynucleotides in a variety of applications, including, for example, in the calibration of a variety of sequencing methods.

title_en: Preparation method of diaryl monophosphine compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of diaryl monophosphine compound, belonging to the technical field of chemical industry. The method comprises the steps of oxidizing raw materials, carrying out asymmetric arylation reaction in the presence of an organic catalyst, and then carrying out aftertreatment to obtain the target compound. The method of the invention avoids using transition metal catalyst, has high atom economy, is green and efficient, and is beneficial to application and implementation.

title_en: Eggshell catalyst, preparation method and application thereof, and method for preparing cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylic acid diester by selective hydrogenation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalytic hydrogenation, and discloses an eggshell type catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, and a method for preparing cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylic acid diester by selective hydrogenation, wherein the catalyst comprises a carrier, and noble metals and lanthanide metals loaded on the carrier, wherein the content of the noble metals is 0.1-1 wt% based on the total amount of the catalyst, the content of the lanthanide metals is 0.5-10 wt% based on oxides, the content of the carrier is 89-99.4 wt%, and the impregnation depth of the noble metals in the catalyst is 1/3-4/5r, wherein r is the distance from the most accessible outer surface of the catalyst to the center of the catalyst. The eggshell catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of small noble metal consumption and simple preparation process, and can obviously reduce the reaction severity when being used in the reaction for preparing cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylic acid diester through selective hydrogenation.

title_en: Isoxazolo [5,4-b ] pyridine FLT3 inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to an FLT3 inhibitor (I) containing an isoxazolo [5,4-b ] pyridine structure and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, wherein the FLT3 small molecule inhibitor can influence related signal paths to inhibit abnormal proliferation of hematopoietic cells and lymphocytes, thereby generating the effect of resisting acute myeloid leukemia. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the compound and medical application of the compound in treating acute myelogenous leukemia.

title_en: Compounds as UBR cassette domain ligands
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a compound as a UBR box domain ligand. The present specification provides a small molecule compound that binds to a UBR box domain. Furthermore, the present specification provides a composition for inhibiting UBR cassette domain substrate binding, a pharmaceutical composition for treating UBR-related diseases, comprising a ligand compound that binds to a UBR cassette domain, and uses thereof.

title_en: Boron nitride composite carrier copper-loaded catalyst and preparation method and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a copper-loaded catalyst of a boron nitride composite carrier, which comprises a copper species and the boron nitride composite carrier; the boron nitride composite carrier is prepared from boron nitride and a secondary carrier through physical and/or chemical action; the copper species is present in an amount of 1-20wt.% based on the weight of the catalyst, and the boron nitride composite support is present in an amount of 80-99wt.% based on the weight of the catalyst. The boron nitride composite carrier copper-loaded catalyst adopts copper species as an active component, and has the characteristics of mild reaction conditions, excellent catalytic reaction performance, simple preparation process, low cost and the like. When the catalyst is used for heterogeneous hydrogenation reaction of dimethyl oxalate, compared with the existing copper-based catalyst, the catalyst can realize high-yield product distribution control of ethylene glycol or methyl glycolate by regulating the type and/or proportion of the boron nitride composite carrier.

title_en: Preparation method and application of rare earth-based oxide superfine nanowire material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a rare earth-based oxide superfine nanowire material, wherein the chemical element composition of the material is REMoO, and RE is selected from one of rare earth elements; the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1: weighing a compound containing corresponding elements as a raw material; weighing the additive; step 2: adding a solvent, fully stirring, and then adding an additive; step 3: transferring the mixed solution into a three-neck flask, and injecting inert gas; step 4: reacting under the condition of heating and stirring, and controlling the reaction temperature and time to obtain a dispersion liquid; step 5: and collecting the precipitate from the dispersion liquid by a high-speed centrifuge, and washing the product by using a nonpolar solvent and a polar solvent to obtain the rare earth-based oxide superfine nanowire material. The preparation method is convenient, efficient and easy to operate, and the prepared material has good optical properties and can be applied to the fields of flexible materials and photocatalysis.

title_en: Cross-linked viologen polymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic photoelectric functional materials, in particular to a crosslinked viologen polymer and a preparation method thereof. The cross-linked viologen polymer film prepared by cyclic voltammetry has extremely strong color change stability. Meanwhile, the molecular structure of the synthesized crosslinked viologen polymer can be regulated and controlled through reasonable molecular structure design in the preparation process. In addition, the monomer structure and the electrochemical polymerization reaction condition are continuously optimized in the preparation process, and the regulation and control of the polymer structure and the film thickness can be realized. The prepared crosslinked viologen polymer can realize reversible color change under 0-1.2V step voltage, shows higher contrast, has good electrochromic performance and has potential application prospect in the field of electrochromic.

title_en: Method for preparing 5-methylfurfural
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing 5-methylfurfural, which adopts an iodide aqueous solution and organic solvent two-phase reaction system and converts biomass raw materials into 5-methylfurfural through one-step reaction in a high-pressure reaction kettle under the hydrogen atmosphere. The method uses biomass and a platform compound thereof as raw materials, and completes the processes of hydrolysis, dehydration, iodination, hydrogenation and deiodination in one step in a batch reactor without a supported catalyst to prepare the 5-methylfurfural. The method has the advantages of low raw material price, mild experimental conditions, high reaction yield and high selectivity, and provides a new way for preparing 5-methylfurfural.

title_en: Piperazine structure-containing derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a piperazine derivative structure and application thereof. The compound has a structure shown in one of the general formulas (I-III):  The compound has good inhibition effects on bacterial leaf blight bacteria, tobacco bacterial wilt bacteria, cucumber bacterial leaf blight bacteria, konjak bacterial leaf blight bacteria, citrus canker bacteria, grape canker bacteria, tomato canker bacteria, kiwi fruit canker bacteria, apple canker bacteria, cucumber gray mold bacteria, pepper bacterial wilt bacteria, rape sclerotinia bacteria, wheat red mold bacteria, potato late blight bacteria, blueberry root rot bacteria and the like.

title_en: HEMA-free nail polish gel with high hardness, high adhesive force and high wear resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional materials, and discloses a low-cost HEMA-free nail polish gel with high hardness, high adhesive force and high wear resistance and remarkably improved mechanical properties and a preparation method thereof. The nail polish gel provided by the invention comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 40-50% of photo-curing resin, 8-15% of bisphenol A glycerol dimethacrylate, 0.5-3% of vinyl silane coupling agent, 1-5% of fumed silica, 20-30% of reactive diluent, 3-10% of photoinitiator and 8-15% of color paste. When the nail polish is used, the nail polish provided by the invention is coated on nails, and the LED nail polish lamp is used for irradiating the surfaces of the nails for 60-150 seconds to obtain a cured coating. Compared with the existing nail polish gel, the nail polish gel disclosed by the invention has the advantages that under the composition of no HEMA, the obtained coating has excellent mechanical properties such as obviously improved hardness, adhesion, wear resistance and the like.

title_en: Suspension crystallization purification equipment and application thereof in lactide purification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-flux suspension crystallization purification device and application thereof in lactide purification, comprising a crystallization washing tower and a crystal slurry melter, wherein the crystallization washing tower comprises a separation section A, a refining section B and a washing section C, crystals are crystallized and separated out in the separation section and enter the refining section, a washing mother liquor outlet is arranged above the separation section A, washing mother liquor is discharged from the washing mother liquor outlet, the refining section B is provided with a stirring paddle, crystals grow up in the refining section B and enter the washing section C, the crystals are deposited in the washing section C to form a crystal stacking bed layer, the lower end of the washing section is provided with a scraper, the bottom of the washing section is provided with a discharge hole, the discharge hole is connected with the crystal slurry melter, the lower end of the washing section is also provided with a liquid inlet and a distributor, and the liquid inlet is connected with the crystal slurry melter. The invention can be applied to the crystal washing procedure of suspension crystallization and purification of lactide, can obviously improve the lactide crystallization yield and reduce the equipment number and investment.

title_en: Method for preparing furfural and 5-hydroxymethylfurfural from straw
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing furfural and 5-hydroxymethylfurfural from straws, belonging to the technical field of agricultural waste treatment. The invention uses Lewis acid type acid deep eutectic solvent as the liquid phase environment of hydrolysis-condensation reaction, on one hand, lewis acid can be used as hydrogen bond acceptor to provide hydrogen bond points, and is tightly combined with hydrogen bond donor to form ternary Deep Eutectic Solvent (DES) integral, so as to form a strong hydrogen bond system and promote the hydrolysis saccharification process of straw; on the other hand, the catalyst can be used as a catalyst to provide an acidic water absorption environment and promote the dehydration condensation process, replace the traditional strong acid catalyst and prevent equipment from being corroded. The invention uses Lewis acid type neutral deep eutectic solvent as the liquid phase environment of enzymolysis-condensation reaction, the Lewis acid type neutral deep eutectic solvent is used as a cosolvent and a catalyst, and the Lewis acid type neutral deep eutectic solvent does not influence the activity of cellulase.

title_en: Boron-containing organic compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a boron-containing organic compound and application thereof, wherein the boron-containing organic compound is shown as a general formula (I): the boron-containing compound of the application is beneficial to improving the hole transmission performance of the compound by introducing the hole transmission group containing cyclopentyl into the boron-containing compound, and can enhance the resonance performance of molecules, so that when the boron-containing organic compound is applied to an organic light-emitting device, the light-emitting efficiency can be effectively improved, meanwhile, the cyclopentyl can effectively improve the distance between molecules, can inhibit exciton quenching caused by accumulation between molecules, and has the function of reducing the boronWhen the organic compound is applied to a blue light material, the stability and the service life of a device can be effectively improved.

title_en: Thiadiazole quinoxaline derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a thiadiazole quinoxaline derivative, wherein 4, 7-dibromo-2, 1, 3-benzothiadiazole is used as an initial raw material, a proper alkyl chain triisopropylsilyl-ethynyl group is introduced through a coupling reaction to ensure good solubility of the compound and help to control the form of a molecular film, then the diamine compound is constructed to perform a cyclocondensation reaction with triphenylene diketone and benzil with different conjugation properties to prepare asymmetric compounds BPhTQ and BZRTQ which take thiadiazole quinoxaline as a strong receptor and further expand a pi conjugation system, and a strong electron-withdrawing group is introduced into a conjugation skeleton to be beneficial to reducing the LUMO energy level. The asymmetric conjugated skeleton can adjust the front edge orbital energy level, the accumulation mode and the solution processability of molecules, and the whole synthetic route is simple, efficient and high in yield; the used raw materials are cheap, and the synthesis cost is low; the synthesis method has universality. These target compounds are expected to have practical applications in the field of n-type organic semiconductor materials.

title_en: Thiophene conductive polymer bifunctional electrode material based on 9-phenyl-carbazole, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a conductive polymer with 9-phenyl-carbazole as a central core and 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene as a peripheral polymeric group, the structure of which is shown in a formula (I), and a preparation method thereof. The conductive polymer can be used in the field of electrochromic supercapacitors. The surface of the polymer film prepared by the invention has a loose structure, which is beneficial to the intercalation and deintercalation of ions, thereby effectively improving the charge storage capacity of the polymer film, showing good charge and discharge performance and simultaneously showing good electrochromic property, so that the material realizes energy storage and simultaneously changes along with the color of the film, and is a difunctional conductive polymer material with good application prospect and electrochromic and energy storage functions.

title_en: Method for improving penetration of vitamin b3 compounds into the skin
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for improving the penetration of vitamin B3 compounds into the skin. The method involves a skin care regimen in which at least two skin care compositions are used sequentially to treat a targeted portion of skin for which a skin health or appearance benefit is desired. The first composition applied to the skin is a low pH skin care composition containing a first concentration of a vitamin B3 compound. The second skin care composition applied to the skin is a conventional skin care composition containing a higher concentration of vitamin B3 compound than the first composition. This regimen results in an unexpectedly high flux of vitamin B3 into the skin when administered in the proper sequence.

title_en: Preparation method of ionic liquid for separating dimethyl carbonate from methanol
abstract_en: A preparation method of ionic liquid for separating dimethyl carbonate from methanol is characterized in that anion groups of synthesized 1-hexyl-3-methylimidazolium bis (trifluoromethanesulfonyl) imide ionic liquid ions have two acyl groups and have strong electronegativity. The preparation process is as follows: firstly, N-methylimidazole reacts with N-bromo-N-hexane under constant-temperature ultrasonic reflux to obtain bromo-1-hexyl-3-methylimidazole, and then the bromo-1-hexyl-3-methylimidazole reacts with bis (trifluoromethanesulfonyl) imide lithium at normal temperature and is purified to obtain ionic liquid, the acting force of the ionic liquid and methanol is greater than that of dimethyl carbonate, more methanol is concentrated around the ionic liquid to form a solvation effect, so that the dimethyl carbonate is far away from the ionic liquid to form a salting-out effect, the dimethyl carbonate is volatilized to a vapor phase, the concentration of the dimethyl carbonate in the vapor phase is increased, and the selective separation of a dimethyl carbonate-methanol azeotropic system is realized. The method is simple, green and environment-friendly, and can be recycled.

title_en: Preservative-free shower gel and preparation method thereof
