abstract_en: The application discloses preservative-free bath foam and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preservative-free bath foam comprises the following components: the composition A is a compound of potassium laurate, potassium myristate, potassium palmitate, glycerin and water, wherein the composition B is a compound of sodium laureth-6 carboxylate and water, the composition C is a compound of lauryl hydroxysulfobetaine, water and sodium chloride, and the composition D is a compound of lauramidopropyl betaine, water and sodium chloride; a preparation method of preservative-free shower gel comprises the following steps: and uniformly mixing the water, the composition A, the composition B, the composition C, the composition D and the humectant to obtain the preservative-free shower gel. The application has good antiseptic effect without adding antiseptic.

title_en: Preparation method and application of double-MOFs functional composite material for methane preparation through gas adsorption and degradation of VOCs (volatile organic compounds)
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-MOFs functional composite material for methane preparation through VOCs gas adsorption degradation, wherein a double-MOFs heterostructure can be used as a height-adjustable platform through adjusting the molar ratio of metal particles, and the pore structure is adjusted according to adsorbed target gas, so that selective adsorption is realized. Second NH  2  UIO-66 is used as an adsorption degradation material with low cost, no toxicity and high catalytic activity, and can effectively ensure the degradation efficiency of VOCs gas molecules.

title_en: Hair loss preventing and caring composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-hair-loss hair care composition which comprises, by weight, 0.5% -0.75% of adenosine, 1% -10% of polyol, 0.5% -3% of pentaerythritol stearate, 30% -50% of a surfactant, 0.3% -1% of a cationic conditioner, 0.05% -0.15% of a chelating agent, 0.2% -1% of a softener, 2% -4% of an auxiliary agent and the balance of water, wherein the surfactant is one or more of an amino acid surfactant and an alkyl glycoside surfactant. The composition has strong anti-drop effect, high viscosity and good stability.

title_en: Dehydrogenation catalyst, preparation method and application thereof, and method for preparing alkenyl arene by dehydrogenating alkyl arene
abstract_en: The invention provides a dehydrogenation catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof and a method for preparing alkenyl arene by alkyl arene dehydrogenation, wherein the catalyst comprises the following active components, by weight, of (a) 63-81% of Fe  2 O 3 , (b) 7-14% of K  2  O, (c) 6-13% of CeO  2 , (d) 0.1-4% of WO  3 , (e) 0.1-5% of alkaline earth metal oxide, (f) 0.05-6% of at least one metal oxide selected from VB group, and (g) 0.01-2% of at least one metal oxide selected from IIIB group except Ce, wherein the weight ratio of the VB group metal oxide to the IIIB group metal oxide except Ce is 0.1-30. The catalyst provided by the invention is used for dehydrogenation under the condition of low water ratio, such as ethylbenzene dehydrogenation, and has good technical effects in promoting catalytic activity and single-receiving.

title_en: Preparation method of axial chiral carbamate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of axial chiral carbamate, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of dispersing a cyclic diaryl high-valence iodine compound, amine, a copper-based catalyst, a ligand and alkali in an organic solvent, and introducing carbon dioxide for reaction to obtain the axial chiral carbamate. The preparation method of the axial chiral carbamate has the advantages of cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, mild reaction conditions, very wide substrate applicability, simple operation, easy industrial production and the like, synthesizes a series of brand-new axial chiral carbamate compounds, and has wide application prospects in the fields of organic synthesis, medicine, health and the like.

title_en: Aromatic amide compound, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aromatic amide compound, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and belongs to the field of chemical medicines. The invention provides an aromatic amide compound with a structure shown in a general formula (I) and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, which can be used as a Bruton Tyrosine Kinase (BTK) inhibitor and can be used for preventing and/or treating cancers based on BTK inhibition.

title_en: Organic compound and application thereof in organic electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic compound and its use in organic electronic devices. The organic compound is selected from a large condensed ring core with a star-shaped structure, so that the overlapping of molecular orbitals can be improved; the material is connected with a terminal electron-withdrawing group A, so that the material has good charge mobility and proper energy level, and can be used as a small molecule acceptor material to be applied to an organic solar cell device, thereby improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the device.

title_en: Method for preparing low-carbon olefin and co-producing high-purity hydrogen by coupling waste plastics with alkali lignin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing low-carbon olefin and co-producing high-purity hydrogen by coupling waste plastics with alkali lignin. The method comprises the following steps: pyrolysis gasification: mixing the pretreated waste plastic with alkali lignin, and performing pyrolysis gasification to generate a gas-phase product, a liquid-phase product and a solid-phase product; adding a catalyst into the liquid phase product to perform catalytic conversion to obtain an olefin product; the gas phase product is subjected to chemical chain reforming with an oxygen carrier and then reacts with water vapor to obtain hydrogen; calcining the reacted oxygen carrier in air atmosphere, and then entering a step S3 for cyclic reaction. According to the invention, the alkali lignin and the waste plastics are mixed for pyrolysis gasification, and the pyrolysis gasification of the alkali metals such as Na, al and the like in the alkali lignin is utilized to generate a catalytic synergistic effect on the waste plastics, so that the recovery yield of olefins in the waste plastics is improved, the added value of products is improved, the synergistic resource utilization of wastes is realized, and the efficient, clean and high-value utilization of the waste plastics is realized.

title_en: Method for producing anion exchange resin and method for producing electrolyte membrane
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing an anion exchange resin capable of producing an electrolyte membrane excellent in mechanical properties (strength). In the preparation of an anion exchange resin in which a hydrophobic group-forming monomer is reacted with a hydrophilic group-forming monomer in the presence of bis (1, 5-cyclooctadiene) nickel (0) as a catalyst, 2' -bipyridine as a co-ligand, a bromide or iodide as a co-catalyst, and a reducing agent, the number of moles of bis (1, 5-cyclooctadiene) nickel (0) is 0.3 to 1.8 times the total number of moles of the hydrophobic group-forming monomer and the hydrophilic group-forming monomer.

title_en: Cyclopropyl-containing nuclear export protein inhibitors
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, provides a cyclopropyl-containing nuclear export protein inhibitor and a preparation method thereof, and relates to application of the cyclopropyl-containing nuclear export protein inhibitor in preparation of a medicine for treating tumors.

title_en: Crown ether regulated non-core organic amine salt material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crown ether regulated non-heart organic amine salt material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the crystal is betaine hydrochloride, and the molecular formula is C  5  H  12  NO  2  Cl, which is a monoclinic system, is crystallized in a polar space group Cm The molecules are mutually connected in the a-axis direction through O-H … Cl hydrogen bonds formed between betaine cations and inorganic chloride ions, so that the compound has polarity and good second-order nonlinear optical characteristics; the preparation method is simple to operate, short in time and low in cost, and the non-heart crystal material with nonlinear optics can be induced by only adding crown ether, and has good stability at room temperature. Has potential application value in the fields of photoelectric switches, laser frequency doubling conversion, biological imaging and high-speed photographic components.

title_en: Organic small-molecule optical diagnosis and treatment reagent, nano-particles, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small organic molecule optical diagnosis and treatment reagent, wherein the small organic molecule is designed and synthesized through an atom replacement strategy, the chemical general formula of the small organic molecule is T-R, the small organic molecule comprises T-N, T-C or T-Si, nano particles of the small organic molecule are prepared through a nano coprecipitation method, the emission wavelength of the nano particles is in an NIR-II range, active oxygen and high heat can be simultaneously generated, excellent photodynamic performance and photothermal performance are displayed, NIR-II fluorescence imaging can be carried out, and the small organic molecule optical diagnosis and treatment reagent is applied to PDT/PTT combined treatment of deeper tumors, so that the treatment effect is obviously improved, and the small organic molecule optical diagnosis and treatment reagent has a better clinical application prospect.

title_en: Method for synthesizing methylcyclohexanediamine by hydrogenating diaminotoluene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing methylcyclohexanediamine (HTDA) by continuously hydrogenating diaminotoluene (TDA). The invention can realize high conversion rate of diaminotoluene hydrogenation, high selectivity and obtain methylcyclohexanediamine (HTDA), and the 2, 6-diamino-1-methyl-cyclohexane and the stereoisomer trans, trans-2, 4-diamino-1-methyl-cyclohexane in the product have high content, and the invention has the advantages of long gel time (operation time), high glass transition temperature and the like when being applied to the epoxy curing field. The invention is easy to implement and has industrial application prospect.

title_en: Preparation process of 3-isobutyl glutarimide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of 3-isobutyl glutarimide, which comprises the following specific operation steps: putting glutaric acid and urea into a 2000ml reaction bottle, heating and stirring, carrying out heat preservation reaction for 5.5-6.5 hours, cooling after the reaction is finished, adding toluene, adding water, cooling to 0 ℃, carrying out suction filtration, washing with a proper amount of water to obtain an imine wet product, putting the imine wet product into a 1000ml reaction bottle, adding methanol, heating to 50 ℃ to fully dissolve, filtering while hot, cooling filtrate to 0 ℃ for crystallization, carrying out suction filtration, and drying to obtain a product; the invention provides a preparation process of 3-isobutyl glutarimide, wherein the yield of an obtained imine wet product in a middle routine is 96 percent, the content of the obtained imine wet product is more than 98 percent, the yield of a final product is 90.7 percent, and the content of the obtained imine wet product is more than or equal to 99 percent.

title_en: Polymerizable photosensitive monomer, photosensitive polymer based on polymerizable photosensitive monomer and biomaterial surface modification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polymerizable photosensitive monomer, a photosensitive polymer based on the polymerizable photosensitive monomer and a biological material surface modification method. The invention synthesizes a polymerizable photosensitive monomer, and polymerizes the polymerizable photosensitive monomer, hydrophilic adhesive monomer and active monomer to obtain a photosensitive polymer with a new structure, and the photosensitive polymer is used as a bridge between the surface of a biological material and bioactive molecules, so that the bioactive molecules can be covalently loaded on the surface of the material, and the biocompatibility of the material is enhanced.

title_en: Arylamine compound and organic electroluminescent device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, in particular to an arylamine compound and an organic electroluminescent device thereof. The arylamine compound provided by the invention has the advantages of high refractive index, high glass transition temperature, good thermal stability and chemical stability, can be used as a covering layer material applied to an OLED device, can effectively improve the light transmittance of the device, can resist high temperature, and can effectively isolate water vapor, oxygen and corrosive gas, thereby delaying the aging of the device, further improving the luminous efficiency of the device and prolonging the service life of the device.

title_en: Composite plant component with stabilizing, brightening and maintenance functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present application is a divisional application of 202110238200.0. The invention discloses a composite plant component with functions of calming, brightening, maintaining and repairing and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of efficacy skin care products. The invention comprises raw materials and auxiliary materials; the raw material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 69.43% -72.76% of water, 6% of butanediol, 0.03% of EDTA disodium, 1.5% of inositol, 4% of glycerol, 3% of tremella fruit body extract solution, 0.1% of xanthan gum, 0.3% of hydrogenated lecithin, 0.2% of carbomer, 0.3% of p-hydroxyacetophenone, 1.5% of polyglycerol-10 oleate, 0.3% of polyglycerol-2 oleate, 3.5% of neopentyl glycol diheptanoate and 3% of squalane; the auxiliary material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0.5 to 3.5 percent of tricholoma matsutake extract solution, 0.5 to 1.5 percent of white truffle extract solution, 0.5 to 1.5 percent of inonotus obliquus extract solution, 0.1 to 0.9 percent of ergothioneine solution, 0.5 percent of 1, 2-hexanediol, 0.03 percent of essence and 0.03 percent of octanoyl hydroxamic acid. The preparation method of the composite plant component has the advantages that the pollution-resistant protective active composition can prevent urban pollutants from damaging skin, calm skin, maintain and repair skin, and lighten skin color through quadruple protection.

title_en: Seco-ambergris acetals
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to compounds of formula (I) and compositions comprising or consisting of one, two, three or more compounds of formula (I). The invention also relates to a process for preparing a compound or composition of formula (I) as defined herein, the use of a compound of formula (I) as defined herein as a fragrance material, the use of a composition as defined herein as a mixture of fragrance materials, and the use of a compound or composition of formula (I) as defined herein for imparting, modifying and/or enhancing one or more olfactory characteristics selected from the group consisting of ambergris, costustoot and animal breath. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a fragrance composition and a fragrance product as defined herein, a method for producing a fragrance product, a method for fragrancing a product and a method for fragrancing hair, skin, textile fibres, surfaces and/or ambient air.

title_en: Process for the preparation of phosphorus-containing flame retardants and their use in polymer compositions
abstract_en: The present application provides a process for the preparation of phosphorus-containing flame retardants and their use in polymer compositions. Phosphorus-containing flame retardants are prepared by reacting a mixture comprising a metal or suitable metal compound and a stoichiometric excess of unsubstituted or alkyl-or aryl-substituted phosphonic acid or pyrophosphonic acid relative to the metal or suitable metal compound at a reaction temperature at which the phosphonic acid or pyrophosphonic acid is in a molten state. The chemical composition of the resulting flame retardant product results in excellent flame retardancy and exhibits high thermal stability. The flame retardant of the present disclosure is suitable for use in, for example, polymeric compositions, particularly thermoplastics that are processed at high temperatures over a wide range of applications.

title_en: Preparation method of mixed tridecyl aldehyde
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of mixed tridecyl aldehyde. The invention provides a preparation method of mixed tridecyl aldehyde, which comprises the following steps: under the condition of carbon monoxide and hydrogen, rhodium catalyst, organic phosphine oxide ligand, mixed dodecene and solvent are mixed and reacted to obtain mixed tridecyl aldehyde. According to the invention, the target product can be efficiently and selectively synthesized by regulating and controlling the catalyst by the organic phosphine oxide ligand, the conversion rate of the substrate and the yield of the product are both high, and the method has good industrial prospect. Meanwhile, compared with the high-pressure cobalt method, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of milder condition, easiness in operation and capability of avoiding the problems of catalyst deactivation and difficult circulation.

title_en: Method for synthesizing plant biomass potassium xanthate without residual liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing plant biomass potassium xanthate without residual liquid, which takes crop straw powder as a raw material, adds potassium hydroxide solution, and stands after stirring uniformly to obtain intermediate materials; adding liquid CS to the intermediate material  2  And stirring uniformly and reacting to obtain the plant biomass potassium xanthate. The invention provides a method for synthesizing plant biomass potassium xanthate without residual liquid, which is simple in process and small in environmental pollution, and the obtained plant biomass potassium xanthate is free from adding magnesium sulfate, has higher effective components and can adsorb heavy metal ions more efficiently under the condition of properly controlling the water quantity of dissolved potassium hydroxide.

title_en: Preparation method of indolyl tetrahydroisoquinoline derivative
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of indolyl tetrahydroisoquinoline derivatives, which comprises the following steps: under the condition of 20W white light, under the action of a photosensitizer and an additive, the tetrahydroisoquinoline and the indole are subjected to cross dehydrogenation coupling reaction in water at room temperature, and after the reaction is carried out for 10 hours, the indolyl tetrahydroisoquinoline derivative is obtained. According to the invention, tetrahydroisoquinoline and indole compounds are used as raw materials, 1mol% of water-dispersible porphyrin is used as a photosensitizer, 2,4, 6-trimethoxybenzoic acid is used as an additive, the reaction is carried out in a water phase for 10 hours at room temperature under the action of 20W white light, and finally the indolyl tetrahydroisoquinoline derivatives are obtained in a yield of 70-89%, the reaction condition is mild, the product yield is moderate to good, and the substrate range is wide; the water-dispersible polyporphyrin-based photosensitizer used exhibits excellent photocatalytic activity,inducible C (sp)  3  ) The construction of the-C (sp) bond and the repeated recycling can be realized, thereby providing a green and sustainable way for the photocatalytic reaction in the water phase.

title_en: Superoxide anion free radical chemiluminescent probe, preparation method thereof and application thereof in early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses a superoxide anion free radical chemiluminescent probe, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, wherein the structural formula is shown as formula (I). The chemiluminescent probe of the invention can overcome the defects of short wavelength, brain, low sensitivity and the like of the reported probe, and is O  2  The preparation of chemiluminescent probes provides a concept. Realizing the treatment of the O in the brain in the AD development and treatment process  2   .‑  Real-time monitoring of changes, it can be clarified that O  2   .‑  The possibility of being used as an AD biomarker has important significance for diagnosis and treatment of AD.

title_en: Carbon-loaded Co-Mo2Preparation method of C heterojunction catalyst and application of C heterojunction catalyst in catalyzing furfural conversion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon-supported Co-Mo  2  C heterojunction catalyst and application of the catalyst in catalyzing furfural conversion. The method utilizes strong alkali to modify a protein-metal ion precursor, and the carbon-loaded Co-Mo  2  C heterojunction catalyst is obtained by calcining under inert atmosphere. The preparation strategy can regulate and control the formation of different phases of molybdenum carbide, strong alkali in the precursor can induce the formation of Mo  2  C phases, and the precursor forms MoC phases without alkali. The carbon-supported Co-Mo  2  C heterojunction catalyst has the characteristics of large specific surface area and good hydrogenolysis capability, can specifically adsorb furfural and intermediates thereof, and can realize high-efficiency conversion of furfural. The invention has the advantages of low cost of raw materials, simple preparation method, low production cost and good cycle performance, and has mild catalytic conditions and easy popularization and application.

title_en: Method for synthesizing 6-thiopurine derivative by copper-catalyzed three-component coupling reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a 6-thiopurine derivative by copper-catalyzed three-component coupling reaction, which takes a 6-chloropurine compound, sodium sulfide and an iodo compound as raw materials, takes polyethylene glycol as a reaction medium under the alkali-free system, and takes three-component coupling reaction forming two C-S bonds under the action of a copper catalyst, so that the 6-thiopurine derivative is efficiently prepared by a one-pot method. The invention omits the pre-synthesis step of 6-mercaptopurine, and has high economy; the odorless inorganic salt sodium sulfide is used as a sulfur source, so that the use of malodorous odor mercaptan is avoided, no special requirement is made on the environment, the operation is simple, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale production; polyethylene glycol is used as a reaction medium, so that the use of volatile organic solvents is avoided, and the environment is protected; no alkaline additive is needed, and the reaction condition is mild; the used copper catalyst is low in toxicity, low in cost, easy to obtain and good in stability; has good substrate applicability, and is applicable to 6-chloropurine and iodo compounds containing different substituents.

title_en: New use of tetrapeptide derivatives for preparing composition for skin repair and tightening
abstract_en: The present invention provides a use of a tetrapeptide derivative or salt thereof in the preparation of a composition for skin repair tightening comprising one or more of increasing fibroblast activity, promoting fibroblast proliferation, repairing skin barrier, promoting collagen production, increasing skin elasticity or increasing skin firmness. The tetrapeptide derivative has the sequence of NA-Pro-Lys-Glu-Lys-OH, can improve the activity of fibroblasts, promote the proliferation of the fibroblasts and promote the generation of collagen, thereby repairing skin barrier, increasing skin elasticity, improving skin firmness, preventing and even treating skin relaxation, treating, preventing or repairing skin aging or photoaging, has good skin repairing tightening effect, and can be applied to products with skin repairing tightening.

title_en: Method for preparing fluorine-containing alkyne by dehydrohalogenating saturated halogenated hydrocarbon
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing a fluorine-containing alkyne by dehydrohalogenating saturated halogenated hydrocarbon, which takes fluoroolefin and halogen as initial raw materials, and obtains the fluorine-containing alkyne through gas phase addition reaction and dehydrohalogenation reaction in two steps.

title_en: Process for preparing high-purity dimethyl carbonate by transesterification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for preparing high-purity dimethyl carbonate by using a transesterification method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Adding propylene carbonate and anhydrous methanol into a reaction kettle with the hydrotalcite solid base catalyst, then filling nitrogen into the reaction kettle, sealing and heating for reaction, and discharging a reaction liquid after the completion of the reaction. (2) And (3) rectifying the reaction liquid in a rectifying device under normal pressure to obtain crude dimethyl carbonate liquid, and then sequentially carrying out cooling crystallization, heating sweating, melting and ultrafiltration membrane separation procedures on the crude dimethyl carbonate liquid to obtain medical grade dimethyl carbonate. The process of the invention not only effectively improves the reaction activity of the hydrotalcite-like solid base catalyst through the modified hydrotalcite, but also improves the conversion rate of raw materials; and medical grade high purity dimethyl carbonate is prepared by melt crystallization technology.

title_en: Gold-based catalyst and application thereof in preparation of dimethyl furandicarboxylate reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold-based catalyst and application thereof in preparation of dimethyl furandicarboxylate, and belongs to the technical field of catalyst preparation and application. Firstly, gold is loaded on a titanium dioxide carrier, and then the gold is modified by a modifier to obtain Au/TiO with the surface covered with the modifier  2  The catalyst, and further improves the catalytic performance of the gold-based catalyst; the conversion rate of the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural in the process of preparing the dimethyl furandicarboxylate by catalyzing the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural by the gold-based catalyst is 82%, and the selectivity of the dimethyl furandicarboxylate is 85%; in the reaction of preparing dimethyl furandicarboxylate by catalyzing furan dicarboxaldehyde, the conversion rate of furan dicarboxaldehyde can reach 100 percent, and the conversion rate of furan dicarboxaldehyde can reach 100 percentThe selectivity of the dimethyl formate can reach 95 percent, and the method can be applied to actual industrial production.

title_en: Synthesis process for preparing dodecanediamine by hydro-ammonification of dodecanediol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fine chemical engineering, and relates to a synthesis process for preparing dodecanediamine by hydro-ammonification of dodecanediol. The reaction process includes mixing dodecanol and solvent in certain proportion, mixing the dodecanol solution with liquid ammonia in certain proportion, injecting the mixture into fixed bed reactor with nickel catalyst loaded with molecular sieve via plunger pump in certain flow rate, hydroammonifying reaction under certain technological condition, and final separating the product in gas-liquid separator to obtain dodecanol. The novel preparation method of the catalyst by using the macroporous molecular sieve as the carrier utilizes ammonia to activate the catalyst, which is beneficial to improving the reaction performance.

title_en: Ethylenediamine rectification dehydration system and rectification dehydration process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ethylenediamine rectifying and dewatering system and a rectifying and dewatering process, wherein the process comprises an atmospheric rectifying tower and a vacuum rectifying tower, the atmospheric rectifying and dewatering is carried out, an ethylenediamine and water mixture is added into the atmospheric rectifying tower, and the materials are fed from the middle upper part of the rectifying tower; controlling the temperature of the tower top to be 95-99.5 ℃ and the temperature of the tower bottom to be 117-127 ℃; the vacuum rectification dehydration is carried out, an azeotrope of ethylenediamine and water at the bottom of the atmospheric rectification tower enters a vacuum rectification tower, and is fed from the middle upper part of the rectification tower, the pressure of the tower is controlled to be-0.05 mpa to-0.1 mpa, the temperature of the tower top is controlled to be 55 to 65 ℃, and the temperature of the tower bottom is controlled to be 80 to 90 ℃; wherein, control to the inside reaction temperature of reaction tower cauldron is realized through the cooperation work between the first control by temperature change auxiliary mechanism of setting and the second control by temperature change auxiliary mechanism.

title_en: Polymorphism luminous phasmid type liquid crystal element, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymorphism luminescent phasmid type liquid crystal element, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of luminescent liquid crystal materials. The polymorphism luminescent phasmid type liquid crystal element molecule synthesized by the invention has a rigid structure of diphenyl cyanoethylene-diphenyl ethynyl benzene-diphenyl cyanoethylene and branch units at two ends. Thus, the molecule of the invention has the typical structural characteristics of D-A-DD-A-D and has stronger intramolecular charge transfer effect in solution. After the molecule is dissolved in a good solvent, the fluorescence quantum yield in the solution is 89.4%, and a hexagonal columnar liquid crystal phase can be formed in a self-body state, and the fluorescence quantum yield of the liquid crystal phase is 45.2%. The invention realizes the polymorphic high-efficiency luminescence of the same molecule, provides a new thought for the design and synthesis of polymorphic luminescent molecules, and fills the gap between ACQ molecules and AIE molecules.

title_en: Fullerene pyrrolidine derivative, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fullerene pyrrolidine derivative and a preparation method thereof, wherein 3, 4-bis (5' -bromopentyloxy) benzaldehyde (A) or 3-hydroxy-4-bromopentyloxy benzaldehyde (B) is synthesized by dihydroxybenzaldehyde; and then the fullerene pyrrolidine is further prepared. The obtained fullerene pyrrolidine derivative can be used as a catalyst carrier to load a Cu nanoparticle catalyst and is used for catalyzing benzyl alcohol oxidation; the catalyst has high catalytic efficiency and good selectivity, the yield of the catalyst can be maintained to be above 93% after the catalyst is recycled for 5 times, and the catalytic activity is relatively stable.

title_en: Method for synthesizing tetrapyridyl cyclobutane
abstract_en: A method of synthesizing a plurality of tetrapyridyl cyclobutanes, the method involving the synthesis of 1,2,3,4- (4-pyridyl) cyclobutane, 1,2,3,4- (3-pyridyl) cyclobutane, 1,2,3,4- (2-pyridyl) cyclobutane. The synthetic method of the application takes bipyridyl ethylene (such as 1, 2-di (4-pyridyl) ethylene, 1, 2-di (3-pyridyl) ethylene, 1, 2-di (2-pyridyl) ethylene) as a raw material, and obtains corresponding tetrapyridyl cyclobutane (such as 1,2,3,4- (4-pyridyl) cyclobutane, 1,2,3,4- (3-pyridyl) cyclobutane or 1,2,3,4- (2-pyridyl) cyclobutane) after light irradiation, freezing solution after 1, 2-di (3-pyridyl) ethylene or 1, 2-di (2-pyridyl) ethylene solution is frozen, separation and purification. The method does not need to use organic or metal eutectic molecules, does not need to separate in a later period, does not need to use other organic matters except ethanol, and is simple to operate, green and pollution-free.

title_en: Preparation method of 3-acetamido-5-acetylfuran
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of 3-acetamido-5-acetyl furan. The method comprises the following steps: s1, synthesizing melamine salt ionic liquid, wherein the synthesized melamine salt ionic liquid comprises melamine borate ionic liquid, melamine hydrochloride ionic liquid and melamine sulfate ionic liquid; s2, catalyzing N-acetamido glucose by using melamine salt ionic liquid prepared in S1 as a catalyst, reacting for 5-120min at 160-200 ℃ by using a pressure-resistant pipe as a reactor in the presence of a cocatalyst and a proper amount of solvent, and converting the N-acetamido glucose into 3-acetamido-5-acetylfuran. The invention adopts the melamine salt ionic liquid catalyst which is simple and convenient to synthesize, low in cost and easy to obtain raw materials and can be reused, and efficiently catalyzes the chitin monomer N-acetamido glucose to be the nitrogen-containing platform compound 3A5AF.

title_en: Cyano-substituted aryl or heteroaryl derivative and organic electroluminescent element comprising same
abstract_en: Provided is a cyano-substituted aryl or heteroaryl derivative which effectively absorbs a high-energy external light source in the UV region to minimize damage to various organic matters inside an organic electroluminescent element, thereby contributing to substantially improving the life of the organic electroluminescent element. The organic electroluminescent element of the present invention comprises: a first electrode; a second electrode; more than one organic layer arranged between the first electrode and the second electrode; and a cover layer, wherein the organic layer or cover layer comprises a cyano-substituted aryl or heteroaryl derivative represented by chemical formula 1 of the present invention.

title_en: Heteropoly compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A heteropoly compound, its preparation method and application are provided. There is provided a heteropoly compound having the following composition: x (Mo)  a  V  b  P  c  Ag  d  X  e  Y  f  Z  g  O  h  ) /yM; the heteropoly compound is prepared by a process comprising the steps of: (1) Mixing a compound comprising Mo, V, P, ag, X, Y, Z to obtain a mixture; (2) subjecting the mixture to microwave reaction for 0.1-5.0h; (3) adding a heat conducting agent and then forming;(4) And roasting the molded sample in steps to obtain a final catalyst finished product, wherein the step of roasting comprises the following steps of: the first step: roasting at 150-300 deg.c in oxygen-containing gas atmosphere with oxygen content of 5-30 vol%; and a second step of: roasting at 300-440 ℃ and in an oxygen-containing gas atmosphere, wherein the volume percentage of oxygen is higher than that of the first step.

title_en: Rose eye shadow and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of eye shadow preparation, and discloses a rose eye shadow which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 46-51% of polydimethylsiloxane, 20-26% of synthetic fluorophlogopite, 6-11% of calcium aluminum borosilicate, 6-10% of silica, 2-6% of magnesium stearate, 77891 2-5% of CI, 2-4% of polydimethylsiloxane cross-linked polymer, 0.5-1.1% of triethoxy octyl silane, 0.1-0.26% of phenoxyethanol, 0.1-0.22% of polymethyl siloxane, 0.03-0.07% of tin oxide and 0.01-0.03% of ethylhexyl glycerol. By preparing the polydimethylsiloxane and the polydimethylsiloxane into the nano liposome, under the action of the polydimethylsiloxane crosslinked polymer and the synthetic fluorophlogopite, the nano liposome not only can carry the polydimethylsiloxane and the polydimethylsiloxane to quickly and efficiently permeate into the dermis layer to play a role, but also has good effects of moistening and preserving moisture, resisting oxidation, improving edema and preventing pigmentation on the skin of eyes.

title_en: Black tea fermentation product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of A61K, and particularly relates to a black tea fermentation product and application thereof; black tea fermentation product, the preparation raw materials include: fermenting substrate, zymophyte and polyalcohol; the flavonoid substances, the polyphenol substances, the organic acid and the like contained in the fermented black tea fermentation product can be more easily loaded in the double-helix structure, meanwhile, because of the existence of carbomer sodium, strong interaction is formed, the slow release effect of the black tea fermentation product is ensured, and when the black tea fermentation product is used in a mask, active ingredients can be in a slow absorption state in the use process, so that the absorption of the active ingredients on the skin surface is promoted.

title_en: Embedded Ni-based nano catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an embedded Ni-based nano catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the embedded Ni-based nano catalyst takes layered nano carbon as a carrier, and Ni is embedded on the surface and inside of the layered nano carbon as an active component; the thickness of the lamellar nano carbon is 60-120 nm, and the average particle size of the active component Ni is 3-15 nm. The catalyst can be used for realizing the upgrading of the aqueous solution of catalytic ethanol into higher alcohol at a lower temperature by improving the dispersibility and structural stability of active metal in the catalyst, the ethanol conversion rate is not lower than 32.4 percent, the higher alcohol yield is not lower than 29.8 percent in the reaction of synthesizing C4+ alcohol by catalytic ethanol, the catalyst is easy to separate, the embedded Ni-based nano catalyst is recycled for 8 times, the catalytic efficiency can be kept above 99 percent, and the catalyst has excellent cycle stability.

title_en: Circulation solvent for preparing MDI by phosgenation and purification method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating solvent for preparing MDI by phosgenation and a purification method thereof, which can improve the quality of products and reduce the color number of the products by controlling the mass content of halogenated hydrocarbon substances in the circulating solvent. The partition tower is combined with multi-effect rectification, so that the high-efficiency separation of halogenated hydrocarbon substances and solvents can be realized, the product quality is greatly improved, and the product can be directly recycled. The method combines the degassing and desolventizing systems in the refining process of the crude isocyanate, saves a solvent purifying unit, realizes complete coupling of energy, has simple and reliable process, and can greatly reduce investment and operation cost.

title_en: Maytansine derivative and biosynthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maytansine derivative, a biosynthesis method and application thereof. The invention discovers SAM-dependent methyltransferase genes pba295, pba296, pba304 and nan291 from nocardia EGI80425 and metagenome, and can realize the efficient synthesis of maytansine derivative 3-O-carbamoylmaytansinol by coexpression with carbamoyltransferase asc21b, thereby effectively solving the problem that endogenous N-methyltransferase Asm10 cannot recognize and catalyze N-desmethyl-3-O-carbamoylmaytansinol and cannot prepare 3-O-carbamoylmaytansinol. The 3-O-carbamoylmaytansinol provided by the invention has obvious cytotoxicity to human breast cancer cells (MDA-MB-231), human cervical cancer cells (HeLa) and human colon cancer cells (HCT 116), so that the 3-O-carbamoylmaytansinol can replace AP-3 to become a novel maytansinoid medicine raw material.

title_en: Synthesis and application of modified organosilicon surfactant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surfactant preparation, in particular to synthesis and application of an organosilicon surfactant. The organic silicon surfactant is prepared by the addition reaction between a silicon-hydrogen bond of low-molecular double-end hydrogen-containing silicone oil and a double bond of epoxy end-capped acrylic ester and allyl polyether; the organic silicon surfactant is further applied to water-based ink, and the technical problems of printing errors or ink accumulation at the nozzle in the using process of the water-based ink in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Method for synthesizing acrylic acid fluorine-containing ester by catalyzing boron-functionalized mesoporous carbon-based solid acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing fluorine-containing acrylate by catalyzing boron-functionalized mesoporous carbon-based solid acid; under the condition that reactants are acrylic acid/methacrylic acid and fluorine-containing alcohol, and a proper amount of polymerization inhibitor and dehydrating agent are introduced, the boron-functionalized mesoporous carbon-based solid acid is used as a catalyst, so that the target product of the fluorine-containing acrylate can be obtained with high selectivity and high conversion rate, and meanwhile, the use of a large amount of concentrated sulfuric acid is avoided, the optimization of the production process of the fluorine-containing acrylate is facilitated, and the production capacity is enlarged.

title_en: Ruthenium-based catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing amino acid by catalyzing reductive amination of carbonyl acid
abstract_en: The application discloses a ruthenium-based catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing amino acid by catalyzing reductive amination of carbonyl acid, wherein the ruthenium-based catalyst comprises a carrier, and metal ruthenium and alkaline earth metal oxide loaded on the carrier; the carrier is oxide. The method for preparing the amino acid by catalyzing the reductive amination of the carbonyl acid comprises the steps of introducing hydrogen into a mixed solution containing the carbonyl acid, a catalyst and ammonia water for reductive amination reaction to obtain the amino acid, wherein the method has high product yield, easy separation of the catalyst and mild reaction conditions. The method and the catalyst have wide application prospect.

title_en: Catalyst, preparation method thereof and application of catalyst in preparation of 9, 10-anthraquinone by anthracene gas-phase oxidation
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing 9, 10-anthraquinone by anthracene gas-phase oxidation. The catalyst is a transition metal modified mesoporous molecular sieve; the preparation method of the catalyst adopts a hydrothermal method to introduce transition metal into the mesoporous molecular sieve in situ. Based on the mass of the catalyst, the mass percentage of the transition metal is 0.5-5%. The catalyst is used for preparing 9, 10-anthraquinone by anthracene gas-phase oxidation on a fixed bed reactor, the conversion rate of anthracene is more than 90 percent, and the selectivity of 9, 10-anthraquinone is more than 90 percent. The catalyst is easy to prepare, can be recycled and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Process for hydroformylation of olefins using platinum and bromine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the hydroformylation of olefins using platinum and bromine.

title_en: Plasma catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plasma catalysts, and discloses a plasma catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises a carrier, an active component element and an auxiliary element which are supported on the carrier, wherein the carrier is selected from Al  2  O  3  、SiO  2  、MgO、ZrO  2  At least one of molecular sieves, wherein the active component element is selected from at least one of Pt, rh, pd, ir, and the auxiliary element is selected from non-noble metals of group VIIIAt least one of an element and a group IB metal element. The catalyst provided by the invention can adapt to the composition change of tail gas after the natural gas is subjected to plasma reaction, realizes the one-step conversion of the natural gas into acrylic acid under low temperature and normal pressure, and can effectively and stably improve the selectivity of the acrylic acid.

title_en: Preparation method of 2-tertiary butyl-4-hydroxyanisole
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of 2-tertiary butyl-4-hydroxyanisole, which takes hydroquinone and tertiary butyl alcohol as initial raw materials to synthesize 2-tertiary butyl-4-hydroxyanisole, 4-hydroxyl with smaller steric hindrance is protected by tertiary butyl dimethyl chlorosilane (TBSCl), methyl iodide preferentially reacts with 1-hydroxyl with larger steric hindrance, and finally protecting groups are removed under mild conditions to obtain high-yield 2-tertiary butyl-4-hydroxyanisole (2-BHA). The preparation method of the invention is not easy to generate side reaction, has mild reaction conditions, reduces the generation of harmful substances, and has good purity and high yield of the obtained product. Meanwhile, the production cost is low, and the method is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Polyol esters comprising rigid cycloaliphatic backbones and methods of making the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyol ester comprising a rigid cycloaliphatic backbone and a method of preparing the same. According to the invention, the alicyclic dicarboxylic acid and the polyol are subjected to secondary esterification reaction under the catalysis of the catalyst, so that the alicyclic dicarboxylic acid with a rigid framework can be introduced into the structure, the high temperature resistance is remarkably improved, the alicyclic dicarboxylic acid is a mixture of various isomers, the pour point of the obtained alcohol ester is also reduced, the viscosity is also greatly changed, and the obtained polyol ester product has a good potential application value in the lubricating oil industry in different fields through the combination optimization with fatty acids with different structures.

title_en: Polyfluoroalkyl sultone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyfluoroalkyl sultone and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of reacting polysubstituted 3-buten-1-ol or 4-penten-1-ol derivative with a photocatalyst and sodium polyfluorosulfinate in a solvent under the irradiation of visible light at room temperature, directly filtering after the reaction is finished, devolatilizing to obtain a concentrated solution, and carrying out reduced pressure rectification (or column chromatography) on the concentrated solution to obtain the polyfluoroalkyl sulfinic lactone. The preparation process is simple and efficient, is easy to operate, has low risk and can be amplified in scale; the raw materials are simple and easy to obtain, and the economy is high; the resulting compounds are in a wide variety of forms and there is no efficient synthetic method in the literature. The compound provides an important material source for modification of sulfur-containing heterocyclic compounds, can be used for research of electrolyte additives or bioactive molecules of electrolytic cells, and has important application value.

title_en: Preparation method of L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate calcium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate calcium, which comprises the following steps: step S1: adding folic acid, reductase, chiral reducing agent and solvent into a pressure kettle, introducing hydrogen to react under preset conditions, detecting the end of the reaction, and filtering the reaction liquid to prepare L-tetrahydrofolic acid; step S2: adding L-tetrahydrofolic acid into water, adding formaldehyde, adding a reducing agent, reacting to obtain L-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid, and adjusting the pH to 7 to obtain an L-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid aqueous solution; step S3: adding a calcium reagent into the L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate solution for reaction, and filtering and drying to obtain the finished product of L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate calcium. The preparation method has the advantages of simple process, high chiral purity, easy operation, environmental protection, no pollution, safe and residue-free calcium reagent, low cost, safe operation, easy industrial mass production, high conversion rate and good product quality.

title_en: Superoxide dismutase fusion polypeptide, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of anti-aging products
abstract_en: A superoxide dismutase fusion polypeptide, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing anti-aging products relate to the technical fields of genetic engineering and synthetic biology. The amino acid sequence of the recombinant SOD enzyme fusion polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3, and the fusion expression is carried out on mPeSOD2-1 with strong heat resistance and the humanized cell repair polypeptide with high function but instability. The mPeSOD2-1 is used as a partner protein to protect repair polypeptide, resist high temperature and degradation and retain the biological activity of the two. After high-temperature incubation, the fusion polypeptide has strong oxidation resistance, is beneficial to removing excessive harmful oxygen free radicals, protecting and repairing cells, and also has the effects of maintaining cells, promoting cell proliferation and repairing organism injury. The fusion polypeptide has strong stability, high activity and strong industrial practicability, and has wide application prospect in the fields of anti-aging cosmetics, health-care foods and the like for delaying the aging of organisms and promoting the regeneration of organisms and skin.

title_en: Multi-compartment calcium alginate gel microcarrier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-compartment calcium alginate gel microcarrier, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of dripping a plurality of Dex-Alg solution droplets into a biphasic receiving solution, and standing after the Dex-Alg solution enters a lower phase to obtain the multi-compartment calcium alginate gel microcarrier, wherein the upper phase of the biphasic receiving solution is PEG solution, and the lower phase is Dex-CaCl  2  Solution, PEG solution of a plurality of Dex-Alg monodisperse droplets in a biphasic receiving solution, and Dex-CaCl  2  The liquid-liquid interface of the solution is fused, alg and Ca are added after entering the lower phase  2+  Crosslinking to form the multi-compartment calcium alginate gel microcarrier. The method is easy to control, the shape of the gel microcarrier can be controlled by controlling the fusion of the liquid drops, no organic reagent is needed to be added, the biocompatibility is high, and the method is green and environment-friendly; the controllable multi-compartment calcium alginate gel microcarrier prepared by the method has wide application prospect.

title_en: Labdane diterpenoid compound, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biochemical medicines, and particularly relates to a labdane diterpenoid compound, a preparation method and application. The preparation method comprises the following steps: extracting beautyberry with water, and sequentially extracting with dichloromethane, ethyl acetate and n-butanol; secondly, separating the ethyl acetate extract liquid part by silica gel column chromatography, and collecting eluent to obtain 9 components, wherein the components are Fr.1-Fr.9; subjecting Fr.3 to macroporous resin column chromatography, eluting with methanol-water solution, and collecting eluate to obtain Fr.3.C; subjecting Fr.3.C to sephadex column chromatography, and collecting eluate to obtain Fr.3.A.1-Fr.3.A.6; and finally, separating and purifying Fr.3.A.1 by a reversed phase chromatographic column, and collecting eluent for 25-30 min. The compound can reduce the expression of proinflammatory cytokines in BV-2 cells stimulated by LPS, and is used for preparing medicines for preventing or treating neuroinflammatory diseases.

title_en: Chlorothiazole compound containing maleic acid structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A chlorthiazole compound containing a maleic acid structure has a structural formula shown in a formula (I): the preparation method is that chlorothiazole is used as a lead, and a primary amine-containing compound with antibacterial activity and maleic anhydride are spliced through an active substructure to prepare a compound with a general formula shown in (I); the preparation method is simple, the reaction condition is mild, the obtained compound has good environmental compatibility, has higher biological activity on plant soil-borne diseases, shows excellent control effect, and provides material guarantee for crop safety production.

title_en: Purification method of chloroethylene carbonate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for purifying chloroethylene carbonate, and belongs to the field of chloroethylene carbonate purification. The purification method of the chloroethylene carbonate comprises the following steps: stripping treatment, purification treatment and recovery treatment. The purification method of the chloroethylene carbonate can effectively purify the synthetic liquid containing the chloroethylene carbonate, which is prepared by chloridizing the ethylene carbonate, and can effectively separate the ethylene carbonate and the byproduct of the chloroethylene carbonate while realizing continuous separation and purification of the chloroethylene carbonate.

title_en: Preparation method of ruthenium compound for protein fluorescent staining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ruthenium compound for protein fluorescent staining, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving hydrated ruthenium trichloride and sodium erythrophenanthroline disulfonate hydrate in ethylene glycol, and heating to react; s2: and (3) dropwise adding the solution after the reaction of S1 into diethyl ether in a stirring state, crystallizing, filtering and drying to obtain the tris (4, 7-diphenyl-1, 10-phenanthroline disulfonate) ruthenium tetrasodium salt. The preparation method of the invention is safe, efficient and easy to operate, has low equipment requirement, simple post-treatment, almost can quantitatively obtain a qualified target substance, and well solves the technical blank of the preparation and purification of the compound.

title_en: Phenyl multi-functionality epoxy modified rosin-based polymer, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phenyl multi-functionality epoxy modified rosin-based polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, and a preparation method of the phenyl multi-functionality epoxy modified rosin-based polymer, which is prepared by reacting epoxy soybean oil rosin ester with a phenyl multi-functionality epoxy compound, wherein the phenyl multi-functionality epoxy compound is at least one of N, N, N, N-tetraepoxypropyl-4, 4-diaminodiphenyl methane, triglycidyl para-aminophenol or 9, 9-di [ (2, 3-epoxypropoxy) phenyl ] fluorene. The invention synthesizes brand new substances by taking biomass rosin as a raw material, belongs to green environment-friendly resource chemicals, has no problems of biotoxicity, environmental pollution and the like, has easily available raw materials, is simple in synthesis process and environment-friendly, and accords with the concept of sustainable development; the PVC has good plasticizing performance, improves the flexibility, the processability and the tensile strength of the PVC, improves the stability of the material, and can effectively inhibit migration problems and thermal damage caused by high temperature in the PVC processing and using process.

title_en: Preparation method, system, application, electrolyte and secondary battery of tetrafluoro oxalic acid phosphate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of new energy, and discloses a preparation method of tetrafluorooxalic acid phosphate for secondary battery electrolyte, which comprises the following steps: step 1: taking hydrogen oxalate and phosphorus pentafluoride as raw materials, and reacting in an inert organic solvent to obtain a solution containing an intermediate product; step 2: reacting the solution containing the intermediate product with chlorosilane to obtain a solution containing tetrafluoro oxalic acid phosphate and volatile byproducts; step 3: the tetrafluorooxalate phosphate was separated from the solution. In addition to the solvent in the solution obtained in the step 2 of the method, the products are tetrafluorooxalate phosphate and volatile byproducts, which means that the solvent can be recycled through simple post-treatment, and the total yield of tetrafluorooxalate phosphate can be improved. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a production system suitable for the method, application of the tetrafluoro oxalic acid phosphate prepared by the method, electrolyte and a secondary battery.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing glycolide and polyglycolide simultaneously and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nontoxic and efficient catalyst and a method for preparing high-purity glycolide monomer and preparing high-intrinsic viscosity polyglycolide by ring-opening polymerization by using the catalyst. The catalyst has no toxic or side effect, low production cost and high catalytic efficiency, and can effectively improve the yield and purity of glycolide and prepare the polyglycolide with high intrinsic viscosity. The method can be used for preparing high-yield (up to 91.0%), high-purity glycolide (more than 99.9%) monomers at 260-290 ℃ and obtaining the polyglycolide with the intrinsic viscosity of 1.55dL/g through ring-opening polymerization at 180-220 ℃, can replace the traditional metal catalyst, and has a large-scale production prospect.

title_en: Fatty acyl amino acid facial cleanser crystallized by using polyalcohol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cosmetics, and relates to fatty acyl amino acid facial cleanser crystallized by using polyol and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyol is 15-35, the fatty acyl amino acid is 30-40, PEG-120 methyl glucose dioleate is 1-3, cocoamidomethyl MEA is 1-3, sodium chloride is 1.5-4, citric acid is 1-3 and water is 20-35. Compared with the prior art, the invention promotes the fatty acyl amino acid surfactant to be separated out from the solution through the polyalcohol, thickens the fatty acyl amino acid facial cleanser through a crystallization mode, improves the stability of the fatty acyl amino acid facial cleanser, has good cleaning effect and has no harm to skin.

title_en: Compound, synthesis method thereof and ultra-high temperature underground corrosion inhibitor containing compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound, a synthesis method thereof and an ultra-high temperature underground corrosion inhibitor containing the compound. The compound has a structure shown in a formula I. The synthesis method of the compound adopts acetyl thiazole, cinnamaldehyde and polyethylene polyamine as raw materials to synthesize the compound through a Mannich reaction. The ultra-high temperature underground corrosion inhibitor containing the compound has the advantages of easily available raw materials, small toxic and side effects, excellent corrosion resistance, simple preparation method and low requirements on production equipment. title_en: Azone compound, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of neurodegenerative disease drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses azone compounds, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing neuroprotective medicines. The invention is prepared from a strain of penicillium sclerotium Penicilliumsclerotiorum ) Separating azone compound from fermentation product of UJNMF0503 CGMCC No.40172 Has neuroprotective activity, and can be used for developing nerveHas good application prospect in the aspect of protecting medicines.

title_en: Aryl boric acid containing organic carbon free radical, derivative and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An arylboronic acid containing organic carbon free radicals and derivatives thereof and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical structural general formula is as follows: wherein n is 1,2 or 3; according to the method, from polychlorinated substituted triphenylmethyl free radicals, the arylboronic acid containing organic carbon free radicals and derivatives thereof are synthesized for the first time through metal catalyzed boration reaction, the method is mild in reaction condition, simple and convenient to operate, high in reaction conversion rate and yield, and capable of specifically selecting triphenylmethyl free radical boration sites, so that the problem of selectivity of C-Cl bonds in the reaction process is solved; the generated aryl boric acid containing organic carbon free radical and its derivative can be used as functional open shell free radical molecular synthesis module, boric acid group with far higher reactivity than chlorine atom is utilized, oxidation reaction is carried out under mild condition, metal catalytic reaction is carried outThe functional molecules are converted into open-shell free radical functional molecules with excellent photoelectric, thermal and magnetic properties in a great amount, and the functional molecules have great application value.

title_en: Amino alkoxy modified flavone compound, pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract_en: The invention provides an amino alkoxy modified flavone compound which has a structure shown in a formula I or a salt thereof. On the basis of not changing the parent nucleus of the flavone, the invention mainly uses amino alkoxy to modify the side chain of the flavone, synthesizes a series of small molecular compounds taking the flavone compound as a framework, and compared with the parent nucleus, the series of compounds keep the advantage of lower toxicity of the flavone to normal cells, and simultaneously obviously improve the antitumor activity and the dissolubility of the flavone.

title_en: Aggregation-induced emission type photosensitizer capable of simultaneously generating I-type and II-type active oxygen and application thereof
abstract_en: An aggregation-induced emission type photosensitizer capable of simultaneously generating I-type and II-type active oxygen and application thereof relate to the field of chemistry. The aggregation-induced emission type photosensitizer capable of simultaneously generating I-type and II-type active oxygen can simultaneously generate I-type and II-type active oxygen, the generation amount of the active oxygen is far higher than that of commercial dye, and the light-induced emission type photosensitizer has better photodynamic effect. The invention effectively improves the problem of environmental limitation of photodynamic therapy, is expected to replace commercial photosensitizer to realize multiple applications in multiple occasions, such as antibiosis and anti-tumor in organisms, and surface antibiosis and cleaning of electronic equipment, public facilities, medical sanitation, business offices or food packaging.

title_en: Thiophene-phenothiazine compound, synthesis method thereof and application thereof in preparation of phototherapy drugs
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to a thiophene-phenothiazine compound, a synthesis method thereof and application thereof in preparation of a light therapeutic drug. The invention provides a thiophene-phenothiazine compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein a thiophene structure is successfully fused to a phenothiazine skeleton in the structure, a brand new molecular bracket is provided, the special structure shows excellent photodynamic activity, has strong wavelength absorption and good photostability in a near infrared region, can efficiently generate ROS in red light, and can be used as a photosensitizer. The thiophene-phenothiazine compound has stronger phototoxicity and higher phototherapy index, shows strong photodynamic anti-tumor activity, has no obvious toxic or side effect, and is expected to become a new generation of novel photosensitizer applicable to clinic and applied to preparing phototherapy drugs or lead compounds thereof.

title_en: Process for the preparation of 1, 2-propanediol
abstract_en: In a process for preparing 1, 2-propanediol by: reacting propylene with hydrogen peroxide in the presence of a phase transfer catalyst and a heteropolytungstate in a liquid biphasic reaction mixture having an organic phase comprising an alkylaromatic hydrocarbon solvent; separating the reaction mixture into an aqueous phase comprising 1, 2-propanediol and an organic phase; d) An oxygen-deficient organic phase (P)  d  ) Recycling to the reaction step; and recovering 1, 2-propanediol from the aqueous phase, the reacting and separating steps being carried out in a vessel filled with liquid at a pressure high enough to inhibit desorption of gas from the liquid reaction mixture, and contacting the separated organic phase with a non-flammable gas stream to desorb 10-75% of oxygen dissolved in the organic phase into the non-flammable gas stream in small amounts of propane prior to recycling the organic phaseAlkene loss safely scavenges oxygen.

title_en: Cytosine-type cross-linked nucleoside phosphoramidite crystal and method for producing same
abstract_en: A cytosine-type cross-linked nucleoside phosphoramidite crystal represented by the following structural formula, wherein R  1  、R  2  Represents a substituent, R  3  Represents a protecting group.

title_en: Oxazolone matrine derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxazolone matrine derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical medicines. The oxazolone matrine derivative can be used for preparing antitumor drugs, has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple operation, simplified synthesis steps, mild reaction conditions and high product yield, and the in-vitro antitumor activity research shows that the compound is an antitumor drug with development prospect and can be used for clinically treating tumors.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for monitoring polarity of targeting Golgi apparatus and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluorescent probes, and particularly relates to a fluorescent probe for monitoring polarity of a target Golgi apparatus, and preparation and application thereof. The structural formula of the fluorescent probe is as follows:  The probe takes sulfanilamide as a Golgi targeting group, coumarin 343 fragments as a polar specificity group to form a typical D-pi-A structure, and GCSP has the capability of detecting the polarity change of a microenvironment through an intramolecular charge transfer effect. The probe can timely monitor the polarity change of the golgi in living cells, realizes the visualization of the golgi polarity of liver adipose tissue and cancer cell tissue for the first time, reveals that the golgi polarity in fatty liver and cancer is lower, successfully proves that the golgi polarity can be used as a marker for early diagnosis of cancer, and provides a powerful tool for revealing the connection between the golgi polarity and serious diseases in future clinical research.

title_en: Composite probiotic composition for oral cavity, application and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oral care, and discloses a composite probiotic composition for oral cavity, application and a product thereof, wherein the composite probiotic composition comprises composite probiotic powder, persimmon tannin and mushroom extract, and the composite probiotic powder comprises lactobacillus reuteri GDMCC 1.614, lactobacillus rhamnosus ATCC 7469 and bifidobacterium longum CICC 6068. The invention scientifically and reasonably combines the composite probiotic powder with the plant active ingredients, generates a synergistic effect in inhibiting the growth of oral pathogenic bacteria Porphyromonas gingivalis, has remarkable antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects, can regulate the balance of oral flora, prevent oral diseases and is beneficial to oral health.

title_en: Method for removing impurities in m-xylylenediamine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing impurities in m-xylylenediamine, which relates to the technical field of m-xylylenediamine treatment. After the reaction is finished, the m-xylylenediamine and the Raney nickel catalyst can be respectively output, the safety of the output Raney nickel catalyst is greatly improved due to the protection of methanol, the subsequent direct use is not influenced, and the method is more suitable for the industrial impurity removal operation of the m-xylylenediamine.

title_en: Preparation method of amide-assisted nano hierarchical pore TS-1 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an amide-assisted nano hierarchical pore TS-1 molecular sieve, which relates to a hierarchical pore molecular sieve preparation technologyThe field of surgery. The invention comprises the following steps: s1: mixing a structure directing agent with water, then adding a silicon source, and performing first mixing to obtain a mixture solution; s2: performing second mixing on a titanium source and the mixture solution to obtain a molecular sieve initial sol mixture; s3: thirdly mixing water-soluble organic small molecules with the molecular sieve initial sol mixture to obtain a molecular sieve sol mixture; s4: and (3) carrying out two-step standing crystallization, solid-liquid separation and calcination on the molecular sieve sol mixture to obtain the high-activity hierarchical pore molecular sieve. The invention has simple operation, strong controllability and low cost, and the TiO of the obtained molecular sieve  6  The catalyst has high active species content, small particle size, rich micropores and mesoporous structures, and high catalytic activity in olefin epoxidation and oxidative desulfurization.

title_en: Lysosome/mitochondrion bicolor fluorescent probe with pH responsiveness and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses a lysosome/mitochondria double-color fluorescent probe with pH responsiveness, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structural formula of the lysosome/mitochondria double-color fluorescent probe compound is shown as formula (I): the A is  ‑  Is an N-methylated anion; preferably, the N-methylated anions are selected from Cl  ‑  、Br  ‑  、I  ‑  、ClO  4   ‑  、TfO  ‑  、TsO  ‑  Or BF  4   ‑  . The fluorescent probe compound has pH responsiveness, can target lysosomes and mitochondria simultaneously after entering cells, and generates no toxicityFluorescence of the same color can be used for double-color imaging of living cell lysosomes and mitochondria, and has important significance for researching interaction of lysosomes and mitochondria.

title_en: Preparation method of filamentous yeast-like fungus fermentation product
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a filamentous yeast-like fungus fermentation product, and relates to the field of fungus fermentation. The filtrate of the fermentation product of the filamentous yeast-like fungi after multiple fermentation has higher cell safety and better product effect. The method adopts filamentous yeast-like fungi and pure natural culture medium prepared from matsutake, white willow bark, ganoderma lucidum, white truffle or rice to carry out multiple fermentation, namely, the sediment in the primary fermentation product is used for the culture medium component of the secondary fermentation, so that the cell safety can be improved, the skin care effect of the fermentation product can be improved, the cost can be saved, and the method is suitable for production and manufacture. The fermented product has good skin care effect, and can be applied to cosmetics.

title_en: Benzothiazepine compounds and their use as bile acid modulators
abstract_en: The present application relates to certain 1, 5-benzothiazepine and 1,2, 5-benzothiazepine derivatives as defined herein. These compounds are bile acid modulators with apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter (ASBT) and/or hepatic bile acid transporter (LBAT) inhibitory activity. The application is also directed to pharmaceutical compositions comprising these compounds and the use of these compounds in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, disorders of fatty acid metabolism and glucose utilization disorders, gastrointestinal disorders and liver diseases.

title_en: Skin conditioner, emulsion containing skin conditioner and preparation method of emulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skin conditioner which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: 10-60 parts of water; 0.5-10 parts of triglyceride; 0.5-10 parts of hydrogenated phosphatidylcholine; 0.5-10 parts of 1, 2-pentanediol; 0.5-10 parts of glycerol; 0.5-10 parts of shea butter tree resin; 0.1-5 parts of squalane; 0.1-5 parts of ceramide NP; the triglyceride is any one or more of caprylic triglyceride or capric triglyceride. The invention also discloses an emulsion and a preparation method thereof. The substrate of the invention does not contain traditional emulsifying agent, and is more beneficial to the use of sensitive muscles. The present patent uses the lipophilic and hydrophilic properties of hydrogenated phosphatidylcholine (i.e. lecithin) existing in skin as an emulsifier, so that the problem of improving the sensitive muscle by repairing damaged cutin barrier and improving skin barrier capability without adding the traditional emulsifier can be truly achieved.

title_en: Alopecia preventing composition, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of anti-hair loss products, in particular to an anti-hair loss composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises: matrine salicylic acid, L-carnitine tartaric acid, collagen production promoting polypeptide, keratin production promoting polypeptide, glyceroglycoside, and betaine 1, 3-propylene glycol. The composition aims at preventing alopecia from multiple dimensions, achieves effects of controlling oil, inhibiting bacteria and diminishing inflammation by using matrine salicylic acid, balances scalp environment, combines the moisturizing effect of glucosyl glycoside, and synergistically improves water-oil balance of scalp; the sub-health state of scalp of the alopecia crowd is corrected by utilizing the restoration capability of the glucosyl glyceroglycosides; the polypeptide which promotes collagen generation by utilizing the combination of the L-carnitine tartaric acid improves the activity of hair follicle cells, repairs the hair follicle structure and strengthens the hair root; promoting hair growth using a keratin-producing promoting polypeptide; betaine 1, 3-propanediol can deliver the composition and also act synergistically on the active.

title_en: Novel preparation method of oxo-pyridine compound and key intermediate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel route for preparing oxo-pyridine compounds shown in a formula (I) and key intermediates thereof. The novel route provided by the invention can greatly reduce the generation of isomer impurities, improve the selectivity of reaction chirality and N/O-alkylation selectivity, improve the yield, ensure that crude products are not required to be purified again, reduce the cost, have short production period, save energy and protect environment, are suitable for preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing diseases related to FXIa receptors, and particularly provide a new thought for preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing cerebrovascular arterial diseases and/or peripheral arterial diseases.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of chiral tetrahydropyran compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of medicine, organic chemical industry and fine chemical industry, in particular to a synthesis method and application of chiral tetrahydropyran compounds. The invention takes alkenyl imine compounds and 1, 4-dipole compounds as raw materials, and uses Pd as a raw material  2  dba  3  Under the catalysis of the catalyst and (R) -BINAP chiral ligand, tetrahydrofuran is used as a solvent, and the product is synthesized after 96 hours at the temperature of minus 20 ℃. The reaction can be carried out by simple post-treatment, thus obtaining a series of chiral tetrahydropyran compounds with high yield and high enantioselectivity. The alkenyl imine substrate substituted at different positions (para, ortho and meta) on the benzene ring and the alkenyl imine compound containing naphthyl and thiophene groups can be used as reaction substrates to obtain corresponding chiral tetrahydropyran compounds, the chiral tetrahydrofuran compounds have an inhibition effect on tumors, and the preparation method can be used for inhibiting tumorsA medicament.

title_en: DNA methyltransferase 1 inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT 1) inhibitor which is a compound shown in a formula I or a salt, stereoisomer or solvate thereof.
