The DNMT1 inhibitor provided by the invention has excellent inhibition activity on DMNT1, has good antiproliferative activity on various tumor cells, can induce tumor cell cycle tissues and apoptosis, is stable in metabolism, and has good application prospects.

title_en: Column [5] arene-based fluorescent material and application thereof in kidney targeted developer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a column [5]]An aromatic hydrocarbon fluorescent material and application thereof in kidney targeting developer. The fluorescent material is prepared by taking 4-methylpyridine and 4-dimethylaminobenzaldehyde as raw materials, and reacting and crystallizing to obtain DMAS; then preparing an intermediate from 1, 4-bis (2-hydroxyethoxy) benzene, triphenylphosphine, carbon tetrabromide, paraformaldehyde and using the intermediate, DMAS and pyridine as raw materials, and preparing the intermediate in CH  3  CN is reacted under reflux to obtain column [5]]An aromatic hydrocarbon-based fluorescent material. The column [5] of the present invention]The aromatic fluorescent material belongs to a novel fluorescent compound, can be used for kidney targeted aggregation and imaging, and has the characteristics of low cytotoxicity, good biocompatibility, good stability, high sensitivity, low cost and easiness in use.

title_en: Method for catalyzing Suzuki reaction based on MOF Pi Keling emulsion of metal organic framework
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for catalyzing Suzuki reaction based on MOF Pi Keling emulsion of a metal organic framework. The invention adopts water and toluene as solvents at the same time, and Pd@MIL-101 is used as an emulsifier to form Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion. The Suzuki reaction is catalyzed by Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion. The Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation method and has ultrahigh catalytic capability in a Suzuki reaction.

title_en: Extraction method of cholesterol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a separation method of compounds, in particular to a cholesterol extraction method. The method comprises the following steps of a, firstly mixing a cholesterol-containing raw material, an alkali source, a catalyst and a solvent, adding inorganic salt into the obtained reaction liquid to obtain a mixed liquid for second mixing, b, adding an extractant into the mixed liquid to perform continuous extraction, separating to obtain an extract, c, concentrating the extract to obtain a cholesterol crude product, and recrystallizing to obtain cholesterol. The method can reduce the saponification reaction energy barrier, promote the reaction of the cholesterol-containing raw material under milder conditions, does not pollute the environment, has thorough reaction, and is suitable for industrial production due to the addition of inorganic salt into the reaction liquid, preferably continuous extraction in a continuous extraction column, thereby improving the purity and yield of the cholesterol in the extraction layer, along with high extraction efficiency, low energy consumption, safe and stable operation.

title_en: Flame-retardant modified polyurethane material and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyurethane and discloses a flame-retardant modified polyurethane material and a synthesis method thereof, wherein the flame-retardant modified polyurethane material comprises 50-70 parts of polyether glycol, 10-15 parts of toluene-2, 4-diisocyanate, 5-10 parts of dibutyltin dilaurate and 3-6 parts of micromolecular flame-retardant cross-linking agent.

title_en: Preparation method and preparation device system of hexafluorobutadiene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and a preparation device system of hexafluorobutadiene, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: under the protection atmosphere condition, mixing chlorotrifluoroethylene, trifluoroethylene and catalytic mixed solution, and heating to react; the preparation method provided by the invention adopts chlorotrifluoroethylene and trifluoroethylene to prepare hexafluorobutadiene through coupling reaction under the catalysis of palladium active catalyst, the catalyst dosage in the reaction process is less, zinc powder activation or copper salt and ferric salt catalysis are not needed, the process is simple, the byproducts are less, and the purification is convenient.

title_en: Photocatalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photocatalyst is formed by compositing CPDI (3, 4,9, 10-perylene tetracarboxylic dianhydride) and a caged group POSS-NH  2  (aminopropyl heptyl-caged polysilsesquioxane) to form a modified catalyst POSS-PDI, the mass ratio of CPDI in the modified catalyst POSS-PDI to POSS-NH  2  is 1:3.29, and the mass ratio of g-CN (mesoporous graphite carbon nitride nano-plate) to POSS-PDI in the g-CN/P-PDI type photocatalyst is 3wt%. The preparation method is simple, and the prepared II-type photocatalyst has good catalytic activity and stability by constructing the heterojunction. Under the synergistic effect of illumination and a plurality of reaction conditions, the depolymerization of the lignin model substance beta-O-4 in acetonitrile can reach 99 percent, and the C-C bond cracking selectivity can reach 96 percent.

title_en: Continuous preparation method of 2-chloro-3-methylbenzoic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous preparation method of 2-chloro-3-methylbenzoic acid. The preparation method of the 2-chloro-3-methylbenzoic acid comprises the following steps: in a tubular reactor, 2, 6-dimethyl chlorobenzene is subjected to oxidation reaction shown in the following formula in the presence of an oxidant, a catalyst and an initiator at a reaction temperature of 150-200 ℃; wherein the oxidant is gas with the oxygen content of 10-50%. The continuous preparation method has the advantages of safety, continuous production and oxygen utilization rate, thereby greatly reducing the safety risk and improving the process productivity.

title_en: Synthesis method of 3,3' - [ oxybismethylene ] bis [ 3-ethyl ] oxetane
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of 3,3' - [ oxybismethylene ] bis [ 3-ethyl ] oxetane, which is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: s1: adding a solvent into a preparation kettle to dissolve the ditrimethylolpropane; s2: filling a strong acid catalyst into a fixed bed; s3: step S1: heating and pressurizing the obtained solution, passing through a fixed bed, and then reducing the pressure in a loop reactor and removing the pressure to obtain a product; the invention can improve the yield and continuously produce the diluent, does not need to use expensive raw materials, has low cost and simple process, and can improve the product yield.

title_en: Organic compound, composition and application thereof in organic electronic device
abstract_en: Provided are organic compounds of formula (I), mixtures thereof, compositions thereof and their use in organic electronic devices, in particular in organic electroluminescent diodes; organic electronic devices, particularly organic electroluminescent diodes, comprising the above organic compounds, and their use in display and lighting technology are also provided. Through device structure optimization, better device performance can be achieved, and particularly, a high-performance OLED device can be achieved, so that better material and preparation technical options are provided for full-color display and illumination application.

title_en: Novel diene or triene benzofuranone compound and efficient synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel diene or triene benzofuranone compound and a high-efficiency synthesis method thereof. The method has the advantages of low cost, high yield, simple operation, no pollution and the like, and has potential industrial application prospect. The method provides a cheap and green way for preparing the diene or triene benzofuranone compound.

title_en: Electrochemical synthesis of alkoxylated benzoxazine compound, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of synthesis of alkoxylated benzoxazine compounds, in particular to an electrochemical synthesis of an alkoxylated benzoxazine compound, the structural formula of which is shown as formula (I), and a preparation method of the compoundThe alkoxylated benzoxazine compound of the present application has excellent antitumor activity.

title_en: Preparation method of fine components and monomer compounds of hedyotis diversifolia and application of fine components and monomer compounds in cosmetics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly discloses an extract of hedysarum gracile and application thereof in preparing cosmetics, wherein the extract refers to an exquisite component of the hedysarum gracile and 7 monomer compounds. The delicate component is the component with the strongest antioxidant activity, tyrosinase activity inhibition and matrix metalloproteinase activity inhibition in the calyx parviflora; the 7 monomer compounds are obtained by macroporous resin column chromatography, methanol-water solution gradient elution, hydroxypropyl sephadex column chromatography, octadecyl silane bonded silica gel column chromatography and high performance liquid chromatography acetonitrile water solution gradient elution of the ethanol extract of the hedysarum calyx. The extract of the calyx parviflora of the invention can be applied to the aspects of skin oxidation resistance, whitening and aging resistance, and is further used for preparing a cosmetic composition containing the extract.

title_en: Silicone oil-free compliant hair conditioner containing phospholipids and hydrolyzed protein and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a silicone oil-free compliant hair conditioner containing phospholipids and hydrolyzed protein and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of washing care products. The hair conditioner comprises the following components in percentage by weight: comprises unsaturated fatty acid component 0.1-2%, willow herb extract 0.1-2%, hydrolyzed rice protein 0.1-3%, hydrolyzed pea protein 0.1-3%, cetostearyl alcohol 5-12%, humectant 1-8%, hydrolyzed wheat protein 0-3%, macadamia nut seed oil 0-5%, oat kernel extract 0-2%, water-locking agent 0-6%, antistatic agent 0-6%, antiseptic 0-1.5%, panthenol 0-3%, thickener 0-1%, flavoring agent 0-1%, and water for the rest. Under the condition of no silicone oil, the hair conditioner can still play a role in conditioning and smoothing the head, and the problems of greasy feeling and heavy and flat hair caused by hair conditioner residues are solved because no silicone oil is added.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing ethanol by directly converting catalytic synthesis gas, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for preparing ethanol by directly converting catalytic synthesis gas, which consists of a carrier, an active ingredient and an auxiliary agent, wherein the active ingredient is Mo  2  C, the auxiliary agent is metal M1 and metal M2; the metal M1 is the combination of any one of Mn, la and Ce and K, and the metal M2 is Co or Ni; the carrier is a carbon carrier; the weight ratio of metal Mo to the carrier is 10-50%, and the Mn, la and Ce areThe molar ratio of any one of the metal M2, K, mo and the metal M2 is (0.05-0.1): (0.05-0.15): (0.3-0.8): 1. meanwhile, the invention also discloses a preparation method of the catalyst and application of the catalyst in preparing ethanol from synthesis gas. The catalyst has simple preparation process and high selectivity of total alcohol and target product ethanol when being used for preparing ethanol by converting synthesis gas.

title_en: Heat-resistant degradable polyester composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biodegradable polyesters, and particularly relates to a heat-resistant degradable polyester composition and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts furfuroyl chloride as a furfuraldehyde derivative to prepare a series of furan-containing bishydrazide degradable polyester nucleating agents, and the degradable polyester nucleating agents are melt blended according to the mass ratio of 100 parts of degradable polyester and 0.3-1 part of nucleating agents on the basis, so that the heat resistance and the transparency of the degradable polyester plastic products can be obviously improved. The nucleating agent has wide sources of raw materials and simple preparation process, can effectively improve the crystallization rate of degradable polyesters including poly (butylene succinate), poly (terephthalic acid-adipic acid-butylene succinate) and poly (terephthalic acid-succinic acid-butylene succinate), and has good industrialized prospect.

title_en: Method for purifying vanillin or derivatives thereof obtained by biotechnological methods
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for purifying a fermentation broth (M) obtained by a biotechnological process, comprising biomass and vanillin or derivatives thereof in an aqueous solution, for preparing crystalline vanillin or derivatives thereof, characterized in that vanillin or derivatives thereof in protonated or salified form remains in the aqueous solution throughout the purification process.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium picosulfate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, relates to synthesis of medicines, and in particular relates to a preparation method of sodium picosulfate. Taking phenol and 2-pyridylaldehyde as raw materials, taking trifluoroacetic acid and formic acid as reaction solvents, dropwise adding concentrated sulfuric acid, obtaining a crude 4,4' - (2-pyridylmethylene) -bisphenol product after complete reaction, and carrying out intermediate refining on the crude 4,4' - (2-pyridylmethylene) -bisphenol product to obtain a pure 4,4' - (2-pyridylmethylene) -bisphenol product; and (3) carrying out sulfonation reaction on the 4,4' - (2-pyridine methylene) -bisphenol pure product by using a sulfur trioxide pyridine compound, then carrying out alkali neutralization reaction to obtain a sodium picosulfate crude product, and carrying out product refining on the sodium picosulfate crude product to obtain the sodium picosulfate pure product. The invention can reduce the generation of isomers, improves the yield, is suitable for industrial production, and the prepared sodium picosulfate meets the requirements of European pharmacopoeia quality standards.

title_en: Organic small molecule with long afterglow luminescence property and biological application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic micromolecule with long afterglow luminescence property, which is based on a cyanine molecular frame modified pyridinium structure through structural design to obtain the cyanine micromolecule structure with pyridinium, and successfully constructs an organic long afterglow material taking the organic micromolecule as a luminophor to obtain the long afterglow organic micromolecule with excellent water solubility and living organism imaging potential, wherein the organic micromolecule can still generate a strong and stable long afterglow signal for a long time after the excitation light stops. The invention also provides an application of the organic long-afterglow luminous system in vivo imaging, the luminous system can rapidly enter the kidney within 1 minute after intravenous injection and is rapidly metabolized by glomerulus, little residue is left in normal tissues, obvious organ damage is not shown, and under the action of excitation light, long-afterglow signals can be shown in an excitation area, so that the organic long-afterglow luminous system has good biomedical application value.

title_en: Red luminous cuprous complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a red-light-emitting cuprous complex and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the molecular formula of the red-light-emitting cuprous complex is C  70 H 51 Cu 4 S 4 N 19 P 2 , the molecular weight is 1601.64, the preparation method comprises the steps of adding a ligand A and an auxiliary ligand 1-phenyl-1H-tetrazole-5-thiol into a mixed solvent of CH  2 Cl 2  and CH  3  OH according to a molar ratio of 1:4, stirring uniformly to obtain a mixed solution, adding [ Cu (CH  3 CN) 4 ]PF 6 ) into the mixed solution, stirring at normal temperature, filtering into a culture flask, slowly volatilizing filtrate in the culture flask at room temperature to obtain crystals, washing the obtained crystals with absolute ethyl alcohol, and vacuum drying.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hyaluronic acid composition and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of skin care products. The composition contains blue copper peptide, can transport copper ions into cells, has the effects of repairing and resisting aging, and has the remarkable effects of repairing skin and reducing fine lines and wrinkles of the skin. The active ingredients of the fennel extract can accelerate metabolism of epidermis, effectively improve self-healing capacity of skin, quickly repair damaged parts and promote regeneration of cell tissues. In addition, the composition contains crosslinked sodium hyaluronate, which can be used as an elastic protective layer to isolate the damage of the external severe environment to the skin, and can induce subcutaneous angiogenesis after the hyaluronic acid fragments generated by continuous degradation are absorbed by the skin to increase the oxygen supply of the skin and improve the skin state.

title_en: Preparation method of L-epinephrine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of epinephrine, and relates to a preparation method of L-epinephrine. The invention provides a preparation method of L-epinephrine, which comprises the following steps: mixing an adrenergic ketone compound, a solvent, an asymmetric reduction catalyst and formic acid, and carrying out reduction reaction to obtain a reduction reaction product; the asymmetric reduction catalyst is N- [ (1S, 2S) -1, 2-diphenyl-2- [ [3- (H6-phenyl) propyl ] amino ] ethyl ] -4-methylbenzenesulfonamide ] ruthenium chloride; and mixing the reduction reaction product with formic acid, and carrying out reduction reaction to obtain the L-epinephrine. Compared with the traditional process route, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages that chiral resolution steps are reduced, the process flow is shortened, the yield of the L-epinephrine is improved, and meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the invention avoids the use of high-pressure hydrogenation reaction, so that the production is safer.

title_en: Pyrazole ionic liquid and method for catalyzing Betti reaction by using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of Betti-alkali aminoalkylnaphthol synthesis, in particular to a pyrazole ionic liquid 1, 2-dibenzyl-3, 5-dimethylpyrazole hexafluorophosphate and a synthesis method thereof, and a method for catalyzing Betti reaction by using the same, wherein under the condition of 70 ℃, a pyrazole ionic liquid is used as a catalyst and a solvent, three-component Betti reaction is carried out on aromatic aldehyde, pyrrolidine and beta-naphthol, a product and the catalyst are separated by ethanol, betti-alkali aminoalkylnaphthol is obtained, the type of ionic liquid, the solvent, the material ratio of reactants, the dosage of the ionic liquid and the reaction temperature are screened, a series of Betty bases with higher yield are obtained under the optimized condition, the yield is 72% -94%, the used catalyst is green and effective, the thermal stability is good, the Betty bases can be catalyzed and synthesized in a short time, the product and the catalyst are easy to separate, industrialization is facilitated, and the catalyst can be recycled for a plurality of times.

title_en: Preparation method and application of potassium ion channel mimics
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of chemical and medical intersection, and provides a preparation method of a potassium ion channel simulator, wherein the inner diameter of the potassium ion channel simulator is 2.7 angstroms, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, single hydrolysis of phenanthroline; step 2, condensation of pyridine dihydrazide hydrolysis and o-phenanthroline monohydrolysis; and 3, closing the oxadiazole ring. The potassium channel mimics constructed by the method have good potassium ion permeability, are further cross-researched with the field of medicine, are proposed to solve diseases caused by potassium channel function defects in medicine, select long QT syndrome type 2 (LQT 2) as the potassium channel dysfunction diseases caused by potassium channel regulation gene mutation, and proved by experiments, the prepared potassium channel mimics can be safely applied to an LQT2 model, and are safe and reasonable LQT2 treatment methods from the aspects of cell experiments, isolated organs and animal model levels.

title_en: Cosmetic compositions with reduced shine
abstract_en: A reduced gloss, single phase cosmetic composition that is soft and water resistant below a selected temperature (e.g., 43 ℃). The composition is durable, stain and peel resistant, and oil resistant. The compositions according to the invention comprise specific combinations of acrylate/VA copolymer, acrylate copolymer and HDI/trimethylol hexyl lactone crosslinked polymer// silica in a cosmetically acceptable matrix or delivery vehicle. The composition according to the invention is hydrophilic before application but will dry to a transparent hydrophobic film. The dried film is easily removed when scrubbed with water above a certain temperature, but not easily removed with water below that temperature. The composition is easy to manufacture, soft and comfortable, and is suitable for skin and hair.

title_en: Development method of large conjugated system spiropyran photochromic material
abstract_en: The invention provides a development method of a large conjugated system spiropyran photochromic material, which successfully introduces naphthalene and benzofuran units into a spiropyran molecular skeleton through screening and optimizing multi-step organic chemical reaction conditions, and develops a series of large conjugated system spiropyran photochromic micromolecule materials, wherein the series of molecular materials can obviously red shift an absorption spectrum under 365nm ultraviolet light or natural light irradiation, meanwhile, the free volume of molecules is obviously increased, so that the material can obviously generate a photochromic phenomenon under a pure solid state, after the light source is irradiated, a plurality of large conjugated system spiropyran materials are changed into a blue system, and through the development method of the large conjugated system spiropyran photochromic material, a plurality of photochromic materials with obviously changed absorption spectrum and obviously increased free volume of molecules after ring-opening isomerization can be obtained, so that the photochromic capability and reversibility of the materials are greatly improved, and the color regulation and control of the photochromic materials are realized.

title_en: Tricyclic compounds as HPK1 inhibitors and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a pharmaceutical composition and a preparation method thereof, and the compound is used as an HPK1 inhibitorIs provided.

title_en: Application of multifunctional silane coupling agent in surface modification of bioactive glass
abstract_en: The invention takes commercial 3-aminopropyl silane coupling agent, diallylamine polyether acrylate, alkylating agent, gamma-propane sultone or gamma-butyrolactone as raw materials, and prepares a multifunctional silane coupling agent with more than one quaternary ammonium cation, sulfobetaine or carboxyl betaine in a molecular structure through aza-Michael addition reaction and quaternary ammonium salt reaction, which is used for surface modification of bioactive glass, and obtains the effects of enhancing biocompatibility, antibacterial and bacteriostasis and hydrophilicity after the surface modification of the bioactive glass.

title_en: Bifunctional spiro catalyst and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic catalyst synthesis, in particular to a bifunctional spiro catalyst, a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein the structural formula of the catalyst is shown as formula (I): wherein R is: the novel bifunctional spiro catalyst can promote asymmetric alkylation reaction of aldehyde and 3-bromoindolone, and the reaction efficiency is obviously increased.

title_en: Method for preparing xylitol and L-arabinose from liquid xylitol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing xylitol and L-arabinose from liquid xylitol, which comprises the following steps of (1) diluting xylose mother liquor, adding nitrogen source and inorganic salt, sterilizing for standby, (2) inoculating candida for fermentation, wherein the candida can decompose other sugar except arabinose, (3) centrifuging and filtering fermentation liquor after fermentation is finished to obtain supernatant, (4) desalting the supernatant through ion exchange resin, (5) concentrating and crystallizing the supernatant after removing pigment, separating crystallized materials to obtain xylitol crystals and xylitol mother liquor, (6) separating the obtained xylitol mother liquor through a chromatographic system to obtain xylitol phase and L-arabinose phase, (7) concentrating and crystallizing the obtained L-arabinose phase, separating crystallized materials to obtain L-arabinose crystals and L-arabinose liquid, and obtaining high-purity L-arabinose by adopting the method.

title_en: Synthesis method of 4-azido-L-phenylalanine
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for synthesizing 4-azido-L-phenylalanine, which comprises the following steps: dissolving 4-amino-L-phenylalanine in 1mol/L dilute hydrochloric acid, and cooling to 0 ℃ to obtain a first solution; dropwise adding an aqueous solution of sodium nitrite into the first solution, and stirring and reacting for 45 minutes at the temperature of 0 ℃ to obtain a second solution; and (3) dropwise adding a potassium azide aqueous solution into the second solution, stirring at normal temperature for reaction for 1 hour, adding a pH regulator to regulate the pH value to 8-9, and washing with water to obtain the 4-azido-L-phenylalanine. The synthesis method provided by the embodiment of the application has the characteristics of mild reaction conditions, low impurity content in the product, simple post-treatment, high yield, and the like, and is convenient for process production and amplification.

title_en: Fused ring conjugated macromolecule based on benzodipyrrole and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fused ring conjugated macromolecule based on benzodipyrrole, and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the fused ring conjugated macromolecule based on the benzodipyrrole is shown as a formula I, and the fused ring conjugated macromolecule comprises a fused ring benzodipyrrole central core and electron-withdrawing terminal groups, wherein the fused ring benzodipyrrole central core is of a nitrogen bridge trapezoid fused ring structure, and the electron-withdrawing terminal groups are connected to two ends of the central core; the preparation process is that 4, 7-dibromo diazosulfide and homologs thereof are used as raw materials, a condensed ring benzodipyrrole center core is obtained through Stille coupling, vilsmeier-Haack and other reactions in sequence, and then a terminal group structure is introduced through Knoevenagel reaction. The fused ring conjugated macromolecule has good solubility as a receptor material, is easy to process into a film, has a good photoelectric conversion function, and is used for preparing an organic solar cell device, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency reaches to about 16% of the conversion efficiency of a single cell. Meanwhile, the material is easy to form nano particles, and carriers are easy to form on the surface after photons are absorbed, so that the photocatalytic hydrogen production rate is improved.

title_en: Benzisoxadiazole derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of benzoselenadiazole, and particularly relates to a benzoselenadiazole derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein an electron donating group at a 4-position and a conjugated electron withdrawing group at a 7-position in a chemical structure of the benzoselenadiazole derivative are regulated and controlled, the maximum visible absorption wavelength is in a near infrared region above 650nm, the triplet state conversion rate is high, active oxygen species can be generated with higher efficiency under the condition of illumination, the active oxygen species has better killing effect on cancer cells and cancer tissues, and the side effect on normal cell tissues is achieved, so that the technical problems that the maximum light absorption wave band of a photosensitizer is positioned outside a near infrared band, the absorption efficiency on near infrared rays is low, and the active oxygen generation efficiency under illumination is lower in the prior art are solved.

title_en: A erianin derivative with antitumor activity, its pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a erianin derivative, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The derivative is obtained by taking the erianin as a parent body through chemical synthesis means, and is characterized in that the structure is as shown in a general formula (1): the antitumor activity test result shows that the prepared erianin derivative has good inhibition effect on esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cell lines and non-small cell lung cancer cell lines.

title_en: Compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound which has the following structural general formula: formula (I); in the formula (I), R  1  Is hydrogen or hydrocarbyl; r is R  2  Is that Ether or thioether groups; wherein R is  3  Is alkylene, R  4  Is hydrogen or alkyl; r is R  5  Is alkyl. The invention develops a brand new chemicalThe synthetic route of the compound adopts microwave reaction, the reaction time is shorter, and the yield and purity of the prepared compound (such as denavirine hydrochloride) are higher, thus being a very good new method.

title_en: Antineoplastic marsdenia tenacissima alcohol and high-purity preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antitumor marsdenia tenacissima alcohol and a high purity preparation method thereof, wherein 3 kinds of marsdenia tenacissima alcohols A (tenacissimol A), marsdenia tenacissima alcohols B (tenacissimol B) and marsdenia tenacissima alcohols C (tenacissimol C) with remarkable antitumor effect are prepared from marsdenia tenacissima simultaneously after the marsdenia tenacissima is decocted with water and then subjected to macroporous resin, silica gel column chromatography and HPLC preparation separation.

title_en: Preparation method and preparation system of hydroxyalkyl acrylate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a preparation system of hydroxyalkyl acrylate, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, adding raw material acrylic acid and a catalyst into a condensation reaction kettle (200), wherein the catalyst is prepared by compounding zinc chloride and copper powder according to a mass ratio of (1-5): 1, stirring and heating to 80 ℃ by steam, slowly introducing ethylene oxide into the reaction kettle, controlling the reaction temperature to 90+/-5 ℃, and carrying out heat preservation reaction for half an hour after the addition of the ethylene oxide is completed, thus obtaining a condensation product hydroxyethyl acrylate. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, has reasonable design, avoids material loss by utilizing the alternate scraping film and removing the attachments, and carries out adaptive selection on the removing modes of the attachments according to the attaching degree of the attachments, so that the invention selects the proper removing modes of the attachments under the condition of not influencing the service life of the parts, thereby having higher social use value and application prospect.

title_en: Preparation and application of levocetirizine hydrochloride intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a levocetirizine hydrochloride intermediate, and the preparation method and application of the levocetirizine hydrochloride intermediate are characterized in that the levocetirizine hydrochloride intermediate with high quality is obtained by taking di (2-chloroethyl) amine as a raw material, carrying out formic acid esterification reaction, cyclizing (R) - (4-chlorophenyl) (phenyl) methylamine, reducing to obtain the levocetirizine hydrochloride intermediate, and carrying out substitution reaction to obtain the levocetirizine hydrochloride.

title_en: Preparation method of elsholtzia extract, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an elsholtzia extract, a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing herba Moslae with water, and leaching to obtain herba Moslae extractive solution; concentrating the herba Moslae extract under reduced pressure, mixing with yeast, and fermenting to obtain herba Moslae fermentation broth; filtering the fermented liquid of herba Moslae, and drying. The invention uses high-pressure hot water for leaching, can improve the dissolution rate of the effective components in the elsholtzia, and is assisted by fermentation technology, thereby improving the biological activity of the effective components in the elsholtzia; the preparation process of the invention does not use any organic solvent or toxic or harmful chemical substances, is harmless to human bodies, is environment-friendly, can be applied to the fields of functional foods, health care products, medicines or functional cosmetics, and the like, and realizes industrial production.

title_en: Oxadiazolone compound, weeding composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides oxadiazolone compounds, herbicidal compositions and uses thereof. The application substitutes oxadiazolone group shown in the formula (a) at the position between sulfonyl and Cl on benzene ring of the benzoyl compound to obtain the oxadiazolone compound, which not only has unexpected high herbicidal activity on various weeds, but also is safer to various crops such as corn, rice and the like. Experimental results show that the compound provided by the invention has good weeding activity, can effectively control weeds such as barnyard grass, crabgrass, abutilon and the like at low dosage, has good weeding effect, and is safe to crops.

title_en: Cyclotriphosphazene derivative silicon-based solid amine material and application thereof in preparation of cyclic carbonate by catalyzing coupling of carbon dioxide and epoxide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material synthesis catalysis, and provides a cyclotriphosphazene derivative silicon-based solid amine material and application thereof in preparing cyclic carbonate by catalyzing coupling of carbon dioxide and epoxide. The whole synthesis process is simple, green and mild; the invention realizes the synthesis of the cyclic carbonate with high selectivity under the conditions of no solvent and no cocatalyst, and simultaneously realizes the simple separation and regeneration of the catalyst.

title_en: Recycling method and application of material containing methyl 4-acetoxybutyrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical industry, and discloses a recycling method and application of a material containing methyl 4-acetoxybutyrate. The method comprises the following steps: (1) In the presence of sodium methoxide, carrying out acylation reaction on a raw material containing gamma-butyrolactone and 4-acetoxymethyl butyrate and methyl acetate, and simultaneously carrying out azeotropic distillation to obtain a dry material containing alpha-acetyl-gamma-butyrolactone sodium salt; (2) Extracting and separating the dried material after treatment to obtain a crude product of alpha-acetyl-gamma-butyrolactone; (3) And (3) carrying out reduced pressure rectification on the crude product, and separating a mixture of gamma-butyrolactone and methyl 4-acetoxybutyrate to obtain a refined product of alpha-acetyl-gamma-butyrolactone. The method fully recycles the methyl 4-acetoxybutyrate produced by the alpha-acetyl-gamma-butyrolactone, and reduces the disposal amount of waste liquid; the separation of the 4-acetoxyl methyl butyrate and gamma-butyrolactone is avoided, and the energy loss is reduced; the prepared alpha-acetyl-gamma-butyrolactone has higher yield and purity.

title_en: Pteridine corrosion inhibitor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pteridine corrosion inhibitor and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method provided by the invention takes beta-propiolactam, 1, 5-dibromopentane and pteridine as monomer raw materials, and the heterocyclic corrosion inhibitor, in particular the pteridine corrosion inhibitor shown in the formula (1), is adsorbed on the metal surface, has stronger adsorption effect than the existing corrosion inhibitor, and improves the overall corrosion inhibition effect. In addition, the corrosion inhibitor is a phosphorus-free agent, and cannot cause the exceeding of total phosphorus in the circulating water.

title_en: ATR inhibitor compounds containing sulfinamide groups
abstract_en: An ATR inhibitor compound containing a sulfinamide group represented by formula (I), a process for its preparation, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, and its use in the treatment of ATR-related or ATR-mediated diseases and/or conditions.

title_en: Preparation method of dihydrazide drozine impurity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of medicine and chemistry, in particular to a preparation method of dihydrazide drozine impurity, S1: adding phthalonitrile (compound 1) into a reaction bottle, adding a solvent and strong alkali, heating, refluxing, stirring and reacting, adjusting the pH of a reaction system by using an acid solvent after the reaction is finished, and crystallizing, filtering and drying to obtain a compound 2, and S2: adding the compound 2 and a solvent into a reaction bottle, adding hydrazine hydrate, concentrating a part of the solvent under reduced pressure after the reaction is finished, crystallizing, filtering and drying to obtain a compound 3, and S3: adding the compound 3 into a reaction bottle, adding a chloro reagent, heating and refluxing to react until the reaction is finished, concentrating to remove the solvent, and then adding hydrazine hydrate. The method provides a preparation process of the dihydrazide drozine impurity 1-amino-4-hydrazino-phthalazine, and has the advantages of simple process, mild reaction conditions and capability of being prepared by a laboratory.

title_en: Covalent bond coupling-based long afterglow compound, system, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a long afterglow compound based on covalent bond coupling, a system, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the long afterglow compound absorbs photons and transmits the energy of the absorbed photons in molecules, photochemical reaction occurs in the molecules and the energy is released in the form of light energy, so that afterglow luminescence is realized; the structure of the long afterglow compound is shown as a formula I, wherein X in the formula I is selected from O or S; r is selected from one of photosensitizers; n is 1 to 15. The long persistence system includes a carrier medium for dissolving, dispersing, or adsorbing the long persistence compound. The invention can realize near infrared luminescence at 660nm and 718nm, and can be applied to the fields of biological imaging, immunodetection, cell tracking, biosensing, information encryption and the like.

title_en: Compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystal forms thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides (2 r,4ar,7 r) -3-propenoyl-12-chloro-10-fluoro-11- ((S) -2-fluoro-6-hydroxyphenyl) -2-methyl-7- ((S) -1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl) -2,3, 4a,6, 7-hexahydro-8-oxa-3, 5a,9,13 c-tetralinimidazo [3,2,1-de ] anthracene-5 (1H) -one (hereinafter referred to as "compound I") or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystalline forms thereof. The present disclosure also provides pharmaceutical compositions comprising at least one of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystalline forms thereof, as well as methods for preparing the crystalline forms. The present disclosure further provides the use of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a crystalline form thereof or a pharmaceutical composition comprising at least one of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a crystalline form thereof in the prevention and/or treatment of a disease, in particular a disease mediated by a KRAS G12C mutation. The crystal form of the compound I or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof has excellent hygroscopicity, solubility and stability.

title_en: Nucleoside phosphoramidite monomer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nucleoside phosphoramidite monomer, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the R of the invention is used  2  After protecting the group, compared with protecting groups such as benzoyl, isobutyryl, acetyl and the like which are commonly used at present, the method increases the rigid structure in the molecular structure, improves the easy crystallinity of molecules, and enables the obtained nucleoside phosphoramidite monomer crude product to be realized by a simple crystallization scheme for separation and purification. In the DNA nucleic acid synthesized by the nucleoside phosphoramidite monomer, the impurities of depurination and lack of bases are fewer.

title_en: Selective HER2 inhibitors
abstract_en: The present invention provides selective HER2 inhibitors. Specifically, the invention provides a compound shown as a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein each group variable is defined as in the specification.

title_en: Preparation method and application of vinyl trimethoxy silane coupling agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a vinyl trimethoxy silane coupling agent, wherein the preparation method of the vinyl trimethoxy silane coupling agent comprises the following steps of S1, mixing silicon powder with methanol to generate trimethoxy silane under the action of a first catalyst; S2, mixing trimethoxy silane with acetylene and an organic solvent, reacting under the action of a second catalyst to obtain a first mixture, S3, introducing a substance for treating hydrogen into the first mixture, stirring to obtain a second mixture, and S4, rectifying the second mixture, and separating to obtain purified vinyl trimethoxy silane. The preparation method solves the problem of hydrogen bond in vinyl trimethoxy silane, solves the problem of ethyl trimethoxy silane in vinyl trimethoxy silane, ensures that the purity of the product reaches more than 99.9%, fully meets the application requirement of the POE adhesive film tackifying auxiliary agent, and is easy for industrial production in the whole process.

title_en: Supported AuPd bimetallic catalyst and application thereof in catalysis of methoxylation reaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supported AuPd bimetallic catalyst prepared by reacting chloroauric acid (HAuC l)  4  ·3H  2  O) and sodium chloropalladate (Na  2  PdC l  4  ) Uniformly mixing the solutions, adding Graphene Oxide (GO) solution, neutralizing with alkali liquor, regulating pH value of the mixed solution, heating and stirring the mixed solution, cooling and curing, removing upper layer solution, centrifuging and washing the lower layer precipitate for multiple times, and drying and crushing to obtain supported bimetallic Au  3  Pd  2  @rgo catalyst. The Au and Pd bimetallic synergistic catalyst has high catalytic activity, can be recycled for multiple times, and reduces the cost of the catalyst; loading of metal with oxygenThe graphene can better improve the dispersibility of the nano particles, reduce the agglomeration of the nano particles in the catalytic process, improve the catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency of the nano particles, and improve the recycling rate of the catalyst in the reaction.

title_en: Method for catalytic hydrogenation treatment of chloroacetic acid mother liquor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of acyclic or carbocyclic compounds with halogen introduced and halogen atoms replaced by other halogen atoms, in particular to a method for preparing chloroacetic acid by an acetic acid catalytic chlorination method. A method for preparing chloroacetic acid by an acetic acid catalytic chlorination method adopts a fixed bed hydrogenation catalytic reactor, and the mother liquor is fully contacted and reacted with hydrogen on the surface of a solid heterogeneous hydrogenation catalyst to convert the polychloroethylene acetic acid into monochloroacetic acid, and the chloroacetic acid mother liquor after hydrolysis reaction enters the reactor from the top after being preheated to a certain temperature; the hydrogen enters the reactor from the bottom at normal temperature, absorbs heat in the rising process and gradually rises in temperature, the hydrogen and chloroacetic acid mother liquor are in reverse contact with the catalyst, the hydrogen absorbs heat released by hydrogenation reaction, the reaction temperature in the tower is maintained at 150-170 ℃, a gas phase product is generated and is discharged from the top of the reactor, after condensation and gas-liquid separation, the liquid phase product returns to the bottom of the hydrogenation reactor, and then the liquid phase product is pumped to a rectification unit to obtain a high-purity monochloroacetic acid product.

title_en: Organic compound, electronic component, and electronic device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and provides an organic compound, an organic electroluminescent device and an electronic device. The organic compound has the structure shown in the formula 1, and can obviously improve the performance of devices.

title_en: Purine derivative compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine synthesis, and particularly relates to a purine derivative compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The polysubstituted purine compounds have a structure shown in a formula (I). Wherein R  1 ,R 2  is defined in the specification. The invention also relates to an agricultural composition containing the compound or the salt thereof acceptable in the agro-pharmaceutical industry. The compound prepared by the invention has good safener activity, and can well remove the phytotoxicity of herbicide mesosulfuron to crops after use, thereby being beneficial to the growth of crops. Compared with the similar compounds, the compound provided by the invention has good detoxification effect and safety.

title_en: Continuous flow synthesis method of key intermediate of MELK inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly relates to a continuous flow synthesis method of a key intermediate of a MELK inhibitor. The continuous flow synthesis method of the invention comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing a raw material A into a solution A, pumping the solution A and the raw material B into a high-efficiency mixing module, mixing, and reacting in a reaction module to obtain a reaction solution A comprising an intermediate A; and 2, after the temperature of the reaction solution A is increased by the rapid temperature increasing module, continuing to react in the high-temperature reaction module, and separating by the gas-liquid separation tower to obtain a product. The method has the advantages of short route, low cost, simple process, safety and environmental protection, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Crystal preparation method of trelagliptin succinate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a trelagliptin succinate crystal, and belongs to the technical field of bulk drug crystallization. Adding succinic acid low molecular alcohol solution into the trelagliptin alkali low molecular alcohol solution to obtain suspension, adding a low molecular ester solvent with the mass of 2-3 times of that of succinic acid in the first step into the suspension, cooling in a gradient manner, and growing crystals at the end temperature to obtain the small-granularity trelagliptin succinate crystals with the D90 less than 10 microns. The method couples the two steps of salification and refining into one step, greatly improves the process efficiency and reduces the production cost. The process is stable, strong in controllability, good in batch-to-batch stability, low in cost, and suitable for industrial production, and the molar yield can reach 90% -97%.

title_en: Preparation method of octadecyl oleamide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of octadecyl oleamide. The preparation method of the octadecyl oleamide comprises the following steps: and (3) taking oleic acid and octadecylamine as raw materials, adding a carbon-supported catalyst, and reacting for 1-2 hours at the temperature of 150-180 ℃ under normal pressure to obtain the octadecyloleamide. In the preparation process of the octadecyl oleamide, the carbon-supported catalyst prepared by a brand new method is added, so that the reaction condition is milder and the reaction time is greatly shortened compared with the method described in Chinese patent No. 109336780A.

title_en: Multi-effect composition containing recombinant collagen and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-effect composition containing recombinant collagen, a preparation method and application thereof. The multi-effect composition provided by the invention adopts the ancient Chinese magnolia and perilla fruit nanocapsules, so that the bioavailability of functional active ingredients is effectively improved, and the supramolecular carnosine can protect collagen and elastin from oxidative stress, so that a good skin structure is maintained, the composition has an anti-saccharification effect, the supramolecular kapok with an anti-oxidation effect and the supramolecular carnosine, collagen and the ancient Chinese magnolia and perilla fruit extracts are matched for use, the skin problem is solved by the synergistic effect, and the effects of resisting oxidation, promoting skin regeneration and resisting saccharification are further improved.

title_en: Continuous purification device and method for recovering methanol in maltol/ethyl maltol production
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for continuously recycling and purifying methanol in the production of maltol/ethyl maltol, which belong to the field of chemical industry, wherein the device comprises a mixer, a primary extraction unit and a secondary extraction unit; the mixer is used for mixing and extracting the extractant and the recovered methanol; the first-stage extraction unit comprises an extraction first-stage heavy phase tank and an extraction tower, wherein the heavy phase mixed and extracted by the mixer overflows to the extraction first-stage heavy phase tank, and the light phase overflows to the extraction tower; the secondary extraction unit comprises an extraction secondary heavy phase tank and a methanol recovery tank; the heavy organic matters extracted by the extraction tower enter the extraction secondary heavy phase tank, the light phase methanol extracted by the extraction tower enters the methanol recovery tank, a continuous purification mode is adopted, and a two-stage extraction and one-time distillation process is adopted, so that continuous and automatic operation of the device is realized, the generation of chlorination side reaction is reduced through purification of the recovered methanol, the ethyl maltol yield is improved, and the consumption of raw material methanol is saved.

title_en: Composition for protecting and repairing skin barrier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cosmetic preparation, in particular to a composition for protecting and repairing skin barrier and a preparation method thereof. The composition for protecting and repairing the skin barrier comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 4-20 parts of plant extract, 4-20 parts of emollient, 4-20 parts of skin conditioner, 5-30 parts of humectant and 0.5-2 parts of pH regulator; the plant extract is at least one of Ginseng radix extract, radix Angelicae sinensis extract, glycyrrhrizae radix extract, radix Sophorae Flavescentis extract, herba Portulacae extract, fructus Citri sinensis extract, herba Rosmarini officinalis extract, herba Centellae extract, rhizoma Bletillae extract, and Kochiae fructus extract; the humectant comprises at least one of radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii extract, aloe extract, gardenia jasminoides ellis flower extract, flos Camelliae Japonicae extract, erythritol, glycerol, and dipropylene glycol. The application can effectively resist external stimulus, effectively protect skin immune barrier, repair damaged skin in time, care skin health, and make skin glow again.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of harmful substance detection, in particular to a fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A, and a preparation method and application thereof. The fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A is a compound of fluorescent dye DOCE and serum albumin through hydrogen bond, wherein the chemical structural formula of the fluorescent dye DOCE is shown as the specification As shown. The fluorescence probe prepared by the invention is used for rapidly and quantitatively detecting ochratoxin A (OTA), and the detection method has the advantages of ultra-fast response speed (5 seconds), high sensitivity (the detection limit is 0.39 ppb) and high selectivity, and has been successfully applied to on-site rapid detection of real food samples such as flour, white wine, red wine and the like.

title_en: Pyrazolo [1,5-a ] pyrimidine derivatives as sigma ligands
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel compounds of formula (I') as sigma ligands having a strong affinity for sigma receptors, sigma 1 receptors and/or sigma 2 receptors. The invention also relates to a method for the production thereof, to a composition containing the same and to the use thereof as a medicament.

title_en: Cationic hybrid nano protein with entrapped biodegradable enzyme and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cationic hybridization nano protein for encapsulating biodegradable enzyme, and preparation and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the lactoferrin and the reducing agent are dissolved in water together to react to obtain a reduced lactoferrin solution; mixing the reduced lactoferrin solution and the biodegradable enzyme solution, regulating the pH value to 6-8 to obtain a mixed solution, and then adding absolute ethyl alcohol to mix and homogenize to obtain a mixed solution; and performing ultrafiltration concentration on the mixed solution to obtain the product. The cationic hybridization nano protein targets the negatively charged biomembrane part through electrostatic adsorption and releases cellulase to disintegrate the bacterial biomembrane; the bacterial cell membrane selective permeability loss can be induced by the self-carried cation adsorption combined with the negatively charged lipopolysaccharide layer in the bacterial cell wall, and bacterial iron death is caused by utilizing the self-iron chelating property; in addition, the nano protein not only can target hydrolysis and deeply penetrate bacterial biological membranes, but also can inhibit bacterial growth efficiently by destroying bacterial walls and blocking bacterial metabolic pathways.

title_en: Device system and method for preparing cyclic carbonate through diol ring esterification
abstract_en: The invention provides a device system and a method for preparing cyclic carbonate by glycol cyclic esterification, wherein the device system comprises a reaction unit, a gas-liquid separation unit and a refining unit which are sequentially connected, the reaction unit utilizes nitrile compounds as auxiliary agents to realize cyclic esterification of glycol and CO  2  to synthesize the cyclic carbonate, the reaction unit comprises any one of a fixed bed reactor, a bubbling bed reactor or a fluidized bed reactor, the liquid feeding and discharging mode of the reaction unit comprises upper liquid feeding and lower liquid discharging or upper liquid discharging, the gas-liquid separation unit comprises a first separation device and a second separation device which are sequentially connected, and the refining unit comprises a light component removing tower, a heavy component removing tower and a high purity tower which are sequentially connected. The invention utilizes the nitrile compound as an auxiliary agent to realize the efficient cyclic esterification of the diol to synthesize the cyclic carbonate, has the advantages of safe production process, high conversion rate and simple and convenient operation, and provides a new innovation route for the industrialized preparation of the cyclic carbonate.

title_en: Water-soluble supermolecule azelaic acid for hair and its synthesis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hair water-soluble supermolecule azelaic acid and a synthesis method thereof, belonging to the technical field of supermolecules. The method for synthesizing the water-soluble supermolecule azelaic acid comprises the following steps: mixing azelaic acid, lactic acid and panthenol, stirring and heating to self-assemble supermolecule hydrogen bonds among azelaic acid, lactic acid and panthenol to form an organic whole; cooling to obtain water-soluble supermolecular azelaic acid. The invention utilizes supermolecule technology to make azelaic acid, lactic acid and panthenol form organic whole body through intermolecular hydrogen bond (the content of azelaic acid in system can be up to 39%), can raise azelaic acid water solubility effectively, and the supermolecule azelaic acid can be diluted directly by water, and can still keep system stability up to 50 times, has no solid precipitation, and is favorable for formula application.

title_en: Supported platinum catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrosilylation catalysts, and particularly relates to a supported platinum catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing ferroferric oxide, tetraethoxysilane and an organic solvent for hydrolysis reaction, mixing the obtained silicon dioxide coated ferroferric oxide, the organic ligand functionalized trialkoxysilane and the organic solvent for condensation reaction, and mixing the obtained organic ligand functionalized ferroferric oxide, a platinum compound and the organic solvent for coordination reaction to obtain the supported platinum catalyst. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the platinum complex is successfully grafted on the surface of the ferric oxide by adopting a chemical coupling method, and the obtained supported platinum catalyst is easy to separate from a reaction system when the heterogeneous catalytic reaction is carried out, so that the product yield of the addition reaction is high, the catalyst stability is high, the catalyst can be recycled, and the service life is long.

title_en: Carbazole derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, in particular to a carbazole derivative and application thereof. The carbazole derivative has a structural formula shown in formula (I)The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The carbazole derivative shown in the formula (I) provided by the invention has a diazaborocarbazole heterocyclic structure. The compound is applied to an organic electroluminescent element, so that the driving voltage can be obviously reduced, the luminous efficiency can be improved, and the service life can be prolonged;

title_en: Method for recovering D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine and ammonium chloride from crystallization mother liquor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine and ammonium chloride from crystallization mother liquor, which comprises the following steps: removing protein and pigment impurities remained in the enzyme method synthesized D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine crystallization mother liquor by adopting an ultrafiltration membrane; and then concentrating the mother liquor by utilizing the solubility difference of D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine and ammonium chloride, namely decompressing and evaporating the mother liquor at a higher temperature, crystallizing and separating out the D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine, recovering to obtain the D-p-hydroxyphenylglycine, crystallizing and separating out the ammonium chloride under the condition of reducing the temperature of the concentrated mother liquor, and recovering to obtain the ammonium chloride. The invention skillfully utilizes crystallization at two temperatures to realize the comprehensive recovery of two effective components in the mother liquor; the recovery process does not introduce new substances, eliminates the use of high-risk, high-energy-consumption and high-pollution-discharge working procedures, has the advantages of safety, energy conservation, environmental protection, low cost, high recovery product yield and good quality, and is very suitable for industrialized popularization.

title_en: Main body material, preparation method thereof and organic electroluminescent device comprising main body material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and provides a main material, a preparation method thereof and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the main material, wherein the general structural formula of the main material is shown in the specification. According to the invention, the anthracene group is introduced into the benzonaphthofuran to change the rigid structure of the compound, so that the stability is enhanced. The adjustable HOMO, LUMO energy levels and suitable singlet and triplet energy levels are suitable as constituent materials for the light-emitting layer in organic electroluminescent devices, in particular as host materials. The organic electroluminescent device prepared by the material has the advantages of low driving voltage, high efficiency and long service life. In addition, deuteration in the compound has the effects of improving the luminous efficiency of the organic electroluminescent device and prolonging the service life.

title_en: Compound containing chain carboxylic acid amide structure, preparation method and application thereof, and bactericide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pesticide bactericides, and discloses a compound containing a chain carboxylic acid amide structure, a preparation method and application thereof, and a bactericide. The compound has excellent control effect on plant diseases caused by oomycetes such as cucumber downy mildew, phytophthora infestans and phytophthora capsici, is equivalent to the existing commercial oomycete disease control medicament fluorothiazole pyrifos, and has good market development prospect.

title_en: Binuclear platinum (II) emitters for red and/or near-infrared OLEDs
abstract_en: Binuclear platinum (II) complexes and methods of making and using the same are described herein. The design of the dinuclear platinum (II) complexes results in photoluminescence of red-deep red, with high quantum yields, short emission lifetimes and fast radiation decay rates at room temperature. The dinuclear platinum (II) complexes can be used to fabricate red and/or NIR emitting OLEDs.

title_en: Soybean fermentation liquor with anti-aging effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of soybean fermentation broth, a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of crushing and degreasing soybeans to prepare a fermentation medium; sterilizing the fermentation medium at 121deg.C under 0.1Mpa for 20min to obtain sterilized fermentation medium; inoculating Lactobacillus paracasei and Lactobacillus plantarum respectively into MRS culture medium at 37deg.C, 200Culturing at rpm for 18-24 hr until the concentration of thallus reaches 10  6  ～10  7  And (3) inoculating the CFU/mL into a sterilized fermentation medium with an inoculum size of 5% -10% for fermentation culture, and filtering by a ceramic membrane to obtain soybean fermentation filtrate. The soybean fermentation liquor is rich in protein, polysaccharide, flavone and the like, and has synergistic effect with probiotics which are fermentation products in the fermentation liquor, so that stronger anti-aging effect is shown.

title_en: Water-dispersible composite hydrophilic modified curing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-dispersible hydrophilic modified curing agent and a preparation method thereof. The structure of the curing agent is that The curing agent obtained by modifying the long-chain isocyanate and introducing the long-chain alkyl, the cyclic alkyl and the amphoteric hydrophilic group has high NCO content, good water dispersibility, long service life and good water resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of quizalofop-p-ethyl
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of quizalofop-p-ethyl, which takes R- (+) -2- (4-hydroxy phenoxy) propionic acid and tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol as raw materials, and obtains a (tetrahydrofuran-2-yl) methyl (2R) -2- (4-hydroxy phenoxy) propionic acid ester intermediate through esterification reaction under the catalysis of a protonic acid catalyst, and the obtained intermediate is subjected to etherification reaction with 2, 6-dichloro quinoxaline, a catalyst and an acid binding agent, so that the content and the optical purity of the quizalofop-ethyl product are effectively improved, and the content is more than 98.5 percent and the optical purity is more than 99 percent.

title_en: Organic silicon elastomer with regular structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a regular organosilicon elastomer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly, reacting cyclic siloxane with an alkenyl group or cyclic siloxane with a hydrosilylation group with polyorganosiloxane capable of carrying out a crosslinking reaction with the cyclic siloxane with an alkenyl group or the cyclic siloxane with a hydrosilylation group in the presence of a catalyst to obtain an organosilicon initial product, and then rolling and curing the organosilicon initial product to obtain the regular organosilicon elastomer; according to the preparation method, the extrusion force in the rolling and curing treatment is utilized to enable the molecular chains in the organosilicon primary product to be extended, and simultaneously the organosilicon primary product is cured in the rolling process, so that the structure of the obtained organosilicon elastomer is normalized, and further the organosilicon elastomer with excellent smoothness and spreadability, no oil and powder are produced, and the organosilicon elastomer with the structured structure is suitable for being applied to daily chemical products.

title_en: SuFEx click chemical reaction activated by intramolecular sulfur bond and product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a SuFEx click chemical reaction activated by intramolecular sulfur bonds, a product and application thereof, wherein alkyl sulfonyl fluoride containing the intramolecular sulfur bonds is taken as a raw material, phenol, alcohol or amine and alkali are taken as reagents, and the raw materials react in a solvent to generate sulfonate/sulfonamide compounds. The method establishes a new method for carrying out high-efficiency Sufex reaction on the alkylsulfonyl fluoride and provides a new way for linking the thiol compound and the N/O-nucleophile. The SuFEx click chemistry reaction based on the activation of the intramolecular sulfur bond greatly improves the reactivity of the alkyl sulfonyl fluoride, improves the atomic utilization rate of the reaction, has mild and simple reaction conditions, is low in price and easy to obtain reaction reagents, and has the advantages of quick reaction, high yield and good functional group compatibility. The invention also discloses alkyl sulfonate and/or sulfonamide compounds with gamma-position being chalcogen elements synthesized by utilizing the SuFEx click chemical reaction activated by intramolecular sulfur bonds and application of the alkyl sulfonate and/or sulfonamide compounds in pesticides and medicines.

title_en: Monolavir-caprolactam eutectic and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicinal chemistry, and particularly relates to a minora-caprolactam eutectic, a preparation method and application thereof. Mo Nuola the co-crystal of the pyrroside-caprolactam consists of Mo Nuola of pyrroside and caprolactam according to a molar ratio of 1:1.9-2.1, and X-ray powder diffraction has a characteristic peak at 6.91、7.09、8.38、11.24、12.52、13.26、13.87、14.24、15.22、16.82、17.31、19.73、20.22、20.53、20.84、21.90、22.28、22.52、22.95、23.51、23.75、24.00、24.31、24.86、25.35、26.44、27.41、28.02、28.69、29.22、29.84、30.33 by using Cu-K alpha radiation and expressed as 2 theta + -1 angle. Mo Nuola the co-crystal of the pyrrosia-caprolactam can be successfully prepared by a grinding method and/or a solution method, a grinding method and/or a melting method, the preparation process is simple, the purity of the obtained product is high, and the product is characterized as a new co-crystal. The powder flowability and tabletting test shows that the Mo Nuola-caprolactam eutectic phase provided by the invention has better flowability and tabletting compared with Mo Nuola-caprolactam eutectic phase I, and can meet the requirements of preparation and production process.

title_en: Reusable gamma-ray film fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reusable gamma-ray film fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides application of rhodamine B hydrazide and polyvinylidene chloride as fluorescent probe materials for detecting gamma rays; the invention also provides a gamma-ray film fluorescent probe which is a film formed by rhodamine B hydrazide and polyvinylidene chloride on a substrate; the invention also provides a preparation method, a use method and a resetting method of the gamma-ray film fluorescent probe. The film provided by the invention has the advantages of high sensitivity, good precision, good portability, simple and quick detection method and reusability as a fluorescent probe; by using the fluorescent probe, the gamma rays can be rapidly detected. Meanwhile, the fluorescent probe has lower manufacturing cost and simple preparation method, and is more beneficial to popularization and use.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for specifically detecting alanine and preparation method and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent probe for specifically detecting alanine, a preparation method and a detection method thereof. The fluorescent probe takes BINOL as a framework, the structure of the fluorescent probe is shown as a formula (1), and the structure of the fluorescent probe capable of specifically identifying high-concentration D-Ala in an aqueous phase is provided, so that the fluorescent probe can specifically identify the D-Ala in 20 amino acids in a human body, and the fluorescent probe has the advantages of specific selectivity, high sensitivity and wide detection concentration range.

title_en: 2- [ (6H-dibenzo [ b, d ] pyran-3-yl) oxy ] amide derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 2- [ (6H-dibenzo [ b, d)]Pyran-3-yl) oxy]Amide derivative, preparation method and application thereof, and 2- [ (6H-dibenzo [ b, d)]Pyran-3-yl) oxy]The amide derivative comprises a compound shown in a general formula (I), a stereoisomer shown in the general formula (I) or a salt thereof: wherein R is  1  The radical is any one of hydrogen atom, methyl, ethyl and benzyl; r is R  2  The group is any one of amino, substituted amino, azacyclyl, substituted azacyclyl, morpholinyl and substituted morpholinyl; r is R  3  The group is a substituted heterocyclic group or a substituted pyrimidinyl group; when said R is  2  When the radical is an amino group, R is  1  The radical is benzyl.

title_en: Preparation method of hydroxyl-protected intermediate, phosphatidylethanolamine compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a hydroxyl-protected intermediate, a phosphatidylethanolamine compound and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the hydroxyl-protected intermediate comprises the following steps: step S1, carrying out substitution reaction on a first raw material comprising a compound 1, a halogenated silane reagent and a first catalyst to obtain a compound 2; and S2, performing a depropanization protection reaction on a second raw material comprising the compound 2 and an acidic reagent to obtain a compound 3, namely a hydroxyl protection intermediate. The unsaturated double bond of unsaturated carboxylic acid is not destroyed and the generation of ester migration impurities is obviously inhibited, so that the quality of phosphatidylethanolamine compound products is improved, meanwhile, the process adopts milder reagents and reaction conditions, is simple and convenient to operate, is suitable for industrial scale-up production, and reduces the cost.

title_en: Organic compound, organic electroluminescent device and electronic device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of organic electroluminescence, and relates to an organic compound, an organic electroluminescent device and an electronic device using the same, the organic compound has a structure shown in a formula 1, and can be used in an organic electroluminescent device to remarkably improve the performance of the organic electroluminescent device.

title_en: Synthesis method of diphenyl silicon glycol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for synthesizing diphenyl silicon diol, which comprises the following steps: adding an organic solvent, deionized water and a solid acid catalyst into a reaction container, heating to 50-60 ℃ under stirring, then dropwise adding diphenyl dimethoxy silane, keeping the temperature at 50-60 ℃ for reflux after the dropwise adding is finished, filtering the solid acid catalyst after the reaction is finished for 1-2 hours, removing the organic solvent and water by reduced pressure distillation, and finally performing rotary evaporation dehydration on the crystallized diphenyl silicon diol to obtain dry diphenyl silicon diol crystals; according to the invention, diphenyl dimethoxy silane is used as a raw material, solid acid is used as a catalyst, hydrolysis is carried out in a mixed solution of alcohol and deionized water, then reduced pressure distillation crystallization is carried out, dehydration and drying are carried out, and thus, the needle-shaped diphenyl silicon diol crystal with high yield and high purity is obtained; and the process is simple, the cost is low, the solid acid catalyst, the organic solvent and the water can be recycled, and the pollution of the wastewater, the waste liquid and the waste acid to the environment is reduced.

title_en: Method for preparing hydrogen-mixed natural gas and cyclic ketone compound based on catalytic cellulose of aqueous phase reforming system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing hydrogen-mixed natural gas and cyclic ketone compounds by catalyzing cellulose based on an aqueous phase reforming system, which comprises the steps of adding a Ni-based catalyst loaded by CeO  2 , zrO2 or TiO  2  into a reaction kettle, adding cellulose and water, controlling the mass of the cellulose to be 0.4-0.5% of the mass of the water, sealing the reaction kettle, replacing air in the reaction kettle, reacting for 2-4 hours at the temperature of 230-250 ℃ under the pressure of 0.1-1MPa, obtaining the hydrogen-mixed natural gas from gas components after the reaction, and obtaining the cyclic ketone compounds in a liquid phase. The method realizes that the gasification C accounts for more than 99 percent of the C proportion of the raw material, the yield of the mixed hydrogen natural gas can reach 94.3 percent, the selectivity of the mixed hydrogen natural gas can reach 71 percent, and the method utilizes cellulose resources to achieve the purposes of high efficiency, low cost, environmental protection and the like, thereby having important values for the high-valued utilization of cellulose and the development of environmental protection energy.
