title_en: Perylene diimide derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a perylene diimide derivative and application thereof, wherein the chemical structural general formula of the perylene diimide derivative is as follows: the invention improves the optical property of the traditional perylene diimide dye and improves the molecular color purity of the dye; solves the problems that the thermal stability and the solvent resistance do not meet the industrial production requirement and the solvent is dissolved in a color photoresist systemThe perylene diimide compound with good performance is screened out and used as a dye to be applied to optical filters of display and sensing devices such as liquid crystal displays, image sensors and the like.

title_en: Paeoniflorin extraction, separation and purification and anti-aging activity research method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biology, and particularly discloses an extraction, separation and purification method of paeoniflorin and an anti-aging activity research method of paeoniflorin. The white peony root extract comprises the following raw materials: 200ml of 1-propyl-3-methylimidazole phosphate monobasic ionic liquid and 20ml of 90% ethanol. By adopting the technical scheme, the ionic liquid is used as the extraction solvent, so that the solubility and the permeability of paeonia lactiflora cells are enhanced, the efficiency is improved, 90% ethanol is used as an auxiliary agent, impurities are effectively removed, and paeoniflorin is further purified; the formula is simple and easy to prepare, a plurality of reference examples are arranged, the proportion is strict, the extraction rate and the purification degree of paeoniflorin are improved by the obtained process route, and the anti-aging activity research proves that the paeoniflorin has a certain anti-aging activity, so that a scientific basis is provided for the application of the paeoniflorin in the anti-aging field.

title_en: Purification method and application of stevioside RB
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purification method and application of stevioside RB, and belongs to the technical field of stevioside RB purification. The purification comprises the following steps: extracting, flocculating, filtering, adsorbing, desorbing, desalting and decolorizing stevioside containing RB to obtain a stevioside-enriched material E; eluting the material E by a column, collecting effluent liquid from 8 th to 10 th times, mixing, filtering and drying to obtain a material H; mixing the effluent collected in the 6 th to 7 th times and the 11 th to 15 th times to obtain a mixed solution I, and adsorbing and desorbing to obtain a material K; and mixing the material H and the material K for multiple times, and recrystallizing to obtain the high-purity stevioside RB.

title_en: Allyl ether compound, resin composition, and cured product thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an allyl ether compound capable of forming a cured product excellent in low dielectric characteristics, high heat resistance and the like, a resin composition thereof, and a cured product obtained from the resin composition. The allyl ether compound isCharacterized by being represented by the following general formula (1).

title_en: PLLA poly-L-lactic acid microsphere for stimulating collagen regeneration
abstract_en: The application relates to PLLA poly-L-lactic acid microsphere for stimulating collagen regeneration, which comprises the following raw materials: the poly-L-lactic acid microsphere compound comprises poly-L-lactic acid microsphere with four molecular weights of 20-30kDa, 50-60kDa, 70-90kDa and 100-130kDa, an active type I collagen alpha 1 precursor chain compound and mannitol. The poly-L-lactic acid microsphere compound of the four different molecular weights is selected, and is difficult to degrade because the single molecular weight is large to form vascular embolism, the poly-L-lactic acid microsphere of the four different molecular weight intervals is selected, the two microspheres of small molecular weight can be well paved on the shallow dermis, the microspheres of medium molecular weight and high molecular weight can be well filled in the deep dermis, the collagen stimulation effect can be better shown, the later degradation is accelerated, and the vascular embolism is not easy to occur safely enough.

title_en: Hair-moistening essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hair-moistening essence, relates to the technical field of hair-care preparations, and aims to solve the problem that the existing essence has more chemical components and damages hair and forehead skin, and adopts the technical scheme that the hair-moistening essence comprises the following components: the hair conditioner is characterized by comprising water, a humectant, a thickening agent, a natural plant extract, a bactericide, a preservative and a PH regulator, wherein the natural plant extract is used as a raw material, so that the hair conditioner is non-irritating, safe and harmless, has no burden on hair and scalp, has a good nourishing and repairing effect, enables the hair to be more smooth and elastic, and is beneficial to the growth of the hair and the prevention of bifurcation; propylene glycol is adopted as a humectant, so that a moisturizing effect can be initiated on the head; and xanthan gum is used as a thickening agent, so that the hair-nourishing essence has good texture and use feel.

title_en: Preparation method of large Kong Huangsuan cation polystyrene resin catalyst, catalyst and application
abstract_en: A process for preparing the cationic polystyrene resin catalyst with big Kong Huangsuan includes such steps as preparing the aqueous solution containing disperser to become dispersed phase, mixing styrene monomer, divinylbenzene monomer, trigger and non-benign solvent as pore-forming agent to obtain a single phase, mixing the dispersed phase with the single phase to obtain a suspension, heating to 94-96 deg.C, polymerizing, thermal solidifying to obtain a stable structure, washing with water, drying, sieving to obtain the big-pore polymerized white balls with granularity of 0.3-1.3mm, cross-linking degree of 15-27% and pore diameter of 40-120nm, and modifying by adding weak base or weak base salt.

title_en: Universal NK cell public library, NK cell preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general NK cell public library, an NK cell preparation and a preparation method thereof, wherein, mononuclear cells obtained by single separation of 50-100mL umbilical cord blood are amplified in vitro for 7-10 days by using trophoblasts, the number of NK cells is calculated according to a surface marker detection result, and the NK cells are frozen to obtain a general NK cell seed library, and when the general NK cell seed library is applied, seed cells and the trophoblasts are co-cultured according to an accurate proportion, and the NK cell preparation with the purity of more than 90% can be obtained after induction culture for 7-10 days again. The invention adopts a secondary amplification mode, firstly prepares NK seed libraries, then carries out short-term amplification culture on seed library cells to obtain NK cell preparations with high purity and excellent quality, the method only needs a small amount of umbilical cord blood, and the final cell preparation can obtain 1-3 multiplied by 10  12  The NK cells can meet the dosage of 1000 times.

title_en: Novel salts of 2-amino-2- (2- (1-decyl-1H-1, 2, 3-triazol-4-yl) ethyl) propane-1, 3-diol and pharmaceutical compositions containing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel salt of 2-amino-2- (2- (1-decyl-1H-1, 2, 3-triazol-4-yl) ethyl) propane-1, 3-diol and pharmaceutical compositions containing the same. Compared with hydrochloride of 2-amino-2- (2- (1-decyl-1H-1, 2, 3-triazol-4-yl) ethyl) propane-1, 3-diol and other salts, the novel salts of 2-amino-2- (2- (1-decyl-1H-1, 2, 3-triazol-4-yl) ethyl) propane-1, 3-diol of the present invention exhibit excellent effects in terms of low hygroscopicity, standard solution stability, photostability, oxidative stability, stability according to pH, solubility, etc., and the pharmaceutical composition of the present invention comprising the novel salts as an active ingredient can be usefully used as a prophylactic or therapeutic agent for multiple sclerosis (multiple sclerosis), cerebral ischemia (ischem), focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, FSGS), inflammatory bowel disease (inflammatory bowel disease), interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (Interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy, IFF) or alopecia areata (ALOPECIAA, AA).

title_en: Au/HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5 catalyst for hydrochlorination of acetylene as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Au/HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5 catalyst for acetylene hydrochlorination, a preparation method and application thereof. The Au/HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5 catalyst comprises a carrier and a gold active component loaded on the carrier, wherein the carrier is a doped hydrogen bond organic framework HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5. The invention provides the application of the Au/HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5 catalyst in the reaction of synthesizing chloroethylene by catalyzing hydrochlorination of acetylene, and the Au/HOF-Co0.5Fe0.5 catalyst has better stability and higher activity.

title_en: Novel stabilized mallow anthocyanin derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel stabilized malva anthocyanin derivative which has the following characteristics The structure is shown, wherein, the structural formula of R is 、 Or (b) Any one of the following. The invention adopts mallow anthocyanin powder and chlorogenic acid powder to react under the action of ultrasonic wave to generate three mallow anthocyanin derivatives with novel structures. The invention also discloses a derivative mixture which is obtained by mixing three malva anthocyanin derivatives with novel structures, and has good application in protecting retina medicines, treating organ aging medicines and improving intestinal flora diversity medicines.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing ethane and propane from heptane, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for preparing ethane and propane from heptane, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises: a molecular sieve support, a binder component and a modifying component; based on the total weight of the catalyst, the mass percent of the molecular sieve carrier is 50% -80%; the mass percentage of the binding component calculated by oxide is 17% -35%; the mass percentage of the modified component calculated by oxide is 3% -15%; the modifying component comprises an oxide of at least one metal of nickel, gallium, copper and zinc. The catalyst can efficiently convert heptane into ethane and propane, and has higher conversion rate and ethane-propane selectivity to heptane at lower temperature.

title_en: Substituted heteropolycyclic compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and relates to a substituted heteropolycyclic compound, a pharmaceutical composition containing the same and application thereof. Specifically, the invention relates to a compound shown in a formula (I) and a formula (II) or a pharmaceutically acceptable form thereof, which shows good Wee1 inhibition activity, can be used as a high-efficiency Wee1 inhibitor and is used for preventing and/or treating Wee1 related diseases.

title_en: Energy-saving system for methyl hydrazine concentration section by ammonia chloride method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fine chemical energy-saving equipment, in particular to an energy-saving system for a methyl hydrazine concentration working section by a chlor-ammonia method, wherein an inlet at the lower end of a separator is connected with a first forced circulation reboiler, an outlet at the lower end of the separator is connected with a second forced circulation reboiler, the lower end of the second forced circulation reboiler and a feeding pipeline are both connected with the first forced circulation reboiler, an outlet at the upper end of the separator is connected with a rectifying tower, the upper end of the rectifying tower is connected with a compressor, the lower end of the rectifying tower is respectively connected with a thermosiphon reboiler, a falling film reboiler and a discharging pipeline, the thermosiphon reboiler is connected with the rectifying tower, the compressor is respectively connected with inlets of heating pipelines of the first forced circulation reboiler, the second forced circulation reboiler and the falling film reboiler, and the outlet of the reflux tank is connected with the upper end of the rectifying tower. The system provided by the invention has the advantages of lower cost, safer process and higher efficiency.

title_en: Dehydration device and dehydration method based on cyclohexane product
abstract_en: The application provides a dehydration device and a dehydration method based on cyclohexane products. The cyclohexane product-based dehydration unit comprises: a vaporizer, a condenser, a reaction system and a pipeline system; the reaction system comprises a first reactor, a second reactor and a third reactor, and the pipeline system comprises a feeding pipe and a discharging pipe; the feeding pipe, the vaporizer, the first reactor, the second reactor, the third reactor, the condenser and the discharging pipe are sequentially connected in series; the first reactor, the second reactor and the third reactor are respectively connected with at least one stop valve in series and connected with at least one stop valve in parallel; the first reactor and the second reactor are both provided with a diluent and a molecular sieve, and the third reactor is provided with a molecular sieve. The embodiment of the application improves the quality of the product; the service life of the molecular sieve is prolonged, and the replacement times are reduced; the molecular sieve is replaced without stopping the reactor, so that the continuous and stable operation of production is ensured; is beneficial to stable and safe operation and can reduce the production cost.

title_en: Selective oxidation catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydrogen selective catalytic oxidation reaction in ethylbenzene dehydrogenation, and discloses a selective oxidation catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises a carrier, and a main catalytic component, a promoting component and a modifying component which are loaded on the carrier, wherein the main catalytic component consists of an inner core containing noble metal elements and a silicon dioxide protective layer covered on the inner core. The selective oxidation catalyst has higher catalytic activity and selectivity in the hydrogen selective catalytic oxidation reaction in the ethylbenzene dehydrogenation process, has higher catalytic stability and can reduce the aromatic hydrocarbon loss rate. The catalyst can be used in industrial production of hydrogen selective catalytic oxidation reaction in ethylbenzene dehydrogenation process, and has extremely high application value.

title_en: Preparation method of porous-grade kagome covalent organic framework material and application of porous-grade kagome covalent organic framework material in catalytic synthesis of lactide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a porous grade kagome covalent organic framework material, which comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing the ligand 1 and the ligand 2, adding an organic solvent into the mixture, refluxing the mixture for 20 to 30 hours at the temperature of between 90 and 150 ℃, cooling the mixture to the room temperature, concentrating the mixture, filtering the mixture, and washing the mixture to obtain an imine bridging compound; (2) Mixing the imine bridging compound with diethyl phosphite, trimethyl bromosilane and acetonitrile or methanol, sealing, refluxing for 20-30h at 90-110 ℃, cooling to room temperature, concentrating, filtering, washing and drying to obtain the porous-grade kagome covalent organic framework material. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses application of the material in catalytic synthesis of lactide. The kagome covalent organic framework material has better crystallinity, low density, high specific surface area and rich active sites, can efficiently convert raw material lactic acid to catalyze and form lactide products, and has good stability.

title_en: Method for constructing sequencing library and sequencing method
abstract_en: The application provides a construction method and a sequencing method of a sequencing library. The construction method of the application is characterized in that after a first restriction enzyme digestion is carried out on a sample to be detected, the sample is connected with a first joint segment, one or more new endonuclease sites are preset in the first segment, and a second restriction enzyme is used for carrying out enzyme digestion and enzyme digestion on enzyme digestion recognition sites in the first joint segment and then is connected with a second joint, so that joints for qualitative and quantitative analysis are connected at specific sites or upstream and downstream of specific sequences. The sequencing library constructed by the application can be detected by a plurality of gene detection platforms, including a PCR platform, a sequencing platform and the like.

title_en: Efficient and stable construction method for full flow of plasma cfDNA secondary sequencing
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a full process of efficient and stable plasma cfDNA second-generation sequencing, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing a collected plasma sample, extracting cfDNA in the plasma sample, and then sequentially carrying out final repair connection, PCR amplification and purification on the cfDNA, so that a high-throughput mechanical extraction scheme is finally constructed, the extraction efficiency and the extraction stability are both improved, and the extraction of 32 samples can be completed simultaneously; the steps of library establishment are simple, the cost is low, and the input amount is as low as 1ng. The cfDNA extracted by the method has no large fragment pollution, is sent to be tested after library construction, and can obtain the sequencing result required by the subsequent data analysis only by low-depth whole genome sequencing, thereby greatly compressing the sequencing cost, completing the whole experiment by only 600 microliter of plasma, ensuring stable sequencing result and qualified parameters.

title_en: Liquid crystal composition comprising ceramide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liquid crystal composition including ceramide, a method of preparing the same, and a cosmetic composition including the same, according to an aspect, the liquid crystal composition including various types of ceramide and the method of preparing the same, not only have high liquid crystal stability, which is capable of maintaining a liquid crystal state even after 4 weeks at high temperature, but also have activity, which is increasing the ceramide content of skin, increasing the expression amount of aquaporin 3, increasing the expression amount of filaggrin, increasing the expression amount of hyaluronic acid, increasing the expression amount of pappalysin, increasing the expression amount of mantle protein, increasing the thickness of skin, to be effectively used for improving the skin state.

title_en: Cyclohexanol recycling device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cyclohexanol recovery device and method, wherein the device comprises a cyclohexanol evaporator, a first heat exchanger, a first cyclohexanol rectification recovery component, a second heat exchanger, a ceramic membrane filter, a preheater and a second cyclohexanol rectification recovery component; the feed inlet of the cyclohexanol evaporator is used for communicating with a cyclohexanol separation tower; the product outlet of the cyclohexanol evaporator is communicated with the first cyclohexanol rectification recovery component through a first heat exchanger, the discharge outlet of the cyclohexanol evaporator is communicated with the feed inlet of a second heat exchanger, the discharge outlet of the second heat exchanger is communicated with the feed inlet of a ceramic membrane filter, and the product outlet of the ceramic membrane filter is communicated with the second cyclohexanol rectification recovery component through a preheater. The method is used for recycling cyclohexanol at the source before waste oil is mixed, and meanwhile, the catalyst is filtered before rectification, so that the risk of blocking the catalyst on a subsequent working section is avoided, and the recycling simplicity and the recycling efficiency of cyclohexanol can be improved.

title_en: Preparation method of astaxanthin intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an astaxanthin intermediate, which takes 4-oxo vinyl-beta-ionol as a raw material, branched hydroxyl groups are firstly protected and etherified, then manganese triacetate is used for carrying out acetoxylation on 4-carbonyl alpha-hydrogen, and finally 3-hydroxyl-4-oxo vinyl-beta-ionol is obtained through hydroxyl deprotection and acetoxylation saponification; the reaction raw materials are simple and easy to obtain, and side reactions on branched chains and six-membered rings are avoided; only four steps of reactions are needed, so that the reaction route is shortened; the method has the advantages that no high-risk raw materials are used, no other toxic and harmful byproducts remain in the product, the safety is high in the production process, and the product meets the use standard; therefore, the whole preparation method has the advantages of less manpower, material resources and financial resources, high safety and suitability for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Platycladus orientalis extract and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, in particular to a biota orientalis extract and a preparation method and application thereof. The biota orientalis extract comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0.121 to 0.902 portion of isoquercitrin, 1.113 to 2.420 portions of afugin, 2.825 to 4.481 portions of amentoflavone, 0.090 to 2.234 portions of Korean pine lactone and 510.61 to 759.44 portions of dextro quinic acid. The biota orientalis extract provided by the invention contains a certain amount of isoquercitrin, aftoside, amentoflavone, korean pine lactone and D-quinic acid, has the effects of preventing and treating alopecia, and can be used as an anti-drop raw material for anti-drop products.

title_en: Novel peptide-based nitrile compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel peptide nitrile compound and application thereof, in particular to a compound shown in a formula (I) and/or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound and/or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a method for preparing the compound and application of the compound in treating diseases caused by cathepsin C and downstream serine protease thereof.

title_en: Catalyst for continuously synthesizing HMT, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for continuously synthesizing HMT, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of organic catalytic synthesis. The invention synthesizes a new polymer acid catalyst by taking styrene, divinylbenzene and styrene as raw materials, wherein the polymer of the cross-linked structure is provided with sulfonic acid groups, which is similar to a resin catalyst, and has the advantages of acid and alkali resistance, organic corrosion resistance and the like, and has strong catalytic effect. When the HMT is continuously catalyzed and synthesized, the selectivity is high, the continuous production is easy to realize, the corrosiveness is low, the requirement on equipment materials is low, the three wastes generated in the reaction process are less, and the HMT has a crosslinked structure, high mechanical strength, high heat resistance and high chemical stability and long service life. Through detection, when the catalyst is used for continuously synthesizing HMT, the reaction conversion rate of the p-isopropyl toluene reaches more than 95%. The catalyst can be repeatedly used, and after 30 days of recycling, the reaction conversion rate of the catalytic p-isopropyl toluene still reaches more than 90%.

title_en: Composition for organic electroluminescent device and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition for an organic electroluminescent device, and simultaneously provides an organic electroluminescent device employing the composition. The composition for an organic electroluminescent device includes a combination of a first compound having a structure as shown in formula I and a second compound having a structure as shown in formula II:  The composition is suitable for a luminescent layer of an organic electroluminescent device, can be used as a main material to realize the transmission balance of holes and electrons, and can regulate and control the position of the recombination center of the electrons and the holes in the luminescent layer to occur at the central position of the luminescent layer, thereby effectively improving the efficiency and the service life of the device; in addition, the energy level difference between the organic electroluminescent material and the doping material is small, so that the loss in the energy transfer process is less, the utilization rate of excitons is improved, the luminous efficiency of the device is further improved, the organic electroluminescent device has excellent efficiency and stability, and the service life of the device is remarkably prolonged.

title_en: Purine polymerizable high-refraction monomer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic chemistry, in particular to a purine polymerizable high-refraction monomer. From the experimental results, the serial monomers synthesized in the invention have higher refractive index; meanwhile, compared with monomers with high sulfur content, the series of purine compounds have lighter color and have certain application potential in the field of high-refraction optical devices.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ginseng fermentation liquor
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of ginseng fermentation liquor, which comprises the steps of obtaining fermentation raw materials, taking ginseng as the raw material, crushing and puffing to obtain the fermentation raw materials, carrying out primary fermentation, carrying out enzymolysis by amylase and amyloglucosidase to obtain enzymolysis liquor A, carrying out secondary fermentation, adding rhizopus oryzae and lactobacillus mixed liquor into the enzymolysis liquor A, carrying out aerobic fermentation for 45-48 hours, carrying out anaerobic fermentation for 28-35 hours to obtain fermentation liquor B, and sequentially filtering, sterilizing, standing, centrifuging, membrane filtering and collecting filtrate to obtain ginseng fermentation filtrate. The ginseng fermentation composition prepared by the invention has remarkable effects on wrinkle resistance and compactness of skin.

title_en: Production method and production device of bridge-type tetrahydrodicyclopentadiene
abstract_en: The application discloses a production method and a production device of bridge-type tetrahydrodicyclopentadiene, wherein the production method comprises a reaction stage and a separation stage; the reaction stage comprises: introducing raw materials containing dicyclopentadiene I and hydrogen I into a reactor, contacting with a catalyst, and reacting to obtain a hydrogenation reaction product; the separation stage comprises: and sequentially carrying out gas-liquid separation, rectification separation I and rectification separation II on the hydrogenation reaction product to sequentially obtain hydrogen II, hydrogen III, dicyclopentadiene II and bridge-type tetrahydrodicyclopentadiene. The method can be used for the production of bridge-type tetrahydrodicyclopentadiene, has continuous process and simple flow, saves energy consumption through hydrogen multistage compression, and is suitable for industrialized large-scale continuous operation.

title_en: Method for preparing methanol by integrating carbon dioxide trapping and hydrogenation by using Cu-based catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing methanol by integrating carbon dioxide trapping and hydrogenation by utilizing a Cu-based catalyst; the preparation method of the supported copper-based catalyst protected by doping C, P and other elements takes a copper source and an aluminum source as raw materials, ammonia water as a precipitator, soluble sugar as a carbon source and phosphoric acid as a phosphorus source, and the supported copper-based catalyst doped with C, P and other elements is obtained by adopting dipping, calcining and reducing, wherein the catalyst component comprises Cu, al  2 O 3 , C or P and other components. The copper-based catalyst in the invention realizes carbon dioxide trapping and hydrogenation to prepare methanol under the liquid phase, and solves the problem of low yield of the methanol prepared by carbon dioxide hydrogenation under the liquid phase.

title_en: Preparation method of caprolactone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of caprolactone, which comprises the following steps of reacting raw material 2-allyl amyl alcohol with carbon monoxide and hydrogen in the presence of a catalyst to prepare caprolactone. The catalyst comprises nickel and/or cobalt, phosphorus-nitrogen ligands and an auxiliary agent. Compared with the existing production technology, the method uses 2-allyl amyl alcohol and synthesis gas to prepare caprolactone through one-step reaction, and avoids the use of high-risk peroxides. And the non-noble metal coupled phosphorus-nitrogen ligand catalytic system is used for the carbonylation reaction, so that the selectivity of caprolactone is greatly improved.

title_en: Metal organic framework material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application discloses a metal organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the metal organic framework material is [ Zn  a F b N c ]·L d ·G e ; wherein L is an organic ligand, G is a guest molecule in the pore canal, a is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 6, b is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 6, c is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 4, d is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 6, and e is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 12. The ZnFN-MOFs provided by the application have stable Zn-F and Zn-N coordinate covalent bonds, can keep a rigid stable structure in a water-gas environment or soaked in water, and are suitable for gas adsorption, industrial catalysis and separation in a humid environment.

title_en: Obtaining aliphatic amines from compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for obtaining amines from a composition by means of distillation and to a composition obtainable by this process. The invention also relates to a method for producing isocyanates from the compositions obtainable.

title_en: Benserazide hydrochloride Z2And method for separating and measuring related impurities thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine analysis, and particularly relates to a separation and determination method of benserazide Z  2  hydrochloride and related impurities thereof. The related impurities comprise any one or more of impurity A, impurity SM  2  and impurity Z  2a ; the method is a high performance liquid chromatography, and specifically comprises the following steps: adopting octyl alkyl silane bonded silica gel as a filler, taking phosphate buffer solution as a mobile phase A and methanol as a mobile phase B, and sequentially separating an impurity A, benserazide hydrochloride Z  2 , an impurity SM  2  and/or an impurity Z  2a  through linear gradient elution; then the mixture enters an ultraviolet detector for detection to obtain a chromatogram, and the content of each component is calculated by an external standard method. The analysis method can simultaneously realize separation and quantification of the benserazide hydrochloride Z  2  and related impurities thereof within 35 minutes, and has the characteristics of strong specificity, high sensitivity and good durability.

title_en: Small molecules for degradation of DOT1L and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to bifunctional compounds, compositions and methods for treating diseases or conditions mediated by aberrant telomere silencing interfering 1 (DOT 1L) activity.

title_en: Probiotic composition for inhibiting fungal proliferation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising one or more isolated probiotic strains, two or more active substances in the one or more isolated probiotic strains, or a combination of one or more isolated probiotic strains and two or more active substances in the one or more isolated probiotic strains; and an acceptable carrier, wherein the one or more isolated probiotic strains and/or two or more active substances in the one or more isolated probiotic strains are capable of inhibiting fungal proliferation.

title_en: Combination pharmaceutical composition of CDK4/6 inhibitor and aromatase inhibitor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a combination pharmaceutical composition of a CDK4/6 inhibitor and an aromatase inhibitor, and to the use thereof for the treatment of breast cancer. The combination pharmaceutical compositions of the present disclosure produce better efficacy in reducing tumor growth or even eliminating tumors as compared to either drug alone in the combination.

title_en: D '-A' -DAD-A '-D' type condensed ring interface material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in photovoltaic cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a D '-A' -DAD-A '-D' type condensed ring interface material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in photovoltaic cells. The condensed ring interface material has a structure shown in a general formula I; the D '-A' -DAD-A '-D' fused ring interface material provided by the invention is prepared through simple and efficient coupling reaction, has the characteristics of self-assembly, self-doping, good film forming property and high electron mobility, can be applied to perovskite photovoltaic cells as an efficient cathode modification interface material, and can effectively reduce energy level barrier, reduce energy loss and enhance charge transmission performance, thereby enhancing the energy conversion efficiency and long-term stability of devices. The interface material is suitable for various perovskite photovoltaic cells.

title_en: Nanofiber membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present application relates to nanofiber membranes and methods of making the same. The nanofiber membrane comprises cerium oxide and polyvinyl alcohol fibers, wherein the cerium oxide is wrapped or embedded in the polyvinyl alcohol fibers, and the nanofiber membrane has strong oxidation resistance and antibacterial performance.

title_en: Synthesis method of mannose triflate intermediate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine synthesis, and particularly relates to a synthesis method of mannose triflate intermediates. The invention takes D-mannitol as a raw material, firstly protects one of hydroxyl groups at the tail end of the D-mannitol, then protects the residual hydroxyl groups, and then removes the terminal hydroxyl protecting groups, oxidizes and removes the residual hydroxyl groups to protect the residual hydroxyl groups to obtain a target product. The synthesis method of mannose triflate intermediate provided by the invention has the advantages of few reaction steps, simple operation process, high yield and low production cost, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Composition with slow release repairing function from natural sources and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of skin care products and preparation thereof, and discloses a composition with a slow release repairing function from natural sources, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-60 parts of carrageenan gel, 20-30 parts of rhizobia gel and 10-30 parts of hydrolyzed algin gel; the carrageenan gel is prepared by crosslinking carrageenan extract, sodium pyrrolidone carboxylate and water; the rhizobia gel is prepared by crosslinking rhizobia gel, pyrrolidone magnesium carboxylate and water; the hydrolyzed algin gel is prepared by crosslinking hydrolyzed algin tetrasodium pyrophosphate, pyrrolidone calcium carboxylate and water. The preparation method adopts specific preparation process steps and addition sequence to obtain the multi-crosslinked composition gel, and then the powder mixture is prepared by low-temperature vacuum drying. The powder mixture has slow release active substances, self-repairing effect, and can be used for thickening and suspending.

title_en: Self-assembled hole transport material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-assembled hole transport material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The self-assembled hole transport material has the following structural general formula:  ; wherein L is an alkylene chain of C  2 ~C 18 , X  1 、X 2 、X 3 、X 4 、X 5  and X  6  are each independently CR or N, R is selected from one or more of hydrogen, alkyl of C  1 ~C 3 , alkoxy of C  1 ~C 3 , alkylthio, hydroxy, cyano, amino, nitro, aryl of substituted or unsubstituted C  6 ~C 30 , arylamine of substituted or unsubstituted C  6 ~C 30 , heteroaryl of substituted or unsubstituted C  6 ~C 30 , and heteroarylamine of substituted or unsubstituted C  6 ~C 30 . The self-assembled hole transport material can coordinate with exposed lead ions at the interface of the perovskite layer to form stable chemical bond action, enhance interface interaction, improve interface charge transport efficiency, passivate interface defects and reduce interface recombination loss.

title_en: Composition containing rose polypeptide and having anti-wrinkle effect, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rose-containing polypeptide composition with anti-wrinkle tightening effect, a preparation method and application thereof, and aims to provide a composition which can enhance DPPH free radical and hydroxyl free radical scavenging capability, enhance collagen secretion capability, has moisturizing effect, can slow down elastin degradation by inhibiting elastase activity and has good anti-wrinkle tightening effect; the technical proposal comprises 1 to 10 wt percent of component A, 5 to 10 wt percent of component B, 0.1 to 3 wt percent of component C and 3 to 10 wt percent of component D; the balance of the component E; the component A is rose composite polypeptide; the component B is rose compound polysaccharide; the component C is rose compound polyphenol; the component D is hydroxypropyl tetrahydropyran triol; the component E is a solvent and preservative system; belongs to the technical field of cosmetics.

title_en: Whitening skin care essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly discloses a whitening skin care essence and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the whitening skin care essence comprises the following steps: adding 0.1-0.5 part of bisabolol and 1-3 parts of octanediol into 50-60 parts of water, heating and stirring, then adding 0.1-1 part of arginine, 1-3 parts of hyaluronic acid, 1-3 parts of trehalose, 0.1-0.5 part of allantoin and 0.5-1 part of tetrahydropyrimidine carboxylic acid, continuously stirring, cooling, then adding 40-50 parts of nano liposome compound, 0.2-0.8 part of preservative, 0.01-0.05 part of daily essence and 0.2-0.8 part of triethanolamine, stirring, cooling, discharging and filling to obtain the product. The skin care essence prepared by the invention is mild to skin, has good absorption effect, can improve skin quality, shrink pores, lighten spots and lighten skin, and achieves the purposes of whitening and nourishing skin.

title_en: Oxadiazole ring derivative, and composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medicines, in particular to oxadiazole ring derivatives shown in a formula I, a composition and application thereof, and a method for preparing the derivatives and intermediates thereof, wherein the derivatives and the compositions can be used for preparing medicines for treating pathological characteristic diseases with indoleamine 2, 3-dioxygenase-mediated tryptophan metabolic pathways.

title_en: Composition with lamellar liquid crystal structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition with a lamellar liquid crystal structure, which comprises the following components: 10-50 wt% of a surfactant; 1-12 wt% fatty acid/fatty alcohol; 1-12% by weight of glycerol laurate; and a carrier acceptable in the personal care product arts; wherein fatty acid/fatty alcohol: the weight ratio of the glycerol laurate is 1:3-2:1. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the composition with the lamellar liquid crystal structure and application of the composition in cosmetics.

title_en: Recombinant humanized silk fibroin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant humanized silk fibroin and a preparation method and application thereof. In the recombinant humanized filaggrin, a humanized FLG protein fragment with a KIF polymerization function is obtained by mutating a proFLG protein fragment by at least one amino acid, wherein the mutation is that arginine is point mutated into lysine, the proFLG protein fragment comprises a plurality of basic tetrapeptides which can form a beta-turn structure and have the KIF polymerization function, and at least one of the basic tetrapeptides contains one or more arginines. The recombinant humanized silk fibroin has long-acting property, can be applied to the purposes of skin barrier damage repair, allergy relief of dry sensitive skin, repair and moisturizing, and symptom depth relief of atopic dermatitis and the like caused by silk fibroin deficiency, and can also be used for preparing dressing, skin external medicines, cosmetics, tissue engineering materials and silk fibroin sponge.

title_en: Treatment of NF- κB mediated diseases
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods of treating or alleviating the symptoms of muscular dystrophy in a human patient between 1 day and 18 years of age comprising administering to the human patient in need thereof a therapeutically effective amount of valve Mo Luotong and/or a salt thereof.

title_en: Preparation method of Chinese herbal medicine fermentation primary pulp with anti-allergic effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of Chinese herbal medicine fermentation primary pulp with anti-allergic effect, which specifically comprises the following steps: step S101, activating strains: carrying out bifidobacterium strain and lactobacillus strain activation through line drawing and fungus shaking to obtain activated strains; step S102, preparing medicinal materials: pulverizing and sieving the composite materials of cortex Dictamni Radicis, flos Matricariae Chamomillae, radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii and Glycyrrhrizae radix to obtain semi-finished product; the invention is based on fermentation technology: the microorganism is subjected to large-scale growth culture to generate chemical change and physiological change, so that a large amount of metabolic products required by human fermentation are generated and accumulated, and bifidobacteria and lactobacillus are utilized to perform composite fermentation on cortex dictamni, chamomile, cactus and liquorice, so that a fermentation liquid which is anti-allergic, safe, mild and good in skin affinity is produced, and the fermentation liquid is suitable for adding of cosmetic raw materials.

title_en: Trithiocarbonate and application thereof in preparation of narrow-distribution poly-p-acetoxystyrene
abstract_en: The invention discloses trithiocarbonate and application thereof in preparing narrow-distribution poly-p-acetoxyl styrene, belonging to the technical field of polymer chemistry. The preparation method of the trithiocarbonate RAFT chain transfer agent provided by the invention has the advantages that the preparation steps are simple, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the prepared narrow-distribution poly-p-acetoxystyrene can be hydrolyzed into poly-p-hydroxystyrene for 248nm photoresist film-forming resin.

title_en: For the production of C6-C12Method for preparing alkyl (meth) acrylates
abstract_en: A process for producing a C  6 -C 12  -alkyl (meth) acrylate, the process comprising an esterification step of (meth) acrylic acid with an alcohol to obtain a crude (meth) acrylate, the (meth) acrylic acid containing a trace amount of acetic acid; and a purification step of purifying the crude (meth) acrylate. The purification step includes introducing crude (meth) acrylate to a side of a low boiler column having a rectifying section disposed above a feed point of the crude (meth) acrylate and a stripping section disposed below the feed point; withdrawing purified (meth) acrylate from the low boiler column; withdrawing a low boiler fraction from the top of the low boiler column, the low boiler fraction comprising alcohol and acetate and less than 10 wt% of (meth) acrylate esters; directing the low boiler fraction to an acetate column, the acetate column operating at a pressure at least 50 mbar higher than the low boiler column pressure and separating the low boiler fraction into an alcohol fraction withdrawn at the top of the acetate column and an acetate fraction withdrawn at the bottom of the acetate column; and recycling the alcohol fraction at least partially to the esterification step; the process does not include recycling from the acetate column to the low boiler column. The process provides an efficient and economically viable process for preparing C  6 -C 12  -alkyl (meth) acrylates having low acetate content.

title_en: Aromatic heterocyclic compound and application thereof
abstract_en: Discloses an aromatic heterocyclic compound and application thereof. The invention provides an aromatic heterocyclic compound shown in a formula I, which has better LSD1 enzyme inhibition activity, can be used as an LSD1 inhibitor and is used for treating tumors and the like.

title_en: Method for recycling light olefin monomers by directional pyrolysis of waste plastics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling light olefin monomers by directional pyrolysis of waste plastics, which comprises the following steps: putting the molecular sieve catalyst into a second-stage reaction zone of a quartz tube of a tube furnace, introducing carrier gas, and heating the tube furnace to pyrolysis temperature; injecting an initiator into a first-stage reaction zone of the tubular furnace, and decomposing to generate free radicals; sending the waste plastic raw material into a first-stage reaction zone of a tubular furnace, carrying out deep depolymerization on volatile matters generated by preliminary pyrolysis under the induction action of free radicals generated by the decomposition of an initiator, blowing a product into a second-stage reaction zone by carrier gas, and further cracking under the catalysis action of a molecular sieve; the initiator comprises nitropropane and the molecular sieve catalyst comprises HZSM-5. The invention adds the initiator which can generate a large amount of active free radicals in the process of catalytically pyrolyzing the waste plastics, so that the waste plastics are deeply depolymerized before catalytic reaction, the light olefin gas yield is finally improved, byproducts such as alkane, aromatic hydrocarbon and the like are reduced, and carbon deposition of the catalyst is inhibited.

title_en: Zirconia catalyst, preparation method thereof and method for preparing cyclic carbonate by catalysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a zirconia catalyst, a preparation method thereof and a method for preparing cyclic carbonate by catalysis, wherein the preparation method of the zirconia catalyst comprises the following steps: mixing a zirconium source with alkali liquor, performing an aging reaction and/or a hydrothermal reaction, and then roasting; the method for preparing the cyclic carbonate by catalysis comprises the following steps: the linear carbonic ester, the diol compound and the zirconia catalyst are mixed for transesterification. The preparation method of the cyclic carbonate provided by the invention takes the linear carbonate and the diol compound as raw materials, the reaction condition is mild, the cyclic carbonate can be prepared in high yield under normal pressure, the product yield is high and is easy to separate, the yield can especially reach 99.2%, the selectivity of the used zirconia catalyst to the product is high, especially can reach 99.9%, the cyclic carbonate can be recycled, the economy is good, and the cyclic carbonate has good application potential.

title_en: Method for synthesizing 2, 5-dihydroxymethyl tetrahydrofuran by catalyzing 5-hydroxymethylfurfural
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method of catalyzing synthesis of 2, 5-dimethyloltetrahydrofuran from 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, the method comprising: dissolving 5-hydroxymethylfurfural and an alkaline substance in formaldehyde solution, adding a ruthenium and zinc oxide composite catalyst, mixing the obtained reaction solution, and placing the mixture in a closed reaction container; and then introducing nitrogen into the reaction vessel, and catalyzing formaldehyde to decompose by utilizing a ruthenium and zinc oxide composite catalyst under an alkaline condition in situ to generate hydrogen in the nitrogen atmosphere, so that the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural is subjected to hydrogenation reaction to obtain the 2, 5-dimethyloltetrahydrofuran.

title_en: Visible light absorption cell membrane dye based on embedded conjugated polyelectrolyte, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a visible light absorption cell membrane dye based on a membrane-embedded conjugated polyelectrolyte, which comprises a conjugated hydrophobic skeleton and polar hydrophilic side chains connected to two sides of the conjugated hydrophobic skeleton, wherein the cell membrane dye has amphipathy; can self-assemble with lipid bilayer on cell membrane; the conjugated hydrophobic skeleton is a fluorescent group; the conjugated hydrophobic skeleton is of a D-A-D structure; the D-A-D structure which is provided with a conjugated framework and is connected with two hydrophilic side chains at two ends and is constructed by the technical scheme of the invention not only can adjust absorption and emission wavelength through changing a receptor unit, but also can enable the receptor feeding part to be in a hydrophobic environment of a phospholipid membrane, reduce the collision of solvent micromolecules on the hydrophilic part of the receptor, and improve fluorescence quantum yield; the stability of the organic conjugated framework can reduce the photobleaching of the probe, ensure the high stability of the probe molecule, and compared with the commercial membrane dye in the prior art, the invention has more uniform and stable cell membrane dyeing effect.

title_en: Amino-substituted fused heteroaryl compounds, preparation method thereof and application thereof in medicine
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to amino-substituted fused heteroaryl compounds, methods for their preparation and their use in medicine. In particular, the present disclosure relates to amino-substituted fused heteroaryl compounds of general formula (I), methods for their preparation, pharmaceutical compositions containing such compounds and their use as therapeutic agents, in particular as TYK2 inhibitors and in the manufacture of medicaments for the treatment and/or prophylaxis of TYK2 mediated or dependent diseases or conditions.

title_en: Preparation method of solid boron trifluoride piperidine complex
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a solid boron trifluoride piperidine complex, and belongs to the technical field of chemical production. Boron trifluoride is introduced into piperidine solution for complex reaction, and a complex product feed liquid is obtained; the piperidine solution comprises piperidine and an organic solvent, wherein the organic solvent is dichloromethane and/or acetone; concentrating the complex product feed liquid to obtain concentrated solution; and mixing the concentrated solution with diethyl ether for crystallization, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain the solid boron trifluoride piperidine complex. The solid boron trifluoride piperidine complex prepared by the method has higher purity, and the product is pure white crystal, and has high melting point and short melting range.

title_en: Improving the water resistance of cosmetic compositions comprising ENSO letrozole
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cosmetic composition comprising a UV filter ENSO ribavirin, an ester of a fatty acid with dextrin, and a mixture of branched and linear saturated C15-C19, wherein the mixture mainly comprises branched saturated C15-C19. The cosmetic composition exhibits enhanced water resistance of the sun protection factor.

title_en: Naphthyridinone derivatives for use in the treatment of diseases or disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds having formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, wherein A, R  1  and R  3  are as described herein, as well as compositions and methods of using such compounds.

title_en: Polypeptide and method for preparing amino acid using same
abstract_en: A polypeptide which comprises a sequence having 90% or more sequence identity to a sequence in which 1 amino acid residue in the amino acid sequence represented by sequence number 1 is changed, and which has a higher catalytic activity under at least one reaction condition for a reductive amination reaction of any 1 or more of a salt thereof of the compound a represented by the formula (1) with any 1 or more of a salt thereof of the compound B represented by the formula (2) or for an intramolecular reductive amination reaction of any 1 or more of a salt thereof of the compound B than the aforementioned catalytic activity of the polypeptide having the amino acid sequence represented by sequence number 1.

title_en: Separation method and application of flavonoids GLYASPERIN D of uralensis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separation method and application of a glycyrrhiza flavonoid compound GLYASPERIN D. The separation method comprises the following steps: extracting, carrying out medium-pressure chromatography coarse separation on QuikSeP, screening components rich in flavonoid components, preparing a reversed-phase preparation column, purifying by reversed-phase preparation liquid chromatography of Fr84, and evaluating the activity of flavonoid monomer compound GLYASPERIN D against non-alcoholic fatty liver. The glycyrrhiza flavonoid compound GLYASPERIN D is obtained by first separation, and the separation method is low in cost and the product purity is more than 95%; the invention adopts the technical means that the large-scale production can be carried out: the raw material requirements are low, the cost is low, and batch preparation is easy; the methanol is subjected to cold leaching at room temperature, so that the operation is easy; is easy to scale. The activity evaluation of the monomer compound by using a 600 mu M oleic acid-induced human liver L02 cell model shows that the flavonoid compound GLYASPERIN D has remarkable activity of resisting the non-alcoholic fatty liver and can be used for preparing the medicine for resisting the non-alcoholic fatty liver.

title_en: Maltose fatty acid ester compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a maltose fatty acid ester compound as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The compound of the formula (I) or the stereoisomer, the deuterated derivative and the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof have excellent antibacterial and anti-inflammatory biological activity, and have the advantages of quick response, long maintenance time, safety, no toxicity and high water solubility, and are suitable for being developed into clinical preparations; 。

title_en: Preparation method of trans-resveratrol
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of trans-resveratrol. In the invention, 3, 5-dihydroxybenzoic acid is taken as a raw material, and is synthesized into 3, 5-dimethoxybenzoic acid through methylation and hydrolysis; then 3, 5-dimethoxy benzoic acid and 4-methoxy styrene are mixed, and Heck reaction is carried out under the action of Boc  2  O, halogen salt, palladium catalyst and ligand to directly synthesize resveratrol trimethyl ether which is a key intermediate of resveratrol; and then, mixing resveratrol dimethyl ether with pyridine hydrochloride, and carrying out demethylation reaction to obtain trans-resveratrol. The method can prepare the trans-resveratrol with biological activity with high selectivity.

title_en: Synthesis method of vinylene carbonate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of vinylene carbonate, which comprises the following steps: in the presence of quaternary ammonium salt compounds, carrying out dehydrogenation and oxidation reaction on ethylene carbonate and specific p-benzoquinone compounds to generate vinylene carbonate; the method can synthesize the vinylene carbonate in one step, and no extra salt is generated in the process, so that the post-treatment of the product is simple, the generated byproducts can be reused after being recycled, the cost is low, the byproducts are fewer, the requirements on equipment are low, and the three wastes are fewer.

title_en: Preparation method of 4-fluoro-2-methoxy-5-nitro-N-tert-butoxyaniline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, and provides a preparation method of 4-fluoro-2-methoxy-5-nitro-N-tert-butoxyaniline, which comprises the following steps: (1) 4-fluoro-2-methoxyaniline is taken as a raw material, a solvent and alkali are added, di-tert-butyl dicarbonate is added after reaction for a period of time, and the intermediate 4-fluoro-2-methoxyaniline is obtained after treatment after reaction for a period of time; (2) Dissolving the intermediate 4-fluoro-2-methoxy-N-tert-butoxyaniline obtained in the step (1) in a solvent, then adding nitrate, slowly dropping an anhydride solution, and treating to obtain a pure 4-fluoro-2-methoxy-5-nitro-N-tert-butoxyaniline product after the reaction is completed; the preparation method has the advantages of simple equipment, easy operation, environmental friendliness, low cost and better yield, can realize commercial large-scale preparation and production, and meets the current ever-increasing market demands.

title_en: RBJ small molecule inhibitors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, in particular to RBJ small molecule inhibitors, and more particularly relates to a compound shown in a formula I, a pharmaceutical composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The compounds of the invention can be used as a highly selective and very effective RET inhibitor, can inhibit RBJ expression and/or activity, and have excellent inhibitory activity on GTPase/MEK1 protein interaction.

title_en: Benzopiperidine derivative modulators, methods of preparation and uses thereof
abstract_en: To a regulator of benzopiperidine derivative, a preparation method and application thereof. In particular to a compound shown in a general formula (I), a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound and application thereof in treating epilepsy, wherein each substituent in the general formula (I) is defined as in the specification.

title_en: Method for producing compound, method for producing compound library, and screening method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a compound having at least 1 structure represented by the following formula (I) or (II), which comprises a step of bringing a compound having at least 1 structure represented by the following formula (III) or (IV) into contact with a prenyl transferase, which is LimF or an enzyme having homology thereto, to introduce a prenyl group into the structure.

title_en: Application of sulforaphane in preparing anticarious or/and anticarious products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of sulforaphane in preparing anticarious or/and anticarious products, belonging to the technical field of biomedicine. The invention discloses application of sulforaphane in preparing anticarious or/and anticarious products. The invention adopts sulforaphane to prevent and resist caries, has definite effect and good safety. Sulforaphane has antibacterial and bactericidal effects on streptococcus mutans; can effectively inhibit the formation of a streptococcus mutans biological film; reducing acid resistance, lactic acid production and extracellular polysaccharide production of Streptococcus mutans; inhibit the occurrence and development of caries in a rat caries model. Sulforaphane has the function of better reducing the acid production capacity of streptococcus mutans than sulforaphane under the same concentration, and can better inhibit the occurrence and development of dental caries in vivo.

title_en: Preparation process and application of red-removing repair factor
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation process of a red-removing repair factor, which comprises the steps of crushing, extracting, fermenting and the like of raw materials. The herba centellae, the oat kernel and the roses are used as plant raw materials, the plant extract is obtained through water extraction, and the fermentation temperature, the fermentation time, the fermentation environment and other conditions in the fermentation process are controlled through the fermentation production process, so that the preparation of a novel repairing raw material is realized, the efficacy of the raw material is improved, the toxicity of the product is reduced, and the safety of the product is improved. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process and mild in condition, and the prepared red-removing repair factor is natural, safe, free of toxic and side effects, low in irritation, and has the effects of resisting bacteria and inflammation, removing red rapidly, promoting wound healing, relieving repair and the like. The invention also provides itching relieving repairing gel which uses the redness relieving repairing factor as a raw material and has excellent anti-inflammatory repairing effects.

title_en: Deuterated pyridone compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of chemical medicaments, and relates to a compound shown in a general formula (I), or a racemate thereof, or an isomer thereof and pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, As a PCSK9 inhibitor and methods of using the same to treat a variety of specific diseases or conditions.

title_en: Camellia oil mixture for preventing and treating infant red buttocks, miliaria, skin inflammation and promoting skin healing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixture which is prepared by taking natural camellia oil and beeswax as main raw materials and is used for preventing and treating red buttocks and miliaria of infants, diminishing inflammation of skin and promoting healing of slight wound of skin. The natural camellia oil is mixed with natural beeswax to prepare a product without additives and preservatives, wherein the natural camellia oil contains 80-90 percent of unsaturated fatty acid and simultaneously contains physiologically active components of squalene, vitamin E, linoleic acid and brass substances; the anti-acne cream is applied to skin, can achieve the effects of diminishing inflammation, sterilizing, relieving itching, preserving moisture, promoting quick healing of skin organism tissues and reducing scar generation, and simultaneously vitamin E and unsaturated fatty acid in tea oil are beneficial to keeping the elasticity and moisture of the skin, have an antioxidation effect, can be used for weakening acne marks and repairing the skin, and particularly have a good prevention and treatment effect on red buttocks and miliaria of infants.

title_en: Aryloxy phenoxy propionate compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aryloxy phenoxy propionate compound and application thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a general formula (I):  Wherein: x is selected from O or S; r  1  is selected from a direct bond or C  1 -C 6  alkyl; r  2 、R 3  is independently selected from a direct bond or C  1 -C 6  alkyl;   r  4 、R 5  is independently selected from halogen, C  1 -C 6  alkoxy, C  1 -C 6  haloalkoxy, C  1 -C 6  alkylthio,   C  1 -C 6  haloalkylthio, C  1 -C 6  alkylsulfonyl, C  1 -C 6  haloalkylsulfonyl, C  1 -C 6  alkylsulfinyl, and,   C  1 -C 6  haloalkyl sulfinyl, C  2 -C 6  alkenyl sulfonyl, C  2 -C 6  alkynyl sulfonyl, C  3 -C 6  cycloalkyl oxy,   C  2 -C 6  alkenyloxy, C  2 -C 6  alkynyloxy, C  1 -C 6  alkylcarbonyloxy, C  2 -C 6  alkenylcarbonyloxy,   c  2 -C 6  alkynyl carbonyloxy;   Chiral carbon atom is R or S configuration, or the mixture of R and S in different proportions. The compound of the invention not only has excellent herbicidal activity, but also is safe for crops.

title_en: Skid-mounted offshore methanol synthesis device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skid-mounted offshore methanol synthesis device, and relates to the technical field of methanol synthesis. Comprising the following steps: and a compression module: comprises a raw material gas compressor and a gas compressor, the synthesis module is used for inputting the mixture of the raw material gas and CO  2  after pressurizing; and a synthesis module: the device is connected with the compression module and comprises an air-cooled reactor for synthesizing crude methanol gas; and (3) a purification module: the device is connected with a synthesis module, and an anti-sloshing purification module is arranged in the synthesis module and is used for separating crude methanol gas into gaseous methanol and gaseous wastewater, and the gaseous methanol is condensed into liquid methanol through a methanol condenser; and (3) a recovery module: the device is connected with the purification module and is used for recycling non-condensable gas generated after the gaseous wastewater generated by the purification module is condensed by the circulating condenser, and the non-condensable gas is mixed with raw gas after being pressurized by the recycling compressor. The invention integrates the device into a skid-mounted platform in a layout mode with the most compact structure and the shortest pipeline/minimum pressure drop, thereby greatly reducing the transportation cost and the construction time of the offshore methanol synthesis device.

title_en: Preparation method and application of heterogeneous gamma-alumina-ionic liquid-palladium catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a heterogeneous gamma-alumina-ionic liquid-palladium catalyst. According to the method, by a heterogeneous phase loading technology, the gamma-Al  2 O 3  is grafted with triethanolamine ammonium chloride ionic liquid to load palladium; on one hand, the ionic liquid strengthens interaction between palladium nano metal and a catalyst carrier, improves the stability of the catalyst, and on the other hand, increases repulsive force among carriers, thereby effectively preventing agglomeration of nano gamma-Al  2 O 3 ; the catalyst has excellent catalytic activity when applied to Suzuki coupled catalytic reaction. The preparation process is simple, the cost is low, high yield can be realized, and the prepared catalyst not only has dispersed active sites and stable structure, but also has excellent circulation stability in the Suzuki coupling catalytic reaction, and the problem that the traditional homogeneous catalyst is difficult to separate is effectively solved.

title_en: Synthesis method of 2, 5-dichloro-p-phenylenediamine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of organic synthesis, relates to a preparation method of a chemical intermediate, and in particular relates to a synthesis method of 2, 5-dichloro-p-phenylenediamine. The method takes p-phenylenediamine as a raw material, and generates 2, 5-dichloro-p-phenylenediamine in one step through chlorination reaction. The invention has simple process route, can obtain the product by only one-step reaction, and greatly simplifies the production steps.

title_en: Imidazole compound and application thereof as pesticide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound of formula I, an isomer or a salt thereof, I, wherein D, E, F, G, X  1 、X 2 、X 3 、X 4 、X 5 、R 1  is defined as the specification. The compound provided by the invention has excellent insecticidal and acaricidal effects and good application prospects.

title_en: Microcoagulation bead skin care product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, in particular to a microcoagulation bead skin care product and a preparation method thereof. The microcoagulite skin care product prepared by the invention can select different mediums according to the dissolution characteristics of active substances, adopts spherical porous silica, beeswax and three-behenine as a carrier, and has wide selection range and large carrying capacity; the method can not only wrap and protect some active ingredients which are easy to oxidize, have poor photosensitivity and insoluble in water and oil such as polyphenol, flavonoid and the like, but also avoid the reduction of the content of the active ingredients caused by oxidation or decomposition of the active ingredients along with the extension of time, and protect the activity of the functional ingredients; the skin care composition also has a controlled release function, can enable the activity of the functional components to be slowly released on the skin, can reduce the irritation of the dangerous raw materials with more addition but sensitization and acne and the like to a certain extent, and is more beneficial to the long-acting stable absorption of the skin on the active components; in addition, the microcoagulation beads have good low-temperature stability and ion resistance, and the preparation method is simple and stable and is more economical and applicable.

title_en: Reaction device and method for continuously preparing 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous preparation device and a continuous preparation method of 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid. The method takes furoic acid as a raw material, and is divided into two steps to synthesize 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid in the presence of an alkaline catalyst, wherein the furoic acid is subjected to carboxylation reaction in the presence of the alkaline catalyst to generate furandicarboxylic acid salt, the furandicarboxylic acid salt is attached to the surface of the catalyst in a solid form, and then the furandicarboxylic acid salt is further reacted with CO  2  and methanol to generate 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid dimethyl ester. The device mainly comprises two main reactors and a catalyst circulating part, wherein the two reactor bodies are formed by a plurality of layers of fluidized beds, and the two reactors are connected by a reagent outlet pipe and a reagent outlet transfer tank, and a reagent return pipe and a reagent return transfer tank. According to the reaction device and the reaction method, the 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid can be continuously synthesized from the furoic acid, so that the reaction speed is greatly increased, the characteristic of difficult separation after the product and the catalyst are salified by the second-step esterification reaction is avoided, and the system efficiency is improved.

title_en: HyT compound for targeted degradation of DAPK1 protein and application of HyT compound in neurodegenerative diseases
abstract_en: A HyT compound which can target and degrade DAPK1 protein is shown as X-Y-Z, wherein X represents ligand of DAPK1 protein, Z represents hydrophobic functional group, and Y represents chain connecting X and Z. The compounds are useful for the treatment or prevention of Alzheimer's disease.

title_en: Method for recycling high-concentration volatile acid from wastewater containing low-concentration volatile acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling high-concentration volatile acid from wastewater containing low-concentration volatile acid, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment. The method comprises the steps of (1) extracting volatile acid from wastewater containing low concentration volatile acid by using an extractant (consisting of phosphate, n-dodecane and polydimethylsiloxane) to obtain a mixture of the extractant and the acid and a mixture of water, a small amount of acid and a small amount of extractant respectively, (2) flash-evaporating the mixture of the extractant and the acid in a flash evaporation device to obtain high concentration acid, and (3) purifying the mixture of water, the small amount of acid and the small amount of extractant in a purification device to obtain water for removing the acid and the extractant. The invention has the advantages that the high-concentration volatile acid can be directly recovered from the wastewater containing the low-concentration volatile acid, the rectification is not needed for pre-concentration, and the wastewater can be directly discharged.

title_en: Preparation method of cyclopropanecarbonyl chloride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of cyclopropanecarbonyl chloride, which belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and comprises the steps of mixing water, zinc chloride and gamma-butyrolactone, heating to 40-60 ℃, stirring once, heating to 60-80 ℃ in nitrogen atmosphere, dropwise adding thionyl chloride, stirring and preserving heat for the second time after the dropwise adding is finished, carrying out primary rectification until bubbles completely disappear and no gas is generated, continuing carrying out secondary rectification on the heavy component, and then continuing carrying out tertiary rectification on the heavy component, wherein the collected light component is the cyclopropanecarbonyl chloride; the preparation method has the advantages of high yield, simple process, less required raw materials, simple post-treatment, less fixed investment and no generation of a large amount of dangerous waste.

title_en: Preparation method of novel chiral bipyridine and application of novel chiral bipyridine in catalytic reaction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical industry, and relates to a preparation method of novel chiral bipyridine and application thereof in catalytic reaction, which is characterized in that various benzyl bromides taking binaphthyl as a framework react with 4, 5-diazafluorene to generate a series of chiral bipyridine ligands, then under the participation of the ligand and the catalysis of [ IrOMe (COD)  2  ] serving as a metal catalyst, indoline, quinoline nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compounds and bisboronic acid pinacol ester react, and then a series of phenol compounds are obtained through sodium perborate oxidation. The novel chiral bipyridine ligand developed by the method does not need strong acid and strong alkali in the process of selectively borating the C-H bond, and has the advantages of good site selectivity and excellent reaction yield.

title_en: Durable eye line gel pen refill material not easy to halate
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly discloses a pen refill material of an eye liner gel pen, which is not easy to halate and durable. The pen core material of the durable eyeliner pen not easy to halate comprises a solvent, a film forming agent, a colorant and a filler, wherein the solvent is C9-12 alkane; the film forming agent comprises bis-hydroxyethoxypropyl polydimethylsiloxane/IPDI copolymer urethane (and) isododecane, trimethylsiloxysilicate and phenylpropyl dimethylsiloxy silicate; the weight ratio of the bis-hydroxyethoxypropyl polydimethylsiloxane/IPDI copolymer urethane (and) isododecane, trimethylsiloxysilicate and phenylpropyl dimethylsiloxy silicate is (3-30): (3-20): (1-5). The pen refill material of the durable eyeliner pen, which is not easy to halate, has high film forming toughness and strong adhesive force, and enables the eyeliner to have excellent migration resistance and friction resistance effects.

title_en: Biochemical reagent for detecting mercapto of biological medicine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine development, and discloses a biochemical reagent with sulfhydryl detection and a preparation method thereof. In particular, the invention relates to compounds of the 4 mother nucleus types, as described in the specification. The use of the compounds of the invention for the detection of mercapto groups.

title_en: Preparation method and application of vinyl acetate catalyst synthesized by ethylene gas phase method
