abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a vinyl acetate catalyst synthesized by an ethylene gas phase method, wherein the main raw materials required by the preparation of the vinyl acetate catalyst are as follows in parts by weight: 300-500 parts of organic silicon dioxide carrier, 2-45 parts of active component compound precursor solution, 50-200 parts of alkali metal silicate and 150-350 parts of reducer. The preparation process is as follows: (1) Impregnating an organic silicon dioxide carrier with an active component compound precursor solution, and then standing the impregnated organic silicon dioxide carrier for 2-6 hours at room temperature; (2) Precipitating the reaction product of the step (1) by alkali metal silicate for 15-30 hours; (3) Adding a reducing agent into the reaction product obtained in the step (2) for reduction, wherein the reduction time is 2-8 h; (4) Immersing the reaction product of the step (3) in 15-90 g/L potassium salt solution, then placing the immersed reaction product in a vacuum drying oven at 60-100 ℃ for 2-8 h, and drying to obtain the finished catalyst. The catalyst obtained by the method has higher catalytic activity and product selectivity, less product impurities, good quality and high catalytic efficiency.

title_en: Perovskite quantum dot in raspberry-shaped TiO2In-situ growth method on hollow sphere and obtained product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ growth method of perovskite quantum dots on raspberry-shaped TiO  2  hollow spheres and an obtained product, wherein hollow carbon spheres are uniformly dispersed in ethanol solution, titanium alkoxide is dropwise added into the suspension in batches, the reaction is carried out after each dripping, and finally a sample is separated, a perovskite quantum dot precursor and the obtained sample are ground and uniformly mixed, then microwave treatment is carried out, and the obtained pretreated mixed sample is calcined in air to obtain the raspberry-shaped TiO  2  hollow spheres carrying the perovskite quantum dots. The invention has the advantages that under the condition of no ligand addition, the high-temperature solid phase synthesis is carried out, the crystallinity of the quantum dots is good, the interface development of the quantum dots and the TiO  2  phase is good, the defects are few, the carrier separation and the transmission are facilitated, the deposition of the quantum dots improves the specific surface area of the TiO  2  material, the photocatalytic performance is obviously improved, and the obtained composite material has important application in the fields of photolysis of water to produce hydrogen, CO  2  photocatalytic reduction, photocatalytic hydrogen peroxide production, chemical fuel conversion and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of phosphorus/silicon synergistic flame-retardant nonionic water-based polyurethane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of phosphorus/silicon synergistic flame-retardant nonionic waterborne polyurethane, which adopts PDMS, polypropylene glycol and toluene diisocyanate as main raw materials to prepare polyurethane prepolymer, adopts self-made PHAD and trimethylolpropane as chain extenders and adopts polyethylene glycol with molecular weight of 2000 as a hydrophilic chain extender to prepare nonionic waterborne polyurethane dispersoid with phosphorus/silicon synergistic flame-retardant effect. The introduction of PDMS can effectively improve the thermal stability and flame retardance of the polyurethane adhesive film; when the PDMS is introduced to 15% of the pre-polymerized polyol component, the Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI) of the adhesive film is up to 28.2%, the residual ash rate at 600 ℃ is up to 7.46%, the PHAD special molecular structure can be more effectively fused into a polyurethane network, and the PDMS is cooperated to strengthen the intermolecular interaction force, so that the overall structural strength and toughness of the material are fundamentally consolidated, embrittlement and strength loss phenomena possibly caused by the traditional silicon-based flame retardant are effectively inhibited, and the perfect balance of flame retardance and mechanical property improvement is realized.

title_en: Modified alumina with adjustable nitrogen-sulfur doping proportion, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified alumina with an adjustable nitrogen-sulfur doping proportion, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, nitrogen-sulfur heteroatoms are introduced into the alumina by introducing an in-situ polymerization decomposition method, and the doping proportion of nitrogen and sulfur can be regulated by changing the composition of a polymerization monomer, so that the pore channel structure and adsorption characteristic of the alumina can be effectively changed.

title_en: Trifunctional silane coupling agent, preparation method thereof, vulcanized rubber composition and vulcanized rubber
abstract_en: The invention provides a trifunctional silane coupling agent, a preparation method thereof, a vulcanized rubber composition and vulcanized rubber. The structural general formula of the trifunctional silane coupling agent is Wherein R  1 、R 2  and R  3  are each independently selected from any one of hydrogen, chlorine, bromine, alkyl of C  1 ～C 20 , alkoxy of C  1 ～C 20 , carboxylate of C  2 ～C 20 , cycloalkyl of C  3 ～C 20 , and aryl of C  6 ～C 20 ; and at least one of R  1 、R 2  and R  3  is selected from any one of chlorine, bromine, an alkoxy group of C  1 ～C 20 , and a carboxylate group of C  2 ～C 20 ; r  4  is selected from any one of C  1 ～C 20  alkylene, C  3 ～C 20  cycloalkylene, C  2 ～C 20  alkenylene, C  2 ～C 20  alkynylene, and C  6 ～C 20  arylene. The trifunctional silane coupling agent is used for preparing vulcanized rubber, and is beneficial to improving the compatibility of fluororubber and white carbon black.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Cu-Beta zeolite catalyst for preparing caprolactam from caprolactone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of petrochemical catalysis, and relates to a preparation method and application of a Cu-Beta zeolite catalyst for preparing caprolactam from caprolactone. The main technical feature of the invention is that dealuminated Beta zeolite is used as carrier, and the improved ammonia distillation method is used to load copper in the pore canal of zeolite carrier. The core of the improved ammonia distillation method is to impregnate the zeolite carrier with the copper ammonia complex solution in equal volume, so that the copper ammonia complex mainly has the reaction of depositing copper hydroxide in the pore canal of the zeolite carrier in the ammonia distillation process. Copper hydroxide deposited in zeolite pore canal can directly form high-dispersion nano-and sub-nano-copper particles at the lattice defect position of hydroxy nest in the pore canal after roasting and hydrogen reduction treatment, and the latter obtains anti-sintering capability through compact interaction with hydroxy nest. The Cu-Beta zeolite catalyst prepared by the method of the invention has high activity and selectivity and good stability when being applied to the reaction of preparing caprolactam by the gas-solid phase hydroamination of caprolactone.

title_en: Reductive amination method of biomass aldehyde ketone and aldehyde compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reductive amination method of biomass aldehyde ketone and aldehyde compounds, belonging to the technical field of fine chemical engineering; the preparation of the nitrogen-containing chemical by reductive amination of biomass aldehyde ketone comprises the following steps: preparing a primary amine compound from biomass aldehyde ketone and ammonia gas in a hydrogen atmosphere; the biomass aldehydes and o-nitroaniline are subjected to reductive amination under the hydrogen atmosphere to prepare the benzimidazole derivative. Compared with the prior art, the method for preparing the nitrogen-containing chemical by reductive amination of biomass aldehyde ketone has the remarkable advantages of environmental protection, low price and good stability of the Ni/GdPO  4  catalyst, easy realization of operation process conditions, strong universality, capability of preparing the target product by a one-pot method, capability of reducing side reaction and the like.

title_en: Electric heating cracking furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric heating cracking furnace applied to ethylene production, the furnace wall of the radiation area comprises a heat storage layer, a heat insulation layer and a heat preservation layer from inside to outside. An electric heating element is arranged in an inner hole of the heat accumulating brick, the end faces are in sealing connection through convex-concave curved surfaces, a vent pipe is arranged on the outer side of the heat accumulating brick, and the introduced inert gas protects the electric heating element. The heat insulating layer is made of pasty heat insulating material and has a total thickness of 10-15mm. The thermal insulation layer is internally provided with a temperature measuring device, the coupling head is arranged in a groove or a pit at the outer side of the thermal storage brick, the compensation lead is provided with a big spiral ring and a small spiral ring, the big spiral ring is arranged in the ceramic tube, and the small spiral ring is arranged in the outer end part and is fixedly connected with the outer end part in an insulating way. The furnace wall is provided with flat flame burners which are staggered at intervals, electric heating is mainly performed, and flame heating is assisted. The invention has good heat insulation effect, reduces the emission of combustion tail gas, prolongs the service life of the cracking tube, and can heat the electric heating element for a long time and effectively operate the temperature measuring device for a long time.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with pathogenic FUS variants
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of antisense oligonucleotides for reducing the expression of selected alleles of a FUS gene encoding the protein FUS or variants thereof. The invention also provides pharmaceutical compositions and methods of treating disease effects associated with pathogenic FUS genetic variants by administering antisense oligonucleotides and therapeutic compositions comprising AONs that target FUS or variants thereof.

title_en: Thioether-functionalized rare earth complex with limited geometric configuration, preparation method thereof, multipolymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a thioether-functionalized limited geometry rare earth complex shown in a formula (I); the invention also provides a multipolymer and a method for preparing the multipolymer, the method comprises the following steps: copolymerizing alpha-olefin, styrene, butadiene and styrene monomers in the presence of a catalytic system consisting of a thioether-functionalized constrained geometry rare earth metal complex, an organoboron compound and alkylaluminum to obtain a copolymer having a conjugated diene content of 20 to 80mol%, a styrene and derivative content of 10 to 40mol% and an alpha-olefin content of 10 to 60mol%;

title_en: Method for preparing benzoic acid and derivatives thereof from tertiary alcohol
abstract_en: The invention provides a new method for realizing the conversion from tertiary alcohol compounds to benzoic acid and derivatives thereof through the oxidative cleavage of carbon-carbon bonds, the method is to react for 12 to 48 hours at 120 to 200 ℃ under the atmosphere of cobalt heterogeneous catalyst and prepare benzoic acid and derivatives thereof from tertiary alcohol compounds. The method has the following advantages: 1) The substrate has wide application range and can obtain the yield of more than medium. 2) The method has the advantages of simple operation, high stability and capability of realizing gram-scale amplification without adding additives, oxidants and the like. 3) The catalyst can be recycled and reused.

title_en: Metal composite modified perovskite type zirconia catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal composite modified perovskite type zirconia catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) mixing soluble zirconium salt, citric acid and deionized water according to a certain proportion to obtain a mixed solution A, (2) dropwise adding alkali liquor into the mixed solution A to obtain a mixed solution B, (3) carrying out water bath on the mixed solution B, stirring the mixed solution B at constant temperature to be transparent gelatinous, cooling a gelatinous substance to room temperature, drying to obtain a precursor C, (4) calcining the precursor C to obtain ZrO  2  powder, (5) dissolving ZrO  2  powder into deionized water to obtain a solution, pouring a proper amount of La (NO  3 ) 3 ·6H 2  O and CrO  3 ) into the solution, stirring, drying and calcining to obtain the catalyst.

title_en: (S) -2- (4- (4-methyl-1-piperazinyl) anilino) -8-anilino-9- (3-piperidinyl) -9H-purine and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the field of anti-cancer drug formulation technology, specifically relates to a (S) -2- (4- (4-methyl-1-piperazinyl) phenylphenyl) -8-phenylphenyl -9- (3-piperidinyl) -9H purine and its application. The compound of the present invention has higher inhibitory activity on tumors insensitive to EGFR inhibitors than EGFR inhibitors, significant single drug efficacy, and can increase the sensitivity of traditional chemotherapy drugs. It has low toxicity and can be applied to the preparation of anti-cancer drug formulations.

title_en: Modified defective carbon nitride and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides modified defective carbon nitride, which consists of defective carbon nitride and modified metal, wherein the modified metal is selected from one or more of Mn, cu and Co, and the content of the modified metal is 1-10% of the modified defective carbon nitride by mass percent. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the modified defective carbon nitride. The invention also provides a method for preparing CO and CH  4  by photocatalytic reduction of CO  2 . The modified defective carbon nitride provided by the invention is used for double modification of specific metal elements and defective sites of the carbon nitride material, and the catalytic performance of the carbon nitride material is obviously improved through the combined action of the two modifications, so that the modified defective carbon nitride is very suitable for being used as a photocatalyst, is beneficial to the recycling of CO  2 , and has very important economic value and social significance.

title_en: Method for preparing nitrile/amine products
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing nitrile/amine products. The material containing acetate is contacted with a catalyst in the atmosphere of mixed gas of NH  3  and H  2  to react to generate nitrile/amine products; the catalyst includes a metal component and an acidic component. In the mixed gas of ammonia and hydrogen, the hydrogen content is 0.01-5 vol%. The method can directly convert the acetate into nitriles/amines, the conversion rate of the acetate can reach more than 98%, the total selectivity of acetonitrile and ethylamine can reach more than 98%, and the purity of the product is more than 99.5%. The method is simple and convenient, has mild reaction conditions, and is suitable for continuous, stable and large-scale production; the catalyst used has low cost, high conversion rate and selectivity of catalytic reaction and good application prospect.

title_en: Alpha 5-GABAAHeterocyclic compounds as receptor modulators
abstract_en: The present invention provides heterocyclic compounds of formula I, tautomers, stereoisomers, hydrates, solvates, pharmaceutically acceptable salts or prodrugs thereof; the compound has regulatory function on alpha 5-GABA  A  receptor,

title_en: N-butyl acetate purifying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses n-butyl acetate purifying equipment which comprises an n-butyl acetate purifying device, a temperature control device and a temperature control system, wherein the n-butyl acetate purifying device comprises a rectifying tower and a condenser, a plurality of layers of trays are arranged in the rectifying tower, the temperature control device comprises a cold liquid tank, a temperature control cabin and a cooling control module, the temperature control cabin is arranged along the height direction of the rectifying tower, the plurality of layers of trays extend into the temperature control cabin, a temperature control heater for heating the layers of trays is arranged at the part of the temperature control cabin, the cooling module comprises an air shower cooling pipe and a second shutoff valve, the air shower cooling pipe is provided with a plurality of spray valves opposite to the temperature control heater, the second shutoff valve is arranged between the air shower cooling pipe and the cold liquid tank and is used for communicating or stopping the air shower cooling pipe and the cold liquid tank, the heat exchange pipe is connected with the cold liquid tank, cold liquid can be stored in the cold liquid tank, the temperature control system is provided with a temperature monitoring module and a cooling control module, and the cooling control module controls the cooling module according to a first temperature sensing subunit and a second Wen Ganzi unit.

title_en: Purification and decolorization method for treating dark NMP waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purification and decolorization method for treating dark NMP waste liquid, belongs to the technical field of NMP waste liquid treatment, and aims to solve the problem that yellowing of an NMP product treated at present cannot meet the use requirement of high purity and no color. The purification and decolorization method of the dark NMP waste liquid is improved from a traditional 1 tower or 2 tower structure to a 3 tower structure, impurities and colors are effectively intercepted by the addition of the decolorization tower, the colors in the NMP finished product are further removed on the premise of removing water, the appearance quality of the product is improved, the final NMP finished product meets the use requirement of high purity and colorless, and the sustainable development is realized by recycling solvents and recycling resources.

title_en: Epigenetic medicine for enhancing anticancer effect of platinum antitumor agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epigenetic medicine for enhancing anticancer effect of a platinum antitumor agent and application thereof. The invention synthesizes the compound shown in the formula (I) at first, can activate p53, increase the protein expression quantity, block cancer cells in the G2/M phase and further play an anticancer role, and can enhance the anticancer role of the platinum anti-tumor agent when the compound shown in the formula (I) is combined with the platinum anti-tumor agent.

title_en: Carbazolo-indenone group-containing compound, oxime ester photoinitiator, photocurable coating and cured film
abstract_en: The application provides a carbazolo indenone-containing compound, an oxime ester photoinitiator, a photo-curing coating and a curing film, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The structural general formula of the photoinitiator is as follows:  The raw materials of the photo-curing coating comprise the oxime ester photoinitiator containing carbazolo indenone groups. The oxime ester photoinitiator containing carbazolo indenone group provided by the application has the advantages of good solubility, high curing speed, high photosensitive energy, less yellowing of a cured film and small use amount.

title_en: Preparation and use of pyrazole compounds containing 3, 5-dichloropyridyloxy arylmethyl
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation and application of a pyrazole compound containing 3, 5-dichloropyridyloxy arylmethyl. Obtained by condensing 3, 5-dichloropyridyloxy arylmethylamine with a substituted pyrazole acid. The pyrazole compound containing 3, 5-dichloropyridyloxy arylmethyl has good insecticidal effect on harmful insects, and can be used for preparing pesticides in the fields of agriculture, gardening and the like.

title_en: Enteromorpha oligosaccharide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses enteromorpha oligosaccharide and a preparation method and application thereof. The enteromorpha oligosaccharide is prepared by degrading enteromorpha polysaccharide, has a polymerization degree of 2-10, and comprises rhamnose, glucose, glucuronic acid and xylose, and the preparation method is simple. According to the invention, through constructing a type 2 diabetes mouse model, the enteromorpha oligosaccharide is proved to be capable of obviously reducing the fasting blood glucose level, the insulin content and the glycosylated serum protein level in serum, improving the blood lipid metabolism capability of the type 2 diabetes mouse, improving the liver glycogen synthesis capability in the liver of the mouse and improving the liver dysfunction of the type 2 diabetes mouse for the first time, and has high safety, and good prospect in the aspect of developing food or medicine with the function of controlling the type 2 diabetes.

title_en: Rosa roxburghii extract mixture for antioxidation and whitening multiple emulsion thereof
abstract_en: A Rosa roxburghii extract mixture for resisting oxidation and whitening and multiple whitening emulsions thereof relate to the field of skin care products. The whitening mixture comprises fructus Rosae Normalis extract rich in Vc and fructus Rosae Normalis extract rich in SOD. The whitening multiple emulsion comprises the following components of whitening mixture, glycerol, propylene glycol, no. 26 white oil, caprylin/caprin glyceride, EM90, SP-80, silicone oil, 16,18 alkyl glucoside (68), TW-80, sorbitol, xanthan gum, poloxamer, water-soluble azone and water. The raw material of the whitening mixture is roxburgh rose, and the preparation process of the extract is green and safe, and has no irritation to skin after long-term use. Pharmacological test researches show that the mixture is favorable for cooperatively removing free radicals, inhibiting tyrosinase and removing melanin. The multiple emulsion is beneficial to improving the stability of Vc and SOD in the mixture, and the application of the multiple emulsion to the field of skin whitening can not only improve the added value of the Rosa roxburghii product, but also provide more choices for the source of natural whitening active substances.

title_en: Method for regenerating cells
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for inducing at least one cell to regenerate, comprising-at least one probiotic bacillus subtilis strain, and-at least one amino acid or peptide, wherein the amino acid is selected from glutamine, glutamic acid or salts thereof and conjugated glutamine, and the peptide is an oligopeptide having a length of 2-10 amino acid units, the amino acid units are natural amino acids, and at least one amino acid unit is glutamine or glutamic acid unit.

title_en: Efficient low-irritation peptide-containing antioxidant composition, preparation method thereof and cosmetic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, in particular to a peptide-containing antioxidant composition with high efficiency and low stimulation, a preparation method thereof and a cosmetic. The peptide-containing antioxidant composition comprises, by weight, 1-3 parts of carnosine, 0.1-0.3 part of hydroxy pinacolone retinoic acid ester and 4-12 parts of dimethyl methoxy chromanol.

title_en: Azobenzene derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of energy storage materials, and particularly relates to an azobenzene derivative and application thereof, compared with common azobenzene, the azobenzene derivative provided by the application has the advantages that an absorption peak moves towards a long wavelength direction, red shift occurs, half life and energy storage density are superior, so that solar energy absorption, conversion and storage are facilitated, the azobenzene derivative can be used in the field of energy storage fabrics or photoinduced drivers, and the technical problem of poor performance of azobenzene in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Sesquiterpenoids Callistephus G and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sesquiterpene compound Callistephus G, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of natural medicinal chemistry. The sesquiterpene compound Callistephus G is extracted and separated from the asterias amurensis flower, is a special sesquiterpene compound with a 6/7 condensed structure as a framework, can effectively inhibit the fibrosis effect of TGF-beta on hepatic stellate cells LX-2, and has good anti-hepatic fibrosis activity. Therefore, the sesquiterpene compound Callistephus G can be used for preparing medicines for treating and/or preventing liver fibrosis, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Polyaryl-containing macrocyclic compounds and uses thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to a micro-molecular polyaryl-containing macrocyclic compound which has better immunoregulatory activity, and also provides an application of the micro-molecular polyaryl-containing macrocyclic compound in preventing or treating diseases related to TLR7, and an application of the micro-molecular polyaryl-containing macrocyclic compound as a vaccine adjuvant, a photodynamic therapeutic agent and a coupling medicament.

title_en: Method for extracting active ingredients from corn soaking water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extraction method of active ingredients in corn soaking water, which comprises the steps of adsorbing phytic acid on corn soaking water through resin, treating an obtained effluent liquid through removing corn protein and removing calcium magnesium salt to obtain a treatment liquid, filtering and concentrating through a reverse osmosis membrane to obtain a first trapped liquid, adding hydrochloric acid into the first trapped liquid to adjust pH to 2.0-2.5, vacuum concentrating until crystals are separated out, closing vacuum, cooling and crystallizing to obtain a KCl crude product and a first filtrate, and distilling the first filtrate to obtain a lactic acid solution and distilled dry matters. The invention effectively separates and obtains the potassium chloride crude product, the lactic acid solution and the distilled dry matter from the corn soaking water, fully extracts, separates and utilizes the effective components in the corn soaking water, and improves the comprehensive economic benefit of the corn processing industry chain.

title_en: Method for preparing internal olefin by catalyzing dehydration and isomerization of straight-chain fatty alcohol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of heterogeneous catalysis organic synthesis, and discloses a method for preparing internal olefin by catalyzing dehydration and isomerization of straight-chain fatty alcohol, and (3) respectively adding linear fatty alcohol (such as n-heptanol) and an H-type MOR zeolite catalyst into a reaction tube, adding a solvent, and then placing the mixture at 130-150 ℃ for reaction for 6-24 hours. After the reaction is finished, the reaction solution is centrifuged, supernatant fluid is collected, and after the decompression concentration treatment, the obtained crude product is subjected to column chromatography separation and purification, and finally internal olefins (2-heptene and 3-heptene) are obtained. The catalyst realizes the serial reaction of dehydration and isomerization of alcohols with longer carbon chain structures, can directly prepare corresponding internal olefins by a one-step method, avoids the use of noble metals, complex ligands and liquid acid and alkali, has simple and convenient operation flow, high efficiency and environmental protection, and simultaneously is easy to separate from products and convenient to recycle.

title_en: Synthesis method of high-purity gallium ammonium oxalate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, in particular to a method for synthesizing high-purity gallium ammonium oxalate, which comprises the steps of mixing a gallium-containing solution with a hydrogen peroxide solution, adding alkali liquor for heating and dissolving to obtain a gallium-containing alkaline solution, filtering, adding inorganic acid into filtrate, adjusting pH to 5-7, aging and filtering, washing the obtained precipitate with deionized water for several times, adding oxalic acid solution into the precipitate until the precipitate is completely dissolved to obtain a gallium oxalate solution, adding a saturated ammonium oxalate solution into the gallium oxalate solution, heating and stirring, aging after the reaction is completed, filtering to obtain gallium ammonium oxalate crystals, washing the gallium ammonium oxalate crystals with deionized water and ethanol for several times respectively, and vacuum drying the gallium ammonium oxalate crystals to obtain the high-purity gallium ammonium oxalate.

title_en: Synthesis method of chiral diol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of chiral diol, and belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis. The chiral diol is chiral 1, 2-diol or 1, 3-diol. The invention takes bromide (aryl bromide or alkenyl bromide) and glycol precursor as substrates, under the existence of ligand, photocatalyst and nickel catalyst, the protected chiral glycol is obtained by reaction under the irradiation of ultraviolet light, and then the chiral glycol is obtained by deprotection, or the chiral glycol is synthesized by a one-pot method starting from ethylene glycol or 1, 3-propylene glycol. The invention realizes the stereoselective arylation or alkenylation reaction of the 1, 2-diol or the 1, 3-diol oxygen ortho-position C (sp  3 ) -H bond by utilizing a light/nickel synergistic catalysis strategy, and has mild reaction condition and wide substrate adaptability. The chiral 1, 2-diol or 1, 3-diol prepared by the method can realize the synthesis of various natural products, commercial drugs and chiral ligands through subsequent conversion, and has huge synthesis value.

title_en: Low-density SNP liquid phase chip in large yellow croaker and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-density SNP liquid-phase chip in large yellow croaker and application thereof, wherein the chip is prepared from probes for detecting 15,292 SNP molecular marker combinations of the whole genome of large yellow croaker, and the position and base information of each SNP locus on the chip are shown in table 1. The invention further provides a preparation method of the chip and application thereof, such as application in large yellow croaker population genetic diversity analysis, genotype identification of breeding population, character association analysis or genome selective breeding. The chip designed by the invention comprises a series of core sites which are obviously related to growth, flow resistance and quality properties, and a large number of background sites, so that the detection accuracy of the designed chip is ensured, the chip has the obvious advantage of low detection cost, the detection cost is reduced by more than 30%, and the scientific innovation of the deep blue industry of large yellow croakers is further accelerated.

title_en: Vanadium phosphorus oxide catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vanadium phosphorus oxide catalyst which comprises the following components, by weight, 66-94% of vanadyl pyrophosphate, 0.5-6% of vanadyl phosphate, 0.8-25% of attapulgite and 1-6% of graphite. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing organic solvent, vanadium pentoxide and phosphoric acid for reaction to obtain blue paste-like reaction liquid containing vanadium-phosphorus-oxygen catalyst precursors, adding an attapulgite carrier into the blue paste-like reaction liquid, and obtaining the catalyst after the steps of filtering, drying, forming, roasting, activating and the like. The catalyst is applied to the reaction of preparing maleic anhydride by oxidizing n-butane, and is carried out in the reaction temperature range of 380-420 ℃, and the conversion rate of n-butane and the yield of maleic anhydride are higher than those of the catalyst without adding attapulgite.

title_en: Protein degradation targeting chimeric and application thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of medicines, and in particular relates to a protein degradation targeting chimeric and application thereof. The protein degradation targeting chimeric has a structure shown in a formula (I), wherein each group is defined in the specification. The compounds of formula (I) have a preferred inhibitory activity against CDK 2.

title_en: Copper-palladium MOF catalyst for synthesizing glycerol carbonate, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper-palladium MOF catalyst for synthesizing glycerol carbonate, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of grease chemical industry. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the steps of dissolving terephthalic acid and Cu (NO  3 ) 2 ·3H 2  O in a mixed solution of N, N-dimethylacetamide and absolute methanol, reacting for 10-30 hours at 100-200 ℃ to obtain a Cu-MOF-2 carrier, dispersing the obtained Cu-MOF-2 in the absolute methanol, loading bivalent palladium on the carrier by an impregnation method, and adding sodium borohydride to obtain a synthetic glycerol carbonate catalyst Pd/Cu-MOF-2.

title_en: Preparation and application of novel MAO-B inhibitor containing tetrahydronaphthalene-1-amine structure
abstract_en: The invention provides preparation and application of a novel MAO-B inhibitor containing tetrahydronaphthalene-1-amine structures, and belongs to the field of medicines. The derivative is a compound shown in a formula I, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt or stereoisomer thereof. The compound can be used for inhibiting monoamine oxidase (MAO), particularly selectively inhibiting MAO-B, can be used for treating diseases such as Parkinson's disease, alzheimer's disease, mood disorder and the like, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method for synthesizing beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide by enzyme conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biotechnology synthesis, and discloses a method for synthesizing beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide by enzyme conversion. The enzyme used adopts a complex enzyme solution composed of nicotinamide nucleoside kinase and phosphotransferase, and the phosphate donor adopts acetyl phosphate diamine. The acetylphosphoric diamine salt has the characteristic of low cost, has a low residue effect compared with other phosphoric acid donors, and effectively simplifies the subsequent impurity removal process. Besides, ADP generated in the reaction process is converted into ATP for recycling by the action of acetyl diammonium phosphate and phosphokinase, so that the consumption of ATP is greatly reduced, the cost is reduced, few byproducts are generated, the post-treatment process is convenient to simplify, and the method is suitable for large-scale production of beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide.

title_en: PPD derivative with heart protecting activity and its prepn and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of PPD derivatives shown in formulas (I), (II) and (III) and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof in preparation of anti-hypoxia reoxygenation injury drugs, anti-ischemia injury drugs or health care products. The ginsenoside PPD derivatives are discovered to have activity of resisting myocardial ischemia reperfusion injury for the first time, and have better ischemic injury resistance and ischemia reperfusion injury resistance, compared with a model group, the ginsenoside PPD derivatives remarkably improve the survival rate of cells, have better relative activity than PPD, have no cytotoxicity, and have good development and application values.

title_en: Co (cobalt)3O4@CN composite material, preparation method thereof and visible light catalytic CO (carbon monoxide)2Application in cycloaddition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano material preparation and application, and provides a Co  3 O 4  @CN composite material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in visible light catalysis of CO  2  cycloaddition. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a UiO-66 material, preparing a UiO-66on ZIF-67 material, and finally preparing the Co  3 O 4  @CN composite material by directly pyrolyzing the UiO-66on ZIF-67 material. The Co  3 O 4  @CN composite material has ultrahigh metal loading capacity, more active sites and excellent photo-thermal conversion performance, can greatly improve the light utilization efficiency and the catalytic performance, and has excellent catalytic performance in the visible light catalytic CO  2  and epoxide cycloaddition reaction.

title_en: Synthesis and application of difunctional fluorescent probe for simultaneously distinguishing and detecting superoxide anions and viscosity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a difunctional fluorescent probe for simultaneously distinguishing and detecting superoxide anions and viscosity, which has the following chemical structural formula:  . The dual-function fluorescent probe combines coumarin derivatives and thiazole derivatives through piperazine, uses trifluoro sulfonate groups as recognition sites to detect superoxide anions, and responds to viscosity through a molecular rotor strategy. The probe emits a strong yellow fluorescence of 550 nm at 470 nm excitation wavelength when reacted with superoxide anions and a near infrared fluorescence of 660 nm at 540 nm excitation wavelength when the probe is at high viscosity. In addition, the probe has the advantages of high sensitivity, excellent selectivity and the like in detecting superoxide anions and viscosity, and has great application prospect in the technical fields of analytical chemistry, life science, biomedical treatment and the like.

title_en: Adhesive skin care emulsion comprising acrylate/taurate copolymer
abstract_en: A skin care composition in the form of an emulsion having a continuous phase comprising a polymer and water and a dispersed phase comprising two or more emollients and emulsifiers. The polymer is an acrylate/taurate copolymer that is compatible with cetostearyl olive oleate and sorbitan olive oleate, and therefore the composition is a stable emulsion. The composition may have a viscosity of greater than or equal to 550pa x s at a shear rate of 0.10s  ‑1  according to the rheology test method.

title_en: Cesium iron chloride micro-crystal material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cesium-iron-chlorine micro-crystal material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chemical expression of the cesium-iron-chlorine micro-crystal material is as follows The size of the cesium-iron-chlorine microcrystal material is The appearance is hexahedral structure, and the cesium-iron-chlorine micron crystal material is prepared by Is prepared by in-situ reduction reaction under the condition of full spectrum illumination Preparation of the precursor by illumination in an isopropanol environment The microcrystal has stable structure, uniform size and regular morphology, simple and advanced preparation process and easy operation, and is prepared Application of microcrystal in photocatalysis The selective reduction and toluene oxidation reactions exhibit excellent photocatalytic performance.

title_en: Crystal of dihydropyridinone derivative or solvate thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides crystals of dihydropyridone derivatives or solvates thereof. The present invention relates to the formula:  crystals of the compound or a solvate thereof and pharmaceutical compositions containing the same.

title_en: Acne anti-inflammatory juice and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmeceuticals, and particularly relates to acne anti-inflammatory juice and a preparation method and application thereof. The anti-acne and anti-inflammatory juice is prepared by mixing and squeezing fresh oldenlandia diffusa and fresh dandelion, and filtering, wherein the fresh oldenlandia diffusa and the fresh dandelion are 0.5-3 parts by weight of fresh oldenlandia diffusa and 0.5-3 parts by weight of fresh dandelion. The invention adopts the combination of the fresh dandelion and the fresh oldenlandia in a specific proportioning range, and the fresh dandelion and the fresh oldenlandia are mutually matched, so that the obvious synergistic effect can be exerted, the proliferation of propionibacterium acnes can be inhibited to the greatest extent, thereby effectively reducing acne inflammation, retaining the effective components of the traditional Chinese medicine to the greatest extent, exerting the special efficacy of the fresh medicine, improving the clinical curative effect, and solving the problems of single fresh medicine type, inconvenient clinical use and the like to a certain extent.

title_en: Strong-effect mild lip-dyeing makeup-removing composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of A61K8/18, in particular to a strong and mild lip-dyeing makeup removing composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials at least comprise 43-55% of surfactant, 14-30% of grease and the balance of water phase, and the water phase at least comprises water, polyalcohol, diethylene glycol monoethyl ether and pH regulator. The formula is optimized to select the surfactant and the grease, and the proportion of the water phase and the oil phase is controlled, so that a bicontinuous phase microemulsion system with high stability is formed, and further, the formula is introduced into diethylene glycol monoethyl ether to synergistically enhance the synergistic effect with the surfactant, so that the discharge capacity of the bicontinuous phase microemulsion system to lip-dyeing products is greatly improved. The invention is designed optimally aiming at the removal of permanent makeup such as lip dyeing liquid, and active substances with specific effects can be added at will to be used as skin conditioning agents, so that the product requirements such as moisturizing, anti-wrinkle, whitening, relieving and repairing are realized, and the compatibility of the formula is high.

title_en: Boron-nitrogen-containing compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a boron-nitrogen-containing compound and application thereof, the boron-nitrogen-containing compound has a structure shown as a formula I or a formula II, the invention designs the structure of the boron-nitrogen-containing compound to obtain the boron-nitrogen-containing compound, the organic electroluminescent device has good luminous performance, can be used for preparing organic electroluminescent devices, especially used as a luminous layer material in the organic electroluminescent devices, can effectively reduce the driving voltage of the organic electroluminescent devices and improve the current efficiency of the organic electroluminescent devices.

title_en: Amino acid derivative of 2,2 '-binaphthyl-6, 6' -dicarboxylic acid, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a2, 2 '-binaphthyl-6, 6' -dicarboxylic acid amino acid derivative, wherein the structural formula of the 2,2 '-binaphthyl-6, 6' -dicarboxylic acid amino acid derivative is shown as follows:  wherein RNH is selected from      One of them. The 2,2 '-binaphthyl-6, 6' -dicarboxylic acid amino acid derivative has antitumor activity.

title_en: Method for purifying di (diethylamino) silane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for purifying di (diethylamino) silane, which comprises the following steps of S1, adding industrial-grade di (diethylamino) silane into a first rectifying tower, carrying out light removal treatment to obtain a light-removed product, leading the light-removed product out of the bottom of the tower, S2, leading the light-removed product into a second rectifying tower, carrying out heavy removal treatment to obtain a heavy-removed product, leading the heavy-removed product out of the top of the tower, S3, leading the heavy-removed product into a condenser, condensing the heavy-removed product into a liquid state, leading the liquid-removed product into an adsorption tank, carrying out adsorption treatment, and leading the liquid-removed product into a finished product tank through a filter screen after the treatment is finished, thus obtaining the high-purity di (diethylamino) silane, wherein the adsorption tank in the step S3 is filled with a composite modified adsorbent. The method can remove metal ion impurities, tri (diethylamino) silane, mono (diethylamino) silane and phosphorus-containing impurities in the di (diethylamino) silane by adding a specific adsorbent, so that the purity of the obtained di (diethylamino) silane reaches more than 99.99 wt%.

title_en: Ruthenium-containing catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a ruthenium-containing catalyst, a preparation method and applications thereof, and belongs to the technical field of catalysts. The preparation method takes 3,3 '-dibromo-4, 4' -biphenol, 1,3, 5-tri (p-vinylphenyl) benzene and ruthenium salt as main raw materials to carry out polymerization reaction to prepare the ruthenium-containing catalyst with the nano-scale pore canal, the obtained ruthenium-containing catalyst has good catalytic performance, thermal stability and chemical stability, the ruthenium-containing catalyst is used for catalyzing the hydrogenation of diisononyl phthalate to prepare the diisononyl cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylate, the catalytic effect of the ruthenium-containing catalyst is good, and the yield of the diisononyl cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylate is high.

title_en: Silane anchoring agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silane anchoring agent, which has the structural formula shown in formula I, wherein n is an integer, n is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 10, R1 represents methyl, hydroxyl, methoxy or ethoxy, R  2  represents hydrogen, methyl or ethyl, R  3  represents gamma- (2, 3-epoxypropoxy) propyl or beta- (3, 4-epoxycyclohexyl) ethyl, R  4  represents hydrogen, methyl, acetoxy or ethoxy R  5  represents vinyl, allyl, or allyl. The anchoring agent is a silane polymer with more epoxy groups on side groups, and has a low-branching and non-excessive crosslinking structure, so that a good anchoring effect can be exerted. Unlike physical blending, the epoxy group and the alkenyl group in the silane anchoring agent are in the molecular chain of the polymer, so that the silane anchoring agent has better compatibility with a pressure-sensitive adhesive system and a release agent system, and meanwhile, the problem of pungent smell of the small-molecule anchoring agent is avoided.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for early corrosion detection of metal and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal ion detection, in particular to a fluorescent probe for early metal corrosion detection and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical name of the fluorescent probe is N- [ (rhodamine-6G) lactam ethylenediamine ] -alpha-furaldehyde condensate, and the molecular formula is C  35 H 33 N 5 O 3 . The invention successfully develops fluorescent micromolecules Rhe-M sensitive to Fe  3+  response through two-step organic synthesis, acts on the carbon steel surface layer as fluorescent probe molecules capable of identifying early corrosion sites of carbon steel metal, can intuitively observe the corrosion sites and the area size of the carbon steel surface through irradiation of an ultraviolet lamp, has simple operation, sensitive reaction, low cost and strong specific identification capability, and is a high-efficiency method capable of being used for detecting the early metal corrosion sites.

title_en: Preparation method of maltotetraose water solution with concentration of more than 50%
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a maltotetraose water solution with concentration of more than 50%, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting maltodextrin to obtain a maltotetraose conversion solution, S2, sterilizing, filtering the maltotetraose conversion solution to obtain a first filtered clear solution, S3, decoloring the first filtered clear solution to obtain a decolored solution, S4, removing maltodextrin, filtering the decolored solution to obtain a second filtered clear solution, and S5, concentrating the second filtered clear solution under reduced pressure to obtain the maltotetraose water solution with concentration of more than 50%. The invention adopts the ultrafiltration membrane to remove maltodextrin from the maltotetraose converting liquid for the first time, effectively improves the content and the yield of the product, and the final yield of the maltotetraose aqueous solution prepared by the method is more than 90 percent and the concentration is more than 50 percent. The method is environment-friendly, low in operation and maintenance cost and simple in operation process.

title_en: High-purity crocin extraction and separation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a high-purity saffron extract and separation method and its application, which relates to the field of industrial dyes. The high-purity saffron extract and separation method comprises the steps of S1 raw material preparation, S2 device preparation S3 crude extraction for backup, S4 preliminary purification, and S5 advanced purification, an industrial dye application of high-purity saffron pigment includes 0.3-0.7 parts of high-purity saffron pigment, 3-6 parts of ethanol, 0.1-0.3 parts of citric acid, 3-5 parts of urea, 5-7 parts of salt, C0.03-0.06 parts of vitamin C, 0.04-0.07 parts of sodium benzoate, 1.2-1.5 parts of natural plant color fixative, and 1.2-1.5 parts of biobased color fixative. The remaining parts are deionized water. By using multi-stage dynamic counter current ultrasonic extraction technology, saffron pigment in crushed gardenia raw materials can be efficiently extracted. The concentration difference between solvent and raw materials is gradually increased, and multi-stage extraction improves extraction efficiency to ensure the extraction. Adequate contact between solvents and raw materials, dynamic stirring to improve extraction efficiency, destruction of plant cell walls, ultrasound assisted acceleration of effective ingredient release, and enhancement of extraction efficiency.

title_en: Fused ring aryl imide derivative with alternately fused naphthalimide and pyrene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condensed ring aromatic imide derivative with alternately condensed naphthalimide and pyrene, a preparation method and application thereof, which takes tetrabromonaphthalimide and hetero atom condensed ring aromatic imide derivative as raw materials, under the protection of inert gas, palladium catalysis is adopted to perform aromatization reaction, and the fused ring aromatic imide derivative formed by alternately fusing naphthalimide and pyrene is prepared by a one-step method. The naphthalimide and pyrene alternate fused condensed ring aromatic imide derivative has stronger absorption to visible light with the wavelength of 400-700nm and higher fluorescence quantum yield, and is shown by TGA test to have thermal decomposition temperatures of more than 340 ℃ and good chemical stability, and can be used as an organic semiconductor n-type electron transport material applied to organic field effect transistors, solar cell materials, liquid crystal materials, organic luminescent materials, industrial dyes and the like  .

title_en: Application of recombinant collagen in preparation of preparation for increasing expression quantity of genes related to skin wrinkle resistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of recombinant collagen in preparation of a preparation for increasing expression level of genes related to skin wrinkle resistance, wherein the amino acid sequence of the recombinant collagen comprises a sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention detects the expression condition of a series of genes related to skin anti-wrinkle through transcriptome, and proves that the recombinant collagen provided by the invention can promote the expression of skin cell anti-wrinkle genes, can be used for developing and applying various cosmetic products, and endows the cosmetic products with the efficacy and effect of promoting skin anti-wrinkle capability, and the genes can also be used as references for evaluating other raw materials or cosmetics on skin anti-wrinkle capability in the future.

title_en: Method for hydrogen transfer reaction by utilizing microreactor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for carrying out hydrogen transfer reaction by utilizing a micro-reactor device, which comprises a liquid pipeline system, a gas pipeline system, a micro-reactor and a cooling and product collecting system, wherein the top of the micro-reactor is respectively communicated with the liquid pipeline system and the gas pipeline system, the bottom of the micro-reactor is connected with the cooling and product collecting system, the method comprises the steps of filling Pt/Al  2 O 3  catalyst in a reaction tube of the micro-reactor, introducing inert gas to discharge air in the micro-reactor, continuously pumping raw material liquid formed by mixing an alcohol compound shown in a formula I and an amine compound shown in a formula II into the micro-reactor for reaction, and allowing the reaction liquid to flow out of the micro-reactor and enter the cooling and product collecting system for collection to obtain a product shown in a formula III. The invention utilizes the microreactor to carry out hydrogen transfer reaction, thus obtaining higher product yield.

title_en: Polymer precursor and preparation method thereof, polymer coating and preparation method thereof, negative electrode current collector and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of batteries, and particularly relates to a polymer precursor and a preparation method thereof, a polymer coating and a preparation method thereof, a negative electrode current collector and a lithium ion battery. The chemical structure of the polymer precursor provided by the invention is shown as a formula A, wherein in the formula A, X is Br, and R  1  and R  2  are one or more selected from methyl, cyano, ethynyl, hydrogen atoms, fluorine atoms and trifluoromethyl. The polymer coating formed by the polymer precursor provided by the invention has a central structure similar to that of imidazole ion liquid, is introduced into a lithium ion battery as a surface coating of a negative electrode current collector, can be artificially induced at the negative electrode to form a high-performance solid electrolyte interface film, and improves the stability of interfacial lithium ion transmission, thereby improving the electrochemical performance of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Broad-spectrum aminoglycoside and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided herein are aminoglycoside compounds, such as compounds of formula (I) and formula (III), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, for use as therapeutic and/or prophylactic agents. The compounds are useful for treating bacterial infections, such as gram-negative bacterial infections, in a subject. Also provided herein are methods of preparing such compounds.

title_en: N- (1, 3-dimethylbutyl) -N' -phenyl p-phenylenediamine-quinone hapten as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an N- (1, 3-dimethylbutyl) -N' -phenyl p-phenylenediamine-quinone hapten, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of environmental pollutant detection. The invention firstly provides an N- (1, 3-dimethylbutyl) -N' -phenyl p-phenylenediamine-quinone hapten, an artificial antigen is obtained by coupling carrier protein, a 6 PPD-quinone antibody is obtained by immunizing animals, and an enzyme-linked immunoassay kit is prepared by utilizing the antibody to realize detection and analysis of the 6 PPD-quinone in a sample. The kit provided by the invention has the advantages of strong specificity, high sensitivity, simplicity and convenience in operation and high analysis speed, overcomes the defect of precision instrument analysis, and realizes the rapid analysis of trace 6 PPD-quinone residues in complex environment media.

title_en: Method for green catalytic synthesis of gamma-ketophosphine oxide by asymmetric alkylaluminum compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing gamma-ketophosphine oxide by green catalysis of an asymmetric aluminum alkyl compound under mild conditions. In the range of 60-100 ℃ and in the presence of an organic solvent, phosphine oxide compound is used as a raw material, an asymmetric alkyl aluminum compound is used as a catalyst, and the phosphine oxide reacts with alpha, beta-unsaturated ketone to generate gamma-ketophosphine oxide. The method has the characteristics of mild reaction conditions, high yield of the product, wide substrate range, no additional acid and alkali, heavy metal and the like, and meets the requirements of green chemistry and atomic economy reaction.

title_en: Method for promoting flower growth by using tebumycins finished liquid fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for promoting flower growth by using a tebufan finished product liquid fertilizer, which relates to the technical field of fertilizer preparation and comprises the following specific steps of firstly screening 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium acetate ionic liquid for subsequent treatment, wherein the method has the advantages that: by selecting polylactic acid as a microcapsule wrapping material, the tylosin can be tightly and stably wrapped, an effective protective barrier is constructed, the influence of external adverse environmental factors on the tylosin is isolated, the activity of the tylosin is effectively ensured to be maintained in the storage and subsequent application processes, the temperature-sensitive hydrogel prepared from poly (N-isopropyl acrylamide) is used as an intelligent response material, the temperature-sensitive property is the key point for realizing intelligent regulation, the hydrogel presents obviously different states at different temperatures, the scientificity and the precision of fertilization are greatly improved, and the flowers can be ensured to obtain proper nutrient supply at different growth stages.

title_en: Preparation method of 4-bromo-2- (1-methylcyclopropyl) pyridine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of 4-bromo-2- (1-methylcyclopropyl) pyridine, which takes 2, 4-dibromopyridine as a starting material and is prepared by deprotonation, nucleophilic addition and Wittig reaction and cyclopropanization reaction in sequence, wherein the specific reaction path is as follows:  The invention takes 2, 4-dibromopyridine as an initial raw material, and synthesizes 4-bromo-2- (1-methylcyclopropyl) pyridine through a Wittig reaction with N-methoxy-N-methylacetamide; the preparation method adopted by the invention has the advantages of relatively cheap raw materials, high yield and simple operation, and can further promote the industrialized application of 4-bromo-2- (1-methylcyclopropyl) pyridine.

title_en: Bionic skin biological composition and application thereof in cosmetics
abstract_en: The application provides a bionic skin biological composition which comprises a film forming agent, a cell phospholipid film component and a cell phospholipid film component, wherein the film forming agent comprises a hard film forming agent, a soft film forming agent and a solvent, the cell phospholipid film component comprises polyquaternary ammonium salt-61, polyquaternary ammonium salt-65, a stabilizer and a solvent, and the mass ratio of the film forming agent to the cell phospholipid film component is 6-15:0.1. The application also provides a cosmetic comprising the composition. The composition has good migration resistance and tearing resistance, remarkably improves the fitting property of a makeup product, has good makeup holding effect, has good flexibility after film formation, has comfortable skin feel, can improve the brightness and the natural luster of skin, does not influence the transdermal absorption of active components of cosmetics, helps to make up and realizes the integration of makeup and health.

title_en: Preparation method of fluroxypyr
abstract_en: A preparation method of fluroxypyr. Fluodeoxime, chemical name (1E) -1- (4-chlorophenyl) -2, 2-trifluoroethanone O- (1, 3-dioxolan-2-ylmethyl) oxime, novel herbicide and safener. At present, a synthesis method is not reported. 1- (4-chlorophenyl) -2, 2-trifluoroethyl-1-one reacts with hydroxylamine hydrochloride to 1- (4-chlorophenyl) -2, 2-trifluoroethyl-1-oxime. Etherification is carried out on 1- (4-chlorophenyl) -2, 2-trifluoroethyl-1-oxime and halogenated acetaldehyde ethylene glycol to obtain the fluroxypyr. The invention provides a preparation method of fluroxypyr and provides a method for industrialization of fluroxypyr.

title_en: Lanthanide metal modified cobalt/attapulgite-based titanium silicalite catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lanthanide metal modified cobalt/attapulgite-based titanium silicalite catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises a carrier and an active component loaded on the carrier, wherein the carrier is attapulgite-based titanium silicalite, and the active component is cobalt and lanthanide metal. The catalyst is applied to the preparation of guaiacol by catalyzing depolymerization of lignin, can realize 100% lignin conversion rate under the conditions of water, glycerol, formic acid solvent, nitrogen and no need of additional hydrogen source, has the advantages of high economic benefit and less metal loading, can improve depolymerization capability and selectivity of the catalyst to lignin, and has good industrial application prospect, and the yield of guaiacol is more than 25% and the yield of guaiacol products is more than 75%.

title_en: Synthesis method of Schiff base ligand and application of Schiff base ligand in detection of Al in jellyfish3+Content application
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of aluminum content detection, and particularly relates to a synthesis method of a Schiff base ligand and application of the Schiff base ligand in detecting the content of Al  3+  in jellyfish. The synthesis method comprises the steps of S1a, uniformly weighing 3-amino 5-mercapto-1, 2, 4-triazole and 2-hydroxy-1-naphthaldehyde in a molar ratio of 1:1 respectively by using an analysis day, putting the mixture into a round-bottomed flask, continuously adding a stirrer, ethanol and 0.03mL glacial acetic acid into the round-bottomed flask to obtain a mixed solution, reacting the mixed solution for 8-10 h by using a heating reflux method, removing a solvent by rotary evaporation to obtain a reaction product, S1d, washing the reaction product by using ethanol, and drying to obtain a Schiff base ligand, and providing a method for detecting the content of Al  3+  in a jellyfish product by using the Schiff base ligand as a fluorescent probe based on the remarkable fluorescence enhancement effect of Al  3+  ions.

title_en: Cyclodiselenide/disulfide/carbon-bridged paclitaxel prodrug, and preparation and application of self-assembled nanoparticle thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to a taxol prodrug antitumor preparation, and in particular relates to construction of a taxol prodrug bridged by a ring structure and self-assembled nanoparticles thereof and application of the taxol prodrug in a drug delivery system. The invention designs and synthesizes taxol prodrugs bridged by different ring structures (wherein X is Se, S or CH  2 , R is Se, S or CH  2 , n=0-8;m =0-8, and the ring structures comprise structures containing saturated or unsaturated bonds), and self-assembled nanoparticles are prepared. The self-assembled nanoparticle of the taxol prodrug bridged by the ring structure can effectively improve the curative effect of taxol and reduce the toxic and side effects of taxol. The cyclic structure can significantly affect the pharmaceutics, in vivo fate, and anti-tumor activity of the paclitaxel prodrug self-assembled nanoparticles. The prodrug or the pharmaceutical composition thereof or the small molecule prodrug self-assembled nanoparticle thereof can be used for preparing an intelligent response type drug delivery system in a tumor microenvironment, so that the anti-tumor effect of the drug is improved.

title_en: Synthesis device and synthesis method of allyl tertiary amine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis device and a synthesis method of allyl tertiary amine, and belongs to the field of fine chemical engineering. The invention discloses a synthesis device of allyl tertiary amine, which comprises a dimethylamine raw material tank, a chloropropene raw material tank, a dimethylamine raw material pump, a chloropropene raw material pump, a micro-channel reactor, a middle storage tank, a dimethylallyl crude product tank and a pH control system, wherein a discharge port of the dimethylamine raw material tank is connected with an inlet of the dimethylamine raw material pump, an outlet of the dimethylamine raw material pump is connected with the micro-channel reactor, a discharge port of the chloropropene raw material tank is connected with an inlet of the chloropropene raw material pump, an outlet of the chloropropene raw material pump is connected with the micro-channel reactor, a discharge port of the micro-channel reactor is connected with the middle storage tank, the middle storage tank is connected with the dimethylallyl crude product tank through a pipeline, and an upper organic phase is led into the dimethylallyl crude product tank, and the pH control system is connected with the micro-channel reactor to control the pH of a reaction system in the micro-channel reactor.

title_en: Enantiomer of azo podophyllotoxin derivative SU056
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel enantiomer of 9- (3-fluorophenyl) -5- (2-hydroxyethyl) -6, 9-dihydro- [1,3] dioxa [4,5-g ] furo [3,4-b ] quinolin-8 (5H) -one (SU 056), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the novel enantiomer, and the use of the novel enantiomer in medical therapy, including in particular cancer therapy.

title_en: Synthesis method of aromatic acyl chloride
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, and discloses a synthesis method of aromatic acyl chloride, which comprises the steps of adding carboxyl modified quaternized cardanol into a reaction kettle at normal temperature, then adding anhydrous aluminum trichloride and trichlorotoluene, then slowly heating to 70-75 ℃, heating to 105-110 ℃ for 1-2 hours after no bubbles are generated in the reaction, transferring the reaction liquid into a distillation flask after the reaction is finished, and distilling to obtain the aromatic acyl chloride. The aromatic acyl chloride solves the problem of high energy consumption or other organic solvents, and has better antibacterial effect.

title_en: Compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound with a structure shown in a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof, a preparation method of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label thereof and application of the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, solvate, hydrate or isotope label in preparing an iron death inhibitor,

title_en: Method for selectively preparing furan dimethylamine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selectively preparing furan dimethylamine, which comprises the steps of mixing 2, 5-diformyl furan, a catalyst, anhydrous methanol, an ammonia source and an additive, and converting the 2, 5-diformyl furan into furan dimethylamine through reductive amination under the condition of pressurized hydrogen and stirring. The preparation process has simple procedures and mild conditions, greatly reduces the preparation cost and time, and in the prepared catalyst, ni metal, ni-Al spinel and Al  2 O 3  are stably present, and the formed metal Ni has strong capability of catalyzing and reducing amination DFF in the mixed phase of the Ni-Al spinel and Al  2 O 3 , thereby being beneficial to preparing BAMF by hydrogenation of an amination intermediate imine.

title_en: Adsorbent for removing metal ions in alcohol ether solvent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adsorbent for removing trace metal ions in an alcohol ether solvent, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical separation. The adsorbent is a zirconium-based metal organic cage material with a discrete structure, which is formed by coordination self-assembly of zirconium metal salt and a nitrogenous polycarboxylic acid organic ligand. The adsorbent provided by the invention has a specific ion nano trap, and can form a strong finite field synergistic effect with metal ions. The adsorbent is suitable for adsorption separation of trace metal ions in various alcohol ether solvents, and has higher metal ion adsorption removal efficiency.

title_en: Anti-aging composition containing protein and micromolecular plant fermentation liquor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging composition containing protein and micromolecular plant fermentation liquor and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biology. The invention provides an anti-aging composition which is prepared from the following raw materials of radix puerariae, rhizoma polygonati, ampelopsis grossedentata, fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae, flos caryophylli, ginseng, american ginseng, water and compound lactobacillus. The anti-aging composition prepared by the invention can effectively remove free radicals, has a strong antioxidation effect, has an obvious improvement effect on skin aging conditions, and has mild components and a wide application range.

title_en: Catalyst for difluoro pyrazole acid synthesis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalysis, in particular to a catalyst for synthesizing difluoro pyrazole acid and a preparation method thereof, the catalyst comprises a nucleus body and a shell, wherein the nucleus body is CS  2 CO 3 , the shell is poly-4-vinyl pyridine-transition metal complex, the catalyst can directly catalyze the generation of difluoro pyrazole acid, bromination reaction is not needed, the generation of toxic waste liquid is reduced, the reaction yield and the product purity are high, the catalyst has a certain industrial application prospect, and the catalyst fully utilizes CO  2  and makes a contribution to reducing the emission of CO  2  and relieving the greenhouse effect.

title_en: Synthesis method of unprotected 1, 2-amino ester and oxazoline derivative
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing unprotected 1, 2-amino ester and oxazoline derivatives, which takes aryl alkene as a raw material, and carries out selective oxidative amination on the aryl alkene in the presence of an amination reagent, an iron catalyst and alkali to obtain unprotected 1, 2-amino ester compounds, or takes the aryl alkene as a raw material, and obtains the oxazoline derivatives by a one-pot two-step method in the presence of the amination reagent, the iron catalyst, the alkali and acid. The method has the advantages of high efficiency, mild reaction condition, convenient operation, short reaction time, less byproducts and the like, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Sodium gluconate for concrete admixture and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides sodium gluconate for concrete admixture, a preparation method and application thereof, which takes glucose as a raw material, water as a solvent, hydrogen peroxide as an oxidant and ferrous sulfate as a catalyst, and glucose is catalytically oxidized at normal temperature through low-frequency ultrasonic excitation to be converted into sodium gluconate, so that the reaction time is short, and the conversion rate of glucose can reach more than 97%. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, high product conversion rate, high glucose conversion rate and no redundant byproducts. Meanwhile, compared with the sodium gluconate sold in the market, the preparation method disclosed by the invention can save the use cost of 600-1000 yuan/ton of the sodium gluconate, and the synthesized sodium gluconate is in a solution state and can be used without further dissolution, so that the sodium gluconate has a higher practical value in the concrete additive industry.

title_en: Repulsive force-based library inoculation and subsequent amplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a repulsive force-based library inoculation and subsequent amplification, which comprises the steps of library carrier construction, occupation, amplification and elution of library carriers on the surface of a sequencing chip, wherein the method can solve the problems of label jump and stability reduction, and realize simultaneous adaptation of a non-array and an array chip.

title_en: Lipopeptide-small molecule polypeptide supermolecule composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lipopeptide-small molecule polypeptide supermolecule composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the lipopeptide-small molecule polypeptide supermolecule composition comprises small molecule polypeptide active substances, amino acids and lipopeptides, the total weight of the composition is 0.1% -5% of the small molecule polypeptide active substances, the amino acids are 0.1% -10% of the small molecule polypeptide active substances, and the lipopeptides are complemented to 100%. The lipopeptide-small molecule polypeptide supermolecule composition prepared by the invention has small particle size, good dispersibility, hydrophilicity and lipophilicity, can self-assemble to form a vesicle structure with a similar structure with a cell membrane, and can further carry other active components.

title_en: Polythiol compound, preparation method thereof and application thereof in optical materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic compounds and the field of preparation of new optical materials, and in particular provides a polythiol compound 4,8, 11-trithiol-3, 6,9, 12-tetrathiatetradecane-1, 14-diol, wherein a polythiol compound is utilized to prepare a polythiol composition, the prepared polythiol composition is utilized to prepare a polymerizable composition, and the obtained polymerizable composition is used for preparing optical materials, so that the prepared optical materials have lower turbidity and yellow indexes. The polythiol compound has a large number of branched chains, which can further increase the degree of crosslinking and reduce turbidity, and the presence of hydroxyl groups generates polyurethane groups during polymerization, which can reduce the yellow index.

title_en: Preparation method of special catalyst dioctyl tin oxide for superfine electrophoretic coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic metals, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a special catalyst dioctyl tin oxide for an ultrafine electrophoretic coating. According to the invention, tetraoctyl tin, stannic chloride, toluene and a catalyst are taken as main raw materials, a traditional surfactant is not used, the formed materials are formed into superfine powder through a special pressurizing spraying device, the impurity wrapping of products is reduced, the reaction efficiency is increased, ultra-low conductivity pure water is used for washing the products for multiple times, the special catalyst-grade superfine, low-chlorine and low-conductivity dioctyl tin oxide for the cathode electrophoresis paint is prepared, WO  3 /MgO is taken as a catalyst in the preparation process, in the process of converting dioctyl tin chloride into dioctyl tin oxide, WO  3 /MgO promotes chlorine atom removal and tin oxide formation, and the addition of WO  3 /MgO is beneficial to improving the stability and dispersibility of the dioctyl tin oxide and preventing aggregation or precipitation in the reaction process.

title_en: NLRP3 inflammation corpuscle inhibitor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and relates to an NLRP3 inflammation small body inhibitor and application thereof. Specifically, the compound represented by the general formula (A) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, stereoisomers and tautomers thereof are defined as the specification. The research shows that the compound shown in the general formula (A) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, stereoisomers and tautomers thereof have higher biological activity on NLRP3 inflammatory corpuscles and have important clinical development value for treating NLRP3 related diseases. Y-W-R  3  (A).

title_en: Glycine and ammonium chloride separation device and separation process
