abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of separation devices and provides a glycine and ammonium chloride separation device and a separation process, wherein the device comprises a shell, a central rotating shaft is rotatably connected inside the shell, a heating structure is arranged inside the shell, and a reinforcing structure is connected with the outer surface of the central rotating shaft; the inside of casing has been seted up the heating chamber, the inner wall surface fixedly connected with annular slide rail of the corresponding heating chamber of casing, the surface swivelling joint of annular slide rail has a plurality of groups of slide, fixedly connected with connecting plate between two adjacent groups of slide, the surface connection of slide has the heating pipe, the inner wall rotation of casing is connected with the swivel ring, the inboard of swivel ring runs through fixedly connected with protruding board, the surface connection of central pivot has adjusting part, adjusting part is used for driving protruding board rotation under the rotation of central pivot to certain rotational speed. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved current separator when heating inside, the inhomogeneous, can prolong the churning time, and the poor problem of heating effect of easy heating.

title_en: Supermolecule chiral spiral nano-catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A process for preparing the chiral spiral nano-catalyst of supermolecule includes such steps as dissolving 5-amino isophthalic acid and n-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine in ultrapure water, adding it to the ultrapure water containing R/S camphorsulfonic acid, ultrasonic clarifying, adding ammonium persulfate, reacting in water bath to obtain R/S-PAIPA nano-fibre, transferring R/S-PAIPA nano-fibre to alcohol, assembling R/S-PAIPA nano-fibre to obtain R/S-PAIPA spiral nano-belt, and mixing R/S-PAIPA spiral nano-belt with Fe  3 O 4  nano-particles. The invention adopts a solvent-induced assembly strategy, and based on the combination of the supermolecule left-hand/right-hand spiral nano material and Fe  3 O 4  nano particles, two supermolecule chiral nano catalysts with excellent chiral selectivity are constructed, and can be used for selectively catalyzing dopa molecules with specific configurations.

title_en: Method for synthesizing santalol ether from muskmelon aldehyde
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synthesizing santalol ether by using muskmelon aldehyde, which comprises the steps of carrying out etherification reaction on muskmelon aldehyde and methanol under the action of a catalyst to obtain methoxy muskmelon aldehyde, and adding the methoxy muskmelon aldehyde by using a methyl metal reagent to obtain the santalol ether. The synthesis route of the invention is novel and short, the muskmelon aldehyde which is cheap and easy to obtain is used as the raw material, the sandalwood ether product is obtained through two steps of etherification and Grignard addition reaction, and the invention has the advantages of high reaction yield, less three wastes, simple and convenient operation, and the like, and is easy for large-scale production. Compared with the traditional method adopting the dihydromyrcene route, the method does not involve high-pressure hydrogenation and does not have methoxy citronellol byproduct, and the route yield is obviously improved.

title_en: Method for preparing 2-substituted benzothiazole derivatives by driving light
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing 2-substituted benzothiazole derivatives by driving light. The method has the advantages of high yield, high atom economy, low price and easy separation of the catalyst, mild reaction conditions, simple and convenient post-treatment, environmental protection and the like, and provides a novel economic, practical and environmental protection method for preparing the 2-substituted benzothiazole compound widely applied to the fields of medicines, luminescent materials, pesticides and the like.

title_en: Optimizing bottom electrode for enhancing ferroelectric properties of hafnium-based oxides using back-end-of-line (BEOL) compatible processes
abstract_en: The presently disclosed and claimed subject matter relates to a ferroelectric device having a bottom electrode, a film comprising a crystalline ferroelectric material comprising a mixture of hafnium oxide and zirconium oxide, wherein a substantial portion (i.e., about 40% or more) or a majority of the material is in a ferroelectric phase in a deposited state, and to methods for preparing and depositing such materials. The bottom electrode is thin and has a low roughness. Ferroelectric devices are BEOL compatible because all process steps are performed at temperatures of 400 degrees celsius or less.

title_en: Cyanostilbene derivative, preparation method thereof and application thereof in zinc ion recognition
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of organic luminescent materials and ion identification, in particular to a cyano stilbene derivative, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in zinc ion identification and recovery rate detection. Firstly, the application designs and synthesizes a cyano-stilbene derivative TCS with three (2-amino ethyl) amine triangular bridge connection, three cyano-stilbene groups of which provide fluorophores for the molecule, and the three (2-amino ethyl) amine triangular bridge provides a flexible framework for bridging the cyano-stilbene groups. Under the drive of supermolecule self-assembly, the single component TCS can carry out fluorescence colorimetric detection on zinc ions in a THF/H  2  O system under the condition that the detection limit is as low as 41nM, the fluorescence color is changed from yellow green to cyan, the single component TCS has the characteristic of high efficiency and single identification, and the TCS can be widely applied to drinking water quality monitoring and industrial wastewater discharge detection by utilizing the characteristic, thereby obviously improving the water quality safety guarantee level.

title_en: Construction method of gene mutation library detected by nucleic acid mass spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a gene mutation library detected by nucleic acid mass spectrometry, which comprises the following steps of taking a gene sequence related to tumor radiotherapy toxicity, collecting and processing a sample, extracting and purifying nucleic acid, determining a gene fragment related to the radiotherapy toxicity, amplifying the gene fragment related to the radiotherapy toxicity, introducing a mutation point into the gene fragment related to the radiotherapy toxicity, carrying out fragmentation treatment on a longer nucleic acid fragment, connecting a carrier, converting a connection product, amplifying and controlling library quality. The invention can systematically study gene functions on gene level by constructing a gene mutation library detected by nucleic acid mass spectrometry, determine specific roles of genes in normal physiological and pathological processes, simulate gene mutation conditions under disease states, predict disease progress, provide resources for discovering drug targets, evaluate drug curative effects and drug response mechanisms, realize accurate medical treatment and provide convenience for malignant tumor treatment work.

title_en: Methods and processes for preparing MCT4 inhibitors
abstract_en: Methods for preparing heterocyclic compounds and compositions useful as MCT4 inhibitors are provided.

title_en: Cyclization polymerization method, catalyst and preparation method of catalyst
abstract_en: A cyclization polymerization method of 1, 3-pentadiene is characterized in that the method takes 1, 3-pentadiene as raw material to carry out cyclization polymerization reaction in the presence of a catalyst, wherein the catalyst consists of titanium on carbon point CDs and alkyl aluminum chloride. The method improves the selectivity of the product cyclic trimer 3,7, 11-trimethyl-1, 5, 9-cyclododecatriene.

title_en: 2-Substituted piperidine derivative, preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: 2-Substituted piperidine derivatives of formula (I), processes for their preparation, pharmaceutical compositions comprising these compounds and their use in medicine for the treatment of diseases or conditions.

title_en: Method for preparing flexible chain quaternary phosphonium salt ion monocrystal under mild condition and application of flexible chain quaternary phosphonium salt ion monocrystal in iodine capture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing flexible chain quaternary phosphonium salt ion monocrystal under mild conditions, which is to dissolve quaternary phosphonium salt cationic monomer and sulfonic acid group anionic monomer in methanol or water respectively, then mix the two, and obtain the quaternary phosphonium salt ion monocrystal material within 12 h. And drying and grinding the obtained product to obtain the solid adsorbent for capturing iodine. Considering that the monocrystal contains abundant heteroatom groups (P, sulfonic acid) and abundant conjugated electrons (benzene rings), the material has the capability of capturing iodine. The work expands the application of the new material in the iodine adsorption field, and fills the blank of the ion monocrystal in the iodine adsorption field. In addition, the preparation method has the advantages of simple preparation process, mild reaction conditions, short reaction time and high synthesis efficiency, and is favorable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: High-adhesion low-moisture-absorption solid epoxy molding compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging materials, in particular to a high-adhesion low-moisture-absorption solid epoxy plastic packaging material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The high-adhesion low-moisture-absorption solid epoxy molding compound comprises, by weight, 4-10 parts of epoxy resin, 2-10 parts of phenolic resin, 70-90 parts of inorganic filler, 0.1-0.3 part of colorant, 0.2-0.6 part of release agent, 0.05-0.5 part of modified curing accelerator, 0.2-1.5 part of ion scavenger, 0.1-0.3 part of coupling agent, 1-5 parts of adhesive and 0.2-1.5 part of stress improver. Compared with the traditional epoxy plastic packaging material, the high-adhesion and low-moisture-absorption solid epoxy plastic packaging material has the advantages that the obtained epoxy plastic packaging material has excellent mechanical strength, adhesiveness and extremely low water absorption under the same curing degree.

title_en: Emotion beauty composition for improving cell activity and reducing wrinkles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emotion beautifying composition for improving cell activity and reducing wrinkles, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of cosmetics; the emotion beautifying composition provided by the invention comprises, by mass, 0.1-5 parts of andrographis paniculata extract, 0.1-5 parts of bacillus fermentation products, 0.1-5 parts of 4-tert-butylcyclohexanol and 0.1-5 parts of radix pseudostellariae extract. The composition has excellent compound effect among the components in proper mass parts, and the obtained emotion beautifying composition can effectively provide internal protection for skin by improving the emotion state, reducing the skin pressure and improving the cell vitality, simultaneously can promote the self-repairing capability of the skin, improve the skin barrier repairing effect, enhance the oxidation resistance and the anti-inflammatory effect and provide external protection for the skin, namely, the interaction between the internal channel and the external channel can realize the effective anti-aging effect and the skin barrier repairing effect.

title_en: Method for realizing high value of glutamic acid isoelectric mother liquor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing high-value of glutamic acid isoelectric mother liquor, belonging to the technical field of industrial fermentation. The method comprises the steps of firstly treating the glutamic acid isoelectric mother liquor through a ceramic membrane and an ultrafiltration membrane to obtain membrane filter liquor and concentrated liquor, filtering and drying the concentrated liquor through a plate frame to obtain mycoprotein, obtaining first-stage concentrated water and first-stage fresh water through electrodialysis treatment of the obtained membrane filter liquor, obtaining ammonium sulfate crystals through evaporation crystallization and solid-liquid separation of the first-stage concentrated water, obtaining second-stage concentrated water and second-stage fresh water through electrodialysis treatment of the second-stage fresh water, obtaining glutamic acid crystals through evaporation crystallization and solid-liquid separation of the second-stage concentrated water, and concentrating and drying the second-stage fresh water to obtain feed protein, thereby realizing the high value of the glutamic acid isoelectric mother liquor. Through the treatment method, glutamic acid and ammonium sulfate are recovered, the mycoprotein yield and the newly added feed yield are improved, and the economic benefit of each ton of monosodium glutamate is improved by 700-900 yuan.

title_en: Synthesis method of natural product Hypermonone G
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of a natural product hypermonone G. 3, 7-dimethyloct-6-ene-1-alkyne-3-ol is taken as a raw material, an oxabicyclo [2.2.1] heptane skeleton shown in a compound I is constructed through the catalysis of a catalyst, and then the oxabicyclo [2.2.1] heptane skeleton is subjected to stereoselective reaction to obtain a final product hypermonone G. The method of the invention asymmetrically synthesizes natural products hypermonone G, has mild reaction conditions, simple and efficient process, green and environment-friendly process, strong practicability and high atom economy, and is suitable for wide popularization.

title_en: Compound, light-emitting material, and light-emitting element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound, a light-emitting material, and a light-emitting element. A compound represented by the following general formula is used as a light-emitting material. R is a hydrogen atom, a deuterium atom, an aryl group or a heteroaryl group bonded via a carbon atom, ar is an aryl group or a heteroaryl group bonded via a carbon atom, D  1  and D  2  are donor groups and at least one is a heterocycle-fused carbazole-9-yl group.

title_en: Preparation method and application of benzimidazole skeleton-containing compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a compound containing benzimidazole skeleton. Specifically, the invention discloses a compound shown in a formula (I) and a pharmaceutical composition thereof, wherein the definition of each group or substituent is as described in the specification. The invention also provides a preparation method of the compound, an inhibition effect and application of the compound in the preparation of a virus nonstructural protein Nsp7/8/12 complex, and also discloses the compound which is used as a brand-new heterocyclic skeleton compound, has high conservation of a target point, can be used for broad-spectrum antivirus, and has potential application prospect in the field of medicaments.

title_en: Perilla triazole onium derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perilla triazolium derivative, which has a chemical structural formula as follows, has a good inhibition effect on plant pathogenic bacteria Botrytis cinerea (Botrytis cinerea), Fusarium oxysporum (Fusarium oxysporum), Colletotrichum camelliae (Colletotrichum camelliae) and Fusarium graminearum (Fusarium graminearum), can be used as a plant inhibitor and is used for preventing and controlling the growth of plant pathogenic bacteria;

title_en: Compound for organic electroluminescent device and organic electroluminescent device comprising same
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound for an organic electroluminescent device and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same. The compound has a structure shown in a formula I, and is a compound with a polysubstituted dehydrogenation condensed ring structure with polysubstituted groups, wherein the substituent groups contain a fluoro-benzodioxole structure, the unique fluoro-benzodioxole structure has good thermal stability and stable electron withdrawing capability, and the unique fluoro-benzodioxole structure is connected with a polysubstituted dehydrogenation condensed ring mother nucleus, so that the organic compound has excellent hole doping capability, can improve the hole injection capability of a hole injection layer, reduce the voltage of the device, improve the efficiency and service life of the device in the preparation of an organic electroluminescent device. I。

title_en: Anti-allergy antibacterial toothpaste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-allergic antibacterial toothpaste and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the anti-allergic antibacterial toothpaste comprise an anti-allergic composition, a thickening agent, a foaming agent, a friction agent and water, the anti-allergic composition comprises calcium sodium phosphosilicate, hydroxyapatite, potassium chloride and collagen. The toothpaste disclosed by the invention can precisely act on exposed dentinal tubules, has high blocking rate on the dentinal tubules, and has a certain synergistic effect on the anti-sensitization effect of sodium calcium phosphosilicate, hydroxyapatite, potassium chloride and collagen. The toothpaste has strong antibacterial effect, effectively inhibits bacterial growth, prevents dental plaque and dental calculus from forming, radically prevents dental caries, gingivitis, periodontitis and other oral diseases, and comprehensively protects oral health.

title_en: Preparation process of extinction PE film for cotton soft towel packaging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of extinction films and discloses a preparation process of an extinction PE film for packaging cotton soft towels, which comprises the steps of taking dibutyl phosphite, 2- (oxazolidine-3-yl) ethanol and di (hydrogenated tallow) phthalic acid amide as raw materials, synthesizing a tetra-long chain alkylated dibutyl phosphate monomer, modifying the tetra-long chain alkylated dibutyl phosphate monomer on the surface of SiO  2  through a covalent grafting method to obtain a solvent-free nano SiO  2  fluid with a core-shell structure, filling the solvent-free nano SiO  2  fluid into a polyethylene and polypropylene mixed resin matrix, mixing to form a homogeneous system, obtaining extinction master batches, taking the extinction master batches as outer layer raw materials, high-density polyethylene resin as intermediate layer raw materials and metallocene polyethylene resin as inner layer raw materials, and adopting a three-layer coextrusion blow molding film forming process to prepare the extinction PE film for packaging cotton soft towels. The extinction PE film developed by the invention has very excellent extinction performance while the tear resistance is only slightly reduced.

title_en: Platinum (IV) prodrug taking EF-24 analogue as ligand, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and relates to a preparation method and application of a platinum (IV) prodrug taking EF-24 analogue as a ligand. The research shows that the synthesized compound has good antiproliferative activity on the tested cancer cells, wherein the compound 8 has the optimal antineoplastic activity, the IC  50  value range is 0.22-0.52 mu M, and the tumor inhibition rate on cisplatin-resistant human lung cancer transplants is 67.2 percent (12.67 mg/kg). In addition, the antiproliferative activity of the compound 8 on cisplatin-resistant cells A549/CDDP is 146.92 times that of cisplatin, the antiproliferative activity on cisplatin-resistant cells A2780/CDDP is 83.40 times that of cisplatin, and the toxicity on human normal lung cells BEAS-2B is lower than that of cisplatin which is a positive drug. The anti-tumor effect of the compound 8 in the cisplatin-resistant lung cancer seed transplantation model is superior to that of cisplatin, and no obvious toxic or side effect is observed. The in-vitro and in-vivo anti-tumor research results show that the compound has potential application prospect for targeted treatment of lung cancer.

title_en: RNAi agents for inhibiting expression of diacylglycerol-O-acyltransferase 2 and uses thereof
abstract_en: RNAi agents and pharmaceutical compositions thereof for inhibiting DGAT2 gene expression in a cell. And therapeutic uses of the RNAi agents.

title_en: Cu (copper) alloy0.1CeO2@LDO photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photo-thermal catalysis, in particular to a Cu  0.1 CeO 2  @LDO photocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. Aiming at the problems of complex existing catalytic system, low conversion rate and the like, the Cu  0.1 CeO 2  @LDO photocatalyst is prepared by a hydrothermal and ethanol impregnation method, and cellulose is selectively converted into lactic acid and formic acid by a photo-thermal catalytic technology. The Cu  0.1 CeO 2  @LDO photocatalyst prepared by the method has good chemical stability and photocatalytic performance, can realize higher conversion rate and product selectivity, and has the advantages of being green, simple, convenient and efficient compared with the traditional thermocatalysis and enzyme catalysis, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ilexolic acid and sodium salt of ilexolic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of ilexolic acid and sodium salt of ilexolic acid. The applicant prepares sodium long-stalk holly acid with good solubility and drug effect. The pharmacodynamics experiment result shows that the sodium pedunculata can reduce the content of myocardial enzyme in serum for myocardial ischemia caused by rat coronary artery ligation, improve electrocardiogram expression caused by myocardial ischemia, and relieve heart index increase caused by myocardial ischemia, so that the sodium pedunculata has a protective effect for myocardial ischemia caused by rat coronary artery ligation. Has important significance for preventing and treating cardiovascular diseases such as coronary heart disease, myocardial ischemia and other common diseases.

title_en: Compounds and methods for synthesizing sphingomyelin
abstract_en: Novel compounds useful for synthesizing sphingomyelin, such as N-palmitoyl-D-erythro-sphingomyelin, novel methods for preparing sphingomyelin using these novel compounds, sphingomyelin formulations prepared by these methods, and compositions comprising sphingomyelin.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of composite modified Y-type molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular sieve modification, in particular to a synthesis method of a composite modified Y-type molecular sieve. The invention takes the Y-shaped molecular sieve as a parent body, carries out acid treatment firstly and then carries out metal modification to obtain the composite modified Y-shaped molecular sieve, and the composite modified Y-shaped molecular sieve shows good catalytic performance in the ring-opening addition reaction of acrylic acid and tetrahydrofuran, promotes the synthesis of 4-hydroxy butyl acrylate, improves the selectivity of a main product, inhibits the polymerization reaction, avoids the generation of a double-esterification product, simplifies the subsequent separation process, and greatly reduces the investment cost.

title_en: Benzodi oxygen heterocyclic compounds preparation method and application of product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pesticides, in particular to a benzodioxan compound and/or a salt thereof, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a benzodioxan compound with novel structure and good comprehensive performance, which has a structure shown in a formula I. The benzodioxan compound has insecticidal function and can be used for preventing and controlling main pests in agriculture, forestry and gardening. The benzodioxan compound provided by the invention is used as an active ingredient to be used as an insecticide, and has excellent control effect on pests such as plutella xylostella when the benzodioxan compound is used in low concentration content.

title_en: Cyano compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, in particular to a cyano compound and application thereof. The invention provides a cyano-containing compound, which has a structure shown as a formula I. The cyano-containing compound provided by the invention has better electron receiving capability, and meanwhile, the fluorene group with large steric hindrance is introduced to weaken the interaction among molecules, so that the cyano-containing compound is used as an electron transport material in an organic electroluminescent device, the current efficiency is improved, and the service life of the device is also greatly prolonged.

title_en: Pyranol palmitate, preparation method thereof and application thereof in cosmetics and external skin medicines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pyranol palmitate formula I compound and a preparation method thereof, and application thereof in cosmetics and external skin medicines. The pyranol palmitate is prepared through acylation reaction, has the advantages of easy absorption, high stability, safety and obvious whitening effect, and experimental results show that the compound has obvious effects on oxidation resistance, melanin inhibition and the like, has no irritation to skin, and is suitable for various cosmetics and skin pharmaceutical preparations.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing tetrahydrofuran by furan hydrogenation, preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for preparing tetrahydrofuran by hydrogenating furan, and preparation and application thereof. According to the invention, the catalyst comprises a first metal component, a second metal component, an auxiliary agent and a carrier, wherein the first metal component is nickel, the second metal component is copper, the auxiliary agent is cerium oxide, and the carrier is silicon dioxide or aluminum oxide. The catalyst comprises, by mass, 10-60% of Ni element, 1-20% of Cu element, 0.5-5% of cerium oxide and the balance of carrier. The catalyst is prepared by adopting a traditional impregnation method, the preparation method is simple, the required catalytic reaction condition is mild, the catalyst has the advantages of high catalytic activity and high tetrahydrofuran selectivity, and the catalyst can improve the yield of tetrahydrofuran prepared by furan hydrogenation and has good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method and production system of hexafluorobutadiene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a production system of hexafluorobutadiene, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) respectively and sequentially feeding an organic solution of trifluorovinyl bromide and zinc powder into a first reactor and a second reactor which are provided with an initiator, zinc powder and an organic solvent, and reacting to obtain the trifluorovinyl zinc bromide solution. And then the reaction liquid enters a sedimentation device to separate excessive zinc powder, so as to obtain zinc powder-free trifluoro vinyl zinc bromide solution, and the excessive zinc powder is filtered and recycled. (2) And (3) introducing the obtained trifluoro vinyl zinc bromide solution and a pre-prepared composite catalyst solution into a third reactor for coupling reaction to obtain a crude hexafluorobutadiene product. (3) Purifying the obtained crude hexafluorobutadiene product to obtain the product with the purity of more than or equal to 99.99 percent. The method has the advantages of high conversion rate of the trifluorobromoethylene, low cost of the coupled composite catalyst, mild reaction conditions, high product purity, high safety and the like.

title_en: Magnetic response type Pickering emulsifier, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a magnetic response type Pickering emulsifier, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the magnetic response type Pickering emulsifier is adopted, and the nano particles can use a very small amount of water to enable high-viscosity tar after deep cracking of acrylic acid to reach a reverse point, so that the tar still keeps a low-viscosity state at normal temperature and can be transported through a pipeline or a tank truck. And the emulsion can be kept in an emulsified state for a long time at high temperature by using the nano particles, so that the storage time is prolonged. After the conveying is finished, the additive magnetic field of the Pickering emulsion of the high-viscosity tar can be quickly demulsified and recycled. The oil phase can be incinerated to produce steam for refining acrylic acid.

title_en: Thiadiazole derivative, composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to thiadiazole derivatives of formula (I), pharmaceutical compositions, methods of preparation and use thereof as therapeutic agents.

title_en: Preparation method and application of mercapto probe based on alpha, beta-unsaturated acrylate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and discloses a near infrared fluorescent probe with an alpha, beta-unsaturated acryloyl ester unit as a response site of sulfhydryl. Fluorescent probes have great advantages in biological small molecule identification, protein labeling and disease diagnosis, and are one of the most convenient and popular tools for exploring complex biological processes. The invention obtains a fluorescent probe molecule which releases red fluorescence after being activated by sulfhydryl for the first time by connecting a fluorophore and an alpha, beta-unsaturated acrylate unit. The fluorescent probe molecule disclosed by the invention can specifically detect the sulfhydryl in organisms, thereby achieving the purpose of accurately monitoring the sulfhydryl in cells.

title_en: Non-noble metal catalyst Cu-ZnO/TiO2Application of P25 in catalytic synthesis of N, N' -dicyclohexyl-P-phenylenediamine in heterogeneous system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of a non-noble metal catalyst Cu-ZnO/TiO  2  in catalyzing and synthesizing N, N' -dicyclohexyl p-phenylenediamine in a heterogeneous system, belonging to the technical field of catalyst preparation and application. The catalyst takes zinc nitrate hexahydrate as a zinc source, copper nitrate trihydrate as a copper source and P25 type titanium dioxide as a carrier, adopts a fractional precipitation method to load metal on the titanium dioxide, is put into a tube furnace for hydrogen reduction to obtain a catalyst Cu-ZnO/TiO  2 , is then dispersed in a solvent, and catalyzes the photo-thermal reductive amination reaction of P-phenylenediamine and cyclohexanone to synthesize the novel rubber anti-aging agent N, N' -dicyclohexyl P-phenylenediamine. The Cu-ZnO/TiO  2  catalyst with the copper content of 7% and the zinc oxide content of 4% has excellent catalytic performance, and the conversion rate of p-phenylenediamine reaches 100% and the selectivity of N, N' -dicyclohexyl-p-phenylenediamine reaches 99.9% when the hydrogen pressure is 6MPa and the temperature is 200 ℃ and the reaction time is 10 hours. The preparation method is simple, low in cost and high in catalytic selectivity, and has wide industrialization prospect.

title_en: Wet tissue liquid spraying equipment and method for wet tissue production
abstract_en: The invention discloses wet tissue liquid spraying equipment and a method for producing wet tissues, and relates to the field of liquid phase treatment of textile materials, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, spraying the wet tissue liquid onto the surface of a wet tissue base material at the pressure of 0.15-0.25 MPa; S2, spraying the residual total amount of wet tissue liquid onto the surface of the pre-wetted wet tissue base material under the pressure of 0.6-0.8 MPa, and S3, spraying gas to the edge of the wet tissue base material during the pre-wetted spraying and the post-high-pressure spraying to form edge air curtain restraining liquid drops. Through the composite process of staged spraying and air curtain constraint, low-pressure pre-spraying passes through the surface of a mild wetting substrate, high-pressure post-spraying drives liquid molecules to penetrate into the substrate by means of the guidance of a pre-wetting channel, meanwhile, air curtain constraint effectively prevents liquid drops from scattering and escaping, spraying efficiency and liquid utilization rate are further improved, foaming rate is further remarkably reduced, liquid utilization rate is improved, distribution uniformity of liquid on a wet towel substrate is ensured, and therefore the using effect of the wet towel is greatly improved.

title_en: Methanol production system
abstract_en: The invention provides a methanol production system, which comprises a reverse water gas reaction module, a methanol synthesis module and a reverse water gas reaction module, wherein the reverse water gas reaction module is provided with a first in-situ separation reactor, the first in-situ separation reactor is configured to carry out reverse water gas conversion of carbon dioxide and hydrogen to generate and in-situ separate carbon monoxide and water, the methanol synthesis module is connected with the reverse water gas reaction module and is provided with a second in-situ separation reactor, and the second in-situ separation reactor is configured to react the carbon monoxide generated by the reverse water gas reaction module with the hydrogen to generate and in-situ separate methanol. The scheme of the invention organically couples the two-step methanol preparation process and the in-situ separation reactor, so that the conversion of carbon dioxide can be completed under a milder working condition, the problems of low single-pass conversion rate, high recycling compression work and the like of preparing methanol by hydrogenating the carbon dioxide are solved, the energy consumption for separating water and methanol is saved, the cost of methanol production is further reduced, and the reliability and the economy of the system are improved.

title_en: Marine fungus-derived small molecule compound and application thereof in preparation of medicines for treating renal fibrosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine fungus-derived micromolecule compound and application thereof in preparing medicines for treating renal fibrosis, and relates to the field of marine natural products. The structural formula of the compound Gamahorin A is shown as the formula (I). Gamahorin A shows significant anti-fibrotic activity by inhibiting TGF- β1-induced α -smooth muscle actin (α -SMA) expression and ECM component (type I collagen and fibronectin) production, inhibiting renal fibrosis progression.

title_en: Efficient synthesis method of polyketide penicilfuranone A
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency synthesis method of polyketone compound penicilfuranone A, which has the structural formula:  According to the invention, through a Stetter-Aldol serial cyclization reaction catalyzed by an N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC), a tetralone skeleton with a tertiary alcohol structure is rapidly constructed, and efficient preparation of a natural product penicilfuranone A is realized. The synthesis method provided by the invention is novel, efficient and economic, reagents used in the whole synthesis process can be purchased commercially at low price, and the reaction strategy is also suitable for synthesis of the intermediates or the derivatives, so that a foundation is laid for structural modification, structure-activity relationship research, new medicine development and mass preparation.

title_en: Mannich type modified diethylenetriamine lignin calcium sulfonate-based filtrate reducer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Mannich type modified diethylenetriamine lignin calcium sulfonate-based filtrate reducer which is characterized by being prepared by reacting calcium lignosulfonate, formaldehyde, diethylenetriamine and anhydrous sodium sulfite. The filtrate reducer has 180 ℃ temperature resistance, greatly improves the calcium resistance performance compared with the conventional filtrate reducer, reaches 10000mg/L, has good compatibility with various water-based drilling fluids, is convenient to use, and has important application value by boosting the technical progress of anti-pollution drilling fluids.

title_en: La doped Pd-CeO2Mono-atom catalyzed aromatic hydrocarbon deuteration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arene deuteration method by La-doped Pd-CeO  2  monoatomic catalysis, which takes arene as a raw material, and under the action of La-doped Pd-CeO  2  monoatomic catalyst and heavy water under the normal pressure system with or without solvent, the reaction product is separated and purified to obtain deuterated product. The La-doped Pd-CeO  2  monoatomic catalyst is used, heavy water is used as deuterium source to carry out deuteration of aromatic hydrocarbon substrates, the catalyst is simple to prepare, the reaction condition is mild, the deuteration degree and the yield are high, and the separation is simple.

title_en: Crystalline forms of 5- [ (2, 4-dinitrophenoxy) methyl ] -1-methyl-2-nitro-1H-imidazole
abstract_en: The present application relates to polymorphic forms of 5- [ (2, 4-dinitrophenoxy) methyl ] -1-methyl-2-nitro-1H-imidazole for use in the treatment of a granulomatous linear related disorder or condition.

title_en: Anti-aging and antioxidant bicyclic peptide compound as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging and antioxidant bicyclic peptide compound, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of polypeptide compound synthesis, and in particular relating to a full-protection peptide resin prepared by adopting solid phase synthesis, wherein the full-protection peptide resin is cut and singly cyclized to obtain a monobasic cyclic peptide, the monobasic cyclic peptide is subjected to binary cyclization treatment to obtain a bicyclic peptide compound Cyclo (His-Cys-Lys-Gly-His-Cys-Lys-Gly-, disulfide bridges Cys & Cys), and the binary cyclization is cyclized under the action of iodomethanol and ascorbic acid or in DMSO. The anti-aging and anti-oxidation bicyclic peptide compound prepared by the invention has the advantages of low toxicity, good stability, good anti-oxidation effect and good anti-inflammatory effect, and can promote the expression of type I collagen.

title_en: Composition for conditioning keratin fibres
abstract_en: A composition for conditioning keratin fibres, comprising a) at least one cationizable surfactant chosen from tertiary amidoamines, b) at least one lipophilic acid, and c) at least one lipophilic polyglycerol-based nonionic surfactant. A non-therapeutic method for conditioning keratin fibers comprising applying the composition to keratin fibers.

title_en: Novel heterocyclic substituted acrylic acid derivative and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a compound shown in a formula I or a tautomer, cis-trans isomer or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and application thereof, wherein the compound comprises inflammatory or autoimmune diseases such as psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, dermatitis, lupus erythematosus, inflammatory bowel disease, suppurative sweat gland inflammation, rheumatoid arthritis, uveitis and the like. The structure of the compound of the formula I is as shown in the claims and the specification. The acrylic acid derivative provided by the invention is used as a novel TYK2 inhibitor, has good TYK2 selective inhibition effect, can reduce side effects caused by inhibiting other JAK family members, and has low off-target risk and higher safety. Has good therapeutic effect in animal models of psoriasis and asthma, good drug forming property and good safety.

title_en: Quick-drying hand-washing-free disinfection gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disinfection gel, and discloses a quick-drying hand-washing-free disinfection gel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the disinfection gel comprises, by weight, 70-80% of ethanol, 0.3-0.8% of carbomer, 0.1-1% of glyceroglycosides, 0.05-0.5% of hydroxyethyl cellulose, 0.05-0.2% of triethanolamine, 1-5% of humectant, 0.15-0.9% of anti-sensitizer, 0.02-0.1% of soothing agent and the balance of water. The application can improve the storage time of the disinfection gel, thereby improving the service life and maintaining the sterilization effect of the disinfection gel.

title_en: Compound, nanoparticle, medicine, and method for producing nanoparticle
abstract_en: A compound represented by the general formula (1) or a salt thereof. R  1  and R  2  each independently represent an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms. R  1  and R  2  may be bonded to each other to form a ring together with the carbon atoms to which R  1  and R  2  are bonded. R  3  each independently represents an alkylene group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms. In addition, nanoparticles comprising the aforementioned compounds or salts thereof. In addition, a pharmaceutical comprising the aforementioned compound or a salt thereof. The method for producing nanoparticles includes a step of injecting a water-miscible organic solvent solution of the compound or a salt thereof into water.

title_en: Organic compound, application thereof and organic electroluminescent device comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic compound, and to the use of such a compound and to an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same. The organic compound has a structure shown in the following formula (1), wherein ring A, ring B, ring C and ring I each independently represent a benzene ring, a naphthalene ring or an anthracene ring, ring D, ring E, ring F and ring G each independently represent one of C5-C20 aromatic rings and C4-C20 heteroaromatic rings, ring Z and ring W each independently represent a benzene ring, naphthalene ring or anthracene ring, X, Y each independently represent a single bond, O, CO, SO  2 、S、NR 1 、CR 2 R 3  or SiR  4 R 5 , and when X is a single bond, Y is selected from CO, SO  2 、S、NR 1 、CR 2 R 3  or SiR  4 R 5 . The organic electroluminescent device adopting the compound has high color purity, high luminous efficiency and good performance, realizes low-efficiency roll-off, and has extremely long service life.

title_en: Soothing and moisturizing composition for sensitive muscles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for relieving and moisturizing sensitive muscles and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of cosmetics. The invention creatively mixes moisturizing components consisting of the tetrahydropyrimidine carboxylic acid, saccharide isomer, trehalose, squalane and glycerol according to a certain mass ratio, soothing components consisting of the radix asparagi extract and the rheum palmatum extract according to a certain mass ratio, cyclodextrin, emulsifying agent, thickening agent, preservative and solvent in a physical blending mode, so that a composition is prepared, and the composition can exert excellent moisturizing and soothing effects when being smeared on the skin around eyes, has small irritation and is very suitable for sensitive muscle groups.

title_en: Separation system for preparing propylene from methanol
abstract_en: The invention provides a separation system for preparing propylene from methanol, belongs to the technical field of preparing propylene from methanol, and solves the problems of large occupied area, high investment cost, unobvious separation effect, low byproduct utilization rate, low product yield, high energy consumption and high production cost of the existing separation system. The device comprises a gas-phase hydrocarbon input pipe and a liquid-phase hydrocarbon input pipe, wherein the gas-phase hydrocarbon input pipe is connected with a depropanizer, the depropanizer is connected with a deethanizer, the deethanizer is connected with a propylene rectifying tower, the propylene rectifying tower is connected with a propylene output pipe, the liquid-phase hydrocarbon input pipe is connected with a debutanizer, and the top of the debutanizer is communicated with the gas-phase hydrocarbon input pipe. The gas phase hydrocarbon sequentially enters the depropanizer, the deethanizer and the propylene rectifying tower, the liquid phase hydrocarbon sequentially enters the depropanizer, the deethanizer and the propylene rectifying tower, the demethanizer and the ethylene rectifying tower in the prior art are eliminated, the operation conditions are relatively simple, the occupied area is small, the investment cost is low, the energy consumption is obviously reduced, and the production cost is low.

title_en: Novel linker drugs comprising phosphoantigens, novel conjugates and their use in therapy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel linker pharmaceutical compounds based on specific phosphoantigens (pAg) having the general structure shown in formula (I) wherein L represents a linking moiety (linker) and W  1 、W 2 、X 1 To the point of  , x, m, n and R  1 To the point of   4 are as defined in the specification. Also provided are conjugates comprising a targeting moiety, preferably a tumor targeting antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof, covalently linked to a linker pharmaceutical compound according to the invention. Such conjugates are useful, for example, in the treatment of diseases such as cancer, infections or autoimmune diseases.

title_en: Preparation and anti-tumor application of 9, 10-anthraquinone- (5-substituted salicylaldehyde) Schiff base dibutyl tin complex
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 9, 10-anthraquinone- (5-substituted salicylaldehyde) Schiff base dibutyl tin complex, which is a compound with the following structural formula (I):  The tin atom in the molecule of the compound is in a five-coordination triangle bipyramid configuration. The inventor also establishes a corresponding preparation method, namely, the reaction is completed under the condition of heating and refluxing by taking 2-amino-3-hydroxyanthraquinone, 5-substituted salicylaldehyde and dibutyl tin oxide as raw materials and absolute methanol as a solvent. The research shows that the 9, 10-anthraquinone- (5-substituted salicylaldehyde) Schiff base dibutyl tin complex has good inhibition activity on human lung cancer cells, human liver cancer cells, human breast cancer cells and human mouth cancer, and the in vitro anticancer activity is obviously superior to that of classical metal anticancer drugs cisplatin. Therefore, the method has potential application value in the research and development of anticancer drugs for human lung cancer, human liver cancer, human breast cancer and human oral cavity cancer. In conclusion, the anthraquinone dibutyl tin complex has good anticancer activity, low cost and simple preparation method, and provides a new way for developing new anticancer drugs.

title_en: Containing biosurfactants and deferoxamine compositions
abstract_en: A composition comprising a) at least one substance selected from the group consisting of deferoxamine and acid addition products of deferoxamine or salts thereof, B) at least one biosurfactant, and optionally C) at least one non-biosurfactant. Use of a composition according to at least one of the preceding claims for removing dirt, preferably fatty and/or oily stains, from a surface, preferably selected from the group consisting of skin, a cutlery surface or a textile surface.

title_en: Preparation and application of column aromatic hydrocarbon grafted cyclodextrin double-macrocyclic chiral filler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a column aromatic hydrocarbon grafted cyclodextrin double-macrocyclic chiral filler and application thereof in chiral pesticide separation. The filler forms a double-macrocyclic structure with multiple chiral recognition sites by covalently grafting para-brominated column aromatic hydrocarbon and beta-aminopropyl cyclodextrin onto aminopropyl silica gel. The preparation process includes catalytic condensation synthesis of arene in bromination column and double-ring bonding reaction on silica gel surface. The filler has high selectivity, multimode compatibility (both normal phase and reverse phase can be used) and excellent stability. The method is particularly suitable for enantiomer resolution of triazole (propiconazole, triazolone) and ester (clodinafop-propargyl) pesticides, and provides a high-efficiency separation tool for environmental behavior research and safety evaluation of chiral pesticides. The invention has simple and convenient process and low cost, solves the problems of insufficient selectivity and narrow application range of the solvent of the existing chiral filler, and has industrial application potential.

title_en: 1,2,3,4, 5-Penta (2-cyanoethoxy) pentane crystal and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a1, 2,3,4, 5-penta (2-cyanoethoxy) pentane crystal and a preparation method thereof, wherein the crystal comprises the following unit cell parameters α=90°,β=103.022±0.008°,γ=90°, The preparation method comprises the steps of 1) reacting xylitol with acrylonitrile under a base catalyst, adding a solvent and water after the reaction is finished, neutralizing with acid, separating an organic layer, washing with water to be neutral, concentrating the organic layer to obtain an oily crude product, 2) adding a first organic solvent into the oily crude product, pulping until the oily crude product is solidified, and filtering to obtain a solid crude product, 3) heating and dissolving the solid crude product obtained in the step 2) with a second organic solvent, filtering to obtain a filtrate, cooling the filtrate to be crystallized, filtering after crystal precipitation, and drying to obtain the solid crude product. The invention provides a method for eluting impurities and intermediates by using an organic solvent, so that the purity of a crude product is improved, and impurities in the crude product can be further dissolved by crystallization and purification, thereby improving the purity of the product and obtaining a high-purity product.

title_en: Skin photoaging repair composition, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a skin photoaging repair composition, and a preparation method and application thereof. The repairing composition comprises, by weight, 1% -20% of naringenin, 0.1% -10% of ergothioneine, 0.5% -10% of thiotaurine, 1% -15% of nicotinamide, 1% -15% of resveratrol and the total weight of the repairing composition. The repair composition provided by the embodiment of the application can intervene from multiple targets based on deep causes of photoaging related to multi-path damage, has remarkable antioxidation, anti-inflammatory and DNA protection effects, can effectively inhibit UVB-induced DNA damage, reduces over-expression of inflammatory factors such as IL-1 beta, IL-6, MMP-1, TNF-alpha, MMP-9 and the like, reduces skin edema, reduces the level of aging markers, and remarkably improves the photoaging phenomenon of skin.

title_en: Multi-tertiary amine multi-tail ionizable cationic lipids, compositions comprising same and uses
abstract_en: The present disclosure is in the field of medicine, more specifically, in the field of delivery lipid technology, and discloses multi-tertiary amine multi-tail ionizable cationic lipids, compositions comprising the same, and uses thereof. The multi-tertiary amine multi-tail chain ionizable cationic lipid provided by the disclosure comprises a structure shown as a formula (I), can be used for targeted delivery of nucleic acid, and can remarkably enhance the anti-off-target effect of mRNA vaccine or medicine.

title_en: Method for preparing cefixime side chain open-loop acid by aqueous phase method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of acyclic compounds, and particularly relates to a method for preparing cefixime side chain open-loop acid by a water phase method. Adding a compound I, a catalyst and a citric acid solution into water for deprotection reaction to obtain an aqueous solution containing the compound II and the catalyst, cooling the aqueous solution containing the compound II and the catalyst, adding an N-chlorosuccinimide aqueous solution for chlorination reaction, adding alkali for adjusting pH, extracting, layering to obtain a water phase, adding acid into the water phase for adjusting pH, separating out solids, filtering, and drying in vacuum to obtain cefixime side chain open-loop acid. The invention uses water as a solvent system, avoids the environmental protection problems of acid waste gas, volatile VOCs and the like generated in the prior art, has less side reaction and high product yield.

title_en: Para-phenylenediamine antiozonant and its synthesis process, antiozonant composition and rubber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a p-phenylenediamine ozone inhibitor and a synthesis method thereof, an ozone inhibitor composition and rubber, wherein the p-phenylenediamine ozone inhibitor is prepared by adding p-dihalide benzene, p-phenylenediamine, a ligand, a catalyst and inorganic base into a polar organic solvent for dissolution, heating and reacting in an inert atmosphere, settling in ethanol after the reaction is finished, collecting the sediment, washing and drying. The p-phenylenediamine ozone resisting agent has the advantages of large molecular weight, high steric hindrance and migration resistance, has positive effect on long-acting protection of rubber, and is beneficial to improving the ozone resistance and durability of the rubber. By adding the p-phenylenediamine ozone resisting agent into rubber, the ozone resistance of the rubber is obviously improved.

title_en: Polycarboxylate surfactant containing tocopherol and application of polycarboxylate surfactant in pesticides
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polycarboxylate surfactants containing tocopherol, and discloses a polycarboxylate surfactant containing tocopherol and application thereof in pesticides, the invention takes trans-1, 4-dichloro-2-butene, diethanolamine, phosphorus pentoxide and the like as raw materials, and the tetraphosphoric acid alkene-containing intermediate is obtained through substitution reaction and esterification reaction. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking DL-alpha-tocopherol, maleic anhydride, polyethylene glycol and the like as raw materials, obtaining the tocopherol modified polyethylene glycol through two-step reaction, and copolymerizing an alkenyl structure contained in the tocopherol modified polyethylene glycol with raw materials such as acrylic acid, tetraphosphoric acid alkene-containing intermediate and the like to obtain the polycarboxylate surfactant containing tocopherol. The polycarboxylate surfactant containing the tocopherol, which is prepared by the invention, is applied to pesticides, and can improve the suspension effect and heat storage stability of pesticide water suspending agents.

title_en: Regenerated silk fibroin composite sodium hyaluronate gel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses regenerated silk fibroin composite sodium hyaluronate gel and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1, stirring regenerated silk fibroin solution, filtering, adding a gel accelerator into filtrate, uniformly mixing, sealing, and carrying out heat preservation treatment to obtain regenerated silk fibroin gel; and 2, adding a sodium hyaluronate solution into the regenerated silk fibroin gel obtained in the step 1, uniformly mixing the system, and sterilizing to obtain the regenerated silk fibroin gel. The preparation method of the regenerated silk fibroin composite sodium hyaluronate gel utilizes the characteristic that the regenerated silk fibroin is not resistant to shearing, and prepares the regenerated silk fibroin composite sodium hyaluronate gel under the condition that a chemical cross-linking agent is not required to be additionally added, so that the prepared regenerated silk fibroin composite sodium hyaluronate gel has excellent biocompatibility, has the effects of relieving, repairing, diminishing inflammation and tightening skin, is controllable in preparation process, and can be conveniently and rapidly prepared into gel suitable for medical repair products, functional skin care products and soft tissue fillers for injection according to needs.

title_en: Surfactant composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of new daily chemical materials, and discloses a surfactant composition which comprises, by weight, 10-85% of a glycoside derivative, 5-30% of an amphoteric surfactant, 0.1-20% of a vegetable protein hydrolysate, wherein the glycoside derivative is an anion modified product of glycoside, and the molecular weight of the vegetable protein hydrolysate is 100-2000 daltons. The composition adopts a combination of a specific glycoside derivative, an amphoteric surfactant and a plant protein hydrolysate, can play a good synergistic effect, and achieves the effects that the surfactant composition is extremely mild, has fine and smooth foam, is stable and high in foam and does not slip after washing. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a preparation method and application of the composition.

title_en: Compound, preparation method thereof and application of compound in small molecule intercalation inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petroleum aids, and discloses a compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The compound has a structure shown in a formula (I-1), has good rigidity and strong temperature resistance as a small molecule intercalation inhibitor, has strong inhibitor performance under high temperature conditions, has smaller molecular volume, can enter the layers of water-sensitive clay minerals more easily, can well inhibit hydration expansion of the clay minerals, and is a shale inhibitor with excellent performance.

title_en: Synthesis method of 1,3,5, 7-tetraacetyl-1, 3,5, 7-tetraazacyclooctane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly relates to a synthesis method of 1,3,5, 7-tetraacetyl-1, 3,5, 7-tetraazacyclooctane. The method comprises the steps of taking hexamethylenetetramine, first acetic anhydride and ammonium acetate as raw materials, carrying out acyl hydrolysis reaction by using a microchannel reactor to obtain DAPT, carrying out ring opening reaction by taking DAPT and second acetic anhydride as raw materials under a reaction system consisting of pyridine hydrochloride catalyst and acetate, and adding water to carry out hydrolysis reaction after the reaction is finished to obtain TAT. The invention provides a method for preparing DAPT strategy by a microchannel reactor under mild conditions, then realizing DAPT ring opening based on a traditional acetic anhydride acylation method by using a low-cost and easily-obtained pyridine hydrochloride catalyst, obtaining a product TAT with higher yield and excellent selectivity, and simultaneously reducing energy consumption, and the reaction process is simple.

title_en: Deodorization antiperspirant spray based on plant components and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deodorizing antiperspirant spray based on plant components and a preparation method thereof, the spray mainly comprises natural antibacterial antiperspirant ingredients, and can realize the effects of effectively inhibiting bacteria, astringing sweat glands and relieving skin. The spray is mild and has no stimulation, can effectively inhibit the odor under the armpit, reduce sweat secretion, and is compound with green and healthy consumption trend.

title_en: Mild female sanitary facial cleanser composition and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a female cleaner and a female cleaner composition for manufacturing the same, and more particularly, to a composition comprising a rice flower extract, a yulian bark extract, a jujube fruit extract, a camellia callus extract and a lotus flower extract as active ingredients, and a female cleaner using the same.

title_en: Plant extract anti-allergic agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant extract anti-allergic agent, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of cosmetics. The plant extraction anti-allergic agent comprises herba Andrographitis extract, radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii extract, glycyrrhrizae radix extract, radix Ophiopogonis extract and herba Portulacae extract, pulverizing radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii, adding cellulase and pectase for enzymolysis, extracting the residue with 50-60% ethanol solution at 30-40deg.C under reduced pressure to obtain radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii extract, mixing radix Ophiopogonis with 20-40% ethanol at 500-800W, performing microwave treatment, reflux extracting to obtain radix Ophiopogonis extract, pulverizing Glycyrrhrizae radix, mixing with solvent choline chloride and 1, 3-butanediol, and extracting to obtain Glycyrrhrizae radix extract. The invention researches the preparation method of the plant extract, and 5 components are mutually cooperated and matched, so that the plant extract has good anti-allergy, skin soothing and anti-inflammatory effects and is widely applied to the preparation of anti-allergy cosmetics or anti-allergy drugs.

title_en: For catalyzing CO2Ternary metal oxide-molecular sieve composite material for preparing low-carbon alkane through hydrogenation, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ternary metal oxide-molecular sieve composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of catalysts. The composite material provided by the invention comprises a ternary metal oxide and a molecular sieve, wherein the general formula of the ternary metal oxide is M1  a M2 b M3 c  Ox, M1 is at least one of Fe, co, ni, pt, pd, cu, zn, M2 is at least one of Cr, mn, mo, cd, ga, in, M3 is at least one of Ce, zr, ti, al, and the molar ratio a is b: c=0.01-0.5:0.05-1:1. The optimized ternary metal and molecular sieve are used as the composite catalyst, the CO  2  conversion rate is improved and the stability of the catalyst is obviously improved at a lower catalytic temperature, the H-SAPO-34 molecular sieve has an eight-membered ring pore structure, the generation of low-carbon olefins is facilitated, and meanwhile, the high-efficiency conversion of the low-carbon olefins into C  2 -C 4  alkanes (ethane, propane and butane) is promoted due to the strong hydrogenation capability of the oxide.

title_en: Cationic surfactant and yellowing-resistant fabric softener composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cationic surfactant, a preparation method and application thereof, a softener composition and a preparation method and application thereof. Firstly, designing and synthesizing a cationic surfactant with a novel structure, introducing cycloalkyl and siloxy by using beta- (3, 4-epoxycyclohexyl) ethyl trialkoxysilane, wherein the epoxy group on the cycloparaffin is easy to carry out nucleophilic substitution reaction at a lower temperature to generate ring opening reaction due to the reason that the ring tension increases the internal stress of the molecule, thereby increasing the steric hindrance around N atoms and improving the yellowing resistance and the stability of the surfactant at a high temperature through steric effect. In addition, si-OR groups which can be hydrolyzed and condensed are introduced into the cationic surfactant, so that the Si-OR groups can be condensed with hydroxyl groups of cellulose molecules, the Si-OR groups are more firmly adsorbed on the surface of cellulose through chemical bond action, the effect is exerted, and the fabric is better in softening performance after being treated.

title_en: Composition for cleansing skin
abstract_en: A composition for cleansing the skin comprising a) greater than 1.0% by weight, relative to the total weight of the composition, of at least one compound of the ceramide type, and b) greater than 1.0% by weight, relative to the total weight of the composition, of at least one surfactant. A method for cleansing skin comprising applying a composition to skin and washing away the composition after an optional time.

title_en: Hydrazide compound with anti-tumor activity and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, in particular to an acyl hydrazine compound with anti-tumor activity, and a preparation method and application thereof. In the invention, the prepared hydrazide compound can be used as a USP16 inhibitor, has the activity of effectively inhibiting proliferation of breast cancer cells, and provides safe and efficient candidate drug molecules for treating breast cancer. The synthesis method of the hydrazide compound is simple, raw materials are easy to obtain, and the compatibility of functional groups is good. Experimental results show that the tumor inhibition rate of the hydrazide compound for treating the mouse tumor-bearing group is better than that of the positive control group, and the hydrazide compound has good application prospect.

title_en: Targeted protein degradation
abstract_en: The present invention provides pharmaceutical protein degrading agents and E3 ubiquitin ligase binders for therapeutic applications as further described herein.

title_en: Process for producing trifluoroacetate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for producing trifluoroacetic acid, which can purify trifluoroacetic acid by a simple method such as distillation without using amines or potassium fluoride. Also provided is a process for producing a trifluoroacetate, which comprises a reaction step of adding CF  3  COF to a lower alcohol having 1 to 4 carbon atoms in an equimolar amount or more to obtain a trifluoroacetate and HF.

title_en: Moisturizing type shampoo and bath lotion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a moisturizing shampoo and bath lotion and a preparation method thereof, wherein the moisturizing shampoo and bath lotion comprises the components of an emollient, a surfactant, a thickener, a skin conditioner, a humectant, an antioxidant and water; the skin conditioner is a combination of camellia extract, lime peel extract, scutellaria baicalensis flower/leaf/stem extract, glyceroglycosides and rambutan peel extract. The shampoo and bath product with low irritation and excellent moisturizing performance is constructed by adopting the mild emollient, the surfactant and the moisturizing agent, and has no pearling agent, no sulfate, no sulfonate, no traditional antiseptic and no acne-causing component, so that the shampoo and bath product not only can quickly restore the microecological balance of skin, but also has excellent moisturizing and oil controlling effects.

title_en: Composition with multiple-effect anti-aging effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of daily chemicals, in particular to a composition with multiple-effect anti-aging effect and application thereof. The composition comprises retinol, palmitoyl tripeptide-1, palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7, lactobacillus/soybean milk fermentation product filtrate and resveratrol. The invention relates to a composition with a triple anti-aging system for mildly promoting collagen regeneration and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition comprises retinol, palmitoyl tripeptide-1, palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7, lactobacillus/soybean milk fermentation product filtrate and resveratrol, has obvious effects on skin epidermis and dermis aging, can regulate the balance of skin flora, enhance the water locking capacity of stratum corneum, improve the permeability of active ingredients and increase the activity of cells, has the characteristics of oxidation resistance and inflammation resistance in epidermis and dermis, has mild ingredients and good absorption effect, does not need to establish tolerance, consolidates the skin resistance, and is particularly suitable for sensitive muscles.

title_en: Application of two PPAP compounds in preparation of medicines for treating neurodegenerative diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides application of two polycyclic poly-isopentenyl acyl phloroglucinol compounds (PPAP) with different framework types in preparation of medicines for relieving/treating neurodegenerative diseases. Belongs to the technical field of medicines. The hyphenrone A provided by the invention is a 1, 9-split ring polycyclic polyisopentenyl phloroglucinol compound, and hyphenrone L is a polycyclic polyisopentenyl acyl phloroglucinol compound with a complex heterocyclic ring system formed by cyclizing a monocyclic polyisopentenyl acyl phloroglucinol compound in a molecule [4+2 ]. The compounds hyphenrone A and hyphenrone L both have the activity of enhancing the voltage-gated T-type calcium channel current, can be used for preparing medicaments for treating neurodegenerative diseases, particularly medicaments for relieving and/or treating diseases such as spinocerebellar ataxia, alzheimer's disease, dysnoesia and the like, and have clinical application value.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon dioxide hydrogenation catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a carbon dioxide hydrogenation catalyst, and belongs to the field of hydrogenation catalysis. The method comprises the steps of taking vanadium slag as a raw material, obtaining leaching solution containing silicon, chromium and vanadium through sodium roasting, adding an aluminum source for removing silicon elements, adding an ordered mesoporous carbon material, converting elemental silicon and aluminum into ordered mesoporous composite oxides, using the ordered mesoporous composite oxides as hydrogenation catalyst carriers, dissolving indium salt, cerium salt and nickel salt in ethanol, mixing the ethanol salt, the cerium salt and the nickel salt with the carriers, carrying out isovolumetric impregnation to obtain a hydrogenation catalyst, and separating chromium and vanadium from the leaching solution after removing silicon to obtain the chromium trioxide and the electrolyte of the all-vanadium redox flow battery. The catalyst has a regular pore canal structure, ordered mesopores provide a domain limiting effect, are beneficial to the dispersion and anchoring of active components, and remarkably improve the activity of the catalyst.

title_en: Production separator of production dimethyl disulfide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dimethyl disulfide production, in particular to a production separation device for producing dimethyl disulfide, including separation evaporation jar and the cover of setting at separation evaporation jar up end, be provided with impurity clearance subassembly on the cover. According to the invention, impurities attached to the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank can be cleaned up and down back and forth and the bottom end of the inner side of the separation evaporation tank can be scraped and cleaned through the arrangement of the impurity cleaning component, so that the cleaning range of the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank is large, the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank is cleaner, the impurities attached to the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank can be subjected to transverse and longitudinal cleaning forces, so that the impurities attached firmly can be cleaned, in addition, the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank can be vibrated, the impurities attached to the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank can be loosened, and the cleaning capability of the impurity cleaning component for attaching the impurities to the inner side wall surface of the separation evaporation tank is improved.

title_en: Isotropic high-strength photo-curing 3D printing resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to isotropic high-strength photo-curing 3D printing resin and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the dynamic dissociation isocyanate cross-linking agent in the resin system comprises the steps of taking tert-butylaminoethyl methacrylate and isophorone diisocyanate as raw materials to synthesize the dynamic dissociation isocyanate cross-linking agent. The dynamic dissociation isocyanate crosslinking agent prepared by the invention can be used as a photocrosslinking agent in the photocuring 3D printing process, so that the shape retention of 3D printing is improved, and isocyanate groups can be released in the heat curing process to form a secondary crosslinking network between layers. On the premise of ensuring printability, the mechanical strength of the printing material is improved, and meanwhile, the anisotropy of the printing product is eliminated, so that the wide application of photo-curing 3D printing is facilitated.

title_en: Benzofuran compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to benzofuran compounds, a preparation method and application thereof, and in particular relates to a compound shown in a formula (I) or a stereoisomer, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, a solvate or a prodrug thereof, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing a medicament for treating tuberculosis, wherein each group definition is shown in the specification in detail. The compound has novel binding mode with PKS13, has better inhibition activity on PKS13,

title_en: All-trans Diels-Alder adduct and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to an all-trans Diels-Alder adduct extracted from white mulberry root-bark, and discloses a method for preparing the Diels-Alder adduct and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of extracting cortex mori coarse powder by alcohol, detecting and collecting fractions containing target compounds through a macroporous adsorption resin column adsorption chromatography and a thin layer chromatography, and separating and purifying the fractions containing the target compounds through silica gel column pressure reduction chromatography, polyamide column chromatography, ODS column chromatography and high performance liquid chromatography to obtain an all-trans Diels-Alder adduct. The method for preparing the all-trans Diels-Alder adduct has definite and controllable operation, and the obtained compound has few impurities and high purity and has the potential of developing into anti-Alzheimer disease drugs.

title_en: System and process for efficiently recycling and preparing acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile
abstract_en: The invention relates to an efficient recovery preparation system and process for acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile, and belongs to the technical field of acetonitrile recovery. Comprises an HCN removing unit, an extraction rectification dehydration unit, a solvent recovery unit and a finished product refining unit, wherein a pre-separation unit is additionally arranged at the upstream of a feed pipe line of the HCN removing unit. The preseparation unit is preferably a cyclone flash tank and is used for preseparating the preheated crude acetonitrile raw material liquid to obtain a gas-phase material rich in hydrogen cyanide and a liquid-phase material with reduced hydrogen cyanide content. Wherein, the liquid phase material is sent to the HCN removal tower, and the gas phase material is directly integrated into the tower top steam system of the HCN removal tower. The cyclone flash tank is internally provided with a rotary inner cylinder which is driven by fluid and provided with spiral blades, a conical reverse pushing assembly and a water removal assembly, so that efficient gas-liquid cyclone separation is realized. The invention solves the technical problems of high energy consumption, limited system processing capacity and poor stability of the HCN removal unit in the existing acetonitrile refining process.

title_en: Compounds, liposomes, and uses thereof for delivery of nucleic acids
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound which is a compound shown in a formula (I) or a stereoisomer, a tautomer, a solvate and a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the compound shown in the formula (I). The compound provided by the invention is used as liposome, has high transfection efficiency, and can be especially used for delivering nucleic acid molecules and the like (such as siRNA, mRNA, pDNA) to regulate the expression of proteins, or delivering CRISPR gene editing tools to realize the knockout or repair of lesion genes.

title_en: Composition and cosmetic for improving facial skin state and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cosmetics, and relates to a composition for improving facial skin states, a cosmetic and a preparation method thereof. The composition comprises 0.01-2% of phenethyl resorcinol, 0.01-20% of SPG beta-glucan, 0.01-5% of chitosan amine and 0.001-5% of Tibetan mushroom fermentation product.
