The compound of the phenethyl resorcinol and the SPG beta-glucan, the acetylglucosamine, the Tibetan mushroom ferment and the phenethyl resorcinol can strengthen a whitening passage, improve skin tolerance, strengthen skin barrier, strengthen oxidation resistance and anti-inflammatory property, so that the irritation of the whole composition can be reduced, the whitening effect can be improved, the skin state can be comprehensively improved, the skin brightness can be improved, the skin redness can be reduced, and the skin wrinkles can be reduced. The compound of the phenethyl resorcinol, the SPG beta-glucan, the acetylglucosamine and the Tibetan mushroom ferment can realize the synergistic effect and improve the problem of single action path of the phenethyl resorcinol.

title_en: Fluorohydrocortisone acetate impurity as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a fludrocortisone acetate impurity and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of drug synthesis. The application provides a synthesis method of a fluorine hydride acetate cortisone impurity, which takes a fluorine hydride acetate cortisone key intermediate 9 beta, 11 beta-epoxy-17 alpha-hydroxy pregna-4-ene-3, 20-dione-21-acetate as a raw material, and obtains an impurity II through oxidation, the impurity II and a fluorinating reagent undergo a ring opening reaction to obtain an impurity III, the purity of the obtained impurities II and III is up to more than 96.0 percent, and the fluorine hydride acetate cortisone impurity II and the impurity III obtained by the method can be used as standard substances for monitoring the impurity content of the fluorine hydride acetate cortisone and have higher application value.

title_en: Astragaloside IV extraction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an astragaloside IV extraction method in the field of natural medicines, which comprises the steps of crushing astragalus, and then carrying out reflux extraction under an alkaline solvent, wherein the alkaline environment comprises a pH range of 9-13, and the pH range of the alkaline condition is regulated by alkaline reagents KOH, naOH and Na  2 CO 3 .

title_en: Solid forms of { 5-cyclopropyl-2- [2- (3, 6-difluoro-pyridin-2-ylamino) -pyridin-4-yl ] -pyrido [3,4-D ] pyrimidin-4-yl } - ((S) -3, 3-dimethyl-piperidin-4-yl) -amine
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are solid forms (e.g., crystalline forms) of 4- (5-cyclopropyl-4-piperazin-1-yl-pyrido [3,4-d ] pyrimidin-2-yl) -9H-pyrido [2,3-b ] indole (compound 1) and compositions, pharmaceutical compositions, kits, methods, and uses thereof. The compounds disclosed herein are inhibitors of atypical protein kinase C (aPKC) and thus their solid forms are useful in the treatment and/or prevention of basal cell carcinoma.

title_en: Mutant library of lung cancer cell strain and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a lung cancer cell strain mutation library and a construction method thereof, belonging to the technical field of cancer cell strain mutation libraries, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting lung cancer cell strains for constructing a mutation library correspondingly, designing a corresponding mutation strategy according to the content of the research purpose, constructing a mutation carrier according to a CRISPR-Cas9 system, introducing the mutation carrier into the cell strains, screening successfully transfected cells, performing PCR (polymerase chain reaction) amplification on the screened cell DNA, sequencing and analyzing a PCR product, realizing verification of expression level and function change, and screening and constructing the mutation library through cell culture to finish construction. The method can be applied to the fields of protein engineering, drug screening, gene functions and the like, and the mutation library contains a large number of random mutations or site-directed mutations, so that functional changes under different mutation backgrounds can be well researched, the understanding of molecular mechanisms of lung cancer is enhanced, a foundation is provided for the later actual engineering application, and mutants with specific functions can be rapidly screened from a large number of mutants.

title_en: Blue light resistant and photodamage repairing sun-screening composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blue light and repair photo damage resistant sun-screening compositions, and discloses a blue light and repair photo damage resistant sun-screening composition, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the blue light and repair photo damage resistant sun-screening composition comprises microencapsulated modified spirulina maxima extract, porous sodium calcium borosilicate and polymethyl methacrylate, and the grain sizes of the polymethyl methacrylate are respectively 1-3 mu m and 300-500 nm. The blue light-resistant sun-screening repair composition has the advantages that the spirulina maxima extract is subjected to microencapsulation modification, the spirulina maxima extract has a slow release effect, the spirulina maxima extract is more easily captured by the pores of porous sodium calcium borosilicate after modification, and the two sizes of polymethyl methacrylate are inserted to form a network to prevent aggregation and sedimentation of each component through a steric hindrance effect, so that the spirulina maxima extract can be uniformly dispersed in the sun-screening composition.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity low-triphenyl phosphate tertiary butyl phenyl phosphate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-purity low-triphenyl phosphate tertiary butyl phenyl phosphate, which comprises the steps of carrying out esterification reaction on phosphorus oxychloride and p-tertiary butyl phenol in a Lewis catalyst through gradient heating, removing phosphorus oxychloride through reduced pressure distillation and molecular distillation after the reaction is finished, and adding phenol for end capping to obtain tertiary butyl phenyl phosphate. The invention adopts gradient heating to react phosphorus oxychloride more thoroughly under mild condition, improves the conversion rate of raw materials, can effectively prevent the loss of phosphorus oxychloride, ensures the safety and stability of the process, and removes phosphorus oxychloride by the common use of reduced pressure distillation and molecular distillation, thereby greatly reducing the residual quantity, further leading the content of triphenyl phosphate in tertiary butyl phosphate to be lower than 0.1 percent, greatly improving the purity of the product.

title_en: Multilayer container and method for producing recycled polyester
abstract_en: A multilayer container comprising a polyester layer and a polyamide layer, wherein the polyester layer contains a polyester resin (X), a phenolic antioxidant (A) and a phosphorus antioxidant (B), or contains a polyester resin (X), a phenolic antioxidant (A), a phosphorus antioxidant (B) and an aldehyde scavenger (C), the polyamide layer contains a polyamide resin (Y), and the total content of the phenolic antioxidant (A), the phosphorus antioxidant (B) and the aldehyde scavenger (C) in the polyester layer is 0.05-0.22 mass%, and the phosphorus antioxidant (B) is a compound having a pentaerythritol skeleton and an aromatic ring.

title_en: Compound for organic optoelectronic device, and display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound for an organic optoelectronic device represented by chemical formula 1, and an organic optoelectronic device and a display device each including the same. The detailed description of chemical formula 1 is as defined in the specification.

title_en: Salicylic acid-cyclodextrin-amino acid ternary inclusion compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salicylic acid-cyclodextrin-amino acid ternary inclusion compound and a preparation method thereof. A salicylic acid-cyclodextrin-amino acid ternary inclusion compound is formed by interaction of salicylic acid, amino acid and cyclodextrin derivatives through non-covalent bonds, wherein the cyclodextrin derivatives are crosslinked beta-cyclodextrin polymers, salicylic acid molecules are included in cavities of the crosslinked beta-cyclodextrin polymers, and meanwhile, exposed parts of the salicylic acid molecules after being included are interacted with hydroxyl groups outside the crosslinked beta-cyclodextrin polymers or through guanidine groups or carboxyl groups of amino acid side chains. According to the invention, the crosslinked beta-cyclodextrin polymer is used, arginine is introduced as a synergistic agent, the salicylic acid-crosslinked beta-cyclodextrin polymer-arginine ternary inclusion compound is constructed, and the inclusion efficiency is obviously improved and the salicylic acid water solubility is improved through charge neutralization and hydrogen bond network synergistic effect.

title_en: Application of ginsenoside Rg2 in preparation of medicine for treating multiple sclerosis
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of biological medicines, and provides application of ginsenoside Rg2 in preparation of a medicament for treating multiple sclerosis, wherein the ginsenoside Rg2 plays a role in treating MS by reducing the expression level of pro-inflammatory factors, promoting the differentiation of regulatory T cells, inhibiting infiltration of immune cells into a central nervous system, inhibiting activation of NLRP3 signal channels, reducing scorching of nerve cells, preventing damage of an immune system to myelin, reducing the ratio of myelin demyelination area to white matter area, up-regulating the expression of oligodendrocyte transcription factors, promoting proliferation and differentiation of oligodendrocyte precursor cells, promoting regeneration of myelin, and inhibiting activation of microglia. The invention solves the problems of limited curative effect, obvious side effect, only delayed progress, limited administration mode and the like of the traditional medicine.

title_en: Preparation and application performances of PIL-OH-Vinyl-COF composite material containing double hydrogen bond donors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PIL-COF composite material containing double hydrogen bond donors. The composite material firstly constructs a novel COF material (OH-Vinyl-COF) containing Vinyl and hydroxyl groups, and then copolymerizes amino ionic liquid with the novel COF material to prepare the PIL-COF material (PIL-OH-Vinyl-COF) containing hydroxyl and amino groups. The catalytic performance of the material on CO  2  and epichlorohydrin is examined, and the result shows that the PIL-OH-Vinyl-COF material containing double hydrogen bond donors has more excellent catalytic performance. As can be seen from the optimization of the reaction conditions, the yield of the cyclic carbonate is as high as 94.07% when the PIL-OH-Vinyl-COF material is used as a catalyst and the reaction temperature is 110℃, CO  2  and the pressure is 0.8 MPa. In addition, the PIL-OH-Vinyl-COF material has excellent recyclability and certain catalytic activity for cycloaddition reaction of other epoxides. According to the invention, the ionic liquid containing the hydrogen bond donor-NH  2  is grafted onto the COF material containing the hydrogen bond donor-OH in a vinyl copolymerization mode, so that the PIL-COF composite material containing the double hydrogen bond donors is prepared, the efficient catalytic conversion of CO  2  under the mild condition without a cocatalyst is realized, and the application prospect is remarkable.

title_en: Heterogeneous catalyst for low-temperature glucose isomerization reaction and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous catalyst for low-temperature glucose isomerization reaction, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of catalyst synthesis. The invention takes the straw as the catalyst carrier raw material, has rich sources and low cost, and realizes the recycling of agricultural wastes. The method synthesizes the straw-based biochar material by a mixing-calcining method, loads the metal oxide active ingredient in the straw-based biochar material, is simple and rapid, has high catalytic activity under the condition of low temperature (50-80 ℃) when used for catalyzing glucose isomerization to generate fructose, and has high selectivity to the product fructose. Meanwhile, the heterogeneous catalyst prepared by the method has good stability and can be recycled for multiple times.

title_en: Hair loss preventing composition based on Chinese herbal medicine plant extract and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Chinese herbal medicine plant extract-based alopecia preventing composition, which comprises a surfactant system, a Chinese herbal medicine plant extract composite group and a nutrition restoration group, wherein the surfactant system comprises an anionic surfactant and a zwitterionic surfactant, the Chinese herbal medicine plant extract composite group comprises a polygonum multiflorum extract, a biota orientalis extract, a kuh-seng extract, a ginger root extract, ginger root oil, an angelica root extract and a soapberry extract, and the nutrition restoration group comprises hydrolyzed wheat protein, sodium hyaluronate, plant amino acids, camellia seed oil, bio-phenol, pantothenic acid and ethylhexyl glycerol, and further comprises the balance of solvents. The invention has the advantages that the seven Chinese herbal medicine extracts are subjected to water-alcohol double extraction, the hair loss causes are covered on the whole surface, the multiple effects of promoting growth, inhibiting alopecia and controlling oil are realized, and the process of stepwise mixing and adding active substances at low temperature is adopted, so that the damage of active ingredients and nutrient substances of the Chinese herbal medicine at high temperature is effectively avoided.

title_en: Vacuum distillation device for producing p-menthane hydroperoxide
abstract_en: The invention provides a vacuum distillation device for producing p-menthane hydroperoxide, and belongs to the technical field of vacuum distillation towers. The novel distillation kettle comprises a distillation kettle, wherein the top end of the distillation kettle is fixedly connected with a kettle cover through a lock catch, the outer wall of the distillation kettle is fixedly connected with a feed pipe, the top end of the kettle cover is fixedly connected with a connecting cylinder, a first avoiding groove is symmetrically formed in the outer wall of the connecting cylinder, the outer wall of the kettle cover, which is close to the connecting cylinder, is fixedly connected with a manhole, a water inlet pipe, a vacuum pipe and a tower body, the inner wall, which is close to the top end, of the distillation kettle is provided with a limit groove, the bottom end of the distillation kettle is provided with a water draining pipe, the bottom end of the distillation kettle is provided with a heating layer, the outer wall of the middle part of the distillation kettle is fixedly connected with a supporting frame through a screw, a cleaning component is used for cleaning the inner wall of the distillation kettle, and the cleaning component is respectively connected with the distillation kettle and the connecting cylinder. According to the invention, the cleaning assembly is arranged, so that dirt attached to the inner wall of the distillation kettle due to bumping sputtering can be scraped, and the trouble of secondary cleaning is avoided.

title_en: Glutarimide derivative, synthesis method thereof and application of glutarimide derivative in reversing tumor drug resistance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and discloses a glutarimide derivative, a synthesis method thereof and application thereof in reversing tumor resistance, wherein the structural general formula of the glutarimide derivative is shown as formula I, formula II or formula III, and the glutarimide derivative specifically corresponds to 27 specific compounds (namely, compounds L1-L27). The glutarimide derivatives can be used for preparing colon cancer drug-resistant cell drug-resistant drugs, and particularly have the effect of reversing drug resistance aiming at the drug resistance problem of taxol on colon cancer drug-resistant cell lines SW620/AD 300. The invention also provides a novel synthesis method for preparing the glutarimide derivative, and the preparation method has the characteristics of easily obtained reaction starting materials, simple steps, wide substrate range, high reaction speed, mild reaction conditions and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of penomelin intermediate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of chemical synthesis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a pennogen intermediate. The method comprises the steps of taking 3-chloro-4- (pyridin-3-yl) -1,2, 5-thiadiazole as a intermediate, taking a novel intermediate 3- (2, 2-dihaloacetyl) aromatic ring compound as a starting material, firstly reacting with hydroxylamine hydrochloride in an alkaline solvent, reacting the obtained reaction product with disulfide in an organic solvent, and finally obtaining the 3-chloro-4- (pyridin-3-yl) -1,2, 5-thiadiazole as the intermediate of the minoxidil. The preparation method has the advantages of easily obtained raw materials, simple and convenient process, mild conditions, low equipment requirement, simplicity and easiness in control, high yield, high product purity and good industrial application prospect.

title_en: 2, 3,4, 9-Tetrahydro-1H-pyridine [3,4-b ] indole compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a2, 3,4, 9-tetrahydro-1H-pyridine [3,4-b ] indole compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzaldehyde and 1- (chloromethyl) -2, 6-difluorobenzene as initial raw materials, and prepares 1- (3- ((2, 6-difluorophenyl) oxo) -4-methoxyphenyl) -2,3,4, 9-tetrahydro-1H-pyridine [3,4-b ] indole through two-step reaction. The 1- (3- ((2, 6-difluorophenyl) oxo) -4-methoxyphenyl) -2,3,4, 9-tetrahydro-1H-pyridine [3,4-b ] indole provided by the invention has a remarkable inhibition effect on the osteoclast differentiation induced by RANKL, has no obvious cytotoxicity, can be used as a candidate medicament for inhibiting the osteoclast differentiation, and can be used for targeting osteoclasts to treat diseases related to bone mass loss.

title_en: Application of 2-methyl-4 (3H) -quinazolinone in preparation of anti-angiogenesis drugs
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of 2-methyl-4 (3H) -quinazolinone in preparation of anti-angiogenesis drugs. The application of the 2-methyl-4 (3H) -quinazolinone compound as an angiogenesis inhibitor in an anti-angiogenesis medicament is disclosed for the first time, and has remarkable inhibition effect on internode blood vessels and dorsal longitudinal anastomosis angiogenesis of a Tg (flk: mCherry) fluorescent transgenic zebra fish strain. Meanwhile, the strain has no obvious influence on the growth of zebra fish embryos and has extremely low toxicity. The compound can be extracted from streptomyces and obtained through an artificial synthesis process, has reliable and stable sources, and has good application prospects in the field of anti-angiogenesis medicines.

title_en: Washing and caring cleaning composition, preparation method and washing and caring sheet
abstract_en: The application discloses a washing and protecting cleaning composition, a preparation method and a washing and protecting sheet, and belongs to the field of cleaning products. The washing, protecting and cleaning composition is prepared from (by mass) amino acid surfactant 10-30 parts, anionic surfactant 1-20 parts, plant polysaccharide 15-45 parts, shape promoter 5-15 parts, nonionic surfactant 1-10 parts, amphoteric surfactant 0.5-5 parts, plant extract 0.5-5 parts, humectant 0.5-5 parts, chelating agent 0.1-5 parts, essence 0-5 parts, enzyme preparation 0-5 parts, and water 20-105 parts. The washing and protecting sheet has the characteristics of low temperature sensitivity, moderate dissolution speed and moderate cleaning force, can be directly contacted with skin, and can be applied to the fields of hair washing, bath, face cleaning, hand washing, underwear cleaning, mother and infant fabric cleaning, toy cleaning and the like.

title_en: Preparation method and application of oligomeric grape seed procyanidine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of oligomeric grape seed procyanidine, and belongs to the field of brewing byproduct processing. The preparation method comprises pretreating grape skin residue to obtain grape seed powder, degreasing with n-hexane, ultrasonic-extracting with ethanol in dark place to obtain crude procyanidine product, purifying with AB-8 macroporous resin to obtain pure product, and depolymerizing in a high-pressure reactor to obtain the final product. The average polymerization degree of the product is less than 5, the monomer content is more than or equal to 47%, the recovery rate is more than or equal to 88%, the bioavailability is high, and the activity is strong. The invention has the advantages of conventional equipment and green solvent, solves the problems of large pollution and difficult industrialization in the prior art, can be used for preparing health products, medicines or cosmetics, improves the added value of brewing byproducts, and has remarkable industrial value.

title_en: Multistage separation method for oil in byproduct acid of dimethyl dichlorosilane hydrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage separation method of oil in byproduct acid of dimethyl dichlorosilane hydrolysis, which is used for removing organic oil impurities in byproduct hydrochloric acid of dimethyl dichlorosilane hydrolysis, and comprises the following steps of S1, conducting static preseparation, namely conducting byproduct hydrochloric acid of dimethyl dichlorosilane hydrolysis to be treated into a static settling tank to remove most of oil drops which are easy to separate in byproduct hydrochloric acid, S2, conducting byproduct hydrochloric acid treated in the step S1 into a high shearing device, adding a polymer demulsifier to stir, promoting oil drops to aggregate, S3, conducting deep filtration on the demulsified acid liquid by adopting a ceramic membrane resistant to strong acid, temperature and pollution, and intercepting fine oil drops S4, namely conducting activated carbon adsorption columns to the filtered byproduct hydrochloric acid in the step S3, and adsorbing residual trace soluble organic matters and pigments. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of convenient operation and use, high efficiency, low cost and environmental protection.

title_en: Retinoyl oligopeptide derivatives with functions of resisting aging and removing wrinkles and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides retinoyl oligopeptide derivatives with functions of resisting aging and reducing wrinkles and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of application of polypeptide derivatives, the retinoic acid modified oligopeptide derivative is obtained by connecting retinoic acid with the amino terminal of oligopeptide at the carboxyl terminal, and has a structure shown in a formula I, wherein n is 1 or 2;L. The retinoic acid modified oligopeptide derivative provided by the invention has good solubility in both aqueous phase and oil phase, is beneficial to the product formulation design in the application process, has good antioxidant activity and skin cell injury protection activity, can reduce the expression of MMP2 and TNF alpha increased by skin fibroblast due to ROS, has excellent collagen-promoting expression activity, and has good antioxidant, skin injury repairing and wrinkle reducing effects when used in cosmetics or skin care products.

title_en: Co-based catalyst and application thereof in preparation of 5-amino-1-pentanol by selective hydrogenolysis of furfuryl amine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Co-based catalyst, which is prepared by dissolving citric acid, cobalt salt and one of cerium salt, calcium salt and strontium salt in deionized water, stirring for 10-20 min, adding polyethylene glycol, continuously stirring for 10-20 min, heating to form fluffy wet gel in an oil bath at 70-90 ℃ under stirring conditions, drying and grinding, calcining a dried product at 500-700 ℃ for 3-5 h, reducing for 3-5 h in a hydrogen atmosphere at 300-550 ℃, and cooling; the catalyst prepared by the method solves the problems that in the existing technical process of preparing 5-amino-1-amyl alcohol by hydrogenolysis of furfuryl amine, the preparation cost of the noble metal catalyst is expensive, the requirement on equipment operation is high due to the dependence of additional acid, and the recovery of the existing catalyst after reaction is complex, and is suitable for industrial production and market popularization and application.

title_en: Bicyclo [ 4.1.1 ] octane azafluorene derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bicyclo [ 4.1.1 ] octane azafluorene derivative, the structural formula of which is shown as formula I:  The preparation method comprises the steps of reacting 2- (2- (2-hydroxybenzylidene) -2, 3-dihydro-1H-indenyl-1-methylene) malononitrile derivatives for 0.5 to 6 hours under the conditions of an organic or inorganic base catalyst, DMF solvent and a temperature of 40 to 150 ℃, adding distilled water after the reaction is finished, extracting with ethyl acetate, drying with anhydrous sodium sulfate, filtering, concentrating and separating by column chromatography. The invention provides a simple, efficient and convenient preparation method of the bicyclo [ 4.1.1 ] octane azafluorene derivative, which has the advantages of high efficiency, convenience, low cost and the like and has good application prospect. The derivative of the invention can be applied as an organic catalyst, an organic photoelectric material, a fluorescent material and the like.

title_en: Enhanced transdermal absorption cosmetic patch containing high-efficiency active polydeoxyribonucleotide PDRN (DNA sodium) and low-temperature preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an enhanced transdermal absorption cosmetic patch containing high-efficiency active polydeoxyribonucleotide PDRN (DNA sodium) and a low-temperature preparation method thereof, wherein the cosmetic patch sequentially comprises an outer stripping back lining layer, a slow release core layer, a quick release core layer and a soluble hollow microneedle array layer from outside to inside, wherein the outer stripping back lining layer is a PET/aluminum foil/polyethylene composite film, and the mass ratio of the outer stripping back lining layer to the PET/aluminum foil/polyethylene composite film is (80-90) (0.5-2) (0.1-0.5). Realizes the efficient transdermal delivery, long-acting effect, high activity retention and excellent biocompatibility of the PDRN, and remarkably improves the transdermal efficiency and the use safety of the cosmetic patch.

title_en: Plant acne-removing composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly relates to a plant acne-removing composition, and a preparation method and application thereof. The acne-removing composition comprises, by weight, 0.1-4 parts of magnolia bark extract, 0.1-2 parts of licorice extract, 0.1-2 parts of tree peony root bark extract and 0.01-0.1 part of tetrandra root extract, and hydroxypropyl cyclodextrin. The invention combines the four extract components in a specific proportion, has obvious multi-target synergistic effect on acne removal efficacy, can comprehensively interfere the pathogenesis of acne from a plurality of links such as bacteriostasis, anti-inflammation, sebum secretion regulation, barrier repair and the like, realizes instant and long-acting acne removal effect, can obviously improve the solubility and bioavailability of plant extracts through the inclusion of hydroxypropyl cyclodextrin, enhances the stability of the composition, promotes transdermal absorption and reduces irritation when being suitable for cosmetics of various systems.

title_en: Lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 capable of generating various bioactive substances to promote skin barrier repair and its metaplasia
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 capable of generating various bioactive substances to promote skin barrier repair and a metagen thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms and medicines. The lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 provided by the invention is fermented to produce 3, 4-dihydroxyphenyl glycol, N-tetradecyl diethanol amine and 3-phenyl lactic acid. The metazoan of lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 has good skin barrier repair effect, the cell lysate and fermentation supernatant of lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 can improve the cell activity of keratinocytes after injury and the expression of FLG, IVL and LOR gene levels, and the cell lysate of lactobacillus acidophilus CCFM1460 can improve the expression of ZO-1, OCCLUDIN and CLDN gene levels. Therefore, the lactobacillus acidophilus has great application prospect in preparing external or oral medicines or cosmetics for repairing skin barriers.

title_en: Preparation method of benzocyclic ketone formate compound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemicals, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a benzocyclic ketone formate compound, which comprises the steps of taking monohalogenated benzocyclic ketone as a raw material, taking CO as a carbon source, replacing inert gas in a solvent in the presence of a palladium catalyst, a ligand and alkali, heating to 80-100 ℃, pressurizing to 0.1-3.0MPa, introducing CO for heat preservation reaction, and carrying out post-treatment steps such as filtering the catalyst, concentrating, stirring the solvent, filtering, pulping, drying and the like after the reaction is finished to obtain the benzocyclic ketone formate compound in one step. The invention adopts the recyclable palladium as the catalyst, has low cost and easy acquisition of raw materials, and adopts pulping operation for purification in post-treatment, thereby avoiding the complicated flow of column chromatography and reducing the use amount of solvent. The method has the advantages of low process cost, environmental protection, high efficiency and high purity of the obtained product, and provides a high-efficiency and feasible synthetic approach for the industrial production of the benzocyclic ketone formate compounds.

title_en: Compound, organic light-emitting diode and display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound, an organic light emitting diode and a display device including the same.

title_en: Preparation method of cosmetic-grade squalane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of cosmetic-grade squalane, and belongs to the technical field of chemical production and preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of 1) carrying out catalytic hydrogenation reaction on a squalene raw material to obtain a squalane-containing reactant, wherein the squalene content in the squalene raw material is 90-95wt%, 2) separating the squalane-containing reactant to obtain crude squalane, and 3) sequentially carrying out filtration, liquid-liquid extraction and molecular distillation on the crude squalane obtained in the step 2) to obtain the cosmetic-grade squalane. The method provided by the invention has the advantages of no addition of organic solvent, good environmental protection and good quality of the obtained squalane product.

title_en: Method for preparing pentanediol through catalytic conversion of furfural
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing pentanediol by hydrogenating furfural. The catalyst active components Co, fe, mgO are all from the corresponding non-noble metal salt solutions. The catalyst is prepared by adopting a urea precipitation method. According to the method, biomass hydrolysate furfural is used as a raw material, isopropanol is used as a solvent, H  2  is used as a hydrogen source, a closed reaction is carried out for 2-6 hours at 120-180 ℃ under the stirring rate of 500-rpm, and then the pentanediol is obtained after cooling to room temperature. Under the optimal condition, the conversion rate of furfural is 100%, the yield of pentanediol is 78%, the preparation method of the catalyst is simple and convenient, the price is low, the cycling stability is good, and the catalyst system is green and efficient and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Guanidine zinc/aluminum complex, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a guanidino zinc/aluminum complex, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of polymerization catalysts. The guanidyl zinc/aluminum complex prepared by the invention has a single catalytic active center, and can realize the precise control of the polymer structure and the molecular weight by regulating and controlling the ligand structure, the metal type and the polymerization condition. The catalyst has the remarkable advantages of low toxicity, low cost, simple synthesis, high catalytic activity, stable performance and the like, and is suitable for lactone ring-opening polymerization reaction. Under the protection of inert gas, the catalyst shows excellent activity when catalyzing the polymerization of lactone monomers such as lactide, caprolactone and the like, and the molecular weight of the obtained polycaprolactone reaches up to 219.2kg/mol, thereby providing an effective way for preparing high molecular weight polyester. In addition, the catalyst can still keep high activity and stability under simulated industrial conditions, and has wide industrial application prospect.

title_en: Tibetan sheep embryo type III collagen, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biomedical materials, in particular to Tibetan sheep embryo type III collagen and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out cation exchange chromatography purification and gel chromatography purification on an extracting solution containing type III collagen extracted from Tibetan sheep embryos, wherein in the step of cation exchange chromatography purification, an acetic acid buffer solution with the concentration of pH value of between 2.5 and 3.5 is loaded in a range of 0.4 and 0.6M, an eluent is sodium chloride solution, gradient elution is carried out in the concentration range of between 0 and 1mol/L, the eluent is phosphate buffer solution with the concentration of between 7.2 and 7.4 in the step of gel chromatography purification, and the preparation of type III collagen with a complete triple helix structure and higher bioactivity from Tibetan sheep embryo tissue has the characteristics of good biocompatibility, good thermal stability, cell proliferation promotion, adhesion, migration and the like, and has higher medical value.

title_en: Preparation method of free amino acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of free amino acid. Specifically discloses a preparation method of free amino acid, which comprises the following steps of neutralizing amino acid hydrochloride in methanol in the presence of an alkaline lithium reagent to prepare the free amino acid. The preparation method is simple and feasible, has high yield and low cost, and can be used for preparing the free amino acid from the amino acid hydrochloride in a small quantity or in an industrialized manner.

title_en: A-D-A type vapor-deposited electron acceptor material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in organic light detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to an A-D-A type vapor-depositable electron acceptor material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an organic light detector, which has the following structure:  Wherein D is a small block electron donor unit, a  1  and a  2  are small block electron acceptor units, and a  1  and a  2  may be the same or different. The invention adopts a modularized synthesis technology, and the detection wavelength is adjustable within the range of 300-850nm through the cooperative regulation and control of the small block donor unit and the small block receptor end group unit, so that the material has the characteristic of low sublimation temperature. OPD devices based on such A-D-A type vaporizable electron acceptor materials have detection rates in excess of 10  13  Jones, which are significantly superior to devices based on conventional fullerene acceptor materials. The material has low manufacturing cost and excellent device performance, and can practically promote the further development of intelligent consumer electronics technology and promote the industrial application of the organic photodetector in the fields of flexible imaging chips, medical diagnosis and industrial detection.

title_en: Preparation method of diethylenetriamine penta methylene phosphonic acid rare earth compound, copolymer composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a diethylenetriamine pentamethylene phosphonic acid rare earth compound, a copolymer composite material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the diethylenetriamine penta-methylene phosphonic acid rare earth compound comprises the steps of mixing an aqueous solution of diethylenetriamine penta-methylene phosphonic acid with an aqueous solution of rare earth salt to prepare a first suspension, wherein rare earth ions in the first suspension and [ DETPMP-H  15‑n ] n‑  ] ions dissociated from the aqueous solution of diethylenetriamine penta-methylene phosphonic acid undergo a coordination bonding reaction, n is a positive integer smaller than 15, reacting the first suspension with polytetrafluoroethylene in a high-pressure reaction kettle for 18-24 hours, enabling the rare earth ions and [ DETPMP-H  15‑n ] n‑  ] ions to be further coordinated and bonded to form an aqueous solution comprising the diethylenetriamine penta-methylene phosphonic acid rare earth compound, and extracting the diethylenetriamine penta-methylene phosphonic acid rare earth compound. The method is simple, efficient, safe and reliable.

title_en: Whitening and repairing composition, cosmetic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a whitening and repairing composition, a cosmetic and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of cosmetics, wherein the composition comprises the following components: the application realizes the synergistic effect of whitening, repairing, moisturizing and antioxidation in a single system, all components are natural or natural equivalent sources, the components are mild and natural and are not stimulated, excellent composition stability can be realized through component content compatibility, and the application is used in cosmetic raw materials of various dosage forms.

title_en: Method for preparing 3-hydroxypropyl nitrate through continuous flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for continuously preparing 3-hydroxypropyl nitrate by adopting a three-step method of monoacetylation, nitration and hydrolysis, wherein the prepared compound can be confirmed by a  1  H NMR characterization method. Meanwhile, the invention realizes continuous production by a serial two-step continuous flow reaction technology and a two-step online continuous separation technology, can accurately control key reaction parameters such as material mixing, heating, residence time and the like, thereby improving product quality and controlling impurities, allowing chemical reaction to react in a higher temperature range without temperature runaway, increasing reaction speed in reaction thermodynamics, improving production efficiency, avoiding heat accumulation of kettle reaction, ensuring safer reaction, ensuring that the post-treatment process of mobile chemistry is always online, ensuring cleaner reaction, facilitating realization of automation and online sample collection, facilitating change of reaction parameters and searching for optimal reaction conditions, and greatly improving process exploration and substrate screening efficiency.

title_en: Deuterated compound and organic light-emitting device comprising same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and particularly relates to a deuterated compound and an organic light-emitting device containing the deuterated compound. The compound provided by the invention adopts a combined structure of the deuterated aryl and the polycyclic aryl substituted by adamantane, so that the hole transmission performance of the compound is improved, and the stability and the charge transmission capability are improved, thereby effectively improving the stability and the service life of the device.

title_en: Continuous flow synthesis process of tromethamine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tromethamine synthesis, in particular to a continuous flow synthesis process of tromethamine. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding nitromethane and a solvent A into a container A to obtain a solution A, adding a depolymerizing agent, a solvent B and paraformaldehyde into a container B to obtain a solution B, respectively and simultaneously conveying the solution A and the solution B to a micro-channel reactor by a first feeding pump and a second feeding pump to perform condensation reaction to obtain a condensation reaction liquid, transferring the condensation reaction liquid to an acidification kettle, adding a quenching solution to perform reaction to obtain a quenching reaction liquid, diluting the quenching reaction liquid, adding a decoloring agent to filter the quenching reaction liquid to obtain a decoloring reaction liquid, adding the decoloring reaction liquid and the solvent C into a hydrogenation reaction system by a circulating pump to perform hydrogenation reaction under the action of hydrogen and a catalyst to obtain a hydrogenation reaction liquid, concentrating the hydrogenation reaction liquid to remove the solvent to obtain a crude product of tromethamine, and refining the crude product of tromethamine to obtain a finished product of tromethamine. The invention has the advantages of low safety risk, continuous smooth continuous flow pipeline and high product yield and purity.

title_en: Synthesis method of spiro thiazolone tetrahydropyridine compound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis and pharmaceutical chemistry, and discloses a synthesis method of a thiazolidine tetrahydropyridine compound, which is characterized in that a Lewis acid is used as a catalyst, thiazolone shown in a general formula I and 2-amino substituted benzaldehyde shown in a general formula II are used as substrates, the thiazolone and the 2-amino substituted benzaldehyde react for 12 to 16 hours in an organic solvent at a temperature of 40 to 80 ℃, and the thiazolidine tetrahydropyridine compound shown in the general formula III is synthesized through cyclization reaction carried out through a [1,5] hydride migration process. The invention provides a new synthetic path with high efficiency, simplicity and universality, the method adopts a single Lewis acid catalyst, and a spiro thiazolone tetrahydropyridine heterocyclic system with a complex structure is obtained through one-step [1,5] hydrogen migration/cyclization reaction under a mild condition, the method can obtain a target product with a yield of up to 95%, and a reliable and efficient synthetic tool is provided for quickly constructing a spiro molecular library with potential bioactivity.

title_en: Hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fine chemical engineering, and discloses hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch comprises the steps of mixing starch and water to prepare starch milk, adding sodium phytate and urea, cooling, adding sodium sulfate and sodium hydroxide, adding propylene oxide to react, and adding sodium trimetaphosphate to react to prepare the hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch. The hydroxypropyl crosslinked starch prepared by the preparation method has excellent shearing resistance, acid resistance and oxidation resistance.

title_en: Organic compound, preparation method and application thereof, composite material and dish-washing machine
abstract_en: The application relates to an organic compound, a preparation method and application thereof, a composite material and a dish-washing machine. The structure of the organic compound is shown as a formula (I):  Wherein m is an integer of 1 to 6, n is an integer of 1 to 3, a and b are respectively and independently selected from an integer of 0 to 4, C is an integer of 0 to 5, R  1 ～R 3  is respectively and independently selected from one of substituted or unsubstituted C  1 ～C 10  alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted C  1 ～C 10  alkoxy, substituted or unsubstituted C  1 ～C 10  alkylthio, halogen, trifluoromethyl, hydroxyl, mercapto, cyano and amino, and substituted substituent is respectively and independently selected from one of C  1 ～C 4  alkyl, amino, halogen, nitro, hydroxyl, mercapto, carboxyl and cyano. The compound can release heat energy in the process of moisture absorption, and no harmful substances are generated.

title_en: Fluorine-containing gemini surfactant and application thereof in nano waterproof locking agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine-containing gemini surfactant and application thereof in a nano waterproof locking agent, wherein the fluorine-containing gemini surfactant has a structure shown in a formula (I), and the waterproof locking agent comprises, by weight, 0.005-0.2 part of the fluorine-containing gemini surfactant, 0.01-0.2 part of modified nano molybdenum disulfide dispersion liquid, 0.01-0.2 part of nonionic hydrocarbon surfactant, 0.01-0.2 part of dispersing agent, 0.01-2 parts of stabilizing agent and 100 parts of water. The waterproof locking agent has excellent waterproof locking, anti-swelling and resistance-reducing effects, good compatibility with stratum water and good application prospect;

title_en: Radionuclide-labeled isoindole-piperidinedione derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radionuclide-labeled isoindole-piperidine dione derivative and application thereof, wherein the structural formula is as follows According to the invention, the E3 ubiquitin ligase key protein CRBN is taken as a new target point for nuclear medicine molecular image research, and dynamic expression of CRBN in a tumor microenvironment is accurately depicted by constructing a targeting molecular probe with an isoindole-piperidinedione parent nucleus structure, so that imaging guidance is provided for clinically and accurately screening benefited crowds and predicting the curative effect of targeted CRBN treatment, and imaging examples are provided for researching dynamic expression of other key proteins in a ubiquitination system.

title_en: 2- (3-Hydroxy-4- (N, N-bis (2-phosphonoethyl) amino) phenyl) benzotriazole and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The 2- (3-hydroxy-4- (N, N-bis (2-phosphonoethyl) amino) phenyl) benzotriazole provided by the invention is prepared from o-nitroaniline and 3-hydroxyanilino-N, N-bis (ethyl-2-phosphonic acid) serving as main raw materials through diazotization reaction, azo reaction and catalytic reduction. The 2- (3-hydroxy-4- (N, N-bis (2-phosphonoethyl) amino) phenyl) benzotriazole not only can strongly absorb ultraviolet rays in the 250-400 nm region, has good solubility in solvents such as water, methanol and ethanol, but also has a pH response function, multiple stimulus-response functions such as light, electricity, heat, fields and heavy metal ions, and is suitable for being used as a water-soluble ultraviolet absorber, a heavy metal ion chelating agent or an ultraviolet-resistant SAM hole transport material for a perovskite solar cell.

title_en: Use of compound 1 in treating or preventing pulmonary fibrosis or pulmonary diseases accompanied by fibrosis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of N- (3-chloro-5- (trifluoromethyl) phenyl) -3- ((6- (4-hydroxypiperidin-1-yl) imidazo [1,2-b ] pyridazin-3-yl) ethynyl) -2-methylbenzamide (also referred to as compound 1 in the present invention) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof for the treatment or prevention of pulmonary fibrosis or a pulmonary disease accompanied by fibrosis, etc.

title_en: Method for preparing vanillin by using eugenol
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing vanillin by using eugenol, which belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis and comprises the following steps of S1, preparing Ni-Mo/aluminosilicate/carbon-based materials, S2, preparing isoeugenol, S3, adding isoeugenol, ni-Mo/aluminosilicate/carbon-based materials, absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water into a closed pressure-resistant reaction kettle, mixing, dropwise adding sodium hydroxide solution, stirring, heating, introducing oxygen, stirring, reacting, cooling, separating, adjusting pH to be acidic, aging, suction filtering, washing, adding into ethanol aqueous solution, heating, stirring, decolorizing, filtering, recrystallizing, washing, and vacuum drying to obtain vanillin. The invention can effectively inhibit side reaction, and improve the yield and purity of the target product.

title_en: Preparation method of m-diphenol compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a m-diphenol compound, which takes the compound shown in a formula (1) as a raw material to react with peroxide in the presence of a catalytic system to prepare the m-diphenol compound shown in a formula (2), wherein the formula (1) is Wherein (2) is The catalyst system comprises a first catalyst, a second catalyst and a cocatalyst, wherein the first catalyst comprises metal salt and an acidamide ligand, the metal salt is palladium salt and/or copper salt, the second catalyst is one or more selected from molybdenum complex, molybdenum oxide, vanadium complex, tungsten oxide, chromium oxide and titanium alkoxide, and the cocatalyst is inorganic base. The preparation method has short reaction flow, can efficiently realize the dihydroxylation reaction of the aromatic compound by adopting a one-step method, and is simple and convenient to operate.

title_en: Whitening and freckle-removing composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whitening and freckle-removing composition and application thereof, and belongs to the field of cosmetics. The composition comprises the following raw materials of cynanchum atratum extract, morinda citrifolia extract, fucus vesiculosus extract, red clover extract and ginkgo mistletoe leaf extract, and the composition provided by the invention has obvious effects of whitening and fading spots through the synergistic combination of the raw materials.

title_en: Palladium-catalyzed Ding Fuxi hydration ring extension reaction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for palladium-catalyzed Ding Fuxi hydration ring extension reaction. Specifically, under the condition of palladium catalysis of tert-butyl nitrite oxidation, ding Fu alkene and water undergo a ring expansion reaction to obtain a cyclopentanone compound. The invention uses green rich water as raw material, and obtains a series of cyclopentanone compounds under milder conditions.

title_en: 2-Amino-4, 5-di (fluorine gem binitro) -1,2, 3-triazole and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 2-amino-4, 5-di (fluoro-gem-binitro) -1,2, 3-triazole and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method specifically comprises the following steps of sequentially adding 4, 5-di (fluoro-gem-binitro) -1,2, 3-triazole and a solvent into a reactor at room temperature, stirring until the mixture is completely dissolved, cooling by ice salt, dropwise adding an organic solvent solution of potassium hydroxide, keeping the reaction after the addition, and dropwise adding an organic solvent solution containing OO-2,4, 6-trimethyl benzenesulfonyl hydroxylamine into the reaction solution under the cooling of ice salt after the reaction is finished, reacting at room temperature, filtering, concentrating filtrate, washing by diethyl ether, and drying to obtain 2-amino-4, 5-di (fluoro-gem-binitro) -1,2, 3-triazole (light yellow solid). The calculated density of the 2-amino-4, 5-di (fluoride gem-binitro) -1,2, 3-triazole is larger, the density is 1.96 g/cm  3 , and the density of the 2-amino-4, 5-binitro-1, 2, 3-2H-triazole in the comparison document is 1.83 g/cm  3 , so that the improvement is 7.1%.

title_en: Luodian jade-based grading volume-production make-up and care one-color make-up raw material and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses Luodian jade-based grading volume-production make-up and care one-piece make-up raw material and application, which are division applications of a parent patent (2025119339307), and belong to the technical field of make-up. Aiming at the problems that the existing manufacturing process of the exclusive color cosmetic raw material of the tremolite jade has uneven raw material performance and cannot realize large-scale mass production, so that the content of color elements (Mn/Cr) is safe hard red, the fiber interweaving degree is a core grading basis, the natural structural pink fluorescent tremolite jade (such as powder-regulated sheep fat jade) is taken as an attribute reference standard, the process of pretreatment-color element preliminary screening-fiber interweaving degree core grading-fluorescence auxiliary judging-directional rudiment auxiliary screening-grading purification-layering compound engraving-grading finished product adaptation is adopted, the 'dumb but not astringent' skin feel is realized through grading surface modification, and four-stage products of star occupational grade, star daily grade, mass high-grade and mass basic grade are prepared, the sensitization rate is less than or equal to 0.1 percent, the suitability for all-scene application is achieved, and the mass production feasibility and the product performance stability are considered.

title_en: Piperidine compounds having Lp (a) lowering activity
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compounds of the formula:  And pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and compounds of the formula:   and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, as well as pharmaceutical compositions comprising these compounds, and their use in the treatment of cardiovascular disease and elevated plasma levels of Lp (a).

title_en: Separation and purification equipment for producing phthalonitrile
abstract_en: The invention relates to separation and purification equipment for producing phthalonitrile, which relates to the field of producing the phthalonitrile and comprises an extraction tower, a crystallization mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein an extraction assembly is arranged in the extraction tower and comprises a plurality of fixed discs and rotating discs which are arranged in an up-down overlapped mode, the crystallization mechanism is arranged at the discharge end of the extraction tower and is used for cooling and crystallizing a molten product, the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the discharge end of the crystallization mechanism and comprises an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder, a spiral conveying blade and a cleaning assembly, the cleaning assembly is arranged in the outer cylinder and comprises a booster pump and a liquid outlet hole.

title_en: Preparation method and application of hierarchical pore molecular sieve rich in Lewis acid-base pairs
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a multistage pore molecular sieve rich in Lewis acid-base pairs, which mainly solve the problems of low raw material ring opening efficiency, easiness in hydrogen transfer and aromatization side reactions and low carbon olefin selectivity in the process of cracking cycloalkanes by using the existing catalyst. The method constructs Lewis acid-base pairs in HIM-5 molecular sieve through the co-precipitation regulation and control of alkali (earth) metal (marked as M) and aluminum, and forms micro-mesoporous multi-stage pore structure, thereby obviously enhancing the activation capability of catalyst to naphthene C-C bond and the diffusion performance of product molecules, further inducing naphthene ring opening, inhibiting side reactions such as hydrogen transfer and aromatization, and directionally cracking to generate low-carbon olefin. The yield of the low-carbon olefin is improved to 48.8 percent from 24.2 percent of the HIM-5 system, and the efficient cracking of the naphthene is realized to prepare the low-carbon olefin.

title_en: Preparation method of soluble selenium glycine
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of soluble selenium glycine, which comprises the following steps of S1, enabling a selenium source and strong alkaline hydroxide to react in water to generate selenite, S2, enabling selenite, glycine and hydrogen peroxide to react in water for 12-16 hours to generate selenium glycine, wherein the reaction temperature is 5-15 ℃, and the reaction is carried out under a light-shielding condition. The selenium glycine product obtained by the preparation method has stable content and good water solubility, the preparation process is simple, the cost is low, the operation is simple and convenient, no chemical auxiliary agent is needed to be added, the operation steps are reduced, the byproduct selenized salt in the chemical reaction can react with hydrogen peroxide to regenerate selenite, no redundant waste exists in the whole reaction process, the production concept of green chemistry is met, the product solubility is good, the application field is wider, and the application effect is better.

title_en: Device and method for preparing methanol by combining new energy hydrogen production with biomass pressurization and oxygen-enriched combustion
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for preparing methanol by combining new energy hydrogen production with biomass pressurization and oxygen-enriched combustion, wherein the device comprises a new energy hydrogen production unit, a biomass pressurization and oxygen-enriched combustion unit, a methanol synthesis unit and a second high-temperature electrolysis unit, the new energy hydrogen production unit comprises a photovoltaic module, a wind power module and a first high-temperature electrolysis unit, the photovoltaic module and the wind power module are both connected with the first high-temperature electrolysis unit, the new energy hydrogen production unit and the biomass pressurization and oxygen-enriched combustion unit are both connected with the methanol synthesis unit, and the biomass pressurization and oxygen-enriched combustion unit is connected with the second high-temperature electrolysis unit. The invention utilizes the new energy hydrogen production unit to produce green hydrogen, and the biomass pressurized oxygen-enriched combustion unit produces green carbon dioxide to synthesize green methanol, thereby effectively improving the biomass utilization efficiency, reducing the green methanol preparation cost and being suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Fluorine-containing hydroxybenzoic acid compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthetic chemistry, and particularly relates to a fluorine-containing hydroxybenzoic acid compound and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a brand new synthetic route, which is characterized in that 4-fluoro-3-methoxybenzonitrile is used as an initial raw material, firstly, a specific demethylation reaction is carried out in benzene or toluene solvent under the catalysis of anhydrous aluminum trichloride to obtain an intermediate 4-fluoro-3-hydroxybenzonitrile, then, the intermediate is subjected to an acidic hydrolysis reaction in a mixed medium of concentrated sulfuric acid and water to convert cyano into carboxyl, a 3-hydroxy-4-fluorobenzoic acid crude product is obtained, and finally, the high-purity product is obtained through directional recrystallization of an ethanol-water mixed solvent. The invention fundamentally avoids the application of competitive bromination and Grignard reagent in the traditional route, and has the remarkable advantages of simple route, mild condition, safe operation, high selectivity, environmental protection and easy industrialized implementation.

title_en: PVP stabilized HKUST-1 material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PVP stabilized HKUST-1 material, a preparation method and an application thereof, comprising the following steps of adding trimesic acid into a mixed solution I of N, N-dimethylformamide and absolute ethyl alcohol, carrying out ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a solution A, dissolving copper nitrate trihydrate into deionized water, adding polyvinylpyrrolidone according to a proportion, stirring uniformly to obtain a solution B, adding the solution A into the solution B, stirring uniformly, placing the solution A into a polytetrafluoroethylene-lined reaction kettle for heating reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying. The preparation method of the PVP stabilized HKUST-1 material provided by the invention is simple and feasible, and the prepared material has excellent methane adsorption performance, high water stability and good recycling performance, and has wide application prospects in the methane adsorption fields of LNG-ANG coupling systems and the like.

title_en: Oil-in-water emulsions and use thereof in cosmetics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition in the form of an oil-in-water emulsion, in particular a cosmetic composition, in particular for making up and/or caring for keratin materials, comprising at least one fatty phase, at least one emulsifier comprising at least one phospholipid, and at least one hydrophilic gelling agent, characterized in that the composition comprises less than 20% by weight of silicone oil, relative to the total weight of the composition.

title_en: Bi-metal catalyst based on biphenyl urea skeleton, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalyst preparation, and particularly relates to a bimetallic catalyst based on a biphenyl urea skeleton, a preparation method and application thereof. The bimetallic catalyst has a structure shown in a formula 1, adopts a biphenyl urea skeleton, is connected with a group urea through carbon atoms, so that the structure of a bimetallic catalyst complex is more stable, compared with the structure of a traditional catalyst, the bimetallic catalyst has better space configuration, the bond length and the twisting degree of a bond angle can be better coordinated with metal through the introduction of urea, the occurrence of polymerization reaction and the insertion of a chain are better promoted through a pocket-shaped structure, meanwhile, the steric effect and the power supply capacity of a ligand are adjusted through the change of a substituent group, the polymerization performance of the metal catalyst is regulated, and the properties such as the molecular weight, the molecular weight distribution, the terminal double bond content, the branched chain insertion rate and the like of a polymer can be adjusted through the selection of the types and the use amounts of R  1 ～R 3  and metal salts in the bimetallic catalyst, so that the polymer is applied to different fields.

title_en: Alkaline phosphatase responsive near infrared fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alkaline phosphatase responsive near infrared fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fluorescent probe is a compound XDM-P, the molecular structure of the fluorescent probe comprises donor-pi-conjugated-acceptor type near infrared fluorophores constructed by taking xanthene and cyano isophorone as parent nuclei, and recognition groups connected through phosphate bonds, and the preparation method comprises the steps of Klebsiella condensation, phosphorylation and selective dealkylation. The probe is subjected to specific hydrolysis under the action of alkaline phosphatase (ALP), and the intramolecular charge transfer effect is recovered, so that near infrared fluorescence 'OFF-ON' response at 774 nm is realized. The probe has high sensitivity, good linear response and deep tissue penetration capability, and can be used for intracellular ALP detection and noninvasive, real-time and semi-quantitative in-vivo fluorescence imaging of liver cancer tumor-bearing mice and drug-induced liver injury mice models.

title_en: Transition metal doped zinc sulfide-cyclodextrin artificial synthetase ZnMS-CD and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transition metal doped zinc sulfide-cyclodextrin artificial synthetase ZnMS-CD, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the artificial synthase comprises the steps of suspending cyclodextrin in an ethanol solution containing Zn  2+  and transition metal M  2+ , stirring and reacting in an N  2  atmosphere to obtain cyclodextrin solid adsorbed with Zn  2+  and transition metal M  2+ , placing the cyclodextrin solid, thiourea and hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide in a hydrothermal kettle for hydrothermal reaction to obtain transition metal doped zinc sulfide-cyclodextrin artificial synthase ZnMS-CD, and applying the obtained artificial synthase ZnMS-CD serving as a catalyst in preparing ethanol by reducing CO  2  driven by a visible light.

title_en: Onium salt monomer, monomer type photoacid generator, polymer, chemically amplified resist composition, and pattern forming method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an onium salt monomer, a monomer type photoacid generator, a polymer, a chemically amplified resist composition and a pattern forming method. The present invention is an onium salt monomer represented by the following general formula (A). Thereby, a chemically amplified resist composition exhibiting excellent solvent solubility, high sensitivity, and high acid diffusion inhibition performance, thereby exhibiting excellent lithographic performance, can be achieved. At least one of W and X  L1  contains an aromatic ring. Z  +  is a sulfonium cation represented by the following general formula (Z-1) or an iodonium cation represented by the following general formula (Z-2). [ chemical 2]

title_en: High-purity deuterated dihydrodiphenyl preparation process of azepine compound
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicine synthesis, and particularly relates to a preparation process of a high-purity deuterated dihydrodibenzothiazepine compound. Adding the compound II into a solvent, adding alkali to react with the full deuterated ethanol, and performing post-treatment to obtain a compound III, adding the compound III and the compound IV into the solvent, adding a catalyst and an acid binding agent, crystallizing after the reaction is finished, filtering to obtain a compound I crude product, and performing refining treatment to obtain a compound I finished product, wherein the reaction equation is as follows:  . The method adopts the common full deuterated ethanol in the market to produce, controls the impurities within a reasonable range by adjusting the production process and conditions, greatly improves the product purity, ensures that the quality requirement of the preparation is met, has simple process, convenient operation, is suitable for industrial production and low cost, and provides a direction for the production of raw materials of deuterated dihydrodibenzothiazepine compounds.

title_en: Amorphous NADP solvate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an amorphous NADP solvate and a preparation method thereof. The amorphous NADP solvate disclosed in the invention is an NADP diethanol solvate or an NADP diisopropanol solvate. The invention adds the NADP water solution with specific concentration and pH into alcohol solvent with specific temperature to stir and crystallize, and then obtains amorphous NADP solvate after suction filtration and vacuum drying. The amorphous NADP solvate disclosed by the invention solves the problems of stability and fluidity, and simultaneously has the advantages of simple method operation, easy process control and suitability for industrialization.

title_en: 5.́ -Amino-3 ́ -nucleotide phosphoramide synthesis and application thereof in oligonucleotide
abstract_en: The invention discloses synthesis of 5' -amino-3 ́ -nucleotide phosphoramide and application thereof in oligonucleotide, wherein the phosphoramide modified oligonucleotide comprises a nucleotide structural unit shown in a formula I or a formula II: … … formula I;   .. the invention realizes that the prepared oligonucleotide contains a phosphoramide structural unit through the specific limitation of the structure of a nucleotide phosphoramide monomer, and compared with the traditional oligonucleotide molecule, the oligonucleotide molecule with the phosphoramide modified nucleotide structure has more excellent effects on pharmaceutical parameters such as enzyme degradation resistance, stability and the like, and in addition, the phosphoramide modification can improve the binding performance between the modified oligonucleotide molecule and environmental ions, thereby providing a novel chemical modification strategy for research, development and application of oligonucleotide drugs.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide and application thereof, which are characterized in that the amino acid sequence is w-r-r-w-k-r-f-k-r, all amino acids are D-type amino acids, and the antibacterial peptide provided by the invention has better antibacterial activity for various common gram-negative bacteria and positive bacteria, has higher safety through safety evaluation experiments, solves the problems of easy drug resistance, insufficient safety and the like of natural AMP, and has great clinical application prospect. The antibacterial peptide has good antibacterial activity for various pathogenic bacteria, can be synthesized by Fmoc solid-phase chemical method, has low synthesis difficulty and has good in-vivo antibacterial activity.

title_en: Jiang Duofen one-step extraction and conversion method based on eutectic solvent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of green efficient extraction of natural active substances, and particularly relates to a method for synchronously realizing efficient extraction of Jiang Duo phenol from ginger raw materials and conversion of the Jiang Duo phenol into high-active substances by a one-step process by adopting a natural edible eutectic solvent system of food-grade raw materials. The invention constructs a eutectic solvent system by selecting two edible natural components of monosaccharide or polyhydroxy compound and organic acid, so that the eutectic solvent system has the dual functions of efficiently dissolving ginger polyphenol substances contained in ginger and mildly catalyzing conversion of gingerol to shogaol, thereby realizing the integrated completion of extraction and conversion. The invention eliminates complex intermediate steps, adopts a one-step process, is beneficial to simplifying the process flow and effectively avoids the loss or degradation of products caused by the intermediate steps. The invention realizes synchronous extraction and conversion, promotes the whole process flow to be greatly shortened, correspondingly reduces the energy consumption and equipment requirements, and shows good economy.

title_en: Preparation method and application of lignin-based RuZn aerogel composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a lignin-based RuZn aerogel composite material. According to the invention, sodium lignin sulfonate is used as a carbon source, and a composite structure of Ru-Zn bimetallic nano particles with high dispersibility loaded in a carbon aerogel network is constructed in situ through the steps of polymerization initiation, sol-gel forming, nitrogen atmosphere calcination and the like. The material has the advantages of aerogel porous structure, high specific surface area and metal synergistic activity, and can efficiently catalyze the directional depolymerization of lignin in a self-hydrogen supply system without adding hydrogen. The lignin-based RuZn aerogel composite material provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, green and low-cost raw materials, high-controllable structure, suitability for efficient conversion of biomass such as lignin and the like, provides a new material selection and research direction for a biomass catalytic conversion technology, and has a wide industrialized application prospect.

title_en: Sphingomonas CCSM001 isolated from human skin and capable of improving skin health and metagen thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses sphingomonas CCSM001 separated from human skin and capable of improving skin health and a metagen thereof, belonging to the fields of microbial technology and medicine. The sphingomonas CCSM001 provided by the invention has good effect and application prospect of repairing barrier function in the aspect of external application, and is specifically characterized in that the activity of HaCaT cells after injury is improved in vitro, the gene level expression of FLG, IVL, AQP, ZO-1, occludin and CLDN is improved in the aspect of functional protein and structural protein after injury. The metagen prepared by the Sphingomonas can be used for preparing cosmetics or medicines for repairing skin barriers, and has a huge application prospect.

title_en: DNA repair damage protein source polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular biology, and relates to a polypeptide derived from DNA repair damage protein and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide comprises a sequence shown as SEQ ID No.1, SEQ ID No.2 or SEQ ID No. 3. The polypeptide has obvious photoprotection effect, can effectively prevent and repair skin injury caused by illumination, has high safety and stability, is suitable for various skin care products, and fills the blank of the prior art.

title_en: Ginsenoside CK-resveratrol supermolecule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supermolecule preparation, in particular to a ginsenoside CK-resveratrol supermolecule which comprises ginsenoside CK and resveratrol connected through hydrogen bonds, wherein in the XRD spectrum of the supermolecule, a characteristic peak exists at a position with a2 theta angle of 15.89 degrees; the preparation method comprises mixing ginsenoside CK and resveratrol powder, dissolving in DMSO or ethanol solvent to obtain solution A, dripping the solution A into purified water, magnetically stirring to obtain ginsenoside CK-resveratrol supermolecule crude product, and dialyzing the supermolecule crude product to obtain ginsenoside CK-resveratrol supermolecule aqueous solution. The transdermal absorption capacity of the ginsenoside CK-resveratrol supermolecule is obviously improved.

title_en: Methane production device and methane production method
abstract_en: The invention provides a methane production device and a methane production method. In the production of methane, the wet catalyst is restored. When methane is produced using a reactor that produces methane from carbon dioxide and hydrogen as raw materials, the raw materials are circulated through a raw materials flow path that extends across the 1 st and 2 nd regions of the reactor, and a catalyst that produces methane from the raw materials is housed in the 1 st and 2 nd regions of the reactor so as to be in contact with the circulated raw materials. Then, the refrigerant is circulated through the refrigerant flow paths extending across the 1 st and 2 nd regions in the reactor, and after methane is produced for a predetermined period of time in a state in which the raw material gas and the refrigerant are circulated through the 1 st and 2 nd regions in the reactor, the flow direction of the raw material gas and the refrigerant is changed, whereby the temperature of the 1 st and 2 nd regions at the side at which the temperature is low in the predetermined period of time is increased.

title_en: Water-in-oil emulsion composition
abstract_en: Disclosed is a water-in-oil emulsion composition which has little color unevenness when applied and is easy to wash off with soap after application (soap elution). The composition comprises (A) an acyclic silicone oil, (B) a pigment, (C) a metal soap, and (D) at least 1 dispersant selected from the group consisting of bis-butylpolydimethylsiloxane polyglycerol-3, isostearic acid, sorbitan sesquistearate, polyglycerol-6 polyricinoleate, glycerol isostearate, and cetyl PEG/PPG-10/1 polydimethylsiloxane, wherein the amount of the component (A) is at least 35% by mass based on the total amount of oil in the composition.

title_en: Soft and bright microbead essence cream composition and independent microcapsule wrapping method thereof
