abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft and bright microbead essence cream composition and an independent microcapsule wrapping method thereof, which relate to the technical field of daily chemistry, and the soft and bright microbead essence cream composition is formed by adopting an enzymatic crosslinking-ionic gel compound grading wall forming process, wherein the inner layer capsule wall is formed by crosslinking of transglutaminase-mediated fibroin and hydrolyzed collagen, the soft and bright microbead essence cream composition is high in flexibility and good in skin affinity, can provide buffer protection for a capsule core, the outer layer capsule wall is formed by sodium alginate, calcium chloride and chitosan through ionic gel and electrostatic adsorption, is compact and stable, effectively solves the problem that the microcapsules prepared by the existing single crosslinking wall forming process are easy to damage or difficult to release, and can realize the precise regulation and control of the particle size of the microcapsules by precisely controlling the dropping rate, stirring rate, reaction temperature, material proportion and other parameters, so that the particle size distribution of the microcapsules is uniform, the temperature shock damage to the capsule wall structure is avoided in a gradient curing step, and the stability of the microcapsules is further improved.

title_en: Coupling device for lactide production and production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coupling device for lactide production and a production method thereof, wherein the coupling device comprises a depolymerization reactor, a heat exchanger and a rectifying tower, the heat exchanger is coupled with the depolymerization reactor and the rectifying tower, the heat exchanger is coupled to the top of the depolymerization reactor and the bottom of the rectifying tower, the production method comprises the following steps of conveying lactic acid oligomer into the depolymerization reactor, depolymerizing the lactic acid oligomer into crude lactide steam containing lactic acid, lactic acid oligomer, water and lactide, cooling the crude lactide steam to the depolymerization reactor to continue depolymerization of the lactide after passing through the heat exchanger and the rectifying tower I coupled with the top of the depolymerization reactor, the residual components enter the rectifying tower II, lactic acid and water in light components are extracted from the top of the rectifying tower, and lactide is extracted from the bottom section of the rectifying tower. Compared with the prior art, the invention provides a high-yield, low-energy-consumption and high-purity lactide synthesis and purification method.

title_en: Method for preparing silanol by silane hydrolysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing silanol by silane hydrolysis, which comprises the steps of taking silane as a reaction raw material, taking water as an oxide, taking a metal compound as a catalyst, and reacting to obtain silanol, wherein the molecular formula of the silane is SiHR  1 R 2 R 3 ,R 1 、R 2 、R 3  which is independently selected from alkyl, phenyl, alkyl-substituted phenyl, halogen-substituted phenyl and alkoxy-substituted phenyl of C1-C4, and the metal compound is carbonate of sodium, potassium or cesium. The method for preparing silanol by hydrolyzing silane disclosed by the invention has the advantages that hydrogen is the only byproduct, the pollution to the environment is avoided, and the requirements of green catalysis are met. In addition, the metal compound catalyst has low cost, the target product silanol can be obtained by extracting the reaction mixture, the product yield is high, and the operation is simple and easy to realize. Furthermore, the method has mild reaction conditions and is easy for industrial application.

title_en: Feedback control method for crystallization process of cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic control, and discloses a feedback control method for a cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate crystallization process, which comprises the steps of obtaining the concentration of cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelic acid in a solvent, the solvent temperature, the stirring speed and the pH value in real time, and forming a state parameter set reflecting the real-time state of a cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate crystallization system; based on a state parameter set, the change rate of the supersaturation degree of the solute, the nucleation rate and the crystal growth rate are deduced by adopting an explicit dynamic relation to obtain a dynamic characteristic set of cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate, the particle size, the shape and the crystallization uniformity of crystals are collected, a corresponding crystal quality prediction function is constructed by combining the dynamic characteristic set of cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate to obtain a predicted crystal quality index, the actually detected crystal morphology index is compared with the predicted crystal quality index, the deviation is calculated, and the crystallization quality of cyclopropylamine (R) -mandelate is improved.

title_en: Ligand compound with quinoline structure, and radioactive or non-radioactive marker and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a class of ligand compounds of quinoline structure and their radioactive or non-radioactive labels and uses, in particular, the disclosure relates to ligand compounds of formula I, non-radioactive labels of formula II and radioactive labels of formula III, and their use in diagnosing or treating diseases in which cells proliferate abnormally.

title_en: Continuous solution crystallization method, special device and application of bezafibrate crystals with controllable granularity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine crystallization, and discloses a continuous elution crystallization method, a special device and application of bezafibrate crystals with controllable granularity. The method is characterized in that a continuous solution crystallization technology of synergy of an ultrasonic field and a tubular crystallizer is adopted, a solution of bezafibrate in a good solvent and an antisolvent are continuously introduced into the tubular crystallizer, mixed crystallization is carried out under the controllable flow rate ratio and ultrasonic energy input, and the generation and crystal growth dynamics of supersaturation degree are precisely regulated, so that the beza Bei Texiao particle size crystal with the average particle size D50 of 2-21 mu m and uniform particle size distribution (C.V. < 70%) is directly obtained. The invention realizes the accurate, continuous and amplified regulation and control of the crystal granularity, the solubility of the obtained product is obviously improved, and the invention is applicable to pharmaceutical preparations with higher requirements on bioavailability.

title_en: Composite oxide catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite oxide catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst comprises M/Cr  x O 3 -Al y O 3 , x+y=2, cr  x O 3 -Al y O 3  is a main catalyst, M represents a metal auxiliary agent component, the preparation method comprises the steps of ball-milling, mixing and roasting Cr  2 O 3  and Al  2 O 3  to obtain a main catalyst, and reacting trifluoromethane with chloroform by utilizing two reactors connected in series under the action of the catalyst to obtain a reaction product containing difluoromethane and dichloromethane. The catalyst can show very high reactivity in the exchange reaction process of HFC-23 and CHCl  3  fluorine and chlorine without fluorination pretreatment, and can still meet the requirement of industrial application on stability under the condition of no addition of carbon deposit eliminating gas in the exchange reaction process of HFC-23 and CHCl  3  fluorine and chlorine.

title_en: Photochromic spiropyran derivative containing adamantyl group and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adamantane group-containing photochromic spiropyran derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the adamantane group-containing photochromic spiropyran derivative takes 4-dimethylaminopyridine and dicyclohexylcarbodiimide as catalysts, 2- (3 ',3' -dimethyl-6-nitrospiro [ chromene-2, 2 '-indoline ] -1' -yl) ethanol and adamantane carboxylic acid compounds are subjected to esterification reaction, adamantane acid ester series large steric hindrance groups are introduced on spiropyran molecules, a relatively loose stacking mode of the compounds is caused, and pi-pi stacking of spiropyran molecules is effectively prevented, so that the photochromic reaction of spiropyran in a solid state is realized.

title_en: Three-carbon-reducing ganoderma lucidum triterpenic acid compound, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preventing and treating influenza
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and discloses a three-carbon-reducing ganoderma lucidum triterpenoid acid compound, a preparation method thereof and an application thereof in preventing and treating influenza. The three-carbon ganoderma lucidum triterpenic acid 3,7,11-Trioxo-25,26,27-trinorlanosta-8-en-24-oic acid is shown in formula I. Experiments prove that the compound has better influenza virus neuraminidase inhibitory activity, and the IC  50  of the compound is 5.17 mu M. Research shows that the compound has application prospect for further developing novel anti-influenza drugs.

title_en: Carbamate fumarate and crystal form, amorphous and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemistry, in particular to a novel fumarate of carbamate, and a crystal form, an amorphous form and a preparation method thereof. The carbamate fumarate and the crystal form and the amorphous form thereof have higher stability and solubility, lower hygroscopicity, better anti-platelet aggregation effect and higher drug effect, and are favorable for realizing clinical application of the medicament.

title_en: Method and system for directional removal of non-volatile acid radical in high-concentration urea wastewater and urea recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for directional removal of non-volatile acid radicals in high-concentration urea wastewater and urea recovery, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment and resource recovery. The method comprises the steps of introducing wastewater into a pretreatment unit, adding a synergistic treatment agent formed by compounding alkali metal salt, an organic complexing agent and nano catalytic particles, directionally precipitating non-volatile acid radicals to form compact precipitates, completing reinforced solid-liquid separation by an ultrasonic-assisted horizontal spiral discharge sedimentation centrifuge, deeply adsorbing residual acid radicals by using graphene quantum dot-temperature responsive magnetic nano particle composite modified anion exchange resin to realize nearly complete removal of acid radicals, concentrating urea by adopting a low-temperature evaporation-waste heat recovery coupling process, crystallizing by a sectional temperature-pressure gradient to separate out high-purity urea crystals, separating and recovering the adsorbed saturated resin by a magnetic field, regulating and controlling temperature, recycling after regeneration, and being suitable for recycling industrial high-concentration urea wastewater.

title_en: Preparation method of 2-methyl-1H- pa pyridine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical synthesis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of 2-methyl-1H- pa pyridine. The method comprises the steps of taking acetic acid and 1, 8-diaminonaphthalene with a molar ratio of 2.5-5.5:1 as reaction raw materials, taking water as a reaction medium, carrying out condensation reaction on one amino group of the 1, 8-diaminonaphthalene and carboxyl of the acetic acid at 100-185 ℃ to remove one water molecule to obtain a product intermediate containing an amide bond, carrying out intramolecular cyclization reaction on the other amino group on the intermediate and carbonyl in the amide bond to remove one water molecule to obtain a crude product, and purifying the crude product to obtain the 2-methyl-1H- pa pyridine. The purity of the 2-methyl-1H- pa pyridine prepared by the method can reach 98 percent.

title_en: Preparation method of androstane-3, 6, 17-trione (E, Z) -3- [ O- (2-aminoethyl) ] oxime hydrochloride
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of androstane-3, 6, 17-trione (E, Z) -3- [ O- (2-aminoethyl) ] oxime hydrochloride, which comprises the following steps of reacting benzophenone oxime with 2-chloroethylamine hydrochloride in dimethyl sulfoxide, carrying out acid-base regulation, toluene extraction, concentrated hydrochloric acid hydrolysis to remove protecting groups, crystallizing to obtain high-purity 2-aminoxyethylamine hydrochloride, carrying out oxidation reaction on androstane-3, 6, 17-triol serving as a raw material under the catalysis of sodium bromate and ruthenium (IV) oxide, quenching, carrying out liquid analysis, washing, replacing solvent crystallization by isopropanol, obtaining androstane-3, 6, 17-trione, carrying out low-temperature mixed reaction on 2-aminoxyethylamine hydrochloride solution and tetrahydrofuran solution of trione, carrying out salting out filtration, liquid analysis, saturated brine washing, drying by magnesium sulfate, carrying out solvent replacement, water dissolution, concentration purification, and cooling crystallization to obtain a high-purity target product. The invention obviously improves the yield of the target product by optimizing the reaction condition, and realizes the raw material availability, low cost and industrial production through the traditional chemical reaction path.

title_en: Photoelectric conversion element, photoelectric conversion device, and method for manufacturing photoelectric conversion element
abstract_en: The present invention solves the problem of providing a photoelectric conversion element having improved photoelectric conversion efficiency. In order to solve the problem, the present invention is a photoelectric conversion element (1) having a first electrode (7), a second electrode (3), and a photoelectric conversion layer (5) disposed between the first electrode (7) and the second electrode (3) and containing crystals having a perovskite structure, wherein a charge transport layer (6) is disposed between the photoelectric conversion layer (5) and the first electrode (7), and the charge transport layer (6) is formed of charge transporting particles and an insulating resin on the surface of the photoelectric conversion layer (5).

title_en: Synthesis method of tetrafluoro-substituted bromoalkyl alcohol
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis method of tetrafluoro-substituted bromoalkyl alcohol, which takes a compound shown in a formula II as a raw material, and reacts with 1, 2-dibromotetrafluoroethane under a free radical initiating system to obtain the tetrafluoro-substituted bromoalkyl alcohol shown in the formula I, wherein n in the formulas I and II represents a positive integer of 1-4, R in the formula II represents one of hydrogen, deuterium, C1-C6 alkyl or C1-C6 acyl, and the free radical initiating system contains a free radical initiating agent which consists of persulfate and formate. The synthesis method has the characteristics of low material cost, high overall yield, low wastewater pollution, high production safety and low metal residue.

title_en: Paint and coating formulations comprising 3-amino-3-methyl-2-butanol and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present technology relates generally to compositions comprising 3-amino-3-methyl-2-butanol. In particular, the present technology relates to compositions for paints and coatings comprising 3-amino-3-methyl-2-butanol.

title_en: Molybdenum-based polyoxometallate-heme composite nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a molybdenum-based polyoxometallate-heme composite nanomaterial and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the room temperature condition, mixing the two raw materials of molybdenum-based polyoxometallate and heme hemin in a manual grinding mode, and sequentially carrying out centrifugal separation, washing and vacuum drying on the obtained mixture to obtain the solid-phase molybdenum-based polyoxometallate-heme composite nanomaterial. The nanocomposite is synthesized by a simple manual grinding method, and can be prepared by the steps of room-temperature grinding, centrifugal separation, washing and vacuum drying under the condition of no need of complex equipment, high temperature and high pressure or toxic organic solvents. The prepared Hemin@PMo3835 has excellent peroxidase simulation activity, and based on the prepared Hemin@PMo  12 , the colorimetric detection of AA is realized. The colorimetric sensor constructed by the Hemin@PMo  12  nanocomposite can rapidly and accurately quantitatively detect the AA content in fresh fruits, and has wide application prospects in the fields of food nutrition analysis, quality control, field detection and the like.

title_en: Rectifying and purifying method of m-xylylenediamine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rectification purification method of m-xylylenediamine, which relates to the technical field of fine chemical purification and comprises the following steps of S1, feeding the crude m-xylylenediamine into a deamination and light removal tower for deamination and light removal treatment, S2, feeding the crude m-xylylenediamine subjected to deamination and light removal treatment into a impurity removal tower for removing heavy impurities through the rectification under reduced pressure, feeding the crude m-xylylenediamine into a finished product tower for purification through rectification under reduced pressure to obtain refined m-xylylenediamine, and S3, adding modified activated carbon into the refined m-xylylenediamine, stirring and decoloring at 70-80 ℃ and filtering to obtain a m-xylylenediamine product. The purity of the m-xylylenediamine product prepared by the preparation method is more than or equal to 99.8%, the moisture is less than or equal to 0.005% and the chromaticity is less than or equal to 98%, the mass fraction of the byproduct 3-cyanobenzylamine is less than or equal to 0.005%, the total mass fraction of secondary ammonia and tertiary ammonia is less than or equal to 0.05%, and the purification yield is more than or equal to 98%. The m-xylylenediamine product completely meets the use requirements of high-end scenes such as nylon MXD6, high-end epoxy curing agent and the like, and can be directly applied without additional treatment.

title_en: Crystal of 2, 2-bis- (4, 4-bis- (3, 5-dimethyl-4-hydroxyphenyl) cyclohexyl) propane and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing an isolated product of 2, 2-bis- (4, 4-bis- (3, 5-dimethyl-4-hydroxyphenyl) cyclohexyl) propane, which is suitable for industrial production. As a solution, a crystal of 2, 2-bis- (4, 4-bis- (3, 5-dimethyl-4-hydroxyphenyl) cyclohexyl) propane is provided.

title_en: Antibacterial compounds and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: Compounds useful as antibacterial agents, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds, and methods of use thereof. The compounds are believed to target bacterial RNA polymerase and NusG.

title_en: Process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tertiary butanol through gas-liquid phase mixing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of isobutene, and particularly relates to a process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method. According to the process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method, tert-butyl alcohol is added into a fixed bed reactor, the temperature and the pressure are controlled under the action of a sulfonic acid type cation exchange resin catalyst, so that the tert-butyl alcohol is subjected to dehydration reaction to generate crude isobutene and water, and the crude isobutene is subjected to flash evaporation in a flash tank and rectification in a rectification tower to prepare isobutene. The process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method provided by the invention has the advantages of higher reaction conversion rate, high reaction selectivity and low energy consumption.

title_en: Six-membered aromatic ring substituted benzoyl or thiobenzoyl trifluoroethylamine compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a six-membered aromatic ring substituted benzoyl or thiobenzoyl trifluoroethylamine compound or agriculturally acceptable salt thereof, the structure of which is shown as a general formula I:  the definition of each substituent group in the formula is shown in the specification. The compound of the general formula I or the agriculturally acceptable salt thereof has excellent insecticidal and acaricidal activity and can be used for controlling insect pests and acarid pests. The invention also discloses an intermediate compound for preparing the compound.

title_en: Pyridazinone compounds and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are pyridazinone compounds and uses thereof, particularly substituted pyridazinone compounds, conjugates and pharmaceutical compositions for the treatment of neuromuscular diseases such as Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD). The disclosed compounds are particularly useful for the treatment of DMD and for modulating the inflammation inhibitor IL-1, IL-6 or TNF-alpha.

title_en: Heterojunction catalyst for photocatalytic oxidation of biomass as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterojunction catalyst for biomass photocatalytic oxidation, which is characterized in that BiVO  4  and Zn  0.5 Cd 0.5  S solid solution are compounded according to the mass fraction of 35% -45%, a heterojunction is constructed, and in the prepared heterojunction catalyst, zn  0.5 Cd 0.5  S is in tight contact with a BiVO  4  interface to form a clear heterojunction interface, so that the recombination of photo-generated electron-hole pairs is effectively inhibited, the interface charge transfer resistance is reduced, and the carrier separation and transmission efficiency is improved. The heterojunction catalyst has obviously better photocatalytic oxidation performance to HMF under the irradiation of visible light than single component, the HMF conversion rate can reach 99%, and the selectivity to target product DFF can reach 34% -60%. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, mild in condition and easy in raw material acquisition, can realize the optimization of the catalyst performance by regulating and controlling the mass fraction of BiVO  4 , and has a wide application prospect in the field of high-valued conversion of biomass platform compounds.

title_en: Method for biomass hydrothermal treatment, biomass coal water slurry and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a biomass hydrothermal treatment method, biomass coal water slurry and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of mixing biomass powder, a slurry forming auxiliary agent and water, and carrying out hydrothermal treatment at 180-280 ℃ in an inert gas atmosphere to obtain the biomass coal water slurry; wherein the pulping aid comprises lignosulfonate and polycarboxylic acid dispersing agent. The biomass component reconstruction is synchronously completed through the synergistic effect of the hydrothermal treatment and the compounded pulping auxiliary agent, the fluidity and the stability of the slurry are enhanced, the carbon-liquid separation process is avoided, and the process flow is simplified; the prepared biomass coal water slurry is easy to store and meets the continuous feeding requirement of a coal water slurry gasifier.

title_en: MER zeolite catalyst, preparation method and application thereof, and method for superposition of 2-methyl-2-butene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of zeolite synthesis, and discloses an MER zeolite catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, and a method for superposing 2-methyl-2-butene. The average grain diameter of the MER zeolite catalyst is 0.1-0.3 mu m, the average aspect ratio is 10-50, the crystallinity is 90-100%, and the content mole ratio of silicon element to aluminum element in the MER zeolite catalyst is 1-2.45:1. The MER zeolite catalyst provided by the invention has good crystallinity, does not contain CHA, ANA, LTL and other zeolite mixed crystals, and has higher 2-methyl-2-butene conversion rate and dimer selectivity when being applied to 2-methyl-2-butene superposition reaction.

title_en: Super-hydrophobic structured catalytic filler and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical process reinforcement and functional materials, and discloses a super-hydrophobic structured catalytic filler, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low utilization rate of catalytic active sites and low mass transfer efficiency caused by water coverage of by-products on the surface of the traditional catalyst. The filler integrates the functions of catalysis, hydrophobic drainage and separation, is used as a tower internal part in the reactive distillation process, has good performance stability and excellent in-situ rejection capability of product water, can obviously improve the utilization efficiency of a catalyst and the product yield, prolongs the service life of the structured catalytic filler, and is suitable for the synthesis process of maleic acid ester and other ester chemical products with water.

title_en: Light-grain moisturizing composition for lipstick and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of daily chemical products, in particular to a light-grain moisturizing composition for lipstick and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition comprises the following raw materials of collagen derivatives, skin feel regulator, polypeptide active substances, natural vegetable oil and plant polysaccharide; the collagen derivative comprises succinyl-terminated collagen, the skin feel modifier comprises polydimethylsiloxane/vinyl polydimethylsiloxane cross-linked polymer, the polypeptide active comprises palmitoyl tripeptide-5, the natural vegetable oil comprises glass chicory seed oil and bitter oil seed oil, and the vegetable polysaccharide comprises tuberose polysaccharide. The composition finished product prepared by the formula of the application is used in lipstick, can solve the defect of lack of strong moistening of most lipsticks, effectively makes lips of users softer and more moist, and can also realize multi-target-point effect on improving lips so as to achieve the effect of lightening the lips.

title_en: Ethylene acenaphthene bisymmetric alpha-diimine intermediate, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ethylene acenaphthene bisasymmetric alpha-diimine intermediate, a catalyst prepared from the same, a preparation method of the intermediate and an application of the catalyst. 2,4, 6-tri-tert-butyl aniline is used as a raw material to react at 120 ℃ in the presence of a catalyst to obtain the ethylene acenaphthene double-asymmetric alpha-diimine chemical intermediate with the structure shown as the formula I. Compared with the prior art, the invention adopts the 2,4, 6-tri-tert-butyl aniline which is easy to obtain in the market, low in price and loose in storage condition to replace the 2, 4-di-tert-butyl aniline which is high in cost and severe in storage as the reaction raw material, thereby effectively reducing the raw material purchasing threshold and the comprehensive production cost and simplifying the storage condition. The method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low cost, simple and convenient operation and higher yield, and is suitable for industrialized amplified production.

title_en: Novel heterocyclic compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel heterocyclic compound having FGFR2 protein activity. In particular, the present invention relates to a compound of formula (III), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, polymorph or isomer thereof, and its use in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of a disease associated with FGFR.

title_en: Lysate of mixed bacteria fermentation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to a lysate of mixed fermentation and a preparation method thereof. The lysate is prepared by adopting two aerobic probiotics for mixed fermentation, namely lactobacillus plantarum and aspergillus oryzae are adopted as fermentation strains to carry out mixed fermentation treatment on rice slurry, and membrane filtration and column chromatography systems are adopted to carry out filtration and enrichment, so that a lysate filtrate rich in kojic acid is prepared, and the kojic acid content is more than 200g/L, and is obviously improved compared with the conventional process. The obtained lysate has no bad smell and clear color, so that the beneficial functions of kojic acid can be exerted in cosmetics only by a low addition amount, and the addition of taste masking and color correction auxiliary materials is reduced, thereby being capable of being used for preparing cosmetics with the effects of skin repair, whitening and the like.

title_en: Construction method and kit for detecting new mutation of dominant monogenic disease before embryo implantation
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of gene detection, and particularly relates to a construction method and a kit of a gene library for detecting new mutation of dominant single-gene disease before embryo implantation. The application provides a construction method of a gene library for detecting dominant single-gene disease new mutation before embryo implantation, which comprises the steps of amplifying genes and relevant copy number variation fragments of the dominant single-gene disease new mutation before embryo implantation in specific screened genome DNA, according to the application, the NGS sequencing technology is accurately applied to screening of dominant single-gene diseases in a trace cell sample, the technical bottleneck of high-throughput sequencing under the condition of extremely low initial DNA quantity is broken through, screening of new mutation before embryo implantation is realized, and a brand-new key technical path is provided for blocking genetic birth defects at an earlier stage.

title_en: Solubilizing stable trollius chinensis liquid preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solubilizing stable trollius chinensis liquid preparation and a preparation method thereof, wherein an anionic surfactant is used as a micelle carrier, and a stable micelle structure formed in a water phase is used for dissolving and uniformly dispersing insoluble active ingredients in trollius chinensis extract in the water phase, so that the dissolving performance and system stability of the trollius chinensis extract are obviously improved, and the antibacterial effect are improved. The preparation has an inhibition rate of more than 90% on escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus and candida albicans after being contacted for 30 seconds, has good stability after being placed for 24 months at room temperature, and has an inhibition rate of more than 80% on the three test bacteria. The concentration of the trollius chinensis extract required for achieving the equivalent or even better antibacterial effect is far lower than 1/16 of that of trollius chinensis liquid preparation which is dissolved by using dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) organic solvent.

title_en: Preparation method of Rayleigh Mi Buti Ni and intermediate thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine synthesis, and particularly relates to a preparation method of Rayleigh Mi Buti Ni and an intermediate thereof. The invention takes a compound I and a compound II as raw materials, and carries out coupling reaction in the presence of a catalyst and alkali to generate an intermediate III, the protecting group is removed through acid treatment to obtain an intermediate IV, the intermediate IV is subjected to acylation reaction under the action of an acylating reagent and alkali to generate an intermediate V, the intermediate V is reduced by adopting a reduced iron powder and ammonium chloride system to obtain an intermediate VI, and the obtained intermediate VI is subjected to direct amidation or condensation amidation to obtain the Rayleigh Mi Buti Ni. The method avoids noble metal catalysts and microwave equipment, has mild and controllable synthesis process conditions, and has the characteristics of high product purity and yield, low production cost, safe operation and suitability for industrial production.

title_en: Method for preparing N- [ (6-chloropyridin-3-yl) methyl ] -2, 2-difluoroethylamine by adopting 2, 2-difluoroethylamine hydrochloride to release base in controlled manner
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of synthesis technology of fluorine-containing fine chemicals, and relates to a method for preparing N- [ (6-chloropyridin-3-yl) methyl ] -2, 2-difluoroethylamine by adopting 2, 2-difluoroethylamine hydrochloride to release alkali in a controlled manner. According to the method, 2-chloro-5-chloromethylpyridine (CCMP) and 2, 2-difluoroethylamine hydrochloride are used as raw materials, a sodium hydroxide aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 28% -32% is continuously added into acetonitrile at the temperature of 35-45 ℃ for 2.0-3.0 h, the total molar quantity of sodium hydroxide relative to the CCMP is 1.95-2.20 equivalent, the continuous adding rate of the sodium hydroxide aqueous solution is controlled, the peak concentration of free 2, 2-difluoroethylamine in a reaction system is controlled to be not higher than 35 mmol/L, the temperature is kept for 0.5-2.0 h after the continuous alkali addition is finished, and a reaction solution containing a target product is obtained through filtration, centrifugation, split phase or a combination of the reaction solution. The method controls CCMP hydrolysis through a combined window of hydrochloride pre-batching, controlled alkali release and peak control while inhibiting secondary alkylation side reaction, can obtain higher target intermediate analysis yield under lower side reaction level, and the obtained reaction liquid can be directly used for subsequent reaction after desalting and/or phase separation.

title_en: Separation preparation method of chemical components of peony petals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural product separation, in particular to a separation preparation method of peony petal components. According to the invention, a method of preparing liquid chromatography by combining high-speed countercurrent chromatography is adopted to separate compounds with higher content of peony petals, 5 compounds of paeoniflorin oxide, kaempferol-3, 7-O-beta-D-diglucoside, picrorhiza glycoside, kaempferol-7-O-beta-D-glucoside and apigenin-7-O-beta-D-glucoside are obtained through separation, and the separation method is simple and the product purity is high.

title_en: Mechanochemical process for deuterated organic compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for deuterating an organic compound by mechanochemical treatment.

title_en: Method for extracting and purifying milbemycins
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extraction and purification method of milbemycins, belonging to the field of preparation of biological medicines. The method comprises the following steps of 1) filtering fermentation liquor plate frames to obtain wet fungus residues, flash drying to obtain dry fungus residues, 2) leaching the dry fungus residues by an organic solvent to obtain a leaching solution, concentrating and extracting to obtain an extraction solution, and 3) washing the extraction solution with alkali, and concentrating and crystallizing the extraction solution to obtain a qualified finished product. The extraction and purification method has the yield reaching more than 85 percent, the milbemycins purity reaching more than 96 percent, various impurities being effectively controlled, and the high-purity milbemycins can be produced in large scale.

title_en: Green light iridium complex, luminescent material and electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green iridium complex, a luminescent material and an electroluminescent device, and belongs to the technical field of organic luminescent materials. In the green iridium complex shown in the formula I, N is selected from an integer of 1-3, q and p are independently selected from 0, 1 or 2;V  1  and V  2  are independently selected from one or more of carbon-carbon single bonds, -C-, -N-, -O-, -S-; 、  Independently selected from one or more of substituted or unsubstituted C6-C30 aryl and C3-C30 heteroaryl, and B  1 、B 2  is independently selected from H, C-C72 aryl, C6-C30 arylamine, substituted or unsubstituted C1-C10 linear or branched alkyl and substituted or unsubstituted C12-C30 nitrogen-containing heteroaryl. The solubility of the green iridium complex is obviously improved, the film prepared from the green iridium complex serving as a luminescent material is excellent in stability, and the luminous efficiency and the service life of an electroluminescent device prepared from the film are obviously improved.  Formula I

title_en: Eurotium cristatum capable of producing flavone and phenolic acid at high yield and degrading oxalic acid at high efficiency and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Eurotium cristatum XYSF2560 strain which can produce flavone and phenolic acid with high efficiency and degrade oxalic acid, and application thereof in relieving physical fatigue. The Eurotium cristatum XYSF2560 strain is named as Aspergillus cristatus (Aspergillus cristatus) XYSF2560, and is preserved in China center for type culture Collection with a preservation date of 2025, 11 and 12 days and a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M20252526. The invention has excellent metabolism advantage in fermentation engineering, gives excellent antioxidation and cell stress relieving performance to the product, remarkably reduces oxalic acid content in fermentation liquor by oxalic acid metabolism way, solves the health risk caused by overhigh oxalic acid in traditional fermented tea or extract, has stable strain property and low fermentation process cost, is suitable for the fields of developing high-end food, medicines, pet nutrition, cosmetics and the like, and has good market application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, and a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of suspending a filamentous fungus mycelium in a buffer solution for homogenization treatment, and then mixing and incubating the mycelium with glycoside hydrolase, protease and ribonuclease to obtain an enzymolysis mixed solution; centrifuging the enzymolysis mixed solution after high-temperature and high-pressure treatment, collecting supernatant, passing the supernatant through an ultrafiltration membrane, removing sediment from filtrate by adopting a sodium acetate ethanol precipitation method, collecting supernatant, carrying out ethanol precipitation treatment on the supernatant, and collecting sediment to obtain the filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product. The preparation process realizes the large-scale preparation of the high-yield high-purity small-molecular-weight PDRN with narrow molecular weight distribution range from the filamentous fungi for the first time, and the filamentous fungi-derived PDRN product has extremely high skin permeability and bioavailability, can more effectively penetrate through the skin stratum corneum, and plays a plurality of biological effects.

title_en: Microchannel reactor applied to formaldehyde preparation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microchannel reactor applied to formaldehyde preparation, which comprises a substrate, a microchannel, a corner area, longitudinal fixing columns, an input port and an output port, wherein the substrate is provided with a snake-shaped microchannel, a cover plate is bonded on the outer side of the substrate and covers the outer side of the microchannel to form a flow channel, two rows of longitudinal fixing columns which are symmetrically distributed are arranged in the flow channel, the upper bottom surfaces of the longitudinal fixing columns are opposite to the side wall of the microchannel, a gap is reserved between the upper bottom surfaces of the longitudinal fixing columns and the side wall of the microchannel, and the lower bottom surfaces of the longitudinal fixing columns are parallel to the side wall of the microchannel. According to the invention, the micro-channel and the two rows of longitudinal fixed columns are processed on the substrate, and after reactants and catalysts are injected into the micro-channel, the reactants and the catalyst solution can generate a gas-liquid interface at the gap of the longitudinal fixed columns, so that the catalyst is prevented from being taken away completely on the premise of maintaining a higher reaction rate, and the loss of the catalyst is reduced.

title_en: Ethyl viologen double-resazurin salt and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides ethyl viologen double-resazurin salt, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion battery anode materials. The preparation method of the ethyl viologen double-resazurin salt comprises the steps of reacting 4,4' -bipyridine with bromoethane to obtain a compound EV-Br  2 , and reacting the compound EV-Br  2  with resazurin sodium to obtain the ethyl viologen double-resazurin salt shown in a formula I. The ethyl viologen double-resazurin salt small-molecule organic compound successfully shows the advantage of high activity, overcomes the defect of high solubility of the small-molecule organic compound in electrolyte, and shows excellent capacity and ultra-long cycle life.

title_en: Process and apparatus for removing carbon monoxide from an ethylene stream
abstract_en: A process and apparatus for separating carbon monoxide from ethylene. Ethylene can be produced from bio-based alcohols. The separation utilizes a fractionation column that produces an ethylene stream lean in carbon monoxide and an overhead stream comprising carbon monoxide and ethylene. Ethylene from the overhead stream may be recovered in an absorption zone having an absorption liquid. An oxygenate fractionation zone can be utilized to remove oxygenates from a carbon monoxide depleted ethylene stream.

title_en: Hair dye based on dihydroflavonoid plant extract and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and discloses a hair dye based on a dihydroflavonoid plant extract and a preparation method thereof. The hair dye is prepared from the following raw materials, by mass, 0.34-0.76% of a colorant, 22.90-30.93% of a pH conditioning agent and 68.49-76.63% of a cosolvent, wherein the colorant is a dihydroflavonoid plant extract, the pH conditioning agent is hydrochloric acid, and the cosolvent is a Tris-HCl buffer solution. The hair dye has the advantages of simple manufacturing process, convenient use, uniform color after dyeing and high color fastness and washing fastness.

title_en: Asymmetric aromatic diselenide compounds and application thereof in preparing pesticides
abstract_en: The invention relates to an asymmetric aromatic diselenide compound and application thereof in preparing pesticides, in particular to application thereof in preparing anti-plant virus agents and bactericides. The asymmetric aromatic diselenide compound has good control effect on TMV at the concentration of 500mg/L, the control effect on the in-vivo passivation can reach 71.6%, the control effect on the in-vivo protection can reach 58.3%, and the control effect on the in-vivo treatment can reach 60.1%. The asymmetric aromatic diselenide compound has good control effect on early blight of tomato, scab of wheat, rice blast, phytophthora capsici of capsicum, sclerotinia rot of colza, gray mold of cucumber, sheath blight of rice, fusarium wilt of cucumber, brown spot of peanut, ring spot of apple, sheath blight of wheat, small spot of corn, anthracnose of watermelon and bakanae disease of rice at the concentration of 50mg/L, and the bactericidal activity of the compound can reach 92.3%.

title_en: Terpenoid in alpinia zerumbet, and extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terpenoid in alpinia zerumbet, and an extraction method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of medicine extraction. The novel terpenoid extracted from alpinia zerumbet has good anti-inflammatory effect, and shows good nitric oxide generation inhibition activity in lipopolysaccharide-induced BV2 cells or RAW 264.7 cells, wherein the IC  50  value of the novel terpenoid is 17.89-61.38 mu M for the lipopolysaccharide-induced BV2 cells, and the IC  50  value of the novel terpenoid is 11.69-71.91 mu M for the lipopolysaccharide-induced RAW 264.7 cells. The inhibitory activity of some compounds was superior to indomethacin and minocycline. In addition, some compounds can significantly reduce expression of iNOS and COX-2 proteins in BV2 cells induced by LPS, inhibit expression of iNOS, IL-1β, TNF- α and the like at mRNA level, and significantly inhibit nuclear translocation of NF- κB.

title_en: Efficient PDRN preparation method based on multi-stage buffer pyrolysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) high-efficiency preparation method based on a multi-stage buffer cracking system, and relates to the technical field of PDRN extraction. The multistage buffer lysis system comprises an S1 basic buffer solution, an S2 alkaline enhancement solution and an S3 acidic precipitation solution, achieves mild release and selective degradation of DNA in a cell nucleus by accurately controlling pH gradient (8.0-12.5-4.5) and chemical component synergism, wherein A260/A280 is 1.8-1.9, protein and RNA impurity residues are less than or equal to 0.5%, and simultaneously A260/A230 is more than or equal to 2.0, no organic solvent residue is basically generated, and the quality and purity of the obtained PDRN are remarkably improved. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and convenient to operate, low in cost, environment-friendly, wide in raw material adaptability, suitable for industrial mass production, and the prepared PDRN has in-vitro repairing and in-vitro tightening effects through tests.

title_en: Strong whitening essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powerful whitening essence and a preparation method thereof, wherein the powerful whitening essence comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 4% -6% of tranexamic acid, 0.2% -0.5% of 4-butylresorcinol, 1.5% -2.5% of nano glabridin, 2.5% -3.5% of DMI permeation promoter and the balance of deionized water; according to the strong whitening essence, the components are wrapped in the nano liposome through the selection of the components and the specific preparation process, so that the effects of strong whitening, quick brightening, mild and low-stimulation, long-acting and stable effects and uniform component dispersion are realized.

title_en: Transposase-based 5mCpG high-throughput detection method TnM-seq, transposase TnM and single-cell multicellular multi-histology application
abstract_en: The invention provides a TnM mCpG high-throughput detection method TnM-seq based on TnM transposase, which adopts transposase TnM comprising MBD structural domain to carry out 5mCpG in-situ detection and comprises the following steps of carrying out pretreatment on cells to be detected, incubating with transposase TnM, recovering and purifying DNA in a target sample after transposition, carrying out PCR (polymerase chain reaction) database construction on the purified DNA, and carrying out high-throughput sequencing on a database construction product. The invention combines the novel transposase TnM with the novel design and synthesis and high-throughput sequencing to realize the detection of 5mCpG in the sample conveniently and rapidly with low cost and high sensitivity. Based on the transposase TnM, a multi-group technology HAM-seq for simultaneously detecting histone modification H3K9me3, chromatin accessibility and DNA methylation modification 5mCpG in the same sample is further developed, and the multi-group technology HAM-seq is combined with a commercial single-cell microfluidic platform to obtain the epigenomic and gene expression four-group technology EpiX-seq which can be used for single-cell analysis in complex tissues.

title_en: Sesquiterpene derivative in elecampane and application thereof in preparing medicament for treating hepatitis B
abstract_en: The invention provides sesquiterpene derivatives in elecampane and application thereof in preparing medicaments for treating hepatitis B, which belong to the technical field of medicaments, and the invention comprises 7 sesquiterpene compounds, and in-vitro cell experiments prove that the compounds have certain anti-HBV activity, can form a medicinal composition with a medicinal carrier or excipient, and are applied to preparing medicaments for treating hepatitis B or anti-HBV.

title_en: Novel aloe-emodin draws jar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel aloe-emodin extraction tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein a tank cover is arranged on the tank body; a stirring shaft is arranged in the tank body, the top end of the stirring shaft penetrates through the top of the tank cover and is in transmission connection with the output end of a driving motor, a plurality of frame-shaped stirring rods are symmetrically arranged in the middle of the stirring shaft, a rubber scraping plate and a scraping brush are respectively arranged in the plurality of frame-shaped stirring rods, and the rubber scraping plate and the scraping brush are adjacently arranged at intervals; the widths of the rubber scraper and the scraping brush are consistent with the width of the frame-shaped stirring rod; the inner sides of the frame-shaped stirring rods are equidistantly provided with obliquely arranged slurry cutters, and a plurality of sieve pores are arranged on the slurry cutters; a plurality of vertically arranged wing knives are arranged on the surface of the paddle knife at equal intervals; the utility model has the advantages that: the stirring efficiency is improved, the adhesion of the raw powder is reduced, and the service life of the tank body is prolonged.

title_en: Trimethyl benzene phosphate synthesis reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trimethyl benzene phosphate synthesis reactor, which comprises a bod, the inside fixedly connected with jar body of organism, first feed inlet has been seted up in the upper end left side of organism, the organism is located the first inlet pipe of fixed position of the first feed inlet outside, the second feed inlet has been seted up on the upper end right side of organism. The utility model discloses in, the cross puddler of setting, the arc puddler of bottom, and straight shape puddler can be to the abundant stirring of raw materials, the internal raw materials of jar mix, the pole of scraping of setting can prevent to heat the back raw materials and glue on the inner wall of the jar body, the spiral winding can carry out even omnidirectional heating to the jar body at the heating pipe in the internal side of organism jar, the HCI of production enters into the water tank by the outlet duct via the connecting pipe in, let in the aquatic in the water tank, HCI is soluble in water and generates hydrochloric acid, and the water in the water tank is discharged by the outlet pipe again via the inlet tube entering.

title_en: Reaction device for synthesizing dimethylamine and triphosgene
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the chemical industry field relates to a reaction unit that is used for dimethylamine and triphosgene to synthesize, including the casing that has the reaction chamber, be equipped with feed inlet and discharge gate on the casing, still include two at least inlet pipes, the entrance point of this inlet pipe is linked together with the outside of casing, and the exit end of this inlet pipe is arranged in the reaction chamber and is connected with atomizer. The utility model discloses an atomizer carries out the atomizing feeding, makes the dichloroethane solution of triphosgene and the aqueous solution of dimethylamine react after atomizing respectively, prevents to take place violent reaction and instantaneous a large amount of exothermic in two kinds of solutions direct addition reation kettle.

title_en: Oxytetracycline hydrochloride granulation machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oxytetracycline hydrochloride production facility technical field just discloses an oxytetracycline hydrochloride granulation machine, including fixed section of thick bamboo, the left side fixed mounting of fixed section of thick bamboo has first driving motor, first driving motor's output shaft fixed mounting has the dead lever, the outside fixed mounting of dead lever has screw thread blade, the square mouth has been seted up at the top of fixed section of thick bamboo, the equal fixed mounting of the left and right sides wall of square mouth has the slide rail, the inside sliding connection of slide rail has a sliding block, two corresponding fixed mounting has a feeding section of thick bamboo between the relative one side of sliding block, the top fixed mounting of fixed section of thick bamboo has two pneumatic cylinders, the piston rod top fixed mounting of pneumatic cylinder has the connecting block, the back fixed mounting of feeding section of thick bamboo has second driving. This oxytetracycline hydrochloride granulation machine, the feeding of being convenient for, prevent blockking up, can scrape the raw materials that apply on the section of thick bamboo wall and get, the even feeding still to production efficiency has been improved.

title_en: A remove iron rust device that is arranged in chlorobenzaldehyde production process chlorine pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a remove iron rust device for chlorine pipeline in chlorobenzaldehyde production process, including storing up chlorine steel bottle, carbon steel pipeline, chlorine buffer tank, chlorine input pipeline, chlorine filter and chlorine output pipeline, store up the one end intercommunication of chlorine steel bottle and carbon steel pipeline, the other end of carbon steel pipeline and the top fixed connection and the intercommunication of chlorine buffer tank, the top of chlorine buffer tank still with the entrance connection of chlorine input pipeline, chlorine input pipeline exit end, chlorine filter and chlorine output pipeline communicate in proper order, the chlorine filter includes the filter core of its inside installation, the chlorine filter is through filtering core and chlorine output pipeline intercommunication, the one end of filtering the core is pegged graft inside the chlorine filter. The utility model discloses can effectively filter the iron rust of adulteration in the chlorine, can avoid the chlorine pipeline to adopt the plastic tubing to carry again and arouse the safety problem.

title_en: Reation kettle for m-fluoro benzotrifluoride
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reation kettle for fluoride trifluorotoluene, including the cauldron body itself, motor and feed inlet are installed to cauldron body upper end, inside is provided with the (mixing) shaft, the lower extreme is provided with the discharge gate, the (mixing) shaft runs through and is connected with the motor in cauldron body upper end, and the junction is provided with the sealing member, the (mixing) shaft upper end is provided with the master gear, the lower extreme is provided with first stirring rake, the bottom is provided with the screw, both sides still are provided with second stirring rake and third stirring rake, be provided with first driven gear on the second stirring rake, be provided with the second on the third stirring rake and follow the gear, first driven gear and second are followed the gear and are linked to each other with the master gear. The utility model relates to a reation kettle for fluoride benzotrifluoride, through setting up first stirring rake and with first stirring rake stirring opposite direction's second stirring rake and third stirring rake, can improve the stirring degree of consistency, through setting up the screw, can promote row's material speed, and then reach the purpose that improves product quality, promotes the working efficiency of enterprise.

title_en: Overhaul safe butadiene washing tower device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a overhaul safe butadiene scrubbing tower device, a butadiene scrubbing tower carries out ferrous sulfate aqueous solution self circulation and boils the device of tower promptly, makes and to carry out self endless tower device that washes, utilizes 0.5% ferrous sulfate solution to boil it, ensures the butadiene polymeric substance active inactivation that the inside exists to guarantee to overhaul safe going on. Mainly adds two metal explosion-proof hoses and a movable centrifugal pump. And a metal hose is additionally arranged at the first pouring position and is connected with an inlet of the movable centrifugal pump, and a metal explosion-proof hose is additionally arranged at the fifth pouring position and is connected with an outlet of the movable centrifugal pump. The problem of when the butadiene water scrubber can not carry out the self circulation of 0.5% ferrous sulfate solution and wash the tower, lead to the active material in the tower not inactive, butadiene polymerization active material reacts with the air in the moment of opening the tower manhole, takes place the danger of burning explosion is solved and avoided.

title_en: Flash separation tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of xylitol preparation equipment, and particularly discloses a flash separation tank, which is provided with a feeding pipe and a discharging pipe, wherein the feeding pipe is connected with a xylitol hydrogenation reaction kettle, the inlet of the feeding pipe is positioned on one side of a tangent line of the separation tank, and the port of the feeding pipe is provided with a pressure reducing valve; the steam pipe separator is characterized in that a heating pipe is arranged in the separation tank, one end of the heating pipe is connected with a steam pipe, a collecting tank for collecting steam condensate is arranged at the inlet of the steam pipe, the other end of the heating pipe is connected with the inner space of the separation tank, and a drain pipe connected with the external environment is arranged at the top of the separation tank. The utility model discloses a set up the steam line heating in the knockout drum, in steam entering knockout drum in the pipeline, for continuously providing pressure-fired and heat in the knockout drum, still make external air can not get into the knockout drum, stop knockout drum internal environment and external contact, be favorable to maintaining the clean and the safety that the hydrogen used of material.

title_en: Octanol purification recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an octanol purification recovery unit, including the retort, the lower extreme surface of retort is provided with the base, the upper end surface of base is provided with the distiller, the outer wall of retort is provided with inlet pipe and connecting pipe, the upper end surface of retort is provided with intake pipe and support, the one end surface of support is provided with the water tank, the other end surface of support is provided with annular butt joint spare, the inside of water tank is provided with the water pump and places the cylinder, it is provided with the hourglass net to place cylindrical outer wall, the upper end surface of water tank is provided with the water inlet. An octanol purification recovery unit, wash comparatively portably, the follow-up use of the device of being convenient for can collect the filtration to the poison gas that produces when purifying, avoids the poison gas to get into human inside, improves its practicality, this equipment is simple structure not only, convenient operation brings better use prospect moreover.

title_en: Draw reation kettle of leucine in follow hair
abstract_en: A reaction kettle for extracting leucine from hair comprises a reaction tank, wherein a heating jacket is sleeved outside the reaction tank, and a heat-insulating layer is sleeved outside the heating jacket; a stirring shaft is vertically inserted into the top of the reaction tank, a separation cage is fixedly installed on the lower portion of the reaction tank, the bottom end of the stirring shaft extends into the separation cage, a stirring paddle is fixedly installed on the stirring shaft in the separation cage, and a power mechanism for driving the stirring shaft to rotate is also fixedly installed on the reaction tank; a transverse partition plate is fixedly arranged in the reaction tank below the partition cage, a heating gap is reserved between the partition plate and the bottom wall of the reaction tank, and a plurality of heaters are fixedly arranged in the heating gap; the bottom of the reaction tank is also communicated with an output pipeline, and an output control valve is also arranged on the output pipeline. This reation kettle reasonable in design, simple and practical can effectively avoid the hair winding to pile up on the stirring rake, improves the hydrolysis reaction efficiency of hair, and then has guaranteed leucine's extraction efficiency.

title_en: Draw decomposition device for leucine from feather
abstract_en: A decomposition device for extracting leucine from feather comprises a decomposition tank, a heating jacket is sleeved outside the decomposition tank, and a heat-insulating layer is sleeved outside the heating jacket; a stirring shaft is vertically inserted into the top of the decomposition tank, the bottom end of the stirring shaft extends to the lower part of the decomposition tank, and a power mechanism for driving the stirring shaft to rotate is fixedly arranged on the decomposition tank; a stirring paddle is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the stirring shaft, a filter screen which is transversely arranged is fixedly arranged in the decomposition tank below the stirring paddle, a filter gap is reserved between the filter screen and the bottom wall of the decomposition tank, and a plurality of heating pipes which are communicated with the heating jacket are fixedly arranged in the filter gap; the bottom of the decomposition tank is also communicated with an output pipeline, and an output control valve is also arranged on the output pipeline. The device can in time export the decomposition liquid that has obtained outwards, is convenient for carry out secondary decomposition to the feather that does not decompose to be convenient for control the decomposition process of feather, effectively improved leucine's extraction efficiency.

title_en: Combined non-woven fabric mask
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of facial masks, and discloses a combined non-woven facial mask which comprises an upper mask body and a lower mask body, wherein the top of the upper mask body is attached to the forehead of a face, the bottom of the upper mask body is attached to cheeks on two sides of a nasal wing in the face, and an eye opening and a nasal wing opening are formed in the upper mask body; the top of the lower membrane body is attached to the upper lip of the face and cheeks on two sides of the upper lip, the bottom of the lower membrane body is attached to the lower jaw of the face, and a mouth opening is formed in the lower membrane body. This application has the face that makes the facial mask adapt to equidimension not to the effect of the essence in the facial mask is fully absorbed to the user.

title_en: Continuous water washing kettle for producing 2, 4-difluoronitrobenzene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 2, 4-difluoronitrobenzene production is with continuous washing cauldron, including motor, washing cauldron body, control panel and base, the both sides at base top are provided with the frame, and the central point at frame top puts the activity and is provided with the fixed disk, and fixed mounting has washing cauldron body between the fixed disk, and the inside side of washing cauldron body is provided with the heater strip, and the outside front portion of washing cauldron body is fixed with control panel, and the central point at washing cauldron body top puts fixed mounting has the motor, and the bottom of motor is provided with the rotation axis, and the outside of rotation axis is provided with first puddler. The utility model discloses be provided with first puddler in the outside of rotation axis, be provided with the second puddler through the axle activity on the first puddler, be provided with the third puddler through the axle on the second puddler, when the rotation axis is rotatory, can extend or shorten along with the rotatory speed of rotation axis through second puddler and third puddler to reach high stirring effect.

title_en: Reduced pressure distillation device for producing 2, 4-difluoroaniline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 2, 4-difluoroaniline production is with decompression distillation plant, which comprises a base, the swivel mount, the heating furnace, first condensation duct and liquid storage pot, the central point on base top puts the department and installs the swivel mount, the inside of swivel mount is equipped with the distillation column, and the safety cover is installed on the top of distillation column, braced frame is installed on the base top of distillation column one side, the surface suit of distillation column has the annular cover, and the one end of annular cover is connected with braced frame, install the liquid storage pot on braced frame's the outer wall, and the central point of liquid storage pot bottom puts the department and installs the liquid outlet, the outlet duct is installed on the top of safety cover, and the top of outlet duct is equipped with the switching cover, the transmission pipe is installed on the top of switching cover. The utility model discloses not only realized the even heating of vacuum distillation device, made things convenient for the dismantlement in vacuum distillation device later stage to maintain, improved vacuum distillation device's work efficiency moreover.

title_en: Be applied to batching cauldron of p hydroxybenzaldehyde production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a batching kettle applied to production of p-hydroxybenzaldehyde, belongs to the technical field of chemical equipment, and particularly relates to the technical field of batching kettles. Can drive stirring vane level and vertical direction stirring, can not only stir batching cauldron body bottom dead angle but also can stir vertical and horizontal direction of material, stir thoroughly, the stirring is effectual.

title_en: A high-efficient type washing equipment for zinc stearate production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of chemical equipment, and particularly relates to efficient washing equipment for zinc stearate production. The device achieves the purpose of effectively washing reactants in the production process of zinc stearate by arranging the upright column, the washing machine shell, the water inlet pipe, the water outlet pipe, the hinged material box unit, the hinged cover plate unit, the air cylinder unit and the limiting column on the bottom plate. The utility model has the following advantages: firstly, the jacking type discharging structure of the washing equipment is simple and effective, and the material taking and placing operation is convenient; secondly, the washing mode of washing and soaking is reasonable and efficient, the structure of the whole washing equipment is relatively simple, and the washing cleanliness is enough; thirdly, the concrete structure of the washing equipment is flexible, ingenious, stable and compact, the automation degree is high, and the cover body of the equipment is automatically opened and closed.

title_en: Three-in-one hydrogel plaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-in-one hydrogel patch, and relates to the technical field of hydrogel patches. The hydrogel patch comprises a forehead patch, a periocular patch and a facia patch, wherein the forehead patch is a long arc patch, and a convex nasion fitting part is arranged in the middle of the lower end of the forehead patch; the eye circumference paste is in an arc wing shape and comprises a left eye circumference paste and a right eye circumference paste which are symmetrical; the order grain paste is E-shaped with an arc edge and comprises a left order grain paste and a right order grain paste which are symmetrical. The hydrogel patch is convenient to use and good in fitting degree, and three parts of the face, which are easy to wrinkle, are repaired in a targeted manner, so that the skin of the face is smooth and compact; the transparent mesh cloth is selected as the support layer of the hydrogel patch, so that the hydrogel patch has better air permeability, and the transdermal absorption rate and the use comfort of hydrogel functional components are improved.

title_en: Compound crystal reaction synthesis production device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction synthesis production device of compound crystals, which comprises a reaction system, a filter pressing system, a washing system and a drying system which are connected by pipelines; the reaction system comprises a raw material storage tank and a reaction kettle which are connected with each other, and the filter pressing system comprises a filter pressing centrifugal pump and a filter press; the washing system comprises a pure water washing pipeline, a circulating washing water storage tank and a sewage discharge pipeline, and is connected with the centrifugal pump and used for transporting washing water; the drying system comprises an air compressor, an air storage tank, a compressed air filter, a cold dryer and a compressed air heater which are sequentially connected, and the compressed air heater is connected with the filter press. The utility model discloses a washing water is collected to circulation washing water storage tank, and the washing water in the washing water storage tank that will circulate is inputed the pressure filter again and is circulated the washing, and after the raffinate saturation in the washing water, carry out new round circulation washing again, can effectively practice thrift the washing water.

title_en: Ammonia absorption equipment in process of preparing diphenylamine from aniline
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an absorption equipment technical field specifically is an aniline system diphenylamine in-process ammonia gas absorption equipment, including at least two-stage ammonia absorption system, ammonia absorption system includes the absorption liquid storage tank that connects gradually into circulation loop through the pipeline, the circulating pump, the falling liquid film absorber, and the heat exchanger, the tower bottom of falling liquid film absorber is equipped with the ammonia import, the ammonia import and the ammonia tube coupling of first order falling liquid film absorber, the top of the tower gas phase export of preceding one-level falling liquid film absorber and the ammonia import of back one-level falling liquid film absorber pass through the pipe connection, the top of the tower gas phase export of last one-level falling liquid film absorber has the tail gas pipeline through the pipe connection. The utility model discloses utilize the absorption liquid to have higher solubility to the ammonia and realize ammonia recovery and tail gas clean-up, reduce ammonia content in the gas gradually through at least two-stage ammonia absorption system, economic environmental protection, the operation power consumption is low, easy operation.

title_en: Oxidation reation kettle is used in synthetic research of 2-isobutyl thiazole
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oxidation reaction cauldron is used in 2-isobutyl thiazole's synthetic research relates to reation kettle equipment technical field, including reation kettle, the reation kettle top is fixed with the proportioning device, proportioning device inner wall bottom mounting has the slope slide, the proportioning device top slides there is the feeding section of thick bamboo that extends to the inner wall, feeding section of thick bamboo bottom mounting has the hose. The utility model discloses a proportioning device, the slope slide, a feeding section of thick bamboo, the hose, the setting of a quantitative section of thick bamboo and tapered slider, the problem of current reation kettle be not convenient for carry out the ration to the powder and add is solved, a slip feeding section of thick bamboo, make the pointer correspond with the inside measurement unit of carving on the reading table, pour the powder into, a slip feeding section of thick bamboo, make tapered slider be located the material through-hole top that falls, the powder drops to reation kettle inside through falling the material through-hole, thereby reach the effect to powder ration, its benefit lies in easy operation convenient, effectually avoided batching in advance and appear complex operation's problem.

title_en: Waste acetic acid external circulation concentration device for special chemical energetic material
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waste acetic acid external circulation concentration device of special chemical energetic material. Reboiler and No. two reboilers of device are linked together through gaseous phase pipe and concentrated tower, the liquid exit tube and the delivery pump import of concentrated tower bottom are linked together, delivery pump is linked together with the heat exchanger with the conveying pipeline, the heat exchanger liquid pipe and the cooler of heat exchanger bottom are linked together, the product exit tube is equipped with on the cooler, the raw materials advances the pipe on the concentrated tower, the concentrated tower gaseous phase pipe and the condenser at concentrated tower top are linked together, the condensate pipe and the reflux drum of condenser lower part are linked together, reflux drum output tube and the backwash pump of reflux drum lower part are linked together, the feed back pipe and the concentrated tower of reflux pump export are linked together. The device adopts the pipeline outside the tower to connect the condenser, the heat exchanger, the cooler and other chemical unit equipment to form the external circulation of the tower, eliminates a high-pressure circulating water system in the tower, has simple process route, stable and controllable production and operation, low investment cost and high working efficiency, and reduces the labor intensity of workers at the same time, and the operation flexibility can reach 5 to 105 percent.

title_en: Positioning structure applied to preparation of oligonucleotide positioning template by solid-phase carrier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be applied to location structure of solid carrier preparation oligonucleotide locating template relates to the mould design field, can not adjust according to the different models of base plate to current locating frame, when using different base plates, need change the locating frame, very big inconvenient scheduling problem, the scheme of now proposing, including locating frame, fixed frame and removal frame, the opening has all been seted up to the both sides of fixed frame, fixed frame is fixed to be set up in one side of locating frame inner circle, remove the inner wall sliding connection of frame and locating frame, the cavity has been seted up in the locating frame, be provided with the movable block that extends to outside the cavity in the cavity. The utility model provides a be applied to solid carrier preparation oligonucleotide positioning template's location structure can adjust the posting according to the model of base plate, makes its base plate that can adapt to different models, also can guarantee the location accuracy of posting simultaneously, convenient to use.

title_en: Methylal reactor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of methylal preparation and discloses a methylal reactor which comprises a tank body, wherein an air inlet is formed in one side of the tank body, a spraying device is arranged at the top of the tank body, the spraying device is used for spraying reaction solution into the tank body, an auxiliary device is arranged in the tank body, the auxiliary device is matched with the spraying device and used for prolonging the reaction time of the solution and gas, the spraying device is connected with a circulating device, and the circulating device is used for circulating the unreacted solution and gas completely. This methylal reactor lets in the methanol gas through the air inlet to the jar internal, spray set sprays formaldehyde solution to jar internal, and formaldehyde solution delays the time of falling through auxiliary device, and auxiliary device remains the methanol gas for a long time, and then prolongs the reaction time of methanol solution and methanol gas to increase the reaction rate of raw materials, continue to reflect through circulating device with solution and gas circulation after the reaction to jar internal, increased the raw materials reaction rate again, and then reduced manufacturing cost.
