title_en: Phthalic anhydride heavy component separation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a phthalic anhydride heavy component separation system, which particularly relates to the technical field of phthalic anhydride production, and comprises a frame, wherein a separation component is arranged at the top of the frame, the separation component comprises a storage tank arranged at the top of the frame, a filter bucket arranged on the frame is arranged at the top of the storage tank, a feeding box is arranged at the top of the filter bucket, a conveying pipe is arranged at the top of the filter bucket, a packing auger for conveying is arranged at the bottom of the conveying pipe, and a separation chamber arranged on the frame is arranged at one end of the packing auger. According to the utility model, the separation assembly is arranged, the whole design is simple, the structure is reasonable, the raw materials are conveyed into the feeding box through the storage tank by corresponding cooperation of the structures, and the raw materials are firstly screened through the screen, so that larger material blocks in the raw materials can be filtered on the screen, the subsequent separation of the raw materials is facilitated, and the raw material separation efficiency and effect are improved.

title_en: Benzyl acetate pickling device
abstract_en: The application discloses benzyl acetate pickling device belongs to the technical field of pickling devices, and comprises a pickling tank, wherein a manhole is connected to the top of the pickling tank in a threaded manner, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the pickling tank, a hollow shaft is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the rotating motor, a rotating plate is fixedly arranged outside the hollow shaft, a flow hole is formed in the rotating plate, and a hollow shaft acid inlet sleeve is fixedly connected to the outside of the hollow shaft; this application is through setting up rotating electrical machines, hollow shaft hole, rotor plate, circulation hole, hollow shaft advance sour cover, inlet pipe, sealing washer and knob, can promote the mixture of acidizing fluid and raw materials through porous design at the in-process that the device used, can carry out sewage discharge through the blow off pipe after dividing the liquid, and the benzyl acetate essential oil of department is arranged to the rethread discharging pipe, and then can improve the quality of benzyl acetate effectively, is worth using widely.

title_en: Glutamic acid preparation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glutamic acid processing, and discloses a preparation device of glutamic acid, which comprises a supporting table, wherein the top surface of the supporting table is provided with a mixing tank body, the outer side surface of the mixing tank body is fixedly provided with a fixing ring, the lower ends of the left side and the right side of the fixing ring are respectively connected with a supporting rod, the bottom of the supporting rod is fixed on the top surface of the supporting table, the top surface of the mixing tank body is fixedly provided with a motor, and the right side of the motor is provided with a feeding port. According to the utility model, the stirring rod and the first connecting rod can be controlled to rotate through the starting motor so as to achieve the effect of mixing and stirring the liquid in the mixing tank body, and the first connecting rod can be synchronously rotated through the rotation of the stirring rod so as to drive the scraping plate to rotate.

title_en: Automatic overflow synthetic nitration kettle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic overflow synthetic nitration kettle, which comprises a kettle body and a first feeding port, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly connected in the middle of the inside of the kettle body, the left side of the top of the kettle body is provided with the first feeding port, the right side of the top of the kettle body is provided with a second feeding port, the middle position of the top of the kettle body is provided with a sealing feeding port, a flow guide pipe is fixedly connected in the sealing feeding port, the flow guide pipe extends into the kettle body, and a sealing cover is additionally arranged at the top of the sealing feeding port. This automatic overflow's synthetic nitrify cauldron is through being provided with overflow channel, separation blade, overflow pipe, dog, when the internal mixed liquid raw materials of cauldron exceeds overflow channel place water line, unnecessary liquid is impacted the separation blade right under the hydraulic pressure impact and is made its opening, and when reaching the water level decline, then can reset the separation blade under the action of gravity, and liquid is discharged from the overflow pipe to realize automatic overflow, solved ratio precision inadequately, the not good problem of preparation purity.

title_en: Extraction equipment for preparing octacosanol
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of extraction equipment, and particularly relates to extraction equipment for preparing octacosanol. The utility model provides extraction equipment for preparing octacosanol, which can be prepared by arranging a stirring motor, a stirring shaft, a waterproof heating rod, a lifting pipe unit and a U-shaped stirring column unit on an open-pore kettle body unit: 1. the layered upper material after extraction can flexibly select a discharging mode, can be discharged downwards and can be sucked upwards at the lifting pipe unit; 2. in the use process of the waterproof heating rod, the height can be adjusted up and down, the waterproof heating rod cannot be bumped by the U-shaped stirring column unit, and the heating effect of the waterproof heating rod is direct, flexible and safe.

title_en: Epoxy chloropropane synthesis reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an epoxy chloropropane synthesis reaction device, which belongs to the technical field of epoxy chloropropane production and aims at solving the problem that different raw materials are uniformly mixed and heated for a long waiting time in the prior art, and the epoxy chloropropane synthesis reaction device comprises a reaction kettle body, wherein a stirring mechanism is arranged in the reaction kettle body; according to the utility model, through the pre-mixing heating mechanism, the dichloropropanol and the liquid alkali solution which are simultaneously introduced into the pre-mixing barrel can be mixed, meanwhile, the heating ring which is electrified and heated to work preheats the mixture and evaporates part of water in the feeding process, and the mode of pre-mixing various materials in advance and carrying out the preheating treatment in the feeding process into the working chamber of the reaction kettle body is beneficial to improving the synthetic reaction efficiency.

title_en: Processing device for processing glacial acetic acid by utilizing waste heat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing device for processing glacial acetic acid by utilizing waste heat, which comprises a tank body and a circulating assembly, wherein the circulating assembly comprises a heating pipe and a gas-liquid separator, a supporting rod is welded on the upper surface of the tank body, a preheating tank is welded on the upper surface of the supporting rod, a vent pipe is arranged on the upper surface of the tank body, the gas-liquid separator is arranged at one end of the vent pipe, the top of the gas-liquid separator is connected with the vent pipe, a liquid outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom of the gas-liquid separator, the heating pipe is arranged in the preheating tank, the heating pipe is connected with the vent pipe, the preheating tank is arranged in the air outlet pipe, the other end of the heating pipe is connected with the air outlet pipe, and a water inlet pipe is arranged between the preheating tank and the tank body. According to the utility model, the preheating tank, the gas-liquid separator and other structures are arranged on the side wall of the tank body, so that the water vapor can be recycled conveniently, the resource waste is avoided, meanwhile, the glacial acetic acid can be preheated, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Separation recovery plant of epoxy chloropropane and waste water
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of chemical separation and recovery, in particular to separation and recovery equipment for epichlorohydrin and wastewater, which comprises a decompression distillation tank, a wastewater recovery storage tank, a water ring vacuum pump, a chromatographic tank and a phase separator, wherein a distributor connected with the water ring vacuum pump is arranged in the middle part in the chromatographic tank, a plurality of downward inclined guide plates are arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the chromatographic tank at the upper and lower positions of the distributor, a plurality of baffle strips are arranged on the lower surface of the guide plates, and the bottom end of the right side of the chromatographic tank is connected with the phase separator through an inverted U-shaped overflow bent pipe. The utility model utilizes the distributor to uniformly disperse the mixed solution in the chromatographic box, is favorable for the chromatographic separation of the epichlorohydrin aqueous solution into an epichlorohydrin phase and a water phase by the barrier strip on the guide plate, the top of the inverted U-shaped bent pipe is connected with the chromatographic box through the pressure balance pipe, the internal pressure balance is kept without supplementing external water, the separation of the epichlorohydrin and the wastewater is more thorough by the chromatographic box and the phase separator for multiple times, and the separation effect is improved.

title_en: Recovery device for DMAC in meta-aramid polymerization byproducts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a recycling device of DMAC in meta-aramid polymerization byproducts, in particular to the technical field of high-performance fibers, which comprises a drying device, a gas-solid separation device, a condensing device, a solvent recycling device and a solvent conveying pump set which are sequentially connected, wherein a gas phase outlet of the condensing device is connected with a vacuum buffer device, the condensing device or the vacuum buffer device is connected with the vacuum pump set, and a liquid phase outlet of the condensing device is connected with the solvent recycling device. According to the recovery device provided by the utility model, through reasonable design of the recovery device, the solvent DMAC in the meta-aramid polymerization byproducts is efficiently recovered, the recovery rate can reach more than 99%, and the service life of the recovery device is obviously prolonged.

title_en: Reaction tower for preparing acetone derivatives and continuous production system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction tower and a continuous production system for preparing an acetone derivative, and relates to the technical field of preparation equipment of the acetone derivative. The system comprises a raw material liquid tank, a preheater, a reaction liquid buffer tank, a distillation kettle and a reaction tower, wherein an outlet of the raw material liquid tank is connected with the reaction tower through the preheater, the preheated raw material liquid enters the reaction tower from the top of the reaction tower, the bottom of the reaction tower is connected with the reaction liquid buffer tank, the reaction liquid obtained by reaction in the reaction tower enters the reaction liquid buffer tank, an outlet of the reaction liquid buffer tank is connected with an inlet of the distillation kettle, and an outlet of the distillation kettle is connected with an inlet of the raw material liquid tank. The top of the reaction tower is respectively provided with a raw material feeding port, a gas purging port and a regeneration liquid inlet, and after the catalyst is deactivated, the catalyst can be activated and regenerated through the combination of the gas purging port and the regeneration liquid inlet; the utility model can realize the large-scale continuous production of the acetone derivatives.

title_en: Nucleic acid production ammonolysis device convenient to operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nucleic acid production ammonolysis device convenient to operate, which belongs to the technical field of ammonolysis devices and comprises a mounting shell assembly, wherein a mounting limit assembly for fixing a synthetic column is arranged in the mounting shell assembly, a rotating motor for rotating the mounting limit assembly is arranged on the mounting shell assembly, and a quantitative injection assembly for quantitatively injecting ammonolysis liquid and acetonitrile is arranged on the mounting shell assembly. Through the mode, the quantitative injection of the ammonolysis liquid and the acetonitrile is realized, the reagent amount used in the reaction is ensured to be the most efficient and accurate, the reaction is always under the optimal reaction condition, meanwhile, the accurate quantitative injection can reduce the waste of the reagent, reduce the production cost, and the synthetic columns can be placed and taken in batches, so that the operation is more convenient.

title_en: Electronic grade methane purification device
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic grade methane purification device which comprises a first adsorber, a second adsorber, a rectifying tower, a condenser, a buffer tank and a product bottle, wherein the first adsorber is provided with a raw material inlet, the first adsorber is connected with the second adsorber in series through a pipeline, the second adsorber is connected with the rectifying tower in series through a pipeline, the rectifying tower is connected with the product bottle in series, the condenser is connected with the buffer tank in series and then is arranged at one side of the rectifying tower and the product bottle in parallel, and the device combining pressure swing adsorption and low-temperature rectification is adopted to separate liquefied natural gas belonging to a gas mixture, namely, the two-stage serial adsorber is firstly utilized to sequentially remove low-boiling organic and inorganic impurities, so that components affecting the rectification efficiency are removed, and then the liquefied natural gas subjected to adsorption treatment is subjected to low-temperature rectification, so that high-boiling organic impurities are removed, thereby obtaining methane with high purity.

title_en: Integrated Rosa roxburghii VC extractor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated Rosa roxburghii VC extractor, which relates to the technical field of Rosa roxburghii VC extraction, and comprises a processing cylinder, wherein the outer wall of the processing cylinder is fixedly connected with a pair of support plates, the bottom end of the processing cylinder is fixedly connected with a discharging pipe, the outer wall of the discharging pipe is fixedly connected with a first control valve, the bottom of the discharging pipe is provided with a collecting box, the top end of the collecting box is connected with a pair of sealing plates through bolts, the opposite sides of the pair of sealing plates are in close contact with the outer wall of the discharging pipe, the bottom end of the collecting box is fixedly connected with an extracting box, and an extracting mechanism is arranged between the extracting box and the discharging pipe. According to the utility model, the extruding mechanism is arranged to extrude the rosa roxburghii tratt slag in the collecting box, so that the residual liquid in the rosa roxburghii tratt slag flows outwards under the action of extrusion and falls into the extracting box, the waste of liquid resources in the rosa roxburghii tratt slag is avoided, the full and comprehensive extraction of vitamin C in the rosa roxburghii tratt is realized, and the extraction effect is enhanced.

title_en: Library construction workstation
abstract_en: The application provides a library construction workstation which comprises a nucleic acid extraction module, a quality inspection module, a library construction module, a first transfer mechanism and a second transfer mechanism, wherein the nucleic acid extraction module is used for extracting nucleic acids, the quality inspection module is used for inspecting the quality of the extracted nucleic acids, the library construction module is arranged side by side with the quality inspection module and used for constructing libraries of the inspected nucleic acids, the first transfer mechanism is used for transferring the nucleic acids extracted by the nucleic acid extraction module to the quality inspection module, and the second transfer mechanism is used for transferring the nucleic acids in the quality inspection module to the library construction module. In the technical scheme, through the cooperation of the nucleic acid extraction module, the quality inspection module, the library construction module and the first transfer mechanism, the operations of nucleic acid extraction, quality inspection, library construction, quality inspection, homogenization and the like are realized, the automation degree of library construction is improved, the consistency of gene sequencing is further improved, and the influence of external risks on detection results is reduced.

title_en: Toluene diisocyanate closed reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of chemical mechanical equipment, and particularly relates to a toluene diisocyanate closed reaction device which comprises an equipment main body, an exhaust pipeline, a support column and a support connecting rod. According to the utility model, the raw materials required by toluene diisocyanate sealing reaction are placed in through the feeding pipes at different positions by arranging the adjusting shaft, the connecting block, the quick blocking upper cover, the limiting plate, the sealing ring and the sealing base, and catalytic reaction is carried out in a mode of heating the inside of the reaction bin, if toxic gas leakage occurs in the sealing reaction process, an operator immediately rotates the sealing ring, so that a through groove on the sealing ring is isolated from the feeding pipes at two sides, the catalytic reaction is immediately blocked, and when toxic gas leakage occurs, the continuous feeding can be quickly blocked through the sealing ring, and the concentration of the catalytic reaction is reduced.

title_en: High-purity isopropanol preparation equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electronic chemical preparation, in particular to high-purity isopropyl alcohol preparation equipment, which comprises a mounting base, wherein a mounting frame is arranged on the mounting base, a plurality of groups of distillation purification mechanisms which are sequentially connected are arranged on the mounting frame, each distillation purification mechanism comprises a distillation tower arranged on the mounting frame, a feeding pipe is arranged on the distillation tower, a heating component is sleeved at the bottom of the distillation tower, the heating component is arranged on the mounting base, a discharging pipe is arranged at the top of the distillation tower, a condensing component is arranged at one end of the discharging pipe, which is far away from the distillation tower, and is connected with the feeding pipe of the next group of distillation purification mechanisms, and an adsorption purification mechanism is further arranged on the mounting base and is used for further purifying isopropyl alcohol subjected to multiple times of distillation. The application has the effect of improving the purification effect of the isopropanol in the production and preparation process, thereby improving the purity of the prepared isopropanol.

title_en: Preparation facilities of ethylene glycol
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preparation device of ethylene glycol, which at least comprises a deep cooling tower, an oxidation reactor, a stripping tower, a hydration reactor, a refrigerating unit, a first cooling unit, a second cooling unit and a second cooling unit, wherein an inlet of the oxidation reactor is connected with the top of the deep cooling tower, an outlet of the oxidation reactor is connected to the stripping tower, the hydration reactor is connected with the bottom of the stripping tower, an inlet of the cooling unit is connected to the bottom of the deep cooling tower, an outlet of the cooling unit is connected to the top of the deep cooling tower, the first cooling unit is connected with the top of the stripping tower, and the second cooling unit is connected with the top of the stripping tower after being arranged in parallel with the first cooling unit, or an inlet of the second cooling unit and the inlet of the refrigerating unit are connected to the bottom of the deep cooling tower after being arranged in parallel with the refrigerating unit, and an outlet of the second cooling unit is connected to the top of the deep cooling tower. The device for preparing the ethylene glycol can reduce energy consumption in the process of preparing the ethylene glycol and improve economic benefits.

title_en: Methyl chloride's purification system
abstract_en: The application discloses a purification system of methyl chloride, which is used for treating gas-phase methyl chloride recovered in a methyl chlorosilane monomer process, and comprises a methyl chloride tower, an acid treatment unit, a first condensing device and a first condensing device, wherein the pressurized gas-phase methyl chloride enters the methyl chloride tower for recovery, the acid treatment unit comprises at least one sulfuric acid tower, the gas-phase methyl chloride in the methyl chloride tower is conveyed to the sulfuric acid tower, olefin entrained in the gas-phase methyl chloride is absorbed by the sulfuric acid tower, and the gas-phase methyl chloride passing through the acid treatment unit is conveyed to the first condensing device for condensation recovery. The recovery system of the chloromethane provided by the application has higher purity, is beneficial to enhancing economic benefit, reducing production cost and improving system safety.

title_en: Continuous recycling system for alpha, alpha-dimethylbenzyl alcohol water separation, hydrogenolysis and cumene production
abstract_en: The utility model provides an alpha, alpha-dimethylbenzyl alcohol water separation hydrogenolysis cumene production continuous recycling system which comprises a first reactor, a second reactor and a third reactor, wherein the first reactor, the second reactor and the third reactor are identical in structure and are sequentially connected, the reaction unit comprises a preheating unit, a dehydration unit and a hydrogenation unit which are sequentially connected, the upper opening of the dehydration unit is communicated with the hydrogenation unit, the separation device is an empty pipe body, the inlet of the separation device is connected with the reactant outlet of the reaction device, the side end of the separation device is provided with a liquid outlet and is connected with the next reactor through a metering pump, the separation device is connected with a condenser, the other end of the condenser is provided with an air valve, and the air valve is respectively connected with the hydrogenation units of the second reactor and the third reactor. The generated water and the isopropylbenzene are separated in the reaction process, and the hydrogen is recycled, so that the efficient conversion from the alpha, alpha-dimethylbenzyl alcohol to the isopropylbenzene can be realized.

title_en: Methanol synthesis reactor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of methanol synthesis reactors and discloses a methanol synthesis reactor, which comprises a shell, wherein the end part of the shell is fixedly connected with a rotating shell, the side surface of the rotating shell is fixedly connected with a feeding tank, the other end of the shell is fixedly connected with a discharging tank, the inner side of the rotating shell is provided with a rotating assembly, the inner side of the discharging tank is rotatably connected with a connecting circular plate, the side surface of the connecting circular plate is provided with a stirring assembly, the inner part of the discharging tank is provided with a separating assembly, and the rotating assembly comprises a first gear and a second gear. According to the utility model, the gear II fixedly connected with the output end of the driving motor drives the gear I meshed with the driving motor to rotate, so that the rotation work of the tube shell and the connecting circular plate is realized, and the effects of enhancing heat exchange and promoting material mixing are further achieved. The first gear rotates to drive the tube shell to rotate in the shell, so that the heat exchange efficiency of materials in the tube shell and hot water outside the tube is enhanced.

title_en: Device for improving stability and purity of propylene carbonate device rectification product
abstract_en: The utility model provides equipment for improving stability and purity of propylene carbonate device rectification products, which relates to the technical field of propylene carbonate rectification and comprises a rear dehydrogenation tower, a front dehydrogenation tower, a heavy-duty removal tower and a synchronous processing device, wherein the synchronous processing device comprises silk screen structured packing fixedly connected inside the rear dehydrogenation tower and the front dehydrogenation tower, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the top ends inside the rear dehydrogenation tower and the front dehydrogenation tower, a water distributing disc is fixedly connected to the output end of the water inlet pipe, and an air duct is fixedly connected inside the front dehydrogenation tower. And secondly, switching between series connection and parallel connection is realized through a switching valve, so that different production requirements are met. And the heat return pipe is used for recovering waste heat at the top of the tower, so that the steam consumption of the heavy-removal tower is reduced, and the filler of the heavy-removal tower is optimized and the pressure is controlled, thereby avoiding back mixing and polluting products.

title_en: Purification system for producing trifluoroacetic acid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a purification system for producing trifluoroacetic acid, which comprises a reaction kettle, a rectifying tower, a condenser, a reboiler, a collecting tank, a separating tank and a metering pump, wherein a discharge port of the reaction kettle is connected with a liquid inlet of the metering pump through a first pipeline, a liquid outlet of the metering pump is connected with a feed port of the rectifying tower through a second pipeline, a bottom of the rectifying tower is connected with a feed port of the reboiler through a third pipeline, the rectifying tower comprises a rectifying section of an upper half section and an extracting section of a lower half section, a discharge port of the reboiler is connected with the top of the extracting section of the rectifying tower through a fourth pipeline, the top of the rectifying section of the rectifying tower is connected with an air inlet of the separating tank through a fifth pipeline, an air outlet of the separating tank is connected with an air inlet of the condenser through a sixth pipeline, and a discharge port of the condenser is connected with the feed port of the collecting tank through a seventh pipeline. The utility model not only improves the purity of the trifluoroacetic acid, but also realizes the recycling of resources and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Tricyclic akr1c3 dependent kars inhibitors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel tricyclic compounds that are AKR1C3 dependent KARS inhibitor, processes for their preparation, pharmaceutical compositions, and medicaments containing them, and their use in diseases and disorders mediated by an AKR1C3 dependent KARS inhibitor.

title_en: Pre-targeting imaging agents
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel compound of the formula: methods of making this compound, methods of using this compound for pretargeted imaging, and preparations of such formulations.

title_en: Bis(phenylmethylene)cycloalkanones and their heterocyclic analogues to be used as drugs
abstract_en: The solution in question applies to the use of bis(phenylmethylene)cycloalkanones and their heterocyclic analogues with general formula I in human and veterinary medicine to treat the diseases caused by the presence of misfolded proteins in a cell, disbalance of protein homeostasis and proteotoxic stress, proteinopathy in general, particularly neurodegenerative diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), Parkinson disease (PD), Alzheimer disease (AD), Kennedy disease (KD), Huntington disease (HD), Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD), spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA), transthyretin familial amyloid polyneuropathy, dentatorubral–pallidoluysian atrophy, system- or organ-specific amyloidosis, as well as cystic fibrosis and diabetes.

title_en: Method for enhancing the efficiency of oil extraction process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for enhancing demulsification of a fermentation broth containing lysed oleaginous microorganisms, comprising the steps of removing water from the fermentation broth wherein the volume of the fermentation broth containing lysed oleaginous microorganisms is less than 60% of its original volume; and of demulsifying the fermentation broth by heating to a temperature of 60 °C to 110 °C.

title_en: Catalyst for reforming of gasoline fractions, method for producing same and use of the catalyst
abstract_en: A catalyst for reforming of gasoline fractions and hydrogenation of benzene fraction or aromatic hydrocarbons is proposed, the catalyst comprising alumina, platinum, zeolite with a structure of ZSM-5 or ZSM-11. As a zeolite, the catalyst comprises crystalline ferro-aluminosilicate or ferro-gallium-aluminosilicate having a zeolite structure of ZSM-5 or ZSM-11 and has the following composition, wt.%: platinum 0.1-0.5, said zeolite 1-75, alumina - the remainder. The invention also discloses a method for preparing the aforementioned catalyst, a method of reforming of gasoline fractions and a method of hydrogenation of benzene fraction or aromatic hydrocarbons. The technical result is a reduced temperature of complete carbon burn from the catalyst during the catalyst regeneration stage, an increase in the aromatic hydrocarbon yield and an increased octane number of the gasoline fraction produced.

title_en: A capsule for vaporization of a liquid
abstract_en: A vaporization capsule including a liquid active agent absorbed in or adsorbed to a substrate, which may be operated so as to vaporize the liquid active agent. The vaporization capsule includes a capsule body defining a first volume and a second volume. A first cover sealingly engages the capsule body at a first end thereof. The first cover includes an exterior perimeter, an interior wall including a hollow defined between the exterior perimeter and the interior wall portion, and at least one indentation disposed in the interior wall portion, fluidly connecting the first volume and the second volume via the hollow.

title_en: Methods of diagnosing and treating patients with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods for predicting the risk of recurrence and/or metastasis in primary cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC).

title_en: Heteroaryl compounds and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are compounds of formula (I), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts, solvates, hydrates, isotopically labeled derivatives and radiolabeled derivative thereof, and pharmaceutical compositions thereof. Also provided are methods and kits involving the inventive compounds or compositions for detecting and imaging Tau aggregates in the brain for detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) in a subject.

title_en: Synthesis and usage of 1,2-diaminodiamantane platinum(ii) complexes
abstract_en: A new bulky lipophilic chiral ligand based on 1,2-diaminodiamantane is revealed in both of its enantiomeric forms for the preparation of novel platinum(II) complexes. The R,R-enantiomer shows increased efficacy as compared to cisplatin. The binding of diamondoid-based platinum complexes to nucleotides occurs at similar or faster rate for both isomers compared to cisplatin so that the herein revealed platinum(II) complexes are compounds with high anti-cancerogenic activity .

title_en: Compositions for topical treatment
abstract_en: A composition for forming a solid material at a temperature of about 60 °F to about 77 °F comprising an oil phase including one or more oils in an amount of from 30% to 70% by weight of the composition, and one or more alcohols; and an aqueous phase including one or more polyglycerides; wherein the ratio of the aqueous phase to the one or more polyglycerides does not exceed 2.5:1.

title_en: Novel self-assembled amino acid supramolecular polymer, preparation method therefor, and application thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a novel self-assembled amino acid supramolecular polymer, a preparation method therefor, and an application thereof. The self-assembled supramolecular polymer is N-lauroyl-L-alanyl-L-alanine or a salt thereof, and the salt thereof comprises sodium N-lauroyl-L-alanyl-L-alaninate and potassium N-lauroyl-L-alanyl-L-alaninate. The disclosed polymer is more effective at inhibiting bacteria and removing pesticides, and can be widely applied to the daily chemical, agricultural, and pharmaceutical industries. Further disclosed are three methods for preparing the compound. The methods produce products in high yields and are suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Fluorine removal from antimony fluorohalide catalyst using chlorocarbons
abstract_en: A method of chlorinating a antimony fluorohalide catalyst is disclosed. In one embodiment the method comprises contacting an antimony fluorohalide catalyst that contains one or more fluorines with a regenerating agent chosen from 2-chloro-3,3,3-trifluoropropene (1233xf), 1,1,1,3-tetrachloropropane (250fb), 2-chloro-1,1,1,2-tetrafluoropropane (HCFC-244bb) and combinations of 1233xf, 250fb, and 244bb, under conditions effective to exchange at least one fluorine in the antimony fluorohalide catalyst with chlorine. The method can be used to regenerate spent antimony fluorohalide catalyst, for example regenerating SbCl 5  from SbF 5 .

title_en: Oral care compositions comprising n-alkyl-n-acylglucamines
abstract_en: Oral care compositions and methods for the same are disclosed. The oral care composition may include an orally acceptable vehicle, and one or more surfactants. The one or more surfactants may include an N-alkyl-N-acylglucamine. The oral care composition may further include an amino acid and one or more abrasives. The method for treating or reducing dentinal hypersensitivity may include contacting the oral care composition with surfaces of the teeth.

title_en: Methods of treatment of cancer comprising cdc7 inhibitors
abstract_en: Herein disclosed are methods of treatment administering SRA141 as a monotherapy or in a combination therapy useful for inhibiting the growth of tumors such as those in patients with cancer.

title_en: Heterocyclyl compounds for the treatment of autoimmune disease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds of formula (I), wherein R 1  to R 3 , A and Q are as described herein, and their pharmaceutically acceptable salt, enantiomer or diastereomer thereof, and compositions including the compounds and methods of using the compounds.

title_en: Azd3355 (lesogaberan) for treatment and prevention of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (nash), liver fibrosis, and other liver conditions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of treatment or prevention of fatty liver disease, nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) including nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), cirrhosis, liver fibrosis, hepatocellular carcinoma and related liver disease and conditions by administering an effective amount of a GABA B  agonist, lesogaberan (AZD3355), or related compounds.

title_en: Process for preparation of eribulin and intermediates thereof
abstract_en: The present application relate to crystalline azide compound of formula (II) which is used as an intermediate for the preparation of halichondrin B analogues such as eribulin or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The present application also covers purification process of azide compound of formula (II) and its further conversion to eribulin or a pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

title_en: Compounds and methods for dcaf-mediated protein degradation
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods and compounds for inducing DDB1- and CUL4-associated factor 16 (DCAF16)-mediated protein degradation in mammalian cells. In some embodiments, also disclosed herein are methods of modulating the substrate selectivity of a DCAF16-CUL4-RBX1-DDB1 complex (CRL4) for modulating protein degradation.

title_en: Cosmetic composition comprising specific hyperbranched copolymers and liquid dispersions of an acrylic polymer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to cosmetic compositions which comprise a hyperbranched copolymer of the monomers dodecenyl succinic acid anhydride, diisopropanol amine and bis-dimethylaminopropyl amine having quaternary terminal groups and at least one liquid dispersion of an acrylic polymer which is a homopolymer or a copolymer of the monomers selected from the group consisting of (meth)acrylic acid, (meth)acrylic esters, (meth)acrylamide and amides of (meth) acrylic acid.

title_en: Methods for screening personal care products
abstract_en: Methods of screening rinse-off personal care compositions can include the use of explant skin in combination with measurements for moisture and/or cell proliferation.

title_en: Cycloalkane-1,3-diamine derivative
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof having an inhibitory action on the interaction between menin and an MLL protein. The compound represented by the formula (1) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.
