title_en: Salt and resin
abstract_en: To provide a salt and a resin capable of producing a resist pattern having good line edge roughness.SOLUTION: A salt represented by formula (I) and a resin are provided. Wherein R1, R2 and R3 each represent a group represented by formula (4a); R4 to R9 each represent a halogen atom, a haloalkyl group or the like; A1 to A3 each represent a hydrocarbon group; X4 represents a single bond, - CH2 -, - O - or the like; and AI - represents an organic anion. ] SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: G9a inhibitors
abstract_en: To provide compounds for the treatment, prevention or suppression of various conditions (such as proliferative diseases like cancer, β-globinopathy, fibrosis, pain, neurodegenerative diseases, Prader-Willi syndrome, malaria, viral infections, myopathy, autism, etc.) by inhibiting G9a.SOLUTION: A compound represented by general formula (I) or a pharmacologically acceptable salt thereof is provided.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Multi-component host material and organic electroluminescent device comprising the same
abstract_en: To provide an organic electroluminescent device having high efficiency and long life.SOLUTION: An organic electroluminescent device comprising at least one light-emitting layer between an anode and a cathode, wherein the light-emitting layer comprises a host and a phosphorescent dopant, the host consists of a multi-component host compound, wherein at least a first host compound of the multi-component host compound is a specific bicarbazole derivative containing an aryl group, and a second host compound is a specific carbazole derivative containing a nitrogen-containing heteroaryl group.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Cosmetic composition containing starfish collagen and Viburnum erosum fruit extract for moisturizing and firming the skin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cosmetic composition for improving skin moisturization and elasticity. More particularly, the present invention relates to a cosmetic composition containing starfish collagen and a Viburnum erosum fruit extract, thereby having excellent effects on skin moisturizing and elasticity improvement.

title_en: Method for extracting saponins and cosmetic composition containing the extracted saponin using the same method with antioxidation and antiaging
abstract_en: Disclosed are a saponin extraction method and a cosmetic composition containing the saponin extracted according to the method. The saponin extraction method includes the following steps: extracting an ultrasonic extract by applying ultrasonic waves to a mixed solution containing shikakai fruits, Saponaria officinalis leaves, Arctium lappa roots, and purified water; and extracting saponin by adding the ultrasonic extract and cyclodextrin to inclusion while stirring.

title_en: Cosmetics for the prevention and improvement of skin inflammation using anthelmintic
abstract_en: Provided is a cosmetic composition comprising a mixture of praziquantel, mebendazole, albendazole, pyrantel, niclosamide and ivermectin, a catalyst, a cosolvent, and an antioxidant.

title_en: POWDER for HAIR DYE
abstract_en: The present invention provides a powder hair dye comprising an expression dye expressed, at the inside of hair, in a structure according to chemical formula 1: [PPD]a-[PPDS]b-[TDS]c-[PAPS]d-[PAP]e-[RS]f-[MAPS]g-[MAP]h-[24DAPE]i. In the formula: each of a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, and i is a molar ratio of each compound and is a value of 0 or more; a + b + c + d + e + f + g + h + i = 1; a + b + c + d + e and f + g + h + i are each greater than 0; and the value of (a + b + c + d + e) / (f + g + h + i) ranges from 0.2 to 8. The reactivity of persalt can be effectively controlled.

title_en: New composition comprising exosomes derived from Gardenia jasminoides as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition for skin elasticity improvement, skin wrinkle improvement, skin regeneration, skin tone or skin brightness improvement, skin whitening, wound healing, and/or wound healing promotion, containing exosomes derived from Gardenia jasminoides as an active ingredient. The composition according to the present invention is less likely to contain impurities such as residual solvents and growth regulators compared to conventional hot water extracts or solvent extracts of Gardenia jasminoides fruits or flowers, filtrate of such extracts, and Gardenia jasminoides callus culture media, and has excellent effects of skin elasticity improvement, skin wrinkle improvement, skin regeneration, skin tone or skin brightness improvement, skin whitening, wound healing, and/or wound healing promotion.

title_en: Composition for immunosuppression comprising l-ahg
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for immunosuppression comprising 3,6-anhydro-L-galactose (L-AHG) as an active ingredient, and to a pharmaceutical composition, functional health food, and functional cosmetic composition comprising the active ingredient for preventing or treating immune diseases. The composition for immunosuppression comprising L-AHG, the pharmaceutical composition, and the functional health food and functional cosmetic composition of the present invention have the excellent effect of selectively and effectively inhibiting the activation, proliferation, and differentiation of CD4 T cells, which are the main target of an immunosuppressive agent. Therefore, the present invention is very useful for the pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetic industries.

title_en: A cosmetic composition with improved percutaneous absorption and a method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a plaxome comprising an amphiphilic surfactant, a nonionic surfactant, and sterol. A plaxome of the present invention has excellent long-term stability and can be mixed without limitation in various formulations of cosmetics, thereby being expected to be widely used in the cosmetic field. In addition, since the plaxome of the present invention has an excellent effect of promoting percutaneous absorption, it is expected to be widely used as a pharmaceutical composition or an external application composition for transdermal delivery of an active ingredient for treating diseases in the medical field in addition to the cosmetic field.

title_en: High-purity cannabidiol refinement and crystallization method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing cannabidiol crystals in a high yield from a hemp extract. The preparation method of the present invention converts cannabidiol (CBD) as well as cannabidiol (CBD-A) in a hemp extract into cannabidiol (CBD) and uses the converted cannabidiol (CBD-A), thereby having a higher yield than the hemp extract. In addition, in the preparation method of the present invention, cannabidiol (CBD) crystals are prepared by using a solubility change according to a solvent temperature difference, and in the present invention, it was confirmed that high-purity cannabidiol (CBD) crystals can be prepared in high yield by using pentane among various solvents.

title_en: Sports patch and Sports patch manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sports patch and a sports patch manufacturing device. This is a device that is attached to a user's skin to block ultraviolet rays and moisturize the skin, and comprises: a base sheet coated with an adhesive layer that adheres to the skin; a nonwoven fabric having a relatively narrower area than the base sheet; a polyurethane layer coated on the lower surface of the nonwoven fabric and adhered to and fixed to the adhesive layer of the base sheet; a hydrogel layer laminated on the upper surface of the nonwoven fabric; and a peeling film that covers the hydrogel layer and is removed during use. The sports patch of the present invention has good adhesion to the skin, thereby preventing a lifting phenomenon and maintaining a long moisturizing property. In addition, the sports patch manufacturing device according to the present invention is capable of manufacturing a sports patch having a shape suitable for the curvature of the skin and having excellent productivity by automatically performing lamination and cutting work on the supplied material.

title_en: Compound and organic light emitting device comprising same
abstract_en: Provided is a compound of the following chemical formula 1. In the chemical formula 1, R9 among R1 to R10 is represented by the following chemical formula 1-A, and the other is represented by -L1-Ar1. L1 is a direct bond; or an arylene group substituted or unsubstituted with deuterium, Ar1 is a heterocyclic group substituted or unsubstituted with one or more of deuterium, an alkyl group, and an aryl group substituted or unsubstituted with deuterium, and the remainder of R1 to R10 are deuterium. The compound according to one embodiment of the present specification is used in an organic light-emitting device, so that the driving voltage of the organic light-emitting device can be lowered and the light efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Depolymerization processing apparatus of waste PLA for improving recovery rate
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a waste PLA depolymerization process apparatus capable of continuously generating gaseous lactide at a low temperature by depolymerizing a reaction mixture in which a PLA oligomer and a reaction catalyst generated through hydrolysis and evaporation processes of waste PLA are mixed while moving the reaction mixture in the form of a thin film in a reaction tank in a vacuum atmosphere. The waste PLA depolymerization process apparatus comprises: a reaction tank having a vacuum exhaust port and a recovery port; a heating unit that discharges gaseous lactide generated by depolymerization of the reaction mixture to a lower part; a depolymerization reaction unit that discharges the reaction mixture that has not been depolymerized together with the gaseous lactide to a lower part; a reheating unit that re-heats the reaction mixture and discharges it to the outside of the reaction tank; and a condenser that converts the discharged gaseous lactide into liquid lactide and discharges it to a lower part.

title_en: Cosmetic composition for protecting hair and scalp from UV which comprises plnat complex extracts of Zingiber officinale var. rubrum, Ocimum Sanctum, Mentha Aquatica, Acorus Calamus and Eclipta Prostrata
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of a complex plant extract of red ginger, holy basil, watermint, Acorus gramineus, and Eclipta prostrata for skin improvement, hair protection, or damaged hair improvement. The complex extract of red ginger, holy basil, watermint, Acorus gramineus, and Eclipta prostrata according to the present invention is non-toxic to dermal papilla cells, exhibits moisturizing and skin barrier improvement effects in keratinocytes, alleviates inflammation in dermal papilla cells, provides protection against ultraviolet rays, and exhibits antioxidant and anti-stress effects. In addition, the complex extract has an immediate improvement effect on the cuticle layer of damaged hair, and thus can be used for skin improvement, hair protection, or damaged hair improvement.

title_en: Cosmetic composition containing pomegranate extract for excellent antioxidant, skin moisturizing, and wrinkle improvement and cosmetics containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an excellent antioxidant, skin moisturizing, and wrinkle alleviating cosmetic composition comprising a pomegranate extract, and cosmetics comprising the same. The present invention provides a cosmetic composition comprising a pomegranate extract as an active ingredient and exhibiting excellent antioxidant activity, high skin moisturizing power, and an effect of preventing and alleviating skin wrinkles.

title_en: A composition comprising rambutan extract and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition comprising a rambutan extract extracted with an extraction solvent containing Natural Deep Eutectic Solvents (NADES), and a method for manufacturing the same.

title_en: EWG green grade natural perfume composition with antioxidant effect
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fragrance composition comprising: Ilex paraguayensis; Laurus nobilis leaf oil; and Tagetes minuta.L oil and, more specifically, to a fragrance composition which uses EWG green grade natural fragrance, thereby being safe, giving customers a sense of trust, and having high anti-oxidant efficacy.

title_en: Pyrazinonindolone derivatives for treatment of triple-negative breast cancer with improved target selectivity and process of preparation thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a pyrazino indolone derivative with high target selectivity for triple-negative breast cancer and a method for manufacturing the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to: a pyrazino indolone derivative which improves a fact that the target selectivity for conventional triple-negative breast cancer is not high, and has a significantly higher proliferation inhibitory effect than gefitinib; and a method for manufacturing the same.

title_en: Compound, core-shell dye, photosensitive resin composition including the same, and color filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound represented by chemical formula 1. (In the chemical formula 1, the definition of each substituent is the same as defined in the specification.) By using the compound or core-shell dye according to one embodiment, a color filter having excellent durability, luminance, and light resistance may be implemented.

title_en: Method for producing imino group-containing organoxysilane compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing an imino group-containing organoxysilane compound. According to the method for producing an imino group-containing organoxysilane compound, by reacting a carbonyl group-containing compound represented by general formula (1) with an aminoorganoxysilane compound represented by general formula (2), an imino group-containing organoxysilane compound represented by general formula (3) is produced. According to the present invention, the imino group-containing organoxysilane compound can be produced efficiently and in high yield.

title_en: Composition for strengthening skin barrier containing extract of Saragassum Horneri
abstract_en: Disclosed is a cosmetic composition for strengthening the skin barrier comprising an extract of Sargassum horneri as an active ingredient. The extract of Sargassum horneri can strengthen the skin barrier, or prevent or recover the damage of the skin barrier by increasing the expression level of LEKT1 and decreasing the expression level of KLK5.

title_en: Compound and organic light emitting device comprising same
abstract_en: The present specification provides a compound of a chemical formula 1 and an organic light emitting device comprising the same. The compound may be used as a material for an organic material layer of the organic light emitting device, and by using the compound, it is possible to improve high color purity and/or lifespan characteristics in the organic light emitting device.

title_en: Composition having sterilzation and anti-influenza virus effect
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for having bactericidal and anti-influenza virus effects and maintaining moisturizing power on the skin. The present invention relates to a composition for having bactericidal and anti-influenza virus effects and maintaining moisturizing power on the skin, which includes ethanol, glycerin, ethylhexyl palmitate, cetylethyl hexanoate, hydrogenic lecithin, polyglyceryl-10 oleate, 1,2-hexanediol, sodium hyaluronate.

title_en: Method for self-emulsifying lamellar liquid emulsion containing moringa oil and emulsion produced by the same, cosmetic composition comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a self-emulsifying lamellar liquid emulsion containing moringa oil to strengthen the skin barrier and increase moisture in the stratum corneum, an emulsion manufactured thereby, and a cosmetic composition including the same. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring moringa oil; manufacturing an oil phase mixture by mixing the moringa oil and an emulsifier and raising the temperature to 75 to 85℃; and mixing 850 to 950 parts by weight of an aqueous mixture containing water and polyol with 100 parts by weight of the oily mixture, raising the temperature to 75 to 85℃, and cooling the mixture to 55 to 65℃ while stirring, thereby manufacturing an emulsion in which the oily mixture is self-emulsified in the aqueous mixture.

title_en: Solid-type cosmetic composition for blocking uv having water resistance and easy-washability
abstract_en: The present invention provides a solid cosmetic composition containing a sunscreen agent, a fatty acid and a wax, having excellent water resistance and/or cleaning properties, and capable of effectively blocking ultraviolet rays. More specifically, the cosmetic composition for sunscreen of the present invention has the excellent water resistance at low pH, but is converted to excellent cleansing properties at high pH when washing the skin, so it is possible to be usefully used.

title_en: Novel prolylFK506 derivatives and their usage with neurite growth and synaptogenic activity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to any one novel compound selected from the group consisting of 9-deoxo-36,37-dihydro-prolylFK506, 9-deoxo-31-O-demethyl-36,37-dihydro-prolylFK506, 9-deoxo-prolylFK520, and 9-deoxo-31-O-demethyl-prolylFK520, and uses thereof.

title_en: Method of Cactus Extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining an Opuntia humifusa stem extract. An objective of the present invention is to provide a method for removing thorns of Opuntia humifusa and solutions to problems occurring during extraction due to the unique viscosity of Opuntia humifusa. To this end, the method for obtaining an Opuntia humifusa stem extract includes a method of using a washer for bulbs and tubers to remove thorns, using alcohol to remove microorganisms, using a grinder, and using stirring, a method for using natural preservatives, and an instant sterilization method. According to the present invention, the method for obtaining an Opuntia humifusa stem extract obtains an extract by minimizing the loss of nutrients possessed by Opuntia humifusa and making the use of unique ingredients of Opuntia humifusa.

title_en: Anti-bacterial composition comprising an extract of Elaeocarpus sylvestris or purified extract thereof as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibacterial composition containing an Elaeocarpus sylvestris extract or a filtrate thereof as an active ingredient. The Elaeocarpus sylvestris extract and the filtrate thereof have antibacterial activities against Lactobacillus sakei, Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactococcus lactis, Leuconostoc mesenteroides, Weissella confusa, Pediococcus acidilactici, Pichia anomala, Pichia fermentans, and Pseudomonas fluorescens strains, which are resistant to antibiotics, and thus can be used in an antibacterial composition against strains resistant to antibiotics.

title_en: Self-Manufacturing Non-liquefied Skin Gel Pack
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a self-produced non-liquid skin gel pack is a self-produced customized skin gel pack which is customized in real time by a purchase user. The self-produced non-liquid skin gel pack comprises a base product. The base product includes a base composition and a base storage part storing the base composition. The base composition contains a specified base component, is stored in a non-liquid state that can be liquefied, is converted into a liquid state by water in a specified temperature range and then solidified under specified conditions to become a gel state which can be molded into a skin gel pack detachably attached to a specified skin area. When N functional products, in which N (N>=1) functional compositions containing specified functional components are stored in specified N functional storage parts, are prepared, the base composition is put into a specified mixing vessel, into which water within a specified temperature range is introduced, liquefied, and mixed with the N functional compositions put into the mixing vessel before, during or after the liquefaction. According to the present invention, a user can produce a customized skin gel pack optimized for his or her current skin condition.

title_en: Novel cyclohexane ester composition and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel cyclohexane-based ester (DCB) composition and a preparation method thereof, and more particularly, provides a novel cyclohexane-based ester composition which is economical and industrially usable through transesterification with alcohol by using cyclohexane-based compounds, which are by-products generated during the production of 1,4-cyclohexane dimethanol, as raw materials. The cyclohexane-based ester (DCB) composition thus provided can be widely applied as a plasticizer for adhesives or plasticizers for paints and other polymer additives.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent materials and devices
abstract_en: A compound of formula I is provided, wherein at least one of a moiety A, a moiety B, a moiety C, and a moiety D is a 6-membered carbocyclic or heterocyclic ring, and at least one of R^A, R^B, R^C, and R^D, includes a group having the formula (II), where R^X may be silyl, germyl, boryl, nitrile, F, CF_3, cycloalkyl, heterocycloalkyl, or monocyclic heteroaryl. The compound is useful as an emitter in OLEDs providing improved efficiency.

title_en: Microfluidic reactor for controlling chemical reaction and chemical reaction control method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microfluidic reactor for controlling chemical reactions and a chemical reaction control method using the same, and more specifically, provides a microfluidic reactor capable of controlling chemical reactions on an expanded scale and a microfluidic reaction device including the same. In addition, an ultra-fast synthesis method for controlling unstable intermediates using the microfluidic reactor and the microfluidic reaction device is provided. The microfluidic reactor of the present invention comprises a housing, a unit flow path module, a branch flow path module, and a collection flow path.

title_en: EGFR and HDAC dual inhibitor compounds and medical use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a compound useful in the treatment or alleviation of fibrosis and medicinal uses thereof. The compound according to the present disclosure is useful for treating, ameliorating or preventing fibrosis. The present disclosure provides medicinal uses of the compounds according to the present disclosure for treating, alleviating or preventing fibrosis.

title_en: Levocetirizine alkyl ester derivatives or its pharmaceutically acceptable salt
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel levocetirizine alkyl esters and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, a method for manufacturing the same, and a pharmaceutical composition containing the same for preventing or treating allergic diseases. Since a novel levocetirizine alkyl ester compound of the present invention is converted to levocetirizine in vivo, it can be usefully used in the prevention or treatment of allergic diseases such as rhinitis, urticaria, dermatitis, and eczema.

title_en: Organometallic compound and organic light emitting device including the same
abstract_en: An organometallic compound represented by a following chemical formula 1, an organic light emitting device including the organometallic compound, and a diagnostic composition including the organometallic compound are disclosed. The description of the above chemical formula 1 is referred to the present specification.

title_en: Oily solid cleansing cosmetic
abstract_en: Provided are oil-based solid cleansing cosmetics that prevent the aggregation and sedimentation of the charcoal powder and ensure sufficient dispersion of charcoal powder despite containing the charcoal powder. Oil-based solid cleansing cosmetics contain the following component A of 4.0-20 mass%, the following component B of 50-90 mass%, the following component C of 0.01-5.0 mass%, the following component D of 8-22 mass%, the following component E of 0.01-5.0 mass%, and the following component F of 0.5-6.0 mass%, wherein component A is a solid oil with a melting point of 50-120℃, component B is a liquid oil, component C is a non-ionic surfactant with an HLB value of 2-6, component D is a non-ionic surfactant with an HLB value of 8-15, component E is charcoal powder with a volume-based median size of 1-35 μm, and component F is water.

title_en: Onium salt, resist composition, and patterning process
abstract_en: Provided is a novel onium salt for use in a resist composition that can be used in lithography to improve LWR or CDU with high sensitivity and good resolution, either positive or negative, and to suppress the collapse of resist patterns. The onium salt is represented by the general formula (1), wherein R^(ALU) represents any one of a tertiary ether, a tertiary carbonate, or an acetal having a cyclic structure, formed with neighboring oxygen atoms. R^F is any one of fluorine atoms, fluoroalkyl groups with carbon numbers 1 through 6, and nitro groups. R^a is a hydrocarbyl group of a carbon number of 1 to 20. n1 is an integer of 0 or 1. n2 and n3 are integers of 1 or 2. One of -O-R^(ALU) and R^F are bonded to neighboring carbon atoms. n4 is an integer from 0 to 3. Z^+ represents an onium cation.

title_en: Nucleic acid molecules, nucleic acid structures, and composition for enhancing immunity and pharmaceutical composition for treating aids comprising the same
abstract_en: A nucleic acid molecule of the present invention may better pass through a cell membrane by attaching lipid-modified uracil to a CpG oligodeoxynucleotide terminal, and may aggregate into a micelle shape due to its self-assembling property, so it does not require a drug delivery system. In addition, the nucleic acid structure by self-assembly of the nucleic acid molecule has an excellent effect of activating immune cells and has an effect of reversing the latent period of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), making it effective in treating AIDS.

title_en: Streptococcus downii strain and its use for improving skin conditions
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a novel Streptococcus downii strain, another object of the present invention is to provide a lysate, a culture medium, or an extract of the culture medium of the strain, and another object of the present invention is to provide a use of the Streptococcus downii strain, the lysate, the culture medium, or the extract of the culture medium. The present invention provides a Streptococcus downii strain belonging to a Streptococcus sp. According to one aspect of the present invention, the novel Streptococcus downii strain has an effect of improving a skin condition such as skin moisturizing or skin barrier strengthening, thereby being useful in cosmetics, medicines, foods, and the like.

title_en: Composition for Inhibiting Persister Cell Comprising Perillae Fructus Extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for inhibiting persistent bacteria (persister cell) comprising an perilla frutescens extract. In the present invention, persistent bacteria which are not killed even by antibiotic treatment can be effectively suppressed by using the perilla frutescens extract. Therefore, the composition for inhibiting persistent bacteria of the present invention can be used for preventing and treating infectious diseases caused by bacteria, especially recurrent or chronic infections, thereby exhibiting an excellent effect, and can be usefully applied to a cosmetic composition for alleviating dermatitis.

title_en: Cosmetic Composition For Improving Skin Moisture, Skin Texture, Or Skin Elasticity Comprising Ginseng Extract Or Fraction Thereof Enriched With Arginine-Fructose-Glucose(AFG) Amino Sugar
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cosmetic composition comprising an arginine-fructose-glucose (afg) amino sugar-enhanced ginseng extract or a fraction thereof, and provides a cosmetic composition having an effect of improving skin moisturizing, skin texture, or skin elasticity by lowering the degree of keratin hardening of the stratum corneum of the skin.

title_en: Extraction method for each use of DNA with different content of salmonid sperm and testis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a DNA extraction method for varying the content of Salmonidae germ cells and, more specifically, to a DNA extraction method for varying the content of Salmonidae germ cells, which uses a solution containing salt in a step of physically pulverizing sperm or testis cells of Salmonidae or pulverizes DNA by spray drying at a temperature of 100 to 200℃ for 10 to 60 minutes in a DNA extraction process using non-alcohol. The present invention can optimally extract DNA by varying the use process according to the DNA concentration. Specifically, the use of spray drying to prepare low-concentration DNA, DNA extraction added by adjusting the content of SDS in TE buffer, adjustment of the amount of salt when extracting DNA by alcohol immersion, spray drying of centrifugation supernatant after aqueous solution extraction, low-temperature vacuum drying of centrifugation supernatant, and the like are more effective when extracting DNA.

title_en: Antioxidant composition comprising Bacillus subtilis strain
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antioxidant composition comprising a bacillus subtilis p223 strain. the composition according to the present invention exhibits meaningful antioxidant activity in a test of dpph radical scavenging ability, reactive oxygen species (ros) scavenging ability, and sod-like antioxidant activity, and thus can be usefully used for patients or consumers in need thereof.

title_en: Wickerhamomyces anomalus KJ-1 and Wickerhamomyces anomalus CP-2 isolated from traditional nuruk and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a Wickerhamomyces anomalus KJ-1 strain deposited under accession number KACC 93373P and a Wickerhamomyces anomalus CP-2 strain deposited under accession number KACC 93384P, both of which are isolated from traditional nuruk. These strains exhibit excellent saccharification ability. The KJ-1 strain (KACC 93373P) shows excellent ACE inhibitory activity, thus providing a pharmaceutical composition and a health functional food composition for preventing or treating hypertension, and enabling the production of a functional alcoholic beverage with enhanced hypertension alleviation or treatment efficacy. The CP-2 strain (KACC 93384P) exhibits excellent tyrosinase inhibitory activity, thus providing a health functional food composition and a cosmetic composition for skin whitening, and enabling the production of a functional alcoholic beverage with enhanced skin whitening efficacy.

title_en: Composition for inhibitor of Pathogenic Escherichia coli and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for inhibiting pathogenic escherichia coli and a use thereof. a compound of the present invention specifically inhibits a regulator protein grla to inhibit pathogenicity such as cell adhesion without inhibiting the growth of pathogenic escherichia coli, thereby lowering the possibility of inducing resistance.

title_en: Composition for maintaining the balance of microbiome in the skin comprising extracellular vesicles derived from cannine adipose-derived stem cell or human-derived somatic cell as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for maintaining balance of a skin microbiome, comprising extracellular vesicles isolated from dog adipose-derived stem cells or human somatic cells as an active ingredient. The extracellular vesicles isolated from canine adipose-derived stem cells or human somatic cells of the present invention increase the species diversity and abundance of the skin microbiome, and exhibit an effect of reducing the distribution of harmful skin microbiota belonging to the firmicutes phylum, thereby being usefully used in the preparation of a composition for maintaining the balance of the skin microbiome.

title_en: Manufacturing method of high-performance photosensor for mid-infrared detection
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a method for manufacturing an optical sensor capable of exhibiting improved optical characteristics at mid-infrared rays by using a precursor capable of easily manufacturing a nickel sulfide thin film having a large area at a lower temperature. The method comprises the following steps of: a) inputting a substrate for forming a nickel sulfide thin film into a deposition chamber; b) forming a nickel sulfide thin film on the substrate in the deposition chamber by using a chemical vapor deposition method or an atomic layer deposition method with a single source precursor including a nickel atom as central metal and having at least one sulfur atom directly coupled to the nickel, wherein the single source precursor includes a sulfur (S) component and a nickel (Ni) component in molecules at the same time; and c) forming a metal electrode coming in direct contact with the generated nickel sulfide thin film. According to the present invention, the optical sensor can easily allow a nickel sulfide thin film to have a large area at a lower temperature through a single source precursor, while having a high-quality uniform surface, thereby exhibiting not only optical characteristics in visible light but also improved optical characteristics in the mid-infrared region.

title_en: COMPOSITION FOR PREVENTING, IMPROVING OR TREATING ATOPIC DERMATITIS CONTAINING Spondias pinnata AS AN ACTIVE INGREDIENT AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing, alleviating, or treating atopic dermatitis comprising Spondias pinnata as an active ingredient, and to a manufacturing method thereof, and more specifically, to a composition for preventing, alleviating or treating atopic dermatitis, a cosmetic composition, and a food composition comprising Spondias pinnata as an active ingredient, and to a manufacturing method of a Spondias pinnata extract.

title_en: Process for alkoxycarbonylation of olefins using synthesis gas
abstract_en: Provided is a method for alkoxycarbonylation of olefin using synthesis gas, comprising the steps of: a) initially charging olefin; b) adding a ligand of chemical formula (I) (where R^1 and R^3 are each -(C3-C20)-heteroaryl radicals, and R^2 and R^4 are each -(C1-C12)-alkyl); c) adding a compound containing Pd; d) adding an alcohol; e) supplying CO and H_2, where the pressure at which H_2 is supplied is at least 0.6 MPa (6 bar); f) heating the reaction mixture from steps a) to e) to convert the olefin to ester.

title_en: Ethanol-free hypoallergenic non-separable low-viscosity emulsified cosmetic composition or method for producing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ethanol-free, hypoallergenic, non-separable, low-viscosity emulsified cosmetic composition and a manufacturing method thereof. The present invention provides a cosmetic composition which contains a specific combination of a thickener, a fragrance, and an emulsifier, so that reverberation remains for a long time even without ethanol, and has excellent formulation stability at room temperature and high temperature.

title_en: Compound for organic electric element, organic electric element using the same, and an electronic device thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound represented by chemical formula 1, a method for recovering the same, an organic electric element including a first electrode, a second electrode, and an organic material layer between the first electrode and the second electrode, and an electronic device including the organic electric element. By including the compound of chemical formula 1 in the organic material layer, it is possible to lower the driving voltage of the organic electric element and improve luminous efficiency and lifespan.

title_en: Organic compound and organic light emitting device comprising same
abstract_en: The present specification provides an organic compound represented by chemical formula 1 and an organic light emitting device including the same.

title_en: manufacturing method and apparatus hydrocarbon
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a hydrocarbon manufacturing method comprising the steps of: (s1) generating a first mixed gas by heat-treating organic waste; (s2) generating a second mixed gas by dry reforming the first mixed gas in a first fluidized bed reactor; (s3) separating the second mixed gas into a first stream containing carbon dioxide and a second stream containing hydrogen and carbon monoxide; (s4) introducing the first stream separated in step (s3) into a second fluidized bed reactor and converting the first stream into carbon monoxide through a reverse boudouard reaction; (s5) manufacturing a third mixed gas by mixing the second stream and the carbon monoxide converted in step (s4); (s6) generating a synthesis gas from the third mixed gas through a water gas conversion reaction; and (s7) generating hydrocarbon from the synthesis gas through a catalytic reaction.

title_en: Copper-based composite catalyst and method for screening oxidation number thereof

title_en: Method of preparing ionic fluids.
abstract_en: A method of preparing MEP including the steps of: (a) adding N-methylpyrrolidine to an excess amount of ethyl bromide located in a reactor, wherein the N-methylpyrrolidine will react with the ethyl bromide forming MEP, wherein the reaction will have a reaction temperature that can varies over time; (b) stopping addition of N-methylpyrrolidine when the excess of ethyl bromide to the N-methylpyrrolidine falls within a range of 3:1 to 1.5:1; (c) adding water to the reactor creating a two phase system to develop which includes: (i) a top layer containing aqueous MEP and (ii) a bottom layer containing ethyl bromide; (d) separating the top layer from the bottom layer yielding a first aqueous solution of MEP and a second solution of ethyl bromide; and (e) removing N-methylpyrrolidine and ethyl bromide from the first aqueous solution of MEP.

The preparations can be used advantageously for the treatment of acne or atopic dermatitis and to care for skin that has been damaged by acne or atopic dermatitis.

title_en: Organic ammonium salts with traceability and dispersing detergency properties for liquid fuels and their obtaining process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to obtaining organic ammonium salts (SAO) and their supramolecular surfactant derivatives (SS), which simultaneously present traceability and dispersing detergents for organic scale. Also, they have applications as differentiators, markers, or tracers of fuels derived from hydrocarbons, disperse organic scale, or inhibit the precipitation of gum in injectors and intake valves of automotive vehicle engines, thus obtaining organic ammonium salts (ODS) through an acid-base reaction between a molecule of the azo family and an amine. The SAO reacts with an organic compound (CO) so that through non-covalent interactions a self-assembly process occurs that gives rise to SS, basing the process on green chemistry in the absence of solvents, thus performing the quantification of said SAO and SS through ultraviolet-visible (UV-VIS) and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) analytical techniques through a calibration curve and evaluating its performance as a rubber-dispersing agent in a single-cylinder engine.

title_en: Methods and compositions for dendritic cell targeting vaccines

The one or more membranes include a first membrane with a pore size sufficient to allow saponin retention. title_en: Process for the preparation of monochloroacetic acid
abstract_en: The present invention pertains to a process for the chlorination of acetic acid to form monochloroacetic acid comprising the following steps a. reacting acetic acid with chlorine using acetic anhydride and/or acetyl chloride as catalyst to form a liquid phase, and a gaseous phase, - the liquid phase comprising at least monochloroacetic acid, acid chlorides, acid anhydrides and optionally un reacted acetic acid, and - the gaseous phase comprising HCI, acetic acid, monochloroacetic acid and acid chlorides, b. stripping said liquid phase at a temperature of between 120 and 180Â°C and a pressure between 1 and 7 bara with gaseous HCI to form a gaseous HCI stream comprising acetic acid, acid chlorides and optionally acid anhydrides and monochloroacetic acid, and a liquid stream comprising monochloroacetic acid and dichloroacetic acid; c. cooling the gaseous HCI stream comprising acetic acid, acid chlorides, acid anhydrides and optionally monochloroacetic acid to a temperature of between 10 and 60Â°C (preferably around 35Â°C), and d. feeding the cooled gaseous HCI to an absorber with acetic acid as absorber, absorbing the acetic acid, acid chlorides and optionally monochloroacetic acid forming a stream comprising acetic acid and acid chlorides.

title_en: Catalytic conversion process and system for producing gasoline and propylene

Said method and system enable high propylene and gasoline yields.

title_en: Method for producing acetic acid (options)
abstract_en:
FIELD: petrochemistry. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of petrochemistry and, more specifically, to a method for producing acetic acid by oxidative carbonylation of methane in a gas-phase mode on zeolite catalysts and can be used for more economical production of acetic acid in industry. Two variants of the method are proposed by oxidative carbonylation of the initial gaseous mixture containing 67% vol. methane, 3% vol. oxygen, 15% vol. carbon monoxide and 15% vol. nitrogen, the gas mixture is fed into the isothermal zone of the reactor at a rate of 1250-40,000 h -1 , at a temperature of 350-450°С, while using a zeolite characterized by a molar ratio of SiO 2 /Al 2 O 3  equal to 33-307, which, after calcination, is additionally subjected to ultrasonic treatment at a frequency of 80 kHz for 1 hour, and the catalyst is obtained by mixing the obtained zeolite with crushed quartz of 3-5 mm fraction in an equal volume ratio. According to the second option, an initial gas mixture containing 55% vol. methane, 3% vol. oxygen, 11% vol. carbon monoxide, 11% vol. nitrogen and 20% vol. water. For both options can be used zeolite modified with rhodium in the amount of 0.5% wt. in relation to the finished catalyst. 
     EFFECT: increasing the selectivity for acetic acid and eliminating the stage of separating the catalyst from the reaction products in a one-stage economical method for producing acetic acid from natural gas, as well as increasing the specific productivity of the proposed method for acetic acid.

title_en: Broad spectrum antiviral compounds
abstract_en: Antiviral compounds comprising prodrugs with differing side chains derived from a tyrosine substance in the form of a tyrosine amide in which the amide substituent side chain is an alkyl ether, thioether, or alkene. Embodiments of the compounds have a range of effective lipophilicity values allowing variation in aqueous solubility, oral bioavailability, cell permeability and in vivo activation properties. The embodiments have promoieties derived from a single amino acid, which are expected to have low toxicity. The features described above also make possible a novel “precision medicine” approach to treatment of viral infections, whereby the prodrug variations can be exploited to match optimal activation of the prodrug to a given patient or strain of virus.

abstract_en: A skin regeneration therapy combining precise bioelectric signals, light, and biologics for skin treatment and regeneration. Precise bioelectric signals give clear instructions to the stimulated cell DNA/RNA to produce specific regenerative proteins on demand. Bioelectric signals give clear instructions to cell membranes on what to let in and what to let out and serve as an equivalent or surrogate of environmental stimuli to cause a cell action in response.

title_en: Method of releasing the suppression of egg maturation in economically-important prawn/shrimp species
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for releasing oocyte maturation regulation by suppressing expression of a gene capable of regulating oocyte maturation in shrimps by the RNA interference method. The present invention provides a method for blocking oocyte maturation inhibition in farmed shrimps to be used as spawners (hereafter, “farmed shrimp”), comprising suppressing the expression of a vitellogenesis-inhibiting hormone (VIH) gene in shrimps by RNA interference using double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) targeting mRNA of the vitellogenesis-inhibiting hormone gene in farmed shrimps.

title_en: Process for the synthesis of aromatic dicarboxylic acids

The present invention relates to a separation method for continuously separating a light liquid and a heavy liquid having a specific gravity larger than that of the light liquid from a mixed liquid containing the light liquid, the heavy liquid, and an emulsion liquid of the light liquid and the heavy liquid by introducing the mixed liquid into a separation tank, in which a specific separation layer is used for the separation tank.

The synthesis cassette includes a synthesis module designed to receive reagents and a radioisotope for the synthesis of the radiotracer. An inner connector plate includes at least one inlet, designed to be connected to a radioisotope admission and also to the inlet of the cassette, and an outlet, designed to be connected to a syringe to be filled with the radiotracer and also to the outlet of the cassette. Such a synthesis device can be installed in a facility including, in a confined room, as well as such devices normally arranged in a storage area, a synthesis station, a radioisotope admission, at least one window for communication to the outside, and a manipulator robot.

title_en: Ultra-long acting insulin-Fc fusion proteins and methods of use
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides recombinantly manufactured ultra-long acting insulin-Fc fusion proteins for use in treating canine and feline diabetes. The insulin-Fc fusion proteins comprise an insulin polypeptide linked via a peptide linker to an Fc-fragment of canine or feline origin. Based on the results obtained, creating a treatment that is amenable to low cost manufacturing, exhibits sufficient in vivo bioactivity, displays extended duration of bioactivity, does not induce anti-drug antibodies, and substantially retains is potency over multiple administrations, requires a non-obvious combination of insulin polypeptide, peptide linkers, and species-specific Fc fragment, in addition to selective mutations on one or more of these components. Exemplary ultra-long acting insulin-Fc fusion proteins, polynucleotides encoding these insulin-Fc fusion proteins, and pharmaceutical formulations of exemplary insulin-Fc fusion proteins are provided, in addition to methods of use and preparation.

title_en: Multi-functional composite catalyst materials and methods of synthesizing the catalyst materials

The catalyst support material may include fumed silica, alumina, fumed alumina, fumed titania, or combinations of these. A catalytic activity of the catalytically active compound may be different than a catalytic activity of the preformed catalyst material. The composite catalyst may be catalyst for producing propene from 2-butene and may include a zeolite as the preformed catalyst material and a metal oxide, such as tungsten oxide, as the catalytically active material. A method of making the composite catalyst may include aerosolizing a catalyst precursor mixture that includes a preformed catalyst material, catalyst support precursor, and catalytically active compound precursor, and drying the aerosolized catalyst precursor mixture.

title_en: Process for separation and purification of a dicarboxylic acid containing mixture

The method involves: providing a dicarboxylic acid-containing mixture of which at least 35% of the carboxylic acid content of the mixture is a dicarboxylic acid product of interest; running an extraction of said dicarboxylic acid-containing mixture through a chromatographic column configured with an amphoteric resin, such that the dicarboxylic acid product elutes preferentially from the dicarboxylic acid-containing mixture. In certain embodiments, the dicarboxylic acid product of interest can be a glucaric or gluconic acid product from a mixture of either or both of these with still other carboxylic acids.

Phosphorus-containing compounds may serve as additives to the first electrode, the second electrode and/or the electrolyte, as well as the separator.

title_en: Trans-splicing ribozyme targeting rhodopsin transcript and uses thereof
abstract_en: A trans-splicing ribozyme capable of splicing a rhodopsin transcript at a target splicing site and containing a sequence that is capable of complementarily binding to a target binding site of the rhodopsin transcript is disclosed. The trans-splicing ribozyme may further containing a desired rhodopsin transcript at 3′-end. The trans-splicing ribozyme may further contains an antisense sequence that is complementary to a region downstream the target binding site of the rhodopsin transcript. A nucleotide molecule encoding the trans-splicing ribozyme is also disclosed. Delivery systems to delivery the nucleotide molecule and/or the trans-splicing ribozyme to target tissue or cells as well as uses of the trans-splicing ribozyme, the nucleotide molecule, delivery systems, or pharmaceutical compositions containing any of them are also disclosed.

title_en: Process and apparatus for regenerating catalyst with supplemental fuel
abstract_en: Higher temperature regenerated dehydrogenation catalyst is mixed with the lower temperature spent dehydrogenation catalyst from a dehydrogenation reaction to heat the spent catalyst. Air or other oxygen containing gas may be introduced to facilitate mixing. The mixing of hot regenerated catalyst with cooler spent catalyst increases the temperature of the spent catalyst and makes the coke on catalyst and in the supplemental fuel gas instantly ready to combust without the delay necessary to heat up the spent catalyst to combustion temperature. The regenerated dehydrogenation catalyst may be mixed with the spent dehydrogenation catalyst before the mixture of catalyst is contacted with the supplemental fuel gas. Combustion with fuel gas should be conditioned to avoid generation of a flame.

title_en: Hair compositions providing improved in-use wet feel
abstract_en: A hair care composition providing improved in-use wet feel. title_en: Substituted imidazo[4,5-b]pyridines, imidazo[4,5-b]pyrazines, and oxazolo[4,5- b]pyrazines as mitochondrial uncouplers
abstract_en: The disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I-A) and (I-B) and the pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The variables, R, R 2 , R 3 , X 1 , X 2 , X 3 , Y 1 , Y, and Z are defined herein. Certain compounds of Formula (I-A) and (I-B) act as selective mitochondrial protonophore uncouplers that do not affect plasma membrane potential. These compounds are useful for treating or decreasing the risk of conditions responsive to mitochondrial uncoupling, such as cancer, obesity, type II diabetes, fatty liver disease, insulin resistance, Parkinson's disease, ischemia reperfusion injury, heart failure, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NALFD), and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), Because mitochondrial uncouplers decrease the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which are known to contribute to age-related cell damage, the compounds are useful for increasing lifespan. Compounds and salts of Formulae (I-A) and (I-B) are also useful for regulating glucose homeostasis or insulin action in a patient.

title_en: Kits for analysis using nucleic acid encoding and/or label
abstract_en: Kits and methods of using the kits for analyzing macromolecules, including peptides, polypeptides, and proteins, employing nucleic acid encoding are disclosed. The sample analysis kits employ nucleic acid encoding and/or nucleic acid recording of a molecular interaction and/or reaction, such as recognition events (e.g., between an antigen and an antibody, between a modified terminal amino acid residue, or between a small molecule or peptide therapeutic and a target, etc.). Additional barcoding reagents, such as those for cycle-specific barcoding (e.g., “clocking”), compartment barcoding, combinatorial barcoding, spatial barcoding, or any combination thereof, may be included in the kits. The sample may comprise macromolecules, including peptides, polypeptides, and proteins, and the recording may generate molecular interaction and/or reaction information, and/or polypeptide sequence information. The kits may be used in high-throughput, multiplexed, and/or automated analysis, and are suitable for analysis of a proteome or subset thereof.

title_en: Methods and compositions for modulating splicing
abstract_en: Described herein are small molecule splicing modulator compounds that modulate splicing of mRNA, such as pre-mRNA, encoded by genes, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same, and methods of use of the small molecule splicing modulator compounds for modulating splicing and treating diseases and conditions.

title_en: Process for preparing isoindolinone derivative, novel intermediates used for the process, and a process for preparing the intermediates
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing an isoindolinone derivative represented by Formula 1, novel intermediates used for the process and a process for preparing the intermediates.

title_en: Method for producing ethylene oxide
abstract_en: A method for producing ethylene oxide includes an ethylene oxide generation step 1 in which a first mixture containing ethylene oxide is obtained by causing ethylene and oxygen to react in presence of a diluent gas; a gas-liquid separation step 2 in which the first mixture is gas-liquid separated into a second mixture containing ethylene, oxygen, and carbon dioxide and a third mixture containing ethylene oxide and water; a carbon dioxide separation step 3 in which carbon dioxide is separated from the second mixture; and an electrolytic reduction step 4 in which the carbon dioxide is electrolytically reduced to obtain a fourth mixture containing ethylene, methane, and carbon dioxide and to obtain oxygen. In the carbon dioxide separation step, carbon dioxide is separated from the fourth mixture. In the ethylene oxide generation step, the second mixture and the fourth mixture, from which carbon dioxide has been removed, and the oxygen obtained in the electrolytic reduction step are used as raw material and a diluent gas.

title_en: Crystalline salts of a plasma kallikrein inhibitor
abstract_en: Disclosed are crystalline salts of Compound I, methods of preparing them, and related pharmaceutical preparations thereof. Also disclosed are methods of treatment using the crystalline salts of the invention.

title_en: Chemokine CXCR4 receptor modulators and uses related thereto
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to chemokine CXCR4 receptor modulators and uses related thereto. The receptor modulators can be formulated to form pharmaceutical compositions comprising the disclosed compounds or pharmaceutically acceptable salts or prodrugs thereof. The compositions may be used for managing CXCR4 related conditions, typically prevention or treatment of viral infections abnormal cellular proliferation, retinal degeneration, inflammatory diseases, or as an immunostimulant or immunosuppressant or for managing cancer and may be administered with another active ingredient such as an antiviral agent or chemotherapeutic agent.

title_en: Integrin targeting ligands and uses thereof
abstract_en: Compounds having affinity for integrins, the synthesis of these compounds, and the use of these compounds as ligands to facilitate the delivery of cargo molecules to cells expressing integrins are described. The described integrin targeting ligands have serum stability and affinity for αvβ3 integrin and/or αvβ5 integrin, and are suitable for conjugation to cargo molecules, such as such as oligonucleotide-based therapeutic agents (e.g., RNAi agents), to facilitate delivery of the cargo molecules to cells and tissues, such as tumor cells, that express integrin αvβ3, integrin αvβ5, or both integrin αvβ3 and integrin αvβ5. Compositions that include integrin targeting ligands and methods of use are also described.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent materials and devices
abstract_en: A mixture of carbazole and triazine derivatives that can be thermally evaporated from one crucible to fabricate thin films for electroluminescent devices is disclosed.

title_en: Curcuminoids, analogs thereof, and methods of making the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides compounds including curcuminoids and analogs thereof, as well as methods of making the same. In various aspects, the method of making the compounds is free of added solvents.

title_en: Flexible production of benzene and derivatives thereof via oligomerization of ethylene
abstract_en: Disclosed is oligomerization of ethylene to form 1-hexene in combination with aromatization of the 1-hexene formed by oligomerization, to form benzene.

title_en: Method of synthesizing a molecular sieve of MWW framework type
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of synthesizing a molecular sieve of MWW framework type, and molecular sieves so synthesized. The method comprises preparing a synthesis mixture for forming a molecular sieve of MWW framework type, said synthesis mixture comprising water, a silicon source, a source of a trivalent element X, a structure directing agent R, a source of alkali or alkaline earth metal cation M, and a source of poly(diallyldimethyl ammonium) cation (PDDA).

title_en: Non-surgical prevention of boar taint and aggressive behavior
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a pharmaceutical intervention in the neonatal pig that inhibits and delays development and activation of the HPG axis, growth of the boar testis and inhibits testicular production of testosterone and androstenone, which prevents the development of aggressive behavior in the maturing boars and the presence of boar taint in the meat. The invention comprises treatment with a combination of an androgen and an estrogen in the newborn male piglet using extended drug delivery methods, with a defined duration of no more than 12 weeks, for the purpose of inhibiting the production of testosterone and androstenone and the accumulation of the boar taint-inducing molecules androstenone and skatole in the fat.

title_en: Electrochemical apparatus and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: An electrochemical apparatus, including a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and an electrolyte. The negative electrode includes a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode active substance layer formed on the negative electrode current collector. The negative electrode current collector has a high tensile strength and the negative electrode active substance layer has a specific weight. The electrochemical apparatus has improved high-temperature storage expansion performance and cyclic expansion performance.

title_en: Process for the diastereomerically pure preparation of DL/LD-methionylmethionine
abstract_en: The invention relates in particular to a process for the preparation of DL/LD-methionine diketopiperazine (I) characterized in that a DD/LL-methionylmethionine-containing aqueous solution or suspension, which has a pH of 3 to 7, measured using a pH electrode at 20° C., is reacted at a temperature of 150 to 220° C., preferably at 170 to 210° C., until an aqueous solution or suspension has formed containing at least a proportion of 30 mol %, preferably 50 mol %, especially 60 mol % of DL/LD-methionine diketopiperazine, based on the total content of DL/LD- and DD/LL-methionine diketopiperazine in the reaction mixture. This process forms part of an overall process for the preparation of DL/LD-methionylmethionine, which is obtained by hydrolysis from the DL/LD-methionine diketopiperazine (I) produced initially.

title_en: Water-dispersible polyisocyanate, aqueous polyurethane resin composition, and article
abstract_en: A water-dispersible polyisocyanate contains an isocyanate group and a sulfone group. The water-dispersible polyisocyanate contains a reaction product of a polyisocyanate component and a hydrophilic active hydrogen component. The polyisocyanate component contains a bis(isocyanatomethyl)cyclohexane derivative. The hydrophilic active hydrogen component contains a sulfone group-containing active hydrogen compound. The bis(isocyanatomethyl)cyclohexane derivative contains an allophanate derivative and an isocyanurate derivative. The allophanate derivative is contained in an amount of 25% by mass or more and 75% by mass or less relative to the total amount of the allophanate derivative and the isocyanurate derivative.

title_en: Method for preparing bio-based 1,4-butanediol
abstract_en: A method for preparing bio-based 1,4-butanediol (BDO) is provided, including: mixing succinic acid from a bio-based source and an alcohol compound to obtain a mixture, and subjecting the mixture to esterification to obtain an oligomer polyester; subjecting the oligomer polyester to hydrogenation reduction in the presence of a catalyst to obtain a 1,4-BDO crude product; and purifying the 1,4-BDO crude product to obtain the bio-based 1,4-BDO.

title_en: Alkyne compound and arthropod pest control composition containing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound that have excellent harmful arthropod controlling effects, the compounds being represented by formula (I) [wherein R represents a C1-C6 chain hydrocarbon group etc., X represents a C1-C4 chain hydrocarbon group etc., G represents a C1-C4 chain hydrocarbon group etc., and n is 0, 1, 2, or 3], as well as a composition for controlling harmful arthropod comprising the same, and a method for controlling harmful arthropod comprising applying the same.

title_en: Method for producing polyfunctional sulfur-containing epoxy compound
abstract_en: The present invention makes it possible to provide a method for producing a polyfunctional sulfur-containing epoxy compound, the method being characterized in that a polyfunctional thiol is reacted with an epihalohydrin in the presence of a reducing agent to form a polyfunctional sulfur-containing halohydrin, which is then reacted with a basic compound. The reducing agent is preferably at least one selected from the group consisting of sodium borohydride, lithium borohydride, lithium aluminum hydride, diisobutylaluminum hydride, and hydrazine.

title_en: Composition of matter for use in organic light-emitting diodes
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to compounds of Formula (I), (II), or (III) as compounds capable of emitting delayed fluorescence, and uses of the compounds in organic light-emitting diodes.

title_en: Catalyst for converting ester to amide using hydroxyl group as orientation group
abstract_en: Provided is a method for amidating a hydroxy ester compound at a high chemical selectivity. The amidation reaction method for a hydroxy ester compound comprises, in the presence of a catalyst containing a compound of a transition metal of the group 4 or group 5 in the periodic table, reacting at least one kind of hydroxy ester compound selected from the group consisting of an α-hydroxy ester compound, a β-hydroxy ester compound, a γ-hydroxy ester compound and a δ-hydroxy ester compound with an amino compound so as to amidate an ester group having a hydroxyl group at the α-, β-, γ- or δ-position of the hydroxy ester compound.

title_en: Synthesising  a molecular magnetic material
abstract_en: A method for synthesising a molecular magnetic material from a paramagnetic reactant including a d-electron metal in a paramagnetic form, a diamagnetic reactant comprising a d-electron metal in a diamagnetic form, and at least one donor of cyanide (CN—) ligands being a separate compound and/or contained in the paramagnetic reactant and/or in the diamagnetic reactant.

title_en: OX2R Compounds
abstract_en: Methods and compositions for agonizing a type-2 orexin receptor (OX2R) in a cell determined to be in need thereof, including the general method of (a) administering to a subject a cyclic guanidinyl OX2R agonist and (b) detecting a resultant enhanced wakefulness or increased resistance to diet-induced accumulation of body fat, or abbreviated recovery from general anesthesia or jet lag.

title_en: Light-Emitting Element, Display Device, Electronic Device, and Lighting Device
abstract_en: To provide a light-emitting element with high emission efficiency and low driving voltage. The light-emitting element includes a guest material and a host material. A LUMO level of the guest material is lower than a LUMO level of the host material. An energy difference between the LUMO level and a HOMO level of the guest material is larger than an energy difference between the LUMO level and a HOMO level of the host material. The guest material has a function of converting triplet excitation energy into light emission. An energy difference between the LUMO level of the guest material and the HOMO level of the host material is larger than or equal to energy of light emission of the guest material.

title_en: Methods for producing tertiary amine catalysts and uses of such
abstract_en: Method for producing a tertiary amine catalyst comprising reacting a first tertiary amine having two or three hydroxyl moieties and a second tertiary amine having a halogen moiety. Also a method for producing tertiary amine catalysts comprising reacting a tertiary amine having at least two halogen moieties and either (i) a tertiary amine having at least one hydroxyl moiety, or (ii) a heterocyclic compound comprising an amine and an ether functional group.

title_en: Herbicides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to herbicidally active pyridino-/pyrimidino-pyridine derivatives. The invention further provides processes and intermediates used for the preparation of such derivatives. The invention further extends to herbicidal compositions comprising such derivatives, as well as to the use of such compounds and compositions in controlling undesirable plant growth: in particular the use in controlling weeds, in crops of useful plants.

title_en: Method and catalyst for producing alcohol
abstract_en: An alcohol production method in which an alcohol is produced from a carbonyl compound, the method including producing an alcohol by using a catalyst, the catalyst including a metal component including rhenium having an average valence of 4 or less and a carrier supporting the metal component, the carrier including zirconium oxide. A catalyst for producing an alcohol by hydrogenation of a carbonyl compound, the catalyst including a carrier including zirconium oxide and a metal component supported on the carrier, the metal component including rhenium having an average valence of 4 or less.

title_en: Triaryl phosphine ligands, preparation method therefor, and use in catalysing coupling reactions
abstract_en: Provided are triaryl phosphine ligands, as shown in general formulae Ia and Ib, or a mixture thereof, and a preparation method therefor. The invention addresses the deficiencies of biaryl phosphine ligands invented by Buchwald et al. Also provided are a triaryl phosphine coordinated palladium complex, a system composed of triaryl phosphine ligand and a palladium salt or complex, and a use of the triaryl phosphine coordinated palladium complex in catalysing organic reactions, in particular a use in catalysis of coupling reactions involving (pseudo)halogenated aromatic hydrocarbon as substrate.

title_en: Purification of 1,4-bis (4-phenoxybenzoyl)benzene by centrifugal filtration
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing 1,4-bis(4-phenoxybenzoyl)benzene, including: reacting terephthaloyl chloride with diphenyl ether in a reaction solvent and in the presence of a Lewis acid, so as to obtain a product mixture comprising a 1,4-bis(4-phenoxybenzoyl)benzene-Lewis acid complex; putting the product mixture in contact with a protic solvent, so as to obtain a first phase containing the Lewis acid and a second phase containing 1,4-bis(4-phenoxybenzoyl)benzene; subjecting at least the second phase to a solid/liquid separation step by centrifugal filtration, so as to recover solid 1,4-bis(4-phenoxybenzoyl)benzene.

title_en: Concentrated personal cleansing compositions and methods
abstract_en: Methods for enhancing fragrance on skin upon initial application of a rinse-off cleansing composition can include combining surfactant, perfume, solvent, and water, to form the composition, wherein the composition has a total GCMS count higher than that of a control where the solvent is replaced with water when the total GCMS count is measured in accordance with the PSHAM method immediately following the initial application.

title_en: Cyclohexyl acid triazole azoles as lpa antagonists
abstract_en: The present invention provides compounds of Formula (I): Formula (I) or a stereoisomer, tautomer, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt or solvate thereof, wherein all the variables are as defined herein. These compounds are selective LPA receptor inhibitors.

title_en: Processes for preparing oligomers
abstract_en: Provided herein are processes for preparing an oligomer (e.g., a morpholino oligomer). The synthetic processes described herein may be advantageous to sealing up oligomer synthesis while maintaining overall yield and parity of a synthesized oligomer.

title_en: Cyclohexane triester based plasticizer composition and resin composition comprising the same
abstract_en: A plasticizer composition which includes a lower non-hybrid-type cyclohexane triester, a lower hybrid-type cyclohexane triester, a higher hybrid-type cyclohexane triester, and a higher non-hybrid-type cyclohexane triester, wherein the alkyl groups of the cyclohexane triesters are a combination of C3-C6 alkyl groups and C7-C10 alkyl groups. When the plasticizer composition is applied to a resin, stress resistance and mechanical properties are maintained at an equivalent level or improved, migration properties, volatile loss characteristics, and plasticization efficiency are balanced, and light resistance and heat resistance are significantly improved.

abstract_en: A resist underlayer composition includes (A) a polymer including a structural unit represented by Chemical Formula 1, a compound represented by Chemical Formula 2, or a combination thereof; (B) a polymer including a structure in which at least one moiety represented by Chemical Formula 3 or Chemical Formula 4 and a moiety represented by Chemical Formula 7 are bound to each other; and (C) a solvent:

title_en: Pain treating compounds and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds useful in the modulation of ion channel activity in cells. The invention also relates to use of these compounds in the treatment of pain, and pharmaceutical compositions containing these compounds and methods for their preparation.

title_en: Detergent Composition With Catechol Metal Complex Compound
abstract_en:
Catechol metal complex compounds of formula (I) 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     are colored and can be used to give color to surfactant compositions. Detergents containing these catechol metal complex compounds do not stain the textile even after repeated use.

title_en: Method for preparing 2-[(3r)-3-methylmorpholin-4-yl]-4-[1-methyl-1h-pyrazol-5-yl)-8-(1h-pyrazol-5-yl)-1,7-naphthyridine
abstract_en: The present invention covers a method for preparing 2-[(3R)-3-methylmorpholin-4-yl]-4-(1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl)-8-(1H-pyrazol-5-yl)-1,7-naphthyridine (“the compound of formula (I)” in the following) as well as intermediate compounds useful in the preparation of the compound of formula (I). The present invention also covers polymorphic form B of the compound of formula (I) with very high purity.

title_en: Aminomethylamidine and methylamidine antimicrobial compounds
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to the field of antimicrobial compounds and to methods of making and using them. In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-2-ones useful for treating, preventing, reducing the risk of, and delaying the onset of microbial infections in humans and animals.

title_en: Cold manufactured oxidative hair lightening or hair coloring composition for level 2 colors
abstract_en: The subject matter of the present disclosure are agents for oxidative hair lightening or hair coloring, containing from about 70-90% by weight of a total of % of water, alkalizing agent, optionally a colorant, and a certain mixture of a cross-linked copolymer of acrylic acid and non-ethoxylated esters of acrylic acid with linear C10-C30 monoalcohols, anionic surfactant and linear, saturated C8-C22 alkan-1-ol, and sodium polyacrylate, whereby the brightening or coloring agent obtains an application-technically optimal viscosity and the consistency of a gel-like cream with an excellent haptics.

title_en: Methods for the epigenetic analysis of dna, particularly cell-free dna
abstract_en: Methods are provided for the epigenetic analysis of cell-free DNA using organic boranes to convert oxidized 5-methylcytosine residues in the cell-free DNA to dihydrouracil (DHU) residues. Cell-free DNA is contacted with an organic borane selected to successively bring about reduction, deamination, and decarboxylation of oxidized 5-methylcytosine residues such as 5-carboxylcytosine and 5-formylcytosine, resulting in DHU residues in place thereof. Following amplification, the treated cell-free DNA is sequenced, with the DHU residues read as thymine residues. Reaction mixtures, kits and additional methods are also provided, as are related methods for the epigenetic analysis of DNA, including cell-free DNA.

title_en: Novel galactoside inhibitor of galectins
abstract_en: An α-D-galactopyranose compound of the general formula (1). The α-D-galactopyranose compound of formula (1) is suitable for use in a method for treating a disorder relating to the binding of a galectin, such as galectin-1 to a ligand in a mammal, such as a human. Furthermore, a method for treatment of a disorder relating to the binding of a galectin, such as galectin-1 to a ligand in a mammal, such as a human.

title_en: (4-hydroxypyrrolidin-2-yl)-heterocyclic compounds and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to bifunctional compounds, which can be used as modulators of targeted ubiquitination. In particular, the present disclosure is directed to compounds which contain on one end a VHL ligand moiety, which binds to the VHL E3 ubiquitin ligase, and on the other end a moiety that binds a target protein such that degradation of the target protein/polypeptide is effectuated. Also disclosed are VHL ligands.

title_en: Method to produce c4 olefins from natural gas-derived acetylene
abstract_en: In accordance with the purpose(s) of the present disclosure, as embodied and broadly described herein, the disclosure relates to a method for producing C 4  olefins from acetylene using supported metal-based catalysts and metal-based promoters. The method is inexpensive, efficient, and environmentally sound. Additionally, the method is selective for C 4  olefins and other value-added products based on changes to reaction parameters including temperature, feed gas composition, and promoter identity. This abstract is intended as a scanning tool for purposes of searching in the particular art and is not intended to be limiting of the present disclosure.

title_en: Hydrophilic linkers for antibody drug conjugates
abstract_en: Described herein protein drug conjugates and compositions thereof that are useful, for example, for the target-specific delivery of drugs to cells. By administering these compounds, compositions, and conjugates as described herein to specific target cells, side-effects due to non-specific binding phenomena, for example, to non-target cells are reduced. In certain embodiments, compounds, compositions, and conjugates are provided, which include hydrophilic residues in linker-payloads and protein conjugates thereof.

title_en: Aminopyridine compounds and methods for the preparation and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to therapeutics targeting the bacterium  Porphyromonas gingivalis , including its proteases arginine gingipain A/B (Rgp), and their use for the treatment of disorders associated with  P. gingivalis  infection, including brain disorders such as Alzheimer's disease. In certain embodiments, the invention provides compounds according to Formula I and Formula III, as described herein, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

title_en: Cycloolefin substituted heteroaromatic compounds and their use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound of formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and/or solvates, racemic mixtures, enantiomers, diasteromers, and tautomers thereof, wherein A, R 1 , R 2 , R 3 , R 3 ′, R 4 , R 4 ′, R 5 , R 6 , R 7 , R 8 , m, and n are as defined in the detailed description of the invention.

title_en: Cell-stored barcoded deep mutational scanning libraries and uses of the same
abstract_en: Cell-stored barcoded viral protein deep mutational scanning libraries are described. The libraries can be used to map resistance mutations to therapeutic treatments. The libraries can be used to predict viruses that become resistant to therapeutic compounds and/or may more easily evolve to infect new species. The libraries can also be used to more safely study dangerous viruses that normally require high safety biocontainment facilities. The libraries include features that allow efficient collection and assessment of informative data, obviating many bottlenecks of previous approaches.

title_en: Hormone receptor modulators for treating metabolic mutagenic and fibrotic conditions and disorders
abstract_en: The invention relates to activators of FXR useful in the treatment of autoimmune disorders, liver disease, intestinal disease, kidney disease, cancer, and other diseases in which FXR plays a role, having the Formula (I): wherein L 1 , A, X 1 , X 2 , Y 1 , Y 2 , Y 3 , Y 4 , R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  are described herein.
