title_en: Method for stimulating the growth of a cell
abstract_en: A method for stimulating the growth of a cell comprising contacting the cell with a composition comprising an isolated lens epidermal dermal growth factor.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis strain and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Bacillus subtilis ID-A05 strain and a composition including same, and more specifically, to: a novel Bacillus subtilis strain effective for both treating cavities and periodontal diseases and alleviating halitosis; a culture medium of the Bacillus subtilis strain; a culture supernatant of the Bacillus subtilis strain; a pharmaceutical composition for treating cavities and periodontal diseases, the pharmaceutical composition containing, as an active ingredient, the Bacillus subtilis strain or a culture medium or culture supernatant thereof; a quasi-drug composition for preventing or alleviating cavities, periodontal diseases, and halitosis, the quasi-drug composition containing, as an active ingredient, the Bacillus subtilis strain or a culture medium or culture supernatant thereof; a health functional food composition; and a food composition.

title_en: A cell culture system controller
abstract_en: A cell culture system controller for controlling the environment of a cell culture system, the controller configured to receive intrauterine data and adjust an environmental parameter of a cell culture system environment over a period of time based on the intrauterine data.

title_en: Gene specific spatial rolling circle amplification and ngs sequencing
abstract_en: The invention is directed to a method to simultaneously obtain both the spatial location and sequence information of a target sequence with a higher resolution than the known technologies. The method comprises steps to spatially localize the mRNA  expressed on a tissue by the use of a hybrid circular/linear DNA probe with an UMI and ¨  after several amplification steps, the obtaining sequence information by NGS.

title_en: T cell recruiting polypeptides based on tcr alpha/beta reactivity
abstract_en: The present technology provides T cell recruiting polypeptides that specifically bind to the constant domain of a human and of a non-human primate TCR. The present technology also provides nucleic acids, vectors, and compositions. The polypeptides can be used in methods for treatment of cancer.

title_en: Genetically modified hepatocyte populations
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides populations of genetically modified hepatocytes and/or hepatocyte progenitors and methods of producing the same. Methods of using said populations of genetically modified hepatocytes and/or progenitors, such as, but not limited to, treating a subject or a plurality of subjects for a condition or a plurality of conditions, are also provided. In some instances, genetically modified hepatocytes and/or hepatocyte progenitors of the population are hypoimmunogenic and the methods include methods of generating hypoimmunogenic hepatocytes and/or progenitors thereof. Non-human mammals containing engrafted populations of genetically modified hepatocytes and/or hepatocyte progenitors are also provided. Useful kits, systems, reagents, cells, and cell therapy doses are also provided.

title_en: Gip and glp-1 dual receptor agonist, pharmaceutical composition, and use
abstract_en: A GIP and GLP-1 dual receptor agonist, a pharmaceutical composition, and the use. In particular, the present application relates to a compound represented by formula I, a pharmaceutical composition comprising the compound, and the use of the compound as a GIP and GLP-1 dual receptor agonist in the field of medicine. The compound represented by formula I exhibits excellent GIPR and GLP-1R agonist activity and excellent pharmaceutical activity in reducing blood sugar and controlling body weight, is a therapeutic drug having a clinical application prospect, and can be used for preventing and treating diseases such as diabetes, diabetes complications, obesity, or obesity complications.

title_en: System and method to recycle the water and ammonia and optionally other cell media nutrients for a power-to-gas plant in biological methanation utilizing biocatalyst (methanogen)
abstract_en: The present invention refers to a method to convert H2 and CO2 into methane by methanogenic microorganisms in a bioreactor in a continuous production process for methane enriched gas compositions, while recycling of at least one ammonia compound and/or recycling of electrons, wherein water (H20) serves as the carrier for electrons. Metabolic water is removed to keep concentrations constant and purified for feeding to electrolyzer to generate hydrogen for supply to methanation reaction to reduce need for freshwater and ammonia to be supplied.

title_en: Bispecific antibody specifically binding to cd47 and pd-l1
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bispecific antibody. Having high binding affinity tumor cells expressing PD-L1 and/or CD47, the bispecific antibody of the present invention exhibits an excellent anti-tumoral effect with minimal side effects of hemagglutination.

title_en: Method of treating inflammatory bowel disease with a combination therapy of antibodies to il-23 and tnf alpha
abstract_en: A method of treating inflammatory bowel disorders, such as ulcerative colitis, comprises administering an IL-23 inhibitor, such as an anti-IL-23p19 antibody (e.g., guselkumab) and a TNFa inhibitor, such as an anti-TNFa antibody (e.g., golimumab).

title_en: Neuro-mesenchyme units control ilc2 and obesity via a brain-adipose circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a neuro-mesenchyme signaling axis that controls group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s), adipose tissue physiology, metabolism, and obesity. This signaling axis includes ILC2s with rearranged during transfection (RET) receptor, mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) with beta- 2 adrenergic receptor (ADRB2), and high- order brain areas including the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVH).

title_en: Plant regulatory elements and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides recombinant DNA molecules and constructs, as well as their nucleotide sequences, useful for modulating gene expression in plants. The invention also provides transgenic plants, plant cells, plant parts, and seeds comprising the recombinant DNA molecules operably linked to heterologous transcribable DNA molecules. Also provided are methods of the use of the recombinant DNA molecules and constructs and the transgenic plants, plant cells, plant parts, and seeds comprising the recombinant DNA molecules and constructs.

title_en: Methods for improving floret fertility and seed yield
abstract_en: This invention relates to compositions and methods for modifying Short Internodes (SHI) transcription factors that regulate floret fertility, seed number, and/or seed weight in plants.

title_en: Methods of producing and using human hepatocytes and related compositions
abstract_en: Provided are isolated expanded human hepatocytes and methods of producing isolated expanded human hepatocytes. In certain embodiments, the methods comprise introducing human hepatocytes into the liver of a non-human in vivo bioreactor, expanding the human hepatocytes in the liver of the non-human in vivo bioreactor, and collecting hepatocytes from the liver of the non-human in vivo bioreactor. The collected hepatocytes comprise a xenomixture of expanded human hepatocytes and non-human in vivo bioreactor cells, including hepatocytes endogenous to the in vivo bioreactor. Such methods may further comprise subjecting the xenomixture to centrifugal elutriation under conditions sufficient to produce an elutriation fraction enriched for the expanded human hepatocytes, and/or removing non-human in vivo bioreactor cells from the elutriation fraction via a negative selection process. Also provided are isolated expanded human hepatocytes produced according to such methods. Centrifugal elutriation- and negative selection-based methods of enriching for human hepatocytes in a xenomixture, and certain compositions useful in such methods, are also provided.

title_en: Humanized mouse models
abstract_en: The human immune system is complex, and its related diseases are similarly complicated. Therefore, human diseases, such as cancers, are often difficult to characterize and treat effectively. Immunodeficient transgenic mice for use as humanized mouse models are provided. The humanized mouse models may be further engrafted with diseased tissues or cells (e.g., human cancer cells). Methods of using the humanized mouse models to assess disease progression, immune response, and efficacy of proposed therapeutic agents are also provided herein.

title_en: Direct production of sirnas in saccharomyces boulardii and packaging in extracellular vesicles (evs) for targeted gene silencing
abstract_en: The present invention is direct to the direct expression of siRNA molecules in yeast, which can be packaged into extracellular vesicles (EVs) and delivered to a target organism causing the downregulation of a select gene.

title_en: Use of dried sodium hydroxide to denaturate double stranded dna
abstract_en: This application relates to methods of denaturing double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). In some examples, the methods utilize dried sodium hydroxide. In some examples, the method includes loading dsDNA into a first portion of a cartridge, wherein the second portion of the cartridge contains sodium hydroxide in a dry form; and mixing the dsDNA with the sodium hydroxide, thereby denaturing the dsDNA.

title_en: Gene therapy
abstract_en: Use of a combination of (a) cyclosporin H (CsH) or a derivative thereof, and (b) a p53 inhibitor and/or an adenoviral protein, or one or more nucleotide sequences encoding therefor, for increasing the efficiency of gene editing of an isolated population of cells when transduced by a viral vector and/or increasing the efficiency of transduction of an isolated population of cells by a viral vector.

title_en: Compositions and methods of modulating long noncoding transcripts associated with ards induced pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: Provided herein are modulators of a long noncoding transcript, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the modulator, and kits comprising the modulator. Also provided herein are methods of modulating a long noncoding transcript in a subject in need thereof. Further provided here are methods of preventing, alleviating, or treating pulmonary fibrosis or inflammation induced or associated with ARDS in a subject in need thereof.

title_en: 5t4 binding agents and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides 5T4 binding agents (e.g., antibodies, including multispecific antibodies such as bispecific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates) and uses thereof.

title_en: Combination therapies with an anti-factor xi/factor xia antibody
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to dosage regimens for combination therapies comprising anti-Factor XI and/or activated Factor XI (Factor XIa) antibodies, or antigen-binding fragments thereof, e.g., for use in the treatment of thromboembolic disorders or related conditions.

title_en: Transgenic banana plants having increased resistance to fusarium oxysporum tropical race 4 and methods of producing same
abstract_en: ABSTRACT The present disclosure provides compositions and methods for producing transgenic banana plants that exhibit increased resistance to Fusarium oxysporumf.sp. cubense Tropical Race 4 (TR4), and the banana plants and bananas so produced.

title_en: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR IN VIVO DUAL RECOMBINASE-MEDIATED CASSETTE EXCHANGE (dRMCE) AND DISEASE MODELS THEREOF
abstract_en: Described herein are donor vectors and systems for use in in vivo dual recombinase- mediated cassette exchange. Also described are animal models for consistent, rigorous, and facile investigation of transgene expression. Further described are methods of screening for therapeutic drugs using these animal models, and methods of treatment.

title_en: System and method for centralized fluid management and culture control
abstract_en: System and method for providing biocompatible, nutrient filled media to the Human Cells, Tissues, and cellular and tissue-based Products (HCT/P) while removing wastes. The present teachings provide for sensing the characteristics of the media, and modifying the characteristics when necessary. The present teachings can also provide components that can provide fluid pumping integrated with fluid gas exchange, and sensing of fluid characteristics at consistent times during the fluid flow cycle. System and method control multiple bioreactors from a centralized media reservoir, while fluidically isolating the bioreactors from cross-contamination.

title_en: Method for detecting embryo chromosome abnormality by using blastocyst culture solution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting embryo chromosome abnormality by using a blastocyst culture solution, which detects free DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid) of an embryo source from an embryo early-stage in-vitro culture solution, namely the blastocyst culture solution, performs uniform whole genome amplification on trace DNA, and analyzes the amplified DNA product by using methods such as second-generation sequencing and the like so as to judge whether the chromosome condition of the embryo, namely whether integral or local aneuploidy of chromosomes occurs or not. The invention selects the blastula culture solution which is the waste in the extra-embryonic-body culture stage in the in-vitro fertilization operation process as the detection sample, and the noninvasive method avoids the cell damage to the embryo caused by the conventional blastomere biopsy or the blastula trophoblast cell biopsy during sampling, does not add extra trouble to clinic, simplifies the operation during sample acquisition, and has higher safety reliability and simplicity.

title_en: Biotin variants, streptavidin mutants and uses thereof
abstract_en: The subject of the invention is: providing a streptavidin mutant having a reduced affinity for native biotin; also provided are biotin variants having high affinity for streptavidin mutants having low affinity for the native biotin. According to the present invention, compounds composed of biotin variant dimers, streptavidin mutants, and uses thereof are provided.

title_en: Culture medium suitable for growth of ustilaginoidea virens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a culture medium suitable for growth of ustilaginoidea virens, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0.1-5% of cane sugar, 0.1-5% of peptone, 0.1-1% of gellan gum and Mg 2+ 0.02 to 0.1 percent of the total weight of the composition and the balance of water. Adding trace amount of inorganic salts such as potassium dihydrogen diphosphate, sodium chloride, ferrous sulfate, sodium molybdate, manganese sulfate and calcium carbonate into the culture medium to obtain culture medium suitable for growth of Ustilaginoidea virens.

title_en: Antibodies comprising modified heavy chain constant regions
abstract_en: Provided herein are heavy chain constant regions (referred to as "modified heavy chain constant regions") or functionally equivalent fragments thereof that enhance the biological properties of an antibody relative to an unmodified form of the same antibody. One exemplary modified heavy chain constant region includes an IgG2 hinge and three constant domains (i.e., CH1, CH2, and CH3 domains), wherein one or more constant regions are of a non-IgG 2 isotype (e.g., IgG1, IgG3, or IgG 4). The heavy chain constant region may comprise wild-type human IgG domain sequences or variants of these sequences. Also provided herein are methods for enhancing some biological properties of an antibody comprising a non-IgG 2 hinge, such as internalization, agonism, and antagonism, wherein the methods comprise replacing the non-IgG 2 hinge of the antibody with an IgG2 hinge.

title_en: Preparation method of homoarginine mixed peptide and application of homoarginine mixed peptide in treatment of gastric cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mixed peptide with high arginine content and application thereof in treating gastric cancer. The preparation method comprises the following steps: pretreating the walnut pulp and egg white protein suspension by using ultrahigh pressure, and then performing stepwise enzymolysis on pretreated products by using alkaline protease and papain under the auxiliary action of ultrasonic waves and microwaves; separating the target mixed peptide in the clear liquid after the enzymolysis liquid is filtered by a reversed-phase high performance liquid chromatography; the mixed peptide is used as a template molecule, acrylic acid and methacrylic acid are used as functional monomers, triethylene glycol dimethacrylate is used as a cross-linking agent, isopropyl thioxanthone is used as an initiator, and ultraviolet initiation polymerization is carried out to form a surface molecularly imprinted membrane which is used for separating and enriching target mixed peptide in enzymolysis clear liquid. The content of arginine in the mixed peptide is more than 18 percent; MTT (methyl thiazolyl tetrazolium) detection shows that the homoarginine mixed peptide can effectively inhibit proliferation of human gastric cancer SGC-7901 cells. The method is helpful for reducing the product cost and accelerating the realization of industrial production.

title_en: Camel blood polypeptide with anti-fatigue effect and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to camel blood polypeptide with an anti-fatigue effect and a preparation method thereof, wherein the content of the camel blood polypeptide product prepared by the invention is more than 80%, and the recovery rate is more than 75%. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method is characterized by providing a preparation process of camel blood polypeptide with anti-fatigue activity; the pretreatment is carried out by using high-temperature steam, so that the temperature rise of a system is accelerated, and the protein can be changed, thereby being beneficial to enzyme digestion; the whole production process uses a green solvent, and has low cost, high efficiency and environmental friendliness; the preparation method is simple, and can provide camel blood polypeptide with anti-fatigue activity for food, health product, medicine, etc.

title_en: Method for producing microbial preparation in which aglycone is accumulated in cell and microbial preparation produced by the method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing aglycone or hydrolyzed glycoside converted from glycoside, and more particularly, to a method for preparing aglycone or hydrolyzed glycoside from glycoside by converting glycoside into aglycone form or hydrolyzed glycoside using a microorganism producing beta-glucosidase and then recovering aglycone or hydrolyzed glycoside accumulated in cells of the microorganism.

title_en: ALK4 ACTRIIB heteromultimers and uses thereof
abstract_en: In certain aspects, the present disclosure provides soluble heteromeric polypeptide complexes comprising an extracellular domain of an ALK4 receptor and an extracellular domain of ActRIIB. In certain aspects, such soluble ALK4: actRIIB complexes may be used to modulate (promote or inhibit) the growth of tissues or cells, including, for example, muscle, bone, cartilage, fat, neural tissue, tumors, and/or cancer cells. In certain aspects, such ALK4: actRIIB complexes are useful for improving muscle formation, bone formation, metabolic parameters, and disorders associated with these tissues, cellular networks, kidneys, and endocrine systems.

title_en: Novel human serum albumin mutants
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a human serum albumin mutant capable of being linked to a physiologically active protein to improve the stability of the protein in blood, and a protein linked thereto. The protein obtained by linking is a human serum albumin mutant comprising an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID No. 3 or an amino acid sequence in which 10 or less amino acid residues are deleted and/or 10 or less amino acid residues are substituted with respect to the amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID No. 3, wherein the 318 th asparagine residue and the 320 th threonine residue at the N-terminus of the amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID No. 3 are bonded to each other through a peptide bond via a single amino acid residue (X) other than proline between the 2 residues, and a physiologically active protein linked thereto.

title_en: External reference for quantitative PCR detection of nucleic acids in plasma
abstract_en: The invention provides an external reference (PLACON) for measuring the content of nucleic acid in blood plasma, a template sequence containing the external reference, a reverse transcription primer, a PCR primer, a detection kit, a using method of the kit and application of the kit in preparation of a product for detecting the nucleic acid in the blood plasma.

title_en: Novel forms of IL33, mutant forms of IL33, antibodies, assays and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides isolated IL-33 proteins, active fragments thereof; and antibodies, antigen-binding fragments thereof, directed against IL-33 protein. Methods of modulating cytokine activity are also provided, for example, for the purpose of treating immune and inflammatory disorders.

title_en: Spatial localization of nucleic acid sequence information
abstract_en: Methods and compositions for spatially detecting and analyzing nucleic acids in a tissue sample are presented. The methods can enable characterization of transcriptomes and/or genomic variations in a tissue while preserving spatial information about the tissue.

title_en: Application of cotton transporter GhBASS5 gene in salt tolerance of plants
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of plant stress resistance research, and particularly relates to a cotton transport protein GhBASS5 The application of the gene in the salt tolerance of plants. The gene is located on chromosome 12, has a full length of 2649bp, comprises 8 exons, 7 introns and a cDNA full length of 1233bp, encodes 411 amino acids and comprises a highly conserved functional structural domain YfeH located at the C end. GhBASS5 The gene is an ion transporter gene, and the main function is dependent on Na + Transport of pyruvate. The ion transport protein is responsible for the absorption, discharge or transport of ions and is an important component of plants responding to salt and drought stress. In general, for cotton GhBASS5 The deep research of the gene can lay a certain theory and application foundation for the new species cultivation of the salt-tolerant cotton plant, and also lay a foundation for the research and application of other salt-tolerant genes.

title_en: Probiotic oligopeptide compound preparation for dispelling effects of alcohol and protecting liver and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probiotic oligopeptide compound preparation for relieving alcoholism and protecting liver and a preparation method thereof, wherein the active ingredients of the compound preparation comprise corn oligopeptide, kudzu root, liquorice and probiotics, and the active ingredients are prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 20-25 parts of corn oligopeptide, 5-15 parts of kudzu root and 5-10 parts of liquorice; each gram of the compound preparation contains 10 9 ～10 11 CFU probiotics; the probiotics at least comprise three bacteria of Lactobacillus plantarum (Lactobacillus plantarum) BLCC2-0015, Lactobacillus rhamnosus (Lactobacillus rhamnosus) BLCC2-0038 and Lactobacillus reuteri (Lactobacillus reuteri) BLCC 2-0032. The preparation composition comprises corn oligopeptide, traditional Chinese medicines and probiotics, wherein the corn oligopeptide contains rich amino acid, can effectively activate the activity of alcohol dehydrogenase in a body, promotes the rapid metabolism of alcohol, and prevents the metabolic load of the liver caused by excessive accumulation.

title_en: Use of pasteurised akkermansia for the treatment of metabolic disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pasteurized akkermansia muciniphila or fragments thereof for use in treating a metabolic disorder in a subject in need thereof. The invention also relates to compositions, pharmaceutical compositions and medicaments comprising pasteurized akkermansia muciniphila or fragments thereof for the treatment of metabolic disorders. The invention also relates to the use of pasteurized akkermansia muciniphila or fragments thereof for promoting weight loss in a subject in need thereof.

title_en: Purple sweet potato anthocyanin synthesis and extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing and extracting anthocyanin in purple sweet potatoes, and particularly relates to a technology for synthesizing and extracting the anthocyanin in the purple sweet potatoes. And (3) adopting high hydrostatic pressure to assist the microorganism to ferment and culture the purple sweet potato cells, and extracting anthocyanin from the purple sweet potatoes by ultrafiltration chromatography. The high hydrostatic pressure is utilized to assist microbial metabolites to damage the cell walls of the purple sweet potato fruits, so that anthocyanin is fully released; meanwhile, enzyme production such as L-phenylalanine and Rhodotorula glutinis are added to promote the synthesis of anthocyanin from unconverted anthocyanin precursor in the purple sweet potato. The fermentation liquor is treated by centrifugation, ultrafiltration separation, chromatography purification, vacuum freeze drying and the like to obtain the anthocyanin with the purity of 96.34 percent, and the extraction amount of the anthocyanin is increased by 15 to 30 percent. The method has the advantages of simple operation, clean and harmless generation process, low cost, high anthocyanin yield, high purity, no need of human intestinal microbial degradation, high medical care value, suitability for large-scale production and application and great market prospect.

title_en: Primary cell extraction equipment and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses primary cell extraction equipment and a using method thereof. The sample mincing zone comprises a tissue mincing device. The operation area comprises a first gate, a heating temperature control device, a rotary fixture, a centrifugal device, a cover opening and closing device, a test tube placing frame and a liquid transferring device; the first gate is adjacent to the sample chopping zone; the heating temperature control device is adjacent to the first gate and is sequentially adjacent to the rotary fixture and the centrifugal device; the switch cover device is adjacent to the first gate, opposite to the heating temperature control device, and is adjacent to the test tube placing frame and the liquid transferring device in sequence. The extraction area comprises a second gate adjacent to the working area. The slide rail device is provided with a trolley which can slide on the slide rail device. The invention can achieve the effects of saving manpower and reducing pollution.

title_en: High intensity sweetener
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are compounds having structural formula (I) or salts thereof. These compounds are useful as sweeteners and/or sweetness enhancers. Also disclosed are compositions comprising the compounds of the application and methods of enhancing the sweetness of ingestible compositions. In addition, methods of preparing the compounds are disclosed.

title_en: Forensic medicine composite detection kit based on 56Y chromosome SNP genetic markers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forensic medicine, and particularly relates to a forensic medicine composite detection kit based on 56Y chromosome SNP genetic markers. The invention solves the technical problem of utilizing the specific SNP genetic marker of the Y chromosome to carry out C, G, H, J, N, R family group identification on Chinese male individual test material and carry out position division on a Y chromosome evolutionary tree so as to carry out family source inference. The technical scheme of the invention is a forensic medicine composite detection kit based on 56Y chromosome SNP genetic markers, which comprises a composite amplification primer mixture and a multiple single-base extension reaction primer mixture which are separately packaged. The kit can obtain the genotyping of 56Y chromosome SNP genetic markers of biological samples at one time by applying composite amplification and single base extension technologies, and correctly belongs C, G, H, J, N, R group samples in Chinese male individuals to the well-known Y chromosome evolutionary tree twigs.

title_en: Preparation method of yeast microcapsule perfume
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of yeast microcapsule perfume, and particularly relates to the field of microcapsule essence perfume, wherein the preparation method of the yeast microcapsule perfume comprises the following steps: the yeast cells are purified firstly, autolysis treatment is carried out on the purified yeast cells by adopting a method combining ultrasonic treatment and sectional temperature treatment, and finally the autolyzed yeast cells and the spice awaken the preparation of capsule spice under the condition of high-pressure aeration.

title_en: High-affinity fusion protein of PD-1 extracellular domain mutant and pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-affinity PD-1 extracellular domain mutant, which comprises an amino acid sequence selected from SEQ ID NO.2, SEQ ID NO.3, SEQ ID NO.4 and SEQ ID NO. 5. The invention further provides a fusion protein of the high-affinity PD-1 extracellular domain mutant and application thereof. The invention creatively synthesizes a high-affinity PD-1 extracellular domain mutant or a fusion protein thereof, and the fusion protein has higher affinity and higher efficacy for binding human PD-L1 or PD-L2 compared with wild type PD-1. The fusion protein of the invention provides a wider approach for the immunotherapy of tumors.

title_en: Breeding method of onion male sterile line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeding method of an onion male sterile line. The breeding method comprises the steps of carrying out protoplast asymmetric fusion by using an onion cytoplasmic male sterile line as a donor and an onion inbred line as a receptor to obtain an onion male sterile line. Experiments prove that 5 onion male sterile lines are bred by using the onion heterogenous cytoplasm male sterile line skiA and the mesogenic red jade by the method provided by the invention, and the 5 onion male sterile lines show different forms from parents: the plant has strong growth vigor, medium sunshine, red bulb skin and no pollen. The breeding method of the onion male sterile line provided by the invention has a short breeding period and has an important application value.

title_en: Host bacterium with endogenous L-asparaginase II gene knocked out, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a host bacterium with an endogenous L-asparaginase II gene knocked out, a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, the invention relates to a method for knocking out an endogenous L-asparaginase II gene of escherichia coli, and a host strain with the gene knocked out is obtained. By means of target vector knockout, the host bacterium genome does not contain genes encoding L-asparaginase II and variants thereof. The host bacteria provided by the invention can be used for recombining and expressing L-asparaginase II and variants thereof from different microorganisms such as Erwinia, Escherichia and the like.

title_en: Thermophilic acidic raw starch alpha-amylase mutant with improved corn starch degradation capability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermophilic acidic raw starch alpha-amylase mutant with improved corn starch degradation capability, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of genetic engineering and enzyme engineering. The invention carries out cyclization rearrangement mutation on SBD structure domain of raw starch alpha-amylase GTamy, and then SBD in GTamy is replaced by SBD cyclization rearrangement mutant to construct GTamy cyclization rearrangement mutant. And screening the raw starch alpha-amylase mutant GTamy-S498 with obviously improved corn starch degradation capacity by comparing the enzyme activity of the GTamy rearrangement mutant on corn starch. The raw starch alpha-amylase mutant GTamy-S498 provided by the invention has the advantage that the enzyme activity on corn starch is improved to 114.77U/mg from 21.08U/mg of a contrast (before mutation), and is improved by 5.44 times. The corn starch degradation capability of the raw starch alpha-amylase mutant GTamy-S498 is obviously improved, and the enzymological properties of the raw starch alpha-amylase mutant meet the requirements of a starch liquefaction process, so that the raw starch alpha-amylase mutant GTamy-S498 is more suitable for the starch liquefaction process.

title_en: Protein and application thereof in preparation of cryptotanshinone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protein and application thereof in preparing cryptotanshinone. The protein disclosed by the invention is named CYP71D375a, and is A1), A2) or A3) as follows: A1) a protein having the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID No. 2; A2) the protein which is obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding one or more amino acid residues to the amino acid sequence shown by SEQ ID No.2 in the sequence table and has the same function; A3) a fusion protein obtained by connecting a label to the N-terminal or/and the C-terminal of A1) or A2). The protein CYP71D375a can catalyze danshenxinone to generate cryptotanshinone, and has important theoretical and practical significance for regulating and producing tanshinone compounds and culturing high-quality salvia miltiorrhiza.

title_en: Establishment of double PCR detection method for chicken parvovirus and chicken newcastle disease virus
abstract_en: The invention discloses establishment of a double PCR detection method for chicken parvovirus and newcastle disease virus. The invention provides a set of primers for identifying chicken parvovirus and chicken newcastle disease virus, which consists of the following primers 1 to 4: the primer 1 is a single-stranded DNA molecule shown in a sequence 1 of a sequence table; the primer 2 is a single-stranded DNA molecule shown in a sequence 2 of a sequence table; the primer 3 is a single-stranded DNA molecule shown in a sequence 3 of a sequence table; the primer 4 is a single-stranded DNA molecule shown in a sequence 4 of a sequence table. The ChPV and NDV double PCR method established by the test can be used for quickly detecting clinical mixed infection of ChPV and NDV, is suitable for large-scale detection, can save cost and time, can reduce pollution, and has high practical value.

title_en: Biocontrol bacterium and application thereof in prevention and control of gummy stem blight of crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biocontrol bacterium and application thereof in prevention and control of gummy stem blight. The biocontrol bacterium CGMCC NO.15764 can effectively prevent and control crop gummy stem blight, particularly has obvious prevention and control effects on gummy stem blight and gummy stem blight, has the effect of promoting growth of watermelons and melons, and can be applied to prevention and control of gummy stem blight and planting of watermelons and melons; moreover, compared with the chemical agents in the prior art, the biocontrol bacterium is nontoxic to human and livestock, does not pollute the environment, has no residue, and is beneficial to the sustainable development of ecological environment.

title_en: 1, 1-dihydroxymethyl-tetrahydro-beta-carboline-3-formyl-GGPRP, and synthesis, activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses (3S) -1, 1-dihydroxymethyl-tetrahydro-beta-carboline-3-formyl-Gly-Gly-Pro-Arg-Pro, a preparation method thereof, anti-arterial thrombosis activity thereof, anti-venous thrombosis activity thereof, GPIIb/IIIa expression inhibition activity thereof and P-selectin expression inhibition activity thereof. Therefore, the invention discloses the application of the derivative in preparing anti-arterial thrombosis medicaments, anti-venous thrombosis medicaments, GPIIb/IIIa antagonists and P-selectin antagonists.

title_en: Method for measuring and calculating cell density in physiological environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring and calculating cell density in a physiological environment, wherein a holographic optical tweezers technology is adopted to control cells, a microfluidic system ensures that the conductivity and dielectric constant of a liquid dielectric medium are suitable for the requirements of the conductivity and dielectric constant of a culture solution in the physiological environment of the cells, and the measurement and calculation of the quality and density of living unicells in the physiological environment are realized. The cell rotation is controlled through the holographic optical tweezers technology, the radius of three axial directions of the cell is obtained by using the microscopic vision method, and the cell volume estimation is realized, so that the measurement and calculation of the viscous resistance of the cell are more accurate, and the precision of the measurement and calculation of the cell density is improved. The holographic optical tweezers can realize the simultaneous and parallel measurement of the high-flux multi-cell density by matching with the design of the microfluidic chip, and the measurement efficiency is improved.

title_en: Bacillus for efficiently carrying out anaerobic reduction on arsenic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacillus for efficiently carrying out anaerobic arsenic reduction, which is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2018411. Under the anaerobic culture condition, the bacillus has high arsenic reducibility, the arsenic reduction rate reaches more than 80% in 4 days, and the bacillus has important significance for researching migration and transformation of arsenic.

title_en: Separated nucleic acid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separated nucleic acid and application thereof, relating to the technical field of biomolecules. The nucleotide sequence of the nucleic acid is as shown in any one of (1) to (3): (1) the base sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3; (2) the base sequences at the 1 st to 225 th positions are shown in SEQ ID NO.1, the base sequences at the 226 th to 1737 th positions encode Env protein, and the amino acid sequence of the Env protein is shown in SEQ ID NO. 4; (3) the base sequences of 1 st to 225 th bits encode M protein, the base sequences of 226 th to 1737 th bits are shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the amino acid sequence of the M protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 5. The nucleic acid can express a large amount of immune antigens of the Zika virus, and is beneficial to research on Zika virus vaccines or Zika virus treatment medicines.

title_en: Raoultella ornithinolytica HA011 for preventing and treating rice seedling stage damping-off and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Raoultella ornithinolytica HA011 for preventing and treating seedling blight of rice and application thereof. The strain is Raoultella ornithinolytica, is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center for 19 months in 2017, and has a preservation number of CGMCC No. 14644. The biocontrol microbial inoculum prepared by liquid fermentation culture of the HA011 strain HAs better effect on preventing and treating rice seedling blight. The biocontrol microbial inoculum HA011 is used for controlling the greenhouse test control effect and the plot test control effect of the rhizoctonia solani in the rice seedling stage to reach 79.38 percent and 71.33 percent respectively.

title_en: Pseudo-ginseng sweet protein gene PnTLP2 and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pseudo-ginseng sweet protein gene PnTLP2 The nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the code is shown as SEQ ID NO: 2; the invention is proved by adopting related technologies of molecular biology and reverse genetics PnTLP2 The gene has the function of improving the plant antifungal property, and the invention is used for resisting the fungi PnTLP2 The gene is constructed on a plant expression vector and is transferred into tobacco for over-expression, and the transgenic tobacco plant has strong in-vitro antifungal activity and over-expression PnTLP2 The transgenic tobacco has obvious inhibiting effect on the growth of five plant pathogenic fungi such as fusarium oxysporum, fusarium solani, alternaria ginseng, sclerotinia sclerotiorum, nigrospora oryzae and the like.

title_en: Diagnosis and treatment marker for postmenopausal osteoporosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diagnosis and treatment marker for postmenopausal osteoporosis, which is miRNA-3656. The invention proves that miRNA-3656 is related to the occurrence and development of postmenopausal osteoporosis through QPCR, and simultaneously proves that miRNA-3656 influences the differentiation of osteoblasts through cell experiments, thereby suggesting that miRNA-3656 can be used as a molecular target for the early diagnosis and treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis.

title_en: Method for preserving aqueous solution containing leuco chromogen
abstract_en: A method for preserving an aqueous solution containing a leuco chromogen, characterized by adding at least 1 acid compound selected from the group consisting of phosphoric acid compounds, carboxylic acid compounds, sulfonic acid compounds and sulfuric acid compounds to the aqueous solution containing the leuco chromogen; a method for stabilizing a leuco chromogen in an aqueous solution, characterized by adding at least 1 acid compound selected from the group consisting of phosphoric acid compounds, carboxylic acid compounds, sulfonic acid compounds and sulfuric acid compounds to an aqueous solution containing a leuco chromogen; a liquid reagent containing a leuco chromogen and at least 1 acid compound selected from the group consisting of a phosphoric acid compound, a carboxylic acid compound, a sulfonic acid compound and a sulfuric acid compound.

title_en: Preparation method of radix pseudostellariae cyclic peptide extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a radix pseudostellariae cyclic peptide extract, which comprises the steps of extracting radix pseudostellariae, degreasing, removing amino acid, precipitating with alcohol and freeze-drying. The total cyclic peptide content of the extract prepared by the method is more than 95 percent, and the extract can be used for developing health products containing cyclic peptide components of radix pseudostellariae and promoting the development of deep-processed products of radix pseudostellariae.

title_en: Cell blowing-off device and cell subculturing method based on same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell blowing device, which comprises a first container, a second container, a third container, a first hose, a second hose, a third hose, a fourth hose and a fifth hose, and also discloses a cell subculture method based on the cell blowing device. The beneficial effects are that: the technical scheme can ensure that the cell suspension is blown off in a closed environment, reduce pollution possibly caused by manual operation, and can meet the requirements of biological products, pharmacy and the like on large-scale cell culture and blowing off. The peristaltic pumps can control the blowing speed of the cell suspension and efficiently complete the work task of uniformly mixing the cell suspension, so that the cell suspension can be directly used for subsequent roller bottle culture and large-scale culture of the bioreactor. The present invention relates to cell culture devices and methods.

title_en: Biosensor for detecting salmonella based on aptamer and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biosensors, in particular to a biosensor for detecting salmonella based on a nucleic acid aptamer, which comprises an aptamer Apt, a template T, a hairpin probe H1, a hairpin probe H2, phi29, salmonella, Nt.Alwl endonuclease and a buffer solution; based on the specificity recognition of the aptamer and a target object, a bridge structure formed by Apt and T is opened, H2 is opened by utilizing the chain extension function of Phi29 polymerase to generate fluorescence, and 3' tilting part specificity digestion is realized to realize the cyclic amplification of the target object, under the assistance of Nt.

title_en: Monovalent inhibitors of huTNFR1 interactions
abstract_en: The present invention provides inhibitors of the huTNFR1 receptor which are human or humanized antibody constructs that monovalent recognize huTNFR1 by an antigen binding moiety characterized by specific CDR sequences; pharmaceutical formulations of the inhibitors; methods of producing the inhibitors; and medical uses of the inhibitors.

title_en: Truffle health-care vinegar and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides truffle health-care vinegar and a preparation process thereof, wherein the preparation process comprises the following operations: preparing base wine: puffing wheat germ, pulverizing, sequentially performing enzymolysis, starter propagation and fermentation to obtain base wine with alcohol content of 12-13%; extracting effective components of truffle; blending: adding 30-50g of the Chinese liquor containing truffle extract into one liter of base liquor, and stirring; preparing vinegar: pouring the product obtained in the last step into a pottery jar, inoculating acetic acid bacteria liquid, fermenting at 38-39 deg.C for 15-20 days, stirring 3-5 times per day, sequentially spraying vinegar, blending, sun drying vinegar, filtering, sterilizing, and packaging. Compared with the prior art, the truffle health vinegar prepared by the preparation process has almost all nutrient substances of wheat germs and truffles, has wheat germ faint scent and truffle special fragrance, and has the advantages of good taste, strong fragrance, high nutritional value, short brewing period and high production efficiency.

title_en: Taqman-MGB detection method for drug resistance of plasmopara viticola to carboxylic acid amide bactericides
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection method for detecting 1105 th nucleotide mutation of a grapevine downy mildew cellulose synthase 3 gene and application thereof in resistance monitoring of carboxylic acid amide bactericides, and particularly discloses a specific primer pair and a probe sequence for detecting the mutation site. The sensitivity of the strain to the carboxylic acid amide bactericides can be judged by one step through carrying out fluorescent PCR reaction on the designed primer and the probe, and the heterozygosity and homozygosity of the sensitive strain can be distinguished. The molecular diagnosis method for detecting the drug resistance of the peronospora parasitica to the carboxylic acid amide medicaments, provided by the invention, has the advantages of high sensitivity, good stability and short detection period, can be used for monitoring the occurrence and development conditions of the resistance of the field peronospora parasitica to the carboxylic acid amide medicaments in a high-throughput manner, realizes early warning of the resistance of the peronospora parasitica to the carboxylic acid amide medicaments, and has important significance for timely and effectively controlling the development of the drug resistance of the peronospora parasitica.

title_en: Streptomyces mutant strain for high-yield tacrolimus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a streptomycete mutagenic strain for high-yield tacrolimus, wherein the mutagenic strain is streptomycete tsukubaensis FIM-07-23, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center on day 07 of 2019, the address is No. 3 of Xilu No.1 of North Chen of the sunward area in Beijing, and the preservation number is CGMCC No. 17137; the Streptomyces tsukubaensis FIM-07-23 is applied to fermentation production of tacrolimus. The streptomyces tsukubaensis can ferment high-yield tacrolimus, greatly improves the yield of the tacrolimus, and has good genetic stability.

title_en: Congenital aniridia screening kit
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a related reagent for detecting a mutation site c.275G & gtA of a human PAX6 gene in preparation of a congenital aniridia screening reagent; the mutation site c.275G & gtA is that the 275 th nucleotide of the gene coding region is mutated from G to A. The invention also provides a congenital aniridia screening kit, which is a kit for detecting the site mutation. The method can be used for auxiliary screening of congenital aniridia and has the characteristics of simplicity and rapidness.

title_en: Environment-friendly biological oil extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly biological oil extraction method, which comprises the steps of injecting a biological activator into an oil field test area through a water injection well by using a high-pressure plunger pump, wherein the injection amount of the biological activator is 0.05-0.1 PV, and the injection speed is 80-150 m 3 D, the air injection amount is 2-3 multiplied by 10 5 Nm 3 The injection mode is continuous injection, and the biological activator is prepared from glycerol, molasses and NaNO 3 Yeast extract, K 2 HPO 4 、MgSO 4 KCl, ethanol, FeSO 4 、CaCO 3 And Na 2 MoO 4 The biological activator is prepared by mixing, and the components and the weight ratio of the biological activator are determined by a screening experiment and an analysis experiment. The method can improve the oil extraction rate of crude oil, further extract the residual oil by utilizing the beneficial activities and metabolites of microorganisms through the effects of degrading the crude oil, reducing the viscosity, increasing the local pressure, increasing the fluidity, changing the oil-water interfacial tension and the rock wettability and the like, and has the advantages of high technological content, good economic benefit, environmental protection and no pollution.

title_en: OBR gene and method for using same as genetic marker related to fatty deposition of \28294ugoose fat liver
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OBR gene and a method for using \28294gand a genetic marker related to fatty deposition of liver of Pteria penguin, wherein a leptin receptor gene OBR and the genetic marker used as the \28294gand the fatty character of Pteria penguin are used for determining the size of Pteria penguin and screening \28294gand the polymorphism of the OBR gene of Pteria penguin, and then the correlation analysis of the polymorphism of the OBR gene and the fatty character is carried out, and the sequence of the OBR molecular marker is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. A G/A base mutation exists at 573bp of SEQ ID NO.1, the GG genotype is \28294whilethe size of the liver of the goose is obviously higher than that of the GA genotype individual. The invention provides a molecular marker for marker-assisted selection of the properties of the fatty liver of \28294Heps.

title_en: Micro-fluidic chip detection system and method integrating cell sorting and focusing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-fluidic chip detection system and a method for integrated cell sorting and focusing, comprising a viscoelastic fluid sample injection device, a sample injection device, a waste liquid collection device, a high-speed image collection device, a micro-fluidic chip, a sample collection device and a microcomputer, wherein the micro-fluidic chip is packaged by a flow channel layer and a basal layer, and the flow channel layer is provided with a spiral flow channel, a bifurcation flow channel, a lower branch flow channel, an upper branch flow channel, a viscoelastic fluid sample injection flow channel, a spiral mixing flow channel and a focusing main flow channel; the invention realizes the sorting of cells according to the dimensional characteristics, the mixing and the blending of the viscoelastic carrier liquid, and the focusing of the sorted rare cells at a single balance position in the center of the cross section of the flow channel; the accuracy of the counting detection is improved.

title_en: KASP molecular marker for identifying CMS male sterility restoring gene of pepper, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a KASP molecular marker for identifying CMS male sterility restoring genes of hot peppers, a kit and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of molecular marker assisted breeding, wherein the KASP molecular marker is obtained by amplifying a primer group comprising an upstream primer F1, an upstream primer F2 and a downstream primer R. By utilizing the KASP molecular marker, fertility identification of the CMS segregation population of the pepper can be quickly completed, whether the pepper contains a CMS fertility restorer gene or not can be quickly judged, batch experiments can be carried out, a large amount of manpower is saved, and the KASP molecular marker is particularly suitable for operation of a large number of samples. The kit for identifying the CMS restoring gene of the pepper and the identification method provided by the invention have high accuracy.

title_en: Methods and compositions for inhibiting skin inflammation and determining susceptibility to cancer
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods of treating or preventing autoimmune and/or inflammatory skin disorders, skin tumors, and obesity in a subject in need thereof by administering an inhibitor capable of inhibiting activation of an inflammasome NLRP1, an NLRP1 mutant, agents that prevent stress responsive secretion factors in the skin, known pro-inflammatory cytokines, keratinocyte differentiation markers, agents that are secreted by an inflammasome-dependent cytokine and growth factors, and agents that reduce the effects of an inflammasome-dependent cytokine. The present invention encompasses the use of NLRP1 activators, such as Talabostat, in particular for the treatment of skin tumours. Also included herein is a method of determining the likelihood of a subject suffering from an autoimmune skin disorder and/or an inflammatory skin disorder, the method comprising detecting an NLRP1 mutation in a sample obtained from the subject. Inflammatory proprioceptive protein NLRP1 mutants and compositions for use in therapy are also disclosed.

title_en: Rice whole genome breeding chip and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to SNP marker combination and a design method for rice genotyping, a chip designed aiming at the SNP markers and application thereof.

title_en: Chimeric antigen receptor gene engineering vector, immune cell and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cell therapy, and discloses a chimeric antigen receptor gene engineering vector, immune cells and application thereof, wherein the chimeric antigen receptor gene engineering vector comprises a lentiviral vector skeleton, a regulatory element connected to the lentiviral vector skeleton and a chimeric antigen receptor gene sequence, and the regulatory element comprises a WPRE element, a cPPT element and an RRE element. The chimeric antigen receptor gene sequence comprises a costimulatory signal path sequence and an effector signal path sequence which are expressed independently; alternatively, the chimeric antigen receptor gene sequence includes a fusion expressed costimulatory signaling pathway sequence and an effector signaling pathway sequence. The chimeric antigen receptor genetic engineering vector has the advantages of good safety, high transfection efficiency, rapid amplification of transfected immune cells and greatly improved killing effect. In addition, compared with the chimeric antigen receptor immune cells with single targets, the target cells are more accurately identified, and the off-target effect of the single targets is prevented.

title_en: Nucleotide sequence of skin type HPV typing detection primer based on constant temperature nucleic acid amplification technology and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of DNA amplification and biological sample detection, in particular to 8 primers for typing detection of skin type papilloma viruses based on a constant temperature nucleic acid amplification technology. The 8 pairs of primers can be used for preparing diagnostic products for rapidly detecting the skin type HPV types, such as kits and the like. The HPV typing identification primers related by the invention are precisely designed, are determined after a large number of experimental screens, have extremely high reaction sensitivity and specificity, are qualified through clinical sample amplification inspection, and are an excellent selection of the 8-type HPV typing detection primers based on the CAMP technology. The nucleotide sequence can rapidly and accurately detect the type of the skin HPV, and can meet the clinical requirement on typing detection of the skin HPV.

title_en: Antioxidant peptide derived from yak blood and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a yak blood antioxidant peptide with strong antioxidant activity,the sequence is TLPDTEKQIKKQ, and the reducing power reaches 3.24 mg/mL  ‑1  The lipid peroxidation inhibition ability was 2.43 mg/mL  ‑1  OH-scavenging ability of 0.74 mg/mL  ‑1  、ABTS  +  The clearance reaches 1.58 mg/mL  ‑1  DPPH and scavenging power reach 1.59 mg/mL  ‑1  The total antioxidant capacity reaches 4.27 mg/mL  ‑1  Has extremely high application prospect, can be used for preparing corresponding antioxidant preparations and is used in the application field of relevant antioxidation.

title_en: Composite fermentation product for inhibiting aspergillus flavus and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite fermentation product for inhibiting aspergillus flavus, a preparation method and an application thereof, and relates to the technical field of microorganisms. As shown in the aspergillus flavus bacteriostasis test described in the specific embodiment of the present invention, the concentrate of the fermentation supernatant of pediococcus acidilactici, lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus coagulans all have an inhibitory effect on the growth of aspergillus flavus, and the concentrate of the composite fermentation supernatant of the composite fermentation of pediococcus acidilactici, lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus coagulans also has an inhibitory effect on the growth of aspergillus flavus. The composite fermentation product provided by the invention is a composite fermentation product of two or three of pediococcus acidilactici, lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus coagulans, and is safe to people and environment. Therefore, the invention provides a safe and effective aspergillus flavus inhibitor.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 and application thereof, wherein the lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 can be rapidly fixedly planted in intestinal tracts, so that fasting blood glucose and oral glucose tolerance caused by type II diabetes mellitus are remarkably improved, and the area under a curve when the glucose tolerance is reduced; the increase of total cholesterol and the reduction of high density lipoprotein cholesterol in serum caused by type II diabetes are obviously improved; remarkably improving the insulin resistance caused by type II diabetes; significantly improve the level of inflammation in type ii diabetic liver tissue; the pathological damage of tissues such as pancreas, liver and the like caused by type II diabetes is obviously improved; the lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 has stronger adsorption capacity on the perfluorooctanoic acid and has the capacity of relieving the toxicity of the perfluorooctanoic acid; remarkably improve constipation caused by type II diabetes, can improve the level of Allobaculum in intestinal tract, and has effects of relieving anxiety, depression and colitis.

title_en: Microcapsule manufacturing system capable of generating high voltage based on mechanical driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a microcapsule manufacturing system capable of generating high voltage by mechanical driving, which belongs to the technical field of micro-nano manufacturing and comprises a mechanical energy input device, a friction nano generator, a rectifying/boosting circuit and a microcapsule generating device which are sequentially connected; the mechanical energy input device drives the friction nano generator to generate kV-level voltage and mA-level current, and the generated voltage is adjusted to be stable kV-level voltage after passing through the rectifying/boosting circuit and is input into the microcapsule generator. The invention combines the friction nanometer generator and the biological microcapsule, and generates a high-voltage electrostatic field through mechanical motion friction, so that the diameter of liquid drops ejected by a needle head is greatly reduced; the current in the circuit is very small when the friction nanometer generator generates high voltage, so that the friction nanometer generator is very safe for operators, does not threaten biological cells, and provides a safe, controllable, simple and low-cost manufacturing platform for biological microcapsules.

title_en: Bispecific checkpoint inhibitor antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention relates to bispecific heterodimer checkpoint antibodies.

title_en: Streptomyces roseosporus Sr-63 and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology microorganisms, and particularly relates to an antagonistic Streptomyces roseovicillicus (Streptomyces roseovitericus) Sr-63 strain and application thereof in plant disease prevention and treatment. The invention discloses a Streptomyces roseoflavus (S.roseovicilliatus) Sr-63 strain, the preservation number is as follows: CCTCC NO: m2019261. The invention also discloses the application of the Streptomyces roseoflavus Sr-63 strain: is used for preventing and treating bacterial leaf blight of rice.

title_en: Molecular marker, primer and method for identifying pseudocercospora fusca based on PCR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular marker for identifying pseudocercospora droppings based on PCR (polymerase chain reaction), wherein the DNA sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO:1 is shown in the specification; the DNA sequences of the upstream primer and the downstream primer are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO: 2. SEQ ID NO:3 is shown in the specification; the identification method is sequentially carried out according to the following steps: separating the tissue of the focus part of the fish body to extract tissue DNA; performing PCR amplification; the PCR product is detected by agarose gel electrophoresis, if an electrophoresis band of 498 bp appears, the ciliate parasitized at the focus part is the water drop pseudoceratitis glauca, and the method has the advantages of rapidness, simplicity, accuracy and the like.

title_en: Rhizosphere fungus capable of promoting development of adventitious roots and secondary roots of nursery stocks and application thereof
abstract_en: Rhizosphere fungi capable of promoting the development of adventitious roots and secondary roots of seedlings and application. The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a Populus deltoides rhizosphere fungus Chaetomium cupreum (Stagonospora ajacis 16W) strain and a function thereof. The invention discloses a rhizosphere fungus strain (Populus deltoides rhizosphere fungus strain) 16W which is Stagonospora ajacis with a preservation number: CGMCC No. 18136. The invention also discloses the application of the rhizosphere fungus strain 16W: is used for promoting the development of adventitious roots and secondary roots of plants, thereby promoting the growth of the plants.

title_en: Production process of yellow wine rich in beta-phenethyl alcohol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of yellow wine rich in beta-phenethyl alcohol, which comprises the following steps: 1. soaking rice; 2. steaming rice; 3. spraying rice; 4. cylinder dropping: transferring the glutinous rice after being soaked with rice into a fermentation tank, adding water, mixing uniformly, and adding wheat starter, yellow wine dry yeast and protease; 5. fermentation: and (3) sugar phase: carrying out aerobic saccharification for 3-4 days at 28-30 ℃, harrowing for 1 time every 10-12h, and then adding XZ-9 yeast; the primary fermentation stage: anaerobic fermentation at 24-25 deg.C and 18-20 deg.C for 2 days, and harrowing for 1 time every 20-24 h; and (3) in a middle and post fermentation stage: anaerobic fermentation at 14-16 deg.C for 23-27 days, and harrowing for 1 time every 48-72 hr; 6. and (3) post-treatment: squeezing after fermentation, and sterilizing. The method obviously improves the content of beta-phenethyl alcohol in the yellow wine, has the lowest content of isobutanol and isoamylol, improves rose and honey aroma brought by the beta-phenethyl alcohol in the yellow wine, weakens foreign flavor brought by the isobutanol and the isoamylol and harm to human bodies, and improves the flavor of the yellow wine.

title_en: Skin wound repair peptide RL-RF10 and purification method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skin wound repair peptide RL-RF10, wherein an amino acid sequence contained in the repair peptide RL-RF10 is RFCFKGTPCG, and the invention also discloses a purification method and application of the repair peptide RL-RF 10. The skin wound repair peptide RL-RF10 provided by the invention can obviously promote the healing of acute skin wounds and reduce the generation of scars, has the capability of promoting the repair of canker sores and the healing of chronic wounds, is one of the strongest active substances for promoting the skin repair in the world, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Recombinant baculovirus and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a recombinant baculovirus suitable for introducing foreign genes into pests, particularly disease-transmitting mosquitoes. The recombinant baculovirus is characterized by having a promoter (which is any one of an HzNV-1 virus early expression gene pag1, an antibacterial peptide gene b1, a defensin gene a4 or hsp70 gene); and a foreign gene operably linked to the promoter. The present invention also relates to a method for introducing an exogenous gene into a pest. The method comprises transferring a recombinant baculovirus into the pest without inhibiting the production of micrornas (miRNAs) in the pest, wherein the recombinant baculovirus comprises a pag1, antimicrobial peptide b1, defensin a4 or hsp70 promoter.

title_en: Fluorescent marker composite amplification kit for human Y chromosome STR locus and InDel locus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and particularly discloses a fluorescent marker composite amplification kit for human Y chromosome STR loci and InDel loci, which comprises 41 pairs of specific primers, and can amplify 37Y chromosome STR loci and 8Y chromosome InDel loci in a single tube. The invention has the characteristics of strong specificity, accurate typing, high sensitivity and the like, and meanwhile, 8 InDel sites are added to distinguish the families of the sample to a certain extent. The invention can meet the needs of cases detection, database construction, paternity test and the like.

title_en: Oat leaf blight bacterium gene CvDUF1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a CvDUF1 gene of bacterial leaf blight of oat and its application, belonging to the technical field of microbial genetic engineering, the DNA sequence of the CvDUF1 gene formed by control toxin of bacterial leaf blight of oat is shown in SEQ ID No. 1; the CvDUF1 gene can be applied to the field of plant gene engineering for resisting bacterial leaf blight of oat; the protein CvDUF1 formed by controlling the toxin of the bacterial leaf blight of oat is deleted, mutated or modified, so that the toxin formation is limited, and the protein CvDUF1 can be used as a target to be applied to designing and screening of anti-bacterial leaf blight medicaments of oat.

title_en: Cas9 fusion protein for improving gene editing efficiency, encoding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a Cas9 fusion protein for improving gene editing efficiency, a coding gene and application thereof. The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to improve the editing efficiency of a CRISPR-Cas9 system at a genome target site, especially the editing efficiency at a low-activity target site. The technical scheme for solving the technical problem is to provide a Cas9 fusion protein. The carbon end of the Cas9 fusion protein is connected with a UBA2 domain derived from arabidopsis ubiquitin receptor protein RAD23 a. Further, the invention also provides a coding gene of the Cas9 fusion protein. The CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing system constructed on the basis of the Cas9 fusion protein coding gene can effectively increase the gene editing efficiency of different gene loci, particularly low-efficiency loci.

title_en: High specific activity xylanase mutant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protein engineering modification, and particularly provides a xylanase mutant with high specific activity. Compared with xylanase Xyn1, the specific activity of the xylanase mutant is generally improved by 16.30-41.29%, wherein the xylanase mutant containing F13Y and S79T two-point mutation has the highest specific activity of 1-13/79 which reaches 1083.3U/mg, and unexpected technical effects are achieved. After fermentation in a 10L fermentation tank, the specific activity of the xylanase mutant Xyn1-13/79 is further improved to 1414.3U/mg, which is 41.4% higher than that of xylanase Xyn 1. The xylanase mutant provided by the invention has improved specific activity, is beneficial to reducing the production cost of xylanase, accelerates the wide application of the xylanase in the field of feed, and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Human DIP-InDel locus fluorescence labeling kit and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human DIP-InDel locus fluorescence labeling kit and a detection method, wherein the kit comprises 45 specific multiplex PCR primers of nucleotide sequences shown in SEQ NO. 1-45 and 4 pairs of fluorescence labeling universal primers of nucleotide sequences shown in SEQ NO. 46-53. Through amplification and comparison of 15 DIP-InDel gene loci, the trace components in the double unbalanced mixed sample are detected, and the individual is eliminated and confirmed, so that the method can be applied to the aspects of double mixed spot forensic identification, noninvasive fetal paternity identification and the like.

title_en: Brevundimonas 2B and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Brevundimonas sp 2B and application thereof, relating to the technical field of edible fungi biology, wherein the Brevundimonas sp 2B is classified and named as Brevundimonas sp 2B and is preserved in China center for type culture collection with the preservation number of CCTCC No. M2019638; the preservation date is as follows: 8, 8 and 16 in 2019; and (4) storage address: when the bacteria disclosed by the invention are applied to the promotion of oyster mushroom growth in Wuhan university in China, the average growing speed of hyphae per day, the yield of a single bag and the thickness of a pileus are increased, the number of days for filling the bag with hyphae is shortened, the oyster mushroom hyphae growth can be effectively promoted, the production period of oyster mushrooms is shortened, the problems of drug residue and environmental pollution can be effectively avoided while the fungus growth is promoted, and the development and the utilization in the commercial field in the future are facilitated.

title_en: Immobilized composite flora material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water environment restoration, and discloses an immobilized composite flora material and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the anaerobic ammonium oxidation granular sludge, the denitrification granular sludge and the aerobic nitrification granular sludge are subjected to immobilized culture in the same carrier by using an immobilized microorganism technology, so that high-activity anaerobic ammonium oxidation bacteria, denitrification bacteria and aerobic nitrification bacteria are enriched, the effect of synchronously removing organic matters, nutritive salts and the like in a water environment is achieved, and the method has the advantages of low cost, energy conservation, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Escherichia coli engineering strain for efficiently producing GDP-fucose
abstract_en: The invention provides an escherichia coli producing strain for efficiently producing GDP-fucose, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering and microbial metabolic engineering. The invention takes glucose as a substrate, and relieves the metabolic pressure of a GDP-fucose synthesis pathway by combining and regulating the expression of phosphomannose mutase (ManB), GDP-mannose pyrophosphorylase (ManC), GDP-mannose 4, 6-dehydratase (Gmd) and GDP-fucose synthetase (Wcag) in the metabolic pathway. The invention also knocks out a gene UDP-glucose lipid carrier transferase (WcaJ) for decomposing GDP-fucose in escherichia coli through a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system and enhances the regeneration of cofactors in a metabolic pathway to further improve the accumulation of intracellular GDP-fucose.

title_en: Strawberry maturation associated transcription factor gene FaNAC2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strawberry maturation associated transcription factor gene FaNAC2 and application thereof. The invention clones a new gene FaNAC2, and discovers for the first time that the strawberry FaNAC2 gene can negatively regulate strawberry fruit ripening and is related to the key gene expression of abscisic acid signal pathway. Inhibition of FaNAC2 expression in strawberry fruits accelerates the fruit ripening process. Therefore, the gene can be reasonably utilized to adjust the marketing time of the fruits of the late-maturing strawberry variety, so that the production service of the strawberry is provided. The invention provides theoretical basis and technical means for regulating the fruit ripening process by utilizing the genetic engineering technology, thereby having great application value in regulating the marketing time of the late-maturing variety fruits of strawberries.

title_en: Genome repeated sequence deletion rate determining method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of biology, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining the deletion rate of a genome repeated sequence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining fluorescence data of each bacterium in a bacterium set and the number of all the bacteria in the bacterium set, wherein the bacteria in the bacterium set are obtained by splitting the same parent bacteria; determining the variation type of the DNA sequence of each bacterium according to the fluorescence data of each bacterium, and counting the number of the repeated sequence deleted bacteria in the bacterium set; and calculating to obtain the repeated sequence deletion rate of the parent bacteria according to the number of all bacteria in the bacteria set and the number of repeated sequence deletion bacteria in the bacteria set. According to the genome repeated sequence deleting rate determining method provided by the application, the bacteria with repeated sequence deleting in the bacteria set can be directly identified through the fluorescence data, so that the repeated sequence deleting rate is obtained through calculation according to the number of the repeated sequence deleting bacteria, and the scheme is simple and has high reliability.

title_en: Glycan interaction compounds and methods of use
abstract_en: The invention provides methods of treating cancer comprising administering a glycan-interacting antibody. The present invention includes anti-sialyl Tn antigen antibodies and related compositions and formulations suitable for achieving desired levels of biological activity, bioavailability, and toxicity.

title_en: Nucleic acid microflow control detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid microflow control detection system which comprises a pretreatment cavity, an incubation cavity, a waste liquid cavity, a reaction cavity, a magnetic bead capturing system, a magnetic control transfer system, a pressure control system and an optical detection system, wherein the magnetic bead capturing system is arranged in the incubation cavity. The pretreatment chamber is used for extracting nucleic acid in a biological sample. The extracted nucleic acid enters an incubation cavity to be incubated with a magnetic bead capturing system, and target nucleic acid is captured. The magnetic control transfer system is used for adsorbing the magnetic bead capturing system and can drive the magnetic bead capturing system to transfer from the incubation cavity to the reaction cavity. The pressure control system is used to drive the transfer of liquid within the system. The waste liquid cavity is used for containing waste liquid. The reaction chamber is used for performing amplification reaction on target nucleic acid. The optical detection system is used for detecting the fluorescent signal. The invention can realize the purification and detection of nucleic acid on one chip, thereby realizing the rapid and accurate detection of nucleic acid. In addition, the invention has simple structure, small volume and low cost.

title_en: Production technology of arabinoxylan for prolonging shelf life of bread and steamed bread
