abstract_en: The invention relates to an arabinoxylan production technology for prolonging the shelf life of bread and steamed bread, belonging to the field of food additives. The method is characterized in that wheat bran is used as a raw material, and the modified arabinoxylan is produced by the steps of ultrasonic-assisted alkali extraction, xylanase hydrolysis and arabinofuranosidase delimbination and is added into dough, so that the starch recrystallization phenomenon of bread and steamed bread in the storage process can be inhibited, and the shelf life of the bread and the steamed bread can be prolonged. The invention has the characteristics of easy production, safety, no pollution, high product nutritional value and the like, the proportion of arabinose and xylose of the arabinoxylan is 0.3-0.5: 1, the addition amount is 0.5-2.0% of the flour mass, the shelf life of bread and steamed bread is respectively prolonged by 20-30 days and 10-20 days, and the invention is an efficient and healthy flour product modifier.

title_en: Mouse endometrial epithelial cell and construction method of 3D differentiation culture model thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mouse endometrial epithelial cell and a construction method of a 3D differentiation culture model thereof. The mouse normal endometrium epithelial cell is named as MNUEC/HL-027, and the preservation number is CCTCC No: C2015108. meanwhile, a construction method of the mouse endometrial epithelial cell 3D differentiation culture model is provided: and (3) suspending single cells by the aid of a 2D culture medium, inoculating the single cells into a gas-liquid culture device, and culturing for 14-21 days by replacing the 2D culture medium with a 3D differentiation culture medium. After the 3D differentiation culture of the mouse endometrium epithelium is completely differentiated, the mouse endometrium epithelium has similar structural characteristics with normal endometrium tissue, and a pseudo-multilayer structure consisting of epithelial cells is formed, and comprises a basal layer and a functional layer. Meanwhile, the recombinant human endometrial peptide also has the expression characteristics of specific protein markers and cell tight junction related proteins which are the same as those of normal mouse endometrial tissues, has structural functionality, and can be used for physiological research and functional research of regeneration and repair of the endometrial tissues.

title_en: Application of rice OsPPR2-1 gene in constructing plant with improved fertility under natural condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a rice OsPPR2-1 gene in constructing plants with improved fertility under natural conditions, and a method for constructing plants with improved fertility by utilizing a gene editing technology. The first research of the invention shows that the OsPPR2-1 gene is related to rice fertility, mutation is carried out on the OsPPR2-1 gene, the expression quantity of OsPPR2-1 protein is reduced or the generation of OsPPR2-1 protein is blocked, and the fertility can be sensitive to the natural environment temperature, so that the OsPPR2-1 gene can be used as an effective target spot for rice genetic breeding. Based on the method, the method for obtaining the natural environment temperature sensitive mutant by mutating the OsPPR2-1 by using the gene editing technology has the advantages of strong purposiveness, small damage to a genome, avoidance of possible risks brought by transgenosis and the like, compared with a wild plant, the fertility of the obtained mutant plant is obviously improved under the natural low temperature condition, the maturing rate is obviously increased, and the yield of rice is obviously improved, so that the invention provides a new gene editing target spot, a new effective breeding way and a new effective breeding method for cultivating high-yield rice.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling nucleic acid molecule strand displacement dynamics based on photochemistry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating and controlling nucleic acid molecule strand displacement dynamics based on photochemistry, which is characterized in that an auxiliary strand and a template strand with a notch are reasonably designed, and a triplex structure can be formed through Hoogsteen hydrogen bonds in a proton-rich environment under the condition of no ultraviolet irradiation so as to introduce a small fulcrum area, thereby triggering nucleic acid molecule strand displacement reaction; the molecular optical switch material spiropyran molecules are added into the system, and the molecular optical switch material spiropyran molecules undergo isomerization reaction under ultraviolet irradiation, so that the proton concentration in the solution is reduced, and the triplex structure cannot exist stably, namely a small fulcrum area cannot be formed, and the nucleic acid molecule strand displacement reaction is inhibited to a certain extent. The invention modifies the fluorescent group on the template chain, and the kinetics and the yield of the nucleic acid molecule chain displacement reaction can be reflected through the monitoring of the fluorescence intensity. The method has the advantages of programmability and adjustable dynamics, and has great application potential in the aspect of nucleic acid molecule nanotechnology.

title_en: Method for treating lower limb ischemic diseases by using stem cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for treating ischemic diseases of lower limbs by stem cells. The cell therapy composition for treating ischemic diseases of lower limbs comprises: umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells, sodium chloride, and water. The cell therapy composition is prepared as follows: dissolving sodium chloride in water, optionally sterilizing the solution to obtain matrix; suspending the prepared mesenchymal stem cells in the matrix, and packaging. The invention also relates to a method for preparing said cell therapy compositions, and to their medical use. The method of the present invention exhibits excellent technical effects as described in the specification, for example, the composition obtained by the present invention exhibits excellent cell recovery performance during cell recovery, and the viability of cells undergoing recovery process and the survival stability of cells after recovery are significantly higher than those of the prior art solutions. In addition, the compositions of the present invention exhibit more beneficial biological activity.

title_en: Bacillus megaterium and application thereof in degrading pyrethroid insecticides
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus megaterium and application thereof in degrading pyrethroid insecticides. The degrading strain is Bacillus megatherium (Bacillus megatherium) strain HLJ7, which is preserved in Guangdong province microorganism strain preservation center in 2019, 9, 4 days, and the preservation number is GDMCC No. 60760. The invention discloses the degradation effect of bacillus megaterium on pyrethroid insecticides such as allethrin for the first time, and the high-efficiency and rapid degradation strain HLJ7 is obtained by screening. Based on the invention, the bacillus megaterium has obvious biodegradation effect on pyrethroid insecticides such as allethrin, has high degradation efficiency and stable degradation performance, can tolerate higher-concentration pesticides, and can be used for bioremediation of polluted environments such as water and soil polluted by pyrethroid insecticides such as allethrin. The invention provides a new development approach for breaking the bottleneck of controlling pesticide residue pollution, enriches the germplasm resource library of pesticide degrading bacteria, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Key gene PmARF6 for regulating and controlling blossoming of masson pine and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key gene PmARF6 for regulating and controlling the blooming of masson pine and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. The nucleotide sequence of the key gene PmARF6 for regulating the blossoming of the masson pine is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the amino acid sequence of the expressed protein product is shown as SEQ ID No.2, and is a masson pine ARF transcription factor. According to the invention, the arabidopsis thaliana with the over-expression PmARF6 gene is obtained by transforming the arabidopsis thaliana, the flowering of the plant is obviously delayed, which shows that the PmARF6 gene maintains vegetative growth and inhibits reproductive transformation (flowering), and the gene is a negative regulatory factor for the flowering of pinus massoniana, and can be applied to regulating and controlling the vegetative growth and reproductive growth time of the plant: over-expressing the gene, prolonging vegetative growth time or delaying reproductive growth time; by knocking out the gene, the vegetative growth time is shortened or the reproductive growth time is advanced. The gene has important application value in the forest tree breeding field.

title_en: RDA method and kit for rapidly detecting influenza A virus
abstract_en: The invention discloses an RDA method and a kit for rapidly detecting influenza A virus, which comprise a specific primer group and an RDA fluorescent labeling probe so as to realize safe, specific, sensitive and simple detection of influenza A virus (FluA), thereby overcoming the defects of the traditional detection technology. The kit provided by the method can omit the nucleic acid extraction step, realizes the detection of the influenza A virus within 20min at the constant temperature of 37-42 ℃, has the specificity of 100 percent, and is very suitable for on-site rapid detection. Compared with the common PCR method, the RDA fluorescence method is to react at constant temperature without changing temperature or complex instrument, and has short reaction time. Therefore, the method and the kit thereof have the characteristics of simple and quick operation, good specificity, high sensitivity, low cost and the like, provide an effective technical means for on-site quick detection and screening of influenza A virus, and have wide application prospects.

title_en: Preparation method of highly-substituted albumin methacryloyl hydrogel for cell and tissue culture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-substituted albumin methacryloyl hydrogel for cell and tissue culture, which comprises the following steps: mixing bovine serum albumin with a CB buffer solution to obtain a mixed solution, adjusting the pH value of the mixed solution to 7-9, adding methacrylic anhydride to react, and performing post-treatment to obtain BSA-MA; dissolving BSA-MA in a PBS buffer solution to obtain a solution A; dissolving a photoinitiator in an ethanol solution to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution, and finally carrying out casting and ultraviolet crosslinking curing to obtain the hydrogel precursor solution. According to the invention, the light-cured bovine serum albumin methacryl hydrogel is synthesized by taking bovine serum albumin as a raw material for the first time, so that the albumin is not denatured in the preparation process, the high substitution of acyl in the albumin is ensured, and the prepared albumin methacryloyl hydrogel has excellent mechanical properties, water absorbability, degradability and biocompatibility.

title_en: NADH analogue dependent cytochrome P450reductase and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NADH analogue dependent cytochrome P450reductase and application thereof. NADH analogue is used as a cofactor and reducing power to catalyze electron transfer and reduce cytochrome P450 to complete catalytic cycle. The enzyme is fused and expressed with different cytochrome P450 enzymes to construct NADH analogue dependent, heterozygous and self-sufficient cytochrome P450 enzyme, the obtained NADH analogue dependent cytochrome P450 enzyme can be coupled with oxidoreductase for regenerating NADH analogue, and NAD analogue is utilized to catalyze corresponding substrate of different families of cytochrome P450 to be converted into product. The NADH analogue-dependent cytochrome P450reductase can be used for constructing a bioorthogonal metabolic pathway independent of a natural cofactor NAD (P) H, and decoupling energy consumption catalyzed by P450 enzyme from endogenous energy metabolism.

title_en: Cultivation method for improving quality of potted fragrant gill rhododendron
abstract_en: The invention provides a cultivation method for improving the quality of potted azalea with fragrant cheeks, belonging to the technical field of azalea cultivation, and comprising transplanting cutting seedlings of azalea with fragrant cheeses, applying a biological compound fertilizer, inoculating an ERM microbial inoculum, and managing the potted azalea with fragrant cheeses; the preparation method of the ERM microbial inoculum comprises the following steps: activating ERM strain, inoculating to liquid culture medium, culturing in shaker at 23-26 deg.C and 140-. The method can promote the root tip meristem to perform periapical division, increase the thickness of the cortex, improve the ERM mycorrhizal infection rate of the rhododendron aromaticum and improve the growth quality of the potted rhododendron; can promote the expression of rhododendron Phenylalanine Ammonia Lyase (PAL) gene, increase PAL activity, promote the synthesis of plant protecting essence, and improve the disease resistance of potted rhododendron.

title_en: Rice low-temperature germination related gene OsDJC58 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice low-temperature germination related gene OsDJC58 and application thereof. The OsDJC58 gene disclosed by the invention is increased in expression amount after being induced by low-temperature germination, and the germination rate and germination index of rice in low-temperature germination are obviously reduced after knockout. The construction of an expression vector, an expression cassette, a transgenic cell line or a host bacterium by using the OsDJC58 gene can help to understand the action mechanism of the OsDJC58, and the cloning of the OsDJC58 lays a foundation for further understanding the genetic control of low-temperature germination of rice and an anti-stress signal conduction path, and can be used for cultivating low-temperature germination transgenic rice varieties. The invention also provides a molecular marker detection primer of the gene OsDJC58 and a detection kit containing the primer, and the low-temperature defense level of a target variety can be quickly judged by detecting the change of the gene expression level, so that a new low-temperature germination variety can be bred.

title_en: Application of candida albicans secretory cysteine-rich protein Sel1
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of candida albicans secretory cysteine-rich protein Sel1. In particular to application of candida albicans secretion type cysteine-rich protein Sel1 in preparing a host immune response activator. The invention discloses the function of the candida albicans secreted cysteine-rich protein Sel1 in host immune response for the first time and discloses a brand new interaction mechanism of the candida albicans and the host.

title_en: Method for producing long-chain dicarboxylic acid by using saturated fatty acid as substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing long-chain dibasic acid by using saturated fatty acid as a substrate, which solves the technical problem that the fermentation process cannot be normally carried out due to serious bubbles in the existing production method of the long-chain dibasic acid, and comprises the following steps: (1) taking a glycerol freezing tube of the strain, inoculating the glycerol freezing tube into a shake flask filled with an YPD culture medium, and preparing a seed solution; inoculating the strain into a shake flask filled with a primary seed culture medium to prepare a primary seed solution; (2) inoculating the prepared first-stage seed liquid into a shake flask filled with a second-stage seed culture medium to prepare a second-stage seed liquid for later use; (3) adjusting pH, stirring speed, temperature and ventilation of the fermentation liquid, inoculating the obtained secondary seed liquid into a fermentation tank containing fermentation medium, supplementing glucose, adjusting pH of the fermentation liquid with sodium hydroxide, and adding laurinol solution of lauric acid to obtain long-chain dicarboxylic acid. The method can be widely applied to the field of preparation of long-chain dibasic acid.

title_en: Integrated automated filtration for separation, washing and drying of peptide crystals
abstract_en: The present invention describes the integration of preparative crystallization, crystal separation, crystal washing and freeze drying processes into a single continuous process using pressure filtration. The method helps to reduce time and outlines new designs using multiple organic solvent washes and nitrogen purges to remove absorbed water and achieve a final drug substance that meets quality specifications.

title_en: L-threonine aldolase mutant R318L and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to threonine aldolase, in particular to an L-threonine aldolase mutant R318L and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the L-threonine aldolase mutant is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3, and the amino acid at the 318 th site of the L-threonine aldolase with the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO. 1 is obtained by changing Arg into Leu. The mutant has diastereoselectivity of 84.9 percent in the reaction of catalyzing 3, 4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde and glycine to synthesize droxidopa [ L-threo- (3, 4-dihydroxy) phenylserine ], is 2.8 times of that of a wild type, and has great application potential in the biosynthesis of droxidopa.

title_en: Kit and detection method for simultaneously detecting three fish-source streptococci
abstract_en: Primer combinations for simultaneously detecting three streptococcus are composed of the following components: upstream and downstream primers for detecting streptococcus agalactiae of SEQ ID MO 1 and 2, upstream and downstream primers for detecting streptococcus agalactiae of SEQ ID MO 3 and 4, and upstream and downstream primers for detecting streptococcus iniae of SEQ ID MO 5 and 6. A kit comprises a DNA extraction reagent and a PCR reaction reagent, wherein the DNA extraction reagent comprises TE buffer solution, proteinase K, chloroform, isopropanol, ethanol and double distilled water; the PC reaction reagent contains reaction buffer solution, dNTPs, DNA polymerase, the 6 primers and deionized water. The method for simultaneously detecting the three streptococcus uses the extracting reagent to extract DNA in a sample, uses the reaction reagent to perform PCR amplification on the DNA, and uses the amplified product to perform gel electrophoresis. The invention can detect the three streptococcus simultaneously, has simple and rapid detection, high sensitivity and strong specificity, and is suitable for the large-scale molecular epidemiology investigation and analysis of aquatic animals and the quality safety detection requirement of aquatic products.

title_en: Method and device for producing fermented feed raw material by using vinasse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for producing a fermented feed raw material by using distillers 'grains, which are characterized in that 70% of rice hulls in the distillers' grains dehydrated by an air heat pump are separated out and are subjected to chemical catalytic hydrolysis treatment to produce monosaccharide, disaccharide and oligosaccharide which are used as ideal carbon sources for microbial fermentation, and the low-cost inorganic nitrogen, namely, ammonium is used as main material, and the organic nitrogen in the distillers 'grains after rice hulls are removed is used as auxiliary material and is converted into mycoprotein by domesticated hypertonic microorganisms, so that the crude protein content in the distillers' grains is increased to about 35% from the original 15%, and the method is superior to the method for producing the carbon sources and producing the protein feed raw material by adopting various enzymes and various microbial rice hulls for decomposition and fermentation.

title_en: Sample preparation device for detecting suspected African swine fever disease material in pig farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sample preparation device for detecting suspected African swine fever disease materials in a pig farm, in particular to the technical field of virus sampling equipment, which comprises a frame, wherein a cabinet door is hinged to the lower side of the front end of the frame, a fixing seat is fixed in the middle part of the frame, a cutting cylinder is rotatably connected to the frame on the upper side of the fixing seat, the cutting cylinder is communicated with the fixing seat, the rotating rod is rotationally connected to the cutting cylinder, the cutting knife is fixed to the side face of the rotating rod, the first storage barrel is fixed to the upper side of the fixing seat on the left side of the cutting cylinder, and the first storage barrel is communicated with the fixing seat through the first connecting pipe. The invention is convenient for placing and positioning the sampling tube, further is convenient for sub-packaging the samples, can synchronously prepare a plurality of groups of samples, improves the efficiency, has compact integral structure, occupies small space and is convenient to use.

title_en: Selective inhibitors of EGFR mutant at exon 18 and/or exon 21
abstract_en: The present application relates to an anti-tumor agent for treating a patient with a malignant tumor that expresses EGFR having at least one mutation selected from the group consisting of: the G719X mutation of exon 18, the E709X mutation of exon 18 and the L861X mutation of exon 21, wherein X represents any amino acid residue, the antineoplastic agent comprises (S) -N- (4-amino-6-methyl-5- (quinolin-3-yl) -8, 9-dihydropyrimido [5,4-b ] indol-8-yl) acrylamide or a salt thereof.

title_en: Method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using microbial fermentation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using a microbial fermentation method, which comprises the following steps: inoculating Rhizopus oryzae (Rhizopus oryzae) GDMCC No:60990 spore in Atractylodis rhizoma powder containing sterile water, fermenting at 28-30 deg.C for 2-3d, ultrasonic extracting the fermented product with water, and concentrating to obtain concentrate; precipitating the concentrate with ethanol and vacuum drying to obtain crude polysaccharide of Atractylodis rhizoma. The fermentation pretreatment of rhizopus oryzae CH5 is added in advance of the ultrasonic treatment of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide. Rhizopus oryzae CH5 grows moderately in Atractylodis rhizoma powder to produce polysaccharide hydrolase, which can hydrolyze insoluble polysaccharide structure tissue of Atractylodes macrocephala, promote dissociation of soluble polysaccharide in binding state, and is more easily dissolved out during hot water ultrasonic extraction. Compared with the conventional method without fermentation pretreatment, the extraction yield of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide can be improved by more than 50%.

title_en: Caco-2 cell monolayer film forming culture method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Caco-2 cell monolayer film forming culture method which comprises the following steps: culturing Caco-2 cells by using MEM culture medium containing 20% of fetal calf serum and 1% of penicillin/streptomycin, digesting with pancreatin when the cell confluence reaches 60% -70%, continuously subculturing for 2-3 times, culturing the cells to logarithmic phase, excessively inoculating the cells for culturing, and washing the cells without adherence by PBS after cell adherence is unfolded, thus obtaining the Caco-2 single-layer membrane cells. The Caco-2 single-layer membrane model established by the method has good state, is in paving stone-like mosaic arrangement, is tightly connected with cells, basically has no cavitation formation, is reliable and stable, has good repeatability, and lays an experimental foundation for subsequent drug absorption and transport research.

title_en: Heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification bacterium and culture method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification bacterium, which is Pseudomonas XN2 (Pseudomonas stutzeri XN 2) and is preserved in Guangdong province microorganism strain preservation center, wherein the preservation time is 2019, 1 and 29 days, and the preservation number is GDMCC No:60531. the strain has the characteristics of high temperature resistance and alkali resistance, has strong heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification performance under the condition of low C/N, and simultaneously has the tolerance of high-concentration NO  3   ‑  -N and NO  2   ‑  -the ability of N.

title_en: Composite bacterial agent for treating petroleum hydrocarbon and benzene series, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of biotechnology and environmental protection, in particular to a microbial inoculum, and particularly relates to a composite microbial inoculum for treating petroleum hydrocarbon and benzene series, a preparation method and application thereof; the active ingredients of the compound microbial inoculum comprise aspergillus oryzae, neurospora, pseudomonas putida, pseudomonas alcaligenes, brevibacterium epidermidis and erwinia; the composite microbial inoculum is particularly suitable for treating soil polluted by petroleum hydrocarbon and benzene series. After the composite microbial inoculum is added into petroleum hydrocarbon and benzene series contaminated soil, indigenous degradation flora can be rapidly propagated, and the repairing process is rapidly started; in the repairing process, the indigenous degrading bacteria always occupy the dominant flora, and the flora in the composite microbial inoculum is cooperatively matched to keep higher degrading efficiency for a long time; finally, the polluted soil is thoroughly repaired, the degradation rate of petroleum hydrocarbon and benzene series is high, and the removal rate of BTEX and TPH can reach more than 98%.

title_en: Microfluidic chip and method for detecting nucleic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microfluidic chip and a method for detecting nucleic acid. A microfluidic chip for nucleic acid detection, comprising: an extraction and purification unit for extracting and purifying nucleic acid molecules in a biological sample; a first amplification zone for performing a first round of amplification of a nucleic acid molecule, said first amplification zone being capable of communicating with said extraction purification unit; a plurality of second amplification regions for performing nested amplification of the nucleic acid molecules after the first round of amplification, each of the second amplification regions being capable of communicating with the first amplification region; and a quantitative distribution device for quantitatively dividing and distributing the microfluidics in the first amplification region to each of the second amplification regions. The invention realizes the high-flux nucleic acid analysis and detection of biological samples.

title_en: Antibodies that bind CTLA-4 and uses thereof
abstract_en: Isolated monoclonal antibodies comprising a CD152 binding domain, wherein the antibody specifically binds to human CD152, are disclosed. Methods of making and using the antibodies to treat diseases including cancer and autoimmune diseases are also provided.

title_en: Human IL-1beta protein binding molecule and its coding gene and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human IL-1beta protein binding molecule, a coding gene and application thereof. The human IL-1beta protein binding molecule has an antigen binding site specifically combined with the human IL-1beta protein, the antigen binding site comprises at least one heavy chain variable region and at least one light chain variable region, the heavy chain variable region has three heavy chain complementarity determining regions, the amino acid sequences of the three heavy chain complementarity determining regions are selected from SEQ ID No.11-17, the light chain variable region has three light chain complementarity determining regions, and the amino acid sequences of the three light chain complementarity determining regions are selected from SEQ ID No. 28-33. The human IL-1beta protein binding molecule is a novel antibody molecule sequence, has high affinity and high blocking activity, and has great disease treatment value.

title_en: Application of Amuc1100 protein
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to application of an Amuc1100 protein. The research of the invention shows that the Amuc1100 protein or the host expressing the Amuc1100 protein has the effect of improving emotional memory, including promoting the regression of negative emotional memory and/or enhancing positive emotional memory. Can be used for preparing drugs for addiction withdrawal or for preparing drugs for treating at least one of anxiety disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, autism, dementia and schizophrenia.

title_en: SNP (single nucleotide polymorphism) locus related to weight of Chinese and bovine tendrils and application
abstract_en: The invention provides SNP loci related to the weight of Chinese and bovine tendrils of money on a bovine chromosome 21, wherein the locus of the SNP marker is 63471788 nucleotide loci on the international bovine reference genome UMD3.1 version chromosome 21, and the base of the locus is T or C. By optimizing the dominant allele of the SNP, the invention can increase the frequency of the dominant allele generation by generation, improve the weight of the Chinese and cattle tendinous tendon, accelerate the genetic improvement progress of cattle and effectively improve the economic benefit of beef cattle breeding.

title_en: Method for promoting skeletal muscle development, inhibitor for promoting skeletal muscle development and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for promoting skeletal muscle development, an inhibitor for promoting skeletal muscle development and application. A method for promoting skeletal muscle development by inhibiting ITGB6 gene expression, an ITGB6 gene inhibitor for promoting skeletal muscle development and application thereof in lean type pig breeding are provided. Provides a new target spot and a new research direction for promoting the development of skeletal muscle and provides a new idea for the breeding of lean type pig strains.

title_en: Separation method of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a separation method of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and application thereof, wherein the separation method comprises the following steps: (1) shearing the separated and washed tumor tissue, and diluting; (2) Mixing the diluted solution with hyaluronidase, DNase and type II collagenase, digesting, filtering, centrifuging and collecting cell precipitate; (3) Removing erythrocytes, fibroblasts and fibroblasts in the cell pellet; (4) Finally removing tumor cells by using lymphocyte separating liquid to obtain tumor infiltrating lymphocytes. The separation method is simple and easy to operate, and the separated tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes have high activity and purity and show good anti-tumor activity.

title_en: Methods and materials for assessing and treating cancer
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods and materials for detecting and/or treating a subject (e.g., a human) having cancer. In some embodiments, methods and materials are provided for identifying a subject as having cancer (e.g., localized cancer), wherein the presence of one or more members of two or more classes of biomarkers is detected. In some embodiments, methods and materials are provided for identifying a subject as having cancer (e.g., localized cancer), wherein the presence of one or more members of at least one class of biomarkers and the presence of aneuploidy are detected. In some embodiments, the methods described herein provide increased sensitivity and/or specificity for detecting cancer in a subject (e.g., a human).

title_en: Analysis system and method
abstract_en: A system, method, and computer-readable medium that enables a user to specify user-defined analysis parameters of an analysis protocol for processing a sample and causing a computer-controlled analyzer to perform an analytical method according to the analysis protocol.

title_en: Dipeptide-modified cyanine dye compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dipeptide modified cyanine dye compound, which has the following structural general formula: wherein R is 1 、R 2 The electronic effect, the luminous performance and the water solubility of the new compound (HCHMC-Leu) can be adjusted for the introduced substituent. The novel compound (HCHMC-Leu) provided by the invention is a brand new organic compound. The novel cyanine dye derivative is prepared from a hemicyanine dye derivative (HCHMC) and a dipeptide (cysteine leucine: Cys-Leu) through a nucleophilic substitution reaction, and meanwhile, the novel compound can specifically interact with biological enzyme LAP, causes a compound fluorescence signal to generate a ratio type change, and can be used for detecting the LAP.

title_en: Molecular marker for prenatal noninvasive diagnosis of cleft lip and palate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and relates to a prenatal noninvasive diagnosis molecular marker for cleft lip and palate and application thereof. The molecular marker for prenatal noninvasive diagnosis of cleft lip and palate fetus consists of 4 genes EN2, LIN28A, HHIP and GLI 2. The molecular marker for prenatal noninvasive diagnosis of cleft lip and palate fetal is applied to preparation of prenatal screening, early warning, clinical diagnosis and biochemical detection products for cleft lip and palate fetal. The invention discovers and verifies that the gene or protein expression abnormality of EN2, LIN28A, HHIP and GLI2 has close correlation with the occurrence of cleft lip and palate fetuses for the first time, and has large amount of verified samples and accurate result. The relevance is provided to provide a new approach for prenatal screening, early warning and diagnosis of cleft lip and palate fetuses. The marker related to prenatal noninvasive diagnosis of the cleft lip fetus, provided by the invention, provides a prenatal diagnosis or risk monitoring service for the cleft lip fetus, and consultative services for diagnosis and prognosis are cooperatively or independently sold to hospitals and clinics.

title_en: Antibody-free modified magnetic bead capable of rapidly capturing and detecting pathogenic bacteria and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibody-free modified magnetic bead capable of rapidly capturing and detecting pathogenic bacteria and a preparation method thereof. The magnetic beads prepared by the method are simple to manufacture, and the method is a one-tube in-situ two-step method without additional modification. The prepared magnetic beads rapidly capture pathogenic bacteria by utilizing an electrostatic adsorption principle, and meanwhile, due to high biocompatibility of the magnetic beads, the magnetic beads carrying bacteria can be directly added into a PCR reaction solution, so that bacteria lysis and nucleic acid amplification are synchronously performed, and a pathogenic bacteria detection result is simply and rapidly obtained.

title_en: Large fungus strain with high cadmium resistance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a large fungus strain with high cadmium resistance and application thereof, wherein the strain is named as Pleurotus ostreatus (Pleurotus ostreatus) pleur-jn 21-2F1, is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center on 08-11 months in 2020, and has a preservation number of CGMCC No. 20239. The invention also discloses application of the strain in repairing cadmium-containing polluted soil or water. The large-scale fungus strain pleur-jn 21-2F1 provided by the invention is used for repairing cadmium-containing soil or water, the operation process is simple, the cost is low, the strain has a good cadmium enrichment effect, and the soil or water repairing efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Polypeptide for promoting pig body to generate broad-spectrum immune response and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide for promoting a pig organism to generate a broad-spectrum immune response and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biomedicine; the polypeptide comprises one or more of a first polypeptide, a second polypeptide, a third polypeptide, a fourth polypeptide and a fifth polypeptide; the amino acid sequences of the first polypeptide, the second polypeptide, the third polypeptide, the fourth polypeptide and the fifth polypeptide are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-SEQ ID NO. 5. The polypeptide can remarkably promote IFN-beta signal path activation in a pig organism, promote mononuclear macrophages, T cells and B cells to secrete IFN-gamma, and promote spleen lymphocytes and the mononuclear macrophages to proliferate, so that the pig organism is promoted to generate broad-spectrum immune response; in addition, the polypeptide of the invention can promote the ASFV antigen specific immune response in pigs, thus being capable of being used as an effective component of ASFV subunit vaccine to enhance the immune response of pigs.

title_en: Frizzled-7 targeted antibody fusion protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Frizzled-7 targeted antibody fusion protein, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of bioengineering. Compared with the prior art, the humanized antibody SHH002-hu1 of the targeting Fzd7 and the MICA protein are fused and expressed in a genetic engineering mode, the design combines the treatment and immune activation of the targeting Fzd7 for the first time, and the antibody part of the fusion protein is combined with the tumor cells positively expressing Fzd7 to anchor the MICA molecules on the surface of the tumor cells; and then the MICA is specifically combined with an NK cell surface membrane receptor NKG2D, the NK cells are gathered to a tumor focus and activated to exert the killing effect on the tumor cells, so that the immune escape of the tumor in conventional antibody treatment is avoided, and the anti-tumor effect of the antibody is enhanced.

title_en: Application of degradable composite material in humidity control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of application of biological materials, and discloses application of a degradable composite material in humidity adjustment. The degradable composite material comprises a three-dimensional net structure formed by fungal hyphae and at least one lignocellulose fragment fixed by the three-dimensional net structure. The invention utilizes the growth of hypha to wind the lignocellulose fragments to form a composite structure of the hypha and the lignocellulose fragments, and the material has better moisture absorption and release capacity and can be used as a moisture control material. In addition, the composite material is a natural degradable organic humidity-controlling material, and is green and safe.

title_en: UCP3 gene related to pig intramuscular fat character, molecular marker and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UCP3 gene related to the intramuscular fat character of pigs, a molecular marker and application thereof, wherein the SNP molecular marker is positioned in a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO: 6 at 2159bp, and at a genomic position 8387309 from the 5' end of chromosome 9 of porcine version 11.1. Firstly, identifying a variation site influencing the intramuscular fat content of pigs in 279 test swinery by utilizing a Fasttarget target region sequencing technology, and establishing a PCR-RsaI-RFLP gene rapid typing method aiming at the site; on the basis, the application effect of the site for improving the intramuscular fat in 500 test swineries is verified, the result shows that the intramuscular fat content of the swinery can be obviously improved by selecting the favorable genotype of the site, and the identified mutation site can be used for early, living and rapid marking auxiliary breeding of the intramuscular fat of the boar.

title_en: Application of siRNA for inhibiting GAN gene expression
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of siRNA for inhibiting GAN gene expression, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine, wherein the siRNA for inhibiting GAN gene expression is at least one of the following two siRNAs: the nucleotide sequence of a sense strand of the GAN-siRNA-1 is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of a reaction strand of the GAN-siRNA-1 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2; the nucleotide sequence of the sense strand of the GAN-siRNA-3 is shown as SEQ ID NO.3, and the nucleotide sequence of the reaction strand thereof is shown as SEQ ID NO. 4. The GAN-siRNA-1 and GAN-siRNA-3 designed by the invention can well inhibit the expression of GAN genes in HCT-116 and HCT-8 cells, and the GAN-siRNA and 5-fluorouracil can be combined to treat colorectal cancer.

title_en: Circulation formula microorganism ventilation fermentation cylinder self-cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating type automatic cleaning device for a microbial ventilation fermentation tank, which is structurally provided with a cap, a driving machine, a cooling water inlet, a sampling port, a gas discharge inlet, a tank body and a foot rest, wherein a movable clamping plate extends under the action of centrifugal force until the movable clamping plate is abutted against the side wall of a fermentation inner container, a sliding ball slides towards a fan-shaped head in a clamping groove under the swinging of the centrifugal force to enable the fan-shaped head to be in close contact with the side wall of the fermentation inner container as much as possible, the sliding ball scrapes the side wall in a rotating mode, the sliding ball enters a containing diameter to generate extrusion force on a contracted end, spring steel is extruded to transmit pressure to a side angle fixing block, the contraction of the contracted end drives an arc-shaped end to extend, the side angle fixing block is compressed and then expands towards two sides in an arc direction to increase the extension force of the arc-shaped end, a first compressed bag is compressed, a second compressed bag is compressed, and the expansion degree of the contacting end head is concave, the contact end head is enabled to carry out attaching and wiping activities in the state of the maximum extension degree, and residual grease is ensured to be scraped cleanly.

title_en: Vaccination against porcine circovirus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for treating or preventing diseases caused by porcine circovirus. The invention discloses inter alia a method for controlling PCV infection or disease in a herd of pigs, comprising (i) vaccinating a sow against PCV at weaning and (ii) vaccinating a piglet against PCV at an age of 2 to 7 weeks.

title_en: Anaerobic fermentation method for organic domestic garbage in villages and towns
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for anaerobic fermentation of organic domestic garbage in villages and towns, and particularly relates to a method for applying an ammonia nitrogen adsorption film material to an anaerobic fermentation process, wherein the preparation method of the ammonia nitrogen adsorption film material comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a FeZn Prussian blue compound, dissolving Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) in N, N Dimethylformamide (DMF), stirring until the Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) is completely dissolved, adding the FeZn Prussian blue compound, and continuously stirring and uniformly dispersing to obtain an electrostatic spinning solution; and adding the electrostatic spinning solution into an injector of an electrostatic spinning machine, and spinning to obtain the FeZn Prussian blue/polyacrylonitrile composite nano-fiber membrane. The composite nanofiber membrane has the advantages of large ammonia nitrogen adsorption amount, stable performance and simple preparation method, and has great application potential for adsorbing ammonia nitrogen and eliminating ammonia inhibition in the anaerobic fermentation process of rural organic domestic garbage.

title_en: Method for removing triphenylphosphine oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing triphenylphosphine oxide. Adding water into a reaction mixture of a compound shown in the formula I and isopentyl triphenyl phosphonium bromide to quench the reaction, adding an extracting agent into the reaction mixture to stir, standing for layering, and washing the obtained organic phase with water; concentrating under reduced pressure, replacing methanol to be thick, cooling, crystallizing, filtering, and drying a filter cake to obtain a compound of a formula II which does not contain triphenylphosphine basically; or water-out to obtain the compound of formula II which is substantially free of triphenylphosphine oxide.

title_en: Lilium regale chitinase gene LrCHI2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Lilium regale chitinase gene LrCHI2 The nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO:1, encoding the polypeptide shown as SEQ ID NO:2 in the sequence table 2. The invention is proved by related technical research of functional genomics LrCHI2 The gene has the function of improving the resistance of plants to pathogenic fungi. The antifungal gene of the present invention LrCHI2 Constructed on plant expression vector and transferred into tobacco for over-expression and over-expression LrCHI2 The transgenic tobacco has stronger capability of resisting infection of the nigrospora oryzae, the sphaerica reticulata and the fusarium oxysporum.

title_en: RT-LAMP amplification system for visual virus nucleic acid RNA detection and application
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of nucleic acid detection, and particularly discloses an RT-LAMP amplification system for visual viral nucleic acid RNA detection and application thereof, wherein the RT-LAMP amplification system for visual viral nucleic acid RNA detection consists of a template, a primer group, a reaction solution and deionized water; the CRISPR system used for visual detection of the viral nucleic acid RNA consists of Cas12a enzyme or Cas12b enzyme, guide RNA, RNase inhibitor, ssDNA fluorescence quenching probe and the like, and the RT-LAMP amplification system used for visual detection of the viral nucleic acid RNA is as follows: the volume ratio of the CRISPR system is 0.1-5.0: 1. The whole detection process can be finished within 30-45min, and the accuracy and reliability of the detection result are high, so that the method is suitable for on-site, rapid and high-sensitivity detection of nucleic acid.

title_en: Novel proto-oncoprotein SET inhibitor, fusion polypeptide thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly discloses a novel protooncoprotein SET inhibitor, a fusion polypeptide thereof and application thereof; the amino acid sequence of the proto-oncoprotein SET inhibitor is SEQ ID NO.1, SEQ ID NO.2 and SEQ ID NO.3. The amino acid sequence of the corresponding fusion polypeptide is SEQ ID NO.4, SEQ ID NO.5, SEQ ID NO.5. Can inhibit cell proliferation mediated by SET protein at the level of 1 micromolar concentration, realizes good tumor inhibition effect in vitro and in vivo experiments, and has potential new drug development value.

title_en: Anti-idiotypic antibody for detecting Anti-CD19 CAR expression level and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides Anti-idiotypic antibodies that detect the expression level of Anti-CD19 CAR and uses thereof. In particular, the invention provides an anti-idiotypic antibody that specifically binds to the antigen binding site of a CAR, the six CDRs of which comprise: GDFRYFSW; IDNDDSIT; RAYRYMYDPR, respectively; KVSSTSSGYY, respectively; ALN; QTFYGSELP are provided. The antibody can specifically evaluate the transfection positive rate of the Anti-CD19 CAR gene derived from FMC63 clone number antibody and the change rule of the number of Anti-CD19 CAR positive T cells in a patient after the administration of the antibody.

title_en: A pharmaceutical composition containing immunocyte for treating virus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for viral therapy comprising immune cells. The immune cell composition comprises a monoclonal antibody specifically aiming at varicella-zoster virus envelope glycoprotein, the monoclonal antibody has better binding property and virus inhibition effect, and experiments in a mouse model together with immune cells show that the monoclonal antibody can effectively improve the treatment effect on the virus infection of the mouse skin, and has better application value and application prospect.

title_en: Efficient genetic transformation technology for duckweed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency genetic transformation technology for duckweed, which comprises the following steps: 1) Inducing the duckweed callus; 2) Growing the callus; 3) Co-culturing after agrobacterium infection; 4) Callus differentiation culture: (1) selecting and culturing under a nursing culture condition; (2) ZT differentiation culture; 5. expanding culture of the duckweed fronds: (1) solid expanding culture; (2) liquid culture and other steps. The invention fills the technical blank of the duckweed exogenous protein expression system, and has the following advantages: (1) the transformation efficiency is high, the infection success positive rate of the callus is 100 percent, the differentiation rate of the callus is as high as 51.3 percent, and the rooting rate of the transgenic plant is as high as 100 percent; (2) the method is simple and easy to operate, the process cycle is short, and only 11-12 weeks are needed; (3) the obtained transgenic plant is stable in heredity; (4) the method has the advantages of high yield, low cost, high safety, wide application and great benefit. The invention has great popularization value.

title_en: Formula of composite microbial flora preparation for improving aerobic dynamic composting efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula of a compound microbial flora preparation for improving aerobic dynamic composting efficiency, belonging to the technical field of environmental microorganisms. The Zhangzhou bacillus preparation is prepared from Zhangzhou bacillus preparation, marine bacillus subtilis preparation, pseudomonas preparation, bacillus vallismortis preparation and bacillus amyloliquefaciens preparation. All microbial inoculum has synergistic effect, and the Zhangzhou bacillus microbial inoculum is nitrogen nitrifying bacteria and can degrade ammonia nitrogen; the pseudomonas agent can rapidly utilize starch and protein in the raw materials to start fermentation; the marine bacillus subtilis microbial inoculum can break crystalline fibers and prolong the high-temperature period in the composting process; the bacillus vallismortis and bacillus amyloliquefaciens have broad-spectrum bactericidal activity. As most of the degradable substances in the compost raw materials are decomposed, the temperature of the compost starts to drop, and the compost enters a decomposition stage. The strain provided by the invention is novel in combination, high in viable count and strong in synergistic effect.

title_en: Mutant N4BP2 gene related to non-syndromic cleft lip and palate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutated N4BP2 Gene related to non-syndrome cleft lip and palate and application thereof, wherein the mutated N4BP2 Gene contains a non-frameshift deletion mutation site 4:40133481-40133489 delaGATATTT in the 13 th exon and a missense mutation site 4:40123905T > G and a missense mutation site 4:40122958C > T in the 9 th exon respectively compared with an unmutated N4BP2 Gene with the accession number of Gene bank as NM-018177.6, and the mutated N4BP2 Gene can be used for preparing a diagnostic kit for detecting the non-syndrome cleft lip and palate diseases. The discovery of the mutation site can guide the family offspring to the good prenatal and postnatal care, and can be used as a carrier screening and prenatal diagnosis screening site of the genetic disease of non-syndrome cleft lip and palate for guiding the good prenatal and postnatal care of the population.

title_en: Construction method of PD-1 knockout CD19CAR-T cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a PD-1 gene knockout CD19CAR-T cell, which comprises the following steps: a Nucleofector nuclear technology is adopted, a PiggyBac vector plasmid Piggybac-CAR-CD19 containing a single-chain antibody variable region gene fragment of CD19, a Transposase expression plasmid Piggybac Transposase, an sgRNA expression plasmid pGL3-U6-hPD1sg1 containing a PD1 gene which can be successfully targeted, and a pST1374-NLS-flag-Cas9-ZF plasmid are co-transfected into a T cell, and the PD-1 gene knockout CD19CAR-T cell is obtained. The experiment of the invention proves that: the PD-1 knockout immune cell has higher cell killing capacity than a PD-1 knockout CD19CAR-T cell.

title_en: Application of long-chain non-coding RNA in preparation of hepatocellular carcinoma diagnostic product or therapeutic drug
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of gene therapy and medical diagnosis, in particular to application of long-chain non-coding RNA in preparation of a hepatocellular carcinoma diagnostic reagent or a kit. The invention also provides application of the long non-coding RNA in preparation of a hepatocellular carcinoma treatment drug. The invention discovers that lncRNA-RNA Pol I regulated is long-chain non-coding RNA which is highly expressed in hepatocellular carcinoma tissues for the first time, and provides a novel diagnosis marker and a novel treatment target for hepatocellular carcinoma.

title_en: Klebsiella variicola WX-01 capable of efficiently degrading butachlor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides Klebsiella variicola WX-01 for efficiently degrading butachlor and application thereof, wherein the strain is preserved in Guangdong province microorganism strain collection center in 11 and 19 months in 2020, and the preservation number is CDMCC NO: 61301. the Klebsiella variicola WX-01 provided by the invention has a degradation rate of 94.22% within 4 days when the initial concentration of butachlor is 1000mg/L, and has a good degradation effect within a wide pH and temperature range. The strain provided by the invention has very important application value in the aspect of removing pesticide residues in water, soil and other environments, can be used for a wastewater treatment system of a pesticide factory, and provides a gene resource library for transgenic resistant crops.

title_en: InDel marker fingerprint spectrum of shiitake fungus WD5140 strain and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an InDel marker fingerprint of a mushroom WD5140 strain and a construction method thereof, wherein the fingerprint consists of 7 InDel markers developed after sequencing based on a mushroom whole genome. The InDel marked fingerprint of the mushroom WD5140 strain can be used for the specificity identification of the mushroom WD5140 strain, has the advantages of short detection time, high accuracy and good repeatability, and has the specificity of the mushroom WD5140 strain in the collected 44 mushroom strains.

title_en: Kit for simultaneously detecting multiple biomarkers based on nucleic acid rolling circle amplification reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a kit for simultaneously detecting multiple biomarkers based on a nucleic acid rolling circle amplification reaction, and relates to the technical field of marker detection. The kit comprises four independent components: a specific antibody solution for labeling single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid; a magnetic bead suspension coating the specific antibody of the biomarker; a reaction solution containing a circular deoxyribonucleic acid; reaction solutions containing different probes. When the kit detects various markers, the kit is similar to the detection result of the Atlantic chemiluminescence, even lower concentration (ag/ml) can be detected in enough time, and the sensitivity is obviously better than that of the chemiluminescence detection method; such as in the detection of biomarkers of cardiovascular disease such as: when cardiac troponin I (cTnI), myoglobin (Myo) and creatine kinase isozyme (CKBB) are detected simultaneously in one reaction cup, and the results are not interfered with each other.

title_en: Artificial marker alleles
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing artificial marker alleles for identifying nucleic acids of interest in an organism. The invention also relates to methods of determining the presence of a nucleic acid of interest in a mixed population, and infiltrating the population with the nucleic acid of interest. The invention also relates to organisms, in particular plants and seeds, comprising such marker alleles and to various uses of artificial marker alleles.

title_en: Small RNA predictors for Alzheimer's disease
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods and kits for assessing Alzheimer's Disease (AD) activity, including in patients undergoing AD therapy or AD candidate therapy, as well as in animal and cell models. In particular, the present disclosure provides biomarkers (sRNA predictors), which are binary predictors of disease activity, and can be used to detect and/or assess AD disease stage, grade and progression, prognosis, and response to therapy or candidate therapy. The biomarkers are further useful in the context of drug discovery and clinical trials to identify candidate drug interventions (or other therapies) useful for the treatment of disease.

title_en: Application of pleiotropic gene SbSnf4 in improvement of cane sugar yield, plant height, fresh weight of stems and/or juice amount
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pleiotropic gene SbSnf4 and application thereof in increasing the yield of cane sugar and the amount of juice, wherein the gene SbSnf4 is a DNA molecule shown in SEQ ID NO.1 or a DNA molecule which is hybridized with a DNA sequence limited by SEQ ID NO.1 under strict conditions and encodes a protein related to increasing the sugar content and the biological yield; or has more than 99 percent of homology with the DNA sequence limited by SEQ ID NO.1 and encodes a DNA molecule of protein related to the improvement of the yield and the juice quantity of the cane sugar. The gene is positioned by the inventor through a correlation analysis method, the SbSnf4 gene is overexpressed in sugarcane, and the sugar yield, the plant height, the fresh weight of stems and the juice yield of transgenic sugarcane plants are obviously increased, namely the sugar yield and the biological yield of the sugarcane are successfully improved.

title_en: KASP primer combination for constructing grape DNA fingerprint atlas database and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a KASP primer combination for constructing a grape DNA fingerprint atlas database and application thereof, relating to the technical field of fingerprint atlas; the primer combination is designed by selecting 46 grape core SNP markers based on a bioinformatics method and combining scientific algorithms such as mathematical statistics and the like, and a DNA fingerprint spectrum library is established by utilizing the set of SNP marker combination, so that cluster analysis and variety identification can be carried out on grape varieties, the detection result is more accurate and efficient, 333 germplasms are effectively distinguished for the first time based on the set of primer combination markers, and the number of the maximum groups identified about grapes at present is obtained. In addition, under the condition that the DNA quality meets the requirements of general KASP reaction or conventional PCR reaction, the KASP primer combination provided by the invention has high accuracy and resolution ratio for detecting the quality of the grapes, the detection efficiency is 10-20 times of that of SSR markers, the detection cost is equivalent to that of the SSR markers, and in addition, toxic chemical reagents such as acrylamide and the like are not required to be used in the detection process.

title_en: Microorganism producing eicosapentaenoic acid and process for producing eicosapentaenoic acid
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a microorganism that efficiently produces EPA and a method for producing EPA using the microorganism. The present invention relates to a microorganism having an ability to produce docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), which comprises a protein (mutant OrfB) comprising an amino acid sequence in which at least one of amino acid residues at positions 6, 65, 230, 231 and 275 in the amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO. 2 is replaced with another amino acid residue, and which is capable of producing eicosapentaenoic acid.

title_en: Methods and compositions for forming ligation products
abstract_en: In some aspects, the present disclosure provides methods of forming ligation products comprising single-stranded polynucleotides without enriching for single-stranded polynucleotides. The ligation products formed by the various aspects of the present disclosure can be used in a variety of applications, including but not limited to sequence analysis. In some embodiments, the ligation product comprises a cell-free polynucleotide. In some aspects, the present disclosure provides reaction mixtures, kits, and complexes consistent with the methods herein.

title_en: Preparation of canine Brain Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology. The invention relates to a polypeptide containing two dominant epitopes of canine Brain Natriuretic Peptide (BNP), which enhances the immune effect by immunizing a mouse by coupling polypeptide with KLH protein. The invention also provides a recombinant protein which comprises two dominant epitopes of canine BNP, and in order to improve the yield of the recombinant protein in a prokaryotic expression system, the amino acid sequence of the recombinant protein is converted into a corresponding nucleotide sequence by adopting an escherichia coli preferred codon, and the nucleotide sequence is chemically synthesized and a recombinant protein expression vector is constructed. The invention also relates to a method for establishing a phage library by using the polypeptide-coupled KLH protein immunized mouse, obtaining a corresponding canine BNP single-chain antibody scfv sequence through panning and screening, constructing the obtained scfv sequence into a complete mouse IgG1 antibody sequence expression vector, expressing a monoclonal antibody through transient HEK293F cells, purifying the monoclonal antibody, and determining the optimal monoclonal antibody pairing combination through an immunofluorescence orthogonal experiment.

title_en: Longan single fruit weight character regulatory gene DlCNR8, protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a longan single fruit weight character regulatory gene DlCNR8, the nucleotide sequence of which is shown in SEQ ID No. 1. The invention is right DlCNR8 The gene is cloned, the sequence structure, the evolutionary relationship and the tissue expression of the gene are analyzed, and a fusion protein expression vector (35S: DlCNR8-GFP) is transferred into arabidopsis mesophyll protoplast cells by a PEG mediated method, and the subcellular localization condition of the gene is observed by a laser confocal microscope. Meanwhile, an overexpression vector is constructed and transformed into Mico Tom tomato for functional analysis. The results show that DlCNR8 The gene regulates the cell division rate to carry out negative regulation on the fruit weight by acting on downstream protein like tomato FW 2.2. The result not only lays an important foundation for the development of theoretical research on the weight/size of fruit trees such as longan and the like, but also provides important gene resources and molecular markers for the subsequent development of new variety breeding of large-fruit type longan by utilizing molecular-assisted breeding.

title_en: Aspergillus aculeatus and application thereof in resisting root-knot nematode
abstract_en: The invention discloses aspergillus aculeatus and application thereof in resisting root knot nematode. The invention provides Aspergillus aculeatus HH5-7 with the preservation registration number of CGMCC No. 21033. The invention also protects a method for preparing the aspergillus aculeatus HH5-7 extract, which comprises the following steps: taking a fermentation product of aspergillus aculeatus HH5-7, extracting by using an organic reagent,collecting the extract; distilling the extractive solution under reduced pressure to remove organic solvent and water to obtain extract. The invention also protects the application of the Aspergillus aculeatus HH5-7 or the extract, which is (a) or (b) as follows: (a) the application in preparing nematode inhibitor; (b) the application in inhibiting nematode. The invention also protects the application of the Aspergillus aculeatus HH5-7 or the extract in preparing the compound shown in the formula (I).

title_en: Chicken slaughter trait related TMEM18 gene molecular marker and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TMEM18 gene molecular marker related to chicken slaughter traits, which is positioned on a second intron of a TMEM18 gene, wherein the first base at the 5' end of a TMEM18 gene nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1 is used as a 1 st site, and C > T base mutation of the 765 th site is adopted. The invention also provides application of the molecular marker in genetic improvement of breeding hens, and the application can accelerate genetic progress of slaughter trait breeding, shorten improvement time of chicken flocks and effectively improve economic benefits of breeding hens.

title_en: PCR primer, kit and method for poultry sex identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a PCR primer, a kit and a method for identifying poultry sex, wherein the sequence of the PCR primer for identifying poultry sex is shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and/or SEQ ID NO. 2. The PCR primer is used for PCR amplification and agarose gel electrophoresis, and the sex of the duck, chicken, pigeon, Muscovy duck, goose or quail is determined by the number of bands of the electrophoresis result, so that the method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, quick and accurate identification result, convenience for basic popularization and use, wide market application prospect, and considerable economic benefit and good social value based on the detection kit developed by the method.

title_en: Strain for high-yield long-chain dibasic acid and fermentation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a candida tropicalis strain and a method for producing long-chain dibasic acid by utilizing the strain through fermentation. The strain is candida tropicalis (Candida tropicalis Am 2020) Am2020, and the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M2019418. The production method of the long-chain dibasic acid comprises the steps of preparing seed liquid by using the candida tropicalis strain (Candida tropicalis Am 2020) Am2020, and/or preparing seed liquid by using the candida tropicalis strain; fermenting to produce long-chain dibasic acid. The candida tropicalis strain (Candida tropicalis Am 2020) Am2020 disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the conversion efficiency of the candida tropicalis strain to a substrate is enhanced compared with that of a parent strain, the productivity of long-chain dibasic acid is improved, the production cost is reduced, the production of mixed acid in the fermentation process is less, the subsequent separation and purification are simple, the fermentation production process is easy to realize large-scale production, and the application prospect is good.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain capable of secreting histamine monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: A hybridoma cell strain secreting histamine monoclonal antibody and application thereof belong to the field of food safety immunoassay. The invention discloses a hybridoma cell strain HLQ6B2 secreting histamine monoclonal antibody, which is classified and named as monoclonal cell strain and preservedThe date of 2019, 11 and 28 months, and the preservation number is CGMCC No. 19182. BALB/c mice were immunized with a complete antigen of histamine. High potency, low IC 50 Spleen cells of a mouse are fused with myeloma cells of the mouse by a PEG method, the fused hybridoma cells are cultured by a culture medium, and then the cells are screened by an indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and are subcloned for three times, so that a hybridoma cell strain secreting the histamine monoclonal antibody is finally obtained. The monoclonal antibody secreted by the cell strain has better specificity and detection sensitivity (semi-inhibitory concentration IC) to histamine 50 22.86 ng/mL). The result of the invention can be used for establishing an immunoassay method for histamine content in aquatic products, dairy products and other foods rich in protein or free amino acid, and has practical application value.

title_en: CRISPR/Cas12a one-step nucleic acid detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a CRISPR/Cas12a one-step nucleic acid detection method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, selecting a target sequence of pathogenic bacteria to be detected, designing an RPA upstream primer and a downstream primer, carrying out specificity screening, amplifying the target sequence to obtain a primer amplicon sequence, and carrying out specificity verification on the primer amplicon sequence by using NCBI BLAST; step 2, designing specific crRNA; step 3, designing a single-stranded DNA reporter molecule; step 4, mixing single-stranded DNA reporter molecules, RPA upstream and downstream primers, freeze-dried RPA reaction particles, magnesium acetate, RPA hydration buffer, NEB buffer2.1 and RNase Inhibitor with a target to be detected to obtain a reaction mixture; step 5, constructing a one-step detection kit comprising a reactant placing tube and a syringe, placing a reaction mixture at the bottom of the reactant placing tube, and pre-loading crRNA and Cas12a protein into the syringe; and step 6, after the reaction mixture reacts, pushing a piston of the injector to mix the crRNA and the Cas12a protein with the reaction mixture for reaction, and then exciting by blue light to obtain a detection result.

title_en: Umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell recovery culture medium and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a stem cell culture technology, and particularly relates to a recovery culture medium for umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells, and a preparation method and application thereof. The umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell recovery culture medium provided by the invention replaces a mesenchymal stem cell complete culture medium commonly adopted in the existing method, and the growth of the recovered umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells is promoted by means of active substances secreted by various cells in the proliferation process, so that the activity of the recovered umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells is improved. In addition, the nutritional factors in the culture supernatant are wrapped by utilizing the nanotechnology, so that the nutrient substances are more stable in the culture process, and in addition, the nanoemulsion formed by hyaluronic acid can replace the carrier effect of serum protein in a culture medium, so that the proliferation capacity of stem cells is further improved.

title_en: Biological energy source biogas reaction furnace convenient to move
abstract_en: The invention provides a biological energy biogas reaction furnace convenient to move, which comprises a reaction furnace body, wherein universal wheels are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom surface of the reaction furnace body through bolts, a receiving hopper placing plate is welded at the bottom of the side surface of the reaction furnace body, a rotary square hole is formed in the reaction furnace body, a rotary hole is formed in the rotary square hole, rotary shafts are arranged at two sides of a transparent glass tank, the transparent glass tank is arranged on the rotary square hole through the matching of the rotary shafts and the rotary hole, an upper matching hole and a lower matching hole are arranged at two sides of the reaction furnace body, an asynchronous rolling wheel group comprises an upper rolling wheel and a lower rolling wheel, an upper rolling shaft is arranged on the upper rolling wheel, a lower rolling shaft is arranged on the lower rolling wheel, the upper rolling wheel is arranged on the reaction furnace body through the matching of the upper rolling shaft and the upper matching hole, and the biological energy biogas reaction furnace has high automation, Simple operation, environmental protection and suitability for popularization.

title_en: Waste treatment device for clean energy production and treatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste treatment device for clean energy production and a treatment method thereof. According to the invention, the rotating column, the connecting rod and the shovel plate are arranged, and the rotating column is rotated to drive the connecting rod to rotate through the cooperation of the rotating mechanism, the connecting rod is rotated to drive the shovel plate to rotate, so that the shovel plate shovels the waste straws at the bottom of the fermentation cavity, the shoveled straws move along with the shovel plate, and the straws fall along with the action of gravity after reaching a certain height, so that the straws at the bottom can be fully contacted with microorganisms in the falling process, and the production efficiency of methane is improved.

title_en: Method for carrying out gene editing on cells based on CRISPR/Cas system
abstract_en: A method for gene editing of a cell based on CRISPRLCAS system is provided, wherein Cas enzyme is Cas9 enzyme with enzyme activity of 0-1 nmoI. Also provided is a method for constructing a general T cell, the T cell thus prepared and its use, wherein TCR genes and MHC genes of the T cell are genetically edited by a gene editing technique. A gRNA construct is also provided.

title_en: anti-PCSK 9 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to anti-PCSK 9 antibodies and uses thereof, preferably for the treatment of hypercholesterolemia.

title_en: Single nucleotide polymorphism genotyping method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single nucleotide polymorphism genotyping method, which comprises the following steps: s10, establishing an experiment group and an experiment unit, and inputting relevant information required by an experiment; s20, carrying out sample application operation on a sample to be tested placed on a two-dimensional platform of the mass spectrometer according to the related information; s30, creating target plate information and task information of the sample to be detected after sample application, and sending a scanning instruction to a mass spectrometer so that the mass spectrometer can scan the sample according to the target plate information and the task information generated by sample application, and storing scanning data into a memory; s40, comparing and analyzing the scanning data and the gene locus data to obtain a single nucleotide polymorphism genotyping result of the sample to be tested.

title_en: Primer group, kit and method for detecting mycoplasma pneumoniae
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primer group, a kit and a method for detecting Mycoplasma Pneumoniae (MP), wherein the primer group comprises an MP outer primer pair, an MP inner primer pair and an MP ring primer pair, the sequences of the MP outer primer pair are shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 and SEQ ID NO. 2, the sequences of the MP inner primer pair are shown as SEQ ID NO. 3 and SEQ ID NO. 4, and the sequences of the MP ring primer pair are shown as SEQ ID NO. 5 and SEQ ID NO. 6. The primer group, the kit and the method provided by the invention have the advantages of high sensitivity (up to 100 copies/reaction), accurate detection, high detection speed and simple detection process.

title_en: Three-flow-plate-bending reactor for mariculture wastewater treatment and microalgae culture harvesting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-flow-plate reactor for mariculture wastewater treatment and microalgae culture and harvesting, wherein each stage of fluidized bed reactor is provided with an arc bottom plate and an aeration plate, the aeration plate is of an inverted Y-shaped structure and comprises a main plate and two side plates which are fixedly connected, the two side plates are fixedly connected with the arc bottom plate, and the highest point of the main plate is lower than that of an isolation plate; aeration holes are formed in the water lifting side surface of the main plate and the water feeding side surfaces of the two side plates, and through holes are formed in the two side plates; the front two-stage arc bottom plate is fixedly connected with the bottom plate of the fluidized bed reactor, an enrichment cavity is arranged between the last-stage arc bottom plate and the bottom plate of the fluidized bed reactor, and a hollow fiber membrane assembly is arranged on one side, away from the partition plate, of the main plate in the last stage.
