On the basis of treating the mariculture wastewater, the invention solves the problems of low microalgae culture efficiency, difficult harvesting and the like, and realizes the purpose of synchronous treatment and harvesting.

title_en: Serratia LE and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganism screening. The invention provides Serratia LE and application thereof, wherein Serratia liquidianvorans is Serratia liquidianvorans. The serratia LE can dissolve inorganic phosphorus, convert indissolvable inorganic phosphorus into soluble phosphorus which can be utilized by plants, and improve the utilization of the plants to soil phosphorus. Therefore, the phosphorus utilization efficiency of crops can be improved by the phosphate solubilizing bacteria in agricultural production, so that the dependence on chemical phosphate fertilizers is reduced, and the efficient and environment-friendly agricultural green development of the phosphate fertilizers is realized.

title_en: Preparation and application of inactivated vaccine of gE/gI gene deletion strain of pseudorabies virus FJ-2012 strain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gene deletion strain of pseudorabies virus FJ-2012 strain gE/I, which is named as a pseudorabies virus FJ-2012 delta gE/gI strain with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: V202025. According to the invention, a gE/gI gene deletion strain of a new pseudorabies virus variation FJ-2012 strain is used as a vaccine seed virus, formaldehyde is inactivated through amplification culture and then the inactivated vaccine is prepared into an inactivated vaccine immune sheep with different adjuvants, the inactivated vaccine is attacked by a parental virulent strain FJ-2012 strain after being immunized for 4 weeks, the inactivated vaccine provides complete immune protection effect on the immune sheep, and the method is suitable for identifying and diagnosing wild virus infection or vaccine immunity by using a general gE ELISA identification and diagnosis kit at present.

title_en: Real-time PCR detection method of human H group rotavirus
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses a Real-time PCR quantitative detection method for human H group rotavirus, wherein an upstream primer F for the Real-time PCR quantitative detection comprises SEQ ID No.1 and a sequence which has at least 70% homology with the SEQ ID No. 1; the downstream primer R comprises SEQ ID No.2 and a sequence which has at least 70 percent of homology with SEQ ID No. 2; the probe comprises SEQ ID No.3 and a sequence which has at least 70% homology with SEQ ID No. 3. The Real-time PCR cycling conditions were: reverse transcription is carried out for 5-8min at the temperature of 48-55 ℃, PCR is started to be activated for 20s-50s at the temperature of 95 ℃, denaturation is carried out for 10-20s at the temperature of 95 ℃, annealing and extension are carried out for 50-70s at the temperature of 55-65 ℃, 35-45 cycles are carried out, and a fluorescence signal is detected after each cycle. The method can quickly and effectively detect the human H group rotavirus infection. The detection method has the advantages of higher detection sensitivity and specificity, simple operation and convenient application, and provides feasible technical support for monitoring H group rotavirus and preventing and controlling H group rotavirus infection diseases in the fields of clinical diagnosis, inspection and quarantine and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of wild Jin Chaishe fermented and processed oral liquid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of traditional Chinese medicine processing and microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of wild Jin Chaishe fermented oral liquid. The invention uses wild Jin Chaigan leaves and wild chrysanthemum as basic culture medium, obtains special strain for fermentation processing through induction training procedure, the metabolic activity of the strain is more beneficial to the full utilization and release of active ingredients in medicinal material tissues and cells during fermentation processing, and a series of bioactive ingredients can be produced, and the prepared wild golden firewood oral liquid is newly added with bioactive products and flavor substances after lactobacillus fermentation, has improved taste, and has various health care functions and natural flavor.

title_en: Kit and method for detecting human pressure sensitivity genotype
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit and a method for detecting human pressure sensitivity genotype. The invention adopts multiple PCR amplification and electrophoresis methods to analyze and identify the allelic polymorphism (SNP) of 5 genes: MAOA, PPP1R1B, COX10, CADM2 and COMT, comprising the steps of: a) collecting the cells dropped off from the oral cavity of a testee, storing the cells in a collection card or extracting DNA nucleic acid from a blood sample; b) adding a saliva acquisition card sample or an extracted DNA sample of a testee into a reaction system for PCR amplification; c) running an amplification program; d) and carrying out electrophoretic analysis on the amplification products, and judging according to a peak pattern. And analyzing and interpreting the result. The invention can synchronously detect the SNP of a plurality of genes related to a testee, and realizes the simplicity, high efficiency and specificity of detection. The analysis provides reference for the resistance of the testee to the pressure.

title_en: Acetylcholine esterase inhibitory peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acetylcholinesterase inhibiting peptide, the amino acid sequence of which is Leu-Ser-Glu-Lys (LSEK). The LSEK provided by the invention has obvious selective inhibition effect on acetylcholinesterase, can adjust and control the activity of the acetylcholinesterase in the brain, and reduce the hydrolysis of the acetylcholinesterase in the brain, thereby obviously improving the improvement effect on dysmnesia, has good water solubility, lower toxicity on liver, can be widely applied to medicines or health-care foods for preventing and treating Alzheimer's disease, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Purification method of recombinant human erythropoietin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a purification method of erythropoietin, which comprises a specific sequence of purification steps. Compared with the existing purification method, the method has simple process, and can obtain the recombinant human erythropoietin protein with high purity and high activity.

title_en: Clone and application of rice plant height gene qPH-IAA30
abstract_en: The invention aims to separate and clone a new gene qPH-IAA30 mediating the height of rice plants and a coding protein thereof, and after the gene is knocked out by a genetic engineering technology, the plant height of crops such as rice and the like can be regulated and controlled; provides the application of the gene in rice molecular marker-assisted selective breeding.

title_en: anti-CXCR2 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are human antibody molecules that immunospecifically bind to human CXCR2. The disclosed human antibody molecules are potent and selective antagonists of CXCR2 function and prevent neutrophils from entering tissues without a strong depletion of circulating neutrophil numbers. Also provided are pharmaceutical compositions, nucleic acid molecules, vectors, cells, and uses of the disclosed antibodies.

title_en: Streptococcus mutans specific targeting antibacterial peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a streptococcus mutans specific targeted antibacterial peptide and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological engineering, wherein the amino acid sequence of the streptococcus mutans specific targeted antibacterial peptide is TFFRLFNRGGGRRWWRF, and the streptococcus mutans specific targeted antibacterial peptide is formed by combining a CSP fragment and a short-chain artificial antibacterial peptide. The narrow-spectrum and high-efficiency antibacterial characteristics of the heterosexual targeting antibacterial peptide are adopted to prompt that the streptococcus mutans specific targeting antibacterial peptide obtained by connecting the targeting peptide fragment capable of being specifically combined with the surface of streptococcus mutans with the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide fragment has the application potential of preventing and treating caries, the narrow-spectrum antibacterial medicament is used for selectively reducing the content of main cariogenic bacteria (such as streptococcus mutans) in dental plaque, so that the non-cariogenic bacteria are converted into dominant bacteria, the re-planting of the cariogenic bacteria can be effectively inhibited, and finally the purpose of preventing the caries for a long time is achieved.

title_en: Precision equipment for quickly carrying out polymerase chain reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses precision equipment for rapidly carrying out polymerase chain reaction. The heating unit comprises a plurality of temperature conduction modules and a plurality of temperature change pastes which are in one-to-one correspondence; the temperature of the variable temperature pastes is different; the temperature conduction module is provided with a plurality of slotted holes, and the slotted holes are connected at the center of the projection of the bottom end of the temperature conduction module to form a straight line; the test tube comprises a plurality of sample tubes, and the sample tubes can be correspondingly inserted into a plurality of slotted holes formed in any temperature conduction module one by one. According to the invention, different temperature points required by PCR reaction are arranged on the temperature conduction module, the sample tube is directly inserted into the slotted hole according to different reaction steps in the reaction process, so that the DNA polymerase in the sample tube rapidly reaches the required temperature, and the temperature conduction module is always at the required temperature point, so that reheating is not required in the process of changing the temperature of the sample tube, the temperature flushing phenomenon is avoided, and the accuracy of the experimental result is ensured.

title_en: Construction and application of T-ALL drug resistance model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a specific knock-down reagent of an MAEL gene in preparing a medicine for reversing T-ALL drug resistance symptoms. The invention also discloses a cell derived from a T-ALL organism, comprising a disruption in a target DNA sequence encoding MAEL, wherein the disruption results in a decrease in the expression of the MAEL gene.

title_en: Clostridium butyricum, microbial inoculum, application of clostridium butyricum and microbial inoculum and preparation method of microbial inoculum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microorganisms, and discloses clostridium butyricum, a microbial inoculum, application of the clostridium butyricum and the microbial inoculum, and a preparation method of the microbial inoculum. Clostridium butyricum (C) Clostridium butyricum ) The preservation number of (2) is CGMCC No. 20417. The strain is derived from caecum contents of healthy pigs; has better antibacterial activity and butyric acid production performance. The microecological preparation prepared from clostridium butyricum has the function of regulating the intestinal tracts of animals, and butyric acid generated by the metabolism of the microecological preparation can reduce the pH value of the intestinal tracts and inhibit the growth of harmful bacteria; when used together with other microorganisms as a water adjusting agent, the water quality can be improved.

title_en: Application of PP2CG1 gene in regulation of low temperature stress resistance of arabidopsis thaliana
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a PP2CG1 gene in regulating and controlling low temperature stress resistance of arabidopsis thaliana. The invention discloses that the PP2CG1 gene has the capacity of regulating and controlling low-temperature stress resistance of arabidopsis thaliana for the first time, the PP2CG1 gene is knocked out in arabidopsis thaliana, and the obtained mutant plant shows a remarkable low-temperature resistance phenotype compared with wild arabidopsis thaliana. Therefore, the PP2CG1 gene is related to low temperature resistance of Arabidopsis thaliana. The invention provides a valuable gene resource for cultivating new varieties of low-temperature resistant plants. The invention also provides a CRISPR/Cas9 mutant material of the plant protein phosphatase gene PP2CG1, and after the PP2CG1 gene is knocked out, the plant shows a low temperature resistant phenotype. The mutant material of the invention provides new germplasm resources for cultivating low temperature stress resistant plants, and lays a theoretical foundation for researching the mechanism of the plants responding to low temperature stress and the molecular mechanism of resisting adverse environment.

title_en: Bovine pathogenic bacillus cereus indirect ELISA detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microbial detection technology, in particular to an indirect ELISA detection kit for bovine pathogenic bacillus cereus. The method is characterized in that: the indirect ELISA detection kit takes bovine pathogenic bacillus cereus suspension as a coating antigen. Has the advantages that: the prepared detection kit is suitable for detecting bovine-derived pathogenic bacillus cereus, has the characteristics of strong detection specificity, high sensitivity, quick detection process, convenient operation and the like, and provides an effective technology and tool for preventing the infection of the bovine pathogenic bacillus cereus.

title_en: Amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide detection method and kit
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a kit for detecting amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide, which adopt a double-antibody sandwich method to detect the content of the amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide; by adopting the amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide detection method and the kit, the specificity and/or the detection rate of detection can be effectively improved.

title_en: Inactivated vaccine of goose astrovirus and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inactivated vaccine of goose astrovirus and a preparation method thereof, wherein a goose astrovirus N-GoAstV-190123 strain with strong toxicity and good immunity performance obtained by separation is taken as an antigen, and the strain can generate a high neutralizing antibody after being prepared into the inactivated vaccine for immunity, so that the goose group can be completely protected.

title_en: Alzheimer disease biomarker and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group of Alzheimer disease biomarkers and application thereof, in particular to application of the group of biomarkers and content change degree thereof in serum in prevention, diagnosis and preparation of diagnosis tools for Alzheimer disease, which comprises the following steps: compared with the average value of normal people, the expressions of apolipoprotein M, kininogen 1, platelet factor 4, intermediate alpha-globulin inhibitory factor H435 kDa fragment subtype and apolipoprotein A-IV26 kDa fragment subtype in serum are obviously reduced, and the reduction amplitude is more than or equal to 50 percent; compared with the average value of normal people, the content of apolipoprotein L1, the content ratio of apolipoprotein L1 to apolipoprotein M, the content ratio of the intermediate alpha-globulin inhibitor H4 full-length subtype to the intermediate alpha-globulin inhibitor H435 kDa fragment subtype, and the content ratio of the apolipoprotein A-IV full-length subtype to the apolipoprotein A-IV26 kDa fragment subtype in serum are obviously increased, and the increase multiple is more than or equal to 3.

title_en: Rhizopus oligosporus and bean dreg fermented product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to rhizopus oligosporus CGMCC NO.21461, and provides an application of the rhizopus oligosporus in preparing fermented products and a method for preparing bean dreg fermented products by applying the rhizopus oligosporus. The rhizopus oligosporus has excellent degradation capacity to protein and peptide in the material during fermentation and is an excellent strain for preparing fermented product. The bean dreg fermented product prepared by using the rhizopus oligosporus disclosed by the invention as a fermentation strain is remarkably improved in nutritional quality.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity fructose syrup
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-purity fructose-glucose syrup, belonging to the technical field of food processing.

title_en: Separated protein combined with antigen AXL and application thereof
abstract_en: The present application provides an isolated antigen binding protein comprising at least one CDR in a VH having the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID No. 1; and comprises at least one CDR in VL having an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 2. The present application also provides immunoconjugates comprising the isolated antigen binding proteins, nucleic acids encoding the isolated antigen binding proteins, vectors comprising the isolated antigen binding proteins, cells comprising the nucleic acids or the vectors, methods of making the isolated antigen binding proteins, and uses of the isolated antigen binding proteins.

title_en: Breast milk source lactobacillus rhamnosus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses breast milk source lactobacillus rhamnosus and application thereof. The preservation number of the lactobacillus rhamnosus is CGMCC NO. 21815. The lactobacillus rhamnosus AUH2101 provided by the invention is derived from Chinese healthy breast milk, can generate two bacteriostatic substances, namely lactic acid and hydrogen peroxide with higher concentration, is sensitive to most antibiotics, and also has gastrointestinal condition tolerance capability and good heavy metal cadmium tolerance and removal capability, so that the lactobacillus rhamnosus AUH2101 has good bacteriostatic potential, lower potential risk and good cadmium discharge function, and is expected to be developed and applied to the food industry.

title_en: Primer probe group for detecting helicobacter pylori based on LFD-RMA method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and particularly relates to a primer probe group for detecting helicobacter pylori based on an LFD-RMA method, which comprises a primer pair for detecting the helicobacter pylori and a corresponding probe, wherein the 5' end of a downstream primer is marked by Biotin; the 5 'end of the probe is marked by FAM, the 31 st base T is replaced by THF (dSpacer), and the 3' end is modified by a blocking group C3-spacer; the amplification product size does not exceed 500 bp. The detection method is simple, noninvasive, rapid, high in accuracy and good in safety, and can be widely applied to rapid detection of helicobacter pylori.

title_en: Novel real-time fluorescent RT-RAA primer, probe and detection kit for coronavirus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel real-time fluorescent RT-RAA primer, a probe and a detection kit for coronavirus, belonging to the technical field of virus nucleic acid detection, wherein the real-time fluorescent RT-RAA primer and the probe are designed according to a novel coronavirus gene sequence, the primer sequences are SEQ ID NO 1 and SEQ ID NO 2, and the probe sequence is SEQ ID NO 1; the kit provided by the invention comprises the primer and the probe; the final concentration of the primers of the kit is respectively 420 nmol/muL, and the final concentration of the probe is 120 nmol/muL; the kit also comprises A Buffer, B Buffer, a recombinase, a polymerase and a freeze-dried enzyme preparation of single-stranded DNA binding protein, a positive control and a negative control. The invention adopts a real-time fluorescence RT-RAA method to detect the primer, the probe and the kit of the novel coronavirus, the detection is rapid, and the operation is simple and convenient; the specificity is good, and the sensitivity is high; is suitable for field detection and large-scale screening.

title_en: Pathogenic bacteria for albinism of laver protonema
abstract_en: The invention provides a pathogenic bacterium of a porphyra protonema albinism disease, and the preservation number of the pathogenic bacterium is CGMCC No. 21174. The strain provided by the invention is applied to screening of a laver strain resisting albinism. The screened pathogenic bacterium Lockera GN-R-1 strain of the laver protonema albinism disease can cause healthy laver protonema to generate albinism symptoms through free protonema infection experiments, and is the pathogenic bacterium of the laver seedling stage albinism disease; the strain is separated and found to be beneficial to laver albinism identification and disease prevention and control, and can be used for screening laver strains with albinism resistance.

title_en: Stem cell transfected gene delivery vector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stem cell transfected gene delivery vector, a preparation method and application thereof, in particular to a vector which targets an endoplasmic reticulum, avoids the intracellular transport path unfavorable for gene delivery into a nucleus and realizes effective lysosome escape, and responds to the reductive microenvironment in a stem cell at the perinuclear part for gene delivery. The gene delivery vector consists of a connecting bond capable of responding to micro-environmental degradation in stem cells, a side chain with a lysosome escape function and a side chain capable of targeting an endoplasmic reticulum, is constructed by covalent connection through Michael addition reaction, is combined with DNA through electrostatic action, enters cells through an energy-dependent endocytosis mode, targets the endoplasmic reticulum, avoids other intracellular transport ways possibly causing gene loss, realizes effective lysosome escape, and realizes degradation under the reductive microenvironment of the perinuclear part of the cell, thereby realizing higher stem cell gene delivery efficiency.

title_en: Method for removing echinocandin B mother nucleus degradation impurities
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of antifungal medicines, and particularly relates to a method for removing echinocandin B mother nucleus degradation impurities. The echinocandin B mother nucleus solution is adjusted in pH value and loaded on a macroporous adsorption resin column in a penetration mode, so that the echinocandin B mother nucleus degradation impurities can be efficiently removed. The echinocandin B mother nucleus in the column feeding liquid has high concentration, the resin treatment capacity is large, relatively less resin is used, no organic solvent is used for elution, the operation is simple and convenient, no expensive equipment is used, the height-diameter ratio of the macroporous resin column is small, the problems of chromatographic column blockage and the like do not exist, the echinocandin B mother nucleus degradation impurities can be effectively removed, the echinocandin yield is high, and the method is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Bifidobacterium animalis with effect of relieving oxidative damage of HaCaT cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses bifidobacterium animalis with an effect of relieving oxidative damage of HaCaT cells, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms and medicines. The invention provides a Bifidobacterium animalis (CCFM 1155), which can relieve the oxidative damage of human cells and obviously improve H 2 O 2 The survival rate of the induced HaCaT cells and the antioxidant capacity of the HaCaT cells; significantly improve H 2 O 2 Induced HaCaT cell oxygenThe damage degree is reduced, the antioxidant signal channel of Nrf2 can be activated, the Nrf2 secretion capacity is improved, and H is obviously relieved and repaired 2 O 2 Induced damage caused by HaCaT cell oxidation, therefore, the bifidobacterium animalis CCFM1155 has great application prospect in preparing products for preventing or treating skin oxidative damage.

title_en: Colorectal cancer organoid and liver organoid co-culture model and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a colorectal cancer organoid and liver organoid co-culture model, which comprises the following steps: collecting colorectal cancer organoids and liver organoids respectively, centrifuging, discarding supernatant, and sucking matrigel as much as possible; respectively adding digestive juice, centrifuging and discarding supernatant after digestion at room temperature, and performing cell count; mixing the colorectal cancer organoids and the liver organoids according to a cell number ratio of 1:1, re-suspending by using matrigel, and dripping onto a preheated 24-pore plate, wherein the gel is quickly transformed into jelly shape after being heated; and (3) placing the 24-pore plate in an incubator for incubation, adding colorectal cancer organoid culture medium and liver organoid culture medium into each pore after the incubation is completed, and then placing the culture medium in the incubator for culture. The colorectal cancer organoid and liver organoid co-culture model can simulate in-vivo 3D growth environment in vitro, and can reflect organism functions more truly, so that pathological processes and occurrence mechanisms of intestinal cancer liver metastasis are studied.

title_en: Bacillus cereus for producing cellulase and xylanase at low temperature
abstract_en: A bacillus cereus for producing cellulase and xylanase at low temperature is preserved in China center for type culture Collection, with the preservation address of Wuhan city Wuchang district No. eight 299 in Hubei province of China, and the classification name is bacillus cereus (Bacillus cereus) Bacillus    cereus ) TK-2, with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2021433, preservation date 2021, 4 months and 22 days. The bacillus cereus TK-2 has low-temperature tolerance, is suitable for growing and producing enzymes at a low temperature, particularly the enzyme activity of xylan produced at the low temperature of 15 ℃ reaches 2.3 times of that produced at the temperature of 37 ℃, the enzyme activity of the produced xylanase can reach 60.57IU/mL, the enzyme activity of cellulase (endo-cellulase) is 28.2IU/mL, the produced xylanase and cellulase still have high enzyme activity at a low catalytic temperature, and the xylanase and cellulase have excellent pH tolerance and better enzyme activity in weakly acidic, neutral and alkaline environments.

title_en: Method for constructing over-expression strain of monascus purpureus comp54338_ c3 gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses monascus purpureus comp54338_c3 The construction method of the gene over-expression strain comprises the steps of strain culture, over-expression vector construction, over-expression plasmid transformation and the like. The invention successfully clones the monascus purpureus M1 strain comp54338_c3 And (3) verifying the existence of the gene, connecting the gene with an overexpression plasmid pBARGPE1-Hygro, and introducing the gene into the monascus M1 strain to successfully construct an overexpression engineering strain c3-7. Over-expression by contrast comp54338_c3 The related physiological indexes of the secondary metabolite yield, hypha biomass, hypha morphology and the like of the c3-7 strain and the M1 strain of the gene are discovered and the gene is down-regulated comp54338_c3 The over-expression of the gene can reduce the yield of Monacolin K and three monascus pigments in monascus, inhibit the growth and development of monascus mycelium to correspondingly reduce the biomass of the mycelium, and change the form of the mycelium to a certain extent.

title_en: Use of agonist ligands of the IGF-2 receptor for the treatment of Angerman syndrome and autism
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for treating neurodevelopmental disorders, such as angeman syndrome and autism, comprising administering to an individual a composition comprising an agonist ligand for IGF-2 receptor. The agonist ligand of the IGF-2 receptor may be mannose IGF-2 or 6-phosphate or a derivative thereof. Also disclosed are compositions comprising mannose-6-phosphate derivatives.

title_en: Strain for efficiently degrading ethyl carbamate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an Agrobacterium tumefaciens for efficiently degrading ethyl carbamate, which is a DL-DNH02 strain obtained by screening from soil, is identified as Agrobacterium tumefaciens (Agrobacterium tumefaciens), is deposited in the China general microbiological culture Collection center on 12-07 th 2020, and has a deposit number: CGMCC No. 21309. The fermentation liquor, supernatant of the fermentation liquor, cell suspension and cell lysate of the strain can be used for preparing a urethane degrading agent, and can degrade urethane. The DL-DNH02 strain screened by the invention has the degradation rate of 95% on ethyl carbamate, has good degradation capability on ethyl carbamate in fermented food, especially wine food, and can effectively improve the quality and safety of fermented food such as white spirit, wine, sake, yellow wine, rice wine and the like.

title_en: Size-controllable composite frame planar material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in cell enrichment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a size-controllable composite frame planar material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in cell enrichment, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The composite frame plane material is composed of a reticular nanofiber membrane, supporting columns and a substrate, wherein the supporting columns of the nano array structure are arranged on one surface of the substrate, and the reticular nanofiber membrane is laid on the supporting columns of the nano array structure. The cell enrichment technology provided by the invention can realize the capture of different cancer cell types without modifying specific cancer cell recognition antibodies or aptamers, and has the advantages of low cost and simple and convenient operation. The prepared composite frame plane material can be used for capturing circulating tumor cells in peripheral blood, and is expected to be used for early diagnosis, detection and analysis of cancer patients, removal of cancer cells and blood purification.

title_en: Method for detecting milk production traits of dairy cows on basis of S1PR1 gene SNPs molecular markers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting milk production traits of dairy cows on the basis of S1PR1 gene SNPs molecular markers. The invention provides an application of a substance for detecting SNP A and/or a substance for detecting SNP B in identification or auxiliary identification of milk production traits of cows. The invention also protects the application of the SNP A and/or the SNP B as a detection target in identification or auxiliary identification of the milk production traits of the dairy cows. The SNP A is g.42033658T > A. SNP B is g.42036127A > G. The g.42033658T > A and/or g.42036127A > G molecular marker is related to the milk yield, the milk fat content and the milk protein content reaching a significant or extremely significant level (P is 0.0408-P is 0.0011).

title_en: Preparation method and application of fusion protein combined with GPC3
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a fusion protein combined with GPC 3. The fusion protein provided by the invention comprises an anti-GPC3 antibody and an extracellular domain of a VEGF receptor. The fusion protein combined with GPC3 provided by the invention can target tumor specific expression protein GPC3, and simultaneously block tumor angiogenesis by capturing VEGF through VEGF receptor extracellular segment, thereby achieving the purpose of tumor prevention and treatment.

title_en: Lactobacillus johnsonii EU03 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses Lactobacillus johnsonii EU03(Lactobacillus johnsonii EU03) and application thereof. The lactobacillus johnsonii has antioxidant activity, can improve the serological indexes of Myocardial Infarction (MI) rats and repair myocardial damage; and can improve cardiac function index of MI rat; restoring normal myocardial morphology to the damaged heart.

title_en: sgRNA of specific targeting human AXL gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses sgRNA specifically targeting a human AXL gene and application thereof, belonging to the field of biological medicines. The invention also discloses a method for constructing the human AXL gene knockout cell based on the CRISPR system. The sgRNA can mediate Cas9 protein to efficiently cut target DNA, and is further used for editing human AXL gene. The sgRNA of the invention can realize high-efficiency targeting through a CRIPSR/Cas9 system.

title_en: Acid-resistant 1,3-1, 4-beta-glucanase mutant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid-resistant 1,3-1, 4-beta-glucanase mutant, belonging to the field of genetic engineering and enzyme engineering. The invention respectively mutates glutamine at position 1, isoleucine at position 133 and valine at position 134 of 1,3-1, 4-beta-glucanase derived from Bacillus tequilensis (Bacillus tequilensis) into glutamic acid, leucine and alanine by overlap extension PCR to respectively obtain single mutants Q1E, I133L, V134A and double mutants Q1E/I133L. The four mutants have better stability in acid environment and catalytic activity, and are more favorable for industrial application compared with the wild enzyme.

title_en: GmARF16 gene for coding soybean ARF transcription factor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GmARF16 gene for coding a soybean ARF transcription factor and application thereof, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the GmARF16 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The gene can influence the growth and development of the nodule. In addition, the method utilizes a CRISPR/Cas vector, quickly obtains a chimera transgenic plant through agrobacterium-mediated soybean hairy root genetic transformation, successfully mutates the GmARF16 gene, analyzes the salt resistance of the chimera transgenic plant, and shows that the mutant GmARF16 gene can improve the salt resistance of soybean and inhibit the generation of root nodules of the soybean.

title_en: Microorganism rapid detection equipment and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganism detection, and discloses a microorganism rapid detection device and a detection method thereof. According to the rapid microorganism detection equipment and the detection method thereof, sterile water is filled in the cavities of the upper box body and the lower box body and then directionally discharged, negative pressure is formed in the cavities of the upper box body and the lower box body to suck water sample solution in the liquid storage box into the cavities, two groups of filter covers and guide columns are directionally moved from left to right along the inner wall of the bottom of the upper box body through the work of the servo motor, the water sample detection solution in the cavities of the upper box body and the lower box body is filtered and screened in the process of directional movement of the two groups of filter covers, the efficiency of extracting microorganisms in the water sample detection solution is improved, and the efficiency of rapid microorganism detection is improved.

title_en: Application of exosome gene, prostatic cancer detection object, detection kit and detection device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of an exosome gene, a prostate cancer detector, a detection kit and a detection device thereof. The application of the exosome gene as a biomarker in the preparation of a prostate cancer detection reagent, a prostate cancer detection kit or a prostate cancer detection device is characterized in that the exosome gene contains at least one of PCA3 gene, SPDEF gene and TMPRSS2: ERG fusion gene. The biomarker is used for preparing a prostatic cancer detection reagent, a prostatic cancer detection kit or a prostatic cancer detection device, and the positive detection rate of prostatic cancer is high.

title_en: Probe and kit for improving detection sensitivity of pathogenic microorganism antigen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probe for improving the detection sensitivity of pathogenic microorganism antigens and a kit containing the probe. The probe is double-stranded DNA containing a fluorescent label and provided with a restriction enzyme site, and the double-stranded DNA consists of Cy5-B-CM-S and NH 2-B-CM-AS; the Cy5-B-CM-S is shown AS SEQ ID No.1, and the NH2-B-CM-AS is shown AS SEQ ID No. 2. The probe is combined with a detection antibody of an antigen to be detected, so that the detection background can be greatly reduced, the detection sensitivity of the pathogenic microorganism antigen is improved, and a foundation is laid for the research and development of a single-molecule diagnostic reagent of the pathogenic microorganism antigen. Meanwhile, the design of the probe restriction endonuclease can realize the rapid detection of the antigen.

title_en: Bacillus coagulans for improving intestinal degradation of aflatoxin zearalenone
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus coagulans for improving intestinal degradation of aflatoxin zearalenone, wherein the preservation number of the bacillus coagulans is CGMCC NO. 20893; the preparation contains an extract of a culture of the bacillus coagulans; the invention has the advantages that: can inhibit intestinal pathogenic bacteria, can efficiently degrade aflatoxin and zearalenone, has simple action condition, does not destroy nutrient components in the feed, and can be added into the feed for a long time.

title_en: Algal fungus skinning cultivation method suitable for calcareous sandy soil of island reef of south China sea coral
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for culturing algal bacteria crusting suitable for calcareous sandy soil of island rocks of south China sea coral. The method directly performs propagation and domestication on the in-situ phycomycete crust, and directly performs field inoculation by utilizing the cultured phycomycete crust, thereby saving the separation and purification process, having higher culture speed, saving the material consumption, improving the field adaptability of the artificially cultured phycomycete crust and having important application value for restoring the ecosystem of the south China sea coral island reef.

title_en: Immunoglobulin a antibodies and methods of making and using
abstract_en: The presently disclosed subject matter provides antibodies, such as IgA antibodies and IgG-IgA fusion molecules, compositions comprising such antibodies, and methods of making and using such antibodies and compositions.

title_en: Scaffold material for cell culture, vessel for cell culture, fiber for cell culture, and method for culturing cells
abstract_en: The present invention provides a scaffold material for cell culture, which has appropriate hydrophilicity and strength, has high immobilization properties after cell inoculation, and can efficiently proliferate cells. In the scaffold material for cell culture of the present invention, the dispersion component of surface free energy is γ d Is 24.5mJ/m 2 Above and below 45.0mJ/m 2 Dipolar component of surface free energy gamma p Is 1.0mJ/m 2 Above andand less than 20.0mJ/m 2 。

title_en: High-fidelity Pfu DNA polymerase mutant, coding DNA thereof and application thereof in NGS
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-fidelity Pfu DNA polymerase mutant which is characterized in that mutation of 1, 3 or 6 amino acid sites is carried out on the basis of wild Pfu DNA polymerase, wherein the mutation sites are selected from the following sites: Y403A, P411H, V438K, A741S, R757Q and S768K. Its coding DNA and its application in NGS are disclosed. The high-fidelity Pfu DNA polymerase mutant provided by the invention has ultrahigh fidelity and high amplification efficiency, can be stably and efficiently applied to the library enrichment process in second-generation sequencing, effectively improves the sequencing quality of the library, reduces the base mismatching rate, and can be used for accurate analysis and interpretation of genetic information.

title_en: P-coumaric acid ester and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses p-coumaric acid ester and a synthesis method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: adding methyl p-coumarate, alcohol and a catalyst into a solvent, uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution, and heating in an oscillating state to perform reaction to obtain the p-coumarate. The transesterification method adopts enzymatic transesterification in a non-aqueous phase system, overcomes the obvious defects of poor selectivity, high reagent toxicity, harsh conditions and the like of the traditional chemical catalysis, maintains and enhances the activity, has mild conditions, high selectivity, simple operation and relatively high yield, shortens the reaction time, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method for improving exosome yield of mesenchymal stem cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the exosome yield of mesenchymal stem cells, which irradiates the mesenchymal stem cells for 30-60 min under a rotating LED red light source, an LED green light source and an LED yellow light source; the wavelength of the LED red light source is 620-625nm, and the voltage is 1.9-2.5V; the wavelength of the LED green light source is 510-520nm, and the voltage is 3.0-3.2V; the wavelength of the LED yellow light source is 585-590nm, and the voltage is 1.9-2.2V. The method utilizes the combined radiation of the red, green and yellow 3 specific waveband LED light sources to efficiently induce the cell activation and promote the generation of the cell exosome, is suitable for the research, regeneration and transformation of the human or animal mesenchymal stem cell-rich exosome, and has good clinical application prospect.

title_en: Fluorescent multiplex amplification system of 39 short tandem repeat sequences and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent multiplex amplification system of 39 short tandem repeats and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological gene detection. The system comprises 39 pairs of amplification primers which are respectively used for simultaneously amplifying 36 autosomal STR loci, 1Y chromosome STR locus DYS391, one Y-Indel locus and one individual recognition locus Amelogenin, and the primers are respectively provided with fluorescent markers. The system has large information quantity and good compatibility, can be compatible with all the information of the kits and the databases on the market, and does not cause the waste of the information of the databases; the system has very high accumulated non-father rejection rate when in use, and realizes the function of comparing the existing database diads; the specificity is strong, the stability is good, the signal intensity is stable, and no non-specific amplification product is generated; the species specificity is good, and other species such as mice, pigs, dogs, cows, sheep and the like can not be amplified except normal amplified human samples; the DNA with high detection sensitivity, as low as 0.03ng, can still be accurately typed; the detection capability of the mixed sample can reach 1:19.

title_en: Exosome separation and purification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exosome separation and purification method, which takes a body fluid or a culture solution containing exosomes, and obtains a purified exosome solution after anion exchange chromatography and/or molecular sieve chromatography. By the purification method, high-purity exosome can be obtained at low cost and high efficiency even in the large-scale exosome demand; compared with the existing exosome purification methods such as a centrifugal method, a PEG polymer precipitation method, an affinity chromatography, an ultrafiltration method and a molecular sieve size exclusion chromatography, the method can realize the purification of exosomes with different volumes (100 ml to 500L), particularly milk-derived products with more impurity proteins, and can also obtain milk-derived exosomes with the purity of more than 99 percent, and simultaneously has the advantages of low cost and high recovery rate, and can meet the requirements of industrial production.

title_en: Anti-BTLA antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to antibodies or antigen binding fragments that bind to human B and T Lymphocyte Attenuators (BTLA) and uses thereof. More particularly, the present invention relates to agonistic antibodies that bind to and modulate the activity of human BTLA, and their use in the treatment of inflammatory, autoimmune and proliferative diseases and disorders.

title_en: Inducer for reprogramming T cells into NK-like cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an inducer for reprogramming T cells into NK-like cells and application thereof, wherein the inducer comprises any one or combination of at least two of a DNA methyltransferase inhibitor, a histone deacetylase inhibitor or a histone methyltransferase EZH2 inhibitor. The method adopts the inducer to induce the methylation level of the T cells to be reduced, inhibit histone deacetylation and histone methylation, and express NK cell receptors and cytokines, so that the aim of reprogramming the T cells into NK-like cells in vitro is fulfilled, the method is simple, the efficiency is high, the period is short, the prepared NK-like cells have obvious in-vitro killing effect, and the method has important significance in the field of cellular immunotherapy.

title_en: Tetrameric protein scaffolds as nanocarriers of therapeutic peptides for the treatment of cancer and other diseases
abstract_en: A protein-based peptide drug carrier derived from the tetramerization domain of the chimeric oncoprotein Bcr/Abl of chronic myeloid leukemia. The peptide to be delivered was grafted to the N-terminal helical region of the Bcr/Abl tetramer. To facilitate cellular uptake, Arg repeat hexapeptide was added to the C-terminal end of the Bcr/Abl protein. The protein-based delivery strategy provides a clinically viable solution to the p53 inspired anticancer strategy and is applicable to the development of many other peptide therapeutics to target other intracellular protein-protein interactions responsible for disease development and progression.

title_en: CD38 specific bicyclic peptide ligands
abstract_en: The present invention relates to polypeptides that are covalently bound to a non-aromatic molecular scaffold such that two or more peptide loops are opposite between the attachment point to the scaffold. Specifically, the invention describes peptides of high affinity binding agents for CD 38. The invention also includes a pharmaceutical conjugate comprising the peptide ligand and a pharmaceutical composition comprising the peptide conjugated to one or more effectors and/or functional groups, and the use of the peptide ligand and pharmaceutical conjugate in the prevention, inhibition or treatment of a CD38 mediated disease or disorder.

title_en: Burkholderia strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a burkholderia strain and application thereof, wherein the strain is classified and named as: burkholderia bacterium (B.), (C.) Burkholderia sp.) YCYP9 with the following accession number: CCTCC NO: M2021733. The strain has the function of dissolving inorganic phosphorus and organic phosphorus simultaneously, and can be used for preparing phosphorus-dissolving preparations. Meanwhile, the strain also has the function of promoting the growth of the camellia oleifera seedlings, and can be used for preparing the camellia oleifera seedling growth promoter.

title_en: EpCAM-CD16-NKG2D trispecific antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an EpCAM-CD16-NKG2D trispecific antibody and the application thereof, which comprises an EpCAM binding domain, a CD16 binding domain and an NKG2D ligand binding domain. The EpCAM-CD16-NKG2D trispecific antibody constructed by the invention increases the NKG2D receptor on the basis of the EpCAM×CD16 bispecific antibody, so that the antibody can be used for targeting and connecting tumor cells expressing the epithelial state of the EpCAM and tumor cells expressing the interstitial state of the NKG2D ligand or tumor cells expressing both the EpCAM and the NKG2D ligand, thereby being capable of mediating stronger capacity of the immune cells to resist the migration tumor.

title_en: Virus density gradient centrifugation purification device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virus density gradient centrifugal purification device. Specifically, the invention provides a virus density gradient centrifugation and purification device, which comprises a loop pipeline and a continuous flow density gradient centrifuge, wherein the continuous flow density gradient centrifuge comprises a continuous flow density gradient centrifugal rotor. The virus density gradient centrifugal purification device can be used for simply, conveniently and timely removing air bubbles in the continuous flow density gradient centrifugal rotor in the sucrose density gradient purification process, and particularly can be used for removing the air bubbles in the sucrose density gradient, so that the vibration of the rotor and the distribution of the sucrose density gradient in the rotor caused by the air bubbles are avoided, and a high-quality virus vaccine can be prepared.

title_en: System and method for culturing microalgae by using high-solid-content excess sludge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for culturing microalgae by using high-solid-content excess sludge, wherein the system comprises a sludge crushing box, a microalgae culture tank and a microalgae culture chamber fixedly arranged in the microalgae culture tank, and an ultrasonic amplitude transformer is fixedly arranged below the sludge crushing box; the sludge outlet of the sludge crushing box is communicated with the sludge inlet at the bottom of the microalgae culture tank through a sludge pipe, the bottom end of the microalgae culture tank is provided with a right-facing air inlet pipe, the air inlet pipe is communicated with an air source, the top end of the microalgae culture tank is provided with an air outlet valve, the top in the microalgae culture tank is provided with a plurality of quartz glass pipes extending into the microalgae culture chamber, and the quartz glass pipes are internally provided with light source components; the high solid content excess sludge is sequentially introduced into a sludge crushing box and a microalgae culture tank, is subjected to ultrasonic crushing pretreatment, and is then cultured together with carbon dioxide, compressed air and microalgae. The invention realizes the resource utilization of the high solid content residual sludge.

title_en: Method for identifying wheat dominant variation chromosome and genetic effect thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a wheat dominant variant chromosome and a genetic effect thereof, which integrates oligonucleotide probe fluorescence in-situ hybridization, wheat chip analysis, mixed segregation population phenotype comparison and BSR-seq analysis to reveal genetic transmission characteristics of the wheat variant chromosome and the effects on genome differentiation, gene expression and phenotype, provides a new scheme for exploring and utilizing the wheat dominant chromosome variant and key genes (clusters) thereof to improve wheat varieties, and belongs to the technical field of crop genetic breeding and agricultural biology.

title_en: Method for detecting influenza virus titer by fluorescent quantitative PCR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting the virus titer of influenza by fluorescence quantitative PCR, wherein the virus titer of the influenza virus in the prior art is detected by a chick embryo EID50 method; however, the method is long in detection time, generally needs 3-4 days for detection once, is poor in result repeatability due to reasons such as sensitivity and the like, usually has a fluctuation range of +/-1.0, needs to determine the titer of key data for multiple times, and is poor in practicability. The invention discloses a method for detecting influenza virus titer by fluorescence quantitative PCR, which only needs 4-5h for detection, has good result repeatability, controls the fluctuation of a detection range within 0.5, and has the lowest detection limit of 10 copies; the invention establishes a more convenient and efficient virus titer detection substitution method, effectively solves the problems of long detection time consumption, large result fluctuation, poor repeatability and the like of the EID50 method, has shorter PCR method time consumption, is more accurate and efficient, is more suitable for detecting the virus titer of the influenza virus, and has higher practicability.

title_en: A accuse temperature purification appearance for production of medicinal nucleic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature control purifier for producing medicinal nucleic acid, which comprises a switch cover and a purifying pipe, wherein a constant temperature mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the purifying pipe, an opening and closing mechanism is fixedly arranged at the top of the constant temperature mechanism, and a collecting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the purifying pipe. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the anti-collision strip movably arranged on the fixed outer sleeve in the constant temperature mechanism, the impact can be effectively buffered, and the arrangement of the structures such as the gas storage box, the heat insulation air bag and the like is matched, after the anti-collision strip is impacted, the heat insulation air bag is timely bulged, so that the situation that the purification pipe is broken is prevented due to effective protection and multiple protection formed between the constant temperature pipe sleeve and the fixed inner sleeve, and the buffer solution after heating can be prevented from being attached to the inner wall of the buffer groove and the buffer solution channel by the arrangement of the first connecting rod between the fixed inner sleeve and the fixed outer sleeve and the second connecting rod between the constant temperature pipe sleeve and the purification pipe.

title_en: Application of salvia miltiorrhiza transcription factor SmbHLH124 in improving hairy root yield traits of salvia miltiorrhiza
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant biology, and particularly relates to a novel application of a salvia miltiorrhiza transcription factor SmbHLH 124. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of improving the yield characteristics of hairy roots of red sage roots. The technical scheme for solving the technical problem is to provide the application of the salvia miltiorrhiza transcription factor SmbHLH124 or the encoding DNA molecule thereof in improving the hairy root yield trait of the salvia miltiorrhiza and the method for improving the hairy root yield trait of the salvia miltiorrhiza. The technical scheme of the invention can obtain hairy roots with obviously increased biomass and tanshinone content, and effectively improve the yield characteristics of the hairy roots of the red sage root. The invention can provide ideal materials for tanshinone medicine source production and has good application prospect in solving the problem of insufficient medicine sources of tanshinone compounds.

title_en: Process for preparing 3-hydroxy-3-methyl butanoate (HMB) and salts thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyrate (HMB) or a salt thereof, which process comprises (a) reacting epoxyisobutane with cyanide to obtain 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyronitrile and (b) hydrolyzing the 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyronitrile obtained in step (a) to obtain HMB, wherein the hydrolysis step (b) is carried out using at least one nitrilase or, alternatively, using a combination of enzymes comprising at least one nitrile hydratase and at least one amidase.

title_en: GHRH or analogues thereof for the treatment of liver disease
abstract_en: The present application relates to methods for utilizing GHRH molecules, such as trans-3-hexenoyl-GHRH (1‑44) ‑NH 2 Or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, for preventing or treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFL), non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) and/or liver fibrosisNovel methods of slowing their progression and/or reducing the risk of liver cancer in a subject, e.g., an HIV-infected subject. The subject may have a particular pathological characteristic, such as liver fibrosis, a liver fat fraction (HFF) of at least about 10%, a serum alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) level of at least about 30U/L, and/or a NAFLD Activity Score (NAS) of at least 4 or 5.

title_en: Compositions for modulating tau protein expression
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are antisense compounds and methods for reducing tau mRNA and protein expression. Such methods, compounds, and compositions are useful for treating, preventing, or ameliorating tau protein-associated diseases, disorders, and conditions.

title_en: Cell amplification medium for gamma delta T, combination product and culture method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cell expansion medium for gamma delta T, a combination product and a culture method thereof. The gamma delta T cell expansion medium comprises a basal medium and additional components, wherein the additional components comprise: 5-15% (v/v) FBS, IL 2200 IU-800 IU/mL, IL 211 ng-20 ng/mL, and coenzyme Q105-20. mu. mol/L. Compared with the traditional method, the method can obviously improve the amplification efficiency and the cell purity of the gamma delta T cells, a large amount of high-purity gamma delta T cells can be obtained by culture, and the killing activity of the gamma delta T cells to tumor cells can be effectively maintained. The gamma delta T cell can be used for foreign body feedback after being modified by a genetic engineering means to express the chimeric antigen receptor, and does not generate graft-versus-host disease, thereby having wider application prospect.

title_en: Cell model capable of supporting hepatitis B virus replication and infection and establishing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cell model capable of supporting hepatitis B virus replication and infection and an establishment method thereof. The inventor of the invention finds that BEL-7404 cells have higher transfection efficiency in experiments, and can better support the replication and infection of hepatitis B virus after overexpression of human sodium taurocholate cotransporter polypeptide (hNTCP) and hepatocyte nuclear factor (HNF4 alpha) genes, so that a 7404NT-HNF4 alpha cell model capable of stably expressing hNTCP and HNF4 alpha is constructed, and the culture system can regulate the expression of HNF4 alpha by adding Doxycycline (DOX) in a culture medium so as to regulate the replication and infection of HBV, thereby providing a new cell model for hepatitis B virus research.

title_en: Preparation method of beta 2-microglobulin multi-antiserum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of beta 2-microglobulin polyclonal antiserum, which comprises the following steps: the beta 2-microglobulin antigen is used for immunizing an experimental rabbit not more than 4 times, and at least 12 subcutaneous injection points are selected for each immunization. The invention reduces the times of immunization and the dosage of immune antigen, and saves time cost, raw material cost and labor cost.

title_en: Anti-proliferative compounds and bispecific antibodies against BCMA and CD3 for use in combination
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to anti-proliferative compounds and bispecific antibodies against BCMA and CD3 for use in combination. Provided herein are methods of treating, preventing or controlling multiple myeloma using 4- (4- (4- (((2- (2, 6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl) -1-oxoisoindolin-4-yl) oxy) methyl) benzyl) piperazin-1-yl) -3-fluorobenzonitrile, or an enantiomer, mixture of enantiomers, tautomer, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and the bispecific antibodies provided herein that specifically bind to human B Cell Maturation Antigen (BCMA) and human CD3e (CD 3).

title_en: Methods for detection and enumeration of low concentration listeria
abstract_en: This document relates to a method for detecting and/or enumerating listeria, such as listeria monocytogenes, in a sample, the method comprising culturing the sample, which may contain listeria, in a medium comprising rhamnose, one or more antibiotics, a pH-color indicator, and LiCl.

title_en: Polypeptide-based self-assembled photosensitive nanofiber material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of antitumor drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypeptide-based self-assembled photosensitive nanofiber material (CFTNFs), which is mainly obtained by covalently coupling a diphenylalanine short peptide FF, a cell penetrating peptide CPP44 and a porphyrin photosensitizer. The CFTNFs not only show excellent phototoxicity to HepG2 cells in vitro, but also can cause more HepG2 cell apoptosis and necrosis; and the compound has tumor targeting capability, improves the tumor retention condition, inhibits tumor proliferation, shows better anti-tumor proliferation activity in vivo, can obviously improve the photodynamic treatment effect, and is expected to be used for the research and development of photodynamic antitumor drugs. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the CFTNFs and application of the CFTNFs in preparation of antitumor drugs. The preparation method is simple to operate, the process is easy to control, the CFTNFs nanofiber material based on covalent coupling of the diphenylalanine short peptide, the cell penetrating peptide and the porphyrin photosensitizer is successfully constructed, and the purity of the prepared product is high.

title_en: Long-chain fatty acid glycerol alcohol compound Rubracin B, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a long-chain fatty acid glycerol alcohol compound Rubracin B in the technical field of microorganisms, the structure of which is shown as the following formula: the compound is obtained by fermenting and extracting the phaeosphaeria rubra, the phaeosphaeria rubra is named as phaeosphaeria rubra Tubeufia PF02-2, and the preservation unit is as follows: china center for type culture Collection, the preservation number is CCTCC NO: m2019957. The compound has the application of preparing tumor drug resistance reversal agent or tumor drug sensitizer.

title_en: Method for preparing diglyceride rich in linolenic acid by enzyme method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing diglyceride rich in linolenic acid by an enzyme method, belonging to the technical field of food processing. The invention utilizes an enzymatic glycerolysis method to prepare diglyceride rich in linolenic acid, and adopts a distillation or adsorption method to reduce the peroxide value in the raw material rich in linolenic acid so as to achieve the aim of keeping the lipase activity to the maximum extent in the enzymatic reaction process, thereby improving the repeated use times of the lipase in the glycerolysis reaction process and reducing the cost for preparing the diglyceride by the enzymatic method. The invention provides a method for synthesizing diglyceride grease by an enzyme method with high efficiency and low cost, which avoids the problem that lipase is easy to inactivate in the enzymatic reaction process, and the method has great application prospect in grease processing.

title_en: Method for positioning Chinese cabbage clubroot disease resistance gene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning clubroot resistance genes of Chinese cabbage, which constructs F after selfing Chinese cabbage parents 2 Population, post inoculation, club root phenotype identification. For F 2 The group phenotype identification result analyzes the genetic rule of the clubroot-resistant material in the test, and the clubroot-resistant material is constructed by constructing a mixed pool of anti-infectious plants and screening SSR markersGenetic map and physical map, and preliminary location of disease-resistant gene contained in the test material.

title_en: Universal human stem cell suitable for allogeneic transplantation and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal human stem cell suitable for allogeneic transplantation and a construction method thereof, wherein the stem cell can maintain low immunogenicity in an inflammatory environment by partially knocking down or silencing an enhancer gene sequence of a B2M gene in the stem cell, desensitizes the stimulation of inflammatory factors IFN-gamma, does not cause immune response of allogeneic peripheral blood mononuclear cells, and can escape from allogeneic CD8 + Killing of T cells and NK cells. Is expected to be transplanted into the body of a patient without considering HLA matching, can avoid the attack of the immune system of the patient, plays a role in treatment and solves the problem of the immune system pair of the human body in the regenerative therapy based on stem cell transplantationThe immunological rejection of cells of allogeneic origin.

title_en: Kit and detection method for detecting clostridium difficile
abstract_en: The application provides a kit and a detection method for detecting clostridium difficile. The kit provided by the application comprises a microfluidic chip, a test strip detection card box, a complex solution and an extraction reference substance, wherein the microfluidic chip comprises at least 4 detection channels, amplification primers and amplification reagents are contained in the detection channels, and the test strip detection card box comprises a microfluidic chip card slot, a dilution liquid slot and at least 4 test strip slots. The kit provided by the application combines a specific and sensitive PCR technology with a convenient and rapid immunochromatography technology to realize detection of clostridium difficile, has the characteristics of rapidness, simpleness and accuracy, is convenient for transportation and storage of reagents, has a visual result, has low requirements on the professional properties of personnel, and is suitable for primary hospitals and on-site use.

title_en: Molecular marker nicas1 for identifying high and low nicotine content in tobacco, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a molecular marker Nicotine Associated SNP 1 for identifying the content of Nicotine in tobacco, a kit and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of molecular biology. The molecular marker Nicotine Associated SNP 1 is an SNP site Nitab4.5_0002539:95304A/G which is positioned at the No. 95304 site of the No. 0002539 genome fragment of a tobacco genome version Nitab v4.5Genome Scaffolds Edwards 2017. The invention can accurately identify and screen tobacco germplasm resources with low nicotine content by 100 percent, and the screened tobacco material can be directly used for breeding new tobacco varieties without a transgenic method.

title_en: Method for preparing shrimp acid by adopting direct-injection microbial inoculum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing shrimp acid by adopting a direct-casting microbial inoculum, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing powder of a direct-injection microbial inoculum; s21, cleaning, shelling and crushing the shrimp into meat paste, preparing two containers A, and putting the meat paste, salt and white spirit into the two containers A; s22, preparing double powder of 0.1% -0.15% of direct-injection microbial inoculum, respectively injecting the double powder into the two containers A, and uniformly stirring; s23, closing the two containers A, and fermenting for 2 months to obtain a semi-finished product of the shrimp acid; s24, opening the container A, filtering out redundant liquid, transferring the semi-finished product of the shrimp acid into the same container B, and putting sweet wine, chilli and salt into the container B; s25, adding 0.02% -0.05% of microbial inoculum into the container B, fully and uniformly mixing the content, sealing the container B, and fermenting for 48 hours to obtain the finished product of the shrimp acid. Accelerate the fermentation of the shrimp acid, inhibit the growth of the escherichia coli, bacillus licheniformis and other miscellaneous bacteria, and promote the edible safety of the shrimp acid.

title_en: Leiocassis longirostris male sex specific molecular marker, amplification primer thereof and genetic sex identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a male sex specific molecular marker of leiocassis longirostris, an amplification primer and a genetic sex identification method thereof. The nucleotide sequence of the male specific molecular marker of leiocassis longirostris is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the amplification primer is shown as SEQ ID No.2 and SEQ ID No. 3. The method is simple, rapid and direct, has high accuracy, has little damage to fish bodies, is not limited by the developmental period of the leiocassis longirostris, solves the problem of difficult sex identification of the leiocassis longirostris in the early development period, and has important significance for realizing sex control breeding of the leiocassis longirostris in production.

title_en: Polypeptide for repairing mucous membrane injury or skin wound and application thereof
abstract_en: The polypeptide has no homology with the known polypeptide, can exist stably in vivo and in vitro, and has the effects of regulating and controlling stem cell proliferation and differentiation to repair mucous membrane injury or skin injury; and to the use of said novel polypeptides for repairing mucosal lesions or skin wounds by modulating stem cell proliferation and differentiation, and for preventing, alleviating or treating gastrointestinal diseases.

title_en: Welch ginger fruit-derived Wick ham yeast strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Wick ham yeast strain derived from Tibetan ginger fruits and application thereof, wherein the preservation number of the strain Wickerhamomyces rabaulensis JBA-MBY-JT229 is CGMCC No.2.6477, the strain is separated from the inside of Tibetan ginger fruits, and gamma-aminobutyric acid (gamma-aminobutyric acid, GABA) is produced by utilizing glucose and xylose, and under the condition of adding ethanol or acetic acid with proper concentration at high temperature, the strain secretes more GABA to a fermentation culture medium. The accuracy is reliable and reliable through observation by a chromogenic method and measurement by an ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole mass spectrometer, so that the capability of the strain for producing GABA is revealed, and accumulation of a large amount of GABA is detected in cells of the strain, so that the strain is a potential GABA production strain and has good application potential and value in the fields of foods and industries.

title_en: Caenorhabditis elegans transgenic plasmid, construction method and application of transgenic caenorhabditis elegans
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology and environmental science, and particularly relates to a caenorhabditis elegans transgenic plasmid, a construction method of transgenic caenorhabditis elegans and application. The invention prepares caenorhabditis elegans rps‑30;rfp::rps‑30     Ubl   A transgenic line; the transgenic line can be used for evaluating the toxicity of environmental pollutants. rps‑30;rfp::rps‑30     Ubl   The transgenic line hasThe method has the advantages of rapid fluorescent protein transgenic strain, simple and convenient operation, high sensitivity and continuous monitoring, and makes up the defect that the quantification of the fluorescence intensity of the existing fluorescent protein transgenic strain is influenced by the exposure intensity and the exposure time because of the quantification of the rod-shaped structure.

title_en: Environment-friendly virus sampling tube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sampling tubes, and particularly discloses an environment-friendly virus sampling tube and a preparation method thereof. The environment-friendly virus sampling tube comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-40 parts of polycarbonate, 15-30 parts of polyethylene, 10-24 parts of corn starch, 10-24 parts of pine fiber, 6-12 parts of polybutylene succinate, 3-8 parts of a degradation additive, 2-6 parts of a plasticizer, 2-6 parts of a curing agent and 20-50 parts of ethanol; the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing polyethylene, corn starch, pine fiber and ethanol, heating, stirring, and pressurizing to obtain mixture A; adding polycarbonate and poly (butylene succinate) into the mixture A, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixture B; and adding the rest raw materials into the mixture B, uniformly mixing, heating, injection molding, cooling and forming to obtain the virus sampling tube. The environmental protection virus sampling pipe of this application, through the synergism between the raw materials, has the advantage of degradability.

title_en: Animal doctor preserves ware with microorganism sample
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial sampling and storing device for veterinarians, which comprises a barrel with an opening at the lower end, a sampling head arranged in the barrel and air holes formed in the upper end of the barrel, wherein the lower end of the barrel is hinged with a left baffle and a right baffle which are abutted together, and the baffles are connected with the barrel through a torsion spring. The sampling device is characterized by further comprising a push-pull mechanism and a pulling mechanism, wherein the push-pull mechanism drives the sampling head to extend out of the barrel body downwards to perform sampling, the pulling mechanism is arranged between the push-pull mechanism and the baffle, and the pulling mechanism can drive the baffle to be turned over and opened when the push-pull mechanism moves downwards. When opening, middle finger and forefinger press from both sides on the guide cylinder, and the thumb pushes down the push handle, extrudees the spring, drives the push rod and inwards removes to release the sampling head, simultaneously, the push rod can stimulate the stay cord, and the stay cord drives the baffle upset, thereby opens, then the sampling head stretches out the barrel, samples, just so can carry out one-hand operation, directly open, and after gathering, directly loosen.

title_en: Mutant gene related to rare genetic disease and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human genetics and cardiovascular in internal medicine, in particular to a mutant gene related to rare genetic diseases, wherein compared with a reference sequence of a wild NR3C2 gene coding DNA, the nucleotide sequence of the mutant gene is SEQ ID NO. 3; at genomic position chr4:149357409, base T is mutated to base C; the reference genomic version is GRCh 37. The invention also relates to application of the mutant gene in preparation of a detection kit. The mutant gene provided by the invention can be used as a biomarker for clinical auxiliary diagnosis; the carrier of the variation is detected, which provides the better prenatal and postnatal care guidance and genetic counseling for the testee, reduces the birth of the sick children, and has important significance for early diagnosis of the pseudo-aldosterone reduction disease or auxiliary clinical judgment.

title_en: Novel combined marker for early detection of multi-target hepatocellular carcinoma and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker combination panel for detecting early liver cancer patients, which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: the marker combination panel comprises a methylation site combination and a protein combination, and the specifically detected methylation site combination comprises: any 3 or more combinations of sequences of SEQ ID No.1 to SEQ ID No.33, or any 3 or more combinations of sequences selected from the fully complementary sequences of SEQ ID No.1 to SEQ ID No. 33. By detecting the methylation level of the 33 sites or the methylation level of the target sequence of one methylation site combination and the level of AFP and DCP in a serum sample, early liver cancer patients and normal control individuals can be sensitively and specifically distinguished. The data of clinical liver cancer and hepatitis samples show that the combination provided by the invention can effectively distinguish liver cancer patients from other liver disease patients.

title_en: Microorganism having enhanced cytochrome C activity for producing L-amino acid and method for producing L-amino acid using the same
abstract_en: An L-amino acid-producing microorganism having enhanced cytochrome C activity and an L-amino acid-producing method using the microorganism are provided.

title_en: Culture medium for improving adventitious bud induction of lily scales and cultivation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a culture medium and a culture method for improving adventitious bud induction of lily scales, which are applied to a lily scale tissue culture production system.
