abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-drug-loading-rate targeted drug loading system and a construction method and application thereof. The targeting drug carrying system is completely composed of nucleic acid, and sequentially comprises a nucleic acid aptamer sequence, a connecting sequence, a single-stranded DNA molecule A, a single-stranded DNA molecule B, a variable structure sequence capable of forming a G-quadruplex, the single-stranded DNA molecule B and a reverse complementary sequence of the single-stranded DNA molecule A, wherein the size of the single-stranded DNA molecule A is at least 2bp, and the size of the single-stranded DNA molecule B is 2-8 bp. Compared with the targeting drug-carrying system in the prior art, the drug-carrying system has higher drug-carrying capacity and good biocompatibility, can be safely metabolized and degraded in a human body while avoiding the damage of an anticancer drug to normal cells, and provides a more accurate and safe targeting drug-carrying mode for the efficient treatment of tumors.

title_en: Respiratory syncytial virus nucleic acid aptamer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiratory syncytial virus aptamer and application thereof, wherein the aptamer comprises at least one of Apt-1 and Apt-7, the sequence of Apt-1 is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the sequence of Apt-7 is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. The DNA aptamer can be combined with the respiratory syncytial virus with high specificity and high affinity, can be applied to a related method for detecting the respiratory syncytial virus, and has important significance in the aspect of detecting the respiratory syncytial virus.

title_en: Application of snoRNA biomarker and related kit
abstract_en: An application of a snoRNA biomarker and a related kit belong to the technical field of biological medicine. In order to explore the biological functions and mechanisms of snoRNAs in CRC and provide a new idea for CRC diagnosis and treatment, the invention discovers the differential expression of two genes of SNORD15B and SNORA5C in CRC tissues and adjacent normal tissues by analyzing the expression quantity of the two genes of SNORD15B and SNORA5C in CRC tissues and adjacent normal tissues, and confirms that the genes have promotion effect on CRC cell proliferation and clone formation through in vitro experiments. Through clinical cohort analysis, it was found that high expression of SNORD15B and SNORA5C was inversely correlated with clinical prognosis of CRC patients. The study data indicate that SNORD15B and SNORA5C are snoRNA molecules that exert a pro-cancerous effect during the course of CRC onset and are potential diagnostic and prognostic markers for CRC.

title_en: Phytophthora camphorata effector protein SCR97226 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SCR effector protein SCR97226 derived from phytophthora camphorae, and a coding gene and application thereof. The protein is a protein with one of the following amino acid residue sequences: the amino acid residue sequence of SEQ ID No.1 in the sequence Listing. Experiments prove that the protein expressed by the gene can participate in the process of infecting Nicotiana benthamiana by phytophthora, and causes apoptosis induced by apoptosis precursor protein Bax. The invention has important significance for enriching the molecular mechanism information of the interaction of the plant pathogenic oomycetes and the host and establishing the comprehensive control technical strategy of the plant pathogenic oomycetes diseases.

title_en: Integrated nucleic acid sampling and detection system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses nucleic acid sampling and detection integrated system and method, and nucleic acid sampling and detection integrated system includes sampling unit, nucleic acid sample pretreatment mechanism, detecting element and automatic control unit, the automatic control unit is used for controlling sampling unit, nucleic acid sample pretreatment mechanism and detecting element work, acquire the nucleic acid testing result. The nucleic acid sampling and detecting integrated system is suitable for single sample detection and batch sample detection, can realize integrated completion of sampling and output of detection results, and can realize self-cleaning; the method can continuously and automatically collect the pathogen-carrying gas-phase samples to provide liquid-phase samples for immediate nucleic acid detection, and is of great significance to the prevention and control of respiratory infectious diseases.

title_en: Recombinant escherichia coli, construction method thereof and method for synthesizing 1, 5-pentanediamine
abstract_en: Hair brushThe recombinant Escherichia coli contains lysine decarboxylase optimal mutant CadA catalyzing L-lysine to generate 1, 5-pentanediamine  P530L/M569V  The recombinant Escherichia coli is used as a catalyst, and the high-yield 1, 5-pentanediamine is obtained, wherein the molar conversion rate is up to 98.67%. According to the method for synthesizing 1, 5-pentanediamine, provided by the invention, recombinant escherichia coli is used as a catalyst, no additional cofactor PLP is required to be added, no buffer solution (pH adjustment is required) is used, no hydrochloric acid is required to be used for neutralization, the time for synthesizing and converting 1, 5-pentanediamine is short, the production cost is low, and an efficient and economic method is provided for industrial production of 1, 5-pentanediamine.

title_en: Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain for separating and producing SOD (superoxide dismutase) from hot spring soil in Quzhuomu region in Tibet and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain for producing SOD by separating hot spring soil in Zuochu region of Tibet and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. The high-temperature-resistant saccharomyces cerevisiae SC-QZM1 provided by the invention is separated from the soil of the Quzhu wood rural hot spring region in the south of Xizang mountain, is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) at 5 and 17 months in 2022, and has the preservation number of CGMCC No. 24900. The SOD enzyme is prepared by fermenting Saccharomyces cerevisiae SC-QZM1, and has good heat resistance, no enzyme activity loss after heat treatment at 90 ℃ for 120min, enzyme activity retention of more than 70% after heat treatment at 100 ℃ for 30min, and enzyme activity retention of more than 45% after heat treatment at 100 ℃ for 60 min. The saccharomyces cerevisiae SC-QZM1 provided by the invention can be applied to the production of heat-resistant SOD, and is beneficial to the application of SOD in the fields of food, medical treatment and the like.

title_en: Biomarker group, kit and system for predicting bad prognosis of ischemic stroke patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker, a kit and a system for predicting bad prognosis of an ischemic cerebral apoplexy patient, and relates to the technical field of molecular diagnosis. The biomarker panel disclosed by the invention comprises a protein marker panel and a Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) marker panel. The biomarker group, the kit and the system provided by the invention can better predict the occurrence risk of death or serious disability of ischemic cerebral apoplexy patients after 3 months of illness, so as to early identify high-risk patients with bad prognosis of ischemic cerebral apoplexy, guide doctors to take corresponding treatment and nursing measures to prevent the occurrence of death or serious disability of ischemic cerebral apoplexy patients after illness, and have important clinical and public health significance.

title_en: MNP (human cytomegalovirus) marker locus, primer composition, kit and application of MNP marker locus
abstract_en: The invention discloses MNP (MNP) marking sites of human cytomegalovirus, a primer composition, a kit and application thereof, wherein the MNP marking sites refer to genome regions which are screened on human cytomegalovirus genome and are separated from other species and have a plurality of nucleotide polymorphisms in the species, and the MNP marking sites comprise MNP-1-MNP-15; the primer is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-SEQ ID NO. 30. The MNP marker locus can specifically identify human cytomegalovirus and monitor variation; the primers are not interfered with each other, and the multiplex amplification and sequencing technology is integrated, so that the sequence analysis can be performed on all the marker loci of multiple samples at one time, the method has the advantages of high throughput, multiple targets, high sensitivity and culture-free detection, can be applied to the identification and genetic variation detection of human cytomegalovirus of large-scale samples, and has important significance for scientific research and epidemic prevention monitoring of human cytomegalovirus.

title_en: Method for rapidly detecting human peripheral blood Her2 gene amplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly detecting human peripheral blood Her2 gene amplification. Based on the principle that gRNA in a CRISPR/Cas9 system can be combined with a specific DNA sequence under the guidance of dcas9, probe gRNA sequences of a targeted Her2 gene and an LAF4 gene are designed, gRNA probes marked with different fluorescence are reacted and combined with dcas9 protein to form a probe system, the fluorescence value results of the Her2 gene and an internal reference gene are displayed through an enzyme-labeling instrument, the rapid detection of the human peripheral blood Her2 gene amplification is realized, and the method has the advantages of high sensitivity, good specificity, rapidness, economy, convenience in operation and the like, and can be used for multiple research fields of breast cancer auxiliary diagnosis, clinic, prognosis and the like through blood ctDNA detection.

title_en: Molecular marker, primer and application for sika deer paternity test and individual identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a molecular marker, a primer and application for sika paternity test and individual identification, and aims to solve the problem of practical application in the existing sika paternity test. The invention provides 16 high-polymorphism sites, which comprise 15 four-base repeated sites and 1 six-base repeated site, wherein the polymorphism information content of the 16 high-polymorphism sites is 0.645-0.892, and the average polymorphism information content is 0.7428. When 16 sites are used for the paternity test of sika deer, the three combination exclusion probabilities are 0.999824, 0.999999 and more than 0.999999 respectively, which are all more than the universal value 0.9973 of the international paternity test. When 8 sites are used for individual identification, the accumulated individual identification rate is more than 99.99%, and the accumulated isotactic identification rate is more than 99.97%. The method solves the problem that the existing method cannot accurately identify, is used for the paternity test and individual identification of the sika deer, has practical application value, can be used in a plurality of sika deer varieties, and has great application prospects.

title_en: Method for determining base type of preset site in embryo cell chromosome and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for determining the base type of a predetermined site in the chromosome of an embryonic cell. The method for determining the base type of the preset site in the chromosome of the embryo cell comprises (1) determining a linkage haploid type block of the preset site based on a sequencing result of a parent of the embryo cell, wherein the linkage haploid type block comprises the preset site and the base type of the linkage site of the preset site in the parent, (2) determining sequence information of at least one part of the genome of the embryo based on a sequencing result of the embryo cell, wherein the at least one part of the genome of the embryo comprises the preset site, and (3) correcting the base type of the preset site in the embryo cell based on the linkage haploid type block of the preset site so as to obtain the base type of the preset site, and (4) determining whether the genome of the embryo has chromosome abnormality based on the sequencing result of the embryo cell.

title_en: Clostridium beijerinckii and method for producing butanol by using clostridium beijerinckii
abstract_en: The invention provides a clostridium beijerinckii (clostridium beijerinckii) capable of producing butanol with high yield Clostridium beijerinckii ) MT1106, deposited in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2022665, preservation date 2022, 5 months and 19 days. The strain MT1106 has the characteristic of high stress resistance, and can obtain higher biomass and butanol yield under the conditions of a wider pH condition of pH =5.5-7.5 and a temperature of 25-37 ℃. In addition, the yield of butanol can be further greatly improved by adding iron ions into the fermentation system, so that the yield of butanol exceeds 23g/L, and the total yield of butanol and acetone exceeds 25 g/L. The application also provides a method for producing butanol by combined fermentation of the cellulose degrading high temperature bacterium clostridium thermocellum and lignocellulose serving as a substrate. Because the optimum pH of the clostridium beijerinckii MT1106 is consistent with the sugar solution obtained by fermenting the clostridium thermocellum, the optimum pH of the clostridium beijerinckii MT1106 is consistent with the sugar solution obtained by fermenting the clostridium thermocellumThe method can be directly used for fermentation of MT1106 without extra pH adjustment and addition of nutritional ingredients with higher cost, thereby greatly reducing the production cost and having important practical application value.

title_en: Method for directly separating and purifying polyhydroxyalkanoate from fermentation broth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for directly separating and purifying polyhydroxyalkanoate from fermentation broth, and belongs to the technical field of downstream post-treatment of bioengineering. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Taking fermentation liquor of polyhydroxyalkanoate producing bacteria, and carrying out cell wall breaking treatment to obtain wall breaking liquor; (2) adjusting the pH value of the wall-broken liquid to be alkaline by using alkali liquor; (3) Adding sodium salt and anionic surfactant into the alkaline wall-breaking liquid, and stirring for reaction, wherein the sequence of adding sodium salt and adding anionic surfactant can be interchanged; (4) Separating and collecting precipitate in the reaction liquid, washing with water to neutrality, dehydrating, and drying to obtain the polyhydroxyalkanoate. The invention adopts the technological means of sodium salt and surfactant, and the product is separated and purified under mild condition, and the molecular shearing is small, and the obtained product has the characteristics of high purity, high molecular weight and stable product quality. The invention has simple process, high production efficiency and low cost, and can realize large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Method for high-throughput screening of voltage-dependent calcium channel antagonist
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for high-flux screening of voltage-dependent calcium channel antagonists, wherein the voltage-dependent calcium channels comprise an N-type calcium channel and an L-type calcium channel, the invention uses extracellular fluid containing Valinomycin to pretreat cells stably expressing the calcium channels, the membrane potential of the cell is controlled by adjusting the concentration of the potassium ions outside the cell, so that VGCCs are activated, therefore, the invention is used for screening the antagonist of the channel by high-flux calcium ion fluorescence imaging, avoids introducing the expression of the inward rectifier potassium ion channel Kir2.3 in cells, meanwhile, the method avoids adding expensive screening antibiotics into a cell culture medium additionally and avoids influencing an experimental result due to the action of a compound to be tested on Kir2.3.

title_en: Anti-human HVEM (TNFRSF 14) antibody and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an antibody that binds to an extracellular portion of human HVEM on a human HVEM expressing cell, which prevents binding of BTLA to HVEM when the antibody binds to the extracellular portion of HVEM, wherein the antibody displaces BTLA bound to the extracellular portion of HVEM. The invention also discloses the use of such antibodies against certain diseases.

title_en: Sampling pipe, sampling pipe support, sampling subassembly and pipetting system
abstract_en: The application discloses sampling tube, sampling pipe support, sampling subassembly and pipetting system, sampling tube include the pipe shaft and with pipe shaft accordant connection's tube cap, the tube cap includes: the gasket-receiving portion is used for receiving and fixing a gasket. The sampling pipe support comprises a sampling pipe groove, and the shape of the inner wall of the sampling pipe groove is matched with that of the outer wall of the sampling pipe. The sampling assembly comprises a sampling pipe and a sampling pipe frame, wherein the sampling pipe frame is matched with the sampling pipe for use. A pipetting system includes a sampling assembly, a pipette tip array, and a well plate. The sealing gasket and the liquid transfer needle tube are matched for use, so that the storage sealing property and the liquid taking sealing property of the sampling tube can be improved, and pollution and the like are avoided; because the sampling tube grooves of the sampling tube rack, the arrangement of the pipette tubes and the distance between central shafts are the same, the operations of cap screwing and cup separation are not needed before the sample nucleic acid extraction is carried out, and the distance change of the pipette tubes is also not needed, thereby saving a large amount of time for the sample nucleic acid extraction process and also saving a large amount of cost.

title_en: Stenotrophomonas rhizophila, microbial inoculum and application of stenotrophomonas rhizophila in wastewater treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses Stenotrophomonas rhizophila, a microbial inoculum and application thereof in wastewater treatment, wherein the strain is Stenotrophomonas rhizophila (Stenotrophoromonas rhizophila) JC-1, is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection and management center at 7-18 months in 2022, and has the strain preservation number as follows: CGMCC NO.25341. The stenotrophomonas rhizophila JC-1 can efficiently degrade hydroquinone and acrylonitrile in wastewater under a high-salt condition, has the degradation capability on other phenolic compounds and cyanides, solves the problems of strong inhibition effect of the phenolic compounds and cyanides on functional microorganisms and low degradation efficiency, and provides an efficient microorganism germplasm resource for the degradation of organic matters in industrial wastewater.

title_en: Application of GFP-labeled erwinia amylovora in monitoring infection colonization and migration characteristics in fruit tree tissues
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a GFP-labeled erwinia amylovora in monitoring of infection colonization and migration characteristics of the erwinia amylovora in fruit tree tissues, and relates to the technical field of plant pathology. The method comprises the steps of utilizing GFP labeled strains of erwinia amylovora, respectively adopting a needling method, a spraying method and a root irrigation method aiming at branch tissues, leaf tissues and root tissues of pear trees, adopting plant tissue materials for measuring scabs of the inoculated branches, selecting a culture medium for isolated culture, and quantitatively detecting the number, migration time and speed of viable bacteria infecting and colonizing the erwinia amylovora in different host tissues by combining identification of fluorescent bacterial colonies. The spread distribution and infection process of pathogenic bacteria in different tissues of the host can be monitored visually through microscopic images. The method has the advantages of convenient material taking, strong operability, simplicity, convenience, practicability, intuition, visualization, accurate result, short detection period and good repeatability.

title_en: Construction method of menaquinone-7 storage space in bacillus subtilis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a menadione-7 storage space in bacillus subtilis, which introduces a DGAT gene of a key enzyme synthesized by triacylglycerol TAG into the bacillus subtilis by using a heterologous expression technology and a genetic engineering means to construct a recombinant plasmid I and realize TAG synthesis in the bacillus subtilis so as to expand the menadione-7 storage space in the bacillus subtilis; or the key gene synthesized by triacylglycerol TAG and the lipin TadA are combined and introduced into the engineering bacillus subtilis to construct a recombinant plasmid II, so that the TAG in the bacillus subtilis and the lipin are combined and assembled to form lipin LDs, and the storage space of menadione-7 in the bacillus subtilis is expanded, thereby promoting the synthesis of menadione-7.

title_en: High-toxicity bacillus thuringiensis mutant strain with ultraviolet resistance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural microorganism application, and discloses a high-toxicity Bacillus thuringiensis mutant strain with ultraviolet resistance and application thereof. The invention adopts CRISPR/Cas9 technology to knock out the hmgA gene of the strain HD-1, and obtains the mutant strain HD-1-delta hmgA, which is preserved in China center for type culture Collection with the preservation number of CCTCCNO: m2022892. The strain has high melanin yield and good ultraviolet resistance, and the biological assay of the cotton bollworm shows that the strain still has 80 percent of insecticidal efficacy after being irradiated by ultraviolet rays for 3 hours. The invention can be used for developing bacillus thuringiensis engineering bacteria with high-efficiency insecticidal activity and long lasting period so as to develop photostable biological pesticide.

title_en: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell exosome and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human umbilical mesenchymal stem cell exosome, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the invention comprises the following steps: human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells are isolated under aseptic conditions, and then primary and subcultured under continuous hypoxia conditions. The method can prepare sufficient mesenchymal stem cells with good immunoregulation function, and the mesenchymal stem cell exosome prepared by the method has good treatment effect on diabetic skin injury and acute lung injury.

title_en: Application of cationic surfactant and mesoporous silica in synergistic inhibition of polyphenol oxidase activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a cationic surfactant and mesoporous silica in synergistically inhibiting activity of polyphenol oxidase. The invention uses cationic surfactant DTAB or [ C ]  12  mim]Br and mesoporous silica nanoparticles are incubated with polyphenol oxidase together to make polyphenol oxidase lose activity by more than 90%, and cationic surfactants DTAB and [ C ]  12  mim]The amount of Br used is obviously lower than that of DTAB or [ C ] used alone  12  mim]Amount of Br used.

title_en: Immortalized Holstein male calf small intestine epithelial cell line and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of modification of cells by introducing exogenous genetic substances, and particularly relates to an immortalized Holstein male calf small intestine epithelial cell line, a construction method and application thereof. The invention relates to an immortalized Holstein male calf small intestine epithelial cell line, the preservation number of which is CGMCC No.45029, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center, address: the institute of microbiology, national academy of sciences, china, the area North Star, west way 1, 3, beijing, chaoyang. The immortalized Holstein male calf small intestine epithelial cell line has the following characteristics: the method has the advantages that the cell activity obtained by screening is strong, the high cell activity and biological characteristics can be maintained after passage 80, and the influence on cells is smaller than that of virus transfection due to the adoption of a non-virus transfection idea, the application range is wide, and the evaluation of the result is more accurate.

title_en: Fermentation process for increasing acarbose yield
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fermentation process for improving the yield of acarbose, which relates to the technical field of bioengineering, and the method comprises the following steps: inoculating acarbose producing bacteria into a basic fermentation culture medium; fermenting at 25-27 deg.C; adding an additive A comprising concanavalin A and hyaluronic acid into the culture medium, and adjusting parameters to continue fermentation; adding an additive B comprising N-acetylneuraminic acid and 2, 5-dimercapto-134-thiadiazole into the culture medium, and adjusting parameters to continue fermentation; and after the fermentation is finished, separating and extracting the obtained fermentation liquor to obtain the acarbose. According to the invention, only by adding specific additives in a specific time period during the fermentation process and adjusting fermentation parameters (temperature and pH value of the culture medium), the acarbose fermentation yield can be obviously improved by a very simple means, and the production and detection cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Solid culture medium for rapid growth of micromonospora for sisomicin production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid culture medium for rapid growth of micromonospora for sisomicin production, which comprises specific microbial polysaccharides (xanthan gum, gellan gum, bacillus mucilaginosus polysaccharide, cyclodextrin and the like), glucose, peptone, yeast powder, DL-aspart, potassium salts (dipotassium hydrogen phosphate, potassium dihydrogen phosphate and tripotassium phosphate), magnesium ions (magnesium sulfate and magnesium chloride), calcium carbonate and agar. The solid culture medium can be used for micromonospora to quickly grow and produce high-activity micromonospora seeds. Compared with the common culture medium, the culture medium has simpler components and greatly shortens the culture time. The culture medium greatly shortens the culture time of the micromonospora seeds, reduces the time cost of fermentation production of sisomicin, and has extremely obvious economic significance for the production of sisomicin.

title_en: AAV capsid-promoter interaction and cell-selective gene expression
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods and compositions for gene therapy, in particular methods and compositions involving alteration of capsid protein sequences for altering permissivity of a promoter within a cell when said promoter and said capsid protein are present within said cell and said capsid protein and said promoter are in the context of a recombinant adeno-associated viral particle (AAV).

title_en: Preparation method of botanical Maillard characteristic meat flavor agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a botanical Maillard characteristic meat flavor agent, and belongs to the technical field of food flavors. The cake protein is subjected to coarse crushing, superfine crushing, restriction enzyme hydrolysis, centrifugal separation, ultrafiltration and nanofiltration concentration to obtain nanofiltration concentrated solution; respectively carrying out enzymolysis and thermal oxidation on more than two kinds of vegetable oil to simulate the composition of animal fat fatty acid to prepare composite vegetable oil; the plant source Maillard characteristic meat flavor agent is prepared by uniformly mixing the raw materials, carrying out vacuum low-temperature azeotropic Maillard reaction, cooling and drying. The botanical Maillard characteristic meat flavor agent has the advantages of simple preparation process, less thermal processing hazard derivatives, strong and natural animal characteristic meat flavor, and fresh-improving and aroma-enhancing effects which are obviously superior to those of the animal-derived meat flavor agent, can meet the requirements of low-fat and vegetarian people, and is applied to plant-based foods and halal foods.

title_en: Deep liquid fermentation method for preparing Coriolus versicolor mycelium and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submerged liquid fermentation method for preparing Coriolus versicolor mycelium and application thereof, wherein a fed-batch fermentation process is adopted, and ammonia water is automatically fed-batch, so that the pH value in the fermentation process is regulated, and meanwhile, the effect of adding a nitrogen source is also achieved; the carbon source required by the mycelium is provided by manually feeding glucose, and a proper amount of nutrient components are supplemented for the mycelium. The invention effectively solves the technical problem of low mycelium yield caused by insufficient acid-base condition and nutrient component supplement in the mycelium growth process, and also provides a new idea of fermentation end for improving the total sugar content in the coriolus versicolor intracellular glycopeptide.

title_en: IL-38 short hairpin RNA fragments and their use to treat periodontitis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short hairpin RNA fragment for interfering interleukin-38 expression, which has the following sequence: sense strand: 5 'UGCAGACCAGAAGGCUCUCUAUA-3' (SEQ ID NO: 5); antisense strand: 5. The short hairpin RNA fragment can interfere the expression of the target gene IL-38, the interference efficiency reaches 70 percent, and the short hairpin RNA fragment has the application prospect of preventing and treating periodontitis.

title_en: Fully human antagonistic antibody with connective tissue growth factor as target and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering and protein engineering, in particular to a fully human antagonistic antibody taking connective tissue growth factor as a target spot and application thereof. The fully human antagonistic antibody is a single-chain antibody, and the amino acid sequence of the fully human antagonistic antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The invention screens out fully human anti-CTGF monoclonal antibody through ScFv phage antibody library of rheumatoid arthritis patients, and respectively determines the nucleotide sequence and the amino acid sequence of the monoclonal antibody, and the fully human antagonistic antibody obtained by the method has the specificity of the targeted human connective tissue growth factor.

title_en: Method for detecting cytochrome CYP8B1 enzyme activity
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting cytochrome CYP8B1 enzyme activity, and belongs to the technical field of biological detection. In the invention, when the activity of the cytochrome CYP8B1 enzyme is detected, the compound shown in the formula I or the salt thereof is used as a reaction substrate, and after the reaction under the action of the cytochrome CYP8B1 enzyme, the generation amount of 12 alpha-hydroxylation products in unit time is detected to detect the activity of the cytochrome CYP8B1 enzyme. Compared with the prior art, the method for detecting the CYP8B1 activity has the outstanding advantages of strong specificity, good reproducibility and simple operation, and has good application prospect.

title_en: For producing nata fermentation medium of mycin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fermentation medium for producing natamycin, and relates to the field of microbial fermentation. In addition to the carbon source, the nitrogen source and the phosphorus source, threonine and biotin are added into the fermentation medium, the content of propionyl coenzyme A of the natamycin precursor is improved through the combined action of threonine and biotin, meanwhile, glutamic acid is added to inhibit the utilization of acetyl coenzyme A in the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and the content of acetyl coenzyme A of the natamycin precursor is increased to promote the synthesis of natamycin. The invention improves the content of propionyl coenzyme A of the natamycin precursor by the combined action of threonine and biotin for the first time in the natamycin production fermentation medium, simultaneously adds glutamic acid to inhibit the utilization of acetyl coenzyme A in tricarboxylic acid circulation, increases the content of acetyl coenzyme A of the natamycin precursor, and jointly improves the anabolic flow of the natamycin, thereby improving the fermentation content.

title_en: Antibody-drug conjugates
abstract_en: An antibody-drug conjugate of an antibody that binds tissue factor and a cytotoxic agent Dxd via a linker formed from maleimidocaproyl-glycine-phenylalanine-glycine.

title_en: Probe composition for identifying or assisting in identifying mammalian species, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: Probe compositions and kits for identifying or aiding in the identification of mammalian species are provided. The probe composition is a nucleotide probe shown in sequence 1-sequence 3590 of a sequence table. The probe is used for capturing the COI gene of the target species, so that the DNA sequence of the COI gene is obtained by a second-generation sequencing high-throughput detection method for library construction, the advantages of flexible and convenient first-generation sequencing and capability of quickly obtaining the result can be simultaneously considered, the problem of complex operation of batch samples in the first-generation sequencing is solved, and the risk that the accurate COI gene sequence cannot be obtained due to unstable results of the first-generation sequencing part is avoided. The probe is developed into a mammalian COI gene capture kit, so that the rapid and batch identification of mammalian species can be realized.

title_en: Method for producing biological material derived from animal tissue, biological material derived from animal tissue produced by the same, and 3D printing method using the biological material
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for preparing an animal tissue-derived biomaterial, an animal tissue-derived biomaterial prepared therefrom, and a 3D printing method using the same, the method for preparing an animal tissue-derived biomaterial comprising: a decellularization step of removing cells from the tissue; a liquefaction step of liquefying the extracellular matrix solution obtained from the liquefaction step; and a sterilization step of sterilizing the mixture obtained from the filtration step. The animal tissue-derived biomaterial of the present disclosure exhibits excellent biocompatibility and storage stability.

title_en: 293 cell feed supplement culture medium and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 293 cell feed medium and preparation and application thereof, wherein the 293 cell feed medium comprises amino acid, vitamin inorganic salt, glucose, sodium pyruvate, hypoxanthine, thymidine and water. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: according to the invention, through the selection of amino acid, vitamin and inorganic salt species and the matching of glucose, sodium pyruvate, hypoxanthine and thymidine, a culture medium formula with a specific formula is formed, and the culture medium formula is supplemented in the process of culturing 293 cells by adopting a growth culture medium, so that the increase of cell density can be well maintained, a higher cell viability can be maintained, the continuous increase of the concentration of cell protein antibodies can be maintained, and the feed is helpful to the expression titer of viruses.

title_en: Gas supply system for cell culture box and gas concentration dynamic control method
abstract_en: The application discloses gas supply system for cell culture case, including the air supply module, the control module that admits air, gaseous mixing module, the culture room module that communicate in proper order, the air supply module includes CO  2  Gas source and N  2  The gas source and the gas inlet control module respectively comprise a gas source and a gas inlet control module which are connected with CO  2  Gas source and N  2  The gas mixing module comprises a premixing cavity and CO arranged in the premixing cavity  2  Concentration sensor, O  2  Concentration sensor and pressure release valve for discharging excess gasSupport the room module and include a plurality of one-to-one cultivation storehouses and gas feed pump, the gas feed pump is arranged in sending into the cultivation storehouse with the gas after mixing from gas mixing module to accomplish the circulation in returning gas mixing module, still include central controller, can be in the simplified system, for a plurality of cultivation room air supplies simultaneously, adopt gaseous internal recycle, concentration control stability is high and the gas loss volume is low. The application also discloses a gas concentration dynamic control method.

title_en: Kit for detecting microbial contamination degree
abstract_en: The application provides a detect microbial contamination degree's kit, especially relates to a plant somatic cell ATP extractant, and this extractant can fully extract plant somatic cell's ATP and do not influence microbial cell, has greatly improved the accuracy of plant source nature food testing result.

title_en: Methods of treating cancer using activated T cells
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method of treating cancer in an individual using activated T cells or PBMCs induced by antigen presenting cells (such as dendritic cells) loaded with a plurality of tumor antigen peptides. The method may further comprise administering to the individual the antigen presenting cells loaded with the plurality of tumor antigen peptides. The methods may be used alone or in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors. The present invention provides accurate therapeutic methods tailored to the individual using neoantigenic peptides or based on the mutational burden in the tumor of the individual. Methods of preparing the activated T cells, methods of monitoring the treatment, and methods of cloning tumor-specific T cell receptors are also disclosed. The invention also provides isolated cell populations comprising the activated T cells, as well as compositions and kits useful in cancer immunotherapy.

title_en: CO based on heat exchange and microalgae carbon sequestration 2 Fixing device and fixing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological environment protection, and particularly relates to a CO2 fixing device and a fixing method based on heat exchange and microalgae carbon sequestration. Compared with the traditional carbon fixation method, the carbon fixation module adopts microalgae and a chemical absorbent to jointly fix carbon, the main raw materials of the carbon fixation module are wide in source and low in price, in addition, the microalgae has higher CO2 fixation efficiency and photosynthetic efficiency and is slightly limited by the land utilization rate, the chemical absorbent is an alkaline solution, the pH value and the buffer capacity of the culture solution can be improved by adding the chemical absorbent, and the pH value of the culture solution can be maintained in a range suitable for the growth of the microalgae by being assisted by a proper CO2 supply strategy, so that the carbon fixation effect of the microalgae is enhanced.

title_en: Application of LDLRAD4 as minimal residual disease marker in predicting prognosis of adult B-ALL patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of LDLRAD4 as a minimal residual disease marker in predicting prognosis of adult B-ALL patients. Cox multifactor analysis results in the examples of the present invention show that LDLRAD4 low expression is a poor prognostic factor for LFS in adult B-ALL patients; the results of the multi-factor analysis show that the LDLRAD4 low expression after two rounds of consolidation chemotherapy is an independent risk factor of adult B-ALL relapse, the risk value of the adult B-ALL patient can be obtained by calculating the ratio of the LDLRAD4 gene expression level to the internal reference gene expression level in bone marrow mononuclear cells of the adult B-ALL patient after treatment, and the leukemia-free survival time and the cumulative relapse rate of the adult B-ALL patient can be predicted according to the risk value. The invention can play an important role in supplementing and perfecting a monitoring system for adult B-ALL minimal residual disease and the relapse risk and prognosis evaluation of B-ALL.

title_en: Glutamate dehydrogenase mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to a glutamate dehydrogenase mutant and application thereof. The glutamate dehydrogenase mutant of the invention takes an amino acid sequence of escherichia coli wild-type glutamate dehydrogenase as a reference sequence, and the glutamate dehydrogenase mutant contains a mutation that the aspartic acid at the 2 nd position is replaced by glutamic acid, glutamine or proline. The strain can effectively change the yield of lysine compared with the original strain.

title_en: Extraction method with function of improving detection sensitivity of low-abundance pathogen nucleic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extraction method with the function of improving the sensitivity of low-abundance pathogen nucleic acid detection, which belongs to the technical field of extraction methods.

title_en: Sea cucumber polypeptide, preparation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea cucumber polypeptide, a preparation process and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the sea cucumber polypeptide is as follows: ALVYYKMMKTSRSTA. The invention creatively discovers active ingredients from the sea cucumber polypeptide mixture, the obtained sea cucumber polypeptide has strong antioxidant activity and fibroblast proliferation activity, and the prepared sea cucumber polypeptide has high safety and provides guarantee for developing relevant products of the sea cucumber polypeptide.

title_en: Pineapple endophyte for water heart disease and application thereof in plant disease control
abstract_en: The invention provides a water heart disease pineapple endophyte which is a penicillium spinulosum named as Penicillium sp.SXB1, deposited at the culture Collection (GDMCC) of Guangdong province on 21/11/2022 with the deposit number of GDMCC No:62986. the strain has stable broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, has good antagonistic effect on pineapple black rot, strawberry anthracnose, pepper anthracnose, mango leaf spot, bacterial angular leaf spot and the like, and has the antibacterial rate of more than 56 percentParticularly, the bacteriostasis rate of the capsicum anthracnose pathogen reaches 83%, so that the method expands a new field for preventing and treating various plant diseases such as anthracnose, has wide development space, and has good development and application prospects.

title_en: Preparation method of ursodeoxycholic acid intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of ursodeoxycholic acid. An enzyme system comprising hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, NAD  +  And a NOX enzyme, wherein the hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase is 12 alpha-HSDH and/or 7 alpha-HSDH. A method for oxidizing the 12 th and/or 7 th position of cholic acid or a derivative thereof, which comprises reacting cholic acid or a derivative thereof after mixing with the enzyme system according to claim 1 or 2; the 12 th and/or 7 th position of the derivative is a hydroxyl group. The invention screens out NAD  +  Dependent 12 alpha-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase and 7 alpha-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, and a high-efficiency NOX coenzyme regeneration system is screened, and the conversion rate can still reach when the concentration of a reaction substrate is 100g/LAnd 96 percent, a key intermediate suitable for industrial enzymatic synthesis of ursodeoxycholic acid is developed, the key problem of industrial enzymatic synthesis of ursodeoxycholic acid is solved, and the method has great significance for reducing the production cost of the ursodeoxycholic acid synthesized by the enzymatic method.

title_en: Heme biosensor-based growth coupling high-throughput screening method and application thereof in multi-gene metabolic pathway optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of synthetic biology and microbial metabolic engineering, and particularly relates to a heme biosensor-based growth coupling high-throughput screening method and application thereof in multi-gene metabolic pathway optimization. The invention establishes a heme pathway library and an efficient and feasible high-throughput screening method based on a heme sensor, thereby rapidly balancing heme metabolic pathways, simultaneously, constructs a key zymogen porphyrin ferrochelatase mutant library for heme synthesis, screens and obtains ideal variants with high enzyme activity, improves the growth and production performance of thalli, and provides theoretical reference for metabolic pathway balance and high-throughput screening of other metabolites, thereby having good value of practical application.

title_en: Torulaspora dimethyldicus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a torula aluta indica G2-2 and application thereof, the torula aluta indica G2-2 is preserved in China center for type culture collection, the address is Wuchang Lojia mountain in Wuhan, hubei province, china, the preservation number is CCTCC M2022937, and the preservation time is 2022 years, 6 months and 21 days. The invention also provides application of torula indoca G2-2 in the white sour soup, a method for compound culture of torula indoca and lactobacillus paracasei is adopted in the preparation process of the leavening agent, and the synergistic fermentation and acid and flavor production effects of the two strains in the fermentation process of the white sour soup are utilized.

title_en: Quality detection method of adapter primer for high-throughput sequencing and high-throughput sequencing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality detection method and a high-throughput sequencing method of a joint primer for high-throughput sequencing. The quality inspection method comprises the following steps: mixing a to-be-detected joint primer and a 3 'joint for a connection reaction, adding an extension primer for an extension reaction to form a DNA second chain, adding a 5' joint for a connection reaction, performing PCR amplification to obtain an MGI library, and sequencing and analyzing data of the MGI library based on an MGI sequencing platform, wherein the 3 'joint and the 5' joint are joints matched with the MGI sequencing platform. The invention designs a quality detection method of the adapter primer for high-throughput sequencing, designs an MGI library construction strategy of the adapter primer to be detected, performs sequencing and data analysis based on an MGI sequencing platform, can accurately analyze the integrity, mutation rate, deletion rate and insertion rate of the adapter primer, and evaluates the quality of the adapter primer, thereby effectively performing quality detection on the high-throughput sequencing adapter primer.

title_en: Triethylamine degrading bacterium and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triethylamine degrading bacterium and application thereof, and solves the problems of low tolerance concentration and long residence time of triethylamine waste water of the existing triethylamine degrading bacterium. The bacterial strain adopted by the biological pretreatment technology is Wen Qiaoan alcohol bacillus P1 which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) in 12 months 17 of 2020, the preservation number is CGMCC No.21389, and the preservation address is North Star Xiyu No. 1 and No. 3 in the Chaoyang district of Beijing city. The triethylamine degrading bacteria have better concentration tolerance capability, can start reaction in the wastewater with the concentration of 2000mg/L, and can effectively reduce the concentration of organic load in the wastewater under the aerobic condition for 24 hours, wherein the degradation rate of the triethylamine in the wastewater reaches 99 percent, so that better treatment effect is realized.

title_en: MALAT1 gene SNP locus and application thereof as gastric cancer prognosis marker
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MALAT1 gene SNP locus and application thereof as a gastric cancer prognosis marker, and particularly relates to the technical fields of molecular biology and gene detection. A kit for predicting gastric cancer prognosis comprises a reagent for detecting polymorphism of SNP loci rs591291, rs11227209 and rs619586. The invention establishes a unified standard database and a specimen library: collecting peripheral fasting venous blood by standardized operation, and collecting complete population epidemiological data and clinical pathological information by a system; the invention extracts DNA of peripheral blood and carries out SNPs typing by adopting allele specific PCR and KASPar method. The invention establishes statistical analysis and screens SNPs sites which can be used for gastric cancer prognosis prediction. The invention develops a detection kit according to SNP loci related to gastric cancer prognostic survival.

title_en: Novel fortified wine medicine and solid-state fermentation box thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel fortified wine medicine and a solid-state fermentation box thereof, belonging to the field of microbial technology and wine brewing production thereof. The invention takes the saccule-covering yeast as a function-strengthening strain, takes long-shaped rice and bran as carriers, adds Chinese herbal medicines such as polygonum hydropiper, dried orange peel, radix codonopsitis and the like, prepares the strengthened wine medicine by solid state fermentation, improves the enzyme activity of the wine medicine and stabilizes the quality of the wine medicine. The method provided by the invention is simple and convenient to produce, stable and uniform in quality, and has the advantages of improving the production efficiency, shortening the whole fermentation time of the medicinal liquor and wide application prospect compared with the traditional process.

title_en: Visual nucleic acid detection kit of human trichomonas pentatrichina LFD-RPA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual nucleic acid detection kit for human trichomonas LFD-RPA, which is designed according to the human trichomonas SPO11-1 gene sequence, can rapidly and effectively detect the primer and probe combination of the human trichomonas, is used for clinically detecting the specificity, sensitivity and rapidness of the human trichomonas by establishing an RPA amplification technology and combining a lateral flow chromatography test strip method, provides an effective technical means for rapid visual field detection of the human trichomonas in a sample, and is particularly suitable for a basic detection laboratory and epidemic situation burst field with relatively lagging experimental equipment. The primer and the probe have strong specificity, have 5 copy number/ul of genome DNA of the human trichomonas, are simple and quick to operate, do not need special instruments, have the reaction temperature close to that of a greenhouse, can observe results with naked eyes, are favorable for realizing the rapid detection and monitoring of the trichomonas of a laboratory and a site, and have high application value in the aspects of fecal pollution prevention and control early warning.

title_en: Microfluidic device for capturing short free DNA and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a microfluidic device for capturing short free DNA and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of microfluidics. The microfluidic device comprises a lower cover plate, a capturing layer, a runner layer and an upper cover plate which are arranged in a stacked mode, wherein a plurality of liquid runners are arranged on one side of the runner layer, which faces the capturing layer, and nanowires which are used for capturing short free DNA and are modified with carboxyl are coated on one side of the capturing layer, which faces the runner layer. According to the invention, the nanowire modified with the carboxyl is coated on the capture layer, so that the contact area between the short free DNA and the capture surface of the capture layer can be increased based on the characteristic of high specific surface area of the nanowire, and the capture capacity of the short free DNA is improved.

title_en: Long-distance molecular genetic marker for chickens and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a long-distance molecular genetic marker of chicken and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of poultry genetic engineering breeding. The long-distance molecular genetic marker of the chicken is a 63366 locus SNP (63366:C > T) of chicken pleiotropic growth factor (PT N) gene intron 4. The molecular genetic marker genotype is obtained by a primer F:5'-CCAAACCTCTTCTGCGTCTC-3' and R:5'-GCAGAGCATTGTGTCAGGAA-3' PCR amplification sequencing. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, provides a long-distance molecular genetic marker for chickens, and utilizes the molecular marker to carry out molecular marker assisted selection on chicken distance length, so that early seed selection on the distance length can be realized, the breeding cost is reduced, the breeding efficiency and effect are improved, and the breeding genetic progress is accelerated.

title_en: Bol_InD1 molecular marker for identifying bolting-resistant character of carrot and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an InDel molecular marker for identifying bolting-resistant traits of carrots and application thereof. The invention particularly discloses an InDel molecular marker of a carrot bolting resistant property or application of a substance for detecting the InDel molecular marker of the carrot bolting resistant property in identification or auxiliary identification of carrot bolting, wherein the InDel molecular marker of the carrot bolting resistant property is a DNA fragment with a nucleotide sequence of 118 th-124 th positions of SEQ ID No. 1. The invention designs a primer of the InDel molecular marker and provides a method for identifying or assisting in identifying the bolting-resistant character of carrots. The InDel molecular marker of the bolting-resistant property of the carrot has high accuracy, good stability, simple and convenient detection, economy and high efficiency, can accelerate the carrot breeding process, and is widely applied to aspects of carrot germplasm resource analysis, molecular assisted genetic breeding and the like.

title_en: Nanometer antibody M124 for H7 subtype avian influenza virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano antibody M124 aiming at H7 subtype avian influenza virus and application thereof, belonging to the field of molecular biology.

title_en: Stirring paddle and reactor
abstract_en: The application discloses stirring paddle leaf and reactor belongs to the bioreactor field. The stirring paddle comprises a main body and a first steel wire sleeve, wherein the main body comprises an air inlet head, a central pipe, a main paddle, a guide pipe and a shunting base; the central pipe is communicated up and down, the upper end of the central pipe is provided with a plurality of openings, and each opening is provided with a main blade; the air inlet head comprises an air inlet pipe and an air inlet pipe base, the air inlet pipe is vertically communicated, the bottom of the air inlet pipe is connected to the air inlet pipe base, the top of the air inlet pipe is provided with an air inlet and a connecting device which are respectively used for introducing air and connected with a transmission device, and the air inlet pipe base is connected with the central pipe; the bottom of the central pipe is provided with a shunting base, and the first steel wire sleeve is arranged outside the shunting base; the guide pipe is arranged in the pipe cavity of the central pipe, and the top of the guide pipe is connected to the air inlet head base and communicated with the air inlet pipe; the bottom of the guide pipe is connected with the flow distribution base, and gas can enter the flow distribution base through the guide pipe. The stirring blade can uniformly supply gas to the reaction liquid.

title_en: Bacillus licheniformis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bacillus licheniformis BN-5 with the preservation number of CGMCC No.22584. The bacillus licheniformis is applied to oil exploitation, microbial single-well stimulation, microbial oil displacement and shale oil exploitation. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. the bacillus licheniformis BN-5 provided by the invention has very strong capability of reducing surface tension and emulsifying and viscosity reduction, and the physical simulation experiment improves the recovery ratio by more than 15%; 2. the strain fermentation liquor is applied to microbial single well huff and puff, and the average single well oil increment is more than 300t; the strain fermentation liquor is applied to microbial oil displacement, and the average daily oil increment of a well group is more than 4 t; 3. the strain fermentation liquor is applied to unconventional shale oil exploitation, the average single well oil increment is 200t, and the effective period is more than 200 d.

title_en: Rice promoter regulated by amino acid and hormone, expression vector containing rice promoter and application of rice promoter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, relates to the technical field of crop breeding, and particularly relates to an amino acid and hormone regulated rice promoter, an expression vector containing the promoter and application of the promoter. When the regulation and control mode of the OsAAP14 gene is researched, the promoter of the gene shown as SEQ ID NO.1 is obtained by cloning. The promoter is a conditional promoter gene expression control element. The promoter is applied to transgenic engineering, and can be connected with a specific effect gene to construct an expression vector and further construct a transgenic rice plant. The technical scheme overcomes the technical problem that the prior transgenic breeding mode lacks a regulatory element for the expression of the controllable target gene. After the transgenic plant is acted by exogenous hormone and amino acid, the promoter starts a large amount of expression of the effect gene, can be used in practical operation of breeding rice and other crops, and has obvious application value and wide application prospect.

title_en: Nucleic acid molecule, application thereof and method for detecting genome pollution in avian trichomonas nucleic acid sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nucleic acid molecule comprising at least one intron region, said intron region being at least greater than 50bp; the nucleotide sequence of the intron is shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. By observing whether expected strips exist in the agarose gel electrophoresis separation result of the amplification product of the trichomonas avian nucleic acid sample, whether genomic DNA pollution exists in the RNA of the sample can be intuitively judged, and the method is also suitable for detecting the genomic DNA pollution in the trichomonas avian cDNA sample. The method has the advantages of simple operation, high repeatability and strong specificity through detecting the genome pollution of the poultry trichomonas nucleic acid sample.

title_en: Synthesis method of semaglutide side chain
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical medicines, and particularly relates to a synthesis method of a semaglutide side chain. The polypeptide side chain analogue is prepared by adopting a liquid phase method, and the intermediate required by the semaglutide side chain can be simply and conveniently prepared by optimizing the carboxyl activating reagent and the reaction solvent, so that the steps of adopting complicated purification modes such as column chromatography and the like in each step are reduced, the preparation process can be simplified, the using amount of an organic reagent is reduced, the cost is reduced, and the method is more green and environment-friendly and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Purification method of SA recombinant protein
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purification method of SA recombinant protein, which comprises the following steps: s1: diluting the crude SA recombinant protein product by using pure water to obtain an SA diluted sample; s2: filling the SA diluted sample obtained in the step S1 into a dialysis bag, and putting the SA diluted sample into pure water for dialysis to obtain a dialyzed sample; s3: adding sodium carbonate and sodium chloride into the dialyzed sample in the step S2, and stirring for dissolving; s4: carrying out affinity purification by using a chromatography filler to obtain an elution product; s5: dialyzing the eluted product obtained in step S4, and storing.

title_en: Endostatin fragments and variants for the treatment of fibrosis
abstract_en: The present application relates to endostatin fragments and variants for the treatment of fibrosis. Materials and methods for treating fibrosis using polypeptides containing fragments and variants of endostatin are described herein.

title_en: Anti-respiratory syncytial virus antibodies and uses related thereto
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel monoclonal anti-Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) antibodies, methods for their preparation, and their related uses for immunodetection. The monoclonal anti-RSV antibody of the invention exhibits high sensitivity and high specificity against RSV, and can be used for detecting RSV at nanogram concentration in a chromatographic platform, and can realize more sensitive detection of the concentration such as picogram in other platforms such as chemiluminescence method.

title_en: Spodoptera frugiperda ABCC2 gene mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Alternaria frugiperda ABCC2 gene mutant and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of insect cell biology and biology. The nucleotide sequence of the Spodoptera frugiperda ABCC2 gene mutant is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, the amino acid sequence of the encoded protein is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, the gene mutant can be used for detecting BtCry1Ac toxin resistance of the Spodoptera frugiperda, and the detection method comprises the following steps: and (3) detecting the mutation condition of the 373bp site base of the Spodoptera frugiperda ABCC2 gene, wherein if the 373bp site of the ABCC2 gene is C, the Spodoptera frugiperda is sensitive to Bt Cry1Ac toxin, and if the 373bp site of the ABCC2 gene is G, the Spodoptera frugiperda is resistant to Bt Cry1Ac toxin. The invention provides a new detection method for identifying whether Spodoptera frugiperda generates resistance to Bt Cry1Ac toxin.

title_en: T7-RNA polymerase mutant suitable for in vitro synthesis of RNA and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a T7-RNA polymerase mutant suitable for in vitro RNA synthesis and application thereof, and relates to the field of nucleic acid tool enzymes and nucleic acid biology. The T7-RNA polymerase mutant provided by the invention is obtained by substituting 173 th amino acid (arginine) of wild type T7RNA polymerase from the N end with alanine or histidine, namely R173A and R173H. The T7RNA polymerase mutant is suitable for synthesizing RNA containing II-type transcription termination signals (the core sequence is 5 '-AUCUGUU-3') in the sequence, and has strong application potential in the aspects of in vitro transcription, RNA synthesis, RNA drug synthesis, RNA vaccine manufacture, gene edition, in vivo protein expression or cell-free protein expression in vitro translation system, transcription terminator research, biological transcription control element synthesis and the like.

title_en: Primer group for realizing simultaneous detection of 15 porcine pathogens through high-throughput targeted sequencing and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a primer group for realizing simultaneous detection of 15 porcine pathogens through high-throughput targeted sequencing and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of high throughput of target gene detection. The primer group is used for 42 target gene amplicon sequencing detection analysis methods for 15 porcine respiratory pathogens, has the technical advantages of rapidness, high efficiency, high targeting, strong specificity and the like, and is suitable for rapid and accurate simultaneous diagnosis of multiple pathogens of sick pigs in a pig farm.

title_en: Method for combining and recombining multiple epitopes based on computer molecular simulation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing multi-antigen epitope peptide by recombination based on a computer molecular simulation technology. When combining and recombining a plurality of antigen epitopes, the method firstly analyzes the key amino acid combination of each monoclonal antibody, then combines and recombines the key amino acid combination of each monoclonal antibody to be recombined into thousands of multi-antigen epitope peptides with different sequences under the guidance of a computer molecular simulation technology, simultaneously analyzes the amino acid sequence of a variable region of each monoclonal antibody, constructs a three-dimensional structure model for the variable region of each monoclonal antibody through the computer molecular simulation technology, finally uses the model to simulate and combine each recombined multi-antigen epitope peptide, screens out the multi-antigen epitope peptide which can be well combined with each monoclonal antibody, carries out biological experimental identification, screens out subsequent works such as vaccine preparation, diagnostic product production or drug research and development on the multi-antigen epitope peptide which is well combined with each monoclonal antibody through biological experiments.

title_en: Mitochondrial fusion protein 2 (MFN 2) and use of variants thereof in immunotherapy
abstract_en: The present invention is in the field of immunotherapy, and more particularly, the present invention relates to the maintenance and/or promotion of CD8 by mitochondrial fusion protein 2 (MFN 2), a variant of MFN2 capable of interacting with SERCA2, or an MFN2 expression promoter  +  Use of T cells for tumor killing and/or viability. CD8 overexpressing MFN2 or a variant thereof  +  T cell in the treatment of cancerThe disease process shows better adaptive metabolism, higher IFN-gamma production level, stronger tumor killing power and better viability.

title_en: Method for preparing chiral alcohol by emulsion microreactor continuous reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing chiral alcohol by emulsion microreactor continuous reaction, belonging to the technical field of enzyme catalysis. Aiming at the defects of relatively low stability of Pickering emulsion, limited selection of organic solvent, poor conversion of high substrate concentration, pressure resistance, enzyme activity loss, incapability of efficient cyclic regeneration of cofactors, difficulty in continuous and industrialized preparation process and the like, the invention realizes the synergic catalysis of enzyme and cofactors in a limited space and long-time continuous conversion by crosslinking the water-in-oil Pickering emulsion. The enzyme and the cofactor are dispersed in aqueous phase PBS buffer solution by taking the interface active silica nano particles as an emulsifier to form water-in-oil Pickering emulsion for encapsulating the enzyme and the cofactor, then a cross-linking agent is added to prepare microcapsules with certain strength and organic solvent tolerance, and continuous reaction is carried out for 400 hours in a fixed bed reactor, the catalytic activity of the enzyme is basically kept unchanged, and the total conversion number of the cofactor can reach more than 220000.

title_en: Breeding method for new variety of high-yield late-maturing medium-grained nonglutinous rice
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breeding method of a new variety of high-yield late-maturing medium-maturing japonica rice, which selects 'Ning 7023' carrying Pib and other rice blast resistance genes and stripe leaf blight resistance genes as female parent, hybridizes with 'nan japonica 44' carrying Pib and other rice blast resistance genes as male parent, and the bred new variety of high-quality fragrant high-yield late-maturing medium-maturing japonica rice is subjected to conventional and molecular breeding technology to polymerize Pita, pib rice blast resistance genes and stripe leaf blight resistance genes.

title_en: Gene cluster for replacing PgsB-derived gamma-PGA synthetase and method for synthesizing polyglutamic acid by gene cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gene cluster for replacing gamma-PGA synthetase from PgsA and a method for synthesizing polyglutamic acid by the same, wherein the gene cluster pgsBCA of the gamma-polyglutamic acid synthetase from bacillus licheniformis is cloned into a corynebacterium glutamicum F343 with high glutamic acid yield for exogenous expression, pgsB is replaced by pgsB from other strains, namely bacillus subtilis, bacillus methylotrophicus, bacillus amyloliquefaciens and bacillus anthracis, so as to obtain recombinant strains B '(BS) CA, B' (BM) CA, B '(BAM) CA and B' (BAN) CA, wherein the gamma-PGA yield produced by B '(BS) CA, B' (BM) CA and B '(BAM) CA is respectively improved by 48.00%, 107.87% and 98.43%, and the gamma-PGA yield produced by B' (BAM) CA is obviously reduced. Replacement of the source of PgsB in a particular PgsBCA polyprotein complex is therefore an effective method to further increase gamma-PGA production.

title_en: Primer combination, kit and library construction method for detecting endometrial cancer
abstract_en: Primer combinations, kits and library construction methods for detecting endometrial cancer, wherein the primer combinations are used for targeted amplification of sites in at least one of the following genes: PTEN, TP53, PIK3CA, PIK3R1, KRAS, CTNNB1, FGFR2, RNF43, tele, PPP2R1A, FBXW, AKT1, APC, BRAF, CDKN2A, EGFR, NRAS, MAPK1, GNAS, HRAS. The invention can detect the gene mutation sites in a plurality of areas of 20 endometrial cancer oncogenes at the same time and directly reflect the specific mutation sites of related genes.

title_en: Quick detection device for fenazaquin in tea, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses tea leavesA quick detection device for fenazaquin and preparation and application thereof relate to fenazaquin hapten, antigen, antibody, quick detection device, preparation thereof and application thereof in detecting fenazaquin in tea. The preparation method of the fenazaquin hapten provided by the invention has the advantages that the used chemical reagent is easy to obtain, the operation process is simple, the synthesis steps are simple and effective, the reaction yield is higher, the detection cost is lower, the fenazaquin hapten is coupled with the carrier protein to prepare the artificial antigen, the antibody specific to the fenazaquin is high in potency, and the minimum detection limit of the fenazaquin is 1.5 ng/mL and IC  50  The value was 54.0 ng/mL. The detection method provided by the invention has the advantages of high sensitivity, strong specificity, low cost, simple operation, short detection time, long quality guarantee period and the like, and can be applied to the rapid detection of the fenazaquin content in tea.

title_en: Method for culturing adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells by using palmitoleic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for culturing adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells by using palmitoleic acid, which comprises the following steps: s1, inoculating adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells into a culture medium containing DMEM/F12, 15% FBS and 0.1% PS; s2, adding digestive enzyme into the passage cells, digesting for 3-5min, collecting the cells, centrifuging, discarding the supernatant, and inoculating the stem cells into a new culture dish or an orifice plate according to the passage ratio of 1:3; s3, dissolving 100mg of palmitoleic acid in DMSO to prepare a concentrated stock solution with the concentration of 0.5mol/L, and adding the concentrated stock solution into a culture medium containing DMEM/F12, 15% FBS and 0.1% PS to prepare a palmitoleic acid conditioned medium; s4, inoculating 3-5 generations of passage cells into a palmitoleic acid conditioned medium, and culturing for 1-5 generations; s5, adding a fat-adding inducer into the culture solution inoculated with the pretreated passage cells, changing the culture solution every 48 hours, and continuing to culture for 1-5 generations. The method for culturing the adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells by using the palmitoleic acid shortens the proliferation time of cell populations, accelerates the adipogenic differentiation process of cells and promotes the fatty acid metabolism.

title_en: Application of mesenchymal stem cells in diabetes related diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides an expression vector, a host cell containing the expression vector, or application of a cell pharmaceutical composition containing the expression vector and pharmaceutically acceptable excipients or vectors in preparation of medicines for treating or preventing wound injury and diabetic foot of diabetics, wherein the expression vector carries coding sequences for expressing IL-10, IL-13 and IL-4. Through genetic modification of stem cells, the key links of anti-inflammatory targeting are achieved, and wound repair is improved to be relieved, so that repair is promoted.

title_en: Primer and probe combination capable of simultaneously detecting ASFV, PEDV and FMDV and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a primer and probe combination for simultaneously detecting African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV), porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus (PEDV) and porcine foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) and application thereof, wherein the primer and probe combination comprises three groups of primers and probes respectively aiming at ASFV P72 gene, PEDV N gene and FMDV 3D gene; primers and probes directed against the beta-actin mRNA sequence as internal standards in assays are further included. The kit comprises a reaction solution packaged by the kit, and each primer and corresponding probe are packaged respectively or mixed and packaged. The invention can diagnose ASFV, PEDV and FMDV simultaneously in one reaction by designing, optimizing and screening the primers and the probes, has no interference to the amplification of the three pathogenic specific genes, has strong specificity, high sensitivity and good repeatability, can accurately diagnose the major epidemic disease of virus infection condition infection causing diarrhea of pigs, has higher application value and generates huge economic benefit.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide AMP3 with high antibacterial activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide AMP3 with high antibacterial activity and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The antibacterial peptide has antibacterial activity, and preliminary toxicity analysis shows that the antibacterial peptide has no hemolysis under the action concentration of 50g/mL and has no obvious influence on proliferation and cell morphology of 293T cells.

title_en: Anti-human IgM antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an anti-human IgM antibody, a method of making and uses thereof. The anti-human IgM monoclonal antibody prepared by the method has high affinity, high reactivity, high sensitivity and specificity to human IgM. The anti-human IgM monoclonal antibody provided by the invention has good effects of blocking and eliminating immune interference when used for immunodetection, and provides an important source of blocker raw materials.

title_en: Novel glutamine-hydrolyzing GMP synthase variants and methods for producing purine nucleotides using the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to glutamine-hydrolyzing GMP synthase variants and methods for producing purine nucleotides by using the same.

title_en: Fusarium venenatum with high protein yield and application thereof in fermentation production of protein
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms and foods, in particular to a high-conversion-rate protein-producing strain breeding method and strain fermentation production application thereof. Compared with the common fusarium venenatum, the fusarium venenatum mutant strain, especially the TB04 strain with the preservation number of CGMCC NO.40423, has obviously improved protein content and growth speed, can utilize agricultural and sideline products as carbon sources or nitrogen sources, has complete amino acid types in fermentation mycelium proteins, contains various essential amino acids required by human bodies, and has wide application value.

title_en: Method for increasing synthesis of 2-pyrrolidone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for increasing synthesis of 2-pyrrolidone, and belongs to the technical field of bioengineering.
