The invention expresses Butyricicoccus faecihominis source CoA transferase in corynebacterium glutamicum, strengthens the secretion expression of CoA transferase through P  tacm  promoter and NS signal peptide, and enables the constructed strain to ferment 2-pyrrolidone by taking glucose as a carbon source in the environment of pH7.0, and the yield of shake flask fermentation for 96h can reach 12.13g/L.

title_en: Cultivation method for improving activity of stem cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivation method for improving the activity of stem cells, which relates to the field of the activity of the stem cells, and aims at solving the problem that the stem cells used clinically at present have low cell activity and further cause obstruction to clinical research, the cultivation method comprises the following steps of providing a culture medium, mesenchymal stem cells and a filler, wherein the filler comprises collagen and hyaluronic acid, and the culture medium comprises culture medium dry powder, glutamine, 4-hydroxyethyl piperazine ethane sulfonic acid, sodium bicarbonate and water, and the weighing proportion of the culture medium is as follows: 10 parts of culture medium dry powder, 1 part of glutamine, 0.8 part of 4-hydroxyethyl piperazine ethane sulfonic acid, 1.4 parts of sodium bicarbonate and the balance of water. The mesenchymal stem cells arranged inside the cultivation method for improving the activity of the stem cells are convenient for increasing the growth and cultivation of the stem cells, and can also increase the activity of the stem cells, and meanwhile, the filler and the culture medium arranged inside the cultivation method are convenient for assisting the mesenchymal stem cells in increasing the activity of the stem cells.

title_en: Novel coronavirus specific T cell and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel coronavirus specific T cell, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functional cells. The novel coronavirus specific T cells enriched from peripheral blood PBMC cells are subjected to two-round external amplification to obtain the novel coronavirus specific T cells with the order of magnitude of 10 hundred million, the amplification multiple of more than 10000 times and the purity of more than 90 percent, and the novel coronavirus specific T cells have the characteristic of specific immune response to the novel coronavirus and provide a new thought for clinically preventing and treating the novel coronavirus.

title_en: Exosome and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exosome and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: separating from culture solution of human induced nerve precursor cells or culture solution of gamma-aminobutyric acid precursor cells obtained by differentiating human induced nerve precursor cells; the humanized inducible neural precursor cells are prepared by reprogramming peripheral blood mononuclear cells by using a Sendai-virus technology. The exosome prepared by the scheme of the invention is separated from the culture solution of the humanized inductive nerve precursor cells or the culture solution of the gamma-aminobutyric acid precursor cells obtained by differentiating the humanized inductive nerve precursor cells, can effectively inhibit astrocytes and PBMNC from secreting inflammatory factors, and has anti-inflammatory and anti-dementia effects.

title_en: Method for delaying retrogradation of starch
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for effectively delaying retrogradation of starch, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural product processing. The invention takes starch as a substrate, adopts enzyme with transglycosidation capability to pretreat the starch, changes the chain length distribution of the amylopectin, increases the proportion of short-chain branches of the amylopectin, and effectively delays the long-term retrogradation of the starch. The enzyme modified starch is adopted to complex with lipid to form a starch-lipid inclusion compound, so that the winding and accumulation of double helix of amylose are prevented in the retrogradation process, and the short-term retrogradation of starch is effectively delayed.

title_en: SNP molecular marker combination related to egg weight and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular markers, in particular to an SNP molecular marker combination related to egg weight and application thereof. The SNP molecular marker combination provided by the invention avoids the problem of poor breeding accuracy of single molecular marker, can more accurately breed the laying hen with higher egg weight, and has obvious egg weight regulating and controlling effect on the whole period of raising the laying hen; can help to save production and breeding cost and accelerate genetic progress, and has great economic application value and scientific research value.

title_en: Method for promoting chondrocyte growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for promoting chondrocyte growth, which comprises the following steps of (1) constructing BMP-2 gene recombinant MSC (MSCdBMP 2) cells, enabling BMP-2 protein to be expressed on the surfaces of MSCdBMP cells, (2) preparing MSCBdMP-derived exosomes (MSCdBMP 2 Exo), and (3) using MSCdBMP2 cells and MSCBMP Exo for stimulation, so that chondrocyte growth can be remarkably promoted. The invention clones BMP-2 gene to MSC cell by gene recombination technology to prepare new BMP-2 gene recombination MSC (MSCdBMP 2) cell, and simultaneously, exosome (MSCdBMP Exo) prepared by MSCdBMP cell has similar biological function of promoting cartilage cell growth as MSCdBMP cell.

title_en: Phellinus linteus YX2, extract and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly discloses a Phellinus linteus YX2, an extract and application thereof, wherein Phellinus linteus YX2 has been preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) for China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) for 12 months and 1 day in 2020, and the preservation address is: the collection number of the strain is CGMCC No.21078 at the institute of microbiological study of the national academy of sciences of China, north Chen Xiu Lu No. 1, no. 3 of the Chaoyang area of Beijing city; the Phellinus linteus YX2 or the extract thereof can obviously enhance drought stress resistance of plants and promote seed germination and plant growth and development only by using nanogram-level dosage; the Phellinus linteus YX2 and the extract thereof can be compounded with fertilizer for use, and after compounding, the synergistic effect is achieved, the stress resistance of plants is further improved, and the compound fertilizer can be used in crop production to realize industrial production.

title_en: Method for synthesizing nucleotide sugar by enzyme catalysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing nucleotide sugar by enzyme catalysis, belonging to the technical field of biology. The invention takes sucrose as a substrate, and generates uridine diphosphate glucose and fructose by the catalysis of sucrose synthase, the fructose generates mannose by the catalysis of mannose isomerase or lyxose isomerase, the mannose generates mannose-1-phosphate by the catalysis of N-acetylhexose aminophosphate kinase, and the mannose-1-phosphate is catalyzed by GDP-Man pyrophosphorylase to obtain guanosine diphosphate mannose. According to the invention, the modules for synthesizing UDP-Glc and GDP-Man are cascaded together, and the UDP-Glc and GDP-Man are simultaneously obtained under the shortest reaction route by taking low-cost sucrose as a raw material, so that the cost for synthesizing high-added-value poly-oligosaccharide and glucoside is reduced.

title_en: Use of insecticidal proteins
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of a pesticidal protein useful for controlling a double-spotted beetle pest, the method of controlling a double-spotted beetle pest comprising contacting the double-spotted beetle pest with at least ACe protein. Compared with the agricultural control method, the chemical control method, the physical control method and the biological control method used in the prior art, the invention protects the plants in the whole growth period and the whole plant to prevent and treat the invasion of the double-spotted fluorescent beetle pests, and has the advantages of no pollution, no residue, stable and thorough effect, simplicity, convenience and economy.

title_en: Bacillus bailii JB23 for preventing and controlling sugarcane fungal diseases and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus bailii JB23 for preventing and controlling sugarcane fungal diseases and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of crop disease prevention and control. The strain is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation time of 2022, 7 months and 18 days and the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m20221134. According to the invention, the bacillus beliensis (Bacillus velezensis) JB23 strain is separated from the sugarcane stem tissue, and the flat plate counter test proves that the bacillus beliensis JB23 strain has a good function of inhibiting the growth of 7 sugarcane pathogenic fungi, and the greenhouse pot test proves that the bacillus beliensis JB23 strain has a good application effect on the biological control of sugarcane fungal diseases, can be used for the biological control of sugarcane fungal diseases, and provides a new strain resource for a sugarcane disease biocontrol strain resource library.

title_en: Microliter-level liquid storage tank for single cell online detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a microliter-level liquid storage tank for single-cell online detection. The invention comprises the following steps: the multifunctional microliter-level liquid storage tank is provided with a liquid storage tank sample adding hole, a liquid storage tank sample adding plug is arranged on the liquid storage tank sample adding hole, a sample injection channel is arranged in the multifunctional microliter-level liquid storage tank, the liquid storage Chi Jiayang hole is connected with the sample injection channel, the front end of the sample injection channel is provided with an air pressure input connector, the rear end of the sample injection channel is a liquid output end, the liquid output end is detachably connected with a quartz capillary tube in a sealing and switching mode, and the inner diameter of the quartz capillary tube in the sealing and switching mode is matched with the quartz capillary tube. The invention searches a proper pressure control path in the process of cell flow type sample injection, realizes the power control of cells, and realizes the flow regulation of solution and cells in the solution by regulating air pressure or hydraulic pressure. Meanwhile, the structure has good tightness, the dead volume of the solution in the flowing process is small, even no dead volume is achieved, the sample adding process is simple, and the installation and the disassembly are convenient.

title_en: Pneumatic mixing solid fermentation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses pneumatic mixing solid fermentation equipment, wherein: the device comprises a solid fermentation container and a pneumatic stirring assembly, wherein a material is placed in the solid fermentation container, the pneumatic stirring assembly is installed in the solid fermentation container and connected with a high-pressure air source, the high-pressure air source can output compressed air to the pneumatic stirring assembly, an air outlet of the pneumatic stirring assembly is positioned in the material, and the compressed air escapes from the air outlet of the pneumatic stirring assembly to stir the material. The invention has the advantages of small filling amount, little mechanical parts, low power consumption and higher cost performance for the ecological environment-friendly treatment process mainly degrading organic pollutants; for the fermentation of the solid organic matters which are difficult to degrade, excessive occupation of land and energy consumption can not be caused even if the fermentation period is prolonged.

title_en: Low-temperature meat-source lactobacillus and application thereof in production of cooked beef
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food biological processing, and discloses low-temperature meat-source lactobacillus and application thereof in production of cooked beef. The strain is Leuconostoc mesenteroides (Leuconostoc mesenteroides) and is preserved in the microorganism strain preservation center of Guangdong province at the 3 rd month of 2022, wherein the preservation number is GDMCC No 62311. The strain plays a very good role in corrosion prevention in the production of the cooked beef, inhibits the growth of spoilage bacteria and the rise of volatile basic nitrogen in a low-temperature environment, is beneficial to reducing the generation of the spoilage crust of the cooked beef, and can improve the tenderness of the cooked beef and give the beef unique flavor. The preparation method has the advantages of low production cost, long activity retention time of the strain, stable performance, simple application, safety to human and animals and good application prospect in the processing and production of the cooked beef.

title_en: Lignin degrading bacterium and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lignin degrading bacterium and application thereof, wherein the lignin degrading bacterium is Pseudomonas paraxantha (Pseudomonas parafulva) ZY-03 and is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.24422. The preparation method utilizes the pseudomonas paraxantha ZY-03 to prepare the microbial inoculum and the microbial powder for tobacco raw materials such as tobacco stems, reconstituted tobacco coating liquid, low-grade tobacco and the like so as to achieve the effects of degrading lignin and enhancing aroma, and meanwhile, the product quality is improved.

title_en: Gallbladder cancer cell strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gallbladder cancer cell strain and application thereof in researching gallbladder cancer diseases and screening or preparing medicaments for treating gallbladder cancer. The preservation number of the gallbladder cancer cell strain (TJ-GBC 2) is CCTCC NO: C2022344. the gall-bladder cancer cell strain TJ-GBC2 provided by the invention is a gall-bladder cancer cell which is established by primary culture of primary tumor tissues and has high invasive transfer capability, can be stably passaged and has heterogenic tumor formation, and is a good object for researching gall-bladder cancer diseases.

title_en: DSB-PE gene editing system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DSB-PE gene editing system and application thereof. The DSB-PE gene editing system comprises fusion protein and pegRNA; the pegRNA sequentially comprises a spacer, scaffold tail end base, a target sequence and PBS, wherein a reverse transcription template is not included between the target sequence and the scaffold tail end base and complementary pairing bases thereof; the fusion protein is formed by fusion of wild Cas9nickase and reverse transcriptase RT. The DSB-PE system of the invention maintains the advantages of various editing modes of the PE2 system, has high editing efficiency and wider application range, greatly improves the accurate insertion rate of the target base without affecting the cutting efficiency, and improves the biological safety of the DSB-PE system. The system is more suitable for editing application scenes without maintaining seamless connection of the 3' -end of the insertion sequence, and can realize target gene knockout through efficient insertion of a stop codon.

title_en: Method for symbiotic evolution of amylase by phage and host and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a method for generating amylase by symbiotic phage and host and application thereof. The method takes wild SP-amyC as phage, converts AV1 plasmid and mutagenized plasmid AEMP into E.coli carrying F factor to obtain host bacteria, and grows in M9 culture medium with starch as unique carbon source; the AV1 plasmid expresses gVI protein in an assisted way, and the nucleic acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID No. 2; the sequence of the mutagenized grain AEMP nucleic acid is shown as SEQ ID No. 3; the wild SP-amyC nucleic acid sequence is shown in SEQ ID No. 4. When the bacteriophage SP-amyC infects the escherichia coli, amylase genes on the bacteriophage express amylase, the amylase hydrolyzes only carbon source starch on soft agar to generate micromolecular maltooligosaccharide which provides energy for the escherichia coli to grow, and newly generated offspring escherichia coli is continuously infested by the offspring bacteriophage again, so that the circulating symbiosis is realized. Compared with the traditional evolution method, the method is more efficient and convenient, does not need to build a warehouse and large amount of manual screening, and has low cost and little manual intervention.

title_en: DNA insertion and deletion variant capture probes and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel low-abundance DNA insertion and deletion mutation capturing technology, the adopted capturing probe sequence is constructed as 5'-CCGTGGAGAGACCACGG- (F) n-GGCACCAGAGAGGTGCC-3', the capturing probe comprises a 5 '-end stem-loop region, a 3' -end stem-loop region and a capturing region (F) n between the stem-loop regions, wherein the sequence of the 5 '-end stem-loop region is 5'-CCGTGGAGAGACCACGG-3', the sequence of the 3' -end stem-loop region is 5'-GGCACCAGAGAGGTGCC-3', the capturing region (F) n is a short tandem repeat segment, F is the reverse complement sequence of the insertion segment or the deletion segment sequence, and n is the short tandem repeat number of the F segment. The DNA insertion and deletion mutation capture probe provided by the invention has the characteristics of simplicity, convenience, universality, economy, high efficiency, sensitivity and specificity, can be used for effectively capturing insertion and deletion mutation DNA fragments with low abundance, and can be used for capturing unknown insertion and deletion mutation DNA fragments with high flux, so that the comprehensive and flexible detection of the insertion and deletion mutation DNA fragments with low abundance is realized on the basis.

title_en: Kit for detecting BCR-ABL1 fusion gene and tyrosine kinase region mutation and promoter methylation thereof and application method
abstract_en: The invention provides a kit for detecting BCR-ABL1 fusion gene and tyrosine kinase region mutation and promoter methylation thereof and a use method, wherein the kit comprises 4crRNA probes for targeting BCR gene cleavage sites, tyrosine kinase mutation regions and promoter regions and 4 qPCR primers for verifying targeting efficiency of the corresponding crRNA probes. The crRNA probe is used as a core component of a targeted gene region of interest, RNPs are assembled by the crRNA probe and transactivation crRNA and endonuclease protein Cas9 to precisely cut target sites, so that the aim of enriching the gene fragments of interest is fulfilled, and the targeting efficiency of 4crRNA probes in each genome DNA sample is controlled by qPCR experiment quality. The invention realizes the simultaneous detection of the fusion site, tyrosine kinase region mutation and promoter methylation level of the BCR-ABL1 fusion gene by adopting a CRISPR/Cas 9targeted enrichment system-based nanopore gene sequencing technology with long sequencing read length and high sequencing depth so as to fully and comprehensively study the mutation related to the fusion gene.

title_en: Bifunctional protein targeting PD-1 or PD-L1 and TGF-beta and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bifunctional protein targeting PD-1 or PD-L1 and TGF-beta and medical application thereof. The bifunctional proteins comprise (i) an antigen binding fragment of an anti-PD-1 or PD-L1 antibody; (ii) an immunoglobulin Fc domain; and (iii) a TGF-. Beta.RII extracellular domain (ECD). The bifunctional protein has stronger affinity with PD-1 or PD-L1 protein, has good thermal stability, and can obviously promote release of IFN gamma and inhibit growth of tumors.

title_en: Method for detecting viruses in water body
abstract_en: The application provides a method for detecting viruses in a water body, which comprises the following steps: collecting water, inactivating, centrifuging to obtain supernatant, extracting RNA, reversely transcribing into cDNA, and amplifying; and after the amplification product is mixed with the CRISPR system, the amplification product is contacted with the SPR sensor, and the content of the virus in the water body is determined according to the wavelength change of the SPR sensor before and after the contact. The method combines with SPR to detect the viruses in the water body, the viruses in the water body can be better extracted and amplified by the pretreatment of the water body, and finally the content of the viruses is detected by the SPR technology. The whole process can obtain the detection effect of the virus under the condition of only adopting a small amount of water, the detection time can be less than 2 hours, the detection limit of the virus can reach 800 copies/mL, and the method has quite high sensitivity and specificity.

title_en: Optimized glucose oxidase gene and application method thereof
abstract_en: In one aspect, the application provides an optimized glucose oxidase gene, wherein the gene sequence is shown as SEQ ID No. 1; in another aspect, the present application provides methods of using the optimized glucose oxidase genes described above in the production of glucose oxidase. The optimized glucose oxidase gene provided by the application improves the preference of corresponding codons to pichia pastoris, and the application method of the optimized glucose oxidase gene provided by the application is combined, so that the expression quantity of the glucose oxidase is improved, and the heterologous efficient expression of the glucose oxidase can be realized, and the purification process is simplified.

title_en: Antibody combination for detecting mycobacterium lipoarabinomannan, application and kit thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody combination for detecting mycobacterium lipoarabinomannan, application and a kit thereof, and relates to the field of biological detection. The inventor of the application utilizes various types of samples to screen and identify, determines a capture antibody suitable for LAM antigen capture and a detection antibody suitable for LAM antigen detection, forms a dominant antibody combination for LAM antigen detection, has higher detection sensitivity and specificity, can be used for purifying LAM, a mycobacterium tuberculosis standard strain, a clinical isolate, and detection of LAM antigens in body fluids such as hydrothorax, blood plasma and the like, provides a novel antibody combination and a novel method for LAM antigen detection, and provides a novel method and a novel kit for auxiliary diagnosis of active tuberculosis.

title_en: Saponin derivative for use in medicine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a saponaria saponins derivative based on a saponin comprising a triterpene aglycone and a first sugar chain and/or a second sugar chain, and comprising: an aglycone core structure comprising a derivatized aldehyde group; and/or a first sugar chain, wherein the first sugar chain comprises a derivatized carboxyl group; and/or a second sugar chain, wherein the second sugar chain comprises at least one derivatized acetoxy group. The invention also relates to a first pharmaceutical composition comprising the saponin derivative of the invention. In addition, the present invention relates to a pharmaceutical combination comprising a first pharmaceutical composition of the present invention and a second pharmaceutical composition comprising any one or more of an antibody-toxin conjugate, a receptor-ligand-toxin conjugate, an antibody-drug conjugate, a receptor-ligand-drug conjugate, an antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate or a receptor-ligand-oligonucleotide conjugate. The invention also relates to a first pharmaceutical composition or pharmaceutical combination of the invention for use as a medicament or for use in the treatment or prevention of cancer, infectious disease, viral infection, hypercholesterolemia, primary hyperoxaluria, hemophilia a, hemophilia B, alpha-1 antitrypsin-related liver disease, acute hepatic porphyria, thyroxine-mediated amyloidosis or autoimmune disease. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an in vitro or ex vivo method for transferring a molecule from outside a cell into said cell, comprising contacting said cell with the molecule and a saponin derivative of the invention.

title_en: M2 type macrophage exosome and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an M2 type macrophage exosome and application thereof, wherein the M2 type macrophage exosome is secreted by M2 type bone marrow macrophages, the M2 type macrophage exosome induces the macrophages to reprogram from M1 type to M2 type by activating PI3K/AKT signal path, and the M2 type macrophage exosome improves the proportion of the M2 type macrophages in a diabetes bone immune microenvironment, thereby effectively promoting the healing of diabetes bones.

title_en: Method for identifying resistance of simple pear tree in-vitro branch pear fire blight
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying resistance of pear fire disease of isolated branches of a simple pear tree. Belonging to the technical field of disease resistance identification. According to the method, the disease resistance of the isolated branches of the pears is identified through artificial inoculation, the problems that the high-resistance resource materials are difficult to discover and evaluate quickly in early stage in the disease resistance breeding of the pears are solved, the operation is simple, the accuracy is high, and a foundation is laid for the breeding of the pear fire resistance disease of the pears. The method comprises the following steps: (1) cultivating and preparing pear seedlings; (2) strain culture; (3) inoculating isolated branches of pear trees; and (4) investigation and evaluation of the illness state. The artificial inoculation technology adopted by the invention can carry out pear fire blight resistance identification on isolated branches of pear trees in batches, has short disease period and convenient operation, provides good disease conditions for pathogenic bacteria, ensures the opportunity of infection of pathogenic bacteria by test materials, can rapidly and accurately carry out pear fire blight resistance identification and screening, has higher efficiency and higher reliability than that of the identification by a spray method and a needle punching method, and prolongs the identification period of pear branches.

title_en: Carbazole alkaloid compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbazole alkaloid compound, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the carbazole alkaloid compound is obtained from Streptomyces sp.HS-NF-1322; the carbazole alkaloid compound provided by the invention can inhibit HT22 cells and PThe C12 cells die through the induction of the erastin, reduce the active oxygen level and can be used for preparing neuroprotective medicines;

title_en: Method for producing germination-treated plant seed, method for producing germination-inducing raw material seed, composition for extracting germination-treated plant seed, and screening method
abstract_en: Provided are a method for producing a novel sprouted plant seed suitable for mass production of phytoalexins, a method for producing a sprouting-inducing starting material seed for producing such sprouted plant seed, an extraction composition for sprouted plant seed, and a method for screening candidate plant seeds for producing a target substance. The method for producing a germination-inducing raw material seed comprises a pretreatment step of continuously holding a plant seed for 5 hours or longer under an atmosphere having a carbon dioxide concentration of 400ppm or more and/or an oxygen concentration of 19 vol.% or less. Or a method for producing a germination-inducing raw material seed, which comprises a pretreatment step of treating a plant seed so that the mass of the phytochemical in the plant seed after the pretreatment step becomes 2 times or more the mass of the phytochemical in the plant seed before the pretreatment step.

title_en: Single domain antibody of GDF15 and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of biotechnology, in particular, the invention relates to antibodies to GDF15 or their use. The present invention provides heavy chain antibodies directed against a GDF15 target that specifically bind to GDF15 and block the interaction of GDF15 with GFRAL, and can be used to treat diseases associated with overexpression of GDF15 or to diagnose GDF15 levels in a patient. The blocking activity of the antibody provided by the invention on the combination of GDF15 and GFRAL is superior to that of a positive control CTL002, the specificity is superior to that of a positive control PF-06946860, and the hydrophilicity is superior to that of a positive control PF-06946860.

title_en: Detection method for paired sample differential methylation region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of a paired sample differential methylation region, which comprises the following steps: (1) Methylation site data of paired samples are obtained through high-throughput methylation sequencing, and the proportion of methylated cytosine C in cytosine at each site is calculated; (2) Combining methylation sites on the same chromosome into segments, and storing the obtained methylation information of each segment into an array in a segmented manner; (3) obtaining information about the differentially methylated regions; (4) And carrying out statistical test and FDR correction on the paired samples according to the methylation information of the sections, and outputting related information. The detection method of the differential methylation region of the paired samples aims at the paired samples to realize the detection of the differential methylation region, and improves the accuracy.

title_en: Grape powdery mildew effector, interaction protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an isolated grape powdery mildew En.NAFU1 effector CSEP080 and interaction proteins VviB f and VviPE thereof. The application also relates to improving the powdery mildew resistance of grapes by silencing the interacting proteins VviB f and VviPE in the grapes.

title_en: Application of pectin synthase gene BnGATL10
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a pectin synthase gene BnGATL10, belonging to the field of plant genetic engineering. The nucleotide sequence of the pectin synthase gene BnGATL10 is shown in SEQ ID NO.3, and the encoded protein sequence is shown in SEQ ID NO. 4. The invention transforms rape by agrobacterium infection method to obtain transgenic plant by constructing recombinant vector containing the gene, which improves BnGATL10 expression in cabbage type rape by gene engineering technique, reduces the leaf sclerotium disease spot area of transgenic rape 47.39%, and makes plant appear more antibacterial sclerotium disease, which has important application prospect for enhancing sclerotium disease resistance of cabbage type rape.

title_en: Antibodies that bind CD38 and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to humanized anti-CD 38 antibodies (including diabody antibodies), methods of their preparation, pharmaceutical compositions containing these antibodies, and uses thereof.

title_en: Adeno-associated virus vector, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adeno-associated virus vector, which is obtained by recombining partial sequences of COL7A1 protein coding genes into ssAAV-dj vectors; the adeno-associated virus vector is AAV9-C7-4K, and comprises a ssAAV-dj vector skeleton and a COL7A1 protein coding gene homology arm, wherein the ssAAV-dj vector skeleton sequence is shown as SEQ ID No. 1, and the COL7A1 protein coding gene homology arm sequence is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. The adeno-associated virus vector has high packaging titer and low vector production cost. By the adeno-associated virus therapy of the invention, the RDEB mice treated by the direct intravenous injection of the adeno-associated virus with high purity show systematic improvement and remarkably prolonged survival.

title_en: Preparation method of human recombinant interleukin 6 and application of human recombinant interleukin 6 in chemiluminescent kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, in particular to a preparation method of human recombinant interleukin 6 and application thereof in a chemiluminescent kit, comprising the steps of recombining an IL-6 original gene sequence to construct pCold-SUMO-IL-6 recombinant expression plasmid; transforming the pCold-SUMO-IL-6 recombinant expression plasmid into large intestine expression competent Origamine B (DE 3), screening positive clone with highest expression quantity of soluble target protein, and optimizing to obtain SUMO-IL-6 fusion protein; after enzyme digestion is carried out on the SUMO-IL-6 fusion protein, removing the tag protein through Ni column affinity purification to obtain target protein; after the activity test of the target protein is carried out by adopting a Roche luminous kit, the target protein is screened by a protective solution to obtain the human recombinant interleukin 6, the expression quantity of the fusion protein is up to 150mg/L, and the problem of low yield of soluble protein of the human interleukin 6 is solved.

title_en: Probiotic agent for improving chronic kidney disease and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a probiotic agent for improving chronic kidney disease and application thereof, wherein bacterial strains in the probiotic agent for improving chronic kidney disease comprise bifidobacterium longum Bifidobacterium longum BL bacterial strain with a preservation number of CGMCC No. 10452. The invention develops a new application of the bifidobacterium longum Bifidobacterium longum BL strain, namely the bifidobacterium longum Bifidobacterium longum BL strain has excellent effect of improving chronic kidney disease, and animal experiments prove that the bifidobacterium longum Bifidobacterium longum BL strain can remarkably increase the weight of rats with chronic kidney disease; significantly reducing the serum uremic toxin level of rats with chronic kidney disease; improving the diversity of colonic mucosa barrier and intestinal flora of rats with chronic kidney disease; reducing the systolic pressure of rats with chronic kidney disease, and reducing the urea nitrogen and creatinine levels in blood. Thus, the probiotic provides a new strategy for improving chronic kidney disease, which can be used for preparing related products for preventing, alleviating or treating chronic kidney disease.

title_en: Lumbricus guangdong characteristic peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Lumbricus guangdalina characteristic peptide and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The characteristic peptide is LLNYVDYK, EFTEEQLR, LQAELAR, ALETQVK, FVVLK, ARDDPHCCSAQDR or GILAADESTATIGK. The characteristic peptide of the invention has strong specificity, simple detection method operation and high sensitivity, can accurately identify whether the earthworm animal medicine contains the components of the earthworm, and provides a scientific method for ensuring the quality of the earthworm and products thereof.

title_en: Strain for high-yield L-malic acid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation engineering, in particular to a strain for high-yield L-malic acid and application thereof. The strain is an aspergillus niger strain, is obtained by ultraviolet mutagenesis and high-concentration cycloheximide iterative mutagenesis screening, has short fermentation period and high L-malic acid yield, can meet the strict production strain requirements in the food field, and provides an excellent strain for L-malic acid production. Provides a new way for the production of the L-malic acid, greatly shortens the fermentation period and improves the yield of the L-malic acid.

title_en: Ribo-OFF space-time specific gene silencing technique and use thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a Ribo-OFF space-time specific gene silencing technology and application thereof. Specifically, the application establishes a gene expression control tool formed by combining ribozyme and specific recombinase, and can realize the state from 'on' to 'off' of endogenous gene expression in time and space.

title_en: Marker, method and primer probe composition for analyzing microsatellite instability
abstract_en: The invention provides a marker, a method and a primer probe composition for analyzing microsatellite instability, and relates to the field of gene detection. The markers used to analyze MSI include markers located at the SULF2, SEC31A, TGFBR, EIF4E3, ACVR2A, TAOK, DIDO1, and UBAC2 genes, respectively. The detection method provided by the invention is based on a melting curve analysis method and has the advantages of high analysis speed, low cost, high accuracy and the like.

title_en: Eggshell membrane antioxidant peptide prepared based on bacteria and enzyme combination, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to eggshell membrane antioxidant peptide prepared based on bacteria and enzyme combination, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to biotechnologyThe field of surgery. Identification of Living Forsythia endophyte by LC-MS/MS LQ1 The active peptide generated by the eggshell membrane which is hydrolyzed by the synergistic pepsin is subjected to preliminary screening by ToxinPred, admetSAR and BIOPEP-UWM program analysis, and then is subjected to molecular butt joint technology screening, so that a peptide sequence which is nontoxic, high in water solubility and good in intestinal tract absorption and has the highest antioxidant activity potential is obtained, and then is synthesized for in vitro antioxidant verification. The amino acid sequence of the antioxidant peptide is IRDGWPH, STDVPRDPWVWG or EKIWHHTF, and the antioxidant peptide has higher antioxidant capacity, can be applied to the fields of foods, beauty products and health products, and provides a certain theoretical basis for screening natural antioxidant peptide by fully utilizing eggshell membrane resources in the follow-up process.

title_en: Split photosynthetic organism hydrogen production reactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a split photosynthetic organism hydrogen production reactor which comprises an upper reaction device, a lower reaction collecting device and a photosynthetic guiding device, wherein the upper end of the upper reaction device is provided with a hydrogen collecting device, the hydrogen collecting device comprises a hydrogen collecting main pipe, a first hydrogen collecting pipe, a second hydrogen collecting pipe, a third hydrogen collecting pipe and a fourth hydrogen collecting pipe are arranged below the hydrogen collecting main pipe, the first hydrogen collecting pipe is connected to an annular hydrogen collecting pipe, the lower end of the annular hydrogen collecting pipe is connected with a fifth hydrogen collecting pipe and a sixth hydrogen collecting pipe, the fifth hydrogen collecting pipe and the sixth hydrogen collecting pipe are connected with the lower reaction collecting device, the upper reaction device comprises a first layer feeding column, a second feeding column and a third feeding column, the first feeding column, the second feeding column and the third feeding column are connected with a photosynthetic reaction bin, the lower end of the photosynthetic reaction bin is connected with the lower reaction collecting device, hydrogen is regulated according to different light source intensities and light source surface areas, and the bottom device is mixed, and a hydrogen production body is controlled to collect layers in the process of producing hydrogen.

title_en: Streptomyces strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a streptomycete strain which is a streptomycete strain with a Geomin terpene synthase gene knocked out. According to the application, the Geomin terpene synthase gene is knocked out, so that the bad smell of fermentation is treated from the beginning, the streptomycete strain with mild tail gas smell and improved fermentation product yield in the fermentation process is obtained, and the streptomycete strain is applied to industrial fermentation production of antibiotics, so that the production cost is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Dual mode radiotracer and therapeutic agent that bind PSMA
abstract_en: The present application relates to a compound according to formula (V): which optionally comprises a chelated radioactive cation and wherein F is optionally  18  F。

title_en: Polynucleotide sequence, escherichia coli neutralizing antibody for pig intestinal toxicity, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, and in particular discloses a polynucleotide sequence, a pig enterotoxigenic escherichia coli neutralizing antibody, a preparation method and application thereof. The polynucleotide sequence comprises a guide sequence and a coding E.coli F4 which are connected in sequence  +  Nucleotide sequence of pilus antibody, nucleotide sequence of coded connecting peptide and coded enterotoxigenic colibacillus F4  +  Nucleotide sequence of pilus antibody. The application also discloses a pig enterotoxigenic escherichia coli neutralizing antibody expressed by the polynucleotide sequence. The pig enterotoxigenic escherichia coli neutralizing antibody provided by the application can effectively neutralize pig enterotoxigenic escherichia coli and reduce diarrhea incidence caused by enterotoxigenic escherichia coli.

title_en: Device for enriching, separating and culturing amycolatopsis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enrichment and separation culture device for oilcan bacteria, which relates to the technical field of microbial culture and comprises a box body, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged between inner walls of two sides of the box body, a positioning ring is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a culture vessel is arranged in the positioning ring, a fifth connecting pipe rotationally connected with the inner top of the box body is arranged at the inner top of the box body in a penetrating manner, an air guide box communicated with the fifth connecting pipe is arranged at one end of the fifth connecting pipe, and an air exchange treatment assembly connected with an air guide assembly and an electric guide assembly is arranged on the box body. The invention can perform rotary blowing on the culture vessel and the apparatus to be used, and can cool the culture vessel and the apparatus at the same time, and after cooling is completed, quantitative antibiotics are automatically injected into the culture vessel, so that the growth of other kinds of microorganisms can be inhibited, the subsequent enrichment and separation of the amycolatopsis are facilitated, and compared with the prior art, the invention has higher degree of automation, improves the working efficiency and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Method for improving nitrogen utilization efficiency of tea trees
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the utilization efficiency of nitrogen in tea trees, which comprises a cytoplasmic glutamine synthetase coding gene CsGS1.1, and belongs to the technical fields of plant molecular biology and genetic engineering. The invention discloses that CsGS1.1 of tea tree can improve the assimilation capability of plants to nitrogen for the first time. Through expression pattern analysis in tea tree varieties with high and low nitrogen utilization rate and overexpression of the gene in arabidopsis, the CsGS1.1 is proved to be related to the nitrogen utilization rate of tea trees, and the tolerance of plants under nitrogen deficiency can be improved. The invention provides gene resources for cultivating new nitrogen-efficient plant varieties and has wide application value.

title_en: Multiple displacement amplification reaction liquid, amplification method and kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a multiple displacement amplification reaction solution, an amplification method and a kit, wherein the preparation raw materials of the reaction solution comprise: the invention discloses a 10X DNA amplification buffer solution, a primer, 2.5mM deoxyribonucleotide triphosphate, amplification enzyme, fetal bovine serum, sterile water and nucleic acid dye for amplification, and aims at solving the problems that the current method for regulating whole genome amplification in liquid drops is complex in operation, limited in detection concentration, ambiguous in single microorganism encapsulation rate and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing teicoplanin by full liquid phase method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polypeptide medicine preparation methods, and particularly relates to a method for preparing teicoplanin by a full liquid phase method. The invention prepares the polypeptide fragments by the carbon-based soluble polypeptide synthesis carrier, and overcomes the defects of low single-batch yield and inaccurate central control of solid-phase polypeptide synthesis. Meanwhile, in the process of synthesizing the short peptide fragment, the relatively pure fragment is obtained through pulping and purification; during synthesis of long peptide, impurities can be removed by beating acetonitrile at low temperature due to the existence of long-chain alkane carrier; the process is simple and efficient, and the equipment cost is low. After the main chain of the teicoplanin is synthesized, ara (OtBu) -Glu (alpha-OtBu) -AEEA-AeEEA-OH is introduced into the side chain of the 20 th Lys, so that the material cost is greatly saved.

title_en: Nucleic acid detection system capable of being quickly premixed
abstract_en: The application provides a nucleic acid detection system capable of being quickly premixed. Comprises a rapid premixing device and a multichannel nucleic acid detection device, so that amplification products can be rapidly verified without uncovering; placing the nucleic acid amplification tube containing the nucleic acid to be detected into a rapid premixing device, and enabling the nucleic acid amplification tube to move downwards to be punctured by pressing down or screwing a sealing cover, wherein liquid in the tube flows out to be rapidly mixed with a detection reagent preset in a detection cavity; and then the rapid premixing device filled with the mixed reagent is placed into a multi-channel nucleic acid detection device for real-time optical detection, and the sample is judged according to the optical signal. The application can prevent aerosol pollution caused by uncapping detection of the amplified product and improve detection accuracy; under the condition that the existing operation steps of nucleic acid amplification are not affected, the next automatic real-time detection can be directly carried out on suspected samples (such as gray area samples) or only amplified samples, repeated experiments are not needed, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Logic and lanthanide luminescent probe and application thereof in detecting exosomes with multiple phenotype proteins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logic and lanthanide luminescent probe and application thereof in detecting exosome multiple phenotype proteins, and relates to the technical field of bioengineering. Thiol (SH) group modified EpCAM aptamer Apt  EpCAM  Dissolving in PBS buffer solution, adding Mal-DOTA, standing for 1 hr, adding Tb  3+  Obtaining a final detection probe precursor P1; amino-modified MUC1 aptamer Apt  MUC1  Dissolved in anhydrous DMF, then Cl-PA was added, then absolute ethanol was added, and the reaction mixture was refluxed under vacuum for 12 hours to obtain the final detection probe precursor P2. The invention adopts the logic design and antenna effect activation of the nucleic acid aptamer sensorThe optical probe strategy establishes an ALL probe for detecting the exosome protein with high sensitivity. The simultaneous expression of EpCAM and MUC1 leads to a wider linear detection range of exosomes and extremely low theoretical detection limit. Patient plasma samples of normal and cancer patient groups can be accurately distinguished.

title_en: Transcription factor downstream gene screening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transcription factor downstream gene screening method (PER-seq). The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing protoplast, then respectively expressing transcription factor-reporter gene and idle-load reporter gene in the protoplast in a transient mode, finally collecting cells which are successfully transformed, carrying out transcriptome sequencing, analyzing differential expression genes, and screening downstream target genes of target transcription factors. The invention establishes a simple, quick, efficient and widely applicable method for excavating the transcription factor downstream regulatory genes without depending on mutants or over-expressed transgenic lines, and provides technical support for analyzing the transcription regulatory mechanisms of plants.

title_en: KASP (KASP sequence identity) marker closely linked with drought tolerance of soybean in germination period and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a KASP marker closely linked with drought tolerance of soybean in germination period and application thereof, belonging to the field of molecular genetic breeding. The KASP is labeled as one or more of s14_5147797 and s18_ 53902767; the nucleotide sequence of the S14_5147797 is shown in SEQ ID NO:1, the nucleotide sequence of the S18_53902767 is shown in SEQ ID NO: 2. The invention develops KASP marks related to soybean germination drought tolerance and performs genotyping, has obvious sample genotyping effect, can sensitively, efficiently and inexpensively predict soybean germination drought tolerance, is favorable for screening and culturing drought-resistant high-yield soybean varieties, assists soybean functional molecular breeding, and further shortens the breeding process.

title_en: Conjugated polypeptides and vaccines for inducing immune responses
abstract_en: Methods and compositions for inducing an immune response against one or more antigens in a mammal are disclosed.

title_en: Cell line for lentivirus production and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cell line for lentivirus production and a preparation method thereof. Specifically, a lentivirus stable packaging cell line is provided, which comprises a packaging plasmid group consisting of pREV-rtTAtTS-puro plasmid, pVSVG-Hyg plasmid, pGagPol-BSD plasmid and CMV-PBtransposase plasmid. Also provided are methods for their preparation and lentivirus stable producer cell lines based thereon.

title_en: Hydrophilic polystyrene-divinylbenzene porous microsphere, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a hydrophilic polystyrene-divinylbenzene porous microsphere, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein an alkyleneoxy group with proper carbon chain length is introduced between the surface of the polystyrene microsphere and a polyhydroxy polymer group, so that the number of polyhydroxy polymer groups connected with the surface of the polystyrene microsphere is effectively increased, the hydroxyl content in the hydrophilic polystyrene-divinylbenzene porous microsphere is further increased, the hydrophilic performance of the hydrophilic polystyrene-divinylbenzene porous microsphere is effectively enhanced, and the specific adsorption capacity of the hydrophilic polystyrene-divinylbenzene porous microsphere on protein macromolecules is greatly improved.

title_en: Primer probe combination, kit and application for detecting 4 living bacteria in micro-ecological four-linked living bacteria product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primer probe combination, a kit and application for detecting 4 living bacteria in a microecological four-linked living bacteria product, and belongs to the technical field of microecological living bacteria detection and identification. Specifically comprises a glpF gene and/or a gmk gene which respectively aim at bacillus cereus, a gdh gene and/or a gyd gene which aim at enterococcus faecalis, a pheS gene and/or an ileS gene which aim at lactobacillus acidophilus, and a primer probe group which aims at a clpC gene and/or a fusA gene of bifidobacterium infantis, wherein the nucleotide sequences of the primer probe groups are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-24; the method can simultaneously identify the species relation of 4 microorganisms in the micro-ecological tetrad viable bacteria product, has the advantages of simple operation, short time consumption, wide identification range, no need of culturing bacteria in the sample, direct identification of the sample, rapidness, time saving, low cost and high sensitivity, and is favorable for rapid inspection of the product.

title_en: Application of reagent for detecting anti-FARP 1 autoantibody in preparation of product for detecting nervous system autoimmune disease
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine. The invention provides application of a reagent for detecting anti-FARP 1 autoantibodies in preparing a product for detecting autoimmune diseases of a nervous system. According to the invention, serum of a patient suffering from a nervous system disease and serum of a healthy person are used as experimental materials, rat brain tissue sections are respectively incubated, signals are amplified through fluorescent secondary antibodies, and compared with serum of a healthy person, the serum of the patient suffering from the nervous system autoimmune disease described by the invention is found to have an autoantibody FARP1 in a mode of co-dyeing with a neuron specific Marker antibody; and the authenticity and the specificity of the target antigen are verified, which shows that the FARP1 protein is expressed in the brain tissue of the rat and the neuron of the rat and has obvious staining signals, the FARP1 can be used as one of the recognition antigens of the autoimmune disease related autoantibodies of the nervous system, and the auxiliary diagnosis of the autoimmune disease of the nervous system can be realized.

title_en: Porcine-derived plasminogen determination kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of assay kits, in particular to a porcine-source plasminogen assay kit and application thereof, comprising a kit shell, an isolation bin, a silo, a reagent tube, a monitoring probe, an atomization port and a light source lamp.

title_en: Porcine delta coronavirus passaging attenuated strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porcine delta coronavirus passaging attenuated strain and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The preservation number of the attenuated strain is CCTCC NO: V202363. The attenuated strain is a passage attenuated strain obtained by cloning and purifying after passage on pig kidney epithelial cells. The sensitivity and adaptability of the strain on cells are gradually enhanced along with the increase of the in vitro passage times, the toxicity is obviously reduced, and no obvious clinical symptoms exist for the newborn piglets. Through sequence analysis, compared with a virulent strain, the attenuated strain has a plurality of gene mutations and is concentrated in S1 protein. The prediction result of protein structure shows that partial mutation can change the structure of S protein so as to influence pathogenicity. The effects of attenuated and virulent strains on the intestinal flora of piglets are significantly different, and infection of attenuated strains causes an increase in the abundance of a large number of beneficial bacteria. The attenuated strain has low biological safety risk and is a vaccine candidate attenuated strain with high safety.

title_en: Protein for reducing tumor invasion capacity and relieving immunosuppression and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, in particular to a protein for reducing tumor invasion capacity and relieving immunosuppression and application thereof. The protein for reducing tumor invasion capacity and relieving immunosuppression has an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO: 1. The protein can be combined with cytokeratin 81 (K81) and Phosphatidylserine (PS) in tumor cells simultaneously, inhibit tumor cell metastasis and relieve immunosuppression, thereby improving the development progress of tumors.

title_en: Heterotrophic nitrification aerobic denitrifying bacteria screening chip and screening method
abstract_en: The application provides a heterotrophic nitrification aerobic denitrifying bacteria screening chip and a screening method, and relates to the technical field of environmental microorganisms. Through setting up heterotrophic nitrification aerobic denitrifying bacteria screening chip internal channel structure, can shorten the time of screening target strain by a wide margin, improve enrichment efficiency, reduce medicament consumption and pollution emission simultaneously.

title_en: Construction and application of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus attenuated FJzz1 strain infectious clone
abstract_en: The application provides a reverse genetic system for rescuing porcine epidemic diarrhea virus FJzz1 strain based on an in-vitro connection means and application thereof. By analyzing the whole genome, we divide the genome into seven fragments of unequal sizes of A, B, C, D, E, F and G on the basis of unique restriction enzyme cleavage sites in the whole genome. Subsequently to increase the efficiency of subsequent ligation, we integrated these seven small fragments into three large fragments AB, CDE and FG. Full-length cDNA is transcribed into RNA transcripts in vitro by using a T7 in vitro transcription kit, and the RNA transcripts and N gene RNA transcripts are transfected into Vero cells to rescue viruses. The rFJzz1 attenuated infectious clone strain which can be inherited stably and has genetic markers is successfully obtained, and a technical platform is provided for the subsequent research of the PEDV pathogenesis of the FJzz1 strain and the development of novel vaccines.

title_en: Method for breeding improved strain of large yellow croaker for resisting pseudomonas putida disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeding method of a large yellow croaker anti-pseudomonas putida fine breed, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a reference population, secondly, constructing a candidate population, thirdly, genotyping the reference population and the candidate population, fourthly, constructing a genetic analysis model, and fifthly, screening fine parents by calculating individual multi-character compound estimated breeding values of the candidate population; on the basis of accurately assessing the disease resistance phenotype, the invention fully utilizes the genotype information of individuals, greatly improves the genetic improvement effect, rapidly and accurately cultures the excellent germplasm of the large yellow croaker with obviously improved disease resistance, effectively shortens the breeding period, and provides a novel efficient and reliable method for culturing the high-quality large yellow croaker with pseudomonas putida resistance.

title_en: Lactobacillus plantarum for preventing and treating obesity by regulating intestinal microbial flora
abstract_en: The invention provides lactobacillus plantarum for preventing and treating obesity by regulating intestinal microbial flora, which has a preservation number of CCTCC NO:15654. the lactobacillus plantarum KSFY01 strain is obtained by separating and purifying a fermented dairy product of karsch from Xinjiang, and the lactobacillus plantarum KSFY01 strain is used for preparing fermented milk and a gastric lavage high fat model mouse. The fermented yoghourt provided by the invention can reduce the weight increase of high-fat fed mice and reduce epididymal fat index and liver index. The strain can inhibit hyperlipidemia induced by high fat diet, relieve liver injury, promote oxidation resistance, and inhibit systemic inflammation. Meanwhile, the strain can reduce fat accumulation, reduce the volume of fat cells, relieve liver lipid degeneration caused by high-fat diet and repair liver injury. The strain is used for treating obesity by regulating the expression of liver and small intestine obesity genes and changing intestinal flora.

title_en: In vitro culture method for embryo yolk sac blood island of mouse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of in vitro culture of mammalian embryos, in particular to an in vitro culture method of mouse embryos from blastula to yolk bursa blood islands. Specifically, the invention advances the continuous culture stage of the mouse embryo to the development of the yolk sac blood island by adopting an improved 3D bionic culture system and improved culture components, thereby providing an effective research platform for the development mechanism of the embryo yolk sac hematopoietic system.

title_en: Coronavirus mRNA vaccine and application thereof
abstract_en: Provided herein are coronavirus mRNA vaccines and uses thereof. The nucleic acid molecules herein encode highly immunogenic antigens capable of eliciting potent neutralizing antibody responses against coronaviruses, and key neutralizing domains for expressing coronavirus spike (S) proteins, are effective in inducing protective immunity when used alone or in combination as immunogenic compositions or vaccines.

title_en: Construction method of mouse lung adenocarcinoma model with Nrf1 alveolus II type epithelial cells specifically knocked out
abstract_en: The invention relates to a specific knockout of alveolar type II epithelial cells Nrf1 A method for constructing a lung adenocarcinoma model of a mouse belongs to the technical field of medicine. Specifically comprises the induction by using the carbamic acid ethyl ester Nrf1 Pulmonary adenocarcinoma occurs in alveolar type II epithelial cell-specific knockout mice. On the basis of the traditional model of the lung adenocarcinoma of the mice caused by the urethane, the tumor load of the lung tumor of the mice of the C57BL/6 strain is improved, the total molding time is shortened, the cost benefit is reduced, a reliable model is provided for the research of complex carcinogenesis mechanisms involving genes and exogenous environmental factors in the development of the lung adenocarcinoma, and the method has important research significance for the establishment of intervention strategies and prevention measures of the lung adenocarcinoma. The method is simple to operate, high in repeatability, easy to master and convenient to popularize.

title_en: Preparation and application of african swine fever virus structural protein p17 specific monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of a monoclonal antibody specific to a structural protein p17 of African swine fever virus. Monoclonal antibody is prepared by prokaryotic expression of African swine fever virus structural protein p17, and the epitope corresponding to the antibody is identified as  68  SSIPKPPPSYY  78  And (3) with  67  KSSIPKPPPSYYV  79  。

title_en: Method for domesticating serum-free full-suspension HEK293 cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses a method for domesticating serum-free full-suspension HEK293 cells and application thereof. The serum-free full-suspension HEK293 cell strain is named as human embryo kidney 293 suspension cell 293S-NB and is preserved in the Guangdong province microorganism strain collection of building 5 of No. 59 of No. 100 of Mitsui, guangzhou, china on the 12 th month of 2022, wherein the preservation number is GDMCC NO:63099; the cell has stable growth state, good dispersibility, high cell density, high activity rate and strong toxin production capacity, can be used for large-scale production, further can be used for preparing proteins, amplifying viruses and preparing vaccines, and the serum-free suspension culture medium adopted by the cell culture does not contain serum, has definite components and is beneficial to improving the quality of large-scale biological products.

title_en: Microbial production of tyrosol and salidroside
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method for producing tyrosol, wherein transgenic bacterial cells which heterologously express phenylpyruvate decarboxylase and overexpress phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxyheptonic acid and prephenate dehydrogenase and wherein both pheAL and feaB are inactivated or removed are grown in a medium comprising metabolic precursors of phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) and erythrose 4-phosphate (E4P), in particular glucose, and optionally phenylalanine as a supplement; and extracting tyrosol from said medium. The application also relates to a method for producing salidroside, wherein the transgenic cell additionally heterologously expresses uridine diphosphate-dependent glycosyltransferase (UGT 85A1, EC: 2.4.1.).

title_en: African swine fever virus detection primer composition, test strip, kit and method
abstract_en: The application relates to an African swine fever virus detection primer composition, a test strip, a kit and a method. The detection primer composition for the African swine fever virus comprises a forward outer primer shown as SEQ ID NO.1, a reverse outer primer shown as SEQ ID NO.2, a forward inner primer shown as SEQ ID NO.3, a reverse inner primer shown as SEQ ID NO.4 and a reverse loop primer shown as SEQ ID NO.5. The application aims to provide a fast African swine fever virus detection test strip and a kit, which can quantitatively detect African swine fever virus with low cost, high speed and high accuracy.

title_en: Fruit and vegetable waste recycling treatment method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of fermentation treatment and application of fruit and vegetable waste, and particularly relates to a fruit and vegetable waste recycling treatment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting fruit and vegetable garbage; s2, adding the fruit and vegetable garbage obtained in the step S1 into a fermentation buffer solution; s3, adding a composite strain into the fermentation buffer solution containing the fruit and vegetable garbage in the step S2 for fermentation; s4, dissolving zeolite and sodium alginate in water, stirring to obtain enzyme activity maintaining liquid, and adding complex enzyme into the enzyme activity maintaining liquid; s5, after the fermentation reaction in the step S3 is carried out for 2 to 3 days, adding the enzyme activity maintaining solution containing the complex enzyme in the step S4 for secondary fermentation; s6, sterilizing, centrifuging and concentrating the substances subjected to the secondary fermentation in the step S5 to obtain a fermentation concentrated solution. The fermentation process is accurately regulated and controlled, the active substance content of the fermented concentrated solution obtained after fermentation is high, the ferment effect can be improved, the fermentation efficiency is high, the fermentation mode is simple to operate, the sources of raw materials are wide, and popularization and application are easy to realize.

title_en: Application of cabbage type rape Bra023796 gene in improving high temperature stress resistance of cabbage type rape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to application of a cabbage type rape Bra023796 gene in improving the high temperature stress resistance of cabbage type rape. The invention constructs an over-expression vector by utilizing the nucleotide sequence 996bp of the cabbage type rape (cabbage 45) Bra023796 gene and pCAMB IAsuper1300-EGFP, and transfers the gene fragment into the cabbage type rape by a transgenic technology, compared with a wild type plant, the over-expression Bra023796 transgenic plant can obviously enhance the high temperature stress tolerance of the cabbage type rape, which indicates that the cabbage type rape Bra023796 gene can be used as a positive regulatory factor of the cabbage type rape for high temperature stress resistance.

title_en: Gene transient expression method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular biology, in particular to a gene transient expression method and application. The invention provides a gene transient expression method, which takes DNA as a substrate, obtains a complete gene expression cassette through PCR amplification, and greatly saves the time for preparing the gene expression cassette; the amplified gene expression cassette can be used as a substrate to carry out transient expression of genes in expression systems such as cells or protoplasts, so that the transfection power and the expression efficiency can be improved, and the expressed gene fragment quantity can be increased. The gene transient expression method provided by the invention is simple and convenient to operate, the experimental period is greatly shortened, the transient expression efficiency is greatly improved, and verifiable DNA fragments (including but not limited to a promoter sequence, a gene coding region and a terminator sequence) are greatly increased. In addition, the gene transient expression method provided by the invention obtains good performance in the transient expression of the gene of a species with smaller protoplast (such as orchid).

title_en: Preparation method of biological enzyme microbial inoculum for soil remediation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a biological enzyme microbial inoculum for soil remediation, which comprises the following steps of; step 1, extracting unsaturated fatty acid, adding a hardening agent, uniformly mixing, heating to obtain a dense mixture, cooling the mixture to prepare hollow capsules, and injecting gel carrying oxidase into the capsules. The composite biological enzyme can promote the transformation and circulation of nutrients in the soil, improve the fertility of the soil, and promote the growth and development of plants by repairing the soil with the biological enzyme; and the biological enzyme can decompose organic substances in the soil, increase the organic matter content of the soil, improve the structure of the soil, increase the agglomeration force and permeability of the soil, improve the water retention capacity and air permeability of the soil, and simultaneously stimulate the microbial activity in the soil, and increase the quantity and diversity of soil microorganisms, thereby improving the stability and the function of a soil ecological system.

title_en: anti-vWF/PF 4 protein monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a monoclonal antibody of anti-vWF/PF 4 protein and application thereof, in particular relates to a monoclonal antibody of anti-vWF/PF 4 protein or an antigen binding fragment thereof, wherein the monoclonal antibody or the antigen binding fragment thereof comprises SEQ ID NO:1, a heavy chain variable region CDR1, SEQ ID NO:2, a heavy chain variable region CDR2, SEQ ID NO:3, a heavy chain variable region CDR3 as set forth in SEQ ID NO:4, the light chain variable region CDR1, SEQ ID NO:5, the light chain variable region CDR2, SEQ ID NO:6, and a light chain variable region CDR3. The application also provides nucleotide molecules, vectors, host cells, methods and uses encoding the monoclonal antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof. The application also provides products, compositions and derivatives comprising the monoclonal antibodies of the application or antigen binding fragments thereof.

title_en: Myclobutanil hapten, antigen, antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of immunoassay, and provides a myclobutanil hapten, an antigen, an antibody, a preparation method and application. According to the invention, the active group is introduced in the meta-position of the chlorine atom on the benzene ring of the myclobutanil, and compared with the existing hapten, the hapten provided by the invention completely simulates the structure of the myclobutanil and enhances the immunogenicity of the antigen. The myclobutanil hapten and carrier protein are coupled, the obtained antigen has strong immunogenicity, and the titer of the generated antibody is 5.0 multiplied by 10 after the injection and the immunization of mice  4  Semi-inhibitory concentration (IC  50  ) The minimum detection limit of the colloidal gold on the myclobutanil in the dry tobacco leaf sample is about 2.5 mug/g.

title_en: Hrpx protein growth promoting peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: Hrpx protein growth promoting peptide and application thereof, and relates to growth promoting peptide and application thereof. It is an object of the present invention to provide Hrpx protein growth promoting peptides which have properties superior to the full length Harpin protein. The Hrpx protein growth promoting peptide is Hrpx-1, hrpx-8, hrpx-9 and Hrpx-10, and can promote plant growth. The arabidopsis after seed soaking of Hrpx-1, hrpx-8, hrpx-9 and Hrpx-10 of the invention has stronger roots and more branches than that of the control group, and the average root length and average fresh weight are obviously higher than those of the control group. Furthermore, the average root length and fresh weight of Hrpx-1, hrpx-8, hrpx-9 and Hrpx-10 treated seeds were significantly better than the control group, and also greater than Hrpx treated seeds. The Hrpx protein growth promoting peptide of the invention is superior to full-length Hrpx protein and has better thermal stability.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide for nonspecific targeted inhibition of pathogenic bacteria and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial peptide for nonspecifically targeting to inhibit pathogenic bacteria and application thereof. The sequence of the antibacterial peptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The antibacterial peptide is simple to prepare and low in cytotoxicity, can inhibit pathogenic bacteria in a nonspecific targeting manner, does not influence the normal growth of probiotics, is suitable for preparing antibacterial agents, such as oral supplies, and can regulate the balance of oral microecology, and further can be used for preventing and treating oral diseases, particularly caries, periodontitis, oral mucosa diseases or oral cancers. In addition, the antibacterial peptide has short length and small chemical synthesis difficulty, can be directly combined into a high-purity product, and has definite effect and wide application.

title_en: Culture device and culture method for microalgae culture by pig farm wastewater
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microalgae culture, in particular to a culture device for culturing microalgae by pig farm wastewater, which comprises the following components: the incubator is internally rotationally connected with a spraying assembly, the incubator is internally rotationally connected with a rotating rod, the surface of the rotating rod is slidingly connected with a linkage assembly, and the linkage assembly limits the spraying assembly; a limiting component is movably inserted into the top surface of the incubator, and limits the linkage component by the limiting component; the beneficial effects are as follows: the limiting plate is rotated to enable the side groove on the surface of the limiting plate to approach the direction of the driving plate until the limiting plate is not contacted with the driving plate any more, under the action of the spring outside the jacking rod, the jacking ball at one end of the jacking rod moves downwards to extrude one end of the driving plate, and the driving plate is extruded by the jacking ball until one end of the driving plate is positioned in the rotating groove, so that when the motor drives the rotating rod to rotate, one end of the driving plate can drive the sprayer to rotate along the rotating groove; the spray range of the spray head is enlarged, so that the spray head can spray microalgae in the incubator in an all-around way.

title_en: Method for identifying circadian rhythm expression of klebsiella pneumoniae genes by using bioluminescence report system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying the circadian rhythm expression of klebsiella pneumoniae genes by using a bioluminescence report system. The invention constructs the recombinant bioluminescence Klebsiella pneumoniae driven by a metabolic gene malic acid: quinone oxidoreductase mqo promoter (Pmqo), and intuitively observes the change rule of bacterial gene expression under the entrainment and free running conditions of temperature cycle through luminous characteristic monitoring. The luxCDABE gene operon contains genes encoding luciferases and substrate synthases, wherein luxA and luxB encode heterodimeric luciferases, and luxC, luxD and luxE synthesize fatty aldehyde as substrates for the luminescence reaction of the luciferases. The luciferase catalyzes the oxidation of fatty aldehyde to generate visible blue-green light with the wavelength of 450-490 nm.
