The Lux bioluminescence report system has the advantages of no need of adding exogenous substrate and no influence on the normal physiological function of a host, and can be applied to the identification of the circadian expression of Klebsiella pneumoniae genes.

title_en: Primer group, kit and method for simultaneously detecting HBA1/2 and HBB gene abnormality
abstract_en: The application relates to a primer group, a kit and a method for simultaneously detecting HBA1/2 and HBB genes, wherein the primer group comprises an HBA2 primer pair, an alpha 3.7 primer pair, an alpha 4.2 primer pair, an SEA primer pair, a THAI primer pair and an HBB primer pair. The primer group can directly amplify the HBA2 and HBB genes in the sample, does not need a nucleic acid extraction step, and can stably amplify amplified fragments with the length within the range of 750-3000 bp.

title_en: Novel steroid hormone ligand assay
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the detection of ligands that bind to and activate steroid hormone receptors. In particular, the invention provides test kits and assay methods for selectively identifying steroid hormone receptor ligands in a test sample. Importantly, the test kits and assay methods described herein are cell-free and do not require the manufacture of expensive nuclear extracts for their performance. In contrast, the test kits and assay methods described herein use a single polypeptide polymerase, such as T7RNA polymerase, linked to a reporter construct. The activity of the enzyme is inhibited, but not activated, by ligand-bound steroid hormone receptor complex formed only in the presence of the target ligand. Thus, a change in a measured physical property (e.g., fluorescence output) of the reporter construct can be used to determine the presence of the target ligand in the sample under study.

title_en: Paenispira rosea strain and application thereof in promoting growth of chlorella
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a strain of Paenibacillus roseus and application thereof in promoting growth of chlorella. A strain of the Saprolegnia rosea is strain SSJ1 of Saprolegnia rosea Clonostachys rosea, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the number of 40657 and the address: the institute of microorganisms of national academy of sciences of China, no.1, no.3, north Chen West Lu, the Korean region of Beijing.

title_en: Use and composition of lactobacillus paracasei ET-22-derived peptidoglycan in breath freshening
abstract_en: The invention provides application and a composition of lactobacillus paracasei ET-22 source peptidoglycan in breath freshening. The peptidoglycan provided by the invention is derived from heat-inactivated bacteria of lactobacillus paracasei ET-22, can obviously reduce the content of Volatile Sulfide Compounds (VSCs) and volatile compounds (VOCs) in oral cavity, reduce the content of characteristic flavor compounds such as indole, propionic acid and capric acid, and has the effects of relieving and inhibiting halitosis and refreshing breath.

title_en: Organic active ionized calcium and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses organic active ionized calcium and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ionized calcium preparation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: soaking oyster shell in alkaline solution, cleaning, drying, sterilizing, and pulverizing; adding water, stirring uniformly, adding composite strain, fermenting and activating at 30-40deg.C for 1-5d; and (3) after centrifugation, calcining, naturally cooling to room temperature, and grinding to obtain the organic active ionic calcium. The active calcium produced by the method has high purity, the content of calcium oxide is more than or equal to 28 percent, and the intermolecular binding force is weakened, so that the activity and the solubility are high, the dissolution rate reaches 98 percent, and the granularity of the product particles is uniform. The invention solves the problems of complex operation, uneven pH value, large granularity and low dissolution rate in the preparation of active ionized calcium products in the prior art.

title_en: Biological sample processing device and biological detection system
abstract_en: The application provides a biological sample processing device and a biological detection system, and belongs to the technical field of biological sample detection. The biological sample processing device comprises a sample processing component, a sample processing device and a biological sample processing device, wherein the sample processing component comprises a cracking cavity for receiving a sample to be processed and cracking the sample to be processed, a cleaning cavity for cleaning the sample to be processed, and a communication channel for communicating the cracking cavity and the cleaning cavity; the separation plate is arranged in the cracking cavity, the separation plate divides the cracking cavity into a first area and a second area, the bottom areas of the first area and the second area are communicated with each other, the corresponding areas of the separation plate are isolated from each other, and the first area is positioned between the communication channel and the second area. By adopting the biological sample processing device and the biological detection system provided by the application, the problems of excessively high manufacturing cost and excessively large device volume of the biological sample processing device caused by the need of a large amount of lipophilic substances in the prior art are at least solved.

title_en: Paris polyphylla-derived extracellular vesicles, and separation and extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an extracellular vesicle from paris polyphylla, and a separation and extraction method and application thereof, belonging to the technical fields of molecular biology and biomedicine; grinding paris polyphylla tubers to obtain paris polyphylla tuber juice, removing large-particle paris polyphylla tissues through low-speed centrifugation for multiple times, and simultaneously precipitating the outer vesicles of paris polyphylla subjected to low-speed centrifugation through 8% PEG 8000; extracellular vesicles were purified by sucrose gradient ultracentrifugation after precipitation. The separation and extraction method has the advantages of wide material sources, low cost, easily available reagents, simple operation, and capability of efficiently separating and extracting the paris polyphylla extracellular vesicles, thereby being beneficial to the development of the extracellular vesicle extraction technology from plant cells and the development of novel nano drug-carrying materials in the later period.

title_en: Acinetobacter with efficient nitrogen fixation capability and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses acinetobacter with high-efficiency nitrogen fixation capability and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial agents. Acinetobacter is Acinetobacter (Acinetobacter sp.) WXH-G5, the preservation number is CGMCC No.27719, and the Acinetobacter is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (China general microbiological culture Collection center) at the year 6 and the month 27, and the preservation address is: no. 1 and No. 3 of the north cinquefoil of the morning sun area of beijing city. The WXH-G5 strain isolated by the application not only has excellent nitrogen fixation effect, but also can improve the soil environment and promote the growth of plant height and the increase of leaf area.

title_en: Levodopa production strain and directional transformation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a directional transformation method of a levodopa production strain, a production strain and a levodopa fermentation method, wherein the strain is obtained by transforming a levodopa metabolic synthesis way, the levodopa production strain LDp10 can be used for synthesizing the levodopa from the head by taking glucose as a carbon source, a tyrosine substrate is not required to be added, the method has the advantages of high production rate, short fermentation period, high strain stability and low cost, a foundation is laid for realizing the large-scale production of the levodopa, the levodopa production strain LDp10 is utilized by a fermentation tank fermentation method to produce the levodopa in a mechanical stirring type fermentation tank, and the levodopa 15g/L is produced by fermenting for 36h, so that the method has good industrial prospect.

title_en: Fermented traditional Chinese medicine composite preparation for preventing and treating piglet viral diarrhea as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fermented traditional Chinese medicine composite preparation for preventing and treating piglet viral diarrhea, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of probiotics fermented traditional Chinese medicines. The Chinese medicinal composition is mainly prepared by taking a Chinese medicinal composition as a basic raw material, fermenting by using a quintuplet probiotics, and adding brine alga liquid, PEDV egg yolk antibody, whey powder, sodium chloride, glucose and the like to mix. The traditional Chinese medicine composition specifically comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1 to 30 parts of Chinese pulsatilla root, 1 to 30 parts of white peony root, 1 to 10 parts of coptis root, 1 to 10 parts of kudzuvine root, 1 to 15 parts of bupleurum, 1 to 20 parts of stir-fried largehead atractylodes rhizome, 1 to 10 parts of radish seed, 1 to 10 parts of officinal magnolia bark, 1 to 10 parts of Chinese angelica, 1 to 10 parts of costustoot and 1 to 15 parts of raw liquorice, and all the components are mutually matched to cooperatively play a role. The invention adopts the modern biological fermentation technology, based on the traditional Chinese medicine composition, five probiotics are used for co-fermentation to realize the biotransformation of microorganisms on the traditional Chinese medicine, change the drug property of the traditional Chinese medicine and realize the synergistic detoxification effect.

title_en: Self-source nano bubble circulating biological hydrogen production system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-source nano-bubble circulating biological hydrogen production system, which comprises a biological hydrogen production module and a nano-bubble preparation module; the biological hydrogen production module is used for fermenting and producing gas I containing hydrogen and carbon dioxide; the nano bubble preparation module comprises a gas separator and a nano bubble generator; the gas I is separated by a gas separator to obtain hydrogen and a gas II which does not contain hydrogen but contains carbon dioxide; the gas II is prepared into nano bubbles by a nano bubble generator, and the nano bubbles are conveyed to a biological hydrogen production module to be mixed with fermentation raw materials for fermentation to produce hydrogen. The method uses the gas generated by self-source biological fermentation as a source, separates the hydrogen, adopts the gas (mainly carbon dioxide) after removing the hydrogen to prepare nano bubbles, supplements the nano bubbles into the biological hydrogen production module, achieves the effect of improving the biological hydrogen yield and simultaneously circularly purifying the hydrogen, and simultaneously reduces the adverse effect of carbon dioxide discharge on the environment.

title_en: MBBR carrier film forming process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment, and particularly relates to a MBBR carrier film forming process which comprises the following steps of S1, treating an MBBR carrier by using low-temperature plasma reaction gas to obtain a modified MBBR carrier, S2, inoculating aerobic nitrifying bacteria in a reactor loaded with sewage to perform expansion culture to obtain bacterial liquid, S3, adding the modified MBBR carrier and N-acyl homoserine lactone into the bacterial liquid to perform primary film forming on the surface of the modified MBBR carrier to obtain a first film forming system, and S4, inoculating anaerobic denitrifying bacteria into the first film forming system to form a biological film on the surface of the modified MBBR carrier to obtain a second film forming system. The invention combines the processes of low-temperature plasma modification, signal factor introduction, special film-forming sequence and the like, and has the advantages of taking into account a plurality of stages of microbial film forming, shortening the film-forming process, strengthening the connection strength between the biological film and the surface of the MBBR carrier, and having good sewage ammonia nitrogen treatment effect.

title_en: Detection chip
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection chip, and relates to the technical field of cell detection. The invention provides a detection chip, which comprises an upper plate, a bottom plate and an adhesive connecting piece, wherein the upper plate is provided with a plurality of grooves; the upper plate is provided with a sample adding hole and an exhaust hole; one end of the viscous connecting piece is connected with the upper plate, the other end of the viscous connecting piece is connected with the bottom plate, and the viscous connecting piece is provided with a sample adding groove which is communicated with the sample adding hole and the exhaust hole. By arranging the viscous connecting piece with viscosity between the upper plate and the bottom plate, the components are tightly connected, so that the risks of sliding among the components and detecting the risk of leakage of the chip are avoided; even if carelessly falls to the floor, the floor is not broken or broken pieces fall to the ground, so that the safety risk in the use process is further reduced. And the cavity formed by the plurality of sample adding holes, the sample adding grooves and the exhaust holes can be used for testing different samples according to different projects, so that the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Treatment method for carrying out anaerobic digestion on high ammonia nitrogen waste through co-digestion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of anaerobic digestion, and relates to a treatment method for performing anaerobic digestion on high ammonia nitrogen waste through co-digestion. The method is that long-chain fatty acid is added into an anaerobic digestion system with high-nitrogen-content organic waste as a substrate, so that the concentration of initial long-chain fatty acid in the anaerobic digestion system is 1-2.5g/L. The ammonia nitrogen inhibition phenomenon can occur when the high-nitrogen organic waste is subjected to anaerobic digestion, and the inhibition effect of the ammonia nitrogen on the anaerobic digestion process can be relieved by co-digestion with LCFA.

title_en: Terminal repair fidelity detection method and kit for DNA polymerase
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a kit for detecting the terminal repair fidelity of DNA polymerase. The detection method comprises the steps of obtaining a sequencing result of an amplified region in a sequence sample; obtaining an effective sequence through screening a sequencing result; based on the effective sequence, the total error amount and the sequencing error amount in the effective sequence are obtained, and the end repair fidelity of the DNA polymerase to be detected is calculated. According to the method, the sequencing result of the amplified and aligned section is subjected to data screening to obtain the effective sequence, the influence of the amplification and sequencing error quantity on the calculation of the DNA polymerase tail end repair error is removed through data screening, and the accuracy of judging the tail end repair error rate is improved.

title_en: SERS biosensor and application thereof in detection of transgenic corn Ruifeng 125
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SERS biosensor and application thereof in detecting transgenic corn Ruifeng 125. Comprising the following steps: a signaling unit, a capture unit, and a Cas9-tracrRNA-crRNA system for specifically cleaving tDNA of a gene characteristic of transgenic maize run 125; the Cas9-tracrRNA-crRNA system can specifically identify and cut and detect characteristic tDNA in a sample, and cDNA on the surface of the capturing unit and probe DNA of the signal unit are subjected to sandwich hybridization with the tDNA to generate strong SERS signals and have characteristic Raman spectra; the method is applied to detecting transgenic corn Ruifeng 125, has good linear correlation between SERS signal intensity and the logarithm of target DNA concentration, has detection limit of 0.5fM, has sensitivity as low as 1fM, and has the advantages of high sensitivity, good selectivity and the like.

title_en: Molecular marker PMEL17 gene for breast muscle blackness of radix aconiti-containing chicken and genetic marking method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of molecular biotechnology and breeding of radix aconiti kusnezoffii chicken, and particularly relates to a molecular marker PMEL17 gene of pectoral muscle of radix aconiti kusnezoffii chicken and a genetic marking method thereof. The nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. Designing a primer pair, and performing PCR amplification by taking genomic DNA of the radix aconiti kusnezoffii bone chicken as a template to obtain a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 4; identifying whether a mutation exists in the sequence; and (5) analyzing the correlation between the mutation and the breast muscle blackness of the aconitum-bath chicken. The gene screened by the invention is related gene of the breast muscle blackness of the chicken with the radix aconiti, and further the SNP related to the character is screened on the 553 locus of the PMEL17 gene sequence, so that the gene can be used as a genetic marker for auxiliary selection of the chicken with the radix aconiti. Through genetic markers, the black-bone chicken with more melanin deposition and deeper black color can be bred, and the black-bone chicken has important significance and application value for genetic breeding of the black-bone chicken.

title_en: Synthetic peptide for detecting circulating tumor cells, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthetic peptide for detecting circulating tumor cells, a kit and application thereof. The synthetic peptide is selected from the group consisting of VAR2CSA functional domain ID1-DBL2X-ID2a peptide fragments. The kit has strong specificity, overcomes the limitation of factors such as the expression downregulation of common markers such as EpCAM, CK, vimentin, N-cadherein and the like under the exogenous stimulation of tumor cells or the variation of the tumor cells, has stronger stability of peptide synthesis compared with antibodies, and has large-scale production capacity.

title_en: Feeder cell for expressing recombinant antigen protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feeder cell for expressing recombinant antigen protein, a preparation method and application thereof. The surface of the feeder cells expresses the recombinant antigen protein that is recognized by effector cells, thereby activating the effector cells; the feeder cells are immune cells expressing recombinant antigen proteins. The invention solves the problem of poor response of effector cells under the condition of low tumor target cell number, and provides the feeder cells for expressing the recombinant antigen protein, so that the effector cells can still exert excellent anti-tumor activity under the condition of low tumor target cell number. The strategy is an original cell product application strategy, is a strategy which does not exist clinically at present, and is also a preventive strategy which is put forward for the first time.

title_en: Mutant strain DeltaarnA of aeromonas dacarbazine and double mutant strain Deltaugd DeltaarnA, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutant strain delta arnA of aeromonas dacarbazine and a double mutant strain delta ugd delta arnA, and a construction method and application thereof. The mutant strain of the aeromonas dactyli is obtained by deleting the argA gene or the ugd gene and the argA gene on the basis of the wild strain of the aeromonas dactyli. Experimental results show that the resistance of the deleted strain of the dacarbazine to polymyxin is weakened, the toxicity to the zebra fish is weakened, and the survival rate of the zebra fish in a toxicity attack test can be improved by using the deleted strain for immune protection. Therefore, the invention is helpful to promote the understanding of pathogenic mechanism and drug-resistant mechanism of the aeromonas dactyli, provides reference for the target gene selection in immune control, and also can provide effective technical means for promoting the healthy development of crocodile breeding industry and protecting the property of crocodile farmers.

title_en: Novel strain of acinetobacter and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel acinetobacter strain and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of microorganisms, and the technical scheme is characterized in that the novel acinetobacter strain belongs to the genus acinetobacter and is preserved in the microorganism strain preservation center of Guangdong province, the preservation date is 10 month 09 of 2023, and the preservation number is GDMCCNO:63863. The Acinetobacter strain which is separated from a hospital sewage treatment pool and does not contain drug resistance genes, does not contain virulence genes, is sensitive to temperature and strong in environment adaptability, is used for treating various organic matters in the wastewater and secreting bioactive metabolites is identified as a new strain of Acinetobacter bacteria, namely Acinetobacter chuandaensis WCHAc060042,060 042, and fills the blank of research in the field of China.

title_en: Histidine decarboxylase expression plasmid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an expression plasmid of histidine decarboxylase and application thereof, wherein the expression plasmid is constructed by selecting proper expression vectors pET-28a plasmid, pACYCDuet-sfp plasmid or pTrc-p99A plasmid, so as to obtain corresponding recombinant genetically engineered bacteria, and the histamine is synthesized by using a biological enzyme method to catalyze, so that the recombinant genetically engineered bacteria are more environment-friendly than the existing chemical synthesis method.

title_en: Double-fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells and application thereof. The double fluorescent protein co-expression system comprises a recombinant vector which is inserted into a pIZ-V5-His vector of an EGFP gene fragment or an mCherry gene fragment respectively, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the EGFP gene fragment is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the mCherry gene fragment is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. According to the double fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells, EGFP and mCherry genes are respectively inserted into a pIZ-V5-His carrier, and the EGFP and mCherry designed are inserted into the forward positions (HindIII and BamHI sites) of enzyme cutting sites, so that the utilization rate of enzyme cutting sites of a carrier skeleton is improved to the greatest extent while fluorescent protein fusion is realized; the recombinant expression vector can be used for promoting expression of green or red double-fluorescence fusion proteins in silkworm BmN cells, can be used for functional research such as protein detection and interaction, realizes visualization of protein expression and localization to be detected, and can be used for detecting protein expression and interaction by using antibodies of EGFP and mCherry proteins.

title_en: Monoclonal neutralizing antibody of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monoclonal neutralizing antibody of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus and application thereof, which can be used for detecting PEDV S1 protein, expressing expression plasmid of PEDV-S1 full-length protein and soluble PEDV-S1 protein, and showing good neutralizing effect on PEDV infected Huh7 cells, can be used for preparing a monoclonal antibody with strong specificity based on the monoclonal antibody, has important significance for providing effective protection for PEDV infection, can widely control PEDV infection, and improves the prevention strength on domestic porcine epidemic diarrhea diseases.

title_en: Methanotrophic engineering bacteria for producing phenazine-1-carboxylic acid, construction method and application
abstract_en: The methanotrophic engineering bacteria integrate exogenous phenazine-1-carboxylic acid synthesis gene clusters into a methanotrophic host genome by a genome integration method, so that the construction of a host heterologous phenazine-1-carboxylic acid synthesis module is completed; synthesizing phenazine-1-carboxylic acid in methanotrophic bacteria by taking a carbon compound as a carbon source, and applying the compound to the production of microbial source phenazine-1-carboxylic acid and derivatives thereof; based on the agricultural and medical activities and the electron transfer function, the phenazine-1-carboxylic acid enhances and promotes the methane oxidation efficiency through the electron transfer process, thereby improving the yield of the phenazine-1-carboxylic acid and realizing the high-efficiency bioconversion of methane.

title_en: Villous wheat sucrose non-glycolysis type protein kinase SnRK2.9-V gene and protein coded by same and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a villous wheat sucrose non-glycolysis type protein kinase SnRK2.9-V gene and a protein coded by the same and application thereof. The cDNA sequence of SnRK2.9-V is SEQ ID NO.1 and the coded amino acid sequence is SEQ ID NO.2. The gene is from diploid haynaldia villosa, and has high expression level in Mao Maizhong roots, stems, leaves and seeds. 3 transgenic plants with the overexpression of SnRK2.9-V are obtained through a transgenic technology, the expression quantity of the SnRK2.9-V is 9-28 times of the field expression quantity, and the overexpression of the transgenic plants positively regulates the grain width and thousand grain weight of the wheat. Therefore, the SnRK2.9-V is expected to be used for genetic engineering breeding, and the overexpression vector pMWB110-SnRK2.9-V is introduced into a high-yield wheat variety, so that the grain width and thousand grain weight of Gao Xiaomai are expected to be improved.

title_en: SNP molecular marker for identifying pepper epidemic disease resistance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pepper epidemic disease detection, and particularly provides an SNP molecular marker for identifying pepper epidemic disease resistance and application thereof. According to the invention, through genetic analysis, molecular marker loci coseparated with the resistance of the pepper epidemic disease are screened on the resistance gene of the pepper epidemic disease. The molecular marker is positioned at 67bp of a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the polymorphism is C/T. The molecular marker and the primer pair can be used for rapidly and accurately detecting the epidemic disease resistance of pepper germplasm in a seedling stage, can be used for molecular marker assisted selection breeding, improves the selection efficiency, and has important application value for accelerating the breeding process of pepper epidemic disease resistance varieties.

title_en: Be applied to purification device of healthy health preserving product research and development
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of small molecular peptide purification, and discloses a purification device applied to research and development of health care products, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a decomposing tank, the inside of the decomposing tank is rotationally connected with a material barrel, the top of the decomposing tank is fixedly connected with a feeding barrel, the inside of the feeding barrel is rotationally connected with a driving shaft, the outside of the driving shaft is provided with a plurality of crushing cutters, the top of the feeding barrel is fixedly connected with a driving motor, and an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the top of the driving shaft.

title_en: Stapler peptide capable of improving activity of resisting drug-resistant bacteria, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polypeptide medicaments, and particularly relates to a staple peptide for improving the activity of resisting drug-resistant bacteria, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes Rink amide MBHA amino resin as a solid phase carrier, and according to template polypeptide SLP-0:Ac-LKRVWKRVFKLLKRYWRQLKKPVR-NH  2  Modification of the amino acid sequence in which amino acid residues 12L and 16W are S  5  And (5) replacing and cyclization to obtain the target stapling peptide. The staple peptide can obviously improve the inhibition activity to staphylococcus aureus, escherichia coli, pseudomonas aeruginosa and acinetobacter baumannii, and has potential application value in the treatment of related diseases such as clinical drug-resistant bacteria infection and the like.

title_en: Purification system and purification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of spore powder processing, in particular to a purification system and a purification method; the purification system comprises a feeding unit, a material separation unit, a stirring unit, a negative pressure separation unit and a collection unit, wherein the feeding unit supplies materials to the material separation unit when the spore powder is lifted and stored, the material separation unit separates fine materials from coarse materials in the materials, the separated fine materials enter the stirring unit, the stirring unit further refines the fine materials by stirring the fine materials, the spore powder in the fine materials is separated, the refined fine materials and the spore powder form spore powder micro-materials, the spore powder micro-materials are led out of the stirring unit under the negative pressure action of the negative pressure separation unit and enter the collection unit to be collected, the spore powder is lifted and stored, the coarse materials of the stirring unit can be effectively reduced through the separation of the fine materials by the material separation unit, the adhesion of the spore powder on the surface of the materials is further reduced, and the purification rate of the spore powder is obviously improved.

title_en: Novel bacillus subtilis and application thereof in whole cell transformation of artificial bear gall powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a brand new bacillus subtilis and application thereof in whole cell transformation of artificial bear gall powder, belonging to the fields of foods and biological medicines. According to the invention, the 7 alpha-HSDH and 7 beta-HSDH enzymes are expressed in the food-grade safety strain bacillus subtilis, the expression quantity of the 7 alpha-HSDH and 7 beta-HSDH enzymes is obviously improved by fusing heat shock proteins and culturing in a heat stress mode, the thallus of the recombinant bacillus subtilis is added into chicken gall powder solution and is matched with coenzyme with proper concentration, so that the accumulation of natural bear gall powder components (TUDCA) outside cells can be realized, and the ratio of TUDCA/TCDCA in artificial bear gall powder can reach the level more than or equal to 1. The method lays a foundation for further engineering and transforming bacillus subtilis to produce artificial bear gall powder.

title_en: Live seedling method for dryopteris fragrans spores
abstract_en: The invention provides a live seedling method of drynaria fortunei spores, belonging to the technical field of propagation of medical pteridophyte spores. The live seeding seedling method of the drynaria fortunei spores comprises the steps of collecting drynaria fortunei spores, sowing the drynaria fortunei spores on the surface of a culture medium, and respectively spraying nutrient solution according to different growth periods until sporophytes grow, wherein the culture medium consists of humus soil, peat soil and limestone according to the volume ratio of 3-5:1-3:1-2, during sowing until sprouting of a protoleaf body, spraying 1/8MS+0.01-0.05 mg/L GA  3  +0.3-0.7mg/L6-BA nutrient solution, and during the period from the protoleaf body to the sporophytes growth, spraying 1/2MS+0.3-0.7mg/LKT+0.3-0.7mg/L6-BA+1.5-2.5 mg/L IBA nutrient solution. The invention can obviously improve the seedling emergence speed and the propagation efficiency of the drynaria fortunei by a specific culture medium and supplementing proper nutrient solution, and has important significance for realizing artificial planting and resource protection of the drynaria fortunei seedling.

title_en: Polypeptide targeting extracellular vesicles and bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypeptide targeting extracellular vesicles and bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The double targeting peptide H2W has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The double targeting peptide can be used for targeting CD63 molecules on the surface of extracellular vesicles through co-incubation under normal temperature conditions, and targeting mesenchymal stem cells simultaneously, so that the extracellular vesicles and the mesenchymal stem cells are firmly anchored together, and the incubation efficiency can reach 80-90%. In addition, the embodiment of the invention also proves that the structure of the H2W modified extracellular vesicles is not changed, and the targeting mesenchymal stem cells are endowed with the capability of targeting the mesenchymal stem cells while the stability is maintained, so that the treatment effect is greatly improved.

title_en: Hybridization capture universal joint sequence blocking reagent for target region targeted sequencing and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of gene sequencing, in particular to a hybridization capture universal joint sequence blocking reagent for target region targeted sequencing and application thereof. The general connector sequence blocking reagent provided by the invention consists of a P5 blocking sequence and a P7 blocking sequence, wherein the middle of the sequence is modified by using a locked nucleotide and hypoxanthine, and the 3' end of the sequence is modified by using an MGB. The invention improves the sequence structure of the sealing reagent, optimizes the types and the number of the modification groups, can be compatible with various joints under an Illumina TruSeq system, is not influenced by the sequence change of the joint label, effectively improves the sealing effect, improves the capturing efficiency, reduces the synthesis cost and reduces the production and experimental cost.

title_en: Microalgae exosome and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microalgae exosome and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of microalgae exosome culture and separation and accord with the industrial standard of the microalgae exosome of GMP standard, and the preparation method of the microalgae exosome mainly comprises the following steps: s1, breeding and culturing; s2, a primary amplification culture stage; s3, a secondary stress amplification culture stage; s4, a separation stage. The enrichment method and the specific separation technology of the specific special culture medium are adopted for the first time to obtain microalgae exosomes with higher concentration than the traditional method; meanwhile, the microalgae exosome preparation method and the separation technology provided by the invention have the whole-course automatic control of culture conditions and the separation technology, can form large-scale industrial production, and have wide industrial application prospects.

title_en: Production equipment and production method of ginseng peptide with oxidation resistance and aging resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses production equipment and a production method of ginseng peptide with oxidation resistance and aging resistance, and relates to the technical field of ginseng peptide production. This production facility with antioxidation and anti-aging's ginseng peptide can realize filling the stock solution bottle that is equipped with enzymatic hydrolysate on the sampling device automatically, later realize injecting enzymatic hydrolysate, cooperation stirring frame makes enzymatic hydrolysate and wait to extract liquid misce bene, sampling device can set up a plurality ofly, thereby can inject same enzymatic hydrolysate simultaneously many times, perhaps inject different enzymatic hydrolysate by many times, after enzymolysis for a period of time, through retrieving the subassembly, the upset subassembly, send the bottle subassembly to bottled empty stock solution on sampling device, can realize automatic sampling through sampling device and sampling pipe fitting, and finally retrieve the subassembly through retrieving, be convenient for carry out sampling detection at the in-process of enzymolysis, the inconvenient extraction liquid that detects in the enzymatic hydrolysate bucket of some enzymatic hydrolysis devices now has been solved, can lead to the enzymolysis condition uncontrollable, the problem of enzymolysis effect is poor.

title_en: Method for establishing chronic-resistance pneumonitis rat model and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a rat model with chronic obstructive pulmonary inflammation, which is used for researching the medical application and pharmacological action of six qi tonifying formulas for treating the chronic obstructive pulmonary inflammation, wherein the Chinese medicines in the six qi tonifying formulas are ginseng, astragalus, fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae, polygonatum, dried orange peel and cinnamon. The method provides basis for the dialectical treatment strategy of the six qi-tonifying formulas through the corresponding regulation of the relevant molecular mechanism of the COPD inflammatory immune network and the relevant molecular mechanism of the lung-intestine microecological axis and the inflammatory immune network. Based on the clinical demand and the early clinical research , the six qi tonifying formulas are discussed from the angles of regulating and controlling the lung immune microenvironment of rats with the syndrome of lung and kidney qi deficiency and the polarization of alveolar macrophages by using various technical methods such as scRNA-seq, CBA, metagenome and the like on the basis of taking the high-incidence condition of the dominant phase of the traditional Chinese medicine of major diseases as an entry point, improving the molecular mechanism of airway immune inflammation, and further researching and verifying the action mechanism action of the six qi tonifying formulas through in vitro experiments.

title_en: Small RNA and small RNA composition of anti-hepatoma bolus for preventing and/or treating hepatoma, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a small RNA and a small RNA composition of a PIANZAIHUANG for preventing and/or treating liver cancer, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The small RNA of the invention is PTH-sRNA-6 with the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and PTH-sRNA-24 with the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The small RNA composition consists of PTH-sRNA-6 and PTH-sRNA-24. The 2 small RNA molecules can be effectively absorbed by ingestion, exist in vivo stably, and can be combined with and inhibit the expression of NDRG3, CUX1, CAT1 and SLC7A1 gene mRNA, thereby exerting the treatment and/or prevention effect on liver cancer. The small RNA composition obtained by combining PTH-sRNA-6 and PTH-sRNA-24 can also effectively inhibit the proliferation of liver cancer cells. The 2 small RNA molecules can be used as markers to control the quality of the Pianzaihuang. The research of the invention discovers that the small RNA in the Pianzaihuang is beneficial to treating liver cancer, which has important significance for further research and development and quality control of the Pianzaihuang.

title_en: Bacillus brevis FHY-12 with dichloroethylene degradation capability and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil bacillus brevis (Brevibacillus agri) FHY-12 with dichloroethylene degradation capability and application thereof, wherein the soil bacillus brevis (Brevibacillus agri) FHY-12 is preserved in China center for type culture collection, and addresses: chinese, university of armed chinese, postal code: 430072, deposit number: cctccc NO: m2023419, storage date 2023, month 03 and 28. The discovery of the strain is of great significance to the efficient purification of chlorinated organic pollutants such as DCE and the like in industrial wastewater and waste gas.

title_en: Real-time visible light colorimetric PCR (polymerase chain reaction) visual quantitative detection method for adulterated meat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time visible light colorimetric PCR (polymerase chain reaction) visual quantitative detection method for adulterated meat. The method comprises the following steps: extracting DNA in meat products and carrying out PCR amplification; extracting target double-stranded DNA products amplified by PCR by using magnetic beads with the surfaces modified with second connectors; resuspending the magnetic beads with the target double-stranded DNA bound on the surface in a hybridization buffer solution, and carrying out melting treatment on the target double-stranded DNA to obtain a sample solution; sequentially adding a specific detection probe and a colorimetric probe into the sample liquid to carry out hybridization to obtain a detection liquid; and adding 4-nitrophenol and sodium borohydride into the detection liquid to form a reaction system, and detecting the adulterated meat in the meat product by observing the color change of the reaction system or detecting the ultraviolet-visible absorption value change of the reaction system at 380-430 nm. The detection method provided by the invention has higher sensitivity and selectivity, and provides a new detection means for biological analysis and medical detection.

title_en: Anti-GPRC 5D antibody, multispecific antibody thereof and related application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-GPRC 5D antibody, a multispecific antibody and related applications thereof, and relates to the field of biological medicine. The anti-GPRC 5D antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof provided by the invention comprises CDRs shown in SEQ ID NO 1-3, 5-6 and SAS or CDRs shown in SEQ ID NO 9-11, 13, 14 and GTS, has better reactivity and killing activity on multiple myeloma cell lines, has better anti-tumor effect on the multi-specific antibody constructed by the antibody, and can be applied to preparing related products for preventing, diagnosing or treating tumors.

title_en: Biochip container
abstract_en: A biochip container (100) is provided, adapted to house a biochip during acquisition of spatially localized structural information from biological tissue. The biochip container includes a substantially plate-shaped container body (110) having a front surface (101) formed with one or more chip grooves (120), each chip groove having a bottom surface (121) defined thereon a chip placement area (1211) for placing one biochip, and each chip groove defining a space adapted to accommodate therein at least a target product captured from biological tissue by the biochip placed on the chip placement area.

title_en: L-high proline production strain and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an L-homoproline production strain, a construction method and application thereof, wherein the production strain is a starting strain by utilizing a metabolic engineering means E.coli Further modified based on W3110 to E.coli E.coli W3110 is chassis, L-lysine is converted into alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde by introducing exogenous L-lysine 6-aminotransferase, and then the semialdehyde is spontaneously reacted to produce D-1-piperidine-6-carboxylic acid, which is delta  1  Reduction of pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase to L-homoproline, production of L-homoproline by fermentation, and use of glucoseAs a substrate, the L-homoproline is directly synthesized from glucose in a fermentation tank, has the advantages of low production cost, no toxic metabolic byproducts, stable heredity, high conversion rate, short fermentation period and the like, can realize the yield of the fermentation 50-h L-homoproline of up to 40.5 g/L, and has very good industrial application value.

title_en: Paenibacillus strain producing small amounts of exopolysaccharides
abstract_en: A Paenibacillus strain is disclosed comprising a reduced activity of a flippase PepR, a flippase PepH, a mannose-1-phosphate guanyl transferase and/or a levansucrase SacB. These Paenibacillus strains exhibit lower viscosity when grown in liquid culture, and agricultural compositions comprising these strains and methods of making and using these strains are also disclosed.

title_en: Method for preparing trehalose from starch
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing trehalose from starch, belonging to the technical field of trehalose; the method comprises the steps of preparing starch milk, liquefying, preparing a carrier, carrying out enzymolysis, filtering, decolorizing, carrying out ion exchange, crystallizing, and centrifuging and drying; the carrier preparation step comprises the steps of preparing mixed sulfuric acid liquid, reacting, post-treating and modifying; the step of preparing the mixed sulfuric acid liquid comprises the steps of mixing cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide, carboxymethyl cellulose and sodium dodecyl sulfate, performing ultrasonic treatment, controlling the ultrasonic time to be 10-14min, controlling the ultrasonic frequency to be 10-12kHz, adding the mixture into the sulfuric acid solution after ultrasonic treatment is finished, and stirring uniformly to obtain the mixed sulfuric acid liquid. The trehalose prepared by the invention has high purity and good yield, and the composite enzyme after the modified silicon dioxide is recycled has good reusability, so that the enzyme dosage is reduced, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Vaccine for preventing African swine fever comprising antigen protein derived from African swine fever virus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a recombinant vector comprising a nucleotide sequence of african swine fever virus antigen protein Lectin (Lectin), CD2v, p72, p54, p30, p15, p35, E199L and/or F317L, a transgenic organism transformed with the above recombinant vector, a vaccine composition for preventing african swine fever comprising african swine fever virus Lectin isolated from the above transgenic organism, CD2v, p72, p54, p30, p15, p35, E199L and/or F317L antigen protein as an active ingredient, and the like.

title_en: Land cotton leaf regulating gene GHCLG and its application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terrestrial cotton leaf regulating gene GHCLG and application thereof. The nucleotide sequence of the gene in the normal broadleaf variety TM-1 of upland cotton is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the gene in the upland cotton leaf mutant T582 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The cloned gene of the invention has direct connection with the shape of cotton leaves. The constructed plant gene editing vector carries out transgenic research on normal broadleaf upland cotton 668, and results show that the knocking-out GHCLG gene leads to the upturned inner coil of the cotton leaf shape, so that the plant gene editing vector has great application potential in the aspects of improving plant leaf shape and plant morphology, improving plant photosynthetic efficiency, resisting insect pest and the like.

title_en: Method for extracting plasmid DNA on large scale
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting plasmid DNA on a large scale, which comprises the following steps: 1) Adding a buffer solution A into the fermented escherichia coli bacterial solution containing plasmid DNA to obtain a cracked escherichia coli bacterial solution, wherein the buffer solution A comprises a Tris solution, an EDTA-2Na.2H  2  O solution, a NaOH solution and an SDS solution; 2) Mixing the cracked escherichia coli bacterial liquid with a buffer solution B for reaction to obtain a reaction liquid, wherein the buffer solution B comprises a Kac solution, a NH  4  Ac solution, a MgSO  4  solution and a CaCl  2  solution; 3) Filtering the reaction solution to obtain plasmid DNA solution. The method simplifies the steps of extracting plasmids according to the conventional method, can achieve the same effect as the conventional method, reduces the process time before purifying the downstream plasmid DNA, saves the cost, and can be used for extracting the plasmid DNA rapidly on a large scale.

title_en: Acid response nano material for promoting angiogenesis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid response nano material for promoting angiogenesis and a preparation method thereof. Comprising the following steps: polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer PLGA nanoparticles, MSC conditioned medium and acid response factor CG-CO  2  of transfection HIF-1 alpha loaded in the PLGA nanoparticles, and erythrocyte membranes and platelet membranes coated on the surfaces of the PLGA nanoparticles. The nano-drug delivery system based on the HIF-1 alpha for regulating and controlling the MSC to secrete the angiogenesis promoting active factors can realize the bomb effect of acid response to quickly release the drugs after entering the focus part, so that the MSC highly expresses the angiogenesis promoting active factors and enhances the targeting ability to the ischemia part.

title_en: Manipulation system and manipulation method
abstract_en: The control system (10) is provided with: a manipulator (16) for manipulating a sample (40); a manipulator drive mechanism (26) that moves the manipulator (16); an imaging device (24) that images the sample (40) through the objective lens (20); a control device (30) that generates force information indicating the magnitude of a force sense presented to a user based on an image captured by the imaging device (24); and force sense presenting means (36, 80) configured to receive an input operation from a user for specifying the position of the manipulator (16) and present a force sense corresponding to the force information generated by the control means (30) to the user.

title_en: African swine fever virus monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybridoma cell, and the microorganism preservation number of the hybridoma cell is CCTCC NO: C202402. The invention also discloses a monoclonal antibody secreted by the hybridoma cells. The invention also discloses a blocking ELISA method and a kit based on the horseradish peroxidase labeled monoclonal antibody and African swine fever virus p72 protein. The ELISA method can effectively detect the African swine fever antibody, has good sensibility and specificity, and has clinical application value.

title_en: Annular RNA marker for diagnosis and treatment of gastric cancer, and composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circular RNA marker for diagnosing and treating gastric cancer, a composition and application thereof, wherein the marker is hsa_circ_0085540, and a nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The research of the invention shows that the efficacy of the plasma hsa_circ_0085540 as a gastric cancer diagnosis index is obviously better than that of the traditional serum tumor markers AFP, CEA and CA19-9; up-regulation of hsa_circ_0085540 expression level can obviously inhibit proliferation, migration and invasion capacity of gastric cancer cells; the up-regulation of the expression level of hsa_circ_0085540 can obviously inhibit the growth of subcutaneous tumor of a gastric cancer cell nude mouse, which indicates that hsa_circ_0085540 can be used as a gastric cancer molecular therapeutic target for preparing and screening gastric cancer therapeutic drugs.

title_en: Method for in vitro culture of tumor organoids
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for in vitro culturing tumor organoids, in particular to a method for in vitro culturing tumor organoids, which comprises the following steps: (a) Culturing a tumor tissue in the presence of a tumor organoid medium, thereby obtaining a tumor organoid; wherein the tumor organoid medium comprises intestinal cancer organoid medium, glioma organoid medium, ovarian cancer organoid medium, liver cancer organoid medium and skin cancer organoid medium. The invention discovers for the first time that the tumor organoids of the invention can effectively screen anti-tumor drugs.

title_en: Method for creating new germplasm of pineapple with long storage life
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for creating a new germplasm of a storage-resistant pineapple, belonging to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. The exogenous genes Pam1 and Pam2 are successfully transformed into pineapple to obtain new germplasm of the pineapple with long storage life. The detection shows that the recombinant expression vectors constructed by the exogenous genes Pam1 and Pam2 and the SK-gRNA vector respectively obtain different degrees of expression in different pineapple varieties, the hardness of pineapple fruits is increased, and new pineapple germplasm with the target characters is successfully obtained, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the recombinant expression vector is shown as SEQ ID NO.1 or SEQ ID NO. 2. The pineapple gene transformation method established by the invention can be used for pineapple gene function research and pineapple transgenic new variety cultivation.

title_en: Polypeptide with tyrosinase inhibitory activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide with tyrosinase inhibitory activity and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide is shown in SEQ ID NO: 1. The polypeptide has strong capability of inhibiting tyrosinase activity, has the advantages of good hydrophilicity, long half-life period, capability of being absorbed through intestinal tracts and the like, can be used for developing products with tyrosinase inhibition activity, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Pseudomonas K1 with phosphate and potassium dissolving function and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to pseudomonas K1 and application thereof, in particular to pseudomonas K1 with a phosphate and potassium dissolving function and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of agricultural microorganisms. The preservation number of the pseudomonas K1 is CGMCC No.29753, and the pseudomonas K1 is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center (China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms) at 1 month 24 of 2024. The strain obtained by the invention can obviously increase the contents of quick-acting phosphorus and quick-acting potassium in saline-alkali soil; the invention also provides a liquid culture medium suitable for the fermentation of the pseudomonas K1, and the pseudomonas K1 can be rapidly obtained in large quantity by using the culture medium, so that the strain provides excellent strain resources for the soil restoration of saline-alkali farmland, and the strain and bacterial liquid thereof have higher agricultural application prospect and economic value.

title_en: Application of TaSPL6 gene in negative regulation of wheat yield and nitrogen utilization efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a TaSPL6 gene in negative regulation of wheat yield and nitrogen utilization efficiency. The gene encodes SQUAMOSA promoter binding protein-like (SPL) transcription factor protein. According to the invention, the TaSPL6 RNAi transgenic plant is obtained by constructing the RNAi vector, and the result shows that the TaSPL6 RNAi transgenic plant can increase the effective tillering number of a single plant under normal conditions and low-nitrogen conditions, and the yield is increased. Therefore, the TaSPL6 gene has potential application value in improving the wheat yield and the nitrogen fertilizer utilization efficiency, and can be used for carrying out genetic improvement on crops by silencing the gene, so that the breeding target of high-yield and high-efficiency synergistic improvement of the crops is hopeful to be realized.

title_en: Bovine promyelocytic leukemia protein monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to detection of bovine promyelocytic leukemia protein and bovine promyelocytic leukemia protein nucleosome, in particular to a bovine promyelocytic leukemia protein monoclonal antibody and application thereof. The invention provides an anti-bovine PML monoclonal antibody which is secreted by hybridoma cells with a preservation number of CGMCC No. 45711. The monoclonal antibody has high affinity and strong specificity to bovine PML protein, can be used for detecting bovine PML and PML NBs in cells, and lays a foundation for revealing the biological functions of bovine PML and PML NBs.

title_en: Metagen combined preparation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metazoan combined preparation and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the metazoan combined preparation comprises lactobacillus plantarum HF05, lactobacillus mucilaginosus HF06, lactobacillus mucilaginosus HF07 and lactococcus lactis HF08, wherein the preservation number of the lactobacillus plantarum HF05 is CGMCC NO.25483, the preservation date is 2022 years 8 months 03 days, the preservation number of the lactobacillus mucilaginosus HF06 is CGMCC NO.25484, the preservation date is 2022 years 8 months 03 days, and the preservation number of the lactobacillus mucilaginosus HF07 is CCTCC NO: m20231044, the preservation date is 2023, 6 and 19 days, and the preservation label of the lactococcus lactis HF08 is CCTCC NO: m20231045, the preservation date is 2023, 6 and 19. The metagen combination preparation provided by the invention has the effect of improving chronic colitis.

title_en: Solvate of nitrogen-containing compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solvate of a nitrogen-containing compound and a preparation method thereof. The invention discloses a solvate of a nitrogen-containing compound shown in a formula 1. The solvate has better stability. The preparation method reduces the possibility of potential condensation side reaction, increases the yield, obtains the product with high purity and crystallinity, simplifies the reaction operation, and is more suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Recombinant protein of microsporidian polar tube protein EbPTP and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering and immunodetection, and particularly relates to a recombinant protein of microsporidian polar tube protein EbPTP and a preparation method and application thereof. The research of the application discovers that the polar tube protein shows stronger immunogenicity under both experimental conditions and natural infection conditions, which provides a potential target for establishing accurate diagnosis and effectively preventing and treating microsporidian diseases. The recombinant protein can be used as an antigen for detecting microsporidian, has better antigenicity, and can accurately capture specific antibodies in serum, thereby achieving the purpose of accurately detecting microsporidian infection. Meanwhile, the recombinant protein is obtained by expressing an optimized gene sequence through an in-vitro expression system, and the recombinant protein has higher protein yield after sequence optimization, has simple operation steps and low cost, and provides technical support for developing microsporidian diagnostic reagents and vaccines.

title_en: SIRP alpha fusion protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a SIRPalpha fusion protein, polynucleotide and application, wherein the fusion protein comprises 1) human SIRPalpha protein, 2) an antibody constant region and 3) human complement protein or a cleavage fragment thereof. The fusion protein provided by the invention has a therapeutic effect on diseases caused by at least one of CD47  +  cells, R2  +  cells and R3  +  cells.

title_en: Acinetobacter lupulus and application thereof in degradation of black tea aflatoxin
abstract_en: The invention relates to acinetobacter lupulus and application thereof in degradation of black tea aflatoxin, belonging to the technical field of microbial degradation; the Acinetobacter rouxii is preserved in China center for type culture Collection (China) in 2024, 01 and 04, and the preservation number is as follows: CCTCC NO: M2024018, the preservation address is: chinese Wuhan is classified and named as: acinetobacter reuteri Acinetobacter lwoffii; the 16SrDNA sequence of the acinetobacter rouxii is shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The Acinetobacter rouxii SGLH-83 obtained through separation and purification can effectively inhibit the growth of aspergillus flavus, can directly degrade the aflatoxin of the black tea, and effectively solves the problem of pollution of the aflatoxin in the storage process of the black tea.

title_en: Modification of brassinolide receptor genes to improve yield traits
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for modifying brassinosteroid insensitivity-1 (BRI 1) genes in plants, which compositions and methods optionally improve yield traits. The invention also relates to plants having increased improved yield traits produced using the methods and compositions of the invention.

title_en: Integrated process for producing polyhydroxyalkanoates and bioethanol from lignocellulosic hydrolysates
abstract_en: An integrated process for producing Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) and bioethanol from a lignocellulosic hydrolysate, the process comprising the steps of: (a) Feeding at least a portion of the lignocellulosic hydrolysate to a first fermentation unit in the presence of at least one microorganism capable of utilizing sugars having six carbon atoms (C6) and an organic acid to obtain a first fermentation broth; (b) Separating the first fermentation broth obtained in said step (a) obtaining an aqueous suspension of cellular biomass comprising at least one Polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) and an aqueous phase comprising sugars (C5) having 5 carbon atoms, said sugars being in an amount greater than or equal to 10g/L, preferably between 12g/L and 100 g/L; (c) Optionally feeding at least part of the aqueous phase obtained in said step (b) to a second fermentation device in the presence of at least one microorganism capable of utilizing a sugar having five carbon atoms (C5) and a sugar having six carbon atoms (C6), obtaining a second fermentation broth (inoculum); (d) Feeding at least part of the aqueous phase obtained in said step (b) and optionally at least part of the second fermentation broth (inoculum) and/or the lignocellulosic hydrolysate obtained in said step (C) to a third fermentation device in the presence of at least one microorganism capable of utilizing a sugar having five carbon atoms (C5) and a sugar having six carbon atoms (C6), obtaining a third fermentation broth; (e) Separating the third fermentation broth to obtain bioethanol. The Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) described above can be advantageously used in a variety of applications, particularly in the medical, pharmacological, agricultural, engineering and food fields. The bioethanol described above can advantageously be used as such, or mixed with fossil fuels for automotive use, or suitably purified in the production of biochemicals (e.g. disinfectants).

title_en: Recombinant turkey herpesvirus rHVT-HA-VP2-gDgI and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a recombinant turkey herpesvirus rHVT-HA-VP2-gDgI, which comprises an H9 subtype avian influenza virus HA gene expression cassette, a chicken infectious bursal disease virus VP2 protein expression cassette and infectious laryngotracheitis virus gD and gI protein expression cassettes. The vaccine prepared by the recombinant virus rHVT-HA-VP2-gDgI can provide multiple protection against IBDV virulent infection, H9N2 subtype avian influenza virus infection and chicken infectious laryngotracheitis virus infection, overcomes the defect that the existing coexpression vaccine cannot prevent three diseases in one vaccine, and HAs good market application prospect.

title_en: Peony PoWOX gene and application of coded protein thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a peony PoWOX gene and a coded protein thereof, belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, and discloses application of a peony PoWOX gene in promoting plant growth, plant root growth and development and plant early bolting and flowering, wherein the gene comprises a nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO:1, and a nucleotide sequence shown in the specification. The invention discovers PoWOX that the gene is over-expressed, promotes the growth of transgenic arabidopsis, advances the flowering of bolting, improves the generation of lateral roots and callus root differentiation of arabidopsis transgenic plants, participates in the growth of main roots and lateral roots of arabidopsis, and the like, and shows that the PoWOX gene can regulate the growth, root development, flowering of bolting and regeneration of in-vitro tissues of transgenic plants, thereby providing a certain theoretical basis for the establishment of complete plant regeneration and genetic transformation systems of peony.

title_en: Construction method and application of DNA library
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and application of a DNA library. The construction method of the DNA library comprises the following steps: a) Connecting a first connector and a second connector at two ends of sample DNA to obtain connector-connected DNA; b) Taking a primer which can be complementarily paired with the first adaptor as a single primer, and carrying out unidirectional PCR amplification on the adaptor-ligated DNA to obtain a unidirectional PCR amplified library; c) Capturing the unidirectional PCR amplified library by using a capture probe capable of complementarily pairing with the second adaptor to obtain a capture library-probe complex; d) The capture probes in the capture library-probe complexes are removed to obtain a DNA library. Can solve the problem of incomplete fragments in the DNA library in the prior art, and is suitable for the field of DNA library construction.

title_en: SNP (Single nucleotide polymorphism) marker primer pair related to pig rib number character and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a SNP (single nucleotide polymorphism) marker primer pair related to pig rib number traits and application thereof. The locus of the SNP marker is a molecular marker of the rs332644388 nucleotide locus of the chromosome 6 of the 11.1 version reference sequence pig genome of the international pig, and has A/G polymorphism. A primer pair for detecting the SNP marker, wherein the upstream primer is: SEQ ID NO:2, the downstream primer is: SEQ ID NO:3. the SNP marker provided by the invention can be applied to marker-assisted selection of pig rib number traits, and a pig population or a new strain with multiple rib numbers can be screened by identifying the genotype of the SNP marker. The establishment of the group or the new strain can improve the rib number and meat production performance of pigs and generate more social and economic benefits.

title_en: Wheat hydrolyzed protein and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides wheat hydrolyzed protein and a preparation method thereof. The first aspect of the present invention provides a wheat protein hydrolysate comprising at least a peptide stretch LQ, IM, LL, LM, VQ, II, AI, VL; based on the mass of the wheat protein hydrolysate, the content of the peptide LQ is more than or equal to 300 mug/g, the content of the peptide IM is more than or equal to 120 mug/g, the content of the peptide LL is more than or equal to 110 mug/g, the content of the peptide LM is more than or equal to 120 mug/g, the content of the peptide VQ is more than or equal to 30 mug/g, the content of the peptide II is more than or equal to 25 mug/g, the content of the peptide AI is more than or equal to 7 mug/g, and the content of the peptide VL is more than or equal to 5 mug/g. The wheat hydrolyzed protein provided by the invention contains various functional peptide fragments, and provides a basis for providing wheat hydrolyzed protein products with more abundant physiological functions.

title_en: Anti-PD 1 antibodies and combination with sensitizers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly provides an anti-PD 1 antibody and a pharmaceutical composition thereof, which are used for treating cancers. The invention also provides the use of an anti-PD 1 antibody in combination with a sensitizer for the treatment of cancer.

title_en: Lactobacillus gasseri JM6 and application thereof in vaginitis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly relates to lactobacillus gasseri JM6 and application thereof in vaginitis. The invention provides lactobacillus gasseri JM6 (Lactobacillus gasseri), wherein the preservation number of the lactobacillus gasseri JM6 is GDMCC No.64112. The lactobacillus gasseri JM6 can regulate secretion of serum inflammatory factors of mice, activity of vaginal tissue MPO and expression of vaginal tissue inflammatory genes, so that inflammation of mice with colpitis is relieved. Therefore, the composition has great significance in clinically preventing and/or treating colpitis.

title_en: Primer pair, system, kit and application for detecting hybrid snakehead rhabdovirus based on RAA-CRISPR/Cas12a
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a primer pair, a system, a kit and application for detecting hybrid snakehead rhabdovirus based on RAA-CRISPR/Cas12 a. The primer pair comprises any one of a primer pair 1, a primer pair 2, a primer pair 3 and a primer pair 4. The invention uses HSHRV glycoprotein sequences and prime 5.0 software to design 4 pairs of specific upstream and downstream PRIMERs, and successfully amplifies nucleic acid. And then manually designing a specific crRNA probe according to design selection, and using a positive sample as a template to screen the primer and the probe respectively, so as to successfully construct a detection method with good specificity, sensitivity and accuracy. A positive sample of 10 copies/. Mu.L can be detected, and only a fluorescent signal exists on a positive template, and other common viruses of common aquatic animals are not amplified. In clinical sample detection experiments, the method has better accuracy.

title_en: Spirulina phycocyanin polypeptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spirulina phycocyanin polypeptide, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of active polypeptides. The invention screens and obtains the active peptide with the antioxidant and whitening effects of a specific sequence from the spirulina phycocyanin enzymolysis product, wherein the active peptide is the polypeptide with the amino acid sequence of FMR and FPPWE. The two polypeptides have the characteristics of stable structure, high safety, no toxic or side effect, good water solubility and the like, and in vitro experiments prove that the polypeptide has good antioxidant activity and higher tyrosinase inhibitory activity, and can solve the technical problems that kojic acid, alpha-arbutin and the like can effectively inhibit tyrosinase but possibly have toxic or side effect in the prior art.

title_en: Preparation method of konjak vinegar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of konjak vinegar, which comprises the steps of carrying out enzymolysis and saccharification on purified konjak flour by utilizing glucanase, then carrying out alcohol fermentation and acetic fermentation sequentially, adding purified konjak flour before acetic fermentation to carry out deepening fermentation, and finally regulating the flavor by utilizing high fructose syrup to obtain the konjak vinegar. The process disclosed by the invention has higher production efficiency, the prepared product trimethylamine acetate has low content and high safety, and compared with the traditional fruit vinegar, the konjak vinegar prepared by the invention has slightly thick taste, contains more functional components such as mannooligosaccharide and the like, has higher acceptance, can play a certain role in preventing diseases, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Air microorganism detection system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of microorganism detection, and provides an air microorganism detection system and method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the sample capturing and cracking unit comprises a sampling bottle and a vacuum pump, wherein the vacuum pump collects an air microorganism sample from the air to the sampling bottle in a negative pressure pumping mode; the microfluidic chip comprises a microfluidic chip extraction reaction unit which is communicated with the sampling bottle; the clamping detection module corresponds to the position of the microfluidic chip; the clamping detection module comprises a clamping assembly and a detection assembly, the clamping assembly comprises a first pressing plate and a second pressing plate, and the microfluidic chip is clamped between the first pressing plate and the second pressing plate. The method and the device are used for solving the defects of complicated operation, long time consumption and high technical requirement when air microorganism detection is carried out in the prior art, the links required by air microorganism sampling can be integrated into one detection system, the collection, the nucleic acid extraction and the detection of air microorganism samples are automatically carried out, and the operation process is simple and convenient.

title_en: Novel Cas13a/cr: mi: crRNA gene knockdown tool, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biotechnology, and discloses a novel Cas13a/cr: mi crRNA gene knockdown tool, a construction method and application thereof, wherein two regular clustered interval short palindromic repeat sequences RNAa (CRISPR-DERIVED RNA, CRRNAA) for guiding Cas13a nuclease (Cas 13 a) to a target gene and a regular clustered interval short palindromic repeat sequence RNAa (CRISPR-DERIVED RNA, CRRNAB) sequence are respectively connected to left and right flanks of primary miRNA (PRIMARY MIRNA, pri-miRNA) to form triple recognition target gene cr: mi crRNA guide RNA, and Cas13a/cr: mi crRNA is constructed. After the cow and mouse muscle cells are transfected with Cas13a/cr: mi: crRNA, the Drosha endonuclease is used for cutting and separating the cr: mi: crRNA, so that crRNAa, crRNAb and precursor miRNA (pre-miRNA) which are separated from each other are generated, triple recognition and cutting are carried out on the targeted messenger RNA (MESSENGER RNA, MRNA), RNAi efficiency is obviously improved, and an efficient gene interference system is provided for biological breeding.

title_en: Method for preparing vitronectin from recombinant fusion protein
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing vitronectin by recombinant fusion protein, and relates to the field of biological medicine. According to the invention, SDR family oxidoreductase EbCR and KDRLp are fused, G4S linker is adopted for linking, fusion enzyme 2A is designed, then acetone xyloside is used as a substrate, preferably fusion enzyme 2A, and NADPH or NADH is utilized for catalyzing the reduction of the acetone xyloside to generate the vitrein with a specific configuration proportion. The biocatalysis system has high reaction efficiency and high conversion rate, realizes the precise control of the product configuration, greatly simplifies the production process, can realize the one-pot preparation of the glass color factor with the specified configuration proportion, and effectively solves the problems of low reduction selectivity and difficult product purification in the prior synthesis technology.

title_en: Fluorine-containing polypeptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine-containing polypeptide, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The fluorine-containing polypeptide compound with a brand new structure is designed by introducing the fluorine sulfonate group into the structure of dolastatin and analogues thereof, the structure of the fluorine-containing polypeptide compound is shown as a formula (I), and the fluorine-containing polypeptide has proliferation inhibition activity on a549, heLa, PC-3, 22RV1 and other tumor cell lines, has good anti-tumor effect, and has wide application prospect in the aspects of tumor diagnosis and treatment.

title_en: Chip and chip combination
