abstract_en: The application discloses a chip and a chip combination, which belong to the technical field of biology, and comprise a main body, wherein a chip flow channel is arranged in the main body, the main body further comprises at least two plug-in parts, each plug-in part is provided with a first through hole, the first through holes of the at least two plug-in parts are communicated with two ends of the chip flow channel, the chip further comprises at least two liquid path quick-inserts, the number of the liquid path quick-inserts is the same as that of the plug-in parts, each liquid path quick-insert comprises a gland and an elastic sheet, the elastic sheet is arranged between the gland and the plug-in parts, the gland comprises a body and a connector, the body and the plug-in parts are buckled, the connector is fixedly connected with the body and is communicated with the chip flow channel through the first through holes, and the connector can be plugged with a pipeline, so that the chip can be communicated with another chip, and different chip models are formed, and the cultivation of various organs is realized.

title_en: Recombinant yarrowia lipolytica engineering bacterium for efficiently synthesizing zeaxanthin and zeaxanthin synthesis method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly discloses a recombinant yarrowia lipolytica engineering bacterium for efficiently synthesizing zeaxanthin and a zeaxanthin synthesis method.

title_en: ANKRD50 gene as molecular marker of Tibetan sheep immune trait and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular markers, in particular to a molecular marker of ANKRD50 gene as Tibetan sheep immune trait and application thereof. The ANKRD50 gene is used as a molecular marker of Tibetan sheep immune traits, the nucleotide sequence of the molecular marker is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and y at 148 th position of the sequence represents T or C, so that the T/C polymorphism of the Tibetan sheep ANKRD50 gene at the position is caused. The invention can judge the immunoglobulin IgA, igG, igM content of Tibetan sheep individuals by detecting the base of 32776109 nucleotide locus on Tibetan sheep chromosome 17, and provides a new SNP molecular marker resource for the auxiliary selection of Tibetan sheep immune character markers for non-diagnostic purposes.

title_en: Molecular marker for identifying multi-tillering character of millet and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of variety identification, and particularly relates to a molecular marker for identifying the multi-tillering character of millet and application thereof. The invention identifies the nutritional branching character-tillering genetic control site and target gene of millet and develops the closely linked marker thereof by forward genetics means, thereby having important significance for molecular auxiliary selection and cultivation of feeding millet varieties.

title_en: Pretreatment device and pretreatment method
abstract_en: The pretreatment device (2) sucks a liquid component from a culture sample separated into the liquid component and the solid component in a container (14) through a solid-liquid interface, and performs pretreatment. The pretreatment device (2) is provided with: suction pipes (58, 59) for sucking the liquid component; a pump (54) that applies negative pressure to the suction tube; and a control unit (500) that moves the suction tube in the liquid component in the direction of the solid-liquid interface in a state where negative pressure is applied.

title_en: AKKERMANSIA MUCINIPHILA and use of its progeny in improving respiratory diseases
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly relates to AKKERMANSIA MUCINIPHILA and application of its progeny in improving respiratory diseases. AKKERMANSIA MUCINIPHILA is AKK ONE, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.20954. The AKK ONE can effectively relieve cough caused by mycoplasma pneumonia, and can down regulate the content of pro-inflammatory factors IL-6 and IL-8 in mouse serum and up regulate the content of anti-inflammatory factors IL-10, thereby reducing the effect of inflammatory reaction; reducing mRNA expression amount of tissue TRPA1, SP and CGRP, and inhibiting severe cough caused by mycoplasma inflammation infection. The invention provides theoretical basis and experimental basis for researching and developing metaplasia and medicines of mycoplasma pneumonia.

title_en: DNA nano-cage probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DNA nano-cage probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The nanocage probe comprises a DNA framework with an internal cavity, a miRNA response probe consisting of double-stranded RF/RQ, and an a-HP hairpin. The preparation method of the nanocage probe comprises the following steps: annealing and assembling double-chain RF/RQ with a DNA framework, and then incubating with an A-HP hairpin to form the DNA nanocage probe. The invention benefits from the size selectivity of the DNA nano-framework, and smaller mature miRNA but not larger pre-miRNA can enter the cavity of the DNA nano-cage for molecular recognition, so that the signal interference of the pre-miRNA is obviously reduced. Meanwhile, the DNA nanocage probe can enter cells without transfection and accurately detect intracellular miRNA imaging under the drive of endogenous enzyme APE 1.

title_en: Beta amyloid fluorescent probe excitation wavelength prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting excitation wavelength of a beta-amyloid fluorescent probe, and belongs to the field of prediction of excitation wavelength of beta-amyloid fluorescent probes. Optimizing a complex structure formed by the beta amyloid and the probe by using a ONIOM model; based on the optimized compound structure, extracting an atomic number Z  i  ' of an atom i in the fluorescent probe and a three-dimensional coordinate P  i '=(x i ',y i ',z i  ' of the atom, converting data of all the atoms into a row matrix X'=[Z 1 ',P 1 ',Z 2 ',P 2 ',Z 3 ',P 3 '...Z i ',P i '];, inputting X ' into a trained beta amyloid fluorescent probe excitation wavelength prediction model, and outputting the excitation wavelength of the beta amyloid fluorescent probe to be predicted. The accuracy is high, the prediction speed is high, and the problems of complex experimental operation, long period, unstable measurement result, high theoretical calculation cost and long time consumption are solved.

title_en: Escherichia coli phage embedding method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses an embedding method of escherichia coli phage and application thereof, wherein an escherichia coli phage liposome coating liquid is used for preparing a medicament for preventing and/or treating chicken air bag inflammation, and the dosage of the escherichia coli phage liposome coating liquid is 10  7 -10 9  PFU/mL. The coliphage is RDP-EC-22027 and is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.45356 in the year 2022, 10 and 31, and the host bacteria is EC-22027. The phage RDP-EC-22027 is made into liposome, so that the phage RDP-EC-22027 can reach focus more quickly and stay in the body for a longer time, has good controlled release property, and can improve the protection rate and reduce the death rate; the phage liposome obtained through embedding is beneficial to better treating chicken air sac inflammation caused by escherichia coli infection.

title_en: Apolipoprotein fusion proteins for cell-specific immunomodulation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fusion proteins of apolipoproteins with immunomodulatory biomolecules and/or diversion molecules. The fusion proteins can be used as carriers of the immunoregulatory biomolecules themselves or the immunoregulatory biomolecules incorporated into the lipid nanoparticles. The fusion proteins may be used to treat immune related disorders, or to target a payload to a specific target site.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus TM08 and application of lactobacillus rhamnosus TM08 product in relieving allergy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly relates to lactobacillus rhamnosus TM08 and application of a product thereof in relieving allergy. The lactobacillus rhamnosus is TM08, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.28301.TM08 can maintain the basic form of colon and jejunum tissues, and has remarkable alleviation effect on jejunum permeability increase caused by food allergy of young mice induced by beta-lactoglobulin. TM08 can also inhibit the activation of Th2 and Th17 cells after food allergy of mice induced by beta-lactoglobulin, which results in obviously reduced cytokine production, and improves the activation of Th1 and Treg cells, thereby relieving the condition of Th1/Th2 cell immune offset.

title_en: Aldehyde ketone reductase mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aldehyde ketone reductase yhdN mutant, which is used for constructing a recombinant whole cell containing the aldehyde ketone reductase yhdN mutant and Glucose Dehydrogenase (GDH), can be used as a catalyst for efficiently preparing N-ethyl methyl carbamic acid-3- [ (1S) -hydroxyethyl ] -phenyl ester ((S) -NEMCA-HEPE) by catalyzing a substrate N-ethyl-methyl carbamic acid acetophenone (NEMCA), has the advantages of reaction conversion rate and ee reaching 99.9%, simple and quick preparation method, low cost and suitability for industrial application.

title_en: Primer group for identifying parent-child relationship of schizothorax megalobrama and identification method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal molecular biology, and relates to a primer group for identifying parent-child relationship of schizothorax grahami and an identification method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting DNA of an individual to be identified of the schizothorax and DNA of a suspected parent fin sample; 2) Using DNA as a template, and carrying out PCR amplification by using a primer group for identifying parent-child relationship of schizothorax grahami to obtain a PCR amplification product; 3) Performing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis on the PCR amplification product, and performing silver staining on the electrophoresis result; 4) And analyzing the relatedness between the individuals of the giant schizothorax to be identified and the suspected parents by using the Mendelian's genetic law. The invention provides a primer group for identifying parent-child relationship of schizothorax and an identification method, which have strong feasibility and high accuracy and can effectively avoid the phenomenon of near-breeding.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating facial shoulder brachial muscular dystrophy
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are polynucleic acid molecules, pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treating facial shoulder humeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD).

title_en: Base editing system suitable for saturated mutant evolution plant genes and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a base editing system suitable for saturated mutation evolution plant genes and application thereof. The base editing system comprises sgRNA, fusion protein formed by fusing nuclear localization signals, uracil glycosidase, cytosine deaminase, uracil glycosidase, cas9 nicking enzyme and nuclear localization signals in sequence (or fusion protein formed by fusing nuclear localization signals, DNA polymerase, cytosine deaminase, uracil glycosidase, cas9 nicking enzyme and nuclear localization signals in sequence) and screening marker protein. Experiments show that: the base editing system is suitable for saturation mutation of plants, can be used for generating and screening favorable mutation types and creating new germplasm materials.

title_en: Gene coding-based clonable electron microscope marker metallothionein CrMT suitable for Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clonable electron microscope marker metallothionein CrMT which is applicable to Chlamydomonas reinhardtii and based on gene coding. When the Chlamydomonas reinhardtii sample is observed by a freeze electron microscope, a gene-encoded marker may be provided. The invention provides a useful tool for structural analysis by adopting a frozen electron microscope as a Chlamydomonas reinhardtii applicability clonable electron microscope marker.

title_en: Primer composition for identifying Tibet Shanxi giant salamander dried body product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primer composition for identifying Tibet mangrove dried product and application thereof, wherein the composition consists of primers for amplifying Tibet mangrove mitochondrial genes ND4 and COX 1. Based on mitochondrial genome of Tibet mangrove giant salamander, 8 pairs of miniature molecular marker primers are developed. 8 pairs of primers have high sensitivity and strong reliability, can identify the Tibet mountain stream giant salamander dry body preparation with seriously degraded DNA, are applied to the material evidence identification of illegal hunting, buying and selling Tibet mountain stream giant salamander cases, and are beneficial to strengthening the attack on rare wild animal crimes.

title_en: Short peptide derivative and application thereof, short peptide derivative hydrogel and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a short peptide derivative and application thereof, and a short peptide derivative hydrogel and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicines. The invention provides a short peptide derivative, which has a sequence of Z-GFFXaa, wherein Z is a blocking group, xaa is amino acid. The short peptide derivative provided by the invention can activate the V gamma 9V delta 2T cells, can effectively activate the T cells after being simply mixed with the V gamma 9V delta 2T cells, enables the T cells to be activated into anti-cancer, anti-virus and other phenotypes, enhances the killing activity of cancer cells, improves the killing activity of the cancer cells, and can control the release of cell medicines by taking hydrogel formed by the short peptide derivative as a delivery carrier.

title_en: Cobalt-based biological material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cobalt-based biological material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of electrocatalysis. Aiming at the scrapped lithium ion battery, the invention fully utilizes the surface activity of the aspergillus niger soluble extracellular polymer and the characteristic of regulating and controlling the pH value to convert the cathode material of the waste lithium ion battery into a high-value catalyst, simultaneously changes the electronic structure of a catalytic interface, reduces the over-potential of the reaction and improves the stability of the catalyst. The invention provides a new idea for recycling waste lithium ion batteries and generating clean energy.

title_en: Lactobacillus reuteri Glory LR15, and composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactobacillus reuteri Glory LR15, a composition and application thereof, wherein the lactobacillus reuteri is classified and named as lactobacillus reuteri (Limosilactobacillus reuteri) Glory LR15, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.26972. Lactobacillus reuteri (Limosilactobacillus reuteri) Glory LR15 was used to prepare a medicament for alleviating cow's milk-induced allergic reactions. The lactobacillus reuteri of the invention can effectively reduce the specific IgE level in serum of people suffering from anaphylactic reaction induced by cow milk, regulate and control the gene expression of Th1 and Th2 cell factors in organisms, thereby regulating the immune function of the organisms and preventing or treating cow milk-induced anaphylactic reaction.

title_en: Rapid detection method for rape black shank based on RPA-Cas12a
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular biology detection, and particularly relates to a rapid detection method for rape black shank based on RPA-Cas12a, which comprises the following steps: extracting genome DNA of a sample to be detected; performing RPA amplification reaction of the target gene by utilizing the upstream primer and the downstream primer of the RPA to obtain an RPA amplification product; and (3) establishing an RPA-Cas12a detection system by utilizing an RPA amplification product, cas12a protein, crRNA and a nucleic acid probe, reacting to obtain an RPA-Cas12a reaction product, and identifying by a fluorescence detection method or a test strip detection method. The detection method provided by the invention has the characteristics of strong stability, high sensitivity, suitability for on-site rapid detection and the like, can well distinguish the near-edge species or subspecies of the black shank germ of the rape, and avoids the generation of false positive. Meanwhile, a monitoring technology of rape black shank based on non-toxic genes is provided, so that the planting of resistant varieties is facilitated, and the invasion of pathogenic bacteria to large-area harm is delayed.

title_en: Dopaminergic neurons comprising mutations and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons comprising disease-related mutations. Further provided herein are methods of using iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons to study neuroinflammation, such as to identify new targets, biomarkers, and therapeutic agents for diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. Further provided herein are assays for studying neuroinflammation using the cell culture models of the present disclosure.

title_en: Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) knockout
abstract_en: An RNA molecule comprising a guide sequence portion having 17-50 consecutive nucleotides comprising the sequence of SEQ ID NO:1-18936, and compositions, methods and uses thereof.

title_en: Application of stem cells in medicaments for treating vascular injury
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses an application of stem cells in a medicament for treating vascular injury, wherein the stem cells are adipose-derived stem cells, a culture medium containing SCF, niacinamide and VEGF is used for culturing the adipose-derived stem cells, and the concentration of the SCF, the niacinamide and the VEGF in the culture medium is 0.1-1ng/mL, 10-20 mmol/L and 20-100ng/mL in sequence. The adipose-derived stem cells prepared by the culture medium used in the invention have stronger survival, migration and differentiation capacities, the expression quantity of miR-146b-3p is obviously improved, aging is less easy, and the adipose-derived stem cells have stronger adipogenic differentiation capacity.

title_en: Composite petroleum ether organochlorine polluted soil eluent and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound petroleum ether and organic chlorine polluted soil eluent and a production process thereof, belonging to the technical field of eluent preparation, wherein the eluent comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 10-15% of soybean oil, 5-10% of triton X100, 7-9% of hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin, 3-5% of carboxymethyl beta cyclodextrin, 10-13% of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, 1-3% of nano zero-valent iron, 1-3% of nano Pd and the balance of petroleum ether.

title_en: A conveyer for pathogenic microorganism transports cultivates
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and discloses a transporter for transporting and culturing pathogenic microorganisms, which comprises a transport tube and preservation solution; wherein the preservation solution is divided into solution A and solution B; the A liquid comprises brain heart infusion broth, niacin, glycerol and glucose; the liquid B comprises beef extract powder, gelatin, soluble starch, charcoal, niacin, sodium chloride, sheep blood and agar. According to the pathogenic microorganism transferring, culturing and transporting device, by adopting specific preservation solution components and a transporting pipe structure design, the pathogenic microorganism is efficiently transported, and the accuracy and the success rate of culturing are improved; after the sample is collected, the transporter disclosed by the invention can be used for transportation at the temperature of 2-8 ℃ and preservation within 48 hours, and meanwhile, the transporter can be directly frozen at the temperature of-80 ℃ to be matched with the subsequent laboratory detection flow.

title_en: Application of mycovirus PaFV1 in prevention and control of plant diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a mycovirus PaFV in prevention and control of plant diseases, wherein the virus is a new virus separated from phomopsis betel, named Phomopsis asparagi fusarivirus (PaFV 1), the nucleotide sequence of the mycovirus is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the mycovirus has the effect of inhibiting plant pathogenic bacteria pathogenicity. According to the invention, by adopting a PEG-mediated protoplast transformation mode, paFV1 is transduced into host fungi phomopsis and non-host fungi fusarium oxysporum, and PaFV1 is proved to be capable of obviously causing the pathogenicity of the host fungi and the non-host fungi to be reduced, so that the mycovirus PaFV1 has good biocontrol potential, and can be used for biological control of diseases such as phomopsis betel and banana vascular wilt.

title_en: Sequence group based on specific HRCA isothermal amplification mycobacterium tuberculosis and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sequence group for isothermal amplification of mycobacterium tuberculosis based on specific HRCA and application thereof. The sequence group disclosed by the invention comprises Lock and Key series primers in an identification stage, and Loop and LINK PRIMER in an amplification stage, and the HRCA reaction is carried out by using the primer group, so that the detection is quick and sensitive, and the result is reliable and stable. The detection method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a lock key structure with an identification function; (2) magnetic separation and identification are carried out; (3) performing HRCA amplification; (4) identifying the fluorescent signal, and judging positive/negative. The method utilizes a lock key structure to design a plurality of conserved fragments of the mycobacterium tuberculosis insertion sequence IS6110 as target genes to trigger the HRCA reaction together, thereby improving the accuracy of the method.

title_en: Application of decidua mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles in pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of application of extracellular vesicles, and particularly relates to application of extracellular vesicles derived from decidua mesenchymal stem cells in pulmonary fibrosis. According to the invention, the decidua mesenchymal stem cells I are transfected by pEGFP-N2-GFE2-Lamp2b plasmid, the decidua mesenchymal stem cells II with a targeting positioning effect are obtained, and after being cultured by a dispersion polymer and a supplement culture medium, the extracellular vesicles from the decidua mesenchymal stem cells with higher purity and stable performance and also with the targeting positioning effect are obtained by adopting a mode of centrifugally combining with sucrose density gradient purification, and can be used in pulmonary fibrosis to realize the application effects of accurately taking effect in small dose and relieving the course of pulmonary fibrosis.

title_en: Preparation method, intermediate and application of cyclopeptide toxin alpha-Amanitin and/or AMANINAMIDE
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method, an intermediate and application of cyclopeptide toxin alpha-Amanitin and/or AMANINAMIDE, and belongs to the field of organic synthesis. The invention provides a total synthesis method of cyclopeptide toxin compounds alpha-Amanitin and AMANINAMIDE, raw materials and reagents used are easy to purchase through commercial paths, intermediates are stable, reaction conditions are mild, an operation process is simple and convenient, a separation and purification process has good operability, yield is high, important reference and practical values are provided, gram-scale preparation of alpha-Amanitin and AMANINAMIDE can be realized, good industrialization prospects are provided, and the preparation method has remarkable application value in the field of cyclopeptide toxin synthesis.

title_en: NtMYB13 protein for regulating and controlling color and aroma of plant flowers, and coding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant breeding, in particular to NtMYB protein for regulating and controlling the color and aroma of flowers of plants, and a coding gene and application thereof. The NtMYB protein comprises an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the coding gene of the NtMYB protein comprises a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The NtMYB protein provided by the invention can negatively regulate the color and aroma components of the plant flowers, and the plant flowers can turn yellow when the NtMYB protein is overexpressed in the plants, so that the aroma components are reduced. The NtMYB protein and the application thereof provided by the invention can be used for enriching the color of flowers, changing the fragrance flux and cultivating new plant varieties.

title_en: Gene haplotype of high-yield lysine of flammulina velutipes and molecular marker identification method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gene haplotype of flammulina velutipes high-yield lysine, a molecular marker identification method and application, and the invention deeply digs the relationship between the haplotype type and the lysine content of 8 key enzyme genes in a lysine synthesis path, finally determines the gene haplotype type of FvSDH of flammulina velutipes high-yield lysine, develops a related detection method, and further can screen flammulina velutipes strains with high-yield lysine in a laboratory on the premise of detecting without cultivating the flammulina velutipes.

title_en: Detection method for simultaneously and rapidly detecting 16 respiratory pathogens
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a detection method for simultaneously and rapidly detecting 16 respiratory pathogens. Specifically comprises forward primers, reverse primers and specific fluorescent probes for detecting influenza A virus, influenza B virus, novel coronavirus (ORF 1ab gene and N gene), haemophilus influenzae, human parainfluenza virus general purpose type, respiratory syncytial virus, human metapneumovirus, enterovirus, mycoplasma pneumoniae, group A streptococcus, pertussis bauter bacteria, common coronavirus, rhinovirus, bocavirus, adenovirus and streptococcus pneumoniae. The invention can simultaneously and rapidly detect whether respiratory pathogens exist in a sample through PCR reaction, and simultaneously carry out parting identification of 16 respiratory pathogens, and is more convenient and rapid and has lower cost than a single fluorescent quantitative PCR method.

title_en: MiRNA as biomarker for Parkinson's disease and diagnostic kit using miRNA
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of providing information for diagnosing parkinson's disease. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a composition for preventing, ameliorating or treating parkinson's disease. The miRNA expression is specifically down-regulated or up-regulated in the parkinsonism model, so that the miRNA can be effectively used for diagnosis and treatment of parkinsonism.

title_en: DRAP1 protein for flowering in advance and fatty acid component change, and coding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a DRAP1 protein for flowering in advance and fatty acid component change, and a coding gene and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses application of the DRAP1 gene of macadamia nut in flowering in advance and fatty acid component change. According to the invention, by researching the DRAP1 gene of NF-YB family in macadimia nut, the mechanism of flowering and fatty acid synthesis of macadimia nut is known, and genetic engineering technology and the like are utilized to induce plants to bloom in advance and change fatty acid components, so that theoretical basis and reference are provided for mechanism research of flowering regulation and fatty acid synthesis accumulation.

title_en: Stem cell culture device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stem cell culture device, and belongs to the field of stem cell culture. A stem cell culture apparatus comprising a base and a sealed compartment secured to the top thereof, further comprising: the culture dish is placed on the bearing table, and clamping parts for fixing the culture dish are arranged on two sides of the bearing table; according to the invention, the bearing table is driven to periodically rotate, so that the culture dish fixed on the bearing table is subjected to rotary shaking action, and stem cells in the culture dish are uniformly contacted with nutrient substances and oxygen, thereby promoting the growth and propagation of the stem cells and improving the culture effect; and in carrying the heat that produces to the heating tank when rotating the drive plummer, the realization of self-adaptation provides suitable temperature environment to the heating of culture dish to the cultivation effect of stem cell has been improved to the heat that produces in the working process has been utilized, more energy-concerving and environment-protective.

title_en: Application of SlCRY a gene in improving salt stress resistance of tomatoes
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of modern agricultural industry, and particularly relates to application of SlCRY a gene in improving salt stress resistance of tomatoes. According to the invention, tomato SlCRY a gene knockout and over-expression plants are constructed by gene means to study the regulation mechanism of tomato salt resistance. The result shows that the salt stress can obviously induce the transcription of SlCRY a, and the over-expression of SlCRY a under the salt stress can improve the accumulation of tomato biomass, improve the fluorescence content of leaf green, reduce the relative conductivity content of leaf and alleviate the accumulation of active oxygen, thereby improving the tolerance of tomato to the salt stress. In the modern agricultural industry, the invention provides gene resources for cultivating new varieties of salt-tolerant tomatoes, has better potential application value, and lays a theoretical foundation for researching the mechanism of responding stress signals of tomato plants and the molecular mechanism of responding complex and changeable environmental factors.

title_en: Trichoderma reesei quinic acid induced CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Trichoderma reesei quinic acid induction type CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system and application, and belongs to the technical field of gene editing. The invention constructs a Trichoderma reesei quinic acid induction type CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system, and the Cas9 gene is placed under a quinic acid induction type promoter P  qaY , so that the expression of the Cas9 gene is regulated and controlled, the expression can only be induced by quinic acid, the space-time expression of the Cas9 protein is strictly controlled, the negative influence caused by off-target effect is reduced, and the Trichoderma reesei strain can be genetically modified more continuously, stably and efficiently. By utilizing the Trichoderma reesei quinic acid induction type CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing system, trichoderma reesei engineering bacteria capable of producing the holly fungus H are constructed for the first time, so that the purpose of producing the holly fungus H is achieved.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for identifying fish intestinal microbial homeostasis or imbalance
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus and computer readable storage media for identifying fish gut microbial homeostasis or imbalance are disclosed. The invention is to protect a technical scheme that the invention detects the microorganism composition of fish intestinal contents through metagenomics, and detects the functional group 2 (bacteroides, firmicutes and fusobacterium) and the functional group 1: the relative abundance ratio of the Proteobacteria "identifies fish intestinal microbial homeostasis or imbalance. Experiments prove that after the functional additive is supplemented in daily ration of grass carp or omnivorous fish and meat fish of largehead jewfish, the relative abundance ratio of the functional group 2/the functional group 1 can reflect the steady state or unbalanced characteristic of intestinal microorganisms of fish. The method provided by the invention can be used for preparing products for detecting fish shoal steady state and fish health, and can also be applied to screening fish feed or functional additives, so that sustainable and rapid growth of fish is realized, and a more effective way is provided.

title_en: Application of CmPYL gene in regulation and control of cold resistance of muskmelon
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of CmPYL gene in regulating cold resistance of muskmelon, which is verified in muskmelon and arabidopsis respectively by constructing transient silencing vector and over-expression vector of CmPYL gene, and proves that CmPYL plays an important role in regulating low temperature tolerance. Compared with the prior art, the invention carries out transcription and metabolism combined analysis on CmPYL7 silent melon seedlings after low-temperature stress treatment, discovers that 27 kinds of lipids and 4 kinds of terpenoids are generally increased except the metabolism of proline and soluble sugar in CmPYL silent plants, and phenolic acids, flavonoids, amino acids, alkaloids, organic acids and other substances are generally reduced, which means that CmPYL7 regulates the synthesis and accumulation of the metabolites at low temperature, thereby affecting the low-temperature stress tolerance capability and obviously increasing the cold resistance of CmPYL over-expressed Arabidopsis plants.

title_en: Gene ASN3 for increasing corn protein content
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural biology, and relates to application of asparagine synthase 3, namely ASN3 or expressed genes thereof in improving plant seed and/or plant protein content and/or plant biomass. The corn asparagine synthase 3 gene Zm00001d028750 can effectively improve the protein content in corn kernels and plants, can improve the biomass of corn plants, and can be used for cultivating new corn varieties with high protein content.

title_en: Gene sequencing reaction equipment, gene sequencing system and gene sequencing reaction method
abstract_en: A gene sequencing reaction device, a gene sequencing system and a gene sequencing reaction method. The gene sequencing reaction equipment comprises a supporting platform (8), a soaking container, a temperature control device and a transfer device, wherein the soaking container is arranged on the supporting platform (8) and is provided with a soaking reaction area, the soaking reaction area is used for containing chemical reagents for gene sequencing reaction and is used for soaking a sequencing chip (2) which is provided with a DNA sample loading structure on the surface and is loaded with the DNA sample into the chemical reagents for carrying out gene sequencing reaction, the temperature control device is used for controlling the temperature of the chemical reagents in the soaking reaction area, and the transfer device is used for inserting the sequencing chip (2) into the soaking reaction area or extracting the sequencing chip from the soaking reaction area. The gene sequencing reaction device can realize the gene sequencing reaction process by soaking the sequencing chip in a chemical reagent.

title_en: Bacillus bailii and application and feed thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses bacillus belicus, which is classified and named Bacillus velezensis ZM2024, and has the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2024695; the bacillus beljalis has good stress resistance and safety, high-yield cellulase, and can obviously improve the nutritional ingredients and the feeding value of high-fiber plant feed raw materials such as palm meal and the like; meanwhile, the bacillus bailii can inhibit pathogenic bacteria causing diarrhea of livestock and poultry, is suitable for processing and feeding livestock and poultry feed, and in addition, the application also discloses application of the bacillus bailii and a feed.

title_en: Application of Lin5 allele in regulating sugar content of tomato fruits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biotechnology, in particular to application of a Lin5 allele in regulating tomato fruit sugar content. According to the invention, a wild material with high sugar content of the fruit and a modern cultivated tomato with low sugar content are taken as research objects, a key natural variation of the Lin5 gene is mined, the key natural variation site of the cultivated tomato is edited by a gene editing technology, the sugar content of the cultivated tomato fruit is remarkably improved, an important genetic basis and a technical support are laid for analysis and application research of the key natural variation of the sugar accumulation of the tomato fruit, and the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Parkinson disease quantitative detection kit of target HIP2 gene, detection method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a target HIP2 gene Parkinson quantitative detection kit, a detection method and application, wherein the kit comprises a first primer, and the sequence of the first primer at least comprises a base sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1; SEQ ID NO. 1: TCCCCCT; a second primer, the sequence of which at least comprises a base sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2; SEQ ID NO. 2: GCCCAA; an inner reference primer set; the kit quantitatively detects the HIP2 content in the sample to be detected by adopting a standard curve method, and can be adapted to different detection samples, wherein the detection range reaches 20-200 ng/ml. The designed primer has good specificity for detecting the target gene, strong specificity, high detection accuracy and high precision, and the measurement range of the primer reaches 10-10  5   copies/. Mu.L by using a standard reference substance; the fitting constants R  2  of the fitting curves of the reference substances are all larger than 0.99; the method provided by the invention can simply, conveniently, accurately and efficiently detect the HIP2 mRNA in clinical blood samples, and has important significance for detecting the HIP2 expression level of clinical samples and the HIP2 relative expression amount for diagnosing the clinical Parkinson disease.

title_en: African swine fever virus outer envelope protein p12 surface B cell neutralization epitope and screening verification method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a B cell neutralization epitope on the surface of an African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV) outer envelope p12 protein and a screening verification method and application thereof, and particularly discloses two screened B cell epitopes GN08 and MA11 in the ASFV outer envelope p12 protein, wherein hybridoma cells (preservation number CCTCC NO: C2023192) generated by monoclonal antibodies against the epitope GN08, cell supernatant secreted by the hybridoma cells and mouse-derived ascites are verified to have the activity of neutralizing the ASFV by utilizing a cell neutralization test of ASFV virus infected pig primary lung macrophages (PAM), and cell supernatant secreted by the hybridoma cells against the MA11 epitope and mouse-derived ascites do not have the activity of neutralizing the ASFV. Therefore, the GN08 epitope is a neutralizing epitope of B cells on the surface of the ASFV outer envelope p12 protein, and has application potential of being developed into a neutralizing virus epitope target.

title_en: SNP molecular marker related to chicken muscle weight characteristics and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SNP molecular marker related to chicken muscle weight characteristics and application thereof, wherein the molecular marker locus is positioned at the downstream of SPRYD genes, GRCg a genome chr1:170671006, individuals of chicken heterozygous populations with 1076 only left pectoral muscle weight and left leg muscle weight are sequenced by utilizing a resequencing technology, whole genome association analysis is carried out, a SNP locus which is obviously related to the muscle weight phenotype is found, 3 genotypes are present in the SNP marker, AA, GG and AG are present, wherein GG corresponds to higher pectoral muscle weight and leg muscle weight, SNP frequency analysis is carried out on the SNP locus in low-weight chicken species and high-weight chicken species, the SNP frequency distribution is found to have obvious difference in the low-weight chicken species and the high-weight chicken species, G is a dominant allele in the low-weight chicken species, A is a dominant allele in the low-weight chicken species, and early selection is carried out on the chicken muscle weight characteristics of the chicken by optimizing the G/G genotype of the SNP locus, so that the genetic breeding can be accelerated.

title_en: Zeolite feed additive for inhibiting foot-and-mouth disease of cattle and sheep and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a zeolite feed additive and a method for inhibiting foot-and-mouth disease of cattle and sheep, wherein the composition comprises a cattle peripheral blood immune stem cell exosome small molecule peptide extract, an antiviral plant fermentation extract, activated zeolite, vitamins and other medium and trace elements, wherein the stem cell immune exosome small molecule peptide extract shows a multi-functional composite mechanism, the antiviral plant is used for fermentation of feed, and waste reed can be fermented into high-quality feed without adding any auxiliary materials. Improving immunity, lasting effect and increasing economic benefit of farmers.

title_en: Compound microbial inoculant containing trichoderma asperellum and application of compound microbial inoculant in tea tree biocontrol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of agricultural microorganisms, and discloses a compound microbial inoculum containing trichoderma asperellum and application thereof in tea tree biocontrol. The preservation number of trichoderma asperellum (Trichoderma asperellum) HBTG3306 in the composite microbial inoculum is CCTCC NO: M20232116, the preservation number of bacillus thuringiensis (Bacillus taichungensis) HBTG1666 in the table is CCTCC NO: M2023678, and compared with a single strain, the composite bacterial strain has synergistic effect on diseases such as tea cake disease, round spot disease, gray mold, white star disease, anthracnose, brown spot disease, tea coal disease and the like of tea, and has a certain application prospect in prevention and control of tea diseases.

title_en: CD33 specific chimeric antigen receptor
abstract_en: Provided herein are Chimeric Antigen Receptors (CARs) for cancer therapy, in particular CARs comprising scFv from a CD33 monoclonal antibody. Immune effector cells comprising such CARs are provided, as well as methods of treating proliferative diseases such as Acute Myelogenous Leukemia (AML) and relapsed or refractory AML.

title_en: Temperature control system for sample sub-packaging, sample sub-packaging system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a temperature control system for sample split charging, a sample split charging system and a method. In the temperature control system, the lower end of the evaporator is connected with the refrigeration plate and exchanges heat with the refrigeration plate so as to cool the storage container; the air duct device comprises a heat exchange assembly arranged in the refrigeration air duct, and the heat exchange assembly is used for enabling the gas in the refrigeration air duct to form turbulence when passing through the heat exchange assembly; the upper end of the evaporator is connected with the heat exchange assembly and exchanges heat with the heat exchange assembly so as to cool the gas passing through the heat exchange assembly, and then cool the refrigerating air channel containing the split charging module for split charging the sample liquid flowing in the storage container through cooled gas. According to the invention, through two mild and stable heat exchange modes of heat conduction of the refrigeration plate and convective heat exchange of the heat exchange component, the storage container and the split charging module are subjected to indirect mild cooling, so that the rapid and efficient cooling is ensured, and the guarantee is provided for keeping the cell activity of the sample liquid.

title_en: Application of magnetic field device in construction of Alzheimer disease inhibiting model
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a magnetic field device in constructing a model for inhibiting Alzheimer's disease, and belongs to the technical field of magnetic biology. The RMF magnetic field experimental device mainly comprises an upper part and a lower part: the lower half is the RMF device, the upper half is the culture device; the RMF device comprises a T-shaped rotor and two permanent magnets; the two permanent magnets are respectively fixed at two ends of the T-shaped rotor upwards through an S pole and an N pole. Steady state magnetic field SMF experiments were cylindrical superconducting magnets with 100mm diameter room temperature bore that could provide a vertical steady state magnetic field up to 3T in the center. The beneficial effects are that: the invention utilizes a RMF experimental device and a steady-state magnetic field SMF experimental device, through scientific experiments, the inhibiting effect of the RMF on AD progress is proved on the molecular level, the cell level and the animal level, and a treatment scheme of the RMF therapeutic instrument for inhibiting AD progress is designed according to the inhibiting effect. Meanwhile, the invention provides a verification method for inhibiting AD progress by RMF and SMF.

title_en: Composite microbial agent and application thereof in hermetia illucens brood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound microbial agent and application thereof in hermetia illucens brood materials, wherein the compound microbial agent comprises compound microorganisms, and the compound microorganisms consist of lactobacillus zeae, cellulose bacteria, lactobacillus johnsonii and enterococcus faecalis. The microbial strains used in the invention are screened out by the hermetia illucens intestinal flora, and are easy to colonise the intestinal tract of the hermetia illucens. The composite microbial agent provided by the invention is suitable for various black soldier fly brooding materials. The compound microbial agent provided by the invention can obviously improve the quality of the bodies of young insects, improve the survival rate, reduce the cost of the feeding amount of the early-stage hermetia illucens, improve the efficiency of biological treatment of chicken manure by the hermetia illucens, and ensure the stability of large-scale brooding of the hermetia illucens.

title_en: Carbonyl reductase, coding gene, vector and method for synthesizing acetoin by using low-grade tobacco leaf leaching liquor
abstract_en: The invention provides carbonyl reductase, a coding gene, a vector and a method for synthesizing acetoin by using low-grade tobacco leaf extract. The invention provides carbonyl reductase, a gene for encoding the carbonyl reductase, a recombinant expression vector carrying the carbonyl reductase and a host cell capable of expressing the carbonyl reductase, and the host cell is used for biosynthesizing acetoin with low-grade tobacco leaching liquor. Removing adverse factors affecting taste such as pectin, starch, protein and the like in the low-grade tobacco leaf leaching solution by a microbial multienzyme system; the carbonyl reductase is utilized to convert the low-grade tobacco leaching solution to generate acetoin, so that substrates in the tobacco are effectively converted into aroma components, the characteristic aroma components in the tobacco are reserved while aroma is generated, the low-grade tobacco leaching solution is used as a raw material of the tobacco aroma, the use value of the low-grade tobacco is improved, and an effective low-grade tobacco biological aroma production process is provided.

title_en: Systems and methods for real-time cytosolic drug-target conjugation
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods and systems that allow for real-time measurement of cytosolic drug-target engagement. The use of fluorescence-based cellular target engagement techniques with real-time gene expression machinery provides several advantages over prior art systems. Integration with real-time gene expression machinery is provided that is not biased towards any particular design or brand. The programmability of the cellular target engagement method is provided so that any software in the real-time gene expression machine can be seamlessly used for programming. Single or multiple organelle integration for cellular target engagement techniques is provided. Compatibility with multiple multi-well plate arrangements is provided. Development of unique modifications of real-time (quantitative) gene expression software for detecting real-time cellular drug-target engagement to work efficiently with existing gene expression machinery is provided.

title_en: SSR molecular marker primer group related to polygonatum cyrtonema germplasm resource identification and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an SSR molecular marker primer group related to the germplasm resource identification of Polygonatum cyrtonema and application thereof, wherein the primer is developed based on rhizome transcriptome of Polygonatum cyrtonema, a large number of sequences obtained by RNA-seq are screened, sequences rich in perfect SSR sites are obtained, and the conserved primer design on two sides of the SSR molecular marker is carried out, so that the problems of small number of SSR molecular markers and low development efficiency of the conventional Polygonatum cyrtonema are overcome. The universality and the effectiveness of the primers of the invention are detected by utilizing the genome of 5 polygonatum species, which lays a foundation for the researches of genetic diversity analysis and genetic structure research, genetic linkage map structure, target gene positioning, molecular marker assisted breeding and the like of medicinal and edible polygonatum cyrtonema and kindred species plants.

title_en: Biosensor for representing protein expression quantity by red fluorescence intensity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biosensor for representing protein expression quantity by red fluorescence intensity, which is characterized in that EGFP is coupled with m-Cherry fluorescent protein expression, the correlation is calculated by two fluorescent values, the fitting degree R  2  reaches 0.998, the coupling sequence is applied to the representation verification of alpha-lactalbumin expression, the correlation is calculated by protein expression gray value and m-Cherry fluorescent value, and the fitting degree reaches 0.6543.

title_en: ST11-K64 type klebsiella pneumoniae capsular polysaccharide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capsular polysaccharide of ST11-K64 klebsiella pneumoniae and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology, wherein the capsular polysaccharide is capsular polysaccharide in the klebsiella pneumoniae obtained by taking ST11-K64 klebsiella pneumoniae as a source and separating and purifying the capsular polysaccharide, the molecular structure main chain of the capsular polysaccharide is → [ 6) -beta-D-Manp- (1 ]  3 →[4)-β-D-Glcp-(1] 6  → and 4 side chains are beta-D-Rhap- (1- & gt 3) -beta-D-Rhap- (1- & gt, beta-D-Manp- (1- & gt, beta-D-Glcp- (1- & gt 3) -beta-D-Glcp- (1- & gt 2- & gt, beta-D-Glcp- (1- & gt, and the uronic acid is reduced to form rhamnose, glucose and mannose with a molar ratio of 0.200:0.583:0.217.

title_en: Probe primer and kit for detecting enterotoxin bacteroides fragilis in high background tissue sample
abstract_en: The invention provides a probe primer and a kit for detecting enterotoxin bacteroides fragilis in a high background tissue sample. The sequences of the upstream primer and the downstream primer used in the detection are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 2; the probe sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The invention further provides a detection kit for enterotoxin bacteroides fragilis and a corresponding detection method. The invention can rapidly and sensitively detect and quantify ETBF in the sample, and has good effect on detecting low abundance ETBF in the paraffin embedded tissue sample. Lays a foundation for developing ETBF infection epidemiological investigation in the crowd, lays a foundation for exploring the occurrence and development mechanisms of colonitis, inflammatory bowel disease, colorectal tumor and other diseases and subsequent scientific prevention and control related diseases, and has very important research significance.

title_en: Molecular marker for sex of large thorn loach and application
abstract_en: The application relates to a molecular marker for sex of thorn loach and application thereof. The molecular marker comprises nucleotide sequences of male and female differences of the thorn loaches. The nucleotide sequences can be used for effectively detecting, identifying and identifying the sex of the spiny loaches, and providing technical support for the unisexual germplasm creation and sexual control breeding of the spiny loaches.

title_en: Multifunctional bacillus subtilis microbial agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological bactericides and discloses a multifunctional bacillus subtilis bactericides and a preparation method thereof, wherein the functional bacillus subtilis bactericides comprise bacillus subtilis, trichoderma reesei, a culture medium A, a nutritional supplement B and a stabilizer C; the culture medium A consists of corn flour, glucose, yeast extract, sodium chloride, potassium dihydrogen phosphate, disodium hydrogen phosphate and water; the nutritional supplement B contains trace elements and vitamins; the stabilizer C contains sodium alginate, xanthan gum and glycerol. The weight portion ratio of each component of the microbial inoculum is 8-10:1:200-220:20-25:6-8. The multifunctional bacillus subtilis microbial inoculum not only has multiple functions of soil potassium decomposition, soil phosphorus decomposition, plant growth promotion and the like, but also introduces the alcohol leaching solution of peppermint and the specially prepared yeast extract in the preparation process, thereby enhancing the stability and activity of the microbial inoculum; the bacterial agent also has an antibacterial effect on bacterial wilt, and provides powerful support for agricultural production.

title_en: Molecular marker of glycogen phosphorylase related to patinopecten yessoensis glycogen metabolism and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular marker assisted breeding, and relates to a molecular marker of glycogen phosphorylase genes related to patinopecten yessoensis glycogen metabolism and application thereof. The molecular marker is positioned in an exon region of a patinopecten yessoensis glycogen phosphorylase gene, the SNP locus is 1252 th base from the 5' end of a nucleotide sequence of a patinopecten yessoensis glycogen phosphorylase PyGPH gene coding region shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, and the base is A or C. The molecular marker related to glycogen traits is screened from the gene exon region of glycogen phosphorylase PyGPH for the first time, and the molecular marker assisted breeding method for high glycogen traits is established, so that the method can be used for rapidly evaluating the glycogen content of patinopecten yessoensis and screening patinopecten yessoensis individuals with high glycogen and breeding new varieties with high glycogen.

title_en: Preparation method, kit and application of induced pluripotent stem cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method, a kit and application of induced pluripotent stem cells, and relates to the technical field of biology. The preparation method of the induced pluripotent stem cells comprises the steps of culturing the reprogrammed cells by using a culture medium containing a BAX allosteric inhibitor, and obviously improving the reprogramming efficiency, cloning morphology and cloning size, improving the cell growth speed and shortening the library establishment period by adding the BAX allosteric inhibitor into a culture solution in the process of cloning and forming after reprogramming.

title_en: Cistanche extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine extraction, and discloses an extraction method and application of cistanche deserticola, wherein the extraction method comprises the steps of obtaining callus of cistanche deserticola; culturing the callus into tender buds; extracting cistanche deserticola polysaccharide of the tender buds; wherein, when obtaining the callus of cistanche deserticola, include: acquiring stem segments of cistanche deserticola plants and performing disinfection treatment; inoculating the sterilized stem segments into a culture dish containing a callus culture medium, and enabling the stem segments to grow to form callus; during the culture, the illumination, temperature and humidity are adjusted according to the growth data of the callus. The invention not only optimizes the culture conditions of the callus and the tender bud, but also greatly improves the extraction efficiency and quality of cistanche deserticola polysaccharide by precisely controlling the enzymolysis and extraction processes. Compared with the traditional extraction method, the cistanche deserticola polysaccharide extracted by the method has higher purity and stronger biological activity, and provides high-quality raw materials for subsequent medicine and health-care product development.

title_en: Method for using tylosin refined solution in tylosin fermentation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microbial fermentation, and particularly discloses a method for using tylosin refined liquid in tylosin fermentation. The method comprises the following steps: the tylosin refined liquid is supplemented into a fermentation tank of the tylosin. According to the invention, the tylosin filtrate extracted and purified by butyl acetate is refined and then used for fermenting tylosin, so that the tylosin component content and the organic solvent residue in the filtrate are effectively controlled. The method not only avoids using the tylosin finished product, but also obviously improves the fermentation level compared with the tylosin finished product, and provides a new idea for the linkage production of tylosin and tylosin.

title_en: Cross-linked antibodies
abstract_en: Provided herein are compositions and methods for cross-linking single domain antibodies to targets with conjugates. Further provided herein are conjugates comprising a targeting domain, wherein the targeting domain comprises an unnatural amino acid. Further provided herein are methods of treating diseases with cross-linked single domain antibodies and multispecific antibodies.

title_en: Star branched poly (beta-amino ester) degradation method, partial degradation product obtained by star branched poly (beta-amino ester) degradation method and application of partial degradation product
abstract_en: The invention provides a star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) degradation method, and the obtained partially degraded star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) and application thereof, wherein the degradation method comprises the following steps: 1) Dissolving star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) in DMSO or tetrahydrofuran to obtain star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) stock solution; 2) Dropwise adding the star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) raw material into an acidic buffer solution, stirring at room temperature for a preset time, and precipitating the obtained reaction liquid to obtain a partially degraded star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) component; wherein the pH value of the acidic buffer solution is 4.0-6.0. The method can successfully prepare a series of partially degraded star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) with different molecular weights and more flexible structures, improves the action between the star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) and DNA, increases the delivery efficiency of the star-branched poly (beta-amino ester) to the DNA, and provides an important platform technology for clinical gene therapy.

title_en: Lysobacter P18 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of microorganisms, and relates to a lysobacter P18 and application thereof, wherein the lysobacter P18 is lysobacter Lysobacter soli, and the lysobacter P18 is submitted to CGMCC for preservation in the 6 th month 7 of 2024, and the preservation number is NO.30877. The lysobacter P18 provided by the invention has a growth promoting effect on tomatoes.

title_en: Method for promoting generation of microvesicles with mitochondria and medical use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for promoting the production of microvesicles having mitochondria and medical uses thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a use of a combination of a factor promoting mitochondrial production and a factor promoting extracellular vesicle production, which is used for promoting the generation of microvesicles with mitochondria. And methods of producing extracellular vesicle compositions: the cell is co-cultured with a factor that promotes mitochondrial production and a factor that promotes extracellular vesicle production, and the resulting extracellular vesicle composition is enriched in microvesicles having mitochondria. By adding factors for promoting mitochondrial production and factors for promoting extracellular vesicle production, cells can be promoted to produce microvesicles with mitochondria; and the collected mitochondria are mitochondria coated by microvesicles, so that the mitochondria are easier to preserve and transport into cells. Also provided are isolated extracellular vesicle compositions, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same, and their use for the preparation of a medicament for the treatment of diabetes and/or kidney injury.

title_en: Porcine circovirus type 3 strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porcine circovirus type 3 strain and application thereof. In particular discloses a PCV3 XY strain, which has a preservation number of CGMCC No.26424 in the China general microbiological culture Collection center. The virus strain can be well proliferated on PK15 cells, has high immunogenicity and good genetic stability, and the inactivated vaccine prepared by using the virus strain has high immunogenicity, is safe and reliable, is more efficient and has lasting immunity, has good immune protection effect on PCV3 virus infection, and the duration of immunized piglets can reach 4 months. The virus strain can also be used for detecting PCV3 antibodies, preparing a virus infection model, further being used for researching a PCV3 infection pathogenic mechanism, screening antiviral drugs, developing a new diagnosis strategy and/or treatment strategy, evaluating vaccine immunoprotection effect and the like, and has wide clinical application value.

title_en: Method for preparing urolithin-containing additive by using marine aureobasidium pullulans and application
abstract_en: A method for preparing additive containing urolithin by using Aureobasidium marine and application thereof belong to the technical field of marine microorganism application, and mainly comprise the steps of preparing a culture medium; fermenting the pomegranate leaves and/or the pomegranate rind by using marine aureobasidium pullulans to prepare ellagic acid; and (3) carrying out secondary fermentation on ellagic acid by utilizing the Weizhmann condensation bacteria and the Lactobacillus helveticus to obtain fermentation products containing urolithin and the like. The ellagic acid content in the product of the invention is not lower than 0.8g/L, and the urolithin content is not lower than 0.15g/L. The product of the invention can be further prepared into food supplements, feed additives or purification of urolithin.

title_en: Biological production method of L-aspartic acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological production method of L-aspartic acid, belonging to the technical field of L-aspartic acid production. Inoculating the L-aspartic acid lyase strain into a culture medium, shake culturing to form a first generation, and continuously culturing to form a second generation under the same condition; inoculating 3-8% of the volume of the culture medium in the fermentation culture medium, shaking the culture medium with a shaking table, cooling to 30deg.C, continuously culturing, centrifuging, and removing supernatant to obtain thallus; adding water to obtain bacterial liquid; adding sodium alginate and glutaraldehyde, uniformly mixing, slowly dripping into CaCl  2  solution, reacting to form gel pellets, filtering the pellets, and washing twice with sodium chloride physiological saline to obtain immobilized cells; taking immobilized cells and fumaric acid, adjusting pH=7-8, and oscillating at constant temperature by a shaking table to obtain L-aspartic acid; further purifying by modified sephadex filtration column to obtain high purity L-aspartic acid. The invention has high content and high yield.

title_en: CHO cell serum-free medium and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a CHO cell serum-free culture medium and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of cell culture, and the culture medium comprises a basic culture medium, a feed supplement culture medium and microcapsules, wherein the microcapsules are sodium alginate microcapsules, are honeycomb-shaped, have the diameter of 0.1-3mm, and have the aperture of 5-8000 nm; the composition can effectively reduce the accumulation of acid peaks in a plurality of clones, so that the composition is used as a universal and effective means for regulating and controlling the charge isomers; secondly, the yield of cells is improved while the acid peak is reduced; the honeycomb structure of the double-layer microcapsule provides an ideal microenvironment for cells, the cells attach and grow on the surface of the microcapsule, so that the cells can form a stable attaching layer on the surface of the microcapsule, the cells can be protected from being influenced by external mechanical damage, and the microcapsule can play a role in buffering in the cell culture process, so that the damage of the cells caused by external factors is reduced.

title_en: DsRNA, application and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a dsRNA, uses thereof, and methods of making the same. The disclosure also relates to pharmaceutical compositions, cells or kits comprising the dsRNA. The dsRNA of the present disclosure can interfere with the expression of AGT, preventing and/or treating related diseases.

title_en: Double-stranded oligonucleotide for inhibiting LPA gene expression and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a double-stranded oligonucleotide for inhibiting LPA gene expression and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nucleic acid medicines. The conjugate containing the double-chain oligonucleotide can obviously reduce the LPA protein level in the serum of the cynomolgus monkey, has durable drug action, can effectively relieve, prevent and/or treat diseases or symptoms mediated by the mRNA level expressed by the LPA gene, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Moisturizing composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of skin care products, and particularly relates to a moisturizing composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 5-10% of inonotus obliquus extract, 6-15% of purslane extract, 3-5% of aloe vera extract, 1-3% of radix sophorae flavescentis extract, 7-9% of field mint leaf extract, 10-12% of golden chamomile extract, 15-20% of butanediol, 8-12% of glycerol, 0.5-1% of 1, 2-hexanediol, 0.3-0.5% of p-hydroxyacetophenone and the balance of water. In the preparation process of the inonotus obliquus extract, synephrine and sodium caseinate are innovatively added into a basic seed culture medium, and shikimic acid and sodium copper chlorophyllin are added into a fermentation culture medium. The test result shows that the addition of synephrine and shikimic acid effectively improves the polysaccharide content in the inonotus obliquus extract, thereby improving the moisturizing effect of the skin care product.

title_en: Application of knock-down TMEM91 to induction of renal cancer cell death and tumor immunotherapy of renal cancer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and relates to application of knock-down TMEM91 to induction of renal cancer cell death and tumor immunotherapy of renal cancer. The invention designs shRNA sequences and siRNA sequences aiming at human-derived and murine-derived TMEM91, and constructs corresponding shRNA lentiviral silencing vectors. Experimental results prove that the shRNA can significantly silence the expression of TMEM 91. In view of TMEM91 as a potential renal cancer treatment target, the shRNA of TMEM91 and the related biological reagent thereof provided by the invention can be used for researching and preparing medicines for treating renal cancer. In addition, the invention proves that inhibiting TMEM91 gene expression can inhibit abnormal proliferation of human kidney transparent cell cancer cells (786-O) and rat kidney cancer cells (RENCA), and proves that TMEM91 is a potential novel target for treating kidney cancer, thereby being beneficial to further researching the occurrence and development mechanism of tumor-related diseases caused by abnormal activation of TMEM 91.

title_en: Unsaturated olefine aldehyde compound with anti-inflammatory and phlegm-eliminating activities, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsaturated olefine aldehyde compound with anti-inflammatory and phlegm-eliminating activities, and a preparation method and application thereof. An unsaturated olefine aldehyde compound shown in a formula I, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt or solvate thereof, wherein R1, R2, R3, R4 and R5 are respectively and independently selected from methyl or hydroxyl. The hepialus intestinal tract endophytic strain can be fermented to produce a novel compound which has stable physical property, low cytotoxicity and obvious anti-inflammatory and phlegm-eliminating activities.

title_en: SNP (single nucleotide polymorphism) marker and detection primer for gene related to nitrite stress resistance characteristics of litopenaeus vannamei and application of SNP marker and detection primer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a litopenaeus vannamei nitrite stress-resistance trait related gene SNP marker, a detection primer and application thereof. The SNP molecular marker is positioned at a 402bp locus of a CDS sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and mutation types are C/C homozygote, A/A homozygote and A/C heterozygote. The anti-nitrite capability of the litopenaeus vannamei with the SNP molecular marker of the C/C homozygous genotype is obviously higher than that of the litopenaeus vannamei with the A/A homozygous genotype and the A/C heterozygous genotype. The invention accelerates the breeding process of the anti-nitrite fine variety of the litopenaeus vannamei by exploring SNP markers related to the anti-nitrite character of the litopenaeus vannamei and establishing a method for assisting in anti-nitrite breeding by using the markers.

title_en: Molecular marking method and application of rice low chalky grain rate QTL CGR5
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular marking method of a rice low chalky grain rate QTL CGR5, which belongs to the field of genetic engineering, uses a rice genome to be detected with a dragon rice 18 blood margin as a template, uses primers of nucleotide sequences shown in SEQ ID No.1 and SEQ ID No.2 to carry out PCR amplification, and if 163bp products can be amplified, the rice to be detected carries the low chalky grain rate QTL CGR5. The invention uses low chalkiness rice Long Dao' in cold region as parent to improve low chalkiness rate of Dongnong 421 of high-yield japonica rice variety, and in F6 generation segregating group, a low chalkiness rate QTL CGR5 from Long Dao is positioned on chromosome 5, and a PCR practical economic label CGR5-1 closely linked with the low chalkiness rate QTL is identified, which can be used to effectively develop molecular auxiliary selective breeding research of rice with low chalkiness rate.

title_en: Application of anti-aging repair polypeptide in cosmetics
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of an anti-aging repair polypeptide in cosmetics, and particularly relates to the technical field of cosmetics. The anti-aging repair polypeptide delays and inhibits the synthesis of interleukin-6 through various action mechanisms, stimulates the synthesis of laminin V and collagen IV and VII, promotes the synthesis of collagen I, and inhibits the activity of acetylcholine receptors, calcium, sodium, potassium and other ion channels. These effects together make the skin firm and elastic, reduce the problems of wrinkles, skin sagging and uneven skin tone, and simultaneously repair the skin and relax muscles to improve and alleviate wrinkles.

title_en: Microsatellite DNA amplification primer pair and second generation sequencing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological genetic engineering, in particular to a microsatellite DNA amplification primer pair and a second generation sequencing method, wherein the primer pair comprises a left primer and a right primer, the primers comprise a TA (barcode) region and a conserved sequence binding region, the left primer conserved sequence binding region is AAAAGAGAGAGAGAGT, the corresponding right primer conserved sequence binding region is TCTCTCTCTCTCTCA, the TA (barcode) region is connected to the 5' end of the left primer or the right primer, the sequencing method has low cost but increases the rate, and the sequencing method is mixed sample sequencing after PCR amplification, so that the data volume produced by sequencing can be more uniform.

title_en: Embroidered ball type KASP mark development method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a development method and application of a hydrangea type KASP mark. The development method of the KASP marker comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining SNP loci related to flower types through GWAS analysis based on resequencing data typing data, (2) screening the data in the step (1), selecting the first 1-20 SNP loci with high-log 10 (P) value in each Scaffold, and (3) carrying out genotyping verification on the SNP loci screened in the step (2) in a plurality of embroidered ball varieties through two methods of DNA sequencing and KASP, and finally confirming the KASP marker for identifying the flower types of the embroidered ball. According to the invention, the SNP loci which are related to the flower types and obtained by analyzing the GWAS are screened, and genotyping verification is carried out by two methods of DNA sequencing and KASP, so that the correlation between the confirmed SNP loci and the hydrangea type characters is higher, and a reference is provided for subsequent flower type breeding.

title_en: Recombinant respiratory syncytial virus vaccine using measles attenuated live vaccine as carrier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant respiratory syncytial virus vaccine taking measles attenuated live vaccine as a carrier and a preparation method thereof. The vaccine can induce immune response and protection against both respiratory syncytial virus and measles virus, the respiratory syncytial virus antigen produced is PreF trimeric recombinant protein, preF is respiratory syncytial virus F protein with S150C, S190F, V207L, S C mutation and the transmembrane region and anchoring region removed, and the coding gene of fusion protein of PreF and foldon sequence is integrated between P gene and M gene of measles attenuated live vaccine. The invention verifies the successful preparation of the vaccine by checking the formation of syncytia caused by recombinant viruses, the expression detection of exogenous antigen proteins, the growth dynamics level of the recombinant viruses and the like, can simultaneously express measles virus antigens and respiratory syncytial virus antigens, and the measles virus vector is a replicative vector, is mature in the upstream and downstream of the production process, is suitable for expanded culture inoculation, and has proven safety and high immunogenicity.

title_en: Application of antigen protein FAM104B and composition thereof in early diagnosis of lung cancer
