abstract_en: The application discloses an antigen protein FAM104B and an application protein composition of the antigen protein FAM104B in early lung cancer diagnosis and an application of the antigen protein FAM104B in early lung cancer diagnosis, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The antigen protein FAM104B is used for detecting lung cancer autoantibody in serum, so that the lung cancer autoantibody is used for early diagnosis of lung cancer, the sensitivity is 48%, the specificity is 95%, the average value of the sensitivity and the specificity is 71%, and the sensitivity and the average value of the sensitivity and the specificity are basically the same as, even better than those of single antigen protein in the prior art. Meanwhile, the antigen protein is combined with other antigen proteins to form a composition, and the lung cancer self-IgG antibody in serum is detected, so that the antigen protein is used for early diagnosis of lung cancer, the average value of sensitivity and specificity is 51% -88%, and especially the average value of sensitivity and specificity of the protein composition containing antigen proteins FAM104B and RAC3 is more than 77%, so that the accuracy of early diagnosis of lung cancer is improved.

title_en: Culture solution for recovering quality of pig oocyte by adding uridine and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a culture solution for recovering quality of porcine oocytes by adding uridine, which comprises a basic culture solution and uridine, wherein the basic culture solution contains 10% of porcine follicular fluid, 0.57mM cysteine, 0.5IU/mLLH, 0.5IU/mL FSH, 10ng/mL epidermal growth factor, 1% of double-antibody TCM 199 culture medium and the balance of water, and the adding amount of uridine is 100 mu M of the basic culture solution. The method of the invention can respectively save the in vitro cultured H  2 O 2  induced oxidative stress porcine oocyte and the delayed culture aged porcine oocyte by using the metabolite uridine (Urd) required by human body, so as to improve the quality of the oocyte.

title_en: Complex enzyme for efficiently converting high-purity rare ginsenoside CK and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a complex enzyme for efficiently converting high-purity rare ginsenoside CK and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The complex enzymes of the invention include beta-glucosidase, fructosyltransferase, lactase, cellulase, and beta-glucanase. According to the invention, the beta-glucosidase, fructosyltransferase, lactase, cellulase and beta-glucanase are selected to be matched to obtain the compound enzyme, so that the ginsenoside CK can be prepared in an enzyme engineering process, and the conversion rate of converting the ginsenoside Rb1 into the ginsenoside CK is improved by synergistic effect.

title_en: Process for the preparation of (R) -oxiranes based on epoxide hydrolases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing (R) -epoxyphenylethane based on epoxide hydrolase, which takes racemic epoxyethane compounds as substrates, and carries out enzyme catalytic reaction in a biphase system under the action of the epoxide hydrolase to obtain (R) -epoxyphenylethane and (R) -1-phenyl-1, 2-glycol or (S) -1-phenyl-1, 2-glycol, wherein the temperature of the enzyme catalytic reaction is controlled to be 5-50 ℃ and the reaction time is 2-24 hours. The invention can efficiently and stereoselectively split the racemic oxirane compound, has good enzyme catalysis effect and high optical purity of the product.

title_en: Application of mitochondrial double-stranded RNA as serum biomarker for lupus nephritis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of mitochondrial double-stranded RNA as a lupus nephritis serum biomarker. The application of the reagent for detecting the mitochondrial double-stranded RNA in preparing the lupus nephritis serum auxiliary diagnostic reagent and/or the prognosis auxiliary diagnostic reagent is provided, wherein the mitochondrial double-stranded RNA is selected from any one or more of ND1, ND4L, COX2, ATP6 and ATP 8. The Mt-dsRNA combination can evaluate the kidney activity state or prognosis of LN patients, and can improve the sensitivity and the specificity of a single index when being used in combination with biochemical indexes. Therefore, by combining mt-dsRNA with the existing biochemical indexes, the occurrence and development processes of LN can be estimated more accurately and efficiently, and personalized treatment schemes suitable for different LN patients can be prepared accordingly.

title_en: Nucleic acid composition for detecting canine coronavirus and canine parvovirus, kit and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of canine parvovirus detection, and in particular relates to a nucleic acid composition for detecting canine coronavirus and canine parvovirus, a kit and application thereof. The kit can be used for constructing a colorimetric sensing detection kit by preparing a biotinylation aptamer and an alkylamino aptamer, taking the biotinylation aptamer as a carrier for capturing viruses, and taking the aptamer coupled to an iron-based metal-organic framework as a detection carrier. The colorimetric sensing kit can be used for detecting CCV or CPV independently or simultaneously, and has high detection sensitivity and high specificity. In addition, the detection kit can effectively avoid the interference of other similar viruses, and has no cross reactivity.

title_en: Respiratory syncytial virus reconstruction polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) F protein reconstitution polypeptide, a polynucleotide encoding the same, a nucleic acid construct comprising the polynucleotide, an expression vector comprising the nucleic acid construct, a host cell into which the above polynucleotide, nucleic acid construct or expression vector has been transformed or transfected, a stabilized multimer formed from the reconstitution polypeptide, an immunogenic composition comprising any of the foregoing, and the use thereof in the manufacture of a vaccine for the prevention and/or treatment of respiratory syncytial virus infection. The RSV F protein reconstitution polypeptide has good immunogenicity, can excite organisms to generate high-level neutralizing antibody titer, and has great significance for clinical treatment, prevention and control of respiratory syncytial virus.

title_en: Crocodile blood peptide compound for improving immunity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an crocodile blood peptide compound for improving immunity and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, 2 polypeptides with better immune cell proliferation promotion and immune activity improvement are obtained from the cultured Siamese crocodile blood through enzymolysis and screening, and the immune activity of mice can be well improved after the polypeptide is prepared into a compound, so that the polypeptide has a better application value.

title_en: Soil conditioner for improving saline-alkali soil and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil conditioner for improving saline-alkali soil, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biochemistry. The invention provides a method for synthesizing glutamine, which comprises the step of carrying out anaerobic fermentation culture on leuconostoc mesenteroides in a fermentation culture medium containing lysate and sodium glutamate to obtain a fermentation liquor containing glutamine. The invention provides a method for synthesizing gamma-polyglutamic acid, which comprises the steps of inoculating bacillus coagulans into fermentation liquor containing glutamine for aerobic fermentation to obtain fermentation liquor containing gamma-polyglutamic acid. The invention provides a preparation method of a soil conditioner, which is characterized in that fermentation bacteria liquid containing gamma-polyglutamic acid is subjected to esterification reaction with alcohols to obtain the soil conditioner. The obtained soil conditioner can obviously improve the physicochemical property of saline-alkali soil, improve the water retention and fertilizer retention capacity of soil, reduce the salt alkalinity of soil, promote plant growth, strengthen the microbial activity of soil, and provide an effective solution for improving the saline-alkali soil.

title_en: Use of acetoacetate to inhibit skin fibrosis
abstract_en: The application relates to application of acetoacetic acid in inhibiting skin fibrosis and a method for inhibiting skin fibroblast fibrosis, which comprises the following steps of S1, aseptically obtaining skin tissues of a human body, S2, cutting the adipose tissues into small pieces, mixing the small pieces with collagenase I, digesting the small pieces in a culture box with 37 ℃ and 5% CO  2 , S3, after enzymolysis, transferring cells into a culture bottle containing a culture medium for further culture through centrifugal treatment and washing, S4, transferring the cells into the culture medium containing the acetoacetic acid for culture when the cells are cultured to 80% fusion degree, and obtaining the cultured skin fibroblasts, and S5, detecting and freezing and storing the skin fibroblasts. The application utilizes acetoacetic acid to inhibit the synthesis of collagen and reduce the deposition of extracellular matrix, thereby possibly slowing down or preventing the development of skin fibrosis.

title_en: Antibody drug conjugate
abstract_en: A drug conjugate of an antibody of a domino compound, an application and a preparation method thereof are provided, and the drug conjugate of the antibody with better stability, hydrophilicity and good pharmacokinetic property is obtained by introducing hydrophilic 1inker to connect with the domino compound.

title_en: Blue copper peptide derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blue copper peptide derivative with the effects of repairing, removing wrinkles, resisting aging and the like and application thereof, wherein the structure of the blue copper peptide derivative is shown as a formula I:  wherein R  1  is selected from:  or R  2  is selected from: 、 、  C1-C20 alkyl or-COCH  2 R 3 ,R 3  represents NH  2  or C1-C20 alkyl. Compared with the original blue copper peptide, the blue copper peptide derivative provided by the invention has the effects of promoting cell proliferation and collagen synthesis, has the effects of promoting barrier repair, promoting wound healing and reducing skin fold degree, and has lower effective concentration. Can be used as main active ingredient in the fields of medicine and daily chemicals.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide and application thereof, wherein the antibacterial peptide comprises one or more of antibacterial peptide PFK with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, antibacterial peptide PVK with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2 and antibacterial peptide PIK with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The antibacterial peptides PFK, PVK and PIK have antibacterial effects on Porphyromonas gingivalis, streptococcus mutans, acinetobacter baumannii, escherichia coli and staphylococcus aureus, have lower hemolytic property and lower cytotoxicity, and can be used for preparing biological antibacterial preparations, anti-infective drugs or oral products.

title_en: Use of CPKs-TIR-NLRs pathway for modulating plant immunity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of CPKs-TIR-NLRs pathway in modulating plant immunity. A method of modulating the immune competence of a plant is provided comprising modulating CPKs-TIR-NLRs signaling pathway or pathway molecule thereof in the plant. The invention discloses CPKs that TIR-NLR can be phosphorylated, so that the immunity of plants is regulated, and the growth of the plants is promoted. The invention has important significance for genetic improvement of plant traits.

title_en: Method for improving enzymolysis efficiency of cellulose in xylose residues
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass resource utilization, in particular to a method for improving the enzymolysis efficiency of cellulose in xylose residues. In the method, the steam explosion is used for processing the xylose residues, so that the high-efficiency enzymolysis of cellulose in the subsequent enzymolysis process is facilitated, the higher water content can be kept in the subsequent drying process of the xylose residues, the energy consumption of production is reduced, meanwhile, the crushing process is not required to be crushed to finer granularity, the problem of blockage of crushing equipment is avoided, the service life of equipment and the stable operation of production are ensured, the energy consumption and the production cost of equipment are effectively reduced, and the method is convenient to apply in industrial production.

title_en: Library construction method for enriching trace CRISPR gene knockout library from space transcriptome
abstract_en: The invention discloses a library construction method for enriching a trace CRISPR gene knockout library from a space transcriptome, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a Total cDNA library mixed by a CRISPR gene knockout library and a space transcriptome library, carrying out inward nest type outer amplification aiming at the CRISPR gene knockout library on the Total cDNA library to obtain an outer enrichment product, carrying out inward nest type Inner enrichment aiming at the CRISPR gene knockout library on the outer enrichment product to obtain an Inner enrichment product, carrying out cyclization reaction after adding splint-TSO cyclization sequences on the Inner enrichment product to obtain cyclized cDNA, removing the cyclized sequences to obtain annular cDNA, carrying out amplification on the annular cDNA to obtain a target fragment library, and adding second-generation sequencing joints on the target fragment library to obtain the CRISPR gene knockout library, wherein the CRISPR gene knockout library can be used for second-generation sequencing.

title_en: SHERLOCK-based method for detecting canine distemper virus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting canine distemper virus based on SHERLOCK, which uses any of the RPA primer groups comprising RPAF1, RPAR1, RPAF2 and RPAR2, CRRNAS IVT-1Tempalte and CRRNAS IVT-2tempalte crRNA or uses a reagent prepared based on any of the RPA primer groups or crRNA. The method for detecting the canine distemper virus based on SHELOCK method has the advantages of good specificity and high sensitivity, can realize the visual detection of the novel canine distemper virus, and respectively carries out conventional PCR and SHELOCK detection on the clinical sample from the processed sample, and the accuracy of the detection results of the two methods is consistent.

title_en: Bacillus acidophilus (Bacillus acidiceler) CNBG-PGPR-17 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacillus acidophilus (Bacillus acidiceler) CNBG-PGPR-17 and application thereof, wherein the strain is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.23673 and classified as bacillus acidophilus (Bacillus acidiceler) in the year of 2021 and the month of 10. The strain has the advantages of high growth speed, good stability, easy amplified culture, strong capability of dissolving inorganic phosphorus, capability of dissolving inorganic phosphorus up to 277.8mg/kg in 7 days of inoculation, capability of secreting small molecular organic acids such as lactic acid, succinic acid and the like, reducing the pH value of the solution, capability of increasing the contents of organic matters, total nitrogen, available phosphorus and quick-acting potassium in soil, reducing the pH value of the soil, promoting the growth of blueberry seedlings and improving the quality of blueberries.

title_en: Solid-liquid separation method of 23-valent pneumococcal fermentation lysate
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel solid-liquid separation method for 23-valent pneumococcal fermentation pyrolysis liquid, which uses a filter cake layer candle type solid-liquid separation system to be matched with a filter aid formula meeting the medical grade standard to clarify and filter raw material liquid, replaces the existing two-step process, namely a process combination of a continuous flow disc separator and a deep filter, shortens the process production process, simplifies the operation process and the production system, improves the product yield, realizes energy conservation and consumption reduction, reduces the production cost and is environment-friendly on the premise of the quality index requirement of equivalent clarity. The invention aims to meet the requirements of high hygiene level and no dead angle and easy cleaning of biopharmaceutical production equipment, optimally designs the equipment structure of a filter cake layer candle type solid-liquid separation system, and correspondingly designs an operation program so that the whole system meets the requirements of cleaning and verification.

title_en: Anti-CD 30 rabbit-derived Fab antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-CD 30 rabbit-derived Fab antibody, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention expresses human CD30 protein by in vitro recombination, utilizes CD30 protein to immunize rabbits for 3 times, then separates peripheral blood lymphocytes and extracts total RNA thereof, reverse transcribes the total RNA into cDNA, uses the cDNA as a template, uses a specific primer to amplify a Fab sequence, screens and obtains a Fab antibody capable of combining the CD30 protein by a yeast display technology, combines the Fab sequence with a rabbit Fc domain to obtain high-purity fusion protein, and verifies that the Fab antibody has stronger activity with CD30 on a cell level and has specific binding capacity with tumor cells.

title_en: Low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of foods. A process for preparing low-phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide includes such steps as dissolving gelatin, two-step enzymolysis by alkaline proteinase and flavourzyme, centrifugal separation of enzymolysis liquid, collecting supernatant, adsorption by activated carbon to remove the polypeptide containing aromatic amino acids (including phenylalanine) to obtain low-phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide solution, freeze drying, grinding and sieving. The low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide has lower fat binding capacity, higher emulsifying capacity and lower Fe  2+  chelating capacity than the non-adsorbed polypeptide. The molecular weight of the low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide obtained by the invention is thousands, compared with amino acid and oligopeptide, the low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide has better physiological activity and nutritive value, the phenylalanine content is controllable (0.19-1.13 g/100 g), and the low phenylalanine gelatin polypeptide has the potential of treating phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency.

title_en: DCAPS molecular marker related to strong female shape of muskmelon and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dCAPS molecular marker related to strong female shapes of muskmelon and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of molecular biology. In the invention, the heavy female gene of the muskmelon is finely positioned based on BSA-seq, and finally the heavy female gene locus is reduced to 51.08Kb of Chr08, and only one gene (Bch 08G 003160) is contained. Sequence alignment shows that the coding region of the gene has two base site deletions, namely a G base (Chr 08,14,693, 255 bp) of SNP_317 and a C base (Chr 08,14,693,154 bp) of SNP_416, and the two base site deletions lead to premature stop codons. Meanwhile, dCAPS markers for screening for strong female traits, namely Sgy _317SNP-dCAPS and Sgy _416SNP-dCAPS, were developed at the deletion positions of the two base sites. The two pairs of marks can be used for accurately screening the strong female type melon, so that the breeding efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Compositions and methods for targeting and killing alpha-vbeta-3 (αvbeta 3) positive Cancer Stem Cells (CSCs) and treating drug resistant and metastatic cancers
abstract_en: The present invention provides compositions and methods for treating or ameliorating advanced cancers such as drug resistant or metastatic cancers or killing cancer stem cells by using human or humanized antibodies, wherein the advanced cancers, drug resistant or metastatic cancers, cancer stem cells express αvβ3 polypeptides on their cell surfaces and the human or humanized antibodies are capable of specifically binding to αvβ3 (avb 3) polypeptides expressed on the cell surfaces of effector cells such as macrophages, neutrophils and dendritic cells, the Fc region of which has selective affinity for human fcγri (CD 64) but not for other fcγrs. By administering these antibodies to an individual in need thereof, these human or humanized antibodies are capable of treating, ameliorating, or slowing the progression of advanced cancer or drug resistant cancer or cancer caused or initiated or maintained by advanced cancer or drug resistant cancer cells or cancer stem cells.

title_en: HLA-A 11:01 renal cell carcinoma tumor antigen short peptide derived from IDO1 gene
abstract_en: The invention discloses HLa-a 11:01 renal cell carcinoma tumor antigen short peptide derived from IDO1 gene. The invention provides a tumor antigen peptide, the amino acid sequence of which is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The present invention has found that the complex formed by the short peptide and the corresponding HLA molecule (HLa-a 11:01) can be recognized by T cells to activate immune response. The invention provides a potential target for treating renal cell carcinoma, and provides a new target screening direction for the subsequent tumor antigen treatment of renal cell carcinoma.

title_en: Cholinesterase determination reagent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of in-vitro detection reagents, and particularly discloses a cholinesterase determination reagent and application thereof. The cholinesterase determination reagent comprises a first reagent containing potassium ferricyanide and a buffer agent, a second reagent containing butyrylthiocholine iodide and a buffer agent, a surfactant and a stabilizer, wherein the stabilizer is dimethyl sulfoxide or dimethylacetamide, and the surfactant is one or two of polyoxyethylene dodecyl ether, aliphatic alcohol containing 8 EO ethylene oxide groups, polyethylene glycol monolaurate and 4-nonylphenyl-polyethylene glycol. The cholinesterase measuring reagent has accurate test result and improved stability, the result of a measured sample can be continuously and stably stored for 60 days in a bottle opening use state at 2-8 ℃, the result of the measured sample can be continuously and stably stored for 24 months in a sealed and light-proof storage process at 2-8 ℃, and the reagent has no color change and is beneficial to storage and use.

title_en: Fusion protein capable of editing four bases simultaneously and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fusion protein for simultaneously editing four bases and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of gene editing. The fusion protein of the invention combines gGBE, DAF-TBE and TadDE, fuses deaminase and glycosidase of the three into nCas, and develops the fusion protein capable of editing four bases (A, T, C, G) simultaneously. The fusion protein can realize the base transition and the transversion of A to G, A to C, A to T, T to G, T to C, T to A, C to T, C to G, C to A, G to A, G to C and G to T, and has wide application prospect in the aspects of directed evolution of protein, cell tracing, construction of complex disease models and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing fowl infectious bursal disease VP2 nanoparticle oral vaccine by using Kluyveromyces marxianus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and discloses a method for preparing an avian infectious bursal disease VP2 nanoparticle oral vaccine by using Kluyveromyces marxianus and application thereof. The applicant prepares a double-replicon expression vector suitable for Kluyveromyces marxianus through screening and assembling, the vector achieves the effects of high conversion rate and high expression efficiency in the Kluyveromyces marxianus, and the double-replicon expression vector pGKD is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. The applicant provides a Kluyveromyces marxianus expression system which can successfully express the avian infectious bursal disease VP2 in the form of nano particles, and provides a new idea for developing an oral immunization strategy of the avian infectious bursal disease.

title_en: Pinning structure hydrophobic modified ionic membrane based on pseudomonas aeruginosa, oil well huff and puff synergist and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pinning structure hydrophobically modified ionic membrane based on pseudomonas aeruginosa, an oil well huff and puff synergist and application thereof, and belongs to the field of petroleum development. According to the invention, pseudomonas aeruginosa is cultured to obtain a biological membrane secreted by the Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and after the biological membrane is crosslinked with an ionic solution, long-chain fatty acid or long-chain fatty acid salt is added for modification, so that the pinning structure hydrophobic modified ionic membrane based on the Pseudomonas aeruginosa is obtained. The hydrophobically modified ionic membrane is used as an oil well huff-puff synergist in an oil well, can improve the relative permeability of water phase and oil phase of the oil well, improves the fluid displacement efficiency and oil displacement effect, has the effect of remarkably improving the oil well huff-puff efficiency, is suitable for complex oil reservoir development due to the characteristics of low cost and high environmental protection, and has certain application potential.

title_en: Modified respiratory syncytial virus F proteins and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) F protein, which comprises at least one modification or mutation for increasing the conformational stability of the RSV F protein before fusion, wherein (1) one or more amino acid mutations for filling hydrophobic cavity are introduced into the RSV F protein, (2) one or more amino acid mutations for electrostatic modification are introduced into the RSV F protein, and (3) the p27 peptide segment in the RSV F protein is removed. The RSV F protein has high stability as recombinant protein antigen, is easy to store and transport, has improved expression quantity, is easy to realize the improvement of yield, has higher immunogenicity, and can generate better immune protection effect.

title_en: Droplet fusion system
abstract_en: The application provides a liquid drop fusion system which comprises a micro-fluidic chip, an air supply assembly, a first laser detection unit, a second laser detection unit, an image acquisition unit and a controller, wherein the first laser detection unit is used for emitting first detection laser, receiving first feedback light formed after passing through a first laser detection area and generating a first laser detection signal, the second laser detection unit is used for emitting second detection laser, receiving second feedback light formed after passing through a second laser detection area and generating a second laser detection signal, the image acquisition unit is used for shooting an image of the image acquisition area, and the controller is used for receiving detection signals of the first laser detection unit and the second laser detection unit and image information of the image acquisition unit and controlling the air supply assembly to adjust the speed and the pressure of liquid flow in the first micro-flow channel and the second micro-flow channel. The liquid drop fusion system adopts the laser detection unit and the image acquisition unit to monitor the liquid drop generation and fusion process, and the controller adjusts parameters to control the quality in real time, thereby obviously improving the reliability and efficiency of single-cell sequencing technology.

title_en: Acetohydroxyacid synthase mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of protein engineering and biotechnology, and particularly relates to an acetohydroxyacid synthase mutant and application thereof. The invention obtains the acetohydroxy acid synthase mutant capable of improving the yield of branched chain amino acid of the strain through intensive research and mutant library screening, can be applied to the production of L-leucine, L-isoleucine and L-valine, and has potential application prospect.

title_en: Antibody for resisting human chorionic gonadotrophin and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-human chorionic gonadotrophin antibody and application thereof, and relates to the field of antibodies. The anti-human chorionic gonadotrophin antibody disclosed by the invention comprises a heavy chain complementarity determining region and a light chain complementarity determining region, provides an important raw material source for the detection of human chorionic gonadotrophin, and has good affinity or activity.

title_en: Anti-plasmodium or lactate dehydrogenase antibody thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody against plasmodium or lactate dehydrogenase thereof and application thereof, and relates to the field of antibodies. The anti-plasmodium or lactate dehydrogenase antibody disclosed by the invention comprises a heavy chain complementarity determining region and a light chain complementarity determining region, provides an important raw material source for detecting plasmodium or lactate dehydrogenase thereof, and has good affinity or activity.

title_en: Automated track incubator shaker compartment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kit for holding and transporting at least one cell culture flask, which is arranged in at least one cell culture flask holder (2, 12), as well as to a method and use of the kit. The invention relates to a track incubator shaker comprising a kit (7) of the invention, and a cell culture flask holder (2, 12) compatible with the kit.

title_en: Pleurotus eryngii strain Ple-0400 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pleurotus eryngii strain Ple-0400 and application thereof. In the invention, the strain is selected and bred according to genome sequencing data in a bag type cultivation way, wherein Pl.e0400 is selected and bred. The method comprises the steps of taking 'Japanese primer 1' as a parent, carrying out selfing breeding, carrying out pairwise mutual comparison on genome sequencing data of 'Pl.e0400' and parent 'Japanese primer 1' by adopting Kmer differential assembly technology to obtain a specific differential fragment Sequence (SV), randomly selecting 4 SV sequences to design specific primer 8 pairs, amplifying apricot Bao Ji 'Pl.e0400' and parent 'Japanese primer 1', wherein Chur 1A, chur 2A, chur 4A and Chur 5A are common fragments of Japanese primer 1 and Pl.e0400, and wherein Chur 1, chur 2, chur 4 and Chur 5 are unique fragments of Japanese primer 1. The result shows that the DNA fingerprints of Pleurotus eryngii 'Pl.e0400' parent 'day 1' are obviously different, and the Pleurotus eryngii is determined to be of different varieties. The Pl.e0400' fungus cover is concave, light gray, short in fungus handle, off-white, high in hardness, short in cultivation period, high in yield, storage-resistant and transportation-resistant, and has good development and application prospects.

title_en: Lactobacillus paracasei W1 and application thereof in inhibiting clostridium difficile infection
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus paracasei (Lacticaseibacillusparacasei) W1 and application thereof in inhibiting clostridium difficile (Clostridioides difficile) infection, relating to the technical field of probiotic application, wherein the technical key points are as follows: the preservation number of the lactobacillus paracasei (L.Paracasei) W1 is CCTCC M2024619. Lactobacillus paracasei (l.paracasei) W1 has the ability to tolerate low pH and high concentration of bile salts of the gastrointestinal tract, and its sterile fermentation supernatant is able to inhibit the growth of clostridium difficile (c.difficilie) and the formation of biofilms. Animal experiments show that lactobacillus paracasei W1 can inhibit colonization of clostridium difficile (c.difficilie) in vivo, improve colonic mucosal injury, relieve colonic shortening and alleviate inflammation caused by clostridium difficile (c.difficilie) infection. The strain has wide application prospect in preventing and treating intestinal diseases caused by clostridium difficile (C.difficilie) infection, and related dairy products, functional products and health care products thereof.

title_en: Method for retrodifferentiating human foreskin fibroblast into human hair follicle dermal papilla-like cell and application
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses a method for inversely differentiating human foreskin fibroblasts into human hair follicle dermal papilla-like cells and application thereof. The application can directly convert human primary foreskin fibroblasts into human hair follicle dermal papilla-like cells by adding peficitinib and Vitamin D2 for combined induction, the marker alkaline phosphatase expression and the marker gene (SOX 2, NOG, VCAN, LEF1 and alpha-SMA) expression of the human hair follicle dermal papilla-like cells have high similarity with the primary human hair follicle dermal papilla cells, and hair follicle regeneration can be induced in vivo, so that the application is suitable for people with alopecia symptoms.

title_en: Construction method of Serpin5 chimeric mutant double-spotted cricket for producing high-activity antibacterial peptide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of Serpin5 chimeric mutant double-spotted cricket for producing high-activity antibacterial peptide, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The invention discloses a sgRNA for knocking out a Serpin5 gene, and the nucleotide sequence of the sgRNA is shown as SEQ ID NO. 25. The CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology is utilized to knock out specific loci of the double-spotted cricket Serpin5 genes, so that the antibacterial activity of the antibacterial peptide in the double-spotted cricket body is improved, and theoretical support and technical thought are provided for improving the quality of the antibacterial peptide and promoting the industrialization process of the high-quality antibacterial peptide.

title_en: Simian poxvirus detection method based on LAMP and fluorescent DNA aptamer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monkey pox virus detection method based on LAMP and fluorescent DNA aptamer. The invention provides a group of specific primers, probes and a kit, wherein the sequences of the primers and the probes are shown in SEQ ID No.1 to SEQ ID No.7, and the probes are thermostable DNA fluorescent aptamers and are connected to the 5' end of a loop primer. The invention uses fluorescent DNA aptamer as probe to replace common nucleic acid dye, and overcomes the problems that loop LAMP is easy to be interfered and false positive is easy to occur. The detection process of the invention does not need complex instruments and equipment, can be completed by constant temperature equipment, has short detection time and high sensitivity, and is suitable for large-scale screening and early diagnosis. The invention has important application value in preventing and controlling the transmission of monkey pox epidemic situation.

title_en: Probe for detecting bacteria in air and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a probe for detecting bacteria in air, a preparation method and application thereof. The probe includes Au-Fe  3 O 4  nanoparticles and a recognition medium bonded to the surfaces of the Au-Fe  3 O 4  nanoparticles, the recognition medium including at least one of a mixture of 5 (6) -carboxyfluorescein and 3- (aminomethyl) phenylborate, and a product obtained by including both as reactants. When the probe is used, air is sampled, maltose is added for incubation, a solution possibly containing bacteria after incubation is taken, then the obtained solution is mixed with the probe, and the bacterial content in the air can be correspondingly obtained through a fluorescent signal displayed by the probe. Namely, the bacterial content in the air can be effectively obtained through the probe. Meanwhile, the probe is simple to prepare and convenient to use, and is beneficial to promoting the development of the technology for detecting bacteria in the air.

title_en: Separation method of ovarian cancer related mesenchymal stem cells and application of ovarian cancer related mesenchymal stem cells in resisting tumors
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a separation method of mesenchymal stem cells related to ovarian cancer and application of the mesenchymal stem cells in resisting tumors. The separation method comprises the following steps of (S1) extracting and separating mesenchymal stem cells from a tumor fresh sample of an ovarian cancer patient by adopting a direct tissue block method, and (S2) sequentially carrying out cell morphology identification, surface marker analysis, iterative dryness detection and tumor and/or fibroblast marker removal experiments, and screening and confirming that the mesenchymal stem cells are the mesenchymal stem cells from tumor sources. Experiments prove that the ovarian cancer related mesenchymal stem cells can be used for evaluating the anti-tumor efficacy of medicines, the anti-invasion capability supported by tumor stroma and/or the anti-balling capability supported by tumor stroma.

title_en: T7 RNA polymerase mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a T7RNA polymerase mutant and application thereof, wherein the T7RNA polymerase mutant has the following mutation of P266L, S430P, N433T, S633P, Y639F, V689 62762 689M, F849I, F880Y relative to wild T7RNA polymerase, or can also have at least one of the following mutation based on the above mutation. The T7RNA polymerase mutant provided by the invention can recognize and incorporate one or more nucleotide substrates of rNTPs, 2' -F-dNTPs and dNTPs, so that single-stranded DNA molecules, fluoro RNA molecules and perfluoro DNA molecules can be efficiently synthesized in vitro.

title_en: Application of ABC transporter family gene OsABCA in plant breeding regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of ABC transporter family gene OsABCA in plant breeding regulation and control. Belonging to the field of plant genetic engineering. The application of ABC transporter family gene OsABCA in plant breeding regulation, wherein the amino acid sequence of the ABC transporter family gene OsABCA coding protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. According to the invention, the ABC transporter gene OsABCA is knocked out in rice, so that Cd absorption in a knocked-out plant under Cd stress is obviously reduced compared with a wild plant, the Cd content of seeds in a knocked-out plant planted by Cd polluted soil is obviously reduced compared with the wild plant, but the content of essential elements in the seeds and the yield of rice are not negatively influenced, thereby providing a new candidate gene resource for creating safe rice with low Cd seeds and a potential restoration method for rice Cd pollution treatment.

title_en: Lactobacillus equi-producing lactobacillus equi-producing subspecies W182 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to a lactobacillus equi-producing lactobacillus equi subspecies W182 and application thereof. The lactobacillus equi-producing subspecies of the wine has the preservation number of CGMCC No.27058 and the preservation time of 2023, 4 and 11 days, can survive in intestinal tracts for a long time, has strong adhesion property, can produce extracellular polysaccharide with high yield, can be used for fermenting dairy products, fruit juice, fruit puree, soybean milk and the like, can also be used for preparing a starter and a natural thickener, can have rich flavor and very good viscosity without adding any existing thickener and emulsifier when being especially applied to fermenting dairy products, can remarkably reduce the precipitation of whey, has long preservation time and has wide application in the food field.

title_en: Preparation method of Janus material for simultaneous screening of protein phosphorylation and palmitoylation modification
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of Janus material for simultaneous screening of protein phosphorylation and palmitoylation modification, belonging to the technical field of magnetic material synthesis. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing MCeO  2 , mixing MCeO  2 , hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide and ammonia water to obtain a mixed solution, adding 1, 2-di (triethoxysilane) ethane into the mixed solution to react to obtain a product, dispersing the product in NH  4 NO 3  solution to perform reflux reaction to obtain Janus MCP, reacting the Janus MCP with a silane coupling agent, and dissolving aminated Janus MCP and 4-vinylsulfonyl benzoic acid in a buffer solution containing EDC and NHS to react to obtain the Janus material. The preparation method is reliable, the material performance is stable, and the enrichment efficiency of the magnetic Janus on target peptide fragments (phosphorylated peptide fragments and palmitoylated peptide fragments) is remarkably improved.

title_en: Application of tomato gene or protein encoded by tomato gene in regulation of low nitrogen stress tolerance of plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of tomato genes or proteins encoded by the tomato genes in regulating and controlling low nitrogen stress tolerance of plants, and relates to the field of biotechnology. According to the invention, by knocking out RBOH gene in tomato, compared with wild plants, nitrogen absorption capacity is reduced, expression of nitrate transporter genes NRT1.1 and NRT2.1 is limited, under low nitrogen stress, RBOH gene expression is up-regulated by 3.2 times after 1 day of treatment, and keeps continuous and remarkable increase within 1 to 3 days, which indicates that RBOH1 positively regulates nitrogen absorption of tomato.

title_en: Engineering bacterium for degrading herbicide 2,4-D, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of construction of genetic engineering strains, and particularly relates to engineering bacteria for degrading herbicide 2,4-D, a construction method and application thereof. The invention provides an engineering bacterium for degrading herbicide 2,4-D, which takes halophilus (Halomonas cupida) J9 as a base bacterium, wherein the genome nonfunctional site of the halophilus J9 is inserted with tfdA, tfdB, tfdC, tfdD, tfdE and tfdF genes. The engineering bacteria (J9U  2,4‑D ) take H.cupida J9 as basic bacteria, can survive and maintain activity in a high-salt concentration environment, rapidly and efficiently degrade 2,4-D, fully mineralize the 2,4-D, effectively convert harmful pollutants into harmless substances, reduce persistent pollution in the environment, reduce treatment cost and reduce negative influence on the environment.

title_en: Optical fiber optical tweezers probe for multi-particle capturing, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an optical fiber optical tweezers probe for multi-particle capturing, a preparation method and application. The optical fiber optical tweezers probe comprises a single-mode optical fiber, wherein one end of the single-mode optical fiber is a conical-like end, and a black porous carbon-based thermoplastic polyurethane polymer is attached to the end surface of the conical-like end. The optical fiber forceps probe is manufactured according to the following paths that one end of a single-mode optical fiber is twisted and electrode discharge is sequentially carried out, the other end of the single-mode optical fiber is twisted, a thermoplastic polyurethane optical fiber coating is placed in a twisted area of the exposed optical fiber, and tapering treatment is carried out, so that the other end of the single-mode optical fiber is provided with a black porous carbon-based thermoplastic polyurethane polymerized conical-like transition area. By applying the scheme, when the optical fiber optical tweezers probe is prepared, other additional optical elements and additional experimental materials are not inserted, and low-cost high-efficiency particle aggregation capturing based on a single-mode optical fiber can be realized.

title_en: Aspergillus niger strain and culture method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Aspergillus niger strain, a culture method and application thereof, wherein the Aspergillus niger strain is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of M20241727. The fermented tea product obtained by fermenting tea leaves or tea leaf extracts with the aspergillus niger strain CCTCC NO: M20241727 has prominent sweet and floral fragrance, obviously reduced bitter degree, higher content of tea polyphenol, free amino acid and flavone than the existing aspergillus niger strain fermented tea product, enhanced antioxidant activity, orange and bright tea soup color and better color, aroma and taste quality than the existing aspergillus niger strain fermented tea product.

title_en: Cryptosporidium-resistant synbiotic preparation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-cryptosporidium synbiotic preparation as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a composite microbial inoculum, which comprises bifidobacterium pseudolongum and bacteroides thetaiotaomicron. In the composite microbial inoculum, the number ratio of the bifidobacterium pseudolongum to the bacteroides thetaiotaomicron is 1-10:1-10. The invention also provides a composition comprising the complex microbial inoculant and guar gum. The invention also provides the application of the composite microbial inoculum or the composition in preparing a product for treating and/or preventing cryptosporidiosis and the application in preparing a product for improving intestinal functions. The invention has industrial value in the field of medicine.

title_en: SiRNA targeting PCSK9 gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses siRNA targeting PCSK9 gene and application thereof. 92 siRNA sequences, namely siRNA-1 to siRNA-92, are respectively designed aiming at different initial positions of the nucleotide sequence of the PCSK9 gene. The invention innovatively adopts a sequence pattern of ' 21+23 ', and two non-complementary sequences are added at the 3' -end of the antisense strand. This design has stronger sequence specificity, reducing off-target efficiency. Meanwhile, the 3' -end of the sense strand is more suitable for coupling with some targeting small molecules. The maximum inhibition efficiency of the siRNA provided by the invention to the PCSK9 gene can exceed 80%, and the effect is stronger. Can be reproduced in a plurality of cells, and has good stability.

title_en: Geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase with high beta-carotene yield and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase with high beta-carotene yield and application thereof. Specifically, the invention discloses a method for producing beta-carotene, which comprises the steps of over-expressing CrtE genes, carRP genes and CarB genes in a chassis strain, wherein the CrtE genes are CrtE genes from sulfolobus (Sulfolobaceae) and/or sulfolobus acidophilus (Sulfolobus acidocaldarius). The method can effectively remove the inhibition effect of lycopene substrate and effectively improve the yield of beta-carotene in chassis strains.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide derived from zebra fish
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial peptide derived from zebra fish, the amino acid sequence of which is SEQ ID NO. 1, and the sequence of the encoding nucleotide of which is SEQ ID NO. 2. The antibacterial peptide provided by the invention can be used for preparing products for preventing and treating antibacterial. The zebra fish antibacterial peptide mP  60‑81  has remarkable antibacterial effect on gram-positive bacteria and gram-negative bacteria, has a wide antibacterial spectrum, has great use value, and has better application in the aspect of developing and preparing antibacterial agents. The antibacterial peptide is derived from zebra fish, can be applied to aquaculture as a feed additive, and can be developed into antibacterial agents, antibacterial medicines and the like, so that the antibacterial peptide has wide application prospects.

title_en: Preparation method of human umbilical cord blood serum capable of replacing fetal bovine serum
abstract_en: The invention relates to a serum preparation method, in particular to a preparation method of human umbilical cord blood serum capable of replacing fetal bovine serum. The invention relates to a preparation method of human umbilical cord blood serum capable of replacing fetal bovine serum, which comprises the steps of adding CaCl  2  into anticoagulated umbilical cord blood plasma, enabling prothrombin to be activated into thrombin by calcium ions, acting on fibrinogen to convert the fibrinogen into fibrin polymers to form jelly-like gel, and finally completing the coagulation process to achieve the aim of removing the fibrinogen in the plasma. Furthermore, the purpose of reducing citrate in the sample is achieved by dialysis, and polyethylene glycol is further adopted to concentrate the dialyzed sample, so that the concentration of total protein and cytokines in umbilical serum is improved.

title_en: Method for treating gynecological malignant tumor by anti-HER 2 antibody drug conjugate and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and uses of anti-HER 2 antibody drug conjugates for treating gynaecological malignancies. In particular, the disclosure relates to the use of an anti-HER 2 antibody drug conjugate in the preparation of a medicament for treating a gynaecological malignancy of HER2 expression, the structure of the antibody drug conjugate being represented by formula (I).

title_en: Novel butenolide signal molecule and application thereof in gene expression regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel butenolide signal molecule and application thereof in gene expression regulation. The invention provides a novel butenolide signal molecule SFB1, the structure of which is shown as a formula I). The induction type gene expression regulating circuit composed of SFB1, its receptor protein and heterozygous promoter can be effectively operated in colibacillus, that is, the nanomolar concentration signal molecule SFB1 can effectively remove the repression of receptor protein TylP on the heterozygous promoter and induce the expression of target gene, and other types of streptomycete signal molecules including butenolide and gamma-butyrolactone from other streptomycetes can not obviously remove the repression of TylP on the heterozygous promoter, that is, the regulating circuit of the invention is not affected by crosstalk of other types of signal molecules common in streptomycete, can be used together with the existing AHL or GBL regulating tools, thus enriching the synthetic biology tool library.

title_en: Broccoli antihypertensive peptide with protecting effect on cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broccoli antihypertensive peptide with a protective effect on heart and cerebral vessels, and a preparation method and application thereof. The broccoli antihypertensive peptide includes peptide fragment HLVNK, peptide fragment LEHGF, peptide fragment LLDGR, peptide fragment HLEVR and peptide fragment LTEVR. The invention explores the effect of ACEI peptides on the AngII levels of VSMCs and the effects of proliferation, migration and apoptosis of VSMCs through cell experiments. The invention not only screens and identifies the novel broccoli ACEI peptide which can play a role in protecting the cardiovascular and cerebrovascular vessels in the high-sugar model, lays a foundation for practical application, but also provides a good reference for the safe and effective antihypertensive peptide with low toxicity in protecting the cardiovascular and cerebrovascular vessels.

title_en: Method for screening high-activity tryptophan enzyme based on random forest and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for screening high-activity tryptophan enzymes based on a random forest and application thereof, wherein a potential high-activity tryptophan enzyme coding gene is efficiently obtained based on the random forest method, cells containing recombinant tryptophan enzymes are obtained through heterologous expression and are applied to DL-tryptophan resolution to efficiently prepare high-purity D-tryptophan, and the problems of low flux, high cost, large error, poor accuracy, complex process and the like of the conventional tryptophan enzyme screening method are solved. The screened tryptophan enzyme gene derived from Morganella morganii is subjected to heterologous expression, the obtained recombinant strain can be used for expressing the tryptophan enzyme more efficiently, the whole cell containing the recombinant tryptophan enzyme is used for splitting DL-tryptophan, the hydrolysis rate of the L-tryptophan reaches 99.36%, and the ee value of the product D-tryptophan reaches 99.23%.

title_en: Preparation method, extraction reagent and extraction method of magnetic beads for extracting whole nucleic acid of micro-cell sample
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nucleic acid extraction and magnetic bead preparation, and relates to a preparation method, an extraction reagent and an extraction method of magnetic beads for extracting whole nucleic acid of a micro-cell sample. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing magnetic fluid Fe  4 O 3 , secondly coating the surface of the prepared magnetic fluid Fe  4 O 3  with silicon base, and thirdly carrying out carboxyl modification on the surface of the magnetic bead obtained through silicon base modification to obtain the magnetic bead for nucleic acid extraction, namely carboxyl magnetic bead. The carboxyl magnetic beads obtained by the process provided by the invention are more favorable for obtaining high-concentration nucleic acid under the condition of low sample size, and can meet the requirements of three-generation sequencing or single-cell sequencing.

title_en: Fish rhabdovirus binding protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of aquatic pathogenic microorganism prevention and control, and particularly relates to a fish rhabdovirus binding protein, a preparation method and application thereof. The protein can be combined with the binding site of the host cell receptor aiming at the fish rhabdovirus with high efficiency, and effectively blocks the invasion channel of the fish rhabdovirus to invade the host cell, thereby blocking the virus infected cell and avoiding the replication and proliferation of the virus in the host. The fish rhabdovirus binding protein provided by the invention has the effect of high-efficiency rhabdovirus resistance, and the premixed feed additive prepared by taking the fish rhabdovirus binding protein as an active material can obviously improve the rhabdovirus resistance of fish fries, is safe and pollution-free, can be applied to large-scale industrialization, and further improves the economic benefit of fish culture.

title_en: Aeromonas salmonicida CuC5 for phosphate and potassium dissolving of tailing sand, fermentation product thereof, microbial organic fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a tail sand phosphate-dissolving potassium-dissolving salmon-killing aeromonas CuC5, a fermentation product thereof, a microbial organic fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of microbial organic fertilizers. The preservation number of the aeromonas salmonicida CuC5 is CGMCC NO.29265, the aeromonas salmonicida CuC5 corresponding fermentation product and the preparation method thereof, and the microbial organic fertilizer is prepared from the aeromonas salmonicida CuC5 fermentation product. The microbial organic fertilizer can improve the effective nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium content of copper tailing sand plants, greatly improve the organic matter content of the tailing sand and improve the carbon fixation amount of a ecological system in a tailing area. The application has important significance for comprehensive utilization of tailing sand and development of functional microorganism organic fertilizer.

title_en: Nitrilase mutant and application thereof in synthesis of buvaracetam chiral intermediate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrilase mutant and application thereof in synthesizing a buvaracetam chiral intermediate, and establishes a high-efficiency (R) -3-cyanohexanoic acid nitrilase synthesis process by constructing the nitrilase mutant with improved catalytic activity and stereoselectivity, thereby meeting the requirement of industrialized buvaracetam key chiral intermediate synthesis and laying a foundation for industrialized production of buvaracetam synthesized by a chemical-enzymatic method.

title_en: Atrazine degrading enzyme and related biological material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses atrazine degrading enzyme and a related biological material and application thereof. According to the invention, atrazine resistance protein ME is butted with atrazine ligand small molecules based on a three-dimensional structure model to obtain a binding site, amino acid mutation is predicted by an amino acid mutation technology, and enzyme MP with degradation potential is obtained by screening according to molecular butting and mutation results. MP can obviously enhance atrazine degradation performance, can be applied to bioremediation of atrazine residues, and has good application potential.

title_en: ACE1 receptor targeting nuclide polypeptide probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of radiopharmaceuticals and nuclear medicine, and relates to an ACE1 receptor targeted nuclide polypeptide probe, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the probe is a BPP or BFC-BPP with a radionuclide label, and BFC is a bifunctional chelating agent for radionuclide labeling. The probe of the invention is expected to be used for differential diagnosis, stage separation, accurate positioning of focus and curative effect monitoring of triple negative breast cancer malignant tumors.

title_en: Chemical-enzyme integrated catalyst for oxygen functionalization reaction of inert C-H bond, preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical-enzyme integrated catalyst for oxygen functionalization reaction of an inert C-H bond, which is prepared by simultaneously fixing rhodium (III) complex and nonspecific peroxygenase AaeUPO by a covalent organic framework COF material with a macroporous structure, wherein trialdehyde phloroglucinol and 5,5 '-diamino-2, 2' -bipyridine are used as ligands, polystyrene spheres are used as hard templates for pore-forming, and the covalent organic framework COF material with the macroporous structure is prepared and is marked as macro-COF. The chemo-enzyme integrated catalyst not only realizes the efficient conversion of in-situ hydrogen peroxide generation to drive AaeUPO to catalyze inert C-H bond oxygen functionalization reaction, but also can effectively inhibit the damage of high-concentration hydrogen peroxide to AaeUPO active center.

title_en: Short peptide SP2 and application thereof in preparation of medicine for treating autism of children
abstract_en: The invention provides a short peptide SP2 (MWPLKTILPLGTA) and application thereof in preparation of products for preventing and/or treating autism of children, and belongs to the technical field of prevention and treatment of autism of children. The invention discovers that the short peptide SP2 has better effect in preventing or treating the autism of children for the first time, and obviously improves the autism of children after treatment. The development of the short peptide SP2 into a product for preventing and protecting the autism of children has important significance.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain VAND, anti-vanillin monoclonal antibody produced by same and application of anti-vanillin monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hybridoma cell strain VAND, an anti-vanillin monoclonal antibody produced by the hybridoma cell strain VAND and application of the anti-vanillin monoclonal antibody, and belongs to the field of immunochemistry. The hybridoma cell strain VAND provided by the invention can be used for preparing high-titer anti-vanillin monoclonal antibodies, the titer measured by an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) method can reach 3.2 multiplied by 10  5 , the anti-vanillin monoclonal antibodies provided by the invention have high sensitivity and good specificity, the 50% inhibition concentration IC  50  of vanillin is 22.1 mug/mL, the cross reaction rate with vanillin structural analogues is low or even no cross reaction, and the anti-vanillin monoclonal antibodies can be applied to measuring vanillin content.

title_en: Kit for extracting plant genome DNA by magnetic bead method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a kit for extracting plant genome DNA by a magnetic bead method and application thereof. The invention provides a binding solution which can be used for adsorbing DNA by magnetic beads in the process of extracting genomic DNA by a magnetic bead method, can improve the concentration and purity of an extraction product obtained in the process of extracting genomic DNA, and has better extraction effect.

title_en: Aptamer specifically binding to GBX2 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer specifically combined with GBX2 protein and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biology. The invention designs and synthesizes a random single-stranded DNA library and a corresponding primer based on a SELEX technology, and screens and obtains a nucleic acid aptamer which has small molecular weight, stable chemical property, easy preservation and marking and can be combined with GBX2 protein with high affinity through improving screening conditions, and the nucleotide sequence of GBX2-08 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The aptamer can be used for detection, diagnosis, imaging, treatment and other aspects, such as purification or high-sensitivity detection of GBX2 protein, preparation of a medicament targeting the GBX2 protein, preparation of a reagent or medicament for diagnosing or treating abnormal GBX2 expression, and the like, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for preparing clean biological methane gas from duckweed residues
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological fermentation engineering and discloses a method for preparing clean biological methane gas by utilizing duckweed residues, which comprises the steps of taking anaerobic granular sludge as an inoculum and duckweed residues as fermentation substrates, and fermenting and preparing methane in an anaerobic fermentation tank, wherein the anaerobic fermentation tank comprises a tank body, a cover body and a regulating and controlling unit, the regulating and controlling unit comprises a controller, a display screen, a barrel, a telescopic device for driving the barrel to lift and fall, a pH sensor, a conductivity sensor and an acid-base solution dosing pipe, wherein the pH sensor, the conductivity sensor, the four-way valve and the display screen are all electrically connected with the controller, and the acid-base solution dosing pipe is communicated with an acid liquor pipe, an alkali liquor pipe and a flushing liquor pipe through a four-way valve. According to the scheme, the regulating and controlling unit is additionally arranged, so that the pH of the fermentation liquor is effectively regulated and controlled in real time and accurately, the pH of the fermentation liquor is ensured to be in the optimal activity pH range of methanogenic bacteria, the activity and the methane yield of the methanogenic bacteria are further improved, and the production benefit is improved.

title_en: HIV quantitative composition, kit, method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of molecular biological detection, and particularly relates to a quantitative composition, a kit, a method and application, and more particularly relates to an HIV quantitative composition, a kit, a method and application. The present invention provides a quantitative composition comprising at least 3 cognate and quantitative vectors for at least a portion of at least one of the regions LTR, GAG, POL, ENV, VIF, VPR, VPU, TAT, REV, or NEF regions of HIV, as well as primers and probes for amplifying both vectors. The invention creatively introduces the homologous carrier, artificially increases the concentration of the sample to be detected, and further improves the stability and the accuracy of the PCR amplification reaction. More particularly, by creatively introducing a plurality of homologous vectors, the detection of the highly mutated virus of HIV is more accurate, preventing missed detection of HIV virus.

title_en: Homogeneous fluorescence instant tumor liquid biopsy strategy based on DNA functionalized nanospheres
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and particularly relates to a homogeneous fluorescent instant tumor liquid biopsy strategy based on a DNA functionalized nanosphere, which synthesizes a multifunctional integrated nanosphere of a protein scaffold DNA-Cu  2+  by combining an apoptosis ligand 1 (PD-L1) aptamer, protein-DNA and DNA-metal ions at room temperature by a one-step method. Based on the functional integration of the nanospheres, the method realizes one-step detection of Circulating Tumor Cells (CTCs) or tumor source exosomes (TDEs), combines test strips and smart phone red, green and blue (RGB) analysis technologies, provides multiple analysis modes including fluorescence detection and smart phone-RGB, builds a rapid and sensitive tumor liquid biopsy instant detection method, realizes convenient analysis of 'drop-in-place' and can meet the rapid and convenient detection requirement of tumor liquid biopsy, and provides an effective means for early disease screening.

title_en: Immunotoxin molecule of anti-HER 2 single domain antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an immunotoxin molecule of an anti-HER 2 single domain antibody, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides an immunotoxin molecule of anti-HER 2, which comprises an anti-HER 2 single domain antibody, PE25 and a linker. The immunotoxin molecule of the anti-HER 2 single domain antibody can target the specific antigen HER2 on the surface of tumor cells with high specificity, and can kill cancer cells with high efficiency and inhibit tumor growth.

title_en: Quick detection device of blood flow infection sample drug resistance micro-fluidic chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clinical sample detection and provides a rapid detection device for a drug resistance microfluidic chip of a blood flow infection sample, which comprises a detection box body, wherein a microfluidic chip is arranged in the detection box body, a cleaning detection mechanism is arranged at the lower part of the microfluidic chip in a sliding manner, the cleaning detection mechanism is connected with a driving mechanism, the rapid detection device also comprises a negative pressure mechanism, one end of the negative pressure mechanism is communicated with the inside of the detection box body, and an air outlet end of the negative pressure mechanism is connected with a power sample pretreatment mechanism. The invention has the beneficial effects that the cycle of identifying and detecting the pathogenic bacteria of the critical infection and drug sensitivity can be shortened, the survival rate of the critical infection patients can be improved, the device has certain linkage, and the whole structure design is ingenious.

title_en: Incubator
abstract_en: The application provides an incubator, which comprises a incubator body, an inner door and an outer door, wherein the inner door and the outer door are arranged on the incubator body, the inner door and the outer door can be independently opened and closed, when the outer door and the inner door are closed, the inner door is positioned between the incubator body and the outer door, a rotary door lock is arranged on the inner door, the rotary door lock comprises a rotary handle, a locking block and a locking block shaft pin fixed on the inner door, the locking block is rotatably arranged on the locking block shaft pin, and the rotary handle is arranged on the locking block. Compared with the existing rotary door lock which is directly arranged on the inner door in a rotatable mode, the locking block can rotate around the locking block shaft pin, and the locking block shaft pin is fixed on the inner door, so that the possibility and frequency of rotation of the rotary handle relative to the inner door can be reduced, the stability of the rotary door lock structure is improved, and the possibility of falling off from the inner door after the rotary door lock is used for a period of time is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of long-term stable passage mouse nasopharyngeal epithelial cell line
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a long-term stable passage mouse nasopharyngeal epithelial cell line, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a mouse nasopharynx part tissue, extracting and separating primary mouse nasopharyngeal epithelial cells, purifying the nasopharyngeal epithelial cell line through time digestion difference, and culturing the primary mouse nasopharyngeal epithelial cells for a long time by using NEC culture medium added with growth factors such as Wnt3a, R-spondin, noggin and the like. The method provided by the invention can stably proliferate the nasopharyngeal epithelial cells of the mice for a long time, and maintain high proliferation activity without the tendency of EMT transformation. The invention provides a valuable cell tool for researching nasopharyngeal epithelium related diseases and making treatment strategies.

title_en: Application and method of reagent for activating expression of endogenous gene of dendrobium candidum or activating expression of endogenous gene of dendrobium candidum in improving dendrobium candidum alkali content
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a reagent for activating the expression of an endogenous gene of dendrobium candidum or activating the expression of the endogenous gene of dendrobium candidum in improving the content of dendrobine and a method thereof, and particularly belongs to the technical field of dendrobine production. The reagent for activating the expression of the endogenous gene of the dendrobium candidum or activating the expression of the endogenous gene of the dendrobium candidum is applied to the promotion of the content of the dendrobium candidum alkali, wherein the endogenous gene comprises HMGR, MCT, STR and CYP94C1, and the reagent for activating the expression of the endogenous gene of the dendrobium candidum comprises sgRNA, an expression cassette, a vector or a host cell. According to the invention, by activating the expression of the dendrobium candidum endogenous genes HMGR, MCT, STR and CYP94C1, the improvement of the dendrobine yield can be realized, the improvement of the dendrobine content in dendrobium candidum plants can be realized, and an effective way is provided for diversification of dendrobine biological sources.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain secreting clotrimazole monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hybridoma cell strain secreting a clotrimazole monoclonal antibody and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of immunodetection. The monoclonal antibody secreted by the hybridoma cell strain has good sensitivity and specificity to clotrimazole, wherein the IC  50  value of the clotrimazole is 7.386ng/mL, the monoclonal antibody has good sensitivity, and has good specificity without cross reaction to functional analogues of the clotrimazole, such as miconazole, econazole, ketoconazole, bifonazole, sertaconazole and the like. Therefore, the clotrimazole monoclonal antibody secreted by the hybridoma cell strain can accurately detect the clotrimazole with low concentration.

title_en: Culture device
abstract_en: A culture device is provided having a base with a first surface and a second surface fixedly disposed relative to the first surface and a flexible sidewall extending from the base and defining an interior volume of the device, the first surface and the second surface not being coplanar.

title_en: Methanopyrrole engineering bacteria for high yield of fermentable sugar, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a methanotrophic genetically engineered bacterium for high yield of fermentable sugar, and a construction method and application thereof, belonging to the technical fields of metabolic engineering and synthetic biology. The methanotrophic bacteria Methylotuvimicrobium buryatense 5GB1、Methylomicrobium alcaliphilum 20Z、Alkalicoccus glycogenes WONF2802 or extracellular polymeric methane figure tile microzyme (Methylotuvimicrobium sanxanigenens) NG09 is used as host bacteria, and the genes for producing fermentable sugar are expressed in the host bacteria by genetically modifying sugar metabolic pathways in the host bacteria, so that the methanotrophic genetically engineered bacteria for producing the fermentable sugar with high yield are constructed. The methanotrophic genetically engineered bacterium uses methane as the only carbon source and energy source to produce fermentable sugar, can provide a new low-carbon biosynthesis way for the commercial production of the fermentable sugar, and has good industrial and agricultural application prospects.

title_en: Method for determining reaction time in sequencing and sequencing method and system
abstract_en: A sequencing method and a sequencing system, wherein the sequencing method comprises the steps of (1) reacting target nucleic acid fixed on the surface of a chip with a polymerization reagent, doping nucleotide or nucleotide analogue to obtain a reaction product, (2) detecting a fluorescent signal, (3) reacting the reaction product with a regeneration reagent to obtain a product capable of carrying out the next polymerization reaction, (4) repeating the steps (1) to (3), and the like, and carrying out multiple cycles to finally obtain sequencing data, wherein the reaction time in at least one of the steps (1) and (3) is calculated by a predetermined cycle number-reaction time relation.

title_en: Making method of oat ice cream
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of oat ice cream, which relates to the technical field of ice cream preparation and comprises the following steps of adding target amounts of drinking water and pure oat flour into a temperature-controlled stirring tank, stirring and boiling the drinking water and the pure oat flour while heating the drinking water and the pure oat flour to form oat paste, adding target amounts of white granulated sugar, continuously stirring and boiling the oat paste, stirring and cooling the oat paste to 25-35 ℃, adding target amounts of strains and stirring the oat paste at a constant temperature to obtain ice cream slurry, extracting the ice cream slurry from the temperature-controlled stirring tank by a material distributing mechanism, injecting the ice cream slurry into an ice cream mold, placing the ice cream mold injected with the ice cream slurry on a belt type conveying mechanism, conveying the ice cream mold injected with the ice cream slurry into a working cabinet for constant temperature fermentation for a certain time, regulating the temperature of the working cabinet after fermentation, enabling the ice cream slurry to be frozen and molded in the mold to obtain oat finished products, and monitoring the overall temperature of ice cream raw materials in the temperature-controlled stirring tank by using the principle of an ideal gas state equation to ensure the raw material preparation effect.

title_en: Soybean MYC2-like transcription factor gene GmMYC3 and application of soybean MYC2-like transcription factor gene and KASP marker thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a soybean MYC2-like transcription factor gene GmMYC3 and its KASP marker. Application of soybean MYC2-like transcription factor gene GmMYC3 in genetic engineering modification of soybean resistance to foliar pests. The over-expression of the gene can obviously improve the resistance of soybean to spodoptera litura and spodoptera frugiperda. The gene is knocked out, so that the insect resistance of soybean can be weakened.
