The genetic variation of the GmMYC3 promoter shown in SEQ ID No.3 and the application of the KASP marker developed by the genetic variation in soybean insect-resistant breeding. And determining the insect resistance of the soybean by detecting whether the genotype of deoxyribonucleotide at 4451695bp position of chromosome 7 in soybean genome to be detected is CC or TT, wherein the insect resistance of the soybean to be detected with the CC genotype is higher than that of the soybean to be detected with the TT genotype.

title_en: Dendritic cell vaccine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, relates to a dendritic cell vaccine, a preparation method and application thereof, and in particular relates to a dendritic cell vaccine based on enhancement of dendritic cell maturation and vaccine efficacy and application thereof in tumor treatment. The dendritic cells are the dendritic cells deleted by the metabotropic glutamate receptor 4 or the dendritic cells treated by the forskolin, can promote the expression of costimulatory molecules on the surfaces of the dendritic cells, promote the proliferation of T cells, induce the effector T cells to secrete interferon gamma and granzyme B, and enhance the killing capacity of the T cells on tumor cells. The dendritic cell vaccine comprises dendritic cells loaded with antigens, wherein the antigens are liver cancer cell lysates. The dendritic cell vaccine has an anti-tumor effect and can be used for preparing anti-tumor medicines.

title_en: Method for transforming tea tree somatic embryo and obtaining transgenic plant based on gene gun mediation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for transforming tea tree somatic embryos and obtaining transgenic plants based on gene gun mediation, which belongs to the technical field of tea tree breeding and comprises the following steps of bombarding a vector containing a target gene into tea tree somatic embryos by using a gene gun method to obtain transgenic somatic embryos; then inoculating the transgenic somatic embryo to a somatic cell induction culture medium for culture to obtain a secondary embryo, inoculating the secondary embryo to a maturation induction culture medium for culture to obtain a cotyledon embryo, inoculating the cotyledon embryo to a germination induction culture medium for culture to obtain a seedling with germinated buds, and inoculating the seedling with germinated buds to a basic growth culture medium for culture to obtain a transgenic tea plant. The method has the beneficial effects that the transformation period is shorter, the method can be better suitable for the biological characteristics of tea trees, and the method has higher application value. The invention provides an effective technical approach for the construction of a genetic transformation system of tea trees and has wide popularization and application potential.

title_en: Enzyme variants and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to a method of hydrolyzing a terephthalic acid monoester, the method comprising exposing the terephthalic acid monoester to a polypeptide having MHETase activity under conditions sufficient to enable the polypeptide to convert the terephthalic acid monoester to terephthalic acid and an alcohol, wherein the terephthalic acid monoester is not mono (2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate.

title_en: Kit for detecting camel-derived components based on RAA-CRISPR/Cas12a method, detection method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular biology detection of food safety, and discloses a kit for detecting camel-derived components based on a RAA-CRISPR/Cas12a method, a detection method and application. The detection method comprises the following steps of carrying out RAA amplification on detection source components, adding amplification products into a CRISPR/Cas12a system for reaction, carrying out fluorescence observation on CRISPR/Cas12a reaction products, and determining that the result is positive when fluorescence appears. Using the crRNAs of the present invention, detection results can be obtained within 1 hour at specific Cas12a protein to crRNA concentrations and ratios, and FQ-ssDNA probe concentrations. In the invention, the minimum detection limit can reach 1 pg/mu L of DNA, camel DNA can be successfully detected in the mixed meat product with 1% adulteration proportion, and an efficient tool is provided for the authenticity detection of the meat product.

title_en: Culture medium for vascular endothelial progenitor cells, culture method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, in particular to a culture medium for vascular endothelial progenitor cells, a culture method and application, the invention improves the culture medium for vascular endothelial progenitor cells, the vascular endothelial progenitor cells prepared by the method have higher proliferation activity and better angiogenesis capacity, and have the strongest secretion capacity of promoting active factors. And the factors such as IL-10, TGF-beta and the like secreted by the EPCs have the functions of potentially inhibiting mast cell degranulation and reducing histamine and inflammatory mediator release, thereby relieving wind mass and pruritus. In addition, EPCs promote endothelial cell proliferation by secreting factors such as VEGF and Ang-1, repair damaged vascular endothelium, and reduce vascular leakage and edema. In urticaria vasculitis, EPCs can inhibit vascular endothelial hyperplasia and relieve chronic inflammation. The culture medium can be used for culturing vascular endothelial progenitor cells, is favorable for screening potential drugs for treating urticaria, and has great application value.

title_en: Fir chloroplast SNP molecular marker and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fir chloroplast SNP molecular marker and application thereof. The invention develops a fir chloroplast SNP molecular marker combination for individual identification of fir, which comprises 60 fir chloroplast SNP loci, and the primer pair capable of specifically amplifying the chloroplast SNP molecular marker combination is used for amplifying a fir variety to be detected, and then sequencing is carried out to obtain the SNP sequence of the characteristics of the fir variety to be detected. Therefore, the SNP molecular marker and the amplification primer thereof developed by the invention can accurately and efficiently identify the fir sample, and provide technical support for protecting and utilizing high-quality fir individual resources.

title_en: Microbial agent for preventing and treating tomato fusarium oxysporum caused tomato fusarium wilt and promoting plant growth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microbial agent for preventing and treating tomato fusarium oxysporum caused tomato fusarium wilt and promoting plant growth, which comprises microbial flora constructed by five strains of bacillus amyloliquefaciens, bacillus bailii, paenibacillus polymyxa, bacillus megaterium and bacillus subtilis. The synthetic flora provided by the invention can effectively antagonize fusarium oxysporum (Fusarium oxysporum), the inhibition rate of the synthetic flora can reach 64-99%, the inhibition capacity of the synthetic flora is obviously better than that of single strain A, B, C, D, E, and the biomass of tomatoes can be obviously improved.

title_en: Application of double-cavity probiotics intervention in colon cancer chemotherapy and intestinal tract and genital tract flora
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of double-cavity probiotics in colon cancer chemotherapy and intestinal tract and genital tract flora, and relates to the technical field of biological medicine. The long subspecies NCU-05 of bifidobacterium longum has been preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms for 1 month 18 of 2023 with a preservation number of CGMCC No.26492, and the Lactobacillus crispatus NCU-28 has been preserved in the China general microbiological culture collection center with a preservation number of CGMCC No.31387 for 7 months 22 of 2024. The invention has the beneficial effects of improving intestinal tract and genital tract dysbacteriosis after colon cancer chemotherapy and being used as an auxiliary drug for treating colon cancer. The long subspecies of bifidobacterium and lactobacillus crispatus are effective in improving intestinal and genital flora imbalance after colon cancer chemotherapy in combination administration through the "bidirectional crosstalk of intestinal-vaginal microbiota" cavity tract.

title_en: New esterases and their use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel esterases and more particularly to esterase variants having improved activity and/or improved thermostability compared to the esterase of SEQ ID n°1 and their use for degrading polyester-containing materials such as plastic articles. The esterases of the invention are particularly suitable for degrading polyethylene terephthalate and materials containing polyethylene terephthalate.

title_en: Papain peptide efficient extraction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protein peptide extraction, and discloses a papain peptide efficient extraction process, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, cleaning immature green papaya, slicing, inactivating endogenous enzymes at high temperature, placing the papaya slices subjected to high temperature treatment into enzymolysis equipment for stirring and enzymolysis, then leading out liquid and residual liquid generated by extrusion of solid residues through the enzymolysis equipment, separating and purifying the liquid through a centrifugal machine to obtain crude extract, performing ultrafiltration separation on the crude extract to obtain high-purity peptide liquid, and finally concentrating, spraying and drying the high-purity peptide liquid to obtain papain peptide powder. The papain peptide prepared by the method has high enzymolysis degree, improves the utilization rate of solid residues and papain peptide in the enzymolysis process, and further improves the yield and extraction efficiency of papain peptide powder.

title_en: Composite synergistic cleanup additive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of a drainage aid, in particular to a composite synergistic drainage aid and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite synergistic drainage aid comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 6-10% of dodecyl dimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride, 2-4% of enzymolysis sodium lignin sulfonate, 1-3% of diethylenetriamine, 0.4-1.2% of a first additive, 0.2-0.4% of a second additive, 0.1-0.3% of a protective agent, 0.1-0.3% of a regulator and the balance of water. According to the invention, after the sodium lignin sulfonate is subjected to cellulase directional enzymolysis, the density of sulfonic acid groups is increased, so that the effect of inhibiting particle aggregation can be achieved, meanwhile, the residual cellulose in a molecular chain can be degraded, the molecular weight is reduced, and the exposure of sulfonic acid groups is increased, so that the water solubility and the dispersion capacity of the sodium lignin sulfonate are improved, solid particles in a stratum can be better dispersed, the blocking of pore channels is prevented, and the usability of the cleanup additive is effectively improved.

title_en: InDel molecular marker related to green leaf pigment content of non-heading Chinese cabbage, primer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an InDel molecular marker related to the green leaf pigment content of non-heading Chinese cabbage, a primer and application thereof, wherein the primer sequence of the InDel molecular marker is shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 2. The InDel molecular marker is obtained according to the InDel mutation design of an exon located in BraC g052220 gene. The InDel molecular marker primer pair provided by the invention is obviously related to the green leaf color and chlorophyll and carotenoid content of the non-heading Chinese cabbage, can be used for molecular auxiliary breeding and high-quality germplasm resource identification of the non-heading Chinese cabbage, and accelerates the creation of high-quality materials of the non-heading Chinese cabbage and the breeding process of new varieties.

title_en: Nucleic acid aptamer screening method by utilizing lanthanide metal to induce in-situ phase separation and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer screening method by utilizing lanthanide metal to induce in-situ phase separation and application thereof, relating to the technical field of nucleic acid aptamer screening, wherein the invention utilizes lanthanide metal ion Gd  3+  to effectively separate nucleic acid aptamer in solution from a random single-stranded DNA library by phase separation, successfully develops a PS-SELEX method, effectively improves library fixation and efficiency in the nucleic acid aptamer screening process, further, cd  2+  and Fe  2+  are respectively taken as research objects, a PS-SELEX technology is adopted, random single-stranded DNA library and Gd  3+  are utilized to self-assemble to form nano particles, in-situ phase separation of a nucleic acid aptamer library is realized, and two nucleic acid aptamer sequences capable of respectively and specifically recognizing Cd  2+  and Fe  2+  are obtained through multiple rounds of forward screening and reverse screening of corresponding interfering ions, so that a theoretical basis is provided for efficient screening of high-affinity nucleic acid aptamers.

title_en: Primer group for detecting important drug resistance genes and virulence genes of multi-drug resistant pathogenic bacteria and application of primer group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-flux targeted sequencing, in particular to a primer group for detecting important drug resistance genes and virulence genes of multi-drug resistant pathogenic bacteria and application thereof. The detection primer is used for detecting various drug-resistant bacteria such as third-generation cephalosporin drug-resistant enterobacteriaceae bacteria, carbapenem drug-resistant acinetobacter baumannii, rifampicin drug-resistant mycobacterium tuberculosis and the like. The invention has the technical advantages of high speed, high efficiency, strong targeting, strong specificity and the like, is suitable for the epidemic and difference analysis of various important drug resistance genes and virulence genes carried by metagenomic samples of various environments or disease materials and the like, evaluates the risk of the related environments on the basis, and can also further guide the preventive and clinical treatment medication.

title_en: Gene-edited hematopoietic stem cells and combined application of hematopoietic stem cells and CAR-T cells
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods of altering an epitope of a cell and cells made using the methods. Also provided herein are methods and pharmaceutical compositions for treating tumors using the cells in combination with CAR-T cells or antibodies. Cells with altered epitopes are not killed by CAR-T or antibody drugs and can be infused into patients to alleviate the side effects of CAR-T products or antibody drugs in tumor therapy.

title_en: Specific primer pair for identifying bupleurum chinense and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a specific primer pair for identifying the authenticity of turtle blood bupleurum and application thereof. The specific primer B-ACT can be amplified in the bupleurum DNA extracted from turtle blood to obtain 167bp target fragment, the primer B-HBA can be amplified in the bupleurum DNA extracted from turtle blood to obtain 113bp target fragment, the primer B-COI can be amplified in the bupleurum DNA extracted from turtle blood to obtain 142bp target fragment, and the primer B-CYT can be amplified in the bupleurum DNA extracted from turtle blood to obtain 147bp target fragment. The PCR method can accurately detect whether the turtle blood bupleurum contains the turtle blood component. The identification method is accurate and quick, and has higher specificity in identifying the bupleurum mixed product of the turtle blood bupleurum and the common animal blood processed bupleurum.

title_en: Imaging structure for cell sorting, cell sorting equipment and cell sorting method
abstract_en: The application discloses an imaging structure for cell sorting, cell sorting equipment and a cell sorting method, and belongs to the technical field of cell culture. The imaging structure comprises an illumination light source and an imaging module, wherein the illumination light source is configured to be arranged at a preset height position, the illumination light source is defined with a channel through which a pipette passes, the pipette can pass through the channel to move towards the direction close to the container or away from the container, the imaging module is opposite to the illumination light source and is used for imaging a target position of the container from the lower part of the container, the illumination light beam emitted by the illumination light source can at least illuminate the target position, and the pipette can move to the target position of the container according to the output result of the imaging module to suck and/or spit target cells. The application can accurately identify the position of the cloned cells and improve the accuracy of the selection of the cloned cells.

title_en: Protein separation method and related application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protein separation method and related application thereof, relating to the technical field of dairy product processing, the method comprises heating whey solution with pH value regulated to 3.5-4.2 by citric acid solution, carrying out microfiltration on the heated product, separating beta-lactoglobulin and/or alpha-lactalbumin from permeate liquid and retentate liquid obtained by the microfiltration, the method is based on a membrane filtration technology, realizes high-purity separation of the beta-lactoglobulin and the alpha-lactalbumin, has the purity of more than 70-90%, is compatible with whey of various sources, has the advantages of low separation cost, high efficiency, easiness in implementation, large flux and the like, and provides a way for large-scale industrial production of the beta-lactoglobulin and the alpha-lactalbumin.

title_en: Conversion of biomass-derived hydrocarbon feedstock to produce adipic acid
abstract_en: Disclosed is a process for converting biomass to adipic acid comprising, in order, a) a step of treating biomass to produce ethanol and CO  2 , b) a step of converting ethanol obtained at the end of step a) to obtain 1, 3-butadiene, c) a step of synthesizing adipic acid from 1, 3-butadiene obtained at the end of step b) and CO  2  obtained at the end of step a).

title_en: Preparation method of snow pear wine brewed by double-bacteria fermentation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of brewing, and particularly relates to a preparation method of snow pear wine by double-bacteria fermentation. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, cutting mature snow pear fruits into small pieces after removing fruit pits, squeezing juice, filtering to obtain pear juice, S2, adding pectase into the pear juice in S1, carrying out enzymolysis at room temperature, adding white granulated sugar into the pear juice to adjust the sugar degree and the pH value, S3, carrying out SO  2  color protection treatment, adjusting the concentration of SO  2  in filtrate to obtain pear juice, sequentially adding non-saccharomyces cerevisiae NS-D into pear wine, adding saccharomyces cerevisiae VL-2, activating, inoculating to obtain fermentation liquor, S4, fermenting the fermentation liquor obtained in S3 to obtain finished snow pear wine, and adjusting the fermented snow pear wine to obtain the double-bacteria fermented snow pear wine.

title_en: ZmbHLH103 protein and application of encoding gene thereof in regulation and control of corn heat resistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to ZmbHLH103,103 protein and application of a coding gene thereof in regulation and control of heat resistance of corn. The invention discovers that the corn ZmbHLH gene can positively regulate and control the heat resistance of plants, and can effectively increase the heat resistance of the plants by over-expressing the expression quantity of the ZmbHLH gene 103. The discovery of the heat resistance function of ZmbHLH genes provides new gene targets and resources for cultivating heat-resistant plant varieties, has important significance for researching the heat-resistant molecular mechanism of corn, and lays a certain theoretical foundation for researching the mechanism of plants responding to high temperature stress and resisting the molecular mechanism of adverse environments.

title_en: Antibodies to Porphyromonas gingivalis and methods of use
abstract_en: The present invention provides monoclonal antibodies and methods of use thereof for diagnosing and/or treating Porphyromonas gingivalis infections and/or chronic diseases caused by or associated with such infections. The invention also identifies specific antigen-antibody reaction regions on the outer membrane protein of Porphyromonas gingivalis and is useful for developing vaccines for prevention and treatment. The monoclonal antibodies of the invention cross-react with different antigenic regions of different Porphyromonas gingivalis outer membrane proteins. The invention also provides animal models and diagnostic kits for serological evaluation, prognosis and treatment effect evaluation after Porphyromonas gingivalis infection.

title_en: Anti-carcinoembryonic antigen-associated cell adhesion molecule 1 (CEACAM 1) antibodies that inhibit Neutrophil Extracellular Trap (NET) -mediated activity
abstract_en: Pharmaceutical compositions comprising anti-CEACAM 1mAb and their use in inhibiting NET-mediated activity and in preventing and treating pathologies associated with these activities are provided and exemplified by mAb CM24 which also has been shown to be effective in inhibiting cancer cell migration and NET-induced platelet aggregation. Also presented are NET-biomarker based prognostic methods for use in patient selection and monitoring treatment efficacy.

title_en: Cell culture surfaces and vessels and methods of making and using the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to coated surfaces suitable for cell culture, methods for preparing such surfaces, and methods for culturing adherent cells on such surfaces. One aspect of the present disclosure is a surface suitable for cell culture that includes an amorphous hydrogenated carbon coating. Another aspect of the present disclosure is a method for preparing a surface suitable for cell culture comprising an amorphous hydrogenated carbon coating. Another aspect of the disclosure is a method for culturing adherent cells, the method comprising incubating a surface comprising an amorphous hydrogenated carbon coating with adherent cells and a growth medium.

title_en: Kit for detecting thyroglobulin gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biological detection, in particular to a kit for detecting thyroglobulin genes and application thereof. The application comprises a composition for detecting thyroid cancer cervical lymph node metastasis, wherein the composition comprises a specific detection primer pair aiming at thyroglobulin genes, the primer pair comprises an upstream primer and a downstream primer, and the sequences of the upstream primer and the downstream primer are shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-2. The kit primer probe is designed in a stable degradation-resistant area of RNA, has higher detection sensitivity for low-quality RNA samples, reduces the false negative of detection, improves the overall detection performance, defines a positive judgment value by delta Ct through one-step multiple qPCR, has an accuracy of 98.6 percent, has a definite positive judgment value, and is convenient for clinical application.

title_en: Specific primer for distinguishing rice from barnyard grass and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a specific primer for distinguishing rice from barnyard grass and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological species identification. The sequences of the specific primers are shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 2. According to the invention, the specific primer is designed according to the ITS sequence of the nuclear gene of rice, the specific primer can accurately identify the rice by PCR, the identification method is stable, the detection time is short, the specificity is strong, the detection limit is low, the method is not influenced by material properties, the rapid and accurate identification of the rice and barnyard grass can be realized, and the problem that the method for effectively and rapidly distinguishing the rice from the barnyard grass is lacking at present is solved.

title_en: Momordica grosvenori residue and silage corn stalk fermented feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed preparation, in particular to a siraitia grosvenorii residue and silage corn stalk fermented feed and a preparation method thereof, wherein the feed comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of siraitia grosvenorii residue, 30-40 parts of corn stalk, 30-40 parts of concentrated feed, 0.1-0.5 part of composite probiotic preparation and 0.5-1 part of flavoring agent. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1, raw material pretreatment, namely screening fresh and sterile Momordica grosvenori residues, corn stalks and concentrated feed as raw materials, pouring the pretreated raw materials into a stirring device, S2, raw material fermentation, namely adjusting the internal temperature of the stirring device to 30-35 ℃, pouring a composite probiotic preparation into the stirring device, mixing the raw materials with the composite probiotic preparation by using the stirring device for 10-15min, standing for 5-7d after the mixing is completed, and obtaining the fermented raw materials, S3, obtaining finished products, namely stirring the fermented raw materials for 10-15min by using the stirring device, and S4, and checking and storing the finished products. The invention can improve the intake of the siraitia grosvenorii residue and reduce the preparation cost.

title_en: OpgG and application of mutant thereof in human milk oligosaccharide production
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to OpgG and application of mutants thereof in human milk oligosaccharide production. The invention provides a glucan biosynthesis protein OpgG mutant, which is obtained by mutating 443 th amino acid from threonine to proline on the basis of a wild glucan biosynthesis protein OpgG shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The opgG gene and/or T443P mutant coding gene are introduced into human milk oligosaccharide production strain, and the gene is applied to human milk oligosaccharide production, so that the yields of 3'-SL, 6' -SL, LNT II, LNnT and LNT are greatly improved.

title_en: Application of soybean isoflavone synthetic gene GmCHI a in improving resistance of plants to phytophthora sojae
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, in particular to application of a soybean isoflavone synthetic gene GmCHI a in improving resistance of plants to phytophthora sojae. The soybean isoflavone synthesis gene GmCHI a has CDS sequence shown in sequence table SEQ ID NO.2, and the application includes constructing plant expression vector with the gene GmCHI a and transferring into target plant to make the gene GmCHI a over-express in the plant. The plant expression vector is transformed and then carries RUBY visual screening markers. The method has the advantages that GmCHI a over-expression can obviously improve the isoflavone content in hairy roots and strengthen the defense effect on the phytophthora sojae, and can be applied to the wide resistance of different physiological races of the phytophthora sojae.

title_en: Application of sunflower HaIAA gene in improving abiotic stress tolerance of plants
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant abiotic stress tolerance, and discloses application of sunflower HaIAA gene in improving plant abiotic stress tolerance. According to the invention, the sunflower HaIAA gene is connected with the plant over-expression vector, and the sunflower is transformed by using an agrobacterium infection method, and the result shows that the physiological state of the sunflower infected and transformed by the HaIAA gene under salt stress and drought stress is obviously better than that of the wild sunflower, so that the sunflower HaIAA gene can obviously improve the salt tolerance of transgenic plants. The invention provides theoretical basis and gene source for transforming or cultivating new varieties of crops such as other salt-tolerant sunflowers, and is helpful for radically improving the salt tolerance of crops.

title_en: Chimeric antigen receptor targeting CD45 and application thereof in hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chimeric antigen receptor targeting CD45 and application thereof in hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, and relates to the technical field of biological medicine. The invention takes the space epitope of the CD45 antigen as a target point, connects the scfv region, the transmembrane region and the intracellular signal domain of the CD45 antibody in series, and carries out structural optimization transformation on the scfv region, the transmembrane region and the intracellular signal domain, thereby greatly reducing the immunogenicity of CAR molecules, prolonging the duration of CAR-T cells in vivo, effectively eliminating hematopoietic stem cells in host bone marrow, being applicable to marrow cleaning pretreatment before hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and providing a new strategy for transplantation pretreatment. Accordingly, due to the advantages of low immunogenicity and the like, an effective prevention strategy is provided for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation related complications such as graft versus host disease.

title_en: Lactobacillus casei paracasei for regulating host local secretion type immunoglobulin and systemic immunoglobulin to enhance anti-infection capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Lactobacillus paracasei strain for regulating host local secretion type immunoglobulin and systemic immunoglobulin to enhance anti-infection capability, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The cheese bacillus paracasei has the effects of reducing vaginal mucosa injury and inhibiting vaginal inflammation, and is specifically characterized by (1) improving the expression of a human body polymerized immunoglobulin receptor gene, (2) promoting the secretion of human body secretory immunoglobulin sIgA, (3) promoting the secretion of human body immunoglobulin IgG, (4) reducing the secretion of human body granulocyte colony stimulating factor, (5) inhibiting the secretion of TNF-alpha, promoting the secretion of IL-10, (6) improving the pathological characterization of the human body and (7) improving glycogen staining characterization after fungal infection of the human body. Therefore, the lactobacillus paracasei has great application prospect in products for improving vaginal mucosa injury and inhibiting vaginal inflammation.

title_en: Anti-ubiquitinyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medical biology, and relates to an anti-lysyl oxidase family nanobody or antigen binding fragment and application thereof. The anti-pan LOX family nano antibody or antigen binding fragment comprises three complementarity determining regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3, wherein the amino acid sequence of the CDR1 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 1-SEQ ID NO:8, the amino acid sequence of the CDR2 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 9-SEQ ID NO:17, and the amino acid sequence of the CDR3 is shown as one of SEQ ID NO: 18-SEQ ID NO: 26. The invention screens the library by using a flow panning method to finally obtain the anti-human/mouse anti-pan LOX family nano antibody gene sequence. The anti-pan-LOX family nano antibody has the advantages of small molecular weight, high affinity and better specificity. Has good prospect for diagnosing fibrosis.

title_en: Biomarker for nephrotic syndrome, analysis method and kit
abstract_en: The biomarker, the analysis method and the kit for the nephrotic syndrome are disclosed, can be effectively used for diagnosing the nephrotic syndrome, and have high sensitivity and accurate and reliable results. Such biomarkers for nephrotic syndrome comprise mRNA, protein and enzyme activity levels of lactate dehydrogenase B.

title_en: Dynamic perfusion control system and method for endoscope microorganism culture agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of endoscopic microorganism culture, and discloses a dynamic perfusion control system and a method of an endoscopic microorganism culture agent, wherein the system comprises a multichannel data acquisition module, a multichannel data acquisition module and a control module, wherein the multichannel data acquisition module is used for acquiring multidimensional culture agent parameters containing concentration distribution, perfusion rate and metabolites in real time, and the concentration distribution data comprises first environment distribution data generated by a multi-area perfusion device and second dynamic feedback data acquired by an optical sensor array; the dynamic regulation and control module carries out gradient balance correction processing on parameters and inputs the parameters into a perfusion analysis processing layer for feature modeling, the perfusion analysis processing layer comprises a data preprocessing module and an environment modeling module, the environment modeling module comprises an environment parameter fusion layer, a gradient balance layer and a perfusion decision layer which are sequentially connected, and finally, a perfusion regulation and control instruction is generated according to an output result. The invention realizes the real-time monitoring and dynamic accurate regulation of multidimensional parameters and improves the quality and efficiency of the endoscopic microorganism culture.

title_en: Erigeron breviscapus modhephene synthase EbMDS and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides erigeron breviscapus modhephene synthase EbMDS and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biosynthesis. The amino acid sequence of the erigeron breviscapus modhephene synthase EbMDS comprises an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, or a functional homologous sequence with at least 75% sequence similarity with the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, or an amino acid sequence which is formed by adding, deleting and replacing one or more amino acids in the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1 and has the same function as a protein formed by the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The coding gene comprises a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2 or a complementary sequence, a degenerate sequence or a homologous sequence of the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention integrates the coding gene of the erigeron breviscapus modhephene synthase EbMDS into a vector and introduces the vector into a host cell, so that the coding gene is expressed in the host cell, and the biosynthesis of modhephene is realized.

title_en: Acid-resistant sulfate reducing bacteria and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to acid-resistant sulfate reducing bacteria and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The acid-resistant sulfate reducing bacteria are Desulfovibrio desulfuricans QY411,411, and are deposited in the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at 2024, 3 and 14 days, and the deposition number is GDMCC No:64412. The invention provides an acid-resistant sulfate reducing bacterium which can survive in an environment with pH of 4, and can be applied to ecological reconstruction of acid tailings and soil in a soil discharge field, wherein the pH of soil and surface water in mining waste land after ecological reconstruction is obviously increased, the concentration of SO  4   2‑  in the soil is obviously reduced, and the acidification process in the soil in mining waste land is effectively inhibited, SO that the acidification process in the mining waste land is effectively controlled. Meanwhile, the heavy metal pollution of soil is reduced, and the vegetation growth is recovered.

title_en: Quorum sensing quenching strain Dan Quanhai source strain from hydrothermal solution and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a quorum sensing quenching strain Dan Quanhai source bacterium from a hydrothermal source and application thereof, wherein the screened strain can inhibit pathogenic bacteria and is used for preparing antibacterial medicines, and the preservation number of the screened Dan Quanhai source bacterium is CCTCC NO: M20251224. The invention also provides an AHL degrading enzyme Aii937 protein separated from YESM strain, which is characterized in that the amino acid sequence of the protein is SEQ ID NO. 2. The YESM strain can block the QS channel of pathogenic bacteria through AHL lactonase Aii937, reduce the secretion of virulence factors of the pathogenic bacteria, and the strain YESM is free from pathogenicity. AHL lactonase has no broad spectrum and strong substrate specificity, and only degrades C  6  -HSL and 3OC-C  14  -HSL.

title_en: Xylanase derived from rhizoctonia thermophila and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bioengineering, and relates to xylanase derived from rhizoctonia thermophila and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the enzyme is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The nucleotide sequence of the gene encoding the enzyme is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The xylanase provided by the invention can specifically degrade xylan without damaging a fiber structure, maintains activity under an alkaline high-temperature condition, can reduce the dosage of ClO  2  in pulp pretreatment, and shows good bleaching-assisting effect.

title_en: Methylation marker combination for diagnosing or predicting gastric cancer, application, kit and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a methylation molecular marker combination for diagnosing or predicting gastric cancer, which consists of the following 2 methylation molecular markers respectively positioned in human OLIG2 and FERD L genes, wherein the methylation molecular markers are chr21:33025814-33026014 and chr7:19145345-19145545, and the specific positioning is carried out through hg 38. The invention also discloses application of the methylation molecular marker combination, a related kit and an analysis processing program recorded by a computer readable storage medium. The methylation level of OLIG2, FERD L genes is used as a marker for early diagnosis or prediction of gastric cancer, and enriches the choices of the technicians in this field.

title_en: Application of combined up-regulated SNRK gene and GSK3B gene expression level in preparation of non-small cell lung cancer resistant medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of up-regulating SNRK gene and GSK3B gene expression level in preparing medicines for resisting non-small cell lung cancer. The nucleotide sequences of mRNA of SNRK genes and mRNA of GSK3B genes are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-2. The invention discloses a key role of combining up-regulation SNRK and GSK3B mRNA expression level in proliferation and migration of non-small cell lung cancer for the first time. Experimental results show that compared with the strategy of independently transfecting exogenous SNRK mRNA expression plasmid or exogenous GSK3BmRNA expression plasmid, the strategy of jointly transfecting SNRK-OE and GSK3B-OE exogenous expression plasmid designed by the invention can remarkably inhibit proliferation and migration capacity of tumor cells. The synergistic effect suggests that SNRK and GSK3B mRNA can be used as novel anti-tumor targets, and the mode of jointly up-regulating SNRK and GSK3B mRNA expression levels can be used as a novel non-small cell lung cancer treatment method, so that theoretical basis is provided for drug development of non-small cell lung cancer.

title_en: Preparation method and application of pseudorabies virus gB protein
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of pseudorabies virus gB protein, and relates to the technical field of biology. The preparation method comprises the step of culturing CHO cells expressing pseudorabies virus gB protein in a fed-batch culture mode, wherein a basic culture medium for fed-batch culture comprises a CD CHO 045 culture medium, and the fed-batch culture medium is a CD Feed 002 culture medium. The preparation method solves the problem of high production cost of the pseudorabies virus gB protein in the prior art, and improves the yield of the pseudorabies virus gB protein.

title_en: Humanized bifidobacterium animalis probiotic bacterial strain and application thereof in preparation of medicines for preventing or treating atopic dermatitis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of probiotics and application thereof, and in particular relates to a humanized animal bifidobacterium probiotic strain and application thereof in preparing a medicament for preventing or treating atopic dermatitis. The preservation number of the humanized animal bifidobacterium is GDMCC No:65044, the preservation unit is simply GDMCC, and the active metabolite secreted by the strain comprises acetate. The bifidobacterium animalis is derived from intestinal tracts of healthy individuals, can normally survive in the intestinal tracts of human bodies, has no toxic or side effect, and has higher safety. In addition, the strain can build a microorganism-immune cell co-culture platform in an organism, and can effectively improve the type 2 immune inflammation of an AD patient by regulating and controlling Th1/Th2 immune balance. By targeting the protective strain which complements the patient's absence, it helps to provide new means of control for AD patients.

title_en: Pantoea ananatis Pa-6 and application thereof as Sang Qing blight biocontrol bacteria and bacterial fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention provides Pantoea ananatis Pa-6 and application thereof as Sang Qing biological control bacteria and bacterial fertilizer for a blight. Pantoea ananatis Pa-6 is preserved in the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at 2025, 6 and 19 days, and the preservation number is GDMCC NO:66555. The strain has good antagonism to Sang Qing bacterial strain of Lawsonia of Solanaceae, can be used for preventing and controlling Sang Qing bacterial strain, can promote the germination of mulberry seeds, has the capability of decomposing potassium, producing auxin and producing siderophores, can promote the growth of the mulberry, and has important value in the aspect of developing microbial fertilizers with the effects of preventing and controlling Sang Qing bacterial strain and promoting growth.

title_en: Special starter for traditional Chinese medicine ferment and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special ferment for traditional Chinese medicine enzymes and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. The special ferment for the traditional Chinese medicine ferment comprises paenibacillus and leuconostoc mesenteroides, wherein the preservation number of the paenibacillus is CPCC S230232, and the preservation number of the leuconostoc mesenteroides is CICC 22264. The special starter prepared by compounding paenibacillus and leuconostoc mesenteroides according to a specific ratio and applying the starter to fermentation of a specific traditional Chinese medicine composition, the traditional Chinese medicine ferment prepared by fermentation is found to have the effect of obviously improving polycystic ovary syndrome, and has important significance for treating polycystic ovary syndrome and infertility caused by polycystic ovary syndrome.

title_en: Method for improving secretory expression swollenin of bacillus subtilis and application of method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving secretory expression of swollenin by bacillus subtilis and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. According to the invention, firstly, bacillus subtilis G600 capable of successfully secreting and expressing bacillus subtilis source swollenin BsEXLX1 is constructed, the expression level of swollenin protein is enhanced in the strain through a strong promoter P  21 , and secondly, the optimal RBS and signal peptide combination is screened, so that the high-efficiency secretory expression of swollenin is optimized, and finally, the secretory expression level of BsEXLX1 is improved by 3.5 times. The transformation method provided by the invention can realize the secretion expression of the swollenin, lays a foundation for the metabolic engineering transformation of bacillus subtilis to promote the biosynthesis of the swollenin, and has good application prospect. The recombinant strain constructed by the invention has stable expression of the produced swollenin protein and high extracellular secretion, and the construction method is simple and convenient to use, thereby laying a foundation for further large-scale industrial production of swollenin.

title_en: Application of SNP molecular marker related to goat milk production traits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of molecular biology and genetic breeding, and provides application of SNP molecular markers related to goat milk production traits. The marker contains a polymorphic site with A or G as the base at the 100 th bp of the sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1 of the goat VPS13C gene, is specifically positioned at the 55079372 th bp of chromosome 10 of a goat reference genome (ARS 1.2), is A > G base mutation (rs 662659918), and is positioned in the first intron of the VPS13C gene. Experiments show that the SNP molecular marker developed by the invention is obviously related to the goat milk production character, and the SNP molecular marker can be applied to goat milk production character molecular marker breeding. The molecular marker provided by the invention is not limited by the age, sex and the like of goats, can be used for breeding excellent dairy goat varieties, and can obviously promote the breeding process of the excellent dairy goat varieties.

title_en: Quick detection method for influenza A virus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid detection method of influenza A virus, which relates to the technical field of molecular diagnosis, and HAs the technical scheme that the method comprises the following steps of carrying out reverse transcription and enzymatic recombination amplification on RNA of the influenza A virus by utilizing an RT-ERA technology, designing specific primers and probes for membrane proteins (MA) or Hemagglutinin (HA) conserved regions of four subtypes H1N1, H3N2, H5N1 and H7N9 of the influenza A virus, completing detection within 20 minutes under the condition of 40 ℃, and ensuring no cross reaction with other subtypes of the influenza A virus, influenza B virus, adenovirus, novel coronavirus, dengue virus and the like, wherein the method not only improves the speed and accuracy of detecting the important subtypes of the influenza A virus, but also reduces the dependence on equipment and technicians, ensures that the detection is more convenient and rapid in-situ, is suitable for carrying out rapid and rapid-control of influenza A virus resources in a basic layer or a lack of a laboratory, and provides a rapid experiment for the risk prevention and control of the influenza A virus.

title_en: Anti-CD 1A antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof capable of binding CD1 a. The antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof may be chimeric or humanized and may be used to treat one or more inflammatory skin or mucosal disorders or diseases, or one or more related systemic diseases or disorders, or one or more systemically expressed inflammatory drug responses, or CD1a expressing malignancies.

title_en: Trichoderma asperellum-bacillus synthetic flora and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides Bacillus cereus which is named as Bacillus cereus and is registered and preserved in the Guangdong province microorganism strain preservation center, wherein the preservation number is GDMCC NO:66395. The invention also provides a synthetic flora containing the bacillus cereus and trichoderma asperellum (Trichoderma asperellum) MM7. The synthetic flora constructed by bacillus cereus and trichoderma asperellum (Trichoderma asperellum) MM7 has a better effect of promoting banana plant growth, can be used for preparing mixed microbial agents or microbial fertilizers, is beneficial to improving the economic benefit of banana planting industry, and has wide application space in green and sustainable development of banana industry.

title_en: Microfluidic isothermal amplification method and system based on multichannel spectrum detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microfluidics, in particular to a microfluidic isothermal amplification method and a microfluidic isothermal amplification system based on multichannel spectrum detection, comprising the steps of adding a sample and a reaction premix to a microfluidic chip to form a reaction liquid; the reaction premix is added with at least two fluorescent probes, isothermal amplification reaction is carried out on the reaction liquid, spectrum time sequence data is collected in the reaction process, spectrum deconvolution is carried out on the spectrum time sequence data, and independent amplification curves corresponding to the fluorescent probes are obtained respectively and are quantitatively analyzed. Aiming at the problems that the reaction amplification quantitative system in the prior art depends on a high-precision quantitative PCR instrument and an optical component and has higher cost, the spectrum deconvolution mode is introduced to separate the independent amplification curves of all the fluorescent probes on the calculation level, thereby omitting an expensive PCR instrument, reducing the requirements on the color filtering and detection precision of the optical component and being applicable to detection scenes with wider wave bands.

title_en: Method for improving volume yield and hydrogen production rate of clostridium anaerobic fermentation hydrogen and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving volume yield and hydrogen production rate of clostridium anaerobic fermentation hydrogen and application thereof. The method is characterized in that biochar is added into a dark fermentation medium for anaerobic fermentation to obtain hydrogen. The method can make clostridium adsorb on the surface and inside of biochar, and avoid direct contact of clostridium with high concentration glucose-containing culture medium to a certain extent, thereby reducing inhibition of high concentration glucose and improving hydrogen production rate and glucose utilization rate. In addition, the biochar is alkaline after being dissolved in water, so that the rapid drop of the pH value of a culture system can be relieved. Meanwhile, the porosity of the biochar is developed, and organic acids such as acetic acid and butyric acid generated by partial glucose metabolism can be adsorbed, so that the inhibition effect of the organic acids on hydrogen production is relieved, and the hydrogen production rate and the glucose utilization rate are improved. In addition, the method has the characteristics of low cost, simple and convenient operation and the like, and is easy to realize large-scale industrial application.

title_en: Erythritol fermentation method for using accelerator
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and provides a use method of an erythritol fermentation promoter, which comprises the following steps of culturing to obtain candida lipolytica seed liquid; the method comprises the steps of fermenting erythritol for a first period, fermenting for 22-26 hours, wherein the components of a fermentation medium comprise 10-12 g/L of fermentation accelerator, the components of the fermentation accelerator comprise 20-22 parts of urea, 30-40 parts of trehalose, 1.4-1.6 parts of inositol, and pumping 130-160 g/L of glucose to a fermentation tank for one-time fermentation until the total sugar concentration of fermentation is 300-320 g/L in a fermentation period, and continuing fermentation to obtain erythritol. In conclusion, the fermentation promoter is added to improve the tolerance capability and metabolic activity of thalli to hypertonic environment, the activity of key enzymes such as erythritol reductase and the like, and glucose is added to high concentration after thalli enter a logarithmic phase, so that the thalli are stressed to produce sugar alcohol with high osmotic pressure, the fermentation period can be effectively shortened, and the erythritol conversion rate can be improved.

title_en: Strategy for ROSA26 safe harbor site knock-in
abstract_en: RNA molecules comprising a guide sequence portion having 17 to 50 consecutive nucleotides of the sequence shown in any of SEQ ID nos. 1 to 25686, and compositions, methods and uses thereof.

title_en: Temperature-control plaster based on outer vesicles, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crossing of a traditional Chinese medicine transdermal preparation and medical equipment, in particular to a temperature control plaster based on an outer vesicle, a preparation method and application, wherein the temperature control plaster based on the outer vesicle comprises a layered structure from outside to inside, namely a back lining layer, a heating layer, an isolation layer and a medicine layer, and has the beneficial effects that the salvia miltiorrhiza-pseudo-ginseng outer vesicle is extracted efficiently by a polyethylene glycol precipitation method, and the extraction efficiency and the active ingredient preservation rate are high; the external vesicle is prevented from being damaged by high temperature through the layered temperature control structure, the temperature of a medicine layer is ensured to be stable in an optimal treatment range, the external vesicle is slowly released through the porous starch microsphere carrier, the stable slow release and targeted delivery of the medicine are realized, the action time is prolonged, a dual treatment mechanism of 'quick anti-inflammatory-long-acting repair' is established through the synergistic effect of the external vesicle and active ingredients of the traditional Chinese medicine, the targeted treatment of bone joint diseases such as cervical spondylosis, lumbar disc herniation and the like is realized, and the multi-effects of anti-inflammatory and analgesic, tissue repair promotion, microcirculation improvement and the like are achieved.

title_en: Separation detection method for intestinal bacteria neonatal outer vesicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separation and detection method of intestinal bacteria neonatal outer vesicles, which comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out metabolic labeling on microorganisms to be researched by using an azido-modified D-type amino acid metabolic marker to enable the neonatal bacteria outer vesicles to carry azide groups, (2) separating and extracting the bacteria outer vesicles from a sample containing the bacteria outer vesicles, (3) adding a capture connector capable of reacting with the azide groups into the extracted bacteria outer vesicles, and (4) separating, capturing and detecting the bacteria outer vesicles obtained in the step (3) by using a microfluidic chip, wherein the obtained bacteria outer vesicles are the neonatal bacteria outer vesicles. The method can selectively capture the nascent bacterial outer vesicles from the sample under the condition of not affecting the expression of the bacterial outer vesicle surface protein so as to carry out downstream analysis on the intestinal flora nascent bacterial outer vesicles.

title_en: Biomarker for evaluating adhesion degree of tuberculous pleural effusion pleura and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and discloses a biomarker for evaluating the pleural adhesion degree of tuberculous pleural effusion (Tuberculous pleural effusion, TPE) and application thereof. The present invention provides a biomarker for assessing the degree of pleural adhesion of tuberculous pleural effusion, the biomarker comprising dsDNA (double-stranded DNA) in pleural effusion. The biomarker can be used for diagnosing TPE more conveniently and economically, and further evaluating the severity of pleural adhesion of a TPE patient, so as to guide clinical anti-tuberculosis and anti-adhesion treatment.

title_en: Neutralizing monoclonal antibody aiming at pig delta coronavirus S1 protein conserved linear epitope and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neutralizing monoclonal antibody aiming at a pig delta coronavirus S1 protein conserved linear epitope and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. The amino acid sequence of the light chain of the neutralizing monoclonal antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO.9, and the amino acid sequence of the heavy chain is shown as SEQ ID NO. 13. The invention utilizes an insect baculovirus expression system to express the S1 protein of the pig delta coronavirus, screens out linear epitopes with neutralization effect, and harvests a neutralizing monoclonal antibody. The monoclonal antibody can generate neutralization reaction with a plurality of pig delta coronaviruses, and has strong neutralization activity and high potency. The neutralizing monoclonal antibody can realize the high-efficiency control of the porcine delta coronavirus. The invention provides a new way for diagnosing and preventing and treating the pig delta coronavirus and provides a theoretical basis for the development of related medicaments and vaccines.

title_en: CRISPR-Cas13 system and application thereof in targeting Ebola virus VP40 to inhibit virus replication
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and discloses a CRISPR-Cas13 system and application thereof in inhibiting virus replication by targeting Ebola virus VP 40. The invention solves the technical problem of inhibiting the replication of ebola virus. The CRISPR-Cas13 system for inhibiting the replication of the Ebola virus disclosed by the invention contains crRNA, and the target sequence of the crRNA is SEQ ID No.2 in a sequence table. Experimental results prove that the crRNA can target the genome sequence of the Ebola virus, reduce the protein level of the virus gene, and degrade the targeted virus gene, thereby inhibiting the replication capacity of the virus. The crRNA and the CRISPR-Cas13 system composed of the crRNA can be used for treating and/or preventing diseases caused by ebola virus.

title_en: Tumor neoantigen polypeptide aiming at BRD4: NUTM1 gene fusion mutation and application of tumor neoantigen polypeptide in NUT cancer treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tumor neoantigen polypeptide aiming at a BRD4: NUTM1 gene fusion mutation and application thereof in NUT cancer treatment, wherein the tumor neoantigen polypeptide is (1) a tumor neoantigen polypeptide with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No.2, and (2) a polypeptide with the same or similar function obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding at least one amino acid in the amino acid sequence. The antigen peptide can stimulate and activate human body specific T cells aiming at the BRD4: NUTM1 gene fusion mutation in vitro, and perform large-scale amplification for adoptive feedback treatment of patients, has obvious immunogenicity, improves the killing capacity of the T cells on NUT cancer cells with the BRD4: NUTM1 gene fusion mutation, can be synthesized in a large scale, and can be used for standardized and individualized immunotherapy of patients with subsequent BRD4: NUTM1 fusion mutation tumors.

title_en: Plasmid DNA extraction kit based on anion exchange column and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a plasmid DNA extraction kit based on an anion exchange column and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biology. The invention provides a plasmid DNA extraction kit based on an anion exchange column, which comprises an anion exchange column, a lysis buffer solution group, a balance buffer solution, a washing buffer solution and an elution buffer solution, wherein the anion exchange column comprises a solid phase extraction empty column, an upper sieve plate and a lower sieve plate which are arranged at the inner side of the empty column and are positioned at the bottom of the empty column, and an anion exchange ligand filled between the upper sieve plate and the lower sieve plate, and the anion exchange ligand comprises diethylaminoethyl dextran gel DEAE-A50 and diethylaminoethyl cellulose DE52. The invention adopts domestic filler and optimized filler ratio as anion exchange ligand, the cost is only 1/20-1/40 of imported product, and the operation time and labor intensity are saved by gravity flow purification process, and the obtained plasmid has high yield and equivalent transfection effect to the commercial kit.

title_en: KASP molecular marker primer combination for detecting peanut late blight resistance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a KASP molecular marker primer combination for detecting peanut late blight resistance and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of peanut molecular breeding. The molecular marker linked with the anti-late blight trait can be used for detecting the genotype of peanuts so as to judge whether the material has the late blight resistance, and by high-throughput genotyping detection, manpower and material resources are greatly saved, the detection is not influenced by environmental factors, the result is accurate and reliable, the molecular marker can be used for early screening of peanut late blight resistant varieties, the breeding period can be shortened, and the breeding efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Construction of random library of promoter, high-throughput sequencing and transcription strength analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a random library of promoters, and analyzing high-throughput sequencing and transcription intensity. The invention establishes a flow and an implementation method for rapidly researching the relative transcription intensity of a large number of promoters in a random promoter library, rapidly constructs the random promoter library by a random primer method, and simultaneously analyzes the transcription intensity of a large number of promoters by deep sequencing of random tags carried by plasmid DNA and transcribed mRNA. The promoter library construction, sequencing and analysis flow can rapidly obtain the transcription strength of promoters with different sequences in high flux, and obtain a promoter library with ideal transcription strength span. The method is rapid and efficient, and can obtain the transcription strength of massive promoter sequences.

title_en: Novel biological preservative based on deep sea barophilic bacteria and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims at solving the problem of complex extraction process of active ingredients, and provides a novel biological preservative based on deep-sea barophila and a preparation method thereof, wherein the novel biological preservative comprises an active ingredient A, an active ingredient B and a microcapsule carrier, wherein the active ingredient A is a cyclic lipopeptide compound separated from deep-sea barophila sp.DP-2022-01 fermentation liquor, the molecular formula is C  34 H 58 N 5 O 7 , the active ingredient B is halogenated fatty acid separated from deep-sea barophila Shewanella sp.DP-2022-03 fermentation liquor, the molecular formula is C  15 H 20 C 1 O 2 , and the microcapsule carrier is a gelatin-acacia composite wall material, and the mass ratio is 1:1. The broad-spectrum antibacterial property is remarkable, namely the active component A (cyclic lipopeptides) can inhibit gram-positive bacteria (such as Listeria monocytogenes) by destroying the integrity of bacterial cell membranes, the active component B (halogenated fatty acid) can interfere with bacterial energy metabolism to inhibit gram-negative bacteria (such as escherichia coli), and the antibacterial rate of the active component A and the halogenated fatty acid to fungi such as staphylococcus aureus, candida albicans and the like can reach more than 95 percent.

title_en: Application of NAT10 regulation shaft in copper death of tumor cells
abstract_en: The application discloses application of an NAT10 regulation shaft in copper death of tumor cells. According to the application, the NAT10 can promote copper death in colorectal cancer by catalyzing ac4C modification of DLAT mRNA, and promote AARS1 to combine with NAT10 or inhibit SIRT1 to combine with NAT10, so that NAT10-K426 can be promoted to be lactated, copper death is finally caused, and the increased lactate of NAT10-K426 not only promotes NAT10 phase separation, but also enhances catalytic capability of DLAT MRNA AC C. In addition, the reduction of soluble DLAT during copper death can further enhance the lactonization of NAT10-K426, which results in replenishment of DLAT levels, forming a positive feedback loop that promotes copper death. The application discloses a novel copper death mechanism and provides a novel treatment approach for copper death-related tumors (such as colorectal cancer).

title_en: Metering water method for improving fragrance of sauce wine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a twice water metering method for improving the fragrance of Maotai-flavor liquor. After steaming, the grains are first supplemented with hot water in 85-90% of total water demand, spread and dried to 30-38 deg.c, and then compounded with composite bacteria liquid and solvent to prepare secondary water, the rest 10-15%. The composite bacterial liquid is compounded by bacillus licheniformis, bacillus subtilis and pichia pastoris. The secondary water is completed before the spreading and airing are completed, so that bacillus is preferentially colonized, excessive production of wine by yeast is inhibited, and accumulation of fragrance precursors is promoted. The implementation result shows that the number of bacillus in fermented grains is improved, the sensory scores of the main wine are averagely improved by 3-5 rounds, the tetramethylpyrazine is increased, the process is compatible with the traditional 12987 flow, and the popularization is easy.

title_en: Sortase A transpeptidase mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Sortase A transpeptidase mutant and application thereof in the technical field of bioengineering, wherein the Sortase A transpeptidase mutant is obtained through single mutation or double mutation on the basis of a protein sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.2, the protein sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.2 is a 60-206 truncated mutant made on wild type Sortase A transpeptidase shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the Sortase A transpeptidase mutant provided by the invention has higher yield, activity and thermal stability and wider application conditions. In addition, the invention also introduces a cysteine at the C end of the Sortase A transpeptidase mutant protein, and fixes the Sortase A transpeptidase mutant on the magnetic beads by utilizing the principle of sulfydryl covalent coupling so as to realize the application value of the Sortase A transpeptidase mutant in protein labeling.

title_en: Device for monitoring dielectric property change in single cell electroporation process
abstract_en: A device for monitoring dielectric property change in single cell electroporation process comprises a signal generator I, a signal generator II, a signal generator III, a signal adder, a microfluidic chip, a syringe pump, a microscope and a host. The invention provides a device for monitoring dielectric property change in a single cell electroporation process, which can realize the integration of capturing, rotating, perforating and monitoring of single cells, so that the relationship between pulse dose and ablation effect is explored at the single cell level. The microfluidic chip provided by the invention has four electrodes, can apply various types of electric fields required, has no mutual interference with the electric fields, realizes three processes of capturing, rotating and perforating single cells, simultaneously generates three electric fields of different amplitudes, frequencies and waveforms of DEP capturing, IRE ablating and ROT scanning on the same chip, and avoids mutual crosstalk. The invention forms a single-cell dielectric database and provides individuation basis for IRE preoperative planning and postoperative evaluation.

title_en: Extraction method for separating aroma-producing bacteria from litchi and application of aroma-producing bacteria in tobacco
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aroma-producing bacteria extraction, and discloses an extraction method for separating aroma-producing bacteria from litchi and application of the extraction method to tobacco, which comprises the following steps: S1, selecting fresh litchis without diseases and insect pests, peeling peel, weighing pulp, shearing, adding sterile water to prepare pulp suspension diluted by 10 times, placing in a shaking table, oscillating for 30min at 30 ℃ and 200r/min, and standing for 10min to prepare the gradient diluent. The extraction method for separating the aroma-producing bacteria from the litchi and the application of the aroma-producing bacteria in tobacco can enhance the market competitiveness of products and relieve the current situation of high-end cigar raw materials in China. Thirdly, the technology provides new microbial aroma-enhancing resources and technical directions for the tobacco industry, is based on the principle of microbial fermentation to induce the conversion of organic matters of tobacco leaves, can be expanded to the quality improvement of other tobacco varieties, promotes the technical innovation of improving the quality of raw materials by the industry through the bioengineering technology, and has the potential of standardized production and large-scale application.

title_en: Preparation method of tetanus full-length toxoid molecule inactivated by genetic engineering technology and application of tetanus full-length toxoid molecule as vaccine antigen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a tetanus full-length toxoid molecule inactivated by a genetic engineering technology and application of the tetanus full-length toxoid molecule as a vaccine antigen, and belongs to the field of biological pharmacy. The technical problem solved by the invention is how to obtain a novel tetanus whole-molecule vaccine with enhanced immune effect and improved protective efficacy. The preparation method of the tetanus full-length toxoid molecule comprises the steps of introducing an expression vector containing ddmTT protein coding genes into microorganisms to express and purify the coding genes to obtain the tetanus full-length toxoid molecule, wherein ddmTT protein is ddmTT protein shown in SEQ ID No. 6. The tetanus full-length toxoid molecule (ddmTT) prepared by the invention has the advantages of no toxicity, high safety, low production cost, strong immunogenicity, high protection efficacy and quick effect, and can be used as a novel vaccine for preventing tetanus toxin poisoning, a novel immunogen and a novel carrier molecule of a conjugate vaccine.

title_en: Method for preparing chiral alcohol by asymmetric reduction of large-steric-hindrance rigid ketone based on aldehyde ketone reductase and mutant thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biosynthesis, and in particular relates to a method for preparing chiral alcohol by asymmetric reduction of large-steric-hindrance rigid ketone based on aldehyde ketone reductase and mutant thereof, which comprises the following steps: adding recombinant escherichia coli wet thalli expressing aldehyde ketone reductase, recombinant escherichia coli wet thalli expressing formate dehydrogenase, buffer solution, substrate, cosolvent, ammonium formate and coenzyme into a reaction container, reacting at a certain temperature, and obtaining the product alcohol after extraction, separation and rotary evaporation after the reaction is completed. The biocatalysis method disclosed by the invention is mild in reaction condition, environment-friendly, high in regioselectivity and stereoselectivity, and capable of avoiding chiral resolution and heavy metal residues in products and exactly compensating for the defects of a chemical method.

title_en: Amaranth plant species identification method based on high-throughput sequencing data
abstract_en: The invention provides a amaranth plant species identification method based on high-throughput sequencing data. The invention screens specific variation regions in amaranthus chloroplast genome based on a high-throughput sequencing data system, combines Pi value screening and specific variation region marking, and develops a standardized fast identification flow of amaranthus plant species. Compared with the traditional DNA bar code fragment, the identification precision of the targeted specific mutation region is obviously improved, so that species with highly overlapped morphology can be effectively distinguished, and the identification accuracy is improved. Meanwhile, the method greatly reduces the technical threshold and cost, and the PCR amplification is carried out on the DNA of the sample to be detected by designing the specific primer targeting the specific variation region, so that the whole genome sequencing and assembly are avoided, the single sample detection cost and detection period are reduced, and the method is compatible with a conventional PCR platform, so that the on-site rapid detection of scenes such as medicinal material markets, customs ports and the like is possible.

title_en: Application of high cadmium-resistant strain Cd2 in promotion of repair of heavy metal pollution by aster drillifolium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbiology, and particularly relates to application of a high cadmium-resistant strain Cd2 in promoting repair of heavy metal pollution of aster ageratoides. A strain Cd2 with high cadmium resistance is named as pseudomonas aeruginosa Pseudomonas aeruginosa in taxonomic classification, and the preservation number is GDMCC No.64110. The method identifies the screened strain through morphological observation, gram staining and 16S rRNA sequence sequencing, inoculates high cadmium-resistant strain Cd2 in soil during the growth period of the super-enriched plant aster, and researches the influence of Cd2 on the growth and enrichment of the super-enriched aster. As a result, when the high cadmium-resistant strain Cd2 is inoculated into the soil of the aster ageratum, the cadmium absorption and the total cadmium accumulation of the lower part and the upper part of the aster ageratum are obviously increased, and the technical support of strengthening the super-enriched plant restoration is provided.

title_en: Preparation method of single-cell sequencing suspension fixedly stored in situ
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of single-cell sequencing suspension which is fixedly stored in situ. The invention provides a digestive juice for preparing single-cell suspension, which is a solution composed of collagenase II and neutral protease. The invention also provides a kit containing the digestive juice. The invention provides application of the digestive juice in preparing a kit and application of the kit in-situ fixing and preserving cells and preparing single-cell suspension. The invention also provides a preparation method for in-situ fixedly preserving cells and single-cell suspension and the single-cell suspension prepared by the preparation method.

title_en: Bacillus jemi-Paenibacillus BZG-2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides bacillus jemi-de-ac BZG-2 and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention provides a Paenibacillus jemi (Paenibacillusjamilae) BZG-2 with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M2024978. The Bacillus jemmyaki BZG-2 has the ability to produce IAA and siderophores. The Bacillus jemi-like BZG-2 has good antibacterial effect on the pathogenic bacteria of the leaf spot of tinospora and the pathogenic bacteria of the leaf spot of Polygonatum sibiricum. The Bacillus jemi-Paenibacillus BZG-2 not only can promote the growth of the radix tinosporae, but also can effectively prevent and control the leaf spot of the radix tinosporae. The bacillus jemi-de-ac BZG-2 provided by the invention provides a more efficient and environment-friendly solution for the biocontrol growth promotion of traditional Chinese medicinal materials.

title_en: Synthesis method of Fmoc-L- (4, 4-difluorocyclohexyl) glycine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of synthesis of unnatural amino acid, and particularly discloses a synthesis method of Fmoc-L- (4, 4-difluorocyclohexyl) glycine.
