A synthesis method of Fmoc-L- (4, 4-difluorocyclohexyl) glycine comprises the steps of reacting 4, 4-difluorocyclohexanone with Z-alpha-phosphonoglycine trimethyl ester and DBU to generate a compound 1, catalyzing the compound 1 by palladium-carbon, hydrogenating the compound 2 at normal pressure, carrying out acetylation reaction on the compound 2 and acetic anhydride, pulping and purifying to obtain a compound 3, carrying out alkaline hydrolysis reaction on the compound 3 to obtain a compound 4, carrying out acetylase hydrolysis on the compound 4 to obtain a compound 5, carrying out reaction on the compound 5 and Fmoc-Osu, and carrying out pulping and purifying to obtain a target product. The synthesis scheme of the application has the advantages of cheap and easily obtained raw materials, mild reaction conditions and easy purification, and is suitable for the large-scale production in laboratories and factories.

title_en: Method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid, and relates to the technical field of microbial culture. The method comprises the steps of inoculating NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 mycelia into a medium containing pruned branches of the nectarines for culturing, wherein the medium is MM medium, and specific formulas are 1.52: 1.52 g/L potassium dihydrogen phosphate, 0.52: 0.52 g/L magnesium sulfate, 6: 6 g/L sodium nitrate and 0.52: 0.52 g/L potassium chloride. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, and provides good conditions for the production of tea stain acid by optimizing the formula of a fermentation medium and adding walnut pruning branches into the medium, improving the fermentation conditions and increasing the content of the tea stain acid in NEMANIA SP YAFEF hyphae.

title_en: Biomarker for colorectal cancer diagnosis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a biomarker for colorectal cancer diagnosis and application thereof. The invention proves that STAM gene is abnormally high expressed in colorectal cancer cells or tissues through researches. In vitro functional experiments show that inhibiting the expression level of STAM2 can inhibit the proliferation capacity of colorectal cancer cells. At the same time, inhibition of STAM's 2 expression can inhibit the growth of colorectal cancer tumors in mice. The results jointly indicate that STAM < 2 > can be used as a novel diagnosis biomarker for colorectal cancer, is beneficial to early screening and early diagnosis of colorectal cancer, improves the screening detection rate of colorectal cancer, further realizes early intervention and early treatment, improves the survival rate of colorectal cancer and improves prognosis.

title_en: Small peptide for improving abiotic stress tolerance of crops and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology and plant science, and particularly relates to a small peptide for improving abiotic stress tolerance of crops and application thereof, wherein the small peptide is GDRP, and an amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention obviously improves the drought resistance of cotton by exogenously applying the small peptide GDRP. Based on a method combining bioinformatics analysis and molecular biological verification, the invention verifies the forward regulation and control action mechanism of GDRP small peptide under drought and salt stress for the first time, and reduces the transpiration rate by activating an MAPK signal path, thereby improving the drought tolerance of cotton, and providing theoretical basis and technical support for developing a novel crop stress regulator with green and high efficiency in the technical field of agricultural biology.

title_en: Primer probe composition for detecting high-incidence six cancers, detection kit and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primer probe composition for detecting high-incidence six cancers, a detection kit and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological detection, wherein the high-incidence six cancers are esophageal cancer, colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, liver cancer, lung cancer and pancreatic cancer, and the primer probe composition with complementary characteristics of OTOP/KCNA 3, septin9/SDC2/BCAT1, RNF180/BNC1/HYAL2/PLAC8 and SHOX2/PTGER4/RASSF1A genes is provided, so that more choices and research directions are provided for the detection of the high-incidence six cancers, and the detection is relatively comprehensive. The comprehensive sensitivity of the kit for detecting the methylation of the high-incidence six cancers is 90.00%, the specificity is 93.33%, and the kit can provide powerful references for clinical detection of the high-incidence six cancers.

title_en: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens YY-27 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacillus amyloliquefaciens (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens) YY-27 and application thereof, wherein the bacillus amyloliquefaciens YY-27 is preserved in China center for type culture collection, the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M2025178, the preservation date is 2025 and 16 days, the address is Wu Changou Italian university of Italian mountain road No. 16 of Wuhan in Wuhan, hubei province, china, the bacillus amyloliquefaciens (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens) YY-27 has certain reducing capability on nitrite, does not grow in PH9.6 broth, grows in brain heart infusion broth medium containing PH6.5 sodium chloride, does not decompose hydrogen sulfide, does not use glucose and lactose, does not generate urease, has biocontrol effect on Vibrio harveyi and sodium demand, has high protease production property, the protein band number below 63KDa in silkworm chrysalis powder is obviously increased through fermentation of YY-27, and the acid soluble protein content is obviously increased, and can reach the maximum 322.63mg/g on the second day of fermentation compared with the contrast group 23.22%.

title_en: Lachnellula arida source cutinase CutBJB for catalytic synthesis of fatty acid ethyl ester, coding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coding gene of a Lachnellula arida source cutinase CutBJB for synthesizing various fatty acid ethyl esters and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the cutinase CutBJB is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the coding gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. In particular discloses Lachnellula arida source cutinase CutBJB6 coding gene and construction of an escherichia coli expression vector carrying the gene, and simultaneously discloses application of Lachnellula arida source cutinase CutBJB in catalytic synthesis of ethyl butyrate, ethyl valerate, ethyl caproate, ethyl caprylate and ethyl caprate in an aqueous phase system. The invention provides a keratinase CutBJB from Lachnellula arida with water phase system fatty acid ethyl ester synthesis capability and a coding gene thereof.

title_en: KASP molecular marker linked to major site related to tobacco brown spot resistance and primer group thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a KASP molecular marker linked with a major site related to tobacco brown spot resistance and a primer group thereof, belonging to the field of biological molecule detection. The major site related to the resistance of tobacco brown spot is positioned at 74838959bp of chromosome 18, and the genotype of the major site is A or C. The invention provides a high-efficiency, simple and reliable reference mark for screening the resistance of the tobacco brown spot, and effectively improves the breeding and genetic improvement efficiency of the resistance molecule of the tobacco brown spot.

title_en: Nucleic acid shut-off switch, method and use thereof
abstract_en: Is characterized by compositions and methods of use of nucleic acids and vectors. In particular, the disclosure features nucleic acid compositions and methods related to the temporal modulation of expression of gene therapeutics comprising therapeutic transgenes. The disclosed compositions, methods and uses relate to gene and cell therapies.

title_en: Microbial agent culture equipment for crops
abstract_en: The invention discloses microbial inoculum culture equipment for crops, which belongs to the field of microbial culture and comprises an incubator, wherein an upper sealing cover is sleeved at the top of the incubator, a driving motor is fixedly connected to the top of the upper sealing cover, a transmission shaft is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, and a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the transmission shaft. Can realize that oxygen gets into the inside of bucket-shaped frame through first intake pipe, reentrant gas distribution pipe's inside, carry the inside of culture medium by the bleeder vent again, for the growth metabolism of microorganism supplements sufficient oxygen, compare in traditional culture apparatus inside direct access oxygen, oxygen not only can contact with the microorganism on culture medium shallow surface layer, can also contact with the microorganism of culture medium bottommost for the microorganism that is in the inside different degree of depth of culture medium can all contact with oxygen, effectively improves microorganism development progress, improves the output of microorganism.

title_en: Bacillus bailii and application thereof in preparation of ethyl laurate, farnesyl acetate and caprylic acid
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to bacillus behenryi and application thereof in preparation of ethyl laurate, farnesyl acetate and caprylic acid. The bacillus belicus Bacillus velezensis is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) No. 36155 at the 10 th month 13 of 2025, and the preservation unit address is China national academy of sciences of China No. 3 of the Seiyusa No. 1 of the Chaiyang area North Star of Beijing city, and ethyl laurate, farnesyl acetate and octanoic acid can be obtained by fermenting sugarcane juice. After the subsequent extraction, the method can be used for industrial production.

title_en: Lipase mutant capable of esterifying short chain fatty acid in water phase, construction method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of genetic engineering and enzyme engineering, in particular to a lipase mutant capable of esterifying short chain fatty acid in water phase, a construction method and application thereof. On the basis of Burkholderia-derived lipase, two single-point mutations H24T, A M and a double-point combined mutant H24T-A191M are obtained through screening. The mutant can catalyze the esterification reaction of isoamyl alcohol and acetic acid under the condition of high water activity, and the esterification product is less affected by hydrolysis. Compared with natural lipase, the mutant obtained by the invention is more suitable for industrial production, especially for removing fusel oil and Chen Lingyu in white spirit, and has good application prospect and industrial value.

title_en: Cordyceps sinensis strain and application thereof in preparing anti-neutron radiation medicines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hepialus lepidoptera strain and application thereof in preparing neutron radiation resistant medicines, wherein the strain is a hepialus lepidoptera strain P969 (Samsoniella hepiali), is preserved in China center for type culture collection, the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M20251172, the preservation date is 2025-05-26, and hypha extract of the strain can protect biological tissues against neutron radiation, repair organ damage caused by the neutron radiation, has a wide development space and has good development and application prospects.

title_en: Molecular marker related to siniperca chuatsi high-sugar feed utilization character and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular marker related to the utilization character of siniperca chuatsi high-sugar feed and application thereof. The molecular marker is positioned on a siniperca chuatsi No. 7 chromosome, the molecular marker contains 1 SNP locus slc25a11-1, the SNP locus slc25a11-1 is positioned at the 1439370 th base of the siniperca chuatsi No. 6 chromosome, and the polymorphism locus is T/C. By implementing the molecular marker, the utilization condition of the high-sugar feed of siniperca chuatsi seeds can be obviously improved, so that the feed cost is reduced and the cultivation benefit is increased.

title_en: Microbial agent for improving glycogen content of oyster
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of microbial agents, and particularly relates to a microbial agent for improving the glycogen content of oyster. The microbial agent for improving the glycogen content of the oyster is prepared by the method that the functions of the several microorganisms are complementary, the synthesis of glycogen is increased through the synergy of immunity and metabolism, the consumption of the glycogen is reduced, the glycogen synthesis efficiency in the oyster is enhanced, the glycogen content of the oyster is improved, and an innovative solution is provided for the quality improvement and the synergy of oyster cultivation.

title_en: Automatic cell culture system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic cell culture system and a control method, wherein the system comprises a cell culture device, a perfusion device and a spectrum analysis device, the cell culture device comprises a culture base and a plurality of functional tanks, wherein a stirring assembly and a liquid path interface are arranged on a cell culture bottle, the perfusion device comprises a peristaltic pump and a pinch valve and is used for accurate perfusion control, the spectrum analysis device comprises a light source, a spectrum detection assembly and a spectrum analyzer, the cell culture bottle is communicated with each tank through the liquid path interface, the peristaltic pump conveys cell liquid to the spectrum detection assembly, the spectrum analyzer carries out optical quantitative evaluation on cell liquid parameters under the light source and feeds the cell liquid parameters back to a controller, and the controller adjusts the speed/duration and the stirring rotating speed of the perfusion pump based on a dynamic strategy so as to optimize the cell growth environment.

title_en: Omega RNA for detecting brucella, fluorescent detection kit, visualization kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to omega RNA for detecting brucella, a fluorescent detection kit, a visual kit and application thereof. The omega RNA nucleotide sequence provided by the invention is shown as SEQ ID NO. 4. The omega RNA provided by the invention can specifically identify the Brucella bp26 gene, the combination TnpB protein has higher bypass cutting activity on an amplification product of the Brucella bp26 gene, and TnpB is used for cutting a nonspecific ssDNA report probe after the omega RNA identifies a target sequence, so that the Brucella can be detected by a fluorescent detection or nucleic acid detection test strip, and the Brucella has higher accuracy and sensitivity. The invention can detect Brucella at any time on the non-laboratory site by using the OMEGA-TnpB detection system, and has the characteristics of wide universality, low operation requirement, high efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Engineered anti-spike protein IgG3 antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to immunology and antibody engineering, and in particular to engineered antibodies with improved properties and methods of hinge engineering for improving properties of, for example, igG1 antibodies. More specifically, the invention provides engineered antibodies comprising an IgG3 subclass specific domain and a variable domain having a viral spike protein binding portion.

title_en: Multifunctional active peptide derived from viscera of mackerel and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional active peptide derived from viscera of mackerel and application thereof. A single exogenous enzyme hydrolysis method is adopted to prepare a mackerel viscera extract, the extract has small molecular peptide with ACE inhibitory activity, three ACE inhibitory peptides are further identified and screened, amino acid sequences are GPPVPGP, GPMGPMGP and SPGPVGMP respectively, and half inhibitory concentration IC  50  values are 80.84 +/-1.12 mug/mL, 177.41 +/-3.26 mug/mL and 163.25 +/-3.46 mug/mL respectively. The heptapeptide GPPVPGP with optimal activity has the function of scavenging DPPH free radical and hydroxyl free radical, and can be used for auxiliary treatment for reducing hypertension or applied to other fields.

title_en: Fermentation process for producing maltose amylase by using bacillus subtilis
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of maltogenic amylase, and in particular discloses a fermentation process for producing maltogenic amylase by using bacillus subtilis. A fermentation process for producing the maltogenic amylase by using bacillus subtilis comprises the following steps of S1, seed culture, S2, fermentation culture, wherein the precultured strain obtained in the S1 is inoculated into a fermentation culture medium according to an inoculum size of 5-10%, and three-stage serial fermentation is carried out, wherein the three-stage serial fermentation comprises sequentially carrying out primary fermentation, secondary fermentation and three-stage fermentation, so that the maltogenic amylase is obtained. The fermentation process disclosed by the application improves the bacterial proliferation efficiency through multidimensional coordinated regulation and control, breaks through the enzyme activity expression capability, removes the inhibition of metabolites in the prior art, and enhances the process stability, thereby realizing the efficient collaborative improvement of the bacterial density and the enzyme activity, and improving the bacterial density to 52gDCM/L and the enzyme activity to more than 5200U/mL.

title_en: SgRNA combination for efficiently knocking out sheep MSTN gene and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an sgRNA combination for efficiently knocking out sheep MSTN genes and application thereof, belonging to the fields of genetic engineering and zootechnic genetic breeding. The sgRNA combination comprises sg-M2 and sg-M3, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the sg-M2 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the nucleotide sequence of the sg-M3 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. By utilizing the sg-M2 and sg-M3 sgRNA combination provided by the invention, offspring are obtained by microinjection of the sgRNA combination and Cas9 mRNA/protein into sheep embryo and embryo transfer. Through the genotype identification of offspring sheep, the MSTN gene editing efficiency reaches 100%, wherein the functional structural domain knockout efficiency can reach 80.0%. The invention can effectively reduce the preparation cost of MSTN gene knockout sheep and provides an effective means for rapidly creating new germplasm of double muscle buttock mutton sheep.

title_en: Cotton HD-Zip transcription factor GhHB2, coding gene and application thereof in improving cotton varieties
abstract_en: The invention provides a cotton HD-Zip transcription factor GhHB2, a coding gene and application thereof in improving cotton varieties, and relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. The invention provides an application of an HD-Zip transcription factor GhHB2 and/or a gene (GhHB 2GhHB 2) encoding the HD-Zip transcription factor GhHB in regulating cotton fiber quality and/or cotton breeding. The cotton HD-Zip transcription factor GhHB2 or the gene improves cotton fiber quality through negative regulation. The embodiment proves that the fiber is obviously prolonged after GhHB < GhHB > is knocked out in cotton, the micronaire value is obviously reduced, and the fiber strength is obviously enhanced. Therefore, the gene GhHB2GhHB2 can improve the fiber quality, can provide important gene resources for cultivating cotton varieties with excellent fiber quality, and has wide application value.

title_en: Electrophilic unnatural amino acid, preparation method and gene coding thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses electrophilic unnatural amino acid, a preparation method and gene coding thereof, belonging to the technical field of synthetic biology. The invention provides a chemical synthesis method of 5 unnatural amino acid compounds, and obtains aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA biological orthogonal pairs for identifying the unnatural amino acids, and the precise introduction of the aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA biological orthogonal pairs in specific sites of proteins is realized in escherichia coli by a codon extension technology. The electrophilic unnatural amino acids can be used as cysteine targeting warheads or bifunctional molecule tools, and have important application values in the fields of covalent inhibitor design, cyclopeptide construction and screening, protein interaction research, multifunctional structure assembly and the like.

title_en: Spread cultivation and recycling method of dry yeast for Bragg
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for expanding culture and recycling of dry yeast, which comprises the following steps of sequentially activating the dry yeast, carrying out primary expanding culture and secondary expanding culture to obtain high-activity yeast liquid, inoculating the high-activity yeast liquid into wort for main fermentation, recycling yeast mud after the main fermentation is finished, and recycling the yeast mud as an inoculum for the next production fermentation step after activity detection and pretreatment. The invention realizes the high-efficiency stability of the fermentation process of the lager beer and the high consistency of the flavor of the product through standardized intelligent expansion culture and accurate circulation management while greatly reducing the use cost of the yeast.

title_en: Recombinant bacillus amyloliquefaciens with high tyrosine yield and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a recombinant bacillus amyloliquefaciens with high tyrosine yield and application thereof, wherein the recombinant bacillus amyloliquefaciens takes bacillus amyloliquefaciens HZ12 as an initial strain, a gene engineering method is utilized to co-express a prephenate dehydrogenase mutant gene tyrAtyrA  M53I/A354V  and a DAHP synthetase gene aroAaroA through RBS sequences, and the expression of the recombinant bacillus amyloliquefaciens is optimized through a PgisB promoter, so that the yield of L-tyrosine is obviously improved. The L-tyrosine yield of the recombinant bacillus amyloliquefaciens is 1104.02 mg/L, which is improved by 2.77 times compared with a control strain.

title_en: Production method of lime-flavored fruit beer
abstract_en: The invention provides a production method of a green lemon flavored fruit beer, which comprises the steps of double-enzyme synergistic saccharification wort, a compound green lemon extract, a modified prebiotic compound and the like, wherein the compound malt is saccharified by double enzymes to improve the utilization rate, the green lemon peel seed realizes full resource utilization, the prebiotic is modified to ensure the activity, and yeast is an acid-resistant mutagenesis strain. The preparation method comprises the steps of customized saccharification, preparation of compound lime components, gradient pressure fermentation, compound clarification sterilization and the like, and the flavor generation is optimized through precise temperature control and pressure control. The green lemon fruit flavor and the malt flavor of the product are coordinated, the retention rate of vitamin C is more than 85%, the activity loss rate of prebiotics is less than or equal to 10%, and the product can be stably stored for 12 months at 3 ℃, and has good flavor and health value.

title_en: Child leukemia prognosis biomarker based on mitochondrial activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clinical molecular diagnosis and individuation tumor medicine, in particular to a group of children leukemia prognosis biomarkers based on mitochondrial activity and application thereof. The invention aims to provide a group of children leukemia prognosis biomarkers based on mitochondrial activity, which are used for quantifying mitochondrial metabolic activity of children B-ALL patients, can be used for early prediction of recurrence risk, evaluation of early curative effect and long-term prognosis and guidance of application of BCL-2 inhibitors or OXPHOS inhibitors, can be used as accompanying diagnostic markers for prediction of response of chemotherapy recurrence risk and targeting drugs (such as venetoclax), can be used as accompanying diagnostic tools for prediction of response of ALL risk stratification and metabolic targeting treatment (such as BCL-2 inhibitors), and has strong clinical popularization.

title_en: Infectious chicken anemia virus-like particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chicken infectious anemia virus-like particle, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention discloses a virus-like particle vaccine for preventing chicken infectious anemia, which comprises VP1 and VP2 proteins of chicken infectious anemia virus. According to the invention, baculovirus expression systems are utilized to express chicken infectious anemia VP1 and VP2 proteins, immunoblotting shows that the two proteins are successfully expressed in sf9 cells, and the expressed proteins can be automatically assembled into complete chicken infectious anemia virus-like particles through electron microscopy observation, so that the chicken infectious anemia virus-like particles have a similar space structure with original viruses, and meanwhile, the virus-like particles have the advantages of high titer, high safety, capability of stimulating humoral immunity, cellular immunity and the like. The preparation method is simple, can prepare a large amount of antigen proteins of chicken infectious anemia viruses, has high expression quantity and short time consumption, greatly reduces the production cost, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection primer set for chestnut solid rot germ Dai's Japanese sheath and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection primer group for a chestnut solid rot germ Dai Japanese sheath and application thereof. The invention designs two groups of loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection primer groups of the chestnut solid rot fungus Dai Japanese sheath, which are respectively a primer combination E1 and a primer combination U5. Experimental results show that the two groups of loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection primer groups and the loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection method for detecting the chestnut solid rot fungi Dairy Japanese shells by using the loop-mediated isothermal amplification detection primer groups have the characteristics of strong specificity, convenience in operation and the like, can realize rapid, accurate, safe and visual detection of the chestnut solid rot fungi in production practice, can be used for disease diagnosis and pathogenic bacteria identification of the chestnut after being picked, and provides reliable technical and theoretical basis for quality control of batch chestnut.

title_en: Soxhlet-like fungus hzt-3', and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a panus pseudowire (Talaromyces pseudofuniculosus) hzt-3' and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microbial application. The strain is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) No. M20251797, and classified and named (Talaromyces pseudofuniculosus) hzt-3'. The method comprises the following steps of collecting moss and vegetation soil samples from basalt, diabase and dolomite, separating and purifying bacterial strains by using Czapek culture medium for bacterial colonies in diluted samples, screening bacterial strains by using anorthite and serpentine as inorganic salt sources to obtain bacterial strains which are stable in growth and have good leaching effects on anorthite minerals, and applying the bacterial strains to efficient leaching of anorthite, serpentine and wollastonite, wherein compared with a sterile control group, the leaching rate of calcium and magnesium ions is improved remarkably. The method solves the problem of slow reaction rate of mineral sequestration carbon dioxide caused by difficult ion leaching in natural silicate minerals, and has great significance.

title_en: OMV vaccine capable of preventing serotype III infection of group B streptococcus and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OMV vaccine capable of preventing serotype III infection of group B streptococcus and a preparation method thereof. The invention belongs to the field of synthetic biology, and particularly relates to an OMV vaccine capable of preventing serotype III infection of group B streptococcus and a preparation method thereof. The recombinant escherichia coli contains a lipoid A deacylase coding gene, a lipoid A dephosphase coding gene and a group B streptococcus capsular polysaccharide length control coding gene, does not contain an acetylglucosamine phosphotransferase coding gene, an escherichia coli O antigen synthesis gene cluster coding gene, a lipoid A myristoyltransferase coding gene, an escherichia coli O antigen chain length control gene coding gene, a lipoid A palmitoyltransferase coding gene and an escherichia coli sialic acid degradation gene cluster coding gene, and also contains a group B streptococcus III capsular polysaccharide synthesis cluster coding gene. The recombinant escherichia coli can be used for producing OMV vaccine for preventing serotype III infection of group B streptococcus.

title_en: Method for preparing circular single-chain deoxyribonucleic acid library
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose methods of preparing circular single stranded deoxyribonucleic acid libraries. The method comprises the steps of repairing 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library, carrying out high-temperature denaturation treatment on the repaired 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library, carrying out cyclization treatment on the 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library after the high-temperature denaturation treatment, carrying out digestion treatment on the cyclized 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library, and carrying out purification treatment on the digested 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library to obtain the purified 1pmol of double-stranded DNA library as a prepared circular single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid library. The implementation mode can reduce the conditions of sequence redundancy interference, technical compatibility conflict and large data quality fluctuation, and can reduce the conditions of cyclization failure or great efficiency reduction, and can reduce residual undegraded fragments, thereby improving the purity of the cyclization product.

title_en: Mouse monoclonal antibody specifically binding to prolactin receptor PRLR and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mouse monoclonal antibody specifically binding to a prolactin receptor PRLR and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides an antibody targeting PRLR or an antigen binding fragment thereof, wherein a heavy chain variable region comprises VHCDR 1-3 shown in SEQ ID NO. 6-8, and a light chain variable region comprises VLCDR 1-3 shown in SEQ ID NO. 2-4. The antibodies provided by the invention can specifically recognize and bind to PRLR proteins, can also bind to human and monkey PRLR antigens and inhibit the growth and/or proliferation of tumors or tumor cells, and mediate internalization upon binding to cell surface expressed PRLR proteins.

title_en: Application of TaSnRK2.8 gene in regulation and control of disease resistance of wheat
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering breeding, and provides an application of TaSnRK2.8 gene in regulation and control of wheat disease resistance. The nucleotide sequence of the TaSnRK2.8 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the amino acid sequence of the gene coding wheat cytoplasmic serine/threonine protein kinase TaSnRK2.8, taSnRK2.8 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The over-expression of the TaSnRK2.8 gene can obviously enhance the resistance of wheat to stripe rust, weaken the pathogenicity of stripe rust bacteria, and the knocking out of the TaSnRK2.8 gene weakens the disease resistance of the wheat, thereby proving that the wheat is positively regulated to resist stripe rust. The invention provides important gene resources and technical support for the genetic improvement of wheat rust resistance, and can be used for cultivating wheat varieties with rust resistance.

title_en: Recombinant escherichia coli for high-yield cyanidin-3-O-glucoside as well as construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant escherichia coli with high yield of cyanidin-3-O-glucoside, and a construction method and application thereof. The invention takes escherichia coli BL21 (DE 3) engineering bacteria as a host, integrates the dihydroflavonol 4-reductase, anthocyanin synthase and flavonoid 3-O-glucosyltransferase which are from different sources on a plasmid vector pRSFDuet to construct chassis cells for producing C3G, simultaneously overexpresses glutathione transferase, adds a small ubiquitin-like modified protein of a dissolution-promoting tag, enzyme engineering FaDFR, artificial protein cage space combination pathway enzyme, in-situ enhanced synthesis key precursor UDP-glucose and cofactor engineering to improve FaDFR catalytic efficiency, constructs a cell factory for efficiently synthesizing C3G based on the combination strategy, improves the yield of C3G and achieves the titer of 797.20mg/L. The method provided by the invention has the characteristics of simplicity, economy and ecology friendliness.

title_en: Application of two polar yeasts in promoting growth of gramineous plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of two polar yeasts to promotion of growth of gramineous plants, and relates to the technical field of cultivation and planting of gramineous plants. The polar yeast strain provided by the invention is a budding Tao Suoni yeast (Tausonia pullulans) A29 with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M20251639 and a Debaryomyces hansenii (Debaryomyces hansenii) A38 with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M20251638, volatile substances generated by the polar yeast strain can promote the growth of gramineous plants such as rice and the like, the promotion of the gramineous plants in a seedling stage is particularly remarkable in a low-temperature environment, and the polar yeast strain has good application prospects in the promotion of the growth of the gramineous plants and the response to cold stress.

title_en: Method for improving slag soil based on railway tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving slag soil based on railway tunnel construction, which belongs to the technical field of civil engineering and environmental remediation and comprises the following steps of S1, slag soil collection, S2, crushing and screening, S3, microbial inoculum activation, S4, mixing and stirring, S5, and composting and curing treatment. According to the invention, by means of microbial inoculum introduction, compost curing and structure optimization technology, waste residue soil is transformed and improved, and the microbial inoculum can be used as a high-quality engineering material for slope greening and roadbed backfilling, so that the applicability of the microbial inoculum as planting soil or backfilling soil is improved, sustainable utilization of resources can be realized, recovery and protection of ecological environment along a line can be effectively promoted, the power is contributed to green construction of a plateau railway, and the dual purposes of resource recycling and ecological restoration are realized.

title_en: PH trigger regulated and controlled nano antibacterial peptide for resisting pseudomonas aeruginosa dimer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of a pH trigger regulated and controlled dimeric nano antibacterial peptide C  2  HF for resisting pseudomonas aeruginosa, and belongs to the technical field of biology. Comprises a branched chain A and a branched chain B, wherein the amino acid sequence of the branched chain A is HHHCFFF, the amino acid sequence of the branched chain B is FFFCHHH, and the branched chain A and the branched chain B are connected through disulfide bonds formed between thiol groups in two cysteine residues. The antibacterial peptide C  2  HF is self-assembled into a nanofiber structure in PB (pH=6.0) solution, the C  2  HF has strong anti-pseudomonas aeruginosa activity under an acidic condition, and the antibacterial peptide C  2  HF has almost no hemolytic toxicity and extremely high application potential under the acidic condition for treating infection by pseudomonas aeruginosa.

title_en: Method for catalytic synthesis of trehalose-6-phosphate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biocatalysis, and provides a method for catalyzing and synthesizing trehalose-6-phosphate, which adjusts key parameters in a multi-enzyme cascade catalytic reaction system for catalyzing and synthesizing trehalose-6-phosphate, wherein the enzyme activity concentration of maltose phosphorylase is 80-120U/mL, the enzyme activity concentration of beta-phosphoglucomutase is 15-35U/mL, the enzyme activity concentration of trehalose-6-phosphate phosphorylase is 3-15U/mL, and the corresponding production process is matched and adjusted, so that the yield of trehalose-6-phosphate can be obviously improved, thereby obtaining a more universal and efficient enzyme dosage combination, enabling the conversion rate of a substrate to a target product trehalose-6-phosphate to be up to 96%, and the method is simple and convenient to operate and low in cost, and realizes the high-efficiency and low-cost industrial production of trehalose-6-phosphate.

title_en: Preparation process for efficiently absorbing fish protein peptide and application of preparation process in fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process for efficiently absorbing fish protein peptide and application of the fish protein peptide in fertilizer, and belongs to the technical field of marine organisms. The invention takes the aquatic protein as a fermentation raw material directly, utilizes the synergistic fermentation effect of microorganisms and assisted biological enzymolysis, remarkably improves the amino acid content in the fish protein biological peptide and further improves the absorption rate of the fish protein peptide, and uses the prepared fish protein peptide in a fertilizer to prepare the fish protein peptide functional fertilizer, remarkably improves the nutritional value and the utilization rate of the fertilizer, and has the effects of remarkably promoting growth, resisting diseases, resisting stress and the like. The invention abandons the prior preparation method of the fish protein peptide by preparing the fermentation enzyme liquid and then carrying out biological enzymolysis, adopts the process of directly fermenting the aquatic protein to prepare the high-efficiency absorption fish protein peptide, combines the fermentation process and the enzymolysis process, has the advantages of simple production process, low production cost and the like compared with the traditional process, and has remarkable effect and significance in promoting the green preparation of the fish protein peptide and the high-efficiency application of the fish protein peptide in the fertilizer.

title_en: Purification method of Brazilian sweet protein
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Brazilian sweet protein purification, and relates to a Brazilian sweet protein purification method which comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out first washing and first elution after absorbing Brazilian sweet protein fermentation liquor on an adsorption resin fixed with silver ions, and (3) loading the obtained Brazilian sweet protein-enriched eluent on an adsorption resin fixed with copper ions, and then sequentially performing second washing and second elution to obtain the Brazilian sweet protein-enriched eluent. The method provided by the invention can realize the high-efficiency separation of the Brazilian sweet protein and the impurity protein, and finally the purity of the Brazilian sweet protein can reach more than 98%.

title_en: Nerve cell with conditional immune escape function and suicide function, and establishment method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nerve cell with both conditional immune escape function and suicide function, and an establishment method and application thereof. A spatiotemporal specific regulatory element is disclosed which is capable of forming a spatiotemporal specific promoter for regulating expression of a gene of interest in the dopaminergic neural precursor phase (mDAP). The improved induced pluripotent stem cells and differentiated nerve cells with both conditional immune escape function and suicide function are also disclosed, and the cells can automatically trigger immune escape at the early stage of dopaminergic precursor and synchronously have the controllable self-destruction function of medicines.

title_en: Preparation method and application of recombinant botulinum toxin type A
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of recombinant A-type botulinum toxin. The preparation method provided by the invention comprises the steps of simultaneously expressing the light chain and the heavy chain of BoNTA in two expression cassettes and autonomously assembling the light chain and the heavy chain into a soluble and active holotoxin protein molecule (Holotoxin) in escherichia coli. The invention can express and purify the recombinant BoNTA protein completely consistent with the amino acid sequence of the natural BoNTA protein, and can also be used for expressing truncated or modified recombinant BoNTA containing one or more amino acid mutations.

title_en: SNP molecular marker combination for Anqing white pig identification and identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to molecular identification of pig breeds, and discloses an SNP molecular marker combination for Anqing Liubai pig identification, which consists of 14 SNP loci, wherein the physical position and allele information of each SNP locus are determined based on a pig reference genome Srcrofa 11.1, rs340865310 is positioned at 226716bp of chromosome 2, the allele is G/A, rs344868753 is positioned at 124988228bp of chromosome 2, the allele is T/C, rs793459202 is positioned at 12758234bp of chromosome 3, the allele is C/T, and rs700761784 is positioned at 13345574bp of chromosome 3, and the allele is C/T. According to the invention, 14 specific SNP are taken as a marker set, and the unified 0/1/2 coding, standardized parameter mu/sigma and threshold judgment rule are matched, so that the flow of a detection end is clear, the repeatability is strong, and the method is convenient for consistent implementation across laboratories.

title_en: SV molecular marker for identifying fight chicken variety and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an SV molecular marker for identifying a nugget variety and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of animal breeding. The SV molecular marker is positioned in the 28178480-28180694 th region of chromosome 2 in the chicken genome and is the insertion or deletion of a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The application provides a kit for detecting the SV molecular marker and a method for identifying the fight chicken variety by using the same. By utilizing the method provided by the application, accurate and efficient identification of the nugget variety genotype can be realized. The SV mark has obvious characteristics of the species of the bucket chicken, is a unique mutation site of the bucket chicken, can rapidly identify the authenticity of the bucket chicken by using less genotype information, and provides a new technical reference for the identification, protection and genetic breeding of bucket chicken resources in the future.

title_en: Domain-specific monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibody specifically combined with an African swine fever virus CD2v protein and application thereof, wherein the antibody has high titer and stable property, can be combined with ASFV infected cells, and provides an important tool for ASFV detection, CD2v antigen or fragment detection and CD2v protein structure analysis.

title_en: Pathogen infection diagnosis marker based on DPH1-DPH7 gene mRNA and diphtheria amide modification level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pathogen infection diagnosis marker based on DPH gene family mRNA and diphtheria amide modification level, a kit and application. The marker combination comprises mRNA expression level of DPH1-DPH7 gene and diphtheria amide modification level of eukaryotic elongation factor 2. The invention discloses for the first time that the combination is obviously related to pathogen infection, and provides a detection kit containing specific primers, biotinylated NAD, pseudomonas exotoxin A and other reagents. The indexes are detected by qPCR and non-denaturing immunoblotting respectively, and the combined analysis can realize high-efficiency diagnosis. Experiments show that the combined marker has excellent diagnosis performance, the area under the curve AUC of the combined logistic regression model can reach 0.917, the sensitivity is 90.9 percent, the specificity is 85.7 percent, and a novel and reliable molecular scheme is provided for early differential diagnosis of infection.

title_en: RPA-LFD primer group for detecting black gall midge, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an RPA-LFD primer group for detecting black gall midge, a kit and application thereof, wherein the primer group comprises Md-AF1-c and Md-AR1-a primers, the sequence of the Md-AF1-c primer is FAM-AACAATAAGTAAAAATCATCAT AAAGATAGT, and the sequence of the Md-AR1-a primer is Biotion-TTCAGTAGCTCATATAGGAATAGTTTTAGG. The invention realizes that the reaction can be completed only by a portable constant temperature device (even body temperature), and the matched freeze-drying reagent can be stored at room temperature, thereby remarkably improving the stability and the field applicability of the method.

title_en: Kit for rapidly detecting clostridium difficile and high-yield strain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular detection, in particular to a kit for rapidly detecting clostridium difficile and high-yield strains. The invention provides a multi-primer probe set for clostridium difficile tcdB, cdtA, tcdC delta 117 and a kit for rapidly detecting clostridium difficile toxigenic genes. The kit can be applied to clinical detection of clostridium difficile toxigenic genes rapidly and accurately, not only can detect clostridium difficile toxigenic, but also can detect RT027 type high-yield strains, and has important significance for clinical accurate diagnosis of clostridium difficile infection and epidemiological investigation.

title_en: Primer combination of rice bacterial leaf blight resistance gene Xa23 without encumbrance marks and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a primer combination of a rice bacterial leaf blight resistance gene Xa23 without a cumbersome mark, which can simultaneously genotype 5 haplotypes including Xa23, xa23  MH63 、xa23 NIP 、xa23 JG30  and Xa23  ZS97  on Xa23 gene loci through zonal electrification. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a primer combination for typing the Xa23 locus based on the universal fluorescent probe, and the Xa23 locus can be typed into disease-resistant (red light, xa 23) and disease-sensitive (green light, xa23  MH63 、xa23 NIP 、xa23 JG30  and Xa23  ZS97 ) genotypes by fluorescence. The invention aims at the design of functional difference points on Xa23 gene loci, and has no linkage cumbersome fragments. The two primer combinations designed by the invention are applicable to 5 representative haplotypes on the Xa23 locus at the same time, and are particularly applicable to the Xa23  ZS97  haplotypes, so that the primer combinations have wider applicability.

title_en: Humanized osteoporosis mouse model and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanized osteoporosis mouse model and a construction method thereof, belonging to the technical fields of biotechnology and animal models. Aiming at the core defects of large species difference, insufficient humanization degree, low pathological simulation degree, unstable phenotype and the like of the existing osteoporosis model, the humanized osteoporosis mouse model is obtained through five core steps of experimental animal pretreatment, collagen-nano hydroxyapatite bionic scaffold preparation and cell pre-planting, immune-bone metabolism double-humanized system construction, progressive osteoporosis induction, model identification and verification. The invention realizes double humanization of immune and bone metabolic systems for the first time, greatly improves the engraftment rate and survival time of human cells, accurately simulates the pathological process of clinical postmenopausal osteoporosis, has stable and uniform model phenotype and high matching degree with clinical drug reactivity, and can be widely used for research and development of anti-osteoporosis drugs and research of pathological mechanism.

title_en: Application of LncRNA XR_002626937.1 in canine coronavirus infection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of long-chain non-coding RNA (LncRNA) XR_002626937.1 in controlling canine coronavirus (CCoV) replication, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The nucleotide sequence of LncRNA XR_002626937.1 is shown as SEQ ID No.1, is mainly located in the nucleus, is significantly up-regulated in time and dose dependence after infection of MDCK cells by CCoV, and is positively correlated with viral load. Functional experiments prove that the LncRNA can obviously promote CCoV replication, and the expression can be effectively inhibited by knocking down the LncRNA, and the action mechanism comprises inhibiting the p53 signal path and the activation of downstream target genes p21 and Bax, so as to inhibit the apoptosis of infected cells, antagonize the expression of natural immune factors such as RIG-I, MAVS, ISG and the like, promote the immune escape of viruses, and can be used as competitive endogenous RNA to adsorb miR-10926-z to regulate downstream signal paths. The invention firstly defines the key role of LncRNA XR_002626937.1 in CCoV infection, provides a new target and theoretical basis for developing an anti-CCoV drug targeting the LncRNA, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Application of plant low-phosphorus stress resistant gene GmGLK-66
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a plant low-phosphorus stress resistance gene GmGLK. The GmGLK gene is found to be involved in the phosphorus balance regulation of soybean root system, and the gene transcription level is obviously up-regulated by low phosphorus stress to be expressed in response to the low phosphorus stress. Meanwhile, gmGLK genes are shown to have positive regulation and control on the growth of soybean root systems and the phosphorus efficiency, and the total phosphorus content of soybeans can be remarkably improved. Under normal phosphorus conditions and low phosphorus stress, the excessive expression GmGLK gene can obviously promote the growth of soybean in-vitro hairy roots, increase the fresh weight of the hairy roots and improve the total phosphorus content, and after the GmGLK gene is knocked out, the effect is opposite, and the Mao Genxian weight and the total phosphorus content can be reduced. Therefore, gmGLK gene plays an important role in promoting the growth of soybean root system and improving the phosphorus efficiency of soybean, and has important significance in elucidating the biological function of GLK gene in leguminous crops for regulating and controlling low phosphorus stress.

title_en: Inhibitors of cell envelope proteases from lactic acid bacteria
abstract_en: The present disclosure is a screening procedure that allows identification of inhibitors of Cellular Envelope Proteases (CEPs) in pathogenic bacteria by using Lactic Acid Bacteria (LAB). The screening platform can be used to screen libraries of compounds to generate a high throughput evaluation of drug candidates, and as exemplified below, a single screening result of 6808 compounds identified 20 compounds that inhibited CEP of lactococcus lactis (Lactococcus lactis).

title_en: Process for producing clanis bilineata tsingii oligopeptide powder and clanis bilineata tsingii peptide oral liquid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional foods and biology, and particularly relates to a process for producing clanis bilineata tsingtauica oligopeptide powder and clanis bilineata tsingtauica peptide oral liquid. The process for producing the clanis bilineata larva oligopeptide powder comprises the following steps of drying clanis bilineata larva to obtain clanis bilineata larva powder, degreasing the clanis bilineata larva powder, extracting clanis bilineata larva protein powder from the degreased clanis bilineata larva powder, carrying out ultrasonic-assisted enzymolysis on the clanis bilineata larva protein powder to obtain clanis bilineata larva peptide liquid, filtering, concentrating and evaporating the clanis bilineata larva peptide liquid to obtain oligopeptide concentrate, and drying and crushing the oligopeptide concentrate to obtain the clanis bilineata larva oligopeptide powder. The invention can improve the yield and quality of the clanis bilineata oligopeptides powder.

title_en: Method for preparing horse-derived immunoglobulin F (ab') 2 by sodium octoate precipitation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing horse-derived immunoglobulin F (ab') 2 by a sodium octoate precipitation process, belonging to the technical fields of biological pharmacy and plasma immunoglobulin separation and purification. The method takes horse-derived immune plasma as a raw material, enzymatic hydrolysis is carried out by protease to obtain enzymatic hydrolysate containing immunoglobulin F (ab ') 2, sodium octoate is added as a selective precipitant, non-target hybrid protein is selectively precipitated, and target protein F (ab') 2 is kept in solution. After solid-liquid separation to obtain clear feed liquid, membrane separation or chromatographic purification treatment can be further carried out according to the requirement to obtain horse-derived immunoglobulin F (ab') 2 product. The precipitate formed by the invention is suitable for industrial filtering operation, solves the problems of low recovery rate of the existing ammonium sulfate precipitate and difficult filtration of the free octanoic acid precipitate, improves the process feasibility and stability, and improves the recovery rate of the product.

title_en: Exosome extraction method of high-viscosity high-protein egg white sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exosome extraction method of a high-viscosity high-protein-content egg white sample, which adopts ammonium sulfate pretreatment to promote non-exosome protein sedimentation, and combines a differential centrifugation and ultrafiltration method to further remove the non-exosome protein in the sample, thereby effectively reducing non-exosome pollution and improving exosome purity.

title_en: Straw pretreatment method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass resource utilization, in particular to a straw pretreatment method and application thereof. The straw pretreatment method comprises the following steps of steam explosion treatment and composite enzymolysis reaction of straw, wherein enzymes of the composite enzymolysis reaction comprise polysaccharide monooxygenase, lignin peroxidase and cellobiose dehydrogenase. After the pretreatment, the lignin content in the straw is obviously reduced, the structural damage of cellulose and hemicellulose is more sufficient, and the degree of glycosidic bond fracture is improved, so that the efficiency and the yield of reducing sugar in the subsequent enzymolysis saccharification process are greatly improved. The method has the advantages of mild treatment conditions, environmental friendliness, high saccharification efficiency and the like, and is suitable for efficient bioconversion of straw wood fiber raw materials.

title_en: Combination therapy for the treatment of cancer
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods for treating cancer in a patient comprising administering a combination therapy comprising a diabody drug conjugate. In some embodiments, the combination therapy comprises (i) a therapeutically effective amount of Trop-2 antibody-drug conjugate (Trop-2 ADC), (ii) a therapeutically effective amount of a Nectin-4 antibody-drug conjugate (Nectin-4 ADC), and optionally, (iii) a therapeutically effective amount of an anti-PD (L) -1 antibody. In some embodiments, the cancer is urothelial cancer.

title_en: Recombinant polypeptides comprising a metal binding motif
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to a recombinant polypeptide comprising an IgG binding domain derived from streptococcal protein G (SpG) and a metal binding motif, wherein the recombinant polypeptide has a first, target-binding conformation in the presence of a metal ion and a second, non-target-binding conformation in the absence of a metal ion, wherein the recombinant polypeptide is configured to bind to a Fab region of IgG in the first, target-binding conformation. The disclosure also relates to ligands comprising the recombinant polypeptides, chromatography matrices comprising ligands coupled to matrices, and methods of purifying sample proteins using chromatography matrices. Furthermore, the disclosure relates to nucleic acids encoding the recombinant polypeptides, and expression systems comprising the nucleic acids.

title_en: Western blot polymer based on organic framework nano-enzyme, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of western-blotting polymers, in particular to a western-blotting polymer based on organic framework nano-enzyme, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method mainly generates free radicals in microenvironment around the template molecules by a strategy of pre-assembling and then positioning initiation, realizes in-situ positioning initiation of polymerization reaction, reduces ineffective polymerization, ensures high reproducibility and controllability of a polymerization process by introducing an iron-based or zinc-based MOF (metal oxide film) instead of a natural enzyme-activated chemical initiator, can keep identification performance in a complex environment and after repeated adsorption-desorption cycles, reduces long-term application cost, and can furthest maintain natural conformation and activity of template proteins and guarantee fidelity of imprinting holes. The organic frame nano-enzyme initiation system constructed by the invention is a universal platform, and provides a new way for preparing a high-selectivity and high-affinity separation medium or a sensing identification element by directional design.

title_en: Triple inactivated vaccine for preventing and treating feline calicivirus disease, feline herpesvirus disease and/or rabies, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present application relates to a recombinant rabies virus obtained by inserting an antigen gene of feline calicivirus and an antigen gene of feline herpesvirus on the genome of an attenuated strain of rabies virus. And based on the recombinant rabies virus, the triple inactivated vaccine for preventing and treating the feline calicivirus, the feline herpesvirus and/or the rabies is prepared, and after the triple inactivated vaccine is used for immunizing cats, the triple inactivated vaccine can effectively induce and generate neutralizing antibodies aiming at the feline calicivirus, the feline herpesvirus and the rabies virus, so that the simultaneous immunization of the three viruses is realized.

title_en: Strong aromatic white spirit brewing method by composite flora sectional temperature control fermentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for brewing strong aromatic Chinese spirits by composite flora sectional temperature control fermentation, belonging to the technical field of Chinese spirits brewing. According to the method, the composite flora is constructed by screening the functional bacterial strains from pit mud, and the accurate regulation and control of the fermentation process are realized by combining a three-section temperature control fermentation process. The composite flora is compounded according to a specific proportion and then cooperates with the aroma large-scale yeast, the temperature is controlled in three stages of a heating activation period, an aroma-producing tripod full period and a flavor balance period in the fermentation process, and the content of characteristic ester substances such as ethyl caproate in the white spirit is obviously improved by optimizing the metabolism rhythm of microorganisms. The strong aromatic Chinese liquor brewed by the method has full aroma and mellow taste, and solves the problems of unstable fermentation flora and low yield of flavor substances in the prior art.

title_en: Antigen epitope peptide and paralichthys olivaceus mucin Muc13 specific antibody prepared from same
abstract_en: The invention provides an epitope peptide and a paralichthys olivaceus mucin Muc13 specific antibody prepared by the same, and a B cell epitope derived from the paralichthys olivaceus Muc13 protein is determined by epitope screening, and the sequence of the B cell epitope is PGTTEEPDPTAGSPP. After the epitope is coupled with KLH carrier protein, the epitope is used for immunizing New Zealand white rabbits, and the rabbit-derived anti-paralichthys olivaceus Muc13 specific antibody is successfully obtained. The antibody can specifically identify Muc13 protein and Muc13 positive mucus cells in the turbot mucosal tissue, and provides a key detection means for deep exploration of the functional mechanism of the mucus cells in the process of mucosal immune response of fish.

title_en: Novel antibacterial peptide for resisting listeria monocytogenes and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of biotechnology, and provides a novel antibacterial peptide for resisting listeria monocytogenes and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the novel antibacterial peptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 4. According to the invention, the sequences of the MurA nanobody, the flexible Linker and the Pediocin_PA-1 antibacterial peptide are spliced and optimized by using a genetic engineering technology, and then the novel antibacterial peptide is synthesized by the steps of induced expression and the like, so that the novel antibacterial peptide can specifically identify MurA protein and whole Listeria monocytogenes, then the Pediocin_PA-1 antibacterial peptide is contacted with the Listeria monocytogenes under the action of the flexible Linker and plays a role of resisting the Listeria monocytogenes, the Listeria monocytogenes can be targeted and positioned, the specificity is strong, the inhibition effect is high, and the novel antibacterial peptide is nontoxic and harmless, and the inhibition effect of the antibacterial peptide on the Listeria monocytogenes is effectively improved.

title_en: Hydrogel microbial agent for cooperatively removing plasticizers and heavy metals in water and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogel microbial agent for synergistically removing plasticizers and heavy metals in water and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hydrogel microbial agent comprises a composite carrier and a composite microbial agent loaded on the composite carrier, the composite carrier is lignin hydrogel loaded with ferrous sulfide nano particles, the composite microbial agent is compounded by a functional strain which is resistant to cadmium domestication and has a phthalate degradation function, the preparation method synchronously synthesizes the lignin hydrogel and loads the ferrous sulfide nano particles to prepare the composite carrier through Cd  2+  concentration gradient induced culture of the functional strain to prepare the composite carrier, and finally prepares the hydrogel microbial agent through bacteria-loaded coupling and drying, the limitation that the microbial agent and the carrier are separated and have poor synergism is overcome, the efficient synchronous removal of the plasticizers and the heavy metal Cd is realized, and the technical problems of low activity, easiness in loss and poor treatment effect of the existing microbial agent in a composite polluted environment are solved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of curvularia fungus-derived polyketide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a polyketide from Curvularia fungi. The polyketide can reduce the generation level of NO in cells in a dose-dependent manner, remarkably inhibit M1 phenotype polarization and promote the conversion of the M1 phenotype polarization to M2 phenotype, remarkably down regulate the expression of intracellular key inflammation related proteins (including IL-1 beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha and COX-2), inhibit the generation of NLRP3 inflammation small bodies and caspase-1, and has potential AD resisting activity, so that the polyketide has good application prospect in the aspect of preparing anti-neuroinflammation medicines.

title_en: Quinazoline compounds for inducing G12D mutant KRAS proteolysis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to quinazoline compounds for use in inducing the proteolytic decomposition of G12D mutant KRAS. The present invention provides use of a quinazoline compound represented by the following formula (I) or a salt thereof in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of pancreatic cancer. The present inventors also provide the use of a pharmaceutical composition comprising a compound of formula (Ia) or a salt thereof, or one or more pharmaceutically acceptable excipients, in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of pancreatic cancer. The quinazoline compound has excellent G12D mutant KRAS protein decomposition inducing effect and G12D mutant KRAS inhibitory activity, and can be used as a pancreatic cancer therapeutic agent, thereby completing the present invention. The quinazoline compound of the present invention or a salt thereof or the pharmaceutical composition may be used as a therapeutic agent for pancreatic cancer.

title_en: Ginseng zymolyte rich in rare ginsenoside CK, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The patent application discloses ginseng zymolyte rich in rare ginsenoside CK, a manufacturing method and application thereof. Adding a ginsenoside mixture containing ginsenoside Rb1, beta-glucosidase N81W-W195E and aspartic protease from Aspergillus niger into a reaction system, converting the ginsenoside Rb1 into ginsenoside CK through ginsenoside F2, and then performing steps such as freeze drying or vacuum drying to obtain ginseng zymolyte rich in rare ginsenoside CK. The obtained ginseng zymolyte has high content of rare ginsenoside CK, and can be used for preparing products for preventing and/or treating obesity or depression.

title_en: Biliary tract cancer organoid-based drug screening method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and provides a biliary tract cancer organoid-based drug screening method, which comprises the steps of constructing biliary tract cancer organoids with high activity and complete structure by using biliary tract cancer tumor tissues through a organoid culture method, simulating tumor environment, and screening candidate drugs by using a biliary tract cancer organoid model through a 384-pore plate high-flux drug screening system. The method adopts the organoid model as a curative effect evaluation means, constructs the tumor organoid through intraoperative or biopsy specimens, and treats the tumor organoid in vitro by using a small molecular compound library, so that the sensitivity of biliary tract cancer cells can be simply, conveniently, quickly and economically judged, and a basis is provided for individuation treatment. And can rapidly screen out sensitive drugs for patients, thereby relieving the great pain of patients to the body caused by repeated chemotherapy.

title_en: Identification and application of novel visceral adipose tissue Treg cell subpopulation
abstract_en: The invention provides identification and application of a novel visceral adipose tissue Treg cell subset. Specifically, the invention identifies two internal visceral adipose tissue Treg cell subsets 1) an Icos  hi  Treg cell subset that specifically and highly expresses Icos, nkg, itgb1, tmsb10, ms4a4b and Ccl5, and 2) a KLRG1  hi   Treg cell subset that specifically and highly expresses Atf3, lmna, klrg1, S100a6 and Cxlc 2. Experiments prove that the novel Treg cell subset can improve lipid metabolism, reduce weight and reduce fat inflammation in vivo, so that obesity is effectively improved.

title_en: Tremella polysaccharide particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides tremella polysaccharide particles and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The tremella polysaccharide particles are prepared by taking tremella water extract with polysaccharide content not lower than 70% w/w as a raw material, carrying out enzymolysis treatment by compound enzyme to obtain tremella polysaccharide enzymolysis liquid, uniformly mixing the tremella polysaccharide enzymolysis liquid with compound stabilizer, adding polyethylene glycol, and preparing the particles. The tremella polysaccharide particles with average particle size controllable in the range of 200 nm-500 nm, uniform distribution and high stability are successfully prepared by the synergistic degradation of the complex enzyme, the synergistic stabilization of the complex stabilizer and the organic combination of the dual functions of polyethylene glycol and the key process sequence, and the tremella polysaccharide particles have wide application prospects in the fields of foods, medicines and cosmetics.

title_en: Use of HHLA2 in diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of HHLA in diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary fibrosis. Specifically, HHLA2 can induce cell senescence by binding to CCAR2, resulting in nuclear export of CCAR2, activating the p53/p21 pathway, and can also induce polarization of macrophages to senescence-associated macrophages, thereby promoting transitional cell formation and ultimately promoting pulmonary fibrosis progression. The invention discloses a method for constructing a lung fibrosis model of a non-human mammal based on the mechanism, a lung fibrosis marker, a detection reagent and application thereof, and the method is used for preparing a diagnostic reagent or a diagnostic kit, wherein the lung fibrosis marker is HHLA < 2 >.

title_en: Triple negative breast cancer prognosis risk layering model and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triple negative breast cancer prognosis risk layering model and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. According to the LncRNA expression profile data and complete clinical follow-up data of the obtained triple-negative breast cancer patients, 7 LncRNAs which are obviously related to survival prognosis of the triple-negative breast cancer patients are screened out through single-factor and multi-factor Cox proportional risk regression analysis to form a specific marker combination, so that the clinical pain point with low prognosis layering precision of the existing triple-negative breast cancer is solved, and meanwhile, a complete prognosis risk layering system is formed based on a prognosis risk scoring model, a specific primer group and a detection kit of the marker combination, so that the accurate prognosis risk layering of the triple-negative breast cancer is realized, guidance is provided for clinical individuation treatment, and the kit has a very good application prospect.

title_en: Mining area waste land ecological restoration plant combination screening method based on natural succession and growth promoting bacteria
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining area abandoned land ecological restoration plant combination screening method based on natural succession and growth promoting bacteria, and belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration. The method provided by the invention fully considers the plant community characteristics formed in the natural restoration process of the abandoned land in the mining area, and has higher scientificity and reliability than the method which only relies on randomly screening the native plants to determine the ecological restoration plant combination. The metal mining area abandoned land restoration plant combination obtained by the screening method disclosed by the invention meets the actual ecological restoration requirement better, and has higher reference value and application prospect.

title_en: Analysis and production of immune cells in a bioreactor
abstract_en: The culturing of immune cells by a data-driven bioreactor can be provided by dividing a first sample of immune cells into a first population and a second population, culturing the first population and the second population in respective first and second bioreactors to produce respective first and second cultured populations, measuring a efficacy parameter, a respective value of a metabolic parameter, or both at a harvest time of each cultured population of immune cells, and after the harvest time, collecting a second sample of immune cells, selecting one of the first or second bioreactors based on which of the respective cultured populations is measured as having a higher value of the efficacy parameter, a higher value of the metabolic parameter, or both, and culturing the second sample of immune cells in the selected one of the first and second bioreactors to produce a cultured second sample.

title_en: Regenerated silk fibroin solution imitating silkworm gland protein, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated silk fibroin solution imitating silkworm gland protein, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of degumming natural silk, dissolving the degummed natural silk in a salt solution system, dialyzing and purifying to obtain an RSF aqueous solution, and setting the addition amount, the addition sequence and the action mode of Na  + 、K + 、Ca 2+ 、Mg 2+  and Fe  3+  according to the preset material performance requirement; according to the set adding amount, adding sequence and action mode, na  + 、K + 、Ca 2+ 、Mg 2+  and Fe  3+  are introduced into the RSF aqueous solution, and finally the RSF solution imitating silkworm gland protein is obtained by adjusting the pH value. According to the invention, the reconstruction of the RSF microstructure is realized by simulating the physiological ion environment in the silkworm gland and utilizing the synergistic effect of trace multielement metal ions, so that the RSF precursor solution with high viscosity and high stability is obtained, and the improvement of the mechanical property of the RSF fiber is facilitated.

title_en: Xylanase mutant based on analysis of hot spots around gate-controlled amino acid and application thereof
abstract_en: According to the invention, xylanase XynNTU-CDLs of GH11 family from Paenibacillus campinasensis NTU-11 is taken as a research object, alphaFold 3 is used for modeling, and the hot spot amino acids around the gate amino acids of xylanase XynNTU-CDLs are analyzed to perform site-directed mutagenesis and combined mutagenesis, so that a series of xylanase mutants are obtained, and compared with the original enzyme, the catalytic efficiency is obviously improved, the heat stability is high, and the method has high application value in the industrial production of xylooligosaccharide.

title_en: Large-size degradable polyester microsphere with through holes and macroporous structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-size degradable polyester microsphere with a through hole and a macroporous structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The polyester microsphere comprises polylactic acid and polycaprolactone, wherein the average pore diameter of the polyester microsphere is 1-100 mu m, and the porosity is more than 90%. The invention adopts polylactic acid and polycaprolactone with good biocompatibility as raw materials, and adopts a one-step method of porous microspheres to prepare large-size porous microspheres with through holes and macroporous structures, which can be applied to cell culture carriers to reduce the influence of acidic substances generated after polylactic acid degradation on cells and tissues.

title_en: Screening culture medium for accurate intestinal flora transplantation, preparation method thereof and enrichment method of enterobacteriales bacteria
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly relates to a screening culture medium for accurate intestinal flora transplantation, a preparation method thereof and an enrichment method of enterobacteriaceae bacteria.
