The application of the composition in the preparation of the intestinal flora screening culture medium provided by the invention, the synergistic interaction between the fructo-oligosaccharide, chlorogenic acid and basic nutrition provided by the CDC anaerobic bacteria agar basic culture medium can realize the effective screening and enrichment of enterobacteriaceae bacteria in a fecal sample under the condition of in-vitro culture, and has very excellent application prospects in separation and purification of enterobacteriaceae bacteria and functional research.

title_en: Application of membrane protein KIDINS and 220 related biological element in prognosis evaluation of retinoblastoma
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disease prognosis evaluation and molecular biology, and particularly relates to application of a membrane protein KIDINS and 220 related biological element in retinoblastoma prognosis evaluation. According to the invention, through database analysis, collection of peripheral blood samples of patients and normal children for Sanger sequencing, detection of KIDINS220 and eEF2 phosphorylation levels in tumor tissues of the patients, it is proved that the mutation rate (c. -241G > A) of the rs191497052 locus of the nerve high expression gene KIDINS in the patients is far higher than that of normal people, and the Rb infants carrying the mutation are more easy to relapse and drug resistance. KIDINS,220 can negatively regulate the malignant biological behavior of Rb cells, KIDINS220,220 and eEF2 can be used as therapeutic targets of Rb, so that the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Lactic acid bacteria and immunostimulant
abstract_en: The invention provides an immunostimulant comprising Lactobacillus helveticus, wherein the lactobacillus helveticus has three functions, namely activation of dendritic cell-like cells, induction of immunoglobulin A (IgA) production and induction of interleukin-12 (IL-12) production.

title_en: Cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant and application thereof in epsilon-caprolactone synthesis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant and application thereof in epsilon-caprolactone synthesis, belonging to the technical field of bioengineering. The invention discloses a cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant, nucleic acid for encoding the cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant, a recombinant expression vector containing the nucleic acid, a recombinant expression transformant containing the recombinant expression vector, and a recombinant cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant catalyst. Compared with other catalysts for preparing epsilon-caprolactone, the cyclohexanone monooxygenase mutant provided by the invention has the advantages of high catalytic activity and good thermal stability, and has strong application potential and wide application prospect in industrial application.

title_en: Biomarkers for assessing head and neck squamous cell carcinoma immune therapy response and/or prognosis, scoring model and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group of biomarkers, a scoring model and application for evaluating the immune treatment response and/or prognosis of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, which relate to the technical field of biological medicine, wherein the biomarkers comprise ITGB1, FTH1, SPP1, CD3D, CXCL and IL2RB, and the STRIE score is obtained by calculating the geometric average ratio of the expression levels of the six biomarkers and can be used for evaluating the immune treatment high and low response possibility and/or prognosis risk of a subject. According to the invention, the spatial domain scoring model based on the D4 spatial domain and the D5 and D6 spatial domains is constructed to obtain the STRIE score for reflecting the spatial immune state of the patient, so that the prognosis risk and the immunotherapy applicability of the head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patient are evaluated.

title_en: Application of CD44v5 as target for treating triple negative breast cancer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological pharmacy, and provides application of CD44v5 in treating triple negative breast cancer targets, wherein an in vitro cell experiment is adopted to evaluate the effect of CD44v5 serving as a marker and a CD44v5 inhibitor on triple negative breast cancer immunotherapy, and the result shows that the blocking of CD44v5 obviously weakens the migration capacity, colony forming capacity and apoptosis resistance of IL-4 mediated triple negative breast cancer cells, simultaneously restores the sensitivity of the CD44v5 to BMS-1, restores the T cell killing function, establishes that the CD44v5 is an IL-4R/STAT3 pathway core regulating factor, can simultaneously regulate and control PD-L1 and PVR immune check point molecules, has a positive feedback mechanism with SAM68, blocks the expression of the CD44v5 and combines cisplatin treatment, and can inhibit tumor growth by inhibiting the expression of SLC7A11 and promoting iron death.

title_en: Application of knock-out PhAGL gene in aspect of improving petunia sex shape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to an application of a PhAGL knocked-out gene in improving the sex shape of petunia. The invention discovers that the wild petunia PhAGL gene is knocked out, the plant height can be obviously reduced, the calyx can be increased, the whole compact form of the plant can be controlled, and the modeling landscape can be beautified.

title_en: Pathogenic bacteria multiplex Raman/visualization dual-mode detection method and kit based on Cas12a cis/trans cleavage activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pathogen single tube multiple Raman/visualization detection method and a reagent kit based on Cas12a and in-situ crRNA synthesis strategies, and belongs to the technical field of food safety detection. By designing single-molecule allosteric hairpin DNA comprising a target recognition region, a T7 promoter and a crRNA template, specifically responding to 16S rRNA of target bacteria, starting hairpin structure recombination and crRNA in-situ synthesis, guiding cis-form and trans-form cutting of Cas12a, and realizing rapid visual detection of total bacterial amount and SERS identification and quantitative detection of different pathogenic bacteria targets. The problem of qualitative accuracy and quantitative sensitivity deficiency caused by the interference of biological matrixes of the existing pathogenic bacteria rapid detection method is solved, the dependence of the CRISPR/Cas12a method on target PAM sites is overcome, and the detection range of food-borne pathogenic bacteria nucleic acid targets is greatly widened. The Raman/visual dual-mode detection system is suitable for on-site rapid detection scenes, the detection limit is low to a single cell level, and the specificity and reproducibility are excellent, so that the Raman/visual dual-mode detection system can be used for food safety control, live pathogen diagnosis and other scenes.

title_en: Anti-wrinkle composition containing plant composite fermentation liquor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of skin care preparations, in particular to an anti-wrinkle composition containing plant composite fermentation liquor and a preparation method thereof. The invention uses retinol and its derivatives, vitriol and black glossy ganoderma extract to form antioxidant repairing agent, uses two-split yeast fermentation product filtrate, glyceroglycosides, glycerol and 1, 3-propanediol to form skin conditioning agent, and selects garden balsam leaf, thorn pear fruit, beautyberry fruit, caper fruit, silver ear fruit body and plantain fruit as composite plant material to prepare plant composite fermentation liquor by composite enzyme enzymolysis and composite strain fermentation in turn.

title_en: Treatment of cancer using chimeric antigen receptor
abstract_en: The present invention provides compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with expression of cancer-associated antigens as described herein. The invention also relates to Chimeric Antigen Receptors (CARs) specific for cancer-associated antigens as described herein, vectors encoding the same, and recombinant T cells comprising the CARs of the invention. The invention also includes a method of administering a genetically modified T cell expressing a CAR comprising an antigen binding domain that binds to a cancer-associated antigen as described herein.

title_en: Immunoregulation short peptide released by digestion of bovine coloctrum powder and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an immunoregulation short peptide released by bovine coloctrum powder through digestion and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the immunoregulation short peptide is LPLMI. The bovine colostrum short peptide library is prepared by adopting simulated digestion, immune target targeted screening is completed based on AlphaFold structure prediction, and in-vivo experiments of mice and in-vitro experiments of RAW264.7 cells are combined to prove that the bovine colostrum can effectively assist in enhancing the immune function of organisms, and the LI5 simulated digestion short peptide obtained by screening has good safety, can obviously inhibit inflammatory factor release and clear active oxygen, has excellent immune regulation and anti-inflammatory antioxidant functions, and can be used for preparing immune enhancement products.

title_en: Composite microbial inoculum and application thereof in household garbage treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite microbial agent and application thereof in household garbage treatment, belongs to the fields of microbial fermentation and environmental protection and energy conservation, and is suitable for the pretreatment of low-temperature (less than or equal to-10 ℃) garbage combustion power generation in winter in the north. Aiming at the problems of freezing, difficult draining and low combustion efficiency of garbage moisture, the composite microbial inoculum (SH-2) is prepared by compounding bacillus coagulans, pseudomonas fluorescens, bacillus licheniformis and bacillus gamboges according to the ratio of 1-5:1-3:1-3:1-5, and the concentration of bacterial liquid is 10  7 ~10 9  CFU/mL. The garbage draining efficiency can reach 56.7% after the garbage draining efficiency is acted on the household garbage, the garbage heat value is increased to 2250-2350 kcal/kg, the slag obtained after combustion is not easy to loosen, the structure is compact, the formability is good, and the compressive strength of the slag manufactured pavement brick is 19-22 MPa.

title_en: Functional flora for degrading crude oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial remediation, and particularly relates to a functional flora for degrading crude oil and a preparation method thereof. The functional flora is composed of rhodococcus, gordonia the genus Klebsiella, the genus Variovorax and the genus Epidermomyces. The strains of each type were found to be 60.79% in rhodococcus, 21.82% in Gordonia, 7.95% in copper, 6.11% in hydrogen and 3.33% in xenorhabdus. The invention cultures high-efficiency petroleum hydrocarbon degrading bacterial colony from oil field sludge, which can obviously improve the metabolism abundance of crude oil pollutants in liquid environment, wherein the bacterial colony comprises genes for degrading easy-degradation hydrocarbon such as medium-long chain alkane, single-ring arene and high-molecular PAHs pollutants, and the bacterial colony can degrade petroleum-polluted water body and tolerates high-concentration petroleum hydrocarbon. The stable degradation rate can reach 48% in the water environment polluted by 1g/L crude oil containing oil, and can reach 18.89% in the water environment polluted by 5g/L crude oil containing oil.

title_en: Cell magnetic separation column and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a cell magnetic separation column which comprises a separation column body and soft magnetic separation sand, wherein the separation column body comprises a through second part and a tip, and the soft magnetic separation sand is made of an alloy comprising iron and chromium and is filled in the second part. The cell magnetic separation column comprises a separation column body and soft magnetic separation sand, wherein the separation column body comprises a through second part and a tip, the soft magnetic separation sand is made of alloy comprising iron and chromium, the soft magnetic separation column body is filled in the second part, the ferrochrome alloy has soft magnetism and stronger corrosion resistance and oxidation resistance, the soft magnetic separation column is suitable for being used as the soft magnetic separation sand, a thermoplastic polymer material layer is not required to be coated on the surface of the soft magnetic separation column body or a protective film is not required to be added, the preparation process is simplified, and the corrosion resistance and oxidation resistance of the ferrochrome alloy are stable, so that the cell magnetic separation column can be reused.

title_en: KVB40a with benzoic acid tolerance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological soil remediation, and particularly relates to a KVB40a with benzoic acid resistance and application thereof, wherein the KVB40a is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (China Committee) for culture Collection of microorganisms, the preservation time is 2026, 04 and 13 days, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.7.719. KVB40a of the KVM strain disclosed by the invention can grow in LB medium containing 1.0g/L benzoic acid, and the evolved strain can be inherited stably for the tolerance of benzoic acid and keeps the benzoic acid decomposition capability. The evolved strain recovers growth in 6-12 h under the acidic condition, the hysteresis period is obviously shorter than that of the original strain, the original strain is completely inhibited from growing when the mass percentage of NaCl is 5%, and the KVB40a can grow normally, which proves that the tolerance of the KVB40a to acid and salt is better than that of the original strain.

title_en: Preparation method of high-activity fresh collagen peptide through ultrasonic synergistic enzymolysis and application of high-activity fresh collagen peptide in promotion of collagen generation
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of high-activity fresh collagen peptide by ultrasonic synergistic enzymolysis and application of promoting collagen generation, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of bioactive peptide, the method comprises the steps of crushing collagen raw materials, mixing the crushed collagen raw materials with purified water to prepare homogenate, adding flavourzyme for constant-temperature stirring to obtain fishy smell removal modified homogenate, then placing the fishy smell removal modified homogenate into an ultrasonic reactor, carrying out ultrasonic treatment by adopting double-frequency alternating pulses and heating by adopting gradient program to obtain loose modified collagen feed liquid; adding compound protease, stirring at constant temperature to perform mild directional enzymolysis to obtain crude collagen peptide enzymolysis solution, performing high-temperature enzyme deactivation treatment, sequentially filtering with a screen, micro-filtering, and ultra-filtering to obtain refined peptide solution, vacuum concentrating, and drying to obtain high-activity fresh collagen peptide powder. The invention solves the technical problems that the collagen natural structure is easy to be damaged by the pretreatment of the traditional technology, the active peptide is seriously lost in the processing process, the product quality is difficult to be ensured under the high-yield condition, and the like.

title_en: Sample tray for temperature sensitive reactions
abstract_en: A sample tray for temperature sensitive reactions includes a plurality of sample wells and a rim. The plurality of sample grooves are independent from each other in the length direction of the frame, and each sample groove is connected with the frame in the width direction of the frame through two floating ribs positioned at two sides of the sample groove.

title_en: Application of biological material for editing CsYTH gene in aspect of regulating and controlling cucumber fruit length
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a biological material editing CsYTH genes in regulating and controlling cucumber fruit length, belonging to the field of cucumber breeding. The biological material controls the cucumber fruit length by partially or completely disabling one chain of two allelic chains in CsYTH gene through gene editing and the other chain does not generate any mutation, or controls the cucumber fruit length by completely disabling only the PrLD domain function in CsYTH protein through gene editing, the fruit length of the cucumber material with the mutation generated in CsYTH gene is obviously increased relative to the fruit length of a wild type cucumber variety, and the cucumber material with the mutation is not accompanied by a serious negative phenotype. The biological material provided by the invention can improve cucumber germplasm or variety, and can obviously improve cucumber fruit length and yield.

title_en: Brevibacterium strain Meng Maiye and application thereof in distiller's grains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strain of Saccharomyces cerevisiae also Meng Maiye and application thereof in distiller's grains, relates to the field of biological manufacturing, and particularly discloses a strain of Saccharomyces cerevisiae also Meng Maiye (Meyerozyma guilliermondii), which is BJZ-6 for short, and has a preservation number of CGMCC No. 39087. The strain can efficiently utilize xylose, can resist inhibitors in distiller's grains, and has strong protein synthesis capability. The invention also provides a method for producing mycoprotein by utilizing the strain to ferment the distiller's grains in liquid or solid state, and the whole component utilization of the distiller's grains can be realized by carrying out wet grinding pretreatment and enzymolysis and then fermenting, so that the crude protein and true protein content of the product are obviously improved. The strain and the fermentation product can be used for preparing animal feed or feed additive.

title_en: Culture medium for mass production of spore by hypocrea discoid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mass-production spore culture medium of a hypocrea discoid and application thereof. The mass-production spore culture medium for the hypocrea discoid comprises 21-23 g/L of lactose, 14-16 g/L of yeast extract powder, 0.4-0.6 g/L of potassium chloride, 0.4-0.6 g/L of magnesium sulfate, 0.4-0.6 g/L of monopotassium phosphate, 0.55-0.75 g/L of disodium hydrogen phosphate, 5-7 mg/L of sodium molybdate dihydrate, VB  6  -60 mg/L, 20-30 mg/L of arginine and 18-22 g/L of agar, and the volume is fixed by double distilled water, and the pH is natural. The culture medium prepared by the invention is used for culturing the hypocrea discoid, can obviously improve the yield (164 times) of the hypocrea discoid spores, reaches 2.21 multiplied by 10  8  conidia/cm 2 , and provides reference conditions for mass production of the hypocrea discoid spores.

title_en: Discovery and application of alternariol monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-Alternariol (AOH) monoclonal antibody sequence and application thereof. The monoclonal antibody is a rabbit antibody prepared by a single B cell screening technology and comprises specific heavy chain and light chain complementarity determining region sequences. The half effective concentration EC50 of the antibody combined with AOH-BSA is 4.88 ng/mL, the half inhibition concentration IC50 for free AOH is 10.45 mug/mL, and the cross reaction rate with other Alternaria alternata is lower than 5%. The invention also provides nucleic acid molecules, expression vectors and host cells encoding the antibodies. The invention applies single B cell screening technology to the development of the AOH small molecule hapten antibody, obviously shortens the preparation period, and the obtained antibody has certain sensitivity and high specificity, can be used for the rapid detection and sample pretreatment of AOH in grains, fruits and vegetables and processed products thereof, and provides a new technical means for food safety supervision.

title_en: Pogostemon yunnanensis detoxification metabolic gene, dsRNA (double-stranded ribonucleic acid) thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toxin-expelling metabolic gene of cyrtosis yunnanensis, dsRNA (double-stranded ribonucleic acid) and application thereof, belonging to the technical fields of genetic engineering and biological control. The invention develops two dsRNAs based on the Yunnan bark beetle detoxification metabolic genes TyCYP-5 and TyJehe, and can be used for efficiently silencing the detoxification metabolic genes of the Yunnan bark beetle on S-alpha-pinene. The sensitivity of the Yunnan bark beetle to S-alpha-pinene can be obviously increased and the lethality of the Yunnan bark beetle under the action of the S-alpha-pinene can be improved by injecting the two dsRNAs prepared by the invention into the Yunnan bark beetle. Provides a brand new thought and target point for green prevention and control of stem borers, and provides a theoretical basis for developing novel biological prevention and control technology and reducing the use of chemical pesticides.

title_en: Method and system for producing biogas from lignocellulosic material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated combined process and corresponding plant for producing biogas from raw materials comprising lignocellulosic material, in particular from raw materials having a high content of lignocellulosic material, in an energy and resource saving manner by applying a plurality of fermentation steps and optimized recycling steps.

title_en: SiRNA and RNA delivery system for inhibiting replication of Banda virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an siRNA and RNA delivery system for inhibiting replication of Banda virus and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of nucleic acid medicaments and antiviral treatment. siRNA is designed for the S segment conservation region of the SFTSV, so that the siRNA can target the S segments of different strains of the SFTSV and other S segments of the Banda virus, and can reduce the level of viral RNA, the expression of viral proteins and the titer of the virus in a cell model, thereby inhibiting the replication of the Banda virus. In addition, the invention also provides an RNA delivery system which can realize the in vivo effective delivery of siRNA and enhance the antiviral effect. Therefore, the siRNA provided by the invention is hopeful to be used for preventing or treating various Banda virus infections such as SFTSV and the like.

title_en: Treatment method for directionally enriching 6-shogaol through microbial fermentation to enhance dampness removing effect of ginger and improve spicy flavor
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method for directionally enriching 6-shogaol by microbial fermentation to enhance the dampness removing effect of ginger and improve the spicy flavor, which comprises the fermentation processing of ginger, wherein the fermentation strain used in the fermentation processing comprises at least one of Lactobacillus paracasei LP8082, lactobacillus plantarum Z1 and Lactobacillus paracasei F1 with the preservation number of GDMCC No. 67814. The processing method for reducing the spicy component of the ginger provided by the invention can accurately reduce the spicy component of the ginger, so that 6-gingerol is converted into 6-shogaol with stronger efficacy, and novel ginger products with definite efficacy, such as sweating, damp expelling, anti-inflammatory, enhancing and avoiding effects and the like and mild taste are developed, thereby meeting the requirements of the market on high-quality natural healthy products.

title_en: Microinjection system and injection method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microinjection, in particular to a microinjection system and an injection method, wherein a microinjection device comprises a movable carrying platform, at least two mechanical arms and injectors correspondingly arranged at the tail end of each mechanical arm, the movable carrying platform comprises a horizontal moving platform and a rotating platform, the rotating platform is arranged on the horizontal moving platform and is used for carrying culture dishes for accommodating at least two different types of samples, the rotating axis of the rotating platform is vertically arranged, the horizontal moving platform is used for driving the rotating platform to move in the horizontal X direction and the horizontal Y direction which are mutually perpendicular, the number of the injectors is the same as the number of the types of the samples, and the at least two mechanical arms respectively drive the injectors at the tail end to perform injection operation on one type of samples. The application can inject multiple types of samples on the same culture dish, thereby greatly improving the microinjection operation efficiency.

title_en: Low-temperature corrosion-promoting composite microbial agent, straw in-situ efficient returning method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature corrosion-promoting composite microbial agent, a straw in-situ efficient returning method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial preparations. The bacterial strain comprises the following components of, by mass, stenotrophomonas maltophilia JGDQ-2, bacillus JX-7, weissella antraniliprole zqw90, weissella enterica zqw, and Neurospora crassa N7, wherein the mass ratio of viable bacteria to the bacterial strain is 1-2:1-2:1.5-2:2.5-2. According to the invention, efficient cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin degradation strains are systematically screened, a multi-bacterium synergistic and functional complementary composite bacterial system is constructed, synchronous efficient degradation of each component of the straw is realized, the overall decomposition efficiency is improved, and the soil nutrient components are improved.

title_en: Plasmid transformation method for improving AAV yield through auxiliary genes and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plasmid transformation method for improving AAV yield through auxiliary genes and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The technical problem to be solved is to provide a simple plasmid transformation method for efficiently improving the AAV packaging yield, so as to solve the problems of lack of an efficient auxiliary scheme, low AAV scale production efficiency and the like in the prior art. The technical scheme is characterized by comprising a plasmid transformation method for improving AAV yield through auxiliary genes, wherein HPV E6 genes and XBP1 genes are simultaneously introduced into a packaging system containing auxiliary plasmids for producing AAV.

title_en: Oligonucleotide dyeing probe library for tracking wheat D genome chromosome and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant molecular cytogenetics, and in particular relates to an oligonucleotide fluorescent in-situ hybridization probe library capable of specifically recognizing and coating all No. 1-7 chromosomes of aegilops tauschii serving as wheat D genome donor seeds, wherein the probe library comprises 7 oligonucleotide probes capable of specifically recognizing and coating all No. 1-7 chromosomes of aegilops tauschii respectively, and the oligonucleotide probes can be applied to tracing the origin of wheat D subgenomic groups, analyzing the chromosome evolutionary relationship among aegilops species and identifying the chromosome structural variation in durum wheat-aegilops tauschii derivative materials.

title_en: Microorganism combination, composite microbial agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a microorganism combination, a compound microbial inoculum and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microbial fertilizers. The preservation number of the bacillus composts SR01-10 is CGMCC No.39418, and the preservation number of the bacillus composts SR01-9 is CGMCC No.39417. Both strains have the capabilities of decomposing cellulose, degrading protein, decomposing potassium, producing siderophores, degrading fat, dissolving inorganic phosphorus and the like, can antagonize plant pathogenic bacteria, and has good growth promoting effect on corn and strawberries. Compared with single strain application, the compound microbial inoculum formed by compounding SR01-10 and SR01-9 according to the proportion of 1:1 can exert the synergistic effect among strains, has more prominent effect on the growth promotion of strawberries and corns, has obviously stronger comprehensive growth promotion capability than two single strains, and has good development and application prospects.

title_en: Method for constructing spontaneous epilepsy mouse model and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and application of a spontaneous epilepsy mouse model, and belongs to the technical field of animal model modeling. The invention constructs a targeting vector by using CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, introduces the targeting vector carrying the p.N179K mutation Foxg expression sequence by a homologous recombination mode on the basis of keeping endogenous Foxg gene expression, carries out microinjection on the targeting vector, cas9 and sgRNA into fertilized eggs of mice together, obtains F0 generation chimeric mice, further carries out mating with wild mice, and screens by PCR, southern blot and other methods to obtain F1 generation positive mice. Wherein, p.N179K is the homologous site of human FOXG1 pathogenic mutation p.N187K in mice. The mouse model constructed by the invention can stably show spontaneous epileptic phenotype and accompany abnormal brain electrical activity by introducing mutant FOXG1 protein while keeping endogenous Foxg gene expression, can be applied to preparation of animal models for screening anti-epileptic drugs, and has important basic research and clinical transformation value.

title_en: Deep sea biodiversity monitoring is with filtering sampling device based on eDNA
abstract_en: The application discloses an eDNA-based filtering and sampling device for monitoring deep sea biodiversity, which relates to the technical field of marine sediment sampling, and is characterized in that an unmanned submarine provided with a suction device is used for operation, a motor-driven fixing piece is arranged at the bottom of the submarine, an electric push rod is rotatably connected with a container shell to control the displacement of a box body piece, a sampling assembly arranged on the box body piece is composed of a rotatable fan-shaped end body, a middle body and a tail body, the rotatable fan-shaped end body, the middle body and the tail body are connected through a fixed shaft, isolation films are formed between the parts to form an isolation space, the end body, the middle body and the tail body are controlled to rotate through a miniature motor, so that the sampling assembly can twist into a coral reef to sample sediment, a sampling hose is fixed in the sampling assembly, the tail end of the sampling assembly is communicated with the suction device of the submarine, a separation net is arranged at a sampling port to filter large-particle sand stone, and a camera is arranged at the top of the end body, so that sediment inside the coral reef is conveniently observed.

title_en: Single-reactor overspeed PCR amplification and real-time fluorescence signal monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a single reactor hypervelocity PCR amplifications and real-time fluorescence signal monitoring devices, including the ultra-thin reactor of quick heat-conduction, the temperature difference container that heats/refrigerate and the real-time fluorescence monitoring optic fibre that have super hydrophobic silver nanometer coating. The utility model improves the temperature rising and falling speed by spraying the heat conducting coating on the outer surface of the ultra-thin reactor, so as to meet the requirement of rapid temperature change of ultra-fast PCR reaction; and meanwhile, the integrated light source and the monitoring optical fiber for collecting the real-time fluorescent signal are used, so that the overspeed PCR amplification instrument and the real-time fluorescent signal monitoring device are simple and portable.

title_en: Microbial inoculum culture apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microbial inoculum culture apparatus relates to microbial inoculum culture field, including the culture tank, the inside of culture tank is provided with the culture dish, and the inboard of culture tank is provided with the spout piece, the culture dish be provided with spout piece matched with slider, and the culture dish passes through slider and culture tank sliding connection, be provided with the spring between the bottom of culture dish and the culture tank, and the inside bottom of culture tank is provided with first motor, the output of first motor is connected with the eccentric wheel. The utility model discloses a sliding connection has the culture dish in the culture tank, and first motor drives the eccentric wheel and rotates, and when the eccentric wheel was laminated with the bottom of culture dish, the culture dish was by jack-up, and when the bottom of culture dish was not laminated with the eccentric wheel, the culture dish fell, and the spring played the cushioning effect to fall again through the periodic jack-up culture dish of eccentric wheel, make the culture dish vibrate, increase the mobility of zymotic fluid, make the better mixture of zymotic fluid.

title_en: Probiotics liquid fermentation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a probiotic liquid fermentation device, which comprises a sealing tank, a stirring rod and a stirring structure, wherein the top end of the sealing tank is hermetically connected with a sealing cover, the middle part of the upper surface of the sealing cover is provided with a hole, the inner wall of the hole is spliced with a sealing plug, one end of the stirring rod passes through the sealing plug and the sealing cover, and one end of the stirring rod is welded with a handle; the utility model discloses a be equipped with the handle, puddler and stirring structure, drive the puddler motion through the handle, and then drive the motion of stirring structure, stir the liquid in the seal pot, the handle can enough stimulate the puddler up-and-down motion, also can rotate the handle and drive the puddler rotation, and then drive the motion of stirring structure, because the coefficient of elasticity of stirring structure is bigger, can enough stir liquid through rocking from top to bottom, also can stir liquid through rotating stirring structure, thereby can stir liquid from the equidirectional, ensure yeast and liquid misce bene, it is inhomogeneous to avoid the fermentation.

title_en: Negative pressure enrichment device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the DNA enrichment device, concretely relates to negative pressure enrichment device. The device comprises a shell, a negative pressure enrichment unit and a control unit, wherein the negative pressure enrichment unit and the control unit are respectively arranged on the shell, the negative pressure enrichment unit comprises a liquid filtering module, a negative pressure water pump and a water outlet, the negative pressure water pump is respectively communicated with the liquid filtering module and the water outlet, the control unit controls the power supply of a system and the opening and closing of the negative pressure water pump, the liquid filtering module comprises an enrichment device and a connecting seat, a filter membrane is installed in the enrichment device, the enrichment device is detachably installed on the connecting seat, and a closed cavity pipeline is formed in the enrichment device; negative pressure pump and connecting seat are linked together through the pipeline, the utility model discloses a collection sample is gathered and is richened in the device of integration, not only can sample in succession, can show moreover and reduce the energy consumption, simplifies the DNA enrichment process in the environmental sample.

title_en: Multifunctional microorganism inoculation sterilization device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of microorganism experiments, in particular to a multifunctional microorganism inoculation sterilization device, which is characterized by comprising a sterilization tube body and a sterilization tube cap detachably connected with the sterilization tube body, wherein the port of the sterilization tube body is provided with a support plate which is provided with a round hole; the utility model discloses a sterilization pipe body, including sterilization pipe body, metal connecting rod, heating structure, locking piece, mounting hole, push rod, the internal heating structure that is equipped with of sterilization pipe, heating structure one end is connected with metal connecting rod, and metal connecting rod's diameter is less than the diameter of round hole, and the metal connecting rod is connected with the inoculation instrument, and the heating structure other end is connected with the push rod, is equipped with the retaining member that screw thread and match with it on the push rod, is equipped with the mounting hole on the terminal. The utility model has the advantages that: can realize the sterilization of a plurality of inoculation tools at one time, is suitable for different inoculation containers, improves the inoculation efficiency and realizes the aseptic operation in the inoculation process.

title_en: Constant-temperature horizontal shaking table with good protection performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a constant temperature horizontal shaking table with good protection performance, which comprises a box body and a box cover, wherein the top of the box cover is provided with a viewing port, a bed body is arranged in the box body, the top of the bed body is provided with a groove, a limiting rod is evenly arranged in the groove, the outer wall of the limiting rod is sleeved with two limiting rings and two limiting plates, the two limiting plates are arranged between the two limiting rings, the distance between the two limiting plates is adjusted by rotating the two limiting rings, after the size of a liquid cup is adjusted to be suitable for the size of the liquid cup, the liquid cup is placed on a placing plate, the first heavy fixation is carried out by the extrusion of the limiting rings, the operation is simple, the use is convenient, the vibration caused by the collision of the box body can be effectively prevented through the first damping block, the second damping block, the first elastic rope and the second elastic rope, the protection performance is good, when the bed body, and a good working environment is maintained.

title_en: Bacterial colony fermentation device based on biotechnology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bacterial colony fermentation device based on biotechnology belongs to the fermentation technology field, including the shock attenuation seat, the upper end of shock attenuation seat is provided with the base, the upper end of base is provided with the fermenting case, the upper end side of fermenting case is provided with the gas vent, the inside both sides of pedestal are provided with the fixing base, the utility model discloses a connecting rod rotates to move and makes the slider slide along the horizontal pole, and reset spring elastic buffering makes the slider move back, and the connecting rod rotates and drives the fixed plate move back, and spacing slide bar moves down, receives the buffer spring elastic force effect to move back, makes the fixed plate move up, and double shock attenuation effectively reduces the vibrations that the fermentation stirring produced, improves the shock attenuation, the noise reduction; the utility model discloses a quick lime drying layer that absorbs water carries out the absorption of moisture, filters the cotton layer and carries out the filtration of impurity, and the active carbon adsorption layer carries out peculiar smell and heavy metal adsorption, improves gas outgoing clean, improves the filter effect.

title_en: Sperm screening injection dish
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sperm screening injection dish, including box body and lid, be provided with a plurality of ovum storage tank, a plurality of sperm washing tank and a plurality of sperm screening groove on the bottom plate of box body, the sperm screening groove includes the screening platform, is located the sperm storage tank on the relative both ends of this screening platform and with the ramp of sperm storage tank and screening platform intercommunication, the top surface of screening platform is no longer than the top surface of bottom plate, and is higher than the sperm storage tank, and this screening platform is rectangular shape, and two sperm storage tanks are located this screening platform length direction's both ends respectively to solve the problem that the injection dish can't separate sperm and impurity completely and influence its injection.

title_en: Biochemical incubator for detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a biochemical incubator for detection, which reduces the condition that a shelter in a working cavity influences the disinfection effect, improves the disinfection effect in the working cavity and improves the practicability; the ultraviolet disinfection lamp tube is arranged at the top of the working chamber; still include water tank, first support, ultrasonic atomization ware, ultrasonic atomization controller, air pump, second support, heating cabinet and third conveyer pipe, the inside of water tank is provided with the holding chamber, and the top of water tank is provided with the entry to the entry communicates with each other with the holding chamber, and the bottom of water tank is connected with the top of first support, and ultrasonic atomization ware fixed mounting is in the inside in holding chamber.

title_en: Cell electrical stimulation culture apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell electro photoluminescence culture apparatus, include: the center of the culture unit is provided with a connecting channel which vertically extends along the height direction of the culture unit and penetrates through the culture unit, and a closed storage space for containing a culture solution is formed in the culture unit; an outer housing in which the culture unit is disposed; the outer shell is internally provided with a conductive column, the culture unit is sleeved on the conductive column, the conductive column penetrates through the connecting channel, and the side wall of the outer shell is made of a conductor material; and the negative pole of the power supply is connected with the conductive column, and the positive pole of the power supply is connected with the side wall of the outer shell. The utility model can highly simulate the simulated electric field and physiological environment which are closer to the real pathological condition of the wound area; because the conductive column passes through the connecting channel and the storage environment for accommodating the culture solution is closed, the electrode can not be directly contacted with the culture solution, and the potential interference of cell generation cytotoxic substances and magnetic fields to cells is avoided.

title_en: Immune cell amplification culture instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an immune cell amplification culture instrument, including main part mechanism, main part mechanism has seted up the cultivation room including cultivateing the appearance main part, cultivates the inside of appearance main part, and the one end surface of cultivateing the appearance main part is rotated and is connected with sealing door, and the inside of cultivateing the room is provided with buffer gear, and buffer gear's upper surface is provided with fixture, the utility model discloses the beneficial effect who reaches is: prevent through setting up horizontal buffer board and vertical buffer board that the culture solution from spilling in the air vent of cultivateing the board, influence the final data of cultivateing, wherein when opening and close the sealing door, probably can make the appearance main part of cultivateing take place to shift, make inside cultivation board take place to vibrate, when taking place to vibrate, the slider of vertical buffer board bottom slides along the stock, and compress the spring at both ends, carry out vertical buffering, horizontal buffer board drives branch and removes, branch drives the pulley through the pivot and undulates in the arc wall and slides, carry out horizontal buffering, prevent the culture solution spill.

title_en: Medical multifunctional inspection analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a medical multifunctional inspection analyzer which can ensure that a sample is at a proper temperature in the detection process and has high detection accuracy; the water pump comprises a base plate, the work box, sealed lid, first backup pad, the water tank, trade the water pipe, the drain pipe, the second backup pad, a water pump, the heat exchange tube, temperature display instrument, temperature sensor and signal line, work box fixed mounting is in the upper end of bottom plate, be provided with the sealing door that can open and shut on the work box, the inside of work box is provided with the cavity, the upper end of work box is the opening, be provided with detection and analysis appearance in the cavity of work box, detection and analysis appearance passes through the electric wire and is connected with external power source, sealed lid fixed mounting is in the upper end of work box, first backup pad fixed mounting is at the right-hand member of work box, water tank fixed mounting is in the upper end of first backup pad, be provided with the cavity on the water tank, the inside of water tank is provided with the heater.

title_en: Improvement device that agrobacterium infects plant callus
abstract_en: An improved device for plant callus impregnated by agrobacterium comprises an outer bottle for containing agrobacterium solution, an inner bottle sleeved in the outer bottle, a plurality of through holes arranged on the inner bottle, and a discharge pipe arranged at the bottom of the outer bottle; the vacuum-pumping mechanism is arranged at the bottleneck of the inner bottle; and a stirring mechanism for driving the agrobacterium solution in the outer bottle to rotate is also arranged in the outer bottle. This application can make plant material fully dip-dye, improves conversion efficiency, and the discharge pipe that the bottom set up can be taken the unnecessary moisture in the bottle out, reduces miscellaneous fungus and pollutes, and the evacuating device that the top set up can get rid of the unnecessary moisture in the bottle as fast as possible, avoids miscellaneous fungus to pollute.

title_en: Microorganism culture box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biological tissue culture, in particular to a microorganism culture box; including box body and lid, it is articulated through the hinge between the rear end of lid and the box body, be connected through the hasp between the front end of lid and the box body, the inside inner wall sliding connection of box body has a plurality of baffles, the baffle cuts off box body inside into a plurality of culture spaces, the inside bottom surface of box body can be dismantled and be connected with a plurality of microorganism culture dishes. The utility model can culture a plurality of microorganisms in the microorganism culture box simultaneously by connecting a plurality of microorganism culture dishes detachably on the bottom surface inside the box body, thereby improving the culture efficiency; through sliding connection between setting up box body and the baffle, the size in every culture space can be adjusted to a plurality of microorganism culture dishes of connection can be dismantled to the inside bottom surface of cooperation box body to can select according to the size of different microorganism culture dishes, and then realize cultivateing the size of different microorganism culture dishes, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Biological testing device with good communication performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biological testing device with communications nature is good, including test incubator, case lid, fastening structure and test culture apparatus, the test incubator is rectangle case column structure, the inside three chamber that holds of having seted up of test incubator holds the intracavity and is provided with a plurality of test culture apparatus, the articulated three case lid of installing on one side of test incubator, the case lid is close to and is provided with sealed the pad on one side that holds the chamber, the case lid is kept away from sealed one side of filling up and is fixed with the handle on one side of keeping away from the hinged end, the joint groove has been seted up to the one end that the hinged end was kept away from to case lid and sealed pad, the fastening chamber has been seted up on the outside limit of test incubator, and the fastening intracavity is provided with fastening structure, the joint cooperation between fastening structure and the joint groove. This biological test device with communication nature is good, reasonable in design can adapt to the regulation demand of different temperatures, is fit for using widely.

title_en: Multifunctional culture device for bacterial biofilm
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bacterial biofilm technical field specifically discloses a bacterial biofilm's multi-functional culture apparatus, including the incubator, the left side fixedly connected with fixed plate at incubator top, the front side fixedly connected with singlechip of fixed plate, the fixedly connected with servo motor of center department at incubator top. The utility model discloses a servo motor drives the pivot and rotates, the pivot drives the cover seat and rotates, the rotation through the cover seat drives the culture plate and rotates, thereby can stir liquid culture solution and cultivation microorganism, the work through the ultraviolet sterilizing lamp is disinfected to incubator inside air, detect the temperature in the incubator through temperature sensor at last, detect data transmission to the in-chip processing, if the temperature is too high in the incubator, single chip microcomputer control fan and heater strip stop work, thereby know at any time and control the temperature in the incubator, multi-functional advantage has been reached.

title_en: Novel microbial cultivation case
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel microbial cultivation case, include: the device comprises a base, a box body, a box door, a partition block, a vent hole, an electric heating wire, an ultraviolet germicidal lamp, an ozone sterilization machine, a heat insulation layer, a first magnetic strip, a second magnetic strip and filter cotton; the base is in a rectangular plate shape; the box body is arranged at the top end of the base, and the box body is connected with the base in a bolt fixing mode; the box door is arranged at the front end of the box body, and the right end of the box door is connected with the box body through a hinge; the second magnetic strip is arranged inside the left side of the box door and connected with the box door in an embedded mode; the first magnetic strip is arranged inside the front end of the left side of the box body and connected with the box body in an embedded mode; the utility model has the advantages of reasonable structure, thorough sterilization and high culture efficiency, thereby effectively solving the problem and the deficiency of the prior art.

title_en: Novel kitchen waste treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel kitchen garbage disposal system belongs to municipal environmental protection field. The utility model discloses a kitchen garbage crusher, water seal return bend, public sewage pipes, UV photodissociation deodorizing device, draught fan, thick liquid conveying tank car, anaerobic reaction jar, organic thick liquid pond and organic thick liquid pipeline of keeping in, kitchen garbage crusher and water seal return bend are connected, the water seal return bend is connected with public sewage pipes, public sewage pipes is connected with organic thick liquid conveying pipe, organic thick liquid conveying pipe keeps in the pond with organic thick liquid and is connected, organic thick liquid keeps in the pond and is connected with thick liquid conveying tank car, thick liquid conveying tank car is connected with anaerobic reaction jar, UV photodissociation deodorizing device is connected with organic thick liquid pond, the draught fan keeps in the photodissociation deodorizing device with UV and is connected.

title_en: Ice box in RNA extraction process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ice box of RNA extraction in-process, including ice box body, installed part and fixed slot, the mounting groove has been seted up to the surface symmetry of ice box body, the installed part is installed in the outside of mounting groove, the fixed slot has been seted up in the outside of ice box body, and the fixed slot is located the below of mounting groove, the press cover is installed at the top of ice box body, sealed piece is installed to the bottom of press cover. The arrangement of the upright post, the adjustable tube, the adjustable screw, the interval culture plate and the recording sheet is favorable for interval culture and meets the requirements; the water injection lid, the storage water tank, the humidification suction pump, metal collapsible tube, the water spray is discharged and the setting of humidification nozzle is favorable to increasing humidity to guarantee to cultivate the effect.

title_en: Improved generation cell culture bag
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cell culture bags, and particularly discloses an improved cell culture bag which comprises a bag body, wherein the periphery of the bag body is thermally sealed to form a sealed edge, the top end of the bag body is connected with a liquid inlet pipe and a liquid transfer pipe, the bottom end of the bag body is connected with a liquid discharge pipe, a liquid discharge valve is arranged on the liquid discharge pipe, the improved cell culture bag also comprises a liquid guide mechanism, the liquid guide mechanism comprises liquid guide blocks symmetrically arranged on two sides of the bottom inside the bag body and a liquid collecting hopper embedded in the bottom end inside the bag body, and the bottom end of the liquid collecting hopper is connected with the top of the liquid discharge pipe and communicated with the liquid discharge pipe. The cell liquid guiding mechanism can realize the flow guiding of the cell liquid, so that the clean liquid drainage of the culture bag is realized, the cell liquid is effectively prevented from remaining in the culture bag to cause waste, the resource utilization rate is greatly improved, and the cell culture experiment cost is favorably saved.

title_en: Automatic pressure release ferment fermentation cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic pressure-relief enzyme fermentation tank which comprises a fermentation tank body; the top of the fermentation tank body is provided with an automatic pressure relief mechanism; the automatic pressure relief mechanism consists of a connecting part, a filtering part and an exhaust part which are mutually communicated; the bottom end of the connecting part is connected with the top of the fermentation tank body, and the top of the connecting part is connected with the bottom of the filtering part; the filter part is large in the middle and small in two ends, more than one layer of filter plate is arranged in the inner cavity of the filter part, and a plurality of lyophobic holes are discretely arranged on the filter plate; a compression spring is arranged at the upper part of the inner cavity of the exhaust part, the top end of the compression spring is fixedly connected with the inner top wall of the exhaust part, the bottom end of the compression spring is connected with a plug part, and the outer circumferential surface of the plug part is attached to the inner side wall of the exhaust part; the side wall of the exhaust part is provided with an exhaust hole. This fermentation cylinder can effectively avoid gaseous entrainment liquid and solid matter to block up the exhaust hole during the pressure release to guarantee the normal clear of pressure release.

title_en: Biochip reaction box with waste liquid bag, assembly and hybridization instrument

The utility model can conveniently collect the residual waste liquid of the hybridization reaction by adding the waste liquid bag, thereby avoiding the waste liquid from being thrown into a reaction bin of the instrument and ensuring the cleanness of the detection instrument and the unaffected surrounding environment/air.

title_en: 96-channel nucleic acid detection box with good heat dissipation effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 96-channel nucleic acid detection box with a good heat dissipation effect, and particularly relates to the technical field of nucleic acid detection. Through the side-mounting heat dissipation bellows at sealed detection case, when needs use sealed detection case, start the inside extraction fan group of heat dissipation bellows earlier, one side of sealed detection case inside is equipped with a set of through-hole and louvre, the guiding gutter on through-hole and the sealing bottom plate is linked together, the work of extraction fan group can take out the dust and the heat of sealed detection case inside through the louvre, prevent that the dust from influencing the experimental result, through the heat dissipation, accelerate the heat emission, conveniently carry out the experiment next time fast.

title_en: Virus sampler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a virus sampler, which comprises a sampling tube, wherein a tube cover is arranged at the top end of the sampling tube, a rubber block is arranged at the inner top of the tube cover, the outer wall of the rubber block is abutted against the inner wall of the tube cover, a mounting hole penetrates through the top of the tube cover, the rubber block penetrates through the mounting hole, a swab is arranged in the sampling tube, and the top end of the swab is arranged in the mounting hole. When the sampling tube is shaken, the swab in the sampling tube can perform better stability in the sampling tube.

title_en: Stem cell collection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stem cell collecting device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is connected with a box body through a bolt, an inner cavity of the box body is fixedly connected with a mixing mechanism, the bottom of the mixing mechanism is communicated with a first electromagnetic valve, the bottom of the first electromagnetic valve penetrates through the bottom of the box body, the top of the surface of the mixing mechanism penetrates through and is fixedly connected with a flushing pipe, and the top of the mixing mechanism is connected with a stirring mechanism through a bolt. The device comprises a base plate, a washing mechanism, a mixing mechanism, a stirring mechanism, a box body, a liquid storage tank, a cleaning water pump, a connecting pipe, an insertion shell, an insertion plate, an ice bag box, a washing pipe, a second electromagnetic valve, a mixing tank, a clamping plate, a clamping spring, a vertical plate, a first electromagnetic valve, a rotating rod, a stirring rod and a motor.

title_en: Microbial fermentation device with circulation fermentation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microbial fermentation device with a circulating fermentation function, which relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation and comprises a tank body, wherein a stirring assembly is arranged inside the tank body, an air outlet pipe is arranged at the top end of the tank body, a connecting pipe is arranged on one side of the air outlet pipe, an external thread section is arranged on the outer side of the connecting pipe, a threaded connecting cylinder is sleeved on the outer sides of the air outlet pipe and the connecting pipe, and a sealing assembly is arranged between the threaded connecting cylinder and the air outlet pipe as well as between the threaded connecting cylinder and the connecting pipe. According to the utility model, through the arranged stirring assembly, the transversely arranged stirring shaft and the stirring blades, the raw material at the bottom of the tank body can be stirred upwards, so that the raw material at the bottom of the tank body can be contacted with oxygen, and thus the fermentation efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Centrifuge tube for obtaining tissues with specific sizes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifuge tube for acquiring tissues with specific sizes, which is used for separating biological tissues. Above-mentioned centrifuging tube includes the body, is located cutting assembly and movable mounting in the body just are located on the body the pressure lid structure of cutting assembly top. The cutting assembly comprises a pad frame fixedly mounted on the inner wall of the pipe body, a lapping groove formed in the top of the pad frame and a metal mesh matched and assembled in the lapping groove. The pressure cover structure comprises a pipe cover, a screw cavity penetrating through the pipe cover, a sterile plastic block in the pipe cover in threaded connection and four groups of springs fixedly installed at the position of the sterile plastic block facing the cushion frame. The centrifugal tube provided by the utility model is used for promoting the separation of biological tissues based on the pressing operation, the separation space is relatively sealed, the separation sterility is good, a uniform tissue sample can be obtained through one-time cutting, and the tissue damage is small.

The digital label is added, so that focusing reference is provided when the embryo is observed by a microscope, the hole position is conveniently captured and determined, and subsequent operation is facilitated.

abstract_en: The utility model provides a livestock liver protein extraction device, which comprises a protein extraction cylinder, wherein a driven round roller is rotatably arranged between the protein extraction cylinder and a triangular bottom plate, a movable shaft is embedded on the top surface of the protein extraction cylinder, a U-shaped rod is embedded in a groove between the movable shafts, a pre-crushing treatment liquid of livestock liver protein is put into an extraction sample placing test tube, the extraction sample placing test tube is put into a test tube rack, a servo motor is used for providing power to drive a rotating shaft to rotate, the rotation of the rotating shaft drives a driving round roller to rotate, a driving belt is used for driving a driving round roller to rotate, the driving belt drives the driven round roller to rotate, the extraction sample placing test tube on the test tube rack is driven to rotate at a high speed by the rotation of the driven round roller, centrifugal force is generated, and the extraction sample placing test tube is layered under the action of centrifugal force according to the different weights of substances, so that the extracted supernatant obtains purer livestock liver protein, and the purity of the livestock liver protein is effectively improved.

title_en: Quick sterile inspection culture equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sterile inspection equipment, and discloses rapid sterile inspection cultivation equipment for solving the problems that in the prior art, the cultivation speed of the sterile inspection on microorganisms is low and quick inspection cannot be realized; the shaking culture chamber comprises a first cavity, a culture bottle placing tray for horizontally placing culture bottles and a driving device capable of driving the culture bottle placing tray to shake, wherein the first cavity comprises a temperature control device and a sterile inspection recognition device for observing conditions of the culture bottles. The utility model can realize automatic quick inspection of sterile inspection.

title_en: Environment-friendly garbage disposal recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a green and environment-friendly garbage disposal and recovery device, which relates to the technical field of recovery devices and comprises a feed inlet, wherein a cutting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the feed inlet, a heating tank is arranged at the bottom of the cutting assembly, a stirring assembly is arranged in an inner cavity of the heating tank, a plurality of expansion strips are longitudinally arranged in the heating tank, a conveying pipe is arranged at the bottom of the heating tank, a conveying tank is arranged at the bottom of the conveying pipe, a liquid adding assembly is arranged at the top of the conveying tank, a fermentation tank, a slag removing opening and a gas conveying pipe are adopted, the treated garbage is piled in the fermentation tank for fermentation, methane generated by garbage fermentation can be recycled through the gas conveying pipe, besides direct combustion, the methane can be used for cooking, drying agricultural and sideline products, heating, illumination, gas welding and the like, the slag in the fermentation tank can be cleaned through the slag removing opening, the fermentation tank can be overhauled in time, and the methane slag can be used for preparing fertilizer or cultivating trees, and the device has the advantages of green and environment-friendliness and sustainable development.

title_en: Microorganism strain culture device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microorganism strain culture device which comprises a culture box body, a box door and a culture rack, wherein the box door is positioned on the surface of the culture box body and is in rotary connection with the culture box body, the culture rack is arranged in the culture box body and is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the culture box body, the culture rack comprises a center rod, a tray rack and a slide block, the surface of the center rod is fixedly connected with the tray rack which is axially distributed, two ends of the center rod are respectively provided with the slide blocks in rotary connection, the connecting part of the inner wall of the culture box body and the slide blocks is fixedly connected with a guide rail, and the slide blocks are buckled with the surface of the guide rail and are in sliding connection with the guide rail. The utility model utilizes the culture box body, the box door and the culture rack to form the culture device, is convenient for opening the box door and simultaneously driving the culture rack to outwards move through the pull rod, and is matched with the culture rack which is rotationally connected, thereby being convenient for operators to operate when culturing microorganism strains.

title_en: Cell and bacterial toxin seed liquid split charging system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cell and fungus poison seed liquid split charging system which comprises a liquid inlet pipe, a liquid storage device and a liquid outlet pipe, wherein the liquid storage device is provided with an inner cavity, the liquid inlet pipe is communicated with the inner cavity of the liquid storage device, and the liquid outlet pipe is communicated with the inner cavity of the liquid storage device; the liquid outlet pipe is connected with a plurality of split charging branch pipes, each split charging branch pipe is connected with a split charging unit respectively, and each split charging branch pipe is provided with a split charging driving pump respectively. According to the cell and fungus poison seed liquid split charging system provided by the utility model, the liquid outlet pipe is provided with a liquid outlet control valve. The cell and fungus toxin seed liquid split charging system provided by the utility model can split charging simultaneously or independently, so that the split charging efficiency is greatly improved, the split charging time is shortened, and the quality of a cell and fungus toxin seed warehouse is effectively ensured.

title_en: Multi-cavity sampling tube capable of being stored in multiple types
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sampling pipes, in particular to a multi-cavity sampling pipe capable of being stored in multiple types, which comprises a sampling pipe body, wherein a cooling groove is formed in the middle of the inner part of the sampling pipe body, a plurality of groups of through holes are formed in the inner wall of the cooling groove, a plurality of groups of placing cavities are formed in the inner part of the sampling pipe body, which is close to the edge, and springs are arranged at positions, which are close to the two sides of the top, of the corresponding inner wall of the placing cavity. The device has the advantages that the existing sampling tube can be effectively solved by arranging the cooling groove, the through hole, the placing cavity, the spring, the limiting ball, the mounting plate, the cooling tube and other parts, and the single tube is adopted, so that only one detection sample can be collected at a time, the working efficiency is low, the sampling tube does not have a heat preservation function, and needs to be timely sent to the virus sampling tube storage box in a specified time, so that the virus sampling tube is stored in a heat preservation mode, and the process is extremely complicated, so that the problem of the detection result cannot be influenced.

title_en: Fermented bean curd fermentation tank with high-temperature sterilization function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fermented bean curd processing equipment, in particular to a fermented bean curd fermentation tank with a high-temperature sterilization function, which comprises a fermentation tank body, wherein a plurality of groups of pull-type fermented bean curd fermentation containers are arranged on one side of the fermentation tank body, and a waste liquid recovery box is arranged at the bottom of the fermentation tank body; the top has seted up the vent in the fermentation cylinder body, installs the air-blower in the vent, and the electrical heating net is installed to the bottom of air-blower, and the symmetry is provided with the fixed strip that the multiunit is used for installing fermented bean curd fermentation container on the both sides inner wall of fermentation cylinder body, and the air outlet has been seted up to the back bottom side of fermentation cylinder body. According to the utility model, the high-temperature sterilization can be carried out on the fermentation tank body through the air blower and the electric heating net which are arranged at the top of the fermentation tank body, and after the electric heating net is closed, the air blower works independently to improve the ventilation effect, the bottom of the containing box is a mesh plate, so that the ventilation effect is improved, and when the fermentation tank is sterilized at high temperature, the containing box can be inserted into the fermentation tank body to synchronously carry out sterilization, so that the fermented bean curd fermentation environment is improved.

title_en: Enzymolysis tank with prevent blockking up function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an enzymolysis tank with an anti-blocking function, and relates to the technical field of enzymolysis tanks. The enzymolysis tank with the anti-blocking function comprises a device body, wherein the bottom of the device body is fixedly connected with supporting legs, the top of the device body is provided with a conveying hopper, and a dredging assembly is arranged in the device body; the dredging component comprises a heated expansion air bag, and a fixing block is fixedly connected to the side face of the heated expansion air bag. This enzymolysis tank with prevent blockking up function when the material gets into the device body through the conveying hopper and carries out enzymolysis for the inside temperature of device body risees, makes the expansion gasbag that is heated and expands drive the atress pole and remove, cooperates the hydraulic pressure storehouse, makes the transfer line remove, cooperates the dredging rod, makes the relative dredging rod of universal ball produce and rotates, makes the pivoted plate with universal ball fixed connection rotate thereupon, makes the operation comparatively simple, has improved the ease of use of device.

title_en: Portable isothermal amplification all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable isothermal amplification integrated machine, which comprises a box body with a top cover; the display screen is connected to the box body, and the installation frame is connected to the inside of the box body; the mounting frame is connected with a placement block with a constant temperature heating module, a plurality of fixing grooves are formed in the placement block, light inlet holes are formed in the placement block at positions corresponding to the bottoms of the fixing grooves, and an excitation light source is arranged at the light inlet holes; the position of the placing block corresponding to one side of the bottom of each fixed tank is provided with a detection hole, and the detection hole is provided with a detection module; the box body is internally connected with a control module, the control module is used for controlling the constant temperature heating module, the excitation light source and the detection module to work, collecting and analyzing signals of the detection module in real time, and transmitting analysis results of the signals to the display screen for display. The utility model not only can reduce the volume of the equipment and make the storage and carrying of the equipment more convenient, but also has the advantage of better protection.

title_en: Full-automatic suspension cell culture workstation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a full-automatic suspension cell culture workstation which comprises a low-temperature box module, a coating module, a culture module and a control display module, wherein the low-temperature box module is used for storing a culture medium and controlling the adding type and weight of the culture medium; the coating module is used for performing cell coating and cell culture in the earlier stage; the culture module is used for carrying out cell culture; the control display module is used for controlling the whole cell culture process and displaying the current culture environment in real time. The cell culture workstation protected by the utility model does not need manual intervention, and the cell culture process is automatically completed in a closed structure, so that the cell culture efficiency can be greatly improved.

title_en: Biological fermentation tank convenient for solid-liquid separation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a biological fermentation tank convenient for solid-liquid separation, belongs to the technical field of solid-liquid separation fermentation tanks, and is used for solving the technical problem of resource waste caused by incomplete solid-liquid separation of the existing biological fermentation tank. The device comprises a tank body, wherein a feed valve is fixed at the upper end of the tank body, a stirring shaft is rotatably arranged on the upper surface of the tank body, a driving motor for driving the stirring shaft to rotate is mounted on the upper surface of the tank body, stirring blades are fixed on the stirring shaft, a plurality of struts are fixed at the lower end of the tank body, a filter assembly is arranged on the lower surface of the tank body, two symmetrically distributed fixing assemblies are arranged on the lower surface of the tank body, each fixing assembly comprises a tray, a placing groove is formed in the tray, a plurality of hydraulic rods are arranged in the placing groove, and an extrusion circular plate is fixed on each hydraulic rod; this biological fermentation jar convenient to solid-liquid separation can realize carrying out extruded function to material residue for by the absorptive partial liquid of material residue by extrusion filtration, with this can more thoroughly accomplish solid-liquid separation, avoid causing the phenomenon of wasting of resources.

title_en: Household thermoelectric complementary co-supply system based on solar energy
