abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of renewable energy sources, in particular to a solar-based household heat and electricity complementary combined supply system, which comprises a solar power generation intelligent control system, a solar water heating system, a biogas fermentation circulating heating system and a biogas fermentation system, wherein the solar water heating system, the biogas fermentation circulating heating system and the biogas fermentation system are connected with the solar power generation intelligent control system in sequence; the solar energy water heating system provides heat energy required by fermentation for the biogas fermentation circulating heating system, the biogas fermentation circulating heating system provides heat energy for the biogas fermentation system to enable the biogas fermentation system to keep a constant temperature range for fermentation, and the solar energy power generation intelligent control system controls the solar energy water heating system and the biogas fermentation circulating heating system to be in the constant temperature range by sensing the temperature in the biogas fermentation system so as to provide energy for fermentation.

title_en: 96-well plate culture support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 96-hole plate culture support which comprises a bottom support plate, wherein a vertical support rod is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the rear side of the bottom support plate, a movable support plate penetrates through the upper end of the vertical support rod, an adjusting rod penetrates through the right side of the movable support plate, the front end of the adjusting rod is fixedly connected with a mounting plate frame, a lamp holder is arranged on the upper end face of the bottom support plate, a flexible adjustable lamp post is connected to the upper end of the lamp holder, and an LED illuminating lamp is connected to the upper end of the flexible adjustable lamp post. This support is cultivateed to 96 orifice plates through setting up adjustable supporting structure, after fixing a position 96 orifice plates, can carry out quick adjustment to its height and longitudinal position, guaranteed the stability of removal in-process simultaneously, set up detachable lighting structure simultaneously, flexible adjustable lamp pole's design, be convenient for change the angle of LED light, conveniently observe downthehole liquid, need not the hand and hold and observe to the light source, improve the convenience of use.

title_en: Tumor cell culture device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tumor cell culture device which comprises an incubator, wherein a movable plate is rotatably arranged in the incubator, a culture dish is placed on the movable plate, a clamping mechanism for fixing the culture dish is arranged on the movable plate, a heating plate is arranged in the movable plate, a plurality of second springs are arranged on one side of the bottom surface of the movable plate, a motor is arranged on the right side surface of the incubator, a shaft lever is arranged on a power output shaft of the motor, the shaft lever extends into the incubator and is in rotary connection with the incubator, and a cam is fixedly sleeved on the part of the shaft lever positioned in the incubator. According to the utility model, the motor, the second spring, the shaft lever and the cam are arranged, the shaft lever and the cam are driven to rotate by starting the motor, and the rotating cam is matched with the second spring, so that the movable plate is continuously rocked, further a culture dish on the movable plate is rocked, the condition that the culture solution is precipitated or coagulated due to long-time static condition is avoided, and the normal culture of tumor cells is facilitated.

title_en: Fermented milk flavor essence preparation facilities
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fermented milk flavor essence, and discloses a fermented milk flavor essence preparation device which comprises a constant temperature box, a discharge hole and a sliding device, wherein the discharge hole is arranged at the middle position below the constant temperature box, feeding pipes are arranged at the two sides above the constant temperature box, a rotating device is arranged between the feeding pipes at the two sides, the sliding device is arranged below the outer wall of the constant temperature box, the rotating device comprises a supporting frame, a motor and a connecting column, the supporting frame is arranged between the feeding pipes at the two sides, the supporting frame is arranged at the middle position above the constant temperature box, the motor is arranged above the supporting frame, the connecting column is arranged at the middle position below the motor, the connecting column penetrates through the supporting frame and is connected with a telescopic cylinder, the lower part of the telescopic cylinder penetrates through the constant temperature box to the inside of the constant temperature box, and a telescopic rod is arranged inside the telescopic cylinder; the utility model can mix the material and the perfume evenly, to improve the working efficiency of device.

title_en: Bean paste processing tedding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thick broad-bean sauce processing tedding device, and relates to the technical field of thick broad-bean sauce processing. The soybean paste tedding machine comprises a machine base and a threaded sleeve, wherein a driving cabin is fixed on the machine base, a fixing plate is fixed on the side edge of the machine base, a power mechanism for driving the threaded sleeve to move up and down is arranged on the fixing plate, an outer plate is symmetrically fixed on the side edge of the threaded sleeve, an inner plate is arranged on the outer plate in a sliding mode, tedding mechanisms for tedding soybean paste are arranged on the outer plate and the inner plate, and the soybean paste tedding machine further comprises an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the inner plate to slide on the outer plate. According to the utility model, the outer plate and the inner plate are provided with the tedding mechanisms special for tedding the thick broad-bean sauce, so that the thick broad-bean sauce can be uniformly tedded, the thick broad-bean sauce is ensured to be fully exposed in the air, and the fermentation and drying processes are promoted; the thread sleeve is driven to move up and down through the power mechanism, so that the outer plate and the inner plate can move up and down, the up-and-down movement of the tedding mechanism is realized, the participation of manual operation is reduced, and the production efficiency and the production consistency are improved.

title_en: Concentrated fruit vegetables juice enzymolysis catalysis jar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a concentrated fruit vegetables juice enzymolysis catalysis jar, relates to catalysis jar technical field, including enzymolysis catalysis jar, enzymolysis catalysis jar top opening, and the baffle is installed to enzymolysis catalysis jar top opening part, and the through-hole has been seted up to the intermediate position of baffle, installs the connecting plate in the through-hole of baffle, and the connecting plate side all sets up flutedly, all installs sampling hose in every recess, and sampling head is all installed to the one end of connecting plate side, and sampling hose's one end is connected with the sampling head, is the arrow-shaped between connecting plate and the sampling head. According to the utility model, the concentrated fruit and vegetable juice in the enzymolysis catalysis tank is sampled through the connecting plate, the sampling head and the sampling hose, so that the problem that multiple sampling is required is solved, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Excrement fungus returnable temperature ware
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fecal fungus temperature re-setting device, which comprises a shell, a placing rack and a heating component, wherein the shell is provided with an accommodating groove with an upward opening, and the accommodating groove is provided with a cover body; the placing frame is detachably arranged in the accommodating groove, a heating cavity for placing liquid is formed between the outer side of the placing frame and the inner wall of the shell, and the placing frame is provided with a plurality of pipeline fixing grooves with upward openings; the heating assembly is used for heating the liquid. Before using, can place the excrement fungus test tube in the pipeline fixed slot, the rack is placed in the low temperature environment and is preserved, when needs inject excrement fungus, can place the storage tank in a plurality of excrement fungus test tubes of rack intercommunication, then start heating element and heat liquid, and then rewarming excrement fungus. The excrement fungus test tube is convenient to transfer in a large quantity, the excrement fungus is rewarmed, the rewarming speed is high, and especially, the operation of doctors is convenient aiming at more patients, and the operation efficiency of the doctors is improved.

title_en: Bacterial wilt disease plant sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bacterial wilt disease plant sampling device, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural tools and comprises a connecting rod, wherein the side surface of the connecting rod is connected with a loop bar, the surface of the loop bar is provided with a fixed component, the surface of the loop bar is sleeved with a movable rod, the bottom of the movable rod is connected with a vertical rod, and the bottoms of the connecting rod and the vertical rod are both connected with a disassembly and assembly component; according to the utility model, the fixing assembly is arranged, and the positioning rod is spliced with the positioning groove under the elastic acting force of the two pairs of fixing rings of the spring, so that the position adjustment and positioning of the sampling mechanisms on two sides can be firm, and the device has higher structural stability and better sampling effect.

title_en: Protein purification case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protein purification box which comprises a main box body, a placement drawer, a placement bin and a protein purification column, wherein the placement drawer is movably connected to the bottom end of the inside of the main box body, a through hole plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the inside of the main box body, the placement bin is movably connected to the top end of the through hole plate, and a connecting pull rod is fixedly connected to one side of the placement bin. According to the utility model, the placing bin is movably connected with the inside of the main box body, the plurality of groups of clamping blocks are arranged in the placing bin, the waste liquid pipe and the collecting pipe are placed in the placing bin, and the clamping blocks in the placing bin are clamped into the clamping grooves on the waste liquid pipe and the collecting pipe, so that the waste liquid pipe and the collecting pipe can be quickly fixed on the placing bin, and meanwhile, the waste liquid pipe and the collecting pipe are lifted upwards, so that the clamping blocks in the placing bin are stressed and are received in the placing bin, and the waste liquid pipe and the collecting pipe can be quickly taken.

title_en: Sperm sieve fertilization dish
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sperm sieve fertilization dish, which comprises a dish body: the internal cavity of the dish body is of a double-layer structure which is stacked up and down, an ovum storage part for containing an ovum is formed at the upper layer of the dish body, and a sperm storage part for containing sperms is formed at the lower layer of the dish body; wherein, a small hole film for passing sperm is arranged between the sperm storage part and the ovum storage part; the novel fertilization dish has the dual functions of sperm screening and sperm concentration control, can screen out sperm with better activity to complete fertilization, is favorable for embryo development, can control the concentration of sperms around an ovum, prevents multi-sperm fertilization, and improves the utilization rate of the ovum.

title_en: Bioreactor sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bioreactor sampling device, which is arranged at a sampling end of a bioreactor, the sampling end is arranged on a sampling valve at the lower side part of the bioreactor, an air inlet end is also arranged on the sampling valve, the air inlet end is communicated with an external steam pipeline, the sampling device comprises a sterilization mechanism and a sampling mechanism, one end of the sterilization mechanism is detachably connected with the sampling end, the sterilization mechanism is provided with an air outlet part, the sampling mechanism comprises a sampling bottle and a three-way pipe, the top of the sampling bottle is provided with a bottle cap, a first interface of the three-way pipe is communicated with one end of a first hose, the other end of the first hose is connected with the other end of the sterilization mechanism, a second interface of the three-way pipe is communicated with one end of a second hose, the other end of the second hose is connected with a sterile one-way valve, a third interface of the three-way pipe is communicated with one end of a third hose, and the other end of the third hose penetrates through the bottle cap and extends to the bottom of the sampling bottle; the utility model can perform sterile sampling for a plurality of times from the sterile one-way valve by arranging the sampling mechanism.

title_en: Mycoplasma drug-sensitive detection plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mycoplasma drug-sensitive detection plate, which comprises: the detecting plate comprises a detecting plate body, wherein a plurality of detecting holes are formed in the top of the detecting plate body, sliding grooves are formed in the left side wall and the right side wall of the detecting plate body, a sliding block is connected in the sliding grooves in a sliding mode, a vertical plate is fixedly connected to one side, located outside the detecting plate body, of the sliding block, a top cover is fixedly connected to the top of the vertical plate, a plurality of observation ports are fixedly connected to the top of the top cover, a plurality of sealing rings are fixedly connected to the bottom of the top cover, and the sealing rings are attached to the detecting plate body; the inner wall of the chute is provided with threaded holes, the inner threads of the sliding block are connected with fastening bolts, and the detection holes are uniformly divided into two rows. Through setting up spout, slider, riser, top cap, viewing aperture and sealing washer, be convenient for cover the detection hole in the pick-up plate main part, avoid the pick-up plate main part to take place the condition that overflows at the in-process that removes.

title_en: Directional enzymolysis tank that xylooligosaccharide production and processing used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a directional enzymolysis tank for producing and processing xylo-oligosaccharide, which comprises a tank body, wherein a motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body, a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the motor, and conveying pipes are communicated with two sides of the fixed pipe. According to the utility model, the motor drives the fixed pipe and the conveying pipe to rotate, the fixed pipe is used for stirring the movable plate through the fixed plate, the stirring plate and the stirring plate are used for stirring materials through the rotation of the stabilizing plate, then the mixing plate is driven to stir the materials at the bottom of the inner wall of the tank body through the rotation of the fixed pipe, and finally the suction force is generated in the fixed pipe through the pipeline by the suction pump, so that the conveying pipe sucks the materials at the bottom of the inner wall of the tank body and then sprays the materials into the tank body to be mixed, thereby having the advantage of accelerating enzymolysis after mixing, replacing the mode that the liquid at the bottom of the inner wall of the existing tank body is only stirred by the stirring rod, and improving the enzymolysis effect of the stirred materials of the tank body.

title_en: Inclined fermentation tank supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inclined fermentation tank supporting devices, in particular to an inclined fermentation tank supporting device which comprises a base and a fermentation tank body, wherein the fermentation tank body is arranged above the base, a supporting structure is arranged outside the fermentation tank body, a buffer structure is arranged below the base, the supporting structure comprises a first supporting plate, the first supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base, a lower supporting ring is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the first supporting plate, a slideway is arranged inside the lower supporting ring, a sliding ring is arranged on the outer wall of the fermentation tank body, and the sliding ring can be slidably clamped inside the slideway. The inclined fermentation tank supporting device can support two ends of a fermentation tank when the fermentation tank is supported, the phenomenon that single-side support is easy to be unstable is avoided, the lower supporting ring and the upper supporting ring can be conveniently installed when the fermentation tank body is locked, the operation is convenient, and the practicability and the stability of the device are improved.

title_en: Cell suction device for immune cell detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of immune cell detection, and discloses a cell suction device for immune cell detection, which comprises an outer tube of an extraction device and a cell storage tube arranged in the outer tube of the extraction device, wherein a yielding through hole is formed in the central position of the bottom wall surface of the inner cavity of the outer tube of the extraction device in a penetrating way, an extraction tube communicated with the bottom end of the cell storage tube is arranged in the yielding through hole in a penetrating way, an extraction needle head is connected to the bottom end of the extraction tube in a threaded way, a limit sliding sleeve is fixedly sleeved in the middle of the top end of the outer tube of the extraction device, an extraction mechanism is arranged in the limit sliding sleeve and comprises an extraction sliding rod in sliding connection with the inside of the limit sliding sleeve and an extraction piston in threaded connection with the bottom end of the extraction sliding rod, and a positioning mechanism is arranged at the top end of the inner cavity of the outer tube of the extraction device. According to the utility model, the extraction mechanism and the positioning mechanism are arranged, so that the convenience in placing and taking out the cell storage tube is improved during use, and the detection efficiency of staff is further improved.

title_en: Separation and purification device with edulcoration function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a separation and purification device with a impurity removal function, which relates to the technical field of separation and purification devices and comprises a tank body, a feed pipe and a discharge pipe, wherein the feed pipe and the discharge pipe are respectively and fixedly arranged at the top and the bottom of the tank body, an annular groove is formed in the surface of the tank body, a filter screen is inserted into the tank body, a mounting plate and a connecting strip are respectively and fixedly arranged at the outer side of the filter screen, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the tank body, and a connecting groove is formed in the surface of the fixing plate. According to the utility model, the filter screen, the connecting strip, the clamping block and the clamping groove are arranged, so that the filter screen has a impurity removing function in the protease purifying process, the purity of a product is improved, the connecting strip is inserted into the connecting groove, the clamping block is clamped into the clamping groove, the convenient installation of the installation plate and the filter screen is realized, meanwhile, the filter screen is convenient to assemble and disassemble, the filter screen is positioned, cleaned and maintained, the impurity removing function is improved, and the purity of the separated and purified product is improved.

title_en: Magnetic fluid sealing stirring mechanism for cell culture tank
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sealed stirring, in particular to a magnetic fluid sealed stirring mechanism for a cell culture tank, which comprises a support, a culture tank fixed on the support through a support plate, and further comprises a span adjusting assembly arranged on the support, wherein the span adjusting assembly is provided with a left stirring mechanism and a right stirring mechanism, a motor drives a driving rotating wheel to rotate, the driving rotating wheel drives a driven rotating wheel through a belt, the driven rotating wheel drives stirring blades to stir the interior of the culture tank, the stirring blades of the left stirring mechanism and the right stirring mechanism stir the interior of the culture tank in different directions and at different speeds, the mixing effect is good, the stirring efficiency is high, when the stirring mechanisms need to be cleaned, the span adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the left stirring mechanism and the right stirring mechanism to stretch into and stretch out of the interior of the culture tank, so that the stirring mechanisms can be conveniently pulled out from the interior of the culture tank to be carefully cleaned in place, and the culture tank is clean, and the culture tank is favorable for next cell culture.

title_en: Instant molecular detection device and equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a molecular instant detection device and equipment, which belong to the technical field of medical equipment, and comprise a shell component and a detection component, wherein the shell component comprises a shell and a base, the shell is detachably and fixedly connected with the base, a containing cavity for containing the detection component is formed between the shell and the base, the shell is provided with a detection hole for installing a detection tube, the detection hole is communicated with the containing cavity, the detection component comprises an LED light source, a color recognition sensor and a light guide column, the LED light source, the color recognition sensor and the light guide column are all positioned in the containing cavity, the LED light source irradiates the detection tube through the conduction of the light guide column, and the light transmitted through the detection tube irradiates the color recognition sensor through the conduction of the light guide column, so that the color recognition detection is realized. The utility model combines the constant temperature direct amplification technology and the color recognition technology, realizes the electronization of medical result judgment, has compact integral structure, is small and portable, is easy to operate and is easy to operate, and the amplification and accurate detection operation of the trace nucleic acid sample can be completed.

title_en: Portable algae space test cell separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable space test cell separator in algae, which relates to the field of algae tests and comprises a foldable separation main body, wherein the separation main body is used for isolating water bodies so as to divide test cells; a fixing member; the fixing piece is connected with the separation main body and is used for fixing the separation main body in a water body; a buoyancy ring; the buoyancy ring is connected to the top of the separation main body and is used for driving the separation main body to float out of the water. According to the utility model, the bottom of the separation main body is fixed in the test pool by adopting the fixing piece, and the separation main body is driven to rise to the floating surface by utilizing the buoyancy of the buoyancy ring, so that the division of test cells is realized, the separation main body is simple and convenient, the separation main body is foldable, and the recovery convenience is improved.

title_en: 96 Hole magnetic force frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 96-hole magnetic frame which is used for placing a micro-pore plate provided with a plurality of holes, and comprises a base and magnets, and is characterized in that the magnets are arranged corresponding to the holes, are annular, are arranged corresponding to the holes, are arranged right below the holes, and can be uniformly distributed around the holes under the condition that more magnetic beads exist through the design of the magnets, so that the phenomenon that the magnetic beads are mistakenly sucked by a liquid dispenser is avoided. Elastic pieces, buckles and the like are additionally arranged between the base and the microporous plate so as to enhance the stability of the microporous plate in the use process. In addition, groove design is carried out at the middle positions of the two long sides of the base, so that a tester can conveniently grasp the micro-pore plate.

title_en: Stirring device for accelerating biomass fermentation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of biomass fermentation equipment, and discloses a stirring device for accelerating biomass fermentation, which comprises a stirring box body, heating equipment, a stirring mechanism, a crushing mechanism, a conveying mechanism and an oxygen dissolving mechanism, wherein the top of the stirring box body is connected with a box cover in a sliding manner, one end of the stirring box body is provided with the stirring mechanism, the stirring mechanism comprises a stirring shaft, the stirring shaft is positioned in the stirring box body and is rotationally connected, a second motor is used for driving a rotating shaft to enable the crushing wheel to rotate simultaneously under the transmission effect of the transmission mechanism, so that biomass materials with larger sizes can be crushed, and then a spiral conveying blade is driven by a third motor to convey the biomass materials which are crushed uniformly to the stirring mechanism arranged in the stirring box body for fermentation stirring.

title_en: Biological ferment liquid fungus stirs fermentation cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biological ferment liquid bacteria stirring fermentation tank which comprises a tank body, wherein a feed pipe and an air inlet pipe are arranged at the top of the tank body, valves are respectively arranged on the feed pipe and the air inlet pipe, a motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the tank body, an output end of the motor penetrates through the tank body and is fixedly provided with a stirring rod, stirring blades are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the stirring rod, a rotating plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the stirring rod, an air outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the rotating plate, air outlet holes are uniformly formed in the lower surface of the air outlet pipe, a cavity communicated with the air outlet pipe is formed in the upper end of the stirring rod, and the cavity is communicated with the air inlet pipe.

title_en: Soy sauce fermentation tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soy sauce fermentation tank, which comprises a support frame and a tank body, wherein a stirring rod is arranged in the tank body, a sedimentation cylinder is integrally formed at the bottom of the tank body, the tank body is communicated with the interior of the sedimentation cylinder, a slag discharging port communicated with the interior of the sedimentation cylinder is formed at the bottom of the sedimentation cylinder, a slag discharging pipe is matched at the slag discharging port, a first extending rod is arranged at the bottom of the stirring rod, the first extending rod extends into the sedimentation cylinder, three scraping plates are uniformly arranged on the first extending rod, one end of the three scraping plates far away from the first extending rod is contacted with the inner wall of the sedimentation cylinder, and meanwhile, the scraping plates contacted with the inner wall of the sedimentation cylinder are arranged on the stirring rod.

title_en: Hybridization reaction platform and nucleic acid chip detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hybridization reaction platform and nucleic acid chip detector, includes first installation base, platform body, heating device, sways device and controlling means, and the platform body is installed in first installation base, and the both ends and the first installation base rotation of platform body are connected to make the both ends of platform body can swing relatively from top to bottom. The platform body is provided with a reaction groove. The heating device is arranged at the bottom of the reaction tank and is used for heating the reaction tank. The swinging device comprises an eccentric wheel and a first driving piece, wherein the eccentric wheel and the platform body are connected to one end of the platform body, which is connected with the first mounting base, and the driving piece is electrically connected with the eccentric wheel and is used for driving the eccentric wheel to do circular motion so as to drive the two ends of the platform body to swing up and down. The control device is electrically connected with the heating device and the first driving piece and is used for controlling the working states of the heating device and the first driving piece. The swing structure of the hybridization reaction platform can fully mix hybridization reagents, and the swing structure is simple in structure and can lighten the hybridization reaction platform.

title_en: Virus purification device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pseudo virus purification devices, and discloses a virus purification device which comprises a shell and a sealing cover, wherein the shell is hinged with the sealing cover, a temperature control device is arranged in the shell, a centrifugal mechanism is arranged in the shell, a locking mechanism is arranged in the centrifugal mechanism, and the locking mechanism comprises a quick locking assembly and a fixing assembly. According to the utility model, the test tube which needs to be subjected to centrifugal operation is further locked by utilizing a more convenient and quick connection locking mode, and when the locking operation is performed, the device can better slide the placed test tube to the upper end and be abutted and fixed with the sealing cover, so that the stability during the centrifugal operation is better ensured.

title_en: Microorganism acquisition detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microorganism acquisition and detection device, which comprises an acquisition and detection instrument body, wherein two L-shaped plates are arranged in the acquisition and detection instrument body, movable rods are arranged in the two L-shaped plates, movable blocks are sleeved at one ends of the two movable rods, a first storage plate is arranged between the inner walls of the two movable blocks, auxiliary grooves are formed in one sides of the two L-shaped plates, a second storage plate is arranged at the bottom of the first storage plate, two auxiliary plates are arranged at one side of the second storage plate, the movable blocks, the first storage plate, the auxiliary rods, the second storage plate, a U-shaped frame and a vertical rod are arranged at one side of the second storage plate, the auxiliary rods can move back and forth at the bottom of the first storage plate, and can slide back and forth in the auxiliary grooves.

title_en: Automatic proportioning, stirring and fermenting device for agricultural ferment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ferment processing and discloses an automatic proportioning, stirring and fermenting device for agricultural ferment, which comprises a bracket, wherein the middle of the top surface of the bracket is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with a barrel body, both sides of the middle of the bracket are fixedly connected with telescopic rods, the output ends of the telescopic rods are fixedly connected with fixed blocks, the similar sides of the fixed blocks are respectively and fixedly connected with the bottoms of both sides of the outer wall of the barrel body, the middle of the top surface of the barrel body is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a stirring rod, the outer side of the stirring rod is fixedly connected with a scraping plate, and the side wall of the scraping plate is contacted with the side wall of the inner wall of the barrel body. According to the utility model, the telescopic rod is driven to extend out of the output end, so that the barrel body and the bottom plate can be separated, and the top surface of the bottom plate can be cleaned at the moment, so that the cleaning operation of the device is facilitated, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: High oxygen-soluble microbial fermentation device for highland barley flour production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of highland barley flour production fermentation, and discloses a high-oxygen-content microbial fermentation device for highland barley flour production, which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein limit grooves are formed in the inner walls of the two sides of the fermentation tank, a storage cylinder is connected with the inner walls of the two sides of the limit grooves in a sliding manner, an annular opening is formed in the outer wall of the top of the fermentation tank, a limiting block is connected with the inner walls of the two sides of the limit grooves in a sliding manner, a fermentation mechanism is arranged on the limiting block, an auxiliary mechanism is arranged on the fermentation tank, the storage cylinder is fixedly connected with the outer wall of one side of the limiting block, a sealing groove is formed in the outer wall of the top of the storage cylinder, and a sealing frame is connected with the inner wall of the side face of the sealing groove in a sliding manner. According to the utility model, through arranging the structures such as the storage barrel, the material mixing tank and the like, the highland barley flour is mechanically and uniformly stirred and sealed in real time, so that the problems of quickening drying of the highland barley flour, and unsatisfactory fermentation caused by temperature difference change are solved and directly opened.

title_en: Pipetting device and phage display device with pipetting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipetting device and a phage display device with the pipetting device, wherein the pipetting device comprises a first pipetting needle, a second pipetting needle, a first conveying pump, a second conveying pump and a flow path switching valve, the flow path switching valve is provided with a small-flow pipetting flow path communicated with the first conveying pump and the first pipetting needle and a large-flow pipetting flow path communicated with the second conveying pump, the first pipetting needle and the second pipetting needle, and the flow path switching valve can be controlled to switch between the small-flow pipetting flow path and the large-flow pipetting flow path, and the pumping flow of the second conveying pump is larger than that of the first conveying pump. According to the utility model, the purpose of accurately transferring the liquid such as the reagent, the sample liquid and the like can be ensured by selecting the small-flow transfer flow path according to the corresponding process requirements, the high-efficiency transfer of the liquid such as the reagent, the sample liquid and the like can be ensured by selecting the large-flow transfer flow path, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Planktonic bacteria sampler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a planktonic bacteria sampler, relates to the technical field of samplers, and aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, when the planktonic bacteria sampler is used for sucking air to capture planktonic bacteria, the air is inconvenient to screen and filter, so that larger particle impurities in the air enter, and the cleanliness of a culture medium in the planktonic bacteria sampler is affected. An equipment box is fixedly arranged above the planktonic bacteria sampler body, a filter frame is arranged in the equipment box and consists of a square frame and filter cloth, laths are symmetrically and fixedly arranged in the equipment box along two sides of the filter frame respectively, the inside of slat is provided with the slot, the inside of the slot of two slats is inserted respectively at the both ends of filter frame, be provided with the shrouding slotted hole on the preceding terminal surface of equipment box, the inside of shrouding slotted hole is provided with the shrouding, and shrouding and square frame fixed connection.

title_en: Ton bag for feed fermentation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ton bag for fermenting feed, which comprises a first bag body, a second bag body, a fastening material, an exhaust connecting device, an air duct, a container and a fixing piece, wherein the second bag body is arranged in the first bag body, a fourth hole is formed in the second bag body, a fifth hole is formed in the first bag body, the container is arranged on the outer side face of the first bag body through the fixing piece, the exhaust connecting device is arranged on the fourth hole of the second bag body, the air duct passes through the fifth hole in the first bag body, one end of the air duct is communicated with the exhaust connecting device, the other end of the air duct stretches into the container, and the fastening material is arranged below a first bag opening of the first bag body and/or below a second bag opening of the second bag body. The utility model can be used for producing the fermented feed by using the breathing bag process, can reduce the discharge resistance of the gas generated by the fermented feed, ensures that the fermented gas in the fermented bag can be smoothly discharged, and ensures that the quality of the final fermented feed is not influenced.

title_en: Microorganism efficient inoculation disinfection device based on gravity sensing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biological sample pretreatment, in particular to a microorganism efficient inoculation disinfection device based on gravity sensing, which comprises a culture dish tray moving mechanism and a scribing lifting mechanism positioned at the front side of the culture dish tray moving mechanism, wherein the culture dish tray moving mechanism is used for driving a culture dish to move back and forth, left and right and rotate, a scribing rotary table is arranged at the top of the scribing lifting mechanism, a plurality of groups of inoculation loops are arranged at the periphery of the scribing rotary table, different inoculation loops are driven to be close to the culture dish through rotation of the scribing rotary table, lifting disinfection mechanisms are distributed at one side of the scribing lifting mechanism, the used inoculation loops are rotationally sent to the upper part of the lifting disinfection mechanism by the scribing rotary table, and after the lifting disinfection mechanism is lifted, the inoculation loops enter an inner cavity for disinfection, so that when one group of inoculation loops are in a working state, the other group of inoculation loops are in a disinfection state, and scribing and disinfection are simultaneously carried out.

title_en: Reaction equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a PCR reaction technology, in particular to a reaction device which comprises a reaction tube, wherein the reaction tube comprises a tube body, the tube body is provided with an opening and a containing cavity, and a movable block capable of moving is arranged in the containing cavity. The application effectively improves the reaction efficiency of PCR by moving the movable block in the limited thread.

title_en: Oxidizing device for methane oxidizing bacteria
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oxidation device for methane-oxidizing bacteria. The oxidizing device for the methane oxidizing bacteria comprises a bottom plate, a constant-temperature water tank fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom plate, an oxidizing fermentation tank arranged on the constant-temperature water tank, a frame fixedly arranged on the oxidizing fermentation tank, a lifting mechanism arranged on the frame and used for driving the methane oxidizing bacteria containing mechanism to move up and down, and a methane oxidizing bacteria containing mechanism arranged at the bottom of the lifting mechanism and used for containing culture mediums and methane oxidizing bacteria. The oxidation device for methane-oxidizing bacteria has the advantages of being convenient to put in and take out the culture medium and the methane-oxidizing bacteria, convenient to operate and having a constant-temperature fermentation function.

title_en: Automatic material feeding assembly and strain cultivation device using same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen waste aerobic fermentation treatment, in particular to an automatic material feeding component and a strain cultivation device using the same, comprising a fermentation bin and a material feeding hopper, wherein the fermentation bin consists of a bin body, a mounting bracket, a stirring device, a partition plate in the bin, an organic fertilizer discharge port, a driving motor and a chain, the mounting bracket is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the bin body, compared with the conventional kitchen waste aerobic fermentation treatment adopting a manual feeding mode, according to the utility model, the addition amount of materials in the fermentation bin can be automatically sensed, the addition of auxiliary materials such as the added auxiliary materials, the microbial inoculum and the brown sugar water is automatically completed, the automation degree is high, the unattended operation is not needed, meanwhile, the on-line detection device is arranged at the organic fertilizer discharge port, the on-line detection of indexes in the organic fertilizer can be realized, and when the detection does not reach the standard, the material adding hopper electric control valve can be automatically controlled, the amount of the added materials is adjusted, and the produced organic fertilizer is ensured to reach the standard.

title_en: Short-term rumen fluid external culture fermentation bag for detecting influence of medicine on rumen fluid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a short-term rumen fluid external culture fermentation bag for detecting the influence of a drug on rumen fluid, which comprises a nylon seal bag with an opening, wherein the opening is provided with a joint sealed with a rubber plug, and the short-term rumen fluid external culture fermentation bag is characterized in that the rubber plug comprises a hollow silica gel column (1), an elastic silica gel membrane (2) and a protective metal tube (3) for preventing the membrane from deforming, and the elastic silica gel membrane (2) is provided with a cross opening (4) serving as a one-way valve. The fermentation bag of the utility model ensures the integral tightness, creates an anaerobic environment for rumen fluid so as to simulate the rumen environment, is suitable for the growth of rumen contents, and simultaneously adopts a specially-structured one-way air guide device so as to facilitate the discharge of air in the bag for biological experiments.

title_en: Multifunctional cell washing preparation tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional cell washing preparation tube which comprises a tube main body, wherein a liquid injection port is formed in the circumferential outer wall of the tube main body, a first sealing plug is fixedly arranged in the liquid injection port, a first connecting tube and a second connecting tube are respectively and fixedly connected to the two ends of the tube main body, and a first filter membrane and a second filter membrane are both arranged in the tube main body. The cell washing preparation provided by the utility model has dual purposes, remarkably simplifies the processes of cell washing and cell suspension preparation, is less influenced by environmental cleanliness, and reduces the risk of cell pollution to a certain extent.

title_en: Feed fermentation device capable of reducing bacterial dip-dyeing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feed fermentation device capable of reducing bacterial infection, which comprises a box body, wherein a crushing cavity and a fermentation cavity are arranged in the box body, the crushing cavity and the fermentation cavity are separated by a filter plate, a crushing roller is arranged in the crushing cavity, a rotating shaft is arranged in the fermentation cavity, a supporting frame is arranged on the rotating shaft, a scraping plate is arranged at the outer end of the supporting frame, a turning roller is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame, turning teeth are arranged on the turning roller, when stirring and shaking the feed, a first driving motor is started to drive the crushing roller to primarily crush the feed, the crushed feed falls into the fermentation cavity through the filter plate, a second driving motor is started to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, the supporting frame, the scraping plate and the turning roller arranged on the rotating shaft realize stirring action on the feed, the stirring action on the feed is realized by matching with the turning teeth arranged on the rotating shaft, the stirring action on the feed is avoided, and the fermentation effect is ensured.

title_en: Fermentation device is used in beef paste production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for beef paste production, which comprises a fermentation tank and an accelerating fermentation mechanism, wherein an installation sealing box is arranged on the upper surface of the fermentation tank, the accelerating fermentation mechanism comprises a bead groove, a rotating bead, a rotating rod, a spiral piece, an arc scraping piece and a bottom ramming disc, the bead groove is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the fermentation tank, the rotating bead is rotationally connected to the inside of the bead groove, the rotating rod is fixedly sleeved in the middle of the rotating bead, the spiral piece at the middle lower section of the outer cambered surface of the rotating rod, the arc scraping piece which is uniformly distributed is arranged at the lower side of the outer cambered surface of the rotating rod, the bottom ramming disc is arranged at the lower end of the rotating rod, the outer cambered surface of the arc scraping piece at the leftmost side is contacted with the inner cambered surface of the fermentation tank, and the lower cambered surface of the bottom ramming disc is contacted with the inner bottom surface of the fermentation tank.

title_en: Automatic purification equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides automatic purification equipment, and belongs to the technical field of biotechnology equipment. The automatic purification equipment comprises a storage and discharge assembly, a metering assembly, an injection assembly and a control unit, wherein the metering assembly and the injection assembly are communicated, the metering assembly and the injection assembly are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit, when reagent injection is carried out, the control unit controls the metering assembly to input reagent into the injection assembly, meanwhile, the injection assembly injects the reagent into the storage and discharge assembly, and when the reagent injection is completed, the control unit controls the injection assembly and the metering assembly to stop reagent injection, and the whole process is sequentially carried out inside the equipment, so that manual intervention is reduced, and injection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Central cold-hot water bath supply type multi-channel temperature division cell culture device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a central cold-hot water bath supply type multi-channel temperature division cell culture device. The central cold and hot water bath supply type multi-way temperature division cell culture device comprises a base, a central hot water supply module, a central cold water supply module, a multi-way hot water inlet pipeline, a multi-way cold water inlet pipeline, a plurality of independently adjustable water mixing valves, a plurality of constant temperature pipe groups and a plurality of cell culture modules, wherein the constant temperature pipe groups are arranged in the base at intervals, and the water mixing valve in front of the water inlet of each constant temperature pipe group is respectively connected with the hot water inlet pipeline and the cold water inlet pipeline. According to the different temperature settings of each path of constant-temperature pipe group, the water mixing valve can be correspondingly set, so that the water temperature entering the water inlet of the constant-temperature pipe group from the water mixing valve meets the temperature requirement of each path of constant-temperature pipe group, each path of constant-temperature pipe group forms a constant-temperature holding area in a corresponding area of the base, and each cell culture module is matched with the corresponding constant-temperature pipe group on the base respectively, so that cell culture environments with different temperatures are realized.

title_en: Efficient fermentation tank for microbial oil displacement
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-efficiency fermentation tank for microbial oil displacement, which comprises a fermentation tank body, a pneumatic circulation assembly, a spiral diversion assembly and a self-cleaning assembly, wherein in order to solve the problem that a common fermentation tank stirring system is easy to cause shear damage to thalli due to continuous mechanical stirring in the prior art, the pneumatic circulation assembly is used for generating ascending air flow, the air is used for ascending to drive liquid to flow, so that the stirring function is realized, the mechanical damage is reduced, meanwhile, the spiral diversion assembly is designed, the spiral diversion assembly is arranged, the liquid can be automatically rotated when the ascending air flow is generated, so that the liquid is driven to carry out spiral diversion, so that microorganisms can be fully mixed with culture solution through spiral, the mixing efficiency is further improved, and further, the self-cleaning assembly can automatically carry out rotary scraping on the inner wall of the tank when the ascending air flow is generated, so as to prevent the thalli and metabolites from scaling.

title_en: Laboratory is with falling dull and stereotyped device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laboratory is with falling dull and stereotyped device, including the body that has the cavity, set up the inner bag in the body and set up the lid that opens and shuts on the body, this internal small-size steam sterilizer that is provided with, small-size steam sterilizer passes through steam outlet blowout steam sterilization gas, be connected with the outlet pipe that is used for flowing out the culture medium on the inner bag, be provided with the intermittent type formula feed mechanism that is used for controlling the culture medium intermittent type to flow on the outlet pipe, intermittent type formula feed mechanism includes ball valve and driving motor, the ball valve is installed on the outlet pipe, the valve rod of ball valve is connected with the driving motor that is used for driving ball valve pivoted. The utility model simplifies the plate pouring process of the solid culture medium, reduces the pollution in the plate pouring process, can precisely control the volume of the poured culture medium in each culture dish, and ensures the uniformity of each solid plate.

title_en: Incubator for biochemical detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of biochemical culture, in particular to an incubator for biochemical detection, which comprises a box body, wherein a plurality of heat insulation parts are fixedly arranged in the box body along the height direction of the box body, a heating cavity is formed between two adjacent heat insulation parts, trays are arranged in the heating cavities and are used for placing culture dishes, a plurality of first through holes are formed in the heat insulation parts, the heat insulation parts are of hollow structures in the heat insulation parts, heat insulation plates are arranged in the heat insulation parts, driving parts are arranged on the outer sides of the heat insulation parts, and the driving parts are used for driving the heat insulation plates to move so as to enable the first through holes to be unblocked or closed. According to the utility model, the heat insulation part is arranged in the box body to divide the space in the box body into a plurality of small spaces, and the through holes on the heat insulation part are controlled to be opened or closed by utilizing the heat insulation plate, so that staff can control the opening and closing of the heat insulation part according to the number of culture dishes and the placed space positions, and the size of the heating space is changed.

title_en: Fermentation tank based on magnetic suspension stirring and ultrasonic vibration plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fermentation tanks and discloses a fermentation tank based on magnetic suspension stirring and ultrasonic vibration plates, which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein a magnetic suspension stirrer and an ultrasonic vibration system are arranged on the fermentation tank, the ultrasonic vibration system comprises a control system, a cooling liquid tank, a plurality of vibration plate groups and a heat exchange tube, the plurality of vibration plate groups are sequentially communicated by the heat exchange tube, a head vibration plate group and a tail vibration plate group are communicated by the cooling liquid tank to form a closed loop, the plurality of vibration plate groups are distributed along the circumferential array of a tank body, the adjacent vibration plate groups have longitudinal intervals, and the intervals are not smaller than the height of one vibration plate group. The problems that the traditional mechanical stirring shaft occupies the central area of the tank body, so that the fluidity of materials around the shaft center is poor and sterilization dead angles are formed are solved, and the problems that high-viscosity materials are easy to adhere to the tank wall, gaps between a conventional scraping plate and the tank wall are difficult to adjust, and residues are bred with bacteria and the like are solved by adopting an ultrasonic vibration system.

title_en: Animal tissue homogenate operation panel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of animal experiment equipment and discloses an animal tissue homogenate operation table, which comprises a workbench, wherein a transparent protective cover capable of opening and closing is arranged at the upper part of the workbench, at least one mashing instrument and a porous test tube support are arranged on the workbench, the mashing instrument comprises a cup body, a reamer, a cup cover and a host, a temperature control box is arranged on the workbench, a placing groove is arranged in the temperature control box, the placing groove can accommodate the cup body of the mashing instrument, an ultraviolet lamp is arranged at the top of the inner side of the protective cover, an operation panel is arranged on the front surface of the workbench, the temperature control box and the ultraviolet lamp are electrically connected with the operation panel, and the opening and closing of the temperature control box and the ultraviolet lamp can be controlled through the operation panel. According to the utility model, the temperature control box is arranged on the workbench, so that a low-temperature environment can be provided for the masher, degradation or denaturation of samples due to overheating of equipment in the homogenizing process is prevented, the accuracy and reliability of experimental results are ensured, the protective cover and the ultraviolet lamp can provide a sterile environment for the workbench, the operation safety is enhanced, and the risk of cross contamination is reduced.

title_en: Mixed reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing reaction device which comprises a motor, a stirring shaft, inclined stirring blades, a frame body, an electric push rod, a vertical pipe, a fixed pipe, an air inlet pipe, a one-way valve, an air hole and a piston, wherein radial flow and axial flow combined stirring is formed, the mixing effect difference is avoided, and air can be timely supplemented for aerobic reaction environments. The tank body is characterized in that a seat frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the tank body, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom of the seat frame, a stirring shaft is fixedly connected to the top of an output shaft of the motor, a plurality of inclined stirring blades are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the stirring shaft, a frame body is fixedly connected to the top of the tank body, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the frame body, a vertical pipe is fixedly connected to the inside of the tank body, a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of an output end of the electric push rod, and two air holes are formed in the outer wall of the fixed pipe.

title_en: Chicken bone extract production device with enzymolysis and solid-liquid separation functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chicken bone extract production device with enzymolysis and solid-liquid separation functions, and relates to the technical field of chicken bone material extraction; the device comprises a frame, wherein an enzymolysis tank is arranged at the upper part of the frame, a separation rotating part and a vibration screening part are respectively arranged at the lower part of the frame, the separation rotating part comprises a separation filter cylinder and a supporting box, the separation filter cylinder is arranged in the supporting box, a filter screen is arranged on the separation filter cylinder, a feeding pipe orifice is arranged at one end of the separation filter cylinder, the other end of the separation filter cylinder is arranged in a closed mode, the supporting box is provided with a rotating part at the end part, far away from the feeding pipe orifice, of the separation filter cylinder, the vibration screening part comprises a front pipeline, a fixed shell and a rear pipeline, a vibration mesh screen is arranged in the fixed shell, guide columns are arranged on the upper part and the lower part of the vibration mesh screen, a vibration part is arranged on the fixed shell, a recoil pipe orifice is arranged on the rear pipeline, and the opening direction of the recoil pipe orifice faces the vibration mesh screen to solve the technical problem that the filter cylinder is difficult to dismantle and clean in a small space.

title_en: Sealed fermentation tank for fermentation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealed fermentation tank for fermentation, which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein a top cover is arranged at the top end of the fermentation tank, a driving mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the top cover, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the fermentation tank, a sealing mechanism is arranged between the fermentation tank and the top cover, the driving mechanism comprises a motor seat, the motor seat is fixedly connected to the top end of the top cover, one side of the motor seat is connected with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a driving wheel, one side of the driving wheel is provided with a driven wheel in a meshed manner, the sealing mechanism comprises a sealing ring, the sealing ring is arranged at the junction of the fermentation tank and the top cover, two arc-shaped guide rings are placed outside the sealing ring, and the two arc-shaped guide rings are connected through bolts. Compared with the prior art, the sealed fermentation tank for fermentation has the advantages that the sealed fermentation tank for fermentation is provided, so that the problems of poor sealing performance, uneven stirring, difficult inner wall cleaning and the like of the existing fermentation tank are solved.

title_en: Packaging structure and sequencing slide
abstract_en: The application provides a packaging structure and a sequencing slide glass, wherein the packaging structure comprises a glass substrate, a plurality of chips and conductive columns, the surfaces of the chips are respectively provided with a biological function layer, the chips are used for analyzing biochemical substances, the glass substrate is provided with a plurality of grooves and through holes surrounding each groove, at least one chip is arranged in each groove, the biological function layers are exposed out of openings of the grooves, the conductive columns are positioned in the through holes, and the conductive columns are electrically connected with the chips and electrically lead out the chips. According to the packaging structure, a plurality of chips are integrated and packaged in the same glass substrate, and the conductive columns are formed in the glass through holes, so that the chips are electrically led out, a large-array planar packaging structure is formed, the flux can be improved, the cost can be reduced, and the risks of corrosion of a circuit by a reagent, short circuit of the circuit, failure of the chip and the like can be reduced.

title_en: Flt3 ligand fusion proteins and methods of use
abstract_en: The invention provides an effectorless immunoglobulin Fc protein, fusions of the effectorless Fc protein to a Flt3 ligand, and methods of using the same.

title_en: Novel pd-1 binding domains
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to novel PD-1 binding domains that have a higher binding affinity for human PD-1 than a reference PD-1 binding domain. The PD-1 binding domains of the present disclosure further provide a comparable, or equal or higher, potency in blocking ligand binding to human PD-1 than a reference PD-1 antibody. The present disclosure further relates to binding moieties comprising such PD-1 binding domains. Also provided is a method for treating a disease, in particular a disease associated with a suppressed immune system, such as cancer, with a PD-1 binding domain or binding moiety of the present disclosure. The present disclosure further relates to nucleic acids encoding the heavy chain variable region of the PD-1 binding domains, and a vector and cell comprising such nucleic acid.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating kcnq4-associated hearing loss
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides technologies comprising a polynucleotide capable of expressing and/or inhibiting a KCNQ4 gene product.

title_en: Attenuated newcastle disease virus (ndv) of a 73t strain for treating neoplasia, method of selectively killing tumor cells and method of inducing tumor regression using same
abstract_en: The invention provides an attenuated Newcastle disease virus (NDV) of a 73T strain, wherein an F protein cleavage site (FPCS) of wild type having the amino acid sequence 111G-R-R-Q-K-R/F117 is modified such that it has a sequence selected from 111H-N-R-T-K-S/F117, 111H-N-K-T-K-S/F117, 111H-N-R-M-K-S/F117, 111H-N-K-M-K-S/F-I118 and 111H-N-R-T-K-R/F-I118. This virus is non-pathogenic to poultry (lentogenic), but exhibits oncolytic properties. Furthermore, the invention provides a method of selectively killing tumor cells and a method of inducing tumor regression in a subject using the virus of the invention. These methods overcome the drawbacks of using pathogenic strains of viruses for human therapy.

title_en: Cytokine prodrugs
abstract_en: Provided herein are cytokine muteins and cytokine prodrugs and methods of making and using thereof.

title_en: Methods for measuring bacteria in biological samples
abstract_en: The disclosure relates generally to methods for measuring bacteria in biological samples. More particularly, the disclosure relates to methods for measuring bacteria using an aqueous clearance solution.

title_en: Methods for treating atopic dermatitis by administering an il-4r inhibitor
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for treating moderate-to-severe or severe atopic dermatitis (AD). The methods of the present invention comprise administering to a subject in need thereof one or more doses of an interleukin-4 receptor (IL-4R) inhibitor such as an anti-IL-4R antibody.

title_en: Methods of quantifying lif and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are assays useful for the quantitation of total LIF from biological samples.

title_en: Disposable bioreactor and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disposable bioreactors having at least one permanently integrated disposable ATR element. These bioreactors are suitable for cultivating microorganisms or cell cultures, or for cell-free gene expression, wherein liquid samples are examined in the bioreactor by means of infrared spectroscopy.

title_en: Method for suppression of hepapitis b virus replication and hepapitis b virus surface antigen secretion
abstract_en: A pharmaceutical composition for use in treating hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection includes an effective amount of an antibody against CD11b or a binding fragment thereof. A method for treating hepatitis B virus infection includes administering to a subject in need thereof an antibody against CD11b. Anti-CD11b antibody binding to CD11b may trigger immunostimulatory responses, as evidenced by the following observations: increased surface expression of MHC II and CD86 in CD11b+ peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs); suppressed level of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and HBV DNA in the blood; and accelerated clearance of HBV from liver.

title_en: Screening plant protoplasts for disease resistant traits
abstract_en: Methods for screening plant cells, particularly plant protoplasts, for disease resistant traits, and kits for performing such methods are provided. The methods are performed in a microfluidic device that includes a flow region and at least one growth chamber suitable for culturing and screening a plant protoplast. The at least one surface of the growth chamber of the microfluidic chip can include a covalently linked coating material or a surface modifying ligand. The kit can comprise a microfluidic chip in combination with a reagent for detecting the viability of the plant protoplast and, optionally, a surface conditioning reagent or a surface modification reagent.

title_en: Modifying binding molecules to minimize pre-existing interactions

title_en: Antigen-binding molecules comprising unpaired variable domains

Use of unpaired VH domains to generate antigen-binding molecules.

title_en: Selection by means of artificial transactivators

title_en: Kit for early screening of liver cell cancer and preparation method and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kit for early screening of hepatocellular carcinoma, comprising a gene marker detection reagent and a protein marker detection reagent. title_en: New adeno-associated virus (aav) variants and uses thereof for gene therapy
abstract_en: Adeno-associated virus (AAV) is a defective mono-stranded DNA virus, endemic in human population (35-80%). Recurrent clonal AAV2 insertions are associated with the pathogenesis of rare human hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) developed on normal liver. The aimed of the inventors was to characterize the natural history of AAV infection in the liver. Viral DNA was thus quantified in tumor and non-tumor liver tissues of 1461 patients. Presence of episomal form and viral mRNA expression were analyzed using a DNAse/TaqMan based assay and quantitative RT-PCR. In silico analyses using viral capture data explored viral variants and new clonal insertions. AAV DNA was detected in 21% of the patients equally distributed in 2 major viral subtypes: one similar to AAV2, the other hybrid between AAV2 and AAV13 sequences. Thus the inventors provided an integrated analysis of the wild type AAV infection in the liver with the identification of viral genotypes, molecular forms, helper virus relationship and viral integrations. These findings are important to understand wild type AAV biology and particularly relevant considering the large usage of AAV vector in liver-targeted gene therapy. Thus, the present invention relates to new adeno-associated virus (AAV) variants and uses thereof for gene therapy.

title_en: Subcutaneous administration of adamts13

title_en: Neutralizing antibodies to human endothelin

title_en: Method for separating pancreatic progenitor cells

title_en: Hla-h in medicine and diagnostics

title_en: Specific marker for identifying t cells specifically attacking cancer cells
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a specific marker for identifying T cells specifically attacking cancer cells and the utilization of the marker. title_en: Culture method and culture vessel

title_en: Highly multiplexed detection of nucleic acids

title_en: Use of il-6 inhibitors for the treatment of acute chest syndrome in patients suffering from sickle cell disease
abstract_en: Acute chest syndrome (ACS) is a common and potentially lethal form of acute lung injury in sickle cell disease (SCD). Because pathophysiology remains unclear, therapeutic options are limited to supportive care with empiric antibiotics and red cell transfusion in case of aggravation. A role of inflammation mediated by endothelial and immune cells has been suspected but the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines in the lungs during ACS have not yet been investigated. Here the inventors report dramatically high levels of IL-6, unlike IL-1β and TNF-α, in the sputum from SCD children during ACS (n=12) compared with non-ACS sputum (n=6). By contrast, plasma IL-6 levels were not significantly increased during ACS (n=12), compared with vaso-occlusive crisis (n=12), steady state (n=12) and healthy controls (n=9). IL-6 levels were more than 150-fold higher in sputum than in plasma, suggesting increased local production by inflammatory cells during ACS. Sputum levels of IL-8, CCL2 and CCL3 chemokines were also increased during ACS, which may contribute to the recruitment of innate immune cells, such as neutrophils and monocytes, in the lungs. The results strongly suggest an involvement of these inflammatory mediators in ACS pathophysiology and open new therapeutic perspectives, in particular with IL-6 inhibitors.

title_en: Parallel multiple displacement amplification method

According to the nucleic acid amplification method according to one aspect, by performing parallel multiple displacement amplification using the first primer containing the barcode sequence, the increased parallelism and throughput of MDA dramatically reduces the time and cost for NGS library production, the barcode bias phenomenon can be resolved by adjusting the ratio at which the first primer is added, and the quality of amplification can also be improved using a laser-based cell separation method. Therefore, the nucleic acid amplification method can be usefully used for large-scale single-cell whole genome analysis.

title_en: Using minivectors to treat idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: MiniVectors and compositions containing MiniVectors that target genes implicated in IPF selected from CDH11, STATS, STAT6, FoxM1, MDM2, TGFβ, SMAD, PDGFA, or TLR4 and/or increase intracellular levels of reduced glutathione, relaxin, and p53, are provided, along with uses in the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

title_en: Methods for storing mrna compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of RNA-containing compositions, more in particular in the stabilization of in vitro transcribed mRNA-containing compositions for frozen storage. Specifically, the present invention provides a solution for reducing or avoiding the formation of aggregates/precipitates in such RNA-containing compositions, even when being frozen and subsequently thawed. Thereto, the present invention provides means and methods for preventing the formation of aggregates/precipitates in a frozen or thawed RNA-containing composition, by adding a metal binding chelator to said composition prior to freezing said composition.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating cancer
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to reveal association of macrophages with the development/progression of a cancer, and to provide a novel pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of a cancer. The present invention provides a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of a cancer; a composition for killing fibroblasts locating adjacent to a tumor tissue; a composition for promoting infiltration of cytotoxic T cells into a tumor tissue; a composition for suppressing the expression of a gene(s) in fibroblasts, which gene(s) suppress(es) infiltration of cytotoxic T cells into a tumor; a composition for promoting the growth of cytotoxic T cells; a composition for enhancing the cytotoxic activity of cytotoxic T cells; and a composition for enhancing the expression of a gene(s) associated with the cytotoxicity of cytotoxic T cells; containing, as an effective component, a substance having an ability to kill CD206-positive M2 macrophages.

title_en: Organoid-derived monolayers and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to culture methods, in particular methods of obtaining organoid-derived monolayers, and to uses of the organoid-derived monolayers obtained by said methods. The invention also relates to assays for epithelial barrier function and methods of screening compounds using said assays.

title_en: Codon-optimised complement factor i
abstract_en: An isolated polynucleotide comprising a nucleotide sequence encoding a codon-optimised Complement Factor I (CFI).

title_en: Mutant pore
