The bacterial strain is used for degrading PBAT plastic in the soil or aquatic environment.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: In vitro expansion method of hair follicle epithelial stem cells
abstract_en: To provide means for efficiently growing epithelial cells that can be used to produce regenerated hair follicle primordia.SOLUTION: Provided are a culture medium for growing epithelial cells that can be used to produce regenerated hair follicle primordia, comprising a basal medium and at least one of the following (1) to (3): (1) at least one BMP inhibitor; (2) at least one fibroblast growth factor; and (3) sonic hedgehog (SHH) or a SHH agonist, and a method for growing the epithelial cells using the culture medium.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Quick detection of escherichia coil in thin film culture device
abstract_en: To provide a device for individually counting Escherichia coli groups and colonies of Escherichia coli microorganisms.SOLUTION: A device 10 includes: a water-impermeable first sheet 12; a water-impermeable second sheet 22 attached to the first sheet; a dry culture medium 16 that can be rehydrated and contains lactose-fermenting indicator series, β-D- glucuronidase indicator series, and a first cold water-soluble gelatinizer adhered to the first sheet, and is placed inside a microorganism proliferation zone; and a second cold water-soluble gelatinizer adhered to the second sheet. The microorganism proliferation zone is placed between the first sheet and the second sheet. The first sheet and the second sheet are constituted so as to delay passage of carbon dioxide passing through the sheets. A method for using the device is also provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Humanized light chain mice
abstract_en: To provide non-human animals, tissues, cells, and genetic material that comprise a modification of an endogenous non-human heavy chain immunoglobulin sequence and that comprise an ADAM6 activity functional in a mouse.SOLUTION: The non-human animals express a human immunoglobulin heavy chain variable domain and a cognate human immunoglobulin λ light chain variable domain. For example, a non-human animal comprises: (a) an insertion of one or more human Vλ and Jλ gene segments upstream of a non-human immunoglobulin light chain constant region, (b) an insertion of one or more human VH, one or more human DH and one or more human JH gene segments upstream of a non-human immunoglobulin heavy chain constant region, and (c) a nucleotide sequence that encodes an ADAM6 protein or a functional fragment thereof, wherein the ADAM6 protein is expressed from an ectopic ADAM6 nucleic acid sequence.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Lipase variant
abstract_en: To provide a lipase variant that mitigates hindrance to activity on a dispersed substrate in the presence of a surfactant.SOLUTION: In one aspect, the lipase variant comprises an amino acid sequence having at least 75% identity to a specific amino acid sequence, and has substitution in a specific amino acid residue. Compared to the parent lipase, hindrance to lipase activity on a dispersed substrate in the presence of a surfactant is mitigated, and the ability to remove triglycerides on a hard surface in the presence of a surfactant is enhanced, so that the lipase variant has superior cleaning performance.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Culture apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a culture apparatus capable of inhibiting a culture medium from entering a supply pipe disposed in a container.SOLUTION: There is provided a culture apparatus 10 comprising a mesh device 30, a support 50, a container 20 and an aeration tube 21. The mesh device 30 has a pair of mesh parts 31, 31 disposed facing left and right. The support 50 supports the mesh device 30. The container 20 is disposed between the pair of mesh parts 31, 31 and is capable of storing a culture medium W of an organism. The aeration tube 21 is for supplying a gas such as carbon dioxide to the culture medium W in the container 20. The aeration tube 21 has a supply tube 21b which is disposed in the container 20 and extends in a front-back direction. A plurality of blowout holes are formed in the supply tube 21b. The blowout holes are formed in the lower half part of the supply tube 21b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Methods and compositions for modulating splicing and translation
abstract_en: To provide a method for modulating the expression of a target peptide sequence, thereby providing a method for treating a disease or condition and a therapeutic agent.SOLUTION: A method of modulating expression of a target peptide sequence by a cell having a pre-mRNA that encodes the target peptide sequence and comprises an inefficient translation region, the method comprising contacting the cell with a therapeutic agent that binds to a targeted region of the pre-mRNA encoding the target peptide sequence. The therapeutic agent is preferably an antisense oligonucleotide of a specific sequence consisting of 18 nucleobases, incorporating a backbone modification including 2'-O-methoxyethyl (2'MOE)-modified sugar moieties and phosphorothioate linkages.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Methods for treating melanocortin 4 receptor pathway-associated disorders
abstract_en: To provide methods for treating melanocortin 4 receptor pathway-associated disorders.SOLUTION: The disclosure is based, at least in part, on the discovery that the use of an MC4R agonist as replacement therapy targeting defects in the POMC-MC4R pathway, e.g., targeting defects upstream of MC4R, led to significant weight loss, decrease in hunger, and/or increase in energy expenditure in obese subjects. The disclosure relates to a method for treating disorders such as Prader Willi Syndrome (PWS), obesity or hyperphagia using a melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R)-agonist. Also disclosed are a method for treating a subject having a deficiency in pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC)-MC4R pathway, for example, a POMC-null or PCSK-null subject, using an MC4R agonist.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Recombinant components and compositions for use in food products
abstract_en: To provide methods for use in producing alternatives to animal-derived food products from recombinant components, as well as compositions used in and obtained from such methods.SOLUTION: Provided are methods for producing food products comprising recombinant components, and compositions used in and food products produced by such methods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Leader sequence
abstract_en: To provide not only improved delivery systems, but also means for producing such systems which find compatibility with molecules (payloads) having a range of sizes and molecular properties.SOLUTION: The present invention provides use of a Photorhabdus Virulence Cassettes (PVC) effector leader sequence, for packaging a payload into a PVC Needle Complex, and related methods for manufacturing a packaged PVC Needle Complex. The payload is one or more selected from a polypeptide, a nucleic acid, or a combination thereof, and the leader sequence and the payload form an effector fusion that is distinct from a wild-type PVC effector protein.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3B

title_en: Crispr-cas-related methods, compositions and components for cancer immunotherapy
abstract_en: To provide CRISPR/CAS-related compositions and methods for treatment of cancer.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a gRNA molecule comprising a targeting domain complementary to a target domain derived from a FAS, BID, CTLA4, PDCD1, CBLB, PTPN6, TRAC or TRBC gene, wherein the targeting domain is configured to provide a cleavage event selected from a double strand break and a single strand break within 500, 400, 300, 200, 100, 50, 25, or 10 nucleotides of a T cell target knockout position.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Devices and methods for detecting microorganisms using recombinant reproduction-deficient indicator bacteriophage
abstract_en: To provide compositions, methods, kits and systems for rapid detection of microorganisms using a reproduction-deficient indicator bacteriophage.SOLUTION: The specificity of such reproduction-deficient indicator bacteriophage for binding and infecting particular microorganisms of interest allows targeted and sensitive detection of a microorganism of interest. An exemplary embodiment of the present disclosure is a composition comprising at least two recombinant phages, each comprising an indicator gene in a late gene region of the genome of the phage, where the recombinant phages are reproduction-deficient, and where the recombinant phages are capable of specifically infecting one or more microorganisms of interest.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Cd137 binding molecules and uses thereof
abstract_en: To provide CD137 binding molecules, in particular CD137×TA binding molecules capable of binding to both an epitope of CD137 and an epitope of a tumor antigen.SOLUTION: The present invention is directed to binding molecules that possess one or more epitope-binding sites specific for an epitope of CD137, including antibodies, and molecules comprising epitope-binding fragments thereof. The invention is further directed to multispecific binding molecules comprising one or more epitope-binding sites specific for an epitope of CD137 and one or more epitope-binding sites specific for an epitope of a tumor antigen ("TA") (e.g., a "CD137×TA Binding Molecule"). In one embodiment, such CD137×TA binding molecules are bispecific molecules, and in particular are bispecific tetravalent diabodies having two epitope-binding sites each specific for an epitope of CD137 and two epitope-binding sites each specific for an epitope of TA.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Cyclization method for peptide compounds
abstract_en: To provide a novel cyclization method for peptide compounds to construct a peptide display library, and to provide methods for the synthesis of branched peptides.SOLUTION: Provided is a method for producing a peptide compound having a cyclic portion, the method comprising: 1) translating and synthesizing an acyclic peptide compound from a nucleic acid encoding the peptide compound composed of an amino acid residue and/or amino acid analog residue, or an amino acid residue and/or amino acid analog residue and N-terminal carboxylic acid analog, the acyclic peptide compound containing an amino acid residue or amino acid analog residue having a reactive site in one of its side chains, and an amino acid, amino acid analog residue or N-terminal carboxylic acid analog with another reactive site at the N-terminus; and 2) forming a carbon-carbon bond between the reactive site of the N-terminal amino acid residue, N-terminal amino acid analog residue, or N-terminal carboxylic acid analog and the reactive site of the amino acid residue or amino acid analog having a reactive site in one of its side chains.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Antisense nucleic acids that induce exon 51 skipping
abstract_en: To provide an agent for highly efficiently skipping the 51st exon of a human dystrophin gene in the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD).SOLUTION: The following (a1) to (d1): (a1) an antisense oligomer comprising a specific nucleotide sequence; (b1) an antisense oligomer comprising a nucleotide sequence derived from the specific nucleotide sequence by deletion, substitution, insertion, and / or addition of 1 to 5 nucleotides; (c1) an antisense oligomer comprising a nucleotide sequence derived from the specific nucleotide sequence by deletion, substitution, insertion, and / or addition of 1 to 5 nucleotides; An antisense oligomer comprising a base sequence having a sequence identity of 80% or more; and (d1) an antisense oligomer hybridizing under stringent conditions with an oligonucleotide consisting of a base sequence complementary to a specific base sequence, provided that the specific base sequence is excluded, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof or a hydrate thereof.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Determination of nucleic acid sequence concentration
abstract_en: To provide a method for determining the concentration of a nucleic acid sequence without underestimating the presence of the target nucleic acid sequence by fragmentation.SOLUTION: The present invention is a method of determining the concentration of a sequence to be detected in non-fragmented nucleic acid by applying a correction factor to the concentration of said sequence to be detected measured in fragmented nucleic acid. Determining the length distribution (LD) of nucleic acids in a sample comprising fragmented nucleic acids, wherein fragmented nucleic acids are derived from said non-fragmented nucleic acids; ii. measuring the concentration of said sequence to be detected in said sample comprising fragmented nucleic acids by a measurement method; and iii. correcting the measured concentration of said sequence to be detected in the sample comprising fragmented nucleic acids by a correction factor to obtain: Obtaining the concentration of the sequence to be detected in the unfragmented nucleic acid, wherein the correction factor is based on the length distribution (LD) and at least one parameter of the measurement method.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Indoor air quality improvement system with microalgae
abstract_en: An indoor air quality improvement system using microalgae is disclosed. According to the present invention, the indoor air quality improvement system using microalgae comprises: a water tank containing a culture solution having salinity within a predetermined range; an air suction unit positioned on one side of the water tank to allow external air containing fine dust to be supplied to the culture solution submerged in the water tank; and a microalgae injection unit installed on the other side of the water tank to allow the microalgae removing the fine dust supplied to the water tank to be supplied to the water tank.

title_en: Use of conditioned media containing high concentration of extracellular vesicles with enhanced functions for alleviating and preventing hair loss
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a use of a conditioned medium for alleviating, preventing, or treating hair loss, containing a high concentration of extracellular vesicles obtained by culturing cells in a culture medium comprising lactoferrin. More specifically, the present invention relates to a composition for alleviating, preventing, or treating hair loss comprising the conditioned medium.

title_en: Contactless Biological Sample Tissue Separation Device
abstract_en: Provided is a contactless biological sample tissue separation device comprising: a cylindrical lower chamber (110); a cylindrical upper chamber (120) disposed on the lower chamber (110) and having open upper and lower portions; a rotation shaft (150) rotatably inserted into a rotation shaft support rod (122) that is formed vertically at the center inside the upper chamber (120); a porous plate (200) mounted below the rotation shaft (150); a blade (210) rotatably mounted on the rotation shaft (150) on the porous plate (200); a scraper (220) rotatably mounted on a lower end of the rotation shaft (150) below the porous plate (200); and a cover (160) disposed at a top of the upper chamber (120). According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent foreign substances or contaminants from mixing with a biological sample (MB') and significantly reduce the separation and acquisition time of the biological sample (MB').

title_en: Mycelium culture method based on fiber medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for culturing mycelium based on a fiber medium, comprising the steps of: applying a nutritional substance in the form of a liquid gel containing a nutritional component for culturing the mycelium to the fiber medium; and applying a first mycelium among a plurality of myceliums to the fiber medium and growing the same.

title_en: Method of promoting tillering of crops involving overexpression of the ospap3 gene
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for promoting tillering of crops comprising a step of overexpressing an OsPAP3 gene and, more specifically, to a method for promoting tillering of crops, which promotes chloroplast development by overexpressing the OsPAP3 gene and increases tillering formation of crops to improve crop production.

title_en: Bio sensor
abstract_en: A biosensor according to embodiments of the present invention includes a substrate, a working electrode including a reaction electrode layer disposed on the substrate and an enzyme reaction layer disposed on the reaction electrode layer, and a reference electrode spaced apart from the working electrode. The surface roughness (Ra) of the reaction electrode layer is 0.2 to 1.5 μm. By increasing the measurement range of the biosensor, it is possible to accurately measure the concentration of a small amount of a target substance.

title_en: Method for production of human parathyroid hormone 1-34 with groes pusion
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a fusion tag, and a fusion polypeptide comprising the fusion tag and human parathyroid hormone 1-34. When the novel fusion tag according to the present invention is used, the yield of human parathyroid hormone 1-34 can be improved compared to a conventional fusion tag. In particular, the present invention is useful in the case of producing human parathyroid hormone 1-34 having a relatively small molecular weight and easily degraded amino terminus by using genetic recombination technology. In addition, the fusion polypeptide comprising the fusion tag according to an embodiment of the present invention has an advantage of being protected from proteolytic enzymes of a host cell and stably producing human parathyroid hormone 1-34 as the expression is induced in the form of an inclusion body in the host cell. Therefore, it is possible to provide a method for producing human parathyroid hormone 1-34 with improved stability and yield compared to the case of using a conventional fusion tag. In order to achieve the purpose of the present invention, the fusion tag for producing human parathyroid hormone 1-34 may include amino acid sequence of SEQ ID No: 6, may be located at N-terminus of human parathyroid hormone 1-34, may be expressed together with human parathyroid hormone 1-34 to form an inclusion body, and may include a linker which is linked the fusion tag to human parathyroid hormone 1-34.

title_en: Composition for detecting antibiotic resistant pathogen of sepsis and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition, kit and method for detecting an antibiotic resistant pathogen, comprising a primer set capable of detecting an antibiotic resistant pathogen among pathogens of sepsis, and a primer and probe set for diagnostic and predictive PCR and a kit using the same or a method for providing information. When using the composition for detecting an antibiotic resistant pathogen of the present invention, it is possible to quickly detect a main causative pathogen of sepsis with high sensitivity. In particular, when used for digital PCR, it is possible to provide high sensitivity and specificity compared to general TaqMan PCR or blood culture. In addition, the present invention can be clinically used and effectively used for sepsis diagnosis or prognosis prediction because a gene associated with the pathogen of sepsis can be detected directly from the blood of a patient suspected of sepsis without a culture step.

title_en: A novel DNA vaccine construct for CMV and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fusion protein used for a novel cytomegalovirus (CMV) vaccine and a use thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to polynucleotide for encrypting a fusion protein comprising CMV gB with deletion of a signal sequence, a transmembrane, and a domain, and a shuffled CMV pp65 protein in which orders of an N-terminal fragment and a C-terminal fragment produced by cleavage at amino acid positions 435 to 438 of a CMV coat protein pp65 are reversed and linked; and a vaccine composition comprising the polynucleotide as an active ingredient. Accordingly, a vaccine prepared by the present invention can be efficiently used for preventing and treating CMV infectious diseases.

title_en: Manufacturing method of isomalto-oligosaccharide using rice powder
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of isomaltooligosaccharide using rice flour, which can manufacture the isomaltooligosaccharide with significantly enhanced prebiotic functions than before by controlling the reaction time and reaction temperature of rice flour and various enzymes, and can be provided as a pharmaceutical composition for prevention, improvement or treatment of irritable bowel syndrome, or as health functional food.

title_en: Method for enhancing immune function of immune cell and immune cell line using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for enhancing the immune function of an immune cell and an immune cell line obtained thereby. The method for enhancing the immune function of an immune cell according to the present invention comprises the steps of: treating an immune cell with a PI3K inhibitor so as to stimulate sub-signals of AKT/mTOR in an ex vivo context; and culturing the immune cell treated with the PI3K inhibitor so as to enable the reduced AKT to be rebounded.

title_en: Apparatus for cell culture
abstract_en: The present invention provides a cell culture device. A cell culture device according to one embodiment of the present invention is a cell culture device for culturing cells to form a three-dimensional spheroid, and may comprise a plate and a plurality of wells disposed on one surface of the plate at a predetermined interval, wherein cells are cultured therein, and micro patterns are disposed on the inner surface so that the inner surface and the cells are spaced apart. According to the present invention, shapes and sizes of spheroids can be uniformly controlled.

title_en: Multi-channel fluorescence detection device using stained glass
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-channel fluorescence detection device which comprises: a PC chip having a chamber for storing a sample; a housing where a light penetration unit is formed in at least a portion of a front side; a plurality of exciting units disposed inside the housing to irradiate light, respectively; and a plurality of emission filters allowing only specific fluorescent light detected among multiple fluorescent light emitted through exciting to penetrate. The PCR chip can be disposed on a front side of the housing to face the light penetration unit.

title_en: Multiple Biomarkers for Lung Cancer Diagnosis and Uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for diagnosing lung cancer, which comprises an agent capable of simultaneously measuring an expression level of SAA, OPN, and CEA, which are lung cancer-specific biomarkers, and more specifically, to a composition for diagnosing lung cancer with increased sensitivity and specificity compared to the conventional biomarkers in terms of an effect and with high diagnostic efficiency, to a lung cancer diagnostic kit comprising the same, and to a diagnosis method of lung cancer using the composition.

title_en: Novel Mesorhizobium soli strain capable of degrading organochlorine pesticide and use of the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a Mesorhizobium soli JH203 strain (KACC 92318P) having organochlorine pesticide decomposition ability. The Mesorhizobium soli JH203 strain (KACC 92318P) of the present invention has excellent decomposition ability for organochlorine pesticides, especially endosulfan. Therefore, the Mesorhizobium soli strain JH203 (KACC 92318P) of the present invention is very useful for biological treatment of soil or water contaminated with the organochlorine pesticides.

title_en: Puer tea extract with increased gallic acid content and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a puer tea extract with an increased gallic acid content and a method for manufacturing the same. The method includes a step of preparing raw materials by grinding puer tea leaves and macerating and aging the same; a step of conducting decompression extraction of the aged product; and a step of conducting decompression concentration of the decompression extracted product.

title_en: CbCN12 gene for enhancing resistance to anthracnose derived from pepper and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to CbCN12 gene derived from an anthracnose-resistant chili pepper cultivar. According to the present invention, it is possible to develop chili pepper cultivars with enhanced or improved resistance to anthracnose caused by Colletotrichum sp. strains, through the expression of the CbCN12 gene.

title_en: Vector for modular cloning of Corynebacterium glutamicum and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vector for modular cloning of Corynebacterium glutamicum and a use thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to: a vector for modular cloning of Corynebacterium glutamicum containing pBL1, ColE1, an antibiotic resistance gene, and one type-IIS restriction enzyme site; a kit including the same; a modular cloning method using the same; and the like.

title_en: SNP marker for determining the content of fatty acid(Eicosenoic acid, C20:1) in pigs and its uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) marker capable of determining the content of fatty acids in pigs, and specifically, to a SNP marker composition for determining the content of eicosenoic ACID (C20:1) in pigs, in which a 1001st base of polynucleotide consisting of a nucleotide sequence of SEQ ID NO: 1 is T or C, and contains a polynucleotide consisting of 5 to 1,000 consecutive bases including the 1001st base or a nucleotide complementary thereto.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of diseases associated with immune dysregulation comprising oxidized immunoglobulin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating immune dysregulation-related diseases, comprising oxidized immunoglobulin as an active ingredient and a preventive or therapeutic method using same. More specifically, the present invention can provide: a pharmaceutical composition for treating allergic diseases, chronic inflammatory diseases, autoimmune diseases or malignant tumor diseases, comprising as an active ingredient oxidized immunoglobulin obtained through artificially induced oxidation; and a novel immunomodulatory therapy which, by administering the composition to patients with the diseases, is differentiated from existing immunoglobulin therapeutic agents and more effective.

title_en: Novel Streptomyces sp. KA-1 Strain and Use Thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a streptomyces sp. KA-1 strain. The strain of the present invention has excellent nematicide efficacy and can be used to exhibit excellent nematode control effects. The strain can be used as a microbial agent to control nematodes. In addition, the strain of the present invention has excellent amylase, protease, and cellulase activities, and thus, can increase soil composting ability.

title_en: Organic waste disposal device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic waste destruction device. The organic waste destruction device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a case; a stirring tank fixed to the inside of the case and having a space therein for storing organic waste and microorganisms which decompose the organic waste; power means disposed inside the case and outside the stirring tank; a first solenoid valve disposed inside the case and controlling the inflow of water into the stirring tank from the outside; a perforated plate disposed inside the stirring tank and having a plurality of perforated holes to discharge organic waste decomposed by microorganisms; a drain plate disposed at the bottom of the stirring tank and into which organic waste discharged from the perforated plate flows; a second solenoid valve disposed inside the case and controlling the inflow of water into the drain plate; a rotating shaft disposed in the storage space of the stirring tank and rotating forward or reverse by power means; a stirring shaft coupled to the rotating shaft and for stirring the organic waste and microorganisms; and a dehydration device disposed inside the case, outside the stirring tank, and removing moisture from the organic waste discharged from the drain plate. Accordingly, the present invention can prevent damage to the stirring unit while smoothly decomposing organic waste through microorganisms.

title_en: All in one molecular diagnosis apparatus and method of molecular diagnosing using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated molecule diagnosis device and a molecule diagnosis method using the same. The integrated molecule diagnosis device includes: a buffer tube into which a sampling tool for collecting a sample is inserted and which generates a sample solution including nucleic acids extracted from the collected sample; and a cartridge that is combined with the buffer tube to receive the sample solution, transports the sample solution to a reaction chamber through a fluid channel, and receives heat at a constant temperature to perform a nucleic acid amplification reaction; and a diagnosis module main body that is detachably coupled to the cartridge to supply heat at the constant temperature to the reaction chamber and detects the nucleic acid amplification reaction to diagnose whether a diagnostic target exists.

title_en: Primer set for discriminating genetic polymorphism of Perilla sp. and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a primer set for discriminating genetic polymorphism of plants of perilla genus and uses thereof, wherein an SSR primer set of the present invention can effectively detect DNA polymorphisms in perilla and plants of Perilla frutescens, a variety of perilla, and thus, by efficiently evaluating the genetic resources of the plants of perilla genus, it will be possible to provide useful information for molecular breeding research on the plants of perilla genus.

title_en: A Composition Immune Checkpoint Inhibition Comprising a WNK3 Inhibitor as an Active Ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for inhibiting an immune checkpoint containing a WNK3 inhibitor, and a composition for preventing or treating cancer or a composition for enhancing immunity containing the same. The composition of the present invention increases the sensitivity of tumors to immune cells by suppressing PD-L1 expression, while promoting the secretion of GRANZYME B and perforin by T cells, which results in multifaceted anti-cancer activity. In addition, a screening method of the present invention efficiently inhibits the expression of PD-L1, which plays a key role in tumor cells' immune evasion mechanism. Thus, candidate substances for fundamental anti-cancer treatments that significantly improve cancer cells' sensitivity to immune responses can be quickly and reliably discovered.

title_en: Long-acting fatty acid-peptide derivatives and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a long-acting fatty acid-peptide derivative and a use thereof, and in particular, to a long-acting GLP-1/GLP-2 dual agonist, and a use thereof for treating intestinal diseases, intestinal damage, or gastric diseases, and the like. The fatty acid-peptide derivative of the present invention, which is an agonist for both GLP-1 and GLP-2 receptors, effectively stimulates GLP-1 and GLP-2 receptors known as targets for short bowel syndrome, has an excellent in-vivo long-acting effect compared to existing drugs, and exhibits a significantly superior therapeutic effect compared to a negative control and a positive control in a short bowel syndrome animal model, and thus can be effectively used in the prevention, amelioration and treatment of intestinal diseases and gastric diseases.

title_en: Liposomal virus-like particles combined with recombinant Spike protein and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liposomal virus-like particle having a recombinant spike protein (S protein) bound to a surface thereof, and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the virus-like particle exhibits antigenic characteristics but does not contain viral genetic material, so that it is possible to be effectively used as an antigen carrier or vaccine candidate, or for immune system research.

title_en: A Composition for Preventing or Treating Cancer Comprising Novel Glycodelted Antibody as an Active Ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention provides an anti-PD1 antibody of which the sugar chain is cleaved into a specific form to improve stability and efficiency, and a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating cancer comprising the same. The present invention provides an improved form of anti-PD-1 antibody which reduces the immunogenicity of the antibody itself and restores T cell activity by optimizing the form of the sugar chain attached to the host cell through GlycoDelete during recombinant production of antibodies. Accordingly, the antibody of the present invention can be ultimately usefully used as an excellent therapeutic antibody which can significantly improve the survival rate of cancer patients through multifaceted anticancer immune activation.

title_en: Anti-Chitinase-3-like protein 1 antibody
abstract_en: An anti-chitinase-3-like protein 1 antibody or an antigen-binding fragment thereof of the present invention comprises a light chain variable region comprising CDRs of Table 1 and a heavy chain variable region comprising CDRs of Table 2. The main purpose of the present invention is to provide a novel antibody capable of specifically binding to chitinase-3-like protein 1 (CHI3L1).

title_en: Composition and method for preparing fructose
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition capable of producing fructose at low cost and high yield by including a sucrose phosphorylation enzyme or a microorganism expressing the same or a culture or pulverized product of the microorganism, and a method for producing fructose.

title_en: Immune enhancing composition containing phosvitin phosphopeptide and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for enhancing immunity comprising phosvitin phosphopeptide and a method for preparing the same. The composition of the present invention can effectively produce phosphopeptide from phosvitin through high-temperature and mild-pressure (HTMP) pretreatment and protease treatment, wherein the phosphopeptide has excellent immunity enhancing activity and can be used as a functional material for enhancing immunity in the pharmaceutical and food fields.

title_en: Manufacturing method of chestnut bread using sugar-resistant yeast
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing chestnut bread using yeast with excellent sugar resistance and, more specifically, to a method for manufacturing chestnut bread using saccharomyces cerevisiae (accession number kctc 15007bp) bradwarm strain (accession number kctc 15007bp) which maintains fermentation power in high sugar dough.

title_en: Novel polypeptide having Deoxynivalenol degradation activity
abstract_en: A mutant polypeptide having DON (Deoxynivalenol) decomposition activity is provided, wherein the mutant polypeptide has an amino acid at a position corresponding to position 36 or 86 of SEQ ID NO: 1 replaced with a different amino acid. The mutant polypeptide having DON decomposition activity of the present application has improved DON decomposition activity, thermal stability, and heat resistance, and can be usefully applied to various industrial fields.

title_en: Genetic biocontainment system to prevent theft and misuse of biological resources and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nucleic acid molecules using quadruplet codons and decoding systems thereof, plasmids or microbial strains containing the same, or a genetic biocontainment technology for preventing the theft or misuse of biological resources such as sequence information related to the nucleic acid molecules. More specifically, the present invention relates to a composition or microbial strain, and a genetic biocontainment method using the same, wherein the composition or microbial strain contains nucleic acid molecules in which triplet codons coding for specific amino acids are replaced with quadruplet codons, wherein the nucleic acid molecules exhibit genetic biocontainment in an environment where tRNA for the quadruplet codons is absent. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a biocontainment method for protecting sequence information using quadruplet codons.

title_en: Novel 1,3-propanediol exporter and method of producing 1,3-propanediol using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel 1,3-propanediol secreting protein and a method for producing 1,3-propanediol using the same, and more specifically, to a recombinant protein or a functional fragment thereof exhibiting activity of secreting 1,3-propanediol produced and accumulated inside a cell to the outside of the cell, a polynucleotide encoding the recombinant protein or the functional fragment thereof, a recombinant expression vector comprising the polynucleotide, a microorganism for producing 1,3-propanediol overexpressing the recombinant protein or the functional fragment thereof, and a method for producing 1,3-propanediol using the same.

title_en: Composition for inhibiting autophagy activity comprising MAB_0676c protein as effective component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for inhibiting autophagy activation comprising an MAB_0676c protein as an active ingredient. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method for regulating autophagy activity in cells in vitro, a kit, and a composition, the method comprising treating cells with an MAB_0676c protein consisting of the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 2.

title_en: Electrical stimulation cell culture system comprising yarn containing conductive polymer and cell culture method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an electrical stimulation cell culture system comprising a yarn containing a conductive polymer and a cell culture method using the same. The cell culture system of the present invention comprises: an electrical stimulation unit (100) comprising a working electrode (110) comprising a yarn and a first conductive polymer and a counter electrode (120) electrically connected to the working electrode; a cell culture unit (200) comprising a conductive scaffold (210) electrically connected to the working electrode (110) and the counter electrode (120), respectively, between the working electrode (110) and the counter electrode (120); an electrolyte (300) comprising a cell culture medium (310); and a packaging part (400) capable of mechanical deformation, which fixes one end and the other end of the above-mentioned working electrode (110) respectively. By using cell culture medium as an electrolyte, the possibility of integrating the electrolyte used for driving the energy harvester and cell culture is improved, and the protruding external wire used for electrical stimulation transmission when using a conventional mechanical energy harvester is unnecessary, thereby reducing the complexity of the system and enabling miniaturization, and has the effect of being usable in the medical industry and the biopharmaceutical industry.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition comprising stem cells treated with ingenol-3-angelate for treatment of autoimmune disease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for treating autoimmune diseases comprising stem cells treated with ingenol-3-angelate (i3a). The stem cells treated with i3a according to the present invention can inhibit or reduce the function of b cells and have an excellent therapeutic effect on autoimmune diseases such as lupus disease, thereby being useful for preventing or treating various autoimmune diseases including lupus disease.

title_en: Manufacturing method of pain au chocolat using sugar-resistant yeast
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing pain au chocolat using yeast with excellent sugar tolerance, and more specifically, to a method for producing pain au chocolat using the Saccharomyces cerevisiae FRUITFLY strain (accession number KCTC 15094BP) which maintains fermentation power in high-sugar dough.

title_en: Antisense oligonucleotide having reduced toxicity.
abstract_en: Provided is an antisense oligonucleotide having reduced toxicity. This antisense oligonucleotide has a central region, a 5'-side region, and a 3'-side region, and is characterized by having, in the central region: a nucleotide in which the 2'-position and 3'-position of the sugar moiety thereof are cross-linked (2'-3' cross-linked nucleotide); and/or a non-cross-linked nucleotide having a substituent at position 3' thereof (position 3'-modified non-cross-linked nucleotide).

title_en: Bcma chimeric antigen receptors and uses thereof.
abstract_en: The invention provides compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with expression of BCMA. The invention also relates to chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) specific to BCMA, vectors encoding the same, and recombinant T cells comprising the BCMA CAR. The invention also includes methods of administering a genetically modified T cell expressing a CAR that comprises a BCMA binding domain.

title_en: Transcription factors isolated from carica papaya and their application for obtaining tolerant plants at extreme temperatures.
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide four CpRap2 genes isolated from Carica papaya identified as CpRap2.4a, CpRap2.4b, CpRap2.1, CpRap2.10, consisting of SEQ.ID NO:1, SEQ.ID NO:2, SEQ.ID NO:3, and SEQ.ID NO:4. Also, it relates to the genetic transformation methods for the overexpression of said genes and obtaining tolerant non-transgenic plants through grafting. The CpRap2 genes and their grafts showed that they could survive extreme temperatures of up to 12 days for heat and more than 30 days for cold.

title_en: Isolated polynucleotides and polypeptides, and methods of using same for increasing plant yield and/or agricultural characteristics.
abstract_en: Provided are isolated polypeptides which are at least 80% homologous to SEQ ID NOs: 182-184, 186-202, 204-216, 219-223, 225, 227-232, 235-236, 238, 240-260, 262-268, 270-275, 277-287, 289-297, 3651-3671, 3686, 3720-3721, 3724, 3727, 3735, 3754, 3774, 3795-4304, 4316, 4374, 4425, 4464, 4481-4813, 4824, 4833, 4843-4844, 4867-4869, 4888, 4890-4891, 5005-5050, 5053-5070, 5093, 5217, 5231, 5233, 5239, 246, 5255, 5257-5296, 5412, 5415-5429, 5447-5456, 5465-5673, 5675-5686, 5688- 695, 5697-5698, 5700, 5702-5707, 5709-5715, 5717-5785, 5831, 5869, 5980, 6010- 6043, 6045-6053, 6055-6093, 6132, 6383, 6405, 6493, 6523, 6533-6537, and 6563- 6589, isolated polynucleotides encoding same, nucleic acid constructs comprising same, transgenic cells expressing same, transgenic plants expressing same and method of using same for increasing yield, abiotic stress tolerance, growth rate, biomass, vigor, oil content, photosynthetic capacity, seed yield, fiber yield, fiber quality, fiber length, and/or nitrogen use efficiency of a plant.

title_en: Dosage and administration of anti-c5 antibodies for treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis.
abstract_en: Provided are methods for clinical treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) using an anti-C5 antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof.

title_en: Liquid protein formulations containing viscosity-lowering agents.
abstract_en: Concentrated, low-viscosity, low-volume liquid pharmaceutical formulations of proteins have been developed. Such formulations can be rapidly and conveniently administered by subcutaneous or intramuscular injection, rather than by lengthy intravenous infusion. These formulations include low-molecular-weight and/or high-molecular-weight proteins, such as mAbs, and viscosity-lowering agents that are typically bulky polar organic compounds, such as many of the GRAS (US Food and Drug Administration List of compounds generally regarded as safe) and inactive injectable ingredients and FDA approved therapeutics.

title_en: Csfv subunit vaccine.
abstract_en: Provided a recombinant classical swine fever virus E2 protein comprising at least one mutation at the epitope specifically recognized by the 6B8 monoclonal antibody. Further, the present invention provides an immunogenic composition comprising the recombinant E2 protein of the present invention and the use of the immunogenic composition for preventing and/or treating diseases associated with CSFV in animal. Moreover, the present invention provides a method and a kit for differentiating animals infected with CSFV from animals vaccinated with the immunogenic composition of the present invention.

title_en: Cell therapy methods.
abstract_en: The present invention is in the field of cell therapy and provides compositions and methods for treating cancer and/or viral infections in patients. The invention provides lymphocytes comprising a synthetic polynucleotide encoding at least one iron regulatory protein and, optionally, a chimeric antigen receptor. The invention further provides methods for producing these lymphocytes and administering them to patients.

title_en: Modulation of t cell responses by ul18 of human cytomegalovirus.
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to methods of modulating T cell responses by UL18 of human cytomegalovirus. The disclosure also relates to methods of generating MHC-Ia, MHC-II, and/or MHC-E restricted CD8+ T cells.

title_en: Puccinia resistance gene.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a plant which has integrated into its genome an exogenous polynucleotide encoding a polypeptide which confers resistance to at least one strain of Puccinia graminis.

title_en: Plant regulatory elements and uses thereof.
abstract_en: The invention provides DNA molecules and constructs, including their nucleotide sequences, useful for modulating gene expression in plants and plant cells. Transgenic plants, plant cells, plant parts, seeds, and commodity products comprising the DNA molecules operably linked to heterologous transcribable polynucleotides are also provided, as are methods of their use.

title_en: Precursor tri-specific antibody constructs and methods of use thereof.
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are precursor tri- specific antibody constructs comprising (i) a first binding domain that binds to a tumor associated antigen, (ii) a second binding domain that binds to a first natural killer (NK) cell surface antigen, and (iii) a third binding domain that binds to a T cell surface antigen or a second NK cell surface antigen. The antibody constructs further comprises regulatory domains that regulate binding to the T cell or NK cell surface antigen. Pharmaceutical compositions comprising the precursor constructs and their uses for treating tumors are also disclosed.

title_en: Compositions and methods for epigenome editing.
abstract_en: Provided herein are,<i> inter alia</i>, compositions and methods for modulating gene expression.

title_en: Methods and compositions for crispr/cas9 guide rna efficiency and specificity against genetically diverse hiv-1 isolates.
abstract_en: Disclosed are guide RNAs (gRNAs) that specifically bind the 5' LTR human immunodeficiency virus -1 (HIV-1) sequence comprising TTGGATGGTGCTTCAAGTTA (SEQ ID NO: 1). Disclosed are gRNAs that specifically bind the 5' LTR HIV-1 sequence comprising CTACAAGGGACTTTCCGCTG (SEQ ID NO:2). Disclosed are gRNAs that specifically bind the 5' LTR HIV-1 sequence comprising TCTACAAGGGACTTTCCGCT (SEQ ID NO: 3). Disclosed are nucleic acid sequences comprising a nucleic acid sequence encoding one or more gRNAs, wherein said one or more gRNAs hybridize with a target sequence in HIV-1, wherein the target sequence is selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NO: 1, SEQ ID NO:2, and SEQ ID NO:3. Disclosed are vectors comprising a nucleic acid sequence encoding one or more gRNAs, wherein the one or more gRNA hybridizes with a target sequence in HIV-1, wherein the target sequence is selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NO: 1, SEQ ID NO:2, and SEQ ID NO:3. Disclosed are methods for inhibiting the function of a target HIV-1 DNA sequence in a cell or removing a target HIV-1 DNA sequence from a cellular genome comprising contacting a cell comprising a cellular genome and harboring a HIV-1 genome comprising a target HIV-1 DNA sequence integrated into the cellular genome with one or more gRNAs, or nucleic acids encoding said one or more gRNAs, and a Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats-Associated (cas) protein, or nucleic acid sequence encoding a cas protein, wherein the one or more gRNAs uniquely hybridizes with the target HIV-1 DNA sequence, wherein the target HIV-1 DNA sequence is selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NO: 1, SEQ ID NO:2, and SEQ ID NO:3; thereby inhibiting the function or presence of the target HIV-1 DNA sequence.

title_en: Parthenocarpic watermelon plants.
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to seedless fruit producing watermelon. The present invention also comprises methods for production of said plants and methods for producing seedless watermelon.

title_en: Nanomaterials.
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes compositions, preparations, nanoparticles (such as lipid nanoparticles), and/or nanomaterials and methods of their use.

title_en: Methods of preparing directional tagmentation sequencing libraries using transposon-based technology with unique molecular identifiers for error correction.
abstract_en: Materials and methods for preparing nucleic acid libraries for next-generation sequencing are described herein. A variety of approaches are described relating to the use of unique molecular identifiers with transposon-based technology in the preparation of sequencing libraries. Also described herein are sequencing materials and methods for identifying and correcting amplification and sequencing errors.

title_en: An anti-tslp fab with improved stability.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an anti-TSLP Fab with improved stability, nucleic acids encoding said Fab, host cells and vector comprising said nucleic acids, and methods of using said Fab in the treatment of TSLP-related conditions.

title_en: Compositions and methods for enhancing gene silencing activity of oligonucleotide compounds.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for enhancing the gene silencing activity of oligonucleotide compounds. In particular, the invention relates to inhibiting the expression or activity of suppressor proteins, such as RAB18, ZW10, STX18, SCFD2, NAPG, SAMD4B, or VPS37A, to increase the efficacy of ligand-conjugated oligonucleotide compounds in reducing the expression of target genes in a cell.

title_en: Magea1 immunogenic peptides, binding proteins recognizing magea1 immunogenic peptides, and uses thereof.
abstract_en: Provided herein are MAGE Al immunogenic peptides, binding proteins recognizing MAGEA1 immunogenic peptides, and uses thereof.

title_en: Systems and processes for aquaculture crop rotation.
abstract_en: A process, system, and use of the system are disclosed, which enable the successive growth of aquatic animals and algae within the same aquaculture pond and optionally reduction of infestation species in ponds bottom solids of the aquaculture pond.

title_en: Tgfî² signal convertor.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides improved compositions for adoptive T cell therapies for treating, preventing, or ameliorating at least one symptom of a cancer, infectious disease, autoimmune disease, inflammatory disease, and immunodeficiency, or condition associated therewith.

title_en: Syf2 antisense oligonucleotides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to SYF2 antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs), pharmaceutical compositions containing them, and methods for treating, inhibiting, suppressing, and preventing neurological diseases with them.

title_en: Improved glycan-dependent chimeric antigen receptor cells
abstract_en: Provided are compositions and methods for treating diseases associated with aberrant glycosylation of cell surface molecules and expression of tumor-associated carbohydrate antigens (TACA). Also provided are chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) specific to tumor-associated carbohydrate antigens (TACA-CARs), vectors encoding the TACA-CARs, and recombinant cells comprising the TACA CARs.

title_en: Milk-derived mirnas as indicators of stress in bovine
abstract_en: The present invention relates miRNA biomarkers from milk, e.g. exosome-derived microRNA from milk, as indicators of welfare in bovines. In particular, the present invention relates to the identification of heat stress in bovines allowing to propose management actions to improve productive animal welfare at the individual or the herd levels.

title_en: Prrs virus variant, european prrs virus cdna clone, and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the field of animal health and provides means to study Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome (PRRS), a vira! disease affecting swine, and for the development of vaccines, therapeutics and diagnostics for the prophylaxis, treatment and diagnosis of PRRS. in a first consideration, the invention relates to a new PRRS virus variant, and, in a second consideration, to a nucleic acid sequence which comprises the genome of an infectious genotype I (EU) PRRS virus clone. Based on this, new PRRS vaccine candidates with improved properties are provided.

title_en: Portable device for obtaining biofilms
abstract_en: The portable device for obtaining biofilms is a device intended to obtain bacterial biofilms directly from nature in a standardized or non-standardized medium, over a flat surface, where different laboratory tests may be applied for studying the biofilms. The device comprises two pieces with an assembly system that form a case, which has perforation arrangements for ventilation purposes so that enabling water and/or air flow or other fluid to flow. These two pieces are useful for introducing the bases over which the microbial community is to be formed, so as to be subsequent studied in the laboratory. In addition, the invention has a counterweight, a couple of bores with tinned string located at the lower portion thereof for being fastened to a surface using a screw and a couple of fastening eyelets arranged in the front wall of the upper cover of the device for being fastened to strings.

title_en: Novel method for controlling dna replication in malaria parasites
abstract_en: The present disclosure is related to a Histone H3 Clipping by a cathepsin C-like protease as a new epigenetic mechanism used by P. falciparum to control DNA replication. Post-translational modifications (PTMs) of histone N-terminal tails are key epigenetic regulators of gene expression in the human malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum. Here, we identify developmentally controlled proteolytic clipping of the N-terminus of histone H3 at amino acid position 21 by a cathepsin C-like protease termed dipeptidyl aminopeptidase 2 (PfDPAP2) as a new PTM in intra-erythrocytic parasite stages. Conditionally knocked down PfDPAP2 abrogated histone H3 clipping and blocked intra-erythrocytic parasite DNA replication. Correspondingly, genome-wide occupancy of clipped histone H3 identified the upstream regions of several DNA replication genes as targets of this essential protease. Because episomally expressed clipped histone H3 showed nucleosomal incorporation at similar genomic loci as the endogenous clipped protein, this points to a novel type of nucleosome replacement mechanism in P. falciparum. The discovery of an unprecedented protease-mediated, epigenetic control mechanism of DNA replication makes PfDPAP2 a promising therapeutic target to develop anti-malarials.
