The invention relates to a supermolecule hydrogel which is prepared from 2-deoxy-2-fluoro-guanine nucleoside analogues shown in a formula I and silver ions. The silver ion supermolecule antibacterial hydrogel has the advantages of simple preparation, low toxicity, good biocompatibility, good stability and the like; the antibacterial material can effectively and slowly release silver ions, has good antibacterial activity, particularly has higher antibacterial activity on methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus ATCC25923, ATCC33591 and fusobacterium nucleatum, is prepared into an antibacterial material, and has better application prospect.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for preventing and treating diabetic neuropathy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for preventing and treating diabetic neuropathy, and relates to the field of medicines for preventing and treating chronic complications of diabetes, wherein pepper or rattan pepper, hot pepper and ligusticum wallichii or extracts thereof are used as raw materials, and the raw materials comprise 0.5-5.0 parts by weight of pepper or rattan pepper: 0.01 to 0.1 percent of hot pepper and 5.0 to 50.0 percent of Szechuan lovage rhizome. According to the invention, the Chinese prickly ash or rattan pepper, the hot pepper and the ligusticum wallichii have obvious synergistic interaction effect and obvious synergistic antagonistic toxicity effect when being used together, so that the composition has a good prevention and treatment effect on diabetic neuropathy.

title_en: Polypeptide for inhibiting hog cholera virus infection activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polypeptide for inhibiting the infection activity of classical swine fever virus and application thereof, wherein the polypeptide sequence is KRWWSHK (P) 8 ). The invention takes the crystal structure of bovine viral diarrhea virus E2 protein as a template, obtains the three-dimensional structure of classical swine fever virus E2 protein by homologous modeling, and finally obtains a polypeptide sequence with high scoring value, namely P, by virtue of a virtual molecule docking technology 8 (ii) a Artificially synthesized P 8 The sequence is identified by ELISA and SPR tests to have affinity and specificity with the interaction of E2 protein, and the result shows that P 8 Has higher affinity and specific combination with E2; then the activity of inhibiting virus infection is verified by qRT-PCR and IPMA test, and the result shows that P 8 The sequence has the activity of better inhibiting the hog cholera virus from infecting PK-15 cells. The invention can provide reliable theoretical basis and new thought for further research on virus receptors and antiviral drug design.

title_en: CXCR2 inhibitors
abstract_en: Compounds are provided that are CXCR2 inhibitors having the structure (I):

title_en: Targeting shells for drug delivery systems using carbosilane dendrimers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a targeted shell for a drug delivery system. The present invention provides a targeting shell for a drug delivery system, which comprises a silole-containing carbosilane dendrimer and a labeling protein (e.g., green fluorescent protein) containing a targeting recognition site, and which is capable of encapsulating a biopolymer or other molecules and selectively delivering the biopolymer or the like to target cells, by utilizing the reactivity of thiol with haloalkane.

title_en: Self-adhesive resin cement composition for dentistry and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adhesive resin cement composition for dentistry, which comprises the following components: a matrix component and a catalytic component; the matrix component comprises: 1-20 parts by mass of an acidic acrylate monomer, 5-30 parts by mass of a non-acidic acrylate monomer, 25-70 parts by mass of a first filler and 0.1-3 parts by mass of an additive; the acidic acrylate monomer comprises dipentaerythritol penta-propylene phosphate; the additives include a stabilizer and a self-curing initiator; the catalytic component comprises: 10-40 parts by mass of a non-acidic acrylate monomer; 25-70 parts by mass of a second filler and 0.1-3 parts by mass of an additive. According to the invention, a specific photoinitiator initiates specific acrylate polymerization, and the acid-base reaction and curing reaction of a specific acidic monomer and a specific basic filler, so that the finally prepared dental self-adhesive resin cement composition has high tensile strength, adhesive strength and flexural strength.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for relieving diarrhea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for relieving diarrhea, which comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 500-1200 parts of radix sophorae flavescentis, 350-1050 parts of coptis chinensis, 150-450 parts of radix paeoniae alba, 150-450 parts of semen plantaginis and 125-375 parts of liquorice. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is preferably prepared from 950 parts of radix sophorae flavescentis, 700 parts of coptis chinensis, 300 parts of radix paeoniae alba, 300 parts of semen plantaginis, 250 parts of liquorice and 7 parts of belladonna fluid extract by weight. Also discloses a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for relieving diarrhea and a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has simple raw materials and simple and convenient preparation process, has definite curative effect on treating acute enteritis, bacillary dysentery and other diarrhea diseases, does not have adverse reactions such as constipation and the like, and overcomes the defects of the existing clinical medication.

title_en: preparation and application of pH-responsive protein macromolecule amphiphile
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing protein-macromolecule amphiphile, which comprises the following steps: (1) Covalently linking an initiator to a protein to obtain a protein-initiator combination; (2) Carrying out in-situ polymerization on the protein-initiator combination and a monomer compound so as to obtain a protein-macromolecule amphiphile, wherein the macromolecule has pH responsiveness within the range of pH 5-10, and the pKa of the macromolecule is 5-10; the method has simple operation, definite chemical structure and high yield, and the protein-macromolecule amphiphile prepared by the method has high protein activity and high pH response sensitivity, can be used as a delivery carrier of chemotherapeutic drugs or diagnostic reagents, improves the targeting property of small molecule drugs and reduces the side effect; meanwhile, the protein can select some medicinal proteins, and the stability and the targeting property of the medicinal proteins can be improved by virtue of the targeting effect of the pH-responsive macromolecule, so that the application of the protein medicament in tumor diagnosis and treatment is expected to be greatly expanded.

title_en: Health care product containing taxifolin for resisting hexavalent molybdenum ion induced damage and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to research a health-care product containing taxifolin for resisting damage induced by hexavalent molybdenum ions. The raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by weight: 60-70% of taxifolin, 7.5-10% of oldenlandia diffusa extract, 7.5-10% of honeysuckle extract, 7.5-10% of astragalus extract and 7.5-10% of gynostemma pentaphylla extract. The pioneering technology of the invention is that the taxifolin is used as a core functional raw material and is reasonably compatible with four traditional Chinese medicine auxiliary materials to generate a synergistic effect, so that a better treatment effect is realized, and the traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating the related diseases of the heavy metal ion induced human body injury is provided. According to the invention, through in-vitro experimental research on human umbilical vein endothelial cells, the taxifolin composition is found to have a good protection effect on hexavalent molybdenum ion induced human umbilical vein endothelial cell damage, play a positive role in preventing and treating human body damage induced by heavy metal ions, and provide a new idea for development and utilization of taxifolin, oldenlandia diffusa, honeysuckle, astragalus membranaceus and gynostemma pentaphylla.

title_en: Preparation method of valsartan amlodipine tablets and valsartan amlodipine tablets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a valsartan amlodipine tablet and the valsartan amlodipine tablet. The valsartan and the amlodipine besylate are pulverized for 0.5-5min at the rotation speed of 10000-30000rpm to obtain premix, and the premix is mixed with other auxiliary materials to obtain a primary mixture, and the primary mixture is subjected to dry granulation, total mixing, tabletting and coating to prepare the valsartan and amlodipine besylate tablet. The valsartan surface area is increased through a high-speed crushing technology, the cohesiveness is enhanced, the collapsibility is reduced, the amlodipine is used for wrapping amlodipine and retarding the dissolution, the dissolution is similar to that of RLD, and the technical problem that dissolution of a valsartan amlodipine tablet prepared from a new batch of valsartan raw materials of the same manufacturer is dissimilar to that of a reference preparation (RLD) of the original valsartan amlodipine tablet is solved; the preparation process has the characteristics of scientificity, reasonableness, simplicity, easiness in operation, lower production cost and the like.

title_en: New use of cistanche phenylethanoid glycosides in improving sleep and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the pharmacological action of phenylethanoid glycosides in traditional Chinese medicine cistanche for resisting insomnia and application thereof, in particular to the preparation of the phenylethanoid glycosides and the application thereof in medicines and health-care foods for treating insomnia. Pharmacological experiments show that the phenylethanoid glycosides have a strong function of improving sleep. The phenylethanoid glycoside has good activity in improving the sleep function, small side effect, low price and good drug property, and can be used for preparing the drugs for improving the sleep function independently or in combination with other drugs. Can be mixed with pharmaceutically or food acceptable carrier or excipient to make into granule, capsule, tablet, etc.

title_en: anti-EGFRv III safe chimeric antigen receptor, preparation method thereof, NK cell modified by same and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor, a preparation method thereof, an NK cell modified by the anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor and an application, wherein the anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor comprises a CD8leader nucleic acid sequence, an EGFRvIII scFv nucleic acid sequence, a CD8 alpha nucleic acid sequence, an NKG2D nucleic acid sequence, a 2B4 nucleic acid sequence, a CD3 zeta nucleic acid sequence, a self-cleavage polypeptide T2A nucleic acid sequence and an RQR8 nucleic acid sequence. The anti-EGFRv III safe chimeric antigen receptor provided by the invention can reduce serious toxic and side effects caused by excessive activity or uncontrolled activity after the chimeric antigen receptor is infused into a body.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine toothpaste containing bletilla striata polysaccharide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine toothpaste containing bletilla striata polysaccharide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine toothpaste containing the bletilla striata polysaccharide comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 1-5% of bletilla polysaccharide, 0.1-0.5% of emodin, 5-20% of glycerol, 30-60% of sorbitol solution, 0.1-0.5% of saccharin sodium, 1-5% of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 10-25% of friction type silicon dioxide, 5-10% of thickening type silicon dioxide, 1-5% of sodium dodecyl sulfate, 0.5-1% of menthol, 0.1-0.5% of sodium benzoate and the balance of deionized water. The traditional Chinese medicine toothpaste containing the bletilla striata polysaccharide, prepared by the invention, has the advantages of less medicinal taste, definite active ingredients, safety, effectiveness and good compliance; the emodin and the bletilla striata polysaccharide have synergistic effect, can comprehensively solve the oral problems of gingival inflammation and gingival bleeding, oral ulcer and the like caused by the gingival inflammation, and achieves the purpose of treating both principal and secondary aspects of diseases.

title_en: Stichopus japonicus-derived small molecule active peptide
abstract_en: Stichopus japonicus-derived small-molecule active peptide and a high-efficiency screening method thereof belong to the field of marine organism small-molecule active peptides. The small molecule active peptide comprises two high-activity small molecule peptides derived from stichopus japonicus, and the amino acid sequences of the small molecule active peptides are Lys-Phe-Pro-Pro-Pro-Met and Phe-Asp-Gly-Pro-Glu-Gly-Pro-Arg. The invention obtains stichopus japonicus enzymolysis oligopeptide products by using an enzymolysis technology, identifies the amino acid sequence of peptide segments contained in the oligopeptide by adopting high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and finally performs activity comprehensive screening on the identified 88 peptide segments by using a plurality of online databases to finally obtain 2 high-activity small molecular peptides. The method disclosed by the invention realizes high-throughput analysis and identification and high-efficiency activity screening of a large number of small-molecule active peptide products, is simple and quick, has strong operability and is easy to realize, the successful screening probability of the active peptides is greatly improved, the method is suitable for early-stage screening of the large number of active peptides, the obtained polypeptide can be used for developing functional foods, health-care foods and biological medicine products with the effects of resisting breast cancer and reducing hypertension, and the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of gel preparation for preventing postpartum uterus involution badness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a gel preparation for preventing postpartum uterus involution badness, which comprises the following preparation steps: (1) weighing the following components in parts by weight: 8-12g of codonopsis pilosula, 7-13g of astragalus, 8-12g of dogwood, 5-15g of angelica, 15-25g of motherwort, 18-22g of safflower, 13-18g of curcuma zedoary and 10-20g of rhizoma sparganii, and extracting and purifying active ingredients to form a traditional Chinese medicine concentrated solution; (2) mixing the Chinese medicinal concentrated solution with hydroxypropyl cellulose and glycerol, standing to obtain gel preparation. The gel preparation is prepared by purifying and extracting effective components through a modern preparation process, can be quickly absorbed through percutaneous acupoint-penetrating administration to prevent postpartum uterine involution badness, makes up for postpartum weakness and poor appetite of the puerpera, overcomes the defect that high-quality food intake is reduced due to the influence of oral traditional Chinese medicine preparation on the appetite of the puerpera, and solves the problems that Chinese herbal medicine acupoint application administration is slow in absorption, easy to fall off and the like.

title_en: Nanoparticle for CT/fluorescence bimodal imaging load siRNA, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoparticle of CT/fluorescence bimodal imaging load siRNA and a preparation method and application thereof. The carrier component is lipid, the drug component is siRNA, the CT imaging component is gold nanoparticles with the particle size of about 5nm, and the fluorescence imaging component is Cy5 (carbon cyanide dye). The nanoparticles formed by coating siRNA, gold nanoparticles and Cy5 with lipid molecules are prepared by an ethanol dilution method, so that the delivery obstacle of the siRNA serving as a medicinal component in vivo can be effectively overcome, and the gold nanoparticles have no tumor targeting property and a longer CT imaging time window.

title_en: Compounds for the treatment of aquaporin mediated diseases
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of selective aquaporin, e.g., aquaporin-4 or aquaporin-2 inhibitors, e.g., certain phenylbenzamide compounds, in the prevention, treatment, and management of aquaporin-mediated disorders, e.g., water imbalance diseases such as edema and hyponatremia and excess fluid retention and diseases such as epilepsy, retinal ischemia, and other ocular diseases associated with abnormal intraocular pressure and/or tissue hydration, myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury, myocardial infarction, myocardial hypoxia, congestive heart failure, sepsis and neuromyelitis optica and migraine; the invention also relates to novel assays for identifying aquaporin inhibitors.

title_en: Self-assembling drug nanoconjugates for tumor cell specific responses
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a drug conjugate as a prodrug, which is degraded by cathepsin B specifically expressed in tumor tissues to release doxorubicin. The drug conjugates can form self-assembled nanoparticles. In addition, the drug conjugates specifically respond to and are activated in tumor cells. Therefore, the use of the drug conjugate can reduce the occurrence of side effects (e.g., cell damage and apoptosis) during the prevention or treatment of cancer.

title_en: Vaginal formulation for maintaining and/or restoring the microbiota of healthy women
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the direct administration of beneficial bacteria or probiotics to a vaginal niche to maintain a healthy vaginal microbiota and to help restore an unbalanced vaginal microbiota. The present application is based on the use of selected lactobacillus strains, in particular lactobacillus pentosus and/or lactobacillus plantarum, as anti-pathogenic agents against common vaginal pathogens, whereby the produced acids, such as lactic acid, are important antimicrobial factors.

title_en: Method for improving stability of carmine radish pelargonium element
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving stability of carmine radish pelargonium, which adopts salicylic acid as an acylating agent to modify carmine radish pelargonium at normal temperature and normal temperatureThe reaction is carried out under reduced pressure, the reaction energy consumption is reduced, the reaction condition is mild, the original structure and activity of the pelargonidin are effectively maintained, the acylation degree is higher, the whole process is simple and easy to control, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the cost is low. The acylated carmine radish pelargonidin obtained by the method obviously improves the light, temperature and Al 3+ The stability of alkaline environment and hydrogen peroxide, and the acylated pelargonium element has no influence on the in vitro antioxidant activity, so the acylated nopaline pelargonium element has good stability and antioxidant activity, and can be widely applied to the fields of food, health care products, cosmetics, medicines and the like.

title_en: Hydrophilic drug sustained-release microspheres with high encapsulation rate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophilic drug sustained-release microsphere with high encapsulation rate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of supplying primary emulsion into a cup-shaped container at the center of a turntable device, starting a turntable driving device, accelerating the primary emulsion in the cup-shaped container to cross a cup opening, impacting an outer disc-shaped turntable under the action of centrifugal force and gravity to disperse into tiny droplets, accelerating the tiny droplets by the disc-shaped turntable to continuously escape from the disc opening to impact the outer disc-shaped turntable, after one or more times of impact dispersion, the droplets fly out of the turntable to be highly dispersed in a main tank body, and solidifying to form the microsphere in the descending motion process. The preparation method can be used for producing the microspheres in a continuous and large-scale production mode, and the prepared microspheres have the advantages of high encapsulation efficiency, high yield, low organic solvent residue, uniform and controllable particle size and low burst release efficiency.

title_en: Stomach-nourishing volatile oil, and stomach-nourishing rice paste, stomach-nourishing microcapsule and stomach-nourishing patch containing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses stomach nourishing volatile oil, and a stomach nourishing rice paste, a stomach nourishing microcapsule and a stomach nourishing patch containing the stomach nourishing volatile oil. The stomach nourishing volatile oil comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of tangerine peel oil, 5-10 parts of ginger oil, 5-10 parts of patchouli oil, 5-10 parts of fennel oil and 5-10 parts of nutmeg oil. The stomach-nourishing volatile oil is prepared by mixing natural traditional Chinese medicine essential oil serving as a raw material, does not contain additives, and is safe and non-toxic. The stomach nourishing rice paste, the stomach nourishing microcapsules and the stomach nourishing patch have good appetite stimulating and digestion aiding effects, can achieve certain effects of strengthening gastrointestinal peristalsis and relieving abdominal distension and other symptoms, are suitable for daily gastrointestinal tract maintenance, and are convenient to carry and use, and meet the requirements of modern people.

title_en: Macrocyclic indole derivatives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to macrocyclic indole derivatives of the general formula (I), to processes for preparing said compounds, to intermediate compounds useful for preparing said compounds, to pharmaceutical compositions and combinations comprising said compounds and to the use of said compounds for manufacturing a pharmaceutical composition for the treatment or prophylaxis of a disease, in particular of a hyperproliferative disorder, as sole agent or in combination with other active ingredients: wherein R is 1 、R 2 、R 3 、R 4 、R 5 、R 6 A and L are as defined herein.

title_en: Application of miRNA-5571 in preparation of anti-colorectal tumor medicine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and relates to application of miRNA-5571 or a mimic or a promoter thereof in preparation of an anti-colorectal tumor medicament. Research shows that the transfer and invasion capacity of colorectal tumor cells can be effectively inhibited by transfecting miR-5571 or a mimic thereof. The invention discovers the inhibition effect of miR-5571 on colorectal tumors for the first time, and has important significance for reducing the death rate of the colorectal tumors.

title_en: Modified ligand-gated ion channels and methods of use
abstract_en: This document relates to materials and methods for controlling ligand-gated ion channel (LGIC) activity. For example, a modified LGIC comprising at least one LGIC subunit having a modified Ligand Binding Domain (LBD) and/or a modified ion domain (IPD) is provided. Exogenous LGIC ligands that can bind and activate the modified LGIC are also provided, as are methods of modulating ion transport across a mammalian cell membrane, methods of modulating cellular excitability in a mammal, and methods of treating a mammal having a channel disorder.

title_en: A tea oil-Aloe cream and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of tea oil-aloe cream, which comprises the following steps: heating and melting an oil phase substance, heating a water phase substance to the same temperature as the oil phase substance, mixing the isothermal oil phase substance and the water phase substance, adding an emulsifier under the mixing condition, continuously mixing until the temperature is reduced to 28-32 ℃, and continuously grinding by using an emulsion homogenizer or a colloid mill; wherein the mass ratio of the oil phase substance, the water phase substance and the emulsifier is 20: 56-57: 1.3-1.8. The tea oil-aloe cream has the advantages that the appearance, consistency, granularity, pH value and stability meet the requirements, the repeatability is high, the used components are non-toxic, inflammation treatment of human skin is facilitated, the aloe and the tea oil can be combined with the effects of two medicines when used together, and the advantages of the medicines are better played.

title_en: Anticoagulation nano gene vector for myocardial infarction treatment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anticoagulable nano gene vector and a preparation method thereof. According to the nano gene vector and the preparation method thereof, anticoagulation and gene safe and effective delivery are combined, so that the dual effects of anticoagulation and gene therapy are achieved, embolism and blood hypercoagulable parts in the microcirculation of the penetrated coronary artery are improved, and the delivery system is led to go deep into infarcted myocardium.

title_en: Feed additive, preparation method and application thereof and feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feed additive, a preparation method and application thereof and feed. The feed additive comprises 10-20 parts by weight of inhibitor for inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress, 0.5-2 parts by weight of inhibitor for inhibiting calcium ion loss from endoplasmic reticulum and 4-10 parts by weight of compound for reducing active oxygen in cells. By using the inhibitor for inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress, the inhibitor for inhibiting calcium ions from losing from the endoplasmic reticulum and the compound for reducing active oxygen in cells and controlling the proportion of the inhibitor, the inhibitor and the compound, the three substances generate synergistic action, can effectively improve the function of the endoplasmic reticulum of the intestinal tract, reduce the occurrence of endoplasmic reticulum stress, further relieve the heat stress phenomenon, block the mutual influence of endoplasmic reticulum stress-mitochondrial injury and relieve the intestinal tract injury.

title_en: Synthetic method and application of tiger stripe analgesic peptide
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis method and application of tiger stripe analgesic peptide. The synthesis method comprises the following steps: providing a peptide fragment 1 including amino acids at positions 1 to 8, a peptide fragment 2 including amino acids at positions 9 to 23, and a peptide fragment 3 including amino acids at positions 24 to 33; removing, cleaving, and oxidizing the peptide fragment 2 to obtain a peptide fragment 4 in which cysteines at positions 9 and 22 form a pair of disulfide bonds; removing a protecting group on the peptide fragment 3, and performing coupling treatment with the peptide fragment 4 to obtain a peptide fragment 5; removing an amino protecting group in the peptide fragment 5, and performing a coupling treatment with the cleaved peptide fragment 1 to obtain a peptide fragment 6; cleaving and oxidizing the peptide fragment 6 to obtain a peptide fragment 8 in which cysteines at positions 2 and 17 are linked; the peptide fragment 8 is subjected to oxidation treatment to thereby oxidatively link cysteines at positions 16 and 29, thereby obtaining a tiger stripe analgesic peptide. The synthesis method has the characteristics of good process stability, high synthesis efficiency, high purity, high yield and the like.

title_en: Medicine for preventing and treating osteoporosis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pharmaceutical compound for preventing and treating osteoporosis, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicines. The structure of the compound is shown as a formula I, and the compound is a flavonoid derivative, wherein R is 1 Independently selected from OH, C1-5 alkyl, C1-5 alkoxy, or halogen, and n is an integer from 1 to 3. The experimental result shows that the compound shown in the formula I has excellent pharmaceutical activity of reducing bone mass loss and improving bone density, and is expected to become a novel medicament which can replace isoflavone medicaments and prevent or treat osteoporosis.

title_en: Compositions and methods for CAR T cell therapy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of treating a patient having cancer by administering to the patient a composition comprising CAR T cells and a small molecule linked to a targeting moiety through a linker. The invention also relates to compositions for use in such methods.

title_en: Bactericidal composition for regulating skin microbial flora and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bactericidal composition for regulating skin microbial flora and application thereof, wherein the bactericidal composition consists of lactobacillus fermentation lysate, quaternary ammonium salt-73 and garcinia mangostana pericarp extract. The lactobacillus fermentation lysate and the garcinia mangostana pericarp extract in the composition can kill propionibacterium acnes by other acne-removing components (such as quaternary ammonium salt-73), reduce the killing rate of the propionibacterium acnes on beneficial bacteria or symbiotic bacteria, and balance imbalance of different degrees of flora caused by individual differences. In addition, the lactobacillus fermentation lysate and the garcinia mangostana pericarp extract are used together, so that the stimulation or damage of the conventional preservative to the face of an acne patient can be effectively reduced, and the allergic conditions such as face itching, pain and swelling caused by the preservative can be reduced.

title_en: Light protection plant composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a light protection plant composition and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the plant composition is prepared from the following raw materials: peony, wintersweet flower, saffron, centella asiatica, cassia twig and cacao seed. The active ingredients of the light-protection plant composition are matched with each other, so that the light-protection plant composition has a synergistic effect, and the protection range covers UVB, UVA and HEV wavelength regions. The composition of the invention can not only carry out photoprotection by absorbing ultraviolet rays, but also remove a large amount of active oxygen free radicals generated under the induction of blue light, and improve the resistance to external harmful light by improving the self resistance and the repairing capacity of the skin.

title_en: Substituted aryl ether compound, preparation method thereof, medicinal composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound represented by the following general formula, a stereoisomer thereof, a prodrug thereof, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof or a pharmaceutically acceptable solvate thereof, a preparation method thereof, a medicinal composition containing the same and application thereof in preparing a prodrugThe application of the medicine in preventing and treating tumors is disclosed, wherein the definition of the substituent group is shown in the specification.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid moisturizing and repairing composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cosmetics, and particularly relates to a hyaluronic acid moisturizing and repairing composition and a preparation method thereof. The hyaluronic acid moisturizing and repairing composition provided by the invention comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 0.84 to 6.08 percent of humectant A, 2.24 to 9.63 percent of humectant B, 0.1 to 0.6 percent of preservative, 0.1 to 0.8 percent of anti-allergic agent, 0.03 to 0.13 percent of thickening agent, 0.03 to 0.13 percent of pH regulator, 0.13 to 1.18 percent of 1,2 hexanediol and 81.45 to 96.53 percent of water. The hyaluronic acid moisturizing and repairing composition humectant, the preservative, the antiallergic agent, the thickening agent and the pH regulator provided by the invention are coordinated with each other, so that the hyaluronic acid moisturizing and repairing composition has good moisturizing, anti-wrinkle, repairing and antioxidant properties.

title_en: Method for producing bacteriostatic active substance by using bacillus amyloliquefaciens
abstract_en: A method for producing bacteriostatic active substances by using Bacillus amyloliquefaciens belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention cultures the bacillus amyloliquefaciens to obtain the fermentation supernatant, and the new hexapeptide is prepared after the supernatant is separated and purified. The fermentation supernatant obtained by the method provided by the invention can be directly used for bacteriostasis, and three bacteriostatics can be obtained after further separation and purification of the fermentation supernatant, wherein the three bacteriostatics comprise a new hexapeptide and also have bacteriostasis; when the three components jointly act on indicator bacterium cells, the damage degree to the cells is larger. The indication bacteria find that the lactic acid and the Surfactin have a synergistic effect through pairwise combination effect of the lactic acid, the lactic acid and the Surfactin; lactic acid and hexapeptide have synergistic effects; surfactin has an additive effect with hexapeptides. Provides theoretical support for continuous development of novel antibacterial peptide and provides a new idea for efficient use of natural antibacterial substances.

title_en: Preparation method and application of tumor microenvironment and redox stepwise responsive nano drug delivery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a tumor microenvironment and redox stepwise responsive nano drug delivery system, relates to preparation of a high-load cis-platinum macromolecule prodrug and a double-end aldehydic polyethylene glycol cross-linked cis-platinum nano drug delivery system, and can be used for treating tumors. The invention takes polyethyleneimine as a framework, and adopts cystamine containing redox-responsive disulfide bond to react with succinic anhydride and then complex with cisplatin to obtain the cisplatin complex. The obtained cisplatin complex is covalently combined with polyethyleneimine to obtain a high-load cisplatin polymer prodrug, and the outer layer is crosslinked by adopting double-end aldehyde polyethylene glycol to obtain the cisplatin nano drug delivery system with tumor microenvironment and redox step-by-step responsiveness. Compared with the traditional chemotherapy medicament cisplatin, the invention can realize the removal of the microenvironment polyethylene glycol shell outside the tumor cell and the gradual responsive release of intracellular oxidation reduction, and ensures the effective uptake of the cisplatin delivery system and the responsive release of the medicament in the tumor, thereby better playing the anti-tumor role and having good clinical treatment application prospect.

title_en: 8- (benzofuran-5-yl) benzoxazine diones and their use as anti-cancer agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to 8- (benzofuran-5-yl) benzoxazine diones of formula (I): wherein R is selected from: hydrogen, C  1  ～C  2  Alkyl radical, C  3  ～C  4  Straight or branched chain alkyl; r is  1  Selected from the group consisting of: hydrogen, C  1  ～C  2  An alkyl group.

title_en: Compound extracted and separated from traditional Chinese medicine cymbidium maculatum, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of extraction and separation of traditional Chinese medicines, in particular to a novel compound extracted, separated and identified from a cymbidium maculatum medicinal material, and a separation method and application thereof. The present invention provides novel compounds of formula C 13 H 12 O 5 Named goodyschle A. The research shows that the novel compound has obvious effects of inhibiting butyrylcholine esterase activity, medium-strength antioxidant activity, weak tumor cell toxicity and acetylcholinesterase activity.

title_en: Synthesis of norcantharidin carboxylic acid difluoro benzyl ester and anti-tumor application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides norcantharidin carboxylic acid difluorobenzyl ester with a structural formula shown as I and an anti-tumor application thereof. The specific structure of the norcantharidin carboxylic acid difluoro benzyl ester shown in the formula I comprises: the activity test shows that the norcantharidin carboxylic acid difluorobenzyl ester synthesized by the invention as shown in I is a suitable candidate anti-tumor drug, and particularly serves as a candidate anti-liver cancer drug. Compared with positive control drugs such as norcantharidin and sodium norcantharidinate, the water solubility, stability and antitumor activity are improved. In addition, the synthesis method of the norcantharidin carboxylic acid difluorobenzyl ester has the advantages of easily available raw materials and easy operation and implementation.

title_en: Preparation method and application of sea cucumber phytosterol sulfate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of active substance screening, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of sea cucumber phytosterol sulfate. Subjecting powdered dried sea cucumber sample to supercritical CO  2  Extracting by a fluid extraction method; wherein the extraction process comprises static extraction and dynamic extraction, the extraction conditions are that the pressure is 150bar, the extraction temperature is 40 ℃, and 5% ethanol entrainer is added. The invention realizes the separation of the phytosterol sulfate from other lipids with similar polarity by optimizing the conditions or adding the entrainer; the sea cucumber sample is ground and then enters the extraction device in a fine powder form, so that the sample is ensured to be fully contacted with the extraction solvent, and the extraction recovery rate is improved and the extraction solvent is saved by a method combining static extraction and dynamic extraction. And the application of the prepared sulfatosterol in preparing food or medicine for improving cholesterol balance and regulating lipid metabolism.

title_en: Uracil compounds as c-MET/AXL inhibitors
abstract_en: A uracil compound shown as a formula (IV) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a pharmaceutical composition thereof. The application of the derivative as a c-MET/AXL inhibitor in preparing c-MET/AXL inhibition drugs or drugs for treating tumors.

title_en: Anti-CD 137 molecules and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof that bind to human CD137, nucleic acids encoding the antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof, therapeutic compositions of the antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof, and their use for enhancing T cell function to up-regulate a cell-mediated immune response and for treating T cell dysfunctional disorders, such as tumor immunity, and for treating cancer.

title_en: Agent for improving mitochondrial dysfunction and preventive or therapeutic agent for diseases or symptoms caused by mitochondrial dysfunction and use thereof
abstract_en: The technical problem of the present invention is to provide a means for substantially improving mitochondrial dysfunction. An aspect of the present invention relates to an agent for ameliorating mitochondrial dysfunction, which comprises a compound represented by the following formula, a stereoisomer thereof or a salt thereof, or a solvent thereforThe compound is used as an active ingredient. Another aspect of the present invention also relates to a medicament or a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of diseases or symptoms caused by mitochondrial dysfunction, which comprises the above-mentioned compound, stereoisomers thereof or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, or pharmaceutically acceptable solvates thereof as an active ingredient.

title_en: Lactobacillus plantarum SD-H9, probiotic microbial inoculum thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides lactobacillus plantarum SD-H9, a probiotic microbial inoculum thereof and application thereof. The lactobacillus plantarum SD-H9 is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC NO. 16649. The probiotic preparation provided by the invention can effectively relieve nasal symptoms of allergic rhinitis rats, reduce the content of histamine, OVA specific IgE and IL-4 in serum of the rhinitis rats, improve the content of IFN-gamma in the serum of the rats, is beneficial to relieving anaphylactic reaction, and induces correct immune response, so that Th2 cell bias for promoting allergic reaction is changed, the treatment effect on the allergic rhinitis is exerted by regulating the immune function of a host, and the rhinitis symptoms can be effectively improved.

title_en: Pyrazine-2 (1H) -ones as FGFR inhibitors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound shown as a formula (I), an isomer thereof or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and relates to application of the compound in preparation of medicines for treating FGFR-related diseases.

title_en: Anti-photodamage skin protection active polypeptide OM-GL15 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-photodamage skin protection active polypeptide OM-GL15 and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the light injury resistant skin protection active polypeptide OM-GL15 is GLLSGHYGRASPVAC. The invention relates to a natural active polypeptide OM-GL15 which is obtained from skin secretion of rana grahami and has the function of resisting skin photodamage and oxidative stress, the polypeptide shows obvious activity of resisting ultraviolet radiation and oxidative stress to damage skin and cells, and OM-GL15 shows potential application prospect in the aspect of protecting skin from photodamage caused by ultraviolet radiation. Therefore, the light damage resistant skin protection active polypeptide OM-GL15 can be considered as a template for developing an anti-ultraviolet medicament, and lays a foundation for further developing a novel acute light damage resistant repair medicament.

title_en: Method for determining genotoxic impurities in rivaroxaban
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining genotoxic impurities in rivaroxaban. The method uses a high performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometer, and can simultaneously and accurately measure the content of 7 different genotoxic impurities, particularly 3 nitro-substituted impurities which are difficult to separate by adjusting the type of a chromatographic column, a mobile phase and an elution gradient, so that the quality of rivaroxaban bulk drug and tablets thereof can be better controlled. The method can separate various isomers, and can keep the advantages of fast analysis, high efficiency, high stability and high sensitivity.

title_en: Two-photon excitation diagnosis and treatment integrated nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-photon excitation diagnosis and treatment integrated nano material and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing the cationic liposome stock solution and the AIE photosensitizer stock solution according to a preset proportion to obtain a mixed solution; and heating the mixed solution at a preset temperature, and crushing the phospholipid membrane obtained after heating to obtain the two-photon excitation diagnosis and treatment integrated nano material. The preparation method has the advantages of simple process, easy operation, and easy scale-up production, and the prepared nano material has high stability, good water dispersibility and easy preservation.

title_en: CD19 and CD22 double-target chimeric antigen receptor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a CD19 and CD22 double-target chimeric antigen receptor and application thereof, wherein the chimeric antigen receptor comprises an antigen binding domain, a transmembrane domain and a signal transduction domain; the antigen binding domain comprises a light chain variable region of an anti-CD 19 single-chain antibody, a heavy chain variable region of an anti-CD 19 single-chain antibody, a light chain variable region of an anti-CD 22 single-chain antibody and a heavy chain variable region of an anti-CD 22 single-chain antibody. The anti-CD 19 and CD22 double-target chimeric antigen receptor has targeting activity on CD19 positive and/or CD22 positive cells, and T cells expressing the anti-CD 19 and CD22 double-target chimeric antigen receptor have killing effects on tumor cells with little or no expression of CD19 antigen and tumor cells with little or no expression of CD22 antigen, so that the immune escape phenomenon is avoided, and the possibility of disease recurrence is reduced.

title_en: Pediococcus pentosaceus SMM914 and screening method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Pediococcus Pentosaceus SMM914 and a screening method and application thereof, wherein the Pediococcus Pentosaceus SMM914 is stored in the common microorganism center of China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms with the storage number of CGMCC:20160. The screening method provided by the invention has the advantages that the technological process is simple to operate, the screening efficiency is high, the obtained bacterial strain has good antibacterial capacity and antioxidation, the proportion of beneficial bacterial groups in intestinal tracts of piglets can be increased, and the method has a good application prospect in preventing Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) of weaned piglets.

title_en: Composition for preparing keratin liquid dressing and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for preparing a liquid dressing, a preparation method and related application. The liquid dressing is prepared from keratin, a film-forming agent, a humectant, a material solvent and a volatile solvent. The method for preparing the liquid dressing by using the keratin is simple, and the preparation or generation process is not complicated. The liquid dressing prepared by the invention can effectively stop bleeding, accelerate wound healing, isolate bacterial infection and has no toxic or side effect. And the product can volatilize and absorb, so that the link of retreating the medicine is avoided, only a proper amount of the medicine is needed to be sprayed on the wound in the actual repeated use process, the use is convenient, the wound can not be injured again due to the treatment of the residual medicine, and excessive pain can be avoided. The liquid dressing prepared by the invention has certain waterproofness, air permeability and extensibility after being filmed, and has a wide application range.

title_en: Methods and compositions for radioprotection using RRx-001
abstract_en: Provided herein are therapeutic methods, kits, and pharmaceutical compositions for protecting a subject from radiation using a therapeutic agent selected from RRx-001 and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. An exemplary method of treatment includes administering RRx-001 to the subject prior to exposure of the subject to the radiation to protect the subject from radiation, such as ionizing radiation containing alpha rays, beta rays, gamma rays, neutron radiation, or a combination thereof.

title_en: Functional non-woven fabric based on inactivated lactic acid bacteria
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a functional non-woven fabric based on inactivated lactobacillus. The non-woven fabrics have wide application in the medical and sanitary fields at present, the non-woven fabrics on the market at present only can play the effects of isolation, absorption and leakage prevention, and functional non-woven fabrics are lacked. The invention aims to improve the traditional non-woven fabric, provides a functional non-woven fabric with a sterilization effect, and can be applied to the preparation of private nursing sanitary products. Based on the purpose, the invention screens and obtains a lactobacillus plantarum (Lactobacillus plantarum) with high chlorogenic acid and lactein yield Lactobacillus plantaium ) HYZQF 1675-61, and realizes the remarkable improvement of the yield of chlorogenic acid and lactein by the optimization of a culture mode. Based on the metabolites after the inactivation of the strain, the functional non-woven fabric prepared by the invention has good inhibition effect on common pathogenic bacteria and mould after verification, and is expected to obtain great market value.

title_en: Lysozyme oral care product for whitening teeth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lysozyme oral care product for whitening teeth, which takes lysozyme, dextrose and glucose oxidase as functional components, the dextrose and the glucose oxidase are separated by subpackaging, and the two are mixed to generate peroxide with whitening effect when in use, the color spot index is obviously reduced, the freckle removing and whitening effect is enhanced, and the problem that hydrogen peroxide is unstable and decomposed in a toothpaste system can be avoided; meanwhile, the peroxide can obviously enhance the sterilization and bacteriostasis effects of the lysozyme on oral cavity pathogenic bacteria such as streptococcus mutans, porphyromonas gingivalis, escherichia coli and the like. The product of the invention has the advantages of coordinated system, good activity stability of lysozyme, synergistic effect of each component, whitening and bacteriostasis effects, and good market prospect.

title_en: Spiro-lactam NMDA receptor modulators and uses thereof
abstract_en: Compounds having the potency to modulate NMDA receptor activity are disclosed. Such compounds are useful in the treatment of conditions such as depression and related disorders, as well as other disorders.

title_en: Cannabinoid receptor light-operated ligand and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a novel cannabinoid receptor light-operated ligand, and a preparation method and application thereof. The cannabinoid receptor photocontrol ligand has a structural formula shown in the specification, or an isomer prodrug, solvate or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof: A-linker-B. Wherein A is a transmembrane domain ligand structure, and B is a light control element; linker is a linear, cannabinoid receptor photoligandin inactive subunit. The invention integrates the cannabinoid receptor ligand with azobenzene through a proper connector, so that the ligand configuration is changed under the condition of illumination, and the agonistic state or the inhibitory state of the cannabinoid receptor is further regulated and controlled.

title_en: Processing technology of rhinitis spray based on traditional Chinese medicine extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing technology of a rhinitis spray based on traditional Chinese medicine extracts, which comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 15-20 parts of radix producescentis, 12-18 parts of spinach roots, 10-20 parts of dried orange peels, 12-15 parts of lotus plumule, 15-22 parts of rhubarb leaves, 10-20 parts of mint, 10-15 parts of honeysuckle roots, 10-20 parts of anise barks, 10-15 parts of tartary buckwheat root hairs, 15-20 parts of bitter garlic, 13-15 parts of pepper and 15-22 parts of additives. The nasal spray is used for administration by nasal spray, is convenient to use and good in administration compliance, liquid medicine is atomized and then directly reaches nasal mucosa, the contact area of atomized small liquid drops and the mucosa is large, the absorption of the medicine is increased, the curative effect is improved, the nasal obstruction symptom can be rapidly improved and eliminated, the defects that the existing oral preparation is low in medicine effect, slow in effect taking and inconvenient to use are overcome, and the rhinitis spray is a Chinese herbal medicine component and has no toxic or side effect.

title_en: Preparation method of derivative containing 1,3, 4-thiadiazole pyridine-2-ketone and application of derivative as anti-cancer drug
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a derivative containing 1,3, 4-thiadiazole pyridine-2-ketone and application of the derivative as an anticancer drug, wherein the chemical structural formula of the derivative containing 1,3, 4-thiadiazole pyridine-2-ketone is shown as a formula (I), and a substituent R in the formula (I) is alkyl, F, Cl, Br, I, alkoxy, hydroxyl, nitrile, nitro, carboxyl or sulfonic group of H, C1-6. The 5, 6-disubstituted phenylamino-3- (2- (1,3, 4-thiadiazole-2-yl) hydrazono) pyridine-2-ketone derivative has certain inhibitory activity on tumor cells, and the synthetic method is simple and the materials are easy to obtain. Can be used for preparing antitumor drugs.

title_en: Electroporation systems, methods, and apparatus
abstract_en: Provided herein are systems, methods, and devices for electroporation, which may include an applicator; endoscopes, trocars, and the like; a generator; and a drug delivery device. The applicator may include a control portion, an insertion tube connected to the control portion, an actuator engaged with the control portion, and a plurality of electrodes including a first electrode having a first tip and a second electrode having a second tip. The plurality of electrodes may be configured to move between a retracted position and a deployed position in response to actuation of the actuator. The distance between the first tip of the first electrode and the second tip of the second electrode may be greater in the deployed position than in the retracted position. Various methods of treatment are also provided.

title_en: Composition for improving and repairing skin texture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of skin care products, and discloses a composition for improving and repairing skin textures, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-45 parts of deionized water, 5-10 parts of alcohol, 1-5 parts of mint extract, 5-15 parts of malic acid, 1-10 parts of lemon extract, 1-10 parts of vitamin C, 1-10 parts of vitamin E, 5-10 parts of glycerol, 5-10 parts of cucumber extract, 10-15 parts of aloe extract, 10-20 parts of milk and 3-6 parts of sunflower seed oil. According to the invention, the malic acid, the lemon extract and the like are added into the raw materials, so that the skin care product has an acne removing effect, the added alcohol and mint extract can absorb heat during volatilization to shrink pores, the cooling effect during smearing is increased, the sunflower seed oil can increase the sun protection effect, and meanwhile, due to the addition of the cucumber extract and the aloe extract, the skin care product also has the effects of moisturizing and whitening.

title_en: Coating composition, oral solid preparation and process for producing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel coating composition for oral solid preparations. The coating composition for oral solid preparation comprises a polyvinyl alcohol polymer (a), a water-swelling clay mineral (b) and a fatty acid ester of a polyhydric alcohol having 3 or more hydroxyl groups (c), wherein the mass ratio of the polyvinyl alcohol polymer (a) to the water-swelling clay mineral (b) is 98:2 to 65: 35.

title_en: Antibacterial hydrogel suitable for diabetic foot ulcer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention providesProvides an antibacterial hydrogel suitable for diabetic foot ulcer and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of medical hydrogel preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) adding acrylic acid, a cross-linking agent and an initiator solution into a sodium alginate solution to modify the sodium alginate; (2) adding medicinal active ingredient D and antibacterial ingredient E, and adding CaCl 2 Solution to prepare a crude gel product; (3) and (4) washing the crude gel, and then drying by using filter paper to obtain the antibacterial hydrogel. The hydrogel prepared by the invention can greatly improve the speed of absorbing wound exudate by improving sodium alginate, so that the wound is treated in time, the traditional Chinese medicine components are added, the hydrogel is absorbed by a human body by slowly releasing and permeating the wound, the local medication effect is achieved, the blood supply condition of ulcer parts can be improved by adding the chloranthus japonicus saponin R, and the healing speed of diabetic foot ulcer is improved by synergistic effect.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine dampness removing plaster and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine dampness removing plaster and a preparation method thereof, wherein the main formula materials of the traditional Chinese medicine dampness removing plaster comprise cocklebur fruit, coix seed, nux vomica, old ginger, gastrodia elata, myrrh, wormwood and earthworm. Comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of cocklebur fruit, 10-15 parts of pearl barley, 1-2 parts of nux vomica, 5-10 parts of old ginger, 5-8 parts of gastrodia elata, 2-5 parts of myrrh, 4-6 parts of wormwood and 3-8 parts of medicinal earthworm. The traditional Chinese medicine materials are cleaned, cut and put into a grinder for grinding, the ground mixed powder of the traditional Chinese medicine is taken, sieved by a 20-mesh sieve, soaked for 12-24 hours, decocted by slow fire, concentrated and the like, and prepared into a patch which is mainly used for being stuck on the abdomen, knees, feet and other parts.

title_en: Two-dimensional nanomaterial vascular plaque scavenger, M2 type macrophage inducer and autophagy modulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of atherosclerosis medicines, and particularly relates to a two-dimensional nano-material vascular plaque scavenging agent, an M2 type macrophage inducer and an autophagy regulator. The three atherosclerosis medicines all adopt the boron alkene nano-particles and/or the black scale nano-particles as main components. The two-dimensional nano material atherosclerosis drug provided by the invention can promote autophagy process of cells through peroxidation of surface active groups, can induce more M2 type macrophages to release in degradation process, purifies blood through physical adsorption effect, and increases fluidity of blood, thereby playing a role in rapidly removing atherosclerotic lesion lipid waste materials to further intervene and control plaque formation. Meanwhile, the black phosphorus nanoparticles and the boron alkene nanoparticles also have good biological activity, biocompatibility and natural degradability, and do not cause any drug damage to human bodies.

title_en: External application liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine preparations, in particular to an external application liquid and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials comprise herba speranskiae tuberculatae, radix Clematidis, rhizoma Et radix Notopterygii, cornu Naemorhedi, radix Angelicae Pubescentis, pericarpium Zanthoxyli, semen Citri Reticulatae, lignum sappan, rhizoma Gastrodiae, radix Ginseng, radix Achyranthis bidentatae, rhizoma Zingiberis recens, Bombyx Batryticatus, radix Dipsaci, flos Carthami, radix Angelicae Dahuricae, fructus Gleditsia, radix Angelicae sinensis, and fructus Capsici; herba speranskiae tuberculatae, radix Clematidis, rhizoma Et radix Notopterygii, cornu Naemorhedi, and radix Angelicae Pubescentis as principal drugs for dispelling pathogenic wind, removing dampness, warming and dredging channels, dispelling cold, relieving pain, and supplementing protein; the Chinese prickly ash, tangerine seed, sappan wood, tall gastrodia tuber, ginseng, twotooth achyranthes root, ginger, stiff silkworm and himalayan teasel root are used as ministerial drugs, warm the middle-jiao to dispel cold, help monarch drugs to disperse blood stasis and dredge channels; safflower, dahurian angelica root, Chinese honey locust and Chinese angelica are used as adjuvant drugs and are matched with monarch and ministerial drugs to treat concurrent syndrome, promote qi circulation, invigorate blood circulation and relieve pain; the pepper is used as a messenger drug, has the effects of tonifying qi, invigorating qi, nourishing blood, dispelling wind-damp, strengthening bones and muscles, and dredging meridians and collaterals, and simultaneously leads all the medicines in the guiding formula to directly reach the disease focus.

title_en: Method for treating bulk drug particles with inconsistent particle sizes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pretreatment method for preparing pharmaceutical raw materials having inconsistent particle sizes by a production method having excellent productivity. According to the pretreatment method of the present invention, an additive containing at least a dispersant is blended with a drug substance having a specific particle size distribution, and the mixture is crushed and granulated to disperse and adhere the additive to the surface of the drug substance particles to produce a powder having a specific particle size distribution, whereby a pharmaceutical preparation can be produced by a direct compression method, a wet continuous granulation system, or the like with excellent productivity, production efficiency, and production cost, and therefore, the pretreatment method is very useful.

title_en: Rosa roxburghii wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roxburgh rose wine and a preparation method thereof. The roxburgh rose wine comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100-300 parts of rosa roxburghii, 80-300 parts of rock sugar, 10-30 parts of distiller's yeast, 6-10 parts of angelica, 8-12 parts of ginseng and 10-14 parts of medlar. The preparation method of the roxburgh rose wine comprises the following steps: (1) weighing roxburgh rose according to the weight parts, cleaning, and crushing by using a stirrer to obtain a product A; (2) mixing product A, crystal sugar and distiller's yeast, placing into a jar, and sealing at 32-36 deg.C for 30-40 days to obtain product B; (3) weighing radix Angelicae sinensis, Ginseng radix and fructus Lycii according to weight parts, cleaning, slicing, placing into a wine jar, sealing at 29-33 deg.C for 30-60 days to obtain product C; (4) the product C is filtered to obtain the product D, and the roxburgh rose wine prepared by the method not only has the unique flavor of roxburgh rose, but also has good health-care effect and fresh taste, and the flavor and the health-care function are two main characteristics of the roxburgh rose wine.

title_en: Peptides for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a peptide for treating rheumatoid arthritis and uses thereof, the present disclosure provides a peptide consisting of SEQ ID NO: 1. SEQ ID NO:3 or SEQ ID NO:5, or a polynucleotide encoding the same, a pharmaceutical composition for treating rheumatoid arthritis or a health functional food composition for ameliorating rheumatoid arthritis, comprising said peptide.

title_en: Application of lactobacillus rhamnosus TCI366 and/or metabolite thereof to improvement of skin condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of lactobacillus rhamnosus TCI366 and/or metabolites thereof, which is an application of lactobacillus rhamnosus TCI366 and/or metabolites thereof in preparing a composition for improving skin conditions, wherein the lactobacillus rhamnosus TCI366 is deposited in Germany collection of microorganisms and has the deposit number DSM 33290.

title_en: Improved Abeta-protofibril binding antibodies
abstract_en: Improved aβ protofibril binding antibodies. The present invention relates to amyloid beta peptide (aβ), more particularly to antibodies that bind to aβ protofibrils and their use in the medical and/or prophylactic treatment of alzheimer's disease and other disorders related to aβ protein aggregation. Furthermore, the invention may relate to the diagnosis of these diseases and monitoring of disease progression by using the antibodies of the invention. Furthermore, the invention may relate to the veterinary use of the antibodies of the invention.

title_en: anti-interleukin-17A antibodies, pharmaceutical compositions thereof, and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of autoimmune disease treatment and molecular immunology, and relates to an anti-IL-17A antibody, a pharmaceutical composition thereof and application thereof. Specifically, the invention relates to a monoclonal antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, wherein the heavy chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody comprises: HCDR1-HCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NOs:31-33 or HCDR1-HCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NOs:37-39, respectively, and the light chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody comprises: LCDR1-LCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NOs:34-36 or LCDR1-LCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NOs: 40-42. The monoclonal antibody of the invention can be well specifically combined with IL-17A, and can specifically antagonize the combination of IL-17A and the ligand thereof, and inhibit the activation of IL-17A on fibroblasts.

title_en: Universal CAR-T cell, preparation method and application thereof, and anti-tumor drug
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general CAR-T cell, a preparation method and application thereof and an anti-tumor drug, and relates to the technical field of CAR-T cells. The preparation method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: adding a stimulator into T cells which are treated by an electrotransformation technology and knocked out of TCR alpha/beta genes and beta 2M genes to stimulate the T cells; the stimulatory agents include CD3 antibodies and CD28 antibodies. The preparation method can obtain more general CAR-T cells, and the general CAR-T cells prepared by the preparation method have normal tumor killing function and can be used for anti-tumor treatment.

title_en: Medicine for treating depression by acting on glossopharyngeal vagal nerve-regulated CCK peptide and preparation method and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicament for treating depression by acting on glossopharyngeal vagal nerve regulation CCK peptide, which contains polygala tenuifolia glycoside compounds or medicinal salts, esters or solvates thereof. Is prepared into tongue and pharynx spray or/and buccal preparation (tablet, liquid) for administration. The medicine is directly contacted and absorbed with vagus nerve of oral tongue fur, pharynx and larynx, and regulates functional disorder of hypothalamus-pituitary-adrenal axis (HPA axis) of vagus nerve through CCK neuropeptide, thereby achieving the obvious effect of treating depression safely, quickly, efficiently and at low cost.

title_en: In vivo homology-directed repair in cardiac, skeletal muscle and muscle stem cells
abstract_en: Methods for genomic modification of skeletal and cardiac muscle using sequence-targeting nucleases and donor sequences delivered by viruses are disclosed.

title_en: IL-17A binding peptides and medical uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to IL-17A binding peptides, inhibitors of IL-17A interaction with the receptor IL-17RA, and to bioconjugates, dimers, pharmaceutical compositions and their medical use.

title_en: P2X 3 Receptor antagonists
abstract_en: The invention relates to compounds of formula (I) and their use as P2X  3  And P2X  2/3  Use of antagonists of receptor activity, pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds, and methods of treatment therewith. The compounds of the invention are useful for the treatment and/or prophylaxis of pain and chronic pain and tolerance to analgesics, respiratory conditions and dysfunctions, and for the treatment of overactive bladder, bladder pain syndrome, dysuria, and in general urogenital diseases, cardiovascular conditions, and more general in P2X  3  And P2X  2/3  Receptors are involved in the potential treatment of characterised diseases and conditions of internal organs.

title_en: Neuregulin polypeptide fragments and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides specific neuregulin polypeptides that can be used in methods and compositions for preventing, treating, or delaying various diseases or disorders. The invention relates to application of neuregulin polypeptide in preparing a medicament for preventing, treating or delaying heart failure of mammals, and a using method of the medicament for preventing, treating or delaying heart failure of the mammals. In particular, the present invention provides a method for the prevention, treatment or delay of heart failure in a mammal by administering a medicament comprising a neuregulin polypeptide fragment in a specific individual suffering from or at risk of heart failure.

title_en: ASBDV composition for improving sleep disorder and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ASBDV composition for improving sleep disorder and a preparation and application thereof. The ASBDV composition for improving sleep disorder is composed of astaxanthin and cannabidiol. The preparation is the ASBDV composition preparation for improving sleep disorder, and auxiliary materials are added into the ASBDV composition to prepare tablets, oral liquid, capsules, granules, powder, pills, injection, film agents or patches. The application is the application of the ASBDV composition for improving the sleep disorder in the preparation of products for preventing/improving the sleep disorder. The composition (ASBDV) of astaxanthin and cannabidiol has obvious effect of improving sleep disorder.

title_en: Sulfoamino acid modified antioxidant oligopeptide and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sulfoamino acid modified antioxidant oligopeptide and a preparation method thereof. The invention utilizes the sulfoamino acid to obtain the unnatural antioxidant oligopeptide for the first time, compared with the natural antioxidant oligopeptide, the sulfoamino acid modified antioxidant oligopeptide has higher antioxidant activity and immunoregulation capability, and the sulfoamino acid modification can be used for various natural antioxidant oligopeptides so as to further improve the antioxidant activity and the immunoregulation capability of the natural antioxidant oligopeptide. The antioxidant performance of the antioxidant oligopeptide Cya-Phe-Leu-Ala-Pro modified by the cysteic acid prepared by the invention is obviously higher than that of sea cucumber tetrapeptide Phe-Leu-Ala-Pro; has better commercial application value.

title_en: Ganoderma lucidum immunomodulatory protein mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: A mutant of ganoderma lucidum immunomodulatory protein, comprising: FIP-gluM N31S 、FIP‑gluM T36N And FIP-gluM N31S/T36N Wherein: FIP-gluM N31S The amino acid sequence and the nucleotide sequence of (A) are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 4; FIP-gluM T36N The amino acid sequence and the nucleotide sequence of (A) are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.2 and SEQ ID NO. 5; FIP-gluM N31S/T36N The amino acid sequence and the nucleotide sequence of (A) are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.3 and SEQ IDShown in NO. 6. The invention can solve the problem that FIP-glu has high cytotoxicity in application, the toxicity of the modified mutant to cells is obviously reduced compared with that of ganoderma lucidum immunomodulatory protein (FIP-glu), and the utilization value of the modified mutant can be effectively improved.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating non-alcoholic steatohepatitis
abstract_en: Cepharanthine, repirailast, ifenprodil hemitartrate, browman's, aclopril, clobenzaprine, issorafen, eltanophylline, rapado, bemidel for use in treating or preventing lobular inflammation or non-alcoholic fatty liver disease or non-alcoholic steatohepatitis in a subject.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating neck, shoulder, waist and leg pain and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating neck, shoulder, waist and leg pains and a preparation method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. The pharmaceutical composition provided by the invention can treat the pains of the shoulders, the waist and the legs caused by liver and kidney deficiency, deficiency of vital qi and rheumatism, and has better pain relieving effect on the pains of the shoulders, the waist and the legs caused by the protrusion of cervical vertebra and lumbar intervertebral disc, even numbness of limbs. Besides having better pain relieving effect, the traditional Chinese medicine composition can also condition the body substantially, such as tonifying liver and kidney, tonifying qi and blood, dispelling wind and cold, relieving lumbar muscle strain and the like. Therefore, the medicine composition provided by the invention has a better effect on treating the neck, shoulder, waist and leg pains. In addition, the preparation method of the pharmaceutical composition for treating neck, shoulder, waist and leg pains can extract effective components in the medicine, so that the product achieves the expected treatment effect, and the method is simple and easy to operate, and is easy to realize automatic batch production.

title_en: For inhibiting Nav1.8 Pyridazine Compounds
abstract_en: Pyridazine compounds useful for inhibiting nav1.8 and methods for treating conditions, diseases or disorders associated with increased nav1.8 activity or expression are disclosed.

title_en: Emu camphor essential oil for promoting skin repair and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emu camphor essential oil for promoting skin repair and a preparation method thereof, the emu camphor essential oil comprises the following components by volume: 1-3 parts of emu oil, 1-3 parts of camphor essential oil, 0-10 parts of wild chrysanthemum flower essential oil, 1-10 parts of rose essential oil, 1-5 parts of orange flower essential oil and base oil: 50-80 parts of antioxidant, 0-20 parts of cosolvent and 1-5 parts of cosolvent. The emu oil and camphor essential oil act together to achieve the effects of quickly diminishing inflammation, dispelling cold, relieving pain, dispelling dampness, relieving itching and inhibiting bacteria on injuries and bruises. Meanwhile, emu oil has excellent skin deep penetration capability, can carry effective components in plant essential oil to reach deep skin, enhances cell activity, promotes proliferation of fiber cells, achieves the effect of cell repair, and revives skin. The added antioxidant can reduce peroxidation of fatty acid in emu camphor essential oil, delay rancidity and prolong shelf life.

title_en: FGFR4 inhibitor and application thereof
abstract_en: A compound (shown as formula I) used as a fibroblast growth factor receptor 4(FGFR4) inhibitor, a pharmaceutical composition thereof, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in treating FGFR4 mediated diseases. The above compounds act by participating in the regulation of multiple processes such as cell proliferation, apoptosis, migration, neovascularization, and the like.

title_en: Human ACE2 remodelling protein and ACE2-hFc antibody protein aiming at novel coronavirus
abstract_en: The invention provides hACE2 mutant protein-hFc fusion protein which has strong binding capacity to mutant strains of new coronaviruses, is more advantageous than the existing antibodies, and can overcome the problem of reduced neutralizing capacity of the antibodies caused by virus mutation. The hFc fusion protein of the hACE2 modified fragment is particularly suitable for treating or preventing new coronaviruses and mutant strains thereof, such as British strain, brazil strain, south Africa strain, mink 501T strain and the like, and preparing corresponding medicaments and vaccines.

title_en: Method for extracting and separating exosome of cryptocaryon irritans of marine parasitic ciliates and application of exosome
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exosome extracting and separating method of sea water parasitic ciliates for cryptocaryon irritans, which comprises the following steps: firstly, collecting cryptocaryon irritans cysts, cleaning the cysts, and placing the cysts in sterile seawater containing antibiotics for incubation; collecting the infected larva by using a sterile filter screen, and incubating and culturing in a culture medium containing antibiotics and exosome-free fetal calf serum; thirdly, centrifuging to remove the larvae in the infection period, and collecting supernatant; fourthly, sterilizing the supernatant through a filter membrane, and concentrating the filtrate; fifthly, centrifuging the concentrated solution to collect coarse exosome precipitates; sixthly, resuspending the crude exosome precipitate by using sterile precooled PBS, and adding a protease inhibitor; and seventhly, centrifuging to remove the supernatant, and using a heavy suspension precipitate to obtain the exosome. The method can effectively separate and extract the exosome stimulating the cryptocaryon irritans, the extracted exosome has a typical disc-shaped or saucer-shaped vesicle-shaped structure, the particle size integrally meets the standard, and the exosome extraction concentration is high.

title_en: Polypeptide fragment C and application thereof
