abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a polypeptide fragment C and application thereof. The polypeptide fragment C has an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID No.1, wherein the 9 th amino acid Xaa is Tyr, Val, Gly, Ser or Gln, the 20 th amino acid Xaa is Ser, Gln, Glu or Tyr, the 30 th amino acid Xaa is Asn, Thr, Ser, Pro or Leu, and the 42 th amino acid Xaa is Gly, Arg, Met or does not exist. MP-C significantly improved the colon pathomorphology of IBD mouse models, reduced disease activity index and colon histopathological score, and had the ability to interfere with the development of inflammatory bowel disease in mice.

title_en: Application of DDX 19A-based method for promoting cervical squamous cell carcinoma metastasis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical products, and discloses an application of DDX19A in promoting squamous cell carcinoma metastasis. Functionally, DDX19A was found to promote migration and invasion of cervical squamous cell carcinoma cells in vitro and lung metastasis in vivo. Mechanistically, overexpression of DDX19A increased NOX1 expression, increased reactive oxygen species ROS production, and induced cervical squamous cell carcinoma cell migration and invasion. Rescue experiments show that over-expression of NOX1 can save the knock-down of DDX19A, which causes cervical cancer squamous cell carcinoma cell invasion and migration and the generation of ROS, and further find that the ROS inhibitor N-acetylcysteine can inhibit the DDX 19A-induced cervical squamous cell carcinoma cell invasion and migration. It is thus demonstrated that DDX19A mediates ROS production by inducing NOX1, thereby promoting cervical squamous cell carcinoma metastasis. Blocking the DDX19A/NOX1/ROS axis may be a potential therapeutic target for cervical squamous cell carcinoma patients.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition containing tag-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex
abstract_en: The present invention provides stable pharmaceutical compositions and the like containing a tag-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex. In a pharmaceutical composition containing a labeling-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex, citric acid, phosphoric acid, 2- [4- (2-hydroxyethyl) -1-piperazinyl ] ethanesulfonic acid or tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane are blended as a buffer, sucrose or glycerol are blended as a stabilizer, and a nonionic surfactant is blended, and the pH is adjusted to 6.5 to 7.5. Thus, the generation of multimeric and insoluble microparticles can be suppressed when the labeling unit-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex is stored.

title_en: Sulfate of pyrimidine benzamide compound and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to sulfate salts of pyrimidine benzamide compounds and their use. The invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising said sulfate salt and to the use of said sulfate salt or said pharmaceutical composition for the preparation of a medicament for the treatment and prevention of central nervous system dysfunction.

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine shampoo and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a Chinese herbal medicine shampoo and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese herbal medicine shampoo comprises 10-30 parts of amino acid type surfactant, 1-5 parts of skin conditioner, 0.3-1 part of thickener, 0.5-5 parts of humectant, 0.02-0.08 part of chelating agent, 0.5-1 part of plant aromatic and 50-80 parts of solvent. The Chinese herbal medicine shampoo can nourish hair, has a protective effect on skin and is good in environmental protection.

title_en: New Zealand vitexin 2 and new Zealand vitexin 3 application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of prevention and control of animal diseases, in particular to a novel application of New Zealand vitexin 2 and New Zealand vitexin 3, and specifically relates to an application of New Zealand vitexin 2 and New Zealand vitexin 3 in preparation of anticoccidiosis medicines or feeds. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: the invention discovers that the New Zealand vitexin 2 and the New Zealand vitexin 3 have obvious inhibition effect on coccidium, the inhibition effect is reflected in that the New Zealand vitexin 2 and the New Zealand vitexin 3 can effectively inhibit the propagation of the Eimeria on a cell culture model of the Eimeria, and the inhibition effect is verified by animal experiments. Aiming at the discovery, the application fields of the New Zealand vitexin 2 and the New Zealand vitexin 3 are widened, and a new scheme is provided for the development of anticoccidial medicines.

title_en: Lactobacillus crispatus capable of preventing and/or treating cervical squamous cell carcinoma
abstract_en: The invention discloses Lactobacillus crispatus Lc31 and Lc83 capable of preventing and/or treating cervical squamous carcinoma. The preservation number of the lactobacillus crispatus Lc31 is CGMCC No.21348, and the preservation number of the lactobacillus crispatus Lc83 is CGMCC No.21349. The lactobacillus crispatus can be well adhered to the surface of cervical squamous cell carcinoma SiHa in vitro, and the metabolite of the lactobacillus crispatus can inhibit the growth, proliferation and migration invasion of the SiHa cell and promote the apoptosis of the SiHa cell. Therefore, the lactobacillus crispatus Lc31 and Lc83 have great application prospects in the aspect of preventing and/or treating cervical squamous cell carcinoma (not aiming at the diagnosis and treatment of diseases).

title_en: Integrated stress pathway inhibitors
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to therapeutic agents useful as inhibitors of the Integrated Stress Response (ISR) pathway.

title_en: Hydrazinopurine compounds and triazolopurine compounds for inhibiting xanthine oxidase
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound represented by the general formula (wherein R  1  、R  3  、R  4  、R  6  、R  8  、R  10  And R is  12  Represents a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group, R  2  、R  5  、R  7  、R  9  、R  11  And R is  13  Represents a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group or an aryl group. ) Representative hydrazinopurine compounds or triazolopurine compounds, and xanthine oxidase-inhibiting compositions and pharmaceutical compositions containing the same as an active ingredient, and particularly relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating hyperuricemia, gout and diseases caused by hyperuricemia.

title_en: Goose astrovirus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goose astrovirus N-GoAstV-190123 strain with strong toxicity and good immunity, which can generate higher neutralizing antibody after being prepared into an inactivated vaccine for immunity, can achieve the complete protection of goose groups, and has important economic value for the goose industry.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating osteoarthritis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for treating osteoarthritis and a preparation method thereof, wherein the pharmaceutical composition is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of cape jasmine, 10-30 parts of angelica, 10-20 parts of rheum officinale, 10-40 parts of salvia miltiorrhiza, 10-30 parts of ligusticum wallichii, 10-20 parts of dragon's blood, 10-30 parts of liquorice, 10-25 parts of angelica dahurica, 10-30 parts of ephedra, 10-30 parts of cassia twig, 10-20 parts of divaricate saposhnikovia root, 10-30 parts of suberect spatholobus stem, 5-20 parts of white paeony root, 15-40 parts of safflower, 5-20 parts of myrrh, 10-20 parts of frankincense, 10-25 parts of Chinese anise, 5-15 parts of garden balsam stem, 5-20 parts of lycopodium clavatum, 10-30 parts of astragalus root, 10-30 parts of cocklebur fruit, 10-20 parts of himalayan teasel root, 10-20 parts of ginger, 10-30 parts of pseudo-ginseng, 10-30 parts of garden balsam stem and 10, the medicine composition has the advantages of no damage to human bodies, simple and convenient preparation, wide medicine sources, low cost, obvious curative effect and no toxic or side effect, and can effectively treat osteoarthritis.

title_en: Crystalline forms of nilotinib, active drugs and pharmaceutical compositions prepared using the crystalline forms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nilotinib crystal form, which has characteristic peaks at diffraction angles 2 theta of 5.0 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 5.4 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 10.8 degrees +/-0.2 degrees, 11.6 degrees +/-0.2 degrees and 13.8 degrees +/-0.2 degrees in an X-ray powder diffraction pattern obtained by Cu-K alpha ray measurement. The nilotinib crystal form provided by the invention is a new crystal form, has good solubility in an aqueous solution with a pH value of 1 and an organic solvent, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Bifunctional fusion protein and medical application thereof
abstract_en: Relates to a bifunctional fusion protein and medical application thereof. In particular to a bifunctional fusion protein containing a SIRP gamma peptide variant and an anti-human PD-L1 antibody, the SIRP gamma peptide variant and medical application thereof. The bifunctional fusion protein can specifically bind to PD-L1 and CD47 to block the binding of PD-L1 or CD47 to a receptor or ligand thereof. Meanwhile, the preparation and application of the bifunctional fusion protein and the treatment of cancer and immune-related diseases are also provided.

title_en: Application of panobinostat in preparation of medicine for preventing, relieving and/or treating multiple sclerosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of panobinostat in preparation of a medicament for preventing, relieving and/or treating multiple sclerosis. Panobinostat shows a very good therapeutic effect on the experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis model in mice, which can effectively treat pathological changes of the disease and the progression of the disease. The therapeutic effect is by inhibiting proliferation of microglial cells in the central nervous system.

title_en: Tetrahydrofuran [2,3-b ] indoline compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tetrahydrofuran [2,3-b ] with a novel structure]Indolines compoundsArticle (A) The preparation method and the application thereof have mild synthesis conditions, can be carried out at room temperature, and have simple and convenient operation and high yield of 99 percent. The results of the antitumor cytotoxicity test on the compounds Ia to Ih show that the compounds have certain inhibitory activities on cancer cells including breast cancer cells MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7, osteosarcoma cancer cells U2OS, leukemia cells HL-60, lymphoma cells JeKo-1, hepG2 cells and melanoma cells A375, wherein the compounds Ib and Id show significant inhibitory activities on JeKo-1 and the compounds Ie show significant inhibitory activities on HL-60.

title_en: Two kinds of animal pathogenic bacteria with multiple drug resistance and capable of forming biological membrane and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses two kinds of animal pathogenic bacteria with multiple drug resistance and capable of forming a biological membrane and application thereof. The odorous aroma bacteria (Myroidesfetidus) WP-1 has a preservation number of: GDMCCNo: 61556. the yellow aroma bacteria (Myroidsflavus) NP-2 has a deposit number of: GDMCCNo: 61557. the invention separates two new pathogenic bacteria strains from diarrhea pig manure, analyzes the drug resistance of the two strains to 23 antibiotics, evaluates the capability of the two strains to form a biological membrane, tests the pathogenicity of the two strains to experimental animals, and has important significance for the detection, diagnosis and treatment of the diarrhea disease of the pig by related invention results.

title_en: Composition for treating cervical syndrome and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for treating cervical syndrome and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. The composition can rapidly penetrate through skin surface, penetrate into subcutaneous tissue and mucous membrane, and enter blood circulation system to achieve good relieving and treating effects. In addition, the composition mainly comprises epimedium and musk, and is supplemented with notopterygium root, asarum, myrrh, angelica, turmeric and safflower, so that the composition can effectively treat symptoms such as limb weakness, waist and knee weakness, difficult walking and the like. Because the composition is prepared from ligusticum wallichii, rhizoma cyperi, clove, rheum officinale and poria cocos, the composition can effectively treat symptoms such as dizziness, vomiting, migraine and the like. In addition, the ginger can promote the qi and blood circulation and the meridian passage, promote the composition to quickly take effect, quickly take effect and relieve the pain of patients. In addition, the preparation method of the composition is simple and easy to implement, the preparation period is short, and the automation is easy to realize.

title_en: Preparation method of universal injectable microwave sensitization immune gel
abstract_en: A preparation method of universal injectable microwave sensitization immune gel comprises the following steps: (1) stirring and dissolving sodium alginate powder in water to obtain a solution A; (2) adding an immunostimulant into the solution A obtained in the step (1) and continuously stirring at room temperature to obtain a solution B; (3) slowly dropwise adding CaCl into the solution B obtained in the step (2) 2 Dropwise adding the aqueous solution while stirring to obtain uniform and stable immune gel; (4) the final product was stored at 4 ℃. Preparation of the ImmunogelThe method has simple steps and mild conditions, can be used after mixing, and is convenient for large-scale commercial production. The obtained gel has good biological safety, injectability, microwave sensitization capability and obvious immune activation capability, can be used for universal microwave ablation-immune combined anti-tumor treatment, and has good application value and clinical transformation prospect.

title_en: Conjugated chemical degradation inducers and methods of use
abstract_en: The subject matter described herein relates to antibody-CIDE conjugates (Ab-CIDE), pharmaceutical compositions comprising them, and their use in treating diseases and conditions in which targeted protein degradation is beneficial.

title_en: Patrinia scabiosaefolia active component, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active component of patrinia, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the active component comprises patrinia villosa and penthorum chinense pursh, and the preparation method comprises the steps of S1, crushing the patrinia villosa and penthorum chinense pursh to obtain coarse powder; s2, soaking the coarse powder obtained in the step S1 in an ethanol solution, percolating, and collecting percolate; s3 adding Glycyrrhrizae radix antioxidant into percolate obtained in step S2, concentrating into thick paste, drying, and pulverizing to obtain herba Patriniae active component; the application refers to the application of the active components in preparing the medicine for treating insomnia. The active ingredients of the sauce can effectively prolong the sleep time induced by the sodium pentobarbital and shorten the sleep latency induced by the sodium barbital through the synergistic effect of the patrinia villosa and the penthorum chinense pursh, the prepared patrinia villosa capsule has simple ingredients, the patrinia villosa and the penthorum chinense pursh serving as a new food raw material are compounded, the safety is high, the insomnia caused by neurasthenia can be effectively improved, the preparation method is simple, and the sauce is suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine for treating prostatitis
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine for treating prostatitis, which is prepared by soaking akebia stem, cress, houttuynia cordata, wild buckwheat rhizome, white dragon beard, cogongrass and water-bindered hemp in 40-50 parts of black nightshade fruit wine at normal temperature for 1-2 h, draining, drying in a drying box, crushing in a crusher after drying, crushing to 50-100 meshes, mixing uniformly, adding a proper amount of honey, and preparing into honeyed pills. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is scientific, has rich raw materials, low cost and good effect, can achieve the effects of clearing heat and promoting diuresis, reducing swelling and relieving pain, cooling blood and relieving itching, and activating blood and removing fatigue, has no side effect, can effectively prevent the recurrence of diseases, has very good curative effect on the prostate diseases through multiple tests of the inventor, can achieve 80-90% of effect after the patient generally uses the traditional Chinese medicine composition for 30 days, and can achieve the recovery from the somatic expression after the patient is consolidated for 90-100 days.

title_en: Development and application of autoimmune inhibitor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to dual blocking antibodies targeting human interleukin-4 and interleukin-13, methods of making and uses thereof.

title_en: Colonic drug delivery formulations
abstract_en: In a delayed release drug formulation comprising a core containing a drug and a delayed release coating for enteric release, the absence of an alkaline intermediate layer between the core and the outer layer does not hinder the release of the drug in the colon. The delayed release coating comprises an inner coating layer and optionally an isolation layer. The outer coating comprises a mixture of enzymatically degradable polysaccharides susceptible to attack by colonic enzymes; and a film forming enteric polymer having a pH threshold of about 6 or greater, said colonic enzyme being selected from the group consisting of starch, amylose, amylopectin, chitosan, chondroitin sulfate, cyclodextrin, dextran, pullulan, carrageenan, scleroglucan, chitin, curdlan, and levan, said enzymatically degradable polysaccharide and said enteric polymer being present in said outer coating in a ratio of greater than 60: 40.

title_en: Preparation of yolk phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microspheres and application of yolk phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microspheres as drug carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microspheres and application of the phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microspheres as a drug carrier. The preparation method of the composite microsphere comprises the following steps: swelling the yolk phosphatidylcholine in a calcium chloride solution to obtain a calcium chloride solution of the yolk phosphatidylcholine; mixing a calcium chloride solution of the egg yolk phosphatidylcholine with a sodium carbonate solution, stirring for reaction, standing and aging to obtain an egg yolk phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microsphere suspension, performing centrifugal separation to obtain a precipitate, cleaning, and drying to obtain the egg yolk phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microsphere. The yolk phosphatidylcholine/calcium carbonate composite microsphere disclosed by the invention has good drug loading performance and slow release performance on water-soluble micromolecular drugs, and can be used as a slow release carrier of the water-soluble micromolecular drugs in the production of pharmaceutical preparations.

title_en: Gold nanocage material capable of photoresponse releasing NO and resisting MRSA biofilm as well as preparation method and application of gold nanocage material
abstract_en: The invention provides a gold nanocage material capable of photoresponsively releasing NO and resisting MRSA biofilm, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of biomedical engineering materials. The preparation method provided by the invention can realize the effective load of the NO donor TCF on the gold nano cage by utilizing the gold-sulfur bond formed by the sulfydryl on the TCF and the gold nano cage AuNC, and the prepared AuNC @ TCF can slowly release NO at physiological temperature, thereby promoting the MRSA to change from a biofilm state to a free bacteria state. The AuNC @ TCF can be quickly heated up through near infrared light irradiation, so that the TCF is promoted to be heated to accelerate release of NO, and the NO is further cooperated with the NO and photothermal therapy for antibiosis. The AuNC @ TCF provided by the invention has obvious effects of inhibiting bacteria and dissipating biofilm, can be used as an antibacterial drug and a drug for promoting wound healing or diminishing inflammation, and shows an important application prospect in the aspect of anti-biofilm.

title_en: Compound preparation for clearing pig endotoxin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound preparation for clearing toxin in pig body and a preparation method thereof, wherein the compound preparation comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1-2 parts of yeast selenium, 1-2 parts of chromium picolinate, 10-20 parts of glutamine, 10-20 parts of arginine, 10-20 parts of glycocyamine and feeding aflatoxin B 1 10-20 parts of lyase, 10-20 parts of saccharomyces cerevisiae culture, 10-20 parts of acanthopanax and 10-20 parts of astragalus. The formula of the invention can improve the immunity and the production performance of the pigs by cleaning the toxins in the pigs, and the invention cleans the toxins in the pigs according to the physiological characteristics of the pigs, selects green raw materials, is safe and effective, has no residue, and has no drug resistance.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition with improved stability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pharmaceutical compositions having improved stability. Specifically, the present invention provides an injectable composition for controlled-release drug delivery and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the composition comprises: a lactic acid-based polymer having a weight average molecular weight between 5,000 and 50,000 daltons, an acid number of less than 3mgKOH/g, and a residual lactide monomer content of less than about 0.3 weight percent; a pharmaceutically acceptable organic solvent; and a bioactive substance or a salt thereof, which contains an amino acid serine in its molecular structure, and which is capable of reacting with a lactide monomer to form a conjugate; and wherein the composition reduces the formation of the conjugate.

title_en: Cell preparation for treating renal fibrosis and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell preparation for treating renal fibrosis, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) isolating and culturing vascular endothelial progenitor cells; (2) subjecting umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells and vascular endothelial progenitor cells to non-contact co-culture, wherein in the co-culture, the umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells secrete cytokines to promote differentiation of the vascular endothelial progenitor cells into vascular endothelial cells; (3) collecting the cells cultured in the step (2) to prepare the cell preparation. The cell preparation of the invention has an inhibiting effect on renal fibrosis, can enhance the activity of resisting renal fibrosis, and provides theoretical basis and experimental basis for developing novel medicines for resisting renal fibrosis.

title_en: Delayed release pharmaceutical formulation comprising an outer layer with an enzymatically degradable polymer, composition thereof and method for the manufacture thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing a coatable core of a delayed release drug formulation for oral administration for delivering a drug to the colon. The method includes forming a core containing a drug. The outer coating compound is prepared by passing a first aqueous compound of an enzymatically degradable polymer which is enzymatically degradable by colonic bacterial enzymes; a second aqueous compound of a film forming enteric polymer having a pH threshold above about pH 6; and an organic detackifier. The core is then coated with an outer coating compound to form an outer coated core.

title_en: Composition for regulating skin micro-ecological balance and application and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition for regulating the microecological balance of skin, and an application and a preparation method thereof. The composition for regulating the skin micro-ecological balance comprises an Sparassis crispa extract, a lactobacillus/rye powder fermentation filtrate and a European plum seed extract. The composition has effects of regulating ecological balance of microorganism on skin surface, promoting growth of beneficial bacteria, inhibiting reproduction of harmful bacteria, eliminating skin inflammation, improving skin resistance, and repairing skin, and can be used for preparing various cosmetics.

title_en: Fomenting bag for treating eye diseases caused by deficiency of qi and blood and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fomenting bag for treating an eye disease caused by deficiency of qi and blood and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the fomenting bag comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of prepared rhizome of rehmannia, 10-20 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 6-12 parts of white chrysanthemum, 6-12 parts of mulberry leaf, 10-20 parts of medlar and 2-4 parts of borneol. The invention belongs to the technical field of eye disease treatment, in particular to a fomenting bag for treating the eye disease of deficiency of both qi and blood and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Fusion protein for treating metabolic diseases and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and relates to a fusion protein for treating metabolic diseases, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the general formula of the fusion protein is R1-L-R2 or R2-L-R1; wherein R1 is FGF21 protein, FGF21 protein analogue or similar peptide with FGF21 protein biological function, R2 is GIP, mutant GIP or similar peptide with GIP biological function, and L is connecting peptide. The fusion protein can be used as a therapeutic drug or a pharmaceutical composition for treating diseases related to hyperglycemia and hyperlipidemia, such as diabetes, obesity, steatohepatitis or cardiovascular diseases, and the therapeutic effect is remarkably superior to that of original FGF21 and GIP.

title_en: Culture solution extract secreted by human body fat cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a culture solution extract secreted by human body fat cells, which comprises a plurality of growth factors, amino acids, proteins, cathepsin D, vitamins, oligopeptides and hyaluronic acid, wherein the plurality of growth factors, amino acids, proteins, cathepsin D, vitamins and oligopeptides are mixed and dissolved into solution to obtain the culture solution of the human body fat cell secretion extract. The culture solution extract disclosed by the invention contains various growth factors, amino acids, proteins, cathepsin D, vitamins, oligopeptides and hyaluronic acid, has obvious effects on the aspects of aging resistance, wound healing and the like, and can obviously improve the activity of fibroblasts of the skin.

title_en: Human plasma kallikrein inhibitors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to human plasma kallikrein inhibitors. The present invention discloses compounds of formula (I) as described herein, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The compounds are inhibitors of plasma kallikrein. Also provided are pharmaceutical compositions comprising at least one compound of the invention, and methods relating to the use of the compounds and compositions of the invention for the treatment and prevention of diseases and conditions characterized by deleterious plasma kallikrein activity.

title_en: Aptamer QQ-2 targeting human highly invasive choroidal melanoma and application
abstract_en: The aptamer QQ-2 for targeting highly invasive choroidal melanoma and the application thereof are beneficial to finding a tumor marker of the choroidal melanoma by identifying the property characteristics and target molecules of the aptamer QQ-2 and are used for diagnosis and targeted treatment of the choroidal melanoma, and the prepared aptamer can specifically identify highly invasive choroidal melanoma cells and choroidal melanoma tissues and has high affinity; no immunogenicity; the molecular weight is small, and the in vitro chemical synthesis can be realized; different parts of the aptamer are easy to modify and replace. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of stable sequence, convenience in storage, convenience in marking and the like. When the aptamer is used for detecting human choroidal melanoma cells, the operation is simpler and quicker, and the aptamer has lower synthesis cost than antibody preparation cost, short period and good reproducibility.

title_en: Application of Bulbus Fritillariae Cirrhosae preparation in preventing and treating silicosis
abstract_en: The application relates to application of a golden shellfish preparation in preventing and treating silicosis, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. Use of a preparation of Thunberg for the preparation of a medicament for the prevention and/or treatment of silicosis. The oral liquid can obviously reduce SiO 2 Induced pulmonary fibrosis in early rat lung tissue lipid peroxidation product MDA content, reducing lipid peroxidation, eliminating excessive oxygen free radicals in vivo and inhibiting pulmonary fibrosis caused by abnormal reconstruction of extracellular matrix; can reduce the level of inflammatory cytokine IL-8 in early lung tissue, thereby reducing chemotaxis of neutrophil, eosinophil, basophil, etc., inhibiting adhesion and exudation of neutrophil, and relieving lung injury; can delay SiO 2 Progression of induced pulmonary fibrosis in rats.

title_en: Microbial compound with effect of relieving irritable bowel syndrome and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microbial compound with an effect of relieving irritable bowel syndrome, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention creatively develops a novel strategy for preventing, relieving or treating irritable bowel syndrome, and the microbial compound can obviously improve the intestinal tract running function of diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome patients; the high sensitivity of the viscera is obviously reduced; the serum inflammatory factor is remarkably reduced: the levels of TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-17 are obviously improved, and the level of serum inflammatory factor IL-10 is obviously improved; significantly reduce serum 5-HT and SP levels; significantly increased colonic SERT levels. The microbial composition has a great application prospect in preparing medicaments, foods or health-care products for preventing, treating and relieving diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome.

title_en: h-BN/MoS capable of realizing targeted photothermal and chemical synergistic treatment 2 Nano probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nanoprobes, in particular to h-BN/MoS capable of realizing targeted photothermal and chemical synergistic treatment  2  The preparation method of the nano probe comprises the following steps: h-BN sodiumRice flake dispersion and FA-PEI modified MoS  2  The quantum dot dispersion liquid is mixed in equal volume to obtain h-BN/MoS  2  A composite material; preparation of DNA hairpins, h-BN/MoS  2  Adsorbing the DNA chain by the composite material to obtain h-BN/MoS  2  A nanoprobe; h-BN/MoS  2  The nanoprobe can be used for miRNA fluorescence and Raman dual-mode detection and/or fluorescence in situ imaging and preparation of a nano preparation. The invention widens the application of the 2D nano-sheet, realizes photothermal and chemical treatment, and lays a foundation for further developing a diagnosis and treatment integrated platform for cancer marker detection and cooperative treatment.

title_en: Carprofen chewable tablet preparation and preparation process method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carprofen chewable tablet preparation and a preparation process method thereof, wherein the preparation process comprises the steps of preprocessing, sieving raw materials with a 60-mesh sieve to obtain uniform particle swarm, premixing microcrystalline cellulose, croscarmellose sodium, carprofen, yellow, red, brown iron oxide and beef essence for 10 minutes to obtain a first mixture, adding 50g of carprofen, 863.6g of filling agent, 15g of disintegrant, 50g of flavoring agent and 1.4g of coloring agent into every 1000g of the mixture, weighing 10g of magnesium stearate and 10g of stearic acid, mixing for 3 minutes to obtain a second mixture, and totally mixing the first mixture and the second mixture to obtain a raw material mixture. Tabletting the raw material mixture to obtain a finished product; the method improves the product quality, and the carprofen chewable tablet with good taste is obtained by matching with the prescription and the granulating process, and the beef flavor is added as the flavoring agent, so that the taste is good, the compliance of the small animals is enhanced, and the quality is stable.

title_en: Drug delivery carrier, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug delivery carrier, a preparation method and application thereof. The drug delivery carrier comprises a co-assembled targeting polypeptide and a membrane-penetrating polypeptide, wherein the targeting polypeptide comprises a targeting part, a response enzyme digestion part and an assembly retention part which are sequentially coupled through chemical bonds, and the membrane-penetrating polypeptide comprises a hydrophilic part, a response enzyme digestion part and an assembly retention part which are sequentially coupled through chemical bonds. The drug delivery carrier can effectively load the drug, can realize high-quantity enrichment and permeation on the cornea, can realize accurate positioning at the cell level, can realize reassembly and detention in the ocular fundus microenvironment through enzyme digestion, realizes controllable drug release, prolongs the action time of the drug, maintains the effective concentration of the drug through low-dose administration, and reduces the toxicity to ocular tissues.

title_en: Preparation method and application of novel silver nano material AgNFs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of novel silver nano material AgNFs, which comprises the following steps: (1) weighing BSA, adding the BSA into water, stirring, and putting the BSA into an oil bath pan for stirring and preheating; (2) adding silver ion solution after preheating, and reacting; (3) finally, dropwise adding an ascorbic acid aqueous solution, and continuing the reaction; (4) after the reaction is finished, the silver nano material AgNFs is obtained by cleaning, dispersed and stored by ultrapure water, and dispersed by ultrasonic before use. The AgNFs of the silver nano material has a simple synthetic path, is environment-friendly, has uniform material size, and has good dispersibility and stability; specifically, based on the enrichment and loading of AgNFs on antibiotics, the concentration of local antibiotics is improved, the metabolic activity of drug-resistant bacteria is regulated, AgNFs stimulate cell respiration, and the antibiotics are taken in a synergistic manner to play an antibacterial role by means of proton motility enhancement.

title_en: Application of DMXAA in preparing medicine for preventing and treating osteoporosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of DMXAA in preparing a medicine for preventing and treating osteoporosis. The invention uses DMXAA to intervene osteoclast differentiation and maturation and an I-type osteoporosis animal model, and finds that the model has the functions of inhibiting osteoclast differentiation and resisting osteoporosis to a certain extent. By utilizing the discovery, the invention provides a medicine which takes DMXAA as a main active ingredient and prevents and treats I-type osteoporosis diseases by inhibiting osteoclast differentiation, has great significance for the research and treatment of the I-type osteoporosis diseases, and opens up new clinical application for the DMXAA. In addition, the DMXAA is used in a smaller dose than the conventional dose, and has small side effect. Animal test results suggest that DMXAA can significantly prevent and treat bone loss due to menopause (estrogen deprivation). The preparation prepared from DMXAA or the pharmaceutically acceptable carrier thereof has the application prospect of the medicine for treating osteoporosis.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine extract for warming and recuperating kidney yang and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine extract for warming and recuperating kidney yang and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine extraction. The traditional Chinese medicine extract for warming and recuperating kidney yang and the preparation method thereof comprise the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1-4 parts of ginseng, 5-9 parts of polygala root, 10-17 parts of poria with hostwood, 5-9 parts of dried orange peel, 10-15 parts of prepared rhizome of rehmannia, 5-9 parts of dodder, 8-14 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 9-19 parts of jujube kernel, 3-8 parts of testis et penis canitis, 5-15 parts of Chinese yam, 10-15 parts of white paeony root and 5-9 parts of cistanche. The traditional Chinese medicine extract has the functions of warming and invigorating qi by extracting the saponin from the ginseng and the polygala tenuifolia, the traditional Chinese medicine preparation has rich warming and invigorating nutrients by the yellow kernel and the Chinese yam, the warming and invigorating effect of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation is improved by matching the prepared rhizome of rehmannia, the golden dog kidney and the cistanche on the basis of warming and invigorating qi, the traditional Chinese medicine preparation has good warming and invigorating effect and ideal drug effect, ensures the long-acting warming and invigorating effect of the medicine on invigorating qi and warming and invigorating kidney yang, is easy to be well absorbed by a body, and is worthy of great popularization.

title_en: Patch preparation
abstract_en: The adhesive patch is provided with an adhesive layer on a support, wherein the adhesive layer contains a drug, DMSO, and an adhesive base, the adhesive base contains a styrene-based thermoplastic elastomer, and the styrene-based thermoplastic elastomer has a triblock content of 35-65%.

title_en: Novel duck reovirus egg yolk antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel duck reovirus egg yolk antibody and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing duck reovirus antigen; (2) inactivating the prepared duck reovirus antigen, adding an adjuvant, mixing and emulsifying to prepare the inactivated vaccine of the duck reovirus; (3) and (3) immunizing the laying hens with the inactivated vaccine, collecting the hyperimmune eggs, and extracting the egg yolk antibody. The novel duck reovirus egg yolk antibody prepared by the invention can safely and effectively prevent the clinical symptoms of duck spleen enlargement, bleeding and necrosis caused by duck reovirus at each age stage, such as reduction of egg laying rate of breeding ducks and weight of meat ducks, increase of feed-meat ratio, remarkable reduction of meat duck slaughter qualification rate and the like, can purposefully prevent and treat infection and outbreak of duck reovirus, simplifies the production process, can be produced in large scale and is applied to clinic.

title_en: Preparation method and application of stem and leaf extract of Zingiber corallinum Hance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of chemical extraction, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of a zingiber corallinum hance stem and leaf extract. The invention adopts a simple distillation method to extract effective substances from stem and leaf parts of the Zingiber corallinum Hance, and fluid extract prepared by evaporating an extracting solution is mixed with volatile oil to obtain the Zingiber corallinum Hance stem and leaf extract. The Zingiber corallinum Hance stem and leaf extract has the effect of resisting candida albicans, can be applied to antibacterial drugs and antibacterial feeds, changes the Zingiber corallinum Hance stem and leaf into valuable, and improves the economic utilization value of the Zingiber corallinum Hance stem and leaf extract.

title_en: Deoxycytidine or uridine derivatives for the treatment of cancer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds of formula (I) or a stereoisomer, solvate, tautomer or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof for use in therapy, in particular in the treatment of cancer: formula (III) X, W 1 、W 2 、Y、Z、R 1 、R 2 And R 3 As defined herein. The invention also relates to a medicineA method of treating cancer comprising administering to a subject in need thereof a compound of formula (I). The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions and kits comprising such compounds.

title_en: Heterocyclic compounds for use in medical therapy
abstract_en: The present invention provides heterocyclic compounds that bind to the ubiquitously expressed E3 ligase protein Cereblon (CRBN) and their use for the treatment of abnormal cell proliferation in humans or other hosts. The invention also provides compounds useful as synthesis intermediates for synthesizing bifunctional compounds for targeting protein degradation.

title_en: Preparation method of acryloyl glycinamide-phenylboronic acid based sugar-sensitive microneedle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of acryloyl glycinamide-phenylboronic acid base sugar-sensitive micro-needle. The glucose-sensitive hydrogel microneedle is directly prepared from photoinitiator 2959 for three monomers, Namely Acryloyl Glycinamide (NAGA), 3-acrylamidophenylboronic acid (AAPBA) and 1-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone (NVP), by a free radical copolymerization method, and is formed. The glucose responsive microneedle prepared by the invention can quickly respond to the change of the concentration of glucose, has good biocompatibility and higher strength, and can be realized by adopting conventional raw materials and equipment.

title_en: Pyrrolopyrimidine derivative and pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating protein kinase-associated diseases comprising the same as active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pyrrolopyrimidine derivatives, and pharmaceutical compositions for preventing or treating protein kinase-associated diseases, comprising the same as an active ingredient. The pyrrolopyrimidine derivative has excellent inhibitory activity on various protein kinases including LRRK2, and has good inhibitory effect on the proliferation of triple-negative breast cancer cells. Accordingly, the pharmaceutical composition comprising the pyrrolopyrimidine derivative as an active ingredient is useful for the treatment or prevention of diseases associated with protein kinases, particularly cancer, degenerative brain disease and inflammatory diseases, and particularly, for the treatment of triple negative breast cancer.

title_en: Tea production method, tea and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of tea production, and provides a tea production method, tea and application thereof, wherein the production method comprises the following steps: diluting the ionic selenium-rich liquid to obtain a selenium-rich diluent; before the Pu 'er tea leaves are picked, spraying selenium-rich diluent on the Pu' er tea trees, and picking the tea leaves to obtain fresh leaves; processing the fresh leaves according to the processing method of sun-dried green or red raw tea and naturally drying in the sun to obtain the tea product. The method can produce the tea leaves which have no pesticide residue and are rich in organic selenium. The special large-leaf tea of Pu 'er tea in Yunnan has strong selenium gathering and resisting capabilities, so that the ion selenium-rich liquid is sprayed on the tea, the normal growth state of the tea can be ensured, the selenium poisoning symptom of the tea can not be caused, the original beneficial elements of the Pu' er tea can be reserved, and organic selenium elements with high content can be added newly.

title_en: Antiviral lectins and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to antiviral lectins and uses thereof. In particular, the present invention relates to complex (CX type) and/or hybrid (HY type) polysaccharide binding lectins for use in the treatment or prevention of influenza virus infection. The invention also provides a method of treating or preventing influenza virus infection by administering the lectin or a composition comprising the same to a subject in need thereof.

title_en: Application of polypeptide in preparing medicine for treating type 2 immune disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses the use of a polypeptide comprising an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID No.3, or a fragment, variant, fusion or derivative thereof, or a fusion of said fragment, variant or derivative thereof, in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of type 2 immune disorders. The invention provides a new method for preventing or treating type 2 immune diseases, and has potential clinical application value. The invention also discloses a method for detecting the Charcot-Laiden crystal.

title_en: Delivery system and application thereof in preparation of anti-infective drugs
abstract_en: The invention provides a delivery system and application thereof in preparing anti-infective drugs, relating to the technical field of biological medicines. The invention provides application of neutrophils in preparation of a common delivery carrier of azithromycin and polymyxin, application of neutrophils in preparation of anti-infective drugs, and a delivery system, a preparation method and application thereof.

title_en: Application of harmine in promoting nerve regeneration and repairing nerve injury
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of harmine in preparing a medicament for promoting nerve regeneration and repairing nerve injury. In the invention, the cortical neuron and the DRG neuron are cultured in vitro by utilizing the microfluidic system to form the nerve axon injury of the central nervous system and the peripheral nervous system, and then the harms are treated by using the harmine, so that the harmine can remarkably promote the regeneration of the damaged cortical neuron and the DRG neuron axon after discovery, and the discovery provides a new direction for the treatment of nerve injury patients such as spinal cord injury, peripheral injury and the like.

title_en: Medicinal composition for treating coronary heart disease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and particularly discloses a pharmaceutical composition for treating coronary heart disease and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the pharmaceutical composition comprises the following steps: s1, extracting the pyrola with 60-70 Vol.% ethanol solution, and processing to obtain pyrola clear paste and pyrola herb residues; extracting epimedium with 65-75 Vol.% of ethanol solution, and processing to obtain epimedium clear paste and epimedium herb residues; s2, mixing herba Pyrolae dregs, herba Epimedii dregs and other four medicines except herba Gynostemmatis total glycosides, and extracting with water to obtain mixed fluid extract; s3, mixing the mixed clear paste, the Chinese pyrola herb clear paste and the epimedium clear paste, precipitating with ethanol, and concentrating to obtain thick paste; s4, adding gypenosides into the soft extract, diluting with water, standing, filtering, and packaging the filtrate. The pharmaceutical composition has the effects of nourishing yin and tonifying kidney and excellent effect of protecting the myocardium after injury.

title_en: Method for preparing multifunctional hydrogel by yeast fermentation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing multifunctional hydrogel by yeast fermentation. Firstly, reducing graphene oxide by polydopamine to obtain a reduced graphene oxide solution, and then preparing a gelatin PCA glucose mixed solution with a certain concentration and an activated yeast solution; mixing the three materials by a one-pot reaction method, stirring uniformly, pouring into a mould, and fermenting in a water bath at 30 ℃ for a certain time to obtain the Gel-PrGO-PCA-yeast multifunctional hydrogel material. The method is simple, convenient, rapid and efficient, and the obtained hydrogel has good air permeability, super mechanical property, electric conductivity and biocompatibility, and can be applied to different skin positions to detect electrocardio and myoelectricity. The invention provides a new thought and a new method for preparing the porous breathable conductive hydrogel electrode, and is beneficial to the development and utilization of the conductive hydrogel material so as to be applied to the field of biosensors.

title_en: TSG-6 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel anti-TSG-6 antibodies, pharmaceutical compositions comprising such antibodies, and therapeutic methods of using such antibodies and pharmaceutical compositions to treat diseases such as cancer or autoimmune diseases.

title_en: Application of papaya polysaccharide on preparing antiviral drugs
abstract_en: The invention provides application of wrinkled papaya polysaccharide in preparation of anti-influenza virus medicines. The application of the wrinkled papaya polysaccharide in preparing medicaments for resisting avian influenza virus. The composition of the wrinkled papaya polysaccharide and the H7N9 avian influenza inactivated vaccine is applied to preparation of medicines for resisting avian influenza virus. The papaya polysaccharide has antiviral effect, and can reduce death of chicken infected by viruses. The effect of the combination with vaccine is more obvious. Can be used in combination with vaccine for preventing and treating avian influenza. The papaya polysaccharide has growth promoting effect, and can promote chicken growth. Especially after the chicken is infected with virus, the chicken can resist virus and promote chicken growth. The effect of the combination with vaccine is more obvious.

title_en: Proteasome 19S regulatory particle subunit PSMD11 as target for preventing or treating cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a proteasome 19S regulatory particle subunit PSMD11 as a target for preventing or treating cancer. The invention proves that PSMD11 is an important survival factor for pancreatic cancer cells induced by Kras oncogenes for the first time. The single-allele or double-allele conditional knockout of PSMD11 in a pancreatic cancer mouse model completely blocked the development and progression of pancreatic cancer and significantly prolonged survival in pancreatic cancer mice. Acute knockout of PSMD11 induced massive pancreatic cancer cell apoptosis and tumor regression in vitro and in vivo. And after single allele knockout of PSMD11, no obvious toxic or side effect is found on mice, and the PSMD11 is proved to be an effective target for treating and preventing pancreatic cancer or other cancers.

title_en: Metal organic framework catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal organic framework catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) synthesizing ligand tetra (4-carboxyl) terphenyl methane; 2) synthesizing an organic ligand and a metal cluster-constructed metal-organic framework catalyst; 3) efficiency calculations for catalyzing phospholipid compounds and the exploration of the relevant mechanisms. The invention adopts an inorganic-organic hybridization strategy and synthesizes the high-pore catalyst based on the advantages of metal organic framework materials. The organic hybridization strategy can reduce the content of metal and improve the biocompatibility of catalysis; the structure of the high pores can improve the adsorption contact capacity of the catalyst and guest molecules and improve the catalytic efficiency, thereby achieving the optimization of performance.

title_en: Therapeutic agent combinations for the prevention or treatment of tumor diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides a therapeutic agent combination for preventing or treating tumor diseases, namely an application of an EGFR inhibitor and a chemotherapeutic medicament in preparing a medicament for treating tumor diseases. Specifically, the invention provides an application of a compound shown as a formula (I), a stereoisomer, a compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in preparation of a medicament for preventing or treating tumor diseases by combining pemetrexed and/or cisplatin.

title_en: Methods of treating fibrotic diseases or conditions or interstitial lung diseases with SRC kinase inhibitors
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to certain Src kinase inhibitors, or pharmaceutically-acceptable salts thereof, and their use in the treatment of fibrosis and fibrotic disorders such as idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in a warm-blooded animal such as a human. The disclosure also relates to the use of the Src kinase inhibitor, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, in combination with at least one further therapeutic agent for the treatment of fibrosis in a warm-blooded animal such as man and fibrotic disorders such as idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

title_en: Bis (bisaziridine) derivatives as photocrosslinkers for treating corneal ectasia disorders
abstract_en: The disclosure features bis (bisaziridine) derivatives of formula (I) (1-a) or (1-b) that produce cross-linking in the cornea in response to exposure to electromagnetic radiation (e.g., UV-light). The compounds can be used, for example, to treat a subject (e.g., a human) having a disease, disorder, or condition, wherein an abnormal shape of the cornea (e.g., corneal thinning, e.g., bilateral thinning of the central, parasentric, or peripheral cornea; or corneal steepening (e.g., swelling)) results in the pathology and/or symptoms and/or progression of the disease, disorder, or condition. Non-limiting examples of such diseases, disorders or conditions include: (i) corneal ectatic disease; (ii) the vision condition; (iii) is a disease, disorder or condition that is inherited from or coexistent with any one of the foregoing or any one of the diseases disclosed herein. More specific non-limiting examples of such diseases, disorders or conditions include keratoconus, corneal spheroids, hyaline limbus degeneration, corneal ectasia (e.g., post-operative ectasia, such as post-LASIK ectasia), telin limbus degeneration, myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, irregular astigmatism and presbyopia. In some embodiments, the claimed methods may be performed without adding or supplementing oxygen levels, which may be advantageous in some applications. Preferred exemplary compounds are, for example, bis (diazirine) amino acid derivatives, as described in example 1:

title_en: Self-enhanced targeting nano-drug based on tumor transferrin regulation and control, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-enhancement targeting nano-drug based on tumor Transferrin regulation and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the nano-drug is formed by liposome self-assembly and comprises Transferrin (Transferrin, tf) modified on the surface of the liposome and hydrophobic drug Deferoxamine (DFO) loaded in a hydrophobic cavity between phospholipid bilayers. The liposome carrier and the loaded drug form unconjugated position relation with hydrophilic and hydrophobic force. The invention successfully prepares the nano-medicament finally by optimizing the preparation process, and the product has moderate and controllable grain diameter. Transferrin on the surface of the nano particles targets transferrin receptors overexpressed on the surface of tumor cells, DFO in the nano medicine is complexed with ferric ions in the tumor cells, the content of the ferric ions in the tumor cells is reduced, the further expression of the transferrin receptors on the surface of the tumor cells is promoted, and the autonomous targeting property of the nano medicine is enhanced. Therefore, the nano-drug is expected to improve the specific targeting property to tumor cells.

title_en: Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for improving omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid, which comprises omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid, cubilose acid and phospholipid. The composition has the advantages that the bird's nest acid in the functional components is dispersed in the DHA grease without adding any additive, the problem that the DHA is easy to be oxidized is solved, and meanwhile, the effects of promoting brain development, regulating immunity, promoting mineral absorption and utilization in intestinal tracts, maintaining beauty and keeping young and the like are achieved. The phospholipid can prevent cubilose acid from settling in omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid oil, and is phosphatidyl choline, phosphatidyl ethanolamine, phosphatidyl inositol, or phosphatidyl serine. Not only can prevent the settlement of the cubilose acid, but also can support the growth of nerve cells, thereby improving the absorptivity of DHA in the brain. PS in particular, not only nourishes the brain and enhances brain function, but also relieves mental stress and improves cognition, and is called "brain nutrient".

title_en: Non-viral modification of mesenchymal stem cells
abstract_en: Described herein are methods of transfecting mesenchymal stem cells with a nucleic acid construct from which one or more functional genes are expressed, which is non-viral and, in certain embodiments, can provide high transfection efficiency, high copy number per cell, high cell viability, long duration of transient expression, and/or a substantially unchanged pluripotent phenotype. In certain embodiments, these methods may be scalable and/or suitable for large-scale clinical production of modified mesenchymal stem cells. Also described in detail herein are transfected mesenchymal stem cells and populations of mesenchymal stem cells, their use, methods of using these transfected mesenchymal stem cells to treat diseases or disorders, such as cancer, and kits and compositions related thereto.

title_en: Application of cinnamaldehyde combined with ceftriaxone sodium
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of cinnamaldehyde combined ceftriaxone sodium, which is mainly used for preparing medicines for preventing and treating drug-resistant bacterial infection. The cinnamaldehyde can also be used as a synergist of ceftriaxone sodium to prepare medicines for preventing and treating salmonella enteritidis infection. The research of the invention discovers that the combination of the two can have synergistic antibacterial activity on drug-resistant gram-negative drug-resistant bacteria, can damage bacterial membranes, increase membrane permeability, promote ceftriaxone sodium intracellular accumulation, inhibit drug-resistant gene expression, induce bacteria to enter a high metabolic state, improve survival rate of mice when drug-resistant salmonella enteritidis is subjected to abdominal cavity infection, improve intestinal inflammation, prevent bacterial intestinal colonization, and also can reduce the dosage of ceftriaxone sodium.

title_en: Self-assembled antibacterial peptide nanoparticles and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antibacterial peptide, in particular to self-assembled antibacterial peptide nanoparticles and application thereof. The antibacterial peptide provided by the invention has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The antibacterial peptide has broad-spectrum antibacterial activity and strong protease stability, can be self-assembled to form peptide nanoparticles, can resist the action of chymotrypsin and trypsin, can be applied to complex physiological environments in which protease exists, plays a role in treating bacterial infectious diseases, shows lower hemolytic activity at a concentration higher than MIC (minimal inhibitory concentration), and has good clinical application value.

title_en: anti-CEA antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: anti-CEA antibodies comprising a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, drug conjugates thereof, and compositions comprising the anti-CEA antibodies or drug conjugates thereof, and their use as pharmaceuticals are provided.

title_en: Formula for treating tumors by algal polysaccharide biological enzymolysis technology and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula for treating tumors by algal polysaccharide biological enzymolysis technology and a preparation method thereof, wherein the formula comprises the following components: comprises Ganoderma, Cordyceps militaris, Coicis semen, rhizoma Dioscoreae, herba Taraxaci, radix Angelicae sinensis, Atractylodis rhizoma, Prunellae Spica, Alismatis rhizoma, Scutellariae radix, radix rehmanniae, fructus Citri Sarcodactylis, fructus Lycii, rhizoma Phragmitis, Glycyrrhrizae radix, radix Angelicae sinensis, rhizoma Ligustici Chuanxiong, carapax et Plastrum Testudinis, rhizoma Polygonati, Glycyrrhrizae radix, radix Angelicae Dahuricae, semen litchi, radix Platycodi, fructus Gardeniae, semen Hoveniae, rhizoma Belamcandae, radix Arctii, flos Lonicerae, Glycyrrhrizae radix, endothelium corneum Gigeriae Galli, Cordyceps, herba Dendrobii, Ganoderma spore powder, and Cordyceps militaris; the invention aims to creatively combine various probiotics for improving the immunity of tumor patients and extracts of a compound of 'medicinal and edible traditional Chinese medicines' on the basis of inheriting the disease treatment method of the traditional Chinese medicine theory, and short peptides, amino acids, carbohydrates, grease with a health care function, various vitamins and various mineral substances are added as auxiliary materials, so that the invention not only can supplement nutrients necessary for the tumor patients with low immunity, but also can improve the nutritional status of organisms.

title_en: Application of circ _0001772 as colorectal cancer diagnosis and treatment marker
abstract_en: Screening circRNA which is differentially expressed in colorectal cancer and can be used as a potential diagnosis target from public database GEO circular RNA expression profile data; further by examining true pathological serological samples, it was determined that circRNA _0001772 (derived from the maternal gene RBM33) is low expressed in colorectal cancer; the colorectal cancer cell line with low-expression circRNA _0001772 verifies that the recovered circRNA _0001772 can inhibit the migration of tumor cells and can be used as a potential drug for treating colorectal cancer.

title_en: Dentin bonding pretreatment composition based on DMA (direct memory access) and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dentin bonding pretreatment composition based on DMA (methyl acryl dopamine, dopamine methacrylamide)) and application thereof. In the invention, DMA is used as an adhesive resin monomer, synchronous permeation with phosphoric acid in an acid etching agent can be realized, permeation filling of dentin acid etching ore removal and resin-based adhesive medium is realized integrally, polymerization can be formed by a free radical polymerization mode and adhesive components, dentin collagen structure stability can be effectively improved, degradation risks caused by exogenous mechanical stress, biochemistry and other factors of glue are reduced, and enzymolysis risks of an adhesive interface are reduced. The invention can realize acid etching, collagen crosslinking and adhesive resin permeation, can meet the use requirements of short clinical operation time, simplified steps and increased stability of oral cavity adhesive repair.

title_en: Methods of treating multiple myeloma
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods for treating multiple myeloma (e.g., refractory multiple myeloma or relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma) in an individual who has received at least two prior therapies for multiple myeloma. The method comprises administering to the individual an anti-CD 38 antibody, pomalidomide and dexamethasone. Methods of ameliorating renal damage in an individual having multiple myeloma are also provided.

title_en: Radiotherapy sensitizer of selenium-tellurium dumbbell-type heterostructure, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radiotherapy sensitizer of a selenium-tellurium dumbbell-type heterostructure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of using PVP, fructose and Na 2 TeO 3 Dissolving the raw materials in water to prepare the tellurium nanorods; taking the tellurium nano-rod, adding Tween80 and Na 2 SeO 3 And vitamin C, constant volumeStirring overnight, and dialyzing to obtain the selenium-tellurium dumbbell-type heterostructure. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple, the synthesis condition is mild, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the synthesized selenium/tellurium nano dumbbell-type heterostructure radiotherapy sensitizer has a stronger killing effect on tumor cells compared with the selenium/tellurium nano core-shell heterostructure radiotherapy sensitizer and X rays.

title_en: Photocurable composition having variable viscosity
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a photocurable composition comprising 20% to 90% (by weight) of a polymerizable core resin; 20% to 90% (by weight) of a diluent resin miscible with the core resin; and at least about 1% (by weight) of at least one rheology modifier different from the diluent resin. Rheology modifiers of the present disclosure include compounds that can form covalent bonds with the core resin or diluent resin and compounds having particle sizes from 1nm to 200 nm. The covalent bond-forming rheology modifier has at least one terminal functional group selected from the group consisting of: acrylates, methacrylates, epoxides, oxetanes, nitriles, olefins, and alkynes. In a preferred embodiment, tetrahydrofuran methacrylate, methacryloyl polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxanes (i.e., POSS) cages, and PEG POSS cages are used as rheology modifiers.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating infertility and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating infertility and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. A traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating infertility comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-15 parts of byssus purpurea, 5-15 parts of salvia miltiorrhiza, 3-10 parts of angelica, 5-15 parts of American ginseng, 5-10 parts of deerhorn glue, 5-15 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 3-8 parts of phyllanthus urinaria, 3-8 parts of tiger ginger and 5-15 parts of all-flower honey. The medicine prepared by the invention has the effects of tonifying kidney and qi, promoting blood circulation and enriching blood, warming channels and relieving pain, and tonifying qi and consolidating exterior, has obvious effects on infertility caused by female irregular menstruation, unsmooth qi and blood and deficiency of kidney yin, and has the effects of tonifying liver and kidney, tonifying yang and arresting seminal emission for male, so that the medicine can treat the infertility of male and female, has short treatment period, quick response, small toxic and side effects, high safety and obvious curative effect.

title_en: Synthetic method of chrysin bridged indole derivatives and application of chrysin bridged indole derivatives in anti-tumor direction
abstract_en: The invention provides a genistein derivative, which is shown as a formula (I), wherein R1, R2, R3, R4=CH or N. Compared with the prior art, the chrysin derivative provided by the invention has good growth inhibition effect on various tumor cells, and particularly has higher growth inhibition activity on five tumor cells, namely A549 cells, heLa cells, MCF-7 cells, SH-SY5Y cells and HepG2 cells when R1, R2, R3 = CH and R4 = N are 7-azaindole substituent groups.

title_en: Microparticles and nanoparticles having sulfate groups on the surface
abstract_en: The present invention provides polymer particles comprising a negative charge on the surface of the particle. Preferably, the particles comprise PLGA and sulphate polymers. The invention also provides polymer particles prepared by the process of the invention.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for benefiting qi, promoting production of body fluid and reducing blood sugar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for tonifying qi, promoting the production of body fluid and reducing blood sugar and a preparation method thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 3-8 parts of ginseng rootlets, 5-10 parts of asparagus cochinchinensis, 10-15 parts of poria cocos, 5-13 parts of wolfberry, 2-10 parts of radix ophiopogonis, 5-15 parts of trichosanthes roots, 15-30 parts of Chinese yams, 3-8 parts of glossy privet fruits, 2-6 parts of yerbadetajo herba ecliptae, 5-10 parts of salvia miltiorrhiza, 10-15 parts of longan aril, 10-20 parts of mulberries, 2-5 parts of radix puerariae, 5-10 parts of spina date seeds, 5-10 parts of leonurus, 5-10 parts of Chinese white olive (denucleated), 3-6 parts of lemons, 7-15 parts of mint, 3-10 parts of dendrobe, 4-10 parts of northern hawthorn fruits and 5-15 parts of green pears. The traditional Chinese medicine composition for tonifying qi, promoting the production of body fluid and reducing blood sugar can achieve the effect of treating both symptoms and root causes, has a good treatment effect on diabetes patients, and is simple in preparation process and easy to prepare.

title_en: Multispecific binding proteins
abstract_en: Provided herein are HLA-peptide targets and multispecific antigen-binding proteins that bind HLA-peptide targets. Provided herein are isolated multispecific antigen-binding proteins (ABPs) comprising: a first Antigen Binding Domain (ABD) that specifically binds to a Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) -peptide target; and an additional ABD that specifically binds an additional antigen, wherein the HLA-peptide target comprises an HLA-restricted peptide complexed to an HLA class I molecule, wherein the HLA-restricted peptide is located in a peptide binding groove of an α 1/α 2 heterodimer portion of the HLA class I molecule, and wherein the HLA-peptide target is selected from table a, table a1, or table a 2.

title_en: Formula granule of cudrania root and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula granule with a base source of curculigo acutifolia cudrania root and a preparation method thereof: step one: weighing a basic source of the curculina seed puncture Dan Yinpian, placing the curculina seed puncture Dan Yinpian into a container, adding 8-10 times of water, carrying out thermal reflux extraction for 1-3 h, filtering, adding 8-10 times of 50% ethanol into filter residues, extracting for 1-3 h, filtering, combining the two filtrates, and concentrating until the relative density is 1.25-1.35g/mL, wherein the basic source is the curculina seed puncture Dan Jingao; step two: mixing dextrin and the base source prepared in the first step with the thorn type puncture Dan Jingao uniformly, preparing into a soft material, sieving with a 24-mesh sieve, granulating, drying in an oven at 50-75 ℃ for 1-2 h, controlling the ambient humidity to be below 63%, and finishing. The base source prepared by the invention is the formula granule of the curculigo acutifolia cudrania, has good stability, high content of active ingredients and reasonable process design, and can realize industrial production.

title_en: Production process of stasis-removing phlegm-reducing decoction pieces based on calcined concha arcae
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of decoction pieces for removing blood stasis and reducing phlegm based on calcined concha arcae, belonging to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, wherein the calcined concha arcae is a monarch drug, is calcined and quenched by adopting an acetic acid solution and then is easily ground into powder, and the calcined concha arcae powder is more exquisite and is convenient to disperse after ball milling; the Ganoderma extract in the dry extract powder contains ganoderan, and has anticancer effect and can prevent inflammatory cell diseases; rhizoma gastrodiae has the effect of clearing and activating the channels and collaterals, dried orange peel has the effects of regulating qi, tonifying spleen, eliminating dampness and reducing phlegm, and the dried orange peel has fragrance, so that the decoction pieces are more tasty; the concentrated solution of fructus Eriobotryae has effects of moistening lung and relieving cough, and semen Armeniacae amarum also has effects of relieving cough and asthma; the liquorice has the effects of eliminating phlegm and relieving cough and harmonizing the medicines, the fried gardenia has the effects of cooling blood and detoxifying, reducing swelling and the like, the viscosity of the prepared honey refined medicinal powder is increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are further fried through refined honey, the disintegration time can be increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are pressed into tablets, and the action time of the medicine is prolonged.

title_en: Bicyclic derivatives for the treatment of endoparasites
abstract_en: The present invention provides compounds of formula (I):  It can be used for controlling endoparasites in warm-blooded animals, such as heartworm.

title_en: Cyclocarya paliurus compound preparation for preventing and treating diabetes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclocarya paliurus compound preparation for preventing and treating diabetes and a preparation method thereof, and particularly relates to the field of tea drinks, wherein cyclocarya paliurus tea is prepared from the following components: the preparation method comprises soaking fresh cyclocarya paliurus leaves, folium Mori, radix Puerariae and organic chromium in water for 2 times: adding 12 times of water for the first time, soaking for 1 hour at 80-90 ℃, and filtering to 200 meshes; adding 10 times of water for the 2 nd time, soaking for 1h at 80-90 ℃, and filtering by 200 meshes; mixing the two filtrates, and concentrating under reduced pressure to relative density of 1.10-1.15; s2, placing radix puerariae and folium mori in an extraction tank, adding water, and boiling and extracting for 2 times: adding 10 times of water for the first time, extracting at 100 deg.C for 1.5 hr, and filtering to 200 mesh; adding 8 times of water for the 2 nd time, extracting at 100 deg.C for 1.5 hr, and filtering to 200 mesh; combining the two filtrates, and concentrating under reduced pressure until the relative density is 1.10-1.15; s3, combining the two concentrated pastes, drying under reduced pressure until the water content is less than 5 percent to obtain an extract, crushing the extract, and sieving the crushed extract by a 60-mesh sieve; s4, mixing the extract with chromium-rich yeast, and filling capsules to obtain the product with a certain blood sugar reducing function.

title_en: Taxol nano particle, preparation method thereof, pharmaceutical composition thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paclitaxel nanoparticle, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition thereof and application thereof, wherein the paclitaxel nanoparticle is prepared by wrapping a Chek2 inhibitor with a paclitaxel polymer prodrug. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, covalently connecting paclitaxel on a side chain of an amphiphilic block polymer in a sulfur bond mode to form a paclitaxel high-molecular prodrug; then the taxol macromolecule prodrug is loaded with a Chek2 inhibitor in an amphiphilic self-assembly mode to form the taxol nanoparticle. The pharmaceutical composition comprises paclitaxel nanoparticles with effective dose for preventing or alleviating, and pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. Application of paclitaxel nanoparticles in preparing medicine for protecting ovarian injury caused by chemotherapy is provided. Compared with the method of singly using the taxol, the method can greatly enhance the tumor killing effect, effectively reduce the dosage of chemotherapy drugs reaching the ovary, inhibit the oocyte apoptosis caused by the taxol and furthest protect the ovarian function of a chemotherapy patient.

title_en: A composition containing Pulsatillae saponin B5 as effective component for promoting hair growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition for promoting hair growth, which contains pulsatilla saponin B5 as an effective component.
