Experiments show that the pulsatilla saponin B5 can promote the hair growth of a mouse unhairing area, improve the growth speed of the mouse unhairing area, increase the number of hair follicles, and has the advantages of no toxic or side effect, low cost and quick response. Therefore, the pulsatilla saponin B5 and preparation auxiliary materials can be used for preparing a composition or a medicament for promoting hair growth.

title_en: Soluble expression EG95 protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soluble expression EG95 protein and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the protein is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and is obtained by connecting a dissolution promoting tag through a flexible connector after an EG95 gene of echinococcosis caprae, the complete EG95 protein sequence is reserved, the immunogenicity of the original protein is reserved to the maximum extent, and the used dissolution promoting tag has little influence on the original protein, not only can effectively promote dissolution, but also can not influence nickel column purification or immunity and the like; compared with the complexity of inclusion body expression production process, the soluble expression simplifies the protein production process, improves the production efficiency, reduces the protein loss caused by a plurality of purification steps, and reduces the emission of ammonia nitrogen wastewater; the protein can be used as an antigen for preparing sheep echinococcosis genetic engineering subunit vaccine, and animal test results prove that the vaccine prepared from the protein has good immune efficacy and safety.

title_en: Preparation method of insulin aspart 30 suspension
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an insulin aspart 30 suspension, belonging to the field of pharmaceutical preparations. The method utilizes the stirring paddle with smaller shearing force to stir the mixture formed by the prescription of the insulin aspart at low speed instead of the prior standing crystallization method, such as anchor type paddles, propellers, frame type paddles and the like, the stirring speed is 40-80rpm, the stirring time is 12-18h, and finally the insulin aspart 30 suspension with quick and long effect is prepared. The insulin aspart suspension prepared by the invention has the advantages of small content of stored impurities, uniform and stable particle size, strong storage stability, simple preparation process, short preparation time and high repeatability, and is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, pharmaceutical composition and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly relates to a compound shown as a formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; the invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and application thereof; the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof can be used for preventing or treating cancers and inhibiting or killing tumor cells;

title_en: Composition for delaying aging, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, and provides a composition which comprises the following components: beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide, blood orange concentrate, and astaxanthin; the invention discovers that the beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide, the concentrated blood orange powder and the astaxanthin have the functions of synergizing and resisting aging, improving sleep, treating cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, recovering nerve health, resisting fatigue, whitening, resisting oxidation and resisting wrinkle.

title_en: Urapidil hydrochloride injection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medicines, and in particular relates to urapidil hydrochloride injection and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method provided by the application comprises the following steps: weighing injection water, cooling to below 30 ℃, vacuumizing and filling nitrogen, adding urapidil hydrochloride, a cosolvent and a buffer into the injection water, stirring until the urapidil hydrochloride, the cosolvent and the buffer are completely dissolved to obtain a first mixed solution, and ensuring that the temperature of the first mixed solution is lower than 30 ℃ in the stirring and dissolving process; adding injection water with the temperature lower than 30 ℃ into the first mixed solution to a constant volume, stirring until the mixture is uniformly mixed to obtain a second mixed solution, and ensuring that the temperature of the second mixed solution is lower than 30 ℃ in the stirring process; filtering the second mixed solution by a filter element to obtain filtrate; and filling nitrogen into the filtrate, encapsulating, sterilizing, cooling, performing lamp inspection and leak detection to obtain the urapidil hydrochloride injection.

title_en: Polyene acetylene compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to polyene acetylene compounds and a preparation method and application thereof. The polyene acetylene compound has a structure as shown in any one of formulas (I) to (V): the polyene acetylene compound has obvious effect of inhibiting differentiation on osteoclast induced by RANKL under 10 mu M, and does not show cytotoxicity.

title_en: Improved MRNA loaded lipid nanoparticles and methods of making same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an improved lipid nanoparticle formulation encapsulating mRNA comprising DEPE as a helper lipid.

title_en: Stem cell hydrogel, preparation method, cryopreservation method and recovery method
abstract_en: The invention provides a stem cell hydrogel and a preparation method, a cryopreservation method and a recovery method thereof, wherein the stem cell hydrogel is of a sheet structure, has the thickness of 1-2 mm, has tissue viscosity and form expandability, and comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a hydrogel template loaded with stem cells, preparing a hydrogel mould in a reverse mould mode, and preparing sheet-shaped stem cell hydrogel on the hydrogel mould; (2) preparing a proper cryoprotectant formula, and performing cryopreservation on the stem cell hydrogel; (3) and determining a proper thawing process to improve the survival rate of the stem cells in the hydrogel. The invention can maintain the vitality and the function of stem cells for a long time, and repair the large-size and unmatched-shape chronic wound by the combined use of a plurality of stem cell hydrogel patches.

title_en: Preparation method of moisture-resistant sorbitol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of moisture-resistant sorbitol. Pouring the auxiliary material additive and the purified water into a container, and stirring until the auxiliary material additive and the purified water are completely dissolved to form an aqueous solution of the additive; pouring sorbitol into a top-spraying granulating pan body, turning on a fluidized bed switch, and sequentially turning on a fan and heating; when the temperature is increased to 40-80 ℃, sequentially opening an atomizing valve and a peristaltic pump, and spraying the aqueous solution of the additive into the fluidized bed through an atomizer; after the injection is finished, closing the peristaltic pump and closing the atomizing valve in sequence; continuously working the fluidized bed for 10-50 min to obtain a finished product of the sorbitol; turning off the heating and turning off the fan; and after the sorbitol finished product is cooled to the room temperature, obtaining the moisture-resistant sorbitol. The water content of the sorbitol treated by the method is reduced by 74.43 percent on average; after 6 months of storage in a dry and ventilated place, the average reduction of the water content reaches 71.64%; after 12 months of storage in dry and ventilated places, the water content decreased to 74.74% on average. Greatly prolongs the industrial effectiveness of the powder.

title_en: Application of RNASE4 as drug target for treating and/or preventing diabetes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of RNASE4 as a drug target in developing or screening or preparing drugs for preventing and/or treating diabetes, which comprises the following properties: maintain islet size, promote islet beta cell proliferation, and promote plasma insulin levels. The diabetes is type 1 diabetes or type 2 diabetes.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating chronic nephrosis proteinuria and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine compositions, and in particular relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating chronic nephropathy proteinuria, and a preparation method and application thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition provided by the invention comprises the following components in parts by weight: 15 to 60 parts of astragalus, 5 to 50 parts of rhizoma polygonati, 5 to 50 parts of polygonatum, 5 to 30 parts of curcuma zedoary, 5 to 30 parts of paniculate swallowwort root, 5 to 30 parts of giant knotweed and 15 to 60 parts of centella. By optimizing the dosage relation of each component, the urine protein content of the chronic kidney disease patient can be obviously reduced, and the renal function of the patient is ensured to be less damaged during the medication period.

title_en: Use of DRP1 protein as marker for determining abnormal mitochondrion after microwave irradiation
abstract_en: The invention provides application of DRP1 protein as a marker for determining whether mitochondrial fission abnormality occurs after microwave radiation. After microwave irradiation, the expression level of DRP1 protein in mitochondria with mitochondrial fission abnormality is obviously up-regulated, so that whether mitochondrial fission abnormality occurs after microwave irradiation can be accurately determined by taking the DRP1 protein as a marker.

title_en: Gene editing delivery system, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a gene editing and delivering system, a preparation method and application thereof. The gene editing nano-delivery system of the present application comprises: the outer layer of the membrane fusion liposome and the inner core of the calcium precipitation hybrid gene editing plasmid; the outer layer of the membrane fusion liposome is coated on the surface of the calcium precipitation hybrid gene editing plasmid kernel. The application provides a method for realizing high-efficiency delivery of a gene editing system in cells through membrane fusion mediation, which can directly bypass an endocytic pathway so as to avoid the risk of lysosome degradation after endosome embedding, is hopeful to realize high-efficiency CRISPR/Cas9 plasmid delivery, and effectively solves the technical problem that the current gene editing system is difficult to deliver into cells; through modification and reconstruction of the nano-carrier and the CRISPR/Cas9 system, the precise gene editing treatment of liver related diseases such as hepatitis, liver cancer, liver failure, liver fibrosis and the like can be realized.

title_en: Cell penetrating peptide-sterol conjugate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell penetrating peptide-sterol conjugate and a preparation method thereof, wherein sterols are cholesterol, ergosterol, beta-sitosterol, stigmasterol and lanosterol, and the amino acid sequence of the cell penetrating peptide is autonomously designed and comprises CGYKK (cysteine-glycine-tyrosine-lysine), CGYRR (cysteine-glycine-tyrosine-arginine) and CGYYK (cysteine-glycine-tyrosine-lysine). The invention adopts Fmoc solid phase synthesis method to synthesize the cell penetrating peptide, the yield is high, and the synthesis speed is high; bromoacetic acid or pyridine acid and sterol are utilized to form an intermediate compound which is then connected with polypeptide chains, so that the product purity is high and impurities are few. The cell penetrating peptide-sterol conjugate as a lipid material is used in a nano drug delivery system, so that on one hand, the transfection efficiency of a nano carrier and cells can be improved, on the other hand, after transfection is completed and the cell enters the cell, the cell penetrating peptide-sterol conjugate can be degraded into sterol and amino acid by intracellular esterase, the sterol and the amino acid are all nutrients which can be utilized by cell growth, and the cytotoxicity is low. In addition, the sterol parent nucleus with different biological activities can endow corresponding conjugates with different functions, so that the novel lipid material has wide application prospects in the fields of biological medicines, health-care products and cosmetics.

title_en: Product with scald relieving and oxidation resisting capabilities and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a product with scalding alleviating and oxidation resisting capabilities and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of skin repair. The essence formula of the repair mask is prepared from honey, carboxymethyl chitosan, vitamin C and injection water; the product for relieving scald and oxidation resistance is mainly used for face care after laser beauty operation, particularly has obvious relieving effect on red swelling and hot pain of the face after laser beauty operation, has the effect of promoting the repair of damaged skin, and is safe and effective.

title_en: Novel compounds inhibiting histone acetyltransferase p300 and anti-fibrotic compositions thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel compound capable of forming an additional hydrogen bond with a specific amino acid position of Histone Acetyltransferase (HAT) p300 by structural analysis of HAT p 300. The novel compound of the present invention has an excellent inhibitory effect on HAT p300 activity and thus can be very effectively used for preventing, ameliorating or treating fibrotic diseases associated with HAT p300 activation.

title_en: Application of ganoderma lucidum in preparation of anti-novel coronavirus product
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of ganoderma lucidum in preparing a product for treating novel coronavirus resistance, the prepared ganoderma lucidum product has the effects of replenishing qi and blood, calming the mind, strengthening the spleen and stomach and resisting viruses, the preparation method of the ganoderma lucidum product is simple, the ganoderma lucidum product can be popularized in a large scale, and the ganoderma lucidum product prepared by the invention has an obvious effect of resisting the novel coronavirus and no side effect.

title_en: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens WF2020 strain product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacillus amyloliquefaciens WF2020 strain product and application thereof. The bacillus amyloliquefaciens WF2020 strain with the functions of resisting oxidation, prolonging service life, resisting aging, promoting growth and development and resisting bacterial infection is obtained by separation, and is preserved in the microorganism strain preservation center of Guangdong province in 2022 1 month 5 days, and the preservation number is GDMCC No:62190. the research of the invention shows that the WF2020 strain can improve the antioxidation capability of caenorhabditis elegans, reduce oxidative damage, prolong the service life of caenorhabditis elegans, increase the body length of nematodes, improve the running power of nematodes, reduce fat accumulation and mitochondrial damage, not influence the reproductive capacity of nematodes, have no toxic or side effect on the safety of nematodes, and have the effect of resisting pathogenic bacteria infection, and can be used for preparing or developing products for resisting oxidization, resisting aging, prolonging the service life, promoting the growth and development and resisting bacterial infection of animals.

title_en: PRCP kit acting on SARS-Cov-2 induced acute lung injury
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biotechnology, in particular to a PRCP kit acting on SARS-Cov-2 induced acute lung injury. The invention constructs a mouse model of SARS-CoV-2 induced ALI by using Vero E6 cell strain capable of expressing SARS-CoV-2 protein (the sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO: 1), intervenes by using slow virus particles with high expression PRCP by tail vein injection and atomizing PRCP proteins with different concentrations, finds out a better administration mode of PRCP for inhibiting SARS-CoV-2 induced ALI by observing the difference of pulmonary elasticity change, lung injury score, dry and wet weight of lung tissue and lung tissue pathology of mice in a control group and different intervention groups, and prepares a corresponding kit.

title_en: Nano aluminium preparation and novel inactivated coronavirus vaccine prepared from same
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano aluminum preparation and a novel coronavirus inactivated vaccine prepared from the nano aluminum preparation. The invention firstly provides a nano aluminum preparation used as a vaccine adjuvant, which is prepared from aluminum hydroxide and carboxymethyl glucan, wherein the mass ratio of the aluminum hydroxide to the carboxymethyl glucan is (20-29): 7-11; the particle size of the nano aluminum preparation is 200-500nm, and the PDI is less than 0.6. The invention also provides a composite adjuvant for vaccines, which comprises the nano-aluminum preparation and CpG ODN. The invention also provides a vaccine comprising the adjuvant.

title_en: Steam sterilization of hydrogels crosslinked by beta-elimination of linkers
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for steam sterilization of hydrogels crosslinked by beta-elimination of linkers without the disadvantage of significant degradation.

title_en: Self-emulsifying functional oil phase and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-emulsifying functional oil phase and a preparation method thereof. The oil phase comprises grease with skin care effect and grease with emulsification effect. The self-emulsifying functional oil phase has the effects of repairing skin, effectively resisting oxidation and various problems of skin, has strong water locking property, is capable of relieving and moisturizing, is convenient for the performance of functional components in the product to be exerted, remarkably increases the efficacy of the product, and has high safety. The oil phase has the emulsification function, is convenient to use, is simple to operate, has wide compatibility, can be matched with various water phase components for use, and is easy to popularize. The preparation method is specially used for preparing oil-in-water emulsified products such as functional emulsion, cream and the like aiming at skin problems.

title_en: Application of marsdenia tenacissima glycoside G in preparation of medicine for preventing and/or treating osteoarthritis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of marsdenia tenacissima glycoside G in preparation of a medicine for preventing and/or treating osteoarthritis, belonging to the technical field of preparation of medicines for preventing osteoarthritis. The invention compares the morphology of the tibia subchondral bone of the right knee joint of a mouse, the data of Micro-CT of the knee joint of the mouse, a dyeing result and OARSI scoring by setting a pseudo-operation control group and a DMM control group, detects the inflammatory factor expression in primary chondrocytes of the mouse and the condition of II type collagen in the primary chondrocytes, and evaluates the treatment effect of the marsdenin G on osteoarthritis.

title_en: Application of marker LGSN for identifying gastric cancer stem cells as gastric cancer diagnosis and treatment target
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a marker LGSN for identifying gastric cancer stem cells as a gastric cancer diagnosis and treatment target, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The inventor discovers a novel gastric cancer stem cell marker LGSN which is remarkably and highly expressed in gastric cancer tissues and gastric cancer stem cells and is related to the survival time of poor prognosis of gastric cancer patients. In one aspect, the invention provides the use of a reagent for detecting the expression level of an LGSN gene and/or a protein encoded thereby in the preparation of a diagnostic reagent or diagnostic kit for gastric cancer. In another aspect, the invention provides the use of an agent that reduces or inhibits the expression of the LGSN gene and/or protein encoded thereby in the preparation of a pharmaceutical composition for the treatment of gastric cancer. The inhibition of LGSN expression can trigger pyrosis, cause gastric cancer stem cell growth inhibition and in-vivo tumor formation, and further increase the sensitivity of chemotherapeutic drugs.

title_en: Method for screening morphine-tolerance-relieving drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for screening morphine-tolerance-relieving drugs, which adopts TRPC5 protein targets as screening conditions, and screens and obtains TRPC5 agonists as morphine-tolerance-relieving drugs. The invention confirms the direct association of the TRPC5 protein target and the opioid tolerance, effectively relieves the morphine tolerance by utilizing the TRPC5 protein agonist, creates a new target for opioid tolerance treatment, and provides convenience for screening and relieving the morphine tolerance medicine. The co-administration of the TRPC5 protein agonist and morphine can relieve morphine tolerance, which suggests that the TRPC5 protein agonist and opioid can form an analgesic composition together, and the tolerance problem of the traditional opioid analgesic is solved.

title_en: Processing device and method for stir-fried radix codonopsis with elecampane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for processing radix codonopsis fried with costustoot, and the technical scheme of the device for processing the radix codonopsis fried with incense has the key points that: the device comprises a placing plate, wherein a heating hole is formed in the top surface of the placing plate, and a miniature gas furnace is fixedly connected inside the heating hole; the placing barrel is arranged on the top surface of the micro gas furnace, and the interior of the placing barrel is movably sleeved on the pressing plate; the adjusting assembly is arranged on the top surface of the interior of the placing barrel and used for adjusting the position of the pressing plate; the filter component, the filter component sets up press the top surface of clamp plate for filter the aucklandia root, the protection network can carry out the secondary filter to pouring into and deposit the inside liquid medicine of bucket, can avoid depositing the outside debris of bucket simultaneously and drop into the inside of depositing the bucket, and the staff smoothes moist to the liquid medicine is whole to absorb the back with the codonopsis pilosula after clean with liquid medicine this moment, goes into the pot again and fries dry with slow fire and can obtain the radix codonopsis of aucklandia root stir-fry, thereby the staff of being convenient for is concocted the radix codonopsis of aucklandia root and is fried the radix codonopsis.

title_en: Application of compound in preparing anti-inflammatory, analgesic and antipyretic medicine
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a compound in preparing anti-inflammatory, analgesic and antipyretic medicines. The compound is N- [ (2-methoxyphenyl) methyl ] -2- [4- (4-methoxyphenyl) -2-oxobenzopyran-7-yl ] oxyacetamide, and pharmacological experiments prove that the compound has the effects of resisting inflammation, relieving pain and relieving heat, and the activity is obviously superior to that of the common clinical medicine aspirin. The compound of the application is used for developing anti-inflammatory, analgesic and antipyretic drugs, and can expand the selectable range of clinical drugs.

title_en: Application of N-substituted phenyl-2-pyridone compounds or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof in treating pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: An application of N-substituted phenyl-2-pyridone compounds or medicinal salts thereof in the treatment of pulmonary fibrosis belongs to the technical field of medicines. The invention provides the application of the compounds in the treatment of pulmonary fibrosis, delays the progress of pulmonary fibrosis, has better effect of preventing and treating pulmonary fibrosis and better safety. Compared with clinical first-line pulmonary fibrosis resistant medicament pirfenidone, the medicament provided by the invention has better pulmonary fibrosis resistant curative effect, is expected to be developed into a high-efficiency medicament for treating pulmonary fibrosis, and provides better medicament selection for preventing and treating pulmonary fibrosis.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for treating Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), in particular, the invention relates to small interfering rna (siRNA) molecules directed against SOD1 gene, adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors encoding siRNA molecules, and methods of treating Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) using the siRNA molecules and AAV vectors.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for gout and uric acid elevation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for gout and uric acid altitude, a preparation method and application thereof, and the raw materials of the pharmaceutical composition comprise: astragalus root, poria cocos, coix seed, lysimachia christinae hance, chinese angelica, nutgrass flatsedge rhizome, rhizoma atractylodis, ligusticum wallichii, rhizoma corydalis, mulberry twig, dried rehmannia root, phellodendron bark, cinnamon, cassia twig, ground beetle, large-leaf gentian root, achyranthes root, rhizoma arisaematis, asarum and paris polyphylla. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the composition. The method comprises the following steps: weighing the raw materials according to a certain proportion, respectively cleaning, grinding and crushing, then putting all the ground and crushed medicines into a container, mixing, adding water for soaking, heating for decoction, filtering to remove residues to obtain a liquid medicine, and finally cooling. The composition can be used for preparing oral preparation and topical fumigation preparation for treating gout and uric acid height. The pharmaceutical composition provided by the invention is characterized in that the traditional Chinese medicine is used for treating gout impurity symptoms in a targeted manner, and has the advantages of excellent curative effect, quick response, no side effect and the like in the using process.

title_en: Pharmaceutical compositions and methods for indoleamine 2, 3-dioxygenase inhibition and indications therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pharmaceutical compositions and methods for indoleamine 2, 3-dioxygenase inhibition and indications therefor, and is useful in the treatment of cancer and other diseases.

title_en: Medicine capable of inhibiting helicobacter pylori and improving liver and thyroid gland injuries
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicine capable of inhibiting helicobacter pylori and improving liver and thyroid gland injuries, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1-10 parts of white hyacinth beans, 1-10 parts of kudzu roots, 2-13 parts of clove, 2-16 parts of long pepper, 2-15 parts of liquorice, 2-16 parts of dandelion roots and 2-15 parts of Chinese torreya. Also comprises a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition provided by the invention utilizes the effect of mutual coordination of medicines according to the channel tropism principle of traditional Chinese medicines, and the compatibility of medicines has the effects of nourishing the stomach, inhibiting helicobacter pylori in the stomach, and simultaneously has the rehabilitation effect on liver injury and thyroid diseases.

title_en: Vibrio alginolyticus phage vB _ ValS _ R15Z and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibrio alginolyticus phage vB _ ValS _ R15Z and application thereof. The Vibrio alginolyticus phage vB _ ValS _ R15Z has a preservation number of GDMCC No: 62170-B1. The vibrio alginolyticus phage vB _ ValS _ R15Z provided by the invention is a new lytic virus and is used for algicidal algaeVibrio pathogenic strain ATCC17749 T Has specific and obvious killing effect. In addition, virulence factor genes and drug resistance genes are not detected in the phage genome, which shows that the phage can not enhance the host toxicity strength and can not cause drug resistance pollution of the surrounding water environment, and the safety is high, and the environment is friendly, so the vibrio alginolyticus phage vB _ ValS _ R15Z can be completely used for preventing and treating vibrio alginolyticus diseases of aquatic products.

title_en: Application of ENPP2 gene or protein in regulation and control of colorectal cancer cells
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of ENPP2 genes or proteins in regulating colorectal cancer cells, wherein the expression of the ENPP2 genes or proteins promotes proliferation and growth of colorectal cancer cells HT 29 and HCT116 and the formation capacity of cell colonies; therefore, the expression of ENPP2 genes or proteins in colorectal cancer cells HT 29 and HCT116 can be inhibited, so that proliferation and growth of the colorectal cancer cells HT 29 and the colorectal cancer cells HCT116 and formation capacity of cell colonies can be inhibited, the purpose of inhibiting colorectal cancer can be achieved, and the method has important significance in research and development of colorectal cancer small molecule targeted drugs.

title_en: 4-methoxyphenyl-1, 3-diamine derivatives containing 1-methyl-1H-indole structure and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 4-methoxyphenyl-1, 3-diamine derivative containing a 1-methyl-1H-indole structure and application thereof. Has a structural general formula shown as (I). The 4-methoxyphenyl-1, 3-diamine derivative containing 1-methyl-1H-indole structure and the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof are reversible inhibitors of EGFR kinase, are compounds with inhibiting effect on tumor cells with variation of EGFR tyrosine kinase, and can be used for treating tumor diseases caused by EGFR tyrosine kinaseTreatment, combination treatment or prevention of various cancers.

title_en: Aromatic heterocyclic compound, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound with a brand new structure (shown as a formula I) serving as a TLR7 activator, a preparation method of the compound and application of the compound in treating diseases mediated by the TLR7 activator. The compound designed by the invention has novel structure and provides a new direction for the development of TLR7 agonist medicaments. Research on the agonistic activity of the human acceptor TLR7 shows that the compounds have stronger agonistic effect on the human acceptor TLR7Can be used as a prospect compound for treating diseases mediated by TLR7 agonists. In addition, the invention researches a specific synthesis method, and the synthesis method has simple process and convenient operation, and is beneficial to large-scale industrial production and application.

title_en: Cordyceps militaris bioactive peptide, separation method and application thereof, and polypeptide oral liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological extraction, and provides cordyceps militaris bioactive peptide, a separation method and application thereof, and a polypeptide oral liquid. The invention adopts an ultrasonic extraction method to extract protein from cordyceps militaris sporocarp, improves the extraction rate of the protein by controlling the ultrasonic extraction conditions, adopts complex enzyme to carry out enzymolysis on the protein after obtaining cordyceps militaris crude protein, controls the enzymolysis conditions, improves the hydrolysis degree of the protein and the polypeptide yield, and obtains the polypeptide with concentrated peptide segment molecular weight and easy collection. The results of the examples show that the polypeptide yield of the method provided by the invention reaches 134.30mg/g, and the obtained cordyceps militaris bioactive peptide has high antibacterial activity and antioxidant activity, also has certain anticancer activity, and has wide application prospects in foods, health-care products and antitumor drugs. The invention also provides the cordyceps militaris polypeptide oral liquid which has good taste and balanced nutrition and has great development potential in the beverage market.

title_en: Compound for target ubiquitination degradation of TRK and preparation method, composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly relates to a compound for target ubiquitination and TRK degradation, and a preparation method, a composition and an application thereof, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula I-a or a formula I-b: ，R  1  and R  2  Represents hydrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, unsubstituted C  1‑4  Alkyl, substituted C  1‑4  Alkyl, unsubstituted C  1‑4  Alkoxy, substituted C  1‑4  Alkoxy, unsubstituted C  1‑4  Alkylthio, substituted C  1‑4  Alkylthio, unsubstituted C  1‑4  Alkylamino or substituted C  1‑4  An alkylamino group; m represents carbon, nitrogen, oxygen or sulfur; q  1  、Q  2  And Q  3  Represents carbon or nitrogen; w is a group of  1  Represents carbon or nitrogen; r is  3  Represents hydrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine, aldehyde group, carboxyl, hydroxyl, amino, sulfydryl or unsubstituted C  1‑4  Alkyl, substituted C  1‑4  Alkyl, aryl, heteroaryl, and heteroaryl, 、 、 Or (ii) a L represents (ii) a D represents 、 、 Or . The compound provided by the invention can realize TRK induced degradation.

title_en: Oleanolic acid derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oleanolic acid derivative and a preparation method and application thereof. The HDAC inhibitor synthesized based on oleanolic acid is designed, and partial compounds in the screened compounds have inhibitory activity and hematological tumor cytotoxicity on HDACs of Hela nuclear protein, and have lower normal cytotoxicity and higher anti-tumor selectivity compared with the marketed drug vorinostat (SAHA).

title_en: anti-GITR antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present application describes anti-GITR antibodies and antigen-binding fragments thereof. Nucleic acids encoding these antibodies, compositions comprising these antibodies, methods of producing these antibodies, and methods of using these antibodies for treating or preventing diseases such as cancer are also described.

title_en: Algin lyase AlyG2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to alginate lyase AlyG2 (molecular weight 34.51kDa) cloned from marine bacterium Seonanhaecolialgicola Gy 8. AlyG2 belongs to the family of polysaccharide lyase 7, which has optimal activity at 45 deg.C and pH 8.6, exhibits remarkable salt and alkali tolerance, is stable between 0.0-3.0M NaCl, has remarkable effect on the biofilm of Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and can be used for removing or inhibiting the biofilm produced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

title_en: Targeting-drug based on IgG1-Fc structural domain of antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protein drug conjugate based on an antibody IgG1-Fc structural domain, a preparation method and application. The conjugate comprises a small molecule targeting ligand, a toxic drug warhead and an Fc domain protein of IgG1, and the protein drug conjugate capable of being targeted by tumor is formed by coupling the ligand and the drug warhead on the N end of the Fc protein. The invention discloses a structure, a preparation method and a therapeutic application of an Fc protein drug conjugate. The invention fuses SMDC and an antibody Fc domain to obtain an eADC (antibody-drug conjugate) similar to the antibody drug conjugate structure. The natural pharmacokinetic advantage of antibody molecules is utilized to make up for the defect of short half-life of the small molecule drug conjugate, and the advantages are taken to make up for the disadvantages, so that the effect of 1+1>2 is realized.

title_en: Pterostilbene N-phenylamide compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pterostilbene N-phenyl amide compound and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical chemistry, wherein a series of pterostilbene amide compounds with novel structures are designed and synthesized, and the structures of the compounds are characterized; the method for preparing the compounds has the characteristics of easily obtained raw materials, simple and convenient operation and high yield, and can quickly synthesize the target compounds; the anti-inflammatory activity of the compounds is tested at the same time, and the compounds with high activity are screened out to be used for developing novel anti-inflammatory drugs.

title_en: New target of lncRNAXIST for hepatocyte insulin resistance and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and relates to application of lncRNA XIST as a hepatocyte insulin resistance treatment target, wherein LncRNA XIST regulates a PI3K/Akt signal path, and the PI3K/Akt signal path is a key factor in insulin-related metabolic reaction, and can regulate glucose transport, lipolysis resistance, fatty acid synthesis and glycogen synthesis. Therefore, lncRNA XIST is likely to regulate the expression of G6Pase and PEPCK and PI3K/Akt signaling pathway regulates hepatocyte IR.

title_en: Medicine for treating atherosclerosis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a medicine for treating atherosclerosis. The drug of the invention is a glucan-based nanogel loaded with an active ingredient, wherein the glucan-based nanogel is a nanogel formed by glucan, and the active ingredient comprises one or a combination of anti-inflammatory drugs and cyclodextrin compounds. Experiments prove that compared with medicines prepared from other carriers, the medicine has good active targeting property, has good therapeutic effect on atherosclerosis, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Skull light transparent reagent and method for long-term observation of cerebral cortex
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a skull light transparent reagent and a method for long-term observation of cerebral cortex, wherein the reagent comprises the following components: alcohol solution of amide organic compounds and derivatives thereof with the mass fraction of 25-30%; an anionic surfactant aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 15-20%; and (4) ultraviolet light curing glue. According to the embodiment of the invention, the long-term transparent skull light transparent window can be obtained by dropwise adding the alcoholic solution of the amide organic compound and the derivative thereof with the mass fraction of 25-30%, the anionic surfactant aqueous solution with the mass fraction of 15-20% and the ultraviolet light curing adhesive on the surface of the skull in sequence and carrying out single treatment, and the skull light transparent window can be used for an optical microscopic imaging system to carry out imaging, establishes a nondestructive, long-term and noninvasive transparent skull window, realizes high-resolution imaging of a cortical vascular network, is simple to operate, has high imaging quality, and can be used for long-term observation.

title_en: Multifunctional mulberry silk collagen and application thereof in biomedical materials
abstract_en: The invention provides multifunctional mulberry silk glue protein and application thereof in biomedical materials. The multifunctional mulberry silk fibroin is prepared by adopting the following method: feeding mulberry silkworms with mulberry leaves with quercetin suspension applied to the surfaces, and removing silkworm pupas from silkworm cocoons obtained by spinning the mulberry silkworms to obtain cocoon shells; separating sericin from cocoon shells to obtain the multifunctional mulberry silk sericin. The multifunctional mulberry silk fibroin has good oxidation resistance and ultraviolet absorption performance, can emit bright yellow-green light under the excitation of laser with the wavelength of 365nm, and has high-intensity fluorescence performance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of lyase, coding gene, composition and bacteriostatic agent
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of molecular biology, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of lyase, a coding gene, a composition, a bacteriostatic agent. A staphylococcal bacteriophage lyase PB50 has an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. A gene encoding the staphylococcal lyase PB50 of claim 1, the gene sequence being represented by SEQ ID No. 2. The lyase can rapidly cleave staphylococcus, has strong heterologous expression solubility and less inclusion bodies.

title_en: Quinorubicin salts and polymorphs, quinorubicin salts and polymorphs, useful in the treatment of diseases
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are novel quinomycin salts and polymorphs useful in the treatment of diseases caused by bacterial and certain protozoal infections, including, for example, malaria, babesiosis, toxoplasmosis, diarrhea, respiratory diseases, sexually transmitted bacterial infections, and some bioterrorism bacteria, including, for example, plague, tularemia, and post-inhalation anthrax. Also disclosed herein are novel quinomycin salts and polymorphs useful in the treatment of inflammatory diseases including, for example, pelvic inflammatory disease and peptic ulcer disease.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating arthritis and lozenge thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating rheumatic diseases and a lozenge thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition comprises fructus Psoraleae, cortex Erythrinae, cortex Phellodendri, fructus Gardeniae, and caulis Spatholobi. The traditional Chinese medicine composition and the preparation thereof can improve the pathological state of knee joint cartilage of the model of New Zealand rabbits, improve inflammatory response caused by arthritis and reduce the content level of IL-1 beta and IL-6 in joint fluid of the New Zealand rabbits; through clinical case analysis, the total effective rate of the traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating knee arthritis is 96.43%, and the obvious effective cure rate is 85.71%.

title_en: Use method of amino-containing insoluble polymer as precise load
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a using method of an amino-containing indissolvable polymer as an accurate load, which is related to the technical field of amino-containing indissolvable polymer carriersThe state is directly used, and the scheme can prepare NH-R-CO from biomedical NH-R (such as chitosan, type I collagen, polypeptide materials and the like)  2  Other substances are loaded, and the biological medical material can be directly used as a liquid biological compatible biological medical material without treatment, so that the precise loading and slow release of the medicine are realized, and the development of the amino-containing insoluble polymer compound is facilitated.

title_en: Stable immediate release tablet and capsule formulations of 1- ((2S,5R) -5- ((7H-pyrrolo [2,3-D ] pyrimidin-4-yl) amino) -2-methylpiperidin-1-yl) prop-2-en-1-one
abstract_en: The present invention relates to 1- ((2S,5R) -5- ((7H-pyrrolo [2, 3-d) inhibitors of Janus kinase 3(JAK3) having structure (I)]Novel stable immediate release tablet and capsule formulations of pyrimidin-4-yl) amino) -2-methylpiperidin-1-yl) prop-2-en-1-one p-toluenesulfonate

title_en: Application of lycorine in preventing and treating GCRV infection
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of lycorine in preventing and treating grass carp reovirus (Grass carp reovirus, GCRV) infection. The establishment of a cell infection model shows that lycorine can play a remarkable role in protecting a cell line infected with GCRV, and the result of a qPCR experiment shows that the transcription level of the GCRV virus-related gene is remarkably inhibited after the lycorine is treated, and the transcription level of the virus-induced immune-related gene is recovered to be normal. Therefore, lycorine can be used as a drug or additive for preventing and treating fish GCRV infection, and has the advantages of small dosage and good protection effect.

title_en: Blood-nourishing hair-growing pharmaceutical composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood-nourishing and hair-growing pharmaceutical composition which is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 200-250 parts of prepared rehmannia root, 150-200 parts of prepared fleece-flower root, 50-80 parts of Chinese angelica, 30-50 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome, 100-120 parts of cortex acanthopanacis, 30-50 parts of tall gastrodia tuber, 30-60 parts of white paeony root and 40-60 parts of mulberry. The blood-nourishing hair-growing medicinal composition adopts Chinese traditional medicinal materials with dual purposes of medicine and food, has easily available raw material sources and small dosage. The invention has the advantages of comprehensive consideration, safety, effectiveness, high consumer acceptance and the like in treating alopecia, and has good prospect in the aspect of blood-nourishing biochemical products.

title_en: Intelligent microneedle patch with mathematical simulation optimized shading and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine technology, mathematics and engineering, in particular to an intelligent microneedle patch for optimizing shading by mathematical simulation and a preparation method thereof. The surface of the microneedle mould is provided with a shading, microneedles are arranged on the shading, wherein the shading equation is in accordance with a trigonometric function, a binomial expansion function or a normal distribution function, and the microneedles comprise sampling microneedles made of cross-linked polymers and drug delivery microneedles made of non-cross-linked polymers. The patch of the invention can efficiently and accurately collect the biomarkers in the mucosal surface and the deep tissue fluid, and can rapidly and simply deliver the loaded drugs to the mucosal surface and the deep mucosal tissue.

title_en: High-photosensitivity fluorescent probe for photodynamic diagnosis and treatment of ovarian cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel high-photosensitivity fluorescent probe for integrated photodynamic diagnosis and treatment of ovarian cancer, and a preparation method and application thereof. The high-photosensitivity fluorescent probe has larger Stokes displacement, and can avoid the interference of some biological autofluorescence; the high-photosensitivity fluorescent probe can be combined with a novel biomarker lysophosphatidic acid of ovarian cancer, so that the selective imaging of ovarian cancer cells is realized. The probe has high photosensitivity, and can generate ROS under the illumination of low power density so as to selectively induce apoptosis of ovarian cancer cells; meanwhile, the probe can show strong fluorescence in apoptotic cells, is beneficial to evaluating the treatment effect by monitoring the apoptosis condition in treatment, and avoids oversherapy. The fluorescent probe with high photosensitivity also has the advantages of small volume, high labeling specificity, simple and convenient preparation, easy quality control and the like.

title_en: Cyclic peptide compound extracted from sponge and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclic peptide compound extracted from sponge, the structure of which is selected from one of the following compounds 1-4: the invention also provides application of the cyclic peptide compound in preparation of antitumor drugs. The cyclic peptide compound has stronger growth inhibition activity on human lung cancer cells NCI-H460. Hair brushTherefore, the compound provides a new lead compound for researching and developing new anti-tumor drugs and provides scientific basis for developing and utilizing marine medicinal resources in China.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating eczema scrotum
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating eczema of scrotum, which is prepared from the following traditional Chinese medicines: sweet wormwood, baical skullcap root, lophatherum gracile, ricepaperplant pith, dried rehmannia root, indian buead, natural indigo, talcum and liquoric root. The traditional Chinese medicine composition disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high itch relieving rate and low recurrence rate on eczema scrotum, fresh adverse reaction, and can be used for external treatment by being matched with scrotum wet dressing and LED green light irradiation, so that the traditional Chinese medicine composition can dispel the channel qi of damp-heat of liver and gallbladder, astringe and excrete dampness, guide evil out and promote local skin injury healing.

title_en: Method for preparing porous magnetic/temperature-sensitive microspheres by micro-fluidic method, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing porous magnetic/temperature-sensitive microspheres by micro-fluidic control, and a product and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of porous magnetic microspheres. The invention discloses a method for preparing porous magnetic/temperature-sensitive microspheres by microfluidics, which mainly comprises the steps of preparing monodisperse monomer liquid drops by a dispersed phase solution and a continuous phase solution through a focusing microfluidic channel, and curing by an ultraviolet lamp to obtain the porous magnetic/temperature-sensitive microspheres. The micro-fluidic preparation technology adopted by the preparation method can realize the control of the particle size and the distribution of the microspheres, and the prepared microspheres have uniform particle size distribution, thereby facilitating the subsequent application in the fields of biological analysis and the like. The preparation method of the invention not only can realize the control of the grain diameter and the appearance of the microsphere carrier, but also can realize the high-efficiency and controllable synthesis of the microsphere grains with high flux; in addition, the method can integrate different functionalities by introducing functional nanoparticles such as magnetic nanoparticles and temperature-sensitive monomers, thereby having potential application prospects in different fields such as magnetic separation, targeted transportation, drug controlled release and the like.

title_en: Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR), compositions, and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods relating to Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) polypeptides, and methods relating thereto. In one embodiment, the invention relates to an engineered cell having chimeric antigen receptor polypeptides directed against at least two targets. In another embodiment, the invention relates to an engineered cell having a chimeric antigen receptor polypeptide and an enhancer moiety.

title_en: Antibacterial and anti-inflammatory toothpaste containing bamboo leaf flavone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toothpaste containing bamboo leaf flavone and having the functions of bacteriostasis and anti-inflammation and no irritation to skin and mucous membrane and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of daily cosmetics. The bamboo leaf flavone toothpaste of the invention comprises the following raw materials: bamboo leaf flavone, disodium dihydrogen pyrophosphate, silicon dioxide, isopropyl myristate, polydimethylsiloxane, sucrose stearate, liquid paraffin, glycerol, sodium benzoate, ethylene glycol oligomer, xanthan gum and a proper amount of water. The ethylene glycol oligomer used in the invention can completely dissolve the bamboo leaf flavone to form a dark brown clear liquid with bamboo leaf faint scent, so that the content of the bamboo leaf flavone in the toothpaste is greatly improved, thereby effectively killing oral bacteria, and achieving the effects of preventing oral problems and removing oral peculiar smell. In addition, the invention has simple preparation process, wide applicable population and no adverse reaction.

title_en: Diphenylalkane compound and preparation method, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to a diphenylalkane compound, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and particularly discloses a diphenylalkane compound shown as a formula (I) and 1-fluoro-3-methoxy-5-phenethyl benzene (II), a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicines for preventing or treating metabolic syndrome. The compound has obvious antimetabolite syndrome effect, and can be applied to the clinical treatment of antimetabolite syndrome in the form of monomer or medicinal composition.

title_en: Synthesis method of naloxone hydrochloride and application of naloxone hydrochloride in compound tiridine hydrochloride sustained-release preparation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of naloxone hydrochloride and application thereof in a compound tilidine hydrochloride sustained-release preparation, and relates to the field of drug synthesis, wherein the synthesis method comprises the steps of reacting a compound I with chloroformic acid-1-chloroethyl ester, adding hydrobromic acid for reaction, then reacting with halopropene, and finally carrying out salt forming reaction to obtain naloxone hydrochloride; the application is to take the synthesized naloxone hydrochloride as a raw material to prepare the compound tillidine hydrochloride sustained-release preparation. The invention takes the compound I obtained by oxidation, hydrogenation and acylation of thebaine as a raw material, directly reacts with chloroformic acid-1-chloroethyl ester, and then hydrobromic acid is added for reaction to obtain the compound II, and the three reactions of cyanidation, demethoxylation and hydrolysis are not needed, so that the reaction steps are shortened, no side reaction occurs in the reaction process of the step, and the reaction yield is effectively improved.

title_en: Aptamer specifically combined with alpha-conotoxin MI and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedical engineering, and provides an aptamer specifically combined with alpha-conotoxin MI (CTX-MI) and application thereof. The sequence general formula of the aptamer is 5'-ATTGGCACTCCACGCATAGG-N  40  -CCTATGCGTGCTACCGTGAA-3', wherein N is any one of A, T, G, C deoxyribonucleotides, 40 represents the number of random nucleotides, preferably a sequence shown in any one of SEQ ID NOs.1-SEQ ID NOs.6, most preferably a sequence shown in any one of SEQ ID NOs.7-SEQ ID NOs.9, and the aptamer can be prepared into CTX-MI separation enrichment reagents, purification reagents, antagonists or neutralizing agents, and can also be used for preparing CTX-MI detection reagents, detection kits or detection sensors, and can be applied to detection of CTX-MI in water samples, so that the aptamer can also lay a foundation for preparation of medicines for preventing or treating CTX-MI poisoning and removal of CTX-MI in water or aquatic products.

title_en: Photochromic orthodontic bracket adhesive and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photochromic orthodontic bracket adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photochromic orthodontic bracket adhesive comprises the following components: commercial resin modified glass ion bracket adhesive powder, liquid and photochromic material; the adding mass of the photochromic material is 2-10% of the mass of the commercial resin modified glass ion bracket adhesive powder; the photochromic material is prepared from the following components in percentage by mass (1-4): and (1) the photochromic material Chameleon UVC P-Yellow and the photochromic material Chameleon UVC P-Blue. The photochromic orthodontic bracket adhesive presents a color different from that of teeth when the mixing is finished, and can help an orthodontist to better remove the adhesive overflowing around the bracket bottom plate. After the adhesive is cured by the irradiation of the light curing lamp, the color of the adhesive is restored to be similar to that of the teeth, so that the beauty of a patient is not influenced.

title_en: Quinolinedione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structural formula of the quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote is as follows: the invention also specifically discloses a preparation method of the quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote and application of the quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote in preparation of antitumor drugs. The quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine hybrid can be used for preparing antitumor drugs and has good development and application prospects through in vitro cytotoxic inhibition tests and NQO1 activity tests. The synthesis method of the quinoline dione sulfonyl piperazine heterozygote is simple, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the industrial production and clinical transformation are easy to realize.

title_en: GPR120 receptor agonist and application of ursodeoxycholic acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medicinal application of ursodeoxycholic acid, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. A particular problem to be solved by the present invention is related to the use of ursodeoxycholic acid or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, polymorph or pharmaceutical composition thereof as a therapeutic, in particular as a GPR120 receptor agonist as a free fatty acid. The key point of the technical problem to be solved by the invention is the determination of GPR120 receptor agonism of the compound.

title_en: Hydroxyapatite microsphere with adjustable shape and size and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydroxyapatite microsphere with adjustable shape and size and a preparation method thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: mixing the hydroxyapatite aqueous suspension with a dispersant and/or salt, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment and homogenization to obtain a stable hydroxyapatite suspension; and (3) carrying out microfluidic atomization spraying on the stable hydroxyapatite suspension to obtain liquid drops, and drying to obtain the hydroxyapatite microspheres. The invention adopts a micro-fluidic spray drying technology, and controls the geometric dimension and the shape of the dried microspheres by adjusting the parameters of the type of the dispersing agent, the mass ratio of hydroxyapatite to the dispersing agent, the salt concentration and the like. In addition, the dispersing agent is removed through the sintering step, the hydroxyapatite microspheres with adjustable appearance and size are prepared, the hydroxyapatite microspheres have a porous structure and can be used as carriers for loading medicaments in pharmaceutical application, and the preparation process has the advantages of low energy consumption, simplicity and convenience in operation and the like.

title_en: Tacrolimus nano liposome ophthalmic preparation with biological adhesiveness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tacrolimus nano liposome ophthalmic preparation with biological adhesiveness and a preparation method thereof. The weight percentage of each component is as follows: 0.05-2%, phospholipid: 1% -6%, cholesterol: 0.1-0.75%, 0.2-1.6% of emulsifier, and biological adhesive material: 3% -14%, preservative: 0.01 percent, the dosage of the pH regulator is to regulate the pH of the preparation to 6.0 to 8.0, and the rest is water for injection. The prepared ophthalmic preparation solves the problems of low solubility of tacrolimus and short eye retention time of common preparations, has controllable granularity and high entrapment rate, and is easy to realize industrial production.

title_en: Composition with effects of dispelling effects of alcohol and protecting liver and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmacy, and provides a composition with effects of dispelling effects of alcohol and protecting liver and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the production device is improved, so that the spore activation and sterilization effects of the concentrated solution in the production process are improved, and the extraction effect of the raw medicinal materials is improved; meanwhile, according to different substances, the effective components are extracted and concentrated by different methods, so that the content of the effective components for dispelling the effects of alcohol and protecting the liver in the composition is increased, and the effects of dispelling the effects of alcohol and protecting the liver of the composition are improved. The composition is verified to be capable of rapidly promoting the acetaldehyde to be decomposed into carbon dioxide and water after drinking, and animal experiments prove that the composition has the effects of reducing oxidative stress and protecting the liver and the spleen and the stomach.

title_en: HPK1 inhibitor and application thereof in medicine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel compound having a cancer therapeutic activity. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the compounds and a pharmaceutical composition containing the compounds.

title_en: Mouse model capable of expressing human IgA1 protein and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mouse model capable of expressing human IgA1 protein, which is a mouse for expressing human IgA1 with an O sugar modified hinge region by integrally introducing a gene sequence of human IGHA1 into a mouse Igha gene region and replacing a heavy chain region of mouse IgA with a heavy chain region of human IgA 1; the whole gene sequence of the human IgA1 refers to the whole section of the human IGHA1 gene and comprises an exon and an intron. The mouse model not only can effectively express the human IgA1 protein, but also can keep the gene information of the IgA1 antibody as much as possible, can realize the integrity of the human heterozygous IgA1 antibody, ensures the functionality of the human IgA1 molecule in the mouse body, has more specificity than the conventional construction method, and is closer to the natural character of the human IgA1. The invention also provides a method for constructing the mouse model and application of the mouse model in the field related to IgA nephropathy.

title_en: Novel lactobacillus reuteri LM1071 strain derived from breast milk, and composition for alleviating premenstrual syndrome comprising the same or culture thereof
abstract_en: The present application relates to Lactobacillus reuteri (Lactobacillus reuteri) LM1071 strain (KCCM 12650P), and a composition for relieving menstrual pain comprising the same. Lactobacillus reuteri LM1071 strain (KCCM 12650P) according to one embodiment of the present application can alleviate premenstrual syndrome by decreasing NO, prostaglandin E2 and leukotriene in blood, increasing the prostaglandin E1/prostaglandin E2 production ratio and epoxyeicosatrienoic acid (EET), and the above strain can be applied to food compositions, health functional food compositions, pharmaceutical compositions, and the like.

title_en: Antisense oligonucleotide for promoting jump of PD-L1 exon 3 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antisense oligonucleotide for promoting the jump of PD-L1 exon 3 and application thereof, belonging to the field of molecular genetics. The invention discovers a key regulatory sequence for splicing human PD-L1 exon 3, develops an antisense oligonucleotide for inhibiting the splicing of the exon, and can ensure that PD-L1 loses the binding capacity and the immunosuppressive function with PD-L1 by promoting the jump of the PD-L1 exon 3 of cancer cells, thereby inhibiting tumor immune escape and further improving the immunotherapeutic effect of the anti-PD-L1 antibody. The antisense oligonucleotide of the invention has an antisense oligonucleotide sequence which is more than 90% complementary to the 325 th to 344 th/405 th to 424 th bases of the PD-L1 gene of Genbank No. NM-014143.4 or the mRNA corresponding thereto.

title_en: Formula and preparation method of mask
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula and a preparation method of a mask, and relates to the technical field of medical supplies; the mask aims to solve the problem that the mask has poor effect of inhibiting viruses; the formula of the mask comprises an outer protective layer, an inner protective layer and a medicine layer, wherein the outer protective layer consists of a non-woven fabric A and a nano adsorption material arranged on the non-woven fabric A; the inner protective layer consists of a non-woven fabric B and a virus killing material arranged on the non-woven fabric B; the medicine layer consists of a non-woven fabric C and traditional Chinese medicine raw materials soaked on the non-woven fabric C; the nano adsorption material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-25 parts of graphene powder, 30-50 parts of nano silver powder and 3-10 parts of disinfection powder; the virus killing material is quantum material powder 10-20 weight portions. The invention has the characteristic of adsorbing viruses, plays an effective protection role and reduces the risk of infecting the viruses of a wearer.

title_en: anti-EGFR/VEGF (epidermal growth factor receptor/vascular endothelial growth factor) bifunctional fusion protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fusion proteins, in particular to an anti-EGFR/VEGF bifunctional fusion protein and application thereof. The anti-EGFR/VEGF bifunctional fusion protein comprises: (a) An anti-EGFR antibody, or antigen-binding fragment thereof, and (b) a D2 domain of the extracellular region of VEGFR 1. The fusion protein has great clinical application prospect in treating diseases related to high expression or abnormal expression of EGFR and VEGF.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition containing glucocorticoid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for treating rheumatoid arthritis, wherein the weight ratio of active ingredients of glucocorticoid to natural products of tripterygium wilfordii is 1: (1-5), wherein the glucocorticoid is methylprednisolone or methylprednisolone aceponate, and the natural product of the tripterygium wilfordii is one or more of triptolide, triptolide and triptolide. The medicine composition provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation method and stable quality, and various active ingredients can be used for synergistically treating the rheumatoid arthritis while respective effects are exerted.

title_en: Melanoma-targeted polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel polypeptide capable of targeting melanoma and application thereof. The amino acid sequences of the polypeptides are respectively: SNTALPSKFYGY, INQDARTMVMVP, ASVASGGWNNPHR, DHAQRYGAGHSG, DLPVNSVIFPFR, LSVPWGPRDNNR, can be used for the preparation of biomedical materials and drugs for realizing tumor targeted therapy by targeted binding of PD-L1 protein. The polypeptide can efficiently target melanoma, can be expanded to other types of tumors, and provides a new idea for the targeted therapy of tumors clinically.

title_en: Formula and preparation method of solid substitutional tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula of solid substitutional tea and a preparation method thereof, wherein the solid substitutional tea comprises the following components: radix Morindae officinalis, herba Lycopodii, caulis Spatholobi, caulis Trachelospermi, notopterygii rhizoma, radix Angelicae Pubescentis, fructus Psoraleae, radix Dipsaci, fructus crataegi, and fructus Jujubae. The Chinese medicinal composition is prepared from various medicinal materials according to the main use proportion of monarch, minister, assistant and guide, is prepared from pure herbal medicinal materials, has small toxic and side effects, has the effects of removing food retention and promoting diuresis, is matched according to the medicinal property and taste of the medicinal materials, reduces the integral bitter taste, is matched with honey, enhances the integral taste, and can be industrially produced according to the corresponding preparation process, so the Chinese medicinal composition is low in cost.

title_en: Composition with antibacterial and anti-dandruff effects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of daily cosmetics, in particular to a composition with antibacterial and anti-dandruff effects, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the composition with antibacterial and anti-dandruff effects, provided by the invention, comprises the following steps: s1, adding polygala root and trichosanthes kirilowii maxim root into a liquid fermentation culture medium to obtain a plant fermentation culture medium; s2, inoculating lactobacillus johnsonii seed liquid into the plant fermentation culture medium in the step S1 for fermentation culture to obtain plant fermentation liquid; and S3, inactivating and purifying the plant fermentation liquor obtained in the step S2 to obtain the composition with the antibacterial and anti-dandruff effects. The composition has good effects of inhibiting malassezia, removing dandruff, relieving itching and cleaning, is safe to human bodies and environment-friendly.

title_en: Application of iron death inhibitor in preparation of medicine for preventing and treating biliary tract diseases
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and provides an application of an iron death inhibitor in preparation of a medicine for preventing and treating biliary diseases, wherein the biliary diseases are any one or more of biliary tract inflammation, gallstone, biliary tract parasitic diseases, biliary tract congenital malformation and jaundice, and the iron death inhibitor is selected from any one or more of an iron overload inhibitor, an iron transport protein regulator, rosiglitazone, pioglitazone, troglitazone, ciglitazone, ferrostatin-1 diyne, SRS11-92, SRS16-86, tocopherol, vitamin K hydroquinone, beta-mercaptoethanol, li Puluo and melatonin. The iron death inhibitor can reduce the jaundice rate of a biliary atresia mouse, improve the jaundice clearance rate and reduce the incidence rate of bacterial cholangitis, and proves that the iron death inhibitor has a treatment effect on biliary diseases such as pathological jaundice, cholangitis, biliary atresia and the like.

title_en: Method for culturing cells, preparation of hydrolysate from cells and use thereof
abstract_en: A method of producing a cell hydrolysate by in vitro cell culture comprising the steps of: lysing the cells by sonication to release the proteins in the cells; digesting the protein by using a protease to produce a short peptide having a molecular size of less than 500 daltons (Da); the digestion step is terminated by heating the protease to a predetermined temperature and continuing heating for a predetermined time period or diluting the protease to a predetermined concentration, and the mixture from the digestion termination step is aseptically filtered through a membrane filter. The resulting cell hydrolysates can be used in a variety of products including, but not limited to, skin care products, wound care products, cosmetics, food products, supplements, pharmaceuticals and other medical applications.

title_en: Application of HyG in reducing MIC of imipenem high-drug-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of HyG in reducing MIC of imipenem high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa, and the application proves that galloyl-based hyperin can reduce the minimum inhibitory concentration of imipenem on the high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa through a growth curve experiment, a sterilization curve experiment and a drug sensitivity experiment. Galloyl-based hyperin reduces the MIC of imipenem for highly resistant P.aeruginosa from 4096 μg/mL to 1024 μg/mL at a concentration of 8 μg/mL. The galloyl-based hyperin can be used as an auxiliary agent for inhibiting the growth of high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa by imipenem, or can be used for preparing high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa growth inhibition drugs or high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa resistant drugs, can be used as targeted antibacterial drugs and is used for inhibiting the growth of high-resistance pseudomonas aeruginosa; has important significance for the research and development of medicines.

title_en: Application of WZ4141 or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in preparing medicines for treating or relieving inflammation
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of WZ4141 or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in preparing a medicine for treating or relieving inflammation, belonging to the technical field of biological medicines, wherein the medicine for treating or relieving inflammation comprises any one of medicines for treating bronchitis, pneumonia, hepatitis, rhinitis, enteronitis, gastritis, nephritis, dermatitis, prostatitis, vaginitis and rheumatoid arthritis. The WZ4141 can be used for treating or relieving inflammation, provides a new application for the WZ4141, and fills up the blank of anti-inflammatory drugs based on PGP-1 targets. The invention also provides a medicament for treating or relieving inflammation.

title_en: Antitumor activity of alpinia plants and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antitumor activity of alpinia plants and application thereof. The research of the invention shows that the alpinia oxyphylla and the cassia seed can obviously inhibit the proliferation of lung cancer cells and colon cancer cells, has the effect of killing tumors of the lung cancer and the colon cancer, and can promote the apoptosis of 2 cancer cells; meanwhile, the effect of alpinia oxyphylla and cassia nutmeg on the lung cancer cell cycle is mainly that cells are blocked in the G2/M phase, the cell cycle is expressed as the proportion of the G2/M phase is increased after the medicine treatment, the proportion of the G1 phase is reduced, and the effect of blocking the colon cancer cell cycle is mainly that the cell cycle is blocked in the G1/S phase, the proportion of the G1 phase is increased, and the proportion of the S phase is reduced; the result shows that the alpinia oxyphylla and the cassia nutmeg have good anti-tumor activity, a novel low-toxicity and easily-absorbed natural plant-derived drug selection is provided for resisting tumors, the defects of drug resistance, high toxic and side effects and the like of the traditional anti-tumor drugs are avoided, and a novel approach is provided for further development and utilization of alpinia resources.

title_en: Virus-like particle vaccine freeze-drying protective agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virus-like particle vaccine freeze-drying protective agent and a preparation method thereof. The freeze-drying protective agent comprises a solution A and a solution B which are mixed according to a volume ratio of 1:1-3:1, wherein the solution A comprises components with the following final concentrations of 0.01-0.5 mol/L base solution I, 0.5-2 mol/L base solution II, 0.01-0.1% polysorbate 80, 5-20% sucrose and 1-5% tryptone, and the solution B comprises components with the following final concentrations of 0.1-5% trehalose, 0.1-5% galactooligosaccharide and 0.1-2% PEG6000. According to the invention, through the compounding of the solution A and the solution B, the vaccine immunity effect can be effectively enhanced, the vaccine preservation time can be prolonged, and the virus-like particle morphology can be kept intact.

title_en: CCK secretion promoting peptide targeting calcium sensitive receptor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a CCK secretion promoting peptide of a targeted calcium sensitive receptor, and a preparation method and application thereof. The CCK secretion promoting peptide of the target calcium sensitive receptor is QGDVVALPA active peptide, and the amino acid sequence is as follows: gln-Gly-Asp-Val-Val-Ala-Leu-Pro-Ala. Compared with the prior art, the active peptide can be artificially synthesized by adopting a chemical solid-phase synthesis method, and can also be obtained by separating and purifying oat protein through enzymolysis.
