The active peptide can target an intestinal endocrine cell membrane CaSR to activate a Gq signal channel, so that the intracellular calcium ion concentration is improved, and the intestinal endocrine cell is remarkably promoted to secrete CCK; meanwhile, the active peptide has the advantages of safety, no toxic or side effect, gastrointestinal digestive enzyme enzymolysis resistance, easy absorption and the like. The active peptide is very suitable to be used as a functional component or a food base material for developing foods, health-care foods and medicines with the functions of delaying gastric emptying, promoting satiety and losing weight, and has very important application value.

title_en: Application of histone deacetylase HDAC3 in preparation of medicines for preventing and treating vascular restenosis after stent and intimal denudation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of histone deacetylase HDAC3 in preparing a medicine for preventing and treating vascular restenosis after stent and intimal denudation, wherein the prevention and treatment of vascular restenosis after stent and intimal denudation is realized by reducing expression and activity of histone deacetylase HDAC3 in cells or tissues, the histone deacetylase HDAC3 can exert the deacetylase activity, regulate and control proliferation of vascular smooth muscle cells and neointimal neogenesis, and the HDAC3 is used as a target to prevent and treat restenosis caused by vascular intimal injury by inhibiting expression and activity of the HDAC3 in cells, so that a new thought is provided for clinical prevention and treatment of the diseases.

title_en: Application of strigolactone derivative in preparation of mitochondrial autophagy inhibitor
abstract_en: The application discloses application of strigolactone derivatives in preparation of a mitochondrial autophagy inhibitor. The strigolactone derivative is used as a mitochondrial autophagy inhibitor, can selectively induce apoptosis of tumor cells and inhibit migration of the tumor cells, can be used for preparing medicines for preventing or treating tumors, can also be used as a chemotherapeutic drug sensitizer, can be used in combination with chemotherapeutic drugs taxol or cisplatin or can be used for researching the mechanism of autophagy or apoptosis, and can be used for preparing medicines for treating neurodegenerative diseases and inflammatory diseases as a mitochondrial autophagy inhibitor. The application further expands the application range of strigolactone derivatives and provides a new scheme for anti-tumor treatment.

title_en: Uricase nanoparticle wrapped by bionic membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations. The invention relates to uricase nanoparticles wrapped by a bionic membrane and a preparation method thereof. The uricase nanoparticle wrapped by the bionic film prepared by the invention can prolong the in vivo circulation half-life period of uricase, improve the bioavailability of the uricase and reduce the immunogenicity, and can be used for treating hyperuricemia and gout.

title_en: Mitochondria-targeted kava piper A derivative and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mitochondria-targeted kava piper A derivative, a synthesis method and application thereof. The mitochondria targeting kava-piperin A derivative (TPP-FKA) is synthesized by taking kava-piperin A (FKA) as a parent body and triphenylphosphine derivative TPP as a mitochondria targeting group through chemical reaction. The invention provides a novel kava-kava derivative which has a mitochondrial targeting effect and has a better effect of resisting acute myeloid leukemia than unmodified kava-kava.

title_en: Application of Fuan granule extract in treating intestinal flora imbalance
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a Fuan granular extract in treating intestinal dysbacteriosis.

title_en: Neurostem cell source 'oncolytic' exosome and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biomedicine, and relates to a neural stem cell source oncolytic exosome and application thereof. In particular to design, separation and application of exosome which is obtained by separating after infecting neural stem cells with oncolytic adenovirus and contains virus components and has the function of oncolytic virus.

title_en: Lifting and tightening skin barrier repair dressing and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The dressing comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1-10 parts of hydrolyzed red algae extract, 0.1-1 part of carbomer, 1-15 parts of glycerol, 0.1-1 part of carrageenan and 73-98.8 parts of purified water; the preparation method of the hydrolyzed red algae extract adopts a double-enzyme method, and the hydrolyzed red algae extract is purified by an ultrafiltration membrane separation and purification method to prepare high-purity hydrolyzed red algae extract; the application also provides an application of the skin barrier repair dressing that draws to tighten, specifically draws to repair for chin draws to apply ointment or plaster, and through the test to drawing to tighten and the barrier repair plays good improvement effect.

title_en: Core-shell nanoparticle for delivering transition state sialyltransferase inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a core-shell nanoparticle for delivering a transition state sialyltransferase inhibitor, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of antitumor drugs. The invention relates to a transition state sialyltransferase inhibitor and Ca  2+  Coordinate bonding by Ca  2+  Interact with phosphate radicals to avoidPhosphate groups are difficult to cross membranes. The invention wraps dioleoyl phosphatidic acid outside the coordination polymer, the hydrophilic end of dioleoyl phosphatidic acid is combined with the coordination polymer, and the hydrophobic end faces outwards; the invention takes dioleoylphosphatidylcholine, DSPE-PEG and cholesterol as shell layers of the kernel nanoparticles, and the DSPE-PEG plays a role in long circulation and is used for enhancing the stability of the nanoparticles in vivo; cholesterol plays a role of a membrane fluidity regulator on the liposome, and can reinforce a lipid bilayer membrane and reduce membrane flow, so that the leakage rate is reduced; the DOPC is used as a membrane material framework, so that the stability of the shell layer can be improved.

title_en: PD-1 nano vesicle loaded with Iguratimod-rhodium nanoparticles as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to a PD-1 nano vesicle loaded with Iguratimod-rhodium nano particles, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a PD-1 nano vesicle loaded with Iguratimod-rhodium nano particles, which takes the PD-1 nano vesicle as a drug carrier to coat the Iguratimod and the rhodium nano particles. The nano vesicle has the effects of resisting tumor growth and tumor metastasis. First, the nanovesicles express the PD-1 receptor, enhancing cancer immunotherapy by disrupting the PD-1/PD-L1 immunosuppressive axis; second, IGU provides chemotherapeutic functions by inhibiting the AKT/mTOR pathway; finally, rh inhibits tumor growth by photothermal treatment via the JNK/ERK pathway. Therefore, the combination therapy can provide a new idea for treating tumors and show good clinical application prospects.

title_en: Stereoselective synthesis of intermediates for the preparation of heterocyclic compounds
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a stereoselective synthesis useful as an intermediate for the preparation of heterocyclic derivatives that are cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitors. The synthesis method provided by the disclosure has the advantages of simple operation, higher yield and relatively controllable stereoselectivity, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine plaster for promoting anorectal postoperative defecation recovery and preparation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine plaster for promoting postoperative defecation recovery of anorectal operation and a preparation method and a using method thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine plaster is prepared from the following raw material medicines in parts by weight: the traditional Chinese medicine plaster for promoting postoperative defecation and recovery of anorectal surgery is prepared from 9-30 parts of immature bitter orange, 9-30 parts of mangnolia officinalis, 9-30 parts of radix astragali, 9-30 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 3-10 parts of Chinese angelica and 3-10 parts of rhizoma cimicifugae.

title_en: Preparation method of novel dust mite allergen pricking liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a novel dust mite allergen prick liquid, which comprises the following production processes: s1, enriching dust mites; s2, extracting; s3, dialyzing and cracking; s4, removing endotoxin; s5, centrifuging, and recovering a supernatant; s6, performing aseptic processing; s7, diluting the sterile supernatant by 10 times and 100 times; s8, shaking the diluent; s9, comparing and analyzing the pricking liquid effect by using a standard substance; and S10, subpackaging. According to the preparation method of the novel dust mite allergen prick liquid, the technology that the prepared stock solution is diluted according to a certain proportion and vibrates at a certain frequency can be adopted, the using amount of the dust mite stock solution is reduced, and the fact that the diluted solution and the stock solution have the same prick effect is guaranteed.

title_en: Mosapride citrate orally disintegrating tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oral solid preparations, and particularly relates to a mosapride citrate orally disintegrating tablet and a preparation method thereof. The raw and auxiliary materials comprise mosapride citrate, a filling agent, a disintegrating agent, a flow aid, a lubricant and a flavoring agent; the invention screens and optimizes the auxiliary material formula, adopts dry granulation and optimizes the preparation process, improves the compressibility and the fluidity of the materials, saves energy, improves the production quality and the stability, ensures that the prepared orally disintegrating tablet is quickly disintegrated and has good taste, greatly improves the administration compliance of patients, improves the medicine dissolution and improves the bioavailability. In addition, compared with other types of solid oral preparations of the variety, the mosapride citrate orally disintegrating tablet is particularly suitable for the old and patients with dysphagia, and provides convenience in special emergency situations such as lack of drinking water for taking medicines.

title_en: Application of NS8593 in preparation of medicine for treating osteoarthritis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of NS8593 in preparation of a medicine for treating osteoarthritis, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. According to the invention, the apoptosis model is constructed on the human normal chondrocyte line C28/I2 to simulate chondrocyte damage after osteoarthritis occurs, and the finding that NS8593 with different concentrations can obviously restore the cell activity and the mitochondrial membrane potential level of apoptotic chondrocytes, reduce the ROS release amount, and reduce chondrocyte apoptosis by inhibiting HO-1 signal transduction pathways, so that the relevant research of chondrocyte protection mechanisms is further supplemented and enriched, and more scientific bases are provided for researching and developing new drugs for treating osteoarthritis.

title_en: Aerogel taking mung bean protein and burdock nanocellulose synergistically stabilized foam as template
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aerogel taking mung bean protein and burdock nanocellulose synergistically stabilized foam as a template, which comprises the following steps: fresh burdock is selected as a raw material, dried after cleaning, superfine crushed and sieved, burdock fine powder and water are mixed and stirred uniformly, amylase, saccharifying enzyme and papain are respectively added, water bath boiling is carried out for enzyme deactivation, and then the burdock fiber is obtained through centrifugation. Washing and centrifuging the obtained burdock fiber for many times to remove trace impurities to obtain a fiber solution, freeze-drying the fiber solution to obtain burdock fiber powder, dispersing the burdock fiber powder in a sodium citrate buffer solution containing xylanase and cellulase, boiling the burdock fiber powder after stirring to inactivate the enzyme, centrifuging the burdock fiber after ultrasonic treatment, collecting precipitate, and washing the precipitate with absolute ethyl alcohol to obtain the burdock nanocellulose. Homogenizing burdock nanocellulose and mung bean protein to form foam. And (5) putting the foam into a refrigerator for freeze drying to obtain the aerogel. Compared with the prior aerogel, the burdock serving as the raw material has low cost and is easy to obtain, and the cost of the aerogel can be reduced.

title_en: Method for preparing bacterial ghost and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of preparing a bacterial ghost comprising forming a non-thermal plasma by gas discharge and treating bacteria with said non-thermal plasma, wherein said gas is nitrogen. The invention also relates to bacterial ghosts and compositions comprising bacterial ghosts.

title_en: Hydrogel preparation loaded with stem cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogel preparation for loading stem cells, and a preparation method and application thereof. The hydrogel takes fibrinogen and thrombin as gel matrix materials, and an anti-fiber solvent is added to improve the stability of the hydrogel, and meanwhile, a stem cell protection liquid is also added to maintain the survival of stem cells in the hydrogel. The invention takes hydrogel as a biological scaffold, simulates a three-dimensional extracellular matrix environment, can support the growth, proliferation and differentiation of stem cells, and realizes the repair of diabetic wound ulcers. The hydrogel preparation has good biocompatibility and the function of promoting wound healing, and experimental results show that the hydrogel preparation has good effects of loading stem cells and treating diabetic wound ulcers.

title_en: Antitumor composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses an anti-tumor composition and application thereof. The composition comprises quercitin and marigold, wherein the mass ratio of the quercitin to the marigold is 1: (0.5-15). The invention researches find that the composition has an anti-tumor effect. Preferably has good effect of inhibiting proliferation, migration and invasion of gastric cancer, cervical cancer, breast cancer and pancreatic cancer. Provides a natural anti-tumor composition with good curative effect and small toxic and side effects.

title_en: Application of stem cell particles in preparation of medicine for preventing and/or treating xerophthalmia
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of stem cell particles in preparing a medicine for preventing and/or treating xerophthalmia, belonging to the field of medicines. The invention discovers that the particles (MSC-MVs) derived from the human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells can effectively treat the autoimmune disease-related xerophthalmia for the first time. In vivo experiment results show that the eye drops taking MSC-MVs as an active ingredient can remarkably increase the tear secretion of an autoimmune disease related xerophthalmia animal model, remarkably improve the stability of a tear film and have a good function of maintaining the function of the tear gland; and the cornea and conjunctiva of an animal with the autoimmune disease-related dry eye can be effectively protected, and the eye damage caused by the dry eye can be alleviated. MSC-MVs have wide application prospect in preparing medicines for preventing and treating xerophthalmia.

title_en: Preparation method, composition and application of hydrolyzed ginseng saponin composition with soothing and repairing effects
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method, a composition and an application of a hydrolyzed ginseng saponin composition, comprising the following steps: pulverizing plant of Panax of Araliaceae, grinding, extracting with ethanol to obtain raw Ginseng radix total saponin; controlling the proportion of diol group protopanaxasaponin Rb1 and triol group protopanaxasaponin Rg1 in the protopanaxasaponin before the enzyme catalysis reaction, and calculating and proportioning to obtain an intermediate raw material protopanaxasaponin mixture; then carrying out enzyme-catalyzed hydrolysis to obtain hydrolyzed ginseng saponin composition, and compounding the hydrolyzed ginseng saponin composition with solvent, humectant, etc. to obtain hydrolyzed ginseng saponin pre-prepared liquid cosmetic raw material (Chinese family dilute glycoside). The hydrolyzed ginseng saponin composition and the cosmetic raw material of the flavonoid glycoside can achieve remarkable relieving and repairing effects on human body problem skin in a stimulation state when used in a skin care product, and can achieve the effects of relieving gingival inflammation, repairing dental ulcer, relieving gingival bleeding and resisting tooth sensitivity when used in an oral care product.

title_en: Process for the manufacture of alkylamide thiazoles
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improved process for the manufacture of alkylamide thiazoles. This novel economic process provides a product of high purity and high yield.

title_en: High-stability collagen targeting SERS polypeptide probe and application thereof in liver fibrosis diagnosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability collagen targeting SERS polypeptide probe and application thereof in liver fibrosis diagnosis. The SERS polypeptide probe comprises a polypeptide (X-targeting polypeptide-Cys), nano particles and a Raman signal molecule, wherein X in the polypeptide is at least one negatively charged amino acid, and the polypeptide is combined with the nano particles through the Cys; the Raman signal molecules are modified to the surfaces of the nanoparticles through sulfhydryl groups. The SERS polypeptide probe provided by the invention has good dispersibility and stability, can be specifically combined with collagen in tissues, is successfully used for SERS imaging of liver fibrosis mice in different stages, and has wide application prospects in diagnosis of collagen-related diseases such as liver fibrosis and the like.

title_en: Method for increasing populations of species of the genus Brewsterilla in the gut microbiota
abstract_en: The population of bacteria of the genus alisteria in the intestinal microbiome of people with various diseases is low. We have found administration of vitamin/vitamin combinations such as: beta-carotene, vitamin a, vitamin D, vitamin B5, vitamin B2 in combination with vitamin C, vitamin K, DHA, or EPA, when administered directly to the large intestine, such that it directly provides nutrition to the gut microbiota, can lead to an increase in the species brewsteri.

title_en: Application of EMP3 as target for treating chronic kidney disease
abstract_en: The invention provides sgRNA of a targeted EMP3 gene mRNA and a corresponding CRISPR-Cas13d system, has high gene editing efficiency, can effectively inhibit the expression of EMP3 in mouse TCMK1 cells and kidney tissues, can obviously delay the progress of chronic renal fibrosis through gene editing as an EMP3 inhibitor, and provides a new target and a treatment strategy for clinically treating the chronic renal fibrosis.

title_en: Anti-aging active composition for promoting absorption and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-aging active composition for promoting absorption, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of active composition preparation. The invention adopts the prescription compatibility principle of monarch, minister, assistant and guide, the synergistic action among the compositions, and takes rhodiola rosea and bighead atractylodes rhizome as main components of the monarch drug composition, thereby having the efficacy of deferring senility; the bighead atractylodes rhizome extract, the liquorice extract and the white poria extract are added to have synergistic effect, so that the immunity is enhanced and the antibacterial effect is achieved; the chamomile extract, the horsetail extract and the horse chestnut extract are added, and the monarch, minister and adjuvant actions are added, so that the skin absorption is promoted, the skin vitality is enhanced, and the skin barrier is restored. The enzymolysis treatment and the ethanol extraction are adopted in the preparation of the monarch drug composition, and the repeated concentration and extraction are adopted in the extraction of the ministerial drug composition, so that the purity and the yield of the obtained product are improved.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibacterial peptide and a preparation method and application thereof. The antibacterial peptide comprises an amino acid sequence shown as SEQNOID: 1. The antibacterial peptide is obtained by modifying an active core sequence of Melittin (Melittin), has extremely low hemolytic toxic and side effects, has good antibacterial activity on clinically common gram negative and positive bacteria, can provide a novel, efficient, nontoxic, nuisanceless and good-stability antibacterial preparation, and is beneficial to changing the current abuse condition of antibiotics.

title_en: Use of compound for preparing medicine for treating KRAS mutant cancer patient
abstract_en: The invention provides methods and pharmaceutical uses for treating KRAS mutated cancer, tumor patients.

title_en: Composition for treating acne, micro-needle for treating acne and preparation method
abstract_en: The application relates to a composition for treating acne, a micro-needle for treating acne and a preparation method. The composition comprises salicylic acid, a cosolvent, a functional component and a matrix material, wherein the cosolvent is selected from at least one of basic amino acid and alkaloid, the basic amino acid is selected from at least one of arginine, lysine and histidine, and the alkaloid is selected from at least one of matrine, magnoflorine and betaine. The composition forms a stable ionic structure through compatibility of cosolvents such as salicylic acid, alkaline amino acid or alkaloid, increases the solubility of the salicylic acid under the condition of no need of high-temperature heating, simplifies the preparation process of combination of the salicylic acid and the cosolvents, improves the stability of the salicylic acid solution, and ensures the bacteriostatic and anti-inflammatory effects of the microneedle patch under smaller dosage.

title_en: Microbial inoculum for relieving intestinal inflammation by adjusting intestinal 5-hydroxytryptamine steady state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial inoculum for relieving intestinal inflammation by adjusting the steady state of intestinal 5-hydroxytryptamine, belonging to the fields of human and animal nutrition and microbial agents. The technical problem to be solved by the invention is as follows: the intestinal inflammation can be safely and effectively prevented and/or treated. In order to solve the technical problems, the invention provides a microbial inoculum for relieving intestinal inflammation, which comprises mucous membrane lactobacillus. Further, the microbial inoculum can relieve intestinal inflammation by regulating the intestinal 5-hydroxytryptamine homeostasis of animals. Further, in the above microbial inoculum, the microbial inoculum further comprises giant coccus aegypti or lactobacillus amylovorus. The invention also provides a product containing the microbial inoculum or a culture of the microbial inoculum, and the product can be used for preventing and/or treating intestinal inflammation. The microbial inoculum provided by the invention can obviously improve symptoms related to intestinal inflammation, such as weight loss, splenomegaly, colon shortening and reduction of proinflammatory factor gene expression, thereby relieving intestinal inflammation.

title_en: Citrobacter freundii phage and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a phage and application thereof. A citrobacter freundii bacteriophage is RDP-CF-21001, is named as citrobacter freundii bacteriophage in classification, and is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) No.45088 in the 20th month of 2022. The citrobacter freundii bacteriophage provided by the invention is a virulent bacteriophage, has strong cracking capacity to citrobacter freundii in water, has a very short incubation period, can be greatly proliferated in a short time, can be rapidly sterilized, and has positive significance for preventing and treating aquaculture diseases. Provides a phage source for industrialized production of phage and treatment of bacterial diseases of aquatic animals caused by the citrobacter freundii.

title_en: Composition for treating hemorrhoids and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for hemorrhoids and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and the composition for hemorrhoids comprises the following components: fructus Aurantii, radix et rhizoma Rhei, radix astragali, galla chinensis, receptaculum Nelumbinis, fructus forsythiae, fructus Siraitiae Grosvenorii, radix Angelicae sinensis, curcumae rhizoma, rhizoma Ligustici Chuanxiong, herba Taraxaci, cortex Phellodendri, radix Arnebiae, and Borneolum Syntheticum. The composition for treating hemorrhoids has good treatment effect on hemorrhoids, and has obvious treatment effect on internal hemorrhoids, external hemorrhoids, mixed hemorrhoids and the like.

title_en: Application of exosome-loaded adriamycin in treatment of neuroblastoma
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of exosome-like loaded adriamycin in treatment of neuroblastoma, and particularly relates to application of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-like exosome-like loaded adriamycin in treatment of neuroblastoma and a preparation method of a novel biological nano-drug carrier. The exosome is prepared by a continuous extrusion method, and the adriamycin is successfully loaded by an ammonium sulfate gradient method, so that the novel biological nano-drug carrier is proved to be a novel biological nano-drug carrier with higher yield, higher tumor specificity, lower cardiotoxicity and better anti-tumor effect. It is noted that the payload of the novel nanocarrier will not be limited to doxorubicin, but can be extended to other traditional chemotherapeutic drugs, small molecule inhibitors, and even nucleic acid or protein drugs, which would hold promise for developing novel precise drugs against neuroblastoma or other childhood tumors.

title_en: A composition with antiviral effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition with antiviral effect, which comprises 60-70% ethanol extract and 90-100% ethanol extract of euphorbia hirta; the mass percentage of the 60-70% ethanol extract and the 90-100% ethanol extract is 1-10: 1 to 10. The invention combines the ethanol extracts with specific concentration of the euphorbia hirta, so that the treatment effect of the euphorbia hirta on resisting respiratory syncytial virus is unexpectedly and obviously improved, and a new and high-safety choice is provided for clinically treating diseases caused by respiratory viruses.

title_en: Recombinant protein and application thereof in preparation of respiratory syncytial virus vaccine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a recombinant protein and application thereof. The recombinant protein comprises: SH protein (SH) of respiratory syncytial virus and G protein (G (CX 3C)) of respiratory syncytial virus containing CX3C motif improve immunogenicity of low molecular weight antigen SH and G (CX 3C) protein, so that the recombinant protein has good immunogenicity and high neutralizing antibody titer, has better protective effect against two immune sites, and can be used for preparing products such as vaccine, respiratory syncytial virus antibody, anti-respiratory syncytial virus serum, diagnostic antigen and the like.

title_en: Application of bosutinib in inhibiting i-motif structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of bosutinib in inhibiting an i-motif structure, wherein the i-motif structure comprises an i-motif structure generated in an in vivo environment and an i-motif structure generated in an in vitro environment. The effective concentration of the bosutinib is 0.5-50 mu M. The invention discovers for the first time that the bosutinib can inhibit the generation of an i-motif structure and has a damage effect on the i-motif structure in vivo and in vitro environments, so that the bosutinib can be effectively used for inhibiting the expression of protooncogenes or damaging the expression of protooncogenes, and provides a new thought for treating diseases related to the i-motif structure.

title_en: High-stability targeting joint-drug conjugate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a targeting linker-drug conjugate with high stability and excellent anti-tumor effect, belonging to the field of drugs. The invention specifically provides a drug linked assembly unit with a specific linker structure and a targeted linker-drug conjugate formed by connecting the drug linked assembly unit and an antibody.

title_en: Anticancer binding molecules and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are bispecific binding molecules of 4-1BB and GPC3, comprising a first domain that specifically binds 4-1BB, and a second domain that specifically binds GPC 3. Also disclosed herein are uses of the bispecific binding molecules for treating or preventing cancer.

title_en: Novel pectin oligosaccharide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel fruitA colloidooligosaccharide and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the novel pectin oligosaccharide is shown as the formula (1): formula (1). The novel pectin oligosaccharide is rich in RG-I galactose side chain, has low molecular weight and low methyl ester degree, has good intestinal flora probiotic function, and can be used in products for improving the intestinal probiotic function; the method for preparing the pectin oligosaccharide is simple to operate, low in production cost, beneficial to fully utilizing fruit and vegetable wastes, capable of improving the added value of the fruit and vegetable wastes, capable of realizing green production and efficient preparation of the pectin oligosaccharide, easy to realize industrial production and capable of improving economic benefits.

title_en: Vectors and methods for in vivo transduction
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods for inducing immunity through cellular expression of antigen receptor binding constructs in vivo.

title_en: Fragrance-expanding pharmaceutical composition for improving anxiety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fragrance-expanding pharmaceutical composition for improving anxiety, which comprises limonene, alpha-copaene, trans-caryophyllene and (+) -delta-cubebene, and also comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-9 parts of beta-cedrene, 5-9 parts of eucalyptol, 2-6 parts of menthol, 0.5-4.5 parts of dibutyl phthalate, 0.5-4.5 parts of alpha-cedrene and 0.1-3 parts of menthone. The pharmaceutical composition of the present invention has excellent efficacy of reducing anxiety level (SAS score). Meanwhile, the composition is convenient to use, and can be directly dripped into a fragrance diffuser for use, so that excellent curative effect can be achieved.

title_en: TNF-alpha antagonistic peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polypeptides, and discloses a TNF-alpha antagonistic peptide and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the TNF-alpha antagonistic peptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The TNF-alpha antagonistic peptide has good stability and obvious effects of diminishing inflammation, regulating immunity and TNF-alpha antagonism, and can be used for preparing medicines for treating inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.

title_en: Human immune cells genetically modified to express orthogonal receptors
abstract_en: Human lymphocytes or myeloid cells comprising polynucleotides encoding engineered orthogonal human CD122 are provided, wherein the lymphocytes or myeloid cells do express native human CD122.

title_en: Antibodies and their use in inhibiting cancer stem cells
abstract_en: The present invention relates to antibodies and their use in inhibiting cancer stem cells. The survivin monoclonal antibody is prepared by a hybridoma technology after a mouse is immunized by taking survivin recombinant protein as an immunogen, and has better survivin binding capacity and specificity. After the antibody is acted with the nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells, the proliferation of the nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells and the expression of survivin protein in the cells can be inhibited. The monoclonal antibody has wide prospect in cancer treatment.

title_en: Polymer-coated lipid nanoparticle, preparation method thereof and pharmaceutical preparation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bioengineering, and particularly relates to a polymer-coated lipid nanoparticle, a preparation method thereof and a pharmaceutical preparation. The polymer-encapsulated lipid nanoparticle comprises a polymer vesicle and lipid encapsulated in the polymer vesicle, wherein a polymer forming the polymer vesicle is an amphiphilic block copolymer, the amphiphilic block copolymer comprises a hydrophilic polymer block and a hydrophobic polymer block, the hydrophilic polymer block accounts for 20-50wt% of the amphiphilic block polymer, and the lipid comprises lipid. The polymer-encapsulated lipid nanoparticle can improve the stability of a load (such as saRNA, mRNA or DNA) and is beneficial to long-term storage at 2-8 ℃ even at room temperature by limiting the mass ratio of the hydrophilic polymer block to the hydrophobic polymer block in the amphiphilic block copolymer to enable the polymer to form a vesicle structure and simultaneously encapsulate the lipid in the vesicle.

title_en: Lycium barbarum root polyphenol derivative composition, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wolfberry root extract with anti-inflammatory and antipruritic effects, a wolfberry root polyphenol derivative and a preparation method thereof, and also relates to application of a wolfberry root extract and wolfberry root polyphenol derivative composition in anti-inflammatory and antipruritic aspects. The extract of the Chinese wolfberry root disclosed by the invention mainly comprises polyphenol derivatives, has excellent anti-inflammatory and antipruritic effects, and has an important application value in anti-inflammatory and antipruritic effects. The extract of the Chinese wolfberry root and the preparation thereof disclosed by the invention can be widely used as raw materials of anti-inflammatory and antipruritic cosmetics or medicines.

title_en: 2, 2-dimethyl benzopyran derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a 2, 2-dimethyl benzopyran derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of medicinal chemistry. The invention designs novel structure 2, 2-dimethyl benzopyran formamide SPU-ZD series compounds and 2, 2-dimethyl benzopyran acrylamide SPU-D series compounds by using the splicing principle and the bioisostere and group replacement strategy, and experiments prove that the invention has high free radical removal efficiency on mice microglial cells BV2, small side effect, strong efficacy of inhibiting inflammatory factors and good antioxidant stress capability, and can be used for preparing medicaments for neuroprotection, treating ischemic cerebral apoplexy and other diseases.

title_en: Molecular marker of RBBP6 gene and CCDC91 gene combination and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a molecular marker combined by RBBP6 gene and CCDC91 gene, a kit and application thereof, belonging to the field of biotechnology and solving at least one of the following problems: (1) The existing virus nucleic acid detection kit can not effectively screen SARS-CoV-2 virus infected persons in a window period; (2) The existing virus nucleic acid detection result is limited by a plurality of factors such as sampling positions, sampling methods, sampling periods and the like. The molecular marker comprises RBBP6 gene and CCDC91 gene. The RBBP6 gene and the CCDC91 gene have correlation with SARS-CoV-2 virus infection, and the molecular marker is suitable for early detection of SARS-CoV-2 virus infection, has easy operation and high detection sensitivity, can distinguish SARS-CoV-2 virus infection from other common respiratory tract virus infection, and shows better specificity.

title_en: Intestinal microbiota bioactive PDE4 inhibitor precursors
abstract_en: This document describes compounds of formula (I), or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, processes for their preparation and methods for their use in the treatment or prophylaxis of a variety of conditions including ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease, chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), adult respiratory distress syndrome, infant respiratory distress syndrome, cough, psoriatic arthritis or psoriasis.

title_en: Application of stephanine in preparing medicine for treating esophageal cancer and radiotherapy sensitization of esophageal cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to the application of stephanine in preparing the sensitization medicine for treating esophageal cancer and esophageal cancer radiotherapy. The invention provides the application of stephanine in preparing the drug for treating esophagus cancer and enhancing the sensitivity of esophagus cancer radiotherapy for the first time, and researches show that the main action mechanism of stephanine for treating esophagus cancer or enhancing the sensitivity of esophagus cancer radiotherapy is as follows: it can induce S-phase cell cycle arrest of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma KYSE150 and its radiotherapy resisting cell line KYSE150R, further reduce proliferation ability of KYSE150 and KYSE150R, and induce cancer cell apoptosis. The stephanine and radiotherapy combined treatment provided by the invention is expected to provide a very promising treatment scheme for patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and has great clinical significance for breaking through the bottleneck of esophageal cancer treatment.

title_en: Powder aerosol composition for inhalation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and in particular relates to a powder aerosol pharmaceutical composition for inhalation, and a preparation method and application thereof. The powder aerosol composition comprises an active substance and a carrier; the active substances are budesonide, formoterol or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and a long-acting or super-long-acting muscarinic antagonist drug or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The powder aerosol pharmaceutical composition for inhalation has good stability of active drugs; the powder fog agent composition product is simple and convenient to operate, convenient for patients to use and convenient to carry; the medicine is stable and uniform; the powder spray composition can realize multi-dose drug administration, has low drug residue rate in the device, and realizes better clinical symptom relief and maintenance treatment effect.

title_en: Application of dihydrocarvacrol angelate in preparation of medicines for treating myocardial ischemia
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of dihydroparsley angelate in preparing or treating myocardial ischemia drugs, which can improve heart function of a myocardial ischemia mouse, has the effects of resisting myocardial ischemia, improving activity of hypoxia injury H9c2 cells, protecting mitochondria and inhibiting autophagy and apoptosis by regulating and controlling PI3K/AKT/mTOR signal paths.

title_en: Gp21 protein encoded by pseudomonas aeruginosa phage and application thereof in inhibiting escherichia coli phage infection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and relates to a Gp21 protein encoded by pseudomonas aeruginosa phage and application thereof in inhibiting coliphage infection. The amino acid sequence of the Gp21 protein encoded by the pseudomonas aeruginosa phage is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The Gp21 protein can be expressed in non-original host bacterium escherichia coli BL21 (DE 3) to strengthen the resistance of escherichia coli to phage infection, shows potential of serving as a target spot to be used for modifying different bacteria to resist phage infection, and has the excellent characteristic of broad-spectrum resistance to phage infection.

title_en: Polysaccharide instant granule and application thereof in gastroesophageal reflux treatment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological pharmacy and application, and discloses polysaccharide instant granules and application thereof in gastroesophageal reflux treatment. The instant polysaccharide granule comprises sodium alginate, ethyl cellulose, coconut powder, calcium carbonate and sodium bicarbonate, and can be used for preparing medicine and health product for treating gastroesophageal reflux. The invention can prevent gastric acid from flowing back to esophagus or prevent gastric acid and digestive enzyme from directly contacting with esophageal mucosa, and relieve symptoms such as stomach burning, heartburn and acid regurgitation.

title_en: FGF21 mutant protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides FGF21 mutant protein and application thereof. The mutein has some changes based on the wild-type human FGF21 sequence: the proline residue at position 171 is deleted or a pair of disulfide bonds is formed before and after the proline residue at position 171 by substitution, deletion or addition of one or more amino acid residues. The FGF21 mutein of the present invention can resist the enzymatic degradation of Fibroblast Activation Protease (FAP) to the C-terminal thereof, and maintain the binding activity of the C-terminal and the beta-klotho receptor, thereby prolonging the in vivo half-life and the drug effect thereof.

title_en: Pabociclib nano suspension and pambociclib nano freeze-dried powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a palbociclib nano suspension and a palbociclib nano freeze-dried powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the palbociclib nano suspension and the palbociclib nano freeze-dried powder comprise palbociclib, a stabilizer, citric acid and sodium bicarbonate, wherein the stabilizer is a combination of lecithin and SDS: lecithin: the mass ratio of SDS is 1:1 to 5: 1-5, palbociclib: citric acid: the molar ratio of sodium bicarbonate is 1:1 to 4:1 to 4. According to the preparation method, the nano suspension of the palbociclib is prepared, so that the dissolution rate of the palbociclib is increased; meanwhile, the freeze-dried powder of the palbociclib nano-suspension is prepared, so that the physical stability of the suspension is further improved, and the problem of low bioavailability of palbociclib is solved.

title_en: Application of Xinmu Jiang Zijian in treating polycystic ovary syndrome
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and particularly relates to application of Xinmu Jiang Zijian in treating polycystic ovary syndrome. For a rat PCOS model caused by dehydroepiandrosterone, the neowood Jiang Zijian can improve the serum estradiol (E  2 ) level, reduce the Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH), gonadotrophin (LH) and testosterone hormone level, has obvious therapeutic effect on PCOS, and provides a new drug choice for subsequent treatment of PCOS.

title_en: TRIM24 and EGFR bispecific binding peptides
abstract_en: The invention discloses TRIM24 binding peptides, TRIM24 and EGFR bispecific binding peptides and medicaments containing the same. The sequence of the TRIM24 binding peptide is: VLFX  1  X  2  YYTX  3  X  4  TM; the sequence of TRIM24 and EGFR bispecific binding peptide is VLFWTYYTPSTM. The invention screens 6 binding peptides which specifically bind TRIM24 protein through a D12 phage library, wherein one binding peptide has strong binding specificity with EGFR protein, is a double-protein binding peptide, and is used for treating glioma diseasesThe basis is established.

title_en: Focal adhesion kinase splice isomer FAK 6/7 Applications of (2)
abstract_en: The invention provides focal adhesion kinase splice isomer FAK  6/7  Is used in the application of (a). Specifically, the invention provides for detecting FAK in a sample  6/7  The use of a reagent according to (2) for the preparation of a diagnostic agent for the diagnosis of a neuroendocrine tumor of the pancreas, breast or brain, said sample being derived from pancreatic, breast or brain tissue of an individual to be tested. The invention also provides FAK  6/7  The application of the target in screening and/or preparing medicines for treating neuroendocrine tumors is also provided, and the application of the FAK-targeting substance in preparing medicines for treating neuroendocrine tumors is also provided. FAK in the invention  6/7  Can be used as a clinical diagnosis marker of neuroendocrine tumor to guide the clinical application of FAK kinase inhibitor.

title_en: Cell apoptosis inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cell apoptosis inhibitor, a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a compound, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, hydrate or solvate thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a formula I. The invention also provides methods for preparing the compounds and pharmaceutical compositions containing them or their use in the treatment or prevention of diseases or conditions associated with cellular apoptosis and/or human receptor interacting protein 1 kinase (RIPK 1).

title_en: Skin antibacterial repair emulsion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a skin antibacterial repair emulsion and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of cosmetics. The skin antibacterial repairing emulsion comprises an oil phase, a water phase and an emulsifier, wherein the oil phase is dispersed in the water phase in the form of liquid drops under the action of the emulsifier, and the particle size of the liquid drops is not more than 200nm; the oil phase comprises at least one of cinnamaldehyde octadecylamine complex, paeonol octadecylamine covalent coupling and asiatic acid. The embodiment of the application can well improve the physicochemical properties of the cinnamaldehyde, the paeonol and the asiatic acid, so that the cinnamic aldehyde, the paeonol and the asiatic acid can exist stably and in a large amount in actual use, and has good treatment effect on acne.

title_en: Keli-boro aerosol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of external medicine, and in particular discloses a clenbuterol aerosol and a preparation method thereof. The aerosol comprises 0.01-3.0% of the clenbuterol, 20-60% of the nonaqueous solvent, 0.5-5.0% of the latent solvent, 0.1-5.0% of the film forming agent and 20-50% of the propellant, wherein the solvent comprises 10-30% of water. Particularly, the aqueous aerosol has the advantages of environmental protection, safety and small irritation compared with the alcohol-based aerosol, and has good stability and excellent skin penetration performance.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine oral liquid for preventing and treating dairy cow mastitis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of veterinary drug preparations, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine oral liquid for preventing and treating cow mastitis, wherein each 100mL of the oral liquid is prepared from the following components in parts by weight and auxiliary materials: 8-15 parts of dandelion, 8-15 parts of semen vaccariae, 6-9 parts of snakegourd fruit, 6-9 parts of uniflower swisscentaury root, 4-8 parts of weeping forsythiae capsule, 4-8 parts of selfheal, 4-8 parts of radix trichosanthis, 4-8 parts of herba violae, 3-5 parts of radix scrophulariae, 3-5 parts of rhizoma anemarrhenae, 3-5 parts of green tangerine peel, 3-5 parts of nutgrass galingale rhizome, 4-8 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 4-8 parts of angelica sinensis and 2-4 parts of liquorice. The traditional Chinese medicine composition adopts purely natural Chinese herbal medicines, has reasonable formula and simple preparation method, is prepared into oral liquid, has the characteristics of more convenient use, quick absorption and utilization and difficult generation of drug resistance, has no toxic or side effect, shortens the recovery period, and ensures the health and milk yield of cows.

title_en: Application of N-acyl homoserine lactonase in preparation of salmonella typhimurium infection resisting products
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of N-acyl homoserine lactonase (AHLase) in preparing a salmonella typhimurium infection-resistant product. According to the invention, the application of AHLase to Salmonella typhimurium can inhibit not only the biofilm formation capacity but also the cluster movement capacity and the adhesion capacity to host intestinal epithelial cells, so that the AHLase can effectively reduce the virulence and/or pathogenicity of Salmonella typhimurium; the invention also applies AHLase to the salmonella typhimurium infected broiler, and discovers that the AHLase has obvious protective effect on the growth performance, organ index and intestinal health of the salmonella typhimurium infected broiler. Therefore, the invention provides the application of AHLase in preparing the salmonella typhimurium infection-resistant product, provides a new treatment scheme for salmonella typhimurium infection, and also provides a new application for AHLase.

title_en: Polysaccharide modified phospholipid complex and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polysaccharide-modified medicinal phospholipid compound, wherein the medicinal phospholipid compound is prepared from a medicament and phospholipid, the medicament comprises oxymatrine and glycyrrhizin, and the polysaccharide modification is to modify the medicinal phospholipid compound by chitosan and then modify the medicinal phospholipid compound coated with chitosan by hyaluronic acid. The polysaccharide modified medicinal phospholipid complex can enhance medicinal aggregation in tumor cells through synergistic effect and active targeting effect, and remarkably improves the antitumor effect of the medicaments.

title_en: Yeast microcapsule carrier modified by non-phospholipid lipid membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yeast microcapsule carrier modified by a non-phospholipid lipid membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicine carriers. The yeast microcapsule is obtained by an ethanol dehydration method, the drug-loaded yeast microcapsule is obtained after drug loading is adsorbed, and then the cation lipid membrane is used for modifying the drug-loaded yeast microcapsule, so that the yeast microcapsule modified by the non-phospholipid cation lipid membrane coating is obtained. The yeast microcapsule carrier modified by the non-phospholipid lipid membrane has the advantages of acid stability, pH responsiveness and ion responsiveness of a cationic lipid membrane, successfully solves the problems of poor stability, excessive drug dosage loss in gastric juice, and low availability caused by incapacity of staying in intestinal tracts, improves the oral availability of drugs such as berberine drugs, promotes the absorption of the drugs in intestinal tracts, and provides a new way for the research, development and use of drugs with low bioavailability in the field of oral preparations.

title_en: Antiviral compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound for antiviral treatment, a preparation method and application thereof. In particular to a compound shown in a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a pharmaceutically acceptable preparation prepared from the compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The compound has better antiviral effect, and can effectively prevent and treat diseases of human beings or animals caused by infection of coronavirus, calicivirus, influenza virus, rabies virus, hepatitis B virus and the like.

title_en: SiRNA for inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress and cell line thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to siRNA for inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress and a cell line thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The invention provides RNA for inhibiting expression of Ero1α, which comprises the sequence shown in SEQ ID NO:1, wherein the 3' end of the oligonucleotide siRNA1 is modified by 2 dT; or shRNA synthesized by taking oligonucleotide siRNA as a target point, wherein the shRNA comprises a sequence shown in SEQ ID NO:5 and the single-stranded RNA molecule corresponding to SEQ ID NO:6, and a single-stranded RNA corresponding to the same. The invention provides a recombinant lentiviral expression vector containing the RNA sequence, and constructs a microvascular endothelial cell line with low expression of Ero1α; the invention provides a new path for treating heart ischemia reperfusion injury by revealing the mechanism of generation and development of vascular endothelial cells ERS and apoptosis, and has important application value.

title_en: Lactobacillus reuteri with high enrichment of selenocysteine and capable of improving activity of selenase
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus reuteri capable of improving selenocysteine activity and enriched with selenocysteine, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The lactobacillus reuteri (Limosilactobacillus reuteri) CCFM1303 obtained by screening can efficiently enrich inorganic selenium, convert the inorganic selenium into organic selenium (selenocysteine), be better absorbed and utilized by organisms, and effectively improve the activity of selenium enzyme of the organisms. Animal experiments prove that the selenium-enriched lactobacillus reuteri can improve the activity of selenium enzyme in male mice, exert higher biological activity than inorganic selenium, and meet the physiological requirement of supplementing selenium. The lactobacillus reuteri CCFM1303 can be used for efficiently enriching inorganic selenium to produce selenocysteine, is used for preparing a probiotic preparation for improving the activity of body selenase, and has huge application prospect in the field of foods or medicines.

title_en: A topical Chinese medicinal composition for treating rheumatism, and its preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides an external traditional Chinese medicine composition for remarkably treating rheumatism, and a preparation method and application thereof. The external traditional Chinese medicine composition is prepared into gel paste, and the traditional Chinese medicine raw materials comprise caulis Piperis Kadsurae, fructus Lipuidambaris, herba Lobeliae chinensis, rhizoma corydalis Decumbentis, herba Agastaches, radix Achyranthis bidentatae, semen Hoveniae, semen Cuscutae, pericarpium Granati, herba Sophorae Alopecuroidis, radix Clematidis, cortex erythrinae, faeces Bombycis and herba Saussureae Involueratae. The invention adopts pure Chinese herbal medicines as raw materials, has proper compatibility of the components, clear mechanism, synergistic effect and good effect of treating rheumatic swelling and pain, and has obvious analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.

title_en: Application of lycium barbarum glycopeptide in preparing medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to application of lycium barbarum glycopeptides in preparation of a medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Experimental results show that the medlar glycopeptide is applied to the preparation of the medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Specifically, the medlar glycopeptide slows down the weight reduction of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the life cycle of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the disease course of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, and down regulates the relative expression quantity of the lumbar spinal cord inflammatory factor of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity eucommia ulmoides leaf total flavonoids and application of high-purity eucommia ulmoides leaf total flavonoids in aspect of osteoporosis resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-purity eucommia ulmoides leaf total flavonoids and application thereof in the aspect of osteoporosis resistance, and relates to the field of biological medicines. The preparation method comprises pulverizing folium Eucommiae, adding into 55-65% ethanol solution, soaking for 0.5-5 hr, flash extracting for 2 times, filtering, concentrating the filtrate under reduced pressure, lyophilizing, concentrating with NKA-9 macroporous resin, and purifying with polyamide resin to obtain folium Eucommiae total flavonoids. The eucommia ulmoides leaf total flavone provided by the invention can effectively improve bone density, bone volume fraction, bone trabecula number and bone formation index serum osteocalcin level of rats with peak bone mass, can reduce bone trabecula separation degree and bone absorption index serum anti-tartaric acid phosphatase 5b activity, can also improve bone formation of rats and inhibit bone absorption, further influences bone metabolism, shows that the osteoporosis resisting effect of the eucommia ulmoides leaf total flavone is obvious, and can be used as a potential osteoporosis resisting medicine.

title_en: Chicken bacillus strain with salpingitis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chicken bacillus salpingitis (Gallibacterium salpingitidis) GS FC22 strain and application thereof. The chicken bacillus tubulosis GS FC22 strain is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) at the year 2022, 07 and 11, and the preservation number is CCTCC NO: m20221076. The invention adopts the GS FC22 strain to successfully construct the model of the laying duck infected with chicken bacillosis, and proves the pathogenicity of the GS FC22 strain to the reproductive system of the laying duck; the GS FC22 strain is prepared into the inactivated vaccine, has the characteristics of low production cost, good safety, good immune effect and the like, can obviously improve the egg laying performance and clinical symptoms of the laying ducks after immunization, reduce the drop of the egg laying rate and the rise of the number of defective eggs, has better immune protection effect, and provides a new thought and method for preventing and controlling the reproductive tract diseases of the laying ducks.

title_en: Aspergillus fumigatus AF-hypo gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses aspergillus fumigatus AF‑hypo Genes and application thereof, which belong to the field of genetic engineering. The technical key points of the invention are as follows: aspergillus fumigatus AF‑hypo Gene, aspergillus fumigatus AF‑hypo The nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. Aspergillus fumigatus of the invention AF‑   hypo The gene can be used as a design target of a targeted drug or applied to screening aspergillosisIs used for treating the disease. AF‑hypo The gene deletion results in an increased sensitivity of aspergillus fumigatus to voriconazole. Clinically if it is to be AF‑hypo The use amount of voriconazole can be reduced and better therapeutic effect can be achieved after the expression quantity of the gene is regulated downwards. The composition has extremely high application value for treating clinical deep aspergillus fumigatus infection, in particular to drug-resistant aspergillus infection.

title_en: Carboxylic acid modified silica aerogel, preparation method and application thereof, and drug delivery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a carboxylic acid modified silicon dioxide aerogel, a preparation method and application thereof, and a drug delivery system, and relates to the technical field of aerogels. According to the invention, the silica gel is subjected to surface hydrophobic modification to introduce hydrophobic groups, hydrophilic group hydroxyl groups are introduced through roasting, amino groups are introduced through amination reaction, and carboxyl groups are introduced through reaction with acid anhydride, so that the carboxyl modified silica aerogel is obtained. The carboxylic acid modified silica aerogel prepared by the method contains a large amount of hydrophilic groups-carboxyl groups, so that the adsorption capacity of drugs (especially polar drug active compounds) is greatly improved, and the problem of low drug loading capacity of the surface hydrophobic modified aerogel is solved. In addition, the carboxyl can form a stable chemical bond with the medicine, so that the release speed of the medicine is obviously reduced, the loss of the medicine is avoided, the dissolution rate and bioavailability of the medicine (especially the medicine with low water solubility) are further improved, and the medicine has good application prospect as a medicine carrier.

title_en: Salt and crystal form of nitrogen-containing heterocyclic derivative, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A salt and crystal form of nitrogen-containing heterocyclic derivative, and a preparation method and application thereof. In particular, it relates to salts and crystalline forms of the compounds of general formula (I), wherein each substituent in general formula (I) is as defined in the specification, a preparation method and a pharmaceutical composition containing a therapeutically effective amount of the crystalline form, and the use of the crystalline form as KRAS G12C mutation inhibitor in treating diseases or conditions such as leukemia, neuroblastoma, melanoma, breast cancer, lung cancer and colon cancer.

title_en: IL-8 antibodies and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes anti-IL-8 antibodies, compositions of anti-IL-8 antibodies, and methods of use thereof. The anti-IL-8 antibodies can be used in methods of inhibiting tumor formation or growth or a combination thereof. The disclosure also describes methods of using anti-IL-8 antibodies in methods of treatment of diseases, wherein the diseases may include cancer, tumor, or viral infection.

title_en: Application of traditional Chinese medicine composition in preparation of products for improving intestinal health of weaned pigs
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of feed additives, and particularly relates to application of a traditional Chinese medicine composition in preparation of a product for improving intestinal health of weaned pigs. The Chinese medicinal composition is a residue of the mulberry chrysanthemum, and comprises the raw materials of 400-600 parts of selfheal, 150-200 parts of mulberry leaves and 60-100 parts of wild chrysanthemum, and is applied to the preparation of feed. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is added into feed, the addition amount is 0.5-5%, and the traditional Chinese medicine composition is used for promoting cell proliferation of intestinal tracts of weaned pigs, regulating intestinal flora, treating diarrhea of the pigs, improving liver, kidney and/or muscle health of the weaned pigs and regulating immunity of organisms. The application of the invention shows that the grass mulberry chrysanthemum slag has remarkable improvement effect on the growth performance and intestinal health of weaned pigs, and provides support for the application of the grass mulberry chrysanthemum slag in the weaned pigs.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid derivative, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hyaluronic acid derivative shown in a formula I, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing anti-infective drugs, and the compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and commercially available hyaluronic acid substances such as TCIsHA and R&The structure of DHA is significantly different, which can form the molecular structure recognized by HepSS-1. The novel molecule can play an anti-infective role by inhibiting the combination of SARS-Cov-2 spike protein and host cell ACE2, and compared with heparin, the novel molecule is not easy to cause serious adverse reactions such as hemorrhage and thrombocytopenia clinically.

title_en: Bionic cell membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a bionic cell membrane, a preparation method and application thereof. The bionic cell membrane comprises a membrane skeleton and membrane proteins; at least a portion of the membrane scaffold is polymerized from a membrane scaffold molecule and a cross-linking agent, the membrane protein being locked in the membrane scaffold formed from the membrane scaffold molecule and the cross-linking agent. Compared with the prior art, the application has at least one of the following beneficial effects: the structure of the bionic cell membrane is locked at the selected time and region through photochemical reaction, the physiological activity of the membrane protein is regulated and controlled, the normal function of the membrane protein is maintained, the bionic cell membrane with high mechanical strength is provided, and the type and the quantity of the membrane protein self-assembled into the bionic cell membrane are accurately controlled.

title_en: Preparation method of octreotide-loaded human serum albumin nanoparticle
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a human serum albumin-loaded octreotide nanoparticle, which can effectively realize the compounding of human serum albumin and polypeptide drugs such as octreotide containing amino by introducing a heterobifunctional cross-linking agent containing two functional groups of N-hydroxysuccinimide ester and maleimide; the preparation method of the octreotide-loaded human serum albumin nanoparticle, which is established by the invention, can obtain a polypeptide nano preparation with small and uniform particle size and good stability, and can be applied to oral preparations, dry powder inhalation preparations, subcutaneous injection preparations and the like; the nanometer preparation can release polypeptide medicine in specific time under the action of human body, and has wide application prospect in the field of controlled release of polypeptide medicine.

title_en: Preparation method of acanthopanax extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an acanthopanax extract, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing acanthopanax leaves and auxiliary traditional Chinese medicines into powder, secondly adding a first eutectic solvent into a mixture of the acanthopanax powder and the auxiliary traditional Chinese medicines, placing the mixture in a microwave extraction machine for extraction, centrifuging to obtain a first clear solution and a first filter residue, thirdly adding a second eutectic solvent into the first filter residue obtained in the step II, placing the first filter residue in the microwave extraction machine for extraction and centrifugation to obtain a second clear solution and a second filter residue, fourthly adding a third eutectic solvent into the second filter residue obtained in the step III, placing the second filter residue in the microwave extraction machine for extraction and centrifugation to obtain a third clear solution and a third filter residue, and fifthly collecting the first clear solution, the second clear solution and the third clear solution for decompression concentration and spray drying to obtain the acanthopanax extract. The invention can simultaneously extract flavonoid, acanthopanaxoside B, acanthopanaxoside E and isofraxidin.

title_en: Isoindolinyl-piperazinyl urea compound, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an isoindolinyl-piperazinyl urea compound, a preparation method and application thereof, and the isoindolinyl-piperazinyl urea compound contains a mother nucleus group with biological activity, which is further chemically modified to generate a plurality of compounds with higher biological activity, so that the wide application of the compound in biological medicine and the development prospect of pharmaceutical preparations are expanded. The compound can obviously inhibit proliferation of cells such as breast cancer, liver cancer, pancreatic cancer, gastric cancer and the like at low dose (nanomole), and can effectively inhibit growth of transplanted tumors in mice, so that the compound has a prospect of being developed into antitumor drugs.

title_en: Compounds and methods for ameliorating or treating coronavirus infection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to anti-coronavirus compounds. The present invention includes a method for preventing and/or treating coronavirus infection by inhibiting the cysteine protease in viruses, particularly SARS-COV-2. Also provided are compositions/pharmaceutical compositions for preventing and/or treating coronavirus infections comprising any of the compounds, pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof or mixtures thereof, and uses of the compounds.

title_en: Preparation method of starch microgel mugwort leaf polysaccharide nano-selenium and starch microgel mugwort leaf polysaccharide nano-selenium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of materials, and provides a preparation method of starch microgel mugwort leaf polysaccharide nano-selenium. The microgel blumea polysaccharide nano-selenium is synthesized jointly on the basis of purifying the blumea polysaccharide, and the obtained microgel blumea polysaccharide nano-selenium has unique size effect and surface effect, lower toxicity and better bioavailability.

title_en: HSD17B13 inhibitors and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are compounds that are inhibitors of HSD17B13, methods of making such compounds, pharmaceutical compositions and medicaments comprising such compounds, and methods of using such compounds to treat conditions, diseases, or disorders associated with HSD17B13 activity.

title_en: Five-flavor disinfection drink preparation for osteomyelitis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a five-flavor disinfection drink preparation for osteomyelitis, which comprises the following raw materials: honeysuckle, wild chrysanthemum, dandelion, viola philippica, gynura bicolor, frankincense, borneol and phytosterol. The preparation method of the five-flavor disinfection drink preparation for osteomyelitis comprises the following steps: mixing flos Lonicerae, flos Chrysanthemi Indici, herba Taraxaci, herba Violae, and radix Semiaquilegiae, grinding, and sieving; soaking the above products in water for 1-5 hr, boiling with strong fire, adding Olibanum and Borneolum Syntheticum, decocting with slow fire for 5-15 hr, and filtering to obtain medicinal liquid alpha; adding water into the filter residue, boiling with strong fire, continuing boiling with slow fire for 2-4h, and filtering to obtain medicinal liquid beta; mixing the medicinal liquid alpha and the medicinal liquid beta, concentrating into soft extract, drying, pulverizing, adding into distilled water together with plant sterol, and stirring to obtain five-ingredient disinfectant beverage preparation for osteomyelitis.

title_en: Medical ray protection spray
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical ray protection spray which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: the superoxide dismutase SOD 0.01 g-0.2 g, recombinant human leucocyte IL-12.000005 g-0.000010g, trideceth-1.01 g-10 g, mannitol 3.0 g-6.0 g, antibacterial peptide 0.01 g-5.0 g and water for injection 76 g-82 g.

title_en: Crystal form, preparation method and application of nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystal form of a nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a crystal form C of a compound 1, and discloses a preparation method, a composition and application thereof in preparing medicines. The crystal form has good stability and high bioavailability.

title_en: Application of 1-O-acetyl-6-O-isobutyryl inula flower lactone in preparation of medicine for preventing and treating asthma
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of 1-O-acetyl-6-O-isobutyryl inula flower lactone in preparing a medicine for preventing and treating asthma, belonging to the technical field of biomedical engineering. The invention provides 1-O-acetyl-6-O-isobutyryl inula flower lactone for the first time, has the function of preventing and treating asthma, and in vivo and in vitro experiments prove that the 1-O-acetyl-6-O-isobutyryl inula flower lactone has strong anti-inflammatory effect, lower cytotoxicity and obvious nitric oxide inhibition activity, can effectively improve the lung function of an asthma organism, reduce the content of ovalbumin specific IgE in serum of the asthma organism, can reduce the expression of mucin 5ACmRNA, and has the function of resisting asthma by inhibiting a PI3K/AKT/MEK/ERK signal pathway.

title_en: Application of active part of ligusticum chuanxiong hort in preparation of anti-gout drugs
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to a traditional Chinese medicine active site and application thereof, and in particular relates to application of a ligusticum wallichii active site in preparation of anti-gout medicines. The application provides that the active site of ligusticum wallichii for inhibiting XOD (xanthine oxidase) is an ethyl acetate site, the site mainly comprises medium and small polar lipophilic components, mainly comprises phthalides, and experiments prove that the site has the anti-gout effect. Further, the application provides an anti-gout medicine or health care product containing the active site of the ligusticum wallichii.

title_en: Compound radix puerariae, radix scutellariae and coptis chinensis soup, and method and effect thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction, a method and an effect thereof, 1) a non-alcoholic fatty liver disease mouse model is established, 2) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease metagenome and metabonomics analysis, 3) the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root decoction is used for improving the lipid disorder of the non-alcoholic fatty liver disease through the regulation and control of TGR5 by intestinal flora metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid, and then a liver cancer cell line lipid deposition model is established; 4) Bacterial outer vesicles can localize to the liver and exert biological effects on non-alcoholic fatty liver disease; the invention discovers that the compound kudzuvine root, baical skullcap root and coptis root soup can improve host NAFLD diseases through AKK bacteria and metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid; akk the metabolite 3-phenylpropionic acid may improve NAFLD lipid disorders through TGR5 modulation.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating tumor bone metastasis and reducing osteoporosis and/or toxic and side effects of chemotherapy, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating tumor bone metastasis and reducing osteoporosis and/or chemotherapy toxic and side effects, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine composition is prepared by extracting the following traditional Chinese medicine raw materials in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of spatholobus stem, 20-80 parts of astragalus, 10-30 parts of glossy privet fruit and 2-10 parts of liquorice. The invention also provides a pharmaceutical composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of the traditional Chinese medicine composition and docetaxel.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for improving sleep quality and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular relates to a pharmaceutical composition for improving sleep quality, and a preparation method and application thereof. The medicine composition comprises, by mass, 90-120 parts of codonopsis pilosula, 225-300 parts of caulis polygoni multiflori, 225-300 parts of cortex albiziae, 110-150 parts of ligusticum wallichii, 150-200 parts of semen ziziphi spinosae, 75-100 parts of radix ophiopogonis, 75-100 parts of rhizoma anemarrhenae, 75-100 parts of longan pulp and 225-300 parts of fructus Tritici Levis.
