Retrospective disease analysis of the pharmaceutical composition shows that the pharmaceutical composition can comprehensively improve the sleeping conditions of insomnia patients with deficiency-cold type, including improving total sleep quality score, improving daytime dysfunction conditions of the patients, reducing hypnotic drug use of the patients, improving sleep disorder, improving sleeping efficiency, reducing sleeping time and improving sleeping quality, and has good safety.

title_en: Pellet type omeprazole enteric capsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pellet-type omeprazole enteric capsule and a preparation method thereof, wherein the pellet-type omeprazole enteric capsule comprises a drug-containing pellet, an isolation layer and an enteric layer, wherein the drug-containing pellet comprises omeprazole, carboxymethyl chitosan, low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose, an adhesive, a filler and a stabilizer, the mass ratio of the omeprazole to the carboxymethyl chitosan to the low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose is 1:0.2-0.4:0.05-0.25, the pellet-type omeprazole enteric capsule does not contain an organic solvent or a surfactant, the auxiliary materials are simple, the pellet particle size is uniform, the roundness is good, the surface smoothness is good, the omeprazole enteric capsule is not easy to break, and the drug release effect is stable.

title_en: Use of Siro-Ronii in combination with antimetabolite chemotherapeutic agents for the treatment of breast cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to an application of Siro-Raney combined with an antimetabolite chemotherapeutic drug in treating breast cancer. The invention provides the use of a pharmaceutical composition comprising Siro-lonib or a derivative thereof and an antimetabolite chemotherapeutic agent in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment and/or prophylaxis of breast cancer. The invention is proved by in vitro tumor cell survival rate test experiments: the antitumor active ingredient 5 '-deoxy-5-fluorocytidine (5' -DFCR) or 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) of the combination of sirolimus and Capecitabine (CAP) can synergistically inhibit the survival of human triple negative breast cancer cells HCC 1395. Clinical experiments prove that the Siro-Ni combined antimetabolite chemotherapeutic medicament has excellent curative effect and controllable safety in patients with advanced triple negative breast cancer which fail to be treated by anthracyclines and taxanes.

title_en: Feed additive, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feed additive, which comprises 0.01-100% of herba Sonchi arvensis extract by mass fraction, and can also comprise one or more of 0.1-20% of plant flavone, 1.0-50% of fatty acid and 10-90% of auxiliary materials by mass fraction. The feed additive simplifies the components, but can enhance the autoimmune capability of animals, and can resist oxidation, viruses and various bacteria and viruses; meanwhile, the meat yield and the quality of meat products can be improved. The feed additive containing the common sow thistle extract provided by the invention can enhance the autoimmune capability of animals, resist oxidation and viruses and resist various bacteria and viruses when being used for feeding livestock and poultry fishes.

title_en: Method for stir-frying eight-ingredient powder before crushing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of eight-ingredient powder processing, in particular to a material frying method before eight-ingredient powder raw materials are crushed, a material frying device is designed aiming at the procedures that the eight-ingredient powder raw materials such as dangshen and white atractylodes rhizome are required to be mixed and fried with auxiliary materials such as rice or wheat bran before superfine crushing, and then the raw materials and the auxiliary materials are separated, and the material frying device is matched with a specific material frying method, so that the efficient operation of raw materials and auxiliary materials can be realized, and particularly, a lifting guide cylinder and guide block structure with a specific structure is designed, so that the raw materials and the auxiliary materials can be efficiently, completely separated and respectively collected, the processing continuity of the front batch and the rear batch of the raw materials for frying is better, when the guide block moves downwards to a third state, the guide plate can move upwards to a first state, and the next batch of raw materials can be put into a material frying pot for frying while the last batch of raw materials fall to a material receiving disc for collection, and the processing efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Exosome diagnosis and treatment agent based on M2 microglial cells, preparation method and application thereof in preparation of medical imaging probes
abstract_en: The invention provides an exosome diagnosis and treatment agent based on M2 microglial cells, a preparation method and application thereof in preparing a medical imaging probe, and the exosome from the M2 microglial cells is prepared, and small molecule ligands capable of targeting cerebral neurons are marked and modified, so that the exosome diagnosis and treatment agent can be specifically used for high-dose initiative in cerebral stroke areasTargeting migration improves the detention capability of an exosome diagnosis and treatment agent in a cerebral apoplexy region and improves the healing efficacy of the exosome diagnosis and treatment agent on the cerebral apoplexy region. For the first time realize fluorescent dye and SPECT signal radionuclide  125  I and magnetic resonance T  2  The direct co-labeling of the weighted contrast agent superparamagnetic iron oxide without chelating agent meets the requirements of fluorescence imaging, nuclear medicine and magnetic resonance imaging equipment on the multi-mode imaging probe, realizes noninvasive, accurate, real-time and dynamic in-vivo monitoring of migration, homing and distribution conditions of exosome diagnosis and treatment agents in a target area under different administration routes, and simultaneously evaluates treatment effects so as to adjust administration time, realize effective repair of cerebral apoplexy and further improve treatment effects.

title_en: Anti-inflammatory powder glue solution and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-inflammatory powder glue solution and a preparation process thereof. The liquid medicine adopts cannabidiol, is prepared into micro powder with the grain diameter of about 1 micron by a physical mode, and is dispersed into water to prepare the cannabidiol water-dispersible liquid medicine. The liquid medicine is coated on the surfaces of fiber and paper by spray coating, dip coating, knife coating and other modes, and is dried to prepare a finished product, and then the finished product is further processed into the health care material. In the application process, cannabidiol floats from the surface of the base material by wetting sweat and the like in the process of contacting with skin, and plays roles of sterilizing, diminishing inflammation and easing pain in the process of contacting with skin.

title_en: Anti-aging composition containing collagen and application thereof in premature senility
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-aging composition comprising collagen and its use in premature aging. According to the invention, the collagen peptide with the functions of resisting oxidation and aging is prepared by separating the Engraulis japonicus Temminck et Schlegel skin, and after the collagen peptide is used together with the prepared PTEN monoclonal antibody, the aging of endothelial cells in a high-sugar environment can be effectively inhibited, so that the collagen peptide has a better application for resisting aging of blood vessels of diabetics. Has excellent application value.

title_en: Enhanced formulation stability and improved lyophilization process
abstract_en: The present application relates to an enhanced stability of pharmaceutical substances and an improved lyophilization process.

title_en: Prime Li Wei free base hemihydrate, its preparation method and use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to N- [5- (sulfamoyl) -4-methyl-1, 3-thiazol-2-yl ] -N-methyl-2- [4- (2-pyridyl) -phenyl ] -acetamide free base hemihydrate, process for its manufacture and its use. In particular, the invention relates to the use of the above compounds in the treatment of herpes virus infections in humans and in the manufacture of medicaments comprising said compounds. The present invention is in the field of antiviral agents.

title_en: Bisindole biphenyl compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bisindole biphenyl compound, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of chemical medicines, wherein the structural general formula of the compound is shown as a formula (I), the preparation method of the compound is to take bisindole biphenyl compound obtained by fermenting wood bamboo endophytic fungi GZWMJZ-258 as a raw material, and the bisindole biphenyl compound is prepared by alkylation and glycosylation modification, has strong inhibitory activity on human acute myelogenous cell strain MV4-11, has weak inhibitory effect on human normal liver cells L-02, and can be applied to preparing medicines for preventing and treating leukemia.

title_en: Broad-spectrum long-acting safe polymeric capsule disinfectant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a broad-spectrum long-acting safe polymeric capsule disinfectant, a preparation method and application thereof. In a first aspect the present invention provides a broad spectrum long-acting safe polymeric capsule disinfectant comprising a first capsule and a second capsule. The disinfectant provided by the invention has good disinfection and sterilization effects on human skin or mucous membrane, object surfaces, fabrics and air, and can inhibit pathogen reproduction and regeneration to achieve the purpose of preventing infection while killing pathogens because the sterilization rate of the disinfectant for 30 days or even 90 days still keeps the long-term effect of more than 99.9 percent.

title_en: Multifunctional AIE optical diagnosis and treatment molecule, azide compound thereof, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional AIE optical diagnosis and treatment molecule, an azide compound, a synthesis method and application thereof. Meanwhile, the multifunctional optical diagnosis and treatment molecule is further subjected to azide modification, so that covalent bonding of the multifunctional optical diagnosis and treatment molecule with functional groups such as polypeptide, DNA, small molecule compounds and the like can be realized. The multifunctional AIE optical diagnosis and treatment molecule has multifunction and can carry out near infrared fluorescence imaging, photodynamic therapy and photothermal therapy on tumors.

title_en: IRAK4 degrading agent and use thereof
abstract_en: IRAK4 degradation agents, formulations and unit dosage forms thereof, and methods of use thereof are provided.

title_en: Dual cleavage ester linkers for antibody-drug conjugates
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides antibody-drug conjugate structures, wherein the antibody-drug conjugate comprises a cleavable linker comprising an ester group linking the antibody to the drug. The present disclosure also encompasses compounds and methods for producing such conjugates. In addition, the present disclosure also encompasses pharmaceutical compositions and methods of using the conjugates.

title_en: Microsphere for long-acting slow release of medicine, medicine-carrying microsphere, preparation method and application of medicine-carrying microsphere
abstract_en: The application relates to a microsphere for long-acting slow release of a drug, a drug-carrying microsphere, a preparation method and application of the drug-carrying microsphere, wherein the microsphere for long-acting slow release of the drug comprises a biodegradable polymer matrix, and at least one part of a molecular chain of the biodegradable polymer is crosslinked through disulfide bonds; at least a portion of the biodegradable polymer molecular chains have end groups containing mercapto groups or disulfide bonds, such that the disulfide bonds formed by the biodegradable polymer molecular chains via disulfide bonds of the end groups reacting with the catalyst crosslink with each other, or such that the biodegradable polymer molecular chains form disulfide-bond crosslinks via autoxidation of mercapto groups of the end groups. The microsphere for the long-acting slow release of the medicine in the technical scheme of the application takes the biodegradable polymer as a microsphere matrix, and the molecular chain of the biodegradable polymer crosslinked through disulfide bonds can increase the molecular weight and the structural stability of the polymer matrix, thereby inhibiting the hydrolysis of the biodegradable polymer and further delaying the degradation rate of the microsphere.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating acute lung injury and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating acute lung injury, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines and the field of pharmacotherapeutics. The composition comprises an active ingredient and/or a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier; the active ingredients comprise the following components in parts by weight: 37.7 to 74.1 parts of scutellarin, 15.1 to 29.6 parts of isoalantolactone, 30.1 to 59.3 parts of chlorogenic acid, 150.6 to 296.3 parts of malic acid, 37.7 to 74.1 parts of 3-indoleacetic acid and 7.5 to 14.8 parts of vitamin B. The application provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating acute lung injury and/or acute respiratory distress syndrome, which has the advantages of simple formula, clear components and excellent effect. The effective components only comprise six groups of scutellarin, isoalantolactone, chlorogenic acid, malic acid, 3-indoleacetic acid and vitamin B2, and the raw materials are safe, environment-friendly, easy to purchase, simple to prepare and particularly suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Diaryl methane derivative containing indolizine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diarylmethane derivative containing indolizine, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the diarylmethane derivative has the following structural formula: wherein R is  1  Selected from acyl groups; r is R  2  Selected from phenyl, substituted phenyl or C1-C5 alkyl; r is R  3  Selected from C1-C5 alkyl, halogen or hydrogen; r is R  4  Selected from p-toluenesulfonyl, p-nitrobenzenesulfonyl, benzenesulfonyl or t-butoxycarbonyl. The inventionThe diarylmethane compound containing the indolizine contains the indolizine and benzofuran or indole, has antibacterial and anticancer activities, can be used as an intermediate for synthesizing other functional organic molecules, and has important value for organic synthesis and drug research and development.

title_en: Anti-infective dosage forms for the production of nasal washes
abstract_en: A single dose, water-soluble or water-miscible dosage form for the manufacture of a nasal rinse comprising at least one anti-infective pharmaceutical ingredient for topical treatment of the human nose. Single dose disposable containers comprising the single dose, water-soluble or water-miscible dosage form, wherein the disposable containers are preferably selected from the group consisting of bags, ampoules, packs and syringes. Use of the single dose, water-soluble or water-miscible dosage form for the manufacture of a nasal rinse. The use of the single dose, water-soluble or water-miscible dosage form in a device for introducing a liquid into the nose of a human, preferably in a nasal irrigator. A nasal rinse comprising at least one anti-infective drug component selected from the group consisting of acyclic alcohols, quaternary ammonium compounds, iodine-containing compounds, halogenated compounds, quinoline derivatives, benzoquinone derivatives, phenol derivatives, and combinations thereof.

title_en: Urea compound, preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to urea compounds, methods for their preparation and their use in medicine. Specifically, the disclosure relates to urea compounds shown in a general formula (I), a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compounds, and application of the compounds as 3CL protease inhibitors in treating diseases or conditions related to 3CL protease activity. Wherein each group in the general formula (I) is defined in the specification.

title_en: Epitope peptide of TrkA and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an epitope peptide of TrkA and application thereof, wherein the epitope peptide comprises the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO:4, and a polypeptide having the amino acid sequence shown in (a) and (b). According to the invention, the dominant epitope of the TrkA antigen is obtained through hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, and the anti-TrkA antibody specifically combined with the dominant epitope can block the combination of a TrkA receptor and ligand NGF thereof, inhibit or weaken NGF/TrKA signal transmission participated by the TrkA, thereby effectively relieving pain and hyperalgesia.

title_en: Method for inhibiting content of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural in rhizoma polygonati processed product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine processing, and relates to an ultrasonic auxiliary extraction method of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural in a rhizoma polygonati processed product and a method for inhibiting the content of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural in the rhizoma polygonati processed product. The ultrasonic extraction method provided by the invention has the advantage that the extraction rate of the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural is 0.42%. The method for inhibiting the content of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural in the rhizoma polygonati processed product finally selects the optimal process that the concentration of L-cysteine is 6g/L, the soaking time is 20min and the soaking temperature is 28 ℃. The result shows that the reduction of the content of the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural is 77.28%, the process condition of the invention is stable, the extraction rate of the 5-hydroxymethylfurfural is obviously increased, the content is obviously reduced, the method is simple to operate, the safety is good, the market prospect is wide, and the method has good industrial practicability.

title_en: Chiral iron-containing super-particle nano material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in magnetic resonance contrast agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chiral iron-containing super-particle nano material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a magnetic resonance contrast agent, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic nano material modification. The chiral iron-containing super-particle nano-material is prepared from chiral small molecular compounds and oleic acid modified ferromagnetic-containing nano-particles under the condition of emulsification and solvent volatilization; the chiral small molecule compound is a chiral molecule containing sulfhydryl or amino or carboxyl. The chiral iron-based contrast agent has a circular dichroism signal and a magnetic resonance signal, the chiral ligand can be combined with iron atoms in the ferroferric oxide nano particles strongly, oleic acid molecules on the surfaces of the ferroferric oxide can be replaced, the surfaces of the magnetic nano particles are induced to distort, chiral optical activity is further generated, and the chiral ligand on the surfaces of the particles can change the magnetic relaxation capacity of the chiral iron-based contrast agent and enhance the imaging capacity of the chiral iron-based contrast agent in tumor tissues of living mice. The chiral iron-containing super-particle nano material is simple and convenient to synthesize and operate and high in biological safety.

title_en: Triazole external medicine assembly
abstract_en: A triazole external medicine component relates to the technical field of external preparations of triazole antifungal medicines, and aims to solve the stability problem of an efroconazole external preparation taking BHA as an antioxidant on one hand and the technical problems of troublesome operation and poor bottle opening sealing property of a toenail brush on the other hand. The medicine component comprises triazole external solution and a smearing type medicine feeder for smearing the triazole external solution on an affected part, wherein the triazole external solution comprises efroconazole, edetic acid or salts thereof, citric acid, butyl hydroxy anisole, C12-15 alcohol lactate, diisopropyl adipate, cyclomethicone, water and ethanol, the weight percentage of the butyl hydroxy anisole is 0.025-0.05%, the smearing type medicine feeder comprises a bottle body, an inner plug, a columnar brush and a dust cover, and the triazole external solution is arranged in the bottle body. The triazole external medicine component can be applied to pharmaceutical enterprises to produce and manufacture stable efroconazole external preparations.

title_en: Method for treating cartilage injury by mesenchymal stem cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for treating cartilage injury by mesenchymal stem cells. According to the invention, the polypeptide NOS-S2 which specifically targets and inhibits NOS activity is screened by the phage library, and the polypeptide can effectively inhibit the apoptosis of cartilage cells after cartilage injury so as to promote the repair of cartilage injury. The polypeptide and the bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells can be combined to remarkably improve the treatment effect, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Topical roflumilast formulations with antifungal properties
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of treating a fungal infection comprising topically administering to a subject in need thereof an antifungal effective amount of roflumilast. Preferably, the topically applied roflumilast is used to treat fungal infections, fungal growth and/or allergy to the fungus malassezia. The patient may also have seborrheic dermatitis, dandruff, dulcit Li Youshan against facial redness, tinea versicolor, pityriasis versicolor, tinea corporis, onychomycosis, tinea manus, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, facial tinea, tinea capitis, and/or unidentified tinea. Topically applied roflumilast is a fast and effective antifungal agent and represents a viable alternative to current antifungal therapies.

title_en: Composition for treating allergic rhinitis asthma syndrome and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and discloses a composition for treating allergic rhinitis and asthma syndrome and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition comprises the following medicines: the Chinese medicinal composition comprises fish brain, clove, elecampane, grassleaf sweelflag rhizome, lightyellow sophora root, pseudo-ginseng, chinese thorowax root, common andrographis herb, ajuga herb and muskmelon pedicel. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple process, low cost and high efficiency, and is beneficial to pharmaceutical enterprises for medicine production and quality control; the product has low price and is easy to be accepted by patients.

title_en: Preparation method of Erdong decoction with high powder yield and Erdong decoction particles
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and particularly discloses a preparation method of Erdong decoction with high powder yield and Erdong decoction particles. According to the application, through research on each link in the preparation process of the Erdong decoction particles, the preparation process capable of obviously improving the dry paste rate and the dry paste powder yield is found, and the same high dry paste rate and dry paste powder yield can be ensured in pilot experiments, so that the loss of medicinal materials can be greatly reduced in the mass production process, and the production cost is reduced; and the improved process can be stably produced in actual pilot-scale production, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for synergistically relieving physical fatigue and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a pharmaceutical composition for synergistically relieving physical fatigue and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine health products. According to the application, through compatibility of the indigo honeysuckle with extracts of the wild jujube, the longan pulp, the lotus seed, the poria cocos, the lily, the rhizoma polygonati and the guarana, the anti-fatigue effect of the indigo honeysuckle is further improved, the swimming time of a mouse can be remarkably improved, the blood lactic acid and blood urea nitrogen content in the body of the mouse are reduced, the liver glycogen and muscle glycogen content of the body of the mouse are improved, and the physical fatigue is fundamentally relieved.

title_en: Acylated collagen, acylated collagen preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural active collagen modification, in particular to an acylated collagen, an acylated collagen preparation and application thereof, wherein the acylated collagen is obtained by modifying acid anhydride, the natural active collagen is dissolved in an acid solution, the pH is regulated, a certain amount of acid anhydride is added, stirring is required in the reaction process, the pH is regulated and a certain temperature is maintained, the stable environment is ensured in the reaction process, dialysis or ultrafiltration is carried out after the reaction is finished, and the acid anhydride modified acylated collagen is obtained after freeze drying and preservation. The acylated collagen preparation contains acylated collagen, and the acylated collagen preparation is used in preparing medicine or cosmetics for resisting inflammation, resisting oxidation, whitening skin and promoting collagen secretion. The acylated collagen prepared by the invention has good water solubility, retains the triple helix structure and biological activity of natural active collagen, has a certain potential for promoting cell proliferation and cell migration, and can be used for cell culture.

title_en: Acyclovir cream and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly relates to acyclovir cream and a preparation method thereof. The acyclovir emulsifiable paste disclosed by the invention comprises the following components in parts by weight: acyclovir, propylene glycol, cetyl alcohol, glyceryl monostearate, polyvinyl alcohol, cysteine, trehalose, and methylparaben. The problems of high content of related substances, poor oxidation resistance and the like of acyclovir are solved by optimizing the prescription, particularly the addition of polyvinyl alcohol, cysteine and trehalose, and the problems of low pH value and high skin irritation of acyclovir emulsifiable paste are solved by optimizing the preparation process.

title_en: Trispecific and/or trivalent binding proteins for the prevention or treatment of HIV infection
abstract_en: The present application provides compositions comprising trispecific and/or trivalent binding proteins comprising 4 polypeptide chains forming 3 antigen binding sites that specifically bind one or more HIV target proteins or one or more T cell receptors, wherein a first pair of polypeptides forming the binding proteins has a dual variable domain with cross-over orientation, and wherein a second pair of polypeptides forming the binding proteins has a single variable domain. Also provided herein are methods for preparing trispecific and/or trivalent binding proteins and the use of such binding proteins for the treatment and/or prevention of HIV/AIDS.

title_en: Recombinant feline herpesvirus vaccine for expressing feline calicivirus VP1 gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a recombinant feline herpesvirus vaccine expressing a feline calicivirus VP1 gene and application thereof. Wherein, the recombinant feline herpesvirus strain takes FHV genome deleted of gI/gE gene as skeleton, and inserts FCV VP1 gene into FHV genome deleted of gI/gE gene. The recombinant feline herpesvirus genetic engineering vaccine FHV delta gI/gE FCV VP1 strain can generate specific antibodies aiming at feline calicivirus by immunized kittens, and is hopeful to be used as vaccine candidate strain for effectively preventing and treating feline herpesvirus and feline calicivirus.

title_en: Bacillus marinus BH03 and application thereof in preparation of antioxidant and anti-aging products
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus marinus BH03 and application thereof in preparation of antioxidant and anti-aging products, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The bacillus marinus BH03 disclosed by the invention has the potential of obviously reducing the ROS level in the zebra fish body and obviously improving the SOD activity in the zebra fish body in a zebra fish oxidative stress model, and provides theoretical reference and guiding basis for developing an antioxidant probiotic preparation by utilizing bacillus marinus BH 03.

title_en: Salvianolic acid B and/or Notoginseng radix total saponin composition and its application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salvianolic acid B and/or total arasaponin composition and application thereof. According to the invention, a lung cancer heart disease model experiment constructed by uratam and benzopyrene is used, and it is determined that salvianolic acid B and Panax notoginsenosides, especially salvianolic acid B combined with Panax notoginsenosides, can reduce the inner diameter of the end systole of the left ventricle and the left cardiac output, and reduce the thickness of the free wall of the right heart, the inner diameter of the end diastole of the right heart, the stroke volume of the right ventricle and the right cardiac output by increasing the ejection fraction of the left ventricle and the short axis shortening rate of the left ventricle, so that the heart function of a lung cancer heart disease mouse is improved. Under the condition that the heart function effect of a plurality of medicaments for treating heart-related diseases is poor for lung cancer heart diseases, the effect of improving the heart function of the salvianolic acid B combined with the total saponins of pseudo-ginseng is equivalent to that of the salmeterol xinafoate which is commonly used clinically at present, unexpected curative effects are obtained, and the medicament has wide application prospect.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition, aprepitant injection and freeze-dried powder injection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition, aprepitant injection and aprepitant freeze-dried powder injection. The pharmaceutical composition comprises aprepitant, a primary stabilizer and a secondary stabilizer, wherein the primary stabilizer comprises sodium deoxycholate, and the secondary stabilizer comprises povidone. The aprepitant injection provided by the invention can be injected and administrated, the dosage of auxiliary materials is greatly reduced, the irritation of the injection part is small when a patient uses the aprepitant injection, the hypersensitivity is difficult to occur, and the aprepitant injection is safer; the preparation has good stability, can be stored and transported at normal temperature, and greatly reduces the production, storage and transportation costs.

title_en: Ribonucleic acid and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses ribonucleic acid and application thereof. The ribonucleic acid has the length of 30nt-544nt, and both the 5' end and the 3' end of the ribonucleic acid have 2' -O-ribose modification. The ribonucleic acid can activate RIG-I, enhance IRF-7 and IFN-beta expression, and play an anti-tumor role. The application not only provides a new nucleic acid fragment for RIG-I receptor agonist, but also provides a new solution for tumor treatment.

title_en: Targeting multiple T cell types using spherical nucleic acid vaccine architecture
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to Spherical Nucleic Acids (SNAs), i.e., nanostructures with a core surrounded by radial presentation of oligonucleotides, that can target multiple classes of immune cells. Methods of making and using the nanoparticles are also provided herein. In some aspects, the present disclosure provides a Spherical Nucleic Acid (SNA) comprising: (a) a nanoparticle core; (b) An oligonucleotide shell attached to an outer surface of the nanoparticle core, the oligonucleotide shell comprising one or more immunostimulatory oligonucleotides; and (c) a first antigen that is a major histocompatibility complex type I (MHC-I) antigen and a second antigen that is a major histocompatibility complex type II (MHC-II) antigen.

title_en: Preparation method of monosaccharide silica nanoparticle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of monosaccharide silica nanoparticles, which comprises the following steps: and (3) placing an alkaline alcohol solution containing hydroxypropyl cellulose into ice water for cooling, then dropwise adding a monosaccharide solution under vortex conditions, mixing, placing into ice water for incubation, adding tetraethoxysilane after incubation, uniformly mixing, and placing to obtain the monosaccharide silica nanoparticle. The preparation method of the monosaccharide silica nanoparticle is simple and convenient, and the monosaccharide silica nanoparticle with good stability, regularity and specific particle size can be prepared; the monosaccharide silica nanoparticle has stable property and low cytotoxicity, can be used as a drug carrier for loading different drugs for cancer treatment, has good effect on loading different drug molecules for liver cancer treatment, and can provide basis for developing novel nano-preparations in the future.

title_en: Dahongpao freeze-dried tea powder solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foods and medicines, and provides a Dahongpao freeze-dried tea powder solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Dahongpao freeze-dried tea powder solid beverage comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-95 parts of Dahongpao freeze-dried tea powder and 5-60 parts of broccoli seed water extract. The invention is obtained by compounding food components, not only has no adverse reaction and dependence of medicines, but also can effectively protect liver and reduce blood sugar and blood fat.

title_en: Superfine pulverizing treatment method of blood lipid-lowering drug powder
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultrafine grinding treatment method of medicinal powder for reducing blood fat, and belongs to the technical field of medicine ultrafine grinding. Which comprises the following steps: (1) collecting the dried raw materials, wherein the raw materials are as follows: the ganoderma lucidum, the liquorice, the almond, the persimmon leaf, the mint leaf, the immature bitter orange, the perilla leaf and the myrobalan are stored in a shade, and the relative moisture content is kept below 20 percent; (2) The raw materials in the step (1) are firstly treated at high temperature, crushed into powder by a crusher and sieved to obtain coarse powder; (3) Pulverizing the coarse powder obtained in the step (2) by using a microcomputer, and sieving to obtain fine powder; (4) Grinding the fine powder obtained in the step (3) by using a ball mill, and sieving to obtain superfine powder. Proved by verification, the effect of reducing blood lipid of the medicament can be effectively improved.

title_en: Coronavirus antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isolated monoclonal antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof which binds to the receptor binding domain RBD of SARS-CoV-2 virus spike protein, comprising: amino acid sequences selected from any of the groups VHCDR1, VHCDR2, VHCDR3, and VLCDR1, VLCDR2, and VLCDR3 of table 1. The invention also discloses application of the monoclonal antibody or the antigen binding fragment thereof in preparing a medicament for treating or preventing virus infection. The antibody of the invention can be combined with the receptor binding region RBD of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein with high efficiency and specificity, and inhibit the infection of the novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2, and has important significance for the prevention and control of the epidemic situation of the novel coronavirus and wide application prospect.

title_en: Whole-plant fresh pseudo-ginseng wall-broken original pulp oral liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a whole plant fresh pseudo-ginseng wall-broken original pulp oral liquid and a preparation method thereof, which are applied to the field of oral liquid, wherein the whole plant fresh pseudo-ginseng original pulp oral liquid is prepared from the following materials: fresh notoginseng flower, fresh notoginseng stem and leaf, fresh notoginseng fibrous root or main root, lotus root starch, fresh yam, oyster peptide, edible sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO 3), alpha-amylase isoamylase, essence, parabens, stevioside or mogroside, honey and purified water; the preparation method comprises the steps of cleaning, cutting, curing and inactivating enzymes, fermenting and enhancing flavor, rolling and breaking walls, catalyzing and extracting sugar, stir-frying and converting, drying, alkalizing and rehydrating, pulping, cavitation wall breaking, emulsifying and homogenizing, filtering, concentrating and the like; the combination of pulping, cavitation wall breaking and emulsification homogenization technology can thoroughly break the wall of cells of materials, quickly release nutrition and effective substances, quickly convert rare saponins and polysaccharides, increase the amount of rare saponins and polysaccharides, and has the characteristics of good absorption, quick response, strong effect and the like.

title_en: Zanthoxylum bungeanum leaf composition and its coating agent
abstract_en: The invention provides a pepper and mugwort leaf composition, which consists of the following components: alcohol extract of pricklyash peel and mugwort leaf in mass ratio of 3:7; the alcohol extract is 60-80% alcohol extract. The invention discovers that the composition or the paint thereof has good antibacterial activity and antioxidant activity.

title_en: Medicine for treating acute upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicament for treating acute upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage, which is prepared from Japanese thistle herb, common cephalanoplos herb, cogongrass rhizome, garden burnet root charcoal, cattail pollen charcoal, pseudo-ginseng powder, rhizoma bletillae and hairyvein agrimony. The invention has the functions of cooling blood and stopping bleeding, removing blood stasis and stopping bleeding, astringing and stopping bleeding, and can be used for treating acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding caused by various diseases (such as gastroduodenal ulcer, esophageal gastric varices and the like), promoting hemostasis, preventing and treating bleeding, strengthening internal medicine hemostasis, stabilizing acute bleeding period illness state and shortening illness course.

title_en: Process development of antibacterial cefadroxil tablet for pets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process development of an antibacterial drug cefadroxil tablet for pets, which comprises 50 parts of cefadroxil, 49 parts of a disintegrating agent and 1 part of a lubricating agent by weight.

title_en: Memantine effectively intervenes in atrial fibrillation by targeting atrial cardiomyocyte glutamate receptors
abstract_en: The invention provides an effective intervention of memantine in atrial fibrillation by targeting atrial cardiomyocyte glutamate receptors. In particular, the invention provides the use of memantine or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof in the manufacture of a medicament for the prevention and/or treatment of atrial fibrillation. The active ingredient of the invention can effectively prevent and treat atrial fibrillation by targeting the atrial cardiomyocyte glutamate receptor.

title_en: Suspension containing radioactive microspheres and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a suspension containing radioactive microspheres, a preparation method and application thereof. The radioactive microsphere comprises resin microsphere and radionuclide loaded on the resin microsphere, wherein the material of the resin microsphere comprises at least one of polystyrene, polyethylene or polydivinylbenzene or a cross-linked polymer thereof, the average particle size of the radioactive microsphere is 25-40 mu m, and the distribution density of the microsphere in a tumor part is improved by controlling the non-spherical ratio of the radioactive microsphere to be within 5%, so that the killing effect on the tumor is improved, and the occurrence rate of adverse events can be reduced.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine monomer composition for preventing and controlling necrotic enteritis of chickens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine monomer composition, which mainly comprises citric acid and magnolol. Research shows that the medicine combination can effectively inhibit the growth of clostridium perfringens and the formation of a biological film in vitro, wherein citric acid and magnolol can play a synergistic effect when the weight ratio of citric acid to magnolol is 50:3. Meanwhile, in vivo experiment results show that necrotic enteritis symptoms of the yellow-feather broilers treated by the method are obviously relieved, and the method is improved in weight loss, feed conversion rate, lesion score, inflammatory factors and the like. Therefore, the traditional Chinese medicine monomer composition has a good effect of resisting clostridium perfringens infection, and enriches the theory of preventing and controlling clostridium perfringens infection. The application of the invention to replace antibiotics for treating necrotic enteritis of chickens can reduce the residue of the breeding medicines, create higher economic benefit and ensure the food safety of human beings.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating dilated cardiomyopathy with reduced ejection fraction and heart failure as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating dilated cardiomyopathy with reduced ejection fraction and heart failure, and a preparation method and application thereof. At present, no traditional Chinese medicine prescription for treating dilated cardiomyopathy complicated with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction is known. The traditional Chinese medicine composition comprises ginseng, red sage root, chinese angelica, cassia twig, stiff silkworm and corn silk, and is used for preparing a medicine for treating qi deficiency and blood stasis and yang deficiency type dilated cardiomyopathy complicated with ejection fraction reduced heart failure. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is used for treating dilated cardiomyopathy complicated with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, has remarkable effects on patients with qi deficiency, blood stasis and yang deficiency, fills the blank of traditional Chinese medicines for treating the symptoms, extracts active ingredients according to the modern extraction technology of traditional Chinese medicines, has the advantages of strong pertinence, good curative effect, short period and no toxic or side effect, and can quickly relieve clinical symptoms of the patients.

title_en: A topical Chinese medicinal composition for treating rhinitis, and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides an external traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating rhinitis and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines. A Chinese medicinal composition for external use for treating rhinitis comprises, by weight, 5-15g of magnolia flower, 12-24g of schizonepeta, 12-24g of radix sileris, 20-30g of rhizoma atractylodis, 4-12g of radix angelicae, 3-9g of periostracum cicada, 20-30g of radix puerariae and 12-24g of radix sophorae flavescentis. The externally applied traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating rhinitis has the effects of dispelling wind, dredging orifices, relieving itching and removing nasal discharge, and is mainly used for treating allergic rhinitis, acute and chronic rhinitis and nasosinusitis. The preparation method ensures that the traditional Chinese medicine composition not only can treat rhinitis, but also can improve the comfort level during administration.

title_en: Aryl-substituted nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compounds
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aryl substituted nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound which can be used as a SMARCA2 target inhibitor or a degradation agent. Specifically disclosed is a compound represented by the structure of formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, hydrate, isotopic substituent or isomer thereof. The structural compound of the formula (I) has an affinity or degradation effect on a SMARCA2 mutant target, particularly has a strong proliferation inhibition effect on SMARCA mutant cancer cells, and can be used for preparing medicaments or molecular probes for preventing or treating diseases (such as cancers, immune diseases and the like) related to SMARCA mutation (particularly SAMRCA4 mutation) signal paths.

title_en: Broad-spectrum antiviral composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a broad-spectrum antiviral composition, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The present invention provides a broad-spectrum antiviral composition comprising: beta-glucan, chitosan oligosaccharide and mannooligosaccharide. The broad-spectrum antiviral composition can effectively prevent and/or treat the lysis of various viruses on cells or the change of the morphology and the function of the cells, maintain the cells in a normal and good growth state, reduce the toxic action of the viruses on the cells, and further prevent and/or treat diseases caused by the infection of the cells by the various viruses. Further, the broad-spectrum antiviral composition provided by the invention has no damaging effect on normal cells. Accordingly, the broad-spectrum antiviral composition provided by the present invention can be used as a safe and effective broad-spectrum antiviral composition for preventing and/or treating viral infections.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating aids related prurigo and traditional Chinese medicine preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating aids related prurigo and a traditional Chinese medicine preparation thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines. The traditional Chinese medicine composition comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-25 parts of radix codonopsis pilosulae, 5-25 parts of dwarf lilyturf tuber, 5-25 parts of dried rehmannia root, 5-25 parts of figwort root, 5-25 parts of radix trichosanthis, 5-25 parts of bunge corydalis herb, 5-25 parts of red sage root, 5-20 parts of oldenlandia diffusa, 5-25 parts of selfheal, 5-20 parts of radix asparagi and 5-20 parts of liquorice. The traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating AIDS-related prurigo uses a pure traditional Chinese medicine preparation, avoids the irritation to the stomach of a patient and the toxic and side effects to the liver, is proved by a large number of people's practices, is safe and reliable, has no obvious adverse reaction, is simple in preparation method, has no pollution to the environment, and has great popularization and application values.

title_en: Porous copper-manganese bimetallic nano material applied to tumor immunotherapy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a porous copper-manganese bimetallic nano material applied to tumor immunotherapy and a preparation method thereof. The invention firstly obtains hollow mesoporous copper-manganese bimetallic nano-material with uniform particle size by a cuprous oxide self-template etching method, then loads photosensitizer IR820 by utilizing the excellent drug carrying capacity of the nano-material, and finally improves the dispersibility of nano-particles by modifying with sulfhydryl polyethylene glycol. The preparation method provided by the invention is stable and reliable, low in cost, wide in source, simple in process, practical, strong in operability and the like. The nano material has multifunction, can realize the cooperative treatment of photothermal treatment/photodynamic treatment/chemical dynamic treatment, simultaneously improve cell hypoxia, consume glutathione, remodel tumor microenvironment, finally induce tumor cell immunogenic death, strengthen the immune response of tumor cells, efficiently inhibit tumor growth and metastasis, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Composite nano medicine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nano biological medicine, and in particular relates to a folic acid targeting photodynamic composite nano medicine for treating hypoxic tumors and a preparation method and application thereof. Based on the unique advantages of the up-conversion nano material, the mesoporous silicon can be used for directly coating the medicine under different apertures, so that a large amount of photosensitizers and medicines can be loaded by using the pore channels, and the light-controlled medicine release can be realized. Because of the acidic environment of the tumor, finally, the acid response characteristic of the polymer is utilized, the drug is released after degradation, and the targeting substance is further added to realize the targeting of the tumor, thereby achieving the purpose of treating the tumor. Irradiation under 980nm near infrared light has deeper penetration depth, and after irradiation, oxygen is consumed by photodynamic, so that the oxygen deficiency of the tumor part is aggravated, and the prodrug is further activated, and the chemotherapy effect is enhanced.

title_en: Application of PRC2 complex as target in developing medicine for preventing and treating neurodegenerative diseases or central nerve injury diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a PRC2 complex serving as a target in developing a medicament for preventing and treating neurodegenerative diseases or central nerve injury diseases. The invention provides the use of a substance that inhibits the expression of a target gene and/or a substance that inhibits the activity of a target gene product and/or a substance that eliminates the level of H3K27me3 and/or a substance that reduces the level of H3K27me3 in the preparation of a medicament; the medicament is used for improving or treating diseases: neurodegenerative diseases or central nerve injury diseases; the target objects are: (a) PRC2 complex; (b) Any one unit or a combination of any several units used to make up the PRC2 complex. The inventor identifies that the PRC2 complex is a novel target for preventing and treating neurodegenerative diseases or central nerve injury diseases, and targeting the expression of the PRC2 complex gene or inhibiting the activity of the PRC2 complex gene product can obviously inhibit the neurodegenerative or nerve injury lesion process.

title_en: Nanometer medicinal preparation for treating urinary diseases, and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of medicines, and discloses a nano-medicinal preparation for treating urinary diseases and a preparation method thereof, wherein the medicinal preparation comprises, by mass, 100 parts of total raw material components, 10-20 parts of cordate houttuynia, 10-15 parts of plantain herb, 10-12 parts of dandelion, 10-12 parts of lysimachia christinae hance, 5-10 parts of purslane, 5-10 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 5-10 parts of honeysuckle, 4-8 parts of scutellaria baicalensis, 6-8 parts of virgate wormwood, 2-5 parts of polygonum cuspidatum, 1-5 parts of turtle shell, 1-5 parts of chinaroot greenbrier, 1-3 parts of perilla seed and 1-3 parts of fructus forsythiae. The invention extracts the active substances from the traditional Chinese medicine composition by a proper method, and combines the active substances with a polymer carrier to prepare a nano preparation, so that the reaction probability among different traditional Chinese medicine active substances can be reduced, and the nano preparation can be acted on a human body to slowly release and continuously act, and has good curative effect on urinary tract infection.

title_en: Rare earth complex for diagnosing and treating Alzheimer's disease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Rare earth complex for diagnosing and treating Alzheimer's disease and preparation method thereof, the structural formula of the complex is:  Wherein R is hydrogen atom or ethyl, ln is Gd or Dy or Nd metal ion. The invention has the advantage that the chiral DOTA molecule is combined with the curcumin molecule to develop a functional molecule which can be used for MRI or near infrared fluorescence detection of Abeta deposition in Alzheimer's disease.

title_en: Monensin premix and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of feed additives. The application discloses a monensin premix and a preparation method thereof. The monensin premix comprises monensin, a carrier, a surfactant, an adhesive, amino acid chelated trace elements, vitamin E, ascorbyl palmitate and coenzyme Q10. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1, stirring and mixing monensin and a carrier to obtain a mixture I, S2, heating and dissolving a binder in a water bath at 80-100 ℃, cooling to normal temperature, adding the mixture I and other raw materials, stirring and mixing to obtain a mixture II, S3, homogenizing the mixture II to obtain an intermediate product, and S4, preparing the intermediate product into particles by adopting a spray drying method to obtain the monensin premix. The monensin premix prepared by the application has uniform granularity, good stability and uniformity and strong drug effect.

title_en: Antibodies that bind PD-1 and uses thereof
abstract_en: An isolated monoclonal antibody that specifically binds to human PD-1. The invention also provides nucleic acid molecules encoding antibodies, expression vectors, host cells, and methods for expressing antibodies. The invention also provides immunoconjugates, bispecific molecules, chimeric antigen receptors, oncolytic viruses and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the antibodies, and methods of treatment using the anti-PD-1 antibodies of the invention.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating allergic purpura and convenient to take
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating allergic purpura, which is convenient to take, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and the traditional Chinese medicine preparation comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-150 parts of a traditional Chinese medicine composition; 30-80 parts of modified gluten protein; 2-10 parts of disintegrating agent; 1-10 parts of adhesive; 8-12 parts of traditional Chinese medicine mate. The traditional Chinese medicine preparation adopts natural medicinal materials, has small side effect and high safety, is suitable for long-term administration, has the effects of cooling blood, stopping bleeding, clearing heat, detoxicating, promoting blood circulation, removing blood stasis and the like, and has good treatment effect on allergic purpura; the modified gluten protein is used for coating, so that the stability is improved, the moisture absorption is not easy, the light-shading performance is strong, and the medicine controlled release effect is realized, so that the Chinese medicinal composition plays the maximum role; in addition, the traditional Chinese medicine partner developed by the invention not only has the functions of masking the bitter and astringent tastes, fishy smell and the like of medicines and improving the serviceability of patients, especially children, but also has the synergistic effect of the traditional Chinese medicine partner and the traditional Chinese medicine composition, can reduce anaphylactic reaction and has strong applicability.

title_en: CDKL 3-targeted small molecule inhibitor HZ1 and derivative HZ1-X thereof
abstract_en: A small molecule inhibitor HZ1 of a targeted CDKL3 and a derivative HZ1-X thereof, belonging to the field of biomedicine. The invention provides a specific small molecule inhibitor capable of effectively inhibiting the activity of CDKL3 kinase, and comprehensively characterizes a key cell signal path and tumor growth which are mediated by HZ1 and a derivative HZ1-X thereof and inhibit protein kinase CDKL3 and promote the occurrence and development of various tumors at a cellular level. The invention provides a new method for the targeted treatment of tumors and a new way for the clinical treatment of malignant tumors.

title_en: Construction method and application of recombinant escherichia coli for synthesizing lactoyl-N-neotetraose
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method and application of recombinant escherichia coli for efficiently synthesizing lactoyl-N-neotetraose, which are characterized in that efficient beta-1, 3-acetylglucosamine transferase and beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase are screened and are introduced into escherichia coli BL21 (DE 3) in a heterologous manner, genome multi-site gene editing is carried out on the escherichia coli, and receptor lactose is added to construct a strain for efficiently producing the lactoyl-N-neotetraose; further optimize the supply of the precursors UDP-acetamido glucose and UDP-galactose, enhance the accumulation of lactose and further improve the yield of lactoyl-N-neotetraose. The lactoyl-N-neotetraose can be efficiently synthesized by culturing and fermenting recombinant escherichia coli, the biological safety of the obtained product can be further improved, and the method is suitable for preparing foods or medicines.

title_en: Peach blossom fermentation liquor for improving constipation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a peach blossom fermentation liquor for improving constipation, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of traditional Chinese medicine processing. The preparation method comprises the following steps: soaking dry peach flowers in water, and decocting to obtain peach flower liquid with residues; adding flavourzyme and cellulase into the peach blossom liquid with slag for enzymolysis, and inactivating enzyme to obtain an enzymolysis slag liquid mixture; adding a carbon source into the enzymolysis slag liquid mixture and sterilizing to obtain a fermentation substrate; inoculating saccharomyces cerevisiae into a fermentation substrate for primary fermentation, and sterilizing after fermentation to obtain primary fermentation liquor; inoculating composite lactobacillus into the primary fermentation liquid for secondary fermentation, sterilizing, filtering and concentrating after fermentation is finished to obtain peach blossom fermentation liquid. The peach blossom fermentation liquor provided by the invention improves the original heavy bitter taste of peach blossom and has good sensory quality; the product has high content of active ingredients, rich nutrition and strong efficacy, can play roles of relaxing bowel and promoting gastrointestinal peristalsis, and has definite and obvious efficacy for improving constipation caused by opioid medicines.

title_en: T cell epitope screening and application of sai card virus A
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of veterinary biological products, in particular to animal disease prevention, and more particularly relates to screening of a dominant epitope of a conservative immunity antigen of a Seneca virus A. According to the invention, through screening T cell immune epitopes of two conserved nonstructural proteins 2C and 3AB of Senecavirus A (SVA), the obtained SVA nonstructural protein T cell epitope polypeptide is screened, so that the screened antigen epitope polypeptide can activate very strong cellular immune response, has good immune effect, generates better neutralizing antibodies and generates complete protection.

title_en: Antibody conjugates and their preparation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to conjugate compositions comprising an antibody or antigen binding fragment, a synthetic protein, and a linker. The disclosure also relates to methods of making the conjugate compositions and methods of using the conjugate compositions for treating diseases. In one aspect, the present disclosure relates to the use of the conjugate composition for the treatment of cancer.

title_en: Application of dimethylmercaptopropionic acid in improving aging and alpha-synuclein protein pathological injury
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to application of dimethylmercaptopropionic acid in improving aging and pathological damage of alpha-synuclein protein. The invention discloses the application of DMSP, which can effectively delay senility and relieve pathological damage caused by alpha synuclein. DMSP promotes the location of SKN-1 protein in cell nucleus and enhances the expression of autophagy related genes, promotes autophagy flow, improves the form and function of mitochondria in senescent caenorhabditis elegans cells, thereby delaying the senescent process of caenorhabditis elegans individuals and prolonging the service life. Meanwhile, the DMSP can reduce aggregation of alpha synuclein, lighten pathological damage caused by the alpha synuclein and improve dopamine neuron damage of caenorhabditis elegans.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition and traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating gall-stone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating gall-stone, a traditional Chinese medicine preparation and a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-60 parts of giant knotweed, 10-35 parts of spina gleditsiae, 20-40 parts of costustoot, 20-40 parts of rhizoma corydalis with vinegar, 20-40 parts of immature bitter orange fried with bran, 25-60 parts of fried chicken's gizzard-skin, 20-40 parts of rhizoma curcumae with vinegar and 20-40 parts of herba lycopodii. The traditional Chinese medicine composition and the traditional Chinese medicine preparation for treating gall-stone have the advantages of convenience in use, good treatment effect, obvious curative effect, no toxic or side effect, difficulty in recurrence and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of burdock fruit formula particles
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of burdock fruit formula particles. Adding fructus Arctii decoction pieces into boiling water according to a preset proportion, and extracting arctiin. Under the high temperature of water, the biological enzyme structure of arctiin hydrolysis is damaged, and then the arctiin in arctiin is deactivated, so that arctiin in arctiin can not be hydrolyzed rapidly. The loss of the biological enzyme activity reduces the hydrolysis of arctiin, so that the content of arctiin in the extract is improved, and the transfer rate is improved. When the burdock decoction pieces are decocted, the burdock decoction pieces are swelled, water outside the burdock tissues enters the tissues, and a higher-concentration arctiin solution is formed inside the tissues. Because of the difference of the internal concentration and the external concentration, the arctiin solution with high concentration in the tissue permeates outside the tissue, and the arctiin in the arctiin decoction pieces can be dissolved in water more quickly and completely, so that the transfer rate of the arctiin is further improved.

title_en: Treatment of coronavirus infection
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to the fields of virology, infectious diseases and medicine, and describes compounds, compositions, methods and kits for treating CoV-mediated diseases, such as diseases caused by SARS-CoV-2, SAR8 or MERS. More particularly, the present disclosure relates to potent inhibitors of coronaviruses, which can treat coronaviruses, including 2019 novel coronaviruses. In one embodiment, the present disclosure provides novel uses of WX-671 as a potent inhibitor of coronavirus and its use in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of human coronavirus infection. In one embodiment, the present disclosure provides novel uses of ABC294640 as a potent inhibitor of coronavirus and its use in the manufacture of a medicament for treating coronavirus infection in humans.

title_en: Nanometer biological material based on protein and porphyrin photosensitive drug co-assembly, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano biological material based on protein and porphyrin photosensitive drug co-assembly and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nano biological material is formed by assembling porphyrin photosensitive drug and tumor necrosis factor superfamily member protein through supermolecular action, and is a photosensitive nanoparticle. The average particle size of the nano particles is between 5 and 1000nm, the nano particles are good in biocompatibility, controllable in size and simple to operate, can start an apoptosis program to induce apoptosis of tumor cells, and can improve the effect of killing cancer cells by combining photodynamic therapy.

title_en: TGF-beta 3 derivative peptide and application thereof in preparation of medicines for promoting cartilage repair and/or treating cartilage defect diseases
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of polypeptides, and in particular discloses a TGF-beta 3 derivative peptide and application thereof in preparing a medicament for promoting cartilage repair and/or treating cartilage defect diseases. The TGF-beta 3-derived peptides of the present application have the ability to induce chondrogenic differentiation, and the TGF-beta 3-derived peptides of the present application can address various drawbacks in the use of these protein growth factors, such as low yield, high cost, and potential immunogenicity. As a promising alternative, TGF- β3 derived peptides can be synthesized chemically, with higher yields, lower costs and immunogenicity, which not only provides an attractive group of bioactive agents for cartilage functionalization of cartilage tissue engineered biomaterials, but also provides chondroprotection and chondroprotection, regeneration of articular cartilage in vitro and in vivo.

title_en: Proteolytic chimera of targeted bromodomain protein 4 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a proteolytic chimera of a targeted bromodomain protein 4 and application thereof. The proteolytic chimera has structural fragments of a bromodomain protein 4 ligand, a connector and an E3 ligase ligand, can recruit E3 ligase to perform ubiquitination modification on bromodomain protein 4 in cells, and then induces degradation of bromodomain protein 4 through UPS. Experimental researches prove that the proteolytic chimera can target bromodomain protein 4 under the condition of lower concentration, induce ubiquitination of the proteolytic chimera, obviously reduce the aggregation level of intracellular bromodomain protein 4, improve the cell activity, reduce the related cytotoxicity and is very suitable for treating bromodomain protein 4 related diseases.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating bordetella gallinarum as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating chicken bordetella, and a preparation method and application thereof. A Chinese medicinal composition for preventing and treating chicken bordetella comprises, by weight, 15-20 parts of herba Duchesneae Indicae, 15-20 parts of herba Solidaginis, 10-15 parts of herba Reineckeae Carneae, 5-12 parts of radix Ampelopsis, 5-12 parts of fructus Citri Sarcodactylis, and 5-10 parts of radix Platycodi. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is reasonably prepared from herba Duchesneae Indicae, herba astronomical grass, herba solidaginis, herba Reineckeae Carneae, radix Ampelopsis, fructus Citri Sarcodactylis and radix Platycodi, has the effects of clearing heat, cooling blood, relieving cough and asthma, and can effectively treat chicken bouillosis. The seven medicines are mixed and then prepared into the oral liquid, and the seven medicines generate synergistic effect in the preparation process, so that the effects of the traditional Chinese medicines are effectively exerted, and the effects of clearing heat and detoxicating, clearing heat and cooling blood, and relieving cough and asthma are further enhanced. The invention has scientific formula compatibility, no obvious toxic or side effect and drug tolerance, and can provide thought for solving the problem of drug resistance of antibiotics.

title_en: Manganese-arsenic virus-like particle modified by protein crown bionic modification and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manganese-arsenic virus-like particle modified by protein crown bionic modification and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of anti-tumor bionic intelligent nano materials. The particles comprise manganese-arsenic virus-like particles and biomimetic protein crowns connected to the surfaces. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing virus-like silicon dioxide by an epitaxial growth method; then, adding a manganese source and an arsenic source into the virus-like silicon dioxide dispersion liquid, heating and stirring; then adding a reducing agent, and continuing heating and stirring; after the reaction is finished, centrifuging to obtain precipitate, and washing to obtain manganese-arsenic virus-like particles; then amino functionalization is carried out on the modified protein, and then biomimetic modification of protein crown is carried out. The invention adopts the Mn-As virus-like particles as the core, can intelligently respond to the tumor specific microenvironment when the bionic nano material efficiently reaches the tumor position, and enables the bionic protein crown to fall off from the surface of the Mn-As virus-like particles, thereby enhancing the retention of the tumor position and the efficient uptake of tumor cells, and realizing low dosage and high anti-tumor efficiency.

title_en: reverse screening method and application of functional probiotics for preventing newcastle disease virus
abstract_en: The application discloses a reverse screening method and application of functional probiotics for preventing newcastle disease viruses, which belong to the technical field of microorganisms, and probiotics capable of secreting newcastle disease virus immune analogues are screened in a reverse high throughput way through a hemagglutination test (HA) and a hemagglutination inhibition test (HI), namely the functional probiotics of natural targeting newcastle disease viruses. The screened functional probiotics are prepared into various products, and the functional probiotics are used for efficiently preventing the infection of chicken newcastle disease viruses in cultivation, are efficient, have low production cost and no side reaction, and have important clinical application value.

title_en: Cake-shaped zinc oxide nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of inorganic chemistry, and particularly relates to a cake-shaped chiral zinc oxide nano material and a preparation method thereof. The invention adds chiral ligand into the formation process of zinc oxide sediment, and induces the target product cake-shaped chiral zinc oxide by means of solvent dispersion method. The chiral zinc oxide nano material is in a cake-shaped structure formed by stacking small particles. The cake-shaped chiral zinc oxide nano material disclosed by the invention is high in safety, good in dispersibility in water, and has CD activity in a near infrared region, and can be used for identifying and detecting polarized light. Meanwhile, the material has obvious chiral configuration, is more suitable for biological environment, can be used as a nano material drug for relieving diabetes symptoms, and has wide application prospect in the field of diabetes treatment.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and antitumor agent for tumors with reduced function of at least one of BAP 1and PBRM1
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a pharmaceutical composition and an antitumor agent which are effective for tumors in which the function of at least one of BAP 1and PBRM1 is reduced. According to the present invention there is provided a pharmaceutical composition comprising 1- (2-deoxy-2-fluoro-4-thio- β -D-arabinofuranosyl) cytosine or a salt thereof, or a prodrug thereof, for use in the treatment of a tumor with reduced function of at least one of BAP 1and PBRM 1.

title_en: Application of radix Isatidis or its extract in preparing medicine or health product for resisting cerebral nerve aging and cognitive disorder
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of radix isatidis or an extract thereof in preparing medicines or health care products for resisting cerebral nerve aging and cognitive dysfunction, belongs to the technical field of foods or medicines, and discloses new application of radix isatidis or an extract thereof, namely application in preparing medicines and health care foods for treating and/or preventing cerebral aging; the invention verifies that the isatis root extract prevents and treats cerebral aging through animal experiments; experimental results prove that the radix isatidis extract has remarkable preventing and improving effects on brain aging of the natural aging mice; and the radix isatidis is a traditional Chinese medicine, has long application history and high safety. Radix Isatidis is mainly produced in the North China yellow river basin of the north of the Yangtze river, and cultivated in various places throughout the country; the invention can provide scientific basis and safe and effective therapeutic drugs for resisting cerebral aging and neurodegenerative diseases. By combining the reasons, the radix isatidis or the extract thereof has better development and utilization prospects in the aspects of preparing medicines and health-care foods for resisting cerebral nerve aging and cognitive dysfunction.

title_en: Novel intron, circular RNA and in vitro preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an in vitro preparation method of circular RNA, which comprises the following steps: constructing a plasmid: ligating the gene segments of the T7 promoter, the 5 'homology arm, the 3' intron, the second exon E2, the first exon E1, the 5 'intron, the 3' homology arm, and the cleavage site EcoRI to an expression vector; the composition of the 3 'intron and the 5' intron is from SEQ ID NO.1-SEQ ID NO.2 sequence; linearizing and purifying plasmids; in vitro transcription; the first cyclization step, the second cyclization step, or the purification step of the one-step method to obtain the circular RNA. According to the invention, the Twit I type intron is modified, the sheared intron sequence is inserted between the 5 '-end and the 3' -end of the target fragment, the linear mRNA is cyclized efficiently, the residual exogenous base is less, and the circular RNA obtained by the preparation method can be suitable for preparing the mRNA vaccine.

title_en: Polymeric depot compositions for sustained release delivery of VMAT2 inhibitors
abstract_en: The present application relates to a sustained release delivery composition of a vesicular monoamine transporter type 2 (VMAT 2) inhibitor, deuterated derivative thereof, pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, active metabolite thereof or prodrug thereof for the treatment of hyperactivity disorder including, but not limited to, tardive Dyskinesia (TD), huntington's disease, chorea, tremor, dystonia, chorea, tics, myoclonus, notch, restless leg syndrome and various other disorders accompanied by abnormal involuntary movements. Methods of making or using the compositions are also disclosed.

title_en: Lyotropic liquid crystal nanosystems with encapsulated bioactive macromolecules
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition of a physicochemical stable colloidal system in the form of a lyotropic liquid crystal, said composition comprising glycerol monooleate, C6-C12 fatty acid salts or derivatives thereof having an aromatic substituent, having the formula H (OCH)  2  CH  2  )  a  (OCH(CH  3  )CH  2  )  b  (OCH  2  CH  2  )  a  Amphiphilic block copolymers of OH (wherein 2.ltoreq.a.ltoreq.150 and 15.ltoreq.b.ltoreq.70) and biologically active macromolecules having peptide bonds.

title_en: Yimu kang granule and production process thereof
