abstract_en: The application relates to the field of Chinese patent medicines, and in particular discloses a Yimu kang granule and a production process thereof, wherein the production process of the Yimu kang granule comprises the following steps: s1, preparing an extract to obtain the extract; s2, crushing, S3 granulating and S4 drying: continuously adding 95-100deg.C water after granulating, and drying to water content of 4-5%; s5, sieving, granulating, S6, mixing, subpackaging, S7 and packaging; by adjusting various parameters of the production process of the beneficial effects and the types and the doping amounts of various raw materials, the active content and the uniformity of the obtained beneficial effects particles are respectively 83.4-83.8% and 96.98-98.75%, and the appearance and the properties of the beneficial effects particles at the end of month 12, 18, 24 and 30 are complete and hard, so that the beneficial effects have better uniformity and stability.

title_en: Thermo-responsive carrier hydrogel, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal-response carrier hydrogel, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of nano materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: polyethylene glycol with thiocarbonylthio groups at two ends is taken as a macromolecular chain transfer agent, and under the action of a free radical initiator, a temperature-sensitive monomer and acrylic acid-N-succinimidyl ester are subjected to reversible addition fragmentation chain transfer free radical polymerization to obtain a first temperature-sensitive polymer; under the activation of N-hydroxysuccinimide ester functional groups, coupling the first thermosensitive polymer with molecules with adhesion functional groups under the catalysis of alkali to obtain a second thermosensitive polymer; adding a chemotherapeutic drug into the first aqueous dispersion of the photo-thermal nano material modified with polyethylene glycol to obtain a second aqueous dispersion; and dissolving the second thermosensitive polymer in the second aqueous dispersion to obtain the thermally responsive carrier hydrogel. The thermal-responsive carrier hydrogel can mediate pancreatic cancer chemotherapy combined photothermal treatment, and has high biological safety.

title_en: Isaria cicadae mycelium aqueous extract and application thereof in preparing cosmetics for improving acne
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aqueous extract of Isaria cicadae mycelium and application thereof in preparing cosmetics for improving acne. According to the invention, after the freeze-dried mycelium of the corynespora cicadae C1 is crushed, a cellulase synergistic hot water extraction method is adopted to extract the mycelium to obtain the corynespora cicadae water extract, and the obtained water extract contains various active ingredients such as polysaccharide, nucleoside, sugar alcohol, protein and the like, has good effects of resisting inflammation and oxidation, promoting the growth of staphylococcus epidermidis, inhibiting propionibacterium acnes and regulating the microecological balance of skin, and can be used as an anti-acne and anti-inflammatory active raw material in the fields of cosmetics and the like.

title_en: Preparation of diagnosis and treatment agent with fluorescence/MR imaging and photodynamic therapy functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a diagnosis and treatment agent with fluorescence/MR imaging and photodynamic therapy functions, and belongs to the technical fields of material science and biomedical technology. The invention aims to provide a preparation method of a diagnosis and treatment agent with fluorescence/MR imaging and photodynamic therapy functions. According to the invention, a hydrophobic fluorescent group with AIE characteristics is coupled with a hydrophilic manganese ion complex with magnetic resonance imaging capability, so that an amphiphilic nano diagnosis and treatment agent TBPN-AM molecule is constructed. The nano diagnosis and treatment agent TBPN-AM prepared by the invention has good fluorescence and magnetic resonance imaging (MR) functions, and can efficiently target tumor cell mitochondria, thereby realizing the specific marking and detection of tumor cells. In addition, the nano-diagnostic agent TBPN-AM can also generate two types of ROS under the illumination condition for PDT ablation of tumor cells, and effectively ablate the tumor cells under normoxic (21% O  2 ) and hypoxic (2%O  2 ) conditions, so that accurate diagnosis and treatment of tumors in a complex tumor microenvironment are realized. The diagnosis and treatment agent has the advantages of simple synthesis method, easily available raw materials, easy realization and control of synthesis conditions, mass production and great potential in clinical application.

title_en: Construction method and application of lung cancer transformation animal model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biotechnology, in particular to a method for constructing a lung cancer transformation animal model based on 3D organoid combined gene editing, which comprises the steps of taking normal lung epithelial organoids of mice with Trp53 gene deletion for culture, extracting lung tissues of the mice, constructing a gene expression vector containing K-ras target, extracting plasmids, packaging retrovirus by adopting a calcium phosphate transfection method, carrying out organoid infection on the retrovirus, and carrying out organoid infection on successful organoids according to the following weight ratio of 1:3, and 300,000 cells of 75 μl were injected into the left lobe of the mouse lung within 10 seconds after identification and then incision suturing was immediately performed. In the technical scheme of the invention, after the cDNA over-expression technology is used for carrying out gene editing on the lung organs of the mice, the mouse lung organs can be effectively and rapidly generated to closely simulate the occurrence and development of human diseases on the genome and phenotype level, and the model has stability and controllability and can make up the modeling technical bottlenecks of hysteresis, uncontrollability and the like of the traditional animal in-vivo lung nodule modeling mode.

title_en: External medicinal liquor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medicines, in particular to an external medicinal liquor and a preparation method thereof. The wine has the effects of dredging channels, activating blood circulation, activating nerves, diminishing inflammation, relieving pain and removing blood stasis. The formula is simple and practical. The blood vessel can strengthen the elasticity of the blood vessel and increase the toughness of the blood vessel while dredging the meridian blood clot, thereby avoiding the situation that the blood vessel is blocked again and reducing the situation of relapse of illness.

title_en: Compositions and methods for inhibiting RAS
abstract_en: Provided herein are compounds or salts, esters, tautomers, prodrugs, zwitterionic forms, or stereoisomers thereof, and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same. Also provided herein are methods of using them to modulate (e.g., inhibit) KRAS (e.g., KRAS having a G12C mutation) and treat a disease or disorder, such as cancer, in a subject in need thereof.

title_en: Whitening and spot-fading water-soluble composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whitening and spot-fading water-soluble composition and a preparation method thereof, and particularly belongs to the field of cosmetic preparations; the water-soluble composition comprises the following components: snow lotus herb extract and white crocus sativus bulb extract; the snow lotus extract and the white crocus sativus bulb extract in the whitening and spot-fading composition provided by the invention have synergistic interaction; the crocus sativus bulb extract has effects of whitening and spot-fading under specific addition.

title_en: Application of 3-oxo-benzofuran compounds in preparation of medicines for treating heart failure related diseases
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to application of a 3-oxo-benzofuran compound in preparation of a medicine for treating heart failure related diseases. Experiments show that the 3-oxo-benzofuran compound LC-4 can play a remarkable role in myocardial protection in a doxorubicin (Dox) induced heart injury model, an angiotensin II (Ang II) induced heart injury model and an Isoprenaline (ISO) induced chronic heart failure model; the mechanism of the compound LC-4 is that the SNX3 subcellular localization is changed by combining with SNX3, and the combination of the SNX3 and the VPS35 is interfered, so that the SNX3 function is inhibited, the downstream pathway is further inhibited, the heart fibrosis and heart failure caused by the heart fibrosis can be improved, and the effect of preventing and treating the heart failure is finally achieved.

title_en: Sea cucumber wine for relieving gastric mucosal injury and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses sea cucumber wine for relieving gastric mucosal injury and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of health-care food. The preparation method of the sea cucumber wine comprises the following steps: weighing sea cucumber enzymolysis powder accounting for 0.1-1% of the total weight of sea cucumber wine, adding water, stirring uniformly, wherein the rotation speed of a stirrer is 50-200 r/min, and the stirring time is 0.5-1 h, so as to obtain a sea cucumber enzymolysis powder solution; adding 52-68 degrees white spirit into the sea cucumber enzymolysis powder solution, stirring and uniformly mixing, and controlling the alcoholic strength to be 30-40 vol%; homogenizing in a high-pressure homogenizer under 40-80 MPa for 6-10 times to obtain sea cucumber wine; the sea cucumber wine has high stability, high sea cucumber addition amount which can reach 1.0%, and has smaller influence on gastric mucosa compared with the prior drinking of sea cucumber solution and the prior drinking of sea cucumber solution, and can effectively improve symptoms such as gastric mucosa rupture damage and inflammatory cell infiltration caused by alcohol.

title_en: MRNA medicine targeting CD73 and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a CD 73-targeted mRNA medicament, and a preparation method and application thereof. In order to develop a CD73mRNA drug based on a lipid nanoparticle delivery system, the invention takes CD73 as a target point to prepare mRNA for various tumors, meanwhile, based on the lipid nanoparticle delivery system, the designed mRNA can deliver the CD73mRNA to a body through the lipid nanoparticle delivery system, and the immune response of the body is activated by expressing CD73 protein as an antigen; meanwhile, the generation of adenosine in the tumor microenvironment can be inhibited, the immunosuppression state in the tumor microenvironment can be reduced, and the anti-tumor effect of the body immunity can be enhanced; the mRNA realizes the curative effect of killing tumor in various tumor models, and has no obvious toxic or side effect. In addition, the combination with the immune checkpoint inhibitor can obviously enhance the treatment effect on tumors, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Corticotropin peptide compositions and methods of use
abstract_en: Described herein are aqueous pharmaceutical compositions comprising the peptide Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro (SEQ ID NO: 1), or a pharmaceutically acceptable derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of any thereof, and methods of treatment using the same.

title_en: Pharmaceutical preparation for treating insomnia
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses a pharmaceutical preparation for treating insomnia, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 15 to 30 parts of prepared rehmannia root, 10 to 20 parts of Chinese angelica, 10 to 20 parts of white peony root, 10 to 20 parts of poria cocos, 15 to 30 parts of astragalus, 10 to 20 parts of medlar, 10 to 20 parts of longan pulp, 5 to 10 parts of shizandra berry, 10 to 20 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 6 to 12 parts of shaddock peel, 6 to 12 parts of dried orange peel, 6 to 12 parts of poria cocos, 3 to 15 parts of auxiliary additive agent and 10 to 15 parts of flavoring agent; the preparation method of the auxiliary additive comprises the following method steps: step one, selecting materials: 10-15 parts of Chinese yam and 10-15 parts of mulberry are selected. The Chinese yam, the mulberry, the pinellia ternate and the liquorice are matched, so that the influence of other medicaments on the body of a user is reduced, the side effect of the medicaments is reduced, and the whole effect of the medicaments can be improved by assisting in adding medicaments, so that the Chinese yam, the mulberry, the pinellia ternate and the liquorice are more suitable for treating insomnia.

title_en: Preparation method and application of semiconductor-phase FeS ultra-small nano-dots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of semiconductor phase FeS ultra-small nano dots, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing metal phase FeS ultra-small nano dots, S2, dispersing the metal phase FeS ultra-small nano dots in ethylene glycol containing sodium citrate, purifying a product after a hydrothermal reaction in an inert atmosphere, and dispersing the product in ultrapure water to obtain the semiconductor phase FeS ultra-small nano dots. The hydrothermal synthesis method provided by the invention is simple, quick and efficient, low in cost, high in reproducibility, convenient for mass production and safe in operation, and is a method for quickly synthesizing the semiconductor-phase FeS ultra-small nano-dots.

title_en: Toluene sulfonic acid Ai Duosha class tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly relates to a toluene sulfonic acid Ai Duosha class tablet and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the liposome technology is utilized to wrap the toluenesulfonic acid Ai Duosha pieces, and a lipid carrier material is preferably selected, and particularly distearoyl phosphatidylethanolamine, beta-sitosterol and sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate are added to form a closed lipid vesicle, so that the drug loading capacity and encapsulation rate of the toluenesulfonic acid Ai Duosha pieces liposome are improved, and the dissolution rate and stability of the toluenesulfonic acid Ai Duosha pieces are further improved, and the liposome has the same dissolution rate as the prior art.

title_en: Application of polyamine in brain tumor treatment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of brain tumor treatment. The present invention provides a method of killing brain tumor cells in these tissues using high concentrations of a cytotoxic agent that is capable of strong binding to normal brain extracellular matrix (ECM) but weak binding to extracellular matrix components in the tumor environment. The cytotoxic agent is a polyamine, such as spermine or putrescine.

title_en: Ivabradine hydrochloride solid dispersion and medicinal slow-release preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and in particular relates to an ivabradine hydrochloride solid dispersion and a pharmaceutical sustained-release preparation thereof. The slow release preparation is prepared by mixing the ivabradine hydrochloride and mesoporous silicon dioxide to prepare a compound, preparing a solid dispersion with candelilla wax by a hot melt extrusion method, and mixing and tabletting the solid dispersion with hydroxypropyl methylcellulose and other pharmaceutically acceptable auxiliary materials. The preparation method of the sustained release preparation is simple and easy to operate, and can improve the stability of the medicine.

title_en: Construction of MSC bionic drug co-carrying system and application thereof in glioma cooperative treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nano-drugs, in particular to a bionic nano-system with multiple targeting characteristics and drug co-loading, and application thereof in glioma cooperative treatment. The invention constructs a centrally targeted drug co-carried nano drug delivery system Ang2-Pmsc-NPs, which has good trans-BBB transport characteristics and tumor tissue permeation characteristics. Carrying siRNA therapeutic gene and PROTAC molecules, killing GSCs, inhibiting NAD  +  energy metabolism pathway of tumor, realizing multi-target anti-glioma effect, and providing new thought and experimental foundation for nano-drug treatment of glioma.

title_en: Method for constructing infectious plasmid of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus in one step and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of animal virology and genetic engineering, and aims to provide a method for constructing infectious plasmids of porcine epidemic diarrhea viruses in one step and application thereof. The invention realizes the efficient construction of the infectious cDNA plasmid of the porcine epidemic diarrhea virus by one-step homologous recombination of the PEDV whole genome cDNA divided into 4 sections and pBelo-BAC11 vector skeleton; constructing new mutant of PEDV infectious cDNA plasmid with specific genetic variation through five-segment homologous recombination in one step; finally obtaining the PEDV infectious cDNA plasmid with the sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 41. The invention reduces the toxicity of the PEDV genome to cells by breaking the toxic sequence, ensures that the cDNA sequence fragment of the PEDV genome is stably stored in a high-copy plasmid pUC57, and realizes the construction of PEDV infectious cDNA clone by one-step homologous recombination. Therefore, the construction and editing of the porcine epidemic diarrhea virus infectious cDNA clone can be realized efficiently by the method.

title_en: Antibacterial acne-removing mite-removing compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of skin care products, and in particular discloses a compound for inhibiting bacteria, removing acnes and removing mites and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the antibacterial acne-removing mite-removing compound comprises the following steps: 1) Mixing rosemary, american ginseng root, fucus vesiculosus, chamomile flower and citrus peel to obtain a plant compound; 2) Putting the plant compound into water, heating and extracting for 4-6h, cooling to be less than or equal to 30 ℃, inoculating compound bacteria, keeping the temperature at 32-34 ℃, and fermenting for 90-100h to obtain a fermentation compound; 3) Adding ethanol into the fermentation complex, heating to 70-72deg.C, keeping the temperature for 2-3 hr, and filtering to obtain extractive solution; 4) Concentrating the extractive solution to obtain concentrated solution; 5) Adding a bacteriostatic agent and a preservative into the concentrated solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain a bacteriostatic acne-removing mite-removing compound; the compound bacteria are the compound of trichoderma asperellum, sorangium cellulosum and Brevibacterium ammoniagenes. The invention has the advantage of further improving the antibacterial and mite-killing effects.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for nose, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses a nasal pharmaceutical composition which comprises epinephrine or medicinal salt thereof, 15-hydroxystearic acid polyethylene glycol ester and clove oil. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the nasal pharmaceutical composition, and a nasal spray containing the nasal pharmaceutical composition. The invention combines 15-hydroxy stearic acid polyethylene glycol ester and clove oil to promote nasal mucosa absorption of epinephrine, and can achieve similar effect of intramuscular injection within 15min of administration. The invention effectively solves the problems of poor stability, easy oxidation and easy racemization of epinephrine, and the total impurity content in the epinephrine nasal spray is less than 0.2 percent when the epinephrine nasal spray is placed for 3 months at 40+/-2 ℃ and the relative humidity is 75+/-5 percent.

title_en: CD 70-targeting chimeric antigen receptor
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a chimeric antigen receptor that targets CD 70. Through flow cytometry, degranulation analysis experiments and T cell cytokine secretion detection, the T cells modified by the four chimeric antigen receptors have strong killing effect on acute myeloid leukemia cells expressing CD70, almost have no killing effect on cells not expressing CD70, and effectively prevent off-target effect. The chimeric antigen receptor CD70scFv-CD8 alpha-4-1 BB-CD3 zeta of the present disclosure can be used for the treatment of CD70  +  hematological tumors.

title_en: Recombinant vaccinia oncolytic virus expressing OPCML, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a recombinant vaccinia oncolytic virus expressing OPCML, and a construction method and application thereof. The oncolytic vaccinia virus specifically expresses OPCML protein in tumor cells, inhibits HER2, EGFR, FGFR1 and VEGFR2 mediated tumor cell proliferation signal transduction, has obvious effect of inhibiting in-vitro ovarian cancer and bladder cancer tumor cells, has obvious treatment effect on tumor animal models, and has application prospect in the field of tumor treatment.

title_en: Method for improving treatment effect of CAR-NK cells
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and discloses a method for improving the treatment effect of CAR-NK cells. Specifically disclosed is a CAR-NK cell which is a CAR expressing a target CD19 on the surface of an NK cell, the structure of which comprises a scFv specifically targeting CD19, a hinge from CD8, a transmembrane region from CD8 and a cd3ζ in combination with a 4-1BB signaling domain. Compared with the CAR-NK cells in the prior art, the CAR-NK cells provided by the invention show stronger and quicker tumor killing effect, and experiments prove that the CAR-NK cells quickly cause target cell membrane rupture and intracellular substance outflow after contacting with target cells, and the average time for killing the tumor cells is only 20 minutes; a kill rate of over 60% can be achieved with an effective target ratio = 1:5.

title_en: Bismuth-based nanoparticle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological medicine, and provides bismuth-based nano particles, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing bismuth salt precursor solution and polysaccharide ligand solution to obtain mixed solution; adding a precipitation solution into the mixed solution, heating and stirring to react to obtain a reaction solution; carrying out precipitation and centrifugation on the reaction liquid to obtain a precipitate; dissolving, purifying and freeze-drying the precipitate to obtain bismuth-based nanoparticles, wherein the bismuth-based nanoparticles comprise bismuth oxide nanoparticles and polysaccharide crust layers coated on the surfaces of the bismuth oxide nanoparticles; the particle size of the bismuth-based nano particles is 2.55-4.25 nm. The preparation method of the application is easy to synthesize bismuth-based nano particles, and the prepared bismuth-based nano particles have the advantages of ultra-small particle size, excellent water solubility, high bismuth content, high sensitivity, excellent X-ray attenuation capability, high biological safety, good targeted enrichment effect on inflammatory sites, large clinical transformation potential and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of double slow-release dapagliflozin tablet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a double slow-release dapagliflozin tablet, and belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations. The preparation method of the double slow-release dapagliflozin tablet comprises an enteric inner core, a gastric-soluble middle core and a coating, wherein the gastric-soluble middle core comprises the following raw and auxiliary materials in percentage by weight: 5-7% of dapagliflozin, 10% of voglibose, 69-73% of microcrystalline cellulose compound, 2-4% of disintegrating agent and 10% of HPMC coating liquid, wherein the enteric inner core comprises the following raw and auxiliary materials in percentage by weight: 5-7% of dapagliflozin, 8% of Yuanzhen sugar, 63-77% of microcrystalline cellulose compound, 4-8% of disintegrating agent, 8% of HPMC coating liquid and 6% of alginic acid; the invention has the advantages of high dissolution rate of the medicinal components, good release effect and small pressure on kidneys.

title_en: Avian adenovirus serum 11 type carrier, recombinant virus constructed by adopting carrier, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of animal genetic engineering vaccines, and particularly relates to an avian adenovirus serotype 11 vector, a recombinant virus constructed by adopting the vector, and a construction method and application thereof. The avian adenovirus serum 11 type carrier is FAdV-11 infectious clone containing a double-selectable marker screening expression cassette, the avian adenovirus serum 11 type carrier comprises a framework carrier p15A-cm and a viral genome sequence of FAdV-11, and ORF0-1-2 or ORF11 genes in the viral genome sequence of FAdV-11 are deleted. The FAdV-11 reverse genetic technology platform established by the invention can provide safe and effective bivalent or multi-linked vaccine for analyzing the pathogenesis of FAdV-11 and preventing and controlling the mixed infection of FAdV-11 and other pathogens, and provides technical support for developing the multi-linked multivalent vaccine based on FAdV-11 vectors.

title_en: Bioactive peptide side chain modified terphenyl arene macrocyclic compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention synthesizes the terphenyl arene macrocyclic compound modified by the bioactive peptide side chain for the first time, and the synthesis method only needs three steps of reactions, and has the advantages of high yield, low cost and definite product chemical structure. The macrocyclic compound is a mimetic of fibroblast growth factor (FGF-2), has the biological activity of FGF-2, and can treat glucocorticoid-induced muscle atrophy by promoting myoblast proliferation, differentiating into myotubes, and increasing myotube volume.

title_en: Recombinant type I Marek's disease virus strain expressing H9N2 subtype AIV HA gene and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant type I Marek's disease virus strain expressing H9N2 subtype AIV HA genes, a construction method and application thereof. The invention uses recombinant cloning technology to insert the gene segment SV40-HA containing SV40 promoter, H9N2 subtype AIV HA gene and terminator sequence into the interior of the UL41 gene of MDV gene deletion vaccine strain (rMS delta Meq strain), and replaces 96927-97106 nucleotide sequence of rMS delta Meq genome sequence to obtain recombinant cosmid inserted into SV40-HA expression frame in the interior of UL41 gene, and the recombinant type I MDV strain-rMDV-HA expressing H9N2 subtype AIV HA gene is obtained by rescue. Studies show that rMDV-HA HAs the same in vitro replication capacity and good genetic stability as the parent virus strain, and can provide good protection effect for H9N2 subtype AIV and MDV after chicken is immunized. The invention provides a technical means for preparing the medicine for simultaneously preventing H9N2 subtype AIV and MDV infection.

title_en: Antimicrobial compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antimicrobial composition, and more particularly to a method and composition for preventing or treating acne. This is achieved by a composition comprising an alkyl-substituted dihydroxybenzene in combination with a selected substituted phenol compound. The composition was also found to have anti-malodor benefits.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating heart failure as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating heart failure, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine composition is prepared from at least the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-25 parts of dwarf lilyturf tuber, 5-25 parts of dendrobium, 5-25 parts of fragrant solomonseal rhizome, 5-25 parts of medlar, 15-35 parts of astragalus root, 10-30 parts of pilose asiabell root, 5-25 parts of plantain seed and 10-30 parts of white gourd peel; the invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the traditional Chinese medicine composition. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: according to the pathological conditions of yin deficiency, blood stasis and water invading heart failure patients such as liver and kidney yin deficiency, water flooding and qi and blood stasis, based on the western medicines, the traditional Chinese medicine composition for nourishing yin, activating blood and promoting diuresis is matched, so that gastrointestinal reactions, gastrointestinal bleeding and other complications of patients caused by long-term western medicine treatment can be improved, clinical symptoms of the patients can be obviously improved, and the effect is obvious.

title_en: Rumen flora propagation nutrient solution and application thereof in rumen flora transplanting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rumen flora propagation nutrient solution and application thereof in rumen flora transplanting, which belong to the technical field of rumen flora propagation nutrient solution, and the rumen flora propagation nutrient solution is obtained by using a rumen flora propagation method, so that the screening quantity of rumen flora donors and the treatment operation of the rumen flora are reduced, the complexity and the cost of the flora transplanting operation are reduced, the rumen flora propagation nutrient solution can be obtained by using the technical scheme, the epidemic disease propagation risk caused by cross-pasture cross-region flora transplanting is eliminated, the rumen flora propagation method is optimized, the problems of donor rumen flora composition and functional stability are solved, and the flora transplanting effect is ensured.

title_en: Antibody combinations specifically recognizing pseudomonas PCRV or PSL antigens and bispecific antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention provides bispecific antibodies that specifically recognize pseudomonas aeruginosa PcrV and/or Psl, including pharmaceutical compositions of antibodies that specifically recognize non-overlapping epitopes of pseudomonas PcrV and/or Psl. Also provides a preparation method and application thereof.

title_en: Short peptide SP1 and application thereof in preparation of medicines for treating ovarian cancer
abstract_en: The invention provides a short peptide SP1 (MNPQIMSLVT) and application thereof in preparation of products for preventing and/or treating ovarian cancer, and belongs to the technical field of prevention and treatment of ovarian cancer. The invention discovers that the short peptide SP1 has better effect in preventing or treating ovarian cancer for the first time, and obviously improves rat ovarian cancer after treatment. The development of the short peptide SP1 into a product for preventing and protecting ovarian cancer has important significance.

title_en: Application of salvianolic acid C in preparation of medicines for treating multiple myeloma
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of salvianolic acid C in preparing medicines for treating multiple myeloma, and through discussing the treatment effects of salvianolic acid C in an in vitro cell model and an in vivo animal model constructed by multiple myeloma cells, the salvianolic acid C is found to have better curative effects in treating the multiple myeloma, and experimental results show that METTL is a key gene for causing the multiple myeloma in clinical samples and cell lines, molecular docking results show that salvianolic acid C is a potential medicine for inhibiting METTL5 gene expression, and in vitro experiments show that salvianolic acid C can promote apoptosis of multiple myeloma cell lines and effectively kill tumor cells in a multiple myeloma blood system tumor model, and in vivo experiments, salvianolic acid C with high concentration has better treatment effects on the model and good in vivo safety.

title_en: Dietary therapy formula for conditioning perimenopausal syndrome
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dietotherapy formula for conditioning perimenopausal syndrome, which belongs to the technical field of medical health care and comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 7-15 parts of Magnetitum, 3-12 parts of wild jujube seed, 6-9 parts of morinda officinalis, 2-6 parts of coptis chinensis, 6-12 parts of polygonum multiflorum, 6-9 parts of baikal skullcap root, 5-9 parts of glossy privet fruit, 1-6 parts of liquorice, 3-9 parts of white paeony root, 7-9 parts of cortex lycii radicis, 5-12 parts of lily, 6-9 parts of rhizoma anemarrhenae, 7-12 parts of dragon bone, 4-9 parts of fructus psoraleae, 5-12 parts of oyster, 4-6 parts of lotus plumule, 4-9 parts of changium, 2-12 parts of cherokee rose fruit, 6-12 parts of prepared rehmannia root, 7-9 parts of eclipta and 4-6 parts of angelica sinensis are prepared into pills with the cross section in a shape of a Lai triangle according to a required proportion, so that the problem that the pill in the prior art is mainly spherical, and the patient is difficult to swallow again after being choked by medicines and is easy to cause discomfort of the patient.

title_en: Method for separating stromal vascular fraction cells from adipose tissue and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses a method for separating stromal vascular fraction cells from adipose tissue and application thereof, comprising the following steps: (1) Collecting adipose tissue, and cleaning the adipose tissue with physiological saline; (2) Adding an extraction reagent into the washed adipose tissues, digesting, centrifuging, removing supernatant, washing the precipitate with washing liquid for 2-4 times, centrifuging, and filtering to obtain stromal vascular fraction cells; the washing liquid consists of sophorolipid, soapberry extract and physiological saline; the mass ratio of the sophorolipid to the soapberry extract to the normal saline is (2-6): (4-8): 100. the method can obviously improve the activity rate and the number of cells in a matrix blood vessel part, wherein the washing liquid can be used for effectively washing, and the sophorolipid in the washing liquid and the soapberry extract are both biological sources, so that the cells can be effectively protected, the centrifugal damage is reduced, and the cell activity is improved.

title_en: Application of genistein in preparing liver protecting medicine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical application, and particularly relates to a compound Genistein (Genistein) and a new application thereof, namely application thereof in preparing liver-protecting medicaments. The invention discovers the new application of the compound Genistein (Genistein) through experiments, can effectively reduce the liver index of mice, improve liver swelling and hypertrophy, reduce the levels of inflammatory factors IL-6, IL-1 beta and TNF-alpha, reduce the activity of GOT and GPT in serum, improve the activity of SOD and GSH-Px, inhibit the content of MDA, improve the pathological changes of liver tissues of the mice, and has better effect of improving liver injury of the mice. The invention discovers that Genistein (Genistein) has excellent liver protection effect and has the prospect of developing medicines, health-care products or foods for protecting the liver.

title_en: Preparation method and application of metaplasia promoting calcium absorption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a metaplasia promoting calcium absorption, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The invention uses Lactobacillus helveticus CCFM1263 to inoculate in casein solution according to a certain proportion for fermentation, and prepares the metagen containing peptide SFSDIPNPIGSENSEK for promoting calcium absorption. The metazoan has the effect of remarkably improving the content of serum calcium and bone calcium. The metagen provided by the invention can effectively promote calcium absorption and bone health, and has very important significance for developing products for improving calcium absorption efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method and application of injectable hydrogel for treating colon cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, in particular to a preparation method and application of injectable hydrogel for treating colon cancer, which comprises the steps of firstly loading a TPT package into a ZIF-8 to keep a lactone ring to stably exert toxicity, then loading the ZIF-8 loaded with a chemotherapeutic drug TPT and a sodium VB  2  of a sound sensitizer riboflavin phosphate into the injectable ALG hydrogel, and utilizing Ca  2+  in a tumor microenvironment to form the injectable hydrogel in situ locally; the method comprises the following specific steps: step 1, preparing TPT/ZIF-8; and (3) preparing the preparation of the step 2 and GRTZ. According to the invention, two functional materials are simply doped by using one carrier, firstly, TPT is encapsulated in a zeolite imidazole skeleton TPT/ZIF-8, and then TPT/ZIF-8 and riboflavin sodium phosphate (VB  2 ) are blended in a sodium alginate solution to form injectable gel TPT/ZIF-8@GR (GRTZ for short). Finally realizing accumulation and long-acting release of the medicine at the tumor part; and GRTZ can generate enhanced ROS under the ultrasonic action, so that the chemo-acoustic power cooperative treatment of the tumor is realized.

title_en: Exosome scaffold protein especially suitable for carrying effective cargoes and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exosome loaded with an effective substance, a preparation method and a pharmaceutical composition thereof, wherein the exosome loaded with the effective substance comprises an exosome, PODXL2 protein which is over-expressed in the exosome and the effective substance connected with the PODXL2 protein. The invention adopts the PODXL2 protein as the exosome internal carrier protein to load the effective substance, and can improve the loading efficiency of the effective substance in the exosome. PODXL2 as an exosome endo-scaffolding protein has been shown to have unexpectedly higher loading efficiencies for loading of various active substances, e.g., gene editing related proteins, anti-inflammatory proteins, etc., inside the exosome, providing more, more preferred alternatives for delivery of the active substances.

title_en: Method for homogenizing Chinese medicinal preparation raw materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine preparations, in particular to a method for homogenizing and treating raw materials of a traditional Chinese medicine preparation. The homogenization treatment method not only performs single homogenization treatment on the index component source medicaments of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation, but also performs further and simpler homogenization treatment on other key components influencing the fluctuation of the index component. By adopting the homogenization treatment method, the problem that the quality consistency of the preparation cannot be further effectively improved due to the optimization of the production process and the direct raw material difference is effectively solved, the problems of complicated process flow and long detection period when the conventional batch products are subjected to the homogenization treatment of key raw materials affecting index components are avoided, the homogenization treatment of medicinal materials can be simplified, the quality difference of the raw medicinal materials among different batches is well reduced, and the quality stability of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation in the industry is ensured.

title_en: Fusion proteins comprising TGF-beta RII extracellular region fragments, pharmaceutical compositions and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biology and medicine, and relates to a fusion protein containing TGF-beta RII extracellular region fragments, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof. Specifically, the fusion protein of the present invention comprises: a first protein functional region that targets an immune checkpoint, and a second protein functional region that has TGF- β binding activity, wherein the second protein functional region is a variant of a TGF- βrii extracellular region fragment, and the variant of the TGF- βrii extracellular region fragment is: the first serine at the N-terminus of the extracellular region of TGF- βrii is replaced with alanine, glycine or threonine; and/or, a fragment comprising the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO:59 has been deleted from the TGF-beta RII extracellular region fragment. The fusion protein can inhibit TIGIT and reduce TGF-beta level simultaneously, and has good potential for preparing antitumor drugs.

title_en: Application of polydatin in preparation of medicine for preventing and/or treating influenza A virus infection secondary infection
abstract_en: The invention provides application of polydatin in preparation of medicines for preventing and/or treating respiratory system secondary infection, and relates to the technical field of medicines, and the invention discovers that polydatin can effectively reduce virus load of the lung of a mouse by effectively slowing down weight reduction of a secondary infected mouse, effectively reduce inflammatory cell infiltration in alveoli, thickening of alveoli walls and lung focus area, and obviously improve lung symptoms of the infected mouse; furthermore, the polydatin can increase the number of CD8  +  T cells in the lung, increase the expression of CD8  +  T cell functional factor Granzyme B and the release of cytokines interferon gamma (IFN-gamma) and tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), and reduce the expression of a CD8  +  T cell surface programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) and a thymic cell selection related high mobility group box (TOX), so that the polydatin can be used for preventing and/or treating respiratory secondary infection and further can be used for preparing medicaments for preventing and/or treating respiratory secondary infection.

title_en: Preparation and application of active oxygen scavenging anti-inflammatory material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation and application of an active oxygen scavenging anti-inflammatory material. The chemical structure of the active oxygen scavenging anti-inflammatory material is that The active oxygen scavenging anti-inflammatory material can effectively scavenge various active oxygen (including hydrogen peroxide, hypochlorite, superoxide anion and hydroxyl radical), and can be used for preparing medicines for treating diseases related to inflammation or oxidative stress injury.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for neurodermatitis and eczema and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a traditional Chinese medicine composition for neurodermatitis and eczema, wherein the preparation raw materials comprise main treatment components and auxiliary treatment components; the main treatment components consist of flos Genkwa, realgar and Natrii sulfas; the adjuvant treatment components comprise cortex Phellodendri, radix Sophorae Flavescentis, fructus Cnidii, kochiae fructus, periostracum Serpentis, fructus Lipuidambaris, siegesbeckiae herba, cortex Erythrinae, borneolum Syntheticum, pulvis Talci, herba Polygoni Avicularis, herba Artemisiae Scopariae, and Camphora. The advantages are that: 1) Experiments prove that the external traditional Chinese medicine preparation prepared by the method has very remarkable treatment effect on neurodermatitis; 2) The treatment cost of neurodermatitis is obviously reduced; 3) The external traditional Chinese medicine preparation prepared by the method has obvious curative effect on eczema.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating and/or preventing preeclampsia and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for treating and/or preventing preeclampsia and application thereof, in particular to application of granulocyte colony stimulating factor (Granulocyte Colony-stimulating Factor, G-CSF) and a modifier thereof (including but not limited to polyethylene glycol modification, albumin modification and the like) in combination treatment and/or prevention of preeclampsia with other drugs (one or more of hypoglycemic drugs, antithrombotic drugs, lipid-lowering drugs, proton pump inhibitors, anticoagulant drugs or cardiac glycoside drugs). Through two retrospective researches and animal experiments, the invention verifies the effectiveness of the combined use of the G-CSF and the hypoglycemic drugs, the antithrombotic drugs, the lipid-lowering drugs, the proton pump inhibitors, the anticoagulants or the cardiac glycosides drugs in treating and/or preventing preeclampsia, and can provide treatment benefits for patients with risk preeclampsia.

title_en: Compound for degrading TMPRSS2 protein in targeted ubiquitination, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound for targeted ubiquitination degradation of TMPRSS2 protein, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a general formula (I) or (II), and in the general formula, an E3 ligand is a ligand of E3 ligase VHL or CRBN, and a Linker is a connecting group. The compound disclosed by the invention can be used for targeted degradation of TMPRSS2 protein, has a good inhibition effect on various tumor cell lines, and has low toxicity on normal cells. The preparation method of the compound has simple operation and mild conditions, the obtained compound has TMPRSS2 protein degradation activity and remarkable anti-tumor effect, and the pharmacologically or physiologically acceptable salt of the compound can be used for preparing anti-tumor drugs.

title_en: Honey gastrodia elata tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a honey-processed gastrodia elata tablet and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of gastrodia elata. Comprising the following steps: (1) classification: cleaning and classifying fresh rhizoma Gastrodiae; (2) one-time steaming: steaming the fresh gastrodia elata of the same grade until no white heart exists inside, and no milk flows out; (3) primary drying: drying or air drying the steamed rhizoma Gastrodiae to seven dryness; (4) secondary steaming: steaming rhizoma Gastrodiae to soft and tough; (5) pressing: taking out rhizoma Gastrodiae when it is hot, and shaping to flat; (6) secondary drying: drying or air drying rhizoma Gastrodiae with consistent shape to seven dryness; (7) three times of steaming: steaming rhizoma Gastrodiae to soft and tough; (8) slicing: peeling rhizoma Gastrodiae, and slicing to obtain rhizoma Gastrodiae tablet; (9) honey preparation: pouring refined honey, lemon juice and peppermint oil into the gastrodia elata slices, uniformly stirring, and baking to obtain the honey gastrodia elata slices. This patent utilizes honey after the refining to flavor, cooks the gastrodia elata simultaneously, cuts thin slice after the plasticity, and is gone into the oven and toasts.

title_en: Application of anti-GNG 5 monoclonal antibody in treatment of Alzheimer disease
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical treatment, and discloses application of an anti-GNG 5 monoclonal antibody in treating Alzheimer's disease, in particular application of the anti-GNG 5 monoclonal antibody in preparing a small-molecule inhibitor for treating Alzheimer's disease. The anti-GNG 5 monoclonal antibody can clear excessive GNG5 in the body and prevent excessive Abeta 42 from being generated in the body, so that the Alzheimer disease can be effectively treated.

title_en: Novel cyclosporine derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cyclosporine derivative, a pharmaceutical composition containing the same and application thereof. The definition of specific substituent groups is described in the specification, and the application is the application of the cyclosporin derivative or a pharmaceutical composition containing the cyclosporin derivative in preparing medicines for treating or preventing cyclophilin mediated diseases or injuries, including viral infection, cancer, autoimmunity and inflammatory diseases.

title_en: Means and methods for reducing the concentration of aphicillin in a composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for reducing the concentration of aphicillin in a composition by providing a microorganism having at least 95% identity with a nucleotide sequence selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NOs 1-7; and the use of said microorganism.

title_en: Raw material for whitening and resisting aging as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whitening and anti-aging raw material, which comprises the following components in parts by mass: 6-15 g of licorice extract, 3-8 g of arbutin, 0.5-5 g of adenosine, 2-10 g of collagen, 100.5-5 g of coenzyme Q, 1-6 g of vitamin C phosphate magnesium, 0.5-5 g of green tea polyphenol, 30-60ml of fermentation liquor, 50-100 g of nano carrier, 80-200 g of purified water, 800-1200 g of cosmetic matrix and 1-5 g of zinc oxide, and the licorice extract and the arbutin are mixed with solvent water by clean raw material powder, then heated to 100-120 ℃, and then filtered, concentrated, purified and dried to finally obtain corresponding extract. The excellent moisturizing effect can be provided by the sodium hyaluronate and the fermentation broth, so that the moisture and the elasticity of the skin are maintained; fine lines and wrinkles can be reduced by adenosine, collagen and coenzyme Q10, and skin elasticity and firmness can be enhanced.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating cholestatic pruritus and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating cholestatic pruritus and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of traditional Chinese medicines. The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating cholestatic pruritus, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 4-6 parts of kuh-seng, 12-18 parts of virgate wormwood herb, 12-18 parts of lysimachia christinae hance, 8-12 parts of fructus kochiae, 8-12 parts of tribulus terrestris and 4-6 parts of honeycomb. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the traditional Chinese medicine composition. The drug effect test proves that the drug can obviously reduce the times of pruritus onset, shorten the duration of pruritus, and has better drug effect than chlorpheniramine maleate, and safer clinical use.

title_en: Eucommia ulmoides granule for treating bone flaccidity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses eucommia ulmoides particles for treating bone atrophy, which are prepared by extracting the following raw materials, by weight, 25-35 parts of eucommia ulmoides, 20-30 parts of prepared rhizome of rehmannia, 18-22 parts of Chinese yam, 20-30 parts of teasel root, 18-22 parts of myrrh, 20-30 parts of szechuan lovage rhizome, 15-25 parts of pseudo-ginseng, 18-22 parts of safflower, 20-30 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 20-30 parts of poria cocos, 25-35 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 20-30 parts of ginseng, 18-22 parts of polygonatum odoratum, 15-25 parts of dendrobium, 18-22 parts of notopterygium root, 20-30 parts of radix angelicae pubescentis, 20-30 parts of cimicifugae foetidae and 18-22 parts of radix sileris, and the purposes of nourishing liver and kidney, activating blood circulation to dissipate blood stasis, tonifying spleen and stomach and dispelling wind-dampness are achieved.

title_en: Antibody-siRNA conjugate and application thereof in preparation of lung adenocarcinoma treatment drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody-siRNA conjugate and application thereof in preparing a medicine for treating lung adenocarcinoma, belonging to the field of biomedicine. The antibody conjugate is obtained by covalently coupling an antibody of CD71 and siRNA targeting lncRNA070974 through a linker. The sense strand sequence of the siRNA is shown as SEQ ID NO:3, the sequence of the antisense strand is shown as SEQ ID NO: 4. The invention delivers siRNA into lung adenocarcinoma cells through CD71 mediation, inhibits tumor cell proliferation, and is expected to bring a new treatment strategy for lung adenocarcinoma. The invention also successfully targets the long-chain non-coding RNA by using the antibody nucleic acid conjugate for the first time to realize gene silencing, and provides a new thought and direction for gene therapy with the long-chain non-coding RNA as a target point.

title_en: Anti-bitter anesthesia mucilage, method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-bitter anesthetic mucilage, a method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. In the anti-bitter anesthetic mucilage, viscous protein with viscosity can be adhered to the tongue root part when being smeared on the tongue root part, and a medicinal film layer is formed on the surface of the tongue. When taking the medicine, the medicine film layer is not easy to wash away because of being stuck on the tongue root. The tetracaine hydrochloride gel has a local anesthetic effect, which can locally anesthetize the tongue root portion during the process of adhering the adhesive protein to the tongue root portion, so that no bitter taste is felt when taking medicines. After the bitter medicine or the bitter things are eaten, a small amount of hot water is taken, so that the bitter-preventing anesthetic mucilage smeared on the tongue root part can be removed, and the taste can be recovered after a period of time. The preparation method of the anti-bitter anesthetic mucilage is simple, the use is convenient, the anti-bitter anesthetic mucilage can be used for preventing bitter in a local anesthetic state, and the anti-bitter anesthetic mucilage is nontoxic and does not cause harm to a user.

title_en: Application of bendamustine combined rituximab in preparing medicament for treating DLBCL
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of bendamustine combined rituximab in preparing a medicament for regulating the immunity of an organism, in particular to an application in preparing an anti-tumor medicament for treating DLBCL combined cardiac insufficiency symptoms.

title_en: Application of SRSF1 as aortic dissection treatment target point
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of SRSF1 as an aortic dissection treatment target point, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. SRSF1 as a target can be used to screen for drugs that prevent and/or treat aortic dissection. SRSF1 is up-regulated in BAPN-induced aortic dissection model mice and aortic dissection patients. Vascular smooth muscle cell knockout SRSF1 mice are not prone to aortic dissection and elastic fiber degradation under BAPN induction. Vascular smooth muscle cell high expression SRSF1 mice are more susceptible to aortic dissection and elastic fiber degradation under BAPN induction. Mechanically, SRSF1 can regulate the phenotype of vascular smooth myositis, promote the degradation of the extravascular matrix, and knocking down SRSF1 can improve the phenomenon, thus providing a new target for treating aortic dissection.

title_en: Vaccine adjuvant, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A vaccine adjuvant, its preparation method and application are provided. The vaccine adjuvant is MA105 immune adjuvant, which comprises: (1) QS-21, 50-300 μg/ml; (2) PolyI: C,400-3000 μg/ml; and (3) lipid molecules constituting the carrier; the carrier is a mixture of cationic liposome and neutral liposome.

title_en: Non-urethane sustained release preparation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-urethane sustained release preparation, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of medical preparations, wherein the non-urethane sustained release preparation is prepared by uniformly mixing 30-50% of non-urethane, 0.1-1% of lubricant, 0.1-2% of glidant, 35-55% of carboxymethyl propyl cellulose, 4-12% of sodium bicarbonate and the balance of filler; the non-urethane sustained release preparation is used for treating animal epilepsy. The non-urethane sustained-release preparation provided by the invention solves the defect of excessively fast metabolism of non-urethane, and can maintain ideal blood concentration within 24 hours, so that the administration frequency is only required to be 1 time per day, the convenience of the animal owners in-home medicine feeding is greatly improved, the compliance is improved, the control of epileptic seizure of animals is facilitated, and the living quality of animals is improved.

title_en: Preparation and application of anti-oxidation brain-strengthening liver-protecting cyperus esculentus fat emulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and application of an antioxidant brain-strengthening liver-protecting cyperus esculentus fat emulsion, the preparation adopts the synergistic effect of the active ingredients such as the novel food raw material, namely the chufa oil, and the nervonic acid, DHA to prepare the chufa fat emulsion preparation with health care effect.

title_en: Application of complement factor C3 as crystallization-like retinal pigment degeneration treatment target
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ophthalmic disease treatment, and particularly relates to application of complement factor C3 as a crystallization-like retinal pigment degeneration treatment target. According to the invention, complement factor C3 is firstly provided as a treatment target point of the crystalline-like retinal pigment degeneration, the condition of lipid metabolism disturbance of crystalline-like retinal pigment degeneration cells and a zebra fish model can be obviously improved by inhibiting the function of complement factor C3, and accumulation of lipid droplets is slowed down, so that a favorable evidence is provided for treating the crystalline-like retinal pigment degeneration. The treatment method of the invention is simple, has lower cost and has obvious advantages compared with gene therapy, cell therapy and the like.

title_en: Self-replicating mRNA sequence and application thereof in preparation of anti-HPV tumor drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-replicating mRNA (MESSENGER RIBONUCLEICACID, mRNA) sequence and the application thereof in anti-HPV (Human PapillomaVirus ) tumor drugs. The self-replicating mRNA base comprises a sequence shown as at least one of SEQ ID NO. 8, SEQ ID NO. 13 and SEQ ID NO. 15. The invention is designed based on the mutation and series connection of E6 and E7 proteins, thereby improving the immunogenicity of the E6 and E7 proteins expressed by mRNA and overcoming the pain point problem that the E6 and E7 proteins of the vaccine in the prior art are difficult to be effectively identified by the immune system of the organism. The invention adopts the principle of immunotherapy, and can activate CD8+ T cell response in vivo only by using a small amount of mRNA drugs, so that the activated cell immune system attacks, inhibits or even eliminates HPV tumors, and has the advantages of small dosage, low drug injection frequency, small toxic and side effects, high immunogenicity and high safety. The invention has wide application prospect in tumor immunotherapy caused by HPV.

title_en: Scylla paramamosain antibacterial polypeptide Sparadin342-364And applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial polypeptide Sparadin  342‑364  of scylla paramamosain and application thereof, the molecular formula of the antibacterial polypeptide is C  109 H 201 N 39 O 29 S 2 , and the amino acid sequence of the antibacterial polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 01. The invention is composed of 23 amino acids, the molecular weight is 2586.4 daltons, the molecular weight contains 6 positively charged amino acid residues, the isoelectric point of the antibacterial peptide is predicted to be 11.83 according to the charges of the amino acid residues, the average coefficient of hydrophobicity is 0.20, the antibacterial peptide has good water solubility, is a positive-charge cationic polypeptide, has the characteristics of easy synthesis, wide antibacterial spectrum, high and stable antibacterial activity and the like, and has good application prospect in the field of aquaculture and the aspect of drug research.

title_en: Bionic high-bioavailability oral iron supplement and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bionic high-bioavailability oral iron supplement and a synthesis method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nano material synthesis. According to the invention, the hexa-linear iron hydrate (6-Fh) with a structure highly similar to that of iron cores in natural ferritin is synthesized by a hydrothermal method. The 6-Fh synthesis process does not add any modifier, has the characteristics of low reactivity, biotoxicity and high bioavailability, and is stable at room temperature. The iron supplementation effect of 6-Fh is equivalent to FeSO  4  (a classical and widely used oral iron supplement). In particular, 6-Fh is taken up by intestinal epithelial cells in a manner independent of the divalent metal transporter (DMT 1). The 6-Fh exists in the gastrointestinal tract stably in the form of nano particles, so that the irritation of metal ions to the gastrointestinal tract is avoided, and the utilization efficiency of iron is greatly improved.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating cardiovascular diseases, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating cardiovascular diseases and a preparation method thereof. The Chinese medicinal composition comprises astragalus, pseudo-ginseng, red sage root, peach kernel, snakegourd fruit, rhubarb, chinaroot greenbrier and white turnip. The preparation method comprises extracting radix astragali, notoginseng radix, saviae Miltiorrhizae radix, semen Persicae and rhizoma Smilacis chinensis to obtain extractive solution; then, the snakegourd fruit, the rheum officinale and the white cabbage are subjected to enzymolysis to obtain an enzymolysis liquid; and finally, mixing the extracting solution with the enzymolysis solution, concentrating and drying to obtain the product. The formula of the invention is prepared by mixing the smilax and the rheum officinale with other medicinal herbs according to a proper proportion, has obvious synergistic effect, has obvious effects on regulating blood lipid and improving hemorheology, has obvious curative effect and simple compatibility, provides a new scheme for treating cardiovascular diseases patients, and has practical application value.

title_en: Mite-removing, itching-relieving, acne-removing and whitening bath foam and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, in particular to a bath lotion capable of removing mites, relieving itching, removing acnes and whitening and a preparation method thereof. The shower gel contains dipotassium glycyrrhizinate and arbutin with whitening and other functions, sulfur with sterilizing and mite killing functions is added, and meanwhile, the arborvitae twig extract, the polygonum multiflorum extract, the sweet wormwood extract, the alpine leonardite herb extract, the centella asiatica extract, the phoenix-tail fern extract and the duckweed extract are added, so that the shower gel has good effects of mite removal, itching relieving, acne removal, whitening, moisturizing, bacteriostasis and the like. The shower gel disclosed by the invention is also added with a plurality of surfactants, so that a better cleaning effect is provided for the shower gel. The moisturizing agent, grape seed oil, avocado oil and evening primrose oil are also added, so that the product has good effects of moisturizing skin and moisturizing skin.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating non-small cell lung cancer KRAS G12C mutation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating non-small cell lung cancer KRAS G12C mutation and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicine. The pharmaceutical composition comprises trimetinib and artesunate, wherein the mass ratio of the trimetinib to the artesunate is 1:100. Compared with single medicine, the pharmaceutical composition of the trametinib and the artesunate can obviously inhibit the growth of tumors, obviously prolong the medicine resistance time, reduce the side effect of the single medicine and have low price. The pharmaceutical composition provided by the invention can be used for preparing a novel therapeutic drug for treating KRAS G12C mutant non-small cell lung cancer, and has important clinical significance.

title_en: White hyacinth bean flower polysaccharide, preparation method, production line and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine development, in particular to white hyacinth bean flower polysaccharide with functions of resisting oxidization, reducing blood sugar and reducing blood fat, a preparation method, a production line and application. The invention adopts ethanol to extract the crude polysaccharide of the white hyacinth bean flower by an ethanol precipitation method, adopts hot water extraction, trichloroacetic acid deproteinization and ethanol precipitation to further purify to obtain the white hyacinth bean flower polysaccharide, and characterizes the structure of the white hyacinth bean flower polysaccharide. The lablab seed polysaccharide has high antioxidant activity through DPPH free radical eliminating experiment, hydroxyl free radical eliminating experiment, ABTS  +  eliminating experiment and ferric ion reducing capacity measuring experiment, and has blood sugar and blood fat reducing activity through in vitro blood sugar and blood fat reducing experiment. The polysaccharide content in the white hyacinth bean flower is 7.05+/-0.74%, and the prepared white hyacinth bean flower polysaccharide is a potential polysaccharide with the functions of resisting oxidization, reducing blood sugar and reducing blood lipid, and has good market development and application prospects in the aspect of related health-care products or medicaments.

title_en: Medicinal liquor for treating coronary heart disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses medicinal liquor for treating coronary heart disease, which is prepared from the following raw materials: 30-50g of red sage root, 10-20g of astragalus root, 5-10g of rhizoma corydalis, 3-8g of saffron, 5-10g of pseudo-ginseng, 10-15g of cinnamon, 30-50g of hawthorn, 10-15g of snow lotus herb, 3-10g of snakegourd peel, 6-10g of cordyceps sinensis and 2000 ml of wine; the preparation method of the medicinal liquor comprises the following steps: s1, weighing and respectively storing the raw materials according to the components and the proportion of the raw materials for later use; s2, obtaining a slice raw material and a powder raw material; s3, obtaining a raw material packet; s4, sealing and storing; s5, obtaining primary soaking wine; s6, obtaining secondary soaking wine; s7, preparation can be completed, various medicinal materials can be reasonably blended by adopting various traditional Chinese medicine components, so that necessary performance effects are exerted, different medicinal materials are treated respectively, the reasonability of soaking is guaranteed, the waste of medicinal effects is avoided, medicinal liquor is soaked in batches, the loss of medicinal effects is avoided, the preparation and the production are convenient, and the treatment and the use are facilitated.

title_en: Universal novel carbon dot mouthwash for preventing and treating caries
abstract_en: The invention relates to a general novel carbon dot mouthwash for preventing and treating caries, in particular to application of a guanylated carbon dot, which is characterized by being used for preparing an antibacterial product, wherein the preparation method of the guanylated carbon dot comprises the following steps: mixing organic acid, quaternary ammonium salt and guanidine hydrochloride to obtain the guanylated carbon dot. The guanylated carbon dots of the present invention can be used for preparing a composition for (a) preventing and/or treating caries; and/or (b) reducing the number of bacterial biofilms; and/or (c) an antibacterial (e.g., anti-Streptococcus mutans) product that alters bacterial morphology.

title_en: Pramipexole long-acting sustained release preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The pramipexole long-acting slow-release preparation comprises pramipexole pamoate or pramipexole palmitate and polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer or polylactic acid, wherein the drug loading rate of the preparation is 10% -50%, and the molar ratio of lactic acid to glycolic acid of the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer is 85:15-95:5. The microsphere has round shape, smooth surface and no pore, can effectively reduce the early burst release of the medicine, and solves the problem of high burst release of the existing pramipexole pamoate microsphere; meanwhile, the slow release period can be effectively prolonged, the problem of short release period of the existing pramipexole pamoate microsphere is solved, the fluctuation of blood concentration is smaller, and the release is more stable.

title_en: External medicament for restoring ovarian function and cleaning internal vulva
abstract_en: The invention discloses an external medicament for restoring ovarian function and cleaning internal and external pudendum, which belongs to the technical field of preparation of medicines for ovary and internal and external pudendum, and comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-50 parts of compound, 30-40 parts of elemene inclusion compound, 10-15 parts of mint She Lvye, 20-30 parts of perilla seed oil, 4-6 parts of propolis extract, 8-12 parts of sunflower extract, 8-10 parts of perilla extract, 5-7 parts of litchi plant extract and 2-5 parts of lithospermum extract. The pulsatilla chinensis extract is encapsulated in the polyglutamic acid and chitosan nanoemulsion, so that the pulsatilla chinensis extract can be protected from being damaged by the external environment, nanoparticles are formed, and the pulsatilla chinensis extract is favorably absorbed by vaginal mucosa cells; the rosmarinic acid is grafted on the hyaluronic acid molecular chain, and the hyaluronic acid molecular binding site is increased, so that the rosmarinic acid has stronger moisturizing effect and is beneficial to forming a layer of lasting moisturizing barrier on the surface of vaginal mucosa.

title_en: Compound traditional Chinese medicine decoction particles
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound traditional Chinese medicine decoction granule, which comprises the following effective components in parts by mass: 0-30 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 3-10 parts of coptis chinensis, 0-20 parts of semen euryales and 0-20 parts of cherokee rose. 0 to 12 parts of pinellia tuber, 0 to 9 parts of baikal skullcap root, 0 to 9 parts of dried ginger, 0 to 9 parts of ginseng, 3 to 10 parts of coptis root and 0 to 30 parts of Chinese date; the compound traditional Chinese medicine decoction particles are prepared by a freeze drying method. The compound traditional Chinese medicine decoction particles are in a solid particle form, and are directly reconstituted into decoction form by water before administration, so that the compound traditional Chinese medicine decoction particles have the advantages of easiness in absorption and quick response of decoction, and also have the advantages of good stability, convenience in storage, transportation and carrying and the like of solid preparations, particularly have good medicine solubility, are convenient to brew, and overcome the problems that the common normal pressure or vacuum drying products are uneven in heating, long in time, and hard in texture, and active ingredients are easily damaged and are not easy to redissolve.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrophobic MOF material and application thereof129Application in Xe magnetic resonance signal enhancement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic resonance spectroscopy, in particular to a preparation method of a hydrophobic Metal Organic Framework (MOF) material and application thereof in enhancing  129  Xe signals. According to the invention, CAU-1-OH-NH  2  is taken as a basic framework, and Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) is wrapped on the surface of a CAU-1-OH-NH  2  material by adopting a chemical vapor deposition method, so that PDMS@CAU-1-OH-NH  2  with certain hydrophobicity is formed. Compared with the CAU-1-OH-NH  2  without the hydrophobic membrane, the PDMS@CAU-1-OH-NH  2  obtained by the strategy has the advantages that the Hyper-CEST signal is obviously enhanced, and the signal directly sampled by  129  Xe is from nothing to nothing. The hydrophobic strategy enhanced  129  Xe signal provided a new idea for the optimization of the subsequent  129  Xe molecular cage signal and the design of the novel  129  Xe molecular cage.

title_en: Novel FAP inhibitor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel FAP inhibitor and application thereof, and relates to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry and radiopharmaceuticals, wherein the FAP inhibitor comprises a compound shown as a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, hydrates, solvates thereof and corresponding radioactive element markers: wherein R1 and R2 are each independently selected from hydrogen, deuterium, halogen, methyl, halomethyl, methoxy, trifluoromethoxy, hydroxy or cyano; r3 is selected from hydrogen, deuterium, methyl, isopropyl, isobutyl, cyclopropyl or cyclobutyl; r4 is selected from hydrogen, methyl, ethyl, propyl, cyclopropyl or cyclobutyl; r5 is selected from hydrogen, methyl, halogen, hydroxyl or mercapto. The novel FAP inhibitor combined with the corresponding radioactive element can be used for diagnosing and treating FAP positive related diseases, and compared with the traditional FAPI radiopharmaceuticals, the novel FAP inhibitor has higher uptake rate at focus positions, higher target-to-non-target contrast ratio and no obvious toxic or side effect.

title_en: FeMoO A4Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides FeMoO  4  nanometer materials, a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, adding a molybdenum source, aliphatic amine and a surface stabilizer into a high-boiling-point solvent, heating and stirring for 5-60 min at 60-120 ℃, then adding an iron source, heating and stirring for 1-60 min at 60-120 ℃, transferring the mixture into a polytetrafluoroethylene autoclave, performing solvothermal reaction for 6-24 h at 100-280 ℃, using an organic polar solvent for washing and centrifuging, dispersing in the organic nonpolar solvent to obtain an oil phase FeMoO  4  nanometer material, S2, adopting a surface modification method, dissolving the oil phase FeMoO  4  nanometer material and modified molecules into the organic nonpolar solvent, stirring for 0-24 h at 25 ℃, performing rotary evaporation for 1h at 60 ℃, and adding distilled water to obtain FeMoO  4  nanometer materials. Under the solvothermal reaction condition, a great number of defect sites are generated in situ by synthesizing and eroding MoO  3‑x  matrix, wherein the defect sites are anchoring sites of single atoms, and in a system, the anchoring sites are anchored by the single atoms Fe, so that the metal substitution rate of the formed single atom Fe nano material is as high as 20.72wt%.

title_en: Hibiscus sabdariffa flavonoid compound as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flavonoid compound of hibiscus and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of medicines. The invention provides a flavonoid compound, the structural formula of which is shown as the formula I. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the flavonoid compound. The invention adopts traditional extraction, separation and purification technology to obtain a brand new compound of formula I, and confirms that the compound has obvious anti-inflammatory activity and confirms the anti-inflammatory way through anti-inflammatory activity experiments and western immunoblotting; the pharmacodynamic test proves that the flavonoid compound is used for treating colpitis, the efficacy is obvious, the moderate dose can reach obvious efficacy, and a new choice is provided for clinic.

title_en: Antibacterial and anti-inflammatory mouthwash
