abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory mouthwash in the field of oral cavity cleaning and hygiene, which is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight: 7-10% of honeysuckle solution, 6-9% of purslane solution, 0.8-1.2% of passion fruit juice, 2.5-5% of dark green tea, 0.2-1.5% of mint and the balance of water. The invention has the beneficial effects that the purslane extract is used as a functional additive, so that the purslane extract has the effects of resisting bacteria and diminishing inflammation, relieving the stink of tissues in the oral cavity, clearing away blood toxin and relieving the symptoms of dental ulcer, the passion fruits are rich in a large amount of trace elements such as vitamin c, calcium, phosphorus, iron and the like to form a buffer system on the teeth, the dark tea is used as a plant with higher fluorine content, the teeth are fluorinated to prevent dental caries, and the auxiliary fragrance of peppermint is convenient for entry, so that the effects of resisting bacteria and diminishing inflammation of the oral cavity are not reduced, and the oral cavity is not damaged.

title_en: Iron ion coupled mitoxantrone nanoparticle and preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-small iron ion coupled mitoxantrone nanoparticle, a preparation method and medical application thereof. The prepared iron ion coupled mitoxantrone nanoparticle has stable property, better tumor targeting, accumulation and distribution than free drugs, and better tumor penetrating capacity and tumor inhibiting capacity.

title_en: Novel yellow tea polysaccharide and application thereof in preparation of antihypertensive drug preparation
abstract_en: The invention discloses novel yellow tea polysaccharide and application thereof in preparation of antihypertensive medicinal preparations, wherein the novel yellow tea polysaccharide is abbreviated as LYTP-2, the total sugar content is 89.75%, and the monosaccharide composition and the molar ratio are mannose, rhamnose, galacturonic acid, glucose, galactose, arabinose=1.844:2.898:2.4:29.98:10.438:1, and the relative molecular mass is 2.0898 multiplied by 10  4  Da. The efficacy experiment shows that the yellow tea polysaccharide LYTP-2 has good ACE inhibitory activity, can obviously reduce systolic pressure and diastolic pressure by regulating RAAS in a rat with hypertension of two kidneys and one clamp, and improves left ventricular hypertrophy, thoracic aortic thickening and kidney injury. The novel yellow tea polysaccharide LYTP-2 has clear composition and obvious efficacy, and has wide development and application prospects in the aspects of preparing antihypertensive and antihypertensive target organ injury improving pharmaceutical preparations.

title_en: Application of AEBP1 gene inhibitor in preparation of medicine for treating cancer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cancer medicaments, and particularly relates to application of an AEBP1 gene inhibitor in preparation of a medicament for treating cancer; the AEBP1 gene of the mouse can be knocked out, so that the growth of the tumor of the mouse can be obviously inhibited; and the compound Chem-5340199 can obviously inhibit the growth of mouse tumors, and has no obvious toxic or side effect on the cellular and in-vivo levels.

title_en: Phospholipid membrane quercetin nanoparticle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phospholipid membrane quercetin nanoparticle, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of drug modification preparation. According to the invention, the quercetin is subjected to chemical modification, and then a phospholipid membrane is coated outside a quercetin modified kernel after the chemical modification to obtain the PM-Que. The PM-Que prepared by the method has good solubility, the drug loading rate is 22.73%, which means that 227.3 mug can be loaded if 1mg of Que is added in the preparation process, so that the solubility of quercetin in water is greatly improved, and the technical problem that the drug effect is influenced by poor water solubility of Que in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition of 3CL inhibitor compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and provides a pharmaceutical composition of a 3CL inhibitor compound, and a preparation method and application thereof.

title_en: Preparation method and application of macleaya cordata oral liquid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of traditional Chinese veterinary medicines, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of macleaya cordata oral liquid; the compound extract of the plant is obtained by carrying out compound extraction on the macleaya cordata and the dandelion, then the compound oral liquid product of the traditional Chinese veterinary medicine without antibiotics is prepared by adopting a liquid production method, and the diarrhea disease is enteritis and diarrhea disease of cattle, sheep and pigs (especially piglets), so that the compound oral liquid has good treatment effect and wide application range, can not cause accumulation of antibiotics in livestock and poultry bodies, avoids transmission of induced drug resistance, has no toxic and side effects after use, and meets the medication requirements of producing pollution-free livestock products and green livestock products.

title_en: Heteroaromatic ring compound, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heteroaromatic compound, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof. The invention provides a compound shown as a formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The compounds of the invention can reactivate mutated p53, restoring p53 cancer-inhibiting function. The compound of the invention shows good proliferation inhibition activity on BxPC-3 human pancreatic cancer cells and/or HuH-7 human liver cancer cells with p53Y220C mutation.

title_en: Application of lactobacillus plantarum KSFY to preparation of medicines or foods for improving depression-like behaviors
abstract_en: The invention provides application of lactobacillus plantarum KSFY to preparation of medicines or foods for improving depression-like behaviors, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The lactobacillus plantarum KSFY is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) No.30929. The study of the invention finds that the lactobacillus plantarum 3835.plantarum KSFY is effective in improving depression-like behaviors.

title_en: Injectable hydrogel for pet endometritis and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an injectable hydrogel for treating endometritis of pets, and belongs to the technical field of veterinary drug preparation. The injectable hydrogel prepared by the invention comprises the following raw materials of forsythoside A, chitosan, beta-sodium glycerophosphate, sodium hyaluronate, acetic acid and water. According to the invention, by combining the technical advantages of the temperature-sensitive gel technology and the injectable gel technology, forsythoside A and chitosan are combined to obtain the injectable hydrogel with excellent antibacterial performance. According to the invention, the forsythoside A is wrapped by chitosan, so that the antibacterial effect of the forsythoside A is enhanced, the release time of the medicine is prolonged, the time required for repairing inflammatory injury can be effectively shortened, and the probability of secondary infection in the uterine cavity is reduced.

title_en: Microecological composition with soothing and repairing effects based on skin care target points
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of A61K8/18, in particular to a microecological composition with a soothing and repairing effect based on a skin care target point, which is prepared from, by weight, at least 1-40 parts of prebiotics, 0-20 parts of probiotics, 0.1-3 parts of auxiliary agents and 50-100 parts of solvents, wherein the prebiotics at least comprise at least one of glucan, ribose, inulin and tetrahydropyrimidine carboxylic acid (ectoin), so that the microecological balance of skin is effectively regulated, and meanwhile, the microecological composition has the effects of repairing skin barriers, relieving redness, stinging, itching, antioxidation and the like, and better meets the use requirements of sensitive skin.

title_en: Combination of antibody-drug conjugates and anti-SIRP alpha antibodies
abstract_en: Pharmaceutical compositions, methods of treatment, and anti-SIRP alpha antibodies are provided that are excellent in terms of anti-tumor effect and safety. The pharmaceutical compositions and methods of treatment are characterized in that an anti-sirpa antibody and at least one antibody-drug conjugate selected from the group consisting of golian Sha Tuozhu mab, velocituzumab and enmetrastuzumab are combined and administered. The anti-SIRPalpha antibody is characterized by being administered in combination with the antibody-drug conjugate.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and cosmetic composition
abstract_en: Provided is a pharmaceutical composition or a pharmaceutical composition raw material comprising a supernatant of a medium after induction-culturing pluripotent stem cells.

title_en: New pentacyclic triterpene B extracted from oleanane type compound extracted from radix bupleuri, and extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oleanane compound new pentacyclic triterpene B extracted from radix stellariae, and an extraction method and application thereof, which can effectively solve the problems of extraction and application of radix stellariae. According to the invention, the compound is extracted from the starwort root, the compound oleanane type compound new pentacyclic triterpene B is obtained by separation, and the related activity experiment result shows that the new pentacyclic triterpene B can obviously reduce the RBL-2H3 cell degranulation damage induced by C48/80, obviously reduce the IgE level, has antiallergic activity, can be further used for preparing medicines for treating allergic diseases, and exploits the medicinal value of the starwort root.

title_en: Female genital tract repairing gel containing complex enzyme and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a female genital tract repairing gel containing complex enzyme and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of gynaecology hygiene, comprising the following steps of S1, preparing materials, namely uniformly mixing chlorhexidine acetate, carbomer, triethanolamine and glycerin according to parts by mass, adding antioxidase and lysozyme solution for dissolution; S2, emulsifying, namely placing the mixture into a vacuum homogenizing emulsifying machine, uniformly stirring, heating the mixture to 60-90 ℃ from normal temperature, preserving heat, cooling the mixture to normal temperature, heating the mixture to 60-90 ℃ from normal temperature, preserving heat for 1-1.5 hours, preserving heat for 1-2 hours, and cooling the mixture to normal temperature for 0.5-1 hour.

title_en: Application of Acremonium standard strain ATCC BAA-835 in reducing area of retinal neovascularization and reducing retinal inflammation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of an Acremonium standard strain ATCC BAA-835 in reducing the area of a new blood vessel of retina and reducing retinal inflammation, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention applies an Ackermansia standard strain ATCC BAA-835, finds a new application in reducing the areas of retina and choroid new blood vessels and reducing retinal inflammation, and provides a new thought for clinically relieving the vision impairment of the aged macular degeneration patients such as premature infant retinopathy, pathologic neovascular high myopia, polypoidal chorioretinopathy, retinal vasculitis and diabetic retinopathy vision impairment, and has wide application prospect and popularization value.

title_en: Benzimidazole derivative targeting bacterial lipoprotein transporter LolCDE, composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses benzimidazole derivatives targeting bacterial lipoprotein transport protein LolCDE, a composition and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical medicines. The benzimidazole derivatives of the gram inner and outer membrane targeting key protein machine provided by the invention have the structure that . The benzimidazole derivative has remarkable antibacterial activity, the minimum antibacterial concentration can be as low as 8 mug/mL, and meanwhile, the benzimidazole derivative can have affinity with target protein LolCDE, so that a novel approach is provided for specific antibacterial treatment of gram-negative bacteria.

title_en: Thymus-dependent lymphocyte antigen epitope peptide of hepatitis B virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses thymus-dependent lymphocyte antigen epitope peptide of hepatitis B virus antigen and application thereof, belonging to the fields of medical immunology and infectious disease. The thymic dependent lymphocyte antigen epitope peptide of hepatitis B virus antigen has the amino acid sequence comprising one or several kinds of amino acid sequence from EEIRLMVFVL, FSSAGPCAL, KSVQHLESL, RVTGGVFLV. The epitope peptide can be specifically combined with cytotoxic thymus dependent lymphocyte to stimulate the activation, proliferation and differentiation of the cytotoxic thymus dependent lymphocyte so as to play an immune effect of resisting hepatitis B virus, and can be used for preparing therapeutic and preventive vaccines for hepatitis B virus infection, and also can be used for preparing detection reagents for detecting the specific cytotoxic thymus dependent lymphocyte of the hepatitis B virus, thereby having potential application value in prevention, treatment and diagnosis of the hepatitis B.

title_en: Compound containing aminobenzoselenazole and triazole bi-heterocycle, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aminobenzoselenazole and triazole bi-heterocycle-containing compound which has a structural formula shown in a formula (I), wherein R  1 、R 2 、R 3  is independently selected from hydrogen, alkyl, halogen, nitro, methoxy, trifluoromethyl, trifluoromethoxy, cyano, aryl, substituted aryl, ester, acyl, aliphatic heterocycle and aromatic heterocycle, and n is the number of carbon separation. The compound containing aminobenzoselenazole and triazole bi-heterocycle shows higher inhibition activity on cancer cells, especially human gastric cancer cells MGC803, and provides a new choice for development and application of gastric cancer therapeutic drugs. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple to operate, mild in system, low in cost, high in yield and great in popularization and application value.

title_en: Ginseng antler refined component and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A ginseng and pilose antler refined component and a preparation method and application thereof relate to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines and solve the problem that the traditional post-menopausal osteoporosis medicine is easy to produce adverse reaction after long-term use. Comprises 12 ginsenoside components and 4 cornu Cervi Pantotrichum oligopeptide components. Pulverizing cornu Cervi Pantotrichum and Ginseng radix, mixing, sieving with 10-30 mesh sieve, reflux-extracting with ethanol, mixing the extractive solutions, centrifuging, collecting supernatant, drying, eluting with ethanol on macroporous adsorbent resin, collecting eluate, drying, eluting with ethanol in C  18  reverse chromatography column, collecting eluate, and drying to obtain refined component of Ginseng radix extract. The invention can be applied to the preparation of medicaments for postmenopausal osteoporosis.

title_en: Application of wogonin in preparing medicine for treating xerosis syndrome and traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating xerosis syndrome
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of wogonin in preparing a medicament for treating sicca syndrome and a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating sicca syndrome, and belongs to the technical field of medicament preparation. Wogonin is not only able to inhibit the growth of M1 macrophages, but is also able to alleviate the drying syndrome by inducing iron death of M1 macrophages. The invention also provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating the drying syndrome, which contains wogonin and can be used for treating the drying syndrome.

title_en: Application of organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt in preparation of medical material for parting diagnosis of prostatitis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt in preparing medical materials for parting diagnosis of prostatitis, wherein the organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt can improve parting diagnosis of prostatitis, a molecular-level or nano-pipeline biocompatible film is formed in a urethra to prevent or destroy bacterial biomembrane, and prostatic fluid flows out through the pipeline without being polluted by bacteria and leucocytes, so that parting diagnosis rate is improved, basis is provided for treating prostatitis, and a novel method for parting diagnosis of prostatitis is provided.

title_en: Use of a vaccine targeting a recessive TERT epitope for the treatment of cancer in HLA-A x 0201 positive patients suffering from TERT-expressing non-immunogenic tumors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of a tumor vaccine consisting of two nine amino acid peptides, which are WT recessive TERT572 (RLFFYRKSV, SEQ ID NO: 1) expressed by tumor cells and its optimized variant TERT572Y (YLFFYRKSV, SEQ ID NO: 2), for the treatment of cancer in HLa-a 0201 positive patients with TERT expressing non-immunogenic tumors.

title_en: C1q antibody and application thereof, and medicament for inhibiting activation of complement classical pathway and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, in particular to a C1q antibody and application thereof, and an agent for inhibiting activation of a classical pathway of complement and application thereof. A C1q antibody comprises VHCDR1, VHCDR2 and VHCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-3, and VLCDR1, VLCDR2 and VLCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NO. 4-6. The antibody has better affinity with the C1q antigen, and can effectively inhibit activation of the classical pathway of complement.

title_en: Cas protein, composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Cas protein, a composition and application thereof. Wherein the Cas protein comprises a protein having at least 80% identity to the amino acid sequence set forth in any one of SEQ ID Nos.1-6, and complexes and compositions for nucleic acid editing comprising the proteins or fusion proteins of the present invention, or nucleic acid molecules encoding them. The invention also relates to a method for nucleic acid editing using a protein or fusion protein comprising the invention.

title_en: Nalbuphine hydrochloride injection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and in particular relates to a nalbuphine hydrochloride injection and a preparation method thereof. The invention solves the problem that the impurities of the dual nalbuphine are easy to generate in the prior art by changing the components and the content of the prescription, obviously improves the stability of the preparation and reduces the risks possibly brought by various potential side effects. Meanwhile, the preparation process is optimized, the process time consumption is greatly shortened, and the exposure time of the product is reduced.

title_en: Synthesis method of pyrrolo [1,2-a ] quinoxaline-4 (5H) -ketone compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthesis method of pyrrolo [1,2-a ] quinoxaline-4 (5H) -ketone compounds, which comprises the following steps of initiating addition and cyclization of nucleophilic imine free radicals to electron-deficient alpha-cyano-alpha, beta-unsaturated ketone (b) by utilizing a visible light catalyst, a hydrogen transfer (HAT) catalyst and an acidic additive through hydrogen atom transfer of N=C  sp   2  -H bond of quinoxaline ketone (a) under visible light irradiation to prepare the pyrrolo [1,2-a ] quinoxaline-4 (5H) -ketone compounds. The whole synthesis method is simple, efficient and mild, avoids transition metal and other residues, has the characteristics of environmental protection and the like, utilizes the synergistic catalytic tandem reaction of visible light and bromine free radicals, has the advantages of high atom economy, step economy, chemical selectivity and the like, and obtains heterocyclic molecules with high added value from simple and easily obtained raw materials, and the synthesis cost is low. The pyrrolo [1,2-a ] quinoxaline-4 (5H) -ketone compound prepared by the invention has a certain antitumor activity, and can be applied to preparing medicines for treating tumors.

title_en: Chlorella pyrenoidosa peptide calcium chelate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chlorella pyrenoidosa calcium chelating peptide and a chlorella pyrenoidosa peptide calcium chelate prepared by using the chlorella pyrenoidosa calcium chelating peptide, wherein the prepared chlorella pyrenoidosa peptide calcium chelate can enhance the maximum tibia load and the structural strength of an osteoporosis mouse. The chlorella pyrenoidosa calcium chelating peptide provided by the invention is combined with calcium ions to form a peptide calcium chelate, and animal experiments prove that the peptide calcium chelate can obviously improve the maximum tibia load and the structural strength of an osteoporosis mouse, and has the effect of improving the bone biomechanical property of the osteoporosis mouse.

title_en: High nucleic acid Kluyveromyces marxianus mutant strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a high nucleic acid Kluyveromyces marxianus mutant strain and application thereof. Specifically, the disclosure provides a high nucleic acid content kluyveromyces marxianus which is classified and named as kluyveromyces marxianus (Kluyveromyces marxianus) CJA0022, and the preservation number is CCTCC No. M20242475. The nucleic acid content in single cell can reach 15%, and the growth rate is high, and the heredity can be stabilized. The Kluyveromyces marxianus strain disclosed by the application has a wide yeast nucleic acid product manufacturing basis.

title_en: Application of epibole alcohol in preparation of anti-lung cancer substance and anti-lung cancer composition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical application, and particularly relates to application of epitramadol in preparation of an anti-lung cancer substance and an anti-lung cancer composition, wherein the invention proves that Epifriedelanol has an inhibition effect on PAICS protein expression in a lung cancer cell line A549/PC9 through Western Blot experiments, and has a dose-dependent relationship with Epifriedelanol concentration. CCK8 experiments found that the inhibition of A549/PC9 by Epifriedelanol alone, CDDP alone was significantly weaker than that of Epifriedelanol in combination with Cisplatin (CDDP).

title_en: 4, 5-Dihydro-3H-pyrrolo [2,3-c ] quinolin-4-one derivatives and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and relates to a 4, 5-dihydro-3H-pyrrolo [2,3-c ] quinoline-4-one derivative, application thereof in inhibiting ATX enzyme and application thereof in preparing medicines for treating and/or preventing diseases caused by ATX-LPA functional axis abnormality, in particular to application in preparing medicines for treating and/or preventing fibrotic diseases and cancers. The derivative is a compound shown in a general formula (I) and pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and in-vitro activity screening shows that the compound has outstanding ATX enzyme inhibition activity and a certain anti-tumor cell proliferation activity, and has good anti-fibrosis activity in a bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis model and good application prospect.

title_en: Recombinant AAV capsid proteins
abstract_en: Provided herein are recombinant adeno-associated virus (AAV) capsid proteins, compositions (e.g., rAAV) comprising the capsid proteins, nucleic acids encoding the capsid proteins, and methods of making and using the capsid proteins.

title_en: Carbobicyclic nucleosides for treatment of viral infections
abstract_en: Carbobicyclic nucleoside compounds are provided for use in the treatment of coronavirus diseases 2019 (COVID-19), RSV and other viral infections. The carbobicyclic nucleoside compound may be a compound as set forth herein. Pharmaceutical formulations for use in the treatment COVID-19 and RSV are also described.

title_en: Amorphous mixture comprising neutral mono-or oligosaccharides and an acidic non-carbohydrate component
abstract_en: Provided are i) amorphous carbon carbohydrates having improved chemical stability and/or physical properties, ii) a process for manufacturing amorphous carbon carbohydrates having improved chemical stability and/or physical properties, and iii) a process for improving the chemical stability and/or physical properties of amorphous carbon carbohydrates.

title_en: MRNA medicine for enhancing T cell curative effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an mRNA medicine for enhancing T cell curative effect and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The mRNA drug coding protein is a BH3 domain of a pro-apoptotic protein Puma or Bim fused with a proper ligand bracket, and the administration mode is an intratumoral administration dosage form. The invention provides an mRNA anti-tumor drug, which utilizes the form of the mRNA drug to carry out intratumoral local administration, induces local apoptosis of focus and can synergistically enhance the T cell mediated killing effect. Finally achieves the effect of synergistically inhibiting the growth of the solid tumor in vivo. The novel mRNA drug provided by the invention shows a strong and effective tumor inhibiting effect in a solid tumor model.

title_en: Nucleoside compound, preparation method thereof, composition thereof and application of nucleoside compound in medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to a nucleoside compound, a preparation method thereof, a composition thereof and application thereof in medicines. The compound of the present invention has a structure represented by formula (I). The compound or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof can be used as METTL inhibitor and has good activity.

title_en: Method for synthesizing cobra antibacterial peptide NA30-CATH by multi-copy integration and high-density fermentation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synthesizing cobra antibacterial peptide NA30-CATH by multi-copy integration and high-density fermentation and application thereof, belonging to the technical fields of genetic engineering and biological engineering. The invention constructs plasmid with two tandem copies, takes pichia pastoris as host, successfully expresses two copies of tandem proteins, and improves the expression yield of the cobra antibacterial peptide NA30-CATH by more than 2 times. Then, by constructing and optimizing a two-copy integration method and optimizing a fermentation process, the high-level synthesis of the cobra antibacterial peptide NA30-CATH is realized. In addition, the invention also provides application of the cobra antibacterial peptide NA30-CATH as a bacteriostatic agent in the process of culturing the micropterus salmoides, and the survival rate of the micropterus salmoides is improved.

title_en: Celecoxib orally disintegrating tablet and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and in particular discloses a celecoxib orally disintegrating tablet and a preparation process thereof. A process for preparing orally disintegrating tablet of celecoxib includes such steps as adding beta-cyclodextrin to deionized water, dissolving to obtain emulsion, adding celecoxib to emulsion, stirring to obtain basic liquid, adding bacterial cellulose to deionized water, adding ammonium carbonate, vacuum filtering to obtain fibrous cake, immersing fibrous cake in the absolute alcohol solution of tetraethyl silicate, washing, drying, grinding to obtain carrier, adding carrier to basic liquid, stirring, centrifugal separation, freeze drying to obtain inclusion compound, mixing inclusion compound with filler, lubricant, adhesive and sweetening agent, stirring, emulsifying, vacuumizing, loading in bubbles, pre-freezing, freeze drying, and packing. The orally disintegrating tablet prepared by the application has the advantages of high disintegration speed, convenient administration, slightly sweet taste and high medication compliance of patients.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating lichen planus with syndrome of damp-heat accumulation in interior and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating lichen planus with damp-heat accumulation in interior, and a preparation method and application thereof. In the formula, rhizoma atractylodis and phellodendron are used as monarch drugs, the rhizoma atractylodis is used for drying dampness and the phellodendron is used for removing heat, the two drugs are combined, the pathogenic factors are cleared, both the symptoms and root causes are treated, the damp-heat is removed, and the damp evil is removed. Kuh-seng is used as ministerial drug for clearing heat and reducing diuresis, and can clear heat and dry dampness. Coix seed is an adjuvant drug, sweet and bland in taste, good in flavor, and mild in cold energy, and good in flavor, and can invigorate the spleen without hurting the healthy energy. Cortex moutan is bitter and pungent in flavor and free from stasis, slightly cold in nature and clear in energy, and achyranthes root is used as guiding drug for its actions of clearing heat and cooling blood, activating blood and resolving stasis and achyranthes root is used as guiding drug for descending. The whole prescription has the effects of clearing damp-heat, guiding the damp-heat of upper energizer downwards, discharging urine, and having better treatment effect on the lichen planus with the damp-heat in the interior, and the effective rate can reach 80.0% -86.7% after two treatment courses.

title_en: Banana resistant starch nano-particle, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of resistant starch nano-particles. The invention provides banana resistant starch nano particles and a preparation method and application thereof, and the banana resistant starch nano particles comprise the following steps of performing steam explosion on bananas and cooling to obtain banana slurry; mixing banana pulp with ethanol, standing, centrifuging to obtain precipitate 1, washing precipitate 1 with water, centrifuging to obtain precipitate 2, and drying precipitate 2 to obtain banana resistant starch nanoparticle. The preparation method can quickly destroy the compact plant tissue and cell wall structure of the banana, so that the hydrogen bonds in cellulose can be completely broken in a short time, and the preparation method has the advantages of low energy consumption, no pollution, high efficiency and the like, and has great potential in the aspect of food processing. The starch nano-particles prepared by the method disclosed by the invention have the advantages of controllable particle size, uniform size, simple and convenient method and low energy consumption, can be used as a food additive, a health-care product or a drug carrier, and widens the application field of banana resistant starch.

title_en: Polyethylene glycol modified DNase I-loaded hollow mesoporous cerium dioxide nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyethylene glycol modified DNase I loaded hollow mesoporous cerium dioxide nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of biomedicine, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of preparing hollow mesoporous cerium dioxide by a hydrothermal method; the functionalized hollow mesoporous cerium dioxide surface is subjected to surface amino functionalization by APTES modification, DNase I and connection polyethylene glycol are sequentially loaded by further using EDC/NHS crosslinking technology, and the nanoparticle with high stability and good biocompatibility is prepared. Experiments prove that the obtained nano-particles retain the biological activity of DNase I and simultaneously show the anti-oxidation and anti-inflammatory effects. The invention provides a preparation method of DNase I-loaded hollow mesoporous cerium dioxide nano particles, which realizes high-efficiency enzyme loading by optimizing material preparation and functionalization processes, and has obvious anti-inflammatory effect and good biocompatibility.

title_en: Darunavir and cobicistat compound tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a darunavir and cobicistat composite tablet and a preparation method thereof, wherein the darunavir and cobicistat composite tablet is prepared by the following steps of adding darunavir ethanol compound, part of a first disintegrating agent and a first lubricant into a dry granulating machine, granulating and finishing to obtain dry granules; mixing hypromellose with proper amount of water to form adhesive solution, spraying the adhesive solution after mixing the dry granules and the rest of the first disintegrating agent, carrying out wet granulation, drying and granulating to obtain wet granules, mixing the wet granules, the silicon dioxide loaded with cobicistat, the second disintegrating agent and the filler uniformly, sieving, adding the second lubricating agent, continuously mixing uniformly, and carrying out film coating after tabletting. The darunavir and the cobicistat are combined to prepare the medicine, so that the drug resistance generated by single administration is reduced, and more choices are provided for the administration of patients with AIDS. In addition, the compound tablet of the invention can improve the content of darunavir.

title_en: Dithiophene benzo bridged ligand and preparation method thereof, and dithienyl benzo bridged dinuclear metal complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of development of tumor photodynamic therapy photosensitizers, sonodynamic therapy sonosensitizers and photothermal therapy photothermal agents, and provides a bithiophene benzo bridging ligand and a preparation method thereof, a bithiophene benzo bridging binuclear metal complex and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention is based on a dithiophene benzo bridging ligand dtdpip, and respectively designs a dithiophene benzo bridging binuclear ruthenium complex, a dithiophene benzo bridging binuclear osmium complex and a dithiophene benzo bridging binuclear iridium complex. The bithiophene benzo bridged binuclear metal complex has extremely high stability and excellent two-photon absorption characteristic, and has excellent biotoxicity and photothermal conversion capability under the action of infrared excitation light and ultrasonic waves. The conjugated double thiophene binuclear metal complex provided by the invention is a potential novel infrared photodynamic photosensitizer, sound sensitizer and photothermal reagent, and has wide application prospects in photodynamic therapy, sound dynamic therapy and photothermal therapy of tumors.

title_en: Tile Ning Qiankong strain ZAAS-S11 and cultivation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strain of Wa Ning Qiankong bacterium ZAAS-S11, which comprises an ITS section nucleic acid sequence and a specific section nucleic acid sequence, wherein the ITS section nucleic acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, the specific section nucleic acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the strain is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center with the preservation number of CGMCC NO.41355. The Wa Ning Qiankong bacterium ZAAS-S11 mycelium extract can effectively prevent and treat inflammatory enteritis by oral administration, and the Wa Ning Qiankong bacterium ZAAS-S11 strain has good administration safety and provides a new choice for preventing and treating inflammatory enteritis of people.

title_en: Methods for treating complement-mediated diseases
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods of treating condensed Collectinopathy (CAD) or Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP) in a subject in need thereof. These methods comprise administering to a subject a humanized antibody (anti-C1 s antibody) that specifically binds complement component C1 s. The method of treating CAD comprises administering the anti-C1 s antibody to a subject at a fixed dose. The method of treating CIDP comprises administering to a subject a weight-based loading dose of the anti-C1 s antibody followed by one or more fixed maintenance doses. These methods comprise administering an effective dose of an anti-C1 s antibody to achieve a minimum level of CP inhibition for therapeutic effect.

title_en: Application of compound of general formula
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, provides a novel application of a compound with a general formula, and particularly provides an application of the compound with the general formula in preventing or/and treating pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury. The compounds of the general formula are effective in the prevention and treatment of Bleomycin (BLM) -induced Pulmonary Fibrosis (PF) in mice. The compound has the same effect as the lung fibrosis drug, namely the nilamide, in preventing the lung fibrosis, and has smaller dosage and better in vivo safety compared with the lung fibrosis drug, namely the pirfenidone, in treating the lung fibrosis.

title_en: Temperature-sensitive hydrogel SV@HP based on hyaluronic acid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of bio-pharmaceuticals, relates to temperature-sensitive hydrogel, and particularly relates to hyaluronic acid-based temperature-sensitive hydrogel SV@HP as well as a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the temperature-sensitive hydrogel SV@HP encapsulates CS-siRNA nanoparticles and VEGF@PLGA microspheres and is used for achieving microenvironment responsive drug delivery treatment of intrauterine adhesion. The CS-siRNA nano particles self-assembled by chlorogenic acid and TGF beta 1 siRNA through disulfide bonds are used for jointly treating uterine cavity adhesion by gene and chemotherapy, and have good effect of improving uterine cavity adhesion through cell and animal experiments. Through real-time fluorescent quantitative method, western blotting method, cell scratch experiment, laser confocal microscope observation, inverted fluorescent microscope observation, in-vivo experiment and other evaluation, the SV@HP gel has the effects of resisting inflammation, improving endomembrane fibrosis, promoting IUA rat endometrium angiogenesis and repair, inhibiting intrauterine adhesion and improving intrauterine environment.

title_en: Red thread traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, in particular to a red thread traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and a preparation method and application thereof. The red thread traditional Chinese medicine composition is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 15-20 parts of rhodiola rosea, 10-15 parts of astragalus mongholicus, 5-10 parts of epimedium, 5-10 parts of red paeony root, 5-10 parts of radix scrophulariae, 5-10 parts of wild buckwheat rhizome, 5-10 parts of radix scutellariae, 10-15 parts of liquorice, 20-25 parts of fructus momordicae and 30-40 parts of red thread. According to the invention, the rhizoma dioscoreae characteristic medicinal material red silk thread is adopted as one of the raw materials, and a synergistic effect is generated with the fructus momordicae, so that the treatment effect of the whole traditional Chinese medicine composition on mice with slow lung resistance is improved, specifically, the degree of lung obstruction can be effectively reduced, the lung expansion capacity is improved, and the tissue elasticity of the lung is improved.

title_en: Angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitory peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitory peptide and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitory peptide is PVKP. Compared with the original inhibitory peptide LYPVK, the inhibitory peptide PVKP provided by the invention has obviously improved inhibitory activity on ACE, the IC  50  value is reduced from 10.6 mug/mL to 9.6 mug/mL, and the stability of digestive enzymes of the inhibitory peptide PVKP and the original inhibitory peptide LYPVK under the same concentration is improved. Molecular simulation docking verifies that the interaction force between the ACE inhibitory peptide PVKP and ACE is enhanced compared with that of the original inhibitory peptide LYPVK, and the interaction force between alkyl groups and the interaction with Zn  2+  of an ACE active center are increased. Further, cell experiments prove that the ACE inhibitory peptide PVKP has intracellular antihypertensive activity, and compared with the original inhibitory peptide LYPVK, the intracellular NO release content is increased, and the ET-1 content is reduced. The ACE inhibitory peptide PVKP disclosed by the invention has small molecular weight and good water solubility, and is beneficial to the application of the ACE inhibitory peptide in developing products with the efficacy of reducing blood pressure.

title_en: Liposome with carrot glycoside or analogue thereof as membrane material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a liposome taking a carrot glycoside or an analogue thereof as a membrane material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The daucosterol liposome prepared by the invention has small particle size, good cell entering capability, good blood long circulation effect and drug delivery capability, meanwhile, the daucosterol liposome loaded with different drugs has good stability and dispersibility and high drug encapsulation rate, is favorable for effective delivery and release of the drugs, can safely and efficiently treat diseases such as tumors, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Myeloid progenitor cell-derived anti-tumor N1 phenotype neutrophil, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an anti-tumor N1 phenotype neutrophil from a myeloid progenitor cell, which comprises the steps of (1) infecting the myeloid progenitor cell by adopting ER-Hoxb8 retrovirus, obtaining the ER-Hoxb8 progenitor cell with continuous proliferation capability under the culture condition of 4-OHT by flow separation, (2) inducing the ER-Hoxb8 progenitor cell to differentiate into the neutrophil by using G-CSF, and carrying out flow separation and purification on the obtained neutrophil, and (3) stimulating the neutrophil by using IL-12 to obtain the neutrophil with the anti-tumor N1 phenotype. Also discloses the obtained anti-tumor N1 phenotype neutrophil granulocyte and the application thereof. The engineered neutrophil granulocyte (IL-12-Neutrophils) prepared by the invention has an N1 phenotype, has obvious killing effect on PANC02 cells, and can be used for treating pancreatic cancer.

title_en: Shampoo with antibacterial, anti-dandruff and antipruritic effects and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology. More particularly, relates to shampoo with antibacterial, anti-dandruff and antipruritic effects and a preparation method thereof. The shampoo comprises, by mass, 5-25% of a surfactant, 0.1-0.3% of guar gum hydroxypropyl trimethoxy ammonium chloride, 100.3-0.5% of polyquaternium-sodium chloride, 0.1-0.3% of PPG-3 octyl ether, 1-3% of semen katsumadai extract, 0.1-1.0% of piroctone olamine, 2-4% of a humectant, 0.1-0.5% of a chelating agent, 0.01-0.05% of a pH regulator, 0.1-0.5% of essence and the balance of water. The human body use evaluation test results show that compared with the anti-dandruff shampoo in the market, the anti-dandruff shampoo has more remarkable effects on scalp redness and swelling, dandruff, itching and the like, and the phenomena of dandruff and itching are remarkably improved after the tested patient uses the shampoo for 28 days.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating primary ciliated dyskinesia
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for treating Primary Ciliated Dyskinesia (PCD) using a splice regulator, such as an antisense oligonucleotide, which is capable of inducing skipping of exon 3 of a coiled-coil domain-containing protein 40 (CCDC 40) pre-mRNA. Also provided are compositions comprising splice modulators and uses thereof.

title_en: Modified T cells for the treatment of head and neck cancer
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods of treating head and neck cancer, and populations of modified immune response cells expressing heterologous TCRs for use in such methods.

title_en: Methods and compositions for activating, modulating and regulating weight loss and therapeutic uses thereof
abstract_en: Methods and systems, as well as compounds and compositions, are provided for modulating or regulating weight and/or inducing weight loss and other diseases and disorders in a subject. Various methods of administration for modulating or regulating or inducing weight loss and other diseases and conditions are provided. In addition, methods of weight loss and methods for treating obesity are provided, such as by modulating one or more enzymes in the iron death pathway.

title_en: Guide RNA molecule, vector and application thereof in medicines for preventing and treating ATTR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a guide RNA molecule, a vector and application thereof in medicines for preventing and treating ATTR, and relates to the technical field of gene therapy. According to the invention, the guide RNA is arranged aiming at the coding sequence of the TTR gene, the guide RNA for gene editing is screened, the sequence similar to the guide sequence has higher TTR gene editing efficiency, the expression level of TTR in the liver of an experimental mouse can be effectively reduced by constructing a gene editing vector, the TTR level in blood circulation can be effectively improved, and the deposition of TTR between important organs and tissues can be effectively improved. Therefore, the guide RNA provided by the invention has good application prospect in preventing and/or treating ATTR.

title_en: Composition containing plant extract, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition containing plant extracts, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a composition containing plant extracts, which comprises (77.5-90)% of water, (1-20)% of willow herb extract and (1-9)% of 1, 2-hexanediol, wherein the percentages are mass percentages of each component in the total mass of the composition. The composition has simple preparation method, high stability and good effect of regulating skin microecology.

title_en: Preparation method and application of corn silk polysaccharide compound with synergistic effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a corn silk polysaccharide compound with a synergistic effect, wherein raw materials are pretreated, then corn silk crude polysaccharide, ganoderma lucidum crude polysaccharide and hericium erinaceus crude polysaccharide are extracted by adopting a hot water extraction method, and the corn silk crude polysaccharide, ganoderma lucidum crude polysaccharide and hericium erinaceus crude polysaccharide are respectively crushed and then are subjected to 200-mesh screening for compounding, so that the corn silk polysaccharide compound with two components or the corn silk polysaccharide compound with three components is obtained. The corn silk polysaccharide compound prepared by the method has the functions of synergistic antioxidation and reducing the dosage of single polysaccharide under the same antioxidation effect. The compound synergism can improve the productivity of polysaccharide products with the same antioxidant effect.

title_en: Oral formulations of diaminophenothiazines and methods of making and using same in the treatment and/or prevention of disease
abstract_en: An oral formulation comprising a diaminophenothiazine compound and a mucoadhesive gastric retention platform, and its veterinary use in the treatment and/or prevention of diseases (e.g. avian wasting diseases) is disclosed. A method of treating and/or preventing a disease (e.g., avian wasting disease) by administering to an animal suffering from the disease (e.g., avian wasting disease) an effective amount of a diaminophenothiazine compound in an oral formulation having a mucoadhesive gastric retention platform. Treated birds can recover from previously untreated diseases.

title_en: Application of coptisine hydrochloride in preparation of HMGB3 inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a new application of coptisine hydrochloride and a pharmaceutical composition. The coptisine hydrochloride has a structure shown in the specification, and can obviously inhibit the expression of HMGB3 in the triple negative breast cancer cells, obviously inhibit the proliferation, clonogenic capacity, invasion and migration capacity of the triple negative breast cancer cells and promote the apoptosis of the triple negative breast cancer cells. Therefore, the coptisine hydrochloride can be used for preparing the medicine for preventing and/or treating triple negative breast cancer. And secondly, the coptisine hydrochloride can also enhance the drug sensitivity of cisplatin, and the combination of the coptisine hydrochloride and the cisplatin has strong synergistic effect in the aspect of treating triple negative breast cancer, thereby providing more treatment options for clinically treating triple negative breast cancer.

title_en: Application of carboplatin in preparation of medicines for preventing and/or treating negative strand RNA virus infection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and in particular relates to application of carboplatin in preparing a medicament for preventing and/or treating negative strand RNA virus infection. Experimental results show that the carboplatin has no obvious influence on the cell survival rate, the virus titer in the Vero cells treated by the carboplatin is obviously reduced, the replication of PPRV in the Vero cells can be obviously inhibited, the inhibition effect is most obvious when the carboplatin concentration is 100 mu M, the N protein level in the Vero cells treated by the carboplatin (100 mu M) is obviously reduced, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Application of angelica sinensis extract in preparation of medicines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, in particular to application of angelica sinensis extract in preparation of medicines, wherein the medicines are used for resisting white spot syndrome viruses, can be used for preventing and/or treating white spot syndrome of aquatic animals, particularly have excellent antiviral efficacy on crustaceans in the aquatic animals, can reduce the losses of the aquatic animals caused by the viruses, and provide powerful guarantee for development of the aquaculture industry.

title_en: Composite emulsion for improving insomnia and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional preparations, and discloses a composite emulsion for improving insomnia and a preparation method thereof. The composite emulsion comprises, by volume, 70-95% of modified fucoidin solution with the concentration of 0.5-3 mg/mL, and the balance of medium chain triglyceride containing melatonin, wherein the content of melatonin in the composite emulsion is 0.02wt%. The compound emulsion has strong stability and high bioavailability, can effectively resist the acidic environment in the stomach, and protects melatonin from being delivered to intestinal tracts. Proved by verification, the average core sleep time of the subject after taking the compound emulsion is 21.05% longer than that of the subject after taking the melatonin only, and the average wakefulness time is 40% shorter than that of the subject after taking the melatonin only, so that the effect is obvious.

title_en: Application of catalpol glycoside in preparing medicine for treating and relieving mitochondrial dysfunction related diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides application of catalpol in preparing medicines for treating and relieving mitochondrial dysfunction related diseases, belongs to the technical field of medicine preparation, and can improve mitochondrial membrane potential, reduce active oxygen level in chondrocytes, improve ATP content in chondrocytes and up-regulate expression level of fusion and division related proteins in chondrocytes by catalpol so as to improve mitochondrial dysfunction and promote cartilage repair, and can be applied to preparing medicines for treating and relieving arthritis and effectively relieve or delay disease course progress of arthritis.

title_en: Preparation and application of phenylethanoid glycosides compounds with anti-inflammatory activity in philippine flemingia root
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and provides two phenylethanoid glycosides compounds with anti-inflammatory activity in a jack and a preparation method and application thereof. In particular to two novel phenylethanoid glycosides compounds extracted and separated from the flemingia philippinensis, namely a compound 1 (xylanchoside A) and a compound 2 (xylanchoside B) shown in structural formulas, wherein the compound 1-2 has an inhibition effect on cytokines IL-6 and TNF-alpha secreted by macrophage RAW264.7 induced by LPS, and can form a pharmaceutical composition with a medicinal carrier for preparing anti-inflammatory medicaments.

title_en: Antibacterial silk fibroin hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial silk fibroin hydrogel, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biomedical materials. The components of the antibacterial silk fibroin hydrogel provided by the invention comprise modified silk fibroin and copper montmorillonite, wherein the modified silk fibroin is at least one of glycidyl methacrylate modified silk fibroin, methacrylic anhydride modified silk fibroin, ethyl methacrylate modified silk fibroin and norbornene dianhydride modified silk fibroin, chemical crosslinking is formed between molecules of the modified silk fibroin, the copper montmorillonite and the modified silk fibroin form physical crosslinking through hydrogen bonds, and the mass ratio of the modified silk fibroin to the copper montmorillonite is 100 (1-10). The antibacterial silk fibroin hydrogel provided by the invention has good biological safety, long-acting antibacterial property, electrical conductivity and good mechanical property.

title_en: Benzazepine derivatives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to benzazepine derivatives. The invention provides, inter alia, benzoazepine compounds of formula (1) or salts thereof having vasopressin V  1a  and V  2  antagonism, advantageous metabolic stability and absorption properties, and their medical use. In this formula, R  1  is an optionally substituted C  1‑6  alkyl group or the like, L is-C (=o) -NH-or the like, ring a  1  is a hydrocarbon ring or the like, ring a  2  is a hydrocarbon ring or the like, and each of rings a  1  and a  2  may have at least one substituent.

title_en: Bilobalide composition and application thereof in preparation of medicine for preventing and/or treating hemolytic jaundice
abstract_en: The invention provides a ginkgolide composition and application thereof in preparing a medicament for preventing and/or treating hemolytic jaundice. The ginkgolide composition mainly comprises ginkgolide A, ginkgolide B, ginkgolide C, ginkgolide J and bilobalide. Experiments show that the bilobalide composition provided by the invention can obviously reduce the serum TBIL, DBIL, IBIL, TBA level of a hemolytic jaundice model mouse, improve the hemolytic jaundice symptom and provide a new drug selection for preventing and treating the hemolytic jaundice.

title_en: Application of human iPSC source platelet-rich suspension in beauty treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for beauty treatment, which comprises platelet concentrate prepared by human induced stem cell (Induced pluripotent stem cell, iPSC) differentiation and additives for preparing platelet suspension or gel. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a functional platelet-rich composition which can be prepared in a large amount, is stable in batches, and can be produced in a standardized manner, in terms of promoting wound healing. Platelet concentrate and blood-separated Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) in the composition of the invention are completely different in composition, are relatively stable in composition, and are helpful for tissue repair by slow release of growth factors.

title_en: Probiotic strains for the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome and FODMAP intolerance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a preparation comprising a single probiotic strain, Lactobacillus plantarum (Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactiplantibacillus plantarum) DSM 33363, and a combination with Lactobacillus plantarum DSM 33364, Lactobacillus paracasei (Lactobacillus paracasei, Lacticaseibacillus paracasei) DSM 33373, Lactobacillus reuteri (Lactobacillus reuteri, Limosilactobacillus reuteri) DSM 33374, Bacillus megaterium (Bacillus megaterium, Priestia megaterium) DSM 33300, Bacillus pumilus (Bacillus pumilus) DSM 33297, and Bacillus subtilis DSM 33355 as live cells or cytoplasmic extracts thereof, as well as their use for the prevention and treatment of IBS and FODMAP intolerance.

title_en: Anti-CD 22 single domain antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of immunology, and relates to an anti-CD 22 single domain antibody and application thereof. The single domain antibody is composed of a heavy chain, wherein the heavy chain comprises a heavy chain CDR1 shown in any one of SEQ ID NO:30-SEQ ID NO:34, a heavy chain CDR2 shown in any one of SEQ ID NO:35-SEQ ID NO:39 and a heavy chain CDR3 shown in any one of SEQ ID NO:40-SEQ ID NO: 43. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that the biological genetic engineering technology is used for screening out the single-domain antibody specific to CD22, and the antibody has better affinity.

title_en: RNA, pharmaceutical composition, conjugate and application
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of diabetic retinopathy, in particular to RNA, a pharmaceutical composition, a conjugate and application. The nucleotide sequence of the RNA is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The RNA can inhibit proliferation, tube formation and migration capacity of retinal vascular endothelial cells, thereby playing a role in inhibiting diabetic retinal angiogenesis. The RNA can also inhibit inflammatory reaction caused by diabetic retinopathy, and has effect in treating diabetic retinopathy.

title_en: Sustained release microsphere containing leuprorelin, injection preparation containing same and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sustained-release microsphere containing high-content leuprorelin, an injection preparation containing the sustained-release microsphere and a preparation method of the sustained-release microsphere. During administration, leuprolide is released at an early stage at a sufficient level to exhibit its effect, thereby allowing exposure to a sufficient amount of the drug while minimizing inflammatory reactions and the like which may be problematic upon administration, whereby the effect of leuprolide can be safely exhibited for at least 1 month.

title_en: Application of spearmint extract in retinal neurotrophic effect
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of orally administering a water-soluble spearmint extract to a subject in a therapeutically effective amount to alleviate retinal cell damage and other nerve cell damage outside the central nervous system associated with reduced supply of neurotrophins (i.e., nerve Growth Factor (NGF)) induced by glaucoma and other forms of neurodegeneration.

title_en: Protection effect of lithocarpus polystachyus for diabetic cardiomyopathy
abstract_en: The invention provides a protection effect of lithocarpus polystachyus for treating cardiomyopathy of diabetics, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicinal materials. The lithocarpus polysachyum extract has the effect of protecting the heart muscle diseases of diabetics, the health care product containing the lithocarpus polysachyum or the lithocarpus polysachyum extract is used for relieving the heart muscle diseases of the diabetics, and the traditional Chinese medicine material containing the lithocarpus polysachyum or the lithocarpus polysachyum extract is used for relieving the heart muscle diseases of the diabetics.

title_en: Four uric acid reducing peptides derived from striped bamboo shark
abstract_en: The invention relates to rapid screening of uric acid reducing peptides in marine-source striped bamboo sharks, belongs to the technical field of marine biological medicines, and particularly relates to four uric acid reducing peptides derived from striped bamboo sharks. Four Xanthine Oxidase (XO) inhibitory peptides have the amino acid sequences NCDEK, PGEAG, GDSGL and GDDGL, respectively. The XO inhibitory peptide is applied to the preparation of XO inhibitors and the preparation of medicines with uric acid level inhibition effect. According to the invention, top8 potential uric acid reducing peptides are rapidly screened from the striped zebra shark proteins by utilizing enzymolysis and molecular docking technologies, and the XO inhibition activity is measured by a high performance liquid chromatography, so that four small molecule peptides are found to have remarkable inhibition activity on XO, and the four small molecule peptides have the potential of becoming XO inhibitors/uric acid reducing drugs.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus metaplasium with constipation relieving effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactobacillus rhamnosus metazoan with constipation relieving effect and application thereof, and belongs to the field of microorganisms. The post-metagen of the lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1039 provided by the invention can obviously reduce the inflammation level in colon tissues, improve pathological damage of colon tissues, reduce the expression of pro-inflammatory factors, improve the expression of anti-inflammatory factors, reduce the expression level of aquaporin, improve the protein content of Motilin (MTL), vasoactive Intestinal Peptide (VIP) and Substance P (SP) in serum, strengthen intestinal peristalsis, shorten the intestinal transit time, regulate and control intestinal homeostasis, and has great application prospects in preparing medicines for relieving constipation.

title_en: Aqueous compositions containing epinastine for improving tissue mobility and preservative efficacy
abstract_en: The present invention provides an aqueous composition comprising epinastine or a salt thereof, boric acid and/or a salt thereof, and an isotonic agent at a concentration of 0.1% (w/v), wherein the pH is 6.0 to 7.7, and the concentration of boric acid and/or a salt thereof is 150 to 500mM in terms of boron concentration, and the aqueous composition improves migration into ocular tissues and preservative efficacy.

title_en: Polyoxyethylene 35 castor oil and HS15 solubilized multivitamin injection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and discloses a polyoxyethylene 35 castor oil and HS 15 solubilizing multivitamin injection and a preparation method thereof, wherein the multivitamin injection comprises multivitamin, a solubilizing agent, a buffering agent and a pH value regulator, wherein the multivitamin comprises water-soluble vitamins and fat-soluble vitamins, the solubilizing agent is polyoxyethylene 35 castor oil and HS 15, the concentration range of the polyoxyethylene 35 castor oil is 0.025% -5% (g/ml), and the concentration range of the HS 15 is 0.025% -5% (g/ml). Can effectively solve the problems of insufficient hemolysis and stability, complex production process and the like of the traditional solubilizer, and can realize single-bottle packaging.

title_en: Probiotic and prebiotic composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of foods or medicines, and particularly relates to a composition of probiotics and prebiotics, a preparation process and application thereof. The composition comprises probiotics, resistant dextrin, xylo-oligosaccharide, fructo-oligosaccharide, stachyose, erythritol and cranberry powder, and is prepared through a fluidized bed spray granulation process. The composition is used as an auxiliary preparation of antibiotics, and animal and test experiments prove that the composition can synergistically treat upper/lower respiratory tract infection and urinary tract infection, shorten the duration of symptoms, accelerate primary disease recovery, simultaneously maintain intestinal flora diversity, promote the abundance of beneficial bacteria such as bifidobacteria, reduce the incidence rate of adverse reactions and relieve antibiotic-associated diarrhea. The invention provides a microecological restoration scheme for antibiotic treatment, and has definite clinical value and process feasibility.

title_en: Kidney-targeting probe, medicine, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, in particular to a probe for targeting kidney, a medicine, a preparation method and application thereof. The protein provided by the invention is used for preparing products targeting the kidney, the protein can be reabsorbed by the healthy kidney, has high tubular targeting property, can be accurately positioned on tubular epithelial cells, can be used as a delivery carrier, and can be prepared into probes or medicines by loading dyes, so that the accuracy and the effectiveness of detection and treatment are ensured. If the fluorescent dye is loaded, the detection of the injury of the renal tubule is successfully realized, and the process is quick and visual, so that the efficiency and accuracy of diagnosis of the kidney disease are greatly improved. By loading the drug, the therapeutic drug is directly delivered to the tubular epithelial cells, achieving effective treatment of kidney disease.

title_en: Polypeptide DR57 and application thereof in preparation of medicines for treating sepsis immune disorder related diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypeptide DR57 and application thereof in preparing a medicament for treating sepsis immune disorder related diseases, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The amino acid sequence of the polypeptide DR57 is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the polypeptide DR57 can be specifically combined with GSDMD-NT protein to inhibit perforation on cell membranes and mitochondrial inner membranes, so that occurrence and development of pyrosis are inhibited, release of inflammatory factors is reduced, and the effect of treating diseases related to inflammatory disorder is further exerted, and the polypeptide DR57 is a drug for potential treatment of sepsis.

title_en: Pediococcus acidilactici MY1 for puppies and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microorganisms, in particular to a pediococcus acidilactici MY1 from a puppy source and application thereof. The Pediococcus acidilactici provided by the invention is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) in the year 2024, month 06 and day 19, and the preservation number is CGMCC NO.31009. The pediococcus acidilactici provided by the invention has strong acid resistance, bile salt resistance and intestinal adhesion resistance, has good inhibition effect on common pathogenic bacteria, is sensitive to various antibiotic manifestations, has good probiotic potential, provides a new candidate strain for pet foods, health care and treatment products or probiotic preparations, and has wide application prospects in the aspects of preparing pet foods, health care products, medicines and the like.

title_en: Nourishing and health-preserving lucid ganoderma, sea cucumber and rehmannia root compound paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nourishing and health-preserving lucid ganoderma, sea cucumber and rehmannia composite paste and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine composite preparations. The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine compound preparations, has the remarkable advantages of scientific and reasonable formula composition, high content of active ingredients, good product stability, long quality guarantee period and the like, and provides a better choice for nourishing, health care and health care.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and application thereof and medicament for preventing or treating pulpitis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biomedical research, in particular to a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and a medicament for preventing or treating pulpitis, which can effectively kill bacteria, obviously improve inflammatory environment and enhance cellular immunity, obviously reduce inflammatory cell infiltration of pulpal tissue and restore pulpal tissue through combined use of thymic peptide alpha 1, nisin and ciprofloxacin, thereby playing a good treatment effect on pulpitis.

title_en: Cell cycle dependent kinase degradation agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cell cycle kinase inhibitor and preparation and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a compound shown as a formula I, wherein the definition of each group is as described in the specification. The compounds have excellent cell cycle kinase (CDK) inhibitory activity and thus are useful in the preparation of pharmaceutical compositions for the treatment of hematological or solid tumor cancers.

title_en: A Chinese medicinal composition with kidney tonifying, yang supporting, and sexual function improving effects, and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of soft extract, and discloses a preparation method of soft extract capable of tonifying kidney, strengthening yang and improving sexual function, which comprises the following steps of selecting and weighing raw materials according to a formula, wherein during the selection, the raw materials which do not meet the preparation requirement are selected; washing with flowing water for several times, removing surface sediment and pesticide residue, soaking in purified water, sealing and extracting for 2 times, filtering with 200 mesh silk cloth, concentrating, decocting at 150-170deg.C, and stirring to obtain paste. The soft extract prepared by the invention can effectively condition qi and blood, tonify kidney and replenish essence, tranquilize mind and promote intelligence, is an ideal choice for whole body nursing and long-term nourishing, helps men to realize comprehensive and deep nourishing experience by improving the whole health state of men, and helps men to promote new health.

title_en: Drug-loaded contrast agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug-loaded contrast agent, and a preparation method and application thereof. The drug-loaded contrast agent comprises a cavity microsphere, wherein at least one cavity is arranged in the cavity microsphere, the shell of the cavity microsphere comprises biodegradable polymers and lipids, drug active ingredients and ultrasound response gas, the drug active ingredients are arranged in the cavity, and at least part of the drug active ingredients are dispersed and distributed in the ultrasound response gas. The active ingredients of the medicine are dispersed and distributed in the ultrasonic response gas, and in the ultrasonic medicine release process, the medicine can be released in a short time, so that the local medicine concentration is improved, and the treatment purpose is achieved.

title_en: Nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound, a preparation method and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of heterocyclic compound synthesis, and solves the problems of low reaction efficiency and high energy consumption caused by the fact that the existing method for synthesizing indole maleimide derivatives needs to be carried out step by step. The preparation method comprises the following steps of adding indoleacetamide and a nucleophilic reagent into a mixed solution for reaction, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain a nitrogenous heterocyclic compound, wherein the mixed solution comprises a base, an additive and an organic solvent, and the base comprises one of triethylamine (Et  3  N), N-diisopropylethylamine, pyridine and 1, 8-diazabicyclo [5.4.0] undec-7-ene.

title_en: Mesenchymal stem cell exosome and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a mesenchymal stem cell exosome and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein miR-29b-3p with a therapeutic effect is wrapped in the exosome, so that the stability of miR-29b-3p can be enhanced, the expression of miR-29b-3p can be effectively regulated, myocardial cell damage is reduced, myocardial ischemia reperfusion injury is improved, the exosome can be used as a carrier to convey miR-29b-3p with a therapeutic effect to myocardial ischemia cells, the targeting delivery efficiency of miR-29b-3p is improved, systemic side effects are avoided, the therapeutic effect of the exosome and the therapeutic effect of miR-29b-3p can be combined, the effectiveness of treating myocardial ischemia reperfusion injury is improved, and in addition, the external surface of the exosome is modified with ischemia myocardial targeting peptide IMTP, so that the targeting and the effectiveness of treatment can be improved.

title_en: Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract anti-hair loss shampoo and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hair loss preventing shampoo containing a Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract, which comprises the Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract and pharmaceutically acceptable auxiliary materials, and does not contain silicone oil, wherein the Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract is a Hainan mountain tea seed extract, and has a definite proportion requirement on the weight ratio range of the Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract to cocoyl sodium methyl taurate, alkyl amine oxide and acyl propyl betaine auxiliary materials. In addition, the weight percentage range of the shampoo is also specified in detail so as to ensure the effectiveness and the safety of the product. The preparation method involves dissolving, mixing and stirring, and the auxiliary materials include, but are not limited to, coconut fatty acid monoethanolamide, locust bean gum, polyquaternium 10, salicylic acid, nicotinamide and sodium hyaluronate. The preparation process comprises ultrasonic dissolution or a pressure dissolution technical means of a homogenizing mixer so as to ensure uniform mixing and dissolution of the components. The shampoo provided by the invention provides a natural and effective hair loss prevention shampoo product through the unique effect of the Hainan mountain pomelo seed extract while ensuring the use safety.

title_en: Preparation method of effective part of herba Hedyotidis Diffusae and its application in preventing and treating myocardial injury
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an effective part of herba hedyotis, which comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out heating reflux extraction on the herba hedyotis, concentrating an extracting solution to obtain a herba hedyotis concentrated solution, and (2) carrying out adsorption elution on the herba hedyotis concentrated solution through macroporous resin and/or polyamide resin to obtain a first effective part of herba hedyotis and/or a second effective part of herba hedyotis.
