The first effective part and/or the second effective part of the herba hedyotis can recover human cardiac muscle cell injury caused by verapamil, wherein the first effective part of the herba hedyotis has the strongest activity in the aspects of promoting the whole activity of human cardiac muscle cells, inhibiting the death of human cardiac muscle cells and promoting the proliferation of human cardiac muscle cells.

title_en: Heat-clearing and goiter-eliminating ointment for treating subacute thyroiditis and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Chinese patent medicines for treating subacute thyroiditis, and discloses a heat-clearing and gall-eliminating paste for treating subacute thyroiditis, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the heat-clearing and gall-eliminating paste is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 40 parts of raw rhubarb, 40 parts of wine baical skullcap root, 30 parts of wine coptis root, 40 parts of radix ranunculi ternati, 30 parts of perfoliate knotweed herb, 20 parts of vinegar olibanum, 20 parts of raw astragalus and 9 parts of borneol. The preparation has the beneficial effects of effectively and rapidly relieving pain symptoms of SAT patients, relieving inflammatory response, relieving thyromegaly, recovering thyroid function and having better curative effect than the treatment of pure non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. The external preparation has definite curative effect and less adverse reaction, can achieve the effect of treating both principal and secondary aspect of disease, is convenient to use and is favorable for development and application.

title_en: Burdock fermentation liquor with relieving and anti-inflammatory effects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant fermentation, and relates to a burdock fermentation liquid with a relieving and anti-inflammatory effect, and a preparation method and application thereof. The fructus Arctii fermentation broth is prepared by fermenting fructus Arctii with Schizosaccharomyces pombe (Schizosaccharomyces pombe) JM 2-16. According to the invention, after the burdock is used as a raw material and is fermented by schizosaccharomyces pombe (Schizosaccharomyces pombe), the hyaluronidase inhibition capability, the elastase inhibition capability and the DPPH free radical scavenging capability of a fermentation product can be improved, so that the fermentation product with better relieving, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant capabilities can be obtained, and the requirements of the market on efficient, natural and safe skin care components can be met.

title_en: Plant source composite small molecule peptide composition and extraction application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine, in particular to a plant source composite small molecule peptide composition and a preparation method and application thereof. The composition is prepared from soybean, pea and oat by mixing and fermenting lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus subtilis, and purifying by combining ultrafiltration concentration, macroporous adsorption resin, ion exchange chromatography, gel filtration chromatography and the like. The composition contains a plurality of small molecule peptides (SEQ ID NO: 1-5) with specific amino acid sequences, and has a plurality of biological activities such as high-efficiency immunoregulation, remarkable regulation of blood sugar and blood fat, excellent skin repair and aging resistance, good liver protection, memory improvement and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of viscoelastic supplement
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a viscoelastic supplement, which comprises the steps of a) dissolving a cross-linking agent to obtain a cross-linking agent reaction solution, wherein the cross-linking agent reaction solution comprises a buffer system, the pH value of the buffer system is 5-9, the cross-linking agent contains 2 or amino groups, b) adding carboxymethyl chitin into the cross-linking agent reaction solution and mixing, the molar ratio of carboxyl groups of the carboxymethyl chitin to amino groups of the cross-linking agent is 3:2-1:2, c) adding a condensing agent to enable the carboxymethyl chitin to perform amidation reaction with the cross-linking agent, the molar ratio of carboxyl groups in the carboxymethyl chitin to the condensing agent is 4:1-1:2, the condensing agent is selected from EDC, DMTMM, EDCI, CDMT or a combination thereof, d) diluting gel to 0.5-5% (w/w), diluting with a buffering agent selected from phosphate, borate, citrate or any combination thereof, and e) obtaining the viscoelastic supplement through dialysis with the buffering agent, wherein the method does not comprise using ethanol, acetone or methanol.

title_en: Imatinib derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of drug synthesis, and provides an imatinib derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, the imatinib derivative provided by the invention has a novel structure, can reduce the interstitial fluid pressure of tumors, enhance the permeability of medicines and improve the curative effect of the medicines. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing 4-mercaptobenzoic acid, N-dimethylformamide, N-hydroxysuccinimide and N, N' -dicyclohexylcarbodiimide solution to obtain an activated system, and mixing the activated system with imazamine to react to obtain the imatinib derivative. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and easily controlled synthetic reaction process and low price.

title_en: Application of beta-amino isobutyric acid in preparation of preparation for treating animal mastitis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, in particular to application of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in preparation of a preparation for treating animal mastitis. The application of beta-amino isobutyric acid in preparing preparations for treating animal mastitis. The beta-amino isobutyric acid provided by the invention is derived from the hindgut content of healthy Sacan dairy goats with the lowest somatic cell number in milk obtained by large-population screening. The method can remarkably promote proliferation efficiency of cow mammary epithelial cells, and can enhance folding efficiency of proteins in an inflammation process by promoting expression of related proteins in an endoplasmic reticulum protein quality control channel in a cow mammary epithelial cell inflammation model induced by LPS, accelerate misfolding and unfolded protein removal, finally reduce concentration of pro-inflammatory cytokines, increase concentration of anti-inflammatory cytokines and relieve inflammation phenotype.

title_en: Method for fermenting astragalus membranaceus by lactobacillus plantarum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of microbial fermentation, and particularly discloses a method for fermenting astragalus membranaceus by lactobacillus plantarum. The method comprises the following steps of S1 crushing and sterilizing astragalus, S2 inoculating lactobacillus plantarum LP-301 and S3 for fermentation culture. After lactobacillus plantarum LP-301 ferments the astragalus, the content of flavonoid, quinone, terpenoid and other substances in the fermentation product is obviously improved, so that the lactobacillus plantarum LP-301 can be used for preparing antioxidant products or anti-inflammatory products, and has great application value.

title_en: Application of ginsenoside Rc in preparing product for resisting skin high Wen Jiguang injury
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of ginsenoside Rc in preparing a product for resisting skin high Wen Jiguang injury. The anti-high Wen Jiguang damage to the skin is manifested in resistance to high temperature induced inflammation and resistance to high temperature and ultraviolet light product FICZ induced inflammation. Research results show that ginsenoside Rc can obviously reduce the induction effect of FICZ on IL-6 and IL-8 in a high-temperature environment, and provides a potential protection mechanism for resisting inflammatory reaction aggravated by the high-temperature condition. The discovery not only provides a theoretical basis for the application of ginsenoside Rc in defending skin inflammation induced by environmental factors, but also reveals an anti-inflammatory potential mechanism of the ginsenoside Rc at a cellular level, and provides a scientific basis for the subsequent application and development in the field of skin care products.

title_en: Antigen capturing nanoparticles and formulations for immunotherapy
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel Antigen Capturing Nanoparticles (ACNP) and pharmaceutical formulations containing such ACNP. Also provided herein are methods for preparing ACNP formulations, as well as methods for treating a disease (such as cancer) in a subject with ACPN or a pharmaceutical formulation containing ACPN.

title_en: Nitrogen-containing chain compound, preparation method, composition containing nitrogen-containing chain compound and application of nitrogen-containing chain compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-containing chain compound, a preparation method, a composition containing the nitrogen-containing chain compound and application of the nitrogen-containing chain compound. The invention particularly discloses a compound shown in a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, which has the advantages that the prepared LNP preparation has relatively uniform nanoparticle size, higher encapsulation efficiency and high in-vivo expression activity.

title_en: Anionic surfactant-chitosan oligosaccharide composite assembly and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anionic surfactant-chitosan oligosaccharide composite assembly and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of mouthwashes. The composite assembly provided by the invention is formed by co-assembling chitosan oligosaccharide and an anionic surfactant through electrostatic interaction. The chitosan oligosaccharide has positive charges capable of destroying bacterial cell membranes, and the hydrophobic chain of the anionic surfactant can permeate the lipid membrane of bacteria, so that the chitosan oligosaccharide and the anionic surfactant cooperate to obviously promote broad-spectrum antibacterial activity on gram-positive/negative bacteria, and the chitosan oligosaccharide and the anionic surfactant show inflammation-induced pH response antibacterial effects, namely, the antibacterial strength is reduced in healthy oral cavity, so that the side effects of the medicine are reduced, and the antibacterial capability is obviously improved under the environment of sub-healthy oral cavity with acid so as to effectively sterilize.

title_en: Dendritic cell bionic nano tumor vaccine for targeted treatment of brain glioma and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dendritic cell bionic nano tumor vaccine for targeted treatment of brain glioma, and a preparation method and application thereof. The bionic nano tumor vaccine provided by the invention consists of Dendritic Cell (DC) membrane protein at the outer layer, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) and TLR7/8 agonist R848 encapsulated as the inner core. The invention can obviously improve the delivery efficiency in the brain of R848, strengthen the anti-tumor activity of T cells at the tumor part, inhibit the progress of glioma and reduce systemic toxicity, and provides a safe and efficient new strategy for the accurate immunotherapy of glioma.

title_en: Anti-PD-1 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to anti-PD-1 antibodies and uses thereof, and in particular discloses methods of treating cancer with antibodies and antibody fragments that bind to PD-1.

title_en: Naphthalene copper phthalocyanine liposome and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper naphthalocyanine liposome and a construction method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of liposome preparations. According to the copper naphthalocyanine liposome, the problems of poor water solubility, insufficient stability and the like of the traditional sound sensitive agent can be solved by wrapping the copper naphthalocyanine and the catalase in the liposome, meanwhile, the copper naphthalocyanine liposome has the effect of catalyzing excessive H  2 O 2  in the micro environment of the glioma to generate O  2  for supplying sound power therapy (SDT) to continuously generate ROS, enhances the sound power performance of the brain glioma, improves the glioma treatment effect, has the advantages of good biosafety, low immunogenicity and in vivo long-circulating property, can effectively penetrate through a blood brain barrier and be delivered to a tumor part, solves the problems that the traditional glioma treatment method is difficult to penetrate through the blood brain barrier and cannot reach effective concentration and the like, and provides a new strategy for glioma treatment.

title_en: Amphiphilic block copolymer, hydrogel material containing amphiphilic block copolymer, and preparation method and application of amphiphilic block copolymer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical polymer materials, relates to an amphiphilic block copolymer, a hydrogel material containing the amphiphilic block copolymer, a preparation method and application of the hydrogel material, and particularly discloses a poly-2-ethyl-2-oxazoline-polyamino acid block copolymer, a preparation method and application of the hydrogel material. The hydrogel material provided by the invention has excellent injectability, and the modulus and the gelation temperature of the gel preparation can be adjusted by changing the molecular weight and the concentration of the amphiphilic block copolymer, so that the hydrogel material is suitable for different physiological environments and is applied to different indications, and compared with other hydrogels, the hydrogel material is more convenient to change the adjustment mode of the chemical structure of the polymer.

title_en: Sea cucumber egg oligopeptide composition for improving female AMH value and improving ovarian function and application thereof
abstract_en: A sea cucumber egg oligopeptide composition for improving female AMH value and improving ovarian function and application thereof belong to the field of medicines, and the sea cucumber egg oligopeptide composition comprises, by weight, 15-25 parts of sea cucumber egg oligopeptide, 10-15 parts of mussel oligopeptide and 10-20 parts of medicinal and edible polyphenol extract. Sea cucumber egg oligopeptide has the effects of improving hormone levels such as AMH, improving energy metabolism and oxidative stress level of oocyte and ovary granular cells, and promoting proliferation of ovary stem cells. The medicinal and edible polyphenol extract has the effects of reducing chronic inflammation of ovarian cells, improving blood supply of ovarian tissues, increasing uterine organ coefficients and relieving ovarian immune injury, and compared with the traditional Chinese medicine formula directly taken, the medicinal and edible polyphenol extract has obviously improved absorption rate. The components improve the ovarian function from different aspects, and the components produce better effects of improving the ovarian reserve than the intake of single or few components under the cooperation of the components, and are safe and have no toxic or side effects.

title_en: Formula composition applied to antioxidant and anti-aging food and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula composition which comprises, by weight, 100-400 parts of grape seed procyanidine, 100-300 parts of punica granatum polyphenol, 10-100 parts of ergothioneine, 50-200 parts of catechin and 100-400 parts of astragalus polysaccharide. The invention uses 'cell-level anti-aging' as core logic, scientifically compounds five active ingredients of grape seed procyanidine, pomegranate polyphenol, ergothioneine, catechin and astragalus polysaccharide, builds a multi-dimensional antioxidant defense system, and can realize multiple effects of scavenging free radicals, repairing cell injury, delaying aging process and the like.

title_en: Application of traditional Chinese medicine composition in preparation of medicine for postoperative treatment of colorectal cancer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a traditional Chinese medicine composition in preparing a medicine for colorectal cancer postoperative treatment, which is prepared from the following raw material medicines: radix astragali, rhizoma anemarrhenae, curcumae rhizoma, parched fructus Aurantii, radix Paeoniae Rubra, achyranthis radix, radix Actinidiae chinensis, rhizoma Polygoni Cuspidati, and flos Campsis. The traditional Chinese medicine composition is suitable for patients after colorectal cancer operation, is particularly suitable for patients after colon cancer operation in stage II and stage III, has certain advantages in inhibiting tumor proliferation, preventing and treating recurrence and metastasis after colorectal cancer operation and prolonging disease-free survival time, can effectively improve uncomfortable symptoms of patients after operation and during postoperative adjuvant therapy, and improves life quality.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity sponge spicule and permeation promotion application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-purity spongy spicules and application thereof in promoting penetration, and belongs to the technical field of spongy spicules. The preparation method comprises the steps of cutting natural sponge, soaking the natural sponge into deionized water, carrying out ultrasonic oscillation, filtering and cleaning to obtain pretreated sponge, carrying out enzymolysis on the pretreated sponge by alkaline protease to obtain a primary enzymolysis product, carrying out enzymolysis on the pretreated sponge by ginger protease to obtain a secondary enzymolysis product, carrying out vacuum freeze drying to obtain high-purity sponge spicules, carrying out enzymolysis on the natural sponge by alkaline protease and ginger protease to obtain high-purity sponge spicules, grafting wheat oligopeptide on the surface of the sponge spicules, loading giant salamander skin collagen, pomegranate seed extract, lonicera japonica extract, centella asiatica extract, celery extract, iris tectorum extract, oyster shell extract and calcium chloride into the sponge spicules, and carrying out mixed treatment materials, thereby improving the repairing effect on skin inflammatory acne.

title_en: Polypeptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The invention discloses a polypeptide with a brand new amino acid structure, and the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The polypeptide provided by the invention can obviously reduce the paralysis rate of transgenic CL4176 nematodes, has obvious activity of resisting Alzheimer disease, and has obvious inhibition effect on the secretion of IgE by U266 cells, and the polypeptide can further realize antiallergic effect by inhibiting the generation of IgE. The polypeptide provided by the invention is expected to be used as a novel medicine for resisting Alzheimer disease or treating anaphylaxis.

title_en: Acyclic chelating agent, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an acyclic chelating agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the acyclic chelating agent is a compound shown in a formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the compound shown in the formula I. Compared with the common macrocyclic chelating agent, the acyclic chelating agent can rapidly and efficiently label the radionuclide under mild conditions, and is used for PET, SPECT, MRI and other imaging or radionuclide therapy application researches after the radionuclide is chelated.

title_en: A composition for promoting hair growth and blackening hair, and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for growing and blackening hair and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition comprises sweetsop seed, radix sophorae flavescentis, chicken bone fragrance, chinese date pit, subprostrate sophora, winter melon seed, black nightshade fruit, oxalis, phyllanthus emblica leaf, elm, white pear leaf, coriander seed and shepherd's purse root, or comprises sophora flavescens, chicken bone fragrance, subprostrate sophora, black nightshade fruit, oxalis, phyllanthus emblica leaf, green jade fan, kangaroo claw flower and pseudo-ginseng. In some embodiments, the composition exhibits comparable or even better hair growth, hair blacking, hair follicle activating effects than a positive control.

title_en: ATR and PARP1 dual target inhibitors
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, discloses an ATR and PARP1 double-target inhibitor, and particularly relates to a compound with a structure shown in a formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, active metabolite, polymorph, ester, optical isomer or prodrug thereof, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound with the structure shown in the formula I and application of the compound as the ATR and PARP1 double-target inhibitor in antitumor drugs.

title_en: Bioactive conjugates, methods of making and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides antibody drug conjugate platforms comprising a binding factor assembly component, and antibody drug conjugates comprising a platform-derived linker-payload and an antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof. In some embodiments, the antibody drug conjugate is of formula (I) Or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, tautomer, solvate, or stereoisomer thereof, wherein the values of variables (e.g., BA, U, V, A, a ', W, w ', Y, y ', PA, x) are as described herein.

title_en: Compositions and methods for anti-PACAP IgG4 antibodies
abstract_en: Pituitary Adenylate Cyclase Activating Peptide (PACAP) is a neuropeptide associated with a wide range of functions such as nociception and primary headache. PACAP is a member of the secretin/Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide (VIP)/Growth Hormone Releasing Hormone (GHRH) family. The present disclosure relates generally to anti-PACAP antibodies, pharmaceutical compositions comprising such antibodies, and methods of making and using such antibodies.

title_en: Application of ganoderma lucidum extract combined with clostridium butyricum in preparation of lipid-lowering food or medicine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of ganoderma lucidum extract combined with clostridium butyricum in preparation of lipid-lowering food or medicine. The invention discovers that the ganoderma lucidum extract is used in combination with clostridium butyricum, can obviously slow down the weight increase of mice induced by high-fat diet, lighten the weight of epididymal fat of high-fat mice, reduce lipid accumulation in the liver and serum of the mice, reduce the size of fat cells, reduce the expression of related lipid metabolism and synthesized key gene mRNA in the liver of the mice, regulate intestinal flora of the mice, can well improve obesity, and has important application prospect in preparing medicines or foods for treating diabetes, blood fat reduction, obesity and nonalcoholic fatty liver diseases.

title_en: Methods and compositions for activating zeta-globin gene expression
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method and composition for activating zeta-globin gene expression. The method comprises artificially forming an enhancer element comprising an NTG-N (7-8) -WGATAR sequence, a NAG-N (7-8) -WGATAR sequence, a YTATCW-N (7-8) -CAN sequence, and/or a YTATCW-N (7-8) -CTN sequence on the sense strand or the antisense strand of the non-coding region of the zeta-globin gene using gene editing techniques. The invention also discloses gRNA, ssODN, a composition and cells, and application thereof in preparing a medicament for treating alpha-thalassemia. The invention does not need to carry out the over-expression of exogenous globin genes, and reduces the safety risk of gene therapy. Moreover, the zeta-globin gene expression is activated, and the alpha-globin gene expression can be suitable for various types of alpha thalassemia patients, and alpha-gene deletion or mutation patients can be used, and the alpha-thalassemia caused by a certain mutation site is not limited.

title_en: Preparation method for efficiently preparing novel carboxymethyl pachyman derivative
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of microorganisms, and particularly relates to a preparation method for efficiently preparing a novel carboxymethyl pachyman derivative. The method comprises the steps of inoculating tuckahoe bacterium CGMCC 5.78 for first-stage fermentation, inoculating spindle-shaped lysine bacillus CGMCC 1.10295, adding a selenium source, performing second-stage co-culture, performing a key high-temperature stimulation step and a subsequent pH adjustment step, and finally separating and purifying fermentation liquor to obtain the selenized carboxymethyl pachyman. The specific process obviously improves the yield and selenium element conversion rate of the selenized carboxymethyl pachyman, and the selenized carboxymethyl pachyman has good DPPH free radical scavenging capability and in-vitro antitumor activity. The process is green and efficient, and provides a new way for developing functional selenium polysaccharide.

title_en: Compound sweetener and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sweeteners, and relates to a compound sweetener, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the compound sweetener can obviously sweeten, has a taste similar to sucrose, and comprises the following raw materials: enhancing sweeteners, additives, glycyrrhizic acid, and/or mogrosides. The compound sweetener has obvious sweetness, realizes the reduction of the sweetener by the synergistic combination of the components, has less dosage under the condition of reaching the same sweetness equivalent of the sucrose, achieves the purpose of reducing the cost of the formula, has better taste, good solubility, no obvious peculiar smell, quick sweetness, full and round sweetness, short duration of sweetness and no tailing after sweetness and improves the acceptance of consumers.

title_en: Application of namilast in preparation of drug for treating intervertebral disc fibrosis by targeted inhibition of megaphaga-myofibroblast transformation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to a novel medical application of a phosphodiesterase 4B inhibitor, namely namilast, in particular to an application of namilast in preparing a medicine for treating intervertebral disc fibrosis by targeted inhibition of megaphaga-myofibroblast transformation.

title_en: Olmesartan medoxomil amlodipine hydrochlorothiazide three-compound preparation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an olmesartan medoxomil amlodipine hydrochlorothiazide three-compound composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the three-compound preparation comprises three active ingredients of olmesartan medoxomil, amlodipine besylate and hydrochlorothiazide, and further comprises auxiliary materials such as pregelatinized starch, silicified microcrystalline cellulose, crosslinked carboxymethyl cellulose, polylactic acid spray-dried powder, tocopherol and the like, and the dissolution stability of the olmesartan medoxomil hydrochlorothiazide tablet obtained after the coating operation of the three-compound composition of olmesartan medoxomil amlodipine hydrochlorothiazide is consistent with that of an original ground product, and the tablet has very smooth surface, no dent and more stable quality.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Mongolian resveratrol body gel containing total alkaloids of Mongolian veratrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a Mongolian resveratrol body gel of a total alkaloid of veratrum, and belongs to the technical field of alkaloids. The preparation method of the Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome gel comprises the steps of weighing cholesterol, mongolian veratrum total alkaloids, a flexibilizer and lecithin, hydrating and carrying out ultrasound at a specified temperature to obtain a Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome, fully swelling carbomer 940 with PBS solution to obtain gel, fully mixing the Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome with the gel, adding glycerol, and finally regulating pH with triethanolamine and uniformly stirring to obtain the Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome gel. The Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome gel prepared by the method can be used for preparing external analgesics. The Mongolian veratrum total alkaloid ethosome gel has the function of a reservoir, can make the medicine act on the skin slowly and continuously, is superior to the common gel, has good skin safety, and has remarkable analgesic and anti-inflammatory activity effects in pharmacodynamics.

title_en: Bird's nest peptide for activating alcohol dehydrogenase and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alcohol dehydrogenase activating bird's nest peptide and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functional polypeptides. The amino acid sequence of the bird's nest peptide for activating the alcohol dehydrogenase is PLLW, which can chelate the active center of the Alcohol Dehydrogenase (ADH), is favorable for preventing the ADH from being oxidized and further maintaining the normal protein molecular structure of the ADH during alcohol metabolism, and the bird's nest peptide powder containing the bird's nest peptide for activating the alcohol dehydrogenase can effectively improve the alcohol catalytic conversion rate of the ADH, has good effect of promoting alcohol metabolism, can be applied to development of anti-alcohol or various anti-alcohol products, and has higher market value.

title_en: Method for inhibiting infection of Tamu virus and application of TCP1 inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for inhibiting a Tamhd virus infection and application of a TCP1 inhibitor. Specifically, the invention discloses a method for inhibiting the infection of host cells by a Tamh virus (Tamdy virus, TAMV), which comprises the step of reducing or inhibiting the expression amount and/or activity of a TCP1 gene or a protein encoded by the TCP1 gene or the protein encoded by the TCP1 gene, by a method selected from the group consisting of gene mutation, gene knockout, gene interruption, RNA interference technology, gene editing technology, an inhibitor for introducing a gene or a protein, or a combination thereof.

title_en: Navel treatment composition and navel treatment preparation for preparing medicine for preventing and treating abdominal pain caused by children intravenous drip azithromycin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and particularly discloses an umbilical therapy composition and an umbilical therapy preparation for preventing and treating abdominal pain caused by azithromycin drop of children and a preparation method thereof. The preparation is prepared by combining evodia rutaecarpa and diarrhea-relieving according to a specific weight ratio, and adding pharmaceutical excipients such as a transdermal enhancer, an excipient and the like to prepare special navel therapy dosage forms such as pills, cakes, patches and the like. The composition utilizes the characteristics of the Shenque acupoint (navel) such as thin epidermis stratum corneum, weak barrier function, rich blood vessels and easy dispersion and absorption of the medicine, and effectively relieves adverse reactions such as gastrointestinal cramping pain, nausea and vomiting and the like caused by the intravenous drip of azithromycin in children by an administration mode of external application. Clinical verification shows that the navel therapy preparation can obviously reduce the incidence rate and severity score of abdominal pain, vomit and diarrhea and obviously improve the treatment compliance of children patients.

title_en: Enteric bacteria freeze-dried powder slow release preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slow release preparation method of intestinal fungus freeze-dried powder, which comprises the steps of obtaining pH value data of alkaline conditions of a small intestine, gradually dissolving an outer layer material through matching of a pH sensitive material database, judging the dissolution rate of the material in the alkaline environment, determining release triggering conditions of a small intestine stage, obtaining dissolution rate parameters from the release triggering conditions of the small intestine, adjusting the thickness of the outer layer material through a time sequence analysis algorithm, judging the matching degree of release rhythm and small intestine residence time, obtaining an accurate release scheme of the small intestine, obtaining enzyme activity data of specific flora of the large intestine, predicting unlocking behaviors under the specific conditions through an enzymatic reaction model, judging the degradation rate of the inner layer material under the action of the flora, determining a large intestine release triggering mechanism, obtaining degradation rate parameters from the large intestine release triggering mechanism, optimizing the inner layer material structure through a layered delivery algorithm, judging the activity retention rate of probiotics in the large intestine environment, and obtaining the complete release scheme of the large intestine.

title_en: Application of indole-3-lactic acid in preparation of uric acid reducing product
abstract_en: The invention provides application of indole-3-lactic acid in preparation of uric acid reducing products, and relates to the technical field of medicines. The indole-3-lactic acid has good effect of reducing blood uric acid, provides a novel uric acid reducing medicine component for health-care food, hyperuricemia and related diseases, has less damage to kidney function, and is a safe and efficient uric acid reducing functional component. The mechanism of treating gout by indole-3-lactic acid is realized mainly by reducing inflammatory reaction of an organism and improving uric acid excretion, has double effects, is different from the mechanism of the existing medicine, and has unique innovation.

title_en: RSV-influenza combined vaccine and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological medicine, and particularly discloses an RSV-influenza combined vaccine and application thereof. The RSV-influenza combined vaccine comprises an respiratory syncytial virus mRNA vaccine and an influenza vaccine, wherein the respiratory syncytial virus mRNA vaccine also comprises lipid nanoparticles, and the mRNA is loaded in the lipid nanoparticles. The combined RSV-influenza vaccine is used for preventing various respiratory tract virus infections (RSV virus and influenza virus), and the LNP adjuvant of the RSV mRNA vaccine can greatly increase the immune response of the influenza vaccine and enhance the protection efficiency of the influenza vaccine in immunocompromised people.

title_en: Sleep-aiding and sleep-improving transdermal patch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of patches, and relates to a sleep-aiding and sleep-aiding transdermal patch and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sleep-aiding and sleep-aiding transdermal patch comprises a medicine carrying layer, and the medicine carrying layer comprises, by mass, 2-9 parts of active medicines and 0.1-7 parts of permeation promoters, wherein the permeation promoters are compositions of menthol and essential oil, and the mass ratio of the menthol to the essential oil is 1-4:0.1-3. The sleep-aiding and sleep-improving transdermal patch with good transmittance and stability is successfully prepared by optimizing the preparation prescription and the preparation process, can realize slow release and absorption of medicines, solves the problems of insomnia and poor sleep quality, and reduces the occurrence probability of side effects while improving the treatment effect.

title_en: New use of polygonum multiflorum and aloe cathartic capsules in preparation of colorectal cancer treatment medicines
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, relates to a new application of a polygoni multiflori constipation relieving capsule, and in particular relates to a new application of a polygoni multiflori constipation relieving capsule in medicines for treating colorectal cancer. The Hui Tonggan capsule is given to colorectal cancer model mice, the difference of various indexes of each group of mice is observed, and the prevention and treatment effects of the Hui Tonggan capsule on colorectal cancer are examined. Experimental results show that the polygonum multiflorum-aloe cathartic capsule not only can obviously improve the quality of colorectal cancer mice and reduce the tumor quantity of the colorectal cancer mice, but also can reduce the tumor weight of the colorectal cancer mice, and has remarkable tumor inhibiting effect. The polygonum multiflorum and aloe cathartic capsule is used for colorectal cancer treatment, can avoid toxic and side effects of western medicines, and is higher in safety.

title_en: Anti-human IFN-alpha 5 antibody and conjugate, detection kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological detection, in particular to an anti-human IFN-alpha 5 antibody, a conjugate thereof, a detection kit and application. The application provides an anti-human IFN-alpha 5 monoclonal antibody, a kit containing the antibody or a conjugate thereof and a detection method thereof. The kit provided by the application can complete quantitative detection of human IFN-alpha 5, has higher specificity and detection sensitivity, and has good development and application prospects.

title_en: Adenosine deaminase capable of acting on DNA and application thereof
abstract_en: Belongs to the field of genetic engineering. In particular to an adenosine deaminase which can act on DNA and application thereof. More specifically, an adenosine deaminase that can act on DNA is provided, depending on a gene editing system based on the deaminase and its use. Enriches the application scene and the selection of the adenine base editor, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Recombinant and modified CRY proteins for controlling insect pests
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to recombinant and modified Cry proteins for methods and compositions for controlling coleopteran pests (particularly sugarcane weevil pests, more particularly sugarcane weevil pests of crop plants). More specifically, the present disclosure relates to recombinant and modified Cry proteins based on and derived from Cry proteins designated SCW 35. The disclosure also relates to the use of these proteins to produce insecticidal compositions. Furthermore, the present disclosure relates to methods for controlling coleopteran pests (more specifically coleopteran pests, sugarcane weevils).

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating vascular einless-dallos syndrome and related disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for treating vascular einles-slaloms syndrome and related connective tissue disorders. The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions and kits for treating vascular lesions. The methods, compositions and kits enable reduced levels of protein kinase C (PCK) activity.

title_en: Dosage regimen
abstract_en: The present invention provides antibodies or binding fragments thereof directed against citrulline-containing epitopes for use in the treatment or prevention of diseases associated with the release of extracellular traps from cells, such as neutrophil extracellular trap (NET-related disease) or eosinophil extracellular trap (EET-related disease), wherein the method comprises administering at least one dose of the antibodies at a specific concentration. The invention also provides the methods themselves. NET-related diseases include Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), lupus, sepsis, vasculitis, inflammatory arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, psoriasis, alzheimer's disease, autoimmune hepatitis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, myositis (polymyositis and dermatomyositis), sjogren's syndrome, antiphospholipid syndrome, behcet's disease, spondylitis, spondyloarthropathies, multisystemic atrophy, parkinson's disease, lewy body dementia, asthma, allergic rhinovirus-aggravated asthma, allergic asthma, acute respiratory distress syndrome, cystic fibrosis, fibrosis and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, heart failure, atherosclerosis, dry eye, uveitis, non-granulomatous uveitis, dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, COPD, bronchitis, or other NET-related diseases such as wound healing in diabetics, cancer metastasis, and transplanted organ health in vivo or in vitro. The invention also provides pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treating or preventing NET-related diseases such as SLE, lupus, sepsis, vasculitis, inflammatory arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, psoriasis, alzheimer's disease, autoimmune hepatitis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, myositis (polymyositis and dermatomyositis), sjogren's syndrome, antiphospholipid syndrome, behcet's disease, spondylitis, spondyloarthropathies, multiple system atrophy, parkinson's disease, lewy body dementia, asthma, allergic rhinovirus-aggravated asthma, allergic asthma, acute respiratory distress syndrome, cystic fibrosis, fibrosis and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, heart failure, atherosclerosis, dry eye, uveitis, non-granulomatous uveitis, dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, COPD, bronchitis, thrombotic diseases, cardiovascular diseases, or other NET-related diseases such as wound healing of diabetic patients, cancer metastasis, and transplanted organ health in vivo or in vitro. EET-related diseases include eosinophil diseases or disorders, such as eosinophil diseases or disorders of the skin, respiratory eosinophil diseases or disorders, gastrointestinal eosinophil diseases or disorders, allergic diseases or disorders, or helminth, fungal, viral or bacterial infections.

title_en: Double-target gemcitabine conjugate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of gemcitabine derivatives, and particularly relates to a double-target gemcitabine conjugate as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The double-target gemcitabine conjugate has the following structural general formula:  Wherein R  1  is selected from amino,  R  2  is selected from Or hydroxy. The dual-target gemcitabine conjugate synthesized by the invention is used for treating tumors, and the effect of inhibiting tumor growth is obviously better than that of the existing gemcitabine.

title_en: Antibodies that bind to multiple saber viruses
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides antibodies and antigen binding fragments thereof that bind to the S protein of sand Bei Bingdu (including, in some embodiments, a plurality of sand Bei Bingdu) and in certain embodiments are capable of neutralizing infection by a plurality of sand shellfish viruses.

title_en: Micro-sized calcium alginate gel particles loaded with bidirectional functionalized nano-selenium and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biomedical materials and animal feed additives, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of micro-size grade calcium alginate gel particles loaded with bidirectional functionalized nano-selenium. The preparation method comprises (1) mixing nano-selenium with high molecular weight alginate to obtain alginic acid modified nano-selenium, (2) mixing alginic acid modified nano-selenium with low molecular weight alginate, spray drying to obtain nano-selenium alginic acid microsphere, and (3) mixing nano-selenium alginic acid microsphere with calcium ion solution, washing, drying to obtain micro-size grade calcium alginate gel particles. The nano-selenium calcium alginate gel particles are micron-sized, can realize gastrointestinal tract positioning and slow release, have the functions of resisting oxidation, enhancing immunity, regulating inflammation, improving intestinal microecology, resisting pathogenic microorganism infection and the like, and can be used for selenium nutrition fortification and animal replacement/reduction-resistance culture.

title_en: Vitamin A microcapsule preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vitamin preparations, and particularly relates to a vitamin A microcapsule preparation and a preparation method thereof, wherein the vitamin A microcapsule preparation comprises 40-60 parts of vitamin A acetate crystals, 160-200 parts of gelatin, 10-15 parts of xanthan gum and a proper amount of water in parts by weight, wherein the vitamin A acetate crystals are taken as active ingredients, the gelatin is taken as a main embedding material, the xanthan gum is taken as a stabilizer, the water is taken as a dispersion medium, the water is used for adjusting the emulsion viscosity formed by the components to 1200-1500cp, the emulsion stability is high, the viscosity is adaptive, the spray drying is carried out, the final product can keep high activity under the conditions of normal temperature and high temperature, and the formula is reasonable and the preparation process is simple.

title_en: Specific antibody for granulomatous mastitis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antibodies, and particularly provides a specific antibody for granulomatous mastitis and application thereof, wherein the antibody has higher specificity and sensitivity, can accurately identify the associated pathological tissues of granulomatous mastitis, and is beneficial to improving the accuracy of early diagnosis and differential diagnosis. In addition, the antibody can be used as a drug delivery carrier or a key component of immunotherapy at the treatment level, thereby realizing higher targeting and curative effect.

title_en: A method for preparing Ginseng radix Rubri product for preventing senile dementia
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of red ginseng preparation, in particular to a red ginseng product preparation method capable of preventing senile dementia, which comprises the following components of red ginseng, medlar extract, walnut peptide, vitamin E, maltodextrin and magnesium stearate, wherein the components and the proportion are 40 parts of red ginseng, 15 parts of medlar extract, 10 parts of walnut peptide, 2 parts of vitamin E, 31.5 parts of maltodextrin and 1.5 parts of magnesium stearate, and the preparation method further comprises the following processing steps of raw material pretreatment, step two, red ginseng active ingredient intensified extraction, step three, multicomponent mixing, step five, packaging and inspection, and the aim of solving the problems that the crushing and grinding degree of red ginseng is insufficient, the compact tissue structure of red ginseng is difficult to break sufficiently, the dissolution efficiency of the subsequent active ingredient is affected, and partial active ingredient oxidative degradation is caused.

title_en: Active targeting nano preparation for enhancing tumor immunotherapy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and discloses an active targeting nano preparation for enhancing tumor immunotherapy and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention prepares a metal organic framework nanoparticle siRNA  PD‑L1  @ZIF-8 carrying siRNA  PD‑L1  through electrostatic adsorption, then modifies HA on the surface of the metal organic framework nanoparticle siRNA  PD‑L1  @ZIF-8 to prepare siRNA  PD‑L1  @HA-ZIF-8, realizes tumor tissue specific accumulation through active targeting, and releases Zn  2+  ions and siRNA  PD‑L1  through acid sensitive cleavage, wherein the Zn  2+  ions induce cell apoptosis, cause immunogenic death and activate in vivo immune response, and the siRNA  PD‑L1  specifically silences PD-L1 genes in tumor cells, reduces the expression of PD-L1 proteins, and cooperatively plays an anti-tumor role. The method has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost, good stability and high repeatability. The active targeting nano preparation disclosed by the invention is beneficial to solving the problems of instability, lack of targeting and the like of the siRNA  PD‑L1  in the systemic circulation, so that the delivery efficiency and the anti-tumor effect of the siRNA  PD‑L1  are improved, and the active targeting nano preparation has a good development prospect in the aspect of clinical application transformation.

title_en: Condensed-cyclic compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fused ring compound, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structure of the fused ring compound is shown as a formula I: among which, Or X 1 、X 2 、X 3 、X 4 、X 5 、X 6 、Y、L、L 1 、L 2 、A、Z、E、G、R 1 、R 2 、R 3  The definition of (2) is as described in the specification. The fused ring compound has high-efficiency and high-selectivity inhibition effect on the epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER 2), and can be used for treating related diseases which are induced by HER2 abnormality, in particular to the treatment of cancer diseases.

title_en: Valsartan hydrochlorothiazide solid dispersion tablet with high bioavailability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-bioavailability valsartan hydrochlorothiazide solid dispersion tablet, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw materials of the tablet comprise valsartan, hydrochlorothiazide and a solid dispersion carrier, and the core of the tablet is that the solid dispersion carrier is a compound of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose acetate succinate and ethylcellulose, and is used in cooperation with a cosolvent, a surfactant and cyclodextrin. The invention realizes the remarkable improvement of the dissolution and the bioavailability and the reliable guarantee of the long-term stability through the coordination of the carrier compounding and the auxiliary materials. Compared with the conventional preparation, the dissolution rate of the tablet 45 min is improved by more than 30%, the bioavailability is improved by more than 60%, the impurity level is unchanged in an acceleration test for 6 months, and the technical problem that the dissolution and the stability of a single carrier system are difficult to be compatible is solved. In addition, the preparation process is suitable for large-scale industrial production and has extremely high industrial conversion value.

title_en: Chinese medicinal preparation based on Chinese angelica and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular discloses a Chinese medicinal preparation based on Chinese angelica and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Chinese medicinal preparation comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the traditional Chinese medicine preparation is prepared by innovatively adding the emulsifying auxiliary agent into the traditional Chinese medicine compound, mixing and emulsifying the emulsifying auxiliary agent and the volatile oil extracted from the traditional Chinese medicine formula, and then mixing with the concentrated extract extracted from the traditional Chinese medicine components, and the obtained traditional Chinese medicine preparation not only improves liver depression and blood deficiency caused by the diabetes renal anemia, lightens the kidney burden and also enhances the tonifying effect of Chinese angelica through the multi-way synergistic effect of tonifying liver and kidney, regulating qi and blood, inducing diuresis to alleviate edema, resisting oxidation and the like, thereby achieving the aim of treating the diabetes renal anemia and reducing complications.

title_en: Akabane virus monoclonal antibody with virus neutralization activity and colloidal gold immunochromatography test strip prepared by same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an akabane virus monoclonal antibody with virus neutralization activity and a colloidal gold immunochromatography test strip prepared by the same, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The monoclonal antibody is secreted by a hybridoma cell strain with the preservation number of CGMCC NO.45859, and is named as 1H6. The monoclonal antibody provided by the invention can specifically recognize AKAV N proteins and neutralize akabane virus. The invention constructs a colloidal gold immunochromatography test strip for detecting akabane virus by using purified monoclonal antibody 1H6 coupled gold particles, wherein rabbit anti-AKAV polyclonal antibody is coated on an NC film as a detection T line and sheep anti-mouse IgG antibody is coated on the NC film as a quality control C line.

title_en: Stable antibiotic-free plasmid expression system and application thereof in preparation of antitumor drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stable antibiotic-free plasmid expression system and application thereof in preparing antitumor drugs. The plasmid expression system comprises a replicon, a regulatable promoter, a ribosome binding site RBS and a axe/txe toxin-antitoxin stabilizing module, and can realize long-term stable expression of exogenous genes under the condition of no antibiotics. The replicon is selected from one or a combination of more of pUC, pMB1, p15A or pSC101, the promoter is selected from one or a combination of more of J23100, J23150 or J23112, and the RBS is selected from one or a combination of more of B0032, B0033 or B0034. The invention establishes an antibiotic-free and persistent plasmid platform for salmonella-based therapies, providing a framework for reliable gene delivery in vivo, synthetic biology and opportunities for cancer treatment.

title_en: Preparation method and application of biological agent for promoting tendon aging repair
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a biological agent for promoting tendon aging repair relate to the field of tendon injury treatment caused by aging, and aim to solve the problems of insufficient cell regeneration capability and tendon injury increase caused by tendon aging. The method comprises the steps of immersing activated graphene oxide aerogel in fisetin solution, standing, fixing to obtain fisetin-loaded graphene oxide aerogel, placing the fisetin-loaded graphene oxide aerogel in a culture device, adding single-cell suspension into the culture device for cell culture, collecting cell supernatant, performing low-intensity pulse ultrasonic treatment, performing ultrafiltration concentration, and adding physiological saline to prepare a biological preparation for promoting tendon aging repair. The biological agent prepared by the invention can slow down tendon aging, improve tendon injury and promote tendon generation.

title_en: Cationic lipids based on tris (hydroxymethyl) methylglycine and citric acid
abstract_en: The present invention provides, in part, tris (hydroxymethyl) methylglycine and citrate lipids, or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The compounds provided herein comprise compounds of formula (a) and may be used to deliver and express mRNA and encoded protein, e.g., as components of liposome delivery vehicles, and thus may be used to treat various diseases, disorders, and conditions, such as those associated with the deficiency of one or more proteins. (A)。

title_en: Drug for treating malignant tumor meninges metastasis with NTRK and/or ROS1 mutation, application and preparation method of drug
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and in particular relates to a medicament for treating malignant tumor meninges metastasis with NTRK and/or ROS1 mutation and a preparation method thereof, wherein the medicament is a freeze-dried powder preparation or injection for subarachnoid cavity injection of NTRK/ROS 1-TKIs. The invention also provides application of the NTRK/ROS1-TKIs in preparing medicines for treating malignant tumor meninges metastasis of NTRK and/or ROS1 mutation. The NTRK/ROS1-TKIs injection prepared by the invention can be directly injected into the subarachnoid space of a patient, so that the concentration of the drug in cerebrospinal fluid of the patient is greatly improved, the cerebrospinal fluid/plasma concentration ratio can reach 20 times or more, the problem of insufficient dosage caused by blood brain barrier after oral targeting of the drug can be completely solved, the drug has quick response, and the treatment effect of malignant tumor meninges metastasis such as lung cancer can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3, lipopeptid prepared from bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3 and application of lipopeptid
abstract_en: The invention provides bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3, lipopeptides prepared from the bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3 and application of the lipopeptides, and belongs to the technical field of biological fermentation technology and nutritional functional food. According to the invention, the bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3 is obtained through screening, and the lipopeptides are prepared by utilizing the bacillus amyloliquefaciens D3, so that the lipopeptides can obviously reduce body fat rate after continuous intervention for 7 weeks, and can improve intestinal flora. The lipopeptide provided by the invention can be applied to the preparation of functional foods or medicines for regulating lipid metabolism, and can also be applied to the preparation of functional foods and medicines for improving intestinal flora, so that the problems of single function and low activity retention rate of the conventional lipopeptide are solved.

title_en: Oral intestinal enzyme-responsive polysaccharide hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological materials, and provides an oral intestinal enzyme-responsive polysaccharide hydrogel, and a preparation method and application thereof. The hydrogel takes polysaccharide as a carrier and vitamin C as a carrier, and is formed by crosslinking. By the technical scheme, the limitation of intravenous administration and direct oral administration of vitamin C in high dosage in the related technology is solved, and the anticancer effect is improved.

title_en: Combination therapy of dacatinib and nilamide for the prevention or treatment of pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a combination therapy of dacatinib (dacomitinib) and nidanib (nintedanib) for the prevention or treatment of pulmonary fibrosis.

title_en: Assembly material for poorly soluble active transdermal mucosal drug delivery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, and provides an assembly material for indissolvable active transdermal mucosa administration and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts lipid cubic phase nano particles composed of glyceryl monooleate, cholesterol, glyceryl dioleate and caprylic acid/capric acid triglyceride, and combines DSPE-PEG2000 to stabilize the surface Ion synergistic regulation design, through melting-hydration-high pressure homogenization-cubic phase curing The continuous process of surface treatment realizes high drug loading and nanoscale particle size control. The invention solves the technical problems that the high loading of indissolvable active ingredients and the long-term colloid stability are difficult to be compatible, the cubic phase structure stability and the surface charge controllability are contradictory in tissue-friendly environment, and the coupling between high drug loading and crystallization prevention under a low-temperature processing window is difficult, and has wide application value in the field of local drug delivery through skin and mucous membrane.

title_en: Solid preparation containing cabergoline and preparation and preservation methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid preparation containing cabergoline, which comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 0.25-1.0 part of component A, 2.9-4.3 parts of component B and 75.4-76.85 parts of component C, wherein the component A is cabergoline, the component B is L-leucine, and the component C is lactose. Also provided are methods of making and preserving solid formulations comprising cabergoline. The solid preparation containing cabergoline can effectively improve the homogeneity and the stability of cabergoline, obviously improve the storage stability of the cabergoline, is suitable for commercial production and is suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Zironoi peptide nasal brain delivery preparation
abstract_en: The invention provides a high brain targeting, safe and noninvasive ziconotide nasal brain delivery preparation which is directly accessed into the brain through nasal administration. The nasal and brain delivery formulation comprises an active ingredient ziconotide and an absorption enhancer selected from one or more of dodecyl-beta-D-maltoside (DDM), menthol, hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HP-beta-CD), sodium Glycocholate (SGC) and related derivatives thereof. The absorption accelerator with specific types and content is cooperated with the ziconotide to act together, so that the ziconotide bypasses the blood brain barrier, enters the brain through the mucous membrane of the nasal olfactory region, forms a drug reservoir in the olfactory bulb, is slowly released to the brain, and maintains long-term drug effect, thereby abandoning the traditional intrathecal administration mode of the ziconotide, and developing the nasal brain administration mode of the ziconotide, and is a new generation therapy of pain symptoms related to the central nervous system.

title_en: Phenothiazine functional precursor, photosensitizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: According to the invention, based on the study of the structure-activity relationship of the benzothiazine site modification, halogen or thienyl is introduced into R  1  and/or R  2  sites of a benzothiazine structure as heavy atoms, so that strong spin-orbit coupling can be promoted to be generated, and the intersystem crossing of the thienazine photosensitizer from an excited singlet state (S  1 ) to a triplet state (T  1 ) is promoted, thereby effectively improving the photosensitive effect of the benzothiazine functional precursor and the corresponding phenothiazine photosensitizer. In addition, after the tetrazine group is added into the phenothiazine photosensitizer for modification, the controllable closing and opening of the phenothiazine is realized, so that the dark toxicity of the phenothiazine is effectively reduced, and the phenothiazine photosensitizer is also connected with the targeting group and the drug group, so that the targeting and treatment effects of the photosensitizer are improved, and the phenothiazine photosensitizer has wide application prospects.

title_en: Boletus edulis extract and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boletus edulis extract, a preparation method and application thereof, the invention provides the application of the boletus edulis extract in preparing medicines, health products or functional foods for preventing and/or treating senile intestinal dysfunction caused by colonic atrophy and degeneration, the preparation method of the boletus edulis extract comprises pulverizing boletus edulis, extracting with water or alcohol solvent, filtering to obtain extractive solution, concentrating the extractive solution, and drying to obtain boletus edulis extract. The boletus edulis extract provided by the invention can up-regulate the expression of the zonula occludens protein ZO-1 and mucin MUC-2 in the colon of an aged organism, promote the growth of the length of the colon and the depth of the crypt, further delay the atrophy and degeneration of the colon and enhance the digestion, absorption and immune function of the intestinal tract.

title_en: Ambroxol hydrochloride syrup and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ambroxol hydrochloride syrup and a preparation process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations. The ambroxol hydrochloride syrup formula comprises ambroxol hydrochloride, a stabilizing cosolvent, a sweetener, a preservative, a pH regulator, essence and a solvent, wherein the stabilizing cosolvent is a composition of propylene glycol, meglumine and propylene carbonate, and the sweetener is a combination of sucrose and a functional sweetener. The preparation process comprises the steps of low-temperature pretreatment of main drugs and stable cosolvent, dissolution and mixing of auxiliary materials, pH adjustment, essence addition, constant volume filtration, encapsulation and the like. The invention obviously improves the storage stability of ambroxol hydrochloride through the synergistic effect of the compound stable cosolvent system and the specific preparation process, optimizes the mouthfeel of the preparation, has wide applicable crowd, and has simple and controllable preparation process, good clinical application value and industrialization prospect.

title_en: Antibody targeting CD112R or antigen binding fragment thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The present application relates to antibodies against CD112R or antigen binding fragments thereof, methods of making and uses thereof. The application also relates to therapeutic and diagnostic uses of these antibodies, antibody fragments.

title_en: Supermolecule polypeptide hydrogel based on polypeptide drug conjugate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supermolecule polypeptide hydrogel used as a drug delivery system. The hydrogel system is formed by self-assembly of indoleamine 2, 3-dioxygenase-1 (IDO-1) inhibitor NLG 919-polypeptide conjugate and is loaded with cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitor Abeli (Abe), so as to construct an injectable supermolecular polypeptide hydrogel system. The polypeptide hydrogel can remarkably improve the retention time of the drug beside the tumor, reduce the systemic exposure, can not influence serum biochemical indexes and blood routine indexes, can not cause obvious changes of the morphology and tissue structure of main organs, can well avoid liver injury and immune cell injury caused by oral administration, has good biological safety, can effectively inhibit the recurrence of tumor and the occurrence of lung metastasis after the operation excision of the triple negative breast cancer of a mouse, and has good application prospect in the in-situ treatment of the triple negative breast cancer.

title_en: Anti-heart failure pharmaceutical composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a pharmaceutical composition comprising a pharmaceutically effective amount of enalapril Li Shesuan and enggliflozin. The invention also provides the use of the composition in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of heart failure.

title_en: Application of aromatic ring compounds in detection of biological thiol glutathione
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of an aromatic ring compound as a fluorescent probe in the detection of biological thiol glutathione, experiments show that the compound can react with glutathione GSH, fluorescence after the reaction is obviously enhanced, and Cys and Hcy which are highly similar to GSH in structure do not have the phenomenon, so that the aromatic ring compound can be used as the fluorescent probe for detecting glutathione GSH, and meanwhile, the experiment shows that a detection system of the invention is not interfered by anions and cations, amino acids, different pH conditions and the like.

title_en: Application of ergothioneine in preparation of medicine for improving metabolism-related fatty liver disease
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an application of ergothioneine in preparing a medicament for improving metabolic-related fatty liver disease. In the present disclosure, it was verified by cell and animal models that ergothioneine can improve metabolism-related fatty liver disease, which is advantageous for use of ergothioneine in the preparation of drugs for improving metabolism-related fatty liver disease.

title_en: Medicated leaven based on multi-strain fermentation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to medicated leaven based on multi-strain fermentation and application thereof, wherein the medicated leaven is prepared by carrying out sectional fermentation on wheat bran, flour, red bean, bitter apricot kernel, dry spicy and hot flower, dry sweet wormwood and dry xanthium sibiricum by utilizing compound fermentation strains of 7 functional strains obtained by screening, so that each strain is orderly proliferated according to a growth time sequence, competitive inhibition is avoided, active ingredient leaching is further ensured, the fermentation effect is improved, and the dry spicy and hot flower, dry sweet wormwood and dry xanthium sibiricum replace the traditional fresh materials, and active ingredient loss caused by season limitation and high-temperature decoction is avoided.

title_en: Application of lactobacillus plantarum Hi188 in promoting bone health
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of lactobacillus plantarum Hi188 in promoting bone health. The invention provides the use of lactobacillus plantarum Hi188 or a progeny thereof, or a composition thereof, for increasing bone density, increasing bone mineral density, promoting skeletal development, increasing bone mineral content and/or promoting tibial growth, or for the preparation of a food product for increasing bone density, increasing bone mineral density, promoting skeletal development, increasing bone mineral content and/or promoting tibial growth, wherein the composition comprises (a) lactobacillus plantarum Hi188 or a progeny thereof, and (B) bifidobacterium lactis Ca360 or a progeny thereof.

title_en: Gynecological antibacterial gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical gel, and particularly relates to gynecological antibacterial gel and a preparation method thereof. The gel comprises two parts of a bacteriostatic phase and an antibacterial phase, achieves broad-spectrum inhibition of common pathogenic bacteria through the synergistic proportion of naringin, nisin and lauroyl arginine ethyl ester hydrochloride, and simultaneously introduces lactobacillus rhamnosus metabolic products, sodium hyaluronate and the like to construct the antibacterial phase so as to promote the field planting of probiotics and the reconstruction of the microecological balance of vagina. The pH value of the gel is stabilized at 4.0-4.5, and the gel has good rheological property and detention performance. In the preparation method, each component is added step by step, the system temperature and the stirring condition are controlled, and the ingredient activity and the product stability are ensured. The invention can effectively relieve bacterial vaginitis, fungal infection and microecological disturbance, and has synergistic, safe and mild comprehensive nursing effect.

title_en: Polyketide derived from actinomycetes and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyketone compound from actinomycetes, a preparation method and application thereof, relating to the technical field of microbial natural product excavation and biological medicine, and the technical scheme is as follows: the invention discloses a novel polyketide Strepactone derived from actinomycetes sp.DP 0001, and the molecular formula of the novel polyketide Strepactone is C  25 H 38 O 5 . The compound is obtained through strain fermentation, ethyl acetate extraction and multi-step chromatographic purification, and the structure is identified through ESI-MS,  1  H NMR and  13  C NMR. Experiments show that Strepactone has an inhibiting effect on staphylococcus aureus and methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus, has a remarkable inhibiting activity on human non-small cell lung cancer A549 cells, the half inhibition concentration IC  50  is 5.36 mu M, and Strepactone has no remarkable cytotoxic activity on human embryonic kidney cell 293T cells at a concentration of 30 mu M. The compound can be used for preparing medicines for resisting drug-resistant bacteria and medicines for resisting human non-small cell lung cancer, and also provides a structural basis for developing novel antibacterial and antitumor lead medicines.

title_en: Multifunctional selenium@platinum nano enzyme for resisting atherosclerosis as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-atherosclerosis multifunctional selenium@platinum nano enzyme and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano medicines. The Se@Pt nano enzyme comprises nano Se particles and nano Pt particles, wherein the nano Se particles are taken as cores, and the nano Pt particles are dispersed and loaded on the surfaces of the nano Se particles to form a spherical or spheroidic morphology. The nano-enzyme has remarkable antibacterial effect on escherichia coli and staphylococcus aureus, and has the effects of improving dyslipidemia, improving the activity of antioxidant enzymes of livers, enhancing the oxidative stress defense capacity of organisms, resisting atherosclerosis and the like.

title_en: Isolated polypeptide for inducing mitochondrial calcium overload and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an isolated polypeptide for inducing mitochondrial calcium overload and application thereof, wherein the isolated polypeptide has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 or 2. The isolated polypeptide of the application can bind to NCLX protein and can promote the degradation of NCLX protein by m-AAA protease, thus preventing the excretion of calcium ions and causing the overload of calcium in mitochondria. Moreover, the isolated polypeptide is significantly superior to the existing calcium release inhibitor CGP37157 in inducing mitochondrial calcium overload.

title_en: Vibrio alginolyticus specific phage PV2-35-1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses vibrio alginolyticus specific phage PV2-35-1 and application thereof. Vibrio alginolyticus phage PV2-35-1 was deposited at the microorganism strain collection (GDMCC) of Guangdong province at 12 months 1 of 2025, at the address of No. 59 building 5 of Dai 100 in Xiuzhou Kouzhou Koujia martyr, post code 510070, accession number GDMCC No:67384-B1. The head of the phage is in an icosahedron structure, the diameter is 57+/-2 nm, the tail is a non-contractile long tail, and the tail length is 154+/-3 nm, belonging to the order of the phage with the tail, and belonging to the family of long-tail phages. The phage had an optimal multiplicity of infection of 0.1, a latency period of 40 min, a lytic period of 100 min and a lytic amount of 248 PFU/mL.

title_en: Salmonid aeromonas natural attenuated strain derived from channel catfish and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pathogenic microorganism screening and aquaculture disease prevention and control, and discloses a salmonicida aeromonas natural attenuated strain derived from channel catfish and application thereof, wherein the preservation number of the strain is CCTCC NO: M20252718. Through artificial infection, the toxicity of the strain to the tested rainbow trout and grass carp is far lower than that of the aeromonas salmonicida virulent strain, and the live vaccine prepared by the strain is used for immunoprotection to the rainbow trout and grass carp, so that bacterial diseases caused by the aeromonas salmonicida virulent strain can be effectively prevented. The strain is used in the cultivation process, so that the use of antibiotics can be effectively reduced, and the strain has a positive pushing effect on reducing the drug residues of freshwater fishes so as to realize green cultivation.

title_en: Aptamer modified extracellular vesicles and antagonism of extracellular vesicles on ocean guanamine neurotoxin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine organisms, in particular to a nucleic acid aptamer modified nerve extracellular vesicle and application thereof in preventing and treating marine guanamine neurotoxin poisoning. The invention couples extracellular vesicles (nEVs) and nucleic acid aptamer (Apt) of tetrodotoxin (TTX) to construct a guanamine toxin nano antagonistic system Apt-nEVs. Apt-nEVs reserves a natural Na  +  channel on a nerve cell membrane, can cooperatively play a double detoxification function of coupling an aptamer and identifying and trapping TTX by the natural Na  +  channel, can realize high-efficiency detoxification of TTX on a non-cellular system and a cellular level, and has an obvious protection effect on oxidative stress injury of cells caused by the TTX. The aptamer coupled extracellular vesicles (Apt-nEVs) obtained in the invention can also provide a thinking reference for constructing a more broad-spectrum marine biotoxin antagonism system.

title_en: Phage capable of lysing pathogenic escherichia coli and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phage capable of lysing pathogenic escherichia coli and application thereof. The phage is named ESCHERICHIA COLI PHAGE VB _ EcoM _YS1 and is deposited in the Guangdong province microorganism strain collection center, and the deposition number is GDMCC No:67465-B1vB_ EcoM _YS1.
