Experiments prove that the phage has strong cracking capacity, strong thermal stability and pH stability, and can keep high titer under the conditions of 4-40℃, pH-9. The phage can lyse various escherichia coli including enterotoxigenic escherichia coli (ETEC) and shiga toxin-producing escherichia coli (STEC), has a wider lysis spectrum, and can be used as an antibiotic substitute. In addition, the phage genome does not contain virulence genes and antibiotic resistance genes, and has good biological safety.

title_en: Spray for improving oral inflammation of pets and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a spray for improving oral inflammation of pets and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of oral spraying for pets. The preparation method of the spray for improving the oral inflammation of the pets comprises the following steps of preparing deoxycholic acid-chitosan, preparing a first component, preparing a second component and mixing the preparation. The spray for improving the oral inflammation of the pet and the preparation method thereof can effectively mask the bad taste of the Chinese herbal medicine components and improve the palatability, meanwhile, the adopted gel system has good matching property with the Chinese herbal medicine components, can effectively protect the Chinese herbal medicine components in the system, can further improve the gel film forming strength of the gel system containing the Chinese herbal medicine components in the oral cavity of the pet, effectively prolong the residence time of the effective components in the oral cavity of the pet, and further improve the nursing effect on the oral inflammation of the pet through the cooperation of the gel system and the Chinese herbal medicine components.

title_en: Application of product for detecting USP18 related molecules
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nasopharyngeal carcinoma diagnosis and treatment, and particularly relates to application of a product for detecting USP18 related molecules. Such uses include any of the use of USP 18-related products as reagents for detecting the protein content of USP18 for diagnosing nasopharyngeal carcinoma. USP 18-related products are agents that inhibit USP18 gene expression for the treatment of nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The product related to USP18 is an animal model or a cell model with low expression of USP18 genes, and is used for developing or screening functional products for treating nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Aiming at USP18, the invention constructs an immunohistochemical kit for diagnosis and various types of inhibitory functional products, provides a new thought and technical support for early diagnosis, curative effect prediction and accurate treatment of nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and has good clinical application prospect and industrialization potential.

title_en: Anti-dandruff itching-relieving nursing essence and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nursing products, in particular to a dandruff-removing itching-relieving nursing essence and a production process thereof. The skin care product comprises the following raw materials of a plant extract compound, silanol components, a polyol humectant, a transdermal enhancer, a thickening agent, a preservative and polydimethylsiloxane. According to the invention, a transdermal carrier-active intervention-barrier anchoring ternary synergistic system constructed by the polydimethylsiloxane, the plant extract compound and the silanol component is used for realizing full-chain accurate intervention of micro-ecological regulation and control of transdermal delivery of the active component to the scalp, so that the transdermal efficiency of anti-dandruff and antipruritic effects and the micro-ecological balance synergistic regulation and control capability are remarkably improved.

title_en: Chimeric virus-like particle vaccine of feline coronavirus and feline panleukopenia virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a chimeric virus-like particle vaccine of feline coronavirus and feline panleukopenia virus and application thereof. The invention provides a chimeric virus-like particle of feline coronavirus and feline panleukopenia virus, which contains feline coronavirus type I S protein and feline panleukopenia virus VP2 protein. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the chimeric virus-like particle. The vaccine prepared from the chimeric virus-like particles can generate high-titer antibody level after immunization of mice and cats, stimulate organisms to generate cellular immunity, and the immunized cats can effectively resist invasion of feline coronavirus and feline panleukopenia virus. The chimeric virus-like particle has good immunogenicity and can be used for preventing and controlling cat infectious diseases.

title_en: Application of miR-150 inhibitor in preparation of medicament for activating adult myocardial cell reentry cell cycle
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a miR-150 inhibitor in preparation of a medicament for activating adult myocardial cell reentry cell cycle. The invention also provides a myocardial patch which contains the miR-150 inhibitor, wherein the miR-150 inhibitor is wrapped in an intracellular delivery carrier such as a liposome, an exosome, a polymer complex, an inorganic nanoparticle and the like, and is further loaded on a biodegradable hydrophilic flexible polymer film or a hydrogel material. The myocardial patch provided by the invention has good biocompatibility and biodegradability, can be degraded and absorbed, does not need additional adhesives, can be closely attached to the surface of the heart by absorbing body fluid on the surface of the heart and by virtue of liquid bridge force, can be closely attached to the surface of the heart by in-situ crosslinking of the surface of the heart to form glue, can deliver miR-150 inhibitors into myocardial cells, activates proliferation potential of the myocardial cells, and further promotes myocardial cell proliferation of damaged myocardial tissues.

title_en: Preparation method of functional nano particles based on cooperative assembly of carbon dots and Fmoc amino acid
abstract_en: The invention designs a preparation method of functional nano particles based on cooperative assembly of carbon dots and Fmoc amino acid. Firstly, taking amino acid modified by Fmoc groups as a starting material, fully dissolving in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) serving as a solvent to obtain suspension, secondly, placing the obtained suspension into ultrapure water with a certain proportion of the volume of the DMSO used in the first step to obtain turbid suspension, stirring the obtained turbid suspension in an ice bath, adding a certain amount of 1-ethyl- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide (EDC) and N-hydroxysuccinimide (NHS), adding a predetermined dose of carbon dots into the amino acid solution, stirring, and finally, placing the turbid suspension obtained in the above step into a centrifuge for centrifugal washing for 3 times to obtain semi-dried solid, and then placing the semi-dried solid into a freeze dryer for freeze drying to obtain a powder to obtain a nanoparticle finished product. The method has low cost, simple operation and high yield.

title_en: Method for enhancing macrophage bacterial swallowing capacity, kit and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing the bacterial swallowing capacity of macrophages, a kit and application thereof. The method comprises the step of over-expressing CYTB-187AA protein in macrophages, wherein the amino acid sequence of the CYTB-187AA protein comprises a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention reveals the new function of CYTB-187AA protein in enhancing the phagocytic bacterial function of macrophages for the first time, and provides a new target point and an effective tool for researching the macrophage functions and developing a novel anti-infection strategy.

title_en: Ophthalmic preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ophthalmic preparation and application thereof. The ophthalmic preparation comprises a TNFalpha nanobody, a protective agent, a thickening agent, a buffer solution and an optional surfactant, wherein the pH value is more than or equal to 6.0 and less than or equal to 7.0, the protective agent is at least one of trehalose, mannitol, arginine and glycine, the thickening agent is any one of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, polyvinyl alcohol and sodium hyaluronate, and the buffer solution is phosphate buffer solution or histidine buffer solution. The ophthalmic formulation is useful for treating immune-mediated inflammatory ophthalmic diseases.

title_en: Drug-loaded nanoparticle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug-loaded nanoparticle, and a preparation method and application thereof. The drug-loaded nanoparticle can be used for treating triple negative breast cancer, and specifically comprises magnetic nanoparticles, active ingredients loaded in the magnetic nanoparticles, and erythrocyte membranes coating the magnetic nanoparticles, wherein the active ingredients are selected from one or more of piperlonguminine, paris polyphylla saponin II, erianin, pseudolaric acid, 6-gingerol, ginkgetin, solasodine, cucurbitacin B and lycorine. In practical application, the drug-loaded nanoparticle has good biological safety, long circulation capacity and higher tumor retention capacity, and can produce efficient killing and treatment effects on the Sanyin breast cancer by inducing apoptosis.

title_en: Expression and application of recombinant humanized collagen
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collagen, in particular to expression and application of recombinant humanized collagen. The recombinant collagen comprises A  X B Y C Z , wherein X and Z are independently selected from 0 or 1, Y is an integer more than or equal to 1, X and Z are 0;A structural domain which is collagen N-terminal peptide or peptide fragment thereof, B structural domain is Gly-Xaa-Yaa structure, C structural domain is collagen C-terminal peptide or peptide fragment thereof, the recombinant collagen not only shows excellent cell compatibility, including higher cell activity, cell adhesion rate and cell proliferation rate, but also has the effects of resisting inflammation and inhibiting melanin generation, and can promote the synthesis of type I collagen, type III collagen and elastin, and can be widely applied to the technical fields of biological medicine, medical equipment, cosmetics and bioengineering.

title_en: Pearl mussel source miRNA and application thereof, biological preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine and functional nucleic acid molecules, and discloses pearl mussel source miRNA, application, biological preparation and application. The pearl mussel source miRNA is miRNA derived from the external body of the mantle of the pearl mussel, comprises a sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, and can be modified with phosphorylation, locked nucleic acid and the like to enhance stability. The biological preparation containing the miRNA can be used for preparing medicines for preventing and/or treating osteoporosis or functional foods for promoting bone mineralization, and can be used for improving bone density and improving bone microstructure by promoting osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and mineralization. The invention provides a new active ingredient and a technical scheme for preventing and treating osteoporosis by utilizing marine biological resources with natural sources and high safety.

title_en: Application of mRNA uncapped complex subunit protein DCP1b in preparation of medicines for preventing or treating Ebola virus infection
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the application of mRNA decapitated complex subunit protein DCP1b in the preparation of drugs for the prevention or treatment of Ebola virus infection. The present invention uses substances that can inhibit or reduce the expression of DCP1b to prepare products for the treatment/prevention of Ebola virus infection/proliferation or Ebola virus disease. The present invention has been experimentally proven to significantly reduce the replication of Ebola virus in cells after treatment with mRNA decapitated complex subunit protein DCP1b siRNA (DCP1b siRNA is siRNA DCP1b 245, siRNA DCP1b 901 or siRNA DCP1b 1833), proving that DCP1b siRNA can effectively inhibit the proliferation of Ebola virus. The present invention further screened for siRNA with significant knockdown effect of DCP1b, namely siRNA DCP1b 245, which has better inhibitory effect on the proliferation of Ebola virus. The present invention provides a new treatment strategy for the prevention and treatment of acute infectious diseases caused by Ebola virus infection.

title_en: Purinone derivative, preparation method and medical application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and discloses a purinone derivative, a preparation method and medical application thereof. The purinone derivative has a structure shown in a general formula I:  the purinone derivative has strong inhibition effect on proliferation of tumor cells such as liver cancer, lung cancer, colon cancer, pancreatic cancer, prostatic cancer, breast cancer and the like, and can be applied to preparation of medicines for treating and/or preventing malignant tumors.

title_en: Application of astaxanthin in preparation of medicine for preventing and treating pancreatitis related intestinal dysfunction and repairing intestinal mucosa barrier
abstract_en: The invention provides application of astaxanthin in preparation of medicines for preventing and treating severe acute pancreatitis related intestinal dysfunction, intestinal flora imbalance or repairing intestinal mucosa barrier. In vivo experiments prove that astaxanthin can remarkably improve the damage of intestinal barrier induced by SAP, reduce the activity of serum diamine oxidase (DAO), repair jejunum villus structure and up-regulate the expression of tight junction protein (ZO-1, occludin, claudin), the mechanism relates to inhibiting local inflammatory reaction and oxidative stress, and specifically correct intestinal flora disorder, including restoring the proportion balance of the phylum of the thick-walled bacteria and the phylum of the bacteroides, improving the abundance of beneficial bacteria such as lactobacillus murinus, ruminococcus and the like, and the invention provides a new strategy for clinical treatment of SAP concurrent intestinal failure.

title_en: Egg yolk antibody for resisting canine interleukin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses an anti-canine interleukin egg yolk antibody, and a preparation method and application thereof. The yolk antibody is prepared by taking an immunocompetent epitope peptide of canine interleukin-31 as an immunogen, wherein the epitope peptide is obtained by predicting a key epitope of IL-31 through ANTIGENIC tools and optimizing in series, and a recombinant expression vector is constructed after a coding gene is optimized by an escherichia coli codon, and the recombinant expression vector is induced to express and purified to obtain a high-purity antigen. After basic immunity and twice boosting immunity, egg yolk antibody is extracted and purified from egg yolk, and ELISA is superior to that of commercial antibody prepared with canine IL-31 protein. The yolk antibody can specifically bind with canine IL-31, obviously reduce the histamine level in the serum of itchy dogs, effectively relieve the symptoms of atopic dermatitis related itching, provide a high-efficiency and safe biological therapeutic preparation for canine IL-31 mediated itching diseases, and have wide clinical application prospects.

title_en: Human interleukin 2 variant and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a human interleukin-2 (IL-2) variant, derivatives and uses thereof. The IL-2 variants are obtained by authorized computational software, with reduced or eliminated affinity for the high affinity receptor IL2rαβγ, while retaining the affinity for the intermediate affinity receptor IL2rβ/γ. The disclosure also relates to human antibody fragment fusion proteins comprising the IL-2 variants that enhance the activity of interleukin 2 variants.

title_en: Application of yuankanin polysaccharide in preparation of products for preventing alcoholic liver injury and assisting in dispelling effects of alcohol
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of yuankanin polysaccharide in preparation of products for preventing alcoholic liver injury and assisting in dispelling effects of alcohol, and belongs to the technical fields of natural product development and biological medicine. The yuankanin polysaccharide prepared by ultrasonic and alcohol extraction is rich in galactose and rhamnose, has higher galacturonic acid content, presents typical RG-I pectin polysaccharide characteristics, can be kept stable in simulated gastrointestinal fluid and directly acts on colon, can obviously reduce transaminase rise and lipid accumulation caused by alcohol, can repair intestinal barriers through specific proliferation of beneficial bacteria such as Akkermansia, can block endotoxin from entering blood, and can obviously activate liver anti-alcoholic enzyme and shorten drunk time.

title_en: Application of tea polysaccharide prepared by fermentation of ganoderma lucidum in preventing varicella-zoster virus infection
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of tea polysaccharide prepared by ganoderma lucidum fermentation in preparing a medicament for preventing and treating varicella-zoster virus infection. The tea polysaccharide is an acidic polysaccharide, and is abbreviated as FTP, the molecular weight of the polysaccharide is 3.51X10  5  Da, the monosaccharide composition and the proportion are that Xyl is GalA, glc is Gal, and Man=4.99:4.43:3.44:2.81:1.69:1. The invention is found and proved by a series of biological experiments, the fermented tea polysaccharide FTP has obvious anti-VZV effect under the dosage without obvious cytotoxicity, is safe and effective, and is expected to be developed into a medicine for preventing and treating VZV.

title_en: CD300LF affinity peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses a CD300LF affinity peptide and application thereof. The CD300LF affinity peptide provided by the invention can be specifically combined with CD300LF protein, can be used for preparing polypeptide drugs or detection reagents targeting CD300LF, and expands the development form of drugs/preparations of CD300LF targets. Experiments prove that the CD300LF affinity peptide can effectively reprogram tumor-associated macrophages, reverse polarization of TAMs from M2 type to M1 type, promote production of M1 type-associated cytokines, and further enhance phagocytic capacity of the macrophages on tumor cells. The CD300LF affinity peptide provided by the invention has obvious tumor inhibiting effect and immune activating effect in an in-vivo tumor model, and the modified polypeptide has excellent in-vivo stability and enzymolysis resistance, has no obvious toxic or side effect, and has good transformation and industrialization prospects.

title_en: A method for preparing Cordyceps
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of cordyceps sinensis, and relates to the technical field of medicine preparation. The method comprises the steps of cooling washed cordyceps sinensis to a first temperature lower than a eutectic point to enable moisture in the cordyceps sinensis to be completely frozen to form ice crystals, performing at least one freeze-thawing cycle, thawing the frozen cordyceps sinensis at a second temperature higher than 0 ℃, cooling to the first temperature at a second cooling rate to refreeze the cordyceps sinensis, placing the cordyceps sinensis in a vacuum environment, performing at least one pressure transformation treatment, and heating and drying under vacuum until the predetermined moisture content is reached. The embodiment remarkably improves the dissolution rate of the functional substances when the cordyceps sinensis is taken by a user, improves the bioavailability of the cordyceps sinensis, and forms uniform, loose and crisp texture, thereby bringing a unique taste which is instantly melted when the cordyceps sinensis is taken in mouth, and solving the problems of hard taste and poor palatability of the traditional freeze-dried cordyceps sinensis.

title_en: Exosome for treating radioactive oral mucositis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses an exosome for treating radioactive oral mucositis and a preparation method thereof. The exosomes are prepared from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells pretreated by FC TAGGED IL-11 and are packaged into the exosome cavity by incubation to form HUCMSCs  FI  -exo-THD. The exosome has excellent biocompatibility and targeting property, and can remarkably improve the delivery efficiency and the treatment effect of thalidomide in the treatment of radioactive oral mucositis. Experimental results show that HUCMSCs  FI  -exo-THD have more remarkable vitality recovery and apoptosis inhibition effects on X-ray induced human oral mucosa epithelial cell injury compared with free thalidomide and other single-treated exosomes, the cell vitality is improved by more than 30%, and the apoptosis rate is reduced to below 10%. The preparation method is simple and convenient, has good repeatability, is suitable for large-scale production, and provides a new strategy for the clinical treatment of radioactive oral mucositis.

title_en: Dipeptidyl peptidase 1 inhibitors and uses thereof
abstract_en: Provided herein are compounds of formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, stereoisomer, or deuterated form thereof, wherein rings A, R  1   、 R 2   、 R 3   、 R 4   、 R 9   、  m and n are defined herein. Also provided herein are pharmaceutical compositions comprising a compound of formula (I), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or deuterated form thereof, and methods of using a compound of formula (I), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or deuterated form thereof, for example, in the treatment of a disease treatable by administration of a DPP1 inhibitor. (I)

title_en: Azetidine tryptamine and method of treating psychotic disorders
abstract_en: The present disclosure includes azetidine tryptamines and methods of treating psychotic disorders with such compounds. Pharmaceutical compositions comprising azetidine primary amines are also provided.

title_en: Broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and discloses a broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide and application thereof. According to the invention, the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H is obtained by digging in a non-classical open reading frame (ncORFs) of a human genome, and proved by experiments, the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H has remarkable inhibition effect on gram-positive bacteria (staphylococcus aureus ATCC 29213) and gram-negative bacteria (escherichia coli K88), meanwhile, the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H can form an alpha helix, and a projection diagram of the alpha helix structure shows that one side of the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H is rich in positively charged hydrophilic amino acid residues, and the other side of the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H is rich in hydrophobic amino acid residues, so that the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H has good amphipathy. In addition, the broad-spectrum antibacterial peptide H provided by the invention has low hemolytic activity, no cytotoxicity, high-efficiency sterilization, in-vivo safety assurance, short synthesis sequence and small molecular weight, and is easy to chemically synthesize.

title_en: Viral proteins and nanostructures and uses thereof
abstract_en: Provided herein are recombinant polypeptides comprising engineered extracellular domains of viral proteins from enveloped viruses. Also provided herein are two-component protein nanostructures and compositions for use in vaccination, generating an immune response, or treating or preventing a viral infection.

title_en: Sein card virus VP1 protein antigen epitope polypeptide, monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and particularly relates to an epitope polypeptide of a VP1 protein of a Sein card virus, a monoclonal antibody and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the antigen epitope polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The monoclonal antibody specifically recognizes the epitope polypeptide. The invention carries out prokaryotic expression on SVV VP1 protein, immunizes mice, obtains a monoclonal antibody of anti-VP 1 protein by utilizing a hybridoma technology, further identifies linear B cell epitope of the monoclonal antibody by truncating and expressing VP1 protein fragments, synthesizes the antigen peptide in vitro, and carries out preliminary research on application of the antigen peptide, thereby providing a powerful tool for etiology research and diagnosis of the virus.

title_en: Application of SHP099 and derivatives thereof in preparation of medicines for treating or relieving postherpetic neuralgia
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and particularly provides application of SHP099 and a derivative thereof in preparing a medicament for treating or relieving postherpetic neuralgia (Postherpetic Neuralgia, PHN). The invention provides the use of SHP099 or a pharmaceutically acceptable derivative thereof as an active ingredient for reducing HSV-1 viral load and pro-inflammatory factor expression in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord while up-regulating the level of neurotrophic factors. The invention discovers that SHP099 or pharmaceutically acceptable derivatives thereof can significantly relieve mechanical hyperalgesia of PHN model animals, and intrathecal local administration can enhance curative effect and reduce systemic side effects. The invention expands the clinical application of SHP099 and provides a new strategy for PHN treatment.

title_en: Application of Fstl protein in preparation of antiplatelet medicines
abstract_en: Use of Fstl protein in preparing antiplatelet medicine is provided. Recombinant Fstl1 protein is prepared through a prokaryotic expression system, and after the recombinant Fstl protein is incubated with human blood platelets, functions of platelet aggregation induced by thrombin, compact particle ATP release, alpha particle P-selectin exposure, integrin alpha IIb beta 3 activation, fibrinogen binding, phosphatidylserine eversion, spreading adhesion and blood clot contraction can be obviously inhibited. Animal experiments show that Fstl protein can effectively inhibit FeCl  3  -induced thrombosis of mesenteric artery and carotid artery of mice, reduce platelet accumulation in vivo, and not remarkably prolong the blood-taking time of the tail of the mice. The invention realizes the effective separation of the anti-thrombus effect and the hemostatic function, and provides candidate molecules for developing novel anti-platelet drugs with low bleeding risk.

title_en: Aptamer LWB-1 targeting CNTFR alpha protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nucleic acid aptamer LWB-1 targeting CNTFR alpha protein and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of molecular biology. The invention provides a nucleic acid aptamer LWB-1 for targeting CNTFRalpha protein, wherein the core nucleotide sequence of the nucleic acid aptamer LWB-1 is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The invention utilizes cell-SELEX screening technology to screen and obtain the aptamer LWB-1 which specifically recognizes CNTFR alpha protein, has a unique stem-loop structure, and discovers that the aptamer LWB-1 has higher binding affinity and specificity for CNTFR alpha protein through flow detection, can specifically recognize CNTFR alpha-293T cells, does not recognize 293T cells, is easy to modify and reform, has no cytotoxicity, strong binding specificity, no immunogenicity, high stability and wide application prospect.

title_en: Antigen binding molecules targeting IL-12 and IL-23
abstract_en: In various embodiments, the disclosure provides polypeptides (e.g., antibodies and antigen-binding fragments thereof) that bind to both interleukin 12 (IL-12) and IL-23. In various embodiments, the disclosure also provides fusion proteins comprising one or more of the polypeptides, polynucleotides encoding the polypeptides, vectors and host cells suitable for expressing the polypeptides, and methods for treating IL-12/IL-23-associated diseases or conditions.

title_en: Metal oxide encapsulated pharmaceutical compositions and methods of making the same
abstract_en: A method of preparing a pharmaceutical composition having a drug-containing core surrounded by one or more metal oxide materials is provided. The method comprises the sequential steps of (a) loading particles comprising a drug into a reactor, (b) applying a vaporous or gaseous metal precursor to the particles in the reactor, (c) performing one or more pump-around cycles of the reactor using an inert gas, (d) applying a vaporous or gaseous oxidant to the particles in the reactor, and (e) performing one or more pump-around cycles of the reactor using an inert gas. The temperature of the particles does not exceed 35 ℃. This results in a pharmaceutical composition comprising a drug-containing core surrounded by one or more metal oxide materials.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating oligospermia by activating Nrf2/HO-1/GPx4 pathway and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for treating asthenospermia by activating Nrf2/HO-1/GPx4 pathway and application thereof. The pharmaceutical composition comprises taurine and geraniin as active ingredients, wherein the mass ratio of the taurine to the geraniin is 3-5:1. The pharmaceutical composition provided by the invention can synergistically activate Nrf2/HO-1/GPx4 antioxidant signal channels, up-regulate the expression of downstream antioxidant enzymes GPx4 and HO-1, inhibit lipid peroxidation, protect sperm mitochondrial function, and improve microenvironment metabolic spectrum of a sperm maturation site-epididymis, thereby improving sperm motility. The pharmaceutical composition provided by the invention can be used for preparing medicines for treating asthenospermia, especially for treating oxidative stress induced asthenospermia.

title_en: Jet microneedle fluid delivery device, composition for local administration of tumor, pharmaceutical and mechanical combination product and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a jet microneedle delivery device capable of realizing controllable initial dispersion and precise targeted drug delivery, a composition for tumor local injection, a pharmaceutical and mechanical combination product and application in preparation of drugs for tumor local injection drug delivery. The jet microneedle delivery device uses a conventional needleless jet injection power source in combination with one or more microneedles to achieve diffuse and precise delivery. The composition comprises a boron compound pharmaceutical ingredient, an immunoadjuvant and a pharmaceutical carrier. The jet microneedle delivery device with special design can realize local administration of boron compound radiotherapy drugs to the tumor, so that the problems that the drugs are difficult to reach the inside and the surface of the tumor during traditional intravenous administration and the highest dosage and the therapeutic effect of the drugs are limited due to systemic toxicity or overdose radioactivity are avoided. The high-concentration local administration of the composition not only improves the local treatment effect of tumors, but also can effectively generate tumor specific antibodies with the assistance of an immunoadjuvant through the neoantigen generated in the treatment process.

title_en: Application of pharmaceutical composition with GL-V9 and chemotherapeutic drugs as active ingredients in treatment of tumor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a pharmaceutical composition taking GL-V9 and a chemotherapeutic drug as active ingredients in treating tumors, wherein when the GL-V9 and the classical chemotherapeutic drug are combined to treat the tumors, a drug synergistic effect can be obviously achieved, and the effect of the pharmaceutical composition is obviously superior to the combination of the similar drugs and the chemotherapeutic drugs. These chemotherapeutic agents include capecitabine and tumor types include leukemia, colorectal cancer and lung cancer.

title_en: Medicine for promoting wound healing and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medicament for promoting wound healing and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the medicament comprises the following steps of S1, taking shells or minerals Dan Xijing of shellfish, sun-drying, placing the shells or minerals into a calciner to be calcined until the shells or minerals are crisp, grinding and sieving to obtain fine powder, S2, adding the fine powder prepared by S1 into water, stirring, standing, filtering to obtain filtrate, and filling. The novel pharmaceutical dosage form provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and easily available preparation raw materials and simple preparation process, and meanwhile, the obtained pharmaceutical can have the remarkable effect of promoting wound healing, is suitable for different types of wounds, and has a wide application range.

title_en: Irinotecan Kang Oulian polypeptide compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an irinotecan Kang Oulian polypeptide compound, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The irinotecan (Dxd) is taken as the active ingredient of the medicine, belongs to topoisomerase I inhibitor-camptothecin derivative, is a semisynthetic micromolecule chemotherapeutic medicine, and can directly kill cancer cells in the active division period and inhibit the growth of tumors. TYLCTACDYTHH is a high-efficiency PDPN targeting peptide capable of effectively targeting PDPN sites in human glioblastoma. In vitro and in vivo experimental results show that the coupling compound can obviously inhibit proliferation of primary glioblastoma cells, effectively inhibit growth of intracranial in-situ transplantation tumor of NOD-SCID mice, and show good anti-tumor activity. The compound is expected to be used for targeted therapy of glioblastoma, and has an application prospect of potentially prolonging the life cycle of a patient.

title_en: Aptamer for recognizing and binding CD64 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer for recognizing and combining CD64 protein and application thereof. The invention provides each aptamer and mutants thereof, and the aptamer has high affinity, no immunogenicity, can be chemically synthesized in vitro, has small molecular weight, can modify and replace different parts, has stable sequence, is easy to store, is convenient to mark (no secondary antibody to be marked), and the like. When the aptamer disclosed by the invention is used for detecting CD64 protein, the operation is simple and rapid, the affinity is strong, the synthesis cost of the aptamer is lower than that of the antibody preparation cost, the period is short, and the reproducibility is good. The invention can be used in a plurality of fields such as disease diagnosis and treatment, drug screening, molecular recognition, analysis and detection and the like.

title_en: 4-Oxo quinoline derivative with iron death inhibiting activity and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 4-oxo quinoline derivative with iron death inhibiting activity, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The invention provides a compound shown in a general formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, isomers, polymorphs and pharmaceutically acceptable solvates thereof, which have the effect of inhibiting iron death, further treat and/or prevent kidney fibrosis and provide a new scheme for treating and/or preventing kidney fibrosis. The invention provides application of a compound shown in a general formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, isomers, polymorphs and pharmaceutically acceptable solvates thereof in preparing an iron death inhibitor and application of the compound shown in the general formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, isomers, polymorphs and pharmaceutically acceptable solvates thereof in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing renal fibrosis, and expands application fields of the compound shown in the general formula I or pharmaceutically acceptable salts, isomers, polymorphs and pharmaceutically acceptable solvates thereof.

title_en: Synthesis method of dihydrochalcone compound and application of dihydrochalcone compound in antibacterial activity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthesis method of dihydrochalcone compounds and an antibacterial activity research thereof. Takes chalcone and 1,3, 4-thiadiazole-2-mercaptan as raw materials, and synthesizes a series of dihydrochalcone derivative compounds through 1, 4-addition reaction. The synthesis method has clear steps and relatively mild reaction conditions, and is suitable for constructing different substituted structures. The obtained compound is subjected to in-vitro antibacterial activity test, and the result shows that the compound has an inhibitory effect on various bacteria, and particularly has a certain inhibitory effect on the growth of escherichia coli, white hairknot bacteria and vibrio parahaemolyticus. The compound synthesis method and the antibacterial activity research result provided by the invention provide a technical approach for the design and further research of antibacterial compounds.

title_en: C8-polysaccharide-modified tetracycline compound and biosynthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of synthetic biology, and discloses a tetracycline compound modified by a C8 polysaccharide group, and a biosynthesis method and application thereof. The tetracycline compound with the polysaccharide group modified at the C8 position provided by the invention has a novel structure, and trisaccharyl and hexaglycosyl modified groups existing at the C8 position are not found in known tetracycline natural products and tetracycline skeleton antibiotics. The biosynthesis method is to express ech gene clusters derived from Streptomyces roseosporus in a Streptomyces milbeus host containing a mis gene cluster, fully utilize different biosynthetic enzymes contained in two similar but different tetracycline natural product biosynthesis gene clusters, synthesize a novel compound which cannot be synthesized by both host bacteria, and have remarkable inhibitory activity on staphylococcus aureus, enterococcus faecalis and enterococcus faecium. The invention provides a new alternative compound for the innovative development of the tetracycline skeleton antibacterial drugs, and has important significance for the development of microbial drug resources.

title_en: Neutral rhizoma polygonati polysaccharide with oxidation resistance and aging resistance, and purification method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antioxidant and anti-aging neutral Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide and a purification method and application thereof, belonging to the field of traditional Chinese medicine purification. The method comprises the steps of crushing rhizoma polygonati, performing ultrasonic water extraction, performing fractional alcohol precipitation, enzymolysis and extraction on an obtained rhizoma polygonati water extract to obtain rhizoma polygonati crude polysaccharide, purifying the rhizoma polygonati crude polysaccharide sequentially through an anion exchange column and a sephadex column, wherein fractional alcohol precipitation is to perform stepwise alcohol precipitation on concentrated solution in a mode of improving the concentration of ethanol through at least two gradients, solid-liquid separation is performed after each stage of alcohol precipitation, supernatant obtained after each solid-liquid separation is collected except the last stage of alcohol precipitation and used for the next stage of alcohol precipitation, precipitate obtained after the solid-liquid separation is collected after the last stage of alcohol precipitation, and the concentration of the last stage of alcohol precipitation is 75-85%. The neutral Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide obtained by the purification method has the advantages of small molecular weight, high antioxidant activity and anti-aging activity, high purity, good water solubility and the like, and has great application potential in the fields of health care products, medicines and the like.

title_en: Ophthalmic composition, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ophthalmic medicines, in particular to an ophthalmic composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the ophthalmic composition comprises a compound shown in a formula I, an osmotic pressure regulator, a pH regulator and water for injection, the pH value of the ophthalmic composition is 4.0-6.0, the concentration of a formula II in the compound shown in the formula I is 0.1-3.0% w/v, the concentration of the osmotic pressure regulator is 0.3-10.0% w/v, and the ophthalmic composition has strong antibacterial activity on streptococcus pneumoniae, staphylococcus aureus and staphylococcus epidermidis and is 2-8 times that of levofloxacin and moxifloxacin hydrochloride. The composition also has strong antibacterial activity to haemophilus influenzae, moraxella catarrhalis, escherichia coli and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and is equivalent to levofloxacin and moxifloxacin hydrochloride. The irritation is small, the light stability and the high temperature stability are good, the quality and the medication safety are ensured, and the application value is good.

title_en: Antigen engineering modified nano vesicle vaccine, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses AN antigen engineering modified nano vesicle vaccine (AN-FV) and a preparation method and application thereof. The vaccine is formed by fusing tumor cell membrane vesicles obtained through pretreatment of a functional nano preparation with mature dendritic cell membrane vesicles, wherein the functional nano preparation comprises autophagy inhibition siRNA and an immunogenicity enhancer, and can synergistically promote tumor cell MHC-I expression and antigen immunogenicity. The vaccine of the invention presents high-density MHC-I-antigen peptide complex and CD80/CD86 costimulatory molecules on the surface of single particles simultaneously, simulates immune synapses on the nanometer scale, thereby efficiently activating tumor-specific T cells. The vaccine integrates antigen source engineering, co-stimulation signal generation and nano platform integration, and provides a new scheme for overcoming the treatment bottleneck of immune 'cold' tumors such as pancreatic cancer and the like.

title_en: Oral preparation containing pyridine phenyl compounds, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: An oral preparation comprises a chemical component of a pyridine phenyl compound and a pharmaceutical adjuvant, wherein the active component of the pyridine phenyl compound comprises a compound of a formula (II), a crystal form or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The oral preparation can be used for treating chronic cough, asthma and alcoholic liver disease. The oral preparation has the advantages of rapid dissolution, good stability, simple preparation process, and suitability for industrial mass production.

title_en: Application of molluscum Oscillospira in preparation of anti-aging preparation and anti-aging preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biology, in particular to application of molluscum Oscillospira in preparation of an anti-aging preparation and the anti-aging preparation. The anti-aging formulation includes an effective amount of molluscum Oscillospira and an acceptable carrier. The invention verifies that the long-term supplementation of the molluscum Oscillospira can effectively improve the behavioral change and the metabolite change caused by aging and maintain the ecological stability of intestinal tracts, thereby achieving the purpose of delaying the aging of organisms. The invention has great application potential in the development of food, health care and biopharmaceutical products.

title_en: Magnetic formulations for biomarker sampling and enhanced drug delivery
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes formulations, methods, and devices for biomarker sampling and therapeutic delivery using magnetic formulations. When combined with the application of an external magnetic field, the magnetic formulation moves within the nasal cavity. The magnetic formulation provides benefits including the ability to target or direct placement of the formulation via a magnetic field, enhance mixing of the formulation via a magnetic field, enhance collection of biological material via antibody coated magnetic beads, or enhance sample retrieval via a magnetic tipped inserter. Exemplary biological materials for collection include proteins, enzymes, neural stem cells, and other biomarkers.

title_en: Lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber composition for reducing blood lipid and regulating intestinal flora structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of health care medicines, and discloses a lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber composition for reducing blood fat and regulating intestinal flora structure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein insoluble dietary fiber in lotus root residue is separated by adopting an enzymolysis method, and the insoluble dietary fiber composition is formed by mixing the insoluble dietary fiber with puerarin and xylooligosaccharide in proportion; the lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber composition and the lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber are respectively matched with high-fat feed to feed rats, and the lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber composition and the lotus root residue insoluble dietary fiber can be used for relieving obesity symptoms of the rats, regulating intestinal flora structures of the rats, maintaining intestinal health of the rats, reducing fat pathological changes of the rats and having obvious effects of reducing blood fat and regulating intestinal flora structures.

title_en: Lactobacillus mucilaginosus and application thereof in preparation of product for preventing and treating fluorosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus reuteri and application thereof in preparing medicaments for preventing and treating fluorosis, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms and application. Is named as T5-3, and is preserved in China center for type culture Collection (CCTC), the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M20251964, and the preservation date is 2025, 9 and 3. The strain can obviously relieve the dental fluorosis symptom, reduce the level of fluorine bones, reduce the dental fluorosis score of SD rats, and also has outstanding expression in reducing the level of inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha, IL-beta and TL-6) in the colon, increasing the length of the colon and increasing the mRNA expression level of colon tissue barrier function genes (ZO-1 and Occludin, mucin 2). Provides a research thought for the treatment of local fluorous poisoning people.

title_en: Preparation method and application of lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate, wherein modified sodium alginate is used as a carrier of immobilized lactobacillus in the preparation method of the lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate. The modified sodium alginate has a space network structure with through pore channels and high specific surface area, can greatly improve the structural stability, the pore channel utilization rate and the biocompatibility of the carrier, and provides ideal microenvironment for adsorption, loading and growth of lactobacillus. The modified sodium alginate is used as a carrier to carry out immobilization treatment on activated lactobacillus, so that the tolerance and fermentation stability of the lactobacillus can be effectively improved, the strain loss is avoided, the fermentation efficiency is improved, the active ingredients of the filtrate of the lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product are more sufficient, the effects of inhibiting inflammatory cell aggregation and relieving skin sensitivity and discomfort of the skin care product composition are obviously enhanced, and the problems of weak efficacy and poor stability of the fermentation filtrate in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of endothelial targeting peptide modified extracellular vesicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an endothelial targeting peptide modified extracellular vesicle, which are used for solving the problems of poor targeting, unstable therapeutic molecules and limited curative effect in the prior art, realizing diabetes wound enrichment, efficient angiogenesis promotion and sustained release, and remarkably accelerating diabetes wound healing. Specifically, the preparation method comprises the steps of culturing mesenchymal stem cells, separating and purifying extracellular vesicles of the mesenchymal stem cells, loading drugs on the extracellular vesicles, modifying the extracellular vesicles by VHP peptide and compounding hydrogel carriers, and finally obtaining the endothelial targeting peptide modified extracellular vesicles. Can be used in wound dressing or medicine for treating chronic wound caused by diabetes.

title_en: Growth hormone nasal preparation convenient for administration and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a growth hormone nasal preparation convenient for administration, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines, wherein the growth hormone nasal preparation comprises a lipid phase and a water phase in a specific ratio, and a liposome technology is combined with a nasal spray technology, so that spray can be formed through a nasal device to act on nasal mucosa for treating growth hormone deficiency. The scheme not only improves the stability of the product containing the recombinant human growth hormone, prolongs the release time of the recombinant human growth hormone in the body, is suitable for long-term administration, but also realizes convenient and rapid administration by a non-invasive administration route, reduces the pain and psychological stress of patients, improves the use compliance of the patients, is beneficial to clinical use, reduces adverse reactions of gastrointestinal tracts of medicines, and improves the bioavailability and the safety of the medicines.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly discloses a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof. The pharmaceutical composition comprises an active ingredient and an emulsifier, wherein the active ingredient consists of eucalyptol, limonene and alpha-pinene, the emulsifier is a composite emulsifier and comprises at least two emulsifier types, and the weight ratio of the active ingredient to the emulsifier is 1 (0.8-1.5). The pharmaceutical composition has the characteristics of self-emulsification, short dispersion time, emulsion droplet particle size reaching the nanometer level, remarkable improvement of bioavailability, shortened peak reaching time, good stability, simple prescription composition and easy production and quality control. Is suitable for relieving cough, diminishing inflammation, eliminating phlegm, promoting contrast agent discharge or treating respiratory diseases such as sinusitis, bronchitis, pneumonia, etc.

title_en: Zinc-doped cerium oxide drug-loaded nano enzyme platform and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc-doped cerium oxide drug-loaded nano-enzyme platform and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical nano-materials. The invention constructs a nano enzyme platform with a continuous functional interface by a specific preparation method, wherein zinc doped cerium oxide is used as an antioxidation core, a phenylboronic acid modification layer is used as an ocular surface adhesion interface, a mitochondrial fission inhibitor is used as a mitochondrial fission regulating drug, and finally, the multi-level cooperative treatment of 'ocular surface long-acting residence-ROS rapid removal-endogenous antioxidation enhancement-mitochondrial fission inhibition-mtDNA leakage reduction-inflammation corpuscle and pyrosis blocking' is realized. The design can more comprehensively interfere with key pathological links of dry eye, and is suitable for constructing an ocular surface administration preparation for treating dry eye.

title_en: Microneedle drug delivery device special for scalp and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of application of soluble microneedles, in particular to a microneedle drug delivery device special for scalp and application thereof, comprising a handle part and a roller, wherein the roller is fixedly arranged or rotatably arranged on the handle part, a plurality of annular seats which are arranged at intervals are arranged on the roller in a penetrating way along the axial direction of the roller, hair storage gaps are reserved between adjacent annular seats, a tubular soluble microneedle patch is arranged on the peripheral wall of each annular seat, the soluble microneedle patch comprises a tubular base plate and a needle point array, the needle point array is integrally formed on the peripheral wall of the tubular base plate, and when the roller drives the soluble microneedle patch to be attached to the scalp and roll, the hair storage gaps allow hairs to enter the hair storage gaps, and the needle point array penetrates the scalp. The special scalp microneedle drug delivery device has the advantages of reasonable structural design, larger carried microneedle area and better applicability, and is beneficial to auxiliary drug delivery for patients suffering from alopecia.

title_en: Memory improving medicine and food homologous product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a memory improving medicine and food homologous product and application thereof, wherein the medicine and food homologous product contains traditional Chinese medicine raw materials, the traditional Chinese medicine raw materials comprise fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae, lily and lotus leaf, or comprise fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae extract, lily extract and lotus leaf extract. The invention effectively improves the spatial memory and the memory identification capability of rats by regulating key targets such as JUN, FOS, SRC, TP, ESR1 and the like to interfere with a memory decline related path, reduces the morphological structure damage of neurons in a CA1 region of a hippocampus, increases the number of neurons and Nishi corpuscles and up regulates the expression of neurotrophic factors, and a human test feeding test proves that the product can improve the scores of memory quotient, montreal cognitive evaluation scale and psychoelastic scale of a crowd with memory decline, reduce the scores of the Hanmiltonian anxiety scale and the fatigue evaluation scale, and relieve the traditional Chinese medicine core symptoms such as memory, forgetfulness, listlessness and the like, and can be used for improving the memory.

title_en: Biocompatible compositions comprising heterogeneous cellular elements
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of biocompatible compositions, in particular injectable biocompatible compositions. In particular, the invention relates to a specific biocompatible composition comprising a solution and heterogeneous cellular elements suspended in said solution, selected from the group consisting of isolated cells, cell micro-tissues, cell clusters and mixtures thereof, at least two of said cellular elements having different densities and/or sizes and/or cell numbers.

title_en: Polypeptide and application thereof in preparation of medicines for treating fatty liver diseases related to metabolic dysfunction
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide, the amino acid sequence of which is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. Specifically, the sequence of the polypeptide is DQEGQDVLLFIDNIFR. The invention also provides a DNA molecule for encoding the polypeptide. The invention also provides a recombinant vector containing the DNA molecule. The invention also provides application of the polypeptide in preparing a medicament for treating fatty liver diseases related to metabolic dysfunction. The invention also provides a pharmaceutical composition, the active ingredient of which is the polypeptide. The polypeptide provided by the invention is used as an endogenous exercise factor, can obviously reduce liver lipid accumulation and liver inflammation, and provides a pharmacological alternative scheme for MASLD patients who cannot perform regular exercise due to body limitation.

title_en: Novel anti-MYCT human antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to anti-MYCT human antibodies and uses thereof.

title_en: Preparation method of polyphenol-mediated self-powered hydrogel for exosome delivery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyphenol-mediated self-powered hydrogel delivered by exosomes, which comprises the steps of respectively dissolving oxidized hyaluronic acid OHA and adipic dihydrazide modified hyaluronic acid Ha-aDH in PBS buffer solution to prepare hydrogel precursor liquid, adding tannic acid obtained by prepolymerization under the condition of NaOH into a precursor system, dispersing nano zinc into one of the precursor liquid to serve as a negative electrode active component, adding ZnHCF, carbon nanotube CNT and milk-derived exosomes into the other precursor liquid to serve as positive electrode functional components, fully mixing to form a uniform system, then utilizing Schiff base reaction between the OHA and the Ha-aDH to realize in-situ crosslinking under the mild condition, and finally constructing an integrated hydrogel battery system. The hydrogel prepared by the invention has good biocompatibility and tissue adhesiveness, and has the comprehensive properties of anti-inflammatory, antioxidation, collagen regeneration promotion, mild electric regulation and the like.

title_en: Azepino [4,3-b ] indole derivative, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an azepino [4,3-b ] indole derivative, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the derivative is a 4-trifluoromethoxy substituted azepino [4,3-b ] indole compound with a brand new structure, the compound is synthesized through condensation reaction and photocatalysis trifluoromethylation reaction, and concretely comprises the steps of condensing 1-methyl-3-carboxylic acid indole with an intermediate to obtain an amide precursor, and introducing trifluoromethoxy through blue light irradiation in the presence of a photosensitizer and copper trifluoromethane sulfonate. In vitro cell experiments show that the IC  50  value of the compound on the MDA-MB-231 of the triple negative breast cancer cells is 3.12+/-0.89 mu M, and the compound can obviously up-regulate the Bax/Bcl-2 protein ratio and induce apoptosis of tumor cells. The compound provided by the invention has the advantages of simple synthetic route and novel structure, and has good potential for developing anti-triple negative breast cancer drugs.

title_en: Chimeric antigen receptor, humanized estrogen receptor alpha mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chimeric antigen receptor, a humanized estrogen receptor alpha mutant and application thereof. The chimeric antigen receptor comprises an extracellular domain, a transmembrane domain, and an intracellular domain, wherein the intracellular domain comprises a drug controllable phase-separated protein element, wherein the drug controllable phase-separated protein element comprises a human estrogen receptor alpha mutant, wherein the human estrogen receptor alpha mutant has no activity in response to endogenous estrogen, and wherein the drug controllable phase-separated protein element undergoes liquid-liquid phase separation in the presence of a selective estrogen receptor degrading agent. The chimeric antigen receptor which can be induced to generate phase separation by the small molecule drug is constructed for the first time. The proliferation potential and antigen sensitivity of CD19 IPHASE CAR-T cells or GPC3 IPHASE CAR-T cells are obviously enhanced after the specific small molecular medicine is added for induction, and finally the purpose of enhancing the anti-tumor effect is achieved.

title_en: Tablet with cross V-shaped structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tablet with alternately V font, tablet (1) is the rectangle, and the surface respectively has four nicks (2) about tablet (1) to two setpoint (3) of rectangle inside are the benchmark, form nick (2) to the angular form of the rectangle far away from the setpoint respectively, and every setpoint (3) are carved out two nicks (2), the position of setpoint (3) is: the tablet is novel in structure, has a crossed V-shaped structure, is convenient for splitting the tablet, and is beneficial to fixing the tablet in transportation due to the nicks and the hollow structure of the tablet; especially, the hollow structure can be added with other active ingredients according to actual needs, and has important application value.

title_en: 4-pyrazin-2-ylmethyl-morpholine derivatives and the use thereof as medicament
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel 4-pyrazin-2-ylmethyl-morpholines of general formula A, processes for their preparation, pharmaceutical compositions containing them and their use in therapy, particularly in the treatment or prevention of conditions having an asso- ciation with NR2B negative allosteric modulating properties.

title_en: Unsaturated oligosaccharides, method of their preparation and their use
abstract_en: Oligosaccharides of formula I consist of alternating glucose and N-acetylglucosamine units with double bond in position 4 of terminal non-reducing saccharide (glucose) and with primary hydroxyl group in position 1 of N-acetylglucosamine on the reducing end. The method of preparation is based on enzymatic or chemical splitting of polymer hyaluronic acid and/or its esters and subsequent reduction of esters of oligosaccharides with sodium borohydride. The materials containing oligosaccharides of formula I show an increased resistance to enzymatic degradation (bovine testicular hyaluronidase, Streptococcus pneumoniae hyaluronan lyase), and also a selective negative effect on viability of certain lines of cancer cells.

title_en: Vaccine for inducing an immune response against hbv
abstract_en: Provided herein are nucleotide sequences encoding a new consensus amino acid sequence of a hepatitis B virus (HBV) core protein, as well as genetic constructs/vectors and vaccines that express said protein sequences. Also provided herein are methods of inducing an immune response against HBV using the provided nucleotide sequences.

title_en: Somatostatin-dopamine chimeric analogs
abstract_en: The invention relates to novel somatostatin-dopamine chimeric analogs, pharmaceutical compositions thereof for the treatment of neuroendocrine tumor and a method of treating neuroendocrine tumor in an individual.

title_en: Compositions comprising fucoxanthin and use thereof in reduction of fat accumulation in cells
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to compositions comprising microalgae extracts comprising fucoxanthin. Further provided are compositions and methods for reducing lipid accumulation in cells. Also provided are methods for prevention or treatment of metabolic syndrome, including but not limited to a fatty liver disease, or a fatty kidney disease.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating cancer, comprising a vascular disrupting agent and taxane compound
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition for preventing or treating cancer, comprising (S)-N-(4-(3-(1H-1,2,4-triazole-1-yl)-4-(3,4,5-trimethoxybenzoyl)phenyl)thiazole-2-yl)-2-amino-3-methylbutanamide or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof and taxane compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The composition of the present invention shows an excellent effect of cancer treatment.

title_en: Methods and compounds for the treatment of genetic disease
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to compounds and methods for modulating the expression of  dmpk, atxnl, atxn2, atxn.3, cacnala, atxn7, ppp2r2br tbp, htt, jph3r ar , or  atnl  and treating diseases and conditions in which  dmpk, atxnl, atxn2, atxn3, cacnala, atxnl, ppp2r2b, tbp, htt, jph3, ar , or  atnl  plays an active role. The compound can be a transcription modulator molecule having a first terminus, a second terminus, and oligomeric backbone, wherein: a) the first terminus comprises a DNA-binding moiety capable of noncovalently binding to a nucleotide repeat sequence CAG or CTG; b) the second terminus comprises a protein-binding moiety binding to a regulatory molecule that modulates an expression of a gene comprising the nucleotide repeat sequence CAG or CTG; and c) the oligomeric backbone comprising a linker between the first terminus and the second terminus.

title_en: Process for making cell populations of the hepatic lineage from endodermal cells and cellular compositions comprising same
abstract_en: The present disclosure concerns processes as well as additives for differentiating an endodermal cells into a posterior foregut cell, a posterior foregut cell into an hepatic progenitor cell and/or an hepatic progenitor cell into an hepatocyte-like cell. In some embodiments, the process can be conducted in the absence of serum. The hepatocyte-like cell population obtained from this process have a detectable Cyp3A4 activity and/or express a detectable level of albumin and/or of urea. The process can be designed to increase cellular yield.

title_en: Therapeutic uses of glucokinase activators in combination with insulin or insulin analogs
abstract_en: Methods of using glucokinase (GK) activators are generally disclosed herein, particularly in combination with insulin or insulin analogs. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides methods of treating type 1 diabetes that include administering a GK activator in combination with insulin or insulin analogs. Uses of GK activators as a medicament are also disclosed herein, as well as the manufacture of a medicament for such uses.

title_en: Treatment of cancers using pi3 kinase isoform modulators
abstract_en: Provided herein is a PI3K inhibitor, alone or in combination with one or more other therapeutic agents, for use in treating or managing indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (iNHL) in a subject that is, or is identified as, relapsed or refractory to a prior treatment with rituximab and the iNHL is refractory to chemotherapy or radioimmunotherapy (RIP), wherein the PI3K inhibitor is Compound 292 or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, a hydrate or a solvate thereof. Furthermore the application relates to a PI3K inhibitor, alone or in combination with one or more other therapeutic agents, for use in treating or managing cancer or hematologic malignancy in a subject who developed resistance to a prior treatment, wherein the PI3K inhibitor is Compound 292, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, a hydrate or a solvate thereof, and wherein the prior treatment is a treatment with one or more BTK inhibitors, anti-CD20 antibodies, proteasome inhibitors, or alkylating agents.

title_en: Ire1 kinase inhibitors and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are, inter alia, compounds modulating Inositol-Requiring Enzyme 1α (IRE1α) and IRE1β activity and methods of use thereof for treating IRE1α-mediated and IRE1β-mediated disorders.

title_en: Therapeutic uses of glucagon and combined product comprising same
abstract_en: Provided are a combination including glucagon and a compound or substance with therapeutic activity against a metabolic syndrome and a use thereof.

title_en: Nanostructured lipid gel, method for preparation and use
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nanostructured lipid gel formed by alternating layers and vesicles composed of phospholipids, fatty acids and a high water content. The structure and fluidity respond reversibly to temperature and pH, and they are capable of transporting at least one active ingredient within the skin and also to the follicles. The exclusively lipid composition ensures high biocompatibility, and the rheological behaviour facilitates topical and ocular application.

title_en: Bioactive phytochemicals in zizyphus and guarana
abstract_en: Described are compositions comprising selected isolated 4-hydroxymethyl-prolines, or pharmaceutically acceptable salts or derivatives thereof. Also described are novel 4- hydroxymethyl-N-methyl-prolines, together with processes for their preparation, compositions containing them, as well as their use as medicaments and pharmaceuticals. Also described are processes for producing a herbal medicine comprising the step of monitoring the quality of said herbal medicine by detecting the presence or absence or measuring the amount of one or more 4-hydroxymethyl-N-methyl-prolines in a sample of said herbal medicine.

title_en: Heterocyclyl polymethine ir chromophores
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides NIR- and SWIR-active small molecule polymethine dyes with improved properties for use in optical imaging, photothermal therapy, and photodynamic therapy.

title_en: Organic compounds
abstract_en: The invention relates to particular substituted heterocycle fused gamma-carbolines, in free, solid, pharmaceutically acceptable salt and/or substantially pure form as described herein, pharmaceutical compositions thereof, and methods of use in the treatment of diseases involving the 5-HT 2A  receptor, the serotonin transporter (SERT), pathways involving the dopamine D 1  and D 2  receptor signaling system, and/or the μ-opioid receptor.

title_en: Bicyclic peptide ligands specific for cd38
abstract_en: The present invention relates to polypeptides which are covalently bound to aromatic molecular scaffolds such that two or more peptide loops are subtended between attachment points to the scaffold. In particular, the invention describes peptides which are high affinity binders of CD38.The invention also includes drug conjugates comprising said peptides, conjugated to one or more effector and/or functional groups, to pharmaceutical compositions comprising said peptide ligands and drug conjugates and to the use of said peptide ligands and drug conjugates in preventing, suppressing or treating a disease or disorder mediated by CD38.

title_en: Kit for stimulating hair growth and restoring scalp balance by a cosmetic trichological protocol
abstract_en: A kit for stimulating hair growth and restoring scalp balance by a cosmetic trichological protocol, characterized in that it comprises at least a first and a second single dose composition comprising zinc PCA, caffeine, panthenol and camphor and support apparatus (1) having first diodes (3) configured to emit infra-red light and second diodes (2) configured to emit light in the visible field, wherein said apparatus (1) has a controller configured to actively select said first diodes (3) and said second diodes (2) and wherein said first single dose composition further comprises at least urtica dioica and Tussilago Farfara leaves, and said second single dose composition further comprises at least hydrolized wheat proteins, serenoa repens fruit extracts and calamus aromaticus root extracts.

title_en: Methods for making mixed allergen compositions
abstract_en: Methods of making mixed allergen products are provided, wherein the mixed allergen products are substantially free of replication viable organisms.

title_en: Dosing regimens for anti-tf-antibody drug-conjugates
abstract_en: Anti-TF antibody drug conjugate and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the antibody drugconjugate for use in the treatment of a solid cancer comprising administering to a subject a weekly dose of from about 0.8 mg/kg to about 1.8 mg/kg of an anti-TF antibody drug conjugate once a week for three consecutive weeks followed by a one week resting period without any administration of anti-TF ADC so that each cycle time is 28 days including the resting period.

title_en: Method for producing microcapsules
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing microcapsules, in particular isocyanate-based microcapsules with improved stability with respect to carboxylic acid- and aldehyde-containing active substances as the core material. The invention additionally relates to microcapsules which can be obtained using the method according to the invention, to microcapsules, to suspensions of such microcapsules, and to the use of the microcapsules and suspensions as components of detergents, fabric softeners, cleaning agents, scent boosters in liquid or solid form, cosmetics, body care products, agricultural products, or pharmaceutical products.

title_en: Device assembly for producing bioconjugates
abstract_en: A device assembly (10) for producing bioconjugates, in particular antibody-drug conjugates, comprises a conjugation unit for performing a bioconjugation reaction in a medium, a first filtration unit for separating precipitates and/or agglomerates, and a second filtration unit for performing an ultrafiltration and/or a diafiltration process. The first filtration unit is arranged in a flow path between the conjugation unit and the second filtration unit. The device assembly (10) further comprises a single control unit (28) for controlling the transfer of medium from the conjugation unit through the first filtration unit to the second filtration unit and for controlling the ultrafiltration and/or diafiltration process.

title_en: Method of sialylating a protein
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of increasing the number of α2,3,-α2,6-disialylgalactose  N -glycans on a glycoprotein by incubating an α2,3-sialylated glycoprotein with an α2,6-sialyltransferase and a sialic acid source. Also provided is a recombinant glycoprotein comprising at least one α2,3,-α2,6-disialylgalactose  N -glycan. In a particular embodiment, the recombinant glycoprotein is alpha-1 antitrypsin (AAT).

title_en: Compositions and methods for potentiating derivatives of 4-aminophenols
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treating paracetamol amenable conditions, such as pain and fever. The pharmaceutical compositions comprise certain combinations of derivatives of 4-Aminophenols and N-acylethanolamines. Also disclosed are methods and kits for treating or minimizing paracetamol amenable conditions.

title_en: Methods for treating neurodegenerative disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of treating Lewy body dementia, multi-system atrophy or pure autonomic failure in a subject in need thereof. Also provided are compositions for treating Lewy body dementia, multi-system atrophy or pure autonomic failure.

title_en: Cll-1 targeted immunotherapies
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides improved CLL-1 targeting polypeptides and compositions for adoptive T cell therapies for treating, preventing, or ameliorating at least one symptom of a cancer, infectious disease, autoimmune disease, inflammatory disease, and immunodeficiency, or condition associated therewith.

title_en: Method to treat type 2 inflammation or mast-cell dependent disease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the treatment of type 2 inflammation or mast-cell dependent disease. The inventors showed that, when exposed to domestic allergic alarms, activation of TRPV1+Tac1+ nociceptor-MRGPRB2+ MC sensory clusters might represent a key early event controlling the development of frequent mast cell-dependent allergic disorders. The human ortholog of MRGPRB2 (MRGPRX2) can thus be a good target to treat type 2 inflammation or mast cell-dependent disorders. Thus, the present relates to a MRGPRX2 inhibitor for use in the treatment of a type 2 inflammation or mast cell-dependent disorders in a subject in need thereof.

title_en: Powder preparation for transnasal administration and method for producing same
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a powder formulation for intranasal administration, which efficiently exhibits a medicinal effect, and the like. The object can be achieved by a powder formulation for intranasal administration comprising composite particles in which an active ingredient and a water-insoluble polysaccharide are cohered to each other.

title_en: Antigen specific immunotherapy for covid-19 fusion proteins and methods of use
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides recombinantly manufactured fusion proteins comprising a SARS-CoV-2 Receptor Binding Domain (SARS-CoV-2-RBD) fragment or an analog thereof linked to a human Fc fragment for use in relation to the 2019 Novel Coronavirus (CQVID-19).
