title_en: Phosphonate prodrugs and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are prodrugs of a nucleoside, a nucleotide, or a nucleobase, or an analog thereof, wherein said prodrug is a compound of formula I: or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, nanoparticles comprising said compound, pharmaceutical compositions comprising said compound or nanoparticle, and methods of use thereof.

title_en: Treatment of a non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
abstract_en: Described are methods of treatment of a non-alcoholic fatty liver disease via a reduction in HSD17B13 expression in humans in need of treatment.

title_en: Green method for obtaining isothiocyanates from cruciferous vegetables
abstract_en: The presently disclosure relates to a method of obtaining isothiocyanates (ITC) from frozen cruciferous vegetables using microwave gravity hydrodiffusion (MHG) technique, a solvent-free extraction technique. The advantages of this method are obtaining two liquid fractions (PLF + WLF) that can be used in different applications and a solid fraction (plant biomass) that can be reused, contributing to the preservation of biodiversity.

title_en: Compounds for the treatment of human sarcopenia
abstract_en: There is provided a compound, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or a prodrug thereof for use in a method of treatment of human sarcopenia, wherein the compound is Mitapivat or TEPP46.

title_en: Injectable in situ cross-linked depots for ultra-long-term delivery of hydrophilic drugs
abstract_en: A therapeutic or diagnostic delivery system, and methods of making and using the same, are disclosed. The system is a solvent free, injectable, biodegradable, and in situ crosslinking depot (ISCD) platform for ultra-long-term release of hydrophilic drugs.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody 5e9 for recognizing human r9ap and use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure belongs to the technical field of antibody, and discloses a monoclonal antibody 5E9 recognizing human R9AP protein and use thereof. The monoclonal antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof has high affinity for R9AP protein and can significantly inhibit EBV infection of epithelial cells and B cells. The antibody can be used for detecting the presence or level of R9AP protein in a sample, detecting a disease caused by high expression of R9AP, and preventing EBV infection and/or treating and/or preventing a disease caused by EBV infection.

title_en: B-lactamase inhibitor antibody and use for the treatment and/or prevention of infections caused by bacteria that produce B-lactamases (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: B-lactamase inhibitory antibody and use for the treatment and/or prevention of infections caused by bacteria that produce B-lactamases. In the present invention, the present document relates to B-lactamase inhibitor antibodies, for example class A β-lactamase from Mycobacterium abscessus, as well as related compositions, uses thereof for and/or preventing infections caused by bacteria that produce β-lactamases.  (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: Attenuation system and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an attenuation system and the use thereof for attenuating plasmodia, specifically the use of an EF1g gene for attenuating plasmodia. The attenuation system regulates the expression or degradation of the EF1g gene by using a regulatory system, thereby controlling the growth of plasmodia and achieving the attenuation of plasmodia.

title_en: Adenomyosis associated infertility and HDACIs
abstract_en: A method of enhancing in vitro fertilization (IVF) in patients suffering with adenomyosis associated infertility by administration of a histone deacetylase inhibitors (HDACI) such as valproic acid (VPA). The method may comprise intralesional administration such as by use of a hysteroscope or transvaginal ultrasound guided needle within the uterus followed by oral administration of HDACI.

title_en: Vitamin A for use in the treatment of traumatic brain injury
abstract_en: Vitamin A, and compositions, combined preparations, and multiple-dose formulations comprising vitamin A, for use in the treatment of acute and chronic traumatic brain injury are described, as well as methods of treatment of such injury using vitamin A, or the compositions, combined preparations, or multiple-dose formulations.

title_en: Novel methods for manufacturing an adjuvant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for manufacturing an adjuvant comprising a saponin using a microfluidic device and to aspects thereof.

title_en: SYNTHESIS of INDAZOLES
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel method of preparing a 2-substituted indazole of structure: , to intermediate compounds, and to the use of intermediate compounds for the preparation of said 2-substituted indazole.

title_en: Treatments of prostate cancer with combinations of abiraterone acetate and niraparib
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a combination of abiraterone acetate and niraparib, free-dose and fixed-dose combinations of abiraterone acetate and niraparib, and methods of treatment of prostate cancer with said combinations.

title_en: Dna construct for stably producing empty capsids of the foot-and-mouth disease virus in mammalian cells; processes, uses, and compositions thereof
abstract_en: The present invention refers to methods and compositions for increasing the production of large amounts of empty capsids of the foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) in a stable manner in mammalian cells by regulating the expression of FMDV 3C protease. The instant methods and compositions are based on the fact that a decreased expression of 3C protease results in a reduced cell toxicity and an increased synthesis of viral capsid proteins, as well as production of recombinant empty capsids. The invention provides recombinant plasmids that direct the expression of P1, 3C, and the use of said plasmids for producing new stable cell lines capable of generating high titers of FMDV empty capsids. The invention provides methods for regulating the expression of the FMDV 3C protease gene at a transcriptional and translational level in order to achieve the required process level of 3C protease for the selection process, as well as the production process.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating systemic sclerosis

title_en: Culture medium composition for culturing urine-derived stem cells, method for dividing and culturing urine-derived stem cells by using same, Urine-derived stem cells having improved kidney diseases therapeutic potential and cell therapeutic composition comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a culture medium for isolating and culturing urine-derived stem cells, a method for separating and culturing urine-derived stem cells using the culture medium, urine-derived stem cells cultured in the culture medium, and a cell therapeutic composition comprising the same. Urine-derived stem cells according to the present invention exhibits an effect of improving renal function and tissue regeneration in an animal model of renal disease. The culture medium includes: a basic medium including Dulbecco's modified eagle's medium (DMEM) and Ham's F12; fetal bovine serum; and parathyroid hormone (PTH).

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating clostridioides difficile infection comprising combination of probiotics
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating Clostridioides difficile infection comprising a probiotic strain as an active component. The composition containing the probiotics strain of the present invention has an excellent effect of inhibiting the growth of Clostridioides difficile, suppresses a decrease in intestinal length in an animal model infected with Clostridioides difficile, and has an effect of improving the internal environment of the intestine. Therefore, the composition can be usefully used for the treatment or symptomatic alleviation of Clostridioides difficile infection-related diseases.

title_en: Microbiome composition of halophilic Bacillus velezensis KMU01 strain fermented culture supernatant with anti-obesity effect
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microbiome composition of a fermented culture supernatant of a halophilic Bacillus polyfermenticus KMU01 strain having anti-obesity efficacy. By confirming that the fermented culture supernatant of the strain deposited under the deposit number KCTC11751BP inhibits fat production and accumulation and reduces blood cholesterol content, it can be usefully utilized as a composition for preventing, treating or improving obesity; or a composition for reducing body fat (visceral fat) or blood cholesterol.

title_en: Composition for suppressing hair loss or promoting hair growth containing gpa peptide
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a composition for inhibiting hair loss or promoting hair growth comprising a gpa peptide. Specifically, the composition according to the present disclosure may effectively inhibit hair loss or promote hair growth by promoting or activating the growth or proliferation of dermal papilla cells.

title_en: The Composition For Obesity-Preventing, Improving, and Curing Composed of Amomum villosum and Atractylodes macrocephala Extracts
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition and health functional food which are produced by mixing Amomum villosum and Atractylodes macrocephala extracts in a ratio of 1 : 1 to 1 : 3, and are effective in weight loss, and liver and epididymal weight reduction.

title_en: Salt of Edoxaban and Pharmaceutical Composition Comprising the Same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel salt of edoxaban and a pharmaceutical composition comprising the same. A crystalline form I of edoxaban edisylate and edoxaban benzenesulfonate according to the present invention has excellent stability against heat and moisture, thereby being able to be usefully used in the manufacture of pharmaceutical preparations.

title_en: Composition for suppressing appetite or preventing or improving obesity comprising ascorbic acid or metabolites thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for suppressing appetite or preventing or alleviating obesity. According to ascorbic acid or a metabolite thereof according to an aspect, there is an effect of suppressing appetite or preventing or treating obesity by regulating an appetite-related neuropeptide, there is an effect of maximizing the effect of suppressing appetite or treating obesity when performed together with intermittent fasting.

title_en: The composition containing co-fermented ussuri pear extract for the prevention of anti-obesity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Pyrus ussuriensis extract. More specifically, the present invention discloses an anti-obesity pharmaceutical composition, functional food, or anti-obesity composition comprising a Pyrus ussuriensis extract as an active component. Preferably, the present invention disclose an anti-obesity composition containing a fermented Pyrus ussuriensis extract as an active component, which is obtained by fermenting lactic acid bacteria and Bacillus subtilis as strains.

title_en: Tablet Comprising Quisqualis Indica Extract as an Active Ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tablet containing a Combretum indicum extract, a natural medicine, as an active component. The present invention increases the content of the Combretum indicum extract relative to the total weight of the tablet to increase the convenience of taking, and achieves improved stability of the Combretum indicum extract and the disintegration of the tablet. The present invention is the tablet which contains the Combretum indicum extract and an excipient as active components, wherein the excipient contains citric acid and sodium bicarbonate as a disintegrant.

title_en: Methods for improving alcohol-based gastric inflammation and manufacturing of GABA-containing compounds using Pyrus Ussuriensis extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Pyrus ussuriensis extract. More specifically, the present invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition or a functional food composition for alleviating, preventing or treating alcohol-induced gastritis containing a Pyrus ussuriensis extract as an active component. In addition, the present invention discloses, in manufacturing the functional food composition containing the Pyrus ussuriensis extract as the active component, a complex fermentation method for enhancing a gamma-aminobutyric acid content.

title_en: TARS or its fragments from Akkermansia muciniphila and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to use of TARS (threonyl-tRNA synthetase) derived from Akkermansia muciniphila or a fragment thereof as an active ingredient for preventing, alleviating and treating inflammatory diseases. According to the present invention, Akkermansia muciniphila TARS or a fragment thereof accelerates differentiation of M2 macrophages as anti-inflammatory macrophages to allow proliferation of the macrophages and increases secretion of IL-10 as anti-inflammatory cytokine to cause proliferation of B cells, and thus shows an anti-inflammatory effect. Therefore, it is shown that Akkermansia muciniphila TARS or a fragment thereof shows an effect of alleviating not only inflammatory diseases but also immune diseases, infection diseases and metabolic diseases accompanied with inflammation, and particularly has an effect of preventing or treating inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), or the like.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating post traumatic stress disorder comprising hesperidin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition, a food composition, and a feed composition for the prevention or treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder comprising hesperidin or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof as an active component, and a method for preventing or treating post-traumatic stress disorder comprising a step of administering the pharmaceutical composition. Since hesperidin of the present invention exhibits an excellent PTSD treatment effect, hesperidin can be included as the active component in the pharmaceutical composition or food and used to develop a therapeutic agent or an alleviating agent for PTSD.

title_en: A composition and method for preventing or treating neurodegenerative diseases, comprising a substance that increases NIX protein expression
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition, etc., for preventing or treating neurodegenerative diseases. In the present invention, it has been confirmed that NIX-dependent mitophagy is reduced by glucocorticoids, resulting in synaptic dysfunction and cognitive impairment, and the mechanism by which glucocorticoids decrease NIX protein through the GR-PGC1α-NIX axis has been specifically confirmed. Accordingly, it is possible to discover target proteins which regulate intracellular transport and suggest a treatment method for restoring mitochondria functions by revealing out the causes of neurodegenerative diseases caused by the inhibited conversion of stress-damaged mitochondria into mitophagosomes and improper placement at synapses and terminals of nerve cells.

title_en: Novel benaodiazepin-3-one derivatives and phamarceutical composition for treating or preventing of diabetic peripheral neuropathy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel benzodiazepin-3-one derivative and a pharmaceutical composition for the treatment or prevention of diabetic neuropathy comprising the same. The novel benzodiazepin-3-one derivative compound of the present invention acts on semi-cells and inhibits the neuroaxon degeneration of Schwann cells and the dedifferentiation of Schwann cells to prevent the degeneration of peripheral nerves, thereby being able to be effectively used for preventing or treating diabetic neuropathy diseases. In addition, a method for manufacturing the compound according to the present invention enables eco-friendly production of a 7-membered benzodiazepin-3-one derivative at low cost.

title_en: Method for manufacture of protein microbead for improving stability of protein therapeutics
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a preparation method of protein microbeads for improving the stability of protein preparations. When trehalose is mixed with protein and the protein is dehydrated in n-octanol using SPG membrane emulsification technology, microbeads with narrow particle size distribution and high reversibility are formed, and it was confirmed that the microbeads exhibited high stability against external impact or high-temperature stress compared to the protein solution. Accordingly, the preparation method of protein microbeads, according to the present invention, is expected to be useful as a method for improving storage stability when applied to the manufacture of high-concentration protein drugs.

title_en: Composition for improving skin whitening comprising fermented product of Momordica charantia or compound isolated therefrom as effective componenet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for skin whitening containing a fermented product of Momordica charantia or a compound isolated therefrom as an active component. The fermented product of Momordica charantia or a novel compound isolated from the same has excellent tyrosinase inhibitory activity and melanin biosynthesis inhibition rate, so that it can be usefully used as a cosmetic or food for improving skin whitening or a therapeutic material for the treatment of melanin pigmentation disease.

title_en: Deoxycholic acid composition with improved lipolytic effect and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a deoxycholic acid (DOCA) composition with an improved lipolysis effect and a method for preparing the same. In the composition of the present invention, amino acid, which is a hydrophilic part, is added to DOCA, so that like a surfactant, both a hydrophilic part and a hydrophobic part are present in the composition. As such, a solubilization ability of a fat-soluble component (fat) can be further increased, and the composition's solubility in water can be increased by increasing the hydrophilicity to DOCA. Accordingly, the composition is easy to prepare as an injection when the solubility of DOCA is increased. After injection, there is no precipitate under biological pH conditions, and thus, inflammatory reactions and the like can be minimized. Therefore, the composition can be applied as an injection for lipolysis.

title_en: Anti-oxidant, anti-bacterial, anti-hypertension, or anti-gout composition comprising extract of Sambucus sieboldiana var. pendula as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antioxidant, antibacterial, antihypertensive, or anti-gout composition comprising an extract of Sambucus sieboldiana var. pendula as an active ingredient. In particular, according to the present invention, a leaf extract of Sambucus sieboldiana var. pendula, which is a Korean endemic plant, has an antioxidant effect by inhibiting DPPH radicals, exhibits a gout inhibitory effect by inhibiting enzyme activity, and has a hypertension inhibitory effect by inhibiting ACE. In addition, the composition exhibits excellent antibacterial activity against Gram-positive bacteria. Therefore, it is expected that the extract of Sambucus sieboldiana var. pendula, according to the present invention, can be useful for pharmaceutical compositions and food compositions.

title_en: Biomarker for predicting diagnosis or prognosis colorectal cancer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a use of HJURP as a biomarker for the diagnosis or prognosis prediction of colon cancer. The present invention provides a composition for diagnosing or predicting prognosis of colon cancer, including an agent capable of measuring the expression level of mRNA of Holliday junction recognition protein (HJURP) or a protein thereof.

title_en: Ointment and cosmetic composition for skin treatment containing E2F as an active ingredient and having wound healing and anti-aging functions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition containing E2F as an active ingredient, and a pharmaceutical composition or a cosmetic composition according to the present invention can have an alleviation, prevention or treatment effect on skin aging or wounds. According to one embodiment of the present invention to achieve the above object, provided is the pharmaceutical composition containing E2F protein, or a peptide containing a partial sequence of the E2F protein as an active ingredient.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating neurodegenerative disease comprising khellactone coumarine derivatives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to khellactone coumarin derivative compounds, which are natural plant-derived compounds useful as AChE inhibitors or BChE inhibitors, pharmaceutical and food compositions for the prevention, alleviation or treatment of degenerative cranial nerve diseases containing a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof or a hydrate thereof as an active ingredient. The natural plant-derived compound is one or more compounds selected from senecioyl-4'-angeloyl-khellactone (senecioyl-4'3'-angeloyl-4'-(2-methylbutyryl)khellactone(3'-angeloyl-4'- (2-methylbutyryl)khellactone), and 3'-isovaleryl-4'-(2-methylbutyroyl)khellactone)(3'-isovaleryl-4'-(2-methylbutyroyl)khellactone). Since the compounds have excellent inhibitory effects on AChE and/or BChE, the compounds can be usefully used in the prevention, alleviation, or treatment of degenerative cranial nerve diseases.

title_en: Novel FGF-1 variants and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel FGF-1 variants and uses thereof, and according to the novel FGF-1 variants and uses thereof, according to one aspect, the novel FGF-1 variants have increased proteolytic stability compared to wild-type FGF1 and therapeutic effects, and thus, can be useful in related uses, such as wound healing, tissue regeneration, inhibition of cancer growth, and inhibition of angiogenesis.

title_en: Polyheterocyclic derivatives containing pyrimidine and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel polyheterocyclic derivative useful for the production of medicines for treating cancer diseases, and more specifically, to a polyheterocyclic derivative including pyrimidine with an excellent tumor growth inhibition effect, or pharmaceutically acceptable salts or an isomer thereof, and a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating cancer including the same as an active ingredient.

title_en: Compositions for improving or treating asthma
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for the alleviation or treatment of asthma, and more specifically, to a composition for the improvement or treatment of asthma containing hydrocarpic acid and goric acid as active ingredients. The composition is useful as health foods or pharmaceutical compositions for alleviating or treating asthma.

title_en: Novel strains having antibacterial activity against candida albicans and their uses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a strain that inhibits a proliferation and activity of Candida albicans, which causes vaginitis, and specifically, relates to strains of the genera Clostridium, Enterococcus, Streptococcus, and Bacteroides, and relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating vaginitis that comprises, as an active ingredient, at least one or more types selected from a group consisting of the strain, a culture of the strain, a concentrate of the culture, a dried product of the culture, an extract of the culture, and dead cells of the strain and a health functional food composition for preventing or improving vaginitis.

title_en: Composition for bone health and anti-obesity comprising Platycodon grandiforum bud extract as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for bone health and anti-obesity containing a platycodon grandiflorum net extract as an active ingredient. the platycodon grandiflorum net extract of the present invention has high alkaline phosphatase (alp) activity and bone mineralization formation, thereby exhibiting an effect of improving bone health. in addition, the platycodon grandiflorum net extract exhibits high lipocyte formation inhibitory activity, thereby exhibiting an excellent anti-obesity effect. therefore, the platycodon grandiflorum net extract can be usefully used as a composition for bone health and anti-obesity.

title_en: A composition for improving, preventing, or treating virus infectious disease comprising apple extracts containing phloretin and/or phlorizin as an active ingredients
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for enhancing immunity and improving anti-inflammation, comprising an apple extract containing phloretin and/or phlorizin as an active ingredient. The immune-enhancing and anti-inflammatory agent used is a natural extract that has already been verified, and thus the composition of the present invention is also safe for application to the human body. The present invention inhibits the mechanisms through which exposure to harmful substances such as LPS or oxidative damage to host cells caused by bacteria and viruses triggers tissue damage, virus replication, and infection under such conditions by inducing cytokine storms. It can therefore efficiently suppress the proliferation of many diseases or most viruses that cause oxidative stress and cytokine storms. Accordingly, the composition may be applied as an inhibitor of various immunocompromised conditions and infections caused by bacteria and viruses through effective anti-inflammatory and immune-enhancing actions, and is expected to be utilized as a preventive or adjuvant in quarantine applications.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating degenerative brain disease comprising bisisoxazole compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating degenerative brain diseases containing a bisisoxazole compound represented by chemical formula 1 as an active ingredient. the composition exhibits an effect of activating mitochondria in neurons such as neurons, glia cells, and microglia cells, suggesting the possibility of being used as a therapeutic agent for various degenerative brain diseases showing a decrease in mitochondria of neurons in degenerative brain diseases such as parkinson2032#s disease.

title_en: Positively charged amino acid polymers and bile acid conjugates and uses thereof for cathepsin B-mediated diseases
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a positively charged amino acid polymer and bile acid conjugate, and a prevention, amelioration, or treatment effect for cathepsin B-mediated diseases thereof. The positively charged amino acid polymer and bile acid conjugate of the present invention are nano-sized and can be self-assembled in an aqueous solution due to the strong positive charge and hydrophobicity of bile acid to form nanoparticles, and have shown promising results in mouse colorectal cancer (CT26) cell treatment and animal experiments. Therefore, the positively charged amino acid polymer and bile acid conjugate can be used as a cathepsin B inhibitor, thereby providing an effect of preventing, alleviating or treating cathepsin B-mediated diseases.

title_en: Stemness-inducing factor of cell and method for increasing or maintaining stemness of cell using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a factor that induces stem cell capability of cells and a method for increasing or maintaining the stem cell capability of cells using the factor. According to the method for increasing or maintaining the stem cell capability of cells using the factor depending on a certain aspect, there is an effect that the cell proliferation capability and stem cell capability are increased or maintained, making it useful for therapeutic efficiency and large-scale cultivation, thereby having an effect that can be used as a cell therapeutic agent. Additionally, as a gene therapeutic agent, the factor can be administered to a living body to exert regenerative function in the targeted tissue.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating pulmonary fibrosis comprising extracts of Panax ginseng and Inula japonica
abstract_en: Disclosure technical problem an object of the present invention is to provide a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating pulmonary fibrosis, comprising ginseng and onion extract or a fraction thereof as an active ingredient. The lung fibrosis prevention or the pharmaceutical composition for prevention includes the ginseng, the onion extracts or this fractions to the active ingredient. The mixed extract of ginseng and onion of the present invention has excellent effects of preventing and treating pulmonary fibrosis and inhibiting pulmonary fibrosis metastasis, and thus can be used for the development of a pulmonary fibrosis prevention or treatment agent and metastasis inhibitor with high stability and alleviated side effects.

title_en: Composition for skin whitening comprising Citrulluside T
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for skin whitening comprising citruloside T. The composition comprising citruloside T derived from a watermelon stem according to the present invention inhibits tyrosinase activity and inhibits melanin production. In addition, citruloside T has an effect of inhibiting melanin production by downregulating the expression of microphthalmia associated transcription factor (MITF), tyrosinase-related protein-1 (TRP-1), and tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-1), which are melanin production-related proteins. Therefore, the composition according to the present invention has an excellent skin whitening effect and has no cytotoxicity and skin side effects, thereby being expected to be very usefully used as a pharmaceutical composition, a cosmetic composition, or a food composition for skin whitening.

title_en: Prussian blue nanozyme-coated exosomes and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to prussian blue nanozyme-coated exosomes (exozyme) and a use thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to prussian blue nanozyme-coated exosomes and uses thereof, for example, in antioxidants, anti-inflammatory agents, pharmaceutical compositions, quasi-drug compositions, cosmetic compositions or food compositions.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating neuropathic pain comprising Phlomidis Radix extract as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating neuropathic pain comprising a phlomidis radix extract as an active ingredient. The extract is confirmed to inhibit neuropathic pain caused by a paclitaxel anticancer agent, thereby being able to be usefully used as a composition for preventing, treating or alleviating neuropathic pain.

title_en: C6'-substituted locked nucleic acid-modified cap analog and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a C6'-substituted locked nucleic acid-modified cap analog and a use thereof, wherein the cap analog improves stability of mRNA and/or translation efficiency of mRNA.

title_en: miR-16 and miR-30c joint Expression Vector, Construction Method and their Use
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and specifically relates to the use of two small RNAs, i.e., miR-16 and miR-30c in combination for regulating the proliferation of neural stem cells. The present application conducted the following works: (1) the number of adult neural stem cells in the hippocampi of Alzheimer's disease mice increased by 1.96 times, n=6, p <0.001, under the combined action of miR?16 and miR- 30c; (2) after the miR- 16 and miR- 30c overexpression, adult neurogenesis in the subventricular zone of the lateral ventricle and adult neurogenesis in the hippocampal dentate gyrus of Alzheimer's disease mice increased by 13.90 times, n=6, p<0.001, and 6.71 times, n=6, p<0.001, respectively. miR-16 and miR-30c show a significant effect on regulating the proliferation of neural stem cells in adult Alzheimer's disease mice, which is conducive to designing targeted drugs for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, which can be in turn used in clinic treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

title_en: Desferrioxamine-metal complexes for the treatment of immune-related disorders.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods kits and combined compositions using DFO-metal complexes, specifically, Zinc-desferrioxamine (Zn-DFO), gallium-desferrioxamine (Ga-DFO) complexes and any combinations thereof for preventing, treating, ameliorating or inhibiting an immune-related disorder, specifically, a skin-related inflammatory disorder such as psoriasis, an inflammatory respiratory condition such as asthma, and an autoimmune disease such as diabetes and any immune-related disorder.

title_en: Deoxynucleoside therapy for diseases caused by unbalanced nucleotide pools including mitochondrial dna depletion syndromes.
abstract_en: The invention relates generally to a pharmacological therapy for human genetic diseases, specifically those characterized by unbalance nucleotide pools, more specifically mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes, and more specifically, thymidine kinase 2 (TK2) deficiency. The pharmacological therapy involves the administration of at least one deoxynucleoside, or mixtures thereof. For the treatment of TK2 deficiency, the pharmacological therapy involves the administration of either deoxythymidine (dT) or deoxycytidine (dC), or mixtures thereof. This administration of deoxynucleosides is applicable to other disorders of unbalanced nucleotide pools, especially those found in mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome.

title_en: Compositions comprising bacterial strains.
abstract_en: The invention provides compositions comprising bacterial strains for stimulating the immune system and treating and preventing diseases.

title_en: Non-cytotoxic benzylated curcuminoid fluorophores for bioimage.
abstract_en: The present invention discloses novel curcuminoid-like fluorophore compounds, which exhibits considerable fluorescence from the curcumin, the most important secondary metabolite isolated from Curcuma longa known for its extensive therapeutic properties. Said compounds permeate through membranes and selectively stain cellular compartments. Also, they possess three main advantages for bio imaging, bio-detection, and monitoring biological activity applications, showing their non-cytotoxic nature, selective ability to diffuse into the nucleus or cytoplasmic compartments, and the inhibition or elimination of natural intrinsic ant proliferative activity.

title_en: Ethanol production and distillation process from grain and bean malt.
abstract_en: The present disclosure is related to the process for obtaining sugars from bean malt and its subsequent transformation into a distilled alcoholic beverage. The process object of the present invention is characterized by the sequence of steps that go from the malting of the beans to obtaining a distilled alcoholic beverage of 38º. The bean malt is dehydrated, then ground and mixed with water until obtaining a juice. This juice is degraded by temperature, thermoacid hydrolysis or enzymatic hydrolysis, to obtain a juice high in sugars. This juice is subjected to alcoholic fermentation for several days. After this period, the ethanol dissolved in the medium is separated by distillation and rectification. After rectification, a bean brandy is obtained (with 51º). Water is added to reduce the alcohol content. After this dilution, an alcoholic beverage distilled from beans is obtained (38º).

title_en: Monohydrate and crystalline forms of 6-[(3s,4s)-4-methyl-1- (pyrimidin-2-ylmethyl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]-3-tetrahydropyran-4-yl- 7h-imid azo [1,5- a] pyrazin-8-one.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to crystalline polymorph forms of 6-[(3S,4S)-4-methyl-1-(pyrimidin-2-ylmethyl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]-3- tetrahydropyran-4-yl-7H-imidazo[1,5-a]pyrazin-8-one.

title_en: Novel salts and crystals.
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a new, stable, pharmaceutically acceptable bis-tosylate salt form of 1-(4-fluoro-phenyl)-4-((6bR,10aS)-3-methyl-2,3,6b,9,10,10a-hexa hydro-1H,7H-pyrido[3',4':4,5]pyrrolo[1,2,3-de]quinoxalin-8-yl)-b utan-1-one, together with methods of making and using them, and pharmaceutical compositions comprising them.

title_en: Combination therapy.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to combination therapies for the treatment of pathological conditions, such as cancer. In particular, the present disclosure relates to combination therapies comprising treatment with an anti-CD25 ADC and Gemcitabine.

title_en: Combination therapy including an mdm2 inhibitor and one or more additional pharmaceutically active agents for the treatment of cancers.
abstract_en: The present invention provides combination therapy that includes an MDM2 inhibitor and one or more additional pharmaceutically active agents, particularly for the treatment of cancers. The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions that contain an MDM2 inhibitor and one or more additional pharmaceutically active agents for the treatment of cancers.

title_en: Dimeric immuno-modulatory compounds against cereblon-based mechanisms.
abstract_en: Disclosed are small molecules against cereblon to enhance effector T cell function. Methods of making these molecules and methods of using them to treat various disease states are also disclosed.

title_en: Non-disruptive gene therapy for the treatment of mma.
abstract_en: Methods and technologies for the treatment of methylmalonic acidemia.

title_en: Cyclobutyl nucleoside analogs as anti-virals.
abstract_en: Described herein are cyclobutyl nucleoside analogs of Formula (I), pharmaceutical compositions that include one or more cyclobutyl nucleoside analogs and methods of using the same to treat HBV, HDV and/or HIV.

title_en: Multimeric t-cell modulatory polypeptides and methods of use thereof.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides T-cell modulatory multimeric polypeptides that comprise an immunomodulatory polypeptide and that comprise an epitope-presenting Wilms tumor peptide. A T-cell modulatory multimeric polypeptide is useful for modulating the activity of a T cell, and for modulating an immune response in an individual.

title_en: Triple combination therapies for targeting mitochondria and killing cancer stem cells.
abstract_en: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) may be eradicated through a novel therapeutic strategy involving, in some embodiments, FDA-approved antibiotics and dietary supplements. The present approach effectively results in the synergistic eradication of CSCs through inhibiting mitochondrial biogenesis in CSCs during induced mitochondrial oxidative stress, without inhibiting normal cells. Embodiments may include a therapeutic agent that inhibits mitochondrial biogenesis and targets the large mitochondrial ribosome, a therapeutic agent that inhibits mitochondrial biogenesis and targets the small mitochondrial ribosome, and a therapeutic agent that behaves as a pro-oxidant or induces mitochondrial oxidative stress. Compositions according to the present approach inhibited CSC propagation by ~ 90% in MCF7 ER(+) cell lines during preliminary studies, with confirmed reduction in mitochondrial oxygen consumption and ATP production. Some embodiments include sub-antimicrobial antibiotic concentrations, thereby minimizing antibiotic resistance concerns. In some embodiments, one or more therapeutic agents are conjugated with a targeting signal.

title_en: Dosing regimen and pharmaceutical combination comprising 3-(1-oxoisoindolin-2-yl)piperidine-2,6-dione derivatives.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to dosing regimens, formulations, and combinations comprising 3-(1-oxoisoindolin-2-yl)piperidine-2,6-dione compounds or pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same; and methods of using such combinations and compositions in the treatment or prevention IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 2 (IKZF2)-dependent diseases or disorders or where reduction of IKZF2 or IKZF4 protein levels can ameliorate a disease, for example, the treatment of cancers.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition comprising an inhibitor of the proton pump for gastric absorption.
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for oral administration comprising a proton pump inhibitor, a buffering agent, and a super disintegrant. Herein, the pharmaceutical composition adapts for absorbing the proton pump inhibitor in the stomach, and the buffering agent modifies the pH thereof, alleviating the overproduction of hydrochloric acid in the stomach and avoiding degrading the proton pump inhibitor. Also, the super disintegrant provides better dispersion of the components improving its use.

title_en: Stabilised hypochlorous solutions and their medical and cosmetic uses.
abstract_en: This invention relates to stabilised hypochlorous solutions and their medical and cosmetic uses. More particularly it relates to their use in the treatment of humans and animals by application to the skin, both external and internal surfaces, and more particularly, but not exclusively, to the treatment of wounds and the oral cavity. It also relates to its use in the tattoo industry and to applications as anti-viral. The total chlorine concentration of the solution is at or below 300ppm and has hypochlorous, measured by UV spectroscopy at 230nm, as the predominant species. The ratio of hypochlorous to hypochlorite, measured by UV spectroscopy at 290nm, is greater than 3:1, and the solution has a pH of between about 7 and 4.

title_en: Integral membrane protein display on poxvirus extracellular enveloped virions.
abstract_en: This disclosure provides compositions and methods for expressing and displaying isolated integral membrane proteins (IMPs) or fragments thereof in a native conformation for use in the screening, selecting, and identifying of antibodies or antibody-like molecules that bind to a target IMP of interest.

title_en: An immunogenic serotype 35b pneumococcal polysaccharide-protein conjugate and conjugation process for making the same.
abstract_en: The present invention provides a process improvement related to the conjugation of capsular polysaccharides from <i>Streptococcus pneumoniae (S. pneumoniae)</i> serotype 35B to a carrier protein. The serotype 35B polysaccharide-protein conjugate, prepared by the disclosed process, is, among other things, more immunogenic than similar conjugates made by prior art methods. <i>S. pneumoniae</i> serotype 35B polysaccharide-protein conjugates prepared using the processes of the invention can be included in multivalent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine compositions.

title_en: Ehrlichia vaccines and immunogenic compositions.
abstract_en: Provided herein are immunogenic compositions that may be used, in some aspects, to induce an immune response against an Ehrlichia such as Ehrlichia cams. In some embodiments, the immunogenic composition comprises an E. canis bacterin and/or adjuvant, such as for example an emulsion or liposomal adjuvant. Related methods such as for diagnosis of or vaccination against ehrlichiosis are also provided.

title_en: Antibody combinations for treatment of cancer in specific patients.
abstract_en: Described is the combined use of a first antibody molecule that specifically binds FcyRIIb via its Fab region and that binds an Fey receptor via its Fc region, and a second antibody molecule that specifically binds PD-1 and that binds at least one Fey receptor via its Fc region, in the treatment of cancer in a patient having tumor infiltrating T lymphocytes with a medium or high PD-1 expression, as well as pharmaceutical compositions and kits comprising these two antibody molecules, and methods of treating cancer using these two antibodies. Described is also a diagnostic test for identification of patients benefitting from the treatment described herein.

title_en: Compositions and methods for silencing vegf-a expression.
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to double-stranded ribonucleic acid (dsRNA) compositions targeting VEGF-A, and methods of using such dsRNA compositions to alter (e.g., inhibit) expression of VEGF-A.

title_en: Biologically active additive based on mesoporous silicon dioxide and on micellar solutions of active substrates and method for preparing same.
abstract_en: The group of inventions provides a biologically active additive and a method for preparing same. The biologically active additive is a micellar solution of an active substance in at least one emulsifier selected from the group comprising: polysorbate 20, polysorbate 80, polysorbate 20 and polysorbate 80, the emulsifier being adsorbed on amorphous mesoporous silicon dioxide nanoparticles having mesopore size from 0.2 to 1.8 nm by way of stirring in a disperser. The active substance may be selected from the group comprising: curcumin extract and rutin extract, dihydroquercetin extract, dihydroquercetin extract with quercetin extract, mixed tocopherol concentrate, cannabis oil with cannabidiol level up to 85%, cannabidiol isolate, cannabidiol isolate with mixed tocopherol concentrate, ADEK vitamin mixture concentrate, Sophora japonica extract, rosemary extract, cholecalciferol, thioctic acid, ferulic acid, resveratrol, resveratrol with ferulic acid, boswellia extract, betulin extract, icariin extract, chlorophyll extract, cannabidiol isolate with melatonin, cannabis oil having cannabidiol level up to 85% with passionflower extract, vardenafil, tadalafil, curcumin extract with soy lecithin, paclitaxel extract, collagen extract with soy lecithin. A method for preparing a biologically active additive comprises loading, into the disperser, an active substance in at least one emulsifier selected from the group comprising: polysorbate 20, polysorbate 80, polysorbate 20 and polysorbate 80, heating to a temperature of 80-90° C. while stirring continuously at from about 1000 rpm to about 2000 rpm, cooling to a temperature from below 60° C. to below 45° C., adding amorphous mesoporous silicon dioxide having a mesopore size from 0.2 to 1.8 nm, stirring at from about 1000 rpm to about 2000 rpm for about 0.5 h, followed by an increase in the stirring speed to 7000-9000 rpm until producing a homogeneous product in the form of a loose powder. The group of inventions provides improved bioavailability of the active substance.

title_en: Methods for ex vivo enrichment and expansion of tumor reactive t cells and related compositions thereof.
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods for manufacturing of tumor reactive T cells that includes ex vivo enrichment of, and expansion of, cells secreting chemokine (C-X-C motif) ligand 13 (CXCL13); cells surface positive for C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5 (CXCR5); and/or one or more of CD39, PD-1 and TIGIT. Also provided are populations of T cells produced by methods described herein and pharmaceutical compositions thereof.

title_en: Pharmaceutical compositions of lipoic acid choline ester salts and methods of treatment using same.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides salts of lipoic acid choline ester (LACE), crystalline forms thereof, and methods of use thereof. The present disclosure further provides pharmaceutical compositions of LACE salts and methods of use thereof.

title_en: Alkylaminoproline derivatives as alfa-2-delta-1 blockers.

title_en: Akt3 modulators.
abstract_en: Compounds of Formula la, lb, or Ic, are described, where the various substituents are defined herein. The compounds can modulate a property or effect of Akt3 <i>in vitro </i>or <i>in vivo</i>, and can also be used, individually or in combination with other agents, in the prevention or treatment of a variety of conditions. Methods for synthesizing the compounds are described. Pharmaceutical compositions and methods of using these compounds or compositions, individually or in combination with other agents or compositions, in the prevention or treatment of a variety of conditions are also described.

title_en: A composition comprising hp-hmg for use in treating infertility.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to improved assisted reproductive technology for women predicted to have a high ovarian response to controlled ovarian stimulation that comprise targeting a threshold serum hCG level by the final day of stimulation.

title_en: Treating rheumatoid arthritis.
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of treating rheumatoid arthritis, comprising administering to a patient a therapeutically effective dose of a TLR7/8 inhibitor or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, in combination with a therapeutically effective dose of a TNFÎ± inhibitor.

title_en: Pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treating parkinson's disease.
abstract_en: The current application relates to a topical pharmaceutical composition comprising at least one active agent selected from CBD and THC, solvent, surfactant, optional permeation enhancer, and optional adhesive/polymer. The topical composition is used for treating, preventing, or slowing the onset or progression of Parkinson's disease and/or related symptoms.

title_en: Antagonist compounds.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compounds of formula (I) shown below: wherein R<sub>1</sub>, R<sub>2</sub>, R<sub>3</sub>, R<sub>4</sub>, R<sub>5</sub> and R<sub>6</sub> are each as defined in the application. title_en: Methods of treating pde iv-mediated diseases or conditions.
abstract_en: The disclosure provides methods and compositions for the treatment of PDE IV-mediated diseases or conditions, including inflammatory diseases or conditions, using a compound of Formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof:.

title_en: Pharmacological agents for treating conditions of the eye.
abstract_en: Provided are compounds useful for treating, preventing, reducing the occurrence of, slowing the progression of, or reducing, ameliorating, or alleviating the symptoms associated with a condition selected from the group consisting of: presbyopia, cataract, transthyretin (TTR)- associated amyloidosis, myopia, or other conditions or disorders associated with the eye, including COMT inhibitors and pro-drugs thereof, and methods of using these compounds.

title_en: Oral cannabinoid product with lipid component.
abstract_en: Meltable compositions configured for oral use, the compositions including at least one cannabinoid or cannabimimetic, are provided. The compositions include a lipid and one or more fillers, typically a sugar alcohol. A method of forming such compositions is also provided.

title_en: Neutralizing antibodies to il-17a, fusion proteins thereof, and uses thereof.
abstract_en: Disclosed are compositions and methods related to anti-IL-17A antibodies and antigen binding fragments thereof. Additionally provided are bi-specific binding proteins comprising the anti-IL-17A binding domains. Additionally provided are methods of use for the compounds and compositions described herein in the treatment of inflammatory diseases and ocular disorders.

title_en: Cell therapy compositions and methods for modulating tgf-b signaling.
abstract_en: Methods of using polypeptides to modulate transforming growth factor-Î² (TGFÎ²) signaling (e.g., TGFÎ² receptors, antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof that specifically bind TGFÎ² or a TGFÎ² receptor) are provided. title_en: High concentration bispecific antibody formulations.
abstract_en: Provided herein are stable aqueous pharmaceutical compositions comprising high concentration formulations of a bispecific epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)/hepatocyte growth factor receptor (c-Met) antibody and methods of preparing the same. Also provided herein are methods of treating cancer in a subject in need thereof by subcutaneously administering to the subject the stable aqueous pharmaceutical compositions as disclosed herein.

title_en: Dispositivo para investigacion de la enfermedad de lyme con chinches y garrapatas.
abstract_en: The present invention describes a device for investigating Lyme's disease by means of bed bugs and ticks, which has rails with slides and a bar with guides for adjusting the positioning of the animal depending on the size thereof, as well as extensions and auxiliary extensions for increasing the size of the retaining plate where the animal is placed for larger animals, as well as having containers in which the insects transmitting the Lyme disease are housed. The present invention integrates a diaphragm perforation by means of which the animal is exposed to insects and a wireless communication unit controls the opening or closing of the containers and the diaphragm via remote. title_en: Glycan-interacting compounds and methods of use.
abstract_en: Methods of treating cancer are provided that include administering glycan-interacting antibodies. Included are anti-sialyl Tn antigen antibodies and related compositions and formulations suitable to achieve desirable bioactivity, bioavailability, and toxicity levels.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and use thereof.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a pharmaceutical composition containing a therapeutically effective amount of furmonertinib or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and optionally a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier, and use of said pharmaceutical composition in manufacture of a medicament for treating and/or preventing a disease mediated by EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation. The pharmaceutical composition of the present disclosure shows an excellent therapeutic effect on disease mediated by EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation (for example, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ) with little side effects and excellent safety.

title_en: Peptides with anti-angiogenic activity.

title_en: Method for treating retinal degeneration.
abstract_en: A method for treating retinal degeneration, the method comprising administering a microbial inhibitor or biocide to the eye or gastrointestinal tract of a patient; specifically, by means of establishing an eye disease model or an eye disease model vector, particularly a retinal degeneration model or model vector, it is verified that the microbial inhibitor or biocide can be used as a drug to treat retinal degenerative diseases.

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating or preventing inflammatory diseases including diabetes and thyroid diseases.
abstract_en: A method of preventing or treating an inflammatory disease and/or conditions associated with inflammation and/or biomarkers associated with inflammation in a subject in need thereof is provided. Also provided are pharmaceutical compositions, articles and foods for the treatment of an inflammatory disease using natural active compounds such as herb and flower extracts.

title_en: Derivatives of substituted morpholines and uses thereof.
abstract_en: A compound of Formula I includes a stereoisomer thereof and/or a salt thereof; wherein R<sup>1</sup> is a substituted alkane group, a heterocylic group, or a pyridine group; X is hydrogen, a halogen, an amino acid residue, a substituted amino acid residue, an alkyl group, or an ester. Such compounds may be used in pharmaceutical compositions and for the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) disorders:.

title_en: Deuterated analogs of acetyl-leucine.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides compounds represented by Formula I: I, and the pharmaceutically acceptable salts and solvates thereof, wherein R<sup>1</sup>, R<sup>2</sup>, R<sup>3</sup>, R<sup>4</sup>, R<sup>5</sup>, R<sup>6</sup>, R<sup>7</sup>, R<sup>8</sup>, R<sup>9</sup>, R<sup>10</sup>, R<sup>11</sup>, R<sup>12</sup>, and R<sup>13</sup> are as defined as set forth in the specification, and the deuterium enrichment of any one or more of R<sup>3</sup>, R<sup>4</sup>, R<sup>5</sup>, R<sup>6</sup>, R<sup>7</sup>, R<sup>8</sup>, R<sup>9</sup>, R<sup>10</sup>, R<sup>11</sup>, R<sup>12</sup>, and R<sup>13</sup> is about 15% or more. title_en: Pharmaceutical compositions of spironolactone for deep dermal drug delivery.
abstract_en: Pharmaceutical compositions for the topical administration of spironolactone to the pilosebaceous unit and methods for administering the same. The pharmaceutical compositions comprise aqueous suspensions of submicron particles of spironolactone in water.

title_en: Treatment of cancers having mutations in wnt pathway tumour suppressors
abstract_en: A method of treating a cancer having one or more mutations in tumour suppressors AXIN1 and/or APC in the WNT pathway in a subject in need thereof is provided wherein the method comprises administering a MEK inhibitor or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof to the subject. The MEK inhibitor may be administered as a single agent or may be combined with treatment with an immune checkpoint inhibitor, such as an inhibitor of PD-1 and/or PD-L1, or a RAF inhibitor.

title_en: Vaccine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions comprising at least one Group A Streptococcus antigen, an aluminium salt and (a) a TLR7 agonist, or (b) a benzonapthyridine compound. The present invention further relates to methods of making an immunogenic composition comprising at least one antigen, an aluminium salt and (a) a TLR7 agonist, and/or (b) a benzonapthyridine compound. The present invention also relates to vaccines comprising the compositions, and methods of using and uses of the compositions.

title_en: Nucleic acids encoding soluble pd-1 and il-12 and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides for nucleic acids encoding for a soluble PD-1 variant and IL-12. Further provided herein are nucleic acids encoding for a chemokine receptor. Additionally described herein are oncolytic viruses comprising the nucleic acids described herein. Oncolytic viruses optionally comprise a mutation or deletion of the gene expressing IFN-gamma. Compositions described herein are further described for use in the treatment of cancer.

title_en: Meningococcal protein based vaccine formulations and methods for manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: Present invention provides fusion proteins with desired reduction in factor H binding, particularly the present invention provides optimized manufacturing process for fusion proteins and formulations comprising the fusion proteins. Present invention provides an efficient platform process for manufacturing an effective vaccine formulation against Neisseria meningitidis that meets multiple criteria including improved immunogenicity, safety, stability, and affordability.

title_en: Synthesis of a hippo-yap pathway modulator and a polymorph thereof
abstract_en: Described herein is the preparation of a Hippo-YAP pathway modulator and chemical intermediates used in the synthetic process. Also described herein is a polymorph of a Hippo-YAP pathway modulator.

title_en: Combination of a menin-ll1 inhibitor, a dna intercalating agent and a pyrimidine analogue to treat a hematopoietic disorder.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to combinations comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a menin-mixed-lineage leukemia 1 (menin-MLL) inhibitor; and a therapeutically effective amount of a DNA intercalating agent and a pyrimidine analog; as well as to methods for treating a subject diagnosed with cancer using such combinations.

title_en: Herbicidal derivatives
abstract_en: Compounds of Formula (I) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim 1. The invention further relates to herbicidal compositions which comprise a compound of Formula (I) and to the use of compounds of Formula (I) for controlling weeds, in particular in crops of useful plants.

title_en: New pyridopyrimidines derivatives compounds
abstract_en: The present invention describes new pyridopyrimidine derivatives compounds with structure represented by General Formula (I): General Formula (I) or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, or their mixtures (in any ratio), a pharmaceutical composition containing them, a method for using the new pyridopyrimidine derivatives compounds as inhibitor of the cyclic nucleotide synthesis or as inhibitor of the cAMP and cGMP synthesis, and their uses in the prophylactic and/or curative treatment of diarrhea, colitis and irritable bowel syndrome.

title_en: Pyranochromenyl phenol derivative, and pharmaceutical composition for treating metabolic syndrome or inflammatory disease
abstract_en: Provided are a pyranochromenyl phenol derivative, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, or a solvate thereof. Also provided is a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating metabolic syndrome or inflammatory disease comprising same. The present invention is efficacious in preventing or treating metabolic syndrome or inflammatory disease and is chemically stable.

title_en: Divalent vaccine compositions and the use thereof for treating tumours
abstract_en: A description is given of vaccine compositions that combine, in equal proportions, the extracellular domains of Her1 and Her2 growth factor receptors or fragments thereof and, in addition, proteoliposomes of very small size deriving from outer membrane proteins of <i>Neisseria meningitidis</i> and GM3 ganglioside (GM3/VSSP), which are intended for subcutaneous administration. The compositions described allow antibodies to be induced for treating malignant tumours and offer advantages owing to the fact that they successfully eliminate the entire mass of the tumour and prevent return of the tumour from the appearance of resistant variants.

title_en: Treatment of mild and moderate alzheimer's disease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of treatment using [3-(4-{2-butyl-1-[4-(4-chloro-phenoxy)-phenyl]-1H-imidazol-4-yl}-phenoxy)-propyl]-diethyl amine ("COMPOUND I") or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. In various embodiments, the methods of treatment include treatment of mild-to-moderate dementia of Alzheimer's type, diabetes, insomnia, and other indications. The present invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising COMPOUND I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

title_en: Pharmaceutical formulations, processes, solid forms and methods of use relating to 1-ethyl-7-(2-methyl-6-(1h-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl) pyridin-3-yl) -3,4-dihydropyrazino[2,3-b]pyrazin-2(1h)-one

title_en: A new quinoline derivative for use in the treatment and prevention of viral infections
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a quinoline derivative of formula (1) or one of its pharmaceutically acceptable salts. The present invention further relates to said quinoline derivative for medicament and for use in the treatment or prevention of a viral or retroviral infection and in particular AIDS or an AIDS-related condition or Human Immunodeficiency virus (HIV). The present invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising said quinoline derivative and to the process for preparing it as to a novel intermediate compound.

title_en: Muscle cell patches and uses therefor
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are contractile cell constructs comprising contractile cells, or progenitors thereof, adhered to a surface of a three dimensional fibroblast containing scaffold (3DFCS) and methods for using them to treat disease. In one aspect, the present invention provides methods for preparing a contractile construct, comprising (a) seeding immature contractile cells onto the surface of a three dimensional fibroblast containing scaffold (3DFCS) to produce a contractile construct; and (b) culturing the contractile construct under conditions to promote differentiation of the immature contractile cells into mature contractile cells, wherein the mature contractile cells form striations. In a further aspect, the invention provides methods for treating a disorder characterized by a lack of functioning contractile cells, comprising contacting a patient with a contractile cell-based disorder with an amount effective to treat the disorder with the construct of any embodiment or combination of embodiments of the invention.

title_en: Increasing drug bioavailability in naltrexone therapy
abstract_en: Disclosed are compositions, uses, methods and kits for increasing drug bioavailability in a naltrexone therapy.

title_en: Cdk inhibitors
abstract_en: Compounds of formulae I, II or III, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, are useful as CDK inhibitors.

title_en: Somatostatin modulators and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are compounds that are somatostatin modulators, methods of making such compounds, pharmaceutical compositions and medicaments comprising such compounds, and methods of using such compounds in the treatment of conditions, diseases, or disorders that would benefit from modulation of somatostatin activity.

title_en: Compositions and methods for immunooncology
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to genome editing systems, reagents and methods for immunooncology.

title_en: Long-Acting Injectable Formulations of Ketamine Pamoate Salts
abstract_en: Provided are sustained-release pharmaceutical compositions including a ketamine pamoate salt and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier thereof. The compositions include aqueous suspension, solution and matrix delivery system, which can provide sustained release for anesthesia, analgesia or treatment of central nervous system and anti-inflammatory diseases.

title_en: Cross-linkers and their uses
abstract_en: Charged or pro-charged cross-linking moieties and conjugates of cell binding agents and drugs comprising the charged or pro-charged cross-linking moieties and method of making the same.

title_en: Cysteine protease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel polypeptide which displays IgG cysteine protease activity, and in vivo and ex vivo uses thereof. Uses of the polypeptide include methods for the prevention or treatment of diseases and conditions mediated by IgG, and methods for the analysis of IgG.   [Figure 13]

title_en: Non-Racemic Beta-Hydroxybutyrate Compounds and Compositions Enriched With The R-Enantiomer And Methods Of Use
abstract_en: Ketogenic compositions including a non-racemic mixture of beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) enriched with the R-enantiomer are formulated to increase ketone body level in a subject. The non-racemic mixture of BHB is enriched with the R-enantiomer to elevate ketone bodies and increase the rate at which ketosis is achieved yet contains an amount of the S-enantiomer sufficient to provide alternative benefits as discussed herein. In some aspects a composition for increasing ketone body level in a subject contains a dietetically or pharmaceutically acceptable carrier and a non-racemic mixture of R-beta-hydroxybutyrate and S-beta-hydroxybutyrate, wherein the non- racemic mixture of R-beta-hydroxybutyrate and S-beta-hydroxybutyrate contains from about 55% to 98% by enantiomeric equivalents of the R-beta-hydroxybutyrate and from about 45% to about 2% by enantiomeric equivalents of S-beta- hydroxybutyrate enantiomer.

title_en: Formulations for treating bladder cancer
abstract_en: Compositions and methods for making and using proliposomal and liposomal formulations of chemotherapeutic agents are disclosed. The proliposomal and liposomal formulations of chemotherapeutics, as well as medicaments and dosage forms that include such formulations, can be used with treatment regimens for bladder cancer and urothelial cancer. Hence, the formulations, medicaments, and dosage forms of the invention are suitable to treat bladder cancers by intravesical administration and to treat urothelial cancers. The formulations according to the Invention Include (a) a taxane (e.g., paclitaxel, docetaxel) or cisplatin, (b) a first phospholipid, dipalmitoyl phosphatidylcholine (DMPC), and (c) a second phospholipid, dimyrsityl phosphatidyl glycerol sodium (DMPG). The proliposomal formulations form liposomes upon contact with an aqueous vehicle.

title_en: 5-halouracil-modified micrornas and their use in the treatment of cancer
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides nucleic acid compositions that incorporate one or more halouracil molecules. More specifically, the present disclosure reveals that the replacement of uracil nucleotides within a microRNA nucleotide sequence with a 5-halouracil increases the ability of the micro-RNA to inhibit cancer progression and tumorigenesis. As such, the present disclosure provides various nucleic acid (e.g., microRNA) compositions having 5-halouracil molecules incorporated in their nucleic acid sequences and methods for using the same. The present disclosure further provides pharmaceutical compositions comprising the modified nucleic acid compositions, and methods for treating cancers using the same.

title_en: Two piece sensor assembly and method of use
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a two-piece sensor assembly that includes an attachment collar (110) configured to attach to a body surface of a patient and comprising at least one opening, and a skin sensor (120) configured to seat into the at least one opening in the attachment collar. The skin sensor includes at least one radiation source configured to irradiate the body surface with at least one interrogation light, and at least one detector configured to detect at least one response light incident from the direction of the body surface. title_en: Chimeric antigen receptor and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a heterodimeric, conditionally active chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), and a nucleic acid comprising a nucleotide sequence encoding the CAR. The present disclosure provides cells genetically modified to produce the CAR. A CAR of the present disclosure can be used in various methods, which are also provided. The heterodimeric, conditionally active CAR comprises a) a first polypeptide comprising: i) a first member of a specific binding pair; ii) a first co-stimulatory domain; iii) a first member of a dimerization pair; and iv) a transmembrane domain interposed between the first member of a specific binding pair and the first co-stimulatory domain; and b) a second polypeptide comprising: i) a second member of the dimerization pair; and ii) an intracellular signaling domain; optionally further comprising a transmembrane domain and/or a second co-stimulatory domain, wherein the first and second members of the dimerization pair form a homodimer or a heterodimer in the presence of a dimerizing agent.

title_en: Anti-trem2 antibodies and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The invention is generally directed to methods and compositions that include antibodies, e.g., monoclonal, chimeric, humanized antibodies, antibody fragments, etc., that specifically bind a TREM2 protein, e.g., a mammalian TREM2 and/or human TREM2. The methods provided herein find use in preventing, reducing risk, or treating an individual having dementia, frontotemporal dementia, Alzheimer’s disease, Nasu-Hakola disease, or multiple sclerosis.

title_en: Chimeric antigen receptors targeting fc receptor-like 5 and uses thereof
abstract_en: The presently disclosed subject matter provides for methods and compositions for treating a neoplasia (e.g., multiple myeloma). It relates to chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) that specifically target Fc Receptor-like 5 (FcRL5), e.g., domain 9 of FcRL5, and immunoresponsive cells comprising such CARs. The presently disclosed FcRL5-targeted CARs have enhanced immune-activating properties, including anti-tumor activity.

title_en: Extended release pharmaceutical compositions of levetiracetam
abstract_en: This invention relates to novel extended release pharmaceutical compositions of levetiracetam and preparations and characterizations thereof. This invention further relates to using these extended release pharmaceutical compositions of levetiracetam for the treatment of cognitive impairment associated with central nervous system (CNS) disorders in a subject in need or at risk thereof.

title_en: Anti-garp antibody
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibody that binds to GARP and is useful as a therapeutic agent against tumors, and a method for treating a tumor using the antibody. The present invention addresses the problem of providing an antibody which can be used as a medicine that inhibits the function of Treg in a tumor and thus exhibits a therapeutic effect, and a method for treating a tumor using the antibody. An anti-GARP antibody that binds to GARP and exhibits a Treg-function inhibiting activity and an ADCC activity is obtained. Moreover, a medicinal composition for treating tumors, said composition containing the antibody, is obtained.

title_en: Antigen receptors and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention generally embraces the treatment of diseases by targeting cells expressing an antigen on the cell surface. In particular the invention relates to recombinant antigen receptors and uses thereof. T cells engineered to express such antigen receptors are useful in the treatment of diseases characterized by expression of one or more antigens bound by the antigen receptors. In a particular embodiment the antigen receptor comprises two peptides each comprising a first domain, a second domain, a variable region of a T cell receptor chain, and an immunoreceptor signal transmission domain. The first domain from the first peptide chain interacts with one of the first and second domains from the second peptide chain to form a first antigen binding site. The second domain from the first peptide chain interacts with the other of the first and second domains of the second peptide chain to form a second antigen binding site. In addition, the first peptide chain comprises a variable region of a T cell receptor alpha chain and a constant region of a T cell receptor alpha chain and the second peptide chain comprises a variable region of a T cell receptor beta chain and a constant region of a T cell receptor beta chain. Alternatively, the first peptide chain comprises a variable region of a T cell receptor beta chain and a constant region of a T cell receptor beta chain and the second peptide chain comprises a variable region of a T cell receptor alpha chain and a constant region of a T cell receptor alpha chain.
