abstract_en: Thermal sterilisation of an antisense oligonucleotide This invention relates to a method for sterilising nusinersen or a salt thereof, comprising a step of heating an aqueous solution of nusinersen or a salt thereof. It also provides a sterile pharmaceutical compositions obtainable by the method for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA).

title_en: Method for monitoring response of subject to both yap1 inhibitor and wwtr1 inhibitor, stratification method and auxiliary method thereof, and pcsk9 expression inhibitor and composition for treatment or prevention of pcsk9-related diseases
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for monitoring a response of a subject to both a YAP1 inhibitor and a WWTR1 inhibitor, and a method for assisting the monitoring method. The present disclosure also relates to a method for stratifying subjects who benefit from administration of a YAP1 inhibitor and a WWTR1 inhibitor, and a method for assisting the stratification method. The present disclosure also relates to a PCSK9 expression inhibitor comprising a YAP1 inhibitor and a WWTR1 inhibitor, and a composition comprising the same for treating or preventing PCSK9-related diseases.

title_en: N-acyl amides and analogs
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides pharmaceutical compositions, dosage forms comprising the pharmaceutical composition, and methods of treating inflammation, decreasing inflammation, decreasing an inflammatory marker, treating inflammatory bowel disease, and treating colorectal cancer in a subject in need thereof, comprising administering the pharmaceutical compositions or dosage forms disclosed herein to a subject in need thereof.

title_en: Cholix-derived delivery construct
abstract_en: The present invention provides a delivery construct comprising: (a) a transport facilitator comprising an immunoglobulin CH2 domain; (b) a transporter comprising a cholix domain Ia; and (c) a therapeutic cargo; wherein the transporter is cleavably coupled to the therapeutic cargo and wherein the transport facilitator is N-terminal to the transporter. Also provided are pharmaceutical compositions comprising the delivery construct.

title_en: Treatment of disorders using sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor modulators
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the treatment of disorders using sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor modulators. Specifically, the present invention relates to the treatment of neurological disorders such as multiple sclerosis using sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor modulators such as fingolimod. Also disclosed are compositions for administration of the sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor modulator to a subject; methods for manufacturing such compositions; and methods of delivering the sphingosine- 1-phosphate receptor modulator to a subject.

title_en: Irreversible fap inhibitor and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, relates to an irreversible FAP inhibitor and a use thereof, and a use of the compound in a drug for diagnosing and/or treating tumors, rheumatoid arthritis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, atherosclerosis, myocardial infarction, liver fibrosis, pulmonary fibrosis, and renal fibrosis, and in particular to a compound represented by formula I, or an isomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or metal complex thereof, and a use thereof. Substituents in formula I have the same definitions as those in the description.

title_en: Kras inhibitors
abstract_en: Disclosed are compounds of Formula (I), methods of using the compounds for inhibiting KRAS activity and pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds. The compounds are useful in treating, preventing or ameliorating diseases or disorders associated with KRAS activity such as cancer.

title_en: Protective antigen combination of mycobacterium tuberculosis and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a protective antigen combination of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and the use thereof. Specifically, the antigen is a combined antigen and contains at least the following antigens: Ag85B, Rv2465c, Rv2029c and Rv3406. The use is for the preparation of a vaccine against Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

title_en: Use of compounds for treating or preventing inflammatory skin disorders
abstract_en: Provided herewith is use of a compound of formula (I) for treating or preventing inflammatory skin disorders and psoriasis, wherein the variables are as defined in the specification.

title_en: Deuterated organic compound and uses thereof
abstract_en: Provided is Compound A, described herein, its preparation, its use as a pharmaceutical, and pharmaceutical compositions comprising it. Compound A is useful, for instance, in modulating dopamine and serotonin neurotransmission and treating disorders that may benefit from the same, such as schizophrenia and depression.

title_en: Antibody formulation and use thereof
abstract_en: A liquid formulation, comprising an anti-IgE antibody, a buffer, a stabilizer and a surfactant, wherein the buffer is selected from a histidine/histidine hydrochloric acid buffer, an acetic acid/sodium acetate buffer and/or a histidine/sodium acetate buffer, the stabilizer is selected from sorbitol and/or sucrose, and the surfactant is selected from polysorbate 20 and/or polysorbate 80. Further provided are a freeze-dried formulation comprising the liquid formulation, and the use of the liquid formulation or freeze-dried reagent in the prevention, diagnosis and/or treatment of diseases.

title_en: Kv7 modulators
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel compounds of formula (I), which modulate the K v 7 potassium channels. Separate aspects of the invention are directed to pharmaceutical compositions comprising said compounds and uses of the compounds to treat disorders responsive to the activation of K v 7 potassium channels with B being defined as moiety of formula (II) and A being defined as moiety of formula (III).

title_en: Active agent having the potential for use in the treatment of alzheimer's and certain neurodegenerative disorders
abstract_en: The invention relates to the development of an active agent increasing the activity of α-carbonic anhydrase (hCA) enzymes, having the potential to be used in the treatment of Alzheimer's and certain neurodegenerative disorders.

title_en: Heterocyclic carboxylic acid derivative, preparation method therefor, and pharmaceutical application thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a heterocyclic carboxylic acid derivative, a preparation method therefor, and a pharmaceutical application thereof. Specifically, provided are a heterocyclic carboxylic acid derivative as represented by general formula (I), a preparation method therefor, a pharmaceutical composition comprising the derivative, and a use thereof as a therapeutic agent, in particular as an sGC (soluble guanylate cyclase) agonist and/or activator, and the use thereof in the preparation of a drug for treating and/or preventing diseases responsive to sGC agonists and/or activators.

title_en: Crystal form of morpholinyl-containing isoindoline compound, and preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a crystal form of a morpholinyl-containing isoindoline compound, and a preparation method therefor and a use thereof. Specifically, a crystal form of a compound of formula (I) is disclosed. The crystal form of the compound of formula (I) provided by the present invention exhibits good stability and has good prospects for pharmaceutical applications.

title_en: Mesothelin-cd3-epsilon bispecific antibodies
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to mesothelin-CD3 epsilon chain (CD3e)- human Fc bispecific antibodies. The present invention provides a method for producing the bispecific antigen-binding molecule in cells with mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (LNP). This invention provides method of antibody production in cells through  in vitro  transcription of mRNA-LNP and  in vivo  intratumoral delivery of RNA-LNP antibody to provide high  in vivo  efficacy. The present invention is further directed to a method for treating mesothelin-positive cancer cells by administering the bispecific mesothelin-CD3e-human Fc antibody to tumors. Intratumoral delivery of mesothelin-CD3 human Fc bispecific mRNA-LNP antibodies is effective to kill mesothelin positive cancer.

title_en: Use of resistant potato starch as a prebiotic to modify microbiota
abstract_en: Consumption of resistant potato starch results in changes to the gut microbiome in elderly adults, resulting in a healthier gut microbiome profile. Furthermore, consumption of resistant potato starch stimulates an increase in Bifidobacterium abundance in all individuals and also reduces levels of E. coli and Shigella. Furthermore, consumption of MSPrebiotic® increased the relative ratio of butyrate in the elderly and significantly reduced the use of stool softeners in the elderly.

title_en: Fire retardant cables formed from halogen-free and heavy metal-free compositions
abstract_en: Fire retardant compositions including a base polymer, a fire retardant filler, and a fire retardant synergist are disclosed. The fire retardant compositions are halogen-free and heavy metal-free and can be crosslinked to form a cable insulation layer or a cable jacket. The cables can pass the UL VW-1 flame test. Cables having coverings formed from such fire retardant compositions are also described herein.

title_en: Solvent free liquid moisture curable polyurethane compositions with long open times and fast cure rates
abstract_en: Disclosed is a liquid, solvent free, moisture curable polyurethane adhesive composition comprising the reaction products of at least one polyoxypropylene polyol having a hydroxyl functionality of at least three and ethylene oxide end-capping with one or more polyisocyanates having a weight average isocyanate functionality of greater than 2.3. The adhesive composition has a long open time and rapid cure time compared to currently available adhesives. The polyoxypropylene polyol preferably has a number average molecular weight of from 3,000 to 8,000. The composition finds special use in panel lamination applications.

title_en: Coating compositions for polymeric roofing materials
abstract_en: A latex emulsion may include an aqueous carrier liquid and a latex copolymer formed from reactants comprising butyl methacrylate, wherein the reactants include at least 20 wt. % butyl methacrylate, based on the total weight of ethylenically unsaturated monomers used to make the latex copolymer. A coating formed from the latex emulsion exhibits a wet adhesion to a thermoplastic polyolefin roofing membrane of greater than about 1 pound per linear inch when tested using fabric embedded peel adhesion testing per ASTM C794. The latex emulsion may be used as part of an aqueous coating composition or a roofing system including a polymeric roofing membrane.

title_en: Dermal fillers and applications thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure herein relates to photoinitiated dermal fillers, hyaluronic acid-rhCollagen double crosslinked dermal fillers and hyaluronic acid-rhCollagen semi interpenetrated network, each comprising plant-derived human collagen, as well as methods of using the same.

title_en: Purified capsular polysaccharides of Streptococcus pneumoniae
abstract_en: The invention relates to capsular polysaccharides of Streptococcus pneumoniae. More specifically, the present invention relates to sized and purified capsular polysaccharides of

title_en: Synthesis of re-pulpable temporary wet strength polymer for tissue application
abstract_en: A grafted polyvinyl alcohol polymer has a balance between hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity. The grafted polyvinyl alcohol polymer has a chemical functionality that allows for adsorption onto the pulp fibers, polymer film formation upon drying, repelling water upon wetting, polymer film swelling and breaking for prolonged wetting by water. When incorporated into paper products, the polymer can provide a paper having improved wet strength, temporary water repellency, and/or is dispersible in aqueous solutions.

title_en: Printable film
abstract_en: An extruded multilayer film includes a top layer comprising a blend of a polyolefin and adsorbent silica. The adsorbent silica is 5% or more of the blend and the polyolefin is 95% or less of the blend. The multilayer film is oriented in at least one direction to cause fracturing of the top layer to provide a microporous surface exposing the adsorbent silica gel. The fractured top layer is receptive to receiving a printing ink on an exposed surface thereof with enhanced pigment entrapment and rapid ink drying. A single layer film in the form of the top layer, and also oriented in at least one direction also constitutes a part of this invention.

title_en: Flow cell including a heteropolymer
abstract_en: A flow cell includes a support and a heteropolymer attached to the support. The heteropolymer includes an acrylamide monomer including an attachment group to react with a functional group attached to a primer, and a monomer including a stimuli-responsive functional group. The monomer including the stimuli-responsive functional group may be pH-responsive, temperature-responsive, saccharide-responsive, nucleophile-responsive, and/or salt-responsive.

title_en: Multi-layer haemostat patch comprising beta-chitin
abstract_en:
A haemostat agent in the form of a multi-layer patch comprising at least first and second layers, 
wherein said first layer comprises a composition comprising fibrous p-chitin (which may be sourced 
from a marine source such as squid pens) and one or more biocompatible polymer (for example, a 
polyethylene glycol (PEG) polymer or sodium polyphosphate (PolyP)), and said second layer 
comprises a film layer comprising fibrous -chitin. In one particular application, the haemostat agent 
is used for treating carotid artery injury associated with endonasal surgery.

title_en: Para-phenylenes as buffer and color tuning layersfor solar cells
abstract_en: Photovoltaic devices having photoactive layers coupled to buffer layers are disclosed. Such devices may be transparent to visible light but absorb near-infrared light and/or ultraviolet light. The photovoltaic devices may include a p-phenylene layer that acts as a buffer layer. The photovoltaic devices may include one or more photoactive layers. The one or more photoactive layers may include a single planar heterojunction, a single bulk heterojunction (BHJ), or multiple stacked BHJs that have complementary absorption characteristics, among other possibilities.

title_en: Purification of saccharides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods for purifying bacterial polysaccharides, in particular for removing impurities from cellular lysates of bacteria producing polysaccharides, comprising: a) acid hydrolysis; b) a first ultrafiltration/diafiltration-(UFDF-1); b) carbon filtration; c) chromatography; and d) a second ultrafiltration/diafiltration-(UFDF-2).

title_en: Barrier composition, use and production method thereof, structures, use and production method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a barrier composition comprising a modified or unmodified starch, a plasticizer and an MFC, and to a method for producing the barrier composition and the use thereof, such as in a multi-layer structure comprising the barrier composition and a carrier layer. Methods for producing a multi-layer structure comprising a barrier composition are also disclosed, and can be applied in order to obtain an article that comprises the multi-layer structure.

title_en: Stabilized polyolefin compositions comprising benzofuranones and organophosphorus stabilizers
abstract_en:
Polyolefin compositions comprising i) a polyolefin, ii) one or more phosphorus
containing benzofuranone compounds and iii) one or more organophosphorus stabilizers are 
provided excellent protection against discoloration and enhanced thermal stability during 
melt processing as exhibited by improved retention of molecular weight and maintenance of 
polymer molecular architecture.

title_en: Silk performance apparel and products and methods of preparing the same
abstract_en:
Silk infused performance apparel and methods of preparing the same are 
disclosed herein. In some embodiments, silk performance apparel includes textiles, 
fabrics, consumer products, leather, and other materials that are coated with aqueous 
5 solutions of pure silk fibroin-based protein fragments. In some embodiments, coated 
apparel products, textiles, and upholstery, as well as other materials, exhibit surprisingly 
improved moisture management properties, resistance to microbial growth, increased 
abrasion resistance, and flame resistance.

title_en: Process for making ethanolamines, polyethylenimine and ammonia based on non-fossil energy
abstract_en: Ethanolamines, polyethylenimine and ammonia having a low molar share of deuterium, a process for making ethanolamines, polyethylenimine and ammonia based on non- fossil energy, the use of the molar share of deuterium in hydrogen and downstream compounds based on hydrogen for tracing the origin of preparation of hydrogen and downstream compounds based on hydrogen, and a process for tracing the origin of preparation of hydrogen and downstream compounds based on hydrogen by determining the molar share of deuterium in hydrogen and said downstream compounds based on hydrogen, applications of the polyethylenimine and the use of the polyethylenimine, and the use of the ethanolamines, preferably monoethanolamine and/or diethanolamine, or the polyethylenimine as liquid or solid CO

title_en: A multi-component direct to metal and plastic primer system
abstract_en: A multi-component primer system is provided. The system includes a first component, a second component, and a third component. The first component comprises an acrylic resin, a polyester resin, and an epoxy resin. The acrylic resin and the polyester resin each have acetoacetoxy functionality. The second component comprises ketimines. The third component comprises a reducer solvent.

title_en: Crosslinkable polymeric compositions with n, n, n', n', n", n"-hexaallyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4,6-triamine crosslinking coagent, methods for making the same, and articles made therefrom
abstract_en: Crosslinkable polymeric compositions comprising a thermoplastic, non-elastomer ethylene-based polymer, an organic peroxide, and a crosslinking coagent comprising N, N, N', N', N", N" -hexaallyl-1, 3, 5-triazine-2, 4, 6-triamine. Such crosslinkable polymeric compositions and their crosslinked forms can be employed as polymeric layers in wire and cable applications, such as insulation in power cables.

title_en: A process for the manufacture of a shaped body
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a shaped body comprising lignin which may be further processed into intermediate carbon fibers and finally also carbon fibers. Uses of said fibers are also disclosed. The present invention addresses the problem of lignin leaching into a precipitation bath. The solution to this problem is a novel method for minimizing the loss of lignin through the addition of certain salts into the precipitation bath.

title_en: Catalyst systems containing low valent titanium-aluminum complexes and polymers produced therefrom
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods for synthesizing low valence, titanium-aluminum complexes from half-metallocene titanium compounds and alkylaluminum compounds. The titanium-aluminum complexes can be used as components in catalyst systems for the polymerization of olefins.

title_en: Prepolymer of elastomer material for screw drilling tool and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a prepolymer of elastomer material for screw drilling tools and a preparation method thereof. The prepolymer includes component A  and component B, wherein the component A includes hydroxyl-terminated liquid rubber, polytetrahydrofuran diol, and polyether polyol; the component B includes at least one of an isocyanate, a cyanate, and a cyano compound; the mass ratio of the hydroxyl-terminated liquid rubber, polytetrahydrofuran diol, and polyether polyol is (0.2-1.0):(0.2-1.0):(0.2-1.0). The present invention introduces different molecular segments of different proportions through structural design, such that the molecular structure of the prepolymer has both rigid and flexible segments, thus to achieve an adjustable and controllable structure of the prepolymer; and the introduction of active groups makes the prepolymer to show good reactivity and processability.  According to the present invention, a reactive elastomer material having excellent properties such as hardness, tear strength, and tensile strength can be obtained, and can be used as an elastomer material for screw drilling tools in the field of drilling technology.

title_en: Polyglycolide copolymer composition and preparation thereof
abstract_en: A composition comprises a polyglycolide or a polyglycolide copolymer and a filler. The polyglycolide is prepared from glycolide by ring-opening polymerization. The composition may have a tensile modulus greater than 5, 800 MPa. The polyglycolide copolymer may have a weight-average molecular weight (Mw) in the range of 10, 000-1, 000, 000 and a ratio of a weight-average molecular weight to a number-average molecular weight (Mw/Mn) in the range of 1.0 to 10Ø The polyglycolide copolymer may have a melt index (MFR) in the range of 0.1 to 1000 g/10 min. Also provided is a process for preparing the composition.

title_en: Highly crosslinked polymer particulate
abstract_en: Highly crosslinked polymer particulate. The highly crosslinked polymer particulate includes a plurality of crosslinked polymer granules. The crosslinked polymer granules include a highly crosslinked polymeric material. A characteristic dimension of each crosslinked polymer granule of the plurality of crosslinked polymer granules is at least 10 micrometers and at most 5 millimeters.

title_en: Mass cytometry reagents and methods for signal amplification
abstract_en: Described herein are reagents and methods for improving signal in imaging mass cytometry. Aspects include mass tags with a large number of labeling atoms, chemical modifications to mass tags and additional reagents to reduce background and/or maintain target binding of mass tagged specific binding partners (SBPs), and schemes for associating a plurality of mass tags with a single SBP. As such, embodiments include any combination of one or more reagents and their use. The reagents, kits and methods herein may be used for mass cytometry, including imaging mass cytometry. In some aspects, reagents, kits or methods may be used for delivery of a large number of radioisotopes to a target analyte, for example for therapeutic use or radiometric detection. In certain aspects, only non-radioactive isotopes may be used for mass cytometry.

title_en: Method for treating obesity and/or hypertension
abstract_en: There is provided a method of treating obesity and/or hypertension in a subject in need thereof by administering a therapeutically effective amount of a low molecular weight levan or a pharmaceutical composition comprising the low molecular weight levan and a pharmaceutically acceptable excipient.

title_en: Calcium carbonate for improving the mechanical properties of thermoplastic polymer compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filled polymer composition comprising at least one polyolefin polymer, at least one thermoplastic polymer and a calcium carbonate-containing filler material, a process for the production thereof, the use of a calcium carbonate-containing filler material in a polymer composition comprising at least one polyolefin polymer and at least one thermoplastic polymer, as well as an article comprising the filled polymer composition.

title_en: Pneumatique comportant une bande de roulement recreusable
abstract_en: "The invention relates to a tire (1) regroovable at least once and whose tread comprises at least one regroovable groove (3). According to the invention, after regrooving, the height (HT) of said at least one regroovable groove (3) is greater than or equal to 70% of the groove height (GH3) of said at least one regroovable groove of the tire in new condition, the elastomer mixture forming the outer surface of the tread comprising a quantity of plasticizers less than 15 inches and the linearity rate of the complex dynamic shear modulus G*, measured at a temperature of 23°C according to the ASTM D 5992-96 standard, of said elastomer mixture being greater than 0.55."

title_en: Aqueous coating compositions including solvent systems for low temperature storage and application
abstract_en: An aqueous coating composition that includes a monoalcohol and a diol or polyol, and a compound with urea functionality is disclosed. The aqueous coating composition has less than 250 grams per liter VOC, is capable of being quality application to a variety of substrates at temperatures below freezing (32ºF), being stored for more than 2 weeks below freezing without bulk freezing, and being applied by a variety of usual application techniques (brush, roller, sprayer) at temperatures below freezing. The additives may be added individual during manufacturing of the coating composition or added together to a coating composition as a low temperature additive package.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible composite hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of composite hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving acrylic acid, an oxidant, a doping modifier and N, N' -methylene bisacrylamide in deionized water, stirring and dispersing by utilizing ultrasonic waves to form a solution; (2) adding a conductive polymer monomer into the solution formed in the step (1), stirring and dispersing by utilizing ultrasonic waves to form a reaction system; (3) adding an initiator into the solution obtained in the step (1), and stirring and dissolving to form a reaction system; (4) standing the reaction system obtained in the steps (2) and (3) at the temperature of 60-80 ℃ for 6-24h to obtain a product, and (5) taking out the product obtained in the step (4), and cleaning the surface with deionized water to obtain the flexible composite hydrogel.

title_en: Polymethacrylol copolymer, molded article using same, and method for producing polymethacrylol copolymer
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polymethacrylol copolymer, a method for producing the same, and a molded article using the same, wherein the polymethacrylol copolymer contains a structural unit (A) represented by the following formula (A) and a structural unit (B) represented by the following formula (B), and the molar ratio (A)/(B) of the structural unit (A) to the structural unit (B) is 0.5 or more. In the formula (B), X represents at least 1 selected from hydrogen atom, alkoxy, hydroxyl and alkyl with 1-3 carbon atoms.

title_en: Conductive material and laminate
abstract_en: A conductive material excellent in strength, conductivity and conductive durability is obtained, and further a laminate having a non-conductive resin layer on one surface or both surfaces thereof and exhibiting excellent conductivity, excellent conductive durability and excellent adhesion strength, and a molded article are obtained. By providing a conductive material having a fluorine-based polymer (X) 2 ) In which 0.1 to 95 wt% of a polymer conductive composition (X) 1 ) The composition of (4), the polymer conductive composition (X) 1 ) The fluorine-containing polymer is obtained by graft polymerizing 2-90 mol% of a molten salt monomer having a salt structure containing an onium cation and a fluorine-containing anion and having a polymerizable functional group onto a fluorine-containing polymer.

title_en: Thermosetting release coating agent, release film, and method for producing release film
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel thermosetting release coating agent which can form a cured coating film with excellent release property and less bleeding problem on a plastic film in a relatively low temperature and a short time. The heat-curable release coating agent contains: (A) a polyol having at least 3 hydroxyl groups in a molecule, a molecular weight of 80 to 5000, and a hydroxyl value of 30 to 2000mgKOH/g, or (A1) a polyol having at least 3 hydroxyl groups in a molecule, a molecular weight of 200 to 5000, and a hydroxyl value of 30 to 840mgKOH/g, and (A2) a polyol having at least 3 hydroxyl groups in a molecule, a molecular weight of 80 to 200, and a hydroxyl value of 841 to 2000 mgKOH/g; (B) a hydroxyl-containing silicone; and (C) a polyisocyanate.

title_en: Falling film melt polycondensation reactor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a falling film type melt polycondensation reactor. The upper part of the reactor tower body is connected with an end enclosure, the lower part of the reactor tower body is connected with a bottom shell, the end enclosure is connected with a heat medium chamber and a material chamber, the lower bottom plate of the material chamber is a material distribution plate, material falling film supporting tubes arranged in rows on the distribution plate penetrate through the material falling film supporting tubes, and film distribution holes located between adjacent falling film supporting tubes in the same row are respectively configured at two sides of the falling film supporting tubes on the distribution plate; the falling film supporting tubes are of a sleeve structure, the tube spacing between two adjacent falling film supporting tubes in the same row is 4 to 60 mm, and the diameters of the falling film supporting tubes are 4 to 100 mm; the bottom shell is internally provided with a stirrer, a screw and a material outlet. The melt polycondensation reactor can provide a larger film forming area, has high devolatilization efficiency and narrow residence time distribution, and is suitable for implementing melt polycondensation of materials such as polyester and the like.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant waterproof film and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature-resistant waterproof film and a manufacturing method thereof, solves the problems that the waterproof film is easy to be damaged and bleeds when a waterproof zipper is ironed in the prior art, and discloses the high-temperature-resistant waterproof film which is prepared by adopting the following substances: the polyurethane resin, butanone, toner, polyisocyanate resin and wear-resisting agent are in the following weight ratio: 1: 0.4: (0.018-0.03): (0.01-0.05): (0.01-0.05). The waterproof membrane manufactured by the manufacturing method of the high-temperature-resistant waterproof membrane can be ironed at the high temperature of 200 ℃ without foaming and peeling.

title_en: Particle, particle material, connecting material, and connecting structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a particle which can inhibit the generation of cracks when loading stress and can improve the moisture resistance. The 10% K value of the particles according to the invention is 100N/mm 2 The 10% K value is 100N/mm 2 The following particles comprise: the silicone resin composition includes a silicone particle body and a plurality of organic resin particles attached to a surface of the silicone particle body.

title_en: Sealing agent for liquid crystal display element, vertical conduction material, and liquid crystal display element
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a sealant for a liquid crystal display element, which has excellent curability of a light shielding part and can inhibit liquid crystal pollution. Further, another object of the present invention is to provide a vertical conduction material and a liquid crystal display element using the sealant for a liquid crystal display element. The sealant for a liquid crystal display element comprises a curable resin and a photo-radical polymerization initiator, wherein the curable resin contains a compound having a molecular weight of 100 or more and less than 500 and a compound having a molecular weight of 500-3000, and the photo-radical polymerization initiator is a compound having a carbazole skeleton.

title_en: 3-hydroxy-4-alkyl phenyl phosphite triester, preparation method thereof and application thereof as styrene thermoplastic elastomer anti-aging agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses 3-hydroxy-4-alkyl phenyl phosphite triester and a preparation method thereof and application of the triester as an age inhibitor of a styrene thermoplastic elastomer; the preparation method of the 3-hydroxy-4-alkyl phenyl phosphite triester comprises the steps of carrying out Friedel-crafts acylation reaction on resorcinol and monocarboxylic acid to obtain a2, 4-dihydroxy phenyl alkyl ketone compound; reducing carbonyl of the 2, 4-dihydroxyphenyl alkyl ketone compound to obtain a 4-alkylresorcinol compound; the 3-hydroxy-4-alkyl phenyl phosphite triester simultaneously contains a triphenyl phosphite structure and a phenol structure, and a large amount of long-chain alkyl is introduced, so that the 4-alkyl resorcinol compound is characterized by volatilization resistance and good stability, can be used for preventing ageing of styrene thermoplastic elastomers, has small dosage and obvious effect, is green and environment-friendly, and can meet the requirements of European Union Reach regulations.

title_en: Polymerizable compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polymerizable compound comprising at least two cyclic structure units, and an acrylate or methacrylate structural unit; wherein at least one ring structure unit is a benzofuran ring structure unit, and at least one ring structure unit is connected with the benzofuran ring structure unit by a carbon-carbon single bond. The polymerizable compounds of the present invention are selected from the group consisting of formulas i and ii. The polymerizable compound has the characteristics of stable structure and property, can effectively form a pretilt angle when applied to a liquid crystal medium, and can still show stability after long-time high-temperature power-up test after the pretilt angle is formed. The polymerizable compound of the invention can be widely applied to liquid crystal display devices.

title_en: Mildew-proof preservative film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mildew-proof preservative film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mildew-proof preservative film comprises a base film, a silicon rubber coating and a mildew-proof preservative coating; the base film is provided with air holes, the silicon rubber coating and the mildew-proof fresh-keeping coating are respectively formed on the surfaces of two sides of the base film, and the silicon rubber coating comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 52 to 63 percent of silicon rubber, 20 to 25 percent of polyurethane, 12 to 18 percent of poly acrylic gamma-methacryloxypropyl trimethoxy silane, 5 to 10 percent of silicon carbide, 3 to 8 percent of titanium dioxide and 1 to 3 percent of univalent silver source. When the mildew-proof preservative film is used for packaging materials, the freshness of fruits and vegetables in the transportation and storage processes can be effectively prolonged, and the market application prospect is wide.

title_en: Self-supporting non-fouling polymers, compositions thereof and related monomers
abstract_en: Self-supporting non-fouling polymers and polymer compositions, monomers and macromers used to make the polymers and polymer compositions, objects made from the polymers and polymer compositions, and methods of making and using the polymers and polymer compositions.

title_en: Epoxy butane composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an epoxybutane composition comprising at least 99.5 wt.% epoxybutane and less than 2000wppm epoxyisobutane. Mainly solves the problems of long separation flow, limited yield and low purity of the butylene oxide by producing a small amount of butylene oxide as a byproduct of propylene oxide production, and discloses a butylene oxide composition, in particular to a method for producing the butylene oxide composition by a hydrogen peroxide isopropyl process (CHP process).

title_en: Fluoropolymer hybrid composites
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fluoropolymer hybrid organic/inorganic composite, to a thin film comprising said fluoropolymer hybrid organic/inorganic composite and to the use of said thin film in various applications, in particular in electrochemical and photoelectrochemical applications.

title_en: Modified linear low-density polyethylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified linear low-density polyethylene material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of linear low-density polyethylene resin, 0.2-4 parts of modifier, 0-10 parts of compatilizer and 0.15-0.60 part of composite antioxidant, wherein the composite antioxidant is composed of antioxidant 1010 and antioxidant 168 according to the weight ratio of 1: 3, the modifier is graphene, the compatilizer is maleic anhydride grafted POE, and the grafting rate is 1-2.5%.

title_en: Continuous polymerization apparatus and process for producing polymer composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a continuous polymerization apparatus and process for producing a polymer composition. The present invention provides a novel continuous polymerization apparatus capable of efficiently producing a polymer composition suitable for obtaining a high-quality resin composition. In a continuous polymerization apparatus, at least a first reactor of a complete mixing type and a second reactor (10, 20) of a complete mixing type are used. Each of the reactors (10, 20) is provided with feed ports (11a, 21a), discharge ports (11b, 21b) and a temperature detecting means (T) for detecting the temperature in the reactor, wherein the feed port (11 a) of the first reactor (10) is connected to the supply sources (1, 3) of the raw material monomer and the polymerization initiator, and the discharge port (11 b) of the first reactor is connected to the feed port (21 a) of the second reactor (20) through a connecting line (15) provided with a cooling means (16). The cooling device (16) is controlled so that the temperature in the connecting line adjacent to the feed port (21 a) of the second reactor is lower than the temperature in the first reactor (10).

title_en: Aqueous polyamide-urea dispersions
abstract_en: Aqueous polyamide-urea dispersions are disclosed. These polymers have enhanced properties compared to similar polyamides due to better hydrolysis resistance of polyamides compared to polyesters and better UV resistance of polyamides compared to polyethers. Polyurea linkages also improve performance compared to polyurethane linkages. Composites and hybrids of these polymers and other polyamides with vinyl polymers are also disclosed and claimed.

title_en: Main chain benzoxazine copolymer oligomer, copolymer resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a main chain benzoxazine copolymer oligomer, copolymer resin and a preparation method thereof. Preparation of main chain benzoxazine copolymer oligomer: adding an aldehyde compound, a phenolic compound and a diamine compound into a reaction container in a one-step feeding or multi-step feeding manner, adding an organic solvent for dissolving, reacting at 80-115 ℃ for 6-48 h, and performing post-treatment to obtain a main chain benzoxazine copolymer oligomer, wherein the phenolic compound comprises a dihydric phenol compound and a monohydric phenol compound. The copolymer oligomer has good processing performance, and the copolymer resin obtained by heating and curing not only keeps the high crosslinking density of pure main chain benzoxazine resin and has good main chain benzoxazine thermal performance and toughness, but also has excellent dielectric property, namely low dielectric constant and dielectric loss under high frequency, and can be used for the fields of high-frequency and high-speed circuit board base materials, microwave and millimeter wave communication, vehicle-mounted radars and other composite materials.

title_en: Carbon fiber recycling composition and method
abstract_en: Methods and compositions for depolymerizing the polymer component of a fiber-reinforced polymer to facilitate free fiber recovery are disclosed.

title_en: Water reducing agents based on polycondensates
abstract_en: The present invention relates to polycondensates comprising at least one structural unit which is an aromatic moiety bearing polyether side chains; at least one structural unit which is an aromatic moiety bearing at least one phosphate monoester group; at least one structural unit which is an aromatic part with at least one hydroxyl group and at least one methylene unit (-CH) 2 -) said methylene unit connecting two aromatic structural units. The invention also relates to a method for producing said polycondensates, to their use for dispersing inorganic adhesives, for increasing the strength gain of concrete and for improving the slump retention of concrete. The invention also relates to a building material mixture comprising the polycondensate and an inorganic binder.

title_en: Electrophotographic photoreceptor, electrophotographic photoreceptor cartridge, image forming apparatus, and dispersant for fluorine-based resin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: an electrophotographic photoreceptor which is excellent in abrasion resistance and electrical characteristics and has a long life by using a fluorine-based resin and a polymer having a structure represented by a specific structural formula; an electrophotographic photoreceptor cartridge containing the electrophotographic photoreceptor; and an imaging device; and a dispersant having excellent dispersibility of the fluorine-based resin particles and excellent electrical characteristics and compatibility with the binder resin.

title_en: Polypropylene toughening master batch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughening master batch and a preparation method thereof, in particular to a polypropylene toughening master batch and a preparation method thereof. The polypropylene toughening master batch is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 65-82 parts of polypropylene; 3-5 parts of a nucleating agent; 10-20 parts of metallocene linear low-density polyethylene; 5-10 parts of an inorganic substance; 0.3-0.6 part of antioxidant; 0.02-0.1 part of an acid acceptor; 0.03-0.1 part of processing rheological agent; wherein the sum of the mass parts of the polypropylene, the nucleating agent, the metallocene linear low-density polyethylene and the inorganic matter is 100 parts. The master batch is applied to toughening of polypropylene, so that a polypropylene material with good normal and low temperature impact strength and heat resistance can be obtained, and other mechanical properties are not reduced; the preparation method is scientific, reasonable, simple and feasible.

title_en: Oil-free middle bundle core formed by plastic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, and provides a plastic-molded oil-free middle-bundle core aiming at the problems of inconvenient production and possible quality reduction of lipstick bodies, wherein the technical scheme is as follows: including the base, rotate well beam pipe of being connected and with base threaded connection lipstick supporting piece with the base, well beam pipe includes: 100 parts of hard plastic; 0.8-2.5 parts of antioxidant; the lipstick holder includes: 100 parts of hard plastic; 4-9 parts of a lubricant; 0.8-3.3 parts of antioxidant; the base comprises; 100 parts of hard plastic; 4-9 parts of a lubricant; 0.8-1.8 parts of antioxidant. By adding the lubricant, the friction force between the parts is reduced, the use hand feeling is ensured, and the lubricant is mixed into the hard plastic during injection molding, so that the subsequent operation of manually smearing the lubricant is not needed, and the production is convenient; because the lubricant is mixed into the hard plastic in proportion during production, the possibility of polluting the lipstick body caused by excessive dosage is reduced, and the quality of the lipstick body is maintained.

title_en: Bio-based polyol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based polyol and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) simultaneously pumping an ethyl acetate solution of 1, 2-dimethyl-7-oxabicyclo [4.1.0] heptane and an alcoholic solution of potassium hydroxide into a first microreactor of a micro-reaction device for reaction to obtain a reaction effluent; (2) and (2) pumping the reaction effluent obtained in the step (1) and an ethyl acetate solution of the epoxidized vegetable oil into a second microreactor of the microreactor at the same time for reaction to obtain the bio-based polyol. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple and efficient, and has the advantages of high selectivity, high safety, continuous production and no need of using a novel catalyst.

title_en: Polymerizable silane compound
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a novel polymerizable silane compound which is used in a polymerizable composition having a cured product that exhibits a high refractive index and a low Abbe number and which is further suitable for producing a molded article having high transparency. The solution is the formula [1]The polymerizable silane compound and polysiloxane which is a polycondensate of the polymerizable silane compound. (wherein X represents a phenyl group, a naphthyl group, a biphenyl group or a phenanthryl group having at least 1 substituent having a polymerizable double bond, Ar 1 Represents a condensed polycyclic hydrocarbon group (which may have an alkyl substituent having 1 to 6 carbon atoms) or a hydrocarbon ring assembly group in which a plurality of aromatic rings are directly bonded by a single bond (which may have an alkyl substituent having 1 to 6 carbon atoms), R 1 Represents a methyl group, an ethyl group, or an isopropyl group. )

title_en: Acrylamide copolymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of oilfield chemicals, and discloses an acrylamide copolymer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the acrylamide copolymer comprises a structural unit A, a structural unit B and a structural unit C, wherein the structural unit A is a structural unit shown in a formula (I), the structural unit B is a structural unit shown in a formula (II), and the structural unit C is a structural unit shown in a formula (III); and the content of the structural unit A is 70-90 wt%, the content of the structural unit B is 8-28 wt%, and the content of the structural unit C is 0.1-5 wt% based on the total weight of the acrylamide copolymer. The acrylamide copolymer can be used as a thermal thickener for tertiary oil recovery of high-temperature and high-salinity oil reservoirs.

title_en: Solid catalyst component for olefin polymerization, olefin polymerization catalyst, application thereof and ethylene copolymer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of olefin polymerization catalysts, and particularly relates to a solid catalyst component for olefin polymerization, an olefin polymerization catalyst, application thereof and an ethylene copolymer. The solid catalyst component comprises magnesium, titanium, halogen and an internal electron donor compound, wherein the internal electron donor compound comprises at least one of cyclotri-veratrolene shown in formula (I) and derivatives thereof, and in the formula (I), M is 1 、M 2 、M 3 、M 4 、M 5 And M 6 Each selected from hydrogen, hydroxyl, amino, aldehyde, carboxyl, acyl, etc. The invention provides the use of the cyclotri veratrum hydrocarbon and the derivative thereof as an internal electron donor of the olefin polymerization catalyst, and compared with a solid catalyst component which does not contain the cyclotri veratrum hydrocarbon and the derivative thereof, the cyclotri veratrum hydrocarbon and the derivative thereof are introduced into the olefin polymerization catalyst, so that the activity, the hydrogen regulation sensitivity and the copolymerization performance of the catalyst can be simultaneously improved.

title_en: Pipe with pH indicating function, preparation method thereof and catheter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical instruments, in particular to a pipe with a pH indicating function, a preparation method thereof and a catheter. The catheter body material provided by the invention is a self-developed pipe material, and the pipe material comprises a transparent pipe body and a pH indicator which is connected to the inner surface of the transparent pipe body through a chemical bond. According to the urine catheter provided by the invention, the pH indicator is arranged on the inner wall of the catheter body, the pH value of urine flowing through the urine catheter can be monitored in a color change mode, the real-time property of urine pH value detection is good, and the sensitivity is high; the transparent texture of the catheter is matched with the bending form of the catheter, so that the color information of the indicator is obtained, the indicating effect is amplified, and the observation is facilitated; simultaneously, because the pH indicator is fixed on the body inner wall of catheter through chemical bonding's mode, consequently have higher stability, do not take place the dissociation of pH indicator and drop at urine scouring class in-process, the cycle of warning cycle is long, and biological safety is high.

title_en: Ligand compound, transition metal compound and catalyst composition comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel ligand compound, a transition metal compound and a catalyst composition comprising the same. The novel ligand compound and transition metal compound according to the present invention can be used as a polymerization catalyst for preparing an olefin-based polymer having a low density. In addition, an olefin polymer polymerized by using a catalyst composition comprising the transition metal compound may be used to manufacture a product having a low Melt Index (MI) and a high molecular weight.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant hot-melt benzoxazine resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-temperature-resistant hot-melt benzoxazine resin, which comprises the following components: phenol, aldehyde, primary amine, catalyst, modifier and toughening agent. The invention also provides a preparation method of the high-temperature-resistant hot-melt benzoxazine resin. The high-temperature-resistant hot-melt benzoxazine resin has good viscosity at room temperature, stable viscosity at high temperature, good heat resistance, good film forming property and excellent mechanical property, and the benzoxazine composite material prepared by the high-temperature-resistant hot-melt benzoxazine resin has low porosity and high quality retention rate.

title_en: Rubber with sound absorption function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rubber with a sound absorption function, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 145 parts of nitrile rubber 123-containing material, 29-38 parts of phenolic resin, 2-4 parts of stannous chloride, 1-3 parts of N, N' -m-phenylene bismaleimide, 2-5 parts of zinc methacrylate, 2-4 parts of N-tert-butyl-2-benzothiazole sulfonamide, 7-9 parts of azodicarbonamide, 2-4 parts of nano molybdenum disulfide, 18-22 parts of sepiolite fiber, 20-23 parts of hollow glass microsphere, 10-15 parts of tetrapod-shaped zinc oxide whisker, 22-25 parts of glass fiber, 4-8 parts of Arabic gum and 7-10 parts of sodium bicarbonate.

title_en: Polycarboxylate superplasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polycarboxylate superplasticizer and a preparation method thereof; the polycarboxylate superplasticizer comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-70 parts of lauryl alcohol polyoxyethylene ether, 45-65 parts of lignin, 18-22 parts of maleic acid, 4-8 parts of chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, 2-6 parts of isodecyl acrylate, 1.5-2 parts of phenothiazine and 0.5-1 part of sodium persulfate; according to the invention, the natural processing raw materials of chitosan quaternary ammonium salt and lignin are adopted to modify the polycarboxylate superplasticizer, so that the toxicity of the product and the requirements on production conditions are reduced, and the method is more environment-friendly; the prepared product has high water reducing property and slump retaining property, can improve the strength of concrete, has good comprehensive performance, greatly improves the antibacterial property of the product, prolongs the storage period and improves the storage stability.

title_en: Method for grafting and modifying surface of silicon rubber based on chain transfer equilibrium reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicone rubber surface grafting modification method based on chain transfer equilibrium reaction, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding modified silicone oil with target functional groups into a closed reaction container, adding an alkaline temporary catalyst, vacuumizing, heating, stirring and dehydrating; (2) adding a silicon rubber sheet to be modified into the reaction system, and soaking for 0.5-3 h at constant temperature to reaction temperature; (3) and after the temperature is reduced to room temperature, taking out the silicon rubber sheet, washing the silicon rubber sheet by tetrahydrofuran, and then putting the silicon rubber sheet into a vacuum oven for drying. Thus obtaining the surface modified silicon rubber material. The invention provides a new way for simply and conveniently adjusting the surface characteristics of the silicon rubber. Technical support can be provided for surface-related applications of silicone rubber.

title_en: One-part low temperature cure coating formed via a dual layer cure mechanism
abstract_en: The present invention relates to storage-stable, low-temperature-curable coating compositions comprising a hydroxy-functional resin, a crosslinker and a catalyst which does not catalyze the crosslinking reaction between the hydroxy-functional resin and the crosslinker contained therein, but rather between the hydroxy-functional resin and the crosslinker contained in different low-temperature-curable coating compositions. Further, a low temperature cure composite coating comprising: a basecoat comprising a low temperature cure coating composition of a first hydroxy-functional resin, a first crosslinker, and a first catalyst; a topcoat comprising a second hydroxy-functional resin, a second crosslinker, and a second catalyst, wherein the first catalyst migrates from the basecoat into the topcoat and catalyzes a reaction between the second hydroxy-functional resin and the crosslinker, and the second catalyst migrates from the topcoat into the basecoat and catalyzes a reaction between the first hydroxy-functional resin and the crosslinker.

title_en: Low-density high-foaming-rate polymer foam material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polymer foam material with low density and high foaming multiplying power and a preparation method thereof, which is prepared by a core back type micropore injection molding technology and comprises the following steps: preparing a modified polymer composite material, preparing polymer melt, filling a cavity with the polymer melt, maintaining pressure, cooling and foaming with a core retreating type. The invention adopts a high-pressure full injection mode, and polymer melt is injected into a mold cavity in the high-pressure full injection mode and completely fills the mold cavity; the polymer solution is kept in the die cavity for a period of time under a higher pressure to ensure that the prepared polymer foam material has highly controllable density and foaming ratio, namely the density is 0.1-0.5g/cm 3 And the foaming ratio is 2-10 times.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing polypeptide by ring-opening polymerization of amino acid cyclic anhydride and method for preparing polypeptide by using catalyst
abstract_en: A catalyst for preparing polypeptide by ring-opening polymerization of amino acid cyclic anhydride and a method for preparing polypeptide by using the catalyst are disclosed, the catalyst comprises a component A and a component B, both of which are nonmetallic compounds, the component A is used for initiating the ring-opening polymerization of amino acid cyclic anhydride monomers to control the molecular weight of the obtained polypeptide, the component B is used for activating the amino acid cyclic anhydride monomers to control the rate of polymerization reaction, and the component B can greatly reduce the reaction activation energy and accelerate the polymerization reaction; adding a catalyst component A, a component B and an organic solvent into a polymerization bottle subjected to anhydrous treatment at room temperature, stirring, adding an amino acid cyclic anhydride monomer, then adding a hydrochloric acid ethanol solution to terminate the reaction after polymerization reaction at room temperature, pouring the reaction solution into ethanol for settling, filtering to obtain a white solid, and drying the obtained white solid to obtain the polypeptide, wherein the polypeptide has the characteristics of greenness, high efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Use of quaternary ammonium salts with hydroxyethyl groups in polyvinyl alcohol processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of quaternary ammonium salts with hydroxyethyl groups in polyvinyl alcohol processing. Researches find that the quaternary ammonium salt with hydroxyethyl group is used as an additive for processing polyvinyl alcohol, the quaternary ammonium salt with hydroxyethyl group is an ionic compound, the quaternary ammonium salt with hydroxyethyl group has better solubility with PVA, and the quaternary ammonium salt with hydroxyethyl group can be used as micromolecules to act between PVA macromolecules, so that the van der Waals acting force between the PVA macromolecules is reduced, the processing fluidity is improved, the melting point during PVA processing is reduced, the processing temperature can be reduced, the problem that hydroxyl groups are easy to shrink in the processing process is avoided, the problems that materials prepared by processing polyvinyl alcohol are easy to turn yellow and the micromolecules are easy to dialyze are solved, and the processing energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Articles of thermoset additive manufacturing incorporating phase change materials and methods of making same
abstract_en: An article of additive manufacturing is comprised of at least two adhered extrudate layers (120), the extrudate layers (120) being comprised of a thermoset material having a phase change material therein, wherein the phase change material undergoes a phase change at a temperature below the decomposition temperature of the thermoset material. The article can be made by: dispensing a mixture comprising an organic reactive material and a phase change material to form an extrudate that is 3D printed into an article having a plurality of extrudate layers bonded together, and then allowing the organic reactive material to react to form a thermoset material having the phase change material therein to form the additive manufactured article. The shape of the article can be altered by heating to a temperature above the temperature at which the phase change material undergoes a phase change upon application of a force and then cooling to below the phase change temperature. Likewise, it is possible to return to the original shape simply by heating above the phase transition temperature and then cooling without applying a force.

title_en: UV-cured acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive suitable for plastic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UV curing acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive suitable for plastic materials and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the UV curing acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 90-99.9 parts of acrylate prepolymer and 0.1-10 parts of tackifying resin; and a second photoinitiator; the tackifying resin is one or a mixture of more of carbon five resin, rosin resin and alkyd resin; the acrylate prepolymer is formed by polymerizing 87-93 parts by weight of isooctyl acrylate and 7-13 parts by weight of one or more of acrylic acid, hydroxyethyl acrylate and isobornyl acrylate under the action of 0.04-0.06 part by weight of a first photoinitiator under ultraviolet irradiation; the addition amount of the second photoinitiator is 1-3% of the mass of the acrylate prepolymer. The UV-cured acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive has good bonding capability on a plastic material substrate with low surface energy.

title_en: Polyolefin rotational molding composition, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polyolefin composition, and in particular relates to a polyolefin rotational molding composition, and a preparation method and application thereof. Comprises the following components in parts by weight: 70-90 parts of linear low-density polyethylene, 2.0-4.0 parts of rutile titanium dioxide, 2.0-12.0 parts of anatase titanium dioxide, 4.0-10.0 parts of activated alumina, 1.0 part of silane coupling agent and 1.0-5.0 parts of polymethylsiloxane. The linear low density polyethylene has a density of 0.936 to 0.939g/cm 3 The melt mass flow rate is 6-12g/10 min. The invention solves the problem of water pollution of the polyethylene water storage tank, and can effectively prevent suspended matters and impurities in the water from adhering to the wall of the water tank to grow into lichen and mildew. The invention also provides the application of the product, the moss in water is prevented from adhering and growing by covering the inner surface of the rotational molding product with the product, the method is simple, and the effect is obvious.

title_en: Polymer material
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a polymer material having excellent elongation properties. The first polymer material of the present invention includes a first polymer including a first structural unit having a guest group in a side chain and a second polymer including a second structural unit having a host group in a side chain, and at least one of the first polymer and the second polymer has 1 or more fluorine groups. The second polymer material of the present invention has: the fluorine-containing polymer comprises a first structural unit having a guest group in a side chain, a second structural unit having a host group in a side chain, and a third structural unit other than the first structural unit and the second structural unit, wherein at least one structural unit of the first structural unit, the second structural unit, and the third structural unit has 1 or more fluorine groups.

title_en: BPS product and preparation method thereof by full bromine method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a BPS product by a full bromine method, which comprises the following steps: preparing raw materials, dissolving materials, carrying out bromination reaction and post-treatment, wherein the dissolving materials are prepared by adding 10gPS g and 190g of bromochloromethane into a four-neck flask, cooling to 0-5 ℃, adding 0.5g of aluminum trichloride and 0.5g of titanium tetrachloride, and uniformly stirring; the invention also provides a BPS product, which has white or light yellow appearance, chlorine content of 0, 1 percent TGA @350 ℃, 5 percent TGA @380 ℃, bromine content of more than or equal to 66 percent and thermal decomposition temperature of more than or equal to 270 ℃; the preparation method of the full bromine method of the invention has no bromine chloride preparation process, less flow steps and short reaction period; deep refrigeration is not needed, and the energy consumption is low; the product does not contain chlorine, has good thermal stability, high color and quality of the product, and enlarged application field, and has great economic and social benefits.

title_en: Polymer with surface activity function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of crude oil recovery, and discloses a polymer with a surface activity function, and a preparation method and application thereof. The polymer comprises a structural unit A, a structural unit B and a structural unit C, wherein the structural unit A is a structural unit of a formula (1), the structural unit B is a structural unit of a formula (2), and the structural unit C is a structural unit of a formula (3); the viscosity average molecular weight of the polymer is 2700 to 3150 ten thousand. The invention introduces a functional monomer which has surface activity and contains polymerizable acrylamide into the acrylamide copolymer, thereby improving the surface activity, the viscosity increasing property, the temperature resistance and the salt resistance of the polyacrylamide solution.

title_en: Fluorine-containing phenanthrenequinone skeleton asymmetric alpha-diimine nickel (II) complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of olefin polymerization, and particularly discloses a fluorine-containing phenanthrenequinone skeleton asymmetric alpha-diimine nickel complex, a preparation method and application thereof. Under the activation of the cocatalyst MMAO, the catalytic activity can be effectively improved, and the microstructure of the polymer can be controlled to a certain extent. The complex catalyzes ethylene polymerization to show higher stability, and the polyethylene elastomer with high molecular weight, narrow molecular weight distribution and low branching degree is obtained.

title_en: Tantalum-containing radiation-proof organic glass and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tantalum-containing radiation-proof organic glass and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparation of Ta 2 O 5 A nanowire; to Ta 2 O 5 Modifying the surface of the nanowire; ta 2 O 5 Grafting a macromolecular initiator on the surface of the nanowire; preparing the tantalum-containing radiation-proof organic glass. The invention selects Ta 2 O 5 Is a tantalum source prepared by preparing Ta 2 O 5 The nano-wire enhances the dispersibility in the matrix and selects a proper method to be coated on Ta 2 O 5 The surface is grafted with the functional polymer and used as a macroinitiator to initiate MMA bulk polymerization, and the prepared tantalum-containing radiation-proof organic glass has excellent radiation-proof performance in a wider energy range, shows high mechanical properties such as strength and toughness and has a wider application prospect.

title_en: Film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a film comprising a substrate layer and a resin layer, wherein one surface layer is the substrate layer and the other surface layer is the resin layer containing a resin composition, the film is bent with the substrate layer as the outside and the resin layer as the inside when cut into a circle having a diameter of 1cm, and when the film is cut along a straight line on the film perpendicular to a straight line having zero curvature with respect to the curved surface of the bent film, the unit interfacial length of a bright portion in the cross section of the resin layer is 15.0 [ mu ] m ‑1 As described above, the unit interfacial length of the dark portion in the cross section of the resin layer was 12.5 μm ‑1 The peeling energy when the film is heat-sealed to an adherend is 60mJ or more, the thickness of the resin layer is 5 μm or more and 100 μm or less, and the thickness of the film is 20 μm or more and 150 μm or less.

title_en: Epoxy resin/montmorillonite nano composite coating for metal surface and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anticorrosive coatings, in particular to an epoxy resin/montmorillonite nano composite coating for a metal surface. The paint comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-120 parts of epoxy resin, 12-18 parts of diluent, 40-60 parts of curing agent, 0.1-3 parts of accelerator and 1-5 parts of organic modified montmorillonite. The coating provided by the invention enhances the binding force between the coating and the metal interface, so that the coating is less prone to falling off on the metal surface, the problem of tackiness existing in the contact interface between the film and the air is solved, the contact interface between the film and the air is smooth and stable, the probability of adsorption of impurities in the tacky air and the occurrence of self-corrosion of the film is reduced, the curing and drying speed of the film is accelerated, the flexibility, salt resistance and acid resistance of the film are obviously improved, and the development of the aluminum alloy anticorrosion industry is certainly promoted.

title_en: Solvent-resistant polyurethane primer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel solvent-resistant polyurethane primer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, putting polyalcohol into a reaction device, adding dimethylformamide and stirring uniformly; step 2, adding an antioxidant, phosphoric acid and a chain extender into the reaction device in the step 1, and continuously stirring for 20 min, wherein the chain extender comprises a trifunctional chain extender; step 3, adding isocyanate and a catalyst after uniformly stirring to perform tackifying reaction; and 4, adding a mixed solvent of butanone and methanol to terminate the reaction, and keeping the viscosity of the product at the end point to be 12-18 ten thousand and the solid content to be 45%. The trifunctional chain extender is added in the preparation process, so that the prepared polyurethane resin forms a slight network structure and does not gel; the prepared polyurethane base material has solvent resistance through a small amount of trifunctional group chain extender, and the defect that the polyurethane synthetic leather is easily corroded by a polar solvent is overcome; and the trifunctional chain extender is added to ensure that the polyurethane primer has better heat resistance.

title_en: Isolation tectorial membrane for soil restoration and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an isolation tectorial membrane for soil restoration, which comprises the following steps: the preparation method comprises the following steps of (I) grafting high-density polyethylene with acrylic acid, (II) preparing tetrafluorophenyl benzophenone ionic polymer, (III) modifying surface with fluorinated graphene, and (IV) preparing membrane. The invention also discloses the isolation covering film for soil remediation, which is prepared according to the preparation method of the isolation covering film for soil remediation. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple and feasible, mild in condition and low in manufacturing cost; the prepared isolation covering film for soil remediation has the advantages of low manufacturing cost, excellent permeation resistance, mechanical property and corrosion resistance, good weather resistance and performance stability, long service life, antibiosis and antistatic properties.

title_en: Preparation and application of polyphosphazene modified graphene oxide composite flame retardant
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of a polyphosphazene modified graphene oxide composite flame retardant, wherein GO is dissolved in deionized water to form a first solution, hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene is dissolved in N, N-dimethylformamide to form a second solution, the two solutions are mixed, and vacuum freeze drying is carried out to obtain modified graphene oxide; dissolving phosphoric acid and melamine in water, heating and stirring, cooling, filtering and washing, and performing vacuum drying to obtain melamine phosphate; dissolving boric acid in water, heating and stirring, adding melamine phosphate, cooling, filtering, washing with water, and drying to obtain melamine phosphate borate; and dissolving the modified graphene oxide and melamine phosphate borate in water, and evaporating the solvent to obtain the polyphosphazene modified graphene oxide composite flame retardant. The composite flame retardant can be used for preparing flame-retardant materials. The graphene prepared by the preparation method can effectively reduce the heat release amount of the polymer, is assisted by an inorganic flame retardant, overcomes the defect of large amount of smoke generated by introducing the graphene, and enhances the flame retardant effect of the polymer.

title_en: Epoxysilazane compound, composition containing same, and method for forming silica film using epoxysilazane compound
abstract_en: The invention provides an epoxysilazane compound and a composition containing the epoxysilazane compound, which can shorten the time of a silica film forming process. An epoxysilazane compound which has a specific structure and in which the ratio of O atoms to the total number of O atoms and N atoms is 5% or more and 25% or less, and which is obtained by subjecting the epoxysilazane compound to an inverse-gated decoupling method 29 In a spectrum obtained by Si-NMR measurement, the ratio of the area of a peak detected at-75 ppm to-90 ppm to the area of a peak detected at-25 ppm to-55 ppm is 4.0% or less.

title_en: Anthocyanin nano-composite gelatin edible film capable of delaying grease oxidation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anthocyanin nano-composite gelatin edible film capable of delaying grease oxidation, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding anthocyanin into chitosan hydrochloride solution, and uniformly stirring to obtain mixed solution of anthocyanin and chitosan hydrochloride; (2) slowly adding carboxymethyl chitosan solution into the mixed solution of anthocyanin and chitosan hydrochloride to ensure that the chitosan hydrochloride with positive charges and the carboxymethyl chitosan with negative charges are mutually crosslinked to prepare anthocyanin nano compound suspension; (3) and gradually adding a gelatin solution into the anthocyanin nano-composite suspension to form a film forming solution, then adding glycerol into the film forming solution, uniformly stirring, standing, and finally forming and drying to obtain the edible film. The tensile strength of the edible film prepared by the invention reaches more than 1.54MPa, the elongation at break reaches more than 206.57, and compared with a pure gelatin edible film, the light transmittance is reduced by 73.7%.

title_en: Low-surface-energy high-water-solubility ultraviolet-curing water-based resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low surface energy and high water solubility ultraviolet light curing water-based resin and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing epoxy acrylic resin; then, reacting dihydric alcohol, diisocyanate and hydroxyl acrylate to prepare polyurethane acrylate with an-NCO functional group at one end, reacting the two resins together to prepare polyurethane acrylate modified epoxy acrylate, adding amino silicone oil into the resin, and grafting the amino silicone oil onto the polyurethane acrylate modified epoxy acrylate through Michael addition reaction; then, diisocyanate and dihydroxy carboxylic acid are reacted to form a prepolymer, the prepolymer is grafted to an epoxy acrylate main chain, and the grafted resin is added into a concentrated alkaline solution to prepare the ultraviolet curing water-based resin with low surface energy and high water solubility. The cured film of the water-based resin has the outstanding advantages of good hardness, flexibility, curing gel rate and wear resistance, low surface energy, good water solubility and the like.

title_en: Adhesive for automobile interior
abstract_en: The invention provides an adhesive for automobile interior decoration, which adopts 2-hydroxyhexyl ACRYLATE (2-HEA) and trifunctional polyether polyol with molecular mass of 400-3000. Because the polyhydric alcohols can influence the weather resistance, the fluidity and the hardness, the invention leads the polyhydric alcohols with different molecular weights into the mixture in sequence by calculation, so that the polyhydric alcohols and the 2-HEA are uniformly distributed, and the purpose of prolonging the service life is achieved.

title_en: Preparation method of biomass-based nano silicon dioxide/carbon composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a biomass-based nano silicon dioxide/carbon composite material, which belongs to the field of biomass energy chemical industry. The invention greatly improves the dispersibility and the interface interaction of the particles in the rubber substrate and improves the macroscopic mechanical property of the rubber by changing the microstructure of the particle surface.

title_en: Preparation method and application of high-haze high-light-transmittance flexible cellulose membrane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a high-haze high-light-transmittance flexible cellulose membrane, relates to the field of natural polymers, and also belongs to the fields of chemistry and environmental engineering. Preparing TEMPO oxidized cellulose, adding deionized water to prepare oxidized cellulose suspension, treating the suspension by ultrasonic waves, removing part of water in the suspension by rotary evaporation, and finally obtaining the high-haze high-light-transmittance flexible cellulose membrane by a solution casting method. The method has the characteristics of simple preparation process, low cost, easy operation and the like. The preparation method can be directly used for industrial production, improves the optical properties of the cellulose membrane, namely light transmittance and haze, has high surface flatness of the prepared cellulose membrane, has the characteristics of light weight and low price, and can be applied to photoelectric substrate materials.

title_en: Cosmetic composition comprising cationic copolymer
