abstract_en: A first aspect of the present invention relates to a cosmetic composition, which comprises the following steps: (i) a copolymer comprising: (A) 0.1 to 99.9mol% of one or more cationic building blocks (A); and (B) from 0.1 to 99.9mol% of one or more macromonomer building blocks (B); and (ii) a cosmetically acceptable component; wherein one or more cationic building blocks (A) are represented by general formula (I) and/or (II) and one or more macromonomer building blocks (B) are represented by general formula (III). Preferably, the composition is a shampoo for cleaning keratin fibres, more preferably a hair cleansing composition.

title_en: Mine sweeping protective boot
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine-sweeping protective boot which comprises a boot sole and a boot vamp, wherein the boot sole sequentially comprises an anti-skid wear-resistant bottom layer, a high-impact-resistant protective middle layer and an elastic buffer inner layer arranged below an insole from bottom to top; the high-impact-resistance protection middle layer is formed by compounding a three-dimensional porous fiber material and resin, and the resin is filled in three-dimensional through holes of the three-dimensional porous fiber material to form a network interwoven composite compact structure; the boot vamp comprises an inner liner layer, a boot vamp layer and a non-woven fabric laminated layer arranged between the inner liner layer and the boot vamp layer; the inner liner is made by the memory sponge, boots surface course is made by waterproof fire-retardant cow hide, the non-woven fabrics stromatolite is pressed by 4 ~ 6 fibrous layers and 2 layers of thermoplastic film heat. The protective boot disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the special materials are adopted and the unique structure is combined, so that the effects in the aspects of impact resistance and puncture resistance are greatly optimized, the blocking and weakening of shock waves and fragments generated by explosion in the mine sweeping process are facilitated, and a good protective effect is achieved.

title_en: Small-aperture polymethacrylimide foam and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-aperture polymethacrylimide foam and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of high polymer materials. The method adopts a mixed foaming agent of a physical foaming agent and a chemical foaming agent, controls the foaming rate and the size and uniformity of foam pores by adjusting the substance and the ratio of the mixed foaming agent and the substance and the ratio of a cross-linking agent, and obtains the polymethacrylimide foam product with the pore diameter of more than 95 percent within the range of 10-60 mu m, uniform pore diameter and maximum pore diameter of not more than 120 mu m.

title_en: One-component pressure-sensitive adhesive composition having a gel content based on reversible crosslinking by means of metal salts
abstract_en: A one-component pressure-sensitive adhesive composition in the form of an aqueous polymer dispersion is described, which contains at least one pressure-sensitive adhesive polymer formed by emulsion polymerization of soft (meth) acrylate monomers, methacrylic acid and optionally further monomers, wherein the polymerization is carried out in the presence of molecular weight regulators or styrene. The gel content of the pressure sensitive adhesive polymer is based at least in part on reversible crosslinking by metal salts. The one-component pressure-sensitive adhesive composition may be used to prepare an adhesive label, an adhesive tape or an adhesive film.

title_en: SBS modified asphalt root-resistant waterproof coiled material and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an SBS modified asphalt root-resistant waterproof coiled material and a production method thereof, belonging to the technical field of waterproof coiled materials. Comprises an upper surface isolation layer, an SBS modified asphalt layer, an intermediate tire base layer, an SBS modified asphalt layer and a lower surface isolation layer; the SBS modified asphalt layer is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-60 parts of No. 90 petroleum asphalt, 10-20 parts of No. 10 petroleum asphalt, 20-30 parts of SBS rubber, 15-25 parts of fluorosilicone rubber, 2-4 parts of vulcanizing agent, 0.5-1 part of vulcanization accelerator, 5-10 parts of silane coupling agent, 5-8 parts of active tackifying resin, 0.8-1.2 parts of antioxidant, 20-30 parts of filler and 3-5 parts of chemical root-resisting agent. The waterproof coiled material has better plant root puncture resistance, strong saline-alkali resistance and is suitable for the waterproof engineering with planting requirements in saline-alkali areas.

title_en: Polylactic acid composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a polylactic acid composite material and a preparation method thereof. The polylactic acid composite material is prepared from raw materials containing end-capped poly-L-lactic acid and an internal lubricant; the capped poly L-lactic acid comprises poly L-lactic acid capped with poly glycidyl methacrylate. Compared with the epoxy group-terminated poly-L-lactic acid in the prior art, the epoxy group-terminated poly-L-lactic acid adopted by the invention contains epoxy groups and double bonds in terminated molecules, and the finally prepared polylactic acid composite material has better transparency and heat resistance. Experimental results show that the light transmittance of the polylactic acid composite material prepared by the invention is not lower than 92%, and the transparency is excellent; the polylactic acid composite material has no deformation in hot water at 90 ℃ and has better heat resistance.

title_en: Silk fibroin high-water-absorption material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silk fibroin super absorbent material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: pouring reaction liquid obtained after uniformly mixing the silk fibroin solution, riboflavin and horseradish peroxidase into a transparent mould, and introducing oxygen into the reaction liquid; irradiating the reaction solution with ultraviolet light to form silk fibroin hydrogel, and controlling the temperature of the reaction solution to be 0-8 ℃ in the irradiation process; drying the silk fibroin hydrogel to obtain silk fibroin xerogel; and crushing the silk fibroin xerogel and screening to obtain the silk fibroin superabsorbent material. The preparation method can effectively reduce the reaction temperature through crosslinking in a low-temperature environment, so that the formed gel keeps a random coiled structure in the solution, thereby effectively limiting the generation of a crystalline structure and greatly improving the swelling capacity of the material. The prepared silk fibroin superabsorbent material has high water absorption multiple and high water retention rate.

title_en: Water-absorbent resin particles
abstract_en: Disclosed are water-absorbent resin particles which contain a crosslinked polymer containing a monomer unit derived from a water-soluble ethylenically unsaturated monomer, wherein the water-absorbent resin particles have an initial swelling force of 8N or more as measured in a swelling force test by a predetermined method, and wherein the proportion of particles having a particle diameter of more than 250 [ mu ] m and 850 [ mu ] m or less is 70 mass% or more and the proportion of particles having a particle diameter of 250 [ mu ] m or less is 20 mass% or less with respect to the total amount of the water-absorbent resin particles.

title_en: Modified polycarbonate material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified polycarbonate material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the modified polycarbonate material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 200-235 parts of polycarbonate, 47-58 parts of poly (1, 4-cyclohexanedicarboxylic acid-1, 4-cyclohexanedimethylene ester), 23-31 parts of branched polybutylene succinate copolymer, 7-12 parts of flame retardant, 0.6-0.9 part of processing aid and 3-5 parts of stabilizer. The modified polycarbonate material has the advantages of low glass transition temperature, high melt index, good low-temperature fluidity and good processability, is easy to process and mold, can be used for preparing films, objects with complex and fine structures and the like, and has wide market application prospect; the tensile strength is high, the elongation at break is moderate, the tensile strength and the elongation at break are more balanced, and the mechanical property is kept good; in addition, the flame retardant has good flame retardant property.

title_en: Basalt flake fiber modified polyimide film
abstract_en: A basalt flake fiber-modified polyimide film has lower water absorption, higher strength and better heat resistance than an unmodified film of the same kind. The invention aims to solve the technical problems that the basalt scale fibers are easy to agglomerate and not easy to disperse due to the interlaminar acting force of the basalt scale fibers in a polymer matrix, and the basalt scale fibers are subjected to surface modification by using an end aminosilane coupling agent, the surface roughness of the basalt scale fibers is changed by a microwave liquid-phase auxiliary method, so that the infiltration modification effect of the end aminosilane coupling agent is improved, the grafting rate of amino functional groups is improved, amino groups on the surfaces of the modified basalt scale fibers are bonded with monomer dianhydride through in-situ polymerization, inorganic fibers are uniformly and stably dispersed in a polyimide system in a chemical bonding mode, and the agglomeration of the scale fibers is avoided. The invention belongs to the field of modified polyimide films.

title_en: Preparation method and application of sucrose carbonization modified carbon fiber
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of sucrose carbonization modified carbon fiber, which comprises the following steps: dissolving sucrose in ethyl acetate, wherein the weight percentage of sucrose to ethyl acetate is 2-3:3-5, stirring to prepare a pre-soaking solution, soaking carbon fibers, performing ultrasonic dispersion for 5-10min, taking out, drying, placing in a tube furnace for high-temperature carbonization, selecting an air atmosphere, heating at a speed of 5-10 ℃/min to 290-300 ℃, preserving heat for 30-90s, and then rapidly cooling to room temperature to obtain the sucrose carbonization modified carbon fibers. On the basis of not damaging the surface of the carbon fiber, the invention increases the roughness of the surface of the carbon fiber, improves the shearing strength of the interface of the carbon fiber, and simultaneously ensures that the carbon fiber has good flexibility and processability. The sucrose carbonization modified carbon fiber is applied to the composite material, so that the wettability and the adhesion of the carbon fiber and a matrix are improved, and the interfacial shear strength, the interlaminar shear strength and the impact resistance of the composite material can be effectively improved.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrogel based on spiropyran composite microspheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of hydrogel based on spiropyran composite microspheres, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting an activation technology to anchor spiropyran on the surface of mesoporous nano particles with primary amine groups on the surface in a covalent manner to prepare spiropyran composite microspheres, and then compounding the spiropyran composite microspheres with sodium alginate/polyacrylamide/metal ions to further synthesize the spiropyran composite microsphere hydrogel. The composite hydrogel has stronger coordination effect on metal ions under the irradiation of ultraviolet light, thereby forming a stable cross-linked network structure and greatly improving the mechanical strength of the hydrogel; under the irradiation of visible light, the spiropyran in the system automatically rearranges to shield active phenol oxygen anions, partial coordination bonds disappear, and the mechanical strength of the hydrogel system is obviously reduced. The spiropyran composite microsphere hydrogel obtained by the invention has photosensitive and controllable mechanical strength, and can be widely applied to the fields of flexible devices, wearable electronics and the like.

title_en: Sizing agent for PDCPD carbon fiber fabric composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A shaping agent for PDCPD carbon fiber fabric composite material and a preparation method thereof comprise the following raw material components in parts by weight: the dosage of the ethylene glycol dicyclopentenyl ether acrylic acid is 160-240 g; the dosage of butyl acrylate is 20-30 g; the amount of the initiator is 3mL-5 mL. The reactive powder sizing agent obtained by UV photocuring has moderate price and more convenient use, can meet the use requirement of a carbon fiber preform in the process, has a structure similar to that of a cyclic olefin with a DCPD monomer, has better compatibility and formability, has no obvious negative influence on the ring-opening living polymerization activity of the DCPD and the performance of a fiber composite material thereof, and has good formability and reaction compatibility.

title_en: Light stabilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light stabilizer and a preparation method thereof, 2- (2,2,6, 6-tetramethyl-4-piperidylamino) -acetic acid (1-octyloxy-2, 2,6, 6-tetramethyl-4-oxy) ester and 2-chloro-4, 6-di- [ N-N-butyl-N- (1,2,2,6, 6-pentamethyl-4-piperidyl) amino ] -1,3, 5-triazine are taken as raw materials, the raw materials react in a solvent, then the temperature is reduced, crystallization and centrifugation are carried out, and finally 2- {4- [4, 6-di (N-butyl-1, 2,2,6, 6-pentamethyl piperidylamino) -1,3, 5-triazine-2-yl ]2 is obtained, 2,6, 6-tetramethyl-4-piperidinylamino } -acetic acid (1-octyloxy-2, 2,6, 6-tetramethyl-4-oxy) ester; the light stabilizer has the advantages of simple preparation process flow, simple and convenient separation and purification process, short reaction time and product yield of about 95 percent.

title_en: Intestinal prebiotics black skin termitomyces albuminosus polysaccharide ORP-1 and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intestinal prebiotics black skin termitomyces albuminosus polysaccharide ORP-1 and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the intestinal prebiotics are black skin termitomyces albuminosus polysaccharide ORP-1Polysaccharide ORP-1 is prepared from Collybia nigricans polysaccharide as raw material by fractional alcohol precipitation, DEAE-52 cellulose column chromatography and superdex-75 molecular sieve gel column chromatography separation and purification; the molecular weight of the compound is 2.4X 10 4 Da, the monosaccharide composition of the strain is mannose, glucose, galactose and fucose in a molar ratio of 1.48:1.00:29.65: 8.22. The novel intestinal prebiotics have the characteristic of resisting digestion in the process of simulating digestion of oral cavity, stomach and small intestine in vitro, but can be utilized by fecal microorganisms in the process of simulating glycolysis of human feces in vitro, and promote the proliferation of intestinal probiotics Bifidobacterium bifidum (Bifidobacterium bifidum) and lactobacillus acidophilus (lactobacillus acidophilus).

title_en: Copolyester hot melt adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A copolyester hot melt adhesive and a preparation method thereof, in particular to a high-performance copolyester hot melt adhesive with low volume shrinkage and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials of the beverage comprise a main material and an auxiliary material, wherein the main material comprises acid and alcohol, the acid is dibasic acid, and the alcohol is composed of dibasic alcohol and tribasic alcohol; the auxiliary materials comprise a toughening agent and a filler besides the catalyst, the stabilizer and the antioxidant. The invention mainly utilizes the synergistic effect of the main materials and the auxiliary materials in the system to reduce the problem of peeling strength reduction caused by shrinkage stress, and obtains the amorphous copolyester hot melt adhesive which has low volume shrinkage rate and high performance and is suitable for bonding and applying flexible base materials such as composite flexible packaging materials.

title_en: C3N4Preparation method of photocatalytic self-polishing resin-based composite coating material
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound C 3 N 4 A method for preparing a photocatalytic self-polishing resin-based composite coating material. Firstly, the method comprises the following steps: using silane coupling agent KH-570 to C 3 N 4 Modifying to obtain a product a; II, secondly: the product a, fluorine-containing acrylate monomer, acrylic monomer and acrylate monomer are polymerized by free radical solution to prepare C 3 N 4 Carrying out photocatalysis self-polishing on the resin mixture to obtain a product b; thirdly, the method comprises the following steps: and (4) carrying out ultrasonic dispersion treatment on the product b to obtain the composite coating material. Compared with the conventional self-polishing coating, the fluorine-containing side chain and the hydrolysis functional group can jointly adjust the hydrolysis speed of the resin matrix, so that the problem of short service life of the photocatalytic self-polishing coating is solved; compared with the conventional C 3 N 4 The coating is a hydrophobic phase formed in the resin, so that the problem that the photocatalyst is lost along with the resin which is removed by polishing is solved; the hole structure of the hydrolyzed resin enables the photocatalyst in the resin to contact with the outside to form free radicals with antifouling activity, and the photocatalytic efficiency of the coating is improved.

title_en: Film, method for evaluating optical homogeneity of film, and method for producing film
abstract_en: The invention provides a film having excellent optical homogeneity and suitable for use as an optical film in an image display device, and a method for producing the film. The present invention also provides an evaluation method capable of evaluating the optical homogeneity of a film with higher accuracy than conventional evaluation methods. A film of the present invention is a casting film containing a resin having a weight average molecular weight of 20 ten thousand or more, wherein line profiles in directions h and v orthogonal to each other in a film inverse space image obtained by Fourier transform of a projection image obtained by a projection method using the film are set as a line profile h and a line profile v, respectively, line profiles in directions h 'and v' orthogonal to each other in a background inverse space image obtained by Fourier transform of a background image obtained without using the film in the projection method are set as a line profile h 'and a line profile v', respectively, and a maximum intensity of a line profile (h-h ') obtained by subtracting the line profile h' from the line profile h is set as Y mh Will be derived from showing the maximum intensity Y mh Minus the median X of the total frequency in the blank corrected line profile cen And the value X obtained max Is set to X mh The maximum intensity of a line profile (v-v ') obtained by subtracting the line profile v' from the line profile v is set to Y mv Will be derived from showing the maximum intensity Y mv Minus the median X of the total frequency in the blank corrected line profile cen And the value X obtained max Is set to X mv When, Y mh And Y mv All are 30 or less, Y mh 、Y mv 、X mh And X mv Satisfying a specific equation.

title_en: Inorganic nano antibacterial hard PVC and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of antibacterial plastics, and discloses inorganic nano antibacterial hard PVC and a preparation method thereof. Adding inorganic non-metal nano filler into water to prepare slurry, then adding a coupling agent, heating, stirring and reacting, carrying out suction filtration, drying, crushing and sieving on the reacted slurry, and then carrying out ball milling by using a high-energy ball mill to obtain an inorganic nano antibacterial agent; mixing the hard polyvinyl chloride, the inorganic nano antibacterial agent and the additive, and performing extrusion molding to obtain the inorganic nano antibacterial hard PVC. According to the invention, the inorganic non-metal nano-filler is adopted to prepare the antibacterial agent through a special treatment process, so that the antibacterial and bacteriostatic ability of the antibacterial agent is improved, the nano-scale of the antibacterial agent can be uniformly dispersed in PVC, the inorganic nano-antibacterial agent is not easy to migrate, the antibacterial and bacteriostatic ability of the antibacterial agent is ensured, the antibacterial agent is simple and convenient to use, has long-term effectiveness, and the impact resistance of hard PVC is improved.

title_en: Modified melamine hard foam material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and particularly discloses a modified melamine hard foam material and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Polyamide composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyamide composite material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: A) 20-80 parts of at least one polyamide E and at least one of polyamide I, polyamide II and polyamide III; the content of polyamide terminal amino E, polyamide I, polyamide II and polyamide III is more than the content of terminal carboxyl; B) 0-35 parts of a filler. The polyamide composite material has the advantages of good laser welding effect and the like.

title_en: High-molecular polymer modified diaphragm, preparation method and application
abstract_en: A high molecular polymer modified diaphragm, a preparation method and application thereof are provided, the high molecular polymer modified diaphragm comprises: the membrane comprises a membrane substrate and a high polymer layer adhered to the surface of the membrane substrate, wherein the high polymer layer is formed by free radical copolymerization of a monomer A, a monomer B and a monomer C, the monomer A is acrylonitrile or a derivative thereof, the monomer B is fluorine-containing (methyl) acrylate or a derivative thereof, the monomer C is alkyl alcohol diacrylate or a derivative thereof, and the molar ratio of the monomer A to the monomer B to the monomer C is 1:1: 0.01-2. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out polymerization reaction on the reaction monomers at 50-80 ℃ for 5-24h to obtain a polymerization solution; freeze-drying the polymerization solution to obtain solid powder; preparing solid powder into slurry with the mass fraction of 5-30 wt%; and uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of the diaphragm substrate to obtain the high molecular polymer modified diaphragm. The invention also relates to the application of the high molecular polymer modified diaphragm in lithium metal batteries and lithium ion batteries. The invention inhibits dendritic crystal growth caused by overhigh local current density of the diaphragm and improves the performance of the battery.

title_en: Preparation method of modified aramid pulp masterbatch
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber processing, in particular to a preparation method of modified aramid pulp masterbatch, which comprises the steps of reasonably mixing aramid pulp with a modifier, a coupling agent, a separant, liquid rubber and solid rubber, carrying out chemical grafting modification on the inert surface of the aramid pulp through the modifier, the coupling agent and certain process steps to enable the aramid pulp to be bonded with matrix materials such as rubber and resin, and then selecting the liquid rubber, the separant and the solid rubber to carry out isolation and pre-dispersion on the modified aramid pulp, wherein the obtained aramid pulp masterbatch has good interface strength and dispersibility, and can improve the crack expansion resistance of the matrix and improve the fatigue performance of a damping material when being used as a reinforcing material.

title_en: Spraying-free PP/PCTG alloy material with multicolor effect and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of PP alloy materials, in particular to a spraying-free PP/PCTG alloy material with a multicolor effect and a preparation method thereof. The alloy material comprises the following components in parts by mass: 10-35 parts of homopolymerized PP resin, 40-65 parts of copolymerized PP resin, 5-15 parts of PCTG resin, 4-8 parts of POE toughening agent, 1-2 parts of lubricant, 0.5-1.5 parts of weather resistant agent, 5-15 parts of multicolor pearlescent master batch and 5-78 parts of compatilizer II 0; the colorful pearlescent master batch comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by mass: 60-90 parts of homopolymerized PP resin, 5-5 parts of compatilizer I3, 10-30 parts of multicolor pearlescent pigment, 1-5 parts of coupling agent, 1-5 parts of oriented arrangement agent, 1-2 parts of lubricant and 0.1-0.5 part of antioxidant. The PP/PCTG alloy material has good impact resistance, and can show good multicolor effect without spraying.

title_en: Thermoplastic composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermoplastic composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the thermoplastic composite material comprises a surface layer material and a framework material; the surface layer material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of high-fluidity polypropylene resin, 45-50 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-8 parts of highlight improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black; the framework material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-35 parts of medium-high fluidity polypropylene resin, 50-70 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-12 parts of low warpage improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black. The thermoplastic composite material provided by the invention has good mechanical properties, high surface gloss, high strength, low warpage and high temperature resistance, meets the requirements of automobile engine hood cover materials, and realizes the light weight of automobiles.

title_en: Process for producing aqueous polytetrafluoroethylene dispersion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for producing an aqueous polytetrafluoroethylene dispersion, which can produce an aqueous fluoropolymer dispersion having a very small particle size and excellent dispersion stability without using a long-chain fluorosurfactant. The present invention relates to a method for producing an aqueous fluoropolymer dispersion, which comprises polymerizing a fluoromonomer in an aqueous medium in the presence of a fluorinated surfactant having a LogPOW of 3.4 or less and a polymerization initiator, wherein the aqueous dispersion contains at least one fluoropolymer selected from the group consisting of polytetrafluoroethylene and melt-processable fluororesins (excluding polytetrafluoroethylene), and wherein the amount of the fluorinated surfactant in the aqueous medium is 4600ppm to 500000ppm.

title_en: Polyacrylonitrile-hydroxyurea chelate fiber and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyacrylonitrile-hydroxyurea chelate fiber, which has the structural formula as follows: the invention also discloses a synthetic method thereof, which comprises the following steps: adding polyacrylonitrile fiber (as a matrix), hydroxyurea (as a ligand) and sodium carbonate into a solvent, and heating to 110-140 ℃ under the microwave condition to react for 5-20 min; and washing the obtained polymer with deionized water, and drying to obtain the polyacrylonitrile-hydroxyurea chelate fiber. The invention also discloses the application of the polyacrylonitrile-hydroxyurea chelate fiber: selectively adsorbing Cu (II); the method is used for detecting the Cu (II) content in the vegetables.

title_en: Preparation method of composite polyimide flame-retardant sheet material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polymer-based composite materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a novel composite polyimide flame-retardant plate. The preparation raw material of the flame-retardant plate comprises graphene with active amino on the surface. The obtained plate has excellent flame retardance, and simultaneously still maintains good mechanical properties.

title_en: Environment-friendly water-based printing acrylic emulsion, preparation method thereof and water-based printing paint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly water-based printing acrylic emulsion, a preparation method thereof and a water-based printing coating, wherein the emulsion comprises 54-70 parts of butyl acrylate, 12-20 parts of styrene, 32-50 parts of ethyl acrylate, 0.8-2 parts of acrylic acid, 5-10 parts of acrylonitrile, 0.6-1.2 parts of self-crosslinking monomer, 0.3-0.8 part of silicon functional monomer, 3.4-6.0 parts of internal crosslinking monomer, 3-7 parts of emulsifier, 0.4-1 part of initiator and 90-110 parts of deionized water; the emulsion is self-crosslinked at low temperature, soft in hand feeling, excellent in elasticity and blocking resistance, has excellent firmness and adhesive force on various garment fabrics, and has a special dye migration and sublimation resistant effect on some polyester-containing fabrics; the method has the advantages of stable reaction, strong controllability, environmental protection and energy saving.

title_en: Preparation method of waterborne polyurethane for synthetic leather
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of waterborne polyurethane for synthetic leather, and relates to the field of organic chemistry. The preparation method of the waterborne polyurethane comprises the following steps: 5-10 parts by mass of side chain polyether glycol and 45-50 parts by mass of polypropylene glycol in N 2 Dehydrating under protection (the dehydration condition is vacuum at 100-110 ℃ for 1-2 h), cooling to normal temperature, adding 30-35 parts by mass of isophorone diisocyanate, dropwise adding 0.2-0.4 part by mass of dibutyltin laurate, heating to 70-90 ℃, reacting for 1-3 h, adding 2-4 parts by mass of dimethylolpropionic acid, and reacting for 1-3 h to obtain a prepolymer; and (3) after the temperature of the prepolymer is reduced to below 50 ℃, adding 2-3 parts by mass of triethylamine, and adding deionized water under the stirring condition to obtain the waterborne polyurethane emulsion. The waterborne polyurethane for synthetic leather prepared by the method has the advantage of hydrolysis resistance.

title_en: Epoxy resin for halogen-free flame-retardant glass fiber reinforced composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epoxy resin for a halogen-free flame-retardant glass fiber reinforced composite material and a preparation method thereof. The material comprises epoxy resin, polysulfide rubber, toughening agent, halogen-free flame retardant and accelerant. The invention solves the problem of the balance among the flame retardant property, the original property of the matrix and the production cost which is difficult to realize in the application aspect of the existing epoxy resin, is suitable for industrial production, effectively improves the flame retardant efficiency, reduces the addition amount of the flame retardant and reduces the production cost. The prepared epoxy resin has a limiting oxygen index of more than 29 and vertical combustion V-0.Tg = 159-164 ℃, the thermal conductivity can reach 0.234W/m.K, the water absorption is less than 0.4wt%, the dielectric constant is less than 4, and the curing temperature is 120 ℃. Can be widely applied to the high and new technical fields of transportation, aerospace, composite materials and the like.

title_en: Low-content polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon rubber compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber application, in particular to a low-content polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon rubber compound and a preparation method thereof. In the rubber compound, the content of benzo (a) pyrene is less than 0.1mg/kg, and the content of benzo (e) pyrene is less than 0.1 mg/kg. The invention provides a rubber compound, which can reduce the content of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon in the rubber compound by selecting proper preparation raw materials, ensure safety, and can be used for materials which are directly or indirectly contacted with a human body, such as toys, tableware, office supplies and the like; in addition, by selecting proper preparation raw materials, the invention can effectively relieve the reduction of tensile strength, elasticity and flexing resistance caused by using an effective sulfur vulcanization system, thereby improving the overall performance and the use stability of the rubber compound.

title_en: Preparation method of xanthan gum oligosaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of xanthan gum oligosaccharide, belonging to the technical field of biology. The invention comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a xanthan gum-acid solution with the final concentration of the xanthan gum being 1%; (2) adding the ionic liquid into the xanthan gum solution obtained in the step (1), stirring until the xanthan gum is dissolved, wherein the final concentration of the ionic liquid in the obtained solution is 1-50 mg/mL, and reacting the obtained solution under a stirring state; (3) after the reaction is finished, adjusting the pH value of the solution to be neutral, then filtering, and dialyzing the filtrate; and after the dialysis is finished, freeze-drying to obtain the xanthan gum oligosaccharide. The method can prepare the xanthan gum oligosaccharide with high activity, simultaneously improves the yield of the oligosaccharide, and lays a foundation for the industrial production and application of the xanthan gum oligosaccharide.

title_en: Flame retardant and flame resistant polyolefin compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to polyolefin compositions having flame retardant and/or fire resistant properties and suitable as flame retardant and/or fire resistant layers for wires and cables. The polyolefin composition of the invention comprises a polyolefin homo-or copolymer, from 30 to 60 wt% of a metal hydroxide based on the weight of the polyolefin composition, and from 5 to 25 wt% of a borate based on the weight of the polyolefin composition. The invention further relates to a wire or cable comprising one or more layers, wherein at least one layer thereof is obtained from the polyolefin composition of the invention. Finally, the invention further relates to the use of the polyolefin composition of the invention as a flame retardant layer for wires or cables.

title_en: Polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material has a basic unit of a core-shell structure, a core is a carbon material, a shell is a polyacrylonitrile layer, and the polyacrylonitrile layer is a single layer or multiple layers; the carbon material is a carbon material having a graphite lattice structure. The polyacrylonitrile-coated graphene oxide composite material realizes the tight coating of the graphene by the polymer while realizing the uniform introduction of the graphene into a spinning system, isolates the interaction between the graphene, reduces the accumulation tendency, greatly shortens the time required by the uniform mixing of the graphene and the polyacrylonitrile, and improves the production efficiency. Moreover, the introduced graphene can play the role of a nucleating agent and a template agent in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, so that a more complete graphite lattice structure of the carbon fiber is obtained, and various performances of the carbon fiber are improved.

title_en: Polyimide film with improved surface quality and method for preparing same
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a polyimide film prepared by imidizing a polyamic acid prepared by polymerizing a first dianhydride, a second dianhydride, a first diamine, and a second diamine.

title_en: Low-molecular-weight and high-trans-1, 4-polyisoprene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A low molecular weight and high trans-1, 4-polyisoprene and its preparation method are provided. The invention belongs to the field of conjugated diene catalytic polymerization. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of double bond deletion caused by difficult control of cyclization side reaction in the existing cationic polymerization isoprene process. Starting from the inhibition of cyclization side reactions, protonic acid (disulfonimide protonic acid containing different substituents) which is less researched and low in cost is used as a catalyst, ionic liquid is used as a solvent, and the cyclization side reactions are reduced by reducing the electron cloud density of molecular chain double bonds, so that the low-molecular-weight and high-trans-1, 4-polyisoprene and the preparation method thereof are provided. The microstructure composition of the low molecular weight and high trans-1, 4-polyisoprene consists of 90-98 percent of trans-1, 4-polyisoprene and 2-10 percent of 3, 4-polyisoprene in percentage by mass; the number average molecular weight is 500g/mol to 3000g/mol, and the molecular weight distribution is 1.2 to 3.0; the double bond retention DB is 82 to 94 percent.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrophilic softening agent with good compatibility for cotton
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a hydrophilic softening agent for cotton with good compatibility, which comprises the following steps: hydrolyzing N-cyclohexyl-gamma-aminopropylmethyldimethoxysilane and 3-piperazinylpropylmethyldimethoxysilane, and adding octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane and ethyl cellulose to prepare amino silicone oil; adding an emulsifier and hydroxyethyl ethylenediamine into the prepared amino silicone oil, uniformly mixing, and slowly adding a certain amount of deionized water mixed with glacial acetic acid to prepare an organic silicon emulsion; mixing the organosilicon emulsion, octadecyl dimethyl amine ethyl lactone and water uniformly.

title_en: Chemically cured water-based 2-component compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a two-component composition comprising: A) a first component a comprising: -an aqueous dispersion of at least one polymer P1; B) a second component B comprising: -at least one hydraulic binder H, -at least one functional compound P2; wherein both components a and B are liquid or pasty and both are prepared and stored separately and mixed directly before application; and with the proviso that the functional compound P2 comprises a functional group which chemically reacts with said aqueous dispersion of said first polymer P1 to form a crosslinked and/or chain-extended polymer. The compositions of the present invention are highly suitable cementitious adhesives, joint sealants, casting compositions or coatings and exhibit improved mechanical properties, adhesive properties and resistance and minimized plasticizer migration problems.

title_en: Hydrophobic oleophobic antistatic PVC composite film
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-fouling antistatic PVC composite film which comprises the following components in parts by weight: an antistatic PVC composite film is taken as a substrate, and an anti-fouling self-cleaning agent is screen-printed on the surface of the substrate; the antistatic PVC composite film comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 4565% of polyvinyl chloride, 10-14% of polytetrafluoroethylene, 12-18% of acrylic monomer, 6-10% of hydroxylated graphene, 4-6% of aminated graphene, 0.1-0.5% of catalyst, 1.8-4% of hyperbranched polystyrene, 1-2% of polypyrrole and 0.1-0.5% of dispersant; the antifouling self-cleaning agent comprises the following components in percentage by weight: nano TiO2  2  30-55% of sol, 5-10% of nano silver powder, 10-15% of lotus leaf hydrophobic agent, 10-15% of perfluorooctyl triethoxysilane and 2030% of perfluoroalkyl ethyl acrylate. The method utilizes the chemical crosslinking action of the graphene with a special functional group structure and the acrylic resin to introduce the graphene into an acrylic polymer molecular chain, and utilizes the principle of similar compatibility among media to ensure that the modified graphene conductive particles are stably compatible with the PVC resin, so that the PVC composite film has permanent antistatic capability.

title_en: PC composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PC composite material and a preparation method thereof. The PC composite material is prepared from the following raw materials: PC, vinyl POSS-g- (EMA-co-GMA), a reinforcing material, an antioxidant and a lubricant. The PC composite material is prepared by the method of firstly adopting the reaction of vinyl POSS and EMA-co-GMA to generate vinyl POSS-g- (EMA-co-GMA), and then melting and blending the vinyl POSS with PC and a reinforcing material. The PC composite material provided by the invention has lower dielectric constant and dielectric loss, and has higher heat resistance and mechanical strength.

title_en: Preparation method of binary metal MOFs material and application of binary metal MOFs material in reducing harm of cigarette smoke
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a binary metal MOFs material and application thereof in reducing harm of cigarette smoke, which is characterized in thatIn alkaline aqueous solution, terephthalic acid and binary mixed metal ion (Cu) are utilized  2+  、Fe  2+  And Ni  2+  Any two of ions) to perform a hydrothermal reflux reaction, thereby obtaining the binary metal MOFs material. The binary metal MOFs material provided by the invention is added into a cigarette filter tip, so that NH in cigarette smoke can be effectively adsorbed and degraded  3  And harmful gases including CO.

title_en: Alignment film material, preparation method of alignment film, display panel and preparation method of display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alignment film material, a preparation method of the alignment film, a display panel and a preparation method of the display panel. The alignment film material comprises a polyimide main body and a branched chain, the display panel comprises two substrates, an alignment film and a liquid crystal layer which are oppositely arranged, the alignment film material is the alignment film material, and the branched chain in the alignment film material extends into liquid crystal molecules of the liquid crystal layer. The invention has the technical effects of reducing the rotation viscosity of the liquid crystal layer, increasing the liquid crystal elastic constant of the liquid crystal layer and realizing the purpose of improving the response time of the display panel.

title_en: Super absorbent polymer and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: Superabsorbent polymers and methods of making the same are provided. The method of preparing a superabsorbent polymer of the present invention can provide a superabsorbent polymer having improved rewetting characteristics and liquid permeability.

title_en: Method for forming resist pattern
abstract_en: The present invention provides a resist pattern forming method comprising: a step of forming a resist film using a positive resist composition containing a polymer having a solvent and units represented by the following general formulae (I) and (II), respectively; an exposure step; a developing step; and a step of rinsing the developed resist film with a rinse solution having a surface tension of 20.0mN/m or less. In the formula (I), R is  1  Is an organic group having 3 to 7 fluorine atoms, in the formula (II), R  2  Is hydrogen, fluorine, alkyl which is unsubstituted or substituted by fluorine, R  3  Is a hydrogen atom, an unsubstituted alkyl group or an alkyl group substituted with a fluorine atom, p and q are integers of 0 to 5, and p+q=5.

title_en: Metal-ligand complex, catalyst composition, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a metal-ligand complex, a catalyst composition for ethylene polymerization comprising the same, and a method for producing an ethylene polymer using the same, wherein the metal-ligand complex of the present invention having a specific functional group introduced at a specific position has high solubility and high catalyst activity, and therefore the catalyst composition for ethylene polymerization comprising the same can produce an ethylene polymer having excellent physical properties.

title_en: Organic phase change energy storage material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic phase change energy storage material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving N-isopropyl acrylamide, N' -methylene bisacrylamide and polyethylene glycol 1000 in deionized water; initiating polymerization reaction in an ammonium persulfate and tetramethylethylenediamine redox system to form poly-N-isopropyl acrylamide gel with polyethylene glycol 1000 as a pore-foaming agent; 2) soaking in distilled water; 3) putting the frozen poly N-isopropylacrylamide gel into a freeze dryer for freeze drying; 4) and respectively soaking the freeze-dried poly N-isopropyl acrylamide gel in the binary organic compound for swelling to prepare the organic phase change energy storage material. The material and the preparation method thereof are very suitable for the fresh-keeping, storage and transportation of fruits and vegetables.

title_en: Clean production preparation method of hydrotalcite for plastic processing
abstract_en: A clean production preparation method of hydrotalcite for plastic processing belongs to the technical field of hydrotalcite synthesis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and stirring an aluminum source, a magnesium source and carbonate, adding water under the action of a catalyst to react into paste, and reacting at the temperature of 0-90 ℃, wherein the molar ratio of the magnesium source to the aluminum source to the carbonate is (3-6) to 2:1, the catalyst accounts for 0.1-0.3% of the total mass of the solid, and the water accounts for 0.8-30 times of the total weight of the solid; and then, the reactant is aged for no more than 20 hours, and then the aged product is dried, crushed and ground to be more than 800 meshes, and packaged into the hydrotalcite for plastic processing. The method has the advantages of low manufacturing cost, no need of high-temperature high-pressure hydrolysis, simple production equipment, simple operation and the like, and is a clean production process without three wastes.

title_en: Flame-retardant EPS foam material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant EPS foam material, wherein in the preparation raw materials of the foam material, 1-20 parts of surface modified microencapsulated flame retardant, 0.1-2 parts of initiator, 2-10 parts of foaming agent, 100 parts of deionized water and 200 parts of water system auxiliary material and 0.2-1.5 parts of water system auxiliary material are matched and used for every 100 parts of styrene monomer, and the water system auxiliary material comprises 0.1-1 part of dispersing agent and 0.1-0.5 part of emulsifying agent. The surface modified microencapsulated flame retardant is prepared by microencapsulating a metal hydroxide flame retardant, an organic silicon flame retardant and an organic phosphorus flame retardant and then carrying out surface modification by hexamethyldisilazane, so that silicon nitrogen atoms are introduced into a system to increase flame retardance, and the compatibility between the flame retardant and a polymer can be increased, so that the polymer is dispersed more uniformly.

title_en: Primary stomach super-absorbent gel and preparation method thereof, and weight-reducing composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primary stomach super-absorbent gel and a preparation method thereof, a stomach super-absorbent gel and a preparation method thereof, and a weight-reducing composition, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The structural formula of the hydrogel primary product is as follows: r1 is COONa, COOK, CH  2  OCH  2  OCOONa or CH  2  OCH  2  CH  2  OH, etc., R2 is O or NH, etc., R3 is O, NH, O (CH)  2  CH  2  O)  n4  、[CH  2  CH(OH)]  n5  Or (CH)  2  CH  2  )  y  Etc., R4 is OH, NHCOCH  3  Or NH  2  Etc.; n1 to n5, x and y are integers greater than 0. The hydrogel primary product can increase satiety of patients and reduce weight by reducing intake, and has high biocompatibility. Intragastric superabsorbent gel and weight loss compositionAlso with the above effects, the weight-loss composition also avoids the risk of entering the small intestine for blockage after gastric emptying. The preparation method of the substance is simple and easy to operate.

title_en: Modified acrylate emulsion and water-based paint containing same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified acrylate emulsion and a water-based paint containing the same. The invention adopts acrylamide fly ash to load nitrogen-doped nano TiO 2 The photocatalyst is modified to obtain acrylate emulsion with a core-shell structure, and the acrylate emulsion is used as a base material, and a plurality of water-based paint auxiliaries are added to prepare the water-based paint capable of absorbing and degrading indoor organic volatile gas. The coating emulsion adopts nitrogen-doped modified nano TiO loaded by fly ash 2 The photocatalyst realizes good dispersion of the photocatalyst in the emulsion, enlarges the light absorption range and obviously improves the photocatalytic efficiency of indoor volatile organic compounds; the coal ash is solid waste of a coal-fired power plant, has a porous structure, can realize good adsorption of indoor organic volatile gas, is easy to obtain raw materials and low in price, and effectively reduces the cost of the coating. The emulsion adopts a semi-continuous seed emulsion polymerization process, has a core-shell structure, and obviously prolongs the storage time of the product.

title_en: Liquid metal/high polymer composite dielectric material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and particularly relates to a liquid metal/polymer composite dielectric material and a preparation method thereof. Uniformly blending the polymerization monomer solution, the liquid metal and the cross-linking agent to obtain a precursor solution; and standing the precursor solution to obtain the high-molecular dielectric material. The preparation method is simple and convenient, and the prepared composite material has excellent dielectric property and better tensile property than the traditional dielectric material, and has wide application prospect in the fields of wearable electronic equipment, soft robots and the like.

title_en: Cationized cellulose/graphene/polypyrrole conductive composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cationized cellulose/graphene/polypyrrole conductive composite material and a preparation method and application thereof; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, oxidizing graphene to obtain reduced graphene oxide by using a reducing agent, then modifying bacterial cellulose by using a quaternary ammonium salt type cationic etherifying agent to prepare a cationized bacterial cellulose dispersion liquid by using the bacterial cellulose as a matrix, then compounding the cationized cellulose dispersion liquid serving as a dispersing agent with the reduced graphene to prepare a cationized cellulose/graphene dispersion liquid, and finally uniformly mixing and reacting the cationized cellulose/graphene dispersion liquid with a pyrrole monomer and an oxidant to obtain the cationized cellulose/graphene/polypyrrole conductive composite material with excellent electrochemical properties. The invention realizes the unification of dispersibility, system compatibility and electrochemical performance, solves the problem that graphene is easy to agglomerate, and prepares the modified cellulose/graphene/polypyrrole conductive composite material with excellent electrochemical performance.

title_en: Preparation method of SG5 type polyvinyl chloride resin with high plasticizing performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of polyvinyl chloride, in particular to a preparation method of SG5 type polyvinyl chloride resin. Deionized water, a pH buffer, a vinyl chloride monomer and a dispersant are added into a polymerization kettle under a stirring state, and then an interface regulator is added to obtain a micro-suspension polymerization system. And adding an initiator into the micro-suspension polymerization system, and then adding a terminator to terminate the polymerization reaction. And adding a defoaming agent after the reaction is finished, and carrying out steam stripping, centrifugation and drying to obtain the product. According to the invention, the polyvinyl alcohol dispersing agent with 80% alcoholysis degree and 72% alcoholysis degree is added in the preparation process of the polyvinyl chloride resin, so that the involucra of the PVC resin is reduced, the oil absorption rate is improved, and the plasticizing performance is improved.

title_en: Polyamide acid, polyamide acid resin, heat-resistant transparent polyimide and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyamic acid, polyamic acid resin, heat-resistant transparent polyimide and a preparation method, wherein the polyamic acid is obtained by polymerization reaction of not less than one fluorine-containing diamine monomer, not less than one fluorine-containing dianhydride monomer and a capping reagent in an aprotic polar solvent; wherein the fluorine-containing dianhydride with the following structure accounts for 5-20% of the total molar amount of the fluorine-containing dianhydride. The glass transition temperature of the transparent polyimide prepared by the invention is more than 370 ℃, the thermal expansion coefficient is less than 17ppm/K, the light transmittance at 500nm is more than 90%, and the transparent polyimide is suitable for manufacturing transparent substrates, cover plates and touch layers in the field of flexible display.

title_en: Polyolefin resin composition and process for producing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a polyolefin resin composition and a method for producing the same. The present invention provides a polyolefin resin satisfying the following conditions: (1) A melt index (MI 2.16, 190 ℃, under 2.16kg load) of 0.1 to 1.5g/10min; (2) a density of 0.91 to 0.93g/cc; (3) A polydispersity index (Mw (weight average molecular weight)/Mn (number average molecular weight)) of 3 to 7; (4) Mz (Z average molecular weight)/Mw (weight average molecular weight) is 2.3 to 4.5; (5) COI (comonomer orthogonality index) values calculated by equation 1 in the specification are 5 to 12. In equation 1, "SCB number at Mz" represents the average number of branches derived from the comonomer per 1000 carbon atoms at Z average molecular weight (Mz), and "SCB number at Mn" represents the average number of short chain branches derived from the comonomer per 1000 carbon atoms at number average molecular weight (Mn) when a molecular weight-comonomer distribution graph is plotted in which a log value (log Mw) of molecular weight (Mw) is plotted on the x-axis of the graph and the amount (dw _ dlog Mw) of the polymer corresponding to the log value (log Mw) and the average number of short chain branches derived from the comonomer (SCB) corresponding to the log value (log Mw) (the average number of branches per 1000 carbon atoms, unit: number/1000C) is plotted on the y-axis of the graph).

title_en: Preparation method of semi-polymerized ionic liquid-filled super-smooth surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a semi-polymerized ionic liquid perfusion-based super-smooth surface, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: firstly, modifying the surface of porous anodic aluminum oxide; then uniformly spreading the ionic liquid prepolymer on the modified porous anodic aluminum oxide surface; secondly, horizontally placing for 10 min under the condition of-80 KPa, and rotating at the rotating speed of 1000 rpm for 10 s to obtain porous anodic alumina infused with ionic liquid prepolymer; finally, the porous anodic alumina infused with the ionic liquid prepolymer is subjected to heat preservation for 5 hours at 80 ℃ under the vacuum condition, and a layer of polyion gel film can be formed on the pore wall; and the excessive unpolymerized ionic liquid prepolymer on the surface of the porous anodic aluminum oxide is used as a lubricating layer of the super-smooth surface. The method has the advantages of simple process, easily obtained raw materials, strong stability of the obtained super-smooth surface, good performance and suitability for large-area preparation and application.

title_en: Thiodiglycol molecularly imprinted polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thiodiglycol molecularly imprinted polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of analysis and detection. Template molecule thiodiglycol is combined with functional monomer alpha-methacrylic acid through hydrogen bonds, after cross-linking agent N, N-dimethyl methylene bisacrylamide and initiator ammonium persulfate are added, polymerization reaction is carried out, finally, template molecules are washed away, binding sites capable of specifically recognizing thiodiglycol are left, and the thiodiglycol molecularly imprinted polymer is prepared. After the polymer specifically adsorbs thiodiglycol, the thiodiglycol can form a firm gold-sulfur bond with gold nanoparticles due to the fact that the thiodiglycol has sulfur atoms, a large number of gold nanoparticles can be adsorbed, and visible red can be formed. The polymer and the corresponding test paper have simple preparation method and easy operation, and are suitable for expanded production.

title_en: Triazine ligand-based two-dimensional metal organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triazine ligand-based two-dimensional metal organic framework material, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the metal organic framework is Zn-MOFs formed by chelating triazine organic ligand 2,4, 6-tri- [4- (8-hydroxy-2-vinyl-quinoline) -phenyl ] -1,3, 5-triazine with metal zinc ions. The novel ligand 2,4, 6-tri- [4- (8-hydroxy-2-vinyl-quinoline) -phenyl ] -1,3, 5-triazine prepared by the invention has excellent solubility in dichloromethane, and has high complexing speed with metal ions, and the novel ligand is chelated with zinc ions by an interfacial diffusion method to obtain the novel two-dimensional metal organic framework material Zn-MOFs.

title_en: Self-repairing carbon nanotube-organic silicon composite elastomer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-repairing carbon nano tube-organic silicon composite elastomer and a preparation method and application thereof. The self-repairing carbon nano tube-organic silicon composite elastomer comprises raw materials of amino-terminated polydimethylsiloxane, diisocyanate and carboxylated carbon nano tubes, reversible strong and weak multiple hydrogen bonds are formed in the composite elastomer, and the composite elastomer can be used as weak dynamic bonds to consume energy generated by strain, so that the elastomer shows excellent tensile property, can quickly repair cracks and has excellent self-repairing property. Meanwhile, the introduction of the carboxylated carbon nanotube further enhances the hydrogen bond effect, and endows the strain sensor with excellent conductivity and sensitive sensing performance. According to the invention, the flexible strain sensor with high repair efficiency, excellent tensile property and high sensitivity can be prepared by a crosslinking mechanism of strong and weak hydrogen bonds in the carbon nanotube-organic silicon elastomer.

title_en: Low-dielectric high-melt-strength flame-retardant polypropylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-dielectric high-melt-strength flame-retardant polypropylene material and a preparation method thereof. The invention utilizes the synergistic flame-retardant effect of the organic modified POSS and the flame-retardant system, can reduce the use amount of the flame retardant by 20 percent and still realize the flame-retardant grade V-0; the organic modified POSS and the toughening agent cooperate with the melt to enhance the effect, the melt strength of the composite material can be improved by 20-100 Pa.s to 70-150 Pa.s, and the melt integrity of the material under the conditions of plastic uptake/foaming/extrusion is ensured; meanwhile, due to the self hollow structure of the POSS, the dielectric constant of the composite material can be reduced, and the application field is expanded.

title_en: Covalent crosslinking proton exchange membrane containing carboxyl sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone/amino modified metal organic framework and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a covalent cross-linking proton exchange membrane containing carboxyl sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone/amino modified metal organic framework and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the fields of polymer chemistry and proton exchange membrane fuel cells, wherein MIL-101-NH  2  The mass ratio of the sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone containing carboxyl to the sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone containing carboxyl is 0.02-0.08: 1. Synthetic MIL-101-NH  2  Successfully introducing free amino into a skeleton structure, and then using the Hirschmanning reaction to introduce MIL-101-NH  2  Anchored to the backbone of a sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone containing carboxyl groups by chemical bonding, MIL-101-NH  2  Iron ions in the membrane dissociate protons from coordinated water molecules under the catalysis of Lewis acid and conduct protons under the action of hydrogen bonds, and in the proton exchange membrane, sulfonyl imide groups can provide protons and conduct protons under the condition of MIL-101-NH  2  And sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone containing carboxyl, thereby realizing long-distance proton transmission. The invention relates to a covalently cross-linked sulfonated polyaryletherketone sulfone containing carboxyl/MIL-101-NH  2  The proton conductivity of the proton exchange composite membrane at 80 ℃ is 0.030S cm  ‑1  ‑0.080S cm  ‑1  The thickness of the hybrid membrane is 20-25 μm.

title_en: Improved drill gun exhaust device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aviation equipment, in particular to an improved drill gun exhaust device; the invention discloses an improved drill gun exhaust device, which is used for adjusting the direction of an air outlet by changing the position of the air outlet, so that the problem that dust is blown up during operation is solved. The method is characterized in that the method comprises the steps of measuring the original exhaust device size and the fixed position size in a real object manner, adopting basic skills of a bench worker, adopting a metal material, adopting a stamping process to generate a convex air outlet cavity (1) in the middle of the material, then, carrying out opening holes of air outlets (2) on two sides of the air outlet cavity (1), finally carrying out opening holes of fixed hole sites (3), and fixing the fixed hole sites (3) to corresponding positions of a tool.

title_en: Hyperbranched polyester, preparation method thereof and water-based paint prepared from hyperbranched polyester
abstract_en: The scheme relates to hyperbranched polyester, a preparation method thereof and a water-based paint prepared from the hyperbranched polyester. The preparation method has the advantages that the hyperbranched polyester is prepared by combining the SCVP method and the RAFT method, the synthetic process is simple, the product has reaction activity, different polymerizable monomers can be added according to application scenes, and the application range is wide; the soft-core hard-shell polyester resin obtained by the invention has higher hardness and glossiness, and excellent weather resistance and moldability; the water-based paint obtained by compounding the hyperbranched polyester and various additives has strong adhesive force on metal plates, can block water and air after being coated, has better stain resistance, chemical resistance and aging resistance, and can be applied to the protection of outdoor metal steel.

title_en: Flame-retardant hot-melt adhesive
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a hot melt adhesive composition comprising 15 to 45 wt% of at least one tackifying resin and 20 to 60 wt% of a mixture of at least one single site catalysed propylene homopolymer (a) and at least one propylene copolymer (B), wherein the propylene homopolymer (a) has a weight average molecular weight of 20,000 to 145,000, the propylene copolymer (B) has an ethylene comonomer content of 5 to 25 wt%, and the weight ratio of the propylene homopolymer (a) to the propylene copolymer (B) is 1:3 to 3:1, wherein the hot melt adhesive further comprises at least one of the following two components (a) and (B): (a) a particulate phosphorus-based compound in an amount of 15 to 40 wt%, or (b) a room-temperature liquid phosphorus-based compound in an amount of 4 to 15 wt%.

title_en: Sealing element for cable connection part, sealing element material formula and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sealing element for a cable junction, a sealing element material formula and a preparation method, and relates to the technical field of cable accessories, the sealing element material formula for the cable junction comprises a sealing sleeve, the middle part of the sealing sleeve is provided with a bulging pipe, the bulging pipe is provided with a telescopic pipe, the sealing sleeve, the bulging pipe and the telescopic pipe are of an integrated structure, and the material formula for producing the sealing element comprises natural rubber, sulfur, magnesium oxide, magnesium hydroxide, tridecafluorooctyltrimethoxysilane, trioctyl trimellitate, an anti-aging agent DPN1-2, bisphenol A and paraffin; the invention also provides a method for preparing the sealing element by using the sealing element material formula at the cable joint. The sealing element disclosed by the invention is flexible and convenient to use, has a good sealing effect, has good hydrophobicity on the premise of ensuring good flexibility, elasticity, oxidation resistance, acid resistance and alkali resistance of the sealing element, can effectively improve the weather resistance of the sealing element, and prolongs the service life of the sealing element.

title_en: Polyethylene glycol derivative modified beta-cyclodextrin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyethylene glycol derivative modified beta-cyclodextrin and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyethylene glycol derivative modified beta-cyclodextrin has a molecular structure shown in a formula (I): wherein n is 1.06-1.25, and Mn is 3000-6000. The invention prepares the polyethylene glycol derivative modified beta-cyclodextrin with the molecular structure shown in the formula (I), the invention adopts the nontoxic and harmless polyethylene glycol derivative as the raw material to carry out chemical modification on the beta-cyclodextrin, improves the hydrophilicity of the cyclodextrin, and the synthesized polymer has uniform molecular weight distribution, molecular stability and enhanced hydrophilicity and can be applied as the hydrophilic part material of a drug carrier.

title_en: High-temperature-shrinkage-resistant polyethylene foam sheet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-shrinkage-resistant polyethylene foam sheet, which is characterized in that the polyolefin foam composition comprises HDPE and LDPE or a composition of LDPE and LLDPE; when the foaming sheet is prepared, the traction speed of the foaming sheet entering the high-temperature foaming area after the softening stage is the first traction speed, the traction speed of the foaming sheet entering the cooling shaping area after the high-temperature foaming area is the second traction speed, and the ratio of the second speed to the first speed to the ratio of the expansion ratio of the foaming material relative to the volume of the original material is in the range of 0.65-0.8. The invention also provides a preparation method of the high-temperature-shrinkage-resistant polyethylene foam sheet. The foaming sheet material has stronger temperature resistance, hardness, tensile strength, rigidity and creep property, and has the functions of buffering, heat insulation, water resistance and sound insulation under the conditions of high temperature environment and higher requirement on dimensional accuracy.

title_en: Release film directly coated with concave-convex grain release agent and coating device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a release film directly coated with a concave-convex grain release agent, which comprises a release film, wherein the release film comprises a substrate layer and a first release layer, an antistatic layer is arranged between the substrate layer and the first release layer, the upper surface of the first release layer is coated with a second release layer, and the second release layer is a release agent layer with twill concave-convex grains, rhombic latticed concave-convex grains or honeycomb concave-convex grains. According to the invention, the distance between the scraper and the surface of the coating roller is adjusted, so that the amount of the scraped release agent is adjusted, the thickness of the release agent adhered to the surface of the coating roller is different, the thickness and the dosage of the release agent rolled in the production and processing of different release films can be adjusted accordingly, the scraper is manually adjusted, the positioning is convenient, the device is easy to operate, the production adaptability of a production device and different release films is increased, three coating rollers with different reticulates are installed, the coating rollers with different reticulates can be adjusted according to the production requirements for production and processing, and the cost of production equipment is saved.

title_en: Color rubber tire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a color rubber tire which mainly comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100-200 parts of rubber, 10-15 parts of white carbon black, 5-10 parts of paraffin oil, 3-4 parts of vulcanizing agent, 3-5 parts of silane coupling agent, 3-6 parts of coloring agent, 5-6 parts of antistatic agent, 3-5 parts of vulcanization accelerator, 2-3 parts of antimony mercaptide, 1-2 parts of tackifying resin, 4-6 parts of anti-aging agent, 3-5 parts of zinc oxide and 1-2 parts of stearic acid. The side tire of the invention has no color change phenomenon under the environment of strong illumination and damp heat, and has beautiful effect.

title_en: Fluoropolymer coating compositions
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a coating film having excellent durability and abrasion resistance and utility as a mold surface release coating. The coating film has excellent peelability (non-tackiness) over a long period of time. Also provided is a coating composition capable of forming such a coating film, the coating composition comprising a fluoropolymer and an oil that is liquid at 25 ℃, wherein the oil has a decomposition temperature that is higher than the melting point of the fluoropolymer.

title_en: Polycarbonate resin, preparation method and formed optical component
abstract_en: The invention provides a polycarbonate resin, a preparation method and a formed optical component. The polycarbonate resin comprises a polycarbonate having a structural unit represented by the following formula; in the formula, R 1 ‑R 2 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom, a hydroxyl group, an alkyl group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms, an alkoxy group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms, a cyclocarbon group having 5 to 20 carbon atoms, a cycloepoxy group having 5 to 20 carbon atoms, an aryl group having 6 to 20 carbon atoms or an aryloxy group having 6 to 20 carbon atoms; xAn alkylene group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms; n is any integer between 1 and 10. The polycarbonate resin prepared by the invention has the advantages of high refractive index, low birefringence and small Abbe number.

title_en: Preparation method of blocked isocyanate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of blocked isocyanate, which comprises the following steps: dissolving a sealing agent in sec-butyl acetate in a reaction kettle, introducing inert gas into the reaction kettle for protection, heating to a reaction temperature, adding isophorone diisocyanate into the reaction kettle, stirring for reaction, removing a solvent, discharging while hot, conveying into a cooling tabletting machine, and crushing a cooling scraping blade to obtain a product. The preparation method of the blocked isocyanate provided by the invention adopts sec-butyl acetate as a solvent to carry out the preparation reaction of the blocked isocyanate, the sec-butyl acetate has low toxicity, environmental protection, strong polarity and high boiling point, does not form a complex bond effect with a blocking agent, has a better promotion effect on the blocking reaction, and the blocking rate of the reaction can still reach more than 80% under the condition of not using a catalyst.

title_en: Application of fused ring structure compound as free radical polymerization reaction control agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of functional materials, and discloses an application of a compound with a parallel ring structure as a free radical polymerization reaction control agent. Preferably, the heterocyclic compound has a structure represented by any one of C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7 and C8. The compound with the fused ring structure has the fused ring structure consisting of an aromatic ring and a saturated carbon-containing six-membered ring, and has good chemical stability; the bond dissociation energy of the saturated carbon C-H bond in the saturated carbon six-membered ring is low, hydrogen atom transfer is easy to occur to block macromolecular free radicals, and the polymerization inhibiting effect is good.

title_en: Solar photovoltaic bracket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a solar photovoltaic bracket, which comprises a plurality of support brackets, wherein the support brackets are connected through a plurality of purlines, each support bracket comprises a cross beam, a front upright post detachably connected to one end of the cross beam, a rear upright post detachably connected to the other end of the cross beam, and a first diagonal bracing detachably connected between the cross beam and the rear upright post, and the height of the rear upright post is higher than that of the front upright post. The solar photovoltaic bracket comprises, by weight, 90-300 parts of glass fibers, 30-100 parts of resin, 40-50 parts of a wrapping felt, 3-15 parts of a low-shrinkage additive, 10-45 parts of a filler, 4-18 parts of an ultraviolet absorber, 4-18 parts of an anti-aging agent, 1-3 parts of color paste, 0.3-1.2 parts of an internal mold release agent and 1-5 parts of a curing agent. The solar photovoltaic bracket in the scheme uses resin as a matrix and uses glass fiber and a composite felt as reinforced composite materials, so that the composite materials have higher mechanical strength and better toughness, and can resist strong wind or external impact.

title_en: High-toughness high-flame-resistance foaming material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-toughness high-flame-resistance foaming material which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 83-93% of magnesium hydroxide, 9-12% of wood bran powder, 3.5-6% of perlite, 2-4.5% of glass fiber cloth and 0.3-1.5% of foaming agent. Further, a preparation method of the high-toughness high-flame-resistance foaming material is also provided, and comprises the following steps: (1) loosening and crushing various materials; (2) diluting the foaming agent, then uniformly mixing the diluted foaming agent with other materials, and placing the mixture in a mould for self foaming. The material prepared by the method is particularly suitable for serving as a fireproof board core material, and through testing, the fireproof board core material reaches A1-grade fireproof performance, is non-toxic, smokeless and odorless and has better toughness, crack resistance and strength than products on the market.

title_en: High-speed railway ballastless track convex blocking platform filling material and preparation method thereof
