abstract_en: The invention provides a convex retaining platform filling material for a ballastless track of a high-speed railway and a preparation method thereof, wherein the filling material comprises the following raw materials: the component A comprises maleimide modified asphalt, the component B comprises epoxy resin and the component C comprises epoxy resin curing agent; the component C comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of polyether amine curing agent, 20-45 parts of blocked polyurethane prepolymer, 10-20 parts of amino polydimethylsiloxane, 0-2.5 parts of curing accelerator and 5-17.5 parts of auxiliary agent; wherein the mass ratio of the component B to the component C is 1 (0.65-1.35), and the mass ratio of the component A to the sum of the component B, C is (0.5-1.5): 1. the filling material forms an epoxy resin-polyurethane interpenetrating polymer network or a sea-island structure after being cured, so that the flexibility of the material is greatly improved, and the shear strength, adhesive force, tensile strength, bending strength and the like of an adhesive layer are improved.

title_en: Cellulose acetate particles, process for producing the same, filler, cosmetic and daily use product
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for producing cellulose particles or cellulose acetate particles, a filler, a cosmetic and a daily necessity, wherein the particle diameter and particle diameter distribution can be controlled and the productivity is higher. Cellulose acetate particles are produced by a production method comprising the steps of: (a) a step for preparing a cellulose acetate solution by dissolving cellulose acetate in an organic solvent; (b) a step of obtaining an emulsion by passing the cellulose acetate solution and an aqueous medium through a gap between an outer cylinder and an inner cylinder disposed coaxially within the outer cylinder and rotating at least one of the outer cylinder and the inner cylinder; and (c) precipitating cellulose acetate particles from the emulsion. Further, cellulose particles are produced by a step of saponifying the acetylcellulose obtained by the production method.

title_en: Conductive adhesive tape with high-temperature automatic circuit breaking function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive adhesive tape with a high-temperature automatic circuit-breaking function, which comprises a base layer and an adhesive layer coated on the surface of one side of the base layer; the base layer adopts a conductive base material; the adhesive layer is a pressure-sensitive adhesive containing conductive particles and expanded microspheres; the expanded microsphere consists of a thermoplastic polymer shell and liquid alkane gas sealed in the thermoplastic polymer shell. The conductive adhesive tape can automatically disconnect a circuit when heated at high temperature, so that fire caused by overheating is prevented, and the safety of electronic elements is guaranteed.

title_en: Physical aging-resistant polylactic acid porous material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical aging resistant polylactic acid porous material, a preparation method and application thereof. The polylactic acid porous material has a three-dimensional porous structure and comprises 0 wt% -85 wt% of crystalline phase and 15 wt% -100 wt% of amorphous phase; the amorphous phase comprises 5 wt% to 75 wt% of metastable phase, and the characteristic peak of the metastable phase in an infrared spectrogram appears at 918cm ‑1 To (3). The polylactic acid porous material has the characteristic of physical aging resistance, and the change rates of the yield strength and the elongation at break before and after storage are small, so that the obtained disposable lunch box and food packaging materialThe product such as material, medical supplies and the like not only has the strength equivalent to or superior to that of the existing polylactic acid foaming material, but also has excellent physical aging resistance, can keep the stability of size and performance in the storage logistics stage, and meanwhile, the preparation process is beneficial to large-scale production and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Organic silicon heat insulation layer for engine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic silicon heat insulation layer for an engine and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials of the organic silicon heat insulation layer comprise: the heat-vulcanized two-component liquid silicone rubber serving as a matrix raw material, powdery ablation-resistant filler, density-reducing filler, antioxidant, coolant, phosphorus flame retardant and fiber filler; the powdery ablation-resistant filler is zirconium silicide and holmium trioxide, the density-reducing filler is phenolic hollow microspheres, the antioxidant is boron carbide, the coolant is basic magnesium carbonate, the phosphorus flame retardant is FR-103 flame retardant, and the fiber filler is phenolic fibers and high silica fibers. The invention can prepare the organic silicon heat insulation layer for the engine, which has ablation resistance, good mechanical property, low heat conduction, low density and low glass transition temperature.

title_en: Bio-fuel-resistant low-permeability automobile oil filler hose and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-permeability automobile fuel filler hose resistant to biofuel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the low-permeability automobile fuel filler hose comprises an inner pipe layer, a middle pipe layer and an outer pipe layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside; the rubber composition for preparing the inner pipe layer comprises, by weight, 100 parts of raw hydrogenated nitrile-butadiene rubber, 50-90 parts of N550 carbon black, 5-10 parts of white carbon black, 4451-4 parts of anti-aging agent, 10-40 parts of magnesium oxide, 0.5-1.5 parts of insoluble sulfur, 0-252-10 parts of vulcanizing agent, 1-4 parts of accelerator CZ, 0.5-1.5 parts of accelerator PZ, 0.2-1.5 parts of anti-scorching agent CTP and 5-5 parts of adhesive DC-1000.5; the middle tube layer is made of fluororesin CPT; the composition for preparing the outer tube layer comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of butyronitrile PVC, 50-110 parts of N660 carbon black, 5-20 parts of white carbon black, 1-4 parts of anti-aging agent RD, 1-3 parts of anti-aging agent 4010NA, 3-10 parts of zinc oxide, 0.5-2 parts of insoluble sulfur, 0.5-2.5 parts of accelerator DM, 1-3 parts of accelerator TBzTD and 5-5 parts of adhesive DC-1000.5. The hose has corrosion resistance, permeability resistance and heat resistance superior to those of the existing automobile oil filler hose, and can meet the use requirements of biological fuel oil.

title_en: Conductive ASA material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a conductive ASA material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-70 parts of styrene-acrylonitrile (SAN) prepolymer, 10-70 parts of acrylonitrile-styrene-acrylate copolymer (ASA) high rubber powder, 10-70 parts of acrylate toughening agent (MA), 0.5-0.8 part of antioxidant, 1-1.5 parts of dispersing aid, 0.5-0.9 part of silicone powder, 1-5 parts of compatilizer, 10-30 parts of superconducting carbon black, 10-30 parts of nickel powder, 0.5-1.2 parts of ultraviolet absorber and 0-20 parts of colorant; wherein the styrene-acrylonitrile (SAN) prepolymer is common-grade resin with a melt index of 10-30g/10 min; the acrylonitrile-styrene-acrylate copolymer (ASA) high rubber powder is high rubber content powder, wherein the content of Styrene (SM) is more than or equal to 25 percent, and the content of acrylate (MA) is more than or equal to 30 percent; the invention not only keeps the good processability, mechanical property, chemical resistance and weather resistance of the ASA material, but also improves the electromagnetic shielding and protecting properties of the ASA material.

title_en: Preparation method and application of semi-aromatic high-temperature-resistant nylon powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of semi-aromatic high-temperature-resistant nylon powder, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing a prepolymer; crushing the prepolymer; solid phase tackifying; cooling and screening to obtain the semi-aromatic high-temperature-resistant nylon powder. Wherein the solid phase tackifying is to perform solid phase tackifying on the refined powder under the condition of high-temperature nitrogen convection, and simultaneously switch the heat treatment temperature of the high-temperature nitrogen at intervals, so that the high-temperature nitrogen performs interval switching at the solid phase tackifying temperature and at the temperature 10-50 ℃ higher than the melting point of the material. The method can effectively reduce the angle of repose of the nylon powder and improve the flowability of the product.

title_en: Polyethylene general pipe for agricultural irrigation and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyethylene universal pipe for agricultural irrigation. The invention discloses a manufacturing method of the polyethylene general pipe for agricultural irrigation, which comprises the following steps: feeding the pretreated polyethylene, titanium dioxide, superfine activated calcium carbonate, PP grafted maleic anhydride, glyceryl distearate, calcium stearate, oxidized polyethylene wax and butyltin mercaptide into a double-screw extruder, and adding glass fiber from a side feeding device of the double-screw extruder to perform extrusion granulation; and (3) feeding the granules into a forced air drying oven for drying at the drying temperature of 90-98 ℃ for 2-4h, and performing injection molding to obtain the polyethylene general pipe for agricultural irrigation. The pretreated polyethylene is prepared by the following process: and sequentially adding styrene and tert-butyl perbenzoate into the pretreated montmorillonite, stirring, heating, adding polyethylene powder, continuously stirring, cooling to room temperature, drying, and crushing to obtain the pretreated polyethylene.

title_en: Highly reactive double metal cyanide compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to supported catalysts for use in the polymerization and copolymerization of epoxide monomers, said supported catalysts having the general formula (I): [ DMCC ]/b support; wherein: [ DMCC ] represents a double metal cyanide complex comprising a Double Metal Cyanide (DMC) compound, at least one organic complexing agent, and a metal salt; supp represents a hydrophobic support material; and b represents an average weight proportion of the carrier material based on the total weight of [ DMCC ] and support, and is preferably in the range of 1% by weight or more and 99% by weight or less.

title_en: Process for the preparation of heterophasic polyethylene particles
abstract_en: There is provided a process for the preparation of heterophasic polyethylene particles, the process comprising: contacting a first olefin monomer and a second olefin monomer with a catalyst system in a single reaction zone to produce heterophasic polyethylene particles and recovering the heterophasic polyethylene particles; wherein the catalyst system comprises a combination product comprising: one or more catalysts having group 3 to 12 metal atoms or lanthanide series metal atoms; at least one activator; and optionally, one or more carrier material compositions; and wherein the heterophasic polyethylene particles comprise the combination product of: a first portion comprising a first polyethylene, the first polyethylene comprising the first olefin monomer and the second olefin monomer; a second portion comprising a second polyethylene, the second polyethylene comprising the first monomer and a second monomer; and wherein the first polyethylene has a higher weight percent of the second monomer than the second polyethylene.

title_en: Methyl methacrylate polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of high molecular materials, and discloses a methyl methacrylate polymer and a preparation method thereof. The methyl methacrylate polymer comprises a structural unit A, a structural unit B and a structural unit C, wherein the structural unit A is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (1), the structural unit B is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (2), and the structural unit C is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (3); wherein n is an integer of 40-50, and m is an integer of 1-8. The methyl methacrylate polymer has excellent light transmittance, impact resistance and heat resistance, and can widen the applicable temperature range of methyl methacrylate.

title_en: Compound, thiol generator, composition, cured product, and method for producing cured product
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a compound that can form a composition having excellent patterning accuracy and heat resistance. The present invention is a compound represented by the following general formula (A). (in the formula, R 1 Representing a valence of oneA monovalent aliphatic group having 1 to 40 carbon atoms, a monovalent aromatic hydrocarbon-containing cyclic group having 6 to 35 carbon atoms, a monovalent heterocyclic group having 2 to 35 carbon atoms, a monovalent silyl group having 0 to 40 carbon atoms, or the like, wherein X represents an aliphatic group having 1 to 40 carbon atoms and the same valence as n, an aromatic hydrocarbon-containing cyclic group having 6 to 35 carbon atoms, a heterocyclic group having 2 to 35 carbon atoms, or the like, and n represents an integer of 2 to 10 inclusive. )

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, method for producing resin film having pattern, and semiconductor circuit board
abstract_en: A photosensitive resin composition contains a polymer (A), a crosslinking agent (B) and a photo cation generator (C), wherein the polymer (A) has a terminal group represented by the following formula (a1) and a repeating structural unit represented by the following formula (a 2). In the formulae (a1) and (a2), Y represents the action of a cation generated from the photo cation generator (C) by irradiation with light, and reacts with the crosslinking agent (B)A reactive group of (a); x independently represents an oxygen atom, a sulfur atom, an ester bond, an amide bond or-SO 2 ‑；R 1 A divalent hydrocarbon group or a divalent group obtained by introducing a functional group other than the reactive group and the heterocyclic ring into the divalent hydrocarbon group; r 2 Represents a divalent hydrocarbon group, a divalent group obtained by introducing a functional group other than the reactive group and the heterocyclic ring into the divalent hydrocarbon group, or a heterocyclic ring-containing group having no reactive group.]‑X‑R 1 ‑Y (a1)

title_en: Reticular magnetic molecular imprinting covalent organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a net-shaped magnetic molecular imprinting covalent organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof. The magnetic molecular imprinting covalent organic framework material for specifically adsorbing the geosmin is provided by using a structural analogue of the geosmin as a virtual template, has good adsorption performance on the geosmin, can realize selective adsorption, has a simple preparation method and a controllable condition, and has a good net-shaped space structure. Can be used as an adsorbent for magnetic dispersion solid phase extraction to realize separation and enrichment in pretreatment of geosmin samples.

title_en: Internal fixation splint with degradation and drug loading functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal fixation splint with degradation and drug-loading functions and a preparation method thereof, wherein the splint comprises: at least one plate-shaped body and a plurality of bone screws; the plate-shaped body and the bone screw are both of porous structures prepared by 3D printing of biodegradable materials, and one side of the plate-shaped body is a binding surface used for being attached to the inner surface or the outer surface of a fracture position; the plate-shaped body is provided with a plurality of screw holes for the bone screws to pass through and fix; the porosity of the plate-shaped body is 30-80%; the bone screw porosity is less than 15%; the pores on the plate-shaped body are used for filling or coating the antibacterial drugs. The internal fixation splint has the functions of degradation and drug loading, the materials and the process adopted by the internal fixation splint can ensure that the product is completely degradable, secondary operations are avoided, and the risks of frequent and frequent operations are reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of composite fluorescent hydrogel and application of composite fluorescent hydrogel in detection of iron ions in water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite fluorescent hydrogel and application of the composite fluorescent hydrogel in detection of iron ions in water, and belongs to the technical field of preparation and application of functional materials. Taking spironolactone fluorescein and acryloyl chloride as raw materials,performing acyl chlorination reaction to obtain acryloyloxy fluorescein; then carrying out free radical copolymerization with acrylamide and PEG (6000) under an ammonium persulfate-N, N, N ', N' -tetramethylethylenediamine (APS-TEMED) redox initiation system. The prepared composite fluorescent hydrogel can be mixed with Fe 3+ Interaction, available for Fe 3+ For Fe 3+ The lowest detection limit of (2) is 4.4 mu mol/L, and the fluorescence intensity of the fluorescent hydrogel and Fe 3+ The concentration of (b) is in a linear relationship within the range of 32-192. mu. mol/L. The composite fluorescent hydrogel prepared by the invention is convenient to carry, low in production cost, green and efficient, and widens the application range of the fluorescent hydrogel in the fields of environmental monitoring and detection and biomedicine.

title_en: Antibacterial and anti-mite composite mattress and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial and anti-mite composite mattress, and relates to the field of articles for daily use. The invention discloses an antibacterial and anti-mite composite mattress which is prepared from the following raw material components in parts by weight: 70-80 parts of low-density polyethylene, 10-20 parts of attapulgite, 5-15 parts of modified plant fiber, 5-10 parts of diatomite, 3-5 parts of foaming agent, 0.6-1.2 parts of coupling agent, 0.2-0.5 part of foaming shrinkage auxiliary agent, 0.1-0.4 part of foam stabilizer, 3-5 parts of surfactant and 300 parts of sterilization modified liquid, wherein the low-density polyethylene foam material is prepared by adding the attapulgite into a low-density polyethylene foam material, mixing the attapulgite with the diatomite and the modified plant fiber which are soaked in the sterilization modified liquid and performing injection molding. The antibacterial and anti-mite composite mattress provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, moderate hardness, good bearing performance, excellent strength, toughness and air permeability, can be adjusted according to different parts of a human body, achieves the comfort degree of people, does not influence the performance due to the use time process, prolongs the service life of the mattress, and has long-acting antibacterial and anti-mite effects.

title_en: High-toughness and high-flow flame-retardant polycarbonate composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-toughness high-fluidity flame-retardant polycarbonate composition, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-99.9 parts of polycarbonate, 0.01-30 parts of polysiloxane-polycarbonate, 0.1-2 parts of low-temperature toughening stabilizer, 0.01-1 part of reinforcing stabilizer, 0.1-5 parts of anti-dripping agent and 0.01-10 parts of flame retardant. The high-toughness high-fluidity flame-retardant polycarbonate composition has the advantages that the ASTM normal-temperature notch impact strength is more than 600J/m under the condition of not adding a toughening agent, the notch impact strength at minus 50 ℃ is more than 300J/m, and the flame-retardant grade of a sample strip with the thickness of 1.0mm reaches UL94-V0 grade, so that the high-toughness high-fluidity flame-retardant polycarbonate composition can be applied to industries with high requirements on toughness and thin-wall flame retardance, such as electronics, electrics, aerospace and the like.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified phenolic resin
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of modified phenolic resin, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing Al 2 O 3 Sol, ZrO 2 Uniformly mixing the sol to obtain mixed sol; slowly adding the modified phenolic aldehyde prepolymer into the mixtureMixing the sol, continuing stirring after the addition is finished, slowly heating to 80-85 ℃ in vacuum, and stirring at constant temperature to obtain a mixture; (2) putting the mixture, tall oil, tung oil and polyamine catalyst into a reaction kettle, heating to 135-class sand 145 ℃, and carrying out heat preservation reaction to obtain phenolic aldehyde slurry; (3) adding hydrogenated castor oil and silane coupling agent modified graphene oxide into the phenolic aldehyde slurry, slowly heating to 230 ℃ for 220-; (4) vacuum drying to obtain the final product. The modified phenolic resin prepared by the invention has the advantages of high heat resistance, high carbon residue rate, high strength, good toughness and wide application range.

title_en: Novel method for preparing moldable mud particles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the invention and discloses a novel method for preparing plastic cement particles, which comprises the following steps that raw materials comprise a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer, a daily chemical essence, an edible pigment and a toner, wherein the raw materials of the plastic cement particles are added into a stirrer, and the raw materials of the plastic cement particles are stirred by the stirrer, so that the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer, the daily chemical essence, the edible pigment and the toner are uniformly mixed to obtain a mixture A; preparing the mixture A into particles B; dehumidifying and shaping the particles B to obtain a finished product; subpackaging the finished product according to the volume; and (7) packaging and warehousing. The plastic clay particles prepared by the preparation method can be reused, the work made of the plastic clay particles is not sticky and is not easy to damage, the plastic clay particles have good toughness and excellent stretching effect after being soaked in warm water at 60 ℃ for a few minutes, and the temperature-variable color-fragrant particle material which is more environment-friendly, has a clay function and a normal-temperature plastic function is provided for handicraft enthusiasts.

title_en: Device and method for recovering residual acid of nitrocellulose
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for recovering residual acid of nitrocellulose, which comprises a centrifugal machine and a vacuum washing filter, wherein a screen frame of the centrifugal machine comprises a high-concentration waste acid separation section and a displacement washing section, an outlet of the high-concentration waste acid separation section is connected with an acid first-stage collecting tank, the centrifugal machine is internally provided with three displacement washing sections, meanwhile, the vacuum washing filter is internally provided with four displacement washing sections, and the centrifugal machine and the vacuum washing filter are used for realizing two-time acid-cotton separation, so that the content of the residual acid in nitrocellulose can be reduced to 5%.

title_en: High-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength, light-weight and scratch-resistant polypropylene composite material and a preparation method thereof. The polypropylene composite material is composed of the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 45-90% of polypropylene; 0.1-5% of polymer type nucleating agent; 0-15% of nano inorganic filler; 5-20% of micron inorganic filler; 5-20% of a toughening agent; 0.5-3% of anti-scratch auxiliary agent; 0.1 to 2 percent of stabilizer; 0-5% of other additives. The polymer type nucleating agent has stronger induced crystallization capability than inorganic filler, so that the polypropylene has higher crystallization temperature and mechanical strength, and the dosage of the inorganic filler can be reduced and the material density can be reduced on the premise of ensuring the high strength of the material. The nanometer inorganic filler replaces part of the conventional micron inorganic filler, so that the total amount of the inorganic filler can be further reduced, and the size of the material is kept stable. The reduction of the inorganic filler can weaken white scratches of the material caused by the exposure of the inorganic filler after being scratched, and the introduction of the scratch-resistant auxiliary agent can further improve the scratch-resistant capability of the material, so that the material can keep better surface appearance after being molded.

title_en: Polycarbonate film capable of blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polycarbonate film capable of blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays, which comprises polycarbonate resin, methyl methacrylate-butadiene-styrene copolymer, cesium tungsten bronze, tin antimony oxide, organic silicon, an ultraviolet absorbent, an antioxidant and a coloring agent; the polycarbonate film capable of blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays is added with the nano-scale cesium tungsten bronze particles and the nano-scale tin antimony oxide particles, so that the polycarbonate film has good absorption and blocking effects on short-wave near infrared rays and long-wave near infrared rays respectively; the film has good ultraviolet resistance, weather resistance and transparency, has good flame retardant effect, and is firm and durable; and the raw materials can be used in extrusion and compression molding to meet the requirements of the production process.

title_en: Polyamide composition, method for producing same, and molded article
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyamide composition, a method for producing the same, and a molded article. The present invention provides a polyamide composition which has excellent flame retardancy and good long-term heat resistance and creep characteristics when formed into a molded article. A polyamide composition comprising (a) an aliphatic polyamide, (B) a semiaromatic polyamide comprising diamine units and dicarboxylic acid units, (C) a flame retardant, (D) a styrene-acrylonitrile copolymer and/or a polymer comprising an α, β -unsaturated dicarboxylic anhydride in the structural unit, and (E) a polyol, wherein the mass ratio (E)/(D) of the content of the (E) polyol to the content of the (D) styrene-acrylonitrile copolymer and/or the polymer comprising an α, β -unsaturated dicarboxylic anhydride in the structural unit is 0.25 or more and less than 2.00.

title_en: High-tear-resistance high-tensile-strength high-transparency silica gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic silica gel preparation, and particularly discloses high-tear-resistance high-tensile-strength high-transparency silica gel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the silica gel is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 25-35% of 0.04% of vinyl crude rubber, 25-35% of 0.22% of vinyl crude rubber, 25-35% of silicon powder, 4.5-8.0% of hydroxyl silicone oil, 0.8-2.0% of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 0.8-1.5% of internal mold release agent and 0.3-0.9% of structure control agent, wherein the particle size of the silicon powder is 120-200 meshes, the hydroxyl content of the hydroxyl silicone oil is 8.0-10.0%, the hydrogen content of the hydrogen-containing silicone oil is 0.1-1.6%, and the internal mold release agent is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 90.0-95.5% of composite lubricant and 4.5-10.0% of high molecular weight organic silicon, wherein the structure control agent is one or more of diphenyl silicone, methyl phenyl diethoxy silane, low molecular weight hydroxyl silicone oil or silazane. The invention can meet the market demand for the silica gel with tearing resistance, tensile strength and transparency.

title_en: Straw/fly ash/waste plastic composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a straw/fly ash/waste plastic composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein each 100 parts by weight of raw materials comprise 30-32 parts of crop straws with the length of 1.0-2.3cm, 32-35 parts of fly ash, 26-28 parts of waste polyethylene plastic, 2.3-2.5 parts of maleic anhydride compatilizer, 1.3-2.0 parts of stearic acid, 0.4-0.5 part of antioxidant, 0.45-0.50 part of age resister and 1.5 parts of pigment. The straw/fly ash/waste plastic composite material product prepared by the extrusion process has the advantages that the compressive strength can reach 25-30 MPa, the elastic modulus can reach 3850-4450 MPa, the water absorption rate is only 1.5-2.3%, the surface smoothness is good, the cost is low, no glue is added in the production process, no formaldehyde is generated, all raw material main materials are waste and resource recycling materials, no waste gas and waste water are discharged in the production, and the straw/fly ash/waste plastic composite material product can be recycled after being used for years.

title_en: Graphene multilayer circuit board heating chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene multilayer circuit board heating chip and a preparation method thereof. The graphene multilayer circuit board heating chip comprises a substrate layer, an electrode layer, a graphene layer and a top layer; the electrode layer and the graphene layer are arranged on the surface of the substrate layer, the electrode layer is connected with the graphene layer, and the top layer is arranged on the graphene layer; the basal layer is an epoxy resin glass fiber board, and the top layer is epoxy resin glass cloth. According to the invention, the epoxy resin glass fiber board is selected as the basal layer and the epoxy resin glass cloth is selected as the top layer, so that the maximum working temperature of the obtained graphene multilayer circuit board heating chip can reach more than 220 ℃, and the stable working temperature is 30-180 ℃.

title_en: Molecular-grade production process and device of inulin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a molecular-grade production process and a molecular-grade production device for inulin, and belongs to the technical field of natural plant extraction. The invention provides a molecular-grade inulin production technology, which utilizes a molecular weight grading and separating device, namely products with more than four different grades, namely a molecular weight of more than 2500, a molecular weight of more than 1000, a molecular weight of more than 500 and a molecular weight of less than 500 and a molecular weight of more than 200, according to the molecular weight.

title_en: Organic silicon modified polymer/pigment composite latex and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic silicon modified polymer/pigment composite latex and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Dispersing an organic pigment into a dispersion medium to obtain an organic pigment dispersion liquid; adding a vinyl monomer and an organic silicon monomer into the organic pigment dispersion liquid to form an oil phase; (2) Dispersing a surfactant, a catalyst and a co-emulsifier into water to form a water phase; (3) Dissolving an oil-soluble initiator in an oil phase or a water-soluble initiator in a water phase; uniformly mixing the oil phase and the water phase to obtain a pre-emulsion; (4) Heating part of the pre-emulsion to 20-80 ℃, and uniformly dripping the rest of the pre-emulsion into the pre-emulsion for polymerization reaction to obtain the organic silicon modified polymer/pigment composite latex. The preparation method has simple process, can be completed by one-step polymerization, and the prepared organic silicon modified polymer/pigment composite latex has high stability.

title_en: Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer foam material composition and foam material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer foam material composition and a foam material. The composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 25-98 parts of thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer, 2-75 parts of unsaturated compound containing carbon-carbon double bond, 0.1-25 parts of foaming agent and 0.1-15 parts of cross-linking agent; wherein the sum of the weight parts of the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer and the unsaturated compound containing carbon-carbon double bonds is 100 parts. The thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer foaming material can be prepared by mixing, die pressing or injection foaming the composition. The foam material has the advantages of good wear resistance, high resilience, excellent anti-slip performance and the like.

title_en: Water-based acrylic epoxy resin emulsion and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based acrylic acid epoxy resin emulsion and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a nonionic surfactant is reacted with epoxy resin to generate the nonionic surfactant containing an epoxy structure; mixing an acrylic acid monomer, a nonionic surfactant containing an epoxy structure and a cosolvent to obtain a first dispersion liquid; dispersing an anionic surfactant in water to obtain a second dispersion; adding the first dispersion into the second dispersion under stirring, optionally adding water, and dispersing to obtain a pre-emulsion; respectively dripping the pre-emulsion and the initiator solution into the reactor under the stirring condition to carry out miniemulsion polymerization reaction of the acrylic monomer; the initiator solution is prepared by dispersing an initiator in water; the aqueous acrylic acid epoxy resin emulsion prepared by the method has good stability, and the prepared insulating paint has good electrical property, bonding force, paint film state and other properties after being cured, thereby realizing the improvement of the overall performance of the aqueous insulating paint.

title_en: Adhesive and method of forming adhesive
abstract_en: The present invention relates to specially formulated adhesives and methods of making such adhesives. The invention also relates to composites and materials formed from such binders. More particularly, the present invention relates to specially formulated adhesives comprising phenolic resins.

title_en: High-stretch resilience heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The high-stretch resilience heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive comprises the following components in parts by weight: alkoxyalkyl (meth) acrylate, 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, 2, 4-tolylene diisocyanate, 1, 4-butanediol diacrylate, 2' -azobisisobutyronitrile, melamine formaldehyde resin, SEBS, acrylonitrile, isooctyl acrylate, O- (7-azabenzotriazol-1-yl) -N, N, N ', N ' -tetramethyluronium hexafluorophosphate, methyl ethyl ketone peroxide and ethyl acetate. The high-stretch resilience heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive disclosed by the invention is good in initial adhesion and permanent adhesion, can still keep higher viscosity particularly at high temperature, is good in high-stretch resilience and small in deformation degree at high temperature, shows that the heat resistance is strong, can keep stable performance at high temperature, and has extremely high market application prospect.

title_en: Tire with a composition comprising an ethylene-rich elastomer, a peroxide and a specific acrylate derivative
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tyre comprising a rubber composition comprising at least one elastomer matrix, a peroxide and a specific acrylate derivative, said elastomer matrix comprising essentially a random copolymer comprising ethylene units and conjugated diene units, the molar fraction of ethylene units in the copolymer being between 50% and 95%.

title_en: Platinum antitumor drug-polysaccharide polymer nano prodrug and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Firstly, grafting hydrazide molecules on polysaccharide polymer molecules containing carboxyl by a carbodiimide method to obtain hydrazide polysaccharide polymer; then, connecting the steroid micromolecules to the polysaccharide polymer through amido bonds to obtain an amphiphilic polysaccharide polymer; then, preparing polysaccharide polymer nanometer suspension by ultrasonic action; and finally, mixing the platinum-polysaccharide polymer nano prodrug with a platinum anti-tumor drug solution to obtain the platinum anti-tumor drug-polysaccharide polymer nano prodrug. The nano prodrug has simple preparation method and components and mild reaction conditions, is suitable for various platinum antitumor drugs, has controllable particle size within the range of 100-200nm and drug loading rate of 36.8 percent, and can be widely used for treating various solid tumors such as breast cancer, liver cancer and the like.

title_en: Polypropylene composite material with high glossiness and good low-temperature toughness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypropylene composite material with high glossiness and good low-temperature toughness, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 52-66 parts of polypropylene, 5-10 parts of polyethylene, 10-15 parts of toughening agent, 1-5 parts of crosslinking agent, 1-4 parts of maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene, 15-25 parts of mineral filler, 0.2-0.5 part of antioxidant, 0.1-0.3 part of light stabilizer and 0.1-0.3 part of lubricant. According to the invention, a specific sulfur vulcanization composition is adopted to crosslink ethylene propylene diene monomer, and the polypropylene is modified by combining a mixture of low-density polyethylene, linear low-density polyethylene and metallocene modified polyethylene in a specific mass ratio, wherein the dosage of the linear low-density polyethylene and the metallocene modified polyethylene is slightly higher than that of the low-density polyethylene, so that the compatibility of a system is further improved, the strength and toughness, especially the low-temperature toughness, of the polypropylene material are greatly improved, and the surface gloss is synergistically improved.

title_en: Method for preparing WPU synthetic leather foaming layer based on Pickering foam template method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel method for preparing a WPU synthetic leather foaming layer based on a Pickering foam template method. The key point of the method is that soft water-based polyurethane is used as a raw material, a water-based cross-linking agent and a Pickering water-based foam stabilizer, namely hydrophobic inorganic solid particles are added, and the Pickering water-based foam slurry containing polyurethane latex particles is obtained through high-speed emulsification; and drying to obtain the waterborne polyurethane foaming layer. The preparation of the waterborne polyurethane foaming layer adopts a Pickering water-based foam template method, no organic solvent is used in the preparation process, the preparation is clean and environment-friendly, the operation is simple, and the industrial production is easier to realize; and the Pickering foam has strong interface stability, the problem that the pore diameter is difficult to regulate and control due to the aggregation and collapse of bubbles in the drying process by a mechanical foaming method is effectively solved, and the prepared synthetic leather foaming layer has good sanitary performance.

title_en: Rat hole plugging daub and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rat hole plugging daub and a preparation method thereof. The daub consists of a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises: polyether polyol, isocyanate, surface hydroxyl modified paraffin, a thickening agent and a solid filler; the component B comprises: polyether polyol, surface hydroxyl modified paraffin, a catalyst, a chain extender and a composite filler. According to the invention, through the surface hydroxyl modified paraffin, as the hydroxyl on the surface of the surface hydroxyl modified paraffin can react with isocyanate, the cured paraffin has good compatibility, and the daub obtained after curing has good weather resistance under the environments of high temperature, high humidity, high salt and the like, and can play a role in protecting and plugging electrical equipment for a long time under severe environments. Meanwhile, the invention achieves the purpose of expelling mice by introducing the composite filler which can generate the gas for expelling mice, thereby achieving the effect of preventing the power station equipment from being damaged by the mice.

title_en: Rare earth-organic framework nano fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and discloses a rare earth-organic framework nano fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The method for preparing the rare earth-organic framework nano material by ligand exchange can control the size of the nano material and avoid forming amorphous coordination polymer. The invention takes rare earth-organic framework nano material Ln-QPTCA as a fluorescent probe, utilizes ATP and ADP to have different quenching effects on the luminescence of the nano probe and uses target detection object kinase as converting enzyme of the ATP and the ADP to realize the detection of the kinase activity. The invention can be used for detecting the kinase activity in the standard solution, can further realize the detection of the kinase activity in the serum, has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, good anti-interference performance, rapidness, sensitivity, economy, practicality and the like, can provide theoretical basis and technical support for solving the problem of real-time monitoring of the kinase activity in a complex system, and has good clinical application potential.

title_en: Preparation method of high-performance stable PPA (polyphthalamide) and SBS (styrene butadiene styrene) composite modified asphalt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-performance stable PPA and SBS composite modified asphalt, which comprises the following steps: the preparation method comprises the following raw materials: the modified asphalt is prepared from the following raw materials of matrix asphalt, natural asphalt, plant asphalt, waste tire rubber powder, a thermoplastic elastomer, modified calcium carbonate, modified sulfur, modified starch, organic acid, modified paraffin, hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, an antioxidant, a solubilizer, a stabilizer, PPA polyphosphoric acid and an SBS linear modifier; modified sulfur is adopted to participate in the cross-linking reaction of SBS and asphalt to form a space network structure, so that the colloid structure of the asphalt is changed, the temperature sensing performance of the asphalt is improved, and the stability of the production quality and the stability of long-time storage and placement are ensured by adding the waste tire rubber powder; SBS improves low temperature and anti-aging performance of asphalt; the PPA has remarkable high-temperature stability and storage stability, and overcomes the defects of high viscosity, poor storage stability, difficult construction and the like of common rubber asphalt.

title_en: Wear-resistant antifouling antistatic hardened film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant antifouling antistatic hardened film and a preparation method thereof, which are characterized in that: the wear-resistant antifouling antistatic hardened film consists of a PET film layer, a primer layer coated on one side of the PET film layer and a hardened film layer coated on the primer layer. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a hardening resin composition and preparing a wear-resistant antifouling antistatic hardening film; the hardening resin composition is prepared by mixing 20-40 parts by mass of high-functional aliphatic polyurethane acrylic resin, 10-20 parts by mass of epoxy acrylic resin, 2-10 parts by mass of photoinitiator, 1-5 parts by mass of antistatic agent, 0.5-5 parts by mass of fluorine-containing antifouling agent and 20-50 parts by mass of organic solvent. The wear-resistant antifouling antistatic hardened film is used for display parts, switch buttons, decorative plate surfaces and the like in electronic products, household appliances and equipment instruments, has the effects of protecting a display panel, prolonging the service life, enhancing the antifouling performance and reducing the side effect of static electricity, and has strong practicability.

title_en: EVA composition for midsole of shoe sole, midsole of shoe sole and preparation method and application of EVA composition
abstract_en: The invention provides an EVA composition for a sole insole, the sole insole and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the EVA composition comprises 42-48 parts by weight of EVA, 22-28 parts by weight of thermoplastic polyester elastomer, 0.1-0.5 part by weight of stearic acid, 0.2-0.8 part by weight of cross-linking agent, 1.5-2 parts by weight of coarse-pore foaming agent and 0.8-1.2 parts by weight of fine-pore foaming agent. The EVA compositions of the present invention form midsoles for footwear having improved compression resistance, shock absorption, and rebound properties.

title_en: Boron-nitrogen-benzene shunt thiophene derivative, conjugated high-molecular polymer, preparation method of conjugated high-molecular polymer and application of conjugated high-molecular polymer in fluorine ion detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boron-nitrogen hetero-benzene shunt thiophene derivative, a conjugated high molecular polymer, a preparation method of the conjugated high molecular polymer and application of fluorine ion detection, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of fluorescent compounds and preparation of fluorescent probes of the fluorescent compounds. The BNDT derivative disclosed by the invention is developed by utilizing the difference of bithiophene chemical site activity caused by the introduction of a BN unit, and based on different reaction intermediates (brominated and boric acid ester radicalization products), the boron-nitrogen-benzene-parallel thiophene micromolecule and the polymer are successfully synthesized by a method with simple and convenient operation and mild reaction conditions, and the BNDT derivative has important significance for the selective later-stage functionalization of boron-nitrogen heterocycles and the design and synthesis of novel photoelectric materials. The invention successfully realizes the selective later-stage functionalization of the boron-nitrogen-hetero-benzene parallel thiophene micromolecules through different cross-coupling reactions, and develops a series of BNDT derivatives. The exploration of the BNDT derivatives further enriches the types of fluorescent probes for detecting fluorine ions and promotes the development of novel chemical sensing.

title_en: PBT composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PBT composition, a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the PBT composition comprises the following components: PBT resin, a brominated flame retardant, an antimony compound, glass fiber, zinc sulfide, a carbon nano tube and an antioxidant; the brominated flame retardant is one or a combination of more of decabromodiphenylethane, poly (pentabromobenzyl methacrylate) and ethylene bistetrabromophthalimide. The PBT composition can achieve excellent laser standard-reaching effect under the condition of a light-colored or white substrate without adding a laser marking aid.

title_en: Preparation method of 2, 3-dimethyl-2, 3-diphenylbutane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of 2, 3-dimethyl-2, 3-diphenylbutane, which comprises the following steps: cumene is subjected to a free radical coupling reaction under the action of dicumyl peroxide to obtain a product stream containing 2, 3-dimethyl-2, 3-diphenylbutane. The invention adopts dicumyl peroxide as the free radical initiator, particularly can realize the recycling of the free radical initiator and can be combined with the CHP-PO process to share part of reaction units, thereby reducing the investment and the cost.

title_en: Batching process for raw materials for producing antibacterial BOPA (biaxially-oriented polyamide) film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of film production, in particular to a batching process of an antibacterial BOPA film production raw material, which can effectively improve batching speed and reduce labor intensity of workers; the bridging phenomenon of the powdery raw materials in the pipeline can be effectively avoided; the method comprises the following steps: (1) screening raw materials; (2) weighing the raw materials; (3) and oscillating and blanking: weighing polyamide 6, calcium carbonate, talcum powder and aliphatic amide wax, adding the weighed polyamide 6, calcium carbonate, talcum powder and aliphatic amide wax into a stirring kettle, and performing knocking oscillation on a blanking pipeline through an oscillating mechanism on one side of the blanking pipeline in the blanking process; (4) mixing the raw materials; (5) heating the raw materials; (6) transferring raw materials; (7) and (5) drying.

title_en: High-viscosity acrylic adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-viscosity acrylic adhesive and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-viscosity acrylic adhesive comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: methyl methacrylate, n-butyl acrylate, isocyanate, acrylic acid, rosin resin, ethyl acetate, toluene, benzoyl peroxide, terpene resin, azo compounds, coupling agents, dimethyl diethoxysilane, nano-scale silica powder, nano-scale alumina powder, micron-scale silica powder, micron-scale alumina powder and solvents. The acrylic adhesive prepared by the invention has excellent binding force, can not be separated from a base material in the using process, and the rosin resin, terpene resin methyl methacrylate, ethyl acrylate and dimethyl diethoxysilane have the combined action, so that the reduction of high temperature resistance caused by adding silicon dioxide powder and alumina powder is avoided, the high temperature resistance is improved, and the viscosity stability under the temperature difference change is improved, thereby improving the reliability of the product.

title_en: Method for preparing silicon dioxide/phenolic resin composite aerogel material by taking water glass as silicon source
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a silicon dioxide/phenolic resin composite aerogel material by taking water glass as a silicon source; the method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing water glass, m-cresol, deionized water and an alkaline substance to obtain a mixed solution; then adding an aldehyde compound, and uniformly mixing to form sol; carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained sol to obtain silicon dioxide/phenolic resin composite gel; then carrying out surface modification in a mixed solution of trimethylchlorosilane, isopropanol and normal hexane; and finally drying under normal pressure to obtain the silica/phenolic resin composite aerogel material. The preparation process is simple and the preparation cost is low; the prepared silicon dioxide/phenolic resin composite aerogel has the characteristics of low density, high specific surface area and high hydrophobicity, and has excellent mechanical strength and heat insulation performance.

title_en: Hydrophilic polyurethane foams for water retention applications
abstract_en: Disclosed is a hydrophilic polyurethane foam produced from a diphenylmethane-based quasi-prepolymer having a specified isocyanate and oxyethylene content. The foam has exceptionally good water retention even under compressive forces. They also show at most moderate swelling upon saturation with water. The foam may be used as a layer of a water containment system, such as a green or blue roofing system.

title_en: Laminate pigments with spacing properties and high UV-ashing stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to titanium dioxide particles having high opacity and UV-ashing resistance, comprising two silica coatings and at least one alumina coating, to a method for obtaining said particles, and to the use of said particles in a method for obtaining decorative paper laminates or decorative foils. The invention also relates to a decorative paper laminate or a decorative foil containing the coated titanium dioxide particles.

title_en: Preparation method of random integrated rubber
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of polymer synthesis, and discloses a preparation method of random integrated rubber, which comprises the following steps: in the presence of an inert solvent and an organic lithium initiator, carrying out batch polymerization reaction on a mixed material formed by a butadiene monomer, an isoprene monomer and a styrene monomer, wherein the feeding speed of the mixed material is controlled so that the mixed material is added in 10-40min, and the initiation temperature of the batch polymerization reaction is 30-60 ℃. The integrated rubber obtained by the method provided by the invention has the characteristic of random distribution, so that the application performance of the integrated rubber is more excellent; and no regulator is needed to be added or a high-temperature polymerization process is needed, so that the production cost can be saved.

title_en: Ceramic tile renovation tough glaze material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic tile renovating tough glaze material and a preparation method thereof. The ceramic tile renovating tough glaze material comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 20-25% of isophorone diisocyanate, 55-60% of HDI aliphatic isocyanate resin, 15-20% of propylene glycol diacetate, 4-5% of isocyanate silane coupling agent and 0.1-0.5% of water removing agent; the component B comprises: 10-15% of polyaspartic acid ester 1, 20-25% of polyaspartic acid ester 2, 10-15% of titanium dioxide, 15-18% of silicon micropowder, 0.1-1% of fumed silica, 20-35% of glass microspheres and 4.5-7.4% of auxiliary agent. The ceramic tile renovating tough glaze material provided by the invention has the advantages that the material is firmly attached to the ceramic tile glaze, the coating has high hardness, scratch resistance and wear resistance, the flexibility and comfort are good, the surface roughness is appropriate, the ceramic tile renovating tough glaze material is easy to clean, anti-skid and safe, the water resistance is excellent, and no bubbles are generated when the ceramic tile renovating tough glaze material is soaked in water.

title_en: Plasma polymerization apparatus
abstract_en: Disclosed is a plasma polymerization apparatus, including: a reaction zone; and at least one gas inlet for supplying at least one monomer in gaseous form to the reaction zone; a first electrode and a second electrode, the first electrode spaced apart from the second electrode and configured to generate an electric field in the reaction zone to form a plasmonic polymer nanoparticle material from the at least one monomer; a plurality of collectors configured to collect plasmonic polymer nanoparticle material formed in the reaction zone, the plurality of collectors positioned adjacent to the second electrode; and a cooling device positioned adjacent to the second electrode and configured to cool the plurality of collectors. A plasma polymerization apparatus is also disclosed that includes a confinement grid extending between a first electrode and a second electrode of the apparatus.

title_en: Polydicyclopentadiene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a polydicyclopentadiene composite material and a preparation method thereof. The polydicyclopentadiene composite material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: the mass ratio of dicyclopentadiene monomer to catalyst was 5000-50000: 1, the mass of the dicyclopentadiene monomer and the antioxidant is 100: 0.01-2. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing the organic solvent with dicyclopentadiene and antioxidant and the organic solvent with catalyst in a multi-section tubular mixer, injecting into a mold, reacting at 40-80 deg.C, molding, and post-treating at 120-150 deg.C. The multi-section tubular micro-channel mixing polymerization process is adopted, the mixing effect is greatly improved, the catalyst consumption is reduced, the production process is simple, and the obtained polydicyclopentadiene composite material has excellent performance.

title_en: Preparation method of cationic color copolymer microspheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cationic color copolymer microsphere, belonging to the field of functional material science. The method is to prepare the cationic color copolymer microspheres by copolymerizing polymerizable disperse dyes with basic monomers and cationic monomers; the polymerizable disperse dye is 1- (6-acrylamido hexylamine) anthraquinone, 2-acryloyloxyethyl-4- (anthraquinone-1-carbamoyl) benzoate or 1- (6-acrylamido hexylamine) -4- (methylamino) anthraquinone. The cationic color copolymer microsphere of the invention utilizes the cationic emulsifier or the cationic comonomer to form positive electricity on the surface of the polymer microsphere, the cationic color copolymer has stronger bonding force to the base material with negative charge, can be firmly adsorbed, has better washability without using an adhesive, and has certain hydrophobicity.

title_en: Thermoplastic low-smoke halogen-free polyolefin cable material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermoplastic low-smoke halogen-free polyolefin cable material and a preparation method and application thereof. The thermoplastic low-smoke halogen-free polyolefin cable material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polyolefin resin; 5-10 parts of a compatilizer; 100-120 parts of aluminum hydroxide; 20-50 parts of magnesium hydroxide; 1-2 parts of a flame-retardant synergist; 2-3 parts of an auxiliary agent; 1-2 parts of black master batch, wherein the average particle size D50 of aluminum hydroxide is 1-2 um, the oil absorption value is 25-30, and the initial decomposition temperature is more than or equal to 250 ℃. The aluminum hydroxide has good compatibility with matrix resin, can obviously improve mechanical property, can obviously improve oxygen index and flame retardant property, and on the other hand, compared with the aluminum hydroxide with coarse particle size, the aluminum hydroxide with fine particle size has high initial decomposition temperature, can improve heat resistance and aging resistance of the material, has low oil absorption value, and can be added with more flame retardants under the same resin addition amount, namely, under the same amount of resin and flame retardants, the material has good fluidity, namely, good processing property.

title_en: Low-carbon residue insulating layer material for electric control solid propellant electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an insulating layer material for a solid propellant, which has excellent comprehensive performance, and comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: polypropylene: 60 to 90; peroxide: 0.1 to 2.0; tackifying resin: 3 to 10; polyethylene wax: 0.5 to 3.0; white carbon black: 5-20; high temperature resistant resin: 2-8, adding white carbon black into the formula to ensure that no attachments are generated on the surface of the electrode after the insulating material burns, and ensuring the construction of a conductive path between the propellant and the electrode. And materials with different heat resistance grades are added to construct the multi-gradient thermal decomposition temperature of the insulating material, so that the orderly and controllable combustion of the insulating material is ensured.

title_en: PVC-coated thermoplastic elastomer composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PVC-coated thermoplastic elastomer composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the thermoplastic elastomer composition is prepared by compounding a specific kind of nonpolar thermoplastic elastomer and a polar thermoplastic elastomer and adding components such as a plasticizer, a compatilizer and the like, and the adhesion between a TPE alloy material and PVC is improved by introducing the polar thermoplastic elastomer and the nonpolar thermoplastic elastomer in a certain ratio, so that the PVC-coated thermoplastic elastomer composition can be widely applied to a PVC encapsulation process.

title_en: Continuous production process of carbon five-resin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a continuous production process of carbon penta-resin, which comprises a compounding process, a polymerization reaction process, an alkaline washing process, a rectification process and a dechlorination process: the compounding procedure is used for fully mixing various catalysts to form a catalyst mixed solution; a polymerization reaction step of sufficiently mixing the raw material and the catalyst mixed solution to form a polymerization solution; the alkaline washing step includes an alkaline washing step and a water washing step for neutralizing the acidic polymerization solution to a weakly acidic resin stock solution and removing the remaining catalyst; the rectification procedure consists of a multi-stage flash evaporation unit and is used for separating the resin stock solution into the non-polycarbon five-solvent and the liquid resin; the liquid resin then enters a pelletizing unit to produce finished resin pellets. The continuous production process of the carbon five resin ensures continuous production; rectifying the derivative products in the production process; the production process is circulated, and the waste caused by discharge is reduced.

title_en: Single chiral carbon nanotube-thiophene polymer composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single chiral carbon nanotube-thiophene polymer composite material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of carbon nanomaterials. The thiophene polymer/(6, 5) SWCNT nano composite containing the high-purity single chiral carbon nano tube is successfully prepared by using the specific thiophene polymer to replace PFO-BPy on PFO-BPy/(6,5) SWCNT, and the problems of metal carbon nano tube residue and poor chiral selectivity of the carbon nano tube after the thiophene polymer directly disperses the carbon nano tube are solved.

title_en: Method for synthesizing aromatic-aliphatic copolyester without catalyst and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing aromatic-aliphatic copolyester without catalyst and a product thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a prepolymerization stage: under the condition of no additional catalyst, taking aromatic dicarboxylic acid, diol and cyclic dicarboxylic acid or corresponding anhydride as raw materials, wherein the total molar weight of the dicarboxylic acid is excessive relative to the diol, and carrying out esterification reaction to obtain a carboxyl-terminated prepolymer; a polymerization stage: under the condition of reduced pressure, the reaction temperature is controlled to be not lower than the boiling point of the acid anhydride corresponding to the cyclic dicarboxylic acid, and the acid anhydride corresponding to the cyclic dicarboxylic acid is removed from the carboxyl-terminated prepolymer to obtain the aromatic-aliphatic copolyester. The method can prepare the aromatic-aliphatic copolyester without the catalyst, thereby avoiding the problems of biotoxicity, accelerated aging, short storage and service life and the like caused by using the catalyst, and simultaneously having degradable performance and relieving the current environmental protection pressure.

title_en: Modified recycled polyethylene polypropylene blends
abstract_en: A polyethylene-polypropylene composition obtainable by blending: a)80 to 97 wt% of a blend (a) comprising a-1) polypropylene and a-2) polyethylene, wherein the weight ratio of polypropylene to polyethylene is from 3:7 to 7:3, and wherein the blend (a) is a recycled material recovered from waste plastic material obtained from post-consumer waste and/or industrial waste; and B)3 to 20% by weight of a compatibilizer (B) which is C 2 C 8 Plastic bodyHaving a DSC melting point (ISO11357) below 75 ℃; MFR equal to or lower than 1.5g/10min 2 (ISO1133, 2.16kg load, at 190 ℃); and-equal to or lower than 885kg/m 3 Density (ISO1183), wherein the ratio MFR 2 (blend (A) (ISO1133, 2.16kg load, at 230 ℃) MFR/MFR 2 (the compatibilizer (B) (ISO1133, 2.16kg load at 190 ℃) is in the range from 3.0 to 15; and c) from 0 to 1.0% by weight of a stabilizer or a mixture of stabilizers.

title_en: Aluminum alloy far infrared radiation material and knapsack
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of backpacks, and particularly discloses an aluminum alloy far infrared radiation material and a backpack. The aluminum alloy far infrared radiation material is mainly prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of rubber, 15-30 parts of base material, 5-10 parts of ceramic material, 3-5 parts of binder and 1-3 parts of dispersant; the base material comprises magnesium aluminum alloy powder, the ceramic material comprises at least one of ZrB ₂ -SiC/MgO-C composite material, zrO ₂/Si composite material, siC/Si composite material, tiO ₂/B ₂ O ₃ composite material, and the dispersing agent is at least one of maleic anhydride-ethanolamine-acrylic acid, polyphosphate ester and alkyl carboxylate. The aluminum alloy far infrared radiation material has the advantage of good far infrared radiation effect; in addition, the knapsack of this application has the advantage of acupuncture point infrared radiation physiotherapy.

title_en: Functional environment-friendly wall coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a functional environment-friendly wall coating and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of coatings. A functional environment-friendly wall paint is mainly prepared from a paint mixing material and a dispersing material; the paint mixing material comprises the following raw materials: covering polymer, pure acrylic emulsion, defoaming agent and water; the dispersing material comprises the following raw materials: water, 2-amino-2-methyl-1-propanol, a defoaming agent, a dispersing agent, a surfactant and a cosolvent; the dispersion raw materials also comprise dispersion fine powder, and the dispersion fine powder comprises the following raw materials: titanium dioxide and filler powder; the pure acrylic emulsion is prepared from the following raw materials: butyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, an emulsifier, an initiator, methacrylic acid, acrylamide and water. It has the advantage that formaldehyde purification efficiency is high. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a dispersing material, preparing a paint mixing material, mixing and the like. The preparation method has the advantage of improving the formaldehyde purification efficiency of the product.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant nylon and synthetic method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-temperature-resistant nylon and a synthesis method thereof, which are characterized in that deionized water, diamine and thiophenedicarboxylic acid are salified, prepolymerized and subjected to solid-phase viscosity increasing under the action of a catalyst to obtain a high-temperature-resistant nylon material containing a thiophene group, wherein the diamine is diamine with 4-16 carbon atoms, and the nylon material with a proper molecular weight is obtained by controlling the intrinsic viscosity of a product. The high-temperature-resistant nylon has a regular molecular structure, has excellent mechanical property and high-temperature resistance, and the nylon material has intrinsic flame retardant property due to the introduction of the thiophene group, can be independently used as a material, and can be used as a reinforcing component, a high-temperature-resistant component or a flame retardant component to be blended with other materials to prepare a composite material, so that the high-temperature-resistant nylon is a new material with a good application prospect.

title_en: Rubber composite material and application thereof in sand suction rubber tube
abstract_en: The invention provides a rubber composite material and application thereof in a sand suction rubber tube, wherein the rubber composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 35-45 parts of graphene oxide/styrene-butadiene rubber composite rubber, 85-95 parts of styrene-butadiene rubber, 5-15 parts of white carbon black, 1-5 parts of stearic acid, 1-5 parts of nano zinc oxide, 1-3 parts of adhesive, 1-3 parts of vulcanizing agent, 0.5-1 part of vulcanization accelerator and 1-3 parts of anti-aging agent; the graphene oxide/styrene-butadiene rubber composite rubber is obtained by mixing isocyanate functionalized graphene oxide and acrylic acid grafted modified styrene-butadiene rubber. The rubber composite material provided by the invention has the excellent performances of high wear resistance and high strength, and the wear resistance and the use performance of the rubber composite material in the sand suction rubber pipe are effectively ensured.

title_en: Multi-layer articles with improved adhesion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multilayer article comprising at least two layers (a) and (B) in adhering contact with each other, wherein layer (a) comprises a polymer composition (PC-a) comprising an ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer and layer (B) comprises a polymer composition (PC-B) comprising a polyolefin and 1.0 to 15.0 wt.% of a non-polar thermoplastic elastomer modified with polar groups; and the use of the non-polar thermoplastic elastomer modified with polar groups for improving the adhesion between said layers (a) and (B) in the multilayer article.

title_en: Polyvinyl chloride paste resin seed emulsion polymerization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyvinyl chloride paste resin seed emulsion polymerization method, wherein equipment used in the polymerization process comprises a polymerization kettle, a soap program groove, a catalyst program groove, an accelerator program groove, a regulator program groove, a reducing agent program groove, a post-mixing program groove and an initial emulsifier program groove, and the output ends of the soap program groove, the catalyst program groove, the accelerator program groove, the regulator program groove, the reducing agent program groove, the post-mixing program groove and the initial emulsifier program groove are communicated with the same feed hole arranged on the polymerization kettle or are communicated with different feed holes arranged on the polymerization kettle. In the invention, the addition of the preparation, the washing of the polymerization kettle and the recovery of the monomer are all automatically completed, the automation degree of the whole process is high, the production efficiency is high, and the method has great advantages in the aspects of energy consumption, monomer residual quantity, yield and the like.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin composition capable of obtaining a cured product which can inhibit the occurrence of flow marks and warping after molding and has excellent adhesion of a heat-peelable adhesive tape. The solution of the present invention is a resin composition comprising (A) a curing agent and (B) an inorganic filler, wherein the component (A) comprises: the hydroxyl group-containing silicone compound (A-1) has a content of 0.5 mass% or more and less than 5 mass% of the component (A-1) when the nonvolatile components other than the component (B) in the resin composition are 100 mass%, and a content of 60 mass% or more when the total nonvolatile components in the resin composition are 100 mass%.

title_en: Preparation method of multifunctional dispersing agent for polyester dyeing
abstract_en: The preparation method of the multifunctional dispersing agent for polyester dyeing comprises, by mass, 10-15 parts of an aqueous acrylate copolymer, 25-40 parts of tristyrylphenol polyoxyethylene polyoxypropylene ether, 2-5 parts of hydroxyethylidene diphosphonic acid, 0-5 parts of oleic acid, 20-35 parts of castor oil polyoxyethylene ether and 10-30 parts of water. The multifunctional dispersing agent disclosed by the invention has better dispersing power on cloth cover residual slurry and oligomers after the terylene pretreatment, and also has excellent dispersibility and level dyeing property on disperse dyes under different water hardness and under the condition of higher electrolyte content in water in the dyeing process. Effectively solves the dyeing problems of color stains, color flowers and the like caused by impurities, water quality and electrolyte in the dyeing process of the terylene.

title_en: Long-sealing-section large-temperature-difference cement slurry system for well cementation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cement slurry system for long-sealing-section large-temperature-difference well cementation, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas field well cementation materials. The cement paste comprises 74-88 wt% of oil well cement, 4-8 wt% of fluid loss additive, 1-3 wt% of suspension stabilizer, 10-20 wt% of high-temperature strength stabilizer and 1-3 wt% of retarder; the retarder is formed by mixing and compounding ethylene diamine tetramethylene phosphonic acid sodium, borax and terpolymer; the terpolymer is prepared by taking sodium methyl propylene sulfonate, isopentenol polyvinyl ether and maleic anhydride as monomers and adopting a free radical solution copolymerization method. The cement paste has a wide use temperature range, can meet the retardation effect on cement paste in the whole temperature range of 50 ℃ and 180 ℃ for the temperatures of the upper end and the lower end of a cementing section in well cementation construction, can have certain strength in the environment of high temperature and large temperature difference of 50 ℃ at the top, and avoids the phenomenon of 'super retardation' of top cement.

title_en: Degradable filler for microbial agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable filler for a microbial agent and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: grinding and uniformly mixing modified cellulose and lignin, adding azodicarbonamide, stirring and uniformly mixing, then filling into a mould, treating in a drying box, taking out, and demoulding; uniformly coating a microbial agent on the surface of the demoulded filler, coating a calcium alginate solution, standing for 2-3 h, cleaning with clear water, and drying to obtain a degradable filler; the modified cellulose is prepared from 5-hydroxy cyclooctanone modified nano microcrystalline cellulose. The prepared degradable filler has a good net-shaped porous structure, and has high specific surface area, porosity, tensile strength and low degradation rate, namely, long service life; due to the degradability and the reproducibility of the filler, the filler has wide application in the field of wastewater treatment and has no secondary pollution to water.

title_en: Coloring composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a coloring composition with excellent heat resistance and light resistance. The present invention relates to a coloring composition comprising a colorant and a resin, wherein the colorant contains a compound represented by the following formula (I).

title_en: Automobile tire inner liner rubber composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an automobile tire inner liner rubber composition, a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the rubber composition comprises the following components in parts by mass: 100 parts of matrix rubber, 30-100 parts of reinforcing filler, 1-50 parts of plasticizer and 0.5-2 parts of accelerator; the matrix rubber is 70-100 parts of halogenated butyl rubber and 0-30 parts of natural rubber; the accelerator comprises sulfenamide accelerator and dibenzothiazyl disulfide accelerator. Compared with the prior art, the method can improve the smell of the rubber material while ensuring the performance of the rubber material of the inner liner of the automobile tire.

title_en: Hard coating film
