abstract_en: The present invention provides a hard coat film (1) comprising a base film (2), a first hard coat layer (3) laminated on at least one main surface side of the base film (2), and a second hard coat layer (4) laminated on the main surface side of the first hard coat layer (3) opposite to the base film (2), wherein the base film (2) is a polyimide film, the first hard coat layer (3) and the second hard coat layer (4) are made of different materials, the difference between the refractive index of the first hard coat layer (3) and the refractive index of the second hard coat layer (4) is 0.04 or less in absolute value, and the total of the thickness of the first hard coat layer (3) and the thickness of the second hard coat layer (4) is 7 [ mu ] m or more and 35 [ mu ] m or less. The hard coating film (1) has bending resistance to withstand repeated bending, and is less likely to warp and further less likely to generate interference fringes.

title_en: Heat-sensitive epoxy curing agent, preparation method thereof and epoxy resin composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-sensitive epoxy curing agent, a preparation method thereof and an epoxy resin composition. The epoxy resin composition comprises a heat-sensitive epoxy curing agent After being mixed with resin, the curing agent has slow viscosity increase, long storage period and low post-curing temperature, is low-viscosity liquid at normal temperature, has good construction convenience, contains epoxy groups in a molecular structure, has good compatibility with epoxy resin, can be dissociated from phenolic hydroxyl groups after the temperature is raised to form a phenolic amine-like structure, can quickly catalyze the polymerization of tertiary amine and epoxy resin, and is particularly suitable for a composite material injection molding process with requirements on long operation time.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength TPS starch for degradable material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high polymer materials, and discloses a preparation method of high-strength TPS starch for degradable materials.

title_en: Polyphenylene sulfide resin composition and molded article thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyphenylene sulfide resin composition comprising 5 to 2000 parts by mass of an inorganic filler per 100 parts by mass of a poly (p-phenylene sulfide) -m-phenylene sulfide random copolymer. The invention has excellent humidity resistance and heat resistance, can keep high mechanical strength when contacting with water for a long time, and is particularly suitable for injection molding into cooling water, antifreeze circulating systems of automobiles and other products which are contacted with liquid such as water for a long time.

title_en: Structure for improving color change of color characters on tire sidewall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a color changing structure for improving color characters on the sidewall of a tire, which comprises wear-resistant rubber, sidewall rubber, embedded rubber and a scribing line; the embedded rubber is embedded in the surface of the sidewall rubber, the scribing line is arranged on one side of the embedded rubber, and the wear-resistant rubber is arranged on one side of the sidewall rubber; according to the scheme provided by the invention, on the premise of using the same label, the tire side structure and the tire side formula are improved by optimizing the process, the migration of the tire side antioxidant of the finished tire is slowed down, and the problem that the color of the color tire side characters of the tire is changed due to illumination, ozone and thermal oxidation is greatly improved; meanwhile, on the premise of keeping the fixed elongation and hardness performance of the tire sidewall rubber, the color sidewall characters are delayed from illumination, ozone and thermal oxidation discoloration through the addition of the embedded structure on the sidewall and the optimization of the sidewall embedded rubber formula, the attractiveness of the sidewall color characters is maintained, and the color intensity of the color characters is kept more durable.

title_en: Starch preparation system for papermaking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a starch preparation system for papermaking, which comprises: an upper control computer, an unprocessed starch storage tank, an alkali liquor adding component, a starch dissolving tank and a starch cooking tank; the unprocessed starch storage tank and the starch dissolving tank are connected through a first starch conveying pipe, and a first control valve is arranged on the first starch conveying pipe. The invention has the beneficial effects that: and an upper control computer is electrically connected with a second control valve, and when the pH value of the starch solution collected by the second control valve is smaller than a set threshold value, the alkali liquor adding assembly is started to add alkali liquor to the starch dissolving tank. The application of the technology can reduce the acidification of surface sizing finished paper, reduce the generation of finished paper odor, realize the regulation and control of the pH value of the starch preparation system, and simultaneously, the recovered glue solution has certain regulation on the pH value of the slurry, thereby being greatly helpful for improving the product quality.

title_en: Improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst comprises a carrier, a main catalyst, a cocatalyst and an internal electron donor; the carrier is anhydrous magnesium chloride; the main catalyst is titanium trichloride and/or titanium tetrachloride; the cocatalyst is triethyl aluminum; the internal electron donor is an antistatic agent. The improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst is used for synthesizing the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene due to the addition of the antistatic agent, can effectively prevent scaling caused by electrostatic effect, enables the reaction to be continuously carried out, and enables the antistatic agent in the catalyst to be uniformly dispersed in a reaction system, so that the prepared ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene has uniform particles and high bulk density, and the improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst has higher catalytic activity.

title_en: Maleic anhydride grafted polyamide composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maleic anhydride grafted polyamide composite material which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of maleic anhydride; 30-60 parts of polyamide resin polyol; 30-60 parts of polytetrahydrofuran; 20-80 parts of polyisocyanate; 2-10 parts of silicon dioxide; 1-5 parts of organic antimony; 10-30 parts of n-butyl alcohol; 5-10 parts of ammonium persulfate. The maleic anhydride grafted polyamide composite material of the invention has good compatibility between maleic anhydride and polyamide, has excellent mechanical property, and can be applied to automobile materials.

title_en: Polyamide moulding compounds for hypochlorite-resistant applications
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of polyamide moulding compounds in applications which are critical for the high resistance to hypochlorous acid. Thus, according to the invention, the molding composition is used for molded bodies which are suitable for contact with aqueous solutions containing hypochlorous acid.

title_en: Electric polarization particle, preparation method thereof and application thereof in electric polarization color-changing optical film
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric polarization particle, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an electric polarization color-changing optical film. The electric polarized particle is a rod-shaped metal complex formed by chemical reaction based on metal iodide, carboxylic acid nitrogen-containing organic molecules, iodine simple substance, cellulose suspending agent and the like. The electrically polarized particles can be used for preparing electrically polarized color-changing optical films. The electric polarization color-changing optical film comprises a substrate, and a first conductive film, an electric polarization color-changing film and a second conductive film which are arranged on the substrate in sequence. The electric polarization particle has the characteristics of simple operation, easy large-scale preparation and the like. The electric polarization color-changing optical film made of the electric polarization particles has the advantages of wide transmittance color-changing range, low haze, high response speed and the like under the drive of voltage.

title_en: Method for improving moisture retention performance of polyglycerol fatty acid ester
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the moisture retention performance of polyglycerol fatty acid ester. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, glycerol is polymerized under the catalysis of a solid base catalyst to prepare mixed polyglycerol, then the mixed polyglycerol is purified by molecular distillation, a polyglycerol fatty acid ester emulsifier is introduced after purification to obtain the polyglycerol with the moisture retention performance, and then the polyglycerol and liquid fatty acid are subjected to esterification reaction to prepare the polyglycerol fatty acid ester. The polyglycerol prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of concentrated polymerization degree, appropriate smell and color and obviously improved moisturizing performance.

title_en: Release agent composition, rotational molding polyethylene composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyolefin processing and forming, and discloses a mold release agent composition. The mold release agent composition contains glycerin alkanoate and wax, wherein the glycerin alkanoate is one or more of glycerin esters of C15-C20 alkanoic acid, and the volatilization amount of the wax at 300 ℃ for 30min is less than 20 wt%. The mold release composition can be arranged in a rotational molding material, so that a rotational molded product has good mold release performance.

title_en: Carbon fiber resin matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of material preparation, in particular to a carbon fiber resin matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof. The carbon fiber-perfluoroalkyl vinyl ether polymer bead string is prepared by the following method: spraying a certain amount of perfluoroalkyl vinyl ether polymer on the specified position of the continuous carbon fiber, fully soaking the continuous carbon fiber with the perfluoroalkyl vinyl ether polymer to form a sphere, fully soaking and mixing the interior of the sphere and the carbon fiber, completely wrapping the exterior of the sphere with the carbon fiber, and curing to obtain the carbon fiber-coated carbon fiber composite material. The method can realize the flexible and controllable thickness of the interface modulus transition layer of the carbon fiber resin matrix composite material, effectively improve the interface performance, and simultaneously improve the bonding strength of the carbon fiber reinforcement and the resin matrix, thereby improving the mechanical performance of the carbon fiber resin matrix composite material.

title_en: Super-viscous self-healing non-emulsified oil for sticking layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses super-sticky self-healing non-emulsified layer-sticking oil which comprises, by weight, 15-25 parts of modified emulsified asphalt, 2-3 parts of a polyurethane mixture, 3-5 parts of polymer resin, 2-5 parts of a surfactant, 5-10 parts of an auxiliary agent and 1-2 parts of an antioxidant. The modified emulsified asphalt is prepared from cold-mixed asphalt, styrene-butadiene rubber, a styrene-butadiene-styrene block copolymer, an emulsifier and a modifier, wherein the polyurethane mixture is a mixture of water-soluble polyurethane, styrene and a butadiene block copolymer SBS, and the polymer resin is a mixture of butyl rubber latex, phenolic resin and epoxy resin. Solves the technical problems of poor bonding effect and low strength of the common adhesive layer oil for the ultrathin wearing layer.

title_en: Long-acting antibacterial flame-retardant double-effect lyocell fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fiber materials, and discloses a long-acting antibacterial flame-retardant double-effect lyocell fiber and a preparation method thereof. Firstly, carrying out Provetex cp flame retardant modification on a lyocell fiber raw material, then dissolving the raw material in an NMMO aqueous solution, adding a silver salt aqueous solution, stirring and mixing uniformly to obtain a spinning solution; adding alkali into the coagulation bath solution to adjust the pH value to be alkaline, so as to obtain a reactive coagulation bath; and (3) spinning the spinning solution, and then, allowing the spinning solution to enter a reactive coagulation bath for coagulation forming to obtain the long-acting antibacterial flame-retardant double-effect lyocell fiber. According to the invention, covalent coupling modification is carried out through the flame retardant, so that the fiber material is endowed with a flame retardant effect; and the silver oxide antibacterial agent is introduced in the process of the solidification and forming of the lyocell fiber through in-situ reaction, the antibacterial agent is uniformly dispersed and has strong adhesive force with the fiber matrix, and the obtained antibacterial fiber has a lasting antibacterial effect and is washable. The preparation method is simple, easy to industrialize and low in cost. Has excellent commercial application prospect.

title_en: Organic conjugated polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic conjugated polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the organic conjugated polymer adopts benzodithiophene or benzodifuran as a matrix The polymer has a high plane conjugated structure, a good visible light absorption range, a large specific surface area and good dispersibility in water. Therefore, the method has excellent performance of photocatalytic hydrogen production from water.

title_en: Method for producing latex and method for producing molded article using same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing a latex, which can emulsify a mixed solution of a rubber solution and an aqueous emulsifier solution into a good state to produce a high-quality latex with little coagulum, the method for producing a latex of the present invention comprises the following steps: a first circulation step of supplying a rubber solution in which rubber and an organic solvent are mixed and an aqueous emulsifier solution to a circulation pipe (2) in a volume ratio of the rubber solution to the aqueous emulsifier solution of 0:100 to 1:4, and circulating the mixture; a second circulation step of supplying the rubber solution in which the rubber and the organic solvent are mixed to the circulation pipe (2) in a state in which the first circulation step is continued, and mixing the aqueous emulsifier solution and the rubber solution by using an emulsifying machine (3) provided in the middle of the circulation pipe (2), thereby obtaining an emulsion; and a desolventizing step of removing the organic solvent from the emulsion.

title_en: Novel bifidobacterium bifidum strain and polysaccharide derived from strain
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bifidobacterium bifidum that induces regulatory T cells (tregs), a polysaccharide derived from bifidobacterium bifidum, and a strain of probiotic bacteria that produces the polysaccharide; and more particularly to a polysaccharide comprising beta-1-6-glucan as an effective ingredient, a probiotic strain producing beta-1-6-glucan, a food comprising the polysaccharide or strain as an effective ingredient for alleviating an immune disease or an inflammatory disease, a therapeutic agent comprising the polysaccharide or strain as an effective ingredient for alleviating an immune disease or an inflammatory disease, a method for preparing induced regulatory T cells (iTreg) by treating with the polysaccharide or strain, and a cell therapy product for preventing or treating an immune disease or an inflammatory disease comprising the induced regulatory T cells prepared by the method.

title_en: Tear-resistant and degradable polylactic acid food packaging film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging materials, and provides a tear-resistant and degradable polylactic acid food packaging film and a preparation method thereof. The polylactic acid food packaging film is composed of polylactic acid and composite cross-linked particles. The composite cross-linked particles are of a core-shell structure, the core layer is nano silicon dioxide particles, and the shell layer is a poly-menthol-lactone elastomer with evenly distributed chitin nano whiskers. In the shell layer of the composite cross-linked particle, the poly-menthol lactone forms a cross-linked network structure, and the chitin nano crystal whisker is used as a cross-linking point of the network structure. The chitin nano whisker is obtained by removing an amorphous area and a low-order area by hydrolyzing chitin, and has few defects and high strength. The shell layer and the core layer form good combination through chemical bonds. According to the invention, the composite cross-linked particles are added into the polylactic acid, so that the tearing strength of the polylactic acid packaging film can be obviously improved, and the packaging film has good degradation capability.

title_en: Viscosity modifier and curable composition
abstract_en: A viscosity modifier for a curable composition, comprising: a diamide compound (a) and/or a solidified castor oil (a') which is obtained by condensation reaction of a diamine component (a1) and a monocarboxylic acid component (a 2); and a polyamide compound (B) which is obtained by polycondensing an amine component (B1) and a carboxylic acid component (B2). The amine component (B1) contains at least one amine selected from the group consisting of diamines and triamines having 2-54 carbon atoms. The carboxylic acid component (B2) contains at least one carboxylic acid selected from dicarboxylic acids and tricarboxylic acids having 4 to 54 carbon atoms. The polyamide compound (B) is obtained by polycondensing at least either one of the amine component (B1) and the carboxylic acid component (B2) containing polymerized fatty acid.

title_en: Method for extracting chlorella extracellular polymeric substances in grading manner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting chlorella extracellular polymeric substances in a grading way, which comprises the steps of firstly, centrifuging chlorella liquid at a low temperature and a medium speed to obtain supernatant, filtering the supernatant with a 0.45 mu m glass fiber filter membrane to obtain filtrate containing soluble extracellular polymeric substances, concentrating the filtrate by a tangential flow ultrafiltration technology, dialyzing the concentrated solution, and drying the dialyzed concentrated solution by a vacuum concentrator to obtain extracellular soluble polymeric substance solid. And centrifuging the re-suspended centrifugal precipitate at low temperature and high speed to obtain supernatant containing loosely bound extracellular polymeric substance, and filtering, concentrating, dialyzing and drying the supernatant to obtain loosely bound extracellular polymeric substance solid. And finally, taking the re-suspended centrifugal precipitate, adopting a pure hot bath and high-speed centrifugal shearing to obtain supernatant containing the tightly-combined extracellular polymeric substance, and carrying out the same treatment steps on the supernatant to obtain the tightly-combined extracellular polymeric substance solid. The invention has the advantages of no damage to chlorella cells and graded extraction of extracellular polymeric substances.

title_en: Neutron and gamma ray composite shielding material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neutron and gamma ray composite shielding material and a preparation method thereof, wherein a neutron absorbent and a gamma absorbent which are subjected to surface modification are introduced into the composite shielding material, so that the material has high-performance neutron absorption capacity and also has certain gamma attenuation capacity; in addition, the silane coupling agent coats the surface of the functional filler, so that the interface compatibility between the filler and the matrix is improved, the dispersion capacity of the filler in the matrix is improved, and the shielding performance of the material is further improved; the doping of the functional filler also improves the thermal stability and tensile strength of the material to a certain extent. The composite shielding material disclosed by the invention can be applied to high-performance neutron shielding with the ambient temperature lower than 100 ℃ and shielding of a neutron and gamma ray mixed field with certain limit on bearing load.

title_en: Flame-retardant polyarylether-based composition, prepreg prepared from flame-retardant polyarylether-based composition and thermosetting high-frequency copper-clad plate prepared from flame-retardant polyarylether-based composition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication materials, and particularly relates to a flame-retardant polyarylether-based composition, a prepreg prepared from the flame-retardant polyarylether-based composition and a thermosetting high-frequency copper-clad plate prepared from the prepreg. According to the invention, the necessary vinyl-terminated polyarylether oligomer, the cross-linking agent, the modified resin, the filler, the initiator and the unnecessary flame retardant are combined to prepare the flame-retardant polyarylether composition, so that the prepared prepreg and copper-clad plate have the advantages of outstanding flame retardant property, excellent dielectric property and capability of meeting the high-frequency communication requirement in the overall performance.

title_en: Nano plugging agent, preparation method thereof and oil field drilling fluid containing nano plugging agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano plugging agent, which comprises the following components: styrene, dimethylamine ethyl methacrylate, isooctyl glucoside, sodium dodecyl sulfate, potassium persulfate and deionized water; a preparation method of a nanometer plugging agent comprises the steps of sequentially adding raw materials to react, and directly cooling the obtained product; according to the invention, organic nano molecule polymerization is adopted, the preparation of the nano plugging agent is simple, the product obtained after the reaction of the raw materials is added is directly cooled, the final product has the effect of filling the pores of the mud cakes, a compact hydrophobic membrane structure is formed, and the plugging effect is obvious.

title_en: Thermoplastic polyolefin compositions suitable for odor reduction
abstract_en: A thermoplastic polyolefin composition is provided which comprises (A) a polypropylene polymer, (B) an elastomer component, (C) an additive component, and (D) a scavenger component. The scavenger component comprises a polyacetoacetate compound having formula (I) defined herein and a metal oxide. Also provided is an article made from the thermoplastic polyolefin composition.

title_en: Copolymer, primer composition, double-layer system and application of double-layer system in double-layer stripping process
abstract_en: The application provides a copolymer, a primer composition, a two-layer system and application thereof in a two-layer stripping process. Belongs to the technical field of semiconductors. The copolymer is obtained by polymerizing an N-substituted maleimide monomer, a dissolution rate control monomer, an acrylate hydrophobic monomer and a hydroxyethyl acrylate hydrophilic monomer. The copolymer is insoluble in a solvent of a traditional photoresist, can be dissolved in an alkaline solution, is insoluble in water, has higher glass transition temperature, better chemical stability and etching resistance, and can be used as a bottom resin material of a double-layer stripping process. The bilayer system includes a top layer photoresist and a copolymer formed underlayer photoresist. The bilayer system can be used for a bilayer stripping process, and a target photoetching pattern can be obtained only by single development and single development, so that the photoetching efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Thermally latent catalysts for isocyanate polymerization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel thermally latent catalysts for the manufacture of isocyanurate and polyisocyanate polymers.

title_en: Papermaking retention aid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a papermaking retention aid and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of modified polyacrylamide. The method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing acrylamide, a cationic monomer, a structure regulator, a hydrophobic monomer, N-vinylformamide and a cationic surfactant by using water to obtain a mixed solution; introducing nitrogen into the mixed solution to remove oxygen, adding a polymerization assistant to initiate polymerization reaction to obtain a jelly, and then sequentially granulating, drying and crushing the jelly to obtain copolymer powder; preparing the copolymerization powder into a copolymerization powder aqueous solution by using water, and then sequentially adding liquid bromine and a sodium hydroxide aqueous solution for modification treatment to obtain a modified treatment solution; and adjusting the pH value of the modified treatment solution to 8-9, and filtering with a filter membrane to obtain the papermaking retention aid. The papermaking retention aid prepared by the invention improves the retention rate of fine fibers, can improve the papermaking production efficiency when being used in a papermaking process, avoids the blockage of a water filtering channel, and can effectively reduce the turbidity of white water.

title_en: Polymer particles, preparation method and carbon-based material
abstract_en: The invention discloses polymer particles, a preparation method and a carbon-based material. A method of making polymer particles comprising: dissolving a first monomer in a solvent to prepare a first monomer solution; adding a second monomer into the first monomer solution, and reacting to obtain polymer particles; wherein the first monomer is a phenolic monomer and/or an amino monomer, and the second monomer is an aldehyde monomer. The invention uses phenols, amino and aldehyde monomers, utilizes intermolecular condensation reaction to assemble monodisperse microspheres and polymer particles with various special structures, and overcomes the limitation that the morphology of polymer particles prepared by the traditional template method and hydrothermal method is difficult to control.

title_en: Preparation method of carbon fiber prepreg for preparing temperature-resistant composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of advanced composite materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a carbon fiber prepreg for preparing a temperature-resistant composite material, which comprises the following preparation raw materials in percentage by weight: 30-70% of polyamide-imide resin, 10-40% of polyetherimide resin, 20-40% of carbon fiber and 1-10% of auxiliary agent; and a diluent. The preparation method of the prepreg comprises the following steps: (1) preparing materials; (2) preparing a matrix resin; (3) adjusting the viscosity of the mixed solution; (4) dipping carbon fiber into glue; (5) and partially removing the diluent in the carbon fiber after gum dipping. The prepreg has high bending strength and high bending modulus, can be further prepared into carbon fiber reinforced polyamide imide and polyetherimide composite materials in any shape according to requirements, has excellent wear resistance and mechanical properties at 240 ℃, and greatly widens the application range of the carbon fiber composite materials.

title_en: Carbon-series composite filler, high-thermal-conductivity electromagnetic shielding composite material and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon-series composite filler, which specifically comprises a carbon-series filler with a three-dimensional structure, wherein molecules of first resin are bonded on the inner surface and the outer surface of the carbon-series filler through chemical bonds of an interface modifier; the internal pores and/or gaps of the carbon-based filler are filled with the first resin; molecules of the first resin for improving compatibility when the carbon-based filler is mixed with the first resin; the first resin for occupying the pores and/or interstices to avoid entrapment of air within the pores and/or interstices, and supporting the pores and/or interstices to maintain the three-dimensional structure; the problem of current epoxy resin class electromagnetic shield material heat conduction and electromagnetic shield performance can not effectively be improved by a wide margin simultaneously to the result it is restricted in heat and electromagnetic shield management material field application is solved.

title_en: High-elasticity heat-conducting silica gel sheet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat-conducting silica gel sheets, in particular to a high-elasticity heat-conducting silica gel sheet, which aims at solving the problems that the prior heat-conducting silica gel sheet has poor service performance, does not have high elasticity and good heat-conducting performance and can not meet the use requirement, and provides the following scheme, which comprises the following important components: 20-30 parts of silica gel, 3-9 parts of polyethylene fiber, 2-6 parts of high-modulus glass fiber, 2-6 parts of alumina fiber, 2-6 parts of boron fiber, 2-6 parts of polyether ether ketone, 2-6 parts of PEEK resin, 3-9 parts of antioxidant, 3-9 parts of preservative, 3-9 parts of insect repellent, 3-7 parts of heat conducting powder, 3-7 parts of carbon fiber, 3-7 parts of polyurethane and 3-7 parts of polyimide, wherein the silica gel is used as a main component. The invention improves the service performance of the heat-conducting silica gel sheet, has high elasticity and good heat-conducting performance, and can meet the use requirement.

title_en: Flame-retardant resin composition, flame-retardant insulated wire and flame-retardant cable
abstract_en: The invention provides a flame-retardant resin composition with excellent flame retardance, heat resistance and tensile property, and a flame-retardant insulated wire and a flame-retardant cable using the same. The electric wire (10) has a conductor (1) and an insulating layer (2) covering the periphery of the conductor (1). The insulating layer (2) is composed of a flame-retardant resin composition containing a base polymer and a flame retardant, and the base polymer contains an ethylene-ethyl acrylate copolymer and chlorinated polyethylene. The flame retardant contains 3 or more of a bromine-based flame retardant, antimony trioxide, magnesium hydroxide and zinc stannate, and is 60 to 110 parts by mass per 100 parts by mass of the base polymer. The ethylene-ethyl acrylate copolymer has an ethyl acrylate content of 7 to 22 mass% based on the total amount of the base polymer; the chlorinated polyethylene has a chlorine content of 1 to 10 mass% based on the total amount of the base polymer.

title_en: Phosphorus-containing flame retardant, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphorus-containing flame retardant, a preparation method and application thereof. The phosphorus-containing flame retardant is prepared by reacting 3-hydroxyphenyl phosphoryl propionic acid with amine. The flame retardant disclosed by the invention has good water solubility and thermal stability and weak acidity, and can be used for improving the flame retardant property and mechanical property of nylon.

title_en: Fluorine-free waterproof agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluoride-free water-proofing agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fluoride-free copolymer comprises 20-35% of a fluoride-free copolymer component, 2-8% of a surfactant, 2-10% of an auxiliary agent and deionized water; the fluorine-free copolymer component comprises a fluorine-free copolymer produced by polymerization in the presence of a chain transfer agent: an α, β -haloacrylate monomer (a), a non-crosslinking (meth) acrylate comonomer (b), and a functional monomer (c); the structural formula of the non-crosslinked (meth) acrylate comonomer is: CH (CH) 2 =C(R 3 )COOR 4 ，R 3 Is H or CH 3 ，R 4 Is a saturated hydrocarbon group or cyclic hydrocarbon group having 1 to 30 carbon atoms. The fluorine-free waterproof agent is prepared based on the alpha, beta-halogenated acrylate containing long-chain alkyl, long-chain alkane can be regularly arranged on the surface of the fabric, the fabric is endowed with lasting low surface energy, the waterproof agent has excellent water repellency and durable waterproofness, and the waterproof agent can be comparable to a fluorine-based waterproof agent in water repellency; the polymer avoids the use of fluorine-containing acrylate monomers, is environment-friendly and has high commercial value.

title_en: CPP film and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CPP film and a production process thereof, wherein the production process specifically comprises the following steps: weighing and proportioning 96 parts, 20 parts, 0.3 part, 0.5 part, 0.4 part and 5 parts of polypropylene resin, halogen-free flame retardant, anti-dripping agent, antioxidant and aluminum foil filler, putting 96 parts of polypropylene resin, 20 parts of halogen-free flame retardant, 0.3 part of anti-dripping agent, 0.5 part of heat stabilizer, 0.4 part of antioxidant and 5 parts of aluminum foil filler into a high-speed stirrer for stirring and mixing, and conveying the mixed master batch obtained in the step two into a double-screw extruder by a feeding machine for melt extrusion granulation; according to the CPP film and the production process thereof, the mixed master batch can be effectively prevented from being accumulated on the inner wall of the high-speed stirrer, meanwhile, the neatness of the interior of the high-speed stirrer can be increased, the working efficiency of the CPP film preparation is improved, the edge of the CPP film can be subjected to edge cutting and glue sealing, and the attractiveness and stability of the CPP film can be improved.

title_en: ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) and PC (polycarbonate) composite material as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile parts, in particular to an ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) and PC (polycarbonate) composite material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The ABS and PC composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-65 parts of PC resin, 15-45 parts of ABS resin, 1-2 parts of compatible resin and 10-12 parts of color master batch, wherein the compatible resin is one or a composition of more of 3- (2, 3-epoxypropoxy) propyl trimethoxy silane, maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene and maleic anhydride grafted styrene. The preparation method of the ABS and PC composite material comprises the following steps: (1) mixing and granulating to obtain a coloring base material; (2) and mixing and injection molding to obtain the ABS and PC composite material. The ABS and PC composite material and the preparation method thereof have the advantage of reducing the possibility of whitening on the surface of a product.

title_en: Fungus polysaccharide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological polysaccharide, in particular to a fungus polysaccharide and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fungus polysaccharide is extracted from a trametes versicolor mycelium, is the trametes versicolor mycelium polysaccharide (TGM), is extracted by a compound enzyme high-pressure hot water extraction method, has high purity, small difference between average molecular weights, is at a molecular weight level, has good biological activity, is safe to use, can improve thymus and spleen indexes, can increase proliferation capacity of spleen T and B lymphocytes, can improve activity of spleen NK cells, can increase the quantity of peripheral white blood cells and lymphocytes, can improve survival rate of the spleen lymphocytes, can promote the spleen lymphocytes to release a large amount of inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha), can enhance phagocytic capacity of mouse peritoneal macrophages, and can be used for preparing immune function regulating products and/or medicaments.

title_en: Process for preparing catalyst for polymerizing olefins
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing a catalyst for the polymerization of olefins. Specifically, the present invention relates to a method for producing a metallocene-supported catalyst capable of producing a polyolefin in which the formation of gel is suppressed. In the method of preparing a metallocene-supported catalyst according to one embodiment of the present invention, the generation of polyolefin, which is a macromolecule, is suppressed by treating with a metal stearate salt after supporting a transition metal compound, so that polyolefin capable of minimizing gel generation can be prepared.

title_en: PBT/artificial granite waste residue composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PBT/artificial granite waste residue composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of dimethyl terephthalate, 2-13 parts of artificial granite waste residues, 95-120 parts of butanediol, 0.01-0.5 part of ester exchange catalyst, 0.01-0.5 part of polymerization catalyst and 0.01-0.5 part of heat stabilizer. The composite material prepared by the invention is prepared by in-situ polymerization, and due to the low viscosity and violent mechanical stirring of the system in the polymerization process and the addition of the unsaturated resin coated on the surface of the artificial granite waste residue, the artificial granite waste residue is uniformly dispersed in the polymer system, so that the obtained composite material has excellent comprehensive mechanical property, and the thermal stability, the crystallization rate and the impact strength are obviously improved. The method can efficiently treat the artificial granite waste residue, eliminate the environmental pollution, change waste into valuable, is beneficial to environmental protection and conforms to the concept of green economic development.

title_en: Multifunctional polyaspartic acid derivative and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional polyaspartic acid derivative and a preparation process thereof. The raw materials of the polyaspartic acid derivative comprise the following components: 100-120 parts of L-aspartic acid, 5-6 parts of phosphoric acid catalyst and 30-40 parts of alkyl primary amine by weight. Has the advantages that: (1) the multifunctional and high-value polyaspartic acid derivative with the functions of moisturizing, removing freckles, whitening, improving skin quality and the like is prepared by a one-pot method, and the preparation method is simple in process and convenient to operate. (2) The HLB value of the polyaspartic acid derivative is controlled by controlling the appropriate grafting ratio through the chain length of the alkyl primary amine side chain and the adding proportion. (3) The L-lysine-polyaspartic acid derivative with amphiprotic molecules is formed by coupling the polyaspartic acid derivative with L-lysine and coordinating with an alkyl chain, thereby synergistically increasing the skin permeability and promoting the generation of collagen.

title_en: Composite thickening agent for paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite thickening agent for paint and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of new materials. The invention firstly uses chitosan and sodium carboxymethylcellulose oxide to react to prepare modified chitosan, then reacts with maleic anhydride solution to synthesize a cross-linking agent, and then is mixed with metal ion solution to prepare a modified cross-linking agent with good water solubility, then the self-made modified cross-linking agent is used for carrying out solution polymerization with acrylic acid monomer, mixed initiator and reducing agent to prepare a polyacrylic acid blank of the composite thickening agent for the coating, and finally the blank of the composite thickening agent for the coating is mixed with water to prepare the composite thickening agent for the coating. The polyacrylic acid thickener for the paint, which is prepared by the invention, has the effects of strong thickening capacity, good conductivity and dye adsorption performance.

title_en: Foaming light diffusion material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of light diffusion materials, and particularly discloses a foaming light diffusion material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the foaming light diffusion material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 93-105 parts of PC, 0.1-0.5 part of antioxidant and 0.3-0.8 part of release agent; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing granules, namely uniformly mixing and extruding 93-105 parts by weight of PC, 0.1-0.5 part by weight of antioxidant and 0.3-0.8 part by weight of release agent to obtain granules; performing injection molding foaming and demonomerization, injecting supercritical carbon dioxide in the injection molding process for foaming and stripping demonomerization to obtain the foamed light diffusion material; wherein the temperatures of different areas of the screw are sequentially 280-300 ℃, 230-380 ℃ and 60-80 ℃; the pressure for maintaining the pressure is 60-100 MPa. The foamed light diffusion material can be used for processing LED lamp shells and has the advantages of high haze and low residual monomer content; in addition, the preparation method has the advantage of reducing the possibility of sticking the die to the product in the processing process.

title_en: Production process of disposable product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of production and processing of daily necessities, in particular to a production process of disposable goods, which comprises the following steps: step A, extruding mixed raw materials: putting mixed raw materials formed by stirring and mixing starch, fiber and water into an extruder, and extruding solid mixed raw materials through a die head of the extruder; step B, forming of a die: feeding the solid mixed raw materials into a forming die device for forming and processing to form a product blank; step C, drying the product: putting the product blank into drying equipment for drying processing to obtain a finished product; and D, packaging the product. The invention takes starch or fiber powder and water as main raw materials to form mixed raw materials, and the mixed raw materials are extruded by an extruder to form solid mixed raw materials, and the solid mixed raw materials are processed into product blanks in a forming die device, and then are dried at high temperature by a drying device to finally form finished products.

title_en: Hybrid polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid polymer and a preparation method and application thereof. The repeating unit structure of the hybrid polymer of the present invention is as follows: the preparation method of the hybrid polymer of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out reaction of trisilanol isooctyl-POSS and vinyl trichlorosilane to obtain a compound 1; 2) carrying out the reaction of the compound 1 and mercaptoethylamine hydrochloride to obtain a compound 2; 3) carrying out a reaction of the compound 2 and cis-5-norbornene-exo-2, 3-dicarboxylic anhydride to obtain a monomer; 4) carrying out polymerization reaction of the monomers to obtain the hybrid polymer. The hybrid polymer has the advantages of light weight, high strength, easy processing and forming, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like, and is suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Novel retarding high-performance water reducing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building materials, and particularly relates to a novel retarding high-performance water reducing agent and a preparation method thereof. The product developed by the invention comprises carboxylic acid type waterborne polyurethane; wherein the carboxylic acid type waterborne polyurethane is obtained by the crosslinking reaction of isocyanate and a polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent; the carboxylic acid type waterborne polyurethane forms a three-dimensional crosslinking network through crosslinking reaction; the three-dimensional cross-linked network is filled with nano silicon dioxide. During preparation, the polycarboxylate superplasticizer and the chain extender are mixed, vacuum dehydration is carried out, isocyanate, dimethyl pyrrolidone and a catalyst are added, after heating reaction, the cross-linking agent and ethyl orthosilicate are added, and heating reaction is continued to obtain a mixed solution; and (3) naturally cooling the mixed solution to 60-65 ℃, and adding an alkaline solution for neutralization under a stirring state to obtain the product. The product obtained by the invention can effectively inhibit the adsorption and interference of clay on the water reducing agent in the using process of the product.

title_en: High-heat-resistance copolymer silicone resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high heat-resistant copolymer silicone resin and a preparation method thereof, wherein a weak base compound is used for catalyzing hydroxyl-terminated linear polysiloxane and organic trichlorosilane to pre-condense in an organic solvent medium, then the pre-condensation is performed with cohydrolysis condensation under the action of strong base to obtain a copolymer, and the copolymer is cured at high temperature to obtain a product, wherein the structural formula of the copolymer is as follows: (R) 1 R 2 ViSiO 0.5 ) a (R 1 R 2 SiO) b (R 3 SiO 1.5 ) c (ii) a Wherein a + b + c is 1, a: c is 3-20: 1; b: c is 1-6: 1; r 1 、R 2 、R 3 The same or different one or more than one selected from Me, Ph and Vi; the number average molecular weight of the polymer is 5 x 10 4 ～10 6 . The copolymerized silicone resin not only can keep good physical and mechanical properties, but also has high heat resistance, can be used for a long time at 300 ℃, and still keeps high strength and high elasticity after being aged for 72 hours under the environment of 350 ℃.

title_en: Sealing ring with high strength and low pressure change, production process thereof and trimming device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sealing rings, in particular to a sealing ring with high strength and low pressure change, a production process and an edge cutting device thereof, which comprise the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 22-38 parts of low-temperature-resistant silicon rubber, 45-55 parts of modified polyurethane resin rubber, 12-34 parts of polycarbodiimide, 10-13 parts of white carbon black, 8-12 parts of graphite, 1.4-2.5 parts of TMTD, 3-6.3 parts of emulsifier, 2.4-5.8 parts of anti-aging agent, 2.6-4.8 parts of nano zinc oxide, 0.05-0.1 part of triallyl isocyanurate, 7-9 parts of sodium phytate and 1.3-1.9 parts of glass fiber; through the scheme, the strength of the sealing ring is improved, low pressure change is realized, the sealing effect of the sealing ring is ideal, and the sealing requirement of equipment is met.

title_en: Plastic hose and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plastic hose and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of plastic hoses. The plastic hose is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 50-65 parts of polytetrafluoroethylene, 1.5-4 parts of a filler, 200 parts of fluorine-containing siloxane, and 600 parts of alkyl lithium/ethylenediamine solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of carrying out cold press molding on polytetrafluoroethylene and filler to obtain a cold press blank; sintering and molding the cold-pressed blank to obtain filled plastic; making the filled plastic into a filled plastic pipe; and soaking the filled plastic pipe in an alkyl lithium/ethylenediamine solution, and then soaking the filled plastic pipe in fluorine-containing siloxane to obtain the plastic hose. The plastic hose can be used for cosmetic manufacturing or cosmetic conveying, and has the advantages of good hydrophobicity and low water absorption rate; in addition, the preparation method of the application is beneficial to gathering the fluorine-containing siloxane on the surface of the plastic hose and improving the hydrophobicity of the surface of the plastic hose.

title_en: Method for producing chitin derivative by ultrasonic treatment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new process for the manufacture of chitin derivatives, in particular nanofibrillar chitin, which is sustainable from the point of view of industrial implementation and is suitable for the production of chitin derivatives with improved properties. The invention also relates to chitin derivatives obtainable by such a process. The invention also relates to the use of such derivatives, including for example the formulation of pastes and aqueous gels useful for topical application to the skin, the manufacture of materials of biomedical interest, and the deposition of chitin nanofibrils on the surface of coatings or their incorporation into the interior of articles such as hygiene products.

title_en: Laser marking additive based on amylose hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of laser marking materials, and particularly relates to a laser marking additive based on amylose hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The laser marking performance of the high polymer material is effectively improved through the synergistic effect of the three components of polystyrene/amylose/polyacrylic acid. Meanwhile, the amylose belongs to biodegradable polysaccharide of biological sources, so that the material is biodegradable and has environmental protection characteristics.

title_en: Conductive MOF material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of metal organic framework materials, and particularly discloses a conductive MOF material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving 2,3,6,7,10, 11-hexa-amino triphenylene hydrate in dimethyl sulfoxide, and stirring until the mixture is fully dissolved to obtain a solution A; s2, dissolving Ni salt in deionized water, and stirring until the Ni salt is fully dissolved to obtain a solution B; s3, dissolving halogen ammonium salt in a mixed solution of ethanol and water, and performing ultrasonic dispersion for 8-12min to obtain a solution C; s4, heating the solution A in an oil bath, adding the solution B and the solution C in sequence, stirring for reaction, and finally adding NH 3 ·H 2 Carrying out O reaction; and S5, repeatedly washing with water and ethanol, and drying in vacuum to obtain the conductive MOF material. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in process, easy to operate, strong in repeatability and environment-friendly, and the conductive X-Ni MOF material with the halogen limited domain of the cavity synthesized by the method disclosed by the invention has a cavity with a smaller size and can improve the selectivity of two-electron oxygen reduction.

title_en: Surface-modified porous polyether-ether-ketone artificial skeleton and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a surface modified porous polyether-ether-ketone artificial skeleton, which adopts a three-period minimum curved surface method to establish discrete points of a three-dimensional topological structure, utilizes the discrete points to generate an artificial skeleton model through reverse modeling, adopts an additive manufacturing method to prepare the porous polyether-ether-ketone artificial skeleton according to the artificial skeleton model, utilizes chemical reaction to convert carbonyl in a polyether-ether-ketone molecular structure on the surface of the artificial skeleton into hydroxyl, and utilizes high-activity isocyanate as an intermediate to respectively react with the hydroxyl on the surface of the polyether-ether-ketone and a compound containing amino to obtain the surface modified polyether-ether-ketone artificial skeleton.

title_en: Porous high-density antibacterial soft-bristle toothbrush
abstract_en: The invention provides a porous high-density antibacterial soft-bristle toothbrush, which belongs to the technical field of toothbrushes and comprises a handle, wherein the handle is a cavity mechanism, the upper end of the handle is fixedly connected with a toothbrush head mounting rod through a connecting sleeve, and the front end of the toothbrush head mounting rod is fixedly connected with a mounting block; the bristles are arranged on the front side of the mounting block, and an injection port is formed in the front side of the bristles; the two groups of buckling mechanisms are respectively connected with the bristles and the mounting block to realize the clamping connection between the mounting block and the bristles; and the flushing mechanism, the toothbrush has the function of flushing teeth in the device, the bristles can be replaced, the service life of the device is prolonged, the new bristles are cleaner than the old bristles, the effect of cleaning oral cavities is better, the bristles have a long-term antibacterial effect, and the device is non-toxic, harmless, green and environment-friendly, and meanwhile, the mint, the tea and the olive can also clear away oral peculiar smell.

title_en: Fabric warm-keeping filling material with down-like function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fabric warm-keeping filling material with a down-like function, and a preparation method and application thereof. Dissolving silk to prepare a mixed solution; soaking the mixed solution into propanol to prepare wet gel, replacing the solvent in the wet gel, and then drying to prepare flexible silk aerogel, namely the fabric warm-keeping filling material with the function similar to down feather; placing the fabric thermal filling material between the two layers of polyester fiber fabric, sewing with needles and threads, and wrapping the fabric thermal filling material on the polyester fiber fabric to obtain the thermal fabric of the flexible silk aerogel. The silk aerogel prepared by the invention does not need other modifiers such as a softening agent and the like, shows good flexibility, and can be used as a filler of thermal clothes. The silk is prepared into the aerogel and used as the filler of the thermal clothes, so that the novel application of the silk is widened, and the application and popularization prospects are good.

title_en: Production and processing equipment and process of polyurethane waterproof coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of waterproof coatings, and particularly relates to polyurethane waterproof coating production and processing equipment and a process thereof, wherein the polyurethane waterproof coating production and processing equipment comprises a first reaction kettle, a second reaction kettle, a feeding kettle and a workbench, wherein the first reaction kettle, the second reaction kettle and the feeding kettle are arranged at the top of the workbench in parallel, and the polyurethane waterproof coating production and processing equipment further comprises: the pneumatic material conveying device is arranged at the top of the reaction kettle II, and the powder conveying device is arranged on the inner wall of the feeding kettle, and the pneumatic material conveying device has the beneficial effects that: through reation kettle one and reation kettle two simultaneous processing, after the reaction is accomplished, open bleeder valve one, hydrovalve three and measuring pump, the measuring pump passes through the material conveying pipeline with the material of mouth of pipe three input to reation kettle two in with the reation kettle two, mix through the material of pneumatic conveying device with powder conveyor, make the batching, grind, react three stage, each other does not influence, can go on simultaneously, operating time has been utilized effectively, the effect of multichannel process continuous production and quick batching has.

title_en: Synthetic method of polyester chip for low-extraction film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthetic method of polyester chips for a low-extraction membrane, belonging to the technical field of polyester preparation and comprising the following steps: 1) esterification reactionAnd 2) pre-polycondensation reaction; 3) final polycondensation reaction; 4) carrying out melt kneading on the PET original sheet obtained in the step 3, phosphate, crown ether and bisphenol endoolefine oxygen compound, wherein the melting temperature is 280 ℃, and the melting time is 5 min; in the invention, 25 percent of KF/Al is adopted 2 O 3 Compared with ethylene glycol antimony, the antimony trioxide added in the invention has lower use cost due to the reason of unit price and subsequent need of water removal, and can overcome the defects that the ethylene glycol antimony is very easy to absorb moisture and needs to be completely used up for 1 time after packaging and unsealing. In the pre-polycondensation stage, the concentration of reaction materials is low, and molecular chains are small, so that the constant speed improvement of the vacuum degree in the pre-polycondensation stage can avoid flooding caused by carrying out a large amount of materials.

title_en: Preparation method of alkaline anion exchange membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an alkaline anion exchange membrane, which comprises the following steps: mixing 4-vinyl benzyl chloride and acrylonitrile in a solvent, heating to react under AN inert atmosphere to obtain a yellow brown reaction product, washing, and fully drying to obtain P (VBC-co-AN); dissolving the obtained P (VBC-co-AN) in dimethyl sulfoxide to obtain a yellow brown solution, adding a trimethylamine/ethanol solution, and stirring for reaction; washing and drying the obtained reaction product, and then adding the reaction product into dimethyl sulfoxide to dissolve and stir to obtain a homogeneous solution; heating and drying in a polytetrafluoroethylene mold to form a film, thereby obtaining a homogeneous benzyl trimethyl ammonium type anion exchange membrane; the obtained anion exchange membrane is soaked in KOH solution and replaced into OH-form to obtain the 4-vinylbenzyl chloride/acrylonitrile copolymer trimethylamine type basic anion exchange membrane material. The product obtained by the invention has excellent mechanical performance resistance, dimensional stability, alkali resistance and thermal stability.

title_en: Antistatic smooth master batch for PP (polypropylene) film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plastic films and preparation thereof, and particularly relates to an antistatic slipping master batch for a PP film and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Powder coating composition redispersible in water
abstract_en: The invention relates to a powder coating composition comprising a) a polymer which can be redispersed in waterAt least one polymer powder, b) pigments and fillers, and C) optionally further additives, characterized in that the polymer powder a) which can be redispersed in water is a mixed polymer which is stabilized with polyvinyl alcohol and is based on a1)50 to 95% by weight of vinyl acetate, a2)1 to 30% by weight of ethylene, a3)0 to 20% by weight of long-chain, optionally branched C  3  To C  12  Vinyl esters of carboxylic acids, a4)0 to 10 wt.% of further ethylenically unsaturated comonomers which are copolymerizable therewith, the values in wt.% adding up to 100 wt.%, and as polyvinyl alcohol containing a degree of hydrolysis of 80 to 95 mol.% and according to Principle (4% aqueous solution, 20 ℃ C.) Method, DIN 53015) of at least one polyvinyl alcohol having a viscosity of 1 to 5mPas and a degree of hydrolysis of 80 to 95 mol% based on A mixture of at least one polyvinyl alcohol with a viscosity of 6 to 40mPas in principle.

title_en: Curcumin modified layered clay/polyvinyl alcohol nano composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a curcumin modified layered clay/polyvinyl alcohol nano composite film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of packaging materials. The preparation method of the composite film comprises the following steps: CUR and Cu  2+  The deposition adsorption and complexation are carried out on the surface of LDHs to prepare the LDHs@CUR-Cu  2+  Then adopting a solution pouring method to pour the LDHs@CUR-Cu  2+  And PVA are blended to prepare LDHs@CUR-Cu  2+  PVA nanocomposite film. The LDHs has good barrier property, specific surface area and structural designability, and the LDHs has high charge density and is not easy to fall off and separate in a solvent. After being added into PVA, the PVA film can be dispersed in PVA, so that the mechanical property and the thermal stability of the PVA film are effectively improved. The load of CUR can effectively improve the antibacterial property and the oxidation resistance of the LDHs/PVA nano composite film and prolong the shelf life of food. In addition, the application of the LDHs/PVA nano composite film in the field of intelligent packaging can be further expanded by utilizing the pH indicative property of curcumin.

title_en: Coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt based on particle size grading and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a preparation method of coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt based on particle size grading, the prepared coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt based on particle size grading can simultaneously meet the requirements of high, medium and low temperature performance and can be applied to asphalt pavement engineering, and the method belongs to the technical field of asphalt; and then heating the matrix asphalt, adding the prepared coal liquefaction residue, and uniformly shearing and stirring by using a high-speed shearing machine to finally prepare the coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt based on the grain size grading. Compared with the coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt without considering the influence of the particle size, the coal liquefaction residue modified asphalt based on the particle size grading has improved high, medium and low temperature performances under the condition of not adding other modifiers and plasticizers.

title_en: Coal-based glycol impurity removal purification method, impurity removal type cation and anion exchange resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The patent application provides a coal-based glycol impurity removal purification method, impurity removal type cation and anion exchange resin and a preparation method thereof. The new purification method for removing impurities from coal-based glycol is to arrange a new purification type cation exchange resin and an anion exchange resin in series in a purification device, and carry out aldehyde removal, ketone removal and ester removal reaction on the coal-based glycol at normal pressure and temperature of 45 ℃ and a space velocity of not higher than 5.0h < -1 >. The impurity-removing type cation exchange resin is prepared by sulfonating polystyrene resin, and the impurity-removing type anion exchange resin is prepared by chloridizing, aminating and hydroxylamine modification of polystyrene resin white balls. The technical scheme proves that the formaldehyde, ketone and ester removal effect of the coal-based glycol is excellent.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling modulus change range of thermal response ionic liquid gel and thermal response ionic liquid gel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for regulating and controlling the modulus change range of a thermal response ionic liquid gel and the thermal response ionic liquid gel, and belongs to the technical field of response materials. According to the method for regulating and controlling the gel modulus of the thermal response ionic liquid, the regulation and control of the modulus change range of the ionic liquid gel before and after thermal response are realized by regulating and controlling the mass ratio of the N-isopropylacrylamide monomer to the ionic liquid or the mass ratio of each ionic liquid in the ionic liquid mixture, and the application range of the ionic liquid in an intelligent response material is widened. The example results show that the thermal response ionic liquid gel prepared by the invention can realize the change of the tensile modulus of the thermal response ionic liquid gel up to 4 to 5 orders of magnitude or more by regulating the mass ratio of each ionic liquid in the ionic liquid.

title_en: Method for preparing high-hardness single-component oxime type room temperature vulcanized silicone rubber by using hydrolysis material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-hardness single-component oxime type room temperature vulcanized silicone rubber by utilizing a hydrolyzed material, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a base material; s2, preparing sizing material; step S1 includes the following steps: adding a hydrolysis material and a filler into a kneader, heating, vacuumizing and dehydrating, removing vacuum after dehydration, continuing kneading, and cooling for later use; step S2 includes the following steps: adding the prepared base material, pigment and cross-linking agent into a stirrer, stirring under a vacuum condition, adding a tackifying assistant and a catalyst, and continuously stirring under the vacuum condition to obtain a finished product; the crosslinking agent is methyl tributyl ketoxime silane, and the catalyst is dibutyltin dilaurate. The single-component oxime type room temperature vulcanized silicone rubber prepared by the preparation method has the characteristics of large modulus, small elasticity and high hardness, can be used for encapsulating electronics and electrical appliances, and greatly reduces the cost of producing RTV-1 compared with the traditional method.

title_en: Preparation method of chiral photosensitive metal organic framework material
abstract_en: A preparation method of a chiral photosensitive metal organic framework material comprises the following steps: adding an organic ligand I shown in a formula (1) and an organic ligand II shown in a formula (2) into N, N-dimethylformamide to dissolve to obtain a reaction solution; adding zirconium tetrachloride and trifluoroacetic acid, dissolving, reacting at 90-120 deg.C for 48-72h, cooling to room temperature, centrifuging, and collecting precipitate; washing the precipitate with N, N-dimethylformamide and ethanol to obtain chiral photosensitive metal organic framework material with a structural formula of Zr 6 O 4 (OH) 8 (L 2 ) n (L 1 ) m In the formula, L 1 Are organic ligands I, L 2 The organic ligand II, m and n are the number of the organic ligand I and the organic ligand II, and m + n is 6. The method is simple and easy to operate, and the preparedThe metal organic framework material can have larger specific surface area and regular pore channel structure, and is beneficial to the reaction of substrate molecules and the function framework.

title_en: Preparation method of ultraviolet light crosslinked polyolefin master batch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of ultraviolet light cross-linked polyolefin master batch, which comprises the following steps: premixing polyolefin and filler to obtain a mixture A, and premixing an antioxidant, a photoinitiator and a crosslinking agent to obtain a mixture B; then mixing the mixture A, B with a dispersant for primary banburying; adding the sulfo-modified silicone oil for secondary banburying, and finally raising the temperature in the banbury mixer to a preset temperature for tertiary banburying to obtain a banburying product; and (3) after the banburying product is prepared into primary master batches, carrying out ultraviolet crosslinking reaction by an ultraviolet irradiation system to obtain ultraviolet crosslinking polyolefin master batches. According to the invention, through multi-step reaction, the phenomenon of evaporation of the photoinitiator and the cross-linking agent when the photoinitiator and the cross-linking agent meet high temperature is effectively avoided, and the ultraviolet cross-linking technology is adopted for cross-linking, so that the efficiency is high, the speed is high, and the finally obtained master batch can effectively improve the high temperature resistance and the mechanical property of the product; the preparation method has the advantages of simple process, convenient operation, energy conservation and environmental protection.

title_en: Synthesis method of eucommia polysaccharide nano silver, synthesized eucommia polysaccharide nano silver and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing eucommia polysaccharide nano-silver, which relates to the technical field of nano-silver and comprises the following steps: (1) mixing 5-10g/L eucommia polysaccharide solution with 0.5-1g/L silver nitrate solution according to a volume ratio of 1-5:2-5, shading, collecting precipitate, cleaning and drying to obtain eucommia polysaccharide nano-silver compound; (2) mixing the eucommia polysaccharide nano-silver compound, the mesoporous silica, the beta-cyclodextrin and the deionized water according to the mass ratio of 1-2:0.2-0.5:10-30:970-1000, stirring, centrifuging, and drying the precipitate to obtain the eucommia polysaccharide nano-silver. The invention also provides the eucommia polysaccharide nano silver synthesized by the method and application thereof. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the problems of high cost, easy agglomeration and the like of the synthesized nano silver are overcome, and on the other hand, the synthesized nano silver has polysaccharide coated load and strong stability.

title_en: High-salt-water-resistance high-temperature-cooking-resistance bi-component polyurethane adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A bi-component polyurethane adhesive with high salt water resistance and high temperature cooking resistance and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of polyurethane. Is prepared by mixing a component A and a component B. The preparation method of the component A comprises the following steps: sequentially putting polybasic acid, polyalcohol and antioxidant into a reaction kettle, introducing nitrogen for protection, stirring and heating, and finishing esterification after reaction; then controlling the temperature of the vacuum reaction kettle to be between 240 ℃ and 260 ℃, and finishing the acid and alcohol polycondensation reaction to obtain polyester polyol; adding polyester polyol, ethyl acetate and a chain extender into a reaction kettle, stirring and heating to 85 ℃ for reaction, cooling to 40-60 ℃ after indexes are qualified, adding ethyl acetate, polyolefin polyol and an adhesion promoter, diluting and stirring uniformly; then mixing with the component B. Solves the problems of easy delamination and low peel strength of the existing composite membrane after the saline content is cooked at the high temperature of 121 ℃.

title_en: Bright yellow antibacterial natural-color bamboo paper pulp and paper product thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to bright yellow antibacterial natural-color bamboo paper pulp and a paper product thereof. The mass ratio of the sum of the mass of pentosan and acid-insoluble lignin to the mass of cellulose in the bamboo paper pulp is 1 to (0.3-8.0), and the bright yellow natural color bamboo paper pulp is made into 80g/m  2  The yellow chromaticity b after the wafer paper is 23-33, L is 63-72, a is 2-5. The natural components of the bamboo are fully reserved in the bamboo pulp, the hemicellulose with stronger hydrophilic performance and fiber elasticity is fully reserved, the lignin with stronger oil absorption performance is reserved as the components of the pulp product, and the substance components which are naturally present in the bamboo and beneficial to sterilization and disinfection are reserved in the bamboo pulp, so that the proportioning of pentosan, acid-insoluble lignin and cellulose in the bamboo pulp product has excellent antibacterial performance, and therefore the bamboo pulp product has good antibacterial performance, water absorption, oil absorption and writing performance. The product has better advantages when being used as a raw material to develop paper for daily use, food packaging paper and writing paper.

title_en: Anti-tumor polypeptide Bax-BH3, fluorescent polymer nano micelle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-tumor polypeptide Bax-BH3, a fluorescent polymer nano micelle, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines, wherein the amino acid sequence of the anti-tumor polypeptide Bax-BH3 is shown as SEQ ID No. 1; the fluorescent polymer nano micelle comprises the antitumor polypeptide Bax-BH 3and a polymer carrier, wherein the polymer carrier is a block copolymer RGD-PHPMA-b-Poly (MMA-alt- (Rhob-MA)). The anti-tumor polypeptide Bax-BH3 has good biocompatibility and biological activity; the fluorescent polymer nano-micelle wraps the antitumor polypeptide Bax-BH3 by using a block copolymer RGD-PHPMA-b-Poly (MMA-alt- (Rhob-MA)), so that the encapsulating rate and the drug loading are high, and the release performance is good.

title_en: Preparation process of efficient universal ultraviolet initiator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of an efficient universal ultraviolet light initiator, belonging to the field of initiators. A preparation process of a high-efficiency universal ultraviolet light initiator comprises a free radical type photoinitiator, a cationic photoinitiator and a photosensitizer, wherein the radical type photoinitiator comprises the following components: MTB, modified 2, 2-dimethoxybenzil ketal, BAPO,2,4, 6-trimethylbenzophenone, methylbenzophenone; the cationic photoinitiator comprises: isopropylferrocene hexafluorophosphate, 1, 3-bis (dicyanomethylene) indene-diphenyliodonium salt; the photosensitizer is cobalt acetylacetonate; the ultraviolet absorption type ultraviolet light absorption device can enlarge the range of the interval capable of absorbing the illumination, can absorb part of visible light and ultraviolet light by the photoinitiator, and can be used for more application scenes.

title_en: Preparation method of metal-complexed hydroxylated graphite carbon nitride-based trimer flame-retardant epoxy resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of metal-complexed terpolymer flame-retardant epoxy resin based on hydroxylated graphite carbon nitride. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking a metal-complexed hydroxylated graphite carbon nitride-based trimer as a flame retardant, taking epoxy resin as a matrix, taking a curing agent as a curing agent, and preparing the flame-retardant epoxy resin composite material through physical stirring. The flame retardant and the flame-retardant epoxy resin composite material are tested and characterized by adopting a limiting oxygen index, a Fourier infrared spectrum, an X-ray diffraction spectrum, an X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, bending performance and an electronic scanning microscope analysis method. The invention has the advantages that: the terpolymer and the epoxy resin prepared by the method have good dispersibility, and the section form of the terpolymer and the section form of the pure epoxy resin are basically consistent. Compared with pure epoxy resin, the epoxy resin composite material obtained by the preparation method has the limit oxygen index of 31.2% only by adding 1 g. The bending property of the epoxy resin composite material provided by the invention is improved by 9% compared with that of pure epoxy resin.

title_en: Compound used as demulsifier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound used as a demulsifier and a preparation method thereof. The structural formula of the compound is shown in a formula I, wherein EO is PO is m and n are PO and EO molar ratio, and m and n are 1 and (3-4).

title_en: Modification treatment method for surface of high-performance carbon fiber
