abstract_en: The invention relates to a modification treatment method for the surface of high-performance carbon fiber, which adopts an anodic electrophoretic deposition technology to prepare a carbon nano material and anionic organic matter codeposition coating on the surface of the carbon fiber so as to improve the surface activity of the carbon fiber, wherein an electrophoretic solution used in electrophoretic deposition consists of the carbon nano material and an anionic polymer electrolyte. The method can endow the carbon fiber with good bundling property and post-processing property, obviously increase the surface activity of the carbon fiber, improve the bonding property of the carbon fiber and a resin matrix, simultaneously does not damage the mechanical property of a carbon fiber body, and has simple process, convenience and easy operation.

title_en: Preparation method and application of high-whiteness titanium dioxide
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of high-whiteness titanium dioxide, and relates to the field of titanium dioxide preparation, wherein the calcination stage in the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) conveying the filter-pressed metatitanic acid into a first-section dehydration zone through a feed inlet for dehydration, controlling the temperature of the dehydration zone to be T1, and dehydrating until the water content of the metatitanic acid is below 3%; (2) transferring the dehydrated metatitanic acid into a secondary desulfurization zone for desulfurization, controlling the temperature of the desulfurization zone to be T2, and dehydrating until the sulfur content of the metatitanic acid is below 2%; (3) transferring the desulfurized metatitanic acid into a three-section crystal form conversion zone and a particle growth zone, controlling the multi-stage program temperature control of the crystal form conversion zone and the particle growth zone, and finally obtaining a kiln falling product, grinding the kiln falling product, and uniformly mixing powder to obtain the titanium dioxide. The titanium dioxide prepared by the method has higher whiteness and covering power, and can be used in the fields of paint, printing ink, plastics and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional high-boron-content boration dispersing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a multifunctional high-boron-content boration dispersing agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing polyisobutylene succinic anhydride and an amine compound, reacting to obtain a polyisobutylene succinimide ashless dispersant, mixing the polyisobutylene succinimide ashless dispersant and boric acid for reaction, adding fatty acid diethanolamide for reaction, and collecting a reaction product. The preparation method of the multifunctional high-boron-content borated dispersant provided by the invention improves the boron content, the dispersing property, the antirust property and the wear resistance in the borated dispersant, and the product can be used in internal combustion engine oil, automobile automatic transmission oil and industrial lubricating oil.

title_en: Aramid fiber impregnated composite material liner and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aramid fiber impregnated composite material gasket which is characterized in that the gasket is prepared by PBO fiber yarns through the working procedures of doubling, weaving, drying, cutting, gluing and shaping, wherein after a sleeve woven by the fiber yarns is cut according to a preset size, the sleeve is soaked in a polytetrafluoroethylene resin solution in the gluing working procedure, polytetrafluoroethylene resin is fully impregnated on the inner surface and the outer surface of the sleeve, the content of the polytetrafluoroethylene resin accounts for 68-72% of the total weight of the sleeve and the polytetrafluoroethylene resin, the fully impregnated sleeve is shaped in a gasket mold at a certain pressure and temperature, and the aramid fiber impregnated composite material gasket is obtained after finishing. The invention also provides a preparation method of the gasket, and the gasket can be used in various environments such as hydraulic oil, fuel oil, salt mist, damp heat and the like, and has the performances of corrosion resistance, salt mist resistance, high temperature resistance, wear resistance and the like.

title_en: Bio-based degradable polyurethane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based degradable polyurethane, which comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 16-19 parts of polyol, 5-8 parts of N, N-dimethylformamide, 6-11 parts of isocyanate and 0.1-0.3 part of chain extender, and belongs to the technical field of polyurethane. The chain extender is used in the raw materials of the polyurethane, wherein the chain extender adopts undecylenic acid as the raw material, the polyurethane prepared by reacting the chain extender as the raw material with the polyol contains a pendant chain, the intermolecular acting force between polymer chains is reduced due to the pendant chain, the ordered arrangement of the molecular chains is hindered, and the orderliness of the molecular chains is reduced, so that the crystallization micro-region is reduced, thereby effectively reducing the crystallinity of the polyurethane material.

title_en: Hot-melt optical adhesive with ultraviolet blocking function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical adhesives, and particularly relates to a hot-melt optical adhesive with an ultraviolet blocking function and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hot-melt optical adhesive comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of a mixed copolymer; 1-5 parts of a coupling agent; 0.2-0.6 part of antioxidant; 0.1-0.6 part of light stabilizer; 5-10 parts of a water-blocking agent; the mixed copolymer is obtained by reacting 100:5-10:0.5-1:1-3:0.5-1 parts by weight of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, a cross-linking agent, an ultraviolet-proof agent, an initiator and a polymerization initiator; the ultraviolet-proof agent consists of 4-methacrylamide salicylic acid and thiazolyl-2 (1H) -pyridinone-4-methyl allyl formate, wherein the thiazolyl-2 (1H) -pyridinone-4-methyl allyl formate is obtained by reacting citric acid with 2-aminoethanethiol to obtain an intermediate product and esterifying with methyl allyl alcohol.

title_en: Front bending degree design method for preparing high-refractive-index resin lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for designing the front curve curvature of a resin lens with high refractive index, which comprises that the maximum designed front curve curvature of-1.00 to-3.50 is-4.00D within the range of-1.00 to-15.00 of the near vision luminosity; -3.75 to-5.50 maximum design bow-3.00D; -5.75 to-8.75 maximum design front camber of-2.00D; the maximum design front camber of-9.00 to-15.00 is-1.50D. The method is mainly suitable for resin lenses with refractive indexes of 1.60, 1.67 and 1.74, limits the maximum bending degree of the designed front curve, can effectively solve the geometrical structure and performance of lens molding, and can furthest reduce the spherical lens luminosity error and oblique astigmatism.

title_en: Continuous production system and production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a continuous production system and a production method. The production system comprises a continuous reaction unit and a comprehensive heat exchange system, the continuous reaction unit is connected with the comprehensive heat exchange system, the continuous reaction unit is used for receiving mixed material liquid and enabling the mixed material liquid to react to form reaction liquid, the comprehensive heat exchange system comprises at least one first heat exchanger, the first heat exchanger comprises two heat exchange strokes, the two heat exchange strokes are used for respectively supplying the mixed material liquid and the reaction liquid to flow, and heat exchange is carried out between the mixed material liquid and the reaction liquid when the mixed material liquid and the reaction liquid flow in the heat exchange strokes. The acrylic resin product obtained by the invention has high solid content (70-90%) and low viscosity (1500-6000 cp). The acrylic resin product does not need to be additionally added with a solvent, so that the use and waste of the solvent are reduced while the post-treatment process is avoided, and the environmental pollution and the harm to the human body caused by the volatilization of the excessive solvent during the use of the product are also avoided, thereby being more environment-friendly.

title_en: Phenolic resin with high controllable molecular weight, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photoresist, and particularly discloses a phenolic resin with a high controllable molecular weight, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the preparation method comprises the following steps: reacting a methylphenol compound with an aldehyde compound in the presence of an acidic catalyst and water in an inert atmosphere to obtain a reaction solution; dehydration and dephenolization steps: firstly, washing the reaction liquid with water, separating out a water phase, and repeating the washing treatment until the pH value of the separated water phase is=6.5-7; and then drying at the temperature of 35-80 ℃ to obtain the phenolic resin. The phenolic resin with the controllable molecular weight is prepared by the preparation method. The application of the phenolic resin with the controllable molecular weight in the preparation of photoresist. The application achieves the aim of highly controlling the molecular weight and softening point of the phenolic resin under the same reaction condition, and ensures the stability of the molecular weight and softening point of the phenolic resin.

title_en: Polycarbonate dihydric alcohol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polycarbonate dihydric alcohol and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1: mixing dihydric alcohol and dimethyl carbonate for reaction, and distilling out a blend of the dimethyl carbonate and methanol; s2: cooling the blend to precipitate dimethyl carbonate crystals, and adding the dimethyl carbonate crystals into step S1; s3: repeating the steps and distilling to obtain the polycarbonate diol. According to the method, after the mixture of the distilled dimethyl carbonate and the methanol is purified and separated, the purified dimethyl carbonate is put into the reaction kettle in the form of raw materials, the molecular weight and the hydroxyl value of the prepared polycarbonate diol can be accurately controlled by controlling the feeding ratio of the raw materials, and compared with the traditional preparation process, the method can reduce the total input amount of the raw material dimethyl carbonate, and is stable in reaction system, low in cost and high in efficiency.

title_en: Concrete toughness-enhanced chain alkanolamine ferric salt composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concrete toughness enhanced chain alcohol amine ferric salt composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein 460-480 parts of chain alcohol amine, 0.15-0.45 part of catalyst, 0.10-0.35 part of antioxidant and 1.2-2.5 parts of chelating agent are added into a reactor protected by inert atmosphere and stirred, then 6-7 parts of ferric salt and 1-2 parts of metal salt are added under the stirring condition for reaction, the reaction time is 2-3 hours, the temperature of a reaction system is kept at 0-30 ℃, and after the addition is finished, the reflux is carried out for 2-3 hours and the heating is kept; and then filtering to remove filter residues, heating and carrying out reduced pressure rectification on the filtrate to obtain product liquid, and heating and carrying out reduced pressure distillation on the obtained product liquid to obtain the product of the alcamine ferric salt. The invention prepares the chain alkanolamine ferric salt composition with the enhanced concrete toughness by using a direct reaction method, and the alcohol amine used by the metal alkanolamine salt can play a good role in adsorption, thereby improving the toughness and the bending resistance of the concrete.

title_en: Automobile exterior trimming part
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile exterior trimming part, which belongs to the technical field of automobile accessory parts and comprises an exterior trimming part main body, wherein a groove is formed in the side surface of the exterior trimming part main body, and a buckle is arranged on the side wall of the exterior trimming part main body; the mica powder material is arranged in the raw materials, and the mica powder is subsequently processed into the modified mica powder, so that the insulativity, high temperature resistance, acid and alkali resistance and corrosion resistance of the produced automobile side skirt edge can be effectively improved, the side skirt edge can cope with the severe environment experienced in the use process of an automobile, the service life of the side skirt edge is kept, meanwhile, the fusion effect of the mica powder and the raw materials can be effectively improved through modification treatment, meanwhile, the epoxy resin material is arranged in the raw materials, the heat resistance, the corrosion resistance and the toughness of the side skirt edge can be effectively improved through the epoxy resin material, the aging condition of the side skirt edge in the use process can be effectively delayed, the service life of the side skirt edge is prolonged, the impact strength of the side skirt edge can be effectively improved, the product quality is improved, and the application effect of the method is improved.

title_en: Maltodextrin preparation process and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maltodextrin preparation, and provides a maltodextrin preparation process and equipment, which comprise the following steps: pulping, spray liquefying, cooling, removing impurities, decolorizing, concentrating, purifying and drying; the device comprises the following equipment: the system comprises a quick-mixing paste mixer, a steam jet liquefier, a flash tank, a stirring processor, a pressurizing separation tank and a spray dryer. Through the technical scheme, the problem of high energy consumption of the maltodextrin per unit weight in the production of the enzyme method process in the related art is solved.

title_en: Flame-retardant nylon 6 fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant nylon 6 fiber and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of functional fibers, and the preparation method of the flame-retardant nylon 6 fiber comprises the following steps of 1, reacting caprolactam, a flame retardant shown in a formula I, deionized water and 6-aminocaproic acid in a reaction device to obtain flame-retardant nylon 6; step 2, drying the flame-retardant nylon 6, and carrying out melt spinning to obtain flame-retardant nylon 6 fibers; formula I. The preparation method of the invention comprises the steps of mixing caprolactam and hindered amine shown as the formula IThe flame retardant nylon 6 is obtained by the in-situ polymerization method, so that the flame retardant can be uniformly dispersed in the flame retardant nylon 6, and the spinnability, flame retardance, thermal stability, mechanical property and hygroscopicity of the flame retardant nylon 6 are improved.

title_en: Hydrophobic migration agent for polyolefin plastic insulator
abstract_en: A hydrophobic migration agent for polyolefin plastic insulators comprises, by weight, 15-40 parts of aliphatic amine and 60-85 parts of perfluoroalkyl acrylate, and is prepared by carrying out chemical reaction on the raw materials to obtain a solid product; the aliphatic amine consists of 1-5 parts of diisooctylamine, 1-5 parts of dodecylamine and 20-35 parts of octadecylamine, and the perfluoroalkyl acrylate is one or more of perfluorobutyl ethyl acrylate, perfluorohexyl ethyl acrylate, perfluorooctyl ethyl acrylate and perfluorodecyl ethyl acrylate. The prepared hydrophobic migration agent has a molecular structure, one end of the molecular structure is perfluoroalkyl, and the molecular structure has excellent hydrophobicity and weather resistance; the other end of the saturated hydrocarbon structure is similar to the molecular structure of the polyolefin resin, and has good compatibility. The invention is added into the polyolefin plastic umbrella cover, can endow long-term hydrophobicity, hydrophobicity migration and antifouling performance, and has the function of well preventing pollution flashover on the surface of the polyolefin insulator of the power transmission line.

title_en: Antibacterial rat and ant prevention magnetic polyethylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An antibacterial rat and ant prevention magnetic polyethylene material and a preparation method thereof have the following advantages: 1. the multifunctional effect of replacing metal materials with high polymer materials is achieved on the functions of magnetism, electric conduction, rat and ant prevention and signal interference shielding; 2. has long-acting rat and ant prevention effect, multiple virus and bacteria resistance and high flame retardant function; 3. the raw material cost is low, the market source is wide, and the purpose of reducing the purchasing cost is achieved; 4. the process is intelligent and simple, and the manufacture is more efficient.

title_en: Impact-resistant copolymerized polypropylene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses impact-resistant copolymerized polypropylene and a preparation method thereof. The impact copolymer polypropylene comprises a propylene homopolymer as a matrix of a continuous phase and an ethylene-propylene random copolymer as a dispersed phase; the monomers of the ethylene-propylene random copolymer include: propylene, ethylene, bis (7-octenyl) dichlorosilane and alpha, omega-nonconjugated dienes. The preparation method comprises the following steps: propylene is subjected to homopolymerization under the action of a catalyst; and then adding di (7-octenyl) dichlorosilane and alpha, omega-non-conjugated diene into a polymerization reaction system, and introducing ethylene-propylene mixed gas to carry out ethylene-propylene random copolymerization reaction to obtain the impact copolymer polypropylene. The two crosslinking auxiliary monomers are added in the ethylene-propylene random copolymerization reaction, so that the crosslinking degree of a rubber phase in the obtained impact copolymer polypropylene can be improved, and the obtained impact copolymer polypropylene has higher impact toughness and stronger creep resistance.

title_en: Low-density high-hardness high-toughness organic silicon SMC resin composition, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-density high-hardness high-toughness organic silicon SMC resin composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises the following raw materials: phenyl vinyl MQ silicon resin, phenyl vinyl silicon oil, hydrogen-containing silicon oil, reinforcing agent,Glass microspheres, glass fibers, a curing agent and an inhibitor. The invention also provides a preparation method of the resin composition. The hardness of the resin composition can reach 80-90 Shore D, the bending strength can reach 135-158MPa, and the resin density is 1.35-1.50g/cm 3 And the SMC has the characteristics of 150 ℃ by 10min rapid forming and the like, has high mechanical strength and good heat resistance after forming, effectively reduces the density of the SMC material, is suitable for the application requirements of light weight of automobiles and rail transit, and can be used for preparing automobile external covering parts, engine protection plates and the like.

title_en: Stannous amino acid and application thereof in polyurethane foam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of chemical industry, and relates to an organic tin catalyst, in particular to stannous amino acid and application thereof in preparation of polyurethane foam. The method comprises the steps of firstly, synthesizing amino acid by using pyruvic acid and aldehyde as raw materials through three steps, and then reacting the amino acid with stannous oxide to obtain the stannous amino acid. Compared with the traditional stannous carboxylate, only carboxyl is coordinated with a tin center in the traditional stannous carboxylate, and amino and carboxyl in the amino acid stannous provided by the invention are simultaneously coordinated with the tin center, so that the complex is more stable and has higher catalytic activity. In addition, the method for synthesizing the amino acid is not reported in a published document, and the method has the advantages of cheap reagent, simpler formula, more convenient operation, greenness, safety, high efficiency, environmental protection and suitability for industrial production.

title_en: Process for preparing highly reactive isobutylene homo-or copolymers
abstract_en: The present application relates to a process for preparing highly reactive isobutene homo-or copolymers, wherein the content of terminal vinylidene double bonds at the chain end of each homo-or copolymer is at least 70mol%, which comprises polymerizing isobutene or an isobutene-containing monomer mixture in the presence of an aluminum trihalide-donor complex or an alkylaluminum halide-donor complex, which is effective as polymerization catalyst, said complex comprising as donor a mixture of at least two organic compounds each containing at least one ether function.

title_en: Co-60-based color changing treatment process for gamma ray irradiation of amber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a color changing treatment process for irradiating amber based on gamma rays generated by Co-60, which can obtain samples which are subjected to serial color changing treatment by gradually deepening serial colors of orange, orange yellow and the like of amber with different producing area attributes. In particular to a color-changing optimized processing sample with different color systems obtained by irradiating an amber sample with different doses through gamma-rays generated by Co-60. The irradiation source is a common irradiation treatment device, the irradiation process is simple, the operation is convenient, the irradiated amber sample has no irradiation residue harm, the invention provides a new technical method for amber optimization treatment, and provides technical support for amber resource and gradient application.

title_en: Graphene conductive polymer composite material for carrier roller, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene conductive polymer composite material for a carrier roller, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-70 parts of high-density polyethylene, 10-30 parts of alkali-free glass fiber, 1-10 parts of a conductive agent, 1-5 parts of a grafting agent, 0.1-1 part of graphene, 0.1-0.5 part of an antioxidant, 0.1-0.5 part of an anti-ultraviolet agent and 0.1-1 part of a lubricant. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application. The invention improves the mechanical property while improving the electrical conductivity of the material, and has the advantages of simple processing technology, low manufacturing cost and higher cost performance.

title_en: Automotive interior sound-absorbing material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an automotive interior sound-absorbing material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the automotive interior sound-absorbing material comprises the following raw materials of 40-50 parts of polypropylene, 20-30 parts of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, 3-8 parts of straws, 4-10 parts of borax, 1-4 parts of titanium dioxide, 0.3-1.4 parts of isoascorbic acid, 2-5 parts of modified mixed solution, 2-4 parts of sodium hexafluoroaluminate, 1-4 parts of zinc stearate and 0.3-0.6 part of mildew preventive; the preparation method of the sound-absorbing material for the automotive interior comprises the following steps: A. preparing raw materials; B. diluting the modified mixed solution with acetone to obtain a modified mixed solution diluent; C. preparing sinter from straw, borax and titanium dioxide; D. modifying the sinter in the modified mixed solution diluent to obtain a mixed material B; E. and (3) carrying out primary mixing, high-speed mixing, extrusion and granulation on the materials to obtain the automotive interior sound-absorbing material. The sound-absorbing material provided by the invention has good sound-absorbing property, mildew resistance, antibacterial property and flame retardance, and the release amount of formaldehyde is low.

title_en: Degradable film for sanitary material packaging and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of degradable materials, and provides a degradable film for sanitary material packaging, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of PLA, 40-60 parts of PBAT, 10-20 parts of organic modified nano calcium carbonate, 0.2-1 part of chain extender, 0.2-1 part of plasticizer and 1-10 parts of PBAT-based titanium dioxide color masterbatch. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the problem that keeping material packing degradability among the prior art can't have concurrently with processability, deflection feel, heat sealability, printing effect has been solved.

title_en: Flexible sensor interface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible sensor interface, which comprises a high molecular polymer and magnetic particles, wherein the flexible sensor interface structure comprises a substrate layer and a raised microstructure growing on the substrate layer. The flexible sensor interface has a specific convex structure, so that the flexible sensor interface has high pressure detection sensitivity. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the flexible sensor interface, which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing the magnetic particles and a high molecular polymer to obtain a mixture; and placing the mixture in a magnetic field to obtain a convex microstructure on the surface of the mixture, and standing for 0.5-3h to obtain a flexible sensor interface. The method is simple in preparation method, environment-friendly and capable of well controlling the interface surface microstructure.

title_en: Asphalt emulsifier, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an asphalt emulsifier, a preparation method and application thereof, and the asphalt emulsifier comprises 80-90 parts of a general formula (1), 2-3 parts of sodium dodecyl sulfate and 60-80 parts of water, wherein the general formula (1) is R-O- (C2H4O) x- (CH (CH3) -CH2-O) y- (C2H4O)5-H, a group R in the general formula (1) is branched alkyl with 10-16 carbon atoms, x represents 6-28, and y represents 5-8. The asphalt obtained by the asphalt emulsifier of the invention can meet the application requirements of asphalt in the industries of paint, plastics, rubber and the like and the aspects of paving pavements and the like.

title_en: Graphene-based sponge and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environment-friendly materials, and particularly relates to graphene-based sponge and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the graphene-based sponge comprises the following steps: carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the mixture of the dispersion liquid of the graphene oxide and the polyurethane sponge to obtain the polyurethane sponge loaded with the graphene oxide; heating the polyurethane sponge loaded with the graphene oxide; the temperature of the heating treatment is 140-220 ℃, and the time of the heating treatment is 5-20 h. The preparation method of the graphene-based sponge is green and nontoxic, environment-friendly and simple to operate, and the obtained graphene-based polyurethane sponge material has excellent oleophylic and hydrophobic properties, can be repeatedly utilized for many times after regeneration, and has a good treatment effect on sewage containing oil substances and/or organic solvents.

title_en: Ferrocene modified polyaniline/carbon nanotube composite electrode capable of selectively removing phosphate ions and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ferrocene modified polyaniline/carbon nano tube composite electrode capable of selectively removing phosphate ions and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing 1,1 '-ferrocenyl diformyl chloride through acyl chloride reaction, (2) preparing 1, 1' -ferrocenyl aniline monomer through amide reaction, (3) preparing a ferrocene modified polyaniline/carbon nano tube composite material through chemical oxidation polymerization reaction, and (4) preparing a ferrocene modified polyaniline/carbon nano tube composite electrode. According to the invention, a group which is selectively responsive to phosphate ions is introduced into the electrode material, so that the composite electrode which is high in selective capture of the phosphate ions, large in ion storage capacity and stable in performance is prepared, and the key technical problem that a capacitive desalting system is poor in effect of removing phosphate in sewage is solved.

title_en: Preparation method of composite film based on poly-tetramethyl-pentene-barium titanate nano particles
abstract_en: The preparation method comprises the steps of weighing polytetramethylene monopentene with the first predetermined mass fraction, dissolving the polytetramethylene monopentene in a nonpolar polymer solvent, and dissolving under the condition of uniform stirring to obtain a polytetramethylene monopentene solution; weighing barium titanate nanoparticles with a second predetermined mass fraction, adding the barium titanate nanoparticles into the polytetramethylene monopentene solution, and stirring to obtain a mixed solution A; and drying the mixed solution A in vacuum to obtain the polytetramethylene monopentene-barium titanate nano particle composite film.

title_en: Preparation method of beta-cyclodextrin modified polystyrene resin with high grafting amount
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of beta-cyclodextrin modified polystyrene resin with high grafting amount, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out chloroacetylation modification on the polystyrene resin by utilizing Friedel-crafts acylation reaction to obtain an acylated polystyrene resin macroinitiator. And then, initiating a vinyl beta-cyclodextrin (MAH-beta-CD) monomer to carry out polymerization reaction by utilizing an Atom Transfer Radical Polymerization (ATRP) method and taking cuprous bromide/N, N, N, N-Tetramethylethylenediamine (TMEDA) as a catalytic system and N, N-dimethylformamide as a solvent to obtain the beta-cyclodextrin modified polystyrene resin. The beta-cyclodextrin modified polystyrene resin prepared by the invention is a micron-sized microsphere, has the advantages of simple preparation process, high beta-cyclodextrin grafting rate and solid loading capacity on the surface of the resin and uniform distribution of the beta-cyclodextrin on the surface of the resin, and solves the problems of complex and unstable reaction process, low surface beta-cyclodextrin grafting rate or solid loading capacity and non-uniform distribution of the traditional micron-sized polystyrene resin surface grafting beta-cyclodextrin.

title_en: Preparation method of KTN/PI composite film with high breakdown and low dielectric loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a KTN/PI composite film with high breakdown and low dielectric loss, which comprises the following steps of firstly, modifying the surface of potassium tantalate niobate (KTN) by using a 3- (2-aminoethylamino) propyl methyl dimethoxy silane coupling agent. Then preparing a PI-based composite film precursor by an in-situ polymerization method, heating at the temperature of 80-330 ℃, and performing thermal imidization to prepare KTN-NH with the mass fraction of 3-11 percent 2 a/PI composite film. KTN-NH in contrast to KTN/PI 2 The breakdown field strength of the/PI composite film can reach 242.12 kilovolts/millimeter, which is 1.49 times of KTN/PI. At a test frequency of 1.0X 10 5 At Hertz, 3 percent of KTN-NH is contained 2 /PI complexThe loss tangent values of the synthetic films are all lower than 0.007.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine extract for reducing blood pressure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine extract for reducing blood pressure and a preparation method thereof, wherein coptis chinensis, eucommia ulmoides, abalone shells, cassia seeds, selfheal, white paeony root and scutellaria baicalensis are taken as main materials for clearing heat and drying damp and purging fire and detoxifying, wild chrysanthemum flowers, dogbane leaves and uncaria are taken as auxiliary materials for calming the liver and soothing the nerves and clearing heat and promoting diuresis, the main materials and the ministerial materials are combined, the heat and the detoxifying are cleared away, the liver is cooled and the eyesight is improved, and the blood pressure is reduced in the middle warmer, so that the effects of clearing heat and drying damp and purging fire and detoxifying are achieved; the formula has the effects of nourishing yin and suppressing yang, and benefiting yin and yang, and the combination of the medicines can treat both symptoms and root causes, and mainly treat the symptoms. The traditional Chinese medicine is scientific in compatibility, is prepared by adopting a modern scientific preparation process, has an excellent blood pressure reducing effect, can effectively relieve hypertension caused by the fact that the air in the body is abundant due to liver and kidney disorder, yin deficiency and yang excess and water retention, and further relieves dizziness and tinnitus, head and eye distending pain and red face and ear due to hypertension.

title_en: Assembling device for high-strength bicycle basket and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembling device of a high-strength bicycle basket and a production process thereof, and relates to the field of bicycle parts, the assembling device is of a combined type, is clamped and installed on a bicycle frame by utilizing an anti-skid washer through a first combined pipe and a second combined pipe, can change the clamping diameter so as to be suitable for bicycles of different types, can be simply and quickly installed and disassembled through clamping and bolt connection, is convenient to use, can fix the basket in multiple directions through installation of an installation plate and support of a support plate, avoids deformation of the basket and increases the bearing force of the basket; be provided with anti rust coating on this assembly device, can effectual isolated air, this anti rust coating itself has the hydrophobicity moreover, and good water-fast, acid-fast and alkali resistance can be difficult to damage to can be to the long-term effectual protection of metalwork, and then maintain each item performance of assembly device of high strength bicycle basket.

title_en: Large biological stone plastic floor containing wormwood active ingredient and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a halobios stone-plastic floor containing wormwood active ingredients, which is of a three-layer structure and comprises a surface layer, a buffer layer and a base layer from top to bottom. The invention also provides a preparation method of the large-organism stone-plastic floor containing the wormwood active ingredient, which comprises the steps of preparing the pore-forming film coating agent, preparing the base layer, preparing the buffer layer and preparing the stone-plastic floor. The porosity of the stone plastic floor prepared by the invention is 32-36%, the porosity is uniform, the diameter is 25-28 μm, the pore film covering thickness is 0.3-0.5 μm, the thickness is uniform, the thickness deviation is +/-0.02-0.03 μm, the porosity film covering rate is high, and the film covering rate is 97.5-98.2%.

title_en: Shape memory nylon material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shape memory polymer materials, in particular to a shape memory nylon material and a preparation method thereof. The shape memory nylon material is prepared by taking nylon containing double bonds as a matrix and performing irradiation crosslinking; wherein the nylon matrix is prepared by salt formation preparation, prepolymerization and final polycondensation of a dibasic acid mixture with the molar content of fumaric acid of 2-10% and diamine, and the irradiation crosslinking adopts cobalt ray irradiation. The shape memory nylon material prepared by the invention has excellent comprehensive performance and good shape memory effect, and compared with the traditional shape memory polymer material, the shape memory nylon material also has high and low temperature resistance and excellent chemical stability.

title_en: Compound for treating cataract, composition thereof, preparation method and medical application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound for treating cataract, a composition, a preparation method and medical application thereof, wherein the compound is used for treating cataractThe compound has a structure shown in formula I (n is 1-50). The compound can be used for treating lens turbidness diseases such as cataract and the like.

title_en: Metal organic framework multienzyme composite catalytic material, preparation method, application and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal organic framework multienzyme composite catalytic material, a preparation method, application and a using method thereof. The composite catalytic material of the invention can effectively recycle CO  2  The method for solving the greenhouse effect is provided, and the method can realize repeated utilization for multiple times through immobilization and cyclic regeneration of cofactors while maintaining higher catalytic activity, and the method for synthesizing the high-value industrialized product with low cost and environmental protection is provided.

title_en: Nano antibacterial composite fiber for processing non-woven fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano antibacterial composite fiber for processing non-woven fabrics, which comprises the following steps: adding nano titanium dioxide into water, performing ultrasonic dispersion for 5-10min, adjusting the pH value of the system to 2.5-4, adding maleic anhydride, stirring for 2-5h at 60-80 ℃ under the protection of nitrogen, performing suction filtration, washing, drying at 40-50 ℃, and crushing to obtain grafted nano powder; adding chitosan into an acetic acid solution, stirring uniformly, adding acrylic acid and the grafted nano powder into the acetic acid solution under the protection of nitrogen, stirring uniformly, adding an initiator, and reacting for 5-10 hours at 40-60 ℃ to obtain a blending solution; extruding the blending solution from a spinneret orifice with the aperture of 0.65-0.75mm at the speed of 8-10mm/min by a variable frequency stepper, entering oxalic acid solution for solidification and forming, and then sequentially washing, drafting and drying at room temperature to constant weight to obtain the nano antibacterial composite fiber for processing the non-woven fabric.

title_en: Uniform heating system and method for modifying heavy calcium carbonate powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a uniform heating system and a method for modifying heavy calcium carbonate powder, which comprises a spiral heater and a rotary dispersion heater; the spiral heater is fixed through a spiral heater support frame; the spiral heater comprises a heater body, an inner cavity of the heater body is of a funnel-shaped structure, and spiral heating rollers are distributed in the inner cavity; the spiral heating roller is of a structure with a wide upper part and a narrow lower part, and a spiral downward material conveying heating groove is arranged on the body surface of the roller body; the inside of the roller body is correspondingly provided with a hot oil circulating channel which is spirally upward; the rotary dispersion heaters are distributed below the spiral heaters and are connected with the discharge holes of the spiral heaters. The invention adopts a double-heat-source heat supply mode combining gas heating and electric heating, obviously improves the heating balance and stability of the powder and has good use effect.

title_en: Phase-change energy-storage heat-insulation composite board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase change energy storage heat preservation composite board which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of phenolic resin, 70-120 parts of inorganic phase change material, 3-7 parts of emulsifier, 0.1-6 parts of diluent and 4-9 parts of curing agent; 30-80 parts of a porous adsorption material; also discloses a preparation method of the phase-change energy-storage heat-insulation composite board. The phenolic resin is used as a main framework of the phase-change composite insulation board, the inorganic phase-change material provides a phase-change energy storage effect for the phase-change composite insulation board, the emulsifier enables the phase-change composite insulation board to have increased toughness and uniform distribution and prevent cracking, the diluent adjusts the viscosity of the material to enable the board to be stable, and the curing agent enables the material to be rapidly cured and formed to wrap the phase-change material, so that the prepared phase-change composite insulation board has the characteristics of low manufacturing cost, large phase-change enthalpy value, difficulty in leakage, long service life and the like compared with the phase-change material in the current market.

title_en: Preparation method of porous network composite material with shielding and sound absorption functions
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a porous network composite material with shielding and sound absorption functions, which comprises the following steps: (1) placing the pre-pressed blocky loofah sponge or the blocky loofah sponge treated by the phenolic resin in a tubular furnace for carbonization; using the blocky loofah sponge carbon without modification or after copper particle modification as a subsequent material; (2) mixing epoxy resin and trichloromethane, adding pine cone carbon, adding barium titanate, curing agent and the like to prepare an epoxy resin-pine cone carbon mixture; firstly, paving a layer of epoxy resin-pine cone carbon mixture on the bottom layer of a mould, then paving blocky loofah sponge carbon, and finally paving a layer of epoxy resin-pine cone carbon mixture; finally, curing in a hot press. The invention has the advantages that: the material has high conductivity, excellent electromagnetic shielding performance, certain sound absorption performance and good mechanical performance, and provides reference value for producing the home decoration material with the electromagnetic shielding performance and the sound absorption performance.

title_en: Preparation method of single chitosan oligosaccharide with high polymerization degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of single chitosan oligosaccharide with high polymerization degree, which comprises the following steps: dissolving fully deacetylated chitosan oligosaccharide in water to prepare a chitosan oligosaccharide solution, adding ethanol for precipitation, centrifuging, and collecting the precipitate; wherein, the volume of the added ethanol accounts for 30 to 55 percent of the volume of the final solution; dissolving the collected precipitate with acetic acid buffer solution, separating and purifying with gel exclusion chromatographic column with Bio-gel P10 as filler, detecting the eluate with differential refraction detector, and collecting the three detected eluate components; desalting the collected three eluent components by a gel exclusion chromatographic column with Sephadex G10 as a filler, and concentrating to obtain the single chitosan oligosaccharide with high polymerization degree. The method disclosed by the invention can be used for preparing the chitosan octaose, chitosan nonaose and chitosan decaose standard products with high purity, and the preparation method is simple and feasible.

title_en: Method for preparing granular polyvinyl alcohol through suspension alcoholysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing granular polyvinyl alcohol through suspension alcoholysis, which is characterized in that a suspending agent is added during the alcoholysis of polyvinyl acetate, so that the granular polyvinyl alcohol is obtained. The method has the advantages of simple process and low cost, and the obtained granular polyvinyl alcohol has uniform particles, does not need subsequent crushing, and is beneficial to the subsequent ripening and washing procedures; the granular polyvinyl alcohol obtained by the invention has higher alcoholysis degree and excellent performance, and can be suitable for various downstream products.

title_en: High-rigidity high-thermal-aging-resistance polypropylene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-rigidity high-thermal-aging-resistance polypropylene composite material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of high polymer materials. The polypropylene composite material of the invention adopts the specific low molecular weight polypropylene and the high melt strength polypropylene as the resin matrix component, and can give consideration to excellent rigidity and high flow forming property of the obtained product; meanwhile, the filler and various high-performance additives are added, so that the finally obtained product has a high thermal aging resistance effect. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the high-rigidity high-thermal-aging-resistance polypropylene composite material.

title_en: High-strength high-stress-at-definite-elongation bionic rubber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of synthetic rubber materials, and provides a high-strength high-stress-at-elongation bionic rubber, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the bionic rubber is prepared by reacting an isoprene monomer and an auxiliary agent under the catalysis of a rare earth catalyst; the auxiliary agent is a modified phospholipid substance obtained by reacting alkyl aluminum with phospholipid; the alkyl aluminum is trialkyl aluminum or alkyl aluminum hydride; the phospholipid is selected from one or more of lecithin, phosphatidylinositol, glycerophosphate, glycerophosphorylcholine and long-chain alkyl phosphate. The bionic rubber prepared by the method has the characteristics of high strength, high stress at definite elongation and the like, and can be used for preparing the tire tread of an aircraft tire.

title_en: Polyamic acid resin capable of being aminated by low Wen Ya and used for negative photoresist and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a low Wen Ya aminated polyamide acid resin for negative photoresist, which is obtained by sequentially adding one or more branched chain imidazole group-containing diamine monomers, one or more other imidazole group-free diamine monomers, dianhydride monomers and an organic solvent into a dry three-necked bottle under the protection of nitrogen, stirring at room temperature, and reacting for 2-12 hours.

title_en: Preparation method of composite thermoelectric material based on metal organic framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite thermoelectric material based on a metal organic framework, which comprises the following steps: a. adding PEDOT PSS aqueous solution to Cu (NO)  3  )  2  Fully and uniformly stirring, fully mixing with ethanolamine/ethanol/NaOH solution and standing; b. b, carrying out vacuum filtration on the solution obtained in the step a, and washing with deionized water; c. and c, carrying out vacuum drying on the product obtained in the step b and filter paper to obtain PEDOT (PSS @ Cu (OH))  2  Compounding a film; d. c, soaking the composite film obtained in the step c in H  3  Ethanol-water solution of BTC, and washing; e. and d, drying the product obtained in the step d in vacuum again to obtain PEDOT (PSS) @ Cu  3  (BTC)  2  Compounding a thermoelectric film; f. soaking the composite thermoelectric film obtained in step e in dimethyl sulfoxide/N-methylpyrrolidone/98%  2  SO  4  After-treatment in the solution and washing.

title_en: Method for preparing expandable microspheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of expandable microspheres, which comprises the following steps: step S10, adding sodium chloride, a dispersant and ethanol into water to form a water phase; step S20, adding a monomer, methyl acrylate, a foaming agent and a cross-linking agent into the water phase, and performing ultrasonic treatment to uniformly disperse the monomers to obtain an emulsion; step S30, adding an initiator into the emulsion, heating to 35-50 ℃, reacting until microspheres are formed, heating to 50-60 ℃, and continuing to react to obtain a mixed solution containing the microspheres; step S40, separating expandable microspheres from the mixed solution; wherein the initiator comprises a water-soluble reducing agent and an oil-soluble oxidizing agent. The invention aims to solve the problem of poor thermal stability of the product in the existing preparation method.

title_en: Wear-resistant anti-fatigue synthetic rubber material
abstract_en: A wear-resistant and fatigue-resistant synthetic rubber material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 35-45.5% of natural rubber, 19-30% of styrene-butadiene rubber, 2-4.5% of zinc oxide, 1-4% of stearic acid, 2-3% of paraffin, 1-2% of sulfur, 0.8-1.2% of accelerator CZ, 26-33% of carbon black and 2.2-4.3% of anti-aging agent. Compared with the material of the rubber sealing ring on the existing cement mill, the synthetic rubber material of the invention has obviously improved fatigue resistance and wear resistance, and has better high temperature resistance.

title_en: Polycarbonate composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polycarbonate composition, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 87-97 parts of polycarbonate resin; 1-10 parts of inorganic filler; 0.1-1 part of flame retardant; 0.1-2 parts of stabilizer; 0.01-0.3 part of aluminum triacetylacetonate; the stabilizer is selected from any one or more of polyethylene wax, oxidized polyethylene wax, maleic anhydride modified polyethylene wax or acrylic acid modified polyethylene wax. According to the invention, through the synergistic effect of the stabilizer and the aluminum triacetylacetone, the problem that the shock resistance and the wet heat aging resistance of the polycarbonate material are deteriorated when the inorganic filler or the flame retardant is added in the prior art is solved, the prepared polycarbonate composition has excellent flame resistance, good shock resistance and good wet heat aging resistance, and the injection molding product has no appearance defect, so that the use requirement of the thin-wall flame-retardant polycarbonate material under the development trend of the current electronic and electric field can be met.

title_en: Flame-retardant high-strength wood-plastic profile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flame-retardant high-strength wood-plastic profile and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of wood-plastic profiles, and solves the problem that the existing wood-plastic profile does not have a production date recording structure; be applied to the wood-plastic section bar of guardrail, when the installation problem appears, generally warn through the warning sign, but warning sign warning range is only limited to a segment on every side, and the problem that the warning mode is not convenient. The flame-retardant high-strength wood-plastic profile comprises a wood-plastic profile main body, wherein a date separating groove penetrating through the rear end face of the wood-plastic profile main body is formed in the middle of the front end face of the wood-plastic profile main body. Through the date separating groove, the date numerical value identification groove A and the date numerical value identification groove B, the record of the date of the production year and the month of the wood-plastic section main body is realized, and a purchasing user can know the production date of the wood-plastic section main body by watching so as to ensure that the purchased wood-plastic section main body is in the quality guarantee time limit.

title_en: Preparation method and application of two-dimensional MXene/polydopamine composite desalting electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a two-dimensional MXene/polydopamine composite desalting electrode material, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: (1) self-assembly of block polymers: the invention adopts polyethylene oxide-block-polypropylene oxide-block-polyethylene oxide (PEO) 20 ‑b‑PPO 70 ‑b‑PEO 20 The triblock polymer is self-assembled in the solution to form a columnar micelle as a mesoporous soft template; (2) preparing cylindrical mesoporous MXene/polydopamine two-dimensional composite nanosheet mPDA/MXene. The invention also provides application of the two-dimensional MXene/polydopamine composite desalting electrode material in a CDI battery. According to the invention, P123 is used as a soft template, and mesoporous channels are introduced to the two sides of MXene, so that the material has a larger internal active specific surface area and an ion transmission channel, is expected to improve the electrochemical performance, and has an application prospect of capacitive deionization.

title_en: Preparation method of cellulose nanocrystalline synergic induction optical limiting film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cellulose nanocrystalline synergic induction optical limiting film, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, synthesizing an MXene water dispersion solution; step 2, preparing cellulose nanocrystals; and step 3, preparing the MXene cellulose nanocrystalline optical limiting film according to the results obtained in the step 1 and the step 2. The invention provides a method for preparing an MXene material, which is used for preparing a novel solid film material by compounding the MXene material and Cellulose Nanocrystalline (CNC) with nonlinear scattering.

title_en: PVC (polyvinyl chloride) mixture for producing polyvinyl chloride foamed wood plastic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PVC mixture for producing polyvinyl chloride foamed wood plastic, which comprises the following components: PVC resin powder; the fiber filler consists of fast-growing wood powder, rice husk powder and waste fabrics; the temperature-resistant filler is formed by mixing sepiolite powder and brucite powder; shell powder; titanium dioxide; a foaming agent; a foaming modifier; a lubricant; a stabilizer. The PVC mixture for producing the polyvinyl chloride foamed wood plastic reduces the proportion of fast-growing wood powder in the limiting filler, uses the rice husk powder and the waste fabric for substitution, improves the resource utilization rate, reduces the economic cost, promotes the product quality, utilizes the environment-friendly additive to replace the traditional chemical additive, and has great significance for protecting the ecological environment.

title_en: Cast nylon 6 composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casting nylon 6 composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the casting nylon 6 composite material is prepared from 100 parts of caprolactam, 50-100 parts of pretreated acrylic felt, 1-5 parts of catalyst, 1-5 parts of activator, 1-2 parts of talcum powder and 1-2 parts of antioxidant according to parts by weight, wherein the pretreated acrylic felt is the acrylic felt subjected to infiltration treatment by KH550 aqueous solution. The cast nylon 6 composite material has excellent sound insulation performance.

title_en: Composite fabric for breathable protective clothing and breathable protective clothing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clothing fabrics, in particular to a composite fabric for breathable protective clothing and the breathable protective clothing, which comprise a breathable bottom layer, a first adhesive layer, a carbon bead layer, a second adhesive layer, a base cloth layer and a surface layer which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, wherein the surface layer is formed by coating waterproof flame-retardant materials, and the carbon bead layer is prepared by adopting composite carbon beads. The composite fabric disclosed by the invention is simple and novel in structure, the arranged surface layer has good waterproof and flame retardant properties, the carbon bead layer arranged in the middle has good antibacterial, mildew-proof, gas-proof and sweat-absorbing effects, sweat penetrating through the breathable bottom layer can be absorbed by the carbon bead layer, and the comfort of protective clothing manufactured by the composite fabric is improved; the performances of the combined surface layer, the carbon bead layer and the breathable bottom further improve the breathable, flame-retardant and waterproof performances of the composite fabric, and the composite fabric has the advantages of light weight, washability, stable performance and improved safety.

title_en: Dispersant polymers for automatic dishwashing
abstract_en: An automatic dishwashing composition is provided comprising a builder; a phosphonate; a nonionic surfactant; and a dispersant polymer comprising: (a) 50 to 95wt%, by weight of the dispersant polymer, structural units of monoethylenically unsaturated monocarboxylic acid monomer; and (b) from 5 to 50wt%, by weight of the dispersant polymer, of structural units of a sulfate-bearing ethylenically unsaturated monomer.

title_en: Separation and purification method of glycosaminoglycan and preparation method of sulfated oligosaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separation and purification method of glycosaminoglycan, which adopts a step-by-step elution method, samples are loaded on a high-efficiency ion exchange material after a sample is dissolved in water, and water, a low-concentration sodium chloride solution and a high-concentration sodium chloride solution are respectively used for sequential elution, and the method has the characteristics of less sample consumption, short analysis time and simple operation. The invention also provides a preparation method of the sulfated oligosaccharide, which takes hydrogen peroxide as a reactant and ascorbic acid as a catalyst to carry out reaction and degrade sulfated polysaccharide at a certain temperature to generate oligosaccharide, and has the characteristics of trace quantity, high efficiency, easily controlled conditions and no pollution.

title_en: Method for recovering carbon fibers
abstract_en: An object of the present embodiment is to provide a method for recovering carbon fibers, which can effectively obtain continuous carbon fibers suitable for reuse. The present embodiment is a method for recovering carbon fibers, including: a step of preparing a carbon fiber-reinforced resin molded article having a carbon fiber-reinforced resin containing carbon fibers and a resin; a step of thermally decomposing or dissolving the resin in the carbon fiber-reinforced resin molded product by a first heat treatment or a first dissolution treatment; and a step of extracting the carbon fibers from the carbon fiber-reinforced resin molded article after the first heat treatment or the first dissolution treatment and winding the extracted carbon fibers, wherein the winding step further includes a step of thermally decomposing or dissolving resin residues adhering to the carbon fibers by the second heat treatment or the second dissolution treatment, and a step of applying a sizing agent to the carbon fibers after the second heat treatment or the second dissolution treatment.

title_en: Quick-crystallization, low-emission and high-toughness PET material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PET material with rapid crystallization, low emission and high toughness and a preparation method thereof. The PET material comprises, by weight, 100 parts of PET,100 parts of PA,50 parts of PBAT,10-30 parts of a cyclic polyolefin polymer, 2-5 parts of an antioxidant, 5-10 parts of a compatilizer, 2-5 parts of a chain extender and 1-10 parts of a crosslinking agent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing PET, PA, PBAT, a compatilizer and a chain extender in a high-speed mixer, adding the mixture into a first section cylinder of a double-screw extruder, adding an antioxidant, a cross-linking agent and a cyclic polyolefin polymer from a5 th section side feeding port after the mixture is completed, simultaneously introducing inert gas into the extruder from the first section of the extruder for extrusion granulation, setting the temperature of the extruder at 265 ℃, setting the temperature of the extruder at 165 ℃ at 5-8 sections, setting the temperature of the extruder at 265 ℃ at the ninth section, and controlling the rotating speed at 500-600r/min. The PET material prepared by the invention has the characteristics of excellent comprehensive mechanical property, high toughness, high crystallization speed, short molding cycle, low odor and certain degradability.

title_en: Porous aerogel bracket and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous aerogel support and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a photoinitiator and polyethylene glycol diacrylate are added into a buffer solution, heated and dissolved, uniformly mixed, and then pluronic F127 is added into the mixed solution, and the mixture is kept stand at a low temperature to obtain the aerogel support material; printing the hydrogel bracket by adopting a 3D printing technology, irradiating with ultraviolet light to crosslink the hydrogel bracket to form a three-dimensional bracket with stable structure, soaking at low temperature to remove pluronic F127, and freeze-drying to obtain the three-dimensional bracket. After 3D printing of the hydrogel bracket is completed, the pluronic F127 is removed, and a porous structure can be formed in the bracket by combining a freeze drying technology, so that survival, growth and proliferation of cells in three-dimensional culture are facilitated.

title_en: Special wood-plastic material for cat litter box and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plastic modification, and particularly relates to a special wood-plastic material for a cat litter box and a preparation method thereof. The invention takes polypropylene as matrix resin, reed fiber and peanut shell fiber as filling materials, and specifically comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-60 parts of reed fibers, 10-30 parts of peanut shell fibers, 20-50 parts of polypropylene, 2-5 parts of a coupling agent, 2-3 parts of a lubricant, 0.2-0.5 part of a light stabilizer and 1-2 parts of a flame retardant. The lubricant is mainly one or two of PE wax, zinc stearate, calcium stearate and the like which are compounded, the coupling agent is maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene, and the flame retardant is ammonium polyphosphate. The method is characterized in that various matrix raw materials and processing aids are subjected to melt blending and extrusion to obtain a composite granular material, and a device prepared from the special wood-plastic material for the cat litter basin has the advantages of good mechanical property, environmental protection, water resistance and the like, is harmless to pets and human bodies, and completely meets the use requirements of the cat litter basin.

title_en: Wear-resistant hydrophobic low-rolling-resistance conveyor belt cover rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A wear-resistant hydrophobic low-rolling-resistance conveyor belt cover rubber and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of conveyor belts. The raw materials for preparing the conveyor belt cover rubber provided by the invention comprise natural rubber CV-60, styrene-butadiene rubber 1500, carbon black N110, zinc oxide, stearic acid, accelerator CZ, sulfur, an anti-aging agent RD, an anti-aging agent 4020, aromatic hydrocarbon oil V500 and oxidized multi-layer fullerene. The conveyor belt cover rubber provided by the invention can meet the requirements of wear resistance, low rolling resistance and hydrophobic performance.

title_en: Photonic crystal material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photonic crystal material, wherein the structure of the photonic crystal material comprises an inner layer and a surface layer positioned on one surface of the inner layer; wherein, the inner layer comprises a micro-nano hole array which is arranged periodically and a filling material which is filled among all holes; the surface layer includes irregular pores and a filler material filled between the pores. The structural color of the photonic crystal material can be reversibly changed under the illumination condition. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the photonic crystal material.

title_en: Optical-grade oleophilic type thermal repair resin, preparation method thereof and self-repair coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical grade oleophilic type thermal repair resin, a preparation method thereof and a self-repair coating, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) polyether polyol and aliphatic isocyanate are adopted to react to generate isocyanate end-capped polyurethane prepolymer; (2) adding caprolactone grafted hydroxy acrylate to react with the polyurethane prepolymer in the step (1) to prepare an intermediate; (3) adding polyhydroxy polyacrylate, bifunctional acrylate and acrylate phosphate, and performing polymerization reaction under the action of an initiator to obtain the thermal repair resin. The thermal repair resin is used as the main resin of the thermal repair coating, and a coating after the resin curing reaction can be self-repaired under a heated condition; the resin has strong stain resistance, compact coating surface, lipophilicity, water contact angle within 80 degrees, strong stain resistance and permeability, and can be well applied to invisible car clothing films and car body color changing films.

title_en: Composite modified starch-based environment-friendly material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite modified starch-based environment-friendly material which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of porous short-chain starch, 60-80 parts of polylactic acid (PLA) or polybutylene succinate (PBS) or polybutylene adipate/terephthalate (PBAT), 1-2 parts of a heat stabilizer and 1-3 parts of a dispersing agent. The porous short-chain starch prepared by the invention has good mechanical property and antibacterial effect, and can be used in the field of degradable handbag and degradable garbage bag. Meanwhile, the environment-friendly material has excellent degradation performance, can not generate a large amount of absorbable particles even if the waste incineration treatment is adopted, is green and environment-friendly, and is beneficial to the sustainable development strategy.

title_en: Conductive thermoplastic elastomer composition, electrode member, and switch
abstract_en: Disclosed are a conductive thermoplastic elastomer composition, an electrode member, and a switch, wherein the conductive thermoplastic elastomer composition is characterized by containing a styrene-based thermoplastic elastomer, a conductivity-imparting agent, and a plasticizer, and the conductivity-imparting agent contains carbon nanotubes.

title_en: Single-component epoxy dispersion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of epoxy dispersoid, and discloses a single-component epoxy dispersoid which comprises, by weight, 80-600 parts of epoxy resin, 0-80 parts of bisphenol A, 0-25 parts of polyether glycol, 0.5-3 parts of a catalyst, 5-70 parts of monoethanolamine, 10-120 parts of polyether monoamine, 20-100 parts of a diluent, 2-10 parts of acrylic acid and 3-12 parts of an amine neutralizer; its preparing process is also disclosed. The single-component epoxy dispersion prepared by the method has excellent metal adhesion and rust resistance and good water resistance, and can be dried in air or dried.

title_en: Novel polycondensation pre-polyesters, other copolyester precursors and copolyesters prepared therefrom
abstract_en: The invention relates toAnd at least one copolyester comprising repeating units of the structure: wherein R and R '' represent the residue of at least one diol; and wherein R and R '' are not the same; wherein R' comprises the residue of at least one diacid or diester, and wherein n Represents the number of repeating units; and/or copolyester precursors thereof, and methods of manufacture.

title_en: Modified fluorosilicone acrylate resin, antifouling and antibacterial coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified fluorosilicone acrylate resin and an antifouling and antibacterial coating. The antibacterial modified fluorosilicone acrylic resin is obtained through acrylate monomer free radical polymerization reaction and modified grafting reaction. And uniformly mixing the modified fluorosilicone acrylate resin, the silane coated nano silver particles, the dispersing agent, the leveling agent, the coupling agent and the filler in a solvent to obtain the coating with the antifouling and antibacterial functions. The antifouling and antibacterial coating has excellent adhesive force, wear resistance, hydrophobicity, antibacterial property and disease resistance on the surfaces of plastic and glass substrates, and has important value in the aspects of mobile phones, computers, household appliances, glass buildings or products and the like. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the modified fluorosilicone acrylate resin and the antifouling and antibacterial paint.

title_en: Super-macroporous fluorine-containing super-strong acid catalytic resin and synthetic method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a super-macroporous fluorine-containing super-strong acid catalytic resin with a three-dimensional cross-linked structure, which has super-strong acidity of difluoromethylsulfonic acid; the catalyst has a stable three-dimensional cross-linked structure, can resist swelling of a high-temperature organic solvent for a long time, has a very stable super-macroporous structure, maintains the long-term stable super-strong acid catalytic capacity, and has the great advantages of high efficiency, cleanness, long-term repeated use and low cost in organic synthesis reactions such as esterification, etherification, epoxy ring opening, acid catalytic rearrangement and the like.

title_en: Dry starch applied to field of biodegradable plastics
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel dry starch which can be used for preparing biodegradable plastics, and is characterized in that the dry starch is prepared by removing water from commercial starch, the water content of the dry starch is below 5%, and the internal organization structure of starch granules is mainly in an amorphous state. The dry starch is a novel application material, the starch-based plastic product prepared from the dry starch is different from the technical route of the existing starch-based plastic product, and the product has good mechanical property and low cost.

title_en: Method of forming polyarylene sulfide
abstract_en: A method for forming polyarylene sulfides with relatively low levels of volatile malodorous compounds is provided. More specifically, such low compound levels can be achieved by selectively controlling the post-polyarylene sulfide formation washing.

title_en: Method for preparing functional grape seed nano-sphere particles by utilizing grape seeds and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing functional grape seed nanosphere particles by utilizing grape seeds, which comprises the steps of crushing the grape seeds in residues after wine making, extracting grape seed oil with petroleum ether-ultrasonic assistance through process optimization, extracting procyanidine in the grape seeds with ethanol, dissolving grape seed lignin in tetrahydrofuran aqueous solution (the temperature is about 25 ℃ at normal temperature without heating), carrying out rotary evaporation precipitation, and washing to prepare the grape seed nanosphere particles with excellent appearance and high additional value. The method disclosed by the invention is simple to operate and low in cost, the application value of the grape seed residues is effectively improved, the full-component utilization of the grape seed residues is realized, the prepared nanosphere particles have higher ultraviolet absorption capacity and certain redox capacity, and the nanosphere particles can be used as efficient natural raw materials and have huge application prospects in the preparation of ultraviolet-resistant coatings or protective articles, cosmetics and drug carriers.

title_en: Graft modified concrete polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building chemical materials, in particular to a graft modified concrete polycarboxylic acid slump retaining agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent comprises a compound group containing propenyl and carboxyl which is modified by chitosan grafting; in the preparation method, the compound A containing propenyl and carboxyl is grafted and modified through chitosan and then polymerized, so that the grafting rate is improved, the concrete has a long-acting slump retaining effect, the further requirement on slump retaining performance on building materials is met, and the method has important practical application value.

title_en: High strength glass fiber rib
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength glass fiber umbrella rib, which has the technical scheme that: the umbrella comprises a middle rod, wherein an upper nest is arranged at the top end of the middle rod, a plurality of first hinge seats are arranged on the circumferential surface of the upper nest, a plurality of first hinge seats are hinged to first umbrella ribs, third hinge seats are arranged on the first umbrella ribs, a lower nest is sleeved on the middle rod, a plurality of second hinge seats are arranged on the lower nest, first supporting rods are hinged to the second hinge seats and the third hinge seats, the tail end of each first umbrella rib is hinged to a first mounting seat, and a second supporting rod is hinged between each first mounting seat and each first supporting rod; through first rib, second rib and coccyx all have better tensile strength height, elongation is little, elasticity correlation coefficient is high and rigidity preferred, adopt inorganic fiber to have the advantage that nonflammable, chemical resistance is good and the heat resistance is good, improve umbrella compressive capacity.

title_en: Polymer composition containing semi-crystalline polymer and method of making
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polymer composition containing a thermoplastic molding compound A, at least one reinforcing fiber B and at least one inorganic filler material C, said polymer composition having excellent aesthetic qualities after thermoplastic processing. The invention also relates to a method for producing the claimed composition and to the use thereof.

title_en: Plasticizer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plasticizer and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method of the plasticizer comprises the following steps: respectively reacting a reaction mixture in a plurality of temperature maintaining stages of a temperature raising program to form a semi-finished product; and purifying the semi-finished product respectively at a plurality of low-pressure stages of a decompression procedure to obtain the plasticizer. Wherein the temperature of the temperature raising program ranges from 140 ℃ to 220 ℃, the pressure of the pressure reducing program ranges from 750 torr to 20 torr, and the reaction mixture comprises dibasic acid, dihydric alcohol, monohydric alcohol and catalyst.

title_en: Block copolymer, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a block copolymer, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials. The structural formula of the block copolymer is shown as the following formula: wherein n is 100-500. The block copolymer has good hydrophilicity and faster degradation speed, and can improve the bone healing speed.

title_en: Biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film and package using same
abstract_en: Provided is a biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film having rigidity and excellent in both fusion sealability and heat sealability.
