A biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film comprising a base layer (A) comprising a polypropylene resin composition and surface layers (B) located on both sides of the base layer (A) and comprising a polypropylene resin composition, wherein the biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film satisfies the following conditions a) to d). a) The polypropylene resin composition constituting the base layer (A) has a meso pentad fraction of 95.0% to 99.5% inclusive. b) The ratio of the component derived from the α -olefin monomer to the total of the component derived from the propylene monomer and the component derived from the α -olefin monomer in the polypropylene resin composition constituting the base layer (a) is 0.2 mol% or less. c) The ratio of the component derived from a 1-butene monomer to the total of the component derived from a propylene monomer and the component derived from an α -olefin monomer in the polypropylene resin composition constituting the surface layer (B) is 5 mol% or more and 10 mol% or less. d) The thickness of the biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film is 60 [ mu ] m or less, and the ratio of the thickness of the surface layer (B) to the thickness of all layers of the biaxially oriented polypropylene resin film is 3% or more and 10% or less.

title_en: Preparation method of novel penetration-resistant radiation door panel interlayer and slurry liquid used in preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slurry liquid for preventing penetration of a radiation door panel interlayer, which is prepared by mixing 50-70% of lead ore powder, 10-25% of graphite powder, 10-20% of chopped glass fiber, 5-10% of modified binder and 0.5-1% of sulfonic acid compound in percentage by mass. The density of the novel penetration-proof radiation-proof interlayer is far less than that of a lead plate interlayer used by the traditional radiation-proof door, so that the overall weight of the explosion-proof door using the interlayer can be reduced; the novel penetration radiation-proof door plate interlayer is convenient and fast to use, can be overlapped for use according to the radiation-proof grade requirement of the explosion-proof door, and has excellent penetration radiation-proof capacity; the interlayer has higher strength, can absorb part of the energy of shock waves in the using process, reduces the overall impact on the explosion-proof door and improves the anti-explosion capability of the explosion-proof door.

title_en: Preparation method of wet-pressure magnetic shoe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a wet-pressure magnetic tile, which comprises the following specific preparation processes: adding the raw materials into a ball mill for ball milling, filtering and drying, firing the dried materials in a muffle furnace, cooling to room temperature, crushing the obtained primary sintered material, passing through a sieve, adding the crushed material into the ball mill, adding a composite additive into the ball mill, carrying out secondary ball milling, filtering the obtained secondary slurry, carrying out wet pressing and molding, and sintering in the muffle furnace to obtain the magnetic shoe. The modified dispersant branched polyacrylic acid ammonium chloride used in the preparation process of the magnetic tile is of a hyperbranched structure, so that the uniform dispersion performance between the dispersant and an inorganic material can be improved, the fineness of the particle size of slurry in the ball milling process is further improved, when the particle size of slurry particles is smaller, the specific surface area is increased, the stored surface energy is improved, the activity is enhanced in the sintering process, the internal gaps are fewer, and the axial shrinkage rate of ferrite is further increased.

title_en: Brominated flame-retardant PBT (polybutylene terephthalate) material as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brominated flame-retardant PBT material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The brominated flame-retardant PBT material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 55-60 parts of PBT resin; 8-12 parts of a brominated flame retardant; 3-5 parts of antimony trioxide; 25-35 parts of glass fiber; 0.3-1 part of lithium stearate. According to the invention, lithium stearate is added into the glass fiber reinforced brominated flame-retardant PBT resin system, so that the melt fluidity of the material (the melt index is up to more than 30g/10min at the temperature of 2.16kg/250 ℃) can be remarkably improved, the material can still keep excellent mechanical properties after injection molding processing, and the application of the brominated flame-retardant PBT material in the field of electronics and electricity is further widened.

title_en: Low-VOC (volatile organic compound) water-based two-component epoxy zinc-rich coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low VOC aqueous bi-component epoxy zinc-rich coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the low VOC aqueous bi-component epoxy zinc-rich coating comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 1-20: 1, a component A and a component B; the component A comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10.5-20 parts of low-viscosity modified waterborne epoxy resin, 65-85 parts of zinc powder, 0-20 parts of filler, 0.5-2 parts of cosolvent, 0.5-1.5 parts of dispersant and 0.3-1 part of anti-settling agent; the component B comprises the following components in parts by weight: 35-50 parts of water-based epoxy curing agent, 50-65 parts of deionized water and 0.5-1 part of flash rust inhibitor. Compared with the prior art, the primer disclosed by the invention is low in VOC content, the paint film is quick to dry, good in toughness, good in early water resistance and excellent in corrosion resistance, and in addition, the preparation method of the water-based epoxy zinc-rich primer disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, and can reduce the preparation cost and improve the corrosion resistance.

title_en: Low-molecular-weight acetylated hyaluronate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low molecular weight acetylated hyaluronate and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biochemical engineering. Wherein the acetyl substitution degree is 1.9-4.0, the intrinsic viscosity is 0.02-0.11dl/g, and the hyaluronic acid is prepared from low molecular weight hyaluronic acid or salt thereof with the average molecular weight of 800-4500Da, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding low molecular weight hyaluronic acid or salt thereof into a mixed solution of acetic acid and acetic anhydride under the protection of inert gas, and adding a concentrated sulfuric acid catalyst for acylation reaction; after the reaction is finished, adding the reaction solution into an ether solvent for crystallization, filtering and washing; collecting solid, dispersing in water, adjusting pH with alkali solution, and drying. The invention takes low molecular weight hyaluronate as raw material, the acetylation degree is moderate, and the obtained acetylated hyaluronate has more remarkable moisture retention, lipophilic lipophilicity and skin-friendly property and is widely applied to the cosmetic fields of emulsion, essence, lipstick and the like.

title_en: Humidity-sensitive color-changing material based on photonic crystal and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a humidity-sensitive color-changing material based on photonic crystals, and a preparation method and application thereof. The humidity-sensitive color-changing material comprises polyurethane hydrogel and nano microspheres which are arranged in a three-dimensional ordered stacking way in the polyurethane hydrogel; the polyurethane hydrogel is prepared from the following raw materials: aliphatic or cycloaliphatic isocyanates, hydrophilic polyethylene glycols, chain extenders and hydroxyethyl (meth) acrylate. According to the invention, the nano microsphere and the polyurethane hydrogel are mixed, and then the photonic crystal with three-dimensional ordered stacking arrangement is directly obtained through a specific structure regulating process. The humidity sensitive color-changing material with obvious humidity response color-changing characteristic and excellent mechanical property is obtained by utilizing the adsorption effect of polyurethane hydrogel on moisture and the amplification effect of Bragg diffraction generated by a photonic crystal structure on color.

title_en: Basic anion exchange membrane based on polyepichlorohydrin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alkaline anion exchange membrane based on polyepichlorohydrin and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the steps of dissolving proper amounts of polyepichlorohydrin, hydroxyl-terminated polyphenyl ether and sodium hydroxide in N, N-dimethylacetamide, and reacting at 60-80 ℃ for 12-24h under inert atmosphere; adding distilled water after the reaction to obtain a precipitate, washing and drying to obtain brown yellow powder PECH-g-PPO; dissolving the obtained PECH-g-PPO in an organic solvent, adding a proper amount of quaternizing agent, and reacting for 1-2 days at room temperature; adding distilled water after the reaction to obtain a precipitate, washing and drying to obtain brown yellow powder QAPECH-g-PPO; dissolving the QAPECH-g-PPO in N, N-dimethylacetamide, tiling, and drying at 60-80 ℃ for 12-24 hours to obtain a brown transparent film; the brown transparent film is soaked in 1-3mol/L KOH solution to obtain Cl  ‑  Replacement by OH  ‑  Obtaining the alkaline anion exchange membrane.

title_en: Method for improving reflectivity of simulated plant in infrared region, simulated plant, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the reflectivity of a simulated plant in an infrared light area, a high-reflectivity simulated plant, a preparation method and application; the main technology is that the simulated plant contains high infrared reflection pigment, and the weight proportion of the high infrared reflection pigment in the simulated plant is 1-5 wt%. The invention improves the reflection of the simulation plant to the energy of the visible light area and the infrared light area of the sunlight, ensures that the surface temperature of the simulation plant is 8-20 ℃, and simultaneously meets the increasingly developing requirements of the market.

title_en: Multifunctional HDPE multilayer composite corrugated pipe and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plastic pipes and preparation methods thereof, and particularly relates to a multifunctional HDPE multilayer composite corrugated pipe and a preparation method thereof. The multifunctional HDPE multilayer composite corrugated pipe prepared by the three-layer co-extrusion method has excellent ultraviolet resistance and impact resistance; meanwhile, the preparation method is simple to operate, a functional layer is extruded on the surface of the outer layer of the corrugated pipe in a 3-layer co-extrusion mode, and functional materials are only added into the functional layer accounting for 10% -25% of the thickness of the outer layer, so that the production cost is greatly reduced, and the preparation method is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Low-density porous all-plastic spraying polyurethane runway slurry and preparation and use methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-density porous full-plastic spraying polyurethane runway slurry and a preparation and use method thereof, and is characterized in that the slurry comprises the following components: 10-60 parts of polyether polyol; 1-5 parts of vegetable oil polyalcohol; 10-40 parts of isocyanate; b, component B: 10-20 parts of polyether polyol; 20-50 parts of inorganic filler; 0.5-2 parts of pigment; 10-30 parts of a plasticizer; 1-3 parts of a crosslinking agent; 1-5 parts of a chain extender; 0.5-2 parts of an oily dispersant; 0.3-1 part of foam stabilizer; 0.2-1 part of a catalyst; and the auxiliary material component C comprises: 10-20 parts of a foaming agent; 30-60 parts of glass beads. The three components are respectively prepared, and when the paint is used, the paint is poured into a spraying machine and sprayed onto a base material to be paved within 5-10 min after being uniformly mixed according to the weight ratio of 25 to 100. The slurry spraying construction is safe and environment-friendly, and has the advantages of smooth foaming, uniform pores, quick curing and forming and excellent physical properties.

title_en: Method for realizing controllable free radical polymerization in air atmosphere and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer synthesis, in particular to a method for realizing controllable free radical polymerization in an air atmosphere and application thereof. In the invention, under the condition of complete exposure to air, the alkyl boron amine complex breaks down the B-N coordination bond to release the alkyl boron compound, and the alkyl boron compound is subjected to autoxidation to generate alkyl free radical to initiate polymerization reaction. The alkyl boron amine complex is used as an initiator in reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer (RAFT) polymerization to realize controlled radical polymerization in an air atmosphere. The method for realizing the controllable free radical polymerization in the air atmosphere has the advantages of high polymerization efficiency, short polymerization reaction time, no obvious polymerization induction period, wide reaction temperature application range, simple reaction conditions and equipment requirements, no need of an oxygen removal link and suitability for industrial production.

title_en: Biodegradable functional environment-friendly glove and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biodegradable functional environment-friendly glove and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glove comprises a glove blank, the glove blank is made of one or more of polylactic acid fiber, protein fiber, alginate fiber and chitin fiber according to any proportion, the surface of the glove blank is impregnated with a gum dipping layer which is prepared by using polyurea gum as a raw material and is subjected to copolymerization treatment by a carboxylic acid type biodegradation agent, and the polyurea gum is added with a biodegradable material which is prepared by mixing any one or more of polylactic acid powder, amylase and alginate powder according to any proportion. The gloves prepared by the invention have good degradation effect and high degradation efficiency, and can be completely degraded in a short time.

title_en: PVC high-transparency antibacterial hard product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of PVC plastics, and particularly relates to a PVC high-transparency antibacterial hard product and a preparation method thereof. The material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of PVC resin, 1.5-2.5 parts of antibacterial heat stabilizer, 6-10 parts of processing impact modifier and 1.5-2.5 parts of lubricant; wherein: the antibacterial heat stabilizer is a bisuracil antibacterial heat stabilizer; the processing impact modifier is a core-shell copolymer and butyl acrylate grafted impact modifier with processability. According to the invention, the combination of the double uracil antibacterial heat stabilizer, the core-shell copolymer with processability and the butyl acrylate grafted impact modifier not only realizes antibacterial performance, ageing resistance and impact resistance, but also effectively improves the transparency of PVC products; the mixing process is simple, the mixing efficiency can be effectively improved by more than 30%, and the production efficiency and the product quality stability are further improved.

title_en: Preparation method of polyborosiloxane modified epoxy resin composite adhesive and composite adhesive
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite adhesive preparation methods, and provides a preparation method of polyborosiloxane modified epoxy resin composite adhesive and the composite adhesive, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: a polyborosiloxane preparation step of obtaining polyborosiloxane by obtaining and processing a plurality of mixtures, and a polyborosiloxane and epoxy resin composite adhesive preparation step of processing the polyborosiloxane and epoxy resin to obtain a polyborosiloxane modified epoxy resin composite adhesive; according to the invention, through the preparation steps of polyborosiloxane and the epoxy resin composite adhesive, the preparation process is simplified, and the prepared polyborosiloxane modified epoxy resin composite adhesive has excellent flexible protection effect; the acceleration response of the structure under high-speed impact is obviously reduced, and an obvious inhibiting effect on interference signals under high frequency is achieved. Meanwhile, the dynamic thermomechanical property and the shock resistance and vibration suppression property are both obviously enhanced.

title_en: High-melt-strength linear low-density polyethylene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses linear low-density polyethylene with high melt strength and a preparation method thereof, wherein paraffin such as polyethylene wax or oxidized polyethylene wax with the molecular weight of about 1000-5000 and the like and derivatives thereof are used as a grafting monomer of a long-chain branch to ensure that the linear low-density polyethylene is grafted to generate the long-chain branch linear low-density polyethylene; the alkane with the molecular weight of 100-300 is used as a grafting monomer with a shorter branch chain, so that macromolecular free radicals generated by a peroxide initiator are combined with the grafting monomer, and the crosslinking degree of the linear low-density polyethylene is reduced; the polar olefin monomer is grafted with linear low density polyethylene, so that the crosslinking of polyethylene is reduced, and the surface polarity of the polyethylene material is increased. The linear low-density polyethylene with high melt strength prepared by the invention has LLDPE with long chain branch and short chain branch, improves the melt strength of LLDPE, improves the processing property of LLDPE and widens the application of LLDPE in the aspects of films and foamed plastics.

title_en: Method for pretreating wood fiber biomass and separating lignin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for pretreating and separating lignin from wood fiber biomass, which comprises the following steps: (1) respectively adding a pretreatment solvent, the lignocellulosic biomass, a catalyst-1, polycarboxylic acid and a catalyst-2 into a reactor, uniformly stirring, treating for 1-24 hours at the conditions of normal pressure and 80-120 ℃, wherein the weight ratio of the lignocellulosic biomass to the pretreatment solvent is 1: 10-30; (2) carrying out solid-liquid separation; (3) washing and drying the obtained solid to obtain rich cellulose; (4) diluting the obtained liquid with water, performing solid-liquid separation, cleaning, and drying to obtain lignin. The invention realizes the high-efficiency pretreatment of the wood fiber biomass and separates out lignin with low polycondensation degree; the loss of carbohydrates such as cellulose and hemicellulose is small, the recovery rate is high, and the enzyme saccharification yield is high; the pretreatment solvent, the catalyst and the like can be recycled, the process is simple, the production cost is low, and the method has a very strong industrial application prospect.

title_en: Modified polypropylene film material for capacitor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified polypropylene film material for a capacitor, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60-90 parts of modified polypropylene, 5-10 parts of modified barium titanate, 30-50 parts of polyvinylidene fluoride, 0.5-2 parts of benzophenone, 3-5 parts of a cross-linking agent, 5-10 parts of a compatilizer and 0.5-1.5 parts of an antioxidant. The film prepared by the invention takes polypropylene as a base material, has low dielectric loss, is added with the modified inorganic ceramic material, has high dielectric property, good mechanical property and processing property, simple and easy preparation method, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Ablation-resistant composite material and preparation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ablation-resistant materials, and discloses an ablation-resistant composite material, and a preparation process and application thereof. In the process, basalt fibers are used as a reinforcing phase, the mechanical property of an ablation-resistant matrix is improved, and the basalt fiber composite ablation-resistant material is prepared. The basalt fiber has the characteristic of low density and excellent mechanical property, and can effectively solve the problems of high brittleness, high strain rate deformation of a shell case or an ammunition barrel and other thin-wall aluminum alloy closing-in barrels during working, easy cracking and falling of a coating and the like. The density of the anti-ablation composite material prepared by taking basalt as a raw material is far lower than that of copper, steel and aluminum alloy, the anti-ablation lining prepared by the method can reduce the weight of the cartridge, the weight of the cartridge is reduced by 20%, the bomb carrying capacity is improved, the product stability is good, the service life is long, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale production.

title_en: Formaldehyde-free low-molecular-weight amino resin modifier and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resin modifiers, and discloses a formaldehyde-free low-molecular-weight amino resin modifier and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the formaldehyde-free low-molecular-weight amino resin modifier comprises 15-20% of melamine-urea-glyoxal resin, 2-10% of acrylate microemulsion and the balance of distilled water in percentage by mass; the acrylic ester microemulsion comprises 10-20 parts by weight of soft monomer, 10-20 parts by weight of hard monomer, 1-5 parts by weight of emulsifier, 0.3-1 part by weight of initiator, 0.5-1 part by weight of pH regulator, 0.5-2 parts by weight of chain transfer agent, 0.5-3 parts by weight of polymerization inhibitor and 100 parts by weight of deionized water; the formaldehyde-free low-molecular-weight amino resin modifier has good water resistance, the density, the dimensional stability and the mechanical strength of the wood treated by the resin modifier are greatly improved, and the problem of wood brittleness after the resin modifier is treated in the past is solved.

title_en: Polyurethane composition, product prepared by using same and preparation method of product
abstract_en: A polyurethane composition is provided. The polyurethane composition comprises: (A) one or more prepolymers prepared by reacting at least one isocyanate compound with a first polyol component; and (B) a second polyol component; wherein at least one of the first polyol component and the second polyol component comprises an ester/ether block copolymer polyol prepared by reacting a starting material polyether polyol with C 4 ‑C 20 Lactone reaction. A foamable or non-foamable polyurethane product prepared by using the polyurethane composition can achieve suppressed internal heat accumulation, high thermal stability, improved curing speed, light stability, thermal stability, and excellent mechanical strength. Also provided is a process for preparing the polyurethane composition and a method for improvingA method for performance characterization of the polyurethane product.

title_en: Polypropylene-polyethylene blends with improved properties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polymer composition comprising at least the following components: A) 20 to 75 wt. -%, based on the total weight of the polymer composition, of a polymer blend comprising a1) polypropylene; a2) polyethylene; wherein the weight ratio of a1) to a2) is 3:7 to 12: 1; and wherein polymer blend A) is a recycled material; B) 25 to 80 weight percent of the virgin heterophasic polypropylene block copolymer, based on the total weight of the polymer composition; wherein the virgin heterophasic polypropylene block copolymer has a weight fraction in the range of 8 to 30 wt. -%, based on the total weight of component B)Xylene solubles content (XCS) determined according to ISO 16152; a C2 content in the range of 2.0 to 12.0 wt.%; and an MFR determined according to ISO 1133 in the range of 30 to 55g/10min 2 (230 ℃, 2.16 kg); with the proviso that the weight proportions of component A) and component B) sum to 100% by weight. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a process for the manufacture of a polymer composition, to the use of component B) for improving the mechanical properties of the polymer blend a), and to an article comprising the polymer composition according to the invention.

title_en: Method for recycling nylon-6 slices
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recycling nylon-6 chips, which comprises the following steps: 1) heating caprolactam to be molten, adding the extraction concentrated solution, homogenizing, and preheating with benzoic acid and a chain segment control agent PTA; 2) feeding into a cracking reactor for ring opening and simultaneously performing polyaddition and polycondensation; 3) feeding the mixture into a prepolymerization reactor for continuous polyaddition polycondensation, and feeding the mixed steam into a three-effect distillation device; 4) feeding the mixture into a polymerization reactor for continuous polyaddition and polycondensation, and feeding the mixed steam into a triple-effect distillation device; 5) underwater granulating after filtering to obtain slices; 6) sending the obtained slices into a pre-extraction tower and an extraction tower, collecting extraction water, sending the extraction water into a triple-effect distillation device to obtain an extraction concentrated solution, and centrifugally dewatering the extracted slices; 7) drying and cooling to obtain nylon 6 slices. The invention has the advantages that: adding chain segment control agent PTA, controlling the growth of chain segment, can prevent that molecular weight is too big, reduced the macromolecule degradation degree of difficulty, reduced the recovery degree of difficulty and cost, cooperation triple effect distillation is effectively retrieved remaining monomer, has reduced manufacturing cost.

title_en: Polymer electrolyte membrane, method for producing same, and solid polymer fuel cell
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polymer electrolyte membrane comprising an ion-conductive polymer and a maleimide compound, wherein 10 to 80% by mole of maleimide groups having double bonds remaining among maleimide groups derived from the maleimide compound, based on all maleimide groups, a method for producing the same, and a solid polymer fuel cell comprising the same. The polymer electrolyte membrane simultaneously realizes excellent dimensional stability and chemical durability by controlling the number of maleimide groups, which remain double bonds, in the polymer membrane.

title_en: Double-response adriamycin targeted nano medicine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dual-response adriamycin targeted nano-drug and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of nano-drugs. The adriamycin is modified by using the aconitic acid group (CA) and the disulfide group (SS), the CA and the disulfide group are sensitive groups, and the cleavage reaction can be carried out under the slightly acidic environment and high-level GSH of the tumor to release the antitumor drug, so that the targeted release property of the drug is improved. The invention uses polyethylene glycol chain segment (PEG) as the hydrophilic group of the nano-drug, which can improve the biocompatibility of the drug. According to the invention, CA, SS and PEG are sequentially modified at the amino end of adriamycin, and the obtained compound can be subjected to self-assembly to form a nanoparticle structure with adriamycin as a hydrophobic core and polyethylene glycol as a hydrophilic shell, so that the circulation time can be prolonged, the accumulation of tumor parts can be enhanced, the effects of enhancing permeation and retention can be achieved, and the bioavailability and the anticancer curative effect of the nano-drug can be effectively improved.

title_en: Vibration-damping sound-insulating material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration reduction and sound insulation material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of vibration reduction materials and preparation thereof. The vibration-damping sound-insulating material comprises a base material and a film layer adhered to the surface of the base material, wherein the base material comprises components such as polyacrylic resin rubber, an antioxidant, expanded vermiculite, polyacrylamide, inorganic filler, tackifying resin, flame retardant and the like. The preparation process of the vibration-damping sound-insulating material comprises the working procedures of mixing, forming, laminating and the like. The vibration damping and sound insulation material provided by the invention has excellent vibration damping and sound insulation performance, extremely high loss factor in similar products, good environmental protection, strength, bending property, low temperature resistance and flame retardance, and simple construction method, and is suitable for being used in section bar gaps of railway vehicle bodies.

title_en: Microbial compound bacterial fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial compound bacterial fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the microbial compound bacterial fertilizer comprises the following raw materials: cow dung, urea, diammonium phosphate, biomass charcoal, potassium nitrate, humic acid, a microbial agent, sepiolite powder, a loosening agent and a soil conditioner. The microbial compound bacterial fertilizer can effectively improve the water and fertilizer retention effect and the microbial activity effect, can improve soil, promote crops to absorb nutrient substances, improve yield, reduce disease rate and improve the utilization rate of the fertilizer, and enables the crops to have the advantages of strong disease resistance, high yield and good quality.

title_en: Thermosensitive adhesive main body resin, thermosensitive adhesive for solar film and preparation method of thermosensitive adhesive
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermosensitive adhesive main body resin, a thermosensitive adhesive for a solar film and a preparation method of the thermosensitive adhesive main body resin, wherein the thermosensitive adhesive main body resin comprises a combination of acrylate monomers, an initiator and a chain transfer agent in specific parts, the acrylate monomers in four different types and different performances are selected for combination, the chain transfer agent and the initiator in specific parts are added in a matched manner, the bonding performance of the thermosensitive adhesive containing the thermosensitive adhesive main body resin is greatly improved, and the thermosensitive adhesive main body resin, an auxiliary agent and a filler have excellent compatibility, so that the transparency, the heat insulation performance and the ultraviolet resistance of the thermosensitive adhesive are improved, and the thermosensitive adhesive main body resin can be applied as an interlayer adhesive of the solar film.

title_en: Polylactic acid composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polylactic acid composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials. The invention discloses a polylactic acid composite material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: polylactic acid: 50-60 parts of poly (butylene adipate/terephthalate): 20-36 parts of a compatilizer: 1-5 parts of modified glass fiber: 10-20 parts of polyether sulfone: 5-10 parts of other auxiliary agents: 0.1-10 parts. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the polylactic acid composite material, which comprises the following steps: and (2) premixing the dried polylactic acid, the dried poly adipic acid/butylene terephthalate and a compatilizer, then uniformly mixing the premix and the rest components in a high-speed mixer, then feeding the mixture into a double-screw extruder for melt blending, and extruding and injection molding to obtain the composite material. The invention also discloses an application of the polylactic acid composite material in an air filter material.

title_en: Method for producing regenerated superabsorbent polymer, method for producing superabsorbent polymer using regenerated superabsorbent polymer, and regenerated superabsorbent polymer
abstract_en: A method for producing a regenerated superabsorbent polymer is provided which can effectively utilize a used superabsorbent polymer originating from a used sanitary article to a product using the superabsorbent polymer as a raw material. The present method is a method for producing a regenerated superabsorbent polymer as a raw material for producing a superabsorbent polymer from a used superabsorbent polymer derived from a used sanitary article. The method comprises an inactivation step (S30) for inactivating a used super absorbent polymer by an acidic solution, an oxidizer treatment step (S31) for treating the used super absorbent polymer inactivated by the acidic solution by an oxidizer under acidic conditions, and a drying step (S33) for drying the used super absorbent polymer treated by the oxidizer to produce a regenerated super absorbent polymer.

title_en: Room temperature curable resin composition, coating agent, adhesive and sealant, and article
abstract_en: A room temperature curable resin composition comprising an organic polymer having silanol groups and/or hydrolyzable silyl groups at both ends of the molecular chain as a main component and an organosilicon compound having a predetermined structure including an organosiloxane structure, a hydrolyzable silyl group and a hindered amine skeleton in the molecule, which composition can give a cured product capable of suppressing deterioration with time due to the action of light such as ultraviolet rays.

title_en: Environment-friendly PBSeT copolyester material with water vapor barrier property and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high polymer materials, in particular to an environment-friendly PBSeT copolyester material with water vapor barrier property and a preparation method thereof; the material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mole: 5 parts of sebacic acid, 10 parts of 1, 4-butanediol, 5 parts of terephthalic acid, 0-0.01 part but not 0 part of 1, 6-hexamethylene diamine, and 0-0.06 part but not 0 part of tetrabutyl titanate; blending sebacic acid, 1, 4-butanediol and 1, 6-hexamethylene diamine under the condition of not adding a catalyst, sequentially performing three stages of two-step esterification and polycondensation to obtain a PBSeT copolyester material, and adding terephthalic acid during the second-stage esterification; experimental results show that the water vapor barrier property of the environment-friendly PBSeT copolyester material added with 0.012 parts of HDA is improved by 11.6% compared with that of the environment-friendly PBSeT copolyester material not added with HDA. The preparation method can greatly improve the water vapor barrier property of the environment-friendly PBSeT copolyester material, and has higher market value.

title_en: Preparation method of modified TPE composite material and modified TPE composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite materials, and provides a preparation method of a modified TPE composite material and the modified TPE composite material, which comprises the following steps: preparing a first mixture, namely modifying TPE to obtain a first mixture; preparing a TPE composite material, namely processing the first mixture and the first composition to obtain the TPE composite material; the TPE composite material obtained through the steps of preparing the first mixture and preparing the TPE composite material not only shows excellent flexibility, but also has excellent resilience.

title_en: Process for preparing polymer compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing a polymer composition, characterized in that an ethylene based prepolymer (P) is obtained by polymerization in a prepolymerization zone in a slurry in the presence of ethylene, optionally at least one comonomer selected from alpha-olefins having from 4 to 10 carbon atoms, and optionally hydrogen; and in a first polymerization zone obtaining a first ethylene polymer component (a) by conducting polymerization in slurry in the presence of ethylene, optionally at least one comonomer selected from alpha-olefins having from 4 to 10 carbon atoms, and optionally hydrogen; and in a second polymerization zone a second ethylene polymer component (B) is obtained by polymerization carried out in slurry in the presence of ethylene, the first ethylene polymer component (a), optionally at least one comonomer selected from alpha-olefins having from 4 to 10 carbon atoms, and optionally hydrogen; and in a third polymerization zone obtaining a third ethylene polymer component (C) by polymerization in the gas phase in the presence of ethylene and at least one comonomer selected from alpha-olefins having from 4 to 10 carbon atoms, to produce a multimodal ethylene polymer (a) having at least one comonomer selected from alpha-olefins having from 4 to 10 carbon atoms, -wherein a) the density is from 900 to 960kg/m 3 B) MFR of 0.1 to 25g/10min 2 (measured at 190 ℃ under a load of 2.16kg according to ISO 1133), c) a MWD of 2 to 6, -which comprises at least-0.5 to<Between 7% by weight of an ethylene prepolymer (P) -10 to<Between 25 wt% of an ethylene polymer component (A), -10 to<Between 25% by weight of an ethylene polymer component (B) and->Between 51 and 79.5 wt% of an ethylene polymer component (C) and wherein the density of ethylene polymer components (A) and (B) is each 925 to 970kg/m 3 The density of the m-ethylene polymer component (C) is 880 to 950kg/m 3 Wherein further the ethylene polymer components (A), (B) and (C) have different MFR 2 The value is obtained.

title_en: Production method of high-dispersion silicon dioxide
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of high-dispersion silicon dioxide, which comprises the following steps: mixing a sodium silicate aqueous solution and an alcohol-water mixed solution to obtain a primary mixed solution; mixing the modified organic solution and the primary mixed solution to obtain a mixed solution; mixing the obtained mixed solution with acid liquor until the pH value is 6-6.5, and aging to obtain primary precipitation solution; mixing an initiator and the primary precipitation solution, dropwise adding an acid solution to adjust the pH value to 4.5-5, and carrying out solid-liquid separation after precipitation reaction to obtain coated modified silicon dioxide; and carrying out heat treatment on the coated modified silicon dioxide to obtain the high-dispersion silicon dioxide. According to the invention, the modified organic solution is added into the sodium silicate aqueous solution, so that the coating modification of the organic matters in the modified organic solution on the silicon dioxide is realized, and the excessive aggregation in the silicon dioxide precipitation process is avoided, so that the silicon dioxide has good dispersion performance under the condition of high specific surface area.

title_en: PTA and BDO esterification process for PBAT production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PTA and BDO esterification process for PBAT production, which comprises the steps of adding terephthalic acid, 1, 4-butanediol and a polymerization degree regulation catalyst into a reaction kettle, wherein the addition amount of the polymerization degree regulation catalyst is 0.5-5 wt% of the mass of the terephthalic acid; the reaction temperature is 120-220 ℃, the reaction time is 1.5-3.5 h, and the reaction pressure is less than or equal to 101kPa; before the reaction, nitrogen is introduced into the reaction kettle and vacuumized for replacement for 1 to 2 times. When PTA and BDO esterification is carried out, the specific polymerization degree regulation catalyst is selected, PTA and BDO esterification is divided into 3 stages to be fed step by step and reacted step by step, and the reaction conditions are optimized, so that the oligomer molecular PBT prepolymer with larger polymerization degree and higher polymerization degree distribution concentration degree can be obtained, the whole reaction process condition is mild, and the reaction process is easy to control.

title_en: Sulfonated perfluoro-polyphenyl proton exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of organic chemistry application, and particularly relates to a sulfonated perfluoro-polyphenyl proton exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof. The sulfonated perfluoro-polyphenyl proton exchange membrane is realized by the reaction of functionalized p-chlorobenzene and perfluoro-p-chlorobenzene, the prepared membrane has good thermodynamic stability, the power density exceeds that of a commercialized Nafion 211 membrane under the condition of different humidity, compared with a non-fluorine aromatic polymer, the water absorption rate of the sulfonated perfluoro-polyphenyl proton exchange membrane can be effectively controlled, the reaction temperature is mild, and the reaction is easier to popularize industrially; compared with the existing perfluorosulfonic acid membrane and polyarylether membranes, the perfluoropolyphenyl proton exchange membrane has higher ion exchange capacity, and the conductivity does not completely depend on the water absorption rate or the ion exchange capacity, so that the perfluoropolyphenyl proton exchange membrane can obtain higher conductivity under the condition of lower IEC or water absorption rate.

title_en: External additive particles and toner
abstract_en: The present invention relates to external additive particles and toners. The external additive particles include a sulfur-containing polymer. The polymer comprises a vinyl polymer portion and a siloxane portion. The ratio of the number of silicon atoms in the external additive particles to the sum of the number of carbon atoms, the number of oxygen atoms, and the number of silicon atoms is 4.0% or more and 25.0% or less, and it is detected that the surface of the external additive particles contains sulfur atoms by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy.

title_en: Wear-resistant oil-proof butyronitrile paster glove and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant and oil-proof butyronitrile patch glove and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of glove protection. According to the invention, the glove latex is prepared for pre-gluing treatment, and is not heated or dried, so that the latex is prevented from forming a film and vulcanizing, and the adhesive force between the latex and a nitrile rubber sheet and glove blanks is greatly improved; the formula of the butyronitrile patch is optimized, so that the oil resistance and wear resistance of the patch can be greatly enhanced, the adhesive force between the patch and glove latex can be increased, and the patch is firm and not easy to fall off; in the final vulcanization process section, two sections of vulcanization are adopted, and the first section is shaped at low temperature, so that the generation of bubbles is effectively inhibited; and the second stage of high-temperature rapid vulcanization shortens the vulcanization time and improves the production efficiency. The glove has good oil resistance and wear resistance, the butyronitrile patch is firm and not easy to fall off, the operation requirement of a special operation environment is completely met, the production cost is low, the operation is simple, the glove is suitable for large-scale popularization and utilization, and the glove has wide market application prospect.

title_en: Oleophilic hydrophilic amphiphilic photo-curing oligomer, preparation method thereof and photo-curing coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a lipophilic hydrophilic amphiphilic photo-curing oligomer, a preparation method thereof and a photo-curing coating. The preparation method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: a) Reacting small molecular alcohol, dihydroxymethyl butyric acid and a third substance under the action of a catalyst to obtain hydrophilic polyester polyol; the small molecular alcohol is polyhydric alcohol with 2 to 4 carbon atoms; the third substance is selected from one or more of anhydride, alkanoic acid and branched hydroxyl substituted alkane; the total raw material types of the small molecular alcohol, the dihydroxymethyl butyric acid and the third substance are more than four; b) Under the action of a catalyst, mixing and reacting the hydrophilic polyester polyol with isocyanate and a polymerization inhibitor to obtain a first prepolymer; c) Reacting the prepolymer with a chain extender to obtain a second prepolymer; d) Reacting the second prepolymer with a modified acrylate monomer to obtain an oligomer. The photo-curing oligomer provided by the invention can improve the curing speed of the coating, and the adhesive force, hardness and wear resistance of a paint film.

title_en: Noise-reducing heat-insulating thin-layer butyl damping film for vehicle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of butyl damping films, and provides a noise-reducing heat-insulating thin-layer butyl damping film for a vehicle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the formula of the butyl damping film comprises the following components: 50-100 parts of butyl rubber, 10-60 parts of neoprene, 10-60 parts of polyisobutylene, 5-50 parts of hollow glass beads, 5-50 parts of carbon black, 30-100 parts of flame retardant, 30-100 parts of reinforcing filler, 5-30 parts of plasticizer, 5-20 parts of antioxidant and 0.1-5 parts of ultraviolet absorbent. The butyl damping rubber has a very high damping coefficient, and the damping coefficient of the butyl damping rubber with the thickness of 1mm can be higher than that of a product with the thickness of 2mm on the market through multiple tests. The application has the characteristics of lower density and heat conductivity coefficient, excellent flame retardance and low smell, and is beneficial to application.

title_en: Manufacturing method of insulating part for rail transit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit, and discloses a manufacturing method of an insulating part for rail transit, which comprises the following steps: adding the organic compound A, the catalyst A and the catalyst B into a reaction chamber with the temperature of 139 ℃ for addition polymerization for 1-2 hours, and standing for 2-3 hours after the addition polymerization is finished to obtain the polymer A. According to the manufacturing method of the insulating part for rail transit, the organic compound A, the catalyst A and the catalyst B are subjected to polymerization operation of vapor deposition at a specific temperature, the polymer A obtained after standing for three hours is polypropylene, the polypropylene is an organic substance with extremely high insulating property, the compression resistance and the insulating property are further enhanced by filling marble particles in the polypropylene, and the insulating material A is used as a rail insulating material of a base layer, so that the compression resistance stability can be enhanced, the insulating property can be greatly improved, the manufacturing method of the insulating part is simple, and the manufacturing efficiency of the insulating part is greatly enhanced.

title_en: Fluorescent polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent polymer, which contains a structural unit shown in a formula (I), a structural unit shown in a formula (II) and an optional structural unit shown in a formula (III): wherein, in formula (I), R1 is H or CH 3; in formula (II), R2 is selected from alkylene; in the formula (III), R3 is an alkyl group represented by C2 to C10 or an aryl group represented by C6 to C10. Fluorescent polymers of the inventionUltraviolet light can be converted to visible light. The invention discloses a preparation method of the fluorescent polymer.

title_en: Method for preparing polymer film with three-dimensional network structure
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method of preparing a polymer film having a three-dimensional network structure, comprising: preparing a natural high molecular polymer and a synthetic high molecular polymer; mixing a natural high molecular polymer and a synthetic high molecular polymer to form a mixture solution; and adding a crosslinking agent to form a three-dimensional network structure of the natural high molecular polymer and the synthetic high molecular polymer, thereby obtaining a polymer film, wherein the three-dimensional network structure comprises a chemical crosslinking network formed by covalent bond crosslinking and a physical crosslinking network formed by ionic bond crosslinking, the chemical crosslinking network has covalent bond crosslinking between the synthetic high molecular polymers and covalent bond crosslinking between the natural high molecular polymer and the synthetic high molecular polymer, and the physical crosslinking network has ionic bond crosslinking between the natural high molecular polymers. According to the present disclosure, a polymer film having good stretch resistance and adhesion can be provided.

title_en: Tear-resistant PBSeT/PP/HDPE composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a tear-resistant PBSeT/PP/HDPE composite material and a preparation method thereof; the composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 40-50 parts of PP, 40-50 parts of HDPE, 0-20 parts of PBSeT and not 0; the preparation method comprises the following steps: performing first-stage melt blending on PP and HDPE in parts by mass, adding PBSeT in parts by mass after the PP and the HDPE are completely melted, and continuing blending after the PBSeT is melted to obtain a tear-resistant PBSeT/PP/HDPE composite material; under the melt blending method provided by the invention, when the addition amount of PBSeT in the composite material accounts for 12%, the tear strength of the composite material is improved by 40.36 times compared with the tear strength of the composite material without PBSeT; when the addition amount of PBSeT in the composite material accounts for 12%, the elongation at break of the composite material is improved by 124.7% compared with the elongation at break of the composite material without the PBSeT. The preparation method can greatly improve the tearing strength and the toughness of the composite material, and has high market value.

title_en: Polypropylene composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypropylene composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of high polymer materials. The invention provides a polypropylene composite material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-78 parts of copolymerized polypropylene resin, 10-30 parts of short glass fiber, 10-30 parts of ethylene-octene copolymer, 1-5 parts of polypropylene grafted maleic anhydride and 1-10 parts of hydrogenated styrene-butadiene block copolymer; wherein the melt mass flow rate of the ethylene-octene copolymer is 0.5-10g/10 min; the grafting rate of the polypropylene grafted maleic anhydride is 0.2-1.0%; the viscosity of the hydrogenated styrene-butadiene block copolymer was 500-1500 MPa.s. According to the invention, the polypropylene composite material with low odor, no tiger skin stripes and good touch feeling is prepared by optimizing the weight parts and parameters of the ethylene-octene copolymer, the polypropylene grafted maleic anhydride and the hydrogenated styrene-butadiene block copolymer.

title_en: Anti-warping laser welding PC/PBT composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a warping-resistant laser welding PC/PBT composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-53 parts of PBT; 10-40 parts of PC; 10-30 parts of glass fiber; 0.1 to 1 portion of crystallization accelerator; 0.5-1.5 parts of ester exchange inhibitor; 0.1 to 0.5 portion of antioxidant; 0.5 part of black dye. According to the invention, the amorphous PC material and the crystalline PBT material are compositely modified, so that the laser-transparent material for laser welding can be obtained, the anti-warping property of the whole PC/PBT material is improved, the welding strength is increased, the welding period is shortened, the productivity is improved, and the application range of the material is expanded.

title_en: Crosslinked polystyrene resin, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crosslinked polystyrene resin and a preparation method and application thereof. The cross-linked polystyrene resin is grafted with diisooctylamine functional groups. The preparation method of the crosslinked polystyrene resin comprises the following steps: adding chloromethylated polystyrene crosslinked microspheres into a solution containing diisooctylamine, swelling, adding an acid-binding agent, and reacting at 50-80 ℃ for 2-48 h to obtain the crosslinked polystyrene resin. The cross-linked polystyrene resin has a good plutonium ion adsorption effect.

title_en: Preparation method of epoxy group-containing polysiloxane-acrylate elastomer and application of epoxy group-containing polysiloxane-acrylate elastomer in low-temperature toughening nylon tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an epoxy group-containing polysiloxane-acrylate elastomer, which comprises the following steps: a. preparing a polysiloxane emulsion; b. preparing polysiloxane-acrylate core emulsion; c. preparing polyacrylate agglomerated latex; d. agglomerating the latex to prepare a large-particle-size polysiloxane-acrylate core emulsion; e. preparing epoxy group-containing polysiloxane-acrylate composite emulsion; f. and (3) preparing the epoxy group-containing polysiloxane-acrylate elastomer with large particle size. The prepared polysiloxane-acrylate elastomer particles with large particle size are used for toughening nylon 6, have more excellent low-temperature (-55 ℃) impact resistance compared with other toughening agents, and do not greatly influence other mechanical properties of nylon 6, so that the nylon material matrix resin has better notch impact resistance strength, processability, toughness and wear resistance, and the application requirements in the fields of automobile parts, nylon pipes and the like are completely met.

title_en: Polymer-ceramic composite housing and housing component for portable electronic devices
abstract_en: A housing piece for a portable electronic device and a method of molding the housing piece for a portable electronic device. The housing member comprises: a housing component comprising ceramic particles in a polymer matrix, the ceramic particles comprising 50% to 90% by volume of the housing component, and the polymer matrix comprising 10% to 50% by volume of the housing component; the ceramic particles have a Dv50 of 50 nm to 100 microns; the ceramic particles are substantially free of agglomeration; the shell component has a relative density of greater than 90%; the housing member is configured to cover a portion of the portable electronic device. The method of molding the housing member of the present invention comprises: disposing polymer-ceramic core-shell particles in a working portion of a cavity in a mold, each core-shell particle comprising a ceramic core comprising ceramic particles and a polymer shell surrounding the core, the shell comprising a polymer, wherein the ceramic core comprises 50 to 90 volume percent of the powder and the polymer shell comprises 10 to 50 volume percent of the powder; heating the mold to a first temperature above the melting temperature (Tm) of the first polymer; subjecting the powder in the mold to a first pressure while maintaining the temperature of the mold at or above the first temperature to define a contour of the shell component in which the ceramic particles are substantially free of agglomerates; cooling the housing component to a temperature below the Tg or Tm of the first polymer; and removing the housing component from the mold. In the housing pieces and methods, the ceramic particles comprise Al  2 O 3 、Fe 3 O 4 、Fe 2 O 3 、ZnO、ZrO 2 、SiO 2  and/or a combination of any two or more of these ceramics; the polymer comprises PPE, PPS, PC copolymer, PEI copolymer, PPSU, PAES, PES, PAEK, PBT, PP, PE, semi-crystalline PI, or semi-crystalline polyamide.

title_en: Methods, systems, and computer program products for producing polyurethane foam products using optical and infrared imaging
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer program products are disclosed for producing a polyurethane foam, then while producing the foam, at or immediately after the outlet, at an angle of greater than 0 degrees to less than 90 degrees relative to a surface of the foam above the top surface of the foam, or after the foam is cut but before it cools to room temperature, imaging the polyurethane foam using an infrared or optical imaging device to acquire an image of the polyurethane foam, and determining whether a defect in the polyurethane foam that requires correction is present based on the acquired image; and optionally, modifying a process parameter for producing the polyurethane foam in response to determining that there is a defect that requires correction.

title_en: Multilayer pipe and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multilayer tube comprising an inner layer comprising a crosslinked fluoroelastomer rubber and an outer layer comprising a crosslinked non-fluoroelastomer rubber, wherein the multilayer tube has a shore a hardness of from about 40 to about 90.

title_en: Flocculating agent for landfill leachate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flocculant for landfill leachate and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: adding acrylamide, a first charge dispersing agent, a second charge dispersing agent, a third charge dispersing agent, inorganic salt, a cationic monomer, a chain extender, a synergist and a masking agent into deionized water, and uniformly stirring to obtain a reaction medium; the first charge dispersing agent, the second charge dispersing agent and the third charge dispersing agent are all cationic polyacrylamide, and the apparent viscosity, the viscosity average molecular weight and the ionic degree of different charge dispersing agents are different; and under the nitrogen atmosphere, adding a composite initiator into the reaction medium to initiate a polymerization reaction, thereby obtaining the flocculant for the landfill leachate. The flocculant prepared by the invention can realize the rapid sedimentation of the landfill leachate, the sludge-water separation interface is clear, the turbidity is low, the COD removal rate is high, and the flocculated residues are harmless to the environment.

title_en: Organic room temperature phosphorescent polymer, preparation thereof and application thereof in X-ray imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic room temperature phosphorescent polymer, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in X-ray imaging, wherein the organic room temperature phosphorescent polymer material is prepared by reacting different bromo-groups with diphenyl phosphorus chloride, then connecting an olefin chain, and then copolymerizing with acrylic acid, and comprises PTPA, PTPA-Br, PTPA-2Br, PCBA-Br, PCBA-2Br, PBNA, PPAE and PPYE. The organic room temperature phosphorescent polymer material shows strong Radiant Luminescence (RL) characteristics under R-ray irradiation; in addition, the polymer can be dissolved in an organic solvent, and based on the condition, the polymer can be used as a scintillator and successfully applied to the field of X-ray imaging, so that a promising approach is provided for expanding the application range of the amorphous organic scintillator.

title_en: Low-dielectric filler for copper-clad plate, preparation method of low-dielectric filler, copper-clad plate intermediate layer and copper-clad plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a low dielectric filler for a copper-clad plate, which comprises the following steps: A) sequentially carrying out acid washing and water washing on the glass fiber untwisted yarns, and then drying to obtain pretreated glass fiber untwisted yarns; B) mixing the pretreated glass fiber untwisted yarn with a treatment solution, and carrying out surface modification to obtain a modified glass fiber untwisted yarn; the treatment liquid comprises a silane coupling agent and polytetrafluoroethylene dispersion liquid, and C) the modified glass fiber untwisted yarn is volatilized and dried, and then is chopped and coarsely ground to obtain the filler with the length of 100-1000 mu m. Under the same conditions, the copper-clad plate prepared by the filler has the advantages of lower dielectric constant, lower dielectric loss, reduced drill bit abrasion, good peel strength and low production cost. The invention also provides a low dielectric filler for the copper-clad plate, a copper-clad plate intermediate layer and the copper-clad plate.

title_en: Foamed sheet, product, and method for producing foamed sheet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foamed sheet, a product and a method for producing a foamed sheet. The foamed sheet includes: polylactic acid; and a filler, wherein when the cushioning coefficient of the foamed sheet is 10 or less, the compressive stress of the foamed sheet is 0.2Mpa or less; and wherein when the sheet thickness of the foamed sheet is 2mm, the puncture strength of the foamed sheet is 2N or more.

title_en: Polyamide 6 resin film
abstract_en: A polyamide 6 resin film characterized by having a temperature rise rate of 5 ℃/min from 50 ℃ to 260 ℃ in Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) measurementMelting onset temperature (T) im ) Is above 216.0 ℃.

title_en: Semi-aromatic polyamide composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The semi-aromatic polyamide composite material is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: 50 parts of semi-aromatic polyamide resin A; 5-15 parts of semi-aromatic polyamide resin B; 15-45 parts of fibrous minerals; wherein the semi-aromatic polyamide resin A has a number average molecular weight Mn of 20000-30000 as measured by gel permeation chromatography GPC; the semi-aromatic polyamide resin B has a number average molecular weight Mn of 13000-16000 as measured by gel permeation chromatography GPC; the concentration of the terminal amino group in the semi-aromatic polyamide composite resin matrix is in the range of 30 to 120 mol/t. According to the invention, two semi-aromatic polyamide resins with different number average molecular weights are selected for compounding, and the terminal amino group concentration of the semi-aromatic polyamide composite material is in a specific value, so that reasonable distribution of fibrous minerals can be realized, and not only can the surface smoothness be improved, but also the wear resistance can be improved.

title_en: Styrene-acrylonitrile in-situ polymerization modified asphalt binder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a styrene-acrylonitrile in-situ polymerization modified asphalt binder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the asphalt binder is prepared from the following components in parts by mass: 4-20 parts of styrene; 2-10 parts of acrylonitrile; 70-90 parts of matrix asphalt; 2-10 parts of polyethylene wax; 1-5 parts of a dispersant; 0.5-5% of initiator. The invention modifies the matrix asphalt with the thermoplastic materials of styrene-acrylonitrile copolymer, polyethylene wax and the like, and obviously improves the softening point of the matrix asphalt. The asphalt binder not only enhances high-temperature fatigue resistance, but also has better low-temperature cracking resistance. Because the in-situ polymerization process is adopted and the dispersing agent is added, once polymer molecules are formed, the polymer molecules can be uniformly dispersed into an asphalt body, the method is superior to simple physical blending, and the stability of the asphalt binder is greatly improved.

title_en: Water-dispersible polymer, composition containing same and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-dispersible polymer which comprises a repeating unit generated by a monomer I, a repeating unit generated by a monomer II and repeating units generated by other monomers. The monomer I is an organosilicon modified acrylic monomer, the monomer II is an amino group-containing acrylic monomer, and the other monomer is at least one selected from a hydroxyl group-containing or polyoxyethylene group-containing monomer III, an anionic group-containing monomer IV and a functional group-containing monomer V. The polymer or the composition containing the polymer can be used for surface treatment of various articles such as textiles, paper, stone and the like, and endows the surfaces of the articles with water and oil repellent functions.

title_en: Biodegradable breathable film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a biodegradable breathable film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the biodegradable breathable film comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 80-100 parts of PLA resin; 15-25 parts of PCL resin; 20-30 parts of PBSA resin; 3-8 parts of an antibacterial agent; 2-5 parts of an antioxidant; 4-10 parts of functional filler; 2-5 parts of a plasticizer; 1-3 parts of a chain extender; the antibacterial agent is prepared by compounding tea polyphenols, thymol and chitosan; the functional filler is formed by compounding calcareous bentonite, glycerol and titanium dioxide; the biodegradable breathable film prepared by double-screw extrusion granulation and single-screw extrusion film blowing machine blow molding not only meets the requirements of food contact materials, but also has good mechanical property, antibacterial property and air permeability, high safety and good transparency, and can be applied to the fields of food freshness protection bags and supermarket rolling bags.

title_en: Mirror surface anti-contamination cosmetic packaging material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mirror surface anti-contamination cosmetic packaging material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of novel functional polymer materials. The packaging material comprises a fingerprint-proof stain-resistant layer, a bright scratch-resistant layer, an antibacterial wear-resistant layer and a base material which are sequentially arranged from outside to inside; the antibacterial wear-resistant layer has a low friction coefficient and contains dispersed antibacterial particles, so that good wear resistance and long-acting antibacterial performance are exerted; the bright scratch-resistant layer takes polyurethane resin and organic silicon epoxy resin with excellent heat resistance, water resistance and bonding strength as main components, has good gloss and scratch resistance, and is bright as a mirror surface for a long time; when the ethylene-methyl acrylate copolymer in the fingerprint-resistant stain-resistant layer modifies the perfluoroethylene propylene copolymer, the hydrophobic and oleophobic filler is dispersed in the copolymer to improve the hydrophobic and oleophobic properties, and the metal powder further improves the glossiness of the packaging material, so that the surface of the fingerprint-resistant stain-resistant layer is low in energy, easy to level, not easy to contaminate fingerprints, and good in stain-resistant effect.

title_en: Environment-friendly water-based paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly water-based paint which is characterized by being prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 35-40 parts of waterborne polyurethane resin, 12-20 parts of waterborne acrylic resin, 18-26 parts of sodium silicate, 20-30 parts of powder filler, 45-65 parts of deionized water, 0.2-0.8 part of defoaming agent, 2-5 parts of film forming agent, 2-4 parts of dispersing agent, 18-25 parts of additive and 1-3 parts of thickening agent. By adopting the technical scheme, the invention provides the environment-friendly water-based paint, the water-based paint is improved to be water-resistant and strong in adhesive force, and the prepared water-based paint can reduce the harm to users and reduce the toxicity.

title_en: Preparation method of size-adjustable AIE nano particles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of AIE (Aggregation-induced emission) nano materials, in particular to a preparation method of AIE nano particles with adjustable size. The preparation method of the size-adjustable AIE nano-particles comprises the following steps: (1) The method is simple and convenient, the practicability is strong, and the obtained nano particles have good stability.

title_en: Polypropylene composition, polypropylene composite powder, preparation method and application thereof, and polypropylene product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of polymer composite materials, in particular to a polypropylene composition, polypropylene composite powder, a preparation method and application thereof and a polypropylene product. The composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polypropylene, 5-40 parts of elastomer, 1-10 parts of compatilizer, 0.1-5 parts of antioxidant and 5-40 parts of modified gasified slag; wherein the modified gasification fine slag is a coupling agent modified gasification fine slag; the gasification fine slag is pulverized coal gasification fine slag. The composition is nontoxic and odorless and low in cost, and the modified gasified fine slag has proper particle size, good thermal conductivity and thermal stability, so that the polypropylene composite powder prepared from the composition meets the 3D printing requirement, has good thermal conductivity, thermal stability, high strength and fluidity, can improve the powder paving effect of materials in the printing process, improves the printing precision, and can also enable the waste gasified fine slag to be utilized in a high-quality manner.

title_en: SBS modified emulsified asphalt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of asphalt modification, and particularly discloses SBS modified emulsified asphalt and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the SBS modified emulsified asphalt adopts a modification and emulsification integrated process; pretreatment is needed before the modification and emulsification integrated process; the pretreatment is to add a pre-dispersed SBS modifier into the matrix asphalt and stir at the temperature of 150-190 ℃ to obtain an asphalt-SBS mixture; in the modification and emulsification integrated process, the asphalt-SBS mixture is directly emulsified into SBS modified emulsified asphalt by adopting soap solution; and the SBS modified emulsified asphalt prepared by the method. The application can obviously improve the service performance and the stability of the SBS modified emulsified asphalt.

title_en: Method for stably storing isocyanate composition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for stably storing an isocyanate composition, the stably stored isocyanate composition and a polyurethane reaction system comprising the isocyanate composition.

title_en: Moisture-resistant olfactory visualization detection sensor based on metal organic framework @ dye @ covalent organic framework composite functional material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-wet olfactory visualization detection sensor based on a metal organic framework@dye@covalent organic framework composite functional material. The colorimetric sensor is an array colorimetric sensor which is formed by uniformly distributing a plurality of colorimetric sensing units on a substrate, wherein the colorimetric sensing units are formed by gas-sensitive materials, and the gas-sensitive materials are MOF@dye@COF composite functional materials; the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly adding MOF powder into an ethanol solution of a dye, fully stirring, centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, washing and drying to obtain MOF@dye; adding MOF@dye into a first COF ligand solution for ultrasonic dissolution; adding a catalyst for ultrasonic dissolution; adding a second COF ligand solution for ultrasonic dissolution; standing and reacting for 3 days at normal temperature; and finally, centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, washing and drying to obtain the MOF@dye@COF composite functional material. The invention can resist the interference of water molecules in the air, has good anti-humidity interference capability and stability in actual detection, can effectively enrich VOCs gas molecules, and has good sensitivity.

title_en: Semi-aromatic polyimide, color-adjustable room-temperature phosphorescent material based on semi-aromatic polyimide and preparation method of color-adjustable room-temperature phosphorescent material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-aromatic polyimide, a color-adjustable room temperature phosphorescent material based on the semi-aromatic polyimide and a preparation method thereof; the chemical structural formula of the semi-aromatic polyimide is as follows: the semi-aromatic polyimide has high heat stability, high mechanical property and light transmittance reaching over 80 percent. The room-temperature phosphorescent material based on the semi-aromatic polyimide base is prepared by doping polyimide with other small organic molecules, and the phosphorescent service life and the phosphorescent color can be regulated and controlled. The pure organic photoluminescence polymer phosphorescent material without containing the organometallic complex avoids potential biotoxicity and has wide functions in the fields of anti-counterfeiting, information encryption, biological imaging and the like.

title_en: Ultralow-heat-generation steel wire belt layer edge covering rubber composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultralow-heat-generation steel wire belt layer edge covering rubber composition and a preparation method thereof, and the technical scheme is as follows: the paint comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of new-process environment-friendly natural rubber, 40-60 parts of novel low-hysteresis reinforcing carbon black, 5-15 parts of white carbon black, 1-4 parts of high-performance novel adhesive resin, 0.5-2 parts of low-heat-generation auxiliary agent, 1-2 parts of cobalt neodecanoate, 0.5-2 parts of anti-reversion agent, 4-7 parts of insoluble sulfur, 3-7 parts of anti-aging agent, 1-3 parts of accelerator, 1-10 parts of zinc oxide, 654-6 parts of adhesive RA, 0.2-1.0 part of stearic acid and 0.05-0.5 part of anti-scorching agent. The engineering tire with the ultralow heat generation steel wire belt layer edge coating rubber is applied to a scene that a severe mine road surface bend is large and heat generation is large due to deformation in a driving process, so that the probability of tire burst caused by heat generation delamination between a steel wire end point and a rubber material due to heat generation of the belt layer end point is reduced.

title_en: Low-temperature preparation method of lentinan powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-temperature preparation method of lentinan powder, belonging to the technical field of deep processing of edible fungi. The invention comprises the following steps: (1) slicing Lentinus Edodes, extracting lentinan with hot water, and filtering to obtain filtrate; (2) concentrating the filtrate in vacuum; (3) spray drying the concentrated solution at low temperature to obtain lentinan powder. The preparation method is quick, simple and convenient, the inner wall is dry and does not stick to the wall, the functional activity of lentinan can be effectively reserved, and the obtained powder is dry, fluffy and fine.

title_en: Crosslinkable cycloolefin copolymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crosslinkable cycloolefin copolymer, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a repeated structural unit of the crosslinkable cycloolefin copolymer comprises an A structural unit and a B structural unit; the B building blocks may be further crosslinked.
