The A structural unit is obtained from norbornene and a derivative monomer a thereof, the B structural unit is obtained from a monomer B containing two or more double bonds, the structure of the monomer B comprises at least one or more six-atom rings, at least one double bond is on the six-membered carbocycle, and at least one double bond is adjacent to the ring body. The crosslinkable cycloolefin copolymer is a COC material with controllable Tg point, is easy to process, can undergo in-situ crosslinking reaction in the subsequent processing process, and is further molded to obtain a high-temperature-resistant COC material, so that the COC material is changed from a thermoplastic material to a thermosetting material, and the thermosetting cycloolefin copolymer can be applied to different fields, such as packaging materials, circuit substrates and the like.

title_en: Skin-like touch thermoplastic elastomer material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a skin-like touch thermoplastic elastomer material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the skin-like touch thermoplastic elastomer material comprises 80-120 parts of a thermoplastic elastomer, 10-15 parts of maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene, 1-2 parts of an elastic auxiliary agent, 3-4 parts of a plasticizer, 1-3 parts of a polar surface treatment agent, 10-20 parts of a slip agent and 2-3 parts of a hand feeling agent, the thermoplastic elastomer, the maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene, the elastic auxiliary agent, the plasticizer, the polar surface treatment agent, the slip agent and the hand feeling agent are melted and uniformly stirred to obtain a premix, and the premix is poured into a mold for molding. The invention improves the touch feeling of the thermoplastic elastomer material and the user experience.

title_en: Modified graphene/bismaleimide resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified graphene/bismaleimide resin and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the modified graphene/bismaleimide resin comprises the following steps: carrying out polymerization reaction on aminated graphene, allyl phenol organic matters, thermoplastic resin and bismaleimide monomer to obtain modified graphene/bismaleimide resin, wherein the weight ratio of the bismaleimide monomer to the aminated graphene to the allyl phenol organic matters to the thermoplastic resin is (50-100): (0.5-7): (35-75): (5-25). The preparation method of the modified graphene/bismaleimide resin prepared by the preparation method has good processability and excellent impact resistance.

title_en: High-voltage high-safety polyimide gel polymer electrolyte, preparation method and application thereof, and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lithium ion battery gel polymer electrolytes, and particularly relates to a high-voltage high-safety polyimide gel polymer electrolyte, a preparation method and application thereof, and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: reacting fluorine-containing aromatic diamine and fluorine-containing aromatic dianhydride to obtain polyamic acid solution; coating polyamic acid and then carrying out high-temperature treatment to obtain a polyimide porous membrane; and immersing the polyimide porous membrane into high-voltage electrolyte for full swelling to obtain the high-voltage high-safety polyimide gel polymer electrolyte. The high-voltage high-safety polyimide polymer electrolyte has strong oxidation resistance, can ensure that a lithium ion battery has good high-voltage circulation stability, is simple and easy to prepare, has strong operability and processability, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Antibacterial agent, preparation method thereof and antibacterial composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial agent, a preparation method thereof and an antibacterial composition, wherein the antibacterial agent comprises chitosan and PrF 3 Adding the mixture into an acetic acid solution, and reacting for 20-24h at normal temperature to obtain a mixed solution; mixing the mixed solution, copper nitrate, glucose solution, deionized water and potassium hydroxide, reacting at 70-90 ℃ for 16-20h, filtering, washing and drying to obtain Cu/chitosan/PrF 3 An antibacterial agent. The antibacterial agent can improve the antibacterial performance of the thermoplastic plastic, can expand the types of the antibacterial agent and meet the requirement of high antibacterial environment.

title_en: Dai medicine composition gel for relieving postpartum pruritus cutanea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Dai medicine composition gel for relieving postpartum pruritus cutanea and a preparation method thereof. The Dai medicine composition gel for relieving postpartum pruritus is composed of 10-40 parts by weight of a wood-milk-fruit composition and 0-20 parts by weight of a big leaf tea extract; the elaeagnus conferta roxb composition consists of elaeagnus conferta roxb total polysaccharides and elaeagnus conferta roxb total polyphenols. The preparation is the Dai medicine composition gel for relieving the postpartum cutaneous pruritus, and auxiliary materials are added into the Dai medicine composition gel for relieving the postpartum cutaneous pruritus to prepare an external preparation. The application of the Dai medicine composition gel for relieving postpartum cutaneous pruritus is application in preparing a product for relieving postpartum cutaneous pruritus.

title_en: Method for splitting tropinolide and derivative
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic chemistry and macromolecules, in particular to a method for splitting tropinolide and derivatives thereof, which comprises the following steps: conducting ring-opening polymerization reaction on the racemic compound of the formula A and chiral lactide ((R, R) -B or (S, S) -B) in the presence of a catalyst to provide the compound of the formula A in S or R configuration and corresponding alternating copolymers C and D. The method for splitting the chiral compound provided by the invention takes the metal complex as the catalyst, has good catalytic effect and wide substrate applicability, can be obtained by excellent enantioselectivity no matter the product and the recovered raw material, has excellent kinetic splitting effect on various substituted tropicalide lactones, also has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple operation, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like, can be obtained by cheap market approaches or can be synthesized by simple steps, and has good industrial prospect.

title_en: Thermoplastic elastomer material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermoplastic elastomer material, and preparation and application thereof, wherein the material comprises the following components: thermoplastic polyurethane, styrene elastomer, white oil, plasticizer, compatilizer, filler and auxiliary agent. The thermoplastic elastomer material has better bonding strength.

title_en: High-thermal-conductivity fluorescent colloid, high-thermal-conductivity white light LD and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of white light LD (laser diode) packaging, and particularly discloses a high-thermal-conductivity fluorescent colloid, a high-thermal-conductivity white light LD and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the high-thermal-conductivity fluorescent colloid comprises the following steps: fully mixing ammonium bicarbonate, non-light-absorbing heat-conducting filler and fluorescent material according to a preset proportion; pressurizing the mixed powder to obtain a flaky mixture; placing the flaky mixture in a high-temperature environment, and heating and decomposing the ammonium bicarbonate into gas to escape to obtain a three-dimensional cross-linked high-thermal-conductivity framework; and injecting the high molecular colloid into the three-dimensional cross-linked high-thermal-conductivity framework to fill the gaps of the three-dimensional cross-linked high-thermal-conductivity framework with the high molecular colloid, and curing to obtain the three-dimensional cross-linked high-thermal-conductivity fluorescent colloid. The invention can enable light energy to smoothly emit from the gap of the high-heat-conduction framework, and can lead out heat generated by the fluorescent material in time while maintaining the optical performance, thereby effectively reducing the working temperature of the fluorescent colloid, ensuring the long-term working reliability of the white light LD and having very wide application prospect.

title_en: Spraying-free resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spraying-free resin and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of modified high polymer materials. The spraying-free resin comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of thermoplastic resin, 0.5-5 parts of pigment, 0.25-2 parts of hyperbranched polymer and 0.1-35 parts of auxiliary agent, wherein the hyperbranched polymer contains terminal functional groups. The hyperbranched polymer containing the terminal functional groups in the spraying-free resin can obviously improve the rheological property of the material so as to reduce related weld marks and flow marks, can utilize rich terminal functional groups to be in physical-chemical bonding with pigments so as to drive the pigments to be better dispersed, has better compatibility with the resin and reduces aluminum powder overturning by using a steric effect, thereby reducing the weld marks and the flow marks, ensuring that the spraying-free resin has good appearance effect, further playing the role of enhancing toughening impact resistance, ensuring that the material has good mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to the fields of electronic appliances, sports goods, office supplies and transportation.

title_en: Bimodal polyethylene homopolymer compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyolefin composition free of nucleating agents and free of LLDPE for use in the manufacture of films having enhanced barrier properties against water vapor and oxygen transmission. Related aspects include formulations, articles of manufacture, films, and methods.

title_en: Electrochemical polymerization-based polypyrrole micro additive manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemical additive manufacturing, and particularly relates to a polypyrrole micro-additive manufacturing method based on electrochemical polymerization. The invention discloses a polypyrrole micro additive manufacturing method based on electrochemical polymerization, which can complete synthesis and forming of polypyrrole in one step and reduce the loss of leftover materials in the step-by-step processing process; meanwhile, the requirement on uniformity and continuity of micro additive manufacturing can be met, the feasibility of the application of polypyrrole in the field of electrochemical micro additive manufacturing is realized, and a new idea is provided for 3D micro additive manufacturing of conductive high polymer polypyrrole; in addition, the limitation that the traditional additive manufacturing synthesis process only can be used for plane synthesis is broken through, and the forming design of 3D polypyrrole products in different shapes can be carried out according to human will.

title_en: Method for separating plant volatile aromatic substances and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for separating plant volatile aromatic substances and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing plant volatile aromatic substances with an ethanol water solution to obtain a feed liquid; (2) and (2) circularly separating the feed liquid obtained in the step (1) by adopting a pervaporation device, wherein a pervaporation membrane adopted by the pervaporation device comprises a polydimethylsiloxane/polyvinylidene fluoride composite membrane. According to the invention, the polydimethylsiloxane/polyvinylidene fluoride composite membrane is adopted to separate plant volatile aromatic substances, and the ethanol is added at the feed side of pervaporation, so that the ethanol has the effects of demulsification, solubilization and swelling of a polydimethylsiloxane separation layer, the solubility of the plant aromatic substances can be improved, the structure of the separation layer can be effectively improved, and the osmotic diffusion of the plant aromatic substances in the membrane phase is promoted, thereby improving the separation efficiency; the reaction condition required in the separation process is mild, green, low in consumption and simple in process; permeate flux can be increased by about 20%.

title_en: Fluorine-containing ether compound, composition, and article having water-and oil-repellent layer
abstract_en: Provided are a fluorine-containing ether compound capable of forming a water-and oil-repellent layer having excellent abrasion resistance on a metal surface of a substrate, a composition, and a belt-repellentWater repellent oil repellent layer. The fluorine-containing ether compound of the present invention is represented by the formula [ R ] f ‑(OX) m ‑O‑] j1 Y 1 ‑Z 1 [‑L 1 ‑S‑R 11 ] g11 [R 12 ] g12 And (4) showing. title_en: Conductive hydrogel based on chitosan/xanthan gum interpenetrating network and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chitosan/xanthan gum interpenetrating network-based conductive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of natural biological high polymer materials. Dissolving CS with acidic substance GDL, and making-NH of CS during preparation  2  Protonating, combining with-COOH of XG and PEDOT-HA in the system, forming conductive hydrogel with stable structure after completing crosslinking, and then preparing the dry scaffold by utilizing a freeze drying technology. The GDL is a green acidic substance, has the characteristics of step ionization and slow pH change, and other chemical cross-linking agents are not required to be added in the preparation process, so that the preparation process is simple. The conductive hydrogel support prepared by the invention has good water absorption, high porosity, proper conductivity and mechanical property; the nerve tissue repair is completed by simulating the micro-electric environment of the nerve cell life in vitro; SEM pictures of cells on the scaffold show that the scaffold contains a large number of cells, and the cells form a staggered network structure, so that the prepared conductive hydrogel scaffold has the potential of being applied to nerve tissue engineering.

title_en: High-absorption resin with in-situ antibacterial property and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: A high-absorptivity resin of sodium polyacrylate with in-situ antibacterial performance is prepared through adding acrolein component with reduction action to silver ion in the formula of conventional high-absorptivity resin of sodium polyacrylate, polymerizing, adding silver nitrate solution, and oxidizing-reducing reaction.

title_en: Catalyst for polyester depolymerization or cyclic ester synthesis, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for polyester depolymerization or cyclic ester synthesis, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is a long-chain catalyst with a main chain carbon atom number more than or equal to 8 and containing a terminal ion group and a terminal hydroxyl structure, and is prepared by combining some classical reactions: the catalyst is prepared by quaternization reaction, Lewis acid-base neutralization reaction, ring-opening polymerization reaction, esterification polycondensation reaction, Bronsted acid-base neutralization reaction, ester bond alkaline hydrolysis reaction and double decomposition reaction, and can be used for catalyzing polyester hydrolysis, alcoholysis or cyclic depolymerization to recover corresponding monomers or monomers and oligomers or catalyzing hydroxy acid or hydroxy acid ester to synthesize cyclic ester monomers or cyclic ester monomers and cyclic oligomers through polycondensation and cyclization reaction. The catalyst can reduce the viscosity of a reaction system, greatly improve the utilization rate of a catalytic active center, reduce the consumption of the catalyst, improve the overall catalytic efficiency, realize the high-efficiency, high-yield and selective depolymerization of polyester homopolymerization, copolymerization, blending or a compound, is simple to operate and is convenient for industrial production.

title_en: 3D printing polyether-ether-ketone interlayer reinforcing material, preparation method thereof and 3D printing forming method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of 3D printing materials, and provides a 3D printing polyether-ether-ketone interlayer reinforcing material, a preparation method thereof and a 3D printing forming method. The 3D printing polyether-ether-ketone interlayer reinforcing material provided by the invention is a quadripolymer of an interlayer reinforcing monomer, a conjugated group monomer, hydroquinone and 4,4' -difluorobenzophenone, wherein the introduction of the conjugated group monomer can increase the physical entanglement among molecular chains and maintain the mechanical strength of a material body; the addition of the interlayer reinforcing monomer can play a role in reducing crystallization rate and increasing interlayer healing time, so that the interlayer bonding strength of the polyether-ether-ketone material can be effectively improved. Meanwhile, the 3D printing polyether-ether-ketone interlayer reinforcing material provided by the invention is appropriate in viscosity, has higher strength and melting point and good high temperature resistance, and has wide application prospects in the field of 3D printing.

title_en: Preparation method and application of acylamino polyaspartic acid ester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of acylamino polyaspartic acid ester, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) reacting maleic anhydride with aliphatic primary amine, and then adding N, N-dimethylacrylamide for reaction to obtain maleic acid amide ester; (2) carrying out esterification reaction on the obtained maleic acid amide ester and alcohol; (3) and (3) reacting the esterification product obtained in the step (2) with aliphatic primary amine to obtain the amido polyaspartic acid ester. According to the invention, an amido group is introduced into a polyaspartic acid ester molecular chain, and when the polyaspartic acid ester molecular chain is applied to the PAE polyurea coating, the operation time of the coating can be prolonged; meanwhile, the introduction of the amide group can lead the coating to have stronger strength, adhesive force, wear resistance and corrosion resistance.

title_en: MOFs crystal material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an MOFs crystal material and preparation and application thereof. The MOFs crystal material has a chemical formula shown in a formula I: [ Ln (TPDB). 2 DMF.2H  2  O]X is of formula I; wherein Ln is Gd  3+  、Eu  3+  、Tb  3+  At least one of; TPDB  2‑  From H  2  Deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of TPDB; h  2  TPDB is 2',5' -diphenyl- [1,1':4', 1' -terphenyl]-4,4 "-dicarboxylic acid; DMF is dimethylformamide; x is NO  3‑  、Cl  ‑  At least one of (1). The MOFs crystal material has the characteristics of high crystallinity and high purity, and has good stability. The preparation method is simple and easy to implement. The MOFs crystal material can be used as a fluorescent air pressure probe to be made into an MOF fluorescent pressure sensor, and the change of air pressure can be conveniently and visually observed according to the intensity of fluorescence.

title_en: Magnetic nanofiber aerogel for thick oil separation
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic nanofiber aerogel for thick oil separation, which is prepared by melting and blending magnetic particles and nanofibers, crosslinking the magnetic nanofiber aerogel with a crosslinking agent to obtain the magnetic nanofiber aerogel, and performing surface hydrophobic modification treatment on the magnetic nanofiber aerogel to obtain the super-hydrophobic magnetic nanofiber aerogel. The magnetic particles can be uniformly and effectively attached to the nanofibers by melting and blending the magnetic particles and the nanofibers, so that the magnetic particles are uniformly distributed in the finally prepared aerogel; by using the hydrophobic resin solution mixed with the hydrophobic particles to perform surface hydrophobic modification on the nanofiber aerogel, the hydrophobic particles can be attached to the surface of the aerogel by means of the viscosity of the hydrophobic resin solution, and meanwhile, the hydrophobic particles can be fixed on the surface of the aerogel as the hydrophobic resin solution is cured on the surface of the aerogel. Through the method, the magnetic particles in the prepared super-hydrophobic magnetic nanofiber aerogel are uniformly distributed and have uniform hydrophobicity.

title_en: Preparation method of liquid silicone rubber
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of liquid silicone rubber, which comprises the following steps: mixing 86.1 parts by mass of the component A with 13.9 parts by mass of copper calcium titanate powder to obtain a first mixture; mixing 86.1 parts by mass of the component B with 13.9 parts by mass of copper calcium titanate powder to obtain a second mixture; and mixing the first mixture and the second mixture to obtain the liquid silicone rubber. By adopting the method, the copper calcium titanate powder and the high-viscosity liquid silicone rubber finished product can be well mixed, the mixed copper calcium titanate powder particles are uniformly filled, the agglomeration degree is small, and the bubbles are few, so that the performance of the modified liquid silicone rubber material reaches the design requirement, the good flowing performance can be ensured, and the vacuum injection molding of large products is facilitated.

title_en: Preparation method of polybenzazole modified graphene oxide/fluoroboric acrylate composite antifouling coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polybenzazole modified graphene oxide/fluoroboric acrylate composite antifouling coating, which comprises the following steps: copolymerizing hexafluorobutyl methacrylate in a polymer main chain through free radical polymerization to prepare an acrylic acid fluorine polymer, and grafting TPBP in an acrylic acid fluorine polymer side chain by utilizing a proton exchange reaction to prepare an acrylic Acid Fluorine Boron Polymer (AFBP); GO is prepared by an improved Hummers method, indole is copolymerized on the surface of graphene oxide by an in-situ chemical oxidation method and is coated on the surface of the graphene oxide, and the polybenzazole modified graphene oxide (PGO) nanofiller is prepared. And obtaining the polybenzazole modified graphene oxide/acrylic acid fluorine boron composite antifouling coating through ultrasonic dispersion and spin coating. The invention has the advantages that: the water resistance of the coating is improved. The hydrophobicity of the coating is enhanced, the antifouling performance of the coating is improved, and the coating has the characteristic of environmental friendliness.

title_en: Anti-doodling and anti-sticking coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-doodling and anti-sticking coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the coating comprises the following components: diisocyanate, perfluoropolyether diol, secondary aminosilane, a defoaming agent, a catalyst and an organic solvent; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing-NCO end capping fluorine-containing prepolymer from diisocyanate and perfluoropolyether diol according to the molar mass ratio of-NCO group to-OH group of 2:1, then preparing anti-doodling resin from the-NCO end capping fluorine-containing prepolymer and secondary aminosilane according to the molar mass ratio of-NCO group to-NH-group of 1:1, and finally adding a defoaming agent, a catalyst and an organic solvent into an anti-doodling resin reaction kettle to obtain the anti-doodling and anti-sticking coating. After the doodling agent is placed for 48 hours at room temperature, the doodling trace can be completely erased by using the dry cotton cloth or the dry paper towel, and the effective components cannot be gradually separated out along with the increase of the use time.

title_en: Process for preparing polyester carbonates
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing aliphatic polyester carbonates, said polyester carbonates themselves, and molding compounds and molded bodies containing said polyester carbonates. The process according to the invention is characterized in particular in that it comprises three steps, and the last step is a melt transesterification process in the presence of two catalysts.

title_en: Carbon black master batch for piano black high impact polypropylene material capable of eliminating surface pits and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon black master batch for a piano black high impact polypropylene material for eliminating surface pits and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer modification. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly mixing high-pigment carbon black with a silane coupling agent, stearate and mineral white oil at high speed to obtain pre-dispersed carbon black, then blending, extruding and granulating the pre-dispersed carbon black with general-purpose polystyrene and maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene to form initial polar carbon black master batch, and finally blending, extruding and granulating the initial polar carbon black master batch with high-melt-index homo-polypropylene, low-melt-index LLDPE and maleic anhydride grafted polypropylene to form a carbon black master batch finished product. When the carbon black master batch prepared by the preparation method is used in a polypropylene material, the piano black effect that the surface of the polypropylene material is smooth and free of pits and the blackness is lower than 31 can be achieved.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, partition wall, organic electroluminescent element, and image display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a photosensitive material which can control the height difference and has ink-jet coating performanceA resin composition. The photosensitive resin composition of the present invention contains (a) a photopolymerization initiator, (B) an alkali-soluble resin, (C) a photopolymerizable compound, and (D) a liquid repellent, wherein the (a) photopolymerization initiator contains a photopolymerization initiator represented by the following general formula (I), the (D) liquid repellent contains an acrylic resin (D1), and the acrylic resin (D1) contains a repeating unit represented by the following general formula (II) and a fluorine atom.

title_en: Production device of melamine resin for soundproof and flame-retardant mineral wool board for suspended ceiling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production device of melamine resin for a sound-insulation flame-retardant mineral wool board for a suspended ceiling, which comprises a lifting driving mechanism, a sliding assembly, a stirring mechanism and a kettle body, wherein the lifting driving mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the kettle body, the stirring mechanism positioned in the kettle body is arranged at the driving end of the lifting driving mechanism, the sliding assembly connected with the inner wall of the kettle body in a sliding and sealing manner is arranged on the stirring mechanism, the sliding assembly comprises a sliding base and an opening and closing mechanism arranged on the sliding base and allowing fluid to pass through, the stirring mechanism is arranged on the sliding base, the stirring mechanism comprises a plurality of stirrers, a rotation driving mechanism driving the stirrers to rotate upwards and a rotating shaft, and an air inlet channel and an air outlet channel are arranged on the rotating shaft.

title_en: Waterborne modified polyester paint for lunch boxes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fine chemical coatings, in particular to a water-based modified polyester paint for lunch boxes, which comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 50-75% of water-based modified polyester resin, 0.1-0.3% of dimethylethanolamine, 7-15% of amino resin, 0.5-3% of closed isocyanate, 0.5-5% of phenylamine resin, 1-5% of adhesion promoter, 0.1-1% of drier, 15-45% of deionized water or 15-20% of water-based color paste, 0.05-0.3% of defoaming agent, 0.05-0.3% of flatting agent and 0-5% of color concentrate. The invention has the advantage of providing the safe and environment-friendly lunch box paint with low non-oily VOC content.

title_en: Functionalized polymer tread additives for improved four season tire performance
abstract_en: Elastomeric compositions are disclosed. The elastomeric composition comprises, per 100 parts by weight of rubber (phr): about 20 to about 40phr of a polybutadiene having a cis-1, 4 linkage content of at least 95%; about 40 to about 70phr of styrene/butadiene copolymer; about 5 to about 30phr natural rubber or polyisoprene; a curing agent; an antioxidant; about 1 to about 20phr carbon black; from about 1 to about 30phr of plasticizing oil; about 40 to about 80phr silica; from about 1 to about 15phr of a silane coupling agent and from about 5 to about 30phr of a polymer selected from the group consisting of: ethylene-propylene-diene terpolymers, butyl rubber, poly (isobutylene-co-p-methylstyrene), and poly (isobutylene-co-p-methylstyrene-co-isoprene) terpolymers.

title_en: Pyrimidine-cyclodextrin polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pyrimidine-cyclodextrin polymer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, oxidizing beta-cyclodextrin by using periodate to prepare aldehyde cyclodextrin; then carrying out cross-linking reaction with 4-amino-6-hydroxy-2-mercaptopyrimidine to obtain cyclodextrin polymerization microspheres; and calcining the cyclodextrin polymerization microspheres to obtain the pyrimidine-cyclodextrin polymer. Compared with the prior art, the polymer photocatalyst prepared by the invention has better absorption capacity in visible light and near infrared regions, has a proper energy band structure, can generate hydrogen peroxide through two ways of catalytic oxygen reduction and water oxidation under the condition of visible light without an electron donor and pH adjustment, and can be further used for in-situ sterilization under the irradiation of visible light in a natural water body.

title_en: Environment-friendly coating inhibitor for drilling fluid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coating inhibitor for an environment-friendly drilling fluid, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: acrylamide, methacryloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride, 3-acryloxypropionic acid, N- (2-methacryloxyethyl) pyrrolidone, deionized water, and azodiisobutylamidine hydrochloride. In addition, a preparation method of the coating inhibitor for the environment-friendly drilling fluid is also disclosed. The coating inhibitor for the environment-friendly drilling fluid improves coating inhibition performance, especially high-temperature coating performance.

title_en: Deep ultraviolet light-promoted degradation epoxy material, composite coating, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep ultraviolet light-promoted degradation epoxy material, a composite coating, and a preparation method and application thereof. The deep ultraviolet light-promoted degradation epoxy material comprises a bio-based epoxy monomer and/or a bio-based epoxy curing agent, and has a structure shown as the following formula: preparation of the inventionThe deep ultraviolet light-promoted degradation epoxy resin condensate not only has the mechanical property and the thermodynamic property which are comparable to those of petroleum-based epoxy condensate, but also has the controllable graded degradation property under the mild condition, and can replace the application of the prior petroleum-based epoxy resin in the traditional field.

title_en: Green building material with good heat preservation performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green building material with good heat preservation performance, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of cement, 20-40 parts of filler, 5-10 parts of cross-linked polyimide aerogel, 2-5 parts of light material, 2-5 parts of foaming agent, 1-2 parts of thickening agent and 70-90 parts of water. According to the invention, the aerogel material with higher strength, hydrophobicity and good heat insulation is prepared by imidizing the flexible 4,4 '-diaminodiphenyl ether, the 2,2' -dimethylbenzidine and the biphenyl tetracarboxylic dianhydride and using the trichloromethyl carbonate as a cross-linking agent, and the prepared building material has good mechanical property, flame retardance and good heat insulation effect.

title_en: Deodorizing insole based on antibacterial fibers and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insoles, in particular to a deodorizing insole based on antibacterial fibers and a preparation method thereof, wherein the deodorizing insole comprises a surface layer, a bottom layer and an antibacterial fiber layer sewn between the surface layer and the bottom layer, the antibacterial fiber layer comprises antibacterial fibers and polyester, and the antibacterial fibers are prepared by copolymerization reaction of quaternary phosphonium salt and cellulose; the invention adopts the quaternary phosphonium salt with high-efficiency antibacterial function and makes the quaternary phosphonium salt covalently bonded on the cellulose through the acrylamide, thereby leading the quaternary phosphonium salt to be stably positioned in the cellulose, effectively avoiding the quaternary phosphonium salt from being separated from the cellulose and further improving the antibacterial continuity of the insole; by copolymerization reaction of the quaternary phosphonium salt and the cellulose, the defects that the grafting quantity of antibacterial groups and the distribution in products are difficult to control due to the fact that the quaternary phosphonium salt is grafted on the cellulose are effectively overcome.

title_en: Single and double direction solid phase stretching processing method for regenerated mixed plastic material
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-direction and two-direction solid-phase stretching processing method of a regenerated hybrid plastic material, which comprises the steps of firstly recovering multi-component hybrid plastic wastes mainly comprising polypropylene, polyethylene terephthalate and nylon 6, grinding the multi-component hybrid plastic wastes through a grinding disc type solid-phase mechanochemical reactor, uniformly mixing the collected superfine hybrid powder with high-density polyethylene powder and a polyolefin elastomer, then carrying out extrusion granulation to prepare a plate, and finally carrying out solid-phase stretching treatment to prepare a high-strength, high-toughness and transparent composite film, thereby realizing high-value recovery and reutilization of the multi-component hybrid plastic wastes.

title_en: Super-elastic aramid nanofiber aerogel, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a superelastic aramid nanofiber aerogel, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving aramid fiber in alkali and organic solvent and reacting to form homogeneous dispersion of aramid nanofiber; compounding the aramid nanofiber dispersion liquid and the slow-release gel, standing for gel after homogenization is completed, and aging to obtain an aramid nanofiber wet gel; and (3) carrying out solvent replacement and gas-liquid exchange drying on the composite material, and then carrying out high-temperature heat treatment in a selected atmosphere to obtain the superelastic aramid nanofiber aerogel. The super elastic aramid nanofiber aerogel provided by the invention has extremely low apparent density, high porosity, excellent mechanical property and low heat conductivity coefficient, and has excellent compression retraction elasticity and heat insulation performance, and has wide application prospects in the fields of mechanical compression, thermal management, sound absorption and noise reduction, environmental management, intelligent sensing, clean energy, electronic information and the like.

title_en: Cyclic regeneration method of polyimide sponge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycling method of polyimide sponge, belongs to the technical field of polyimide porous materials, and solves the technical problems that existing polyimide foams and polyimide aerogel are low in preparation efficiency, difficult in component recycling, non-sustainable in materials and the like. According to the method for recycling the polyimide sponge, disclosed by the invention, hydraulic defibering and mechanical defibering are combined, so that a toxic and harmful polar solvent is avoided, green recycling and sustainable preparation of fiber components in the polyimide porous material are realized, and the performance of the polyimide porous material prepared in a recycling manner is equivalent to that of a raw material; the method solves the problems of low preparation efficiency, difficult component recycling, non-sustainable material and the like of the existing polyimide foam and polyimide aerogel, and provides a new method and possibility for the cyclic preparation and the green sustainable development of the polyimide porous material.

title_en: Flame-retardant dust suppressant for coal and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal flame-retardant dust suppressants, and relates to a DT-WPU coal flame-retardant dust suppressant, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 7.35-10.0 parts of polyester polyol, 4.88-5.08 parts of isocyanate, 0.02-0.04 parts of catalyst, 0.65-0.75 parts of hydrophilic chain extender, 0.3-0.75 parts of modifier, 13.0-18.0 parts of solvent, 0.28-0.7 parts of small molecule chain extender, 0.49-0.62 parts of neutralizer, 0.02-0.04 parts of post-chain extender and 38-44 parts of deionized water; the modifier is phosphorus-containing compound DOPO-THPO. The DOPO-THPO is adopted to modify the WPU, so that the flame retardant property of the WPU is obviously improved, the DT-WPU coal flame retardant dust suppressant is environment-friendly and excellent in performance, and coal dust pollution and coal dust loss in the process of mining, storage and transportation can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Device for preparing polythioether rubber by continuous light synthesis
abstract_en: The device comprises a material mixing kettle, a liquid material tank, a nitrogen bottle, a solid material injection reaction kettle, a flow meter, a synthesis reaction kettle, a water washing kettle, a water drier, a dewatering drier, a water washing kettle, a dewatering drier and a nitrogen bottle.

title_en: Polypeptide chelate potassium-based compound fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a polypeptide chelate potassium-based compound fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the application has reasonable process design and proper component proportion, the polypeptide chelate potassium and urea are mixed to be used as a core layer fertilizer, and the core layer fertilizer contains amino acid, trace elements and nitrogen elements required by plant growth, is easy to be absorbed by plants, and can effectively play a role in fattening; according to the application, polyurethane is adopted to coat the core layer fertilizer so as to realize the slow release effect of the core layer fertilizer, the frying waste oil is used as a raw material to prepare the polyurethane coating material, the waste frying waste oil is utilized to process, waste is changed into valuable, the cost is reduced, and the utilization rate of the waste oil is also improved.

title_en: Response type nucleic acid delivery system, preparation method thereof and cross-linked polymer carrier
abstract_en: The invention provides a responsive nucleic acid delivery system, which comprises a nucleic acid and a cross-linked polymer coated on the surface of the nucleic acid; the cross-linked polymer is formed by cross-linking and polymerizing functional monomers; the functional monomer comprises a cationic polymerization monomer, a monomer containing phosphorylcholine groups and a crosslinking monomer containing disulfide bonds; the cationic polymerization monomer comprises imidazole monomer. Compared with the prior art, the cross-linked polymer is coated on the surface of the nucleic acid to serve as the carrier, so that the stability is higher, after the cross-linked polymer is taken by cells, lysosomes can be damaged in the acidic environment of the lysosomes through the imidazole group proton sponge effect, lysosome escape is realized, after the cross-linked polymer is transferred to cytoplasm, the carrier can respond to the high GSH environment in tumor cells, the reticular polymer shell is cracked, the release of the nucleic acid is realized, the response of a nucleic acid delivery system to the GSH and the capability of releasing the nucleic acid are improved, and the cellular uptake and transfection efficiency of the nucleic acid delivery system is also improved.

title_en: Preparation method of coating type color-changing TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) color-changing film
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a coating type color-changing TPU color-changing film, which relates to the field of color-changing films and comprises the following steps: (1) coating a functional coating on one surface of the TPU film, and baking and curing to obtain a pretreated film; (2) carrying out plasma etching treatment on the other side of the pretreated film, and then obtaining a surface modified TPU film; (3) and uniformly coating a layer of water-based color adhesive on the etched surface of the surface modified TPU film, baking, drying and curing, and adhering a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer to the surface of the water-based color adhesive layer to obtain the coating type TPU color-modified film. According to the invention, the TPU film is subjected to plasma bias etching treatment in advance, so that a nano-scale pattern is formed on the film, the roughness of the surface of the film is increased, the contact surface between the rubber material and the film is increased, the combination of the color rubber layer and the film is facilitated, the firmness of the color rubber layer is improved, the color rubber layer is not easy to fall off, and the overall performance of the film is better improved due to the improvement of the firmness of the coating and the film.

title_en: Preparation method of carbon dioxide-based polycarbonate polyol product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon dioxide-based polycarbonate polyol product, which comprises the following two steps: (1) Synthesis of catalyst: adding urea, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, triethylamine and N, N-dimethylformamide for dissolution and reaction; after reduced pressure distillation, zinc acetate and cobalt oxalate are added to obtain a catalyst system; (2) Synthesis of polycarbonate polyol: introducing nitrogen to remove air in the system, dropwise adding an initiator, propylene oxide and ethylene oxide, introducing carbon dioxide, heating and stirring for reaction; and after the reaction is finished, adding the polycarbonate polyol, adjusting the pH, filtering, and distilling under reduced pressure to obtain a polycarbonate polyol product. The invention realizes the controllable synthesis of the carbon dioxide-based polycarbonate polyol product, has the advantages of short preparation process route, safe and nontoxic catalyst, chemical carbon fixation, adjustable hydroxyl value and viscosity of the product, stable performance, biodegradability and the like, can be independently used as a raw material for producing polyurethane materials, and can also be mixed with other polyols for use.

title_en: Diamino polyether surfactant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a diamino polyether surfactant, which has the following structural formula: a method for preparing a diamino polyether surfactant, comprising the following steps: (1) Adding a certain amount of fatty amine into an autoclave, adding a proper amount of alkali, vacuumizing, exhausting air, heating to 80-150 ℃, stirring, slowly adding a certain amount of ethylene oxide for reacting for 5-10 hours, and adding a certain amount of propylene oxide for reacting for 5-10 hours to obtain an intermediate product; (2) Adding a proper amount of alcohol solvent into an autoclave, then dripping a certain amount of dihalogenated hydrocarbon, regulating the temperature to 60-120 ℃, and then carrying out reflux condensation reaction or stirring reaction for 8-20h through a reflux pipe, thereby obtaining the diaminopolyether surfactant after the reaction is completed.

title_en: Negative photosensitive resin composition and method for producing cured relief pattern
abstract_en: The invention provides a negative photosensitive resin composition which shows high definition when forming a relief pattern on a copper wiring, can fully perform imidization even if the curing temperature is low, and can manufacture a cured relief pattern with good adhesion with the copper wiring, and a cured relief pattern manufactured by using the negative photosensitive resin compositionA method of patterning. The negative photosensitive resin composition includes: (A) a polyimide precursor containing a structural unit represented by a specific general formula (1) and (B) a photopolymerization initiator, wherein the structural unit contains a 1-valent organic group having a urea structure.

title_en: Green and environment-friendly rubber asphalt and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of asphalt preparation, and discloses green environment-friendly rubber asphalt and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the main preparation raw materials of the green environment-friendly rubber asphalt comprise the following components in parts by weight: 80-120 parts of road petroleum asphalt, 10-20 parts of waste rubber powder, 5-15 parts of calcium nitrate, 5-15 parts of nano calcium carbonate, 5-15 parts of inorganic desulfurizer, 5-30 parts of modifier, 0.1-2 parts of stabilizer, 1-5 parts of surfactant and 15-60 parts of water; the road petroleum asphalt is any one of 50#, 70#, and 90 #. The preparation method is simple and environment-friendly; the preparation raw materials are easy to obtain, and the cost is low; the preparation process is safe and does not release harmful gases. Is beneficial to the engineering popularization and application.

title_en: Preparation method of super water-absorbing material and super water-absorbing material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymeric functional high molecular compounds, in particular to a preparation method of a super absorbent material and the super absorbent material. A method for preparing a super absorbent material comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a first monomer, a second monomer and water to obtain a mixed solution; wherein the first monomer comprises at least one of acrylic acid and sodium acrylate, and the second monomer comprises 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid and 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid sodium salt; (2) heating the mixed solution to a preset temperature, and carrying out polymerization reaction at the preset temperature to obtain a polymer solution; (3) and (3) taking the polymer solution as a spinning solution, and preparing the super absorbent material by an electrostatic spinning process. The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of a super absorbent material, and the super absorbent material with excellent absorption rate and water absorption rate can be provided.

title_en: Self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent and anti-seepage method
abstract_en: A self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent and an anti-seepage method are disclosed, wherein the self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 15-20% of main monomer, 3-8% of temperature-resistant and salt-resistant monomer, 0.5-3% of acid-sensitive monomer, 0.02-0.05% of water-soluble initiator and the balance of water. The proportion of different anti-seepage agents is adjusted by adopting the types and the using amounts of the different anti-seepage agents so as to change the degradation characteristics of the anti-seepage agents, and finally, the soil is recovered after the operation is finished. The formula can be adjusted according to the mining age of the ore body so as to change the cage breaking time node. By adopting the method, the problems of incapability of recovering functions of the soil after the mining and the selection, ecological environment damage and the like caused by a permanent impermeable layer can be effectively solved, and the green mine construction is powerfully promoted.

title_en: Regeneration process and regeneration device for waste rubber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regeneration process and a regeneration device for waste rubber, which relate to the technical field of rubber regeneration, and comprise a material mixing unit, a shearing decoupling unit, a self-adaptive circulation unit and a material receiving unit which are sequentially communicated; the process comprises the following steps: putting the waste rubber powder and the regeneration auxiliary agent into a mixing unit in proportion for mixing; after the material mixing is finished, the rubber material is conveyed between two rollers of the shearing and decoupling unit, and after passing through a gap between the two rollers, the rubber material is scraped to the self-adaptive circulating unit by a scraper to continuously circulate through the rollers, so that the rubber material shearing and decoupling process is finished; and conveying the fully sheared and de-linked regenerated rubber material to a cooling unit to complete the regeneration process. The device can ensure the continuity and automation of the regeneration process of the waste rubber, greatly reduce the regeneration process flow, equipment investment and occupied area, reduce the working strength and improve the production efficiency. The process adopts a normal-temperature process, can realize normal-temperature environment-friendly zero-emission regeneration of the waste rubber, and improves the comprehensive performance and the application added value of the regenerated rubber.

title_en: PC/ABS alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a PC/ABS alloy and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of high polymer materials. The PC/ABS alloy comprises the following components in parts by weight: 60-80 parts of polycarbonate; 20-40 parts of ABS plastic; 3-5 parts of a compatibilizer; 0-4 parts of a lubricant; 2-5 parts of red phosphorus master batch; 5-10 parts of a toughening agent; wherein, the red phosphorus master batch comprises the following components by taking the total mass percentage of the components in the red phosphorus master batch as 100 percent: 10 to 50 percent of red phosphorus; 50 to 90 percent of dispersant. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can not only reduce the addition of red phosphorus, but also uniformly disperse the red phosphorus in the PC/ABS alloy, and simultaneously has good flame retardant effect, and can not cause the mechanical property of the PC/ABS alloy to be obviously deteriorated.

title_en: Chain scission to prepare improved polymers for 3D printing
abstract_en: The end-capped condensation polymer may be formed by: heating the polycondensate in the presence of an end-capping compound to form a cleaved polycondensate, and reacting at least a portion of the cleaved polycondensate with the end-capping compound to form an end-capped polycondensate. The end-capped condensation polymers may be used to form additive manufactured articles having high solids loadings and improved processing due to improved rheological properties.

title_en: High-performance self-repairing polyurethane elastomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A high-performance self-repairing polyurethane elastomer and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of self-repairing materials, and particularly relate to a preparation method of a high-performance self-repairing polyurethane elastomer. The invention aims to solve the problems of low repair efficiency and poor mechanical property of the self-repairing polyurethane elastomer prepared by the existing method. The structural formula of the high-performance self-repairing polyurethane elastomer is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: first, prepare 5- (2 hydroxyethyl) -6-methyl2-semicarbazide pyrimidine base; secondly, preparing a polyurethane prepolymer with quadruple hydrogen bonds; and thirdly, adding furfuryl alcohol or furfuryl ammonia, adding the solvent and the 4,4' -bismaleimide diphenylmethane, stirring for reaction, and forming. The high-performance self-repairing polyurethane elastomer prepared by the invention has the characteristics of high strength, high toughness, quick self-repairing, repeated cyclic utilization, good thermal stability and the like, and has wide application prospects in the aspects of functional coatings, electronic wearable equipment and the like.

title_en: Organic zinc antibacterial powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic zinc antibacterial powder and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the organic zinc antibacterial powder takes a novel quaternary ammonium salt antibacterial agent as a reaction raw material, the novel quaternary ammonium salt antibacterial agent is dimethyl octadecyl [3- (trimethoxy silicon-based) propyl ] ammonium chloride or dimethyl octadecyl [3- (triethoxy silicon-based) propyl ] ammonium chloride, the crosslinking capability is increased by changing the groups of the original quaternary ammonium salt material, the novel quaternary ammonium salt antibacterial agent is easier to become a high polymer material, meanwhile, the introduced zinc material better enhances the bactericidal property, and the crosslinked organic zinc antibacterial powder has the stability and adaptability of inorganic materials, the dispersibility and antibacterial property of organic materials, and the defect of antibacterial master batch/plastic materials under the existing inorganic or organic systems is overcome.

title_en: Method for manufacturing double-sided adhesive tape with TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) as base material
abstract_en: The application provides a method for manufacturing a double-sided adhesive tape with TPU as a base material, which comprises the following steps of (A) manufacturing a TPU base layer; (B) manufacturing a low-surface-energy applicable adhesive layer, and attaching the adhesive layer to the TPU base layer; (C) the adhesive layer with medium and high surface energy is manufactured and is attached to the TPU base layer, the thickness of the TPU base layer is 30-250 um, the tensile strength is 5-95 MPa, and the elongation at break is 450-1500%. The novel TPU double-sided adhesive tape solves the bonding problem of low-surface-energy TPU foam or silicone rubber on common plastic materials by innovatively introducing a TPU base material and matching low-surface-energy applicable adhesive and polyacrylic resin with double surfaces suitable for different surface energies, and has the advantages of elasticity and weather resistance.

title_en: Foam control composition
abstract_en: Foam control compositions and formulations thereof, and the use of the foam control compositions and formulations thereof in various applications, including a process for preparing a foam control composition comprising a crosslinked polyorganosiloxane material including dispersed silica filler, the process comprising the steps of: A) a hydrosilylation reaction mixture was prepared by combining the following components: (i) a silica filler; (ii) (iv) a polyorganosiloxane having at least two reactive substituents capable of addition reaction with component (iii) by hydrosilylation; (iii) (iii) a polyorganosiloxane having at least three reactive substituents capable of addition reaction with component (ii) by hydrosilylation; and (iv) a hydrosilylation catalyst; B) (iv) conducting the hydrosilylation reaction of components (ii) and (iii) until the reaction mixture at least partially gels to form a hydrosilylation reaction product; C) shearing the hydrosilylation reaction product of step B); and D) combining the hydrosilylation reaction product of step C) with (v) a silicone resin and (vi) a condensation catalyst to form a condensation reaction mixture, and performing a condensation reaction between (v) the silicone resin and the hydrosilylation reaction product of step C) to form a condensation reaction product.

title_en: High-impact-resistance oil-resistant paint PC/PBT alloy material for plastic part vehicle body cover plate, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of high polymer materials, in particular to a high-impact-resistance oil-resistant paint PC/PBT alloy material for a plastic part vehicle body cover plate, a preparation method and application; the alloy material comprises the following raw materials: siloxane polycarbonate, polybutylene terephthalate, a compound toughening agent and an ester exchange inhibitor; the method comprises the following steps: premixing the siloxane polycarbonate, the polybutylene terephthalate and the white mineral oil to obtain an initial mixed material; mixing the initial mixed material, the compound toughening agent and the ester exchange inhibitor to obtain a secondary mixed material; extruding the secondary mixed material to obtain a high-impact-resistance and high-oil-resistance PC/PBT alloy material; by using an organic silicon group in the siloxane polycarbonate and compounding the toughening agent, the fluidity and the processing performance of the alloy material are improved, so that the contact surface between the alloy material and the acrylic primer is less, the corrosion is reduced, and the mechanical property retention rate of the material is higher.

title_en: Water-based UV-curable antifogging coating and preparation and application methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based UV curing antifogging coating and a preparation and application method thereof, wherein a polymer A with a thiolactone side chain containing thiolactone is prepared by utilizing the reaction characteristic of the thiolactone containing double bonds, a polymer B with a hydrophilic group and acrylic ester is prepared by utilizing the polymer A with the thiolactone side chain containing thiolactone, the polymer B is provided with the hydrophilic group and the reactive double bonds simultaneously, the hydrophilic group and the reactive double bonds can provide good antifogging capability and adhesive force respectively, and a water-soluble monomer, an active diluent and a water-soluble photoinitiator are introduced as reaction components simultaneously, so that the UV curing antifogging coating with good antifogging performance, high adhesive force and solvent-free characteristic is obtained, and the problems of low adhesive force, poor durability and difficult unification of process performance of the existing antifogging coating are solved.

title_en: Antibacterial blue light prevention film for mobile phone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high polymer materials, in particular to an antibacterial blue light prevention film for a mobile phone and a preparation method thereof, wherein the antibacterial blue light prevention film comprises carbon quantum dots/strontium titanate, and the molecular formula of the strontium titanate is as follows: srTi  1‑   x  A  x  O  3  The blue light preventing film prepared by the invention has excellent antibacterial effect and good antibacterial spectrum property, and has certain inhibition effect on common staphylococcus aureus, escherichia coli, streptococcus, mould and clostridium on a mobile phone.

title_en: Preparation method of insulating cable material with high volume resistivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an insulated cable material with high volume resistivity, which belongs to the technical field of cable material preparation, wherein the insulated cable material comprises ethylene propylene diene monomer, chlorinated polyethylene, a calcium zinc stabilizer, 58 wax blocks, 1,2 polybutadiene, an anti-aging agent 1010, an anti-aging agent 445, magnesium oxide, diisooctyl adipate, nano calcium carbonate, talcum powder, di-tert-butyl-peroxide diisopropylbenzene vulcanizing agent and an activator HYJL, and the insulated cable material comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: ethylene propylene diene monomer particles (8-10), chlorinated polyethylene (25-30), calcium zinc stabilizer (0.6-1), 58 wax blocks (0.6-0.8) and 1,2 polybutadiene (1.2-1.4). According to the preparation method of the insulating cable material with high volume resistivity, the volume resistivity of the cable is greatly improved, and the volume resistivity after being immersed in water is also greatly improved.

title_en: Halogen-free flame-retardant high-strength sheath material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a halogen-free flame-retardant high-strength sheath material and a preparation method thereof. The halogen-free flame-retardant high-strength sheath material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-80 parts of first base resin; 50-80 parts of an elastomer; 20-110 parts of a flame-retardant system; 10-40 parts of a reinforcing system; 0-30 parts of a first modifier; 1-20 parts of other functional additives. The halogen-free flame-retardant high-strength sheath material provided by the invention has higher flame retardant property, meets the use requirement of halogen-free flame retardation, and simultaneously utilizes the matrix resin, the glass fiber and the modifier to prepare a reinforcing system, thereby improving the mechanical strength of the material. In addition, the preparation process of the sheath material is simple and controllable, the performance is stable, and the environmental adaptability is improved compared with the same type of products. The selected raw materials are cheap and easily available, and the cost is controllable.

title_en: Maleimide resin and method for producing the same, maleimide solution, curable resin composition and cured product thereof
abstract_en: The present invention is a maleimide resin represented by the following formula (1), wherein the maleimide resin contains N, N '- (phenylenebis (2,2-propylene) diphenylene) bismaleimide in an amount of 98 area% or less in terms of GPC area percentage, and the N, N' - (phenylenebis (2,2-propylene) diphenylene) bismaleimide contains a maleimide compound represented by the following formula (2) in an amount of 30 area% or more and less in terms of HPLC area percentage60 area%. In the formula (1), n is the number of repetitions, and the average value thereof is 1 < n < 5.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant reinforced halogen-free flame-retardant PP/HMSPP composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of processing of high polymer materials, and discloses a low-temperature-resistant reinforced halogen-free flame-retardant PP/HMSPP composite material and a preparation method thereof. The low-temperature-resistant reinforced halogen-free flame-retardant PP/HMSPP composite material comprises, by weight, 32-50 parts of PP resin, 5-10 parts of HMSPP resin, 4-7 parts of a low-temperature-resistant auxiliary agent, 20-25 parts of a reinforcing agent, 20-25 parts of a halogen-free flame retardant and 0.4-1 part of a processing auxiliary agent. The composite material disclosed by the invention utilizes the excellent performance characteristics of PP (polypropylene), combines the high-melt property of the HMSPP material to carry out low-temperature-resistant reinforced flame-retardant research, improves the compatibility of the PP material and glass fiber, and balances the stability between the rigidity and the flame retardance by matching with the composite low-temperature-resistant auxiliary agent.

title_en: Glycerol modified polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogel materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of glycerol modified polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel. According to the method, the micro-crystallization state of the PVA hydrogel is regulated and controlled through the glycerol consumption and the drying temperature in the hydrogel formula, so that the mechanical property of the PVA hydrogel is obviously improved, the water resistance is improved, the preparation method of the traditional PVA hydrogel is simplified, the defect that the traditional PVA hydrogel is poor in mechanical properties such as low rigidity, low tensile strength and low toughness is obviously overcome, and the application range of PVA hydrogel materials can be widened. The hydrogel prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple and environment-friendly, strong in mechanical property, good in water resistance and wide in application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of indicating type seaweed-based straw and straw
abstract_en: The technical scheme discloses a preparation method of an indicating type seaweed-based straw and the straw. The invention adopts alginate fibers, seaweed water-soluble polysaccharide extracts and pH sensitive edible pigments as indicators, and prepares the straw after repeated freeze thawing and drying. The technical problem solved by the technical scheme is as follows: how to prepare an indicating seaweed-based pipette.

title_en: Method for preparing supported metallocene catalyst, supported metallocene catalyst and method for preparing polyolefin using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of preparing a supported metallocene catalyst, and a method of preparing polyolefin using the same. According to the present invention, there are provided a method of preparing a supported metallocene catalyst, which has not only excellent olefin polymerization activity but also can prepare polyolefin having a uniform powder morphology, a supported metallocene catalyst prepared by the method, and a method of preparing polyolefin using the same.

title_en: Resin material and multilayer printed wiring board
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin material which can effectively remove stains through decontamination treatment, can reduce the dielectric loss tangent of a cured product, and can improve the thermal dimensional stability of the cured product. The resin material of the present invention comprises: a1 st compound having a1 st skeleton derived from an acid anhydride having a non-conjugated carbon-carbon double bond and having an imide bond, and a curing accelerator.

title_en: Aqueous coating composition comprising an epoxy-amine system and an aromatic carboxylic acid as curing catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aqueous coating composition, preferably an aqueous sanding primer surfacer or primer surfacer, comprising an aqueous epoxy resin dispersion (A), an aqueous amine-functional resin dispersion (B) and an aromatic carboxylic acid (C). The aqueous dispersion (B) comprises at least one specific di-and/or polyfunctional monomeric amine (A1) and at least one Resin Component (RC) comprising at least one specific polyfunctional organic amine (A2). Furthermore, the invention relates to a kit comprising a base varnish comprising an aqueous epoxy resin dispersion (a) and a curing component comprising an aqueous amine-functional resin dispersion (B) and an aromatic carboxylic acid (C). Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for producing a coating on a substrate and to a coated substrate obtainable by said method. Cured coatings formed from the compositions exhibit good adhesion to substrates under wet conditions as well as high inter-coating adhesion and bubble stability without negatively impacting excellent sanding and good stone-strike performance.

title_en: Polymerizable liquid crystal composition, retardation film, elliptically polarizing plate, and optical display
abstract_en: A polymerizable liquid crystal composition comprising at least 2 polymerizable liquid crystal compounds having the same molecular weight but different molecular structures from each other and represented by formula (1), wherein G in formula (1) is contained as the polymerizable liquid crystal compound 1 And G 2 A polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-1) each of which is 1,4-trans-cyclohexanediyl, and G in the formula (1) alone with the polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-1) 1 And G 2 At least one of the two groups is a polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-2) having a different molecular structure such as 1,4-cis-cyclohexanediyl group, and the ratio of the peak area of the polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-2) to the total peak area of the polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-1) and the polymerizable liquid crystal compound (1-2) is 0.01% to 10%, as measured by liquid chromatography. P 1 ‑F 1 ‑B 1 ‑A 1 ‑E 1 ‑G 1 ‑D 1 ‑Ar‑D 2 ‑G 2 ‑E 2 ‑A 2 ‑B 2 ‑F 2 ‑P 2 (1)。

title_en: Silk fibroin hydrogel dressing and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a silk fibroin hydrogel dressing and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medical dressings. The invention provides a preparation method of a silk fibroin hydrogel dressing, which comprises the following steps: (1) Dissolving silk fibroin fibers by using a dissolving solution to obtain a silk fibroin stock solution; (2) Dialyzing the silk fibroin stock solution to obtain a silk fibroin solution; (3) And after being subjected to rotational flow shearing, the silk fibroin solution is immersed into a carrier, and then subjected to heat treatment for in-situ gelation to obtain the silk fibroin hydrogel dressing. The silk fibroin gel dressing prepared by the invention does not use any additive, can carry out in-situ controllable gelation on a carrier through a physical crosslinking method and shearing synergistic thermal effect, and has higher safety and operability when being applied to the field of medicines.

title_en: Chelating resin special for adsorbing gallium and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal extraction, in particular to a chelating resin special for gallium adsorption and a preparation method thereof. The chelate resin is prepared by the following method: mixing amino carboxylic acid chelate resin with acetonitrile, and adding carbon disulfide to react to obtain carbon disulfide treated amino carboxylic acid chelate resin; mixing the amino carboxylic acid chelate resin treated by carbon disulfide with triethylamine, and reacting for 4-5 hours to obtain the amino carboxylic acid chelate resin. The modified aminocarboxylic acid chelating resin prepared by the invention can selectively and highly adsorb metal gallium, and simultaneously reduce the adsorption capacity to metal vanadium, thereby effectively enriching the metal gallium from Bayer mother liquor; meanwhile, the chelate and resin provided by the invention has a wide applicable pH range, and shows high adsorptivity to metallic gallium in both acidic and alkaline environments.

title_en: Preparation method of calcium hydroxide/chitosan composite film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a calcium hydroxide/chitosan composite film. Firstly, adding chitosan powder into glacial acetic acid solution with a certain concentration, and stirring to obtain chitosan solution. And adding the calcium hydroxide solution into the chitosan solution according to different proportions, mixing, and stirring to obtain a composite solution. Pouring the composite solution into a glass dish after ultrasonic defoaming, and adopting a casting method to prepare a film. Drying the casting solution in an oven to form a film, standing at room temperature, regulating humidity and uncovering the film. And (3) placing the uncovered composite film into a sodium hydroxide solution for washing, washing the film twice by using deionized water, and drying in a hot press dryer to finally obtain the calcium hydroxide/chitosan composite film. The prepared composite film has good mechanical strength, thermal stability, antibacterial property and degradability.

title_en: UHMWPE antifouling material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UHMWPE antifouling material and a preparation method thereof, firstly, the surface of the UHMWPE material is processed by plasma etching, so that the micro surface of the UHMWPE material generates protrusions; then carrying out super-hydrophobic treatment on the UHMWPE material through a perfluorodecyl trichlorosilane-toluene solution, drying after blowing dry by nitrogen, soaking by a mixed solution of trihydroxymethyl aminomethane and dopamine hydrochloride, finally cleaning by deionized water, blowing dry by nitrogen and drying to obtain the UHMWPE material. The UHMWPE antifouling material provided by the invention belongs to a hydrophobic structure in a macroscopic view, but the surface of the material has hydrophilic points to adsorb water, so that a high-adhesion super-hydrophobic structure is generated, the structure can effectively prevent fouling organisms from attaching, and the UHMWPE antifouling material can be applied to the aspects of ship body antifouling, filter screens of coastal power plants and the like.

title_en: Nylon textile with radiation refrigeration function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nylon textile with a radiation refrigeration function and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Fluorine-containing acrylic acidMixing an ester monomer, a hard monomer, a soft monomer and organic silicon alkyd resin to obtain a mixed monomer, and then adding a reactive emulsifier to stir uniformly to obtain a mixed solution; dissolving an initiator in water to obtain an initiator aqueous solution; dropwise adding the mixed solution into an initiator aqueous solution, stirring, and homogenizing to obtain a pre-emulsion; (2) carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the pre-emulsion to obtain a miniemulsion; reacting the miniemulsion by adopting a semi-continuous polymerization method to obtain organosilicon fluorine-containing acrylic emulsion; (3) Mixing SiO  2  Hydrophobic modification is carried out on the particles to obtain hydrophobic modified SiO  2  Particles; (4) Hydrophobically modified SiO  2  And sequentially coating the particles and the organic silicon fluorine-containing acrylic emulsion on the surface of the nylon fabric, and drying at room temperature to obtain the nylon textile with the radiation refrigeration function. The preparation method successfully solves the problem that the nylon is easy to yellow in high-temperature finishing.

title_en: Pesticide suspoemulsion sulfonate dispersing agent, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a pesticide suspoemulsion sulfonate dispersing agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the pesticide suspoemulsion sulfonate dispersing agent comprises the following steps: a) Mixing unsaturated polyether and an oxidant to obtain a first mixture for later use; b) Mixing unsaturated carboxyl with a reducing agent to obtain a second mixture for later use; c) Reacting the first mixture obtained in step a) with the second mixture obtained in step b) to obtain a polyether-polyester copolymer; d) Reacting the polyether-polyester copolymer obtained in the step c) with sulfonate to generate the pesticide suspoemulsion sulfonate dispersing agent. The pesticide suspoemulsion sulfonate dispersing agent prepared by the invention is applied to pesticide suspoemulsions, can improve the suspension rate, the dispersibility and the cold and hot storage stability of the suspoemulsions, enables the suspoemulsions to be stable in suspension, has no layering and bottom forming, and prolongs the storage period of the suspoemulsions.

title_en: Degradable bio-based medical casting film, preparation method and application thereof
