abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable bio-based medical casting film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the casting film is integrally formed and comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 38-69.5% of PBS resin, 15-25% of PBAT resin, 5-15% of PLA resin, 10-20% of calcium carbonate and 0.5-2% of auxiliary agent; the preparation method comprises the steps of heating and stirring raw materials, drying, conveying to a casting machine, and co-extruding casting blanks through an extruder; then cooling, shaping, traction thickness measurement, slitting and rolling; the prepared casting film is applied to medical drape sheets, surgical gowns and isolation gowns; the medical casting film has excellent hydrostatic pressure, breaking strength and synthetic blood resistance, and the preparation process is simple.

title_en: Lithium ion battery diaphragm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery diaphragm and a preparation method thereof, wherein the diaphragm comprises a diaphragm substrate and a diaphragm coating, the diaphragm substrate is modified polyvinylidene fluoride, and the diaphragm coating is a high polymer material containing lithium ions; the modified polyvinylidene fluoride is prepared by the following steps: polyvinylidene fluoride and hydroxy acrylic acid are mixed according to the mass ratio of 1: after being uniformly mixed, 0.4 to 0.6 of N, N dimethylformamide and ethanol are added in a volume ratio of 2:1 to 1.3, heating to 50 to 60 ℃ and stirring; adding lithium isopropoxide and P123 into ethanol solution, performing ultrasonic treatment for 3-6 h, then dripping into the polyvinylidene fluoride and hydroxy acrylic acid solution, and aging for 6-10 h to obtain the modified polyvinylidene fluoride. The high polymer material is prepared from the following components in percentage by mass: 2-4 of polydopamine and cellulose.

title_en: Chloroprene rubber compound for automobile wiper blade and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chloroprene rubber compound for an automobile wiper blade and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chloroprene rubber compound comprises a combination of mercaptan-regulated chloroprene rubber raw rubber, white carbon black, magnesium oxide, zinc oxide, a vulcanization accelerator, an anti-aging agent and a softening agent; through selecting mercaptan-regulated chloroprene rubber raw rubber and the filler to be matched in a specific dosage range and adopting a specific wet mixing process, the filler has good dispersibility in the rubber raw rubber and less loss in the mixing process, so that the finally obtained chloroprene rubber compound has higher tensile strength and tearing strength, also has good high and low temperature resistance, good oil resistance and excellent aging resistance, ozone resistance and flex fatigue resistance, and is suitable for being used in automobile wiper blades.

title_en: Polytetrafluoroethylene prepreg, preparation method thereof and copper-clad plate
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of prepreg material processes, in particular to a polytetrafluoroethylene prepreg, a preparation method thereof and a copper-clad plate. The preparation method of the polytetrafluoroethylene prepreg comprises the following steps: carrying out surface treatment on the inorganic filler by using a surface modifier to obtain a surface-modified inorganic filler; mixing and dispersing the surface-modified inorganic filler and the polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion to obtain a dispersion liquid; demulsifying the dispersion liquid to form a demulsifying group, and pressing the demulsifying group into a composite membrane material; and carrying out at least one cycle of preheating treatment and folding and pressing the film on the composite film material, and then carrying out heat treatment to obtain the polytetrafluoroethylene prepreg. The polytetrafluoroethylene prepreg prepared by the preparation method has the advantages of high mechanical property, low water absorption, low dielectric constant, low dielectric loss and uniform and stable dielectric property, and has a good application prospect in copper-clad plates.

title_en: Polylactic acid composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a polylactic acid composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polylactic acid composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 75-90 parts of polylactic acid prepolymer; 3-15 parts of a toughening agent; 1-8 parts of a compatibilizer; 0.6-3 parts of nucleating agent; 0.5-2.5 parts of antioxidant. The polylactic acid prepolymer is used as a main raw material, and the mechanical property, the heat resistance, the water resistance and the processing property of the polylactic acid composite material are good through adding the toughening agent, the compatibilizer, the nucleating agent and the antioxidant. The polylactic acid prepolymer has excellent mechanical properties, and the heat resistance and the water resistance are remarkably improved; the toughening agent and the compatibilizer are compounded for use, so that the compatibility of a polylactic acid system can be improved, and the mechanical property and the processability of the polylactic acid composite material are effectively improved. Meanwhile, the preparation method of the polylactic acid composite material has simple flow and short time consumption, and is easy for industrial implementation.

title_en: Underwater high-temperature slow-curing single-component epoxy resin system and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-component epoxy resin system capable of being cured underwater slowly at a high temperature, and a preparation method and application thereof. The single-component epoxy resin curing system comprises epoxy matrix resin, a curing agent and a diluent. The curing agent is a 4, 4-diaminodiphenylmethane derivative, which is prepared by a Mannich reaction of a compound containing active hydrogen, aldehyde and 4, 4-diaminodiphenylmethane under the catalysis of protonic acid. A curing system formed by the curing agent, the epoxy resin monomer and the diluent has good fluidity, and can keep the fluidity for a long time at high temperature, namely has long pot life at high temperature. The cured product obtained by curing has good thermal property and mechanical property, can work for a long time in a high-temperature underwater environment, has ultra-long gel time and good thermal property and mechanical property under underwater high temperature, and can be used in the fields of water shutoff and profile control in the upstream of the petroleum and natural gas industry.

title_en: Flame-retardant natural fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flame-retardant natural fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite material preparation. The preparation method of the flame-retardant natural fiber composite material comprises the following steps: treating natural fibers by using NaOH, carrying out flame-retardant treatment on the fibers treated by the NaOH, preparing natural fiber prepreg, treating natural fiber pre-material by using urea and a coupling agent, and finally carrying out hot pressing on the natural fiber prepreg by using a compression molding process to obtain the flame-retardant natural fiber composite material. The composite material has excellent flame retardant property, can improve the mechanical property of the composite material, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Process for preparing pu big bottom sheet and TPU sheet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of PU big bottom sheets and TPU sheet processing, in particular to a process for preparing PU big bottom sheets and TPU sheets, which comprises the following steps: s1: batching and debugging ab material ratio; s2: testing the ab material discharge ratio; s3: testing the volume of the mold; s4: programming and die positioning; s5: testing the mold; s6: vacuum suction and bubble removal; s7: treating by an oven; s8: demoulding and packaging, wherein in S1, ab materials are respectively polyester polyol and isocyanate, and the proportion of the ab materials is 2:1, controlling the material temperature to be 30 ℃. The invention optimizes and improves the traditional PU outsole and the production technology of the injected TPU, automatically fills materials in the whole process by programming an automatic machine and controlling the volume of the die and the material ratio, thereby achieving the purpose of improving the benefit and the product quality, having the processing advantages of high productivity and multi-color one-step molding, simultaneously adopting assembly line operation, having higher efficiency, avoiding the problem of high cost and more dies and saving the cost.

title_en: Water-based sulfonate polyester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based sulfonate polyester and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the sulfonate polyester comprise dihydric alcohol and dibasic acid; the dihydric alcohol comprises at least one of dihydric alcohol with an unbranched chain structure and dihydric alcohol with an alicyclic structure; the dibasic acid comprises sulfonic acid group-containing dibasic acid or ester thereof and aromatic dibasic acid. According to the invention, aliphatic diol is used as a soft segment, aromatic diacid is used as a hard segment, different molecular structures are obtained by adjusting the types and contents of monomers for preparing the sulfonate polyester, the glass transition temperature of the prepared sulfonate polyester is adjustable, and the color paste prepared by using the sulfonate polyester dispersion liquid has better dispersion stability.

title_en: Swelling-resistant tough hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-swelling tough hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a hydrophilic organic polymer into a solvent to obtain a first solution; mixing the liquid silicone-based hydrophobic elastomer prepolymer, the first solution and a surfactant, and then carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain a second solution; the second solution is subjected to cold setting treatment at a first preset temperature for a first preset time, and then is placed at room temperature for standing for a second preset time to obtain a hydrogel precursor; and (3) dehydrating the hydrogel precursor to obtain the swelling-resistant flexible hydrogel. According to the invention, the hydrophilic organic polymer and the silicone-based hydrophobic elastomer prepolymer are blended to construct a unique hydrophilic-hydrophobic two-phase nano hybrid structure, the anti-swelling tough hydrogel has good mechanical deformation stability due to the introduction of the hydrophilic organic polymer, and the elasticity and underwater anti-swelling performance of the anti-swelling tough hydrogel are improved due to the introduction of the silicone-based hydrophobic elastomer.

title_en: Organic ligand, triphenylene alkynyl functionalized organic framework material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic ligand, a triphenylene alkynyl functionalized organic framework material, a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the organic ligand comprises a triphenylene structure, the 1,5, 9-position of the triphenylene is connected with 4-aminobenzene through alkynyl, a conjugated rigid connecting structure is formed in a plane, and the triphenylene is subjected to an amino-aldehyde condensation reaction with trialdehyde phloroglucinol to form the organic framework material, and the organic framework material has a two-dimensional honeycomb net structure and high crystallinity; the beta-keto enamine connection structure and the conjugated system caused by enol-ketone tautomerization and rich alkynyl regulate the transfer of electrons, so that the organic framework material has wide absorption spectrum and high stability, and is favorable for absorbing sunlight. Under the irradiation of simulated sunlight, the temperature of the organic frame material can reach 48 ℃, and the organic frame material shows higher photo-thermal conversion performance. The preparation method of the organic ligand and the organic framework material has mild conditions, does not need harsh reaction conditions and can be used for large-scale preparation.

title_en: Conjugated polymer material containing benzodithiophene-4, 5-diketone and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a conjugated polymer material containing benzodithiophene-4, 5-dione, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of organic polymer semiconductor materials. Compared with the prior art, the conjugated polymer containing benzodithiophene-4, 5-diketone provided by the invention has the chemical structural formula: the hole mobility is high, and the transmission of current carriers is facilitated; the high molecular solution has good solubility, and can form a film on a substrate in a dropping or spin coating mode in the preparation of a device, so that the morphology of the film is favorably optimized, and the performance of the device is improved; has good thermal stability, good response to sunlight, wider coverage to sunlight spectrum, higher hole mobility, open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current of the deviceDensity, can be used as an electron donor material component of an organic photovoltaic cell device.

title_en: Bio-based benzoxazine maleimide copolymer and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional polymer materials, and particularly relates to a bio-based benzoxazine maleimide copolymer, a synthetic method and an application thereof, wherein the bio-based benzoxazine maleimide copolymer comprises the following steps: s1, mixing eugenol, paraformaldehyde and decamethylenediamine, and preparing a benzoxazine monomer by a solvent-free method; and S2, preparing the bio-based benzoxazine maleimide copolymer from the S1 benzoxazine monomer and bismaleimide through copolymerization. The bio-based benzoxazine maleimide copolymer has excellent thermal property, mechanical property and dielectric property, and meanwhile, the research method adopted by the invention provides a new idea for preparing a green high-performance low-dielectric thermosetting material.

title_en: Polyimide/polyether-ether-ketone composite aerogel material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyimide/polyether-ether-ketone composite aerogel material and a preparation method and application thereof. Taking a small amount of powder, adding a proper amount of water, magnetically stirring and heating for 3-7 hours to obtain the polyether-ether-ketone/polyimide hydrogel, freeze-drying the hydrogel for 5-10 hours, and thermally imidizing to obtain the polyether-ether-ketone/polyimide aerogel. The composite aerogel material is a porous material with light weight and high porosity, and the polyimide aerogel has good thermal stability, biocompatibility and large specific surface area.

title_en: Scratch-resistant composition, method for the production and use
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a scratch-resistant composition, a preparation method and application. The scratch resistant composition of the present application comprises, in weight percent: 40.8 to 56.95 percent of methyl methacrylate-styrene copolymer, 28.05 to 44.2 percent of styrene-butadiene copolymer, 1 to 5 percent of inorganic metal nano particles, 0.005 to 0.15 percent of coupling agent, 0.5 to 2 percent of polysiloxane compound, 1 to 5 percent of compatilizer, 0.1 to 0.5 percent of antioxidant, 0.1 to 0.5 percent of lubricant and 0.1 to 0.5 percent of pigment. According to the preparation method, the modified inorganic metal nanoparticles are added into the methyl methacrylate-styrene copolymer and the styrene-butadiene copolymer, so that the transmittance of the material is improved, and meanwhile, the addition of a proper amount of polysiloxane compound is found, so that the scratch resistance of the material is improved.

title_en: Modified polylactic acid and preparation thereof and application of modified polylactic acid to blowing of high-toughness fully-degradable polylactic acid film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high-performance resin preparation, in particular to a method for preparing high-melt-strength polylactic acid resin by a reactive extrusion method, and forming a high-toughness polylactic acid film by using the obtained polylactic acid resin through film blowing processing. The invention provides a preparation method of modified polylactic acid resin, which comprises the following steps: melt blending 100 parts by weight of maleic anhydride-polylactic acid graft copolymer, 2-15 parts by weight of epoxy vegetable oil and 0.2-2 parts by weight of catalyst to prepare the modified polylactic acid resin; wherein the catalyst is an acetylacetonate metal complex. The melt strength of the modified polylactic acid resin is greatly improved, and continuous processing of high melt strength polylactic acid is realized; the modified polylactic resin can be stably blown to obtain a high-toughness full-biodegradable polylactic film through a film blowing process, and the obtained polylactic film has high toughness and obviously improves the elongation at break of the film in the longitudinal and transverse directions.

title_en: Phenolic resin suitable for RTM process and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermoplastic phenolic matrix resin suitable for an RTM (resin transfer molding) process, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of new materials. The resin is cured through the transesterification reaction between the boric acid ester and phenolic hydroxyl groups of the phenolic resin, and small molecular compounds are not released in the curing process, so that the requirements of an RTM forming process can be fully met. The cured resin has excellent thermal stability and high-temperature plasticity, can repair defects and cavities, and is a repairable and ablation-resistant composite resin matrix for RTM molding.

title_en: Heat conductive silicone composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat conductive silicone composition characterized by containing the following components (A) to (C), 100 parts by mass of (A) moving at 25 DEG CThe viscosity is 10-500,000mm  2  10 to 2,000 parts by mass of (B) a thermally conductive filler having an average particle diameter of 0.01 to 100 μm, and 1,000 to 10,000 parts by mass of (C) gallium or a gallium alloy having a melting point of-20 to 100 ℃. Thus, a thermally conductive silicone composition having excellent thermal conductivity can be provided.

title_en: Diisocyanate composition and optical lens produced using the same
abstract_en: A diisocyanate composition comprising two types of diisocyanates and having an adjusted viscosity is provided; and a polymerizable composition and an optical lens produced using the diisocyanate composition.

title_en: Method for extracting active ingredients from Tremella sanguinea Pang
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting active ingredients from Tremella sanguinea Pang, which comprises the following steps: mixing Tremella sanguinea Pang powder with eutectic solvent, performing ultrasonic extraction on the Tremella sanguinea Pang powder at room temperature, centrifuging, and collecting supernatant to obtain Tremella sanguinea Pang leaching solution; adding a precipitation auxiliary agent into the Tremella sanguinea Leaff leaching liquor, uniformly mixing, standing, centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, washing and centrifuging the precipitate, adding the precipitate into distilled water, and dissolving in a water bath to obtain a dissolving solution; filtering the dissolved solution by using an ultrafiltration tube to respectively obtain a filtrate and a retentate; adding frozen ethanol into the filtrate, centrifuging, collecting supernatant, and rotary steaming to obtain small molecule extract mainly containing Tremella sanguinea Pang crude polyphenol; and adding water to the retentate for dissolving and diluting to obtain a macromolecular extract mainly containing Tremella sanguinea Pang polysaccharide. The invention takes the eutectic solvent as the extraction solvent and takes the ultrasonic extraction as the auxiliary means, thereby realizing the high-efficiency extraction of various active ingredients in the Tremella sanguinea Pang at room temperature.

title_en: Artificial quartz stone unsaturated polyester resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An artificial quartz unsaturated polyester resin and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of artificial quartz unsaturated polyester. The quartz stone plate produced by using the existing unsaturated polyester resin as a binder has poor temperature resistance and is easy to deform at high temperature, so that the application of the existing unsaturated polyester resin for artificial quartz stone is limited. The raw materials of the invention comprise terephthalic acid, maleic anhydride, phthalic anhydride, propylene glycol, ethylene glycol, diethylene glycol, polytrimethylene terephthalate (PTT), benzoic acid, styrene, polymerization inhibitor, catalyst and antioxidant. The mechanical property, the heat deformation resistance and the water and stain resistance of the prepared polyester are obviously improved by utilizing the terephthalic acid, the phthalic anhydride, the propanediol and the PTT.

title_en: Method for preparing amino-terminated polyether by continuous hydro-ammonification
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing amino-terminated polyether by continuous hydro-ammoniation, which comprises the following steps: (1) Polyether, ammonia gas and hydrogen enter a reaction tower, a hydro-ammoniation reaction is carried out under the action of a supported metal catalyst, gas-phase materials are discharged from a top discharge port of the reaction tower, and amine-terminated polyether is discharged from a bottom discharge port of the reaction tower; (2) The gas phase material is separated after being cooled, and the separated crude hydrogen is returned to the reaction tower for recycling; (3) The separated separating liquid enters a membrane separator, concentrated solution returns to the reaction tower, permeate enters a water-ammonia separation tower, and crude ammonia discharged from the top of the water-ammonia separation tower returns to the reaction tower for recycling. The application establishes a separation section in the reaction tower, combines with the high-pressure separator and the nanofiltration membrane separator, effectively separates amine-terminated polyether from ammonia, hydrogen and water, improves the reaction efficiency and reduces the separation energy consumption while ensuring the reaction depth so as to save the operation cost.

title_en: Degradable polypropylene non-adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polypropylene non-adhesive films, and particularly relates to a degradable polypropylene non-adhesive film which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-25 parts of polypropylene, 20-30 parts of polylactic acid, 6-9 parts of maleic anhydride, 0.3-0.6 part of dicumyl peroxide, 1-4 parts of sodium silicate and 1-4 parts of paraffin, wherein the polylactic acid and the polypropylene are used as raw materials, the dicumyl peroxide is used as an initiator under the condition that a maleic anhydride graft is used as an auxiliary agent, and the raw materials are melted and blended through a screw machine to prepare the biodegradable polypropylene adhesive-free film, so that the overall degradation time of the polypropylene adhesive-free film is greatly reduced, the content of low-molecular-weight propylene oligomers in a degradation product is greatly reduced, and the pressure of the adhesive-free film on the environment is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of solvent-resistant cross-linked anion exchange membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a solvent-resistant cross-linked anion exchange membrane, which comprises the following steps: (1) Preparation of 2,2 '-bis (2- (4-fluorophenyl)) -5,5' -bibenzoimidazole; (2) Solvent copolycondensation is carried out on 2,2' -bis (2- (4-fluorophenyl)) -5,5' -biphenyl benzimidazole monomer, diallyl bisphenol A monomer and 2,2' -bis (4-hydroxyphenyl) hexafluoropropane monomer to obtain a benzimidazole structure-containing polymer; (3) Preparation of 3-hexanyl-1-vinylimidazole and 1,6-bis (1-vinylimidazole-3-) hexane; (4) Dissolving a polymer containing a benzimidazole structure, 3-hexyl-1-vinylimidazole and 1,6-di (1-vinylimidazole-3-) hexane in an organic solvent to obtain a casting solution, pouring the casting solution on a glass plate, and realizing in-situ crosslinking at 40-200 ℃ to obtain the anion exchange membrane with the crosslinked structure.

title_en: Dense water net of reverse osmosis membrane and reverse osmosis membrane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water purification treatment, and particularly relates to a reverse osmosis membrane and a concentrated water net thereof, aiming at solving the problem that the concentration of silver ions in water is too high when the concentrated water net of the existing reverse osmosis membrane inhibits bacteria from breeding. For this purpose, the dense water network of the reverse osmosis membrane comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polypropylene and 10-16 parts of zinc oxide, or the concentrated water net comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polypropylene, 5-8 parts of zinc oxide and 0.1-1 part of auxiliary bacteriostatic agent. Through the arrangement, zinc oxide is used as a main bacteriostatic agent to replace a silver-containing bacteriostatic agent or reduce the use proportion of the silver-containing bacteriostatic agent in the concentrated water net so as to reduce the content of silver ions in the filtered water.

title_en: Hydrophobic thermoplastic starch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A hydrophobic thermoplastic starch, the raw materials include: 100 parts of starch; 20-50 parts of a plasticizer; 3 to 10 parts of hydrophobic monomer; 0.2 to 1 part of coupling agent; 5 to 10 parts of inorganic filler; 0.5 to 3 parts of other additives; the hydrophobic monomer comprises 3 to 8 parts of monofunctional monomer and 0.2 to 2 parts of polyfunctional crosslinking agent; other auxiliary agents include lubricants and antioxidants. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1. radiation grafting of starch. Placing the mixed powder in a tray, paving, and then irradiating with the irradiation dose of 10 to 100kGy; 2. and (4) extruding and granulating. And extruding and processing the powder subjected to irradiation grafting by using a double-screw extruder, wherein the temperature of each section is controlled to be 110-140 ℃ in the processing process, so as to obtain the hydrophobic thermoplastic starch plastic. The hydrophobic modification of the invention can improve the water resistance of the starch material used for full-biodegradable products, and can also improve the compatibility of the starch material and the polyester matrix and improve the material performance. The modification of the starch solid powder is directly realized through the irradiation process, a solvent and a large-scale chemical device are not needed, and the method is green and environment-friendly.

title_en: Preparation method of photo-curing resin containing boron ester dynamic covalent bond
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a photo-curing resin containing a boron ester dynamic covalent bond, which introduces the boron ester in the preparation of the photo-curing resin. According to the invention, the boron ester dynamic covalent bond is introduced into the crosslinked network of the resin polymer, so that the resin polymer can be represented as classical thermosetting under certain conditions, but after the dynamic covalent bond is activated, the network topology structure can be rearranged repeatedly, and the obvious result is self-finishing repair of the network polymer. The resin containing the boron ester dynamic covalent bond prepared by the invention has better elongation at break and toughness, can effectively prolong the service life of the material, and is particularly suitable for the field of 3D printing.

title_en: Method for separating and obtaining salidroside from rhodiola rosea
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of rhodiola rosea extraction, and in particular discloses a method for separating salidroside from rhodiola rosea, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining rhodiola rosea powder; s2, leaching with ethanol to obtain crude eluent, and passing through a macroporous resin column; s3, eluting to obtain a crude salidroside/tyrosol eluent; eluting with 65-90% ethanol solution to obtain crude eluates; s4, respectively obtaining a rhodiola rosea glycoside crude eluent and a tyrosol crude eluent; s5, adding glucose and solidified beta-glucosidase into the tyrosol crude eluent, and adding phosphate buffer solution and 1-vinyl-3-butyl imidazole thiocyanate to obtain salidroside generating solution; s6, passing the salidroside generating solution and the crude salidroside eluent through an aluminum oxide column, eluting to obtain a salidroside eluent, concentrating and drying to obtain a salidroside extract. The application has the characteristic of separating rhodiola rosea with higher content from rhodiola rosea.

title_en: Process for preparing polybutadiene latex
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of synthetic resin, and particularly relates to a preparation method of polybutadiene latex. The method comprises the following steps: a) Forming submicron droplets from a butadiene monomer, an oil-soluble initiator and an emulsifier under the action of microwaves; b) Maintaining the submicron droplet morphology with microwaves, and synthesizing a polybutadiene latex at a temperature suitable for polymerization of the butadiene monomer.

title_en: Preparation method of granular polyglycolic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of granular polyglycolic acid. The method comprises the steps of: (1) Prepolymerizing molten glycolide and a reaction auxiliary agent in a static mixer to obtain a glycolic acid prepolymer; (2) Carrying out final polymerization on the glycolic acid prepolymer obtained in the step (1) and a chain extender through a tackifying device to obtain a molten product; and (3) extruding and granulating the molten product obtained in the step (2), and cooling to obtain granular polyglycolic acid.

title_en: Zirconia ceramic wear-resistant microbead and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zirconia ceramic wear-resistant microbead and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite microbead is prepared by treating composite microbeads with treatment liquid, the composite microbeads contain graphene, the graphene is a two-dimensional material with high tensile strength and high elastic modulus, the wear resistance of the wear-resistant microbeads can be enhanced, meanwhile, the surface of the wear-resistant microbeads contains a layer of hydrophobic layer, so that the self-cleaning effect is achieved, the graphene on the wear-resistant microbeads has a conductive effect, the wear-resistant microbeads has a certain antistatic effect, the quaternary ammonium salt structure on the surface can enable charges on the surface to be rapidly dissipated, the resistance and half life of the surface are reduced, the effect of static electricity is weakened, hydrogen bonds in the phosphate structure are combined with water in the air, the resistance of a polymer is reduced, dissipation of static electricity is accelerated, and the antistatic effect of the wear-resistant microbeads is further improved.

title_en: Irradiation-resistant high-flexibility anti-interference measuring cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irradiation-resistant high-flexibility anti-interference measuring cable and a preparation method thereof, and the cable has the characteristics of long service life, gao Fuzhao dosage resistance, design benchmark accident resistance, long-term chemical solution immersion resistance, high-energy pipeline break accident impact resistance, hydrogen explosion accident impact resistance, and the like, and can keep a signal transmission function under an accident working condition and a post-accident working condition, and the specific scheme is as follows: the utility model provides an anti-interference measuring cable of high flexibility of resistant irradiation and preparation method thereof, includes the insulating layer, the insulating layer includes the inner insulating layer, the material of inner insulating layer is irradiation-resistant type low smoke and zero halogen polyolefin insulating material, irradiation-resistant type low smoke and zero halogen polyolefin insulating material includes following parts by weight raw and other materials: 40-60 parts of high-density polyethylene, 40-60 parts of maleic anhydride grafted POE, 10-30 parts of modified phenolic resin containing Si C, 0.5-5 parts of polyfunctional group cross-linking agent, 5-10 parts of lamellar hybrid anti-irradiation agent loaded with nano particles, 1-3 parts of high-temperature resistant antioxidant and 0.5-2 parts of lubricant.

title_en: Heat conduction shielding composite material with double-isolation network structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat conduction shielding composite material with a double-isolation network structure and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of manufacturing of multifunctional polymer-based composite materials. The composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60-90 parts of fluoroplastic microspheres coated with carbon tubes and 10-40 parts of heterostructure magnetic iron compound. The preparation method of the material comprises the following steps: synthesizing a heterostructure magnetic iron compound nano material by an in-situ growth method, preparing fluoroplastic microspheres coated with carbon tubes by a phase separation method, mechanically mixing the composite microspheres with magnetic particles, and placing the mixture on a flat vulcanizing machine for hot pressing to obtain the composite material. The composite material prepared by the invention has the advantages of high shielding, low reflection, high heat conduction and the like, has simple preparation process and low cost, is suitable for large-scale industrial production, and is very easy to be widely applied to electronic equipment and dense systems in the fields of 5G communication technology and the like.

title_en: Production process for reducing non-enzymatic browning of chitosan oligosaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chitosan oligosaccharide preparation, in particular to a production process for reducing non-enzymatic browning of chitosan oligosaccharide. The process is mainly based on that the contact to oxygen is reduced and the non-enzymatic browning is reduced in the production process of the chitosan oligosaccharide, the contact of oxygen is reduced by introducing protective gas in the enzymatic degradation process and the contact of oxygen is reduced in the spray drying process, so that the non-enzymatic browning of the chitosan oligosaccharide is reduced, and the effective content of the chitosan oligosaccharide in the produced chitosan oligosaccharide product is at least improved by 6 percent.

title_en: Fructus psoraleae formula particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fructus psoraleae formula particle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, extracting and concentrating a fructus psoraleae raw material to obtain a fructus psoraleae concentrated solution; s2, adding modified beta-cyclodextrin into the fructus psoraleae concentrated solution, and then spray-drying to obtain fructus psoraleae powder, wherein the modified beta-cyclodextrin is obtained by modifying beta-cyclodextrin by protein; s3, mixing and granulating the fructus psoraleae powder and auxiliary materials to obtain fructus psoraleae formula granules. According to the preparation method of the fructus psoraleae formula particles, the modified beta-cyclodextrin is added into the fructus psoraleae concentrated solution and then spray drying is carried out, so that the loss of active ingredients of the fructus psoraleae concentrated solution in the spray drying process is obviously reduced, and the utilization rate of the active ingredients in the fructus psoraleae is improved.

title_en: Light-sensitive heterochromatic antibacterial film, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application provides a light-sensitive heterochromatic antibacterial film, a preparation method and application. The light-sensitive heterochromatic antibacterial film comprises a light-sensitive heterochromatic antibacterial coating and a base material layer; the light sensation heterochromatic antibacterial coating comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 0.01-25 parts of nano inorganic material, 0.01-45 parts of resin, 0.01-30 parts of liquid crystal material and 25-90 parts of solvent. The light sensation heterochrosis antibacterial film not only has the characteristics of the existing film, but also has the effects of antibiosis and light sensation heterochrosis. Meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the application can complete the preparation of the light-sensitive heterochromatic antibacterial film by only one step; the light sensation heterochromatic antibacterial film has wide application space.

title_en: Mineral powder master batch, preparation method, polypropylene composition containing mineral powder master batch and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polymer materials, and particularly relates to mineral powder master batches, a preparation method thereof, a polypropylene composition containing the mineral powder master batches and application thereof. The mineral powder master batch comprises the following components in parts by weight: 250-500 parts of mineral powder, 3-7 parts of fluorine-containing acid activator, 3-7 parts of coupling agent and 29-73 parts of metallocene polyethylene. The mineral powder master batch prepared by the invention has better performance, and the polypropylene composition prepared by adding the mineral powder master batch is obviously improved in the performances of impact strength, glossiness, washing resistance and the like.

title_en: Hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biochemistry, and discloses hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel is prepared by crosslinking gamma-polyglutamic acid, epsilon-polylysine and konjac mannan oxidized by sodium periodate, which are jointly modified by dopamine and L-cysteine. The hydrogel provided by the invention is crosslinked without using a crosslinking agent, has high crosslinking speed, and has certain antibacterial property, oxidation resistance, biocompatibility and adhesion. The hydrogel provided by the invention can be applied to a wound surface in an injection form, and can provide a moist healing environment and a protective effect for the wound.

title_en: Method for preparing freshness indicating film based on purple sweet potato powder subjected to different heat treatments
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a freshness indicating film based on different heat treatment purple sweet potato powder, which belongs to the field of food packaging and comprises the following steps: (1) Respectively steaming, boiling and baking fresh purple sweet potatoes, peeling, cutting into pieces, freeze-drying, crushing and sieving to obtain heat-treated purple sweet potato powder; (2) Suspending the heat-treated purple sweet potato powder in water, homogenizing by a high-speed disperser, and gelatinizing by a water bath to obtain a purple sweet potato powder suspension; (3) Adding a certain amount of sodium alginate into the purple sweet potato powder suspension obtained in the step (2) to obtain a purple sweet potato powder-sodium alginate mixed solution; (4) Adding glycerol into the mixed solution obtained in the step (3), and mixing by a magnetic stirrer to obtain a film-forming solution; (5) And pouring the obtained film forming solution into an organic glass mold, controlling humidity and air drying to form the film. The freshness indicating film prepared by the invention has the advantages of green preparation process and low production cost, and has application potential in the field of intelligent food packaging.

title_en: Sodium hyaluronate gel capable of being degraded in gradient manner and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedical materials, and provides a sodium hyaluronate gel capable of being degraded in a gradient manner and a preparation method thereof; the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving sodium hyaluronate in an aqueous solution containing sodium hydroxide, uniformly stirring, adding a cross-linking agent, and obtaining cross-linked gel after reaction; neutralizing the crosslinked gel to be neutral, fully swelling to a proper concentration, and homogenizing to obtain crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel particles with proper particle size, wherein the particles are marked as particles 1; s2, dissolving sodium hyaluronate in an aqueous solution containing sodium hydroxide, adding a cross-linking agent, uniformly stirring, adding the particles 1 prepared in the step S1, uniformly stirring, performing secondary cross-linking reaction, and obtaining cross-linked gel after the reaction is finished; neutralizing the crosslinked gel to be neutral, swelling to a proper concentration, and homogenizing to obtain crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel particles with proper particle size, wherein the particles are marked as particles 2; and S3, repeating the step S2 at least once to obtain the multiple cross-linked sodium hyaluronate gel which has excellent gradient degradation performance and mechanical property.

title_en: Formula of environment-friendly lamp shell
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lamp manufacturing, in particular to a formula of an environment-friendly lamp shell, which comprises a carrying disc, a cutting ring, a top seat, a motor and a cam; the top surface of the conveyor belt is provided with a plurality of carrying discs, the top surface of each carrying disc is provided with a plurality of supporting grooves, the outer ring of each supporting groove is provided with a cutting ring, the top surface of the conveyor belt is fixedly connected with a top seat, the side surface of the top seat is fixedly connected with a motor, a rotating shaft of the motor rotatably penetrates through the side wall of the top seat, a cam is rotatably arranged in the top seat, and one end of the cam is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft of the motor; the injection molding's lamps and lanterns shell has been placed in the support groove of seting up on carrying the dish, and the conveyer belt drives carries the dish and removes the bottom of footstock, and the motor drives the cam and rotates, impresses the bottom in the support groove of lamps and lanterns shell for the outer lane of cutting lamps and lanterns shell of cutting ring knife cuts the deckle edge excision of lamps and lanterns shell, has reduced staff's work load, has reduced the manufacturing cost of lamps and lanterns shell, has improved the production quality of lamps and lanterns shell.

title_en: Penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide and extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide, an extraction method and application thereof, relates to the field of penicillium, and aims at solving the problem that the application of the penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide is restricted because specific active ingredients in the penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide cannot be separated. The invention exactly discloses a structure and a preparation method of the penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide, which comprises ethanol precipitation, enzymolysis protein removal, gel chromatographic column separation and purification, infrared spectrum, high performance liquid chromatography and nuclear magnetic resonance analysis structure, the prepared penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide has better effect on the prevention and treatment of tobacco mosaic virus, the prepared penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium polysaccharide enables active ingredients of the penicillium chrysogenum inactivated mycelium to be more definite, the preparation method is simple, pharmacology is clearer, the basis and the method are provided for developing natural antiviral preparations, and the invention has wide applicability in the field of natural product plant disease resistance.

title_en: Method for preparing high-conductivity fluororubber sealing material by ionic liquid assisted dispersion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery sealing materials, and discloses a method for preparing a high-conductivity fluororubber sealing material by ionic liquid assisted dispersion. The invention takes fluororubber as a matrix, and is matched with auxiliary materials such as a vulcanizing agent, an activating agent, an auxiliary crosslinking agent, a conductive filler, a conductive additive, a dispersing agent and the like, and the high-conductivity fluororubber sealing material which is easy to process and has low compression permanent deformation is prepared by filler pretreatment, mixing and vulcanization. The fluororubber sealing material prepared by the invention has excellent processing performance, extrusion deformation resistance and high conductivity, has excellent mechanical properties, has better tolerance to thermal aging and electrolyte, and has bright application prospect in the aspect of sealing electrode columns of lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Keycap and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a keycap and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein modified ABS resin: 60-80 parts; PC resin: 30-50 parts; a compatilizer: 3-7 parts; antioxidant: 2-8 parts; polyacrylonitrile fiber: 10-20 parts; the modified ABS resin is prepared from ABS resin, rubber oil, montmorillonite, butadiene and cumene hydroperoxide. This application has the effect that improves the hardness of key cap.

title_en: Easily-cleaned scratch-resistant polypropylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the easy-to-clean scratch-resistant polypropylene material is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of polypropylene resin, 1-5 parts of unsaturated carboxylic acid, 0.2-0.5 part of an initiator, 1-2 parts of a dispersion solvent, 0.1-0.3 part of an antioxidant 1#, 0.05-0.3 part of a catalyst, 0.3-1.2 parts of an antioxidant 2#, 0.5-2.5 parts of a lubricant and 0.8-1.0X parts of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, wherein X= (M  1 /M 1 ×M 2 )×N;m 1  is the added mass of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M  1  is the molecular weight of the unsaturated carboxylic acid, M  2  is the molecular weight of perfluoroalkyl alcohol, and N is the carboxylic acid number of the unsaturated carboxylic acid.

title_en: Graphene-loaded high-corrosion-resistance nano polyaniline microsphere and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses a graphene-loaded high-corrosion-resistance nano polyaniline microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of strictly controlling the proportion of doping acid, anion composite surfactant and deionized water to form a water phase component, and controlling aniline and ethylbenzene to form an oil phase component; then mixing water phase and oil phase according to a specified proportion; the nano-scale graphene is used as a core, and a composite initiator is used for initiating a reaction, so that the generated polyaniline has the characteristics of super-hydrophobic surface, graphene loaded in a cavity and nano-scale spherical particles. The high-corrosion-resistance nano polyaniline microspheres delay water permeation through the super-hydrophobic surface, and simultaneously, the capability of polyaniline to induce metal passivation by self is greatly enhanced by utilizing the high conductivity of graphene, so that multiple corrosion protection effects can be superposed on passive metal. The graphene-loaded high-corrosion-resistance nano polyaniline microspheres disclosed by the invention can also be used for preparing a corrosion-resistant coating or adding a corrosion inhibitor and the like.

title_en: Ink-absorbing coating emulsion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ink printing, and particularly discloses an ink-absorbing coating emulsion and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ink-absorbing coating emulsion comprises, by weight, 40-45 parts of methyl methacrylate, 30-40 parts of butyl acrylate, 10-15 parts of styrene, 1-3 parts of methacrylic acid, 1.5-3 parts of an emulsifier, 0.3-2 parts of a crosslinking monomer, 1-3 parts of an initiator and 100 parts of deionized water. According to the invention, by selecting the types and proportions of the monomers of methyl methacrylate, styrene, butyl acrylate and methacrylic acid and adding reasonable types and proportions of crosslinking monomers, the prepared emulsion has the characteristics of proper glass transition temperature, excellent yellowing performance, high printing and drying speed, bright and uniform printing color and low cost, and can meet the requirements of the existing outdoor portrait printing ink-absorbing coating and the requirements of the future outdoor portrait printing quick-drying ink-absorbing coating.

title_en: Anti-swelling hydrogel with excellent mechanical property and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: An anti-swelling hydrogel with excellent mechanical properties, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention belongs to the field of double-network hydrogel. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the existing hydrogel cannot give consideration to excellent swelling resistance, high strength, high toughness and electrical conductivity. The hydrogel has an interpenetrating double network, wherein a chitosan molecular chain is used as a first network, butyl acrylate, 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate and acrylic acid are used as monomers, dimethylaminoethyl methacrylate maleic acid ester is used as a cross-linking agent for copolymerization to form a second network, and the first network and the second network form a double network physical cross-linking structure with a hydrogen bonding effect. The hydrogel prepared by the invention has good mechanical property, high continuous conductivity and swelling resistance. Based on the excellent performances, the hydrogel is expected to be used as flexible wearable electronic equipment, and the application range of the hydrogel is widened.

title_en: High-tightness isotope sampling bottle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of closed plastic bottles, and discloses a high-tightness isotope sampling bottle, a preparation method and application thereof. The sampling bottle comprises a bottle body, a bottle cap and a gasket, wherein the gasket is arranged in the bottle cap. The invention realizes high air-isolation and airtight performance by optimizing the raw material composition of the bottle body and setting the thickness of the bottle body to be 2-4 mm, so that the sampling bottle can meet the requirements of  14  The requirements of sampling, sample preparation and testing in the year C technology can be matched with the used equipment. The sampling bottle uses high-density polyethylene as a main material, is compounded with nylon 6 and intercalated montmorillonite to improve gas barrier property, and intercalation groups of the intercalated montmorillonite have certain interaction with the high-density polyethylene, so that the intercalated montmorillonite is uniformly dispersed in the high-density polyethylene, and the barrier property is improved through a lamellar structure of the intercalated montmorillonite. The use of the nano particles not only improves the mechanical property of the sampling bottle, but alsoThe sampling bottle has a certain antibacterial function, so that the sample can be stored in the bottle for a long time.

title_en: Biaxially oriented polyolefin agricultural film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural film preparation, and particularly discloses a biaxially oriented polyolefin agricultural film. The biaxially oriented polyolefin agricultural film comprises the following raw material components in parts by weight: 50-70 parts of low-density polyethylene; 30-50 parts of linear low density polyethylene; 20-30 parts of ethylene-octene copolymer; 30-50 parts of reinforcing agent; 10-20 parts of liquid crystal high molecular polymer; 5-10 parts of compatilizer; 1-3 parts of dispersing agent; 0.5 to 1 part of ultraviolet absorber. The biaxially oriented polyolefin agricultural film is prepared from low-density polyethylene, linear low-density polyethylene, ethylene-octene copolymer, reinforcing agent and liquid crystal high-molecular polymer serving as raw materials, and has good tensile strength and tear strength.

title_en: High-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor and preparation method of material thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flexible sensors, and particularly discloses a high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor and a preparation method of a material of the high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor. The preparation method of the high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor material comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing epsilon-caprolactone and 1,4, 8-trioxaspiro-9-undecanone, and reacting under the action of a catalyst to obtain a polymer material; (2) Dissolving a polymer material in a solvent, adding a carbon nano tube, and carrying out ultrasonic stirring to obtain a uniform solution; and pouring the uniform solution into a mold for mold pressing to obtain the high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor material. The material can be completely degraded in tetrahydrofuran, so that the problem that the existing flexible material cannot be degraded is solved; meanwhile, the high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor material also has excellent mechanical properties; the high-sensitivity flexible wearable strain sensor made of the material also has good electrochemical stability and signal response performance.

title_en: Acid-resistant high-temperature-resistant phenolic epoxy anticorrosive paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid-resistant high-temperature-resistant phenolic epoxy anticorrosive paint and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of anticorrosive paint, and solves the problems of poor mechanical property and poor acid-resistant and alkali-resistant properties of the existing anticorrosive paint in a high-temperature environment. The coating comprises the following components: component one: phenolic epoxy resin, dispersing agent, polyamide wax slurry, silicon micropowder, barium sulfate, titanium white, carbon black, glass flakes, molybdenum disulfide, silane coupling agent KH-506, cyclohexanone, dimethylbenzene and butanol; and a second component: modified fatty amine curing agent, epoxy resin E-20, reactive diluent, dimethylbenzene and butanol. According to the invention, the flaky glass flake anti-corrosion material and the molybdenum disulfide wear-resistant material are added, so that the glass flakes are distributed more uniformly in a paint film, and a high-density high-temperature-resistant and acid-resistant anti-corrosion coating is obtained; the epoxy resin and the reactive diluent N-513 endow the modified fatty amine curing agent with excellent toughness, so that the paint film has more excellent physical and mechanical properties.

title_en: Coupled polymer asphalt modifier and preparation and application thereof in asphalt modification
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of asphalt polymer modification, and particularly relates to a coupled polymer asphalt modifier which comprises a coupled polymer A and a coupled polymer B, wherein the coupled polymer A has an expression of (SB)  n1 X 1 , and the coupled polymer B has an expression of [ S  1 -(S 2 /B)] n2 X 2  ]. The invention also provides preparation and application of the modifier and a waterproof coiled material added with the modifier. According to the invention, the combination of the double-coupling polymers A and B can generate cooperativity, so that the asphalt modification effect can be effectively improved.

title_en: Preparation method of phosphorus-nitrogen-silicon synergistic flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane for shoe leather surface layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of phosphorus-nitrogen-silicon synergistic flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane for shoe leather surface layers, which comprises the following steps: drying the polyhydric alcohol for 0.5 to 2 hours under the vacuum condition at the temperature of between 100 and 130 ℃, and controlling the water content in the polyhydric alcohol to be lower than 0.05 percent; and (2) uniformly mixing the polyol dried in the step (1) with isocyanate, heating to 80-100 ℃ for reaction for 1-2 h, then adding a chain extender, a hydrophilic chain extender and acetone, uniformly mixing, and reacting at 70-100 ℃ for 2-3 h. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the preparation process of the flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane is environment-friendly and pollution-free, the preparation process is simple, halogen is not contained, and the prepared waterborne polyurethane coating film has the characteristic of excellent flame retardance; the prepared waterborne polyurethane has excellent flame retardant property, and the elongation at break and the breaking strength are not obviously changed, namely the comprehensive performance of the flame retardant waterborne polyurethane is excellent.

title_en: 3D decoration film and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of decorative films, and more particularly, to a 3D decorative film and a process for preparing the same. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Sputtering the silver composite target material on the surface of the substrate to form a coating layer on the surface of the substrate; 2) Coating the transparent transition coating on the surface of the coating layer, and curing to form a transparent transition layer on the surface of the coating layer; 3) Printing the decorative coating on the transparent transition layer in a gravure printing mode, curing, and forming a decorative layer on the transparent transition layer to obtain a semi-finished product; 4) And coating the transparent protective coating on the semi-finished product to form a transparent protective layer, and curing to obtain the 3D decorative film. The preparation method is simple to operate, the chromatic aberration is formed through the coating layer and the decorative layer, the obtained 3D decorative film has a good 3D effect and is attractive, the 3D decorative film is not easy to discolor and tear, and the practicability of the 3D film is improved.

title_en: Quaternary nanostructure based on bright silver
abstract_en: The present invention discloses nanostructures comprising Ag, in, ga, and S, and a shell comprising Ag, ga, and S, wherein the nanostructures have a peak wavelength emission of 480-545nm and wherein at least about 80% of the emission is band-edge emission. Methods of making the nanostructures are also disclosed.

title_en: Method for increasing crystallization temperature of polyamide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a method for increasing the crystallization temperature of polyamide. The method for increasing the crystallization temperature of the polyamide comprises the following steps: adding the nucleating agent into a polyamide water salt system in proportion for polymerization, extrusion, cooling, drying and grain cutting; or proportionally adding the nucleating agent and the polyamide into a double-screw extruder for melting, extruding, cooling, drying and granulating. According to the invention, the special nucleating agent is added to improve the crystallization temperature and the crystallization speed of polyamide, so that the molding period can be shortened, the production efficiency can be improved, the crystal structure can be improved, the mechanical property and the optical property of a product can be improved, the thermal deformation temperature of the product can be improved, the dimensional stability of the product can be improved, and the post-shrinkage of the product can be reduced.

title_en: Bio-based polyol, preparation method thereof and application thereof in waterborne polyurethane coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyurethane coatings, and particularly relates to a bio-based polyol, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an aqueous polyurethane coating.A secondary alcohol is used as a first ring-opening reagent, and the secondary alcohol and epoxy vegetable oil carry out ring-opening reaction in a first microreactor of a microchannel modular reaction device under the action of a catalyst to obtain the polyol; and (3) taking alcohols containing quaternary ammonium salt as a second ring-opening reagent, and carrying out ring-opening reaction on the alcohols containing quaternary ammonium salt and polyhydric alcohol to obtain the bio-based polyhydric alcohol. The bio-based polyol prepared by adopting the novel ring-opening reagent has a novel structure, is moderate and uniformly distributed, has low viscosity, can replace the traditional petrochemical polyol, and can be used for preparing the waterborne polyurethane coating with remarkably improved performance.

title_en: Environment-friendly agricultural mulching film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly agricultural mulching film, which comprises the following components: 10-15 parts of bamboo powder, 4-6 parts of corn starch, 1-2 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 3-4 parts of plasticizer and 0.1-0.15 part of cross-linking agent; the invention also relates to a preparation method of the green and environment-friendly agricultural mulching film, which comprises the following steps: dissolving polyvinyl alcohol into water, adding corn starch, gelatinizing, adding bamboo powder and a plasticizer, stirring, adding a cross-linking agent, stirring for a period of time at a certain temperature, pouring into a template while hot, casting to form a film, drying, sizing on two sides, and drying for a period of time at room temperature to obtain a bamboo mulch film; the invention not only improves the added value of bamboo products, but also solves the problem that the existing degradable mulching film is difficult to replace plastic mulching film due to the problems of high price, non-environmental protection in the production process and the like.

title_en: Biocidal polyurethane system, method for the production thereof and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of polymers, in particular to polymer systems based on Polyurethane (PU) having a broad spectrum of biocidal activity, and to the use thereof for the production of biocidal products. The present invention provides a process for providing biocidal polyurethane-iodine (PU-I) complexes comprising (I) dissolving at least one iodine source into one or more starting materials for preparing a desired Polyurethane (PU) to obtain a single-phase iodine system, followed by (ii) conducting a PU polymerization reaction in the presence of the single-phase iodine system, thereby generating biocidal PU-I complexes in situ.

title_en: Glass bead for coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides glass beads for a coating, a preparation method and application thereof; the preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out surface treatment on the glass beads by adopting a treating agent to obtain glass beads for the coating; the treating agent is prepared from the following raw materials: 100 parts of reaction main material; 0.01 to 0.05 weight portion of catalyst; 50-100 parts of titanium dioxide slurry; 50-200 parts by weight of a first solvent; the reaction main material is prepared from the following components in a molar ratio of 10: (29 to 31): (4-12), isocyanate and amino silane coupling agent. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages that the treating agent with specific content components is selected to treat the glass beads, the integral better interaction is realized, the obtained glass beads for the coating can reduce the breakage rate in the coating preparation process, so that the coating is light in weight, has better heat insulation performance, and can improve the reflection performance of the coating on the premise of low titanium dioxide consumption.

title_en: Fluorine-containing treating agent, preparation method thereof and application of fluorine-containing treating agent to non-woven fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of surface treatment agents, and provides a fluorine-containing treatment agent, a preparation method and application thereof to non-woven fabrics, wherein the fluorine-containing treatment agent comprises 40-80 parts by mass of fluorine-containing monomers, 10-50 parts by mass of non-fluorine monomers, 1-10 parts by mass of crosslinking monomers and 10-40 parts by mass of halogenated olefin monomers, and the purpose of solving the contradiction that the conventional three-antibody finishing agent is difficult to achieve both good anti-alcohol performance and good antistatic performance. The prepared fluorine-containing treating agent has good anti-alcoholic performance, high mechanical strength and good antistatic performance, and meanwhile, the prepared fluorine-containing treating agent has good compatibility and good permeability to fibers due to the amphoteric emulsifying system, so that the fluorine-containing treating agent is suitable for non-woven fabrics.

title_en: Conjugated microporous polymer based on hydroxyl-substituted 1,3, 5-benzenetricarboxylic acid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydroxyl-substituted 1,3, 5-benzenetricarboxylic acid-based conjugated microporous polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of porous materials. The structural unit of the conjugated microporous polymer provided by the invention has a structure shown in a formula I or a formula II, and the conjugated microporous polymer has good thermal stability, a hollow microporous structure and a high specific surface area by introducing the 1,2, 4-triazole segment of the conjugated structure, has good catalytic and gas adsorption potentials, and can be applied to the fields of catalytic materials, adsorption materials, heat-resistant materials and the like. The conjugated microporous polymer with the structural unit having the structure shown in the formula I successfully prepared by the application has better thermal stability below 307 ℃ and certain absorption capacity on ultraviolet light, and the conjugated microporous polymer with the structural unit having the structure shown in the formula II has relatively excellent ultraviolet absorption performance and better internal thermal stability at 263 ℃.

title_en: Polyamide composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser welding materials, in particular to a polyamide composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polyamide composite material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-70 parts of conventional nylon, 5-15 parts of special nylon, 15-40 parts of glass fiber, 0.1-3 parts of nucleating agent, 0.1-5 parts of antioxidant auxiliary agent, 0.1-3 parts of lubricant, 0.1-3 parts of anti-reflection agent and 0.1-3 parts of organic toner. The invention adopts the mixture of special nylon and common nylon as the main raw material, adopts the compounding of flat glass fiber and round glass fiber, and utilizes the antioxidant auxiliary agent composed of copper salt antioxidant and composite antioxidant to improve the light transmittance while meeting the mechanical property of the material. According to the invention, the inorganic toner is replaced by the organic toner, so that the inorganic toner can be prevented from absorbing light waves, the light transmission performance of the material is improved, and the subsequent welding is facilitated.

title_en: ROMP monomer molecule with single chiral PEG side chain and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ROMP monomer molecule with a single chiral PEG side chain, which has a structure shown in a formula I; formula I, X is independently selected from chiral polyethylene glycol terminal group. The invention introduces a single side chain containing chiral PEG into the polymer through ROMP for the first time; the invention introduces N-bearing in each chain of the polymer through ROMP for the first time  3  The group chain stopping agent builds a platform for subsequent CLICK reaction, can be connected with small molecules such as dye and metal ions through the CLICK, and is used for tracking the metabolism and transport process of the polymer at the level of biological cells; the invention synthesizes a brush polymer containing chiral PEG side chains for the first time, the tail end of each PEG chain is provided with a Trt protecting group, and the Trt protecting group can be removed through p-toluenesulfonic acid, thereby exposing a large amount of hydroxyl groups which can participate in reaction for lappingThe drug-loading object constructs a wide platform.

title_en: Photoinitiator composition and ultraviolet light curable ink based on same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic film packaging, relates to the technical field of ultraviolet light curing ink, and relates to a photoinitiator composition and ultraviolet light curable ink based on the photoinitiator composition. The photoinitiator composition is formed by mixing a first photoinitiator and a second photoinitiator according to the weight ratio of 1 (0.1-10), wherein the first photoinitiator is a monoacyl phosphine oxide compound, and the second photoinitiator is a bisacyl phosphine oxide compound. The ultraviolet light curable ink prepared based on the photoinitiator composition has long absorption wavelength under the 395nm UV-LED light source and good photoinitiator activity, so that limited ultraviolet light energy is absorbed as much as possible, and the development of environment-friendly and energy-saving UV light curing is promoted.

title_en: Titanium-based nano composite material for microwave thermal diagnosis and treatment integration and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a titanium-based nano composite material for microwave thermal diagnosis and treatment integration and a preparation method and application thereof. The titanium-based nano composite material has good microwave heat conversion performance under microwave irradiation; active oxygen can be generated under microwave irradiation, and the microwave generator has good microwave power performance; meanwhile, the magnetic resonance imaging method can be used for magnetic resonance imaging, guiding tumor treatment in real time and being effectively applied to the field of biomedicine.

title_en: Polyurethane resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyurethane resin and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyurethane resin comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of polyester polyol, 4.0-11.0 parts of toluene diisocyanate, 16.0-31.5 parts of 4, 4' -diphenylmethane diisocyanate, 2.5-7.5 parts of chain extender, 4.0-6.0 parts of sealant, 0.5-0.7 part of flatting agent, 0.1-0.2 part of antioxidant and 0.2-0.5 part of wear-resistant assistant, wherein the wear-resistant assistant is prepared from fumed silica, titanate coupling agent and graphene oxide. The polyurethane resin disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the viscosity and the solid content meet the industrial standard, and the polyurethane resin has excellent wear resistance, breaking strength and elongation.

title_en: Method for preparing branched polycarbonate by continuous two-phase interface phosgene method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing branched polycarbonate by a continuous two-phase interface phosgene method, which comprises the following steps: step a: respectively dissolving dihydric phenol and a branching agent with alkaline solution, and carrying out phosgenation reaction with phosgene in inert organic solvent to obtain branched polycarbonate prepolymer A; step b: dissolving dihydric phenol with alkaline solution, and performing phosgenation reaction with phosgene in inert organic solvent to obtain polycarbonate prepolymer B; dissolving the end capping agent by using an inert organic solvent, and then adding the end capping agent into the polycarbonate prepolymer B for uniform mixing; step c: and d, directly mixing the prepolymers obtained in the step a and the step b, adding a polycondensation catalyst for polycondensation reaction, and finally obtaining the branched polycarbonate. The method can obviously reduce the phosgene consumption under the condition of avoiding excessive cross-linking of the product, and can prepare the branched polycarbonate with the branching agent conversion rate of more than 99% and few crystal points.

title_en: Preparation method of methylphenyl silicone oil
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of methyl phenyl silicone oil, which comprises the following steps: a1 Mixing methylphenyl oligomer, octamethyl cyclotetrasiloxane and hexamethyldisiloxane, heating to 50-60 ℃, adding tetramethyl ammonium hydroxide or tetramethyl ammonium hydroxide alkali gel, heating to 85-100 ℃, adding water, continuously stirring for 4-8 h under the vacuum degree of minus 0.04-minus 0.098MPa, heating to 145-155 ℃, maintaining for 55-65 min, heating to 180-200 ℃, and removing small molecules to obtain the methylphenyl silicone oil. Or further, adding a phosphazene chloride catalyst after the medium is broken; not only can achieve the aim of rapidly eliminating hydroxyl (or alkoxy) but also can avoid regenerating a ring body, thereby improving the generating efficiency.

title_en: Packaging epoxy resin for dry type transformer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of epoxy resin, in particular to a packaging epoxy resin for a dry-type transformer and a preparation method thereof; preparing multi-polyether modified silicone oil by reacting hydrogen-containing polysiloxane with polyether, blocking polyether by using isocyanate groups and blocking the isocyanate groups to obtain isocyanate-blocked multi-polyether modified organosilicon containing multi-reactive groups; introducing mercapto polysulfide rubber and modified organosilicon into epoxy resin; controlling the mass ratio of the mercapto polysulfide rubber at the end and the modified organosilicon; the method is characterized in that the phytic acid iron and ammonium polyphosphate are compounded to be used as a composite halogen-free flame retardant, wherein the phytic acid iron is a hollow medium Kong Zhisuan iron nanosphere with a multi-stage structure; the bimetal organic frame modified polyethylenimine is prepared from the bimetal organic frame and the hyperbranched polyethylenimine and is used as a curing agent, so that the fatigue and self-healing properties of the epoxy resin are effectively improved, and the service life of the epoxy resin is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Environment-friendly transfer glue and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly transfer adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof. The transfer glue comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 45 to 65 portions of water, 8 to 18 portions of solid acrylic resin, 3 to 5 portions of ammonia water, 0.2 to 0.6 portion of emulsifier, 25 to 45 portions of acrylic monomer, 2 to 5 portions of initiator solution, 0.2 to 2 portions of cross linker and 1 to 5 portions of film forming additive; the acid value of the solid acrylic resin is 140-280 mg KOH/g, and the Tg is 50-150 ℃.
