The transfer glue is similar to soap-free emulsion, and emulsion synthesis is carried out by selecting solid acrylic resin with high acid value as protective glue, so that the hydrophilicity of the solid resin is good, the Tg is high, and the coating tends to be distributed in a homogeneous phase in the film forming process; meanwhile, the high-Tg hydrophilic outer layer endows the surface of the coating with better flatness, is similar to a mirror surface effect, and can form mirror reflection more easily during high-temperature mould pressing to obtain a better laser effect.

title_en: Fluorine-containing surfactant for oil film stripping and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine-containing surfactant for stripping an oil film, which consists of 1-2 parts of maleic anhydride/primary amine/amino-terminated polyether/diisocyanate/fluorine-containing alcohol/sodium bisulfite and 5-8 parts of N, N-dimethylformamide. A preparation method of a fluorine-containing surfactant for oil film stripping comprises the steps of firstly, putting maleic anhydride, primary amine and amino-terminated polyether into a reactor according to the formula amount, and stirring uniformly to react to obtain a first intermediate product; step two, uniformly mixing diisocyanate and fluorine-containing alcohol according to the formula amount to obtain a mixture, and then adding the mixture into N, N-dimethylformamide according to the formula amount to be uniformly stirred and reacted to obtain a second intermediate product; step three, mixing the first intermediate product and the second intermediate product to obtain a third intermediate product; and step four, adding sodium bisulfite with the formula amount into the third intermediate product to obtain a mixture, then adding water into the mixture, and obtaining the fluorine-containing surfactant for oil film stripping after the reaction is finished.

title_en: Method and system for adsorbing and purifying helium by adopting two-section film combined alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of helium extraction and refining, and particularly discloses a method and a system for purifying helium by adopting two-section film combined alloy adsorption. The method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: and sequentially carrying out catalytic dehydrogenation separation, first-stage polymer membrane separation, alloy adsorption and second-stage polymer membrane separation on the feed gas to obtain the ultrapure helium. The invention effectively combines the processes of catalytic oxidative dehydrogenation (primary dehydrogenation), polymer membrane separation (first-stage membrane separation and second-stage membrane separation), alloy adsorption (deep dehydrogenation) and the like together, and takes natural gas, shale gas, multi-stage flash steam and the like as raw material gases to prepare high-purity helium (5N or 6N-stage helium), and the conditions of the processes are stable and controllable; the advantages of the above process technologies are combined, especially the specific arrangement among the processes is considered, so that the helium preparation process is simple, economic, continuous and stable, the problem of preparation and purification of the ultra-pure helium is well solved, and the method has a very wide application prospect.

title_en: Flame-retardant polyurethane material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant polyurethane material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the flame-retardant polyurethane material comprises the following steps of carrying out surface modification on mica stone by adopting a silane coupling agent, dispersing the obtained surface-modified mica stone and imidazole in a solvent, adding zinc salt, reacting to obtain a synergistic flame retardant, mixing and reacting the synergistic flame retardant with ammonium polyphosphate, isocyanate and polyalcohol, adding a chain extender and a catalyst, and mixing to obtain the flame-retardant polyurethane material. The flame-retardant polyurethane material provided by the invention takes ammonium polyphosphate as a main flame retardant and takes a synergistic flame retardant prepared from mica as an auxiliary flame retardant, so that the flame-retardant effect is greatly improved, the problems of large addition amount and low flame-retardant efficiency of the traditional additive flame retardant are effectively solved, the influence on the mechanical properties of the material is avoided, and the flame-retardant polyurethane material is a green, environment-friendly and efficient halogen-free flame-retardant material.

title_en: Method for preparing compact polyolefin polyamide thin-layer composite membrane based on concentrated aromatic polyacyl chloride coating interfacial polymerization
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a compact polyolefin polyamide thin-layer composite membrane based on interfacial polymerization of a concentrated aromatic polyacyl chloride coating, wherein the membrane consists of a Polyethylene (PE) bottom membrane and a compact Polyamide (PA) layer, and the typical preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing diamine aqueous solution and acyl chloride alkane solution with proper concentration; the preparation method comprises the steps of taking a polyethylene support membrane, pouring a proper amount of aromatic polyacyl chloride organic solution on the surface of the polyethylene support membrane, completely volatilizing a solvent in an oil phase solution by adopting different drying methods to obtain a dried and concentrated aromatic polyacyl chloride coating, then pouring a diamine aqueous phase solution for interfacial polymerization, pouring out the diamine solution after the interfacial polymerization is carried out for a certain time, and then drying.

title_en: High-light-transmittance low-moisture-absorption material for LED packaging and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-light-transmittance low-moisture-absorption material for LED packaging, which is prepared by grafting and modifying a collagen polypeptide single-layer film G-STSocac by using epoxy polysiloxane (PDMS-E) with a molecular weight of 1000, wherein the grafting rate of the epoxy polysiloxane on the film is 1.7-2.0%, the contact angle is 115-126 ℃, the water resistance is that the weight loss rate of the epoxy polysiloxane after being soaked in water for 2 hours is 0.006-0.011%, the high temperature resistance is that the weight loss rate of the epoxy polysiloxane after being stood for 2 hours is 0.002-0.005% under the condition of 150+/-5 ℃, and the visible light transmittance is 94-98%. The high-light-transmittance low-moisture-absorption material for LED packaging provided by the invention has good light transmittance characteristics, low thickness and controllability, and the epoxy polysiloxane is firmly combined with the polypeptide monolayer film, so that the chemical stability is high. Compared with the prior art, the coating can improve the adhesiveness of the coating on the surface of the material.

title_en: SPAN/MOFs @ Luminol luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano material preparation and chemiluminescence analysis, and discloses a preparation method and application of a sulfonated polyaniline functionalized metal organic framework @ Luminol (SPAN/MOFs @ Luminol) luminescent material, wherein the preparation method of the SPAN/MOFs @ Luminol luminescent material comprises the following steps: preparing Sulfonated Polyaniline (SPAN) by controlling synthesis conditions, modifying the SPAN on the surface of a Metal Organic Framework (MOFs) material by a hydrothermal method, centrifuging a reaction product, washing, collecting precipitate, and drying in a drying oven to obtain a sulfonated polyaniline functionalized metal organic framework material; adding Luminol, magnetically stirring for reaction for a while, centrifuging, washing and precipitating to obtain SPAN/MOFs @ Luminol chemiluminescent material. The SPAN/MOFs @ Luminol luminescent material prepared by the invention has high chemiluminescence quantum yield, can generate a significant chemiluminescence signal in the presence of hydrogen peroxide without adding a chemiluminescence substrate, and is easy to operate in reaction, stable in luminescence signal and easy to record.

title_en: Deep high-temperature-resistant salt-resistant fluid loss agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature-resistant salt-resistant fluid loss agent suitable for deep layers and a preparation method and application thereof. The high-temperature-resistant salt-resistant fluid loss agent suitable for deep layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of water, 10-70 parts of 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, 5-80 parts of N, N-dimethylacrylamide, 0.5-20 parts of acrylamide, 0.1-25 parts of vinylpyrrolidone, 1-30 parts of 3-allyloxy-2-hydroxy-1-propanesulfonic acid, 1-20 parts of acrylic acid and 0.01-20 parts of acrylonitrile. The preparation method of the deep-layer high-temperature-resistant salt-resistant fluid loss agent is simple, and the prepared product has good water solubility and can be matched with other oil well cement additives for use at the temperature of less than 180 ℃. Has wider temperature application range and good salt resistance effect, and does not influence the performance of cement paste in saturated or semi-saturated saline water.

title_en: Curing reaction resins using unsaturated peroxides as initiators and organophosphites as accelerators
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel reactive resin formulations, for example for marking roads or for coating surfaces, which have a significantly improved performance profile compared with the prior art. The reaction resins, especially based on the new curing agent system, exhibit an improved combination of the following properties: higher long-term storage stability, improved toxicological profile, shortened curing times and a low tendency to yellowing, and also better color fastness.

title_en: Wood-based bionic skeleton material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wood-based bionic skeleton material and a preparation method thereof, and the wood-based bionic skeleton material comprises wood-based cellulose hydrogel, wherein the wood-based cellulose hydrogel is provided with a cross-linking structure formed by cellulose and a high polymer material, the cross-linking structure forms a fiber skeleton which is obtained by carrying out delignification treatment on wood, and the cellulose and the high polymer material form a stable wood-based bionic skeleton material through hydrogen bonds. The method comprises the steps of carrying out chemical treatment on wood raw materials by using alkaline substances and/or oxides to obtain a pretreatment product, and carrying out freeze-thaw drying treatment on the pretreatment product to obtain the wood-based bionic skeleton material. The invention effectively solves the problems of non-degradability and isotropy of petroleum-based hydrogel materials, and has the advantages of environmental protection, degradability, light weight, low cost, simple preparation process, easily obtained raw materials, good biocompatibility and excellent mechanical strength.

title_en: Synthesis method of large-particle-size polybutadiene latex
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer material preparation, and provides a method for synthesizing polybutadiene latex with large particle size. According to the invention, butadiene and a chain transfer agent are added into a reaction liquid in batches for polymerization reaction, and polybutadiene obtained in the previous reaction can be used as seeds for the subsequent polymerization reaction, so that multi-step seed polymerization is realized; the method provided by the invention is simple to operate, the reaction time is short, and the obtained polybutadiene latex has narrow particle size distribution; meanwhile, the particle size of the obtained polybutadiene latex can be controlled by controlling the reaction times, and the particle size of the obtained polybutadiene latex is larger when the reaction times are larger under the condition that the total consumption of butadiene and chain transfer agent is the same. In addition, the polybutadiene latex obtained by the synthesis method provided by the invention has low solid content, and is beneficial to control of reaction.

title_en: Photo-thermal response-based liquid drop control ultra-smooth surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra-smooth surfaces. The invention provides a photo-thermal response-based liquid drop control ultra-smooth surface and a preparation method thereof. Sequentially preparing a first layer of microstructure and a second layer of microstructure on a silicon wafer, spraying polyvinylpyrrolidone solution, and then baking to obtain the silicon wafer with a double-layer microstructure; mixing hydrophobic modified ferroferric oxide nano particles, polydimethylsiloxane prepolymer and curing agent to obtain a mixture; pouring the mixture on a silicon wafer with a double-layer microstructure, sequentially removing bubbles, and stripping from the silicon wafer after curing treatment to obtain a ferroferric oxide-polydimethylsiloxane droplet controlled ultra-smooth surface substrate; and immersing the ferroferric oxide-polydimethylsiloxane liquid drop control super-smooth surface substrate in silicone oil to obtain the liquid drop control super-smooth surface based on photo-thermal response. The super-smooth surface for controlling the liquid drop with the double-layer microstructure can control the liquid drop 614 times, and has good durability.

title_en: Carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on conductive network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on a conductive network, which comprises the following raw materials: carbon fiber materials, phenolic resin and nano conductive carbon materials; the nano conductive carbon material is deposited on the surface of the carbon fiber through electrochemistry and is physically dispersed in the phenolic resin; the carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on the conductive network is obtained by coating phenolic resin containing nano conductive carbon materials on carbon fiber materials modified by the nano conductive carbon materials and then performing hot-pressing curing; the nano conductive carbon material is a compound of a carbon nano tube and graphene. The invention not only improves the interface bonding force of the carbon fiber/phenolic resin composite material, but also further enhances the mechanical and electrical coupling performance of the composite material. Meanwhile, the relationship among the material structure, the mechanical property and the electrical property is established through the resistance measurement result, and a new idea is provided for the electrical impedance measurement technology of the composite material.

title_en: Polyurethane adhesive combined polyether for melamine board, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides polyurethane adhesive combined polyether for a melamine board, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of adhesives. The polyurethane adhesive combined polyether for the melamine board adopts polyether polyol A and polyether polyol B with different hydroxyl values and molecular weights, uses an organic metal catalyst and/or an amine catalyst with a delayed catalysis effect, and ensures sufficient construction time and shorter curing and drying time by accurately controlling the addition amount of the catalyst. The polyurethane adhesive prepared from the combined polyether has the construction time of more than 2 hours and the curing and drying time of less than 24 hours, and is particularly suitable for construction operation of adhering melamine boards. The polyurethane adhesive prepared from the combined polyether has high bonding strength to melamine boards, is solvent-free and has good environmental protection performance.

title_en: High transparency electrochromic polymers
abstract_en: An electrochromic polymer is composed of repeating units comprising one or more meta-conjugated linkers (MCLs) and one or more aromatic moieties (Ars). Each of the one or more MCLs is partially conjugated to the one or more Ars at a position meta to the MCLs to form a polymer backbone of the electrochromic polymer. The electrochromic polymer can undergo optical switching and color change in an electrochromic device, exhibiting high transparency and high optical contrast.

title_en: Chlorinated polyethylene rubber composition, rubber sheet and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vulcanized rubber, and particularly discloses a chlorinated polyethylene rubber composition, a rubber plate and a preparation method. The chlorinated polyethylene rubber composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of chlorinated polyethylene rubber, 2-15 parts of heat stabilizer, 0.1-0.5 part of anti-aging agent, 10-60 parts of reinforcing agent, 20-80 parts of inorganic filler, 2-6 parts of flow promoter, 10-35 parts of plasticizer, 2-5 parts of cross-linking agent and 1-5 parts of auxiliary cross-linking agent; the flow auxiliary agent is compound fatty acid R-300V. The flow assistant R-300V has obvious internal lubrication effect on a rubber compound system, the demolding performance and the mechanical property of the plate in a rubber plate vulcanization process are greatly improved, the rubber plate with a smooth and flat surface and extremely small shrinkage deformation can be prepared by a drum type vulcanizing machine and a flat plate vulcanizing machine, and a finished product of the rubber plate has good mechanical property, heat resistance, aging resistance, flame retardance and oil resistance, is a multifunctional low-cost rubber plate, and expands the application field of the chlorinated polyethylene rubber.

title_en: EPVA polymerization heat removal method under low pressure condition and EPVA preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ethylene modified polyvinyl alcohol preparation methods, in particular to a method for EPVA polymerization heat removal under low pressure, a preparation method of EPVA and equipment thereof. The preparation process of EPVA includes polymerization reaction of the copolymerization system in the reaction environment to obtain copolymerized resin; in the polymerization reaction process, a gas phase part consisting of ethylene, vinyl ester compounds and a solvent is led out from a reaction environment and flows in parallel with a liquid phase part consisting of vinyl ester compounds and the solvent, and then condensate and non-condensable gas are formed after cooling treatment; the condensate is conveyed back to the reaction environment, and the non-condensable gas is conveyed back to the reaction environment after being pressurized; and continuously collecting the polymerization liquid containing the copolymer resin from the reaction environment. The technical problem that the efficiency of using gas-phase ethylene to remove heat is not high when EPVA is synthesized under low pressure can be solved, and the method can be applied to practical operation of production and preparation of EPVA.

title_en: Anti-static trench cover plate
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-static trench cover plate, which relates to the technical field of cover plates, and the anti-static trench cover plate is prepared from, by weight, 25-30% of polyurea grease, 28-36% of filler, 0.5-2% of conductive filler, 6-20% of curing agent, 16-24% of polyether-ether-ketone, 2-5% of fiber mesh cloth, 0.3-1% of plasticizer and 0.5-3% of other auxiliary agents. According to the invention, the polyether-ether-ketone and the plasticizer are mixed, hot-melt extruded and then pressed to form the cover plate inner core, polyurea grease, filler, conductive filler and other auxiliary agents are mixed and reacted with a curing agent to prepare the injection molding liquid, the injection molding liquid is molded on the surface of the cover plate inner core, the cover plate inner core made of the polyether-ether-ketone material has higher strength, the finished cover plate can be prevented from being easily deformed, the addition of the conductive filler can adjust the resistance of the outer layer of the finished cover plate, so that the resistance of the finished cover plate can be between antistatic standards, and the finished cover plate can achieve better use effect.

title_en: Preparation method of mold containing release agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mold preparation, and provides a preparation method of a mold containing a release agent. According to the invention, the liquid release agent and the solid release agent are respectively added into the photo-curing composite cyanate ink, and the solid release agent has an adsorption effect on the liquid release agent, and the two types of release agents do not participate in the cross-linking polymerization reaction of the photo-curing composite cyanate ink, and finally the liquid release agent can be separated out from the interior of the die, so that a layer of lubricating film is formed on the surface, the surface energy of the die and the friction and adhesion force of the die during demolding are obviously reduced, the die can be effectively and nondestructively demolded without additionally smearing the release agent during use, and the die can be recycled. Meanwhile, after the acid ester monomer in the photo-curing composite cyanate ester ink is subjected to photo-thermal treatment, a triazine ring structure is formed, so that the die has excellent mechanical property and thermal stability. In addition, the invention adopts 3D printing to prepare the mould, has high forming speed and high precision, and meets the customization requirement of the personalized mould.

title_en: Polyester for high-speed film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a polyester for a high-speed film and a preparation method thereof, which are used for preparing the high-speed film by playing the comprehensive effects of reducing crystallization rate, improving attachment performance, reducing viscosity and reducing crystallinity by playing the synergistic effect of additives in polyester melt. Compared with the existing film polyester for the medium-high speed production line with the same performance index, the polyester for the high-speed film prepared by the utility model has the advantages that the melting specific resistance is reduced by more than 50%, the viscosity of the polyester after melt extrusion is reduced by more than 45%, the semi-crystallization time is increased by more than 15%, the molecular weight distribution index is increased by 10%, the maximum tensile strain rate of a cast sheet is increased by more than 20%, and the high-speed film has obvious high-speed tensile advantage.

title_en: Iron-based hybrid flocculant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water treatment, in particular to an iron-based hybrid flocculant and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the iron-based hybrid flocculant comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing an ammonium acetate solution with an iron salt solution to obtain ferric hydroxide colloid; (2) Uniformly mixing part of acrylamide and ferric hydroxide colloid to obtain a mixed solution; (3) And uniformly mixing the initiator, the mixed solution, the hydrophobic cationic monomer and the residual acrylamide, and then reacting to obtain the iron-based hybrid flocculant. The application method of the iron-based hybrid flocculant in pretreatment of high turbidity and oil-containing mine water comprises the following steps: (1) adjusting the pH value and the temperature of the water body of the mine water; and (2) adding an iron-based hybrid flocculant and stirring. The mine water pretreatment method provided by the invention is simple, convenient and efficient, and can avoid harm to the environment.

title_en: Covalent organic framework material, ligand structure thereof and application of covalent organic framework material in separation membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a covalent organic framework material, a ligand structure thereof and application thereof in a separation membrane, and belongs to the technical field of preparation and application of covalent organic framework materials. The invention solves the problems of low flux, low recycling rate and the like of the traditional composite membrane for oil-water separation under the gravity condition. The invention firstly synthesizes a covalent organic framework material COF-ET41, then takes the COF-ET41 and PAN as raw materials, and prepares the COF-ET41/PAN nanofiber composite membrane by adopting an electrostatic spinning technology. The composite membrane has excellent separation performance, and the flux of the oil-water mixture can reach 3.42 multiplied by 10 under the driving of gravity  5   Lm  ‑2  h  ‑1  The separation efficiency is more than 99.9%. In addition, the composite membrane has excellent anti-pollution performance, the flux is hardly attenuated after 100 times of circulation, the separation efficiency is still maintained above 99.9%, and the composite membrane has huge long-term application potential.

title_en: Application of photoresist in ArF dry photoetching
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of photoresist in ArF dry lithography. The photoresist composition in the application is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 75-95 parts of resin, 1.0-10 parts of photoacid generator, 1000-2000 parts of solvent, 0.5-3.0 parts of quencher and surfactant. The photoresist containing the resin has the advantages of high resolution, high sensitivity and low line width roughness.

title_en: Insulating high-heat-conductivity fiber gasket material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulating high-heat-conductivity silicon nitride fiber gasket material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the insulating high-heat-conductivity silicon nitride fiber gasket material comprises the following components: the base material and the heat conducting filler are fibrous fillers, and the fibrous fillers comprise at least one of carbon fibers, carbon nanotubes, boron nitride fibers, aluminum oxide fibers and copper fibers; the insulating high-heat-conductivity fiber gasket material prepared by the invention has certain insulating property, higher heat conductivity coefficient, certain flexibility, reduced contact thermal resistance and prolonged service life of electronic components.

title_en: Liner for pressure vessel and high pressure gas storage tank
abstract_en: A gasket for a pressure vessel, which comprises a fiber-reinforced composite material comprising a thermosetting resin or a cured product of a thermosetting resin composition and comprising continuous reinforcing fibers, and a high-pressure gas tank provided with the gasket.

title_en: Aging-resistant degradable modified double-bio-based polyether polyol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aging-resistant degradable modified double-bio-based polyether polyol and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polyether polyol preparation. The technical proposal is as follows: comprises the steps of extracting hemicellulose, preparing modified hemicellulose and preparing modified double bio-based polyether polyol. The invention can prepare the double-biology-based polyether polyol with good thermal stability and more environment protection.

title_en: Flame retardant, fireproof paint and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame retardant, a fireproof paint and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the flame retardant comprises the following steps: stirring zirconium phosphate to disperse in water, then dropwise adding tetrabutylammonium hydroxide solution, performing ultrasonic stirring reaction, dropwise adding phosphoric acid, and performing solid-liquid separation after the reaction to obtain semitransparent gel precipitate; washing the semitransparent gel precipitate, adding a silane coupling agent and a reaction solvent, stirring and performing ultrasonic dispersion, and then stirring and reacting under the condition of oil bath to obtain a reactant; adding benzaldehyde into the reaction product to react; adding DOPO and heating to perform reflux reaction; after the reflux reaction is finished, cooling to room temperature, filtering, washing and drying to obtain the flame retardant. The flame retardant, the fireproof paint and the preparation method have the advantages of long fire resistance time, good water resistance and durability, short drying time, environmental friendliness, wide applicability and simple preparation process, and are suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Method for stabilizing organic materials using a stabilizer mixture
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for stabilizing organic materials by reducing degradation caused by chlorine-containing compounds. The invention further relates to a stabilizer mixture comprising at least one compound (A), at least one UV absorber and at least one metal hydroxide. The invention also relates to a composition comprising an organic material and a stabilizer mixture. Furthermore, the invention relates to articles prepared from said composition. Furthermore, the invention relates to the use of the stabilizer mixture for stabilizing organic materials by reducing degradation caused by chlorine-containing compounds.

title_en: Liquid hindered phenol antioxidant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid hindered phenol antioxidant, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the molecular structure of the liquid hindered phenol antioxidant is as follows:  The liquid hindered phenol antioxidant prepared by the invention not only can effectively inhibit the generation of aldehyde in the storage process of polyether, but also has certain heat resistance, oxidation resistance and thermal stability, and has excellent compatibility with polyurethane foam, and is particularly suitable for polyurethane flexible foam slabs.

title_en: SMMA microporous foam material with high toughness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SMMA microporous foaming material with high toughness and a preparation method thereof. SMMA microporous foam material with high toughness has a notched impact strength of 2KJ/m  2  The elongation at break is more than 2.5%, the weight loss is more than 25%, the average size of the cells is less than 40 microns, and the density of the cells is more than 10  7  Individual/cm  3  . The preparation method comprises the following steps: blending and extruding 60-90 wt% of SMMA, 10-40 wt% of elastomer SBS and 0-5wt% of nucleating agent through a double screw extruder, drying the obtained composite material, and adding the dried composite material into a foaming injection molding machine to form foaming gasThe body pressure is 4-10MPa, the pre-molding is carried out to obtain even composite material melt and gas melt, the even composite material melt and gas melt are injected into a mold cavity, the pressure is maintained, then the mold is opened for foaming, and the SMMA microporous foaming material with high toughness is obtained after cooling.

title_en: Flexible regenerated carbon fiber cloth electromagnetic shielding film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible regenerated carbon fiber cloth electromagnetic shielding film. The high-efficiency and flexible electromagnetic shielding film of the regenerated carbon fiber cloth is prepared by using the regenerated carbon fiber cloth obtained through low-consumption and environment-friendly thermal cracking, carrying silver nanowires on the surface and impregnating resin for molding. The high-value recycling process of the recycled carbon fiber is closely related to the integrity and feasibility of a composite material recycling technical chain and an industrial chain in the face of resource waste and environmental pollution caused by waste carbon fiber composite materials; according to the invention, the surface of the regenerated carbon fiber is characterized, and the electromagnetic function is regulated and controlled, so that the flexible and efficient electromagnetic shielding film is obtained. The method is suitable for more different electromagnetic protection environments, and has important significance on solving the problems of waste carbon fiber composite material resources and electromagnetic wave radiation pollution, along with green, environment-friendly and economic significance.

title_en: Functionalized modified heat-conducting silicone rubber material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functionalized modified heat-conducting silicone rubber material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the heat-conducting silicone rubber material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-100 parts of silicon rubber, 2.3-2.8 parts of silane coupling agent, 5-8 parts of carbon nano tube, 25-30 parts of metal oxide, 115-20 parts of self-made carbon fiber, 8-16 parts of metal organic porous material and 15-25 parts of fumed silica.

title_en: Multiple-response hydrogel with high capacity and drug loading, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a multi-response hydrogel for high-capacity loaded drugs, which promotes the phenylboronic acid group and the 1, 2-or 1, 3-diol/phenol group to form a boric acid ester bond under the action of a hydrophilic alkaline drug molecule through the boron-nitrogen coordination action of the phenylboronic acid group and the hydrophobic drug, thereby promoting the cross-linking of a hydrogel precursor into a gel, successfully solving the defect of regulating the pH value faced by constructing the hydrogel through the boric acid ester bond, avoiding introducing impurities into a hydrogel material, and realizing high-capacity loading of the hydrophobic drug.

title_en: Emulsion special for expansion type steel structure fireproof coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emulsion special for an expansion type steel structure fireproof coating, which comprises an inner hard core, an inner hard core surface layer, an outer soft shell and an outer soft shell surface layer, wherein the emulsion is prepared from an inner hard core raw material, an inner hard core surface layer raw material, an outer soft shell raw material and an outer soft shell raw material through emulsification, initiated copolymerization and condensation, and an inner crosslinking monomer is two acrylic ester monomers with carbon-carbon double bonds, and an outer soft shell surface layer raw material is a vinyl silane coupling agent and a normal-temperature self-crosslinking monomer. The invention ensures the minimum film forming temperature and simultaneously greatly improves the compactness of the emulsion after film forming and the water resistance, the cohesiveness and the adhesive force to the filler of the emulsion by the synergistic effect of three crosslinking systems of micro crosslinking in the emulsion, normal temperature self crosslinking and inorganic-organic phase crosslinking, thereby greatly improving the water resistance and the cohesiveness of the coating.

title_en: Preparation method of high-entropy covalent organic framework compound
abstract_en: The invention mainly provides a preparation method of a high-entropy covalent organic framework Compound (COF), which comprises the following steps of dispersing trialdehyde phloroglucinol (Tp), 2, 5-dibromo-p-phenylenediamine, 2, 5-dichloro-p-phenylenediamine, 2- (trifluoromethyl) -1, 4-phenylenediamine and p-phenylenediamine in a mixed solution of o-dichlorobenzene and n-butanol under the condition of room temperature ultrasonic; adding proper amount of acetic acid and deionized water into the solution after ultrasonic dispersion is uniform; vacuum is applied for 5min under the condition of liquid nitrogen freezing, and the mixture is thawed again, circulated for 3 times, and then reacted for 72h in an oven at 120 ℃. The prepared sample was washed with dichloromethane and collected in a vacuum oven at 80 ℃ overnight. According to the technical scheme, under the condition of acetic acid, a crystalline substance which is insoluble in a solvent is rapidly generated, and the COF material with high crystallization and high specific surface area is obtained through high-temperature preparation for 3 days.

title_en: Stable Pickering emulsion of starch nanocrystalline-sodium alginate composite particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stable Pickering emulsion of starch nanocrystalline-sodium alginate composite particles and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the surface wettability and electrostatic repulsive force of the starch nanocrystalline particles are improved in a mode of compounding sodium alginate and starch nanocrystalline, so that the starch nanocrystalline particles are easier to adsorb on an oil-water interface and are not easy to agglomerate, the stability of emulsion is improved, and the defect that a single starch nanocrystalline is used as an emulsifier is overcome; in addition, two natural plant polysaccharides are selected as raw materials, so that the plant polysaccharide has the advantages of rich sources, low price, good biocompatibility and safety.

title_en: Method for synthesizing metal organic framework material by using aluminum-rich clay mineral acid etching solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a metal organic frame material by using an acid etching solution of an aluminum-rich clay mineral, which takes an aluminum-rich waste liquid generated in the process of producing nano silicon dioxide by acid etching nano clay as a raw material and a reaction medium, synthesizes the aluminum metal organic frame material through one-step hydrothermal reaction, realizes the utilization of valuable resources and the production of new materials while harmlessly disposing the waste liquid, and truly achieves the sustainable development goal of changing waste into materials. The prepared metal organic framework material has good crystallinity, excellent performance, stable batch, specific surface area up to 477.91m  2 /g, no influence on the adsorption of organic molecules by coexisting ions, high removal rate of organic pollutants (such as p-nitrophenol) in real water bodies such as seawater, long river water, yellow river water, tap water and the like, and strong practical applicability.

title_en: Cu-MOF porous material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Cu-MOF porous material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, 3D printing hydrogel precursor ink to form a 3D printing hydrogel matrix with a preset shape, S2, reacting the hydrogel matrix in a copper source to obtain the Cu-MOF porous material, wherein the Cu-MOF is a metal organic framework material formed by taking copper ions as nodes and trimesic acid ligand as a support, and the preparation method of the Cu-MOF porous material is simple in preparation method, high in yield, good in stability of the prepared complex, favorable for storage, good in selectivity to CO  2  and capable of realizing efficient, simple and specific detection of CO  2 .

title_en: Maleic anhydride-conjugated diene copolymer microsphere, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of macromolecules, and discloses a maleic anhydride-conjugated diene copolymer microsphere, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises dissolving polymerization monomer and initiator in reaction medium in protective atmosphere to form homogeneous solution, polymerizing to obtain copolymer emulsion suspension, and separating to obtain maleic anhydride-conjugated di-polymerOlefin copolymer microspheres; the polymerized monomers are maleic anhydride and conjugated diene; the amount of maleic anhydride is 35-80wt% and the amount of conjugated diene is 20-65wt% based on the total weight of the polymerized monomers; the reaction medium is a mixture of a compound shown in the formula (1) and alkane; wherein R is  1  And R is  2  Each independently is an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms. The copolymer microsphere is used as a dispersing agent in polypropylene, and is not migrated in polypropylene, is not precipitated and has no peculiar smell unlike the traditional small molecular dispersing agent which is unstable and is easy to precipitate.

title_en: Composite solvent for ultra-fast dissolving starch at room temperature
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite solvent for ultra-fast dissolving starch at room temperature, which comprises the following raw materials: a nitrogen-containing acyclic organic compound, a nitrogen-containing heterocyclic organic compound, and water. The novel composite solvent for ultra-fast dissolving starch at room temperature is prepared by adding a small amount of nitrogen-containing organic compound and heterocyclic compound into water, and has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple synthesis method, low cost, no pollution, large starch dissolving amount and the like.

title_en: Preparation of 2, 6-diisopropylthiophenol single metallocene catalyst and application of catalyst in preparation of functionalized polyolefin
abstract_en: The invention reports the preparation of a 2, 6-diisopropylthiophenol single metallocene catalyst and the application of the catalyst in preparing functionalized polyolefin. The invention introduces the anionic ligand 2, 6-diisopropylthiophenol, improves the tolerance of the catalyst to hetero atoms in the polymerization process, can conveniently regulate and control the three-dimensional effect and the electronic effect of the model metal catalyst by changing the framework configuration, realizes different catalytic performances and prepares polyolefin polymer materials with various structures and various performances. The novel thiophenol single metallocene catalyst reported by the invention has the characteristics of simple preparation, high activity and good homo-polymerization and copolymerization performances, is suitable for preparing a reactive polyolefin intermediate with external suspension type double bond units by non-conjugated diene copolymerization, and preparing a high molecular weight reactive polyolefin intermediate with wide distribution, wherein the reactive polyolefin intermediate has high comonomer insertion rate, and can realize large-scale effective control of material performance by fine adjustment of a polymer structure, thereby obtaining novel functionalized polyolefin meeting different application requirements. Therefore, the 2, 6-diisopropylthiophenol single-metallocene catalyst and the technology for preparing the functionalized polyolefin reported by the invention have original innovativeness, and can enhance the competitive capacity of participating in the international high-end polyolefin high-molecular material technical market in China.

title_en: Straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material, which relates to the technical field of polymer modified materials, and comprises a polyethylene main material, polyolefin auxiliary materials, talcum powder, straw fibers, a coupling agent, a surface modifier and an auxiliary agent; the auxiliary agent at least comprises a compatilizer; the straw fiber is fiber with submicron to nanometer scale after the straw is subjected to high-temperature pyrolysis treatment. The straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material provided by the invention utilizes the characteristics of the organic compatibility of straw fibers, the coexisting organic conjugated molecules in talcum powder and the surfactant composition, reduces the surface polarity of talcum powder, improves the compatibility between straw fibers and talcum powder and organic high polymer materials, and simultaneously has the characteristics of low cost and high strength.

title_en: Curable resin composition containing luminescent particles, light-converting layer, color filter, wavelength conversion film, and light-emitting element
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a curable resin composition containing luminescent particles, which has excellent stability to light in the presence of water and oxygen, and a light conversion layer, a color filter, a wavelength conversion film and a light-emitting element using the composition. The light-emitting particle-containing curable resin composition of the present invention is characterized by comprising: luminescent particles comprising semiconductor nanocrystals and an inorganic coating layer, organic-inorganic composite particles, and photopolymerizable compounds. The light conversion layer of the present invention is characterized by comprising the polymer of the light-emitting particle-containing curable resin composition. The light emitting element of the present invention is characterized by comprising the light conversion layer.

title_en: Preparation method of novel solid-solid phase change energy storage material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of phase change material preparation, and discloses a preparation method of a novel solid-solid phase change energy storage material. Polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether is used as a phase change material, toluene-2, 4-diisocyanate is used as a cross-linking agent, lignin is used as a supporting material, dibutyltin dilaurate is used as a catalyst, acetone is used as a solvent, and a solid-solid phase change energy storage material is prepared by a chemical grafting method. The solid-solid phase change energy storage material prepared by the invention has adjustable phase change temperature, large phase change enthalpy, good solubility and wide application range.

title_en: Vinyl alcohol polymer, method for producing vinyl alcohol polymer, dispersing agent for suspension polymerization, dispersing aid for suspension polymerization, and method for producing vinyl polymer
abstract_en: Provided are a novel vinyl alcohol polymer, a method for producing the same, a dispersion agent for suspension polymerization, a dispersion aid for suspension polymerization, and a method for producing a vinyl polymer, wherein the dispersion agent can obtain polymer particles having a small average particle diameter, few coarse particles, and good plasticizer absorbency. The present invention relates to a vinyl alcohol polymer having carbonyl groups, formyl groups and alkenyl groups in the same or different molecules. The present invention also provides a method for producing a vinyl alcohol polymer, comprising: a step of polymerizing a vinyl ester in the presence of an aliphatic unsaturated aldehyde, and a step of saponifying the obtained vinyl ester polymer.

title_en: Thermoplastic resin and optical member comprising the same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to efficiently produce and provide a material having a high refractive index, low birefringence, excellent balance between heat resistance and moldability, low haze, high Charpy impact strength, low water absorption, and a wide range of high refractive index bands. A thermoplastic resin composition comprising a thermoplastic resin (A) containing a unit represented by the formula (1) and a thermoplastic resin (B) containing a unit represented by the formula (2). { in formula (1), L  1  and L  2  each independently represent a divalent linking group, k and L each independently represent an integer of 0 or more, R  1 、R 2 、R 3  and R  4  each independently represent a hydrogen atom or a hydrocarbon group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms, and W represents a divalent linking group. In the { formula (2), L  3  and L  4  each independently represent a divalent linking group, m and n each independently represent an integer of 0 or more, and R  5 、R 6 、R 7  and R  8  each independently represent a hydrogen atom or a hydrocarbon group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms. }

title_en: Units based on bridged triphenylamine derivatives, small molecules and polymers containing units, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridged triphenylamine derivative unit, a small molecule containing the unit, a polymer and preparation methods and applications thereof. The invention builds a novel aromatic unit with good planeness based on bridged triphenylamine derivatives; and a series of small molecules and copolymers are constructed based on bridged triphenylamine derivative units, and the prepared small molecules and polymers have excellent thermal stability and high carrier mobility. The small molecules and polymers based on the bridged triphenylamine derivative units can be used as hole transport layers and applied to organic/polymer electronic devices such as organic/polymer photodetectors and organic/polymer electroluminescence.

title_en: Linear easy-to-tear polypropylene composition film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food packaging, in particular to a linear easy-tearing polypropylene composition film and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a polypropylene composition film, which comprises, by mass, 60-90 parts of propylene polymer, 10-40 parts of propylene alpha-olefin copolymer and 0.5-5 parts of ethylene alpha-olefin copolymer. The polypropylene composition film can simultaneously meet the requirements of easy tearing and unsealing property, good high-temperature steaming property, heat sealing strength and excellent low-temperature impact resistance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of waste biomass bacterial cellulose aerogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of waste biomass bacterial cellulose aerogel, and belongs to the technical field of functional material preparation. Taking the extract of the waste pericarp as a carbon source, fermenting to obtain a bacterial cellulose membrane, and then performing directional freeze drying and chemical vapor modification treatment to obtain the bacterial cellulose aerogel. According to the invention, the waste pericarp is used as a carbon source for fermenting bacterial cellulose, and the bacterial cellulose aerogel is prepared by modifying through a directional freezing method and a chemical gas phase method, so that agricultural wastes are fully recycled, the cost is low, the environment-friendly ecological concept is met, and the problems of marine oil leakage, industrial waste gas pollution and the like are solved.

title_en: Low-filling high-heat-conductivity natural rubber nanocomposite and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-filling high-heat-conductivity natural rubber nanocomposite and a preparation method thereof, and is characterized in that firstly, epoxidized Natural Rubber (ENR) latex is prepared through in-situ epoxidation under the stabilization action of a nonionic surfactant, a cross-linking epoxy site is introduced, hydroxyl introduced by ultrasonic treatment of a Boron Nitride Nanosheet (BNNS) in a strong alkali solution is subjected to esterification reaction with a polycarboxy compound to obtain a carboxylated boron nitride nanosheet (BNNS-COOH), and a carboxyl functional group is introduced; further, BNNS-COOH and ENR latex are subjected to ultrasonic dispersion and full stirring and mixing, carboxyl on a BNNS-COOH sheet layer reacts with epoxy groups on an ENR molecular chain to generate beta-hydroxyl ester covalent cross-linking bonds, no other catalyst or cross-linking agent is added into the system, the natural rubber nanocomposite is prepared through mixing and hot pressing by an open mill, the beta-hydroxyl ester bonds constructed at the interface of the heat conducting filler and the rubber matrix obviously improve the dispersibility of BNNS, the interface effect between BNNS and the rubber molecular chain is enhanced, and the interface thermal resistance between BNNS and the rubber matrix is reduced, so that the natural rubber is endowed with low-filling high heat conducting characteristics.

title_en: Polyol peroxide based stabilizers and process for preparing polymer polyols
abstract_en: The invention relates to a general formula (HO)  x  ‑R  a  ‑(O‑C(＝O)‑R  b  ‑C(＝O)‑O‑O‑R  c  )  y  To a process for obtaining the same and to the use thereof in the synthesis of polymer polyols. The invention also relates to the resulting polymer polyol and to a dispersant obtainable in a process for preparing a polymer polyol by reacting the macroinitiator with at least one ethylenically unsaturated monomer.

title_en: Hypoxia response drug delivery micelle adapting to pancreatic cancer microenvironment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano drug delivery, and particularly relates to an hypoxia response drug delivery micelle adapting to pancreatic cancer microenvironment and a preparation method thereof. The hypoxia response polymer is polyethylene glycol-polylysine-taxol-polyphenylalanine, the polyethylene glycol-polylysine-polyphenylalanine triblock polymer is formed through ring-opening polymerization reaction, amino groups on lysine of the triblock polymer are coupled with disulfide bonds to chemotherapeutics taxol, azide groups at the tail end of the polyethylene glycol are connected with alkynyl groups at the tail end of polypeptide CREKA or Ni-Alk through click chemical reaction, and gemcitabine prodrug is wrapped in the core of the nano response micelle through physical encapsulation. The nano drug delivery micelle can respond to the tumor microenvironment to release chemotherapeutic drugs of gemcitabine and paclitaxel, and can also avoid tumor metastasis caused by the destruction of an external matrix; can penetrate through the external matrix of pancreatic cancer to realize deep chemotherapy drug accumulation.

title_en: Selenium polysaccharide for improving alcoholic liver injury and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses selenium polysaccharide for improving alcoholic liver injury and a preparation method and application thereof. The selenium-enriched agaricus blazei murill fruiting body is obtained through a selenium-enriched cultivation mode, crude selenium polysaccharide is obtained by extracting the fruiting body by adopting a water extraction and alcohol precipitation method, components larger than 10KD in the agaricus blazei murill polysaccharide are separated by utilizing a hollow fiber tangential flow membrane, and the components are further purified by DEAE-52 and Sephadex G-100 column chromatography to obtain a single selenium polysaccharide component AbPSe, wherein the selenium polysaccharide component consists of glucose, rhamnose, arabinose, mannose and galactose, has good alleviation effect on liver injury caused by long-term drinking, and can be developed into medicines or health care products for preventing and treating alcoholic liver injury.

title_en: Polyurethane hot melt adhesive for bonding metal materials and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a polyurethane hot melt adhesive for bonding metal materials and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of polyurethane adhesives. According to the preparation method of the polyurethane hot melt adhesive for bonding the metal materials, the bisphenol A type epoxy resin and/or the bisphenol F type epoxy resin and the polyether polyol are used for preparing a first prepolymer, the crystalline polyester polyol and the amorphous polyester polyol are used for preparing a second prepolymer, and the first prepolymer and the second prepolymer are mixed to prepare the polyurethane hot melt adhesive. According to the method, bisphenol A type epoxy resin and/or bisphenol F type epoxy resin structures are introduced into the polyurethane hot melt adhesive, the structures have a larger conjugated system, and larger electrostatic force can be generated between the structures and empty metal tracks, so that the adhesive force of the polyurethane hot melt adhesive to metal materials is improved, and the adhesive effect of the polyurethane hot melt adhesive to the metal materials is further improved.

title_en: Liquid crystal aligning agent, liquid crystal alignment film and liquid crystal display element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liquid crystal aligning agent containing a polymer (a) which is at least one selected from the group consisting of a polyimide precursor having a repeating unit (a 1) represented by the following formula (1) and polyimide which is an imide compound of the polyimide precursor. title_en: Fully-degradable composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environment-friendly high polymer materials, in particular to a fully degradable composite material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: preparation of calcium carbonate nanowhiskers: uniformly stirring and dispersing water-soluble calcium salt, water-soluble carbonate and a soft template agent in water, placing the water-soluble calcium salt, the water-soluble carbonate and the soft template agent into a microwave reaction kettle, and reacting for a preset reaction time at a preset temperature to obtain a first dispersion liquid of calcium carbonate nano whiskers; plasma treatment of whisker dispersion: treating the calcium carbonate nano whisker aqueous solution by adopting plasma equipment to obtain second dispersion liquid with stable dispersion of the nano whisker; spray drying to prepare in-situ functional whisker powder; preparing high-filling master batches; preparing the high-strength weather-proof type full-degradable composite material. The composite material has the characteristics of high melt strength, high tensile strength, excellent weather resistance and the like, and is beneficial to expanding the application and development of the polylactic acid composite material in the fields of high-performance structural materials, high-end functional materials and the like.

title_en: Starch-based particle board adhesive capable of being quickly cured at medium and low temperatures and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a starch-based chipboard adhesive capable of being quickly cured at a medium and low temperature and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adhesive preparation. The starch-based adhesive for the particle board comprises a component A and a component B; the component A comprises the following components: 150 parts of starch, 200-300 parts of water, 20-25 parts of concentrated hydrochloric acid, 12-18 parts of dilute nitric acid, 25-40 parts of sodium hydroxide solution, 6-9 parts of initiator, 27-35 parts of grafting monomer and 2-5 parts of emulsifier; the component B comprises: 8-11 parts of post-crosslinking agent ethylenediamine. The starch-based chipboard adhesive effectively solves the problems of high curing temperature and long curing time of the starch adhesive in the prior art, can reduce the curing temperature to 105 ℃ on the premise of keeping a higher curing speed, reduces the production energy consumption of chipboards, and can be widely applied to hot-press bonding of chipboards, plywood, fiberboards and wood blocks.

title_en: Preparation method of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers, which comprises the following steps of dispersing ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene powder and a processing aid in a solvent to obtain a mixed raw material, preheating the mixed raw material, feeding the mixed raw material into a double-screw extruder for spinning to obtain polyethylene sol colloidal filament bundles, cooling the polyethylene sol colloidal filament bundles in cold water, squeezing water to obtain gel filaments, pre-drawing the gel filaments, extracting the gel filaments in an extracting agent at normal temperature, sequentially washing, evaporating and drying after extraction is finished to obtain ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber precursor, and drawing the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber precursor to obtain the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers. The invention can solve the problem of poor fluidity in the current ultra-high molecular polyethylene processing, and the polyethylene fiber with excellent creep resistance and ideal mechanical property is prepared.

title_en: Polymer plastic pipe and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high polymer plastic pipe and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the high polymer plastic pipe comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the invention relates to the technical field of pipeline processing, and comprises 10-20 parts of composite resin, 10-20 parts of polystyrene, 10-20 parts of composite fiber components, 5-10 parts of polyoxyethylene oleate, 5-10 parts of graphene, 3-5 parts of barium stearate, 3-5 parts of acryloyl chloride, 1-3 parts of antioxidant, 1-3 parts of plasticizer, 1-3 parts of cross-linking agent and 1-3 parts of toughening agent. According to the high polymer plastic pipe and the manufacturing method thereof, the toughness of the plastic pipe can be greatly improved by adding the composite fiber, the graphene, the barium stearate, the acryloyl chloride and the toughening agent into the plastic pipe, the purposes of improving the toughness of the plastic pipe and ensuring the material performance of the plastic pipe are well achieved, the application range of the high polymer plastic pipe is greatly expanded, the toughness of the high polymer plastic pipe is well improved, and the plastic pipe can bear a certain impact in the actual use process and cannot be cracked or damaged.

title_en: Thermoplastic composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition comprising a particulate solid, a plastic material and a polymer, wherein the polymer is a polyamide having fatty end groups; wherein the polyamide is the condensation reaction product of a diamine and a diacid; wherein the polymer has 5 to 13 monomer units; wherein the diamine is saturated C  2  ‑C  12  Linear, branched or cyclic diamines; wherein the amine group of the diamine is a primary or secondary amine; wherein the diacid is saturated C  20  ‑C  50  Branched carboxylic acid diacid; and wherein each of the fatty end groups is independently C  6  ‑C  36  A linear or branched carbon chain attached to the polyamide via an amide or imide linkage.

title_en: Flake graphite fluorocarbon film, self-adhesive waterproof coiled material and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon film, a self-adhesive waterproof coiled material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon film comprises the following steps: mixing fluorocarbon resin with an organic solvent, adding nano zinc oxide and nano titanium dioxide, and performing ball milling and dispersion to obtain zinc oxide-titanium dioxide-fluorocarbon resin solution; adding the crystalline flake graphite into methyl polysiloxane resin, and performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain crystalline flake graphite-methyl polysiloxane resin; uniformly stirring and mixing zinc oxide-titanium dioxide-fluorocarbon resin solution, crystalline flake graphite-methyl polysiloxane resin and dibutyltin dilaurate to obtain crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon solution; and casting and drying the crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon solution to obtain the crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon film. The crystalline flake graphite fluorocarbon film prepared by the invention and the self-adhesive waterproof coiled material thereof have good waterproof performance and ageing resistance.

title_en: Polyvinyl fluoride/fluorinated graphene composite material and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The molding method of the polyvinyl fluoride/fluorinated graphene composite material comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing the fluorinated graphene powder and polytetrafluoroethylene powder to obtain polytetrafluoroethylene/fluorinated graphene composite powder; pressing the obtained polytetrafluoroethylene/fluorinated graphene composite powder through a flat plate mold with unrestricted periphery to obtain a preformed composite material; and further pressing the obtained preformed composite material in a closed mold to obtain the polyvinyl fluoride/fluorinated graphene composite material with ultralow dielectric constant and ultralow dielectric loss at a high working frequency (GHz). The polytetrafluoroethylene/fluorinated graphene composite material with the ultralow dielectric constant and ultralow dielectric loss has excellent mechanical properties; and the addition of a small amount of fluorinated graphene not only effectively reduces the dielectric loss of the polytetrafluoroethylene, but also effectively improves the mechanical property of the polytetrafluoroethylene.

title_en: Chemically modified hemicellulose solid particles, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hemicellulose materials, and particularly relates to a chemically modified hemicellulose solid particle, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the chemically modified hemicellulose solid particles comprises the following preparation steps: s1, adding hemicellulose into a solvent, and stirring until the hemicellulose is completely dissolved; s2, adjusting the reaction temperature and the pH value, then adding acetic anhydride and phthalic anhydride to continuously react, separating out the product by using absolute ethyl alcohol, washing to remove unreacted reagent, and drying to obtain the catalyst. The Pickering emulsion prepared from the hemicellulose solid particles prepared by the invention has smaller and uniform droplet size, low emulsion layering speed and no flocculation and demulsification.

title_en: Pyridine/pyranyl-linked COFs and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis, in particular to a pyridine/pyranyl-connected COFs, and preparation and application thereof. Firstly, dissolving a precursor in a solvent to obtain a precursor solution; then heating the precursor solution, performing polymerization reaction, and performing aftertreatment to obtain a target product: pyridyl-linked COFs or pyranyl-linked COFs. The invention firstly utilizes Aldol condensation reaction, a Michael addition cyclization tandem reaction one-pot method to prepare the novel pyridine/pyran connected COFs, and provides a COFs bonding mode and a synthesis method which are easier to synthesize, more stable and easier to modify in the field of covalent organic porous material research.

title_en: Composite epoxy resin material for cable bridge and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a composite epoxy resin material for a cable bridge and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of new materials for cable bridges; the composite material is prepared from the following raw material components in parts by weight: 60-90 parts of composite epoxy resin; 40-60 parts of glass fiber; 5-8 parts of decabromodiphenyl ether; 20-25 parts of auxiliary agents; 0.6-1.0 parts of bacteriostat; 2-5 parts of calcium stearate; the composite epoxy resin consists of bisphenol A epoxy ethylene resin, phenol methyl ether type epoxy resin and nano silicon oxide, and the proportion is (1-3): 1: (0.4-1); the auxiliary agent comprises graphene, perlite and vermiculite; the composite epoxy resin material provided by the application has better fireproof performance, physical strength and chemical corrosion resistance.

title_en: Polybutylene succinate and polysiloxane block copolymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a poly (butylene succinate) and polysiloxane block copolymer and a preparation method thereof. The polybutylene succinate and the polysiloxane block copolyesters have excellent mechanical properties and high molecular weight, and the polysiloxane blocks also endow the block copolyesters with good anti-fouling function and excellent impact resistance, and simultaneously improve the tensile strength, bending strength and elongation at break.

title_en: Flame-retardant expandable polystyrene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses flame-retardant expandable polystyrene and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following raw materials: styrene, nucleating agent, desalted water, organic compound containing peroxy functional group, inorganic salt, brominated flame retardant, dispersing agent and solvent. The product powder and massive materials prepared by the method are less, the mechanical properties of the prepared polystyrene board are excellent, the phenomena of foam collapse, deformation and the like do not occur after the polystyrene board is placed for one week or even one month, the combustion performance completely reaches the B level, and the polystyrene board has high-efficiency flame-retardant and fireproof performances. Meanwhile, the product obtained by the application has high bromine content, good heat stability, low exudation, no toxicity, small influence on the mechanical properties of materials, no generation of toxic gases such as polybrominated dibenzodioxane and polybrominated dibenzofuran during thermal cracking or combustion, and the like, completely meets the requirements of European regulations on dioxin, and does not cause harm to the environment.

title_en: Process system and method for synthesizing middle-low molecular weight perfluoropolyether
abstract_en: The invention provides a process system and a process method for synthesizing middle-low molecular weight perfluoropolyether, wherein the system comprises oxidative polymerization, crude product phase separation, stabilization treatment and rectification separation. The mixed gas of hexafluoropropylene and oxyfluoride as the reaction raw material is subjected to an oxidation polymerization reaction in an oxidation polymerization reactor, the gas is fully discretized by using two modes of high-speed mechanical shearing and liquid collision mixing, and the temperature of the reactor is controlled by a coupling integrated heat exchange structure. And collecting the crude product of the perfluoropolyether by a phase separator, preheating, and then introducing the crude product into a fluorination reactor for fluorination stabilization treatment. And obtaining products with different molecular weight distribution through the stabilized perfluoropolyether by a rectifying tower. The invention can continuously and controllably prepare a plurality of perfluoropolyether products with medium-low molecular weight distribution, and has the following advantages: the bubble distribution and the heat distribution in the oxidation polymerization reactor are uniform, hot spot areas are prevented from occurring, and the industrial operation safety is high; the oxidative polymerization reactor is coupled with the integrated heat exchange structure.

title_en: Bio-based triazine charring foaming agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A bio-based triazine charring foaming agent and a preparation method and application thereof relate to the field of intumescent flame retardants, in particular to a bio-based triazine charring foaming agent and a preparation method and application thereof. The method aims to solve the problems of environmental protection, unsafety, low flame retardant efficiency and poor thermal stability existing in the synthesis process of the char-forming foaming agent of the existing IFR system. The preparation method of the foaming agent comprises the following steps: 1. placing cyanuric chloride into a flask, adding ice water, and stirring to obtain white turbid liquid; 2. mixing beta-alanine and sodium hydroxide, adding water, stirring, and dripping to obtain an intermediate 1; 3. dropwise adding a mixed aqueous solution of ethylenediamine and sodium hydroxide into the intermediate 1, and carrying out reflux reaction to obtain an intermediate 2; 4. and (3) dropwise adding a certain amount of acid into the intermediate 2, reacting, washing and drying to obtain the bio-based triazine charring foaming agent. The productivity of the foaming agent is more than 91%, and the foaming agent has excellent heat stability and flame retardant efficiency. The invention is used for preparing the carbon foaming agent.

title_en: Method for catalyzing Suzuki reaction based on MOF Pi Keling emulsion of metal organic framework
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for catalyzing Suzuki reaction based on MOF Pi Keling emulsion of a metal organic framework. The invention adopts water and toluene as solvents at the same time, and Pd@MIL-101 is used as an emulsifier to form Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion. The Suzuki reaction is catalyzed by Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion. The Pd@MIL-101 Pi Keling emulsion disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation method and has ultrahigh catalytic capability in a Suzuki reaction.

title_en: End group functionalized polymer catalyst and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer synthesis, and provides a terminal group functionalized polymer catalyst and a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein 55mg (0.2 mmol) of cyclooctadiene nickel is weighed in a glove box, a Schlenk tube purged by high-purity argon is added, 1ml of newly-prepared anhydrous THF is slowly added under the argon flow, 0.2mmol of p-methoxy cinnamyl propionate is dropwise added at 0 ℃, the system gradually turns from yellow to dark red, the reaction is carried out for 30min at 0 ℃, 52.4mg (0.2mmol,solved in 1mlTHF) of triphenylphosphine is added, the reaction is carried out for 1h at 0 ℃ to obtain a Ni complex THF solution, and the reaction is continued for 1h at 0 ℃; 177mg (0.2 mmol) of sodium trifluoromethyl tetraphenyl borate was added, the reaction was continued for 1h, diethyl ether was removed by evaporation under reduced pressure, methanol was added to the system, yellow to orange crystallites were formed, and the product was filtered under argon atmosphere to give yellow crystallites. The method has the advantages of simple operation, high yield, easy industrial production and lower cost, and meets the requirements of more occasions.

title_en: Preparation method of moisture-absorbing flame-retardant polyamide and fiber
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyamide synthesis modification and fiber preparation thereof, in particular to a preparation method of moisture-absorbing flame-retardant polyamide and fiber. The preparation method of the moisture-absorbing flame-retardant polyamide comprises the following steps of (1) salifying a flame retardant with polyether amine for salifying to obtain a flame retardant salt, and (2) copolymerizing a polyamide monomer, the flame retardant salt and the polyether amine for moisture absorption modification to obtain the moisture-absorbing flame-retardant polyamide. In the preparation method, the flame retardant with carboxyl and the polyether amine for salifying are salified in advance and then participate in the copolymerization synthesis of polyamide, so that the dispersibility of the flame retardant in the polyamide can be improved, the better flame retardant effect can be achieved, the polyether amine for salifying and the polyether amine for moisture absorption modification participate in the copolymerization synthesis of polyamide, the polyether amine can be uniformly dispersed in the polyamide, and the strong moisture absorption of the polyether amine and the amide bond formed between the polyether amine and polyamide monomers can be utilized, so that the moisture absorption of the polyamide is improved to a large extent.

title_en: Method for preparing two-dimensional CuBDC nanosheets by using photobase generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a two-dimensional CuBDC nanosheet by using a photobase generator, which belongs to the field of nanomaterials and comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a solution consisting of a photobase and DMSO; (2) Weighing copper nitrate, terephthalic acid and DMSO with certain mass, and fully and uniformly stirring; (3) Adding the solution in the step (1) into the MOF precursor liquid in the step (2), and fully and uniformly stirring; (4) Placing the MOF precursor liquid containing the photobase in the step (3) under an ultraviolet lamp; (5) Centrifuging the solution containing the MOF nanosheets obtained in the step (4) after illumination, and centrifuging and washing three times by using DMSO and low boiling point solvent methanol respectively to remove unreacted monomers and solvent substitution; (6) And (3) placing the MOF nano-sheets subjected to methanol substitution in the step (5) in a vacuum oven, and fully drying to remove the solvent in the holes to obtain MOF nano-sheet powder.

title_en: Degradable PP composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a degradable PP composite material and a preparation method thereof.
