The degradable PP composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 48-52 parts of PP (polypropylene), 28-32 parts of tea fiber, 18-22 parts of inorganic powder, 0.8-1.2 parts of photosensitizer, 1.5-1.8 parts of decomposition aid and 1.2-1.5 parts of dispersing agent, wherein the decomposition aid is a composition of galactose, vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate and diisostearyl malate according to a mass ratio of 1:4-7:2-4. The application selects proper formula and reasonable proportion, and utilizes photosensitizer and decomposition aid to obtain degradable PP composite material which has the advantages of complete degradability, high filling, environment-friendly property, excellent physical property and the like, and has the advantages of high production efficiency, low cost, suitability for mass production and the like, and is applied to industries such as medical treatment, catering and the like.

title_en: Application of carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex in health care medicine or food
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex in health care drugs or foods, belonging to the fields of health care foods and drug research. And adopting a NaOH-chloroacetic acid method to carry out carboxymethyl modified xylan, observing the influences of three factors of reactant mass ratio, reaction temperature and reaction time by a single factor to obtain the optimal condition of zinc complexation, and carrying out zinc complexation reaction on carboxymethyl xylan under the condition to obtain carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex. The invention uses the artificially synthesized carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex for the test of the internal intestinal contents of mice, and the vital sign analysis result reflects the beneficial effect of the carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex on the intestinal health, thereby providing a reference basis for the application of the carboxymethyl xylan zinc complex in the fields of health food and medicine research.

title_en: POSS composite polyacrylate aqueous dispersion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention designs and synthesizes a novel POSS composite polyacrylate aqueous dispersion. The dispersion is prepared under emulsion polymerization conditions with POSS having acrylic groups as a crosslinker. The aqueous polymer dispersion had a significantly greater molecular weight and average particle size than the control group without the addition of POSS. The coating prepared based on the POSS composite polyacrylate water dispersion has remarkably more excellent hardness and chemical resistance compared with a control group.

title_en: Environment-friendly low-temperature molding material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an environment-friendly low-temperature molding compound and a preparation method thereof, wherein the molding compound comprises the following components in parts by weight: 75-95 parts of paraffin, wherein the paraffin is C25-30 alkane with short branched chains, and the total substitution degree of the short branched chains is 0.3-0.5; 0.1-5 parts of polyethylene wax; 0.2-4 parts of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer; petroleum resin 0.5-8 parts. According to the scheme, the formula design is optimized and adjusted in a targeted manner by researching the working characteristics of the low-temperature casting wax, so that the casting performance of the low-temperature casting material is greatly improved.

title_en: Mineral wool product with low chloride content
abstract_en: The present invention relates to mineral fiber products having low water leachable chloride content suitable as non-corrosive insulation and/or soundproofing materials.

title_en: Method for high-selectivity adsorption recovery of cobalt from DMC catalyst sludge
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for high-selectivity adsorption recovery of cobalt from DMC catalyst sludge, which is characterized in that the synergistic effect of a brand new clover-shaped polymer resin adsorbent with a specific structure and a specific process method is designed, so that the method for high-selectivity adsorption recovery of cobalt from DMC catalyst sludge environment with specific components has the effects of high cobalt recovery rate and high purity. The method can fully release cobalt (III) ions in DMC catalyst sludge, then uses a specific adsorbent for adsorption separation, and finally fixes the cobalt into cobalt hydroxide, so that the recovery amount of cobalt is large, the recovery rate of cobalt is more than or equal to 90%, the purity of cobalt hydroxide is more than or equal to 99.0%, and the recovery rate of cobalt is still up to 90% when the concentration of cobalt is up to 17 g/L. Furthermore, zinc ions can be precipitated into zinc hydroxide by controlling the pH value while cobalt is recovered, and the purity reaches more than 90 percent.

title_en: Conductive silica gel with electromagnetic shielding performance and preparation device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive silica gel with electromagnetic shielding performance, and a preparation device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the conductive silica gel is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 70-80 parts of polysiloxane, 5-10 parts of modified conductive powder, 0.5-2 parts of flame retardant, 1-3 parts of cross-linking agent, 1-3 parts of coupling agent, 2-5 parts of mildew inhibitor, 0.03-0.3 part of catalyst and 1-5 parts of vulcanizing agent. According to the invention, the modified conductive powder is adopted, so that pure silver powder and zinc oxide are borne on polythiophene, the migration of conductive particles is avoided, the conductivity is improved, PHMG is introduced into silica gel as a mildew-proof antibacterial agent, the mildew of the silica gel is avoided, and the condition that the sealing performance is lost due to mildew corrosion of the conductive particles is avoided under the condition that graphene is not adopted as a conductive body; according to the device, the blanking component adopts rotary blanking, and meanwhile, the blanking block can always reciprocate horizontally during rotation, so that the modified conductive powder can be uniformly scattered during blanking, and the uniform distribution of the modified conductive powder during mixing is improved.

title_en: Wood-based heat storage material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a wood-based heat storage material and a preparation method thereof. The wood-based heat storage material is provided with a plurality of wood fiber layers, wherein the wood fiber layers are derived from wood fibers, the wood fiber layers are connected with the wood fiber layers, at least part of the wood fiber layers and the wood fiber layers are provided with pore channel structures, and the pore channel structures are formed by collapse of wood ray tissues. The wood-based heat storage material has excellent photo-thermal conversion performance, very high photo-thermal conversion rate and excellent elasticity and shape recovery. Furthermore, the preparation method disclosed by the application can expose the benzene ring carbon skeleton of lignin, so that the wood-based heat storage material with excellent photo-thermal conversion performance is obtained, and the preparation method disclosed by the application is simple and easy to implement, is easy to obtain raw materials, and is suitable for mass production.

title_en: Reaction separation system device for polyester degradation and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reaction separation system device for polyester degradation, which comprises a solvent storage tank, a first conveying pump, a polyester degradation reaction kettle, a magnetic separation pipe, a degradation product storage tank, a separation and post-treatment tank, a solvent recovery storage tank, a second conveying pump, a catalyst recovery tank and a third conveying pump; the invention also discloses an application step of the reaction separation system device in polyester degradation reaction. The magnetic catalyst separation system (the magnetic separation pipe, the catalyst recovery tank and the solvent recovery storage tank) can conveniently and efficiently separate the polyester degradation products from the magnetic catalyst, can effectively improve the recycling rate of the catalyst and reduce the use cost of the polyester catalyst; meanwhile, the system organically combines polyester degradation, catalyst separation and product treatment processes, is beneficial to reducing equipment investment and energy consumption, and has important guiding significance for the industrial process of polyester degradation.

title_en: Aqueous polyurethane resin dispersoid and application thereof in coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water-based paint, and discloses a water-based polyurethane resin dispersoid and application thereof in paint. The aqueous polyurethane resin dispersion comprises the following raw materials: isophorone diisocyanate, polytetrahydrofuran ether glycol, a catalyst, antibacterial silicone oil, a small molecular chain extender, antioxidative graphite phase carbon nitride, a neutralizer and deionized water; wherein the antibacterial silicone oil is prepared by carrying out chemical reaction on vinyl-terminated silicone oil, 2-amino-3-mercaptopropyl-1-alcohol and 2, 3-epoxypropyl trimethyl ammonium chloride; the oxidation resistant graphite phase carbon nitride is prepared by the chemical reaction of graphite phase carbon nitride, isophorone diisocyanate and 3, 5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxy benzyl alcohol; the aqueous polyurethane resin dispersoid prepared by the invention has the properties of long-acting antibiosis, heat resistance, corrosion resistance and aging resistance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of beta-cyclodextrin functionalized covalent organic framework composite material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a β - cyclodextrin functionalized covalent organic framework composite material, which constructs a β - CD-COF layer through the aldoimine condensation reaction between the aldehyde groups on 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzaldehyde and ortho benzaldehyde, and the amino group on hepta (6-amino-6-oxy) beta cyclodextrin. The one-step method is used to prepare a β - cyclodextrin covalent organic framework composite material, which has good enrichment ability for phosphopeptides, is conducive to purification and extraction, and has good application prospects in mass spectrometry detection and separation of extracellular vesicles.

title_en: Liquid crystal polymer, LCP fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal polymer, LCP fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials. The monomer units of the liquid crystal polymer comprise-NH-and-O-groups, and the molar content of the monomer units containing-NH-is 1-15%. According to the preparation method of the LCP fiber, the liquid crystal polymer is used as a raw material, the aqueous solution of the alkyl phosphate is sprayed in the spinning process, and the alkyl phosphate reacts with the amide groups of the liquid crystal polymer to form hydrogen bonds, so that the alkyl phosphate is tightly combined with the LCP fiber, the surface polarity of the LCP fiber is greatly improved, and the binding force between the LCP fiber and other resins is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of ultraviolet-absorbable carbon quantum dot nanocellulose film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ultraviolet-absorbable carbon quantum dot nanocellulose film, which specifically comprises the following steps: dissolving citric acid, ethylenediamine and butyl methoxy dibenzoyl methane in an aqueous solution, stirring for dissolving, performing ultrasonic treatment, pouring into a polytetrafluoroethylene-lined reaction kettle for reaction, and performing centrifugation and filtration to obtain a product A-CQD; diluting oxidized nanocellulose in an aqueous solution, adding dicyclohexylcarbodiimide and 4-dimethylaminopyridine respectively in the stirring process, and then adding A-CQD; stirring overnight at normal temperature in dark environment, filtering redundant A-CQD and suction filtering to form a film to obtain a cellulose film A-CQD-TOCNF; according to the invention, the transmittance of the film is 0 in the near ultraviolet region by introducing the carbon quantum dots, and the method for modifying the nanocellulose by adopting the carbon quantum dots is not only natural and renewable, low-energy and environment-friendly, but also blue fluorescence under ultraviolet light, and has good application prospects in the aspects of 3D screen display, photoelectric devices and the like.

title_en: Polycarbonate composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electronic material packaging, and provides a polycarbonate composite material which comprises polycarbonate, first carbon nanotubes and second carbon nanotubes, wherein the first carbon nanotubes are distributed in the polycarbonate in an array mode, a surfactant is combined on the surface of the first carbon nanotubes, and the second carbon nanotubes are distributed in the polycarbonate in a disordered arrangement mode. In the polycarbonate composite material provided by the application, the distribution mode of the first carbon nano tubes in the polycarbonate substrate can effectively improve the dispersibility of the carbon nano tubes while meeting the conductivity of the composite material; the distribution mode of the second carbon nano tubes in the polycarbonate substrate ensures that the composite material has conductive uniformity in multiple directions, has an addition improvement effect on improving the conductivity of the composite material and reducing the agglomeration effect of the carbon nano tubes, and simultaneously has higher conductive property, mechanical property and surface flatness.

title_en: Phenolic flower mud resin, flower mud foam and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a phenolic flower mud resin, flower mud foam and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the phenolic flower mud resin comprise the following components in parts by mass: 100 parts of phenol, 10-40 parts of liquid formaldehyde, 40-80 parts of paraformaldehyde, 2-6 parts of urea, 0.5-3 parts of an alkaline catalyst, 10-20 parts of PEG-400 and 1-10 parts of water. The phenolic resin adopts paraformaldehyde to replace part of liquid formaldehyde, the reaction end point is easy to control, the performance difference among batches of phenolic resin is small, the production efficiency is obviously improved, and the production cost is obviously reduced; the free aldehyde and free phenol content of the phenolic resin is obviously reduced compared with the common products in the market, and the environmental protection performance is obviously improved. The flower mud foam has the characteristics of mild foaming process, low curing exotherm, high water absorbability, high water retention and weak acidity, and avoids the generation of larger cells.

title_en: Preparation and application of organic coated SiO2 particles with flame retardant and toughening effects
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic and inorganic nonmetallic composite materials with flame retardant and toughening functions, in particular to preparation and application of organic coated SiO2 particles with flame retardant and toughening effects, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step A, the silane coupling agent is easier to hydrolyze and react with water glass under the acidic condition; in the step B, the initiator is mixed and diluted in the pre-emulsion in the step B1, then a part of the pre-emulsion is added in the step B2 for reaction, and the rest of the pre-emulsion is continuously added in a dropwise manner for reaction, so that the phenomenon of incomplete monomer reaction during the amplification production is avoided; in the step C, the component A grafted with SiO2 with negative charge and the component B of the cationic emulsion polymerization organic shell are mutually attracted by charges, so that the SiO2 inner cores of the component A are coated in the organic shell oligomer of the component B, and the formed organic coated SiO2 particles have stronger structural stability and can exert excellent flame retardant and toughening effects.

title_en: Electrochromic polymer, preparation method thereof and electrochromic polymer film
abstract_en: An electrochromic polymer, a preparation method thereof and an electrochromic polymer film are provided, wherein the electrochromic polymer comprises a compound shown in the following structural formula: wherein R is  1  Branched alkyl of 12 or more carbons, R  2  A linear alkyl group having 6 or more carbon atoms, m  1  、m  2  The number of repeating units is represented by n, the degree of polymerization is represented by n, and n is a natural number of 8 to 120. The polymer is prepared by direct arylation polymerization.

title_en: Promoter dispersion master batch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an accelerator dispersion master batch and a preparation method thereof, relates to the field of rubber additives, and aims to improve the stability of the accelerator dispersion master batch. Wherein the accelerator dispersion master batch comprises 25-40 weight parts of powder carrier and 60-75 weight parts of powder modification accelerator. The carrier comprises the following components in percentage by weight (20-60): (40-80): (10-40): the oil-filled ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber, the non-oil-filled ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber, the ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer and the rosin in the (10-40), and the modification accelerator comprises the following components in percentage by weight: the accelerator of (20-30) and rosin glyceride. The accelerator dispersion master batch disclosed by the application has the advantages of no frosting problem in two years, low pulverization rate and high stability.

title_en: Red phosphorus flame-retardant non-reinforced nylon/polyphenyl ether alloy material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a red phosphorus flame-retardant non-reinforced nylon/polyphenyl ether alloy material and a preparation method thereof. The red phosphorus flame-retardant non-reinforced nylon/polyphenyl ether alloy material is prepared from components including nylon resin, polyphenyl ether resin, compatilizer, red phosphorus flame-retardant master batch, synergistic flame retardant and lubricant. The invention effectively solves the flame-retardant problem of the red phosphorus flame-retardant non-reinforced nylon material. The red phosphorus flame-retardant master batch and the synergistic flame retardant are compounded, so that the total amount of the red phosphorus flame-retardant master batch and the synergistic flame retardant is controlled in a lower range on the premise of meeting the UL94V-0 level requirement, the negative influence of the flame retardant on the mechanical property and the processing property of the nylon is reduced, the red phosphorus flame-retardant non-reinforced nylon material with excellent comprehensive performance and meeting the requirement of customer indexes is obtained, and the raw material cost of the product can be controlled to the maximum extent.

title_en: Polysiloxane aerogel fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polysiloxane aerogel fiber and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of aerogel fibers, wherein a sol-gel technology is utilized to obtain polysiloxane wet gel with a uniform mesoporous structure in a water solvent, then a directional freezing technology is combined to uniformly divide a three-dimensional blocky aerogel into one-dimensional fibrous aerogel with a micron-sized diameter, the time-consuming solvent replacement and supercritical drying process in the traditional aerogel preparation process can be avoided, and a rapid directional freezing technology and a vacuum drying technology are combined to obtain the fibrous polysiloxane aerogel under the condition of not damaging the original mesoporous structure, so that the prepared polysiloxane aerogel fiber does not need to be subjected to hydrophobic modification, has intrinsic super-hydrophobic capability, and has a stable structure and wider application field.

title_en: Acrylic ester pressure-sensitive adhesive, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application discloses an acrylic acid ester pressure-sensitive adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw material formulation of the high temperature resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive comprises, by weight, 30-40 parts of solvent, 25 parts of (methyl) acrylic acid ester monomer, 20-25 parts of long carbon chain (methyl) acrylic acid ester monomer, 10-15 parts of double bond organic metal chelating agent, 5-10 parts of double bond silane coupling agent, 5-10 parts of high temperature resistant auxiliary agent, 0.5-5.5 parts of thermal initiator, 0.5-1.5 parts of cross-linking agent, 0.5-1.5 parts of antioxidant and 0.5-1.5 parts of polymerization inhibitor. The high-temperature-resistant high-temperature curing type acrylate adhesive has the solid content of 60-70%, the high-temperature resistance of the obtained product is more than or equal to 100 ℃, the mechanical property is moderate, the high-temperature-resistant high-temperature-curing type acrylate adhesive has better stability at high temperature, and the high-temperature-resistant high-temperature-curing type acrylate adhesive can be coated to form a quick-adhesion pressure-sensitive adhesive tape before curing by using a die and can be used as a protective film pressure-sensitive adhesive.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding carbon fiber composite material, preparation process thereof and housing for medical equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an electromagnetic shielding carbon fiber composite material, a process for preparing the same, and a housing for medical equipment. The composite material comprises 30-70% of carbon fiber filaments, 28-68% of resin and/or thermoplastic plastic and more than 1500 mesh flake graphite powder or graphene powder by weight percentage based on the total weight in the preparation process of the electromagnetic shielding carbon fiber composite material, wherein the preparation process comprises the steps of braiding the carbon fiber filaments into a net; soaking in acetone water solution and performing ultrasonic treatment after soaking; washing with distilled water and drying; diluting the phosphorus flake graphite powder or graphene powder with absolute ethyl alcohol or acetone aqueous solution, spraying the diluted phosphorus flake graphite powder or graphene powder on the surface of a carbon fiber, and drying to obtain a thickness of 1-2 microns; and forming the dried carbon fiber yarns with resin and/or thermoplastic. The embodiment of the disclosure carries out multiple treatments on the surface of the carbon fiber, thereby improving the electromagnetic shielding effect and the production efficiency of the carbon fiber composite material.

title_en: Dual reactor chain shuttling of ethylene/vinylarene diblock and triblock interpolymers
abstract_en: The present application provides a method of forming a composition comprising ethylene/vinyl aromatic hydrocarbon diblock and/or triblock interpolymers, said method comprising at least the steps of: a) Polymerizing a mixture a comprising ethylene and optionally alpha-olefin and optionally vinylarene in the presence of at least the following in a reactor a: a) A metal complex S as described herein selected from: formula S1, formula S2, formula S3, formula S4 or formula S5; b) Polymerizing a mixture B comprising ethylene, vinylarene and optionally alpha-olefin in a reactor B in the presence of at least the following: b) A metal complex H selected from the following formula H1 or formula H2 as described herein; and wherein step a occurs before step B, or vice versa, and feeding at least one chain shuttling agent into the first reactor. The present application provides a composition comprising an ethylene/vinyl aromatic hydrocarbon diblock or triblock interpolymer as described herein.

title_en: Anti-seepage material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-seepage material which comprises laterite, polymer gel and water, wherein the polymer gel comprises acrylic acid, maleic anhydride, polyvinylpyrrolidone, an initiator and a cross-linking agent, and the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) weighing raw materials, (2) dissolving polyvinylpyrrolidone in water, stirring to obtain a reaction solution, (3) mixing the acrylic acid, the maleic anhydride and the cross-linking agent to obtain a mixed solution, (4) adding the initiator into the reaction solution, then adding the mixed solution for reaction, (5) soaking, flushing, constant weight, crushing and sieving, (6) uniformly mixing the raw materials with the laterite, and adding water and stirring to obtain the anti-seepage material. The anti-seepage material can effectively prevent the water accumulation from seepage, avoid the water quality from deteriorating and the anti-seepage interlayer from causing secondary pollution to the environment, has the advantages of simple preparation method, convenient operation, environment friendliness, no toxicity, biodegradability and the like, and has wide application prospect in water accumulation facilities.

title_en: Production device and method for polypropylene product
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a production device and a production method of a polypropylene product, which belong to the technical field of olefin polymerization, wherein a production system comprises a catalyst providing unit, a propylene providing unit, a prepolymerization unit, a comonomer providing unit, a reaction unit, a flash evaporation unit, a medium-pressure separator, a low-pressure separator, a condensation recycling unit, a purification bin and a monomer recovery system, and a polymer degassing and propylene and comonomer recovery section of the production system only comprises flash evaporation, gas-solid separation, compression condensation, purging and membrane recovery processes. The gas-solid separation process is carried out in three steps of a medium-pressure separator, a low-pressure separator and a purification bin, so that the procedures of washing, steaming, drying, propylene/ethylene stripping and separating and the like in the original loop pipe body polymerization process are eliminated, the procedures of polymer degassing and propylene/comonomer recovery working section are greatly simplified, the layout is more compact, and the equipment investment and the wastewater discharge are reduced.

title_en: PET graphene-coated shielding material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PET (polyethylene terephthalate) graphene-coated shielding material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the shielding material comprises the following components: 35-85 thickness percent of PET and 16-66 thickness percent of graphene, wherein the thickness of the PET is 6-15 mu m, the thickness of the graphene is 3-10 mu m, and the preparation method of the shielding material comprises the following steps: step S100, selecting PET materials, and carrying out corona treatment on the PET materials; step S200, selecting graphene, and diluting the graphene by a diluent to obtain diluted graphene; and step S300, coating the diluted graphene in the step S200 on the PET material subjected to corona treatment, and completing preparation of the shielding material. The shielding material provided by the invention has the advantages that the tensile strength can reach 233MPa on average, the thermal conductivity is about 181W/m.K, the resistance average value of the shielding material is about 0.135 omega, the tensile strength is obviously improved, the flexibility is higher, the breakage is not easy to occur, and the heat dissipation effect is better.

title_en: Packaging material, preparation method thereof and packaging processing technology
abstract_en: The application provides a packaging material, a preparation method and a packaging processing technology thereof. The conductive heat-resistant layer adopts the procedure of mixing HEPE, LDPE and conductive carbon black according to a certain proportion, and can control the melting points of the conductive heat-resistant layer and the polyethylene layer of the packaging material to have certain difference, so that the produced plastic film can have different properties, the packaging material has the characteristics of conductive outer layer and heat resistance, the melting point of the inner layer is lower than that of the outer layer, and the packaging material not only has the conductive property, but also can resist heat, and can be used for packaging static-sensitive components. And the material can be directly processed into packages through a hot pressing process, so that the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving heat preservation cotton for household appliances and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses energy-saving heat-insulating cotton for household appliances and a preparation method thereof, wherein the heat-insulating cotton is prepared from the following raw materials: the preparation method of the rock wool powder, polyester resin, diluent, accelerator, carbon fiber, EVA adhesive and flame retardant, and the heat preservation cotton comprises the following steps: step one: screening raw materials; step two: pretreating raw materials; step three: proportioning raw materials; step four: mixing raw materials; step five: pressing and forming the raw materials; step six: and (5) vulcanizing and curing. The heat-insulating cotton prepared from the preparation raw materials has the advantages of small density, high strength, good water resistance, better softness and stronger practicability compared with the existing heat-insulating cotton, and the preparation method of the heat-insulating cotton has the advantages of low preparation cost and capability of avoiding discomfort to operators.

title_en: Kitchen and bathroom seamless waterproof construction method based on combination of paint and material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seamless waterproof construction method for a kitchen and bathroom based on combination of paint and materials, which belongs to the technical field of kitchen and bathroom waterproofing and comprises the following specific steps: when the floor is used for waterproof construction, the floor must find a slope in the floor drain direction and must find a slope before the waterproof paint is painted, and meanwhile, the elevation of the floor is 2cm-3cm lower than that of the floor in the adjacent room, so that water is prevented from flowing backwards outside the kitchen and toilet, the drainage gradient of the floor drain edge 5cm outwards is 3% -4%, during construction, the floor drain is used for radiating in the surrounding direction, the slope is found, the floor drain is scraped by a scraping rule, the plastering surface is required to be flat and free of pits, the water is not accumulated, and the position is far away from a doorway, so that the highest point of the doorway after the slope is found is ensured.

title_en: Preparation method and application of shape memory locking/releasing mechanism
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a shape memory locking/releasing mechanism belong to the technical field of preparation of shape memory composite materials and comprise the following steps of firstly mixing liquid metal with alcohol and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain alcohol-liquid metal suspension, secondly coating the alcohol-liquid metal suspension on left and right areas of carbon cloth, volatilizing alcohol to obtain carbon cloth-liquid metal, thirdly leading out electrodes on two sides of each liquid metal area, fourthly stacking the carbon cloth which is not coated with liquid metal and the carbon cloth coated with liquid metal together, pouring resin capable of realizing two-stage curing, after the resin is cured in the first stage, completing the second-stage curing of one liquid metal area, fifth heating the resin which is cured in the second stage again, bending the resin to lock a structural member I, bending the other liquid metal area to be matched with the structural member II, and completing the second-stage curing of the area to form the shape memory locking/releasing mechanism.

title_en: Resin composition, prepreg and preparation method thereof, copper-clad plate and preparation method thereof, and printed circuit board
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of copper-clad plates, in particular to a resin composition, a prepreg and a preparation method thereof, a copper-clad plate and a preparation method thereof, and a printed circuit board. The resin composition comprises 80-200 parts of cyanate, 20-80 parts of bismaleimide, 5-50 parts of diallyl bisphenol A, 0.1-5 parts of curing catalyst, 0.1-1 part of silane coupling agent, 100-300 parts of silicon micropowder, 10-80 parts of boehmite and 10-80 parts of phosphorus-containing flame retardant. The cyanate and the bismaleimide are compounded for use, so that the heat resistance of the prepreg can be improved, and the dielectric constant and dielectric loss of the prepreg can be reduced. Diallyl bisphenol A is used to improve the toughness of cyanate/bismaleimide resin systems. The curing catalyst is used for improving the curing efficiency of the cyanate ester/bismaleimide resin system. The silica micropowder is used for reducing the dielectric constant and dielectric loss of the prepreg. Boehmite and phosphorus-containing flame retardants are used to improve the flame retardant properties of prepregs.

title_en: Bio-based conveyor belt, preparation process and banburying production system matched with bio-based conveyor belt
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of conveyor belt production, in particular to a biological base conveyor belt, a preparation process and a banburying production system matched with the biological base conveyor belt, wherein the biological base conveyor belt comprises a covering adhesive layer, a rubberizing layer and a framework layer, and the framework layer is made of high-strength polyester cotton canvas; the covering adhesive layer and the rubberizing layer are respectively fixedly adhered to the surface of the framework layer; the covering adhesive layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of bio-based rubber, 4-7 parts of organic zinc, 1.5-2.5 parts of stearic acid, 10-25 parts of N220 carbon black, 15-35 parts of N33 carbon black, 1.0-1.3 parts of environment-friendly accelerator, 1.7-3.0 parts of insoluble sulfur, 2.5-3.5 parts of environment-friendly anti-aging agent, 1-3 parts of monoglyceride, 1.0-1.5 parts of microcrystalline paraffin, 5-10 parts of environment-friendly softener and 5-10 parts of active clay. The covering rubber layer and the rubberizing layer of the bio-based conveyer belt are all made of bio-based rubber, wherein the bio-based rubber is made of one of itaconic acid ester rubber (functionalized bio-based itaconic acid ester-butadiene rubber), dandelion rubber and eucommia ulmoides rubber, and the environment-friendly performance of the material is ensured.

title_en: Preparation method of polycaprolactone porous membrane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a polycaprolactone porous membrane, which comprises the following steps: dissolving PCL in DCM and THF solvents respectively to prepare casting solution with a certain mass fraction, magnetically stirring and dissolving the casting solution at normal temperature, sucking 80 mu L by a microinjector, injecting the casting solution onto a glass substrate at a certain temperature and humidity, and pouring the casting solution into a film. Wherein the humidity is controlled by saturated salt solution under closed condition, and the relative humidity of environments corresponding to saturated solution of potassium carbonate, sodium bromide, sodium chloride, potassium chloride and potassium nitrate is 43%, 56%, 75%, 83% and 91% respectively. The closed vessel was placed in a thermostatic water bath. And after the solvent volatilizes, vacuum drying at 30 ℃ to obtain the polycaprolactone porous membrane.

title_en: Fluorine-containing rheological agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorine-containing rheological agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fluorine-containing rheological agent has a structure shown in the following formula I, and the preparation method is that 1.0G PAMAM dendritic macromolecules react with perfluoroalkyl sulfonyl fluoride to obtain the fluorine-containing rheological agent. The fluorine-containing rheological agent of the invention has four componentsThe perfluorohexyl sulfonyl fluoride group has larger molecular weight, is not easy to generate migration loss in the material extrusion molding process, can effectively eliminate periodic melt fracture, reduces the melt temperature in the high-viscosity and high-molecular weight resin processing process, reduces the head pressure, reduces the screw torque, increases the yield and improves the extrusion efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified chitosan silica sol-based intumescent flame retardant coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of intumescent flame retardant coatings, in particular to a preparation method of an organic-inorganic hybrid composite intumescent flame retardant coating and application of the flame retardant coating on the surface of a wood board material. The invention aims to solve the problem of inflammability of wood. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hybridization crosslinking reaction on acidic silica sol and modified chitosan-acetic acid solution through a water bath synthesis method, wherein chitosan molecules can be alternately distributed in Si-O-Si gaps, and the formed coating has both inorganic and organic characteristics, so as to obtain the organic-inorganic hybridization film forming agent, namely the flame retardant coating. Compared with the existing intumescent flame retardant coating, the modified chitosan silica sol-based composite flame retardant coating disclosed by the invention has the advantages of less addition amount of an intumescent flame retardant, high flame retardant efficiency and good physical properties while ensuring the high flame retardant property of the material. The flame-retardant coating prepared by the invention is used for preparing the field of flame-retardant plates.

title_en: Sizing agent for ageing-resistant epoxy pipeline yarns and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of impregnating compounds, and particularly relates to an ageing-resistant impregnating compound for yarns for epoxy pipelines and a preparation method thereof. The sizing agent for the ageing-resistant epoxy pipeline yarn consists of a coupling agent, a lubricant, a film forming agent, a pH regulator and deionized water, wherein the film forming agent is a mixture of bisphenol A type epoxy emulsion, polyurethane emulsion and phenolic epoxy emulsion. The glass fiber product produced by the sizing agent has good compatibility with epoxy resin, and simultaneously has the manufacturability of winding pipelines, good wear resistance, less hairiness and high soaking speed; the glass fiber produced by the sizing agent has no performance degradation after high-temperature aging, and the epoxy high-pressure pipeline produced by the glass fiber has higher aging retention rate of the composite material performance after being boiled for 1500 hours in boiling water.

title_en: Ruthenium-based oxazine compound electrochemiluminescence material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruthenium-based oxazine compound electrochemiluminescence material and a preparation method thereof. In the basic unit structure of the luminescent material, the central metal element is Ru ions, the coordination group is an oxazinyl group, and the auxiliary coordination group is a pyridyl group. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing crystalline covalent triazine frame material into CTFs water solution; adding Ru ion solution under magnetic stirring, vacuum filtering, dispersing in deionized water, centrifuging after reaction, washing with deionized water, removing supernatant, precipitating, and vacuum drying to obtain powder; and (3) re-dispersing the powder into deionized water, adding a pyrithione solution, reacting, centrifugally washing, and vacuum drying to obtain the ruthenium-based oxazine compound electrochemiluminescence material. The invention has simple preparation, low cost and strong signal stability, and ECL efficiency reaches commercial Ru (bpy)  3   2+  Is expected to be used as a novel ECL probe, is developed into an in vitro detection kit and is applied to in vitro medicineThe field of academic detection.

title_en: Double-component polyurethane adhesive for outdoor yacht, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-component polyurethane adhesive for outdoor yachts, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the double-component polyurethane adhesive comprises an A component and a B component, the A component comprises polyester polyol, polyether polyol, aromatic isocyanate A, a chain extender, a catalyst and a terminator in specific parts, and the B component comprises aromatic isocyanate B; the polyester polyol and the polyether polyol are selected from the component A for compounding, and isocyanate in the component A and isocyanate in the component B are aromatic isocyanate, so that the finally obtained polyurethane adhesive has excellent bonding performance, water resistance and heat aging resistance, and is suitable for being applied to bonding of outdoor yacht skins and interior trim materials.

title_en: Preparation method and application of kappa-carrageenan oligosaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of kappa-carrageenan oligosaccharides, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) preparing a mixed solution of kappa-carrageenan, H  2 O 2  and ascorbic acid, (2) placing the mixed solution in a reaction environment with the temperature of 40-60 ℃ and the pressure of 20-60 MPa, reacting for 5-30 min to obtain kappa-carrageenan degradation solution, and (3) separating and intercepting the kappa-carrageenan degradation solution to obtain the kappa-carrageenan oligosaccharides with the molecular weight of 1000Da-3000 Da. The preparation method of the kappa-carrageenan oligosaccharide provided by the invention takes the H  2 O 2  -ascorbic acid system as a main component to carry out oxidative degradation on the kappa-carrageenan in a low-temperature high-pressure environment, has the advantages of simple process, high yield, short time consumption and environmental friendliness, can carry out industrial production, and has good antibacterial activity.

title_en: Preparation method of organosilicon elastomer base material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of an organosilicon elastomer base material in the technical field of elastomers, which comprises the following steps: s1. Preparation of PDMS/AD molecules: s1-1, adding bis (3-aminopropyl) end-capped polydimethylsiloxane into a flask, heating the flask in vacuum for half an hour under the condition of an oil bath at 100 ℃, cooling the flask to room temperature, and adding anhydrous tetrahydrofuran into the flask; s1-2, adding isophorone diisocyanate into a beaker, and adding anhydrous tetrahydrofuran for dissolution; after dissolution, pouring the solution in the beaker into a constant pressure dropping funnel, dropping the solution in the step S1-1, and reacting for 24 hours at room temperature overnight; s2. Preparation of PDMS/SS-AD molecules; by constructing polydimethylsiloxane with gradient action of multiple density hydrogen bonds and dynamic disulfide bonds, controlling the precursor structure and molecular weight, selecting a chain extender, regulating and controlling the performance of polysiloxane, optimizing the performance of an organosilicon system, and preparing the organosilicon elastomer substrate material with high strength, high stretching and rapid and efficient self-repairing function.

title_en: Polyphosphoric carbazole material, preparation method and application thereof in photoelectric device
abstract_en: The application discloses a polyphosphoric acid carbazole material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of material preparation. The polyphosphoric carbazole material provided by the application has better stability, and good film forming property and interaction between macromolecular chains can effectively solve the problems of poor compactness, easy diffusion and the like of the traditional phosphoric carbazole small molecules, so that a stable photoelectric device based on polyphosphoric carbazole is realized. The synthesis method of the polyphosphoric acid carbazole is simple and quick, the reaction condition is mild, the obtained polyphosphoric acid carbazole material is dissolved in single or mixed solvents such as toluene, chlorobenzene, chloroform, dichloromethane, methanol, ethanol and isopropanol, and the like, and the polyphosphoric acid carbazole material is processed into a film through processes such as spin coating, knife coating, slit coating, dip coating and spray coating, so that the photoelectric device based on the polyphosphoric acid carbazole material is prepared. The application has important scientific significance and extremely high industrial value.

title_en: Composite toughened polylactic acid degradable master batch and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite toughened polylactic acid (PLA) degradable master batch and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of degradable PLA wood-plastic composite materials. The preparation method comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by mass: PLA resin 20-60 parts, modified plant short fiber 10-50 parts, modified CaCO  3  10 to 50 parts of particles and 0.5 to 1.0 part of lubricant. Softness against PLAAnd the problems of poor impact property and high cost, the interface modifier is adopted for preparing the plant short fiber and CaCO  3  The particle is modified to effectively solve the problems of poor interfacial compatibility and poor dispersion in PLA, and the use of plant staple fiber or CaCO  3  The particles can improve the toughness of PLA and reduce the strength of PLA at the same time, and reduce the cost of PLA composite degradation master batch. The composite toughening polylactic acid master batch provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, environment friendliness and degradability, and is widely applied to the fields of food packaging and transportation, agricultural mulching films or buildings and the like.

title_en: Efficient breathable waterproof sports shoes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sports shoes, in particular to a high-efficiency breathable waterproof sports shoe and a preparation method thereof, which are used for solving the problem that the waterproofness and the breathability of the existing sports shoes cannot be simultaneously considered; according to the preparation method, the hemp fiber and the cotton fiber are used as raw materials to form the fly-knitted vamp, the hemp fiber and the cotton fiber belong to cellulose fiber, the fiber molecules contain a large number of polar hydrophilic groups, the hemp fiber is easy to combine with water molecules to adsorb the water molecules when in contact with water, the hemp fiber has a unique structure, moisture and water vapor in the fabric can be quickly transferred and diffused, sweat or moisture can be timely dredged to the surface of the fabric and is dissipated into the air when the foot sweats due to movement, the air permeability is good, and then super-waterproof emulsion is sprayed on the fly-knitted vamp, so that a super-hydrophobic surface can be formed on the outer surface of the fly-knitted vamp, the waterproof effect is realized, the absorption and the dredging of the sweat or the moisture by the inner surface of the fly-knitted vamp are not influenced, and the wearing comfort of the sports shoes is improved.

title_en: All-natural plant-based sound insulation material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an all-natural plant-based sound insulation material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, pretreating plant biomass by adopting a pretreatment solution, and controlling the lignin content in the plant biomass to be 5% -15%; and then preparing a culture medium by taking the delignified plant biomass as a raw material, and culturing fungus mycelia to obtain a mycelia-plant composite material serving as a plant-based sound insulation material. The composite material obtained by the application is composed of natural substances, has good sound insulation effect and also has excellent mechanical properties; and the preparation process is simple and environment-friendly.

title_en: Ultra-thin elastomer sheet and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Provided is a self-supporting and practically usable ultra-thin elastomer sheet composed of silicone. The ultra-thin elastomer sheet is an ultra-thin sheet having a maximum film thickness of 3 [ mu ] m and being composed of a crosslinked silicone polymer in which a plurality of unit portions having a reactive organic group and a plurality of unit portions having no reactive organic group are crosslinked with a crosslinking agent having a reactive group reactive with the reactive organic group, the crosslinked silicone polymer being defined by the following formula (I) U= (um+Un)/Ua. wherein U is the number of unit portions between crosslinking points of the crosslinked silicone polymer, um is the number of unit portions having no reactive organic group in the silicone polymer, un is the number of unit portions having a reactive organic group in the silicone polymer, ua is the number of reactive groups of the crosslinking agent for crosslinking, and the number of unit portions between the crosslinking points of the crosslinked silicone is 348 to 0.

title_en: PVA fiber@nano ZnO/epoxy resin composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PVA fiber@nano ZnO/epoxy resin composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method is that after stirring and mixing treatment of polyvinyl alcohol fiber, polyvinyl alcohol solution and nano ZnO dispersion liquid, mixing the PVA fiber@nano ZnO/epoxy resin composite material with epoxy resin and other conventional auxiliary agents by utilizing a Vacuum Assisted Resin Transfer Molding (VARTM) process. The invention discovers that under the process condition of using Vacuum Auxiliary Resin Transfer Molding (VARTM), the mechanical interlocking between the treated PVA fiber and the epoxy resin matrix is realized through the synergistic effect of the PVA fiber, the PVA solution and the nano ZnO dispersion liquid, and the strength of the PVA reinforced epoxy resin material is further obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method of composite impermeable material, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of impermeable materials, and provides a preparation method of a composite impermeable material, a product and an application thereof. The preparation method of the composite impermeable material comprises the steps of mixing a first component with an acidic sodium silicate solution to obtain a mixed solution, and mixing a second component with the mixed solution to obtain the composite impermeable material, wherein the first component comprises a first main agent, a cross-linking agent, a retarder and an accelerator, the first main agent comprises an aqueous solution of a first acrylic acid salt, the first acrylic acid salt comprises at least one of calcium acrylate and magnesium acrylate, the second component comprises an initiator, and the initiator comprises at least one of ammonium persulfate and sodium persulfate. The composite impermeable material provided by the disclosure at least achieves the impermeable effects of simple preparation method, high compressive strength, high later stability, good impermeable effect, good durability, uniform liquid, environmental friendliness and low cost by compounding the acrylate and the acidic sodium silicate, and can be applied to ion rare earth mines.

title_en: Polyacetal resin composition, method for producing same, and resin gear
abstract_en: A process for producing a polyacetal resin composition, which comprises adding an alkaline inactivating agent (D) to a reaction product obtained by copolymerizing a predetermined heteropolyacid with a polymerization catalyst (C), wherein the reaction product comprises a trioxane as a main monomer (a), and a cyclic ether and/or cyclic methylal having a C-C bond of 1 or more as a comonomer (B), to a polymerization catalyst (C), and then performing a melt kneading treatment to inactivate the polymerization catalyst (C), wherein the polyacetal resin composition comprises a predetermined amount of a predetermined modified olefin polymer (B), a predetermined alkylene glycol polymer (C), a predetermined calcium carbonate (D), a partial ester of a polyhydric alcohol having 2 to 4 members and an (F) alpha-olefin oligomer (A) per 100 parts by mass of the polyacetal copolymer.

title_en: Non-crosslinked shielding material for environment-friendly cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-crosslinked shielding material for an environment-friendly cable, and belongs to the technical field of environment-friendly cable materials. The shielding material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-90 parts of impact polypropylene, 10-50 parts of thermoplastic elastomer, 20-40 parts of carbon black, 0.1-0.3 part of antioxidant A, 0.05-0.1 part of antioxidant B and 3-10 parts of lubricant. The invention adopts the anti-impact polypropylene as the base material, and adopts a reciprocating single screw extruder to melt and mix the anti-impact polypropylene, the thermoplastic elastomer, the composite antioxidant and the lubricant, remove impurities, extrude and granulate, and prepare the non-crosslinked shielding material with ultra-smooth surface and excellent mechanical property.

title_en: High-light-transmittance degradable elastomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a high-light-transmittance degradable elastomer and a preparation method thereof. The high-light-transmittance degradable elastomer takes propylene oxide and carbon dioxide as raw materials, and can realize the regulation and control of a soft segment structure and the regulation and control of a glass transition temperature by regulating and controlling the proportion of the propylene oxide and the carbon dioxide, and the range is-60 to-10 ℃. Meanwhile, the proportion of the soft segment to the hard segment is adjustable, and the content of the hard segment is as follows: 40-80 wt% of the high light transmittance degradable elastomer can be regulated and controlled on the thermal mechanical property of the high light transmittance degradable elastomer. Meanwhile, the elastomer has good light transmittance, and the light transmittance is 82-88%. In addition, the compound has good biodegradability, and the released small molecular compound can be reused without pollution to the environment. The whole preparation route is efficient, low in energy consumption and free from waste discharge, is an atomic economy route, and meanwhile, the used catalyst and raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, so that the method is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Cellulose nanofibril modified heat insulation silicon-based composite aerogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and relates to a cellulose nanofibril modified heat insulation silicon-based composite aerogel and a preparation method and application thereof. Mixing and stirring a silane coupling agent, cellulose nanofibrils, water, a cosolvent, a catalyst and a surfactant, and then transferring the obtained precursor into a closed container for condensation reaction to form silica gel; soaking the obtained gel in an organic solvent for multiple replacement to obtain an organic gel; and standing the gel subjected to solvent replacement at normal temperature and normal pressure to obtain the high-elastic heat-insulation silicon-based composite aerogel. The silicon-based composite aerogel prepared by the method has the advantages of lower density, excellent mechanical property, excellent hydrophobicity and high-temperature heat insulation property, and has wide application prospect in the field of heat insulation.

title_en: Bismaleimide thermosetting dielectric film, preparation method thereof and capacitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismaleimide thermosetting dielectric film, a preparation method thereof and a capacitor, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing bismaleimide resin, diamine chain extender, catalyst and nano filler into N, N-dimethylformamide solution to obtain bismaleimide system composition slurry; the catalyst is an anionic catalyst or a free radical initiator; the bismaleimide system composition slurry is coated on a substrate,sequentially performing film forming, curing, demolding and drying treatment to obtain the bismaleimide thermosetting dielectric film. The bismaleimide thermosetting dielectric film prepared by the invention has a cross-linked network structure and can resist the high temperature of 250 ℃; the solvent resistance is strong; excellent energy storage performance at high temperature of 150 ℃ and over 400MV/m and high electric field, such as high breakdown field strength (Eb is more than or equal to 600 MV/m), high charge and discharge efficiency (eta is more than or equal to 90 percent) and high discharge energy density (Ue is more than or equal to 5J/cm)  3  )。

title_en: Solar cell light conversion POE adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar cell light conversion POE adhesive film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the solar cell light conversion POE adhesive film is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 75-95 parts of POE resin, 2-20 parts of tackifying light conversion agent, 1-3 parts of cross-linking agent, 0.5-2 parts of auxiliary cross-linking agent and 0.1-1 part of antioxidant; the tackifying light conversion agent is prepared by reacting POE resin, polar monomer, chain extension monomer, silane coupling agent and initiator melt grafting to obtain POE graft and europium chloride. According to the solar cell light conversion POE adhesive film, the novel tackifying light conversion agent is introduced, so that ultraviolet light with the wavelength of 300-400nm can be converted into red orange light with the wavelength of 580-700nm, the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell is effectively improved, and the solar cell light conversion film still keeps good light transmission performance, particularly has high adhesive performance, and has a wider application prospect.

title_en: Special nano composite auxiliary agent for ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a special nano composite auxiliary agent for ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: 10-25% of an anti-sticking agent, 20-30% of an antioxidant, 25-35% of an inorganic nano adsorption-nucleating agent, 5-15% of an acid absorption stabilizer, 10-15% of a rheological additive and 0.01-0.1% of a yellow finger control agent. The preparation technology comprises the following steps: 1) Uniformly mixing the anti-sticking agent, the inorganic nano adsorption-nucleating agent, the rheological auxiliary agent and the yellow index control agent by using a high-speed stirring device to perform; 2) Uniformly reinforcing the preformed component and other components into a composite material by adopting a gravity-free mixing device; 3) And curing the composite material at low temperature through parallel double screws, and finally obtaining the composite additive with uniform size through a granule pressing forming and screening device. The composite additive is used for the special material of the ethylene-propylene-butyl ternary polymerization CPP aluminized corona resin, and can obtain the cast polypropylene aluminized film with excellent comprehensive properties such as good optics, mechanics, anti-adhesion, processing molding, precipitation resistance, thermo-oxidative aging resistance and the like. In addition, the composite auxiliary agent has the characteristics of integration, easy addition, small addition amount, low-temperature preparation, environmental protection and the like, scientifically solves the problems of accurate regulation and control of dust-free environment in the preparation process of the nano composite auxiliary agent and dust-free addition of the composite auxiliary agent in the production process of the special polypropylene resin material, and is a special high-performance composite auxiliary agent for the cast polypropylene aluminized film resin.

title_en: Polymer, composition containing same and application of polymer in anti-dispersion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polymer, a composition containing the same and its use in anti-dispersion. Wherein the polymer unit is an acrylamide compound unit, a cationic organic compound unit and a carboxylic acid unit, and the composition further comprises polyvinyl alcohol.

title_en: High-strength ABS material for keys and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of ABS materials, and particularly discloses a high-strength ABS material for keys and a preparation method thereof. The high-strength ABS material for the keys is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-70 parts of ABS resin, 23-43 parts of glass fiber, 10-20 parts of toughening agent, 8-18 parts of wear-resistant auxiliary agent, 6-16 parts of compatilizer, 5-12 parts of flame retardant, 1-3 parts of antioxidant and 0.5-2 parts of color masterbatch, wherein the glass fiber is prepared by modifying silane coupling agent, organic silicon resin and carboxyl-terminated liquid nitrile rubber; the preparation method comprises the following steps: the ABS resin, glass fiber, toughening agent, wear-resistant auxiliary agent, compatilizer, flame retardant, antioxidant and color master are added into reaction equipment, melted, extruded, formed and cooled to be granulated to prepare the high-strength ABS material for the key.

title_en: Low-density low-friction-factor flame-retardant elastomer material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber products, and particularly discloses a low-density low-friction-factor flame-retardant elastomer material and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the low-density low-friction-factor flame-retardant elastomer material, the low-Mooney ethylene propylene diene monomer and polypropylene are adopted as matrix materials, and the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene, the flame retardant and the foaming agent with specific types and contents are added, so that the prepared modified TPV material has the performance requirements of low density, low friction factor, high flame retardance, hardness, tensile strength and the like, the flame retardance can meet European standard, further, the phenolic resin is selected as the vulcanizing agent, the vulcanization manufacturability of the modified TPV material is guaranteed, the rapid vulcanization and stable production of the modified TPV material are facilitated, and the modified TPV material has wide application prospects in the field of automobile sealing parts.

title_en: Special material for nano antibacterial polyolefin silent drain pipe and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a special material for a nano antibacterial polyolefin silent drain pipe, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 80-93 parts of polypropylene or 76-90 parts of polyethylene, 2-4 parts of grafted POE,5-20 parts of talcum powder, 0.3-0.8 part of nano silver powder, 0.8-1.5 parts of nano titanium dioxide, 0.5-1.5 parts of dispersing agent, 0.8-2.0 parts of stabilizer, 0.5-1.2 parts of flow modifier and 0.3-0.6 part of antioxidant. The nanometer metal particle is combined with mercapto (-SH) on bacteria proteinase to make proteinase lose activity, so that the inherent bacteria component is destroyed to produce dysfunction and death, and the nanometer material is introduced into polyethylene or polypropylene to prepare one kind of long-acting antibiotic material for use in the inner layer and outer layer of three-layer structure polyolefin silent drain pipe to form one long-acting antibiotic layer to ensure health.

title_en: High-elasticity biliquid grouting material for plugging and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-elasticity biliquid grouting material for plugging, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 82-94 parts of active prepolymer, 6-18 parts of alpha-silane modified polymer, 2-3 parts of vinyl trimethoxy silane, 55-65 parts of tackifying resin solution, 5-15 parts of triethylene diamine aqueous solution, 5-15 parts of polyaspartic acid ester resin, 45-55 parts of composite filler, 3-6 parts of titanium dioxide, 0.3-0.6 part of high pigment carbon black, 0.3-0.7 part of antioxidant, 0.3-0.7 part of ultraviolet absorber, 0.3-0.1 part of defoamer, 0.3-0.7 part of anti-settling agent and 1-3 parts of aminosilane coupling agent. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the high-elasticity biliquid grouting material, which leads the material to have the advantage of double solidification by introducing the active prepolymer containing isocyanate groups and the alpha-silane modified polymer, realizes priming-free bonding and is beneficial to improving the wet bonding strength.

title_en: Kneaded material, method for producing kneaded material, molded body, and optical member
abstract_en: A kneaded material comprising: an ultraviolet absorber comprising at least 1 compound selected from the group consisting of a compound represented by formula (1) and a compound represented by formula (2); a polymer compound.

title_en: Polypropylene composite additive and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypropylene composite additive and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of resin additives. The homo-polypropylene modified by the composite additive provided by the invention has better tensile property and thermal oxidative aging resistance, and can effectively improve the color stability of polypropylene.

title_en: Method for preparing L-glucan by co-pyrolysis of cellulose and urea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of levoglucosan, and particularly relates to a method for preparing levoglucosan by co-pyrolysis of cellulose and urea. The method comprises the following steps of mixing urea and cellulose, performing pyrolysis, and collecting volatile matters to obtain the biological oil containing the L-glucan. The method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process, convenience in operation, no subsequent catalyst recovery and other operations, lower requirements on the pyrolysis reactor, and high yield of the preparation of the L-glucan by taking cellulose or lignocellulose biomass and urea as raw materials.

title_en: Low-stress underfill capable of being repaired by heating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: An underfill adhesive which can be repaired by heating and has low stress, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adhesives. The underfill adhesive disclosed by the invention comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 2-10 parts of liquid epoxy resin; 5-15 parts of curing agent; 50-80 parts of inorganic filler; 0.1-3 parts of coupling agent; 0.1-2 parts of auxiliary agent; 0.1-10 parts of siloxane-containing additive. The siloxane-containing additive contains dynamic covalent bonds, so that the material has stress relaxation and heating self-healing property, and the problem of delamination and cracking of the underfill in the actual chip packaging application process can be effectively solved.

title_en: Thermal association type scale inhibitor, alkaline scale inhibition polymer fracturing fluid system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal association type scale inhibitor, an alkaline scale inhibition polymer fracturing liquid system and a preparation method thereof, wherein the molecular structural formula of the thermal association type scale inhibitor is as follows: wherein x=92-98, y=1-3, z=1-5, and the molar ratio of p to q is 3:2; the-COO-/-SO in the thermally associated scale inhibitor  3  ‑/PO  4  ‑/‑NH  2  The group can play a better role in chelating divalent ions such as calcium and magnesium in water, can be adsorbed on the surface of calcium carbonate crystal, changes the crystal morphology and causes lattice distortion, and in addition, the hydrophobic group with summarized molecular structure can fully extend the molecular chain of the scale inhibitor in water SO as to enable-COO-/-SO  3  ‑/PO  4  ‑/‑NH  2  The groups are more exposed outside, so that the attraction between divalent ions such as strong carbonate radicals and calcium, magnesium and the like is inhibited, the adsorption capacity of the strong carbonate radicals on the surface of the microcrystal of the scale is enhanced, the crystal forms of the scale are distorted or dispersed, and the scale inhibition effect of the scale inhibitor is further improved.

title_en: Biodegradable synthetic polymer material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biodegradable synthetic polymer material and a preparation method thereof, the process is simple to operate, pollution-free, natural and environment-friendly, can be reused, has wide sources of required raw materials, is economical and easy to obtain, and provides the following steps: (1) Polymerizing the initial monomer under the condition of introducing high molecular organic chemistry until the required molecular weight is reached; (2) mixing the polymer obtained with sugar in a desired ratio; (3) continuing the subsequent treatment.

title_en: Device and method for preparing polybutylene terephthalate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for preparing polybutylene terephthalate, wherein the device comprises an esterification kettle, a preshrinking kettle and a preshrinking kettle, wherein an inlet end of the preshrinking kettle is provided with common baffles and heating baffles which are alternately arranged, the height of each common baffle is 1.2-3.0 times that of each heating baffle, a weir plate is arranged in the middle of each common baffle, the height of each common baffle is in a descending trend from the inlet end to the inside, the method sequentially carries out esterification, preshrinking and final polycondensation reactions on mixed slurry of terephthalic acid and 1, 4-butanediol in the device, and a catalyst enters the esterification kettle or enters the preshrinking kettle from a catalyst adding port in a component way, and the polybutylene terephthalate with an average polymerization degree of 130-200 is obtained after the reaction is finished. The high molecular weight polybutylene terephthalate prepared by the specific device and method has high average polymerization degree, excellent spinning performance and heat stability.

title_en: High-flame-retardance rapid ceramic silicon rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-flame-retardance rapid ceramic silicone rubber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the silicone rubber comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of crude silicone rubber, 35-45 parts of reinforcing filler, 80-120 parts of flame-retardant ceramic filler, 10-20 parts of fluxing agent, 2.0 parts of cross-linking agent and 5 parts of heat-resistant agent, wherein the heat-resistant agent is silicone resin; the preparation method of the silicone rubber comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of weighing silicon rubber, white carbon black, a flame-retardant ceramic filler, a fluxing agent and a heat-resistant agent according to a proportion, adding the weighed silicon rubber, white carbon black, a flame-retardant ceramic filler, a fluxing agent and a heat-resistant agent into a torque rheometer, adding the white carbon black into the torque rheometer for multiple times, mixing the white carbon black into blocks, and heating equipment to 180 ℃ for 1 hour to obtain a mixed rubber; placing the obtained mixed rubber at room temperature for at least 24 hours, then carrying out open mill in an open mill at room temperature, adding a cross-linking agent in a corresponding proportion, and obtaining the rubber compound after rolling, thin pass and sheet falling; the obtained product has the characteristics of low temperature, high speed and compact porcelain, and the porcelain has better high-temperature electrical insulation property and meets the requirements of fire-resistant cable insulation and other similar applications.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional MHOF intercalated graphene oxide film with high rejection rate for alpha and beta radionuclides
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a two-dimensional MHOF intercalation graphene oxide film with high rejection rate to alpha and beta radionuclides, which belongs to the technical field of film preparation and comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving metal nitrate with certain mass and 0.37mmo l of azobenzene 4,4' -dicarboxylic acid in water; s2, adding the mixed solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle of a Teflon substrate for reaction at 120 ℃ for 12 hours after ultrasonic dispersion of 30min (the heating rate is 5 ℃/min); the beneficial effects are that: because the MHOF required by the method is prepared by a one-step hydrothermal method, the reaction process is simple, convenient, quick and controllable, and the yield and quality of the reaction product are high; the method utilizes vacuum filtration, and the filtered filtrate is easy-to-process liquid (water) which is more environment-friendly; the method does not need a complex reaction process, can be used for multiple times by one-time synthesis, and has the potential of large-scale application.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bimetallic porphyrin-based organic framework material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a bimetallic porphyrin-based organic framework material, and belongs to the field of chemical materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: under the vacuum condition, M1-aldehyde phenyl porphyrin and M2-amino phenyl porphyrin are reacted by a solvothermal method to generate a bimetallic porphyrin-based organic framework material; m1 and M2 are each independently selected from one of transition metals coordinated with the aldehyde phenylporphyrin or aminophenylporphyrin; m1+.m2. According to the invention, M1-aldehyde phenyl porphyrin and M2-amino phenyl porphyrin are reacted by a solvothermal method, so that M1-aldehyde phenyl porphyrin and M2-amino phenyl porphyrin are subjected to Schiff base reaction, and the positions of M1 and M2 are fixed, so that the bimetallic porphyrin-based organic framework material with different metal ions is synthesized. The method has simple steps and is convenient to operate.

title_en: Adhesive tape and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an adhesive tape, a preparation method and application thereof. The adhesive tape consists of an open-pore sponge body and an adhesive layer arranged on one side of the open-pore sponge body; the thickness of the open pore sponge body is 5-10 mm; the thickness of the adhesive layer is 0.2-0.6 mm. The raw materials for preparing the open-cell sponge comprise 100 parts of rubber, 5-50 parts of resin, 2-10 parts of vulcanizing agent and 45-55 parts of filler. The raw materials for preparing the adhesive comprise: 20 parts of polyurethane composite glue, 20-30 parts of MEK, 3-4 parts of aluminum powder, 1-2 parts of carbon powder, 1-2 parts of bridge agent and 0.4-1 part of accelerator; coating an adhesive on one side of the open-pore sponge body, then adopting a laminating wheel to press and laminate the open-pore sponge and the adhesive together, and cooling to prepare the adhesive tape. The adhesive tape has better elasticity, strength and adhesion, and can be widely applied to fixedly wrapping the electric wire.

title_en: Hf-N-B main chain structure ultrahigh temperature ceramic single-source precursor and preparation method thereof
