abstract_en: The invention relates to an Hf-N-B main chain structure superhigh temperature ceramic single-source precursor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the superhigh temperature ceramic single-source precursor comprises the following molecular chain structure: wherein the main chain structure unit is Hf-N-B, N represents the polymerization degree, and the ultra-high temperature means that the use temperature of the precursor pyrolysis conversion ceramic is above 1600 ℃; the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly utilizing active substituent groups to modify and end-capped trimethylaminoborane, filtering a solution and then mixing the solution with HfCl  4  And (3) reacting, removing the solvent, and continuously heating to enable precipitation to be decomposed and escape, so that a precursor with the Hf content exceeding 30wt% is finally obtained.The invention can improve the dissolution and melting performance and spinning performance of the precursor through the regulation and control of the side group, and the fiber obtained by spinning has the diameter smaller than 50 mu m and the length larger than 20cm, thereby solving the difficult problem that the high refractory metal content and the good rheological property are difficult to be obtained simultaneously. The precursor is thermally pyrolyzed to obtain HfC/HfB with Hf content up to 80wt%  2  Ultra-high temperature complex phase ceramic.

title_en: Preparation method of bio-based cobalt boride
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of bio-based cobalt boride, belonging to the field of cobalt boride preparation. The preparation raw materials comprise the following components in parts by weight: lauric acid: 62-82, myristic acid: 72 to 92, palmitic acid: 82-102, acetic acid: 55-75, cobalt hydroxide: 90-110 parts of tributyl borate: 73-93, n-butyl acetate: 240-260, soybean wax: 5 to 10. The bio-based raw materials are easy to obtain and low in price, a new raw material source is opened up for the cobalt boronate, and the production cost is reduced. The byproduct after the boration reaction is n-butyl acetate, which can be used as a solvent for recycling, and the melting point of the produced cobalt salt is moderate: about 95 ℃. The soybean wax is added into the raw materials, so that the rubber can be softened, the low-melting-point soybean wax can improve the melting point of cobalt salt, the soybean wax has the function of promoting the adhesion of metal and rubber, and meanwhile, the soybean wax can be utilized to migrate to the surface of vulcanized rubber to form a layer of protective film, so that the heat and oxygen resistance, the damp and heat resistance, the salt water resistance and the metal corrosion resistance are improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly flame retardant, preparation method and application thereof in plastics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flame retardants, and discloses an environment-friendly flame retardant, a preparation method and application thereof in plastics. The preparation method of the environment-friendly flame retardant comprises the following steps of carrying out intercalation modification on nano hydrotalcite by using dihydrogen phosphate, then carrying out surface modification on the nano hydrotalcite by using an aminosilane coupling agent, carrying out loading on polytetrafluoroethylene by using polyvinyl alcohol modified melamine formaldehyde resin, and carrying out a polytetrafluoroethylene loading reaction by using DOPO and surface modified dihydrogen phosphate intercalated nano hydrotalcite and polyvinyl alcohol modified melamine formaldehyde resin to obtain the environment-friendly flame retardant. The environment-friendly flame retardant disclosed by the invention is environment-friendly, nontoxic, smokeless, anti-dripping, excellent in flame retardant effect and good in compatibility with a polymer, is environment-friendly, and can be used for flame retardance of plastic materials.

title_en: Method for improving mechanical properties of bio-based glass polymer material containing isomannide by using polyvinyl acetal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving mechanical properties of bio-based glass polymer material containing isomannide by using polyvinyl acetal, which comprises the steps of dissolving isomannide, micromolecular dihydric alcohol and diisocyanate in a solvent, and carrying out ice bath, a catalyst and N  2  Under the protection condition, adding a cross-linking agent, reacting to obtain the isomannide-based glass polymer and polyvinyl acetal, dissolving in acetone, pouring into a mold, and solidifying to obtain the bio-based glass polymer material. The invention takes part in dynamic reversible reaction with biomass notOnly the reversible ester bond is obtained, the characteristics of repeatable processing and recycling of the glass-like polymer material are endowed, and the polyvinyl acetal and the glass-like polymer are compounded, so that the hydroxyl groups in the polyvinyl acetal can participate in the exchange reaction of dynamic covalent bonds, the mechanical properties of the material are improved, the material can be applied to high-strength and environment-friendly degradable materials, the application range is enlarged, and the process requirements are reduced by a low-cost and simple process method.

title_en: Impurity removal method for enox esterification reaction liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for removing impurities from enox esterification reaction liquid, which comprises the following steps of (1) adding anhydrous sodium acetate methanol solution into enox esterification reaction liquid, carrying out mixed precipitation to obtain a solid-liquid suspension, and (2) adding purified water into the solid-liquid suspension under stirring, stopping stirring and standing, removing supernatant, taking wet solid, washing with methanol, and drying to obtain enox esterified heparin dried product. The method reduces the dosage of methanol, simultaneously optimizes the impurity removal effect of the enoxaparin esterification process, reduces the transfer operation of materials among equipment, optimizes the process trend, improves the yield and the production efficiency of the esterified heparin, and is convenient and safe in process operation and suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Rheological agent for starch, preparation method and application of rheological agent in pseudoplastic liquid mulching film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rheological agent for starch, which comprises a first reaction liquid and a second reaction liquid, wherein the first reaction liquid comprises modified magnesium-aluminum hydrotalcite, an anionic surfactant and an anionic ethylenically unsaturated monomer, and the second reaction liquid comprises lignosulfonate, ethylenically unsaturated anhydride and strong alkali; the mass ratio of the first reaction liquid to the second reaction liquid is 1: (1-2); the modified magnesium-aluminum hydrotalcite is prepared by reacting magnesium salt, aluminum salt and alcohol compound in alkaline solution. According to the rheological agent for starch, through the structure of modified magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite in the first reaction liquid and the hydrophobicity and carbon chain hydrophobic skeleton of lignosulfonate in the second reaction liquid, macromolecular chains are formed through double bond crosslinking after the two are compounded, so that the hydrogen bonding effect between starch-based molecular chains is reduced, the viscosity of the starch-based liquid mulching film is reduced, and the mulching film with large thickness and good soil heat preservation and moisture preservation is formed, so that the yield and quality of crops are improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic adhesive film master batch, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solar photovoltaic modules, in particular to a photovoltaic film master batch, a preparation method and application thereof. The photovoltaic film master batch is prepared from the following raw materials in a supercritical carbon dioxide atmosphere: 92.25 to 94.8 percent of POE resin; 3-5 wt% of a first monomer; 0.5 to 2 weight percent of second monomer; 0.08 to 0.2 weight percent of initiator; 0.1 to 0.3 weight percent of antioxidant; 0.5 to 2 weight percent of auxiliary adhesive; the sum of the amounts of the components is equal to 100%. According to the invention, supercritical carbon dioxide is introduced in the preparation process, so that the grafting rate of the product is obviously improved, the bonding strength of the POE adhesive film, glass and back plate is greatly improved, the delamination phenomenon in the use process of the photovoltaic module is prevented, the defective rate of the module is reduced, the service life of the module is prolonged, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Method for preparing epoxy resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing epoxy resin, which comprises the following steps: the epoxy resin is prepared by heating and sectional curing reaction of epoxy resin oligomer and amine curing agent; the amine curing agent contains two amino groups with different reactivity of aliphatic and aromatic at the same time; the segmented curing includes: curing at 80 deg.C or below, and then at 120 deg.C or above. The invention prepares the epoxy resin with excellent mechanical properties by utilizing the difference of reaction kinetics of aliphatic and aromatic amino groups and epoxy groups. The preparation method provided by the preparation method is simple in process and has important significance for widening the practical application of the resin material in engineering.

title_en: Method for improving mechanical stability and chemical stability of latex
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for improving the mechanical stability and chemical stability of latex, comprising: 1) Collecting fresh latex: cleaning, namely adding a natural latex anti-coagulation preservative into a rubber collecting barrel with a nano titanium dioxide coating, collecting fresh latex by using the rubber collecting barrel, and uniformly mixing the fresh latex, wherein the natural latex anti-coagulation preservative comprises diammonium hydrogen phosphate and ammonium laurate; 2) Treatment of fresh latex: collecting fresh latex, filtering, centrifuging to obtain upper layer of skim latex and lower layer of concentrated latex, and adding water solution of octyl phenol polyoxyethylene ether and green tea extract into the lower layer of concentrated latex; 3) Preservation of fresh latex: the obtained concentrated latex is stored in a storage tank with a nano titanium dioxide coating in a sealing way and stored in a dark place at normal temperature. The method of the invention can maintain the latex with good mechanical stability and chemical stability in long-term storage.

title_en: Wide-temperature-range friction material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of friction materials, and particularly relates to a wide-temperature-range friction material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a wide-temperature-range friction material which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 60-80 parts of polytetrafluoroethylene, 10-20 parts of sericite and 10-20 parts of copper-nickel alloy nanowires. According to the invention, under the combined action of sericite and copper-nickel alloy nanowires, the high temperature resistance of the friction material is remarkably improved, so that the friction material has good friction resistance in a wider temperature range. The friction material provided by the invention is applied to the ultrasonic motor, so that the application range of the ultrasonic motor is widened.

title_en: Application of lily and rehmannia homogeneous polysaccharide in preparing medicament for treating cerebral ischemia
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and discloses application of lily and rehmannia uniform polysaccharide in preparation of a medicine for treating cerebral ischemia, wherein the lily and rehmannia uniform polysaccharide is prepared from galactose, glucose and fructose according to a molar ratio of 2.25:18.98: 78.77. The lily rehmannia homogeneous polysaccharide obtained by the invention has fixed components, and can protect brain tissues from damage caused by cerebral ischemia by regulating cGAS-STING signal transmission, thereby greatly promoting the industrialization process of lily rehmannia and the application range thereof.

title_en: Drug delivery system based on polyamphoon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a drug delivery system, a preparation method and application thereof. The drug delivery system of the present invention comprises a polymer polymerized from cationic monomers, anionic monomers, and zwitterionic monomers, and a drug molecule encapsulated by the polymer. And provides the application of the composition in preparing medicines for treating diabetes, cancer and retinitis pigmentosa.

title_en: Methacrylic acid succinic acid di-esterified starch, preparation method thereof and application thereof in cornea defect in-situ filling agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses succinic acid di-esterified starch methacrylate, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in cornea defect in-situ filling agents, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. The succinic acid double-esterified methacrylate starch is prepared by grafting carboxylation treatment of starch and then grafting double bonds. The cornea defect in-situ filling agent consists of succinic acid double-esterified starch methacrylate (StacMA), methacrylic acid acylated gelatin (GelMA), a photoinitiator and a solvent. The natural biomacromolecule-based cornea filler based on starch and gelatin has good biocompatibility, excellent photoresponse adhesion characteristic and excellent mechanical property, can realize in-situ photocrosslinking of hydrogel through ultraviolet irradiation and simultaneously generate excellent mechanical property and strong adhesion capacity, so that stable adhesion of an in-situ formed artificial cornea on a cornea implantation bed is realized, and regeneration of a damaged cornea natural structure and reconstruction of visual functions are promoted.

title_en: Organic polythioether and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic polythioether and a preparation method and application thereof. The sulfur content of the organic polysulfide is more than 45%, preferably 50-80 wt%, and the organic sulfur composition contains a cyclic trisulfide CnR  2  nS  3  . The preparation method of the organic polythioether comprises the following steps: catalytic action of elemental sulfur and unsaturated hydrocarbons on alkaline substancesThe reaction was carried out as follows, the reaction temperature of which was controlled by: heating a material system containing elemental sulfur, monitoring the viscosity coefficient of the material system, when the viscosity coefficient of the material system is changed from gradual reduction to increase, recording the temperature of the material system as T, controlling the temperature of the material system to be higher than T0-15 ℃, continuously reacting for a period of time, and then cooling and separating liquid materials to obtain the sulfur-containing composition. The preparation method of the organic polysulfide is simple and easy to control, and the organic polysulfide contains a cyclic organic polysulfide with a longer sulfur chain and has high mass content of the cyclic polysulfide.

title_en: Reactive composition, polyurethane foam prepared from same and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reactive composition, polyurethane foam prepared from the reactive composition and a preparation method of the polyurethane foam. The reactive composition of the present invention comprises a polyol component, a physical blowing agent component, and an isocyanate component; the physical foaming agent comprises chlorofluoroolefin and fluoroolefin, wherein the boiling point of the chlorofluoroolefin is 10-20 ℃, and the boiling point of the fluoroolefin is < -10 ℃; based on the total weight of the physical foaming agent components, the total weight ratio of the chlorofluoroolefin and the fluoroolefin is more than or equal to 80wt percent, and the weight ratio of the chlorofluoroolefin is more than 60wt percent; the average hydroxyl number of the polyol component is > 300mgKOH/g, the average functionality is > 3, and the average functionality of the isocyanate component is > 2. The reactive composition provided by the invention can be used for obtaining rigid polyurethane foam with excellent heat insulation performance, and the heat conductivity coefficient of the rigid polyurethane foam can be less than or equal to 15 mW/m.K; the structure of the foam cells can be optimized, so that the anisotropy of the foam cells is low, and the comprehensive performance of the foam is optimized.

title_en: Opening extrusion-assisting master batch for heavy packaging film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high molecular compounds, and particularly discloses an opening extrusion-assisting master batch for a heavy packaging film and a preparation method thereof. The extrusion-assisting master batch for the opening of the heavy packaging film comprises the following components in parts by mass: 90-100 parts of linear low density polyethylene LLDPE, 20-50 parts of an opening agent, 4.5-9.5 parts of a fluorine-containing processing aid PPA, 2-12 parts of a dispersing agent, 0.5-2 parts of a coupling agent, 0.2-1 part of a lubricant, 0.05-0.2 part of a slipping agent and 0.5-1.2 parts of an antioxidant. The extrusion-assisted master batch for the packaging film has good application effect, wherein the silicon dioxide opening agent component can form microscopic protrusions on the surface of the film, reduce the contact area between the films, prevent the formation of vacuum closure, and can greatly reduce the adhesion force between the films by matching with smooth dispersing components so as to promote the films to be easy to open; the fluorine-containing processing aid PPA has the advantages of reducing apparent viscosity of melt, eliminating or reducing die accumulation, preventing melt fracture, improving film surface quality, improving production efficiency and reducing processing energy consumption.

title_en: Microcapsule self-lubricating material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials, in particular to a microcapsule self-lubricating material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the microcapsule self-lubricating material comprises a mixture phase and a matrix material phase; wherein the mixture phase comprises microcapsule material with core-shell structure and glue. The prepared microcapsule self-lubricating material has the characteristics of uniform composition distribution, excellent high-temperature resistance and high mechanical strength, and also has good self-lubricating performance.

title_en: ZIF-8/bacterial cellulose composite sponge, preparation method thereof and application thereof as dressing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ZIF-8/bacterial cellulose composite sponge, a preparation method thereof and application thereof as a dressing. The preparation method comprises the steps of in-situ growth of ZIF-8 crystals on bacterial cellulose fibers through a two-step low-temperature reaction, wherein the bacterial cellulose hydrogel is not dehydrated or is subjected to partial dehydration, then is treated by zinc salt solution, is transferred to ligand solution for treatment, is cleaned to obtain ZIF-8/bacterial cellulose composite hydrogel, and is finally treated by ethanol aqueous solution and is subjected to freeze drying to obtain a final product. The ZIF-8/bacterial cellulose composite sponge prepared by the preparation method does not damage the three-dimensional network structure of bacterial nanocellulose, fully retains the function of the bacterial cellulose, can absorb a large amount of exudates and convert the exudates into hydrogel, and can be used as a wound dressing after being loaded with medicines.

title_en: Methacrylate structural adhesive with excellent electrolyte resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to a methacrylate structural adhesive with excellent electrolyte resistance and a preparation method thereof. The methacrylate structural adhesive with excellent electrolyte resistance comprises, by weight, 1-15 parts of methacrylic acid, 30-50 parts of methacrylate monomer, 19-30 parts of elastomer toughening agent, 10-20 parts of low-polarity polyfunctional acrylate resin, 0.8-2.0 parts of reducing agent and 0.05-0.6 part of stabilizer, and 25-45 parts of oxidant, 20-40 parts of epoxy resin and 0.1-0.5 part of pigment. The methacrylate structural adhesive provided by the invention has the advantages of high curing speed and high bonding strength of the conventional acrylate structural adhesive, and the cured product has good electrolyte resistance.

title_en: Cleaning agent for removing paint layer on metal surface and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cleaning agent for removing a paint layer on a metal surface and a production process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of cleaning agents. The cleaning agent comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 6.5 to 9 weight percent of paint removal auxiliary agent, 8 to 10 weight percent of surfactant, 0.7 to 0.9 weight percent of chelating agent, 0.14 to 0.18 weight percent of penetrating agent, 0.5 to 0.6 weight percent of buffering agent, 7 to 10 weight percent of banana oil and the balance of deionized water; in the process of treating the paint layer, banana oil preferentially carries out micro-dissolution on the paint film, a surface layer compact structure is damaged, an ester-containing branched alkane chain at the end part of a paint removal auxiliary molecule is easy to attach to a dissolving layer in an aqueous agent, the paint layer is swelled, the combination property of the paint layer and a substrate is reduced, the paint layer is enabled to fall off along with continuous erosion of the banana oil, the template effect is formed by the end branch structure of the paint removal auxiliary molecule and the middle polyether segment, the detached paint layer is carried out into a cleaning agent in a sheet shape, and the cleaning agent is beneficial to aftertreatment regeneration.

title_en: Preparation method of epoxy chain extender
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an epoxy chain extender, which comprises the following steps: in the presence of chloroplatinic acid catalyst, performing hydrosilylation reaction on allyl glycidyl ether and hydrogen-containing silicone oil to obtain a reaction product; and adding a complexing agent into the reaction product, carrying out complexing treatment at the temperature of 90-130 ℃, and filtering to obtain the epoxy chain extender. The epoxy chain extender prepared by the preparation method has less Pt catalyst and gel and high reaction activity.

title_en: Melamine benzenesulfonate flame retardant, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a melamine benzenesulfonate flame retardant, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of flame retardants. The melamine benzenesulfonate flame retardant is obtained by adopting melamine solution or melamine derivative solution and benzenesulfonic acid compound solution as raw materials through a specific preparation method, and the problem that the performance of the flame retardant in the prior art is to be improved is solved. The flame retardant has the advantages of high flame retardant efficiency, no toxicity and environmental protection; the fluidity is good, the influence on the aspects of small addition amount, mechanical property, thermal stability and the like is relatively small, and a good flame-retardant effect can be realized in a wider temperature range; the flame retardant has excellent flame retardant property, thermal stability, simple preparation method, no generation of redundant waste, high conversion rate and simple post-treatment process, and is beneficial to realizing industrial production.

title_en: Cinnamon essential oil edible composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fruit and vegetable storage and preservation, and particularly discloses an edible cinnamon essential oil composite film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing cinnamon essential oil nanoemulsion, and preparing a composite film substrate by using oxidized corn starch/pullulan; and mixing the gelatinized starch suspension with cinnamon essential oil nanoemulsion to prepare a film forming liquid, pouring the film forming liquid into a culture dish by a tape casting method, and drying in a constant-temperature drying oven to prepare the cinnamon essential oil edible composite film. Compared with the prior art, the cinnamon essential oil edible composite film prepared by the invention has good mechanical property, ultraviolet shielding effect and high safety, and is expected to be used as a green and high-quality fruit and vegetable fresh-keeping technology after picking; the cinnamon essential oil edible composite film is used for treating tomato fruits, so that the weight loss rate, hardness and cell structure change of the fruits can be effectively controlled, the ripening and aging process of the fruits can be slowed down, the quality of the tomato fruits can be maintained, and the storage period of the fruits can be prolonged.

title_en: Benzoxazole-based polymer fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a benzoxazole-based polymer fiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the benzoxazolyl polymer fiber provided by the application comprises the following steps: mixing 4, 6-diamino resorcinol monomer, terephthalic acid monomer and/or terephthalic acid derivative monomer and 2- (4-aminophenyl) -5-aminobenzimidazole monomer in an acid solvent, and obtaining a polyhydroxy amide precursor spinning solution after polymerization reaction; spinning the polyhydroxyamide precursor spinning solution to obtain polyhydroxyamide precursor fibers; and performing thermal cyclization on the polyhydroxyamide precursor fiber to obtain the benzoxazolyl polymer fiber. The benzoxazole-based polymer fiber prepared by the method has good comprehensive performance, can effectively improve the compression resistance and ultraviolet resistance of the conventional polybenzoxazole fiber, improves the interfacial binding force between the fiber and resin, and is a novel benzoxazole-based polymer fiber.

title_en: Ultraviolet light curing 3D printing resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultraviolet light curing 3D printing resin, which comprises an acrylate photosensitive prepolymer containing dynamic covalent bonds and an active hydrogen-containing oligomer, wherein the acrylate photosensitive prepolymer containing dynamic covalent bonds has the following structure: wherein R is  1  Is that R  2  R is hydrogen or methyl, and R is a residual group of the polyisocyanate after two NCO are lost; the invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the ultraviolet light curing 3D printing resin, wherein the application method comprises the following steps: (1) Taking the ultraviolet light curing 3D printing resin as a raw material, and adopting light curing 3D printing to prepare a light curing sample; (2) And (3) placing the photo-cured sample in an environment of 80-150 ℃ for heat treatment for 6-24 hours. The resin provided by the invention can keep high modulus in the printing process, and the problem that the ultralow modulus material is inconvenient to print is solved by changing the low modulus material into the low modulus material through simple post-treatment after printing is finished, so that the printing yield of the low modulus material is greatly improved.

title_en: Hinge film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hinge film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the hinge film comprises a first protective layer, an intermediate layer and a second protective layer which are sequentially laminated; the components of the intermediate layer include a block copolymer having a polymethacrylate block and a polyacrylate block. The hinge film provided by the invention has the advantages of high surface hardness, high wear resistance, good weather resistance, good solvent resistance, good flexibility, good bending resistance and very good adhesive strength with a polycarbonate data page of a passport.

title_en: Modified lithium supplementing agent, modification method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified lithium supplementing agent, a modification method and application thereof. The modified lithium supplementing agent comprises a lithium supplementing base material and a protective layer coated on the surface of the lithium supplementing base material, wherein the protective layer comprises a crosslinked polymer, and the reaction raw materials of the crosslinked polymer comprise a polyvinyl alcohol polymer and an isocyanate monomer. In the modified lithium supplementing agent provided by the invention, the crosslinked polymer formed by crosslinking the polyvinyl alcohol polymer and the isocyanate monomer improves the density of the surface of the lithium supplementing base material, isolates air, improves the problem that the lithium supplementing material is unstable in air, and has excellent lithium supplementing effect.

title_en: Composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of packaging films, and particularly relates to a composite film and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, essential oil is added into the film in the form of emulsion, so that the core problems of solubility, stability, slow release property and the like of active ingredients in the film are solved by utilizing the nano emulsion technology, the physical stability is improved, and the antibacterial activity of the active ingredients is improved. Nanoemulsions have very small droplets and show great potential in stabilizing multiphase systems. The nano emulsion increases the surface area and enlarges the contact area between the bioactive component and food, so that the essential oil which is mixed into the film in the form of emulsion can effectively enhance the antibacterial activity of the composite film. The stable essential oil emulsion is doped in the film, so that the essential oil in the edible film can be better protected, and the risk of reducing the mechanical strength of the composite film is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of light and thin modified PE (polyethylene) diaphragm with high mechanical strength and high lithium ion flux
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery diaphragms, and discloses a preparation method of a light and thin modified PE diaphragm with high mechanical strength and high lithium ion flux, which comprises the following steps of mixing sodium montmorillonite slurry and lithium chloride solution, stirring, centrifuging, cleaning and drying to obtain lithium montmorillonite; adding the lithium montmorillonite into a dispersing agent, circularly shearing by a high-pressure homogenizer, and centrifugally separating to obtain two-dimensional lamellar lithium montmorillonite powder; adding two-dimensional lamellar lithium montmorillonite powder into deionized water, sequentially adding a hydroxymethyl cellulose aqueous solution and polyacrylamide, and respectively mixing and stirring to obtain lithium montmorillonite mixed slurry; and coating the lithium montmorillonite mixed slurry on the surface of the PE diaphragm by using a bar blade coating method, and drying to obtain the modified PE diaphragm. According to the invention, by adopting the steps, the obtained large-scale two-dimensional lamellar lithium montmorillonite coating on the modified PE diaphragm can selectively adsorb lithium ions, so that the mobility of the lithium ions is effectively improved, and the lithium dendrite growth inhibition capability is excellent.

title_en: Surface treating agent
abstract_en: The present invention provides a siloxane-containing silane compound represented by the following formula (1) or (2) (wherein each symbol is as described in the specification). R is R  S1   α  ‑X  A  ‑R  H   β   (1)，R  H   γ  ‑X  A  ‑R  S2  ‑X  A  ‑R  H   γ   (2)。

title_en: N-vinyllactam-containing polymers for papermaking
abstract_en: The present invention provides N-vinyllactam-based polyvinylamine-based polymers, methods for producing N-vinyllactam-based polyvinylamine-based polymers, and methods for making paper. An exemplary process for producing a N-vinyllactam-containing polyvinylamine-based polymer comprises performing a free radical polymerization of a vinylamide monomer, a vinylmonomer containing an amide functional group, and optionally a vinylmonomer containing a carboxylic acid group to obtain a prepolymer. Furthermore, the process comprises hydrolyzing the prepolymer under alkaline conditions to obtain a polyvinylamine-based polymer containing N-vinyllactam.

title_en: Barite dispersing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a barite dispersing agent, a preparation method and application thereof. The barite dispersing agent comprises, by mole ratio, 60% -80% of carboxyl monomers, 40% -20% of sulfonic acid monomers and 1% -3% of initiators. One or more monomers bearing carboxyl groups are polymerized with one or more monomers bearing sulfonic acid groups to form a polymeric dispersant bearing both carboxyl groups and sulfonic acid groups. The proportion of sulfonic acid groups and carboxyl groups on the polymer is controlled within a reasonable range by adjusting the proportion of the polymerized monomers, so that the effect of improving the barite dispersion rate is achieved.

title_en: Degradable high-barrier polylactic acid composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable high-barrier polylactic acid composite membrane and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of polylactic acid composite membranes; the high-barrier polylactic acid composite film comprises a polylactic acid upper surface layer, a high-barrier middle layer and a polylactic acid lower surface layer, wherein the polylactic acid upper surface layer and the polylactic acid lower surface layer are composed of a resin mixture A comprising polylactic acid resin, a lactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, a degradable elastomer, a compatilizer, an antioxidant and an anti-hydrolysis agent, the high-barrier middle layer is composed of a resin mixture B comprising polyglycolic acid, a lactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, a compatilizer and an antioxidant, the preparation method is simple, industrial production and use are easy to achieve, and the prepared polylactic acid composite film is a fully degradable film and has excellent degradability, mechanical property and processability, and good performance in the aspects of flexibility and barrier property, and can effectively prevent water vapor and oxygen permeation in air.

title_en: Low-shrinkage alcohol-resistant disinfectant PC/PBT alloy material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PC/PBT alloy material with a low-shrinkage alcohol-resistant disinfectant and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of PC resin; 15-25 parts of PBT resin; 2-5 parts of toughening agent; 0.3 to 1.2 portions of alcohol resistant agent; 0.2 to 0.5 part of shrinkage regulator; the alcohol resistant agent is octaphenyl cyclotetrasiloxane; the shrinkage regulator is isopropyl titanate; weighing PC resin, PBT resin, a toughening agent, an alcohol-resistant agent and a shrinkage rate regulator according to a formula, fully and uniformly mixing the components by a high-speed mixer, and extruding and granulating by a double-screw extruder to obtain the low-shrinkage alcohol-resistant disinfectant PC/PBT alloy material. The shrinkage rate of the product can reach 0.4 to 0.6 percent, which is far lower than that of the traditional PC/PBT alloy material; the preparation method of the invention selects isopropyl titanate as a shrinkage regulator, and uses the nonpolar of octaphenyl cyclotetrasiloxane to reduce the shrinkage of the material.

title_en: Multifunctional nanofiber hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional nanofiber hydrogel and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the multifunctional nanofiber hydrogel comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 47 to 86.9 percent of water, 0.1 to 1.0 percent of cellulose nanocrystals, 1 to 10 percent of high molecular polymer, 2 to 12 percent of protein and 10 to 30 percent of cross-linking agent. The prepared nanofiber hydrogel has the advantages of high stretching rate of more than 2000% at normal temperature and self-healing time of 5-45 s, has the characteristics of high stretching and quick healing, has the characteristics of high transparency, natural bacteriostasis, strong tissue adhesion, biocompatibility, pore structure stability and the like, can become an ideal novel medical dressing carrier, avoids secondary injury, and effectively prevents the medical dressing from slipping off when being used at a sport joint.

title_en: Fluorine-containing acrylic ester/graphene modified polyurethane coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine-containing acrylic ester/graphene modified polyurethane coating and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of oil well pipe surface treatment in the petroleum and natural gas industry. The method disclosed by the invention uses polypropylene glycol, dimethylolpropionic acid and toluene diisocyanate to prepare polyurethane prepolymer, realizes the modification of polyurethane by adopting a multiple modification method, then mixes polyurethane prepolymer, fluorine-containing acrylate/graphene dispersion liquid, ethylenediamine and triaminopropyl siloxane, combines fluorine-containing polymer with graphene in a covalent bond mode by utilizing active functional groups such as hydroxyl groups on the surface and the edge of the graphene under the action of a catalyst, improves the mechanical property, corrosion resistance, high-temperature aging resistance and the like of the coating, and has wide application value and prospect.

title_en: Carbon fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material preparation, and discloses a carbon fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the carbon fiber composite material comprises 15-40% of carbon fiber reinforced material, 50-75% of matrix material, 2-10% of interface reinforced layer, 1-5% of porous structure layer, 2-10% of metal or ceramic particles and 0.5-5% of conductive filler. According to the invention, by adopting the interface enhancement layer structure, the surface modified metal nano particles are introduced into the interface enhancement layer, and the improved carbon fiber composite material is remarkably improved in interface bonding performance. Therefore, the chemical bond combination between the resin matrix and the carbon fiber can be enhanced, the strength and the stability of the interface are improved, the risks of interfacial peeling and fracture are reduced, and the improved material can better absorb and disperse energy when impact or collision occurs by adopting a sandwich structure. The existence of the hollow area can provide the function of shock absorption and buffering, effectively reduce the influence of impact force on the material, and further improve the energy absorption performance of the composite material.

title_en: Preparation method of flame-retardant glass fiber reinforced modified polypropylene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polypropylene, and discloses a preparation method of flame-retardant glass fiber reinforced modified polypropylene, which utilizes an alkenyl-terminated hyperbranched flame retardant and KH570 modified glass fiber to carry out synergistic modification on polypropylene, and alkenyl contained in the alkenyl-terminated hyperbranched flame retardant and KH570 modified glass fiber is subjected to melt grafting with the polypropylene under the action of an initiator, so that the interfacial compatibility between the hyperbranched flame retardant, the glass fiber and the polypropylene is improved, and a three-dimensional hybrid crosslinking system is formed by crosslinking, so that the chemical crosslinking degree between the hyperbranched flame retardant and the polypropylene molecular chain is enhanced, the thermal decomposition temperature of the polypropylene is improved, and the flame-retardant glass fiber reinforced polypropylene has better heat resistance, flame retardant property, notch impact strength and mechanical property.

title_en: Matte high-stain-resistance hydrophobic polyacrylate emulsion coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a matte high-stain-resistance hydrophobic polyacrylate emulsion coating, and a preparation method and application thereof; the matte high-stain-resistance hydrophobic polyacrylate emulsion coating is obtained by coating polyacrylate core-shell emulsion on the surface of a substrate, heating and forming a film, wherein the film forming temperature is controlled to be lower than the glass transition temperature of a core layer polymer and higher than the glass transition temperature of a shell layer polymer, and the film forming temperature is controlled to be 0-5 ℃ higher or lower than the average value of the glass transition temperature of the core layer and the glass transition temperature of the shell layer; controlling the vitrification temperature of the core layer polymer to be 45-95 ℃ and the vitrification temperature of the shell layer polymer to be 10-60 ℃; the difference between the glass transition temperature of the core polymer and the glass transition temperature of the shell polymer are controlled to be 35-60 ℃. The coating has the hardness reaching 3H, can achieve matte, low VOC, high stain resistance, good water resistance and 0-level adhesive force, and is a matte high stain resistance hydrophobic polyacrylate emulsion coating.

title_en: Imidazole ionic liquid for mixing trans-butyl-pentyl rubber as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides imidazole ionic liquid for mixing trans-butyl-pentyl rubber, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the imidazole ionic liquid is named MI, and X in the chemical formula is at least one of Br, cl, I or F. The imidazole ionic liquid for mixing the trans-butyl-pentyl rubber is used for wet mixing and premixing of the trans-butyl-pentyl rubber. The invention creatively designs and synthesizes the imidazole ionic liquid MI which can be mutually dissolved with alkaline water, and MI shows good solubility to TBIR. After the TBIR is dissolved by MI, the mixture is added into a wet premixing system of natural latex and magnesium hydroxide with water as a solvent, so that the green wet premixing technology of TBIR (without organic solvent) is realized.

title_en: High-transparency mirror explosion-proof membrane and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer films, in particular to a high-transparency mirror explosion-proof film and a preparation process thereof, wherein polycarbonate is used as a base material to prepare the high-transparency mirror explosion-proof film, so that the prepared explosion-proof film has higher transparency and high strength; finally, the hydrogenated acrylic rosin (beta-acryloyloxyethyl) ester is introduced in the polymerization process of the acrylic ester, so that the tackifying component prepared from the acrylic ester can be improved, and the tackiness of the polycarbonate can be enhanced, so that the prepared high-transparency mirror explosion-proof film has better tackiness.

title_en: Environment-friendly protein film food packaging material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of food packaging materials, and provides an environment-friendly protein film food packaging material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the protein film food packaging material comprises the following components in parts by mass: 30-50 parts of soybean protein, 5-8 parts of gelatin, 3-7 parts of nano cellulose, 2-6 parts of nano alumina, 1-3 parts of nano zinc oxide, 6-8 parts of carbon nano tube, 2-4 parts of polycaprolactone, 2-5 parts of metal phthalocyanine-titanium dioxide composite material, 7-10 parts of polylactic acid, 1.2-2.8 parts of film forming agent and 0.5-1.6 parts of stabilizer; preferably, the metal phthalocyanine in the metal phthalocyanine-titanium dioxide composite material is one of tetraminophthalocyanine cobalt or tetraminophthalocyanine copper. The protein film food packaging material obtained by the scheme not only can be degraded, but also has better strength and light transmittance, in addition, the strength can be improved by the metal phthalocyanine-titanium dioxide, wherein the metal phthalocyanine can be used as a catalyst, and the degradation rate is accelerated during degradation.

title_en: Yellowing-resistant halogen-free flame-retardant reinforced PPA composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yellowing-resistant halogen-free flame-retardant reinforced PPA composite material which comprises, by mass, 50% -70% of high-temperature nylon PPA, 18% of hypophosphite halogen-free flame retardant, 18% -22% of glass fiber, 5% -15% of amorphous nylon PA6I, 0.2% -0.5% of lactone type main antioxidant, 0.2% -0.5% of auxiliary antioxidant, 0.3% -0.5% of lubricant, wherein the lactone type main antioxidant is benzofuranone, the auxiliary antioxidant is spirophosphite type auxiliary antioxidant, and the PA6I in the invention can damage the regularity of a high-temperature nylon PPA molecular chain, reduce the crystallinity and reduce the melt temperature, so as to avoid degradation of hypophosphite halogen-free flame retardant in the processing process, and the melting temperature of the PA6I is low, and can further improve the flowability and yellowing-resistant capability of the material, the adopted lactone type main antioxidant can effectively protect the color stability in the processing process of the material, the content of the adopted spirophosphite type antioxidant is high, hydrogen peroxide can be quenched in the autoxidation process of the material, and the yellowing or the problem of the composite material caused by oxidative degradation can be avoided.

title_en: Laser anti-counterfeiting coating, preparation method thereof and laser transfer film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of laser anti-counterfeiting coating, in particular to laser anti-counterfeiting coating, a preparation method thereof and a laser transfer film, which are prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of polyurethane acrylate resin, 10-20 parts of epoxy resin, 1-3 parts of amine compound, 1-3 parts of photoinitiator, 5-10 parts of rare earth strontium aluminate nano particles and 20-40 parts of reactive diluent, and the film layer formed by curing the laser anti-counterfeiting coating prepared by the invention has good mechanical properties, and compared with triethanolamine, ethylenediamine, diethylenetriamine and m-phenylenediamine, the amine compound has a faster curing speed, and has minimal influence on the performance of the film layer.

title_en: Preparation method of catalyst carrier for olefin polymerization, obtained catalyst carrier and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a catalyst carrier for olefin polymerization, the catalyst carrier and application thereof, wherein the method is characterized in that the catalyst carrier is mixed in a Y-shaped micro-channel and then enters a reaction kettle, the Y-shaped micro-channel comprises a first pipeline, a second pipeline and a third pipeline, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and emulsifying a compound shown in a formula (I), a magnesium-containing compound, an organic alcohol, an optional surfactant and an optional dispersing agent to obtain an emulsified mixture; the emulsified mixture is fed by a first pipeline, and alkylene oxide is fed by a second pipeline, wherein the emulsified mixture and the epoxy compound enter a third pipeline at the joint of the first pipeline and the second pipeline for mixing, so as to obtain a mixed material; the mixed material enters a reaction kettle to react, and the catalyst carrier for olefin polymerization is obtained. The carrier particles obtained by the method have good morphology, basically no special-shaped particles and proper carrier particle size.

title_en: Cleaning modifier for directionally adsorbing harmful gas, modified asphalt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning modifier for directionally adsorbing harmful gas, modified asphalt and a preparation method thereof, wherein the cleaning modifier comprises copper powder, poly (3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene) -poly (styrenesulfonic acid), methacryloyl chloride, polydivinylbenzene, an adsorption base material A and an adsorption base material B; the adsorption base material A is carbon black, biochar, activated carbon, mesoporous silica or zeolite; the adsorption base material B is fly ash or diatomite. The modified asphalt comprises road asphalt, a cleaning modifier, a dispersing agent and a coupling agent. The modified asphalt with the function of directionally adsorbing the road harmful gas can realize the efficient cleaning of the road automobile tail gas and the harmful smoke in the construction, transportation and maintenance stages of asphalt pavement, has the cleaning effect obviously improved compared with the existing single-adsorption and purification modified asphalt, and has important significance on reducing the energy consumption and relieving the pressure of the road service and ecological environment.

title_en: High-selectivity polymer material with adjustable repeating unit carbon skeleton structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A high-selectivity polymer material with an adjustable repeating unit carbon skeleton structure and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of functional polymer materials. The polymer with a high activity and multiple reaction sites is prepared from a polymer with a skeleton structure of C2 (the repeating unit in the main chain consists of 2 carbon atoms), C3 (the repeating unit in the main chain consists of 3 carbon atoms) and C4 (the repeating unit in the main chain consists of 4 carbon atoms) which have controllable molecular weight and narrow distribution through changing the polymerization conditions such as the system temperature, the polymerization concentration, the type and the dosage of a regulator, and the like, thereby realizing the regulation and control of the carbon skeleton structure of the polyolefin repeating unit, endowing the material with different properties and further meeting the application of the polyolefin material in different fields. The polymerization process is simple, the raw materials are easy to synthesize, and the preparation process has no pollution to the environment. The differences of the carbon skeleton structures lead to great differences of the physical properties of the corresponding polyolefin materials. The invention can regulate and control one monomer into three skeleton structures, thereby being applied to different fields.

title_en: Micro-nano basic magnesium carbonate flame retardant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flame retardants, and discloses a micro-nano basic magnesium carbonate flame retardant and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following specific steps: s1, firstly, selecting high-purity magnesium carbonate as a basic raw material, and treating the magnesium carbonate by a proper particle size distribution control method to ensure that the magnesium carbonate has better dispersion performance; s2, placing the treated magnesium carbonate into a reaction kettle, and then adding a proper amount of alkaline substances such as sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide for uniform mixing; and S3, adding clear water step by step in the stirring process to form uniform slurry, and controlling the viscosity of the slurry by adjusting the adding speed and the stirring speed of the water. According to the invention, the specific surface area of basic magnesium carbonate is increased, so that the basic magnesium carbonate has a better flame retardant effect, and the compatibility of micro-nano basic magnesium carbonate powder and a high polymer material is improved through surface modification, so that the basic magnesium carbonate has good dispersibility in the high polymer material.

title_en: Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene catalyst component, preparation method thereof and catalyst containing catalyst component
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene catalyst component, which is prepared by a method comprising the following steps: magnesium compound (alkyl magnesium and magnesium chloride) and fatty alcohol with C6-C12 are mixed and reacted to form magnesium compound solution, and then the magnesium compound solution and titanium compound are mixed and reacted to obtain the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene catalyst component. When the catalyst component of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene and the organic aluminum compound are matched with each other to prepare the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene in a catalytic manner, the polymerization kinetic curve is stable, the activity decay is slow, the catalyst still maintains high polymerization activity after 2 hours of polymerization in the polymerization process of 4 hours, and the content of fine powder and the bulk density of polymer powder are remarkably improved compared with the prior art. The catalyst is described as being useful for increasing the space-time yield of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene produced by a slurry process, particularly a batch slurry process polyethylene process.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant organic silicon gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-temperature-resistant organic silicon gel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the organic silicon gel comprises a component A and a component B, and the component A comprises 50-80 parts of vinyl-terminated silicone oil, 10-30 parts of hydrogen-terminated silicone oil, 0.1-5 parts of cross-linked hydrogen silicone oil and 0.001-0.03 part of inhibitor; the component B comprises 98 to 99.5 parts of vinyl-terminated silicone oil, 0.5 to 2 parts of Wen Chuji resistant and 0.01 to 0.02 part of catalyst A; the structural formula of the temperature-resistant auxiliary agent is Ce a (O(Me 2 SiO) x （MePhSiO） y ) b (O(Me 2 SiO) x （MePhSiOH） y ) c ., cerium ions contained in the temperature-resistant auxiliary agent have strong coordination capability, can react with free radicals generated in the oxidative decomposition process and free radical intermediates to form a complex to terminate the free radicals, and the contained benzene ring can inhibit the movement of molecular chains of the organic silicon gel at high temperature and reduce the generation of the free radicals.

title_en: Sensing film based on phase separation water storage structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a sensing film based on a phase separation water storage structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The sensing film comprises a hydrophobic polymer, a pH indicator, an amphiphilic surfactant and an organic acid; the hydrophobic end of the amphiphilic surfactant is connected with the hydrophobic polymer, and the hydrophilic end of the amphiphilic surfactant is polymerized inwards to form a microcapsule; the pH indicator and the inorganic acid are embedded in the microcapsule; the organic acid is at least one selected from citric acid, tartaric acid, oxalic acid, tricarballylic acid and p-toluenesulfonic acid. According to the application, a hydrophobic working layer and a hydrophilic water storage layer are formed based on phase separation, so that the water molecule exchange channels inside and outside the traditional ammonia gas sensing film based on the pH indicator are cut off, and the dryness of humidity on the sensing film is inhibited; the organic acid is embedded in the microcapsule formed by hydrophilic end polymerization of the water storage layer, so that the service life of the pH indicator is prolonged.

title_en: Sterilization composition particle medical fertilizer containing thifluzamide and azoxystrobin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bactericidal composition particle medical fertilizer containing thifluzamide and azoxystrobin and a preparation method thereof, wherein the medical fertilizer is prepared from an active bactericidal component, a carrier containing the active bactericidal component, an auxiliary agent and a fertilizer; the active bactericidal component comprises thifluzamide and azoxystrobin, the mass ratio of the thifluzamide to the azoxystrobin is 20-1:1-20, the carrier consists of a separation membrane and a water-soluble carrier, and the molecular weight cut-off of the separation membrane is 400-450Da. The invention has the advantages that the carrier is adopted to be respectively mixed with the thifluzamide and the azoxystrobin, so that the stability and the biological activity of the thifluzamide and the azoxystrobin can be obviously improved, the harm to crops caused by direct mixing of the thifluzamide and the azoxystrobin is reduced, the disease control effect of the crops is ensured, the fertilization process is finished, the time and the labor are saved, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of ethylene-chlorotrifluoroethylene copolymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ethylene-chlorotrifluoroethylene copolymer, which comprises the steps of carrying out emulsion polymerization reaction on chlorotrifluoroethylene and ethylene under a supercritical state in the presence of an initiator and a compound emulsifier to prepare the ethylene-chlorotrifluoroethylene copolymer, wherein the initiator is an organic peroxide with a decomposition half-life t  1/2  of 1h at 90-150 ℃, the compound emulsifier is a mixture of a non-fluoride anion emulsifier and a non-fluoride macromolecule emulsifier, before the initiator is added into a reaction system, adding a first mixed gas with a molar ratio of chlorotrifluoroethylene to ethylene of 1:1-6:1 into the reaction system, stopping adding until the pressure of the reaction system reaches 3-12 MPa, maintaining the temperature and the pressure of the reaction system unchanged after the initiator is added into the reaction system, continuously adding a second mixed gas with a molar ratio of chlorotrifluoroethylene to ethylene of 0.5:1-2:1 into the reaction system for 1.5-2.5 h, and continuously adding the mixed gas with a molar ratio of chlorotrifluoroethylene to ethylene of 1:1-6:1 into the reaction system until the polymerization reaction system is finished. The preparation method has the advantages of high polymerization reaction rate, stable end group, high structural regularity and excellent heat-resistant yellowing resistance of the obtained ethylene-chlorotrifluoroethylene copolymer.

title_en: Synthesis method of fluorine-containing and quaternary amine acrylate functional monomer grafted composite biomass derivative
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of a fluorine-containing and quaternary amine acrylate functional monomer grafted composite biomass derivative. Firstly, taking bagasse xylan/resveratrol compound as a raw material, selecting a fluorine-containing monomer, namely trifluoroethyl methacrylate, a quaternary amine acrylic ester active monomer, namely dimethylaminoethyl acrylate, and a water-soluble monomer, namely 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, which are emulsified by sucrose fatty acid ester, and taking ammonium persulfate and sodium bisulfate as initiators, and synthesizing a fluorine-containing and quaternary amine acrylic ester functional monomer grafted compound biomass derivative with anticancer double activity through free radical graft copolymerization and crosslinking of crosslinking monomers, namely N, N-methylene bisacrylamide. Meanwhile, the inhibition rates of the product obtained by measuring with a thiazolyl blue tetrazolium bromide (MTT) method on human liver cancer cells and human gastric cancer cells are 39.52% and 33.97% respectively when the mass concentration is 100 mug/mL, and obviously, the inhibition effect of the product on liver cancer cells is more obvious.

title_en: Polyimide powder for battery pack liquid cooling plate, coating and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyimide powder for a battery pack liquid cooling plate, a coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyimide powder comprises the following steps: adding an aromatic diamine tetraacid monomer into an aprotic solvent for dissolution, adding an aromatic dianhydride monomer, and performing polycondensation reaction at the temperature of below 80 ℃ to prepare a polyamic acid solution; adding a chemical imidizing reagent into a polyamic acid solution to perform imidization treatment, so as to prepare polyimide resin; pouring polyimide resin into a detergent for precipitation, drying and crushing to prepare polyimide powder; and then spraying polyimide powder onto the metal substrate, and curing and forming to prepare the polyimide coating. The invention realizes the preparation of the liquid cooling plate glue-free polyimide coating and the low-temperature processability through the adjustment of the monomer structure, and can also realize the preparation of the liquid cooling plate coating with high thickness, the special-shaped plate and no solvent by adopting an electrostatic powder spraying mode.

title_en: Preparation process of lignin adhesive for ENF-grade impregnated bond paper veneer plywood base material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lignin adhesive for a plywood substrate. The preparation process of the lignin adhesive for the ENF grade impregnated bond paper veneer plywood substrate comprises the following steps: extracting lignin, purifying, steaming at high temperature, vacuum drying, filtering, cooling and the like. The lignin adhesive is creatively prepared by combining a high-temperature hot-pressing method, a concentrated sulfuric acid curing method, an ultrafiltration method and the like, has the advantages of being green, simple in process, excellent in performance and low in cost, and can form a physical and chemical gluing effect on a plate interface, so that the efficient preparation of green low-carbon wood products is realized, and the lignin adhesive is widely applied to the fields of construction, home furnishing, decoration, packaging and the like.

title_en: Multilayer stretched film and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multilayer stretched film comprising a stretched layer (L2) and at least one stretched layer (L1), wherein the stretched layer (L1) is provided on the outermost side of the multilayer stretched film and comprises a thermoplastic resin (P1), wherein the thermoplastic resin (P1) comprises fine particles, wherein the stretched layer (L2) comprises a thermoplastic resin (P2), wherein the thermoplastic resin (P2) comprises an alicyclic structure-containing polymer, and wherein the thermoplastic resin (P1) and the thermoplastic resin (P2) satisfy the formula (1): tg2-Tg1>0 ℃, where Tg1 represents the glass transition temperature of the thermoplastic resin (P1), and Tg2 represents the glass transition temperature of the thermoplastic resin (P2).

title_en: Biocompatible and biostable polydimethylsiloxane polyurethane urea with chain extension of urea-based chain extender, preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biocompatible and biostable polydimethylsiloxane polyurethane urea with chain extension of a urea-based chain extender, and preparation and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biomedical materials. The solubilizing and blending soft segment is composed of the polyatomic alcohol and the modified polydimethylsiloxane, and the aromatic diisocyanate and the ureido chain extender are used as hard segment components, so that the thermodynamic compatibility of the soft segment and the hard segment is increased, the phase separation of materials is improved, ureido is directly introduced through the ureido chain extender and is introduced through the reaction of the double-end amino polydimethylsiloxane and isocyanate groups, multiple hydrogen bonding is generated between the molecular chains, and the mechanical properties of the materials, especially the tear resistance, creep resistance, repeated puncture resistance and the like, are further improved, and the materials can be healed rapidly. The polyurethane urea copolymer is biocompatible and biostable, and is suitable for being used as artificial blood vessels with various calibers, coronary stent coatings, artificial heart valves and the like which are implanted for a long time.

title_en: Hydrophobic oleophylic self-repairing polyurethane foam material for marine antifouling and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophobic and oleophylic self-repairing polyurethane foam material for marine antifouling, which is prepared by uniformly stirring polyether polyol, polyester polyol, deionized water, a tin catalyst, an amine catalyst and a foam stabilizer; dropping self-repairing monomer into isocyanate and organic solvent under heating and stirring to obtain prepolymer, and removing solvent under vacuum to obtain foam B material; dissolving a hydrophobic auxiliary agent in an organic solvent, and uniformly mixing to obtain foam C material; adding the foam B material into the foam A material to obtain uncured polyurethane foam; curing the uncured polyurethane foam to obtain a polyurethane foam material with a self-repairing function, immersing the polyurethane foam material into foam C to obtain the hydrophobic oleophylic self-repairing polyurethane foam material for marine antifouling, wherein the self-repairing effect of the matrix can be achieved through covalent bond recombination under high-temperature induction, the self-repairing efficiency is 65.8%, and the weather resistance of the polyurethane foam is effectively improved.

title_en: Polyamic acid resin and preparation method thereof, polyimide elastomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides half/full aliphatic branched polyamide acid resin, which adopts macromolecular flexible polyamine and dianhydride as raw materials, and through the collocation of polyfunctional amine monomers and multicomponent amine monomers and the control of the synthesis of the components of the raw materials, the polyamide acid resin has good solubility, processability and mechanical properties, and can overcome the defects of deep color of aromatic polyimide caused by the formation of intramolecular and intermolecular charge transfer complexes; the polyamide acid resin can be used for preparing polyimide elastomer materials with good mechanical properties and elastic deformation capability, and the synthesized polyimide elastomer materials have wide application scenes.

title_en: Biodegradable carbon quantum dot/waterborne polyurethane composite coating as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a biodegradable carbon quantum dot/water-based polyurethane composite coating, a preparation method and application thereof, which belong to the technical field of polymer material preparation, wherein the preparation method is simple, and the biodegradable carbon quantum dot/water-based polyurethane composite coating is prepared based on a biological-based chain extender, carboxylic acid modified polyether polyol and castor oil, has a solid content of 40-45% and an average particle diameter of <100nm, has a tensile strength of 60-65 MPa and an elongation at break of 800-912%, and is well applied to environment-friendly leather finishing agents.

title_en: Aliphatic water reducer
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified aliphatic water reducer, which comprises a water reducer A and a water reducer B, wherein the water reducer A is an aliphatic water reducer, the water reducer B is polyamino acid grafted lignosulfonate, and diphenyl Methane Diisocyanate (MDI) is used as a cross-linking agent for the water reducer B; the water reducer B is used for modifying the water reducer A, SO that a large amount of amino (-NH  2 ), sulfonic (-SO  3  H), hydroxyl (-OH) and carboxyl (-COOH) hydrophilic groups exist in molecules, the hydrophilicity of the water reducer A is obviously improved, the molecular weight of the water reducer is increased, the molecular polarity and the steric hindrance effect of the water reducer A are enhanced, cement particles are effectively dispersed, aggregation among the cement particles is reduced, the dispersibility of the modified aliphatic water reducer is good, the fluidity of concrete in a concrete test reaches 293mm, the fluidity loss of 1 hour is only 2mm, and meanwhile, the water reducer is easy to biodegrade and is green and environment-friendly. The invention also provides a preparation method of the composite.

title_en: Organometallic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic metal catalyst which has a structure shown in a formula I, wherein M is a divalent metal ion; r  1  is a linear or branched alkyl group; r  2  is a linear or branched alkyl group, n=0, 1, 2 or 3; x is selected from N, O, S, P, when X is selected from N or P, X and R  1  are connected through a covalent bond, and when X is selected from O or S, no connection relationship exists between X and R  1 ; y is selected from halogen, unsubstituted or substituted alkoxy, unsubstituted or substituted phenol, substituted amino, unsubstituted or substituted straight chain alkyl; "substituted" means that at least one H in the substituted group is replaced by trimethylsilyl;  representing a domain-separated key; and represents a coordination bond. The organometallic catalyst can realize the efficient ring-opening polymerization of the dioxanone under the condition of not adding an alcohol initiator to obtain the polydioxanone with the weight average molecular weight of 80 ten thousand; and the preparation method is nontoxic, good in biocompatibility and environment-friendly.

title_en: Rubber resistant to wet heat aging and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rubber resistant to wet heat aging and a preparation method thereof, which belongs to the technical field of rubber material preparation, and the invention is characterized in that a carbon raw material is subjected to heat treatment and then is put into hydrogen peroxide solution for oxidation, introducing oxygen-containing functional groups on the surface of the carbon, and then carboxylating the functional groups on the surface of graphene oxide by using chloroacetic acid and sodium hydroxide treatment to prepare carboxylated biochar. Mixing crop straws and carboxylated biochar, then modifying the prepared mixed system by using dopamine hydrochloride, adding reinforcing materials comprising sepiolite and aromatic ring-containing antioxidants into the system, and carrying out beating treatment and electrolytic treatment to prepare the rubber anti-aging agent; and then epoxidizing the natural rubber, adding a rubber anti-aging agent, and mixing to prepare the damp-heat aging resistant rubber material. The prepared rubber material has the characteristics of good mechanical property, aging resistance and durability.

title_en: Low-temperature curing thin-coating powder coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-temperature curing thin-coating powder coating and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of coating preparation. According to the application, the branching degree and the carboxyl activity of the end part of the resin are effectively improved by optimizing the preparation raw materials and the preparation raw material proportion of the resin, the curing temperature of the powder coating is reduced while the reactivity of the resin is ensured, excellent weather resistance and mechanical properties can be obtained, and the catalyst and the antioxidant are added in the preparation stage of the resin, so that the storage stability is improved, the problem of uneven dispersion of the powder coating can be solved as a whole, and the glossiness and the performance of the coating are improved.

title_en: Method for repairing road under complex conditions such as wading and the like under magnetic field effect
abstract_en: A method for repairing roads under complex conditions such as wading and the like under the action of a magnetic field comprises the following steps: 1. preparing a material; 2. determining the proportion of the magnetic slurry composition materials; 3. preparing for pavement repair and determining a repair scheme; 4. preparing a lattice magnet; 5. preparing magnetic slurry; 6. according to the determined repairing scheme, road construction repairing is carried out; the invention provides a novel road repairing technology, which utilizes a mode of combining magnetic slurry and dot matrix magnets to quickly and accurately repair a road.

title_en: Application of molecular imprinting nano-channel membrane in selective detection of Dimethoate
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a molecular imprinting nano-channel membrane in selective recognition of Dimethoate molecules; the molecular imprinting nano-channel membrane is obtained by firstly synthesizing a molecular imprinting polymer with a Dimethoate molecular imprinting cavity and then uniformly loading the molecular imprinting polymer on an AAO substrate by utilizing a super-assembly technology. According to the invention, the molecular imprinting nano-channel membrane is used as an ion selective membrane to construct a nano-fluid device comprising two semi-conductive pools, and the identification and detection of Dimethoate are realized by testing the I-V change condition of the electrolyte solution after the solution to be detected is added. The method is simple to operate, high in sensitivity and has considerable application prospect in the field of intelligent ion transmission.

title_en: Water-dilutable fluid-resistant coating with low VOC content
abstract_en: Disclosed are water-dilutable coatings having low volatile organic content and are resistant to aerospace solvents. The coating includes an epoxy component and an amine component. The epoxy resin component includes a difunctional polyepoxide resin, a polyfunctional aliphatic polyepoxide resin, and a polyacetoacetate resin. The amine component includes a polyepoxy-polyamine adduct and a methylene bridged poly (cyclohexyl-aromatic) amine.

title_en: Method for recycling carbon fiber reinforced resin matrix composite
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon fiber composite material recovery and regeneration, in particular to a method for recovering a carbon fiber reinforced resin matrix composite material, which comprises the following steps: pretreatment, size reduction, pyrolysis treatment, chemical treatment, ultrasonic cleaning, mechanical wiredrawing and finishing, surface treatment, drying and classification, and composite material preparation. According to the invention, non-CFRP materials and surface impurities can be effectively removed through pretreatment and classification, so that the purity and quality of the recycled materials are improved. The pyrolysis process and the application of chemical solvents enable the resin matrix to be removed more thoroughly, and the carbon fibers to be released more cleanly. The ultrasonic cleaning technology is excellent in removing fine residues, and further ensures the purity of the carbon fiber. The mechanical wiredrawing and surface modification technology not only recovers the strength of the carbon fiber, but also improves the binding force of the carbon fiber with a new resin matrix. Through accurate drying and classification processes, the quality and uniformity of the carbon fiber are ensured, and a solid foundation is provided for the preparation of high-quality composite materials.

title_en: Antibacterial fluororubber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fluororubber materials, in particular to an antibacterial fluororubber composite material and a preparation method thereof.
