The antibacterial fluororubber composite material comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by mass: 70-75 parts of fluororubber, 5-7 parts of epoxy resin E-51, 5-7 parts of plasticizer, 3-5 parts of coupling agent, 30-35 parts of heat conducting filler, 5-8 parts of zinc oxide, 2-4 parts of zinc stearate, 1-1.5 parts of anti-aging agent, 1-1.5 parts of accelerator, 1-2 parts of vulcanizing agent and 2-3 parts of composite antibacterial agent, wherein the composite antibacterial agent consists of maleic anhydride acylated chitosan and silver-copper-zinc doped titanium dioxide in a mass ratio of 5-7:1. The antibacterial fluororubber composite material has excellent mechanical property, good heat conduction property, excellent antibacterial property and good hydrophilicity, is simple in preparation process, high in vulcanization speed, energy-saving and environment-friendly, and is very suitable for market demands in the field of wearable equipment.

title_en: Radiation-sensitive composition comprising a combination of metals or metalloid compounds
abstract_en: The present invention provides radiation-sensitive compositions and substrates coated with radiation-sensitive compositions, wherein the compositions comprise a combination of a metal compound and/or metalloid compound, a functionalized or unfunctionalized acetylenic compound, and other optional ingredients such as a modifying agent. The invention also provides a radiation-sensitive device for detecting or measuring radiation comprising a substrate coated with these radiation-sensitive compositions. The radiation-sensitive compositions and devices find application in dentistry, non-destructive testing, oncology, radiology, radiation therapy, and the like.

title_en: Base film for high-temperature-resistant and aging-resistant composite current collector and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The scheme relates to a high temperature resistant aging resistant base film for a composite current collector and a preparation method thereof, wherein terephthalic acid, calcium dihydroxybenzene sulfonate and butanediol are used as raw materials, an intermediate product is prepared through esterification reaction and polycondensation reaction, and then modified grafted PET is obtained by irradiating grafted polyglycidyl methacrylate on the surface of the intermediate product; and (3) after the PEN resin reacts with hexamethylenediamine, feeding the mixture into a mixing bin together with PET resin, modified grafted PET, an antioxidant and a lubricant, mixing to prepare a mixture, and carrying out extrusion molding, biaxial stretching, traction and rolling to obtain the PET (polyethylene terephthalate) composite material. The invention takes a low-cost PET resin material as a base material, combines self-made modified PET and PEN at the same time, and prepares the high-temperature resistant PET film in the presence of a trace of auxiliary agent; the film is not easy to deform when the composite current collector is prepared, has low reject ratio, and can meet the special requirements of the composite current collector industry on the base film.

title_en: Lightweight composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight composite material and a preparation method thereof, and the lightweight composite material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of polypropylene, 18-26 parts of styrene-butadiene-acrylonitrile polymer, 6-12 parts of ethylene-octene copolymer, 20-35 parts of reinforcing modified material, 1.3-2.1 parts of lubricant, 0.2-0.6 part of antioxidant and 0.5-1.5 parts of light stabilizer. The invention prepares a lightweight composite material, adopts a mixture of polypropylene, ABS and POE as a main raw material, adds modified ettringite as a reinforcing and modifying material, and adds a small amount of auxiliary agents, and finally the prepared product has the advantages of light weight, high strength, strong toughness and scratch resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of novel high-foaming expansion sheet for vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of expansion sheet preparation, in particular to a preparation method of a novel high-foaming vehicular expansion sheet. The method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing an ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, azodicarbonamide, zinc stearate, polyethylene wax and an antioxidant, and then mixing and slicing to obtain foaming master batches; uniformly mixing the foaming master batch, low-density polyethylene, ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer and dicumyl peroxide to obtain injection molding raw materials; adding injection molding raw materials into a hopper of an injection molding machine, acquiring a melt defect evaluation index of each pixel point through a temperature monitoring window in each expansion sheet image in two sections, and then clustering to construct a raw material defect run matrix to acquire a melt defect perception index; obtaining the optimal two-stage temperature based on melt defect perception indexes at different time points; and (5) performing temperature adjustment according to the optimal two-stage temperature to finish the preparation of the high-foaming vehicle expansion sheet. The application obtains the high foaming vehicle expansion sheet with fewer defects.

title_en: Polymer, insulin composition containing same and application of polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymer, an insulin composition containing the same and application thereof. The polymer provided by the invention consists of a structural unit I, a structural unit II and a structural unit III. The insulin composition prepared by taking the polymer as a drug carrier has one or more of the advantages of good stability, easy control of injection metering, high drug loading, long in-vivo residence time of insulin, easy in-vivo metabolic clearance of the carrier and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of biomass flame-retardant transparent hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass material preparation, in particular to the technical field of silane solution modification and the technical field of flame-retardant hydrogel preparation. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of poor transparency, low mechanical property, complex method and high cost and environmental pollution of the existing flame-retardant hydrogel. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a silane solution; preparing an aqueous solution of phytic acid; preparing a phytic acid modified silane hydrolysis solution; hydrogels were prepared. The preparation method is simple, only needs to combine the modified phytic acid silane solution with the acrylamide, avoids complex synthesis steps and expensive raw materials in the prior art, reduces the production cost and has wider application prospect. The method is used for preparing the biomass flame-retardant transparent hydrogel.

title_en: Micro-nano composite polymer microsphere plugging agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-nano composite polymer microsphere plugging agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a copolymerization monomer, a cross-linking agent and nano lignin with water to obtain a first mixed solution; mixing a surfactant with an oil phase solvent to obtain a second mixed solution; mixing the second mixed solution with the first mixed solution to obtain a third mixed solution; and adding an initiator into the third mixed solution, and then carrying out polymerization reaction to obtain the micro-nano composite polymer microsphere plugging agent. The micro-nano composite polymer microsphere plugging prepared by the invention has good temperature resistance and plugging performance, is suitable for plugging operation of oil-based drilling fluid while drilling, and can improve the plugging effect on stratum pores and cracks.

title_en: Paper-plastic composite aqueous adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paper-plastic composite water-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of adhesives, and comprising the following components in parts by weight: 65-70 parts of deionized water, 82-89 parts of monomer mixture, 3-4 parts of modified monomer, 3 parts of emulsifier, 0.6-0.8 part of initiator, 2-3 parts of tackifying resin, 0.8-1 part of ammonia water and 0.12-0.15 part of defoamer; the monomer mixture includes 60% -80% of one or more of the soft component monomers, 20% -40% of one or more of the hard component monomers, and 3% -6% of one or more of the functional monomers. The invention provides a paper-plastic composite water-based adhesive, which is prepared by adjusting the proportion of monomers and using modified monomers and tackifying resin.

title_en: Photo-curing 3D printing material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photo-curing 3D printing material and a preparation method thereof. The material is prepared from a photo-curing oligomer, a reactive diluent, a photoinitiator and an auxiliary agent. The photocuring oligomer is blocked by a long chain structure, and the prepared photocuring 3D printing material has the characteristics of low viscosity, good flexibility, high curing speed, high molding precision and good surface curing effect, and is suitable for a photocuring 3D printer.

title_en: Modified carbon black, modified asphalt containing modified carbon black and preparation method of modified asphalt
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of asphalt materials, in particular to modified carbon black, modified asphalt containing the modified carbon black and a preparation method thereof. The modified asphalt containing the modified carbon black comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 80-120 parts of matrix asphalt, 15-20 parts of high polymer resin, 1-5 parts of compatilizer, 0.1-1 part of stabilizer, 20-25 parts of modified carbon black, 1-3 parts of viscosity modifier and 5-15 parts of auxiliary agent. The modified asphalt containing the modified carbon black prepared by the application can maintain good weather resistance, water resistance and heat stability performance while having excellent mechanical and mechanical properties, and particularly has better performance and service life when used in long-term humid and sultry environments.

title_en: Composite material based on polydicyclopentadiene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polydicyclopentadiene-based composite material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite material preparation, and comprising reinforced fibers and dicyclopentadiene modified polymers, wherein the reinforced fibers are natural fibers with the surfaces modified by metal ions, and the dicyclopentadiene modified polymers are copolymerization products of dicyclopentadiene monomers and 4' - (4-methacryloxyphenyl) -2,2':6',2' ' -terpyridine monomers; according to the invention, 4'- (4-methacryloxyphenyl) -2,2':6',2' -terpyridine is taken as a modified monomer to prepare the dicyclopentadiene modified polymer, a multi-bipyridine group is introduced into a side chain through the modification of a composite monomer, a metal coordination supermolecular structure can be formed with metal ions on the surface of a fiber, the wetting compatibility between the fiber and a resin melt is remarkably improved, the interface combination is greatly improved, and the mechanical strength is further improved.

title_en: Plate transfer film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a plate transfer film, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of preparation of transfer films for plates. The plate transfer film sequentially comprises an upper surface layer, a core layer and a lower surface layer from top to bottom; the upper surface layer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 89-91 parts of polypropylene, 1.1-6.3 parts of antistatic agent and 0.2-0.5 part of slipping agent; the core layer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 40-70 parts of high-density polyethylene, 2-15 parts of matting agent, 1-3 parts of dispersing agent and 0.1-1.0 part of antioxidant; the lower surface layer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 95-97 parts of polypropylene and 3.0-5.0 parts of polymethacrylate. And (3) attaching the plate transfer film to a PETG plate at 175-185 ℃ to prepare the PETG plate, wherein the glossiness value of the PETG plate is 35-42%.

title_en: Preparation method of cellulose nanocrystals with high thermal stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-thermal-stability nanocellulose at low cost, and belongs to the technical field of natural polymers. The method comprises the following steps: grinding the bleached cellulose pulp board into flocculent, then carrying out catalytic hydrolysis in citric acid mixed acid, quenching reaction, standing to separate out citric acid waste liquid, recycling citric acid for recycling, carrying out sufficient centrifugal washing on precipitate, collecting supernatant as prepared nano cellulose crystal dilute solution, and further improving concentration for preservation through rotary evaporation. The method greatly reduces the consumption of inorganic strong acid, reduces the risk of equipment corrosion, can recycle citric acid, and greatly reduces the cost for preparing the nano cellulose crystal. The prepared nano cellulose crystal has uniform and stable size, has higher thermal stability than the nano cellulose crystal prepared by a sulfuric acid method, provides a low-cost scheme for industrial preparation of the nano cellulose crystal, and greatly widens the application range of the nano cellulose crystal.

title_en: Preparation method of crystalline polar covalent triazine framework material and photo-thermal coupling catalytic application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalysts, and provides a preparation method of a novel crystalline D-A junction covalent triazine frame material and an anchored metal nanoparticle with a surface plasma effect and a gas-solid phase photo-thermal catalysis application thereof. The preparation method mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a covalent triazine frame ultrathin nanosheet SCTF containing a bithiophene building block and a covalent triazine frame ultrathin nanosheet CCTF containing a biphenyl building block by adopting NaCl as a template through an amidino polycondensation method; secondly, carrying out Pd and Au bimetallic nanoparticle loading on the SCTF and the CCTF to obtain covalent triazine organic framework materials SCTF-Pd  X Au 10‑X  and CCTF-Pd  X Au 10‑X  (X=10, 7, 5 and 0). According to the crystalline D-A junction covalent triazine frame material SCTF, an effective D-A structure can be formed by introducing a bithiophene building block and CCTF and a triazine ring by introducing a biphenyl building block, the light capturing capacity of the SCTF and the CCTF and the electron concentration of a triazine nitrogen site are increased, the interaction of a metal carrier is further increased, and the yield of the material for preparing hydrogen by photo-thermal catalysis of pure formic acid is further improved through the LSPR effect of metal nano particles and a designed gas-solid phase catalytic system.

title_en: Bio-based crosslinked polyamide capable of being repeatedly processed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bio-based cross-linked polyamide capable of being repeatedly processed and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high molecular polymers. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages that the linear diamine and the benzaldehyde are subjected to the prepolymerization reaction to obtain the prepolymer with the end capped by the amino group, and then the prepolymer is subjected to the polymerization reaction with the trimethyl citrate, so that the reaction is fully completed, the imine bond is introduced into the polymer, the crosslinked polyamide has the reworkability, the self-repairing property and the degradability, the method is simple to operate, the organic solvent and the catalyst with higher toxicity are not required to be added, and the process cost is low and the environment is protected. The results of the examples show that the polyamide prepared by the invention has tensile strength of >18MPa, elongation at break of >10%, melting temperature of >98.6 ℃, 20 ℃ and glass transition temperature of <60 ℃, thermal decomposition 5% temperature of >260 ℃ and retention rate of repeated processing mechanical properties of >85%.

title_en: Heat preservation board with high compression resistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat insulation materials, and provides a heat insulation board with high compression resistance, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of polystyrene resin, 3-6 parts of expandable graphite, 5-10 parts of ore powder, 8-10 parts of flame retardant, 4-6 parts of compatilizer and 5-10 parts of foaming agent; the compatilizer consists of 2, 5-bis [ (acetoacetyl) amino ] benzenesulfonic acid and hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the polystyrene insulation board in the prior art is low in flame retardance and compressive strength is solved.

title_en: Low-total-chlorine high-purity epoxy resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to low-total-chlorine high-purity epoxy resin and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing polytrimethylene ether glycol with epichlorohydrin, adding sodium hydroxide powder, reacting to obtain crude polytrimethylene ether glycol epoxy resin, dissolving the crude polytrimethylene ether glycol epoxy resin with dimethylbenzene, adding porous nano calcium carbonate suspension, reacting to obtain a mixture, adding phosphoric acid solution into the mixture, separating a resin layer from a water layer to obtain the resin layer, and finally, carrying out reduced pressure distillation on the resin layer to remove a solvent to obtain the polytrimethylene ether glycol epoxy resin. The polytrimethylene ether glycol epoxy resin prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention has lower total chlorine content, and meanwhile, the epoxy value, viscosity and yield of the epoxy resin are kept stable.

title_en: Graphene-epoxy resin emulsion and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-epoxy resin emulsion and application thereof, wherein the graphene-epoxy resin emulsion comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 20 to 35 percent of bisphenol A type epoxy resin solution, 1 to 3 percent of propylene glycol methyl ether, 5 to 10 percent of polyethylene glycol (molecular weight 6000g/mol, PEG 6000), 30 to 40 percent of isobutanol, 10 to 15 percent of 1, 4-butanediol, 5 to 10 percent of graphene and 3 to 7 percent of emulsifier. Compared with the conventional epoxy emulsion, the graphene-bisphenol A epoxy resin emulsion prepared by the method has better stability, can improve the anti-corrosion performance of the coating, effectively reduces the use of heavy fillers in the coating, and obviously improves the flexibility, impact resistance, water resistance, salt spray resistance and acid-base resistance of the coating.

title_en: Antibacterial degradable high polymer material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of starch-based materials, and particularly discloses an antibacterial degradable high polymer material and a preparation method thereof. The invention firstly prepares the amino starch by the reaction of starch and N, N-diethyl-3-aminopropyl triethoxy silane, prepares the benzimidazole cross-linking agent by the reaction of phenylenediamine and dicyandiamide in 4-chloro-1, 2-phenylenediamine, and the benzimidazole cross-linking agent reacts with the amino starch to form a quaternary amine structure, so that a cross-linked network is formed between starch molecular chains, the problem of poor compatibility of an antibacterial agent and starch is solved, the mechanical property of the material is improved, the starch has stronger antibacterial effect, a new idea is provided for the modification of starch-based materials, and the application range of the starch-based materials is enlarged.

title_en: Ion-specific high-cell-density microcarrier, biological artificial liver system, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ion-specific high-cell-density microcarrier, a bioartificial liver system, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein protein particle microcarriers are generated through shearing action between a water phase and an oil phase, the water phase comprises ion and photo-curing protein hydrogel, and the oil phase comprises high-viscosity oil; recrystallizing the protein particles by adopting a quenching-annealing method; the polymer structure network generated in the recrystallization process is reserved through freeze drying, a bionic ecological niche pore structure is formed, and the ion-specific high-cell-density microcarrier is obtained. The invention combines the protein-based hydrogel with the Hofmeister effect through the microfluidic technology to prepare the in-vitro bionic liver microcarrier with high liver cell density microcarrier, and liver cells can be greatly proliferated on the microcarrier and express normal metabolites, so that the invention can be used for preparing a bioartificial liver system for treating acute liver failure.

title_en: Piezoelectric hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a piezoelectric hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the field of hydrogel materials and comprise the following components: dissolving a matrix material with mechanical properties and biocompatibility and a doping material with mechanical properties and biocompatibility in water to form a first mixed solution; dissolving an initiator and a cross-linking agent in water to form a second mixed solution; uniformly mixing the first mixed solution and the second mixed solution, then placing the mixed solution in a gel mold, reacting, and collecting gel; the gel is soaked in the piezoelectric material water solution, and the piezoelectric hydrogel is collected. According to the preparation method provided by the embodiment of the application, the mechanical property of the hydrogel can be obviously improved by doping the material with the other mechanical property and biocompatibility on the basis of the matrix material with certain strength, the hydrogel can have a certain piezoelectric effect after being soaked in the aqueous solution of the piezoelectric material, namely the hydrogel can be compressed and deformed to detect the generation of voltage and current, the hydrogel can generate voltage and current and has certain biocompatibility, and the hydrogel can be used as a wound dressing patch of human skin, so that the good biocompatible gel patch can not be repelled by a wound, and the piezoelectric gel patch can continuously generate current along with the movement of a human body to stimulate wound cell proliferation, accelerate the healing of wound tissues, and is hopeful to be used in biomedicine.

title_en: Photo-curing 3D printing resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a photo-curing 3D printing resin, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photo-curing 3D printing resin comprises the following components: the silane coupling agent modified superfine silica micropowder, photosensitive resin, wetting dispersant and anti-settling auxiliary agent, wherein the silane coupling agent modified superfine silica micropowder accounts for 40-70wt% of the photosensitive resin. After 3D printing, the photo-cured 3D printing resin is subjected to secondary curing treatment under certain conditions, so that the thermal deformation temperature of the obtained 3D printing product exceeds 250 ℃, the photo-cured 3D printing resin can be used in a high-temperature environment, and the mechanical property of the 3D printing product is excellent. In addition, the photo-curing 3D printing resin has lower viscosity, can be printed normally by a conventional LCD 3D printer, does not generate sedimentation, and has good storage performance.

title_en: Halogen-free low-expansion epoxy resin for copper-clad plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses halogen-free low-expansion epoxy resin for a copper-clad plate and a preparation method thereof. When the invention is used in a copper-clad plate, the high temperature resistance of the prepreg in the copper-clad plate can be effectively improved, the flame retardant property of the prepreg in the copper-clad plate can be effectively ensured, the thermal weight loss temperature of the prepreg in the copper-clad plate can be effectively improved, the thermal weight loss is smaller under the same temperature condition, and the safety performance of the copper-clad plate can be effectively improved; the silane coupling agent KH550 can carry out silanization treatment on the epoxy resin, and then the modification treatment on the epoxy resin is realized through the physical copolymerization of the organic silicon resin and the silanized epoxy resin, so that the heat resistance, the adhesive force and the corrosion resistance of the epoxy resin can be effectively improved; the composite filler is doped into the epoxy resin for supplementary treatment, so that the heat resistance and the thermal weight loss temperature of the epoxy resin material can be further improved.

title_en: Application of acrylic acid polymer in hard water resistance of humic acid water-soluble fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of an acrylic acid polymer in hard water resistance of a humic acid water-soluble fertilizer, and belongs to the technical field of water-soluble fertilizer materials. The acrylic acid polymer is a monobasic or dibasic polymer prepared from acrylic acid and other monomers; the other monomer is one or two of 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, N-tert-butyl acrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, styrene, itaconic acid, methallyl alcohol, methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate and acrylonitrile. According to the invention, the acrylic acid polymer is added into the humic acid water-soluble fertilizer and the hard water, and is quickly combined with the soluble calcium and magnesium ions in the hard water, so that the precipitation effect of the soluble calcium and magnesium ions in the hard water on the humic acid is effectively reduced, the problem that the conventional humic acid water-soluble fertilizer generates a large amount of precipitation when meeting the hard water is solved, the blockage of the precipitation on agricultural spray and drip irrigation equipment is avoided, and the coordination and the use of fertilizer products and water and fertilizer integrated facilities are facilitated.

title_en: Polyion liquid binder, preparation method thereof and application of polyion liquid binder in water-based zinc ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyion liquid binder, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a water system zinc ion battery, relates to the technical field of zinc ion batteries, and aims to solve the technical problem of how to apply an imidazole polyion liquid material to the zinc ion battery; the invention discloses a polyion liquid binder which is 1-butyl-3-ethylimidazole difluoro sulfonyl imide, and further discloses a preparation method of the polyion liquid binder and application thereof in a water system zinc ion battery, compared with traditional binders such as polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), the polyion liquid binder adopted by the invention has good ionic conductivity, is beneficial to the diffusion and transmission of zinc ions in electrode materials, reduces the internal resistance of the battery, and further improves the specific capacity and the cycling stability of the battery.

title_en: Environment-friendly composite board and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and particularly relates to an environment-friendly composite board and a production process thereof. The environment-friendly composite board provided by the invention is prepared from an adhesive, modified bamboo fibers, polymer resin, a filler, isopropyl triisostearate titanate, polymethyl methacrylate and absolute ethyl alcohol. According to the invention, the polyvinyl acetate, the vinyl triethoxysilane and the ethyl methacrylate are taken as reaction monomers together, and the polyvinyl acetate type emulsion adhesive is obtained through emulsion polymerization, so that the adhesive strength of the adhesive is effectively improved; and (3) treating the bamboo fiber by adopting a phosphoric acid aqueous solution under an ultrasonic condition, and introducing carboxyl groups to the surface of the bamboo fiber under the condition that potassium permanganate is taken as an initiator, so that the compatibility of the bamboo fiber and polymer resin is improved.

title_en: Elastic shockproof composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an elastic shockproof composite film and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing porous material particles with polyvinylidene fluoride, and putting the mixture into a ball mill for mixing and ball milling to obtain mixed powder; feeding the mixed powder into a double-drive open mill for mixing and calendaring to obtain a porous material particle film; and (3) feeding the porous material particle film and the elastic polymer into a double-drive open mill together to form the elastic shockproof composite film. The invention takes porous material particles and elastic polymer as raw materials, the materials are mixed to form a film, the elastic polymer deforms under the repeated actions of shearing force and high temperature to form a large number of slender fibers to be attached on the porous material particles, so that the elastic polymer forms a micro fiber network inside the film to form a space skeleton structure, and the porous material particles are connected with each other to form a micro net-shaped enveloping structure. When the impact force is applied, the pores inside the elastic shockproof composite film are extruded to generate plastic deformation, so that kinetic energy is absorbed, and the shockproof effect is exerted.

title_en: Tear-resistant biodegradable mulching film special for vegetables and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special tear-resistant biodegradable mulching film for vegetables and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of preparation of biodegradable materials, comprising the steps of preparation of the special tear-resistant biodegradable mulching film for vegetables, and preparation of the special tear-resistant biodegradable mulching film for vegetables, wherein the steps of preparation of the special tear-resistant biodegradable mulching film for vegetables are as follows: weighing polybutylene terephthalate-adipic acid-butylene, polypropylene carbonate, polycaprolactone, polybutylene succinate and black master batch, uniformly mixing, then adding a light shielding agent, a heat stabilizer, a lubricant, a photocatalytic antibacterial agent, an antioxidant, a biodegradation accelerator and a reinforcing agent, uniformly mixing, then putting the mixture into a double-screw extruder, extruding a melt into a thin tube, blowing the extruded thin tube into a film by compressed air while the thin tube is hot, and finally cooling and cutting. The invention improves the tearing resistance and soil moisture conservation of the mulching film and solves the problems of difficult degradation and environmental pollution of the traditional mulching film by designing the special tearing-resistant biodegradable mulching film for vegetables.

title_en: Coating composition for reinforcing protective layers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating composition comprising a resin system comprising an organic film-forming resin and optionally a curing agent reactive with the organic film-forming resin, a lithium salt having a solubility in water in the range of 0.01-120g/L at 20 ℃ selected from lithium carbonate, lithium phosphate, lithium bicarbonate, lithium tetraborate and lithium oxalate, and zinc salts of 2, 5-dimercapto-1, 3, 4-thiadiazole (DMTD), wherein the zinc salts of DMTD are present as solid particles, the surface of which is at least partially covered by a film-forming polymer layer. Zinc salts of DMTD proved to have a synergistic effect on the enhancement of the barrier function of the protective layer formed in the coating defect due to the presence of the lithium salt. Furthermore, the coating composition has an improved pot life.

title_en: Antibacterial polypropylene material, preparation method thereof and antibacterial plastic package
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of antibacterial materials, and particularly discloses an antibacterial polypropylene material, a preparation method thereof and an antibacterial plastic package. The antibacterial polypropylene material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 80-100 parts of polypropylene, 5-15 parts of precursor solution, 1-3 parts of reducing agent and 5-10 parts of bamboo charcoal fiber; the precursor solution comprises silver salt, zinc salt and solvent as raw materials. According to the application, silver salt and zinc salt are dissolved in a solvent to obtain a precursor solution, and silver ions and zinc ions in the precursor solution are reduced to substances with an antibacterial effect by a reducing agent and are loaded on the bamboo charcoal fiber, so that migration of the antibacterial substances is reduced, and the bamboo charcoal fiber has a certain antibacterial effect, so that the antibacterial performance of the finally prepared polypropylene material is improved.

title_en: Method for preparing peroxy-perfluoro polyether acyl fluoride through continuous cross-flow photooxidation reaction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of photooxidation, and particularly relates to a method for preparing peroxy-perfluoro polyether acyl fluoride by continuous cross-flow photooxidation reaction, which comprises the steps of sequentially enabling hexapropene fluoride with the temperature of-50 to-40 ℃ to pass through photooxidation reactors connected in series, and carrying out photooxidation reaction by entering oxygen from the bottom of each photooxidation reactor and trifluoro vinyl chloride gas under the excitation of ultraviolet light; the reaction liquid overflowed from the upper side surface of the last photooxidation reactor directly enters a hexafluoropropylene evaporation recovery kettle at room temperature, and vaporized hexafluoropropylene is condensed and circulated to a hexafluoropropylene raw material storage tank for recycling; the number of the photooxidation reactors is more than or equal to 2. The method has the advantages of high light excitation efficiency, stable oxidation reaction and complete controllable and adjustable molecular weight distribution of the perfluoropolyether acyl fluoride.

title_en: Method for manufacturing edible degradable porous microcarrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for manufacturing edible and degradable porous microcarriers. The porous edible/degradable microcarrier is prepared by taking polyquaternary ammonium salt amino acid, chitosan quaternary ammonium salt and alginate as base materials, calcium salt as a cross-linking agent and lysine, glutamic acid, chitosan and soy protein isolate as modifiers. The invention realizes the porous structure of the microcarrier by supercritical carbon dioxide, does not use chemical reagents, can be completely removed, and has no food safety risk.

title_en: High-elasticity cushioning light-sensitive material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-elastic cushioning light-sensitive material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-elastic cushioning light-sensitive material comprises, by mass, 20-30 parts of a first ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA), 25-35 parts of a second ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA), 18-23 parts of a polyolefin elastomer (POE), 20-25 parts of a hydrogenated styrene-butadiene block copolymer (SEBS), 1-5 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer, 9-10 parts of an antiwear agent, 0.2-0.5 part of an active agent, 0.5-1 part of an auxiliary agent, 7-9 parts of high-light-color particles, 0.5-1 part of a cross-linking agent and 5-8 parts of a low-temperature foaming agent, wherein the Vinyl Acetate (VA) content in the first ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer is 26%, and the Vinyl Acetate (VA) content in the second ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer is 33%. The appearance of the high-elasticity cushioning light-sensitive material can meet the user requirements of diversification and differentiation.

title_en: Polyamide composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyamide composite material, a preparation method and application thereof. The polyamide composite material comprises 60-85 parts of aliphatic polyamide and 6-14 parts of semi-aromatic polyamide by weight; according to the polyamide composite material provided by the invention, the semi-aromatic polyamide is added, the content of the semi-aromatic polyamide is controlled within a specific range, and the water absorption rate of the polyamide material can be reduced and the dimensional stability of the polyamide material can be improved on the premise that the basic performance of the polyamide is not affected.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium lignin sulfonate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of sodium lignin sulfonate, which comprises the following steps: dispersing calcium lignosulfonate in a mixed solvent to form a reaction system; part or all of the reaction system circularly flows along a preset path, filtering is carried out in the process of circulating flow, sodium carbonate solution is added into the reaction system, and calcium lignosulfonate and sodium carbonate are contacted and then undergo double decomposition reaction to generate sodium lignosulfonate and calcium carbonate; the mixed solvent consists of water and an organic solvent, and the feeding mass ratio of the water to the organic solvent is 1:0.01-0.3; in the method, the consumption and the residual quantity of sodium carbonate are less, the quality of the final sodium lignin sulfonate is improved, the filtering speed is high, and the problem of the prior art is solved.

title_en: Light heat-resistant polyamide composite material for automobile instrument board beam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyamide composite materials, and discloses a light heat-resistant polyamide composite material for automobile instrument board beams, which is prepared by adding polyamide, triazinyl polyamide, modified graphene oxide and an antioxidant into a double-screw extruder, carrying out melt blending, extruding and granulating; then injection molding is carried out through an injection molding machine, so that the light heat-resistant polyamide composite material for the automobile instrument board beam is obtained; the phosphorus element, the nitrogen element and the nitrogen element in the modified graphene oxide contained in the triazinyl polyamide form a flame-retardant system, so that a better flame-retardant effect is achieved; the triazinyl polyamide contains a large amount of amide structures and the polyamide has better interface compatibility, wherein the triazinyl group and the graphene oxide have better heat-resistant effect, and the heat resistance of the material is improved.

title_en: Cyanoethyl cellulose/itaconic anhydride composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and relates to a cyanoethyl cellulose/itaconic anhydride composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof. Dissolving cyanoethyl cellulose in a first polar solvent to obtain CEC solution; dissolving itaconic anhydride in a second polar solvent to obtain an ITA solution; mixing CEC solution and ITA solution uniformly, and performing esterification reaction to obtain CEC/ITA mixed solution; and casting the CEC/ITA mixed solution into a film, drying, dipping with absolute ethyl alcohol, and drying to obtain the full-organic cyanoethyl cellulose/itaconic anhydride composite material. The invention uses the bio-based material cyanoethyl cellulose as a dielectric polymer matrix and itaconic anhydride as a modified cross-linking agent, and the prepared synthetic functional polymer is environment-friendly and has application prospect in electrical materials. The introduction of polar groups in the itaconic anhydride structure in the dielectric film material can increase the number of dipoles in the polymer matrix, which is beneficial to improving the dielectric constant.

title_en: Preparation method of composite animal tissue collagen sponge with antibacterial and antioxidant activities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite animal tissue collagen sponge with antibacterial and antioxidant activities, which comprises the following steps of; s1, pretreatment of animal tissues; cleaning fresh animal tissue, shearing, regulating pH value, washing with water to neutrality, draining water; s2, extracting animal tissue collagen: soaking the animal tissue treated in the step S1 in acetic acid solution containing pepsin, filtering by using gauze, adding sodium chloride, stirring for a plurality of times, standing for precipitation, and centrifuging the solution; s3, purifying animal tissue collagen: s4, primary crosslinking of animal tissue collagen sponge: s5, animal tissue collagen sponge secondary crosslinking: s6, collecting animal tissue collagen sponge. Compared with the traditional chemical crosslinking method, the method avoids exogenous toxic chemical substances from entering the animal tissue collagen sponge, avoids residual toxicity, and simultaneously endows the collagen sponge with antibacterial and antioxidant biological activity.

title_en: Epoxy compound, epoxy resin composition, cured product, prepreg, fiber-reinforced composite material, method for producing the same, sealing material, semiconductor device, method for sealing semiconductor element, and method for using the same as sealing material
abstract_en: The present invention provides a glycidylamine-type fluorine-containing epoxy compound. The present disclosure relates to a fluorine-containing epoxy compound represented by the general formula (1). In the general formula (1), n is an integer of 0 to 4, R  1  is a monovalent substituent, and R  1  is one selected from the group consisting of halogen atom, alkyl group, alkoxy group, haloalkoxy group and aryl group.

title_en: Cotton pulp black liquor dry powder-based wood-plastic composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cotton pulp black liquor dry powder-based wood-plastic composite material, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-60 parts of cotton pulp black liquor dry powder, 30-60 parts of polyolefin and 5-15 parts of auxiliary agent; the preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: (1) weighing the raw materials; (2) Uniformly mixing cotton pulp black liquor dry powder, polyolefin and an auxiliary agent, and cooling to normal temperature; (3) Crushing, loading into a mold, hot-pressing to plasticity, and cooling to normal temperature. According to the invention, cotton pulp black liquor dry powder is used as a filler to prepare the wood-plastic composite material, and the cotton pulp black liquor dry powder is characterized, so that not only is the efficient utilization of cotton pulp black liquor biomass resources realized, but also a new path is provided for the preparation of the wood-plastic composite material.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant polyurethane sealing gasket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant polyurethane sealing gasket and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of gaskets. Firstly, preparing polyurethane with double hydroxyl end caps by copolymerizing hydrogenated poly (dimer acid-co-ethylene glycol) and isocyanate monomers; the two benzene rings contained in the chain extender lock the molecular chain, so that the molecular chain is difficult to decompose at high temperature; the polymer contains a large number of reversible cyclic structures such as hydrogen bonds, dynamic disulfide bonds and the like, and can carry out dynamic recombination reverse reaction. Secondly, the dihydroxyl on the end cap of the polyurethane soft segment reacts with the epoxy group in the epoxy resin E51 to form an alcohol compound, and simultaneously, siloxane is introduced to form a reticular system with moderate crosslinking with the secondary hydroxyl in the epoxy resin E51 through ultraviolet curing in the preparation process of the polyurethane sealing gasket, so that the high temperature resistance is improved. The gasket prepared by the invention has the effects of high temperature resistance and sealing.

title_en: Filtrate reducer for oil-based drilling fluid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a filtrate reducer for oil-based drilling fluid, a preparation method and application thereof, the preparation raw materials of the filtrate reducer comprise monomers, an initiator, a cross-linking agent, an ethylenic long-chain alkyl lipid compound, a first solvent, a second solvent and an auxiliary agent. In the invention, the filtrate reducer has stable performance and strong adaptability, and can meet the drilling requirements of various complex well conditions; the filtrate reducer has good filtrate reducing effect, is nontoxic and has good environmental acceptability and biodegradability.

title_en: Transparent thermoplastic polyimide resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a transparent thermoplastic polyimide resin, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the transparent thermoplastic polyimide resin has a structure shown in a formula I. According to the invention, the fluorine-containing group and/or the alicyclic structure is introduced into the molecular main chain of the polyimide resin, so that the strong electron withdrawing capability of the fluorine-containing group or the capability of the alicyclic ring to destroy the conjugated structure can effectively inhibit charge transfer in the molecular chain, thereby improving the light transmittance of the polyimide resin material. And the content of Ar  2  containing fluorine groups and/or B containing alicyclic structures is controlled, so that the polyimide resin material has better thermoplastic processability and can control the cost.

title_en: Coated slow release fertilizer based on protein capsule film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coated slow release fertilizer based on a protein capsule film, belongs to the technical field of fertilizers, and is used for solving the technical problems that gelatin in the prior art is poor in mechanical property and hydrophobicity as a coating material, and polyurethane is difficult to degrade as the coating material; the invention adds the melted protein capsule membrane into urea particles to obtain a first membrane layer, drops dihydroxy end-capped fluorinated chain extender solution, modified polyol solid and isophorone diisocyanate into the first membrane layer to obtain a second membrane layer, enriches the nutrition elements of the protein capsule membrane and improves the slow release performance by adopting citric acid, trace metal elements and quaternary ammonium salt methyltrialkyl ammonium chloride modified gelatin, and improves the hydrophobicity and mechanical performance of the polyurethane film by using a polyfluoro chain extender, a polyfunctional group and a multi-crosslinking site modified polyol solid.

title_en: Starch-based polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a starch-based polymer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) mixing starch and amylase and simultaneously introducing water for maintenance treatment; adding plasticizer into the material obtained in the step (1), uniformly mixing and cooling, and (3) adding initiator, acrylamide, functional monomer, N-methylene bisacrylamide and water into the material obtained in the step (2) for carrying out a bursting polymerization reaction, and further carrying out optional molding and drying treatment on the material obtained after the reaction to obtain the starch-based polymer. A starch-based polymer and its use in water-based mud drilling are also provided. The starch-based polymer prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention has the characteristics of good salt resistance, temperature resistance, filtration loss performance, environment friendliness, lubrication, good water solubility, low cost, easiness in storage and the like.

title_en: Transparent patterned self-repairing self-cleaning coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional coating preparation/construction, and particularly relates to a transparent patterned self-repairing self-cleaning coating and a preparation method thereof. The invention firstly prepares cage-shaped silsesquioxane by utilizing functionalized trimethylsiloxane through hydrolytic condensation, then prepares hydroxyl functional cage-shaped silsesquioxane through mercapto-alkene click chemical reaction, then prepares polyurethane prepolymer through hydroxyl functional polydimethylsiloxane, isophorone diisocyanate and initiator through polymerization addition reaction, then prepares inorganic-organic hybrid polyurethane polymer through the reaction of the hydroxyl functional cage-shaped silsesquioxane and the polyurethane prepolymer, prepares the polymer into paint, and then is dripped on the surface of a sample and cured at normal temperature to prepare the transparent patterned self-repairing self-cleaning coating. The coating constructed by the invention can realize the self-cleaning and antifouling properties of a long-acting interface through an organic solvent-assisted self-repairing strategy, maintain clear optical transparency, realize the self-repairing of mechanical damage of an optical glass device and have wide application prospect.

title_en: Fluorine-free binder for positive electrode of lithium ion battery, preparation method of fluorine-free binder, positive electrode of battery and battery
abstract_en: The application provides a fluorine-free binder for a lithium ion battery anode, a preparation method thereof, a battery anode and a battery, wherein the fluorine-free binder structure for the lithium ion battery anode comprises a cross-linked core and an oil-soluble shell, the cross-linked core is a spherical polymer with a cross-linked structure, the oil-soluble shell is a polymer shell layer polymerized on the cross-linked core in situ, one end of a molecular chain segment of an outer shell layer polymer is bound on the central cross-linked core, the raw material components of the binder comprise, by mass, 25-75 parts of A1 monomer, 25-50 parts of A2 monomer, 7-15 parts of a cross-linked monomer, 20-50 parts of a B1 monomer, 50-100 parts of a B2 monomer and 5-20 parts of a functional monomer.

title_en: Divalent metal coordination polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antibacterial coordination polymers, in particular to a divalent metal coordination polymer, a preparation method and application thereof. The divalent metal coordination polymer is prepared by adopting one-pot hydrothermal reaction, the chemical formula of the divalent metal coordination polymer is [ Mn (cpt)  2 ] n  or [ Co (cpt)  2 ] n ,[Mn(cpt) 2 ] n  ] is C  56 H 36 CoN 6 O 6 , the molecular formula of the divalent metal coordination polymer is C  56 H 36 MnN 6 O 6 ,[Co(cpt) 2 ] n , the preparation method has the advantages of simple process, convenience in operation, high yield, good reproducibility and the like, and the prepared [ Mn (cpt)  2 ] n  and [ Co (cpt)  2 ] n  have good antibacterial activity on staphylococcus aureus and pseudomonas aeruginosa.

title_en: 6-Bit binaphthyl diisocyanate, synthesis method thereof and application thereof in preparation of binaphthyl polyurethane material
abstract_en: The invention provides 6-binaphthyl diisocyanate which is prepared by taking metal or salts thereof as a catalyst, carrying out an Ullmann coupling reaction in the presence of a ligand and inorganic base and under the protection of inert gas, carrying out amide hydrolysis, and then carrying out a carboacylation reaction with a carboacylation reagent. The invention also provides a synthesis method of the 6-binaphthyl diisocyanate. The invention also provides application of the 6-position binaphthyl diisocyanate in preparing urethane rubber and elastomer, urethane fiber, pouring urethane rubber, urethane emulsion and coating, urethane adhesive, damping foam material, energy-absorbing foam material and damping foam material. The 6-binaphthyl diisocyanate provided by the invention has a four-ring structure, has high covalent bond stability, and has excellent chemical stability and thermal stability.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of oxygen-containing alkyl chain functionalized covalent organic framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method and application of an oxygen-containing alkyl chain functionalized covalent organic framework, and belongs to the technical field of environmental protection. The invention synthesizes the covalent organic framework with triazine structure and hydroxyl group by 4,4' ' - (1, 3, 5-triazine-2, 4, 6-triyl) triphenylamine and 3,3' -dihydroxyl- [1,1' -biphenyl ] -4,4' -dicarboxaldehyde through Schiff base reaction, and then prepares the functional covalent organic framework with the oxygen-containing alkyl chain by modifying hydroxyl into the oxygen-containing alkyl chain through 1-bromo-2 (2-methoxyethoxy) ethane. The oxygen-containing alkyl chain functionalized covalent organic framework synthesized by the method has the advantages of super-strong hydrophilicity, abundant action sites, effective electron-hole separation, efficient electron transfer and the like, has strong photocatalytic reduction capability on U (VI), high efficiency, good selectivity and good application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of elastic polyurethane material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elastic polyurethane materials, in particular to a preparation method of an elastic polyurethane material, which comprises the following steps of (1) preparing biomass-based polyol LBP, (2) synthesizing a light response type chain extender ADE, (3) preparing a flame retardant modifier PNSFR, (4) preparing the elastic polyurethane material based on the LBP, the ADE and PNSFR, and reducing dependence on petroleum resources and utilizing lignin which is a renewable resource by introducing the biomass-based polyol LBP. The unique structure of LBP also improves the mechanical property and the thermal stability of the material, and the introduction of the light response type chain extender ADE endows the material with reversible light response, thereby realizing the shape memory and self-repairing functions. More importantly, the conjugated structure of ADE also enhances the mechanical property and thermal stability of the material, and realizes the cooperative improvement of functions and performances. The flame retardant modifier PNSFR obviously improves the flame retardance of the material through the synergistic effect of phosphorus and nitrogen, and reaches the UL-94V-0 level.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified chitosan microsphere double-container corrosion inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a modified chitosan double-container microsphere corrosion inhibitor, which comprises the following steps: dissolving benzotriazole in an acetone solution, stirring until the benzotriazole is dissolved, adding the benzotriazole into a flask containing an aqueous solution of beta-cyclodextrin, and stirring at constant temperature; after the reaction is finished, suction filtration is carried out, deionized water is used for cleaning, and an intermediate product is obtained after drying. Adding the intermediate product into a flask containing sodium hydroxide solution, and stirring until the intermediate product is dissolved; then dropwise adding the solution of the paratoluenesulfonyl chloride dissolved in acetonitrile into a flask, and stirring at a constant temperature; after the reaction is finished, the solution is filtered, washed by deionized water and dried to obtain an intermediate product. Adding chitosan and 1-allyl imidazole into a flask containing acetic acid solution, and stirring until the chitosan and the 1-allyl imidazole are dissolved; dissolving the intermediate product in DMF solution, stirring until the intermediate product is dissolved, dropwise adding the solution into a flask, and stirring at constant temperature; after the reaction was completed, the solution was added dropwise to a flask containing liquid paraffin and Span80, and mechanically stirred at constant temperature. Then adding glutaraldehyde solution into the flask drop by drop, and mechanically stirring at constant temperature; and after the reaction is finished, centrifuging the obtained emulsion, washing the product by using petroleum ether and isopropanol in sequence, and collecting and drying to obtain the modified chitosan double-container microsphere corrosion inhibitor. According to the invention, the environment-friendly polymer chitosan is selected as a raw material, and the prepared corrosion inhibitor has excellent anti-corrosion performance in a CO  2  environment, can ensure long-term stable operation of pipes and equipment, and has wide development prospect and application potential in the field of oil and gas field corrosion prevention.

title_en: Preparation method of conductive composite material, conductive composite material and flexible sensor
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of a conductive composite material, the conductive composite material and a flexible sensor, which are used for solving the technical problem that the measurement is inaccurate because the resistance value of the conductive polymer composite material adopted by the conventional flexible sensor is influenced by the change of the ambient temperature. According to the preparation method, the preparation method combines a liquid phase dispersion technology and a molding curing technology, and granular conductive filler with a preset mass ratio is uniformly distributed on a high polymer matrix to form a conductive network with tunnel effect. The resistance value of the conductive composite material is reduced due to the mobility enhancement of electrons in the conductive network of the tunnel effect caused by the temperature rise, and the resistance value increase of the conductive composite material caused by the interruption of partial conductive paths caused by the thermal expansion of the material is adaptively compensated.

title_en: Preparation method and application of super-lubricated hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a super-lubricated hydrogel, and relates to the technical field of medicine. According to the invention, the super-lubrication hydrogel is obtained by grafting a 2-methacryloyloxyethyl phosphorylcholine polymer on the surface of a methacryloylated gelatin hydrogel matrix through surface initiated atom transfer radical polymerization reaction. The super-lubricating hydrogel prepared by the invention can be used as a super-lubricating interface of bionic articular cartilage to enhance tribology performance, and a novel low-friction and wear-resistant bionic articular cartilage bracket is constructed, so that the defects of the existing cartilage repair materials are overcome, and the super-lubricating hydrogel has important significance in promoting the development of an articular cartilage repair technology and improving the life quality of an articular cartilage injury patient.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant cement paste thixotropic agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cement paste thixotropic agents, in particular to a high-temperature cement paste thixotropic agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the former raw material comprises nano silicon dioxide, a polymer and an initiator, the polymer is formed by compounding 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid, acrylamide and dimethyl diallyl ammonium chloride, the thixotropic agent is prepared by the following steps of firstly dissolving the polymer in water, and then regulating the pH value of the obtained polymer solution; then sequentially adding nano silicon dioxide and an initiator into the polymer solution, uniformly mixing to obtain slurry, and finally, reacting the slurry under heating to obtain the nano silicon dioxide-initiator composite material. The cement paste system added with the high-temperature-resistant cement paste thixotropic agent has excellent thixotropic property under the condition of 120 ℃.

title_en: Rare earth doped quantum dot composite light conversion agricultural film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum dot light-converting agricultural films, in particular to a rare earth doped quantum dot composite light-converting agricultural film and a preparation method thereof. The light conversion agricultural film comprises 0.2-5% of light conversion master batch and 95-99.8% of polymer matrix, wherein the light conversion master batch comprises 10-50% of red quantum dot light conversion agent, 1-5% of green rare earth light conversion agent, 1-10% of auxiliary agent and master batch matrix, the red quantum dot light conversion agent is at least one of perovskite quantum dot, II-VI group quantum dot, III-V group quantum dot, IV-VI group quantum dot, carbon quantum dot and silicon quantum dot, and the green rare earth light conversion agent comprises at least one of Tb, dy, ce, ho, pr elements. The method has the advantages that by adding the green rare earth material, the green rare earth material absorbs energy under the irradiation of sunlight and then transfers the energy to the red light quantum dots, so that the luminous intensity of the quantum dots is enhanced.

title_en: Highly branched cyclodextrin and preparation process, application and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides novel high-branched cyclodextrin and a preparation process, application and a product thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. According to the invention, on the basis of the high-branched cyclodextrin, the branched content of the high-branched cyclodextrin is increased by more than 10% through the synergistic effect of the 4, 6-alpha-glycosyltransferase and the branching enzyme, the average length of branched chains is shortened by more than 20%, meanwhile, no extra small molecular weight sugar is produced, the product yield is high, and the product hardly contains reducing sugar. The molecular weight of the novel highly branched cyclodextrin prepared by the invention is 50000-80000 Da, the content of alpha-1, 6-glycosidic bond is 5.5-6.5%, the content of reducing sugar is less than 1%, and Maillard reaction is not easy to occur. The novel high branched cyclodextrin with the structural characteristics has an anti-fatigue effect in sports and physical activities, and can effectively improve sports performance and delay fatigue.

title_en: Polyester resin, solvent-free adhesive, preparation method of solvent-free adhesive, aluminum plastic film and lithium battery
abstract_en: The application provides a polyester resin, a solvent-free adhesive and a preparation method thereof, an aluminum plastic film and a lithium battery, and relates to the technical field of materials. The polyester resin has the structural general formula as follows:  The preparation method of the polyester resin comprises the following steps: and mixing the dibasic acid, the dibasic alcohol and the catalyst to perform a first reaction, and then adding the monofunctional beta-dicarbonyl compound and the difunctional beta-dicarbonyl compound to perform a second reaction to obtain the polyester resin. The solvent-free adhesive comprises the following components in parts by mass: 60-80 parts of polyester resin, 20-40 parts of epoxy resin, 5-15 parts of reactive diluent, 0.5-1.5 parts of silane coupling agent and 0.15-0.45 part of alkaline catalyst. Compared with the traditional polyurethane adhesive, the solvent-free adhesive provided by the application has no solvent volatilization, and the reaction crosslinking product has no easily-hydrolyzed group and good wet heat resistance; compared with the traditional epoxy system, the epoxy resin has high reactivity, can be rapidly cured, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Polycarbonate resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polycarbonate resin and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polycarbonate resin contains a structural unit shown in a formula I, and the polycarbonate resin is limited to contain the structural unit shown in the formula I, so that the polycarbonate resin has the advantages of better flexibility of a molecular chain, high Abbe number, high refractive index and lower birefringence, and meanwhile, has excellent heat resistance because of no hetero atoms such as sulfur, nitrogen and the like in a structure, and is not easy to generate adverse phenomena such as yellowing and the like in the processing and application processes; in addition, the polycarbonate resin has simple preparation raw materials and low cost, does not need to use an acid catalyst in the preparation process, is very environment-friendly, and can be applied to the fields of optical parts, electronic products or medical products and the like.

title_en: Catalyst for synthesizing polyethylene oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalyst for synthesizing polyethylene oxide and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of polymer material synthesis, wherein the catalyst is a modified ZIF-8 supported ammonia calcium catalyst, the supported mass ratio is (25-30) of modified ZIF-8 to (5-8) of ammonia calcium catalyst, and the modified ZIF-8 is fructo-oligosaccharide modified ZIF-8. The invention adopts the ZIF-8 modified by fructo-oligosaccharide to load the ammonia-calcium catalyst, improves the dispersibility and stability of the ammonia-calcium catalyst, adopts the methacrylonitrile to match and modify to improve the stability of the ammonia-calcium catalyst, and the catalyst catalyzes the ethylene oxide to prepare the polyethylene oxide with high yield, high purity, very concentrated molecular weight distribution and good thermal stability, thereby greatly improving the quality of the low molecular weight polyethylene oxide.

title_en: Circuit board for CCM module and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit board for a CCM module and a preparation process thereof, belonging to the technical field of ceramic preparation; the preparation process comprises the following steps: manufacturing an inner core plate; laminating an insulating layer; laminating and pressing copper foil; drilling at one time; filling holes with conductive paste; secondary drilling; electroplating; a dry film; etching; welding prevention; characters; and (5) cutting the plate. According to the invention, the epoxy resin can be modified by compounding the curing agent and adding the modifier 2-toluene glycidyl ether, the 2-toluene glycidyl ether with a rigid benzene ring structure and a flexible-C-O-C-chain segment can increase the rigidity and toughness of the cured modified glue solution, so that the rigidity and toughness of the prepreg are increased, benzene ring groups in cyclohexenyl and phthalic anhydride in tetrahydrophthalic anhydride are brought into a more excellent rigid structure of the compounded epoxy system, the torsion behavior of the compounded epoxy molecular structure at high temperature is hindered, the heat resistance and glass transition temperature of the compounded epoxy molecular structure are improved, and the deformation of the circuit board in the production process is reduced.

title_en: Aromatic polyether, process for producing aromatic polyether, composition, and sheet
abstract_en: An aromatic polyether comprising a structural unit represented by the following formula (1), a structural unit represented by the following formula (2) and a structure represented by the following formula (3), wherein the ratio of the peak intensity of the peak having the largest peak intensity among peaks from the structure represented by the above formula (3) which occur in the range of 7.55ppm to 7.65ppm in chemical shift to the peak intensity of the peak from the structural unit represented by the above formula (2) which occur in the vicinity of 7.35ppm in chemical shift is 0.20 to 2.00% in  1  H-NMR measurement.

title_en: Antibacterial environment-friendly tableware material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial environment-friendly tableware material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer material processing. The antibacterial environment-friendly tableware material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60-80 parts of polylactic acid, 15-30 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 15-30 parts of modified talcum powder, 10-20 parts of poly-3-hydroxybutyrate, 10-20 parts of water, 8-12 parts of Arabic gum, 4-9 parts of flame retardant, 2-3 parts of sodium bicarbonate, 2-5 parts of calcium stearate, 0.8-1.5 parts of antibacterial agent and 0.1-0.3 part of crosslinking auxiliary agent. The modified talcum powder, the antibacterial agent and the polylactic acid have chemical action, so the quaternary phosphonium salt antibacterial agent containing long carbon chains (14 carbon) endows the tableware material with efficient, safe and durable antibacterial effect; in addition, the tableware material has excellent mechanical property, flame retardant property, degradation property and the like under the combined action of other raw materials.

title_en: Silicon-based composite material containing organic flexible coating layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon-based composite material containing an organic flexible coating layer, which is of a three-layer core-shell structure, and sequentially comprises a silicon-based material, an inorganic carbon coating layer and an organic flexible coating layer from inside to outside; the organic flexible coating layer is an organosilicon-polyaniline layer formed by performing surface modification on a silicon-based material containing an inorganic carbon coating layer by adopting anilino silane to form a precursor, and then performing in-situ polymerization on the precursor, aniline, an oxidant and a cross-linking agent octaepoxysilsesquioxane; the mass ratio of the precursor, the aniline, the oxidant and the crosslinking agent octaepoxysilsesquioxane is 100: (10-25): (5-12): (0.2 to 0.5); the mass ratio of the silicon-based material containing the inorganic carbon coating layer to the anilino silane is 100: (8-15). The organic flexible coating layer can effectively relieve volume expansion and particle breakage of the silicon-based material in the charge and discharge process, and can play a role in specific capacity and conductivity.

title_en: Bipolar membrane
abstract_en: A bipolar membrane comprising an anion exchange layer and a cation exchange layer, wherein the cation exchange layer is obtainable by curing a composition comprising: (a1) A first crosslinking agent comprising an anionic group and at least two polymerizable groups; (b1) A second crosslinking agent comprising at least two polymerizable groups and no anionic groups; wherein the molar ratio of component (a 1) to component (b 1) is at least 1.

title_en: Composite catalyst containing zinc pyridine carboxylate complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite catalysts, and discloses a composite catalyst containing a zinc pyridine carboxylate complex, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite catalyst comprises the zinc pyridine carboxylate complex and a double metal cyanide catalyst DMC, the molar ratio of the zinc pyridine carboxylate complex is 1:1-60, the zinc pyridine carboxylate complex is provided with an electron withdrawing group and an electron donating group, the zinc pyridine carboxylate complex has the characteristics of high selectivity and high activity, the catalytic activity of 12 h can reach 510 g  polyment /g  cat , the high propylene oxide conversion rate can be realized on the basis of ensuring the high carbonate content in the low-temperature (30-75 ℃) catalytic carbon dioxide copolymerization reaction, and the polymerization reaction time is obviously shortened, so that the product has high carbonate content, high molecular weight, high conversion rate and low byproduct content and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Device and method for polymerizing ultra-high purity ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene by using plasma
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for polymerizing ultra-high purity ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene by using plasma, wherein the device comprises a plasma reaction cavity, a plasma high-energy excitation source, a gas supply system, a vacuum control system, a temperature control system, a product collection system and a gas circulation system. The plasma coil in the high-energy plasma excitation source is sleeved on the outer ring of the bell jar of the plasma reaction cavity to provide energy for the plasma reaction cavity, and the high-activity high-energy density plasma is excited in the inner wall of the cavity. The invention generates high-activity high-energy density plasmas through high-energy excitation, ethylene monomer molecules are impacted by high-energy particles in the plasmas to form active species, the active species react with other ethylene monomers or the active species, and free radical polymerization is carried out to form polyethylene chains, so that the polymerization of the ethylene monomers is realized, and an ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene material is generated under the action of no catalyst; by accurate control of temperature and pressure, ultra-high purity polyethylene products can be obtained.

title_en: Hollow particles
abstract_en: The present invention provides a hollow particle comprising a shell comprising a resin and a hollow portion surrounded by the shell, wherein the resin comprises a shell polymer comprising a crosslinkable monomer unit, the hollow particle has a true density of 1.16g/cm  3  or more, and the hollow particle has a value of C calculated by the following formula (1) of 0.94 or more. Formula (1): c=a× (100-B)/100 (in the above formula (1), a represents a value of the true density of the hollow particles (unit: g/cm  3 ), and B represents a value of the content ratio of the monofunctional monomer units in the above shell polymer (unit: mass%)).

title_en: Mosquito-repellent group modified polyacrylate emulsion, outer wall waterproof coating and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mosquito-repellent group modified polyacrylate emulsion, an external wall waterproof coating and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a mosquito-repellent group modified polyacrylate emulsion which is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 45-60 parts of soft monomers, 5-20 parts of hard monomers, 0-1.5 parts of functional monomers and 25-40 parts of mosquito-repellent group monomers. The invention also provides an external wall waterproof coating, which comprises a feed liquid component and a powder component, wherein the feed liquid component comprises the mosquito-repellent group modified polyacrylate emulsion. According to the invention, the composite mosquito repellent synergist is preferably matched with the polymer emulsion, the aluminate cement and the pigment filler, so that the prepared waterproof coating for the outer wall has excellent waterproof and decorative effects and good weather resistance and mosquito repellent rate.

title_en: Wear-resistant resin matrix composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant resin matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite material preparation, wherein the composite material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-50 parts of thermosetting resin, 5-10 parts of curing agent, 0.6-1 part of lubricant, 3-8 parts of flame retardant and 1-3 parts of filler; the lubricant is silicone oil, and the curing agent is any one of phthalic anhydride, pyromellitic dianhydride, tetrahydrophthalic anhydride and maleic anhydride.
