According to the wear-resistant resin-based composite material and the preparation method thereof, the wear resistance of the composite material can be obviously improved by adding the modified silicon carbide whisker, and meanwhile, the interface bonding strength of the silicon carbide whisker and the resin matrix can be improved by modifying the silicon carbide whisker through the silane coupling agent, so that the mechanical property of the composite material is improved; meanwhile, the flame retardant performance of the composite material can be effectively improved and the safety of the composite material in use under the high-temperature condition can be improved by adding the flame retardant.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium alginate hydrogel film containing nitrogen and carbon dots
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a sodium alginate hydrogel film containing nitrogen-doped carbon dots, which has excellent antioxidation and antibacterial properties. An acidic nitrogen doped carbon point with citric acid as a carbon source and urea as a nitrogen source is synthesized by a microwave auxiliary method with short time and low cost. And the calcium ions in the system are released in the presence of acidic carbon points, so that the ionic crosslinking of the calcium ions and the sodium alginate is realized. The invention is characterized in that no acid substances are needed to be added in the preparation process of the hydrogel film, the natural environment-friendly property is realized, the excellent oxidation resistance and antibacterial property are simultaneously provided for the hydrogel film, and the mechanical property and the gel strength of the hydrogel film are improved. The hydrogel film can be used in the fields of medical treatment and health, biological engineering, food preservation and the like.

title_en: Degradable three-phase polymer mixed film with core-shell structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable three-phase polymer mixed film with a core-shell structure, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials. The PBS is used as a shell structure to wrap the PGA core, so that the problem of rapid hydrolysis of PGA is solved, and the phase interface binding force is enhanced and the mechanical property of the ternary mixed film is improved by adding the epoxidized soybean oil cardanol ether bio-based compatilizer.

title_en: Modified epoxy resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides modified epoxy resins and methods of making the same. The modified epoxy resin raw material comprises epoxy resin, curing agent amine compound, low molecular monoepoxy compound and polyurea polymer. The preparation method of the modified epoxy resin comprises the steps of reacting a difunctional amine compound with a difunctional isocyanate compound in an organic solvent to prepare a polyurea polymer, adding a low-molecular monoepoxy compound into the epoxy resin, stirring, adding a curing agent amine compound and the polyurea polymer, stirring, removing bubbles in a system under vacuum negative pressure, and coating on the surface of a substrate to obtain the modified epoxy resin coating.

title_en: Method for preparing sizing carbon fiber by using polyester-containing polyurethane pre-sizing agent and application thereof, sizing carbon fiber and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon fiber sizing agents, in particular to a method for preparing sized carbon fibers by using a polyester-containing polyurethane pre-sizing agent and application thereof, and sized carbon fibers and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: s1, pre-sizing and pre-drying carbon fibers by adopting a pre-sizing agent containing polyester polyurethane and epoxy resin to obtain initial carbon fibers; s2, carrying out secondary sizing and secondary drying on the initial carbon fiber by adopting resorcinol formaldehyde latex to obtain sized carbon fiber; the infiltration time of the pre-sizing agent is less than or equal to 25 seconds, and the viscosity at 25 ℃ is less than or equal to 90 centipoise. Due to the existence of polyester polyurethane in the pre-sizing agent, the wear resistance of the carbon fiber can be obviously improved, the binding force between the sizing carbon fiber and the rubber matrix can be enhanced, and the temperature resistance of the sizing carbon fiber can be improved.

title_en: Preparation process of environment-friendly EVA foaming injection colloidal particle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of environment-friendly EVA foaming injection colloidal particles, and relates to the field of injection colloidal particle production. According to the invention, a staged mixing technology is introduced in the process, so that the mixing uniformity is effectively improved: the components are added and mixed in batches in stages, so that each component is ensured to be uniformly distributed, and the local concentration is prevented from being too high or too low; reducing degradation risk: in the banburying process, the banburying is carried out in sections, so that the degradation risk of the foaming agent and the cross-linking agent at high temperature for a long time is reduced, and the stability of the material is maintained; optimizing production efficiency: the mixing process can be better controlled by staged mixing, the downtime is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Polyurethane composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyurethane composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer composite materials. The invention provides a polyurethane composite material, which comprises a soft polyurethane matrix and hard polyurethane fibers dispersed in the soft polyurethane matrix. The soft polyurethane matrix and the hard polyurethane fiber in the composite material are polyurethane, so that the soft polyurethane matrix and the hard polyurethane fiber have good compatibility, and the tensile strength and the elongation at break are improved. The example results show that the tensile strength of the polyurethane composite material can reach 30-60 MPa, and the elongation at break can reach 700-1600%.

title_en: Chain-extended PVC paste resin, PVC foaming composite special material, foaming product, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a chain-extended PVC paste resin, a PVC foaming composite special material, a foaming product, a preparation method and application. The chain-extended PVC paste resin is polymerized by the following raw materials: 15 to 75 weight portions of vinyl chloride monomer, 10 to 70 weight portions of acrylic ester monomer, 3 to 7 weight portions of chain extender, 0.5 to 1 weight portion of initiator, 10 to 15 weight portions of surfactant and 60 to 90 weight portions of dispersion medium. The chain-extended PVC paste resin can be compounded with a plasticizer, a foaming agent, a stabilizer and an inorganic filler to obtain a foaming composite special material, and the foaming product is prepared under a certain foaming process, so that the prepared foaming product has good foaming performance.

title_en: Hydrogen bond aromatic amide molecular cage compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen bond aromatic amide molecular cage compound and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of porous organic functional materials. According to the invention, an imine intermediate is synthesized by a dynamic covalent chemical imine condensation reaction of a hydrogen bond oligomeric aromatic amide diamine monomer and a trialdehyde monomer in methylene dichloride, and then an in-situ one-pot method is used for reduction by using NaBH  3  CN, so that an aromatic amide cage-shaped molecule is finally prepared, the preparation method is simple, and the reaction monomer is cheap and easy to obtain. Meanwhile, the hydrogen bond aromatic amide molecular cage compound prepared by the method has high thermal stability and high chemical stability, can efficiently adsorb iodine (comprising I  2 、I 3   ‑  and CH  3  I) in a solution state and a gas phase form, and can be applied to design and development of high-performance radioactive iodine capturing materials.

title_en: Preparation process of composite material based on resin transfer film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of imprinting, and particularly relates to a preparation process of a composite material based on a resin transfer film, which comprises the following steps: step 1, carrying out surface cleaning treatment on a glass substrate to be treated; step 2, selecting a proper resin transfer film, and processing the resin transfer film according to the required shape and size; step 3, coating a layer of adhesive on the surface of the base material treated in the step 1; step 4, attaching the resin transfer film to the adhesive of the glass substrate, and curing; and 5, finishing, polishing and painting according to the requirement to obtain a final product. The glass and the resin film are adhered by the special adhesive, so that the glass has more pattern types, and also has better adhesion, high temperature resistance, water resistance and scratch resistance; and the curing of the process adopts UV light curing, so that the overall production efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-efficiency filtering spunlaced non-woven fabric with flame retardant and antibacterial functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency filtering spun-laced non-woven fabric with flame retardant and antibacterial functions and a preparation method thereof, comprising a flame retardant non-woven fabric layer, an antibacterial non-woven fabric layer and a base cloth layer, wherein the flame retardant non-woven fabric layer is formed by centrifugally spinning a precursor PAA of polyimide obtained by dissolving pyromellitic anhydride and 4, 4-diaminodiphenyl ether in N, N-dimethylformamide; the antibacterial non-woven fabric layer is formed by a water-jet process of bicomponent fibers added with antibacterial master batches; the base cloth layer is prepared from flame-retardant polyester staple fibers through a needling process and electrostatic electret treatment. According to the invention, polyimide with excellent flame retardant property is adopted as a flame retardant layer, the bicomponent fiber added with the antibacterial master batch is adopted as an antibacterial layer, and the needling process and the electrostatic electret treated polyester base cloth layer are combined, so that the prepared spunlaced non-woven fabric has the functions of lasting flame retardance, antibacterial property and efficient filtration, and the problems of single function and short service cycle of the spunlaced non-woven fabric are solved.

title_en: Difunctional photoinitiator of diblock copolymer, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a difunctional photoinitiator of a diblock copolymer, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of diblock copolymers. The structural formula of the dual-function photoinitiator disclosed by the invention is as follows:  wherein HR is  Has good application prospect in the aspect of preparing the diblock copolymer.

title_en: High refractive index 1.67 resin lens monomer and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high refractive index 1.67 resin lens monomer and a preparation process thereof, wherein the resin lens monomer comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 70-80wt% of triethylene glycol diacrylate; modified styrene; 10-15wt%; 5-10wt% of thiol acrylate; 0.5-1wt% of ultraviolet absorber; 0.5-1wt% of benzoyl peroxide. The triethylene glycol diacrylate is used as a matrix monomer in the formula, so that the refractive index of the resin lens is effectively improved. The modified styrene increases the density of benzene rings through the special design of molecular structures, enhances the optical density of the material, and further improves the refractive index. Compared with the traditional styrene, the modified styrene not only improves the refractive index, but also improves the weather resistance and chemical stability of the material. The use of thiol acrylate as a cross-linking agent not only improves the mechanical strength of the lens, but also improves the thermal stability and chemical resistance of the material by moderate cross-linking.

title_en: Poly (dimethyl diphenyl imide) siloxane/phenolic group double-network hybrid resin and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a poly (dimethyl dibenzoyl imide) siloxane/phenolic aldehyde double-network hybrid resin and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of advanced materials. The invention provides a copolymer for preparing ablative thermal protection hybrid resin, which has a structure shown in a formula I. Hybrid resins prepared with the copolymers are then provided. The copolymer shown in the formula I in the hybrid resin has good compatibility with the phenolic resin, and the copolymer is uniformly distributed in the phenolic resin; and the hybrid resin is graphitized and ceramic in the ablation process, and has excellent ablation resistance. The invention provides a thought and a method for preparing novel ablation-resistant hybrid phenolic resin by copolymerization, and the novel ablation-resistant hybrid phenolic resin which is expected to meet the increasingly severe future flight environment is prepared.

title_en: Preparation method of luminous artificial spider silk, luminous surgical suture line and fluorescent protective net
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a luminous artificial spider silk, a luminous surgical suture and a fluorescent protective net, and relates to the field of preparation of high polymer materials. The method takes organic acid derivatives with aggregation-induced emission property and polyhydroxy monomers as raw materials, obtains spinning solution through ultraviolet polymerization under the action of an initiator, and then directly spins and continuously prepares the luminous artificial spider silk. The mechanical properties can be regulated and enhanced by adding hydroxyl monomers, and the mechanical properties can be further enhanced by introducing cross-linking agents and twisting. The luminous artificial spider silk has the tensile strength of 506MPa, the stretchability of 24 percent, the fluorescence quantum yield of 15.6 percent, and the luminous artificial spider silk has strong light stability and is not easy to bleach. The strategy for preparing the fiber by combining aggregation-induced emission and a plurality of hydrogen bond fragments can also excite new designs in 3D printing, advanced infrastructure and construction, and the spinning method using spiders as inspiration is an environment-friendly and energy-saving method, so that the release of carbon in the environment can be reduced.

title_en: Polycarbonate resin, method for producing same, and polycarbonate resin composition
abstract_en: A polycarbonate resin having terminal groups represented by the following formula (1), wherein the proportion of the terminal groups represented by the following formula (1) relative to the total terminal groups is 0.024-4.0 mol%. (In the above formula (1), X  1 ～X 5  may be the same or different and each independently represents a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group having 1 to 3 carbon atoms, wherein at least one of X  1 ～X 5  in the formula (1) is an alkyl group having 1 to 3 carbon atoms and represents a bond to a polycarbonate resin chain).

title_en: Polyaromatic ether type aromatic amide polymer, preparation method thereof and coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyaromatic ether type aromatic amide polymer, a preparation method and a coating thereof, wherein the polymer adopts p-phenylenediamine, aromatic ether phenylenediamine and terephthaloyl chloride to polymerize into a low-molecular polyaromatic ether type aromatic amide polymer system under the condition of existence of a tertiary amide type composite solvent, has specific physicochemical properties, ensures that the polymer has better uniformity, has deeper infiltration and firmer adhesion to a base film, does not need pore-forming agents or other auxiliary materials, has good solution fluidity, is suitable for industrial batch production, has excellent tensile strength, puncture strength and ventilation value, and has low defect rate of a diaphragm coating, and is particularly suitable for preparing the coating of a lithium battery diaphragm.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength high-toughness cellulose hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-strength high-toughness cellulose hydrogel, and belongs to the field of material science. The method comprises the steps of firstly dissolving cellulose in an alkaline solution, using epichlorohydrin for crosslinking, then pouring the cellulose into a mould or emulsifying, then annealing and regenerating, then exposing regenerated cellulose hydrogel to ethanol vapor, then soaking the cellulose hydrogel in an ethanol water solution with a certain concentration, and finally washing ethanol in the hydrogel by deionized water. The result shows that the cellulose hydrogel prepared by the method has high strength and high toughness, the method is simple and convenient to operate, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the prepared cellulose hydrogel with various shapes has good mechanical properties and can be suitable for the fields of flexible electronic devices, biomedical equipment and the like.

title_en: Powdery binder for secondary battery positive electrode and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a powdery binder for a secondary battery positive electrode, which can improve the productivity of the secondary battery positive electrode, and can improve the dispersibility of the binder in an active material and the adhesion with the active material. Further, a powder particle composite comprising the powder binder is provided. A powder binder for a secondary battery positive electrode, wherein the powder binder for a secondary battery positive electrode contains a non-crosslinked polymer having a glass transition temperature of 60 ℃ to 150 ℃. A powdery particle composite body, wherein the powdery particle composite body comprises a positive electrode active material and the powdery binder for a positive electrode of the secondary battery.

title_en: Anti-aging agent MB-S, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antioxidant MB-S, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of rubber antioxidants. The technical proposal is that the structure is as follows The method comprises the steps of 1) placing the anti-aging agent MB and the aldehyde compound in an alcohol solvent, adding the catalyst, reacting for 2-6 hours in a reflux state to generate intermediate dimethylol MB, 2) adding hydroxylamine or inorganic salt thereof, continuing reflux reaction for 2-6 hours, adding alkali solution to neutralize pH to 6-7, cooling, crystallizing, centrifuging and drying to obtain the anti-aging agent MB-S. The antioxidant MB-S has low transitional state energy of reaction with the alkyl peroxide free radical and strong antioxidation capability, is beneficial to prolonging the service life and the performance stability of rubber products, and reduces the maintenance cost.

title_en: Water-absorbing antibacterial foaming sponge, preparation method thereof and insole
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shoe materials, and particularly discloses a water-absorbing antibacterial foam sponge, a preparation method thereof and an insole, wherein a surface fabric of the insole is chemically bonded with the water-absorbing antibacterial foam sponge, primary aryl amine groups with protecting groups are introduced into a molecular chain of the foam sponge, diazotization groups are obtained by surface modification of a bonding surface of the water-absorbing antibacterial foam sponge, which is bonded with the surface fabric, before bonding, and ultraviolet irradiation causes the diazotization groups and carboxyl groups to perform denitrification reaction during bonding. The invention utilizes the bacteriostatic ability of the citrated chitosan to achieve excellent bacteriostatic performance and utilizes the hydrophilic groups which are rich in the citrated chitosan to endow the sponge with good water absorption performance, on one hand, the invention has denitrification reaction with carboxyl groups on the surface of the surface cloth after plasma treatment to carry out chemical bonding, the foaming sponge can be firmly bonded without using hot melt adhesive or other bonding materials, and on the other hand, the foaming sponge and the insole have nitrogen removal reaction with part of carboxyl groups in the molecular chain of the foaming sponge to realize a reticular structure through self-crosslinking, so that the compression resistance of the foaming sponge and the insole is ensured.

title_en: Electrocatalyst preparation based on Metal Organic Frameworks (MOFs) and method for preparing dissolved oxygen saturated solutions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrolytic water hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution reaction, and provides a method for preparing MOF materials by taking Co and Fe ions as metal ions and preparing a dissolved oxygen saturated solution. Co (NO 3) 2.6H2O and FeCl3.6H2O are firstly dissolved in N, N-Dimethylacetamide (DMA) solution, terephthalic acid (1, 4-BDC) is added as an organic linking agent after the mixture is fully dissolved, and 1, 4-diazabicyclo [2.2.2] octane (dabco) is added as a regulator after the mixture is uniformly dispersed. And then placing the obtained suspension into a hydrothermal kettle for hydrothermal reaction, adding the obtained dark green solid into a centrifuge tube, and respectively flushing with absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water for three times and twice. And finally, placing the solid in the centrifuge tube into an oven for drying treatment to obtain a light yellow solid substance. The electrocatalyst prepared by the method provided by the invention has very low overpotential and Tafel slope, can realize high-efficiency hydrogen production and oxygen production by electrolysis of water, and is used for preparing a dissolved oxygen saturated solution for a calibration device of an optical dissolved oxygen sensor based on oxygen production of an anode during electrolysis.

title_en: Continuous carbon fiber reinforced high-performance PET engineering plastic and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous carbon fiber reinforced high-performance PET engineering plastic and a manufacturing method thereof. The high-performance PET engineering plastic comprises 30-90 parts of PET polyester, 10-70 parts of continuous carbon fiber, 1-5 parts of nucleating agent, 0-5 parts of crystallization accelerator and 0.5-3 parts of antioxidant. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of uniformly mixing the raw materials according to the weight ratio, conveying the raw materials to a screw extruder, setting the temperature of each section of the extruder and the temperature of a die head, enabling PET polyester to enter an impregnation die head after the set temperature is reached, uniformly dispersing continuous carbon fibers into parallel monofilaments through a dispersing device, enabling the parallel monofilaments to pass through molten resin in the impregnation die head under the pressure of 0.3-1.2MPa, and carrying out water cooling, air drying and granulating on screw extrusion sample bars. The invention uses the continuous carbon fiber as the reinforcing agent, can effectively improve the mechanical property of PET engineering plastics, has excellent antistatic property, and greatly expands the application field.

title_en: Polyurethane composite material, polyurethane foam material, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyurethane composite material, a polyurethane foaming material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer foaming materials. The invention provides a polyurethane composite material, which comprises a polyurethane matrix and polyurethane composites dispersed in the matrix, wherein the polyurethane composites comprise soft polyurethane and hard polyurethane, and the polyurethane matrix is soft polyurethane. The soft polyurethane and the hard polyurethane in the matrix are polyurethane, so that the soft polyurethane and the hard polyurethane have good compatibility, and the composite prepared by the hard polyurethane and the soft polyurethane is firstly dispersed in the soft polyurethane matrix, so that the compatibility of the hard polyurethane and the soft polyurethane matrix is further improved, and the prepared foaming material has a bimodal cell structure due to the good compatibility.

title_en: Collagen composition for brightening skin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oral preparations, and particularly relates to a collagen composition for brightening skin and a preparation method thereof. The collagen composition comprises, by weight, 40-60 parts of fish collagen peptide, 2-5 parts of arbutin extract, 0.1-0.5 part of black pepper extract, 3-6 parts of glutathione, 1-3 parts of ellagic acid, 1-2 parts of shea butter, 3-5 parts of antioxidant, 1-2 parts of squalane, 1-2 parts of ceramide, 0.5-1 part of sodium bicarbonate, 5-10 parts of beta-cyclodextrin, 1-3 parts of lecithin and 0.5-1 part of silicon dioxide. According to the invention, the polyethylene glycol grafted aminated nanocellulose magnetic carrier is used for immobilizing enzyme, so that the enzyme thermal stability and denaturation resistance are improved, the enzyme activity is optimized and maintained by crosslinking, the recovery process is simplified, the cost is reduced, the yield and quality of collagen peptide are improved, the active ingredients are protected by nanocrystallization and embedding technology, and the absorption efficiency and the product stability are enhanced.

title_en: Polyurethane fluoride-free water repellent agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyurethane fluoride-free water repellent agent and a preparation method thereof. The structural formula of the polyurethane fluorine-free water repellent is as follows:  . The fluorine-free polyurethane water repellent agent has the beneficial effects that the fluorine-free polyurethane water repellent agent prepared by the invention has a certain oil-proof effect, can keep better water repellency after being used in a high-temperature and low-temperature environment, and can keep excellent water repellency after being used under long-time ultraviolet irradiation.

title_en: Prepreg, laminate, printed wiring board, and semiconductor package
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a prepreg comprising a thermosetting resin composition and a fiber base material, wherein the prepreg has one surface and another surface on the opposite side from the one surface, and the prepreg has, starting from at least one of the one surface and the other surface, a first region which constitutes the surface of the prepreg to be the starting point and contains the thermosetting resin composition, and a second region which contains a thermosetting resin composition different from the thermosetting resin composition contained in the first region, and has a storage modulus E '(1) at 260 ℃ of a cured product of the thermosetting resin composition contained in the first region lower than a storage modulus E' (2) at 260 ℃ of a cured product of the thermosetting resin composition contained in the second region.

title_en: Preparation method and application of PEO modified PTFE film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a PEO modified PTFE film, belonging to the technical field of polymer material processing, comprising the following steps of S1, selecting a PEO raw material, adding the PEO raw material into 1, 2-dichloroethane as a solvent, finally adding water, and stirring at a high speed to obtain a mixed solution; S2, selecting PTFE dispersion materials, carrying out operations of mixing, blank making, pushing, calendaring, deoiling, stretching and shaping to obtain a single-axis stretched PTFE low-density microporous belt, S3, placing the PEO/1, 2-dichloroethane/water mixed solution obtained in the S1 into a water bath sealing heating box of surface treatment equipment, wherein the water bath temperature is 25-55 ℃, S4, placing the PTFE low-density microporous belt obtained in the S2 at the unreeling end of the PTFE low-density microporous belt of the surface treatment equipment, and pulling the PTFE low-density microporous belt into the water bath sealing heating box for surface treatment. The defect of poor bonding effect of the PTFE film and the TPU material is overcome, the problem of ageing and slag falling caused by traditional glue compounding is avoided, and the adhesive has higher bonding strength and long-term stability.

title_en: Polyether ketone polymerization equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymerization device of polyether ketone and a use method thereof, belonging to the field of polyether ketone polymerization, and comprising a feeding machine box, wherein a lifting material tray capable of lifting or descending along the longitudinal direction is arranged in the feeding machine box; and the transferring component is detachably arranged in the feeding machine box and is positioned above the jacking tray and used for clamping the jacking tray and transferring. According to the polymerization equipment of the polyether ketone and the application method of the polymerization equipment, the second electric cylinder is started through the arranged dropping component, so that when the output end of the second electric cylinder outputs, the second electric cylinder is used for driving the built-in guide pipe to move downwards to penetrate into the initiator dropping disc and be communicated with the initiator dropping disc, the second electric cylinder is used for driving the initiator dropping disc to drop into the polymerization barrel, and the initiator drops in an outer ring shape through the initiator dropping disc are led into the polymerization barrel to react with polyether ketone materials.

title_en: Method for recycling waste photovoltaic backboard polyester through click-dynamic crosslinking upgrading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling waste photovoltaic backboard polyester by click-dynamic crosslinking upgrading, and particularly relates to the field of recycling of new energy photovoltaic modules. The method comprises the following steps of crushing PET polyester plates separated from waste photovoltaic backboard, mixing with dihydric alcohol and catalyst, and heating to carry out glycolysis reaction to realize partial degradation and hydroxyl end capping of PET. The carbon-carbon double bond introduced in the repolymerization process is utilized to react with the dynamic cross-linking agent for curing, and the prepared regenerated polyester product has excellent mechanical properties and excellent reworkability. The method of the invention does not produce any waste in the polymerization process, has green and efficient reaction, has the product performance close to that of the commercial PET plastic and is easy to reprocess, can heal rapidly after cracking occurs at 80 ℃ for 15min, can reprocess into sheets at 100 ℃ after being crushed into powder for 2h, greatly reduces the recycling energy consumption, and is expected to replace commercial polyester materials partially.

title_en: Rubber hose for liquid cooling system and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sizing material for preparing a rubber hose for a liquid cooling system, which is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 55-80 parts of high-Mooney ethylene propylene diene monomer, 20-45 parts of low-Mooney ethylene propylene diene monomer, 100-150 parts of quick extrusion carbon black, 30-65 parts of paraffin oil, 3-8 parts of petroleum resin, 1-5 parts of an anti-aging agent, 2-7 parts of an adhesive, 3-8 parts of zinc oxide, 1-3 parts of stearic acid, 0.3-1.5 parts of sulfur and 3-8 parts of an accelerator. The invention also discloses a rubber hose for the liquid cooling system, which sequentially comprises an inner rubber layer, a first reinforcing layer, a first middle rubber layer, a second reinforcing layer, a second middle rubber layer, a third reinforcing layer and an outer rubber layer from inside to outside. The hose has excellent flexibility, smaller bending radius, improved flexibility and efficiency of spatial layout of the liquid cooling system, good compatibility with electronic fluoridation liquid, excellent performances of high and low temperature resistance, ozone resistance and the like, and excellent durability.

title_en: Self-polishing marine antifouling transparent coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine coatings, and provides a self-polishing marine antifouling transparent coating, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention carries out free radical polymerization reaction on monomer mixtures such as acrylic ester basic monomers, hydroxyl-containing acrylic ester monomers, acrylic silane ester monomers and the like, an initiator, a chain transfer agent and a solvent in protective gas to obtain acrylic prepolymer, and then carries out reaction on the acrylic prepolymer, a metal compound, an organic acid and the solvent to obtain hydroxyl-containing acrylic silane ester/acrylic metal salt resin, and then the acrylic silane ester/acrylic metal salt resin is mixed with a cross-linking agent and the solvent. The hydroxyl-containing acrylic silane ester/acrylic metal salt resin has a linear structure, forms self-polishing marine antifouling transparent coating under the action of a cross-linking agent, is cured into the self-polishing marine antifouling transparent coating with a three-dimensional network structure, has a transmittance of more than 80% in a 400-800 nm wave band, and can meet the requirements of various underwater equipment.

title_en: Preparation method of high-frequency high-speed BT resin-based copper-clad plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of copper-clad plates, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a high-frequency high-speed BT resin-based copper-clad plate. Wherein, the BT resin system in the copper-clad plate is added with DBA modified hollow glass microspheres. The method has the advantages that the dielectric property of the copper-clad plate can be further improved by introducing the hollow glass microspheres into the BT resin system, allyl on the surface of the hollow bead glass modified by the DBA can react with the bismaleimide, the compatibility of the hollow bead glass and the resin system is remarkably improved, and meanwhile, the DBA can play a role in chain extension in the bismaleimide resin, so that the toughness of the resin is improved. On the other hand, DBA can play a role of a catalyst in the cyanate triazination reaction, so that the temperature required by cyanate triazination can be reduced, and the processing difficulty can be reduced.

title_en: Light-heat dual-curing high-temperature-resistant resin system with long storage period at room temperature for fiber prepreg tape and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and particularly relates to a photo-thermal dual-curing high-temperature-resistant resin system for a fiber prepreg tape and a preparation method thereof, wherein the photo-thermal dual-curing high-temperature-resistant resin system comprises a high-temperature-resistant photo-crosslinking epoxy resin component, a thermal initiator component and a photoinitiator component. Under the irradiation of ultraviolet light, the photoinitiator component and the high-temperature-resistant photo-crosslinking epoxy resin component form a primary crosslinking structure, and then the thermal initiator component is completely cured in a heating mode, so that the composite material with excellent performance is obtained. The design of the photo-thermal dual-curing resin system omits the energy consumption processes of low-temperature storage, high curing temperature, long curing time and the like of the traditional resin system, effectively solves the problems of short storage period at room temperature, large energy consumption in refrigeration storage, high cost, long curing time, high curing temperature and the like of the fiber prepreg tape in the prior art, greatly improves the production efficiency and provides a new technical path for manufacturing and applying the high-performance composite material.

title_en: Solid-phase probe for marking terminal alkyne compound and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid-phase probe for marking a terminal alkyne compound, and a synthesis method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of analysis and detection. The solid-phase probe is prepared by taking cyclodextrin polymer material as a carrier, taking a molecular probe as a carrier and loading the carrier on the carrier through a host-guest recognition effect, and is marked as alpha-CDP-d  0 /d 5 -Azo-N 3 . The solid-phase probe is characterized in that a benzene ring in the structure is taken as an isotope group, an azobenzene unit is taken as a photoswitch, an imidazolium salt is taken as a mass spectrum signal enhancement tag, and an azido group is taken as a reaction group. After chemical marking, the marked product can be dissociated from the solid phase carrier under the irradiation of ultraviolet light, and the rapid detection and screening of the natural terminal alkyne compound in a complex system can be realized by combining the matrix-assisted laser desorption ionization mass spectrometry technology, so that the directional separation of the natural terminal alkyne compound is guided. The method has the characteristics of good selectivity of the terminal alkyne compound, strong mass spectrum signal of the marked product, simple operation, mild reaction conditions and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of medical-grade low-density polyethylene resin
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of medical-grade low-density polyethylene resin. The temperature peak of each reaction zone is decreased along with the increasing sequence of the reaction zones by decreasing the adding amount of the oxygen initiator along with the increasing sequence of the reaction zones, the temperature of the later reaction zone generated in the concentration of the low molecular weight component is decreased, the branching reaction rate at low temperature is decreased, especially the branching rate of the short branched chain is decreased, so that the branching degree of the low molecular weight component is decreased, and meanwhile, the chain transfer to the polymer reaction in the front reaction zone generated in the concentration of the high molecular weight component is more frequent by increasing the adding proportion of the telogen along with the increasing sequence of the reaction zones, the growth of the high molecular weight component is promoted, and the relative content of the low molecular weight component is reduced under the condition of a certain conversion rate. By combining the above methods, the aim of inhibiting the generation of soluble matters with low molecular weight and high branching degree is fulfilled, and the medical-grade low-density polyethylene resin material is prepared.

title_en: Polyethylene copolymer for film layers
abstract_en: Use of a metallocene-catalyzed multimodal medium density polyethylene (mMDPE), multimodal medium density polyethylene (mMDPE) in film applications, and films comprising mMDPE of the invention.

title_en: Curable resin composition and electronic component device
abstract_en: The first curable resin composition contains a triphenylmethane-type epoxy resin having at least one selected from the group consisting of an alkyl group and an alkoxy group. The second curable resin composition contains a triphenylmethane type epoxy resin having at least one selected from the group consisting of an alkyl group and an alkoxy group, and a polysiloxane type stress relaxation agent. The third curable resin composition has an elastic modulus at 260 ℃ of 400MPa or less when a cured product is produced, a linear expansion coefficient of 180 ℃ to 200 ℃ of 32 ppm/DEG C or more when a cured product is produced, and an adhesive strength of the cured product after being treated at 85 ℃ and 85% RH to Ag (silver) of 0.45MPa or more.

title_en: Porous ion imprinting imine adsorption material for purifying nuclear medical waste liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous ion imprinting imine adsorption material for purifying nuclear medical waste liquid and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out block copolymerization on polyamino alpha carboxylate with metal ions, rigid structural dialdehyde and a triamino cross-linking agent with flexibility through a one-step solution processing method to obtain an ionic imine material with metal ion compatibility, and carrying the ionic imine material on a matrix material with a three-dimensional porous framework through solution processing and in-situ polymerization to obtain the porous ion imprinting imine adsorption material. The porous ion imprinting imine adsorption material obtained by the invention can be used for rapid and efficient adsorption and deep purification of low-concentration lutetium-177 ions in nuclear medicine waste liquid, and has the advantages of green preparation process, large scale, no need of additional initiator and no need of high-temperature high-pressure conditions.

title_en: Method for removing phenolic compounds and metal ions in carbon dioxide-based polyol
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer purification, and discloses a method for removing phenolic compounds and metal ions in carbon dioxide-based polyol, which comprises the steps of dynamic adsorption and pressure swing desorption, wherein a combined modified activated carbon adsorbent is used for feeding in proportion, low-frequency ultrasonic waves are adopted for pre-adsorption, and then heating, mechanical stirring and dynamic monitoring are carried out on adsorption balance; and after adsorption balance, inert gas low-pressure filtration is adopted, and then inert gas medium-pressure rapid filtration is adopted. The removal rate of phenolic compounds in the purified carbon dioxide-based polyol is up to more than 99%, the concentration of metal ions is less than 2 ppm, and the carbon dioxide-based polyol with extremely high quality can be obtained efficiently and rapidly.

title_en: Degradable preservative film for fruit preservation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degradable preservative film for fruit preservation and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of preservative films. Comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 40-60 parts of polylactic acid, 15-25 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 6-12 parts of cellulose, 10-20 parts of modified chitosan and 3-9 parts of lubricant. The prepared preservative film takes polylactic acid as a matrix, and has higher transparency, heat resistance and degradability, wherein polyvinyl alcohol is a degradable material, can enhance the gas barrier property of the preservative film, wherein cellulose can enhance the heat stability and mechanical property of the preservative film, and wherein modified chitosan can enhance the antibacterial property, heat resistance, barrier property and mechanical property of the preservative film to water, and the performance is stable for a long time.

title_en: Thermal interface material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-conducting thermal interface material. The thermal interface includes a body layer and at least one adhesive layer. The body layer includes a first acrylic rubber, plasticizer particles, and first filler particles, and the first filler particles are substantially aligned in a first direction. A first adhesive layer is disposed on a first side of the host material. The first adhesive layer has a greater tackiness than the host material. The first adhesive layer includes a second acrylic rubber. The first direction is substantially perpendicular to the first surface of the first side on which the first adhesive layer is disposed.

title_en: In-situ carbon-coated cobalt-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses in-situ carbon-coated cobalt-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a metal-organic framework precursor Fe  x Mn 1‑x‑y Co y  -MOF, wherein 0< x <1,0< y <0.01, then mixing the metal-organic framework precursor with a lithium source and a phosphorus source, carrying out grinding treatment, spray drying and calcining in an inert atmosphere to obtain the in-situ carbon-coated cobalt-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate. According to the invention, uniform Co doping is formed on the manganese iron phosphate crystal lattice in situ, co element can occupy Fe position or Mn position in the manganese iron phosphate, and Co element can catalyze organic ligand to form high-conductivity carbon nano tube in situ to be inserted on the surface of in-situ carbon coated manganese iron phosphate particles in the sintering process, and the Co element and the in-situ carbon nano tube cooperate to improve conductivity, stability and compaction density of the material.

title_en: Rare earth metal doped high-temperature-resistant polyimide composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a high-temperature-resistant polyimide composite material, wherein the polyimide composite material comprises polyimide and rare earth metal oxide nano-filler, and the rare earth metal oxide nano-filler comprises rare earth metal oxide and a modifier grafted on the surface of the rare earth metal oxide. According to the invention, the temperature resistance of polyimide is obviously improved by adding the rare earth metal oxide nano filler, and the prepared polyimide composite material has excellent temperature resistance and mechanical properties.

title_en: Organic viscosity-reducing warm-mixing agent for hydraulic engineering and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic viscosity-reducing warm-mixing agent for hydraulic engineering, which sequentially comprises a core layer, an intermediate layer and an outer coating layer from inside to outside, wherein the inner core layer comprises a mixture of partially carbonized plant fibers and self-heating iron powder, the intermediate layer comprises a wax layer, and the outer coating layer comprises an EVA layer.

title_en: Waste vinegar residue auxiliary agent for polypropylene grafted cigarettes, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypropylene grafted waste vinegar residue auxiliary agent for cigarettes, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein firstly, waste vinegar residue for cigarettes is dissolved in tetrahydrofuran; then adding polypropylene grafted maleic anhydride dissolved in dimethylbenzene into the solution to carry out grafting reaction, precipitating, washing and drying to obtain plasticization and compatibility integrated auxiliary agent polypropylene grafted waste vinegar residues for cigarettes, adding bamboo powder into tetrahydrofuran, adding triethylamine and phthaloyl chloride into the suspension to carry out reaction, precipitating, washing and drying to obtain hydrophobically modified bamboo powder, and finally, applying the auxiliary agent to melt extrusion of polypropylene/modified bamboo powder to obtain master batch. The invention utilizes the waste vinegar residues for cigarettes to prepare the plasticizing and compatible integrated auxiliary agent, realizes the technical innovation of waste recycling, and applies the auxiliary agent to the melt extrusion of polypropylene/modified bamboo powder to obtain master batch with improved mechanical property and thermodynamic property.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid hydrogel based on copper ion crosslinking modification and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hyaluronic acid hydrogel based on copper ion crosslinking modification, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. Dissolving Cu  2+  in sterile deionized water to obtain Cu  2+  solution, adding hyaluronic acid into Cu  2+  solution, mixing to obtain Cu  2+  liquid hydrogel, adding a cross-linking agent into Cu  2+  liquid hydrogel, mixing, crosslinking in dark, and cleaning to obtain the modified hyaluronic acid hydrogel based on copper ion crosslinking. The preparation method has the advantages of mild condition, simple method, few reagents, no severe reaction, low cost and easy realization of industrialization, and the prepared hyaluronic acid hydrogel has excellent degradation resistance, excellent mechanical property, good biocompatibility and long in vivo duration, and is suitable for the scenes such as subcutaneous filling in the biomedical material field.

title_en: Benzoxazine resin based on protocatechuic acid and synthesis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protocatechuic acid-based benzoxazine resin and synthesis and application thereof, wherein protocatechuic acid is used as a raw material, furfuryl amine is firstly used for amidation, and then a protocatechuic acid-based benzoxazine monomer (NDBA-fa) is synthesized by a one-pot method with furfuryl amine and paraformaldehyde, and the resin monomer can be independently solidified to form the protocatechuic acid benzoxazine resin. When NDBA-fa is used for reinforcing the bisphenol A-aniline benzoxazine (BA-a) and the mass content is 7.5%, the glass transition temperature T  g , the thermal decomposition temperature T  d5% 、T d10%  and the carbon residue rate of the cured resin are respectively increased by 21 ℃, 14 ℃, 23 ℃ and 16.8%, and the heat release capacity HRC is reduced by 76.3 Jg  ‑1 K ‑1 . The protocatechuic acid base benzoxazine monomer provided by the invention can be used as a novel modifier, and can effectively improve the thermal stability and flame retardant property of BA-a. Also widens the application range of biological resources.

title_en: Scratch-resistant and wear-resistant overhead cable and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scratch-resistant and wear-resistant overhead cable and a production process thereof, which relate to the field of overhead cables and comprise a conductor, an insulating layer and a sheath layer from inside to outside, wherein the sheath layer comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 60-80 parts of polyurethane resin, 15-25 parts of heat conducting filler, 10-15 parts of flame retardant, 0.8-1.0 part of ultraviolet absorbent and 1-1.5 parts of hydrolysis-resistant agent. The polyurethane-based cable sheath material has excellent wear resistance and meets the use requirement of scratch resistance and wear resistance of the overhead cable. The synthesized heat conducting filler comprises boron nitride, phenothiazine structure, secondary hydroxyl and the like, and improves the heat dissipation, mechanical property and ageing resistance of the cable. The synthesized hydrolysis resisting agent comprises a polyurethane structure, a polymerized carbodiimide structure and a polysilicone chain, so that the hydrolysis resistance and the heat resistance of the cable are improved.

title_en: High-adhesion moisture-heat-resistant yellowing-resistant photovoltaic adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-adhesion moisture-heat-resistant yellowing-resistant photovoltaic adhesive and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-adhesion moisture-heat-resistant yellowing-resistant photovoltaic adhesive comprises, by weight, 40-60 parts of photo-curing acrylic ester, 34-44 parts of reactive diluents, 0.5-4 parts of photoinitiators, 0.05-3.5 parts of first polymerization inhibitors and 1-6 parts of auxiliary agents, and the photo-curing acrylic ester has the structure shown in the specification, wherein A- (B-C)  x  is a heterocyclic compound containing urea bonds, B is an alicyclic diisocyanate monomer, C is a hydroxyl-containing acrylic acid derivative, and x is from 1 to 5. The photovoltaic adhesive disclosed by the application can meet the general requirements of the photovoltaic adhesive, has high adhesive force, moisture and heat resistance, ageing resistance and yellowing resistance, and is matched with a low-temperature tin-coated welding strip, so that double fixing of the welding strip and a battery piece is realized, the stripping force between the welding strip and the battery piece is greatly improved, the traditional infrared and external thermal welding is replaced, and the realizability is provided for lightening and thinning of the battery piece at the component end and reducing the cost and the energy.

title_en: Anti-aging modified asphalt composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging modified asphalt composition and a preparation method thereof. The anti-aging modified asphalt composition comprises, by weight, 100 parts of matrix asphalt, 2-13 parts of a polymer modifier, 0.1-1 part of a vulcanizing agent and 0.01-0.3 part of a vulcanization accelerator, wherein the polymer modifier comprises SBS and a monomer compound. The anti-aging modified asphalt composition can effectively inhibit the aging process of asphalt under the photo-thermal condition, does not generate physical migration and volatilization of an anti-aging agent, has good compatibility with additives, and can ensure that the modified asphalt is not easy to rut at high temperature and not easy to frost crack at low temperature.

title_en: Polymer drug-loaded nano-particle with targeting function and double response, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a dual-response polymer drug-loaded nanoparticle with targeting function, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a polymer drug-loaded nanoparticle with targeting function and double response, which is characterized in that a core-shell structure acid-responsive double drug small molecule is positioned in a core layer and is coated outside, wherein the polymer nanoparticle consists of an active oxygen-responsive amphiphilic block copolymer A and a targeting amphiphilic block copolymer B. The acid-responsive double-drug and polymer self-assemble to form the double-responsive polymer drug-carrying nano-particle with the targeting function, the targeting aggregation is carried out on the over-expressed glycoprotein pathological change part, and the responsive release is realized in the active oxygen and acid environment, so that the material has better therapeutic function and biological safety. The preparation method is simple and has potential of clinical transformation.

title_en: Xylylene diisocyanate composition, xylylene diisocyanate modified composition, polymerizable composition, resin, molded article, optical element, and lens
abstract_en: The xylylene diisocyanate composition contains xylylene diisocyanate and a compound having a retention time of 14.0 minutes to 14.6 minutes when measured by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry under specific measurement conditions, and the content ratio of the compound is adjusted to 2000ppm or less.

title_en: Biochar-based toughened composite material for PLA and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material preparation, in particular to a biochar-based toughened composite material for PLA and a preparation method thereof. The composite material consists of biochar and methyl methacrylate polymer, wherein the mass ratio of the biochar to the methyl methacrylate polymer is 2:5. The invention utilizes the characteristic of good compatibility of MMA and biodegradable resin, and effectively solves the problem that the biochar is incompatible with the biodegradable resin by constructing a soft phase (MMA unit) on the surface of a hard phase (biochar), so that the mechanical property and the thermal stability of the biodegradable resin can be effectively improved, the application field of the biodegradable resin is expanded, the durability of the biodegradable resin is improved, and the application competitiveness of the biodegradable resin and petroleum-based materials is enhanced.

title_en: Antibacterial composite hydrogel loaded with nano particles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibacterial composite hydrogel loaded with nano particles, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a hydrogel network main body is formed by grafting phenylboronic acid to methacryloyl type I collagen rCol MA-PBA and methacryloyl polylysine EPLMA, adding glucose oxidase GoX and crosslinking, and simultaneously, the antibacterial composite hydrogel is loaded with core-shell nano enzyme C@Z@T, and the core-shell nano enzyme C@Z@T consists of a spherical CeO  2  nano particle core, a zeolite imidazole ester framework material TIF-8 shell and tannic acid TA coated on the shell. The hydrogel has the advantages of easy acquisition of raw materials, simple preparation method, low price, safe and reliable components, integrates the functions of resisting bacteria, resisting inflammation, resisting oxidation, promoting angiogenesis and the like, provides a more comprehensive treatment effect, and can be used for healing the wound surface of diabetes.

title_en: Polymer manufacturing process using poly (aryl ether sulfone) as reactant
abstract_en: A process for the manufacture of a polyarylethersulfone 'PAES' (P2) using recycled polymeric material is disclosed, the process comprising heating a Reaction Medium (RM) comprising recycled polymeric material comprising the polyarylethersulfone 'PAES' (P1), at least one monomer (M), an alkaline salt former (A) and a polar aprotic solvent (S) to a reaction temperature of at least 150 ℃ to form PAES (P2), and separating the formed PAES (P2) from the reaction medium. The PAES (P1) recycle ratio may be 100wt.% to 1wt.%. The recycled polymeric material added to the reaction medium may further include other one or more polymers, solid fillers, and/or additives. The monomer (M) may be at least one aromatic diol monomer (AA) and/or at least one aromatic dihalo monomer (BB). The diol (AA) may comprise bisphenol a, bisphenol S, biphenol, 1,4:3, 6-dianhydrohexitol sugar diol and/or tetramethyl bisphenol F, and the dihalo (BB) may comprise non-sulfonated and/or disulfonated dihalodiphenyl sulfone.

title_en: Extrusion blow molding foaming polyethylene product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extrusion blow molding foaming polyethylene product and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of packaging materials. The extrusion blow molding foaming polyethylene product comprises the following components, by weight, 1-3% of foaming agent master batch, 93-96% of matrix resin and 3-4% of color master batch. The foaming agent master batch comprises, by weight, 45-60% of an ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer and 40-55% of a core-shell type thermal expansion foaming agent. The invention provides an extrusion blow molding foaming polyethylene product and a preparation method thereof, wherein in the blow molding process, a core-shell type thermal expansion foaming agent shell is softened, alkane of a core is gasified and expanded, the expanded shell is cooled and shaped, and bubbles with the diameter smaller than 100 mu m are formed in the product, so that the foaming effect is achieved, and the purpose of reducing the use of plastic materials is achieved.

title_en: Sizing material for new energy battery edge banding and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rubber material for a new energy battery edge sealing strip and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of rubber materials for battery edge sealing strips, and comprising the following raw materials, by weight, 79-119 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber, 110-140 parts of graphene powder, 26-46 parts of heavy calcium, 16-36 parts of light calcium, 48-68 parts of paraffin oil, 4-8 parts of nano silicon dioxide, 0.5-2 parts of stearic acid, 10-15 parts of melamine-urea-glucose (MUG) and 4.6-12.8 parts of an auxiliary agent. Through the mode, the rubber material disclosed by the invention has excellent basic physical properties, good compression set performance, good ozone resistance, excellent high and low temperature resistance and strong copper corrosion resistance, and is suitable for being used as a rubber material for the edge sealing strip of a new energy battery.

title_en: Preparation method and application of antibacterial graphene modified polystyrene plastic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polystyrene, and discloses antibacterial graphene modified polystyrene plastic, wherein a bromine atom of bromobutyl triphenyl phosphonium bromide and one hydroxyl of polyalcohol are subjected to nucleophilic substitution reaction to obtain hydroxyl-terminated triphenyl phosphonium bromide, the hydroxyl-terminated triphenyl phosphonium bromide is used as a quaternary phosphonium salt antibacterial monomer, a plurality of hydroxyl groups contained at the chain end of the hydroxyl-terminated triphenyl phosphonium bromide can be added to increase reaction sites and accelerate esterification reaction with acyl chloride groups of graphene, so that the quaternary phosphonium salt antibacterial monomer is chemically bonded to the surface of the graphene to obtain functionalized graphene with high antibacterial activity, and the surface-modified triphenyl phosphonium bromide of the graphene contains a large amount of benzene ring structures similar to the polarity of styrene, so that the interfacial affinity and compatibility of the graphene and the polystyrene can be improved, the dispersion of the graphene can be promoted, the aggregation phenomenon can be reduced, and the excellent antibacterial performance and tensile strength of the polystyrene can be endowed.

title_en: High-barrier fresh-keeping low-temperature heat-sealing composite film and manufacturing process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-barrier fresh-keeping low-temperature heat sealing composite film and a manufacturing process and application thereof, the composite film comprises an inner layer, a heat sealing layer, a barrier layer, a reinforcing layer and a surface treatment layer in sequence from the inner layer to the outer layer, wherein the layers are bonded through an adhesive layer. The heat sealing layer is made of modified polyethylene, polypropylene and heat sealing auxiliary agent, and the barrier layer is made of composite material of nano alumina, polyvinylidene fluoride and ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer. The reinforcing layer is made of polyester film, and the surface treatment layer is subjected to corona treatment. The composite film is prepared by a specific manufacturing process, and comprises the steps of preparing a heat sealing layer and a barrier layer, compounding, curing, surface treatment and the like. The composite film has excellent barrier property and low-temperature heat sealing capability, is suitable for vacuum packaging or modified atmosphere packaging of foods, and effectively prolongs the fresh-keeping period and the shelf life of the foods.

title_en: Preparation method and application of migration-resistant composite anti-aging agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a migration-resistant composite anti-aging agent. The carboxyl of the hindered phenol antioxidant is activated and chemically reacts with the benzophenone ultraviolet absorbent to obtain the novel anti-aging agent with hindered phenol hydroxyl and ultraviolet absorbing groups in the structure. The anti-aging agent provided by the invention further plays the ultraviolet absorption capability of the benzophenone compound on the basis of fully utilizing the free radical capturing capability of the hindered phenolic hydroxyl, and simultaneously, the chemical synthesis of the hindered phenolic hydroxyl and the anti-aging agent enables the substituent on the benzophenone to be changed from an electron withdrawing group to an electron donating group, so that the ultraviolet absorption capability and stability of the benzophenone compound are enhanced, and the anti-aging agent has an excellent anti-aging effect in the use process of the high polymer material. The chemical reaction of the two compounds improves the migration resistance and the ultraviolet absorption capacity of the anti-aging agent, and prolongs the service life of the anti-aging agent in the high polymer material. The anti-aging agent has the advantages of simple process preparation, migration resistance, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Trimercaptotriazine trisodium salt corrosion inhibition bactericide, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trimercapto triazine trisodium salt corrosion inhibition bactericide, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of corrosion inhibition bactericide synthesis. The invention takes cyanuric acid as a raw material, successfully grafts carbon-carbon double bond by reacting with bromopropene to generate an intermediate 2, 4-dimercapto-6-mercaptopropenyl-1, 3, 5-triazine monomer, then carries out polymerization reaction with allylthiourea, adds an initiator under the protection of nitrogen, and heats, stirs, purifies and dries in a water bath kettle to prepare the corrosion inhibition bactericide.

title_en: Method for preparing flame-retardant bamboo shaving board by using soybean oil-based adhesive
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing flame-retardant bamboo shaving board by using soybean oil-based adhesive, which comprises the steps of adding 1, 3-butanediol dimethacrylate, epoxidized soybean oil acrylic ester, isocyanatoethyl methacrylate and an initiator into a single-neck flask according to mass ratio, mechanically stirring at room temperature, uniformly mixing to prepare the soybean oil-based adhesive, uniformly mixing the obtained adhesive, dried bamboo shavings and flame retardant, and performing hot press molding to obtain the flame-retardant bamboo shaving board. The flame-retardant bamboo shaving board prepared by the invention has the advantages of environment-friendly raw material sources, formaldehyde-free adhesive, good static bending strength, internal bonding strength, water resistance and flame retardance.

title_en: Polyester three-effect functional modification auxiliary agent, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polyester three-effect functional modified auxiliary agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the scheme comprises the steps of synthesizing a single-layer MoS  2  nano sheet by a space domain-limiting method, mixing with an ethylene glycol solution, adding dihydroxydiethyl phthalate-5-sodium sulfonate for grafting reaction, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the auxiliary agent. The preparation method of the auxiliary agent has definite parameters of each step, and can ensure the synthesis, effective grafting and the like of the nano-sheet with high single-layer rate. The auxiliary agent can be dispersed in various polymer liquid monomer media, and the functionalized polymer nano composite material is synthesized through in-situ polymerization. Solves the problems of single function, poor dispersibility and the like of the prior polyester functional modification auxiliary agent, endows the polyester material with three effects of photo-thermal, antibacterial and stock solution coloring, is suitable for modifying various polyester and related polymer materials, realizes product upgrading on the basis of not changing the prior process, widens the application market, improves the added value of the product, and has important industrial application value and market prospect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of amino acid polymer nucleic acid vector
abstract_en: The invention provides an amino acid polymer with a structure shown in a formula I, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The polymer provided by the invention is prepared by introducing an amino acid monomer into a Linear Polyethyleneimine (LPEI) side chain. The polymer provided by the invention is used as a nucleic acid drug delivery carrier, has simple components, can realize high-efficiency nucleic acid delivery by a single-component carrier, and shows excellent transfection efficiency and biocompatibility;

title_en: Novel medical developing catheter, developing mark, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of implantation intervention medical instruments, and relates to a novel medical developing catheter, a developing mark, a preparation method and application thereof. The developing mark is prepared from 10 parts of high polymer material and 3-6 parts of developing auxiliary agent by blending granulation, secondary melt extrusion and sample aging, and is fixedly arranged on a medical catheter body through a welding, rheological or bonding process, the bonding process is simple, the bonding firmness is high, and the problems of displacement and falling off of the developing mark and the catheter body when the medical catheter passes through a narrow human body cavity are avoided. The polymer material comprises polyurethane, nylon elastomer or polyvinyl chloride, and the developing aid comprises tungsten powder, barium powder or bismuth powder with the particle size of 0.01-0.05 mu m. Under the detection of X-ray or other imaging technologies, the developing effect of the developing mark is equivalent to that of a metal developing ring, and the developing mark can replace the existing metal developing ring, so that the material cost and the processing application difficulty are reduced. The novel medical developing catheter has the developing and hydrophilic lubricating functions.

title_en: Hyperbranched polyamide containing methylpiperazine and polytrianiline structures, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Hyperbranched polyamide containing methylpiperazine and polytrianiline structures, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention relates to monomers containing methylpiperazine and triphenylamine cores: the invention relates to a preparation method and application of N1, N1-bis (4-aminophenyl) -N4- (bis (4-aminophenylamino) phenyl) 4- (4-methyloxazin-1-yl) benzene) phenyl-1, 4-diamine and hyperbranched polyamide, which aims to solve the problems of low solubility, poor thermal stability, single color change, low optical contrast and poor electrochemical stability of triphenylamine polyamide materials in organic solvents, and is used for introducing methylpiperazine electron donating groups and multiple electroactive centers in a molecular design process and synthesizing hyperbranched polyamide, so that the color change capability and the cyclic stability of the polymer are improved.

title_en: Method for synthesizing cellulose ester by taking acidic ionic liquid as catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing cellulose ester by using acidic ionic liquid as a catalyst, which comprises the steps of constant-temperature activation, esterification, hydrolysis and post-treatment. The 1, 8-diazabicyclo [5.4.0] undec-7-ene-sulfuric acid [ DBUH  + ][HSO 4   ‑  ], triethylbenzyl-sulfuric acid [ N  B222 H + ][HSO 4   ‑  ] and tetramethylguanidine-sulfuric acid [ TMGH  + ][HSO 4   ‑  ] acidic ionic liquid catalyst synthesized by the method has low cost and is easy to synthesize. The catalyst can be simultaneously used for the synthesis process of cellulose acetate, cellulose acetate propionate and cellulose acetate butyrate, and the synthesized cellulose acetate, cellulose acetate propionate and cellulose acetate butyrate have excellent performance, and the catalyst has high thermal stability and low volatility, is easy to recycle, reduces the production and treatment cost of pollutants, overcomes the problems of serious corrosiveness and difficult repeated use of the traditional sulfuric acid catalyst, and has important significance for promoting the green and efficient production of cellulose acetate, cellulose acetate propionate and cellulose acetate butyrate.

title_en: Preparation method of optical transparent bio-based nylon 510 polymer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer material transparent nylon, and discloses a preparation method of an optical transparent bio-based nylon 510 polymer. The preparation method comprises the following steps of mixing nylon 510 salt, a catalyst, an antioxidant, imidazole ionic liquid and a solvent, sequentially carrying out prepolymerization and melt polymerization, and then carrying out low-temperature treatment to obtain the optical transparent bio-based nylon. The optical transparent bio-based nylon 510 polymer prepared by the method has the light transmittance reaching 85-90%, the tensile strength reaching 65-70 MPa, and excellent mechanical strength and high transparency.

title_en: Injectable hydrogel, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an injectable hydrogel, a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical-physical double-network crosslinked hydrogel is prepared by adopting a blending solution with magnesium acrylate, carboxymethyl chitosan and phytic acid as main components. Wherein the covalent cross-linking is derived from a magnesium polyacrylate network constructed by free radical polymerization. Non-covalent cross-linking results from hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions between components in the interpenetrating network, and gradually induces the formation of a entangled network of carboxymethyl chitosan chains during application in a physiological environment. In the preparation process, the pH value of the reaction system is controlled by controlling the concentration of phytic acid, and magnesium ions are chelated so as to control the structural strength of the hydrogel, thereby achieving the injectable effect. Meanwhile, the phytic acid can chelate proteins and enhance the adhesiveness of the proteins to tissues. The preparation process is simple and convenient, is easy to control and realize large-scale industrial production, and all raw materials are easy to obtain and low in cost. The hydrogels have high adhesion efficiency and wet adhesion strength to tissue.

title_en: Wood lacquer coating composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a wood lacquer coating composition, and relates to the technical field of wood lacquer. The wood lacquer coating composition comprises a component A and a component B according to a molar equivalent ratio of 1:1-1.1, wherein the raw material component of the component A comprises a composite aspartic ester resin composed of a first aspartic ester resin and a second aspartic ester resin, the weight ratio of the second aspartic ester resin in the composite aspartic ester resin is 10-40%, the first aspartic ester resin is bifunctional aspartic ester, the second aspartic ester resin is monofunctional aspartic ester, the viscosity is low, and the component B is isocyanate curing agent. The coating cured by the wood lacquer coating composition has the advantages of good water resistance, heat resistance, aging resistance, dirt resistance, hand feeling and the like.

title_en: Damping solid buoyancy material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a damping solid buoyancy material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the buoyancy material comprises, by weight, 100 parts of matrix resin, 30-120 parts of a curing agent, 5-20 parts of a diluent, 1-5 parts of an anti-settling agent, 1-5 parts of a defoaming agent and 50-140 parts of composite hollow glass beads; the method comprises the steps of preparing a prefabricated body, preparing a finished product, preparing buoyancy material slurry, placing the buoyancy material slurry into a mold, heating and curing the mold into a baking oven for molding, demolding to obtain the required damping solid buoyancy material, and effectively enhancing the interface acting force between all components in the buoyancy material, simplifying the preparation method of the buoyancy material, reducing the preparation cost of the buoyancy material, improving the preparation efficiency of the buoyancy material and improving the damping performance of the buoyancy material.

title_en: Low-stress optical transparent pressure-sensitive adhesive composition suitable for full lamination of large-size display module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-stress optical transparent pressure-sensitive adhesive composition suitable for full lamination of a large-size display module and a preparation method thereof.
