The low-stress optical transparent pressure-sensitive adhesive composition suitable for full lamination of large-size display modules comprises 30-50 parts of polyurethane prepolymer blocked by partial acrylic ester, 15-40 parts of acrylic ester monomer with low glass transition temperature, 5-30 parts of acrylic ester monomer with high glass transition temperature, 5-30 parts of functional acrylic ester monomer, 0.5-2 parts of photoinitiator, 0.1-1 part of mercaptan chain transfer agent and 2-5 parts of anti-aging agent. The invention also provides a preparation method of the low-stress optical transparent pressure-sensitive adhesive for full lamination of the large-size display module. The pressure-sensitive adhesive composition has extremely low bonding stress and proper peeling strength, the bonding stress is further reduced after the mercaptan chain transfer agent is added, the peeling strength is obviously increased, and the pressure-sensitive adhesive composition is suitable for the full bonding process of the large-size display module sensitive to stress.

title_en: Application of charge crosslinked carrier as tumor chemotherapeutic medicine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-carrier based on charge crosslinking, a preparation method thereof and application thereof as a tumor chemotherapeutic drug. The nano carrier is formed by assembling two polymer chains with positive and negative charges through electrostatic action, the precursor ligand on the polymer chain B releases an organic ligand under exogenous or endogenous stimulation, and competing for metal ions on the positive charge polymer chain A to generate a metal complex in situ, and meanwhile, the electrostatic action of the nano carrier is weakened, so that the nano carrier is dissociated, the polymer chain B containing the organic ligand is released, and the effect of tumor chemotherapy or immunoregulation is exerted. The method has the advantages of simple operation, short time consumption, mild reaction conditions, good biocompatibility and high safety. In some embodiments, the drug effect experiments show that the nano-carrier can effectively kill breast cancer and induce cell immunogenicity death, and inhibit tumor cell metastasis, thereby providing a new thought and means for the clinical problem of breast cancer lung metastasis which is to be solved urgently.

title_en: Preparation method of high-toughness NDI-based fluorescent polyurea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polymer preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of high-toughness NDI-based fluorescent polyurea, which takes NDI, polyetheramine, TEPA and IPDI as raw materials, utilizes the rapid reaction of isocyanate and amino to enable NDI, polyetheramine and TEPA to construct a main chain under mild conditions, utilizes the reaction of diisocyanate and secondary amine to enable the main chain to be crosslinked, and the difference of hydrogen bond and covalent bond fracture energy to form a gradient energy dissipation mechanism, so that the toughness of the material is greatly improved, and the hydrogen bond and covalent bond crosslinking limit the movement of a plane rigid conjugated structure, so that non-radiative transition is weakened, the radiative transition is enhanced, and the fluorescent property is enhanced. The preparation method of the high-toughness fluorescent polyurea is novel, and the prepared polyurea has the characteristics of ultrahigh toughness and fluorescence, and the cost of the selected raw materials is low, so that the high-toughness fluorescent polyurea has a wide market prospect. Simple steps, convenient operation and strong practicability.

title_en: Low-dielectric high-flame-retardance cable material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cables, and relates to a low-dielectric high-flame-retardance cable material, a preparation method and application thereof. The cable material adopts the components of polyolefin resin, fluorinated resin, naphthenic oil, fluorinated PPO, composite halogen-free flame retardant, antioxidant, dispersing agent and the like in a specific proportion, and by accurately controlling the content of each component, the dielectric constant and dielectric loss of the cable material are reduced, the flame retardant property of the cable material is greatly improved, particularly the mixed use of hydrogenated styrene-butadiene block copolymer (SEBS) and polypropylene, and the filling of naphthenic oil effectively improves the processability and mechanical strength of the material.

title_en: Bending-resistant transparent polyamide-imide film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flexible display materials, and discloses a bending-resistant transparent polyamide-imide film, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving dianhydride monomers in diamine solution for polymerization reaction to obtain polyamide acid solution, adding monovalent alkali metal salt and acyl chloride monomers into the polyamide acid solution for copolymerization to obtain precursor solution, adding dehydrating agent and catalyst into the precursor solution, dehydrating imidization to obtain polyamide-imide solution, mixing the polyamide-imide solution with precipitant for precipitation to obtain polyamide-imide solid, dissolving the polyamide-imide solid in polar organic solvent, adding multivalent alkaline earth metal salt to obtain multi-coordinated polyamide-imide solution, coating the multi-coordinated polyamide-imide solution on the surface of a substrate, heating for solidification, and demoulding. The transparent polyamide-imide film prepared by the application has the tensile strength of 160MPa at most, the transmittance at the wavelength of 550nm of more than 88 percent, the yellowness value of <3, and can be bent for 200,000 times without breaking under the condition that the bending radius is 0.5 mm.

title_en: High-performance granulation oil, preparation method thereof and method for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of granulation oil, and particularly discloses high-performance granulation oil, a preparation method thereof and a method for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles. A process for preparing high-performance granulating oil includes such steps as mixing polyvinyl alcohol, emulsifier, defoaming agent and water to obtain basic liquid, 2) dissolving polyethanediol and cyclodextrin derivative in solvent, adding diisocyanate to perform the first-stage reaction, adding polybasic aldehyde to perform the second-stage reaction, washing, drying to obtain component A, mixing sodium tetraborate, polyose and quaternary phosphorus alkali, regulating pH value to be weak alkali, adding micro powder of rubber vulcanization accelerator, mixing to obtain component B, and mixing basic liquid, component A and component B. The high-performance granulation oil prepared by the application is used for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles, and has the advantages of good granulation effect, uniform particle size distribution and difficult powder falling.

title_en: Aryl piperidine type anion exchange membrane containing electron-rich branched monomer, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of alkaline anion exchange membranes, and discloses an aryl piperidine type anion exchange membrane containing electron-rich branched monomers, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, an electron-rich branched monomer is firstly introduced to be copolymerized with aryl piperidine, and then a piperidine ring of N-methyl-4-piperidone is directly used as a grafting site to quaternize a polymer, so that a membrane material is obtained and a membrane is prepared. The introduced branched monomer can play a role of enriching ion clusters, can improve the ion conductivity of the polymer, contains the branched monomer rich in pi electrons, can enhance the pi-pi conjugation of the polymer, can reduce the swelling rate of the polymer, and can be applied to alkaline fuel cells and alkaline electrolyzed water.

title_en: Application of myrtle polysaccharide P6 in preparation of antibacterial and antioxidant drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of myrtle polysaccharide P6 in preparation of antibacterial and antioxidant drugs, wherein the myrtle polysaccharide P6 comprises, by mole, 4.97% of rhamnose, 11.32% of arabinose, 4.64% of galactose, 4.43% of glucose, 74.63% of galacturonic acid, a number average molecular weight (Mn) of 36.96kDa and a weight average molecular weight (Mw) of 59.15kDa. The invention discovers that the myrtle polysaccharide has antibacterial and antioxidant effects, and expands the potential application range of the myrtle polysaccharide.

title_en: Blending modified fluorine-free foaming plate of regenerated polyethylene, regenerated EVA and recovered leftover materials and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated polyethylene, regenerated EVA and recycled leftover material blending modified fluoride-free foaming plate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following components, by weight, 30-40 parts of regenerated polyethylene, 20-25 parts of regenerated EVA particles, 30-35 parts of recycled variegated leftover particles, 2-7.5 parts of alkaline agent, 10-15 parts of filling material, 0.8-4 parts of stability accelerator, 1.5-6 parts of foaming agent, 0.1-0.5 part of antioxidant and 0.1-0.5 part of weather resistant agent. The invention has the beneficial effects of 1) high cost performance and easy processing, 2) no toxicity of the product, and detection results show that the product meets European Union detection standards.

title_en: Super-tough PC/PBT alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a super-tough PC/PBT alloy, and a preparation method and application thereof. The super-tough PC/PBT alloy provided by the invention comprises polycarbonate resin, polybutylene terephthalate resin, a composite toughening agent, an antioxidant and a lubricant, wherein the composite toughening agent is formed into elastomer pellets in the super-tough PC/PBT alloy through melt extrusion, and the composite toughening agent consists of 20-95wt% of toughening agent A, 3-30wt% of toughening agent B and 0.1-2wt% of coupling agent C. According to the invention, the inorganic micro-nano particles are used as the synergistic toughening agent, so that the toughening efficiency is improved, the use amount of the organic toughening agent is reduced, the ratio of PC resin in PC/PBT alloy is reduced, the production cost is saved, and huge benefits are provided for enterprise cost reduction and synergy. The super-tough PC/PBT alloy provided by the invention has excellent ductility and high notch impact strength, and can meet the performance use requirements of materials in the field of safety helmet shells.

title_en: Polyalkylene carbonate resin composition and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyalkylene carbonate resin composition having excellent thermal stability and a method for preparing the same. The polyalkylene carbonate resin composition comprises a polyalkylene carbonate, an organic acid, and at least one additive selected from an antioxidant and a hydrolysis inhibitor. The content of the organic acid is 0.001 parts by weight or more and less than 0.5 parts by weight relative to 100 parts by weight of the polyalkylene carbonate.

title_en: Pavement rapid repair material, preparation method thereof and asphalt concrete
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pavement quick repair material, a preparation method thereof and asphalt concrete, which belong to the technical field of asphalt concrete and are characterized by comprising, by weight, 180-200 parts of self-made multifunctional emulsified asphalt, 15-20 parts of polybutene-styrene latex, 10-15 parts of polyvinyl acetate emulsion, 8-12 parts of self-made silicone hydrogel, 8-12 parts of basalt fiber, 0.5-0.9 part of dodecyl trimethoxy silane and 0.5-1.5 part of dodecanol ester. The pavement quick repairing material provided by the invention is prepared by mixing the material with aggregate at normal temperature, filling the mixture into a part of a pavement to be repaired, has no pollution to the environment, does not need special machinery, can be used for immediately repairing a pavement after being rolled by a road roller, can be used for constructing both a rainy day and a wet pavement, can be used for quickly repairing the pavement, has good stability after being used for repairing the pavement, does not generate early damage, has excellent high-temperature, low-temperature, bonding and durability, and has a wide application prospect in quick repairing of asphalt concrete and the pavement.

title_en: Double-layer composite microcapsule applicable to asphalt surface layer and capable of self-repairing high-energy-storage ice and snow resistance, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Double-layer composite microcapsule with self-repairing high energy storage and ice and snow resistance suitable for asphalt surface layer and its preparation process and application. The self-repairing microcapsule for the asphalt pavement solves the technical problems that an existing core material for the self-repairing microcapsule for the asphalt pavement is poor in releasing and self-healing effects, unstable in shell wall material, low in heat conductivity, easy to leak and single in function. The double-layer composite microcapsule comprises an internal phase change microcapsule core, an internal phase change microcapsule shell, an external self-repairing microcapsule core and an external self-repairing microcapsule shell from inside to outside in sequence, wherein the internal phase change microcapsule core is prepared by n-octanoic acid and tetradecane, the internal phase change microcapsule shell is prepared by a carbon nano tube and a double polymer, the external self-repairing microcapsule core is prepared by biological oil and a carbon nano tube, and the external self-repairing microcapsule shell is prepared by a carbon nano tube and a double polymer. Compared with a common asphalt pavement, the healing index of the surface layer of the asphalt pavement prepared by the double-layer composite microcapsule is improved by 8.1% -26.3%. Can be used in the highway field.

title_en: Flame-retardant core material of aluminum-plastic plate and aluminum-plastic plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, in particular to an aluminum-plastic plate flame-retardant core material and an aluminum-plastic plate. The aluminum-plastic plate flame-retardant core material comprises, by weight, 35-50 parts of a base material, 30-40 parts of magnesium hydroxide, 6-11 parts of a synergist, 0.5-3 parts of a dispersing agent, 2-3 parts of a coupling agent, 0.5-1 part of an antioxidant, 1-2 parts of a compatilizer and 6-10 parts of an inorganic filler, wherein the synergist comprises a phosphate flame retardant and zinc borate. According to the aluminum-plastic plate flame-retardant core material, the magnesium hydroxide, the phosphate flame retardant and the zinc borate form a ternary flame-retardant system, so that the flame retardant property can be effectively improved, the consumption of the magnesium hydroxide is reduced, and the strength of the core material is maintained.

title_en: Long carbon chain polyamide resin composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a long carbon chain polyamide resin composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the long carbon chain polyamide resin composition comprises, by weight, 35-70 parts of long carbon chain polyamide resin, 4-22 parts of reinforcing filler, 10-40 parts of porcelain forming filler and 2.5-22 parts of ablative filler, and the porcelain forming filler comprises boron nitride and/or aluminum nitride. In the invention, the long carbon chain polyamide resin composition has good ablation resistance, flame retardance and mechanical property, and is easy to extrude and process.

title_en: Resin composition, prepreg and printed circuit board
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a resin composition, a prepreg and a printed circuit board. The resin composition comprises 40-80 parts of prepolymer, 10-50 parts of curing agent, 30-70 parts of epoxy resin, 1-10 parts of imidazole compound and 50-150 parts of filler, wherein the preparation raw materials of the prepolymer comprise maleimide resin and amino-containing fluorenyl compound, the maleimide resin comprises one or more of the structural compounds shown in the formula (I), and the amino-containing fluorenyl compound comprises one or more of the structural compounds shown in the formula (II). The resin composition provided by the application adopts the prepolymer modified by maleimide resin, has good compatibility with epoxy resin, can effectively reduce the addition of filler, further can ensure the processing performance, and has excellent heat resistance.

title_en: Interface treating agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interface treating agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the interface treating agent is mainly prepared from the following components in parts by mass:  The invention overcomes the defect of poor cell closing effect and bonding durability existing in the prior interface mortar or ceramic tile interface agent, adopts the rigid acrylic composite emulsion as a core cementing material, adopts quartz sand with different preferential grades as aggregate, and adopts heavy calcium carbonate with preferential mesh number and preferential functional auxiliary agent in the system, thereby having the advantages of being suitable for filling and reinforcing the foamed ceramic, good cell closing effect and good bonding durability.

title_en: Pour point depressing wax-proofing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pour point depressing and wax preventing agents, in particular to a pour point depressing and wax preventing agent, a preparation method and application thereof. The conventional polymer type pour point depressing and wax preventing agent can increase the viscosity of crude oil while exerting the pour point depressing and wax preventing effects, obviously increase the resistance of crude oil pipeline transportation and improve the energy consumption. Aiming at the technical problems, the invention provides a pour point depressing and wax preventing agent, which is obtained by grafting alkyl acrylamide on the surface of a sulfhydryl nanosphere, wherein the sulfhydryl nanosphere is a sulfhydryl nanosphere obtained by hydrolyzing and polycondensing a sulfhydryl silane coupling agent under an alkaline condition. The nanosphere pour point depressant has the advantages of simple and easy preparation method, excellent pour point depressing and wax preventing effects, no viscosity increasing effect compared with the conventional polymer pour point depressing and wax preventing agents, and good application prospect.

title_en: Composition for TPO functional master batch, TPO functional master batch and preparation method thereof, composition for waterproof roll, waterproof roll and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of TPO waterproof coiled materials, and discloses a TPO functional master batch composition, a TPO functional master batch and a preparation method thereof, a waterproof coiled material composition, a waterproof coiled material and a preparation method thereof. The TPO functional masterbatch composition comprises a TPO elastomer, a first component, a second component, metal salt, a cross-linking agent, stearic acid and calcium stearate, wherein the content of the first component is 10-20 parts by weight, the content of the second component is 1-5 parts by weight, the content of the metal salt is 2-8 parts by weight, the content of the cross-linking agent is 0.1-1.5 parts by weight, and the total content of the calcium stearate and the stearic acid is 0.5-3 parts by weight, relative to 100 parts by weight of the TPO elastomer, and the TPO functional masterbatch obtained by adopting the TPO functional masterbatch composition has good application prospect in preparing TPO waterproof coiled materials.

title_en: Sealing resin composition, cured product, electronic component device, and method for manufacturing electronic component device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sealing resin composition, a cured product, an electronic component device, and a method for manufacturing the electronic component device. A sealing resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin, (B) a curing agent having at least 1 amino group, (C) a resin having a phenoxy structure, and (D) an inorganic filler. According to the sealing resin composition of the present invention, the occurrence of bleeding phenomenon can be suppressed.

title_en: Humic acid composite repair material for coal chemical pollution sites and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of soil restoration materials, and particularly relates to a humic acid composite restoration material for a coal chemical industry polluted site and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of 1) taking raw materials, alkali liquor and phosphide, uniformly mixing, standing, taking supernatant, adding acid liquor to adjust the pH value of a system, carrying out suction filtration to obtain humic acid solution, 2) drying the solid obtained in the step 1), standing, adding acid liquor, uniformly mixing, filtering, cleaning, adding strong acid for corrosion, filtering again, cleaning, and drying to obtain a substrate, 3) taking organic raw materials, emulsifying agent and solvent, heating, keeping stirring, adding mixed liquor of acyclic carboxylic acid and humic acid solution, adding an initiator, carrying out thermal reaction, adding the substrate while the mixture is hot, uniformly mixing, and drying and grinding to obtain the humic acid composite repair material. The humic acid composite repair material can effectively improve the structure and quality of soil and effectively improve the efficiency of soil repair.

title_en: Phosphorus-containing macromolecular carbonizing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flame retardants, and relates to a phosphorus-containing macromolecular char-forming agent, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the phosphorus-containing macromolecular char-forming agent is prepared by esterification of dicarboxyl DOPO derivatives, succinic acid, 1,3, 5-tris (2-hydroxyethyl) isocyanurate, a catalyst and sodium bicarbonate; and then melting and blending the phosphorus-containing macromolecular char forming agent with polyester resin, glass fiber and aluminum phosphite according to a certain proportion to prepare the flame-retardant polyester resin composite material. The flame-retardant polyester composite material prepared by the invention obviously improves the flame retardant property of the polyester material by the synergistic effect of the phosphorus-containing macromolecular carbon forming agent and the aluminum phosphite, and effectively overcomes the candlewick effect of the glass fiber reinforced polyester material. In addition, the composite material has excellent flame retardant effect, small loss of mechanical property and wide application range.

title_en: Long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of heparin anticoagulation coatings, and particularly relates to a long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating and a preparation method thereof. The long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating is formed by solidifying a long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating, wherein the long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating comprises a component A and a component B, raw materials of the component A comprise at least one of monomers, an initiator, a polymer, poly-L-lysine hydrobromide, streptavidin, sodium hyaluronate and crotonaldehyde, the monomers comprise at least one of MPC, PEGMA, SBMA, the polymer comprises an amino substrate, and the raw materials of the component B comprise at least one of a reducing agent and heparin. The preparation method comprises the steps of circulating the long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating in an ECMO system, and solidifying to obtain the long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating. The long-acting heparin anticoagulation coating constructed by the application can realize durable and stable anticoagulation effect in an ECMO system, and can solve the defects existing in the prior art.

title_en: Starch modified biodegradable plastic bag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly discloses a starch modified biodegradable plastic bag and a preparation method thereof. The starch modified biodegradable plastic bag comprises, by weight, 3-6 parts of PLA resin, 3-5 parts of talcum powder, 20-25 parts of starch, 60-65 parts of PBAT resin, 0.3-0.5 part of polyethylene wax, 0.2-0.4 part of erucamide powder, 2-4 parts of glycerol, 3.5-5 parts of water and 0.2-0.5 part of antioxidant. The plastic bag has the advantages of good starch dispersibility, difficult generation of crystal points, high surface quality, high tensile strength and excellent barrier property.

title_en: Benzothiazolyl COFs reinforced polymer electrolyte membrane, preparation method thereof and application thereof in all-solid-state lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benzothiazolyl COFs reinforced polymer electrolyte membrane, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an all-solid-state lithium battery, wherein the polymer electrolyte membrane is prepared from polycaprolactone, lithium difluoro oxalato borate and benzothiazolyl COFs serving as raw materials; the benzothiazolyl COFs serving as the filler is used for the film material manufactured by the polymer solid electrolyte, the performance of the film is improved under the condition that the mechanical strength of the film is not lost, and when the film is applied to an all-solid-state lithium battery, the all-solid-state lithium battery shows excellent multiplying power performance and potential window, and a new way is provided for effectively improving the performance of the all-solid-state lithium battery.

title_en: Composite green extraction method of low-ester pectin, hesperidin and synephrine in young citrus fruits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of citrus processing, in particular to a composite green extraction technology of low-ester pectin, hesperidin and synephrine in citrus young fruits, which comprises the steps of (1) crushing dried citrus young fruits, placing young fruit powder into an ultrasonic extraction tank, adding distilled water according to the ratio of 1:5-1:30 g/mL, the ultrasonic frequency being 20-80 kHz, the extraction time being 20-60 min, the temperature being 50-90 ℃, centrifuging after the treatment is finished, taking supernatant, and using the rest filter residues for extracting hesperidin and synephrine. The technical scheme provided by the invention can realize the compound extraction of low-ester pectin, hesperidin and synephrine in the young citrus fruits, effectively improve the extraction efficiency of functional active substances in the young citrus fruits, has less pollution to the used extraction solvent, is more environment-friendly than organic solvents such as dichloromethane, ethyl acetate, methanol and acetone used in the prior art, realizes the recycling of the extraction solvent, reduces the environmental pollution and reduces the extraction cost.

title_en: Solid wax inhibitor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crude oil solid wax-proofing agents, and relates to a preparation method of a solid wax-proofing agent, which comprises the following steps of (1) dissolving ethylene vinyl acetate, long-chain alkyl naphthalene higher alcohol ester and perfluoroalkyl acrylate monomers in water to obtain a water phase solution; adding cyclohexane, an emulsifying agent and an initiating agent into the aqueous phase solution, stirring to obtain a water-in-oil emulsion, regulating the pH value of the water-in-oil emulsion to be alkaline, performing inverse emulsion polymerization to obtain a synthetic agent, mixing the synthetic agent uniformly, and performing compression molding to obtain the solid wax inhibitor. The solid wax-proofing agent prepared by the invention has wax-proofing effect, and the wax-proofing rate is more than or equal to 90%. The solid wax-proofing agent has good slow-release wax-proofing effect, and the preparation method is simple, the sources of raw materials are wide, the solid wax-proofing agent is suitable for solving the wax-proofing problem in the fields of oil and gas transmission pipelines and the like, and has very important practical application value.

title_en: Compression-resistant cold-resistant hydrogenated nitrile rubber for oil field and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compression-resistant cold-resistant hydrogenated nitrile rubber for oil fields and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) preparation of a macromolecular tri-hetero-arm star-shaped composite functional grafting agent, (2) preparation of the compression-resistant cold-resistant hydrogenated nitrile rubber for oil fields, and the macromolecular tri-hetero-arm star-shaped composite functional grafting agent has the following structure:  The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a macromolecular three-hybrid-arm star-type composite functional grafting agent, wherein BR is a 1, 3-butadiene homopolymer section with wide vinyl distribution, SB is a random section of styrene and 1, 3-butadiene, S-B is a gradual section of styrene and 1, 3-butadiene, B is end-capped 1, 3-butadiene, n, m, L is a positive integer with the number of repeated units being more than or equal to 1, m is more than or equal to 1, L is more than or equal to 1, the number average molecular weight (Mn) of the macromolecular three-hybrid-arm star-type composite functional grafting agent is 6000-9000, and the molecular weight distribution (Mw/Mn) is 12.13-13.94. The preparation method of the compression-resistant cold-resistant hydrogenated nitrile rubber for the oil field has the characteristics of environmental protection, high modification effect, low modifier consumption, readily available raw materials in the market, suitability for industrial production and the like.

title_en: Halogen-free low-smoke insulated cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a halogen-free low-smoke insulated cable and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of wires and cables. The cable prepared by the invention has the advantages that the material of the protective sleeve takes high-density polyethylene as a matrix, the cable is endowed with good mechanical property and insulating property, the glass fiber is added into the material of the protective sleeve, the mechanical strength of the cable is further improved, the flame retardant modifier is prepared through a series of reactions, and the flame retardant modifier molecule contains three flame retardant components, so that the flame retardant property of the cable is greatly enhanced, and the mechanical property of the cable is further improved.

title_en: Wave absorber suitable for 5G base station shielding material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, in particular to a wave absorber suitable for a 5G base station shielding material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the wave absorber comprises the following steps of mixing carbonyl iron powder and a dielectric material, performing three-stage ball milling, and then performing annealing treatment to obtain the wave absorber, wherein the three-stage ball milling is specifically carried out in the steps of 1, wherein the ball material ratio is 10:1, the rotating speed is 300-350 rpm, the time is 2h, 2, 1, 600-700 rpm, the time is 3.5-5 h, and 3, adding an additive accounting for 1% of the total mass of the carbonyl iron powder and the dielectric material, performing ball milling in the step 3, wherein the ball material ratio is 5:1, the rotating speed is 200-250 rpm, and the time is 1 h. The invention adopts a staged ball milling process to realize the morphology regulation of the wave absorber particles, thereby improving the wave absorbing capacity of the wave absorber in the P wave band below 1 GHz.

title_en: Amide polymer, preparation method and application thereof, and water-based drilling fluid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of drilling fluids in petroleum industry, and discloses an amide polymer which comprises a structural unit A, a structural unit B, a structural unit C and a structural unit D, wherein the structural unit A is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (1), the structural unit B is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (2), the structural unit C is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (3), and the structural unit D is a structural unit with a structure shown in a formula (4). The amide polymer provided by the invention has excellent temperature resistance and calcium resistance, and has excellent filtrate loss performance after being applied to drilling fluid.

title_en: UV-LED cured spraying agent for furniture and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of epoxy resin, and discloses a UV-LED cured spray coating agent for furniture and a preparation method thereof, wherein the spray coating agent comprises 100 parts by weight of UV cured waterborne epoxy resin, 5-20 parts by weight of sulfhydryl waterborne polyurethane, 1.6-2.4 parts by weight of neutralizer, 0.6-1 part by weight of defoamer and 4.2-5.4 parts by weight of photoinitiator, under the action of the photoinitiator, a large amount of sulfhydryl contained in a waterborne polyurethane side chain and alkenyl in the waterborne epoxy resin generate sulfhydryl-alkene light-click reaction, so that the chemical crosslinking modification of polyurethane on the epoxy resin is realized, and the flexible polyurethane molecular chain is chemically grafted into the epoxy resin to play an excellent toughening role, thereby improving the flexibility, impact resistance and elongation at break of a paint film of the epoxy resin spray coating agent. The obtained spray has good practical application in furniture building materials and other aspects.

title_en: Spiro phosphate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses spiro phosphate and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the spiro phosphate is as follows:  The preparation method of the spiro phosphate comprises the following steps of 1) carrying out a reaction of furfuryl amine and vanillin to obtain a Schiff base intermediate, 2) carrying out a reaction of the Schiff base intermediate and pentaerythritol diphosphate chloride to obtain a flame retardant precursor, and 3) carrying out a reaction of the flame retardant precursor and 9, 10-dihydro-9 oxa-10 phosphaphenanthrene-10-oxide to obtain the spiro phosphate. The spiro phosphate disclosed by the invention is used as an epoxy resin flame retardant, has the advantages of excellent flame retardant property, good smoke suppression effect, good thermal stability, good compatibility with epoxy resin, environment friendliness and the like, and is simple in preparation method, wide in raw material source, low in production cost and suitable for large-scale industrial production and application.

title_en: Environment-friendly antibacterial PVC material and shoes
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly antibacterial PVC material and shoes, which belong to the technical field of polyvinyl chloride materials and comprise, by weight, 40-60 parts of PVC powder, 45-50 parts of plasticizer, 0.4-0.8 part of calcium-zinc stabilizer, 10-20 parts of slow-release silver ion composite material and 5-10 parts of anti-aging auxiliary agent, wherein the calcium-zinc stabilizer is adopted as the auxiliary agent to improve the thermal stability of the PVC material, the antibacterial effect and aging resistance are improved by adsorbing and wrapping antibacterial silver ions, the dispersibility and aging resistance of the anti-aging auxiliary agent are improved by a nano intercalation composite technology, the aging time of the PVC material is prolonged, the durability of the prepared PVC shoes is improved, the environment-friendly PVC material is prepared by adopting a benzene-free or low-benzene plasticizer, the environmental and health risks brought by the traditional phthalate plasticizer are effectively avoided, the prepared PVC material is safer and environment-friendly, the PVC material meets the environment-friendly standard of PVC shoes, meanwhile, the proportion of the plasticizer is set, and the flexibility of the PVC material is effectively improved.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant modified PPR and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of PPR pipes, and particularly relates to a low-temperature-resistant modified PPR, which comprises, by weight, 80-100 parts of a modified PPR matrix, 0.5-3 parts of an antioxidant, 1-5 parts of a silane coupling agent, 10-20 parts of a filler and 10-15 parts of a diluent. The modified PPR material prepared by the invention has excellent low temperature resistance and flame retardance.

title_en: Temperature-resistant anticorrosive paint for pipelines and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature-resistant anticorrosive paint for a pipeline and a preparation method thereof, wherein the temperature-resistant anticorrosive paint comprises the following steps of uniformly mixing mixed epoxy resin, an auxiliary agent and a mixed solvent according to a proportion, adding titanium white powder, talcum powder and precipitated barium sulfate into the mixture to uniformly disperse, adding a heat-resistant filler into the mixture, and uniformly stirring the mixture to obtain a component A; and mixing the modified hyperbranched amino silicone curing agent and the mixed solvent according to a proportion to obtain a component B, and finally mixing the component A and the component B uniformly to obtain the temperature-resistant anticorrosive paint for the pipeline. The coating prepared by the invention has high solid content and environmental protection, can be used for pipelines under CUI heat insulation layers, has excellent temperature resistance and corrosion resistance, can be used for outdoor pipelines, and has excellent weather resistance and durability.

title_en: Heat-conductive silicone composition and cured product thereof
abstract_en: A liquid and curable heat-conductive silicone composition comprising (A) a liquid silicone, (B) a hydrosilylation catalyst, and (C) a filler, wherein the filler comprises at least (C-1) a heat-conductive filler having a true density greater than the density of the liquid silicone and (C-2) a low-density filler having a true density equal to or less than the density of the liquid silicone, and the particle size distribution of the filler is controlled so that the filler is dispersed in a matrix comprising the liquid silicone in a state close to the closest packing.

title_en: Rubber composition, low-Mooney rubber, preparation method of low-Mooney rubber, low-Mooney halogenated rubber and application of low-Mooney halogenated rubber
abstract_en: The invention provides a rubber composition, low-Mooney rubber, a preparation method thereof, low-Mooney halogenated rubber and application thereof. The rubber composition provided by the invention comprises a rubber monomer and a Mooney regulator shown in a formula I. The invention can not cause the reduction of the polymerization conversion rate of rubber, residual redundant double bonds, influence the unsaturation degree of rubber and generate adverse effect on subsequent bromination by adding a proper amount of the Mooney regulator, has the effect of reducing Mooney without increasing the dosage of the initiator, ensures that the polymerization reaction is easier to control, prolongs the operation period of a reaction kettle, and reduces the content of metal elements in the product.

title_en: Hyperbranched multi-arm reversible crosslinked resin, preparation thereof and application thereof as adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses hyperbranched multi-arm reversible crosslinked resin, and preparation and application thereof as an adhesive. The preparation method of the hyperbranched multi-arm reversible crosslinking resin comprises the steps of (1) catalyzing ethylene and a reversible crosslinking functional monomer A shown in a formula I to carry out copolymerization by utilizing an alpha-diimine palladium catalyst based on a chain walking mechanism to obtain a hyperbranched polyethylene reversible crosslinking agent, (2) taking 2-bromoisobutyryl bromide as an initiator, taking a common monomer and a reversible crosslinking functional monomer B shown in a formula IV as comonomers, and synthesizing a linear reversible crosslinking polymer by utilizing atom transfer free radical polymerization, and (3) obtaining the hyperbranched multi-arm reversible crosslinking resin by carrying out crosslinking reaction on the hyperbranched polyethylene reversible crosslinking agent and the linear reversible crosslinking polymer in a solvent. The invention provides application of the hyperbranched multi-arm reversible crosslinking resin as an adhesive, which has excellent adhesive property and recycling property and is suitable for large-scale application.

title_en: Sulfonic acid type copolymer, preparation method and profile control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petroleum exploitation, and discloses a sulfonic acid type copolymer, a preparation method and a profile control system. The invention takes sulfonic acid group monomer as main construction unit, introduces amide, alkyl amine acyl and tertiary carbonic ester monomer structure unit, can control the hydrolysis rate of amide group and alkyl amide, and simultaneously inhibit precipitation.

title_en: Proton exchange resin with multi-element proton conduction center and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of proton exchange membrane fuel cells, and provides a proton exchange resin with a multi-element proton conduction center and a preparation method thereof. The main chain structure of the proton exchange membrane is a perfluorinated framework, the side chains contain groups such as sulfonic acid, phosphonic acid, sulfonyl imide and the like, the formed multi-active center improves the ion exchange capacity, enhances the proton conductivity and ensures the proton transmission capacity of the proton exchange membrane under low humidity. Meanwhile, the benzene ring structure has larger steric hindrance, and the glass transition temperature is improved, so that the polymer can take account of proton conductivity and thermal stability.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant flame-retardant PVC material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature-resistant flame-retardant PVC material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of polymer composite materials. The PVC material comprises 8-12wt% of ABS resin, 5.2-6.5wt% of temperature-resistant modified flame retardant, 1.8-2.3wt% of intumescent synergistic flame retardant, 20-25wt% of plasticizer, 1.3-1.6wt% of heat stabilizer, 2.4-2.8wt% of lubricant and 0.1-0.12wt% of antioxidant, and the balance of PVC resin, wherein the temperature-resistant modified flame retardant has a multi-branched structure and good migration resistance, and a multi-benzene ring structure introduced on a branched side chain and a chlorine group of a PVC macromolecular side chain form dipole-dipole interaction to strengthen the material, anchor the DOPO functional structure, not easily migrate at high temperature, play a stable flame retardant effect, and alleviate the problem of mechanical property deterioration caused by internal defect formed by migration.

title_en: Preparation method of UV-moisture multi-curing polyurethane modified acrylic ester three-proofing paint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyurethane and discloses a preparation method of UV-moisture multi-curing polyurethane modified acrylic ester three-proofing paint, which is prepared by mixing 100 parts by weight of polyurethane modified acrylic ester, 12-18 parts by weight of tertiary amine diacrylate diluent, 0.5-1 part by weight of thickener, 3.3-3.8 parts by weight of photoinitiator and the like. The terminal position of the polyurethane modified acrylic ester introduces an active chlorine atom, and can carry out quaternization reaction with a tertiary amine group of a tertiary amine diacrylate diluent, thereby introducing an antibacterial quaternary ammonium salt group, and endowing the polyurethane paint with excellent antibacterial and bactericidal performance. The polyurethane modified acrylic ester has multiple crosslinking effects such as moisture curing, photo-curing crosslinking, hydrogen bond crosslinking and the like, so that the polyurethane adhesive film has higher tensile strength and elongation at break. And has good water resistance and salt fog resistance.

title_en: Liquid crystal polyester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses liquid crystal polyester, a preparation method and application thereof, which belong to the technical field of high molecular engineering plastics, wherein the viscous flow activation energy and the shearing viscosity of the liquid crystal polyester at the shearing rate of 1000s  ‑1  are in a proper range, the liquid crystal polyester can be effectively applied to spinning, is especially suitable for spinning liquid crystal polyester monofilaments, is easy to attenuate and stretch out fibers in the spinning process, has excellent continuous spinnability, and has excellent dimensional stability, strength stability and modulus stability, and meanwhile, the prepared liquid crystal polyester monofilaments have excellent creep resistance and high strength.

title_en: Polyester copolymer, preparation method thereof and performance evaluation method
abstract_en: A polyester copolymer comprising residues of an aromatic dicarboxylic acid component derived from terephthalic acid, isophthalic acid mixture, and residues of a diol component derived from a cyclic diol having a boiling point of more than 270 ℃, such as Isosorbide (ISB), cyclohexanedimethanol (CHDM), and linear long chain diol-1, 6-Hexanediol (HOL) having a carbon-to-carbon length of more than 4, the molar ratio of alkyd being 1.05 to 1.30. The key properties of the resulting material are glass transition Temperature (TG), core properties are Viscosity (VIS), important properties are resistance to chemical changes (HAZ) and ductility elongation (REN). The comprehensive application performance of the material accords with the target application performance and the influence weight thereof, and auxiliary prediction and evaluation can be carried out.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling polyimide film high-temperature energy storage through regulating molecular structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating and controlling high-temperature energy storage of a polyimide film by regulating a molecular structure, belonging to the application fields of embedded capacitors, pulse power devices and the like. The invention aims to solve the problem that the conventional polyimide is difficult to meet the requirement of long-term stable operation under extreme environments such as high temperature, high frequency, strong electric field and the like. The method comprises the steps of dissolving diamine in a solvent, placing in an ice-water bath, stirring to be uniform, adding dianhydride in batches, continuously stirring to be uniform after the addition is finished to obtain PAA glue solution, paving a film, and carrying out gradient heating for imidization. According to the invention, a high-polarity group is introduced into a polyimide skeleton to induce dipole polarization of the polyimide, and meanwhile, the interaction between adjacent conjugated planes is optimized to obtain the polyimide film with excellent high temperature, high power and high stability. Can be used as raw materials for manufacturing modern embedded capacitors, semiconductor memory devices and the like.

title_en: Resin composition for high-modulus high-heat-conductivity copper-clad plate and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic materials, and relates to a resin composition for a high-modulus high-heat-conductivity copper-clad plate and application thereof. The invention discloses a resin composition for a high-modulus high-heat-conductivity copper-clad plate, which comprises the following raw materials of nitrile resin and composite heat-conductivity fibers, wherein the composite heat-conductivity fibers comprise carboxylated inorganic fibers, amino-modified boron nitride, amino-modified ceramic powder and a crosslinking agent. According to the invention, the filler surface modification technology is used for carrying out amination treatment on the boron nitride and the ceramic powder, so that the problems of compatibility and dispersibility of the boron nitride and the ceramic powder in resin are solved, the adding amount of the boron nitride is improved, the heat resistance and the peeling strength of the prepared laminated board are not influenced, the peeling strength of the copper foil reaches more than 1.0N/mm, and the heat conductivity coefficient reaches more than 1.5W/(m.K).

title_en: Low-surface-energy antibacterial resin material, preparation method and marine antifouling paint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of anti-fouling compounds, in particular to a low-surface-energy antibacterial resin material, a preparation method and a marine anti-fouling coating. The preparation method of the low-surface-energy antibacterial resin material comprises the steps of mixing 15-35 parts by mass of hydrocarbon chain acrylic acid monomer, 5-10 parts by mass of quaternary ammonium salt monomer, 2-10 parts by mass of fluorocarbon chain acrylic ester monomer and 1-5 parts by mass of hydroxyl acrylate monomer to form a first solution, dissolving an initiator and a chain transfer agent in an organic solvent to form a second solution, adding the second solution into the first solution to perform polymerization reaction to obtain a solution of the first resin material, adding the initiator into the solution of the first resin material, and obtaining the low-surface-energy antibacterial resin material after the cross-linking reaction. The resin material is further prepared into a coating, and the coating can realize good static antifouling and dynamic long-acting antifouling.

title_en: Preparation method of novel biomass hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogel preparation, in particular to a preparation method of novel biomass hydrogel. The biomass hydrogel prepared by the method overcomes the problems of poor hygroscopicity and poor recycling property of the traditional hydrogel in a low-humidity environment. The method comprises the steps of preparing dialdehyde starch by oxidizing tapioca starch with sodium periodate, enhancing hydrophilicity, coating and combining epoxy groups with covalent bond to fix lithium chloride by sodium alginate to realize slow release of salt and deliquescence with low humidity, introducing ink containing nano carbon materials to realize efficient photo-thermal conversion, forming a high molecular network gel structure after three-dimensional crosslinking of the substances, and combining gradient drying and rehydration control to ensure a porous structure and mechanical strength. The prepared hydrogel can absorb moisture rapidly and evaporate photo-thermally with high efficiency under low humidity environment, and has good recycling property.

title_en: Acetified cellulose, method for preparing same by using poplar and application thereof in preparing sustained-release medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production of acetified cellulose, in particular to acetified cellulose, a method for preparing the acetified cellulose by using poplar and application of the acetified cellulose in preparation of sustained-release medicines. The invention takes the domestic very surplus poplar wood as the raw material, adopts the acidic sulfite (magnesium salt base) method of adding the cooking auxiliary agent sodium citrate and methanol for cooking, obtains the cellulose pulp with high cellulose content, high polymerization degree and high purity, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Chitosan hydrogel with strong-effect antifungal-antibacterial double-effect synergy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chitosan hydrogel with strong antifungal-antibacterial effect and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the steps of generating 3- (4-amino-5-fluoro-2-oxo pyrimidine-1 (2H) -yl) ethyl propionate by utilizing an addition reaction of 5-fluorocytosine and ethyl acrylate, hydrolyzing to obtain 3- (4-amino-5-fluoro-2-oxo pyrimidine-1 (2H) -yl) propionic acid, preparing chitosan derivatives by utilizing carboxylated 5-fluorocytosine modified chitosan, introducing silver nano particles into a 5-fluorocytosine modified chitosan solution to obtain Ag@5FC-CS, and finally obtaining the chitosan hydrogel with strong antifungal-antibacterial effect and synergy through a Schiff base reaction of Ag@5FC-CS and a cross-linking agent. The chitosan hydrogel provided by the invention has the advantages of strong antifungal and antibacterial properties, uniform pore structure, slow silver release and the like.

title_en: PBT-based composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PBT-based composite material and a preparation method thereof. The PBT-based composite material comprises, by mass, 40-55 parts of PBT resin, 5-10 parts of PET resin, 28-32 parts of alkali-free glass fibers, 8-15 parts of brominated flame retardants, 2-5 parts of solid flame retardant synergists, 0.2-1 part of liquid flame retardant synergists, 0.1-1 part of lubricants, 0-5 parts of toughening agents and 1-3 parts of other processing aids, wherein the PBT-based composite material has low fiber floating, low precipitation, enhanced flame retardance and excellent mechanical properties.

title_en: Polyimide paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyimide paint, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polyimide paint is prepared from the following raw materials of aluminum isopropoxide and tetraethoxysilane, the solid content is 20-30wt%, and the viscosity is not more than 5 Pa.s and not more than 50 Pa.s. The preparation raw materials further comprise orthosilicic acid or a silane coupling agent. The polyimide paint disclosed by the invention can be used for simultaneously achieving high solid content, low viscosity and excellent corona resistance. In the invention, tetraethoxysilane is taken as a main inorganic particle source, aluminum isopropoxide and orthosilicic acid can simultaneously play the roles of a coupling agent and an inorganic particle source, and are combined with carboxyl and amino in polyamide acid, so that the compatibility of tetraethoxysilane and a molecular chain is improved, and the problem of particle agglomeration when inorganic particles or nano dispersion liquid thereof are directly adopted to blend with polyamide acid is effectively solved.

title_en: Beta zinc sulfide nano particle and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a beta zinc sulfide nanoparticle and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1 dispersing zinc salt, doping agent and complexing agent into water, regulating pH to 8-10 to obtain zinc complex sol, S2 adding sulfur source solution into the zinc complex sol for primary heating reaction to obtain ZnS precursor sol, S3 adding template agent into the ZnS precursor sol for secondary heating reaction, washing to obtain ZnS hydrothermal product, S4 treating the ZnS hydrothermal product with plasma to obtain the beta zinc sulfide nanoparticle, and combining element doping and morphology regulation through sol-hydrothermal synergistic process, thereby solving the performance contradiction between zinc sulfide whiteness and ultraviolet absorptivity for glass fiber reinforced polyester engineering plastics and realizing synergistic optimization of high whiteness (more than or equal to 95%) and high ultraviolet absorptivity (more than or equal to 99%) of zinc sulfide.

title_en: Crystal orientation type covalent organic framework film, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of two-dimensional covalent organic framework materials, and particularly relates to a crystallization orientation type covalent organic framework film, a preparation method and application. The invention is based on an interfacial polymerization method, reaction kinetics is regulated and controlled by constructing a solvent buffer layer and introducing a reaction regulator, and an amino monomer containing pyridine nitrogen is protonated and then orderly arranged at a water/oil two-phase interface through cation-pi action, so that an aldehyde monomer dissolved in an oil phase is induced to react with the amino monomer at the interface to generate Schiff base reaction, and a two-dimensional covalent organic framework film with crystal orientation is formed at normal temperature. The self-supporting covalent organic framework film prepared by the method has controllable thickness, obvious crystallization orientation, is favorable for carrier migration, and can be used as an electrocatalyst for electrocatalytic reduction of CO  2 .

title_en: Wear-resistant and glue-resistant food-grade PP grinding cover and injection molding process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant and anti-rubber wire food-grade PP grinding cover and an injection molding process thereof, wherein the wear-resistant and anti-rubber wire food-grade PP grinding cover comprises, by weight, 100-150 parts of food-grade PP resin, 5-10 parts of wear-resistant additives, 2-5 parts of anti-rubber wire auxiliary agents, 0.5-1 part of antioxidants and 0.5-1 part of lubricants; according to the invention, the additive has high hardness and good wear resistance, is uniformly dispersed in a food-grade PP resin matrix, and can bear partial friction force when being rubbed, so that the wear of the PP resin is reduced, the wear resistance of a grinding cover is obviously improved, the service life of a product is prolonged, the replacement frequency is reduced, the problem of foreign matter pollution caused by the abrasion of the product in the grinding process of the seasoning is avoided, and the organosilicon compound is contained in the anti-rubber silk auxiliary agent, so that the organosilicon compound has low surface energy and good lubricity, the friction force between plastics and the ground product is reduced, and the breakage and wiredrawing phenomenon of the plastics caused by friction are reduced.

title_en: Polycarbonate resin and resin composition containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention can provide a polycarbonate resin comprising a structural unit (a) derived from a monomer represented by the general formula (1), a structural unit (B) derived from a monomer represented by the general formula (2), and a structural unit (C) derived from a monomer represented by the general formula (3), wherein the proportion of the structural unit (a) is 20 to 50 mol% and the proportion of the structural unit (B) is 5 to 20 mol% and the proportion of the structural unit (C) is 30 to 75 mol% based on the total of the structural units (a), (B), and (C) constituting the polycarbonate resin.

title_en: Ruthenium-based catalyst, preparation method thereof and application of ruthenium-based catalyst in preparation of hydrogenated nitrile rubber in organic solvent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ruthenium-based catalyst and a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing hydrogenated nitrile rubber in an organic solvent, which relate to the technical field of rubber materials, the invention provides a ruthenium-based catalyst and a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing hydrogenated nitrile rubber in an organic solvent, the structural general formula of the ruthenium-based catalyst is shown as formula I, and the controllable hydrogenation of the nitrile rubber can be realized under the condition of low catalyst consumption, so that the requirement for recovering the catalyst from the hydrogenated nitrile rubber is greatly reduced.

title_en: Reference rubber for testing abrasion resistance of rubber, preparation method and testing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reference rubber for testing the wear resistance of rubber, a preparation method and a testing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of rubber wear resistance testing. The reference rubber for testing the wear resistance of the rubber is characterized by comprising, by weight, 100 parts of solution polymerized styrene-butadiene rubber, 30-60 parts of white carbon black, 30-60 parts of talcum powder, 1-5 parts of PEG4000, 1-3 parts of anti-aging agent, 2-10 parts of indirect zinc oxide, 1-5 parts of stearic acid, 1-2 parts of sulfur and 1.5-3.5 parts of accelerator CZ. The reference glue provided by the invention not only has the function of calibrating the abrasion test conditions by the conventional standard glue, but also has the ideal effect of cleaning the grinding wheel, so that the grinding wheel pollution caused by the adhesion of abrasive dust on the grinding wheel in the test process of the test glue can be effectively avoided, and the accuracy of the abrasion test result is improved.

title_en: High-heat-conductivity carbon black and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-heat-conductivity carbon black and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon black modification, wherein the preparation method of the high-heat-conductivity carbon black comprises the following steps of carrying out oxidation treatment, silanization treatment and tannic acid coating treatment on the carbon black to obtain modified carbon black; preparing graphene/boron nitride/modified carbon black multidimensional filler, modifying the graphene/boron nitride/modified carbon black multidimensional filler by lignin, polyvinylpyrrolidone and samarium chloride for the first time, and modifying the graphene/boron nitride/modified carbon black multidimensional filler by 6-aminocaproic acid for the second time to obtain the high-heat-conductivity carbon black. The high-heat-conductivity carbon black prepared by the method disclosed by the invention not only has good dispersibility, but also can well improve the heat-conducting property and mechanical property of the rubber matrix.

title_en: Coil-to-coil pretreatment method for electroless plating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coil-to-coil pretreatment method for electroless plating, which comprises the following steps: s1: plasma pretreatment of a substrate material; s2: coating and grafting the roll-to-roll coating; s3: adsorbing the roll-to-roll seed layer; s4: post-processing of coiled materials; the method can efficiently clean pollutants on the surface of the material, activate the surface of the substrate material and excite hydroxyl groups through plasma pretreatment, is more efficient and thorough than the steps of degreasing, washing, coarsening, pickling, activating and the like in the traditional chemical plating pretreatment process, reduces complicated operation steps, improves production efficiency, coats a coating containing a large number of active groups on a roll-to-roll basis, controls the coating thickness and grafting temperature, enables the active groups in the coating to react with the hydroxyl groups on the surface of the substrate material to form stable chemical bonds, and can more effectively improve the binding force between a coating and the substrate material than the traditional method.

title_en: Biodegradable mulch film material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a biodegradable mulching film material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural mulching films. The mulching film material is prepared from, by weight, PBMST-95 parts of inorganic filler, 5-20 parts of metal oxide nano quantum dots, 0.01-0.1 part of epoxy chain extender, 0.1-2 parts of antioxidant and 0.5-2 parts of one or more of ZnO, ceO, zrO metal oxide nano quantum dots. The base material of the mulch film material is PBMST, the types and mass fractions of other components are limited, and the preparation method of the mulch film material is matched, so that the obtained biodegradable mulch film material has excellent ultraviolet aging resistance, water vapor barrier and mechanical properties, can adapt to various use environments, and has wide application areas.

title_en: Modified polylactic acid plastic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides modified polylactic acid plastic and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of modified plastic. The modified polylactic acid plastic is prepared from sodium dodecyl sulfate, alkyl amide carboxyl betaine modified nano clay, PLA and an antioxidant through premixing, melting, extrusion, cooling and granulating. According to the invention, the nano clay is modified by adopting the sodium dodecyl sulfate and alkylamide carboxyl betaine compound modifier, the hydrogen bond effect of the modified nano clay and PLA ester group is enhanced, and the interfacial binding force is improved, so that the modified PLA has good barrier property, mechanical property and shock resistance, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Polymer, preparation method thereof, composition, photoelectric device and display device
abstract_en: The polymer provided by the technical scheme of the application has good hole mobility, is not easy to fluorescence quenching, can be subjected to solution processing, and is more stable compared with small molecules.

title_en: Copper ion antibacterial copolyester and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides copper ion antibacterial copolyester and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer material synthesis. In the copper ion antibacterial copolyester, isophthalic acid containing a copper sulfonate ion group is bonded to a main chain of a polyethylene terephthalate molecule as a comonomer, and copper ions with high-efficiency antibacterial performance are loaded on a polyester molecule chain through ionic bonding. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing isophthalic acid-5-copper sulfonate, terephthalic acid and ethylene glycol into slurry, carrying out esterification reaction on the slurry to obtain copper-containing polyester oligomer, and sequentially carrying out pre-polycondensation, final polycondensation, filtration, cooling solidification and granulating molding on the copper-containing polyester oligomer to obtain the copper ion antibacterial copolyester slice. The copper ion dispersing agent can realize atomic level dispersion of copper ions and endow polyester products with excellent antibacterial and antifungal properties.

title_en: Modified montmorillonite with nucleation and compatibilization, preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified montmorillonite with nucleation and compatibilization, preparation and application, and relates to the technical field of composite materials, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, dissolving isocyanatopropyl triethoxysilane in ethanol water solution, uniformly mixing with montmorillonite to obtain alkylated montmorillonite, S2, dissolving cyanuric chloride in toluene, adding Li Ben alcohol for reaction, S3, dissolving the alkylated montmorillonite in acetone, adding a product of S2 and a catalyst for reaction, and carrying out precipitation, washing and drying after the reaction to obtain the modified montmorillonite with nucleation and compatibilization. The modified montmorillonite obtained by the method plays a role in heterogeneous nucleation, can improve the crystallization performance of the PBAT composite material, has strong hydrophobicity and high reactivity, can realize the capacity increase with the PBAT, and can improve the barrier performance and the mechanical property of the PBAT composite material as a two-dimensional layered material.

title_en: Preparation method of in-situ sodium alginate hydrogel disposable glove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an in-situ sodium alginate hydrogel disposable glove, which is used for in-situ forming the sodium alginate hydrogel disposable glove on the surface of a human hand, and comprises the following steps of dissolving sodium alginate and a thickening agent in water to prepare a first solution; and after the first solution is uniformly coated on the surface of the hand, the second solution is sprayed on the surface of the first solution, and after the gel is formed, the disposable glove of the sodium alginate hydrogel is prepared in situ. According to the preparation method of the disposable glove with the in-situ sodium alginate hydrogel, the formation process of the sodium alginate hydrogel is transferred to the surface of a human hand to form the glove, so that the glove attached to the hand is prepared, the use is convenient, the sodium alginate hydrogel is degradable, and the environment is protected.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin composition which can bring a cured product exhibiting good dielectric properties and having excellent adhesion strength with a conductor layer after being exposed to a high-temperature and high-humidity environment, a resin sheet using the resin composition, a cured product of the resin composition, a circuit board comprising the cured product, and a semiconductor device comprising the circuit board. A resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin, (B) an active ester-based curing agent, and (C) a compound containing a structural unit represented by the formula (C1) and a terminal group represented by the formula (C1).

title_en: Preparation method of nadroparin calcium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nadroparin calcium, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. By optimizing key steps such as degradation, reduction, ion exchange, oxidation and the like of heparin sodium and combining specific anion exchange resin, the yield and purity of the product are obviously improved. The method comprises mixing heparin sodium with purified water, degrading by adjusting pH value and adding sodium nitrite, continuing to react with sodium hydroxide and sodium borohydride, sterilizing, precipitating with ethanol, and collecting precipitate. Subsequently, the precipitate is reacted with an anion exchange resin in purified water, and after washing and precipitation, an oxidation reaction is performed. Finally, the nadroparin calcium is obtained through filtration, dehydration and drying. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method has higher yield and purity, more concentrated molecular weight distribution, higher active ingredient ratio and obviously reduced proportion of micromolecule and macromolecular impurities, thereby improving the quality and curative effect of the product.

title_en: Double-sided matte polypropylene synthetic paper, preparation method thereof and application thereof in TPU hot melt adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses double-sided matte polypropylene synthetic paper, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in TPU hot melt adhesives, and belongs to the technical field of synthetic paper. The synthetic paper comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of polypropylene, 0.4-0.8 part of an antioxidant, 30-35 parts of calcium carbonate, 2-3 parts of titanium dioxide, 3-5 parts of a water repellent agent, 1-2 parts of fog flour, 0.5-1 part of a slipping agent and 2-4 parts of an antistatic agent, wherein the middle layer comprises, by weight, 30-50 parts of polypropylene, 2-6 parts of calcium carbonate and 1-2 parts of titanium dioxide, and the raw materials and parts of the inner surface layer are the same as those of the outer surface layer. The double-sided matte polypropylene synthetic paper prepared by the invention has excellent waterproof performance and antibacterial performance.

title_en: Silicone rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses silicon rubber and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of silicon rubber. The raw materials of the silicone rubber in the application comprise vinyl silicone rubber raw rubber, MQ silicone resin, styrene-butadiene-styrene block copolymer, fluororesin, filler, structure modifier and vulcanizing agent. The application also discloses a preparation method of the silicon rubber. According to the application, the fluorine resin is used for forming the coating layer on the surface of the filler, the filler is uniformly dispersed in the silicone rubber along with the kneading and vulcanization processes, and the fluorine resin coated on the surface of the filler is uniformly distributed and crosslinked to form a three-dimensional network structure, so that the uniform distribution of fluorine atoms in the silicone rubber base stock can be realized, and the specific structure modifier is assisted, so that the oil resistance and high temperature resistance of the whole silicone rubber are improved, the compatibility of the fluorine resin and the filler with the silicone rubber base stock is promoted, and the problems of poor oil resistance, high cost and insufficient compatibility of the traditional silicone rubber are solved.

title_en: Monomer, polymer, preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrochromic material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monomer, a polymer, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrochromic materials. Relates to the technical field of electrochromic materials. The monomer has the following specific structural formula:  Wherein R is selected from alkyl, aryl or substituted aryl with C  1 -C 18  carbon atoms, D is selected from thiophene or 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene, pi is selected from any one of the following structures:   the monomer of the invention is an electrochromic monomer with low driving voltage, high contrast, fast switching time and good stability.

title_en: Surface modified polypropylene and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses surface modified polypropylene and a preparation method thereof, wherein the surface modified polypropylene comprises a polypropylene substrate, a nano titanium oxide/nano zinc oxide composite coating is coated on the polypropylene substrate, the thickness of the nano titanium oxide/nano zinc oxide composite coating is 50-200nm, and the atomic ratio of titanium to zinc in the nano titanium oxide/nano zinc oxide composite coating is 1:0.5-5. The surface modified polypropylene has excellent biocompatibility and antibacterial property, and the invention also discloses application of the surface modified polypropylene in preparing soft tissue implant materials.

title_en: Laminate body
abstract_en: The present invention provides a laminate comprising a base sheet and a metal particle-containing layer which is laminated on the base sheet and contains metal particles, wherein the base sheet has a contact surface with the metal particle-containing layer, and the Young's modulus of the base sheet at 23 ℃ as determined by measuring the contact surface by nanoindentation is 0.01-10 GPa.

title_en: Composition with effects of reducing blood sugar and enhancing immunity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine extraction, and particularly relates to a composition with the effects of reducing blood sugar and enhancing immunity and a preparation method thereof. The composition comprises dendrobium candidum and tremella aurantialba, and the obtained composition has better effects of resisting oxidization, reducing blood sugar and enhancing immunity by matching the two raw materials, and the composition prepared by the dendrobium candidum and tremella aurantialba in a weight ratio of 2:1 or 3:1 has better effects of resisting oxidization, reducing blood sugar and enhancing immunity.

title_en: High-strength low-dielectric-loss epoxy resin composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber materials, in particular to a high-strength and low-dielectric-loss epoxy resin composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the epoxy resin composite material comprises, by weight, 100 parts of modified epoxy resin, 12-18 parts of cyanate resin, 40-50 parts of aramid fiber, 10-15 parts of filler, 15-25 parts of toughening agent, 1-6 parts of first curing agent and 1-2 parts of accelerator.
