The epoxy resin composite material with high strength and low dielectric loss has high strength and good shock resistance, has high breakdown strength, low dielectric constant and low dielectric loss, can meet the requirements of insulating parts of high-voltage transmission equipment, high-frequency circuit substrates, lightweight structural parts of spacecrafts and the like on the fields with strict requirements on mechanical strength and dielectric properties, is simple and controllable in preparation method, has low production cost, and can be produced in a large scale.

title_en: Moisture-heat-resistant ultraviolet-blocking polyester master batch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyester master batches, and particularly relates to a moisture-heat resistant ultraviolet blocking polyester master batch and a preparation method thereof. The ultraviolet resistant agent is prepared by modifying a nano light shielding agent by a carboxylate coupling agent according to a mass ratio of 3-5:100 to obtain a modified intermediate, and then carrying out grafting reaction on the modified intermediate and a hydroxybenzoketone derivative according to a mass ratio of 100:5-8, wherein the nano light shielding agent is selected from one or a combination of two or more of nano zinc oxide, nano titanium dioxide, nano cerium oxide, nano tin antimony oxide and nano carbon black. The ultraviolet resistant agent has improved dispersion effect in the master batch, improved ultraviolet blocking and light transmittance, and enhanced interaction with PET due to transesterification with PET during screw extrusion, and can avoid migration in damp and hot environment, so that the ultraviolet shielding performance is durable and stable.

title_en: Granite concrete with enhanced interface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interface-enhanced granite concrete and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of concrete. The granite concrete comprises, by mass, 30-40 parts of cement, 40-50 parts of modified granite coarse aggregate, 50-60 parts of fine aggregate, 20-30 parts of mixed filler, 1-3 parts of low-hydration heat polycarboxylate water reducer, 0.5-2 parts of shrinkage reducer and 10-30 parts of water. According to the invention, the granite is subjected to surface modification, and the novel low-hydration thermal polycarboxylate water reducer is adopted, so that the interfacial adhesion performance of granite aggregate and cement paste is obviously improved, and the performances of compressive strength, tensile strength and the like of granite concrete are greatly improved, so that the granite concrete has a good application prospect and value in the technical field of concrete.

title_en: Hyperbranched flame retardant, preparation method thereof and flame-retardant epoxy resin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flame-retardant materials, and particularly relates to a hyperbranched flame retardant, a preparation method thereof and flame-retardant epoxy resin. The preparation method comprises the steps of placing itaconic anhydride and phosphaphenanthrene at 80-110 ℃ in a solvent system to perform an addition reaction to obtain a first intermediate, mixing phosphorus oxychloride and 1,3, 5-tris (2-hydroxyethyl) cyanuric acid in the solvent system, performing a nucleophilic substitution reaction under the action of an acid binding agent to obtain a second intermediate, placing the first intermediate and the second intermediate at 80-120 ℃ to perform an esterification reaction to obtain a phosphorus-nitrogen intermediate, and placing the phosphorus-nitrogen intermediate and boric acid at 120-160 ℃ in a protective atmosphere to perform a condensation reaction to obtain the hyperbranched flame retardant. The hyperbranched flame retardant prepared by the invention is used for preparing flame-retardant epoxy resin, and has the characteristics of excellent flame retardant property, high strength and high toughness.

title_en: Block polyarylpiperidine polymer, anion exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ion exchange membranes, and in particular relates to a block polyarylpiperidine polymer, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) preparing the block polyarylpiperidine polymer; (2) preparation of quaternized block polyarylpiperidine polymer and (3) preparation of anion exchange membrane. According to the invention, the segmented polyarylpiperidine polymer and the anion exchange membrane are prepared by adopting a one-pot method, so that the oligomer is not required to be purified for multiple times, the preparation is simple, the regular chain segment arrangement can form an efficient microphase separation structure through thermodynamic driving, and the conductivity of the anion exchange membrane is enhanced. Moreover, the water absorption and swelling degree of the membrane are reduced, and the membrane is used in the fields of low-temperature direct ammonia fuel cells, electrolytic ammonia water and the like, and has good ammonia resistance.

title_en: Molecularly imprinted adsorption material with metal organic framework as carrier framework, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular imprinting adsorption material taking a metal organic framework as a carrier framework, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adsorption materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrothermal reaction on transition metal salt and phthalic acid ligand to obtain metal organic framework nano particles, carrying out phase change polymerization on the metal organic framework nano particles after absorbing flavonoid template molecules, mixing the metal organic framework nano particles with lysozyme and disulfide bond reducing agent, and eluting to remove flavonoid template molecules after the phase change polymerization is finished to obtain the molecular imprinting adsorption material with rich imprinting sites and good stability, wherein the molecular imprinting adsorption material has good adsorption selectivity, high speed and large capacity on flavonoid compounds, has good chemical stability and acid resistance washing, can be recycled, and can be widely used for extracting and separating the flavonoid compounds.

title_en: Preparation method of low-dielectric polyimide porous material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a porous polyimide low-dielectric material. The specific steps are that the polyamic acid solution with certain solid content is prepared under the ice water bath condition. After the solution returns to normal temperature, a certain amount of sodium alginate is added, and after the solution is uniform, a catalyst and a dehydrating agent are added for chemical imidization. Coating the solution after reacting for a certain time on a substrate medium, standing in air for a certain time, sequentially placing the solution in ethanol and a hot water bath respectively for a certain time, airing at normal temperature, and transferring to a high-temperature oven for gradient cyclization to realize complete imidization. The method has mild and controllable conditions, and the low dielectric film material with smooth appearance and ordered structure is prepared only by using a normal pressure drying method.

title_en: Preparation method of liquorice polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of pharmaceutical compositions, in particular to a preparation method of liquorice polysaccharide, which sequentially comprises the following steps of solid state fermentation, alkaline solution leaching, degreasing treatment, deproteinization treatment, decoloring treatment, ethanol fractional extraction, amination modification and selenization treatment. The glycyrrhiza polysaccharide connected with selenoprotein is obtained by the preparation method provided by the disclosure, and has the effects of resisting oxidation, improving immunity, resisting tumor and the like.

title_en: Chiral conjugated polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chiral conjugated polymer and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the polymer is shown in a formula I, wherein 2,2 ́ -dimethoxy-1, 1 ́ -binaphthyl is selected from any one of R configuration and S configuration, R  1  is selected from any one of C1-C50 straight-chain or branched-chain alkyl, C1-C50 alkoxy, C7-C50 aralkyl and C5-C50 heteroalkyl, ar is selected from any one of aryl, heteroaryl, aryl containing substituent groups and heteroaryl containing substituent groups, the bonding mode in the group is selected from at least one of single bond, double bond and triple bond, x: y is 1:5-15, wherein hetero atoms in the heteroalkyl are at least one of oxygen, sulfur and selenium, and the number of hetero atom substitutions is 1-10. The polymer is prepared by adopting a carbon-carbon coupling reaction. According to the invention, a chiral group with a certain proportion is introduced, so that the chiral conjugated polymer is obtained, and the specific detection of circularly polarized light of the organic field effect transistor is realized.

title_en: Production and preparation process of micro-fine wire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production and preparation process of micro-fine wires, belongs to the technical field of micro-fine wire processing, and is used for solving the technical problems that the flexibility, the insulating property, the high temperature resistance and the bonding fastness of micro-fine wires in the prior art are to be further improved; the method comprises the steps of taking copper blocks as raw materials, preparing a filament conductor with the diameter of 0.13-0.15mm through smelting, rolling and stretching, depositing a polydopamine layer formed by mixing dopamine hydrochloride and buffer solution on the surface of the filament conductor, namely raising the temperature of a reaction system to 50-60 ℃, performing ultrasonic dispersion, adding the filament conductor into the reaction system, performing heat preservation and ultrasonic deposition for 3-5h, and performing post-treatment to obtain a pretreated conductor.

title_en: Rare earth-titanium bimetallic nano-structure catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of titanium metal catalysts, in particular to a rare earth-titanium bimetallic nano-structure catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is obtained by modifying a supported catalyst precursor by using a P=O group in phosphate and coating the supported catalyst precursor by generating a surface coordination structure; the supported catalyst precursor is obtained by taking a mixed oxide sol network as a precursor and carrying out anchoring and loading on the precursor and an amination carrier with Si-O-Si-Y bonds through Ti-O-Si bonds, wherein the precursor is prepared by chelating carbonic ester by using diketone compounds and then carrying out hydrolysis-condensation on the carbonic ester and rare earth metal ions to form a mixed oxide sol network with Ti-O-Ti bonds and Ti-O-M bonds, namely, a bonding network is formed by the rare earth metals and titanium, and a surface hydrophobic layer constructed by combining phosphate is combined, so that the hydrolysis half life of the catalyst under a high-temperature and high-humidity environment is improved.

title_en: Composite film modified based on rare earth complex and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite film based on rare earth complex modification, which specifically comprises the following steps of preparing Zn-rare earth complex SL3-Zn-Eu, preparing Zn-rare earth complex DL3-Zn-Eu, preparing Zn-rare earth complex CNC film according to products obtained in the steps 1 and 2. The invention also discloses a composite film based on rare earth complex modification, which solves the problems of low conductivity, difficult preparation process and high cost of the existing rare earth complex when the rare earth complex is used for a solar panel.

title_en: Antistatic PEEK powder, preparation method thereof and antistatic PEEK molded product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to antistatic PEEK powder, a preparation method thereof and an antistatic PEEK molded product. The antistatic PEEK powder comprises, by weight, 80-90 parts of PEEK fine powder, 0.5-1.5 parts of conductive filler, 5-15 parts of non-conductive inorganic filler and 1-3 parts of mixed dispersing agent. According to the antistatic PEEK powder, the use amount of each raw material is limited within a reasonable range, so that better synergistic effect can be exerted among the raw materials, the balance of rigidity and toughness is considered on the basis that the surface resistivity of the antistatic PEEK powder meets the standard, burrs and cracks are not generated in the process of carrying out die pressing processing, the processability of the antistatic PEEK powder is improved, the antistatic PEEK powder can be well applied to the die pressing processing technology, and further a die pressing product with excellent performance is prepared.

title_en: Cobalt boride-based adhesion promoter preparation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesion promoter preparation, in particular to a cobalt boride-based adhesion promoter preparation system and a cobalt boride-based adhesion promoter preparation method, wherein the system comprises a mixing module, a stirring module and a stirring module, wherein the mixing module is used for mixing cobalt boride and an additive to output a mixture; the device comprises a mixing module, a purifying module, a detection module and a control module, wherein the mixing module is used for mixing a mixture in a reaction kettle, the purifying module is used for purifying the mixture to output an adhesion promoter, the detection module comprises a pressure sensor used for detecting the pressure of an additive conveying pipe, and the control module is respectively connected with the mixing module, the purifying module and the detection module and used for determining the angle between stirring blades in the reaction kettle according to the generation rate of the mixture in unit time or determining the stirring time of the mixture in the reaction kettle according to the pressure difference between two ends of the additive conveying pipe and determining the circulation rate of cooling water according to the temperature rising rate in the reaction kettle. The invention improves the preparation stability of the adhesion promoter.

title_en: Lignin fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of composite materials, and discloses a lignin fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the lignin fiber composite material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of lignin fiber, 25-45 parts of composite matrix resin, 5-12 parts of nano reinforcing particles, 3-7 parts of interface modifier, 4-9 parts of flexibilizer, 2-6 parts of graphene aerogel and 3-8 parts of basalt fiber; the invention provides a lignin fiber composite material combining a multi-element reinforcing system design (lignin fiber/basalt fiber/graphene aerogel/nano silicon dioxide) and an interface modification technology and a preparation method thereof, and solves the problems of poor interface compatibility and insufficient mechanical property of the traditional lignin fiber asphalt composite material.

title_en: Separating agent
abstract_en: And a separating agent comprising a polyacetylene compound supported on a carrier, wherein the polyacetylene compound has 1 or more repeating units represented by any one of the general formulae (1) to (3). (R  1 、R 2  and R  3  are each independently an alkyl group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms or a hydrogen atom which may have 1 or more substituents selected from the group consisting of a halogen atom and an alkoxy group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms; and R  4  is each independently an alkyl group having 1 to 20 carbon atoms or a hydrogen atom which may be substituted with a halogen atom.)

title_en: Preparation method of daylighting tile resin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses a preparation method of daylighting tile resin, which comprises the following steps of preparing a surface optical layer; step two, preparing an intermediate reinforcing layer, step three, preparing a base weather-resistant layer, and step four, co-extrusion molding of three layers. The high weather-resistant and heat-deformation-resistant daylighting tile resin prepared by the invention obviously improves the light transmittance of the daylighting tile by adopting a technical means of compounding the sulfur-containing acrylic resin and high refractive TiO  2  nano particles with refractive index of 2.0 in an optical layer. Through testing, the light transmittance of the light-collecting tile can reach 92.5%, and compared with the light transmittance of the traditional light-collecting tile resin, the light transmittance of the light-collecting tile resin is improved by 8.8%. Meanwhile, the barrier rate of the daylighting tile resin to ultraviolet rays is up to 98.5%, so that the damage of the ultraviolet rays to indoor articles can be effectively prevented, a more comfortable and healthy illumination environment is provided for the indoor, and the requirements of high light transmittance and excellent ultraviolet barrier performance of the daylighting tile resin are met.

title_en: Modified piperazine pyrophosphate flame retardant, flame-retardant polystyrene foam heat-insulating material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified piperazine pyrophosphate flame retardant, a flame-retardant polystyrene foam heat-insulating material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of halogen-free flame retardance; and then mixing the transition metal organic framework material grafted polydopamine modified piperazine pyrophosphate flame retardant, the halogen-free flame retardant and the polystyrene particles, and performing compression molding under the high-temperature condition to prepare the flame-retardant polystyrene foam heat-insulating material. The invention solves the problem of low flame retardant efficiency when the traditional halogen-free flame retardant is singly added into polystyrene foam, and the halogen-free flame retardant and the transition metal organic framework material grafted polydopamine modified piperazine pyrophosphate flame retardant play a role in catalysis in a polystyrene foam matrix.

title_en: Double-component polyurethane circuit board pouring sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pouring sealant coatings, in particular to a double-component polyurethane circuit board pouring sealant and a preparation method thereof. The flame retardant comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises liquefied MDI, a phosphate flame retardant and a plasticizer, the component B comprises a hydroxy acrylic ester oligomer, a bio-based polyol, a defoaming agent and a catalyst, the viscosity of the hydroxy acrylic ester oligomer at 25 ℃ is 8000-15000 mPa.s, and the hydroxyl value is 100-150 mgKOH/g. By limiting the viscosity of the hydroxy acrylic ester oligomer to 8000-12000 mPa.s at 25 ℃ and the hydroxyl value to 100-140 mgKOH/g, the mechanical property and the ageing resistance of the pouring sealant can be improved simultaneously.

title_en: Preparation method of high-flexibility water-soluble high-viscosity CMC material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion battery binder materials, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a high-flexibility water-soluble high-viscosity CMC material, which comprises the following steps of (a) dispersing sodium carboxymethyl cellulose in ethanol, then adding sulfuric acid to adjust the pH of a system to 1.8-2.2, reacting for 1.5-2.5 hours at 30-45 ℃, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain protonated CMC-H, (b) dispersing CMC-H in ethanol to form CMC-H suspension, adding sodium sulfamate solution subjected to CO  2  saturation pretreatment, mixing the CMC-H suspension and the sodium sulfamate solution saturated by CO  2  in a reactor with centrifugal force of more than or equal to 800G and liquid film thickness of less than or equal to 20 mu m, reacting at 50-60 ℃, and (C) washing the product obtained in the step (b), and then carrying out vacuum drying treatment. The scheme aims at obtaining the sulfamate sodium carboxymethyl cellulose with high elongation at break (high flexibility) and high viscosity through protonating the carboxymethyl cellulose and sulfonating the carboxymethyl cellulose with sodium sulfamate under specific process conditions.

title_en: Polyurethane flame-retardant moisture-permeable film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyurethane flame-retardant moisture-permeable film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the film comprises the following raw materials: isocyanate, polyether polyol, dihydric alcohol, chain extender, catalyst, flame retardant, organic solvent, dispersant, bentonite, kaolin, silane coupling agent, antioxidant and defoamer, according to the invention, a compound system is formed by adding halogen and halogen-free flame retardant, so that high-efficiency flame retardance is realized, the flame retardant cannot migrate to the surface of the film, and good hand feeling is maintained. Meanwhile, the yellowing resistance, the hydrolysis resistance and the heat resistance of the polyurethane are improved by adopting dihydric alcohol for modification. In addition, the modified bentonite is introduced to ensure that the film has good moisture permeability, thereby meeting the requirements of the related fields.

title_en: Flexible coating material with gradient transition layer and double-silver layer structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible coating material with a gradient transition layer and a double-silver layer structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the flexible coating material comprises a flexible substrate layer, a gradient transition layer and a double-silver layer; the gradient transition layer sequentially comprises a bottom coating, a middle coating and a surface coating, wherein the double silver layers sequentially comprise a first silver layer, a medium layer, a second silver layer and a protective layer, the middle coating contains carboxylated carbon nanotubes, and the carboxylated carbon nanotubes are arranged in an oriented manner. According to the invention, through gradient transition layer design and double-silver layer structure optimization, a high-light-transmittance and high-weather-resistance coating material based on a Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) substrate is obtained.

title_en: HDPE solid insulating material for net wires and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of net twine materials, and particularly relates to an HDPE solid insulating material for net twines and a preparation method thereof. 65-75 parts of HDPE, 10-20 parts of LLDPE, 5-10 parts of ethylene-octene copolymer, 2-5 parts of nano silicon dioxide, 0.5-1 part of antioxidant, 0.5-1 part of ultraviolet absorber, 0.5-2 parts of lubricant and 0.5-1 part of coupling agent by weight, adding a high-speed mixer to mix to obtain premix, and adding the premix into a double-screw extruder to obtain the HDPE solid insulation material for the net wire. The HDPE solid insulating material for the net wires, which has excellent physical properties, good dielectric properties and better environmental resistance and meets the practical use requirement of YD/T760-95 of the net wires, is obtained through reasonable formula design and optimized preparation process.

title_en: Preparation method of ultraviolet-resistant RCGT elastic FDY
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyester fibers, in particular to a preparation method of ultraviolet-resistant RCGT elastic FDY, which comprises the following steps of S1, esterifying terephthalic acid, 1, 4-butanediol and concentrated sulfuric acid, adding the esterification reaction kettle into the esterification reaction kettle, heating the esterification reaction kettle to obtain an esterification product, S2, pre-condensing, adding the esterification product and ethylene glycol into the polycondensation reaction kettle, filling nitrogen into the polycondensation reaction kettle, heating the polycondensation reaction kettle, keeping the temperature and the pressure for 20-30 min, vacuumizing and heating the polycondensation reaction kettle, keeping the temperature and the pressure for 1-2 h to obtain a pre-condensed product, S3, keeping the temperature and the pressure for 2-3 h to obtain a melt, and S4, spinning the melt by a spinning machine to obtain ultraviolet-resistant RCGT elastic FDY. The modified titanium dioxide has good compatibility with polyester, and can lead the ultraviolet-resistant RCGT elastic FDY to have good ultraviolet resistance and mechanical property.

title_en: Sheet-like heat radiation member
abstract_en: The present invention provides a sheet-like heat dissipation member which is disposed between a heat dissipation electronic component and a heat dissipation component, and which comprises a heat-softening heat-conductive composition containing (A) 100 parts by mass of a silicone resin having a melting point of 110 ℃ or less, (B) 500 to 1,850 parts by mass of silver powder, and (C) 1.0 to 20 parts by mass of an organohydrogen polysiloxane, wherein the average particle diameter of the silver powder of the component (B) is 0.5 to 10 [ mu ] m, the heat-softening heat-conductive composition contains 30 to 60% by volume of the silver powder of the component (B), and the organohydrogen polysiloxane of the component (C) contains an organohydrogen polysiloxane having 2 or more hydrogen silane groups in 1 molecule. Thus, a sheet-like heat dissipation member can be provided that exhibits excellent heat conductivity and heat dissipation performance even when heated and compressed at about 150 ℃.

title_en: Bending-resistant high-light-transmittance protective film for folding screen and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of protective films, and particularly relates to a bending-resistant high-light-transmittance protective film for a folding screen and a preparation process thereof. The bending-resistant high-light-transmittance protective film sequentially comprises a release layer, an OCA optical adhesive layer, a flexible substrate layer A, a flexible substrate layer B, a silica gel layer and a protective layer from top to bottom, wherein the raw materials of the flexible substrate layer A and the flexible substrate layer B all contain organic-inorganic hybrid particles, and the content of the organic-inorganic hybrid particles in the raw materials of the flexible substrate layer A is greater than that of the organic-inorganic hybrid particles in the raw materials of the flexible substrate layer B. The bending resistance, particularly the low-temperature bending resistance, the light transmittance and the hardness of the bending-resistant high-light transmittance protective film for the folding screen are excellent.

title_en: Aluminum alloy photovoltaic frame based on PID effect resistance and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy, in particular to an aluminum alloy photovoltaic frame based on PID effect resistance and a processing method thereof, in order to improve the PID resistance of the aluminum alloy photovoltaic frame, the invention firstly carries out anodic oxidation treatment on the aluminum alloy frame, prepares a layer of oxide film on the surface of the aluminum alloy by utilizing an anodic oxidation process, and on the basis of an anodic oxidation process, the invention also modifies the hole sealing process to prepare the anti-PID coating with ultraviolet resistance, hydrophobicity and water resistance, and fluorine and benzotriazole groups are introduced into the anti-PID coating to improve the water resistance and ultraviolet resistance of the coating, so that the anti-PID performance of the aluminum alloy photovoltaic frame can be maintained for a long time.

title_en: Polymer semiconductor material stable in photoetching, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic semiconductor materials, and particularly relates to a polymer semiconductor material with stable photoetching, and a preparation method and application thereof. The polymer semiconductor material is a D-A type copolymer PFIDTO-BSe, and the structure of the polymer semiconductor material comprises a diselenophene donor unit and a difluoro indacene acceptor unit. The material has excellent ultraviolet stability, mobility retention rate of >95% after 365nm irradiation, and good solvent resistance, and mobility retention rate of >95% after NMP soaking for 1000 minutes. Preparing organic field effect transistor array by Stille coupling, spin coating semiconductor film on the modified substrate, depositing photoresist, patterning, evaporating source and drain electrodes, and stripping the photoresist. The polymer semiconductor material is compatible with a photoetching process, realizes 7 mu m channel precision patterning, has a transistor array yield of more than 98 percent, and is suitable for manufacturing flexible integrated circuits.

title_en: Hydrogel system membrane model with hollow vascular structure, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogel series membrane model with a hollow vascular structure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the hydrogel series membrane model is characterized by being formed by a reaction system comprising, by weight, 8-12 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1.5-2.5 parts of ethylene vinyl alcohol, 8-12 parts of N-methylolacrylamide, 1-4 parts of polyethylene glycol diacrylate, 0.15-0.25 part of photoinitiator and up to 100 parts of mixed solvent, the mixed solvent is a solution formed by mixing a polar organic solvent and deionized water according to a volume ratio of 6:4 to 8:2, the preparation method is to prepare a double cross-linked network by adopting a mixed solvent system of N-propanol/water by dissolving the polyvinyl alcohol and the ethylene vinyl alcohol in stages, and preparing the hydrogel model by combining a photo-curing process at a wavelength of 405 nm. The invention has the advantages of high-fidelity reduction of mesenteric vessel morphology with water-proof property and adhesiveness, excellent mechanical property and thermal stability, and suitability for clinical training.

title_en: Anti-aging flame-retardant sheath material for automobile wires and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging flame-retardant sheath material for an automobile wire and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of materials. The anti-aging flame-retardant sheath material for the automobile wire, which is prepared by the method, comprises modified polypropylene, modified silicon dioxide and chloromethyl silicone oil, wherein the modified polypropylene is obtained by reacting amino-nitrothiazole after the reaction of amino polypropylene and bromine-1, 8-naphthalene anhydride, and then reducing, the modified silicon dioxide is obtained by grafting hexachlorocyclotriphosphazene with the amino silicon dioxide, then reacting with tert-butyl 4-hydroxyphenyl carbamate and methyl p-hydroxyphenylpropionate, and then reacting with 3- (3, 5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxyphenyl) propionyl hydrazine, and finally deprotecting.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a supramolecular polymer comprising polymer chains according to formula (I):  Wherein the average n in the supramolecular polymer is between 2 and 16, and wherein the building block-Q-represents:   wherein the average i in the supramolecular polymer is between 1.5 and 6.0, and wherein the building block-T-represents:   Wherein the average j in the supramolecular polymer is between 1 and 6, wherein the supramolecular polymer has an average molecular weight M  n  of about 15kDa to about 150kDa, wherein POL is a linear hydrophilic polymer group having an average molecular weight M  n  of about 1kDa to about 30kDa, wherein L and K represent linking groups, and wherein a represents a hydrogen bonding unit.

title_en: Water-soluble conjugate, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of agriculture and medicine industry, and can be applied to crop disease control, green agriculture, medical instrument coating and the like, and particularly relates to a water-soluble conjugate (carboxymethyl chitosan-carbendazim conjugate) and a preparation method and application thereof. The water-soluble conjugate is a water-soluble carboxymethyl chitosan-carbendazim conjugate. The invention successfully breaks through the solubility limit of the traditional chitosan and the carbendazim through a chemical modification means, so that the chitosan and the carbendazim can keep a stable dissolution state in neutral and weak alkaline environments, the pH range of application is greatly widened, the technical problems that the conventional chitosan is only dissolved in an acidic medium and the carbendazim is easy to separate out under an alkaline condition and the like are solved, and the technical support is provided for practical application.

title_en: Synthetic method of medium-refractive vinyl silicone resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing medium-refractive vinyl silicone resin, which comprises the following steps of mixing tetramethyl divinyl disiloxane with methanol, water and a solvent, adding trifluoro methane sulfonic acid as a catalyst, dropwise adding a mixture of methyl trimethoxy silane and phenyl trimethoxy silane, controlling the material temperature to be less than 15 ℃, heating to 60 ℃ under stirring after the dropwise adding is completed, refluxing for 3 hours, carrying out circulating water washing purification on reaction materials through anion-cation exchange resin, adding 25% KOH alcohol solution as the catalyst into the reaction materials, installing a water diversion device, carrying out reflux for 1-3 hours at 100 ℃ to obtain a polycondensation material, cooling the polycondensation material to below 60 ℃, adding acetic acid for neutralization, carrying out circulating water washing purification through anion-cation exchange resin until the conductivity is less than 5 us/cm and the pH is 5-7, filtering the polycondensation material, maintaining the vacuum degree at 110-120 ℃ for 100-101.325 MT (vacuum distillation) for 1-3 hours, and finally cooling to remove the solvent and low molecules, thus obtaining the medium-refractive vinyl silicone resin in a target product.

title_en: Hydrothermal preparation method and application of tough cellulose film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new materials, and discloses a hydrothermal preparation method and application of a tough cellulose film, comprising the following steps of a fiber pretreatment stage; and a heat pretreatment and molding stage to obtain the high-strength and high-toughness nano cellulose film with a continuous network structure. The invention improves the fiber-separating efficiency by heat pretreatment. The fiber length, the diameter distribution concentration degree is improved, and the microfiber size uniformity is good. The thermal pretreatment process in the method effectively reduces the gel structure strength, shortens the suction filtration time to 1/3 of the traditional method, and simultaneously reduces a large number of microcrack defects. The mechanical properties, namely toughness and fracture strain, of the cellulose membrane prepared by the method are obviously improved.

title_en: Hydrogel material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioelectrodes, in particular to a hydrogel material and a preparation method and application thereof. The hydrogel material takes amide polymers with a cyclic structure as a framework, metal salts as conductive particles and polyvinyl alcohol and/or polyethylene glycol as plasticizers, wherein the structure of the amide polymers with the cyclic structure is shown as a general formula (I):  One or more of X  1 ~X 4  is an amide group and is an alkyl group when the amide group is not an amide group, R  1 ~R 5  is independently, identically or differently a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group containing 1 to 10 carbon atoms, m is an arbitrary integer of 0 to 6, and n is an arbitrary integer of 20 to 20000. The invention provides a permeable low-impedance hydrogel material, which is used for improving the problem of insufficient tight interface contact between skin and an electrode, enhancing the definition of electrocardio and electroencephalogram signals and effectively overcoming the defects in the prior art.

title_en: Method for improving carrageenan extraction rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the extraction rate of carrageenan, which comprises the steps of pretreatment, extraction, concentration, precipitation purification, drying and finished product treatment, wherein an extraction device is used for carrying out the extraction treatment in the extraction step, the extraction device comprises an extraction mechanism, a controller, a solid lifting machine and liquid supply equipment, the controller is arranged on the outer surface of the extraction mechanism, the solid lifting machine is arranged at the right rear part outside the extraction mechanism, and the liquid supply equipment is arranged at the rear side outside the extraction mechanism.

title_en: High-phosphorus-content organic phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant and application thereof in preparation of flame-retardant polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant with high phosphorus content and application thereof in preparation of flame-retardant polymers. The molecular formula of the high-phosphorus-content organic phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant is (PH  2 O) n (EH m‑1 ) n  R, the structural general formula of which is shown as follows:  Wherein R is aliphatic or aromatic fragment, E is element N or O, m is more than or equal to 1, N is more than or equal to 1. According to the invention, the high-phosphorus-content organic phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant is added into a polymer matrix according to different proportions to obtain the flame-retardant composite material, and then the combustion performance and the mechanical property of the flame-retardant composite material are characterized. The results show that at lower levels of addition, the polymer material successfully passed UL 94V-0 rating with a substantial decrease in Heat Release Rate (HRR) and Total Heat Release (THR). Meanwhile, the mechanical property of the material is reduced to a small extent, and the mechanical property level is still kept to be excellent.

title_en: Heat conduction gasket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a heat-conducting gasket and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of heat-conducting materials. The heat-conducting gasket comprises, by weight, 90-110 parts of vinyl silicone oil, 290-310 parts of dimethyl silicone oil, 55-64 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 19000-21000 parts of heat-conducting filler, 1-2 parts of inhibitor, 30-45 parts of catalyst and 54-56 parts of low-boiling-point solvent. The elastic cross-linked network matrix is formed by vinyl silicone oil, hydrogen-containing silicone oil and dimethyl silicone oil, a high-proportion heat conducting filler is filled in the matrix to form a continuous electric conducting network, and a porous elastic structure is formed by combining low-boiling-point solvent volatilization, so that the heat conducting gasket has high heat conducting performance and high rebound resilience.

title_en: Aqueous polyurethane dispersion for primer, primer layer, and laminate
abstract_en: The invention provides an aqueous polyurethane dispersion for primer, a primer layer and a laminate, wherein the aqueous polyurethane dispersion can form a primer layer with excellent adhesion, hot water resistance, reagent resistance and moist heat resistance. The present invention relates to an aqueous polyurethane dispersion for primer, which is used for forming a primer layer on an amorphous resin substrate, and a polymer containing a composition comprising an aromatic isocyanate, an alkylene oxide adduct of bisphenol A, a linear aliphatic polyol having 3 to 5 carbon atoms, a diol compound having a carboxyl group, and a polyol compound X having a number average molecular weight of 500 to 3000.

title_en: Antistatic heat-conducting polycarbonate composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antistatic heat-conducting polycarbonate composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the material comprises, by mass, 70-80 parts of polycarbonate, 5-8 parts of silicon powder, 6-9 parts of alumina, 12-16 parts of glass fiber powder, 12-16 parts of modified carbon fiber, 3-4 parts of dispersed toughening agent, 5-6 parts of EMA, 4-6 parts of flame retardant, 0.5-1.0 part of anti-dripping agent, 0.5-1.0 part of lubricant, 0.6-1.0 part of silicone powder, 0.4-0.7 part of antioxidant and 1-3 parts of titanium dioxide. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, mixing the components through a staged mixing process to obtain a premixed material, and S2, adding the premixed material into a double-screw extruder, extruding and granulating. The material provided by the invention has good antistatic performance, mechanical performance, heat conduction performance and weather resistance, and meets the requirements of electronic product shells.

title_en: Fluorine-free positive electrode binder, positive electrode plate and lithium ion secondary battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluoride-free positive electrode binder, a positive electrode plate and a lithium ion secondary battery. The fluorine-free positive electrode binder comprises a copolymer, wherein the copolymer comprises a first structural unit and a second structural unit, the first structural unit comprises an acrylonitrile structural unit, and the second structural unit comprises a cyano group, a functional structural unit and a polyether structural unit. The fluorine-free positive electrode binder has low electrolyte swelling degree, the positive electrode plate prepared by the binder has good flexibility, and the lithium ion secondary battery prepared by the positive electrode plate has low impedance.

title_en: High-temperature creep-resistant thermoplastic crosslinked rubber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-temperature creep-resistant thermoplastic crosslinked rubber, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of rubber materials. The preparation method of the high-temperature creep-resistant thermoplastic crosslinked rubber comprises the steps of carrying out primary mixing, primary vulcanization and granulation on a first raw rubber and a static crosslinking agent to obtain static high-crosslinked rubber particles, carrying out secondary mixing and secondary vulcanization on a second raw rubber, a dynamic crosslinking agent, a filler and the static high-crosslinked rubber particles to obtain the high-temperature creep-resistant thermoplastic crosslinked rubber, wherein the first raw rubber and the second raw rubber are the same or different. The application can construct and form a static/dynamic cross-linked creep-resistant two-phase network structure, wherein a static phase in the network structure can limit excessive slip of a dynamic phase molecular chain based on a steric hindrance effect, so that the cooperative optimization of creep resistance and reworking performance is realized, and the application has wide application prospects in the preparation of rubber products.

title_en: Preparation method and application of two-component high-performance strippable protective coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-component high-performance strippable protective coating which comprises, by weight, 80-100 parts of a component A and 20-30 parts of a component B, wherein the component A comprises hyperbranched resin, an acrylic dispersion 1, an acrylic dispersion 2, an impact-resistant functional agent, a leveling agent and the like, the component B is an isocyanate curing agent, the impact-resistant functional agent containing biphenyl and an unsaturated long-chain olefin structure participates in the preparation of the coating, the mechanical property and the structural strength of the coating are improved, the water-proof performance and the water-proof performance of the substrate can be synergistically improved with an aging-resistant agent, and meanwhile, the aging-resistant agent contains a hindered phenol structure which can be synergistically endowed with the anti-aging effect of the coating substrate with nanometer zinc oxide, so that the aging-resistant performance of the substrate is improved.

title_en: Epoxy resin composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underfill adhesives, and particularly relates to an epoxy resin composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The epoxy resin composition comprises epoxy resin, a trifunctional epoxy compound, a toughening agent, a curing agent, optional toner and an optional coupling agent, wherein the trifunctional epoxy compound has a structure shown in a formula (1). The key point of the invention is to add a trifunctional epoxy compound with a specific structure into the epoxy resin composition, wherein the trifunctional epoxy compound has a tetraethylene glycol structure, a pyridine structure and three epoxy groups, the two epoxy groups are respectively bonded on carbon ortho to nitrogen atoms on the pyridine ring, and the rest one epoxy group is bonded on the tetraethylene glycol structure, and the specific trifunctional epoxy compound has unique electronic conjugation characteristics and chemical activity, so that the epoxy resin composition can be endowed with good toughness. title_en: Cyanogen-containing phosphate derivative, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flame retardance of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a cyanogen-containing phosphate derivative, and a preparation method and application thereof. The cyanogen-containing phosphate derivative provided by the invention contains phosphorus and nitrogen elements, can obviously improve the flame retardant property of the epoxy resin, has small influence on environment compared with the epoxy resin added with the halogen flame retardant, and is more environment-friendly. The epoxy resin composition containing the cyanogen phosphate derivative has the characteristics of high flame retardance and high mechanical property retention, and can be used for preparing epoxy resin products.

title_en: Graphene hydrogel micro-current stable wearable bioelectrode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocardio electrodes, in particular to a graphene hydrogel microcurrent stabilized wearable bioelectrode and a preparation method thereof, wherein a flexible substrate layer, a conductive layer, an interface modification layer, a water-locking protective layer and a high water-retaining layer are sequentially laminated on the electrode from bottom to top; the electrode is also provided with an encapsulation layer, the encapsulation layer is a porous encapsulation film covered on the upper surfaces of the flexible substrate layer and the conductive layer, and the middle part of the encapsulation layer is provided with a window exposing the composite hydrogel, so that continuous high-fidelity acquisition and stability acquisition of bioelectricity signals, especially microcurrent signals under dynamic and long-term monitoring scenes are realized.

title_en: Preparation method of antibacterial gamma-polyglutamic acid super absorbent hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an antibacterial gamma-polyglutamic acid super absorbent hydrogel, which comprises the following steps of (1) preparing gamma-polyglutamic acid solution, (2) dissolving an antibacterial drug in the gamma-polyglutamic acid solution, fully stirring and uniformly mixing to obtain mixed solution 1, regulating the pH of the mixed solution 1, heating the mixed solution 1 to 60 ℃ for continuous reaction for 1-2 hours to obtain mixed solution 2, cooling the mixed solution 2 to room temperature, adding a cross-linking agent, uniformly mixing to obtain mixed solution 3, standing the mixed solution 3 at room temperature for 1-3 hours, and then carrying out gradient heating reaction to obtain an antibacterial gel-like product, (3) dehydrating and vacuum negative pressure drying the antibacterial gel-like product to obtain a dried hydrogel product, namely the antibacterial gamma-polyglutamic acid super absorbent hydrogel. The antibacterial gamma-polyglutamic acid super absorbent hydrogel prepared by the invention has good biocompatibility, is safe and nontoxic, has excellent water absorption performance and antibacterial performance, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Composite material based on natural bamboo and having mechanical strength and X/gamma ray shielding performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite material with mechanical strength and X/gamma ray shielding performance based on natural bamboo, which comprises the following steps of 1, fully mixing and reacting high Z element salt, an adhesive and bamboo to obtain a composite, wherein the mass ratio of the high Z element salt to the adhesive to the bamboo is 1-3:1-100:1-100, 2, carrying out hot press molding on the composite obtained in the step 1, and carrying out compression molding to obtain the required composite material. The shielding material has the characteristics of light weight, high mechanical strength and strong shielding performance.

title_en: Weather-resistant PMMA/ASA alloy material with high surface hardness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses a weather-resistant PMMA/ASA alloy material with high surface hardness, which comprises, by weight, 30-70 parts of PMMA, 30-70 parts of ASA, 3-6 parts of a compatilizer, 5-15 parts of a stiffening agent, 0.3-0.6 part of a lubricant, 0.2-0.8 part of an ultraviolet light absorber, 0.2-0.8 part of a light stabilizer, 0.2-0.8 part of an antioxidant and 5 parts of a surfactant, wherein the stiffening agent is at least one of quartz powder, talcum powder, calcium carbonate, mica powder, glass beads, wollastonite and barium sulfate, and the surfactant is N-2-aminoethyl-3-aminopropyl trimethoxysilane with a molecular weight of 150-500. The stiffening agent, the ultraviolet light absorber and the light stabilizer are compounded in the formula system, and the stiffening agent, the ultraviolet light absorber and the light stabilizer are synergistic, so that the surface hardness of the material is enhanced, and the material is ensured to have excellent weather resistance.

title_en: Nylon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a nylon composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. The nylon composite material comprises, by mass, 37% -89% of nylon, 10% -60% of long glass fibers and 0.5% -3% of modified lubricants, wherein the length of the long glass fibers is equal to that of the nylon composite material, and the modified lubricants comprise furfuryl-modified amide lubricants. The nylon composite material can improve the compatibility of long glass fibers and nylon and improve the mechanical property of the nylon composite material.

title_en: Polystyrene-b-polydimethylsiloxane-b-polystyrene triblock copolymer, cable material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials, and discloses a polystyrene-b-polydimethylsiloxane-b-polystyrene triblock copolymer, a cable material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the polystyrene-b-polydimethylsiloxane-b-polystyrene triblock copolymer (PS-b-PDMS-b-PS) comprises the step of carrying out click chemistry reaction on polystyrene (PS-SH) with end groups of sulfhydryl groups and divinyl-terminated polydimethylsiloxane to obtain PS-b-PDMS-b-PS, wherein the preparation method of the PS-SH comprises the step of carrying out polymerization reaction on styrene and ethylene sulfide to obtain PS-SH, and the molar ratio of the styrene to the ethylene sulfide is (20-60): 1. The polystyrene-b-polydimethylsiloxane-b-polystyrene triblock copolymer prepared by the invention can improve the elongation at break and gamma-ray radiation resistance of the cable material.

title_en: Preparation method of bletilla striata polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant deep processing, in particular to a preparation method of bletilla striata polysaccharide. The method comprises the steps of (1) cleaning rhizoma bletillae, slicing, drying, crushing, performing steam explosion treatment, drying and crushing, 2) performing hot water leaching on rhizoma bletillae powder subjected to steam explosion, reserving supernatant, sequentially adding high-temperature resistant alpha-amylase, saccharifying enzyme and protease, inactivating enzyme, taking supernatant, 3) performing alcohol precipitation on the supernatant, washing reserved precipitate with absolute ethyl alcohol, adding water to the precipitate for redissolution, and performing freeze drying to obtain rhizoma bletillae polysaccharide. According to the invention, the bletilla striata is subjected to steam explosion technology treatment and then subjected to hot water leaching, so that the extraction rate of the bletilla striata polysaccharide is improved compared with the extraction of the bletilla striata polysaccharide only by hot water, and the prepared bletilla striata polysaccharide has higher sugar content.

title_en: Clay mineral surface hydration intercalation inhibitor for drilling fluid, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of drilling fluid inhibitors, and discloses a clay mineral surface hydration intercalation inhibitor for drilling fluid, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the intercalation inhibitor comprises a compound of a formula A with the following structure:  the intercalation inhibitor can effectively solve the technical problem that the existing intercalation inhibitor can not completely inhibit the surface hydration of clay minerals.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant polypropylene insulated cable and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrosion-resistant polypropylene insulated cable and a preparation process thereof, belonging to the technical field of cables; the corrosion-resistant polypropylene insulated cable comprises a cable core, a wrapping layer, an inner sheath layer, an armor layer and an outer sheath layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, wherein the inner sheath layer and the outer sheath layer are both prepared from corrosion-resistant polypropylene cable materials, the corrosion-resistant polypropylene cable materials comprise polypropylene, POE (polyolefin elastomer), a plasticizer, a composite flame retardant, a heat conducting filler, a lubricant, an ultraviolet absorber and a nucleating agent, the composite flame retardant is prepared from cyanuric chloride, 4-hydroxymethyl-1-oxo-1-phospha-2, 6, 7-trioxabicyclo [2.2.2] octane, hydroxyl N-alkoxy hindered amine, ethylenediamine and N- (2-aminoethyl) maleimide, the heat conducting filler is prepared from graphene oxide, a silane coupling agent, boron nitride and 3, 5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxycinnamic acid, and the corrosion-resistant polypropylene insulated cable prepared by the method has good corrosion resistance, heat dissipation, flame retardance, thermal aging resistance and mechanical property.

abstract_en: The fluoroether compound .R 1 -CH 2 -R 2 ［-CH 2 -R 3 -CH 2 -R 2 ］ x -CH 2 -R 4 (x represented by the following formula is 1 or 2.R  2  is a perfluoropolyether chain. title_en: Microsphere filler based on polyhydroxyalkanoate-polyglutamic acid graft copolymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microsphere filler based on polyhydroxyalkanoate-polyglutamic acid graft copolymer, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the microsphere filler comprises the steps of (1) preparing a polyhydroxyalkanoate-polyglutamic acid graft copolymer, (2) preparing an organic phase, an inner water phase and an outer water phase respectively, and (3) sequentially mixing the organic phase, the inner water phase and the outer water phase to prepare the microsphere filler based on the polyhydroxyalkanoate-polyglutamic acid graft copolymer. The microsphere filler provided by the invention has a compression modulus of 150-200 kPa, and the degradation products are hydroxy fatty acid and glutamic acid, so that the microsphere filler is nontoxic, has a cell survival rate of more than 90%, and has good biocompatibility. Meanwhile, the degradation period of the microsphere filler is matched with the tissue repair period, and the microsphere pores promote fibroblast adhesion and collagen deposition, so that the degradation and regeneration of the microsphere filler are controllable.

title_en: Bi-component foaming silicon rubber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-component foaming silicone rubber which comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the preparation raw materials of the component A comprise a first base rubber, a first reinforcing agent, a first surface treatment agent, first hydroxyl polysiloxane, an alcohol compound, a platinum complex catalyst and a first flame retardant, the preparation raw materials of the component B comprise a second base rubber, a second reinforcing agent, a second surface treatment agent, a second hydroxyl polysiloxane, a filling agent, vinyl-terminated silicone oil, hydrogen-containing silicone oil, a cross-linking agent and a second flame retardant, the first base rubber and the second base rubber are vinyl silicone oil, and the viscosity of the first base rubber and the second base rubber at 25 ℃ is 1000-8000 MPa.s. Based on the system, the foaming silicon rubber with proper cell diameter can be obtained by controlling the viscosity of vinyl silicone oil, the uniformity of the cells of the material is improved, and the foaming silicon rubber has lower heat conductivity coefficient and better mechanical property. In addition, the invention also provides a preparation method and application of the bi-component foaming silicon rubber.

title_en: Microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer in the field of high polymer materials, and a preparation method and application thereof. The microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer comprises a high-valence metal ion polymer of maleic anhydride, the high-valence metal ion polymer is obtained by ring-opening maleic anhydride in a maleic anhydride copolymer and then connecting the maleic anhydride copolymer with high-valence metal ions, the maleic anhydride copolymer is a maleic anhydride linear copolymer, the microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer is spherical or spheroidic, the average grain diameter of the microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer is 3.5-15 mu m, the microsphere maleic anhydride ionomer takes the maleic anhydride linear copolymer as a matrix, salinization is carried out, then high-valence salt replacement crosslinking is carried out, and finally microsphere modifier with small grain diameter is prepared in a spray drying mode, so that the microsphere ionomer has multiple functions and application fields, and the preparation method is simple and efficient.

title_en: Battery cell insulating film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cell films, in particular to a cell insulating film and a preparation method thereof. The battery cell insulating film comprises, by weight, 30-50 parts of alicyclic epoxy resin, 20-30 parts of bis (7-oxabicyclo [4.1.0] 3-heptylmethyl) adipate, 15-25 parts of cyclohexane-1, 2-dicarboxylic acid diglycidyl ester, 10-15 parts of 4, 5-epoxy tetrahydrophthalic acid diglycidyl ester, 5-10 parts of 3-ethyl-3-hydroxymethyl oxetane, 10-30 parts of bisphenol F diglycidyl ether and 1-6 parts of a cationic curing agent. The invention adopts the formula of alicyclic epoxy resin, epoxy resin and photo-cationic curing agent, and solves the problems of low automation degree, low curing speed, high energy consumption and the like in the traditional production process of the cell blue film by innovating the formula and the curing mode, thereby having wide application prospect.

title_en: Composite material containing core-shell structured filler and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite material containing core-shell structured filler and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, taking deionized water, sodium hydroxide solution and nano-scale calcium carbonate, and mixing the deionized water, the sodium hydroxide solution and the nano-scale calcium carbonate by stirring to prepare a first suspension. S2, mixing zinc chloride and deionized water to obtain a zinc chloride solution. And S3, introducing the zinc chloride solution prepared in the step S2 into the first suspension prepared in the step S1, and fully mixing the zinc chloride solution in the first suspension by stirring, and simultaneously reacting to prepare a second suspension. And S4, filtering the second suspension to obtain a filler precursor. S5, performing heat treatment on the filler precursor to obtain the core-shell structured filler. S6, carrying out melt blending on the core-shell structured filler and the PP granules to obtain the antibacterial PP granules. S7, adding the antibacterial PP granules into an injection machine for molding, and preparing the composite material containing the core-shell structured filler. Thereby improving the comprehensive performance of the tensile strength and the antibacterial rate of the composite material.

title_en: Low-ice-adhesion superhydrophobic anti-icing coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-ice-adhesion superhydrophobic anti-icing coating and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, single-end amino fluorosilicone oil is grafted on the surface of an aldehyde functional metal organic frame material through an amino-aldehyde condensation reaction, a hydrophobically modified metal organic frame material is obtained, and then the hydrophobically modified metal organic frame material is compounded with a synthesized fluorine-containing acrylate copolymer, and a coating is prepared through ultrasonic dispersion and spray curing processes. The low-ice adhesion superhydrophobic anti-icing coating prepared by the invention realizes the excellent performance that the static water contact angle is more than or equal to 160 degrees, the rolling angle is less than or equal to 2 degrees and the ice adhesion strength is less than or equal to 20kPa through the synergistic effect of fluorosilane grafting modification and the micro-nano structure. Compared with the traditional anti-icing coating, the invention adopts a metal organic frame material functionalization modification strategy, obviously reduces ice adhesion while maintaining the mechanical stability of the coating, and can realize uniform film formation on the surfaces of base materials such as aluminum wires and the like by a spraying process. The coating is suitable for the anti-icing protection of the aluminum conductor of the power transmission line, and has the characteristics of long-acting anti-icing and low ice adhesion.

title_en: 3D printing photo-curing resin, preparation method thereof and printing process
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses 3D printing photo-curing resin, a preparation method and a printing process thereof. The raw material components of the 3D printing photo-curing resin comprise acrylic resin, a photoinitiator, a photo-absorber, color paste and an auxiliary agent, wherein the acrylic resin is at least one of polyurethane acrylic resin, polyester acrylic resin, epoxy acrylic resin and polyether acrylic resin, the number average molecular weight of the acrylic resin is 1000-10000 g/mol, the viscosity of the acrylic resin is 40000-1200000cps at 25 ℃, and/or the viscosity of the acrylic resin is 3000-300000 cps at 60 ℃, and the temperature of a printer resin groove in the preparation method and the printing process is controlled by limiting the proportion of the raw material components, so that the prepared printing finished product has good mechanical property, high notch impact strength and low dimensional shrinkage.

title_en: Rubber sealing hydrogen-resistant wear-resistant composite coating for hydrogen energy equipment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rubber sealing hydrogen-resistant wear-resistant composite coating for hydrogen energy equipment and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of firstly etching MAX phase to obtain MXene powder, then modifying epoxy resin EP by adopting hydroxyl-terminated polydimethylsiloxane PDMS-OH under the action of KH550 to form modified epoxy resin, then adding MXene dispersion liquid dispersed in a curing agent into the modified epoxy resin to form a composite coating, and preparing the MXene-containing modified epoxy resin composite coating on the pretreated rubber surface by a dip coating method. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, high in bonding strength of the composite coating and the substrate, capable of realizing double protection of hydrogen resistance, abrasion resistance and friction reduction of the rubber substrate, and applicable to large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Liquid epoxy molding compound with low warpage and high reliability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a liquid epoxy molding compound with low warpage and high reliability, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the liquid epoxy molding compound comprises, by mass, 86% -88% of an inorganic filler, 6% -10% of an alicyclic epoxy resin monomer, 1.5% -7% of a silicon-epoxy hybrid resin, 0.3% -0.8% of a stress release agent, 0.2% -0.5% of a cationic thermal initiator, 0.1% -0.2% of a first silane coupling agent and 0.1% -0.2% of a coloring agent, the inorganic filler is silicon dioxide subjected to surface modification by a second silane coupling agent, and the first silane coupling agent is a silane coupling agent containing alicyclic epoxy groups. The liquid epoxy plastic packaging material has excellent fluidity, warping inhibition performance, damage resistance performance, bonding performance and wet heat resistance, and is suitable for being used as a packaging material in 2.5D packaging.

title_en: Silicon-rich anti-reflection resin, preparation method thereof and coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-rich anti-reflection resin, which has a structural formula shown in a formula (1), wherein x, y and z are respectively 0 or 1. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the silicon-rich anti-reflection resin, which comprises the steps of (1) dissolving a modified phthalonitrile monomer, a catalyst I and a carbon-carbon double bond monomer containing a crosslinking group in a solvent to react to obtain a mixed solution A, (2) dissolving the mixed solution A, a siloxane monomer containing a light absorption group and a catalyst II in the solvent to react to obtain a mixed solution B, and (3) distilling the mixed solution B under reduced pressure to remove residual solvent to obtain the silicon-rich anti-reflection resin. The silicon-rich anti-reflection coating obtained by spin coating the silicon-rich anti-reflection resin on a semiconductor substrate and curing and baking at high temperature can meet the requirements of the silicon-rich anti-reflection coating on etching rate and anti-reflection function under different application scenes. title_en: Conductive polymer solution and application thereof, conductive polymer and electrolytic capacitor
abstract_en: In order to solve the problem that the conductive polymer in the existing electrolytic capacitor is unevenly dispersed on electrolytic paper, the invention provides a conductive polymer solution which comprises n-type conductive polymer, solvent and electron withdrawing group compound, wherein the n-type conductive polymer comprises polymer polymerized by the compound shown in a structural formula 1;  The electron withdrawing group compound comprises one or more of butyraldehyde, valeraldehyde, acetone, butanone, adipic acid, sebacic acid, dodecylbenzene sulfonic acid, dodecylsulfonic acid and ethylene terephthalate. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses application of the conductive polymer solution, a conductive polymer and an electrolytic capacitor. The conductive polymer solution provided by the invention can obviously improve the dispersion uniformity of the n-type conductive polymer on the electrolytic paper in the core package and improve the overall performance of the solid aluminum electrolytic capacitor.

title_en: Modified PBO fiber with high composite property with resin, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified PBO fiber with high composite property with resin, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of PBO fiber modification, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing the PBO fiber; S2, preparing PBO fiber A with nano silicon dioxide embedded on the surface, S3, preparing PBO fiber B after heat treatment, and S4, preparing PBO fiber after surface modification, thereby solving the problems of poor composite property of PBO fiber and resin, low interface strength and influence on the mechanical property of PBO composite material in the prior art.

title_en: Silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT, composite fiber thereof and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of silicon-containing polyester, and discloses silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT, a composite fiber thereof and a preparation method thereof. The molecular chain of the silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT comprises a polydimethylsiloxane chain segment, wherein the silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT comprises raw materials of 1, 3-propanediol, terephthalic acid, double-end hydroxyl polydimethylsiloxane and a dispersing agent, and the dispersing agent comprises polyacrylate and dodecylbenzene sulfonate. The invention can ensure that the silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT has better melt fluidity and the polydimethylsiloxane chain segments in the silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT are uniformly distributed, thereby ensuring that the silicon-containing modified hydrophobic PTT has better hydrophobic property and mechanical property.

title_en: Preparation method of MOF material and catalyst ink containing corresponding MOF material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a MOF material and catalyst ink containing the corresponding MOF material, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing 1.5-2.5 parts of metal chloride, 0.8-2.4 parts of terephthalic acid organic ligand, 30-60 parts of N, N-dimethylformamide and 3.5-7 parts of weak acid according to weight ratio, heating the mixed solution to perform chemical reaction, and then cooling, filtering, cleaning, activating and drying the mixed solution to obtain the MOF material. The catalyst ink comprises, by weight, 0.75-2.25 parts of a platinum-containing catalyst, 9-27 parts of a perfluorosulfonic acid polymer solution, 18-54 parts of a deionized water-isopropanol mixture, and 0.05-0.14 part of the prepared MOF material. The catalyst ink can improve the power of the fuel cell by not less than 40 percent.

title_en: SERS substrate based on functionalized gold nano bipyramid@covalent organic framework and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SERS substrate based on a functionalized gold nano bipyramid@covalent organic framework and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of analysis and detection. The SERS substrate comprises a carrier and an AuNBPs@COF composite material loaded on the carrier, wherein the AuNBPs@COF composite material comprises a gold nano bipyramid positioned at a core and a COF shell layer coating the gold nano bipyramid, the COF shell layer can efficiently enrich DA molecules and separate matrix impurities, and AuNBPs plays a role in enhancing SERS signals. The synergistic design of AuNBPs enhanced-COF recognition solves the problems of low content of shellfish toxin, complex background interference and difficulty in efficiently separating and enriching alginic acid toxin from complex samples, breaks through the limitation of insufficient SERS activity of a pure COF material, and provides a novel sensing platform with high sensitivity and excellent selectivity for marine toxin detection.

title_en: Double-layer capsule shell controlled release type fish oil soft capsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer capsule shell controlled release type fish oil soft capsule and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of fish oil soft capsules. A double-layer capsule shell controlled release fish oil soft capsule comprises an outer layer large capsule shell, an inner layer small capsule shell and fish oil content wrapped in the inner layer small capsule shell. The invention realizes multiple technical breakthroughs through a double-layer structure and a full polysaccharide system design, wherein an outer layer capsule shell is used for constructing an environment barrier, an inner layer is used for realizing intestinal targeted controlled release, fish oil gastric stimulation is radically avoided, the requirements of special crowds such as infants, postoperative patients and the like are met, the full polysaccharide raw material is used for replacing gelatin, the problem of cross-linking aging is avoided, the long-term disintegration stability and bioavailability of the capsule shell are ensured, meanwhile, auxiliary materials are used for cooperatively improving the storage performance, the pain points such as gastrointestinal discomfort, storage failure and the like of the traditional single-layer capsule shell and the gelatin capsule shell are effectively solved, and the comprehensive performance is obviously superior to that of the traditional fish oil soft capsule, and has safety, stability and special crowd suitability.

title_en: Modified hyperbranched polyester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hyperbranched polyesters, and discloses a modified hyperbranched polyester, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the number average molecular weight of the modified hyperbranched polyester is 890-2450 Da, the polydispersity index is 1.17-1.21, the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly reacting CEPPA with TMP to obtain hyperbranched polyester, and then reacting modifier with the hyperbranched polyester to obtain the modified hyperbranched polyester, and the application is used for melt blending with HDPE to obtain the modified HDPE, wherein the tensile strength of the modified HDPE is 20.31-22.83 MPa, the yield load is 75.2-82.8N, the impact strength is 10.6-12.3 kJ/m  2 , and the melt index at 200 ℃ and 2.16kg is 7.1-8.5 g/10min. The invention realizes plasticization and maintains and even enhances mechanical properties.

title_en: Anti-shrinkage liquid bridge plug material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-shrinkage liquid bridge plug material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the liquid bridge plug material is prepared from a glue hardening agent, an adhesion reinforcing agent and thermal expansion particles as raw materials, and the mass ratio of the glue hardening agent to the adhesion reinforcing agent to the thermal expansion particles is (15-25): (65-70): (5-10). The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and stirring the glue hardening agent, the bonding reinforcing agent and the thermal expansion particles according to the proportion, and curing in an oven to obtain the liquid bridge plug material.
