According to the invention, by doping thermal expansion particles in the material and modifying the fixedly-connected monomer, the volume shrinkage of the liquid bridge plug material in the curing process is successfully reduced, the stability of the material is remarkably improved, the adhesive property of the material is improved, the adhesive capability with the wall surface of a shaft or a leakage channel is enhanced, and the challenges in fracturing and plugging construction can be effectively met.

title_en: Waterproof fiber composite board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof fiber composite board and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fiber composite boards. Mixing and stirring fir wood fiber, maleic anhydride, benzoyl peroxide and N, N-dimethylaniline to react to obtain pretreated wood fiber, mixing the pretreated wood fiber with phenolic resin with the solid content of 50% to obtain a wood matrix material, adding modified pollen, modified lotus leaf wax, stannous octoate and modified aerogel to mix and stir to obtain functional slurry, pouring the functional slurry into a mould, and carrying out hot pressing treatment to obtain the waterproof fiber composite board. The chemical bonding of the modified aerogel and the pretreated wood fibers and the modified pollen is realized through isocyanate groups, a continuous heat preservation network is constructed to endow heat preservation property, the phenolic resin, the modified pollen and the modified lotus leaf wax form a double waterproof barrier, the problem of easy migration of hydrophobic components is solved, and the components cooperate to ensure that the product has excellent waterproof, antibacterial, heat preservation, mechanical property and thermal stability.

title_en: Acrylic resin emulsion, preparation method thereof and application thereof in scraping ink
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of scratch-off ink, and provides an acrylic resin emulsion, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in scratch-off ink. The raw materials for preparing the acrylic resin emulsion comprise 18-30 parts of hard monomers, 0.5-2 parts of functional monomers, 7-13 parts of soft monomers, 3-10 parts of flexible monomers, 0.2-1 part of crosslinking monomers, 0.1-1 part of initiators, 0.2-1 part of emulsifying agents, 0.01-0.1 part of bactericides and 52-72 parts of water. The acrylic resin emulsion provided by the invention has good film forming property and strong bonding capability with a base material, and the aqueous scratch ink prepared by the acrylic resin emulsion has high adhesion fastness, is easy to scratch, is flaky after being scratched, is not easy to dirty hands and cannot be restored. Meanwhile, the water-based scratch ink provided by the invention does not contain an organic solvent, is good in environmental protection and has a wide application prospect in the field of instant lottery.

title_en: Curved polyaniline modified 3D printing polyurethane material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polymer preparation, and particularly relates to a curved polyaniline modified 3D printing polyurethane material and application thereof. The invention combines the ice crystal hard template method with the polyether glycol soft template method to adjust the microstructure of polyaniline, thus preparing the curved polyaniline with regular morphology. The curved surface arc structure has larger specific surface area, and can form more contact sites with the resin when being directly fused and blended with the resin, thereby being beneficial to constructing a conductive path, and simultaneously being difficult to agglomerate due to the curved surface structure. And the polyaniline with the arc-shaped structure presents a three-dimensional space structure, and is directly blended with the resin to form a randomly arranged conductive network structure, so that the composite material is not easy to break when impacted, and can be better embedded between the resins to form a stress transmission channel, a complex three-dimensional network structure is constructed, and the mechanical property and antistatic capacity of the product are improved.

title_en: Mute ABS composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mute ABS composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite material is prepared from the following components, by weight, 70-90 parts of ABS resin, 10-30 parts of TPU resin, 3-6 parts of compatilizer, 0.5 part of antioxidant and 0.4-0.6 part of lubricant. By adding the high-viscoelasticity damping TPU resin into the ABS resin, the noise performance of the high-viscoelasticity damping TPU resin is obviously improved compared with that of the common ABS resin, the abnormal sound generated in the use process of plastic parts can be greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the mute ABS composite material has higher toughness, and can be widely applied to industries such as household appliances, automobiles, electronic appliances and the like.

title_en: Recycling method of epoxy resin pouring glue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycling method of epoxy resin pouring glue, which comprises the steps of catalyzing, crushing and surface modifying epoxy resin pouring glue waste materials by a silane coupling agent, mixing the epoxy resin pouring glue waste materials with new epoxy resin and lignin-based dynamic covalent cross-linking agents to form a reversible cross-linking network with pH/temperature dual response, adding a defoaming agent, an accelerator and a curing agent, and carrying out gradient curing to obtain the new epoxy resin pouring glue. The invention enhances the dispersibility of the waste epoxy resin pouring glue through the surface, thereby improving the mechanical property of the new epoxy resin pouring glue, realizing the recycling of waste epoxy resin pouring glue resources and reducing the pollution to the environment.

title_en: Transparent thermoplastic resin composition, injection molded article, light guide for vehicle, light guide member, daytime running light for vehicle, and aspherical lens
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a transparent thermoplastic resin composition for use in a molded article excellent in transparency, heat resistance, long-term heat stability, light resistance and moldability and having a reduced yellowing. The invention provides a transparent thermoplastic resin composition, an injection molded article, a light guide for a vehicle, a light guide member, a daytime running light for a vehicle, and an aspherical lens. The transparent thermoplastic resin composition comprises 95-99.999% by mass of a transparent thermoplastic resin (A) and 0.001-0.3% by mass of a phosphorus compound (B) represented by the general formula (1), wherein the Vicat softening temperature of the transparent thermoplastic resin composition is 105 ℃ or higher.

title_en: Wave-transparent rain-erosion-resistant anti-icing polyurea hydrophobic coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A wave-transparent rain erosion-resistant anti-icing polyurea hydrophobic coating and a preparation method thereof are provided, wherein after a solution A containing isophorone diisocyanate (IPDI) and Hexamethylene Diisocyanate (HDI) and a solution B containing polyetheramine 2000 (PEA 2000), diaminopropyl Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and 4,4- (hexafluoroisopropyl) bis (p-phenoxy) diphenylamine (HFBAPP) are prepared, the solution A and the solution B are uniformly mixed and then fully reacted and sprayed on the surface of a substrate, and after curing, the polyurea coating with adjustable hydrophobic property is obtained. According to the invention, an anti-rain erosion wave-transparent polyurea coating with a low dielectric constant is constructed by introducing an asymmetric hydrogen bond network and a low-polarity unit into a polyurea molecular chain, and then an integral intrinsic polyurea hydrophobic coating with wave-transparent, anti-rain erosion and anti-icing performances is designed on the premise of not adding any micro-nano filler by combining a technology of dynamically driving directional rearrangement of the molecular chain on the surface of the polyurea coating and dynamic evolution of a micro-nano structure.

title_en: Intelligent response liquid crystal elastomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent response liquid crystal elastomer and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of liquid crystal elastomer preparation, wherein a liquid crystal monomer, a cross-linking agent, a photoinitiator and a catalyst are dissolved in an organic solvent to obtain a mixed solution, the mixed solution is injected into a template to carry out primary cross-linking, and is taken out after fiber formation and dried to obtain P-LCE fibers, the P-LCE fibers are subjected to drafting treatment and then impregnated with a silica gel solution, then suspended and placed, and the silica gel solution wrapped on the surfaces of the fibers is dried and solidified, and then subjected to secondary cross-linking to obtain LCEP. The intelligent response liquid crystal elastomer prepared by the application presents spiral curling shrinkage deformation under thermal stimulation, and has the advantages of large shrinkage rate, high response speed, reversible deformation and almost unchanged shrinkage rate after 100 times of cyclic stimulation.

title_en: PU toy material with long-acting antibacterial function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of polyurethane, and particularly discloses a PU toy material with a long-acting antibacterial function and a preparation method thereof; the PU toy material with the long-acting antibacterial function comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of isocyanate, 25-35 parts of polyester polyol, 20-30 parts of filler, 1-3 parts of foaming agent, 1-3 parts of low molecular weight cationic polysaccharide, 0.3-0.5 part of catalyst, 3-5 parts of composite antibacterial agent, 1-3 parts of coupling agent and 1-3 parts of peroxide vulcanizing agent; the composite antibacterial agent is an in-situ polymerization antibacterial agent and an inorganic antibacterial agent; according to the method, the in-situ polymerization antibacterial agent is chemically bonded to the polyurethane molecular chain, the phenomenon of migration and loss of antibacterial groups is reduced, the low-molecular-weight cationic polysaccharide is used for participating in polyurethane synthesis, the length of the polyurethane molecular chain is prolonged, the tensile strength and the tearing strength of a polyurethane material are improved, and meanwhile the antibacterial groups are chemically bonded to the polyurethane molecular chain, so that long-acting antibacterial effect is realized.

title_en: Polycaprolactone-lactide copolymer and controllable synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polycaprolactone-lactide copolymer and a controllable synthesis method thereof, comprising the following steps of firstly, adding an L-LA monomer and an epsilon-caprolactone monomer into a reaction kettle under the protection of nitrogen, and heating to a preset reaction temperature; and secondly, adding a catalyst and an initiator into the reaction kettle after reaching a preset reaction temperature, reacting for 6-10 hours, discharging and cooling after reaching a reaction end point, and obtaining the polycaprolactone-lactide copolymer. The invention can controllably prepare the polycaprolactone-lactide copolymer with a series of elongation at break and tensile strength, and can produce products with corresponding elongation at break and tensile strength according to the types of products required, such as degradable films, such as food preservative films, packaging bags, plastic packaging films and the like.

title_en: SiC nanowire/PVA composite aerogel with high rebound resilience and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SiC nanowire/PVA composite aerogel with high rebound resilience and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite aerogel. The preparation method comprises the steps of uniformly mixing tetraethoxysilane, cetyltrimethylammonium bromide, hydrochloric acid and deionized water to obtain a precursor solution, standing and solidifying the precursor solution, grinding the precursor solution into precursor powder, placing a cut sheet carbon felt on the precursor powder, carrying out high-temperature heat treatment and low-temperature oxidation treatment to obtain SiC nanowires, dissolving the SiC nanowires in the deionized water, adding the PVA solution, carrying out mechanical stirring to obtain a suspension, standing and defoaming, and carrying out vacuum freeze-drying treatment on the suspension to obtain the SiC nanowire/PVA composite aerogel. The method is used for solving the technical problem that the nano wires of the aerogel prepared by the prior art do not have any cross-linking nodes, only depend on Van der Waals force between the nano wires to interact, and have poor compression resilience performance.

title_en: Light plastic suspension body assembly capable of automatically blocking odor of floor drain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light plastic suspension body component capable of automatically blocking floor drain odor, which relates to the field of deodorization of plastic pipe fittings and comprises an automatic air isolation component, wherein the automatic air isolation component comprises a suspension chamber body, a suspension chamber cover plate, a drain pipe, a connecting pipe, a floor drain, a suspension body, a directional rod and a trap; this light plastics suspension subassembly that can automatic separation floor drain foul smell, through the effect of automatic gas barrier subassembly, a complete and efficient drainage and gas barrier system have been formed, make the subassembly can be according to the drainage state automatic switch-over mode of floor drain, need not manual intervention, the intelligent control of drainage and gas barrier has been realized, convenience and the practicality of using have been improved greatly, compare in driving the gas barrier through setting up the trap and flow backward, prevent that the foul smell flows backward and get into indoor mode, can not exist the state of drying, lead to driving the phenomenon that separates the gas and flow backward, prevent foul smell backflow function failure, thereby can avoid the foul smell to let in indoor influence indoor air through the branch pipe.

title_en: Cable insulation material capable of effectively preventing water from flowing into tree electric tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable insulation materials, and discloses a cable insulation material capable of effectively preventing water from a tree, which comprises the following components of polyethylene resin, a nano composite additive, a cross-linking agent, an antioxidant and a silane coupling agent; the invention has the core advantages that the multi-dimensional synergistic effect formed among the components realizes the breakthrough of the comprehensive performance of the material through functional complementation and mechanism superposition, and the labyrinth effect of the multi-level modified nano montmorillonite and the water molecule capturing effect of the surface modified nano silicon dioxide form synergy. The layered structure of montmorillonite blocks macroscopic moisture transmission, the amino group of silica fixes water molecules from the molecular level, the combination of the two greatly reduces the water absorption rate of the material, and simultaneously the capture of carriers by montmorillonite and the blocking of the silica to the water tree channel jointly inhibit the growth of water tree and electric tree, so that the anti-aging effect is improved compared with that of single nano material.

title_en: Fiber composite modified polyethylene geomembrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geomembranes, in particular to a fiber composite modified polyethylene geomembrane and a preparation method thereof, which are used for solving the problems that the existing polyethylene geomembrane is insufficient in mechanical strength and poor in high-temperature stability, and the engineering requirements of the existing polyethylene geomembrane under severe environments are limited; according to the preparation method, the polyethylene material is used as a base material, the modified mixed fiber is added to the base material to modify the performance of the base material, the carbon fiber has the characteristics of high strength and high modulus, the basalt fiber has the characteristics of excellent corrosion resistance and heat resistance, the two fibers are reasonably compounded and used to realize performance complementation and enhancement, and the surface modification is carried out on the two fibers, so that the two fibers are uniformly distributed in the base material, the enhancement effect of the two fibers is fully exerted, and the prepared polyethylene geomembrane has excellent mechanical properties and excellent thermal stability, so that the prepared polyethylene geomembrane can still maintain good stability and durability in various severe environments.

title_en: Modified ABS composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modified ABS composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the modified ABS composite material comprises, by weight, 40-75 parts of SAN resin, 20-30 parts of ABS high rubber powder, 10-30 parts of PMMA resin, 1-5 parts of lubricant and 2-10 parts of filler, and the particle size of the filler is not less than 3500 meshes. According to the invention, the high-rigidity component PMMA resin, the lubricant and the superfine particle size filler are introduced, so that the obtained modified ABS composite material has the technical effect of low abnormal sound.

title_en: Water-based carbon-coated aluminum foil slurry, preparation method thereof, carbon-coated aluminum foil and sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based carbon-coated aluminum foil slurry, a preparation method thereof, a carbon-coated aluminum foil and a sodium ion battery, and belongs to the technical field of conductive current collectors. The aqueous carbon-coated aluminum foil slurry is prepared from, by mass, 1.5% -15% of a conductive agent, 8% -35.5% of a binder, 30% -85% of a solvent, 0.1% -1% of a dispersing agent and 0.1% -1% of a defoaming agent, wherein the binder is a water-soluble acrylic copolymer emulsion, and the water-soluble acrylic copolymer is polymerized from butyl acrylate, acrylic acid, hydroxyethyl acrylate and glycidyl acrylate. The adhesive used in the invention introduces hydrophilic groups such as carboxyl groups to realize excellent water dispersibility of the slurry, and utilizes polar groups to enhance the adhesive force to the aluminum foil substrate, and in the subsequent preparation process of the carbon-coated aluminum foil, a stable three-dimensional crosslinked network structure is formed through the reaction of glycidyl ester groups during drying, so that the mechanical strength, water resistance and electrolyte resistance of the carbon-coated aluminum foil are obviously improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly single-component bio-based polyurethane beauty glue and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of adhesives, and particularly relates to an environment-friendly single-component bio-based polyurethane cosmetic adhesive and a preparation method thereof, wherein the environment-friendly single-component bio-based polyurethane cosmetic adhesive comprises, by weight, 100 parts of a bio-based polyurethane prepolymer, 0.1-0.5 part of an anti-aging auxiliary agent, 10-20 parts of a filler, 4-8 parts of a thixotropic agent, 1-5 parts of an adhesion promoter, 1-3 parts of a dispersing agent, 0.1-0.5 part of a defoaming agent and 0.2-0.8 part of a catalyst. Compared with the traditional single-component polyurethane beauty gel, the invention ensures the performance of the beauty gel and is more environment-friendly, reduces the pressure on the environment, and is particularly suitable for scenes with high requirements on environmental protection and decoration.

title_en: Paste for external electrode
abstract_en: Provided is a paste for external electrodes, which can improve the strength of a dry film and the moisture resistance reliability. An external electrode paste used for forming an external electrode of a laminated ceramic electronic component comprises at least a part of a copolymerized acrylic resin and ethylcellulose resin, a Cu powder, a Glass powder and a solvent, wherein the ratio of D50_Cu of the Cu powder obtained by a laser diffraction scattering particle size distribution measurement method to D50_glass of the Glass powder (D50_glass/D50_Cu) is 0.13 to 0.67 inclusive, D50_Cu is 3.0 [ mu ] m or less, and the BET specific surface area (SSA_glass) of the Glass powder is 1.7m  2 /g to 20m  2 /g inclusive.

title_en: Polysiloxane with reversible crosslinking characteristic, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polysiloxane, and particularly relates to polysiloxane with reversible crosslinking characteristic, and a preparation method and application thereof. Adding vinylsilane, furyl silane and maleimide silane into solvent, stirring to obtain mixture, adding acid into the mixture, stirring to react to obtain reactant, steaming, washing and drying to obtain polysiloxane with reversible crosslinking characteristic. The method has the advantages of simple reaction operation, no need of complex equipment, mild reaction conditions, no need of high temperature and high pressure and special catalyst, easily obtained raw materials, low energy consumption and low cost, and suitability for large-scale production, and the polysiloxane with the reversible crosslinking characteristic is grafted onto polymers such as polyolefin and the like through vinyl during high-temperature processing, and then the molecular chain segments of the polymers such as polyolefin and the like are bound through reversible crosslinking between furyl and maleimide groups so as to form crosslinking points.

title_en: Efficient demulsifier for oil field and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an efficient demulsifier for an oil field and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of petroleum auxiliary agents. The demulsifier is prepared by compounding a hyperbranched demulsification main agent, a nonionic surfactant and an oily solvent, wherein the hyperbranched demulsification main agent is prepared by the following steps of firstly esterifying dimerized glycerol and methacryloyl chloride to obtain a half-esterified intermediate, then carrying out ring opening reaction with glycerol triglycidyl ether to form a hyperbranched matrix, and finally introducing an alkyl branched chain containing sulfur ester through click chemistry reaction of alkyl mercaptan and alkenyl. The demulsifier promotes water drop coalescence by utilizing the multi-site bridging effect and strong hydrophilicity of the hyperbranched framework, and simultaneously enhances the compatibility with crude oil through alkyl branched chains, thereby realizing rapid interface permeation and efficient demulsification.

title_en: Preparation method of ultraviolet-resistant antistatic polyester cotton functional fabric
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an anti-ultraviolet antistatic polyester cotton functional fabric, which comprises the steps of mixing carbon black powder, coating black, an abrasive and water, grinding to obtain a water-based carbon black coating suspension, reacting dehydrated polytetrahydrofuran ether glycol with isophorone diisocyanate under the action of a catalyst to generate polyurethane prepolymer, dropwise adding a cationic chain extender into the polyurethane prepolymer for chain extension reaction, neutralizing by acid and alkali, distilling under reduced pressure to recover acetone, adding water and stirring to obtain a cationic aqueous polyurethane adhesive aqueous solution after the reaction is finished, dispersing the water-based carbon black coating suspension and the cationic modified polyurethane adhesive aqueous solution in a foam compound system, forming a dispersed foam dye solution through ultrasonic stirring, and placing polyester cotton fabric into the dispersed foam dye solution for dyeing. The invention realizes one-bath dyeing of polyester-cotton two fibers by utilizing the action of the cationic modified polyurethane binder.

title_en: Chitosan-based antibacterial coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coatings, and discloses a chitosan-based antibacterial coating and a preparation method thereof. The chitosan-based antibacterial coating comprises, by weight, 50-60 parts of epoxy resin, 20-35 parts of polyamide resin, 3-6 parts of modified chitosan, 1-5 parts of modified sodium alginate, 1-3 parts of tributyl citrate, 1-2 parts of fumed silica, 1-2 parts of ethyl acrylate, 0.5-1.5 parts of zinc dihydrogen phosphate, 1-2 parts of a leveling agent RM-2020, and 2-8 parts of acetone. The modified chitosan in the coating can inhibit the breeding of various common pathogenic bacteria efficiently through grafting quaternary phosphonium salt and thiazolidinedione structures, and the modified sodium alginate endows the coating with self-repairing performance through grafting disulfide bonds and introducing multiple hydrogen bonds.

title_en: Antibacterial polyurethane emulsion sizing agent for carbon fibers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of carbon fiber surface modification, and in particular relates to an antibacterial polyurethane emulsion sizing agent for carbon fibers and a preparation method thereof, wherein the antibacterial polyurethane emulsion sizing agent for the carbon fibers comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 6-9 parts of polyurethane emulsion, 0.2 part of silane coupling agent and 90.8-93.8 parts of deionized water, and after being mixed according to a proportion, the mixture is discharged, and the antibacterial polyurethane emulsion sizing agent for carbon fibers is obtained. The antibacterial polyurethane emulsion sizing agent for the carbon fiber solves the problems of poor wettability and no antibacterial property of sizing agent and main resin in a composite material in the prior art, and has the advantages of excellent emulsion stability, safety, environmental protection and easy operation.

title_en: Ultra-silent HDPE (high-density polyethylene) pipe for building drainage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-silent HDPE pipe for building drainage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the HDPE pipe is formed by co-extrusion compounding of an inner layer, a middle silent layer and an outer layer, the inner layer and the outer layer are both prepared from HDPE, an antioxidant, a lubricant and pigment in a certain proportion, and the middle silent layer is prepared from HDPE, modified mica powder, expancel pre-expansion microspheres, maleic anhydride grafted polyethylene, an elastomer, the lubricant and the antioxidant in a certain proportion. The preparation method of the HDPE pipe comprises the steps of adding an inner layer mixed material into a first extruder for melt extrusion, adding an intermediate silent layer mixed material into a second extruder for melt extrusion, adding an outer layer mixed material into a third extruder for melt extrusion, then carrying out coextrusion molding through a coextrusion die, and cooling and shaping to obtain the ultra-silent HDPE pipe for building drainage. The HDPE pipe provided by the invention has good silencing performance, high temperature resistance and toughness, and other performances meet the requirements.

title_en: Recovery method of terylene/acrylic fiber blended material
abstract_en: The application provides a recycling method of a terylene/acrylic fiber blended material, which comprises the following steps of stirring the following components of 65-85% of N-methylpyrrolidone, 10-30% of ethylene glycol monomethyl ether, 0.5-5.0% of sodium metabisulfite and 0.1-0.3% of vitamin E to obtain a composite solvent, adding the terylene/acrylic fiber blended material into the composite solvent, heating and stirring the mixture to dissolve the acrylic fibers in the terylene/acrylic fiber blended material, suspending the terylene in the solution without dissolving the acrylic fibers to form a solid-liquid mixture, filtering the solid-liquid mixture to obtain terylene filter residues and filtrate containing the acrylic fibers, wherein the terylene in the filter residues is regenerated terylene, and distilling the filtrate containing the acrylic fibers to separate the composite solvent from the acrylic fibers to obtain the regenerated acrylic fibers. According to the application, the acrylic fibers in the terylene/acrylic fiber blended material are dissolved by the composite solvent, and then the regenerated terylene and the regenerated acrylic fibers are obtained by filtering and distilling respectively, so that the terylene and the acrylic fibers can be recovered efficiently.

title_en: Bicolor rubber bottom for line book font identification and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rubber product manufacturing, and discloses a bicolor rubber sole with a line book font mark and a preparation process thereof. The rubber bottom consists of a primer layer and a marker layer, wherein the hardness of the primer is controlled to be 65+/-3 HA, the hardness of the marker is controlled to be 82+/-3 HA, and the marker has excellent fluidity and edge support in the mould pressing process by constructing a hardness gradient of about 17 HA. The thickness of the marking layer is strictly controlled to be 4.0-4.2 mm, so that the font can not only completely fill the die cavity in the forming process, but also keep the edge clear, not fuzzy and not diffuse. According to the invention, through decomposing the stroke path and optimizing the pressure conduction, the high-hardness identification material precisely flows and fills under the pressure, and the clear, attractive and wear-resistant identification font is obtained. The invention realizes the integrated molding of the double-color rubber bottom and the font mark through double mixing, calendaring, isolation, mould pressing and co-vulcanization processes, and is suitable for rubber products with high requirements on wear resistance and marking effect.

title_en: Low-carbon concrete with high crack resistance and water abrasion resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-carbon concrete, in particular to low-carbon concrete with high crack resistance, water resistance and abrasion resistance and a preparation method thereof. A method for preparing low-carbon concrete with high crack resistance and water abrasion resistance comprises the steps of preparing a super absorbent polymer, preparing modified calcium aluminum hydrotalcite, preparing reinforcing fibers and preparing the low-carbon concrete. The low-carbon concrete contains super absorbent polymer, modified calcium aluminum hydrotalcite and reinforcing fiber, wherein the former is water-retaining by N-vinyl pyrrolidone to reduce shrinkage, the hydrotalcite fixes chloride ions and fills pores, the fiber is modified and crack-resistant, the super absorbent polymer and the hydrotalcite are assisted and compact, the fiber is restrained to crack, and the crack resistance, the seepage resistance and the water-resistant and abrasion-resistant performance of the concrete are improved from multiple dimensions, so that the low-carbon concrete is suitable for water conservancy and other scenes.

title_en: Phenylboronic acid functionalized polyion liquid catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phenylboronic acid functionalized polyion liquid catalyst which is synthesized in one step by hydrothermal free radical copolymerization by taking phenylboronic acid imidazole salt ionic liquid (PBIL) as a monomer and Divinylbenzene (DVB) as a crosslinking agent. The catalyst efficiently catalyzes the cycloaddition reaction of CO2 and epoxide under the conditions of no solvent, normal pressure and 90-100 ℃ by the synergistic action of hydroxyl, imidazolyl and Br-multiple active sites, and the conversion rate of the catalyst to 1, 2-epoxyhexane reaches 99%. The catalyst can be recycled and has stable structure, solves the problem that the prior art needs high pressure/co-catalyst, and has industrial application potential.

title_en: Environment-friendly alkyd resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of resins, in particular to an environment-friendly alkyd resin and a preparation method thereof. The alkyd resin comprises, by weight, 20-35 parts of vegetable oil, 10-20 parts of polyol, 15-25 parts of polybasic acid, 2-5 parts of functional monomer, 0.5-3 parts of catalyst, 0.1-0.5 part of initiator, 0.1-1 part of antioxidant, 3-8 parts of cosolvent, 2-4 parts of neutralizer and 40-60 parts of deionized water. The invention takes renewable bio-based raw materials as a main body, combines water-based treatment, takes water as a dispersion medium as a final product, controls the content of volatile organic compounds at a lower level, solves the problem of organic solvent toxicity in the production, construction and application processes of the traditional solvent type resin, and meets the requirements of environmental protection.

title_en: Lead-based coordination polymer synthesized by hydrothermal method and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead-based coordination polymer synthesized by a hydrothermal method and a preparation method thereof, wherein the lead-based coordination polymer has the chemical formula:  The crystal system of the lead-based coordination polymer belongs to an orthorhombic system, the space group is Pbca, the unit cell parameter is aa=7.25 (5) a, bb=12.80 (1) a, cc=27.50 (2) a, alpha alpha=90 degrees, beta=90 degrees, gamma=90 degrees, and VV=2530 (1) a  3 , and zz=4.

title_en: Waterproof and dustproof film for electronic product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polytetrafluoroethylene plastic films, in particular to a waterproof dustproof film for electronic products and a preparation method thereof, wherein polyether-ether-ketone resin is adopted as a matrix of filler master batch to enhance the compatibility and dispersibility of silica particles, and then the porous structure of the ePTFE film is formed by distributed directional stretching and hot-pressing compounding, the pore diameter of the surface layer of the membrane material is minimum, liquid water cannot permeate, the pore diameter of the middle layer is enlarged, small molecular gas such as water vapor is allowed to pass through, the pore diameter of the bottom layer is maximum, the water vapor transmittance is obviously improved, and finally, the surface is impregnated and crosslinked to form a hydrophobic coating, so that the hydrophobicity, the friction resistance and the ageing resistance of the surface of the membrane material are further improved.

title_en: Heavy-duty fused epoxy powder coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy-duty fused epoxy powder coating and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of anti-corrosion coatings. The coating comprises, by weight, 100 parts of an epoxy resin composition, 30-50 parts of a time sequence temperature control curing system, 3-8 parts of a core-shell structure toughening agent, 30-60 parts of a functional filler composition and 1-3 parts of an auxiliary agent composition. The time sequence temperature control curing system comprises a main curing agent and a microencapsulated latent accelerator, and the accelerator releases the accelerator when reaching a preset trigger temperature, so that time sequence control of leveling and curing is realized, and the contradiction between curing efficiency and coating compactness in thick coating construction is effectively solved. The invention also remarkably improves the impact resistance, flexibility and corrosion resistance of the coating by the synergistic effect of the rigid-flexible compound of the epoxy resin composition, the core-shell toughening agent and the functional filler, is suitable for various processes such as electrostatic spraying, fluidized bed dip coating and the like, and has good universality and construction stability.

title_en: Crosslinkable hole-transport polymer and application thereof in preparation of photoelectric device
abstract_en: The application discloses a crosslinkable hole-transporting polymer and application thereof in preparing photoelectric devices, wherein the polymer is provided with a triarylamine unit, and a chemically reactive group is introduced into a polymer side chain; the crosslinkable hole-transport polymer can realize crosslinking and curing under the treatment of mild conditions such as heat, light, an initiator and the like, has better solvent resistance, and can prepare another layer of film on the crosslinked hole-transport polymer through solution processing to realize a multilayer solution processing device. The crosslinkable hole-transport polymer also has higher optical transparency, has higher potential as a hole-transport polymer, and can realize different energy levels and carrier mobilities by adjusting the content of polymerized units. The hole injection layer can be used for preparing photoelectric devices.

title_en: Multifunctional high-barrier multilayer packaging film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of packaging materials, and provides a multifunctional high-barrier multilayer packaging film and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts a five-layer structural design, and sequentially comprises a polypropylene layer, a first bonding layer, an ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer layer, a second bonding layer and a polyethylene layer from outside to inside, wherein the bonding layer comprises master batches formed by covalently compounding maleic anhydride grafted polyethylene and aminopropyl silane modified montmorillonite through an amide bond and an imide bond, so that the strong interface combination of a barrier layer and a polyolefin layer and the synergistic enhancement of an inorganic sheet layer are realized. The film has the oxygen transmittance of not more than 1.0 cm < 3 >/(m2.24 24 h.0.1: 0.1 MPa), the water vapor transmittance of not more than 1.0 g/(m2.24 24 h), and no delamination at the interlayer interface under the condition of 121 ℃ heat treatment, solves the problems of attenuation of barrier performance, interlayer stripping and insufficient toughness of the existing multilayer barrier film under the damp-heat environment, and has application value in the fields of high-temperature digestion packaging, aseptic packaging, medical packaging and the like.

title_en: Green extraction process of high-purity high-activity quinoa polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of separation and extraction of plant active ingredients, and particularly relates to a green extraction process of high-purity high-activity quinoa polysaccharide. The extraction process comprises the following steps of (1) ultrasonic-microwave pretreatment, namely cleaning quinoa rice bran or endosperm slag, drying and crushing to obtain quinoa matrix powder, breaking the wall of the quinoa matrix powder to obtain pretreated extracting solution, centrifuging the pretreated extracting solution, collecting supernatant, (2) enzymolysis and directional impurity removal, namely adding compound enzyme into the supernatant for enzymolysis at controlled temperature, heating, cooling after enzymolysis, centrifuging, collecting impurity-removed polysaccharide solution, (3) macroporous resin-membrane combined purification, namely macroporous resin adsorption, elution enrichment and ultrafiltration fractionation of the impurity-removed polysaccharide solution to obtain purified polysaccharide solution, and (4) concentration and drying, namely vacuum concentration and freeze drying of the purified polysaccharide solution to obtain the quinoa polysaccharide solution. The extraction process provided by the invention has high efficiency, excellent purification effect and low energy consumption.

title_en: Preparation method of high-thermal-conductivity insulating PVB intermediate film for photovoltaic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-heat-conductivity insulating PVB intermediate film for a photovoltaic module, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic module packaging materials and comprises the following steps: carrying out hydroxylation treatment and surface grafting modification on hexagonal boron nitride by using a silane coupling agent, premixing PVB resin and a plasticizer to obtain pre-plasticized PVB resin, carrying out melt blending granulation on the modified hexagonal boron nitride and the pre-plasticized PVB resin by using a double-screw extruder, extruding the composite granules by using a single-screw extruder to carry out tape casting film formation, and obtaining the high-heat-conductivity insulating PVB intermediate film. The PVB intermediate film prepared by the invention has the heat conductivity coefficient of 0.5-2.0W/(m.K) and the volume resistivity of 10  14  -10  16  Ω.cm, and can effectively improve the heat dissipation performance of the assembly and the power generation efficiency when being applied to the encapsulation of the photovoltaic assembly.

title_en: Aerated concrete block and light heat-preservation sound-insulation composite block
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of concrete, and particularly discloses an aerated concrete block and a light heat-insulation sound-insulation composite block, wherein the aerated concrete block comprises, by weight, 120-180 parts of ordinary Portland cement, 100-120 parts of lime, 650-750 parts of quartz sand, 0.8-1.2 parts of aluminum paste, 0.5-0.8 part of modified fibers and 300-357 parts of water, and the modified fibers are one or two of polycaprolactone-modified polypropylene fibers and ethylene-vinyl acetate-modified basalt fibers. The organic group of the modified fiber can be entangled with the organic component of the foaming heat-insulating layer, and form weak bonds with hydroxyl and calcium ions of hydration products of the aerated concrete matrix, so that the chemical barriers of inorganic-organic interfaces are broken from the matrix side, the bonding strength of the aerated concrete block and the heat-insulating core layer is improved, and the heat insulation performance and the sound insulation effect of the composite block are improved.

title_en: Siloxane end-capped liquid rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides siloxane end-capped liquid rubber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of adding a hydroxyl protecting reagent, a nitrogen-containing organic compound and halogenated alcohol into a nonpolar solvent, and removing a nitrogen-containing organic compound-hydrogen chloride complex to obtain a protecting group initiator intermediate solution; adding alkali metal into the intermediate solution of the protective group initiator to react to obtain the protective group initiator, initiating butadiene polymerization by the protective group initiator, then carrying out end-capping reaction to obtain a polymerization glue solution, adding deionized water and acid into the polymerization glue solution to obtain a double-end hydroxyl polymerization glue solution, adding a silane end capping agent, a nitrogenous organic compound and deionized water, and removing the nitrogenous organic compound-hydrogen chloride complex to obtain the siloxane end-capped liquid rubber, thereby obviously improving the mixing uniformity of white carbon black and rubber sizing material, effectively reducing the rolling resistance and hysteresis loss of the tire and enabling the tire to have excellent dynamic performance.

title_en: (Methyl) acrylic ester copolymer, optical transparent adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical transparent adhesive, and particularly relates to an optical transparent adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof. Compared with a copolymer prepared by polymerizing (methyl) acrylate monomers, the (methyl) acrylate copolymer and the optical transparent adhesive prepared by the (methyl) acrylate copolymer disclosed by the invention have the advantages that a denser hydrogen bond network and a firm ionic bond are constructed in an OCA polymer network by adding the ionic liquid monomers, the physical crosslinking point is formed by the ionic clusters at normal temperature to ensure the die cutting stability, and the problem of bubble rebound of the traditional hydrogen bond OCA in a high-temperature high-humidity environment can be effectively solved by adopting thermally stable and low-hygroscopicity anions in a high-temperature high-humidity environment.

title_en: Flame-retardant anti-aging ethylene propylene copolymer composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyolefin insulating materials for wires and cables, in particular to a flame-retardant anti-aging ethylene propylene copolymer composition and a preparation method thereof. The composition takes ethylene-propylene copolymer as a matrix, introduces an organic phosphorus flame retardant composed of aluminum phosphinate and melamine polyphosphate, and is synergistic with magnesium-aluminum layered double hydroxide treated by organosilane/fatty acid salt for flame retardance, adopts a multi-element anti-aging system containing hindered phenol, phosphite ester and the like, part of anti-aging components are pre-adsorbed on the surface of aerosil nano-filler, and simultaneously, an ethylene-propylene grafting compatilizer containing maleic anhydride groups is added, and is formed by two-step melt blending granulation of flame retardant master batches. The material meets the flame-retardant grade requirement, has higher oxygen index and good dripping inhibition effect, has excellent mechanical and electrical property retention rate after heat aging, and is suitable for cable jackets and insulating layers in long-term service.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin composition with excellent varnish stability. The solution of the present invention is a resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin, (B) a maleimide resin, a specific amount of (C) an inorganic filler in a specific range, and a specific (D) a cyclic phosphazene compound.

title_en: Wear-resistant PEEK composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a wear-resistant PEEK composite material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the steps of adding phenylethynyl phthalic anhydride into polyether-ether-ketone powder for evaporation end-capping treatment to form end-capped polyether-ether-ketone comprising an alkynyl large end and a small end, and preparing end-capped polyether-ether-ketone with the alkynyl large end and the small end; dispersing mixed filler particles in a mixed solution containing a silane coupling agent, stirring, carrying out melt mixing treatment on the stirred composite filler and capped polyether-ether-ketone to obtain a composite melt, carrying out hot pressing on the composite melt to form a crystal structure, carrying out thermal cycle diffusion treatment on the crystal structure to obtain a heat treatment product comprising an interface diffusion layer, and carrying out scanning treatment on the heat treatment product based on pulse laser to enable the polyether-ether-ketone on the surface layer to be melted and activate the interface diffusion layer to form the wear-resistant composite material comprising the wear-resistant coating. The application solves the technical problems of weak bonding force between the wear-resistant coating and the matrix interface and easy premature stripping in the prior art, and greatly reduces the wear rate compared with the reference in the prior art.

title_en: Method for preparing chitosan with narrow molecular weight distribution by cooperatively treating shrimp and crab shells by microwave-enzyme method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing chitosan with narrow molecular weight distribution by cooperatively treating shrimp and crab shells by a microwave-enzyme method. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out microwave-enzyme synergetic deproteinization and degradation on a chitin crude product and carrying out microwave-assisted deacetylation to obtain chitosan, S2, treating the chitosan by adopting immobilized chitinase, and S3, carrying out post-treatment and purification to obtain the chitosan. According to the invention, the whole process of cooperatively treating shrimp and crab shells by a microwave-enzyme method is adopted, so that the efficient preparation of chitosan with narrow molecular weight distribution is realized, the yield of chitosan is obviously improved, the molecular weight distribution is optimized, the deacetylation degree is improved, and a foundation is laid for the application of chitosan in multiple fields.

title_en: Surface treatment method of hollow glass beads and low-dielectric epoxy resin composition prepared by surface treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a surface treatment method of hollow glass beads and a low-dielectric epoxy resin composition prepared by the same. The hollow glass beads, the silane coupling agent, the interface reinforcing agent and the like are subjected to surface treatment under the conditions of a solvent and a catalyst. The surface treatment process can remarkably improve interface contact, wettability and fluidity of the hollow glass beads and epoxy resin, and improve floating and layering phenomena which are easy to occur when the hollow glass beads are dispersed in the epoxy resin. And fully stirring and mixing the hollow glass beads subjected to surface treatment with epoxy resin, a curing agent, a catalyst and a solvent to prepare the low-dielectric epoxy resin composition. The composition can achieve better flame-retardant effect without additional flame-retardant elements, has lower dielectric constant Dk and dielectric loss factor Df, can be more suitable for the performance requirements of the current high-end electronic products on high-speed transmission and low loss of electric signals, and is expected to be widely applied to the manufacturing field of high-end copper-clad plate products.

title_en: Optical monomer, preparation method thereof, optical resin, nano-imprinting adhesive and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an optical monomer and a preparation method thereof, optical resin, nano-imprinting glue and application thereof, wherein the optical monomer has a structure shown in a formula I. The optical monomer can be used for preparing nano-imprinting glue, is beneficial to improving the refractive index, mechanical strength and high temperature resistance of the nano-imprinting glue, is further beneficial to improving the mechanical property of a microstructure, avoids the collapse or deformation of the microstructure, reduces the problems of tearing, falling, adhesive residue and the like in the imprinting and reliability testing process, and can be also used for preparing optical resin, and the prepared optical resin has higher refractive index (more than or equal to 1.70), high light transmittance and low yellowness.

title_en: Scintillator film for real-time X-ray dosimeter, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a scintillator film for a real-time X-ray dosimeter, a preparation method and application thereof, and Eu (NO) is weighed  3 ) 3 .6H 2 O、Tb(NO 3 ) 3   6H 2 O、Lu(NO 3 ) 3   6H  2  O, naF and NH  4  F, preparing a rare earth fluoride material C from the powder B, weighing a polydimethylsiloxane prepolymer and a curing agent, adding into a cyclohexane solution, performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a mixture D, adding rare earth fluoride material C and PMMA particles into an ethanol solution, uniformly dispersing to obtain a mixture E, dripping the mixture E into the stirred mixture D, performing vacuum mixing to obtain a mixture F, transferring the mixture F to the surface of a ceramic plate which is respectively cleaned and dried by water, ethanol and acetone, coating to form a film, performing heating annealing, and cooling to obtain a flexible scintillator film NaLuF  4 :Tb 3+ /Eu 3+  @PDMS for a real-time X-ray dosimeter.

title_en: Polyolefin composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyolefin composition and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials, wherein the polyolefin composition comprises, by mass, 38-82 parts of polyolefin resin, 28-52 parts of styrene triblock elastomer, 1-7 parts of maleic anhydride graft and 0.1-2 parts of nucleating agent, wherein the mass percentage of diblock in the styrene triblock elastomer is 28-62%, the polyolefin resin comprises at least one of polypropylene copolymer and polyethylene copolymer, and the melt index of the polyolefin resin at 230 ℃ per 2.16kg is 3-32g/10min. The polyolefin composition provided by the invention can realize excellent low-temperature stability and low-temperature toughness of products by selecting proper parts by mass of components and mutually matching the components.

title_en: Flame-retardant and explosion-proof carbon fiber composite material for new energy automobile battery shell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety protection materials, in particular to a flame-retardant and explosion-proof carbon fiber composite material for a battery shell of a new energy automobile and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of S1, activating and modifying carbon fiber fabrics, S2, preparing flame-retardant thermoplastic-thermosetting mixed resin colloid, S3, placing the activated and modified carbon fiber fabrics in a vacuum bag, paving, pressing the mixed resin colloid into the vacuum bag through vacuum negative pressure to impregnate the activated and modified carbon fiber fabrics, S4, performing compression molding and curing, namely placing the vacuum bag in a mold of a hot press, and performing curing according to the curing step to finally obtain the carbon fiber composite material. The carbon fiber composite material with flame retardance, explosion prevention, high temperature resistance and high strength is prepared by adopting carbon fiber phosphoric acid activation modification, high temperature carbonization, resin impregnation and gradient curing processes, so that the technical bottleneck of the existing protective material is broken through, high-level passive safety guarantee is provided for a power battery, and the method has great significance in promoting the safety of new energy automobiles.

title_en: Epoxy resin adhesive and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of adhesives, and particularly relates to an epoxy resin adhesive, and a preparation method and application thereof. The epoxy resin adhesive comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises bisphenol A epoxy resin, polyfunctional epoxy resin, toughening resin and heat conducting filler, the component B comprises a curing agent and an accelerator, the toughening resin comprises organosilicon modified epoxy resin, the organosilicon modified epoxy resin comprises-Si-O-C-copolymerized grafted organosilicon modified epoxy resin, the curing agent comprises polyether amine and modified aromatic amine, the preparation raw materials of the modified aromatic amine comprise amine compounds, phenolic compounds and paraformaldehyde, and the heat conducting filler comprises aluminum hydroxide treated by a coupling agent and aluminum oxide treated by the coupling agent. The epoxy resin adhesive has the advantages of lower viscosity, good flexibility, heat conductivity, sedimentation resistance, higher glass transition temperature and lower linear expansion coefficient, can avoid cracking of a potting layer, and can realize room-temperature curing.

title_en: Low-odor finishing agent for polyester skein and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates TO a preparation method of a low-odor finishing agent for polyester skein, which comprises the following steps of adding hydrogen-terminated silicone oil and allyl glycidyl ether, heating TO 75-85 ℃ while stirring, adding chloroplatinic acid serving as a catalyst, continuously heating TO 135-140 ℃, stirring, preserving heat, reacting, vacuumizing, cooling TO 60 ℃ TO obtain a hydrogen-containing silicone oil intermediate A, uniformly stirring and mixing the hydrogen-containing silicone oil intermediate A and dipropylene glycol, heating TO 150-165 ℃, adding polyether amine ED-600, stirring, preserving heat, reacting, cooling TO 55-65 ℃ TO obtain modified silicone oil B, mixing and stirring the modified silicone oil B, lactic acid and a nonionic surfactant TO-7 completely uniformly, and slowly adding deionized water while stirring TO obtain the low-odor finishing agent for polyester skein. The finishing agent disclosed by the invention does not influence the comprehensive air hand feeling of the polyester skein and reduces the content of residual high-odor volatile matters on the fibers.

title_en: Polyamide type polycarboxylate superplasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyamide type polycarboxylate water reducer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyamide type polycarboxylate water reducer comprises the steps of firstly adding dibasic acid, diamine, caprolactam, a molecular weight regulator and water into a reactor, stirring and mixing uniformly, introducing protective gas to replace the reactor, heating a reaction body to a certain temperature, keeping the reaction system under different pressure conditions through staged pressure regulation and control to obtain a first product, secondly adding the first product and maleic anhydride into the reactor, stirring and mixing uniformly, keeping the temperature for 0.5-1h to obtain a second product, thirdly adding the second product, acrylic acid, a catalyst, a chain transfer agent and water into the reactor, stirring uniformly, and reacting to obtain the final product polyamide type polycarboxylate water reducer. According to the scheme, the polyamide structure is adopted as a side chain to replace a traditional polyether side chain, so that the water reducer has high water reducing rate, high slump retaining property and reinforcing property.

title_en: Hyperbranched polymer poly-zirconium-aluminum-boron siloxane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses hyperbranched polymer poly-zirconium-aluminum-boron siloxane, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high molecular compounds; dissolving aluminum isopropoxide and boric acid in an organic solvent, adding glacial acetic acid, stirring uniformly to obtain a boron aluminum composite solution, mixing the zirconium-chelating agent complex solution and the boron aluminum composite solution uniformly to obtain a zirconium-boron-aluminum mixed precursor solution, adding methyltrimethoxysilane into the zirconium-boron-aluminum mixed precursor solution, reacting, and removing the organic solvent by rotary evaporation to obtain the poly zirconium aluminum boron siloxane. The invention provides the synergistically modified poly-zirconium-aluminum-boron siloxane, which improves the temperature resistance of a resin skeleton by introducing zirconium element, enables the resin to form a glass phase in situ at high temperature by boron-aluminum modification, plays roles of adhesion and protection, and overcomes the limitation of a single modification element.

title_en: Preparation process of cyclic phosphonate CU flame retardant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of synthesis of organic phosphorus functional compounds, and particularly relates to a preparation process of a cyclic phosphonate CU flame retardant, which comprises the steps of adding TMP and trimethylolpropane into a synthesis kettle, performing transesterification reaction at normal pressure and 80-160 ℃, distilling off by-product methanol while reacting for 12 hours to obtain an intermediate product TMPP, recycling methanol and returning the intermediate product TMPP to the TMP esterification kettle for reuse, adding DMMP into the synthesis kettle, performing substitution and rearrangement reaction at 160-220 ℃ for 8 hours to obtain a crude product, performing reduced pressure distillation on the crude product at 160-220 ℃ and a vacuum degree of 0.09-0.10 MPa, distilling off a front cut to obtain a product, wherein the front cut mainly comprises unreacted DMMP, recycling the sleeve is used for replacing rearrangement reaction, improving the overall conversion efficiency of raw materials, realizing the recycling of the by-products and unreacted raw materials, reducing the raw material waste, reducing the raw material cost, controlling the conditions such as the temperature and the pressure of the production step by step, ensuring that the state of the whole production process is more controllable, and the product quality is stable.

title_en: High-crosslinking ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical high polymer materials, in particular to a high crosslinking ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene material and a preparation method thereof, which combines two radiation and two heat treatments with different temperatures, the primary radiation and remelting treatment realizes high crosslinking and low free radical content, and the secondary radiation and annealing treatment below the melting point further improves the crosslinking degree and maintains high crystallinity. The obtained material is superior to the material prepared by the traditional single method in the aspects of residual free radical, oxidation index, swelling degree, crystallinity, mechanical property, abrasion rate and the like, and has the advantages of high abrasion resistance, high oxidation resistance and high strength.

title_en: Polyolefin-based hot melt adhesive composition
abstract_en: In the present disclosure there is provided a hot melt adhesive composition comprising (a) 25 to 50wt% of a copolymer of butene-1 with at least one comonomer selected from the group consisting of ethylene, propylene, C5-C10 alpha-olefins and combinations thereof, the copolymer having a copolymerized comonomer content of 0.5 to 8.0wt% and a melt flow rate MFR (a) equal to or greater than 200g/10min (ISO 1133:2011,190 ℃ per 2.16 kg), (B) 30 to 60wt% tackifier, and (C) 5 to 30wt% polypropylene wax, wherein the amounts of (a), (B) and (C) are based on the total weight of (a) + (B) + (C). An article comprising the HMA composition is also provided.

title_en: Preparation method and application of quasi-solid thermoelectric material for realizing humidity stability by means of phase separation regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of thermoelectric technology, and relates to a preparation method and application of a quasi-solid thermoelectric material for realizing humidity stability by means of phase separation regulation, wherein a negatively charged hydrophilic monomer, a charge neutral monomer, a cross-linking agent and a photoinitiator are dissolved in a solvent to obtain a precursor solution, and ultraviolet polymerization reaction is carried out to form polyelectrolyte gel; and immersing the gel into the quaternary electrolyte system to fully replace the internal solution through diffusion action, thus obtaining the quasi-solid thermoelectric material with stable humidity. The thermoelectric material has the advantages of excellent Seebeck coefficient, good stability, high mechanical strength, high power density and the like, can supply power for wearable electronic products in an actual humidity fluctuation environment, breaks through the main bottleneck of the practical application of quasi-solid ion thermoelectric materials based on ion hydrogel, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Compression-resistant oil-aging-resistant composite material, preparation method thereof and retainer
abstract_en: The application discloses a compression-resistant oil-aging-resistant composite material, a preparation method thereof and a retainer, and belongs to the technical field of composite materials and retainers. The composite material comprises, by weight, 100-120 parts of POM, 20-25 parts of epoxidized silicone rubber, 10-15 parts of polyethylene terephthalate powder, 20-25 parts of modified glass fibers, 3-4 parts of compatilizer, 0.3-0.5 part of antioxidant and 0.2-0.4 part of lubricant, wherein the modified glass fibers are obtained by modifying butyl carbamate. The composite material has excellent oil resistance and compression resistance, even if the composite material is subjected to the working condition of high-temperature oil soaking, the composite material still can show good oil aging resistance, and the performance requirement of the bearing retainer on the material under the complex working condition can be met.

title_en: Reinforced nylon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a reinforced nylon composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite materials. The invention uses poly (m-xylylenediamine-adipamide) and inorganic fiber as composite stiffening agent to strengthen the strength and modulus of nylon composite material, introduces primary antioxidant, secondary antioxidant and anti-photoaging agent into the composite additive to make the nylon composite material have more excellent appearance and molding stability, can effectively shorten the molding time of the product and promote the dimensional stability, eliminates the problem of unstable dimension after nylon absorbs moisture, combines the basic magnesium sulfate whisker in the composite additive, has the characteristics of high rigidity, low density, low warpage and the like, and under the auxiliary effect of the composite lubricant, the obtained nylon composite material has high strength, high modulus, impact resistance, low warpage, low density, high appearance, excellent dimensional stability and excellent comprehensive performance, and can be widely applied to materials such as plastic substituted steel.

title_en: Semitransparent silicon rubber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of silicone rubber, and particularly relates to semitransparent silicone rubber and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the semitransparent silicone rubber comprises, by weight, 35-55 parts of vinyl silicone oil, 5-15 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 5-30 parts of vinyl MQ silicone resin, 5-15 parts of fumed silica, 0.01-0.15 part of an inhibitor, 0.1-1 part of a platinum catalyst, 0.3-1.0 part of an adhesive A and 0.2-0.9 part of an adhesive B. Compared with the prior art, the semitransparent silicon rubber provided by the invention has the characteristics of low viscosity, high thixotropic property, low modulus, high tensile strength and long room temperature operation time.

title_en: Uniform polysaccharide from Xiaoyao powder as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a uniform polysaccharide from a Xiaoyao powder source, and a preparation method and application thereof. The homogeneous polysaccharide consists of arabinose, galactose, mannose, glucose and fructose, and has a weight average molecular weight Mw of 293.223 kDa. The polysaccharide is obtained by separating and purifying from XIAOYAO powder by water extraction, alcohol precipitation, ion exchange column chromatography and gel column chromatography. Experimental results show that the uniform polysaccharide can improve the behavior of a cortisol-induced zebra fish depression model, improve the exercise activity, has the antidepressant activity, and can be used for preparing medicaments for treating or preventing depression.

title_en: Vinyl resin sizing agent based on bionic structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A vinyl resin sizing agent based on a bionic structure and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of carbon fiber sizing agent preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing polyethylene glycol 2000, ethylene glycol diglycidyl ether, E51 and the like for reaction to prepare modified resin, grafting 3,4 dihydroxybenzene propionic acid and a double bond structure into the modified resin, stirring and uniformly mixing the modified resin with deionized water in a high-shear dispersion emulsifying machine to form sizing agent emulsion, and preparing the vinyl resin sizing agent based on mussel bionics. The 3,4 dihydroxybenzene propionic acid plays an anchoring role in carbon fiber, the double bond structure chemical copolymerization crosslinking characteristic can promote compatibility with vinyl resin, and then plays an interface reinforcing role in a double-unit structure, and the interface performance of the composite material is obviously improved.

title_en: Modified silicon rubber material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of silicone rubber, in particular to a modified silicone rubber material and a preparation method thereof, wherein 1, firstly, white carbon black is contacted with water vapor for primary heat treatment to obtain dechlorinated white carbon black, then, the dechlorinated white carbon black is contacted with water and a modifier for secondary heat treatment to obtain modified white carbon black, 2, raw silicone rubber, the modified white carbon black, a heat-resistant additive, a vulcanizing agent and a vulcanization aid are pressed into a mixed rubber sheet, then, the mixed rubber sheet is subjected to vulcanization treatment to obtain the modified silicone rubber material, the vulcanizing agent comprises at least one of dicumyl peroxide, di-tert-butyl-peroxyisopropyl benzene and 2, 4-dichloro benzoyl peroxide, and the vulcanization aid comprises at least one of N, N' -m-phenylene bismaleimide, trimethylolpropane triacrylate, trimethylolpropane trimethacrylate and diallyl phthalate. The method provided by the invention can ensure that the silicon rubber material has good mechanical property at normal temperature and excellent compression resistance and denaturation performance at high temperature.

title_en: Conveying belt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a conveyer belt and a preparation method thereof. The conveyor belt provided by the invention is an impact-resistant multi-layer glass fiber cloth reinforced conveyor belt, glass fibers with a warp-weft reticular structure are used as framework materials of the conveyor belt and are subjected to specific dipping treatment, meanwhile, two layers of foam bodies are particularly introduced, and the composition of a foaming impact-resistant layer is reasonably designed, so that the impact-resistant multi-layer glass fiber cloth reinforced conveyor belt is lighter than the traditional steel wire rope core and fabric core conveyor belt in weight, higher in mechanical tensile strength and more uniform in stress, can effectively absorb impact energy from the outside, and improves impact resistance. In addition, the reinforcing body is made of inorganic materials, and the expansion rate of the reinforcing body when heated is lower than that of polyester cloth, nylon cloth, aramid cloth and the like, so that the thermal stability of the conveying belt is improved.

title_en: Method for removing NMP in poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing NMP in poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin, belonging to the technical field of organic matter separation. The granularity of the poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin ground by the method is not more than 0.2mm, the poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin is easy to dissolve in concentrated sulfuric acid, and the poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin slurry is easier to prepare, so that NMP is conveniently removed, and the NMP content in the poly (p-phenylene terephthamide) resin is not more than 0.01%.

title_en: Quaternary ammonium salt type pyrrolidine polyoxyethylene ether composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quaternary ammonium salt type pyrrolidine polyoxyethylene ether composition and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of polyoxyethylene ether materials. The quaternary ammonium salt type pyrrolidine polyoxyethylene ether composition comprises, by weight, 20-30 parts of quaternary ammonium salt type pyrrolidine polyoxyethylene ether, 0.5-1 part of an antioxidant and 25-35 parts of deionized water. The invention generates monosubstituted compound through the reaction of cyanuric chloride and amino-decaethylene glycol monomethyl ether, and generates antioxidant through the reaction of the monosubstituted compound and 3, 5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxybenzylamine. The quaternary ammonium salt type pyrrolidine polyoxyethylene ether composition prepared by the invention has good surface tension and oxidation resistance.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant high-activity metallocene catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant high-activity metallocene catalyst and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of olefin polymerization catalysts. The catalyst provided by the invention takes a condensed ring structure with a rigid framework as a ligand framework, and is coordinated with transition metal titanium, zirconium or hafnium, so that the catalyst has excellent thermal stability and high catalytic activity, and is suitable for copolymerization of ethylene and alpha-olefin. In the high-temperature polymerization reaction, the catalyst provided by the invention realizes the efficient copolymerization of ethylene and alpha-olefin, and the obtained copolymer has higher molecular weight and higher comonomer insertion amount, so that the structure and performance of the product are effectively regulated and controlled.

title_en: PMMA substrate film with high scratch resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a PMMA substrate film with high scratch resistance and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PMMA substrate film comprises, by weight, 60-78 parts of polymethyl methacrylate, 10-20 parts of modified polystyrene resin, 2-8 parts of plastic toughening agent, 1-12 parts of compatilizer, 0.05-0.65 part of AS opening slipping agent, 0.01-0.09 part of dispersible nano diamond microsphere and 0.1-0.5 part of antioxidant. The dispersible nano diamond microsphere is a porous and hollow sphere, and the sphere is any one or more of a sphere and an elliptic sphere. The PMMA substrate film designed by the application has excellent optical/physical properties, and has the advantages of high optical transmittance, low surface roughness, low surface dynamic friction coefficient, high hardness, high friction resistance and high scratch resistance.

title_en: Composition, preparation method thereof and carrier
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a composition, a preparation method thereof and a carrier, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials. The composition comprises, by mass, 50% -85% of cycloolefin resin, 3% -25% of a first thermoplastic elastomer, 10% -25% of a second thermoplastic elastomer and 0.3% -8% of a conductive filler. The first thermoplastic elastomer comprises a thermoplastic elastomer and a polar monomer grafted to the thermoplastic elastomer, wherein the polar monomer comprises at least one of maleic anhydride, itaconic anhydride, citraconic anhydride, crotonic anhydride, acrylic acid, methacrylic acid, methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, ethyl methacrylate and glycidyl methacrylate. The second thermoplastic elastomer includes a styrene segment as a repeating unit. The material of the composition has the characteristics of low moisture absorption, high heat resistance, high cleanliness, high mechanical strength and antistatic property.

title_en: PDMS-based green flexible composite material with synchronous response force and thermal stimulation and preparation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-functional PDMS/SrAl  2 O 4 :Eu 2+ ,Dy 3+   flexible composite material for synchronously responding to mechanical and thermal stimulus and a preparation technology thereof, wherein the material takes PDMS as a matrix, and SrAl  2 O 4 :Eu 2+ ,Dy 3+  fluorescent powder is subjected to surface modification and then is compounded, so that a composite film with water resistance, high brightness and high flexibility is successfully prepared. The method effectively overcomes the defects of high brittleness and difficult independent molding of the fluorescent powder material, and expands the application potential of the fluorescent powder material in the flexible photoelectric field.

title_en: Oil-soluble drag reducer with anti-shearing performance, and preparation method and application thereof
