abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oilfield drag reducers, and particularly relates to an oil-soluble drag reducer with anti-shearing performance, and a preparation method and application thereof. The drag reducer has a structure shown in a formula (I) or a formula (II), has excellent shearing resistance, can be prepared by a one-pot method under mild reaction conditions, can be applied to the pipeline transportation of crude oil, reduces the pipeline transportation resistance, and increases the transportation flow.

title_en: PET composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PET composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PET composition comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of PET, 5-12 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1-5 parts of epoxy resin, 0.3-10mol% of IPA monomer in the PET, and 79-96.5 mol% of alcoholysis degree of the polyvinyl alcohol. According to the invention, PET with specific IPA monomer content and polyvinyl alcohol with specific alcoholysis degree are selected, so that the adhesive strength and hydrolysis resistance can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Wear-resistant butyronitrile glove and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly discloses a wear-resistant butyronitrile glove and a preparation method thereof. The glove is prepared from 100 parts of nitrile latex, 0.6-1 part of foamless wetting agent, 1.5-1.8 parts of potassium hydroxide, 1-1.5 parts of sulfur powder, 1-2 parts of zinc oxide, 0.3-0.5 part of BZ accelerator, 0.3-0.5 part of EZ accelerator, 1.5-2 parts of titanium dioxide, 0.05-0.1 part of colorant, 0.8-1.2 parts of wear-resistant filler, wherein the wear-resistant filler comprises silicon oxide nano fibers, eggshell powder and lignin nano particles, the balance of deionized water, and the solid content is 14-14.5%. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a coagulant and a nitrile latex composite slurry, dipping the coagulant for the first time, dipping the coagulant for the second time, curling, drying, cooling and demolding. It has the advantage of excellent wear resistance.

title_en: Resin composition and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic materials, and discloses a resin composition and a product thereof. The resin composition comprises 100 parts by weight of maleimide resin containing an indane structure, 5-30 parts by weight of amino modified hydrogenated styrene polymer, 10-30 parts by weight of (methyl) acrylic ester end-capped phosphate resin and 10-30 parts by weight of vinyl-containing polyphenyl ether resin. The article prepared from the resin composition of the present invention comprises a prepreg, a resin film, a laminate, a printed circuit board or a cured insulator, and is improved in at least one of dielectric loss, X-axis thermal expansion coefficient, carrier copper tension, heat resistance after moisture absorption, water absorption after pressure cooking, interlayer tension, and elongated bubble streak.

title_en: Medical waterproof adhesive and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical waterproof adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the medical waterproof adhesive comprises the steps of preparing solid gel, and then adjusting the rheological property of the solid gel to obtain the viscoelastic fluid waterproof adhesive. The preparation method of the adhesive provided by the invention has the advantages of simple operation, controllable process, high repeatability and low cost. The prepared waterproof adhesive has stable performance, good injectability and spreadability at normal temperature, convenient operation, and the preformed network can effectively resist the instant scouring and dilution of tear, aqueous humor, blood and other body fluids in a moist ocular surface environment, ensure the stable residence and accurate positioning of the aqueous humor, the gel undergoes polymerization reaction under the irradiation of a specific wavelength light source, and a compact and firm secondary crosslinking network is rapidly formed under the moist condition, so that stable and reliable in-situ solidification and tissue adhesion are realized.

title_en: Nanocellulose-reinforced biomass-based high-strength furniture board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-cellulose reinforced biomass-based high-strength furniture board and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of furniture board preparation, wherein the method comprises the steps of preparing ZnO nanowire functionalized CNF by a sol-gel method and a hydrothermal method and using a directing agent for induction, preparing ferulic acid@lignin-based microcapsules by an emulsion solvent evaporation method, then mixing ZnO nanowire functionalized CNF, ferulic acid@lignin-based microcapsules, hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose and the like at a high speed to obtain a compound material, and finally carrying out melt extrusion at a gradient temperature and liquid nitrogen cooling forming at-40 ℃; according to the invention, through the synergistic effects of the vertical growth enhancement interface combination of ZnO nanowires, the stability of the microcapsule for resisting ultraviolet light and the optimized dispersion of the dispersing agent, the problems of mechanical attenuation/fading and failure of the traditional ultraviolet light resisting agent caused by weak mechanical property and ultraviolet aging of biomass substrate materials are solved, the cooperative promotion of mechanical property and ultraviolet light resisting is realized, and the requirements of stable bearing and ultraviolet light resisting fading of middle-high-end furniture are met.

title_en: Assembled building wallboard and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assembled building wallboard and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of manufacturing of novel wall materials of assembled buildings, wherein the assembled building wallboard comprises, by weight, 360-400 parts of cement, 70-90 parts of fly ash, 110-130 parts of modified lightweight aggregate, 530-570 parts of machine-made sand, 1.0-1.5 parts of polypropylene fiber, 3.5-4.5 parts of polycarboxylate water reducer and 150-170 parts of water, wherein the surface of the aggregate is coated with an interface layer formed by crosslinking amphiphilic hyperbranched polysiloxane containing C12-C18 long-chain alkyl, alkoxy silane and a hydroxyl-containing flexible amino chain segment, and an Si-O-Si-Ca covalent bond network is built in the interior for connection through the reaction of the alkoxy silane and a cement hydration product.

title_en: Epoxy resin composition and method for preparing same
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure generally relate to epoxy resin compositions and uses thereof. The epoxy resin composition includes an epoxy component including a first epoxy compound and a second epoxy compound. The epoxy resin composition includes a curing agent component including a first polyamine compound and a second polyamine compound.

title_en: Preparation method of superhydrophobic monoatomic Cu porous polymer ammonia separation material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a super-hydrophobic single-atom Cu porous polymer ammonia separation material. The material is prepared by copolymerizing divinylbenzene and 4-vinyl pyridine to construct a super-hydrophobic porous framework, and anchoring monoatomically dispersed copper species by using pyridine nitrogen groups to form strong adsorption sites. The preparation method has simple process and easily obtained raw materials. The material has super-hydrophobic surface and high-density monoatomic copper sites, has extremely high adsorption capacity and selectivity for ammonia, can particularly effectively inhibit competitive adsorption of water molecules in a high-humidity environment, keeps excellent ammonia trapping performance and cycle stability, and has wide application prospects in the fields of synthesis gas purification, ammonia-containing waste gas treatment, ammonia energy purification and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of lightweight melt-blown hot-melt non-woven fabric containing hydrophobic nano silicon dioxide
abstract_en: The lightweight meltblown hot melt nonwoven fabric containing hydrophobic nanosilicon dioxide prepared by the preparation method of the present invention has the effect of ensuring uniformity of adhesive force per section, excellent peel strength and good air permeability even when a smaller amount of adhesive resin is used than in the conventional hot melt film, and reducing material cost and energy by about 10 to 50%, in the case of performing an adhesive function by being interposed between adherends such as fabric, whereby a fabric product to which the meltblown hot melt nonwoven fabric is applied has the feature of preventing overflow (overflow) phenomenon in an adhesive process, and realizing lightweight and soft touch feeling.

title_en: High-stability latex glove coagulant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability latex glove coagulant, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer material processing aids. The coagulant comprises 12-18% of slow-release main gel, 1.5-2.5% of gradient release composite demolding/nucleating agent, 0.2-0.35% of rheology modifier, 0.35-0.55% of double-effect wetting spreading system, 0.3-0.6% of hydrolysis-resistant buffer system and the balance of deionized water. The main gel is modified calcium nitrate tetrahydrate, and the composite demolding/nucleating agent is a nano-scale composite micelle formed by high-speed shearing and emulsifying of sodium stearate, zinc stearate and calcium stearate. The invention realizes the chemical bonding of the coagulant with the hand mold and the latex layer through gradient release and interfacial chemical anchoring, remarkably improves the interlayer binding force, stability and demolding effect, and is suitable for dip molding of various latex gloves.

title_en: Modified polyester polyol, antibacterial polyurethane microporous elastomer and preparation method of elastomer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polyurethane elastomers, and particularly relates to a modified polyester polyol, an antibacterial polyurethane microporous elastomer and a preparation method of the elastomer. The modified polyester polyol is prepared by grafting modified Ag@SiO  2 , and the antibacterial polyurethane microporous elastomer is prepared by using the modified polyester polyol. The antibacterial polyurethane microporous elastomer is mainly prepared by mixing and curing an A component and a B component, wherein the A component mainly comprises conventional polyester polyol and modified polyester polyol, and the B component mainly comprises conventional polyester polyol, polyether polyol and isocyanate; according to the antibacterial polyurethane microporous elastomer and the preparation method thereof, the prepared polyurethane microporous elastomer has long-acting and stable antibacterial performance, is uniformly dispersed, and simultaneously maintains excellent physical and mechanical properties and a microporous structure.

title_en: Continuous carbon fiber reinforced polyaryletherketone rod-shaped structural member, reinforced screw and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a continuous carbon fiber reinforced polyaryletherketone rod-shaped structural member, a reinforced screw and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of engineering plastics, and mainly develops post-treatment of annealing a bar after hot press molding in a vacuum rotation state, so that the whole bar can be heated uniformly, internal stress is effectively eliminated, interface combination of continuous carbon fibers and a polyaryletherketone matrix is enhanced, and further, the anti-pull out force, the bending strength and the fatigue life are remarkably improved.

title_en: Rare earth modified EPDM rubber with low compression set and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides rare earth modified EPDM rubber with low compression set, a preparation method and application thereof, comprising EPDM, rare earth core-shell particles, IL, sulfur, phenolic resin cross-linking agent, BMI, accelerator, anti-aging agent, paraffin oil, carbon black, stearic acid and processing aid. The application adopts a one-step in-situ modification-masterbatch dilution-low temperature mixing-common two-stage vulcanization process to realize uniform dispersion of rare earth particles in an EPDM matrix, avoid agglomeration and frosting, lead CS value to be 5.8% -7.8% under the compression condition of 100 ℃ multiplied by 70h/25%, be far lower than the prior 25% -35% and meet the requirements of less than or equal to 10% of high-end scenes, lead CS retention rate to be more than or equal to 90% after aging at 150 ℃ multiplied by 168h, have no rebound phenomenon, and have outstanding aspects of balanced and stable mechanical properties, high and low temperature resistance, ageing resistance, processing and use stability and the like, strong industrial feasibility, low process energy consumption and large-scale production, expand the application of the composition in the field of high-end sealing and meet the severe use requirements of scenes such as fuel cells, LNG equipment, spacecrafts and the like.

title_en: High-toughness composite material for high jump cross rod and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-toughness composite material for a high jump cross rod and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polyamide materials. The high-toughness composite material comprises, by weight, 60-85 parts of PA6 resin, 5-10 parts of a toughening agent, 1-5 parts of an antioxidant, 2-4 parts of a compatilizer, 10-12 parts of carbon fibers and 0.5-1 part of a lubricant, and the high-toughness composite material prepared by the method has excellent tensile strength, elongation at break, notch impact strength and ageing resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of super-hydrophilic surface constructed by ordered microstructure and coating thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a super-hydrophilic surface constructed by an ordered microstructure and a coating thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of surface functionalized coatings. The method comprises the steps of adopting PECVD to deposit HMDSO polymer on the surface of a substrate to form an initial organic silicon deposition layer, then closing ventilation and plasmas for a period of time to regulate and control the density of surface active groups, depositing TMCTS polymer on the surface of the obtained organic layer, enabling a chip structure formed after TMCTS plasma activation to be deposited on the surface active sites preferentially to form an ordered cellular microstructure, and carrying out oxygen plasma modification and hydrophilic polymer molecular chain grafting on the surface with the microstructure to construct the super-hydrophilic functional layer. According to the invention, the chemical characteristics, active sites and local selective growth of the precursor are cooperatively regulated, so that the ordered construction of the surface microstructure is realized, and the coating with high light transmittance, long-term stable super-hydrophilicity and excellent anti-fog performance is obtained through acrylic acid grafting.

title_en: Intelligent temperature-adjusting aluminum honeycomb composite board based on phase-change material and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent temperature-regulating aluminum honeycomb composite board based on a phase-change material and a manufacturing process thereof, and relates to the field of building energy conservation. The phase change material is prepared from graphene composite cellulose and hydroxyethyl methacrylate serving as raw materials through freezing molding, freeze drying and thermal crosslinking treatment to form composite cellulose aerogel, and then vacuum impregnating polyethylene glycol, wherein the graphene composite cellulose is prepared by reacting amino cellulose with epoxy functionalized graphene and an epoxy polymer, so that a heat conduction path of the graphene and a rigid and heat-resistant structure of the polymer are synchronously introduced, and the phase change material is filled in an aluminum honeycomb plate and pressed to prepare the intelligent temperature-regulating composite plate. The phase change material prepared by the method has the advantages of low leakage rate, high heat conductivity coefficient and excellent mechanical property, and is suitable for the field of building energy conservation.

title_en: Halogen-free and phosphorus-free intrinsic flame-retardant tetrafunctional benzoxazine monomer, nitrogen-rich resin, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a halogen-free and phosphorus-free intrinsic flame retardant type tetrafunctional benzoxazine monomer, nitrogen-rich resin, a preparation method and application thereof. The halogen-free and phosphorus-free intrinsic flame-retardant type tetrafunctional benzoxazine monomer is a benzoxazine monomer shown in any structure in a formula 1. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing 2,2', 4' -tetrahydroxybenzophenone, monoamine and aldehyde compounds in an organic solvent, wherein the monoamine is aniline, furfuryl amine or m-aminophenylacetylene, adding acid to adjust the pH value to 2.5-3.3, reacting raw materials for 6-48 h under the nitrogen atmosphere at 75-115   o  ℃, and filtering and purifying the raw materials. The halogen-free phosphorus-free intrinsic flame-retardant type tetrafunctional benzoxazine monomer provided by the invention can be used for preparing halogen-free phosphorus-free intrinsic flame-retardant type tetrafunctional benzoxazine nitrogen-rich resin, the obtained benzoxazine resin can realize intrinsic flame retardance without any flame retardant additive, has excellent heat resistance and flame retardance, and is simple and convenient in preparation method, and the raw materials are economical and easy to obtain.

title_en: Enzyme-assisted green extraction and nanocrystallization modification method for active polysaccharide of traditional Chinese medicinal materials
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural product extraction and nano material preparation, and particularly discloses an enzyme-assisted green extraction and nanocrystallization modification method of active polysaccharide of a traditional Chinese medicine, wherein xylanase, pectase and cellulase are adopted in the extraction stage in a three-stage bionic gradient layered degradation strategy for targeting wall breaking, and coupled subcritical water extraction is adopted to realize efficient polysaccharide release, the extraction rate is 18-25%, the purity is 85-95%, the polysaccharide, chitosan, sodium alginate and tea polyphenol are built into core-shell nano particles (50-200 nm) by ultrasonic driving layer-by-layer self-assembly in the nanocrystallization stage, the water solubility of the polysaccharide is improved by 3-5 times, the thermal stability is improved by 30-45 ℃, and the oral absorption rate is improved by more than 2 times.

title_en: Perfluoro-cyclobutyl polyether sulfone polymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perfluoro-cyclobutyl polyether sulfone polymer and a preparation method thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a copolymer A and a polymer B prepared by taking the copolymer A as an intermediate, wherein the copolymer A comprises a repeating unit I and a repeating unit II. The polymer of the present invention has excellent solubility, optical properties, thermal stability, processability, etc.

title_en: Diaphragm for super capacitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diaphragms, and provides a diaphragm for a super capacitor, and a preparation method and application thereof. The separator for the super capacitor comprises, by weight, 70 parts of polypropylene fibers, 15-22 parts of tencel fibers, 10-12 parts of carbon nanofibers, 5-8 parts of organic silicon resin, 1-3 parts of plasticizers, 2-4 parts of binders, 3-8 parts of deacetylated chitin and 8-15 parts of calcium silicate whiskers. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the wettability of the diaphragm for the super capacitor in the related technology is relatively poor is solved.

title_en: Preparation method of heat-insulating composite outer wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heat-insulating composite outer wall, which comprises the steps of S1 coating an interface transition layer on the surface of the composite heat-insulating core material, S2 splicing the composite heat-insulating core material coated with the interface transition layer, S3 building a template support system, fixing the composite heat-insulating core material in the template support system through an adjustable steel fixture, adhering water stop strips at splicing gaps between two adjacent composite heat-insulating core materials, S4 casting a concrete wall by adopting a layered casting and symmetrical casting method, and vibrating each layer of concrete wall by adopting an inserted vibrator. By constructing a three-in-one composite system of the heat-insulating core material, the interface transition layer and the concrete, synchronous pouring and one-step forming of the heat-insulating layer and the wall structure are realized, and the technical problems of displacement of the heat-insulating core material, uneven concrete wrapping and the like in the pouring process of the traditional split type process are radically solved.

title_en: Preparation method of annular nitrogen-doped iron-cobalt bimetallic organic framework catalyst and application of annular nitrogen-doped iron-cobalt bimetallic organic framework catalyst in catalysis of generation of singlet oxygen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cyclic nitrogen-doped iron-cobalt bimetallic organic framework catalyst and application thereof in catalyzing and generating singlet oxygen, firstly preparing the iron-cobalt bimetallic organic framework by a solvothermal method, then adopting polyamine grafting reagent to carry out amino grafting modification, and constructing a metal-amine site, and finally, under the condition of anaerobic inert atmosphere and lower temperature heating, performing Schiff base reaction with dialdehyde reagents, cyclizing, and directionally forming a cyclic nitrogen active site mainly containing pyrrole nitrogen to obtain the cyclic nitrogen doped iron-cobalt bimetallic organic framework catalyst. The catalyst can efficiently activate persulfate oxidant, inhibit free radical path under the synergistic effect of iron-cobalt bimetallic center and metal-nitrogen active site, promote non-free radical path leading reaction, realize high-selectivity generation of singlet oxygen, have excellent removal effect on refractory organic pollutants, have strong water interference resistance and wide applicable pH range, and are suitable for selective treatment of complex wastewater.

title_en: Vinylidene fluoride polymer dispersing agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vinylidene fluoride polymer dispersing agent and application thereof, wherein the relative weight average molecular weight of the dispersing agent is 1-60 ten thousand, and the dispersing agent is vinylidene fluoride homopolymer or copolymer formed by vinylidene fluoride and comonomer. The comonomer of the vinylidene fluoride copolymer is C2-C10 olefin containing at least one polar functional group, wherein the polar functional group is selected from at least one of carboxyl, ester group, hydroxyl, sulfonic acid group, phosphoric acid group, amide group, cyano group, amino group, mercapto group, aldehyde group or halogen, and the comonomer accounts for 0.1-50mol% of the vinylidene fluoride repeating unit. The vinylidene fluoride polymer dispersing agent is applied to the preparation of lithium battery electrodes or capacitor electrodes, can not only play a role in stabilizing positive electrode active substances and conductive agents, but also can improve the binding force between the positive electrode active substances and pole pieces.

title_en: Polyaryl ion conducting membrane containing double electron-withdrawing side chain structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of new energy storage flow batteries, and provides a polyaryl ion conductive membrane containing a double electron-withdrawing side chain structure and a preparation method thereof. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of (1) preparing a polyaryl main chain polymer through a super acid-mediated polycondensation reaction, wherein the polyaryl main chain polymer contains a double electron-withdrawing side chain structure, (2) carrying out sulfonation reaction on the polyaryl main chain polymer, grafting sulfonic acid groups capable of conducting protons on benzene rings of the main chain, and (3) preparing the sulfonated polyaryl polymer into a homogeneous compact ion conducting membrane through a solution casting method. The polyaryl ion conductive film containing the side chains with double electron-withdrawing functions has the advantages that the side chain electron-withdrawing effect can redistribute the main chain electron cloud density, promote the dissociation of sulfonic acid groups and repel vanadium ions, so that the hydrogen vanadium ion selectivity and the cycle stability of the energy storage all-vanadium redox flow battery are remarkably improved.

title_en: TAC composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TAC composite film and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of optical films. The TAC composite film comprises a modified TAC base film and a functional protective coating, wherein the modified TAC base film is prepared by casting a triacetate cellulose solution into a film, the triacetate cellulose solution comprises, by mass, 20 parts of triacetate cellulose, 1-2 parts of sulfhydryl esterified cellulose, 0.1-0.3 part of plasticizer, 0.1-0.4 part of ultraviolet absorber and 80-100 parts of mixed solvent, the functional protective coating is prepared by coating slurry and then photo-curing, and the coating slurry comprises, by mass, 30 parts of photo-curing acrylate prepolymer, 4-8 parts of alkenyl quaternized cellulose, 0.5-1.5 parts of photoinitiator and 40-50 parts of solvent. In the invention, sulfhydryl esterified cellulose is added into a base film, alkenyl quaternized cellulose is added into a coating, and the interfacial binding force is enhanced through chemical action.

title_en: Chitosan-based hydrogel, preparation method and application thereof in wound healing of bacterial infection
abstract_en: The invention provides chitosan-based hydrogel and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of chemical synthesis and biomedicine. The chitosan-based hydrogel is obtained by crosslinking a carboxymethyl chitosan main structure and a synthesized crosslinking agent shown in a formula 1. The invention also provides application of the chitosan-based hydrogel in preparing a medicament for treating bacterial infection wound healing. The chitosan-based hydrogel provided by the invention has excellent bioluminescence performance, and can be used for detecting the intensity of inflammation at a wound part. The prepared hydrogel material has the effects of photo-thermal, photodynamic and near infrared photocatalysis cage release H  2  S, antibiosis and wound healing.

title_en: Functional nanoparticle premix, method of obtaining the premix, method of modifying material properties, and material having modified properties
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material engineering and nanotechnology. More specifically, a functional premix comprising nanoparticles and a carrier or compatibilizer, a method of obtaining the premix, a method of modifying material properties, and a modified material formed having improved properties are disclosed. Unexpectedly, the premixes of the present invention can be used to alter the properties of different kinds of materials (e.g., polymers, metals, ceramic materials, and/or composites of different materials). The premix of the present invention has many advantages in terms of transportation, use and incorporation of nanoparticles into different materials. In one embodiment, the present invention provides a significant modification to the properties of the polymer and in fact breaks through existing concepts in the art. In another embodiment, the invention provides advantages in altering the properties of metallic and/or ceramic materials.

title_en: Dispersants for carbon nanotubes and carbon nanotube compositions comprising modified maleated natural oils, salts containing lactam moieties
abstract_en: The present application provides a dispersant for carbon nanotubes or carbon nanotube compositions comprising the reaction product of (A) a maleated natural oil, including natural oils having maleated functional groups, and (B) at least one lactam having at least one hydroxyl functional group. In addition, the application provides a dispersant for a carbon nanotube or a carbon nanotube composition comprising the reaction product of (A) a maleated natural oil, including a natural oil having a maleated functional group, (B) at least one lactam having at least one hydroxyl functional group, and (C) a base. In addition, the present application provides a dispersant for a carbon nanotube or carbon nanotube composition comprising the reaction product of (A) a maleated natural oil comprising a natural oil having a maleated functional group, (B) a lactam moiety having at least one hydroxyl, thiol or amine functional group, (C) a functionalized or unfunctionalized moiety selected from the group consisting of a hydrophobic moiety, a hydrophilic moiety, and combinations thereof, wherein the maleated functional group has partially reacted with the functionalized or unfunctionalized moiety, and (D) an optional base. Dispersants for carbon nanotubes or carbon nanotube compositions comprising the reaction product of a modified natural oil having a lactam moiety are used in lithium ion or sodium ion batteries.

title_en: Self-repairing polyurethane based on pyridine-metal coordination and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides self-repairing polyurethane based on pyridine-metal coordination and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) dissolving diaminopyridine in an organic solvent to obtain a diaminopyridine solution; stirring and mixing diaminopyridine solution and isocyanate polyurethane prepolymer, performing chain extension reaction to obtain rigid aromatic heterocyclic polyurethane solution, 2) dripping ferric salt solution into the rigid aromatic heterocyclic polyurethane solution, performing reaction to obtain self-repairing polyurethane solution, and sequentially performing reverse molding and drying on the self-repairing polyurethane solution to obtain the self-repairing polyurethane based on pyridine-metal coordination. The prepared polyurethane can be recycled and self-repaired under mild conditions, and has mechanical stability.

title_en: Single-component heat-conducting gel containing hyperbranched phenyl vinyl polysiloxane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic silicon high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a single-component heat-conducting gel containing hyperbranched phenyl vinyl polysiloxane and a preparation method thereof, wherein the heat-conducting gel is prepared from the following raw materials of, by weight, 2-15 parts of hyperbranched phenyl vinyl polysiloxane, 0.2-2 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 0.1-2 parts of catalyst, 0.05-0.5 part of inhibitor and 80-97 parts of heat-conducting filler, and the hyperbranched phenyl vinyl polysiloxane is prepared from side hydrogen-containing polysiloxane and terminal vinyl phenyl polysiloxane through hydrosilylation reaction. The single-component heat-conducting gel prepared by the method has high heat conductivity coefficient, excellent rebound resilience and high temperature resistance, the heat conductivity coefficient can reach 20.0W/m.K at the highest, the rebound resilience can reach 98% at the highest by combining the advantages of self-made hyperbranched phenyl vinyl polysiloxane, and the use temperature can be 180-250 ℃.

title_en: One-part moisture curable silane terminated polymer composition with reactive plasticizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a one-component moisture-curable composition comprising at least one organic polymer having on average at least two reactive silane end groups, at least one reactive plasticizer having on average from 1 to 1.5 reactive silane end groups, optionally a filler and optionally at least one additive. The one-part moisture curable composition can be formulated to exhibit excellent properties for non-exuding sealants. The present invention also reduces the amount of detrimental phthalate-containing plasticizers.

title_en: Sustained-release implantation type biodegradable stent loaded with anti-tumor active ingredient
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological medicine and high polymer materials, and discloses a slow-release implantation type biodegradable stent loaded with an anti-tumor active ingredient, which consists of a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, doxorubicin hydrochloride, a citric acid end capped polyethylene glycol polymer, zinc acetate dihydrate and N-acetylcysteine. The application utilizes in-situ coordination reaction among components to construct a metastable state complex structure, which prevents the rapid release of water-soluble doxorubicin hydrochloride in the initial stage of implantation. After implantation, N-acetylcysteine is dissociated and released preferentially to generate zinc ion coordination unsaturated sites in a coordination network, and lactic acid molecules generated by hydrolysis of the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer are involved in the unsaturated sites to generate competition coordination reaction, so that a coordination framework is destroyed and an antitumor drug is released. The application realizes the synchronization of the drug release rate and the degradation rate of the polymer matrix, and meanwhile, the acetate dissociated by the zinc acetate can effectively buffer and degrade the pH value of the microenvironment.

title_en: Organosilicon-based long-acting anti-caking agent for hymexazol soluble powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organosilicon-based long-acting anti-caking agent for hymexazol soluble powder and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of hymexazol soluble powder; the preparation method comprises the steps of epoxy modified organosiloxane and mixing, wherein the epoxy modified organosiloxane comprises the steps of mixing phenyl triethoxysilane, dimethyl diethoxysilane and 3-glycidoxypropyl triethoxysilane, stirring uniformly, adding deionized water and hydrochloric acid solution, carrying out hydrolytic polycondensation at 50-80 ℃ for 2-4h, carrying out decompression condensation at 120-140 ℃ and 0.08-0.09 MPa for 1-2h, cooling and sieving to obtain white powder, namely the epoxy modified organosiloxane.

title_en: Composite environment-friendly rubber auxiliary agent with reinforcement and anti-aging functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rubber additives, and provides a rubber additive with two functions of reinforcement and aging resistance. The auxiliary agent mainly comprises one or more of styrene bisphenol, benzene diphenol tar, polybutyl bisphenol, furan phenol tar and benzene diphenol tar-formaldehyde oligomer, and is compounded by using one or more of dioctyl phthalate, white carbon black, phenyl silicone oil and silane coupling agent. The composite additive manufactured by the method is a reactive additive, partially participates in the crosslinking reaction of natural rubber or synthetic rubber, has the characteristic of rubber plasticizer, and has the advantage of environmental friendliness due to no polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon. The rubber sizing material prepared by the composite additive reduces mixing energy consumption, the extrusion size stability of a semi-finished product is good, the surface finish of the rolled sizing material is improved, and compared with the rubber vulcanized rubber without the additive, the tear resistance and the ageing resistance of a rubber product are improved by using the additive.

title_en: Modified carbon fiber with chitosan-metal polyphenol network-graphene oxide synergistic interface, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of carbon fiber material preparation, and particularly relates to a modified carbon fiber with a chitosan-metal polyphenol network-graphene oxide synergistic interface, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method, tannic acid and ferric salt are coordinated to form a metal polyphenol network solution, carbon fibers are subjected to desizing and cleaning, then immersed into the metal polyphenol network solution for modification to form a transition layer, MPN modified carbon fibers are immersed into a chitosan-graphene oxide composite solution, a chitosan-metal polyphenol network-graphene oxide synergistic interface is constructed in the composite solution, and the modified carbon fibers are obtained after washing and drying. The method has the advantages of simple process and low production cost, and combines the high rigidity of the graphene oxide with the high flexibility of the chitosan organically, and forms a composite interface layer with a synergistic effect on the surface of the carbon fiber, so that the uniform distribution and firm combination of the carbon fiber surface modification layer are realized, and the interface compatibility and the mechanical property between the fiber and the matrix are obviously improved.

title_en: Automobile tire mute puncture-resistant patch based on butyl rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mute puncture-resistant patch for an automobile tire based on butyl rubber and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of tire patch preparation, and is used for solving the technical problem that the vibration noise control performance and puncture resistance of the mute puncture-resistant patch in the prior art are to be further improved; according to the invention, the continuous rubber phase with the synergistic effect of interfacial activation and network is constructed by imidazole grafted butyl rubber and borate bridged butyl rubber, the stable interfacial and high-efficiency bearing reinforcing phase is constructed by dopamine coated aramid fiber and silane immobilized aramid fiber, and a surface layer structure with sealing and buffering effects is formed by adopting zinc salt polyurethane hole sealing glue, so that a synergistic structure foundation is formed on the aspects of substrate continuity, fiber-substrate interfacial synergistic effect and surface layer integrity of the mute puncture-proof patch, and the puncture resistance, tear resistance, wear resistance and vibration noise control effects are considered.

title_en: Capillary electrochromatography column for chiral tyrosine separation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capillary electrochromatography column for chiral tyrosine separation and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of chemical synthesis and analysis, and comprise a capillary and a composite coating fixed on the inner wall of the capillary, wherein the composite coating comprises a Chiral Metal Organic Framework (CMOFs) and a Chiral Molecularly Imprinted Polymer (CMIPs) modified on the surface of CMOFs, the CMOFs is formed by the coordination reaction of MIL-101 (Cr) and L-tyrosine serving as a chiral ligand, and the composite coating (CMIP@CMOF) is a multi-stage composite structure formed by taking CMOFs as a support carrier and performing in-situ polymerization in a system comprising a cross-linking agent, a functional monomer, an initiator and L-tyrosine serving as a template molecule. The separation system formed by the coating column has excellent separation performance, the separation degree (Rs) of DL-tyrosine enantiomers is up to 5.83, and the selectivity factor (alpha) is up to 1.33.

title_en: Insulating flame-retardant high-strength medium-high voltage cable terminal cap and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulating flame-retardant high-strength medium-high voltage cable terminal cap and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of cable materials and are used for solving the technical problem that the insulating property, the flame retardant property and the mechanical property of the cable terminal cap in the prior art are to be further improved. The invention further improves the insulating property, the flame retardant property and the mechanical property of the prepared cable terminal cap through the synergistic effect among the prepared composite polysiloxane, the flame retardant and the composite reinforcing agent.

title_en: Preparation method and application of covalent organic framework regulated and controlled by double sites
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pyridyl Covalent Organic Framework (COF) and an antimony (Sb) coordination compound (TAPB-BTTA, TAPT-BTTA, TAPB-BTTA-Sb and TAPT-BTTA-Sb) thereof, and application of the compound in photocatalytic hydrogen peroxide (H  2 O 2 ), belonging to the technical field of photocatalysis. According to the invention, through a molecular engineering strategy, specific amine monomers and aldehyde monomers are used as raw materials, a crystal Schiff base is reacted to prepare TAPB-BTTA and TAPT-BTTA with pyridyl-imine bidentate chelation sites, and then a main group metal Sb atom is accurately anchored at a pyridine-imine coordination site of a COFs framework through a post-modification synthesis strategy, so that an atomic-level dispersed Sb coordination COF compound is formed. The material optimizes the H  2 O 2  generation path into a high-efficiency one-step double-electron oxygen reduction reaction (2 e  ‑  ORR) path through the two-stage regulation and control of the nitrogen locus and the Sb metal locus, and remarkably improves the separation efficiency and catalytic activity of photo-generated carriers, wherein the H  2 O 2  generation rate of TAPT-BTTA-Sb is as high as 18399.72 mu mol H  ‑1  g ‑1 , the material has excellent stability and oxygen utilization rate, and the high-efficiency material and the preparation method are provided for solar drive clean H  2 O 2  synthesis.

title_en: Ion imprinting covalent organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ion imprinting covalent organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of organic high polymer porous materials. The method comprises the steps of carrying out ultrasonic mixing on a functional monomer with C  2v  symmetry, planar hexacoordinated metal imprinting ions and a solvent to obtain a C  3  symmetry hexasite coordination complex, adding a solvent-dispersed C  3  symmetry node monomer into a system of the C  3  symmetry hexasite coordination complex to carry out ultrasonic mixing again, adding a catalyst solution to carry out ultrasonic post reaction to obtain a reaction product, carrying out post-treatment on the reaction product to obtain a metal covalent organic framework ion imprinting COFs precursor, dispersing the metal covalent organic framework ion imprinting COFs precursor into a sulfuric acid solution to carry out elution, and then carrying out post-treatment to obtain the ion imprinting covalent organic framework material. The method solves the problems that the crystallinity is difficult to control, the scale synthesis is difficult, and the specific coordination environment cannot be constructed.

title_en: One-step synthesis of fluoro functional ionic polymeric material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of organic polymeric materials, and particularly relates to a one-step synthesis of a fluoro functional ionic polymeric material and application thereof. The invention provides a one-step synthesized fluoro functional ionic polymerization material, which is prepared from the following raw materials of a connecting monomer A, a functional monomer B and a functional monomer C, wherein the connecting monomer A is a polymer connecting arm, the functional monomer B and the functional monomer C are functional groups, the connecting monomer A is fluorine-containing dibromide, the functional monomer B is 4-aminopyridine or N, N-dimethyl ethylenediamine, and the functional monomer C is 4,4' -methylenebis (phenyl isocyanate) or triphenylmethane triisocyanate. The invention prepares the fluoro functional ionic polymeric material in one step by adopting a simple solvothermal method through three-component reaction, and realizes the efficient removal of PFAS in water by regulating and controlling the structure and the function of the polymeric material by utilizing the change of functional monomers.

title_en: Aramid fiber slurry and preparation method thereof, battery diaphragm and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides aramid fiber slurry, a preparation method thereof, a battery diaphragm, a preparation method and application thereof. The aramid fiber slurry comprises aramid fiber, a non-proton type strong polar solvent and a cosolvent, wherein the pH value of the cosolvent is 5-7.5 at 25 ℃ and 101.325kPa, and the rotational viscosity of the aramid fiber slurry is 500-5000 mPa.s. The aramid pulp can dissolve aramid without using strong alkalinity such as sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide and other cosolvent, can avoid damage of the cosolvent to aramid molecules, prolongs the operation time window, improves the stability of the pulp, can be stably stored for more than 168 hours, reduces the production operation difficulty and personnel and equipment investment, and is beneficial to large-scale production. The rotational viscosity of the aramid fiber slurry formed by the application has a proper range, and the slurry in the range has good stability and ideal performance of the diaphragm.

title_en: Adhesive, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a binder, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the binder comprises a soft segment-containing compound, a hard segment-containing compound and a chain extender, the soft segment-containing compound comprises polyether polyol and polyester polyol, the polyether polyol is blocked by amino or hydroxyl, the polyester polyol is blocked by amino or hydroxyl, the hard segment-containing compound is diisocyanate, and the chain extender is a chain extender containing phenol groups. The binder disclosed by the invention is beneficial to solving the interface problem of the positive electrode when the battery works, and is expected to improve the cycle life and stability of the battery.

title_en: Antithrombotic polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antithrombotic polymer, a preparation method and application thereof. The antithrombotic polymer is composed of three parts, namely A) fibrinolytic functional units, B) surface adhesion units and C) units containing zwitterionic structures, so that the functional coating can be uniformly and firmly existing on the surface of the medical biological material, and the antithrombotic functional regulation and control of various mechanisms can be realized according to the actual use requirements of different instruments. In addition, the preparation process of the antithrombotic polymer is simpler and the antithrombotic polymer can be used as a coating of medical equipment, thereby being convenient for high-efficiency modification of various modeling and special-structure equipment.

title_en: Low-density three-dimensional graphene heat conduction gasket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-density three-dimensional graphene heat conduction gasket and a preparation method thereof, wherein the conventional graphene heat conduction gasket is of a local three-dimensional network structure, an integral heat conduction network structure is not formed, and the improvement of the heat conduction coefficient is influenced; and finally, pouring a low-viscosity heat-conducting high-molecular polymer into the heat-conducting filler/three-dimensional graphene frame, wherein the low-viscosity heat-conducting high-molecular polymer can be better filled in a gap structure of the heat-conducting filler/three-dimensional graphene frame, the heat-conducting high-molecular polymer effectively supports a three-dimensional network structure after solidification, and meanwhile, the three-dimensional graphene, the high-heat-conducting spherical heat-conducting filler and the low-dimensional heat-conducting filler form a rich heat-conducting passage, so that the heat-conducting gasket has excellent heat-conducting property and flexibility, and the process is simple and feasible and is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Nylon cable sheath material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nylon cable sheath material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nylon cable sheath material comprises, by weight, 80-90 parts of long carbon chain nylon, 0-12 parts of a plasticizer, 0-5 parts of a modified wear-resistant auxiliary agent, 0-2 parts of a chain extender, 0-2 parts of an antioxidant, 0-2 parts of a light stabilizer and 0-2 parts of a lubricant. The material is produced by a double-screw extrusion granulation process, has good wear resistance, high hardness and termite gnawing resistance, and has application prospect in the field of cable jackets.

title_en: Emulsion modifier and application thereof in prevention and control of heavy metal in gas slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emulsion modifier and application thereof in prevention and control of heavy metal in gas slag, and belongs to the field of mining and environmental protection. The method comprises the steps of adding 0.1-10 parts of emulsion modifier into 100 parts of gas slag, modifying the gas slag in a certain granularity range for a certain time by adopting equipment such as a mixer or a ball mill, aging and drying to obtain modified gas slag, wherein the emulsion modifier is prepared by carrying out configuration reaction on 0-50 parts of organic silicon resin, 0-50 parts of epoxy resin, 0-50 parts of styrene-acrylic emulsion, 1-5 parts of silane coupling agent and 0-2 parts of naphthalene sulfonate. The invention has simple treatment process, can prevent and control the precipitation of Al, cu, zn, as, se, cr, pb and other heavy metal ions in the gas slag and reduce the environmental pollution hazard of the gas slag.

title_en: Alkali-resistant waterproof exterior wall paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of paint, in particular to alkali-resistant waterproof exterior wall paint and a preparation method thereof. In order to further improve the water resistance and alkali resistance of the stone-like paint, the invention improves the stone-like paint, adds a layer of texture protective paint in the structure of the traditional stone-like paint, adds colored sand in the components of the stone-like paint, can provide uneven texture for the surface of the stone-like paint after the stone-like paint is finally molded, adds boron nitride nano sheets in the texture protective paint, and carries out modification treatment on the boron nitride nano sheets, and introduces fluorine element and silicon element into the texture protective paint, thereby improving the chemical resistance of resin, preventing infiltration and invasion of external erosion media and effectively improving the acid and alkali resistance of the resin paint.

title_en: Modified photo-curing oligomer, preparation method thereof and photo-curing 3D printing resin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a modified photo-curing oligomer, a preparation method thereof and photo-curing 3D printing resin, wherein the preparation method of the modified photo-curing oligomer comprises the following steps of providing an acrylic monomer, a triblock thermoplastic elastomer, a coupling agent and polyurethane acrylate, dissolving the triblock thermoplastic elastomer in the acrylic monomer to obtain a block copolymer mixed solution, adding the coupling agent into the block copolymer mixed solution to obtain a modified block copolymer mixed solution, adding the polyurethane acrylate into the modified block copolymer mixed solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain the modified photo-curing oligomer. According to the modified photocuring oligomer, the preparation method thereof and the photocuring 3D printing resin provided by the embodiment of the application, the triblock thermoplastic elastomer is used as a toughness reinforcing phase, and the surface of the triblock thermoplastic elastomer is chemically modified by using a coupling agent, so that a firm chemical bonding interface can be formed between the triblock thermoplastic elastomer and polyurethane acrylate after the triblock thermoplastic elastomer is pre-dispersed in an acrylic monomer.

title_en: Flame-retardant silica gel material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant silica gel material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of flame-retardant silica gel materials. The method comprises the following steps of (1) MXene surface hydrophobic modification treatment, (2) anti-migration shear thickening fluid STF preparation, (3) seepage prevention phase change composite prepolymer preparation, (4) flame-retardant modified silica gel based adhesive mixing preparation, (5) single-side MXene flame-retardant barrier layer loading, (6) another side composite phase change thermal buffer layer, (7) sectional vulcanization molding, and (8) cooling shaping and post-treatment. According to the invention, a silica gel system is compositely introduced by a modified MXene nano-barrier flame-retardant system, surface passivation modified shear thickening liquid and a silicon-based coated phase-change thermal buffer system, so that an asymmetric Janus structure is constructed, the synergistic effects of efficient flame retardance, smoke suppression, impact resistance and thermal buffering and heat resistance degradation are realized, and the problems of poor dispersibility, reduced mechanical strength, weak impact resistance, insufficient flame retardance and long-acting property and the like of the traditional flame-retardant silica gel filler are solved.

title_en: Efficient halogen-free flame retardant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-efficiency halogen-free flame retardant, which comprises the steps of preparing a hyperbranched flame retardant mother substrate from alicyclic diamine and polycarboxylic acid ester, preparing magnesium-based co-phase from magnesium-aluminum double-metal hydroxide LDHs and magnesium hydroxide, modifying attapulgite whiskers, adding a phosphazene hybrid oxazoline monomer and a zinc source aqueous solution, and finally obtaining the high-efficiency halogen-free flame retardant. Through precisely regulating and controlling the synergistic effect of all components and the preparation process, the prepared flame retardant has good flame retardant efficiency and mechanical property, and can better meet the flame retardant use requirement in the field of electronic material packaging.

title_en: Preparation method and application of EVA wax for high-performance hot melt adhesive
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of EVA wax for high-performance hot melt adhesive, and belongs to the technical field of polymer material processing aids. According to the invention, a medium-pressure polymerization process (8-15 MPa) is adopted, alkane compounds are used as solvents, and EVA wax with the ethylene content of 80% -90%, the molecular weight of 4000-10000 g/mol, the melt index of 50-150 g/10min and the melting point of 80-100 ℃ is successfully prepared by means of stepwise feeding and continuous dripping of an initiator. Compared with the existing high-pressure polymerization process, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the equipment investment and the operation cost are obviously reduced, the process is simple, and the industrial production is easy. The high-performance hot melt adhesive prepared based on the EVA wax has the viscosity retention of 745-N, the opening time of over 410-s, and good compatibility, thermal stability and precipitation delamination resistance. The invention provides an economic, controllable and excellent wax auxiliary agent solution for the field of high-performance hot melt adhesives, and has definite industrial application value and popularization prospect.

title_en: Composite deodorant for rubber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite deodorant for rubber and a preparation method thereof. The composite deodorant comprises, by weight, 25-50 parts of porous polymer, 20-40 parts of modified silicate, 5-18 parts of zinc phytate-tannic acid complex, 3-12 parts of hydrophobic porous adsorbent and 10-25 parts of rubber compatible coating agent. The composite deodorant disclosed by the invention realizes the synergistic treatment of chemical capture and physical adsorption on various odor substances such as ethylidene norbornene, amine generated by vulcanization, sulfur-containing micromolecules and the like remained in a rubber system through the multiple synergistic effect of tetrazine groups, aldehyde groups, mercapto-zinc active centers, polyphenol-metal complex centers and hydrophobic porous adsorption structures, is stable in capture, remarkably reduces the VOC release level and the re-release proportion after heat aging, has good process compatibility, and can be used for the low odor processing of rubber products such as ethylene propylene diene monomer and the like.

title_en: PETG modified composite material with high transparency, low internal stress and wide process window and preparation and injection molding process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PETG modified composite material with high transparency, low internal stress and wide process window, which comprises PETG matrix resin, transparent copolyester compatible modified resin, composite thermal oxygen degradation resistant stabilizer, transparent core-shell toughening internal stress regulator and the like. The low-shear preparation granulation process of the composite material comprises the following steps of ingredient mixing, low-shear melt extrusion, bracing water-cooled granulation and constant-temperature low-humidity storage. The low-stress injection molding process of the composite material comprises the following steps of drying working conditions, equipment screw selection, barrel temperature control, glue injection control and optimal design of a mold structure. Through reasonable formula component proportion and synergistic effect design, material degradation is reduced by combining a low-shear granulation process, and matched injection molding process optimization is realized, the comprehensive improvement of the moisture absorption performance, the thermal stability, the processing performance, the molding performance and the service performance of the material is realized, the application scene of the material is widened, and the mass production efficiency and the finished product yield are improved.

title_en: Layered porous wood-based solar interface evaporator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sea water desalination by wood-based solar energy interface evaporation, and relates to a layered porous wood-based solar energy interface evaporator, a preparation method and application thereof. The layered porous wood-based solar interface evaporator comprises a layered wood-based supporting part, a photo-thermal conversion part and a photo-thermal conversion part, wherein the layered wood-based supporting part is a natural wood-based Kong Cengzhuang skeleton, the photo-thermal conversion part is positioned on the light-receiving surface side of the layered wood-based supporting part and comprises carbon black, the light-receiving surface comprises a layered pore structure, the carbon black is attached to the pore wall of the layered pore in situ, the carbon black is carbon black with an oxygen-containing functional group grafted on the surface, and the surface of the layered skeleton is provided with hydrophilic binding sites rich in negative charges. The pure water evaporation rate of the layered porous wood-based solar interface evaporator provided by the invention can reach 1.76 kg m  ‑2  h ‑1 , the evaporation efficiency is 79%, and no obvious salt crystallization accumulation exists at the evaporation interface after the layered porous wood-based solar interface evaporator is operated in high-concentration brine for a long time.

title_en: Electrode binder polymer, electrode binder composition, electrode slurry, electrode, secondary battery, method for producing electrode binder polymer, method for producing electrode binder composition, method for producing electrode slurry, and method for producing electrode
abstract_en: The electrode binder polymer has a1 st functional group and a 2 nd functional group, the 1 st functional group is at least 1 selected from a carboxyl group and a carboxyl group which has formed a salt, the 2 nd functional group is at least 1 selected from an isocyanate group and a blocked isocyanate group, and the glass transition temperature Tg of the electrode binder polymer is-3 ℃ or higher.

title_en: Multilayer composite film and application thereof in packaging with braille
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer composite film and application thereof in packaging with braille, and relates to the technical field of high polymer composite materials and special packaging. The composite membrane at least comprises a surface layer, a core supporting layer and a bottom layer, wherein the core supporting layer comprises, by mass, 55-75 parts of polyvinyl chloride resin, 15-25 parts of a plasticizer, 1.5-4 parts of a heat stabilizer, 0.5-2 parts of a lubricant and 5-15 parts of a structurally modified sepiolite fiber, and the structurally modified sepiolite fiber is an oleophylic fiber which is reamed by an acid-induced micro-channel and the surface of which is modified by ultrasonic in-situ intercalation of a pyrophosphoric acid type titanate coupling agent. The composite film builds a compact interface transition layer through the uniform dispersion of the modified fibers in the matrix, effectively dissipates molding stress and interweaves inside to form a rigid micro skeleton network, can remarkably inhibit creep collapse when continuously pressed and prevent the generation of salient point edge microcracks when punched, and ensures that the packaging film has excellent Braille compression resistance and shape retention effects and good toughness.

title_en: Water-based low-surface-energy anti-contamination paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a water-based low-surface-energy anti-contamination paint and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of water-based paint, and the technical scheme is characterized in that the water-based low-surface-energy anti-contamination paint comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 50-60 parts of modified aqueous acrylic emulsion, 10-12 parts of aqueous polyurethane curing agent, 8-10 parts of aqueous fluorosilane emulsion, 10-12 parts of nano silicon dioxide water dispersion slurry, 0.5-1 part of aqueous dispersing agent, 0.3-0.5 part of aqueous wetting agent, 0.2-0.5 part of aqueous defoaming agent, 0.5-1 part of aqueous thickening agent and 15-20 parts of deionized water, wherein the solid content of the nano silicon dioxide water dispersion slurry is 25%.

title_en: Polyolefin composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyolefin composition comprising one or more olefin polymers and polyethylene, wherein the crystal distribution width of the high and medium crystal portions is maintained above 22 ℃, thereby minimizing creep phenomenon, and thus, when used for manufacturing a composition for sealing film or sealing film, deformation of the film can be minimized even if used for a long period of time.

title_en: Composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite membrane at least comprises a substrate layer, a coating layer and a coating layer, wherein the substrate layer is made of polyolefin, the coating layer is arranged on one side of the substrate layer, the material of the coating layer comprises elastomer and nano particles, and the median pore diameter in the coating layer is smaller than that in the substrate layer. The composite film, the preparation method and the application thereof can ensure that the garment fabric has excellent moisture permeability and water resistance, thereby improving the comfort and durability of the garment fabric.

title_en: Polyphenyl ether composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyphenyl ether composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, wherein the polyphenyl ether composite material comprises, by mass, 53-82 parts of polyphenyl ether resin, 8-22 parts of polystyrene resin, 0.5-8.5 parts of hydrogenated styrene-butadiene-styrene, 0.3-2.2 parts of composite stabilizer and 1.5-5.5 parts of thermal decomposition type inorganic foaming agent, the composite stabilizer comprises phosphite antioxidant and thiol antioxidant, the thermal decomposition type inorganic foaming agent comprises at least one of carbonate and bicarbonate, and the hydroxyl end content of the polyphenyl ether resin is less than or equal to 30mg KOH/g. The polyphenyl ether composite material provided by the invention has good continuous extrusion processability by selecting proper parts by mass of components, and meanwhile, the obtained product has excellent ageing resistance, low yellowing degree before and after ageing and high notch impact strength retention rate.

title_en: All-weather self-adaptive temperature control coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy-saving coating materials, in particular to an all-weather self-adaptive temperature control coating and a preparation method thereof. The all-weather self-adaptive temperature control coating provided by the invention comprises, by mass, 350-450 parts of phase-change acrylic emulsion, 100-150 parts of phase-change microcapsule, 120-180 parts of high-reflection filler, 150-200 parts of radiation refrigeration filler, 35-60 parts of auxiliary agent and 80-120 parts of water. The all-weather self-adaptive temperature control coating provided by the invention is based on the phase change-reflection-radiation synergistic effect, so that the coating has active daytime reflection and radiation heat dissipation, absorbs and stores excessive heat through phase change, releases and stores the heat through phase change at night, and compensates heat loss to relieve supercooling phenomenon, thereby realizing all-weather intelligent temperature control of daytime cooling and nighttime cold prevention.

title_en: Preparation method of A-B-X type luminescent material, flexible blue light display screen and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an A-B-X type luminescent material, a flexible blue light display screen and application thereof. The preparation method of the A-B-X type luminescent material comprises the following steps of grinding, mixing, standing and drying the A-B-X type metal halide luminescent material, wherein the main regulation component and the polar solvent are mixed. The invention improves the local microenvironment of the luminous component to a certain extent, reduces the defect state and the component instability, is beneficial to improving the blue light emission performance and stability, and improves the flexibility, the bending resistance and the film formation continuity of the material, so that the material is more suitable for flexible display and related photoelectric devices.

title_en: Fiber reinforced composite material with damage auxiliary positioning function, preparation method and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fiber reinforced composite material with damage auxiliary positioning and a preparation method and a detection method thereof, and the fiber reinforced composite material comprises reinforced fibers, a resin matrix and a microcapsule indication system dispersed in the resin matrix, wherein the microcapsule indication system comprises microcapsules with the wall thickness of 3-15 mu m, indication substances are encapsulated in the microcapsules, when the composite material generates cracks with the width of more than or equal to 0.05mm, the microcapsules on a crack path are broken, the indication substances are released, the interface performance is relatively poor, the problem that the damage of the traditional fiber reinforced composite material is difficult to discover timely, intuitively and remotely is solved, and the self-indication composite material which does not depend on external energy sources, has strong environmental adaptability and durable signals and the preparation method thereof are provided, so that the safety and the service life of key structural parts are remarkably improved.

title_en: Method for preparing large hollow particles
abstract_en: Described herein is a method of preparing hollow latex particles having a volume average particle size greater than 1 μm and a particle burst level of less than 50%. Hollow latex particles prepared thereby and articles containing the hollow latex particles are also described.

title_en: Composite antibacterial mildew inhibitor, plastic master batch, plastic, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite antibacterial mildew preventive, a plastic master batch, plastic, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite antibacterial mildew preventive comprises nano zinc oxide and an organic antibacterial mildew preventive, wherein the organic antibacterial mildew preventive comprises benzimidazole antibacterial agents, pyridine antibacterial agents and amine antibacterial agents. The composite antibacterial mildew preventive has excellent and long-acting stable antibacterial mildew preventive performance, and the components have synergistic effect and are matched with each other, so that the excellent long-acting stability can be ensured after the molding temperature of the composite antibacterial mildew preventive is equal to that of plastic or an intermediate product thereof, the excellent antibacterial mildew preventive effect can be maintained after the composite antibacterial mildew preventive is soaked in water at high temperature, and the composite antibacterial mildew preventive can be suitable for a scene with water or in frequent contact with water.

title_en: Medical adhesive tape containing squid visceral polysaccharide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medical adhesive tape containing squid visceral polysaccharide and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of medical adhesive products. The technical problems to be solved are that the synthetic antioxidants in the existing medical adhesive tape have migration toxicity risk and poor stability, the vitamin derivatives are easy to inactivate and possibly irritate skin, and meanwhile, the adhesive tape is easy to swell in a damp and hot environment to cause the problems of reduced viscosity, insufficient durability and the like. The technical scheme is characterized in that the squid viscera polysaccharide is added into acrylic acid pressure-sensitive adhesive as a natural antioxidant and a physical crosslinking agent, a hydrogen bond network is formed by utilizing the hydroxyl of the polysaccharide and the carboxyl of polyacrylic acid, and the medical adhesive tape is prepared by coating the adhesive on a PE release film or paper substrate and compounding non-woven fabrics or cotton cloth.

title_en: Self-repairing crease-resistant shirt fabric and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-repairing crease-resistant shirt fabric and a preparation process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fabrics, wherein epsilon-caprolactone and bis (2-hydroxyethyl) disulfide are reacted under the action of a catalyst, a solvent is removed by distillation after the reaction, precipitate is collected, the precipitate is dried to obtain polycaprolactone diol containing disulfide bonds, the polycaprolactone diol is dispersed in the solvent, and diphenylmethane diisocyanate and the catalyst are added for mixed reaction to obtain isocyanate-terminated prepolymer; mixing the isocyanate group end-capped prepolymer with 1, 4-butanediol, adding titanium carbide nanosheet dispersion liquid for reaction, adding an end-capping agent for end capping and defoaming to obtain shape memory polyurethane spinning solution, spinning the spinning solution to form shape memory polyurethane fibers, and finally compounding the shape memory polyurethane fibers on cotton fibers, and weaving to obtain the polyurethane fiber. The fabric provided by the invention adopts a synergistic mechanism of photo-thermal triggering-shape memory recovery-disulfide bond self-repairing, and has excellent crease resistance and self-repairing performance.

title_en: Weather-resistant ABS dyeing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather-resistant ABS dyeing material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ABS materials. The method comprises the steps of preparing an epoxy modified hindered amine silane intermediate through an epoxy-amine addition reaction, introducing a benzotriazole ultraviolet absorbent into a polymerizable double bond to prepare a light stable functional monomer, fixing an ultraviolet absorption unit, a hindered amine light stable unit and a silane unit on a polymethyl methacrylate molecular chain in a chemical bond mode, compounding with nano titanium dioxide, performing hydrophobic modification to obtain light stable functional particles, coating the pigment with silicon dioxide and performing epoxy modification to obtain a coated modified pigment, and uniformly mixing and melt-blending the ABS resin, the light stable functional particles, the coated modified pigment and an antioxidant to obtain the weather-resistant ABS dye.

title_en: Preparation method of microcapsule/epoxy resin flame-retardant composite material with multilayer core-shell structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a microcapsule/epoxy resin flame-retardant composite material with a multilayer core-shell structure, which aims to solve the technical problem that the flame-retardant performance and smoke suppression effect of epoxy resin are to be improved. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly, ball-milling and mixing potassium bicarbonate and magnesium hydroxide to obtain inorganic nano mixed powder, secondly, performing ultrasonic dispersion on the inorganic nano mixed powder, polyethylene glycol and triethylene tetramine to obtain a water phase, emulsifying and dispersing the water phase in the oil phase, adding a TPC solution to perform interfacial polymerization reaction to obtain polyamide coated microcapsules, thirdly, coating phosphorus-containing flame-retardant wall materials on the polyamide coated microcapsules, fourthly, constructing silicon dioxide wall materials, and fifthly, preparing the microcapsule/epoxy resin flame-retardant composite material with the multilayer core-shell structure. After the microcapsule is introduced into epoxy resin, the flame retardant property of the composite material is obviously improved, the vertical combustion test reaches V-0 level, the limiting oxygen index can reach 27%, and the heat release rate and the total smoke yield are obviously reduced.

title_en: Photo-crosslinkable copolyesters and process for obtaining them by post-functionalization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for functionalizing a copolyester of glycerol and dicarboxylic acid monomers comprising the steps of a) contacting glycerol with a copolyester of dicarboxylic acid monomers and a cross-linking agent of the itaconic acid class selected from itaconic acid, itaconic anhydride and mixtures thereof, b) heating the mixture obtained from step a) in the presence of a stabilizer for a time sufficient to form a photo-crosslinkable functionalized copolyester, c) cooling and recovering the photo-crosslinkable functionalized copolyester.
