The invention also relates to a photocrosslinkable copolyester, in particular a photocrosslinkable copolyester obtainable by the process, to a photocrosslinkable composition comprising said photocrosslinkable copolyester, to a crosslinked copolyester obtainable by crosslinking (advantageously photocrosslinking), and to the use thereof.

title_en: Reinforced and toughened polylactic acid composite material prepared from bio-based modified calcium carbonate powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced and toughened polylactic acid composite material prepared from bio-based modified calcium carbonate powder and a preparation method thereof, which adopts bio-based fatty diacid to modify the calcium carbonate powder, and then grafting the bio-based epoxy compound on the surface of the carboxylated calcium carbonate powder to prepare the bio-based modified calcium carbonate cross-linking agent. Subsequently, carboxylated calcium carbonate powder and a biobased modified calcium carbonate crosslinking agent are added to the polylactic acid and And the high-strength high-toughness degradable polylactic acid composite material is prepared by blending, melting and extruding. The prepared polylactic acid composite material has simple system components, effectively reduces compatibility conflict, realizes high strength, high toughness and quick degradation, greatly reduces production cost, and can be applied to the fields of agricultural films, foods, packaging, medical treatment and the like.

title_en: Self-extinguishing catalyst system for propylene polymerization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a catalyst system for the polymerization of polyolefin, preferably polypropylene, based polymers comprising one or more ziegler-natta procatalyst compositions, one or more internal donors, one or more cocatalysts, preferably aluminum containing cocatalysts, one or more external donors comprising a mixture of one or more Selectivity Control Agents (SCA), one or more Activity Limiting Agents (ALA), wherein said Activity Limiting Agents (ALA) are compounds according to formula (I), wherein R  1  and R  2  are independently selected from substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, alkenyl, aryl, aralkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxycarbonyl, linear or branched chain of alkylaryl groups, wherein R  3  is a substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, alkenyl, aryl, aralkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxycarbonyl or alkylaryl group having 1-10 carbon atoms, or R  3  is represented by-O-R  4  -O-or-O-  4  -, wherein R  4  is selected from substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, alkenyl, aryl, linear or branched chain of alkyl, alkenyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylaryl group having 1-10 carbon atoms. Formula (I)

title_en: UPE carbon fiber composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a UPE carbon fiber composite material and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of carbon fibers and are prepared from the following components, by weight, 55-75 parts of UPE resin powder, 8-12 parts of modified carbon fibers, 3-7 parts of chopped carbon fibers, 0.5-0.8 part of pearl powder, 1-2.5 parts of polyethylene micro powder wax, 1.2-1.8 parts of maleic anhydride grafted polyethylene, 1-1.5 parts of light stabilizer 2020, 0.2-0.5 part of volcanic mud micro powder and 0.2-0.5 part of composite antioxidant. By arranging the modified carbon fibers with three lengths and the chopped carbon fibers with three lengths, the fibers with different lengths are mutually overlapped and stacked, the chopped carbon fibers fill micropores in a resin matrix and gaps among the modified fibers, so that the defects of pores in a material are reduced, a large number of microcosmic concave-convex gully structures are etched on the surface of the modified carbon fibers, the grafting load of KH-570 silane coupling agent on the surface of the fibers is obviously improved, and the industrial problems that the compatibility of the carbon fibers and ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene is poor and the interface is easy to debond and peel are solved.

title_en: Polyacrylonitrile/sodium methallyl sulfonate hollow fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyacrylonitrile/sodium methacrylate hollow fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing acrylonitrile, sodium methacrylate, azodiisobutyronitrile and a solvent for polymerization to obtain an acrylonitrile/sodium methacrylate copolymer, and carrying out dry-wet spinning on the acrylonitrile/sodium methacrylate copolymer through a single C-shaped porous spinneret plate to obtain the hollow fiber, wherein the molar ratio of the sodium methacrylate to the acrylonitrile is 2% -4%, the acrylonitrile accounts for 25% -33% of the total mass of the acrylonitrile and the solvent, the inner diameter of the single C-shaped porous spinneret plate is 0.7-1.2mm, the outer diameter is 0.8-1.3mm, the slit width is 0.16-0.20 mm, the pore number is 40-60, and the air layer height in the dry-wet spinning process is 3-5mm. The method can be used for preparing the hollow fiber by dry-wet spinning of the acrylonitrile/sodium methacrylate copolymer through a single C-shaped porous spinneret plate.

title_en: Super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plugging sealing materials, and relates to a super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material comprises a base material system, a modified functional filler system and a composite auxiliary agent system, wherein the base material system comprises 65.8-98.3 parts of amino-terminated polyether modified polyurea prepolymer, 8.2-15.7 parts of active diluent, the modified functional filler system comprises 12.5-26.9 parts of silicon carbide micro powder subjected to composite modification by nano silicon dioxide and montmorillonite, and the composite auxiliary agent system comprises 1.2-3.8 parts of super-hydrophobic modifier, 0.9-2.7 parts of high Wen Oulian parts of foam inhibitor compatibilizer, 0.5-1.9 parts of foam inhibitor and 0.3-1.1 part of gel inhibitor. The invention effectively solves the technical problems of poor temperature resistance, insufficient adhesion in complex environment, easy foaming in underwater construction and the like of the traditional polyurea material, and has wide engineering application value.

title_en: Extraction method of astragalus polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extraction method of astragalus polysaccharide, which comprises the steps of adding purified water into astragalus powder to fully moisten the astragalus powder, then adopting a tunnel microwave dryer to carry out microwave irradiation treatment on the moistened astragalus powder, extracting the astragalus powder subjected to microwave irradiation by using water, controlling the extraction temperature at 35-75 ℃, filtering the extracting solution after the extraction is finished, and carrying out low-temperature concentration and ethanol precipitation to obtain the astragalus polysaccharide. The invention adopts the microwave-water extraction combined technology, and the water molecules in the astragalus cells are heated by microwaves, so that the temperature in the cells is quickly increased, the cells are gasified instantly, the cell walls of cellulose are burst, the content (astragalus polysaccharide) is easy to release, the water extraction method is carried out at a lower temperature, the Maillard reaction is effectively prevented, and the biological activity of the astragalus polysaccharide is better maintained.

title_en: Thermally conductive silicone composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermally conductive silicone composition which can form a cured product having stability even in a low-temperature environment. A thermally conductive silicone composition comprising (A) an organopolysiloxane having 2 or more silicon atoms to which an aliphatic unsaturated hydrocarbon group is bonded in the molecule, (B) an organopolysiloxane having 1 silicon atom to which an aliphatic unsaturated hydrocarbon group is bonded in the molecule, (C) an organohydrogen polysiloxane having 2 or more SiH groups in the molecule, (D) an organosilane R  1   a Si(OR 2 ) 4‑a  represented by the following general formula (1) & gt (1) (wherein R  1  is a monovalent hydrocarbon group, R  2  is an alkyl group or a cycloalkyl group, and a is a number of 1 to 3; E) a platinum group metal catalyst, (F) a reaction control agent, (G) an inorganic filler having an average particle diameter of 3 [ mu ] m or less, and (H) an inorganic filler having an average particle diameter of more than 3 [ mu ] m and 150 [ mu ] m or less.

title_en: Continuous slurry preparation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a continuous slurry preparation device, which comprises a slurry preparation tank, wherein a powder inlet at the top of the slurry preparation tank is connected with a PTA feed pipe, the bottom of the slurry preparation tank is connected with a slurry conveying screw pump and a slurry output pipe, a spray column is installed at the top of the slurry preparation tank, the top of the spray column is connected with an air inlet of a cyclone separator, the top of the cyclone separator is connected with an induced draft fan, and a bottom outlet of the cyclone separator is connected with a backflow port at the top of the slurry preparation tank; the spraying column is sequentially provided with an ethylene glycol spray head and a catalyst spray head from top to bottom, the lower end of the spraying column is inserted into the inner cavity of the slurry preparation tank and is connected with a liquid distributor, the top of the middle section of the liquid distributor is communicated with the lower port of the spraying column and symmetrically extends along the radial direction of the slurry preparation tank, the vertical section of the liquid distributor is rhombic, the lower parts of the two ends of the liquid distributor are closed, and the lower end of the liquid distributor is provided with a strip-shaped discharge port. The continuous slurry preparation device has the advantages of less raw material loss, good slurry mixing uniformity and no environmental pollution.

title_en: Composite structure has oil tank from closing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil tank with a composite structure and a self-sealing function, which comprises a protective framework layer, a self-sealing layer and a barrier layer which are sequentially arranged from outside to inside; the self-sealing layer is formed on the inner surface of the protective framework layer by curing liquid rubber through a rotational molding process, and the barrier layer is formed on the inner surface of the self-sealing layer through a rotational molding process; or the self-sealing layer is independently cured and molded by adopting liquid rubber, is tightly attached to the outer surface of the barrier layer through the elasticity of the self-sealing layer, and finally the protective framework layer is molded on the outer surface of the self-sealing layer. The self-sealing layer of the oil tank of the utility model is not easy to fall off, thus greatly improving the self-sealing effect; the elastic holes in the protective framework layer and the blocking layer have certain self-contraction characteristics, the size of the elastic hole is smaller than that of the elastic piece, the elastic hole is smooth and has no petal-shaped flanging, and deformation recovery of the elastic hole of the self-sealing layer is less obstructed; the self-sealing layer is arranged between the protective framework layer and the barrier layer, and is not directly subjected to external scraping, impact, illumination and washing of internal oil, so that the service life is longer.

title_en: Preparation equipment of female silk of antibiotic dacron DTY
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a preparation method of antibiotic dacron DTY female silk, including esterifying the jar, constituting the last pulping tank of esterifying the jar bottom wall, (mixing) shaft and drive the actuating mechanism that the (mixing) shaft rotates, lower esterifying the jar and being equipped with the electric heater, the part that the (mixing) shaft is located lower esterifying the jar is equipped with the gas outlet, the (mixing) shaft links together with the helium source through the loose joint, the last pulping tank is inserted liquid suction pipe, liquid suction pipe external water conservancy diversion hose, the end of water conservancy diversion hose communicates lower esterifying the jar, the water conservancy diversion hose is equipped with the oil-well pump, be equipped with the first stirring leaf that is arranged in last pulping tank and be arranged in the second stirring leaf that esterifies down the jar on the (mixing; the upper part of the lower esterification tank is provided with an air outlet pipe, and the bottom of the lower esterification tank is provided with a material discharge pipe. The utility model provides a can be with making beating and the integrated preparation equipment of going on in a reation kettle of antibiotic dacron DTY female silk of esterifying, solved the big problem of equipment occupation space in the female silk preparation process of current antibiotic dacron DTY.

title_en: Be used for supplementary extraction equipment of hot pepper polysaccharide supersound
abstract_en: The utility model provides a be used for supplementary equipment of extracting of hot pepper polysaccharide supersound, this equipment includes: ultrasonic wave extractor and pot-type concentrator, the hot pepper leftover bits after smashing draw the back through the ultrasonic wave extractor, and the extract passes through the sack filter, flows into the pot-type concentrator again, and the concentrated circulating pump is being connected to the bottom exit of pot-type concentrator, and the concentrated circulating pump is heated in constantly pouring into concentrated circulation heater with the extract, and it is internal that the extract that makes to be heated returns the jar from the upper portion of pot-type concentrator again.

title_en: Rainwater grate prepared from composite material
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rain grate prepared by composite material, which comprises a rain grate seat with a 'gamma' structure, wherein the vertical mounting surface of the rain grate seat is provided with a first hole for rainwater to flow in, and the horizontal mounting surface of the rain grate seat is provided with a second hole for mounting a rain grate cover; the edge of the bottom of the rainwater grate cover is enclosed to form a cavity, the first rib plates which are distributed in a crossed mode are arranged in the cavity, the second hole is internally provided with a flange for supporting the edge of the bottom of the rainwater grate cover, when the rainwater grate cover is embedded into the second hole, the edge of the bottom of the rainwater grate cover is abutted against the flange, the second rib plates are arranged at the bottom of the horizontal mounting surface of the rainwater grate seat, and the second rib plates are vertically abutted against the inner side surfaces of the flanges. The floor is arranged in the bottom of the rainwater grate cover and the bottom of the horizontal mounting surface of the rainwater grate base, so that the strength of the rainwater grate cover is improved, the size of the rainwater grate cover can be increased, when the rainwater grate cover faces a large sewer inlet, the integrated rainwater grate cover is directly adopted, and the installation of splicing of a plurality of rainwater grates is not required.

title_en: Device for producing low-density polyethylene
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of low-density polyethylene production equipment, in particular to a device for producing low-density polyethylene, which has simple structure and convenient use, and comprises a reactor, a support seat and a cooling barrel, wherein the middle part of the upper end of the reactor is provided with a feed pipe, the middle part of the lower end is provided with a discharge pipe, the support seat comprises a base and a support plate, the support plate is fixedly arranged at the middle part of the upper end of the base, the cooling barrel is arranged at the middle part of the upper end of the right side of the support plate, a fixed block is fixedly arranged between the rear wall of the cooling barrel and the front wall of the support plate, the middle part of the upper end of the cooling barrel is provided with a placing through hole, the lower end of the reactor passes through the placing through hole and extends into the cooling barrel, the lower end of the discharge pipe passes through the discharge through hole, the middle part of the upper end of the left side of the support plate is fixedly provided with a cooling water circulator, a cooling pipe is fixedly arranged between the water inlet and the water outlet of the cooling circulator, the side wall of the cooling pipe passing through the support plate and the cooling barrel extends into the cooling barrel, and the middle part of the cooling pipe is wound and fixed on the inner wall of the cooling barrel.

title_en: Degradable medical film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a degradable medical film, which is of a multilayer structure, the multilayer structure comprises at least one AB type composite structure arranged by alternate coating, the AB type composite structure is a structure formed by compounding a supporting layer and an adhesive layer, and the outermost layer of the film is respectively a supporting layer and an adhesive layer; wherein the coating directions of the adjacent coated supporting layer and the adhesive layer are different. The utility model provides a medical film is through two kinds of composite component of cross coating AB, and the supporting role of A component all obtains strengthening with the tissue adhesion effect of B component, and degradation time is controllable, according to different use position and clinical demand, adjusts the degradation cycle. The base materials with different molecular weights can be selected according to different use parts and different requirements on the strength of the sealing film; and the use is convenient, the traditional sewing fixation is not needed, and the effect of instant effect is achieved. Can be gradually degraded, absorbed and metabolized without removing the sealing film.

title_en: Multifunctional reaction equipment is used in production of bio-based polyester polyol
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a biobased polyester response device technical field, concretely relates to biobased polyester polyol production is with multi-functional response device, including biobased polyester response mechanism, biobased polyester response mechanism includes biobased polyester reaction main part, the inside top fixed mounting of biobased polyester reaction main part has the motor, the one end fixed mounting of motor has the bull stick, the one end fixed mounting of bull stick has the lantern ring. The utility model discloses a be provided with the bull stick, the lantern ring, the stirring rake, first bracing piece, second bracing piece and first spring, the staff adds the raw materials to the inside of biobased polyester reaction main part, it is rotatory that the motor is rotatory to drive the stirring rake through the bull stick and the lantern ring to stir the raw materials, because vibrations, the one end of first bracing piece is to the inside shrink of second bracing piece, make first spring produce elasticity, cushion the device, the production efficiency of device has been increased, staff's use experience has been promoted.

title_en: Resistant starch production is with annular jet stream crushing drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an annular jet airflow crushing and drying device for producing resistant starch, which comprises a runway-shaped annular pipeline vertically arranged, wherein one side of the bottom of the annular pipeline is provided with a material inlet, the bottom of the other side of the annular pipeline is provided with a plurality of hot air inlets, and cavities at the upper parts of the hot air inlets form crushing cavities; the material inlet is communicated with a hopper through a pipeline, and one side of the hopper far away from the material inlet is communicated with a hot air inlet through a pipeline; the hot air inlet and the hot air inlet are both communicated with a hot air supply device; a grading regulator is arranged on the outer side of the top of the annular pipeline on the same side of the hopper; the inside of the top of the annular pipeline on the same side of the hopper is inwards sunken to form a separation cavity, the top of the separation cavity is provided with a vortex nozzle, and the bottom of the separation cavity is provided with a material outlet. The utility model has compact structure, simple structure and low abrasion because of no transmission part, can realize the crushing and drying of the resistant starch with 80 percent of moisture content, and meets the production requirement of RS3 type resistant starch drying.

title_en: Clear resin lens of printing opacity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clear light-transmitting resin lens, which comprises a substrate formed by curing resin, wherein a convex side of the substrate is provided with a central viewing area surface and a peripheral viewing area surface at the edge; a hard layer arranged on the surface of the central vision area; a 1.49 refractive index film layer plated on the hard layer; 1.67 refractive index film layer plated on the 1.49 refractive index film layer; a cellulose triacetate layer coated on the film layer with the refractive index of 1.67; a metallic silver ion layer ion-exchanged in the cellulose triacetate layer; and a nano liquid glass layer sprayed on the peripheral visual area surface. According to the utility model, the 1.49 refractive index film layer is matched with the 1.67 refractive index film layer, so that the high and low refraction is realized, the light transmission is enhanced, and meanwhile, the metal silver ion layer is antibacterial, so that the troubles of unclear lens and poor light transmission in the prior art are avoided.

title_en: Acrylic resin preparation facilities
abstract_en: The utility model provides an acrylic resin preparation device which comprises an acidification reaction kettle, a waste acid recycling system, a centrifugal kettle, a monomer mixing kettle, a modification reaction kettle and a polymerization reaction kettle. The utility model aims to provide an efficient and environment-friendly acrylic resin preparation device which integrates functions of acidification, modification, polymerization and the like.

title_en: Low-temperature nitrogen charging device of SEMI quartz electrode
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quartz electrodes, in particular to a low-temperature nitrogen charging device of a SEMI quartz electrode, which enables the quartz electrode to be cooled more uniformly in the low-temperature environment in a tank body, improves the cooling effect in the device, improves the use efficiency and the use effect of the device, and improves the practicability; nitrogen gas storehouse and cooling storehouse are installed respectively to the bottom of the jar body, the workstation is installed to the bottom in nitrogen gas storehouse and cooling storehouse, the right-hand member intercommunication in nitrogen gas storehouse is provided with first pipeline, first pipeline is fixed in the inside in cooling storehouse, the right-hand member in cooling storehouse is installed the air pump and is communicated with the right-hand member of first pipeline, the output intercommunication of air pump is provided with the second pipeline, the top intercommunication of second pipeline is provided with the third pipeline, the third pipeline is installed at the inside top region of the jar body, be provided with the ventilation net on the fixed axle, the left end that is located jar body left end rotation axis is provided with the rotary disk, the rotary disk is installed on the lateral wall of the jar body.

title_en: Flexible net silica gel protection film
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of protective films, in particular to a flexible grid silica gel protective film. The silica gel protective film comprises a first composite layer, a using layer and a second composite layer which are arranged in sequence; the first composite layer comprises a first antistatic coating (1), a first base material layer (2) and a second antistatic coating (3) which are sequentially arranged; the using layer comprises a silica gel gridding glue layer (4) containing antistatic particles; the silica gel grid adhesive layer (4) is attached to the second anti-static coating (3); the second composite layer comprises a third antistatic coating (5), a second base material layer (6), an acrylic adhesive layer (7), a third base material layer (8) and a fourth antistatic coating (9) which are sequentially arranged; the third antistatic coating (5) is attached to the silica gel grid adhesive layer (4). The utility model discloses flexible net silica gel protection film is very soft, and the laminating effect is splendid, has advantages such as exhaust effect is excellent, antistatic, dyestripping voltage is little simultaneously.

title_en: Reation kettle is used in polypropylene preparation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction kettle for preparing polypropylene, which comprises a polypropylene reaction kettle main body and a sampling mechanism; sampling mechanism installs on the lateral wall of polypropylene reation kettle main part, sampling mechanism includes the sampling tube, sampling tube fixedly connected with closing plate one, sliding on the closing plate one is equipped with movable rod one, the one end that the movable rod is located the sampling tube is connected with plugging plate one, be connected with plugging block one on the plugging plate one, be equipped with sampling hole one on the closing plate one, a plugging block is in sampling hole one, be connected with the limiting plate on the lateral wall that the movable rod one is located the sampling tube. The utility model discloses a setting of corresponding mechanism can carry out nimble sampling to the polymer in the polypropylene reation kettle to the staff masters the reaction situation of polypropylene polymer at any time, guarantees that the polypropylene polymer can react according to expecting, and then can guarantee the production quality of polypropylene, reduces producer's economic loss.

title_en: Humic acid production system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a humic acid production technical field specifically is a humic acid production system. Humic acid production system, including negative pressure loading attachment, negative pressure loading attachment is connected with one-level hoisting device through the rubbing crusher, one-level hoisting device passes through the second grade hoisting device and links to each other with the feed bin, the feed bin passes through the auger and links to each other with the batching jar, the batching jar links to each other with reation kettle through the activation cauldron, reation kettle passes through the heat sink and links to each other with solid-liquid separator, solid-liquid separator links to each other with drying device. This system is through the recovery processing to spent acid in the production, with its add activation cauldron once more, not only reduced the handling capacity of spent acid, but also promoted the utilization ratio of acid, be favorable to industrial production.

title_en: Anionic polyacrylamide copolymerization reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anionic polyacrylamide copolymerization reaction kettle which comprises a reaction kettle body, wherein the top of the reaction kettle body is covered with a kettle cover, two sides of the bottom of the kettle cover are respectively and movably connected with a first transmission rod and a second transmission rod through sealing bearings, a motor is installed at the axis of the outer wall of the top of the kettle cover through bolts, and the output end of the motor is in transmission connection with a driving gear through a coupling. The novel design of the mixing frame is a rectangular frame-shaped structure, two mixing plates distributed in an inclined structure are welded in the mixing frame, a plurality of guide plates distributed in an equidistant vertical inclined structure are welded on the inner walls of the two sides of the mixing frame, and the uniformity of mixing of the anionic polyacrylamide copolymerization raw materials can be effectively improved in the rotating process of the mixing frame, so that the condition of uneven mixing of the anionic polyacrylamide copolymerization raw materials caused by stirring and mixing of stirring blades is avoided.

title_en: Schisandra chinensis polysaccharide extraction element
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a schisandra polysaccharide extraction device, which comprises an extractor and an extraction cylinder arranged at the upper side of the extractor, wherein a filter paper inner cylinder is arranged at the middle inner position of the upper side of the extraction cylinder, a condensation cylinder is arranged at the upper side of the extraction cylinder, a condensation pipe is arranged at the middle inner side of the condensation cylinder, a condensate water outlet is arranged at the outer position of the left upper side of the condensation cylinder, an operator can extract extracting solution from the extraction cylinder to the extractor when siphon effect occurs, when the extracting solution is not completely extracted, a connecting magnet at the outer part of the left upper side of a rubber pipe and a connecting magnet at the outer part of the right lower side of the extraction cylinder can be stripped, U-shaped pipes at the front end and the rear end of the section and a rubber pipe are inclined towards the rear side or the front side, the siphon level is reduced, the height of the condensation cylinder is adjusted, so that residual extracting solution in the extraction cylinder is completely led into the extractor through a return pipe, the effect of extracting solution loss rate is reduced.

title_en: Antibacterial finishing paint for TPU substrate
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of finishing paint, and particularly relates to an antibacterial finishing paint for a TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) substrate, which comprises a TPU substrate, wherein an epoxy resin layer, a nano coating, an epoxy resin layer, a skin-friendly coating and the like are sequentially sprayed on the surface of the TPU substrate. The epoxy resin has high adhesion to various substances due to the existence of the inherent polar hydroxyl and ether bond in the molecular chain, has low shrinkage when being cured, generates small internal stress, is favorable for improving the adhesion strength, has good tension and prevents cracking, so that the nano coating and the skin-friendly coating can be effectively prevented from cracking, and meanwhile, the skin-friendly coating is porous; the epoxy resin layer between the skin-friendly coating and the nano coating is arranged in a porous way, so that the antibacterial property of the nano coating can be effectively promoted, and in addition, the skin-friendly coating is beneficial to skin-friendly.

title_en: Deodorizing and purifying device for preparing hydroxyl silicone oil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deodorizing and purifying device for preparing hydroxyl silicone oil, which comprises a first purifying tank and a second purifying tank, wherein a heating jacket is arranged at the outer side of the first purifying tank at intervals, a nitrogen conveying pipe is arranged on the first purifying tank, a partition plate is arranged in the first purifying tank, a plurality of distributing holes are uniformly distributed and processed on the partition plate, a feeding pipe and an exhaust pipe are arranged at the top of the first purifying tank, a condenser, a vacuum pump and a recycling tank are sequentially connected on the exhaust pipe, an inner filtering tank is arranged in the second purifying tank, a material guide pipe is arranged at the top of the inner filtering tank, a driving mechanism in transmission connection with the material guide pipe is arranged at the top of the second purifying tank, a communicating pipe is arranged at the bottom of the first purifying tank, an outlet of the communicating pipe is inserted in the material guide pipe, and a material discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the second purifying tank. The device not only can heat and purify the reaction material of the hydroxyl silicone oil, but also can remove impurities and filter the reaction material after the deodorization and purification.

title_en: Heparin sodium processing device capable of rapidly removing impurities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heparin sodium processing device capable of rapidly removing impurities, which belongs to the technical field of heparin sodium processing and adopts the technical scheme that the heparin sodium processing device comprises an impurity removing cylinder and a feeding port, wherein an impurity removing and discharging mechanism is arranged in the middle of the impurity removing cylinder, a high-temperature impurity removing mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the impurity removing cylinder, the impurity removing and discharging mechanism comprises a blanking pipe, a storage tank, a rotating shaft, a motor, a roller, stirring blades, a filter screen, an impurity removing cover, a discharging port, an electric telescopic rod and a blocking plate, and when the heparin sodium processing device is used, heparin sodium raw materials enter the inside of the impurity removing cylinder through the feeding port, the speed of heparin sodium passing through the filter screen can be accelerated through the impurity removing and filtering mechanism, the filtered impurities can be rapidly discharged and cleaned, the heparin sodium in the impurity removing cylinder can be heated through the high-temperature impurity removing mechanism, and moisture and bacteria in the heparin sodium can be subjected to impurity removing treatment.

title_en: Embryo equipment is carried to maize starch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of embryo extraction equipment, in particular to corn starch embryo extraction equipment which improves the dust removal and screening effects during corn starch processing, improves the processing quality of corn starch and improves embryo extraction efficiency; the corn germ separating device comprises a tank body, a valve, a separating device, a crushing device, a dust removing device, a storage box, a dust removing box and a feeding hopper, wherein the valve is communicated with the bottom end of the tank body, the separating device is communicated with the storage box, the separating device is used for separating corn germs, the dust removing box is communicated with the air inlet of the tank body, the feeding hopper is communicated with the upper part of the outer side of the dust removing box, the dust removing device is arranged in the dust removing box and used for dust removing corn raw materials, and the crushing device is arranged in the tank body and used for crushing the corn raw materials.

title_en: Ultrasonic-assisted tea bran polysaccharide double-aqueous-phase extraction device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of double-water-phase extraction, and discloses an ultrasonic-assisted tea bran polysaccharide double-water-phase extraction device, which comprises a screw rod linear module for driving an ultrasonic transducer to move up and down and a rotary cylinder for driving an extraction container to switch back and forth between an extraction station and a cleaning station, wherein the extraction container is positioned at the extraction station when being vertically aligned with the ultrasonic transducer, the ultrasonic transducer is driven to move downwards and be inserted into a tea bran-loaded sample in the extraction container by the action of the screw rod linear module, and the extraction efficiency of the tea bran sample is enhanced by the high-frequency vibration of ultrasonic waves. Automatic control components such as a screw rod linear module and a rotary cylinder are adopted, so that automatic up-and-down movement of an ultrasonic transducer and automatic rotation and station switching of an extraction container are realized, the automation degree of operation is greatly improved, and the complexity of manual operation is reduced.

title_en: Panel with local three-dimensional textures
abstract_en: The application relates to a panel with local three-dimensional textures, which structurally comprises a substrate layer, wherein the substrate layer is at least provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite in the thickness direction, the first surface is an external facing, a UV anti-dazzle texture layer is arranged on the external facing, the second surface is an attachment surface, a first coloring layer, a local UV color printing layer or a local UV color printing layer, a first UV texture layer or a UV three-dimensional texture layer and a second coloring layer are sequentially arranged on the attachment surface from inside to outside.

title_en: Anion exchange membranes based on polymerization of long chain alpha olefins
abstract_en: Described herein are cationic polymers having a plurality of quaternary amino groups, methods of making such polymers, and uses of such polymers as ion exchange membranes in electrochemical devices.

title_en: Thermoplastic resin composition and molded product using the same
abstract_en: A thermoplastic resin composition includes: 100 parts by weight of a base resin including (A) ≥ 35 wt% to ≤ 55 wt% of an acrylic graft copolymer; (B) ≥ 35 wt% to ≤ 55 wt% of an aromatic vinyl-vinyl cyanide copolymer; and (C) ≥ 2 wt% to ≤ 15 wt% of an alkyl(meth)acrylate-based resin; (D) ≥ 0.4 parts by weight to ≤ 2 parts by weight of a first sterically hindered amine represented by Chemical Formula 1 described in the detailed description; and (E) ≥ 0.4 parts by weight to ≤ 2 parts by weight of a second sterically hindered amine represented by Chemical Formula 2 described in the detailed description.

title_en: Absorbent article comprising an adhesive composition
abstract_en: Described herein is an absorbent article. The absorbent article includes an assembly of components and an adhesive composition joining at least two of the assembly of components together. The adhesive composition includes from about 70 wt. % to about 90 wt. % of one or more copolymers and from about 10 wt. % to about 30 wt. % of one or more heterophase copolymers. The one or more copolymers include from about 30 mole % to about 70 mole % of monomer units selected from ethylene, 1-butene, and mixtures thereof. The one or more copolymers also include from about 30 mole % to about 70 mole % of propene monomer units. The adhesive composition is free of polyisobutylene and has a viscosity of from about 2,000 mPa-s to about 11,500 mPa-s at 150 °C.

title_en: Absorbent article comprising an adhesive composition
abstract_en: Described herein is an absorbent article having a longitudinal centerline and a lateral centerline, a front waist region with a front waist edge, a rear waist region with a rear waist edge, a crotch region disposed between the front waist region and the rear waist region, and two spaced apart longitudinal side edges joining the front waist edge to the rear waist edge, wherein the absorbent article comprises an assembly of components, and wherein the absorbent article comprises an adhesive composition. The adhesive composition comprises a copolymer; the adhesive composition has a viscosity of from about 2,000 mPa-s to about 11,500 mPa-s at 150 °C, the adhesive composition has a Storage Modulus at 37 °C of from about 3 MPa to 9.5 MPa, and the adhesive composition has a Yield Stress at 37 °C of from about 0.8 MPa to about 1.45 MPa.

title_en: Anti-fingerprint coatings
abstract_en: To achieve anti-fingerprint properties to decorative surfaces, a novel method for coating a metal substrate with an anti-fingerprint coating is provided. The method comprises the following method steps: (a) providing the metal substrate; (b) providing a silicone coating mixture containing: (i) at least one first silicone compound selected from the group consisting of mono- or oligo(aminoalkyl)-fluoroalkyl silicones; (ii) at least one second silicone compound selected from the group consisting of aminoalkyl silicones; (iii) at least one acidifier; and (iv) water; further (c) treating the metal substrate with the silicone coating mixture by bringing the metal substrate into contact with the silicone coating mixture; and (d) curing the treated metal substrate at a predetermined temperature.

title_en: Epoxy resin composition, prepreg and molded body
Fluid for controlling the permeability of a subterranean formation, and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fluid for controlling the permeability of a subterranean formation comprising an aqueous solution of at least one thermo-responsive polymer with block structure A-B-A', wherein:- A and A', the same as or different from one another, each represent a thermo-responsive oligomer group;- B is an oligomer group comprising n repeat units, the same as or different from one another, wherein: (i) at least one of the repeat units has a solubility of the corresponding monomer, in water at 20°C, equal to or greater than 120 g/l, (ii) n is a whole number within the range 30 –1000. The present invention also relates to a method for controlling the permeability of a subterranean formation in which the aforesaid fluid is used.

title_en: Foam compositions and uses thereof
abstract_en: A pre-foam composition comprising: 5 parts per hundred resin (phr) to 45 phr of an A-B-A block copolymer; 30 to 90 phr of a C 4 -C 100  unsaturated olefin component; and 5 to 50 phr of an ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer having a vinyl acetate content of about 10% to about 45% by weight based upon a total weight of the ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, wherein the ratio of the phr of (a) to (b) ranges from 0.17 to 0.3. Also related compositions, methods, and products, including foam compositions, compression molded foam compositions, sole components (14), and articles of footwear (10).

title_en: Stabilized rotomolded polyolefin
abstract_en: Polyolefin hollow articles prepared via a rotomolding process are provided stability against the deleterious effects of heat, light and oxygen by incorporating therein a hindered amine light stabilizer, an ultraviolet light absorber and a thioether additive.

title_en: Shoe sole or insole having sheet-type coated cork coupled thereto, and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a technique capable of overcoming defects in dynamic strength and wear resistance while incorporating a sheet-type coated cork in a shoe sole or an insole. The present disclosure also relates to a product in which a main-body-coupling opening, which is an empty space, is artificially formed between crushed cork pieces of a sheet-type coated cork, and to a method of manufacturing the same. A sole-type body member, which is a main body of a shoe sole or an insole, is laminated on the sheet-type coated cork, and is then pressed and heated so that a part of the sole-type body member is inserted into the main-body-coupling opening, thereby achieving coupling therebetween.

title_en: Epoxy resin, epoxy resin composition, epoxy resin cured product and composite material
abstract_en: An epoxy resin includes a reaction product between an epoxy compound and a compound having a naphthalene structure and a functional group that is reactive with an epoxy group.

abstract_en:

The ultraviolet curable silicone composition contains:

title_en: Photochromic article
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a photochromic article that includes a substrate and a photochromic layer formed from a curable photochromic composition. The photochromic composition includes a polyol component that includes a polycarbonate diol, an isocyanate component that includes an unblocked polyfunctional isocyanate and/or a blocked polyfunctional isocyanate, and at least one photochromic compound. The equivalents ratio of blocked/unblocked isocyanate equivalents of the isocyanate component to hydroxyl equivalents of the polyol component is at least 5:1. The photochromic article exhibits a T1/2 (Fade Half Life) at 23°C of less than or equal to 70 seconds.

title_en: Process to produce a polymer and polymer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process to produce a polymer, a corresponding polymer and a article comprising a polymer made by the process according to the invention...

title_en: Method for producing a polyoxyalkylene polyester polyol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a polyoxyalkylene polyester polyol by reacting a polyoxyalkylene polyol with a lactone in the presence of a Brønsted acid catalyst, wherein the catalyst has a pKa value of 1 or less; the number-average molar mass of the polyoxyalkylene polyol is ≥ 1000 g/mol, preferably ≥ 1500 g/mol, particularly preferably ≥ 2000 g/mol; and in the lactone a CH2 group is bonded to the ring oxygen. The invention further relates to polyoxyalkylene polyester polyols obtainable using the method according to the invention, and to a method for producing polyurethanes by reacting the polyoxyalkylene polyester polyols according to the invention with polyisocyanates.

title_en: Method for preparing a functionalized polyorganosiloxane
abstract_en: A method for preparing functionalized polyorganosiloxanes is disclosed. The method includes 1) combining starting materials including A) a boron - containing Lewis acid catalyst, and B) an organosilicon compound having an average, per molecule of at least 1 silicon bonded groups of the formula -OR 2 ; wherein each R 2  is an independently selected monovalent hydrocarbon group of 1 to 6 carbon atoms, thereby forming a catalyzed mixture; and thereafter 2) adding the catalyzed mixture into a starting material including C) an organohydrogensiloxane having at least 1 silicon bonded hydrogen atom per molecule, thereby preparing a product comprising the functionalized polyorganosiloxane and a by-product comprising HR 2 .

title_en: Thermoplastic polyurethane hot-melt adhesive and its use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermoplastic polyurethane hot-melt adhesive comprising: a reaction product of (a) an isocyanate; (b) a polyol comprising at least 5 wt% of a polyolefin polyol based on the total weight of the polyol; and (c) a chain extender, wherein the polyolefin polyol comprises an ethylenically unsaturated group. The present invention also relates to a method of preparing a shoe sole assembly using the thermoplastic polyurethane hot-melt adhesive and the use of the thermoplastic polyurethane hot-melt adhesive in the preparation of the shoe sole assembly.

title_en: Active energy ray-curable composition
abstract_en:
An object is to obtain an active energy ray-curable composition which can constitute an active energy ray-curable composition having a higher ratio of biomass-derived raw material, while still maintaining such basic properties as curability, compatibility, adhesion, physical properties of cured product (cured coating film), etc., and which is also superior in that it uses nonedible biomass and thus does not compete with food production and prevents triggering starvation and food shortage problems, and therefore contributes significantly to the creation of a sustainable, recycling-oriented society, and another object is to provide an active energy ray-curable composition which is superior in terms of environmental, safety, and other regulations, because it can be effective without using a polymerization initiator.
