title_en: Thermochromic resin composite material and laminate using the same
abstract_en: To provide a thermochromic resin composite material having high absorbance of visible light at a temperature of 30°C or lower and low absorbance of visible light at a temperature of at least 60°C.SOLUTION: A thermochromic resin composite material comprising 100 parts by mass of a resin composition containing 20 to 95% by mass of an acrylic polymer having a refractive index of 1.46 to 1.65 at 23°C, 4 to 75% by mass of polyvinylidene fluoride having a refractive index of 1.36 to 1.64 at 23°C, and 1 to 40% by mass of an alkyl acrylate having a refractive index of 1.41 to 1.51 at 23°C, and 0.0005 to 0.03 parts by mass of at least one black colorant selected from the group consisting of a black pigment and a black dye with respect to 100 parts by mass of the resin composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polymer, composition, dry film, optical waveguide, photoelectric composite substrate and electronic component
abstract_en: To provide a new polymer capable of reducing warpage of a dry film to be obtained.SOLUTION: The polymer contains a structural unit represented by formula (1) and a norbornene structural unit other than the formula (1). (In Formula (1), a represents an integer of 0 or more and 6 or less, and R11 represents an aryl group) SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Manufacturing method of eco-friendly fragrant EPDM rubber powder and EPDM rubber powder produced thereby
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly aromatic EPDM rubber powder manufacturing method in which harmful substances such as heavy metals, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are not generated at all. According to the present invention, the eco-friendly aromatic EPDM rubber powder manufacturing method comprises: a raw material preparation step in which raw materials for manufacturing EPDM rubber are put into a kneader, blended, and then cooled; a kneading step; an extrusion step of molding the raw materials through an extruder; an automatic continuous vulcanization step; and a grinding step.

title_en: Medium temperature recycled asphalt additives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a medium-temperature cycle asphalt additive for reducing emissions of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and carbon dioxide and a medium-temperature cycle asphalt mixture using the same. More specifically, the medium-temperature cycle asphalt additive for reducing emissions of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and carbon dioxide consists of 10 to 30 wt% of a first mixture, 10 to 30 wt% of a second mixture, 10 to 25 wt% of recycled mineral oil, 1 to 20 wt% of recycled fatty acid, and 5 to 10 wt% of asphalt, 1 to 14 wt% of animal oil, 0.1 to 0.5 wt% of antioxidant, and 0.01 to 4% wt of cellulose. In the present invention, an asphalt mixture can be produced and constructed even at a temperature about 30℃ lower than 160 ℃, which is a general heating asphalt production and construction temperature, by using a medium-temperature additive.

title_en: High viscosty waterproof spray seal material and construction method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-viscosity spray waterproof sealant for flow prevention which comprises: a waste synthetic rubber sheet composition; process oil; new rubber powder; gum resin; an adhesion promoter; a modifier; and an additive, wherein the adhesion promoter includes conchiolin and a composite wall waterproofing construction method using the same. The high-viscosity spray waterproof sealant for flow prevention can form a waterproof layer on a surface of a CIP wall with a waveform by spraying so that the high-viscosity spray waterproof sealant forms a strong adhesive force even on an uneven surface, does not flow easily, and can quickly form a film. Subsequently, when constructing a hybrid composite waterproof sheet, the hybrid composite waterproof sheet can be strongly and stably bonded.

title_en: polyimide composite Film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polyimide composite film in which a primer layer included therein has a thin thickness in the form of an ultra-thin film and at the same time has excellent ion migration resistance and adhesive strength above a certain level so that when used as a raw material for electronic devices, the polyimide composite film can ensure the miniaturization and thinness of the electronic devices and the lifespan and stability of the electronic devices.

title_en: Attachment type fire patch and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an adhesive-type fire extinguishing patch and a manufacturing method thereof. The adhesive-type fire extinguishing patch according to the present invention comprises: a release layer disposed at the bottom; an adhesive layer disposed on the release layer; a nonwoven fabric layer disposed on the adhesive layer; a fire extinguishing layer disposed on the nonwoven fabric layer; and a high humidity protective layer disposed on the fire extinguishing layer. The high humidity protective layer is composed of a mixture of a polyester resin, dioxolane, an acrylic resin, xylene, N-butyl acetate, and toluene. Accordingly, the adhesive fire extinguishing patch can be provided which operates normally in a place with high humidity.

title_en: Rubber composition for tires containing recycled carbon black derived from waste tires
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rubber composition for tires containing recycled carbon black derived from waste tires. More specifically, the present invention relates to a rubber composition for tires containing recycled carbon black derived from waste tires, which replaces recycled carbon black derived from waste tires containing silica and zinc oxide instead of new carbon black in the rubber composition for tires, and improves the physical properties of rubber for waste tires manufactured from the rubber composition by adjusting the content of zinc oxide, an additive, together with a silane coupling agent for crosslinking silica.

title_en: Binder, separator and rechargeable lithium battery including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a binder, a separator comprising the same, and a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. The binder comprises: a first structural unit derived from (meth)acrylic acid, (meth)acrylate, or a salt thereof; a second structural unit derived from hydroxyalkyl (meth)acrylate; and a third structural unit derived from (meth)acrylamidosulfonic acid or a salt thereof.

title_en: High-efficiency Compressor-Reactor Catalyst based ethylene, propane and polymer production system and its operation method
abstract_en: The present invention provides an environmentally friendly ethylene, propane, and polymer production system that improves energy efficiency and simplifies processes by addressing inefficiencies of high-temperature and high-pressure processes, catalyst deactivation, and carbon dioxide emissions. The present invention relates to a compressor-, reactor-, and catalyst-based integrated mixed production system capable of filtering carbon dioxide and hydrogen, mixing and compressing the filtered gases under high temperature and high pressure, synthesizing ethylene gas through a heat exchanger and a catalytic reactor, cooling and liquefying the synthesized ethylene for storage, and producing propane and polymer materials using a portion of the stored ethylene.

title_en: High heat-resistant low-temperature adhesive hot-melt composition and led modules comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high heat-resistant and low-temperature adhesive hot-melt composition and an electric/electronic component comprising the same and, more specifically, to a hot-melt composition comprising polyethylene wax, polypropylene wax, microcrystalline wax, an ethylene-methacrylic acid copolymer (EMA), a hydrogenated styrene-isoprene-styrene block copolymer (SSIS), maleic anhydride-grafted polypropylene (MAPP), nanosilica, an adhesion enhancer, and a heat stabilizer, and particularly having excellent adhesion, heat resistance, cold resistance, and water resistance in a wide temperature range of -40℃ to 200℃, and to an electric/electronic component (particularly, an LED module) comprising the same.

title_en: Multilayer polyimide film for graphite sheet, preparing method thereof and graphite sheet prepared therefrom
abstract_en: Disclosed are a multilayer polyimide film for a graphite sheet, a manufacturing method thereof, and a graphite sheet manufactured therefrom. The multiplayer polyimide film for a graphite sheet comprises: a non-thermoplastic polyimide layer having a thickness of 100 μm or more; and two or more polyimide films including a thermoplastic polyimide layer laminated on one or both surfaces of the non-thermoplastic polyimide layer, wherein the two or more polyimide films are adhesively laminated through the thermoplastic polyimide layer.

title_en: Film for bonding and light transmitting layered product comprising of the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bonding film, a light-transmitting laminate including the same, and the like. The disclosed bonding film includes an embossed surface, wherein the Mr1 value of the embossed surface is equal to or greater than the rev_Mr2 value. The characteristics of the embossed surface of the bonding film and the like are controlled to improve degassing stability, edge sealing properties and the like when forming the light-transmitting laminate.

title_en: Thermoplastic resin composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermoplastic resin composition, which contains an arylene oxide-based polymer; a diene-based rubber graft polymer; an aromatic vinyl-based polymer containing an oxazoline group; and a glycol-based polymer, wherein 5 to 20 wt% of the glycol-based polymer is contained. According to the present invention, it is possible to produce hydrophobic surface-modified silica at low cost through process improvement.

title_en: Transfer pipe leakage liquid spray prvention device
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for preventing scattering of leaking liquid in a transfer pipe. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for preventing scattering of leaking liquid in a transfer pipe comprises: a body formed with a predetermined width and length so as to surround an outer circumferential surface of a transfer pipe joint or the transfer pipe; a liner having a porous structure and arranged to cover at least a portion of an inner side of the body; a leakage detection sensor provided with a conductor whose current value is changed by the leaking liquid of the transfer pipe; a power supply unit for supplying power to the leakage detection sensor; and a communication unit which measures current information flowing through the conductor and transmits it to the outside.

title_en: Conductive polymer composite and fabrication method thereof
abstract_en: A conductive polymer composite with improved conductivity and mechanical properties, is capable of inducing the formation of particle aggregates, by adding particles having higher affinity to a second polymer after forming a dispersed phase of the second polymer in a first polymer that forms a continuous phase. The particle aggregates formed according to the present invention have an aspect ratio with the difference between maximum and minimum values of at least three, and the occupied volume with the difference between maximum and minimum values of at least two, and thereby the mutual contact between the particle aggregates is increased. Thus, the conductivity of the polymer composite can be increased by the network of the particle aggregates.

title_en: Multi purpose complex sheet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-functional composite sheet. Particularly, the present invention relates to a multi-functional composite sheet, which can perform multiple functions by incorporating one or more functional materials to one sheet, can realize a synergic effect through the combination of the effects provided by individual functional materials to maximize the effects of the functional materials, and can be applied to various living goods, such as beddings, heating mats and sitting cushions, as it is, with no separate additional processing, by applying various functional materials efficiently to the sheet. According to the multi-functional composite sheet of the present invention, two or more functional materials are received in one sheet to perform various effects and functions, and a synergic effect is induced from the individual effects generated from each of the functional materials to maximize the health-aid effect. In addition, the multi-functional composite sheet is manufactured in the form of a sheet and can be applied to various living goods with no separate change in the manufacturing process, and thus provides convenience of use.

title_en: Curable resine composition and transparent film prepared by using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a curable resin composition comprising a binder resin comprising at least two kinds of unit structures represented by a specific chemical formula, an epoxy compound, and a solvent, and a transparent film prepared by using the same. According to the present invention, the transparent film can provide excellent permeability, flexibility, and chemical resistance.

title_en: Ehylene acrylic acid copolymer and water-dispersive composition including the same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an ethylene-(meth)acrylic acid copolymer having improved light transmittance and adhesion and an aqueous dispersion composition comprising the same. The ethylene-(meth)acrylic acid copolymer according to embodiments of the present invention can have a content of a part having a melting temperature of 94℃ or higher measured by a successive self-nucleation and annealing (SSA) measurement method of 1.5% or less. The aqueous dispersion composition having high adhesion and transmittance can be prepared by using the ethylene-(meth)acrylic acid copolymer.

title_en: Thermoplastic resin composition, method for preparing the thermoplastic resin composition and molding products prepared therefrom
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermoplastic resin composition, a method for preparing the same, and a molded article including the same. The thermoplastic resin composition according to the present invention includes: a styrene-based copolymer including a (meth)acrylate-based monomer, aromatic vinyl-based monomer and a maleimide-based monomer; a first graft copolymer including an acryl-based rubbery polymer, aromatic vinyl-based monomer and a vinyl cyanide-based monomer; and a second graft copolymer including an acryl-based rubbery polymer, aromatic vinyl-based monomer and a vinyl cyanide-based monomer, wherein the styrene-based copolymer has a residual oligomer content of 0.37 wt% or less, and the acryl-based rubbery polymer of the first graft copolymer has an average particle diameter different from the average particle diameter of the acryl-based rubbery polymer of the second graft copolymer.

title_en: Tire comprising sealant and sound absorbing material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tire including a sealant and sound absorbing material, and to a tire comprising: a sound absorbing material layer located on an inner surface of the tire; a sealant layer located between the inner surface of the tire and the sound absorbing layer; and a film layer located between the sealant layer and the sound absorbing layer. The sound absorbing material layer comprises: a second sound absorbing material layer in contact with the film layer; and a first sound absorbing material layer excluding the second sound absorbing material layer. The tire reduces resonance sound generated by air vibration inside the tire among the tire noises and prevents an accident due to rapid tire contraction in case of tire puncture.

title_en: Elastic anode binder for secondary lithium ion battery
abstract_en: An electrochemical cell is manufactured from a silicon-based negative electrode active material and a polyimide-based binder manufactured by curing polyamic acid with heat and/or a catalyst. A silicon-based material can be silicon suboxide. A negative electrode manufactured by a combination of an elastic polyimide-based binder and a negative electrode active material improves specific capacity, cycle characteristics, and electrical characteristics of a lithium secondary battery.

title_en: Adhesive composition and protective film prepared from the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition and, more specifically, to a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition comprising: a photocurable acrylic copolymer and a urethane-based polymer containing a (meth)acrylate group. The pressure-sensitive adhesive composition according to the present invention makes it possible to form an adhesive layer or a protective film having excellent adhesive durability and reliability even under severe conditions including high temperature and high humidity, while having low adhesiveness.

title_en: Polymer and organic light emitting device using the same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a polymer and an organic light emitting device using the same. The polymer according to an exemplary embodiment of the present specification may be applied to a hole transport layer of the organic light emitting device to improve performance and/or lifetime characteristics of the device.

title_en: Elastic water-proof material composition, water-proof paint and water-proof cement mortar comprising the same, and preparation method of elastic water-proof material composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elastic waterproof agent composition, a waterproof paint and waterproof cement mortar including the same, and a method for manufacturing the elastic waterproof agent composition, wherein the elastic waterproof agent composition includes: a block copolymer including a polyacrylic acid block and a polyisoprene block; a silicate compound; and a carbonate compound.

title_en: Method of manufacturing connector seal with excellent electric resistance and connector seal for military vehicle manufactured therefrom
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a connector seal with excellent electric resistance and a connector seal for a military vehicle manufactured therefrom, and specifically, to a method for manufacturing a connector seal that provides excellent electric resistance performance and excellent physical properties through a combination of fiber and rubber to improve the tensile performance of rubber products inside the equipment in order to minimize impact in military vehicles.

title_en: Method of Manufacturing Coating Solution for Color Contact Lenses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a coating solution for color contact lenses, and more particularly, to a method for manufacturing a coating solution for color contact lenses with improved physical properties such as biocompatibility, tensile strength, and wettability by containing collagen, which is a biomaterial, in a coating layer that comes in direct contact with a wearer's cornea. The method for manufacturing a coating solution for color contact lenses comprises the steps of: pre-processing atelocollagen; preparing an atelocollagen solution containing the pre-processed atelocollagen; preparing a hydroxyethyl methacrylate solution; preparing a mixture by stirring the atelocollagen solution and the hydroxyethyl methacrylate solution; and adding at least one monomer to the mixture and then polymerizing the same to form a coating polymer.

title_en: Optical film, polarizing plate comprising the same and optical display apparatus comprising the same
abstract_en: Provided are: an optical film, which includes a first layer and a second layer laminated on a lower surface of the first layer via a first primer layer, wherein the first primer layer is formed of a composition containing a urethane-based polymer and an isocyanate-based curing agent, wherein the urethane-based polymer includes a repeating unit derived from an alicyclic isocyanate-based compound, and the isocyanate-based curing agent includes an isocyanate-based trimer; a polarizing plate comprising the same; and an optical display apparatus comprising the same.

title_en: Triblock Copolymer, Method of Synthesis thereof and Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells having the same
abstract_en: A triblock copolymer is provided. The triblock copolymer may consist of a compound, which has a 4-cyanopentanoic acid end group or a 2-methylpropionitrile end group, and is represented by PMMA(poly (methyl methacrylate))-b(block)-PEG(poly (ethylene glycol))-b-PMMA. The present invention is to provide a dye-sensitized solar cell having excellent efficiency and long-term stability.

title_en: Method of preparing composition for forming polyimide film and composition for forming polyimide film therefrom and uses thereof
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention is to provide a method for preparing a composition for forming a polyimide film, capable of remarkably improving the dispersibility of a pigment. Specifically, the preparation method includes a step of preparing a polyamic acid resin in the presence of a pigment dispersion containing a blue inorganic pigment and a dispersant. In addition, the average particle size of the inorganic pigment in the pigment dispersion may be 10 to 100 nm.

title_en: Binder Composition for Environmental-friendly Insulating Material and Method for Preparing the Same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a binder composition for an eco-friendly insulating material and a manufacturing method thereof, and more particularly, to a binder composition for an eco-friendly insulating material and a manufacturing method thereof, which are made of food materials containing starch and starch sugar and have excellent properties.

title_en: Colored photosensitive composition, color filter and image display device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a colored photosensitive composition, a color filter and an image display device. The colored photosensitive composition includes a binder resin, a colorant including a first colorant represented by chemical formula 1, a photopolymerizable compound, a photopolymerization initiator including a compound represented by chemical formula 2, and a solvent. A colored pattern with improved pattern stability and color reproducibility is formed through a combination of the first colorant and the photopolymerization initiator.

title_en: Light moisture-curable resin composition having excellent storage stability and curing property
abstract_en: The present invention is a hybrid resin composition which can be dual-cured by light (UV) and moisture, and more specifically, can continuously ensure excellent storage stability by purification of raw materials and use of specific moisture removal additives, and can be cured sufficiently by light curing and moisture curing even in light-shielding areas where UV rays cannot pass through, resulting in high adhesion and high reliability. The hybrid resin composition of the present invention comprises a moisture-curing urethane resin, a photocurable monomer, a photoinitiator, and at least one moisture removal additive containing a formate-based compound.

title_en: Method for manufacturing high molecular dietary fiber or high molecular protein into low molecular dietary fiber or low molecular protein
abstract_en: Provided is a method for reducing the molecular weight of high molecular weight dietary fiber or high molecular weight protein, comprising the steps of a) dissolving high molecular weight dietary fiber or high molecular weight protein in water; b) adding hydrogen peroxide to the high molecular weight dietary fiber or high molecular weight protein solution; c) stirring the solution to which hydrogen peroxide has been added; d) confirming that hydrogen peroxide is not present in the solution; and e) evaporating water from the solution to recover low molecular weight dietary fiber or low molecular weight protein.

title_en: Dual metal-plated credit card
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dual metal plate payment card, which includes: a pair of first and second plates spaced apart from each other and made of metal; a flexible circuit board interposed between the first and second plates and including an integrated circuit (IC) chip and a loop antenna; a pair of first slots and second slots which penetrate each of the first and second plates, are formed at positions which overlap each other, and expose a portion of the loop antenna; and at least one reinforcing material interposed between at least one of the first and second plates and the flexible circuit board and reinforcing rigidity. Therefore, it is possible to suppress the deterioration of RF communication while maintaining a metal material with its unique color and texture.

title_en: A transport tray made of biodegradable plastic
abstract_en: The present invention relates to biodegradable plastics. More specifically, some of the chemical resin raw materials are replaced with natural polymer materials, wherein the natural polymer materials have excellent biodegradation ability by using a chitosan waste powder, which is extracted from chitosan and reprocessed discarded industrial waste, rather than a chitosan extract, are inexpensive yet have excellent mechanical and thermal properties, and are manufactured to be provided as plastic products made of biodegradable plastic that biodegrades in nature without producing harmful substances, specifically, transport trays.

title_en: Easily degradable resin composition and uses using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an easily degradable composite resin composition and a use using the same. The present invention provides an easily degradable composite resin composition, in which, based on 100 parts by weight of a composite resin consisting of a first biodegradable resin of polylactic acid (PLA) and a second biodegradable resin containing polybutylene-adipate-co-terephthalate (PBAT), 0.1 to 2 parts by weight of a low-molecular-weight plasticizer or a compatibilizer of 1 to 5 parts by weight of an acrylic copolymer with epoxy is blended, to be advantageous in complementing physical properties between biodegradable resins, to enhance mechanical properties and processability compared to the use of biodegradable resins alone, and in particular, to improve easy degradability in soil, thereby being useful for being applied to a mulching film made of a non-foamed film molded by extruding the composition and to a seedling container made of a foam sheet molded by foaming the composition.

title_en: Packaging material for battery and secondary battery including the same
abstract_en: A battery packaging material and a secondary battery including the same are provided. The battery packaging material includes: an outer protective layer including a liquid crystal polymer; a sealant layer; and an adhesive layer for joining the outer protective layer and the sealant layer. A secondary battery having high capacity, chemical resistance, and mechanical reliability while omitting a metal layer can be provided.

title_en: Sleeping mattress assembly including hard and thin cushion mat, bed including the same and cushion mat therefor
abstract_en: Provided are a cushion mat capable of providing a comfortable sleeping state while having a thinner thickness than before, a sleeping mattress assembly including the same, and a bed including the same. The mattress assembly comprises: a spring mat including a plurality of springs; and a cushion mat disposed on the spring mat. The cushion mat includes a polymer having a tensile strength of 10.0 MPa to 35.0 MPa, a 100% Modulus of 2.5 MPa to 5.0 MPa, and a Shore A hardness of 50.0 to 80.0.

title_en: Hydrogenated dicyclopentadiene based resin, preparation method thereof, and composition for tackifier or adhesive comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hydrogenated dicyclopentadiene-based resin, which is environmentally friendly and has excellent physical properties such as heat resistance, adhesiveness and the like by containing bio-based raw materials, a manufacturing method thereof, and a composition for an adhesive agent containing the same.

title_en: A rubber composition for tire read and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a rubber composition for a tire tread, which contains: a rubbery polymer; conjugated diene-based liquid rubber; and functionalized processing aids, wherein the functionalized processing aid is a component derived from polyalkylphenyl sulfide, and a manufacturing method thereof. The aim is to provide the rubber composition for tire treads that exhibits excellent mechanical and dynamic properties by improving the dispersibility of a reinforcing agent, and at the same time, has excellent processability, and a manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: Improved water tight connecting structure with protecting ring for coated steel pipe end for water supply
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a water-coated steel pipe connection structure with a double watertight tube end protection ring which improves the hydraulic performance while maintaining watertightness, prevents cross-sectional corrosion, and prevents the coating layer inside the pipe from being damaged by another steel pipe into which the inner covering layer of the steel pipe is inserted. A water-coated steel pipe connection structure comprises: a first coated steel pipe (100) having an expansion unit (110); a second coated steel pipe (200) having an insertion unit (210); a sealing member (300) interposed between the insertion unit (210) inserted into the expansion unit (110) and the expansion unit (110) to firstly form a watertight structure; a coupling assembly (400) pressing the sealing member (300) between the expansion unit (110) and the insertion unit (210) and preventing the expansion unit (110) and the insertion unit (210) from being separated; and a pipe end protection cap (500) formed in a pipe end area of the insertion unit (210) to secondly form the watertight structure.

title_en: Solid electrolyte composition, solid electrolyte formed from the composition and lithium secondary battery including the same electrolyte
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide: a solid electrolyte composition that improves lithium-ion mobility, has excellent ionic conductivity by suppressing crystallization at low temperatures, and having excellent electrochemical stability; and a solid electrolyte formed therefrom. The present invention provides a solid electrolyte composition comprising: an amine-based compound represented by chemical formula 1; a polyfunctional isocyanate; and a lithium salt, wherein the content of the lithium salt is 40-80 parts by weight relative to 100 parts by weight of the amine-based compound. In chemical formula 1, L1 and L2 each independently include at least one selected from a C1-C12 alkylene group or heteroalkylene group, a C3-C16 cycloalkylene group or cycloheteroalkylene group, a C6-C16 arylene group or heteroarylene group, where n is a natural number in the range of 1 to 5000, and m is a natural number in the range of 1 to 200. The solid polymer electrolyte according to the present invention suppresses crystallization, improves the mobility of lithium ions, improves ion conductivity, and has excellent electrochemical stability, which can contribute to improving the stability and output of lithium secondary batteries.

title_en: Road marking paint composition containing graphene oxides
abstract_en: According to the present invention, the polyurea paint for road marking comprises: a first agent containing an aliphatic isocyanate polymer, an aromatic isocyanate polymer, and surface-modified graphene oxide; and a second agent containing an aspartic acid ester-based compound, hydrophobic colloidal silica, titanium dioxide, and dicarboxylic acid.

title_en: Chemical mechanical polishing apparatus
abstract_en: A chemical mechanical polishing apparatus is provided. the chemical mechanical polishing apparatus includes: a rotatable polishing platen including an electromagnet; a lower polishing pad located on the polishing platen, including a first region including a first magnetic material and overlapping the electromagnet, and a second region including a non-magnetic material; an upper polishing pad located on the lower polishing pad, including a second magnetic material and overlapping the first region; and a rotatable polishing head providing a wafer on the upper polishing pad.

title_en: Dicing tape intergrated protecting sheet for semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: A protective film sheet for a dicing tape-integrated semiconductor wafer according to embodiments of the present invention includes: a base film; an adhesive layer disposed on the base film; and a protective film forming layer disposed on the adhesive layer. the adhesive layer may include a resin including an acrylic acid ester monomer and an isocyanate-based compound, and the resin of the adhesive layer may have a glass transition temperature of -46.5 to 0°c. the protective film sheet for a dicing tape-integrated semiconductor wafer according to embodiments of the present invention can improve heat resistance and dicing processability.

title_en: Dry finish acrylic composition for three dimension textured building materials
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an acrylic composition for dry finishing, which applies a three-dimensional texture to a surface finishing layer while being cured as a predetermined time elapses after being applied to a wall surface of a building or the like. According to the present invention, the acrylic composition for dry finishing can form a finishing coating film having excellent durability on a wall surface of a building material, a surface of furniture, and the like, and can easily form a three-dimensional texture such as various natural stones.

title_en: Acid anhydride compound, polyamideimide resin and film using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an acid anhydride compound having a novel structure, a polyamideimide resin prepared therefrom, and a polyamideimide film. Specifically, since the polyamideimide film according to the present invention includes the structural unit derived from the acid anhydride compound, the polyamideimide film may be colorless and transparent, and may have high heat resistance and a low coefficient of thermal expansion.

title_en: Composition for encapsulating organic light emitting diodes and organic light emitting diodes display comprising organic layer prepared using the same
abstract_en: Provided is a composition for encapsulating an organic light emitting device, comprising a vinyl ether-based compound, a phenol-based compound, and a photoacid generator. The present invention provides a composition for encapsulating an organic light emitting device, which realizes an organic layer having a low dielectric constant and a high modulus after curing.

title_en: Separator for secondary battery comprising metal oxide-nanocellulose fiber and manufacturing method of thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a separator for a secondary battery comprising a metal oxide-nanocellulose fiber and, more specifically, to a separator for a secondary battery comprising a metal oxide-nanocellulose fiber and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein a metal oxide is chemically bonded to the surface of the nanocellulose fiber without an organic binder, thereby having excellent high-temperature heat resistance and relatively thinning the thickness of a thin film.

title_en: Silane Coupling Agent and Adhesive Composition Comprising the Same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a silane coupling agent comprising a silane compound having an acid anhydride group and a hydrolyzable group in one molecule. The silane coupling agent according to the present invention can exhibit excellent heat resistance and wet heat resistance durability by promoting an increase in the adhesion of the interface even under high temperature or high temperature and high humidity conditions.

title_en: Composition for chromium-free surface treating containing, coated steel sheet using thereof, and method for manufacturing therefor
abstract_en: A chrome-free surface treatment composition is provided, comprising, at 100% by weight: i) 25% to 60% of a biomass-based water-soluble polyurethane resin, ii) 25% to 60% of a petroleum-based water-soluble polyurethane resin, iii) 0.1% to 5.0% of a silane-based crosslinking agent, iv) 3% to 15% of a co-modifier, v) 1% to 10% of an inorganic metal rust inhibitor; vi) 0.1% to 5.0% of a lubricant; and the remainder being a solvent. According to the present invention, in providing a surface treatment composition for surface treating a plated steel sheet, an environmentally friendly composition can be provided, and such a composition has corrosion resistance, chemical resistance, weather resistance, processability, etc., equivalent to or greater than that of a conventional surface treatment agent using materials derived from fossil fuels.

title_en: Bio degradable polyester with variable thermal properties and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biodegradable polyester with adjustable thermal properties, obtained by polymerizing a C8-12 dicarboxylic acid and two or more types of diols including isosorbide, and a manufacturing method thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to a biodegradable polyester and a manufacturing method thereof, which possesses high elongation properties and improved thermal stability, and allows for the adjustment of thermal properties within a melting point range relatively lower than that of general polymers, thereby enhancing melt processability.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: Provided is a resin composition which can obtain a cured product having a low coefficient of linear thermal expansion and excellent adhesion to a conductor layer, and has excellent fluidity. A resin composition includes (a) a curable resin, (b) an inorganic filler having a specific surface area of 50 m2/g or less, and (c) an aerogel having a porosity of 85% or more. [representative diagram] no.

title_en: Fire extinguishable and non-flammable paint conposition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-extinguishing nonflammable paint composition comprising three types of hollow ceramic particles having different average particle diameters, micro-extinguishing capsules, one or more types of micro-fired inorganic particles, a silicone acrylic copolymer emulsion, a phosphorus-based flame retardant, aerogel, and a copper (ii) compound.

title_en: Method for improving moisture absorption capacity of sulfonated polyarylene ether sulfone polymer electrolyte membrane
abstract_en: A method for improving the water absorption capacity of a sulfonated polyarylene ether sulfone polymer electrolyte membrane according to one embodiment of the present invention may include: a) a first step of synthesizing a plurality of materials for manufacturing a SPAES ionomer; b) a second step of manufacturing a SPAES PEM based on the SPAES ionomer; and c) a limited deswelling step of manufacturing a modified SPAES PEM with improved water absorption capacity by expanding the SPAES PEM to produce an expanded SPAES PEM, and by limiting the expansion in the width direction of the expanded SPAES PEM to induce a biaxial stretching effect and reduce chain entanglement of polymer chains.

title_en: Castor oil-based flame-retardant plasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a castor oil-based flame-retardant plasticizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein ricinolyl ethyl methacrylate and pentaerythritol tetra(3-mercaptopropionate) are evenly mixed in a solvent, azodiisobutyronitrile is used as a catalyst, and a castor oil-based intermediate is obtained after the reaction is finished and purified; the castor oil-based intermediate and the flame-retardant containing terminal double bonds are evenly mixed in a solvent, azodiisobutyronitrile is used as a catalyst, and the castor oil-based flame-retardant plasticizer is obtained after the reaction is finished and purified. According to the invention, the castor oil-based plasticizer with excellent flame retardancy is prepared through click reaction; developing new bio-based flame-retardant plasticizer can not only effectively solve the problems of huge consumption of petroleum-based resources and environmental pollution, but also has great significance for sustainable development. The bio-based plasticizer has good flame-retardant performance and broad application prospects in many industrial fields.

title_en: Polychromatic regenerated nylon 6 chip, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polychromatic regenerated nylon 6 chip, a preparation method and an application thereof. The regenerated nylon 6 chip is prepared by crushing nylon 6 waste silk mixture, quantitatively feeding side materials, melting, plasticizing, shearing, granulating, vibrating screening and vacuum constant temperature drying. According to the invention, dispersant JIAwax-100 is added in the process of preparing polychromatic regenerated nylon 6 chips by adding various toners, so as to improve the melt uniformity and avoid the problem of low breaking strength caused by the decrease of fiber crystallinity, and antioxidant 9606 is selectively added to reduce the oxidation degree of nylon melt and reduce the influence of oxidative discoloration of regenerated chips on the weaving of light-colored regenerated fibers; according to the invention, the regenerated chips of multi-color polyamide 6 are applied to spinning, and the fibers are endowed with different colors through the regenerated chips of different colors.

title_en: Cast films comprising bimodal ethylene-based polymers having high molecular weight high density fractions.
abstract_en: A cast film inclucing a bimodal ethylene-based polymer having a high density fraction (HDF) from 3.0% to 10.0%, an I<sub>10</sub>/I<sub>2</sub> ratio from 5.5 to 7.0, a short chain branching distribution (SCBD) less than or equal to 10 Â°C, a density from 0.910 g/cc to 0.920 g/cc, and a melt index (I<sub>2</sub>) from 1.0 g/10 mins to 8.0 g/10 mins.

title_en: Method and device for processing a mixture of recycled polyester material and a polyester prepolymer.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for processing a mixture of recycled polyester material and a polyester prepolymer from a polyester manufacturing process, wherein a recycled polyester material is mixed with a polyester prepolymer, from a polyester manufacturing process, and treated in a bulk thermal treatment reactor (7) with a process gas which flows in a counter-current or a cross-current flow direction to the flow direction of the mixture. In this process, the process gas, before entering a catalyst vessel (14), is passed through a protective bed (11) containing a solid adsorbent material, and the protective bed (11) removes high-boiling organic substances or organic substances, with a high combustion temperature, from the process gas stream.

title_en: Polymerizable composition for optical material, polymerizable prepolymer composition for optical material, cured product, and method for producing optical material.
abstract_en: This polymerizable composition for an optical material comprises at least two different monomers for an optical material and a polymerization catalyst, wherein: at least one of the at least two different monomers for an optical material is an isocyanate compound with no aromatic ring; the content of the polymerization catalyst is 0.05-2.0 parts by mass (exclusive of 0.05) with respect to a total of 100 parts by mass of the at least two different monomers for an optical material; and the viscosity measured by a B-type viscometer under the conditions of 25 Â°C and 60 rpm is 10-1,000 mPaÂ·s.

title_en: Immunogenic compositions comprising conjugated capsular saccharide antigens, kits comprising the same and uses thereof.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to new immunogenic compositions comprising conjugated <i>Streptococcus pneumoniae</i> capsular saccharide antigens (glycoconjugates), kits comprising said immunogenic compositions and uses thereof. Immunogenic compositions of the present invention will typically comprise at least one glycoconjugate from a <i>S. pneumoniae</i> serotype not found in PREVNARÂ®, SYNFLORIXÂ® and/or PREVNAR 13Â®. The invention also relates to vaccination of human subjects, in particular infants and elderly, against pneumoccocal infections using said novel immunogenic compositions.

title_en: Polymeric anion-conducting membrane.
abstract_en: The present invention provides compounds, especially polymeric compounds, having preferably at least one spiro or piperidine structural unit, a process for preparation thereof and the use thereof as anion conducting membrane.

title_en: Layered constructions with removable layers.
abstract_en: Layered constructions, such as those used in pressure sensitive adhesive constructions and release liner constructions, are disclosed having a functional layer that is capable of removal. Methods of utilizing the layered constructions are also disclosed.

title_en: Encapsulated probiotic powder for hot beverages
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an encapsulation that confers on the probiotic a stable protective barrier at hot beverage temperatures (90° C) and beverages at room temperature (30° C), resistant to medium-to-use more than 3 months, resistant to the generation of water crystals produced by freezing, thermostable, stable at ph acids and degredation at basic pH, is bioavailable and confers effective delivery of the probiotic to the intestine of the consumer, where the ingredients of the encapsulate are safe for the food industry, are considered GRAS and safe for human consumption.

title_en: Anti-corrosion coating.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of a powdered mixture of zinc flake and of zinc oxide Zn/ZnO to increase the value of the coefficient of adhesion of an anti-corrosion coating, characterised in that the zinc flake represents between 60 and 99% of the mixture of zinc flake and zinc oxide, and more particularly between 70 and 95% of the mixture of zinc flake and zinc oxide. The invention also relates to methods for obtaining and applying the anti-corrosion coating, and to the anti-corrosion coating per se and to substrates covered with the coating.

title_en: Binder composition for iron ore agglomeration
abstract_en: This invention relates to a binder composition for the manufacture of iron ore pellets containing: a) at least two organic binding agents LO in the form of solid particles, which are at least: - a water-soluble anionic polymer PI with a weight average molecular weight between 500 and 200,000 daltons, and, - a water-soluble anionic polymer P2 with a weight average molecular weight greater than 500,000 daltons; and; b) at least one inorganic binding agent LI in the form of solid particles, the solid particles of the binding agents LO having a number median size of more than 500 micrometers, the particles of the binding agent LI have a number median size of less than one-third of the number median size of the solid particles of the binding agents LO.

title_en: Composite glass fiber material comprising a thermosetting polymer
abstract_en: A composite glass fiber material comprises a thermosetting polymer, which is obtained from a curable resin composition comprising (i) an ethylenically unsaturated resin; and (ii) a reactive diluent, which is an N-vinyloxazolidinone of formula (I) in which R<sup>1</sup>, R<sup>2</sup>, R<sup>3</sup> and R<sup>4</sup> are independently from one another selected from a hydrogen atom and an organic moiety comprising 1 to 10 carbon atoms, wherein the reactive diluent (ii) is present in an amount of at least 0.5 wt-% relative to the total amount of reactive diluent (ii) and further reactive diluents.

title_en: Electrodes for energy storage device comprising copolymeric binder
abstract_en: An electrode useful in energy storage devices comprises a current collector and an active layer on the current collector, wherein the active layer comprises electrode active particles, electrically conducting material and a binder wherein the binder comprises a copolymer that comprises a first repeat unit and a second repeat unit; where the first repeat unit is derived from the polymerization of a first monomer which is ethylenically unsaturated monomer having a hydrophilic pendant group and the second repeat unit is derived from the polymerization of a second monomer having ethylenic unsaturation.

title_en: Electrodepositable coating compositions comprising calcined clay
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to an electrodepositable coating composition comprising an active hydrogen-containing, ionic salt group-containing film-forming polymer; a curing agent; at least one organic resinous component different than the active hydrogen-containing, ionic salt group-containing film-forming polymer and curing agent, wherein the organic resinous component has an aliphatic content of at least 60% by weight, based on the total weight of the organic resinous component; a curing catalyst substantially free, essentially free, or completely free of catalytic tin and/or comprising a bismuth-containing curing catalyst, an amine-containing curing catalyst, a zinc-containing curing catalyst, a zirconium-containing catalyst, a cerium-containing catalyst, an amidine-containing catalyst, an imidazole-containing catalyst, and/or a titanium-containing catalyst; and calcined clay pigment. Also disclosed are electrodepositable coating compositions, methods of coating substrates, and uses of electrodepositable coating compositions.

title_en: Flame retardant polypropylene composition
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a polypropylene composition (C) comprising a propylene homopolymer, a mixed-plastics polypropylene blend (PPB), a flame retardant (FR), fibers (F) and optionally an adhesion promoter (AP) as well as an article comprising said polypropylene composition (C).

title_en: Halogenated perfluoroaliphatic compounds and methods of making and using the same
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a method for making halogenated perfluoroaliphatic compounds using a one-step procedure that can be adapted for use with various different linear fluorine-containing starting materials. The method is safe, reproducible, and adaptable. It utilizes readily accessible starting materials (e.g., a fluorine-containing compound and a halogen-based reagent, such as Br<sub>2</sub>, IBr, ICl, BrCl, or Cl<sub>2</sub>) to provide various halogenated perfluoroaliphatic compounds that can be further be converted to additional valuable products used in various industries.

title_en: Hydrogel prodrugs
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of a hydrogel and to a hydrogel obtainable by said process. The present invention further relates to a process for the preparation of a hydrogel-spacer conjugate, to a hydrogel-spacer conjugate obtainable by said process, to a process for the preparation of a carrier-linked prodrug and to carrier- linked prodrugs obtainable by said process, in particular to carrier- linked prodrugs that provide for a controlled or sustained release of a drug from a carrier. In addition, the invention relates to the use of the hydrogel for the preparation of a carrier-linked prodrug.

title_en: Complex comprising oxidative dehydrogenation unit
abstract_en: Chemical complexes and processes for the oxidative dehydrogenation (ODH) of paraffins to olefins are disclosed. Said chemical complexes comprise a steam cracker, a C2 splitter, and a hydrogenation unit to remove acetylene wherein an oxidative dehydrogenation unit is integrated with the C2 splitter or the hydrogenation unit to remove acetylene. The oxidative dehydrogenation process can be integrated into back end separation processes of a conventional steam cracker to increase capacity and/or to provide a lower energy route to produce olefins, thus reducing costs. Oxidative dehydrogenation processes may be integrated with a number of processes in a chemical plant such as polymerization processes, and the manufacture of glycols, carboxylic acids and esters.

title_en: Syntactic polyurethane elastomers for use in subsea pipeline insulation
abstract_en: Syntactic polyurethane elastomers are made using a non-mercury catalyst. The elastomer is made from a reaction mixture containing a polymer polyol which has a liquid polyether polyol as a continuous phase and polymer particles dispersed in the liquid polyether polyol, a chain extender, a polyisocyanate and microspheres. The elastomer adheres well to itself, which makes it very useful as thermal insulation for pipelines and other structures that have a complex geometry.

title_en: Coating composition for extreme washable coatings
abstract_en: A coating composition including: an aqueous dispersion of self-crosslinkable core-shell particles, where the core-shell particles include (1) a polymeric core at least partially encapsulated by (2) a polymeric shell having urethane linkages, keto and/or aldo functional groups, and hydrazide functional groups, where the polymeric core is covalently bonded to at least a portion of the polymeric shell, and an acrylic polymer, where the acrylic polymer is non-reactive with the polymeric core and the polymeric shell. A substrate coated with a coating formed from the coating composition and a method of improving stain resistance of a substrateare also disclosed.

title_en: Insulated pipe containing polyurethane foam which is foamed by an environmentally friendly foaming agent and has a low degree of brittleness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a pipe which is insulated using polyurethane foam, wherein (a) isocyanates are mixed with (b) polyols, (c) foaming agents containing at least one aliphatic halogenated hydrocarbon compound (c1) made of 2 to 5 carbon atoms, at least one hydrogen atom, and at least one fluorine and/or chlorine atom, said compound (c1) containing at least one carbon-carbon double bond, (d) a catalyst containing N,N-dialkylbenzylamine, optionally (e) chain-extending and/or cross-linking agents, and optionally (f) auxiliary agents and additives in order to form a reaction mixture, and the reaction mixture is applied onto a medium pipe and is allowed to harden in order to form the polyurethane foam. The invention additionally relates to an insulated pipe which can be obtained using such a method and to the use of such an insulated pipe as an insulated jacket compound pipe for underground long-distance heating or cooling grids.

title_en: Gel cicatrizante de pectin plasticiado con glicerol y enriched con alantoina.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the development of a methodology for obtaining and using a pectin gel enriched with allantoin and plasticized with glycerol as a healing, regenerative, anti-inflammatory and/or antibacterial product for medical, pharmaceutical or cosmetic use in superficial or deep skin wounds of animals or people. Said proposal includes results from an in vivo animal test, validating that the film has healing, anti-inflammatory and regenerative properties that can aid in the healing and regeneration process of skin wounds, reducing the healing process to fifteen days in which new cutaneous tissue is already present with abundant fur.

title_en: Method for preparing bio-based composite using palm biomass powder as raw material
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for preparing a bio-based composite using palm biomass powder as raw material, and belongs to the technical field of preparation method of bio-based composite. During palm micropowder washing, 100 parts by weight of 600-1,200 mesh palm micropowder is placed in a reactor, and 400-500 parts by weight of acetone is added to the reactor in a 1:4 or 1:5 bath ratio; during surface treatment of palm micropowder, the reaction system after solvent displacement is heated to 80-100?C, and distillate is dehydrated with a 3A molecular sieve and then refluxed to a reactor; bio-based resin is compounded and extruded. The present invention solves the problem that use of palm as a biomass raw material leads to impurity migration and insufficient product performance due to high small oily molecule content. The present invention breaks away from the misunderstanding that only treating biomass in an aqueous solution leads to a high conversion cost, and creates an effective palm biomass treatment method. A new bio-based resin material with low cost, high performance, excellent processability, and satisfaction of food contact conditions can be prepared by using palm residue as a bio-based material.

title_en: Organic Hydrophilic Coating Composition and Hydrophilic Film for Aluminum Material for a Heat Exchanger
abstract_en: Provided are an organic hydrophilic coating composition for forming a hydrophilic film having not only properties including long-term hydrophilicity but also a self-cleaning property on the surface of any of various hard materials, such as metallic materials, plastic materials, and ceramics materials, and a hydrophilic film, and an aluminum material for a heat exchanger, such as a precoated fin material. The organic hydrophilic coating composition includes: a polyvinyl alcohol resin as a resin component at a ratio of from 40 g/L to 100 g/L; and ascorbic acid as an additional component at a ratio of from 0.02 g/L to 39 g/L, the organic hydrophilic coating composition having a hydroxyl value of from 550 mgKOH/g to 1,300 mgKOH/g. The hydrophilic film and the aluminum material for a heat exchanger are each formed using the organic hydrophilic coating composition.

title_en: Powder coating formulation and method for manufacturing latex article therefrom
abstract_en: A powder coating formulation comprising a dispersion formed of a powder material, an anti tack agent, a dispersing agent, a thickening agent, a slip agent and a diluting agent, characterized in that the dispersion formed further includes a binding agent, wherein the binding agent is selected from the group consisting of acrylonitrile butadiene latex, natural rubber latex, butyl latex, chloroprene latex and polyisoprene latex. A glove having at least a coating prepared from the powder coating formulation as described above.  Most illustrative drawing: Figure 3.

title_en: Polyacetal resin composition and sliding member
abstract_en: The purpose of an embodiment of the present invention is to provide a polyacetal resin composition and a sliding member, the polyacetal resin composition having excellent performance with respect to friction/abrasion characteristics while maintaining good appearance of a molded article thereof or low occurrence of mold contamination during molding. The purpose of an embodiment of the present invention is achieved by a polyacetal resin composition containing at least (A) 100 parts by mass of a polyacetal resin, (B) 0.01 part by mass to 1 part by mass of a hindered-phenol-based antioxidant, (C) 0.3 part by mass to 5 parts by mass of silicone oil, (D) 0.1 part by mass to 1.0 part by mass of calcium carbonate, and (E) 0.02 part by mass to 0.2 part by mass of a fatty acid, the calcium carbonate (D) being precipitated calcium carbonate which is not surface-treated and which has an average particle diameter of 1 m or less, and the fatty acid (E) being a C12-30 fatty acid.   No Figure

title_en: Silk fibroin composite hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present application discloses a silk fibroin composite hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. A method for preparing a silk fibroin composite hydrogel, including the following steps: preparing silk fibroin and modifying the silk fibroin by amination to obtain aminated silk fibroin; dynamically crosslinking the aminated silk fibroin with oxidized sodium alginate through Schiff base bonds by using an enzyme-catalyzed crosslinking process to obtain a dynamically crosslinked network solution; adding temperature-sensitive components to the dynamically crosslinked network solution, and mixing them evenly to obtain a temperature-sensitive-dynamic dual network prehydrogel solution with temperature responsiveness; loading active ingredients into the temperature-sensitive-dynamic dual network pre-hydrogel solution to obtain a composite hydrogel solution; incubating the composite hydrogel solution to obtain a nascent hydrogel; and introducing disulfide bonds into the nascent hydrogel and performing crosslinking enhancement and sterilization to obtain a silk fibroin composite hydrogel.

title_en: Chemical modifier for asphaltic layers - interaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for modifying road bitumen by adding manganese chloride (MnCl<sub>2</sub> or MnCl<sub>2 </sub>x 4 H<sub>2</sub>O) in a ratio of 2% of the bitumen mass in a mixer. The reaction is performed at 150...170°C in the presence of oxygen, forming Lewis Mn-O centers in the bituminous matrix and determining the increase of dynamic rigidity of over 9000 MPa (10 Hz and 20°C), increasing the resistance to fatigue and permanent deformations. The process provides for a higher thermal stability and an extended lifespan of the road structures.

title_en: The method of preparation of bio-based unsaturated polyester resin reinforced with modified nanocellulose fibers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the method of preparing unsaturated polyester resin (UPR) based on raw materials obtained from biorenewable sources, reinforced with modified nanocellulose fibers. The preparation method includes the following steps: (1) synthesis of prepolymer by polycondensation reaction using unsaturated and saturated diacids as well as glycol as starting monomers; (2) preparation of resuspension of nanocellulose fibers in acetone and their modification with dimethyl itaconate where dimethyl itaconate is used as a reagent and as a solvent; and (3) preparation of UPR based on raw materials from biorenewable sources with modified nanocellulose fibers by adding modified nanocellulose fibers to the prepolymer, then adding activators and initiators, and finally performing the crosslinking reaction at an elevated temperature for 24 h. The obtained UPR based on raw materials from biorenewable sources has an environmentally acceptable composition and has improved mechanical properties compared to UPR without nanocellulose fibers. Dimethyl itaconate, which can be obtained from biorenewable raw materials, using the proposed method is simultaneously used for the modification of nanocellulose fibers and as a reactive solvent for the preparation of UPR. In this way, a simple modification of nanocellulose fibers is achieved, which are chemically bound to the UPR matrix and better dispersed in it, and thus better mechanical properties of UPR based on raw materials from biorenewable sources are achieved.

title_en: Method for modifying polypropylene
abstract_en:
FIELD: chemical industry.  
     SUBSTANCE: present invention relates to a method for modifying polypropylene. This method involves introducing branched polysulfone into polypropylene in the presence of bismaleimide, followed by extrusion in the temperature range 200-290°С. The branched polysulfone is obtained by polycondensation of 4,4'-dichlorodiphenylsulfone with bisphenol in the presence of phenolphthalein at the following ratio of polypropylene to polysulfone: polypropylene 95-98 wt%; branched polysulfone 2-5% by weight. 4,4'-dioxy-2,2-diphenylpropane, or 4,4'-dioxydiphenylsulfone, or 4,4'-dioxydiphenyl ketone, or 4,4'-dioxydiphenyl is used as bisphenol.    
     EFFECT: development of a method for modifying polypropylene and improving performance characteristics of polypropylene for household and industrial use (increasing heat resistance, resistance to aggressive media and to osmotic penetration of the solvent (swelling)). 
     5 cl, 1 tbl, 1 ex

title_en: Radiation resistant polypropylene
abstract_en:
FIELD: chemistry. 
     SUBSTANCE: present invention relates to radiation-resistant polymer materials used in space engineering. Radiation-resistant polypropylene is PPH030GP polypropylene modified with ZrO 2  nanoparticles as filler. Modification is carried out with zirconium dioxide nanoparticles in amount of one weight percent. 
     EFFECT: high resistance to radiation of polymer nanocomposites, characterized by simple design and does not require complex and expensive equipment. 
     1 cl, 1 tbl, 5 ex

title_en: Adhesive composition based on polyethylene with improved long-term stability, method for preparation and use thereof
abstract_en:
FIELD: chemistry. 
     SUBSTANCE: present invention relates to a group of inventions: an adhesive composition based on polyethylene, a method of producing an adhesive composition, use of an adhesive composition and a pipe. This composition contains: A) from 50 to 80 wt. % of linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE) obtained on catalytic systems Ziegler-Natta, having density from 0.915 to 0.925 g/cm 3  and melt flow index (MFR 190/2.16 ) in range from 2.5 to 8.0 g/10 min; B) from 15 to 30 wt. % high-density polyethylene (HDPE) grafted with a functional monomer, having a density of not less than 0.955 g/cm 3  and a melt flow index (MFR 190/2.16 ) in range of 1.5 to 2.5 g/10 min; and C) from 5 to 20 wt. % of elastomer. This method involves mixing the components taken in amounts relative to the total weight, and subsequent compounding of the obtained mixture in the melt. Polyethylene-based adhesive composition is used as an adhesive layer in multilayer coatings. 
     EFFECT: development of an adhesive composition based on polyethylene, which retains high adhesion strength in an aqueous environment for a long period of time, as well as resistance of the adhesive joint to cathode peeling; simple method of producing the composition by performing it in one step. 
     72 cl, 3 tbl, 6 ex

title_en: Composition comprising block copolymer, and method for producing siliceous film using the same
abstract_en: To provide a siliceous film manufacturing composition that can fill a narrow and a high aspect ratio trench and can produce a thick siliceous film. The present invention provides a siliceous film manufacturing composition that comprises, (a) a block copolymer having a linear and/or cyclic polysilane backbone block with 5 or more silicon atoms and a polycarbosilane backbone block with 15 or more silicon atoms, and (b) a solvent.

title_en: Additive manufacturing of polishing pads
abstract_en: A formulation, system, and method for additive manufacturing of a polishing pad. The formulation includes monomer, dispersant, and nanoparticles. A method of preparing the formulation includes adding a dispersant that is a polyester derivative to monomer, adding metal-oxide nanoparticles to the monomer, and subjecting the monomer having the nanoparticles and dispersant to sonication to disperse the nanoparticles in the monomer.

title_en: Resist composition and method of forming resist pattern
abstract_en: A resist composition which generates an acid upon light exposure and whose solubility in a developing solution is changed due to an action of the acid, the resist composition comprising a base material component (A) whose solubility in a developing solution is changed due to the action of an acid, and an acid generator component (B) which generates an acid upon light exposure, in which the base material component (A) contains a polymer compound (A1) which has a constitutional unit (a0) containing an acid-dissociable group represented by Formula (a01-r-1), and the acid generator component (B) contains a compound (B1) represented by Formula (b1) but does not contain an onium salt having a halogen atom in an anion moiety: Image available on "Original document" wherein R01 represents an alkyl group having 4 or more carbon atoms; n represents an integer of 1 to 4; and * represents a bonding site, Image available on "Original document" wherein Rb1 represents a hydrocarbon group which may have a substituent, provided that Rb1 does not contain a halogen atom; m represents an integer of 1 or greater; and Mm+ represents an m-valent organic cation.

title_en: Active energy ray-curable coating composition
abstract_en: Provided is an active energy ray-curable coating composition containing the components (A), (B), and (C) indicated below. (A) is an oligomer having a group represented by formula (1) and a substituted or unsubstituted acryloyl group, (B) is a (meth)acrylic acid ester monomer having one unsaturated bond per molecule thereof, and (C) is photopolymerization initiator (in formula (1), R1 represents a perfluoroalkyl group having 4-6 carbon atoms).

title_en: Polycarbonate/polyorganosiloxane copolymer and resin composition including said copolymer
abstract_en: A polycarbonate/polyorganosiloxane copolymer which comprises a polyorganosiloxane block (A-1) including a specific structural unit and a polycarbonate block (A-2) composed of specific repeating units.

title_en: A uv curable silicone composition and an encapsulant or a sheet film thereof
abstract_en: A UV curable silicone composition has exceptional curability by ultraviolet irradiation. The UV curable silicone composition includes (A) an organopolysiloxane composition selected from the following: (A-1) an organopolysiloxane composition comprising a linear organopolysiloxane in which both ends of the molecular chain are capped with alkenyl groups and/or a branched organopolysiloxane containing at least 2 alkenyl groups at the ends of the molecular chain, and an organopolysiloxane containing at least 2 thiol groups in side-chains of the molecular chain, wherein the thiol group content is 1% by mass or more per molecule, (A-2) an organopolysiloxane composition comprising a linear organopolysiloxane in which both ends of the molecular chain are capped with thiol groups, wherein the thiol group content is 1% by mass or more per molecule, and an organopolysiloxane containing at least 2 alkenyl groups in side-chains of the molecular chain and/or a resinous organopolysiloxane containing at least 2 alkenyl groups at the ends of the molecular chain, or (A-3) an organopolysiloxane composition comprising an alkenyl group- and aryl group-containing organopolysiloxane and a multifunctional thiol compound, but furthermore comprising an alkenyl group-containing resinous organopolysiloxane when the multifunctional thiol compound contains only a bifunctional thiol compound, and (B) a silicone-compatible photo-initiator comprising a compound selected from the following: (B-1) an alpha-hydroxyacetophenone, (B-2) a combination of an alpha-hydroxyacetophenone and an alpha-aminoalkylphenone, or (B-3) a combination of an alpha-hydroxyacetophenone and a mono-acylphosphine oxide, wherein the ratio between the thiol groups and alkenyl groups (SH/Vi ratio) included in the organopolysiloxane composition is 0.6 or more.

title_en: Aqueous composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aqueous composition that includes delgocitinib or a salt thereof, and has a pH of 4.0-6.5.

title_en: Low-residue siloxane compound, and lubricating oil composition and lubricant using this
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the siloxane compound represented by formula (1).

title_en: Continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material and manufacturing method thereof, and continuous fiber reinforced resin molded product
abstract_en: The continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material of the present invention contains continuous reinforced fibers and a thermoplastic resin, and the peak temperature of tan [delta] at the interface between the continuous reinforcing fiber of the continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material and the thermoplastic resin is 80 DEG C or higher.

title_en: Resin composition, cured product of resin composition, resin sheet, printed wiring board, semiconductor chip package, and semiconductor device A resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin and (B) a resin composition of hardener
abstract_en: To provide a resin composition that can obtain a cured product with suppressed warpage and excellent long-term reliability; and a cured product of the resin composition, a resin sheet, a printed wiring board, a semiconductor chip package, and a semiconductor device. A resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin and (B) a resin composition of hardener, wherein the average coefficient of linear thermal expansion α of the cured product is divided by the crosslinking density n of the cured product. The value Zf (ppm.cm3/mol.K) satisfies 145&ltZf&lt 1300.

title_en: Polyimide film and metal-lined layered sheet
abstract_en: This polyimide film has a dielectric loss tangent of less than 0.010 after being immersed for 24 hours in water at 25 DEG C.

title_en: Binder resin, positive-type photosensitive resin composition, insulating film and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a binder resin, a photosensitive resin composition, an insulating film and a semiconductor device.

title_en: film
abstract_en: Provided are: a film having little variation in thermal diffusivity; and a composition that can form said film. This film includes a polyimide resin (A) and a particulate polymer (B). When the area of the particulate polymer (B) is calculated in each of six square segmented regions obtained by setting, at any given location in a scanning transmission electron microscope image of a cross section of the film in the thickness direction, a rectangular observation region having a length t in the film thickness direction and a length of 1.5*t in the direction perpendicular to the film thickness direction [t represents the shorter length between 25*L (L representing the average primary particle diameter of the particulate polymer (B)) and the film thickness], and dividing the observation region evenly in two in the thickness direction and evenly in three in the direction perpendicular to the thickness direction, the standard deviation of the areas is 20 or less.

title_en: Polyimide film and production method therefor
abstract_en: Provided are a colorless polyimide film which is high in tensile rupture strength and tensile modulus and has a high elongation at rupture and a low coefficient of linear expansion and a method for producing the polyimide film. The polyimide film is a multilayered polyimide film having a thickness of 3-120 [mu]m, a yellowness index of 5 or less, and a total light transmittance of 86% or greater, characterized by having a multilayer structure in which at least two polyimide layers differing in composition have been superposed in the thickness direction and in that the two polyimide layers include an (a) layer and a (b) layer, the (a) layer having a film thickness of 0.3 [mu]m or larger and the (b) layer having a film thickness 5-25 times that of the (a) layer.

title_en: Aromatic diamine compound and polyimide films

title_en: Polymer composition, liquid crystal aligning agent, resin film, liquid crystal alignment film, method for producing liquid crystal display element, and liquid crystal display element
abstract_en: A polymer composition containing a polymer (A) that has a partial structure represented by any of formulas (i-1) to (i-3) and that has a structure obtained by removing R from the partial structure in the main chain. (R is a monovalent organic group having two aromatic hydrocarbon rings and a nitrogen atom (A).
