abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (1) for adjusting the concentration of a gas in a liquid, said device (1) comprising a cartridge (2) in which the concentration of the gas in the liquid is adjustedchanged, a pipe (3) for supplying the liquid into the cartridge (2), a pipe (4) for supplying gas into the cartridge (2), and a pipe (5) for discharging the liquid from the cartridge (2). According the invention, the gas supply pipe (4) comprises an expansion valve (7) with of which athe pressure setpoint that is controlled by an "a setpoint for the quantity amount of gas in the liquid and by an amount ofa quantity of gas in the liquid measured by a gas concentration sensor (8) located in the liquid discharge pipe (5).

title_en: Packaged ambient coffee beverage with aerated texture upon hand shaking
abstract_en: A beverage consisting essentially of coffee beverage in a closed container is disclosed. The beverage may be foamed by shaking, to provide a pleasant aerated texture/mouthfeel.

title_en: Dairy product analogs and processes for making same
abstract_en: Provided are non-dairy yogurt analogs having qualities similar to dairy-based yogurts. Certain embodiments are to plant-based yogurt analogs comprising fermented plant protein isolates and/or gelled plant protein isolates and processes for production of non-dairy yogurt analogs. The method for producing a plant-based yogurt mixture to make a plant-based yogurt analog comprises the steps of: a) obtaining an essentially dairy-free base for a yogurt formulation including a plant-based derivative; and b) adding an acid to said formulation. Thereafter, formulation may be used to manufacture a plant-based yogurt analog comprising the steps of: a) heating a plant-based yogurt mixture at for a first pre-determined amount of time while stirring; b) allowing the mixture to cool; c) adding yogurt cultures to the resultant mixture; and d) incubating the resultant mixture for a second pre-determined amount of time to produce a plant-based yogurt analog.

title_en: Soybean variety 5pjnk09
abstract_en: ABSTRACT A novel soybean variety, designated 5PJNK09 is provided. Also provided are the seeds of soybean variety 5PJNK09, cells from soybean variety 5PJNK09, plants of soybean 5PJNK09, and plant parts of soybean variety 5PJNK09. Methods provided include producing a soybean plant by crossing soybean variety 5PJNK09 with another soybean plant, methods for introgressing a transgenic trait, a mutant trait, and/or a native trait into soybean variety 5PJNK09, methods for producing other soybean varieties or plant parts derived from soybean variety 5PJNK09, and methods of characterizing soybean variety 5PJNK09. Soybean seed, cells, plants, germplasm, breeding lines, varieties, and plant parts produced by these methods and/or derived from soybean variety 5PJNK09 are further provided. CA 3062682 2019-11-26

title_en: Cooking device and components thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a cooking system for cooking food, the system including a housing having a hollow interior, a lid movable relative to the housing, at least one heating element associated with one of the housing and the lid, wherein the cooking system is operable in a plurality of modes including a conductive cooking mode and a convective cooking mode, wherein in the conductive cooking mode the cooking system is operable as a conductive cooker and in the convective cooking mode the cooking system is operable as a convection cooker.

title_en: Maize inbred ph42yr
abstract_en: A novel maize variety designated PH42YR and seed, plants and plant parts thereof are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant comprise crossing maize variety PH42YR with another maize plant are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant containing in its genetic material one or more traits introgressed into PH42YR through backcross conversion and/or transformation, and to the maize seed, plant and plant part produced thereby are provided. Hybrid maize seed, plants or plant parts are produced by crossing the variety PH42YR or a locus conversion of PH42YR with another maize variety.

title_en: Compositions for preventing or treating fish parasitic infections, including extracts of sophora flavescens aiton or fractions thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating a parasitic infectious disease of fish, comprising an extract of Sophora flavescens Aiton or fraction thereof as an active ingredient, more specifically, a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating a sea lice infectious disease which is a parasite of fish, a feed additive composition for preventing or improving, and a method for preventing or treating a parasitic infectious disease of a fish, comprising the step of putting the composition directly into a fish or in a farm.

title_en: Hemp plant named 'cw1as1'
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a new and distinct hemp cultivar designated 'CW1AS1'. The present disclosure relates to seeds of the hemp plant 'CW1AS1,' to plants and parts of the hemp plant 'CW1AS1,' and to methods for producing a hemp plant by crossing the hemp plant 'CW1AS1' with itself or other cannabis plants. The disclosure further relates to the morphological and physiological characteristics of the new and distinct hemp cultivar and its uses.

title_en: Triticale cultivar 343cms
abstract_en: A cytoplasmic male sterile triticale cultivar, designated 343CMS, is disclosed. The invention relates to the seeds of triticale cultivar 343CM5, to the plants of triticale 343CM5, and to methods for producing a triticale plant produced by crossing the cultivar 343CM5 with itself or another triticale variety. The invention also relates to methods for producing a triticale plant containing in its genetic material one or more transgenes and to the transgenic triticale plants and plant parts produced by those methods. The invention also relates to triticale varieties or breeding varieties and plant parts derived from triticale cultivar 343CM5, to methods for producing other triticale varieties, lines or plant parts derived from triticale cultivar 343CM5, and to the triticale plants, varieties, and their parts derived from the use of those methods. The invention further relates to hybrid triticale seeds and plants produced by crossing the cultivar 343CM5 with another triticale cultivar.

title_en: Composition for preparing candy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preparing candy, and a method for preparing candy using same, and provides candy having reduced stickiness and/or cold flow. The composition for preparing candy contains saccharides having a degree of polymerization of 2 or less, and saccharides having a degree of polymerization of 3 or more, wherein, on a dry-solids basis, the composition contains 29 parts by weight or more of the saccharides having a degree of polymerization of 3 or more with respect to 100 parts by weight of the saccharides having a degree of polymerization of 2 or less.

title_en: Bacterial populations for desirable traits in ruminating animals
abstract_en: A method of selecting a ruminating animal having a desirable, hereditable trait is disclosed. The method comprises analyzing in the microbiome of the animal for an amount of a hereditable microorganism which is associated with the hereditable trait, wherein the amount of the hereditable microorganism is indicative as to whether the animal has a desirable hereditable trait.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating parkinson's disease comprising o-cyclic phytosphingosine-1-phosphate
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating Parkinson's disease comprising 0-cyclic phytosphingosine-l-phosphate. The present composition can prevent the death of SH-SY5Y nerve cells, which are dopaminergic nerve cells, and increase the expression of tyrosine hydroxylase, an enzyme required for dopamine formation.  Accordingly, the present composition can be effectively used for preventing or treating Parkinson's disease.

title_en: Process for manufacturing a formed meat analogue product
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for manufacturing a formed meat analogue product, which preferably has a visual aspect of a marbled meat product.

title_en: A robotic cooking system
abstract_en: A robotic cooking system comprising a robotic arm, and end of arm tool with a gripper, and ingredient holding and dispensing assemblies; a cooking receptacle; dish storing device, and a tray designed to be releasably gripped by the gripper; the system having a dish and food transfer area, a cleaning system for cleaning the cooking receptacle and tray; the end of arm tool having a rotary drive adapted for engagement with the containers so that the dispenser can dispense the ingredient from the assembly; the rotary drive having a flexible coupling to compensate misalignment and/or ensure easy entering of the rotary drive to the containers; wherein the end of arm tool also has one or more air nozzles directed towards the tray to create air flow along the surface of the tray to facilitate discharging food ingredients from the tray.

title_en: Maize inbred 1pruc36
abstract_en: A novel maize variety designated 1PRUC36 and seed, plants and plant parts thereof are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant comprise crossing maize variety 1PRUC36 with another maize plant are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant containing in its genetic material one or more traits introgressed into 1PRUC36 through backcross conversion and/or transformation, and to the maize seed, plant and plant part produced thereby are provided. Hybrid maize seed, plants or plant parts are produced by crossing the variety 1PRUC36 or a locus conversion of 1PRUC36 with another maize variety.

title_en: Dietary supplement composition comprising collagen
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to improving physical and athletic performance and supporting recovery of joints, ligaments, and tendons with collagen peptides and dietary ingredients that physical and athletic performance. The dietary supplement composition of the present invention comprise collagen, preferably in the form of hydrolyzed collagen peptides, in combination with Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAA), Creatine Nitrate, Arginine Nitrate, N- acetyl-L-Carnitine, L-Citrulline, Betaine Anhydrous, Alpha-Glyceryl Phosphoryl Choline, Ancient Peat Extract with Apple Fruit Extract, and Caffeine. Physical and athletic performance, as well as recovery from exercise, is improved using this combination of components.

title_en: Maize hybrid x95r017
abstract_en: A novel maize variety designated X95R017 and seed, plants and plant parts thereof are produced by crossing inbred maize varieties. Methods for producing a maize plant by crossing hybrid maize variety X95R017 with another maize plant are disclosed. Methods for producing a maize plant containing in its genetic material one or more traits introgressed into X95R017 through backcrossing or genetic transformation, and to the maize seed, plant and plant part produced thereby are described. Maize variety X95R017, the seed, the plant produced from the seed, and variants, mutants, and minor modifications of maize variety X95R017 are provided. Methods for producing maize varieties derived from maize variety X95R017 and methods of using maize variety X95R017 are disclosed.

title_en: Use of cyclo-hispro (chp) for lowering blood pressure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a use of Cyclo-HisPro (CHP) for lowering blood pressure. More specifically, the present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for lowering blood pressure, comprising CHP, and a functional health food composition comprising same; a method for lowering blood pressure using CHP; a use of CHP in the manufacture of antihypertensive agents; a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating hypertension or complications thereof, comprising CHP, and a functional health food composition comprising same, for preventing or improving hypertension or complications thereof; a method for preventing or treating hypertension or complications thereof by using CHP; and a use of CHP in the manufacture of a medicament for preventing or treating hypertension or complications thereof.

title_en: Device for preparing and dispensing reconstituted beer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for preparing and dispensing reconstituted beer, said device comprising: ? a first vessel containing a liquid concentrate for preparing a beer; ? a second vessel containing an alcoholic liquid; ? a source of water; ? a source of pressurized carbon dioxide; ? a reconstitution unit; ? a dispensing unit for dispensing the alcoholic beer; wherein the device is operable (i) to form a reconstituted beer comprising water from the source of water, carbon dioxide from the source of pressurized carbon dioxide, liquid concentrate from the first vessel and alcoholic liquid from the second vessel, in the reconstitution unit and (ii) to dispense the reconstituted beer from the dispensing unit; wherein the liquid concentrate in the first vessel an ethanol content of 0-1 % ABV; and wherein the alcoholic liquid in the second vessel contains 12-100 wt.% ethanol and 0-88 wt.% water, ethanol and water together constituting 80-100 wt.% of the alcoholic liquid. An alternative aspect of the invention relates to a device wherein the source of water and the source of pressurised carbon dioxide are replaced by a source of carbonated water and the device is operable to form a reconstituted beer comprising water from the source of carbonated water, liquid concentrate from the first vessel and alcoholic liquid from the second vessel in the reconstitution unit. The aforementioned devices can be used to prepare a reconstituted beer of superior quality. The use of an essentially alcohol-free concentrate offers the advantage that the stability of the concentrate is substantially improved.

title_en: Methods for controlling meristem size for crop improvement
abstract_en: This invention relates to compositions and methods for modifying CORYNE (CRN) genes inplants to optionally increase kernel row number and/or improve one or more yield traits. The invention further relates to plants having increased kernel row number and/or one or more improved yield traits produced using the methods and compositions of the invention.

title_en: Synergistic herbal compositions for improving gut health
abstract_en: Synergistic Herbal Compositions For Improving Gut Health" The present invention discloses synergistic herbal compositions comprising at least two ingredients selected from extract(s), fraction(s), phytochemical(s), or mixtures thereof derived each one from a different herb selected from Abelmoschus esculentus, Withania somnifera and Amorphophallus paeoniifolius; improving at least one gut health function selected from gut-brain axis, easing of constipation, bowel movement, improved GI motility, digestion and gut immunity; and reducing gut inflammation. The invention further relates to methods of treatment and the use of the compositions.

title_en: Method for reducing sulfur-containing-compound content of volatile substances from fried food
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for decreasing a sulfur-containing compound included in a volatile substance from a fried food. This method for decreasing a sulfur-containing compound included in a volatile substance from a fried food is a method wherein an ingredient is fry cooked with an oil/fat composition containing an edible oil/fat and component A. Component A: One or two or more oils/fats selected from (1)-(5). (1) A roasted oil, (2) a decoction oil, (3) an n-3 edible oil/fat, (4) an overheated oil, (5) olive oil.

title_en: Benzamide derivatives, preparation method thereof, and pharmaceutical composition for use in preventing of treating cancer containing the same as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a benzamide derivative, a method for preparing same, and a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of cancer, containing same as an active ingredient. The benzamide derivative according to an aspect of the present invention can be used in the prevention or treatment of cancer by suppressing EGFR mutation, and, when administered in combination with an EGFR antagonist such as cetuximab, exhibits a significantly synergistic effect on anticancer activity, and thus can be effectively used as an anticancer agent.

title_en: Method for obtaining soluble fibres enzymatically
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a mixture of poorly-digestible alpha-glucans from a substrate rich in oligosaccharides having a degree of polymerisation (DP) of 4.

title_en: Quantitative trait loci associated with purple color in cannabis
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods of characterizing and identifying a Cannabis spp. plant comprising quantitative trait loci (QTLs) associated with a purple color trait of interest, and methods of producing plants having a purple color trait of interest based on defined allelic states of polymorphisms defining the QTLs. Also provided are Cannabis spp. plants with the purple color trait of interest comprising defined allelic states of polymorphisms defining the QTLs and plants identified, characterized or produced by the methods described herein. Further provided are methods of marker assisted selection, genomic selection and marker assisted breeding, in particular using a combination of specific markers provided, for obtaining plants having a purple color trait of interest.

title_en: Lettuce variety nun 06364 ltl
abstract_en: Lettuce variety NUN 06364 LTL is disclosed, as well as seeds and plants and heads or leaves thereof.

title_en: Group of glycosyltransferases and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a group of glycosyltransferases and applications thereof. Specifically, the application of glycosyltransferases gGT25, gGT13, gGT30, gGT25-1, gGT25-3, gGT25-5, gGT29, gGT29-3, gGT29-4, gGT29-5, gGT29-6, gGT29-7, 3GT1, 3GT2, 3GT3, 3GT4 and derived polypeptides in terpenoid glycosylation catalysis and new saponin synthesis is provided, wherein the glycosyltransferases can specifically and efficiently catalyze the C-20 position and/or C-6 position and/or C-3 hydroxyl glycosylation of a tetracyclic triterpene compound substrate and/or transfer glycosyl from a glycosyl donor to the first glycosyl at the C-3 position and C-6 position of the tetracyclic triterpene compound so as to extend sugar chains. The glycosyltransferase can also be used for constructing artificially synthesized rare ginsenoside and a plurality of new ginsenoside and derivatives thereof.

title_en: Crisp potato chips and making method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a crisp potato chip which has the characteristics of low fat content and crisp mouthfeel. In addition, the invention also provides a preparation method of the potato chips, the clean potato chips are subjected to high-pressure treatment and low-pressure impregnation, the solute of the impregnation liquid quickly permeates into the materials, the distribution is uniform, and the taste of the product is fine and uniform. By adding substances such as salt, citric acid and the like into the steeping liquor, the seasoning effect is achieved, the crystal nucleus can be used for inducing more ice crystals, and the product is promoted to form a crisp taste. After the initial cooling and freezing, the quick-frozen knots are adopted, which is beneficial to the growth of ice crystals and the increase of the size, thereby generating larger holes, and the product is crisp and has improved crispness. The invention adopts freeze sublimation drying dehydration, is not fried, and has crisp and soft products and small nutrition loss.

title_en: Jasmine tea fresh flower curing device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a jasmine tea fresh flower curing device and a use method thereof. The using method comprises the following steps: 1) The sliding plate and the cloth cover fixing plate are respectively moved in opposite directions through the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism, so that spreading of the cooling cloth is realized; 2) Placing jasmine flower petals on a spreading cooling cloth; 3) The lifting rod of the cam mechanism is enabled to realize lifting and reciprocating movement through the third driving mechanism, so that the spreading cooling cloth is vibrated at different places to achieve the purpose of spreading jasmine flower petals; 4) After the jasmine flower petals are spread and cooled, the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism respectively enable the sliding plate cloth cover fixing plates to move in opposite directions, so that spreading and cooling cloth is folded. The device simple structure is convenient to be used for carrying out the stand cooling to jasmine flower heap and handles.

title_en: Centrifugal oat frying device and frying process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal oat frying device and a frying process, and belongs to the technical field of oat processing, wherein the frying device comprises at least two stepped fixed woks, a rotary stirring device and a heating device, wherein the rotary stirring device is positioned at the upper part of each wok and used for circumferentially stirring oat in the wok, a collecting port is arranged between two adjacent woks, the collecting port is a channel for the oat to enter a low-position wok from a high-position wok, and a conveying pipeline for the oat is arranged at the upper part of the highest-position wok; the frying process and the oat frying procedure are carried out in the centrifugal oat frying device. The invention adopts the running water type operation, the rotary stir-frying mode, the stir-frying is uniform, the automation degree is high, the labor intensity is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic tea leaf dehumidifying device is taken out at thin stand
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic thin tea leaf spreading and dehumidifying device which comprises a thin spreading mechanism and a dehumidifying mechanism, wherein the thin spreading mechanism is fixedly arranged on the dehumidifying mechanism, the thin spreading mechanism comprises a front fixing seat, a rear fixing seat, a driving shaft, a fixing shaft, a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a driving belt, a raking rack and a motor, the dehumidifying mechanism comprises a hollow rectangular wall support, a movable support, a thin plate, a conveying mechanism, a fan and a cylinder, the front fixing seat is fixedly arranged on two sides of the front end of the hollow rectangular wall support, the rear fixing seat is fixedly arranged on two sides of the rear end of the hollow rectangular wall support, the movable supports are respectively arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the hollow rectangular wall support through hinges, the upper end of each movable support is fixedly connected with the thin plate, and the conveying mechanism and the fan are both arranged in. The invention integrates the functions of spreading fresh tea leaves, quickly dehumidifying and conveying, realizes the automatic production of the tea leaves, greatly reduces the labor intensity and improves the production efficiency of the tea leaves.

title_en: New application of thymol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of feed additives, and particularly relates to a new application of thymol. The invention provides a new application of thymol in dissolving yeast cell walls and improving the content of yeast cell wall polysaccharide, and also provides a feed additive comprising thymol and yeast cells. The method solves the technical defects of the existing method for removing aflatoxin in the feed, such as reduction of feed nutritive value, environmental pollution, single method, complex process and higher cost. The obtained feed additive can efficiently adsorb the aflatoxin in the feed, and is green and pollution-free. Meanwhile, the method for preparing the feed additive has the advantages of simple process and low cost.

title_en: Selected composite vitamin health product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a health food which has the effect of assisting in preventing cardiovascular diseases or has a health-care function. The health food of the invention is prepared from vitamin A, vitamin D and vitamin B 12 And proper auxiliary materials, wherein the content of vitamin A is 160-800 mug, the content of vitamin D is 2-15 mug, and vitamin B 12 The content is 0.5 to 10 μ g. The invention has the advantages that: the functional relevant vitamins are selected, the formula is scientific and reasonable, the components have efficacy synergistic effect, and the health-care food is used for assisting in preventing cardiovascular diseases and embodies the advantage of accurate nutrition.

title_en: Chocolate slurry temperature regulating and controlling system
abstract_en: The chocolate slurry temperature regulation and control system comprises a heat exchanger, an external heat exchanger water inlet pipe and a heat exchanger water outlet pipe, wherein a filter is arranged on a pipeline of the water inlet pipe, a water inlet of a heating water tank is connected with the water inlet pipe through a connecting pipe, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a connecting pipeline of the water inlet of the heating water tank and the water inlet pipe, a manual ball valve is arranged on the outer wall of the heating water tank, a water pump is arranged on a loop of the heat exchanger water inlet pipe, the heat exchanger is accommodated in an inner cavity of a chocolate slurry tank, and each group of chocolate slurry tanks is independently connected with the heating water tank through the heat exchanger water inlet pipe and the heat exchanger water outlet pipe in a pipeline manner, so that each group of chocolate slurry tanks realizes respective temperature regulation and control, and the practical requirements according to a plurality of groups of production lines are met.

title_en: Pharmaceutical and food compositions for inducing satiety and prolonging satiety in a subject in need thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to pharmaceutical and food compositions for inducing satiety and prolonging satiety in a subject in need thereof. In particular, the present invention relates to a method of inducing satiety in a subject in need thereof comprising administering to the subject an effective amount of the ClpB protein or an effective amount of a bacterium that expresses the ClpB protein.

title_en: Vitamin composition suitable for accurate nutrition of middle-aged and elderly people
abstract_en: The invention provides a vitamin composition consisting of vitamin A, K, B12 and edible auxiliary materials, wherein the content of vitamin A is 200-1200 mug, the content of vitamin K is 20-10 mg, and the content of vitamin B12 is 5-50 mug. The invention selects the vitamins with related functions, has scientific and reasonable formula, has efficacy synergistic effect among the components, and is suitable for middle-aged and elderly people to improve immunity and prevent osteoporosis and cardiovascular diseases.

title_en: Lactase microcapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactase microcapsule and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of food processing. The lactase is used as a core material, kappa-carrageenan and sodium alginate are used as wall materials, and CaCl is used as the wall material 2 And epsilon-polylysine is used as a curing agent of colloidal particles, kappa-carrageenan is used as a film coating agent, epsilon-polylysine is used as a surface hardening agent, and the lactase microcapsules are prepared by preparing lactase glue solution, ultrasonically defoaming, spraying and granulating, curing, coating and hardening for the second time and drying. The invention has reasonable technology, the obtained product has the performance of being stable in the stomach and dissolving and releasing lactase in the small intestine, and the product has fine particles, good fluidity and dispersibility and good quality, can be widely applied to the people with lactose intolerance, and has good expected economic and social benefits.

title_en: Food particle suspension cold sterilization and/or disinfestation equipment, method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a food particle suspension cold sterilization and/or deinsectization device, a method and application thereof. The invention has exquisite design, and the food particles are in a suspension state by generating air flow through the diffusion device, so that the food particles are prevented from being piled up together, thereby ensuring that the food particles are fully exposed in a radio frequency electric field and uniformly receive radio frequency energy, realizing uniform sterilization and/or deinsectization, ensuring the effectiveness and the sufficiency of sterilization and/or deinsectization, and simultaneously, the radio frequency sterilization and/or deinsectization can also keep more nutritional ingredients and flavors such as color, aroma, taste, shape and the like.

title_en: Gradient separation and comprehensive utilization method of puffball active ingredients
abstract_en: The invention provides a gradient separation and comprehensive utilization method of puffball active ingredients, which comprises the following steps: lasiosphaera Seu Calvatia is firstly extracted by ethanol to obtain crude extract and extraction residue, and the crude extract is evaporated and concentrated to obtain ethanol and extract. The extract is eluted by different polar solvents in sections to obtain different extraction parts, and the different extraction parts are evaporated and concentrated to separate the solvents to obtain a plurality of subdivided extracts. The subdivided extract is repeatedly eluted in stages to obtain a single-component extract, and the single-component extract is separated from the solvent to obtain a pure monomer compound. The crude extract, various extraction parts, subdivided extract and monomer compound obtained by the method can be respectively used as products of different grades according to different properties, and the extraction residue can also be used for manufacturing livestock and poultry feed, materials for cultivating edible fungi or organic fertilizers and the like. The various solvents can be evaporated for recycling. The method has high utilization rate of puffball, zero emission, no environmental pollution, and high comprehensive benefit.

title_en: Preparation method of pumpkin flower wine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of pumpkin flower wine, and belongs to the field of wine brewing. The method comprises the following steps: soaking pumpkin flower in water, and treating with a microwave drying sterilizer; adding malt saccharification liquid and saccharomycete liquid to the pre-treated pumpkin flower, saccharifying in a closed condition, and adding saccharomyces cerevisiae for fermentation to obtain semi-solid fermented mash; adding beer yeast into the semi-solid fermented mash, adding cellulase and water, and fermenting to obtain liquid fermented mash; adding the pretreated pumpkin flowers into the liquid fermented mash, and fermenting to obtain mature mash; adding malt powder and malt saccharification liquid into the mature mash for fermentation, and then adding pretreated pumpkin flowers for fermentation to obtain final mash; and finally filtering the mash to obtain the finished pumpkin flower wine. The invention uses pumpkin flower as raw material, and uses new technique to produce wine with unique taste, and keeps the health-care functional components of pumpkin.

title_en: Process for comprehensively processing acorns by biological enzyme method and application of obtained products
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for comprehensive processing and utilization of acorns by a biological enzyme method. The invention relates to a process for comprehensively processing acorns by a biological enzyme method, which comprises the following steps of debitterizing and deastringent treatment of acorn kernels, pulping to obtain slurry and filter residues, filtering the slurry, debitterizing and deastringent treatment again to obtain acorn starch; adding biological enzyme into the obtained filter residue for enzymolysis to obtain acorn polysaccharide, adding compound protease for continuous enzymolysis to obtain acorn polypeptide. The acorn is processed by adopting the method of the invention, and the acorn starch with more thorough debitterizing and deastringency is obtained; in addition, the filter residue generated in acorn starch processing is subjected to biological enzyme method treatment to obtain acorn polysaccharide and acorn polypeptide, wherein the acorn polysaccharide can be applied to the food processing industry, and the acorn polypeptide can be applied to the cosmetic industry.

title_en: Antrodia camphorata strain and preservation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and relates to an antrodia camphorata strain and a preservation method thereof. The antrodia camphorata strain preservation method includes inoculating antrodia camphorata strain into 60-100mL of liquid culture medium by an inoculation amount of 5-10%, culturing for 5-10 days on a constant-temperature shaking table with the temperature of 25-30 ℃ and the humidity of 40-80% at the rotating speed of 80-150rpm to obtain antrodia camphorata activated bacterium liquid, coating the antrodia camphorata bacterium liquid on a slant solid culture medium for culturing, statically culturing for 10-15 days in a constant-temperature constant-humidity incubator with the temperature of 25-30 ℃ and the humidity of 40-80%, pouring sterile 20-50% glycerol into a slant test tube after mycelia grow out spores, scraping the spores by a spatula, uniformly mixing the mycelia with a glycerol solution, placing the tube into a sterile centrifuge tube, covering the tube with a cover, sealing the tube by a sealing film, placing the tube into a refrigerator with the temperature of-18 ℃ for precooling for 3-5 hours, and then transferring the tube into a refrigerator with the.

title_en: Health-care Pu' er tea bag and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health-care Pu 'er tea bag and a processing technology thereof, which is characterized in that gastrodia elata, lucid ganoderma and dried dragon fruit flowers are crushed into particles by a crusher and mixed with high-quality Pu' er loose tea (cooked tea) after being matched, wherein the gastrodia elata accounts for 6% of the finished product, the lucid ganoderma accounts for 3% of the finished product and the dried dragon fruit flowers account for 1% of the finished product, and then the mixture is crushed, roasted and the like to be finally molded and packaged. The method is simple and convenient to operate, has high feasibility, provides a more convenient use mode for fully exerting the medicinal health care efficacy of the Pu 'er tea, the gastrodia elata, the ganoderma lucidum and the pitaya flower, and the prepared health care Pu' er tea has the efficacies of clearing away heat and toxic materials, building the body, dispelling wind and dredging collaterals and delaying senescence, and has good effects of treating dizziness and blackness, accelerating the digestion and conversion of vivotoxin and preventing and resisting cancers.

title_en: Method for inducing and culturing calluses of stem segments of holboellia latifolia
abstract_en: The callus inducing culture method of the stem segment of the holboellia latifolia comprises the technical links of explant browning resistance, disinfection, axillary bud inducing culture, callus inducing culture, subculture proliferation culture and the like, and the method takes tender stem segments with axillary buds which just germinate for 7-15 days as the explant, and the explant is soaked by antioxidant vitamin C and then soaked and disinfected by potassium permanganate aqueous solution to improve the disinfection treatment mode, so that the browning rate and the pollution rate of the explant are remarkably reduced, and the survival rate of the explant through primary induction inoculation reaches 90%. By adding 1.5g.L into 1/2MS culture medium ‑1 Activated carbon and 2.0g.L ‑1 The polyvinylpyrrolidone combines with hormone formulas screened at different stages, can ensure that the callus induced differentiation rate reaches more than 90 percent, can simultaneously perform subculture proliferation on the callus and the cluster buds, and has the proliferation coefficient of more than 3.0. The method can provide technical reference for carrying out new variety mutagenesis cultivation and good variety rapid seedling cultivation by utilizing callus culture.

title_en: Active substance composition for feed, feed additive, feed and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active substance composition for feed, a feed additive, feed and a preparation method, wherein the active substance composition for feed comprises functional oligosaccharide, an acidifier, triglyceride, probiotics, aloe dry powder, medlar powder and momordica grosvenori powder; the active substance composition for the feed comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1-9 parts of functional oligosaccharide, 4-8 parts of acidifier, 4-8 parts of triglyceride, 2-6 parts of probiotics, 10-18 parts of aloe dry powder, 10-20 parts of medlar powder and 18-26 parts of momordica grosvenori powder. The invention also provides a feed additive or feed prepared from the active substance composition for the feed and a preparation method thereof. The feed additive or the feed provided by the invention can improve the immunity, health state and growth performance of piglets.

title_en: Pretreatment method of oranges
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pretreatment method of oranges, which comprises the following steps: soaking the oranges in ethylene solution, and storing the soaked oranges in a storage environment with a carbon dioxide absorbent, or storing the soaked oranges in a storage environment with a carbon dioxide concentration not higher than 0.3%. The method has the advantages of good debitterizing effect, convenient operation, controllable conditions, and no influence on orange juice flavor. The orange is pretreated by the method and then is squeezed, so that the squeezing quality can be improved, the bitter taste of the orange is reduced, the limonin content in the orange is low, and the basic indexes of sugar, acid, VC, color and luster and the abnormal taste component ethanol of the orange juice are not influenced.

title_en: Cultivation method of virus-resistant interspecific introgression line of sweet potatoes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivation method of virus-resistant interspecific introgression lines of sweet potatoes. The method utilizes the extensive-affinity parent Xushu 18 to perform interspecific hybridization with antiviral sweet potato wild seeds, obtains interspecific hybrid seedling seeds on the basis of ensuring the hybridization quantity and utilizing the hybridization treatment fluid for treatment, and then obtains the hybrid F 1 Tracking and identifying the colony, selecting SPVD-resistant true hybrid as female parent, and using Xushu 18 as recurrent parent to make continuous backcross for 3 generations to construct BC 3 F 1 Population, final pair BC 3 F 1 Carrying out resistance identification and marker analysis on the population to obtain a virus-resistant introgression population BC 3 F 1 . The invention breaks through the traditional sweet potato genetic population construction method, widens the sweet potato genetic basis, can construct a high-density genetic map in a smaller population scale, and reduces the cost of manpower and material resources such as excessive markers. Meanwhile, the method can be used for the improvement of SPVD-resistant varieties.

title_en: Hard butter, chocolate using same, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing chocolate which utilizes the properties of fat and oil, has a soft texture, and has an excellent texture when melted in the mouth. In particular, it is intended to provide a chocolate which has a crispy and soft texture and an excellent texture when melted in the mouth, which have not been achieved conventionally, by baking. The chocolate contains 30-73 mass% of palm kernel oil fractionated soft oil having an iodine value of 21-29, and has a solid fat content of 5% or less at 35 ℃.

title_en: Tea aroma raising device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea processing equipment, and particularly discloses a tea aroma raising device which comprises an aroma raising barrel, wherein the aroma raising barrel comprises an inner barrel and an outer barrel, a heating cavity is formed between the inner barrel and the outer barrel, a plurality of heating holes are formed in the side wall of the inner barrel, a heat supply mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the aroma raising barrel, a vertical shaft is connected to the top of the aroma raising barrel, a tray is fixedly connected to the vertical shaft, a stirring unit comprises a cross rod, one end of the cross rod is connected with a first bevel gear, the first bevel gear is meshed with a second bevel gear, and a stirring plate is fixed on the cross rod; the tray below is equipped with the striker plate, the fixed scraper blade that is equipped with on the vertical axis, and scraper blade bottom and striker plate surface laminating are equipped with the magnetism ejector pad in scraper blade counter-clockwise one side, are connected with the spring between magnetism ejector pad and the vertical axis, and the striker plate is inlayed and is had the magnetism locating piece, is equipped with the hole of slagging tap on the inlayer bucket, and the hole of slagging tap is tangent with the striker plate. The invention does not need additional screening process, and recycles the tea dust to improve the quality of the tea.

title_en: Fructus amomi and fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae tabletting candy and making method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fructus amomi and fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae tabletting candy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: mixing fructus Amomi and fructus Alpinae Oxyphyllae, squeezing to obtain juice, and adding pectinase to obtain fruit pulp; activating yeast, adding into the fruit pulp, adjusting sugar degree, and fermenting at room temperature to obtain fermentation broth; sterilizing part of fermentation broth, inoculating acetic acid bacteria and lactobacillus, culturing for 48 hr, pouring into the rest fermentation broth, sealing, and fermenting for more than 2 months; spray drying the fermentation liquor to obtain raw material powder, mixing with other auxiliary materials, granulating, and making into fructus Amomi and fructus Alpinae Oxyphyllae tablet candy. According to the invention, the medicinal and edible fructus amomi and the fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae are applied to the preparation of the tablet candy, so that the taste of the public is enriched, the health is ensured, the requirements of modern people on pursuing healthy and nutritional diet are met, the healthy food development concept is conformed, and the comprehensive utilization of characteristic resources in Lingnan is expanded.

title_en: Composition comprising 2FL and LNnT for controlling food intake and growth in infants or young children
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nutritional composition comprising at least one fucosylated oligosaccharide and at least one N-acetylated oligosaccharide for use in reducing and/or controlling food intake of an infant or a young child, and/or for use in promoting healthy growth of an infant or a young child.

title_en: CRISPR/Cpf1 system-mediated homologous recombination method taking RNA transcript as repair template
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CRISPR/Cpf1 system-mediated homologous recombination method taking RNA transcripts as repair templates. The invention takes the ALS gene of rice as a research object to construct a homologous recombination vector. RCR1-RCR2-RDR fragments are transcribed in vitro, and the RNA transcripts are used as repair templates by an RNP method, so that the homologous recombination repair of target genes is realized in the healing of rice. Meanwhile, a gene gun method is utilized to introduce the vector into the rice healed to obtain the ALS gene site-directed modified rice plant. The result shows that the RNA serving as a repair template can successfully mediate homologous recombination of a target gene, and a new thought is provided for crop breeding, so that the RNA has strong application potential in the aspect of agricultural breeding.

title_en: Tissue culture method for increasing effective young shoot differentiation number of golden mountain ash
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant tissue culture, and particularly relates to a tissue culture method for increasing the number of effective young shoots of golden mountain ash. The method utilizes a group of combined culture media to improve the number of the new shoot differentiation of the golden mountain ash, and the combined culture media comprise an induction culture medium, a differentiation culture medium and a growth culture medium. The tissue culture method for improving the new shoot differentiation number of the golden mountain ash comprises the following steps: establishing a sterile system, subculturing in a two-step relay mode, inducing rooting culture, hardening seedlings, transplanting and the like. According to the tissue culture method of the golden mountain poplar, on one hand, the components of the culture medium are optimized and adjusted, on the other hand, the culture mode is adjusted in the process of subculture, and the tissue culture seedling is subcultured in the specific culture medium in a two-step relay mode, so that the total culture time is not prolonged, the processes of proliferation and growth are considered, the number of effective young shoots is increased, and the vitrification phenomenon in the process of tissue culture is avoided better.

title_en: Breeding method of indica rice restorer line with strong rice blast resistance and strong superiority
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breeding method of a strong-superiority indica rice restorer line capable of resisting rice blast, belonging to the technical field of crop genetic breeding. The method relates to a method for breeding a new rice blast resistant strong dominant restoring line by taking a first indica rice restoring line parent (Huazhan) with rice blast resistance, excellent comprehensive agronomic characters, strong superiority and good combining ability as a rice blast resistant gene donor parent, taking a second indica rice restoring line parent (Huazhan) which is not resistant to rice blast, excellent comprehensive agronomic characters, strong superiority and good combining ability as a receptor parent, hybridizing, taking the first parent (Huazhan) as a recurrent parent, backcrossing once, detecting rice blast resistant genes such as Pi2, Pi54, Pid3, Pita and Pib contained in the first indica rice restoring line (Huazhan) by using molecular markers, breeding a new rice blast resistant strong dominant restoring line by synthesizing agronomic characters and rice blast resistance identification results, and further pairing with different sterile lines to breed a rice blast resistant high-quality hybrid new rice blast resistant rice combination, thereby improving the rice blast resistance of the first hybrid generation and meeting the requirements of current rice production.

title_en: Bioactive polypeptide DQDLVLI and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of proteins, and particularly relates to a bioactive polypeptide DQDLVLI, a preparation method and application thereof. In-vitro anti-inflammatory activity experiments and in-vivo anti-aging experiments prove that the polypeptide DQDLVLI has better anti-inflammatory activity and anti-aging activity, and on one hand, the bioactive polypeptide DQDLVLI can promote macrophages to secrete cytokines, promote the increase of the induced amount of nitric oxide of the macrophages, improve the capability of the organism to resist the infection of external pathogens and reduce the morbidity of the organism; on the other hand, the activity of an anti-peroxidase system in vivo can be improved, and the function of resisting exogenous stimulation of the organism is enhanced, so that the probability of aging, aging and illness of the organism is reduced, and the method has very important significance for developing foods, health-care products and medicines with anti-inflammatory and anti-aging functions.

title_en: Intelligent solanaceae vegetable picking system based on unmanned aerial vehicle and TOF imaging technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligence solanaceae vegetables system of picking based on unmanned aerial vehicle and TOF imaging technique, including unmanned aerial vehicle device, storage device, pick the device, protector, washing unit, recognition device, closing device, wireless device and control center, unmanned aerial vehicle device includes the unmanned aerial vehicle warehouse and picks unmanned aerial vehicle, storage device still includes coupling mechanism, vegetables storage storehouse, pick arm, pick the passageway, storage channel and pick storage storehouse, pick the device and include cutting motor, cutting pipeline and flexible cutting blade, protector includes protection storage chamber, first protection passageway, protection flexible motor and protection expansion plate, washing unit includes washing storage storehouse, washing nozzle, washing pipe, water supply head, water supply storage storehouse, water supply flexible hose and drainage channel, recognition device includes first camera, second camera and TOF sensor, closing device includes storage closed motor, The storage sealing plate, the picking sealing motor and the picking sealing plate are arranged in the planning position.

title_en: Rice noodle processing production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rice noodle processing, in particular to a rice noodle processing production line, which comprises a positioning bearing device, a rice noodle stirring device, a rice noodle discharging device and a fixed-length shearing device arranged at the output end of the rice noodle discharging device, wherein the rice noodle stirring device comprises a positioning stirring part, a containing part and a self-heating conveying part communicated with the containing part, a feeding port for the rice noodle to be stirred to enter is also arranged at the side of the containing part, the rice noodle discharging device comprises a discharging stirring part and a fixed-length discharging part arranged at the discharging end of the discharging stirring part, the discharging stirring part is communicated with the discharging end of the containing part, the fixed-length shearing device comprises a rice noodle conveying part and a shearing part arranged at the output end of the rice noodle conveying part, and the positioning discharging part is in butt joint with the rice noodle conveying part under the working state. According to the invention, the rice noodle processing devices are sequentially processed, so that the rice noodle making speed can be increased, and the manual output is reduced in the rice noodle making process.

title_en: Method for shortening lactic acid bacteria lag phase in fermented milk production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for shortening lactic acid bacteria lag phase in fermented milk production, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) adding part of milk to be fermented into a mixing tank, and adding oligosaccharide; (2) mixing, homogenizing, filtering, sterilizing, cooling, and transferring to seeding tank; (3) inoculating lactase and neutral protease for hydrolysis; (4) after hydrolysis, enzyme deactivation is carried out, lactobacillus powder is inoculated after cooling, and stirring is carried out until the strains are recovered; (5) conveying the mixture into a fermentation tank by using a sterile centrifugal pump, and uniformly mixing the mixture with the blended milk to be fermented for fermentation. The invention not only shortens the production time of the fermented milk, but also improves the viable count of the final product and prolongs the survival time of the lactobacillus in the shelf life of the product.

title_en: Method for extracting mycotoxins from cereals, other food and feed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for the extraction of mycotoxins from cereals and other food or from feed and the subsequent quantification thereof. The application fields are food industry, feed industry or biotechnology. The object of the invention is to develop an extraction method with which mycotoxins with different solubility characteristics can be extracted in a single operation. It has been shown that hydrophobic as well as hydrophilic mycotoxins can be extracted with the aid of aqueous, buffered naphthalene and/or benzene compounds or heterocyclic analogues thereof. The method according to the invention is characterized in that a buffered solution of a naphthalene compound and/or a benzene compound and/or a heterocyclic analogue thereof having at least one sulfonic acid group or at least one carboxylic acid group is contacted with the cereal or other food or feed, followed by separating the aqueous solution and determining the content of the extracted mycotoxins in the aqueous solution.

title_en: High-fiber nutrition powder with intestinal tract adjusting function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-fiber nutrition powder with an intestinal tract adjusting function and a preparation method thereof, the high-fiber nutrition powder mainly contains lactic acid bacteria fermentation products, fibers and dictyophora mycelium polysaccharide, the bamboo shoot shells and/or the bamboo shoot heads are treated by high temperature and lactic acid bacteria, then dictyophora is used for fermentation, the decomposition and conversion effects of mycelium growth on raw material fibers are further utilized, and finally, a product with good taste, rich nutrition and the intestinal tract adjusting function is formed, and the preparation method is simple and easy.

title_en: Smoking liquid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smoking solution and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: heating the smoked raw materials to a dry distillation temperature by adopting sectional steps for dry distillation; the sectional type step heating at least adopts four steps, the temperature of each step is increased by 100-200 ℃, and the dry distillation temperature is 300-700 ℃. The preparation method has simple process, can effectively improve the quality of the product, can greatly reduce energy consumption, and effectively protects the environment; the prepared liquid smoke product can be applied to meat products in two modes of internal addition and external spraying, so that the product has good color and flavor, no benzo (alpha) pyrene is detected in the product, and the safety is good.

title_en: Preparation method of algae oil starch high internal phase emulsion capable of preventing DHA oxidation
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of algae oil starch high internal phase emulsion for preventing DHA oxidation. The invention is characterized in that DHA in the emulsion is protected by adopting a dynamic gas environment, and natural oxidation and temperature protection of DHA are carried out by utilizing the low boiling point of ethanol and ammonia gas, so that grease deterioration of the emulsion during storage is avoided, and the shelf life of the product is prolonged. The product of the invention can be used as but not limited to beverages, nutrition enhancers, health and oral liquids, and pharmaceutical grade oral liquids.

title_en: Magnesium ion as an antimicrobial agent
abstract_en: Compositions comprising magnesium-rich liquids are provided. In particular, compositions comprising magnesium-enriched milk and/or milk products and methods of producing the same are provided, wherein the concentration of magnesium ions in the milk and/or milk products ranges from 8mM to 25mM.

title_en: Culture method of Goldfish with arch-shaped back water bubbles
abstract_en: The invention provides a culture method of golden fish with arch-shaped back water-soaked eyes, which comprises the following steps: (1) selecting a culture pond; (2) fry breeding: feeding the red-spotted insects and the compound feed in a combined manner; (3) screening fish fries; (4) daily management; (5) preventing and treating diseases. The invention starts from the aspects of enhancing the bait and regulating and controlling the water depth, so that the blister develops moderately, thereby achieving the effect of improving the quality of the blister. Through the control to the depth of water, mould the back of the body type of fish, bow the back of the body, more have the radian. Meanwhile, the quality of the individual is further improved by combining the standard culture technology in other aspects. The method has strong guiding effect on the cultivation and practical popularization of the bow-backed blister strain goldfish, and is beneficial to the large-scale cultivation and popularization of the goldfish.

title_en: Livestock feed or livestock supplement, growth promoter for Lactobacillus bacteria, and growth promoting method for Lactobacillus bacteria
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a livestock feed or a livestock supplement that improves the intestinal environment of livestock without supplying bacteria from the outside, more specifically, that can increase the proportion of bacteria of the genus lactobacillus in intestinal bacteria, a growth promoter for bacteria of the genus lactobacillus, and a method for promoting the growth of bacteria of the genus lactobacillus. According to the present invention, there is provided a livestock feed or livestock supplement containing at least one of a salacia plant, a salacia plant extract and a salacia plant pulverized product, and used for promoting the growth of lactobacillus bacteria in livestock.

title_en: Bimetallic material immobilized phosphotungstic acid catalyst, preparation method and application in cellulose hydrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bimetallic material immobilized phosphotungstic acid catalyst, a preparation method and application in cellulose hydrolysis. The method is characterized in that transition metal ions Ni are introduced when organic ligands are coordinated with metal 2+ With the central metal ion Cr 3+ Forming competitive coordination, adding organic acid to promote the coordination of the composite bimetal MOFs, simultaneously playing the role of a mineralizer and introducing-NH 2 The PTA is chemically immobilized through electrostatic interaction with phosphotungstic acid, and the catalyst is synthesized; the catalyst realizes the directional conversion of cellulose to glucose by forming a hydrogen bond with cellulose through a strong electronegative group to adsorb the cellulose. Meanwhile, the hydrogen bonding can weaken the hydrogen bonding inside the cellulose, reduce the crystallinity of the cellulose, enable the cellulose to be easier to hydrolyze and improve the hydrolysis efficiency. The catalyst synthesis process does not need to add HF acid, sodium hydroxide and other solutions, and is green and environment-friendly.

title_en: Prefabricated fish meat modifier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preformed fish flesh modifier and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preformed fish flesh modifier comprises, by mass, 0.05-1.5% of ligusticum wallichii, 0.05-3% of purple perilla, 0.05-3% of ginger powder, 0.1-0.5% of composite phosphate and the balance of water, wherein the total mass of the raw materials is 100%. Adding ligusticum wallichii, purple perilla and ginger into water, soaking for 20-90 min, adding composite phosphate, placing in a stainless steel container, sealing, boiling for 15-40 min, quickly cooling to 0-5 ℃, and filtering to obtain the prefabricated fish flesh modifier. Aiming at the problem that common additives cannot be directly used for processing the aquatic product prefabricated products in the field of aquatic product processing, the invention screens the ligusticum wallichii, the purple perilla and the ginger from the spices for the first time to prepare the prefabricated fish meat quality modifier, has the effects of promoting collagen crosslinking and inhibiting collagenase, and has the advantages of difficult loosening of fish, increased hardness, weakened fish fishy smell and reduced allergenicity to a certain extent.

title_en: Meal replacement powder for improving intestinal flora and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses meal replacement powder for improving intestinal flora and application thereof. The dietary composition provided by the invention comprises at least one selected from the group consisting of kudzuvine root powder, coix seed powder, lily powder, inulin and balsam pear powder. The product can achieve the effect of reducing blood sugar by adjusting intestinal microorganisms of the people with T2D diabetes mellitus, and the raw materials are common food materials without toxic or side effects, so that daily needs of people are met, and the purpose of health can be achieved.

title_en: Extrusion screw rod puffing cavity structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an extrusion screw rod puffing cavity structure which comprises a puffing cavity and a screw rod accommodated in the cavity, and is characterized in that the puffing cavity comprises a feeding conveying cavity, a first section of high-temperature heating cavity, a second section of high-temperature heating cavity, a low-temperature heating cavity and a third section of high-temperature heating cavity which are sequentially distributed from a feeding end to a discharging end, wherein a first section of high-temperature heating resistance wire, a second section of high-temperature heating resistance wire and a third section of high-temperature heating resistance wire are respectively arranged outside the cavity walls of the first section of high-temperature heating cavity, the second section of high-temperature heating resistance wire and the third section of high-temperature heating resistance wire, a refrigerant accommodating cavity is arranged outside the cavity wall of the low-temperature heating cavity, and the cavity wall of the low-temperature heating cavity is inwards concave to form a material channel with the diameter gradually reduced and then gradually increased. The cavity structure comprises four sections of heating cavities, namely a first section of high-temperature heating cavity, a second section of high-temperature heating cavity, a low-temperature heating cavity and a third section of high-temperature heating cavity, so that materials discharged from the cavity structure can be heated and cooled for the second time through heating processes of heating, cooling, warming and cooling, and the second warming and cooling of the materials can be realized, and the expanded products with better quality can be obtained.

title_en: Small-size ozone water preparation system suitable for fruit vegetables washs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-sized ozone water preparation system suitable for cleaning fruits and vegetables, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a water tank is arranged at one end part of the top end of the bottom plate, an ozone generator is arranged at the other end part of the top end of the bottom plate, a gas-liquid mixing pump is arranged at the position between the bottom plate top corresponding to the water tank and the ozone generator.

title_en: Lactonase and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: Novel lactonases are provided.

title_en: Refrigerator with fruit and vegetable callus function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refrigerator with a fruit and vegetable callus function and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of refrigerators. The invention comprises a callus cabin, wherein the callus cabin comprises a healing chamber, an air control chamber and a humidifying chamber, the healing chamber is respectively connected with the air control chamber and the humidifying chamber, a heating pipe and a cooling pipe are arranged in the air control chamber, and a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are arranged in the healing chamber. The invention provides a special functional area for a refrigerator user to heal the damaged tissues of fruits and vegetables, places the fruits and vegetables subjected to mechanical damage into the special functional area for healing, and provides the healing treatment temperature and humidity to enable the injured or scratched wounds of the fruits and vegetables to quickly form a wood plug layer so as to heal the surface layer, thereby effectively preventing the invasion of germs such as black spot disease, improving the resistance of the fruits and vegetables to low temperature and improving the storage performance. Meanwhile, a storage environment is provided for the fruits and vegetables according to the proper storage temperature and humidity, and the storage quality is greatly improved.

title_en: Advanced encapsulation method for controlling release of active ingredients of chewing gum
abstract_en: The present invention provides chewing gum components for chewing gum compositions that include a component body and a plurality of regions of at least one active ingredient encapsulated within an encapsulating material. The plurality of regions are disposed within the component body. An average active concentration of less than 15% of the component body is in contact with the outer surface of the component body.

title_en: Bivalent RNAi expression vector for constructing TYLCV and ToCV by Gateway technology and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bivalent RNAi expression vector for constructing TYLCV and ToCV by using Gateway technology and application thereof. The bivalent RNAi expression vector is named pRNAi-TOCV-TY. The nucleotide sequence of the RNAi expression vector is shown as SEQ ID NO. 5. According to the invention, a great deal of research work is carried out by utilizing RNAi technology, a double RNAi expression vector of the coat protein genes of TYLCV and ToCV is constructed by using Gateway technology, and transgenic tomato plants resistant to two viruses are obtained by experimental methods such as genetic transformation, resistance identification and the like. The invention further discloses application of the pRNAi-TOCV-TY expression vector in effectively preventing and treating tomato infected by ToCV and TYLCV. In particular to the application of pRNAi-TOCV-TY expression vector in effectively preventing the replication of tomato viruses in plants.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 and application thereof, wherein the lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 can be rapidly fixedly planted in intestinal tracts, so that fasting blood glucose and oral glucose tolerance caused by type II diabetes mellitus are remarkably improved, and the area under a curve when the glucose tolerance is reduced; the increase of total cholesterol and the reduction of high density lipoprotein cholesterol in serum caused by type II diabetes are obviously improved; remarkably improving the insulin resistance caused by type II diabetes; significantly improve the level of inflammation in type ii diabetic liver tissue; the pathological damage of tissues such as pancreas, liver and the like caused by type II diabetes is obviously improved; the lactobacillus rhamnosus CCFM1064 has stronger adsorption capacity on the perfluorooctanoic acid and has the capacity of relieving the toxicity of the perfluorooctanoic acid; remarkably improve constipation caused by type II diabetes, can improve the level of Allobaculum in intestinal tract, and has effects of relieving anxiety, depression and colitis.

title_en: Benzocyclopentanone derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benzo-cyclopentanone derivative, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in inhibiting aflatoxin.

title_en: Preparation of umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell secretory factor and application thereof in hair growth
abstract_en: The application provides an application of an umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell secretory factor in promoting hair follicle repair and/or hair regeneration, wherein the umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell secretory factor is prepared by a method comprising the following steps: 1) before induction culture, carrying out subculture on the umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells; 2) removing the subculture medium, and performing induction culture by using a stem cell induction medium; 3) collecting the supernatant to obtain the umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell secretory factor. The umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell secretory factor has a remarkable effect on promoting hair follicle repair and/or hair regeneration.

title_en: Large-scale propagation method for Bactrocera cucurbitae larva parasitic wasp Choisy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale propagation method for Bactrocera cucurbitae larva parasitic wasp Chorispora frutescens, which comprises the following steps: 1) collecting adult melon fruit fly, 2) feeding adult melon fruit fly, 3) obtaining melon fruit fly eggs, 4) propagating melon fruit fly larvae, 5) feeding short dormitopsis fradori, 6) parasitizing the short dormitopsis fradorsalis: 7) parasitic hosts are collected, and 8) the Chouioia frutescens is cultivated. The method has simple process and low cost, can be operated indoors, can breed all the year round, is easy to popularize on a large scale, and effectively improves the parasitic capacity of the Braconidia furiosaeli.

title_en: Additive-free white eel food and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A preparation method of an additive-free white eel food is characterized by comprising the following steps: skin and surface roasting is carried out on the whole white eel which is cut, killed, head removed, bone removed, cleaned and washed; wherein the cleaning comprises cleaning viscera and dorsal fins; turning over the rice field eel, and roasting the rice field eel on the meat surface; performing leather surface punching treatment on the white eel subjected to meat surface roasting; cooking the pricked white eel to soften and ripen the meat of the white eel slices and achieve the sterilization effect; rapidly freezing the white eel to reduce the central temperature to-2 to-10 ℃; cutting the frozen rice field eel into slices, blocks or strips to finish the preparation. The method has the advantages that the non-additive white eel quick-frozen/frozen food can be obtained, the food is convenient and instant slices/blocks/strips, the meat quality is intact, inedible parts such as gill fins are not contained, the oil content is low, the eating requirement of modern consumers can be well met, and the eating mouthfeel is good.

title_en: Cloning of ZmNAC89 transcription factor gene and application thereof in improving saline-alkali tolerance and yield of corn
abstract_en: The invention discloses cloning of ZmNAC89 transcription factor gene and application thereof in improving saline-alkali tolerance and yield of corn. The ZmNAC89 transcription factor gene is located in the Bin7.05 region of the maize chromosome 7 and is subjected to NaCl and Na 2 CO 3 After stress such as ABA, PEG and the like, the expression level of the polypeptide is obviously increased. The gene has the total length of 2280bp and comprises 3 exons and 2 introns; the open reading frame is 1197bp, 398 amino acids are coded, the 5 '-UTR region is 163bp, and the 3' -UTR region is 253 bp; the encoded protein has a NAM protein conserved structural domain; the promoter comprises an abiotic adversity stress related element and belongs to a stress inducible promoter; the saline-alkali tolerance of the corn transformed with the ZmNAC89 gene is remarkably improved, and the weight of a hundred grains planted under the saline-alkali condition is remarkably increased. The invention provides an effective way for improving the saline-alkali tolerance of the corn by a transgenic method and further improving the yield of the corn in the saline-alkali soil.

title_en: Active freeze-dried powder for preventing and treating loquat postharvest diseases and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active freeze-dried powder capable of preventing and treating postharvest diseases of loquats and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological prevention and treatment of postharvest fruits; the freeze-dried powder comprises Metschnikowia pulcherrima E1, lactose, sodium glutamate, sorbitol and inulin; the method comprises the steps of firstly, inoculating activated Meiji yeast E1 into NYDB for enrichment culture, then centrifuging a culture solution to obtain bacterial sludge, then resuspending the bacterial sludge into bacterial suspension by using a protective agent solution, and performing vacuum freeze drying to obtain freeze-dried powder after subpackaging; the yeast is suspended in sterile water and adjusted to 1 × 10 concentration  8  And (5) soaking the loquats in the bacterial liquid for 5min, then taking out the loquats or directly and uniformly spraying the loquats on the surfaces of the loquats, and airing the loquats. The active freeze-dried powder can obviously reduce the incidence rate and the disease spot diameter of the loquat fruit gray leaf spot; but also can obviously reduce the rotting index of the loquat fruit; the weight loss rate of the fruits and the permeability of cell membranes of the peels are inhibited; and delays the reduction of soluble solids, titratable acid, soluble protein and Vc of the loquat fruits.

title_en: Yarrowia lipolytica and application thereof in preparation of low-sugar low-fat desiccated coconut nutrition powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses yarrowia lipolytica and application thereof in preparation of low-sugar low-fat desiccated coconut nutrition powder. The yarrowia lipolytica has a collection number of GDMCC No. 60782, and is collected in the Guangdong province microbial culture collection center of 5-building Guangdong province microbial research institute, Michelia Tokyo No. 100, Dazhou province, 59, in Guangzhou city, 9 and 20 days in 2019. The method comprises the steps of mixing desiccated coconut with water, and heating; pulping the heated desiccated coconut, homogenizing the obtained desiccated coconut, adjusting the pH value, and sterilizing to obtain a desiccated coconut suspension; inoculating a culture solution of yarrowia lipolytica into the cooled desiccated coconut suspension, and fermenting; and sterilizing the obtained fermentation liquor, spray-drying and crushing to obtain the low-sugar and low-fat desiccated coconut nutritional powder. The low-sugar low-fat desiccated coconut nutritional powder is rich in nutrition, low in sugar and fat, and strong in coconut flavor, and is suitable for serving as a brewing food for all people.

title_en: Food preparation appliance
abstract_en: An apparatus for heating food includes a base and a cover coupled to each other by an articulated handle. Two fluid-filled hot fluid containers having flexible surfaces are mounted in the lid and base to form a chamber for holding food products in the low temperature cooking container f. The hot fluid container may be replaced with a high temperature cooking plate to cauterize or brown the food product. During low temperature cooking, the appliance user is protected from exposure to the hot fluid that remains in the container.

title_en: Nutrient complementary type compound leaven and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutrient complementary type compound leaven, which comprises: debaryomyces hansenii, lactobacillus sake and staphylococcus xylosus, application of the nutrition complementary type compound leaven and fermented sausage prepared by applying the nutrition complementary type compound leaven. The nutrient complementary type compound starter has the advantages of 'nutrient complementation' of carbon source and nitrogen source, pH rising, community member survival pressure reduction and stable symbiosis among strains, and can achieve the purpose of regulating and controlling the formation of key flavor substances of the fermented sausage, so that the fermented sausage has better sensory characteristics.

title_en: Method for preparing reducing sugar and 5-HMF by catalyzing cellulose hydrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing reducing sugar and 5-hydroxymethylfurfural by catalyzing cellulose hydrolysis, which is implemented according to the following steps: adding cellulose, kaolin and distilled water into a high-pressure reaction kettle, sealing the high-pressure reaction kettle, controlling the reaction temperature at 180-220 ℃ for reaction, and separating after full reaction to obtain a reaction solution containing reducing sugar and 5-hydroxymethylfurfural. The method has the advantages of simple process, low cost and environmental protection.

title_en: Fleet of robotic vehicles for food product preparation
abstract_en: An autonomous robotic vehicle according to aspects of the present disclosure includes a transport system, a navigation system, a communication system configured to communicate with a food delivery management system, one or more storage modules including a storage compartment or storage sub-compartment configured to store food, one or more preparation modules including a preparation compartment or preparation sub-compartment configured to prepare food, a processor(s), and a memory storing instructions.
