The instructions, when executed by the processor(s), cause the autonomous robotic vehicle to autonomously receive a food order for a destination via a communication system, determine a travel route including the destination, control a transport system to travel along the travel route to reach the destination, and prepare food while traveling along the travel route.

title_en: Raw material high-temperature stir-frying equipment for nut meal replacement soup electuary processing and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature stir-frying device for processing nut meal-replacing soup granules and a use method thereof, wherein the high-temperature stir-frying device comprises a base and a stir-frying box movably connected above the base; a material baffle plate is connected in a material inlet of the top end surface of the stir-frying box in an adjustable manner; the inner side wall of the stir-frying box is divided into a stir-frying area and a material loading area from top to bottom through a partition plate, and a material control mechanism is arranged in a material flowing hole of the partition plate; a rotating shaft is rotatably connected in the stir-frying interval, a first driving mechanism for driving the rotating shaft is arranged on the stir-frying box, a stir-frying plate is fixedly connected to the outer circumferential side wall of the rotating shaft, and a heating plate is fixedly connected to the side wall of the stir-frying interval; the nut meal replacement spoon granules are stir-fried and charged, and workers can process the nut meal replacement spoon granules conveniently.

title_en: Oil and fat composition, oil-based food and method for producing the same, and bloom and granulating inhibitor and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil composition, an oily food, a method for producing the same, an inhibitor for bloom and granulation, and a method for producing the same. An inhibitor of bloom and pelletization which is effective in inhibiting the occurrence of bloom and pelletization originating from oils and fats contained in an oily food. The present invention provides a grease composition which satisfies the following conditions (a) to (c). The content of (a) C24-30 is 0.5-12% by mass. (b) The total content of HMM, HLM and HLL is 17 to 50 mass%. (c) The total content of HHM and HIL is 17 to 40 mass%.

title_en: Non-water-soluble fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-water-soluble fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing modified starch and water-soluble calcium salt in water for reaction, filtering and washing after the reaction is completed to obtain calcium-containing modified starch, and adding water for dissolving to prepare a water phase containing the calcium-containing modified starch; (2) Melting or dissolving the core material component containing the fat-soluble nutrient into an oil phase, and then mixing with the water phase obtained in the step (1) to obtain an emulsion; (3) And (3) adding sodium alginate into the emulsion obtained in the step (2), and granulating to obtain the water-insoluble fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule. The wall material component of the fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule does not contain protein components, but takes calcium-containing modified starch as the wall material component, and then adopts sodium alginate to carry out crosslinking film formation, thus obtaining the non-water-soluble characteristic and better stability.

title_en: Preparation method and preparation system of nanocrystallized fermented beverage
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and a preparation system of a nano fermented beverage, wherein the preparation method comprises an extraction procedure, wherein an edible material is extracted in an extraction medium at 10-35 ℃ and under an extraction pressure, and is processed to obtain a material to be fermented; a first fermentation procedure, namely adding a proper amount of the material to be fermented, a first fermentation strain and auxiliary raw materials into a fermentation tank, continuously fermenting for at least 60 days at the temperature of 20-35 ℃, and filtering at the end of the procedure to obtain a first fermentation solution; a second fermentation procedure, namely adding a second fermentation strain into the first fermentation liquid, and continuously fermenting for at least 180 days at the temperature of 15-35 ℃ to obtain a second fermentation liquid; a liquid molecule refining procedure, namely refining the liquid molecules by the second fermentation liquor through the catalytic reaction of the conversion catalyst material; and a flavor adjusting procedure, namely adding a flavoring agent into the second fermentation liquor after the liquid molecules are refined to adjust the flavor to obtain the nano fermented beverage.

title_en: Crocodile egg white hydrolysate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a crocodile egg white hydrolysate, which comprises chondroitin sulfate, amino acids and small molecule peptides, wherein the content of the chondroitin sulfate is 5.8% -25.8% by mass fraction of the crocodile egg white hydrolysate, and the amino acids and the small molecule peptides comprise: threonine, serine, valine, glutamic acid, methionine, glycine, lysine, histidine, isoleucine, arginine, leucine, alanine, tyrosine, proline, aspartic acid and tyrosine. The crocodile egg white hydrolysate scavenges free radicals; promoting regeneration of hippocampal nerve cells, promoting expression of BDNF and CREB1, activating phosphorylation of PKA, ERK and CREB1, and inhibiting expression of GSK-3; improving the mRNA expression of antioxidant enzyme in the hippocampus, and inhibiting acetylcholinesterase; improving anxiety-like behavior and memory deterioration behavior, and improving space exploration ability and object recognition ability.

title_en: Recombinant plasmid containing astaxanthin synthetase fusion gene and screening marker-free gene NPT II, recombinant bacterium and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a recombinant plasmid containing an astaxanthin synthetase fusion gene and a screening marker-free gene NPT II, a recombinant bacterium and application, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering breeding; the nucleotide sequence of the astaxanthin synthetase fusion gene is shown as SEQ ID NO: 1 is shown in the specification; the recombinant plasmid takes pBI121 as an original plasmid; the recombinant plasmid deletes the screening marker gene NPT II. The invention connects four astaxanthin synthesis key enzyme genes by using 2A short peptide sequences, can simplify the construction of recombinant plasmids (expression vectors) and realize the synergistic expression of each gene. In addition, the recombinant plasmid of the invention deletes the screening marker gene NPT II, and the safety of the recombinant plasmid for transgenosis is improved.

title_en: Separation process and application of natural free radical scavenger in saxifraga tangutica
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of separation of a natural free radical scavenger in saxifrage tangutica, in particular to a separation process and application of the natural free radical scavenger in saxifrage tangutica. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises six steps of extraction, coarse separation by a microporous resin column, screening of components of an on-line free radical scavenger, preparation of a reversed-phase preparation column, purification by a reversed-phase preparation liquid chromatography of Fr1-1 and purification by a hydrophilic/reversed-phase two-dimensional liquid chromatography of Fr 1-3. The invention has low cost and the product purity is more than 95 percent; the technical means adopted by the invention can be used for large-scale production: the raw material requirement is not high, the cost is low, and batch preparation is easy; the methanol is extracted by cold immersion at room temperature, and the operation is easy; the separation adopts a microporous resin column for rough separation, and the microporous resin separation material can be arranged in a medium-pressure column chromatography system and is easy to scale; the reversed-phase preparative liquid chromatography or hydrophilic preparative liquid chromatography used in the separation and purification is a rapid isocratic method.

title_en: Insecticidal protein and nucleic acid thereof, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insecticidal protein, and the amino acid sequence of the insecticidal protein is at least one of SEQ ID No.1, SEQ ID No.2, SEQ ID No.3, SEQ ID No.4, SEQ ID No.5 and SEQ ID No. 6. The proteins have consistent insecticidal spectrum, have good insecticidal activity on coleoptera pests such as great ape leaf beetles, small ape leaf beetles, phyllotreta striolata, elm blue leaf beetles, potato beetles and the like, and particularly have outstanding insecticidal effect on the protein with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 4.

title_en: Sugar solution with little coloration and method for producing same
abstract_en: Provided is a reaction product of rice and amylase as a sugar solution which contains less soluble components other than sugar and more extract than conventional sugar solutions, or a substance which can be easily obtained from the reaction product. A sugar solution comprising water and a reaction product of rice and an alpha amylase in the water, wherein the amount of soluble protein in the sugar solution is 200 μg/ml or less, and the amount of extract in the sugar solution is 43 wt% or more relative to the whole sugar solution, wherein the reaction product of rice and an alpha amylase is obtained by: steam is blown into a liquefied liquid or emulsion obtained from rice, alpha-amylase and water, and the reaction is carried out at a temperature of 90-150 ℃ for a period of 1-3.5 minutes, wherein the liquefied liquid or emulsion obtained from rice, alpha-amylase and water has a liquefaction time of 15 seconds-30 minutes and a liquefaction temperature of 55-80 ℃.

title_en: Preparation method of low-sugar high-fluffy cake
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a low-sugar high-fluffiness cake, and relates to the technical field of cake processing. The preparation method of the low-sugar high-fluffy cake mainly comprises the following steps: preparing raw materials, primarily treating the raw materials, mixing the raw materials, freezing, evaporating by steam, shaping, baking, packaging and the like. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, greatly improves the filling power of the cake, improves the taste and flavor of the cake, has stable preparation process of the cake and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Functional yogurt product with alpha-glucosidase and tyrosinase activity inhibition function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional yoghurt product with the functions of inhibiting activities of alpha-glucosidase and tyrosinase and a preparation method thereof, which is characterized in that polygonum multiflorum and kudzuvine root are subjected to superfine grinding, then are mixed with water, skim milk powder and white sugar uniformly by stirring according to a certain proportion, and are filtered, emulsified by a colloid mill, sterilized, cooled, added with lactobacillus plantarum, lactobacillus acidophilus and streptococcus thermophilus leavening agents, uniformly mixed, filled, fermented, cooled and subjected to after-ripening to obtain the yoghurt product with the functions of inhibiting the activities of the alpha-glucosidase and the tyrosinase and resisting fatigue.

title_en: Automatic peeling process for quick-frozen fresh corn kernels
abstract_en: An automatic peeling process for quick-frozen fresh corn kernels solves the problems that in the prior art, the operation efficiency is low, the yield is low, a large amount of bran is mixed in the peeled fresh corn kernels, the temperature change range of the fresh corn kernels in the processing process is large, the nutritional ingredients are not reserved easily, and the product quality is influenced. The automatic peeling process utilizes a first-stage peeling device, a second-stage peeling device and a third-stage peeling device respectively to grind and peel frozen corn particles layer by layer; meanwhile, the bran powder shifting wheel rotating along with the grinding rotating wheel shifts the bran powder in the bran powder accumulation cavity into the bran powder conveying pipeline from the bran powder discharge port, and the bran powder ground by the peeling device is collected by the bran collecting device. The automatic peeling process is high in production efficiency, good in product uniformity, free of bran and chaff impurities, small in temperature change amplitude in the processing process, beneficial to retention of nutrient components, capable of effectively collecting and grinding bran and chaff, capable of reducing pollution to the working environment and capable of ensuring product quality.

title_en: Transcription factor for regulating and controlling tomato fruit quality and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant biology, in particular to a transcription factor for regulating and controlling tomato fruit quality and application thereof. The research of the invention finds that the EIL2 transcription factor can be directly combined with the promoter of the LCYB to inhibit the expression of the LCYB transcription factor and reduce the conversion of lycopene; the WHY1 transcription factor can be combined with a promoter of EIL2 to inhibit the expression of the transcription factor, so that the transcription of LCYB is promoted, and the conversion of lycopene to beta-carotene is promoted; the EIL2 can also inhibit the expression of genes of inositol monophosphatase (IMP, inositol synthesis rate-limiting enzyme) and inositol oxygenase (MIOX, rate-limiting enzyme for synthesizing ascorbic acid by inositol pathway) by directly combining with a promoter element, and reduce the synthesis of ascorbic acid. WHY1 can promote ascorbic acid synthesis by inhibiting EIL 2. The WHY1-EIL2 mediated regulation mechanism has important significance on the accumulation of lycopene and ascorbic acid in tomato fruits.

title_en: Method for improving stress tolerance of rice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving stress tolerance of rice. The invention provides a method for cultivating a plant resisting abiotic stress, which comprises the following steps: inhibiting the expression of abscisic acid 8' -hydroxylase gene in the starting plant, thereby enhancing the stress tolerance of the plant to abiotic stress. The abiotic stress is a low temperature stress and/or a salt stress and/or a drought stress. The invention has important theoretical significance and practical value for plant breeding aiming at cultivating the stress-tolerant plant, in particular for rice breeding aiming at cultivating the stress-tolerant plant.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis strain and application thereof in aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of functional microorganism screening and application, in particular to bacillus subtilis and application thereof in aquaculture. The bacillus subtilis is selected from intestinal tracts of litopenaeus vannamei, has a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M2020091, can obviously inhibit pathogenic bacteria, improves the immunity and disease resistance of aquatic animals, generates protease and amylase to improve the digestion and utilization of feed, promotes the growth of the aquatic animals, and can be widely applied to the field of aquatic feeds.

title_en: Embedded sialic acid, probiotic product containing same and preparation method of embedded sialic acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to embedded sialic acid, a probiotic product containing the same and a preparation method thereof, wherein the embedded sialic acid comprises a core material and a coating material for embedding the core material, the core material comprises sialic acid, and the probiotic product comprises the embedded sialic acid and probiotics. The probiotic product related by the invention contains two nutritional components of sialic acid and probiotics, and the sialic acid can promote the synergy of the probiotics as prebiotics; meanwhile, as the sialic acid is embedded in the coating material, the killing effect of the strong acid sialic acid on the probiotics is avoided, so that the survival rate of the probiotics is obviously improved; more importantly, the uniformity of the probiotic product of the invention is obviously improved regardless of sialic acid or probiotics.

title_en: Self-turning type heating frying pan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cooking appliances, in particular to an automatic-turning type heating frying pan which comprises a base and a heating pan, wherein the heating pan is fixedly arranged on the base, a symmetrically arranged supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base, a working box is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting plate, an intermittent mechanism is fixedly arranged on the working box, an electric push rod is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the intermittent mechanism, a mounting plate is fixedly screwed to the bottom end of the electric push rod, a plurality of turning mechanisms for turning foods are arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, the turning mechanisms are distributed on the mounting plate in an annular array, and an adjusting mechanism for pulling the turning mechanisms is arranged on the top surface of the mounting plate.

title_en: Lactose-free milk product
abstract_en: Described herein are liquid, concentrated or dried lactose-free skim milk products or lactose-free, fat-containing milk products that show stability during thermal processing and storage due to the ratio of the reducing carbohydrate to the milk protein of the milk product. The osmotic pressure of lactose-free milk products described herein also improves the nutritional utilization when compared to commercially available lactose-hydrolyzed milk products.

title_en: Lactobacillus acidophilus strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Lactobacillus acidophilus strain and application thereof, wherein the Lactobacillus acidophilus strain (Lactobacillus acidophilus) has a preservation number of CGMCC No.20471, and the 16s rDNA base sequence of the strain is shown as SEQ ID NO: 1 is shown. The invention also relates to a method for using the strain in planting and breeding, which comprises the following steps: (1) a fermentation medium formula; (2) fermentation processes (including fermentation parameters and methods); (3) a fermentation liquor planting application method; (4) a fermentation liquor cultivation application method; the invention has the advantages that the strain is rapidly propagated in soil, straws, feed or aquaculture water, and other microorganisms (including pathogenic bacteria) are continuously inhibited to occupy the advantage of a microecological region, so that the formation of harmful substances is avoided, the growth environment of plants is improved, the straw decomposition and the harmless decomposition products are promoted, the gastrointestinal tract function of animals is improved, and the nitrite in the aquaculture water is degraded.

title_en: Ginger chrysanthemum juice wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ginger chrysanthemum juice wine which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 2-3 parts of turmeric extract, 1-2 parts of chrysanthemum extract, 0.5-3 parts of medlar crude polysaccharide, 1-4 parts of hawthorn or Chinese hawthorn extract, 2-10 parts of sugar, 0.01-1 part of compound food additive, 100 parts of white spirit and 0.01-1 part of food processing additive. The other method of the invention comprises the steps of preparing, filtering and filling the extract. The invention breaks through the conventional thinking of developing traditional medicines and health care products for treating alcohol dependence, and ensures that the health care wine itself contains components for preventing and treating alcohol dependence and relieving alcohol damage, so that a patient can gradually eliminate alcohol dependence while drinking.

title_en: Intelligent release type protein metal ion antibacterial nano-particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to an antibacterial additive for foodThe field, in particular to an intelligent release type protein metal ion antibacterial nano-particle and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts a nano precipitation method to wrap the achillea essential oil in the zein, adjusts the pH value of the solution to ensure that the surface of the zein is negatively charged, and chelates zinc metal ions with positive charges through electrostatic interaction. The characteristics of bacterial metalloprotease are utilized to make it a biological switch when Zn is contained  2+  The bacteria of the metalloprotease encounter the chelated nanoparticles, and the protease activity of the bacteria is activated, so that the proteins on the surfaces of the nanoparticles are hydrolyzed, and the encapsulated achillea essential oil is released, thereby killing the bacteria. The novel antibacterial nano-particles can effectively inhibit various bacteria such as Escherichia coli O157H 7, staphylococcus aureus and Listeria monocytogenes, and can intelligently release antibacterial agents.

title_en: Breeding method of wheat variety with resistance to infection and expansion of gibberellic disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeding method with infection resistance and expansion resistance to wheat scab, which comprises the following steps: 1) parental selection and F 1 Obtaining a substitute; 2) and (4) breeding low-generation selection: f 2 To F 4 Selecting single plants or single ears, inoculating diseased wheat grains in the field, combining water spraying and moisture preservation to determine gibberellic disease induced selective pressure, stopping water spraying, and screening target single plants with preliminary infection resistance; 3) and (3) breeding high-generation selection: f 5 And (D) further screening the target individual plant with the infection resistance by combining spore liquid spray inoculation and water spray moisture preservation on the target individual plant, F 6 Generation pair F 5 And synchronously identifying the expansion resistance and the infection resistance of the target individual plant obtained by the generation in the field by single flower instillation and spore liquid spraying, and carrying out pressure identification in a greenhouse to obtain the wheat variety with the functions of gibberellic disease infection resistance and expansion. The breeding process has strong operability, can be used for reference of different wheat regions, improves the breeding efficiency, and can obtain the wheat variety with stable gibberellic disease resistance.

title_en: Method for effectively inhibiting cluster bud browning in tissue culture process of phyllostachys pubescens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for effectively inhibiting cluster bud browning in a tissue culture process of phyllostachys pubescens, and belongs to the technical field of plant tissue culture. The method comprises the following steps: selecting a brocade bamboo explant, sterilizing, performing primary induction culture, performing secondary multiplication culture, performing anti-browning culture and the like. Aiming at the problem of serious cluster bud browning in the existing brocade bamboo tissue culture, the invention effectively inhibits the oxidation of phenolic substances by adding the anti-browning agent and adjusting the medium components and hormone proportion, avoids the occurrence of the cluster bud browning phenomenon of the brocade bamboo, can reduce the cluster bud browning rate of the brocade bamboo to be below 5 percent, solves the problems of high cluster bud browning rate and easy death in the brocade bamboo tissue culture process, shows better technical advantages, and also lays a good technical foundation for improving the rapid propagation efficiency of the brocade bamboo.

title_en: Making process of special steamed hamburger blank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for making a special steamed hamburger blank, which comprises the following steps: (1) making flour into dough; (2) standing the dough; (3) performing proofing treatment; (4) steaming; (5) and (5) packaging and refrigerating. The secret steamed hamburger blank is simple in manufacturing method, and the hamburger is rich in nutrition and delicious; can be refrigerated and stored, is convenient to take and use, has long storage time, and does not influence the sensory property of the secret steamed hamburger blank.

title_en: Production process of sweet and spicy sausage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of sweet and spicy sausage, which comprises pork, pepper, dried orange peel, fructus amomi, salt, cassia bark, star anise, hot pepper, sugar, cooking wine, sesame, fennel and aniseed.

title_en: Diet low-sugar eight-treasure rice pudding and preparation method and processing equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to diet low-sugar eight-treasure rice pudding capable of being produced in large batches and a preparation method thereof, and particularly relates to diet low-sugar eight-treasure rice pudding and a preparation method and processing equipment thereof, wherein the diet low-sugar eight-treasure rice pudding comprises main materials and auxiliary materials, and the main materials comprise the following components: glutinous rice, black rice, lotus root starch and sterile water; the auxiliary materials comprise the following components: chinese dates, pear blocks, medlar, broad beans, lotus plumule and oligosaccharide. The eight-treasure rice pudding has the characteristics of good taste and low sugar, and can be eaten by a diabetic in a proper amount; the eight-treasure rice pudding prepared by the preparation method is produced in an aseptic environment, so that the safety and health of food can be better ensured, the storage time of the food is effectively prolonged, and the influence degree of long-time storage on the taste of the food is reduced; most procedures of the whole processing equipment are in an automatic processing state in the processing process, so that the production efficiency can be effectively improved, and the production capacity is improved; meanwhile, the labor amount of operators is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and trouble and labor are saved.

title_en: Tea processing device convenient for rolling tea
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea processing equipment, in particular to a tea processing device convenient for rolling tea, which solves the defects in the prior art and comprises a rack and a rolling mechanism arranged on the rack; the twisting mechanism is provided with a remote monitoring and control system; the remote monitoring and control system comprises a temperature monitoring and adjusting module, a time monitoring and adjusting module and a pressure monitoring and adjusting module; the temperature monitoring and adjusting module, the time monitoring and adjusting module and the pressure monitoring and adjusting module are all controlled by a central control module, and the central control module is in communication connection with a user mobile terminal through a wireless communication module; the user mobile terminal is provided with an instruction control submodule for regulating and controlling the temperature monitoring and adjusting module, the time monitoring and adjusting module and the pressure monitoring and adjusting module.

title_en: Coix seed and bamboo sleep-promoting tea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coix seed and bamboo sleep-promoting tea and a preparation method thereof, the coix seed and bamboo sleep-promoting tea adopts gastrodia elata, wild chrysanthemum root, coix seed bud, polygonatum odoratum, medlar, yam, tuckahoe, malt, lily and jujube kernel as main raw materials, and is formed into the coix seed and bamboo sleep-promoting tea through advanced processes of ethanol extraction, vacuum concentration, low-temperature drying and the like; the coix seed and bamboo sleep-promoting tea is safe to eat, free of toxic and side effects, prepared by extracting selected Shennongjia natural herbal plants with homology of medicine and food according to a health-preserving tea treatment formula invented by the traditional Chinese medicine theory, mild in taste, natural in mouthfeel, convenient to carry and healthy and fashionable; the raw materials are mutually cooperated, and the traditional Chinese medicine composition can improve the immunity of a human body and enhance the functions of a central nervous system by inducing natural sleep, tonifying qi and consolidating exterior, calming the heart and removing dryness, promoting the circulation of qi and relieving depression, and tranquilizing and allaying excitement, and has good treatment and relieving effects on symptoms such as insomnia and dreaminess.

title_en: Tomato late blight resistant gene Sly-miR166b and cloning method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a tomato late blight resistant gene Sly-miR166b, the DNA molecular sequence of which is shown in SEQ ID NO. 1; provides a cloning method of the gene, and uses the DNA of the wild type sensitive late blight tomato early powder No.2 as a template to carry out PCR amplification; connecting the obtained PCR product with a pMD-19T cloning vector, transforming Escherichia coli DH5 alpha, and selecting a single colony for sequencing; also provides an application method of the gene, which is used for preventing tomato from being infected by pathogenic bacteria. After the Sly-miR166b obtained by the method is transiently overexpressed in tomatoes, the expression quantity of Sly-miR166b in plants is higher than that of wild plants, the late blight resistance effect is better, and the method has important significance for cultivating late blight resistance tomato varieties.

title_en: Pelteobagrus fulvidraco juvenile fish puffed particle compound feed and production processing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a pelteobagrus fulvidraco juvenile fish puffed particle compound feed and a production processing device, which belong to the technical field of fish feed preparation, and comprise a supporting platform, a crusher, supporting legs, a material suction pipe, a stirring tank, a material discharge hopper, an auxiliary material adding hopper, an auxiliary material containing bearing plate, a longitudinal material return pipe, a sampling window, a material suction pipe containing plate and a material discharge hopper blockage dredging mechanism; the invention can ensure that the judgment of the stirring end point is more accurate by arranging the pair of sampling windows; the material mixing efficiency can be improved by arranging the longitudinal material returning pipe; auxiliary materials and additives can be temporarily stored by arranging the auxiliary material containing bearing plate and the fence, and the weight of the material suction pipe part can be increased by arranging the weight, so that the opening of the material suction pipe part is sunk in the large-particle raw material constantly, and air suction is prevented; the material suction pipe storage plate is arranged, so that the storage function can be provided for the material suction pipe; through setting up out hopper jam dredge mechanism, can realize the mediation to the material of jam at the play hopper entrance.

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine health care white spirit and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Chinese herbal medicine health care white spirit and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein the formula comprises the following components: the wine is prepared from 2000 ml of pure grain white spirit with the alcoholic strength of 50 to 60 degrees, 45 g of red ginseng, 35 g of pilose antler, 45 g of medlar, 30 g of rehmannia, 50 g of cherokee rose fruit, 1 pair of hippocampus, 20 g of Chinese magnoliavine fruit and 20 g of bupleurum; weighing the medicinal materials according to the formula; cutting Hippocampus into pieces, and placing the pieces and other medicinal materials into a large-opening porcelain or glass container; then 2000 ml of pure grain white spirit with the alcoholic strength of 50-60 degrees is poured into the wine; sealing and placing in shade for 15 days to obtain the final product; the invention provides the health care wine which has the advantages of low cost, easily obtained raw materials, simple preparation and full utilization of medicinal material values and has the functions of preventing and treating a series of symptoms such as insomnia and dreaminess, amnesia, night sweat, spermatorrhea, premature ejaculation, soreness and weakness of waist and knees, aversion to cold and the like.

title_en: Production equipment of cuttlefish ball emulsified slurry and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to meat product processing equipment and the technical field thereof, in particular to production equipment of cuttlefish ball emulsified slurry and a preparation method thereof, which are characterized in that: the device comprises a base, a material mortar driving device, a chopping knife driving device, an ice crushing device and a vibrating device, wherein the cross section of an annular cavity in the material mortar is larger than a semicircle, more materials are borne, the diameter of the material mortar of the same yield is smaller, and the materials are not easy to throw out when rotating due to the fact that the upper opening of the annular cavity is folded, so that the allowable rotating speed of the material mortar is higher, the productivity of the device is improved, and the fineness of the slurry is better; the condition of sticking and blocking can be avoided by vibrating the material by the vibrating rod; crushed ice is added for mixing at the initial stage of chopping, so that the meat fiber is contracted, and the problem that the raw materials are early matured due to too fast temperature rise of the raw materials and influence the subsequent taste is avoided; the fine density and elasticity of the product are greatly enhanced, the damage to meat fiber is small, and the emulsification effect, elasticity and fineness of the meat product are improved to the greatest extent.

title_en: Fresh and wet potato vermicelli and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to fresh and wet potato vermicelli and a preparation method thereof; the preparation method of the fresh and wet potato vermicelli comprises the steps of making starch, kneading dough, forming, boiling and cooling, wherein the cooling specifically comprises the following steps: soaking or spraying the boiled vermicelli by using slightly acidic electrolyzed water; the pH value of the subacid electrolyzed water is 5.0-6.5, the effective chlorine concentration is 10-80 ppm, and the oxidation-reduction potential is 600-950 mV. The invention prolongs the quality guarantee period of the fresh and wet potato vermicelli without adding preservative; in addition, the fresh and wet potato vermicelli prepared by the method has excellent quality. The preparation method of the invention does not reduce the texture and cooking characteristics of the vermicelli, has simple and convenient operation and is beneficial to large-scale popularization.

title_en: Tea bag and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of traditional Chinese medicines, in particular to a tea bag, a preparation method and an application method thereof, and the tea bag at least comprises the following components in parts by weight: is prepared from Siberian cocklebur stem 2 parts, Orthosiphon aristatus 2 parts, gynostemma pentaphyllum 2 parts, kudzu vine root 1.5 parts, lysimachia christinae 1 part, eucommia bark 1 part, and chicory 1 part. The tea bag is a herbal tea bag, has multiple effects of regulating and treating hyperuricemia and complicating diseases thereof by taking a tea, adopts pure natural raw materials, has good curative effect, quick response and no toxic or side effect, and has the functions of regulating and treating gout, diabetes and complicating diseases caused by the gout, the diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia, gallstone, kidney stone, vesical stone, ureteral stone, urethral stone, cholecystitis, hepatitis, nephritis, cystitis, urethritis and prostatitis; the composition is taken orally 1 time in the morning, noon and evening, and 100 bags are taken continuously for a treatment course until symptoms completely disappear, and the patient is fasted for food such as seafood, beer, animal viscera, etc., and the severe patient can take the composition for three to four treatment courses.

title_en: Roasting method for softening mutton crisps
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roasting method for softening mutton crisps, belongs to the technical field of food processing, and aims to solve the problem that the taste of the conventional mutton shashlik is influenced because the mutton shashlik is hard in taste. The method comprises the steps of raw material preparation, mutton treatment, mutton pickling, mutton shashlik and mutton barbecuing. When the mutton is pickled, common ingredients are added, and kiwi fruit pulp is also added to promote the mutton to be softened; in addition, the mutton is put into a container, and bubble water is poured into the container to pressurize and pickle, so that the permeation of the seasonings into the mutton is accelerated. The mutton roasted by the process is not only soft, but also has layering sense in taste, and is superior to the conventional roasting process.

title_en: Grain, fruit and vegetable composition capable of bidirectionally improving gastrointestinal tract function and losing weight and beautifying features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grain, fruit and vegetable composition for bidirectionally improving gastrointestinal tract function and losing weight and beautifying, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1005 parts of polygonatum odoratum, 402 parts of red date, 402 parts of lily, 67-201 parts of orange peel, 30-80 parts of black bean, 10-30 parts of soybean, 200 parts of brown rice, 35-75 parts of pearl barley, 200 parts of small red bean and 40-60 parts of Chinese yam. According to the invention, the polygonatum, lily, red date, orange peel, black bean, soybean, brown rice, pearl barley, small red bean, Chinese yam, tuckahoe, black sesame, oat, wheat germ powder, fish collagen peptide, walnut kernel and spina date seed are matched with each other, so that the effects of obviously improving constipation and diarrhea, losing weight and beautifying the face and having no any harmful damage to a human body can be achieved on the gastrointestinal function of people.

title_en: Hypoglycemic compositions and methods of making and using the same
abstract_en: An edible composition comprising a low glycemic index sugar component having a glycemic index of no greater than 20, wherein the edible composition comprises no less than 50% by weight of the low glycemic index sugar component, wherein the edible composition is substantially free of D-sucrose, D-fructose, D-glucose, a sugar alcohol, and a non-sugar sweetener, wherein the sweet taste profile of the edible composition is substantially similar to D-sucrose.

title_en: Isolated preservation culture medium and isolated preservation method for Adiantum furiosaeanum
abstract_en: The invention provides an isolated preservation culture medium and an isolated preservation method for Adiantum furnanus, and relates to the technical field of germplasm preservation. The in vitro preservation culture medium comprises the following components: huabao No. 2 3g/L, NAA 0.5.5 mg/L, cane sugar 20g/L, active carbon 1g/L and agar 6g/L, and the pH value is 5.8. When the in vitro preservation culture medium is used for in vitro preservation, spores germinate after germination and culture for 15 days, the germination rate of the spores can reach 67.32% after 30 days of microscopic examination, and the spores develop into young prothallium after about 50 days; inoculating 4 young prothallium into a proliferation culture medium, continuously growing and proliferating the young prothallium after 30d subculture, wherein the proliferation rate can reach 1: 3; transferring the prothallium mass to an in vitro preservation culture medium, wherein 4 prothallium bodies are inoculated in each bottle, the prothallium bodies are in strip shapes, the middle is thick, the edge is thin, and the subculture period of the prothallium mass can be prolonged to more than 1.5 years. Provides theoretical basis and technical support for the development, utilization and protection of the subsequent related wild germplasm resources of the Nelumbo plants.

title_en: Preserved fruit containing hyaluronic acid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a confection comprising high molecular weight hyaluronic acid and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid. The invention also provides a preparation method of the preserved fruit, which comprises the following steps: preparing a first solution containing high molecular hyaluronic acid and low molecular hyaluronic acid, and adding the fresh fruits into the first solution for boiling to obtain boiled fresh fruits; preparing a second solution containing high molecular hyaluronic acid and low molecular hyaluronic acid, and soaking the boiled fresh fruits in the second solution to obtain soaked fresh fruits; and drying the soaked fresh fruits to obtain preserved fruits. Compared with the prior art, the preserved fruit has the following beneficial effects: (1) the high molecular weight hyaluronic acid can form a protective layer on the surface of the preserved fruit product to prevent the loss of water in the preserved fruit; (2) the low molecular weight hyaluronic acid effectively locks the water in the preserved fruit and prevents the surface of the preserved fruit from sand return.

title_en: Preparation method of crab feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of crab feed, which comprises the steps of weighing raw materials, carrying out heat treatment, pasting treatment, grinding, mixing, stirring and granulating, wherein the raw materials comprise fish meal, meat and bone meal, soybeans, corn flour, starch, soybean oil, probiotics, garlic, food-grade sodium polyacrylate and vitamins. The heat treatment of the soybean increases the absorption of the crabs to the protein, after the heat treatment of the soybean, the contents of total protein and total amino acid in the soybean are slightly increased, so that the protein absorbed by the crabs is more, meanwhile, the soybean contains various anti-nutritional factors such as antitrypsin and the like, which influence the absorption of the crabs to nutrient substances, and the anti-nutritional factors have certain toxic action on animals.

title_en: Preparation method of composite micro-powder nutritional chewable tablet
abstract_en: A preparation method of a composite micro-powder nutritional chewable tablet comprises the following steps: crushing, namely mixing the cleaned acer truncatum seeds and flaxseeds, and crushing into micro powder with the granularity of more than 300 meshes; mixing, namely mixing the micro powder obtained in the crushing step with goat milk powder and/or a plurality of fruit and vegetable micro powders; tabletting, namely putting the mixed raw materials into a tabletting machine for tabletting and forming; coating, tabletting and forming, and then coating. The nutrition and health care functions are enhanced, products with different tastes, colors and functions can be produced, the storage life of the products can be prolonged, and the requirements of different consumer groups can be met.

title_en: Method for regulating flowering phase of plumbago auriculata
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for regulating and controlling the flowering phase of a plumbago auriculata, and belongs to the technical field of plant tissue culture or cultivation. The method does not need to add any plant hormone, polyamine, plant growth regulator and fertilizer, and comprises the following specific steps: (1) selecting a tissue culture seedling or a seedling of the plumbago auriculata; (2) carrying out the following temperature change treatment on the plants in the step (1): and (3) alternately treating at 25-35 ℃ and 30-35 ℃ for 12h/d respectively, wherein the treatment time is 27-38 d, and the flowering period of the blue flower lead is regulated and controlled. The regulating method can effectively regulate the flowering phase of the Plumbum preparatium so that the Plumbum preparatium can bloom as required, can regulate the Plumbum preparatium to bloom at any time in a non-natural flowering phase, and the bloomed finished seedling has good crown width and color, thereby obtaining great market benefit.

title_en: Pickering double emulsion with interface stabilized by solid fat and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pickering double emulsion with an interface stabilized by solid fat, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in low-fat food. The interface provided by the invention is formed into fat crystals in situ by the Pickering double emulsion with stable solid fat through the emulsifying property of the solid fat and the template effect of lipophilic interface crystallization inducer, and the fat crystals are used as adjuvantThe emulsion is stabilized, the overall stability of the emulsion is enhanced, the dosage of the emulsifier, the stabilizer and the gelling agent is further reduced, the emulsion does not have coalescence phenomenon after being placed for 1 month, and the instability caused by the processing or compounding process can be effectively improved; in-vitro digestion experiments show that the Pickering double emulsion W prepared by the invention 1 /O/W 2 The solid lipid interface layer partially inhibits the digestion of liquid oil by lipase, has the characteristic of low lipid digestibility, and widens the application of food-grade Pickering emulsion in the fields of processed food and low-fat food.

title_en: Blended type stewed three-yellow chicken oily essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blended type stewed three-yellow chicken oily essence and a preparation method thereof, and the flavor of the stewed three-yellow chicken oily essence comprises the following components: the three-yellow stewed chicken oily essence is mainly characterized by comprising the following components of a mixture of spicy flavor, chicken fat flavor and the like, a roasted flavor, a burnt sweet flavor and a meat flavor. The finally prepared essence has strong flavor of the stewed three-yellow chicken, can provide good fragrance and flavor of the stewed three-yellow chicken for seasoning products such as chicken essence and the like, has good stability of the fragrance and flavor, and can ensure that the seasoning products such as the chicken essence and the like still keep good fragrance and flavor in the shelf life.

title_en: Air door device for refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air door device for a refrigerator, which comprises a refrigerator frame body mechanism, a refrigerator air door frame body mechanism and a refrigerator air door clamping mechanism, wherein the refrigerator air door frame body mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the front side of the refrigerator frame body mechanism, the outer surface of the refrigerator air door frame body mechanism is movably connected with the refrigerator air door clamping mechanism, an air door body is arranged on the front side of the refrigerator air door clamping mechanism, a fixed shaft is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the air door body, a rotating shaft is movably sleeved at one end of the inner side of the fixed shaft, one end of the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with. This air door device for refrigerator, the installation piece through the inboard fixed mounting of permanent magnet is corresponding with the fixed block joint groove of air door body top fixed surface installation, and the inside fixedly connected with elastic spring of grafting piece extrudees the grafting piece at the installation piece, makes elastic spring drive the grafting piece to the inboard removal in both ends to let the installation piece peg graft into fixed block joint inslot portion, convenient simple, very big reduction the dismouting time.

title_en: Composite nutritional cereal flour and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses grain composite nutritional flour and a preparation method thereof, wherein corn grains, oat, soybean, buckwheat, rye, sorghum grains, soybean and purple rice are poured into a feeding box of a processing device in sequence, a third motor is started to drive a second wheel disc to rotate by the third motor, a belt between the second wheel disc and the first wheel disc is used for driving the first wheel disc to rotate, so that the first wheel disc drives a material crushing machine to operate, the third motor drives a butt joint hopper to vibrate by a transmission connecting rod, a screening plate is driven by the butt joint hopper to vibrate, impurities in grains are discharged through a second material nozzle on the side edge of the feeding box, the grains passing through the screening plate enter the material crushing machine, and the material crushing machine is used for preparing the grains into powder; the preparation method can synchronously carry out screening operation in the flour processing process, improves the processing efficiency, simultaneously makes the mixing operation of the grain composite nutrient flour more uniform, and improves the taste.

title_en: Whole wheat flour bread improver with good water retention effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whole wheat flour bread improver with a good water-retaining effect, belonging to the technical field of food improvers and comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3.5-6.5 parts of bean dregs, 0.1-0.2 part of streptococcus thermophilus, 3.5-6.5 parts of grape skin dregs, 0.1-0.2 part of lactobacillus bulgaricus, 0.1-0.2 part of thickening agent, 1.5-2.5 parts of carrageenan, 0.1-0.2 part of guar gum and 0.5-1.5 parts of beta-glucan. The whole wheat flour bread prepared by the method has a very good water retention effect and is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Hypoallergenic soybean protein powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to hypoallergenic soybean protein powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: adding food-source polyphenol into the soybean protein water solution, uniformly stirring, adjusting the pH value of the solution to be alkaline, and placing the solution in a dark place at room temperature for reaction for 24 hours to obtain a polyphenol-soybean protein covalent complex solution; adding oligomeric reducing sugar into the polyphenol-soybean protein covalent complex solution, and uniformly stirring to obtain a reaction solution; freeze-drying the reaction solution to obtain reactant powder; and (3) placing the reactant powder into a reaction condition with the temperature of 55-65 ℃ and the relative humidity of 75% to react for 12-36 h, so as to obtain the hypoallergenic soybean protein powder. Therefore, the soybean protein sensitization is reduced, and meanwhile, the advanced glycosylation end products are reduced to the greatest extent, and adverse effects of the accompanying products on human health are avoided.

title_en: Selenium-rich konjak food and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selenium-rich konjak food which is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 30-50 parts of konjak fine powder, 10-30 parts of cassava powder, 10-20 parts of corn starch, 10-15 parts of coix seed powder, 5-10 parts of a selenium source, 5-10 parts of a flavoring agent and 5-10 parts of a food additive. The selenium-rich konjak food adopts the mutual matching and supplement of organic selenium and inorganic selenium, the organic selenium is high in price but good in absorption effect, the inorganic selenium is very low in price but poor in absorption, so that the absorption effect of the low-concentration inorganic selenium is obviously improved by matching the organic selenium and the inorganic selenium, and a certain amount of organic selenium is supplemented to reach the content required by a human body. The selenium element required by human body is supplemented while the price is not too high. In addition, each kilogram of konjak contains 350 mug of selenium element, which is greatly superior to common food, and is high-quality organically combined selenium, and the content of selenium additive can be further reduced, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Lactobacillus paracasei and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides lactobacillus paracasei GRR (Lactobacillus paracasei  GRR) with the preservation number of CCTCC No: m2017777. The lactobacillus paracasei GRR is applied to preparing rice straw fermented feed. The lactobacillus paracasei disclosed by the invention has the advantages of strong low-temperature adaptability, capability of accelerating the fermentation and maturation of rice straws, improvement of the fermentation quality of the rice straws, improvement of aerobic stability, feeding safety and the like, and can be widely applied to the field of preparation of rice straw fermented feeds.

title_en: Method for promoting growth of strawberries and biological material used by same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for promoting the growth of strawberries and a biological material used by the method. One technical scheme to be protected by the invention is application of protein from strawberry in regulation and control of plant growth, wherein the protein is named as SnRK2.1 protein, and can be protein with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID No.1 in a sequence table. Experiments prove that compared with the strawberry only transformed with pH7WG2D and 1 empty vector, the strawberry transformed with the SnRK2.1 gene can obviously improve the plant height and the crown diameter of the strawberry, the plant height is improved by 76.95% and the crown diameter is increased by 86.02% in 8 weeks of growth, which shows that the SnRK2.1 has an important effect on the growth of strawberry plants and can be applied to the improvement of the quality of the strawberry.

title_en: Fresh-keeping egg white crystal powder, preparation and fresh-keeping storage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fresh-keeping egg white crystal powder and a preparation method and a fresh-keeping storage method thereof. Carrying out high-speed shearing and high-speed centrifugal separation on the egg white of the raw egg collected by the egg white separator by a crusher to obtain egg white homogeneous liquid; spreading the egg white homogeneous liquid in an open container with dialysis membrane with cut-off molecular weight not more than 1000 kDa or microfiltration membrane with pore size not more than 100 nm as bottom, evaporating water from the upper part of the container and dehydrating with the lower part of the filtration membrane to obtain flaky egg white crystal with average water content of 13.0%, and grinding to obtain egg white crystal powder. The egg white crystal powder prepared by the invention can keep the egg white not to deteriorate for a long time when stored at a low temperature below 4 ℃; the method is completely green and environment-friendly, does not need any hydrolysis or degradation treatment, and greatly reduces the production cost; the egg white crystal powder is easy to dissolve in water, maintains the original taste and flavor and the nutritional ingredients of the egg white, and is suitable for the fields of food industry, food biological processing industry, medical medicines, medical biomaterials and the like.

title_en: Pesticide residue and slitting device are got rid of to carambola
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fruits, in particular to a device for removing pesticide residues and slitting carambola. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: provides a device for removing pesticide residues and cutting carambola into strips. The technical implementation scheme of the invention is as follows: a carambola removes pesticide residue and slitting device, including removing the pesticide residue mechanism, surface cleaning mechanism and slitting mechanism, etc.; one side of slitting mechanism is provided with first containing box. The invention is designed aiming at the special appearance of the carambola, and solves the defect that the pesticide residue on the carambola surface is difficult to remove; the method that carambola is generally cleaned simply and sliced directly when carambola is treated at present is abandoned, and pesticide residues on the carambola surface are thoroughly removed; the existing equipment is changed, most of the carambola slicing devices are used, and the carambola cannot be sliced; meanwhile, pesticide treatment cannot be carried out on the carambola firstly, and then follow-up operation cannot be carried out, so that the carambola is processed under the current situation of safety defect.

title_en: Application of plant stress tolerance related protein GmDof41 in regulation and control of plant stress tolerance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a plant stress tolerance related protein GmDof41 in regulation and control of plant stress tolerance. The GmDof41 provided by the invention can improve the salt tolerance and drought resistance of plants, can be used for preparing products for improving the stress resistance of plants and directly used for stress resistance, provides a foundation for artificially controlling the expression of stress resistance and stress resistance related genes, and plays an important role in breeding plants with enhanced stress resistance and stress resistance.

title_en: Corn ZmHsf gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides ZmHsf genes, proteins encoded by the ZmHsf genes and their use in plant breeding. In particular, the invention provides the use of ZmHsf gene in increasing plant yield and improving plant disease resistance, especially stem rot.

title_en: Preparation method of sea cucumber enzymolysis liquid, preparation method of freeze-dried powder of royal jelly and sea cucumber enzymolysis peptide, freeze-dried powder and food
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of sea cucumber enzymolysis liquid, a preparation method of royal jelly sea cucumber enzymolysis peptide freeze-dried powder, freeze-dried powder and food, and relates to the technical field of food, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing sea cucumber with water, and grinding to obtain sea cucumber pulp; the mass ratio of the sea water to the water is (10-30) to (5-15); (2) mixing the sea cucumber slurry obtained in the step (1) with protease for enzymolysis to obtain a first sea cucumber enzymolysis liquid; the dosage of the protease accounts for 0.3 to 0.5 percent of the total mass of the sea cucumber slurry; (3) carrying out enzyme deactivation and sterilization on the first sea cucumber enzymolysis liquid obtained in the step (2) to obtain enzyme-deactivated and sterilized sea cucumber enzymolysis liquid; (4) and (4) filtering the enzyme-deactivated and sterilized sea cucumber enzymatic hydrolysate obtained in the step (3) to obtain the sea cucumber enzymatic hydrolysate. The preparation method provided by the invention has simple process, and effectively protects the nutrient components and active substances.

title_en: Two TK1 receptor kinase genes in arabidopsis thaliana and soybean and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of genetic engineering, and discloses two TK1 receptor kinase genes in arabidopsis thaliana and soybean and application thereof. The application effect of the two TK1 receptor kinases screened from arabidopsis thaliana and soybean in resisting phytophthora infection of plants is remarkable. Taking the Nicotiana benthamiana as an example, the TK1 gene in Arabidopsis and soybean is transiently expressed in the Nicotiana benthamiana, so that the resistance of the Nicotiana benthamiana to phytophthora can be obviously improved. Under the condition that no particularly good method for preventing and controlling phytophthora exists, cloning of TK1 gene is of great significance for cultivating crop varieties with phytophthora resistance by using genetic engineering means.

title_en: Pet food added with marine oligosaccharide and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pet food added with marine oligosaccharide and a preparation method thereof, and the raw materials comprise the following components: 63-89 parts of chicken breast paste, 2-8 parts of brown alginate oligosaccharides, 5-10 parts of beef paste, 3-6 parts of starch, 0.5-2 parts of vegetable oil, 0.1-1 part of salt and 12-20 parts of water. Aiming at the health of pet intestinal tracts, the brown algae oligosaccharide with the average molecular weight within 3000 is added, so that the growth of intestinal probiotics such as bifidobacteria and lactobacilli can be remarkably promoted, the growth of harmful bacteria such as pathogenic bacteria and putrefying bacteria is inhibited, the effects of improving the intestinal micro-ecological environment and purifying the intestinal tracts are achieved, the immunity is improved, the endocrine system is improved, and the absorption of nutrient substances is promoted, so that the diseases such as intestinal infection are improved; the brown algae oligosaccharide is used as a pet food additive, can regulate intestinal flora and improve the immunity of pets, is safe, green and nontoxic, and is beneficial to large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Lactating sow premix and complete feed
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of feeds, and provides a lactating sow premix and a complete feed, wherein the premix comprises sodium chloride, 98.5% of L-lysine, polysaccharide fermented montmorillonite, sodium bicarbonate, polymineral of a pig, betaine, 98.5% of L-threonine, 60% of choline chloride, xylooligosaccharide, multivitamin of the pig, 99% of DL-methionine, complex enzyme, ethoxyquinoline, 50% of vitamin E, 10000FTU of phytase, FA488 and 99% of vitamin C. The feed additive fully considers the mixture ratio of various additives and the physiological characteristics of the lactating sows, has balanced nutrition, can enhance the disease resistance of the lactating sows after being eaten, improves the ingestion capability and the lactation capability of the lactating sows, and can promote the sows to estrate as soon as possible after the lactating sows are weaned, thereby improving the production capability and the fattening period.

title_en: Litchi beverage fruit particle sauce and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food, and particularly relates to litchi beverage fruit particle sauce and a preparation method thereof. The litchi beverage fruit particle sauce comprises the following raw materials: litchi, high fructose corn syrup, white granulated sugar, water, hydroxypropyl distarch phosphate, pectin, an acidity regulator, potassium sorbate and edible essence. The preparation method of the litchi beverage fruit particle sauce comprises the following steps: firstly), carrying out foreign matter inspection on the raw materials; secondly), putting the raw materials into a jacketed kettle according to the weight parts, stirring and heating the raw materials to 80-85 ℃, preserving heat for 10-20min, and conveying the materials to a filling machine through a pipeline for full-automatic filling; and thirdly), spraying the code production date from the filled product to the outer package through a metal detector, and warehousing the product after the product is qualified. The litchi beverage fruit particle sauce disclosed by the invention is good in taste, unique in flavor, rich in nutrition and green and environment-friendly; the preparation method of the litchi beverage fruit particle sauce is simple and efficient, is convenient to operate and control, and the produced product has long shelf life and is beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: Green and healthy sweet sauce for baking and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of baking supplies, and particularly relates to green and healthy baking sweet sauce and application thereof, wherein the baking sweet sauce mainly comprises the following components: sweet sauce seasoning, 25-45% of syrup/white granulated sugar and 5-10% of thickening agent; the green and healthy sweet sauce for baking provided by the invention adopts green and healthy raw materials to form a green formula, is more green, safe and healthy compared with the existing sweet sauce for baking, does not need to add any preservative, and meets the promotion of the life quality of people and increasingly enhanced health requirements. The invention adopts physically modified starch and/or physically modified raw powder as a thickening agent, and can meet the requirements of sauce on the thickening agent without adding any chemical reagent; meanwhile, other raw materials are adopted, so that the health and delicious effects are achieved.

title_en: A distiller's yeast with Bayanxiang as main material and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides distiller's yeast, and belongs to the field of food processing. The distiller's yeast is prepared from the following raw materials: glutinous rice, Japanese ardisia, stephania sinica diels, white hens, big and small baryanxiang, big and small bardanxiang, dahurian rhododendron leaf, big and small nightleaf, big and small dendrobium, big and small daylily, wild aniseed, green jack beans, big and small wild soybeans, peppery hot vegetables, big and small water chestnut, ginseng, qimei, phoenix eggs, kudzu bract, waysia yellow, hovenia dulcis, couchgrass root, Japanese dock root, bee sugar flower, melissa grass, manyflower leech, maojian thorn root, paris polyphylla, ardisia japonica, big and small sweetmeats, big and small areca nuts, rust-coloured crotalaria herb, honeysuckle, red and white achyranthes bidentata, hen coop and kenaf. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the distiller's yeast. The rice wine brewed by the distiller's yeast prepared by the formula has no toxic or side effect, does not cause scurry head after drinking, and has the effects of nourishing internal organs, promoting blood circulation and dispelling cold.

title_en: Multi-section type distillation liquid collecting equipment for brewing
abstract_en: The invention discloses multi-section type distillation liquid collecting equipment for brewing, which comprises a distillation tank, a distillation tower, a cooler, a reflux structure and a storage structure, wherein a liquid outlet of the distillation tank is communicated with the distillation tower, the cooler is communicated with the top end of the distillation tower, the cooler is connected with the reflux structure, the reflux structure is connected with the middle section of the distillation tower, and a multi-section type reboiling condensation liquid collecting mechanism is arranged between the cooler and the storage structure as well as between the cooler and the reflux structure; the multistage distillation liquid collecting device for brewing has the advantages that the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, the multistage reboiling condensation liquid collecting mechanism is additionally arranged between the cooling structure and the reflux structure and is used for directly separating alcohol by reboiling with accurate temperature control, then the alcohol is recovered by the condensation means, and then low-purity liquid is refluxed into the distillation tower to be distilled again, so that the separation efficiency is increased and the distillation purity is improved.

title_en: Compound, traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product and application of compound and traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product in preparation of medicine or health-care product with anti-aging effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly discloses a compound, a traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product and application of the compound and the traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product in preparation of a medicine or a health-care product with an anti-aging effect. The traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product comprises a compound shown in a formula (I); the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) taking the traditional Chinese medicine raw materials, and fermenting with probiotics to obtain fermentation liquor; (2) drying the fermentation liquor to obtain the traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product; the traditional Chinese medicine raw materials in the step (1) are traditional Chinese medicine raw materials comprising purple perilla, astragalus, lily, rhodiola rosea, glossy privet fruit, pseudo-ginseng, ginkgo leaf, mint and gorgon fruit. The compound shown in the formula (I) and the traditional Chinese medicine probiotic fermentation product have excellent effects of resisting oxidation and delaying senescence; can be used for preparing medicines and health products.

title_en: Beefsteak processing tenderization device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a beef steak processing and tenderizing device which comprises a processing box, wherein a feed hopper is fixed on the upper left side of the processing box through screws, a flow guide groove is fixed on the processing box on the inner side of the feed hopper, a connecting plate is fixed in the processing box on the lower side of the flow guide groove, the right side of the connecting plate is rotatably connected with a rotating rod, a push rod is fixed at the upper end of the rotating rod, a rolling roller is fixed on the lower side of the rotating rod, and a rolling seat is slidably connected in the processing box on the lower side of the rolling roller. According to the beef steak pickling device, the beef steaks after being processed can be conveniently conveyed through the feeding hopper, the flow guide grooves and the conveying belt, the processing efficiency is guaranteed, pickled materials are stored through the storage box, the pickled materials can be conveniently conveyed through the pump body I, the conveying pipe II and the spray head, the beef steaks can be conveniently pickled, the beef steaks can be better squeezed through the rolling seat, the rotating rod, the pushing rod and the rolling roller, the muscle structure inside the beef is damaged, and the beef steaks can be better pickled.

title_en: Method and apparatus for producing ensilaged products and ensilage process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a silage product of improved quality, a silage process using the method or the silage product, and an apparatus for preparing a silage product of improved quality.

title_en: Vegetable sterilizing and fresh-keeping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a vegetable sterilization preservative and a preparation method thereof, wherein the vegetable sterilization preservative comprises the following steps: fructus forsythiae extract, chitosan, radix Scutellariae extract, Gallic acid streptostacin-vitamin complex, tea polyphenols and sterile water. The preparation method of the vegetable sterilization preservative is simple and convenient, the prepared preservative is compounded with various natural biological preservatives, can inhibit the survival of various bacteria and microorganisms, and simultaneously isolates air to make the bacteria difficult to survive, thereby realizing the sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, and the vegetable sterilization preservative has the characteristics of good sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, wide action range, lasting action time and the like.

title_en: Feed for fattening beef cattle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding, and relates to a feed for fattening beef cattle. The feed comprises 200-400 parts of corn, 250-350 parts of barley, 50-200 parts of soybean meal, 30-150 parts of corn germ meal, 30-60 parts of corn DDGS, 5-15 parts of mountain flour, 3-10 parts of calcium hydrophosphate, 3-10 parts of salt, 2-5 parts of organic calcium magnesium, 2-10 parts of yeast culture, 2-5 parts of active microecological preparation, 1-2 parts of trace element premix, 0.2-1 part of rumen-bypass vitamin and 1-5 parts of rumen-bypass amino acid; the organic calcium magnesium is mixture of calcium alginate and magnesium alginate. The feed has the advantages that the organic calcium-magnesium mixture of sodium alginate and magnesium alginate is added, so that the rumen regulation effect is effectively improved, rumen acidosis is relieved, the feed intake of dry matters is increased, and the average daily gain is increased.

title_en: Composition containing feather protein powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a composition containing feather protein powder and a preparation method thereof. The composition containing the feather protein powder is prepared from corn flour, the feather protein powder, prebiotics, multivitamins, amino acid, bone meal, calcium carbonate, bracken, salt, an additive and water. The composition containing the feather protein powder provided by the invention covers comprehensive nutrition required by animal growth, supplements calcium element, promotes calcium absorption, promotes animal growth and is easy to digest and absorb by animals. In addition, the composition containing the feather protein powder provided by the invention contains nutritional ingredients such as prebiotics, bracken, ferulic acid and the like, and can promote intestinal peristalsis of animals, regulate immunity and reduce the morbidity of the animals.

title_en: Trachinotus ovatus nutrition-enhanced feed formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutrition-enhanced feed for Trachinotus ovatus and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides nutrition-enriched feed for trachinotus ovatus, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 25-35 parts of fish meal, 10-20 parts of soybean meal, 10-20 parts of plasma protein, 10-15 parts of Chinese herbal medicines, 10-15 parts of efficient probiotics, 0.25-1 part of bacteriocin, 2-3 parts of compound vitamin and 0.1-0.4 part of compound mineral. The nutrient enrichment feed for the trachinotus ovatus is rich in nutrient substances such as amino acids, small peptides, highly unsaturated fatty acids and the like required by the growth of the trachinotus ovatus, and can promote the rapid growth of the trachinotus ovatus. Meanwhile, the selected raw material hermetia illucens powder is rich in lauric acid and high-quality protein, has the antibacterial and antivirus effects, and improves the immunity of animals. The selected probiotic powder and Chinese herbal medicine have the functions of improving immunity, and the selected bacteriocin has the functions of resisting bacteria, killing parasites and bacteria and improving immunity.

title_en: Recombinant yeast strain and application thereof in reducing cecal ammonia gas production of laying hens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant yeast strain and application thereof in reducing the generation of cecal ammonia gas of laying hens. The recombinant yeast strain is obtained by transforming a recombinant expression vector containing a gdhA gene and a glnA gene into a pichia pastoris GS115 strain. The invention introduces the glnA gene in the bacillus coagulans and the gdhA gene in the enterococcus faecium into pichia pastoris through a genetic engineering means to construct a double-gene recombinant strain, the double-gene recombinant strain can efficiently express glutamate dehydrogenase and glutamine synthetase, can reduce 75% of ammonia gas emission in cecum of laying hens, has low cost and easy culture, has the advantages of no residue, no side effect, no resistance generation and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis, microecological preparation, feed and application of bacillus subtilis to improvement of production performance and eggshell quality of hens
abstract_en: The invention provides bacillus subtilis, a microecological preparation, a feed and application thereof in improving the production performance and the eggshell quality of breeding hens, and relates to the technical field of biology.
