The bacillus subtilis Liu-c1 provided by the invention is derived from traditional cheese, and the inventor adds bacillus subtilis Liu-c1 as a microecological preparation into the daily ration of a breeding hen to research and find that the laying rate of the breeding hen is improved by 5.63%, the qualified rate of hatching eggs is improved by 9.15%, and the feed-egg ratio is reduced by 4.09%; the superfine structure of the eggshell is improved, the thickness of the eggshell is increased by 3.67 percent, the strength of the eggshell is increased by 17.21 percent, and the content of calcium in the eggshell is increased by 2.34 percent; and the calcium content of the serum, the tibia and the uterus of the breeding hen are respectively increased by 11.62 percent, 5.06 percent and 19.63 percent, and the relative expression quantity of genes participating in calcium transfer and calcification in the egg shell forming process of the uterus is improved.

title_en: R gene for controlling soybean-rhizobium matching property, protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology, relates to application of a new gene, and particularly relates to a method for controlling matching of soybean and rhizobiumThe R gene of (1), and the protein and application thereof. The gene disclosed by the invention GmNNL1 In black bean of soybean line GmNNL1 The genome sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the coded amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. Of soybean R Gene GmNNL1 The gene is an effective gene capable of regulating and controlling the nodulation quantity of specific rhizobia on soybeans, can regulate and control the nodulation quantity by directly identifying the haplotype of specific effector protein NopP of slow rhizobia, limits the symbiotic nodulation of indigenous rhizobia, enables soybeans to preferentially nodulate with high-efficiency rhizobia agent applied artificially, and can improve the symbiotic nitrogen fixation capacity.

title_en: Fermentation type fruit wine brewing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brewing process of fermented fruit wine, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20% of fresh fruits, 13% of pure sugarcane brown sugar and 67% of water. According to the invention, through adopting a three-step fermentation process, the raw materials are sterilized firstly, each index of the wine is detected every day in the fermentation process, and meanwhile, peculiar smell gas is discharged to avoid explosion in the detection process every day.

title_en: Method for preparing functional tea beverage with artichoke as raw material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing functional tea drink by taking artichoke as a raw material, which relates to the technical field of tea processing and comprises the following steps: (1) carefully selecting and classifying buds, (2) accurately cutting stems, (3) shredding and shaping, (4) deactivating enzymes by microwaves, (5) stewing and yellowing at constant temperature and humidity, and (6) freezing and drying in vacuum. Compared with the artichoke tea produced by the prior art, the preparation method of the functional tea taking artichoke as the raw material has the advantages of attractive and formed appearance, yellow, white, bright and moist color and sweet and pure and mild taste, and simultaneously reduces the loss of functional components to the maximum extent, reduces the broken tea rate and improves the utilization rate.

title_en: Application of chitosan or derivatives thereof in de-odoring dairy products
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of chitosan or a derivative thereof in removing the cowy taste of animal dairy products or the fishy smell of vegetable dairy products, an application of chitosan or a derivative thereof in removing the cowy taste of animal dairy products or the fishy smell of vegetable dairy products by combining with an antioxidant, and a method for removing the cowy taste of animal dairy products or the fishy smell of vegetable dairy products.

title_en: Production method of dendrobium-rosa roxburghii tratt composite fruit powder
abstract_en: The invention provides dendrobium and rosa roxburghii tratt composite fruit powder which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: the composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 40-45 parts of roxburgh rose fruit powder, 20-30 parts of dendrobium powder, 5-10 parts of sugarcane powder, 10-20 parts of white lotus root powder, 5-10 parts of mint powder, 10-20 parts of medlar powder, 10-15 parts of scented tea powder and 3-8 parts of white granulated sugar powder.

title_en: Carrier and engineering bacteria for expressing phycocolloid lyase
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vector for expressing phycocolloid lyase and a recombinant engineering bacterium, wherein the recombinant engineering bacterium is a phycocolloid lyase yeast strain capable of expressing high enzyme activity, and the phycocolloid lyase secreted by the recombinant engineering bacterium can be used for preparing alginate oligosaccharides. The invention also provides the optimum fermentation temperature and the optimum fermentation pH value of the recombinant engineering bacteria, can further improve the yield of the phycocolloid lyase, and has wide industrial application prospect.

title_en: Spiral black tea with optimized fermentation of functional microorganisms and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a spiral black tea optimized and fermented by functional microorganisms and a preparation method thereof, wherein 3 functional microorganisms, namely monascus purpureus (aspergillus) ((R)) Monascus    purpureus ) CGMCC 3.884, Saccharomyces cerevisiae (C) Saccharomyces cerevisiae ) CGMCC 2.1543 and Lactobacillus plantarum (C) Lactobacillus plantarum ) CGMCC 1.2469 ensures that during the conversion of tea polyphenol to tea pigment, theaflavin and thearubigin are properly generated and in proper proportion, prevents excessive generation of theaflavin, and ensures that black tea is rich in health functional components lovastatin and gama-aminobutyric acid, thereby improving the taste and quality of tea and being widely applied to the technical field of tea processing.

title_en: Method for preparing food smoking liquid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing food smoking solution and application thereof, and the method for preparing the food smoking solution comprises the steps of respectively preparing n raw materials into single smoking solutions, and then mixing at least two single smoking solutions to prepare the food smoking solution, wherein n is a positive integer more than or equal to 2. The application of the food smoking solution is to carry out liquid smoking on food. Greatly enriches the variety and flavor of the food smoking solution and is convenient for developing the food smoking solutions with different varieties and flavors.

title_en: Transgenic salt-tolerant poplar with overexpression Siberian nitraria high-affinity potassium ion transporter gene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transgenic salt-tolerant poplar over-expressing Siberian nitraria high-affinity potassium ion transporter gene. The invention provides a protein, which is the protein described in the following 1) or 2) or 3): 1) a protein consisting of an amino acid sequence shown in a sequence 2 in a sequence table; 2) co-expression protein obtained by connecting molecular tags at the N end or/and the C end of the protein in the step 1); 3) the protein obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding one or more amino acid residues on the protein in the step 1) and has the same function. The invention transfers the key salt-tolerant gene NSHKT1 of the halophytic shrub Siberian nitraria tangutorum bobr into the 84K poplar, obtains the transgenic poplar with strong salt tolerance, alkali resistance and oxidation resistance, and provides a candidate variety for the application of the poplar in the saline and alkaline land.

title_en: Octenyl succinic acid starch ester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses octenyl succinic acid starch ester and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out grafting reaction on starch and octenyl succinic anhydride, and centrifugally washing after the reaction is finished to obtain a filter cake; (2) adding alpha amylase into the filter cake for enzymolysis reaction until the DE value is 5-20, deactivating the alpha amylase, then cooking, cooling after cooking, adding beta-amylase for enzymolysis reaction, and deactivating the beta-amylase after the reaction is finished to obtain an enzymatic hydrolysate; (3) and spray drying the enzymolysis solution to obtain the octenyl succinic acid starch ester. The emulsifying property of the octenyl succinic acid starch ester is greatly improved, and the octenyl succinic acid starch ester can be used as an excellent non-animal protein wall material to prepare fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule dry powder; meanwhile, the nutrient microcapsule dry powder product prepared by adopting the octenyl succinic acid starch ester has the characteristic of high water-soluble speed, and is particularly suitable for solid beverages, particularly instant beverages.

title_en: Starch octenyl succinate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses octenyl succinic acid starch ester and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out grafting reaction on starch and octenyl succinic anhydride, and centrifugally washing after the reaction is finished to obtain a filter cake; (2) Adding alpha amylase into the filter cake for enzymolysis reaction, performing enzymolysis until the DE value is 5-20, inactivating enzyme, then steaming, cooling after steaming, adding beta amylase for enzymolysis reaction, and inactivating enzyme after the reaction is finished to obtain enzymolysis liquid; (3) And (3) spray-drying the enzymolysis liquid to obtain the octenyl succinic acid starch ester. The starch octenyl succinate has greatly improved emulsifying performance, and can be used as an excellent non-animal protein wall material to prepare fat-soluble nutrient microcapsule dry powder; meanwhile, the nutrient microcapsule dry powder product prepared by adopting the octenyl succinic acid starch ester has the characteristic of high water dissolution speed, and is particularly suitable for solid beverages, especially instant beverages.

title_en: Novel chicken feed in egg laying period
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel chicken feed in an egg laying period, belonging to the field of poultry farming; mainly comprises the following steps: 70 to 80 parts of corn, 0.5 to 1.5 parts of corn germ meal, 0.5 to 1.5 parts of soybean oil, 0.5 to 2.5 parts of corn protein powder, 10 to 20 parts of soybean meal, 3 to 6 parts of peeled soybean meal, 5 to 10 parts of distillers dried grains and 1 to 7 parts of Aronia melanocarpa fruit powder; the feed can improve the oxidation resistance of the ovaries of the laying hens in the egg producing period, reduce the ovaries inflammation caused by egg production of the laying hens and shorten the egg producing period; the weight of the laying hen in the egg producing period can be increased, and the storage time of eggs can be prolonged; and the number of harmful bacteria can be reduced, the number of beneficial bacteria can be increased, and the intestinal health environment of the laying hens can be maintained.

title_en: Microwave puffed crisp fish slices and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microwave puffed crisp fish slice and a preparation method thereof, wherein unfrozen frozen meat raw material is used as a main component to be subjected to pretreatment, stirring, pulping, dishing and standing, quick freezing, temperature returning slicing, drying and slice collection and microwave puffing treatment to obtain a finished product of the microwave puffed crisp fish slice.

title_en: Fermented soya bean chili sauce and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Fermented soya bean chili sauce comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 15-25 parts of fermented soya beans, 80-120 parts of fresh raw chili, 10-20 parts of garlic, 8-15 parts of ginger, 5-10 parts of white spirit, 5-10 parts of white sugar and 15-25 parts of edible raw salt.

title_en: Ice cream evaporating cylinder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaporation cylinders, in particular to an ice cream evaporation cylinder which comprises an inner refrigeration cylinder body, wherein the bottom of the inner refrigeration cylinder body is communicated with an inner and outer double-sided refrigeration cylinder body, the left side wall of the upper part of the inner refrigeration cylinder body is communicated with a refrigerant inlet I, the left side wall of the lower part of the inner refrigeration cylinder body is also communicated with a refrigerant outlet I, the side wall of the bottom of the inner refrigeration cylinder body is respectively communicated with a refrigerant inlet II and a refrigerant outlet II, and the front side wall of the inner and outer double-sided refrigeration cylinder body is also horizontally communicated with a feed inlet. The evaporation area is refrigerated on three sides, the refrigeration effect is fast, and the electricity consumption cost is low.

title_en: Beverage capable of repairing digestive function and maintaining beauty and keeping young and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional drinks, and discloses a drink for repairing digestive functions and maintaining beauty and keeping young and a preparation method thereof. Taking strawberry, blueberry, mulberry and mangosteen, mixing, pulping at normal temperature, and filter-pressing to obtain an effective component stock solution; adding fructo-oligosaccharide, polydextrose, xanthan gum and sodium carboxymethylcellulose into water, stirring and dissolving uniformly, heating to 55-85 ℃, curing, and cooling to room temperature to obtain a protective solution; adding the functional component stock solution into the protective solution, stirring and mixing uniformly, then adding citric acid, sodium citrate, vitamin C and potassium sorbate, stirring and mixing uniformly to obtain the drink for repairing digestive function and maintaining beauty and keeping young. According to the invention, the curing treatment protection liquid is adopted to effectively wrap and protect the functional components obtained by squeezing at normal temperature, the obtained product has obviously enhanced stability, and the function of the functional component stock solution can be synergistically promoted to play.

title_en: Lobster kernel surface icing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses lobster kernel surface icing equipment which comprises a conveyor and a conveyor belt, wherein the conveyor belt is obliquely arranged at the upper part of the right end of the conveyor, and a refrigerator is fixedly arranged in the middle of the conveyor; the conveyor is provided with two groups, an objective table is movably connected between the two groups of the conveyor, a plurality of groups of through holes are formed in the objective table at equal intervals, an extension ring is movably connected to the lower part of an inner ring of the through holes, a round table is movably connected to the lower part of the inner ring of the extension ring, and a plurality of water outlets are formed in the middle of the side wall of the extension ring in a penetrating manner; the application relates to a device for automatically and uniformly collecting shelled shrimps, which comprises a conveyor, a plurality of spray heads, a collecting hopper, a slope, a plurality of water pipes, a plurality of spray heads, a plurality of water pipes, a plurality of collecting hoppers, a plurality of water pipes and a plurality of water pipes.

title_en: Yeast particle tolerant to livestock and poultry feed granulation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a core-shell structure yeast particle tolerant to livestock and poultry feed granulation, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of feed additives. The shell layer of the yeast particles is inactivated yeast, and the core layer is live yeast. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing yeast paste; 2) shaping and drying the yeast to obtain the spherical yeast particles with the core-shell structure. The yeast particles of the invention have uniform particle size, and the total number of the live yeast cells can reach 1.8 multiplied by 10 10 cfuMore than g; and the compound feed additive has good heat resistance and moisture resistance, can resist high-temperature and high-humidity environments in the feed granulating process, and the survival rate of yeast cells after feed granulation can reach more than 80%. The invention also provides a livestock feed, and the yeast granules are added into the livestock feed, so that the feed intake and weight gain of livestock can be improved, and the growth performance of animals can be safely and effectively improved.

title_en: Pseudo-ginseng WRKY transcription factor gene PnWRKY9 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pseudo-ginseng WRKY transcription factor gene PnWRKY9 And the application thereof, PnWRKY9 the nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the gene codes WRKY transcription factor; the invention is proved by related technical researches of molecular biology and functional genomics PnWRKY9 The gene has the function of improving the fungal disease resistance of plants, and the antifungal gene of the invention PnWRKY9 Constructed on a plant expression vector and transferred into tobacco for over-expression, the transgenic tobacco plant has strong in-vitro antifungal activity, PnWRKY9 overexpression of transgenic tobacco on Alternaria alternata ( Alternaria    compacta ) Fusarium solani (F.solani) (II) Fusarium solani ) "Black rice spore ( Nigrospora oryzae ) Has obvious inhibiting effect on the growth of the plants.

title_en: Mango essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses mango essence which is characterized by comprising, by mass, 135 parts of fruit aroma substances 130, 3-4 parts of green aroma substances, 1-2 parts of bean aroma substances, 1-2 parts of wine aroma substances, 1-2 parts of milk aroma substances, 18-19 parts of acid aroma substances, 12-13 parts of oil aroma substances, 50-55 parts of sweet aroma substances and 1-2 parts of characteristic aroma substances. The preparation method comprises the steps of detecting aroma components in a mature mango pulp sample by adopting a headspace solid-phase microextraction-gas chromatography/mass spectrometry combined technology to obtain component data of fruit aroma, green aroma, sweet aroma, bean aroma, wine aroma, milk aroma, acid aroma, oil aroma and characteristic aroma; and preparing the mango essence according to the component data. The mango essence disclosed by the invention is good in perfuming effect, good in natural feeling and natural feeling, and less in addition amount in practical application.

title_en: Human milk endogenous antibacterial polypeptide and application thereof in preparation of anti-inflammatory drugs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polypeptide compound GSPSGQKDLLF which is derived from human milk endogenous source and has inhibitory activity to gram-positive bacteria and gram-negative bacteria represented by escherichia coli and staphylococcus aureus, and the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide compound is Gly-Ser-Pro-Ser-Gly-Gln-Lys-Asp-Leu-Leu-Phe. The polypeptide GSPSGQKDLLF has broad inhibitory activity on gram-positive bacteria and gram-negative bacteria, and has good application prospect as a medicament and/or health product for preventing and/or reducing intestinal infection diseases of newborns caused by microorganisms or an additive of novel infant formula food.

title_en: Phytase mutant and coding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to an optimized and improved phytase mutant and a coding gene and application thereof. Which is substituted based on amino acid 77, 81, 219, 293 or 294 of the phytase shown in SEQ ID NO. 2. Compared with the wild phytase, the specific enzyme activity of the improved phytase mutant is improved to different degrees (10-63%). The improved phytase has good application prospect in the field of animal feed addition.

title_en: Functional plant solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional plant solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the functional plant solid beverage comprises the following components in percentage by mass: the sea-buckthorn health beverage is prepared from 15% of sea-buckthorn, 15% of white mulberry, 12% of dandelion, 12% of polygonatum odoratum, 12% of rhizoma polygonati, 30% of black fruit micromolecule peptide, 1% of riboflavin and 3% of monosaccharide, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing the following components in percentage by mass: sea-buckthorn, white mulberry, dandelion, polygonatum, rhizoma polygonati, black fruit small molecular peptide, riboflavin and monosaccharide; baking fructus Hippophae, Mori fructus, herba Taraxaci, rhizoma Polygonati Odorati, rhizoma Polygonati, small molecular peptide of fructus Nicandrae, riboflavin, and monosaccharide at low temperature for more than 24 hr; and putting the baked components into a high-speed powder grinding machine according to the weight part ratio for wall breaking treatment, and sieving by a sieve of 80-100 meshes to obtain superfine mixed powder. The invention can quickly and effectively dissolve fat and thrombolysis, reduce cholesterol and supplement various trace elements required by human body.

title_en: Shaftless spiral solid-liquid conveyor capable of avoiding blockage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shaftless spiral solid-liquid conveyor capable of avoiding blockage, which comprises a water supply pipe and is characterized in that: the rice cooker comprises a water supply pipe, a distribution pipe, a fixed barrel, a rotary barrel, a propeller blade, a rice supply pipe, a steam supply pipe, a rice supply valve ball, a rice supply valve port, a steam supply valve ball, a left telescopic shaft and a right telescopic shaft, wherein the right side of the water supply pipe is fixedly connected with the distribution pipe, the right side of the distribution pipe is fixedly connected with the fixed barrel, the rotary barrel is rotatably arranged in the fixed barrel, the propeller blade is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the rotary barrel, the rice supply pipe is arranged above the distribution pipe, the steam supply pipe is arranged below the distribution pipe, the rice supply valve ball is arranged on one side, located in the distribution pipe, of the rice supply pipe, the rice supply valve ball is arranged in the rice supply valve port, the steam supply pipe is provided with the rice supply valve ball.

title_en: Potato powder with stomach protecting and lung clearing functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A potato powder with stomach protecting and lung clearing functions and a preparation method thereof, the formula comprises: 600 parts of potato powder, 150 parts of rhizoma atractylodis macrocephalae, 150 parts of fig, 80-100 parts of barley powder, 80-100 parts of oat powder and 80-100 parts of corn powder. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, selecting materials; step two, soaking; step three, stirring and grinding; fourthly, fermenting; and fifthly, steaming and forming to obtain the product of the invention. The potato powder is beneficial to conditioning the body, can treat stomach diseases such as gastritis and gastric ulcer, has excellent stomach protection effect, and is an ideal health care product for patients with stomach diseases; it has effects in relieving cough and fever, clearing away heat, eliminating phlegm, and relieving cough.

title_en: Cooked pear and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pear manufacturing, in particular to a ripe pear and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the ripe pear comprises, by weight, 150 parts of pear 100-; the cooked pear has good taste, no astringent taste and no bitter taste, retains the water in the original pear, and is soft and beneficial to eating; the preparation method of the cooked pear comprises the steps of selecting materials, cleaning, blending, steaming and packaging; the method is simple and easy to operate, the cooked pear obtained by the preparation method is brownish red in color, transparent in surface, full in epidermis, and fragrant.

title_en: Formula and processing method of hericium erinaceus tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hericium erinaceus tea formula and a processing method thereof, wherein the hericium erinaceus tea formula is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: hericium erinaceus (prepared by drying, soaking, removing impurities, cutting, pre-cooking, performing enzymolysis, permeating water, dehydrating, etc.) (various shapes which can be processed by knife processing such as strip, sheet, block, etc.) 80-120 parts, refined salt 4-8 parts, crystal sugar 2-25 parts, brown sugar 2-25 parts, etc. are made into sugar solid products. The invention provides a production method and a processing method of hericium erinaceus tea. The method has simple operation, simple and reasonable formula and balanced nutrition; the raw material hericium erinaceus belongs to edible and medicinal fungi, has the effects of tonifying spleen and nourishing stomach, soothing nerves and resisting cancer, and has a good health-care effect.

title_en: Intelligent drying device for rumen-bypass product processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of drying devices, and particularly relates to an intelligent drying device for rumen-bypass product processing, which comprises a drying box, wherein a first hopper and a blanking hopper are arranged at the upper end of the drying box, the lower end of the blanking hopper is fixedly connected with a dispersion pipe and a dispersion hopper, a swing plate is arranged in the drying box, a moving rod penetrates through the lower end of the drying box, a lever plate is arranged in the drying box, the lever plate and the moving rod are hinged to form a connecting plate, a rotary drum is arranged below the connecting plate, and a driving shell, a driving motor, a driving shaft and a cam are arranged at the lower end of the drying box; the invention enables the dispersion pipes to rotate by arranging the dispersion motors, the driving wheels and the gear teeth, the falling distribution is more uniform, the drying is convenient, the moving rods are driven by the cams to move up and down, the swinging plates are driven to swing, rumen-bypass products roll off from the swinging plates intermittently, the drying is accelerated, meanwhile, the rotating drums are driven to rotate, the rotary drying can be realized during the falling, the four-time drying is realized, the drying is comprehensive, and the device is intelligent and convenient to operate.

title_en: Soup slice
abstract_en: The invention relates to soup slices. In particular, the present invention relates to a soup tablet comprising fat with a low solid fat content, fiber and having a moisture content of less than 2 wt.%. Yet another aspect of the invention is a method for producing soup slices.

title_en: Tissue culture method using dianthus chinensis cotyledon and application of tissue culture method in dianthus chinensis genetic transformation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a tissue culture method by using dianthus caryophyllus cotyledons and application thereof in dianthus caryophyllus genetic transformation. Not only provides a rapid propagation production technology for the pink, but also carries out industrial production; meanwhile, the regeneration method is utilized to carry out genetic transformation, and the genetic transformation can also be rapidly completed to obtain transgenic plants, so that a powerful technical platform is constructed for further carrying out agrobacterium tumefaciens-mediated transgenic research on the dianthus chinensis.

title_en: Liposome simulating breast milk lipid structure, formula powder for premature infant and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liposome simulating breast milk lipid structure, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5490-6710 parts of raw milk, 230-290 parts of whey protein powder rich in MFGM milk fat globule membrane, 18-22 parts of soybean lecithin, 180-220 parts of OPO structure fat, 20-25 parts of linseed oil, 50-62 parts of coconut oil and 138-170 parts of sunflower seed oil; wherein the whey protein powder rich in MFGM cream spherical membranes contains 12-20% of MFGM cream spherical membrane components. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the liposome simulating breast milk lipid structure, preterm infant formula powder and a preparation method thereof. The formula powder for premature babies is prepared by reasonably proportioning protein and carbohydrate, and strengthening components such as oligosaccharide, phospholipid, vitamins, mineral substances, nutrients and the like.

title_en: Method for improving enzyme sensitivity of starch
abstract_en: A method of increasing the enzyme sensitivity of starch comprising the steps of: s1: taking a predetermined amount of starch, and sieving; s2: the screened starch is blended into starch milk with the concentration of 30 to 40 percent; s3: vacuum packaging the starch milk, and then placing the starch milk in ultrahigh-pressure coupling heat treatment equipment for ultrahigh-pressure coupling heat treatment, wherein the pressure is 200-250 MPa, the temperature is 50-55 ℃, and the time is 10-20 min; s4: starch milk with improved enzyme sensitivity is obtained.

title_en: Arabidopsis thaliana anther tapetum promoter expression vector and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The construction method of the arabidopsis thaliana anther tapetum promoter expression vector comprises the following steps: defining about 1380bp sequence before the AT1G75050 protein coding region as the gene promoter, cloning the promoter, connecting the promoter into an expression vector containing a GUS reporter gene, transforming an arabidopsis thaliana plant, screening and identifying to finally obtain a transgenic plant. The invention clones the arabidopsis gene promoter AT1G75050 promoter, starts the construction of GUS expression vector, transforms the GUS expression vector into plants for research, analyzes the screened plants to find that GUS gene is specifically expressed in anther tapetum, and the transgenic material can be used for the separation and research of tapetum cells. On the other hand, the promoter can promote the specific expression of related genes in a tapetum and create more male sterile materials related to pollen development.

title_en: Rattan pepper flavor low-temperature fresh-keeping lobster and pickling material thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rattan pepper flavored low-temperature locked fresh lobster and a pickling material thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The pickled vine pepper flavor low-temperature fresh-keeping lobster is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3-5 parts of fresh rattan pepper, 1-3 parts of fresh pepper, 2-4 parts of fresh zanthoxylum piperitum, 1-3 parts of oyster sauce, 2-4 parts of light soy sauce, 4-6 parts of white sugar and 2-4 parts of rattan pepper oil. The rattan pepper flavor low-temperature fresh-keeping lobster pickling material provided by the invention is clear in color, has fresh and fragrant rattan pepper flavor, is moderate in sweet, salty and hot degree, and is fragrant and soft in taste. The low-temperature fresh-keeping lobster with the rattan pepper taste is obtained by pickling the lobsters with the pickling material after cleaning and frying, the cooked crayfish is red and bright in color and luster, the tastes of the fried lobsters and the pickling material are kneaded, the lobster meat is elastic when entering the mouth, has the rattan pepper taste, is salty, fresh and slightly sweet in taste, is fragrant, spicy and slightly hot in taste, and improves the commodity value of the crayfish.

title_en: Angelica keiskei polysaccharide extract and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a angelica keiskei polysaccharide extract and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of food and medicine. The preparation method of the angelica keiskei polysaccharide extract comprises the following steps: activating strains, namely inoculating trichoderma viride on a PDA culture medium for culture; strain amplification, namely inoculating the activated strain into a liquid culture medium for culture to obtain a strain culture solution; microbial transformation, namely inoculating a strain culture solution into a biotransformation culture medium containing the tangeretin according to 8-12% of inoculation amount for culture; separating and purifying to obtain Angelica keiskei polysaccharide extract. The angelica keiskei polysaccharide extract prepared by the invention has high biotransformation rate, strong drug effect, excellent anti-inflammatory effect and oxidation resistance, good thrombolytic effect and excellent treatment effect on fracture combined brain injury, and can be used for preparing corresponding medicines or functional health-care foods.

title_en: Long-hair rabbit feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cultivation, and particularly relates to a formula and a preparation method of a feed for long-hair rabbits; the feed is prepared from rice, longan shell, corn, sword bean, cinnamon, Chinese date, purslane and microbial preparation. Wherein the microbial preparation is prepared from lactobacillus and yeast by pulverizing, fermenting, mixing, etc. The feed prepared by the method can obviously improve the hair yield of the long-hair rabbits, improve the coarse hair rate, greatly improve the economic value of the long-hair rabbit breeding, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Non-coding nucleotide sequence and application thereof in improving expression level of exogenous gene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-coding nucleotide sequence and application thereof in improving the expression level of exogenous genes, belonging to the field of biotechnology, wherein the nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1.

title_en: Preparation method of preserved Aronia melanocarpa without astringency through microwave sugar permeation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a microwave sugar-penetrated Aronia melanocarpa preserved fruit, relates to the field of foods, and aims to solve the problems of poor taste, long sugar-curing time and complex acerbity removing method of the Aronia melanocarpa preserved fruit. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: selecting raw materials, cleaning, scalding, protecting color, decocting with sugar, microwave soaking sugar, soaking in sugar at normal temperature, draining, and drying. The preserved black chokeberry fruit processed by the invention is sweet, soft and delicious, has good integrity and excellent taste, and simultaneously retains the original taste of the black chokeberry fruit. The invention is applied to the field of preserved fruits.

title_en: Application of avenanthramide compounds and composition thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of avenanthramide compounds in inhibiting the growth of mucormous roseomonas and preparing a pet bacteriostatic composition. The invention also discloses a pet antibacterial composition which mainly comprises the avenanthramide compound, wherein the avenanthramide compound is composed of an effective dose for inhibiting the mucormycosis, auxiliary materials and physiologically acceptable components for pets. The invention verifies the inhibition effect of the avenanthramide compounds on the mucormophyte through experiments, greatly widens the application field of the avenanthramide compounds, develops the brand-new application of the avenanthramide compounds in pet antibacterial compositions, especially pet antibacterial nutritional pastes, effectively plays the role of inhibiting the infection of the mucormophyte of pets, fills the market blank of inhibiting the mucormophyte of pets, and adds a layer of powerful protection for the guarantee of the health of the pets by combining with the field of pets.

title_en: Fish fat metabolism regulator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fish fat metabolism regulator, which comprises a compound acidifier, a traditional Chinese medicine mixture and an alkaloid preparation, wherein the mass ratio of the components is (3-4): (2-3): (2-4); the compound acidulant is a mixture which takes citric acid, fumaric acid, phosphoric acid and benzoic acid as main acidulants and rice bran meal as a carrier; the effective components of the Chinese medicinal mixture comprise fructus crataegi, semen Cassiae and herba Taxilli, and the carrier is rice hull; the effective components of the alkaloid preparation are betaine and L-carnitine, and the carrier is wheat bran. The invention adopts nutritional additives as most of raw materials, has obvious effect and good safety in the aspects of accelerating the fat transformation of fish bodies and reducing the fat deposition of visceral organs, has no residue in fish bodies, and provides reliable guarantee for the production of pollution-free aquatic products.

title_en: Water-replenishing and whitening solid beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foods, in particular to a water replenishing and whitening solid beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the water replenishing and whitening solid beverage comprises 40-60% of fish collagen peptide, 20-40% of fructo-oligosaccharide, 15-25% of blueberry powder, 0.1-0.5% of sodium hyaluronate and 0.05-0.2% of vitamin C, the average molecular weight of the fish collagen peptide is 1000-3000 daltons, and the water replenishing and whitening solid beverage has the advantages of easiness in absorption, good water replenishing effect, lasting water replenishing, good whitening effect and good taste; the preparation method of the water replenishing and whitening solid beverage has the advantage of easy operation.

title_en: Composition with effects of calming and helping sleep and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition with effects of calming and helping sleep and application thereof, wherein the active ingredients of the composition comprise: 4-8 parts of cannabidiol, 0.5-1.5 parts of tetrahydrocannabinol and 1.3-2.7 parts of cannabinol. In the composition provided by the invention, different hemp extracts are combined in proportion, and the effects of calming, helping sleep and the like are achieved through the interaction of medicinal components, so that the composition is particularly suitable for various people with higher pressure at present.

title_en: Processing technology of mackerel fillet
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing technology of mackerel blocks, which comprises the following steps: the three-level tablet is unfrozen, abdominal pricked removed, inspected, disinfected and cleaned, pricked and inspected, rechecked, rinsed, water controlled, frozen/micro-frozen, cut into sections, seasoning liquid proportioning, flavor soaking, liquid controlled, powder stained, inspected, refrigerated in, taken out of a single freezer, inspected, bagged, sealed, gold detected, boxed, reweighed and boxed, packaged, checked and warehoused for refrigeration. The mackerel flesh soaked by the seasoning liquid has unique flavor and rich nutrition, is quick-frozen and is kept below-18 ℃, so that the freshness of the mackerel flesh is ensured, the nutrient substances of the mackerel flesh can be kept as much as possible, a consumer can eat the mackerel flesh anytime and anywhere, and consumption is promoted. The whole processing process of the mackerel fillet is carried out at low temperature, so that the freshness of the raw materials is ensured, the reproduction of microorganisms is inhibited, and the quality of the fillet product is ensured.

title_en: Microwave quick-freezing prepared galangal beef slices and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microwave quick-freezing prepared galangal beef slice and a processing method thereof, wherein the processing method comprises the following steps: counting by taking the mass of the fresh beef as a reference, wherein the fresh beef comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 5 to 10 percent of vegetable oil, 3 to 5 percent of galangal, 5 to 8 percent of potato starch, 1 to 1.5 percent of salt, 0.5 to 1 percent of white granulated sugar, 0.4 to 0.8 percent of monosodium glutamate, 0.5 to 1 percent of light soy sauce, 0.3 to 0.5 percent of TG enzyme solution, 0.1 to 0.2 percent of baking soda, 0.1 to 0.3 percent of carrageenan, 0.1 to 0.15 percent of gluconic acid-delta-lactone, 0.1 to 0.12 percent of chlorogenic acid, 0.01 to 0.02 percent of nicotinamide, 0.4 to 0.6 percent of compound spice and 20 to 30 percent of ice water. The preparation method has higher process operability, can meet the requirements of people on natural, safe, nutritional, convenient and diversified food, is suitable for wide crowds and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Application of electrolyzed water for fresh keeping
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preservation, discloses an application of electrolyzed water in preservation, and solves the problem that the existing chemical preservative has side effects on human bodies. The invention preserves the freshness of vegetables and fruits by electrolyzing water, compared with the prior art which adopts a chemical preparation mode, the electrolyzed water is directly obtained by electrolysis, and has the characteristic of safe use; meanwhile, the electrolyzed water can remove pesticide residues remained on fruits and vegetables, thereby further improving the effect of the electrolyzed water.

title_en: Tea frying device assisting in discharging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tea frying device with auxiliary blanking, which comprises a working bin, wherein the lower part of the right side of an inner cavity of the working bin is fixedly connected with a base station, the middle part of the right side of the inner cavity of the working bin is fixedly connected with a beam frame, a vertical frame is fixedly connected between the base station and the beam frame, two groups of first expansion frames are horizontally arranged on the vertical frame, the left ends of the two groups of first expansion frames are fixedly connected with adjusting frames, the top sides of the adjusting frames are movably connected with the beam frame, and each group of the adjusting frames is provided with a strip-shaped groove; the lower portion of the left side of the inner cavity of the working bin is fixedly connected with an arc-shaped frame, the top side of the arc-shaped frame is movably connected with a frying plate, two sides of the right end of the frying plate are fixedly connected with connecting frames, a guide clamping rod is fixedly connected between the two groups of connecting frames, and the guide clamping rod is movably clamped with the strip-shaped groove.

title_en: Tortoise peptide essence health wine and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tortoise peptide essence health wine and a production method thereof, wherein adult live turtles are slaughtered, deboned, cleaned and crushed into turtle meat paste, and are matched with deerhorn glue, poria cocos, propolis, black beans, lucid ganoderma and beautiful millettia root according to the proportion to extract and obtain liquid with bioactive components; preparing turtle peptide by taking a turtle shell extract and turtle meat paste as raw materials and using an enzymatic hydrolysis method; mixing the bioactive component liquid and the tortoise peptide in proportion, and finally modulating, aging, filtering and filling to obtain a finished product. The invention extracts and preserves the bioactive components in the raw materials to the maximum extent, retains the unique flavor of the raw materials, removes the peculiar smell from animal and plant medicinal materials, supplements a plurality of bioactive components from the raw materials, and can effectively regulate immunity, resist oxidation, tumors, fatigue, blood fat, improve sleep and delay aging, thereby achieving the effects of nourishing yin and strengthening yang, building up body, maintaining beauty and keeping young and prolonging life.

title_en: Method for improving content of methyl catechin in green tea
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green tea production, and discloses a method for improving the content of methyl catechin in green tea, which comprises the following steps: preparing fresh fruit juice and fruit pieces; fresh tea leaves are picked, fresh fruit juice is sprayed to wither and deactivate, fresh fruit shreds are mixed into the deactivated tea leaves to be rolled, and the fresh fruit shreds are mixed again to be baked after rolling She Jiekuai. Different types of efficient oxygen methyl transferase contained in the skin and the meat of natural edible fruits can catalyze the conversion of flavonoid secondary metabolites in fresh tea leaves to form methyl catechin, and the content of the methyl catechin in green tea is improved.

title_en: Fermented traditional Chinese medicine additive for improving egg poultry production performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fermented traditional Chinese medicine additive for improving the production performance of laying poultry and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of feed additives; the paint specifically comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-15 parts of liquorice, 15-25 parts of dried orange peel, 25-35 parts of hawthorn, 25-35 parts of Chinese yam, 25-35 parts of divaricate saposhnikovia root, 55-65 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 55-65 parts of astragalus membranaceus, 25-35 parts of epimedium herb and 55-65 parts of isatis root; adding liquorice, dried orange peel, hawthorn and Chinese yam into yeast and medicated leaven for aerobic liquid fermentation, then adding radix sileris, bighead atractylodes rhizome, astragalus, epimedium and isatis root for anaerobic liquid fermentation to obtain an intermediate fermentation product, adding lactobacillus plantarum, bacillus subtilis and bacillus licheniformis into the intermediate fermentation product, and then performing solid fermentation to obtain a traditional Chinese medicine additive; the invention improves the absorption and utilization rate of the traditional Chinese medicine components of the laying fowl, improves the medicinal effect, and solves the problems of the egg laying rate reduction caused by insufficient qi and blood of the laying fowl and abnormal oviduct.

title_en: High-load and high-stability protein-based curcumin product and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional foods, and discloses a high-load and high-stability protein-based curcumin product and a preparation method and application thereof. The protein-based curcumin product is prepared from protein and curcumin; the protein is a basic protein. The invention utilizes the structural characteristics of protein, regulates and controls pH, takes the protein as a curcumin carrier, protects curcumin in the denatured and folded protein, realizes the high-efficiency load of curcumin, and greatly improves the water solubility, stability and bioavailability of curcumin.

title_en: Mashed garlic gold sauce and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses minced garlic gold sauce which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 33-37 parts of golden pepper, 28-32 parts of garlic, 4-6 parts of onion, 4-6 parts of ginger, 14-16 parts of salad oil, 2-4 parts of concentrated chicken juice, 1.5-2.5 parts of chicken essence, 1.5-2.5 parts of monosodium glutamate, 1.5-2.5 parts of white sugar and 0.8-1.2 parts of salt. The golden garlic sauce prepared by the invention is organically combined by the golden pepper and other raw materials with spicy taste, so that the golden garlic sauce has the characteristics of aromatic flavor and lingering taste.

title_en: Stirring machine for manufacturing chili sauce
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stirring machine, in particular to a stirring machine for manufacturing chilli sauce. The technical problem of the invention is as follows: provided is a stirring machine for manufacturing chili sauce, which can realize uniform stirring and saves time and labor. The technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides a chilli sauce makes and uses stirring machine, has placed the agitator including backup pad, agitator, servo motor, agitator, protection machanism and feed liquor mechanism at the backup pad top, is equipped with servo motor in the middle of the agitator bottom, and the servo motor output shaft passes the agitator, and servo motor output shaft top is equipped with the agitator, is equipped with protection machanism between backup pad and the agitator, is equipped with feed liquor mechanism on the protection machanism. Through the cooperation between protection machanism and the feed liquor mechanism, can constantly stir oil and hot pepper automatically, at the stirring in-process, block the hot pepper to the hot pepper splashes on one's body to people, plays the guard action.

title_en: Sauce wine blending impurity removal method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquor blending, and discloses a liquor blending impurity removal method based on sauce, which comprises the steps of selecting a base material, preparing a biological blending agent, removing impurities by using the biological blending agent, blending a new liquor in a small sample, blending a scorched aroma agent, and detecting a liquor body, selecting an antiphlogistic grass rich in flavonoid, terpenes, phenolphthalein and volatile oil substances from a plurality of medicinal materials as a main base material, soaking the main base material in old sauce fragrant Daqu liquor to leach out medicinal components, improving the oxidation and hydrolysis resistance of the substances in the liquor by using the flavonoid, terpenes, phenolphthalein and volatile oil substances in the medicinal components, reducing the generation of mercaptan odor caused by oxidation reaction of substances such as hydrogen sulfide in the liquor, and influencing Kau the taste and aroma of the stored liquor, wherein the flavonoid ingredients in the medicinal materials are used for improving the oxidation resistance of the liquor, and inhibiting the hydrolysis and oxidation of the substances such as hydrogen sulfide, mercaptan, diethyl sulfide and the like in the liquor, prevent the liquor from being recycled and influencing the quality of the soy sauce liquor.

title_en: Sunflower seed oil composition
abstract_en: The present application provides a sunflower seed oil composition wherein the content of cis-verbenol in the sunflower seed oil composition is above 0.15ppm and less than 1.30ppm, preferably between 0.30ppm and 1.25ppm, and the content of cis-verbenol is the amount of non-exogenously added cis-verbenol. The application also provides a preparation method and application of the sunflower seed oil composition.

title_en: Linolenic acid and protein powder set composite beverage and eating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linolenic acid and protein powder packaged compound beverage, which is a large-package packaged finished product formed by matching 1-10 parts of linolenic acid and 20-50 parts of protein powder by mass; the linolenic acid is oil materials such as perilla seed oil, linseed oil and the like rich in natural alpha-linolenic acid or alpha-linolenic acid purification materials of the oil materials; the protein powder is animal milk powder, plant protein powder or their combination; the linolenic acid is filled in a light-resistant glass bottle and is liquid lipid; the invention also discloses an eating method of the linolenic acid and protein powder packaged compound beverage, which comprises the steps of pouring protein powder into a cup or a bowl, adding warm boiled water at 30-50 ℃ for stirring, adding linolenic acid after the mixture is mixed into paste, stirring uniformly, and eating after the linolenic acid is completely emulsified. Therefore, the invention adopts the light-resistant glass bottle for filling and adopts the edible method of homogenizing with warm boiled water at 30-50 ℃, thus avoiding the inactivation of the alpha-linolenic acid.

title_en: Encoding gene for improving cadmium tolerance of plants and repairing cadmium pollution of soil by plant genetic engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coding gene for enhancing cadmium tolerance of plants and promoting cadmium ions to transfer from roots to leaves, belonging to the technical field of plant repair genetic engineering. The coding gene sequence for enhancing the cadmium tolerance of plants and promoting the transfer of cadmium ions from roots to leaves is shown in a sequence table SEQ ID No: l is shown. The invention mutates coding genes which can enhance the cadmium tolerance of plants and promote the transfer of cadmium ions from roots to leaves in plants by using a T-DNA insertion mutation technology, so that the plants in the plants are cadmium-tolerant and the expression of coding genes of cadmium transporter in the plants is increased, thereby promoting the plants to transfer cadmium from the roots to the leaves with less toxicity to the plants for storage, and further expressing the cadmium tolerance. The related protein for enhancing the cadmium tolerance of plants and promoting the transfer of cadmium ions from roots to leaves and the coding gene thereof can provide gene resources and technical support for improving the heavy metal pollution of soil by the plant repair genetic engineering technology.

title_en: Processing method of tea tree scented tea
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea processing, in particular to a processing method of tea tree scented tea. The processing method of the tea tree scented tea comprises the following steps: and S1 picking: picking tea flowers in bud period in the morning and afternoon before winter solstice every year; s2 sorting: conveying the collected tea flowers into a winnowing machine for winnowing treatment, and removing broken leaves and impurities in the tea leaves; s3 vacuum freeze drying: putting the tea flowers in a freeze dryer, and carrying out freeze drying treatment; s4, low-temperature drying: spreading the dried tea flowers in a tray in a single layer, baking in a hot air dryer to obtain primary baked flowers, and naturally cooling; s5 high-temperature sterilization: sterilizing the primarily baked flowers under high pressure; s6 classification: removing impurities, screening and cleaning flowers, and metering and subpackaging; and S7 sealing and warehousing. The invention solves the problems of non-strong fragrance and heavy bitter taste of the tea tree scented tea prepared by the prior art, and the obtained tea soup has lasting fragrance and good taste and quality.

title_en: Anti-solidification device for crushing raw materials and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of brown sugar processing, and particularly relates to an anti-solidification device for crushing raw materials. The device removes the moisture in the airflow entering the crushing device twice; the air flow after removing the moisture for two times contacts with the brown sugar powder in the grinding device, and the brown sugar powder can be effectively prevented from absorbing water and being solidified again. The invention also provides a using method of the device, which comprises the steps of primary dehumidification, secondary dehumidification, state adjustment of the dehumidification unit and the like, wherein the method of the invention dehumidifies the inlet air flow twice through the dehumidification unit; in the dehumidification process, the internal and external surfaces of the dehumidification unit can absorb moisture uniformly by adjusting the working state of the dehumidification unit; simultaneously, a large amount of nitrogen is added into the air flow, so that the content of oxygen in the air flow can be reduced, and the effect of inhibiting the breeding of bacteria in the brown sugar is achieved.

title_en: Mixed fermentation process based on yeast Naganishia albida and saccharomyces cerevisiae
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mixed fermentation process based on yeast Naganishia albida and saccharomyces cerevisiae, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The mixed fermentation process based on the yeast Naganishia albida and the saccharomyces cerevisiae is characterized in that the yeast Naganishia albida and the saccharomyces cerevisiae are subjected to mixed fermentation; the yeast Naganishia albida refers to a yeast Naganishia albida strain YC22; the preservation number of the yeast Naganishia albida strain YC22 is CCTCC M2021085. Compared with the single-fungus fermentation of the Saccharomyces cerevisiae F33, the method has very remarkable promotion on a plurality of aroma substances which can influence the flavor of the alcoholic beverage, thereby bringing about unique flavor, aroma and taste of the fermented beverage.

title_en: Transgenic method for automatically deleting selection markers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular biology, and particularly discloses a transgenic method for automatically deleting a selection marker. Constructing a transgenic vector containing a selection marker and automatically deleting the selection marker, and transforming the transgenic vector into plants to obtain callus; the selection marker gene can be expressed normally, and after cytokinin is added, the selection marker gene is induced to be deleted automatically; the DNA sequence of the transgenic vector with the automatic deletion selection marker is arranged according to the vector skeleton-loxP-Arr 5-Cre-selection marker-loxP-vector skeleton. The transgenic vector comprises a Cre/loxP recombination system, a selection marker, an Arr5 promoter gene and the Cre gene are positioned between two loxP sites, the Arr5 promoter can start Cre recombinase expression, and then loxP recombination reaction is induced to delete DNA sequences between the two loxP sites, so that deletion of the selection marker gene is realized, and a possible technical approach is provided for the safety of transgenic plants.

title_en: Bai Shi nan Li kou wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wine production and processing, in particular to a Bai Shi nan Li kou wine and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Bai Shi nan Li kou wine is obtained by the following method: the method comprises the steps of carrying out manual sorting, stem removing and crushing, temperature reduction and squeezing, low-temperature clarification and separation on overcooked atrophied and slightly browned Bai Shi nan grapes to obtain clarified juice, carrying out acid adjustment and temperature control fermentation on the clarified juice to obtain fermentation liquor, adding brandy into the fermentation liquor to adjust the alcoholic strength, carrying out low-temperature filtration to obtain liqueur base wine, and carrying out ageing, degumming, filtration, freezing and heat preservation and filtration on the liqueur base wine to obtain the Bai Shi nan liqueur wine. The method utilizes the characteristic of natural high sugar of the Turpan local white poem grape raw material, does not need to add additional sweet substances, adopts constant temperature to carry out low-temperature fermentation, promotes the fusion of aroma substances in wine, and has the advantages of simple processing method, low raw material cost, bright product color, rich aroma, smooth taste, high market acceptance and good market prospect.

title_en: Bletilla direct seeding and seedling raising method utilizing symbiotic bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bletilla direct seeding and seedling raising method by utilizing symbiotic bacteria, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1 obtaining bletilla striata symbiotic bacteria: culturing bletilla striata explants to obtain bletilla striata symbiotic bacteria strains for later use; s2 direct seeding and seedling raising of bletilla striata: seed mixing is carried out on the pretreated bletilla striata seeds and the bletilla striata symbiotic bacteria in the step S1, and then the seeds are sowed in a seedbed; s3 sowing later-stage management: after the sowed seeds sprout out, fertilizing and hardening the seedlings, and then transplanting. The bletilla striata symbiotic bacteria and bletilla striata seeds are mixed uniformly and then are subjected to direct seeding and seedling hardening treatment, the bletilla striata symbiotic bacteria are added in the bletilla striata seed germination process, the direct seeding germination rate of the bletilla striata seeds is up to 86%, a Huabao foliar fertilizer is sprayed in the later management process, and the seedling growth speed is high.

title_en: Fish skin gelatin emulsion stabilized by sodium alginate and corn starch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A fish skin gelatin emulsion stabilized by sodium alginate and corn starch and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of emulsion preparation. Firstly, mixing sodium alginate and corn starch, dissolving in deionized water, carrying out water bath reaction, and cooling to room temperature to obtain a biopolymer stabilizer; dissolving fishskin gelatin in a stabilizer to prepare a water phase, and adding fat-soluble active substances into the corn oil to serve as an oil phase; and mixing the water phase and the oil phase, and then dispersing at a high speed and homogenizing at a high pressure to obtain the fish skin gelatin emulsion with stable sodium alginate and corn starch. Compared with the emulsion prepared by only using fish skin gelatin under the same condition, the emulsion prepared by the invention is an oil-in-water delivery system which has the advantages of low cost, safety, convenience, higher BITC embedding rate and bioavailability and better storage stability, and has great potential in the development of health-care foods, functional beverages and other products.

title_en: Preparation process of paper mulberry silage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of paper mulberry silage, which relates to the technical field of animal feeds and comprises the following raw materials: the feed is prepared from broussonetia papyrifera leaves, corn straws, feed mulberry leaves, pasture, alfalfa, salt, composite mineral substances, potatoes, oilseed dregs, phosphorus powder, sugar, papain, a leavening agent and a composite microecological preparation, and by fermenting the broussonetia papyrifera leaves, the leavening agent and the composite microecological preparation, not only can nutrients in the broussonetia papyrifera leaves and other raw materials be fully released, but also the mixed bacteria are less, the preparation time of the silage can be effectively shortened, the mixing of putrefying bacteria is reduced, the content of pediococcus acidilactici and lactobacillus plantarum which are beneficial to digestion and absorption of animals is large, and toxic substances in the broussonetia papyrifera leaves can be effectively consumed; compared with dry feed, the silage obtained by the invention is soft and juicy, has sweet and sour flavor, effectively enhances the palatability of the feed, and can increase the yield of the silage, and particularly, livestock can eat greenish feed in the hay season.

title_en: GH61 polypeptide variants and polynucleotides encoding same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to GH61 polypeptide variants. The invention also relates to polynucleotides encoding these variants; nucleic acid constructs, vectors, and host cells comprising the polynucleotides; and methods of using these variants.

title_en: High homogenization tealeaves system device of frying based on gravity and inertia combine together
abstract_en: The invention provides a tea leaf stir-frying device with high homogenization based on combination of gravity and inertia, which belongs to the technical field of tea leaf stir-frying devices and comprises a stir-frying box, wherein bendable stir-frying surfaces are symmetrically arranged in the stir-frying box up and down, connecting rods are uniformly arranged on one side of the bendable stir-frying surfaces, bendable heating surfaces are arranged on the bendable stir-frying surfaces between the connecting rods, and guide plates are uniformly and rotatably arranged on the inner side wall of the stir-frying box at positions corresponding to the upper and lower bendable stir-frying surfaces. This high homogenization tealeaves system of frying device based on gravity and inertia combine together, through the combined action of flexible system face of frying, flexible heating face, connecting rod, deflector, cam spare and accepting the board, with inertia and gravity scientific and reasonable's combination together, make tealeaves be heated more evenly at the system in-process of frying, very big improvement the homogeneity and the rationality that the system in-process was fried to tealeaves heated, corresponding improvement the quality that the tealeaves was fried and the finished product quality of tealeaves.

title_en: Fruit and vegetable dish with disinfection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fruit and vegetable tray with a disinfection function, which comprises a fruit tray main body, wherein the fruit tray main body is provided with a storage cavity for containing food, and the fruit tray main body is provided with a disinfection device capable of disinfecting the food in the storage cavity. The disinfection device is preferably an electrolysis assembly capable of generating hypochlorous acid disinfection liquid in the storage cavity. Under the electrolysis of the electrolysis assembly, hypochlorous acid can be generated, and the fruits, vegetables and other food in the storage cavity can be disinfected through the hypochlorous acid, so that the device is safe and sanitary.

title_en: Herbicide-resistant polypeptide, nucleic acid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides herbicide resistant polypeptides, nucleic acids and applications thereof, in particular herbicide resistant genes, polypeptides and applications thereof in plant breeding, in particular, the invention provides a mutant HPPD polypeptide, and the mutant HPPD polypeptide is mutated at the 20 th amino acid corresponding to SEQ ID NO.1 compared with a parent HPPD polypeptide. The mutated HPPD polypeptide has strong tolerance to herbicide and has very wide application prospect in the field of improving and cultivating HPPD-resistant herbicide tolerant plants.

title_en: Cow milk beta-lactoglobulin T cell immune tolerance hydrolysate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cow milk beta-lactoglobulin T cell immune tolerance hydrolysate and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises predicting a beta-lactoglobulin T-cell epitope; carrying out enzymolysis on beta-lactoglobulin by adopting different types of protease, determining the amino acid sequence of a hydrolysate peptide segment by using mass spectrum, comparing the amino acid sequence of the peptide segment with a predicted beta-lactoglobulin T cell epitope sequence, and preliminarily screening out a hydrolysate which possibly has an immune tolerance effect; the selected hydrolysate which possibly has the immunological tolerance is taken as a research object, and the hydrolysate which actually has the immunological tolerance is further selected by an animal experiment. The invention successfully establishes a model for inducing oral tolerance of Balb/c mice by trypsin, compound protease and papain beta-lactoglobulin hydrolysate, and the three hydrolysates can effectively prevent anaphylactic reaction of the mice induced by OVA. According to the beta-lactoglobulin hydrolysate of the present invention, peptide drugs or functional foods can be developed.

title_en: Method and system for measuring brewing temperature of white spirit and highland barley wine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for measuring brewing temperature of white spirit and highland barley wine, relates to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to the technical field of brewing of highland barley wine. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the highland barley is selected, crushed, moistened with grain, cooked, added with water for spreading cold, added with yeast powder and stirred with shells, and then put into a fermentation tank for primary fermentation; arranging a wireless temperature sensor at least one preset position in a fermentation pool in advance; in the fermentation process, the wireless temperature sensor is started, and the primary fermentation temperature data measured by the wireless temperature sensor according to the preset frequency is received through the wireless transceiver, so that the temperature data in the highland barley wine brewing process can be accurately measured, the effect of temperature on microorganisms and the influence on the formation of flavor compounds can be obtained, and reference is provided for the subsequent regulation of the formation of flavor compounds in the highland barley wine.

title_en: Preparation method of puffed sesame and sweet potato chips
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of puffed sesame sweet potato chips, which comprises a preparation method of puffed sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed peanut sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed red date sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed scallion-flavor sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed ginger-flavor sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed jasmine flower sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed sweet osmanthus sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed pecan sesame sweet potato chips, a preparation method of puffed sesame potato chips, a preparation method of puffed peanut sesame sweet potato chips and a preparation method of puffed red date sesame sweet potato chips, wherein the prepared sweet potato chips do not need to be fried, are nutritional and delicious, and the preparation method is simple; the raw materials are healthy and safe, the prepared sweet potato sesame slices solve the problems of frying in the prior art, and have the advantages of being crispy and delicious, low in fat content and the like.

title_en: Be used for agricultural production to use dairy products high temperature disinfection machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature disinfection machine for dairy products, in particular to a high-temperature disinfection machine for dairy products for agricultural production. The dairy product high-temperature disinfection machine for agricultural production is simple to operate, high in working efficiency and capable of technically reminding people of completion of disinfection of dairy products. A high-temperature sterilization machine for dairy products for agricultural production, comprising: the front side of the top of the bottom plate is provided with the guide rod; the bottom plate of the material storage mechanism is provided with a material storage mechanism; the top of the bottom plate is provided with the high-temperature heating mechanism. According to the invention, the dairy product can flow out through the discharge pipe by opening the valve through the arranged discharge mechanism by workers, so that the dairy product can be collected by the workers better.

title_en: Preparation method of mesona blume gum-minced fillet composite gel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of food processing, and relates to a preparation method of mesona blume gelatin-minced fillet composite gel. The method comprises the following steps: cutting minced fillet, cutting with salt, adding Chinese mesona herb gum and citric acid, mixing and cutting, adding starch, water retention agent and flavoring agent, gelatinizing at low temperature, cooking at high temperature, cooling and storing. The minced fillet gel is prepared from mesona blume gum, minced fillet and the following components as raw materials: 0.5-5% of mesona blume gum, 1-3% of edible salt, 0.5-5% of starch, 0.02-1% of citric acid, 0.02-0.3% of a water retention agent, 1-8% of a seasoning and 1-30% of ice water. Compared with the traditional minced fillet product, the compound minced fillet product prepared by adding the mesona blume gelatin with unique procoagulant property and good biological activity into the minced fillet has better texture property and sensory property and has the nutritional functionality of the mesona blume gelatin.

title_en: Method for preparing soluble dietary fiber from citrus fruit peel residues
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soluble dietary fiber preparation, and particularly discloses a method for preparing soluble dietary fiber from citrus fruit peel residues. The method comprises the following steps: (1) crushing citrus fruit peel residues to obtain citrus fruit peel residue powder; (2) performing irradiation treatment on the citrus fruit peel residue powder to obtain irradiated citrus fruit peel residue powder; (3) mixing the irradiated citrus peel residue powder with water to prepare a soluble dietary fiber concentrated solution A and an insoluble dietary fiber A; (4) mixing insoluble dietary fiber A with water, adding complex enzyme 1 and complex enzyme 2 for enzymolysis to prepare soluble dietary fiber concentrated solution B; (5) and mixing the soluble dietary fiber concentrated solution A and the soluble dietary fiber concentrated solution B to obtain the soluble dietary fiber. The soluble dietary fiber prepared by the method has high water holding capacity, oil holding capacity and expansibility.

title_en: Method and system for intelligently adjusting environment of black tea fermentation chamber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for intelligently adjusting the environment of a black tea fermentation chamber, which are characterized in that preset fermentation parameters and fermentation chamber control parameters are obtained; obtaining first parameter adjustment information according to preset fermentation parameters and fermentation chamber control parameters; acquiring tea humidity information, tea temperature information and first image information; inputting the first image information into a fermentation degree prediction model to obtain first fermentation color information; inputting the humidity information, the temperature information and the first fermentation color information of the tea leaves into a fermentation environment evaluation model to obtain a first evaluation result; judging whether the first evaluation result meets a first preset condition or not; when the first evaluation result does not meet the first evaluation result, obtaining a first fermentation rule according to preset fermentation parameters; obtaining a first regulating instruction according to the first fermentation rule. The technical problems that parameter adjustment of the black tea fermentation environment is mainly controlled by experience of a master worker, is greatly influenced by human factors, is influenced by a human control level and cannot ensure the stability of the fermentation level are solved.

title_en: Fruit cake or soft sweet plum slice and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fruit cake or soft sweet plum slice and a preparation process thereof, wherein the fruit cake or soft sweet plum slice comprises the following raw materials: green plum, honey pomelo, starch, white granulated sugar, edible salt, maltose syrup, grape syrup and food additive. The method comprises the following steps: selecting and cleaning green plums, soaking the green plums in saline water and the like to prepare plum slices; step two: preparing maltose syrup, fructus Vitis Viniferae pulp, starch, white sugar, honey pomelo, and food additive into soft candy or fruitcake; step three: the two plum slices are sandwiched by a layer of fruitcake or soft sweets, or two fruitcakes or soft sweets are sandwiched by a layer of plum slices, or multiple layers of plum slices and the fruitcake or soft sweets and the plum slices are sequentially placed to be made into multiple layers.

title_en: Pickering emulsion based on fat crystal nanoparticle stability and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stable pickering emulsion based on fat crystal nanoparticles and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of food-grade emulsion development. The fat crystal nanoparticle-based pickering emulsion is prepared by the following method: and (2) ultrasonically homogenizing and mixing a certain amount of fat and water at a high temperature, cooling and crystallizing under a certain condition to obtain a fat crystal nanoparticle suspension, and then mixing and homogenizing the suspension and an oil phase to obtain the water-in-oil type Pickering emulsion.
