The pickering emulsion constructed by the interfacial adsorption and assembly of the edible fat crystal nanoparticles has the characteristics of green and environment-friendly raw materials, good stability, good dispersibility, high uniformity and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of food, cosmetics, medicines and the like.

title_en: Porcine proteus mirabilis for removing zearalenone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porcine proteus mirabilis for removing zearalenone, belonging to the technical field of agricultural microorganism application. The culture is preserved in China center for type culture Collection with the preservation address: eight Wuhan university No. 299 in Wuhan district, Wuhan city, Hubei, the preservation date is 11 months and 16 days 2020, the preservation number is CCTCC M2020738, and the classification name is Proteus mirabilis PM-001-YX. The Genbank accession number of the 16s rDNA of this strain is MZ 348886. The strain culture solution can effectively reduce the content of zearalenone in a system, extracellular fluid of the strain can degrade zearalenone, and cell walls of the strain culture solution also have a certain adsorption effect on zearalenone. The strain enriches the variety of mycotoxin-free microorganisms, and has good application prospect when being used as a biological material for removing zearalenone.

title_en: Air path system of compound tea withering machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an air path system of a duplex tea withering machine, which comprises a multi-layer framework arranged from high to low, wherein the framework is uniformly divided into a plurality of withering areas from the front end to the rear end, each withering area is provided with a fan, or the vertically arranged multi-layer withering areas share the same fan, a net belt of each withering area comprises an upper partition plate and a lower partition plate, an inclined partition plate is arranged between the upper partition plate and the lower partition plate, and the fan supplies air from the side surface of a space between the upper partition plate and the lower partition plate so that the air can travel along the upper surface of the inclined partition plate. The air path system of the compound tea withering machine has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, high working efficiency and small occupied area, saves manpower, can ensure that wind can uniformly penetrate through leaf layers, and ensures that the withering degree is uniform and consistent.

title_en: Pediococcus pentosaceus NHB-PpA9601 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides pediococcus pentosaceus (Pediococcus pentosaceus) NHB-PpA9601, which is separated from the intestinal canal of white feather broilers and is preserved in the China general microbiological center (CGMCC for short, address: national institute of microbiology, national academy of sciences of China, 3, national academy of sciences, 1 st China, G.Chen, G.P., with preservation number CGMCC NO.22646, and preservation date of 2021, 5 months and 31 days. The pediococcus pentosaceus NHB-PpA9601 has remarkable probiotics, and can effectively inhibit the growth and reproduction of pathogenic bacteria such as enteropathogenic escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus, salmonella suis, salmonella choleraesuis, salmonella gallinarum, salmonella pullorum, salmonella typhimurium, salmonella, shigella, clostridium perfringens, bacillus pensonii, aeromonas hydrophila, vibrio parahaemolyticus and the like. The Pediococcus pentosaceus NHB-PpA9601 disclosed by the invention can be used for producing wet-based fermented feed, so that the intestinal health can be effectively improved, and the economic benefit can be improved.

title_en: Application of rutin as anti-diarrhea digestion-promoting agent in preparation of piglet feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of rutin as an anti-diarrhea digestion-promoting agent in preparation of piglet feed. The invention discovers for the first time that 300-1000mg/kg rutin is added into piglet feed to effectively enhance the expression of intestinal tract tight junction genes and proteins of weaned piglets, inhibit bacterial translocation, improve intestinal barrier function and reduce diarrhea rate. The rutin has the advantages of environmental protection, wide sources, low cost and the like, and is a safe and efficient green feed anti-diarrhea growth promoter.

title_en: Efficient comprehensive utilization method of blueberries
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of blueberry hyaluronic acid white spirit, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: a. making the special distiller's yeast for blueberries; b. preparing blueberry fermented fruits: preparing green and healthy fresh blueberry fruits; cleaning fresh blueberry fruits, and adding blueberry distiller's yeast; fermenting at normal temperature of 22-25 deg.C for 12-18 days; after 7-8 times of fermentation, separating fruit wine to obtain blueberry fermented fruits; c. preparing blueberry high-alcohol wine: making five-grain fermented wine; mixing the blueberry fermented fruits obtained in the steps b4 and c1 with five-grain fermented raw wine according to the weight ratio of 0.5-2:1, adding 0.1 per mill of hyaluronic acid and blueberry distiller's yeast for secondary fermentation, and fermenting for 3-5 months; and (3) obtaining a mixed liquor stock solution by a distillation mode, adding hyaluronic acid again, and adjusting the alcoholic strength to 52 degrees or more to obtain the blueberry hyaluronic acid liquor.

title_en: Drying device for agricultural product processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airing device for processing agricultural products, which comprises a base, wherein a driving motor is arranged at the lower end of the base, the tail end of an output shaft of the driving motor penetrates through the base and is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the rotating rod is fixedly connected with the lower end of the base, a sleeve is sleeved on the outer side of the rotating rod and is in sliding connection with the rotating rod, guide grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the rotating rod, guide blocks are arranged in the two guide grooves, and the two guide blocks are in sliding connection with the inner walls of the corresponding guide grooves. The device passes through the motor and drives the preserved pork rotation for the preserved pork can even sunning, rotates the in-process simultaneously and can reciprocate, avoids the fly worm to be close to, and can disperse light when light is stronger, avoids the preserved pork to take place rotten condition after insolateing and takes place, and gas still is in the mobile state around the preserved pork when being in windless weather, thereby guarantees the sunning quality of preserved pork.

title_en: Preparation method and application of biological feed additive based on hermetia illucens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a black soldier fly-based biological feed additive. Cleaning Hermetia illucens larvae, drying with microwave, and pulverizing to 20-200 mesh to obtain dry powder; the feed additive is prepared from 50-90% of dry insect powder, 30-50% of corn flour, 1-10% of mixed microbial inoculum and 1-10% of mixed enzyme preparation by weight; adding sterile water according to the weight ratio to ensure that the water content of the material is 30-60%, and fermenting for 12-36h at constant temperature and humidity under the conditions of 25-40 ℃ and 40-90% RH; dehydrating the fermented material by freeze-drying, pulverizing to 100 mesh, and packaging. The feed additive is instructive in studying the nutrition proportion of the hermetia illucens.

title_en: Preparation method of spicy dried scallop table sauce
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and a preparation method of spicy dried scallop table sauce comprises three steps of raw material pretreatment, frying, cooling and filling. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: the preparation method is simple to operate, the procedures are reasonable, the fishy smell of the seafood is removed to the maximum extent, the tastes of all food materials are fused together, and the layering sense is clear; the sweet taste of the dried scallop, the freshness of the dried shrimps, the fragrance of the Jinhua ham and the salty taste of the salted fish are mutually fused, so that the edible diversification of the dried scallop, the dried shrimps, the ham and the salted fish is improved, and the dried scallop, the dried scallop with sauce, the small dish with sauce, the noodles and the like are suitable to be cooked; the spicy scallop appetizer sauce prepared by the method is ruddy in color, the sea rice in the product contains rich potassium, iodine and magnesium, the scallop has the effects of promoting the secretion of saliva or body fluid, tonifying spleen, reducing swelling and promoting urination, the salty fish contains unsaturated fatty acid which is an important source of fatty acid necessary for a human body, and the ham has the effects of nourishing the stomach and promoting the secretion of saliva or body fluid; the dried scallop and the dried shrimps in the raw materials have obvious effects on absorbing amino acid and improving the absorption of calcium.

title_en: Chilli sauce raw material processing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a chilli sauce raw material processing system which comprises a crushing unit and a frying unit, wherein a material guide cylinder is connected to the outlet of the crushing unit, the output end of the material guide cylinder is connected with one inlet of a stirring barrel, a material guide plate is connected to the outlet of the frying unit, the output end of the material guide plate is connected with the other inlet of the stirring barrel, and the outlet of the stirring barrel is connected with a fermentation tank; the crushing unit comprises a grinding shell, a power motor is installed on the lower portion of the rack, a transmission shaft of the power motor is upwards connected with a power wheel, a driven wheel is installed on the lower portion of the power shaft, the power wheel is connected with the driven wheel through a transmission belt, protruding grinding thorns are arranged on the surface of the conical grinding disc, and a material throwing baffle is fixed on the wall of an inner cavity in the lower portion of the grinding shell. Rational in infrastructure after this scheme of adoption, can realize automated production with the external system cooperation.

title_en: Daqu liquor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Daqu liquor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Daqu liquor comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the traditional Chinese medicine distiller's yeast and the brewing grain respectively comprise the following components: (1) traditional Chinese medicine distiller's yeast: 5-10 parts of angelica dahurica, 5-20 parts of galangal, 10-20 parts of tsaoko amomum fruits, 30-50 parts of almonds, 5-10 parts of dried ginger, 10-30 parts of folium artemisiae argyi, 10-15 parts of mulberry leaves, 15-20 parts of bighead atractylodes rhizome, 15-30 parts of purple kidney beans, 10-20 parts of wolfberry fruits, 10-15 parts of asarum and 50 kg of flour; (2) brewing grains: 20-30 parts of sorghum, 20-30 parts of rice, 30-50 parts of corn, 20-30 parts of glutinous rice, 10-20 parts of wheat and 30-50 parts of rice chaff. The traditional Chinese medicine distiller's yeast is uniformly mixed, polished and prepared into powder, and then the brewing grain: selecting grain → soaking grain and washing grain → steaming grain → spreading for cool → adding distiller's yeast → fermenting → distilling → obtaining wine. The invention has the advantages of fresh and sweet taste, mellow and fragrant wine taste, and rich vitamins required by human body.

title_en: Fermentation method of high-quality silage paper mulberry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-quality silage broussonetia papyrifera fermentation method which comprises six steps of selecting silage raw materials, setting a control group CK and control groups P97, P94 and P91, preparing an MRS culture medium, inoculating and culturing strains, separating and purifying the strains by using a calcium ring dissolution method and detecting the performance. According to the invention, by arranging the control group CK and the control groups P97, P94 and P91, the types of microorganisms existing in the paper mulberry ensiling process, the fermentation proportion of lactic acid bacteria, the interference of internal microorganisms on the fermentation of the lactic acid bacteria and the like can be detected under the condition of adding corn starch with different concentrations, and the corn starch with 6% concentration can be added to obtain the lactic acid bacteria with higher proportion and the lactobacillus saccharolyticus with higher proportion, so that the lactic acid bacteria with higher purity can be obtained, and the paper mulberry ensiling quality and efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Chaenomeles speciosa tea beverage capable of promoting blood circulation, regulating menstruation and relieving pain and preparation method of chaenomeles speciosa tea beverage
abstract_en: The invention provides a chaenomeles speciosa tea beverage for promoting blood circulation, regulating menstruation and relieving pain and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chaenomeles speciosa tea beverage is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 25-35 parts of chaenomeles speciosa, 20-30 parts of mulberry, 15-25 parts of rose, 13-23 parts of red date, 10-20 parts of red bean, 8-18 parts of peach kernel, 6-16 parts of lalang grass rhizome, 5-15 parts of mulberry leaf and 4-8 parts of donkey-hide gelatin, and the preparation method comprises the steps of crushing, sieving, mixing, granulating, drying and subpackaging. The invention has the effects of promoting blood circulation, regulating menstruation and relieving pain.

title_en: Feed additive for improving immunity of Haliotis diversicolor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of feed additives, and discloses a feed additive for improving immunity of Haliotis diversicolor, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 30% of alanylglutamine, 10% of tyrosine, 10% of phenylalanine, 10% of tryptophan, 20% of leucine, 10% of valine and 10% of isoleucine. The price is low, and the source is stable; the interaction of the components obviously promotes the growth of the Haliotis diversicolor, improves the nonspecific immunity and survival rate of the Haliotis diversicolor, and enhances the disease resistance; improving phagocytic activity and NO level of blood cells of Haliotis diversicolor; the invention has simple production process and convenient use.

title_en: Diphenyl ether herbicide nitroreductase gene dnrA and nitroreductase and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitroreductase gene dnrA, nitroreductase and application thereof, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the gene dnrA is SEQ ID NO.1, and the amino acid sequence of the nitroreductase gene dnrA coded by the gene dnrA is SEQ ID NO.2. The invention clones to a nitroreductase gene dnrA, the gene is a diphenyl ether herbicide nitroreductase gene, the full length is 780bp, codes 259 amino acids; the nitroreductase gene dnrA of the invention codes the nitroreductase DnrA which can reduce the nitro in the diphenyl ether herbicide into amino degradation and convert the diphenyl ether herbicide, and the nitroreductase DnrA and the genetic engineering bacteria containing the nitroreductase gene dnrA can be used for removing the residue of the diphenyl ether herbicide in polluted farmlands and environmental water bodies and biologically converting the drug synthesis, and have very important theoretical and application values.

title_en: Soft elastic bread and fermentation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food preparation, and particularly discloses soft elastic bread and a fermentation process thereof; the bread is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 45-58 parts of high gluten flour, 7-13 parts of white granulated sugar, 12-14 parts of sweet slice oil, 3.05-5.25 parts of humectant, 0.37-0.48 part of natural salt, 0.65-0.73 part of dry yeast, 0.06-0.4 part of softener, 0.1-0.25 part of edible essence, 3.25-4.45 parts of margarine, 1-1.5 parts of whole egg liquid, 0.65-0.9 part of emulsifying paste, 1-1.6 parts of soybean oil, 0.1-0.4 part of preservative and 21-24.5 parts of deionized water; the softening agent comprises at least one of Gleditsiae Abnormalis gum and trehalose; the fermentation process comprises the following steps: mixing high gluten powder, white granulated sugar, dry yeast and deionized water, stirring, adding natural salt, stirring, adding whole egg liquid, sweet piece oil, soybean oil, margarine and emulsified paste, stirring with humectant, softener, edible essence and antiseptic, and making into dough; standing the dough for 50-80min, cutting, baking, and cooling to obtain the final product; the bread of the present application has a durable softness and elasticity.

title_en: Biological preparation for breeding shrimps and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a biological preparation for breeding shrimps and a preparation method thereof, wherein the biological preparation contains a composite yeast cake, and the composite yeast cake is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of dried shrimps, 5-10 parts of plant dead branches, 10-20 parts of algae extract, 15-25 parts of polysaccharide, 1-5 parts of leavening agent and 10-20 parts of peanut meal. The biological agent prepared by the invention not only improves the immunity and survival rate of the breeding shrimps, but also reduces the abnormal rate of the breeding shrimps, further improves the mating rate of the breeding shrimps, and simultaneously obtains the shrimp larvae which have strong immunity, good stress resistance and rapid growth.

title_en: Dendrobium nobile cream and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food production, in particular to a dendrobium cream and a preparation method thereof, wherein the dendrobium cream comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of dendrobium officinale, 15-25 parts of honeysuckle, 15-25 parts of fresh ginger flower, 1-5 parts of lucid ganoderma, 1-3 parts of ginseng, 0.5-1.5 parts of sweetening agent, 1-3 parts of mixed enzyme and 1-2 parts of stabilizing agent. The dendrobium-ginger stomach-nourishing honey is scientific and reasonable in raw material formula and is prepared according to a reasonable proportion, so that active ingredients of different raw materials are fully fused and complemented, the dendrobium-ginger stomach-nourishing honey is high in economic benefit, social benefit and popularization value, the dendrobium-ginger stomach-nourishing honey is capable of tonifying middle-jiao and moistening dryness, and the dendrobium-ginger stomach-nourishing honey is used in combination, so that the dendrobium-ginger stomach-nourishing honey has a good stomach-nourishing effect, is capable of effectively improving symptoms of stomachache, conditioning intestines and stomach, enhancing the movement function of spleen and stomach, effectively reducing the symptoms of gastroenteritis, is good in stomach-nourishing effect, free of side effect, convenient to take, good in taste, good in medicine taking compliance and simple in preparation process.

title_en: Tea baking box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tea baking box, which comprises a main box body, wherein a working cavity is arranged in the main box body, a stirring rotating shaft is rotatably arranged at the lower wall in the working cavity, the outer circular surface of the stirring rotating shaft is fixedly connected with stirring blades which are distributed in a matrix arrangement from top to bottom, and the upper wall of the working cavity is communicated with a feeding cavity with an upward opening, the device is more energy-saving.

title_en: Preparation method of marinated food
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marinating, and discloses a method for making marinated vegetables. According to the preparation method of the marinated food, the marinated food materials are selected and washed, so that the food materials can be kept clean, the amount of the marinated products and the seasonings is determined according to the weight proportion of the food materials, the excessive deviation of the taste can not occur when the food materials are marinated, the duration of the marinating is determined according to the time, the moderate hardness of the taste of the food materials is ensured, and the delicious taste of the food materials is ensured.

title_en: Chicken breast pickling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meat pickling equipment, in particular to a chicken breast pickling device which comprises a rack and a conveying belt for conveying meat blocks, wherein a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the conveying belt, a plurality of positive-pressure liquid filling mechanisms for injecting pickling liquid into the meat blocks are arranged above the conveying belt, a plurality of negative-pressure suction mechanisms for sucking the pickling liquid in the meat blocks outwards are arranged above the conveying belt, and injection ports of the positive-pressure liquid filling mechanisms for the meat blocks and suction ports of the negative-pressure suction mechanisms for the meat blocks are distributed in a staggered mode. This device working process reasonable in design can accelerate the speed of marinade liquid at the inside diffusion of meat piece, improves the speed that the meat piece was pickled, is favorable to accelerating the efficiency that the meat produced the processing.

title_en: Application of SPL7 in regulation and control of plant drought resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of SPL7 in regulation and control of plant drought resistance. The invention discovers that the SPL7 gene knockout or inactivation can delay the growth of plants, but can improve the drought resistance of the plants. The research shows that SPL7 inhibits transcription of NCED3 and AAO3 in ABA biosynthesis pathway by recognizing GTAC motif on promoter, thereby reducing ABA accumulation and balancing growth and stress resistance of plants. Namely, a potential conservative mechanism exists in terrestrial plants, and the new biosynthesis of ABA is regulated through SPL7-GTAC, so that the growth and stress response of the plants are balanced, and a method is provided for manually regulating the drought resistance of the plants.

title_en: Method for comprehensively utilizing reed, sorghum and corn straw
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for comprehensively utilizing reed, sorghum and corn straw, which comprises the following steps: crushing reed, sorghum and corn straw which are naturally dried in the sun and mixing the crushed reed, sorghum and corn straw into raw materials; extruding the raw materials into a bar blank and then carrying out anaerobic pyrolysis reaction in a carbonization furnace; recycling gas generated in the anaerobic pyrolysis process by using a condenser; storing the obtained gas which cannot be condensed in a gas cylinder to obtain straw gas; condensing and settling the obtained condensable gas, and then dividing the condensable gas into an upper layer and a lower layer, wherein the upper layer is straw vinegar liquid, and the lower layer is straw tar; performing anaerobic pyrolysis reaction, and then obtaining straw carbon as residues in the carbonization furnace for storage; or, steaming the raw materials for more than 4h by using water vapor, cooling the steamed raw materials to room temperature, adding yoghourt, uniformly mixing, and carrying out closed fermentation to obtain the fermented straw feed.

title_en: Screening and identifying device for high-quality pit mud high-yield caproic acid bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a screening and identifying device for high-quality pit mud and high-yield caproic acid bacteria, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a support frame is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the bottom plate, movable grooves which are penetrated through from front to back are formed in the left side and the right side of the upper part of the support frame, a screening mechanism and a collecting mechanism are respectively connected in the two movable grooves in a sliding manner, a fermentation box body is detachably arranged at the upper end of the screening mechanism, a separation component is connected to the lower part of the right end of the fermentation box body in an inserting manner, a flattening mechanism is fixedly connected to the left box wall in the fermentation box body, an identifying box is fixedly arranged at the right end of the collecting mechanism, a transmission mechanism is fixedly arranged at the rear end of a fixed seat, and the transmission mechanism is movably connected with the collecting mechanism and the screening mechanism. The screening and identifying device for high-quality pit mud and high-yield caproic acid bacteria, disclosed by the invention, has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, short pit mud fermentation time, high efficiency, short caproic acid bacteria acquisition time, convenience in collection, convenience in extraction and identification and capability of being popularized and used.

title_en: Kidney bean plant protein beverage rich in gamma-aminobutyric acid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-enrichment gamma-aminobutyric acid small white kidney bean vegetable protein beverage and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: germinating semen Phaseoli vulgaris, grinding into slurry, boiling, filtering, sterilizing, cooling, inoculating Lactobacillus casei, and fermenting under heat preservation to obtain semen Phaseoli vulgaris fermentation broth; and (3) blending, homogenizing and sterilizing the fermented liquid of the white kidney bean pulp after germination, grinding, boiling, filtering, sterilization and cooling to obtain the white kidney bean pulp. According to the invention, the sprouting of the navy pea beans is creatively combined with the fermentation process, so that the gamma-aminobutyric acid in the navy pea vegetable protein beverage is effectively improved, and the navy pea vegetable protein beverage which is rich in the gamma-aminobutyric acid and has no sugar addition is processed, and is nutritional, healthy and unique in flavor.

title_en: Application of probiotic active peptide in preparation of medicine, food or health-care product with effect of preventing or treating diarrhea
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly discloses application of probiotic active peptide in preparation of a medicament, food or health-care product with a function of preventing or treating diarrhea. The probiotic active peptide has a structure shown in a formula I or a formula II. The probiotic active peptide composition comprises probiotic active peptides with structures shown in a formula I and a formula II. The research shows that: the probiotic active peptide with the structures shown in the formula I and the formula II has the effect of resisting diarrhea, in particular to the effect of resisting virus diarrhea caused by rotavirus; therefore, the skilled person can use the compound as an active ingredient for preparing a medicament, food or health-care product with the effect of preventing or treating diarrhea.

title_en: Use of FBA8 protein or protein derived therefrom for regulating vascular bundle division and/or rachis cross-sectional area in plants
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of FBA8 protein or protein derived from the FBA8 protein in regulating the division of plant vascular bundles and/or the cross-sectional area of an rachis, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The invention provides an application of FBA8 protein or protein derived from FBA8 protein with one or more amino acids substituted, deleted or added in the amino acid sequence in regulating the division of plant vascular bundles and/or the cross-sectional area of an inflorescence shaft, wherein the amino acid sequence of the FBA8 protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. According to the invention, the arabidopsis wild type Col-0 is subjected to transgenosis by using an overexpression vector to obtain a transgenic plant, and the cross-sectional area and the number of vascular bundles of the rachis of the transgenic plant are changed.

title_en: Tea aroma raising machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tea aroma raising machine which comprises a frame, wherein a tea containing part and a heating part are arranged on the frame, the tea containing part is used for containing tea and turning the tea, and the heating part is used for heating the tea contained in the tea containing part in a radiation heating mode. The holding portion includes the cylinder of rotation installation in the frame, and the heating portion includes the heating unit that the cylinder outside set up carries out radiant heating to tealeaves in the cylinder. The technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively carry out aroma extraction treatment on the tea, improve the aroma, color and strip shape of the tea and improve the quality and grade of the tea.

title_en: Sweet food prepared from dried fruit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sweet food made of dried fruits having the same physicochemical properties as chocolate and a process for preparing the same, comprising: from 25% to 45% by weight of dried fruit having a total fat contribution from the dried fruit of at most 25% by weight of the dried fruit, relative to the total weight of the food product; 25% to 45% by weight of sucrose or other anhydrous sweetening substance; 20% to 40% by weight of cocoa butter or any other vegetable fat that is solid at ambient temperature and is used as a partial or complete substitute for cocoa butter; optionally, an emulsifier in an amount less than or equal to 1%; the sweet food has a particle size of less than or equal to 50 μm.

title_en: Processing device and method for vegetable packet in fast food flour food
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing device for vegetable bags in fast food flour food, belonging to the technical field of food processing; the processing device comprises a microwave differential pressure drying tank, a vacuum buffer tank, a water vapor condenser, a condensed water storage tank and a vacuum pump which are connected in sequence; an electromagnetic valve is arranged between the microwave differential pressure drying tank and the vacuum buffer tank; the side wall of the microwave differential pressure drying tank is provided with a plurality of microwave leading-in holes; the microwave leading-in hole is connected with a microwave generator. The vegetable bag prepared by the device has the advantages of compact structure, packaging space saving and easy rehydration, and overcomes the defect that the existing fast food, flour food and vegetable bag occupies more packaging space.

title_en: D-configuration anti-tumor peptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a D-configuration anti-tumor peptide, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of polypeptide preparation and biological medicine. Aiming at the defects that the L-type peptide is easy to be degraded by protease and the like, the invention synthesizes the D-type anti-tumor peptide composed of D-type amino acid. The D-form of the polypeptide is naturally resistant to protease degradation, which greatly increases the stability of the polypeptide. The aging curve experiment shows that the stability of the anti-tumor effect of the D-type polypeptide is more than 5 times of that of the L-type polypeptide, so that the anti-tumor effect has good practical application value.

title_en: Improved beer production process
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved beer production process, and relates to the technical field of beer production. The improved beer production process comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 20% of malt, 75% of warm water, 2% of hops, 1% of maltose and 3% of beer yeast; the method comprises the following specific steps: s1, preparing 20% of malt with full particles and uniform size, soaking the malt for 1 hour by using a proper amount of cold water, fishing out and draining the malt after soaking is finished, slowly drying the malt by using fruit charcoal after draining the water, S2, crushing the dried malt by using a crusher, then pouring the crushed malt into a stirring device, adding 75% of warm water with the temperature of 60-70 ℃, and starting a stirring mechanism to uniformly stir the malt. The fruit charcoal is selected to slowly bake the malt, and the fermentation tank made of fruit wood is used for storage fermentation, so that the malt can be blended with the aroma of the fruit wood, and the subsequently made beer contains the aroma of the fruit wood and has more unique taste and flavor.

title_en: Feeding enzyme nutrient solution based on citrus pulp and traditional Chinese medicine residues and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a feeding ferment nutrient solution based on citrus pulp and traditional Chinese medicine residues, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of citrus pulp, 10-20 parts of traditional Chinese medicine residues, 0.03-0.08 part of microbial compound preparation, 0.01-0.1 part of enzyme preparation and 0.1-0.5 part of brown sugar; wherein the Chinese medicinal materials in the Chinese medicinal residue comprise radix astragali, radix Saposhnikoviae and Atractylodis rhizoma; the microbial compound preparation consists of the following microbial agents in parts by weight: 0.01-0.03 part of bacillus subtilis, 0.01-0.03 part of candida utilis and 0.01-0.03 part of lactobacillus lactis; the enzyme preparation comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 0.01-0.1 part of protease, 0.01-0.1 part of cellulase, 0.01-0.1 part of pectinase and 0.01-0.1 part of amylase. The scheme provided by the application can improve the feed conversion rate, reduce the breeding cost, provide antioxidant active substances for the bred animals, and improve the autoimmunity of the bred animals.

title_en: Composition for regulating and controlling rumen fermentation gas yield of ruminant and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a composition for regulating rumen fermentation gas yield of ruminants, use thereof in the manufacture of a feed additive for regulating rumen fermentation gas yield of ruminants, a feed additive comprising the composition and a feed comprising the feed additive and a basal feed. The present disclosure initially relates to the use of 3-nitropropanol and vitamin B  12  In combination, a new class of compositions with the ability to regulate ruminant rumen fermentation gas production is formed. Transferring hydrogen from methane production to propionic acid production minimizes digestible energy loss in ruminant biogas production while inhibiting methane emissions, allows ruminants to obtain more energy, and reduces feed energy waste. The composition has the advantages of better effect of improving rumen fermentation of ruminants in experiments, low cost, easily available raw materials and easy popularization and application.

title_en: Integrated sea cucumber automatic boiling and preparing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated automatic sea cucumber boiling and preparing system, which relates to the field of sea cucumber processing and comprises a cabinet body for placing sea cucumbers, wherein the cabinet body is communicated with an external circulation cooling and filtering system and a cold and hot pipe system; the external circulation cooling and filtering system is used for providing cooled and filtered circulating water for the cabinet body, and the cold and hot pipe system can be used for increasing or reducing the temperature of the circulating water in the cabinet; the top of the cabinet body is provided with a weighing device which is connected with a weighing bracket arranged in the cabinet body through a tension column, a plurality of groups of support brackets are arranged on the weighing bracket along the vertical direction, and a groove type Kong Ti for placing sea cucumbers is arranged on each group of support brackets in a supporting way; the internal circulation water of the cabinet body is also internally circulated through an internal circulation pipeline arranged outside. The invention can integrate the sea cucumber stewing and preparing processes, improve the efficiency and reduce the waste of water.

title_en: Instant Wuhei cereal block and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Wuhei instant cereal block which is characterized by being prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-70 parts of black wheat meal, 30-50 parts of black bean slices, 20-40 parts of black rice slices, 20-40 parts of black quinoa slices, 5-15 parts of black sesame, 5-15 parts of fructo-oligosaccharide, 5-15 parts of polydextrose and 5-15 parts of coconut oil. The invention also provides a preparation method of the Wuhei instant cereal block. The five-black instant cereal block integrates the nutrition of five black cereals, is rich in nutrition, is easy to grasp and eat by processing the five black cereals into blocks, and changes the eating mode of the traditional brewing.

title_en: American ginseng glycopeptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an American ginseng glycopeptide and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention discovers a new American ginseng glycopeptide in American ginseng for the first time, wherein the American ginseng glycopeptide contains 52.8 percent of neutral polysaccharide (calculated by glucose), 41.3 percent of uronic acid (calculated by galacturonic acid) and 2.3 percent of peptide (calculated by bovine serum albumin), which are separated from American ginseng root in percentage by mass. The American ginseng glycopeptide is a glycopeptide substance with a novel structure, is a pure chemical component, is a naturally-existing glycopeptide macromolecule, is essentially different from a polysaccharide and polypeptide mixture obtained by enzymolysis processing, and the inventor finds that the American ginseng glycopeptide is an important drug-effect substance in American ginseng, has unique biological activity, has a remarkable regulation effect on hyperglycemia, has the characteristics of high safety and suitability for long-term administration, and has an important application prospect.

title_en: Application of OsHin1 gene in prevention and control of meloidogyne pseudograminis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of an OsHin1 gene in prevention and control of root-knot nematodes of Poaceae, and belongs to the technical field of plant disease prevention and control. The nucleotide sequence of the OsHin1 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the coded amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The OsHin1 gene overexpression can reduce the infection of the pseudogramineous root-knot nematode, and the OsHin1 gene knockout can improve the infection of the pseudogramineous root-knot nematode, so that the OsHin1 gene knock-out can be applied to preparing a pseudogramineous root-knot nematode prevention and control product and cultivating the rice resisting the pseudogramineous root-knot nematode.

title_en: Method for preparing structured lipid by enzymatic method selective catalysis
abstract_en: A method for preparing structured lipid by enzyme-method selective catalysis belongs to the fields of biochemical engineering and enzyme catalysis, and particularly relates to a method for preparing structured lipid with proper n-3PUFA/n-6PUFA ratio by enzyme-method selective catalysis based on rubber seed oil. The method comprises the following steps: quantitatively mixing the rubber seed oil and the medium-chain triglyceride, adding lipase, carrying out acyl exchange reaction in a solvent-free system, and filtering and removing the lipase through a Buchner funnel after the reaction is finished to obtain the MLCT structured lipid which has four structures of MLM, LML, MML, LLM and the like, has proper n-3PUFA/n-6PUFA ratio and can better meet the nutritional requirements of human beings. The energy-saving oil-water separator is developed and applied to edible oil and fat, and has the advantages of stable energy supply, reduction of fat accumulation of organisms and the like. Short reaction period, mild reaction conditions, simple separation process, greenness and economy.

title_en: Wheat mutation breeding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheat mutation breeding method, which comprises the following specific steps: s1, preparation of buffer solution: preparing acetate buffer solution; s2, preparation of mutagen: mixing the prepared buffer solution with a methyl urea solution of a nitrite machine to prepare a mutagen with the pH value of 7; s3, soaking mutagenesis: soaking the wheat seeds in a culture dish containing a mutagen; s4, post-processing: washing the soaked wheat seeds with a cleaning solution to remove a mutagen, wherein the treatment time is not less than 48H; s5, breeding: transplanting the treated wheat seeds into soil for planting. The method comprises the steps of soaking seeds in a mutagen, enabling the mutagen to enter embryo cells through low-temperature treatment, and then transferring the seeds into a fresh mutagen to accelerate the speed of a mutagenesis reaction.

title_en: Formula of auxiliary edible dumplings suitable for children and making method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food, in particular to a formula of dumplings suitable for children to eat and a preparation method thereof, wherein dumpling wrappers are prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight, the raw materials comprise flour, eggs, vegetable paste and salt, the vegetable paste is prepared from any one of the following vegetable raw materials, and the vegetable paste comprises red heart dragon fruits, spinach, purple sweet potatoes, pumpkins, carrots and tomatoes; the dumpling stuffing is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight, including a meat stuffing combination, ginger, scallion, egg white, oyster sauce, chicken juice, sesame oil, scallion oil and corn starch, wherein the meat stuffing combination comprises a pork combination, a chicken combination and a beef combination.

title_en: Cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 of rice and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 of rice and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of gene editing. The cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 of the rice is a negative regulation gene, the nucleotide sequence of the negative regulation gene is a sequence shown in SEQ ID No.1, and the amino acid sequence of the coding protein of the negative regulation gene is a sequence shown in SEQ ID No. 2; the application of the cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 of rice in improving the cold resistance of rice comprises the following steps: s1, synthesizing gRNA according to a rice cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 coding sequence; s2, constructing the gRNA synthesized in the step S1 into a gene editing vector CRISPR/cas9; and S3, transforming the vector constructed in the step S2 into Nipponbare rice by utilizing an agrobacterium transgenic method to obtain cold-resistant rice, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the gRNA is a sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.3, and the agrobacterium adopted in the agrobacterium transgenic method is an EHA105 strain. According to the invention, the cold-resistant gene OsRab11C1 of the rice is knocked out by using a gene editing technology (CRISPR), so that the cold resistance of the rice can be obviously improved.

title_en: Solar pulse power supply driving magnetic field coupling high-voltage electric field drying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar pulse power supply driving magnetic field coupling high-voltage electric field drying device which comprises a power supply module, a microcomputer control module, a direct current boosting module, a pulse generation module, an overcurrent protection module, a needle-net electrode drying module and a magnetic field generation module; the power supply module is connected with the microcomputer control module, the microcomputer control module is connected with the direct current boosting module, the direct current boosting module is connected with the pulse generation module, the pulse generation module is connected with the overcurrent protection module, the overcurrent protection module is connected with the needle-net electrode drying module, and the magnetic field generation module is connected with the needle-net electrode drying module; according to the invention, the electron collapse column in the corona discharge process is controlled through electric field distortion, so that the ionic wind speed is increased, and the energy conversion efficiency is improved; the drying is assisted by the magnetic field, the motion trail of the charged particles is changed, the mean free path of free electrons is increased, the ion wind speed is increased rapidly, and the drying time is shortened.

title_en: Bitter gourd slice air-drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses bitter gourd slice air drying equipment, which belongs to the field of crop processing and comprises vertical parts horizontally arranged at intervals, wherein a top plate is arranged at the upper end of each vertical part, an object supporting part and a pushing part which transversely move are arranged between the vertical parts at two sides, the upper end surface of each object supporting part is used for placing a first spread cooling plate, a support is arranged between the vertical parts at two sides and obliquely above the object supporting part, the support rotates around a horizontally arranged rotating shaft, and a linear driving device is arranged on the support and connected with a second spread cooling plate; the pushing part is positioned above the support and used for pushing the first cooling plate rotating above the support to be far away from the second cooling plate; fans are arranged on the top plate at intervals; and a lifting driving device is arranged on one side of the top plate, which is far away from the support, and the lifting driving device is connected with the pushing plate. The invention aims to provide equipment for air-drying bitter gourd slices, which can improve the cooling efficiency.

title_en: Rice nitrate-induced protein gene OsNOI4 and engineering application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrate-induced protein gene OsNOI4 of rice and a genetic engineering application thereof, comprising the application of the gene and the protein in shortening the growth period, regulating the development of crop roots, improving the yield and improving the utilization efficiency of nitrogen fertilizer. The gene sequence of OsNOI4 is SEQ ID NO.1, and the protein sequence thereof is SEQ ID NO. 2. The gene has a nitrate-induced (NOI) structural domain and is located on the No. 6 chromosome of rice. The invention constructs and observes the growth difference between OsNOI4 transgenic rice and wild rice. The over-expressed OsNOI4 material was found to have advanced flowering phase and increased tillering (FIG. 9). The invention also constructs the mutant material of the gene, and compared with the over-expression material, the mutant material has reduced tillering after the florescence is retreated (figure 9).

title_en: Orange Pu' er tea making process and device with Xinhui dried orange peel shreds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process and a device for preparing orange Pu' er tea with Xinhui dried orange peel shreds, which comprises the following steps: pretreatment of dried orange peel: selecting dried orange peels aged for more than three years, steaming, then putting into far infrared rays for baking, baking intensively at the baking temperature of 70-80 ℃, and shredding after the dried orange peels are cooled for later use; step two: uniformly mixing the dried tangerine peel shreds with the Pu' er tea subjected to wetting, and then compacting to obtain tea blocks; step three: selecting green oranges, digging fruits of the green oranges, cleaning the green oranges through a cleaning device, and deactivating enzymes through steam after the cleaning is finished; this application designs to the drawback of current tealeaves, passes through little blue or green mandarin orange shell packing with the tea piece after tangerine peel and the tealeaves suppression, has guaranteed the pure and clear of its tea flavor, disposes corresponding belt cleaning device simultaneously, can filter little blue or green mandarin orange volume to can also wash little blue or green mandarin orange fast, guarantee the processingquality in later stage.

title_en: Steviol glycosides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to steviol glycosides. The invention relates to a steviol glycoside having formula (I), wherein at least three sugar moieties are present at position R1 and at least three sugar moieties are present at position R2, and wherein the steviol glycoside comprises at least seven sugar moieties, all of which are linked, directly or indirectly, by a beta bond to steviol aglycone.

title_en: Efficient cooling system for low-temperature grain storage of granary and working method of efficient cooling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency heat dissipation system for low-temperature grain storage of a granary, which comprises a water storage tank, a heat pipe component, a ground source heat pump component and a ventilation component, wherein the water storage tank is arranged underground at the bottom of the granary, an evaporation end of the heat pipe component is arranged in the water storage tank, a condensation end is arranged on the ground, and the evaporation end and the condensation end are connected through an ascending pipe and a descending pipe to form a circulation loop. The ground source heat pump assembly comprises a U-shaped pipe and a water pump, wherein the U-shaped pipe and the water pump are arranged in the reservoir, and the bent part of the U-shaped pipe is arranged in soil. The ventilation assembly comprises an S-shaped pipeline arranged in the reservoir, one end of the S-shaped pipeline is connected with the air blower, the other end of the S-shaped pipeline is connected with the ground air blower, the transverse ventilation pipe is connected with the air blower to ventilate the granary, the exhaust pipe is connected with the exhaust fan to exhaust air of the granary, and the air blower is connected with the ventilation valve to form a second inlet. The invention also discloses a working method of the system. The invention realizes the low-temperature storage of the grain without using a special air conditioning system, greatly reduces the energy consumption, reduces the grain storage cost and ensures the grain quality.

title_en: Indoor large-scale propagation method for insect-producing tea insects
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insect-producing tea insect breeding, and relates to a method for indoor large-scale breeding of insect-producing tea insects. The large-scale propagation method comprises the following steps: placing the egg cards in a feeding box with general artificial feed, covering with paper towels, and then placing in an artificial climate box; placing paper sheets folded into an M shape into the feeding box to enable the mature larvae of the insect-producing tea insects to cocoon and pupate, and placing the box in an artificial climate box to cultivate and obtain a large amount of insect-producing tea insect adults. The feed comprises the following raw materials: 5-10% of wheat germ; 10-15% of soybean meal; 1-5% of yeast powder; 2-5% of glucose; ascorbic acid 0.1-0.5%; 0.1 to 0.5 percent of choline chloride; 0.1 to 0.3 percent of potassium sorbate; 0.5 to 1.0 percent of anhydrous citric acid; 0.2-0.5% of linseed oil; 1.5-2.0% of carragheen powder. The invention solves the problems that wild insect sources of insect-producing tea insects are limited, other insects are easy to be mixed and the like.

title_en: Enterococcus acidi strain capable of degrading nitrite and derived from medicated cakes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterococcus lactis (enterococcus lactis) B3, which is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m20211140, which is derived from medicated cakes, has high nitrite tolerance, can still grow when the nitrite concentration is 1%, and is significantly higher than lactic acid bacteria separated from other traditional fermented foods; meanwhile, the strain also has higher nitrite degradation capability, and the highest degradation rate can reach 99.53%. Therefore, the enterococcus acidi B3 can be used as a new biological resource for processing medicated cakes, and can be added into a leaven of fermented foods such as pickle, sour meat, sour fish and the like for reducing nitrite so as to improve the food safety.

title_en: Feed additive for channel catfish
abstract_en: The invention provides a feed additive for channel catfish, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-14 parts of meat and bone meal, 15-25 parts of rapeseed meal, 20-40 parts of peeled soybean meal, 0.2-0.5 part of choline chloride, 15-22 parts of wheat middling, 0.5-1 part of soybean oil, 0.2 part of vitamin premix, 0.15 part of mineral premix, 1-2 parts of monocalcium phosphate, 0.01-0.03 part of plant enzyme, 0.05-0.1 part of bile salt substances, 0.03-0.06 part of toxin adsorbent, 0.1-0.3 part of natural plant compound, 0.1-0.2 part of microbial compound and 0.1-0.3 part of polysaccharide compound. The invention can improve the health of intestinal tract and liver tissues of the channel catfish, improve the intestinal immune function, maintain the stability of intestinal flora and prevent the intestinal diseases of the channel catfish.

title_en: Method for preparing naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener by adding hydrogen into pummelo peel extract and prepared naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dessert preparation, and particularly discloses a method for preparing a naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener by hydrogenating an exocarpium citri grandis extract and the prepared naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extraction: extracting naringin from the crushed pummelo peel by using a eutectic solvent to obtain a naringin extracting solution; ring opening and hydrogenation are carried out to obtain naringin dihydrochalcone; wherein, the adopted eutectic solvent is selected from the following components in a molar ratio of 1: (1-1.5): (0.5-1) choline chloride, acetic acid and polyhydric alcohol; the naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener disclosed in the application is prepared by the method, the application has the advantages that the naringin dihydrochalcone sweetener is extracted from pummelo peel and prepared, the extraction rate is higher, and the industrialized production is facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent production method of moon cakes
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly relates to an intelligent production method of a moon cake. According to the invention, a layer of barbecue-flavor meat pie is fried in the moon cake, so that the flavor of the moon cake is well improved, and the blank of the moon cake in barbecue flavor is filled. The oil smoke monitoring sensors are respectively arranged at the front, the back, the left and the right ends below the moon cake, so that the situation that whether the minced meat is uniformly and fully fried can be found without manual care.

title_en: Method and preparation for regulating and controlling excessive synthesis of lipid after dietary restriction and re-ingestion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a preparation for regulating and controlling excessive synthesis of lipid after dietary restriction and re-ingestion. In the present invention, an animal model suitable for lipid metabolism studies or obesity studies was established, and a phenomenon that refeeding after dietary restriction promotes the development of obesity was revealed. The present invention also reveals that lipid absorption through a high protein diet or targeted intestinal tract is an effective strategy to prevent obesity after dietary restrictions.

title_en: Animal and plant mixed protein peptide with memory improving function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses animal and plant mixed protein peptide with a memory improving function, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of active peptide. The invention adopts degreased walnut protein powder and fresh fish heads as raw materials, degreases the fish heads by ethanol ultrasound, then fully hydrolyzes the walnut protein powder and the degreased fish head powder by an alkaline protease and papain two-step controlled enzymolysis technology to obtain walnut protein peptide and fish head protein peptide with high hydrolysis degree and high activity, and finally obtains mixed protein peptide by special proportion. The combined peptide has the advantages of simple formula, high safety and synergistic effect, can be used as a food-derived peptide, and provides a safe and reliable functional food with remarkable memory improving effect for consumers.

title_en: Herbal tea formula for dehumidifying and discharging fire
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of herbal tea production formulas, and particularly relates to a herbal tea formula for removing dampness and fire, which comprises 6-8% of dandelion, 8-10% of microcos paniculata, 6-8% of mulberry leaves, 7-9% of sweet grass, 8-10% of jasmine flowers, 9-11% of mesona chinensis benth, 5-7% of sophora flowers, 5-7% of wrinkled gianthyssop, 4-6% of reed rhizome, 2-4% of honey, 2-4% of poria cocos and 2-4% of hawthorn.

title_en: Combined enzyme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined enzyme, which belongs to the technical field of meal replacement food, and comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1-2 parts of probiotic enzyme, 2-3 parts of comprehensive grain and bean enzyme, 2-3 parts of high-fiber vegetable and fruit enzyme, 1-2 parts of soybean composite enzyme and 0.3-1.2 parts of sorbitol composition. The combined ferment disclosed by the invention is rich in nutrition, can be used as a meal replacement food, is remarkable in weight-losing effect and safe to use, can be used for conditioning bodies, and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Method for inducing red mango to be colored after picking
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for inducing the coloring of red mangoes after picking, which adopts the following environmental conditions: the temperature is 15-20 ℃; relative humidity is 70% -90%; the UV-B light intensity is 4.2-4.8 mu W-cm ‑2 The white light intensity is 3500-4500 Lux. According to the method, the uncolored red mangoes harvested in the green stage are placed under the environment conditions that the temperature, the humidity and the illumination are controllable, and the continuous treatment is carried out for a period of time, so that the accumulation of anthocyanin can be effectively induced, the coloring is promoted, and the appearance quality and the commodity of the mangoes are improved. The method has the advantages of reasonable design, simple and convenient operation, safety, effectiveness, lower requirement on equipment, large-scale operation and demonstration, popularization and application to commercial production.

title_en: Novel caffeoylquinic acid ester compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses five novel caffeoylquinic acid ester compounds and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the five prepared compounds are as follows: 4-O-caffeoylquinic acid isobutyl ester, 3-O-coumaroyl-4-O-caffeoylquinic acid methyl ester, 3-O-caffeoyl-4-O-feruloylquinic acid methyl ester, 4, 5-O-dicaffeoylquinic acid isobutyl ester, and 3, 4-O-dicaffeoylquinic acid isobutyl ester. The five caffeoylquinic acid ester compounds provided by the invention are used as natural compounds, and have lower toxicity to normal cells and smaller side effect; the composition also shows obvious anti-inflammatory effect below the cytotoxic concentration, and has the advantages of moderate effective dose, obvious curative effect, small toxic and side effects and the like, so the composition has wide application prospect.

title_en: Streptococcus thermophilus, sleep-aiding fermented milk base material rich in GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid), lactobacillus beverage and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fermented foods, and discloses streptococcus thermophilus, a sleep-aiding fermented milk base material rich in GABA, a lactobacillus beverage and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials of the fermented milk base material comprise a direct vat set starter and milk; the direct vat set starter comprises lactobacillus helveticus 3878 and streptococcus thermophilus 3881. The lactobacillus beverage comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 20-60% of the fermented milk base material, 4-10% of sweet substances, 0.01-0.1% of stabilizer, 0.05-0.5% of edible essence, 0.05-0.1% of sour substances and the balance of water. According to the invention, after the lactobacillus helveticus 3878 and the streptococcus thermophilus 3881 are compounded, the fermented milk base material and the lactobacillus beverage are prepared by co-fermentation, the two strains can play a synergistic effect, and compared with a single strain, the lactobacillus beverage has higher gamma-aminobutyric acid production efficiency, and has higher GABA content and better sleep-aiding effect.

title_en: Method for improving strength of silkworm cocoon silk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving strength of silkworm cocoon silk, which comprises the steps of preparing a solution from nano graphene oxide, vinyl acetate and beta-sitosterol, spraying the solution on mature leaves according to the dosage of adding 8.0-12L of the solution into 100kg of mulberry leaves, airing, and feeding 5-year-old silkworms for 4-5 days, wherein the strength of the silkworm cocoon silk can be improved by more than 30%, and the yield can be increased by more than 8%. According to the biological function of the nano graphene oxide and the physiological characteristics of silkworms, the prepared additive for silkworms has wide sources and low cost, and the disclosed method has strong usability, is convenient to operate, has obvious effect and is suitable for popularization and application in silkworm areas in China.

title_en: Corn ZmHSMT3 gene and application thereof in reducing cadmium accumulation in rice grains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn ZmHSMT3 gene and application thereof in reducing cadmium accumulation of rice grains, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The CDS region nucleotide sequence of the maize ZmHSMT3 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. According to the invention, the corn ZmHSMT3 gene is cloned and analyzed, and the gene is subjected to function verification by combining with a transgenic technology to carry out heterologous overexpression in rice, so that the tolerance of ZmHSMT3 overexpression plants to cadmium is remarkably enhanced, and the cadmium content in grains is remarkably reduced. The invention provides a feasible technical scheme for low-accumulation breeding and production of rice grains.

title_en: Sandwich pig feed capable of promoting appetite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sandwich pig feed capable of promoting appetite, which comprises a first outer layer and a second outer layer, wherein a first sandwich layer and a second sandwich layer are arranged between the first outer layer and the second outer layer, and coating layers are arranged on the surfaces of the first outer layer and the second outer layer and the side surfaces of the first sandwich layer and the second sandwich layer. This kind of can promote sandwich pig feed of appetite, first sandwich layer through setting up helps promoting appetite, the second sandwich layer of setting helps the digestion absorption, thereby promote the growth of live pig, first skin, the second skin promotes energy and protein for the live pig, consequently, can improve the digestion absorptive capacity of live pig, promote the growth of pig, reduce feed cost, the healthy safe high benefit's of live pig is bred, and external coating makes to form a complete graininess, it is fragile to have avoided the fodder to loose.

title_en: Production method and production equipment of dried beef
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method and production equipment of dried beef, which belong to the field of dried beef production, and the production method of the dried beef comprises the following steps of: step S1: selecting fresh beef surface clear water, washing at least once, adding ginger slices into the beef, boiling with cold water, and boiling with low fire; step S2: taking out the beef boiled in the step S1, draining, cleaning and cutting into strips of 3-5 cm; and (3) batching: step S3: placing the pretreated beef in production equipment, and adding a proper amount of liquid flavoring; adding a proper amount of solid flavoring agent at intervals while stirring, and uniformly stirring for a period of time; step S4: and finally, taking out the beef stirred in the step S3 from production equipment, and baking for 0.7-1.2 hours at 130-150 ℃ in a baking furnace. And (3) packaging a finished product: step S5: and (5) inspecting the finished product after baking, and finally bagging and packaging. The beef jerky produced by the method is delicious and has better flavor.

title_en: A preserved vegetable with reduced salt and flavor, and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salt-reduced preserved szechuan pickle with a maintained flavor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of food processing. The salt-reduced preserved szechuan pickle has low salt content, and compared with the traditional preserved szechuan pickle, the preserved szechuan pickle has the advantages that the salt content is reduced, but the change of the salty taste and the flavor is small, so that the preserved szechuan pickle is suitable for consumers with traditional taste, and the health risk of high salt intake is reduced; the invention has the advantages of low processing and production cost, convenient preparation and good salt reduction effect, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Tissue culture technology for cultivating field mutant strain of Wubaiyuanqi eaglewood I
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tissue culture technology for cultivating field mutant strains of Wubai Yicheng nan I lignum aquilariae resinatum, relates to the technical field of cultivation, and particularly relates to a tissue culture technology for cultivating field mutant strains of Wubai Yicheng nan I lignum aquilariae resinatum, which comprises the following steps: s1, cutting blade tips, blade stems and rootstocks of young tender blades of the field mutant strain of Wubai Yicheng nan I as explants, and sterilizing for later use; s2, making 6 experimental groups by adopting transverse cutting and oblique cutting, and comparing and recording the culture condition of the callus; s3, promoting the proliferation of the intermediate propagules, and further differentiating to promote rooting and seedling strengthening; s4, sterilizing the seedlings of the fresh roots, and culturing the seedlings with disease and pest resistance until the conditions of transplantation are met, and obtaining the high-quality field mutant strain of Wubai Yicheng nan Yi Chen agilawood. The invention can effectively reduce the influence of bacteria or virus carried on the cultivation by sterilizing the explant in advance, and can be matched with different cultivation groups for mutual comparison to determine the optimal cultivation condition and improve the cultivation effect.

title_en: High-drug-concentration foaming crisp pear syrup and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foaming crisp pear syrup sugar with high drug concentration and a preparation method thereof, wherein the foaming crisp pear syrup sugar comprises 110 parts of sugar component, 10 parts of pear syrup, 104 parts of traditional Chinese medicine component and 30 parts of foaming agent component; sugar components comprising 55 parts of white granulated sugar, 45 parts of trehalose and 5 parts of rock sugar; chinese medicinal components including exocarpium Citri rubrum, Glycyrrhrizae radix, pericarpium Citri Tangerinae, radix Angelicae Dahuricae, fructus Siraitiae Grosvenorii, semen Scaphii Lychnophori, flos Lonicerae, semen Armeniacae amarum, rhizoma Alpiniae Officinarum, radix Isatidis, Bulbus Fritillariae Cirrhosae and Glycyrrhrizae radix 8 parts respectively; the foaming agent components comprise 2.5 parts of xanthan gum, 12 parts of egg white and 15.5 parts of soybean protein isolate, raw materials are prepared step by step during processing, and a foaming process is added, so that the prepared finished product pear syrup candy greatly improves the medicine concentration, simultaneously foams and crisps the interior of the candy, makes the taste of the candy lighter and thinner, and can contain white granulated sugar and pear syrup raw pulp in bubbles, thereby providing sweet taste during chewing and effectively improving the taste of the finished product high-medicine-concentration foamed crisp pear syrup candy.

title_en: Preparation process and finish machining device of sauce-flavor marinated chicken feet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marinated chicken claws, in particular to a preparation and finish machining device for sauce-flavor marinated chicken claws, which comprises a storage box, wherein power components are arranged at two sides of the top of the storage box, an inner box and control components are arranged in the storage box, a plurality of uniformly-distributed control components are connected to two sides of the inner box, a discharging pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the bottom of the storage box, two symmetrically-distributed boat-shaped shells are arranged around the inner box, and the boat-shaped shells are fixedly embedded into a shell of the storage box, and the invention also discloses a preparation process for the sauce-flavor marinated chicken claws, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: pretreatment, step two: cleaning equipment, and step three: charging, step four: checking, step five: the chicken feet are placed in the inner box, the efficient soaking and marinating effects are achieved, marinade in the storage box is stirred in the mode, and therefore the uniformity of the marinade soaked on the chicken feet is improved, and the marinating taste of the chicken feet is improved.

title_en: Radix tetrastigme ThF3'5' H gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radix tetrastigme ThF3'5' H gene and application thereof, and the nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention utilizes transcriptome sequencing technology to detect differential expression of radix tetrastigme genes under different functional states, determines candidate genes, clones the full length of the genes through 3'-RACE and 5' -RACE technologies, finds out functional classification of the genes through homologous comparison in public databases of genes and amino acid sequences, and finally detects changes of transgenic arabidopsis metabolites to determine the functions of the genes through gene transformation of arabidopsis, and finds out that the radix tetrastigme 3'5' H genes can improve the content of flavonoid metabolites of kaempferol-3-O-rutin and isorhamnetin-3-O-beta-D-rutinoside of arabidopsis plants, thereby providing basis for subsequent research on improving the antibacterial property of the arabidopsis plants.

title_en: Application of SLC in preparation of product for preventing testicular function reduction caused by testicular injury
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of SLC in preparing a product for preventing testicular function reduction caused by testicular injury. Experiments of the invention show that SLC can effectively reduce the damage of testicular cells, weaken the inflammatory reaction of the testicle, protect the spermatogenic function of the testicle and recover the fertility of the testicle after the testicle is damaged; more importantly, the SLC can effectively reduce the damage of cells of the contralateral testis, weaken the inflammatory reaction of the contralateral testis, protect the spermatogenic function of the contralateral testis and recover the fertility of the contralateral testis after the unilateral testis is damaged, and the SLC can effectively prevent the reduction of the function of the testis caused by the damage of the testis and has good application value in the aspect of developing related products capable of preventing the reduction of the function of the testis caused by the damage of the testis.

title_en: Fermentation separation device for preparing capsicum products and method for preparing capsicum products
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pepper product processing equipment, in particular to a fermentation separation device for pepper product preparation and a pepper product preparation method, wherein a fermentation separation combined design concept is adopted, a separation box is arranged in a fermentation box, and the separation box can be subjected to adjustment extrusion to realize the removal of liquid so as to achieve the purpose of reducing salinity, and meanwhile, the liquid removal stage is completed in the fermentation box, so that the pepper quality is ensured; and can be with the liquid circulation processing capsicum that separates for capsicum fermentation efficiency, device simple structure, convenient to use.

title_en: Preparation method of yellow wine with effects of dispelling effects of alcohol and not damaging liver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of yellow wine with the effects of relieving alcoholism and not damaging liver, belonging to the technical field of yellow wine preparation and comprising the following steps: 1) cleaning raw materials; 2) soaking the raw materials; 3) cooking the raw materials; according to the invention, rice peptide and oyster peptide are prepared while yellow wine fermentation raw materials are prepared, drying and pulverizing of the rice peptide and the oyster peptide are not needed, separated upper layer liquid directly participates in fermentation, preparation procedures are reduced, oyster powder extract has a good protection effect on experimental liver injury, the content of ALT/AST in serum of the liver injury caused by CC14 can be remarkably reduced, the injury degree of stem cells is reduced, after the added plant peptide is perfused into the stomach, the concentration of the amino acids in blood is increased, more NAD +, NAD + are coenzyme of ALDH can be provided, ALDH enzyme activity can be increased, acetaldehyde metabolism is promoted, the concentration of blood acetaldehyde is reduced, arrhythmia, nausea, anxiety, flushing and the like caused by accumulation of acetaldehyde are avoided, and the rice peptide and oyster peptide are suitable for people who need to drink yellow wine but cannot take alcohol.

title_en: Application of Rheum tanguticum Maxim petiole in preparing health food or medicine
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of Rheum tanguticum Maxim petioles in preparing health food or medicine. In particular to the application of the rhubarb tang tangut leaves and stems in preparing antioxidant health food and the application of the rhubarb tang tangut leaves and stems in preparing antioxidant, uric acid reducing, heat clearing and detoxifying drugs. The study of the invention finds that the Rheum tanguticum Maxim petiole has good effects of resisting oxidation, reducing uric acid, clearing heat and removing toxicity, and can prevent and/or treat gout or diminish inflammation. Therefore, the rhubarb petiole of tangut can be prepared into health food or medicine with related efficacy. The invention also provides a preparation method of the rhubarb tang juice, which can overcome the astringent taste of the tang of rhubarb and obtain the rhubarb tang juice with excellent taste. The invention develops the economic value of the Rheum tanguticum Maxim petiole and has good market prospect.

title_en: Co-production method of cold-pressed oil, sauce and powder of walnut kernels
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep processing of agricultural products, and discloses a co-production method of cold-pressed walnut kernel oil, sauce and powder. The method mainly comprises the steps of grinding walnut kernels into liquid from solid, then pumping the walnut kernels to a filter press for filter pressing, and finally separating protein from grease. According to the method, the grinding temperature between the walnut kernels and the grinding equipment is set, so that the damage degree of mechanical grinding to walnut kernel cells can be effectively reduced, the integrity of walnut kernel oil bodies is improved, and the quality of walnut oil can be improved. Meanwhile, the quality of the walnut protein can be protected.
