The oil preparation method can realize large-scale continuous production; can obtain high-quality walnut protein and walnut oil; the high temperature and chemicals are not needed, so that the sanitary and safe effects are achieved; drying is not needed, pollution of materials is avoided, energy is saved, environment is protected, and consumption is reduced.

title_en: Whole-process anti-oxidation brewing method for combination of honey and blueberries and application
abstract_en: A brewing method for preventing whole-course oxidation of honey and blueberry combination and an application thereof belong to the technical field of fruit wine brewing. The method comprises the steps of raw material treatment, cleaning of fermentation equipment, preparation of fermentation liquor, low-temperature fermentation, squeezing and filtration, low-temperature aging, sterilization and canning, wherein potassium metabisulfite is used in the whole process. The invention also provides the honey blueberry fruit wine prepared by the method and application of the brewing method. The invention effectively protects the anthocyanidin, phenols, ketones and other antioxidant substances, prevents the wine body from being oxidized and browned, and improves the quality of the fruit wine. Tracking and detecting free SO in brewing process 2 Content, effective free SO is guaranteed in the whole course 2 The content of the fruit wine achieves the effects of sterilization and antioxidation, and brings a pure natural health-care fruit wine to consumers.

title_en: Intelligent museum system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent noodle shop system, which relates to the technical field of automatic catering and comprises a noodle making device, wherein the noodle making device comprises a transmission mechanism, a noodle making module and a noodle boiling module, the noodle making module and the noodle boiling module are arranged on two opposite sides of the transmission mechanism, the noodle making module is transferred to the noodle boiling module after making noodles, the noodle boiling module is used for transferring the cooked noodles to the transmission mechanism, and the transmission mechanism transmits the noodles outwards; the noodle cooking system is characterized by further comprising an order management module and a control module, wherein the order management module is electrically connected with the control module, the control module is in control connection with the noodle making module, the noodle cooking module and the transmission mechanism, after receiving an order, the order management module transmits an order signal to the control module, and the control module processes order information and starts the noodle making module, the noodle cooking module and the transmission mechanism. The whole process of the invention has high standardization degree, can be copied quickly, improves the operation efficiency and achieves the purpose of artificial intelligent catering.

title_en: Organic shrimp breeding method
abstract_en: A method for culturing organic shrimps comprises the following steps: reforming, pool bottom pretreatment, early-stage water treatment, seedling release, feeding, water quality regulation and control, disease prevention and control, and shrimp collecting in turn; the invention is characterized in that a seawater salt field primary evaporation pond is transformed into a single culture pond, the fermentation lance tail goby and wheat bran rich water is utilized, the whole process is organic rich water, the survival rate of the shrimps can be improved, and the yield per mu and the total output are greatly improved.

title_en: Feed additive suitable for weaned piglets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feed additive suitable for weaned pigs, which belongs to the field of feed additives and comprises the following raw material medicines in parts by weight: 8-16 parts of glucose, 14-23 parts of montmorillonite, 30-45 parts of carrier, 10-20 parts of compound microorganism, 2-3 parts of compound vitamin and 10-20 parts of compound traditional Chinese medicine. The invention can not only adjust the intestinal function, promote the development of intestinal mucosa, maintain the flora balance of the intestinal system, improve the immunity of the organism, but also enhance the feed attractant and improve the growth performance of piglets.

title_en: Card type deoxidizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a card type deoxidizer and a preparation method thereof, which mainly comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-25 parts of paper pulp, 10-20 parts of water, 30-60 parts of reduced iron powder, 1-5 parts of metal chloride, 2-8 parts of gas absorbent and 1-5 parts of water-retaining agent. The invention has the advantages that: (1) the prepared card-type deoxidizer is in a card shape, and the problem of powder leakage is avoided; (2) because the powder leakage problem does not exist, the card-shaped pressing sheet is formed and can be packaged, and the production efficiency is greatly improved; (3) the paper pulp is used as the raw material of the card type deoxidizer, has low price and recoverability, and greatly reduces the production cost; (4) the card-type deoxidizer has an excellent deoxidizing effect.

title_en: Method for efficiently preparing blueberry concentrated juice with high anthocyanin content
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food processing, in particular to a method for efficiently preparing blueberry concentrated juice with high anthocyanin content. The blueberry concentrated juice prepared by the invention has the advantages of strong fruity flavor, smooth and sweet taste, rich nutrition, and high anthocyanin content of 8.24mg/g, which is 5.35 times higher than that of the blueberry raw juice before concentration. The method is efficient, safe and environment-friendly, and can be further popularized in industrial production.

title_en: Selenium-rich edible salt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses selenium-rich edible salt and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of edible salt. This selenium-enriched edible salt, including first wrapping layer and second wrapping layer, the first wrapping layer of second wrapping layer parcel, the parcel has organic selenium in the first wrapping layer, and the parcel has salt in the second wrapping layer, and the salt is located between first wrapping layer and the second wrapping layer. The processing method of the selenium-rich edible salt comprises the following steps: mixing organic selenium, starch and water to obtain a first mixture; granulating and drying the first mixture to obtain first granules; spraying the first wall material solution on the surface of the first particle, and drying to obtain a first coating; mixing salt, starch and water, adding the first particles, continuously mixing to obtain a second mixture, granulating and drying the second mixture to obtain second particles, spraying a second wall material solution onto the surfaces of the second particles through spray coating, and drying to obtain the selenium-rich edible salt. The selenium-rich edible salt provided by the invention can effectively prevent the salt from caking.

title_en: Instant bird's nest production line and production process for ultrahigh pressure sterilization treatment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of instant cubilose production, in particular to an instant cubilose production line for ultrahigh pressure sterilization treatment. The application also relates to a production process of the instant bird's nest through the ultrahigh pressure sterilization treatment executed by the production line of the instant bird's nest. The instant bird's nest production line comprises an automatic bird's nest picking device, the instant bird's nest production line further comprises a bird's nest air dryer, the bird's nest air dryer is arranged before the automatic bird's nest picking device, the automatic bird's nest picking device comprises an industrial robot, clamping jaws and a first industrial camera, the clamping jaws are arranged on the output end of the industrial robot, the clamping jaws comprise claw heads and claw tails, the claw heads are sharp, and electromagnetic coils are respectively arranged on the two claw tails. The instant bird nest production line for ultrahigh pressure sterilization provided by the application realizes the function of air drying and picking hair after bird nest foaming, solves the defects that the foam bird nest has hair residues and the hair picking is difficult, can ensure the timeliness of the action of the clamping jaw by the electromagnetic coil on the claw tail, has smaller force and cannot clamp the bird nest.

title_en: Method for reducing time for pickling duck eggs
abstract_en: A method for reducing time for pickling duck eggs comprises the steps of preparing 20 duck eggs, 600 g of white spirit, 500 g of refined salt, 2600 g of water, 100 g of vinasse, 10 g of star anise and 30 g of pepper according to a formula proportion, cleaning duck egg white, wiping water, soaking the duck egg white in the white spirit, cleaning a container, wiping the water, preparing food materials sequentially for later use, placing the star anise, the pepper and the water into a pot, boiling the duck egg white with strong fire, extinguishing the fire, adding the refined salt for five times at intervals of two minutes, fully stirring the duck egg white 100 g each time until the duck egg is saturated, cooling the duck egg, carefully placing the duck egg into the container, adding the vinasse, pouring cooled marinade into the container, placing the container in a cool and dry place, sealing and preserving the duck egg, taking out the duck egg after five weeks, and keeping original taste and endowing the duck egg with unique fragrance and nutrition on the basis of shortening the preserving time and simplifying a preserving method.

title_en: Formula and method for making sauce-puffed fish roe balls
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation formula and a preparation method of a juice-puffed fish roe ball, which belong to the juice-puffed fish roe ball, the preparation formula of the juice-puffed fish roe ball comprises a juice-puffed fish roe ball skin formula and a juice-puffed fish roe ball stuffing formula, wherein the juice-puffed fish roe ball comprises the following components in parts by weight: the formula of the fried fish roe ball skin comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 38-40 parts of chicken, 56-60 parts of minced fillet A, 24-28 parts of ice water, 1.8-2.1 parts of garlic, 100 parts of soybean oil emulsified slurry, 25-28 parts of raw powder and the like; the sauce-puffed caviar ball stuffing comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 58-62 parts of minced fillet, 20-22 parts of breast minced meat, 9.1-9.3 parts of ascites roe, 38-40 parts of chicken neck skin, 36-38 parts of carrot, 30-33 parts of shortening, 2.8-3.1 parts of white sugar, 8.8-9.1 parts of glucose and the like, and also provides a preparation method thereof. The method is stable and reliable, is suitable for industrial production, can ensure the freshness of food in the preparation process, ensures healthy eating by adopting the formula, is more palatable, has rich, fresh and succulent taste, is not easy to cause food waste, and is suitable for popularization and application in the field of food.

title_en: Pickled vegetable formula and processing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pickled vegetable processing technology, which comprises the following steps: selecting raw materials, pretreating, cleaning pickle jar, filling raw materials and fermenting. According to the formula and the processing technology of the pickled vegetable, the pickled vegetable jar is cleaned by the white spirit in the processing process, so that the pickled vegetable can generate less harmful bacteria in the fermentation process, and is particularly crisp in taste, bright in color, unique in taste, moderate in sweetness and pungency and suitable for the old and the young. The manufacturing process of the pickle is different from the main materials and the ingredients of other pickle, and the fermentation time of the pickle only needs 24 hours, thereby shortening the production period of the pickle.

title_en: Fish body thawing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing equipment, and relates to a fish body thawing device. The fish thawing device comprises a thawing box, wherein a placing frame is arranged in the thawing box and used for placing fish bodies to be thawed; the ultrasonic oscillator is arranged on the unfreezing box and can unfreeze the fish body to be unfrozen on the placing frame; the main conveying pipe is fixedly arranged on the unfreezing box, one end of the main conveying pipe extends into the unfreezing box, the end part of the main conveying pipe is sealed, the main conveying pipe is connected with an air compressing mechanism, a spraying and flushing pipe is arranged on the main conveying pipe and corresponds to the fish body to be unfrozen on the placing frame, and the air compressing mechanism can discharge air into the unfreezing chamber through the main conveying pipe and enable the air to impact the fish body to be unfrozen through the spraying and flushing pipe. The invention has the advantages that: the unfreezing efficiency of the fish body is improved.

title_en: Probiotics activity maintaining method and application of probiotics activity maintaining method in solid lipid food
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for maintaining the activity of probiotics, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding 50-80 parts of whey protein solution into an aseptic container, slowly pouring 60-90 parts of probiotic powder, and continuously stirring at 25-30 ℃ until the mixture becomes viscous; s2, dripping 2-5 parts of peppermint oil into the viscous solution, and continuing stirring for 2-5 min; s3, cold treating at-5-10 deg.C for 5-10min, canning, and storing, wherein the probiotic powder comprises halophilic bacteriaThe whey protein powder is prepared by optimizing streptococcus thermophilus, lactobacillus plantarum, lactobacillus paracasei, pediococcus acidilactici, streptococcus lactis and streptococcus lactis, wherein the concentration of the whey protein solution is 15-20%, and the concentration of the probiotic powder is 4-7 x 10 10 cfu/g, the concentration of peppermint oil is 50-60%. The method for maintaining the activity of the probiotics and the application of the probiotics in solid lipid food reduce the influence of other microorganisms on the probiotics by adding the mint oil into the probiotics and selectively inhibiting the bacteria of the mint oil, and are beneficial to maintaining the activity of the probiotics for a long time.

title_en: Movable dark tea drying rack
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black tea drying racks and discloses a movable black tea drying rack which comprises a support plate, wherein a push rod motor is fixedly installed on the left side of the top of the support plate, a top plate is connected to the top of a transmission shaft of the push rod motor in a transmission mode, a dryer is fixedly installed in the middle of the top plate, a sealing gasket is fixedly installed on the outer side, close to an air outlet, of the bottom of the dryer, an inner rod is fixedly installed at the bottom of the right side of the top plate, the inner rod is inserted into a sleeve, the bottom end of the sleeve is fixedly connected with the support plate, and a charging barrel penetrates through the middle of the support plate. According to the tea leaf drying machine, the spring and the limiting rod are arranged, when the dryer is close to the screen plate, a worker can move the forming plate downwards, the worker can turn the forming plate, the material turning efficiency is improved compared with a mode of frequently adjusting the height of the push rod motor, after the tea leaf single-batch material is dried, the worker rotates the screen plate through the rotating rod, the tea leaf is conveyed into a designated container at the lower side through the charging barrel in a sliding mode, and the tea leaf drying machine is more labor-saving compared with a mode of lifting away from the screen plate and dumping.

title_en: Radix ophiopogonis extract and application thereof in chicken breeding
abstract_en: The invention provides an ophiopogon root extract and application thereof in chicken breeding, and relates to the technical field of animal feeding. The radix Ophiopogonis extract comprises alkaloid, saponin and polysaccharide; the embodiment of the invention provides an ophiopogon root extract, wherein alkaloid substances contained in the ophiopogon root extract not only can effectively play a beneficial effect on various diseases of chickens, but also can accelerate the growth speed of the chickens and provide nutrition for the chickens; the saponin contained in the ophiopogon root extract can be used for further treating the liver diseases of the chicken and the like; the polysaccharides in radix Ophiopogonis can not only provide nutrition, but also regulate various indexes of human body, thereby improving physical condition. In addition, the invention also provides application of the radix ophiopogonis extract, which can be used as an additive of chicken feed and a medicine for treating chicken liver diseases, has no side effect and has the effect of dual purposes.

title_en: Processing device for instant powder of Chinese yam mud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device of instant powder of Chinese yam mud, which belongs to the technical field of processing of instant powder of Chinese yam mud, and comprises a cooking box, wherein first sliding grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the cooking box, first rotating rods are connected to the inner sides of the two first sliding grooves in a sliding manner, and a material loading mechanism for uniformly tiling Chinese yam slices is connected to the inner ends of the two first rotating rods; according to the invention, when the yam slices are required to be steamed, the loading mechanism is utilized to carry and spread the yam slices, so that the yam slices are uniformly spread on the inner side of the loading mechanism, the phenomenon of yam stacking is avoided, the pushing mechanism and the conversion mechanism are matched, when the yam slices are pushed into the steaming box to be steamed, the steamed surfaces of the yam slices are continuously converted, and the uniform spreading of the yam slices is ensured in the conversion process, so that the yam slices are thoroughly and uniformly steamed in the steaming box, and the phenomenon of incomplete adhesion of yams together in steaming is avoided.

title_en: Yu-rank fine cordyceps militaris compound powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid beverages and discloses imperial rank-fine cordyceps militaris composite powder which is characterized by comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 35-45 parts of xylose, 15-25 parts of cordyceps militaris, 3-8 parts of wolfberry fruit, 3-8 parts of agaricus blazei, 15-25 parts of ginseng, 3-8 parts of rhizoma polygonati and 3-8 parts of grape seed extract. This compound powder of imperial rank fine cordyceps militaris, through xylose, the agaricus blazei, the cooperation setting of cordyceps militaris, need not to add white sugar at the in-process of batching and be used for flavouring, make the hyperglycemic crowd also can normal drinking, the agaricus blazei nutrient richly contains multiple amino acid simultaneously, have the hypolipidemic, the function of tranquilization and preventing arteriosclerosis, the cordyceps militaris is edible dual-purpose fungus, its protein content is up to 40.7%, the human essential amino acid that contains wherein not only is complete in kind, and sufficient in quantity, and the proportion is appropriate, can avoid the drinker to ingest too much heat when supplementing nutrition and protein.

title_en: Full-automatic environmental protection and energy saving's marine product scalds boiling integral type hot water tank furnace
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-automatic environment-friendly energy-saving marine product scalding integrated hot water tank furnace, which comprises a scalding water tank, a combustion heater arranged in the scalding water tank and a material boosting mechanism arranged in the scalding water tank, wherein the combustion heater is arranged in the scalding water tank; the boiling water tank is provided with a feeding end and a discharging end; the burning heater is arranged at the middle upper part in the boiling water tank, and a first crawler belt conveying mechanism is arranged from the feeding end to the discharging end at the middle lower part in the boiling water tank; a material conveying channel is formed between the combustion heater and the first crawler conveying mechanism, and a sedimentation and purification tank is formed below the first crawler conveying mechanism. The invention has the advantages that: the burning heater that the basin and be used for going on heating to water that scalds and boil marine product both fuse into one body, and the high temperature heat that burning heater radiation goes out can directly carry out the heat transfer with the water that scalds in the basin of boiling water, can greatly promote the heat exchange efficiency of burning heater, reduces thermal scattering and disappearing to avoid causing fuel, thermal waste.

title_en: Donkey meat hotpot condiment formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a donkey meat hotpot condiment formula and a preparation method thereof, wherein the donkey meat hotpot condiment formula comprises the following components in parts by mass: 15-25 jin of donkey large bone, 220 jin of water, 8-12 g of shallot, 4-9 g of red onion, 8-12 g of green radish, 1-3 g of tricholoma matsutake, 8-12 g of apple, 4-8 g of ginger, 1-3 g of cordyceps flower, 2-4 red dates, 1-3 garlic cloves, 8-12 g of salt, 3-7 g of chicken powder, 12-17 g of chicken juice and 6-10 g of apple vinegar; the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: 1, taking 20 jin to 25 jin of donkey big bone, putting the donkey big bone into a pot with cold water, heating cooking wine, boiling with strong fire, then removing floating foam, and then soaking in cold water; 2: adding 200 jin of purified water into a pot for stewing, adding the soaked big bone, and stewing for 8 hours by small fire to obtain stock soup; step two: 1: firstly, preparing a soup base small material; 2: and (4) putting the small soup bottom materials into a pot, and adding the raw soup decocted in the first step. According to the invention, the donkey bone is taken as the main material, and then various auxiliary materials are added, so that the hotpot condiment has fresh, fragrant and light taste, and the optional range of consumers is widened.

title_en: Cloning of aromatic phenol amine synthetic gene cluster in rice and application in disease resistance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. The invention specifically discloses a metabolic gene cluster for controlling biosynthesis of aromatic phenol amine (hydroxycinnamoyl tyramine) on rice chromosome 10. The gene cluster consists of 1 pyridoxine 5' -phosphate oxidase (OsPDX 3 coding), 1 tyrosine decarboxylase (OsTyDC 1 coding) and 2 hydroxycinnamoyl transferase (OsTHT 1 and OsTHT2 coding), and the means of in vitro enzyme activity measurement, over-expression transgenic rice and the like prove the biosynthesis step coded by the metabolic gene cluster. The transgenic technology is utilized to respectively obtain rice plants which overexpress the OsTHT1 and OsTHT2 genes, and the targeted metabonomics detection result shows that the transgenic rice which overexpresses the OsTHT1 and the OsTHT2 accumulates more aromatic phenol amines such as hydroxycinnamoyl tyramine and the like than the wild rice, and has stronger resistance to two typical diseases (white leaf blight and rice blast). The invention discloses the effect of aromatic phenol amino gene clusters of rice on broad-spectrum disease resistance of rice, and provides a new gene resource for genetic improvement breeding of rice resistance.

title_en: Method for improving edible quality of germinated wheat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the edible quality of germinated wheat, and belongs to the technical field of food preparation. In the wheat germination process, the wheat is subjected to UV-B irradiation to stress the wheat to germinate and inhibit the activity of endogenous hydrolase, so that the eating quality after germination is improved. The wheat flour prepared by the invention has better rough taste, improved content of nutritional functional components and good edible quality.

title_en: Preparation method of fishy smell-removed embryo cervi ultramicro freeze-dried powder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of health food preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of fishy smell removed embryo cervi ultramicro freeze-dried powder. The invention relates to a method for processing deer fetus, which comprises the steps of unfreezing deer fetus, cutting the deer fetus into small blocks, soaking the small blocks in fishy smell removing liquid, airing the soaked small blocks and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of genipin-crosslinked quercetin-zein/pectin/chitosan nanoparticles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of genipin-crosslinked quercetin-zein/pectin/chitosan nano-particles, which belongs to the technical field of food. In the composite nano-particles prepared by the invention, the bioavailability of the quercetin is improved from 16.1% to 82.7%, and the nano-particles can keep good stability after being stored for 15 days at 4 ℃.

title_en: Controllable robot of velocity of flow goes up rice steamer hopper mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of retort loading by robots, in particular to a robot retort loading hopper mechanism with controllable flow rate, which comprises a retort loading hopper mechanism body, a retort loading hopper mechanism body and a conveying belt, wherein the retort loading hopper mechanism body is formed by a section bar frame, a metal plate outer frame and a conveying belt, and the top and the front of the retort loading hopper mechanism body are provided with openings; a rake barrel assembly is arranged in a hopper of the retort feeding hopper mechanism body; the harrow section of thick bamboo subassembly includes the harrow section of thick bamboo cylinder motor that transversely sets up, cup joints the harrow section of thick bamboo in the harrow section of thick bamboo cylinder motor outside and installs a plurality of harrow piece on the harrow section of thick bamboo. According to the invention, the roller motor in the rake barrel of the rake barrel assembly drives the rake barrel to rotate at a certain speed, and the rake blades fixed on the rake barrel are used for scattering and fluffing materials in the hopper; the scattered materials fall on the conveyor belt, fall through the outlet plate after moving at a certain speed, and are combined with the path planning and speed optimization of the robot, so that the scattered materials can reproduce a manual retort feeding method to a large extent, the retort feeding requirements of light weight, looseness, thinness, accuracy, uniformity and flatness required by vinasse are met, and the process of feeding the vinasse to the retort is completed.

title_en: Radiation-resistant roseobacteria RP1 with high oxidation resistance and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses radiation-resistant roseobacteria RP1 with a high oxidation resistance function and equipment thereof. The separated rosette bacillus RP1 is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center in 24 months 8 in 2020 with the preservation number as follows: CGMCC NO: 20420, it has good oxidation resistance and DNA damage repair resistance, can be used as a functional strain for genetic engineering modification, highly expresses a platform compound with application value, and can also transfer the excellent oxidation resistance gene into other organisms, thereby obtaining organisms with excellent stress resistance. By identifying and developing the high-efficiency antioxidant substances in the strain, the strain is also beneficial to the development of functional foods and radioprotective medicaments.

title_en: 2-acetylpyrroline precursors
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of seasoning. More particularly, it relates to precursor compounds of formula (I) which release 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline, in the form of any one of its stereoisomers, tautomers, salts or mixtures thereof, and to a method for releasing 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline from a precursor compound of formula (I), and wherein R is 1 Represents a hydrogen atom or C optionally containing one to three heteroatoms 1 To C 10 A hydrocarbyl group; x represents an amino acid, a peptide OR OR 2 Wherein R is 2 Represents a hydrogen atom or C optionally containing one to three heteroatoms 1 To C 20 A hydrocarbon group, and n is 0 when the dotted line represents a single bond, or n is 1 when the dotted line represents no bond.

title_en: Preparation method of nano enhanced functional flat wire composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nano enhanced functional flat wire composite material. The method comprises the following steps: adding functional nanometer material into silkworm feed, and feeding silkworm to upper cluster; and (5) placing the silkworms clustered on a two-dimensional plane plate for spinning to obtain the composite material. The preparation method of the nano enhanced functional flat silk composite material provided by the invention is simple to operate, the whole process is environment-friendly and pollution-free, the cost is extremely low, composite materials with different functions, sizes and shapes can be prepared according to the needs, the large-scale production is facilitated, meanwhile, the produced composite material has a structure similar to silkworm cocoons, the mechanical property is excellent, the special functions such as antibiosis, electric conduction and ultraviolet resistance are also provided by the functional nano material, and the application range is extremely wide.

title_en: Composition and solid beverage containing American ginseng extract and sealwort extract
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and relates to a composition containing an American ginseng extract and a polygonatum extract, a solid beverage containing the American ginseng extract and the polygonatum extract and a preparation method of the solid beverage. The composition provided by the invention comprises the following main raw materials in parts by weight: 5-60 parts of American ginseng extract, 10-50 parts of rhizoma polygonati extract, 0.05-10 parts of guarana extract, 1-30 parts of medlar powder and 1-30 parts of mulberry powder; also comprises at least one of sweetening agent and sour agent. In the invention, the American ginseng extract and the sealwort extract are respectively embedded by adopting an embedding agent maltodextrin and then are spray-dried, so that the polysaccharide and saponin components in the American ginseng extract and the sealwort extract are effectively protected from loss, and the contents of the two active components are ensured; the American ginseng is subjected to superfine grinding and then steam explosion treatment, so that the dissolution rate of polysaccharide is improved by 3 times, and the composition plays a remarkable role in improving the immunity and the antioxidant effect of the composition.

title_en: Knocking forming equipment for making glutinous rice cake
abstract_en: The invention relates to knocking forming equipment used in making glutinous rice cake, which comprises a base, a guide frame, a placing cylinder, a gear motor, a first gear, a second gear, a knocking component and a material taking component. According to the invention, the steamed glutinous rice is poured into the placing cylinder, the gear motor is started to drive the first gear to rotate, the first gear rotates to drive the placing cylinder to rotate through the second gear, the placing cylinder rotates to drive the glutinous rice to rotate, the knocking assembly is started again, and the knocking assembly operates to smash the glutinous rice, so that people are not required to manually smash the glutinous rice, the labor is saved, and the working efficiency is high.

title_en: Tetragenococcus halophilus and application thereof in production of anti-cancer extracellular polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of functional microorganism screening and application, and particularly provides Tetragenococcus halophilus and application thereof in production of anti-cancer extracellular polysaccharide. The halophilic tetragenococcus is obtained by separating and screening from northeast naturally fermented soybean paste, has the preservation number of CGMCC No.23137, can produce extracellular polysaccharide at high yield, and has the advantages of short sugar production period, safety and no toxic or side effect. The exopolysaccharide produced by the strain can obviously inhibit the proliferation of human liver cancer cells and induce apoptosis, and is expected to be developed into a novel natural anti-cancer medicament.

title_en: Method and system for preparing granular fish feed from sauce-flavor wine waste vinasse
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for preparing granular fish feed by using waste vinasse of sauce-flavor liquor, wherein the method comprises the steps of drying the waste vinasse of sauce-flavor liquor to ensure that the water content of the waste vinasse is 10-15%, and mixing the dried vinasse with bean pulp, bran, fish meal and salt, wherein the weight percentage ratio of the dried vinasse to the bean pulp to the bran to the fish meal to the salt is as follows: drying 60% of distiller's grains, 30% of bean pulp, 5% of bran, 4% of fish meal and 1% of salt, and finally molding the mixed distiller's grains, bean pulp, bran, fish meal and salt by a granulator. The method is characterized in that waste vinasse generated in the Maotai-flavor liquor brewing engineering is used as a main raw material, and a certain amount of other nutrient substances are added to prepare the granular fish feed, so that the problems that the waste vinasse pollutes the environment and is insufficient in resource utilization and the like are solved. Belongs to the field of wine making waste treatment and fish feed processing.

title_en: Shine skin papaya sweetened roll and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shine skin papaya sweetened roll and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of food processing, wherein the preparation method of the shine skin papaya sweetened roll comprises the following steps: peeling and denucleating fresh glabrous skin papaya, mixing with water, homogenizing, sieving, adjusting pH to 4.3-4.5, and filtering to obtain glabrous skin papaya flesh and glabrous skin papaya juice; heating the shine skin papaya juice to 80-90 ℃, adding sucrose and pectin, stirring uniformly, adding shine skin papaya flesh, stirring uniformly until no particles exist, cooling to 45-55 ℃, adding ethyl maltol and potassium sorbate, and stirring uniformly to obtain a mixture; and drying and slicing the mixture to obtain the shine skin papaya sweetened roll. The papaya and melon tree peony bark prepared by the method has the advantages of palatable sour and sweet taste, unobvious astringent taste, fineness and toughness and easily-controlled quality.

title_en: Method for preparing goose liver paste by using duck livers produced in non-cage culture and non-forced feeding culture modes and goose liver paste
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goose liver paste making method, in particular to a goose liver paste making method using duck livers and the goose liver paste, wherein the goose liver paste is made by using duck livers produced in a non-forced feeding and breeding mode, and the goose liver paste can promote health by providing balanced nutrition, realize the taste of being wet, soft and crisp inside and outside, and further improve the taste and flavor.

title_en: Method for inducing red beet embryogenic callus
abstract_en: A method for inducing red beet embryogenic callus, which belongs to the technical field of callus induction. In order to obtain embryogenic callus of red beet and establish a regeneration system, red beet resource 357 is selected, aseptic seedlings are obtained after seed treatment and germination, aseptic seedling explants are collected, and the embryogenic callus is obtained after inoculation in a callus culture medium containing 0.25 mg/L6-BA for 7-8 weeks. The method for inducing red beet callus provides a cytological theoretical basis for establishing a beet plant regeneration system, and lays a foundation for better utilizing genetic engineering means to provide high-quality and high-yield new varieties.

title_en: Multivitamin calcium zinc chewable tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multivitamin calcium zinc chewable tablet and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of food preparation, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: taking povidone K30, zinc gluconate, sucralose, calcium hydrophosphate, L-calcium lactate, vitamin B12 and D-mannitol, uniformly mixing, granulating by a wet method, and taking a main material I; taking povidone K30, folic acid, D-calcium pantothenate, vitamin B1, vitamin B2 and vitamin B6, uniformly mixing, granulating by a dry method, and preparing a main material II; mixing lactose, nicotinamide, vitamin D3 powder and vitamin A acetate dry powder, and granulating by a dry method to obtain vitamins; and uniformly mixing the main material I, the main material II, the vitamins and the auxiliary materials, and tabletting to obtain the multivitamin calcium zinc chewable tablet. According to the invention, different raw materials are classified and granulated in different modes, so that the generation of impurities in the granulating process of the raw materials can be reduced.

title_en: Food additive produces heating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating device for food additive production, which relates to the technical field of food additives.A shell comprises a first bracket, wherein a rotating mechanism is arranged on the first bracket, a transmission mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the rotating mechanism, and a heating mechanism is connected onto the transmission mechanism in a sliding manner; the vertical height and the horizontal position of the heating plate can be flexibly changed by adjusting the transmission mechanism and the heating mechanism, so that the heating efficiency is higher; the heating area of the heating plate can be changed by adjusting the heating mechanism, and the applicability is wide.

title_en: Liquid state fermented vinegar and its production method
abstract_en: The invention provides liquid fermented vinegar and a production method thereof. The production method comprises the following steps: step S1, carrying out alcohol fermentation on a first raw material comprising grains, an enzyme preparation and yeast to obtain fermented glutinous rice; step S2, performing acetic fermentation on a second raw material comprising fermented glutinous rice, acetic acid bacteria and apple juice to obtain liquid fermented raw vinegar; and step S3, sequentially sterilizing and aging the liquid fermented raw vinegar to obtain the liquid fermented vinegar. A certain amount of apple juice is added in the acetic acid fermentation stage of the liquid fermented vinegar, so that on one hand, the acetic acid fermentation rate is increased, the acetic acid fermentation period is shortened, and meanwhile, the consumption of acetic acid which is consumed by acetic acid bacteria as a carbon source is reduced, and further, the conversion rate of alcohol to acetic acid is increased. On the other hand, the content of the non-volatile acid is increased by more than 0.5g/100mL, thereby improving the problem of single flavor of the liquid fermented vinegar.

title_en: Weaned piglet feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weaned pig feed and a preparation method thereof, wherein the weaned pig feed comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 45-55 parts of corn; 10-20 parts of puffed corn; 8-12 parts of bran; 10-15 parts of soybean meal; 6-10 parts of fermented soybean meal; 1-2 parts of soybean oil; 2-6 parts of premix; wherein the mass ratio of the soybean meal to the fermented soybean meal is (1.5-1.7): 1, the fermented soybean meal contains lactic acid bacteria, saccharomycetes and acetic acid bacteria, and the content of total viable bacteria reaches more than 200 cfu/g. According to the application, a certain amount of fermented soybean meal is added into the feed, the problem of nutritional diarrhea of piglets is solved by reducing the amount of the soybean meal, and the growth and development of the piglets are promoted by the nutritional components and beneficial bacteria of the fermented soybean meal.

title_en: Processing method of yellow konjak
abstract_en: In order to solve the problem of complex processing procedures of the existing konjak, the invention aims to provide a processing method of a yellow konjak product, which comprises the following steps: s100, sorting the fresh konjak; s200: cleaning the fresh konjac screened in the step S100 to remove surface impurities or rotten konjac; s300: removing the raw material of the cleaned fresh konjak by using disinfection and sterilization raw material removal water; s400: rough machining, namely performing rough machining on the first product to form a second product; s500: drying the second product to form a third product; s600: forming a fourth product by performing a second process on the third product; s700: packaging the fourth product to form a solid yellow konjac product. The principle of the invention is that the raw water is cleaned at low temperature and disinfected and sterilized to remove the raw water, so that the loss of vitamin C in the konjak caused by high temperature is avoided; and the energy consumption is less, the resource waste is less, a large amount of manpower and material resources are saved, and the loss of a large amount of nutrient components is also avoided.

title_en: Preparation method of selenium-enriched lactobacillus composite preparation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a selenium-enriched lactic acid bacteria compound preparation, which comprises three links of porous calcium carbonate-sodium alginate spheres preparation, fermentation process control and post-treatment. The invention utilizes sodium alginate-porous calcium carbonate particles to load sodium selenite, sufficient sodium selenite is loaded at one time through the micron porous calcium carbonate and the sodium alginate, the release rate of the sodium selenite is controlled, sufficient time is provided for lactic acid bacteria to convert the sodium selenite into organic selenium, and during the fermentation process, the calcium carbonate neutralizes part of lactic acid, thereby not only promoting the further proliferation of the lactic acid bacteria, greatly increasing the number of the lactic acid bacteria in unit volume of fermentation liquor, but also forming excellent calcium lactate supplement which is easy to be absorbed by human bodies, eliminating the damage of the processed lactic acid to the environmental pollution, and realizing good economic and ecological benefits.

title_en: Acne-removing and whitening beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an acne-removing and whitening beverage and a preparation method thereof. The acne-removing whitening beverage comprises the following components: 18-45 parts of pomegranate fruit powder, 11-25 parts of saussurea involucrate culture, 6-15 parts of grape seed extract and 2-6.5 parts of hydrolyzed fish collagen. The acne-removing and whitening beverage can remarkably improve the acne-removing and whitening effects, and has the advantages of no side effect, high absorptivity, good portability and high market acceptance.

title_en: Bread fermentation seed, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a bread fermentation seed, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of food baking, wherein the bread fermentation seed is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 430-580 parts of flour and 400-500 parts of composite fruit residue fermentation stock solution; a method for preparing bread fermentation seeds, comprising the following steps: s1, fermenting, S2, dough, S3, and proofing; a toast is prepared from the bread fermentation seed. The method has the effect of reducing the production cost of the fermentation seeds, and can improve the quality of toast processing.

title_en: Preparation process of wanying tea
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of wanying tea, which comprises the following steps: preparing materials such as 1-3g of sandalwood, 50-80g of nutmeg, 20-30g of rhubarb (prepared with wine), 5-10g of dried orange peel (prepared), 3-15g of cablin potchouli herb, 5-10g of mint, 3-5g of notopterygium root, 5-10g of bighead atractylodes rhizome (fried with soil), 10-20g of changium smyrnioides, 5-10g of poria cocos, 5-10g of white hyacinth bean (prepared with ginger), 5-10g of rhizoma cyperi (prepared with vinegar), 10-20g of rhizoma atractylodis, 10-20g of amomum cardamomum, 20-30g of magnolia officinalis (prepared with ginger), 5-10g of fructus aurantii (fried with bran), 5-8g of cinnamon, 3-5g of rhizoma alismatis (prepared with salt), 5-8g of whiteflower hogfenneI and the like, respectively placing the materials in a suitable container for standby, adding 400ml of clear water into the prepared container, cleaning the prepared materials for the first time, after the cleaning is finished, the prepared materials are washed for the second time, and after the cleaning is finished, a drying device is adopted for drying. The preparation process of the wanying tea adopts automatic processing equipment to carry out processing production, effectively improves the production efficiency, improves the yield of the wanying tea, reduces the production cost and ensures the quality and the safety of the wanying tea.

title_en: Bacterial strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microorganisms, in particular to a strain and application thereof. The strain is Lactobacillus paracasei (Lactobacillus paracasei) with the preservation number of CGMCC No. 23526. The strain can take inulin and/or fructo-oligosaccharide as a unique carbon source, obtains growth energy superior to that taking glucose as the unique carbon source, and has stronger prebiotic utilization capacity than Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG; has good acid resistance and bile salt resistance; has good inhibition effect on pathogenic bacteria; meanwhile, the product is sensitive to ampicillin, penicillin, clarithromycin and tetracycline, and has good probiotic function and safety.

title_en: Preparation of ultramicro chestnut powder fresh noodles by high-energy nano impact mill and airflow pulverization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of fresh chestnut powder fresh noodles by using a high-energy nano impact mill and airflow crushing, which comprises the following steps: picking fresh and disease-free mature Chinese chestnuts, cleaning, and then shelling and peeling the cleaned Chinese chestnuts; then, the Chinese chestnut slices are dried in a vacuum freeze dryer to prepare dried Chinese chestnut slices; after the obtained dry Chinese chestnut pieces are coarsely crushed, high-energy nano impact grinding and airflow crushing treatment are carried out to obtain high-energy nano impact ground Chinese chestnut powder and airflow crushed Chinese chestnut powder; the chestnut powder prepared by different methods is added into high-quality high-gluten flour in proportion, and the fresh chestnut powder noodles are prepared after dough kneading, tabletting and slitting. The fresh noodles prepared by the method not only can improve the nutrient content of the noodles, but also can improve the processing characteristics of the noodles and endow the noodles with unique flavor.

title_en: Composite preservative loaded with carbon quantum dots, preparation method and application of composite preservative in preservation of fresh-cut fruits and vegetables
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite preservative loaded with carbon quantum dots, a preparation method and application thereof in preservation of fresh-cut fruits and vegetables. The composite preservative comprises 2.5-4.5% of carrot carbon quantum dots, 1-2% of wheat gluten, 1-1.5% of chitosan, 1-3% of ascorbic acid, 2-3% of glycerol, 3-5% of absolute ethyl alcohol and the balance of acetic acid buffer solution. According to the invention, the carbon quantum dots prepared from the kitchen garbage are added into the preservative, and due to the antibacterial advantage of the carbon quantum dots and the synergistic sterilization of the carbon quantum dots and the chitosan, the preservation of the fresh-cut fruits and vegetables is realized, and meanwhile, the kitchen garbage is converted into new resources through proper treatment and processing, so that the recycling of the resources is realized. The preparation method is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the preparation method is nontoxic, harmless and pollution-free to the environment. The prepared composite preservative has good effects in the aspects of browning prevention, water retention, sterilization, rot prevention and the like, has a comprehensive effect, prolongs the shelf life and has a good preservation effect.

title_en: Compound feed for laying hens and preparation method and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of poultry feed, and particularly relates to a compound feed for laying hens, and a preparation method and equipment thereof. According to the invention, the immunity of the laying hen can be remarkably improved by adding the Chinese herbal medicine additive with the powder specification. In addition, the invention also provides a preparation method of the laying hen feed using the rolling type air heater, wherein the structure of the rolling type air heater comprises a base unit, a transverse rotating barrel unit, a circular slotted plate unit and a hot air pipe unit, and the preparation method has the characteristics of high heating and drying efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine materials and convenience in operation. The invention has the following advantages: firstly, after the traditional Chinese herbal medicine additive is added into the existing common laying hen feed, the disease prevention and anti-virus capability and immunity of laying hens can be obviously improved; secondly, the Chinese herbal medicine additive is powder, and is dried and then crushed, so that the crushing operation is quicker, and the Chinese herbal medicine in the powder type can release effective components more easily.

title_en: Standardized processing method of steamed crab instant dish
abstract_en: The invention discloses a standardized processing method of a steamed crab instant dish, which is characterized in that fresh and alive steamed crabs grown in Changdong lake are selected, cleaned and decontaminated and then put into a quick freezing warehouse for quick freezing; and then marinating in the prepared sauce, performing low-temperature flavoring after marinating, and finally performing modified atmosphere preservation and packaging. The steamed crab instant dish prepared by the method has the advantages of high production efficiency, high standardization degree, small pollution risk and long quality guarantee period, and can prolong the quality guarantee period by more than 50 percent on the basis of 3-5 days of the traditional steamed crab instant dish, and the quality guarantee period reaches 8-10 days.

title_en: Black-bone chicken soup beneficial to enhancing immunity of pregnant women during pregnancy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black-bone chicken soup which is beneficial to enhancing immunity of pregnant women during pregnancy, and the black-bone chicken soup comprises the following components in parts by weight: 90-130 parts of black-bone chicken, 8-13 parts of Chinese yam, 1-5 parts of dried orange peel, 1-5 parts of medlar, 1-5 parts of fructus amomi and 1-3 parts of seasoning auxiliary materials. The invention belongs to the technical field of black-bone chicken soup, and particularly relates to black-bone chicken soup for reinforcing kidney and strengthening spleen, tonifying qi and preventing miscarriage and enhancing immunity of pregnant women during pregnancy and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Plant fat meat and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant fat meat and a preparation method thereof, and the plant fat meat comprises the following components: water, acetate starch, solid vegetable oil, sodium alginate and locust bean gum; the preparation method comprises the following steps: heating solid vegetable oil in a steamer to a temperature of more than 50 ℃ to form liquid; uniformly stirring and mixing water, acetic ester starch, sodium alginate and locust bean gum to obtain a mixed raw material; adding vegetable oil which is melted into liquid into the mixed raw materials, and shearing for 30-60 s to fully mix the vegetable oil and the liquid; steaming the mixture in a steamer at 100 ℃ for 25-40 min for shaping; and (5) cooling and demoulding to obtain the plant fat meat. According to the invention, sodium alginate, acetic ester starch and locust bean gum are compounded to generate a cross-linking synergistic effect to replace common konjac flour in the market, and the prepared finished product has high gel strength and a taste similar to pork fat.

title_en: Cereal compositions containing human milk oligosaccharides
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a cereal composition that can be prepared on-the-fly by adding a liquid, which composition comprises at least one Human Milk Oligosaccharide (HMO) and other ingredients necessary for the healthy growth and development of young individuals.

title_en: Polygonatum cyrtonema micro-tuber dark energy-saving in-vitro propagation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Polygonatum cyrtonema micro-tuber dark energy-saving in-vitro propagation method, belonging to the technical field of plant tissue culture. The method reduces the apical dominance of the explant by optimizing the plant growth regulator and the in vitro culture of the polygonatum sibiricum explant, releases the growth potential of lateral buds from a dormant state, and induces the formation of tubers. Cytological observations show that the rosette type plant explants can form a plurality of tubers, and each tuber is originated from the axillary bud at the base of the leaf. Unlike adventitious organogenesis, newly developing tubers originate from intrinsic lateral buds and no callus formation. The tuber production system of the present invention provides a new method for propagating polygonatum cyrtonema plants that facilitates easier storage, transplantation and tuber sowing. Higher genetic stability can be obtained without callus formation.

title_en: Microcapsule of starch-based formula and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a microcapsule of a starch-based formula and application thereof. The core material in the microcapsule of the starch-based formula is polyunsaturated fatty acid grease, and the wall material at least comprises first sodium starch octenyl succinate and second sodium starch octenyl succinate; the dosage of polyunsaturated fatty acid grease is not less than 35%; the molecular weight of the first sodium starch octenyl succinate is (1-4) multiplied by 10  7  g/mol, the molecular weight of the second sodium starch octenyl succinate is 5000g/mol-7 multiplied by 10  4  g/mol. According to the invention, two specific starch sodium octenyl succinates with different molecular weights are used as one of wall material raw materials to be compounded with the core material of the high-content unsaturated fatty acid grease, so that the obtained microcapsule of the starch-based formula has good stability, and can be well applied to milk powder and infant formula milk powder with higher requirements on product performance.

title_en: Method and equipment for making Fu tea by light pressure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Fu tea processing, and discloses a method and equipment for manufacturing lightly-pressed Fu tea, which solve the problems that when the Fu tea is manufactured, the Fu tea needs to be manually taken for discharging, so that the discharging is inconvenient, and further the manufacturing speed of the Fu tea is slow, and comprises the following steps: picking tender shoots of black tea for later use, removing impurities and screening the tender shoots in the step S1, cleaning the screened tender shoots, cutting the tender shoots, placing the cut tender shoots in a worm gear fermentation machine for steaming for 30 minutes to soften the tea leaves for later use, adding water into the tea leaves in the step S4, and steaming the tea leaves again through the worm gear fermentation machine for 1 minute; through the design of pushing equipment and scraping wings, be convenient for make the scraping wings push the fashioned tealeaves ejection of compact of braking, the effectual artifical ejection of compact of avoiding, and then improved the discharging efficiency of tealeaves, and then accelerated the production efficiency to tealeaves.

title_en: Heat-resistant fried pigskin flavor essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses heat-resistant fried pigskin flavor essence. The heat-resistant fried pigskin flavor essence comprises, by mass, 34-40 parts of meat flavor substances, 0-2 parts of acid flavor substances, 0-0.7 part of spicy flavor substances, 7-11 parts of fat flavor substances, 5-8 parts of sweet flavor substances, 9-15 parts of baking flavor substances, 1-4 parts of smoking flavor substances and 30-40 parts of heat-resistant essence solvents. The method adopts a headspace solid-phase microextraction-gas chromatography/mass spectrometry combined technology to detect the aroma components of the real fried pigskin, so as to obtain the component data of meat aroma, acid aroma, spicy aroma, fat aroma, sweet aroma, baking aroma and smoking aroma; preparing the fried pigskin essence according to the ingredient data. The fried pigskin essence has good perfuming effect, good natural feeling and natural feeling, and less addition amount in practical application.

title_en: Mulberry enzyme and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mulberry enzyme and a production process thereof, wherein the formula comprises the following components: the production process of mulberry, white sugar and probiotics comprises the steps of selecting materials and preparing materials; step two, probiotic culture; step three, canning and fermenting; step four, filtering and purifying; step five, preparing mulberry enzyme; firstly, washing mulberry fruits serving as raw materials by using clear water, and then draining, removing stems and crushing for later use; activating the strain of the probiotics, and culturing for 48-72h to obtain a bacterial liquid of the probiotics for later use; the mulberry enzyme prepared by matching the mulberry, the white sugar and the probiotics has high nutritive value, and the raw materials have simple components and wide sources; through the use of probiotics, the mulberries are comprehensively fermented, so that the nutrients are micro-quantized and are more beneficial to the absorption of a human body; the production process used by the invention is simple and comprehensive, and is beneficial to popularization and use.

title_en: Preparation method and application of colorful powder
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of gorgeous powder, which comprises the steps of deactivating enzyme of gorgeous leaves and vacuum freeze-drying the deactivated gorgeous leaves; the freeze-drying temperature is-20 ℃ to 35 ℃. The colorful powder prepared by the application has high yield, more dominant color and flavor than other methods, and breaks through the technical problem of poor quality of the colorful powder produced in China. The application also provides a gorgeous coconut cake, which comprises the gorgeous powder, coconut extract, hispid fig extracting solution and the like. The cake provided by the application has special fresh fragrance, is bright in color, promotes appetite and digestion, and has the effects of clearing summer heat. In addition, the cake disclosed by the application not only has the satiety effect of similar cake products, but also has various effects of facilitating digestion and absorption, promoting appetite, clearing heat and relieving summer-heat, tonifying qi and eliminating dampness and the like, and the welcome degree is far higher than that of the existing products.

title_en: Bacillus bailii and composite bacterial preparation thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to bacillus bailii MVCR2 which can improve the immunity of rainbow trout and has obvious inhibition effect on aeromonas salmonicida and vibrio anguillarum; also relates to a composite bacterial preparation containing the bacillus belicus MVCR2; also relates to the application of the bacillus belicus MVCR 2. The bacillus belicus (Bacillus velezensis) MVCR2 is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with a strain preservation number of M2021507 and a preservation date of 2021, 05 and 08. The bacillus beijerinus MVCR2 has remarkable inhibition effect on aeromonas salmonicida and vibrio anguillarum, has effective control effect on various aquaculture diseases caused by aeromonas salmon and vibrio anguillarum, can improve the growth and immunity of rainbow trout, improve the survival rate of rainbow trout, and reduce the transitional sea death rate of fresh water rainbow trout.

title_en: Nutritional composition for safely and efficiently dissolving thrombus and lipid plaque
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutritional composition for safely and efficiently dissolving thrombus and lipid plaques, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of natto freeze-dried powder, 6-15 parts of red yeast rice, 10-15 parts of sheep heart peptide, 6-10 parts of honeysuckle, 6-10 parts of kudzu root powder and 1-2 parts of taurine. The nutritional composition can be converted into a product for preventing and treating cardiovascular and cerebrovascular basic diseases, and is suitable for hyperlipidemia, blood viscosity, atherosclerosis, plaque formation, blood supply insufficiency of heart, brain and whole body tissues caused by vascular stenosis and hypertension due to plaque, and the like.

title_en: Preparation method and application of poria cocos extract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a poria cocos extract, which comprises the following preparation steps: taking dry poria cocos slices, crushing, grinding and screening to obtain poria cocos powder; adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the poria cocos powder, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed liquid; placing the mixed liquid A in a microwave reactor, performing microwave extraction, and performing suction filtration to obtain an alcohol-containing Poria cocos extracting solution A; adding the filter residue obtained in the step S3 into purified water, stirring uniformly, and heating and refluxing for extraction to obtain a water-containing poria cocos extracting solution B; mixing alcohol-containing Poria extract A and water-containing Poria extract B, stirring, and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain mixed extract C; and (3) placing the mixed extracting solution C in a vacuum environment, concentrating into a paste, drying and crushing to obtain the poria cocos extract. The tuckahoe extract is taken as a food additive in food and beverage for a long time, so that the occurrence of metabolic diseases such as obesity, hyperlipidemia and the like can be reduced.

title_en: Improvements in or relating to organic compounds
abstract_en: Use of a compound of formula (I) as an umami tastant, and wherein X, Y is-NH-or-O-, wherein at least X or Y is-NH-, the compound being in its formAny one of the stereoisomeric forms, or mixtures thereof, wherein represents a carbon-carbon single or double bond, and wherein one carbon-carbon double bond is present at C2 or C3, the wavy bond represents an unspecified configuration of the adjacent double bond. Wherein

title_en: Forming die and manufacturing method of sandwich soft sweet
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming die of a sandwich soft candy, which comprises a first split die, a second split die, a die frame and a push rod, wherein the two ends of the first split die and the second split die are respectively hinged on bases at the two ends of the die frame, a first half die cavity and a second half die cavity are respectively arranged in a die clamping surface of the first split die and the second split die, after die clamping, the first half die cavity and the second half die cavity are matched together to form a die cavity consistent with the shape of a soft candy wrapper, and the push rod is also arranged on the bases at the two ends of the die frame in a vertical sliding mode and used for pushing the first split die and the second split die. The invention also provides a manufacturing method for forming the sandwich soft sweet, which utilizes the gel shrinkage principle of the soft sweet leather material to form a surface depression, then casts the soft sweet core material into the surface depression, and then cools the mold to form the sandwich soft sweet, wherein a casting hole is not reserved on the outer surface of the soft sweet leather material, the sandwich soft sweet has attractive appearance, and the excessive sugar material is not required to be manually cut off, so that the labor cost is saved, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Automatic glue rubbing device for donkey-hide gelatin production
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of donkey-hide gelatin production and application, and particularly relates to an automatic gelatin wiping device for donkey-hide gelatin production. The device comprises a frame and a transmission belt arranged on the frame, wherein the frame is also provided with a sliding block, the sliding block comprises a power sliding block arranged on one side of the transmission belt and a passive sliding block arranged on one side of the transmission belt, which is far away from the power sliding block, the sliding blocks are arranged on two sides of the transmission belt in a sliding manner, and a driving mechanism for driving the sliding blocks to slide is arranged on the frame.

title_en: Preparation method of honey roast duck
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of honey roast ducks, and provides a preparation method of honey roast ducks, which comprises the following steps; the method comprises the following steps: selecting materials, and the step two: selecting auxiliary materials, and step three: processing honey, and step four: pickling the materials, and carrying out the fifth step: air-drying the materials, and carrying out the sixth step: smearing honey, and the seventh step is: baking to obtain duck meat, adding soy sauce, cooking wine, aniseed, cassia bark, pricklyash peel, scallion, ginger, clear water, honey, crystal sugar, salt and apple as auxiliary materials, and processing honey by sequentially adding maltose and brown sugar into collected native honey, stirring, adding pure natural rose syrup during stirring, and continuously stirring. According to the preparation method of the honey roast duck, before roasting the roast duck, the roast duck is smeared with honey, and the honey is smeared by continuously adding the honey in the roasting process, so that the roast duck is more tasty, and the taste of the roast duck is not single any more.

title_en: Method for producing fried vegetable food and fried vegetable food
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing a noodle-like fried vegetable food, which can effectively suppress the occurrence of defects such as chipping and breaking in the packaging step or transportation during the production of noodle-like fried vegetables, has the original texture of vegetables when reconstituted with hot water, and can be eaten like noodles, and a noodle-like fried vegetable food. The method for producing a noodle-like fried vegetable food according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: cutting vegetables into noodle-like shapes to form noodle-like vegetables, providing a frying vessel having a holder, housing the noodle-like vegetables in the holder of the frying vessel to form pieces of noodle-like vegetables, and frying the pieces of noodle-like vegetables housed in the holder; the method further comprises the following steps: the pieces of the noodle-like vegetables are compressed during or immediately after frying of the pieces of noodle-like vegetables.

title_en: Corn and mycorrhizal fungi symbiotic related protein, and coding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn and mycorrhizal fungi symbiotic related protein, and a coding gene and application thereof. The protein provided by the invention is as follows (a) or (b): (a) Protein composed of amino acid sequences shown in sequence 1 or 2 in a sequence table; (b) And (b) a protein which is obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding one or more amino acid residues for the amino acid sequence of the sequence 1 or 2 and is related to the symbiotic relationship of plants and mycorrhizal fungi. The ZmL gene can regulate and control the symbiosis of corn and mycorrhizal fungi, namely, the homozygous mutation or deletion of the gene can ensure that the corn loses the symbiosis of the mycorrhizal fungi and forms mycorrhizal structures; expression of ZmL in the mutated or deleted material of the gene restores the above-described ability of maize. ZmL75 can improve the salt tolerance of plants and restore the mutant atgpat6 kernal phenotype. The invention provides a new gene resource for symbiotic research of plants and mycorrhizal fungi, and can be applied to the fields of plant stress-tolerant breeding and the like.

title_en: Plant stress resistance related gene ATAGL70, and coding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention identifies a gene ATAGL70 related to plant stress resistance, a coding protein and application thereof. The invention provides a polypeptide consisting of SEQ ID NO: 1 and the nucleotide sequence of the DNA shown in SEQ ID NO: 2, and 2, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; the invention provides application of a plant stress resistance related gene ATAGL70 in improving plant stress resistance, cultivating stress resistance transgenic plants and breeding plant varieties with improved stress resistance. Experiments prove that the gene ATAGL70 provided by the invention negatively regulates the stress resistance, and the deletion of the gene ATAGL70 causes the plant to be more tolerant to osmotic stress in the aspect of main root extension; meanwhile, the mutant has less pore density and pore diameter, so that the deletion mutant has obvious drought resistance. The discovery is beneficial to comprehensively knowing and revealing the influence mechanism of drought stress on crops and is beneficial to the cultivation of new stress-resistant varieties of the crops.

title_en: Multilayer coated heat-sensitive nutrient microcapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a multilayer coated heat-sensitive nutrient microcapsule and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nutrient microcapsule comprises: nutrient microparticles; the packaging material is filled in the inner pore canal of the nutrient particle and wraps the surface of the nutrient particle; the outer wall material is wrapped outside the nutrient particles and the packaging material; wherein the nutrient microparticles comprise: nutrients, inner wall material and grease. The interior of the nutrient particle is filled with the packaging material, so that the microcapsule is not easy to absorb water and deteriorate, has good stability, long shelf life and good rigidity, and is not easy to damage, deform and the like in the subsequent processing process.

title_en: Intelligent undaria pinnatifida shredding machine
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent undaria pinnatifida wire cutting machine which comprises a transverse bottom plate, a guide fixing frame structure, an upper side mounting frame, a convenient maintenance protection observation frame structure, a driving roller, a driven roller, a conveying motor, a conveying belt, a buffer wire cutting frame structure, a guiding frame, a storage inserting bucket, an adjustable pad frame structure, a control table and a controller, wherein the guide fixing frame structure is mounted on the upper part of the transverse bottom plate, the upper side mounting frame is mounted on the outer upper part of the guide fixing frame structure, the convenient maintenance protection observation frame structure is mounted on the front side of the upper side mounting frame, the driving roller is connected to the right lower side of the upper side mounting frame, and the driven roller is connected to the left upper side of the upper side mounting frame. The storage inserting frame is inserted into the right side of the inside of the supporting base, so that the storage inserting hopper can be conveniently stored when in use, and the occupied space can be saved when the storage inserting frame is not in use.

title_en: Auricularia auricula polysaccharide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black fungus polysaccharide and application thereof; an Auricularia polysaccharide with average molecular weight of 1.5KDa comprises 8 monosaccharides. The preparation method comprises the steps of crushing the black fungus to 50-100 meshes, adding water, and stirring and extracting; 2) adding hydrolytic protease, oscillating at constant temperature, removing protein, and inactivating enzyme; 3) concentrating after enzyme deactivation, slowly adding ethanol with the concentration of 95% until the volume fraction of the ethanol reaches 75-85%, and precipitating with ethanol; 4) centrifuging, removing supernatant, and vacuum freeze drying the precipitate; 5) re-dissolving the precipitate to prepare a black fungus polysaccharide solution; purifying, carrying out chromatographic separation, collecting eluent, concentrating and drying to obtain the auricularia auricula polysaccharide; the invention screens out the auricularia auricula polysaccharide component which can improve the rehydration characteristic of dehydrated vegetables; the result shows that the auricularia auricula polysaccharide AAP-80-III can effectively improve the rehydration characteristic of dehydrated vegetables and better maintain the color, hardness and chewiness of samples after rehydration.

title_en: Ramie breeding method with high crude protein content
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ramie breeding method with high crude protein content, which relates to the technical field of crop breeding, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: s1, germplasm screening; s2, measuring the SPAD value of the leaves on the ramie plant, and then screening 40 parts of ramie material with high SPAD value; and measuring the crude protein content of each variety of 40 parts of materials; s3, selecting 100 parts of the initially screened germplasm with strong growth potential and good stumping force for propagation and planting according to the steps S1 and S2, analyzing the SPAD value of the leaves on the ramie plant by using a SPAD502 chlorophyll content tester, repeatedly counting the SPAD value for three times, and screening the A-class ramie variety of which the SPAD value is more than 49; s4, cultivating the A-class ramie variety to obtain the ramie seed with high A-class crude protein content. The method for breeding the ramie can breed the ramie with strong growth potential, good stump-growing force, high yield and high crude protein content, and is convenient to improve the feeding value; meanwhile, the method is simple and high in efficiency.

title_en: IbPIF1 related to sweet potato stem nematode resistance as well as encoding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sweet potato stem nematode resistance-related protein IbPIF1, and a coding gene and application thereof. The IbPIF1 is protein shown by a1) or a2) or a3) or a 4): a1) a protein shown in sequence 2; a2) a fusion protein obtained by connecting labels to the N end or/and the C end of the protein shown in the sequence 2; a3) the protein related to the resistance of the stem nematode disease is obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding one or more amino acid residues of the amino acid sequence shown in the sequence 2; a4) and (b) a protein which has 90% identity with the amino acid sequence shown in the sequence 2, is derived from sweet potatoes and is related to the resistance of the stem nematode disease. The invention introduces the coding gene of IbPIF1 protein into sweet potato to obtain transgenic plant, and the transgenic plant is infected by stem nematode to find that the resistance of the transgenic plant is enhanced. The IbPIF1 protein plays an important role in the disease-resistant process of plants and has wide application prospect.

title_en: GmZTL3 protein, application of coding gene thereof and method for cultivating soybean
