abstract_en: The invention discloses GmZTL3 protein, application of a coding gene thereof and a method for cultivating soybean, belonging to the technical field of biology. To provide a method for controlling the photoperiod and the flowering phase of plants simultaneously. The invention provides application of GmZTL3 protein in controlling the plant growth period, controlling the plant photoperiod or controlling the plant growth period and the plant photoperiod, wherein the amino acid sequence of the GmZTL3 protein is shown as SEQ ID NO.10, and the plant height is improved in the growth period under the condition of long and short sunshine; the control photoperiod is to bloom in advance, and the protein sequence provided by the invention has wide application space and market prospect in the agricultural field.

title_en: Recombinant III-type humanized collagen C3, and expression vector, expression strain, expression method and application thereof
abstract_en: A recombinant III-type humanized collagen C3, an expression vector, an expression strain, an expression method and application thereof relate to the fields of genetic engineering and synthetic biology; the amino acid sequence is shown in SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention eliminates the non-CTHR region in the human III type collagen with the known sequence, preferably the CTHR region and the preserved non-spiral regions of the N-end and the C-end, and edits and recombines the reinforced micro human collagen, the core functional region sequence of the reinforced micro human collagen is 100 percent same as the corresponding part of the human collagen, and the reinforced micro human collagen can not cause immunological rejection reaction when being applied to human bodies. The collagen protein has high stability, high tensile strength, good biodegradability and good hydrophilicity, has the characteristics of promoting cell growth, promoting cell adhesion, promoting collagen density increase, repairing wounds by cooperating with new cells and tissues and the like, and has great application prospect in the fields of cosmetics, medical treatment and food. The strain is effective and stable, the preparation method is simple, high yield can be obtained at low cost, and industrialization is easy to realize.

title_en: Tyrannospora rex heat-resistant gene ZxDPB3-1 and application thereof in cultivation of heat-resistant crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of molecular biology, in particular to a heat-resistant gene ZxDPB3-1 of overlord and application thereof in cultivating heat-resistant crops, and provides a nucleotide sequence and an encoded amino acid sequence of the heat-resistant gene ZxDPB3-1, and meanwhile, the overexpression of the gene in arabidopsis thaliana can obviously enhance the heat resistance of arabidopsis thaliana. The method not only provides a theoretical basis for breeding new high-temperature-resistant plant varieties, but also provides a new gene resource for cultivating heat-resistant crops, and has wide application value.

title_en: Malanian indole metabolism related gene BcWRKY1, protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cerulenin metabolism related gene BcWRKY1, a protein and an application thereof, wherein the gene BcWRKY1 has a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 1; 1 nucleotide sequence, allele or derivative generated by adding, substituting, inserting or deleting one or more nucleotides in the nucleotide sequence; the protein coded by the kalanchoe metabolic related gene BcWRKY1 has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 2; the gene BcWRKY1 has a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the gene BcWRKY1 and a nucleotide sequence, an allele or a derivative generated by adding, substituting, inserting or deleting one or more nucleotides in the nucleotide sequence are applied to indole acetate for regulating tryptophan metabolism in Arabidopsis.

title_en: High-stability heavy metal expelling composition, and application, dosage form and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A high-stability heavy metal expelling composition, and application, a preparation form and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of medicines. The composition comprises: A) 70-95% by weight of a compound of formula (1) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; B) 1-25% by weight of a compound of formula (2) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof; 0.001-5 wt% of alkaline compound, wherein the alkaline compound is at least one of hydroxide, carbonate, bicarbonate, hydrogen phosphate, carboxylate or ammonia water of alkali metal. Compared with the existing GDTC medicines, the composition obtained by the invention has the advantages that the stability is greatly improved, and the excellent heavy metal expelling effect is kept; because the stability is improved, the dosage can be reduced to about 1/4 without changing the drug effect, and the use safety of the drug is improved; meanwhile, the stability of the medicine is improved, so that the production, transportation and storage costs can be effectively reduced, the effective period is prolonged, and the cost of the medicine is effectively reduced.

title_en: Fresh ginger warm beer and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of beer production, in particular to a production method of fresh ginger warm beer and the fresh ginger warm beer obtained by the production method. The production method of the fresh ginger warm beer comprises the steps of adding fresh ginger, red dates, medlar, clove and amomum cardamomum as auxiliary materials in the process of boiling wort, carrying out rotary precipitation and fermentation after cooling, and obtaining the fresh ginger warm beer. The production method of the invention inherits the traditional Chinese food-based vitality-nourishing way, sublimates the essence of the traditional Chinese food materials, organically integrates the effects of dispelling cold and warming stomach of fresh ginger, enriching blood and strengthening beer of red dates, tonifying qi and improving eyesight of medlar, warming kidney and tonifying yang of clove, resolving dampness and promoting qi circulation of round cardamon, warming middle-jiao and preventing vomiting and the like, and enriches the variety of the refined beer. The fresh ginger warm beer provided by the invention has good taste, is suitable for drinking in autumn and winter, and has more comprehensive health care effect.

title_en: Method for removing bitter soybean peptide by utilizing aminopeptidase and alkaline protease in synergy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly relates to a method for removing soybean peptide by utilizing aminopeptidase and alkaline protease in a synergistic manner. The soybean peptide is subjected to debittering by adopting the complex enzyme of aminopeptidase and alkaline protease, the aminopeptidase and alkaline protease are synergistically hydrolyzed to achieve a good debittering effect, and various factors influencing debittering such as enzyme adding amount, substrate concentration, enzymolysis temperature, enzymolysis time and the like are optimized to obtain optimal enzymolysis conditions, so that the debittering effect is obvious, the bitterness score of soybean peptide hydrolysate is reduced to 1.3, the molecular weight of the soybean peptide is totally distributed below 6500Da, only 1450Da occupies 93.87%, and the soybean peptide has wide application prospect in the fields of foods and the like.

title_en: Formula of polysaccharide multi-dimensional dietary fiber composite powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a formula of a medical saccharose multi-dimensional dietary fiber composite powder, which relates to the technical field of dietary fiber composite powder, the formula of the medical saccharose multi-dimensional dietary fiber composite powder is prepared from calcium, iron, zinc, vitamin A, vitamin D, folic acid, vitamin B12, vitamin E, vitamin B1, vitamin B2, nicotinamide, biotin, pantothenic acid, vitamin C, lactalbumin, resistant dextrin, water-soluble dietary fiber, oligosaccharide, sugar alcohol, sweetening agent and plant fiber, and each material consists of 0.04-0.08 part of calcium and 0.0008-0.0012 part of iron in parts by weight, in the invention, the soluble dietary fiber forms viscose with glucose after meeting water in gastrointestinal tracts, thereby slowing down the absorption of glucose, reducing the blood cholesterol level, not only being capable of reasonably supplementing the nutrition during pregnancy, but also effectively controlling the rise of blood sugar, thereby achieving the perfect level of supplementing nutrition and sugar control, thereby effectively controlling and stabilizing the blood sugar and ensuring that the pregnant woman can normally give birth and perform an operation.

title_en: Rice machine is irritated to lotus root
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lotus root rice filling machine, which comprises a hopper and a mixer, wherein the hopper is fixed at the top of the mixer, a mixing wheel rotationally connected with the mixer is arranged in the mixer, the mixing wheel is cylindrical, a cylindrical cavity matched with the mixing wheel is arranged in the mixer, a mixing cavity is arranged below the cylindrical cavity, the mixing cavity and the mixing wheel are arranged in parallel, two sides of the mixer are respectively connected with an air conveying pipeline and a connecting pipeline, the air conveying pipeline and the connecting pipeline are in butt joint communication with the mixing cavity, the outer wall of the mixer is also provided with a motor, an output shaft of the motor extends into the mixer and is fixedly connected with a wheel shaft of the mixing wheel, and the outer wall of the mixing wheel is provided with a plurality of sunken holes; this device special design is through mixing wheel automatically mixed raw materials to carry out autoloading by highly-compressed air, improved the downthehole efficiency of irritating rice of lotus root greatly, satisfied the quick production demand of industrialization.

title_en: Application of pectin ECG composition in inhibiting formation of pyridine derivatives in gastrointestinal tract
abstract_en: The application discloses an application of a pectin ECG composition in inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives in the gastrointestinal tract, belonging to the field of health-care food or medicines. The application discovers that the pectin and the ECG can obviously improve the effect of inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives in the gastrointestinal tract after being combined with each other, and the antioxidant capacity of the combination of the pectin and the ECG is obviously stronger than that of the pectin or the ECG alone. The pectin and the ECG or the composition containing the pectin and the ECG can be used for preparing health-care food or medicine for inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives or resisting oxidation or treating and delaying or improving diseases related to the pyridine derivatives, and has wide application prospect in the fields of resisting oxidation, aging, diabetes and the like.

title_en: Method for obtaining interspecific filial generation of dianthus chinensis and dianthus caryophyllus through embryo rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology breeding, and particularly relates to a method for obtaining interspecific filial generation of dianthus chinensis and dianthus caryophyllus by embryo rescue, which specifically comprises the following steps: the female parent is selected from the giant summer pink Dianthus plumarius  L. selecting and using cut flower type carnation (a) as male parent Dianthus caryophyllus L.); artificial pollination is carried out for interspecific hybridization; culturing ovules in vitro; and (4) young embryo culture and seedling transplantation. The invention utilizes the embryo rescue technology to overcome the obstacle that hybrid plants can not be obtained due to abortion of young embryos when the dianthus chinensis and the dianthus caryophyllus are intercrossed, and obtains a large number of hybrid progeny, the hybrid plants inherit the excellent characters of parents, the plants are short and strong, the stress resistance is strong, and the flowers are large, the color is bright, the flower fragrance is rich, and the ornamental value is high. The method can effectively improve the interspecific cross breeding efficiency of the dianthus, and accelerate the breeding process of new species of the dianthus.

title_en: Buckwheat noodles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses buckwheat noodles and a preparation method thereof in the technical field of noodle processing, and the buckwheat noodles comprise the following raw materials in percentage by mass: buckwheat flour, wheat flour and compound additive. The preparation method comprises the following steps: pre-gelatinization: firstly, putting buckwheat flour into a steam stirrer, and stirring while cooking, wherein the gelatinization water accounts for 40-60% and the gelatinization time is 8-15 minutes; mixing: adding the compound additive into the wheat flour in proportion, fully and uniformly mixing, adding the uniformly mixed flour into the gelatinized buckwheat flour in the step one, adding clear water, stirring and uniformly mixing, and then starting kneading; pressing the noodles: pressing the dough kneaded in the step two into dough sheets, and cutting the dough sheets into noodles with the same width; baking: putting the cut noodles into a baking machine for baking; and (3) drying: putting the baked noodles into a drying chamber until the water content of the noodles is 12-14% to obtain the buckwheat noodles. The scheme aims to solve the problem that the existing buckwheat noodles are easy to gelatinize when being boiled in water.

title_en: Selenium nutrition enhancer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selenium nutrition enhancer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a PD culture medium, preparing seeds, preparing an inorganic selenium nutrient solution, soaking, preparing a solid culture medium, culturing, crushing and the like. The invention is prepared by taking the seafood mushroom, the wheat, the corn and the inorganic selenium as raw materials, reduces the production cost of the selenium nutrition enhancer, shortens the production period, improves the yield in unit time, and ensures that the organic selenium content of the final product meets the national selenium nutrition enhancer standard.

title_en: SPEEK/PEG/PVDF gas regulation composite membrane, preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of membrane materials, and discloses a SPEEK/PEG/PVDF gas regulation composite membrane, and preparation and application thereof. The invention takes low-density polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) as a main material, and adds two functions of sulfonated polyether ether ketone (SPEEK) and polyethylene glycol (PEG)And (3) a performance auxiliary material, namely a self-made gas regulation composite membrane. The preparation method of the composite membrane comprises the following steps: stirring and dissolving SPEEK and PEG in DMF, adding PVDF into a blending solution of the SPEEK and the PEG, stirring and dissolving to obtain a membrane casting solution, and preparing the SPEEK/PEG/PVDF gas regulation composite membrane by adopting a solution volatilization method. The invention has simple preparation and easy control of film forming conditions, and the obtained gas separation film has high gas permeability and high CO 2 /O 2 Selectivity, obvious inhibition effect on fruit and vegetable respiration, and can be applied to the field of fruit and vegetable storage and preservation.

title_en: Gene TaPIP2 and 8 for enhancing wheat biological resistance and yield and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gene TaPIP2 for enhancing wheat biological resistance and yield; 8 and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of plant molecular biology and plant genetic engineering. The invention discovers for the first time: aquaporin gene TaPIP2;8, the protein coded by the gene can promote the wheat to activate defense reaction by overexpression in the wheat, and obviously enhance the disease resistance of the wheat to the fusarium graminearum and the resistance of aphids; the photosynthesis of the wheat can be promoted, so that the yield of the wheat grains is increased by about 22%; the invention can be applied to the field production of wheat, and is expected to improve the disease resistance and yield of wheat, thereby achieving the purpose of increasing yield and reducing drug consumption.

title_en: Method for rapidly judging Pu' er tea fermentation degree through pH value
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Pu 'er tea fermentation, and discloses a method for rapidly judging the fermentation degree of Pu' er tea through a pH value, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) fermenting the Pu' er tea raw material inoculated with the microorganisms by using a fermentation tank with a target capacity to obtain a plurality of groups of data of the pH value of the tea, the content of gallic acid and the content of theabrownin; (2) respectively performing linear fitting and combination by using a plurality of groups of theabrownin content-gallic acid content data and gallic acid content-tea pH value data to obtain a linear relation of the theabrownin content along with the change of the tea pH value; (3) aiming at the Pu ' er tea fermentation system to be predicted, the content of theabrownin in the Pu ' er tea fermentation system can be rapidly predicted only according to the measured pH value of the tea, so that the fermentation degree of the Pu ' er tea is judged. The method for rapidly judging the fermentation degree of the Pu 'er tea through the pH value, which is established by the invention, ensures the timeliness of parameter regulation and control in the fermentation process of the Pu' er tea and enables the stable production of products.

title_en: Composite nutritional egg and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pet food, and provides a composite nutritional egg and a preparation method and application thereof; the composite nutritional egg comprises a nutritional mixture and eggs, the mass ratio of the eggs to the nutritional mixture is (8-10): 1, and the nutritional mixture comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of hawthorn extract, 5-10 parts of rhizoma alismatis extract, 10-20 parts of grape seed extract, 5-10 parts of valerian root extract, 10-20 parts of brown algae polysaccharide, 10-20 parts of red yeast rice extract, 20-30 parts of taurine, 10-20 parts of water-soluble pearl powder and 5-10 parts of dragon fruit powder; the compound nutritional egg provided by the invention does not contain any chemical nutritional additive, the all-natural nutritional proportion achieves the functional protection of dogs and cats, and the nutritional proportion provided by each plant extract achieves the effects of promoting the growth of dogs and cats, resisting oxidation, strengthening immunity and resisting respiratory system infection, thereby having good market prospect.

title_en: Throat-moistening paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A throat moistening paste is prepared from principal drug (radix Panacis Quinquefolii, radix Platycodi), ministerial drug, adjuvant drug, and messenger drug; the ministerial drugs are mint, fructus momordicae and liquorice; the adjuvant drug is fragrant solomonseal rhizome. The throat moistening paste has effects of invigorating qi, nourishing yin, relieving sore throat and moistening throat. The method is particularly suitable for people who work in languages, such as teachers, actors, singers and the like.

title_en: Lactobacillus brevis 248 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Lactobacillus brevis 248 and application thereof, wherein the Lactobacillus brevis 248 is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of the Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms with the preservation number of CGMCC No. 23167; the silage treated by the lactobacillus brevis 248 has good aerobic stability, can reduce pH, has good freeze-thaw resistance and acid resistance, can quickly produce acid to realize the effect of low pH, has good adaptability to the environment, improves the silage fermentation quality, and can achieve the effect of storing the silage for a long time; when the silage is stored and opened, the silage treated by the lactobacillus brevis 248 can avoid secondary fermentation.

title_en: Preparation method and preparation device of fresh pepper red oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a preparation device of fresh pepper red oil, and relates to the technical field of biological food. The preparation method of the fresh pepper red oil comprises four steps of raw material preparation, red oil preparation, oil pouring and soaking and filtering, the obtained fresh pepper red oil is red and bright, the vegetable oil is heated at a high temperature, the raw oil taste in the vegetable oil is removed, and the obtained fresh pepper red oil is more fresh, hot and fragrant. This bright chilli oil preparation facilities, including the mounting bracket, mechanism and rabbling mechanism of flavouring, be provided with four group's spliced poles on the mounting bracket, the inside wall fixed mounting of four group's spliced poles has the heating pot, the top of heating pot sets up for the opening, conveniently heat vegetable oil when making bright chilli oil, get rid of raw oil flavor, the processing of flavouring is conveniently carried out to vegetable oil simultaneously, in the in-process of flavouring, can soak spices in vegetable oil completely, it is fast to go into flavor, conveniently salvage spices simultaneously, practice thrift the time of flavouring, and then increase the system efficiency of stewing of bright chilli oil, and the practicality is high.

title_en: Controllable white spirit raw materials of temperature boil cooling integrated device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature-controllable white spirit raw material cooking and cooling integrated device which comprises a box body, wherein a feed hopper is arranged at the top of the box body, a blanking hopper is arranged at the bottom of the box body, a cooking heat-preserving furnace is arranged inside the box body, a temperature detector is arranged inside the cooking heat-preserving furnace, a jacket is arranged outside the box body, a stirring cylinder is arranged on the upper side of the cooking heat-preserving furnace, a stirring shaft is arranged inside the stirring cylinder, the side surface of the stirring shaft is fixedly connected with a mixing rod, a heater is arranged outside the box body, the heater is electrically connected with a heating core rod in the stirring shaft, a blanking pipe is arranged at the bottom of the stirring cylinder, one end of the stirring shaft is connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is connected with a motor through belt transmission, a control switch is arranged on the other side of the box body, and a cooling box is arranged on the lower side of the box body. The invention has compact structure and simple operation, integrates the processes of stirring and mixing raw materials, stewing, preserving heat and cooling, and improves the production and processing efficiency of white spirit.

title_en: Sucrose-free viable bacteria solid yogurt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses sucrose-free live bacteria solid yogurt and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of solid beverages, and relates to yogurt. A sucrose-free viable bacteria solid yogurt comprises the following components in parts by weight: 2-10% of sugar alcohol, 1-5% of prebiotics, 1-5% of whey protein powder, 1-6% of sugar-free soybean milk powder, 0.001-0.004% of leaven and the balance of raw milk. The invention solves the problems of acid feeling and astringent feeling caused by no addition of sucrose, realizes the purposes of low energy consumption and improvement of equipment utilization rate in the drying process, and has stable shape and good taste of the finished product.

title_en: Gel soft sweet rich in pitaya peel procyanidine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jelly soft sweet rich in pitaya peel procyanidine and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The preparation method adopts ultrasonic wave assisted method to extract procyanidine from pitaya peel, and the procyanidine extract of the pitaya peel is prepared after concentration; the gelatin is used as a gel, the xylitol and the sorbitol are used as sweeteners, the citric acid is used as a sour agent, and the pitaya peel procyanidin extract and the marigold lutein extract are added to develop the green and healthy anti-asthenopia soft candy with low calorific value, good nutritional and healthy values, resource waste is reduced, and a new scheme is provided for pitaya resource development.

title_en: Beverage brewing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a beverage brewing apparatus comprising a support assembly, a mixing cup, a tube assembly and a sealing assembly; the supporting component is provided with a mounting groove; the mixing cup is arranged on the supporting component; the pipe assembly comprises a first pipeline and a second pipeline, the first pipeline is connected with the mounting groove, the first end of the second pipeline is connected with the mounting groove, and the second end of the second pipeline is connected with the mixing cup; the sealing assembly seals the mounting groove under the condition that the beverage is injected into the mixing cup through the first pipeline and the second pipeline, so that the beverage cannot flow out when flowing through the mounting groove. When needing to use the auxiliary material to modulate the drink, can place the auxiliary material storage piece in the mounting groove as seal assembly, when need not using the auxiliary material to modulate the drink, can regard as seal assembly the auxiliary material storage piece that does not contain the auxiliary material, also can use all the other structures that can seal the mounting groove to realize the sealing to the mounting groove.

title_en: Bio-based fresh-keeping packaging film material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based fresh-keeping packaging film material, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, through the simple and efficient low-eutectic system mediated biomass full-component synchronous dissolution and esterification modification, the solubility and film forming property of the biomass full-component are improved, and the full-component direct conversion and utilization are realized; and the polymer is used for reinforcement and plasticizer plasticization, so that the film strength and toughness are improved, a novel green and environment-friendly bio-based film is developed, excellent antibacterial property, oxidation resistance and ultraviolet resistance are shown, and the fresh-keeping packaging period of fresh-cut fruits and vegetables can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Silkworm pupa protein modification method based on restriction enzyme-catalyzed decoupling glycosylation reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silkworm pupa protein modification method based on a restriction enzyme decoupling glycosylation reaction, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting silkworm pupa protein by an alkaline method, then utilizing alkaline protease to carry out restriction enzyme hydrolysis on the silkworm pupa protein extracted by the alkaline method for 10-30min, adding xylose, carrying out enzyme deactivation treatment in boiling water bath, simultaneously inducing the protein to carry out Maillard reaction, carrying out ice bath quick cooling after the reaction is finished, obtaining the modified silkworm pupa protein, analyzing and determining the structural characteristics and the functional properties of the modified silkworm pupa protein, and proving that the decoupling glycosylation reaction can improve the functional properties, the allergenicity and the bad smell of the silkworm pupa protein, and is beneficial to wider application in the food industry.

title_en: Beet pulp full-component emulsifying thickener and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a beet pulp full-component emulsifying thickener, a preparation method and application thereof; the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly cleaning beet pulp, crushing and preprocessing; dispersing beet pulp powder after cleaning and crushing pretreatment in water, and placing the water in a high-pressure reaction kettle to control the temperature to be 110-140 ℃ for hydrothermal treatment for 0.5-4 h; diluting with water, stirring, and performing high-energy ultrasonic crushing treatment; concentrating and drying to obtain the beet pulp full-component emulsifying thickener. The whole process does not need acid-base strong oxidant or enzyme, and is green and environment-friendly; the nanofiber yarn can play a role in synergistic emulsification with beet pectin, and can be adsorbed to an oil-water interface together to form a compact netlike interface film, so that the film has a stronger steric hindrance barrier effect, the problem of poor emulsion stability of beet pectin is solved, and the full-component utilization of beet pulp is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of oligopeptide capable of improving defecation function of pet dogs and cats
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of oligopeptide for improving defecation function of pet dogs and cats, relates to the field of preparation of active peptides, and particularly relates to a method for preparing wheat oligopeptide containing homocysteine and oxides thereof by carrying out prehydrolysis on wheat gluten, oxidizing and breaking protein disulfide bonds by using amylase, glucose oxidase and ultrasonic cavitation and continuing proper enzymolysis. The invention overcomes the defect that gluten powder is easy to adhere to form a cluster when being stirred in water, effectively opens a disulfide bond with firm protein, has low hydrolysis degree of the obtained wheat oligopeptide and high cysteine content, can effectively improve the gastrointestinal condition of pet dogs and cats, and reduces the problems of non-pathological diarrhea, soft stool and the like caused by the change of feeding areas or daily ration of the pet dogs and cats.

title_en: Liquid intermittent immersion cultivation method for potato tissue culture seedlings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid intermittent immersion culture method for potato tissue culture seedlings, which comprises the steps of cutting off single sections of the potato tissue culture seedlings and transferring the potato tissue culture seedlings into a culture medium, wherein the intermittent immersion frequency of a nutrient solution is 3-4 times per day, immersion is carried out for 5-10 min every time, the temperature is 24 +/-1 ℃, the illuminance is set to 2000lx, the illumination time is 16 h/d-18 h/d, and the potato tissue culture seedlings are obtained after 30 days of culture. The invention can obviously improve the plant height, stem thickness, effective stem node number and root number of the potato tissue culture seedling and simultaneously improve the use efficiency of the nutrient solution; in addition, the method is simple to operate and suitable for industrial production of potatoes.

title_en: Breast milk structured fat simulating triglyceride composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breast milk structured fat with simulated triglyceride composition and a preparation method thereof, wherein the similarity of the breast milk structured fat with simulated triglyceride composition and breast milk is more than 90%, the content of glycidyl ester is less than 0.3mg/kg, the content of chloropropanol ester is less than 0.5mg/kg, and the content of trans-fatty acid is less than 0.3g/100g. The finished product prepared by the invention is highly similar to breast milk in composition, and meets the requirements of national food safety standard GB 30604-2015.

title_en: Method for preparing qi-yang-deficiency-tonifying and health-preserving capsule food by extracting high-quality protein from blood-flesh poultry animals and Chinese herbal medicines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing qi-yang deficiency health-care capsule food by selecting blood meat poultry animals to extract high-quality protein and Chinese herbal medicines. The method comprises the following steps: (1) sequentially adding the minced blood-meat poultry and water into an extraction container, heating and extracting, opening a condensation valve when the temperature of the extract liquid reaches 105 ℃ until the surface liquid is distilled, and filtering to obtain filtrate for later use; (2) adding adjuvants into the filtrate, and stirring to obtain high quality protein nutrient solution extracted from blood meat poultry animal; (3) and (3) adding the Chinese herbal medicine compound functional powder into the nutrient solution obtained in the step (2), uniformly stirring, and collecting after spray drying to obtain the qi and yang deficiency health-care capsule food. The capsule food produced by the preparation method provided by the invention can better extract and retain nutritional ingredients, particularly aims at sub-health of deficiency of qi and yang and the constitution of people needing to be well-maintained, has the functions of tonifying qi, warming yang, tonifying kidney, controlling nocturnal emission, promoting blood circulation, soothing nerves and enhancing the immunity of human bodies, and has a health-care effect.

title_en: Method for enhancing plant resistance to variable light intensity stress
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for enhancing the resistance of plants to variable light intensity stress. The invention researches and discloses a pair of novel acetylated proteins Pat (coded by slr 1888)/deacetylated proteins Dac (coded by slr0245) for the first time, can adjust the light energy utilization or biomass traits of plants, and performs appropriate artificial regulation on the plants, thereby being beneficial to promoting the plants to resist high light stress, improving the photosynthesis efficiency and improving the biomass. The novel protein of the invention has important practical significance for genetic improvement of plant traits.

title_en: Red yeast rice and Chinese yam beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a red yeast rice and Chinese yam beverage and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The red yeast yam beverage is prepared by the steps of raw material pretreatment, sterilization, inoculation, fermentation, enzyme deactivation, sterilization, blending and the like. The monascus yam disclosed by the invention contains the nutritional ingredients in the yam and the monascus pigment which is a beneficial secondary metabolite of monascus, and the beneficial ingredients have important physiological activities of resisting cancer, resisting oxidation, reducing blood fat, resisting bacteria and diminishing inflammation and the like. The method has the advantages of simple operation, safety, reliability and high added value of products, has the health care effect of monascus while giving consideration to the nutrition of the Chinese yam, and provides a new method for deep processing and utilization of the Chinese yam and variety development of Chinese yam fermented drinks.

title_en: Apple non-integration system four-group sports planting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-group sports method of an apple apomixis system, which comprises the steps of selecting apomixis base materials of wild natural groups and sequencing genomes; mutagenesis is carried out to create a base material mutant library, and excellent character strains are selected as mutagenesis progeny groups; collecting various source pollen; the flowering time is prolonged; collecting seeds and sowing; carrying out chromosome ploidy identification on the target character seedlings; performing homologous comparison with a wild type after re-sequencing; selecting a strain with complete replacement of the genome or ploidy increase and target characters as a filial generation population; by utilizing the apomixis characteristic, offspring with high apomixis capacity is selected from the mutagenic offspring population and the filial offspring population as an excellent stable population. Based on the facultative apomixis characteristic of the apples, the diversified allopolyploid apples are quickly created and identified by utilizing various source pollen pollination, flow cytometry and genome re-sequencing, and the method greatly enriches the breeding approaches of the apple polyploids.

title_en: Mulberry leaf source protein compound feed based on multiple fermentation of composite flora and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mulberry leaf source protein compound feed based on multiple fermentation of composite flora and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microbial fermentation and aquatic feeds. The compound feed comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-40 parts of fish meal, 20-30 parts of meat and bone meal, 5-10 parts of fermented mulberry leaf source protein, 5-10 parts of blood meal, 10-15 parts of alpha-starch, 2-5 parts of vinasse, and CaH  2  PO  4  1-3 parts of vitamin premix, 0.1-0.5 part of vitamin premix, 0.5-2 parts of mineral premix, 2-7 parts of soybean meal and 0.5-1 part of fish oil. According to the invention, the mulberry leaves are fermented by adopting various complex floras, and the fermentation product is added into the feed formula of the Chinese soft-shelled turtle as a protein source, so that the weight gain and the survival rate of the Chinese soft-shelled turtle are effectively improved, the immunity of the Chinese soft-shelled turtle is improved, and the feed is low in cost and has good practical popularization and application values.

title_en: Multi-effect nutritional pill and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional nutritional pill and a preparation method thereof, wherein the multifunctional nutritional pill is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 3-5 parts of mulberry distilled liquid, 3-5 parts of rhizoma sparganii tea, 7-10 parts of dendrobium officinale, 7-10 parts of black sesame powder, 3-5 parts of turmeric powder, 5-10 parts of poria cocos powder, 5-10 parts of spina date seed powder, 7-10 parts of radix puerariae powder, 10-15 parts of selenium-rich malt powder, 5-10 parts of lily, 5-7 parts of honey and 3-5 parts of probiotics. The multifunctional nutritive pill disclosed by the invention is prepared from pure traditional Chinese medicines, keeps natural active ingredients, does not contain artificial pigments, stimulants, hormones and preservatives, has the effects of regulating gastrointestinal functions, improving sleep, delaying senescence, resisting fatigue, improving human immunity, regulating blood pressure, blood sugar, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular functions, nourishing cells, repairing cells and inhibiting cancer cells, and brings better application prospects.

title_en: Kiwi fruit preservative and preparation and application methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fruit and vegetable preservation, and particularly relates to a kiwi fruit preservative and a preparation and application method thereof. The preservative for spraying before picking kiwi fruits provided by the invention comprises active components of an N-alpha-lauroyl-L-arginine ethyl ester hydrochloride LAE solution and a potassium sorbate solution; the mass fraction of the N-alpha-lauroyl-L-arginine ethyl ester hydrochloride in the solution of the N-alpha-lauroyl-L-arginine ethyl ester hydrochloride LAE is 0.01 to 0.06 percent; the mass fraction of potassium sorbate in the potassium sorbate solution is 0.2%; the solvent in the solution of the N-alpha-lauroyl-L-arginine ethyl ester hydrochloride LAE is ethanol and water. The kiwi fruit preservative disclosed by the invention is used for carrying out pre-picking treatment on kiwi fruits, so that the edible safety of the kiwi fruits is improved, and the decline of the sensory quality and the nutritional quality of the kiwi fruits is slowed down, so that the shelf life is prolonged.

title_en: Laying hen feed prepared from carrot byproducts by composite microorganism fermentation and production method of laying hen feed
abstract_en: The application provides a laying hen feed for fermenting carrot byproducts by composite microorganisms and a production method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the biological fermentation laying hen feed provided by the application has the advantages of simple and easily obtained raw materials, simple preparation and convenient use, can obviously enhance the immunity of organisms, improve the productivity of laying hens and improve the reproduction function. The feed raw material for the laying hens has a natural coloring effect, can improve the quality of eggs, promote the enrichment of astaxanthin in yolk, strengthen the nutrition of eggs and improve the nutritive value of products.

title_en: PEF cooking appliance and method for applying PEF pulses
abstract_en: A PEF cooking appliance (1) having: a food container (2) having two PEF electrodes (3 a, 3 b) spaced apart from each other, between which a food product (G) can be filled; a power factor correction filter connectable to a supply voltage; -energy storage means (6) connected to said power factor correction filter (5); and two pulse shaping devices (7 a, 7 b) connected to the energy storage device, wherein a first pulse shaping device (7 a) is connected to the first PEF electrode (7 a) and a second pulse shaping device is connected to the second PEF electrode (7 b), wherein the power factor correction filter is designed to generate a pulse voltage of more than 600V. A method for applying PEF pulses to PEF electrodes of a PEF cooking appliance, which are arranged spaced apart from one another in a food product container (2), wherein a supply voltage is converted up to a pulse voltage by means of a power factor correction filter; charging an energy storage means by means of said pulsed voltage; converting the pulsed voltage provided by the energy storage device into PEF pulses at a level exceeding 600V; and applying the PEF pulse to the PEF electrode. The invention can be advantageously applied in particular to household PEF cooking appliances.

title_en: Active polypeptide, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of product for relieving and/or treating liver injury
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses a preparation method of an active polypeptide, which comprises the following steps: s11, taking fresh animal bone marrow, adding water, and uniformly stirring to obtain a bone marrow mixed solution; s12, adding protease into the bone marrow mixed liquor for enzymolysis, inactivating the protease after the enzymolysis is finished, and filtering to remove precipitates to obtain an enzymolysis liquid; s13, dialyzing the enzymatic hydrolysate by using a first dialysis bag to obtain first dialysate and first cut-off liquid; s14, dialyzing the first dialysate by using a second dialysis bag to obtain a second dialysate and a second trapped fluid; and concentrating and drying the second trapped fluid to obtain the active polypeptide. The active polypeptide of the composition and tremella polysaccharide. Research shows that the active polypeptide and the composition have excellent effect of treating liver injury; therefore, the compound has important application value as an effective component for developing functional food, dietary supplement or medicament for relieving and/or treating liver injury.

title_en: Method for tissue culture and rapid propagation of cinnamomum burmannii
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for tissue culture and rapid propagation of cinnamomum burmannii, and belongs to the technical field of plant biology. The invention focuses on the technical problems of high contamination rate of explants, low efficiency of cluster bud induction and propagation expansion, difficult rooting and the like in the process of yin-fragrant tissue culture, and establishes a high-efficiency sterile culture technical scheme with low contamination rate by taking yin-fragrant stem segments with axillary buds as explants and performing pretreatment, mercury-free surface disinfection and primary generation antibacterial culture; the method adopts a unique improved culture medium, combines the application of a novel cytokinin plant growth regulator and a low-concentration auxin, effectively realizes the induction and the amplification propagation of cluster buds and the generation of adventitious roots, and then obtains the healthy and growing yin-fragrant regeneration plant through transplantation and domestication. The invention establishes an efficient breeding technical system of yin-fragrant tissue culture seedlings, can be used for large-scale production of yin-fragrant excellent germplasm tissue culture seedlings, and is beneficial to the development of the natural borneol industry in China.

title_en: Chewable raspberry tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a raspberry chewable tablet and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of food processing. The invention utilizes raspberry powder obtained by vacuum freeze drying, selects mannitol as a sweetening agent, lactose, maltodextrin and microcrystalline cellulose as fillers, and magnesium stearate as a lubricant, and adopts a direct tabletting method to carry out tabletting, thereby optimizing the process from chewable tablet hardness, friability, tablet weight difference and sensory evaluation. The raspberry chewable tablet prepared by the invention has good taste, moderate sour and sweet taste, unique flavor of the raspberry, smooth surface and luster. The process is simple and easy to operate, is suitable for industrial production, and has good development prospect and application value.

title_en: Probiotic drink with good sleep aiding effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of probiotic beverages, in particular to a probiotic beverage with good sleep aiding effect, which comprises the following steps: selecting apples with good appearance, cleaning the apples, then using a juicing device to remove kernels, and making the apples into apple juice; weighing the apple juice obtained in the step S1 according to the formula amount, pouring the apple juice into a fermentation tank, inoculating strains, and fermenting for 4-5 hours to obtain the probiotic drink; filling the probiotic drink obtained in the step S2 into a bottle with the specification of 10 g/bottle, and then packaging the probiotic drink into a box according to 10 bottles; by arranging the juicing equipment, the apple cores are removed firstly, so that the influence of hard seeds in the apple cores on the quality of the probiotic drink is avoided; by taking apple juice, lactobacillus plantarum, bacillus coagulans and the like as raw materials, the probiotic drink can nourish blood and calm nerves and has good sleep aiding effect.

title_en: Streptococcus thermophilus S869 and application thereof in regulating immunity and intestinal function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, and provides Streptococcus thermophilus (Streptococcus thermophilus) S869 which is deposited in the China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.24190. Through the technical scheme, the problems that the difference of the immunity of live bacteria and killed bacteria in the existing strain is large, and the existing strain cannot simultaneously have good functions of regulating the immunity of an organism and regulating the intestinal function are solved.

title_en: UV treatment of transformed beetle larvae for vitamin D3 enrichment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing beetle powder, comprising a light treatment step in which at least one light source emits ultraviolet radiation towards transformed beetle larvae.

title_en: Method for making diet fried eggs and frying device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for making diet fried eggs and a frying device thereof, wherein the frying device comprises a stabilizing frame, a frying pan and a linear motor I, wherein the end of the stabilizing frame is provided with a swinging frying mechanism, the lower end of the swinging frying mechanism is provided with a self-cleaning mechanism, the self-cleaning mechanism comprises a frying rod, a frying part and a cleaning part, a hollow rod swings to drive the frying rod to move, the cleaning part comprises a scraping plate, the cleaning part drives the scraping plate to slide relative to the frying rod, and the scraping plate moves to change the angle between the frying rod and the scraping plate; the preparation method of the diet fried egg comprises the steps of firstly, proportioning raw materials; step two, solution preparation; step three, integral manufacturing, the invention has the beneficial effects that; can clear up the system stick of frying automatically through the effect from clearance mechanism, avoid artifical clearance, save the clearing time by a wide margin, realize automatic clear while, fry the system messenger and still can compress the processing to egg liquid, promote the formation of egg group.

title_en: Weilong bone-strengthening wine for treating rheumatic bone diseases and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicines, and in particular relates to Weilong bone strengthening wine for treating rheumatic bone diseases and a preparation method thereof. The preparation raw materials of the Weilong bone-strengthening wine comprise the following components in parts by weight: 100-120 parts of sialon bone, 10-20 parts of papaya, 10-15 parts of kadsura pepper stem, 10-15 parts of radix angelicae, 10-20 parts of angelica sinensis, 5-8 parts of ginseng, 5-8 parts of ligusticum wallichii and 600-700 parts of highland barley wine. The invention adopts the steps of co-fermenting the saccharomyces cerevisiae and the probiotics in the preparation process of the highland barley wine and adding the co-fermenting step of the saccharomyces cerevisiae and the probiotics and the enzymolysis step in the preparation process of the Wilkswagen bone strengthening wine, thereby accelerating the dissolution of effective substances and improving the drug effect. The Weilong bone-strengthening wine has the effects of dispelling wind, promoting blood circulation, strengthening bones and tendons, and can be used for treating arthralgia and myalgia, limb joint swelling, numbness of limbs and soreness of waist and knees caused by wind-cold-dampness arthralgia.

title_en: Combined use of a plant based drink with improved phytase and PAD
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of food. The present invention provides a method for obtaining improved properties of a beverage comprising plant protein, the method comprising incubating a solution comprising plant protein with a phytase and a Peptidyl Arginine Deiminase (PAD), and optionally processing the phytase and PAD treated solution into a beverage comprising plant protein, wherein the plant protein is pea protein or broad bean protein.

title_en: Complex enzyme preparation for improving utilization rate of sunflower seed meal and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound enzyme preparation for degrading anti-nutritional factors in sunflower seed meal, belonging to the field of enzyme preparation application. The complex enzyme preparation comprises phytase, neutral protease, xylanase and cellulase, wherein the enzyme activity ratio is 1:25:30:80. the invention adopts phytase, neutral proteinase, xylanase and cellulase for compounding, and is used for degrading anti-nutritional factors such as phytic acid, proteinase inhibitor, non-starch polysaccharide and the like in sunflower seed meal, reducing the content of crude fiber and improving the digestion utilization rate of the sunflower seed meal.

title_en: Preparation method of natural roxburgh rose extract
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural roxburgh rose extracts, in particular to a preparation method of a natural roxburgh rose extract, which comprises the following steps: a. breaking cell walls and homogenizing: removing the preserved sepals and dense acupuncture points on the roxburgh rose fruit, cleaning with purified water, separating the seeds to obtain roxburgh rose pulp, and adding pure water to the roxburgh rose pulp to break the wall and homogenize; b. clarification and impurity removal: continuously centrifuging the fruit pulp to remove coarse residues, standing the centrifugate, refrigerating at low temperature, and filtering at low temperature to obtain clear fruit juice solution; c. and (3) concentrating: concentrating the clear juice solution to obtain a concentrated solution; d. and (3) drying: spray drying or freeze drying the concentrated solution to obtain powder, and packaging. The preparation method adopted by the invention has the advantages of high extraction speed of the nutrient components of the roxburgh rose, high efficiency, low energy consumption, environmental protection, no pollution, maximum reservation of the effective components and the flavor, and suitability for mass production; the prepared roxburgh rose extract has stable quality and is easy to store, thereby solving the problem that seasonal fresh fruits are difficult to store.

title_en: Carotenoid-loaded alginic acid derivative micelle, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alginic acid derivative micelle, and particularly relates to a carotenoid-loaded alginic acid derivative micelle, and a preparation method and application thereof. The alginic acid derivative micelle loaded with the carotenoid disclosed by the invention takes algal polysaccharide as a raw material, constructs the self-assembled nano micelle of the alginic acid derivative capable of coating or loading the carotenoid through Schiff base-reductive amination reaction, effectively improves the solubility, stability and oral absorption rate of hydrophobic carotenoid, and fully exerts the application effect of the hydrophobic carotenoid in functional food. The alginic acid derivative micelle prepared by the invention has good stability, the particle size can be controlled within the range of 20 to 200nm, the alginic acid derivative micelle has good penetration capacity, can circularly release functional factors for a long time to exert the effect for a long time, and has great application value in the fields of functional food, biomedicine and the like.

title_en: Vinegar fumigating grain making equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses vinegar fumigating and preparing equipment, which comprises a tank body, wherein a fumigating chamber is arranged in the tank body, two electric heating plates are arranged at the inner bottom of the fumigating chamber, a mounting box is arranged at the lower end of the tank body, a driving motor is arranged in the mounting box, the tail end of an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating rod, and the upper end of the first rotating rod extends into the fumigating chamber; the left and right sides of the tank body are provided with circulating components. This equipment is through pushing the setting of subassembly and circulation subassembly, can carry the partial vinegar unstrained spirits of bottom to can avoid bottom vinegar unstrained spirits long-time heating to appear few burnt condition to appear, utilize simultaneously turn the subassembly and can further change the vinegar unstrained spirits of bottom and other positions, further avoid the condition that bottom vinegar unstrained spirits burnt to appear, make edible vinegar can carry out even smoked unstrained spirits and handle, utilize the hot gas flow to accelerate the rectangular plate intensification simultaneously, make inside vinegar unstrained spirits also can the quick contact heat.

title_en: Coarse cereal pearl rice ball and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses coarse cereal pearl ball and a preparation method thereof, wherein the pearl ball comprises the following components in parts by weight: 3.25 to 16.25 portions of coarse cereal powder, 3.25 to 16.25 portions of inulin, 65 to 75 portions of cassava starch, 20 to 30 portions of brown sugar and 1550 to 1880 portions of water. The invention takes coarse cereal powder, inulin and cassava starch as main raw materials and brown sugar as an auxiliary material to prepare the pearl balls, thereby achieving the purpose of nutrition supplement, increasing the nutritive value and health care effect of the pearl balls, improving the oxidation resistance of the pearl balls, simultaneously keeping excellent taste and prolonging the storage period of the pearl balls.

title_en: Salicornia bigelovii extract and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a salicornia extract and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: collecting fresh Salicornia bigelovii, cleaning, airing, drying, crushing and sieving to obtain Salicornia bigelovii powder; leaching with 61vt.% ethanol three times, the first pH being 2.0, the feed to liquid ratio being 1g:20mL; taking filter residues for the second time, wherein the pH value is 7.5, and the feed-liquid ratio is 1g:15mL; taking filter residues for the third time, wherein the pH value is 8.3, and the feed-liquid ratio is 1g:10mL; and combining all the filtrates, decoloring, filtering, concentrating, and freeze-drying to obtain the Salicornia bigelovii extract. The preparation method adopts a semi-bionic technology, is simple and easy to implement, has low production cost, and the prepared extract has the effect of regulating intestinal flora, has potential lipid-lowering and weight-losing effects, can be used as a novel prebiotic for improving or regulating related medicaments or food additives for treating diseases such as hyperlipidemia, hypertension and the like caused by intestinal flora disorder, and has wide development prospect.

title_en: Heat sterilized packaged beverage containing medium chain fatty acid triglyceride and ascorbic acid
abstract_en: The packaged beverage which has been heat sterilized and in which the amount of ascorbic acid is 6mg/100ml or more and the ratio of the amount of ascorbic acid to the amount of medium chain fatty acid triglyceride (ascorbic acid/medium chain fatty acid triglyceride) is 0.0003 to 0.1340 contains 1mg/100ml or more of catechins (total amount of catechin, catechin gallate, epicatechin gallate, gallocatechin gallate, epigallocatechin and epigallocatechin gallate). This reduces the unpleasant odor of the degraded rice bran which is generally generated when the heat sterilized packaged beverage containing ascorbic acid and medium-chain fatty acid triglyceride in the above-described range is stored.

title_en: Abalone compound feed for enhancing immunity and improving intestinal flora and application thereof
abstract_en: An abalone compound feed for enhancing immunity and improving intestinal flora and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of aquatic feeds. The compound feed for abalone comprises: fish meal, gluten powder, soybean meal, high gluten flour, kelp powder, an adhesive, soybean lecithin, calcium dihydrogen phosphate, choline chloride, compound vitamins, compound mineral substances, sodium alginate and curcumin. The compound feed is applied to abalone culture, can stimulate the cellular immune response of abalones infected by Vibrio harveyi, and reduce the mortality rate of Vibrio harveyi infection; promote the growth of abalone and the growth and proliferation of beneficial intestinal flora, reduce the feed waste and reduce the feed coefficient; improving the activity of abalone serum and liver antioxidant enzyme, reducing the generation of lipid peroxidation products and protecting the liver health. Curcumin is a pure natural polyphenol compound, has the potential of continuously replacing antibiotics, reduces the possibility of bacterial drug resistance, drug residue and intestinal flora imbalance caused by using antibiotics and chemical drugs, and is beneficial to the growth and survival of the abalone.

title_en: Lactobacillus acidophilus fermented broadleaf holly leaf and fermentation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides lactobacillus acidophilus fermented broadleaf holly tea, which is prepared by fermenting yuqing lobular broadleaf holly tea by lactobacillus acidophilus, and the adopted fermentation process comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing a culture medium; 2) Culturing the first-level strain of lactobacillus acidophilus to obtain a second-generation seed suspension; 3) Inoculating the second-generation seed suspension for fermentation, wherein the dosage ratio of the broadleaf holly leaf to the pure water to the lactobacillus acidophilus suspension is 45-55g. 4) And (5) drying. The invention belongs to the technical field of tea fermentation, and provides lactobacillus acidophilus fermented broadleaf holly leaf which has double physiological effects of lactobacillus acidophilus and lobular broadleaf, can effectively improve the content of active ingredients, improves the taste of the broadleaf holly leaf, and is easy to brew and absorb by a human body.

title_en: Sticky composition, food composition, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a sticky composition, a food composition, a preparation method and an application thereof, and relates to the technical field of food formulas. The adhesive composition comprises: (A) Less than about 38% by weight of oil based on the dry weight of the tacky composition; and; (B) Solids homogeneously dispersed in the oil, the solids comprising edible protein, wherein the solids in the adhesive composition have an average particle size in the range of about 25 μm to 500 μm. The sticky composition and the substance to be sticky can be combined to prepare a food composition, the food composition can be used as food such as meal replacement bars, protein bars and energy bars, the mouth feel of the food such as crispness, tooth-sticking resistance and hardening resistance is improved, the addition amount of oil is reduced, and the food composition has extremely high market potential and application prospect.

title_en: Application of modified pectin emulsion as colon-targeted delivery functional carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of modified pectin emulsion as a colon-targeted transmission functional carrier, and belongs to the technical field of functional carrier application. The modified pectin emulsion is methyl esterified citrus pectin UHMP emulsion, does not contain protein, is insensitive to pepsin, can be stable in stomach, and smoothly enters small intestine and colon, has good stability and lower in-vitro digestion fat decomposition rate in stomach and small intestine simulation liquid, and can targetedly transport functional substances to colon parts; has wide application in food, medicine and other industries, and expands the inherent application range of pectin.

title_en: Fermentation process of lime traditional Chinese medicine health-care vinegar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lime traditional Chinese medicine health-care vinegar fermentation process which comprises six steps of material selection, rice vinegar fermentation, vinegar extract preparation, traditional Chinese medicine liquid preparation and finished product preparation, wherein the material selection comprises 1-3 parts of fresh lime, 20-30 parts of glutinous rice, 1-2 parts of distiller's yeast, 4-6 parts of yeast, 1-3 parts of honeysuckle, 1-6 parts of schisandra chinensis, 1-2 parts of kudzu roots, 1-2 parts of saussurea involucrate, 10-20 parts of absolute ethyl alcohol, 6-10 parts of rock candy, 6-9 parts of table salt and 100-200 parts of clear water. The traditional Chinese medicine liquid processed by rice vinegar is combined with the rice vinegar extract, so that the obtained compound vinegar has pharmacological effects of resisting inflammation, enhancing immunity, resisting bacteria and the like, is rich in various nutritional ingredients such as amino acid, trace elements and the like, and the lime, the honeysuckle, the schisandra chinensis, the kudzuvine root and the snow lotus are scientifically compounded.

title_en: Pickled preserved szechuan pickle manufacturing method and processing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing pickled mustard tuber and a processing device, and relates to the technical field of pickled mustard tuber pickling. According to the invention, the output end of the servo motor rotates, so that the hot pickled mustard tuber on the upper surface of the filter cloth can be driven to move upwards, the upper end of the hot pickled mustard tuber is contacted with the lower surface of the barrel cover, the barrel cover presses the hot pickled mustard tuber, the water of the hot pickled mustard tuber is slowly extruded, the extruded water flows out from the liquid outlet, and the device can mix the stirring and the drying water, so that the convenience of the device is improved, and the manufacturing speed of the hot pickled mustard tuber is accelerated.

title_en: Oil tea cake preparation facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil-tea camellia cake production equipment, in particular to an oil-tea camellia cake preparation device which can effectively reduce the labor intensity of workers, enables oil-tea camellia cakes to be taken and placed more conveniently, effectively improves the working efficiency and reduces the use limitation; including the electric heat stoving case, the upset motor, the drive shaft, the butt joint board, the case lid, a tray, two sets of slats of connecting, left side baffle and right baffle, electric heat stoving case left end is equipped with gets and puts the mouth, electric heat stoving bottom of the case portion is equipped with adjustment mechanism, the fixed two sets of fixed plates that are equipped with in electric heat stoving case top left side, limiting plate slidable mounting is on two sets of slide rails, the fixed of symmetry is equipped with two sets of articulated seats down around on the tray, the fixed of symmetry is equipped with articulated seat on two sets of on around on the case lid, the both ends of two sets of slats of connecting are all fixed and are equipped with the spindle nose, the both ends of two sets of slats of connecting are passed through the spindle nose and are articulated seat under with two sets of on articulated seat on with two sets of respectively, the fixed mounting of left side baffle and right baffle left and right side symmetry is on the tray.

title_en: Method and device for separating and collecting anthers of oil tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for separating and collecting anthers of camellia oleifera, and particularly relates to a method and a device for separating and collecting the anthers of the comb-shaped camellia oleifera. A camellia oleifera anther separation and collection device comprises a tooth comb separation mechanism, an electric telescopic mechanism, an anther conveying mechanism and a filtering and collection mechanism. The method and the device for separating and collecting the camellia anther have the characteristics of high separation and collection efficiency, low flower damage rate and large pollen collection amount, can effectively improve the pollen collection amount, and is favorable for regulating and controlling the anther cracking time to ensure the activity of pollen, thereby improving the pollination rate of crops and realizing the purpose of improving the crop yield. The device has simple structure, small size and convenient carrying.

title_en: Preparation method of black tea beverage for improving darkness of tea soup and black tea beverage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black tea beverage preparation method for improving darkness of tea soup, and a black tea beverage, wherein the black tea beverage preparation method comprises the following steps: leaching and primary filtering of tea leaves: leaching black tea, and filtering to obtain tea soup; cooling the tea soup; centrifuging the tea soup; adding Vc with the mass fraction of 0.1-0.6 per mill into the centrifuged tea soup to obtain tea soup regulating solution; membrane filtration: filtering the tea soup regulating liquid by a filtering membrane; blending; the black tea beverage is obtained by sterilizing and filling, the preparation method is adopted to effectively reduce the water-soluble impermeable high polymer substances of theabrownin, greatly improve the soup color of the finished tea beverage product and the color of the tea concentrate, ensure the flavor of the tea beverage, and the whole preparation method is green and environment-friendly without adding chemical reagents and has low cost.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine distiller's yeast, preparation method and application thereof, and yellow wine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wine brewing, and discloses traditional Chinese medicine distiller's yeast, a preparation method and application thereof, and yellow wine. According to the application, five traditional Chinese medicines of verbena, white paeony root, lophatherum gracile, black nightshade and Chinese angelica are selected as raw materials of the medicinal starter, and are combined with rice to make the starter together, so that the yeast beta-glucan with various physiological functions can be obtained when the yeast beta-glucan is used for brewing yellow wine, and the yeast beta-glucan contains rich amino acid, polyphenol, polysaccharide, isomaltooligosaccharide, isomaltotriose, magnesium, zinc and other nutrient substances, and has a health-care effect on the basis of the flavor of the yellow wine, so that a new trend is provided for the yellow wine brewing process.

title_en: Brown rice plant protein beverage with cocoa flavor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food, in particular to a brown rice plant protein beverage with cocoa flavor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise 10 to 12 percent of brown rice powder, 2.0 to 3.0 percent of vegetable oil, 2.0 to 3.0 percent of erythritol, 1.0 to 2.0 percent of pea protein, 0.9 to 1.2 percent of cocoa powder, 0.05 to 0.07 percent of dipotassium hydrogen phosphate, 0.06 to 0.08 percent of tricalcium phosphate, 0.026 to 0.03 percent of gellan gum, 0.08 to 0.10 percent of mono-diglycerol fatty acid ester, 0.04 to 0.06 percent of sucrose fatty acid ester, 0.03 to 0.04 percent of alpha-amylase and 0.08 to 0.1 percent of glucoamylase, the weight percentage is up to 100 percent by water; the preparation method comprises mixing part of alpha-amylase, water and brown rice powder, gelatinizing, adding the rest alpha-amylase and glucoamylase, and performing enzymolysis; mixing cocoa powder and water simultaneously; mixing the two mixtures with the rest materials, homogenizing, cooling, and standardizing. The invention solves the problems that most of protein in the brown rice is water-insoluble protein and is rich in insoluble dietary fiber and the product has heavier powder feeling due to the addition of cocoa powder; also solves the problem of suspension stability of the cocoa powder in the brown rice hydrolysis solution.

title_en: Smooth boiling-resistant nutritional rice noodles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rice noodle production, and discloses a preparation method of smooth and boiling-resistant nutritional rice noodles, which comprises the following steps: removing impurities from 200-250 parts of rice by a winnowing machine, then putting 200-250 parts of the rice after impurity removal into a water tank for washing, then soaking 200-250 parts of the rice for 30min (soaking for 50min in winter) until the water content of 200-250 parts of the rice is 30% -34%, fishing the rice into a bamboo basket, standing for 1-2 h, putting the rice after standing into a crusher for crushing into rice flour, and then sieving through a sieve with 60-80 meshes. The smooth and boiling-resistant nutritional rice noodle and its preparation method, by adding starch, the produced rice noodle has reduced breakage rate, white and smooth texture, good transparency, and improved elasticity, chewiness and biting force, the rice noodle has the advantages that the puffing degree of the rice noodle is increased in the cooking process, the taste of the rice noodle is improved, the rice noodle is soft and soft, the rice noodle is not easy to age and break, the whiteness of the rice noodle is improved, and the surface of the rice noodle is smoother.

title_en: Cactus fresh squeezing process and equipment thereof
abstract_en: A cactus fresh squeezing process and equipment thereof belong to the technical field of squeezing equipment and aim to solve the problems that flying is caused when fine thorns on the outer wall of a worker are removed by rubbing with cloth after the worker picks the cactus, and the flying fine thorns are easy to attach to the skin of the worker to be injured; the method comprises the following steps: s1: processing raw materials, namely washing collected cactus; s2: removing thorns, holding the short stick to make the gelatin colloid roll on the outer walls of the two surfaces of the cactus to adhere to the outer walls of the two surfaces of the cactus to remove the thorns; s3: crushing, namely putting the cactus with the thorns removed into crushing equipment for crushing; s4: juicing, namely putting the broken cactus fragments into juicing equipment for juicing; s5: treating tailings, namely putting gelatin colloid adhered with the cactus spines into water for hydrolysis to form a solution, recovering by using low-temperature gel, and fishing out the spines on the suspended water surface; the problem that the flying of cactus thin thorns caused by friction removal of the fabric causes worker injury is avoided, and the fabric is convenient and practical.

title_en: Vertical oil tea fruit rejuvenator of cyclic heating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclic heating vertical oil-tea camellia fruit hull breaking machine which has two functions of heating, drying and heating hull breaking, wherein a lifting system is used for lifting, heating and breaking hulls, and the mechanical structure is as follows: drying system and lift system, the drying system upper end is the drying chamber, the lower extreme is the breaking chamber, lift system possesses the function of breaking the shell, lift system bottom and hopper link to each other, fresh oil tea fruit loading hopper starter motor, fix the mesh conveying bucket on promoting the skeleton, promote to the top uninstallation upper flow tube, flow in drying system, fill the back with the drying chamber, the heat source pours into hot-blast room into from the heat source interface, hot-blast through the inner tube orifice plate, get into in the drying chamber, the wind channel in hot-blast cover is got into through the return air duct to the hot-blast after realizing the heat exchange, pierce through mesh conveying bucket, outside the air outlet eduction machine of lift system bottom, oil tea fruit circulates in the drying chamber and turns, get into the blasting chamber through adjustable minute flitch, pass through control switch after the blasting, fall into underflow groove and return the hopper.

title_en: Non-contact tomato pollination device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant pollination methods, and particularly discloses a non-contact tomato pollination device and method. The non-contact tomato pollination device mainly comprises a pulse airflow generating module consisting of a vacuum pump, a motor, an airflow blocking disc and the like to generate pulse airflow, and also comprises a fan, an air pipe, an air cavity and the like to guide the airflow generating module to generate guide airflow to finish pollination. Therefore, the non-contact pollination is respectively realized by driving the tomato spica to vibrate through the pulse airflow so as to release the pollen and spreading the released pollen by adopting the airflow guidance. According to the pollination device and the pollination method, the tomato plants do not need to be contacted, pollen does not need to be prepared in advance, and efficient and accurate pollination on the tomatoes is realized. Compare in prior art, can realize high-efficient, green pollination, and avoid the tomato plant damage in the contact pollination, promote the pollination quality. Can solve the problems of easy pollution or damage, low fruit setting rate and the like in the existing tomato pollination method, and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Rapid propagation method of fetal water lily
