abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid propagation method of a newborn water lily, which takes a newborn bud as an explant, and adventitious buds, proliferation culture, differentiation and rooting are carried out in the later period, so that the propagation coefficient of the newborn bud is greatly improved, the development period of the newborn bud is shortened, a large number of water lily seedlings with the same genetic character as a parent are obtained in a short period, the restriction of climate and regional conditions on the newborn development of the water lily is broken, the utilization of planting resources is guaranteed, the famous water lily variety is favorably propagated, and meanwhile, the large-scale production can meet the market demands at home and abroad.

title_en: Sterilizing and fresh-keeping method for instant canned food and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sterilization and preservation method of instant canned food and application thereof, comprising the following steps: s1: mixing lysozyme, hawthorn flavone and tea polyphenol according to the weight ratio of 1: (0.3-0.5): (0.1-0.3) to obtain a fresh-keeping color fixative; s2: blending and cooking food raw materials, and then sterilizing the obtained instant canned food by high-voltage pulse for 0.08-0.2s; s3: sterilizing the container with high pressure steam at 121 deg.C for 15-30min; s4: and (3) adding the fresh-keeping color fixative into the ready-to-eat canned food treated in the step (S2) in an aseptic environment, uniformly stirring, filling into a canned container treated in the step (S3), sealing in vacuum, and storing at room temperature in a ventilated and cool place. The invention adopts high-pressure pulse sterilization and high-pressure steam sterilization to carry out sectional sterilization treatment on the instant canned food and the canned container, can better keep the original flavor, taste and nutritional ingredients of the instant canned food, and prolongs the eating time of the canned food after opening.

title_en: Increasing yield of steviol glycosides
abstract_en: Aspects of the invention relate to steviol glycoside extraction. A method of processing a stevia extract comprising steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof and malonated steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof, comprising processing the stevia extract at a pH greater than 10 to convert at least some of the malonated steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof to non-malonated steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof to produce a modified stevia extract. The method comprises reducing the pH of the modified stevia extract to a pH of less than 9 to provide a pH adjusted modified stevia extract. The method also includes recovering steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof from the pH adjusted modified stevia extract, the recovered steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof comprising non-malonated steviol glycosides and/or salts thereof.

title_en: Chicken flavor base material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chicken flavor base stock and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chicken flavor base stock comprises the following steps: cooking chicken skeleton and chicken breast, and pulverizing; (II) carrying out enzymolysis by using compound enzyme; (III) enzyme deactivation treatment; and (IV) freezing and drying to obtain the chicken flavor base material. The method has the advantages that the low-price chicken skeleton is used as the main raw material, and a proper amount of chicken breast is added, so that the cost is reduced, and the nutritional value is improved; the preparation method is simple and has high operability; by adopting a compound enzyme enzymolysis technology, compared with a single enzymolysis technology, enzyme cutting sites are increased after double enzymes are compounded, the enzymolysis of a compound substrate is facilitated, the hydrolysis degree is obviously improved, the bitterness of the enzymolysis liquid is effectively reduced, and the prepared enzymolysis liquid has rich flavor and good taste; the freeze drying technology is adopted to maintain the flavor of the base material to the maximum extent.

title_en: High-oil-carrying microcapsule powder with weight-losing function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-oil-carrying microcapsule powder with a weight-losing function and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The invention adopts ultrasonic-assisted glycosylation modified protein as a wall material, uses olive oil diester oil and vine fruit oil as core materials, and obtains a high-oil-carrying microcapsule powder product with a weight-losing function through shearing, homogenizing and spray drying. The invention provides a microcapsule preparation method with simple formula and quick operation, the olive oil microcapsule prepared by the method has the characteristics of high oil carrying capacity (50-70%), high embedding rate (more than or equal to 97%), uniform color, particle size, good thermal stability and storage stability (POV is less than or equal to 6.0 meq/kg), and long shelf life, and the re-dissolved emulsion of microcapsule powder has similar sensory characteristics as the original emulsion, so that the application range of powder grease is enlarged.

title_en: Walnut acetylcholinesterase inhibiting peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a walnut acetylcholinesterase inhibiting peptide and application thereof. The walnut acetylcholinesterase inhibitory active peptide FR, SF and LR has clear structure and can be obtained by a solid-phase chemical synthesis method in the prior art. The method screens out the polypeptide with high acetylcholinesterase activity by combining the restriction enzymolysis with mass spectrum and a computer simulation method, thereby not only reducing the labor cost, lightening the working strength and shortening the development period, but also greatly improving the preparation success rate of the target bioactive peptide. The acetylcholinesterase-inhibiting active peptide has good acetylcholinesterase-inhibiting activity and potential memory-improving effect, can be independently used for preparing memory-improving medicaments or memory-improving health care products, and can be compounded with memory-improving related substances in the prior art for use so as to obtain better synergistic memory-improving effect.

title_en: Cinnamon essential oil Pickering emulsion with stable oxidized bacterial cellulose nanofibers and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides cinnamon essential oil Pickering emulsion with stable oxidized bacterial cellulose nanofibers and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of bio-based materials and colloid chemistry, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: mechanically processing the bacterial cellulose membrane by using a fiber fluffer and a high-pressure homogenizer to obtain a bacterial cellulose nanofiber suspension; then, oxidizing hydroxyl of the bacterial cellulose C6 into carboxyl by Tempo to obtain oxidized bacterial cellulose nanofiber; and further, mixing the suspension with cinnamon essential oil in a certain proportion by taking the oxidized bacterial cellulose nanofiber as an emulsifier, and emulsifying in a high-speed homogenization mode to finally obtain the O/W type Pickering emulsion. The oxidative bacterial cellulose nanofiber adopted by the invention has excellent emulsifying property, the obtained cinnamon essential oil Pickering emulsion has better stability and uniform particle size, the obtained Pickering emulsion has a certain slow release effect on cinnamon essential oil, and excellent antibacterial property, and can be used for antisepsis and fresh keeping of fresh fruits and vegetables.

title_en: Composition comprising lactobacillus-derived vesicles for use in the prevention or treatment of metabolic or muscle diseases
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating metabolic diseases or muscle diseases, which comprises vesicles derived from bacteria of the genus lactobacillus. The inventors confirmed that when vesicles derived from bacteria of the genus lactobacillus are administered into an animal model having metabolic diseases caused by high fat, the vesicles effectively inhibit metabolic diseases caused by high fat diet and increase the steady state against metabolic stress by activating AMPK signals in muscle cells, and thus, the vesicles derived from bacteria of the genus lactobacillus according to the present invention can be effectively used to develop drugs or health functional foods for preventing, improving symptoms or treating metabolic diseases such as obesity and muscle diseases.

title_en: Fermented large yellow croaker succinic acid dehydroprotein antibacterial peptide SDH73 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fermented large yellow croaker succinic acid dehydroprotein antibacterial peptide SDH73, the amino acid sequence of which is KRGMLENCILLLSLFAK, and the molecular weight of the antibacterial peptide SDH73 is 1836 daltons. Experiments prove that the antimicrobial peptide SDH73 can effectively inhibit food spoilage bacteria such as nitrobacillus, bacillus aryabhattai, bacillus stratosphaeris and the like. The invention lays a foundation for further researching the application of the fermented large yellow croaker succinic acid dehydroprotein in food preservatives, biological medicines and feed additives.

title_en: Application of small molecular compound in eucalyptus asexual propagation and genetic transformation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant asexual propagation, and discloses application of a small molecular compound in eucalyptus asexual propagation and genetic transformation. The small molecular compound is fepiprazole salt and has a molecular formula of:  The small molecular compound is utilized to efficiently induce callus formation and adventitious bud generation so as to improve the asexual propagation efficiency of eucalyptus, and then the benefit of large-scale propagation of forestry is improved.

title_en: Domestic fruit vegetables ripening machine with fresh-keeping function of constant temperature
abstract_en: The invention discloses a household fruit and vegetable ripening machine with a constant-temperature fresh-keeping function, which comprises a machine body and a turnover door rotatably arranged at the front end of the machine body, wherein an electronic refrigerating sheet, an exhaust fan and a heating pipe are arranged in the rear side wall of the machine body, a partition plate is transversely arranged in the machine body in a sliding manner, a sealing connecting block is arranged at the front side wall of the machine body, the turnover door is hermetically connected with the machine body through the sealing connecting block, and a wind guide cavity and a reaction cavity are respectively arranged in the side walls at two sides in the machine body. The invention relates to the technical field of household appliances; this domestic fruit vegetables ripening machine with constant temperature fresh-keeping function through the addition of buffer solution and ripening liquid to and rotate the removal that the turning block comes the control sealing plate, carries out the ration of ripening gas and puts in, reduces the carbon dioxide volume in the organism and produces oxygen through the absorption simultaneously, reduces the suppression of carbon dioxide to fruit vegetables cell respiration, and increased the oxygen concentration in the organism, can high-efficiently carry out the process of ripening to the fruit vegetables in the organism.

title_en: Preparation method of chicken essence compound condiment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seasoning preparation, and discloses a preparation method of a chicken essence composite seasoning, which comprises the following steps: s1: preparing raw materials, wherein the raw materials comprise: monosodium glutamate, edible salt, sucrose, corn starch, egg yolk, chicken oil, white pepper, ginger powder, meat powder, chicken essence paste, chicken essence, edible essence, curry powder, vegetable powder, seafood powder and food additive; s2: preparing meat meal, namely taking chicken and pork, cooking the chicken and the pork respectively, extracting and air-drying the chicken and the pork to prepare chicken meal and pork meal, then selecting spareribs to heat, crush and grind the pork to prepare spareribs powder, and sequentially taking the chicken meal, the pork meal and the spareribs powder to prepare the meat meal according to the mass ratio. The invention can reserve a large amount of vitamins and mineral substances in vegetables and increase nutrient components, and the seafood powder prepared by adopting the fresh scallop as the raw material has sufficient seafood flavor and is rich in a large amount of protein and amino acid, thereby improving the product quality and having better market competitiveness.

title_en: Buffer system oyster shell sterilization, disinfection, antibiosis and bacteriostasis material and preparation method and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a buffer system oyster shell powder sterilization, disinfection and bacteriostasis material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of antibacterial adsorption. The invention provides a buffer system oyster shell powder sterilization, antibacterial and bacteriostatic material and a preparation method and use thereof, and the buffer system oyster shell powder sterilization, antibacterial and bacteriostatic material comprises pretreatment, high-pressure screen cleaning, three-stage stepped heating and calcining for forging, calcining in an oxidizing atmosphere, grinding to powder with the particle size of below 50 mu m, and cooling.

title_en: Method for making preserved eggs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing preserved eggs, which comprises the steps of sorting eggs or duck eggs, preparing ingredient water, soaking eggs and the like, wherein the ingredient is easy to obtain raw materials, the preparation cost is low, and the ingredient does not use raw materials containing lead, so that the lead can be prevented from being introduced, and the preserved eggs are safer and healthier; the preparation method has short preparation period which only needs 15-20 days, and is beneficial to reducing the cost and popularizing; the ingredient water used in the invention can be recycled, so that the cost can be further reduced; the preserved eggs prepared by the invention have unique flavor and fresh mouthfeel; in the preserved eggs prepared from eggs, zinc sulfate is used for permeating, so that trace zinc element is contained in the preserved eggs, and the preserved eggs are healthier.

title_en: Drug-resistant lactobacillus casei SICAU-LAB26 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug-resistant lactobacillus casei (Lactobacillus casei) SICAU-LAB26 and application thereof, wherein the strain is separated from naturally fermented yak milk cheese in western Sichuan plateau, is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCCNO) within 12 months and 20 days in 2021, and has the preservation number of CCTCCNO: m20211648, the nucleotide sequence of 16SrRNA is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The bacterial colony of the strain is milky white, round or quasi-round, and the diameter of the bacterial colony is more than 1.0 mm; the surface is raised and smooth, and the edge is neat; the thallus is in the shape of short rod, with two ends being round and arranged in short chain. The acid-producing capability of the strain is strong, the strain has strong antibiotic resistance, and is also an advantageous strain with acid resistance, osmotic pressure resistance, cholate resistance, high temperature resistance and strong pathogen resistance through verification, and the strain and the prepared biological agent thereof have good application prospects.

title_en: Lactobacillus mucosae and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses a lactobacillus mucosae (Limosilactobacillus mucosae), which is characterized in that the preservation number is: GDMCC NO:62541; preservation date: 2022, 06, 13, deposit unit: the collection of microbial strains, guangdong province, address: guangzhou city first middle road No. 100 college No. 59 building 5. The strain can improve the resistance effect of pigs on Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus (PEDV), has better functions in the aspects of the regulation of factors such as I-type interferon IFN-alpha, IFN-beta and the like and in the aspects of the regulation of genes of III-type interferon IFN-lambda 1 and IFN-lambda 3, and has differentiation and specificity in the regulation of antiviral protein genes MX1, MX2, OAS1 and ZAP. Meanwhile, the invention also provides application of the strain.

title_en: Agent for increasing IgA antibody content in milk
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide an intestinal symbiotic bacterium having an effect of increasing the IgA content in milk. As an agent for increasing the IgA antibody content in milk, a strain comprising 1 or 2 or more species selected from the group consisting of a Bacteroides strain having a 16S rRNA gene having at least 90% identity with the nucleotide sequence represented by SEQ ID No. 1 and having an effect of increasing the IgA antibody content in milk and a Prevotella strain having a 16S rRNA gene having at least 90% identity with the nucleotide sequence represented by SEQ ID No. 2 and having an effect of increasing the IgA antibody content in milk is used.

title_en: Tomato sauce and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a tomato sauce and a production method thereof, belonging to the technical field of food processing. The invention provides a tomato sauce which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 90 to 220 parts of tomato sauce, 18 to 43 parts of clear water, 27 to 62 parts of carrot, 14 to 42 parts of cabbage, 18 to 43 parts of onion, 4 to 16 parts of green pepper, 9 to 54 parts of rapeseed oil, 1 to 6 parts of salt and seasoning. Compared with the existing tomato sauce, the tomato ketchup provided by the invention has the unique flavor of the raw materials such as tomatoes and seasonings, is sour, sweet and delicious, can be used as various food raw and auxiliary materials, is suitable for the taste of Chinese consumers, and can be eaten independently.

title_en: Method for realizing gene transient expression in lotus petals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing gene transient expression in lotus petals, which mainly comprises the following steps: (1) constructing an agrobacterium tumefaciens expression vector of a target gene; (2) carrying out agrobacterium transformation on the expression vector by an electric shock method; and (3) introducing a target gene by using a lotus petal agrobacterium injection method. The method realizes the transient over-expression of the target gene by selecting the lotus flowers at a specific development stage, is convenient and simple to operate, can quickly realize the body function verification of the candidate genes participating in the synthesis and regulation of metabolites such as lotus anthocyanin, alkaloid, starch and the like, and fills the gap that the lotus is always lack of an effective homologous gene function verification method.

title_en: Enzymolysis preparation method of oat beverage rich in beta-glucan
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of oat beverage, in particular to an enzymolysis preparation method of oat beverage rich in beta-glucan, which comprises the following steps: (1) Adding compound amylase into deionized water, and preheating the deionized water, wherein the compound amylase comprises fungal amylase, maltogenic amylase and saccharifying enzyme; (2) Adding oat flour into the solution prepared in the step (1) and stirring and uniformly mixing; (3) Placing the mixture prepared in the step (2) under the constant temperature condition for enzymolysis to obtain oat pulp; (4) heating oat pulp to inactivate enzyme; (5) Filtering and deslagging the oat pulp after enzyme deactivation to obtain oat liquid; and (6) homogenizing the oat liquid to obtain the oat beverage. The invention reduces the damage degree of beta-glucan in the enzymolysis process by using fungal amylase, so that the oat beverage prepared by the method has higher nutrition, and the preparation method is simple and mild in condition, and is convenient for industrial production.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis and method for preparing selenium-enriched natto by using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus subtilis and a method for preparing selenium-enriched natto by using the same. Belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. Comprising the following steps: bacillus subtilis XG-1 with a preservation number of CCTCCNO: m2022399. The invention adopts a microbial fermentation method to produce the selenium-enriched natto, does not need to plant the selenium-enriched natto on a large scale, can produce the selenium-enriched natto which is rich in organic selenium and nattokinase in a short time, has multiple effects, and has the advantages of short period, low cost and high efficiency. The selenium-enriched bacillus natto liquid strain provided by the invention can be directly used for preparing selenium-enriched bacillus natto in factories or families, does not need additional raw materials or reconstruction equipment, is convenient and quick, and can be directly prepared into bacterial powder to be used as a health product for supplementing selenium, resisting oxidization and preventing cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.

title_en: Cassava transcription factor MebZIP34 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cassava transcription factor MebZIP34 and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the cassava transcription factor MebZIP34 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the nucleotide sequence thereof is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The subcellular localization of the gene of the transcription factor MebZIP34 is respectively localized in nucleus and cytoplasm, and the segment of the gene is adopted to construct a silencing system, so that the target gene can be effectively silenced, and the silencing system can also be used for effectively silencing the target geneEffectively regulating and controlling the expression of antioxidant enzyme gene of plants and H in the plants  2  O  2  Content and MDA content. The invention lays a good foundation for enriching breeding gene resources and creating cassava varieties resistant to post-harvest physiological deterioration.

title_en: Aspergillus niger strain and application thereof in improving flavor and taste of fermented sea fish
abstract_en: The invention discloses aspergillus niger and application thereof in improving flavor and taste of fermented marine fish, and relates to the field of food microorganisms. The Aspergillus niger is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC No. 40251) in the year 7 and 20 of 2022, and the preservation address is North Chen Xiu No.1 and 3 of the Korean area of Beijing city. The invention utilizes the screening culture medium to screen a strain of aspergillus niger MXL-21 from the fermented plum-flavored fish, and the fermented golden pompano and the fermented sea bass obtained by inoculating the aspergillus niger have the special fragrance of the traditional fermented plum-flavored fish; compared with natural fermented golden pomfret and fermented sea bass, the content and the variety of the volatile flavor compounds are increased. In addition, the elasticity and the chewiness of the meat quality of the fermented sea fish can be improved and the flavor and the taste of the quick-fermented sea fish can be improved by inoculating the aspergillus niger to the fermented sea fish.

title_en: Application of MYB15 gene in improvement of plant fruit lignin content
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of MYB15 gene in improving plant fruit lignin content; also provided is a method of increasing lignin content in a plant comprising the step of transferring into plant material that develops into said plant an overexpression cassette for a MYB15 gene. The invention discovers the effect of the MYB15 gene in improving the lignin content in the fruit cells of plants such as oranges, and the stress resistance of the fruits of the plants can be enhanced due to the moderate accumulation of the lignin, so that the regulation of the expression of the MYB15 gene can be used as a way for regulating and controlling the lignin content in the fruit cells of the plants, the fruits of the plants such as the oranges can be properly lignified, and the resistance of the fruits to plant diseases and insect pests can be improved on the premise of keeping the taste and the color of the fruits of the plants.

title_en: Modified milk powder for enhancing immunity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified milk powder for enhancing immunity and a preparation method thereof, wherein the modified milk powder for enhancing immunity comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 850 parts of whole milk powder, 750 parts of skim milk powder, 240 parts of desalted whey powder, 200 parts of bovine colostrum powder, 150 parts of desalted whey powder, 50 parts of composite vegetable oil, 80 parts of dietary fiber, 100 parts of erythritol, 8 parts of elderberry powder, 5 parts of acerola powder, 1 part of lactoferrin, 0.5 part of phospholipid, 0.05 part of N-acetylneuraminic acid, 0.5 part of yeast beta-glucan, 0.5 part of docosahexaenoic acid and 10 parts of immunoglobulin. The invention combines elderberry powder, yeast beta-glucan, bovine colostrum powder and lactoferrin on the basis of preparing the milk powder from the raw materials, comprehensively plays roles of enhancing cellular immunity, humoral immunity and innate immunity, covers most of immune functions of an organism and plays a role of comprehensively enhancing the immunity.

title_en: Application of armillaria mellea in degrading vomitoxin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of armillaria mellea in degrading vomitoxin; the invention also discloses armillaria mellea Am-07-22 with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: m20221044; the mycotoxin is vomitoxin or zearalenone. The strain Am-07-22 has the best degradation effect when the concentration of vomitoxin is 2 mu g/mL, and the degradation rate is 64.05 percent; the armillaria mellea has good degradation effect on vomitoxin in two different fermentation raw materials when the corn bran is subjected to a solid fermentation mode, and the corn gluten is subjected to a liquid fermentation mode.

title_en: Polypeptide for immunoregulation of broiler chickens and application thereof
abstract_en: The provided polypeptide has the effects of resisting bacteria and regulating the immunity of the broiler chickens, does not damage the livers of the bred broiler chickens, and can be used as a feed additive. The amino acid sequence of the provided polypeptide is SEQ ID NO. 1. The polypeptide separated from the liver tissues of the broiler chicken provided by the invention has a broad-spectrum antibacterial effect. In addition, the high-concentration feed additive does not cause obvious stress reaction on the broiler chickens when used at high concentration, and can be used as a feed additive of the broiler chickens.

title_en: Energy micro-bubble tablet containing ginseng adventitious roots and capable of relieving physical fatigue and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy micro-bubble tablet containing ginseng adventitious roots and capable of relieving physical fatigue and a preparation method thereof. The energy micro-bubble tablet capable of relieving physical fatigue comprises ginseng adventitious root freeze-dried powder, taurine, L-aspartic acid, asparagus extract, guarana extract, sweetener, acid source, alkali source, edible essence, edible pigment and lubricant. The mass ratio of the ginseng adventitious root freeze-dried powder to the L-aspartic acid to the asparagus extract is 20-40:6-9:6-9; the mass ratio of the acid source to the alkali source is 1:1-1:1.4. The energy micro-bubble tablet capable of relieving physical fatigue provided by the invention is convenient to eat, excellent in taste and capable of slowly releasing bubbles in the oral cavity; the components are reasonable in proportion, the components can play a role in synergism, the effect of relieving physical fatigue can be greatly improved, and the effect of greatly invigorating primordial qi of ginseng can be also played.

title_en: Tea tree net spot virus infectious clone and construction method and application of VIGS vector thereof
abstract_en: A tea tree net spot virus infectious clone and a construction method and application of a VIGS vector thereof belong to the technical field of genetic engineering. The infectious clone contained three component full-length cDNA recombinant plasmids of tea tree net spot virus (TPLPV), pTPLPV1 and pTPLPV3, respectively. pTPLPV3 can be used for inserting exogenous gene fragments to form a VIGS vector of TPLPV, and the pTPLPV3-VIGS is singly inoculated or mixed with the former two chains for infection by an agrobacterium-mediated method, so that the NbPDS gene of the plant tobacco with a mode can be silenced and a albino silencing phenotype can be generated, and the CsPDS gene of tea trees can be silenced and the albino silencing phenotype can be generated by singly infection. The invention firstly reforms the TPLPV of the tea tree virus into the infectious clone and the VIGS vector, and provides tool vectors and technical supports for researching the functions, pathogenic mechanisms and construction and reformation of the silencing vector of the virus protein.

title_en: Composition with blood sugar reducing synergistic effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition with a blood sugar reducing synergistic effect and application thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of food nutrition and health care and biological medicine. The composition comprises oyster peptide and anthocyanin extract. The mass ratio of the oyster peptide to the anthocyanin extract is 1:10-3:1. Experiments prove that the synergistic effect of the internal and external blood sugar reduction of the composition is remarkable, and the digestion stability is remarkably improved; animal experiments prove that the composition has synergistic hypoglycemic effect on type II diabetes mice, has more remarkable hypoglycemic effect than single oyster peptide or anthocyanin, and has no toxic effect on animals after long-term use; the in vivo experiment shows that the combined oyster peptide and anthocyanin has partial synergistic hypoglycemic mechanism. The invention provides a new direction for reducing blood sugar and treating and preventing II diabetes.

title_en: Fruit washs letter sorting equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fruit sorting and packaging, in particular to fruit cleaning and sorting equipment. The device comprises a cleaning mechanism and a sorting mechanism; the sorting mechanism comprises a small fruit sorting mechanism, a big fruit sorting mechanism and a secondary fruit sorting mechanism, and the small fruit sorting mechanism is arranged in a cleaning chamber of the cleaning mechanism; the small fruit sorting mechanism comprises a lifting table which is arranged in the cleaning chamber and can move up and down, a fruit outlet is connected with a sterilizing mechanism, and the sterilizing mechanism is connected with a heat treatment mechanism; the small fruit outlet is communicated with a secondary fruit storage bin through a small fruit channel. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: organically combining a plurality of fruit sorting and packaging links, and completing primary sorting of the sizes of the fruits through fruit falling inclined planes and sorting columns which are orderly arranged in a high-efficiency cleaning process; and then sequentially connected sterilizing mechanism and heat treatment mechanism are utilized to continuously and compactly finish the operations of secondary sorting, efficient sterilization, drying, heat preservation of fruits, thereby completing a whole set of closely matched, efficient and intelligent fruit sorting, packaging and processing procedures.

title_en: Application of tomato SlERF.H6 gene in regulating and controlling solanine metabolism to reduce tomato toxicity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. In particular to the application of tomato SlERF.H6 gene in regulating solanine metabolic pathway gene and reducing plant toxicity. Through forward genetics means and adopting a whole genome association analysis (mGWAS) method, the tomato SlERF.H6 gene is positioned, and through over-expression and CRISPR editing expression in tomato plants, the fact that the over-expression of the SlERF.H6 gene can reduce the content of toxic tomato steroidal glycoside alkaloid metabolites of tomatoes, so that the content of non-toxic alkaloid metabolites is increased, and the biological function and application path of the gene are verified.

title_en: Nitrogen-filled fresh-keeping process for coarse cereal food
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-filled fresh-keeping process for coarse cereal food, which comprises the steps of S1, performing coarse cereal drying treatment, removing moisture in coarse cereal and keeping the coarse cereal in a dry state; s2, carrying out bin loading treatment, and pumping the dried coarse cereals into storage equipment by using a grain pumping machine for storage; s3, carrying out negative pressure pumping treatment, and pumping air in the coarse cereal storage equipment by utilizing negative pressure equipment to be in a negative pressure state; s4, nitrogen charging and preservation are carried out in the coarse cereal storage equipment in a negative pressure state, so that the coarse cereals are subjected to disinfection, sterilization and preservation treatment in an ultralow temperature environment, and in the steps S2 to S4 of the preservation process, the coarse cereal storage equipment is required to be matched and corresponding treatment operation is completed, the coarse cereal storage equipment comprises a support frame, a storage bin is arranged in the support frame, a nitrogen charging component is arranged on the support frame, and the sufficiency of inert gas in the storage bin is kept all the time in the nitrogen charging component during use, so that the preservation effect of coarse cereal foods is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Weight-losing coffee solid beverage formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a weight-losing coffee solid beverage formula and a preparation method thereof, and the weight-losing coffee solid beverage formula is prepared by mixing 1-5 parts of mulberry leaves, 30-60 parts of instant coffee, 1-10 parts of ginseng extract, 10-30 parts of skimmed milk powder, 1-5 parts of semen cassiae, 1-5 parts of lotus leaves, 1-5 parts of semen benincasae, 1-5 parts of longan pulp and 1-5 parts of sucralose uniformly and crushing at a low temperature, and finally the powdery instant ginseng extract coffee is prepared, has rich fragrance, mellow taste, has health-care and health-preserving functions, is suitable for mass consumers to drink, and is convenient to carry and eat. Breaks through the current situation that the traditional ginseng-containing drink is liquid, and the produced solid drink is more convenient and safer for health care.

title_en: Lactic acid bacteria for producing aminopeptidase and application of lactic acid bacteria in oligopeptide feed fermentation debittering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactic acid bacteria for producing aminopeptidase and application thereof in fermentation and debitterizing of oligopeptide feed, wherein the lactic acid bacteria take enterococcus faecium (Enterococcus faecium) as an expression host, pQE-30 as an expression vector, and an aminopeptidase gene with a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1 is recombined. The invention applies the lactic acid bacteria engineering bacteria for producing aminopeptidase to feed fermentation, so that the feed is rich in oligopeptides, and the oligopeptides are debitterized, thereby not only improving the nutritive value of the feed, but also improving the overall palatability of the feed, and further increasing probiotics and prebiotics of the feed, and having very high application prospect.

title_en: Process for separating skim milk components
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for separating skim milk components, in particular for extracting milk proteins and lactose from skim milk powder. The process comprises mixing skim milk powder with water, increasing the temperature of the resulting mixture, and subsequently cooling the mixture to produce a viscous casein fraction and a less viscous lactose fraction, and then separating the two fractions by optional purification.

title_en: Preparation method of heat-resistant beet red powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of heat-resistant beet red powder, which comprises the following steps: (1) Selecting beet red pigment, color protecting component and purified water, mixing them, and under the action of high-speed shearing machine obtaining uniform beet red solution; (2) Selecting a drying aid as a carrier, adding the beet red solution and the drying aid into edible alcohol, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixture; (3) Drying the mixture in vacuum at low temperature, and grinding into powder to obtain beet red powder. According to the invention, by combining the defects of beet red, different color protection schemes are tested, and meanwhile, the compound formula is dried in a low-temperature vacuum drying mode, so that the heat-resistant beet red powder is prepared, the color value and the color stability of the powder can be kept in a long-term storage process, and the heat stability of the powder is obviously improved.

title_en: Three-phase type water-removing equipment and water-removing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses three-phase de-enzyming equipment and a de-enzyming method thereof, which comprise a roller, wherein the roller is provided with a hot air generator, a hot air releaser, a steam generator and a steam releaser, the roller is provided with a heating device for heating the inner wall of the roller, the steam releaser is arranged in an inner cavity of the roller and comprises a steam pipeline communicated with the steam generator, the part of the steam pipeline entering the inner cavity of the roller is shorter than the length of the roller, a steam release hole is formed in the part of the steam pipeline entering the inner cavity of the roller, the hot air releaser is arranged in the inner cavity of the roller and comprises a hot air pipeline communicated with the hot air generator, the part of the hot air pipeline entering the inner cavity of the roller is shorter than the length of the roller, and a hot air release hole is formed in the part of the hot air pipeline entering the inner cavity of the roller. The invention optimizes and innovates traditional roller fixation, steam fixation, hot air fixation and the like, exerts respective fixation advantages, avoids weaknesses, and realizes comprehensive improvement of fixation leaves in terms of color, aroma, uniformity and the like.

title_en: Method for carrying out gene expression by utilizing agrobacterium to transiently transform golden camellia leaves
abstract_en: A method for gene expression by utilizing agrobacterium to transiently transform golden camellia leaves belongs to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the following steps: selecting golden camellia green leaves and branches thereof; transforming a plasmid with an exogenous target gene into an agrobacterium competent cell; selecting positive agrobacterium monoclonal and transferring the positive agrobacterium monoclonal into an LB liquid culture medium for culture; infecting bacteria liquid; and verifying the expression quantity of the target gene by fluorescent quantitative PCR. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method is convenient to operate, provides a new technical means for functional verification of the golden camellia gene, greatly improves efficiency, enables exogenous genes to be successfully expressed in golden camellia leaves through transient transformation of golden camellia in-vitro leaves by agrobacterium, and lays a foundation for better researching and developing and utilizing the golden camellia flower color mechanism.

title_en: Fermented wine prepared from sugar or syrup and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fermented wine brewing, in particular to fermented wine with sugar or syrup as a raw material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: s1, pretreating a sugar or syrup raw material to obtain fermentation liquor; s2, adding an acidity regulator to regulate the acidity of the fermentation broth; s3, adding a nitrogen source and activated yeast, and performing primary fermentation at room temperature; s4, after the first fermentation is finished, adding nitrogen sources and activated yeast which are equal to the nitrogen sources and the activated yeast for the first fermentation again to perform the second fermentation; s5, after the second fermentation is finished, filtering the fermentation liquor, and transferring the fermentation liquor into a maple barrel for ageing; s6, adding maple syrup and distilled liquor after ageing, adjusting sugar degree and alcohol degree, and filtering, sterilizing again to obtain the finished fermented wine. The invention adopts sugar or syrup to replace molasses, sugarcane and the like as fermentation sugar sources, and has no waste treatment problem in the production process. The adoption of the maple barrel as an ageing device breaks through the ageing mode of a single oak barrel, and enriches the variety of fermented wine.

title_en: High-protein biological ferment with zero addition of flour and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological fermenters, in particular to the field of IPC A21D, and more particularly relates to a high-protein biological fermenter with zero added flour and a preparation method thereof. The high-protein biological ferment of the zero-addition flour comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by weight: 400-600 parts of edible particles, 100-200 parts of egg liquid, 0-200 parts of sweetener, 0-50 parts of moisture retention agent, 0-50 parts of grease, 10-50 parts of bulking agent, 0-20 parts of modifier, 0-20 parts of flavoring, 0-20 parts of essence and 400-600 parts of water. The invention uses edible particles to replace flour, greatly improves the nutrition component ratio of protein, reduces the nutrition component ratio of carbohydrate, and ensures the taste and flavor of common bread and meets the health requirement of consumers by adjusting the types and the proportion of the modifier.

title_en: Laying hen feed capable of prolonging egg laying period and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chicken feeds, and particularly relates to a laying hen feed for prolonging an egg laying period and a preparation method thereof. The laying hen feed for prolonging the egg laying period comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-125 parts of coarse grain material; 5-10 parts of compound vitamin microcapsule powder; 0.1-0.5 part of complex enzyme preparation; 3-6 parts of organic salt; 1-3 parts of amino acid mixed powder; the coarse grain comprises corn, rape seed meal, rice chaff, wheat bran, fish meal, bone meal, silkworm chrysalis meal, pine needle meal, eucommia ulmoides male pollen, broken ganoderma lucidum spore powder, tripterygium wilfordii extract, choline chloride and salt. Through the nutrition requirement of the laying hen in the egg laying period, the coarse grain material, the compound vitamin microcapsule powder, the compound enzyme preparation, the organic salt and the amino acid mixed powder are matched in the laying hen feed to obtain the laying hen feed with comprehensive and balanced nutrition, and compared with the common feed, the laying hen feed provided by the invention prolongs the egg laying peak period of the laying hen by 63 days, prolongs the egg laying period by 10 weeks and improves the egg quality.

title_en: Three-layer seamless soft capsule and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: There is provided a three-layer seamless soft capsule comprising a core, an intermediate protective layer surrounding the core, and a film layer surrounding the intermediate protective layer, the intermediate protective layer comprising 279 to 294 parts by weight of a first oily substance and 6 to 21 parts by weight of a phospholipid; the phospholipid contains 10-60wt% of phosphatidylcholine; the first oily substance is hardened oil or hardened oil composition which is in a solidification state at room temperature and has a melting point of 40-60 ℃. The invention solves the problem that the capsule is easy to break and leak oil caused by overlarge oil drops in the coating film in the manufacturing process of the seamless soft capsule.

title_en: Blood sugar-reducing compound anthocyanin beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood sugar-reducing compound anthocyanin beverage and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of anthocyanin beverage preparation, wherein the preparation raw materials of the blood sugar-reducing compound anthocyanin beverage comprise: sang Shecu extract, beta-cyclodextrin, compound sugar, citric acid, anthocyanin extract, tea polyphenol and tartary buckwheat tea. The preparation method of the anthocyanin extract comprises the steps of anthocyanin crude extraction and anthocyanin extract preparation, and the obtained anthocyanin extract has high anthocyanin content, deep red color and no suspended matters. Solves the problems of low anthocyanin content, non-ideal taste, color and luster and blood sugar reducing function of the prepared anthocyanin beverage due to insufficient anthocyanin dissolution and excessive impurities which are easy to generate oxidation-reduction reaction in the anthocyanin extraction process.

title_en: Tea leaf rolling machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tea leaf rolling machine which comprises a flattening mechanism, a rolling mechanism, a transmission mechanism, a power source, a material taking mechanism and a mounting frame, wherein the flattening mechanism is arranged on the mounting frame; the mounting frame is used for mounting the winding mechanism, the power source and the material taking mechanism; the power source provides power, drives the transmission mechanism to move, drives the flattening mechanism to flatten tea leaves through the transmission mechanism, drives the rolling mechanism to roll flattened tea leaves, and the material taking mechanism is used for taking materials from the tea leaves rolled on the rolling mechanism. According to the invention, the tea is flattened and power for forward movement is provided by arranging the two flattening rollers with opposite directions, the flattening rollers are further matched with the rolling mechanism, and the rolling mechanism is provided with a floating mechanism with two degrees of freedom, so that the rolling function of the tea is realized; the coiled tea leaves are pulled out to the trough to slide out through the material taking mechanism, so that the whole function is realized.

title_en: Fungus soup containing traditional Chinese medicinal materials and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fungus soup containing traditional Chinese medicinal materials and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of food soup base production. The fungus soup containing the traditional Chinese medicinal materials comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 10-20 parts of Morchella esculenta, 1-5 parts of Dictyophora indusiata, 1-5 parts of Agaricus blazei, 2-6 parts of velvet antler mushroom, 1-5 parts of Cordyceps sinensis flower, 5-10 parts of Lentinus Edodes, 0.5-2 parts of radix Codonopsis and 5-10 parts of rhizoma Dioscoreae; the preparation method of the fungus soup containing the traditional Chinese medicinal materials comprises the following steps of: step one, cleaning Morchella, dictyophora Indusiata, agaricus blazei, velvet antler mushroom, cordyceps sinensis flower and Lentinus Edodes in the raw materials, and drying; step two, cleaning the codonopsis pilosula, slicing the codonopsis pilosula, and drying the codonopsis pilosula; step three, cleaning and peeling the Chinese yam, slicing and drying. The fungus soup is prepared from fungus raw materials such as morchella, bamboo fungus, agaricus blazei, velvet antler mushroom, cordyceps flower, mushroom and the like and Chinese medicinal materials such as dangshen in reasonable proportion, so that the fungus soup is delicious, achieves the effects of treating patients and building up body, and has higher nutritive value.

title_en: Bacterial strain for use as a probiotic, composition thereof, deposited strain and method for identifying a probiotic bacterial strain
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bacterial strain or a combination of bacterial strains for use as a probiotic in fish, selected from the group consisting of: golden fungus strain of horse; a flavobacterium species strain, comprising with the genome the sequence of SEQ ID NO: the flavobacterium species strain identified by accession No. i-5481, which was deposited with the french national culture and collection of microorganisms (CNCM) at 1 or 24 months in 2020, has an Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) value of at least 95% or more; and variants thereof. The strains may each have an Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) value of at least 95% or more as follows: the genome comprises SEQ ID NO: the golden fungus strain of golden fungus identified by accession No. i-5479 deposited with CNCM at 24 of 1/2020 and/or the genome comprises the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: a strain of Flavobacterium species identified by accession No. I-5481 deposited on CNCM at 1 or 24 months of 2020; or a variant thereof. The probiotic use may involve preventing or minimizing flavobacterium columniform infection in fish. The invention also relates to said deposited bacterial strain, or a probiotic composition or food or kit comprising the same, and to a method of identifying a probiotic bacterial strain that is resistant to infection by a pathogen.

title_en: Bromofuranone C-30 sustained release agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bromofuranone C-30 sustained release agent, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention dissolves bromofuranone in ethyl acetate, adds silicon dioxide to prepare fine particles, and then coats palm wax on the fine particles to obtain the bromofuranone C-30 slow release agent. The bromofuranone C-30 sustained release agent effectively improves the stability of the bromofuranone C-30, avoids the absorption of the bromofuranone C-30 in animal stomach, prolongs the action time of the bromofuranone C-30 in intestinal tracts, and can be applied to livestock, poultry and aquatic animal feeds. The preparation method of the bromofuranone C-30 sustained release agent provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process and low production cost.

title_en: Dietary therapy formula for preventing senile dementia, improving memory and repairing and dredging damaged cerebral nerves and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dietotherapy formula for preventing senile dementia, improving memory and repairing and dredging damaged cerebral nerves and a preparation method thereof. Nervonic acid has effects of obviously reducing blood lipid, lowering blood viscosity, inhibiting platelet aggregation, and increasing high density lipoprotein. Nervonic acid is a core natural component of brain nerve fibers and nerve cells. The lack of nervonic acid can cause cerebral diseases such as cerebral apoplexy sequela, senile dementia, cerebral palsy, cerebral atrophy, hypomnesis, insomnia, amnesia and the like. The nervonic acid can completely permeate the blood brain barrier and directly act on nerve fibers to repair and dredge; regenerating the damaged and detached protective sheath, dissolving necrotic tissue blocking the channel, and inducing the self-growth and division of nerve fibers; the information generated by nerve cells and the external information can be smoothly transmitted through nerve fibers; the instructions are smooth, so that damaged, diseased and dormant nerve cells are activated, and the nerve network is remodelled; recovering part or all functions of the patient in terms of language, memory, feeling, limbs and the like, and achieving the thorough rehabilitation of encephalopathy; the invention optimizes the proportion combination through reasonable component content proportion so as to achieve better food therapy effect.

title_en: Nutritional soft candy containing nutrients and its preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutritional soft candy containing nutrients and a production process thereof, wherein the soft candy is mainly prepared from 2-8 parts of edible gum, 70-80 parts of sweetener, 1 part of nutrients, 3-7 parts of vegetable oil, 7-12 parts of fruit juice and 30-40 parts of pure water by proper proportion and process, and solid fruit taste colloid accounting for 15% -30% of a soft candy body is wrapped in the soft candy, so that the chewing of the soft candy is more layered, and meanwhile, the fall and empty sensation generated during chewing is avoided, wherein the water content of a solid sandwich layer is more than twice that of an external sugar layer, and the proper proportion of the sandwich layer in the soft candy enables the sandwich layer to burst fruit juice and fragrance in an oral cavity, so that obvious refreshing sensation can be obtained.

title_en: Open-mouth pellet feed for penaeus vannamei boone seedling culture and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a litopenaeus vannamei feed and a preparation process thereof, which solve the technical problems that the research of the traditional litopenaeus vannamei feed is still very weak and the nutrition research is insufficient, and the litopenaeus vannamei feed comprises the following raw material components in parts by weight: 50-55 parts of imported super steamed fish meal, 5-8 parts of imported antarctic krill meal, 5-10 parts of fermented soybean meal, 10-15 parts of high gluten flour, 3-5 parts of cuttlefish cream, 4-8 parts of spirulina powder, 2-4 parts of fish oil, 3-5 parts of wheat gluten, 3-5 parts of egg powder, 0.15 part of DMPT (shrimp premix compound) and 1 part of shrimp premix; the invention also discloses a preparation process of the litopenaeus vannamei feed, which can be widely applied to the technical field of aquaculture feed.

title_en: Production method of high-quality edible flower sauce
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of high-quality edible flower paste, which belongs to the technical field of flower paste production and is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: step 1: 25-35 parts of jasmine flower, 3-5 parts of mint leaves and 1-2 parts of sweet osmanthus flower are cleaned, drained and dried in an air drying room for 7-15 days after the flower buds and the stems are removed; pouring the crushed petal powder into a bowl-shaped stirring vessel, pouring honey and white granulated sugar into the vessel, and kneading the vessel to a sticky cake to obtain jasmine jam; cutting pericarpium Citri Tangerinae into small particles, mixing with the above jasmine paste, and grinding to obtain pericarpium Citri Tangerinae and jasmine paste; the kumquat jasmine jam pulp and the dehydrating agent are placed in a sealed cabinet for drying and molding to obtain kumquat jasmine jam, and the kumquat jasmine jam is bottled and sealed, stored at low temperature, has the effects of soothing liver and regulating qi, strengthening spleen and stomach and stopping diarrhea, can be used for slow release of symptoms such as globus hystericus, abdominal distention and pain, diarrhea and the like, and has the effects of relieving stomach ache and recovering appetite.

title_en: Chlorine-containing sesquiterpene lactone compound with anti-inflammatory activity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chlorine-containing sesquiterpene lactone compound with anti-inflammatory activity and a preparation method thereof, wherein the structural general formula (I) is as follows: when R1 is hydroxyl (-OH), R2 is chloromethyl (-CH 2 Cl); or R2 is hydroxy (-OH) when R1 is chloromethyl (-CH 2 Cl). The preparation method is simple and rapid, the purity is high, and the raw materials are easy to obtain.

title_en: Method for enriching pit mud functional flora
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to a method for enriching pit mud functional flora. In view of the problems that most of pit mud functional bacterial groups are anaerobic fermentation bacteria, separation and culture conditions are difficult and pit mud improvement is limited, the invention provides a pit mud functional bacterial group enrichment method which comprises the following steps of inoculating pit mud suspension into a yellow water culture medium, adding reinforced Daqu, culturing under anaerobic conditions to obtain pit mud culture solution, and carrying out multi-round inoculation and expansion culture on the pit mud culture solution. The pit mud culture solution obtained by the method has the advantages that the quantity of functional bacteria methane sarcina and clostridium is greatly increased, the abundance of caproic acid bacteria (Caproiciproducens) which metabolize white spirit characteristic products is increased, the synthesis of butyric acid and caproic acid is promoted, the quality of pit mud is improved, and the subsequent production and brewing are facilitated.

title_en: Rice dominant male sterile gene SDGMS and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plant sterility related gene, in particular to application of a gene derived from rice and related to dominant male sterility and a coding protein thereof in creating a dominant male sterile line of the rice. The invention provides a dominant male sterile gene SDGMS of rice and application thereof. The rice dominant male sterility related gene SDGMS can be used for creating a new dominant male sterile line and enhancing the utilization of rice hybrid vigor. The T0 generation of the transgenic plant line with the excessive expression of the dominant male sterility related gene SDGMS of the rice shows pollen abortion or no pollen, which indicates that the transgenic plant with the excessive expression of the gene can obtain new sterile materials. The creation of dominant male sterile line can promote the wide application of recurrent selection breeding method, enrich the genetic diversity of new breeding varieties and improve the problem of single rice varieties. The gene provides an important way for the creation of dominant male sterile lines of rice and the popularization of recurrent breeding methods.

title_en: Refrigerating equipment, high-pressure thawing device, control method and control device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses refrigeration equipment, a high-voltage thawing device, a control method of the high-voltage thawing device and the control device, wherein the control method of the high-voltage thawing device comprises the steps of controlling electrode plates and/or conducting pins to move towards opposite electrode plates so that each conducting pin towards a substance to be thawed is separated from the substance to be thawed by a preset distance, and controlling the two electrode plates to work so as to generate a high-voltage electric field and thaw the substance to be thawed under high voltage. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the thawing effect of substances to be thawed with uneven surfaces and irregular shapes.

title_en: Hydrothermal purification method
abstract_en: A method and system for reducing contaminants contained in a contaminated feedstock, the method comprising mixing a contaminated feedstock with water and at least one metal scavenger or reactant to form a feedstock-water-reactant mixture, feeding the mixture under pressure to a hydrothermal purification reactor, wherein the mixture is subjected to heat, pressure and turbulence conditions to cause inorganic contaminants to react rapidly with the metal scavenger or reactant to form inorganic salts that partition into an aqueous phase, and maintaining the temperature, pressure and turbulence conditions of the feedstock-water-reactant mixture for a predetermined time to prevent conversion reactions of organic portions of the feedstock in the mixture, thereby forming a hydrothermal reactor effluent; the effluent is separated into an aqueous phase containing a salt of the inorganic contaminant and an organic phase containing a lower concentration of inorganic contaminant than the contaminated feed.

title_en: Metaplasia with constipation-relieving and preservative functions, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metagen with constipation and corrosion prevention functions, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation. The metagen disclosed by the invention is prepared by fermenting lactobacillus paracasei Postbio-P6 and lactococcus lactis Postbio-F3, and has good food preservative effect and constipation improving function, so that the metagen has important application value in the aspects of food preservation, constipation symptom improvement and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional protein based on lactobacillus surface LPxTG structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional protein based on a lactobacillus surface LPxTG structure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the amino acid sequence of the multifunctional protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. Compared with the prior art, the multifunctional protein based on the LPxTG structure on the surface of the lactobacillus has both adhesion property and esterase property, wherein the adhesion rate of the lactobacillus to the gastrointestinal tract can be improved through the adhesion property, so that the colonization property of the lactobacillus in the intestinal tract is improved, a foundation is provided for the intestinal tract probiotics function of the lactobacillus, and the hydrolysis of bovine milk fat can be assisted through the esterase activity of the multifunctional protein, so that the lipolysis is promoted, and more high-quality fatty acids are produced.

title_en: Preparation method of monkey mushroom vegetarian diced chicken
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a monkey vegetable diced chicken, which comprises the following steps: cleaning Hericium erinaceus, drying, and grinding Hericium erinaceus into powder; mixing Hericium erinaceus powder, wheat protein, soybean protein, whey protein, casein and pea protein, and adding water to mix and stir; carrying out high-moisture extrusion treatment on the uniformly mixed materials at 100-110 ℃, and adding an aqueous solution dissolved with a seasoning bag on line in the extrusion process; and then placing the extruded material into a die for molding, and then cutting and cooling to obtain the monkey mushroom diced chicken. The vegetarian chicken dices are prepared from the monkey mushroom, the wheat protein, the soybean protein, the hericium erinaceus, the whey protein, the casein, the pea protein and the soybean lecithin, not only have high nutritive value, but also increase the taste of the vegetarian chicken dices, and are more popular to people for eating.

title_en: Natural edible fungus sauce processing method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a processing method of natural edible fungus sauce, which takes special edible fungus such as pig tripe, seafood mushroom, black skin termitomyces albuminosus and the like as raw materials, is supplemented with Guizhou special fermented wheat sauce, glutinous rice cake chilli, flavored fermented soybean and the like, does not add chemical synthetic seasonings, adopts a segmented variable temperature drying and short time frying process, furthest retains nutritional value, simultaneously excites edible fungus flavor substances, greatly enhances the anti-corrosion and antibacterial properties of products by adopting more than 10 medicinal and edible spice, and controls the peroxide value and acid value of the products by low-temperature long-time oil soaking so as to ensure the quality and edible mouthfeel of the products after long-term storage. The utility model optimizes the quality of the edible fungus sauce jointly from the aspects of formulation and process, and provides the edible sauce which is unique in raw material, fresh and fragrant in flavor, innovative in process, free of preservative and natural and healthy.

title_en: Pokeberry protein Panip2 and encoding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pokeberry protein PaNIP2 and a coding gene and application thereof. The invention identifies a protein from pokeberry (Phytolacca Americana l.) that is related to its ability to super-enrich rare earth elements, particularly heavy rare earth elements, designated PaNIP2. Through over-expressing protein PaNIP2 in fungi or plants, the enrichment capability of the fungi or plants on rare earth elements, especially heavy rare earth elements, can be improved, can be used for cultivating transgenic plants with large biomass and rare earth element enrichment, and can further repair soil polluted by the rare earth elements by using the obtained transgenic plants. The invention not only enriches the molecular resources related to the rare earth elements enriched by plants, but also is beneficial to the restoration of the rare earth polluted soil and the recycling of the rare earth elements.

title_en: Soybean GmGA20ox4 gene and encoding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The soybean GmGA20ox4 gene and its coding protein and application relates to the field of soybean gene engineering, especially soybean GmGA20ox4 gene and its coding protein and application. The invention provides a GmGA20ox4 gene for coding gibberellin 20 oxidase, which is separated from soybeans, and can regulate and control the content of bioactive gibberellin in soybeans, influence the plant height of the soybeans and be used for realizing the breeding target of soybean semi-dwarf plant types. The CDS sequence of the soybean GmGA20ox4 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 in the sequence table. The amino acid sequence of the coded protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The gene participates in regulating the biosynthesis process of soybean gibberellin, influences the content of bioactive gibberellin in soybean, and finally influences the plant height of soybean. The method can be used for optimizing lodging resistance and close planting resistance of the soybean and realizing the breeding target of the semi-dwarf soybean plant type.

title_en: Refrigerator, ice plating method and ice plating device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric appliances, and provides a refrigerator, an ice plating method and a spraying system. The ice plating method comprises the steps of determining that food materials exist in an ice plating chamber of a refrigerator, obtaining the detection temperature of the ice plating chamber, determining that the detection temperature is in a set temperature range, and controlling a spraying system of the refrigerator to start spraying or spraying water into the ice plating chamber. According to the ice plating method of the refrigerator, the ice plating effect of the food materials is guaranteed by controlling the temperature conditions in the ice plating chamber, so that the freshness and moisture preservation of the food materials are guaranteed, and the storage period of the food materials is prolonged.

title_en: Sucrose-free fermented milk and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing and discloses sucrose-free fermented milk and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fermented milk comprises 8-15 parts by mass of whole milk powder, 1.01-5.03 parts by mass of sweetener, 0.81-2.02 parts by mass of stabilizer, 0.002-0.020 parts by mass of starter and the balance of ultrapure water, the ACE inhibition activity of the fermented milk can reach 95.7-99.7%, the blood pressure of a hypertensive eater can be effectively reduced, the fermented milk still has the effect of reducing the blood pressure after the hypertensive eater stops eating the fermented milk for 4 th week, the fermented milk is not added with sucrose, can be stored under normal temperature conditions, does not need refrigeration, the shelf life at normal temperature can reach 150-180 days, people who have high blood pressure and need to limit sugar intake and dislike cold food can eat, and the preparation method of the fermented milk has the advantages of simple process, low cost, short fermentation time and easy industrialized production.

title_en: Sesame paste seasoning and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seasonings, and particularly relates to a sesame paste seasoning and a preparation method thereof. According to the sesame paste seasoning, sesame paste, spice, sesame, edible oil, sodium starch octenyl succinate, citrus fiber, acidic substances, edible salt, water and auxiliary materials are used as raw materials, the proportion of the citrus fiber and the sodium starch octenyl succinate is reasonably limited, the citrus fiber and the sodium starch octenyl succinate are used in a combined mode, hydrophilic lipophilic groups of the sodium starch octenyl succinate are solidified by the citrus fiber with a net structure, the physical stability is enhanced, the acidic substances and the edible salt are combined, the high permeability and the acidic antibacterial effect of the edible salt are improved, the corrosion resistance of a system is improved, and the sesame paste seasoning which is free of corrosion resistance and uniform and stable in physical state and quality can be prepared without adding a preservative.

title_en: Application of Yan flower MYB4b protein in regulation and control of plant leaf morphology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to application of a swallow flower MYB4b protein in regulation and control of plant leaf morphology. The nucleotide sequence of the YAB 4b protein of the Yan flower is shown as SEQ ID No.1, the amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID No.2, and the gene can narrow the leaf of common tobacco and deepen the leaf color, which shows that the MYB4b gene of the Yan flower has the function of regulating the morphogenesis of the leaf of plants. The swallow flower MYB4b protein and the coding gene thereof provided by the invention not only provide an important theoretical basis for the regulation and control of the leaf shape of the swallow flower, but also provide important gene resources for the breeding of other foliage plants.

title_en: A method for improving dough or batter with fungal fermentation product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving dough or batter by using a fungus fermentation product, belonging to the technical field of food processing. Firstly, performing steps of strain extraction, flat inoculation, seed expansion culture, liquid submerged culture and the like on selected fungus fruiting bodies to obtain fungus liquid submerged fermentation liquid; the fungus fruiting body can be common fungi such as Lentinus Edodes, ganoderma, etc.; preparing improved dough or batter by using the fungus liquid submerged fermentation liquid as a raw material; the improved dough or batter can be applied to the preparation of flour products such as bread, steamed bread, noodles or cakes. The fungus deep fermentation liquid is used as a functional food additive to prepare dough or batter, so that the processing performance of the dough or batter can be improved, the water retention of the dough or batter can be improved, and the storage performance of the processed dough or batter product can be improved. Meanwhile, the adopted fungus fermentation liquor has various bioactive substances, so that the nutritional value and the health care function of the dough or the batter processed product can be increased.

title_en: Composite preparation for earthworm enzymolysis, preparation method and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of amino acid additives in the feed industry, in particular to a composite preparation for earthworm enzymolysis, a preparation method and a use method thereof. The compound preparation for earthworm enzymolysis is prepared by mixing 3% -13% of compound enzyme, 4% -15% of compound trace elements and 30% -90% of molasses, wherein the compound enzyme consists of cellulase, beta-glucanase and pectase, the compound trace elements consist of ferrous sulfate, zinc sulfate, sodium acetate and manganese sulfate, and the molasses consists of sugar and various beneficial microorganisms; when in use, the compound preparation is activated by clean water, then is scattered into earthworm raw materials to be manufactured, and is subjected to closed enzymolysis for 72 hours. The composite preparation prepared by the invention can fully hydrolyze earthworms, has the enzymolysis degree of more than 95%, is beneficial to storage and convenient to transport, can be used for developing feed resources, improves the nutrition quality of feed, supplements trace elements required by animals, improves palatability, feeding promoting effect and disease resistance, and has important effects on the development of feed industry and aquatic livestock industry.

title_en: Circulating rice wine distiller
abstract_en: The invention provides a circulating rice wine distiller, which comprises a first heating box, wherein a first mounting groove is formed in the first heating box, a first heating plate is fixedly connected to the first heating box in the first mounting groove, and a circulating mechanism is arranged on one side of the first heating box, so that a condensing bin generally used for distilling rice wine is improved, the temperature of the condensing bin can be influenced by gaseous high-temperature alcohol after the condensing bin is used for a long time, the condensing efficiency of the condensing bin can be reduced, and the time required by distillation is increased.

title_en: Liquid medicine for preserving vegetables and preservation method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of vegetable preservation, and particularly discloses a liquid medicine for vegetable preservation and a preservation method. The liquid medicine for vegetable preservation comprises the following raw materials: hypochlorous acid, tea polyphenol, collagen powder, chitosan microcapsules, white carbon black and purified water; wherein the concentration of the hypochlorous acid is 3-9mg/L. The liquid medicine for vegetable preservation and fresh-keeping prepared by the method has good antibacterial property, fresh-keeping property and fresh-keeping durability, the raw material components are matched with each other, the film forming property of the liquid medicine is improved, and the liquid medicine has good effect on the subsequent vegetable preservation and fresh-keeping.

title_en: Composition, method and application for improving performance of aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of feed additives, and particularly provides a composition for improving the performance of aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 5-10% of stone powder, 5-10% of starch, 3-5% of diatomite, 2-5% of sodium sulfate, 1-3% of sodium citrate, 0-10% of thickener and the balance of water. The raw materials used in the composition for improving the performance of the aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme are all raw materials which are allowed to be added in the feed additive industry, so that the compliance and the safety of the product are ensured. The invention also provides a method for preparing the aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme preparation with acid resistance and pepsin resistance by using the composition to carry out post-treatment on the aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme, the method is simple and easy to implement, and the pH value of the obtained aflatoxin B1 degrading enzyme preparation in the preparation process can be improved to 52% by the synergistic effect of the components and the control of the pH value in the preparation process, the pepsin resistance retention rate can be improved to 89%, and the method has wide application prospect.

title_en: Deodorization agent and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials, in particular to a deodorization agent and preparation and application thereof. The deodorization and deodorization agent comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.001% -5% of ginger oil, 0.001% -90% of tea extract and 5% -99.998% of auxiliary agent; wherein the sum of the mass percentages of the components is 100 percent.
