In the invention, the sources of removing fishy smell of ginger oil and tea polyphenol are different, the labor division is different, and the mechanism is also different; the odor of ginger oil after the combination of the two can mask the odor based on the soil odor element and the 2-methyl isoborneol; the tea polyphenol has good adhesive property, is effectively adsorbed on the solid surface, enhances the sterilization and oxidation resistance, and reduces the activities of microorganisms and the generation of odor. The combination of the two may produce a synergistic effect of fishy smell removal.

title_en: Coloring composition for food products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of anthocyanin and/or betanin as a colorant in food products, plant extracts as sources of anthocyanin and/or betanin, compositions comprising the plant extracts, and methods of using anthocyanin and/or betanin or compositions described herein.

title_en: Palm meal feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a palm meal feed and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of animal feeds and have the technical scheme that: comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 100g of palm meal, 0-0.5% of single-function microbial inoculum, 0-0.5% of enzyme preparation and 0-0.5% of mixed microbial inoculum. According to the invention, through the optimal addition of the single functional microbial inoculum, the enzyme preparation and the mixed microbial inoculum selected by screening, enzyme-bacteria compounding is carried out, and the optimal combination of enzyme-bacteria combination is screened, so that an enzyme-bacteria combination feed product containing high proportion of crude fibers, total non-starch polysaccharides and other anti-nutritional factors in the biodegradable palm meal is developed, and the digestibility of the palm meal is improved.

title_en: Steamed bread quality improver, preparation method of steamed bread and steamed bread
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of steamed bread making, in particular to a steamed bread quality improver, a preparation method of steamed bread and the steamed bread, wherein the improver comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 0.15-0.25 part of glucose oxidase, 0.20-0.35 part of amylase, 1.2-2 parts of sodium stearoyl lactylate, 20-25 parts of hydroxypropyl distarch phosphate and 0.5-1.0 part of polydextrose; the modifier has the advantage of reducing the hardness of steamed bread when the steamed bread is placed for a long time.

title_en: Intelligent grain drying method and device based on microwave heat pump
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent grain drying method and device based on a microwave heat pump, and belongs to the field of grain drying, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial moisture content and volume weight of a drying substance, and determining the current substance type of the drying substance according to pre-established corresponding relations of different substance types, different moisture contents and volume weight; and drying the dried material according to the target drying model, wherein the target drying model comprises target microwave power and target hot air temperature matched with the current material type and the initial water content, and the target drying model is obtained by screening a plurality of candidate drying models with different microwave powers and different hot air temperatures according to the waist bursting rate and the whole polished rice rate. The method avoids the problems of long drying time and low efficiency, and ensures the best waist bursting rate and whole polished rice rate.

title_en: Preparation and application of brassica napus BnaTT12 gene and mutant thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of a brassica napus BnaTT12 gene and a mutant thereof, wherein 2 homologous copies BnaTT12.A07 and BnaTT12.C06 of the BnaTT12 gene are targeted and knocked out through a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, the brassica napus mutant with the BnaTT12 gene mutation is obtained, and researches show that compared with a wild type and a single mutant, compared with the wild type and the single mutant, the brassica napus mutant has the advantages that the procyanidine content in the seed coats of double homozygous mutant lines is reduced, the seed coats turn yellow and thin, the lignin content in the seed coats is reduced, and a yellow seed phenotype can be generated; and the oil content of mature seeds and the ratio of linoleic acid to linolenic acid are obviously increased. Therefore, the BnaTT12 gene can be applied to rape breeding to improve rape seed characters, has huge application potential and prospect, and provides new germplasm resources for rape quality breeding.

title_en: Application of soybean GmPHOTs family genes in regulation and control of plant isoflavone synthesis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of soybean GmPHOTs family genes in regulating and controlling plant isoflavone synthesis. The soybean GmPHOTs family genes include five members of GmPHOT a gene, gmPHOT b gene, gmPHOT c gene, gmPHOT a gene and GmPHOT b gene. The present invention obtains genetically edited soybean plants, such as genistin and daidzin, with reduced isoflavone content by creating GmPHOT s three-gene knockout mutant and GmPHOT s double-gene knockout mutant using CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing technology.

title_en: Mixed wine and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound wine and a preparation process thereof, wherein the compound wine is prepared from Chinese yam, raspberry, wrinkled gianthyssop herb, honey, rhizoma polygonati, medlar, ginseng and base wine, wherein 2-5g of Chinese yam, 2-5g of raspberry, 2-5g of wrinkled gianthyssop herb, 1-3g of honey, 1-3g of rhizoma polygonati, 3-6g of medlar and 3-6g of ginseng are added into each 1000mL of white wine, the base wine is white wine, the ginseng is artificially planted for 5 years and less than 5 years, and the white wine meets the regulations of GB/T20821 or GB/T20822 and GB 2757. The invention combines a plurality of components of Chinese yam, raspberry, wrinkled gianthyssop herb, honey, rhizoma polygonati, medlar and ginseng, and the Chinese yam has the effects of tonifying qi and yin, tonifying spleen, lung and kidney, securing essence and stopping leukorrhagia; the raspberry has the effects of stopping nocturnal emission, reducing urination, tonifying liver and kidney and improving eyesight; herba Pogostemonis has effects of eliminating dampness, relieving vomit, and relieving summer-heat; the honey has effects of removing toxic substances, clearing heat, invigorating spleen and stomach, and moistening dryness.

title_en: Temperature control equipment for goat milk microbial fermentation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses temperature control equipment for microbial fermentation of goat milk and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation, the temperature control equipment comprises a fermentation tank, wherein a control device is arranged on the surface of the fermentation tank, a heat dissipation groove is formed in the surface of the fermentation tank, a sealing groove is formed in the end face of the side where a tank opening of the fermentation tank is positioned, a tank door is arranged at the tank opening of the fermentation tank, an annular groove is formed in the end face of the fermentation tank, provided with the sealing groove, an annular plate is arranged on the surface of the fermentation tank, and a temperature adjusting mechanism is arranged on the annular plate; the annular plate is provided with a uniform regulating mechanism. Through being provided with temperature regulating mechanism for this device can regulate and control the temperature in the fermentation cylinder according to temperature sensor measuring temperature value, and then very big improvement the efficiency of goat milk fermentation and the quality after the goat milk fermentation.

title_en: Satiety meal replacement protein powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satiety meal replacement protein powder and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the field of food processing and comprise the following components: 15-17 parts of isolated soybean protein, 6-7 parts of dietary fiber coconut milk powder, 2-3 parts of resistant dextrin, 2-3 parts of maltodextrin, 0.3-0.5 part of yeast peptide, 0.1-0.2 part of compound vitamin, 1-1.5 parts of compound mineral, 0.05-0.07 part of microbion C and 0.2-05 parts of silicon dioxide. The satiety meal replacement protein powder provided by the invention has the effects of losing weight and reducing fat while meeting the satiety, and can also meet the basic nutrition required by the body. In addition, the food is rich in dietary fibers, multiple vitamins and minerals, achieves the effects of satiety and fat reduction, and reduces constipation. The product retains the nutritional ingredients and rich and pure natural coconut flavor of fresh coconut, provides mellow and rich taste for the product, and does not add any essence, pigment and preservative, thus really achieving good taste and no burden.

title_en: Fresh milk ice cream and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fresh milk ice cream and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of frozen food processing. The fresh milk ice cream provided by the invention comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-15 parts of skimmed milk powder, 1-5 parts of cream, 0.01-0.5 part of stabilizer, 1-10 parts of vegetable oil, 1-5 parts of emulsifier, 1-5 parts of sweetener, 0.1-1 part of yolk powder and 1-3 parts of ginseng polysaccharide. The invention screens the raw materials of the ice cream, improves the stability and the expansion rate of the fresh milk ice cream through the cooperative matching of the process conditions, and the prepared ice cream has fine taste, better flavor and effectively improves the quality of the ice cream.

title_en: Kidney-tonifying and kidney-nourishing beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a kidney-tonifying and kidney-nourishing drink and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the beverage comprises the steps of raw material preparation, raw material pretreatment, boiling, brewing, filtering and the like. The beverage uses fruits and foods as main ingredients for tonifying kidney, supplements required vitamins and microelements, and reasonably designs part of traditional Chinese medicines with the effects of tonifying kidney, nourishing kidney, protecting liver, promoting urination and the like, so that the beverage prepared by the invention can be suitable for most patients with different etiology and gender for tonifying kidney and nourishing kidney.

title_en: Garlic fruit moisture removing device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of moisture removal equipment, in particular to a garlic fruit moisture removal device which comprises a box body; a group of struts are fixedly connected to the bottom of the box body; the top and the bottom of the box body are respectively provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet; sealing covers are arranged in the feed inlet and the discharge outlet; a diffusion pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the inner wall of the box body, and the diffusion pipe corresponds to the feed inlet in position; the bottom end of the diffusion tube is fixedly connected with a multi-folded tube; the multi-fold pipe is fixedly connected with the inner side wall of the box body through a pair of reinforcing columns; the bending part of the highest end of the multi-fold pipe is fixedly connected with an air heater through a support column; the method is characterized in that the method is used for solving the problem that the garlic fruits are directly put into water-inlet-component removing equipment to complete the water-component removing work of the garlic fruits, but the mode lacks a pretreatment process for the water on the surfaces of the garlic fruits, so that a large amount of water enters the equipment along with the garlic fruits, further more time is needed for removing the water of the garlic fruits, and the water-component removing efficiency is reduced.

title_en: Application of atractylis lancea polysaccharide in preparation of gastric cancer treatment products
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of atractylis lancea polysaccharide application, and in particular relates to application of atractylis lancea polysaccharide in preparation of a product for treating gastric cancer. The preparation method of the atractylis lancea polysaccharide comprises the following steps: s1, cleaning rhizoma atractylodis, drying, crushing and sieving to obtain rhizoma atractylodis powder; s2, weighing rhizoma atractylodis powder, adding rhizoma atractylodis polysaccharide zymotic bacteria under the constant temperature oscillation of 30 ℃ for fermentation treatment, and separating and purifying the leaching liquor and the fermentation liquor after the fermentation is finished to obtain the rhizoma atractylodis polysaccharide. The atractylis lancea polysaccharide is proved to be capable of inhibiting PLGC cell proliferation, has the effects of promoting abnormal proliferation and apoptosis of gastric mucosa epithelial cells and inhibiting gastric mucosa canceration, and therefore has good application prospect in the aspect of preparing medicines or health-care foods for preventing and treating gastric cancer.

title_en: Polysaccharide copper, polysaccharide copper gel, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of biological medicine, relates to aquaculture, in particular to a copper compound, and particularly relates to polysaccharide copper, polysaccharide copper gel, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the polysaccharide copper or polysaccharide copper gel comprises the following steps: dissolving polysaccharide, starch and trisodium citrate in water, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed solution; cuCl is added  2  Slowly dripping hydrochloric acid solution into the mixed solution, adjusting the pH value, heating in a water bath for reaction, centrifuging and dialyzing the obtained product, and freeze-drying the dialyzate to obtain polysaccharide copper; concentrating the obtained dialysate to a concentration of 1.01-1.35 g/mL to obtain polysaccharide copper gel. The copper gel prepared by the application has good antibacterial activity on gram-positive bacteria and gram-negative bacteria, can slowly release copper, has low acute toxicity to mice, and has no obvious toxicity to the growth of young zebra fish.

title_en: Rapid and efficient culture method for induction and proliferation of hairy roots of mare
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid and efficient culture method for inducing and proliferating hairy roots of mare. The method comprises the steps of preparing an explant of the marshy embryo, activating agrobacterium rhizogenes, preparing an aggressive solution, impregnating the agrobacterium rhizogenes, co-culturing, and carrying out secondary and expansion culture. The method for inducing the mare embryo is simple to operate, high in efficiency and high in induction rate, provides a new way for converting the hairy roots of the mare embryo into secondary metabolites such as triterpenoid saponins of the mare embryo by utilizing agrobacterium rhizogenes, and can be used for producing alternative resources of pharmaceutical components of the industrial mare embryo on a large scale. Meanwhile, the method has important significance for the subsequent establishment of a genetic transformation system of the mare's fetus.

title_en: Preparation method of eurotium cristatum fermented tartary buckwheat powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a eurotium cristatum fermented tartary buckwheat powder, which relates to the technical field of fermentation engineering and comprises the following steps: s1: husking the tartary buckwheat to obtain tartary buckwheat rice; soaking the tartary buckwheat rice, and dehydrating and filtering the soaked tartary buckwheat rice; s2: steaming the filtered tartary buckwheat rice, and draining water after steaming; s3: adding tartary buckwheat bran powder and eucommia ulmoides male pollen into the tartary buckwheat rice drained in the step S2 to obtain a tartary buckwheat rice mixture; s4: sterilizing the mixture of the tartary buckwheat and the rice at high temperature and high pressure, and cooling; s5: inoculating Eurotium cristatum into the cooled tartary buckwheat rice mixture, uniformly stirring, and fermenting; s6: and after the fermentation is finished, drying and crushing the fermented product to obtain the eurotium cristatum fermented tartary buckwheat powder. The Eurotium cristatum and the tartary buckwheat rice are fermented together, so that the nutritional value of the tartary buckwheat powder is improved, the aroma of the tartary buckwheat powder is increased, the bitter taste of the tartary buckwheat powder is reduced, and the popularization of tartary buckwheat products is facilitated.

title_en: Peony peptide and peony seed oil peptide with immunity improving and brain strengthening effects, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peony peptide and peony seed oil peptide with immunity improving and brain strengthening effects, and a preparation method and application thereof. The peony seed oil is extracted from seed peony seed kernel and peony seed shell, contains various components of unsaturated fatty acid, and is rich in components. Animal experiments prove that the peony seed oil has obvious effects of enhancing immunity and strengthening brain. The peony seed oil peptide microcapsule can effectively release free fatty acid and collagen tripeptide, is easy to absorb in vivo and has good biological absorption effect.

title_en: Panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 and application thereof. The panda source Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 was deposited at the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at 2023, 3 and 14 days with the deposit number of GDMCC NO:63205, named: gao Liwei Shewanella (weissella koreensiskk). The strain has good acid resistance and bile salt resistance, and can ensure that enough biomass passes through the stress of the digestive tract environment; the bacteria have surface hydrophobicity and automatic aggregation capability; the extracellular metabolite after fermentation of the strain has the capability of removing DPPH free radical and hydroxyl free radical; the strain can produce feed enzyme preparations such as cellulase, beta-galactosidase and the like; the strain has good inhibition effect and copolymerization collection capability on pathogenic bacteria such as salmonella typhimurium, escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus and the like. In addition, animal feeding experiments show that the Gao Liwei Shewanella kk64 has good application prospects in the aspects of improving the feed value, improving the intestinal health of animals, enhancing the immunity of organisms, improving the meat yield of animals and the like as a probiotic feed additive.

title_en: Application of medicago sativa MtMET1 gene in regulation and control of plant stress tolerance
abstract_en: The invention discloses medicago sativa L MtMET1 The application of the gene in regulating and controlling the stress tolerance of plants. The invention takes medicago tribulus as an experimental material, from which a medicago tribulus DNA methyltransferase gene is cloned, and the CDS nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The invention uses bioinformatics tools to analyze the structural characteristics of the gene and further primarily analyzes the gene function by transforming Arabidopsis thaliana, and the result shows that the gene is over-expressed in Arabidopsis thaliana MtMET1 The transgenic plant of the gene has poorer stress resistance than the wild arabidopsis plant, which proves that the medicago truncatula is proved MtMET1 The gene has the function of regulating and controlling the adversity stress resistance of plants.

title_en: Utilization method of blood orange pomace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural product processing waste residue recycling production, and discloses a method for utilizing blood orange pomace, which comprises the steps of immersing blood orange pomace in water, adding pectase for enzymolysis and ultrasonic treatment to obtain a blood orange pomace mixed solution, adding sucrose into the mixed solution of blood orange pomace to adjust the sugar degree, and then adding saccharomyces cerevisiae to perform low-temperature fermentation to obtain the fermented fruit wine containing anthocyanin. According to the invention, the fermented fruit wine with the anthocyanin content of 20mg/L is produced by utilizing the blood orange pomace, the blood orange pomace is converted into fruit wine products rich in anthocyanin and having various health care effects such as antioxidation, anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor effects, the anthocyanin components rich in the blood orange pomace are fully utilized, the economic value of the blood orange pomace is greatly improved, and a method with higher economic value and environmental protection is provided for reutilization of the blood orange pomace.

title_en: Method for reducing acrylamide in coffee extract and soluble coffee product
abstract_en: The present application provides a method for reducing acrylamide in an aqueous coffee extract, the method comprising: contacting the aqueous coffee extract containing acrylamide with the coffee grounds at a temperature of 70 ℃ to 120 ℃ for at least 30 minutes to form an acrylamide depleted coffee extract.

title_en: Kidney-tonifying tea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A kidney-tonifying tea and a preparation method thereof comprise the following raw materials: 2-9 parts of medlar, 4-10 parts of hawthorn, 2-9 parts of black fungus, 4-7 parts of saffron, 2-7 parts of cornu cervi degelatinatum, 1-4 parts of fructus psoraleae, 1-3 parts of cordyceps sinensis, 2-5 parts of rhizoma curculiginis, 4-7 parts of cynomorium songaricum, 2-5 parts of codonopsis pilosula, 5-10 parts of sturgeon roe, 4-9 parts of male silkworm moth, 3-7 parts of silkworm chrysalis, 2-4 parts of loach, 2-4 parts of mulberry, 4-10 parts of kiwi fruit, 8-12 parts of pomegranate, 3-8 parts of honey, 1-2 parts of hippocampus powder, 0.005-0.01 part of ubiquinone and water. After the formula is adopted, the invention has the following advantages: the kidney-tonifying tea disclosed by the invention is composed of mixed liquor A, mixed liquor B, mixed liquor C and extractum which are added with honey, has the effects of tonifying qi and strengthening yang, tonifying qi and producing sperm, is wide in raw material sources, easy to manufacture and low in cost, and has the advantages of improving metabolism of organisms, improving kidney functions, causing the organisms to urinate and strengthen kidneys, improving permeability of cell membranes, taking tea, chinese herbal medicines and fruit tea as the basis, and selecting purely natural plants as medicinal and edible homologous drinks as raw materials, and the formula is scientific.

title_en: Preparation method of tartary buckwheat meal replacement food and tartary buckwheat meal replacement food
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a tartary buckwheat meal replacement food and the tartary buckwheat meal replacement food, which comprise the following steps: step 1: pretreating tartary buckwheat, hawthorn, dwarf lilyturf tuber, radix glehniae, kudzuvine root, white kidney beans and radix pseudostellariae, and drying to obtain tartary buckwheat mixed powder to be subjected to enzymolysis; step 2: placing the mixed powder of the tartary buckwheat to be subjected to enzymolysis in an enzyme solution A at 80-90 ℃ for enzymolysis for 20-40min, cooling to 40-60 ℃, adding an enzyme solution B for enzymolysis for 20-40min, and drying to obtain mixed powder B of the tartary buckwheat; step 3: the bitter gourd peptide and stevioside are added to obtain the finished product of the bitter buckwheat meal replacement food powder, the preparation method disclosed by the application is simple, the raw material cost is low, the effects of slowly increasing sugar and assisting in reducing sugar are achieved, the economic burden on target people is small, the bitter gourd peptide and stevioside are suitable for the masses of the population, the product solubility is good, the mass production can be realized, the prepared food can be prepared into various types of foods, and the requirements of the masses can be met.

title_en: Mellow fungus
abstract_en: The invention discloses mellow bacteria, relates to the technical field of bioengineering, and is used for converting sewage into liquid fuel. The beneficial effects are as follows: the mellow bacteria are used for converting sewage into liquid fuel, so that a novel method for treating sewage is provided, the pollution of the sewage to the environment is reduced, waste is changed into valuable, the sewage is converted into the liquid fuel, a novel energy source is provided, the dependence of human beings on non-renewable energy sources is reduced, and a novel idea is opened for human beings to utilize the energy source. The mellow fungus has great development space for life science. Practice proves that. The alcohol bacteria and traditional Chinese medicine are matched, and the alcohol bacteria and traditional Chinese medicine are compared, namely, one hundred jin of sorghum liquor is firstly taken, the alcoholic strength is required to be more than 52 degrees, then, caulis spatholobi, sargentgloryvine stem, northern insect flowers, bones and muscles , one jin of sweet osmanthus are taken, two cordyceps sinensis are taken, 8 blue dragonflies are taken, half jin of red dates are soaked in the liquor, ten days later, mellow bacteria are put in, and after two hours, the wine is filtered, thus obtaining the ninety-six jin of microbial liquor which can tonify kidney, strengthen waist, improve the marginal epidemic force and delay aging.

title_en: Heat-resistant regulating gene of flowering cabbage and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a heat-resistant regulation gene of a heart and application thereof, wherein the heat-resistant regulation gene of the heart is meiosis related gene BrASY2 and aspartokinase gene BrAK3. The nucleotide sequence of the BrASY2 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the BrAK3 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The BrASY2 gene and the BrAK3 gene disclosed by the invention have very important functions in regulating and controlling the heat resistance of the vegetable center, can effectively regulate and control the heat resistance of the vegetable center, can be applied to regulating and controlling the heat resistance of the vegetable center, lay a theoretical foundation for researching the mechanism of plant response to high-temperature signals, provide gene resources for cultivating new varieties of heat-resistant vegetable center, and have better potential application value.

title_en: Uniform stirring leaching device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of meat product processing, in particular to a uniform stirring leaching device, which comprises a kettle body, a stirring tank and a stirring tank, wherein the kettle body is used for leaching meat products; the feeding barrel is arranged above the kettle body and used for feeding the device, and the top end of the feeding barrel is provided with a discharging component used for discharging meat products in the feeding barrel at a constant speed; the leaching barrel is arranged in the kettle body and used for leaching and processing meat products, and the bottom end of the leaching barrel is provided with a stirring assembly; the lifting rod is arranged at the middle end of the leaching barrel and is used for lifting the leaching barrel; the kettle cover is provided with two, is arranged at the top end of the kettle body, is used for sealing the kettle body when the kettle body works, and can realize the automatic process of processing and leaching meat products through the combined use of the feeding barrel and the leaching barrel. The application solves the problems that automatic feeding and leaching are inconvenient when meat products are processed and leached in the prior art, so that the labor processing cost is reduced and the leaching efficiency is inconvenient to improve by mutually matching the feeding barrel and the leaching barrel.

title_en: Lactobacillus mucilaginosus YYS-K2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microorganisms, and provides lactobacillus mucilaginosus YYS-K2 and application thereof. The preservation number of the lactobacillus mucilaginosus YYS-K2 is CGMCC No.27129. The fermented lactobacillus mucilaginosus YYS-K2 can produce Alcohol Dehydrogenase (ADH), has good ethanol tolerance and degradation capability, can grow in a high-concentration ethanol culture medium, has remarkable inhibition effect on alpha-amylase inhibition, has remarkable OH and DPPH free radical scavenging capability and good reduction capability, and can provide a new probiotic source for development of functional products such as anti-alcoholic products, antioxidant products, slimming products (alpha-amylase inhibition functional products) and the like, and has important application value.

title_en: Preparation technology of composite vegetable soup base package
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to a preparation process of a composite vegetable soup base packet, and in particular relates to a composite vegetable mixing, crushing and stirring machine, which comprises a mixing processing bin with a cylindrical structure, wherein an independent pre-cutting mechanism, a pre-mixing mechanism and a crushing and mixing mechanism are arranged in the mixing processing bin; in the whole crushing processing preparation process of various vegetable materials, the invention can synchronously pre-cut and pre-mix the various vegetables, can realize the decomposition of processing steps, and can greatly reduce the working pressure of a final crushing mixing mechanism, thereby greatly improving the whole crushing and mixing efficiency of the materials, ensuring the uniformity of the sizes of crushing particles of the various vegetable materials and the uniformity of mixing among different vegetable particles, and being capable of being mixed in place at one time without carrying out subsequent supplementary stirring and mixing.

title_en: Nutrient solution production equipment for improving female secondary ovarian function decline and formula thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nutrient solution production equipment, in particular to nutrient solution production equipment for improving female secondary ovarian function decline and a formula thereof. According to the invention, the filter plate and the baffle are arranged, when raw materials are introduced into the dissolving tank, the filter plate can filter the raw materials, medicine residues are separated at the position between the outer side of the filter plate and the side wall of the dissolving tank, when dissolved nutrient solution is completely discharged out of the dissolving tank through the liquid discharge valve, the heating wire is started, so that the medicine residues are heated, residual medicine liquid can be evaporated onto the condensing cover, and finally the medicine residues are collected through the liquid guide pipe, so that the medicine liquid remained in the medicine residues is prevented from being wasted.

title_en: Wild rice ghost virus B infectious clone vector and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a wild rice ghost virus B (wild rice ghost-like virus B, wrULVB) invasive cloning vector and a construction method thereof, which are obtained by cloning the wild rice ghost leaves serving as materials into a pCassRZ binary vector containing a cauliflower mosaic virus double 35S promoter in a multi-fragment homologous recombination mode on the basis of obtaining a WrULVB genome complete sequence. The application firstly obtains the virus vector pCassRZ-WrULVB which has systematic infection capability to the present smoke through agrobacterium mediation, lays a foundation for researching infection, replication, movement, transmission, pathogenic mechanism and the like of the virus through reverse genetics, and makes the transformation of the virus vector into a vector tool possible.

title_en: Big meat bag with cured meat flavor
abstract_en: A big meat bun with cured meat flavor comprises a hair surface skin and cured meat slices, and is characterized in that a big cured meat slice is wrapped in the hair surface skin and then steamed in a cage to obtain the big meat bun with cured meat flavor.

title_en: Intestinal composite probiotic composition for marine fish culture and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound probiotics for mariculture and application thereof, which are characterized by comprising a mixture of bacillus vietnamensis Bacillus vietnamensis, bacillus licheniformis Bacillus licheniformis and Brevibacterium lactobacilli. The invention obviously improves the specific growth rate of the weight of the sea fish to be more than 0.43 percent and the specific growth rate of the body length to be more than 0.26 percent, and provides theoretical basis and technical support for the application and development of the marine culture animal composite probiotic preparation.

title_en: Flavor nanoemulsions for beverage and personal care applications
abstract_en: The present application relates to a flavor nanoemulsion comprising: surfactant systems comprising polyoxyethylene sorbitan fatty acid esters and fatty acid polyglycerol esters (PGEs), comprising a non-polar phase of flavor oils, and a polar phase. The application also relates to a flavored beverage comprising the flavor nanoemulsion according to the application.

title_en: Poultry feed containing bacillus natto for improving immunity of broiler chickens
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of broiler immunity regulation and poultry feed preparation, and particularly discloses a poultry feed containing bacillus natto for improving broiler immunity. The poultry feed comprises basic ration and bacillus natto premix, wherein the basic ration consists of corn, soybean meal, soybean oil, stone powder, salt, lysine, methionine, premix, choline chloride, calcium hydrophosphate and compound vitamin, the metabolizable energy is 12-13MJ/kg on the nutrition level, the crude protein content is 19-21%, the calcium is 0.9-1.1%, the available phosphorus is 0.5-0.7%, and the methionine is 0.4-0.5%, so that the growth requirement of broilers is completely met, and the composition is simple and the cost is low; a small amount of bacillus natto premix is added into the basic ration, which is favorable for repairing damaged intestinal tracts of the broiler chickens in a stress state, improving the growth performance of the broiler chickens and enhancing the immunity of organisms, thereby improving the breeding efficiency of the broiler chickens.

title_en: Method for identifying black embryo disease resistance of wheat to be tested and molecular marker
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for identifying the resistance of wheat to be tested to black embryo disease and a molecular marker. The application provides application of a single nucleotide polymorphism of a specific SNP locus (38 th position of SEQ ID No.4 on a wheat 3B chromosome, T or G) on a wheat genome as a marker in identification or auxiliary identification of black embryo disease resistance of wheat. According to the application, KASP primers are developed according to the specific SNP locus, and molecular marker assisted screening can be carried out on the black embryo genes. The application has important significance for cultivating the wheat variety with the enhanced melanosis antibody.

title_en: Green tea preparation process
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of green tea preparation, in particular to a green tea preparation process; step one: removing impurities after picking up tea leaves, and flushing the tea leaves by using clear water; step two: selecting the washed tea leaves, and selecting the tea leaves with similar and full lengths; step three: spreading the tea leaves in a preparation device, and rubbing the tea leaves in one direction by using the preparation device to curl the tea leaves; step four: and drying the curled tea leaves to obtain long-strip coiled green tea leaves. The preparation device comprises a top plate and a rotating frame, wherein the top plate and the rotating frame are respectively connected with two rotating rollers in a rotating mode, a belt is sleeved between the two rotating rollers on the top plate in a rotating mode, a conveying belt is sleeved between the two rotating rollers on the rotating frame in a rotating mode, two outer shafts are respectively formed on two sides of the top plate, one end of each rotating rod is connected to each outer shaft in a rotating mode, and each rotating rod can rotate around the other end of each rotating rod; can continuously knead long strip coiled green tea leaves.

title_en: Probiotic fermented drink for regulating gastrointestinal functions of human body and assisting and reducing fat and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a probiotic fermented drink for regulating gastrointestinal functions of a human body, assisting and reducing fat and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of probiotic drinks. The invention provides a preparation method of a probiotic fermented drink for regulating gastrointestinal functions of a human body, assisting and reducing fat, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding water into fruits and vegetables to pulp to obtain fruit and vegetable pulp; (2) Mixing the fruit and vegetable pulp with glucose and fructose to obtain a fruit and vegetable culture medium; (3) Inoculating probiotics into the fruit and vegetable culture medium for fermentation to obtain probiotic fermentation liquor; (4) And mixing the probiotic fermentation liquid with the white kidney bean extract to obtain the probiotic fermentation drink. The probiotic fermented drink for regulating gastrointestinal functions of human bodies and assisting and reducing fat can achieve better fat reducing effect under the combined action of probiotics and alpha-amylase inhibitor.

title_en: Oyster-source exosome-like vesicle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano biological materials, and discloses an oyster-source exosome-like vesicle and a preparation method and application thereof, in particular discloses an oyster-source exosome-like vesicle which is separated from oyster meat; the exosome-like vesicles contain osteogenic mineral elements. The invention discloses oyster-source exosome-like vesicles for the first time, which are nano-scale membrane vesicles, have typical tea-tray-like shapes, have average particle diameters of less than 150nm, can carry osteogenic mineral elements such as calcium, phosphorus and the like, can be effectively taken up by osteoblasts, have the effect of promoting proliferation and differentiation of the osteoblasts, have the effect of improving osteoporosis, and can be used as a beneficial dietary supplement for delaying related functional foods of bone loss.

title_en: Polygonatum sibiricum wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rhizoma polygonati wine and a preparation method thereof, wherein rhizoma polygonati, rhizoma polygonati odorati, red ginseng, mulberry, medlar, chinese yam, poria cocos, fructus amomi, dried ginger, cinnamon, fructus alpiniae oxyphyllae and dried orange peel are mixed and crushed to obtain premixed powder; parching semen Panici Miliacei with small fire, adding premixed powder, parching with small fire, and pulverizing to obtain clinker; adding malt flour and saccharifying enzyme into water, heating to obtain malt saccharifying liquid, adding malt saccharifying liquid and Daqu into clinker, stirring, pre-fermenting, and filtering to obtain filter residue and filtrate; and then spreading filter residues, inoculating aspergillus oryzae spore suspension and propionibacterium liquid, performing solid state fermentation to obtain a solid state fermentation product, uniformly mixing the solid state fermentation product with filtrate, performing mixed fermentation, and performing post-treatment to obtain the product. The rhizoma polygonati wine has high rhizoma polygonati polysaccharide content, proper drinking of the rhizoma polygonati wine does not hurt the stomach, and has good health care effect.

title_en: Flavoring wine produced by using Maotai-flavor white spirit by-products and production method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a flavoring wine produced by using a sauce flavor type white spirit byproduct, which is prepared from waste distillers' grains and fermented yellow water with a soysauce flavor; wherein, the waste lees are fully hydrolyzed by cellulase and pectase and then are subjected to metabolism fermentation by lactobacillus, acetic acid bacteria and high-temperature Daqu; the fermented yellow water with the sauce flavor is extracted by the off-the-shelf wine and then is combined with catabolites of the waste lees, and then the combined liquid is subjected to catalytic esterification and distillation to obtain the flavoring wine. The substrates used in the flavoring wine and participating in fermentation are all from mass production materials, and wastes are reused; wherein, the concentration of organic acid substrate and various flavor substances of esterification reaction are greatly enriched; the wine body is cleaner by filtering and removing impurities for many times and aerating and removing peculiar smell; and Yu Zao, residual liquid and colloid solid in the production process are recycled, so that clean production friendly to the environment of enterprises is truly realized.

title_en: Animal bifidobacterium subspecies lactis King31 for deodorizing dogs and cats as well as microbial inoculum, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganism application, in particular to a bifidobacterium animalis subspecies lactis King31 for deodorization of dogs and cats, a microbial inoculum, a preparation method and application. The bifidobacterium animalis subspecies (Bifidobacterium animalis subsp.lactis) King31 is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (China Committee) for culture Collection of microorganisms in the 8 th month 19 of 2022, and the preservation address is the North Chen West Lu No. 1, 3 of the Korean region of Beijing, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.25557. The strain is prepared into a microbial inoculum through a fermentation technology, the microbial inoculum can increase the content of bifidobacteria in the intestinal tracts of dogs and cats, and the intestinal flora is regulated, and experiments prove that after the microbial inoculum is continuously drunk for a period of time, the bad breath of pet dogs and pet cats is obviously improved, the odor components in the feces are obviously reduced, and the body odor is obviously improved.

title_en: Application of corn ZmGLSs 2 and ZmRAFS genes in improving crop seed yield
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of corn ZmGLS 2 and ZmRAFS genes to improvement of crop seed yield. The invention also discloses application of the corn ZmGLS 2 and ZmRAFS genes in superposition to improving corn harvest index. The invention proves that the corn ZmGALS 2 and ZmRAFS genes are simultaneously over-expressed in corn, so that the relation of source libraries is changed, the harvest index is improved, and the corn kernel yield is improved.

title_en: Zoysia japonica salt tolerance gene ZmLA1, protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides zoysia japonica salt-tolerant gene ZmLA1 and protein and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The invention clones a new zoysia japonica salt-tolerance related gene ZmLA1 for the first time, and the nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The zoysia japonica salt tolerance related gene ZmLA1 is introduced into plants, so that the salt tolerance of the plants can be improved, and the zoysia japonica salt tolerance related gene ZmLA1 can be applied to genetic improvement of the plants. The zoysia japonica salt-tolerance related gene ZmLA1 is constructed into a plant expression vector, and genetic transformation is carried out by an agrobacterium-mediated method, so that a new germplasm with salt-tolerance characteristic can be obtained, and the zoysia japonica salt-tolerance related gene ZmLA1 has important significance for cultivation of new varieties of good crops and wide application in production.

title_en: Hovenia dulcis anti-alcoholic beverage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hovenia dulcis anti-alcoholic beverage which is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 20% of hovenia dulcis original juice, 10% of white granulated sugar, 0.06% of xanthan gum and the balance of water. The fruit juice blending experiment shows that the process is optimized by adopting an orthogonal experiment under a single factor experiment to obtain 20% of the original juice of the hovenia dulcis thunb, 10% of the white granulated sugar, and 0.06% of the xanthan gum, the taste of the fruit juice of the hovenia dulcis thunb is soft, the flavor of the hovenia dulcis thunb is thick, the color and luster are transparent, no precipitation impurity exists, the sweetness is proper, and the nutrient elements are rich; physical and chemical index measurement is carried out on the hovenia dulcis thunb juice, the juice content is 11%, the soluble solid content is 9%, the total acid content is 0.25%, the protein content is 0.8g/100ml, and the vitamin C content is 5mg/100ml; and (3) determining the total number of the bacterial colonies of the hovenia dulcis thunb juice to obtain <100 bacterial colony total acids and <3 escherichia coli, wherein the bacterial colony total acids and the escherichia coli total acids all meet the national food sanitation requirements.

title_en: Method for reducing oil absorption of fried potato strips
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for reducing oil absorption of frying chips, wherein the device comprises the following components: the frying device comprises a frying cavity, a draining cavity, a vacuum device, a frying basket and a reciprocating lifting mechanism, wherein the draining cavity is arranged at the upper end of the frying cavity, the top end of the draining cavity is provided with a rotary driving mechanism, the vacuum device is connected with the draining cavity or the frying cavity through a control valve, the frying basket is detachably connected with the rotary driving mechanism, and the frying basket is arranged between the draining cavity and the frying cavity in a reciprocating lifting mode. The device for reducing the oil absorption of the fries can finish two processes of frying and draining the fries, and clean the frying oil attached to the surfaces of the fries while draining the fries, so that the oil content of the fries is reduced. According to the method, a certain amount of gamma-oryzanol is added into grease, the physicochemical property of heat transfer medium oil in the frying process is regulated and controlled, the viscosity increase value of the frying oil is reduced, the evaporation and escape of moisture in the fried food are inhibited, and the oil absorption of the fried food in the frying process and the cooling stage is reduced by combining the centrifugal rotation while the fried food is hot.

title_en: Lactobacillus casei and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactobacillus casei GS0605 which is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) for 5-22 days in 2023 and the preservation number is CGMCC NO.27393. The strain has good safety, does not produce hemolysis phenomenon on Columbia blood plates, is sensitive to various common antibiotics, has better tolerance to artificial stomach and intestinal juice, has strong adhesion capability to human colon cancer cells, has stronger cancer cell growth activity inhibition capability and cancer cell apoptosis promotion capability after fermentation supernatant and colon cancer cells HCT-116 are co-cultivated, and simultaneously has stronger inhibition capability to various pathogenic bacteria such as escherichia coli, pseudomonas aeruginosa and the like, has stronger acetic acid production capability and lactic acid capability, has higher degradation effect on cholesterol and has stronger antioxidation effect. Therefore, the strain has obvious probiotic effect and can be applied to the field of functional foods for human and animals.

title_en: Honeysuckle flower superfine powder tea beverage capable of refreshing and reducing pathogenic fire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides honeysuckle flower superfine powder tea for refreshing and reducing internal heat and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of tea drinks. The invention provides a preparation method of honeysuckle flower superfine powder tea for refreshing and reducing pathogenic fire, which comprises the following steps: (1) Decocting flos Lonicerae in water, and oven drying flos Lonicerae together with the decoction; (2) Parching the dried materials in the step (1), pulverizing, and micronizing to obtain flos Lonicerae micropowder; (3) And filling the honeysuckle superfine powder into a tea bag to obtain the honeysuckle superfine powder tea. The invention improves the extraction rate (more than 90%) and release rate of flavonoid substances by improving the preparation process of the honeysuckle ultrafine powder, and the proper soaking time is 5min and the proper drinking time is 30-60 min at the water temperature of 80 ℃.

title_en: Nutritional instant food package
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutrition instant food package, relates to the field of instant food packages, and solves the problems that the existing instant food package is less in main food category, unchanged in heating, large in size and inconvenient to carry outdoors in large quantities. The steamed stuffed bun has the characteristics of high nutrition, low fat and low sugar, wide applicable crowd, good taste and health.

title_en: Breeding method of rape with short stem and large flower period
abstract_en: The invention provides a breeding method of rape with short stems and large petals in a long flowering period, belonging to the technical field of rape breeding. The breeding method of the invention comprises the following steps: hybridization is carried out by taking the short-stalk cabbage type rape DY-1 as a female parent and the large-petal cabbage type rape 7633-56 as a male parent to obtain an F1 generation; microspore culture is carried out on the F1 generation plants to obtain DH strain; and (5) examining the DH strain characteristics, and selecting a strain with stable characteristics to obtain the gardening ornamental rape with short stem and large flower period petals. The invention establishes a gardening ornamental rape breeding technology system by utilizing a polymerization breeding method and a microspore culture technology, cultures rape germplasm materials which are suitable for modern consumers, establishes a scientific, accurate, objective and practical rape material identification technology system, and provides technical guarantees for protecting rape breeding property rights, registering new varieties, identifying and detecting rape material authenticity, standardizing rape seed market operation and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of polypeptide soup-stock
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing application, and particularly discloses a preparation method of polypeptide soup-stock, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing, namely adding water into fresh smashed chicken for steaming; s2, adding water and protease into the steamed chicken, and performing primary enzymolysis through an enzymolysis tank; s3, filtering out the enzymolysis liquid containing chicken bone and meat in the S2, and collecting for later use, and performing secondary enzymolysis; s4, filtering out the enzymolysis liquid containing chicken bone meat in the step S3; s5, filtering and concentrating the mixed solution obtained after the stewing in the S4; s6, homogenizing and mixing; s7, oil-water separation, ultrafiltration and sterilization are carried out, and the flavor polypeptide soup stock is prepared. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the polypeptide broth prepared by the secondary enzymolysis method has the characteristics of high nutritive value, fragrant flavor and the like, and has reasonable preparation process and high preparation efficiency; the fresh chicken, spice powder, shallot, ginger and cooking wine are deeply decocted, so that the traditional Chinese style herb Shang Fa can be reduced to the greatest extent, the nutrition loss is reduced, and the decocted soup stock is delicious and rich in taste.

title_en: Method for breaking collard self-incompatibility by malonyl-CoA
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reagent malonyl-CoA for breaking collard self-incompatibility, and also relates to application of the reagent in breaking collard self-incompatibility and effective concentration of the reagent in breaking self-incompatibility reaction. The invention discovers that the exogenous application of malonyl-CoA can effectively break the self-incompatibility reaction of collard, overcome the reproductive isolation caused by the self-incompatibility, promote the affinity pollination, and provide an effective means for improving the seed collection rate and breeding new varieties.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine biscuits capable of relieving dysmenorrhea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a traditional Chinese medicine biscuit for relieving dysmenorrhea and a preparation method thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine biscuit is prepared by adjusting the following raw materials in proportion into paste and baking: 8-16 g of prepared rehmannia root, 4.5-9 g of Chinese angelica, 4.5-9 g of white peony root, 3-6 g of szechuan lovage rhizome, 0.5-1.0 g of caper nut, 150-300 g of low gluten flour, 40-80 g of butter, 40-80 g of cream, 100-200 g of egg liquid and 150-300 mL of drinking water; compared with the traditional mode of relieving dysmenorrhea by Western medicines or traditional Chinese medicine decoction, the traditional Chinese medicine biscuits are more convenient to carry and eat, and greatly improve convenience; compared with western medicines and traditional Chinese medicine decoction, the biscuit shape is easier to be accepted by patients; in addition, the Chinese medicinal biscuit is added with the semen arecae so as to remove or greatly reduce bitter taste, and simultaneously, butter, cream and egg liquid are added, so that the mouthfeel can be improved, the nutrition can be increased, and the acceptance and satisfaction degree of patients can be further improved.

title_en: Three-screw puffing extrusion device with shunt for extruding large-aperture materials
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-screw puffing extrusion device with a shunt for extruding large-aperture materials, which relates to a puffing extrusion device, and comprises three groups of screws arranged in a screw sleeve assembly, wherein the screw sleeve assembly comprises a feeding area, a mixing area, an exhaust area and a metering output area; the metering output area is divided into a converging section and a diverging section, the accommodating cavity of the screw sleeve is divided into a converging cavity and a diverging cavity, each constituent diverging cavity is outwards extended to form a group of corresponding long discharge pipes, the engaging threads of the three groups of screws are extended to the converging cavity, the end part of each group of screws is also provided with diverging conveying threads respectively configured in the three constituent diverging cavities, the converging section is used for controlling the total flow of raw materials entering the converging cavity, the diverging section is used for controlling the flow of raw materials entering the three constituent diverging cavities, the sum of the single pitch volumes of the three constituent diverging cavities is the same as the single pitch volume of the converging cavity, and the production efficiency of the invention not only meets 3 times that of a single-outlet extrusion device, but also ensures that each discharge port can stably and uniformly discharge.

title_en: Probiotics cat food processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed preparation, in particular to a processing method of probiotic cat food. The beneficial effects of the invention are that the probiotic cat food with stable effect in long-term storage can be produced. The method comprises the following steps: s1: dispersing cat food raw materials, mincing, adding into processing equipment, and mixing to obtain paste; s2: sterilizing and preserving the chyme raw material by heat treatment; s3: adding the prebiotics and the probiotics into processing equipment, and mixing and granulating with the minced raw materials; s4: and spraying prebiotics and linseed oil on the surface of the granulated cat food so as to obtain the finished product of the probiotic cat food. The processing equipment comprises a shell, a mixing mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the shell, a heating mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the mixing mechanism, a granulating mechanism is arranged on the right side of the heating mechanism, a blanking box is fixedly connected on the upper side of the granulating mechanism, a control cabinet is fixedly connected on the lower side of the heating mechanism, the control cabinet is fixedly connected inside the shell, a part of a spraying mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the control cabinet, and the other part of the spraying mechanism is slidably connected on the lower side of the shell.

title_en: Spicy jam and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a spicy jam and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food jam preparation. The application takes Mao Laguo, large-square-wrinkle pepper, crisp whistle, vegetable oil, white granulated sugar, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, garlic, edible salt and spice as raw materials. The raw materials of the application mainly comprise Mao Laguo of Guizhou and large-square-wrinkled peppers, and the application has high nutritive value, low cost and abundant and easily available raw materials, wherein the crisp whistle prepared from pork by the local processing technique of Guizhou is added, so that the taste of the sauce is enriched. The whole sauce is simple in preparation process, the sour, hot, delicious and rich in fragrance taste of the product is endowed through reasonable matching between raw materials and auxiliary materials, the product has local special flavor in Guizhou, the production process and bottled packaging can basically realize mechanization and automation, the industrial feasibility of the product is high, and the problems of single taste and single nutritive value of the existing tomato sauce are solved.

title_en: Production process of birch sap nutrition spirit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of white birch juice nutrition spirit, which relates to the technical field of white birch juice spirit and comprises the following steps: s1: filtering the white birch juice stock solution, and sterilizing for 10-20 s at 120 ℃ by a high-temperature instantaneous sterilizer; s2: bacterial fermentation: fermenting at 30-35deg.C until juice becomes turbid; s3: and (3) yeast fermentation: the fermentation temperature is 16-20 ℃, the fermentation time is 50-60 days, and whether white granulated sugar needs to be added or not is judged according to the sugar content; s4: separating the raw wine; s5: twice distillation; s6: aging and storing to obtain birch sap year strong wine; s7: soaking with birch sap year strong wine respectively and (3) blending the ledum palustre and the inonotus obliquus. The invention takes the white birch juice as raw material, prepares the white birch juice nutrition spirit by bacterial fermentation, yeast fermentation, distillation and blending, reserves microelements and minerals in the white birch juice, enables bacillus subtilis to grow and reproduce to generate beneficial active substances, and finally soaks duxiang and inonotus obliquus to increase the aroma and the nutrition components of the product.

title_en: Application of wheat TaLAC gene 129
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheat TaLAC gene, the nucleotide sequence of the wheat TaLAC gene 129 is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the amino acid sequence of the coded protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention also provides application of the wheat TaLAC gene in culturing transgenic wheat plants, which comprises the steps of introducing the TaLAC gene into wild wheat plants to enable the TaLAC gene to be overexpressed to obtain transgenic plants, and researching that the overexpressed TaLAC gene can obviously improve the yield of wheat, can improve the laccase activity and lignin content of root systems and resist invasion of harmful bacteria or fungi, so that the TaLAC129 gene can be used for improving the yield and regulating plant stress resistance and has great application value for plant breeding.

title_en: Application of peanut glycosyltransferase AhUGT215 in improving stress resistance of plants
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of peanut glycosyltransferase AhUGT215 in improving stress resistance of plants. The invention discovers that glycosyltransferase gene AhUGT215 participates in the drought stress and salt stress response process of peanuts, and after the gene is overexpressed in Arabidopsis thaliana, the drought resistance and salt tolerance of transgenic plants are obviously improved. The invention provides excellent gene resources for creating novel drought-resistant and salt-tolerant crops after implementation, can be used for stress-resistant genetic improvement of subsequent crop varieties, and has great significance for agricultural production in China.

title_en: Geotrichum candidum for preventing and controlling aflatoxin and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotrichum candidum (Geotrichumcandidum) XG1 which can be used for preventing and controlling aflatoxin, and is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center with the preservation number of CGMCC No.27705. The strain can obviously inhibit the growth of aspergillus flavus, and the degradation rate of aflatoxin B  1  reaches 99-100%. In addition, on the dried chilli, peanut and corn, the aflatoxin B  1  produced by the aspergillus flavus can be obviously inhibited. Meanwhile, the strain can generate obvious fruit fragrance and has good application prospect in the fields of food, feed and the like.

title_en: Composition for improving fat-protein stability and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of A23C11/00, in particular to a composition for improving the stability of fat-protein and application thereof, which consists of an emulsifying agent, protein and a stabilizing agent; the emulsifier is at least one selected from monoglyceride, diglyceride, sucrose fatty acid ester, sodium stearoyl lactylate, diacetyl tartaric acid monoglyceride, polyglycerol monostearate, tween and span; the protein is at least one of soybean protein, gelatin, concentrated whey protein, sodium caseinate and pea protein; the stabilizer is at least one of xanthan gum, microcrystalline cellulose, sodium carboxymethylcellulose, guar gum, carrageenan, gellan gum, sodium alginate, acacia and modified starch, a composition composed of a specific emulsifier, the stabilizer and protein is selected based on the characteristics of raw materials, and is added into a thick coconut milk product system, and the composition is matched with a corresponding operation process to ensure good stability of the thick coconut milk product system in the shelf life of 6-9 months.

title_en: Processing technology of composite spice
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of processing of compound spices, and particularly provides a processing technology of the compound spices. According to the invention, the capsicum is pre-ground and crushed through the concave-convex matching of the wavy structure of the inner wall of the receiving cylinder and the outer wall of the conical cover, and the crushed capsicum is dried again through the heating component, so that the wet inner core of the capsicum is sufficiently dried after being crushed, the capsicum is conveniently subjected to secondary grinding, the problem of caking of the grinded capsicum caused by moisture in the capsicum is avoided, the grinding and screening effects of the capsicum are improved, the downward moving speed of the capsicum can be slowed down by the wavy structure of the inner wall of the receiving cylinder and the outer wall of the conical cover, the drying time of the capsicum is prolonged, the crushed capsicum is more dispersed, the contact area between the crushed capsicum and the wavy structure of the inner wall of the receiving cylinder and the wavy structure of the outer wall of the conical cover is increased, and the capsicum can be sufficiently dried.

title_en: Preparation method of instant chilli sauce with walnut oil flavor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of instant chilli sauce with walnut oil flavor, which is characterized in that dried chilli, pepper, ginger, garlic and mushroom are treated and washed by clear water, and the mushroom is washed, shredded and water-controlled for later use; decocting dry Capsici fructus in water to soft, draining, and pulverizing; cleaning rhizoma Zingiberis recens and Bulbus Allii, pulverizing, heating oleum Juglandis, frying in mushroom, frying mushroom to 6 dry, adding pulverized rhizoma Zingiberis recens and Bulbus Allii, frying for 20-40 s, adding dry Capsici fructus and fructus Zanthoxyli, rapidly stirring, adding appropriate salt, flavoring, cooling, bottling, and sealing. The walnut oil used in the invention has rich nutrition, light taste and easy digestion and absorption, a large amount of hot oil is used for instant flavoring of food materials, and the food materials are cured and then added with seasonings to prepare the chilli sauce.

title_en: Application of oleuropein in improving comfort level after drinking and alcoholic beverage
abstract_en: The application discloses application of oleuropein in improving comfort degree after drinking and a wine drink, wherein the application is characterized in that a large number of natural active substances with the effect of potentially improving the comfort degree after drinking are screened in vitro, the obtained oleuropein can effectively reduce oxidation and inflammation damage in vivo after drinking the wine, and can effectively relieve symptoms such as headache, dry mouth and the like after drinking the wine, so that the comfort degree after drinking the wine is more comprehensively and effectively improved.

title_en: Winter health-preserving soup and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses winter health-preserving soup and a preparation method thereof, wherein the winter health-preserving soup is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 500-850 parts of water, 230-270 parts of black-bone chicken, 100-130 parts of milk, 20-30 parts of Chinese yam, 20-30 parts of coix seed, 10-20 parts of carrot, 5-7 parts of red sage root, 4-6 parts of pseudo-ginseng, 5-6 parts of nutgrass galingale rhizome, 5-6 parts of tall gastrodia tuber, 5-6 parts of honeysuckle, 3-5 parts of ginseng, 3-5 parts of fleece-flower root, 3-4 parts of lucid ganoderma, 3-4 parts of chrysanthemum, 2-3 parts of Chinese angelica and 6-8 parts of additive. The winter health preserving soup disclosed by the invention can effectively reduce the magnitude of vasoconstriction of practical people, stabilize blood pressure or blood pressure, reduce heart burden, reduce the possibility of seasonal occurrence of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases of people in winter, and play an effective role in supplementing old people in winter and people with cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease history.

title_en: Cloning and application of sophora alopecuroide SaATHB7 gene
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of plant genetic engineering and provides a sophora alopecuroide SaATHB7 Cloning and application of the gene, by carrying out transcriptome sequencing on the sophora alopecuroide seedlings subjected to simulated adversity stress treatment, analyzing the obtained differential expression genes, screening out sophora alopecuroide genes related to salt stress, and finding that the genes possibly belong to homologous structural domain leucine zipper transcription factor family genes through the nucleic acid sequence of the genes obtained by sequencing, and naming the genes as SaATHB7 . According to the sequence obtained by sequencing, clone primer and quantitative primer are designed, and the gene is detected in reverse direction by using RT-PCR technologyUnder the condition of the environmental stress, the expression quantity in different tissues of the sophora alopecuroide is changed so as to primarily study the corresponding effect of the gene in the adversity stress of the sophora alopecuroide, and meanwhile, a plant over-expression vector is constructed for the gene and is successfully transferred into the wild type arabidopsis thaliana to perform functional primary verification, and the result shows that the salt tolerance and drought tolerance of the arabidopsis thaliana can be improved after the gene is over-expressed in the arabidopsis thaliana.

title_en: Screening method and application of ecological restoration plants in open mining abandoned land
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screening method and application of ecological restoration plants in open mining abandoned lands, and belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mines. The screening method comprises the steps of measuring plant biomass and the content of organic acid secreted by root systems for primary screening, calculating the total average value of membership functions for secondary screening, and combining the two screened ecological restoration plants to obtain the overlapped species of the ecological restoration plants in the open mining abandoned land. The method can screen out the ecological restoration herbaceous plants, shrubs and trees in the open-mining waste land, and has the advantages of short screening period, mature screening technology, controllable screening conditions, accurate screening results and the like.

title_en: Method for controlling postharvest black heart disease and water-borne heart disease of pineapple
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling postharvest black heart disease and water-borne heart disease of pineapple. Fruit picking and heat dissipation are carried out at room temperature below 25 ℃ within 12 hours after pineapple picking, water is heated to 50-63 ℃, 0-3% of calcium salt is added according to mass fraction to prepare hot solution, the hot solution is placed in the room temperature, pineapple is placed in the hot solution to be soaked for 1-20 minutes, then the pineapple is dried in the room temperature environment, and then the pineapple is stored or sold. The invention can be applied to postharvest before storage or before sales, has simple process, no drug residue, safety and no toxicity, does not need large-scale equipment, and plays a role in controlling postharvest black heart disease and water-borne heart disease of pineapple, thereby prolonging the storage period and shelf life.

title_en: Rice large grain gene qRBG1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and relates to a rice large-grain gene qRBG1 and application thereof. The invention discloses a rice large grain gene qRBG1, which has a CDS sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 and a promoter sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 3, wherein the encoded protein is a signal factor OsBZR5 of brassinolide signal transduction of rice, and has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. qRBG1 can be used for regulating rice grain types, improving rice yield and quality, and providing reliable gene resources for rice grain type design breeding research.

title_en: Multi-strain composition for producing puer tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-strain composition for producing puer tea, and relates to the technical field of puer tea processing; the strain composition is prepared from Saccharomyces cerevisiae PSac0501, and the preservation date is 16 days of 5 months of 2005, and the preservation number is: CGMCC No.1372; rhizopus arrhizus Prhi501, date of preservation: year 2007, 3 and 1, deposit number: CGMCC No.1963, aspergillus niger PAsp0501, preservation date: 5.16.2005, accession number: CGMCC No.1373 in proportion; through the procedures of preliminary screening, secondary screening, natural culture medium culture and purification culture by combining auxiliary materials; the inoculation amount of 0.1% is applied to the strains in the production process of the puer tea to ferment, the temperature of a fermentation chamber is controlled to be 50+/-5 ℃, the humidity is controlled to be 80+/-0.1%, when the temperature of the fermentation chamber is raised to be 30+/-5 ℃, the strain composition starts to metabolize, and a large amount of enzymes including glucose amylase, cellulase and pectinase are secreted along with the extension of the fermentation time.

title_en: Textured edible protein products derived from insect larvae or worms
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods and systems for producing textured edible protein products derived from insect larvae or worms. The method comprises a) reducing the size of insect larvae or worms to obtain a slurry, b) mixing the slurry with a hydrocolloid which gels with metal cations in an aqueous solution to form a protein-hydrocolloid slurry, and c) injecting the protein-hydrocolloid slurry into an aqueous solution of at least 2-valent metal cations to form a textured edible protein product. In step c), the protein-hydrocolloid slurry is sprayed under pressure into the aqueous solution from outside the aqueous solution of at least 2-valent metal cations at an oblique angle relative to the liquid surface of the aqueous solution, thereby producing flakes of the textured edible protein product in the aqueous solution in which substantially all of the hydrocolloid has gelled with the metal cations.

title_en: Defrosting control method of air-cooled refrigerator and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a defrosting control method of an air-cooled refrigerator and a computer storage medium. The defrosting control method of the air-cooled refrigerator comprises the following steps: receiving a defrosting trigger signal of the air-cooled refrigerator and controlling the defrosting module to be started; acquiring the actual running time of a compressor and the actual door opening time of an air-cooled refrigerator; determining the opening and closing states of the electromagnetic valve according to the actual running time and the actual opening time; and controlling the electromagnetic valve to work according to the determined opening and closing state. According to the scheme, the control method for defrosting the evaporator by utilizing the heat generated by the power amplifier can be provided, so that energy sources are effectively saved, and the use experience of a user is improved; the efficient heat dissipation of the power amplifier is achieved while defrosting the evaporator.

title_en: Swiss roll cake and production process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of food processing, and particularly discloses a Swiss roll cake and a production process thereof. The Swiss roll cake comprises a cake body, stuffing and a showering surface; the cake body comprises the following raw materials: 70-76 parts of honey, 284-300 parts of egg yolk, 180-200 parts of white granulated sugar, 380-400 parts of egg white, 115-125 parts of flour, 32-40 parts of cocoa powder, 82-90 parts of milk, 30-44 parts of butter and 20-28 parts of hazelnut paste; the stuffing comprises the following raw materials: 550-650 parts of cream, 25-35 parts of white granulated sugar, 25-35 parts of hazelnut paste and 18-24 parts of hazelnut paste; the shower surface comprises the following raw materials: 14500-1500 parts of dark chocolate, 1450-1550 parts of cocoa butter, 140-160 parts of hazelnut paste and 340-360 parts of hazelnut kernel. The Swiss roll cake has the advantages of high softness, wettability and bulk, and long low-temperature storage period.

title_en: High-activity odorless natto product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-activity odorless natto product, which comprises the following steps: s1, cutting sweet potatoes into blocks or slices, and drying to obtain dried sweet potatoes; s2, soaking the dried potato and the soybeans in the nutrient solution 1, draining, and steaming; s3, peeling soybeans, soaking and washing steamed dried potatoes and peeled soybeans with a nutrient solution 2, and inoculating bacillus natto for three-stage fermentation to obtain a odorless sweet natto product.
