More importantly, the fibrinolytic activity is improved by about 10 times compared with the traditional natto by adopting special nutrient solution for soaking and three-stage fermentation, and the thrombolytic effect is more remarkable. Therefore, the high-activity odorless natto has remarkable advantages in smell, taste, nattokinase content, fibrinolytic activity and thrombolytic efficacy.

title_en: Rice OsMYB-Hv1 gene and encoding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to cloning of a rice OsMYB-Hv1 gene and application thereof in increasing the grain length, grain weight and yield of rice, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the OsMYB-Hv1 gene is SEQ ID NO.1 in a sequence table; the nucleotide sequence of the protein coding region is SEQ ID NO.2 in the sequence table; the coded protein sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.3 in the sequence table. The complete protein coding region sequence of the OsMYB-Hv1 gene is placed under the control of a constitutive promoter 35S to be over-expressed in rice, and the ear length, grain weight and yield of transgenic plants are obviously increased, so that the OsMYB-Hv1 gene has potential use value in genetic improvement of rice. The invention describes the role of the OsMYB-Hv1 gene in increasing spike length, grain weight and yield.

title_en: Method for producing heated food
abstract_en: The present invention provides a technique capable of suppressing water loss caused by cooking of food materials and capable of simply producing a heated food having a juicy texture. The method for producing a heated food of the present invention comprises the steps of: a pretreatment step of adhering a composition containing a monovalent metal salt of alginic acid and a sparingly water-soluble divalent metal salt to a food material that is oozed out of water by heating; and a heating step of heating and cooking the food material subjected to the pretreatment step. Gelation prevention means for preventing gelation of alginic acid contained in the composition is carried out from the time after the pretreatment step is carried out to the time before the heating step is carried out. The gelation prevention means comprises: setting the product temperature of the food material immediately before the composition is attached in the pretreatment step to 30 ℃ or lower; the product temperature of the food material subjected to the pretreatment process is not more than 2 hours and is more than 40 ℃; and the time for the product temperature of the food material subjected to the pretreatment step to reach 10-20 ℃ is not more than 12 hours.

title_en: Novel composite pork crisp and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel composite pork crisp and a processing technology thereof, which belong to the technical field of food processing, wherein the processing technology comprises the following steps: step S1, pork treatment: removing impurities from pork, cleaning, cutting, and performing ultrasonic vacuum cooking, and then removing the pork to obtain pork thin meat thin threads; s2, rehydrating the soybean wiredrawing protein to obtain soybean wiredrawing protein filaments; s3, mixing to obtain protein filaments; s4, mixing auxiliary materials and protein threads according to a formula; s5, pressing and forming to obtain a semi-finished product; s6, puffing and drying; and S7, packaging. The whole processing technology is basically under 90 ℃, adopts the combined technology of ultrasonic vacuum cooking and differential pressure puffing, changes the traditional high-temperature cooking, normal-pressure high-temperature baking and other technologies into a low-temperature negative-pressure processing technology, furthest reserves the nutritional ingredients of the meringues and ensures the safety of foods.

title_en: Straw fodder intelligent production system and working principle thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent production system for straw forage, which mainly comprises a feeding conveyer belt, a forage stirring mixer, a concentrate conveyer belt, a zymophyte storage tank, a quantitative fungus pump, a water tank, a quantitative water pump, a transfer conveyer belt, a homogenizing machine, an output conveyer belt, a round bale membrane machine and a control system, wherein a weight sensor and an atomizing nozzle are arranged in the forage stirring mixer, the output ends of the feeding conveyer belt and the concentrate conveyer belt are connected with the forage stirring mixer, the zymophyte storage tank and the water tank are respectively connected with the forage stirring mixer through the quantitative fungus pump, the quantitative water pump, a water pipe and the atomizing nozzle, the output end of the forage stirring mixer is connected with the homogenizing machine through the transfer conveyer belt, and the output end of the homogenizing machine is connected with the round bale membrane machine through the output conveyer belt. According to the invention, the fermentation bacteria and the clear water can be accurately proportioned according to the weight of the materials, the quantitative pump is controlled by the controller, and the quantitative fermentation bacteria and the clear water are conveyed into the materials after being atomized, so that the accurate feeding is realized, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: Special look of fresh leaf selects equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of color selection equipment, and discloses special color selection equipment for fresh leaves, which comprises a fresh leaf color selector, wherein the top of the fresh leaf color selector is provided with a shaking blanking mechanism, and the special color selection equipment also comprises an intelligent control cabinet, a carding machine, and a winnowing device is arranged on the carding machine; a shaking screen; a hoist; when the tea leaf automatic sorting machine is used, the fresh leaf color sorter automatically sorts and sorts the fresh leaf raw materials, fully screens the fresh leaf raw materials, meanwhile, the drying mechanism carries out drying treatment on the fresh leaf raw materials moving on the screening screen plate, so that moisture contained in fresh leaves is effectively removed, blocking is avoided, the yield of high-quality tea leaves is greatly improved, the quality of the tea leaves and the color sorting precision of finished tea leaves can be greatly improved in the tea leaf processing process, and in the fresh leaf color sorting operation process, a plurality of conveying equipment and intelligent control systems are adopted, so that the automation level of tea enterprises can be enhanced, and the labor cost of the tea enterprises can be reduced.

title_en: Magnetic field fresh-keeping drawer and refrigerating and freezing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic field fresh-keeping drawer and a refrigerating and freezing device, wherein the magnetic field fresh-keeping drawer comprises: an outer tub; the drawer is arranged in the outer barrel in a drawable manner, and a fresh-keeping storage space is formed in the drawer; the wireless power supply coil is arranged on the outer barrel and used for controllably outputting induction magnetic flux; the wireless power receiving coil is arranged on the drawer, is opposite to the wireless power supply coil under the condition that the drawer is pushed into the outer barrel, and is configured to convert the acquired induction magnetic flux into an electric energy signal; and the electromagnetic field generating element is arranged on the drawer and is configured to apply a magnetic field to the fresh-keeping storage space by utilizing electric energy provided by the wireless power receiving coil. According to the magnetic field fresh-keeping drawer, the electromagnetic field generating element is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate of the drawer, so that the attenuation of the magnetic field intensity is avoided, the use efficiency of the magnetic field is higher, and the influence on the surrounding space is reduced. The electromagnetic field generating element supplies power in a wireless power supply mode, and the power supply difficulty in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Nutritional anti-alcohol tablet containing vitamin glutamine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutritional anti-alcohol tablet containing vitamin glutamine and a preparation method thereof. The nutritional anti-alcohol tablet containing vitamin glutamine comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 5-15% of food source peptide; 0.05-0.15% of vitamin; 1-2% of hydroxypropyl cellulose; 15-25% of microcrystalline cellulose; 5-15% of sorbitol; 0.3-1% of magnesium stearate; the balance being L-glutamine. The anti-alcoholic tablet combines natural nutritional ingredients, provides necessary nutritional support for athletes, and effectively relieves drunk symptoms. Food-derived peptides and vitamins help to accelerate physical recovery and protect nerve health. L-glutamine not only enhances the effect of alcohol effect, but also enhances immunity, liver protection and gastrointestinal function. The versatility of the anti-hangover tablet makes the anti-hangover tablet an ideal choice for athletes and common consumers, provides them with a healthy and comprehensive supplement scheme, and meets the sports and social demands.

title_en: Wonton skin and preparation method of wonton skin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and discloses wonton skin and a preparation method of wonton skin, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 25kg of flour; water: 8.8-9.5kg; salt: 180-210g; baking soda: 5-5.5g; egg white: 800g; xanthan gum: 3.5g; 500g of cereal flour. The formula of the instant dumpling is accurate, the preparation is standardized, the instant dumpling does not crack in 12 months of steaming, quick freezing and freezing preservation, and the mouthfeel of the instant dumpling is kept flexible and chewy, and the instant dumpling is comparable to a fresh and flour-mixed manual wonton; the formula and the preparation method of the invention have the advantages of fine adjustment in summer and winter, accurate quantification and suitability for industrialized mass production.

title_en: Method for improving fermentation efficiency of soy sauce pond
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving fermentation efficiency of a soy sauce pond, which is characterized in that self-sourced microorganisms in soy sauce mash of a fermentation pond are utilized for fermentation culture outside the fermentation pond, and after being combined with lactobacillus reuteri fermentation liquor for collaborative fermentation, the fermentation culture liquor is returned to a pouring fermentation pond, and the fermentation is repeated for a plurality of times, so that the self-sourced microorganisms of the fermentation pond promote soy sauce fermentation. The fermentation tank is characterized in that the salinity is reduced outside the fermentation tank, a proper amount of starch raw material is added to ferment and culture the self-sourced microorganisms, the protease fermentation liquid with higher activity can be prepared in a shorter time, the protease fermentation liquid is returned to the fermentation tank to be used for pouring, the protein hydrolysis degree and the hydrolysis efficiency of the fermentation tank are improved, lactobacillus reuteri takes the soy sauce mash fermentation liquid in the fermentation tank as a basic nutrition source and ferments together with a proper amount of white granulated sugar to produce fermentation liquid with the function of inhibiting escherichia coli, the escherichia coli pollution of the self-sourced microorganisms outside the fermentation tank can be resisted, the safety of the returned pouring fermentation liquid is ensured, and the production efficiency of the soy sauce tank type fermentation technology is further improved.

title_en: Sea cucumber polypeptide freeze-dried powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea cucumber polypeptide freeze-dried powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly thawing frozen sea cucumber meat, adding deionized water into the thawed sea cucumber meat for mixing, and then crushing and pulping the sea cucumber meat to obtain slurry containing sea cucumber crude protein; carrying out enzymolysis, centrifugation, concentration and sterilization on the slurry to obtain sea cucumber enzymolysis filtrate; and filling the sea cucumber enzymolysis filtrate, and freeze-drying to obtain sea cucumber polypeptide freeze-dried powder, wherein the freeze-drying process comprises a pre-freezing stage, a primary sublimation stage and an analytical drying stage, and the primary sublimation stage adopts a gradually heating and slowly sublimating mode. According to the invention, the quality and the appearance parameters of the freeze-dried product can be optimized by refining the freeze-drying process in the preparation process of the freeze-dried powder, so that the quality of the freeze-dried product is ensured.

title_en: Production method of folic acid flour
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a production method of folic acid flour, which comprises the following steps: s1, taking 6-10 parts of folic acid; s2, placing 75000-125000 parts of flour into the small beaker containing folic acid; s3, placing 150000-250000 parts of flour into 75006-125010 parts of flour containing folic acid; s4, 2775000-4625000 parts of flour is taken, 225000-375000 parts of flour containing folic acid is sprinkled in 2775000-4625000 parts of flour; s5, putting 3000000-5000000 parts of folic acid flour into a first mixer; s6, taking out 3000000-5000000 parts of folic acid flour and feeding the folic acid flour into a second mixer; the folic acid is placed in the flour with small components, the flour with small components doped with folic acid is added into the flour with other small components, and the flour with small components is added into the flour with relatively large components, so that the folic acid is uniformly distributed in the flour, the phenomenon that the folic acid content in the local flour is extremely low and the folic acid content in the local flour is extremely high can not occur, the folic acid content in the produced folic acid flour is uniform, and a proper amount of folic acid component intake when a user eats the flour product is ensured.

title_en: KASP molecular marker of QTL related to content of arachic acid and linoleic acid and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a KASP molecular marker of a QTL related to the content of peanut oleic acid and linoleic acid and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of molecular genetic breeding, and the technical scheme is as follows: QTL was mapped to the peanut a09 chromosome, designated qOA _a09_3. According to the invention, through peanut genome-wide resequencing and association mapping, SNP markers with obvious association of peanut kernel oleic acid and linoleic acid content are mined, and KASP molecular markers are developed and provided. The QTL related to the content of peanut kernel oleic acid and linoleic acid positioned by the KASP molecular marker is derived from a gene FATB1 different from FAD2A and FAD2B, and the GG/TT haplotype of the QTL leads to different oleic acid and linoleic acid content phenotypes, and the KASP molecular marker designed based on the locus can carry out marker-assisted selection on the content of peanut kernel oleic acid and linoleic acid, so that the breeding efficiency is improved, the variety genetic diversity is widened, and the method has wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for efficiently extracting xylose by utilizing bamboo chip steam explosion and membrane separation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomass waste utilization, and particularly relates to a method for efficiently extracting xylose by utilizing bamboo chip steam explosion and membrane separation. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, adding water into raw bamboo scraps, stirring, and adjusting the water content of the bamboo scraps; then putting the materials into a pilot-scale steam explosion device with high temperature and high pressure, and carrying out instantaneous explosion and pressure relief after staying for a period of time at constant temperature so as to separate three elements in bamboo scraps to the maximum extent; finally, the blasting material is subjected to the technological processes of pulping, pulp washing, membrane separation, acid hydrolysis and the like, and hemicellulose in the bamboo chips is finally efficiently converted into xylose. The invention provides a process method combining steam explosion and membrane separation, which has great popularization and application value for the technology of efficiently extracting xylose, can solve the pollution problems of increasingly serious waste biomass and production process from the source, can change waste into valuables, and increases the economic benefits of society and enterprises.

title_en: Compound traditional Chinese medicine for preventing and treating colibacillosis of piglets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound traditional Chinese medicine for preventing and treating colibacillosis of piglets, and belongs to the technical field of feed additives. The components of the compound traditional Chinese medicine are as follows by weight percent: 78.0% of acalypha australis, 5.5% of astragalus polysaccharide extract, 5.5% of schisandra chinensis extract and 11.0% of curcumin. The compound traditional Chinese medicine with the weight of 0.2 percent is added into the conventional piglet feed, so that the intestinal flora of the piglets can be effectively improved, the propagation of beneficial bacteria is promoted, the immunity of the piglets is improved, and the aim of preventing and treating colibacillosis of the piglets is achieved.

title_en: New use of throat-moistening sugar concentrated solution for treating viral pneumonia
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new application of throat-moistening sugar concentrated solution in treating viral pneumonia. The throat-moistening candy concentrated solution is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 50 to 56 percent of mesona chinensis, 19 to 23 percent of liquorice, 13 to 17 percent of chrysanthemum, 7 to 11 percent of fructus momordicae and 1 to 4 percent of honeysuckle.

title_en: Vacuum low-temperature marinating equipment and marinating method for low-temperature marinated products
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of marinated foods, in particular to vacuum low-temperature marinating equipment and a marinating method of low-temperature marinating products, wherein the vacuum low-temperature marinating equipment comprises a rack and a heating plate, and further comprises: the water bath kettle is arranged on the heating plate, a marinating kettle is nested in the water bath kettle, the marinating kettle is arranged for sealing the kettle opening of the water bath kettle, and the water bath kettle is also connected with a vacuum pressure-retaining pump; the transmission shaft is arranged on the frame and is connected with a rotating structure and a lifting structure, the rotating structure can drive the transmission shaft to rotate around the axis of the transmission shaft, and the lifting structure can drive the transmission shaft to slide along the axis of the transmission shaft; the conversion frame is connected to the transmission shaft, the transmission shaft rotates and can drive the conversion frame to rotate, the conversion frame is connected with the filter pot, a plurality of filter holes are formed in the outer peripheral surface of the filter pot, the filter pot rotates and slides along with the conversion frame and can move into the marinating pot, and the filter pot can seal the pot opening of the marinating pot. The marinating machine can maintain low temperature for marinating products, reduces manpower input and improves operation efficiency.

title_en: A culture apparatus that is used for lactic acid bacteria fermentation dried turnip in laboratory
abstract_en: The application discloses a culture device for fermenting dried turnips by lactic acid bacteria in a laboratory, which relates to the technical field of experimental equipment and comprises fermentation detection equipment and a fermentation container, wherein the fermentation detection equipment is connected with the fermentation container, the fermentation container is used for storing dried turnips, the fermentation detection equipment is used for detecting a fermentation environment in the fermentation container, and the fermentation container comprises a sampling point and a transfer area; the stirring mechanism is arranged in the inner cavity of the fermentation container and is positioned below the sampling point; wherein the fermentation container comprises a power component, a negative pressure component, a sample taking component, a sample container connecting component, a penetration driving component, a sealing component and a manual component; the sample container connecting component is connected to the negative pressure component and is used for moving the sample from the fermentation container to the transfer area.

title_en: Preparation method of product for blocking fat and losing weight and controlling weight
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health products, in particular to a preparation method of a product for blocking fat, losing weight and controlling weight, which comprises the following steps: s1, raw material pretreatment; s2, preparing raw materials; s3, cleaning raw materials; s4, scalding raw materials; s6, crushing and grinding; s7, screening; s8, packaging, wherein the taste regulator in the S2 consists of the following components in parts by weight: white sugar, sesame, peanut, vanilla, desiccated coconut and salt. The invention is prepared by mixing celery, red date, medlar, cassia seed, lotus leaf, hemp seed, bunge cherry seed, lemon, white gourd, apple, hawthorn, balsam pear, mulberry leaf, licorice and taste regulator, is vegetable and fruit materials, has no chemical addition, is favorable for body absorption, does not influence the body health after long-time eating, is eaten as brewing food, improves the edible taste through the self-contained taste seasoning of vegetable and fruit, improves the human absorption speed, reduces weight in a food supplementing way, has satiety, and simultaneously improves the weight reducing effect through reducing fat and reducing weight.

title_en: Application of CsWS1 gene or protein coded by same in regulation and control of cucumber fruit storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a CsWS1 gene or a protein encoded by the CsWS1 gene in regulating cucumber fruit storage, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the CsWS1 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The amino acid sequence of the CsWS1 gene coding protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention discovers that the cucumber CsWS1 gene is related to cucumber fruit storage through screening, and the commercial cucumber fruits of the cucumber mutant have obviously shortened storage period compared with '649' (WT). The gene can be applied to screening of storage-resistant cucumber fruits and prolonging of the commodity fruit shelf life of the cucumber.

title_en: PRAMS molecular marker of rice photosensitive gene SE1, primer group and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PRAMS molecular marker of rice photosensitive gene SE1, a primer group and application thereof, and the rice photosensitive gene SE1 can be rapidly and accurately detected in different germplasm resources such as indica rice, japonica rice and the like by carrying out SE1 gene detection on rice materials by using a PARMS technology through the PARMS molecular marker of the rice photosensitive gene SE1. The invention does not need complex procedures such as enzyme digestion, electrophoresis, sequencing and the like in the detection process, reduces pollution of aerosol of PCR products and use of toxic substances such as EB and the like, can simultaneously carry out prospect selection in early stage of molecular marker assisted breeding, reduces the scale of breeding population, accelerates the breeding process, and is beneficial to being applied to commercial molecular breeding of rice by SE1 genes with high efficiency and environmental protection.

title_en: Plant honey composite fermented beverage capable of improving immunity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of composite fermented beverages, and particularly relates to a plant honey composite fermented beverage for improving immunity and a preparation method thereof. The honeysuckle heat-clearing water obtained by high-pressure decoction is used as a solvent, and the ingredients such as vitamins, stachyose, flavone and the like contained in natural honey, cotton stachys sieboldii, lignum nakai and radix scrophulariae can enhance the phagocytic capacity of phagocytes and improve the immunity of organisms; the high-pressure homogenizer is used for homogenizing, so that the distribution of active ingredients is more uniform and stable, the active ingredients are fermented in a fermentation tank through a composite fermentation microbial inoculum after ultraviolet sterilization, macromolecular substances such as cellulose, protein and the like in the raw materials are decomposed into small molecules, finally, the small molecules are filtered by a sterile filter cloth to remove impurities, the prepared drink is fine and rich in taste, high in active ingredient content and favorable for intestinal absorption, the immunoglobulin content and the antioxidant capacity in a mouse body can be obviously improved, the phagocytosis rate of macrophages reaches 69.7%, and the phagocytosis index is 0.99.

title_en: Polypeptide derived from samara seed kernel oil meal and auxiliary anti-inflammatory and antioxidant blood lipid reducing composition
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide derived from samara seed kernel oil meal and an auxiliary anti-inflammatory and antioxidant hypolipidemic composition, wherein the samara seed kernel oil meal protein polypeptide SDCG1 has an amino acid sequence of FEDADLWYANLYH. The polypeptide and the product thereof have better anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, can effectively remove DPPH, ABTS, hydroxyl free radicals and other free radicals, have the characteristics of simple structure, strong antioxidant activity and high safety, can be used as an excellent substitute of chemical synthetic antioxidants, have certain antitumor activity, also have certain blood lipid reducing function, and provide theoretical basis and practical reference for research and development of novel natural additives in the pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries.

title_en: Preparation method of water-soluble capsicum oleoresin, prepared water-soluble capsicum oleoresin and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of water-soluble capsicum oleoresin, the prepared water-soluble capsicum oleoresin and application thereof. The synergistic effect of the components in the formula can keep the stability of the water-soluble capsicum oleoresin in the invention for a long time at the temperature of-5 ℃ to 25 ℃.

title_en: Low molecular weight chitosan nicotinamide derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low molecular weight chitosan nicotinamide derivative and application thereof, and relates to the field of bacteriostats, wherein nicotinic acid compounds such as nicotinic acid (VPP), 2-chloronicotinic acid (2-CNA), 2-aminonicotinic acid (2-ANA) and the like with bacteriostatic activity are grafted onto low molecular weight chitosan to prepare a novel low molecular weight chitosan nicotinamide derivative; the inhibition effect of the derivatives on phytophthora capsici, gibberella wheat, pholiota nameko and early blight of tomato is measured by adopting a hypha growth rate method, and the results show that the fungi inhibition effect of the derivatives is obviously higher than that of chitosan raw materials.

title_en: Sea buckthorn, medlar and mulberry composite raw pulp and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to sea-buckthorn, medlar and mulberry composite raw pulp, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of health products, wherein the sea-buckthorn, medlar and mulberry composite raw pulp comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-90 parts of sea buckthorn original pulp, 5-45 parts of medlar original pulp and 5-45 parts of mulberry original pulp. The invention prepares the sea-buckthorn, medlar and mulberry composite raw pulp by compounding sea-buckthorn raw pulp, medlar raw pulp and mulberry raw pulp in a specific proportion. The sea buckthorn, medlar and mulberry composite raw pulp has excellent inhibition activity to alpha-glucosidase, and the highest activity can reach 95%; meanwhile, the production process is purely natural, has no addition, is safe and nutritious, and has wide practical application value.

title_en: Production process for removing fishy smell of donkey-hide gelatin
abstract_en: The invention provides a donkey hide gelatin deodorization production process, which relates to the technical field of donkey hide gelatin production and comprises the following steps of rinsing donkey hide, dehairing, dicing, cleaning, decocting with water, filtering, merging filtrate, concentrating to thick paste, adding a proper amount of yellow wine, rock sugar and soybean oil respectively in the concentrating process, condensing, dicing and airing to obtain the finished donkey hide gelatin.

title_en: Floating fiber sustained release tablet for losing weight and reducing lipid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a floating fiber sustained release tablet for losing weight and reducing blood fat and a preparation method thereof, wherein active substances are active peptides, and the active substances are prepared into the floating fiber sustained release tablet which is suitable for people losing weight, improves dyslipidemia and can also be used for patients suffering from lipid metabolism syndrome. The invention screens active peptide through a scientific and purposeful mode, has strong pertinence, floats above gastric fluid, prolongs the drug release time, enhances the absorption of human body to the drug, can better exert the drug effect, has the characteristics of long drug release time, stable property, good drug absorption effect and small side effect, and the floating sustained release tablet has stable light and heat properties and is not easy to absorb moisture, thereby providing basis for drug transportation and storage.

title_en: Capsule type health food for regulating blood fat and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health-care food, in particular to a capsule type health-care food for regulating blood fat and a preparation method thereof. Is prepared from red rice powder, red sage root extract, gingko leaf extract, notoginseng extract, saussurea involucrata culture and matrix. Has the functions of regulating blood fat, resisting oxidation, regulating immunity, etc., and can be used for auxiliary treatment of people with hyperlipidemia, and can be orally taken. The method for preparing the capsule type health food for regulating blood fat, provided by the invention, can accurately control the ration of the capsule, so that the capsule has smooth surface, good taste, easy swallowing, convenient carrying and safe eating.

title_en: Rice haploid induction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology and plant breeding, relates to a method for inducing haploids by using parthenogenesis genes, and particularly relates to a rice haploid induction method. The rice haploid induction method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: the promoter of arabidopsis egg cell specific expression gene AtEC1.2 is used for inducing the ectopic expression of a mountain Liu Ju (Pilosselapilloseloides) parthenogenesis gene PpPAR in rice egg cells, and inducing rice to parthenogenesis, thus obtaining rice haploids. The method of the invention introduces the mountain Liu Jugu female genitalia PpPAR existing in nature into rice, successfully enables the rice to perform parthenogenesis by allowing the PpPAR to be expressed in egg cell ectopic, and can induce haploid generation on the premise of not influencing plant growth and development, thereby providing a new solution for rice haploid breeding.

title_en: Method for preserving fruits of Zanthoxylum bungeanum
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preserving fruits of Zanthoxylum bungeanum, and relates to the technical field of fruit preservation. The fresh-keeping method of the pepper fruits comprises the steps of impurity removal, soaking and cleaning, steam fixation, soaking and cooling, air drying, sealed packaging, low-temperature storage and the like. The fresh-keeping method for the pepper fruits can avoid the loss of special flavor substances of the pepper, realize the uninterrupted supply of fresh pepper all the year round, solve the difficult problems of fresh keeping, quality keeping and the like after the large-scale cultivation of the pepper, effectively coordinate the contradiction of large scale, ecologization, high quality and the like in the development process of ecological industry, and has stronger practical application value.

title_en: Dendrobium huoshanense collagen peptide beverage and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dendrobium huoshanense collagen peptide beverage and a preparation process thereof, and relates to the field of beverages, wherein the beverage comprises the following raw material components: extracting dried dendrobium huoshanense stems, collagen peptide, sodium hyaluronate 3000, xanthan gum, vitamin C, blending materials and water, concentrating to obtain concentrated solution, adding water into other materials, mixing with the dendrobium huoshanense concentrated solution in a preparation tank, uniformly stirring, boiling, cooling to 40-50 ℃, filling, sterilizing and performing light inspection; the beverage prepared by the invention can improve the immunity of human bodies and improve the skin state, is suitable for people with dry skin, wrinkles and yellowing, and can be suitable for people of various ages to drink.

title_en: Wide powder production process
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide powder production process, which relates to the technical field of wide powder processing production and comprises the following steps: selecting and processing raw materials, selecting high-quality rice as raw materials, detecting the quality of the rice by a spectrum analyzer, and removing impurities by a screening machine to obtain screened rice. According to the invention, the quality of rice is detected by using a spectrum analyzer, so that the quality of raw materials can be ensured, the taste and quality of a final product are ensured, meanwhile, the water absorption and softening degree of rice are improved by using a constant-temperature water tank, the subsequent grinding processing is facilitated, the fineness and uniformity of slurry are ensured, the temperature and time monitoring of the grinding process and a multi-layer filtering process are further ensured, the quality of the rice slurry is further ensured, the processability of the slurry is enhanced by controlling the temperature and the humidity, a good foundation is provided for compression molding, the product quality is greatly improved by the whole process, the production efficiency is improved, the material waste is reduced, and the market competitiveness of the product is enhanced.

title_en: Preparation method of functional lutein compound and application of functional lutein compound in relieving xerophthalmia
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a functional lutein compound and application of the functional lutein compound in relieving xerophthalmia, and belongs to the technical field of foods and health-care foods. The invention provides a lutein compound, which is prepared by carrying out primary embedding on lutein by using phycocyanin, grafting tricarboxyphenyl boric acid onto yeast beta glucan through esterification reaction, and further carrying out layer-by-layer self-assembly on modified yeast beta glucan and chitosan through electrostatic interaction to construct the compound with improved hydrophobicity nutrient substances; the method improves the stability of physical and chemical properties of lutein, can realize gastric acid protection of lutein, improves the concentration of lutein in blood and eyeballs, relieves and intervenes the symptom of dry eye syndrome of mice, constructs a functional characteristic nano-carrier system by adopting an embedding protection mode, and fully improves the absorption availability of natural nutrient substances.

title_en: Preparation process of lentinus edodes chilli sauce and oil separating system of material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of mushroom chilli sauce and a material oil separation system, which relate to the field of food processing and comprise a tank body, wherein a feeding door is arranged at the upper part of the tank body, a separation mechanism for separating oil from solid materials is arranged in the tank body, and a pressing mechanism which faces the inside of the tank body and controls the oil amount of the separation mechanism is arranged at the top of the tank body; the invention can solve the following problems that the proportion of oil and solid materials in the lentinus edodes chilli sauce can be controlled simultaneously through the control mechanism, so that the proportion of the oil and the solid materials in the lentinus edodes chilli sauce can be controlled more accurately, the proportion requirements of different oil and solid materials in products can be met, and the positions of the separating mechanism and the pressing mechanism can be adjusted through the adjusting mechanism, so that the oil and the solid materials in the tank body are prevented from being reduced continuously along with filling, and the situation that the separating mechanism cannot suck the oil is avoided.

title_en: Rapid propagation method of dendrobium primordium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid propagation method of dendrobium nobile, which adopts a plant tissue culture technology to save the in vitro germplasm of the dendrobium nobile and cultivate tissue culture seedlings, and comprises the following steps: (1) screening and surface sterilizing of dendrobium cherry capsules; (2) sterile sowing and induction culture of dendrobium primordium seed embryos; (3) proliferation and differentiation culture of primula sikkimensis protocorms; (4) strong seedling and rooting culture of dendrobium primordium seedlings; (5) subculturing and hardening transplanting of the dendrobium primordium tissue culture seedlings; wherein the culture mediums used in the steps (2) to (4) are the same, the composition of the culture mediums is 1/2MS+6% potato powder+0.8% Huabao No. one+30 g/L sucrose+4 g/L agar powder, and the pH value of the culture mediums is 5.8. The invention provides a feasible scheme for development and utilization of the dendrobium nobile, on one hand protects wild resources of the dendrobium nobile, and on the other hand plays a role in social value and economic value of the dendrobium nobile.

title_en: Fermented fungus tea and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea preparation, in particular to zymophyte tea and a preparation method and application thereof. Inoculating Cordyceps militaris YCC2 and Ganoderma lucidum into the tea, and fermenting to obtain the fermented tea. The invention uses the advantage strain of ganoderma lucidum and Cordyceps militaris YCC2 selected from the group consisting of ganoderma lucidum and Cordyceps militaris, and the strain has the advantages of fast growth, wide adaptability and the like. The artificial inoculation can realize pure fermentation and clean fermentation production, and ensure the quality safety of the product. Compared with the traditional fermented tea, the fungus tea has stronger fungus fragrance and smoother taste, and the quality is obviously superior to that of the traditional oolong tea.

title_en: Production process of whole wheat flour for high-viscosity special water feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of whole wheat flour for high-viscosity special water feed, which comprises the steps of screening, impurity removing, water washing, drying and crushing wheat to obtain wheat flour; then extruding and puffing the wheat flour to obtain pretreated wheat flour; uniformly mixing pretreated wheat flour, enteromorpha powder and water to obtain a premix, sterilizing, inoculating lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus subtilis, and fermenting to obtain a fermentation product; vacuumizing, adding stannous octoate into the fermentation product, heating and polymerizing to realize polylactic acid grafting modification, carrying out ozone treatment and post-treatment to obtain the whole wheat flour. The whole wheat flour obtained by the invention has good adhesiveness, so that the special water feed is not easy to disperse in water.

title_en: Carboxypeptidase A mutant with improved thermostability and activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carboxypeptidase A mutant with improved catalytic activity and thermal stability, belonging to the field of protein engineering. The invention utilizes rational design and site-directed mutagenesis technology to obtain carboxypeptidase A mutant D93C/F96C by introducing disulfide bonds. The half-life of the carboxypeptidase A mutant is improved by 13.3min at 65 ℃ compared with that of a wild type, the half-inactivation temperature is increased by 8.5 ℃ compared with that of the wild type, and the specific enzyme activity is improved by 24.32% compared with that of the wild type. The invention breaks through the balance of stability and activity, realizes the double improvement of the thermal stability and the catalytic activity of the carboxypeptidase A, is beneficial to the important role of carboxypeptidase A mutant in the industrial application in the fields of food, medicine or feed and the like, can be used as a food starter and a bitter taste remover in industrial production, and can also be applied to removal of ochratoxin A and the like.

title_en: Strong-flavor cyperus esculentus hay feed based on biosynthesis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of feed fermentation, and particularly relates to a strong-flavor cyperus esculentus hay feed based on biosynthesis and a preparation method thereof. The aroma type cyperus esculentus hay feed comprises cyperus esculentus hay, a bacterial liquid fused with Weissella, a carbon source and a nitrogen source; the Wessezia is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC), and the preservation number is CGMCC No.24053. According to the technical scheme, the cyperus esculentus is fermented in an assisted manner by biotechnology, and organic acid is generated by decomposing fibers and utilizing fermentation substrates such as soluble carbohydrates, so that the growth of moulds and other spoilage bacteria is inhibited, and the loss of nutrient components is reduced. Meanwhile, the flavor substances (mainly including alcohols, aldehydes, phenols, acids, esters, ketones and hydrocarbon substances thereof) are greatly enriched after fermentation, and the aroma components of the feed can be effectively increased.

title_en: Virus detoxification method of Chinese yam
abstract_en: The invention provides a virus detoxification method of Chinese yam. According to the invention, after the stem tip of the Chinese yam is peeled, the heat treatment and the ribavirin Lin Tuo virus are adopted, so that the damage of Japanese Yam Mosaic Virus (JYMV), potato Virus Y (PVY), potato Virus X (PVX) and potato leaf curl virus (PLRV) can be effectively avoided. The optimal virus removal method is that the stem tip is peeled to 0.3-0.5mm, and the heat treatment is carried out for 8 hours at 40 ℃, and the ribavirin is 50mg/L.

title_en: Integrated fermented soybean production line
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated fermented soybean production line, which belongs to the technical field of fermented soybean production and comprises a processing box, a protective frame, a bidirectional motor and a water pump, wherein the protective frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the processing box, and the inner wall of one side of the protective frame is provided with the bidirectional motor.

title_en: Method for producing yellow wine by using tartary buckwheat
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of food, and provides a method for producing yellow wine by using tartary buckwheat, which comprises the following steps: washing Fagopyrum tataricum rice, soaking for 24 hr, cleaning, and draining; pouring the cleaned tartary buckwheat rice into a frying pan and  meters; transferring  paste into saccharification tank, stirring, cooling, adding wheat starter at 8% when temperature reaches 30deg.C, and stirring; transferring the tartary buckwheat rice added with wheat yeast into a fermentation tank, and inoculating solid yeast according to the proportion of 5%; squeezing fermented mash after fermentation, and pumping the wine liquor after filter pressing into a clarifying tank for freezing and clarifying; filtering, decocting, storing and blending the clarified wine, and then carrying out fine filtration, filling, cooling, packaging and inspection to obtain a finished product. The invention takes the tartary buckwheat as the raw material, adopts the processes of fermentation, squeezing, freezing clarification, wine frying and the like, so that the finished wine has rich taste, strong aroma, and the aroma of the wine is combined with the aroma of the tartary buckwheat, and simultaneously contains the nutritional value of the tartary buckwheat, thereby being a unique fermented wine.

title_en: Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain capable of tolerating high-concentration ethanol and high osmotic pressure and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a saccharomyces cerevisiae strain which is resistant to high-concentration ethanol and high osmotic pressure, which is a saccharomyces cerevisiae (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) strain YN81mc-8.3 which is preserved in the microorganism strain preservation center of Guangdong province at the 8 month 23 day of 2023, wherein the preservation number is GDMCC 63738, and the strain is obtained based on a microorganism micro-droplet culture system (Microbial microdroplet culture system, MMC) and an adaptive laboratory evolution technology (Adaptive laboratory evolution, ALE). The strain S.cerevisiae YN81mc-8.3 has obviously improved growth capacity under high sucrose concentration (300-460 g/L), can tolerate 12% ethanol concentration, and has 20% improved ethanol tolerance compared with the strain S.cerevisiae YN81 mc. The strain S.cerevisiae YN81mc-8.3 of the present invention can be used for brewing a strong beer by a high concentration wort fermentation method (VHG) and a high concentration wort fermentation method (VHGAE) in which ethanol is added exogenously.

title_en: Sterilization and fresh-keeping process for small molecule peptide product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sterilization and fresh-keeping process of a small molecular peptide product, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1, primary sterilization: placing the small molecular peptide product in acidic oxidation potential water, performing soaking treatment, and then placing in a sterile environment to drain water; s2, fresh-keeping treatment: carrying out modified atmosphere preservation treatment on the small molecular peptide product; the invention relates to the technical field of storage of small molecule peptide products. The sterilization and fresh-keeping process of the small molecular peptide product effectively improves the sterilization effect by sterilizing the small molecular peptide product by the acidic oxidation potential water, and has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost, safety, no toxicity, no residue and no pollution to the environment; the low-temperature plasma treatment instrument is used for carrying out secondary sterilization on the small molecular peptide product, so that the sterilization effect is further improved; the breath strength of the small molecular peptide product is inhibited through the fresh-keeping treatment, so that the higher commodity rate of the small molecular peptide product in the storage time is maintained, and the storage time is prolonged.

title_en: Tea making method capable of increasing and stabilizing bubbles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea infusion making technology, in particular to a tea infusion making method for increasing and stabilizing bubbles, which comprises the following steps of: s1: preparing tea powder, taking a proper amount of tea leaves, putting the tea leaves into a multifunctional crusher, crushing the tea leaves, taking the crushed tea leaves out, grinding the crushed tea leaves by using a stone mill, and then sieving the ground tea leaves to obtain the tea powder for later use; the method has the advantages that the addition and stability of the spot tea foam pastry can be realized in the specific manufacturing process, and the problems that the existing manufacturing method can not effectively finish the spot tea manufacture, and the quantity of the manufactured spot tea foam pastry is small and sparse are solved; the tea-making cake manufactured by the tea-making preparation method for increasing and stabilizing the foam can enable the tea-making cake to have the characteristic of biting the cup, namely, the cake is as dense as biting the cup wall, the stability of the tea-making cake is effectively realized, and the specific use needs of people are met.

title_en: Genetic transformation method of Mongolian agropyron
abstract_en: The application provides a genetic transformation method of Mongolian agropyron, comprising the following steps: step one, inducing an explant of Mongolian agropyron to form a callus, and carrying out subculture and differentiation culture on the callus to obtain a transformation receptor; step two, carrying out primary infection on the transformation receptor obtained in the step one by using agrobacterium infection liquid; thirdly, carrying out dark culture screening on the transformed receptor infected in the second step, and carrying out secondary infection by adopting agrobacterium tumefaciens infection solution after screening; and fourthly, co-culturing the infected transformation receptor, and determining the infection effect. The genetic transformation system of the Mongolian agropyron is designed and successfully established, the infection efficiency of the easily-infected genotype Mongolian agropyron is improved from less than 5% to more than 80%, and after 2 months of dark culture screening, the transferred target gene can be stably expressed in the callus of the Mongolian agropyron, so that a novel method is provided for molecular breeding research and development of the Mongolian agropyron.

title_en: Method for non-in-vitro identification of peony dormancy removal related gene, gene PsEMF2 and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for non-in-vitro identification of peony dormancy removal related genes, a gene PsEMF2 and application thereof, and belongs to the field of molecular biology. The method can directly reveal the functions of candidate genes through the germination rate, and simultaneously avoid the problems of difficult tissue culture regeneration and transplantation. The method finds that the overexpression of PsEMF2 promotes the dormancy release in peony buds and is a positive regulatory factor for dormancy release.

title_en: Method for producing compound oligosaccharide in sterilization process
abstract_en: The pyruvic acid catalyst adopted by the invention has two functional groups of carbonyl and carboxyl in the molecule, and has stronger catalytic activity. The gleditsia sinensis polysaccharide gum raw material is presoaked, so that the viscosity of an oligosaccharide production system of a subsequent sterilizing pot is greatly reduced, and the oligosaccharide conversion efficiency is improved. The camellia oleifera shell is subjected to hot water leaching pretreatment, so that the degradation reaction efficiency of hemicellulose of the camellia oleifera shell is improved while the effective components of the camellia oleifera saponin are recycled. The method has the advantages that the galactomannan and hemicellulose are catalytically degraded by the aqueous solution of the pyruvic acid at the sterilization temperature to efficiently produce the compound oligosaccharide, the pyruvic acid can be used as a functional additive in an oligosaccharide product, separation is not needed, the high-yield production of the compound oligosaccharide can be realized only by the sterilization operation of raw materials, and the production process is safe and efficient.

title_en: Lactobacillus reuteri BN01 for repairing gastrointestinal mucosal injury and its progeny
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus reuteri BN01 for repairing gastrointestinal mucosal injury and a metathereof, wherein the lactobacillus reuteri is lactobacillus reuteri (Limosilactobacillus reuteri) BN01 which is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) No.29132 in the 11 th month 27 of 2023. The lactobacillus reuteri metaplasia for repairing the gastrointestinal mucosa injury provided by the invention is prepared by symbiotic fermentation and graded fermentation of the composition by utilizing lactobacillus reuteri BN01, and the obtained metaplasia has the effect of repairing the gastrointestinal mucosa injury.

title_en: Green tea manufacturing process and rolling device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green tea manufacturing process and a rolling device thereof, and relates to the field of tea manufacturing, wherein the process comprises S1 picking, S2 selecting, S3 withering, S4 high-temperature fixation, S5 rolling shaping, S6 slow fire drying and S7 compound fire fragrance raising, the rolling device comprises a rolling disc, a rolling barrel, a driving assembly, a sealing cover and a lifting assembly, the rolling disc comprises a rolling circular plate and a coaming assembly, a cylindrical rolling groove is formed by encircling the rolling circular plate and the coaming assembly, a discharge hole is formed in the center of the rolling circular plate, a sealing cover assembly is arranged at the discharge hole, and the coaming assembly comprises a positioning ring, a rotating ring and a plurality of arc-shaped rolling strips. The invention structurally improves the rolling disc, can automatically clean the residual tea leaves on the rolling disc after rolling, reduces the labor intensity of operators on the premise of not influencing the rolling effect of green tea, improves the rolling efficiency and reduces the rolling cost of the tea leaves.

title_en: Preparation method of organic trace element compound premix for piglets
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation method of organic trace element compound premix for piglets, which belongs to the technical field of feed preparation, and comprises the following steps: obtaining a powdery additive; uniformly mixing the powdery additive and the powder carrier to obtain a mixture; adding the mixture into oil and water in a first preset proportion, stirring, and preparing granules; obtaining a liquid additive; diluting the liquid additive, soaking the granules in the diluted liquid additive, and taking out the granules after standing for a preset period of time; and drying the soaked granules to prepare the organic trace element compound premix for piglets. By adopting the mode, the organic trace element compound premix prepared by the processing method provided by the embodiment of the application can be uniformly mixed with the basic compound feed, so that the uniformity of each component in the mixed complete compound feed is improved, and the growth performance of piglets can be further improved.

title_en: Composition for preventing Alzheimer disease and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for preventing Alzheimer disease, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical fields of functional foods, health-care foods and medicines, wherein the composition comprises a basic component and a functional component; according to the weight parts, the basic component is 50-80 parts of barley green, the functional component is 2-10 parts, and the barley green consists of saffron extract and spearmint extract, wherein the weight ratio of the saffron extract to the spearmint extract is 1.2:1-1.8:1; the composition has the effects of preventing or treating Alzheimer's disease or delaying the condition of Alzheimer's disease, can be applied to health-care food or functional food in the future, and also has medicinal potential.

title_en: Application of atovaquone in radiation damage resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of atovaquone in radiation injury resistance, and the application of atovaquone in radiation injury resistance is discovered and verified for the first time, and atovaquone can obviously improve survival rate of mice suffering from acute radiation injury, obviously promote recovery of peripheral blood multi-system hematopoietic cells of irradiated mice and obviously improve reduction of the number of radiation-induced hematopoietic stem progenitor cells of the mice, has obvious prevention and/or treatment effects on radiation injury, can be used in preparation of radiation injury resistance medicines, and provides a new thought and direction for developing high-efficiency and safe radiation protection medicines in the field.

title_en: Lactobacillus plantarum MC14 and application thereof in pickling vegetables
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and discloses a lactobacillus plantarum MC14 and application thereof in pickling vegetables. The strain is preserved in the collection of microorganism strains of Guangdong province, called GDMCC for short, and the strain preservation number is GDMCC No. 63633 at 7 and 10 days 2023. A series of experiments prove that the strain has excellent probiotics potential and fermentation characteristics. The invention also uses lactobacillus plantarum MC14 and mesenteric leuconostoc 1.774 to prepare the direct-vat starter, which can shorten the fermentation time of pickled radishes, improve the texture, flavor and taste of the pickled radishes and show higher xanthine oxidase inhibition effect.

title_en: Method for rapidly collecting pollen in pigment marigold seed production process
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for rapidly collecting pollen in the process of preparing pigment marigold seeds, which comprises the following steps: (1) seed pretreatment; (2) aseptic seedling acquisition; (3) adventitious bud induction culture: cutting the obtained leaves of the aseptic seedlings, and inoculating the cut leaves to an adventitious bud induction culture medium for culture; (4) adventitious bud bloom and pollen collection; (5) subculture; and (3) cutting off roots of the root seedlings after the pollen is collected, transferring the root seedlings into a new culture medium for continuous subculture, and allowing the root seedlings to continuously bloom and collecting the pollen. The method is quick and simple, and a large number of seedlings which are tidy, uniform and consistent in purity are obtained in a short period based on tissue culture, so that pollen can be collected conveniently and quickly and efficiently, and the activity of the obtained pollen is still high during subculture.

title_en: Nucleotide sequence for regulating rice grain shape and grain weight and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleotide sequence for regulating and controlling rice grain shape and grain weight and application thereof, wherein the nucleotide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the gene is utilized to construct a CaMV 35S-AtABI4 fusion gene which is transformed into rice to increase the grain length, grain width, grain thickness and grain weight of a transgenic rice strain with heterologous expression AtABI4, thus having potential application value in improving the seed size and grain weight of the rice and increasing the crop yield.

title_en: Processing process flow of sauced and marinated meat product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a processing process flow of a sauced and braised meat product, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The method comprises the following steps: checking and accepting raw materials and auxiliary materials; storing; thawing; cleaning and finishing: cleaning and trimming the defrosted raw materials; and (3) batching: weighing auxiliary materials; pickling: cold preserving and curing for 48 hours after curing for 24 hours at normal temperature; cooking: placing the pickled meat into an automatic marinating saucepan, and preserving heat for 2 hours after boiling; and (3) cooling: naturally cooling the marinated product for half an hour; checking and accepting the packing material, sterilizing the inner packing material, and vacuum packaging the product. The invention provides a processing process flow of a sauced meat product, which is completed after strict procedures of material selection, vacuum sealing, high-temperature steaming, sterilization and the like, so that the nutritional ingredients of raw materials are completely reserved, the delicious flavor of the sauced meat is also locked, the prepared sauced meat has long storage time, the traditional sauced product realizes standardized large-scale production, and the sauced meat product has potential meat snack food and good market prospect.

title_en: Selenium-enriched lactobacillus and application thereof in preventing and/or relieving heavy metal liver injury
abstract_en: The invention provides a selenium-enriched lactobacillus and application thereof in preventing and/or relieving heavy metal liver injury. The classification of the selenium-enriched lactobacillus is named as follows: lactobacillus plantarum (Lactiplantibacillus plantarum) WCZ2323 can effectively reduce the content of serum ALT, AST, ALP, TC, TG, LDL; increasing HDL content; reducing fat accumulation or cell swelling of the liver; improving the oxidation resistance; can effectively reduce the Cd content in liver tissue; effectively reduces the damage of liver Cd deposition to the liver. The selenium-enriched lactobacillus provided by the invention provides a wide application prospect for clinical intervention and prevention of liver injury and oxidative stress caused by heavy metals.

title_en: Cultivation equipment and cultivation method for improving pollination probability of muskmelon
abstract_en: The invention discloses cultivation equipment and a cultivation method for improving pollination probability of muskmelon, comprising a handle and a storage box, wherein one end of the handle is fixedly connected with the storage box, the inner side of the top end of the storage box is spirally connected with an end cover, the bottom end of the storage box is fixedly connected with a material guiding pipe, the inner side of the material guiding pipe is provided with a feeding mechanism, a part of the feeding mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the storage box, and pollen at the inner side of the storage box can be quantitatively stored through filter cloth, so that the pollination quantity is ensured not to be too much or too little, pollen waste is ensured, too little pollinating is easy to occur, uneven pollination is also caused, pollination is easy to fail, and then the problem of low pollination rate is caused, and meanwhile, the pollen can be enclosed by a pair of pistil studs under the action of breathable cotton and the breathable cloth, when the pollen is sprayed on the surfaces of the studs, the pollen is not blown down to the ground due to the effect of wind, so that the pollination uniformity is further ensured, and the pollination probability is improved.

title_en: Tissue culture detoxification rapid propagation method of waterlogging-resistant and saline-alkali-resistant large cherry stock seedlings
abstract_en: The invention provides a tissue culture detoxification rapid propagation method of a waterlogging-resistant and saline-alkali-resistant large cherry stock seedling, which comprises four steps of primary culture, propagation and subculture, detoxification and cuttage rooting. The invention adopts the improved F14 culture medium, so that the buds germinate fast, the leaves are light green, the propagation effect is good, the consistency of large cherry stock seedlings is higher, the growth vigor is good, a large number of detoxified test tube seedlings can be obtained in a short period, and the large cherry stock seedlings can be supplied to the market after grafting, thereby effectively solving the demands of planting large cherries in river beach lands and saline-alkali lands.

title_en: Method for reducing shrinkage in vacuum drying process of fresh wolfberry fruits
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for reducing shrinkage in a vacuum drying process of fresh wolfberry fruits, which comprises the following steps: pretreatment, vacuum drying: the pretreated fresh wolfberry fruits are placed into a dryer for vacuum drying, and the vacuum drying is divided into three stages, namely the following steps: the first stage, keeping the temperature not higher than 55 ℃, the vacuum pressure not higher than 1200pa, the cold trap temperature not lower than-15 ℃ and the drying time not lower than 10h; the second stage, on the basis of the first stage, the temperature is increased by 5-15 ℃, the vacuum pressure is reduced by 700-800 pa, the cold trap temperature is increased by 10-20 ℃, and the drying time is not less than 8 hours; and in the third stage, the temperature is increased by 5-10 ℃ on the basis of the second stage, the vacuum pressure is reduced by 50-150 pa, the cold trap temperature is reduced by 20-25 ℃, and the drying time is not less than 5h. The water migration speed is comprehensively regulated, the problems of shrinkage and dark color in the vacuum drying processing process of fresh wolfberry fruits are reduced, and the qualification rate and the quality of the dried wolfberry fruits are improved.

title_en: Wheat cold-resistant gene TaERF-like and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to a wheat cold-resistant gene TaERF-like and application thereof. The invention provides an application of a wheat ethylene response element binding protein family AP2/EREBP transcription factor gene TaERF-like in plant cold resistance and plant flowering time advance. The plant transformed with the gene can endure low temperature stress and lead flowering time to be advanced, and the nucleotide sequence of the gene and the amino acid sequence of the coded protein are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 2. Through over-expression of the gene in arabidopsis, the cold resistance of transgenic plants can be obviously improved, and the flowering time of plants is advanced.

title_en: Phage RKP-PA-2022001 for lysing drug-resistant pseudomonas aeruginosa and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a bacteriophage for splitting drug-resistant pseudomonas aeruginosa and application thereof. The phage RKP-PA-2022001 of the drug-resistant pseudomonas aeruginosa is pseudomonas aeruginosa phage Pseudomonas aeruginosa bacteriophage which is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of 45092 in the 4 th month of 2022. The invention discovers and separates a bacteriophage RKP-PA-2022001, which takes pseudomonas aeruginosa as a host, has strong cracking effect on drug-resistant pseudomonas aeruginosa in a culture environment, and provides a good phage source for the control of pseudomonas aeruginosa in the culture environment by industrially producing phage.

title_en: Regeneration method of banana embryo
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural biology, and relates to a regeneration method of a canna embryo, which comprises the steps of disinfection and material drawing of explants, embryo germination induction, adventitious bud differentiation and proliferation, rooting culture, seedling hardening and transplanting and the like. The invention takes the seed embryo of the fresh canna fruit which is about 80-100 days after bud picking and fruit setting as the explant to carry out tissue culture, adopts a two-step induction germination mode of inducing and differentiating firstly to differentiate and can efficiently differentiate adventitious buds without a callus stage, has better germination differentiation effect and higher differentiation rate, lays a foundation for subsequent proliferation culture and rooting culture, has the characteristics of less required raw materials, stable genetic character, small variation, rapid differentiation speed, simple operation, low cost, rapid growth and the like, and lays a foundation for the resource protection, ecological restoration and excavation utilization of the canna.

title_en: Eight-delicacy tea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses eight-treasure tea and a preparation method thereof, wherein the eight-treasure tea comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1-1.5 parts of plums, 1-2 parts of apricots, 3-5 parts of dates, 2-3 parts of peaches, 3-5 parts of chestnut, 1-1.8 parts of medlar, 1-1.3 parts of cistanche deserticola and 5-8 parts of brown sugar, and the beneficial effects of the invention are that: the tea substitute is prepared from plums, apricots, dates, peaches and chestnut serving materials, is light in taste, combines five flavors, supplements five viscera and six viscera, does not add any preservative or pigment, truly achieves green tea beverage, and has the effects of nourishing yin and liver, tonifying yang and kidney and enriching blood and tonifying deficiency by adding the Chinese wolfberry, cistanche and brown sugar.

title_en: High specific activity acidic mannanase mutant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering and protein modification, in particular to a high specific activity acidic mannase mutant and application thereof. The invention provides mutants comprising the mutation site selected from the group consisting of F46S/Q, Y132F, T K/R, F L/W/M, L259M, S263E/T/D, W264F/Y/M/V, T266F/K/Y/L/G/Q, P335Q/E/K/T, D336G based on wild-type mannanase M20. The specific activity of the mannase mutant is obviously improved, which is beneficial to reducing the production cost of the enzyme and promoting the wide application of the mannase mutant in the feed field.

title_en: High-active-oxygen black tea fermentation machine capable of limiting leaf temperature and adopting constant-temperature water mist for heating and fermentation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-active oxygen black tea fermentation machine capable of limiting leaf temperature and adopting constant-temperature water mist heating, which comprises a fermentation box, wherein a plurality of fermentation frames are sequentially arranged in the fermentation box at intervals from top to bottom, a blower is arranged at the bottom of the fermentation frame, a constant-temperature atomizer is arranged at the top of the fermentation box and communicated with the interior of the fermentation box through a water mist inlet pipe, constant-temperature water mist rich in high-active oxygen is injected into the fermentation box, and an exhaust pipe is further arranged at the top of the fermentation box and used for exhausting gas higher than the air pressure outside the fermentation box in the fermentation box. The device does not need to worry about too high and too low temperature and humidity in the whole fermentation process, only needs to set the fermentation time according to the needs, and the fermentation leaves can be fermented safely under proper fermentation conditions, so that the device is very simple and efficient.

title_en: Novel solar energy phase change energy storage integral type coconut is dry device
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel solar phase-change energy-storage integrated coconut drying device which comprises a drying chamber, wherein the drying chamber comprises a ceiling and a circumferential side plate connected below the ceiling, and a plurality of drying modules are arranged in the drying chamber from top to bottom. The drying module comprises a phase-change energy storage cabin and a drying plate arranged above the phase-change energy storage cabin from bottom to top. The invention has high practicability, low energy consumption and easy operation. When the solar energy solar cell panel is used, direct solar energy enters a drying chamber to dry coconuts, the polycrystalline solar cell panel provides electric energy for the operation of a dehumidifier, an exhaust fan and a temperature and humidity measuring device, and the exhaust fan discharges saturated air from the drying chamber and introduces fresh air to fill the drying chamber. Meanwhile, the ceiling effectively absorbs solar radiation, the photovoltaic glass plays an effective light absorption and heat insulation role, the phase-change energy storage cabin effectively absorbs and stores heat energy, the black limestone substrate resists heat energy of the phase-change energy storage cabin to escape to the lower part, sunlight heat energy is effectively utilized, drying uniformity is achieved, drying cost is low, and drying efficiency is high.

title_en: Special chafing dish essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special hot pot essence and a preparation method thereof, wherein the special hot pot essence comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10 to 20 parts of beef tallow, 20 to 30 parts of soybean oil, 5 to 10 parts of lard, 2 to 4 parts of thick broad-bean sauce, 2 to 4 parts of ginger, 3 to 5 parts of green onion, 4 to 6 parts of chilli, 0.2 to 0.5 part of pepper, 0.1 to 0.2 part of nutmeg, 0.01 to 0.1 part of cassia bark, 2 to 5 parts of star anise, 1 to 2 parts of tsaoko cardamon, 0.5 to 1 part of lysimachia foenum-graecum, 0.5 to 1 part of angelica, 1 to 2 parts of kaempferia galanga, 0.02 to 0.04 part of clove oil, 0.2 to 0.8 part of chilli essential oil, 2 to 4 parts of propylene glycol, 0.02 to 0.06 part of ethyl maltol, 0.01 to 0.02 part of glycine, 0.01 to 0.02 part of L-alanine and 0.01 to 0.03 part of 5' -nucleotide disodium; the beef tallow, the soybean oil and the lard are mixed according to a specific proportion for use, so that the beef tallow, the soybean oil and the lard have stronger fragrance and richer fragrance, and the raw materials are fried at high temperature by adding various spices, so that the fragrance substances of the raw materials are fully released, the integral characteristics of the product, the flavor of the chafing dish, the flavor stability of the chafing dish and the fragrance retention duration are improved, and the comprehensive characteristic fragrance of the chafing dish bottom flavoring can be enhanced and the fragrance retention effect is improved by adding the beef tallow, the soybean oil and the lard into the chafing dish.

title_en: Preparation method of spiced tomato bean curd blocks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of spiced tomato bean curd blocks, which belongs to the technical field of food preparation and comprises the following steps: 1) Grinding soybean into powder; 2) Adding crushed fruits and vegetables to obtain a mixture; 3) Adding the flavoring and continuing mixing; 4) Boxing and quick-freezing the mixture; 5) Packaging and warehousing; according to the invention, the soybean is ground into powder, then the crushed fruits and vegetables and the seasonings are directly added, and the bean curd blocks can be obtained after boxing and freezing, so that the process is short, the processing efficiency is high, and the taste is obviously improved.

title_en: Gastrodia elata ferment and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gastrodia elata ferment and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the gastrodia elata ferment comprises the steps of cleaning fresh gastrodia elata, pulping, inactivating enzyme, cooling, ultrasonic extraction, enzymolysis, filtering, homogenizing, primary sterilization, inoculation fermentation, degassing and secondary sterilization, wherein the inoculation fermentation step is to add ferment starter and bread yeast for symbiotic fermentation.

title_en: Bamboo shoot product blanching and steaming equipment with fluid heating device
