abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bamboo shoot product processing, in particular to bamboo shoot product blanching and steaming equipment with a fluid heating device, which comprises a support base consisting of a support ring and a plurality of support connecting rods, wherein a heating box is arranged on the support base, the heating box is communicated with the steaming box, a sealing top cover is detachably connected to the steaming box, a long mounting column is fixedly arranged in the steaming box through a long mounting rod, a plurality of Y-shaped mounting frames are annularly arranged on the long mounting column, a bamboo shoot placing box is rotatably arranged on the Y-shaped mounting frames, an internal ventilation pipe for ventilating the inside of the bamboo shoot placing box is arranged in the middle of the bamboo shoot placing box, ventilation of the inside of the bamboo shoot placing box is realized through the internal ventilation pipe, accumulation of the bamboo shoots is avoided, the contact area of the bamboo shoots and water vapor is increased, the bamboo shoots are heated uniformly, and the steaming quality is improved.

title_en: Sow feed regulator for improving constipation and feed
abstract_en: A sow feed regulator for improving constipation, wherein the feed regulator consists of bifidobacterium lactis and bacillus subtilis fermented products; the bacillus subtilis ferment is prepared by fermenting Km of bacillus subtilis PL13-hom with the preservation number of CCTCC: M2015002 in a culture medium, wherein the culture medium contains plant extracts, and the plant extracts are water extracts of a mixture consisting of immature bitter orange, almond, rheum officinale, magnolia officinalis, paeonia lactiflora and hemp seed. The invention can solve the toxicity and inhibition effects of the plant extract on bifidobacterium lactis production, and can reversely promote the growth of bifidobacterium lactis and the long-term colonization survival in intestinal tracts, thereby playing a role in synergistically promoting the prevention and treatment of constipation.

title_en: Rehmannia iridoid oxidase gene RgIO and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rehmannia iridoid oxidase gene RgIO. Experiments show that the content of catalpol in the leaves can be obviously increased by adopting rehmannia leaves to transiently overexpress the iridoid oxidase gene RgIO. Therefore, the rehmannia iridoid oxidase gene RgIO and the protein coded by the same can obviously promote the synthesis of iridoid components, especially promote the biosynthesis of rehmannia catalpol in vivo, and have good application prospects in the aspect of improving the medicinal quality of rehmannia.

title_en: Application of ZmCCD gene in corn breeding
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of ZmCCD genes in corn breeding, which comprises the steps of improving the iron content of leaves, especially ear leaves, improving the iron content of corn kernels, especially single ear kernels, inhibiting interaction between ZmMYB118 and ZmVIT2.1 protein-DNA in plants and the like. The invention also provides a corn breeding method for obtaining a new corn strain by over-expressing ZmCCD genes and a new corn strain with over-expressed ZmCCD genes. The invention can provide important genetic resources and technical support for improving crop quality and stress resistance, and has important application prospect.

title_en: Liupu tea steaming processing device and steaming process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Liupu tea processing, in particular to a Liupu tea steaming processing device and a steaming process, comprising a device body, wherein a centrifugal rotating disc is arranged in an inner cavity of the device body, and an air extraction assembly is arranged above the centrifugal rotating disc; a steam jet assembly is arranged below the centrifugal rotating disc; the steam jet assembly is externally connected with a steam generator and jets steam to the lower part of the centrifugal rotating disc, and the steam flows upwards and flows to the upper part of the centrifugal rotating disc from the vent hole; according to the steaming process, when steaming is carried out, the centrifugal rotating disc is used for carrying out centrifugal operation on tea leaves in a centrifugal mode, so that the tea leaves are enabled to roll and swing in the centrifugal process, and meanwhile, high-temperature steam is introduced into the rolled and swing tea leaves from bottom to top, and the rolled and swing tea leaves are enabled to be cured rapidly and uniformly. The invention has the advantages of good steaming uniformity, high efficiency, good tea quality and the like.

title_en: Application of ZmVPE a gene in regulation and control of salt tolerance of corn
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to application of ZmVPE a gene in regulation and control of salt tolerance of corn. The invention discovers that the expression of a tonoplast phosphate transport gene ZmVPE a in corn is obviously inhibited after NaCl treatment, and physiological phenotype analysis of zmvpe a-mu mutant of the gene and a super-expression material OE-ZmVPE a under NaCl treatment conditions is utilized to obtain a conclusion: knocking down the expression level of the corn vacuolar phosphorus transporter gene ZmVPE a can improve the tolerance of corn to NaCl stress. The invention discloses a new function of the gene, and the gene can be used as a molecular marker to provide a powerful theoretical basis for physiological evaluation of plant salt tolerance and molecular breeding work in the future.

title_en: Roller stir-frying machine for melon seed production and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of melon seed production, and provides a drum stir-frying machine for melon seed production and a production process thereof, which solve the problems of high production cost and high cleaning cost caused by structural design defects of the existing equipment, and comprise a rack, wherein a drum is erected on the rack, two ends of the drum are respectively provided with a closed first end and an open second end, and the first end is provided with a lifting part for adjusting the height of the first end of the drum; the roller is divided into a mixing section, a first discharging section, a second discharging section and a leakage-proof section from a first end to a second end, and a plurality of first discharging holes and a plurality of second discharging holes are respectively formed in the surfaces of the first discharging section and the second discharging section; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the lifting part, the height difference between the first end and the second end of the roller is changed, so that the mixed materials can be guided to the first discharging section and the second discharging section provided with the discharging holes, the materials are separated and discharged, the subsequent impurity removal assembly line is shortened, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Rhizoma acori graminei transcription factor AtsWRKY and vector, recombinant bacterium and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a grassleaf sweelflag rhizome transcription factor AtsWRKY, the nucleotide sequence of which is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the amino acid sequence of a coding region is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention also provides a vector comprising the transcription factor and recombinant bacteria comprising the transcription factor. Meanwhile, the invention also provides application of the transcription factor AtsWRKY in the effect of the grassleaf sweelflag rhizome leaf on the mosquito-repellent effect of the aedes albopictus. The WRKY transcription factor AtsWRKY provided by the invention participates in the regulation and control of terpenoid metabolism in the grassleaf sweelflag rhizome, and through over-expression of AtsWRKY gene in the grassleaf sweelflag rhizome, the content of terpenoid in grassleaf sweelflag rhizome leaves can be effectively increased, so that the mosquito-repellent effect of the grassleaf sweelflag rhizome is improved, and a theoretical basis is provided for the grassleaf sweelflag rhizome leaves as natural mosquito-repellent products.

title_en: Bacillus subtilis and application thereof in preventing and treating mastitis
abstract_en: The invention discloses bacillus subtilis and application thereof in preventing and treating mastitis. The bacillus subtilis Bacillus subtilis M2022 can inhibit the formation of staphylococcus aureus biological films, damage the staphylococcus aureus biological films, further reduce the colonization of staphylococcus aureus, reduce the number of somatic cells of dairy cows and prevent the mastitis of the dairy cows, and has potential application prospects in the field of the control of the mastitis of the dairy cows.

title_en: Method for engineering and transforming nannochloropsis co-producing canthaxanthin and EPA and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for engineering and transforming nannochloropsis to co-produce canthaxanthin and EPA and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of screening beta-carotene ketolase from nannochloropsis, codon optimization and selection of a positioning peptide, and then mediating and expressing the beta-carotene ketolase in nannochloropsis chloroplast by chloroplast transit peptide to obtain a nannochloropsis engineering strain for synthesizing canthaxanthin and EPA simultaneously, and particularly the nannochloropsis engineering strain can effectively solve the problems that the conventional nannochloropsis midcorner Huang Suzhi is synthesized under the stress condition and has extremely low content.

title_en: Compositions and methods for transforming embryogenic explants excised from monocot seeds
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel compositions and methods for improving transformation of embryogenic explants excised from monocot seeds, which may include one or more steps of explant preparation, explant rehydration, rhizobia bacterial inoculation and co-cultivation, bud induction, extended bud induction, or regeneration of genetically modified plants or plant parts. Methods provided herein can include transforming at least one plant cell of an embryo explant with a heterologous polynucleotide by inoculating the embryo explant with a rhizobia bacterium comprising the heterologous polynucleotide. Methods provided herein also include methods of regenerating genetically modified plants or plant parts from transformed or edited plant cells or explants.

title_en: Preparation method of passion fruit whole fruit wine with improved clarification effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of passion fruit whole fruit wine with improved clarification effect, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. In the method of the invention, pectase, cellulase and glutamine transaminase are added before fermentation, and polyglutamic acid, bentonite and curdlan are added after fermentation. The light transmittance of the passion fruit whole fruit wine obtained by the method is up to 98.9%. The passion fruit wine composite clarifying agent prepared by the invention can be used for preparing passion fruit wine from passion fruit, can obviously improve the clarity of passion fruit wine, reduce the technical difficulty and production cost of a clarification process, shorten the clarification treatment time, effectively maintain the flavor and the nutritional value of the fruit wine, improve the production efficiency of the fruit wine, and has the advantages of simple operation, easy implementation and popularization and use value.

title_en: Nutritional method for improving anti-hypoxia stress capability of large yellow croaker
abstract_en: The invention provides a nutritional method for improving the anti-hypoxia stress capability of large yellow croaker, and belongs to the technical field of aquaculture. The method comprises the following steps: preparing, processing, feeding and breeding feed. The feed is prepared from clostridium ethoxide protein, cotton seed concentrated protein, kelp powder containing gelatin and 5-aminolevulinic acid as main components of the compound feed for feeding the large yellow croaker, improves the proportion of fish meal, reduces the negative influence on the health of the large yellow croaker body, and simultaneously combines a specific processing technology and a feed feeding mode to improve the survival rate, the oxidation resistance and the hypoxia stress resistance of the large yellow croaker. In addition, the nutritional method for improving the anti-hypoxia stress capability of the large yellow croaker has the characteristics of small feed consumption, low production cost and stable effect.

title_en: Processing method of aquatic product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of aquatic products, which relates to the field of aquatic product processing, and comprises a frame, a flowing bin and a storage bin, wherein the flowing bin is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the frame, one end of the frame is provided with a reflux pump for conveying the aquatic products, a water tank assembly and a water distribution shell, the upper end of the flowing bin is provided with a sealing plate for sealing the flowing bin, the sealed flowing bin is filled with nitrogen, and the upper end of the sealing plate is fixedly provided with a feeding bin.

title_en: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles, which comprises the following steps: mixing Chlamydomonas reinhardtii with water to obtain a mixed solution; adding complex enzyme into the mixed solution, adding acetic acid to adjust pH, preserving heat, and heating for extraction to obtain an extract; filtering the extracting solution and concentrating the extracting solution into clear paste with the concentration of 1.05 to 1.15 g/mL; adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the clear paste, centrifugally separating and collecting precipitate; dissolving the precipitate in water, adding cyclodextrin, mixing, and spray drying to obtain polysaccharide dry powder; mixing the polysaccharide dry powder with starch and magnesium stearate, granulating, and sieving to obtain Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles; the complex enzyme comprises cellulase, pectase and superoxide dismutase. According to the preparation method, the complex enzyme is adopted for enzymolysis, so that the cell wall structure of the chlamydomonas reinhardtii can be damaged to promote the polysaccharide to be easily dissolved out, the problems of low extraction efficiency and low purity in the chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide extraction process are solved, and the loss of the polysaccharide is avoided to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method for in-vitro preservation of sugarcane germplasm resources by cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preserving sugarcane germplasm resources in vitro by cells, and belongs to the technical field of sugarcane germplasm preservation. The method comprises the following steps of taking sugarcane tender leaf sheaths as explants, carrying out callus induction culture and multiplication culture to obtain embryogenic cell masses, and carrying out ultralow temperature preservation on the embryogenic cell masses, wherein culture mediums of the callus induction culture and the multiplication culture comprise mannitol and corn silk extracts, and the corn silk extracts are alcohol extracts of corn silk. According to the invention, mannitol and corn silk extract are added into the callus induction culture medium and the multiplication culture medium, so that the phenomenon of browning of the explant in the in-vitro tissue culture process of the sugarcane is effectively relieved, the activity of embryogenic callus cell mass is improved, the generation of in-vitro regenerated seedlings of the sugarcane is promoted, and the transplanting survival rate of the regenerated seedlings is improved through optimizing the illumination condition.

title_en: Method for prolonging storage period of fried paste-coated peanuts by using antioxidant microcapsules assisted with vacuum deoxidization packaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for prolonging the storage period of fried and paste-coated peanuts by an antioxidant microcapsule assisted by vacuum deoxidization packaging, which comprises the steps of preparing alpha-tocopherol ferulate through enzymatic catalysis, adding the alpha-tocopherol ferulate into frying oil after microencapsulation, transferring the alpha-tocopherol ferulate microcapsule into the fried and paste-coated peanuts through oil-water exchange in the frying process, and prolonging the storage period of the fried and paste-coated peanuts by vacuum deoxidization packaging. The method has important application value for prolonging the service life of the natural antioxidant alpha-tocopherol in the fried and pasted peanuts so as to prolong the storage period of the fried and pasted peanuts.

title_en: Food steaming and baking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a food steaming and baking device, which aims to solve the technical problems that the food steaming efficiency is low and different types of foods cannot be simultaneously manufactured in the prior art. The invention comprises a feeding mechanism, a first transfer mechanism, a proofing mechanism, a second transfer mechanism, a steaming mechanism, a third transfer mechanism and a cooling mechanism; the interior of the proofing mechanism and the interior of the steaming mechanism are respectively provided with a baking heating pipe, food is conveyed to the first transfer mechanism by the feeding mechanism, the first transfer mechanism is correspondingly connected with the proofing mechanism and is used for distributing the food to proofing conveyer belts of different layers, the proofing mechanism is correspondingly connected with the second transfer mechanism and is used for conveying the proofed food into the steaming mechanism, and the steaming mechanism is correspondingly connected with the third transfer mechanism and is used for conveying the steamed food into the cooling mechanism. The beneficial technical effects of the invention are as follows: the degree of automation is high, improves production efficiency, and satisfies different foods and makes in parallel simultaneously.

title_en: Method for brewing high-quality white spirit by polished rice
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to a method for brewing high-quality white spirit by polished rice, which adopts a polishing method to polish rice, removes fat and protein on the surface of the rice, and then brews rice-flavor wine base, in the brewing process, the most suitable polished rice rate is continuously searched, meanwhile, the fat and protein are basically removed by combining with the polished rice, the common saccharomycetes are used for improving the strain of the wine base, the technical defect that the fermentation effect is not obvious is overcome, and the self-screened buckling capsule film-covered saccharomycetes (Saccharomycopsisfibuligera) S1 and the purple monascus (Monascuspurpureus) strain M2 are adopted for compounding to prepare the wine base.

title_en: Application of EXA1 gene in enhancing resistance of tomato brown wrinkle fruit virus
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of molecular biology and biotechnology, and relates to application of an EXA1 gene in enhancing resistance of tomato brown wrinkle fruit viruses. By comparing the virus accumulation of tomato and tobacco EXA1 down-regulated plants with that of control plants, the virus accumulation of ToBRFV, TMV and PVX in EXA1 down-regulated plants is obviously lower than that of control plants, which shows that the virus disease resistance of crops can be enhanced by inhibiting the reduction and/or inactivation of EXA1 gene expression and/or activity. EXA1 genes are ubiquitous in plants, EXA1 is down-regulated by a VIGS technology and is knocked out by a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, EXA1 down-regulated and knocked-out plants are obtained, the method is expected to obviously enhance the virus disease resistance of solanaceous crops, and theoretical and method basis is provided for obtaining new disease-resistant varieties by using EXA1, so that the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Soy sauce beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soy sauce beverage and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of beverages. The soy sauce beverage comprises the following components in parts by weight: 1-5 parts of original brewed soy sauce and sugar substitute: 0.001-1 part of other nutrient substances: 0.01-2 parts of water 100 parts. The soy sauce beverage has proper salinity, reducing sugar content, amino acid nitrogen content, total acid content and total active substance content by the optimized preparation method. The soy sauce beverage has light soy sauce flavor, no peculiar smell, rich taste, slight sweet and sour taste, light salty taste, mild taste, and no bitter taste. The red-brown natural pigment has the advantages of no need of adding pigment and essence, excellent color, smell, taste and quality, and rich natural and healthy nutrient substances which are easy to absorb.

title_en: Medicinal and edible composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicinal and edible composition, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention is designed from the comprehensive conditioning angles of activating blood circulation to dissipate blood stasis, clearing liver-fire, strengthening spleen to remove dampness, nourishing yin and replenishing blood, and the like, has reasonable compatibility, ensures that the composition can help to maintain the healthy level function of blood fat, avoids the harm caused by the increase of the blood fat, and has the remarkable effects of reducing total cholesterol and triglyceride. Moreover, the composition is prepared from natural medicinal and edible Chinese herbal medicines, has no side effect or small side effect on human bodies, can nourish bodies, can be taken for a long time, and has wide applicable crowd and high practical application value.

title_en: Use of fullerenes in the prevention or treatment of altitude degradation
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the field of biological medicine, and in particular relates to application of fullerene in preventing or treating altitude degradation. In particular, the present disclosure provides a use of a fullerene in the preparation of a composition for preventing or treating altitude degradation. Hypoxia results in reduced mice feeding, weight and physical performance, elevated blood oxidative stress levels, and increased metabolic waste lactate. Experimental results of the present disclosure demonstrate that changes in physical performance, oxidative stress, and lactic acid accumulation of mice caused by hypoxia can be improved by adding fullerenes to the mouse feed. Although the salidroside can also improve physical performance and reduce the degree of oxidative stress, the salidroside has no obvious effect of reducing accumulated lactic acid. Meanwhile, the medicine concentration of the salidroside is twice that of a high-concentration fullerene group, so that the treatment effect of the fullerene on the mice with the physical strength decline model is superior to that of the salidroside. In conclusion, the fullerene is a supplement with remarkable effect for improving exercise endurance, and can be widely used for preparing medicines for preventing and treating altitude degradation.

title_en: Composition and microemulsion for regulating intestinal health of livestock and poultry as well as preparation method and application of composition and microemulsion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses a composition for regulating intestinal health of livestock and poultry, which comprises black soldier fly larva intestinal extract, and also comprises a poplar flower extract, dihydromyricetin and pine needle powder extract, wherein the weight ratio of the black soldier fly larva intestinal extract to the poplar flower extract to the dihydromyricetin to the pine needle powder extract is 1:0.1-10:0.1-0.5:0.1-10. The composition can improve intestinal health and reduce diarrhea of weaned pigs, is beneficial to improving the intestinal tracts of the weaned pigs, has good effect of improving the intestinal health of other pigs of all ages, and further provides microemulsion containing the composition and a preparation method and application thereof.

title_en: Bean pulp decrement replacement feed for improving growth performance and meat quality of broiler chickens
abstract_en: The invention provides a soybean meal decrement alternative feed for improving the growth performance and meat quality of broiler chickens, and belongs to the field of poultry feeds. The chicken feed comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 62 to 68 parts of corn, 3 to 15 parts of bean pulp, 5 to 20 parts of hemp pulp, 1 to 3 parts of fish meal, 4 to 5 parts of bran, 3 to 5 parts of soybean oil, 0.8 to 1 part of stone powder, 0.5 to 1 part of calcium hydrophosphate, 0.3 part of salt, 0.2 to 0.7 part of L-lysine salt, 0.1 to 0.2 part of DL-methionine and 1 part of premix. According to the invention, hemp meal is used for partially replacing soybean meal, so that the feed intake, weight and feed conversion efficiency of broiler chickens are improved, the raising cost is reduced, the raising benefit is improved, the pectoral muscle water retention is effectively improved, the chicken tenderness and juiciness are improved, and the chicken quality is improved.

title_en: Method for making steamed meat and processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing steamed meat and processing equipment, wherein the steamed meat processing equipment comprises a vegetable washing pool, four-port marinating pots, a food cage, a cooling room, a cooling system arranged in the cooling room, a humidifier, a turntable unit, an infrared temperature sensor, an air extraction system, an alarm and a controller, wherein the cooling room is a transparent glass room, the cooling system comprises an air conditioner external unit and an air conditioner internal unit, the turntable unit is positioned in front of the air conditioner internal unit, the humidifier discharges water vapor between the air conditioner internal unit and the turntable unit, a hook of the food cage is used for hooking on a hook part or the edge of the marinating pot, the infrared temperature sensor is positioned on one side of the turntable unit, and the air extraction system comprises a first air extraction pipe fixed on a wall of the glass room and a second air extraction pipe arranged above the marinating pot; the method for preparing the marinated meat comprises 7 steps. According to the method for preparing the braised pork, disclosed by the invention, through the three-boiling three-washing and rapid cooling modes, the cooled food material surface is cleaner, the loss of fragrance is reduced, and the purchasing desire of consumers is increased.

title_en: Method for preparing seafood preservative by taking bamboo as raw material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seafood preservation, and particularly relates to a method for preparing seafood preservative by taking bamboo as a raw material. The preparation method comprises preparing active water, preparing bamboo leaf antioxidant, preparing bamboo fiber liquid, and plasma treating. The invention starts with the mechanism of seafood spoilage, fully utilizes bamboo as a raw material, extracts antioxidants in bamboo leaves, adopts plasma to excite free radicals in sterile bamboo liquid bioactive water, solves the problem of too fast fish decay, carries out surface adsorption on micron-sized bamboo fiber balls, ensures that a fresh-keeping layer is firmer, prevents bacteria from further infection, and finally adopts active polysaccharide, namely chitosan to carry out film forming, thereby blocking bacteria in air from entering. The raw materials of the invention adopt original ecological bamboo, which is environment-friendly and low in cost, and the prepared preservative adopts triple preservation modes, namely adsorption preservation, ionic group release and film formation preservation, so that the seafood preservation effect is better, no harm is caused to the component human body, and the preservative is safer and more environment-friendly.

title_en: Intelligent fruit tray
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses an intelligent fruit tray, which comprises: the device comprises a shell disc, a base, an atomization sterilizing component and a fan component. The shell disc is used for placing fruits and is provided with an atomization port and a temperature return port which penetrate through the shell disc; the base is connected with the bottom of the shell disc in an adaptive manner; the atomization sterilizing component is arranged in the base, and is communicated with the atomization opening under the condition that the shell disc is in adaptive connection with the base and is used for providing an atomization sterilizing medium for the upper side of the shell disc; the fan assembly is arranged in the base, and is communicated with the temperature return port under the condition that the shell disc is in adaptive connection with the base and used for driving air flow to pass through the upper side of the shell disc to form temperature return air flow. The sterilization can be better realized by atomizing and sterilizing, meanwhile, the residual pesticide on the fruits can be purified, the cleanliness of the fruits is maintained, the air flow is driven by the fan assembly to flow in from the temperature return port, the air flow is generated around the fruits, the heat exchange between the indoor normal-temperature air flow and the fruits is increased, and the fruits can be quickly warmed.

title_en: Gene TaLAC capable of improving wheat scab disease resistance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gene TaLAC capable of improving wheat scab disease resistance and application thereof, comprising TaLAC gene which belongs to laccase family members and is a gene specifically expressed in disease resistant variety Sumai No. 3. The gene is guided into a popularization variety field by constructing an over-expression vector and adopting an agrobacterium infection method to obtain a stable transgenic plant, and the disease resistance of scab is obviously improved in the obtained three transgenic lines. The invention has important production significance for improving the resistance of wheat scab, and provides new gene resources for cultivating new wheat varieties with high yield, stable yield and strong adaptability.

title_en: Preparation method and application of tomato haploid inducer line
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of crop genetic breeding application, and provides a preparation method and application of a tomato haploid inducer line, comprising the following steps: knocking out CenH genes to obtain transgenic tomato I; expressing the fusion protein with the complementary CenH gene deleted to obtain a transgenic tomato II; selfing the offspring obtained by hybridization of the transgenic tomato I and the transgenic tomato II to obtain a tomato haploid induction line; selfing tomato haploid induction line or its offspring, or crossing with other tomato material as female parent to obtain tomato haploid. In conclusion, the preparation method of the tomato haploid induction line can generate the haploid induction line, lays an important foundation for expanding the application of haploid breeding technology on tomatoes, and provides a new strategy for germplasm innovation and new variety breeding of tomatoes.

title_en: Replacement feed for orius soleiformis and large-scale continuous breeding method for orius soleiformis
abstract_en: The invention provides a replacement feed for orius soleiformis and a large-scale continuous breeding method for orius soleiformis. Step one, sterilizing the brine shrimp eggs by using a sterilizing liquid; step two, preparing agarose gel matrix, and placing the brine shrimp eggs on the gel matrix; step three, the orius lucorum and the culture medium are put into a culture device; step four, taking out the same batch of culture medium, placing the culture medium in a new culture device, and after the hatching of the orius lucorum eggs, replacing the culture medium at regular time, and continuously repeating the step three and the step four; the invention provides a technical method for differentially breeding a breeding population and a commodity population in a large-scale breeding process of orius september; the invention realizes batch supply of feed and spawning matrix; the natural enemy feeding is carried out by taking the substitute feed as main food, so that the food required by the natural enemy can be stably supplied, and the population scale can be conveniently and timely adjusted.

title_en: High-efficiency curcumin-loaded polysaccharide-protein based co-assembly and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency curcumin-loaded polysaccharide-protein based co-assembly, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functional food processing. The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a protein-based co-assembly loaded with curcumin through a pH circulating strategy, and then depositing a pectin coating on the surface of the protein-based co-assembly through the surface of polyelectrolyte to prepare the polysaccharide-protein-based co-assembly loaded with curcumin. The curcumin-loaded polysaccharide-protein based co-assembly prepared by the invention can realize high-efficiency loading of curcumin, and can effectively improve the in-vitro antioxidant activity of curcumin and the biological accessibility of curcumin after simulated gastrointestinal digestion. Meanwhile, the preparation process is simple and convenient, has low energy consumption, and meets the requirements of green, low-carbon and sustainable development concepts. The invention expands the application range of liposoluble polyphenols such as curcumin in the food processing field, improves the added value of tilapia protein isolate and promotes the development of the tilapia deep processing industry.

title_en: Backbone parent screening method for fir high-generation production population
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backbone parent screening method of a fir high-generation production group, which comprises the steps of S1, preprocessing each fir parent in a designated fir third-generation seed garden to obtain microsatellite data corresponding to each fir parent, wherein the designated fir third-generation seed garden comprises a plurality of fir parents, each fir parent comprises an a plant clone, S2, collecting reproduction character data corresponding to each fir parent in the designated fir third-generation seed garden respectively for each fir parent, S3, obtaining growth character information of offspring corresponding to each fir parent according to offspring measuring forest corresponding to the designated fir third-generation seed garden, and S4, screening out the backbone parent based on microsatellite data corresponding to each parent in the designated fir third-generation seed garden, reproduction character data and growth character information of the offspring.

title_en: Probiotic nutrition bar for regulating intestinal microecology and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probiotic nutrition bar for regulating intestinal microecology and a preparation process thereof, and relates to the technical field of nutritional foods. The probiotic nutrition bar is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 1-5 parts of medlar dietary fiber, 5-15 parts of sugar alcohol substances, 10-30 parts of protein substances, 5-25 parts of soluble dietary fiber, 5-10 parts of frozen powder of Welch's disease-induced mannite, 0.5-5 parts of highland barley, 1-2 parts of stabilizer, 1-3 parts of grease and 1-10 parts of flaxseed; the preservation number of the condensation Wittman is CCTCC NO: M2017813. The probiotic nutrition bar has good texture characteristics, has good effect of relieving constipation, promotes intestinal peristalsis, and can improve constipation through enzyme activity in intestinal tract.

title_en: Seaweed dietary fiber and application thereof in feed additive
abstract_en: The invention relates to seaweed dietary fiber and application thereof in feed additives, in the preparation process of fucoidan-microelement chelate, methanol-aqueous solution is adopted to pre-dissolve fucoidan, so that sugar chains of fucoidan can be fully stretched, hydroxyl units in fucoidan are fully exposed in the solution, chelation sites of fucoidan and microelement are increased, and the chelation amount of the fucoidan-microelement in the microelement can be obviously improved by matching with a subsequent complexation process, so that fucoidan-microelement chelate is obtained, wherein the content of microelement is not less than 25%, and when the fucoidan-microelement chelate is applied to the feed additives for laying hens, the egg laying quality of laying hens can be obviously improved.

title_en: Denatured milk proteins and methods of making same
abstract_en: The present disclosure includes denatured whey protein compositions. The composition comprises, on a dry weight basis, at least 60% by weight protein, less than 8% by weight natural Glycomacropeptide (GMP), relative to the total weight of the protein, greater than 2% by weight enzymatically hydrolyzed GMP, at least 8% by weight proteolysis index, and greater than 50% by weight denatured whey protein, relative to the total weight of the protein.

title_en: Lactobacillus plantarum and application thereof in ulcerative colitis prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus plantarum and application thereof in ulcerative colitis prevention, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The strain provided by the invention is lactobacillus plantarum (Lactobacillus plantarum) M67-25, and the preservation number of the strain in China general microbiological culture collection center is CGMCC No.28661. Lactobacillus plantarum (Lactobacillus plantarum) M67-25 can be used as probiotic, food additive and food starter for preventing ulcerative colitis. The invention has wide application prospect in the aspect of ulcerative colitis prevention.

title_en: ZmHLH2 gene for regulating corn leaf included angle and plant height and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ZmHLH gene for regulating and controlling corn leaf included angle and plant height and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, wherein the genome sequence of the ZmHLH gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, the CDS sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3, and the amino acid sequence of an expressed protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention uses CRISPR/Cas9 technology to knock out corn ZmHLH gene, the leaf angle, plant height and plant height of mutant are obviously reduced, which has important significance for corn density-tolerant breeding. The upstanding blades enable densely planted crops to reduce mutual shading and capture more light, thereby helping to increase the yield per unit area of the crop.

title_en: Application of riboflavin synthase gene OsRIBAB in regulating and controlling salt tolerance and drought tolerance of rice
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and discloses application of a coding gene of riboflavin synthase of rice in negative regulation of salt tolerance and drought tolerance of the rice, wherein the coding gene is OsRIBAB2 (Os 02g 0572400). According to the invention, a rice tillering control gene OsRIBAB (riboflavin biosynthesis protein ribAB 2) responding to temperature change is cloned and identified from a rice single tillering mutant tsm (thermo-SENSITIVE MONOCULM 1) subjected to radiation mutagenesis, and further research shows that a tsm1 plant with OsRIBAB partial loss-of-function mutation is salt-tolerant and drought-tolerant, so that the OsRIBAB gene has important application value in the aspects of rice salt-tolerant and drought-tolerant variety breeding.

title_en: Grape flavonol synthesis regulating gene VvbZIP7 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a grape flavonol synthesis regulating gene VvbZIP and application thereof. The nucleotide sequence of the grape flavonol synthesis regulating gene VvbZIP is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention identifies a transcription factor VvbZIP which can promote the expression of genes related to flavonol synthesis and the synthesis of flavonol. It is shown that VvbZIP7 can be used as a candidate gene for creating new grape varieties with high flavonol content in the future.

title_en: Electrostatic spinning water-absorbing cotton, preparation method thereof and application thereof in fresh food fresh-keeping liner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food fresh-keeping materials. The invention provides a preparation method of electrostatic spinning absorbent cotton applied to fresh food preservation, which comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing a shell water-absorbing film-forming substance with a solvent to obtain a shell spinning solution; (2) Adding a core layer film forming substance or a core layer film forming substance plus a preservative into a solvent to obtain a core layer spinning solution; (3) And injecting the obtained shell layer spinning solution and core layer spinning solution into coaxial electrostatic spinning equipment for electrostatic spinning to obtain the electrostatic spinning absorbent cotton. The electrostatic spinning absorbent cotton prepared by the method can be used in fresh-keeping liners for aquatic products, meat products and fruits and vegetables, can better realize the absorption of exudates generated in the storage process of fresh foods, reduces secondary invasion, prolongs the fresh-keeping period of the foods and widens the sales radius; meanwhile, the electrostatic spinning absorbent cotton prepared by the method has the characteristics of stable physical and chemical properties, high safety, ultra-light weight, simple preparation and low cost, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Shrimp seedling raising method capable of reducing vibrio vulnificus
abstract_en: The invention provides a shrimp larva raising method for reducing vibrio vulnificus, which comprises the steps of larva raising pool preparation, water quality treatment, larva raising, larva shrimp raising, shrimp larva strengthening raising, pool discharging and the like. The special adsorption matrix and phytoplankton are used for inoculation, the adsorption matrix comprises components such as a loaded microorganism adsorbent, the loaded microorganism adsorbent is loaded on an adsorption material by microorganisms, and the water quality is ensured to be excellent by combining ozone treatment. Environmental parameters are controlled according to different periods of the shrimp larvae, and baits are fed. The density and environment of the larvae are adjusted by culturing, and the artificial bait is mainly used. The density is controlled during the intensive cultivation of the shrimp larvae, the water quality is regulated, the water flow stimulation is increased, the bait is fed, natural components such as antibacterial peptide and the like are innovatively added in the bait, and the immunity of the shrimp larvae is enhanced. In particular, the enzyme-based water treatment agent is used for water flow stimulation to further inhibit vibrio vulnificus. The method is simple and convenient to operate, effectively reduces the influence of vibrio on the shrimp larvae, improves the survival rate of the shrimp larvae, and provides powerful guarantee for healthy cultivation of the shrimp larvae.

title_en: Food attractant for fish larvae and larvae of Epinephelus and food domestication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a food attractant for larvae of the family of the genus Carnis Pseudosciaenae and a food-domesticating method, which relate to the technical field of aquaculture, wherein squid pulp is subjected to ultrasonic emulsification and enzymolysis to reach 40% of molecular weight distribution between 500 and 2000Dalton, and then sediment is centrifugally collected and frozen for air drying; then the air-dried squid pulp is placed in feed according to the proportion of 0.6 to 1 percent of the total weight, and the squid pulp is air-dried for standby; and installing timing feeding equipment at the position of 3-3.5 m of the space between the walls of the seedling cement pool, and setting feeding amount and time according to the number of fish shoals. The emulsified enzymolysis squid pulp has the characteristics of small particles and strong aromatic flavor, and achieves the aim of clustering the young squid by stimulating the smell and taste of fish; the fish feed is also convenient for the absorption and utilization of the unhealthy digestive system of the young fish and promotes the growth of the fish; meanwhile, the feeding parameters are set according to the number of the young fish, so that the problem of high feeding difficulty in the young fish cultivation process is effectively solved, and the domestication survival rate and the cultivation efficiency of the young fish are improved.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine health-preserving soup absorption accelerator, traditional Chinese medicine health-preserving soup and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine health-preserving soup absorption accelerator and a traditional Chinese medicine health-preserving soup and a preparation process thereof, belonging to the field of foods, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine health-preserving soup absorption accelerator comprises a component A and a component B; the component A comprises adsorption-enhanced nano calcium aspartate, hyaluronic acid-modified nano porous aluminum phosphate gel and polyglycerol fatty acid ester; wherein the mass ratio of the adsorption-enhanced nano calcium aspartate, the hyaluronic acid-modified nano porous aluminum phosphate gel and the polyglycerol fatty acid ester is 1:2:0.2; the component B comprises pepsin wrapped by a slow release layer; a Chinese medicinal health soup is added with the above absorption promoter. Under the synergistic effect of the component A and the component B, the invention can play a remarkable role in promoting absorption of active ingredients.

title_en: Bifidobacterium animalis subspecies Bbm-19 and application thereof in neurotransmitter regulation
abstract_en: The invention provides an animal bifidobacterium subspecies Bbm-19 and application thereof in neurotransmitter regulation, which belong to the technical field of probiotics, wherein the animal bifidobacterium subspecies Bbm-19 are separated from breast milk of healthy women and are preserved in the China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.25080. The animal bifidobacterium lactis Bbm-19 strain can synthesize functional active substances such as short chain fatty acid, organic acid and derivatives thereof, amino acid and derivatives thereof, brain intestinal axis regulating substances and the like outside cells. The bifidobacterium animalis subspecies Bbm-19 of the present invention have the ability to modulate the levels of serotonin and gamma aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the body. The invention provides a brand new thought for developing functional active substances and improving the deep research and utilization of mental probiotics of nervous system disorder, and has great research and application values.

title_en: Winter jujube vinegar intelligent production equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to intelligent production equipment of winter jujube vinegar and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of winter jujube vinegar fermentation, the intelligent production equipment comprises a fermentation cylinder, wherein the fermentation cylinder is a hollow cylinder with one end open, a feed inlet is formed in the closed end of the fermentation cylinder, and a first sealing cover is detachably connected to the feed inlet; the opening end of the fermentation cylinder is detachably connected with a second sealing cover, the fermentation cylinder is connected with a stirring mechanism, and the stirring mechanism is used for stirring fermentation base liquid in the fermentation cylinder; the stirring mechanism is connected with an aeration mechanism, and the aeration mechanism is used for improving the oxygen content of the fermentation base solution. The application has the effect of improving the quality of winter jujube vinegar in the acetic acid fermentation process.

title_en: Morchella strain KS1, cultivation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of edible fungus cultivation, in particular to a Morchella esculenta strain KS1, a cultivation method and application thereof. The strain is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) at the date of 11 and 13 of 2023, the preservation number is CGMCC No.40979, and the preservation address is North Star Xili No. 1 and 3 of the Korean region of Beijing city. After the strain KS1 provided by the invention is cultivated by adopting the cultivation method provided by the invention, the average acre yield is up to 918.79 kg/acre, the highest acre yield is 986.32 kg/acre, and the acre yield is far higher than that of the parent strain S2; meanwhile, the fruiting temperature range of the strain is wide (5-22 ℃), the culturable region of Morchella is enlarged, the proper cultivation time of Morchella is advanced, the fruiting of the strain is neat, the properties are good, and the yield is stable.

title_en: Control method of refrigerator, controller, refrigerator and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a control method of a refrigerator, a controller, the refrigerator and a storage medium, wherein the control method of the refrigerator comprises the following steps: determining a target mode, determining target light radiation doses of the first lamp and the second lamp according to the target mode, driving the first lamp and the second lamp to irradiate the target food material based on the target light radiation doses, and driving the third lamp to irradiate the target food material according to the preset light radiation doses. The blue light, the UVB and the red light can improve the anthocyanin content of berries, the red light can improve the chlorophyll and carotenoid content of green vegetables, the UVB can improve the lycopene content of tomatoes, the phenolic compounds in fruits and vegetables and the vitamin D content in mushrooms, and the synergistic effect of the two can be more obvious than the improvement effect of monochromatic light. Therefore, under the condition that the first lamp, the second lamp and the third lamp are matched with each other to perform illumination, the function of improving and storing nutrition of fruits and vegetables and prolonging the fresh-keeping period can be achieved.

title_en: Processing technology of medlar original pulp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing technology of medlar puree, which belongs to the technical field of medlar processing, and comprises the steps of picking, acceptance, winnowing, manual sorting, cleaning, draining, crushing, double pulping, colloid milling, high-pressure homogenization, concentration, vacuum degassing, sterilization, aseptic filling and the like. The invention adds self-made stabilizer before the double beating step, the stabilizer is formed by mixing ascorbic acid, rice bran polysaccharide and tea polyphenol, and the nutritional value of the medlar puree is stably reserved and the product quality is effectively improved by detecting the stabilizer compounded by the invention.

title_en: A tea substitute with blood lipid and blood glucose reducing and blood pressure lowering effects, and its preparation method and preparation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substituted tea with the functions of reducing blood fat, reducing blood sugar and reducing blood pressure, a preparation process and a preparation device, which belong to the technical field of food processing, wherein the tea is placed in a freezer, a refrigerating pipe is started to cool the tea in a freezing cavity on the freezer to-20 ℃ or-15 ℃ for 9-12 hours, a driving piece drives a movable screw rod to reversely rotate, a rotary crushing knife and a connecting rod move upwards in the rotating process, materials are guided upwards and thrown out in the moving process, and are crushed again in the throwing process, so that the circulating crushing function is realized, the crushed materials are guided out through a filtering piece, the sieving function is realized in the guiding-out process, the crushed materials are guided into a storage piece for storage, the storage piece is of a detachable structure, the refrigerating pipe is arranged in the freezer, and the outer side of the refrigerating pipe is covered with a third heat-insulating layer, a second heat-insulating layer and a first heat-insulating layer for cold insulation, and the energy consumption reduction functions are realized.

title_en: Composition containing breast milk oligosaccharide and probiotics and application of composition to intestinal development improvement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition containing breast milk oligosaccharide and probiotics and application thereof in improving intestinal development. The breast milk oligosaccharide is neutral fucosylated breast milk oligosaccharide, and the probiotics are bifidobacterium animalis. The composition can synergistically improve the development of intestinal epithelial cell glycocalyx layers, prevent the adhesion of pathogens through the good development of the intestinal epithelial cell glycocalyx layers, provide good binding sites for symbiotic microorganisms and further promote the development of intestinal barrier functions and intestinal tracts.

title_en: Preparation and application of metaplasia based on bacillus subtilis
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a metazoan based on bacillus subtilis and an application of the metazoan in a food preservative, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The optimal activating, culturing and fermenting condition parameters of the bacillus subtilis are obtained through experiments, and the prepared metazoan has a good inhibiting effect on listeria, and has a great application prospect in the fields of food preservation and fresh keeping.

title_en: Shatterproof genes and mutations
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides shatter prevention (SHP) genes and plants and/or plant cells carrying one or more mutations in the shatter prevention genes; and methods of making and using such plants. In some embodiments, the plant or plant cell is resistant to pre-harvest dehiscence.

title_en: Yeast peptide-hydroxytyrosol compound with high ROS capturing capability as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yeast peptide-hydroxytyrosol compound with high ROS capturing capability, and a preparation method and application thereof. The yeast peptide-hydroxytyrosol compound contains hydroxytyrosol and yeast peptide, wherein the yeast peptide is a peptide with molecular weight of more than or equal to 1kDa and less than 3kDa generated by yeast proteolysis, the preparation method of the yeast peptide-hydroxytyrosol compound with high ROS capturing capability comprises the steps of respectively dispersing the yeast peptide and the hydroxytyrosol in PBS buffer solution with low ionic strength, then mixing the yeast peptide dispersion solution and the hydroxytyrosol dispersion solution, and the application of the compound with high ROS capturing capability in the aspect of preparing antioxidant drugs. The yeast peptide-hydroxytyrosol compound provided by the invention has higher ROS capturing performance, has higher free radical and peroxide scavenging capability than that of single use of hydroxytyrosol or yeast peptide, and has excellent application potential in the fields of food, medicine and the like.

title_en: FORMIN10 and application of coding gene thereof in regulating and controlling plant cold tolerance
abstract_en: The invention discloses FORMIN and application of a coding gene thereof in regulating and controlling plant cold resistance. Experiments of the invention prove that the FORMIN knockout line shows remarkable cold resistance compared with a wild type line, and the FORMIN knockout line.

title_en: Improved process lacquer tree seed oil squeezing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of edible oil, and particularly relates to an improved process lacquer tree seed oil squeezing method. The method mainly comprises the steps of primary screening, peeling, baking, crushing, sieving, squeezing, canning and sealing. The components containing lacquer wax can be removed by a method for separating lacquer tree seed shells and kernels, so that the pressed lacquer tree seed oil has lower saturated fatty acid content. The lacquer tree seeds are baked at the temperature of 120-140 ℃ for 20-40 min, so that the peroxide value in the lacquer tree seeds is reduced, and gastrointestinal discomfort, diarrhea and liver damage of human bodies caused by overhigh peroxide value of lacquer tree seed oil are prevented; the oil extraction rate of the lacquer tree seed oil is improved by selecting a hydraulic oil press to press.

title_en: Method for preparing yellow wine by fermentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing yellow wine by fermentation, which belongs to the technical field of fermentation and comprises the steps of steaming, saccharification, fermentation and treatment, wherein the fermentation is carried out by adding Angel yeast into saccharification liquid, then adding fermentation regulator, then adding water, fermenting for 35-36h at 28-30 ℃, continuously introducing sterile air during fermentation, stirring periodically, stopping introducing sterile air, sealing and fermenting for 50-55h at 28-30 ℃ and sealing and fermenting for 75-80h at 14-16 ℃ to obtain fermentation liquid.

title_en: Preparation method and application of plant source composite polysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of plant source composite polysaccharide, and belongs to the technical field of plant source polysaccharide preparation. The plant source compound polysaccharide is prepared by extracting and separating polysaccharide in wrinkled papaya, crab apple and hawthorn seed, adding inulin, and then performing enzymolysis to decompose macromolecular polysaccharide into micromolecular saccharide with higher bioactivity. When the compound polysaccharide prepared by the invention is used for aquaculture, the immunocompetence and the antioxidation capability of aquatic organisms can be obviously improved, the survival rate can be improved, the growth of the aquatic organisms can be promoted, the use is safe, and the aquatic organisms are free from obvious liver injury and the like.

title_en: Portable pollen collection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a portable pollen collecting device, and relates to the technical field of pollen collection. The portable pollen collecting device comprises a pollen collecting cylinder, wherein the front surface of the pollen collecting cylinder is fixedly connected with a sealing cover, the front surface of the sealing cover is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, and the top of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a piston cylinder; the inner cavity of the fixing frame is provided with a supply assembly, the supply assembly comprises a servo motor fixed at the center of the back of the fixing frame, and the sealing cover is provided with a pollen removing assembly for pollen to fall off; the piston cylinder is provided with a negative pressure component, and the other two ends of the negative pressure component are provided with powder sucking components for collecting pollen. Through the cooperation of supply unit, pollen removal subassembly, negative pressure subassembly and powder suction subassembly, the mode of simulation wind-force impact, pollen in the anther is taken off the powder naturally, adopts high-efficient negative pressure absorption's mode again, realizes the multiple protection nature of pollen and adopts the powder effect to avoid causing permanent injury to the anther of flower.

title_en: Bioactive peptide feed and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feeds, in particular to a bioactive peptide feed and a preparation process thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a polyethyleneimine carrier; the carrier is used for fixing the bioactive peptide; microbial fermentation of feed materials is combined with peptides. According to the invention, the polyethyleneimine silicon chip with good hydrophilicity is prepared, and then the mixed microbial inoculum is used for carrying out microbial fermentation on the rapeseed meal and the cistanche deserticola powder to obtain a fermentation wet material containing the rapeseed peptide and the cistanche deserticola polypeptide, and the polyethyleneimine silicon chip is immersed in the fermentation wet material, so that the electrostatic interaction between the rapeseed peptide and the cistanche deserticola polypeptide and the amino groups of the polyethyleneimine is carried out, and the polyethyleneimine silicon chip is adsorbed on the surface of the polyethyleneimine silicon chip, so that the rapeseed peptide and the cistanche deserticola polypeptide are prevented from being easily degraded after entering the intestinal tract, the prepared bioactive peptide feed can obviously improve the immunity and the total antioxidant function of serum of piglets, reduce the quantity of pathogenic bacteria groups in cecum chyme and mucous membrane of piglets, increase the richness of probiotics, and relieve weaning stress reaction of piglets.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus AFY04 and application thereof in maintaining intestinal tract and/or spleen
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of functional microorganisms, and particularly discloses lactobacillus rhamnosus AFY04 and application thereof in maintaining intestinal tracts and/or spleens, wherein lactobacillus rhamnosus strain (Lactobacillus rhamnosus) AFY04 is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms) with a preservation date of 2024, 6 and 11 days and a preservation number of CGMCC No.30982; the invention discovers that the lactobacillus rhamnosus AFY04 can effectively relieve the offset of Th1 cells to Th2 cells in allergic mice and regulate the Th1/Th2 immune balance; in addition, the normal structure of spleen and intestinal tissues can be maintained, the complete morphology of colon, jejunum and spleen tissues is protected, the barrier function of intestinal tracts is enhanced, and allergy is relieved; has potential food additive, feed additive and pharmaceutical application.

title_en: Out-of-season breeding method for promoting growth of meat geese
abstract_en: The invention provides an out-of-season cultivation method for promoting growth of meat geese, which comprises the following steps: s1, feeding pellet feed every day in the gosling stage, wherein the feeding amount of the pellet feed every time is 1-2% of the weight of the gosling, and feeding 3-4 times every day; s2, feeding the mixed feed A every day in the growth stage, wherein the feeding amount of the mixed feed A every time is 5-8% of the weight of the goose, and feeding for 2-3 times every day; and S3, feeding the mixed feed B every day in the fattening stage, wherein the feeding amount of the mixed feed B every time is 4-5% of the weight of the goose, and feeding for 2-3 times every day. In the out-of-season breeding process of the meat geese, scientific and reasonable feed collocation and corresponding environmental conditions are adopted according to the nutritional requirements of the meat geese at different stages, so that the absorption and utilization of nutrient substances in the feed are effectively promoted, the growth of the meat geese in the out-of-season breeding process is effectively promoted, the number of the out-of-sale of the meat geese is increased, the resistance of the meat geese can be effectively improved, the survival rate is improved, and the quality of the out-of-sale meat of the meat geese is also ensured.

title_en: Processing method of vegetable oil with good flavor and high nutrient
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of grease processing, and discloses a processing method of vegetable oil with good flavor and high nutrient. The method comprises the following steps: the vegetable crude oil is sequentially degummed, neutralized, desapodized, emulsified, deodorized and optionally dewaxed. The method for refining the vegetable crude oil can directionally remove the n-hexanol and the chlorophyll in the processing process of the oil part without affecting the content of other flavor substances, thereby improving the flavor quality of the product.

title_en: Beverage fermentation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a beverage fermentation device, which relates to the technical field of fermentation and comprises: the top of the fermentation container is fixedly provided with a driving motor; a feeding cylinder is fixedly arranged at one side of the top of the fermentation container; a discharging cylinder is fixedly arranged at the front side of the fermentation container; a mixing shaft is rotatably arranged at the top end of the interior of the fermentation container; the bottom end of the fermentation container is fixedly provided with a guide cylinder with a cylindrical structure; the cleaning slide bar is arranged in the guide cylinder in a sliding way. The cleaning scraping piece cleans the fermented beverage adhered and wrapped on the sensor through up-and-down reciprocating movement, so that the cleanness of the appearance of the sensor is ensured, the condition that the temperature detection is inaccurate due to the fact that the sensor wraps the fermented beverage on the appearance is prevented, and the problems that a layer of fermented beverage is easily accumulated and adhered on the outer wall of the sensor along with the increase of the service time, and the sensor is easy to detect the inaccuracy of temperature sensing due to the layer of fermented beverage wrapped on the outer wall are solved.

title_en: Sterilization and fresh-keeping equipment and sterilization and fresh-keeping method based on sterilization and fresh-keeping equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides sterilization and fresh-keeping equipment and a sterilization and fresh-keeping method based on the sterilization and fresh-keeping equipment, comprising a fruit and vegetable storage assembly and a plasma activated water spraying assembly; wherein, the fruit and vegetable storage component comprises a fruit and vegetable storage cavity; the plasma activated water spray assembly includes a plasma activated water riser; the water inlet end of the plasma activated water atomization device is connected with the water outlet end of the plasma activated water rising pipe; the water inlet end of the plasma activated water atomizing nozzle is connected with the water outlet end of the plasma activated water atomizing device, and the water outlet end of the plasma activated water atomizing nozzle is arranged at the top of the fruit and vegetable storage cavity. The activation water is uniformly distributed on the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables in the form of extremely fine water drops by utilizing an atomization technology, so that the fruits and vegetables do not need to be directly soaked, and the damage to the thermosensitive fruits and vegetables is avoided; the double improvement of environmental protection and economic benefits of the fruit and vegetable fresh-keeping technology is realized.

title_en: Raw material extraction process for extracting protein powder and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a raw material extraction process for extracting protein powder and a device thereof, wherein fresh eggs are used as raw materials for the protein powder, the protein powder is prepared by egg selection, egg feeding, egg washing, egg breaking separation, filtration, homogenization, pasteurization/spray drying, during the egg breaking separation process, egg liquid and egg yolk are separated first, then the egg liquid is purified by centrifugal equipment, the centrifugal device comprises a centrifugal shell, the outer side wall of the centrifugal shell is provided with a cleaning device, the cleaning device comprises a cleaning shell, a chute is arranged in the cleaning shell, a sliding block is connected in the chute in a sliding way, a plurality of installation bins are arranged in the sliding block, and a spray head is arranged at the bottom of each installation bin.

title_en: Method for improving digestion resistance of starch by utilizing water-soluble arabinoxylan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving digestion resistance of starch by utilizing water-soluble arabinoxylan, which comprises the following steps: (1) Weighing water-soluble arabinoxylan and dissolving in distilled water; (2) Adding starch into the solution prepared in the step (1), and continuing magnetic stirring; (3) Changing the temperature and time of the magnetic stirring water bath kettle in the step (2) to ensure that the gelatinization degree is 40-70%; (4) Transferring the partially gelatinized starch in the step (3) to flowing water and cooling to room temperature; (5) Transferring the starch in the step (4) into a quick freezing cabinet for freezing and then putting the starch into a freeze dryer for freeze drying; (6) Lightly grinding and sieving the starch freeze-dried in the step (5) in a mortar to obtain a starch-water-soluble arabinoxylan complex. The method of the invention ensures that the content of the resistant starch is most obviously increased, the interaction force is enhanced, the order of the starch short-range structure is increased, the operation is simple, the treatment time is short, the cost is low, and the energy consumption is low.

title_en: Fermentation inoculant for preparing instant fruit and vegetable juice beverage and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fermentation inoculant for preparing an instant fruit and vegetable juice beverage, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention provides a microbial agent for preparing an instant fruit and vegetable juice beverage, wherein the strain in the microbial agent is acid fish combined lactobacillus (Ligilactobacillus acidipiscis) SAAS-B-MRS-2020810-9, and the microbial agent is preserved in the microorganism strain preservation center of Guangdong province, and the address is: building 5, road 100 college No. 59 building in Guangzhou City martyr, the preservation date is: 2024, 22 nd 07 th month, deposit number GDMCC No:64904. the microbial inoculum is a safe strain applied to foods, has strong adaptability, low acid production and high octanol production, endows the fermented fruit and vegetable juice with rose and orange flower fragrance, improves the flavor of the fermented fruit and vegetable juice, and is suitable for large-scale production and application.

title_en: Application of Chinese forest frog egg peptide in preparation of functional food for improving fertility
abstract_en: The application provides application of Chinese forest frog egg peptide in preparing functional food or medicine for improving fertility. The application obviously enhances the promotion effect of the microalgae polysaccharide on female fertility and the enhancement effect of the microalgae polysaccharide on immunity by modifying the Chinese forest frog egg peptide.

title_en: Salmonella phage targeting salmonella lipopolysaccharide O antigen and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of phages, and particularly relates to a salmonella phage targeting a salmonella lipopolysaccharide O antigen and application thereof. The salmonella phage vB_SalM-ps4 disclosed by the invention does not contain virulence genes, is high in safety, good in stability in a certain temperature and acid-base range, wide in tolerance range, capable of effectively inhibiting and removing a biofilm formed by salmonella, has a cleaning and inhibiting effect on various salmonella, wide in cracking spectrum, and good in prevention and cleaning effect on salmonella in food and feed infected by the salmonella, and meanwhile, the salmonella phage vB_SalM-ps4 can also crack escherichia coli O157:H7 in a cross-species manner, and is wide in application field.

title_en: Feed additive for preventing and controlling vibrio litopenaeus vannamei as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a feed additive for preventing and treating vibrio of penaeus vannamei, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the feed additive for preventing and treating vibrio of penaeus vannamei comprises, by weight, 0.05-0.2 part of sinomenine, 20-40 parts of a plant extract, 0.1-1 part of bromelain and 30-80 parts of a wall material. The additive provided by the invention can be used in aquaculture to effectively inhibit the propagation of vibrio, reduce the infection of vibrio in the aquaculture process and improve the immunity and survival rate of aquatic animals.

title_en: Filter equipment is used in processing is made to bright grape wine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filtering device for fresh wine brewing and processing, which belongs to the technical field of filtering and comprises a bottom plate, a single-shaft robot, a cantilever pin and a fixed plate, wherein a shaft is movably arranged on the cantilever pin through a bearing seat assembly, the shaft is movably arranged on the fixed plate, a gear I is arranged on the shaft, a connecting plate is arranged on the fixed plate, the gear I and the gear II are in meshed transmission, the gear II is movably arranged on the connecting plate, a filter bag is arranged on the inner wall of the gear through a fixed hoop, a plurality of tracks are arranged on the bottom surface of the gear II, locking plates are all arranged in the tracks, a positioning plate is arranged on the connecting plate through a bracket, a sliding rail corresponding to the tracks is arranged on the positioning plate, the locking plates are movably arranged on the sliding rail, meanwhile, a telescopic rod is movably arranged on the side wall of the bearing seat assembly through a linear bearing, the fixed seat is arranged on the bottom plate, and materials are placed in the filter bag. The device can realize the extrusion to the greatest extent, and improves the utilization rate of materials.

title_en: Application of schizonepeta essential oil in bacteriostasis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural products, and particularly relates to application of schizonepeta essential oil in bacteriostasis. The herba Schizonepetae essential oil is used for inhibiting the activity of bacteria or fungi, and is prepared by extracting herba Schizonepetae by water distillation. The schizonepeta essential oil provided by the invention has obvious inhibition effect on bacillus subtilis, escherichia coli, aspergillus niger, mucor, cladosporium, aspergillus flavus, fraxinus, fusarium and fusarium.

title_en: Application of oyster peptide in improving learning and memory ability and resisting aging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, discloses application of oyster peptide in improving learning and memory capacity and resisting aging, and particularly discloses oyster peptide or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The invention provides oyster peptide (namely OP-4), which has the main peptide amino acid sequence shown as SX  1 X 2  NYGTMTSM, wherein X  1  is S or H, and X  2  is Y or L. OP-4 can improve oxidative stress injury, reduce toxicity of senescence-associated marker proteins, improve learning and memory capacity and delay senescence, and the mechanism of the OP-4 is closely related to an IIS signal pathway and a P38MAPK signal pathway.

title_en: InDel molecular marker for identifying farnesol type Cinnamomum tenuifolia, primer set and application of InDel molecular marker
abstract_en: The invention provides an InDel molecular marker for identifying farnesol type Cinnamomum tenuifolia, a primer group and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of molecular markers. The nucleotide sequence of the molecular marker is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the 358 th nucleotide of the sequence has 27 base deletions. The invention designs a primer group aiming at the molecular marker, wherein the primer group comprises an upstream primer and a downstream primer, the nucleotide sequence of the upstream primer is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the nucleotide sequence of the downstream primer is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The primer group can obtain specific 384bp long bands in Cinnamomum tenuifolia plants with non-high farnesol content through PCR amplification, and can not obtain corresponding bands in Cinnamomum tenuifolia plants with high farnesol content.
