The molecular marker amplification is stable, and can be used for identifying the acacia alcohol type Cinnamomum tenuifolia plants.

title_en: Adapter device
abstract_en: An adapter comprising a body having an interior space, an annular sealing space formed around a valve of a gas tank when the valve is inserted into the interior space, the valve having at least one exterior port that opens transverse to a longitudinal axis of the valve, and a plunger having an exterior surface for actuating the valve, the exterior surface being located outside the annular sealing space when the valve is actuated, and wherein the adapter further comprises at least one channel configured to direct pressurized gas from a filling port of a tank filling machine to the annular sealing space through one or more transverse channels oriented transverse to the longitudinal axis of the valve.

title_en: Scallop flavor raw material extraction method based on microwave vacuum freeze drying process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scallop flavor raw material extraction method based on a microwave vacuum freeze-drying process, which comprises the following steps of carrying out preliminary pretreatment on a scallop which is a test material, freeze-drying the scallop by utilizing a vacuum freeze-drying technology, determining the optimal technological parameters of the scallop flavor raw material, analyzing the influence of a single factor on a scallop drying curve, optimizing the scallop extraction process by a response surface method, determining the microwave power, the material thickness and the vacuum degree of scallop flavor substances extracted under the microwave-vacuum freeze-drying condition by combining the single factor with the response surface test, selecting the microwave power, the material thickness and the vacuum degree as independent variables, carrying out sensory score as a response value, finding out the optimal technological parameters by analyzing the response surface, simulating to obtain a predictive model of a quadratic polynomial regression equation, and verifying the predictive model, thereby conveniently determining the optimal drying extraction technological parameters, and having good operability and practicability and practical use value.

title_en: Preparation method of red ginseng oral liquid with antithrombotic effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of red ginseng oral liquid with antithrombotic effect, which relates to the technical field of health-care food and comprises the following steps of firstly, weighing quantitative raw materials, and standing for standby; step two, crushing the raw materials by using a wall breaking machine respectively, and step three, screening the crushed raw materials to remove the raw materials which are not completely crushed, and secondarily crushing the raw materials which are not completely crushed. According to the invention, the crushed red ginseng root powder, the hawthorn powder, the apple powder, the kiwi fruit powder, the soybean powder and the corn powder are sequentially and respectively screened by the screening device, the raw materials which are not completely crushed are screened, the raw materials which are completely crushed are collected for standby, the raw materials which are not completely crushed are put into the wall breaking machine again for secondary crushing, and then the screening device is used for screening the raw materials which are secondarily crushed again, so that the raw materials are ensured to be completely crushed, the subsequent steaming process is facilitated, the waste of nutrient substances is reduced, and the effect of the oral liquid is ensured.

title_en: Explosion bead embedded with seaweed polysaccharide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an explosion bead embedded with algal polysaccharide, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The explosive bead is an explosive bead particle prepared from a curing liquid and a colloid solution, wherein the curing liquid comprises water and calcium salt, the colloid solution comprises sodium alginate, algal polysaccharide, water and concentrated juice, the calcium salt is calcium lactate, and the addition amount of the calcium salt is 2.0-3.5wt% of the total weight of the explosive bead particle based on the concentration of Ca  2+ . The invention also provides an explosion bead for embedding the algal polysaccharide, which is prepared by using an explosion bead technology for embedding the algal polysaccharide, and the explosion bead technology and the seaweed polysaccharide complement each other, so that the seaweed polysaccharide has excellent mouthfeel and taste, stable property and good effect, and is easy to be favored by consumers.

title_en: Nutritional composition rich in Rosa roxburghii SOD and various peptides and formula proportion thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutritional composition rich in Rosa roxburghii SOD and various peptides and a formula proportion thereof, and relates to the field of nutrition supplement and health care, the nutritional composition comprises Rosa roxburghii SOD and fifteen plant peptides, wherein the fifteen plant peptides are respectively black sesame peptide, black bean peptide, quinoa peptide, oat peptide, millet peptide, corn peptide, yam peptide, kudzuvine root peptide, chestnut peptide, walnut peptide, sea buckthorn peptide, grape seed peptide, matrimony vine peptide, spina date seed peptide and selenium-rich malt peptide; the nutritional composition rich in the rosa roxburghii SOD and the various peptides and the formula proportion thereof play a synergistic effect of various nutritional ingredients by combining the rosa roxburghii SOD and the fifteen plant peptides together, provide comprehensive nutrition supplementing and health care effects, ensure that all the ingredients are derived from natural food materials, ensure that the product is safe and reliable, have no side effects, have the characteristics of small molecular weight and easy absorption, can be quickly absorbed and utilized by human bodies, improve the bioavailability of the nutritional ingredients, and are suitable for adult groups of all ages.

title_en: Cold resistance evaluation method for eggplant stock
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant cultivation and breeding, in particular to a cold resistance evaluation method of eggplant stocks, which comprises the steps of seeding, raising seedlings, pruning and cutting, placing the seedlings in a low-temperature condition for cultivation, measuring rooting conditions of the seedlings, classifying cold injury according to the number of newly grown root systems, calculating cold injury indexes according to the classifying grades of the cold injury, and evaluating the cold resistance of the eggplant stocks according to the cold injury indexes. The method can solve the problems of large workload, high technical requirements and poor repeatability of the existing crop cold resistance identification method.

title_en: Fresh, crisp and high-color-value fish roe blessing bag and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a delicious, crisp and high-color-value fish roe bag and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of food processing. In order to meet the diversified demands of vast consumers, the fish roe bag product is innovatively developed. The instant noodle not only conquers taste buds with excellent delicious taste, but also contains rich nutritional ingredients, and is greatly beneficial to promoting the health of consumers, so that the instant noodle shows strong attraction and wide potential demands on the market.

title_en: Fruit and vegetable freeze-dried superfine powder preparation device based on secondary enzymolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary enzymolysis-based fruit and vegetable freeze-drying superfine powder preparation device, and relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable freeze-drying superfine powder preparation. According to the invention, the appearance of fruits and vegetables is obtained through the shooting module, data is sent to the processor module through the data transmission cable, the components and target products of the raw materials of the fruits and vegetables are verified through the processor module, a proper enzyme liquid preparation is selected, the proper enzyme liquid preparation is prepared and is sent to the primary enzymolysis tank through the arrangement of the PLC controller, the flow valve and the pH sensor, the first temperature sensor and the first heating block are arranged, the temperature in the primary enzymolysis tank can be kept at the optimal temperature, the cutting assembly cuts the fruits and vegetables into blocks or pieces with proper sizes and sends the blocks or pieces to the primary enzymolysis tank, and the first servo motor, the stirring shaft and the stirring rod are matched, so that the enzymolysis effect is improved, the utilization rate of the raw materials is improved, and the loss of nutritional ingredients is reduced.

title_en: Solubilizing emulsion based on mogroside and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food addition, and discloses a solubilizing emulsion based on mogroside, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention adopts the compound lipid, which has the functions of solubilization and density adjustment, and the amphiprotic solubilization emulsifying agent such as single Gan Zhilei substances, effectively realizes the stable dissolution of the mogroside in the medium chain triglyceride oily core liquid, and the preparation method of the mogroside-based solubilization emulsion has the characteristics of simple process, low cost, safety and innocuity, does not need to use an organic solvent or special preparation equipment and process, and simultaneously obviously improves the solubility of the mogroside on the basis of not changing the composition of the bead-bursting candy core liquid.

title_en: Apple laccase LAC3 gene and application thereof in improving plant aphid resistance
abstract_en: The invention provides an apple laccase LAC3 gene and application thereof in improving plant aphid resistance, the invention clones the apple laccase LAC3 gene, defines the nucleic acid sequence and protein structure thereof, designs a primer on the basis, constructs an over-expression vector thereof, cultures tobacco tissue culture seedlings and mediates agrobacterium tumefaciens, transfers the tobacco tissue culture seedlings into tobacco to obtain transgenic plants, screens the transgenic plants to obtain homozygous lines, observes aphid feeding behaviors through an EPG technology, inoculates aphid researches and defines the aphid resistance function thereof. Compared with the wild type, the transgenic plant has overground parts with growth density higher than that of the wild type, strong stems and increased lignin, plays a good role in resisting aphids, and provides a theoretical basis for aphid resistance molecular improvement breeding.

title_en: Recombinant human XVII type collagen and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The recombinant human XVII type collagen is any one of COL17A 3a, COL17A 3b, COL17A 3c, COL17A 3d or COL17A 3 e. According to the invention, the functional fragment of XVII collagen is analyzed by using computer software, the minimum functional region of the XVII collagen is screened, and the expression and the extraction are carried out by using an escherichia coli recombinant expression system, so that the target functional fragment with higher yield can be obtained.

title_en: Cannabis protein peptide and granule for inhibiting alpha-glucosidase, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hemp seed protein peptide and a particle for inhibiting alpha-glucosidase as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The cannabis protein peptide for inhibiting alpha-glucosidase of the invention comprises at least one of the polypeptides having amino acid sequence FY, SPVI, TGLGR, FR. The hemp seed protein peptide particles for assisting in reducing blood sugar comprise hemp seed protein peptide powder, sugar-free auxiliary materials, a flavoring agent and an adhesive, wherein the mass ratio of the hemp seed protein peptide powder to the sugar-free auxiliary materials is 1:5-1:9, and the addition amount of the flavoring agent is 0.2% -0.8% of the total mass of the hemp seed protein peptide powder and the sugar-free auxiliary materials. The hemp seed protein peptide has very high alpha-glucosidase inhibition rate, and the granules prepared by screening proper auxiliary materials and proportion can ensure the stability of the hemp seed protein peptide in the processes of storage and the like, and the hemp seed protein peptide has high transfer rate, high granule forming rate and yield, good administration taste and good blood sugar reducing effect in the production process.

title_en: Method for hybridization of marigold
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant cultivation, and particularly discloses a marigold hybridization method. The marigold hybridization method includes the steps of (1) trimming the female parent along the top end of a calyx to remove the calyx-exceeding tongue flower petals, (2) shearing the bottommost part of the calyx to remove a part of the calyx to form a notch capable of exposing small flowers in the rest of the calyx, (3) cleaning all small flowers carrying stamens in the rest of the calyx from the notch, and if the female parent only comprises the tongue flowers, the small flowers refer to the tongue flowers, and if the female parent comprises the tongue flowers and the tubular flowers, the small flowers refer to the tongue flowers and the tubular flowers. The method has the advantages of simple operation, time and labor saving, low cost, no dependence on male sterile dual-purpose lines and capability of rapidly obtaining the hybrid seeds among marigold germplasm resources.

title_en: Palatable chlorella noodles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly relates to a palatable chlorella noodle and a preparation method thereof. In the invention, the optimal adding amount of chlorella powder is 2.0%, the optimal adding amount of edible alkali is 1.0%, the optimal adding amount of water is 46%, and the optimal adding amount of salt is 1.3%. The chlorella noodles obtained by the optimal preparation process have better sensory evaluation, the color is more easily accepted by consumers, the starch in the chlorella noodles is not easy to age, and the viscoelasticity is greatly improved. The invention combines the traditional noodle making process and the characteristic that the chlorella powder is rich in various influencing substances, and adds the chlorella powder with a certain proportion into the flour to improve the nutritional value and the sensory quality of the noodle, such as color and flavor, and simultaneously improves the taste of the chlorella noodle by adding the salt and the edible alkali. The present invention can effectively improve the current situation that the traditional noodles mainly use carbohydrate as a nutrient substance.

title_en: Production process of traditional Chinese medicine health care liqueur with mellow and healthy taste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health care wine production processes, in particular to a traditional Chinese medicine health care wine production process with mellow taste, which comprises the following steps of selecting glutinous rice, cleaning and soaking, steaming, mixing and stirring after soaking, adding liquid medicine and wine liquid, mixing and saccharifying, filtering and decocting wine after saccharification, and ageing after decoction; according to the invention, by adding the traditional Chinese medicinal materials such as the rhizoma polygonati, the red ginseng, the dogwood, the eucommia male flowers, the oyster peptides and the like, not only are the mouthfeel and the flavor of the juice wine enriched, but also the health care effects of moistening lung and strengthening spleen are ensured, the immunity of the organism is enhanced, the body resistance is improved, and simultaneously, the body is better nourished, and the symptoms such as sallow complexion, hypodynamia and the like are improved.

title_en: Intelligent fresh-keeping warehouse for non-crystal frozen storage of meat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent meat preservation equipment, and provides a meat non-crystal freezing storage intelligent preservation warehouse, which comprises a warehouse body, a commodity shelf and a control system, wherein the warehouse body is provided with a multi-point temperature sensor, a refrigerating assembly is arranged in the warehouse body, the commodity shelf is horizontally arranged in the warehouse body, the commodity shelf is provided with a commodity carrying layer frame, an alternating electric field generating device is embedded in the layer frame to generate a controllable electric field, each layer of the commodity shelf is provided with a temperature probe, the control system comprises a meat raw material information input module, a non-crystal freezing storage intelligent decision module, an abnormal freezing early warning ablation module and a human-computer interaction interface, the control system decides to output parameters of the non-crystal freezing storage and the abnormal freezing early warning ablation electric field, and a polar plate space forms a controllable electric field with multi-mode feedback matching to inhibit ice nuclei from forming.

title_en: High-quality rapeseed protein and rapeseed dietary fiber as well as synchronous preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of comprehensive utilization of rapeseed cakes, and particularly relates to high-quality rapeseed protein and rapeseed dietary fiber as well as a synchronous preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the coarse grinding pretreatment is carried out on the rapeseed cake, and crushing and sieving are not needed, so that the method is more energy-saving and environment-friendly. And then adopting a good solvent flushing synchronous scale control sieving technology, dispersing the coarsely ground rapeseed meal in the good solvent, passing through a scale-controllable sieve, flushing the oversize product by using the good solvent, and finally synchronously obtaining a crude protein extract and dietary fiber so as to realize convenient preparation of the rapeseed dietary fiber. And further, carrying out weak acid enrichment on the crude extract of the rapeseed protein after homogenizing treatment so as to improve the protein yield. And further adopts weak acid synchronous gradient membrane separation technology, and prevents the problems of too slow concentration or equipment blockage caused by rapid aggregation by regulating and controlling the structural characteristics and aggregation behavior of the protein, thereby improving the concentration degree of the protein and finally obtaining the rapeseed protein with high yield and high quality.

title_en: Zero-calorie flavored beverage thick slurry and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-clip flavored beverage thick slurry manufacturing device which comprises a cleaning component, wherein the cleaning component comprises a workbench, a cleaning pool is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the workbench, a fixing frame is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the cleaning pool, a hydraulic push rod is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the fixing frame, an output end at the bottom of the hydraulic push rod can slidably penetrate through the fixing frame, a first rotating motor is arranged at the bottom end of the hydraulic push rod, a first rotating shaft is connected to the bottom of the first rotating motor, a cleaning brush is detachably arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the workbench, a delivery pump is arranged on one side of the delivery pump, a connecting pipe is connected to the top of the delivery pump, one end of the delivery pipe is connected into the cleaning pool, a spray head is arranged at the end head of the delivery pipe, a heating component for manufacturing sugar liquid and a heat preservation component for assisting manufacturing are arranged on one side of the workbench, the heating component comprises a heating furnace, the heating furnace is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the workbench, and radiating ports are arranged on two sides of the heating furnace.

title_en: Application of CsUGT84A22 gene in synthesis of ferulic acid-beta-glucoside and breeding of tea tree disease-resistant varieties
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a CsUGT84A22 gene in synthesis of ferulic acid-beta-glucoside and breeding of tea tree disease-resistant varieties, and belongs to the technical field of tea tree gene utilization. The CDS nucleotide sequence of the tea tree glycosyltransferase gene CsUGT84A22 is shown as SEQ ID No.1. The amino acid sequence of the protein coded by the CsUGT84A22 gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The invention has the beneficial effects that the tea tree glycosyltransferase CsUGT84A22 gene derived from tea tree is cloned, the recombinant protein is obtained by prokaryotic expression in escherichia coli and purification through affinity chromatography, the purity and the activity are high, and the recombinant protein can be applied to ferulic acid-beta-glucoside biosynthesis genetic engineering. And sequence differences among different leaf spot resistant tea tree varieties are analyzed, and the fact that the promoter sequence of CsUGT84A22 is inserted in more sections in the varieties with stronger resistance than in the varieties with weaker resistance is found, so that the understanding of the reasons for causing the different tea tree resistance differences is facilitated, and guidance is provided for tea tree breeding.

title_en: Cynanchum otophyllum pericarpium citri reticulatae mung bean paste ice Pizi and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of foods, and particularly provides a common sage herb, dried orange peel and mung bean paste ice Pizi and a preparation method thereof. The invention discloses a green bean paste ice Pi containing common sage herb, which comprises, by weight, 4-8 parts of glutinous rice flour, 2-4 parts of flour, 2-5 parts of brome condensed milk and 25-35 parts of milk, and stuffing, wherein the stuffing comprises 8-10 parts of common sage herb, 20-25 parts of mung bean with skin, 1-2 parts of dried orange peel, 90-100 parts of water, 10-15 parts of white granulated sugar and 10-15 parts of butter.

title_en: Green-protecting preservative as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a green-protecting preservative and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of fruit preservation. The green-protecting preservative comprises, by weight, 20-40 parts of chitosan, 1-5 parts of 6-benzylaminopurine, 1-5 parts of gibberellic acid, 10-20 parts of citric acid and 3-10 parts of cinnamon extract. The green-protecting preservative is safe and simple to use, can well keep the color of the green lemon, delay the degradation of chlorophyll in the green lemon peel, keep the fragrance of the green lemon, reduce the incidence rate of diseases and insect pests in storage such as black spot disease of the green lemon and the like, and well keep the fruit quality of the green lemon due to slow change of the color of the green lemon fruit during storage.

title_en: Rice AFR1 gene and application thereof in controlling leaf pillow development and leaf angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice AFR1 gene and application thereof in controlling leaf pillow development and leaf angle. The gene sequence is shown in a sequence table SEQ ID No. 1, and the protein sequence is shown in a sequence table SEQ ID No. 2. According to the invention, it is first identified that the AFR1 gene expression can obviously control the growth of rice leaf pillow and the leaf angle, the rice AFR1 protein mutation can increase the length of the leaf pillow, the cell is increased, the leaf angle is increased, the rice AFR1 protein overexpression can shorten the length of the leaf pillow, the cell is reduced, and the leaf angle is reduced. The protein and the coding gene thereof have important theoretical and practical significance for improving the close planting property of plants and the crop yield, and can play an important role in crop genetic breeding, and have wide application prospect.

title_en: Pure grain selenium-enriched wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of brewing, and particularly relates to pure grain selenium-enriched wine and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly soaking finished grains in water, filtering and draining after soaking, then washing and draining to obtain pure grains, then heating and boiling the pure grains, cooling after boiling, then adding selenium-containing substances into the cooled pure grains, stirring uniformly to obtain a selenium-containing pure grain mixture, finally fermenting after the selenium-containing pure grain mixture is cooled to normal temperature, and after fermentation is completed, sequentially squeezing wine, decocting wine, filling into a jar and cellaring to obtain the pure grain selenium-enriched wine. The pure grain selenium-enriched wine contains rich selenium nutrients, and has the advantages of mellow, sweet and soft taste, aromatic and sweet taste, good taste, and health promotion effects of protecting liver.

title_en: Engineering probiotics for targeted treatment of colonitis and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses engineering probiotics for targeted treatment of colonitis and a construction method and application thereof, wherein the construction method of the engineering probiotics for targeted treatment of colonitis comprises the following steps of 1, connecting PelB and optimized Fc and IL-4 genes with a homology arm through PCR, inserting the obtained product into pBAD33 plasmid after seamless cloning to construct recombinant plasmid, 2, transferring the obtained plasmid in the step 1 into competent E.collDH5α through a heat shock method, carrying out sequencing verification after colony PCR verification to determine whether the recombinant plasmid is successfully constructed, 3, transferring the recombinant plasmid into the competent EcN through the heat shock method under the condition that the recombinant plasmid is successfully constructed, adopting a chloramphenicol resistance LB solid plate to carry out screening treatment, culturing the screened colony in a chloramphenicol-containing LB liquid medium, and centrifugally collecting and storing the colony. The invention realizes the characteristics of targeting the inflammation part and treating inflammation.

title_en: Preparation method of mung bean sprout dietary fiber with insulin resistance improving activity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polysaccharides, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of mung bean sprout dietary fibers. The monosaccharide composition of the dietary fiber mainly comprises fucose, arabinose, galactose, glucose and mannose, and the molar ratio is 12.28:2.60:27.59:7.06:50.47. The structural unit of the dietary fiber is formed by interconnecting 6-alpha-D-Glcp- (1- & gt, 5-alpha-L-Araf- (1- & gt, 3, 6) -alpha-D-Glcp- (1- & gt and the like to form a main chain, and the branched chain is mainly formed by beta-D-Manp- (1- & gt, connecting at the O-3 position of sugar residue 3, 6) -alpha-D-Glcp- (1- & gt and the like, proved by in vitro cell experiments, the dietary fiber can improve the insulin resistance state of HepG2 cells, including increasing glucose consumption and cell glycogen synthesis, increasing hexokinase and pyruvate kinase activities, and having no toxic effect on cell growth activity in vitro, therefore, the dietary fiber has the function of potentially improving insulin resistance, and is expected to become a functional food raw material for treating diabetes.

title_en: Percolating device and method for ten-full tonic wine
abstract_en: The invention provides a percolation device and a percolation method for a Shiquanda tonic wine, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine percolation methods. Including section of thick bamboo oozes the subassembly and supports a section of thick bamboo, support section of thick bamboo top inner wall fixed mounting has a heat preservation section of thick bamboo, section of thick bamboo oozes the subassembly and is located a heat preservation section of thick bamboo, and is equipped with the multiunit, section of thick bamboo oozes the subassembly including flourishing cartridge case, flourishing cartridge case is equipped with the multiunit, and is vertical stack setting, flourishing cartridge case is inside to be equipped with the main mechanism that contracts, the main mechanism that contracts is equipped with the multiunit. According to the invention, medicinal materials are placed in the medicine containing cylinder, so that raw wine enters the medicine containing cylinder through the percolating shell and the filter plate II, when the medicinal materials in the medicine containing cylinder are subjected to liquid expansion, the displacement of the main shrinkage mechanism and the outward expansion block with the grooves is utilized to increase the inner space of the medicine containing cylinder, and meanwhile, low-temperature nitrogen is introduced by utilizing the effect of thermal expansion and cold shrinkage, so that the medicinal materials can be percolated by the wine liquid, and the problem that the existing medicinal materials can be expanded in the percolating process, so that the wine liquid is prevented from being percolated, and the wine liquid percolating efficiency is reduced is solved.

title_en: Soybean cytochrome b5 gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soybean cytochrome b5 gene and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of genetic engineering. The invention takes 303 parts of cultivated soybeans as experimental materials, carries out accurate identification of the salt and alkali resistant phenotype in the seedling stage, evaluates the salt and alkali resistant grade of the cultivated soybeans according to root cap ratio and leaf damage degree, simultaneously utilizes whole genome correlation analysis to excavate and identify a candidate gene of the salt and alkali resistant soybean, namely cytochrome b5 gene GmCytb-2, further utilizes a transient transformation system of yeast and soybean rooting and over-expressed GmCytb5 soybean materials of stable transformation, and determines that the gene has the function of improving the salt and alkali resistance in the germination stage and seedling stage of the soybeans. The invention discloses the effect of GmCytb-2 genes in the process of resisting the saline-alkali stress of the soybeans on one hand, and provides candidate genes and new ideas for the cultivation of new germplasm of the saline-alkali resistant soybeans and related breeding work thereof on the other hand.

title_en: Preparation method of ice recrystallization inhibitor protein peptide from almond meal for food and ice recrystallization inhibitor protein peptide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food proteins, and discloses an ice recrystallization inhibition protein peptide derived from almond meal for food, which comprises the following steps of combining almond protein with polysaccharide to form the ice recrystallization inhibition protein peptide, wherein the almond protein is extracted from the almond meal, the combination ratio of the almond protein to the polysaccharide is 1:2-4, and the ratio is the mass ratio. The ice recrystallization inhibition protein peptide is prepared by the preparation method of the ice recrystallization inhibition protein peptide from almond meal for food. The invention can effectively extract functional polysaccharide and protein peptide from wheat bran and almond meal respectively, not only improves extraction efficiency and purity, but also inhibits the protein peptide from ice recrystallization by combining polysaccharide and protein peptide through chemical crosslinking and other actions, shows excellent ice recrystallization inhibition performance in frozen food, and is beneficial to improving food quality.

title_en: Snow cherry health-care tea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses snow cherry health-care tea and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of health-care tea. The snow cherry health tea comprises snow cherry extract, aloe extract, american ginseng extract, composite fermentation powder and composite enzymolysis powder, wherein the composite fermentation powder is prepared by fermenting and drying shizandra berry extract, acanthopanax extract and eucommia ulmoides leaf extract through composite fermentation microbial agents, the composite fermentation microbial agents comprise clostridium butyricum, bacillus coagulans and aspergillus oryzae, the composite enzymolysis powder is prepared by mixing polygonatum odoratum, burdock and echinacea and then carrying out enzymolysis through composite enzyme, and the composite enzyme comprises pectase, acid proteinase, glucose oxidase, malate dehydrogenase and thermolysin. The cherokee rose fruit health-care tea not only improves the solubility and bioavailability of the product, but also enhances the stability and the functionality of the product, so that the product has remarkable advantages in improving the immunity, and the product can better meet the requirements of consumers on health care through the carefully designed process steps.

title_en: Polygonatum sibiricum tea preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea processing, in particular to a sealwort tea preparation device and a sealwort tea preparation method. The device comprises a machine body, wherein the machine body comprises a feeding part and a processing part, a collecting box is arranged below the feeding part, a meshing gear is arranged on the side wall of the processing part, an air cylinder is arranged above the processing part, a feeding component is arranged below the air cylinder and used for automatically feeding sealwort to be sliced, and an anti-sticking component is arranged above the feeding component.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ganoderma lucidum liquid fermentation product for animal feed
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal feed processing and discloses a preparation method of a ganoderma lucidum liquid fermentation product for animal feed, which comprises the following steps of S1, filling a proper amount of water into a fermentation tank, heating to a proper temperature, adding a proper amount of fermentation culture medium, fully stirring, uniformly mixing, supplementing water, fixing volume, sealing, sterilizing and cooling, S2, rapidly inoculating 0.6-1.2% of ganoderma lucidum fermentation strain into the fermentation tank through a fungus inoculation port, closing the fungus inoculation port, and continuously fermenting and culturing for 7-14d at constant temperature in proper fermentation culture conditions to obtain the ganoderma lucidum liquid fermentation product. The ganoderma lucidum liquid fermented product prepared by the preparation method is also disclosed to be used as a feed additive for calves. The ganoderma lucidum liquid fermentation product can be used as a feed additive for calves, and can promote the growth and development of calves, promote the proliferation of blood immune cells, the expression of cytokines and immunoglobulin and improve the diversity of intestinal microorganisms.

title_en: Rapid genetic transformation method of peanuts
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid genetic transformation method of peanuts, which mainly comprises the following steps of sterilizing peanut seeds, peeling stem tips, carrying out agrobacterium infection, continuously treating for 1-3 times, placing an explant on a co-culture medium for 2-5 days, transferring the explant to a bud induction screening medium, carrying out subculture for 1-3 times, and then carrying out bud elongation culture and rooting culture. The rapid genetic transformation method of peanuts provided by the invention has important significance for effectively reducing mechanical damage and accelerating genetic transformation, and provides a new idea for further researching the genetic transformation method of peanuts.

title_en: Dough sheet extrusion die and dough sheet
abstract_en: The extrusion die comprises an outer die 3, an inner die 4 is fixedly connected in the outer die 3, an extrusion cavity outer wall 32 is arranged at the front end of the outer die 3, an extrusion cavity inner wall 43 is arranged at the front end of the inner die 4, an extrusion cavity 6 is formed by a gap between the extrusion cavity outer wall 32 and the extrusion cavity inner wall 43, a first forming groove 321 is formed in the extrusion cavity outer wall 32 at intervals, a second forming groove 431 is formed in the extrusion cavity inner wall 43 at intervals, tooth bodies 41 are arranged at intervals on the periphery of the rear end of the inner die 4, a feeding cavity 31 is arranged at the rear end of the outer die 3, the top ends of the tooth bodies 41 are abutted against the inner wall of the feeding cavity 31, a feeding hole 5 is formed in the gap between every two adjacent tooth bodies 41, the feeding hole 5 is communicated with the extrusion cavity 6, a second inner die 81 is fixedly connected in the inner die 4, a second feeding hole is formed in the rear end between the inner die 4 and the second inner die 81, and a second extrusion cavity communicated with the second feeding hole is formed in the front end between the inner die 4 and the second inner die 81.

title_en: Anti-alcoholic composition containing dendrobium nobile small molecule peptide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses an anti-alcoholic composition containing dendrobium nobile small molecule peptide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the main components of the anti-alcoholic composition comprise dendrobium nobile small molecule peptide extract, which contains unreported small molecule peptide DHP-1 (Gly-Ala-Val-His-Leu), DHP-2 (Pro-Tyr-Ser-Met-Gln) or DHP-3 (Asp-Ile-Thr-Lys-Cys), and auxiliary materials such as vitamin C, glucose, citric acid and the like. After drinking, the alcohol concentration in blood is obviously lower than that of non-users in a certain period of time, which indicates that the composition has good anti-alcoholic effect. After the anti-alcoholic beverage is taken, the drunk symptoms such as dizziness, nausea, vomit and the like are obviously relieved, and the comfort level of a subject is improved. Through detecting liver function indexes (such as glutamic pyruvic transaminase, glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase and the like), the liver injury degree of a subject who drinks for a long time and takes the anti-alcoholic beverage is obviously lower than that of a person who drinks only, so that the composition has a liver protection effect.

title_en: Lactobacillus paracasei XH146 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to lactobacillus paracasei XH146 and application thereof, wherein the strain XH146 is obtained by self screening of an applicant, compared with the same lactobacillus, the strain can survive in target grasses well and form flora advantage, the target grasses are silated, in order to adjust smell, palatability and fermentation efficiency of the fermented grasses, peel raw materials capable of promoting proliferation of the strain XH146 are selected from peel of unconventional feed resources, and after screening and orthogonal optimization of unconventional feed resources, pineapple peel and papaya peel are selected and added into the grasses according to a certain addition amount, so that growth of the strain XH146 is effectively promoted, fermentation efficiency is improved, and quality of the fermented grasses is further improved.

title_en: Application of OsWOX13 gene in synergistically improving drought resistance and nitrogen utilization efficiency of rice
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of an OsWOX13 gene in synergistically improving drought resistance and nitrogen utilization efficiency of rice, and a rice breeding method for synergistically improving the drought resistance and the nitrogen utilization efficiency of the rice, which comprises the step of improving the expression level of the OsWOX13 gene in the rice. The invention digs the multifunctional function of OsWOX13 in regulating and controlling the drought stress response and nitrogen utilization efficiency of rice, provides a new view for creating high-quality rice resources, and provides a molecular basis for the future collaborative cultivation of rice with drought tolerance and high nitrogen utilization efficiency.

title_en: Medicinal and edible seasoning tea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses a medicine and food homologous seasoning tea and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the raw materials comprise ginseng, poria cocos, wild jujube seed, cassia twig, liquorice, fried white peony root, dried ginger, shizandra berry, poria cocos, dangshen, fried almond, cinnamon, prepared fleece-flower root, radix sileris, notopterygium root, rhizoma alismatis, cortex moutan, dried rehmannia root, chinese yam, mountain meat, dwarf lilyturf tuber, villous amomum fruit, clove, astragalus root, magnolia bark, angelica, szechuan lovage rhizome, fried atractylodes rhizome, rhizoma atractylodis, nutmeg, costustoot, agilawood, rosewood, jujube piece burnt medicated leaven, red tangerine peel, huixiang and Pu' er green tea. The preparation method comprises decocting the above raw materials into decoction, spraying the decoction onto Pu' er sun-dried green tea, stirring, adding a batch of decoction, fermenting with steel basin nest, fermenting until the temperature is no longer increased, repeating until the tea leaves are fermented, shaping, baking, and packaging to obtain tea cake.

title_en: Glutinous sorghum yellow cake and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glutinous sorghum yellow cake and a preparation process thereof, wherein the glutinous sorghum yellow cake comprises the following components, by weight, 49.59% of glutinous rice, 8.26% of rice, 24.79% of glutinous sorghum, 4.96% of soybean, 4.13% of rock sugar and 8.26% of brown sugar, takes the glutinous sorghum as a main raw material, fully utilizes the nutritional ingredients of the glutinous sorghum, such as rich dietary fibers, which are helpful for promoting intestinal peristalsis, protein can provide essential amino acids for human bodies and the like, so that the yellow cake has higher nutritional value, the unique flavor of the glutinous sorghum adds other mouthfeel to the yellow cake, and compared with the traditional glutinous rice yellow cake, the taste is richer and layered, the glutinous sorghum yellow cake has the fragrance of the glutinous sorghum and the sweet of soft glutinous rice, is easy to operate and control, is suitable for industrial production, and can meet the requirements of the market on novel special foods.

title_en: Bifidobacterium longum subspecies YLGB-1496 strain and its use for reducing cortisol content and/or improving appetite
abstract_en: The invention provides a bifidobacterium longum subspecies YLGB-1496 strain and application thereof in reducing cortisol content and/or improving appetite.

title_en: Bifidobacterium longum subspecies YLGB-1496 strain and its use for reducing cortisol content and/or improving appetite
abstract_en: The invention provides a bifidobacterium longum subspecies YLGB-1496 strain and application thereof in reducing cortisol content and/or improving appetite.

title_en: Five-element tea granule formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a five-element tea granule formula and a preparation method thereof, wherein the five-element tea granule formula comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 5-10 parts of green tea with green color, 9-15 parts of radish with white color, 3-10 parts of sea buckthorn with yellow color, 6-12 parts of medlar with red color and 9-15 parts of black Sang Qi with black color. The preparation method comprises decocting green tea 5-10 parts, white radish 9-15 parts, yellow Hippophae rhamnoides 3-10 parts, red fructus Lycii 6-12 parts, black chess 9-15 parts, and xylitol 6 parts with water 700 parts for 30min, filtering to obtain filtrate, decocting with water 500 parts for 20 min, filtering to obtain filtrate, mixing the filtrates, spray drying to obtain powder, and packaging.

title_en: Composition containing dietary fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural plant raw material preparation, and particularly relates to a composition containing dietary fibers, and a preparation method and application thereof. The dietary fiber-containing composition comprises, by weight, 10-20 parts of white kidney bean fiber, 5-10 parts of flaxseed, 3-8 parts of resistant dextrin, 1-5 parts of citrus fiber, 1-5 parts of oat fiber, 1-5 parts of inulin, 1-5 parts of mango powder and 0.5-3 parts of turmeric. The composition containing the dietary fiber provided by the invention is prepared by selecting plant natural raw materials for compounding and combining, and has various effects of increasing satiety, reducing excessive fat, sugar intake and the like. Meanwhile, the mixed liquid can keep a more uniform suspension state after being brewed, and is beneficial to the use of consumers, so that the mixed liquid has good practical application value.

title_en: Autonomous granule for improving piperine auxiliary gastric mucosa protection effect and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of natural product preparation, and in particular provides self-contained granules for improving the effect of piperine in assisting in protecting gastric mucosa and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps of dissolving piperine and partridge tea polyphenol, mixing, adjusting the pH value, heating, concentrating, purifying and drying. The invention solves the problems of structural complexity and subtle balance relation among compounds in the natural product self-assembly process, successfully prepares the piperine self-assembly nano-particles, and the use dosage of the piperine self-assembly nano-particles is only 20 mg/kg, b.w can obviously improve the auxiliary gastric mucosa protection capability of piperine. In addition, the method is based on a natural eutectic solvent aqueous two-phase system to separate and recover piperine and partridge tea polyphenol, has the advantages of large extraction quantity, simplicity in operation, mild preparation conditions, high selection, greenness and high efficiency, and overcomes the problems of difficult recovery, low selectivity, low efficiency and the like of the purified matters in the traditional extraction separation method.

title_en: Application of CmoCK gene in creating cucumber low-temperature-resistant stock
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant molecular breeding and low-temperature stress cultivation, in particular to application of CmoCK gene in creating a low-temperature resistant stock of cucumber, the low-temperature resistance of the obtained CmoCK gene over-expressed cucumber is obviously improved through low-temperature treatment of the over-expressed CmoCK gene and a wild cucumber, the wild type and over-expressed plants are respectively used as stocks and grafted with wild type scions, the over-expressed CmoCK gene cucumber is found to be used as the stock to improve the low-temperature resistance of the scion cucumber, and the above plants are measured for relative conductivity, malondialdehyde content and other physiological indexes, so that the novel CmoCK gene function has better application potential, and provides gene resources and novel ideas for reducing low-temperature stress and delaying low-temperature response of the cucumber in production, and further, the special stock for cultivating the low-temperature resistant cucumber has wide application prospect and higher use value.

title_en: PvFIP37 protein and application of related biological material thereof in regulation and control of cadmium tolerance of plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses PvFIP protein and application of related biological materials thereof in regulating and controlling cadmium tolerance of plants. The invention clones PvFIP genes from switchgrass and successfully constructs PvFIP37 over-expressed switchgrass. Analysis of the phenotype of PvFIP37 over-expressed switchgrass under cadmium stress shows that the improvement of PvFIP37 gene expression compared with wild type switchgrass can enhance cadmium tolerance of the switchgrass, which shows that PvFIP37 has the function of regulating cadmium tolerance of plants. The switchgrass PvFIP gene provided by the invention can be used as an excellent gene resource, can be widely applied to the field of genetic breeding of grasses or other crops, and has important significance for understanding the tolerance of plants under heavy metal stress.

title_en: Functional food and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of functional foods, and particularly discloses a functional food which is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 40-50% of peanut skin, 14-18% of burdock tea, 20-25% of jujube and 10-15% of plantain seed husk powder; A method for preparing functional food includes such steps as purchasing raw materials from reliable supplier, screening, removing impurities and unqualified products, processing raw materials, testing, packing, storing and selling, quality inspection, packing and storing, and final selling. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the food integrates various natural raw materials, provides comprehensive nutrients, meets daily health requirements, and has delicious taste and is easy to be accepted by consumers through reasonable formula and preparation process.

title_en: Nuclear factor YC subunit gene specifically induced by rice arbuscular mycorrhiza symbiotic and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear factor YC subunit gene specifically induced by arbuscular mycorrhizal and application thereof. A rice nuclear factor YC subunit gene OsNF-YC3 has a nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The protein OsNF-YC3 coded by the gene OsNF-YC3 has an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 2. The rice nitrate transporter gene OsNF-YC3 is applied to promoting interaction of plants and arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi and improving phosphorus absorption in the plant symbiotic process.

title_en: Production equipment and production method for producing dried shrimps with high astaxanthin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production device and a production method for producing dried shrimps with high astaxanthin, which relate to the technical field of astaxanthin health-care foods and comprise a base, a middle bracket, an upper bracket and a front side plate, wherein an extraction cylinder is rotatably arranged on the upper bracket, an extractant cylinder is arranged at the top of the upper bracket, the extractant in the extractant cylinder is sent into the extraction cylinder through a pumping and injecting mechanism and a material injecting pipe, the shrimp shell is sent into the extraction cylinder by combining the feeding groove, the shrimp shell is crushed by the crushing assembly, meanwhile, the opening and closing mechanism is arranged on the front side plate to control the opening and closing of the sliding plate on the extraction cylinder, the extraction agent containing astaxanthin is extracted by combining the material injection hole on the sliding plate and the extraction and injection mechanism and is sent into the drying mechanism to be dried together with the shrimp meat, so that the astaxanthin content in the dried shrimp is improved.

title_en: Rape BnaREV protein and encoding gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a rape BnaREV protein, a coding gene and application thereof. The protein is one of the following amino acid residue sequences, 1) SEQ ID No. 1 in a sequence table, 2) the protein which is obtained by substituting and/or deleting and/or adding one to five amino acid residues in the amino acid residue sequence of SEQ ID No. 1 in the sequence table and has cold resistance effect on rape. The invention also comprises a recombinant expression vector containing the gene, a transgenic cell line and engineering bacteria. Expression of the coding gene of the rape BnaREV protein in rape can obviously improve the cold resistance of the rape. The invention provides a brand new approach for rape cold resistance.

title_en: Application of RRM1-61 gene in regulation of rice blast resistance of plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of RRM1-61 genes in regulating plant rice blast resistance, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The invention provides application of RRM1-61 genes in regulating plant rice blast resistance, and experiments prove that plants with the RRM1-61 genes silenced are susceptible, compared with wild type plants, the plant with the RRM1-61 genes has obvious difference in lesion area on leaves, and the leaves are yellowing besides the lesions. Plants over-expressing the RRM1-61 gene are shown to be more disease resistant, and the area of lesions on leaves is significantly different from that of wild type plants. The invention provides a technical basis for cultivating new rice blast resistant varieties of plants and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Perfume composition and food and beverage
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique for masking unpleasant odors (off-flavors) generated in foods and beverages. As one embodiment, the present invention provides an inhibitor of unpleasant odor (off-flavor), a perfume composition, a food or drink having the unpleasant odor (off-flavor) masked, a method for producing the food or drink, and a method for masking the unpleasant odor (off-flavor). The present invention can suppress unpleasant odor (off-flavor) of foods and beverages by using 1 or more selected from the group consisting of oleic acid, β -damascone, 4-methyl-2-phenyl-2-pentenal, menthyl 3-hydroxybutyrate, dimethylbenzyl orthobutyrate and methyl 4-t-butylphenylacetate as an active ingredient.

title_en: Non-transgenic method for producing low-nicotine tobacco mutant plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-transgenic method for producing a low-nicotine tobacco mutant plant, which comprises the following steps of infecting a tobacco plant by using an engineering RNA virus vector carrying CRISPR/Cas nuclease, editing one or more genes of a tobacco berberine bridge-like protein gene family in a targeted manner by the nuclease, carrying out in vitro tissue culture on tobacco cells infected by viruses to regenerate the tobacco mutant plant, and screening a homozygous tobacco mutant plant with remarkably reduced nicotine content and unaffected normal growth and development yield. The invention has the advantages that EMDV can efficiently and stably express Cas9 protein and guide RNA in infected tobacco tissues to realize multicopy gene editing, exogenous DNA sequences are not required to be introduced into cells to be modified in the gene editing process, the risk of exogenous gene integration is avoided, the nicotine of the a/b/d1/d2/e and a/b/e mutant is obviously reduced, and the yield is not affected.

title_en: Composition for enhancing cooling effect
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to cooling modifying compositions that enhance the cooling effect of cooling compounds (e.g., menthol, piperlongum, etc.). In certain forms, the present disclosure provides for the use of such cooling degree modifying compositions for cooling effects of cooling compounds. In certain other aspects, the present disclosure provides compositions (e.g., edible compositions or oral care compositions) comprising a cooling compound (e.g., menthol, piperlongum, etc.) and a cooling modifying composition of the present disclosure. In certain embodiments, such compositions are in the form of a food product, beverage product, or oral care product (e.g., toothpaste, mouthwash, tooth whitening composition, chewing gum, dentifrice, etc.). In certain other embodiments, such compositions are in the form of a body care product (e.g., a cosmetic product, a skin care product, or a hair care product).

title_en: Bee-attracting pollination equipment for green shaddock planting
abstract_en: The invention provides a bee-attracting pollination device for green shaddock planting, which comprises a movable vehicle body, wherein a raw material component is arranged on the rear side of the top of the movable vehicle body, a fixed seat is arranged on the front side of the top of the movable vehicle body, a groove is formed in the center of the top of the fixed seat, two sides of the inside of the groove are respectively and movably connected with a rotating shaft, and a spray pipe is fixed between the two rotating shafts. The invention has the following beneficial effects that through the design of the raw material component, the water delivery outer pipe in the transfusion component is inserted into the inserting grooves on the bee calling agent box, the first water tank, the second water tank and the medicament box, the water delivery outer pipe is sleeved outside the water delivery inner pipe, the water delivery inner pipe is communicated with the inside of the water delivery outer pipe, the water delivery outer pipe triggers the infrared sensor on the inner wall of the inserting groove when the water delivery outer pipe is inserted into the inserting groove, the infrared sensor can start the electromagnetic valve inside the water delivery inner pipe, the water delivery inner pipe is opened, and the liquid delivery work is conveniently realized.

title_en: Preparation method of camellia seed oil with high oxidation resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of camellia seed oil with high oxidation resistance, which comprises the following steps of 1) preparing a fermentation substrate, namely, preprocessing camellia seed shells and camellia fruits to obtain the fermentation substrate, 2) preparing a fermentation medium by adopting the fermentation substrate, distilled water and a Basal medium as raw materials, 3) fermenting chlorella, namely, inoculating activated chlorella into the fermentation medium to perform high-temperature fermentation to obtain an intermediate product, 4) fermenting Micrococcus antarcticus, namely, firstly cooling the intermediate product, then inoculating the activated Micrococcus antarctica into the cooled intermediate product to perform low-temperature fermentation to obtain the fermentation product, 5) treating coenzyme Q0, namely, adding coenzyme Q0 into the fermentation product to perform enzymolysis and inactivation to obtain a fermentation enzymolysis liquid, and 6) squeezing the fermentation enzymolysis liquid to obtain the camellia seed oil with high oxidation resistance after drying, steaming. The method improves EPA content and oxidation resistance of oil tea seed oil.

title_en: Duck gizzard processingequipment of form distribution uniformity and stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to a duck gizzard processing device with uniform and stable morphological distribution, which comprises a conveying mechanism, a slitting mechanism, a film scraping mechanism and a string penetrating mechanism, wherein the conveying mechanism is used for conveying duck gizzards and comprises a rack and a conveying belt, the slitting mechanism is used for slitting the duck gizzards into continuous spiral shapes and comprises a positioning component used for positioning the duck gizzards and a slitting component used for slitting the positioned duck gizzards, the film scraping mechanism is arranged behind the slitting mechanism and used for scraping gold in ducks on the surfaces of the duck gizzards, the string penetrating mechanism is arranged behind the film scraping mechanism and used for being matched with the positioning component to complete string penetrating, and the pickling mechanism is arranged behind the conveying mechanism and used for pickling the duck gizzards. Solves the technical problems that the duck gizzard processing needs to consume a great deal of labor and the finished product has larger instability.

title_en: Preparation method of rhizoma polygonati tea for enhancing immunity of organism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of Polygonatum sibiricum tea, in particular to a preparation method of Polygonatum sibiricum tea for enhancing immunity of an organism, which comprises the following steps of selecting fresh rhizome of Polygonatum sibiricum, good in texture and free of plant diseases and insect pests; cleaning rhizoma polygonati rhizome with clear water, removing sediment and impurities on the surface, soaking the cleaned rhizome of rhizoma polygonati in clear water to slightly soften the rhizome of rhizoma polygonati, steaming the rhizome of rhizoma polygonati after soaking in the clear water with big fire, taking out the rhizoma polygonati after steaming, airing the rhizoma polygonati under the sun until the surface is dry, repeating the steps of steaming and airing for nine times, slicing or dicing the rhizoma polygonati, drying the diced rhizoma polygonati in a heat pump dryer in stages until the rhizoma polygonati is completely dried, bagging and storing the dried rhizoma polygonati, and the nine-steaming and nine-airing step of the rhizoma polygonati tea can decompose macromolecular grease and protein in the rhizoma polygonati into small molecules so as to enable the small molecules to be absorbed by human bodies more easily, and meanwhile, degrading the micro-toxic components contained in the rhizoma polygonati, so that the drug property of the rhizoma polygonati is milder and the drug effect is enhanced.

title_en: Prefabricated rice dumpling porridge capable of being eaten by brewing and being eaten dry and comprising prefabricated rice dumpling and prefabricated porridge powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ready-made sweet dumpling porridge capable of being eaten by brewing and being eaten by dry and prepared porridge powder, which consists of cooked sweet dumplings and a self-preservation wrapping layer arranged on the surface of the ready-made sweet dumplings, wherein the self-preservation wrapping layer at least has the effects of preserving, preserving moisture, delaying hardening, preventing adhesion and helping digestion on the cooked sweet dumplings, comprises an attached thin wrapping layer and/or an embedded thick wrapping layer, the attached self-preservation wrapping layer fully covers the surface of the cooked sweet dumplings to form the sweet dumplings capable of being eaten by boiling water and form ready-to-eat dry sweet dumplings capable of being unsealed, the embedded thick wrapping layer is matched to form the ready-to-eat porridge powder capable of being eaten by boiling water and the cooked sweet dumplings to form the ready-to-eat sweet dumplings.

title_en: Selenium-enriched oyster mushroom mycelium protein Pickering emulsion gel, method, 3D printing material and product
abstract_en: The invention provides selenium-rich oyster mushroom mycelium protein Pickering emulsion gel, a method, 3D printing materials and products, wherein the raw materials comprise 20% -70% of water phase and 30% -80% of oil phase in terms of mass fraction, and the water phase is a mixed solution of selenium-rich oyster mushroom mycelium protein and xanthan gum. According to the invention, selenium-enriched oyster mushroom mycelium protein is used as a mycoprotein resource for replacing animal protein, so that the application value of oyster mushroom in food processing is improved, and a 3D printed food with a selenium supplementing function is further developed.

title_en: Pomegranate wine production equipment and process capable of preventing inner cores from being broken
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of pomegranate wine production, and provides a pomegranate wine production device and a process for preventing kernel from being broken, wherein the pomegranate wine production device for preventing kernel from being broken comprises a device box for producing fragrant pomegranate wine, and a conveying box is arranged on the device box and is used for conveying pomegranate seeds for producing the fragrant pomegranate wine; the device comprises a conveying box, a hopper, a squeezing cylinder, a primary filter box and a device box, wherein the hopper is fixedly communicated with the top of the conveying box, the squeezing cylinder is fixedly communicated with the discharge end of the conveying box and used for squeezing and treating the pomegranate seeds, and the primary filter box is arranged in the device box and used for receiving and treating the squeezed juice of the pomegranate seeds and an inner core. The technical problem that the quality of the pomegranate wine is reduced due to the broken inner core in the current production process of the pomegranate wine is solved.

title_en: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GYX-9 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lactobacillus rhamnosus GYX-9 and application thereof. The lactobacillus rhamnosus GYX-9 can regulate the problems of lipid metabolism disorder, liver lipid accumulation or pathological damage and the like caused by high-fat diet. The lactobacillus rhamnosus GYX-9 can reduce the level of TNF-alpha, increase the content of IL-10, regulate colonic immune disorder, regulate the colony abundance of intestinal microbiota, and regulate metabolic disorder caused by high-fat diet based on intestinal flora-intestinal-liver axis. The invention also prepares normal-temperature viable bacteria fermented milk with viable bacteria count not less than 10  8  cfu/mL, which has remarkable cholesterol-reducing, taurocholate-binding and pancreatic lipase-inhibiting capabilities, wherein the pancreatic lipase-inhibiting rate can reach 67.06%.

title_en: Processing method of yolk peptide rich in glycerophosphorylcholine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of yolk peptide rich in glycerophosphorylcholine, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out protease treatment, namely uniformly mixing yolk powder with water, adjusting pH to 7-10, adding protease, carrying out enzymolysis for 4-8 hours at the temperature of 45-55 ℃ to obtain yolk enzymolysis liquid 1, S2, carrying out phospholipase treatment, namely adjusting the pH of the yolk enzymolysis liquid 1 obtained in the step S1 to 5.5-7.5, adding phospholipase B, carrying out stirring enzymolysis for 2-4 hours at the temperature of 50-60 ℃ to obtain yolk enzymolysis liquid 2, S3, carrying out flash evaporation treatment, carrying out flash evaporation, concentration, high-temperature sterilization and spray drying treatment on the yolk enzymolysis liquid 2 obtained in the step S2, and thus obtaining the yolk peptide rich in glycerophosphorylcholine. The method can solve the problems of insufficient comprehensive utilization rate of yolk resources and low added value of products, is simple to operate and is easy to realize industrialization.

title_en: Preparation and primary induction culture method of high-induction-rate explant of endangered plant camellia nitidissima
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and primary induction culture method of high-induction rate explants of endangered plant camellia nitidissima, which utilizes nutrient solution to promote multiple-time extraction of camellia nitidissima seedlings as an explant source, and after sterilization treatment, inoculating a preferred primary induction sprouting culture medium and an initial bud domestication culture medium for primary induction culture. The invention utilizes the principle that the stem segments of the golden camellia can be extracted for many times during the acquisition and the primary induction culture of the explants, can obtain abundant explant materials, remarkably improves the induction rate, can obtain a large amount of culture materials in a short period, lays a material foundation for further tissue culture breeding application research, can track the economic character of the mother plant of the explants, and has important significance for promoting the development of golden camellia industry.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide modified from signal peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide modified from a signal peptide and application thereof, belonging to the field of biological medicine. The invention provides an antibacterial peptide PERCEPTIDE modified from a signal peptide, which is VKKRLLFRKPLLKLFLLFGRRLKA in sequence by utilizing an artificial intelligent model to mutate and modify the signal peptide. The test shows that the antibacterial peptide has good antibacterial activity to both gram-positive strains and gram-negative strains, the minimum antibacterial concentration can reach 1 mu M, the hemolytic activity is low, the half hemolytic concentration HC  50  is more than 128 mu M, the interaction with the bacterial inner membrane and the human cell membrane shows selectivity, and the antibacterial peptide can be used for developing antibacterial drugs and antibacterial products.

title_en: Mutant miR396 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mutant miR396 and application thereof, wherein the mutant miR396 has a base mutation relative to a parent miR396, the parent miR396 is a wild type miR396 derived from corn, the miR396 comprises miR396c and/or miR396d, and the mutant miR396 can enhance the disease resistance of the corn and improve the yield of the corn.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine feed additive and application thereof in partridge cultivation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine feed additive and application thereof in partridge breeding, and belongs to the technical field of poultry breeding. The traditional Chinese medicine feed additive is prepared from the following components, by weight, 5-7 parts of dried orange peel, 3-5 parts of cape jasmine and 2-3 parts of radix scutellariae. The invention also discloses application of the traditional Chinese medicine feed additive, which can improve the intestinal flora of partridge, increase the contents of partridge egg taurine, protein, vitamin A, vitamin E and vitamin B2 and improve the quality of gu eggs. The traditional Chinese medicine feed additive provided by the invention has a remarkable improvement effect on the quality of cultured partridge eggs, and brings a wide application prospect for development of partridge industry.

title_en: Three-stage nano-film ultrafilter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-level nano-film ultrafilter which comprises an ultrafiltration mechanism, a pump body, a power device, a reversing valve assembly, a reversing driving mechanism and a cleaning liquid storage tank, wherein the reversing valve assembly is matched with the reversing driving mechanism, the reversing driving mechanism is in power connection with the power device through a transmission assembly A, the pump body is in power connection with the power device through a transmission assembly B, a ratchet assembly A is arranged on the transmission assembly A, a ratchet assembly B is arranged on the transmission assembly B, when the reversing driving mechanism is driven by the power device to work under the action of the ratchet assembly A and the ratchet assembly B, the pump body does not work, and when the pump body is driven by the power device to work, the reversing driving mechanism does not work, and pipelines among the reversing valve assembly, the cleaning liquid storage tank and the ultrafiltration mechanism are connected. The invention relates to the technical field of nano-film ultrafilters, which has the advantages of realization of back flushing, low overall failure rate and convenient maintenance and overhaul.

title_en: Gallocatechin gallate use of esters and isoquercitrins
abstract_en: The use of gallocatechin gallate (Gallocatechin Gallate; GCG) and isoquercitrin (Isoquercitrin, IQC) for the manufacture of a composition for liver health promotion or for the assisted protection against chemical liver injury is disclosed in the present specification. In one aspect, the composition of the present invention can contain a complex of gallocatechin gallate and isoquercitrin to effectively reduce oxidative stress and chronic inflammatory response occurring during lipid accumulation in liver tissues to promote liver health, and is applicable to prevention, improvement or treatment of various liver diseases such as hepatitis, liver cirrhosis, liver cancer and the like.

title_en: Radix asparagi dividing rapid propagation irradiation mutation seedling raising method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to an asparagus root split rapid propagation irradiation mutation seedling method. By adopting the method, the survival rate of the separated plants of the radix asparagi is up to more than 90%, the work efficiency of transplanting the separated plants of the radix asparagi is greatly improved, the highest separation coefficient of the separated plants can be up to 8 times through mutagenesis treatment, a large number of radix asparagi seedlings can be obtained quickly, the propagation speed of the radix asparagi is accelerated, the stable improvement of the yield of the radix asparagi is facilitated, the artificial industrialized planting of the radix asparagi is realized, the reliable resource guarantee is provided for the deep processing of the radix asparagi, the industrialized and large-scale planting of the radix asparagi can be realized, and the guarantee is provided for the large-scale and standardized cultivation of the radix asparagi.

title_en: Processing method of low-salt fermented bean curd
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of low-salt fermented bean curd, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The processing method comprises the steps of sterilizing the bean curd white blank, pre-fermenting, curing with seasoning quality guarantee liquid and post-fermenting. According to the invention, after the bean curd white blank is sterilized, the bean curd white blank is inoculated with the Mucor elegans for pre-fermentation, namely the directional pure-breeding fermentation, so that the pollution of mixed bacteria can be effectively avoided, and the limit of fermented bean curd fermentation to a high-salt environment is eliminated. Compared with the traditional method of pickling by using a solid pickling material, the method can promote the moisture extravasation of the fermented bean curd blank, is more beneficial to endowing the fermented bean curd with salty and fresh taste, can effectively reduce the salt content of the low-salt fermented bean curd on the premise of guaranteeing the flavor of the product, is more compatible with the pursuit of healthy diet by consumers at present, reduces the health risks of diseases such as hypertension and cardiovascular diseases caused by excessive salt intake of the consumers, and widens the consumer groups of the product, especially the crowd with requirements for low-salt diet.

title_en: Breakfast porridge and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to breakfast porridge and a preparation method thereof, wherein the breakfast porridge comprises 7% -8% of coffee beans or powder, 12% -13% of purified water, 12% -13% of purple rice, 9% -11% of oat, 6% -7% of quinoa, 6% -7% of soybean milk oat, 6% -7% of snow bud rice, 2% -3% of Chinese yam slices, 5% -7% of lily, 5% -7% of red quinoa, 1% -2% of tremella, 1% -2% of hericium erinaceus, 2% -3% of rock honey, 12% -16% of milk and 0.05% -0.07% of bird nest. Has the following technical effects of protecting the digestive system, wherein drinking coffee in the fasting state can increase gastric acid secretion, and gastric acid excess can influence digestion function, so that uncomfortable symptoms such as dyspepsia, inappetence, gastralgia, gastrectasia, nausea, vomiting and the like are caused. The formula combines the components such as coffee and the like with the nutrient substances such as dietary fibers, vitamins and the like of grains, and provides comprehensive nutrition.

title_en: Nutritional composition and use of a nutritional composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides nutritional compositions and uses of nutritional compositions. The nutritional composition comprises medium-long chain fatty acid triglyceride (MLCT) and Milk Fat Globule Membrane (MFGM) in a mass ratio of 2:1 to 80:1, which in combination have synergistic effects of improving diarrhea, inhibiting staphylococcus aureus in vivo or in vitro, and/or modulating intestinal flora.

title_en: Application of Bs4C gene in bacterial wilt resistance and vector constructed by same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, and particularly relates to application of a Bs4C gene in bacterial wilt resistance and a vector constructed by the same. The invention discloses a new application of an anti-disease protein coding gene Bs4C gene in bacterial wilt resistance for the first time.
