Genetic transformation was performed in tobacco by constructing a recombinant vector in which the ADC1 promoter and the Bs4C gene were expressed in tandem. In the tobacco plants transformed by the recombinant vector, the Bs4C gene is inoculated with the bacterial wilt pathogen, ralstonia solanacearum, for induction expression. After bacterial wilt inoculation, tobacco plants induced by Bs4C gene showed stronger resistance to bacterial wilt than controls. Under normal growth conditions, the tobacco plants did not induce expression of Bs4C gene, and the growth vigor was not significantly different from that of the wild type. In conclusion, the Bs4C gene plays an important positive regulation role in the resistance regulation process of tobacco bacterial wilt, and a bacterial wilt induction expression system constructed by using the ADC1 promoter and the Bs4C gene can be applied to gene function research and genetic engineering breeding for improving the resistance of tobacco bacterial wilt.

title_en: Soybean MYB transcription factor gene and application thereof in improving isoflavone content
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of genetic engineering, and provides a soybean MYB transcription factor gene and application thereof in improving isoflavone content. The soybean MYB transcription factor gene is GmMYB3a, and the nucleotide sequence of the soybean MYB transcription factor gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention successfully constructs the pTF101-GmMYB3a overexpression vector and the RNAi-GmMYB3a interference vector, and transfers the constructed vector into a receptor soybean variety Williams 82. Experimental results show that the soybean strain over-expressing the GmMYB3a gene shows higher isoflavone content, and the soybean strain interfering with the GmMYB3a gene has reduced isoflavone content, so that the forward regulation and control effect of the GmMYB3a in the isoflavone biosynthesis process is proved. The invention not only provides an innovative molecular breeding strategy for cultivating the soybean strain with high isoflavone content, but also has remarkable application potential and market prospect.

title_en: Method for synthesizing triglyceride with high sn-2 DHA content by using lipase to catalyze algae oil and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of grease biological enzyme synthesis, and particularly relates to a method for synthesizing sn-2 high-DHA triglyceride by catalyzing algae oil with lipase and application thereof. The method takes DHA-containing algae oil, sunflower seed fully hydrolyzed oil and medium-long chain fatty acid as raw materials, and is prepared by a multi-step enzyme method. By the method, the content of sn-2DHA in the total DHA can be stably improved by more than 60 percent.

title_en: Circulating grain water molecule evaporation plant based on air source heat pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of drying, in particular to a circulating grain water molecule evaporation device based on an air source heat pump. The conventional grain water molecule evaporation device has the defects that the grain accumulation easily causes unsmooth hot air circulation and reduces the drying efficiency, and when a plurality of devices are heated, only hot air is simply conveyed, and a reasonable hot air utilization and water vapor discharge mechanism is lacked, so that the water molecules in the grain are slowly evaporated, and the drying effect is not ideal. The circulating grain water molecule evaporating device based on the air source heat pump comprises a base, wherein an evaporating cylinder is fixedly connected to the base, and a feed hopper is fixedly connected to the outer side of the upper part of the evaporating cylinder. The steam then gets into moisture extraction cover, is followed by the suction ring pipe and the blast pipe is absorbed away, realizes the stoving processing to grain from this, and not only, the suction ring pipe still can be through swivel becket, crooked pipe, fixed pipe and tooth harrow pole, and the inside is piled to grain between deep evaporation cage and the moisture extraction cover, and moisture among them is extracted, reinforces the stoving effect.

title_en: Retinol derivative or its salt, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a retinol derivative or a salt thereof, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the retinol derivative or the salt thereof maintains the anti-aging effect of retinol and reduces the side effects of skin irritation and allergy, and in addition, the retinol derivative or the salt thereof has the effects of whitening, resisting photodamage, resisting inflammation, resisting oxidation, repairing and the like, and has good application prospects in the field of cosmetic raw materials.

title_en: Application of rice OsARF24 gene
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a rice OsARF24 gene. The accession number of the OsARF24 gene nucleotide sequence in Genbank is LOC4352211. The rice OsARF24 gene is a key element on the auxin signaling pathway. Knockout of OsARF1 results in reduced expression level, nitrate nitrogen absorption rate, plant height and yield of the rice nitrogen metabolism related genes, and comprehensive expression is represented by reduced nitrogen fertilizer utilization efficiency. The function of positive regulation of the rice nitrogen fertilizer utilization efficiency of the OsARF24 gene is clarified, and a technical route for improving the rice nitrogen fertilizer utilization efficiency by increasing the expression of the OsARF24 in rice is provided.

title_en: Alfalfa gene MtZW1 and application thereof in plant salt tolerance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering and salt-tolerant plant cultivation, and particularly relates to an alfalfa gene MtZW and application thereof in plant salt tolerance. Specifically, the invention discovers a gene MtZW1 for negatively regulating the salt tolerance of the medicago truncatula for the first time, and researches show that the loss of the function of the gene MtZW1 can obviously influence the salt tolerance phenotype of the medicago truncatula. Compared with a wild plant, the survival rate of the gene mutant plant after 100mM NaCl treatment is obviously improved. The invention only clarifies the action mechanism of the gene MtZW1 in plant salt tolerance, and provides a new tool and a method for improving the plant salt tolerance by using a genetic engineering means, thereby having important scientific significance and practical application prospect.

title_en: Formula of monascus tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formula of monascus tea, and belongs to the technical field of food. The monascus tea is rich in natural statins, has obvious functions of reducing blood fat, reducing blood pressure and reducing blood sugar, is beneficial to preventing and treating cardiovascular diseases, improves the taste of the monascus by adding sugar such as glucose, is more sweet and delicious and is more easily accepted and liked by people, and the monascus tea is prepared into tea bags or balls or tablets, so that the consumption is beneficial to customers to master, and is packaged in the form of tea bags or bottles and the like, so that the monascus tea is convenient to carry and brew, and becomes a healthy, convenient and easy-to-drink beverage.

title_en: Soybean GmSUC gene and application of encoding protein thereof in regulating and controlling soybean seed protein content
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, and discloses an application of soybean GmSUC gene and its coded protein in regulating and controlling soybean seed protein content. The invention discloses soybean GmSUC gene and its coded protein for the first time, which have the function of regulating and controlling soybean seed protein content, and the coded protein of GmSUC gene can effectively improve soybean protein content by mutation in plants. The GmSUC gene and the coded protein thereof provided by the invention can be used for breeding high-protein soybean varieties, and have wide application prospects.

title_en: Instant flower gum and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an instant flower gum and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of flower gum processing and comprise the following steps of a) mixing a dried orange peel solution, sealwort stem leaves, flower gum and water, adding lactobacillus, fermenting until the pH value reaches 4.2-4.6, taking out the flower gum, washing with water, steaming in a pot, and cutting to obtain flower gum cubes; b) mixing the dendrobium candidum polysaccharide, the flower gum butyl and water, heating and stirring, adjusting the pH to 8-10, stirring to obtain paste, and cooling to obtain the dendrobium candidum polysaccharide instant flower gum. According to the preparation method of the instant flower gum, the dried orange peel, the stems and leaves of the rhizoma polygonati and the flower gum are mixed and fermented together, and the flower gum is embedded by the dendrobium candidum polysaccharide, so that the obtained instant flower gum can well improve fishy smell and keep nutritional ingredients of the flower gum. Meanwhile, the novel function of the flower gum can be given to further improve the overall nutritive value of the instant flower gum.

title_en: SNP marker primer of ALS gene of rice anti-imidazolinone herbicide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological detection, and in particular relates to an SNP (single nucleotide polymorphism) marker primer of an imidazolinone herbicide ALS (ALS) gene of rice and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides an SNP marker primer for detecting an imidazolinone herbicide resistant gene ALS of rice, which is characterized by comprising an upstream primer F1, an upstream primer F2 and a downstream primer R, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the upstream primer F1 is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, the nucleotide sequence of the upstream primer F2 is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the nucleotide sequence of the downstream primer R is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The SNP marker primer provided by the disclosure has high sensitivity and high specificity.

title_en: Application of aromatic thioglycoside in preparation of hypoglycemic drugs and health care related products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of aromatic thioglycoside in preparing hypoglycemic drugs and health care related products. The aromatic thio-glycoside compounds have good inhibitory activity effect on alpha-glycosidase. The thioglycoside compound provided by the invention is expected to be used for preventing or treating diabetes.

title_en: Method for preparing high-protein-concentration feed protein by DDGS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-protein-concentration feed protein by DDGS. According to the invention, DDGS is used as a fermentation raw material, multi-bacteria mixing two-step fermentation is adopted to produce high-protein-concentration feed protein, and finally 30L is used for amplifying the content of crude protein in the feed protein produced by fermentation to 70% -75%, so that the requirements of harmless treatment and utilization of alcohol waste DDGS are met, and the utilization rate of the DDGS is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of digestion-resistant dry rice flour
abstract_en: A process for preparing digestion-resistant dried rice flour includes such steps as washing rice, immersing, grinding, adding corn starch, edible fat (edible oil, oleic acid, linoleic acid or lauric acid), stirring, heating, stirring, toughening, heating, gelatinizing, extruding out, ageing and baking. According to the method, edible lipid is added in the processing process, on one hand, the lipid is added and toughened, so that the combination of the lipid and amylose can be promoted, the formation of starch-lipid composite resistant starch is facilitated, the digestion resistance of the dry rice flour is improved, on the other hand, the addition of the lipid regulates and controls the aging of the dry rice flour, and the rehydration time of the dry rice flour can be shortened.

title_en: Egg membrane aqueous solution device and production method using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an egg membrane aqueous solution device and a production method using the same, wherein the device comprises a plurality of containers, a liquid supply unit, a heating unit, a condensation recovery unit, a hanging unit, a microwave generation unit and a control unit, wherein the containers are respectively used for installing different units and are combined in a stacking manner so as to heat an egg shell raw material, clean water and ferment in the containers to 50-70 ℃ for 6-12 hours, water vapor in the process is collected into recovered water, the recovered water is used for flushing the egg shell raw material to wash away the water-soluble egg shell membrane remained on the surface, air suction and heating to 60-80 ℃ are performed for reduced pressure concentration, finally, the microwave is used for destroying protein bonds of the egg membrane aqueous solution and inactivating the ferment, the action process is automated so as to improve the production quality and efficiency, and the stacking design can also improve the configuration elasticity.

title_en: Application of Mei Shati Ni as copper death inhibitor in preparation of medicine for preventing and treating copper death related diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of Mei Shati Ni as a copper death inhibitor in preparing a medicine for preventing and treating copper death related diseases, and relates to the technical field of medicines. According to the invention, through the experimental verification of cells and mice, merestinib obviously restores the levels of Fe-S cluster protein (LIAS/DLAT) and esterified protein (FDX 1) related to copper death, reduces the level of heat shock protein HSP70, further reduces the sensitivity of various cells to copper death and enhances the restoring effect on acute liver injury. Simultaneously Merestinib can obviously reduce the level of glutamic-pyruvic transaminase and glutamic-pyruvic transaminase in serum and the level of inflammatory factors IL-1 beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha, effectively promote the repair of liver tissues and play an anti-inflammatory role. The invention provides theoretical support for treating copper death related diseases.

title_en: Corn husk soluble dietary fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a corn husk soluble dietary fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of soluble dietary fiber preparation. The invention provides trichoderma reesei TE-36 and a method for preparing corn husk soluble dietary fibers by using the strain, comprising the following steps of mixing corn husk powder with a culture medium, inoculating seed liquid of trichoderma reesei TE-36, and fermenting; and then carrying out enzymolysis and alcohol precipitation to obtain the corn husk soluble dietary fiber. The Trichoderma reesei TE-36 provided by the invention has complete cellulase system composition, high growth speed and high enzyme yield, can secrete a plurality of high-activity cell wall hydrolytic enzymes, and can effectively degrade cellulose and hemicellulose macromolecules in corn husks. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the bacterial and enzymatic synergistic fermentation technology is adopted, and a plurality of treatment modes are organically fused, so that the yield, purity and blood sugar reducing function characteristics of the soluble dietary fiber are improved, and the preparation method is also suitable for industrial popularization.

title_en: Aquatic product thawing equipment and thawing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides aquatic product thawing equipment and a thawing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of aquatic product thawing. The defrosting device comprises a defrosting device body, wherein a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the defrosting device body, a heating pipe is arranged at the bottom of the defrosting device body, a bubble pipe is arranged at the bottom of the defrosting device body, a control system is arranged in the defrosting device body, a water inlet is arranged in the defrosting device body, and a water outlet is arranged in the defrosting device body. According to the invention, the spacing supporting mechanism and the mounting and fixing assembly are arranged, so that the spacing supporting mechanism can be used for rapidly mounting and fixing the separation net bag, the edge of the separation net bag is tightly attached to the inner wall of the main body of the thawing equipment when the separation net bag is used, the separation net bag is more convenient to use when the separation net bag is used for cleaning floating foam in the main body of the thawing equipment, the floating foam in water in the main body of the thawing equipment is cleaned more thoroughly, and aquatic products can be buffered by the arrangement of the separation net bag.

title_en: Vinegar for reducing blood pressure and blood lipid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to blood pressure and blood lipid reducing vinegar and a preparation method thereof. A blood pressure and blood lipid reducing vinegar is prepared from pure grape wine, eucommiae cortex, crystal sugar, and radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii by mixing, wherein the pure grape wine is prepared by selecting high-quality pure grape wine as basic raw material, preferably aging dry red grape wine in a sterile stainless steel fermentation tank for a certain time by conventional brewing process; the eucommia ulmoides is accurately weighed 25g, the eucommia ulmoides is selected from a high-quality production area, the eucommia ulmoides is strictly screened to ensure that dried eucommia ulmoides bark is free of mildew and impurities, 37 g of rock candy is prepared, and high-quality rock candy with high purity and transparent color is selected.

title_en: Method for generating hybrid sweetgum sulfopeptide dependent vegetative organ origin somatic embryo
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating embryo of hybrid sweetgum fruit sulfopeptide dependent vegetative organ origin, which comprises taking mature vegetative organ as explant, performing callus induction, callus proliferation, embryogenic callus maturation, embryo induction and embryo development on a culture medium containing sulfopeptide, and performing embryo germination on a culture medium without sulfopeptide. The invention utilizes the novel plant small peptide sulfopeptide to realize the induction of the cotyledon embryo of the origin of the hybrid sweetgum leaf piece in both high embryogenic genotypes and low embryogenic genotypes, and proves that the sulfopeptide can obviously improve the induction rate of leaf callus, the formation rate of cotyledon embryo and the germination rate, thereby not only providing a stable and efficient system for the subsequent theoretical exploration, but also laying a solid foundation for the development of the clone forestry of the hybrid sweetgum.

title_en: Sectional liquor picking device for liquor processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a sectional wine picking device for processing white wine, which belongs to the technical field of white wine picking and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a wine storage bin through an upright post, the upper end surface of the wine storage bin is provided with an adjustable wine receiving structure, and a temperature sensor and an alcohol concentration sensor are respectively arranged on the wine storage bin. According to the invention, through the temperature sensor, the alcohol concentration sensor, the connecting pipe, the branch pipe, the first electromagnetic valve, the first alcohol picking pipe, the second alcohol picking pipe, the third alcohol picking pipe, the connecting pipe, the second electromagnetic valve and the alcohol discharging pipe, the temperature and the alcohol concentration of the white wine are monitored in real time, and the alcohol is picked in a segmented mode according to the preset standard, so that the accuracy of the alcohol picking is ensured, the alcohol picking effect of the white wine is improved, the degree of alcohol can be accurately distinguished, the accurate segmentation is realized, the alcohol picking efficiency is obviously improved, and the problem of low accuracy of manual alcohol picking in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Culture medium composition for tissue culture of saussurea involucrata and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a culture medium composition for tissue culture of saussurea involucrata and application thereof, belonging to the field of plant tissue culture. The culture medium composition further comprises 9-11 g/L of fructose, 9-11 g/L of glucose, 9-11 g/L of sucrose, 5-7 g/L of agar, 0.5-1.5 mg/L of 2, 4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid, 0.05-0.1 mg/L, N-phenyl-N' -1,2, 3-thiadiazole-5-urea, 0.05-0.2 mg/L of hydrolyzed milk protein, 400-600 mg/L of activated carbon, 0.2-0.4 g/L of activated carbon and 10-25 mg/L of methyl jasmonate on the basis of an MS culture medium. Through integrating hormone, functional additives (hydrolyzed milk protein and active carbon) and nano materials (silver/copper doped nano zinc oxide), a multi-level synergistic effect is formed, so that the yield of flavonoid compounds is improved on the basis of improving the callus induction rate of saussurea involucrata.

title_en: Double gel, preparation method and application thereof and crisp biscuits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food processing, and discloses a double gel, a preparation method and application thereof and crisp biscuits. The double gel component comprises a solution-state oleogel and hydrogel, wherein the solution-state oleogel component comprises soybean oil, beef tallow, ethyl cellulose and an emulsifier, and the hydrogel component comprises konjak glucomannan. The preparation method comprises adding ethyl cellulose and emulsifier into soybean oil and beef tallow, heating to dissolve to obtain solution-state oil gel, swelling konjac glucomannan in water, heating to form hydrogel, mixing the hydrogel with the solution-state oil gel, stirring, homogenizing, cooling, and standing to obtain double gel. The crisp biscuits prepared by the double gel are closer to those prepared by margarine, the hardness, the crispness and the fatty acid content are obviously reduced, and the double gel has the advantages of uniform color, regular shape and layering section.

title_en: Use of milk basic proteins for promoting development and/or repair of ocular structures
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of food or medicine, in particular to the use of milk basic proteins for promoting eye development, and/or repair of ocular structures, and/or for treating or preventing ocular diseases associated with degeneration or pathological changes of ocular structures.

title_en: Animal model for constructing hyperuricemia by using epinephrine and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal model construction, and particularly relates to a hyperuricemia animal model constructed by epinephrine and a construction method thereof. The animal model is molded by adopting a method of injecting low-dose epinephrine, and the method comprises the following steps of injecting low-dose epinephrine into experimental animals every day, enabling the experimental animals to drink water freely in normal diet, and enabling the molding time to be at least 14 days. The animal model of high uric acid can be successfully constructed by injecting low dose epinephrine, and the animal model of high uric acid can also be successfully constructed by adopting a modeling method of combining high purine diet, uricase inhibitor and uric acid transporter inhibitor. In addition, from the viewpoints of economy, cost and the like, only low-dose epinephrine is injected, and the animal model with high uric acid can be successfully constructed without additional auxiliary modeling conditions, so that a brand new choice is provided for the construction method of the animal model.

title_en: AI optimization-based full-automatic pet health product processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pet health product production and processing, and discloses a full-automatic pet health product processing system and method based on AI optimization, wherein the full-automatic pet health product processing method based on AI optimization comprises the steps of constructing a pulse electric field auxiliary low-temperature sterilization system; the method comprises the steps of establishing a microbial electric field sensitivity database, realizing accurate customization of electric field parameters, analyzing thermal response characteristics of different active ingredients in the pet health care product, constructing a thermal diffusion equation inversion algorithm, realizing accurate reconstruction of an internal temperature field of the material, realizing real-time monitoring of the content of the active ingredients by combining a Raman spectrum technology and a thermal imaging system, establishing an active ingredient thermal degradation dynamics model, realizing optimal balance of a sterilization effect and retention rates of different active ingredients by combining a multi-objective pareto optimization method, solving the technical problem of serious active ingredient loss in the traditional thermal sterilization process, and improving the retention rate of heat-sensitive ingredients in the pet health care product.

title_en: Preparation process of squid sticky powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of squid processing, in particular to a squid sticky powder preparation process. The squid meat crushing device comprises a crushing mechanism, a main rod, an energy storage assembly, a main rod, a filtering mechanism, a stirring mechanism, an energy storage assembly and a main rod rotating mechanism, wherein the crushing mechanism is started to crush squid meat to be crushed, slurry generated in the process of crushing squid meat starts to be slowly separated from the squid meat to be crushed under the action of gravity, the squid meat is intercepted by the filtering mechanism, the crushing mechanism continuously stores energy to the energy storage mechanism in the process of crushing squid meat, the stored energy is released by the energy storage mechanism after the squid meat is crushed, the stirring mechanism is driven to intermittently strike the bottom of the filtering mechanism in the process of releasing elastic potential energy, the slurry is separated from the squid meat is accelerated, the main rod rotates to tension the energy storage assembly for energy storage in the process of the main rod, and the main rod drives the energy storage assembly to synchronously rotate after the energy storage assembly reaches the maximum value of stored energy.

title_en: Wheat TaPHT & 36 gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides wheat TaPHT & lt 1 & gt, 36 & lt gene & gt and application thereof under low phosphorus stress, wherein the sequence published in a wheat genome database is used for preparing cDNA by taking total RNA of a SW2 root system of a low phosphorus resistant spring wheat material as a template, cDNA is reversely transcribed, taPHT & lt 1 & gt, 36 & lt gene & gt is cloned by taking cDNA as a template, an over-expression vector is constructed, transgenic genetic transformation Arabidopsis thaliana is used for carrying out gene function verification, compared with wild Arabidopsis thaliana WT, the transgene TaPHT & lt 1 & gt is found, the 36 & lt gene & gt can improve the low phosphorus resistance, and theoretical basis and gene resources are provided for cultivating low phosphorus resistant wheat.

title_en: High-protein shrimp puffed crisp chips and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a high-protein shrimp puffed crisp chip and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the high-protein minced fillet is prepared by taking shrimp and tapioca starch as core raw materials and soybean oil, purified water, salt and sugar as auxiliary materials, thawing shrimp meat, rinsing and dewatering, chopping, mixing raw materials and auxiliary materials, and baking and molding in an oven. The invention has simple process flow, convenient production operation and quality control, good product uniformity and suitability for industrial production. The prepared shrimp cracker has hardness of 200-600g, brittleness value of 0.250-0.550mm and protein content as high as 14-16%. The invention not only meets the requirements of consumers on crisp leisure food, but also efficiently utilizes protein resources of shrimps, and has important significance for promoting comprehensive development and utilization of shrimp resources.

title_en: Composition comprising urolithin compound
abstract_en: The present invention provides compositions comprising a protein source and urolithin. The invention also provides uses and methods relating to or utilizing the compositions, such as medicaments, dietary supplements, functional or medical foods, for treating and/or preventing muscle-related pathological conditions. The invention also provides a kit comprising urolithin and a protein.

title_en: Preparation method of frozen animal and plant mixed whipped cream with high freeze-thawing stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of frozen animal and plant mixed whipped cream with high freeze-thawing stability, belonging to the technical field of food development. The invention firstly uses ultrasonic to treat protein and colloid to prepare colloid-protein compound, the colloid-protein compound is added into a cream system, and the cream can strengthen the resistance to temperature change through the interaction between colloid and protein, so that the cream is fine and smooth in emulsion after repeated freeze thawing, the viscosity is not obvious in growth, the emulsion is stable, the inflation performance is good, the section is fine and smooth, the inflation system is stable, and good quality is still maintained.

title_en: Plant amyloid protein fiber and preparation method thereof, composite film and composite film preservative
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant amyloid protein fiber and a preparation method thereof, a composite film and a composite film preservative, and belongs to the technical field of protein fibers. According to the method, plant protein isolate is mixed with water, the pH value is adjusted to 1.5-2.5, then solid-liquid separation is carried out, the obtained plant protein-containing liquid material is subjected to fiber growth treatment, and plant amyloid protein fibers are obtained, according to a growth dynamics curve of the plant amyloid protein fibers, the fiber growth treatment comprises a first incubation treatment, an ultrasonic treatment and a second incubation treatment which are sequentially carried out, the time of the first incubation treatment is 0 h-the end of a logarithmic growth phase, the first incubation treatment and the second incubation treatment are carried out under a non-ultrasonic condition, and when the time of the first incubation treatment is 0h, the ultrasonic power density of the ultrasonic treatment is more than or equal to 2.5W/mL. The method is convenient for regulating and controlling the growth process and morphology of the fiber at the same time, and can reduce the duty ratio of the rigid fiber.

title_en: Sonola desert bacillus for high yield of 4-ethyl guaiacol and separation culture method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Sonola desert bacillus with high yield of 4-ethyl guaiacol, and a separation culture method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention separates and screens out a strain of Sonola desert bacillus LZLJ-9 from high temperature Daqu, the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M2025365, the invention has the advantages of easy culture, high temperature resistance, adaptability to the brewing environment of white spirit, and the like, can utilize a wheat solid culture medium to produce 4-ethyl guaiacol with high yield, the fermentation temperature is gradually increased from 37 ℃ to 63 ℃, can adapt to the temperature change of a high temperature starter making process, and in the white spirit brewing process, the content of 4-ethyl guaiacol can be increased to 3.956 mug/g, which is far higher than the existing level, thereby providing high-quality strain resources for the biosynthesis of 4-ethyl guaiacol in white spirit, and having important significance for the high temperature process white spirit brewing.

title_en: Sugar liquid energy-saving concentration equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sugar liquid energy-saving concentration device and a method, wherein the sugar liquid energy-saving concentration device comprises a concentrator provided with a liquid discharge pipe and a steam outlet, a liquid conveying pipe and a steam pipe are vertically arranged in the concentrator, a first rotary joint is arranged at the tops of the steam pipe and the liquid conveying pipe, a second rotary joint is arranged at the bottom of the steam pipe, a plurality of rotary disks are arranged outside the liquid conveying pipe, the rotary disks are of cavity structures, are sleeved outside the steam pipe and fixedly and hermetically connected with the steam pipe, a gas conveying pipe is arranged in the rotary disks, passes through the liquid conveying pipe and is communicated with the steam pipe, a liquid discharge port for discharging liquid to the surface of the rotary disks is arranged on the liquid conveying pipe, and a motor is arranged on the concentrator and is used for driving the liquid conveying pipe and the steam pipe to synchronously rotate. According to the invention, the vapor compressor is used for recompression of secondary vapor generated by evaporation of the large rotary liquid film in the concentrator, and then part of the secondary vapor is used for heating the feed liquid in the preheater, and the other part of the secondary vapor is used for supplementing heat in the concentrator.

title_en: Preparation process of black-skin red yeast wine and automatic steaming system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of black-skin red yeast wine and an automatic steaming system, comprising the following steps of pretreatment of main materials in step S1, pretreatment of auxiliary materials in step S2, harrowing in step S3, fermentation in step S4, squeezing in step S5, filtration in step S6 and sterilization and filling in step S7; the invention relates to the technical field of brewing technology and equipment, in particular to a manufacturing technology and an automatic steaming system of black-skin red yeast wine, wherein the steaming system is designed and modified through modularized equipment and automatic control, so that the steaming and fermentation technology of the black-skin red yeast wine are optimized, and the homogenization steaming and stable fermentation are realized through the cooperation of a split steaming shell, a stirring component and a high-pressure steam boiler; the energy consumption is reduced through the steam circulation and high-temperature short-time process, the utilization rate of raw materials is improved, and the retention rate of functional components is improved through the auxiliary material enzymolysis and staged fermentation technology, so that the modern healthy consumption requirements are met.

title_en: Biodegradable composite controlled atmosphere preservation method for fruits and vegetables
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biodegradable composite modified atmosphere preservation method for fruits and vegetables, which comprises the steps of sequentially wrapping a film B and a film A on fruits and vegetables from inside to outside, and forming a sealing interlayer between the film B and the film A; the film B is positioned on the inner layer and is directly contacted with fruits and vegetables, so that the film B can penetrate moisture and block oxygen, the film A is positioned on the outer layer and has barrier property to moisture, and the sealing interlayer is used for controlling a humidity environment. The invention adopts the double-layer composite structure to optimize the controlled atmosphere fresh-keeping method of fruits and vegetables, the inner layer film B directly contacts fruits and vegetables, has the functions of penetrating moisture and blocking oxygen, ensures the internal atmosphere to be stable, and the outer layer film A plays the role of blocking moisture. The design of the sealing interlayer between the two layers combines the moisturizing antibacterial solution, can accurately regulate and control the humidity in the wrapping environment, and prevents the quality of fruits and vegetables from being reduced due to excessive or insufficient water.

title_en: DpCYP707A2 gene for regulating and controlling synthesis of dioscin and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to DpCYP A707A 2 gene for regulating and controlling synthesis of dioscin and application thereof. The nucleotide sequence of DpCYP A2 gene is shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. According to the result of the embodiment of the application, the yam DpCYP A2 gene provided by the application can regulate and control the synthesis of dioscin, and the DpCYP A2 gene plays an important role in influencing the synthesis of plant dioscin, can help to select and select a new yam variety with increased dioscin content, and has a wide application value.

title_en: Application of OsSAK gene in regulation and control of salt stress tolerance of crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural biology, in particular to application of OsSAK gene in regulating and controlling salt stress resistance of crops. The OsSAK gene provided by the invention has a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention discovers that the transcription level of OsSAK gene of crops can be reduced in a salt stress environment, compared with a common plant, the OsSAK gene mutant plant has higher survival rate and better growth vigor in the salt stress environment, and the OsSAK gene over-expressed plant is easier to die in the salt stress environment, so that the OsSAK gene is verified to be used as a negative regulator for regulating and controlling the salt stress of crops, and a key molecular tool is provided for developing new varieties of crops with the salt stress tolerance, and the gene has wide application potential and market value in the agricultural planting field, especially in the aspects of improving the salt stress tolerance of crops and cultivating salt stress tolerance transgenic crops.

title_en: Application of soybean GmSRO gene in promoting root nodule production of leguminous plants
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to application of soybean GmSRO gene in promoting root nodule production of leguminous plants. According to the invention, the pZP211 over-expression vector is utilized, the transgenic plant is rapidly obtained through agrobacterium-mediated soybean genetic transformation, gmSRO is successfully over-expressed, the number of root nodules of the chimeric transgenic plant is counted, and the result shows that the GmSRO gene can positively regulate the number of soybean root nodules and has an obvious effect. The invention provides that the SRO5 can positively regulate and control the soybean nodulation process for the first time, and proves that the soybean GmSRO gene over-expression can obviously increase the number of soybean nodulation, can be applied to soybean production and molecular breeding by means of transgenosis, molecular markers and the like in the future, and has very important application value.

title_en: Medicated diet jasmine soft Europe and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of functional food processing, and discloses a medicated jasmine soft Europe and a preparation process thereof, wherein the jasmine soft Europe consists of dough and stuffing, and the dough comprises the following materials in parts by weight: 245-250 parts of high gluten flour; 40-50 parts of Chinese yam; 3-3.5 parts of dry yeast; 28-30 parts of fine granulated sugar; 2-3 parts of salt; 100-105 parts of milk; 18-20 parts of butter; 45-50 parts of jasmine tea soup; the stuffing material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 500-505 parts of milk; 95-100 parts of cream cheese; 13-15 parts of jasmine tea powder; 180-200 parts of Kashida powder; 5-8 parts of radix trichosanthis; 10-15 parts of snow pear; lotus seeds 20 to 30 parts, during the preparation, firstly softening butter at room temperature, steaming and mashing Chinese yam, soaking jasmine tea into tea soup according to a ratio of 1:2 for later use, then mixing with other materials to prepare dough, refrigerating, adding butter and salt, kneading to a film, performing first fermentation, uniformly mixing stuffing materials, refrigerating and shaping, exhausting, cutting and loosening the dough after fermentation, rolling out stuffing and shaping, performing second fermentation, and baking until the surface of the dough is golden, thus obtaining the soft Europe of the medicated diet jasmine.

title_en: Buckwheat flour, high-toughness buckwheat noodles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to buckwheat flour, high-toughness buckwheat noodles and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. The buckwheat flour comprises buckwheat flour consisting of sweet buckwheat flour and tartary buckwheat flour, high gluten wheat flour and wheat gluten, and can be used for preparing high-toughness buckwheat noodles. The high-toughness buckwheat noodles provided by the invention solve the problems of low toughness and poor taste caused by high content of buckwheat flour, balance the flavor and taste of the buckwheat noodles while keeping the high content of the buckwheat flour, and increase the toughness of the noodles. The buckwheat noodles prepared from the buckwheat flour are free from any additives and edible salt, and have the advantages of smooth mouthfeel, high toughness, high stretchability and boiling resistance without breaking on the premise of keeping the original quality of the buckwheat flour.

title_en: Automatic processing device for Wo-orange slices
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of processing of citrus chips, in particular to an automated processing device for citrus chips, which comprises a device bottom plate and a protective top plate, wherein an automatic processing assembly is arranged on the device bottom plate, a multifunctional driving assembly is arranged on the protective top plate, the automatic processing assembly comprises a first processing cylinder, a second processing cylinder and a third processing cylinder, the first processing cylinder and the second processing cylinder are both rotationally connected with a supporting plate through bearings, a first positioning rod and a supporting rod are fixedly welded on the supporting plate, a guide cylinder is fixedly welded on the supporting rod, a screw rod is rotationally connected on the supporting plate, a second positioning rod and a driven shaft are rotationally connected on the inner bottom end surface of the third processing cylinder, and the problems that the existing processing device is single in functionality, most of equipment can only complete a certain link in the processes of color protection processing, sugar stain processing, drying processing and the like, and the integrated integration of multiple processes is difficult to realize, and the degree of automation is low are solved.

title_en: Vitamin premix and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vitamin premix and a preparation process thereof, belonging to the technical field of food additives, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps: adding the fat-soluble vitamin mixed particles, the mixed water-soluble vitamins and the mixed minerals into a mixer for mixing, then adding vitamin C, magnesium taurate, amino acid and tricalcium phosphate for continuous mixing, and sieving to obtain the vitamin-calcium phosphate. The raw materials of the fat-soluble vitamin mixed particles comprise vitamin A, vitamin E acetate, vitamin D3, vitamin K2, acacia, modified protein and beta-cyclodextrin, the raw materials of the mixed water-soluble vitamin comprise vitamin B1, vitamin B2, vitamin B5, vitamin B12, folic acid and nicotinamide, and the raw materials of the mixed mineral substances comprise ferrous glycinate, calcium citrate, magnesium citrate and zinc glycinate. The vitamin premix prepared by the invention can be used as a nutritional supplement in various foods, is convenient to use, and has good stability and mixing uniformity.

title_en: Macromolecular dried longan pulp heteropolysaccharide with blood sugar reducing characteristic, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of extracts, in particular to macromolecular dry longan pulp heteropolysaccharide with blood sugar reducing property, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises oven drying arillus longan, homogenizing the dried arillus longan, adding distilled water, leaching with hot water, filtering with gauze, and separating dry arillus longan heteropolysaccharide with molecular weight greater than 100kDa from the dried arillus longan by combining dialysis and ultrafiltration interception. The invention adopts a hot water extraction method to extract the polysaccharide of the dried longan pulp, adopts an ultrafiltration interception system device to separate the polysaccharide of the dried longan pulp, and the main component of the polysaccharide is DLP, and the polysaccharide can inhibit starch digestive enzyme, improve model cell insulin resistance and change human intestinal flora composition. Has effects in reducing blood sugar and regulating intestinal flora.

title_en: Preparation method of glycosylated gelatin and application of glycosylated gelatin in microcapsules
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of glycosylated gelatin and application of glycosylated gelatin in microcapsules. Under the action of a photocatalyst 9-methyl-10-phenylacridine-10-ammonium chloride, catalyzing sugar and gelatin to carry out glycosylation reaction, washing and drying to obtain glycosylation modified gelatin. The method realizes the preparation of glycosylation modified gelatin through photocatalysis, and the glycosylation modified gelatin is applied to vitamin A microcapsules without adding an emulsifier, and stable O/W type emulsion can be prepared by adopting common stirring, so that the traditional emulsification process is simplified, the particle size of the prepared emulsion reaches 0.3-1.0 mu m, the oil carrying rate is more than 45%, and the embedding rate of a dried product is more than or equal to 99%.

title_en: Red date, hawthorn and chickpea soft sweet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soft sweets, in particular to a red date, hawthorn and chickpea soft sweets and a preparation method thereof. The soft candy is prepared by the method. The method comprises the steps of preparing composite syrup, pre-dissolved gelatin, red date pulp and hawthorn pulp respectively, mixing the red date pulp, the hawthorn pulp and the chickpea powder uniformly, adding the mixture into the composite syrup, stirring the mixture uniformly to obtain a mixed system, cooling the mixed system to below 65 ℃, adding the pre-dissolved gelatin into the mixed system, stirring the mixture until the pre-dissolved gelatin is completely dissolved to obtain a prefabricated product, sterilizing the prefabricated product, and sequentially carrying out reverse molding, cooling, airing, demolding and packaging to obtain the red date hawthorn chickpea soft sweets. The invention can prepare soft sweet products with relatively low sugar content, less additives and rich nutrition, and solves the problems of high sugar, high additives and single nutrition of the traditional soft sweet.

title_en: Lucid ganoderma health-care flour composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of health product technology and provides a Ganoderma lucidum health flour composition and its preparation method. Ganoderma lucidum and flour are used as the main raw materials, and Ganoderma lucidum is further processed, supplemented with leavening agents, sweeteners, oils and other raw materials mixed with water to prepare different types of food. The present invention not only fully preserves the rich nutritional components in Ganoderma lucidum raw materials, but also makes them easier to obtain, which is conducive to storage and deep processing, and adapts to industrial production. In addition, by further processing Ganoderma lucidum health flour composition as raw materials into various types and flavors of food, the consumption and consumption of Ganoderma lucidum are increased, and its health benefits are fully exerted.

title_en: Self-healing hydrogel for food and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a food self-healing hydrogel and a preparation method and application thereof. The self-healing hydrogel of the food has excellent mechanical property matching performance with biological tissues, self-healing characteristics, stability under physiological environment and other dynamic functional mechanical properties. All materials used in the invention are food grade, and the self-healing hydrogel of the food can obviously relieve intestinal inflammation, and provides a novel method for non-pharmaceutical food intervention for relieving intestinal inflammation and other diseases. In addition, the method for preparing the self-healing hydrogel for food has mild preparation conditions, simple operation and no need of using various complex instruments.

title_en: Automatic steamer discharging device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of white spirit brewing equipment, in particular to an automatic steamer discharging device which comprises a frame, a steamer pot, a heating mechanism, a movable frame, a bottom pot and a receiving device, wherein the steamer pot comprises a pot cover and a pot body fixedly arranged on the frame, a net-shaped discharging door is arranged at the lower end of the pot body, the heating mechanism comprises a heating pipe group arranged below the pot body, the heating pipe group extends upwards to form a connecting pipe, the connecting pipe rotates to avoid a discharging area below the net-shaped discharging door, the movable frame is connected onto a guide rail fixedly connected with the frame in a sliding manner, the moving track of the movable frame passes through the position right below the pot body, the bottom pot is arranged on the movable frame in a lifting manner, and when the bottom pot is in butt joint with the bottom of the pot body, the heating pipe group is positioned in liquid in the bottom pot, and the receiving device moves to the discharging area below the net-shaped discharging door and receives a material tank falling from the pot body. The automatic steamer discharging device keeps the pot body fixed, only needs to remove the bottom pot after descending, and turns away the heating tube group, so that the automatic steamer discharging device is time-saving and labor-saving and has high efficiency.

title_en: Wide pressure cooker
abstract_en: An apparatus configured to perform pressure cooking includes a housing including a rim, a lid coupled to the housing, the lid configured to engage the rim to form an airtight seal that enables pressure cooking within the housing, and a cooking vessel defining a chamber in which food to be cooked is placed. The maximum inner diameter of the cooking vessel is at least 1.5 times the maximum vessel depth of the cooking vessel. Additionally or alternatively, at least a portion of the power circuit controlling the heating element and/or at least a portion of the power circuit housing containing the power circuit is above the bottom of the cooking vessel.

title_en: Functional protein peptide product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a functional protein peptide product and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of protein peptides. The method comprises the steps of S1, carrying out enzymolysis on loaches and Prinsepia utilis Royle, precipitating a protein composition, S2, carrying out fermentation on selenium-enriched saccharomycetes of filter residues, precipitating to obtain selenium-enriched protein, S3, carrying out enzymolysis on saccharomycete mud to obtain an enzymolysis product, S4, separating and purifying the enzymolysis product to obtain 2-10kDa antibacterial peptide, S5, chelating the antibacterial peptide with Zn/Cu ions, S6, preparing malic acid/salicylic acid condensation chelating Zn/Cu antibacterial peptide, S7, uniformly mixing the malic acid/salicylic acid condensation chelating Zn/Cu antibacterial peptide, the protein composition and the selenium-enriched protein to obtain a functional protein peptide product, promoting the growth and development of livestock, promoting lactation, improving the nutritive value of meat quality, inhibiting tumors, resisting aging, resisting oxidization, resisting inflammation and resisting bacterial activity, reducing pathogenic factors, and simultaneously having a strong inhibition effect on intestinal tract pathogenic bacteria.

title_en: Extraction process of non-denatured type II collagen for relieving osteoarthritis, and product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extraction process of non-denatured type II collagen for relieving osteoarthritis, and a product and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of non-denatured type II collagen extraction, wherein the extraction process comprises the following steps of (1) pretreatment to obtain cartilage particles; the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) enzyme activation, namely mixing medlar, dwarf lilyturf tuber, chicory and honeysuckle, adding water for extraction to obtain an extracting solution, adding pepsin for uniform mixing to obtain an activated enzyme, (3) enzymolysis, namely adding the activated enzyme into cartilage particles for enzymolysis to obtain a precipitate, and (4) post-treatment, namely drying and crushing the precipitate. The extraction process is simple, the production efficiency is high, the enzyme dosage is small, the cost is low, the environment is protected, the requirement of large-scale production is met, and the prepared non-denatured type II collagen has good improvement and treatment effects on osteoporosis and osteoarthritis.

title_en: Aspartic proteinase heat-resistant mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aspartic proteinase heat-resistant mutant and application thereof. Wherein the aspartic protease heat-resistant mutant comprises (a) a protein which has aspartic protease activity and heat resistance higher than that of the wild-type aspartic protease pap1 through amino acid mutation at least one site selected from the group consisting of G133, D159, S376, T198, T103, T144, L303 and A387 based on the wild-type aspartic protease pap1 shown in SEQ ID NO:1, or (b) a protein which has homology of 80% or more with the amino acid sequence defined in (a), has aspartic protease activity and heat resistance higher than that of the wild-type aspartic protease pap 1. Can solve the problem of poor heat resistance of aspartic proteinase in the prior art, and is suitable for the field of enzyme catalysis.

title_en: Salix psammophila SpsRLCK upstream regulatory factor SpsZFP coding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salix psammophila SpsRLCK upstream regulatory factor SpsZFP6 coding protein and application thereof, and successfully identifies an upstream regulatory factor SpsZFP of a SpsRLCK promoter through a yeast single hybridization library screening experiment, and under drought stress conditions, transgenic arabidopsis with the transgenic SpsZFP6 shows obviously enhanced stress resistance. The method is characterized in that the root length, fresh weight and plant height of the transgenic plant under drought treatment are all superior to those of wild plants, the integrity of cell membranes is good, the activity of antioxidant enzyme is obviously improved, and the accumulation of ROS is reduced. This shows that SpsZFP can specifically improve the stress resistance of plants under drought conditions, and provides important theoretical basis and practical basis for molecular breeding of woods. The invention is not only beneficial to cultivating new transgenic varieties with drought tolerance, but also provides a new direction for further researching plant stress resistance mechanism.

title_en: Hainan tiger ganoderma lucidum strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Hainan tiger ganoderma lucidum strain and application thereof. The strain is separated from tropical rain forest of Wuzhishan in Hainan province, is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of M2025951 and the preservation date of 2025, 4 and 30 days. The strain has the characteristics of high polysaccharide content, strong antioxidant capacity, strong antibacterial capacity and the like, can be applied to the fields of medicines, health products, foods and the like, and has good application prospect and economic value.

title_en: Preparation method and application of fat substitute with shear responsiveness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a fat substitute with shear response, belonging to the technical field of food industry, mixing and heating the oil gel, the oil phase and the additive, magnetically stirring to form a uniform dispersion, and cooling in a room temperature environment to obtain the oil gel type fat substitute. According to the invention, through specific formula design and accurate process control, a weak gel network with controllable rheological property is constructed by utilizing the synergistic effect of the selected oil phase, the oil gel based on hydrogen bond action and the lubrication enhancement additive, and the weak gel network can be rapidly and controllably broken under the shearing action of simulated oral chewing, and the oil drops are accurately released, so that a stable lubricating oil film is formed on the surface of an oral cavity, and the lubrication perception of grease is remarkably improved.

title_en: Health beverage for treating pharyngolaryngitis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health-care beverage special for treating sphagitis, which comprises dark plum, seville orange flower, chicken's gizzard-skin, kelp, grosvener siraitia, platycodon root and water. The beverage is prepared from natural plant materials, has multiple effects of clearing heat and detoxicating, relieving sore throat and detumescence, relieving cough and eliminating phlegm, has no toxic side effect, and is safe and reliable. The preparation process is simple and convenient, is easy to operate, and is suitable for large-scale production and daily drinking.

title_en: Application of kynurenic acid in product for preventing and treating vomit toxin toxicity
abstract_en: The invention discloses kynurenic acid with an effect of relieving vomit toxin toxicity, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural animals. The invention proves that the kynurenic acid can effectively relieve toxic effects induced by vomit toxin, and is mainly characterized by effectively promoting animal weight growth, improving intestinal motility function, inhibiting inflammatory factor release, regulating intestinal flora and the like. The invention determines the effect of kynurenic acid in relieving vomitoxin toxicity, and has wide application prospect in preparing products for preventing and treating vomitoxin toxicity.

title_en: Method for preparing 1-linoleoyl lysophosphatidylcholine by using ganoderma lucidum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing 1-linoleoyl lysophosphatidylcholine by using ganoderma lucidum, which takes ganoderma lucidum as a material, has wide raw material sources, simple preparation method and easy realization of industrial production, provides a new way for developing the 1-linoleoyl lysophosphatidylcholine, and also provides scientific guidance for developing ganoderma lucidum functional health-care food.

title_en: Composite lignin degrading fungi, fermentation culture method, application and straw feed
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lignin degradation, and discloses a composite lignin degrading fungus, a fermentation culture method, application and straw feed, wherein the composite lignin degrading fungus, a white bag harrow tooth bacterium and a color-changing trametes are in a weight ratio of 1-2:1-2. The invention provides a composite lignin degrading fungus, which adopts a composite strain formed by harrow tooth bacteria and trametes versicolor, and can produce the function of synergistically improving lignin degrading capability when the two bacteria are compounded.

title_en: Frozen rice starch-based food based on ultrasonic-assisted hydrothermal modification and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses frozen rice starch-based food based on ultrasonic-assisted hydrothermal modification and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the modified starch with better ageing resistance is added into the rice starch by carrying out ultrasonic binding hydrothermal double modification on the rice starch, so that the modified starch can be used for preparing rice starch-based frozen food with high moisture content. The prepared mixed starch system has better ageing resistance, thermal stability and digestion resistance, the disintegration value and retrogradation value are gradually reduced along with the increase of modified starch, and the disintegration value and retrogradation value are respectively reduced by 64.79 percent and 33.93 percent compared with a pure rice starch system. Meanwhile, the hardness, elasticity, adhesiveness and chewiness of the high-moisture mixed starch gel prepared by the invention are all improved compared with those of the rice starch gel. The gel hardness of the frozen and stored mixed starch is gradually reduced along with the addition of the modified starch, and the elasticity is gradually enhanced, which proves that the modified starch can well reduce the damage of ice crystals and aging to a starch gel network in the frozen and stored process.

title_en: Vitamin A microcapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vitamin A microcapsule production, in particular to a vitamin A microcapsule and a preparation method thereof. It is found that controlling the size of the relation 0.88 Xln (Q) +0.12 Xe (-0.002 mu) × (N/1000)/(0.18-0.05 XTe-120|+0.1× (epsilon/2.4)/(0.5) can be used to control the rounding degree of vitamin A microcapsules prepared by the emulsion through the spray drying process, and the above relation calculated by the parameters of the spray drying process and controlled to be above 50% can obtain vitamin A microcapsules with rounding degree of above 50%, thereby remarkably improving the rounding degree of vitamin A microcapsules, further improving the premature release of the microcapsules in gastric juice, improving the targeting of intestinal tracts, improving the degradation condition of the microcapsules during the storage period and improving the stability of the microcapsules.

title_en: Prefabricated vegetable production pickling processing device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a prefabricated vegetable production pickling processing device and method, which relate to the field of prefabricated vegetable processing and comprise a plurality of evenly arranged storage frames, wherein a plurality of partition boards are fixed on each storage frame, a plurality of static pickling basins are placed on each partition board, a rack is arranged beside each storage frame, a support frame is fixed on the upper surface of the rack, a connecting frame is connected onto the support frame in a sliding manner, the connecting frame is fixed with the storage frames through connecting rods, a connecting frame for controlling an integrated structure, a connecting rod and a control component for controlling the movement of the storage frames are arranged on the support frame.

title_en: Application of soybean isoflavone synthetic gene GmCHI a in improving resistance of plants to phytophthora sojae
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, in particular to application of a soybean isoflavone synthetic gene GmCHI a in improving resistance of plants to phytophthora sojae. The soybean isoflavone synthesis gene GmCHI a has CDS sequence shown in sequence table SEQ ID NO.2, and the application includes constructing plant expression vector with the gene GmCHI a and transferring into target plant to make the gene GmCHI a over-express in the plant. The plant expression vector is transformed and then carries RUBY visual screening markers. The method has the advantages that GmCHI a over-expression can obviously improve the isoflavone content in hairy roots and strengthen the defense effect on the phytophthora sojae, and can be applied to the wide resistance of different physiological races of the phytophthora sojae.

title_en: Preparation method of Aronia melanocarpa soothing fruit juice
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a liriodendron melanocarpa soothing fruit juice, and belongs to the field of food processing. According to the invention, an edible gelatin aqueous solution with a freezing force value of 120-250 bloom g is added into the Aronia melanocarpa fruit juice to obtain a mixed solution, the pH value of the mixed solution is regulated to 2-5, the mixed solution is subjected to water bath reaction, and after rapid cooling, standing, filtering, sterilizing and canning are carried out to obtain the Aronia melanocarpa fruit soothing juice. The method realizes the specific precipitation of condensed tannin by accurately regulating and controlling the molecular conformation and the reaction pH of gelatin, reduces the content of condensed tannin in the Aronia melanocarpa fruit juice, effectively relieves the adverse symptoms such as diarrhea and increased exhaust gas quantity caused by the condensed tannin, does not destroy bioactive substances anthocyanin in the Aronia melanocarpa fruit juice, retains the nutritional value of the anthocyanin, has simple raw material composition and is convenient and feasible in process.

title_en: Pea peptide with muscle repair and growth promoting functions as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pea peptide with the function of promoting muscle repair and growth and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of vegetable protein processing and providing a preparation method of pea peptide with the function of promoting muscle repair and growth, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing pea protein powder with water, and soaking to obtain pea protein solution; adding alkaline protease, performing first hydrolysis to obtain a first hydrolysate, adding neutral protease, performing second hydrolysis to obtain a second hydrolysate, adding compound protease, performing third hydrolysis to obtain a third hydrolysate, filtering the third hydrolysate by using an ultrafiltration membrane to obtain an ultrafiltration component, concentrating in vacuum to 1/8 or 1/10 of the original volume, and drying to obtain pea peptide. The pea peptide obtained by the preparation method provided by the invention has high purity and small molecular weight, and has excellent performance in the aspects of promoting muscle repair and growth and the like due to high activity.

title_en: Rape glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta-291 mutant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genetic engineering, in particular to a rape glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta-291 mutant and application thereof. The invention respectively over-expresses and edits Bnbgr  T291I  in the cabbage type rape at fixed points, obtains the transgenic plant with dwarf, obviously reduced branching angle and obviously increased pod density, provides important theoretical basis and precious germplasm resource for the improvement of the cabbage type rape plant type, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Separation and transformation method of populus alba leaf protoplast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separation and transformation method of populus alba leaf protoplast, which belongs to the technical field of biology, and comprises the following steps of 1, taking populus alba leaf protoplast tissue culture seedlings growing for 5-8 weeks, cutting out leaves, placing the leaves in sterile double distilled water for standby, cutting off leaf tips, veins and edge parts of the leaves to obtain leaf epidermis strips, 2, placing the leaf epidermis strips obtained in the step 1 in enzyme liquid, digesting, turning up and down, vibrating, 3, filtering, collecting protoplast solution, and 4, centrifuging for 100g and 5min at 4 ℃. The invention discloses a separation and transformation method for the protoplast of the silver poplar leaf through a gradient experiment, so that biochemical and molecular biological researches such as subcellular localization, transient gene expression and the like can be efficiently carried out.

title_en: Preparation method of microbial agent for producing urease inhibitor, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a microbial agent for producing a urease inhibitor, a product and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of inoculating strain seed liquid into a liquid culture medium in a fermentation tank for fermentation culture, collecting thalli and drying, wherein during the fermentation culture, the fermentation temperature is controlled to be 36 ℃ in the early stage of fermentation, the fermentation temperature is reduced to be 34 ℃ after fermentation enters a logarithmic growth phase, the fermentation temperature is controlled to be 36-38 ℃ to be completed after fermentation enters a stationary phase, and the whole fermentation time is shortened to about 32 hours, so that the energy consumption is reduced, and meanwhile, the production efficiency, the biomass and the spore rate are also remarkably improved. The invention also provides a microbial agent containing the protective agent and used for producing the urease inhibitor, which comprises 0.2% of egg albumen powder, 0.46% of dibutyl hydroxy toluene and 0.54% of mannitol, and the balance of the microbial agent, wherein the spore survival rate of the microbial agent is 98.1% and is obviously higher than that of the existing microbial agent containing the protective agent.

title_en: Meal replacement stick for evaluating human body absorptivity, method and experimental design
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meal replacement bar for human body absorptivity evaluation, which is prepared by mixing selected edible dye with one or more component raw materials in the meal replacement bar, uniformly stirring to enable the dye to be uniformly adhered to the surface of the raw materials, stirring at a speed of 30-50 rpm for 10-15 minutes, drying the dyed raw materials in an oven at a temperature of 40-50 ℃ until the preset moisture content is ensured, fixing the dye on the surface of the raw materials, proportionally adding the dyed and dried raw materials and other undyed component raw materials into a mixer, setting the rotating speed of the mixer at 20-30 rpm, mixing for 20-30 minutes to enable the raw materials to be fully and uniformly mixed, preparing the mixed raw materials into the meal replacement bar shape by an extrusion forming machine, controlling the extrusion temperature at 50-60 ℃ and forming pressure at 10-20 megapascals, and enabling the meal replacement bar to be uniform and solid in texture.

title_en: Method for producing beverage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for producing non-fermented beverage by using beer grains (BSG), thereby improving the efficiency of beer production resources. The method comprises obtaining (203) BSG from a beer production process, mixing (204) the BSG with water into a slurry, treating (205) the slurry to produce a precursor liquid, and storing (206) the precursor liquid during a storage period, which is subsequently used as a base for producing a non-fermented beverage, wherein the storage period exceeds 2 hours. The method is easily integrated with existing beer production. The dependency between non-fermented beverage production and beer production is reduced, e.g. allowing beer and non-fermented beverage to be produced at different factories.

title_en: Multilayer sugar-coated food and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer sugar-coated food and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of food processing, wherein the multilayer sugar-coated food comprises a core body and a multilayer sugar coating, the core body is particles prepared by mixing fruit paste and fruit powder, an isolation layer, a sugar powder layer and a crispy layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside coat the core body to jointly form the multilayer sugar coating, and the mass ratio of the core body to the multilayer sugar coating is 1:0.50-0.90. The sugar coating disclosed by the invention is of a multilayer structure, the core body can be effectively coated, and the core body can be dried for many times during the coating period, so that the moisture in the core body can be effectively reduced, the core body component is prevented from being released outwards, and the sugar coating has higher brittleness due to lower moisture, and can be endowed with good crisp mouthfeel.

title_en: Preparation method of highland barley black vinegar polypeptide instant vinegar egg liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of highland barley black vinegar polypeptide instant vinegar egg liquid, and relates to the technical field of food processing. Comprises 26 parts of 9-degree highland barley black vinegar, 14 parts of fresh eggs, 4 parts of peanuts, 4 parts of black beans, 2 parts of black sesame seeds, 2 parts of walnut kernels, 1.6 parts of medlar, 1.2 parts of red dates, 3.2 parts of onions, 2 parts of garlic, 2 parts of ginger, 35.5 parts of 6-degree highland barley black vinegar, 2 parts of honey, 0.4 part of proteose and 0.1 part of 5 ten thousand units of acid proteinase are weighed according to the weight proportion, and disinfection and sterilization treatment are carried out. The invention is manufactured by utilizing various natural raw materials, integrates various vinegar soaking food materials into one, highland barley black vinegar provides rich beta glucan and vitamin B groups, various traditional vinegar soaking food materials provide rich anthocyanin, beta carotene, rutin, quercetin, garlicin and other polyphenol substances, the nutritional value of the product is enhanced, the fresh eggs are rich in high-quality proteins, and the fresh eggs are hydrolyzed into polypeptide structures after multi-stage vinegar soaking treatment, so that the biological activity and the absorption efficiency of the fresh eggs are enhanced.

title_en: Preparation method of kappa-carrageenan targeted controlled release 3D printing rice cake based on pH response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of kappa-carrageenan targeted controlled release 3D printing rice cake based on pH response. Through a coaxial 3D printing technology, brown rice powder-arrowhead powder compound is taken as a shell, kappa-carrageenan/corn starch gel is taken as an inner core to load plantain extract, and the intestinal targeting release of the plantain extract is realized by utilizing the characteristic that kappa-carrageenan contracts in an acidic (pH < 4) state and swells in an alkaline (pH > 7) state. In vitro digestion experiments show that the release rate of the rice cake in artificial gastric juice is less than 25%, and the release rate in artificial intestinal juice is more than 73%, so that the bioavailability is obviously improved compared with that of the traditional rice cake. Meanwhile, purple potato anthocyanin (0.1-0.5%) is added as a pH indicator, and the freshness of the product is monitored in real time through visible color change (red, purple and blue-green). The invention has the visual functions of low purine, intelligent release and freshness, and provides a novel functional staple food solution for high uric acid crowds.

title_en: Application of glucoraphanin in preparation of perfluorooctane sulfonate bioaccumulation product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of glucoraphanin in preparing a perfluorooctane sulfonate bioaccumulation product, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines.
