The invention confirms through epidemiological experiments of crowd that the occurrence probability of high PFOS level in the body of participants who frequently eat broccoli is obviously reduced, then confirms through clinical RCT random control experiments that the PFOS level in the body is obviously reduced, confirms through lipidomic analysis that the metabolic changes of steroid, ceramide and bile acid in serum which is interfered by the glucoraphanin are closely related to the reduction of the PFOS level, and finally confirms through animal experiments and AI reverse targeting technology that the glucoraphanin can effectively reduce accumulation in the body of PFOS, improve liver injury caused by PFOS, and the glucoraphanin and the in vivo metabolite glucoraphanin thereof have stronger binding capacity with liver specific PXR receptor, thus laying a good technical foundation for the research and development of medicines for treating diseases related to the accumulation of PFOS.

title_en: Yeast capable of being fermented rapidly and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to yeast capable of being fermented rapidly and application thereof. The invention utilizes two different yeasts to jointly ferment the Maojian tea to prepare the refined beer, the beer has good foamability, the alcohol content and the higher alcohol content are relatively high, so that the beer has good taste and flavor, meanwhile, the content of diacetyl is relatively low, and the content of tea polyphenol and tea polysaccharide is relatively high, so that the tea flavor of the Maojian beer is further highlighted, and the beer is more suitable for the taste of consumers.

title_en: Aesculin and mannitol eutectic crystal and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of eutectic, in particular to a aesculin and mannitol eutectic, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein an XRD spectrum of the eutectic at least has a characteristic diffraction peak at a position with a2 theta angle of 13.80°、17.41°、18.87°、19.99°、20.55°、21.46°、25.29°、27.15°、27.66°、28.30°、33.32°、34.13°、35.67°、36.33°、36.80°、44.06° and has an error margin of +/-0.2 ℃, and a DSC spectrum has characteristic endothermic peaks at 167.5 ℃ and 327 ℃ and has an error margin of +/-0.2 ℃. The preparation method comprises dissolving mannitol and aesculin in deionized water, heating and stirring, reacting at high temperature under high pressure, standing, crystallizing, filtering, and drying to obtain eutectic crystal which can be used in cosmetics, health products, foods and medicines. The eutectic crystal has the advantages of no irritation, high safety, easy absorption and good stability.

title_en: High-water-retention low-fat chicken sausage containing seaweed powder-soybean protein isolate-trehalose ternary system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-water-retention low-fat chicken sausage containing a seaweed powder-soybean protein isolate-trehalose ternary system, which comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 60 parts of chicken breast, 4 parts of pig ridge fat, 3 parts of soybean protein isolate, 2 parts of starch, 0.3-1.2 parts of seaweed powder, 2 parts of trehalose, 1.5 parts of salt, 0.3 part of sodium tripolyphosphate, 0.5 part of white pepper powder, 0.2 parts of sausage spice and 25.3-26.2 parts of ice water. The processing technology of the high-quality chicken sausage with the fat content less than or equal to 5% and the cooking loss rate less than or equal to 3% is realized through the synergistic effect of the ternary system of the algae powder, the soy protein isolate and the trehalose.

title_en: Application and method of CsRHY A gene in improving resistance of citrus yellow long disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application and a method of CsRHY A gene in improving resistance of citrus yellow long disease, belonging to the technical field of agricultural biological genetic engineering, wherein the application of CsRHY A gene in improving resistance of citrus yellow long disease is disclosed, and the nucleotide sequence of CsRHY A gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The method for improving the resistance of citrus yellow dragon disease by utilizing the CsRHY A gene comprises the following steps of S1 cloning the citrus CsRHY A gene, S2 constructing CsRHY A over-expression vectors pLGNe-CsRHY1A, S3 and S2 to obtain over-expression vectors pLGNe-CsRHY A for transforming citrus, and identifying to obtain transgenic plants with improved resistance of citrus yellow dragon disease. The invention provides a new choice for improving the resistance of the citrus to the yellow dragon disease, effectively improves the resistance of the citrus to the yellow dragon disease, and has great application value for breeding the citrus to the yellow dragon disease.

title_en: Preparation method of stable mixed nut sesame solid beverage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a stable mixed nut sesame solid beverage, which comprises the following steps of cleaning soybeans, soaking to obtain a first material, baking mixed nuts and black sesame in an oven to obtain a second material, mixing the first material and the second material in a specific proportion, finely grinding to obtain a primary mixed material, pumping the primary mixed material, maltose syrup and white granulated sugar material in a specific weight proportion into a soybean milk mixing tank, shearing at the speed of 1400r and min for 8-10min to obtain a secondary mixed material, sterilizing, cooling, homogenizing to obtain a tertiary mixed material, concentrating the tertiary mixed material sequentially through a first-effect evaporator, a second-effect evaporator and a third-effect evaporator, and spray drying and fluidized bed sieving, wherein the ratio of the first material to the second material in the fine grinding step is 1:1-2, so that the ratio of 7S protein to unsaturated fatty acid is greater than 1:2, and the shelf life of the solid beverage is prolonged.

title_en: NtTLP26 protein and application of coding gene thereof in drought resistance and tobacco mosaic virus resistance of tobacco
abstract_en: The invention discloses NtTLP protein and application of a coding gene thereof in drought resistance and tobacco mosaic virus resistance of tobacco. The NtTLP protein is A1) or A2) protein, wherein A1) protein consists of an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID No.2, and A2) protein which is derived from A1) by substitution and/or deletion and/or addition of one or more amino acid residues in the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID No.2 and related to drought resistance and tobacco mosaic virus resistance of tobacco. The coding gene has a nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The NtTLP protein has the main functions of negatively regulating and controlling the drought resistance of tobacco and positively regulating and controlling the tobacco mosaic disease resistance. The gene of the invention has high application value in inducing drought resistance and tobacco mosaic disease resistance of plants.

title_en: Staphylococcus meat color development strengthening method based on exogenous additive regulation and control and application thereof in pickling dried fish
abstract_en: The invention discloses a staphylococcus meat color development strengthening method based on exogenous additive regulation and application of staphylococcus meat color development strengthening method in pickling dried fish, which comprises the steps of mixing methemoglobin solution with broth, adding exogenous additive, constructing a simulation system, inoculating staphylococcus meat into the simulation system for culture, and observing color change of the simulation system, wherein the exogenous additive comprises one or more of L-arginine, tea polyphenol, ascorbic acid or tocopherol. According to the invention, one or more of L-arginine, tea polyphenol, ascorbic acid or tocopherol is used as an exogenous additive to carry out synergistic fermentation with staphylococcus meat, so that the redness value of the salted dried fish is remarkably improved.

title_en: Preservation method of grouper slices
abstract_en: The invention provides a preservation method of grouper slices, which comprises the steps of S1, preparing a preservative by taking aminodextran, casein phosphopeptide, L-glutamine, chitosan solution, pentosan, propylene glycol alginate, epsilon-polylysine, acerola cherry extract and water as raw materials, S2, cutting the grouper slices into slices with uniform thickness after being cleaned, fishing out the slices after being soaked by sterile ice water, draining, S3, immersing the grouper slices into the preservative, air-drying the slices after being soaked in the preservative, S4, wrapping the slices with a preservative film after air-drying, packaging and storing at a low temperature. The fresh-keeping method can enable the preservative to form a uniform and stable preservative film to be adhered to the surface of the fillet, can effectively slow down the water loss of the fillet during preservation, can prevent the entry of oxygen, slow down the degradation of protein of the fillet and the breeding of microorganisms, effectively maintain the texture characteristics of the fillet, effectively prolong the shelf life of the fillet and simultaneously ensure the quality of meat.

title_en: Coordinated type candy pouring molding equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a linkage type candy casting molding device, which relates to the technical field of candy production equipment and comprises a frame, a die conveying assembly, a casting assembly and a linkage assembly, the frame contains two parallel mounting plates, and mould conveying assembly locates between two mounting plates, drives the mould circulation through the drive shaft. The linkage assembly comprises a transmission shaft, a bevel gear pair, a linkage sheave, a linkage pin and a first sliding table, and the pouring assembly is arranged on the first sliding table. The driving shaft drives the transmission shaft to rotate through the bevel gear pair, the linkage grooved pulley rotates along with the transmission shaft, the circumferential side annular groove of the linkage grooved pulley is in sliding fit with the linkage pin, the circular motion is converted into the reciprocating linear motion of the first sliding table, and the pouring assembly and the die synchronously move to finish pouring. The application has the effects of realizing continuous operation of equipment, reducing abrasion and improving efficiency and stability.

title_en: Glutinous rice cake preparation equipment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steaming cabinets and discloses glutinous rice cake preparation equipment and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glutinous rice cake preparation equipment comprises a rice cake raw material steaming cabinet, wherein a plurality of groups of dough steaming tray mechanisms are longitudinally arranged in the rice cake raw material steaming cabinet, each dough steaming tray mechanism comprises a dough steaming tray body, a lifting plate is movably arranged in the dough steaming tray body, a plurality of swinging needle trays are arranged on the lifting plate in an array manner, and each swinging needle tray is rotationally connected with the lifting plate; the following turntables are distributed in an array mode, each following turntable is correspondingly arranged above the needle swinging disc, and the following turntables and the needle swinging disc are in concentric axial fit; two inflating needles are fixedly arranged on each group of swinging needle plate, when a dough steaming plate body containing dough is placed in a rice cake raw material steaming cabinet, the lifting plate drives the inflating needles to penetrate into the dough along with the turntable.

title_en: Simple and efficient film coating agent preparation process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simple and efficient preparation process of a coating agent, which is particularly suitable for the preparation process of a wax emulsion type coating agent with natural waxes as film forming substances. The process adopts a one-step emulsification method, fatty acid, natural wax, water and an emulsifying agent are heated and mixed in a closed reaction kettle, after the pH value is regulated by adding a neutralizing agent and the temperature is raised to the emulsification temperature, the pressure in a system is formed by further raising the temperature to 100-120 ℃, so that bubbles generated in the emulsification process are effectively reduced or eliminated, and then the stable emulsion product is obtained by cooling and filtering. Compared with the traditional two-step method or multi-kettle process, the process has the advantages of simple equipment, convenient operation, high emulsion stability and remarkable bubble control effect, and is suitable for large-scale continuous production. The obtained wax emulsion can be widely applied to the fields of fruit and vegetable fresh keeping, seed coating, biological medicine and the like, and has good economic and popularization values.

title_en: Codonopsis pilosula oligopeptide composition with blood replenishing and qi tonifying effects, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a codonopsis pilosula oligopeptide composition with blood replenishing and qi tonifying effects, and a preparation method and application thereof. The codonopsis pilosula oligopeptide composition comprises, by weight, 2-5 parts of codonopsis pilosula oligopeptide, 2-4 parts of blueberry extract, 2-3 parts of longan pulp extract, 2-3 parts of jujube extract, 2-3 parts of whey protein powder, 2-3 parts of soybean peptide powder, 2-3 parts of medlar extract, 1-2 parts of roselle powder, 0.2-0.5 part of flower gum oligopeptide and 0.5-1 part of compound nutrition enhancer. The codonopsis pilosula oligopeptide composition with the wheel blades in one embodiment of the application can improve the exhaustion swimming time of mice with qi deficiency constitution, increase spleen index, increase the number of blood cells in blood of the mice with blood deficiency, increase secretion of hematopoietic factors to promote hematopoietic function, improve organism immunity and further improve the symptoms of the qi deficiency with blood deficiency.

title_en: Automatic grabbing, dip-coating and discharging device for umbrella-shaped ice cream
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic grabbing, dip-coating and discharging device of umbrella-shaped ice cream, which comprises an ice cream conveying line, wherein the ice cream conveying line conveys umbrella-shaped ice cream which is filled with ice cream in two rows, a first grabbing conveying line and a second grabbing conveying line are respectively arranged on two sides of the ice cream conveying line, a first conveying component and a second conveying component which are in circulation operation are respectively arranged in the middle of the first grabbing conveying line and the second grabbing conveying line, the first grabbing conveying line and the second grabbing conveying line both comprise conveying chains and conveying plates paved on the conveying chains, one ends, far away from the ice cream conveying lines, of the first grabbing conveying line and the second grabbing conveying line are respectively provided with a discharging grabbing component, and at least one dip-coating groove is arranged below the first conveying component and the second conveying component so as to dip-coat the outer umbrella-shaped ice cream on the conveying plates passing through the dip-coating grooves. The invention can solve the problem that the existing production equipment can not meet the requirements of efficient production and personalized production of umbrella-shaped ice cream.

title_en: Vacuum freeze-drying equipment for fruit and vegetable drying
abstract_en: The invention discloses vacuum freeze-drying equipment for drying fruits and vegetables, which belongs to the technical field of freeze-drying of fruits and vegetables and comprises a box body, wherein the front end of the box body is rotationally connected with a box door, a plurality of fixed frames which are distributed at equal intervals are slidably arranged in the box body, and a supporting assembly, which comprises a plurality of supporting holes which are formed in a sliding plate at equal intervals, is used for bearing whole fruits and vegetables, and can limit the whole fruits and vegetables in the conveying process by adopting a tray with a notch so as to prevent the whole fruits and vegetables from moving in the tray, and a pushing seat in the freeze-drying equipment can make the fruits and vegetables in a fixed accommodating cavity separate from the shielding of the side wall of the tray in a mode that the pushing seat pushes up the fruits and vegetables upwards relative to the tray through the notch so as to make the fruits and vegetables fully contact with the air flow in the freeze-drying equipment; and after the freeze-drying is finished, the bottom plate resets, the pushing seat can retract back to the inside of the supporting hole again, and fruits and vegetables fall to the inside again and are fixed in the tray, so that the fruits and vegetables after the freeze-drying can be kept stable again when the fruits and vegetables are taken out.

title_en: Glabridin inclusion compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glabridin inclusion compound and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of medicines and cosmetics. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out water extraction treatment on liquorice to obtain liquorice slag and filtrate, S2, obtaining sediment A in the filtrate, extracting the liquorice slag to obtain an extract B containing glabridin, S3, respectively mixing the sediment A and the extract B with a solvent to obtain sediment A solution and extract B solution, mixing the sediment A solution and the extract B solution, and drying to obtain the glabridin clathrate. The invention adopts the liquorice to wrap the glabridin, the formed inclusion compound has excellent solubility and water dispersibility, no stimulation auxiliary materials such as solubilizer and the like are required to be added, the potential anaphylactic risk and the production cost of the product can be effectively reduced, and the application field of the product is widened.

title_en: White kidney bean preparation for controlling in-vivo fat and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plant extract technology, and discloses a white kidney bean preparation for controlling in-vivo fat and a preparation method thereof; the invention skillfully extracts the alpha-amylase inhibitor from the white kidney beans by combining microwave extraction and specific combination acid precipitation, and the extracted alpha-amylase inhibitor has high biological activity, high purity and great economic and health care value.

title_en: South medicine composite preparation for preventing and treating pig diarrhea and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine composition which comprises, by weight, 60-80 parts of pith, 4-11 parts of common sarcandra herb, 4-11 parts of Chinese knotweed herb, 4-11 parts of cortex rotundae, 2-8 parts of fructus gardeniae, 1-6 parts of radix sophorae flavescentis, 1-3 parts of poria cocos and 1-6 parts of pericarpium citri reticulatae. The traditional Chinese medicine composition takes the south medicine as a formula component, can replace antibiotics widely used in pig farming industry, realizes prevention and/or treatment of pig diarrhea, can improve pig performance of pigs, including daily gain and feed conversion rate of pigs, can improve natural resistance of pigs, reduces occurrence of diseases, and further reduces dependence of pigs on antibiotics.

title_en: Breeding method and cultivation method of five-color rice with one spike
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rice breeding, in particular to a breeding method and a cultivation method of one-ear five-color rice, wherein the breeding method of one-ear five-color rice comprises the steps of constructing a rice ear group containing five colors of black, brown, red, yellow and white seeds through hybridization breeding; the invention realizes the automatic separation and screening of the five-class color seeds by combining the artificial intelligent image recognition technology, has the remarkable advantages of objectivity, high efficiency, accuracy and the like, provides scientific decision basis for breeding experts, improves the breeding efficiency and accuracy of one-spike five-color rice, and accelerates the breeding process of good varieties of one-spike five-color rice.

title_en: Full-nutrition formula food for obesity and fat-reducing operation with special medical application and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a total nutrient formula food for obesity and fat-reducing surgery with special medical application and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of special medical foods, and the total nutrient formula food comprises the following raw materials of 30-45% of protein compound, 20-30% of mixed lipid, 25-35% of carbohydrate, 2-5% of vitamin, 2-5% of mineral, 2-4% of functionalized pea protein and 0.2-0.6% of low-ester citrus pectin; the formula food realizes the accurate proportioning of high protein, low sugar, moderate lipid, dietary fiber and key micronutrients on the premise of ensuring energy balance, thereby not only meeting the requirements of rapid recovery in the perioperative period, but also supporting long-term weight management and nutrition maintenance after operation.

title_en: Low-purine beer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of beer preparation, and particularly discloses low-purine beer and a preparation method thereof. A preparation method of low-purine beer comprises the steps of crushing malt, sieving, adding water, uniformly mixing, heating, saccharifying, filtering, washing grains to obtain first wort and the spent grains, boiling the first wort, adding hops before boiling, cooling, rotary precipitating, filtering to obtain second wort, adding beer yeast into the second wort, fermenting to obtain beer fermentation liquor, adding an adsorbent into the beer fermentation liquor, adsorbing, filtering, centrifuging, and sterilizing to obtain the low-purine beer, wherein the adsorbent comprises modified spent grains, and the raw materials of the modified spent grains comprise the spent grains, citric acid and zinc salt in the step S1. The low-purine beer has low-content purine value, is healthier, and has mellow mouthfeel, flavor and foam performance.

title_en: Bifidobacterium adolescentis for relieving estrogen-related metabolic disorder and obesity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bifidobacterium adolescentis strain for relieving estrogen-related metabolic disorder and obesity and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The screened bifidobacterium adolescentis CCFM1506 can effectively improve the estrogen disorder symptoms of an ovariectomized individual, obviously slow down the weight growth speed and the weight increment of the estrogen disorder individual, improve the CYP11A1 and ER alpha expression levels in serum estradiol and adrenal glands and the high-density lipoprotein content in serum, reduce the total cholesterol and glucose level, adjust the abnormal glycolipid metabolism, improve SCFA in colon contents, relieve climacteric syndrome caused by estrogen reduction, and can be used for preparing medicines for relieving or treating estrogen-related metabolic disorders and obesity or preparing health-care products which are beneficial to controlling internal fat and maintaining the blood fat health level, and the obvious physiological effect and wide application prospect provide new ideas and new basis for developing functional foods or medicines based on probiotics.

title_en: CeMV resistance in celery
abstract_en: The present invention relates to CeMV resistant celery plants, methods for identifying CeMV resistant celery plants, methods for producing CeMV resistant celery plants and means for producing or identifying CeMV resistant celery plants. In particular, the invention relates to CeMV-resistant celery plants comprising a genomic region on chromosome 10 between 80,545 and 80,589cm, wherein said genomic region comprises one or more mutations which cause said CeMV resistance.

title_en: Method for improving oxidation stability of diglyceride oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of edible oil processing, and particularly relates to a method for improving oxidation stability of diglyceride oil. According to the invention, the plant sterol ester is added into the diglyceride oil with high diglyceride content, so that the oxidation stability of the diglyceride oil is obviously improved, the diglyceride oil is an oil product with the diglyceride content of 20% -100%, and the addition amount of the plant sterol ester is 0.5% -20% of the mass of the diglyceride oil. The invention has the beneficial effects that the addition of the plant sterol ester obviously prolongs the oxidation induction time of the diglyceride oil, improves the oxidation stability and slows down the rancidity process, thereby providing theoretical and technical support for the application of the diglyceride oil.

title_en: Pediococcus pentosaceus HNTP and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly discloses pediococcus pentosaceus HNTP and application thereof. The Pediococcus pentosaceus (Pediococcus pentosaceus) HNTP has the preservation number of CGMCC No.29067, has strong acid resistance and quick growth, can be used for fermenting high-fiber matrix grains, can adjust the relative abundance of various bacteria, generate various volatile gases, can improve the content of beneficial components in a fermentation product, can adjust and improve traditional fermented foods and drinks, and provides a new choice for fermenting whole grain plant-based plants.

title_en: Compositions and methods for preparing bioactive triterpene milk fat globule formulations
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions for oral or topical human administration and methods of making the same. The present invention relates to pentacyclic triterpene compounds, wherein the triterpene compounds are incorporated into lipid vesicles, preferably milk fat globules, surrounded by a three-layer membrane. The triterpene compound is preferably betulinic acid, and/or betulin, and/or lupeol, and/or oleanolic acid, and/or ursolic acid, and most preferably betulinic acid. The incorporation of the triterpene compounds into milk fat globules or lipid vesicles at a high payload of at least 10 up to 50mg/ml is preferably accomplished using high energy emulsification techniques, most preferably sonication. The composition is present in a preferred embodiment as a liquid emulsion formulation. In another preferred embodiment, the composition is a powder, which can be prepared from a liquid embodiment of the composition by, for example, spray drying or freeze drying techniques. The composition can be preferably used as a medicament, food supplement or nutraceutical for the treatment or prevention of cancer, type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular diseases.

title_en: Instant mutton porridge and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides instant mutton porridge and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing 40-80 parts by weight of grains with 1000-1800 parts by weight of water, boiling to skim floating foam, mixing 15-40 parts by weight of vegetable oil, 5-20 parts by weight of ginger and boiling for 15-35 minutes to prepare porridge bottom, mixing 5-60 parts by weight of mutton foam with pickling seasoning and pickling for 20-30 minutes to prepare pickled mutton, mixing 7.5-29 parts by weight of pickled mutton and seasoning and boiling for 1-20 minutes, mixing 10-30 parts by weight of onion plants and continuously boiling for 1-5 minutes to prepare mutton porridge, and freeze-drying the mutton porridge. The instant mutton porridge provided by the application is fragrant, free of mutton smell, salty and fresh and palatable, and the quality and taste of the porridge are improved.

title_en: Automatic fermentation tank of biological power method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic fermentation tank adopting a biological power method, which belongs to the technical field of food processing and comprises a tank body, wherein a plurality of liquid leakage ports are formed in the top surface of the tank body, the liquid leakage ports are controlled to open and close through a driving mechanism, a pressure probe is fixedly connected to the top of the tank body, an exhaust pipe is communicated with the side surface of the top of the tank body, an exhaust valve is fixedly connected in the exhaust pipe, an open bin is fixedly connected to the top of the tank body, an opening cover is arranged at the top of the tank body, a liquid level probe is fixedly connected in the open bin, one end of a liquid feeding pipe is communicated with the bottom of an inner cavity of the tank body, the other end of the liquid feeding pipe is communicated in the open bin, an electric valve is arranged in the liquid feeding pipe, and a controller is used for receiving detection information of the pressure probe and the liquid level probe and controlling the exhaust valve, the electric valve or the driving mechanism according to the detected information. According to the invention, manual intervention is reduced through intelligent control, the labor cost is reduced, and the fermentation efficiency and the product quality are obviously improved.

title_en: Membrane-source vesicle based on cavitation shearing mechanism, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the cross fields of cell engineering, biological medicine, nanotechnology, biological materials and the like, and relates to a membrane source vesicle preparation method based on a cavitation shearing mechanism and application thereof. Through the accurate control of nitrogen pressure, saturation time and instantaneous pressure release, the selective rupture of cell membranes is realized, thermal injury, chemical pollution, oxidative stress and mixing of genetic materials of cell organelles are avoided under mild conditions, and the structure and functions of vesicle membranes are effectively reserved. The method has the advantages of high preparation efficiency, good product uniformity, centralized particle size distribution of the obtained vesicle, complete structure, excellent functional activity, high yield of unit cells, controllable parameters and standardized and industrialized potential. The product can be widely applied to the fields of drug delivery, immunotherapy, functional skin care, nutritional food, synthetic biology and the like.

title_en: Quick astringent taste removing process and equipment for astringent taste persimmon based on low-temperature vacuum permeation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fast astringent persimmon removing process based on low-temperature vacuum infiltration, which comprises the following steps of a pretreatment stage, a vacuum astringent persimmon removing stage, a control and regulation vacuum low-temperature stage, a post-treatment and quality control stage, fast astringent persimmon removing equipment based on low-temperature vacuum infiltration, and a hoisting mechanism arranged in a sealed vacuum tank, wherein the bottom end of the inside of the sealed vacuum tank is provided with a moving mechanism, the hoisting mechanism is arranged in the sealed vacuum tank, the coordination effect of vacuum degree and temperature is improved by controlling the accurate synchronous control of environmental parameters, the spiral lifting and regulation of the vacuum degree and the temperature reduces the damage to the astringent persimmon caused by the abrupt change of the vacuum degree and the temperature, the layered rack placed with the astringent persimmon is transported to the inside of the sealed vacuum tank by the moving mechanism at the bottom, and the layered rack is hoisted by the hoisting mechanism, so that the layered rack is not pressed on the moving mechanism for a long time, and the hoisting stability of the layered rack is maintained.

title_en: Preparation method and application of superfine crushed dendrobium nobile
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of superfine crushed dendrobium nobile, belonging to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine processing and application, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) airing fresh dendrobium nobile stems, cutting into sections and drying to obtain dry stem sections; 2) pre-crushing the dry stem, first sieving, collecting the undersize component to obtain fine powder, 3) carrying out superfine crushing on the fine powder, second sieving, and collecting the undersize component to obtain superfine powder. The preparation method provided by the invention greatly damages the structure of the dendrobium nobile, reduces the particle size of the powder, increases the cell wall breaking rate, promotes the leaching and release of active ingredients including polysaccharide, dendrobine, total polyphenol and total flavone in the dendrobium nobile, and remarkably improves the cell wall breaking rate, hydration and filling property of the powder.

title_en: Application of gene ZmAGO105 in regulation and control of heat stress resistance of corn in seedling stage
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a gene AGO105 in regulating and controlling heat stress resistance of plants in a seedling stage. The heat stress resistance of the corn at the seedling stage can be improved by inhibiting the expression of the gene AGO105 in the corn, the death rate of the AGO105 homozygous mutant under the heat stress at the seedling stage is obviously reduced, and the AGO105 gene plays an important role in regulating and controlling the heat response of the corn at the seedling stage. The invention provides effective gene resources for enhancing the heat resistance of corns in seedling stage.

title_en: Application of NtPPO gene in regulation and control of tobacco plant anti-prodenia litura and tobacco plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant genes and breeding, in particular to application of NtPPO genes in regulating and controlling tobacco plant prodenia litura resistance and tobacco plants. The gene is at least one of NtPPO-4 gene and NtPPO-11 gene. The base sequence of NtPPO-4 gene is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the base sequence of NtPPO-11 gene is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. The regulation comprises reducing the resistance of the tobacco plant to prodenia litura by knocking out or reducing at least one of the NtPPO-4 gene and the NtPPO-11 gene. And improving the resistance of the tobacco plant to the prodenia litura by over-expressing at least one of the NtPPO-4 gene and the NtPPO-11 gene. The gene is subjected to single-gene or multi-gene overexpression in tobacco plants, so that the resistance of the plants to prodenia litura can be greatly enhanced. Has important significance in the aspects of resistance mechanism research, molecular breeding and the like of prodenia litura and wide application prospect.

title_en: Application of 5-aminolevulinic acid in preparation of products for improving pork quality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of 5-aminolevulinic acid for the preparation of a product for improving pork quality, including improving flesh colour brightness and flesh colour redness, reducing drip loss, reducing PSE meat fraction. According to the invention, the addition of 5-ALA in the daily ration of pigs is found for the first time, so that positive influence is generated on the meat quality of pigs, slaughter yield is increased, and meat color and meat quality are improved. The invention also discovers that the PQQ+5-ALA combination has better effect on improving the meat color than 5-ALA, and the meat color score can be obviously improved and the PSE meat ratio can be reduced by recommending 50 g/ton of 5-aminolevulinic acid as well as 0.2 g/ton of pyrroloquinoline quinone as per ton of feed in fattening pigs.

title_en: Feed-grade zinc oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of feed-grade zinc oxide preparation, in particular to feed-grade zinc oxide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the feed-grade zinc oxide with the content of 98 percent and the specific surface area of three hundred and more can be prepared by mixing granular flaky zinc oxide and active zinc oxide which are crushed to 200 meshes, the contact probability of zinc oxide and intestinal microorganisms is remarkably improved, the delay time of the growth of microorganisms is prolonged, the prepared feed-grade zinc oxide has good fluidity and is beneficial to animal absorption, the preparation method is easy to operate, and the problem that the fluidity of indirect zinc oxide is poor is solved by mixing granular flaky zinc oxide and active zinc oxide which are crushed to 200 meshes through a coarse sieve to 60 meshes, fine powder is crushed to 200 meshes through an ultrafine crusher and then active zinc oxide is added for stirring.

title_en: Application of OsBTD gene in regulation and control of nitrogen utilization efficiency of rice
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of OsBTD gene in regulating nitrogen utilization efficiency of rice, which comprises that a nucleotide sequence of OsBTD gene is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and OsBTD gene negatively regulates nitrogen absorption rate of rice. By knocking out the target point of OsBTD gene, osbtd mutant plant is obtained, the overground part height of osbtd mutant plant under the condition of low nitrogen stress is obviously higher than that of wild plant, and osbtd mutant plant effectively overcomes the inhibition of low nitrogen stress to plant growth. The aerial part height of osbtd1 mutant plants under high nitrogen conditions is significantly higher than that of wild type plants, which indicates that osbtd mutant plants still have yield-increasing potential under high nitrogen conditions. The synergistic regulation capability of OsBTD genes provides core gene resources for cultivating new varieties of fertilizer-saving high-yield rice, and has great significance for agricultural sustainable development.

title_en: Epimedium and rhizoma polygonati beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of functional beverages and discloses an epimedium and rhizoma polygonati beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the epimedium and rhizoma polygonati beverage comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 5-10 parts of epimedium, 8-15 parts of rhizoma polygonati, 3-6 parts of medlar, 5-8 parts of red dates, 4-7 parts of Chinese yam, 2-5 parts of trace element supplements, 1-3 parts of white granulated sugar, additives and purified water. According to the invention, the epimedium, the rhizoma polygonati and microelements such as zinc, selenium and manganese are compounded, wherein the zinc element can promote the absorption and conversion of icariine, the selenium element and the rhizoma polygonati polysaccharide synergistically enhance the antioxidation capability, the problem of single nutrition of the traditional beverage is solved, meanwhile, the icariine retention rate in the finished product is higher, the microelement recovery rate is higher, the problem of precipitation of the microelements and plant polyphenol is solved by adopting the beta-cyclodextrin inclusion technology, the stability of the beverage for long-time placement is improved, the Chinese yam, fructo-oligosaccharide and the like are added, the content of dietary fibers is enriched, and the bitter and astringent taste of the epimedium is neutralized.

title_en: Less sugar type zero-hydrogenation solid beverage based on spray drying and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly relates to a low-sugar type zero-hydrogenation solid beverage based on spray drying and a preparation method thereof, wherein the low-sugar type zero-hydrogenation solid beverage is prepared by compounding polydextrose and glucose syrup in a specific proportion, and the low-sugar type zero-hydrogenation solid beverage is used as a core sweet taste and structural framework, so that the total sugar content of a finished product is reduced by more than 30% from the source; meanwhile, refined vegetable oil is selected, so that the hydrogenation process is avoided, and the zero hydrogenation of the product is realized; the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing an aqueous phase and an oil phase respectively, and carrying out high-efficiency shearing emulsification and two-step homogenization at 60-70 ℃. The invention not only remarkably reduces the sugar content of the product and increases the dietary fiber, meets the requirements of sugar-control groups, but also effectively solves the technical problem that the polydextrose is easy to change color and coagulate in heat treatment through process optimization, and ensures that the final product has excellent solubility, stability and sensory flavor.

title_en: Carya illinoensis uric acid-reducing active peptide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a apocarya uric acid reducing active peptide and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides apocarya uric acid reducing active peptide which comprises at least one of the following amino acid sequences, namely FLADAF, FFFPGPS and/or WPFGGDS, wherein the amino acid sequence of FLADAF is SEQ ID No.1, the amino acid sequence of FFFPGPS is SEQ ID No.2, and the amino acid sequence of WPFGGDS is SEQ ID No.3. The apocarya-derived active peptide not only has uric acid reducing and uric acid toxicity resisting effects, but also has kidney protecting, liver protecting and intestine protecting functions, and shows good safety and wide application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of traditional Chinese medicine high-activity dry powder based on whole-course low-temperature wet wall breaking technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of traditional Chinese medicine high-activity dry powder based on a whole-course low-temperature wet wall breaking technology, which comprises the following steps of S1 optimizing low-temperature hydration and pretreatment, S2 assisting wet ultra-micro wall breaking and enzymolysis, S3 concentrating and degassing treatment in a low-temperature vacuum manner, S4 drying in a low-temperature gradient manner, S5 modifying moisture absorption resistance and ultra-micro grinding in a low-temperature manner, S6 packaging in a sterile manner and quality monitoring. Taking Polygonatum sibiricum as an example, the retention rate of Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide can reach 92-97%, which is improved by 14-19% compared with 78% by the traditional dry method, and is improved by 10-15% compared with 82% by the traditional water extraction spray drying.

title_en: Two-section type heat exchange wine receiving cooler
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wine receiving coolers, and discloses a two-section heat exchange wine receiving cooler which comprises an upper shell, a lower shell, a high-temperature sleeve type cooling assembly and a low-temperature coil type cooling assembly, wherein wine base steam is condensed into liquid wine base by high-temperature cooling water outside an inner tube of the high-temperature sleeve, the heat exchange effect between the high-temperature cooling water and the wine base steam is enhanced through the design of a coaxial sleeve, so that the wine base steam is efficiently condensed into liquid wine base under a relatively small heat transfer area, the liquid wine base flows into a coil cooler in the lower shell, is further cooled to the wine receiving process temperature by low-temperature cooling water outside the lower shell and flows out, the flow cross section of the cooling water side is smaller through the structural design of an annular cavity of the lower shell, the flow rate of the cooling water is improved, the convection heat transfer coefficient is increased, the outflow temperature of the liquid wine base can be accurately regulated through regulating the flow rate of the low-temperature cooling water, and the quality stability of the wine is ensured.

title_en: Application of wheat TabHLH protein 93 or coding gene thereof in regulation and control of plant seed development
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular breeding in plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to application of wheat TabHLH protein or a coding gene thereof in regulating and controlling plant seed development. The invention constructs a binary expression vector capable of ectopic expression of TabHLH93 genes, and genetically transforms the binary expression vector into common wheat to obtain a offspring with high expression of TabHLH93 genes, thereby realizing the overexpression of TabHLH93 genes, verifying that TabHLH has the function of regulating and controlling the grain size of wheat, and simultaneously having important regulation and control functions on agronomic characters such as plant height, tillering number, spike length, thousand grain weight and the like of the wheat. Provides candidate genes with important application prospects for high-yield genetic improvement of wheat, and has important significance for guaranteeing grain safety.

title_en: Enzyme pretreated high-fiber feed formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of animal feeds, in particular to an enzyme pretreated high-fiber feed formula and a preparation method thereof. The formula comprises 8-18% of enzyme pretreatment fiber raw materials, 18-28% of protein raw materials, 35-55% of energy raw materials, 3-8% of mineral and vitamin premix, 2-6% of vegetable oil and fat and the balance of water, 5-9% of finished crude fibers and not higher than 12% of water. The enzyme pretreatment fiber raw material is obtained by short-range action of composite fiber degrading enzyme at 45-55 ℃ and pH 4.5-5.5, and is dried and crushed, so that the soluble oligosaccharide accounts for 5-12% of the self mass. Under the condition of not improving the steam intensity and the water content, the particle durability is improved, the pulverization and the grease migration are reduced, the digestion rate of the NDF/ADF and the AMEn are effectively utilized by matching with the fiber fraction, the FCR and the EPEF are further improved, and meanwhile, the higher trace element retention rate is kept after the storage.

title_en: Composite fermentation uric acid reducing beverage of red vine, chicory and plantain herb and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a red vine, chicory and plantain herb compound fermentation uric acid reducing beverage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the red vine, chicory and plantain herb compound fermentation uric acid reducing beverage is prepared from, by dry weight, 10-15 parts of red vine, 8-12 parts of chicory, 5-10 parts of plantain herb, 3-5 parts of warm food materials, wherein the warm food materials are one or a combination of ginger, red date and longan, the beverage is prepared by ultrasonic auxiliary extraction and a compound bacteria fermentation process, and the compound bacteria are lactobacillus plantarum and saccharomycetes, and the ratio of the two is 2:1. The activity of the red vine phenolic component, the chicory triterpenes and the plantain flavone is improved by more than 30 percent after fermentation, the uric acid reduction rate of rats is more than or equal to 20 percent, the effect of assisting in reducing uric acid is remarkable, the warm food material neutralizes cold, the problem that the spleen and stomach are damaged by the traditional heat-clearing beverage is solved, the bitter taste is light, the herb fragrance is coordinated, the combination of ultrasonic extraction and compound bacteria fermentation solves the problem of degradation of plant fibers, and the fermentation efficiency is improved by more than 40 percent.

title_en: Hericium erinaceus stomach-nourishing compound polysaccharide composition, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hericium erinaceus stomach-nourishing compound polysaccharide composition, a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the steps of S1, mixing dried hericium erinaceus fruit bodies, spirulina, chinese yam, corn silk and mulberry leaves, carrying out coarse crushing and nitrogen gas jet crushing to obtain compound crushed materials, S2, degreasing, drying to obtain compound degreasing powder, S3, carrying out low-temperature plasma treatment to obtain pretreated compound degreasing powder, S4, placing in deionized water, carrying out ultrasonic treatment while stirring, S5, obtaining an extracting solution, concentrating, adding absolute ethanol for precipitation, washing the precipitate with ethanol, drying to obtain compound polysaccharide to be treated, S6, adding deionized water for mixing and dissolving, carrying out ultrafiltration with an ultrafiltration membrane, concentrating the obtained concentrated solution, and then carrying out freeze drying to obtain the hericium erinaceus stomach-nourishing compound polysaccharide composition.

title_en: Composition for improving respiratory system health and treating or preventing respiratory system diseases comprising vitamin B5, pharmaceutical composition for treating or preventing respiratory system diseases comprising the same, and health functional food composition for improving respiratory system health or respiratory system diseases comprising the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition containing vitamin B  5  for improving respiratory system health and treating or preventing respiratory system diseases, a pharmaceutical composition containing the same for treating or preventing respiratory system diseases and a health-care functional food composition containing the same for improving respiratory system health or respiratory system diseases.

title_en: Functional alcoholic beverage formula based on active polypeptide and compound traditional Chinese medicine and brewing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and discloses a functional wine drink formula based on active polypeptide and composite traditional Chinese medicine, which comprises active polypeptide, starch raw materials and composite traditional Chinese medicine, wherein the active polypeptide sequence is Gln-Phe-Ser-Thr-Val-Ala-Ser-Val-Ala-Phe-Val-Ala-Leu-Lys, the concentration is 200-500ppm, and the starch raw materials comprise 50 parts of corn, 30 parts of sorghum and 30 parts of highland barley by weight. The Gln-Phe-Ser-Thr-Val-Ala-Ser-Val-Ala-Phe-Val-Ala-Leu-Lys14 amino acid active polypeptide is firstly applied to the scene of unique composite traditional Chinese medicine combination of Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation, fills up the gap of related technology, achieves the compatibility effect of combining spleen and kidney with tonifying, clearing and tonifying, tonifying without stagnation, astringency and clearing and improving, achieves the aim of synergistic interaction, simultaneously combines active polypeptide induction yeast activation and a two-step fermentation method through optimizing a fermentation process, not only improves the yeast proliferation speed by 20-30 percent, shortens the fermentation period by 1-2 days, but also fully extracts and converts the effective components of the traditional Chinese medicine, and endows the product with multiple health care effects of tonifying kidney, strengthening spleen, regulating immunity, resisting oxidization and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of composite fruit-flavored freeze-dried milk skin layers
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of food deep processing and discloses a preparation method of a composite fruit-flavored freeze-dried milk skin multi-layer, which comprises the following steps of preparing a substrate milk skin with micro-air-dried surface and a composite fruit fluid with thixotropic property, performing interfacial emulsification assembly on the surface of the milk skin by adopting variable-frequency ultrasonic induction fluid, placing a semi-finished product in a high hydrostatic pressure environment, performing shear thinning permeation by using mechanical vibration to assist fluid, performing instantaneous pressure relief to realize explosive nucleation and in-situ thixotropic locking, and finally performing gradient heating vacuum freeze drying to obtain the finished product. The application utilizes ultrasonic cavitation effect to eliminate hydrophilic-hydrophobic interface obstacle, and cooperates with high-pressure displacement freezing technology to construct micro mechanical interlocking structure, thus effectively solving the problems of weak interlayer combination, easy stripping and uneven texture of traditional freeze-dried multi-layer products. The obtained finished product has firm interlayer combination, uniform and fine porous skeleton, crisp taste and excellent rehydration.

title_en: Formula and preparation method of dried orange peel pot-stewed chicken
abstract_en: The invention provides a formula of a dried orange peel pot-stewed chicken and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of foods, wherein the formula comprises chicken, basic seasonings, a spice composition and a special sugar color material, wherein the spice composition comprises 150+/-5 g of dried orange peel, 50+/-2 g of fructus amomi, 25+/-1 g of white knot, 75+/-3 g of galangal, 25+/-1 g of amomum cardamomum, 50+/-2 g of tsaoko cardamon, 60+/-2 g of star anise, 35+/-1.5 g of clove, 75+/-3 g of cinnamon, 45+/-2 g of bay leaves, 50+/-2 g of fennel, 75+/-3 g of angelica dahurica, 25+/-1 g of fragrant sand and 75+/-3 g of pepper, and the preparation method is simple and easy to operate, can enable the spice to permeate chicken permanently and fully, can ensure the chicken quality, realize uniform marinating fragrance and heavy bottom taste, effectively improve the quality of the pot-stewed chicken, and the chicken is tender and tender in texture, and attractive overall color and red, fresh and sweet.

title_en: Low-temperature forming soft capsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-temperature forming soft capsules, and particularly discloses a low-temperature forming soft capsule and a preparation method thereof. The low-temperature forming soft capsule provided by the invention comprises a rubber and a content, wherein the rubber consists of gelatin, sodium gluconate modified carrageenan, sodium carboxymethylcellulose, glycerol, propylene glycol, a condensation film forming auxiliary agent and water, and the content consists of vegetable oil, a temperature-sensitive active ingredient and an antioxidant. The low-temperature forming soft capsule provided by the invention can be formed under a low-temperature condition, so that the deactivation of temperature-sensitive active ingredients caused by the traditional high-temperature process is avoided, and meanwhile, the low-temperature forming soft capsule rubber provided by the invention has good compactness and toughness. The preparation method of the low-temperature forming soft capsule provided by the invention does not need special complex equipment, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Application of quercetin in improving proliferation rate of axillary buds of phoebe of frame and culture medium and culture method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of quercetin in improving the proliferation rate of axillary buds of frame phoebe, a culture medium and a culture method thereof, wherein aseptic seedlings with axillary buds are used as materials, the aseptic seedlings are inoculated in the axillary buds proliferation culture medium which is optimized by the culture medium and added with auxin inhibitors, the proliferation rate of the axillary buds is improved to 64.71% from the traditional 2.97%, in addition, the proliferation rate of the axillary buds produced by the traditional axillary buds is enlarged, weak and small, rooting and survival are difficult, and the proliferation rate of the axillary buds produced by the optimized culture medium is more robust, so that the subsequent further rooting and survival are guaranteed.

title_en: Composition with antioxidant and whitening effects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly provides a composition with an antioxidant and whitening effect, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composition with the antioxidant and whitening effect at least comprises, by weight, 20-40 parts of glutathione-enriched yeast extract, 0.5-5 parts of burdock root extract, 0.5-5 parts of cordyceps militaris extract, 0.2-2 parts of tricholoma matsutake freeze-dried powder, 0.2-2 parts of boletus concentrated powder and 20-40 parts of osmanthus fragrans powder. The composition provided by the technical scheme is compounded according to a certain proportion, so that the composition has good antioxidation and whitening effects.

title_en: Direct fire and hot air combined suspension baking machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct fire and hot air combined suspension baking machine which comprises an air inlet heating structure, a direct fire baking structure and a silver skin/cooked bean collecting bin which are sequentially communicated from bottom to top. The air inlet heating structure introduces external cold air and heats, blows up raw beans in the direct fire baking structure, and enables the raw beans to circularly suspend between the main channel and the side channel and continuously contact the heating coil pipe assembly. The raw beans fully contact the heat source under the dual heating actions of heat radiation of the heating coil assembly and heat conduction of the air flow, so that uneven local heating is effectively avoided, and uniform heating and baking are ensured. And (3) silver skin generated in the baking process and cooked beans prepared after the baking process enter a silver skin/cooked bean collecting bin under the action of air flow to be automatically collected. The whole machine utilizes the cooperation of hot air drive and direct fire heating, combines the motion mode of raw bean circulation suspension, promotes heat utilization efficiency, ensures the baking quality homogeneity.

title_en: Method for rapidly creating breeding material for overcoming distant hybridization death of tobacco and application
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for rapidly creating a breeding material for overcoming distant hybridization death of tobacco and application thereof. The primer combination comprises a PCR primer group or a KASP primer group, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the PCR primer group is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-3, and the nucleotide sequence of the KASP primer group is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3-5. The KASP primer group is a KASP18_S primer group. A kit comprising the primer combination described above. The primer combination and the kit can be used for seedling stage identification, the operation method is simple, the efficiency is high, the time is short, the cost of manpower, material resources, time and the like for creating breeding materials is obviously reduced, and the primer combination and the kit have important application value in overcoming the transformation of tobacco hybrid lethal genes and the cultivation of new tobacco varieties.

title_en: Phyllostachys pubescens PeMT gene and encoding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phyllostachys pubescens PeMT gene and a coding protein and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering. The nucleotide sequence of the phyllostachys pubescens PeMT gene disclosed by the invention is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the amino acid sequence of the encoded protein is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. Cloning the phyllostachys pubescens PeMT gene to the pCAMBIA1302 plasmid to obtain a recombinant vector pCAMBIA 1302-PeMT. And transforming the recombinant vector into Arabidopsis thaliana, and culturing and screening to obtain a transgenic Arabidopsis thaliana strain. The transgenic arabidopsis lines show obvious late-flowering phenotype, the number of rosette leaves is increased, and flowering time is delayed. The invention discloses the function of PeMT gene for the first time and also discloses the application of the PeMT gene in the aspect of regulating the flowering time of plants and the quantity of rosette leaves.

title_en: Based on alkalization biogas slurry and aerobic digestion of CO2System for preparing ammonium bicarbonate cooperatively and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for preparing ammonium bicarbonate based on the synergy of alkalization biogas slurry and aerobic digestion of CO  2  and an operation method thereof, relating to the technical field of resource recovery, the system comprises a CO  2  gas supply and pretreatment unit, a biogas slurry pretreatment and alkalization unit, an ammonium bicarbonate synthesis reactor, an ammonium bicarbonate post-treatment unit and a control and monitoring unit, and (3) feeding CO  2  -enriched gas generated by aerobic digestion of kitchen waste into a pretreatment unit for treatment through CO  2  gas, introducing the CO  2  -enriched gas into an ammonium bicarbonate synthesis reactor for reaction with alkalized biogas slurry obtained by a biogas slurry pretreatment and alkalization unit to obtain ammonium bicarbonate crystal slurry, and conveying the ammonium bicarbonate crystal slurry into an ammonium bicarbonate post-treatment unit for separation, washing and drying to obtain an ammonium bicarbonate product. The invention solves the technical problems of high cost, complex process and high energy consumption in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of integrally preparing ammonium bicarbonate based on the direct absorption of aerobically digested CO  2  by alkalized biogas slurry.

title_en: Rice-derived vesicle and extraction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The rice-derived vesicle is extracted from rice by centrifugation and/or size exclusion chromatography, the extraction method is simple and easy for large-scale production, and the obtained rice-derived vesicle has good water solubility, good permeability and easy absorption, has the effects of regulating blood sugar and blood fat and reducing weight, and has potential in the fields of functional food development, health management, medicine research and development and the like.

title_en: Efficient apple dwarf stock wide-row close planting cultivation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency cultivation method for apple dwarf stock wide row close planting, which comprises planting, constructing a high spindle-shaped tree body structure, cultivating roots in soil, managing flowers and fruits and comprehensively treating plant diseases and insect pests. The invention integrates a whole-process efficient light-simple technical system taking high-standard garden building, quantized tree form, soil-bearing root cultivation, precise flower and fruit and green prevention and control as cores, realizes that fruits are seen in the 2 nd year after planting and enter the full bearing period in the 3 rd to 4 th year, saves more than 85% of labor per mu, has a high-quality fruit rate of more than 90%, achieves a mu pure profit of 7500 yuan in the full bearing period, and has remarkable economic, ecological and social benefits.

title_en: Composite feed additive for relieving stress effect of marine fishes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound feed additive for relieving stress reaction of seawater fish, which is prepared by mixing raw materials such as black soldier fly protein and the like to prepare a premix, embedding the premix by using a lac-glycyrrhizic acid system to prepare a lac microcapsule, modifying fucoidin by using glycyrrhizin and gamma-linolenic acid, embedding rhodosporidium palustris and bacillus pumilus to prepare compound bacteria nano particles, and finally mixing the lac microcapsule and the compound bacteria nano particles according to a proportion. The invention can effectively inhibit excessive secretion of sea fish cortisol, and the hermetia illucens protein provides rich nutrition, reduces muscle decomposition, and the compound microorganism is beneficial to maintaining intestinal microecological balance and improving the nutrition utilization rate. The compound feed additive prepared by the invention can be directly sprinkled in a culture or transportation water body or added into feed, so that the stress response of the sea fish is effectively relieved, the survival rate of the sea fish is improved, and a powerful support is provided for sea fish culture.

title_en: Sugar signal perception kinase LcTOR and application thereof in regulating and controlling litchi fruit shedding
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a sugar signal perception kinase LcTOR and application thereof in regulating and controlling litchi fruit shedding. The gene codes a sugar signal perception kinase, the expression is obviously up-regulated in the process of litchi fruit drop, the fruit drop can be obviously reduced through the treatment of an inhibitor AZD8055, the drop is promoted by an activator MHY1485, the drop of an Arabidopsis flower organ can be accelerated by the heterologous overexpression of the gene, and the fruit drop of litchi is inhibited by silencing the gene. The invention provides a new gene resource and a regulating and controlling means for controlling the fruit drop of litchi and other crops.

title_en: Gingko pancake and making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gingko pancake and a preparation method thereof, wherein the gingko pancake comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 30-40 parts of rice, 15-25 parts of millet, 15-25 parts of corn, 3-7 parts of soybean, 12-18 parts of gingko powder, 3-7 parts of oat bran, 1.5-2.5 parts of honey, 0.2-0.4 part of edible salt, 0.1-0.3 part of saccharomycetes, 0.3-0.7 part of lactic acid bacteria, 0.8-1.2 parts of baking soda and 180-220 parts of water, wherein the addition amount of the water is 1.8-2.2 times of the total weight of the rice, the millet, the corn, the soybean, the gingko powder and oat bran. The grains provide basic energy and nutrition, the soybeans supplement high-quality vegetable proteins, oat bran strengthens dietary fiber intake, and the ginkgo powder brings unique bioactive components, breaks through the limitation of single nutrition of the traditional pancake, and meets the nutritional requirements of modern consumers on health foods.

title_en: Preparation method and application of chlorella pyrenoidosa protein peptide-calcium chelate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a chlorella pyrenoidosa protein peptide-calcium chelate, which comprises the following steps of S1, dissolving chlorella pyrenoidosa protein in deionized water, adjusting the pH to 2-13, stirring for 1-5 h, centrifuging, taking supernatant to obtain a chlorella pyrenoidosa protein treatment liquid, S2, adding calcium chloride into the chlorella pyrenoidosa protein treatment liquid, chelating for 1.8-2.2 h in a 35-38 ℃ water bath, centrifuging, adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the supernatant, standing, centrifuging again, collecting precipitate, and freeze-drying to obtain the chlorella pyrenoidosa protein chelate. The preparation process is simple, has no toxic or side reagent and low energy consumption, and the prepared product verifies the calcium absorption promoting effect through animal experiments, thereby providing firm theoretical support for the development and application of the chlorella pyrenoidosa protein peptide-calcium chelate as a novel bone health promoter.

title_en: Preparation method of low-beta-glucan malt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-beta-glucan malt, and belongs to the technical field of wheat making. The method comprises the steps of adjusting a drying step according to malt relative beta-glucanase activity (RAG) and an optimal time interval (KPG) of beta-glucanase activity, wherein RAG is the ratio of the peak value of malt beta-glucanase activity in the drying process to the peak value of beta-glucanase activity in the germination process, and KPG is obtained by determining a moisture change interval of malt beta-glucanase activity in a high activity state in the drying process by detecting a malt moisture change curve in the drying process, and determining time corresponding to the change of malt moisture in the interval according to the malt moisture change curve in the drying process along with the drying time. The invention is applied to the aspect of wheat preparation, solves the problem that the existing wheat preparation method is difficult to adjust and improve the dissolution of beta-glucan, and can quickly and efficiently adjust the glucanase activity, thereby reducing the content of the final malt beta-glucan and preparing the finished malt with high quality.

title_en: OsExo70FX9a gene and application of encoded protein thereof in improving bacterial leaf blight resistance of rice
abstract_en: The invention discloses OsExo FX9aOsExo FX9a gene and application of a coded protein thereof in improving bacterial leaf blight resistance of rice, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The nucleotide sequence of OsExo FX9aOsExo FX9a gene is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. According to the invention, osExo FX9aOsExo FX9a gene can be obviously expressed in bacterial leaf blight induction, and the rice bacterial leaf blight resistance can be improved by improving OsExo FX9aOsExo FX9a gene expression, and an over-expression strain of rice OsExo70FX9aOsExo FX9a gene is constructed, and has broad-spectrum resistance to bacterial leaf blight, and through optimization of a promoter, the invention successfully realizes that the OsExo FX9aOsExo FX9a over-expression strain effectively improves bacterial leaf blight resistance, and simultaneously has a seedling stage seedling length, root length and seed size which are only minimally influenced, so that a foundation is provided for rice bacterial leaf blight resistance breeding, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Black tea production process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a black tea production process which comprises the following specific steps of firstly preparing a composite new material, comprising 3-5kg of a probiotic synergist, 1-2kg of an astringency neutralizer and 0.5-1kg of a flavor synergist according to the addition amount of each 100kg of rolled leaves, uniformly spraying the composite new material into paste, uniformly stirring, carrying out pile fermentation, supplementing the dried composite new material into the tea after pile fermentation is finished and drying, carrying out hundred years of wood warehouse fermentation after uniformly mixing, and finally drying and packaging the tea to obtain a black tea finished product. According to the black tea production process, the astringency generated in the fermentation process of the black tea is reduced through the synergistic chemical reaction of the composite new materials and the natural materials of the tea, the mellow feeling and smoothness of the taste are improved, the proliferation of probiotics is promoted, the functional components are enriched, the health care value of the product is improved, and the quality of the black tea is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of plant essence and beverage
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a plant essence drink and the drink, wherein the preparation method of the plant essence drink comprises the steps of mixing white gourd and aloe, preparing plant essence concentrate through a water decoction extraction process, preparing a beverage bottle with a sealed storage bin, storing the essence concentrate in the sealed storage bin of the beverage bottle mouth, preparing mineral water, filling the mineral water into the beverage bottle, and packaging the essence concentrate and the mineral water on a sterile production line. The plant essence beverage prepared by the method enriches the types of plant essence beverages on the market and has the effect of maintaining intestinal tracts.

title_en: SPX4 gene for negative regulation of plant drought tolerance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological genes, in particular to an SPX4 gene for negatively regulating plant drought tolerance and application thereof. The negative regulation effect of SPX4 in plant drought stress response is disclosed, specifically, SPX4 can regulate the nuclear entering process of downstream core transcription factors, under the treatment of ABA, compared with wild type, SPX4 over-expression can inhibit the expression of a plurality of stress response genes such as OsNCED4, osPSY, osPM1, DREB1C, osbHLH and the like, which suggests that the SPX4 plays a negative regulation role in the stress response process, SPX4-OE strain plays a role in the insensitive of ABA treatment in root growth experiments, under the treatment of PEG 6000 simulated drought, SPX4 over-expression plants play a drought sensitivity, and further, the negative regulation capability of SPX4 in the drought response process is proved, in a field, under the drought condition of low nitrogen or high nitrogen, SPX4-OE plants all play a significant yield reduction, especially under the low nitrogen, and the loss of yield is proved to be taken as a negative regulation component to participate in the plant stress tolerance process. The invention provides a new target spot and an effective strategy for crop stress-tolerant breeding.

title_en: Breeding method of heat-resistant cucumber variety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural crop breeding, in particular to a breeding method of a heat-resistant cucumber variety. The cucumber hybridization combination M75×Mn of the company is selected as an original breeding material, and the combination has excellent basic characters of dense thorns and bright melon strips. The selfing separation is carried out in spring and autumn every year starting in spring 2016, and 6 generations of selfing are carried out continuously. In each generation of selfing process, single plant selection is strictly carried out according to screening standards of medium growth vigor, stable internode, medium size of leaves, about 38cm in length of melon strips, short stem, dense thorns, green meat and oil brightness, and plant lines with overstrong growth vigor or overweak vigor, unstable internode, melon strip deformity or poor brightness are eliminated, so that the disease resistance and the virus resistance are high. The invention has the beneficial effects that the heat resistance is outstanding, the early stage of 'Jieu 238' cultivated by the invention is low-temperature resistant, and the later stage is high-temperature resistant, and the invention can adapt to temperature changes in different seasons, solves the problems of the growth resistance and melon strip deformity of cucumbers in the high-temperature seasons, and expands the planting season range of the cucumbers.

title_en: Application of StRAP2.7 gene in regulating and controlling senescence of potato leaves
abstract_en: The invention provides application of a StRAP2.7 gene in regulating and controlling leaf senescence of potatoes, wherein a CDS sequence of the StRAP2.7 gene is shown as SEQ ID No.1, an amino acid sequence of a coding protein is shown as SEQ ID No.2, and the StRAP2.7 gene is positioned in a cell nucleus and can negatively regulate and control leaf senescence by promoting removal of ROS. The overexpression of StRAP2.7 in potatoes can delay the senescence of potato leaves, prolong the growth period of potatoes, and the reduction of StRAP2.7 expression can accelerate the senescence of potato leaves and shorten the growth period of potatoes. The method provides new genetic materials and theoretical basis for analyzing the aging regulation mechanism of the potatoes and improving the breeding of the potatoes.

title_en: Yolk phospholipid composition, method for producing same, and fat emulsion and lipolytic agent using same
abstract_en: A yolk phospholipid composition, which contains lysophosphatidylethanolamine in an amount of 1 mass% or less and contains amino acids in an amount of 50mg/100g or more and 500mg/100g or less.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide and application thereof as medicine and feed additive
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide and application thereof as a medicine and a feed additive. The antibacterial peptide is obtained by modifying an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The invention excavates potential antibacterial peptide sequences from channel catfish proteome, and obtains a novel antibacterial peptide with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, especially with obvious inhibition effect on APEC through structural transformation and optimization. The antibacterial peptide can effectively inhibit the growth of various drug-resistant APEC strains in vitro, has good safety in cytotoxicity and erythrocyte hemolysis experiments, and can be used as a powerful supplement for the prevention and control of traditional antibiotics and vaccines.

title_en: Preparation method and application of shikonin polymer
