abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical synthesis and antibacterial application of natural products, and provides a preparation method and application of a shikonin polymer, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of taking a shikonin pure product or a shikonin derivative as a starting raw material, dissolving the shikonin pure product or shikonin derivative in an organic solvent, adding an acid catalyst, and reacting for 6-24 hours at 80-120 ℃ in a pressure-resistant pipe; the preparation method comprises the steps of evaporating reaction liquid under reduced pressure, filtering under reduced pressure, vacuum drying for 1-12 hours to obtain a crude alkannin dimer product, dissolving the crude product with methanol or acetone with the weight of 2-3 times of the crude product, adding silica gel with the weight of 1-3 times of the crude product for sample mixing, purifying the mixed materials through normal phase column chromatography, detecting through silica gel thin layer chromatography, merging fractions with the same color development characteristics and separation coefficients, and concentrating to obtain a pure product.

title_en: Modulated milk powder for improving learning memory and/or cognitive function, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modulated milk powder for improving learning memory and/or cognitive function, a preparation method and application thereof. The total protein content of the prepared milk powder is 16.5-30g/100g, the fat content is 10-35g/100g, the carbohydrate content is 35-70g/100g, and the prepared milk powder comprises alpha-choline alfoscerate and galactose, wherein the mass ratio of the alpha-choline alfoscerate to the galactose is 1 (8-100). The prepared milk powder disclosed by the invention is beneficial to improving learning, memory and/or cognitive functions.

title_en: Hungatella genus bacteria and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of microbiology. Specifically, the Hungatella bacteria can metabolize uric acid in a culture medium, part of strains can completely metabolize the uric acid in the culture medium by approximately 2000 mug/mL in 8 hours, and meanwhile, in vivo experiments also show that the uric acid content in serum, urine and feces of mice with different hyperuricemia models can be obviously reduced, gout is reduced, kidney and intestinal pathological injuries of the mice with hyperuricemia are relieved, organ functions are protected, patient diseases are reduced, uric acid excretion is promoted, serum uric acid level is reduced, intestinal barrier is maintained, intestinal environment is protected, and health of the mice is promoted. Therefore, the Hungatella bacteria can be expected to replace or partially replace the existing compound medicines, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: ShSBT1.4 protein and application of encoding gene thereof in regulating and controlling powdery mildew resistance of plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of ShSBT1.4 protein and a coding gene thereof in regulating and controlling powdery mildew resistance of plants. According to the invention, shSBT1.4 silent tomatoes and ShSBT1.4 over-expression tomatoes are respectively constructed, and the analysis on powdery mildew resistance of the tomatoes shows that ShSBT1.4 in the silent tomatoes can reduce the resistance of the tomatoes to powdery mildew, and the over-expression of ShSBT1.4 in the tomatoes can improve the resistance of the tomatoes to powdery mildew. The ShSBT1.4 protein or the related biological material thereof is involved in regulating and controlling the powdery mildew resistance of plants, and can be used for cultivating powdery mildew resistant plant varieties in agricultural production. The invention has important significance for cultivating powdery mildew resistant plant varieties.

title_en: Application of biological agent material for enhancing DaMYB expression in anthracnose resistance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of control of anthracnose of ginseng and potato, and particularly relates to application of a biological preparation material for enhancing DaMYB expression in anthracnose resistance. The application of the biological preparation material for enhancing DaMYB expression in anthracnose resistance is characterized in that the nucleotide sequence of DaMYB is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The DaMYB expression is enhanced to enhance the resistance of the plant to anthracnose. The application of the preparation for enhancing DaMYB expression in resisting anthracnose of ginseng and potato can obviously enhance the resistance of plants to anthracnose, obviously reduce the area of disease spots and stabilize the control effect. The material used in the invention is biological material, which can not pollute the environment, on the other hand, the invention can reduce the invasion of anthracnose by regulating and controlling the closing of the air holes of the blades, and belongs to the physical function, so that the pathogenic bacteria of the anthracnose can not generate drug resistance.

title_en: Bacillus coagulans strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacillus coagulans strain, the microorganism preservation number of which is CCTCC NO: M20252261. The strain can treat or slow down intestinal oxidative damage, intestinal inflammatory damage, intestinal morphological damage, intestinal barrier function damage and intestinal flora disorder caused by lipopolysaccharide, and promote growth of a subject. The strain is a probiotic with clinical application prospect.

title_en: Application of GmPAP8 gene in improving low-phosphorus stress resistance of soybean
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soybean genetic engineering, and discloses a soybean low phosphorus resistance important gene GmPAP8 and application thereof. The GmPAP8 gene is cloned and obtained in soybean for the first time, and GmPAP8 plays a key role in the metabolic process of soybean under phosphorus stress. When the content of available phosphorus in the soil environment is low, the soybean root system senses a phosphorus starvation signal, so that the expression of the GmPAP8 gene is up-regulated, the GmPAP8 gene can catalyze the hydrolysis of organic phosphorus compounds, and organic phosphorus which is difficult to absorb by soybean is converted into absorbable inorganic phosphorus, so that the content of available phosphorus of the soybean is increased. In the case of higher levels of organic phosphorus but lacking inorganic phosphorus in the soil, gmPAP8 may help soybeans increase the ability to absorb phosphorus elements. According to the invention, through cloning analysis and expression pattern analysis of the GmPAP8 gene and combining homologous genetic transformation over-expression and gene editing technology, functional research on the gene is carried out, so that when soybean is subjected to low-phosphorus stress, the GmPAP8 gene is induced to be up-regulated, and the adaptability of the soybean to the low-phosphorus stress environment can be improved.

title_en: Application of human sake Lactobacillus widely TG035 in preparation of beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of human-derived lactobacillus widely used in sake of lactobacillus plantarum TG035 in preparing beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The preservation number of the strain TG035 is CCTCC NO: M20252662, and the 16S rDNA sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The strain has the capability of synthesizing beta-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN).

title_en: Combination product comprising edible salt, coconut water and birch sap
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combination product containing edible salt, coconut water and birch juice. The invention also relates to the application of the combination product in hydration, fatigue relief, repair after exercise (anti-inflammatory and immunity improvement) and the like, and can be used for preparing sports functional food or beverage.

title_en: Steam sterilization device for processing chilli powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pepper powder processing, in particular to a steam sterilization device for processing pepper powder, which comprises a sterilization tank body, wherein a feed pipeline and an upper section air inlet assembly are arranged at the top end of the sterilization tank body, one end of the upper section air inlet assembly is communicated with a high-pressure steam main pipe, a plurality of branch pipes are arranged on the high-pressure steam main pipe, the automatic scattering, uniform scattering and lump cutting of the pepper powder can be realized by the linkage design of a nozzle, a scattering disc and a reverse rotation cutter on a conical column of the upper section air inlet assembly in combination with the air flow guiding function of an arc-shaped guide block and the guide nozzle, the high-pressure steam is sprayed from the nozzle to blow the pepper powder accumulated on the scattering disc, the scattering disc rotates to drive the pepper powder to splash along the conical opening, and then the guide structure is used for guiding the pepper powder to the reverse cutter to break the lump, so that the problems of accumulating, bridging and dead zone residue of the pepper powder are solved effectively, the incomplete sterilization caused by the fact that the steam cannot penetrate is avoided, the labor intensity is reduced, and the uniformity of the pepper powder contacted with the steam is improved.

title_en: Ginseng peptide with functions of resisting fatigue and improving constipation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to ginseng peptide with functions of resisting fatigue and improving constipation and application thereof. The ginseng peptide is prepared from ginseng serving as a raw material through the steps of crushing, high-pressure homogenization, two-step enzymolysis, membrane separation, spray drying and the like, and the yield of the prepared ginseng peptide can reach more than 18 percent, and the purity of the prepared ginseng peptide can reach more than 94 percent. The invention adopts a two-step enzymolysis process and omits the traditional alcohol precipitation purification step, and the improvement greatly improves the yield and purity of the ginseng peptide, so that the whole preparation process is more efficient. The ginseng peptide prepared by the invention has the functions of resisting oxidation, resisting fatigue and relieving constipation, and can be used for preparing products for resisting oxidation, resisting fatigue and relieving constipation.

title_en: Ice sand preparation method and device based on refrigerator, refrigerator and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for preparing ice and sand based on a refrigerator, the refrigerator and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of starting an ice and sand preparation device and acquiring a time interval required by an ultrasonic generator to transmit to an ultrasonic receiver and the signal intensity of an ultrasonic signal received by the ultrasonic receiver under the condition that a container is placed in a target compartment; judging whether the ratio between the second time interval acquired at the current moment and the first time interval acquired at the initial moment when the ice-making device is started is smaller than or equal to a first preset threshold value, judging whether the ratio between the second signal intensity acquired at the current moment and the first signal intensity acquired at the initial moment is smaller than or equal to a second preset threshold value, and stopping running the ice-making device under the condition that the ratio between the second time interval and the first time interval is smaller than or equal to the first preset threshold value and the ratio between the second signal intensity and the first signal intensity is smaller than or equal to the second preset threshold value. By adopting the method, the success rate of ice and sand preparation of the refrigerator can be improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of livestock breeding feed taking fruit wine residues as raw materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of livestock-raising feed using fruit wine residues as raw materials, which are applied to the field of feed preparation, and aim to solve the problems of low utilization rate of fruit wine residues, feed resource waste, low cultivation benefit and the like; according to the method, the fruit wine residues are pretreated and accurately compounded, mineral substances adsorbent optimized structures are added to perform mixing tempering, multistage collaborative fermentation, dynamic regulation and control of the fermentation process, intermittent stirring and weak forced ventilation are performed during regulation and control, and finally drying granulation is performed, so that the emission of harmful gases in the fermentation process is effectively controlled, the stable fermentation environment is maintained, the availability of proteins and trace elements in the feed is obviously improved, the fruit wine residues which are difficult to treat originally are converted into high-quality livestock feed with balanced nutrition, waste materials of wine byproducts are turned into wealth, and the problem of environmental pollution of waste is solved.

title_en: Seed production device suitable for corn seed production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of corn breeding and discloses a seed production device suitable for corn seed production, which comprises a lifting frame, wherein a sleeve is fixedly connected inside the lifting frame, an exhaust fan is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the sleeve, a collecting cylinder is arranged on one side, far away from the sleeve, of the exhaust fan, the outer wall of the collecting cylinder is arranged inside the lifting frame, a plurality of supporting rods are fixedly connected with the outer wall of the lower side of the sleeve, a plurality of bottom plates are connected with the outer wall of each supporting rod in a sliding manner, the upper surface of each bottom plate is attached to the lower surface of the sleeve, and an electric push rod is arranged inside each bottom plate. Through mutually supporting between gasbag one and the expansion piece, realize when collecting father's maize pollen automatically in succession, when carrying out automatic centre gripping to different maize rhizome, can also realize sealing the sleeve inside, avoid pollen overflow to lead to reducing pollen utilization ratio and influence the healthy effect of operating personnel.

title_en: Molecular breeding method for high-temperature-resistant mechanically-picked cotton
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crop molecular breeding, and discloses a high-temperature-resistant mechanical cotton molecular breeding method which comprises the steps of selecting mechanical-picking character parent materials and high-temperature-resistant parent materials to hybridize to obtain separation groups; the method comprises the steps of carrying out flowering phase directional high-temperature window treatment on a fruit branch layer of a daily flowering place in an early stage from initial flowering to full-bloom, carrying out mechanical picking vibration simulation screening treatment on plants, constructing a high-temperature resistant mechanical picking comprehensive selection index based on the treatment result and screening target single plants or families, carrying out molecular marker detection on screening materials, carrying out joint selection by combining a molecular marker result and the comprehensive selection index, and finally obtaining the high-temperature resistant mechanical picking cotton material through continuous selfing or backcross. According to the invention, the directional high-temperature window treatment of the flowering phase is implemented at the early stage from the initial flowering stage to the early flower holding stage of cotton, so that materials which can still finish the ringing process in a high-temperature environment can be identified at the early breeding stage, and the selection pertinence of the high-temperature resistance state is improved.

title_en: Foamable composition and foam
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a foamable composition comprising, based on the total weight of the composition, from 0.05 to 10wt% of plant germ flour, from 0.1 to 15wt% of a thickener, from 0.1 to 35wt% of natural fibers, and water. The invention further relates to a foam obtainable from said foamable composition, to a method for producing said foamable composition comprising mixing said ingredients with water, to the use of said foamable composition or said foam in a food product, and to a food product comprising said foamable composition or said foam.

title_en: Coating composition comprising fatty alcohol
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to coatings for agricultural products comprising one or more monoglycerides of C  4 -C 28  fatty acids and one or more C  8 -C 24  fatty alcohols. Exemplary embodiments include from about 30% to about 98% by weight of monoglycerides of one or more C  4 -C 28  fatty acids and from about 1% to about 50% by weight of one or more C  8 -C 24  fatty alcohols.

title_en: Sugar alcohol processing is with pan that has cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sugar processing, in particular to a cooker with a cleaning function for sugar alcohol processing, which comprises a base and a cooker body for sugar alcohol processing, wherein a heater is arranged on the base, a sealing cover for sealing the cooker body is arranged on a support, a cleaning mechanism for cleaning the inside of the cooker body is arranged at the bottom of the sealing cover, a guiding-out mechanism for pumping out fluid in the cooker body is also arranged on the sealing cover, the cleaning mechanism comprises an annular pipe fixedly connected to the sealing cover, a spray head for spraying water is fixedly connected to the bottom of the annular pipe, and a transmission assembly for driving the spray head to swing is arranged on the sealing cover. According to the invention, the cleaning mechanism is arranged, the annular pipe sprays water from the spray head to clean the pot body, the transmission assembly can drive the spray head to swing, the annular pipe sprays water into the pot uniformly, the pot bottom and the inner wall can be effectively cleaned, the pot bottom and the inner wall are cleaner and more sanitary, and the spray head swings, so that the cleaning range is improved.

title_en: Bacillus bailii CL02 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant disease control, in particular to bacillus beijerinckii CL02 and application thereof. The invention discloses bacillus beliae (Bacillus velezensis) CL02 for antagonizing chestnut solid rot, which belongs to bacillus and has the preservation number of CGMCC No.35215, and research results show that the strain CL02 and fermentation liquor and volatile gas thereof can effectively inhibit hypha expansion of chestnut solid rot, cause hypha expansion and malformation of pathogenic bacteria and obviously inhibit the expansion of chestnut solid rot in nuts. The strain CL02 has no damage to the quality of chestnut fruits in the storage period, has no obvious influence on the contents of starch, soluble sugar, soluble protein, soluble solid and water, and can maintain the VC content of chestnut. In addition, the fermentation liquid and volatile gas of CL02 can obviously reduce the natural decay rate of fruits in the low-temperature storage period, and have great application potential.

title_en: Pure wine device and method for manufacturing pure wine device
abstract_en: The application provides a pure wine device and a method for manufacturing the same. The wine purifying device comprises a first material body and a second material body. The second material body and the first material body together form a wine-purifying device. The surface of the wine purification device comprises a plurality of concave structures. The pure wine device is a block structure.

title_en: AcLTH70 gene for regulating pineapple leaf thorn formation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular biology and genetic engineering, and particularly relates to AcLTH gene for regulating and controlling pineapple leaf thorn formation and application thereof. The pineapple AcLTH gene has the function of regulating and controlling pineapple thorn formation, and through regulating and controlling over-expression or silencing of the AcLTH gene, the pineapple variety with thorns, little thorns or no thorns is obtained, the requirements of pineapple varieties in different cultivation scenes are met, the pineapple breeding efficiency is further improved, and the pineapple has important industrial application value.

title_en: Application of rice self-regulating haplotype (SRHs) in differentiation of indica subspecies, steady state of seed size and improvement of yield traits
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a rice self-regulating haplotype (SRHs) in differentiation of indica subspecies, steady state of seed size and improvement of yield characteristics. According to the invention, three genes for controlling grain length change and natural variation thereof in rice are identified through GWAS analysis, and a molecular mechanism of OsGRX- (OsbZIP 47) -OsbZIP08-OsGRX for negative feedback regulation and control of OsGRX expression and indica-japonica subspecies seed size steady-state is analyzed. The self-regulating haplotype (SRHs) formed by the negative feedback loop shows unique geographic distribution, indica-japonica differentiation, seed size and yield difference, and the genetic contribution to rice yield and seed size is far higher than the individual contribution of the individual components. Based on key SRHs, the directional improvement of the size and the yield of rice seeds can be realized, a new strategy is provided for rice breeding, and a theoretical basis is provided for analyzing indica-japonica character differences and cereal crop breeding research.

title_en: Multiphase extraction system (m.e.s.) for extracting bioactive compounds from plant substrates using combinatorial extraction techniques and vehicles containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field related to extracts of natural substances, in particular plant products, wherein such extracts are bioactive compounds or agents that can be intelligently delivered for transport and release, for example in nutritional and pharmaceutical applications. In particular, the present invention relates to a method for extracting bioactive compounds from plant matrices and preparing micro-and/or nanoparticles containing them. The method according to the invention advantageously represents an innovative integrated device for the production of micro-and/or nano-particles functionalized for specific targets, delivering active ingredients extracted from a plant matrix. Furthermore, since such micro-and/or nano-particles may comprise a biologically active compound or ingredient, the present invention relates to a method of producing micro-and/or nano-particles, and such micro-and/or nano-particles comprising a biologically active compound or ingredient. Thus, the extracted and obtained bioactive compounds or ingredients can be advantageously and effectively incorporated into vehicles such as nanoemulsions, alginate-based microspheres or clays, which allow for the transport or delivery of high biological value substances extracted/recovered from various plant matrices using the methods of the present invention. Practical applications can be advantageously found in the delivery of active ingredients ("drug delivery"). The advantages of using such a structural form are multiple, including gastric protection of the bioactive compound or ingredient, the formation of a specific delayed form, and the possibility of multiplexing the micro-nano particles in response to a specific stimulus.

title_en: Preparation method of yeast extract
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a yeast extract, belonging to the technical field of bioengineering. The method comprises the steps of mixing yeast cells subjected to fermentation culture, glycine and activated aspergillus oryzae mycelia, carrying out synergistic autolysis reaction under the mild condition of 45-60℃, pH and 4.5-6.5, and carrying out post enzymolysis and fine modification by utilizing trace amount of flavourzyme. By constructing the co-autolysis system, high-efficiency bioconversion is realized under mild conditions, and dependence on expensive exogenous enzymes is reduced. The prepared yeast extract has high free amino acid and taste nucleotide content, strong delicate flavor and coordinated flavor. The invention has simple process, low cost and easy industrialization, and provides a new scheme for producing high-quality natural seasonings.

title_en: Composite fermentation rapeseed meal for improving utilization of pig mineral substances and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses a composite fermentation rapeseed meal for improving the utilization of pig mineral substances, the composite fermentation rapeseed meal is obtained by adopting composite bacteria fermentation rapeseed meal consisting of aspergillus oryzae, bacillus subtilis, lactobacillus plantarum and bacteroides defibrii. The composite fermentation vegetable meal adopts four fermentation bacteria, one of which is a unique strain preserved by the inventor, the four strains can realize the efficient synergistic degradation of cellulose and phytic acid, the absorption and utilization efficiency of pigs on mineral substances are obviously improved, after the phytic acid is degraded by the synergistic degradation of the bacteroides fibrinolyticus LYH2 and commercial strains, the degradation rate of the phytic acid is more than or equal to 80%, the degradation rate of the cellulose is more than or equal to 65%, the utilization rate of the mineral substances can be improved by more than 31% by adding 4-6% in daily ration of pigs, and is improved by more than 17% by combination of DSM 14838 standard strains, the use of 30% mineral additives is reduced, and the excretion of fecal copper and zinc is reduced by more than 40%. The application does not need exogenous enzyme preparation, has low cost and stable effect, and provides technical support for vegetable meal resource utilization and green cultivation. Meanwhile, the application also provides application of the composite fermented rapeseed meal.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine compound composition with nerve repair effect, cell culture medium, traditional Chinese medicine-neural stem cell exosome compound and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine compound composition with a nerve repairing effect, a cell culture medium, a traditional Chinese medicine-neural stem cell exosome compound and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine compound composition based on a basic theory of traditional Chinese medicine and a combined theory of traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, which comprises gastrodia elata exosome, astragalus exosome and resveratrol, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine compound composition is prepared into a cell culture medium, and neural stem cells are cultured by using the cell culture medium, so that a traditional Chinese medicine-neural stem cell exosome compound with a high-efficiency nerve repair function is prepared. The traditional Chinese medicine-neural stem cell exosome compound can be used for comprehensively repairing nerve injury by accurately targeting nerve cells, promoting neurogenesis, repairing nerve circuit functions and reducing inflammatory effects, and can be used for preparing medical instruments and medicines related to nerve repair.

title_en: DT1 protein and application of coding gene thereof in efficient utilization of corn potassium
abstract_en: The invention relates to DT1 protein and application of coding genes thereof in efficient utilization of corn potassium. According to the invention, through over-expressing DT1 genes in corn plants, over-expression plants with high potassium absorption and utilization efficiency are obtained, under normal culture conditions, compared with wild plants, the over-expression plants have larger plant biomass and higher leaf potassium content, under low-potassium conditions, the third leaf of the mutant has stronger green holding property, and after the over-expression plants have higher leaf potassium content, the potassium absorption and utilization efficiency of corn and the potassium content of corn leaves are regulated and controlled after the expression level of the DT1 genes is improved, so that the tolerance capability of the corn under low-potassium conditions is improved, the potassium absorption and utilization efficiency is improved, and the biomass is improved. Compared with the traditional breeding mode, the breeding method for high-efficiency potassium absorption and utilization has the advantages of short breeding time, strong purpose, obvious shortening of breeding period, improvement of breeding efficiency, great application value in crop molecular improvement and theoretical basis for elucidating molecular mechanisms of plant potassium nutrition absorption and utilization.

title_en: Silk fibroin composite spray coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food fresh-keeping materials, in particular to a silk fibroin composite spray coating, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein solution A is silk fibroin solution, solution B is mixed solution of epsilon-polylysine and gamma-polyglutamic acid, solution A and solution B are respectively filled into two liquid storage cavities of a double-liquid spray coating system, spraying operation is carried out on the surfaces of fruits, and solution A and solution B are instantly mixed at a nozzle and sprayed on the surfaces of the fruits, so that a uniform and transparent fibrous composite coating film can be obtained without any subsequent drying or chemical treatment. Has the characteristics of quick film forming, multifunctional integration, washability and the like. The preparation process is simple and green, no organic solvent or post-treatment is needed, the material has excellent biocompatibility and degradability, and the problems that the edible coating in the prior art has long film forming time, requires organic solvent or post-treatment, and is difficult to integrate and remove multifunctional components are solved.

title_en: Fruit preservative containing trichodermin or analogues thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: A fruit preservative containing trichodermin or analogues thereof and application thereof belong to the technical field of fruit preservation. In order to reduce the postharvest loss of fruits caused by pathogen infection and imperfect preservation technology and solve the technical problem of safety risk of the existing fruit preservation technology, the invention provides a fruit preservative containing trichoderma or analogues thereof, which is prepared by dissolving trichoderma or analogues thereof in absolute ethyl alcohol, and can prolong the storage time of the fruits after harvest and inhibit the growth of pathogenic fungus hyphae causing the postharvest diseases of the fruits by fumigation, so as to further prevent and treat various postharvest diseases of the fruits. In addition, trichoderma analog is dissolved in water to serve as a fruit preservative, and fruits are preserved in a spraying mode, so that the effects of prolonging the storage time of the picked fruits and preventing and controlling various fruit postharvest diseases can be achieved.

title_en: Application of ZM4 of zymomonas mobilis in improving diabetes
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to application of ZM4 in diabetes improvement, which comprises the steps of obtaining a bacterial suspension from ZM4 with the deposit number of ATCC31821 through liquid culture, centrifugation and resuspension, and then using the bacterial suspension in diabetes improvement, wherein ZM4 in the bacterial suspension still has activity after centrifugation and resuspension, and the bacterial suspension does not contain fermentation products of ZM 4. The application of the ZM4 of the zymomonas mobilis in improving diabetes provided by the application utilizes the probiotic characteristics of the ZM4 of the zymomonas mobilis to improve the type and abundance of intestinal flora, so that the blood sugar of a mouse with type II diabetes is reduced, the oral glucose tolerance of the mouse is improved, the contents of glycosylated hemoglobin, blood insulin and GLP-1 are regulated, the level of inflammatory factors related to diabetes is reduced, and damaged islet cells can be improved and recovered to a certain extent.

title_en: Long-acting sterile ornamental and regeneration integrated culture method for isolated buds of China rose
abstract_en: The invention provides a long-acting sterile ornamental and regeneration integrated culture method for the isolated buds of China rose, which has low pollution risk and broad-spectrum and durable antibacterial effect, and provides fundamental guarantee for long-term sterile culture of the explants of the buds of China rose. Under the system, the China rose bud explant completes the complete period from flowering to decay by depending on slow release nutrition, and the ornamental period of the China rose cut flowers is obviously prolonged. In addition, the cut rose flowers also have complete transplanting survival capability after the ornamental period is finished, and the transformation from one-time consumption to sustainable cultivation is realized. The scheme has the industrialized advantages of short production period, high stability and low maintenance cost, is suitable for all-season regional application, remarkably improves the ornamental value and practicality of the product, and provides innovative products for the fields of home decoration, high-end gift, medical health care, education science popularization and the like.

title_en: Efficient germination culture method for embryo breaking through deep dormancy characteristic of tilia amurensis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant tissue culture and endangered tree species breeding, in particular to a seed embryo high-efficiency germination culture method breaking through the deep dormancy characteristic of tilia amurensis, which is used for solving the problems of low germination rate, long period, high pollution rate and poor embryo quality of the existing tilia amurensis seeds. The method comprises the steps of selecting a robust tilia amurensis parent tree in a specific area such as 129 DEG 19' +/-0.5 DEG, harvesting seeds with a water content of 45.25% -59.06% in the specific area of 29-9 months and 20 days, carrying out low-temperature lamination at 4 ℃ for 20 days, adding 50mg/L GA  3 , soaking for 12 hours, carrying out pretreatment and de-inhibition, carrying out accurate disinfection by 75% alcohol and 2% sodium hypochlorite, carrying out antioxidation treatment by using a vitamin C-humic acid solution after cutting 1-2mm of a seed coat, inoculating the seed coat into an optimized MS culture medium containing 0.1mg/L of hormones such as 6-BA, and carrying out dark culture at 22 ℃ for 5 days, and carrying out illumination culture at 24 ℃ and 2000 lx. The method has the advantages of high efficiency, deep dormancy breaking, low pollution rate, strong embryo, and capability of supporting large-scale breeding and population recovery of tilia amurensis.

title_en: Dendrobium officinale compound tea and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of processing technology of dendrobium tea, and particularly relates to dendrobium candidum compound tea and a preparation method and application thereof. The dendrobium candidum compound tea is prepared by mixing dendrobium candidum stems, dendrobium candidum leaves, medlar, roses and liquorice according to the proportion of (2.4 g-4 g) (0.4 g-0.8 g) (2.535 g:0.688g:0.400 g), and performing vacuum freeze drying on the dendrobium candidum stems and the dendrobium candidum leaves. The dendrobium candidum compound tea has high leaching rate and can effectively resist oxidation and maintain blood sugar health level.

title_en: Method for gene editing in soybean by using Cas12i
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and provides a method for performing gene editing in soybeans by using Cas12i, which comprises the following steps of constructing a plant binary vector for expressing the Cas12i nuclease, respectively mutating 369 th and 433 th amino acids of the Cas12i nuclease into arginine, designing gRNAs targeting soybean GmFAD2-1A genes and GmFAD2-1B genes, co-converting the gRNA expression cassette and the Cas12i nuclease expression cassette into soybean receptor materials by an agrobacterium-mediated method, and screening to obtain T0 generation transgenic plants, and identifying target gene editing types by molecular detection. The 369 th amino acid and the 433 th amino acid of the Cas12i nuclease are mutated into arginine simultaneously, so that the cutting activity and the targeting specificity of the nuclease in plant cells are obviously improved, double-gene knockout efficiency is doubled, and the adopted Cas12i nuclease recognizes a TTC-PAM sequence, so that more AT enrichment areas can be targeted, the editing window of a soybean genome is obviously expanded, and the off-target risk is reduced.

title_en: Sweet potato and sweet potato layered fermented milk and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sweet potato and sweet potato layered fermented milk and a preparation method thereof. The sweet potato is prepared from the following raw materials, by taking the total weight of the raw materials as a reference, 74-82% of raw milk, 8-12% of sweet substances and 10-14% of thickening agents, wherein the thickening agents comprise hydroxypropyl distarch phosphate (CMC) and xanthan gum. The invention relates to a sweet potato layered fermented milk, which comprises the sweet potato and the fermented milk. The sweet potato layered fermented milk provided by the invention has the advantages that the nutrition value is improved, the fluidity meets the process conditions of production and filling, the Q is soft and glutinous in shelf life and the stability is good, the sweet potato layered fermented milk provided by the invention has rich mouthfeel, the nutrition value of the product is higher, and the stability in the shelf life is good.

title_en: Milk powder for regulating blood sugar of rat model and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological detection and treatment, and discloses milk powder for regulating blood sugar of a rat model, which comprises, by mass, 3% -5% of selenium-rich wheat green powder, 70% -90% of basic milk powder and the balance of auxiliary materials. And can be added with multiple vitamins and prebiotics. According to the invention, selenium-rich wheat bran coat is added into milk powder, and simultaneously, reasonable collocation of various nutrients is combined, so that the function of regulating blood glucose metabolism in a rat experiment is realized.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine wine making system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a traditional Chinese medicine wine making system, which relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine wine making, and comprises a crushing mechanism, an ultrasonic extraction mechanism, a mixing device and a wine base, wherein the crushing mechanism comprises a supporting frame, a medicine charging barrel and a crushing shaft, the supporting frame is used for supporting the medicine charging barrel, the medicine charging barrel is used for storing medicinal materials, the crushing shaft is positioned in the medicine charging barrel in a working state and is circumferentially provided with a plurality of stirring blades for crushing the medicinal materials, the crushing shaft is provided with an adjusting component for adjusting the installation inclination angle of the stirring blades, the ultrasonic extraction mechanism is positioned at the discharge end of the crushing mechanism, a conveying channel is arranged between the crushing mechanism and the ultrasonic extraction mechanism, the crushed medicinal materials enter the ultrasonic extraction mechanism along the conveying channel and are subjected to ultrasonic extraction, and a filtering unit for filtering medicinal material waste is further arranged at the ultrasonic extraction mechanism, and medicinal material extract enters the mixing mechanism and the wine base for mixing. The application is used for solving the problems of low treatment efficiency of medicinal materials, complex structure of an extraction device and easy loss of beneficial components in extraction or weighing in the prior art.

title_en: Hu sheep active ingredient and application thereof in immunoregulation health care product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Hu sheep active ingredient and application thereof in an immunoregulation health-care product, belongs to the technical field of immunoregulation agents, and particularly relates to a Hu sheep active ingredient, wherein the Hu sheep active ingredient comprises a Hu sheep placenta extract and carnosic acid A, and the mass ratio of the Hu sheep placenta extract to the carnosic acid A is 1:0.11-0.23. The Hu sheep active ingredient disclosed by the invention can effectively remove free radicals, reduce the oxidative stress level, improve the antioxidation energy, enhance the forward regulation of phagocytic activity of phagocytes, enhance the immunity, and has good application value in an immunoregulation medicament.

title_en: Method for controlling breeding by using low-concentration EMS mutagenesis and time-efficient window of germinated seeds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-concentration EMS mutagenesis and time-efficient window control breeding method for germinated seeds, which comprises the steps of 1) sterilizing seeds, placing the seeds in sterile deionized water with 3-5 times of volume, soaking the seeds in sterile deionized water at a constant temperature of 25+/-1 ℃ until the seeds are just exposed to white, enabling the seeds to enter a germinated state from a dormant state, activating physiological metabolism, softening seed coats to obtain germinated seeds, 2) carrying out mutagenesis on the germinated seeds by adopting a low-concentration EMS working solution, wherein the volume concentration of the EMS working solution is less than 0.5%, 3) transferring the seeds obtained in the step 2) into 5-10 times of 5% sodium thiosulfate solution, soaking the seeds for 20-30 minutes, filtering the seeds, washing the seeds with a washing liquid until no EMS residues exist, and finally drying the surface moisture of the seeds, and 4) sowing the seeds obtained in the step 3) in 12 hours after the treatment, and then carrying out germination in an environment with the relative humidity of 70% -80%. The invention obviously reduces the concentration of EMS, overcomes the contradiction between mutagenesis efficiency and seed survival rate, and improves the seedling rate and the robustness.

title_en: Yellow tea piling and alcoholizing device based on damp-heat coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea alcoholization equipment, and discloses a yellow tea piling alcoholization device based on a wet-heat coupling effect, which comprises a box body, an alcoholization trough, a turning roller and a wet-heat coupling control device, wherein the box body is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, a bottom plate of the alcoholization trough is a porous plate, the bottom of the alcoholization trough is provided with a condensed water recovery trough, a rotating shaft in the middle of the alcoholization trough is connected with a rotating driving piece to adjust the dip angle, the turning roller is provided with a flexible turning plate, and the flexible turning plate is connected with the alcoholization trough through a linear driver and moves back and forth along the length direction of the alcoholization trough and rolls, and the wet-heat coupling control device comprises an air duct, a hot air blower, an exhaust fan, a humidifying device, a temperature and humidity detection device and a control device. According to the invention, uniform air supply and dehumidification along the path are realized through the air duct, and the reciprocating turning is matched, so that the stable and regular turning of the wet and hot conditions in the alcoholization process of the yellow tea is realized, and the alcoholization uniformity is improved.

title_en: Composite enzymolysis synergistic method for lotus seeds
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lotus seed compound enzymolysis synergistic method, which adopts compound pretreatment liquid composed of sodium bicarbonate, sodium sulfite and trisodium citrate to realize lotus seed wall breaking and enzyme inhibitor pretreatment, prepares difunctional modified cyclodextrin through epoxy activation, amino functionalization and hydrophobic modification, targets an inclusion enzyme inhibitor through double functions of hydrogen bond and hydrophobic, uses a compound enzyme preparation composed of cellulase, pectase, neutral protease and alpha-amylase according to a specific proportion, cooperates with the difunctional modified cyclodextrin to realize synergistic high-efficiency enzymolysis, carries out high-temperature inactivation, filtration separation after enzymolysis, and compounds residues back into enzymolysis liquid after activation treatment, and finally obtains a finished product through ultraviolet sterilization. The invention solves the problems of low enzymolysis efficiency, easy inhibition of enzyme activity, waste of raw materials and poor product stability of the prior art, realizes the full-component utilization of lotus seeds, has complete nutrition and good stability of the product, and improves the enzymolysis efficiency and the product quality.

title_en: Phenolic acid-enriched black sweet corn plant-based yoghurt and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses dark sweet corn plant-based yoghurt rich in phenolic acid, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, black sweet corn juice and soybean powder are used as matrixes, lactobacillus plantarum BFS1243 strain is compounded in a conventional plant-based yoghurt fermentation microbial inoculum, and composite fermentation is carried out, so that the prepared black sweet corn yoghurt is bright pink, fine in texture, low in beany flavor and remarkably improved in antioxidant activity effect. The BFS1243 strain is adopted for composite fermentation, so that glycosidic bonds on anthocyanin molecules in black sweet corn can be cut off, macromolecular anthocyanin with large molecular weight and low absorptivity is directionally degraded and converted into micromolecular phenolic acid, the problems that natural anthocyanin in black sweet corn is easy to degrade and low in bioavailability in the fermentation and storage processes are solved, the fermentation time can be shortened, the fermentation efficiency is improved, the flavor quality of fermented yoghourt is obviously improved, the unique corn aroma and pink appearance are presented, and more active substances and better antioxidant activity are provided.

title_en: Antarctic krill source xanthine oxidase inhibitory peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a euphausia superba source xanthine oxidase inhibitory peptide and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology, and particularly relating to the technology of bioactive peptide. The xanthine oxidase inhibitor peptide WRIPSRL with the amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 is obtained by taking antarctic krill protein as a raw material and adopting virtual screening, molecular docking and in-vitro activity verification technologies. The invention utilizes BIOPEP-UWM platform to make virtual hydrolysis, utilizes PEPTIDERANKER activity prediction and ToxinPred toxicity screening to obtain candidate peptide, then utilizes Autodock Vina algorithm to make molecular butt joint with xanthine oxidase crystal structure 1N5X to screen out high-affinity peptide segment, and makes external activity measurement show that IC  50  value of WRIPSRL peptide segment is 1.04 mM, and its inhibition rate is 48.68% under the condition of 1 mM concentration.

title_en: Environment-friendly production process for reducing bacteria of fresh meat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bacteria-reducing environment-friendly production process for fresh meat, which comprises the following steps of slaughtering pigs qualified in production place inspection in a slaughter house, flushing the live pigs in a clean water tank, introducing waste water generated by flushing into a recovery purification tower, carrying out quarantine and quality inspection, cutting and blocking for standby, bleeding the stunned pigs for no more than 5 minutes, scalding, peeling and eviscerating the pigs, carrying out surface irradiation on the pork blocks by using a UV sterilizing lamp by adopting an ultraviolet sterilizing technology, and then uniformly spraying overheat steam on the surface of the fresh meat at a sterilizing treatment station for sterilization. The invention has compact and reasonable structure and convenient operation, and ensures that the fresh meat surface is uniformly heated and sterilized in a low-oxygen or micro-oxygen environment through the overheat steam in a short time.

title_en: Method for improving color of vacuum skin packaged fresh meat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the color of vacuum skin packaged fresh meat, belonging to the technical field of food preservation. The invention forms a thicker oxymyoglobin layer on the surface of fresh meat through supercharging treatment in a high-oxygen environment at the front end of the vacuum skin packaging process, and inhibits the oxygen consumption of mitochondria in the fresh meat, thereby solving the problem that the fresh meat in the vacuum skin packaging process is dark purple red, and further limiting the capacity of competing oxygen between mitochondria and oxymyoglobin by matching with-1 ℃ ice temperature control, and obviously inhibiting the proliferation of microorganisms and the oxidation of lipids, so as to realize the effective balance among flesh color stability, microorganism inhibition and oxidation control. To avoid hard switching of fresh meat from high oxygen boost conditions to low residual oxygen conditions of the skin packaging to be vacuum, color abrupt changes are reduced. The invention further increases transition oxygen-reduction color stabilization treatment and controlled pressure-reduction treatment after the step of pressure-increasing and color-increasing treatment, so that the fresh meat is in transition atmosphere close to the atmospheric oxygen concentration, the color stability of the fresh meat is improved, and the risks of surface damage, local color difference and the like are reduced.

title_en: Chicken bone zymolyte rich in taste peptide, preparation method thereof and application thereof in chicken soup product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chicken bone zymolyte rich in taste peptide, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in chicken soup products, and relates to the technical field of food biology. The method comprises the steps of S100, steaming fresh chicken bones at high temperature and high pressure, obtaining chicken bone extract and bone residues through solid-liquid separation, S200, adding water into the bone residues to prepare, adopting a step-by-step temperature-control enzymolysis process, sequentially adding two types of compound enzyme systems to carry out directional enzymolysis, S300, merging the enzymolysis liquid after enzyme deactivation with the chicken bone extract obtained in the step S100, adopting three-stage membrane filtration, collecting trapped fluid with the molecular weight of 300-1500 Da, S400, concentrating the trapped fluid, and drying to obtain the target chicken bone zymolyte. The invention realizes the efficient enrichment of 300-1500 Da flavor peptide, the flavor peptide in the combined liquid of the zymolyte and the extracting solution accounts for more than 72 percent of the total peptide content, the flavor activity of the small molecular peptide is reserved, and the product has strong chicken flavor and lasting thickness return feeling.

title_en: Oil gel-based W/O emulsion and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil gel-based W/O emulsion and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of emulsion preparation. The preparation method of the oil gel-based W/O emulsion comprises the steps of preparing oil gel by melting wax into rapeseed oil, then slowly dispersing an aqueous phase into the oil gel dropwise to form an oil-water mixture, and then shearing and emulsifying to obtain the oil gel-based W/O emulsion. The oil gel formed by the solar sunflower wax and the beeswax has higher oil binding capacity, hardness, viscosity and deformation resistance, can stabilize higher water phase (50%), has smaller droplet size and stronger gel structure, and the prepared oil gel-based W/O emulsion has better emulsifying property and stability and wider application value in fat substitution varieties.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating constipation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines and health products, and in particular relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition for preventing and treating constipation and application thereof. The invention relates to a Chinese medicinal composition for preventing and treating constipation, which is prepared from three or four of chicory, dandelion, mulberry and astragalus root. The invention provides a new medicine choice for preventing and treating constipation, and the traditional Chinese medicine composition has the characteristics of simple medicine taste, medicine and food containing two medicines, rich medicine sources and high safety, and has better clinical application prospect and economic utilization value.

title_en: SmDMP-based eggplant haploid induction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SmDMP-based eggplant haploid induction method, which relates to the technical field of molecular breeding and comprises the following steps of gene cloning and vector construction; the invention applies the DMP gene to the haploid induction of the eggplant for the first time, successfully creates a stable inheritance male parent haploid induction system of the eggplant, successfully establishes a female parent haploid induction system mediated by the eggplant DMP gene, greatly improves the breeding efficiency of the eggplant, can be popularized and applied to haploid breeding of eggplant and other solanaceous crops, has the induction rate of 1.05-2.11 percent, is simple and convenient to operate, has no genotype dependency, can identify the haploid through molecular markers in the seedling stage, greatly improves the breeding efficiency, can accurately predict the haploid through PCR amplification, flow cytometry and phenotype observation, saves the field identification cost, and provides technical support for rapid polymerization of the characteristics of fixed hybridization advantages, disease resistance, high yield and the like of the eggplant, and has wide popularization value.

title_en: Preparation method and application of cabbage type rape BnaALC gene and mutant thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a cabbage type rape BnaALC gene and a mutant thereof, and relates to the technical field of rape molecular breeding. The mutant is obtained by knocking out 2 homologous copy genes of BnaALC genes, wherein the homologous copy genes are BnaALC.A07 genes shown in SEQ ID NO. 1 and BnaALC.C07 genes shown in SEQ ID NO. 2 respectively. According to the invention, 2 homologous copies (BnaALC A07 and BnaALC.C07) of BnaALC genes are targeted and knocked out through CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, and a BnaALC gene mutant cabbage type rape mutant is obtained, and researches show that the flowering time of a double homozygous mutant strain is 8 days earlier than that of a wild type strain, so that the BnaALC genes can be applied to rape breeding to improve rape yield traits, and the method has great application potential and prospect, and provides new germplasm resources for rape quality breeding.

title_en: Eye-protecting blueberry juice and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses eye-protecting blueberry juice and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of functional beverage preparation. The blueberry juice comprises 30ml of blueberry juice, 5-8mg of lutein microcapsule powder, 1-2mg of zeaxanthin microcapsule powder, 20-30mg of DHA seaweed oil, 5g of semen cassiae extract, 5g of chrysanthemum extract and 30ml of auxiliary materials. The core raw materials of the invention are natural or functional raw materials which meet the national food safety standard and have the eye protection effect.

title_en: Medicine and food homologous composite powder for improving female qi and blood deficiency and brightening skin color
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicine and food homologous composite powder for improving female deficiency of qi and blood and brightening skin and a preparation process thereof, wherein the medicine and food homologous composite powder comprises 10g of donkey-hide gelatin powder, red rose powder with heavy petals, red date powder, medlar powder, poria cocos powder, yam powder, mulberry powder and vitamin C. The preparation method comprises oven drying at low temperature, micronizing, mixing under aseptic condition, sterilizing with microwave, and packaging into strip. The invention has scientific and mild formula, synergistic effect of medicinal and edible components, can effectively nourish qi and blood, warm uterus and resist fatigue, lighten skin color, improve cold hands and feet, has simple process, is easy to produce in mass, is portable and easy to absorb, and is suitable for long-term daily nourishing of females.

title_en: Coffee flavored chocolate composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a delicious coffee-flavored chocolate composition having a good balance of bitterness, fruit flavor and body taste, and a method for producing the same. The content of ethyl acetate in the chocolate composition is adjusted to 5-1500 ppb, and/or the content of phenethyl alcohol is adjusted to 5-1500 ppb, and the total content of cafestol palmitate and cafestol palmitate is adjusted to 700-7800 mg/kg.

title_en: Method for improving quality of flour products by using static magnetic field to assist dough fermentation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food biological processing, and particularly relates to a method for improving the quality of flour products by utilizing static magnetic field to assist the fermentation of sour dough. Flour raw material, water, and an acid dough leavening agent are kneaded and shaped, and then leavened in an environment where a static magnetic field is applied. The invention is suitable for different flour raw materials, and can improve the fermentation rate of dough, improve the quality of products and improve the content of bioactive substances of the products by carrying out magnetic field treatment on the sour dough in the fermentation process. Meanwhile, the invention can accelerate the acidification rate of the acid dough through carrying out magnetic field treatment in the preparation process of the acid dough, further regulate and control the quality of the final product, and enrich the application mode of the static magnetic field in the field of acid dough processing. The method is safe, green and residue-free, accords with the trend of the modern food industry of cleaning labels, has simple process and is easy to realize industrialized application.

title_en: Automatic fermentation device is used in processing of paver formula tealeaves
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea processing and discloses a fermentation device for automatic paving type tea processing, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a fermentation box, a fermentation frame is arranged in the fermentation box, a plurality of round holes are formed in the fermentation frame, a sliding sleeve is driven by an electric push rod to transversely reciprocate along a sliding rod, a turning rod is driven to conduct long-distance translation in the fermentation frame, the tea turning uniformity is improved, and gears at two ends are meshed with racks in the translation process of the rotating rod. When the rotary rod moves to the left end and the right end of the box body, the gear drives the rotary rod to automatically rotate together with the turning rod, so that the stirring angle of the turning rod is switched from translational pushing to rotary turning, bottom tea leaves are forced to be lifted up, surface tea leaves are forced to sink down, deep three-dimensional replacement is realized, fermentation uniformity is remarkably improved, the problems of dead end accumulation, partial fermentation overuse or mildew existing in traditional scraper type turning are thoroughly solved, and each tea leaf is ensured to participate in cyclic turning.

title_en: Low-diacetyl saccharomyces cerevisiae composition and application thereof in beer fermentation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of food fermentation and beer brewing, and provides a low diacetyl saccharomyces cerevisiae composition and application thereof in beer fermentation, the invention combines industrial saccharomyces cerevisiae with controlled micro-flocculation and ionic crosslinking sodium alginate-pectin microsphere bi-component containing L-valine, and introduces cell wall fragments of homologous saccharomyces cerevisiae and a delayed release design, the method forms a feeding system which takes account of the stability of yeast recycling, the metabolic contact of main fermentation and the release regulation of valine, realizes the generation inhibition of diacetyl precursors, the stabilization of microsphere frameworks and the adaptation of the main fermentation process, solves the problem that the flocculation recycling of yeast and the control of low diacetyl are difficult to take account of, and is suitable for the feeding of beer main fermentation and the recycling management of industrial yeast.

title_en: Astaxanthin-producing probiotic yeast engineering bacteria, and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses astaxanthin-producing probiotic yeast engineering bacteria, and a construction method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of synthetic biology. The engineering bacteria take beta-carotene producing saccharomyces cerevisiae as chassis cells, the genome of the engineering bacteria integrates fusion genes subjected to adaptive screening, the genes are formed by sequentially connecting a Brevundimonas source BDC263crtW, a flexible connecting peptide and an alcaligenes source AspcrtZ, and meanwhile, on the basis of carrying out systematic expression screening on a plurality of key genes, an endogenous acetyl-CoA synthetic key gene ACS1 is optimized and overexpressed, and an acetic acid metabolism negative regulation gene YPL062W is knocked out. The construction method comprises plasmid construction and genome targeted integration of the fusion expression module and the ACS1 expression module. According to the invention, through enzyme source optimization and substrate channel effect, the astaxanthin synthesis level is obviously improved, and the environmental tolerance and the antioxidant capacity of engineering bacteria in the simulated gastrointestinal tract are enhanced. The engineering bacteria can be directly used as a functional live bacteria preparation for food and feed additives, and has wide industrial application prospect.

title_en: Application of fern AnGRAS gene of lotus leaf in improving flooding stress resistance of plants
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of plant genetic engineering, and particularly discloses application of a lotus leaf iron wire AnGRAS gene in improving water flooding stress resistance of plants. According to the invention, anGRAS gene is cloned from the lotus leaf iron wire fern for the first time, the gene function is verified, an agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation method is utilized to obtain an arabidopsis plant of which the expression is AnGRAS through constructing AnGRAS19 over-expression vector, and experimental results show that the over-expression AnGRAS19 can obviously enhance the tolerance of the plant to flooding stress, and the survival rate is improved, the photosynthetic activity is enhanced, the integrity of cell membranes is maintained, the proline content and the capability of resisting peroxyanions are improved, and meanwhile, the accumulation of malondialdehyde and hydrogen peroxide is reduced. The gene can be used for waterlogging-resistant genetic improvement of forest, crops and ecological restoration plants, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Feed for improving muscle quality of hexagrammos otakii and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of compound feeds for marine fishes, and particularly relates to a feed for improving muscle quality of hexagram and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a feed for improving muscle quality of six-line greenling, which is prepared from the following raw materials, by mass, 93.5% -96.5% of a basic ingredient, 1% of a compound vitamin, 1% of a compound mineral salt and 1.5% -4.5% of a compound feed composition, wherein the sum of the mass percentages of the raw materials is 100%, the compound feed composition comprises yeast beta-glucan, chitosan oligosaccharide and coated sodium butyrate, and the mass ratio of the yeast beta-glucan, the chitosan oligosaccharide and the coated sodium butyrate is 1-3:1-2. The invention not only effectively reduces fat deposition of the six-line fish body, improves the elasticity and chewing property of the muscle of the six-line fish body, but also obviously improves the texture characteristic of the fish meat, thereby realizing the improvement of the whole muscle quality of the six-line fish body and meeting the preference of consumers.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant intestinal targeted release active substance microcapsule and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high Wen Changdao targeted release resistant active substance microcapsule, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of food functional factor embedding. The invention takes grape seed procyanidine obtained by single-stage alcohol extraction-macroporous resin purification as a core material, takes High Methoxyl Pectin (HMP) and hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose phthalate (HPMCP) as composite wall materials, and prepares the microcapsule by combining high-speed shearing emulsification and spray drying processes. According to the invention, through the synergistic effect of the composite wall materials, the microcapsule has excellent high-temperature-resistant processing stability and pH response type intestinal targeted release characteristics, so that degradation and inactivation of grape seed procyanidine in hot processing, storage and gastric acid environments can be obviously reduced, and the low-sugar-increasing function of which procyanidine content and alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase inhibiting activity are core is efficiently reserved.

title_en: Method for fermenting and culturing feeding yarrowia lipolytica by using corn processing sugar-making waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fermenting and culturing feeding yarrowia lipolytica by using corn processing sugar-making waste liquid. The invention uses the main waste glucose crystallization secondary mother liquor and corn steep liquor generated by corn processing and sugar manufacturing as a carbon source and a nitrogen source respectively, and utilizes a fermentation tank to culture yarrowia lipolytica by adopting an aerobic feed supplement mode. The required culture medium and feed supplement liquid only need two raw materials of secondary mother liquor and corn steep liquor except necessary pH adjustment and addition of defoamer, and under the condition that the fermentation pre-stage culture medium and fermentation operation are the same, the later feed supplement stage only changes the proportion of the secondary mother liquor and the corn steep liquor in the feed supplement liquid, namely the goals of high accumulation of grease, high accumulation of protein and high yield of thalli in the yarrowia lipolytica cells obtained by culture are respectively realized, and the characteristics of high polyunsaturated fatty acid content of grease accumulated by the yarrowia lipolytica and rich amino acids such as lysine, serine and leucine of protein are not changed.

title_en: Sow anti-stress functional feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sow anti-stress functional feed and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sow anti-stress functional feed comprises, by weight, 700-850 parts of a basic feed, 0.5-3 parts of probiotics, 0.01-0.05 part of yeast selenium, 5-15 parts of compound amino acid, 1-3 parts of vitamin premix, 2-5 parts of mineral premix and 10-30 parts of carrier, the probiotics are compound microbial inoculum of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, bacillus subtilis and Pediococcus acidilactici, the weight ratio of the three is 3:2:1, the viable count is more than or equal to 80 hundred million CFU/g, and the organic selenium content in the yeast selenium is more than or equal to 2000ppm. The invention has scientific formula and remarkable synergistic effect, organically combines probiotics, yeast selenium and compound amino acid, wherein the probiotics regulate intestinal microecology balance, the yeast selenium enhances the oxidation resistance of organisms, the compound amino acid supplements nutrition loss, effectively relieves the stress reaction of sows, solves the problem of limited anti-stress effect of single component, has balanced nutrition, and meets the nutrition requirements of sows at different stages.

title_en: Lily white kidney bean chewable tablet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A lily white kidney bean chewable tablet and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of chewable tablet processing, and the lily white kidney bean chewable tablet comprises the following components in parts by weight, 20 parts of dried lily powder, 25 parts of white kidney bean powder, 10 parts of maltodextrin, 5 parts of sorbitol, 1 part of magnesium stearate, 0.4 part of citric acid and a proper amount of pure water. The invention destroys partial starch structure in lily, so that the contained mucilage is easier to be absorbed by human body, the component has an auxiliary effect on regulating blood fat, the treatment on white kidney beans can prevent the contained phytohemagglutinin and trypsin inhibitor from obstructing protein absorption and stimulating intestines and stomach, the dietary fiber and B vitamins in the white kidney beans can be reserved to the greatest extent, and the invention is beneficial to controlling sugar and reducing blood fat.

title_en: New use
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of reducing methane emissions from ruminants. In particular, the invention relates to the administration of a combination of 3-nitrooxypropanol and/or a derivative thereof and linoleic acid to ruminants for reducing methane production caused by digestive activity of the ruminant.

title_en: Bean soy sauce crude oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bean soy sauce crude oil and a preparation method thereof, and provides a pretreatment method of bean materials for preparing soy sauce crude oil, which comprises the steps of carrying out ultrasonic treatment on soaked bean materials in a liquid medium, preparing the bean materials by the pretreatment method, further providing a preparation method of the bean soy sauce crude oil, providing the bean materials, and preparing soy sauce by using the bean materials as raw materials. The invention provides a novel pretreatment process of soy sauce, which is used for improving the amino acid nitrogen and total nitrogen content in soy sauce crude oil prepared by fermentation by matching with a conventional fermentation process, improving the protein utilization rate, further reducing the turbidity of the soy sauce crude oil and simplifying the subsequent clarification step.

title_en: Wheat scab resistance gene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheat scab resistance gene TaCXIP and application thereof, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the gene is shown as SEQ ID N0.1, the amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, the gene belongs to a binding protein family of calcium ion antiport protein, the gene is introduced into wheat for functional verification, the wheat scab resistance capability is obviously enhanced after the gene is over-expressed, and TaCXIP4 of the gene can be used as an excellent scab resistance candidate gene resource and has important application value in breeding of wheat disease resistance molecules.

title_en: Construction method and application of artificial sweetener neotame-induced zebra fish Parkinson disease model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction of a zebra fish Parkinson disease model, and particularly discloses a construction method and application of an artificial sweetener neotame-induced zebra fish Parkinson disease model, wherein the technical key points are that the construction method comprises the steps of mixing neotame with water to obtain neotame aqueous solution mother liquor with mass volume concentration of 1 g/L; and diluting the mother solution into a working solution with the mass volume concentration of 1-100 mg/L by using feeding water, and exposing the zebra fish to the working solution for 4 weeks to obtain the neotame-induced zebra fish Parkinson disease animal model. The invention also provides a model constructed by the method, an evaluation method of the model and application thereof. The model can be used for research of nervous system diseases, screening of neotame neurotoxicity, evaluation of neotame neurotoxicity in food and high-throughput screening of anti-Parkinson medicines.

title_en: Method for producing nutrient-rich wheat flour and color wheat whole wheat product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing eutrophic wheat flour and a color wheat whole wheat product, which comprises the steps of wheat cleaning, preparing cold plasma activated water, wetting color wheat, germinating, directly pulverizing germinated color wheat to obtain the eutrophic wheat flour, wet-pulverizing germinated color wheat to obtain wheat slurry, inoculating lactobacillus and enzyme for fermentation, flash drying to obtain color wheat whole wheat flour, concentrating the wheat slurry to 30-35% of water to form extrudable dough, feeding the extrudable dough into an extruding noodle machine, extruding and forming by a noodle die, and (9) adopting a step low-temperature air drying step to prepare noodles. The invention can efficiently enrich specific nutritional components in the color wheat, realize high nutritional retention of flour products, improve the purity and color of flour, and simultaneously realize the reduction of energy consumption in preparation and processing links.

title_en: Method for applying acidic electrolyzed water and chitosan to fresh-keeping of fresh-cut apples in combined manner and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of non-thermal sterilization and preservation, and discloses a method for applying acid electrolyzed water and chitosan to fresh-cut apples preservation in a combined way and application, comprising the following steps of S1, preparing the acid electrolyzed water, namely adopting a three-tank double-diaphragm type acid electrolyzed water device system, and obtaining the acid electrolyzed water containing available chlorine through setting parameters and electrolysis; S2, preparing a chitosan coating solution, namely mixing chitosan with an acetic acid aqueous solution, dissolving at room temperature, adjusting the pH value to 5.0, and carrying out combined treatment on the S3, acidic electrolyzed water and chitosan, namely soaking fresh-cut apples in the acidic electrolyzed water obtained in the S1, soaking in the chitosan coating solution obtained in the S2, naturally airing a ventilated place, and storing for later use. The method belongs to a non-thermal processing technology, is favorable for keeping the biological activity of the fresh-cut fruits by low-temperature treatment, is environment-friendly, has obvious fresh-keeping effect and has good application potential.

title_en: Cold water fish fermentation product obtained by synergistic fermentation of microorganism composition and preparation method thereof
