abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold water fish fermentation product obtained by synergistic fermentation of a microbial composition and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of microbial fermentation foods. The invention compounds lactobacillus plantarum, lactobacillus sake and saccharomyces cerevisiae into a microbial composition, prepares composite bacterial liquid of three microorganisms into pickling liquid, takes back muscles of cold water fish as raw materials, and obtains cold water fish fermentation products through pickling, drying and fermentation treatment. Experimental results show that the microbial composition provided by the invention can be inoculated to rapidly produce acid to form a low pH environment, can efficiently regulate and control protein hydrolysis, remarkably shortens fermentation period, inhibits lipid oxidation and reduces TBARS value. The invention provides a novel microorganism composition and a fermentation method for low-salt, high-efficiency and safe fermentation of the cold water fish, and lays a foundation for improving the fermentation flavor of the cold water fish fermentation product, stabilizing the product quality and improving the edible safety of the product.

title_en: Production and preparation process of flower-color nutrition fine dried noodles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing and discloses a production and preparation process of a peanut colored nutrition fine dried noodles, which comprises the following steps of mixing wheat flour, fruit and vegetable powder, sodium alginate, glucono-delta-lactone and sodium citrate to obtain a dry powder material; spraying saline water under vacuum for low-speed kneading, atomizing and spraying a fat phase suspension system containing vegetable oil and calcium ascorbate, mixing at medium speed, curing, calendaring and shredding, and performing multistage stepped heating drying and normal-temperature tempering. According to the invention, a lipid phase suspension system is utilized to physically separate a calcium source in the early stage, and the lactone is heated by water to interpret acid in the heating and drying stage, so that calcium ions are triggered to release and gel crosslinking is carried out with sodium alginate in situ. The process remodels the internal skeleton of the noodle, compensates for gluten weakening caused by fruit and vegetable powder, reduces the breakage rate, and simultaneously utilizes the released ascorbate and the grease layer to cooperatively slow down pigment oxidation and maintain the color stability of the finished product.

title_en: Dietary fiber composition containing Kluyveromyces marxianus beta-glucan and application of dietary fiber composition in puffed rice cakes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dietary fiber composition containing Kluyveromyces marxianus beta-glucan and application thereof in puffed rice cakes, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The dietary fiber composition comprises, by mass, 5-30 parts of Kluyveromyces marxianus beta-glucan compound, 40-85 parts of cereal powder, 5-25 parts of dietary fiber, 2-10 parts of natural sweetener, 1-5 parts of grease, 0.2-2 parts of emulsifier and 0.5-3 parts of leavening agent. The compound is prepared by mixing Kluyveromyces marxianus beta-glucan and citrus fiber according to the mass ratio of 1:0.5-1:2, adjusting the pH to 6.0-7.5, preserving heat at 50-70 ℃ and stirring, and freeze-drying. The invention obviously improves the retention rate of the beta-glucan in the high-temperature baking and puffing process by a pre-compounding technology, improves the puffing degree of the product and synergistically enhances the yield of short-chain fatty acid.

title_en: Brewing process of natural organic germanium health-preserving yellow wine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sectional temperature control brewing process of natural organic germanium health-preserving yellow wine, and belongs to the technical field of yellow wine brewing. Aiming at the defects of long fermentation period (about 6 months), high alcohol content (12-16% vol), easy oxidation and deterioration, high biogenic amine content and weak functionality of the traditional Hakka yellow wine, the invention adopts high-quality glutinous rice and natural germanium-rich spring water as raw materials, adopts three-stage temperature control fermentation processes of primary fermentation 28-30 ℃, middle fermentation 25-28 ℃ and secondary fermentation 15-17 ℃ to shorten the fermentation period to 45 days, and prepares the functional yellow wine with alcohol content of 9-10% vol and organic germanium content of 0.1-0.3mg/100 mL. The organic germanium has the functions of scavenging free radicals, resisting oxidation, enhancing immunoregulation and delaying oxidative deterioration, and can effectively relieve the problems of easy oxidation and insufficient health care of the traditional yellow wine. The process retains the mellow flavor of the non-genetic yellow wine, remarkably reduces biogenic amine, has health care value, and is suitable for mass production of low-alcohol health care yellow wine.

title_en: Artificial sea cylinder system and construction and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial sea vat system and a construction and operation method thereof, and relates to the field of aquatic animal cultivation, wherein a bottom vat is fixed at the bottom of a main vat, and is sequentially divided into a physical filtering bin, an egg separating bin, a filtering material bin, an algae vat bin and a water pump bin along the water flow direction; the water in the main cylinder enters the physical filtering bin through the overflow port and can sequentially flow through the egg separating bin, the filtering material bin, the algae cylinder bin and the water pump bin, the water pump bin is used for conveying the water back to the main cylinder to form a water circulation loop, the filtering material is arranged in the main cylinder and the bottom cylinder and used as a biological adhesion carrier and a landscaping structure, the directional domestication strain combination comprises nitrifying bacteria, denitrifying bacteria, heterotrophic degrading bacteria, purple non-sulfur bacteria and pseudoalteromonas corallina, artificial sea salt is used for constructing an artificial sea water environment and providing element supplement for marine organisms, and the water quality regulation and control composition comprises a nutrient salt stripping component and a nutrient salt supplementing component and is used for cooperatively regulating and controlling the carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus metabolism dynamic balance of the system. The system has stable and rapid water quality and high biological survival rate.

title_en: Special astragalus glycollic peptide for waterfowl
abstract_en: The invention provides a special astragalus glycollic peptide for waterfowl, which adopts four composite probiotics of duck-origin lactobacillus plantarum, bacillus subtilis, aspergillus niger and candida utilis for synergistic fermentation. The process not only improves dissolution rate and bioavailability of active ingredients in radix astragali, but also generates novel functional factors by microorganism metabolism. The fermentation product is rich in antibacterial peptide, has obvious inhibition effect on common pathogenic bacteria of waterfowl such as Riemerella anatipestifer, escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus and salmonella, and the antibacterial activity of the prepared antibacterial peptide preparation is obviously enhanced. The product is used as a feed additive, and has important application prospects in the aspects of promoting the growth and development of waterfowl, improving intestinal health, improving feed conversion rate, reducing antibiotic use and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of plantain and herba brassicae probiotic enzyme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of plantain and ash vegetable probiotics ferment, which relates to the technical field of preparation of plantain and ash vegetable probiotics ferment, and comprises the steps of firstly removing impurities from freshly collected plantain and ash vegetable, cleaning and draining, mixing in proportion, pulping to obtain mixed slurry, heating the mixed slurry to a set temperature, standing at constant temperature to complete enzyme deactivation treatment, performing rough filtration and deslagging to obtain clarified mixed juice, adjusting the content of soluble solids of the mixed juice, inoculating a compound microbial inoculum of lactobacillus plantarum and bacillus coagulans, performing first-stage constant-temperature anaerobic fermentation, adding a slow-release carbon source in a fermentation medium stage, transferring into second-stage constant-temperature anaerobic fermentation, and sequentially performing retarded cooling, low-temperature standing clarification and low-temperature instantaneous sterilization treatment after fermentation to obtain ferment finished products. The invention can directionally degrade anti-nutritional factors such as oxalic acid, irritant alkaloid and the like in the raw materials, passivate endogenous enzymes, avoid the loss of active ingredients in a large amount, greatly improve the viable count of the finished product and ensure high safety of the finished product.

title_en: Application of DlACS gene in plant type regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant genetic engineering and molecular breeding, and particularly relates to application of DlACS gene in plant type regulation. The invention constructs a plant over-expression vector by cloning a longan DlACS gene cDNA sequence and converts a receptor plant, thereby verifying the gene function. Experiments show that transgenic plants over-expressing DlACS gene show significant character change, namely, the plant height is reduced significantly, the internode length is shortened, the branch number is increased, the leaf area is reduced and the plant is round. Further research shows that the gene can obviously promote the biosynthesis of plant endogenous ethylene. Therefore, the longan DlACS gene, the expression vector and the transgenic material thereof can be applied to plant dwarf breeding, plant type improvement, branch regulation and control and research on plant hormone regulation and control, and have higher application value in the fields of plant molecular breeding and genetic improvement.

title_en: Dragon fruit and longan ferment raw juice beverage and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food fermentation, and discloses a dragon fruit and longan ferment primary pulp drink and a preparation process thereof, wherein the drink consists of 400-430 parts of 1-year fermented dragon fruit ferment primary pulp, 40-50 parts of 5-year fermented dragon fruit ferment primary pulp, 350-380 parts of longan ferment primary pulp, 160-180 parts of isomaltooligosaccharide, 30-80 parts of tremella polysaccharide clear liquid and 30-60 parts of dragon fruit residue emulsion. The preparation method comprises fermenting fresh juice of dragon fruit with yeast, acetic acid bacteria and lactobacillus step by step, aging for 1 year and 5 years respectively, recovering concentrated juice of longan to 15-18% of soluble solids, fermenting with lactobacillus, mixing, filtering, packaging, and pasteurizing. The product has mellow and coordinated flavor and rich organic acid by combining the dragon fruit ferment with multi-strain fermentation and matching with longan ferment primary pulp, tremella polysaccharide clear liquid and dragon fruit residue emulsion, and the bentonite clarification process is adopted, so that the precipitation is effectively prevented, and the shelf life stability is high.

title_en: Cellulase mutant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cellulase mutant and a preparation method and application thereof. The cellulase mutant has the following mutation of Y40K and/or T177K based on the amino acid sequence SEQ ID NO. 1. The specific activity of the mutant is obviously superior to that of a wild-type enzyme at the low temperature of 20-50 ℃, and the specific activity is respectively improved to 4.0 times and 4.9 times of that of the wild-type enzyme at the temperature of 30-40 ℃. In the saccharification of waste cut stems of tobacco, the yield of reducing sugar in the mutant treatment group is nearly 2 times that of the wild type. The cellulase mutant provided by the invention has higher catalytic activity under the medium-low temperature condition, and can be widely applied to the fields of papermaking, spinning, biofuel production, tobacco waste treatment and the like.

title_en: Method for enhancing stability of protein peptide emulsion through glycosylation-calcium bridge synergistic modification and preparation of nutrition emulsion thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of processing of nutritional formula foods, and discloses a method for enhancing the stability of protein peptide emulsion through glycosylation-calcium bridge synergistic modification. The method comprises the steps of carrying out glycosylation reaction on protein peptide and carbohydrate, adding calcium chloride before emulsification, and inducing proper crosslinking of glycosylated protein peptide through calcium bridge under the condition of room temperature or heating, so as to regulate self-assembly behavior of protein peptide and emulsion formation process, thereby improving thermal stability and ion tolerance of protein peptide emulsion. The invention also discloses a protein peptide nutrition emulsion prepared based on the synergistic modification technology, wherein each 100mL nutrition emulsion comprises 3-8 g protein peptide, 2-12 g grease, 8-30 g carbohydrate, 0.25-2 mmol calcium chloride (namely 10-80 mg calcium element), 0.05-0.5 g compound vitamin and 0.02-1 g compound mineral. The obtained nutritional emulsion has obviously better long-term stability after high-temperature sterilization. The method can be widely applied to the production of special meal emulsion foods such as high-stability protein base materials, full-nutrition emulsion and the like, and the protein peptide nutrition emulsion can meet the requirement of people for protein peptide absorption.

title_en: Rapid propagation method for axillary bud origin of North America ilex
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid propagation method of an axillary bud of North American ilex, which comprises the following steps of (1) collecting an external germ, obtaining the axillary bud after disinfection and sterilization, slicing for standby, (2) placing the slice on a culture medium for primary culture to obtain the primary axillary bud, wherein the culture medium comprises a Z culture medium (the concentration of ammonium nitrate is 900 mg/L) and 0.2mg/L of 6-BA, (3) cutting the primary axillary bud into segments, placing the segments on the culture medium for secondary culture to obtain stem segments, wherein the culture medium comprises a Z culture medium (the concentration of ammonium nitrate is 700 mg/L), 150mg/L of glutamine and 0.2mg/L of BAP, (4) cutting the stem segments, placing the stem segments on the culture medium for rooting culture to obtain seedlings, and the rooting culture components comprise R culture medium and IBA of 10  ‑6 ) after transplanting and domestication, continuing seedling cultivation. The invention directly enters rooting culture from primary culture, and realizes large-scale proliferation through repeated secondary culture.

title_en: Simple preservation method for arrowroot families in bamboo mountain
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of storage and preservation of agricultural products after picking, and particularly relates to a simple household preservation method for arrowroot in a bamboo mountain. The method comprises four steps of raw material pretreatment, pre-drying, bagging, winding, sealing and storage. Aiming at the problems of large equipment investment, complicated operation and inapplicability to daily household storage of the conventional arrowroot preservation technology, the invention provides a preservation method for forming a self-air-conditioning microenvironment in a bag by utilizing the combined operation of pre-airing, dehydration and winding sealing of a common household polyethylene preservation bag. Actual detection proves that the preservation period of the arrowroot processed by the method can reach more than one year under the normal temperature condition of 10-25 ℃, the moisture content after preservation is kept at about 59.3%, the protein content and the crude fiber content are kept stable, the puerarin content is kept at a higher level of 2869 mug/g, and the sprouting and rotting phenomena are avoided. The invention has the advantages of no need of special equipment, simple operation and low cost, and is suitable for popularization and use by families and farmers.

title_en: Method for improving feed digestibility of bovine animals
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for increasing the digestibility of a feed for bovine animals, in particular to the use of a combination of at least one bacterial amylase and a mixture of at least two essential oil compounds selected from the group consisting of thymol, eugenol, m-cresol, vanillin and guaiacol in a feed for ruminants of the subfamily nikovia for improving weight gain, milk yield and/or Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR). Examples of bovine animals are beef cattle and dairy cows.

title_en: Nanometer calcium carbonate modifier and modification method of nanometer calcium carbonate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano calcium carbonate preparation, and particularly relates to a nano calcium carbonate modifier and a nano calcium carbonate modification method. The nano calcium carbonate modifier comprises, by weight, 70-95 parts of a component A and 5-25 parts of a component B, wherein the component A is at least one of citric acid, sodium citrate, lactic acid, calcium lactate, malic acid, tartaric acid, succinic acid and fumaric acid or at least one of salts formed by the acids, and the component B is sodium starch octenyl succinate, pectin, xanthan gum, acacia gum and inulin. The nano calcium carbonate modifier provided by the invention can ensure the food safety of the end product on one hand, and on the other hand, the calcium carbonate modified by the modifier has good dispersibility in an aqueous system.

title_en: Lactobacillus plantarum LL20, microbial inoculum, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses lactobacillus plantarum LL20, a microbial inoculum, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms, wherein the lactobacillus plantarum LL20 is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) No. M20232427 in 12-04 of 2023, and the preservation address is China university of Wuhan. The invention solves the problem that the traditional probiotics have limited effects in reducing blood uric acid level and improving related inflammation, and the lactobacillus plantarum LL20 has the capability of directly degrading uric acid, has stronger intestinal tract colonisation capability and probiotic capability, can improve blood uric acid, creatinine and urea level in vivo, protect liver and kidney, improve intestinal flora and organism metabolism level, can obviously reduce uric acid, and has the effect of preventing gout.

title_en: Erythrina straw SsPP C gene for improving salt tolerance of plants and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a erythrina tsaoko SsPP C gene for improving plant salt tolerance and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of genetic engineering. The SsPP C gene is named SsPP C21 and codes for an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. Under the conditions of ABA and NaCl stress, the germination rate and the seedling rate of transgenic Arabidopsis seeds over-expressing the gene are both obviously higher than those of wild type, which indicates that the gene can positively regulate and control the tolerance of plants to salt stress and ABA stress. The gene provides a new gene resource for plant stress-resistant molecular breeding, can be used for cultivating new varieties of crops with salt tolerance, drought resistance or ABA stress tolerance, and has important application prospects in the aspects of improving the abiotic stress adaptability and the stable yield of crops.

title_en: Antioxidant composition containing asafetida aqueous extract and preparation method and application thereof

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a batching device with an ultraviolet sterilization function, which comprises a box body, a weighing hopper, a mass sensor and a batching box, wherein ultraviolet sterilization lamps are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of an inner cavity of the box body, a quartz glass cover is fixedly connected to the outer side of each ultraviolet sterilization lamp, double-head cylinders are fixedly arranged on the lower ends of the left side and the right side of the weighing hopper, extending ends of the double-head cylinders are fixedly connected with connecting blocks, and sealing plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the connecting blocks. According to the utility model, through the action of the second motor, the rotating rod, the driving conical gear, the driven conical gear, the rotating shaft, the stirring rod, the pushing blade, the weighing hopper, the double-head cylinder, the connecting block, the sealing plate and the ultraviolet sterilizing lamp, the problems that the existing batching device does not have an ultraviolet sterilizing function, and simultaneously, precipitation and blockage are easy to occur during batching and weighing, and the batching efficiency is reduced are solved.

title_en: Full-automatic wine processing system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wine processing, and particularly discloses a full-automatic wine processing system which comprises a processing barrel, a skin breaking component, a skin soaking component and a juice discharging component, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the top of the processing barrel, the skin breaking component is arranged at the feeding hole, and a blocking piece for blocking the feeding hole is arranged at the feeding hole; the skin soaking assembly is used for pressing grape skin residues in the processing barrel; the peeling assembly comprises a feeding pipe, a first driving part, a material scraping part and a blocking part, the first driving part comprises a first driving piece and two groups of processing rollers, the first driving piece is used for driving the two groups of processing rollers to rotate in opposite directions, and a slag discharging gap is reserved between the two groups of processing rollers; the scraping part comprises two groups of first scraping plates which are respectively positioned below the processing roller; the blocking part comprises two groups of baffles which are respectively positioned above the processing rollers. The utility model can solve the problem that grape skin is adhered to the processing roller to influence the rotation of the processing roller, thereby causing damage and influencing skin breaking in the prior art.

title_en: Rotary drying assembly and large-scale rotor drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary drying assembly and a large-scale rotor drying device, wherein the rotary drying assembly comprises: a fixing member; the drying modules are arranged in an array along a first array direction, each drying module comprises a first drying unit and a second drying unit which are sequentially arranged along the first array direction, and the first drying unit and the second drying unit are fixedly arranged on the surface of the fixing piece; wherein the first array direction is circular. According to the grain drying device, the first drying units and the second drying units are arranged in the plurality of groups, and the grains are dried by the first drying units and the second drying units, so that the grains are uniformly heated, the water content of the grains is effectively reduced, the grain drying efficiency is greatly improved, the work efficiency is further improved, and the grain drying device has a wide market application value.

title_en: A culture apparatus for drought-enduring alfalfa embryogenic callus is induced
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a culture device for inducing embryonic callus of drought-tolerant alfalfa, wherein an installation rod is arranged in the middle of the bottom in a culture box, a first connecting gear is arranged at the bottom of the outer side of the installation rod, an installation disc is arranged at the top of the installation rod, culture dishes are uniformly arranged at the edge position of the upper part of the installation disc, a driving motor is arranged on one side of the bottom in the culture box, and a transmission rod is arranged at the power output end of the driving motor. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the adjusting gear, the first transmission gear, the second connecting gear, the first connecting gear, the mounting disc and the adjusting assembly, the sealing door does not need to be opened when nutrient solution needs to be added into the culture dish, so that the contact between air and the culture dish is effectively isolated, the pollution of bacteria to calluses is reduced, and through the mutual matching of the adjusting gear, the second transmission gear, the toggle gear and the culture dish, the normal placing and culturing effects of other culture dishes are not influenced during observation.

title_en: Three-dimensional tea leaf tedding frame convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional tea leaf tedding frame convenient to clean, which comprises a storage container, wherein the side wall of the storage container is fixedly connected with a plurality of equidistant fixing plates, the fixing plates are respectively positioned at the left end and the right end of the side wall of the storage container, one end of the left fixing plate is fixedly connected with a gear shell, the side wall of the storage container is fixedly connected with a plurality of equidistant first slideways, the storage container is fixedly connected with a plurality of equidistant placing frames, the top of each placing frame is fixedly connected with a second slideway, the placing frames are communicated with the second slideway, one end of each second slideway is fixedly connected with a brush head, the side wall of each fixing plate is provided with a placing groove, the side wall of each fixing plate is rotatably connected with a plurality of first rotating shafts and second rotating shafts, and the side walls of the first rotating shafts and the second rotating shafts are rotatably connected with tracks; according to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the brush head is arranged for cleaning, so that the influence of subsequent tea spreading is removed, the use efficiency of the machine is improved, the contact surface with tea is reduced in a pulling plate pushing mode, the damage to the tea during collection is reduced, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: Stem of noble dendrobium acidophilus milk fermentation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food processing equipment, in particular to dendrobium yoghourt fermentation equipment which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein the top of the fermentation tank is provided with a sealing cover, a plurality of groups of ultraviolet sterilization mechanisms are arranged in the fermentation tank, each group of ultraviolet sterilization mechanisms comprises a first ultraviolet lamp tube and a second ultraviolet lamp tube which are arranged in parallel, a gap is formed between the first ultraviolet lamp tube and the second ultraviolet lamp tube, a stirring shaft is fixedly connected below the ultraviolet sterilization mechanisms, and the periphery of the stirring shaft is provided with a plurality of axial stirring blades; the fermentation tank is further provided with a driving assembly, and the driving assembly is used for driving the stirring shaft to rotate. The dendrobium yoghourt fermentation equipment can automatically sterilize the fermentation liquor, and avoids transfer and manual stirring of the fermentation liquor so as to reduce the probability of mixed bacteria pollution.

title_en: Mixed processing device is used in wine production processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing treatment device for wine production and processing, which comprises a barrel, wherein a motor is fixedly arranged at the center of the top of the barrel, the bottom of the motor is fixedly connected with a shaft rod, a threaded rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the shaft rod, a collecting box is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the barrel, and a blanking plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the collecting box. According to the utility model, the shaft lever can drive the stirring paddle to stir the raw materials in the inner cavity of the cylinder, the raw materials can be poured to the position at the bottom of the inner cavity of the cylinder by opening the material guide plate after stirring, then the material guide plate can be closed, the raw materials can be poured into the cylinder again through the feed hopper for stirring, the material guide plate can be opened for mixing after stirring, and the raw materials can move downwards on the surface of the threaded rod through the threaded sleeve after mixing.

title_en: Heating barrel chassis capable of heating uniformly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat even heating bucket chassis, including the chassis main part, a mechanism of leading sparks is installed to the bottom of chassis main part, the mechanism of leading sparks includes a plurality of flame paths that are the ring array difference group of leading sparks, flame paths lead sparks group including locating the first fire guide plate of flame paths both sides of leading sparks group, be equipped with the second fire guide plate between the first fire guide plate, first fire guide plate with be equipped with the third fire guide plate between the second fire guide plate, the third fire guide plate with reach between the second fire guide plate the third fire guide plate with all be equipped with the fourth fire guide plate between the first fire guide plate, second fire guide plate, third fire guide plate and fourth fire guide plate by the inboard of chassis main part to the outside of chassis main part extends, the fourth fire guide plate is located the outside of leading sparks mechanism. The utility model discloses the fire from inside to outside direction that the fuel formed, the heated area on chassis is big, and the heat conduction is even, and the heat conduction is efficient, fuel saving.

title_en: Orange powder pipeline type high-temperature sterilization machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline type high-temperature sterilization machine for orange powder. The utility model relates to a pipeline type high-temperature sterilization machine for orange powder, wherein orange powder is conveyed into an inner tube cavity from an inlet pipe and slides downwards along the track of the inner tube cavity, meanwhile, a heating resistor in a heating frame heats an outer tube layer, the outer tube layer transfers heat into a heat insulation net layer and carries out heat insulation, the heat insulation net layer transfers the heat onto an inner tube layer, the inner tube layer is heated and then carries out high-temperature sterilization on the orange powder in the inner tube layer, a reflecting plate also absorbs and reflects the heat of the heating resistor, the reflected heat acts on the outer tube layer, the absorbed heat is transferred to a heat insulation cushion layer, the heat insulation cushion layer and a heat storage layer store the heat and carry out heat insulation on the inner part of an embedded frame, and the pipeline type high-temperature sterilization machine can effectively improve the use efficiency of the high-temperature heat of the sterilization machine and reduce the energy loss in the use process.

title_en: Soybean steaming device for soy sauce production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soybean steaming device for soy sauce production, which comprises: the heating device comprises a box body, a heating pipe, a door plate, a bottom plate and a support plate, wherein the bottom of the box body is provided with the heating pipe, the front end of the box body is provided with the door plate, the bottom plate is arranged above the heating pipe, and the bottom plate is fixed on the box body through the support plate; the sliding plate is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the surface of the sliding plate is provided with air holes, and the upper surface of the sliding plate is provided with a positioning sleeve; the telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top end of the box body, the output end of the telescopic cylinder is connected with the rotating shaft, and the lower end of the rotating shaft is provided with the stirring blade; wherein, the outside of axis of rotation is provided with the sliding sleeve to the internal surface of sliding sleeve is provided with double helix groove. By adopting the technical scheme, the soybeans can be turned in the cooking process, so that the soybeans are more uniform in cooking, fermentation is performed after the soybean is cooked, the steaming barrel is convenient to take down after the soybean is cooked, and the work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Vacuum rolling and kneading machine for silk-wrapped rabbit
abstract_en: The application discloses twine silk rabbit vacuum and roll machine of rubbing relates to the vacuum and rolls machine technical field, improves present vacuum and rolls the problem of rubbing the machine comparatively wasting time and energy when the ejection of compact. Including rolling a section of thick bamboo, the outside symmetry of rolling a section of thick bamboo is rotated and is connected with the riser, the arc mouth has been seted up at the top of rolling a section of thick bamboo, the inside rotation of arc mouth is connected with the arc apron, this application passes through arc mouth, arc apron and step motor's setting for when the ejection of compact, only need rotate the arc mouth to down, then start step motor, make step motor drive the go-between and the guide ring relative motion of both sides through two-way lead screw when starting work, thereby stop to carry on spacing fixed to the arc apron, then the arc apron is opened because the effect of gravity is automatic, make the inside silk rabbit raw materials that finishes of rolling a section of thick bamboo can be arranged into through the arc mouth is automatic, thereby effectively improved the convenience of whole rolling the quick-witted ejection of compact of rubbing.

title_en: Electric field generating device based on piezoelectric transformer and refrigerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric field generating device based on a piezoelectric transformer, which comprises a power supply connecting part, a piezoelectric transformer driving circuit, the piezoelectric transformer, a voltage doubling rectifying circuit, a feedback control circuit and an electric field emitting device, wherein the output end of the piezoelectric transformer driving circuit is electrically connected with the input end of the piezoelectric transformer, the output end of the piezoelectric transformer is electrically connected with the input end of the voltage doubling rectifying circuit, the output end of the voltage doubling rectifying circuit is electrically connected with the input end of the electric field emitting device, the electric field emitting device and the output end of the piezoelectric transformer are electrically connected with the feedback control circuit, and the feedback control circuit is electrically connected with the input end of the piezoelectric transformer driving circuit. The utility model also discloses a refrigerator with the electric field generating device based on the piezoelectric transformer. The utility model uses piezoelectric transformer to replace heavy and complex electromagnetic transformer, with small volume and high reliability. The fresh-keeping agent plays a good role in keeping fresh for different vegetables, fruits, meats, seafood, food, beverages, milk, wine, seeds and the like.

title_en: Convenient to use's tealeaves sunning frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea leaf airing rack convenient to use, which relates to the technical field of tea leaf processing, and adopts the technical scheme that the rack comprises two supports which are arranged in parallel, the two supports are fixedly connected through a first connecting plate, the number of the first connecting plates is a plurality, the first connecting plates are distributed at equal intervals, the tops of all the first connecting plates positioned below the first connecting plates on the second layer of the supports and the first connecting plates on the second layer of the supports are provided with first supporting plates for supporting tea leaf trays, the effect is that when tea leaves are aired, the uppermost tea leaf tray is directly placed on the top of the first connecting plate, the second supporting plate, the fourth supporting plate and the third supporting plate inside the first supporting plate below the uppermost tea leaf tray are outwards stretched, the tea leaf trays are respectively placed on the tops of the second supporting plate and the fourth supporting plate, the tea leaf trays are distributed in a ladder shape at the moment, and the tea leaf trays are not overlapped with each other, so that the tea can fully receive the sunlight when being aired, and the airing effect is ensured.

title_en: Disinfecting equipment is used in golden silk huang chrysanthemum processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disinfection device for golden thread royal chrysanthemum processing, which comprises a case, a frame and a steam generator, wherein the frame is arranged on one side of the case, an installation cavity is arranged in the case, a first motor is arranged in the installation cavity, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with the bottom of a rotating seat through a coupler, in the disinfection device, a guide plate on the rotating seat is driven to rotate through the rotation of the first motor, so that golden thread royal chrysanthemum on the guide plate is driven to uniformly scatter to one side of a rotating column, the low working efficiency caused by the concentrated accumulation of the golden thread royal chrysanthemum is avoided, a guide rod on the rotating column is driven to rotate through the rotation of a second motor, so that the golden thread royal chrysanthemum can be driven to uniformly disinfect through an air nozzle in batches through steam, the fan is driven to rotate through the rotation of a driving motor, the wind power generated by the rotating fan blows out of a filter hole, the movement of the golden thread royal chrysanthemum to the rotating column can be assisted, the hot air generated by the heating pipe can dry the golden-silk Huang chrysanthemum sterilized by steam.

title_en: Nutrient proportioning device is used in production of bird's nest probiotic drink
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nutrition proportioning device for producing a bird's nest probiotic drink, which comprises: the device main part, the upper end of device main part is provided with the feeder hopper, and the lower extreme of feeder hopper is connected with the pipe to one side, the lower extreme of pipe to one side is connected with leading straight tube and rearmounted straight tube respectively, and leading straight tube and rearmounted straight tube all pass and fix the disinfection ring in the device main part is inside, the inside solenoid valve that is provided with of lower extreme of leading straight tube and rearmounted straight tube, the lower extreme of leading straight tube and rearmounted straight tube is provided with the batching subassembly, and the outside of batching subassembly is connected with the push rod to the outside of push rod is connected with the cylinder. The utility model solves the problems that the proportioning device related in the background art patent document can not completely bear raw materials, has bearing errors, and the stirring effect and efficiency of the stirring shaft on mixed liquid are poor.

title_en: Fresh fruit storage device suitable for strawberry sales usefulness
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fresh fruit storage device suitable for strawberry sales, which comprises a storage box, wherein a heat insulation layer is arranged inside the storage box, a refrigeration cavity is arranged inside the heat insulation layer, a fixing frame is arranged inside the refrigeration cavity, a placing cavity is arranged inside the fixing frame, limiting plates are arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the placing cavity, a plurality of sliding grooves in linear arrays are arranged inside the limiting plates, and the inner walls of the sliding grooves are connected with a push-pull plate in a sliding manner. According to the strawberry preservation box, through the arrangement of the heat preservation layer, the refrigeration cavity and the placing cavity, the strawberry can be refrigerated, the metabolism of the strawberry is greatly reduced, the eating time of the strawberry is prolonged, cold air is input through the air inlet fixedly connected with the refrigeration cavity, the temperature in the preservation box can be adjusted, the refrigeration and the preservation of the strawberry are achieved, meanwhile, the current situation of the strawberry in the preservation box can be observed through the observation window arranged in the box door, and the anti-skidding plate arranged at the bottom end of the preservation box can play an anti-skidding role in the preservation box.

title_en: Beer production is with pot of boiling of rapid saccharification
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid saccharification boiling pot for beer production, which comprises a boiling pot shell, a saccharification boiling cavity, a boiling filter cavity, a boiling saccharification component, a filter component and a cleaning component, wherein the boiling pot shell is arranged in a hollow cavity, the saccharification boiling cavity is arranged at the upper end of the boiling pot shell, the boiling filter cavity is arranged at the lower end of the boiling pot shell and is arranged below the saccharification boiling cavity, the boiling saccharification component is arranged in the saccharification boiling cavity, the filter component is arranged in the boiling filter cavity, and the cleaning component is arranged on one side of the boiling pot shell. The utility model belongs to the technical field of boiling pots, and particularly provides a rapid saccharification boiling pot for beer production, which has the advantages that a saccharification boiling component is convenient for accelerating the saccharification speed of beer raw materials, wheat juice is prevented from being adhered to the side wall of a saccharification boiling cavity, a filtering component is convenient for filtering impurities in the beer raw materials, and the rapid saccharification boiling pot is high in practicability, simple to operate, reasonable in design, high in working efficiency and good in stirring effect.

title_en: Rolling device based on tea processing material loading is leak-proof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea processing feeding leakage-proof kneading device which comprises a first support column, a discharge port and a kneading barrel, wherein a kneading disc is arranged on the right side above the first support column, a splash-proof assembly is arranged on the inner side of the kneading disc, the splash-proof assembly comprises a limiting sleeve, a limiting block, a fixing ring and a rubber barrier strip, the limiting block is arranged on one side, close to the central axis of the kneading disc, of the limiting block, the fixing ring is fixedly connected to one side, close to the central axis of the kneading disc, of the limiting block, the rubber barrier strip is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixing ring, and the kneading barrel is arranged above the kneading disc. This knead device based on leak protection of tea processing material loading passes through the setting of rubber blend stop for the retainer plate is placed in the inboard back of kneading the dish, and the rubber blend stop can be when kneading the surface of dish kneading the tealeaves of bucket in, shelters from the tealeaves that removes to kneading a dish inner wall department, thereby avoids tealeaves to knead the in-process, and tealeaves takes place from the phenomenon of kneading a dish surface and dropping.

title_en: Quick forming device is used in chocolate processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick forming device for chocolate processing, which comprises a forming machine, a filter plate and a scraper plate, wherein the filter plate is positioned at the top of an inner cavity of the forming machine, and the bottom of the scraper plate is in contact with the inner cavity of the filter plate. Through setting up the filter, the scraper blade, positioning mechanism and drive mechanism's cooperation is used, drive positioning mechanism through drive mechanism and remove to suitable position after, with scraper blade and filter butt joint, then loosen drive mechanism, positioning mechanism can fix the scraper blade when reseing, the spacing to the scraper blade has been accomplished, the chocolate sauce extrusion that has solved to accomplish at present will stir when moulding the board in to, the surface that can appear moulding the board is stained with the condition that attaches a lot of chocolate sauce, just need use the scraper blade to clear away unnecessary chocolate sauce on moulding the board, and the scraper blade can't obtain effectual spacing on the make-up machine, carry out the inconvenient problem that the in-process that clears away will be very to chocolate sauce.

title_en: Cereal storage ventilation unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grain storage ventilation device, which comprises a granary, wherein a base is installed at the lower end of the granary, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are further installed on the inner top wall of the granary, a discharge pipe is installed at the lower end of the granary, an electromagnetic valve is further installed on the discharge pipe, a first rain cover is installed at the upper end of the granary, a second rain cover is installed at the upper end of the first rain cover through a support, a drying mechanism is installed between the first rain cover and the second rain cover, a stirring mechanism is installed in the granary, a ventilation mechanism is further installed in the granary, the granary is a multi-layer mechanism and comprises an outer protective layer and an inner heat conduction layer, a cavity is arranged between the protective layer and the heat conduction layer, and a plurality of groups of electric heating sheets are distributed and installed in the cavity, so that the grain storage effect can be improved, and the risk of grain mildew is reduced, can bring convenience to the technical field of grain storage.

title_en: Tricholoma matsutake picking device capable of automatically sterilizing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tricholoma matsutake picking device capable of automatically sterilizing. The tricholoma matsutake picking device capable of automatically sterilizing comprises a tricholoma matsutake picking device body, wherein the tricholoma matsutake picking device body comprises a holding rod, a liquid storage bottle is fixedly mounted at the top of the holding rod, a small water pump is fixedly mounted on the inner wall of one side of the liquid storage bottle, and the liquid outlet end of the small water pump extends out of the liquid storage bottle; the connecting pipe is fixedly arranged on the holding rod, the liquid inlet end of the connecting pipe is fixedly connected with the liquid outlet end of the small water pump, and the liquid outlet end of the connecting pipe is fixedly provided with an atomizing nozzle; and the stirring mechanism is arranged on the liquid storage bottle. The tricholoma matsutake picking device capable of automatically sterilizing has the advantages that tricholoma matsutake can be sterilized during picking, and adverse effects of bacteria on tricholoma matsutake are reduced.

title_en: Longan ultrasonic disinfection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses longan ultrasonic disinfection equipment, belonging to the field of longan disinfection; an ultrasonic longan disinfection device comprises a bottom plate, a water tank, a mounting rack, a storage box and universal wheels; the water tank is arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, the energy converter is arranged on the water tank, the sound energy of the power ultrasonic frequency source can be converted into mechanical vibration, ultrasonic waves are radiated into water through the wall of the water tank, the liftable storage box is arranged on the mounting frame, and the storage box can be overturned, so that the positions of the longan can be conveniently adjusted by driving the longan to be more fully disinfected and cleaned; the mounting frame is connected with the bottom plate in a sliding mode, and the longan storage box is turned over, so that taking and unloading of longan in the storage box are facilitated; four universal wheels are arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, so that the transplanting and the transportation of the disinfection equipment are facilitated.

title_en: Forming device is used in ice cream processing convenient to quick drawing of patterns
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forming device for processing ice cream convenient for quick demoulding, which relates to the technical field of ice cream forming and comprises a base, a forming die and a driving mechanism, wherein the top end of the base is rotationally connected with a plurality of toothed rings, the top end of each toothed ring is fixedly connected with the forming die, the top end of the base is provided with a chute, the inside of the chute is slidably connected with a moving plate, one side surface of the moving plate is fixedly connected with meshing teeth, the meshing teeth are meshed with the toothed rings, the top end of the base is provided with the driving mechanism, the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a guide rod, the guide rod is slidably connected with a sleeve, and one side surface of the sleeve is fixedly connected with a mounting plate. According to the forming device for processing the ice cream convenient for quick demoulding, the driving mechanism drives the moving plate to reciprocate, and the forming die rotates in a reciprocating manner under the matching of the meshing teeth and the gear ring, so that the forming die and the ice cream form relative rotation, and the quick demoulding function of the ice cream is realized.

title_en: Spreading frame for manual tea leaf making
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea, and discloses a spreading frame for manual tea production, which comprises a spreading frame, wherein a sliding groove is formed in the surface of the inner wall of the spreading frame, a sliding block is arranged in the sliding groove in a matched mode, an extension block is arranged on the surface of the outer wall of the sliding block, a first clamping groove is formed in one side of the outer wall of the extension block, and a first clamping block is arranged on the inner side of the first clamping groove in a matched mode. This spreading frame for manual tea manufacturing, through being provided with spreading frame, the spout, the slider, extension block, first draw-in groove, first fixture block, the concatenation piece, spacing groove and stopper, can outwards stimulate extension block earlier, make the slider can drive extension block and remove, can conveniently play the effect of the extension of being convenient for to it, make more tealeaves that can pave, make its work efficiency increase, fill in spacing inslot portion with the stopper again, make stopper and spacing groove can cooperate the installation, thereby make and conveniently fix the extension block, make things convenient for follow-up use.

title_en: Pollinator is planted with fruit tree to agricultural production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fruit tree planting pollinator for agricultural production, which relates to the technical field of fruit tree planting, and comprises a fan; one end of the fan is provided with an air pipe, one end of the air pipe is provided with a connector, one end of the connector is provided with a pollination head, one end of the pollination head is provided with a stainless steel baffle, the side surface of one end of the pollination head is provided with an expansion hole at equal intervals, the side surface of the pollination head is positioned in front of the expansion hole and is provided with a sliding cavity, the stainless steel baffle is positioned on the surface of the sliding cavity, the pollination head is in a semi-arc structure, the bottom end of the surface of the air pipe is provided with a collection port, the bottom end of the collection port is provided with a powder collection tank, and the bottom end inside the air pipe is provided with a powder collection channel; the utility model discloses a pollination head and extension hole and stainless steel baffle structure have realized the blowout volume to how much adjust the pollen according to the stamen, consequently avoid the pollen to spray too much and cause the pollen loss serious, and the semi-arc pollination head makes personnel can pollinate the stamen that the equidirectional blooming simultaneously to the utilization ratio of pollen has been improved.

title_en: Be provided with tealeaves fermenting installation of residue clearance structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea fermentation device with a residue cleaning structure, which comprises a fixed mounting base, wherein the lower end of the fixed mounting base is fixedly provided with a fixed supporting leg with a supporting function, and the upper surfaces of the left end and the right end of the fixed mounting base are fixedly provided with a first adjusting rod; the fixed mounting block is fixedly mounted on the upper surface of the outer part of the tea leaf containing box, the upper end of the middle part of the fixed mounting base is fixedly provided with an outer frame, and the lower end of the first driving motor is connected with a second adjusting rod; the bearing plate is arranged outside the lower side of the second adjusting rod, second limiting rods connected with the outer frame are arranged on the inner sides of the front end and the rear end of the bearing plate, and a stirring rod connected with the tea leaf containing box is arranged at the lower end of the second driving motor. This be provided with tealeaves fermenting installation of residue clearance structure is favorable to carrying out stable connection installation, can clear up the residue, and has improved device's practical function.

title_en: Automatic egg stirring device for improving egg liquid collection efficiency
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an improve automatic egg beating device of egg liquid collection efficiency, including conveyer belt, egg liquid mechanism and egg liquid slide, the tip of conveyer belt suits with egg mechanism's position, the egg liquid slide is connected and is set up in one side of egg mechanism, and the one end downward sloping of this egg liquid slide, the egg liquid slide both sides are all arranged and are equipped with a plurality of cleaning rods, a plurality of cleaning rods all connect and are equipped with the axis of rotation, and this axis of rotation is perpendicular to cleaning rod, the lower extreme of axis of rotation runs through the egg liquid slide and connects and be equipped with driving motor, driving motor fixed connection egg liquid slide's bottom surface; the bottom surface of the egg liquid slideway is connected with an eggshell collecting plate, and the eggshell collecting plate is provided with a leakage-proof baffle plate extending to two sides of the egg liquid slideway; realized the clearance pole and rotated the eggshell on with the egg liquid slide and swept to both sides to drop on the eggshell collecting plate and concentrate and stack, avoid the eggshell to hinder egg liquid to slide and glue on the egg liquid slide, prevent that egg liquid from receiving eggshell surface pollution.

title_en: Adjustable frying device for tea processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tea processing technology field especially relates to a system device of frying that tea processing used with adjustable, has solved the homogeneity that tea fried among the prior art remained the problem that improves. An adjustable tea processing stir-fry apparatus comprising: the processing pot, the inside of processing pot from top to bottom parallel arrangement has first filter disc and second filter disc to make the processing pot from top to bottom form first system chamber of frying, second system chamber of frying and the system chamber is fried to the third in proper order. The utility model discloses a tealeaves can carry out the stir-fry system of different modes and adjust, and when the even upset of circumference was fried and was made about can also realizing, the tealeaves that the screening of disintegrating slag and thin sediment was fried and was made is different according to the particle size, has realized that an automatic tea processing who sieves the material is with stir-fry system device, has reduced the condition emergence that tealeaves fried yellow, improves the convenience and the tea processing efficiency that tealeaves was fried and was made.

title_en: Automatic drying equipment of tealeaves of formula of rolling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tea processing technology field just discloses a automatic drying equipment of tealeaves of formula of tumbling, including the stoving case, the right side of stoving case is provided with and rises the material device, the inside of stoving case is provided with the drying device that turns, it includes the motor to rise the material device, first spur gear, helical blade, first pivot, the case that rises, second spur gear, the second pivot, first conical gear, it installs at the outer wall of stoving case to rise workbin fixed mounting, the inner wall top that rises the case is provided with first bearing, first pivot runs through the inner wall that rises workbin and first bearing from top to bottom in proper order to inwards extend, the top of stoving case is provided with the L template, motor fixed mounting is in on the L template, shaft coupling fixed connection is passed through on the outer wall of motor drive shaft in the top of first pivot. The utility model discloses reach and to automize and dry tealeaves, accomplish the purpose with the dust separation in the tealeaves simultaneously.

title_en: System for ecological breeding of shrimps and crabs by using hermetia illucens compound shrimp and crab feed
abstract_en: The utility model provides a system for ecologically breeding shrimps and crabs by using a black soldier fly compound shrimp and crab feed, which comprises a breeding pond body provided with a plurality of breeding units, wherein the breeding pond body is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet; a pond bottom purification layer, a submerged plant layer, an oxygenation system, a water quality purification device and an ecological floating bed are sequentially arranged on the pond body of the culture pond from bottom to top; the culture pond body is internally provided with a separation net which divides the culture pond body into a first culture area, a second culture area and a third culture area; the submerged plant layer at the bottom in each culture area is respectively planted with different submerged plants. abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rub tea machine technical field, specifically be for fall fluorine and rub tea machine based on tealeaves preparation, including workstation, machine of twisting, be provided with the cooperation on the workstation and rub the take-up (stock) pan that the machine was kneaded to tealeaves, be provided with the drive on the workstation and rub the actuating mechanism that the machine was kneaded, be provided with the automatic mechanism of adding water and fall fluorine on the workstation, the mechanism of adding water includes the water tank, the inside of water tank is provided with the closing plate, the inside of water tank is provided with the water pump, the drain pipe is installed to the water outlet end of water pump, drain pipe and closing plate through connection, drain pipe and take-up (stock) pan through connection, the mechanism of adding water still includes the wash port of seting up on the take-up (stock) pan, rotate on the water tank and install the switch shaft, the utility model aims to provide fall fluorine based on tealeaves preparation and rub tea machine, through the application of water treatment and hydrologic cycle in falling fluorine work, saved a large amount of water resources, reduced the cost that tealeaves falls fluorine processing.

title_en: Efficient grain air-dries storehouse device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency grain air drying bin device, and mainly relates to the field of grain drying. Including the outer storehouse body, the top and the bottom of the outer storehouse body are equipped with feed inlet and discharge gate respectively, the internal position that is located the feed inlet below in the outer storehouse is equipped with the inner bin body, the internal array distribution in outer storehouse has a plurality of auxiliary bins, the auxiliary bin encircles the outside including the storehouse body, the conical form is all become at the top in the inner bin body and auxiliary bin, all be equipped with a plurality of air vents on the lateral wall in the inner bin body and auxiliary bin, all be equipped with the breather pipe on the inner bin body and the auxiliary bin. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the air-drying device can greatly improve the contact area between air flow and grains, and the wind field in the bin is smoother and stable, so that the air-drying efficiency and uniformity are greatly improved.

title_en: Dried tofu homogenization equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses dried bean curd homogenizing equipment which comprises a forming frame (1), a forming frame return line (2), a lifting mechanism (3), a production line (4), blades (6) and a slurry discharging device (7), wherein the lifting mechanism (3) is fixed with the forming frame return line (2), a grabbing device is arranged at the tail end of the lifting mechanism (3), the grabbing device is fixed with the forming frame (1), the forming frame (1) is placed below the forming frame return line (2), the production line (4) is arranged below the forming frame (1), the slurry discharging device (7) is arranged between the forming frame return line (2) and the production line (4), and the blades (6) capable of lifting are arranged on the slurry discharging device (7). The utility model provides dried bean curd homogenizing equipment which can automatically put and take frames, and saves labor; the product can be automatically homogenized; simple structure, can combine the manual work to operate advantage such as.

title_en: Tissue culture inoculation apparatus rack
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tissue culture inoculating device placing rack, which comprises a placing bracket and a balancing bracket, wherein the placing bracket comprises a group of parallel supporting frames, and the two supporting frames are connected with a supporting frame; the balance support comprises a blocking plate, two ends of the blocking plate are respectively hinged with a telescopic rod, the other end of the telescopic rod is hinged with the side wall of the support frame, and an adjusting bolt is arranged on the telescopic rod. The tissue culture inoculating device placing rack provided by the utility model has the advantages that the balance bracket is used as the support of the placing bracket, so that the placing rack can be prevented from tipping under the pressure of a heavier device; the blocking plate of the balance bracket is used for supporting the tail part of the appliance, so that the appliance can be prevented from slipping off the commodity shelf; through setting up the telescopic link for the device is adjustable, and the adjustment of being convenient for is applicable to the utensil of multiple length and places. The object placing bracket and the balance bracket in the device form a stressed whole, so that the object placing bracket is stable and not easy to slip when elongated appliances such as forceps, surgical knives and the like are placed, and is not easy to tip when larger and heavier appliances such as scissors and the like are placed.

title_en: Novel ultrasonic thawing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses novel ultrasonic thawing equipment which belongs to the technical field of ultrasonic thawing, and comprises a box body and a thawing trough, wherein the right side of the top of the box body is provided with the thawing trough, a net-shaped grid is arranged inside the thawing trough, the bottom of the thawing trough is provided with a connecting wire, an ultrasonic transmitter is arranged on the connecting wire, the top of the thawing trough is provided with a water inlet pipe, the water inlet pipe is provided with a valve, the bottom of the box body is provided with a water storage tank, the bottom of the water inlet pipe is connected with the water storage tank, the top of the box body is provided with a storage tank, the left side of the top of the box body is provided with a trolley rod, the left side of the box body is provided with a radiating opening, the radiating opening is provided with a silencer, the bottom of the box body is provided with a fixed block, the fixed block is provided with a roller, the rear side of the box body is provided with a box door, the box door is provided with a handle, the trolley rod and the roller, the box body is provided with the trolley rod and the roller, the ultrasonic thawing equipment can be pushed away in time, the collection work can be completed after the sewage is used, the water source is wasted, the dust can be prevented, the dust can be cleaned up through the water storage tank, and the dust can be prevented from being corroded equipment.

title_en: Aquatic product processing thawing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aquatic product processing and discloses an aquatic product processing thawing device, which comprises a body mechanism, a spraying mechanism, a conducting mechanism and a filtering mechanism, wherein the spraying mechanism is positioned at the inner end of the body mechanism, the conducting mechanism is positioned below the spraying mechanism, the filtering mechanism is positioned below the conducting mechanism, the conducting mechanism comprises a thawing barrel, a driving piece, a screw rod, a movable block, a conducting block, an assembly groove and a sliding block, the driving piece is fixedly arranged at the outer end of the thawing barrel, the screw rod is fixedly arranged at the transmission end of the driving piece, the movable block is movably arranged at the outer end of the screw rod, and the conducting block is movably arranged at the outer end of the movable block. This aquatic products processing thawing apparatus can let the inside aquatic products outside attached frozen ice of section of thick bamboo that unfreezes can accelerate to drop, has avoided the outside attached ice-cube of aquatic products to influence the defrosting speed, lets the device unfreeze the efficiency increase of aquatic products, has improved the aquatic products processing effect of device.

title_en: Fresh milk pasteurization machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fresh milk sterilization equipment, and particularly relates to a fresh milk pasteurization machine, which comprises a base, wherein a control panel is arranged on the front side wall of the base, an installation sleeve is fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the base, a heating sleeve is fixedly connected to the installation sleeve through screws, a heating wire is arranged on the outer side wall of the heating sleeve, a motor is arranged on the lower end surface of the heating sleeve, a driving end of the motor penetrates through the bottom wall of the heating sleeve and is fixedly connected with a rotating sleeve, a milk pot is arranged in the heating sleeve, and a rotating shaft is connected to the bottom end of the milk pot in a rotating manner. According to the utility model, the fresh milk is conveniently and uniformly heated through the mounting sleeve, the heating sleeve and the heating wire, the phenomenon of uneven heating and bottom sticking caused by bottom heating is avoided, the fresh milk is conveniently stirred and heated through the rotating sleeve, the rotating shaft, the chuck and the stirring blade, the milk pot is conveniently separated and held, and more milk can be contained.

title_en: Meat block disinfection rolling machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rolling equipment, and particularly relates to a meat block disinfection rolling machine, which structurally comprises a bottom frame, a controller, a pad seat, a driving mechanism, a rolling and kneading tank, a rotary supporting mechanism and a disinfection mechanism, wherein the pad seat is fixedly arranged at the top end of the bottom frame, and the driving mechanism and the rotary supporting mechanism are respectively fixedly arranged at the top end of the pad seat; the transparent sleeve provides a light transmission effect and a blocking effect; the support rod provides support for the position of the transparent sleeve and prevents the lamp holder rod and the transparent sleeve from deforming; the electric connection wire is connected to the outer side of the lamp holder rod and is directly connected with the storage battery fixedly arranged on the outer side of the tank body, so that the power distribution and tank body synchronous rotation structure is adopted for opening and using; further can carry out synchronous disinfection to the meat of rolling and kneading, improve the practicality.

title_en: Automatic transportation degassing unit is used in food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic transportation disinfection device for food processing, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged on the frame, one side of the conveyor belt is fixedly connected with teeth, a stand is fixedly connected on the frame outside the conveyor belt, a transmission box is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the stand, a transmission shaft is rotatably connected to the bottom surface wall inside the transmission box, a first gear and a second gear which are coaxially arranged are fixedly connected to the transmission shaft, and the first gear is meshed with the teeth. According to the utility model, firstly, foods to be disinfected are sequentially placed on the conveyor belt according to the marking strips, the conveyor belt drives the foods to move, and simultaneously drives the teeth to move, so that the first gear meshed with the teeth rotates, the transmission shaft drives the second gear to rotate, and the fluted disc meshed with the second gear rotates, and the turntable and the disinfection lamp are driven to rotate, thereby realizing omnibearing disinfection of the foods and improving the disinfection effect.

title_en: Frozen food detection device with quick thawing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a frozen food detection device with a rapid thawing function, which comprises a supporting mechanism for supporting upper equipment and a thawing mechanism for thawing frozen food, wherein the thawing mechanism is fixed above the supporting mechanism, and the frozen food detection device also comprises a detection mechanism for detecting food, and the detection mechanism is arranged above the thawing mechanism. According to the utility model, the detection mechanism is arranged, when the food detector is damaged, the threaded rod is rotated, the threaded rod is far away from the limit seat under the action of the fixing plate, the spring is contracted to drive the telescopic rod to be contracted, the telescopic rod is contracted to drive the limit seat to be far away from the food detector, and the food detector can be detached after the limit seat is separated from the food detector, so that great convenience is brought to maintenance of the food detector.

title_en: Bracket for placing plant tissue culture inoculation tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a support for placing plant tissue culture inoculation instrument, includes the base, the both ends of base one side are rotated respectively and are adjusted install the bracing piece, and the both ends of fixed bolster respectively with two the bracing piece is slided from top to bottom and is adjusted and be connected, is equipped with a plurality of mounting grooves on the fixed bolster, and the mounting groove is used for detachable installation locating piece, is equipped with the constant head tank that is used for placing inoculation instrument on the locating piece. The base makes whole support can steadily place, and the bracing piece can rotate with the base and adjust to can make things convenient for angle regulation, fixed bolster slip regulation's installation is on the bracing piece, is convenient for according to the high of the type adjustment locating piece of instrument, thereby makes the instrument can be stable place on the constant head tank of locating piece, locating piece detachable installs in the mounting groove of fixed bolster, is convenient for install the locating piece that corresponds according to the instrument of needs, thereby fixes corresponding inoculation instrument.

title_en: Visual preserved meat smokes equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses visual cured meat smoking equipment which comprises a smoking box and a cured meat rack; fumigating box: the front end of the fumigating box is of an opening structure, the left side of the front end of the fumigating box is hinged with a box door through a hinge, and an observation glass is arranged in an observation port at the upper end of the box door; cured meat rack: including mounted frame, T type couple, gear, rectangular channel and rack board, the mounted frame is arranged in about the smoked case between the inner wall upper end, and the extrados lower extreme of mounted frame rotates through the bearing respectively has T type couple, and the inside of mounted frame is equipped with rectangular channel, and the inside sliding connection in rectangular channel has rack board, and the gear sets up respectively in the upper end of the vertical post of T type couple, rack board and gear cooperation installation, this visual cured meat smoking equipment, automatic rotate cured meat, judge cured meat smoking state more comprehensively, and cured meat adopts alternate pivoted mode simultaneously, provides sufficient time for staff's observation, improves the visual degree of equipment.

title_en: Preserved meat air-drying box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of cured meat processing, and discloses a cured meat air drying box which comprises a box body, wherein a first hole is formed in the box body, the inner wall of the first hole is meshed with the outer wall of a first rotating shaft, the top end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first fixing plate, the bottom end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first shaft gear, the first shaft gear is meshed with a second shaft gear, a second rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the inner part of the second shaft gear, the outer wall of the second rotating shaft is meshed with the inner wall of the second hole, the outer wall of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, and the lower surface of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a hook. According to the utility model, the preserved meat to be dried is hung on the hook on the lower surface of the rotary table, the rotary table on the outer wall is driven to turn through the rotation of the second rotary shaft, and the rotary table rotates to drive the hook on the lower surface and the preserved meat to rotate for adjusting the angle of the dried meat, so that the preserved meat is dried in all aspects.

title_en: Quality monitoring mechanism of pasteurizer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pasteurization equipment, and discloses a pasteurization machine quality monitoring mechanism, which comprises a cylindrical tank body which is arranged in a hollow mode, wherein a cover body is covered on the tank body, a feed inlet is arranged on the cover body, a supporting leg is fixedly connected below the tank body, a feed opening is arranged below the tank body, a switch valve for controlling discharge is arranged on the feed opening, a fixed block is fixedly connected on the cover body, the fixed block penetrates through the cover body and extends to the lower part of the cover body, a monitoring rod is fixedly connected below the fixed block, a plurality of temperature sensors are arranged at different heights on the monitoring rod, and a monitoring display screen which is electrically connected with the temperature sensors is fixedly arranged on the cover body.

title_en: Cake with external support
