abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cake with an external support, which comprises a base, wherein a cake main body is arranged at the top of the base, a surface milk oil layer is arranged on the surface of the cake main body, solid chocolate is sleeved outside the surface milk oil layer on the side surface of the cake main body, the solid chocolate is of an annular structure, cutting grooves are formed at equal intervals, and a protective shell is arranged on the outer side of the cake main body, which is positioned outside the solid chocolate. According to the utility model, the solid chocolate is sleeved outside the surface milk oil layer on the side surface of the cake main body, and the cake main body can be supported through the annular solid chocolate structure to avoid collapse of the cake main body.

title_en: Board-like sterilizing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses plate-type sterilization equipment which comprises a water tank, supporting legs, a material collecting box and a water guide pipe, wherein a sealing ring is fixedly arranged on the left side of the water guide pipe, a heating box is fixedly connected on the right side of the water guide pipe, a fixing column is arranged in the center of the inside of the heating box, a heating wire is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the fixing column, a heat insulation pipe is arranged at the top of the heating box, an air guide pipe is fixedly connected inside the heat insulation pipe, one end of the air guide pipe is fixedly connected with a sterilizing box, a material inlet is formed on the right side of the sterilizing box, and one end of the material inlet is fixedly connected with a curved heat guide pipe. According to the utility model, through the special form of the curved heat-conducting pipe, the material is heated in the sterilizing box for a longer and more uniform time, so that the sterilizing effect is effectively improved, the heat of the sterilized material can be absorbed by water flow in the water tank, the heat is secondarily utilized, the heat utilization efficiency is improved, and the energy waste is avoided.

title_en: Novel fermentation device for fermenting high-efficiency sweet fermented flour paste
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sweet fermented flour paste fermentation, in particular to a novel high-efficiency sweet fermented flour paste fermentation device, which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the right side of the top of the fermentation tank, a discharge outlet is formed in the middle of the bottom of the fermentation tank, an auxiliary device is arranged below the interior of the fermentation tank, the upper right side of the front end of the fermentation tank is fixedly connected with a first motor through a bracket, a bevel gear set is fixedly connected with the output end of the first motor, and a stirring device is arranged at the rear end of the bevel gear set. Through the cooperation between first straight gear, second straight gear, puddler and the third straight gear, first straight gear drives the rotation of third straight gear, and the third straight gear can drive the puddler and rotate to make the puddler rotate the limit and move down, back in moving to the below, reverse start first motor, thereby make the puddler rotate the limit and upwards move, when realizing the stirring, upwards drive the sweet flour paste of bottom, make the stirring more abundant, the effect is better.

title_en: Fish thawing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fish thawing device, which relates to the field of seafood processing equipment and aims at solving the problems that frozen fish cannot be contacted with all normal-temperature water in a container rapidly and heat transfer is completed due to lack of flow of normal-temperature water in the container, so that thawing efficiency of the frozen fish is reduced, and the technical scheme is as follows: the main box body that includes the case lid and offer the cavity, the cavity internal fixation is provided with the board of placing that is used for placing frozen fish, place the board connection and be provided with hydrologic cycle mechanism. According to the fish thawing device, normal-temperature water in the box body flows through the water circulation mechanism, so that different normal-temperature water can be contacted with frozen fish to finish heat transfer, and the thawing efficiency of the frozen fish placed in the box body is improved.

title_en: Tea fermentation box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea fermentation box, wherein a plurality of U-shaped carrier plates which are bilaterally symmetrical are arranged in the fermentation box, a placing tray is arranged between opposite surfaces of the U-shaped carrier plates, a turnover mechanism is arranged above the placing tray, uniformly distributed limiting holes are formed in the left side and the right side above the placing tray, a plurality of uniformly distributed springs are fixedly connected above the U-shaped carrier plates, the lower ends of the springs are fixedly connected with the same fixing plate, limiting blocks which correspond to the limiting holes in number on one side of the placing tray are fixedly connected to the lower side of the fixing plate, the limiting blocks are inserted into the limiting holes, a vertically downward connecting rod is connected to the U-shaped carrier plates in a sliding mode, the lower end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected to the upper side of the fixing plate, an upper protruding block which is uniformly distributed is arranged on the lower side of the placing tray, and the connecting rod drives the fixing plate to move upwards, so that the whole placing tray is conveniently taken out of the fermentation box, and tea leaves after fermentation is conveniently taken out.

title_en: Stewing device for fresh stewed bird's nest
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stewing device for fresh stew cubilose, which comprises a stewing pot, wherein the upper end of the stewing pot is provided with a fastening cavity, the lower end of the fastening cavity is provided with a connecting groove, the left end and the right end of a bearing mounting box are both welded with fastening shafts, the stewing device further comprises holding rods, the holding rods are mounted at the upper end and the lower end of a fastening plate, the left side of a permanent magnet piece A is connected with a permanent magnet piece B, the bearing mounting box is movably connected with a screwing cover, the stewing device further comprises an exhaust cavity, the exhaust cavity is arranged at the symmetrical position of the central axis of the stewing pot, the outer surface of the fastening mounting box is inlaid with a constant temperature plate, the stewing device further comprises an electric heating structure, the electric heating structure is positioned in the fastening mounting box, and a control valve is fixedly mounted at the top end of the stewing pot. The utility model has higher cooking efficiency and even maturity, is convenient for cooling the cooked food and reduces the waste of energy.

title_en: High-efficiency energy-saving black tea processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-efficiency energy-saving black tea processing equipment, which comprises a pile fermentation tank and a pile watering mechanism arranged on the outer side surface of the pile fermentation tank; the pile fermentation tank comprises a tank body, an electric heating pipe arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the tank body, and a partition plate fixed at the middle part of the inner cavity of the tank body. Compared with the traditional pile fermentation process, the utility model indirectly heats the tea by the electric heating tube in the pile fermentation tank, thereby promoting the fermentation temperature of the tea to reach the standard; the traditional pile fermentation temperature can be determined according to self experience of a fermentation operator, no exact standard exists, the technical scheme realizes fermentation through an electric heating tube capable of controlling the temperature, so that the problem of excessive fermentation can be avoided, in addition, before pile fermentation, compared with the traditional manual method, the traditional method utilizes a spray pot to spray water to a tea pile, and the technical scheme utilizes a pile fermentation water spraying mechanism to uniformly spray water to tea so that the moisture degree of the tea is more consistent.

title_en: High-efficiency energy-saving brewing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-efficiency energy-saving brewing equipment, belongs to the technical field of brewing equipment, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, before hot steam is contacted with a raw material fermentation product, raw material fermentation is needed, and the raw material fermentation and the hot steam are of split type design, so that heat cannot be utilized at the same time, and the energy utilization rate is low. Including heat energy case, collection box, condenser and actuating mechanism, the top of heat energy case is equipped with the heat steam ager, fixed mounting actuating mechanism on the lateral wall of heat steam ager, and the upper surface of heat steam ager has the feed inlet, and the side of feed inlet is equipped with the flow tube, and the one end intercommunication heat steam ager of flow tube, the other end intercommunication condenser, the collection box setting is equipped with the door plant in the below of condenser on the heat steam ager. The high-efficiency energy-saving brewing equipment benefits from the cooperation of the heat energy box and the heat steam box, so that the heat steam and the fermentation heating of the brewing raw materials adopt the same heat source, the heat efficiency and the heat utilization rate are effectively improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the high-efficiency energy-saving brewing equipment has the advantages of environmental protection and energy saving.

title_en: Tea production is with device that completes
abstract_en: The utility model provides a green removing device for tea production, which comprises a processing box body, wherein an inwards concave mounting bin is arranged on the upper end surface of the processing box body, an inwards extending part transverse groove is formed in the lower end surface of the mounting bin, a frying pan body is arranged in the mounting bin, a plurality of convex teeth are arranged on the outer wall of the frying pan body, a reciprocating cylinder is arranged on the left wall in the part transverse groove, a rack is arranged at the output end of the reciprocating cylinder, the rack is meshed with the convex teeth, an arc-shaped groove is formed in the frying pan body, and an electric heating wire is arranged in the arc-shaped groove. According to the utility model, when tea leaves are processed, the tea leaves can be stir-fried continuously, so that the tea leaves are stir-fried and deactivated uniformly, and the processing quality of the tea leaves is greatly improved.

title_en: Tea spreading device of tea primary making production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea spreading device of a tea primary production line, which comprises: the machine frame is of a U-shaped frame structure, two driving rollers are rotatably connected between the inner walls of the two sides of the machine frame, the two driving rollers are respectively positioned at the two opposite ends of the machine frame, rubber conveyor belts are sleeved on the driving rollers, and a driving assembly for driving the driving rollers to rotate is arranged on the machine frame; the rubber conveyor belt is attached to the inner wall of the frame, and the vibrating motor is fixedly arranged at a position close to the inner side of the rubber conveyor belt on the frame; the feeding box for storing tea leaves to be paved is erected at one end of the top of the frame, the feeding box is of a reverse cone table hollow structure with openings at the upper end and the lower end, and the opening at the lower end of the feeding box is connected with the rubber conveyor belt. The utility model can solve the problem that tea and a hard paving part are mutually extruded to easily cause the breakage and damage of the tea in the prior art.

title_en: Heat preservation and moisture preservation structure of tea fermentation machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea fermentation, and discloses a heat-preserving and moisture-preserving structure of a tea fermentation machine, which comprises a heat-preserving shell: the fermentation cavity has been seted up to the inside below of heat preservation casing, storage chamber and rotation chamber have been seted up respectively to the inside top of heat preservation casing, one side of rotation chamber bottom inner wall is through bolt fixedly connected with driving motor, work through control electrothermal tube, can heat the water in the storage chamber to appointed temperature, control water pump work, through outlet pipe, aqueduct, rotary joint and the combination of rotation pipe, can lead into the spray tube in the hot water in the storage chamber, spout through the orifice blowout, can effectively carry out the temperature to tealeaves in the fermentation chamber and keep warm, control driving motor work, can drive first gear and rotate, thereby drive the rotation pipe and rotate, further drive the spray tube and rotate in the fermentation chamber, can stir the tealeaves of fermentation intracavity, further accurate control fermentation intracavity tealeaves's humidity and temperature.

title_en: Automatic tea leaf twisting machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tea processing equipment, and particularly relates to an automatic tea rolling machine which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two supporting plates are fixed at the top of the bottom plate, supporting shafts are connected to the side walls of the two supporting plates in a rotating mode through bearings, supporting seats are fixed between the two supporting shafts, a rolling disc is fixed at the top of the supporting seats, and a bracket is arranged above the rolling disc. According to the tea leaf rolling machine, the bottom plate, the supporting shaft, the supporting seat, the rolling disc, the connecting plate, the bearing frame, the rolling barrel, the supporting seat and the lifting mechanism are arranged, after the rolling machine is used for rolling tea leaves, the lifting mechanism is started to drive the rolling barrel to move upwards, at the moment, the tea leaves in the rolling barrel can fall into the rolling disc completely, the rolling disc is driven to overturn through the supporting shaft, and the tea leaves in the rolling disc can be discharged completely, so that the phenomenon of repeated rolling after the tea leaves remain is avoided, and the taste of the tea leaves is protected.

title_en: Fermentation container for soy sauce fermentation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation container for soy sauce fermentation, relates to the technical field of fermentation containers, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, partial raw materials slowly sink in the soy sauce fermentation process, and if stirring is not performed, the raw materials gradually settle to the bottom to influence the quality of the soy sauce. The top of container jar is provided with first closing cap, and the outside of container jar upper end is located to first closing cap cover, the (mixing) shaft is installed to the centre of first closing cap below, and first closing cap passes through the bearing rotation with the (mixing) shaft and be connected, the outside fixed mounting of (mixing) shaft has the curved bar frame, the outside fixed mounting of curved bar frame has the blade, one side fixed mounting of (mixing) shaft has the connecting rod, one side fixed mounting of connecting rod has the scraper blade, one side fixed mounting of scraper blade has the rubber slab, the rubber slab is laminated with the inner wall of container jar mutually.

title_en: Thickness adjusting device of processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thickness adjusting device of processing equipment, which comprises: the support mechanism comprises a frame body, the inner wall of the frame body is connected with a movable seat in a sliding manner, and the top and the bottom of the movable seat are respectively and fixedly connected with a mounting sleeve and a support spring; the adjusting mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a screw rod is rotatably connected to the bottom of the fixing frame, a nut sleeve is sleeved on the surface thread of the screw rod, a movable frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the nut sleeve, and a slide rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the movable frame. The utility model has the advantages of thickness adjustment, solved the processing equipment of current potato sheet jelly in the in-process of using, be inconvenient for highly adjusting the shaping roller, influence the shaping thickness of potato sheet jelly easily, reduced the problem of potato sheet jelly processing equipment processing effect.

title_en: Aquatic product processing quick-freezing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick-freezing device for aquatic product processing, which comprises a quick-freezing box, wherein openings are formed in two sides of the front wall of the quick-freezing box, a first conveyer belt, a second conveyer belt, a third conveyer belt and a fourth conveyer belt are arranged in the quick-freezing box in parallel, the first conveyer belt and the fourth conveyer belt are respectively aligned to the two openings, the conveying directions of the first conveyer belt and the second conveyer belt are opposite, the conveying directions of the second conveyer belt and the third conveyer belt are opposite, a first guide mechanism is arranged between one end of the conveyer belt and the first end of the second conveyer belt, a second guide mechanism is arranged between the two ends of the second conveyer belt and the third end of the third conveyer belt, a third guide mechanism is arranged between the three ends of the third conveyer belt and the fourth end of the conveyer belt, a plurality of spray pipes are arranged in the quick-freezing box, a plurality of spray pipes are arranged between the spray pipes, and the spray pipes are connected to the refrigerator. The utility model can ensure that the aquatic products are fully quick-frozen, and simultaneously can shorten the length of the quick-freezing device, so that the freezing device can be suitable for being arranged in a smaller processing workshop.

title_en: Fermentation cylinder is used in milk production convenient to wash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation tank convenient to clean for milk production, which comprises a tank body, wherein a rotating cylinder extending to the inside of the tank body is rotatably arranged on the upper surface of the tank body, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the rotating cylinder, a plurality of stirring pages for stirring milk stock are arranged on the surface of the rotating rod, and a cleaning assembly for cleaning the inner wall of the tank body is arranged on the outer surface of the bottom end of the rotating cylinder; the cleaning component comprises an annular pipeline fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the rotary cylinder, and two cleaning scraping plates which are arranged on the outer surface of the annular pipeline in a circumferential array. Fermentation cylinder for milk production convenient to wash compares with prior art, can realize carrying out self-cleaning's purpose to the inner wall of jar body, and can carry out comprehensive clearance to the inner wall of jar body under the effect of clearance scraper blade, easy operation practices thrift the manpower, has solved among the prior art and needs the manual defect of dismantling jar body and carrying out manual clearance.

title_en: Agricultural product stoving storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying and storing device for agricultural products, which belongs to the technical field of drying and storing devices and particularly relates to a drying and storing device for agricultural products, which comprises a storage box, wherein a supporting leg is fixedly connected to the bottom of the storage box, the upper end of the storage box is connected with a box cover through a bolt, a supporting plate is arranged on the lower side of an inner cavity of the storage box, a hot air cavity is formed between the supporting plate and the bottom of the storage box, a hot air blower is connected to the bottom of the storage box through a bolt, an air outlet of the hot air blower is communicated with the hot air cavity, a first ventilation hole is uniformly formed in the supporting plate, a vertical pipe is uniformly arranged at the edge of the outer side of the supporting plate along the center of the storage box, an opening is formed in the bottom of the vertical pipe and is positioned in the hot air cavity, cereal crops are placed in the storage box, the storage box combines drying and storing the cereal crops, the operation is convenient, the cereal crops can be dried and stored conveniently, repeated drying can be carried out at any time, and the drying degree of the cereal crops is not required to be reduced.

title_en: Tea rolling equipment for tea processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses tea leaf rolling equipment based on tea leaf processing, which relates to the technical field of tea leaf processing and comprises a base, wherein a rotary sleeve is rotationally connected to the upper side of the base, a rolling disc is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the rotary sleeve, a rotary column is rotationally connected to the center of the upper side of the base, the rotary column penetrates through the center of the upper side rolling disc, a plurality of rolling cylinders are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the rotary column, and the rolling cylinders are uniformly distributed on the surface of the upper side of the rolling disc. According to the rolling device, the outer rolling barrel plays a role of binding tea balls, the plurality of rolling balls with the upper side pressed downwards by the springs simulate the touch feeling of a palm of a human body, the rolling disc rotating at the lower side is matched with the rolling barrel, rapid and good rolling work is performed on the tea balls, the rolling structure comprises a plurality of groups of rolling barrel structures, the rolling barrel structures rotate on the rolling disc, and meanwhile, the rolling discs at the lower side reversely rotate, so that rapid rolling of tea leaves is realized, and the rolling effect is better.

title_en: Pasteurization system for yolk treatment fluid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pasteurization system of egg yolk treatment fluid, which comprises a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger and a third heat exchanger, wherein one channel of the first heat exchanger is a first cold inlet and a first cold outlet respectively, the other channel is a first hot inlet and a first hot outlet respectively, and the first cold inlet receives egg yolk filtrate to be sterilized; one channel of the second heat exchanger is a second cold inlet and a second cold outlet respectively, the other channel is a second hot inlet and a second hot outlet respectively, the second hot inlet and the hot outlet are connected with a hot process water source, the connected hot process water is used as a heat source for pasteurization, the second cold inlet is connected with the first cold outlet, and the second cold outlet is connected with the first hot inlet; one channel of the third heat exchanger is a third cold inlet and a third cold outlet respectively, the other channel is a third hot inlet and a third hot outlet respectively, the third cold inlet and the third hot outlet are connected with a cold process water source, the third hot inlet is connected with the first hot outlet, and the output of the third hot outlet is sterilized feed liquid. The energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Tank type fermentation equipment for pickle processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses pot-type fermentation equipment for processing pickle, which comprises a substrate provided with a fermentation tank and a placing pot capable of being placed in the fermentation tank, wherein a plurality of through holes which are convenient for liquid to pass through are formed in the placing pot, a support is fixed at the inner bottom of the fermentation tank of the substrate, and the support supports the placing pot. The fermentation equipment is used for placing the pickle through the placing tank so as to enter the fermentation tank for fermentation, the pickle can be quickly taken out after the fermentation is finished, and fermentation water in the fermentation tank can enter the placing tank for fermentation of the pickle through the support.

title_en: Steam heating fumigating furnace for aquatic product processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam heating fumigating furnace for processing aquatic products, which belongs to the technical field of aquatic product processing equipment, and comprises a fumigating box, wherein a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the fumigating box, a water storage tank is arranged on the supporting plate, a gas guide component is arranged between the water storage tank and the fumigating box, a rotating rod is rotationally arranged in the fumigating box, mounting rods are symmetrically arranged on the rotating rod, a sliding cylinder is movably arranged on the mounting rods, an adjusting module is arranged between the sliding cylinder and the mounting rods, a clamping component is arranged at the bottom of the sliding cylinder, one end of the rotating rod penetrates through the fumigating box and is connected with a driven bevel gear, a rotating motor is arranged at the top of the fumigating box, and the rotating motor is connected with a driving bevel gear which is in meshed connection with the driven bevel gear.

title_en: Sunning frame that tealeaves processing was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea processing airing frame which comprises a base, wherein movable casters are arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the base, and two ends of two sides of the top of the base are fixedly connected with mounting rods. This sunning frame that tealeaves processing was used is through being provided with installation cover, backup pad, lock bolt and fixed slot, unscrew lock bolt from the inside of installation pole when needing the distance between the regulation backup pad to can make the installation cover lose fixedly, afterwards make the installation cover slide the outside of installation pole and adjust the distance between the backup pad, distance between the regulation backup pad not only can install multiunit backup pad as required, can also improve the sunning effect of tealeaves, screw in the inside of fixed slot again lock bolt and carry out spacing fixed to the installation cover after adjusting, prevent that the installation cover from unexpected slip in the outside of installation pole, the inconvenient distance between the backup pad of adjusting of solution, the relatively poor problem of flexibility.

title_en: Material steaming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steaming device, and relates to the technical field of steaming devices. The utility model relates to a steaming device which comprises a steaming box, wherein a fixed shell is arranged at the top of the steaming box, a paving mechanism is arranged at the top and inside of the steaming box, a discharging mechanism is arranged on the right side of the steaming box and inside of the fixed shell and on the paving mechanism, and the discharging mechanism is used for driving the paving mechanism. According to the utility model, the raw materials in the shell are uniformly conveyed from right to left through the rotation of the conveying rod, so that the raw materials in the shell can be continuously conveyed to the inside of the box body through the discharge chute, the raw materials on the top surface of the partition board are paved through the rotation of the paving plate, the raw materials on the top surface of the partition board can be increased along with the continuous increase of the height of the raw materials, the sleeve rod and the paving plate are pressed under the action of spring elastic force, and the surface of the paving plate is always pressed on the raw materials on the top surface of the partition board, so that the paving effect on the surface of the partition board is ensured, and the steaming effect on the raw materials is further improved.

title_en: Cleaning platform for tea processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea cleaning and discloses a cleaning platform for tea processing, which comprises a box body and an inner barrel, wherein a baffle plate is fixedly arranged on the left side of the inside of the box body, a motor is fixedly arranged on the left side of the baffle plate, a gear is fixedly arranged at the output shaft end of the motor, a driven gear meshed with the gear is fixedly arranged on the left side of the inner barrel, stirring columns are fixedly arranged on the right side of the baffle plate, a plurality of stirring plates are fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the stirring columns, a plurality of stirring blocks are fixedly arranged on the stirring plates, a stable shaft is fixedly arranged at the right end of the stirring columns, a barrel door sleeved with the stable shaft is movably arranged at the right end of the box body, a bearing in contact with the driven gear is fixedly arranged at the left end of the stirring columns, and an inner barrel is fixedly arranged at the top of the bearing. The cleaning platform for tea processing can improve the production efficiency of tea processing and save the production cost.

title_en: Tea baking oven
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea baking oven which comprises a box body, wherein a cover plate is rotatably connected to the outer wall of one side of the box body, an electric cabinet is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one end of the box body, a treatment bin is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a plurality of collecting mechanisms are arranged on the inner wall of the treatment bin, a rotating rod is arranged at one end of each collecting mechanism, a position adjusting mechanism is arranged between each rotating rod and each collecting mechanism, a heat drying mechanism is arranged at four corners of the inner wall of the box body, and an air drying mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of each rotating rod. According to the utility model, the tea can be collected by arranging the material collecting mechanism, the height of the tea can be adjusted by arranging the position adjusting mechanism, the baking efficiency is improved, the tea in the box body can be fully heated and baked by arranging the thermal drying mechanism, the tea can be subjected to hot air baking by arranging the air drying mechanism, and the rotating rod can be driven to rotate by arranging the motor at the top of the rotating rod, so that the aim of uniform thermal drying treatment is fulfilled.

title_en: Rice wine production is with squeezing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a squeezing device for rice wine production, which comprises a box body with a cavity, wherein a pressing plate is arranged in the box body, a movable block is fixed at the top of the pressing plate, driving components are arranged at two ends of the movable block, a reset component is arranged at the top of the movable block, a sliding plate is arranged in the box body and below the pressing plate, two groups of squeezing grooves are fixed at the top of the sliding plate, the pressing plate is respectively matched with the two groups of squeezing grooves, a plurality of groups of filtering holes are formed in the inner bottoms of the two groups of squeezing grooves, a collecting plate is fixed at the inner bottoms of the box body, a discharging pipe is communicated with the bottom of the collecting plate, and one end of the discharging pipe extends to one side of the box body. The pressing plate is convenient to drive through being provided with the drive assembly to realize squeezing the material, be provided with the subassembly that resets simultaneously and be convenient for squeeze work convenience, slow down the speed that movable block descends through being provided with worm and rack, thereby improve the efficiency of squeezing.

title_en: Edible fungus processing is with stoving sterilization apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying and sterilizing device for edible fungus processing, and particularly relates to the technical field of edible fungus processing. According to the utility model, wind generated by the arranged fan is accumulated in the accumulation pipeline through the wind pipe, the heating wires in the accumulation pipeline are discharged from the air blowing openings, so that edible fungi on the filter screen are directly dried, and each air blowing opening is used for drying the edible fungi on one filter screen, so that the uniformity of edible fungi drying is effectively improved.

title_en: Automatic sterilization equipment for pasteurized dairy product processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dairy product sterilization, in particular to automatic pasteurization dairy product processing sterilization equipment, which comprises a heating water tank, wherein the upper surface of the heating water tank is provided with a heating water tank cover, a water filling port is formed in the heating water tank cover, a sterilization tank is arranged on the right side of the heating water tank, the upper surface of the sterilization tank is provided with a sterilization tank cover, the upper surface of the sterilization tank cover is provided with a feed inlet, the upper surface of the sterilization tank cover is provided with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a stirring assembly, one side of the motor is connected with a connecting piece, the connecting piece is connected with a baffle plate arranged on the sterilization tank through a bolt, and the lower surface of the sterilization tank is fixedly connected with a circular ring type strut. Through setting up stirring subassembly and motor, will enter into the milk product that disinfects the case and carry out abundant stirring, make milk product can the furthest contact with the heat source, make the milk product after the stirring disinfect efficiency higher, increase the efficiency of production.

title_en: Sand removing device with back flushing tank and lotus root processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lotus root processing, in particular to a sand removing device with a back flushing tank and lotus root processing equipment, which comprise a water circulation component, wherein a lotus root hot processing component is arranged on the side face of the water circulation component.

title_en: Fresh-keeping storage container and refrigerator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fresh-keeping storage container and a refrigerator. The fresh-keeping storing container includes: the barrel body comprises an inner barrel body, and an accommodating compartment is formed in the inner barrel body; the drawer is arranged in the accommodating compartment in a drawable manner; and the magnetic field assembly is used for generating a magnetic field in the drawer, and is arranged at the top opening of the drawer so as to cover the top opening of the drawer. The magnetic field assembly is very close to the inner space of the drawer, and then the region with the most dense magnetic field lines generated by the magnetic field assembly is positioned in the inner space of the drawer, so that the magnetic field in the inner space of the drawer is uniform.

title_en: High-temperature sterilization device for production of waxberry juice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature sterilization device for producing waxberry juice, which relates to the technical field of sterilization of waxberry juice, and aims to solve the technical problem that uniform transmission of high-temperature sterilization treatment on the waxberry juice is inconvenient in the prior art; the high-temperature sterilization device comprises a bottom plate; the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a fixed back plate, the upper end of the fixed back plate is fixedly provided with a top plate, the upper end of the top plate is fixedly provided with a fixed seat, the inner side of the fixed seat is provided with a driving component, the upper end of the bottom plate is provided with a conveying component, the outer side of the fixed back plate is provided with a sterilizing component, and a plurality of groups of sterilizing components are arranged; this high temperature sterilization device is used in red bayberry fruit juice production carries out drive processing through drive assembly to conveying subassembly, drives red bayberry fruit juice through conveying subassembly's setting and carries out even conveying processing, carries out sterilization processing to red bayberry fruit juice through sterilizing subassembly's setting, has realized carrying out even transmission high temperature sterilization processing to red bayberry fruit juice.

title_en: Assembled combined saccharifying machine for beer production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a container combined type saccharifying machine for beer production, which comprises: jar body and feed inlet, jar body surface is connected with the feed inlet, jar body side is connected with out the notch, jar body side is provided with the centrifugal pump, be connected with the connecting pipe between centrifugal pump and the jar body, be close to out the notch jar internal portion is fixed with out the liquid board, agitating unit is installed to jar body bottom, jar internal wall is connected with prevents blocking mechanism, feed inlet internally connected with filtering mechanism, this collection dress combination formula beer production saccharification machine, the scraper blade rotates and can scrape the broken malt of liquid board top and move, avoids the broken excessive of piling up of malt to reduce filtration efficiency with out the liquid board jam, and the spring can drive the steel ball to slide into the block inslot portion according to self elasticity reset and fix this moment to fix the filter screen, can pour the broken malt into the feed inlet inside this moment, the broken malt can filter through the filter screen, avoids the broken too big saccharification efficiency that influences of malt.

title_en: Orange-flavor lollipop with adjustable taste
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an orange-flavor lollipop with adjustable taste, which comprises a sugar block and a handle, wherein the sugar block comprises a plurality of adjusting sugar sheets; the sugar sheet is cylindrical, through holes are formed in two sides of the sugar sheet, and a hollow cavity is formed in the sugar sheet and communicated with the through holes in two sides; a plurality of locking protrusions are arranged on one side of the handle at intervals; the handle passes through the through hole to enable the locking protrusion to be in interference fit with the hollow cavity, a plurality of adjusting sugar sheets can be connected in series on the same handle, and consumers can select adjusting sugar sheets with different tastes to be combined into sugar blocks with specific tastes, so that the taste of the lollipop is adjusted, the consumers can adjust the richness of a certain taste or add other tastes, the mixing among different tastes is realized, and the richer taste is obtained.

title_en: Shaping and strickle-off structure of dessert mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shaping and strickling structure of a dessert mold, which comprises the following components: the device seat is internally inserted with a bearing seat; the fixing frame is fixed on the left side of the top of the device seat, an adjusting rod is connected with the inner side of the top of the fixing frame in a threaded mode, and a scraping frame is rotatably arranged in the adjusting rod; the movable frame is slidably arranged on the front side and the rear side of the inside of the fixed frame; the die comprises a die body, wherein the die body is placed at the top of a bearing seat, the inside of the bearing seat is of a hollow structure, the top of the bearing seat is of a net structure, and a limiting rod is arranged on the left side of the inside of the device seat in an up-down sliding manner. This structure is strikeed to dessert mould design is strikeed to be convenient for adjust the position of strikeeing according to the mould size, strikeed the in-process and be convenient for clear up the dessert raw materials that spills over moreover, and the dessert mould strikeed the in-process and be convenient for fix simultaneously, prevents that the mould from strikeeing the in-process and taking place the skew.

title_en: Fire-clearing baking device for tea preparation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire-clearing baking device for tea preparation, which comprises a U-shaped base, wherein a placing bin for drying tea is arranged in the U-shaped base, a swinging piece for driving the placing bin to swing back and forth is arranged at the upper end of the U-shaped base, a stir-frying piece for stir-frying tea is arranged in the placing bin, and a combustion furnace for heating the placing bin is arranged in a transverse plate of the U-shaped base; the utility model can realize uniform baking of tea.

title_en: Automatic change and press and take excellent tablet preforming equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic tablet tabletting equipment with a compressible rod, which relates to the technical field of tabletting equipment and comprises a machine body, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the machine body, a rotary table is arranged at the upper end inside the machine body, a tabletting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the rotary table, a supporting frame is arranged on the outer side of the rotary table, a paper rod blanking mechanism is arranged at the upper end inside the machine body, a rod inserting mechanism is arranged on the outer side below the tabletting mechanism, a discharging mechanism is arranged on one side of the tabletting mechanism, a material processor is arranged at the upper end of the machine body, the rod inserting is automatically placed by arranging the paper rod blanking mechanism and the rod inserting mechanism, the material processor is arranged, and redundant compressible materials are sucked onto the material processor through a dust suction pipe and recycled.

title_en: Vegetable product processing drying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vegetable processing equipment and discloses a vegetable product processing and drying device which comprises a box body, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the left side of the box body, a placing basket is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a cover plate is connected to the placing basket through a connecting shaft, a fixing assembly is fixedly connected to the front side of the cover plate, a supporting column is fixedly connected to the right side of the fixing assembly, a fixing block is rotatably connected to the right side of the supporting column, the fixing block is fixedly connected to the right side of the inside of the box body, a collecting box is fixedly connected to the lower side of the inside of the box body, and a drain pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the collecting box. According to the utility model, vegetables are rotated in the drying process, so that the vegetables are dried in an omnibearing manner, partial positions are prevented from being difficult to dry due to vegetable accumulation, the vegetables are sterilized and purified in the drying process, and the safety of vegetable products is improved.

title_en: Chocolate refiner feed mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chocolate processing and discloses a chocolate refiner feeding mechanism, which comprises a base, wherein a sliding piece is arranged in the base in a sliding manner, a telescopic piece is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the sliding piece, and a rotating disc is fixedly arranged at the top end of the sliding piece; according to the utility model, the lantern ring and the rubber ring are driven to synchronously lift by stretching the electric telescopic rod, the lantern ring and the rubber ring are utilized to drive the container filled with fluid chocolate to lift, so that a mechanical device is utilized to replace a manual operation to transport the container filled with fluid chocolate, the fixing frame is driven to move by sliding of the sliding part, the fixing frame is driven to rotate by rotating of the rotating disc, the container filled with fluid chocolate on the fixing frame is rotated and moved, mechanical feeding is finally realized, and the moving position of the sliding part is controlled by clamping connection between the telescopic part and the groove on the inner wall of the base, so that the sliding part is prevented from sliding by itself.

title_en: Fodder cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feed cooler, which relates to the technical field of coolers, and particularly relates to a feed cooler. This fodder cooler can make the receipts material spare get into in the inside wind channel of air-cooled box through promoting the drive sleeve, can make the receipts material spare collect the material that remains in the wind channel before the device is out of service, avoids having the material to remain in the wind channel of air-cooled box inside, can drive the rotor through the bleeder, makes the rotor drive the eccentric wheel and rotates, makes the eccentric wheel drive to collecting the storehouse, conveniently collects the storehouse and carries out the unloading.

title_en: Steaming and killing machine for tea processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steaming and killing machine for tea processing, which relates to the technical field of tea processing and comprises a shell and a steam generator, wherein two sides of the inner wall of the shell are respectively and rotatably connected with a hollow rotating rod, a steaming and killing cylinder is fixedly connected between one ends of the hollow rotating rods, which are close to each other, a strip-shaped discharging groove is formed in the outer side of the steaming and killing cylinder, a feeding groove is further formed in the outer side of the steaming and killing cylinder, an installation frame is fixedly connected to the outer side of the shell, and a control mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the installation frame. According to the utility model, by arranging the drying mechanism, the dryer can be controlled to work, the second motor is enabled to work, the steaming and killing cylinder is driven to rotate so that the strip-shaped discharging groove is opposite to the discharging hole, tea leaves fall into the drying rack from the discharging hole, and the tea leaves move along the guide plate, so that the steamed and killed tea leaves are dried, the movable channel of the tea leaves is prolonged by the guide plate in the drying process, the drying effect is better, the tea leaves are dried in the blanking process, and the drying efficiency is high.

title_en: Tea wrap machine with heat dissipation function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of tea fixation machines, and discloses a tea fixation machine with a heat radiation function. According to the utility model, the driving motor is clamped with one end of the heat dissipation cylinder, the other end of the heat dissipation cylinder is supported by the support frame, in the fixation process, if the fixation temperature is too high, one end of the ventilation pipe can be connected to the support frame to enable the ventilation pipe to be opposite to the heat dissipation cylinder, the other end of the ventilation pipe to be connected with external fan equipment, the external fan equipment is started to drive air flow to enter the inner side of the heat dissipation cylinder, normal-temperature air is sprayed out of the air hole on the heat dissipation cylinder to cool the tea, so that the temperature is uniform, the operation is convenient, and the practicability is high without additional driving equipment.

title_en: Corn crop hybridization pollination device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corn crop hybridization pollination device, which comprises a pollen plate, wherein funnel-shaped baffles are arranged on two sides of the pollen plate, slide ways are arranged on two sides above the pollen plate, and springs are arranged in the slide ways; the bottle cap body is arranged above the pollen plate, two third screens are arranged in the bottle cap body, and a bottle cap drying chamber is arranged between the third screens; and the bottle body is connected above the bottle cap body. This maize crop hybridization pollination device compares with current device, can absorb the vapor of going into by the bottleneck through the drying chamber at pollination in-process, prevents that whole body from making pollen absorb water because of the vapor gathers too much, destroys the vigor and the pollination success probability of pollen, and the vacuum chamber can utilize PVC wainscot vacuum plastic uptake processing technology to carry out vacuum treatment with it, and the conduction of heating power can be blocked in the vacuum between glass liner and the body, carries out simple isolation to external environment temperature, prevents that the air temperature from too high leading to pollen structure unusual.

title_en: Halogen-free flame-retardant modified cheese handheld rod
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a halogen-free flame-retardant modified cheese handheld rod, which comprises a rod body containing a halogen-free flame-retardant additive, wherein the rod body comprises a handheld part (1), a fixing part (2) and a connecting layer (3), the fixing part (2) is used for limiting cheese (4), a storage groove (5) is formed in one side, far away from the cheese (4), of the fixing part (2), the handheld part (1) is inserted into the storage groove (5) and then meshed through threads, the connecting layer (3) is sticky, the connecting layer (3) is arranged on the fixing part (2), the surface of the connecting layer (3) is rough, and the connecting layer (3) is contacted with the cheese (4). The utility model has the effect of increasing the connection stability of cheese and bars.

title_en: Tea leaf rolling machine capable of being cleaned rapidly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea processing and discloses a tea rolling machine capable of being cleaned quickly, which comprises a fixing frame, wherein a rolling disc is arranged on the fixing frame, the fixing frame is fixedly arranged on a supporting frame, a rolling mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the fixing frame and the rolling disc, a stabilizing mechanism is arranged on the fixing frame and the rolling disc, a mounting groove is formed in the fixing frame, a limiting rod penetrates through the fixing frame, the end part of the limiting rod is in an inclined plane shape, and a limiting spring is sleeved on the outer wall of the limiting rod. This tealeaves that can clear up fast kneads quick-witted is extruded through the tip inclined plane of gag lever post in the stop gear and can make spacing by automatic dismantlement, and the installation is accomplished in the inside that makes things convenient for gag lever post joint to advance spacing hole, makes the spacing by the dismantlement through pulling the gag lever post simultaneously, makes things convenient for the dismantlement of twisting the dish to clear up the collection to tealeaves.

title_en: Efficient food sterilization machine for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chicken processing, in particular to a high-efficiency food sterilization machine for food processing, which comprises a base, a box body fixedly connected to the top end of the base and two first rotating shafts respectively connected to the left side and the right side in the box body in a rotating way, wherein connecting discs are fixedly connected to opposite ends of the two first rotating shafts, the same connecting shafts are fixedly connected to opposite side walls of the two connecting discs, synchronous rotating shafts are rotatably connected to the connecting shafts, rotating frames are fixedly connected to the front end and the rear end of each synchronous rotating shaft, a first driving part for driving the synchronous rotating shafts to rotate is arranged on each connecting shaft, the first rotating shafts on the left side are rotatably connected with the inner side wall of the box body through bearings, and the first rotating shafts on the right side extend to the outer side of the box body and are driven to rotate through second driving parts. Compared with the rotating frame in the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the left side and the right side of the chicken vacuum packaged in the original rotating frame are fully sprayed and sterilized through the first driving part and the synchronous rotating shaft, the sterilization effect is improved, and the quality of the chicken is ensured.

title_en: Laying hen feed processing premix device with sterilization function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laying hen feed processing premix device with a sterilization function, which comprises a mixing box, a material blocking rail, an inner supporting column and a conical tray, wherein feeding retainer rings are arranged on the inner side of the mixing box in an up-down linear array manner, the feeding retainer rings are uniformly recessed from the edge parts to the center, sterilization equipment is fixed on the lower side of the feeding retainer rings, the inner supporting column is fixed on the inner bottom side of the mixing box, the conical tray is fixed on the outer linear array of the inner supporting column, the conical tray is positioned under the feeding retainer rings, the material blocking rail is sleeved outside the conical tray up and down, and a lifting power assembly is arranged in the mixing box to drive the material blocking rail to lift; the utility model can spread the feed on the conical trays, so that the feed can be spread on a plurality of conical trays, the feed is prevented from being excessively piled up, and the sterilizing equipment can sterilize the feed spread on each conical tray, thereby ensuring the sterilizing effect.

title_en: Environment-friendly preserved meat smoking machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of smoking machines and discloses an environment-friendly preserved meat smoking machine which comprises a cabinet body, a cabinet door, a visual window and a sealing groove, wherein a plurality of hanging rods are fixedly connected to the upper part and the middle part of an inner cavity of the cabinet body at equal distances, a plurality of smoking holes are formed in the periphery of the inner cavity of the cabinet body at equal distances, a guide plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the inner cavity of the cabinet body, an oil collecting assembly is movably connected to the rear end of the guide plate, a connecting groove is formed in one side of the bottom end of the inner cavity of the cabinet body, an air purifier is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the cabinet body, an exhaust pipe is fixedly connected to the middle of the top end of the air purifier, a smoking device is fixedly arranged at the front end of the inner cavity of the cabinet body, oil dripping grease is collected through the oil collecting assembly and burnt through a burning box, smoke generated in the burning box is transported to the inner cavity of the cabinet body through a conveying pipe to be smoked, and the smoke treated by the air purifier is discharged through the exhaust pipe.

title_en: Tea carding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea carding machine, which has the technical scheme that: including the fixed plate, first standing groove has been seted up to the top surface of fixed plate, the equal fixed mounting of inside corner of first standing groove has the fixed plate, the sliding hole has been seted up to the top surface of fixed plate, the inside bottom surface fixed mounting of first standing groove has the hot plate, the top surface fixed mounting of hot plate has a plurality of limiting plate, the inside of first standing groove is provided with the sliding plate, a plurality of limiting hole has been seted up to the top surface of sliding plate, the top surface fixed mounting of sliding plate has a plurality of gag lever post, the gag lever post comprises cylindrical part and disc part, the cylindrical part outer wall cover of gag lever post is equipped with the spring, the spring pass through disc part with the top surface of fixed plate is spacing, through the design of hot plate and sliding plate, can control the state of reason strip and material loading, when reason strip for the limiting plate stretches out through the limiting hole.

title_en: Anti-blocking type saccharification pot for beer production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of saccharification pots, in particular to an anti-blocking type saccharification pot for beer production, which comprises a saccharification pot mechanism, wherein the saccharification pot mechanism comprises a pot body, a saccharification pot fixing plate, a water outlet pipe, a saccharification pot first support column, a support column base, a saccharification pot second support column and a saccharification pot connecting plate, the bottom end of the pot body is fixedly provided with the saccharification pot fixing plate, the bottom end of the saccharification pot fixing plate is fixedly provided with the water outlet pipe, when the equipment is operated, a machine is powered on, then beer is poured into a stirring rod above the equipment to prevent the beer from saccharification, and then the beer can flow out through the water outlet pipe.

title_en: Fermentation device for producing probiotics beverage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for producing a probiotic beverage, which relates to the technical field of fermentation equipment of the probiotic beverage, and comprises a fermentation tank and a support frame, wherein the support frame is arranged at the bottom of the fermentation tank; the air leakage cylinder is arranged at one side of the top of the fermentation tank and consists of an outer cylinder, an inner braking piece and a smooth platform, the inner braking piece and the smooth platform are arranged at the inner side of the outer cylinder, and the smooth platform is connected to the bottom of the inner braking piece in a sliding manner; the feeding cylinder is arranged on the other side of the top of the fermentation tank; the industrial tablet personal computer is arranged outside the fermentation tank; the stirring assembly is connected to the inside of the fermentation tank; in the utility model, the pressure can be automatically released, so that the pressure of a fermentation tank is not required to be released at regular time when workers spend time, and the burden of the workers can be reduced to a certain extent; moreover, the arrangement of the temperature increasing components is dispersed and comprehensive, so that the internal temperature of the fermentation tank is more uniform when the internal temperature of the fermentation tank is increased, and the fermentation effect of the probiotic beverage is not adversely affected.

title_en: Saccharification filter equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a saccharification filter device, which relates to the technical field of beer production, in particular to a saccharification filter device, comprising an operation box, wherein the front and the bottom of the operation box are fixedly connected with mounting plates, one of them the bottom fixedly connected with lifting subassembly of mounting panel, the spout has all been seted up to the both sides of control box upper surface, the top fixedly connected with mounting bracket of control box both sides. Through sideslip subassembly and clearance subassembly's setting, C motor drives the B lead screw and rotates, and then the B lead screw rotates and drives the scraper blade and remove, scrapes the impurity on the filter when the scraper blade removes, and then carries out primary cleaning to the filter, and then the water pump starts, later with the inside extraction of water storage box, later sends it to the inside of leading to the chamber board, sprays the filter through wasing the shower nozzle and clear up, and then clear up the filter again to avoid the filter filtration pore to appear blocking.

title_en: Screening plant for maize breeding granule
abstract_en: The utility model provides a screening device for corn breeding particles, which relates to the technical field of screening devices and comprises: the screening device comprises a screening device bracket, wherein a dust shielding plate is arranged at the top of the screening device bracket, and a drying box is arranged above the screening device bracket; the dust shielding component is arranged between the screening device bracket and the dust shielding plate and is used for preventing dust from flying; and a drying component arranged between the screening device bracket and the drying box and used for drying corn seeds. This kind of screening plant passes through the setting of stoving subassembly, can carry out the stoving processing to the moisture on maize seed surface, reduces the screening in-process impurity and mixes in the seed surface follow-up process, improves screening quality to through the setting of hiding the dirt subassembly, can avoid the dust to splash, reduce the risk that operating personnel inhaled the dust, be favorable to protecting operating personnel's health.

title_en: Pipeline cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline cleaning, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, when a scale in a pipeline is cleaned, the pipeline is required to be taken out, the pipeline is required to be cleaned after being knocked back after being cleaned manually, and the pipeline is easy to damage, the workload is large and the efficiency is low; the utility model can clean the scale in the heating medium tube without disassembling the pipeline, does not damage the pipeline, has simple operation, saves time and labor, and is beneficial to saving cost and improving working efficiency.

title_en: Effectual grain storage device dehumidifies
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a storage device, which belongs to the technical field of grain storage, in particular to a grain storage device with good dehumidification effect, comprising a granary, wherein a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the granary, and an air inlet pipe is arranged at the outer side of the granary; according to the grain bin, the driving shaft and the spiral blades are driven by the starting motor to rotate through the arrangement of the stirring mechanism, so that grains at the bottom of the grain bin move upwards along the fixed pipe until the grains overflow from the top end of the fixed pipe, then the grains fall on the top of the grains through the material guiding disc, the driving shaft rotates to drive the L-shaped rod and the scraping rod to rotate, the scraping rod rotates to stir the tops of the grains, the driving shaft drives the rotating shaft and the fan blades to rotate through the driving belt and the two driving wheels, the purpose of stirring the grains in the grain bin is achieved, the grains can be fully ventilated, the dehumidification effect of the grains is improved, and the problem that the grains accumulated for a long time can generate larger moisture due to the fact that the grain bin is larger and is inconvenient to stir the grains is solved.

title_en: Residue recovery unit that milk product production was used
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of milk products, in particular to a residue recovery device for milk product production, which comprises a bracket, a conveying belt, a heating component and a material cleaning component, wherein the conveying belt is arranged on the bracket, the heating component comprises a heating rod, the heating rod is arranged on the bracket and is positioned between the upper belt surface and the lower belt surface of the conveying belt, the material cleaning component comprises a scraping plate, the scraping plate is arranged on the bracket, is positioned at the discharge end of the conveying belt, is abutted with the surface of the conveying belt and is positioned below the upper belt surface of the conveying belt; the designed residue recovery device for the dairy product production reduces the moisture content in the dairy product residues falling onto the conveying belt after the dairy product residues are dried by the heating rod, and then the dairy product residues on the conveying belt are scraped and collected by the scraping plate, so that people can conveniently collect and store the dairy product residues.

title_en: Tea rolling device with elastic cloth guiding structure
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of tea processing devices, and provides a tea rolling device with an elastic cloth guiding structure, which comprises: the rolling machine comprises a frame, wherein a rolling box is fixedly connected to the top of the frame, and a connecting frame is arranged at the top of the rolling box. According to the tea rolling device with the elastic cloth guiding-out structure, provided by the utility model, the rotation of the rolling blocks while the rolling blocks turn round is controlled by arranging the hollow pipe, the power shaft, the first bevel gear, the second bevel gear, the motor case, the third bevel gear, the motor, the rotating mechanism and the linkage mechanism, so that the loss of electric energy is reduced, the problem that the existing rolling device is used for rolling tea by arranging a plurality of motors to control the rolling bottom plate to rotate while the rolling bottom plate turns round is solved, but the power consumption is overlarge due to the arrangement of the motors, and the processing cost of the tea is increased is solved.

title_en: Cooling device for tea processing
abstract_en: A cooling device for tea processing comprises a support, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged on the support, one end of the conveyor belt is a feeding end, the other end of the conveyor belt is a discharging end, tea to be cooled is paved on the conveyor belt, a primary cooling box and a secondary cooling box are arranged on the support, the conveyor belt penetrates through the primary cooling box and the secondary cooling box, a first air inlet is formed in the lower portion of the primary cooling box, a first air outlet is formed in the upper portion of the primary cooling box, a second air inlet is formed in the lower portion of the secondary cooling box, and a second air outlet is formed in the upper portion of the secondary cooling box. The primary cooling box is filled with natural wind, so that tea leaves with higher temperature after fixation are subjected to primary heat dissipation, the secondary cooling box is filled with cold wind, and the tea leaves and the cold wind in the box body are subjected to heat exchange to finish final cooling. The first-stage cooling box and the second-stage cooling box form a continuous and step-by-step enhanced cooling effect, and the multi-stage cooling arrangement can enable tea to be cooled more uniformly and thoroughly.

title_en: Salted duck egg white membrane ultrafiltration desalination device
abstract_en: The application discloses a salted duck egg white membrane ultrafiltration desalination device which comprises a dilution stirring unit and an ultrafiltration unit, wherein the dilution stirring unit comprises a charging basket, an inverted U-shaped frame, a stirring motor, a stirring shaft and a plurality of stirring paddles, an ultrasonic generating unit is arranged at the charging basket, a dilution pipe and a blanking pipe are connected at the charging basket, two feeding holes are formed in the top of the charging basket, a filtration unit is arranged at the feeding holes, and the ultrafiltration unit comprises a liquid inlet main pipe, a discharge main pipe, a backwash main pipe, a waste liquid main pipe and a plurality of ultrafiltration pipes. According to the membrane ultrafiltration desalination device, the main feeding pipe and the auxiliary feeding pipe can be used for feeding simultaneously, so that quick feeding is realized, the filtering unit is arranged at the feeding port and used for filtering impurities, the filtering unit can be replaced quickly, the multiple pipes of the ultrafiltration unit are arranged in parallel, ultrafiltration and backwashing operations are more flexible, and liquid flow in the treatment process can be effectively controlled, so that the efficiency and quality of salted duck egg white membrane desalination are improved.

title_en: Tea-oil camellia processing beating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea-oil camellia processing hammering device which comprises a hammering mechanism and a position moving mechanism, wherein the position moving mechanism is fixedly connected to the front side of the top of the hammering mechanism, the position moving mechanism comprises a moving box, the bottom of the right side of an inner cavity of the moving box is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the left side of the surface of the rotating rod is sleeved with a first gear ring, the top of the inner cavity of the moving box is transversely and movably connected with a screw rod through a bearing, the left side of the surface of the screw rod is sleeved with a second gear ring, the bottom of the second gear ring is meshed with the first gear ring, and the surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a screw block. The hammering device changes the mode that the positions of the traditional hammering frames are fixed, adopts the connecting blocks to drive the hammering material frames to move left and right, is not troublesome when needing to beat oil tea at different positions, does not need to stop equipment to swing the oil tea in the hammering frames, and does not influence the overall hammering efficiency.

title_en: Tea pile fermentation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea pile fermentation device which comprises a placing box, wherein first telescopic rods are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top end of the placing box, the top ends of the first telescopic rods are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of a supporting inner plate, first springs are welded around the outer wall of the top end of each first telescopic rod, the top ends of the first springs are welded on the outer wall of the bottom end of the supporting inner plate, a plurality of groups of ventilation holes are formed in the outer wall of the bottom end of the supporting inner plate at equal intervals, and the outer side wall of the placing box is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the bottom end of a connecting frame. According to the utility model, under the action of the elastic potential energy of the first spring matched with the telescopic action of the first telescopic rod, the supporting inner plate bearing the tea pile is driven to perform lifting vibration operation on the inner side of the placement box, in the lifting vibration operation process, the tea pile bearing the top end of the inner plate is subjected to vibration flattening operation, in the vibration process, the stacked height level is even, and the later-stage oxidation fermentation effect of tea is effectively ensured.

title_en: Antioxidant adding mechanism and nut stir-frying machine
abstract_en: The application discloses an antioxidant adding mechanism and a nut frying machine, which relate to the technical field of nut frying equipment, and comprise a base, wherein a sliding groove is formed in the base, an adding cylinder is arranged in the sliding groove in a sliding manner and used for containing an antioxidant, a valve is arranged on the adding cylinder, the valve is used for controlling the opening and closing of the discharge hole of the adding cylinder, a reciprocating screw rod is arranged in the base in a rotating mode, the reciprocating screw rod is used for driving the adding cylinder to reciprocate, a driving source is arranged on the base, and the driving source is used for driving the reciprocating screw rod to rotate. The application has the effect of improving the mixing uniformity of roasted seeds and nuts and antioxidants.

title_en: Tunnel type microwave sterilization machine for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel type microwave sterilization machine for food processing, which comprises a conveying device, wherein microwave sterilization equipment is arranged at the middle part right above the conveying device, an L-shaped limiting block is arranged at one end right above the conveying device, a horizontal moving mechanism is arranged at the inner side of the L-shaped limiting block, a rotating structure is arranged below the horizontal moving mechanism, the tunnel type microwave sterilization machine for food processing can prevent materials from scattering in the conveying process through baffles arranged at two sides of a conveying belt, the tunnel type microwave sterilization machine for food processing can push materials through an upper mechanism to prevent stacking when the materials are stacked, rotatable plates are arranged below the upper mechanism, and are extruded through springs, so that the plates are extruded by the springs to drive the materials to move when contacting the materials in the horizontal moving process, and the mode can not damage the surfaces of the materials.

title_en: Container mounting structure of ice cream machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a container mounting structure of an ice cream machine, which comprises a cup locking assembly and a cup assembly provided with a cup inner cutter, wherein the cup assembly is provided with a cup body mounting body, the cup body mounting body comprises a mounting inclined surface and a locked surface, the mounting inclined surface is a threaded surface, the cup locking assembly comprises a locking piece and a cup locking piece provided with a cup body mounting groove, and the locking piece is in linear sliding connection and has a trend of approaching the cup assembly, and the locking piece abuts against the locked surface to prevent the cup assembly from rotating out of the cup body mounting groove. The utility model has the advantages that the cup assembly is convenient to install and can be firmly installed.

title_en: Grain dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grain dryer which comprises a mounting frame, wherein an electric slide rail and two mounting plates are fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, a feed hopper is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting frame in a penetrating manner, a drying box is fixedly arranged between the two mounting plates, a valve is arranged at the discharge end of the drying box, a material guide mechanism and a blowing mechanism are arranged between the two mounting plates, a first communication port and a second communication port are formed in the mounting plate in a penetrating manner, a material guide plate which is obliquely arranged is fixedly arranged on the mounting plate, a stirring mechanism is arranged at the inner top of the mounting frame, and an electric sliding block is connected onto the electric slide rail in a sliding manner. The grain drying box is reasonable in structural design, when the grains are dried, moisture in the grains positioned on the bottom of the drying box can be guaranteed to be rapidly emitted, the drying effect is guaranteed, an operator can conveniently sample and observe the dried grains, and whether the operator is capable of rapidly judging whether the grains are dried or not is guaranteed.

title_en: Fish meal dryer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fish meal drying, in particular to a fish meal dryer, which comprises a shaking module and a base arranged on the bottom surface of the shaking module, wherein the upper end of the shaking module is rotationally connected with a shell, the surface of the shell is provided with a material opening, the fish meal dryer also comprises a drying assembly arranged in the shell, the drying assembly comprises a first motor arranged on the surface of the shell, the inner clamping plate and the outer clamping plate can be matched, the inner clamping plate is driven to rotate by the outer clamping plate, a containing cylinder connected with the inner clamping plate can rotate, fish meal at the bottommost layer can move upwards along with the rotation of the containing cylinder and then falls down due to gravity, the stirring rod is used for fully stirring the fish meal, so that the fish meal can be fully dried, and meanwhile, a suction assembly is added, and the characteristics that hot moisture in the containing cylinder is sucked into the gas storage box by utilizing the matching of a gas collecting groove and a vent hole and is condensed by utilizing a condensing plate.

title_en: Hawthorn product uncovering device
