abstract_en: The utility model discloses a haw product uncovering device, which relates to the technical field of haw product processing, is suitable for uncovering when haw slices are processed, and comprises an adjusting component; the device comprises an adjusting component, a vibration unit arranged on the upper surface of the adjusting component, and a uncovering piece unit arranged on the outer surface of the vibration unit and used for uncovering pieces, wherein the vibration unit comprises a turnover component and a placing component arranged on the outer surface of the turnover component. According to the utility model, the rotating base, the buffer spring column, the placement box and the vibrator are mutually matched, so that the placement tray is arranged in the placement box, the hawthorn can be conveniently separated from the placement tray by high-frequency vibration, the lifting of the hawthorn can be conveniently realized, and the hawthorn can be conveniently removed by mutually matching the support frame II, the driving motor, the screw rod, the limiting slide rod, the moving plate, the electric lifting rod, the telescopic limiting rod, the lifting plate and the lifting scraper, so that the hawthorn adhered in the tray can be conveniently realized, and the hawthorn product lifting device can be further used for thoroughly removing the hawthorn.

title_en: Lifting ice cream machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ice cream machines, and particularly relates to a lifting ice cream machine which comprises an ice cream machine body, wherein a first groove is formed in one side of the ice cream machine body, a cross column is connected in a sliding mode in the first groove, a first connecting block is fixedly connected to one side of the cross column, a placing ring is fixedly connected to the top end of the first connecting block, a square block is fixedly connected to one end of the connecting column, a quantitative blanking module is arranged on one side of the ice cream machine body, and a lifting assembly is arranged in the ice cream machine body.

title_en: Disc type intermittent immersed plant bioreactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disc type intermittent submerged plant bioreactor, which relates to the field of plant tissue culture and comprises a box body, wherein a bulkhead is arranged in the box body, the box body is divided into a culture cabin and a motor cabin which are sealed with each other, an opening at the bottom of the culture cabin is used for externally connecting a water pipe, culture solution is introduced into or discharged from the culture cabin, a culture disc is obliquely arranged in the culture cabin, plants are uniformly arranged in the culture disc along the circumferential direction, at least one part of the plants is submerged in the culture solution, a motor is fixedly arranged in the motor cabin, and the shaft end of the motor penetrates through the bulkhead and then is connected with the bulkhead to drive the culture disc, so that each part of the plants is intermittently submerged in the culture solution. The utility model utilizes the motor to drive the culture tray to uniformly rotate in the culture cabin (water receiving tray), ensures that each part of plants is immersed into the culture solution intermittently, and the whole reactor only needs the motor to drive and control, has simple structure and high control efficiency, and can meet the requirements of most of plants with medium and low immersion frequency and some plants with high immersion frequency.

title_en: Tea cake pressing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea cake processing equipment, in particular to a tea cake pressing machine, which comprises a belt conveyor, wherein a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the top of the belt conveyor, a charging barrel is arranged in the center of the top of the mounting frame in a penetrating manner, and a sealing cover is sleeved on the top thread of the surface of the charging barrel. The utility model solves the problems that the pressing thickness of tea cakes is inconvenient to control, when tea cakes with different thicknesses are required to be manufactured, the setting of the device is required to be frequently changed, the machine is required to be repeatedly started and shut down after the tea cakes are pressed, then the finished product is taken out and the tea materials are refilled, the effect of accurate pressing can be effectively achieved, the adjustment is convenient and fast, the cutting speed of the cutting knife can be effectively controlled, the size of the cut tea materials can be changed, thus the tea cakes with different sizes can be manufactured, the tea cakes can be rapidly conveyed forwards after the pressing is finished, the pressing is continuously carried out, the material is not required to be stopped and taken out in the whole process, the operation safety coefficient is high, and the working efficiency is high.

title_en: Full-automatic rice steaming machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wine making equipment, in particular to a full-automatic rice steaming machine which comprises a base and a box body, wherein the surface of the base is fixedly connected with the box body, a moving device is arranged in the box body, a shaking device is arranged on the surface of a tray, the other end of a hose is fixedly communicated with a spiral heat exchange tube in a heat exchanger, and the surface of the spiral heat exchange tube is fixedly connected in the heat exchanger. This full-automatic rice steaming machine, through the cooperation of mobile device and tray, no longer need operating personnel to deposit and take out the rice raw materials by hand, operating personnel's work load has been reduced, the work efficiency of a full-automatic rice steaming machine has been improved, continuous rotation of output shaft through the second motor drives the slider and carries out reciprocating motion, the slider drives the bin and carries out synchronous motion, make the inside rice raw materials of bin stall under the effect of inertia, avoid the different time differences that the rice of different positions steamed, the rice steaming effect of a full-automatic rice steaming machine has been improved.

title_en: Cleaning device for processing vegetables and fruits
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vegetable and fruit processing equipment, and discloses a cleaning device for vegetable and fruit processing, which comprises a cleaning tank, a soaking tank part arranged on one side, and a power roller rotatably connected to two sides of the inner wall of the cleaning tank, wherein one side of the power roller is provided with a limit groove, and two ends of a hairbrush roller are fixedly connected with clamping blocks; according to the vegetable and fruit cleaning device, dirt in the brush roller is cleaned in the vegetable and fruit cleaning process through the arrangement of the cleaning mechanism, the vegetable and fruit cleaning effect can be improved, the subsequent vegetable and fruit pollution risk can be reduced, meanwhile, the brush roller can be quickly and conveniently detached and replaced through the cooperation of the quick-release mechanism, the limiting groove and the clamping block, the efficiency of disassembling the brush roller can be improved, the time and labor cost are saved, and the problems that the brush roller cannot be cleaned and the brush roller is inconvenient to replace in the use process of the conventional vegetable and fruit processing and cleaning device are solved.

title_en: Highland barley food parch equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses highland barley food baking and frying equipment, which relates to the technical field of highland barley food processing, and comprises a base plate, wherein the top end of the base plate is fixedly connected with a baking and frying cylinder, the side wall of the baking and frying cylinder is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, the center of an outer ring of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a spiral stirring blade, an external thread is arranged at one side of the outer ring of the rotating shaft, the outer ring of the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with a three-fork frame at the external thread, scraping strips are fixedly connected at the side ends of the three-fork frame, which are close to corners, and are in contact with the inner wall of the baking and frying cylinder.

title_en: Dry ladle desulfurization equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable fresh-keeping storage and discloses a dry ladle desulfurization device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the front side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a desulfurization box, the rear side of the desulfurization box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a driving assembly, the front side of the driving assembly is fixedly connected with a beating head, the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the desulfurization box are fixedly connected with support plates, and the left side and the right side of the top of each support plate are fixedly connected with limiting columns. According to the utility model, the wet dry ladle is placed in the desulfurization box, and then hot steam is introduced into the air inlet pipe, so that the dry ladle can be heated and desulfurized, and then the motor is started, so that the output end of the motor drives the output shaft to rotate, and then the output shaft drives the beating head to beat the vibrating plate when rotating, so that the dry ladle vibrates, and then the dry ladle can be heated uniformly and desulfurized more thoroughly.

title_en: White tea sweetness enhancement equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses white tea sweetness enhancement equipment, which comprises a stabilizing seat, wherein a discharging bin is arranged above the stabilizing seat at intervals through a supporting part, a feeding door and a discharging pipe are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the discharging bin, a rotating bin capable of taking in air is horizontally arranged in the discharging bin through a rotating shaft, one rotating shaft penetrates through the outer side of the rotating bin and is connected with a driving mechanism, and a discharging opening is formed in the rotating bin. The white tea sweetness enhancement equipment is convenient for uniformly withering tea leaves, and ensures that the sweetness of the tea leaves is uniform as much as possible.

title_en: Tea cake pressing machine for tea production
abstract_en: The application relates to a tea cake pressing machine for tea production, which slides in a positioning slideway through a surrounding plate to form a pressing die by cooperating with a pressing table, the pressing table and the surrounding plate have various specifications, so that the specifications of the die can be freely determined according to the specifications of tea cakes to be pressed, after the surrounding plates are folded, tea leaves are placed in a space formed by the pressing table and the surrounding plates, a hydraulic cylinder drives a pressing column to move, so that the tea leaves are pressed into the tea cakes, after the pressing is finished, the surrounding plate is moved along the positioning slideway in a direction away from the pressing table, so that the pressed tea cakes are conveniently taken out, when the pressing column presses the tea cakes, a pressure bearing plate on the bottom surface of the pressing table can move downwards due to the pressure from the pressing column, thereby triggering a sensor, the sensor displays the detected pressure through a display, and a user can observe the pressing pressure in real time conveniently.

title_en: Low plant pollination device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low plant pollination device, which relates to the technical field of plant pollination and comprises an air pipe, wherein an air channel is formed in the air pipe, a fan is fixedly connected to one side of the air pipe, the input end and the output end of the fan are both communicated with the air channel, air holes are formed in two sides of the air pipe, the air holes are communicated with the air channel, a placement box is arranged in the air holes, a filter is arranged on one side of the placement box, and a first baffle is fixedly connected to one side of the air pipe. According to the utility model, the box is fixedly arranged in the wind hole connected with the wind channel, the first filter screen and the second filter screen are arranged in the box, and double-layer filtration can effectively prevent flowers from entering the wind channel from the wind hole, so that the influence on pollination efficiency caused by the fact that the pollination device cannot work normally due to the blockage of the wind channel is avoided, and therefore, the guarantee is provided for the normal work of the pollination device, the smooth progress of pollen transmission is ensured, and the pollination efficiency and success rate are improved.

title_en: A cooking device for vinegar processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooking device for processing vinegar, which comprises a cooking cylinder, wherein a rotary moving assembly is arranged on the outer side of the cooking cylinder, the rotary moving assembly comprises two limiting plates arranged on the circumferential outer wall of the cooking cylinder, a rotary ring is arranged between the two limiting plates and is in rotary connection with the cooking cylinder, a side frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the rotary ring, a toothed ring is arranged on the outer wall of the cooking cylinder, one side of the toothed ring is in meshed connection with a first gear, the first gear is fixedly connected with an output shaft of a first motor, and the first motor is fixedly arranged on the side frame.

title_en: Impurity removal and purification equipment for white spirit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a white spirit impurity removal and purification device which comprises a distillation table, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the upper surface of the distillation table, a condensation tank is fixedly connected to the side surface of a steel ring, a water tank is fixedly connected to the side surface of the condensation tank, a water pump is fixedly connected to the side wall of the water tank, a water pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the water pump, one end of the water pipe, far away from the water tank, extends to the inner surface of the condensation tank, and the water pipe is provided with a fixing ring, a fixing bolt, the clamping groove, a sealing plate and a clamping block.

title_en: A stir-fry device turns over for cooked food processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cooked food processing and discloses a stir-frying device for cooked food processing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the left side and the right side of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with connecting plates, the back end of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a vertical plate, a heating furnace is arranged in the middle of the top of the bottom plate, a rotating stir-frying mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the connecting plates, the back end of the vertical plate is provided with a lifting mechanism, the rotating stir-frying mechanism comprises a rotating assembly and a stir-frying assembly, the rotating assembly is arranged on the inner side of the connecting plates, the stir-frying assembly is arranged on the inner side of the rotating assembly, the rotating assembly comprises a first motor, the first motor is fixedly connected to the right side of the connecting plates, and the back end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a worm. The worm is driven to rotate through the first motor, the worm drives the rotating rod to rotate through the worm wheel, the rotating rod drives the connecting rod to rotate through the rotating disc, the connecting rod can drive the storage pot to rotate, and cooked food in the storage pot can be poured out.

title_en: Fragrant golden pagodatree flower bud tea making device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fragrant golden pagodatree flower bud tea manufacturing device which comprises a threshing assembly and an integrating furnace, wherein an evaporating barrel, a gas conveying area and a liquid sealing area are arranged in the integrating furnace, the evaporating barrel is positioned in the gas conveying area, a supporting truss is connected above the threshing assembly, a conveying rail is arranged below the supporting truss, the bottom of the threshing barrel is communicated with the evaporating barrel, a steam through hole is formed in the outer wall of the evaporating barrel, the gas conveying area is positioned above the liquid sealing area, a discharge port is formed in the bottom of a stir-frying furnace, the liquid sealing area is communicated with the gas conveying area and the outer surface of the stir-frying furnace, and a steam manufacturing machine is communicated with the liquid sealing area.

title_en: Bean product curdling barrel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bean product processing, in particular to a bean product pulp-dropping bucket, which comprises a pulp-dropping bucket base body and a supporting seat, wherein the pulp-dropping bucket base body is arranged on the supporting seat, and further comprises a stirring device, the stirring device comprises a stirring shaft, a stirring paddle, a stirring motor, a rotating assembly, a connecting sliding block, a mounting guide rail, a connecting block and a lifting driving assembly, the stirring shaft is fixedly connected with the rotating output end of the stirring motor, the stirring paddle is fixedly connected with the stirring shaft, the stirring motor is rotationally connected with the connecting sliding block through the rotating assembly, the rotating assembly is connected with the stirring motor and drives the stirring motor to rotate, the connecting sliding block is slidingly connected with a mounting guide rail through the lifting driving assembly, the mounting guide rail is fixedly connected with the connecting block, the connecting block is fixedly connected with the supporting seat, and the lifting driving assembly is connected with the connecting sliding block to move so as to obtain the effect of replacing manual pulp dropping, reducing the manual labor and accelerating the processing efficiency of bean products.

title_en: Pasteurization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pasteurization device, which relates to the technical field of milk processing and is technically characterized by comprising a heat preservation layer, wherein a milk outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the heat preservation layer, an outlet battery valve is fixedly arranged at one end of the milk outlet pipe far away from the heat preservation layer, a double-layer mechanism is arranged in the heat preservation layer, a processing tank sealing mechanism is arranged at the top of the double-layer mechanism, a heat flow mechanism is arranged on the left side of the double-layer mechanism, a cold flow mechanism is arranged on the right side of the double-layer mechanism, the double-layer mechanism comprises an outer cavity, a partition ring is arranged on the inner side of the outer cavity, and a milk placing cavity is formed on the inner side of the partition ring.

title_en: Steamed meat product stand device that dries in air
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a braised meat product spreading and airing device in the technical field of braised meat spreading and airing. The inner side of the spreading and airing structure is provided with a supporting structure for supporting the spreading and airing structure, the lower end of the spreading and airing structure is provided with an oil storage structure for storing oil, the upper end of the spreading and airing structure is provided with a plurality of isolation nets for placing the steamed meat, the supporting structure comprises a vertical rod, and the middle part of the vertical rod is provided with a plurality of positioning holes for positioning the spreading and airing structure. The oil that steamed meat spread and dried in the air produced falls to the upper end of bottom plate, through the support diagonal bar that the slope set up for the bottom plate slope in step, and oil falls to down oil pipe's middle part from the oil drain port, finally falls into the inside collection of arc batch oil tank, avoids the oil drop to on the steamed meat of next floor spread and dried in the air. Through a plurality of locating holes in the middle part of the vertical rod, the locating rods are inserted into the corresponding locating holes by the staff with different heights according to the heights of the staff, the heights of the spreading and airing structures are located, and inconvenience caused by too high spreading and airing heights for the staff is avoided.

title_en: Cotton candy gift machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton candy gift machine, which relates to the technical field of cotton candy manufacturing equipment and comprises a cotton candy gift machine body, a rotating mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein the rotating mechanism is connected to the cotton candy gift machine body and comprises a connecting rod, a mounting plate, a motor, a rotating shaft, rotating blocks and telescopic rods, the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the cotton candy gift machine body through two symmetrically arranged connecting rods, the motor is mounted on the upper surface of the mounting plate, the output end of the motor penetrates through the upper surface of the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft through a coupler, and the rotating blocks are fixedly connected to the lower end of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Multifunctional tea earlier-stage treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional tea pre-treatment device, which relates to the field of tea processing and comprises a treatment box, wherein a circulating mechanism is arranged on the front side of the treatment box, an electric heater is fixedly arranged on the left side of the treatment box, a position adjusting mechanism is arranged on the back side of the treatment box, and a rotary dispersing mechanism is arranged on the right side of the treatment box. According to the utility model, the circulation mechanism is arranged, so that the air flow in the treatment box can be accelerated, the heat diffusion is more uniform, the dehumidifying board can filter moisture, the drying efficiency is improved, the rotary dispersing mechanism is arranged, the net-shaped charging barrel can be driven to rotate, so that the tea leaves in the net-shaped charging barrel are driven to roll, the tea leaves are heated more uniformly and are convenient to dry, the net-shaped door is opened, the tea leaves are convenient to take, and the position adjusting mechanism is arranged, wherein the integral position of the rotary dispersing mechanism can be adjusted by controlling the forward rotation or the reverse rotation of the first motor, so that the tea leaves are convenient to take.

title_en: Green tea roasting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses green tea pan-firing equipment, which relates to the field of green tea processing and comprises a supporting box body, wherein bottom cushion blocks are evenly abutted to the bottom surface of the supporting box body, a control panel is fixedly arranged on one side edge of the supporting box body, a turnover top groove is horizontally formed in the top surface of the supporting box body, a turnover inner block is horizontally clamped on the inner side edge of the turnover top groove, a top groove channel is formed in the top surface of the supporting box body, a rotary box body is arranged on the inner side edge of the top groove, bottom screw holes are evenly formed in the bottom surface of the supporting box body, connecting screws are fixedly inserted into the top surface of the bottom cushion block, a heat insulation inner layer is fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the top groove, a treatment inner layer is fixedly arranged on the inner side edge of the heat insulation inner layer, a heating pipe is inlaid in the inner side wall of the treatment inner layer, and the integral control structure is adopted, so that when the integral control structure is used, the integral control structure is more convenient and efficient, meanwhile, the pan-firing efficiency is improved, and the turnover efficiency is improved.

title_en: Novel smokeless food soup skin frying machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soup skin machines and provides a novel smokeless food soup skin machine, which comprises a placing frame, a heating coil device, an iron pan, a temperature controller host and a plurality of heating coil devices, wherein a plurality of supporting frames are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the placing frame in a circumferential array, the heating coil device is fixedly arranged at the center of the top of the placing frame, the iron pan is movably arranged on the inner wall of the heating coil device, transverse strips are fixedly arranged on two adjacent sides of each supporting frame, and the temperature controller host is fixedly arranged at the tops of the transverse strips. According to the utility model, the heating coil device is controlled by the temperature controller host to heat so as to heat the iron pan, the temperature of the heating coil device can be precisely controlled under the action of the temperature controller host, the iron pan can be directly heated, firewood or liquefied gas can be prevented from being used as fuel, pollution can be reduced, and production cost can be saved.

title_en: Egg breaking machine capable of recycling residual liquid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an egg breaking machine capable of recycling residual liquid, which relates to the field of egg breaking machines and comprises an egg breaking machine body and a yolk guide assembly, wherein support columns are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the egg breaking machine body left and right, a feeding assembly is fixedly arranged at the right side of the egg breaking machine body, a fixing support is fixedly connected to the left side of the egg breaking machine body, and a connecting support is fixedly arranged at the left side of the egg breaking machine body. This egg machine of breaking down of recoverable residual liquid through the connecting axle that sets up for the staff can drive the yolk leading truck and rotate along the internal surface of linking bridge when driving the knob to rotate, thereby make the right-hand member downwardly moving of yolk leading truck, with this reach the purpose of empting residual liquid in the yolk leading truck, through dead lever and the connecting strip that set up, make the yolk leading truck can drive the egg liquid leading truck and carry out synchronous rotation when carrying out the rotation, make the raffinate in yolk leading truck and the egg liquid leading truck all can obtain the rapid treatment.

title_en: Flash tank in starch sugar production process
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of starch sugar preparation devices, in particular to a flash tank in a starch sugar production process, which comprises an upper tank body, a tank body and a lower tank body, wherein the upper tank body, the tank body and the lower tank body are sequentially communicated from top to bottom, a steam outlet is formed in the top end of the upper tank body, a material outlet is formed in the bottom end of the lower tank body, the tank body comprises a main body, a conical baffle, a sprayer and a heat exchanger, the conical baffle, the sprayer and the heat exchanger are sequentially and fixedly arranged in the main body from top to bottom, the conical baffle comprises a baffle main body enclosing a conical curved surface forming an assumed cone, the bottom surface of the assumed cone faces the upper tank body, a plurality of through holes are formed in the baffle main body, an opening is formed in the bottom surface of the assumed cone, a drain hole is formed in the baffle main body at the conical tip of the assumed cone, the quick and uniform heat energy transfer is realized, the flash evaporation time is shortened, the product quality is improved, and the overall productivity is improved.

title_en: Tea multi-port feeding and single-port output all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tea multi-port feeding and single-port outputting integrated machine, which relates to the technical field of tea processing and comprises a main board, wherein a movable plate is arranged in the main board, a storage frame is fixed at the top end of the movable plate, a collecting frame is placed in the storage frame, a bushing plate is arranged in the collecting frame, and telescopic rods are arranged at two ends of the storage frame. When different tealeaves are poured into to collect in the frame, through the operation of two telescopic links, drive two push plates equidirectional constantly remove to can drive the collection frame between two push plates and constantly sideslip, on the one hand, rock the mixture to collecting different tealeaves in the frame, on the other hand, make and collect in the frame tealeaves and rock, make its tealeaves sediment that exists can shift out through the bushing, make its quality higher, the practicality is stronger, and the device is placed in accomodating the frame through collecting the frame, can take out at any time and collect the frame, change or wash it, the practicality is stronger.

title_en: High-temperature sterilization device for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature sterilization device for food processing, which belongs to the technical field of high-temperature sterilization for food processing and comprises four support columns, wherein the top ends of the support columns are fixedly connected with middle hole plates, device shells are placed at middle holes of the middle hole plates, heat preservation barrels are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the device shells, straight barrel thick pipes are fixedly communicated with the bottom ends of the heat preservation barrels, liquid discharge pipes are fixedly communicated with one sides of the bottom ends of the straight barrel thick pipes, first electromagnetic valves are arranged at one ends of the liquid discharge pipes, straight barrel thin pipes are fixedly connected with the inner walls of the bottom ends of the straight barrel thick pipes, air inlet pipes are fixedly communicated with one sides of the bottom ends of the straight barrel thin pipes, and second electromagnetic valves are arranged at one ends of the air inlet pipes.

title_en: Sea cucumber sterilization device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sea cucumber sterilization and discloses a sea cucumber sterilization device, which comprises two brackets which are distributed front and back, wherein a sterilization cylinder is fixedly connected between the tops of the two brackets, the front and back of the sterilization cylinder are sealed, the middle part of the interior of the sterilization cylinder is rotationally connected with a sea cucumber cylinder, the front end of the sea cucumber cylinder is opened and rotationally connected with a sealing door, the outer wall of the sea cucumber cylinder is provided with uniformly distributed vent holes, the rear side wall of the sterilization cylinder is fixedly provided with a motor, the output shaft of the motor is rotationally connected with the sterilization cylinder, the output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the middle part of the rear side wall of the sea cucumber cylinder, and the right side of the sterilization cylinder is provided with a water pump. According to the utility model, the sea cucumber is sterilized by the high-temperature steam generated by the heating wire, so that bacteria and microorganisms on the surface of the sea cucumber can be effectively killed, the sanitary quality of the sea cucumber is ensured, the motor drives the sea cucumber barrel to rotate, the sea cucumber is uniformly heated in the barrel, the problem of uneven heating possibly occurring is avoided, and the sterilization effect is improved.

title_en: Automatic filling device for plant tissue culture dish
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plant tissue culture, in particular to an automatic filling device of a plant tissue culture dish, which comprises a mounting plate, the outside of connecting axle has seted up the locating hole, and the outside fixed pipe fixed mounting has the extension spring, and the one end fixedly connected with of extension spring is pegged graft with the locating pin of locating hole. According to the utility model, the placing grooves with specific sizes are formed in the placing plate, so that the precise and rapid placing of the culture dishes with specific sizes is facilitated, in addition, the tension spring is stretched by pulling the positioning pin, one end of the positioning pin is separated from the inside of the positioning hole, the effect of conveniently taking down the fixed pipe from the outer side of the connecting shaft is achieved, the placing plates with different sizes are convenient to replace, the adapting capability is improved, and the technical problems that in the prior art, when a plurality of culture dishes are placed, the placing precision and the placing rapidness are difficult to ensure, the using effect is poor, and the practicability is reduced are solved.

title_en: Drying room for processing air-dried geese
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of drying rooms, and particularly relates to a drying room for processing air-dried geese, which comprises two rectangular frames sequentially arranged from top to bottom, wherein a side plate surrounding a circle is inserted between the two rectangular frames, the rectangular frames comprise a plurality of connecting rods which are detachably connected and four corner rods, the four corner rods and the plurality of connecting rods are sequentially spliced end to end in a modularization manner to form a mounting part for accommodating the plurality of side plates in an inserting manner, two ends of each connecting rod and each corner rod are respectively provided with a butt joint hole and a butt joint block, one end of each butt joint block can be inserted into an adjacent butt joint hole, and a fixing piece for fixing the butt joint block is arranged in each butt joint hole.

title_en: Efficient ice making device for snow thawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of snow thawing machines and discloses a high-efficiency ice making device for a snow thawing machine, which comprises a refrigeration roller, wherein a first ice making area and a second ice making area are arranged on the refrigeration roller, a first stirring piece and a second stirring piece are arranged on the refrigeration roller, the first stirring piece is arranged in the first ice making area, and the second stirring piece is arranged in the second ice making area; through set up first ice making region and second ice making region on the refrigeration running roller, through the first stirring piece that is located first ice making region and the second stirring piece that is located second ice making region cooperate to improve the ice making region of refrigeration running roller, and then improve the heat exchange efficiency of interior liquid of snow melt machine and refrigeration running roller, and then improve the shaping speed of ice.

title_en: Extrusion drying device for dried meat floss production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dried meat floss production extrusion steaming equipment, in particular to an extrusion steaming device for dried meat floss production, which comprises a workbench and vertical fixing rods fixedly arranged at the end parts of the workbench, wherein a first lapping plate is fixedly connected between the two vertical fixing rods, a threaded rod is connected at the vertical center of the first lapping plate in a threaded manner, the lower end of the threaded rod is rotatably connected with a mounting shell through a bearing, a heating pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the mounting shell, and a limiting ring piece is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the mounting shell.

title_en: Raw material stirring device for egg roll production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring devices, in particular to a raw material stirring device for egg roll production, which comprises a substrate and the like, wherein the substrate is an assembly carrier of the device, a stirring cylinder is arranged on the substrate, the top of the stirring cylinder is provided with a blanking opening, a top cover is semicircular and fixedly connected to the opening at the top of the stirring cylinder, the top cover is shielded at half of the opening at the top of the stirring cylinder, and the raw material stirring device further comprises a discharging frame which is arranged on one side wall of the lower part of the stirring cylinder, and a motor which is arranged on the top cover through a bracket. The top cover and the movable cover form a complete shielding cover together, raw materials can be conveniently added by rotating the movable cover, the operation is convenient, and the cleaning water can be sprayed into the stirring cylinder by arranging the plurality of spray heads on the bottom surface and the side surface of the flow guide frame, so that the cleaning efficiency is improved especially for materials which are difficult to clean on the bottom surface and the corners of the stirring cylinder.

title_en: Fermentation device is used in beef paste production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for beef paste production, which comprises a fermentation tank and an accelerating fermentation mechanism, wherein an installation sealing box is arranged on the upper surface of the fermentation tank, the accelerating fermentation mechanism comprises a bead groove, a rotating bead, a rotating rod, a spiral piece, an arc scraping piece and a bottom ramming disc, the bead groove is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the fermentation tank, the rotating bead is rotationally connected to the inside of the bead groove, the rotating rod is fixedly sleeved in the middle of the rotating bead, the spiral piece at the middle lower section of the outer cambered surface of the rotating rod, the arc scraping piece which is uniformly distributed is arranged at the lower side of the outer cambered surface of the rotating rod, the bottom ramming disc is arranged at the lower end of the rotating rod, the outer cambered surface of the arc scraping piece at the leftmost side is contacted with the inner cambered surface of the fermentation tank, and the lower cambered surface of the bottom ramming disc is contacted with the inner bottom surface of the fermentation tank.

title_en: Quick cooling mechanism of jerky
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rapid cooling of jerky, and discloses a rapid cooling mechanism of jerky, which comprises a cabinet body, a cabinet door and a connecting frame, wherein the side wall of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the side wall of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with an inclined slide way, and a connecting device is arranged above the connecting plate; when the quick cooling work of the dried pork is carried out, the cabinet body is opened by sliding the cabinet door, at the moment, the connecting device can be automatically connected with a gap generated by opening the cabinet door above the connecting plate, and then the food rack containing the dried pork is pushed, so that the food rack can be moved into the cabinet body along the inclined slide way through the connecting device, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and the connecting device can prevent the food rack from being clamped in the gap between the cabinet body and the inclined slide way after the cabinet door is opened during movement.

title_en: Tea strip tidying machine convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea carding machine convenient to clean, which belongs to the technical field of tea carding machines and comprises a bottom plate for installing the tea carding machine and a cleaning roller brush for cleaning tea, wherein a carding plate is slidably arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, a plurality of carding grooves are formed in the top surface of the carding plate, two strip grooves are symmetrically formed in the top surface of the carding plate, an electric sliding block is slidably arranged in the strip grooves, a U-shaped plate is fixedly arranged between the top surfaces of the two electric sliding blocks, a plurality of vertical plates are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the U-shaped plate corresponding to the carding grooves, a motor is fixedly arranged on one side of each vertical plate, the cleaning roller brush is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of an output shaft of the motor, and the outer side of the cleaning roller brush is attached to the inner wall of the carding groove. Compared with the prior art, the device can be used for effectively cleaning tea leaves, tea residue and the like in the carding groove, so that the quality of finished products of the tea leaves is improved.

title_en: Ox bone thawing weighing line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a beef bone thawing weighing line, which belongs to the field of production lines and comprises a weighing working area, a cleaning elevator, a beef bone conveying belt and a beef bone thawing machine, wherein the output end of the beef bone thawing machine is connected with the beef bone conveying belt, the output end of the beef bone conveying belt is connected with the cleaning elevator, the lifting end of the cleaning elevator is connected with the weighing working area, the beef bone is transported to the beef bone conveying belt after being thawed from the beef bone thawing machine, then transported to the cleaning elevator through the beef bone conveying belt, and enters the weighing working area after being cleaned and lifted by the cleaning elevator, the beef bone is subjected to lossless thawing through the special beef bone thawing machine, and then is weighed through the cleaning elevator, so that the problems of large-batch beef bone thawing, manual consumption, residue cleaning and weighing are solved.

title_en: Handle mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of frozen beverage makers, and discloses a lifting handle mechanism which can be opened or locked by lifting or pressing, wherein when a first end of a locking assembly (30 a, 30 b) moves to a first end of a limiting assembly (130 a), a clamping assembly (20 b) is separated from the locking assembly (30 a, 30 b) so as to control a mixing container (20) to be separated from a main body (10), and when a second end of the locking assembly (30 a, 30 b) moves to a second end of the limiting assembly (130 a), the limiting assembly (130 a) is embedded into the clamping assembly so as to lock the mixing container (20) on the main body (10).

title_en: Steam box for instant noodle production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a steam box for instant noodle production, which relates to the technical field of instant noodle production equipment and comprises a steam box body, wherein a plurality of placing racks are arranged in the steam box body from top to bottom, supporting locking assemblies are symmetrically arranged at the bottoms of the placing racks, supporting protruding blocks matched with the supporting locking assemblies are arranged at the left end and the right end of the interior of the steam box body, each supporting locking assembly comprises a movable locking block, a screw rod and a handle, a guide cylinder is fixedly arranged at the side part of the placing rack, a threaded hole communicated with the guide cylinder is formed in the placing rack, a guide groove is formed in one side of the movable locking block, which is far away from the guide groove, and a groove matched with the supporting protruding blocks is formed in one side of the movable locking block.

title_en: Fresh-keeping equipment capable of improving spraying range
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fresh-keeping equipment capable of improving spraying range, which relates to the technical field of fresh-keeping equipment and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a fresh-keeping agent box is fixedly connected to the bottom plate, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the side surface of the fresh-keeping agent box, a first gear is movably mounted on the mounting plate, a connecting sleeve is fixedly connected to the side surface of the first gear on the mounting plate, an inner pipe is rotatably connected to the connecting sleeve, a second gear is fixedly connected to the inner pipe, a spraying sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner pipe at the position below the second gear, the height of an annular moving plate is adjusted by rotation of a screw rod, so that the sprayable range of the fresh-keeping agent is increased, a stepping motor is started, the first gear and the second gear are meshed with each other for transmission, the inner pipe is rotated by the second gear, centrifugal force is provided for sprayed liquid, the spraying range is further improved, and the spraying effect is better.

title_en: Be used for high pulp content fruit juice electrolytic deacidification equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to electrolysis equipment, in particular to electrolysis deacidification equipment for high-pulp-content juice. The technical scheme is that the electrolytic deacidification equipment for the high-pulp-content fruit juice comprises a frame, a blanking frame, a glass plate, a storage battery, a power line and the like, wherein the blanking frame is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the frame, the glass plate is fixedly connected to the other side of the top of the frame, the storage battery is fixedly connected to one side of the frame, the power line is fixedly connected to the left side, the right side and the rear side of the storage battery, and the power line penetrates through a side wall and stretches into the frame. The utility model combines the fruit juice with positive ions (such as H  + ) generated by the anode in the anode electrolysis area to primarily reduce acidity and generate low-acidity compounds such as water, and combines the residual acidic substances in the fruit juice with negative ions (such as OH  ‑ ) generated by the cathode in the cathode electrolysis area to further reduce acidity, thereby effectively realizing the electrolytic deacidification effect of the fruit juice.

title_en: Preheating device for dairy product production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preheating device for dairy product production, which relates to the technical field of dairy product heating and comprises a preheating cylinder, wherein a temperature detection device is connected to the preheating cylinder, a connecting ring is connected to the preheating cylinder, a heating box is connected to the bottom of the preheating cylinder, and a mounting plate is connected to the top of the heating box. According to the utility model, the electric slide bar slides in the slide groove, the connecting ring is driven to rotate through the movement of the electric slide bar, the connecting ring and the preheating cylinder synchronously rotate, so that uniform heating is realized, the connecting ring is driven to move through the rotating handle, namely the preheating cylinder is driven to rotate, the dairy product can be uniformly heated in the preheating process through the rotation of the preheating cylinder, the synchronous rotation ensures that the same preheating effect can be achieved for each produced product, the annular heating element is arranged in the heating box, and the annular heating element can provide a rapid and uniform heating effect because heat can be transmitted from multiple directions, and the heat loss and the heating time are reduced.

title_en: Rotary opening and closing rotary digging grain lifting hopper
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary opening and closing rotary excavating vinasse hopper, and belongs to the technical field of white spirit brewing equipment. The device comprises a connecting arm, wherein the top of the connecting arm is connected with a traveling crane in a workshop, a vinasse starting barrel is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the connecting arm, a first driving piece for driving the vinasse starting barrel to rotate is arranged on the connecting arm, an opening is formed in the bottom of the vinasse starting barrel, a bottom cover component and a second driving piece for driving the bottom cover component to rotate are hinged to the bottom of the vinasse starting barrel, the bottom cover component comprises an upper cover body and a lower cover body, a vinasse inlet is formed in the upper cover body, and the lower cover body is coaxially rotatably arranged at the bottom of the upper cover body. The opening of the dreg inlet and the rotary digging of the dreg discharging opening can be realized by driving the dreg discharging barrel to descend and rotate, the dreg inlet is closed when the dreg discharging barrel reversely rotates, and the bottom cover component integrally overturns to realize the dreg discharging, so that the dreg discharging barrel has the effects of small movable occupied space of the dreg discharging hopper and high dreg discharging efficiency for the dreg in the pit.

title_en: Smokeless stir-frying equipment for composite seasoning production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of composite seasoning production, in particular to smokeless seasoning equipment for composite seasoning production, which comprises a processing box, wherein a hemispherical pot body is fixedly arranged in the processing box, a feed hopper is arranged at the top end of the processing box, a discharge hole is arranged at the bottom end of the processing box, a heating mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the hemispherical pot body, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the hemispherical pot body, and a smoke filtering mechanism is arranged at one side of the processing box. The driving motor is started through the control panel, the stirring shaft and the spiral stirring rod are driven to rotate, the arc stirring blades and the inclined stirring blades are synchronously driven to stir and mix the seasonings, and the inclined stirring blades can penetrate into the inside of the seasonings to break up the cohesive and agglomerated materials so as to facilitate subsequent uniform heating. After the seasoning is fried, the driving motor is operated to rotate reversely through the control panel, the valve of the discharge port is opened, the reverse thrust of the spiral stirring rod is utilized, the blockage of the discharge port is avoided, and the rapid discharge of the seasoning is realized.

title_en: Detachable grain turning machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grain storage, in particular to a detachable grain turning machine which comprises a floating disc, wherein a driving motor is arranged on the floating disc, an output shaft of the driving motor vertically penetrates through the floating disc downwards, an auger delivery blade is detachably arranged on an output shaft of the driving motor, the floating disc adopts a split type structure and comprises a front floating disc and a rear floating disc, the front floating disc and the rear floating disc are detachably connected through quick-release locks, the driving motor is arranged on the rear floating disc, and an armrest is detachably arranged on the rear floating disc. Compared with the prior art, the utility model adopting the technical scheme has the outstanding characteristics that the wear-resistant floating disc specification is changed in a folding and splitting mode, so that the floating disc can enter the shallow circular bin through the manhole, and finally, the grain turning machine can walk on the grain surface of the shallow circular bin to finish grain turning, and the grain turning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fermentation vat is used in white spirit processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of white spirit processing and discloses a fermentation cylinder for white spirit processing, which comprises a fermentation cylinder main body, wherein the top of a cylinder cover is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the right side of the front surface of the fixed plate is provided with a driving component, the middle of the top of the fixed plate is provided with a control component, the bottom of the control component is provided with a lifting component, the bottom of the lifting component is provided with a movable rod, and the bottom of the movable rod is fixedly connected with a storage basket. Through being equipped with drive assembly, control assembly, lifting unit, movable rod and locating frame, the lower extreme of fly leaf can drive lifting unit and carry out the lift removal of vertical direction, makes the movable rod drive and puts the thing basket and go up and down to the movable rod is when going up and down to remove, and the guide way plays the effect of direction to the dead lever, thereby makes the movable rod take place to rotate, drives then and puts the thing basket and take place to rotate, can make the white spirit raw materials in the thing basket can fully contact with the clear water, makes white spirit raw materials can obtain abundant fermentation.

title_en: Tea screening and grading integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea screening and grading integrated device which comprises a base, a supporting frame, a storage box, a screening frame and a screening assembly, wherein supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the base, the supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base, the storage box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting frame, the outer side of the storage box is fixedly connected with a discharging channel, the screening frame is arranged at the lower end of the discharging channel, and the screening assembly is arranged at the upper end of the base. This tealeaves screening and hierarchical integrated device wait to process tealeaves drops screening frame upper end through the discharge channel, and operation driving motor this moment, driving motor output drives first bevel gear and rotates, and first bevel gear drives second bevel gear through the meshing with second bevel gear and rotate, and second bevel gear rotates and can drive the axis of rotation and rotate, and the axis of rotation drives the screening frame of vibrating plate upper end through the connection of two joints and swings, thereby screening frame high-speed swing can produce vibration sense and drive the tealeaves of upper end along screening frame inclined plane downwardly moving.

title_en: Quick cooling setting device of food
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of food processing, and particularly relates to a rapid food cooling and shaping device which comprises a cooling and shaping bin for rapid cooling and shaping of food, wherein lifting grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the cooling and shaping bin, vibrating sliders are slidably arranged on the inner sides of the two lifting grooves, vibrating mechanisms are arranged on the two vibrating sliders, a protective shell is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the cooling and shaping bin, an extrusion mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the protective shell, a sealing cover is rotatably arranged at the top of the cooling and shaping bin, and a handle is fixedly arranged on one side of the sealing cover. The utility model can drive the silica gel mould containing syrup to vibrate, so that the syrup in the silica gel mould is uniformly distributed, the condition of uneven surface of the finished candy is prevented, and the silica gel mould can be extruded through the extrusion mechanism, thereby being convenient for ejecting the finished candy out of the silica gel mould, being convenient for demoulding and increasing the practicability of equipment.

title_en: Screening plant is used in green tea processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screening device for green tea processing, which comprises a vibrating bin, a supporting frame and a vibrating motor, wherein a plurality of first supporting plates are fixed on the side walls of the two sides of the vibrating bin, a first spring is arranged at the bottom of each first supporting plate, the bottom of the first spring is fixedly connected with the top of the supporting frame, the vibrating bin is connected with the supporting frame through the first spring, the vibrating motor is arranged on the side wall of the vibrating bin, a feeding component for conveying green tea into the vibrating bin is further arranged at the top of the vibrating bin, a stirring rod is further rotatably arranged on the vibrating bin, a driving component for driving the stirring rod to rotate is arranged on the supporting frame, a first screening net and a second screening net are further arranged in the vibrating bin, and the second screening net is arranged at the bottom of the first screening net, so that the problems that impurities such as small-sized crushed slag cannot be screened by the existing screening device, and the crushed slag fall into the screening bin together with the screened tea leaves, and the screening efficiency of the green tea is affected are solved.

title_en: Slurry feeding device is wrapped up in to poultry egg
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slurry-wrapping feeding device for poultry eggs, which comprises a raw egg conveying mechanism and a slurry tank which are adjacently arranged, wherein a raw egg output end of the raw egg conveying mechanism is positioned above the liquid surface of the slurry tank, and a raw egg buffer structure which is used for receiving raw eggs just fallen from the raw egg output end through autorotation and enabling the raw eggs to slowly fall on the liquid surface of the slurry tank is arranged between the raw egg output end of the raw egg conveying mechanism and the liquid surface of the slurry tank. The slurry-wrapped feeding device for the poultry eggs can slow down the speed of the raw eggs when the raw eggs fall on the surface of a slurry pool, reduce the impact force applied to the raw egg shells, avoid the situation that the raw egg shells break as much as possible, and improve the qualification rate of products.

title_en: Automatic tea wrap device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea fixation, and discloses an automatic tea fixation device, which comprises a conveying mechanism, wherein a microwave fixation mechanism is arranged at the top end of the conveying mechanism, L-shaped fixing plates are fixedly connected to the front end and the rear end of the conveying mechanism, an adjusting rod is connected to the inside of the L-shaped fixing plates in a sliding manner, a limiting plate is arranged at one end of the adjusting rod, a handle is fixedly connected to the other end of the adjusting rod, and sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the inside of the L-shaped fixing plates. This automatic change tea wrap device, through the setting that can lead to the removal orbit of tealeaves, when the staff need carry the bin with the tealeaves after completing that completes, can make the transportation orbit of tealeaves obtain effectual control, and then make tealeaves can fall into the bin neatly and steadily, avoided the tealeaves to scatter and chaotic in transportation, also can effectually reduce staff's work load.

title_en: Mixing bearing device for grain wetting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mixing bearing device for a grain wetting machine, which belongs to the technical field of crop processing production equipment and comprises a bearing bracket, a driving mechanism and a bin, wherein the bearing bracket comprises a lower bracket and a bottom bracket, the lower bracket is provided with a pneumatic ultrasonic generator and the driving mechanism, the front end of the bottom bracket is supported and fixed with the bin through a front bracket, one end, close to an opening of the bin, of the bottom bracket is provided with a water-vapor separation device, steel cylinders of the water-vapor separation device are fixedly connected through guard bars on two sides of the bottom bracket, the top end of the front bracket is provided with two groups of pulleys, the outer wall of the bin is provided with hoops corresponding to the pulleys, the water-vapor separation device is fixedly connected to the bottom bracket and is positioned at the bottom of the bin, and the lower bracket comprises a trapezoid bottom bracket and a supporting platform.

title_en: Tea leaf drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea drying device, which relates to the technical field of tea processing equipment and comprises an outer cylinder, a driving mechanism, an inner cylinder and a material supporting mechanism, wherein the upper end of the outer cylinder is provided with a discharging hole, the lower end of the outer cylinder is provided with a discharging hole, a discharging cylinder is arranged on the discharging hole, a conveying plate is rotationally connected to the discharging cylinder, the driving mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the outer cylinder and is connected with the input end of the conveying plate through a transmission component, the inner cylinder is arranged in the outer cylinder through a fixing frame, a feeding hole is arranged at the position, corresponding to the feeding hole, of the upper end of the inner cylinder, the lower end of the inner cylinder is provided with a discharging hole, the material supporting mechanism is rotationally connected in the inner cylinder, the input end of the material supporting mechanism penetrates through the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder and is in transmission connection with the transmission component, and a sweeping mechanism is fixedly arranged in the inner cylinder.

title_en: Combined saccharification pot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined saccharification pot which comprises a stirring barrel, a connecting plate and a driving motor, wherein the connecting plate is connected to the upper end of the stirring barrel in a sliding manner, the driving motor is fixedly connected to the upper end of the connecting plate, a slot is formed in the upper end of the stirring barrel, an arc-shaped guide groove is formed in the inner wall of the slot, an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a connecting shaft through a coupler, stirring rods are arranged on the outer wall of the connecting shaft in an array manner, one side of the connecting shaft is movably connected with a movable guide block, and the movable guide block is connected to the inside of the arc-shaped guide groove in a sliding manner. According to the stirring rod, the connecting shaft is driven by the driving motor to drive the stirring rod to rotate, and meanwhile, the movable guide block is driven to do sliding motion in the arc-shaped guide groove, so that the stirring rod moves upwards under the guide of the arc-shaped guide groove, and the stirring rod moves upwards while stirring, so that the stirring mode is not uniform, and the stirring effect is improved.

title_en: Cold pressing lemon juice equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to cold-pressed lemon juice equipment which comprises a lemon juice pressing module, a lemon juice cooling module and a nitrogen protection module, wherein the pressing module is used for realizing lemon cutting and juice extrusion through a feeding hopper, a blade assembly, a feeding roller and a pair of rolling rollers, the cooling module is used for realizing accurate temperature control of 4 ℃ of lemon juice by matching a spiral cooling coil with a stirrer and combining a temperature sensor and a flow control valve, an 8cm heat preservation interlayer is arranged on the outer side of the cooling cylinder, and the nitrogen protection module is used for charging nitrogen and discharging oxygen before juicing through a nitrogen inlet below a screen and a nitrogen outlet at the top of the cooling cylinder to form an anaerobic barrier. The device also comprises a raw material precooling module at 4-10 ℃. The utility model effectively inhibits thermal oxidation and flavor deterioration, shortens quick-freezing time and reduces energy consumption through full-process low-temperature control and nitrogen seal protection, and is suitable for large-scale production of high-quality lemon juice.

title_en: Saucepan capable of heating uniformly
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mushroom processing, and particularly relates to a uniformly heated saucepan, which comprises a saucepan, a pot cover and a handle, wherein the pot cover is arranged at the top end of the saucepan, the handle is fixedly arranged at the top end of the pot cover, a pressing device is arranged on the outer wall of the saucepan, and an agitating device is arranged in the saucepan. This saucepan of even heating through setting up agitating unit for the device is steaming and boiling the in-process to the mushroom, can stir the mushroom, thereby makes the mushroom be heated more evenly, promotes the efficiency of being heated, has also improved the efficiency of cooking, has solved the device that proposes among the background art when steaming and boiling the mushroom, the inside mushroom of saucepan is heated inefficiency, thereby produces the problem of certain influence to the processing of mushroom, through setting up closing device, can compress tightly the pot cover to the in-process that the mushroom was steamed, makes the leakproofness of this saucepan obtain reinforcing, makes the device's efficiency of cooking obtain promoting, has also promoted the production quality of mushroom.

title_en: Semi-automatic self-flowing bean washing and soaking integrated barrel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-automatic self-flowing bean washing and soaking integrated barrel, which belongs to the technical field of food processing and comprises a barrel body, a baffle device detachably connected with the barrel body, a flow guiding device connected to the bottom of the barrel body and an incubation barrel positioned at the tail part of the flow guiding device, wherein the barrel body comprises supporting legs, a cone bottom barrel connected above the supporting legs, a quick connection pipeline connected to the outlet of the bottom of the cone bottom barrel, a support plate arranged in the cone bottom barrel and a connecting nut arranged in the center of the support plate, the baffle device comprises a handle, an upright rod vertically connected with the handle, a threaded connector arranged at the tail end of the upright rod and a pore plate arranged on the upright rod, the flow guiding device comprises a quick connection joint connected with the quick connection pipeline, the other end of the quick connection joint is sequentially connected with a gate valve, a quick connection male plug, a quick connection female plug and a steel wire hose, and the tail part of the steel wire hose is communicated with the incubation barrel. The device can integrate three processes of bean washing, bean soaking and bean pouring into the hatching barrel, reduces the labor intensity of workers and has low cost.

title_en: Filtering mechanism for bone soup production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering mechanism for bone soup production, and relates to the technical field of food production. The utility model comprises a boiling Shang Zujian, wherein a motor is fixedly arranged on the upper wall of a fixed cover, a spring is arranged in the upper part of a guide rod corresponding to the inside of a guide sleeve, a plurality of lifting plates are fixedly arranged on the lower side of the peripheral wall of the guide rod, round rods are fixedly arranged on the upper side of the guide rod, spiral ribs are fixedly arranged at the two ends of each round rod corresponding to the inner peripheral wall of a heating box in a circumferential array, rotating rods are fixedly arranged on the side walls of the front side and the rear side of a mounting frame, side plates fixed with the heating box are arranged outside the rotating rods, a gauze layer is arranged in the mounting frame, and a fine mesh screen is arranged above the gauze layer. According to the utility model, the reciprocating up-and-down motion of the lifting plate is realized through the cooperation of the spiral ribs, the springs and the round rods, the structure is simpler, the maintenance is more convenient, the bone soup is further filtered through the gauze layer, and meanwhile, the filtering position is arranged outside the heating box, so that the filtering effect is improved, and meanwhile, the fine mesh screen and the gauze layer are more convenient to clean.

title_en: Fruit and vegetable cleaning machine with ozone function
abstract_en: A fruit and vegetable cleaning machine with ozone function. Solves the defects of the prior art that the structure is complex, the volume is large, the air pump is difficult to be matched with the ozone generator, the ozone generating efficiency is low, the concentration of ozone in gas is low, the power consumption is high, and the like. The technical proposal is that the kitchen sink comprises an electric control circuit, a vegetable washer shell, a cleaning basin and an ozone generator, wherein the ozone generator is an air pump type ozone generator. The generator shell is of a double-cavity structure formed by a pressure gas generating cavity and an ozone generating cavity, the ceramic piezoelectric vibrator is arranged in the pressure gas generating cavity, and the ozone generating sheet is arranged in the ozone generating cavity. The ozone exhaust port of the air pump type ozone generator is communicated with the inner cavity of the cleaning basin through a pipeline. The ozone generator has the advantages of simple structure, small whole volume, low working noise, low cost, high ozone generating efficiency, good cleaning effect, good pesticide residue removing effect, low power consumption and the like.

title_en: Milk sterilizing and deodorizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fresh milk treatment, and discloses a sterilizing and deodorizing device for milk, which comprises a tank body, wherein a feed pipe and a blow-down pipe are respectively embedded at the top of the tank body, the blow-down pipe is communicated with an external negative pressure system, a discharge pipe is embedded at the right lower part of the tank body, valves are arranged on the surfaces of the feed pipe and the discharge pipe, and a heating assembly, a stirring assembly and a material adding and deodorizing assembly are respectively arranged in the tank body. When the device for sterilizing and deodorizing the milk is used, the milk is added into the tank body through the feed pipe, and is heated and boiled through the electric heating plate, so that the smell substances in the milk volatilize, and the smell substances are discharged out of the tank body through the blow-down pipe, the purposes of sterilizing and primarily deodorizing the milk are achieved, scented tea and almonds are added into the storage net bag, substances in the scented tea and the almonds are utilized to neutralize the substances of the mutton smell, the purpose of further deodorizing the milk is achieved, and the taste of the milk is ensured.

title_en: Multi-head micro-vibration device for artificial supplementary pollination in flowering phase of rape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-head micro-vibration device for artificial supplementary pollination in a rape flowering phase, which relates to the technical field of supplementary pollination, wherein an extension rod is inserted at the upper end of a loop bar in a sliding manner, an installation seat is fixed at the upper end of the extension rod, the upper end of the extension rod is fixedly connected with the installation seat, two installation cylinders are rotatably connected at the inner sides of the installation seat, and vibration mechanisms are arranged at the inner sides of the two installation cylinders. The utility model can flexibly set the whole length of the device, and the vibrating rod can be unfolded outwards or stored inwards, so that the device is convenient to use or store, improves the pollination efficiency and success rate, and is suitable for the problems of difficulty and low efficiency of artificial pollination in the breeding process.

title_en: Beer fermentation tank temperature itinerant acquisition device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temperature itinerant acquisition device of a beer fermentation tank, which comprises a fermentation tank, a motor, a transmission rod, stirring blades, a temperature itinerant acquisition structure and a heating device; the utility model aims at solving the problems of large number of fermentation tanks and dense temperature detection points in large-scale breweries, eight routes of itinerary acquisition modules are adopted, a single module can be connected with eight temperature probes simultaneously, independent temperature transmitters and analog quantity channels are not required to be configured for each detection point, forty fermentation tanks are taken, three detection points of each fermentation tank are taken as an example, one hundred twenty routes of analog quantity channels and corresponding modules are required in a traditional mode, fifteen routes of itinerary acquisition modules are only required in the device, the purchase cost, the line laying cost and the later maintenance cost of automatic control equipment are obviously reduced, and on the aspect of temperature regulation and control precision, C-shaped heating rings corresponding to the temperature probes are arranged on the inner walls of the upper, middle and lower parts of the fermentation tanks, and the heating intensity can be accurately regulated according to the temperature requirements of different areas by matching with partition control logic of a controller.

title_en: Rice flour microwave heating curing device and rice flour machine with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microwave heating curing device for rice flour and a rice flour machine with the device, wherein the curing device comprises a silk extruding part, the device comprises a wire extruding cylinder and a microwave heating assembly, wherein the microwave heating assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the wire extruding cylinder. The microwave heating component comprises a magnetron, the wire extrusion component comprises a machine barrel component and a wire extrusion screw, the machine barrel component comprises an inner barrel and a wire extrusion barrel, a plurality of microwave inlets are formed in the side wall of the wire extrusion barrel, the inner barrel is arranged in the wire extrusion barrel, a feeding hole of the inner barrel is communicated with the feeding pipe, the wire extrusion screw is arranged in an inner cavity of the inner barrel, each inlet on the wire extrusion barrel is provided with a microwave heating component, and the inlets are fixedly connected with the magnetron. The microwave heating and curing device for the rice flour directly heats the rice flour by microwaves, is easy to control the heating temperature, is energy-saving and environment-friendly, and can solve the problems of uneven heating of materials, long heating time and high energy consumption in the heating and curing process of the rice flour.

title_en: Green tea stir-frying machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of green tea processing and discloses a green tea stir-frying machine, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a driving motor is fixedly connected to the outer part of the mounting frame, a driving shaft is arranged at the output end of the driving motor, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner part of the mounting frame, a stir-frying barrel is fixedly connected between the driving shaft and the rotating shaft, a debris collecting mechanism is arranged in the stir-frying barrel and used for collecting debris in the tea frying process, a stir-frying mechanism is arranged in the stir-frying barrel and used for enabling the green tea to be stir-fried more uniformly. According to the utility model, the sliding rod is pushed downwards by the push handle, so that the sliding block moves downwards to compress the spring, and when the sliding block moves, the U-shaped frame is driven by the connecting rods at two sides of the sliding block, so that the two clamping rods drive the two hoops to be separated relatively, the final quality of a product is improved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Rice wine distillation purification device
