abstract_en: The utility model provides a rice wine distillation and purification device which comprises a distillation bearing component, a heating distillation component, a steam conveying component, a condensation component and a collection component, wherein the distillation bearing component, the heating distillation component, the steam conveying component, the condensation component and the collection component are cooperatively operated, so that when wine is distilled and heated, the stirring shaft stirs the wine, thereby ensuring the uniformity of wine heating, further increasing the distillation effect on the wine, and through the cooperative operation among the collection components, when the wine is collected, the head wine at the front part is singly collected in one area of a collection barrel, meanwhile, the first rotary motor drives the rotary disc and the collection barrel to rotate, so that a cooling pipe on a sealing cover faces the other area, thereby singly collecting the middle second-stage wine, and after a certain time, the rotary motor drives the rotary disc and the collection barrel to rotate again, thereby collecting the tail wine, further realizing the separate collection of the head wine, the second-stage wine and the tail wine, and greatly increasing the quality of the wine.

title_en: Sterilizing and sorting device for fish fillet processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sterilizing and sorting device for fish fillet processing, and relates to the technical field of fish fillet processing. The fish fillet sorting machine comprises a sterilizing part, a discharging part, a sorting part and a discharging part, wherein the sterilizing part is used for sterilizing fish fillets, the discharging part is arranged on the left side of the sterilizing part, the sterilizing part is used for storing and discharging the fish fillets, and the sorting part is arranged on the right side of the sterilizing part. According to the utility model, the blanking assembly is arranged, in particular, the sliding of the fillets in the blanking hopper is facilitated through the vibration motor, the motor is started to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, the plurality of flexible blades are driven to rotate in the rotating process of the rotating shaft, the sliding fillets are uniformly blanked when the plurality of flexible blades rotate, the subsequent sterilization treatment is facilitated through the uniform blanking of the fillets, the stacking and conveying condition of the fillets is reduced, the sterilization effect of the fillets is greatly improved, the quality of products is improved, and meanwhile, the preservation period of the fillets is also reduced.

title_en: Anti-blocking screen for highland barley beer wort filtration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a highland barley beer wort filtering anti-blocking screen, which relates to the technical field of beer brewing equipment and comprises a rectangular frame plate and a plate body, wherein support bars are arranged in the front-rear direction of the left side and the right side of the rectangular frame plate, the plate body is arranged above the inside of the rectangular frame plate and is fixedly adhered to the rectangular frame plate, a plurality of first filtering holes are formed in the inside of the plate body, a plurality of second filtering holes are formed in one side, close to the first filtering holes, of the inside of the plate body, a plurality of connecting blocks are arranged on the inner side wall of the rectangular frame plate, and first filtering holes and second filtering holes are formed in the plate body, and the inclined angle directions of the first filtering holes and the inclined angle directions of the second filtering holes are different.

title_en: Tea fermentation barrel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea fermentation barrel, which relates to the technical field of tea processing and comprises a heat preservation shell, wherein a fermentation tank is rotationally connected inside the heat preservation shell, two diversion boxes are fixedly embedded in one side of the heat preservation shell, a plurality of first air guide grooves are formed in the outer sides of the two diversion boxes, a second air guide groove is formed in one side of the first air guide grooves, a third air guide groove is formed in one side of the second air guide groove, a supporting component is arranged in the outer side of the heat preservation shell, the two diversion boxes, the first air guide grooves, the second air guide grooves and the third air guide grooves are matched with the rotating fermentation tank, high-speed steam is continuously supplied to the interior of the fermentation tank when the fermentation tank rotationally turns inner tea, the temperature and humidity of tea at different positions inside the fermentation tank are uniform, tea fermentation quality is guaranteed, the tea is heated through the high-speed steam with certain humidity, and the tea is prevented from being stuck and burnt on the inner wall of the fermentation tank.

title_en: A high-pressure sterilization device for concentrated milk production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high-pressure sterilization of concentrated milk, in particular to a high-pressure sterilization device for producing and processing the concentrated milk, which comprises a base, wherein a high-pressure sterilization barrel is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, a guide bar is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the high-pressure sterilization barrel, a sliding rail is arranged on the surface of the base, a gear is rotatably arranged at the output end of a motor, a toothed ring is connected with the side end face of the gear in a meshed manner, a sliding block is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the toothed ring, an upper clamping block is fixedly arranged at the top end of a second protection plate, a clamping groove is arranged on the inner surface of the upper clamping block, a guide groove is arranged on the inner wall of the second protection plate, and a lower clamping block is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of a sealing cover.

title_en: Shell assembly of vertical frozen food manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shell assembly of vertical frozen food manufacturing equipment, which comprises a first half shell and a second half shell which extend along the vertical direction, wherein the side edge of the first half shell is connected with the side edge of the second half shell, the inner side wall of the first half shell is provided with an upward extending vertical plate, the upper end of the vertical plate is connected with a side extension plate which extends out from the side surface of the first half shell and abuts against the upper end of the first half shell, the side extension plate is used for installing a functional assembly, the upper part of the second half shell is provided with a side extension shell which is covered above the side extension plate, and a supporting frame with a double-layer structure is enclosed among the first half shell, the vertical plate and the side extension plate. When the functional component acts on the first half shell through gravity moment and working vibration, the supporting frame can prevent the first half shell and the vertical plate from generating distortion, and the upper end of the first half shell is supported at the position of the side extending plate, so that the gravity moment arm of the functional component is reduced, and the structural strength of the shell component and the working stability of the vertical frozen food manufacturing equipment are improved.

title_en: Portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food science and engineering, and discloses a portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box, which comprises a box body, wherein a slot is formed in the inner side wall of the box body, a box cover is arranged at the top of the box body, rectangular grooves are formed in the surface of the box cover, two cavities are respectively formed in the box cover, a closing component is arranged in each of the two cavities, a connecting pipe is installed on the surface of the box body, a mounting groove is formed in the inner side wall of the connecting pipe, a water outlet pipe is connected to the inner side wall of the mounting groove in a sliding mode, and a clamping groove is formed in the surface of the water outlet pipe. The portable sealed pickled Chinese cabbage fermentation box can be opened and closed by simply poking the L-shaped rotating block, complex operation is not needed, the lever type transmission design is more labor-saving in force application of hands, the operation can be easily performed by old people and children, the opening and closing process is accompanied by damping and buffering, noise generated by collision of parts is avoided, and meanwhile, the sealing performance in locking moment is ensured not to be influenced by impact.

title_en: Visual tweezers for plant pollination
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of visual tweezers for plant pollination, and relates to the field of plant pollination. Including handheld section of thick bamboo, the one end fixedly connected with spliced pole of handheld section of thick bamboo, the inboard fixedly connected with camera of one end of handheld section of thick bamboo is kept away from to the spliced pole, the inboard fixedly connected with light of handheld section of thick bamboo, the case is placed to the surface fixedly connected with electron of handheld section of thick bamboo, the upper surface fixedly connected with display screen of case is placed to the electron. This visual tweezers is through handheld section of thick bamboo, spliced pole, camera, light, power button, electron place case, display screen and control button's cooperation use, gather flower bud image in real time and show on the display screen through the camera, but the operator clear observation pollination position avoids the sight to shelter from the problem, is showing and improves the pollination precision, and the light provides the light filling function, ensures still can acquire clear image when light is not enough, has expanded the service scene and the time range of equipment.

title_en: Black tea floor heating withering trough machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a black tea floor heating withering trough machine which comprises a withering trough, wherein an arc-shaped air guide box is fixedly connected above one end of the withering trough, one end of the arc-shaped air guide box is fixedly connected with a plurality of heating air boxes, a first driving motor is fixedly connected inside the heating air boxes, a fan is fixedly connected with a driving end of the first driving motor, a heating pipe is arranged at the rear end of the first driving motor, a fixed filter screen is fixedly connected with the outer side end part of the heating air boxes, conveying rollers are arranged at two ends of the inner part of the withering trough, and conveying nets are sleeved outside the conveying rollers. Through first driving motor drive, get into the inside and the heating pipe contact of heating bellows with external gas guide to realize the heating effect, the gaseous inside circulation of arc wind groove after the temperature rising, and flow through to the inside in wind channel, gaseous will carry on the net surface black tea stoving operation, can reduce occupation space through installing the groove that withers underground, and make things convenient for toppling over of black tea.

title_en: Grain heat pump drying device with dust removal function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grain heat pump drying device with a dust removing function, which comprises a main body box, wherein a door is arranged on the main body box, the door is connected with the main body box in a rotating way through a hinge, a placing structure is arranged in the main body box, the placing structure comprises a placing plate, a cover plate and a filter screen, the placing structure is provided with a plurality of groups, grains are placed through the placing structure, the placing plate is movably arranged in the main body box, a drying structure is fixedly arranged in the main body box, the drying structure comprises a ventilation hood, a heat pump body and an intermediate pipe, the drying structure is provided with a plurality of groups, the ventilation hood is fixedly arranged in the main body box, and a partition plate is fixedly arranged in the main body box, so that the grains are dried through the drying structure.

title_en: Intelligent temperature-control beer curing tank
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of beer production equipment, in particular to an intelligent temperature control beer ripening tank. The curing tank system mainly comprises a tank body, a set of sectional temperature control jacket integrated on the outer wall of the tank body, a central temperature measuring rod positioned on the central axis of the tank body, a set of peripheral temperature sensors distributed on the inner wall of the tank body and a central controller, wherein the central temperature measuring rod is axially arranged at the center of the tank body, and a plurality of internal temperature sensors are distributed and fixed on the central temperature measuring rod along the height direction and used for monitoring and collecting temperature data of the central area of the tank body along the vertical direction in real time. The aging tank can improve the controllability and stability of the beer aging process by introducing more three-dimensional multipoint temperature measurement and self-adaptive control, can shorten the aging period, reduce the energy consumption and is beneficial to producing high-quality beer with consistent flavor.

title_en: Coffee filter
abstract_en: A filter assembly that includes a receptacle, filter, and filter holder. The receptacle has an inside surface defining an open-ended first through-channel. The filter is positioned inside the first through-channel and configured to produce a filtered liquid by filtering particulates each larger than a predetermined size from a liquid. The filtered liquid exits the filter through an outlet opening of the filter. The filter holder removably couples the filter to the receptacle. A holding area configured to receive the liquid is defined in the first through-channel above the filter holder and between the filter and the inside surface of the receptacle. The filter holder includes an open-ended second through-channel in fluid communication with the outlet opening and configured to receive the filtered liquid from the outlet opening. The second through-channel is configured to be in fluid communication with an interior of a container and to provide the filtered liquid thereto.

title_en: Method for inhibiting separation of oil in processed food
abstract_en: Provided is a method for preventing oil separation in a processed food, the method being capable of emulsifying an oil in the processed food produced by mixing a food raw material containing water and large quantities of an edible oil, and appropriately avoiding oil separation. Emulsified oil-water is mixed into the processed food produced by mixing the edible oil with the food raw material containing water, and the mixture is stirred. Furthermore, as the emulsified oil-water to be mixed into the processed food, a mixture obtainable by mixing electrolyzed alkaline ionized water with a pH of 12 or more and an edible oil, and stirring to emulsify the mixture is used. The mixing ratio of the edible oil to the electrolyzed alkaline ionized water in the emulsified oil-water is 10 : 90 by weight ratio. The proportion, to an oil content in the processed food, of the emulsified oil-water to be mixed into the processed food ranges from 10 to 40 wt%.

title_en: Method for treating the surface of plant parts
abstract_en: A method for masking corking on the surface of polyphenol-containing plant parts is characterized by contacting the surface of the polyphenol-containing plant parts with one or more iron(III) salts, preferably with an aqueous solution that contains one or more iron(II) salts.

title_en: Integrated smart, healthy and safe cooking oven (pressure oven)
abstract_en: This invention relates to smart, integrated, fully automated cooking and pressure oven. The oven works by electricity and comprises a pressure steam box, System of multi-layers works like a puzzle. In addition, it contains touch pad, processing unit operated by software, high temperature, high humidity, cooling systems, hot water, unique hot air and water mixing system. It cooks different foods at the same time in different drawers each drawer works as a cooking cabinet. Controlled systems according to the cooking recipe taking from the oven database, depends on the input cooking data. The invention is a multi- functional cooking oven, which can calculate nutrition and can cook all types of food in a healthy manner taken in consideration medical concerns. The oven is totally safe, secure and clean all the time during cooking processes. The invention also is characterized by ease components installation, supported with internet port and communication devices. The enclosed software can detect and inform the parts failures. It informs maintenance by mobile application for repairing. The oven software automatically manages, adjusts the cooking and safety systems through different sensors and valves. The cooking system is completely protected and automatically monitored all the time.

title_en: Separator and method for operation thereof
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a separator (4, 4', 4'', 4''', 4'''', 4 v , 4 v 
 i , 30, 30'), in particular a separator (4, 4', 4'', 4''', 4'''', 4 v , 4 vi , 30, 30') having a vertical axis of rotation (8), comprising a rotatably mounted drum (5, 31) having a drum interior for centrifugal processing of a liquid (1), the separator, 4', 4'', 4''', 4'''', 4 v , 4 vi , 30, 30') having at least one gas supply line (11, 11', 11'', 11''', 11'''', 11 v , 38, 38') for introducing gas (2, 2') into the liquid (1), which gas supply line opens into the drum interior. The invention also relates to a method for operating the separator (4, 4', 4'', 4''', 4'''', 4 v , 4 vi , 30, 30').

title_en: Method for producing flavor oil having burnt cheese flavor
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a method for producing a flavor oil having a burnt cheese flavor, said flavor oil being capable of imparting a roasted cheese-like fragrant flavor or enhancing a cheese flavor when just used in cooking. The present inventor found that a flavor oil having a fragrant burnt cheese flavor can be obtained by a production method that comprises heating an oil in the presence of 3-20 mass%, relative to the oil, of a starting material derived from cheese. In particular, a stronger and better flavor could be obtained by using a cheese powder and conducting the heating in a reaction system purged with an inert gas.

title_en: An apparatus and methods for measuring, monitoring, and controlling chemical concentrations of active ingredients in plant and plant crop treatment solutions
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and methods for measuring, monitoring, and/or controlling the chemical concentration of one or more active ingredients in a solution for treating plants and plant crops, such as fruits and vegetables.

title_en: Method for reducing the amount of acrylamide during the heat treatment of food with baking raising agent effect
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for the significant reduction, through to the complete prevention, of the in-situ formation of acrylamide during the thermal production process of foods for example during baking, frying or deep-frying. According to the invention, a cost-effective combination of two or more approved food additives are used that suppress the formation of acrylamide and at the same time function efficiently as a baking raising agent. The method can be carried out without the use of costly enzymes or vitamins.

title_en: Control method and system for controlling a machine for the temperature processing of containers of food products; method for retrofitting such machine
abstract_en: A control method is described for controlling a machine (1) for the temperature processing of containers (10) of food products; the machine (1) comprises a temperature-processing zone (2, 3, 4), where the containers (10) are processed by injecting a processing fluid (6) on them; the temperature-processing zone (2, 3, 4) comprises a collection tank (5a, 5b, 5c) for storing processing fluid (6); an injection assembly (7a, 7b, 7c) for injecting processing fluid (6) from tank (5a, 5b, 5c) onto containers (10); and a control unit (11); the method comprises the steps of: i) determining a temperature (t) of the processing fluid (6) by means of a temperature sensor (12) of machine (1) and/or a temperature (t) of containers (10); ii) comparing the temperature (t) determined with a desired temperature range by means of control unit (11); iii) detecting a level (1) of processing fluid (6) inside tank (5a, 5b, 5c) by means of a level sensor (13); iv) comparing level (1) with a desired level range by means of control unit (11); v) controlling by means of control unit (11) a drainage valve (14) to discharge processing fluid (6) from tank (5a, 5b, 5c), if temperature (t) is outside the desired temperature range and level (1) is within desired level range; vi) controlling by means of control unit (11) an inlet valve (8) of machine (1) to allow the injection of fresh processing fluid (9) in tank (5a, 5b, 5c), if temperature (t) is outside desired temperature range and level (1) is outside desired level range. title_en: Promoters for regulation of gene expression in plants
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to promoters that have particular utility in driving root-specific expression of heterologous genes that impart increased agronomic, horticultural and/or pesticidal characteristics to a given transgenic plant. The present invention is also drawn to DNA molecules comprising the promoters of the invention and transformed plant tissues containing DNA molecules comprising a promoter of the invention operably linked to a heterologous gene or genes, and seeds thereof.

title_en: Method for increasing backset recycle in dry grind alcohol production
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dry grind ethanol process in which post-distillation backset is subjected to aerobic fermentation to remove components that are inhibitory to an ethanolagen, such as yeast, allowing the utilization of an increased amount of post-distillation backset during the initial preparation of starch-containing substrates for the dry grind ethanol process. Aerobic fermentation of the post-distillation backset allows substantially higher backset recycle, resulting in fresh water savings and increased sustainability.

title_en: Extensive whey protein hydrolysate with tolerogenic peptides
abstract_en: The invention concerns a process for preparing an ultrafiltered whey protein hydrolysate comprising tolerogenic peptides wherein an emulsifier and/or a chaotropic agent is added before ultrafiltration. The invention further concerns the product obtainable by the process.

title_en: Method to select the smoke treating unit of a roasting apparatus
abstract_en: The invention concerns a method to select the smoke treating unit (3) of a system (1) of a roasting apparatus (2) and an associated smoke treating unit when said system is used in a room (10), said method comprising : - receiving room data input, - receiving roasting use data input in order to determine the quantity of each contaminant produced by the roasting apparatus during a period, - for each system of the roasting apparatus and of one smoke treating units, calculating the concentration of each contaminant present in the room during said period, - for each system and for each contaminant, comparing the calculated concentration of said contaminant present in the room during the period with the concentration of said contaminant authorised according to local health and safety regulations, - selecting the smoke treating unit of the system in the list of smoke treating units providing for each contaminant a calculated concentration inferior to the authorised concentration.

title_en: Tobamovirus-resistant tomato plant, method for producing tobamovirus-resistant tomato plant, method for imparting tobamovirus resistance in tomato plant, method for screening for tobamovirus-resistant tomato plant, and method for detecting tobamovirus resistance in tomato plant
abstract_en: The present invention provides a tomato plant which is resistant to ToBRFV. A Tobamovirus resistant tomato plant of the present invention is with loss of function for a SITOMla gene, a SlTOM1c gene, and a SlTOM1d gene.

title_en: In vitro meat production
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a composition containing animal protein, comprising (a) isolating precursor cells from perinatal tissue of a mammal; (b) incubating the precursor cells under conditions which lead to a myogenic differentiation of the precursor cells; and (c) harvesting the cells. The present invention also relates to a method for producing precursor cells from perinatal tissue, to animal protein produced according to the invention and precursor cells produced according to the invention. The present invention additionally relates to the use of a culture medium which has a reduced content of methionine in comparison to the standard medium for differentiation of precursor cells, and to a method for in vitro production of a meat-like composition.

title_en: Fat composition suitable as a cocoa butter equivalent
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fat composition suitable for use as a cocoa butter equivalent, wherein the fat composition comprises triglycerides of which 60% by weight or more is Sat 2 O, wherein Sat is selected from St, P, or combinations hereof; and wherein, in the fat composition, the content of St 2 O is 40% by weight or less, and the total content of StOP + StPO + St2O is 60% by weight or less, wherein O is oleic acid, St is stearic acid, and P is palmitic acid; and wherein the fat composition has a Bühler crystallization index (BCI) value of 2.5 or more. Uses of the fat composition is also disclosed.

title_en: Galacto-oligosaccharide having a terminal mannose residue, its preparation and application
abstract_en: The present invention provides a new type of galacto-oligosaccharide, having a mannose residue instead of a glucose residue at the reducing end. The invention also relates to compositions comprising this galacto-oligosaccharide, its preparation and use in nutritional compositions.

title_en: Methods for providing a solid hmo product, and solid hmo products obtained thereby
abstract_en: Various methods are provided for providing a solid HMO product, said methods including drum-drying, belt drying, preferably vacuum bed drying, or granulation. Solid HMO products are obtained via said methods, as well as solid HMO products per se. The methods can provide solid HMO products which are different to those achieved via other methods.

title_en: Microbial oils with high levels of omega-3 fatty acids
abstract_en: Provided herein are microbial oils and methods of making and using microbial oils with high levels of omega-3 fatty acids. Specifically, provided is a microbial oil comprising at least 85% total fatty acids, wherein the total fatty acids comprise at least 50% DHA. Also provided is a method of making a biomass comprising culturing an oil-producing microorganism in a culture medium comprising a fatty acid synthesis inhibitor, wherein the biomass comprises at least 500 mg/g oil.

title_en: Corn sweet steeping
abstract_en: Described is a process for releasing soluble starch hydrolysates or hydrolysed starch syrup from substantially intact corn kernels during high temperature steeping at a temperature at or above the gelatinization temperature of starch in the corn kernels, and the recovery of protein and oil-enhanced, carbohydrate-depleted residuals that are ideally suited for use as high quality animal feed or other food-grade products.

title_en: Clubroot resistance
abstract_en: This disclosure describes clubroot (CR) resistant plants; in particular, CR resistant  Brassica  plants, including  B. napus . CR resistant plants include all or part of at least one genomic sequence of a  B. napus  parent genome that confers clubroot resistance. The genomic sequence may be a genomic sequence from chromosome N03, chromosome N04, and/or chromosome N08.

title_en: A method for improving the nutritional value of animal feed
abstract_en: Offering broiler chickens a low protein diet supplemented with an array of synthetic amino acids is not fully effective in promoting maximal growth and both bodyweight and feed conversion ratio (FCR). However the present invention shows, growth rate and FCR can be promoted by the addition of available Phosphorus to the low protein diet and that this strategy is effective in restoring performance losses associated with the diet with low protein concentration. Therefore, the present invention relates to a method for improving the nutritional value of animal feed comprising a marginal protein content. More specifically, the invention relates to a method for improving weight gain and feed conversion ratio, which method comprises feeding the animal with a low protein diet and an extra supplementation of phosphorous.

title_en: A food glaze coating composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a food glaze coating composition. The invention also relates to methods of manufacturing food glaze coating compositions, methods of glazing food products, and glazed food products. The present invention provides a food glaze coating composition that is egg-free, non-dairy, and non-protein (non-allergenic) and ready-to-use for food products such as baking products and having desirable functionalities.

title_en: Animal feed supplement and methods of making
abstract_en: A solid animal feed composition generally includes a liquid nutrient component in an amount of 1% to 40% by weight and a fatty acid component in an amount of 60% to 99% by weight. The solid animal feed composition has a melting point of at least 70°F. The animal feed composition can be fed to lactating dairy cows to increase milk production, increase the fat content of milk produced by the cow, and/or increase the protein content of milk produced by the cow.

title_en: Oat-based biscuits with slowly available glucose
abstract_en: The invention relates to biscuits with a slowly-digestible-starch-over-total-availablestarch ratio of the biscuit of at least 40%, the biscuit comprising oat-based starchy ingredients and non-oat starchy ingredients, wherein the total amount of starchy ingredients comprises at least 55 wt% of the total weight of the biscuit, wherein the biscuit comprises at least 15 wt% oat-based starchy ingredients, and wherein the ratio (w/w) of oat-based starchy ingredients over non-oat starchy ingredients is between 1/4 and 4/1.

title_en: Tomato plants with improved disease resistance
abstract_en: Tomato plants exhibiting resistance to tomato chlorosis virus and  Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici  race 2 are provided, together with methods of producing, identifying, or selecting plants or germplasm with a tomato chlorosis virus and  Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici  race 2 resistance phenotype and lacking an undesirable cold sensitivity trait. Such plants include tomato plants comprising recombinant genomic regions conferring disease resistance. Compositions, including novel polymorphic markers for detecting plants comprising introgressed disease resistance alleles, are further provided.

title_en: Use of a ruminant feed supplement composition as a non-protein nitrogen source to improve rumen fermentation, the productivity and performance of the ruminant animals and the enteric methane emission
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the use of a ruminant feed supplement composition comprising urea, biuret and N-containing by-products of the biuret production out of urea, as a NPN-source to reduce methane emission produced by ruminant animals, as well as to improve the dry matter intake (DMI) of ruminant animals. The present disclosure further relates to the use of a ruminant feed supplement composition comprising urea, biuret, N-containing by-products of the biuret production out of urea and one or more nitrate compounds as a NPN-source to improve nitrogen nutrition and to reduce methane emission of ruminant animals, also the use to improve the average daily gain (ADG) of ruminant animals and the use to improve the feed efficiency of ruminant animals.

title_en: Plants with stem rust resistance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a genetically modified plant which has enhanced resistance to one or more fungal pathogen(s).

title_en: Milk powder composition
abstract_en: It is disclosed a lactose free milk powder composition com-prising a citrate preparation, a method for its production, and a method for producing a lactose free low sugar acidified milk product using the lactose free milk powder composition.

title_en: Nucleotide sequences mutated by insertion that encode a truncated oleate desaturase protein, proteins, methods and uses
abstract_en: Isolated nucleotide sequences mutated by insertion encoding a truncated sunflower oleate desaturase protein, truncated protein, methods, procedures and uses. The isolated nucleotide sequences comprise an insertion that includes a stop codon, and wherein the sequences encode a truncated sunflower oleate desaturase protein. The truncated sunflower oleate desaturase protein may be for example the sequence shown in SEQ ID No:1 or SEQ ID No:2.

title_en: Method of making low-sugar caramels
abstract_en: A caramel includes water, glycerol, fat, and about 10% by weight or greater of at least one protein source including at least one protein. A method of forming a caramel includes combining water, glycerol, fat, and about 10% by weight or greater of at least one protein source including at least one protein to form a caramel composition. The method also includes hydrating the protein at a hydrating temperature less than a denaturation temperature of the protein to achieve the caramel having a predetermined water activity without denaturing the protein. The caramel includes about 25% by weight or greater of the protein source, and the protein is not in a denatured state in the caramel. A comestible product includes a protein core layer and a layer of a slab-able caramel adhering to the protein core layer.

title_en: Yarrowia lipolytica and its use for producing lipases specifically liberating short chain fatty acids
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Yarrowia strain, preferably a non-genetically modified Yarrowia strain, for the production of a wild-type, non-engineered, microbial lipolytic enzyme with a high specificity for short-chain fatty acids, preferably with a higher specificity for short chain fatty acids than for medium to long chain fatty acids, preferably when compared to a known microbial lipolytic enzyme. This invention is suitable for use in the food industry, preferably in the dairy industry, more preferably in the cheese industry leading, for example, to flavor enhancement or shortening of the ripening times for ripened cheeses.

title_en: Foodstuffs and methods for making the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to foodstuffs comprising structured fats and/or fat-like compositions and methods for making the same. In particular, the foodstuff may be a sausage, baked good, dairy product, confectionery product or food emulsion with improved properties, such as health benefits and/or improved thermal and/or textural properties and/or an improved oral sensory experience.

title_en: Nanoemulsion endowed with antiseptic effect
abstract_en: Provided is a nanoemulsion which has stability and to which preservative efficacy is imparted, in a bacterial contamination environment. This object is attained by a nanoemulsion which has an average particle diameter of 30 nm or less, has a particle size distribution index of 0.14 or less, does not contain particles of 100 nm or more, and contains, as a preservative, at least one selected from an organic acid (salt) and a biguanide-based compound.

title_en: Texturized vegetable protein
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dry extrusion process for preparing a texturized vegetable protein comprising extruding a mixture of rapeseed protein, a legume derived protein and calcium carbonate, to a composition comprising rapeseed protein, a legume-derived protein, calcium and a plant-based fiber, to the use of said composition in the preparation of a meat alternative and to meat alternatives. It also relates to the use of calcium carbonate for improving the hydration rate, water holding capacity and/or density of a texturized vegetable protein comprising rapeseed protein.

title_en: Irregular and random shaped extruded protein puff cereal
abstract_en: Puffed cereal pieces which are random and irregular in size and shape relative to each other are produced by forming a protein-based cereal dough, having a density of about 100-150 g/100 in 3  and including about 30-60% plant protein by weight, in an extruder, extruding the cereal dough from a plurality of spaced, commonly shaped geometric openings of a die, directly expanding the cereal dough, cutting the cereal dough into extrudate pieces, and drying the extrudate pieces. The plant protein is derived from seeds, legumes or grains, with a particular embodiment employing a combination of soy protein isolate and one or more types of grains.

title_en: Method for making natural cheese with specific texture attributes
abstract_en: The invention provides natural cheese and a method for making natural cheese with specific texture attributes.

title_en: Improved enzymatic modification of phospholipids in food
abstract_en: A phospholipase A1 characterized by having an sn1/sn2 specificity ratio of about 55/45 or greater wherein said phospholipase A1 has a lysophospholipase/phospholipase activity ratio of less than 0.01 is presented in conjunction with methods for use in lipid containing food matrix, baking and making dough with the phospholipase and also including baking improvers using the disclosed phospholipase A1.

title_en: Nutritional composition
abstract_en: A nutritional composition comprising sn-2 palmitic acid and lactoferrin for use in improving the gut microbiota in a human subject.

title_en: Tomato plants resistant to resistance-breaking tswv strains and corresponding resistance genes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Sw-5b protein, which is a variant of the wild type protein, conferring recognition of the NSm protein of the Tomato Spotted Wilt virus (TSWV), especially to resistance-breaking TSWV, and wherein said variant comprises a variation at one or more of the following positions: 23, 26, 28, 29, 30, 75, 82, 83, 90, 134, 135, 136, 138, 139, 140, 143, 147, 148, 151, 203, 209, 214, 325, 351, 448, 522, 622 and 759 with respect to the sw-5b protein. The present invention also relates to genetic sequences encoding such a variant protein, preferably to a mutated sw-5b gene, and to plants, especially Solanum lycopersicum plants comprising in their genome said mutated gene conferring resistance to RB-TSWV. The invention is also directed to parts of these plants, as well as progeny, and to the use of these sequences for providing TSWV resistance.

title_en: Concentrated liquid tannic acid solution for use in beer, usage process, and use
abstract_en: The present invention refers to a solution of liquid, concentrated and stable tannic acid for application in a brewing process for colloidal stabilization, as well as to the description of the process comprising the application of the liquid tannic acid solution in order to obtain the desired performance and technological and sensory advantages.

title_en: Protein structuring module, arrangement and method for providing a structured protein substance for manufacturing of a food product
abstract_en: The present document relates to a protein structuring module for a providing arrangement for manufacturing of a food product, using a protein constituent. The module establishes a shear stress for aligning molecules of the protein constituent, by including a first and a second solid part. The first solid parts are detachably connected to each other along their contact surfaces, and at least one of said contact surfaces includes a groove running across the surface. Together, as connected, the groove in the contact surfaces of the connected first and second solid parts define a shear channel of the cell having a first open end and a second open end. The open ends define an inlet and an outlet for conveying the structured protein substance.

title_en: Rapid fermentation process for making alcoholic beverages
abstract_en: Presently disclosed is a rapid method of producing alcohol-containing beverages, including beer, kombucha, hard seltzers, wines, ciders, hard teas, sake and distilled products. The method includes cooling the mixture after boiling and allowing yeast or other microorganisms to ferment the mixture at a warm temperature, for a short period of time. Staged oxygenation occurs during the fermentation process. An alcohol-containing beverage is produced in 1-2 days or less, saving costs by allowing delivery of a product to the consumer quickly, also reducing storage time and costs associated with extended fermentation such as utilities, water, labor and chemicals. The beverage may be enhanced by the addition of hops or hop flavor-active materials, spices, herbs, specialty malts, psychoactive materials, physiologically active materials, natural or artificial flavors, caffeine, vitamins and supplements, mineral supplements, proteins, herbs, spices, terpenes, cannabinoids, synthetic cannabinoids, mushrooms, psilocybin containing mushrooms, peyote, ayahuasca, mescaline or combinations thereof.

title_en: Plant-based frozen confection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a plant-based frozen confection comprising: fat in an amount of 1 to 15 wt%; sugars in an amount of 10 to 30 wt%; solids from oat material in an amount of 0.5 to 12 wt%; and plant protein in an amount of 0.4 to 10 wt%, wherein the solids from oat material comprise one or more of: oat protein (P3), fat, carbohydrate, and/or fibre; and wherein the plant protein comprises pea protein (P1) and fava bean protein (P2) in a weight ratio (P1: P2) of 2:1 to 1:2.

title_en: Mental wellbeing compositions
abstract_en: Compositions for improving mental wellbeing and associated uses.

title_en: Wheat ms1 polynucleotides, polypeptides, and methods of use
abstract_en: Compositions and methods are capable of modulating male fertility in a plant. Compositions comprise polynucleotides and polypeptides, and fragments and variants thereof, which modulate male fertility. Expression cassettes comprise a male-fertility polynucleotide, or fragment or variant thereof, operably linked to a promoter, wherein expression of the polynucleotide modulates the male fertility of a plant. The level and/or activity of a polynucleotide that influences male fertility is modulated in a plant or plant part. Regulatory sequences drive expression in a male-tissue-preferred manner an may be targets to downregulate an operably linked gene. Methods to track mutations that induce nuclear recessive male sterility in subsequent selfing and crossing of wheat lines containing the mutations are also provided. Male-sterile plants may be maintained by pollinating with maintainer plant.

title_en: Natural chewing gum with nicotine and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention pertains to a natural chewing gum with nicotine (20) comprising a natural gum base (30) and active substance nicotine (34, 36, 38). The natural gum base (30) includes components or ingredients such as a gum base made of chicle with gum arabic or acacia, heat mixed with nicotine (34, 36, 38) in specific quantities. The chewing gum (20) is designed to administer nicotine during buccal use (70) up to 30 minutes while quickly releasing nicotine substance the first 5 minutes. The gum base (30) is covered with a glazing layer (40) with flavors (42) such as mint, strawberry, and taste enhancers with natural ingredients (44) such as xylitol, stevia, glycerin; beet powder, or spirulina, or a combination. A method for manufacturing the natural chewing gum (20) is disclosed, involving manufacturing of the gum base (100), addition of nicotine (200), manufacturing of the glazing mix (300), a glazing process (400), before packaging (500).

title_en: Method for the production of lactones
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods for preparing lactones, in particular massoia lactone and saturated delta-lactones. The method includes producing fatty acid esters comprising 3,5-dihydroxydecanoate, by culturing a fungal species under conditions suitable for the production of said fatty acid esters, wherein the fungal species has more than one copy of the liamocin biosynthesis and secretion pathway. The fatty acid esters comprising 3,5-dihydroxydecanoate are converted to massoia lactone, and then optionally to saturated delta-lactones. The conversion to saturated delta-lactones uses oxidoreductases. The invention also relates to the use of such lactones in flavored products and in perfumed consumer products.

title_en: Novel compound comprising n-methylpiperazine ethanol carbamate structure and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel compound comprising an N-methylpiperazine ethanol carbamate structure and use thereof.

title_en: Nutritional composition and method for promoting sleep and/or for treating and/or preventing sleep disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a combination of galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS) and a mix of human oligosaccharides (HMOs), or nutritional compositions comprising the combination, for use in promoting sleep and/or treating and/or preventing sleep disorders in a subject, wherein the mix consists of 2'-fucosyllactose (2'FL) and difucosyllactose (DFL) or lacto-N-tetraose (LNT) and 6'-sialyllactose (6'SL). The present invention also relates to the use of a combination of galacto- oligosaccharides (GOS) and a mix of human oligosaccharides (HMOs), or nutritional compositions comprising the combination, for use in promoting sleep and/or treating and/or preventing sleep disorders in a subject, wherein the mix consists of 2'- fucosyllactose (2'FL) and difucosyllactose (DFL) or lacto-N-tetraose (LNT) and 6'- sialyllactose (6'SL). Furthermore, the present invention relates to a method for in promoting sleep and/or in treating and/or preventing sleep disorders in a subject, the method comprising administering to the subject a combination or a nutritional composition according to the invention.

title_en: Composition for preventing, ameliorating, or treating disease caused by protein nitration comprising peptide with terminal tyrosine as effective component
abstract_en: According to the present invention, the peptide with terminal tyrosine has an excellent effect on inhibiting protein nitration and also an excellent effect on preventing, ameliorating, or treating disease symptoms in chronic immobilization stress-induced depression/cognitive impairment model, Alzheimer's disease model, epileptic seizure model, stroke model, type 2 diabetes model, acute renal failure model, or hyperammonemia model.

title_en: Lactobacillus paracasei strain and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention pertains to: a novel human-derived probiotic strain that is  Lactobacillus paracasei  KBL382,  Lactobacillus paracasei  KBL384, or  Lactobacillus paracasei  KBL385; and a use of the strain for improving intestinal health and treating or preventing intestinal diseases. The strain according to the present invention has excellent anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory functions, has a superb strengthening effect on tight junctions of the intestinal tract wall, suppresses enteritis-induced weight loss and colon length reduction, thereby exhibiting a therapeutic effect for enteritis, and significantly alleviates the symptoms of atopic dermatitis. Therefore, the strain can be useful as a probiotic material for enhancing anti-inflammatory effects, strengthening immunity, improving intestinal health functions, and alleviating allergic diseases

title_en: Sustainable biomass production
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for cultivating a microorganism, preferably a  Saccharomycetales  yeast, capable of utilizing low-grade ethanol as feedstock. The invention is directed to a method for the production of biomass, in particular single cell protein, wherein the yeast single cell protein product comprises  Saccharomycetales  yeast cells, as well as to an animal feed comprising such biomass.

title_en: A method for production of clear red grape juice
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing red grape juice comprising rubisco enzyme (11); In a first step (10) rubisco enzyme (11) and bentonite as a clay (12) are added to red grape juice in a production tank (14), tannins (18) causing turbidity and sediment in red grape juice are precipitated by rubisco enzyme (20), proteins (22) causing turbidity and sediment in red grape juice are precipitated by bentonite (24), relates to a clear red grape juice production method comprising the steps of removing the precipitate (24) formed in the first stage (10) from the red grape juice (26) by filtration (28), removing the red grape juice without moving the precipitate at the bottom of the tank (30) and performing a standard juice filtration process (32) in a second stage (26) following the first stage operations.

title_en: Treatment and composition for reversing the biological age of skin
abstract_en: Novel methods and compositions for treating aged and environmentally damaged skin are disclosed which measurably reverse the biological, epigenetic age of the skin, resulting in improvements in the skin's visual appearance, function, and biophysical properties The disclosed treatment methods involve topical application of a novel cosmetic composition containing the combination of a cell-membrane stabilizing agent, a metabolic enhancing agent, amino acids, minerals, and nutrients. To some extent, the formulation goes further to achieve restorative results for certain types of skin damage beyond the typical concerns of wrinkles, looseness, age spots, and sun damage.

title_en: Improved process for producing vegetable protein concentrates
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for producing plant-based protein concentrates from desolventized meal resulting from hexane extraction of oleaginous vegetable material and, preferably, from a high-quality desolventized and defatted meal known as "white-flakes". In particular, the invention relates to a substantial improvement allowing the valorisation of the fines and dust contained in white-flakes by their agglomeration in specific extractable and undegraded agglomerates of food-grades quality. This improvement allows a substantial yield increase of the extraction process without jeopardising the quality of the final plant-based protein concentrate.

title_en: Feed ingredient composition, use thereof and feed comprising the same
abstract_en: Esillä oleva keksintö koskee eläinten rehun ainesosakoostumusta, joka käsittää R-(-)-karvonia tai S-(+)-karvonia, tai näiden yhdistelmää, ja ainakin yhtä pinta-aktiivista ainetta. Esillä oleva keksintö koskee lisäksi rehua, joka käsittää mainittua eläinten rehun ainesosakoostumusta.

title_en: A composition for making a drink, a method for producing a composition, an apparatus for producing a composition and use of an antacid ingredient
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for making a drink. The composition comprises a coffee bean ingredient and an antacid ingredient. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a composition. The present invention further relates to an apparatus for producing a composition. The present invention further relates to use of an antacid ingredient.

title_en: Demoulding apparatus and method
abstract_en: A demoulding apparatus and dislodging apparatus for demoulding a soft elastic product 310 from a cavity 312 by deforming the moulded products to break any adhesion to the cavities. The dislodging apparatus comprises a prodder 320, which may be a non-contact air prodder or a contact prodder and may deform many products. The prodder may be a blunt linear or a rotary prodder. The prodder may function vertically or at an angle of 60º from the vertical 330. There may be a freeboard area between arrows 317, 319, of about 1.0mm. Preferably, the moulded product is a jelly-type medicinal/food product. Additionally, the demoulding apparatus may comprise a conveyor, an ejection device, and a lubrication device. Preferably, the ejection device is a pneumatic gas knife or a vacuum device. The method of forming a moulded product comprises: providing a mould 300; inserting a liquid into a mould cavity to set; prodding the moulded product to deform it; and ejecting it from the mould. Preferably, the mould is coated in a lubricating fluid 318. Preferably, the product is formed on a continuous or semi-continuous production line.

title_en: Nanoemulsion, plant-based meat and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A nanoemulsion for preparing plant-based meat. The nanoemulsion has a particle size ranging from 300-320 nm and may be prepared by high-pressure homogenisation using oil in water in a certain proportion. The oil and the water volume percentage may range from 30-70%. The oil may be a long-chain triglyceride such as sunflower oil, canola oil, corn oil, soyabean oil, macadamia oil, olive oil and/or safflower oil. The plant-based meat may be prepared by mixing the nanoemulsion with dry particles, which may include: plant-based protein (e.g. soybeans, peas, mung beans or broad beans) with a particle size 90-230µm; non-starch polysaccharide (e.g. inulin, cellulose, pectin or glucan); and hydrocolloids (e.g. xanthan gum, carrageenan, guar gum, locust bean gum or konjac) with a particle size 2-150µm. The plant-based meat prepared using the nanoemulsion is also claimed and it may retain flavours after various cooking methods. The plant-based meat may withstand different pH values and temperatures, and remains stable at different concentrations of salt, sugar, lipids, protein, carbohydrates, and a variety of organic compounds. The plant-based meat retains more flavours, so less flavouring is needed, and the cost will be reduced.

title_en: Quantitative trait locus (QTL) associated with an autoflowering trait in cannabis
abstract_en: A method for identifying an autoflowering or light insensitive Cannabis sativa plant comprising in its genome an autoflower quantitative trait loci (QTL), the method comprising the steps of: (i) providing a population of cannabis plants; (ii) genotyping at least one plant from the population with respect to the autoflower QTL by detecting one or more polymorphisms associated with autoflowering as defined in Table 2 or Table 4; and (iii) identifying one or more plants containing the autoflower QTL. Further disclosed are methods of producing said plant using marker assisted selection. Cannabis sativa plants and extracts of said plants comprising the autoflowering QTL are disclosed. Further disclosed is an quantitative trait locus that controls an autoflowering trait, wherein the quantitative trait locus has a sequence that corresponds to nucleotides 22256688 to 24945282 of NC_04437.1 and contains one or more polymorphisms associated with autoflowering as defined in Table 2 or Table 4.

title_en: Elastase inhibitor
abstract_en: To provide an elastase inhibitor.SOLUTION: An elastase inhibitor contains extract from Acacia bark.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Oral composition
abstract_en: To provide a composition that is excellent in the palatability and the bodily sensation of improved fatigue, and has excellent endurance improving effect and anti-fatigue effect.SOLUTION: An oral composition contains β-alanine and protein with the β-alanine content of 3 mass% or more in the composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Reduction method of rubber-like resilient feeling by starch in starch-containing meat processed food
abstract_en: To provide a reduction method of rubber-like resilient feeling caused by starch, even in the case of meat processed food formed by blending starch as much as 3-15 mass% into a dough of the meat processed food.SOLUTION: Concerning starch-containing meat processed food using a starch-containing meat processed food dough containing meat, starch, and soybean flour in which NSI is 70-95%, in a reduction method of rubber-like resilient feeling caused by starch in the starch-containing meat processed food, assuming that the content of starch is 5-15 mass%, a blending amount of soybean flour is adjusted to be 0.3-2 mass%. abstract_en: The present invention relates to a spray type whipped cream dispenser comprising: a container (10) containing whipped cream; a head (20) positioned above the container and including a discharge portion (26); a cover part (30) covering the head (20); and a grip bar (50) for pressing the cover part (30), wherein the cover part (30) includes a grip bar fixing part (36) to which the grip bar (50) is rotatably installed.

title_en: A laver connecting apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laver connecting device that enables the operation of seating the front end of a second sheet of laver supplied later on the upper surface of the rear end of a first sheet of laver supplied in advance and the operation of pressing and bonding the two sheets of laver using a single driving source, and can reduce the occurrence of a discontinuous bonded portion by allowing the center of the rear end of the second sheet of laver to be firstly seated on the first sheet of laver.

title_en: Healthy well-being stacked laver snacks containing blackfish with very high customer satisfaction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a stacked laver snack which is health well-being product with very high consumer satisfaction capable of reducing a risk of acidification and extending an expiration date because of being not fried in oil, strengthening nutrients which are lacking in laver, and providing an excellent taste without a fishy taste without using oil. After mixing salt and a second fermentation product, which is manufactured by fermenting mushroom powder and mixing a porous ceramic carrier containing fermentation strains in a first fermentation product, at a weight ratio of 0.1: 10 to 1: 1, a ramie water bottle dried in a mixing product places laver at the bottom, evenly sprinkles dried whitebaits, places laver thereon, bakes the same by using a heat press, and cuts the same into a bite size by using the salt which is manufactured by spraying and drying a concentrated liquid after extracting a solvent as water at 90-100℃ for 2-4 hours in a mixture which mixes chard and sedum kamtschaticumat the same weight ratio.

title_en: whole walnut manufacturing device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing apparatus and a manufacturing method for walnut skin removal for whole walnut preparation. According to the automatic whole walnut manufacturing apparatus and the automatic whole walnut manufacturing method of the present invention, walnuts are automatically supplied by a hopper accommodating the walnuts, and the supplied walnuts are moved toward a wire saw rotated in an endless orbit by a wire saw device motor in a state where a single walnut is gripped by a gripper including three or four jaws. Walnut skin cutting is performed as a result. After the skin cutting, the gripper is moved to a discharge position and the walnut is discharged with the inter-gripper distance increased. As a result, the walnut in the walnut skin can be taken out in a whole flesh form, that is, as a whole walnut.

title_en: Manufacturing methods of natural seasoning comprising anti-browning coated mushroom and stockfish
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of natural seasoning containing mushrooms and dried fish coated for anti-browning. More specifically, the manufacturing method can protect a surface of powder from air and moisture by pulverizing the mushrooms and the dried fish and coating the same with a coating solution for an anti-browning effect, thereby preventing browning and extending a storage period of the natural seasoning. In addition, according to the present invention, the taste and flavor of the mushrooms can be improved by repeatedly roasting the mushrooms several times after pulverizing the same, and a fishy smell and odor of the dried fish can be removed while maintaining the peculiar taste of the dried fish by rapidly cooling the dried fish after roasting.

title_en: Apparatus for extracting concentrate from food materials
abstract_en: Disclosed by the present invention is a food concentrating apparatus. Specifically, the food concentrating apparatus is characterized by comprising: a concentrator horizontally disposed and configured to heat and stir food ingredients contained therein to extract a concentrate; a condenser which condenses vapor evaporated in the concentrator; a condensate tank in which condensate condensed in the condenser is stored; a chiller which cools refrigerant and supplies and circulates the refrigerant in the condenser; and a vacuum pump which forms a negative pressure in the condensate tank and the condenser. The condenser comprises: a condensation housing of which both ends are sealed with a first cover and a second cover, respectively, a refrigerant inlet is formed in the outer circumferential surface thereof to allow the refrigerant to be introduced, and a refrigerant outlet is formed at the center of the second cover to allow the refrigerant to be discharged; a steam inflow pipe penetrating an edge of the second cover and inserted along the longitudinal direction of the condensation housing; a plurality of spiral tubes each of which has one end communicating with the steam inflow pipe, is bent inward to be formed in a spiral shape, and is formed along the steam inflow pipe; a condensate discharge pipe penetrating the refrigerant outlet and the condensation housing and communicating with the other ends of the spiral tubes to discharge condensate; and a curved plate-shaped baffle bent in a spiral shape so as to be inserted into the spiral tubes along a spiral channel. According to the present invention, the condensate can be quickly generated and thus, the evaporation in the concentrator can be further promoted.

title_en: New ceramide, method for preparing the new ceramide and its use
abstract_en: In the present specification, disclosed are a novel ceramide, and specifically, 1-O-acylceramide having a fatty acid chain in both directions on a Phytosphingosine backbone, an isomer thereof, a salt thereof, a solvate thereof or a hydrate thereof, uses for skin barrier function enhancement thereof, and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Manufacturing method of cheonggukjang stew and cheonggukjang stew manufactured by this manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Cheonggukjang stew and a preparation method thereof which comprises: a stock preparation step of adding 31-33 parts by weight of white radish to 100 parts by weight of purified water to prepare stock; a solid ingredient preparation step of stir-frying 17-19 parts by weight of beef, 11-13 parts by weight of onion, and 10-12 parts by weight of green onion to prepare solid ingredients; a soup preparation step of adding 27-29 parts by weight of Cheonggukjang and the solid ingredients to the stock to boil the mixture and then prepare soup; a functional mixture addition step of adding a functional mixture consisting of grains to the soup; a bean curd addition step of adding 52-54 parts by weight of bean curd to the soup to boil the mixture; and a seasoning addition step of adding 0.5-0.7 part by weight of red pepper powder to the soup after the bean curd addition step to boil the mixture. Accordingly, provided is the Cheonggukjang stew which can have effects of weight loss, control of blood glucose, anti-cancer, and anti-oxidation while keeping the unique taste thereof.

title_en: Method for producing granola with enhance protein contents
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing granola with an increased protein content and, more particularly, to a method for producing granola with excellent protein content, texture and flavor through the development of a grain process.

title_en: Method for producing rice cake for DDUGBOGGI with enhanced texture
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: a method for producing rice cake for Suhyangmi tteokbokki (stir-fried rice cake), which is produced by using various functional materials such as rice flour obtained by pretreating Suhyangmi (rice variety), a well-known local product of Hwaseong, Gyeonggi-do, and a Dendropanax morbiferus extract; and Suhyangmi rice cake for tteokbokki prepared by the method. An objective of the present invention is to provide a method for producing rice cake for tteokbokki with excellent texture and preference.

title_en: Meat aging method and the apparatus
abstract_en: A meat aging method according to the present invention comprises: a step (S100) of vacuum packaging a meat in a vacuum packaging pack; and a step (S200) of immersing the vacuum-packed meat in cold water maintained at a temperature of 0 to 5℃ for 1 to 20 days, wherein if aging a meat such as Korean beef sirloin, the aged meat can be stored for a long period of time and the aged taste of the meat does not deteriorate, and the meat can be aged to a desired degree by controlling aging of the meat according to a weight, shape, and tissue composition of various meats. When Korean beef sirloin is grilled and consumed using the Korean beef sirloin grilling method according to the present invention, the Korean beef sirloin becomes very soft and the savory taste and flavor of the Korean beef sirloin are greatly improved, and especially, kkakdugi fried rice according to the present invention has excellent savory taste and delicious taste.

title_en: An anti-obesity composition comprising Lactobacillus plantarum HAC03 and Garcinia cambogia extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition and a health functional food composition for the prevention or treatment of obesity, containing a Lactobacillus plantarum HAC03 strain and a Garcinia cambogia extract as active components. The combination of the Lactobacillus plantarum HAC03 strain and the Garcinia cambogia extract of the present invention has an effect of reducing body weight and adipose tissue weight, reducing adipocyte size, and inhibiting fat synthesis, and can be utilized as a therapeutic agent for obesity diseases, a health functional food, etc.

title_en: Functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta. A functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta according to an embodiment of the technical idea of the present invention contains hydrolyzed and fermented horse placenta as an active ingredient, wherein 1-10 wt% of the hydrolyzed and fermented horse placenta is contained based on the total content of the function food. By such configuration, a functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta according to various embodiments of the technical idea of the present invention causes no side effect and is effective in preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms by hydrolyzing the horse placenta to produce a hydrolyzed and fermented product and using the same in a food.

title_en: Novel compounds inhibiting stem cell senescence and pharmaceutical use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new ccompound for inhibiting stem cell aging or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and uses thereof, which can restore the function of stem cells by strengthening stem cell function through oxidative stress control and mitochondrial resynthesis, and therethrough, can generate an anti-aging effect.

title_en: Manufacturing method of black goat oriental medicine fermented composition for immunity improvement and energy enchancement
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a herbal composition for immunity improvement and energy enhancement, and more specifically, comprises: a black goat fat meat processing step of deboning black goat and selecting black goat fat meat; a fat meat cutting step of cutting the black goat fat meat processed through the black goat fat meat processing step; a protein degradation step of immersing the black goat fat meat cut through the fat meat cutting step in a protein degrader and making the black goat fat meat react with the same; a black goat juice extraction step of extracting black goat juice by heating the mixture in which the protein has been decomposed through the protein degradation step; a herbal medicine mixing step of mixing herbal medicine with the black goat juice extracted through the black goat juice extraction step and heating the mixture; a filtration step of filtering the mixture prepared through the herbal medicine mixing step; and a heat sterilization step of heating and sterilizing the mixture filtered through the filtration step. The herbal composition prepared through the above process contains a high content of low-molecular-weight protein that is easily absorbed into the body, has the unpleasant smell of black goat fat meat removed, and contains herbal medicine, thereby showing excellent preference as well as exhibiting immunity improvement and energy enhancement of eaters.

title_en: Novel use of a nona-peptide
abstract_en: The present invention provides novel uses of peptides comprising amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 1 or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. The present invention has the advantage of effectively treating, preventing, alleviating and/or inhibiting at least one selected from obesity or obesity complications.

title_en: Levilactobacillus brevis strain, and vesicles from thereof and anti-inflammation and anti-bacteria uses of thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel microorganisms, isolates thereof, cultures thereof, extracts thereof, endoplasmic reticulum and anti-inflammatory and/or antimicrobial uses thereof. According to one aspect, novel strains thereof and endoplasmic reticulum derived therefrom, which can be useful in the prevention, alleviation, or treatment of inflammation-related conditions, or bacterial infections.

title_en: How to make a boxed meal of Osambulgogi and a boxed meal produced accordingly
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for manufacturing an osam bulgogi box lunch, which removes the peculiar fishy smell and odor from main ingredients, squid and pork belly, by preprocessing, and provides the unique useful functionality of the raw materials to be mixed, while at the same time providing a higher savory taste and deeper taste, thereby improving the preference. The osam bulgogi box lunch manufacturing method includes an osam bulgogi preparation step (S10); a rice preparation step (S20); a soup preparation step (S30); a side dish preparation step (S40); a weighing step (S50); and a metal detection and packaging step (S60).

title_en: Sugar-free and unsweetened traditional Sikhye manufacturing method and traditional sikhye produced thereby
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a sugar-free and unsweetened traditional sikhye using local specialties in order to continue the tradition of our excellent traditional beverages, wherein a sikhye, which is sold on the market these days, is a "fake" sikhye that tastes sweet with sugar and artificial sweeteners, away from the method for producing a traditional sikhye. More specifically, the present invention has completed the development of a method for producing a healthy traditional sikhye having a sugar content of 12 brix or more by adding pulp grains of peaches or raspberries, which are local special products, without sugar and sugar additives when producing the sikhye. Therefore, the sugar-free and unsweetened sikhye can popularize a traditional sikhye in line with the recent "zero-sugar" trend, which has been created with the importance of "health," and the modern reinterpreted sikhye was developed by using pulp grains of local specialties to relieve some consumers' rejection of rice grains.

title_en: A packaging system that can check the deterioration of soymilk
abstract_en: Provided is a packaging system capable of checking whether soymilk is spoiled, comprising: an inspection information receiving unit for receiving image information generated by photographing the surface of soymilk stored in a soymilk tank from a quality inspection device and temperature information generated by measuring the temperature of the soymilk stored in the soymilk tank; a particle information generating unit for generating particle information based on scattered light received by an array optical sensor when the array optical sensor receives the scattered light; a spoilage determination unit for determining whether the soymilk stored in the soymilk tank is spoiled by comparing each of the received image information, temperature information, and particle information with pre-stored sample information; and a management unit for packaging the soymilk into a soymilk product or maintaining and managing the temperature of a temperature control device installed in the work area and a plurality of facilities located in the work area. According to the present invention, it is possible to quickly and accurately determine whether the soymilk is spoiled or not through the packaging system capable of checking whether the soymilk is spoiled or not, thereby providing a consumer with the soymilk of a predetermined quality or higher.

title_en: Vinegar granule using fermented subicho vinegar and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vinegar granule using Subicho containing Subicho vinegar powder, collagen, probiotics, and additives, and a use thereof and, more specifically, to a vinegar granule using Subicho and a health functional food including the same capable of spray-drying Subicho vinegar, which is obtained by inoculating and fermenting an acetic acid bacterium in a fermentation medium manufactured by adding sugar to a suspension of vinegar powder, to form powder; manufacturing the granule by adding a constant amount of a diluting agent; and being manufactured by additionally adding, mixing, and coating the collagen, and the probiotics before drying the vinegar granule using Subicho. Therefore, the present invention has excellent sensory properties, antioxidant activity, and anti-diabetic activity. The vinegar granule using Subicho of the present invention has useful components and excellent sensory properties derived from mature vinegar fruits, and has high portability, accessibility, and preference. Unlike other vinegars, the vinegar granules can be consumed easily and without water and irritation even when there is dental damage or soft tissue damage in a mouth. The present invention exhibits a higher polyphenol content and strong antioxidant and anti-diabetic activities compared to conventional vinegars. Thus, the present invention can be expected to be utilized as health functional foods for aging inhibition, cancer prevention, and stress relief, thereby being a very useful invention in a food industry.

title_en: Jelly composition having a texture similar to yanggaeng
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a jelly composition having a texture similar to that of sweet jelly. A jelly formulation composition comprising Iota Carrageenan and Amidated Pectin as gelling agents, wherein the jelly formulation composition has coherency greater than 0.6; the chewiness is 3000-7000 mj; the resilience is less than 700; the gumminess is 40,000-100,000g; and a texture of the jelly formulation composition is similar to that of sweet jelly. The jelly composition of the present invention can be manufactured by using the existing jelly manufacturing equipment since there is no need to have an additional equipment for implementing a jelly composition having a texture similar to that of sweet jelly, thereby having an economic advantage.

title_en: Method for manufacturing functional feed for companion animals and functional feed produced thereby
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing functional feed for pets and the functional feed manufactured thereby, and has the effect of improving feed intake efficiency by reducing off-flavors, which may occur when a powder-type functional ingredient for enhancing the immunity of pets is ingested, through the use of pollack powder. To this end, the method of the present invention comprises: a raw material preparing step (ST 1) of preparing raw materials including a marigold extract, milk thistle, glucosamine, chondroitin, fish collagen, propolis, coenzyme Q10, zinc, a chlorella extract, and hyaluronic acid; a raw material mixing step (ST 2) of uniformly mixing the prepared raw materials by putting the prepared raw materials into a stirrer; a pollack powder adding step (ST 3) of additionally adding pollack powder to the mixed raw materials; a drying step (ST 4) of stirring and drying the functional feed to which the pollack powder is added; and a packaging step (ST 5) of packaging the dried functional feed in a certain weight unit.

title_en: High-moisture and plant-based alternative meat with nutritional benefits and long-tearing meat texture, alternative meat composition for manufacturing thereof, manufacutring method of the same alternative meat
abstract_en: The present invention relates to vegetable high-moisture substitute meat having excellent nutrition and long-tearing meat texture, a substitute meat composition, and a method for manufacturing substitute meat.
