More specifically, the present invention relates to vegetable high-moisture substitute meat which has excellent processability in an extrusion manufacturing process, has a long-tearing texture like a meat grain, can provide texture and texture similar to animal meat, and is improved in terms of nutrition, a substitute meat composition for manufacturing the same, and a method for manufacturing the substitute meat.

title_en: Method for producing pork feet broth concentrate using replenishing solution and composition thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pork feet sauce composition using replenishing water and a manufacturing method thereof. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps of: (a) manufacturing replenishing water by mixing water, basic seasoning materials, and other seasoning materials; (b) manufacturing a primary pork feet sauce composition by concentrating the replenishing water; (c) manufacturing a final pork feet sauce composition by adding a thickener, a flavor enhancer, an emulsifier, an antioxidant, a pH adjusting agent, and a preservative to the primary pork feet sauce composition; and (d) low-temperature aging, homogenizing, sterilizing, and aseptically packaging the final pork feet sauce composition. The manufacturing method according to the present invention can consistently mass-produce pork feet sauce having rich taste and aroma, and can greatly improve the preservability and stability of the product.

title_en: Novel Pyrrole or Imidazole Derivatives and Improvement Use for Pulmonary Fibrosis Thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a novel pyrrole derivative or a novel imidazole derivative having an activity of inhibiting tgf-β1 signaling pathway and emt inhibition without showing special cytotoxicity to a549 cells, which are lung cancer-derived lung epithelial cells, and a composition for alleviating pulmonary fibrosis using the derivative.

title_en: Bread with Acorn pollen and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to bread containing acorn pollen and a manufacturing method thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to: bread containing acorn pollen in which acorn pollen is added to dough and/or red bean paste, followed by secondary fermentation, so that the bread has higher palatability than general bread and contains various nutrients while having an excellent antioxidant effect; and a manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: A pharmaceutical composition containing cell-transducing HSP70 fusion protein for stimualing neurogeneration
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a drug for nerve generation with little or no side effects. The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for nerve regeneration comprising a cell-permeable HSP70 fusion protein, and in the present invention, heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) fusion protein increased novel target recognition memory, cell proliferation, and neuroblast differentiation in the hippocampus. The result implies that the HSP70 fusion protein can be used as the pharmaceutical composition for promoting neurogenesis and preventing neurodegenerative diseases.

title_en: Method of manufacturing fermented vinegar containing Actinidia arguta sap
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing fermented vinegar by using a Bower Actinidia sap as a main material and by performing alcohol fermentation and acetic fermentation by utilizing sugars and yeast. More specifically, the method comprises the steps of: (a) adding, mixing, and dipping a Bower Actinidia sap, sugars, bay salt, and human microbiome, and closing a lid of the container to seal the same; (b) leaving the sealed container in a shaded place without sunlight to perform alcohol fermentation; (c) after completion of the alcohol fermentation, removing the lid of the container, supplementing a Bower Actinidia sap, covering Korean traditional paper, and leaving the same to perform acetic acid fermentation; and (d) after completion of the acetic acid fermentation, closing the lid of the container, and sealing and aging the same. According to the present invention, fermented vinegar can be produced through alcohol fermentation and acetic acid fermentation.

title_en: Composition for preventing, ameliorating or treating fatty liver disease comprising Pediococcus inopinatus as effective component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing, mitigating, or treating fatty liver disease containing Pediococcus inopinatus as an effective ingredient. More specifically, according to the present invention, Pediococcus inopinatus not only has no cytotoxicity, but also effectively reduces accumulation of triglycerides in a hepatocarcinoma cell line (HepG_2), lowers the levels of blood ALT and TG content increased by alcohol, and provides effects of lowering, in animal models in which fatty liver is induced through high-fat diet, reducing the weight of the liver and an expression level of fat metabolism-related genes in the liver. Accordingly, the composition of the present invention can be usefully used as a health functional food, medicine, and a feed additive or veterinary composition for preventing, mitigating, and treating the fatty liver disease. The component comprises at least one, as an active ingredient, selected from a group consisting of a Pediococcus inopinatus WiKim0108 strain (Accession No.: KACC 81091BP), the culture of the strain, and a concentrate, a dried product, and an extract of the culture.

title_en: Composition for improvement of learning and memory function comprising fermented red ginseng, Polygala tenuifolia, Ginkgo blioba leaf and Poria cocos mixture as effective component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising a mixed fermented product of red ginseng, polygala tenuifolia, a ginkgo leaf, and poria cocos as an active ingredient to improve a cognitive function or a memory ability. The mixed fermented product of red ginseng, polygala tenuifolia, a ginkgo leaf, and poria cocos of the present invention provides an excellent effect of inhibiting activity of an acetylcholine degrading enzyme which inhibits neurotransmission by destroying acetylcholine, is usefully used for prevention or treatment of degenerative cranial nerve diseases such as Alzheimer′s disease with excellent recovery ability for memory and cognitive ability of a scopolamine-induced memory impairment animal model, and improves or enhances impaired memory, learning ability, and a cognitive function.

title_en: Preparing method for ginseng berry liquid tea and ginseng berry liquid tea prepared by the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a preparing method for ginseng berry liquid tea, and a ginseng berry concentrate prepared by the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to a preparing method for liquid tea with improved efficacy obtained from ginseng berries, without destroying active ingredients of the ginseng berries. The preparing method for ginseng berry liquid tea comprises: a step of steaming ginseng berries; a step of drying the steamed ginseng berries; and a step of grinding the steamed and dried ginseng berries.

title_en: Ssanghwa jeonbyeong and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ssanghwa crepe containing ssanghwa powder and a method for manufacturing the same. The present invention provides a ssanghwa crepe and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the ssanghwa crepe is baked in an oven together with nuts, so the crispy taste and nutty flavor can be further enhanced, and storage is easy. Also, the ssanghwa crepe does not contain preservatives, has low contents of carbohydrate, sodium, sugar and fat, and contains ssanghwa powder, and thus can be provided as a safe food for all people, including people with chronic diseases such as hypertension and diabetes.

title_en: The method of produce for the crude rice wine with some Garlic Chive and Houttuynia Heart-leaves
abstract_en: A 'heartleaf Houttuynia-garlic chive makgeolli' according to the present invention is a traditional alcoholic beverage that can relieve skin problems and various blood flow problems by adding heartleaf Houttuynia and garlic chives after fermentation.

title_en: Method for manufacturing kimchi using enzyme
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing kimchi using an enzyme, and more specifically, to a method for manufacturing kimchi using an enzyme, wherein a step of pickling using an enzyme in the manufacture of kimchi can be rapidly progressed. The method for manufacturing kimchi using an enzyme according to the present invention includes: a first step of selecting and washing cabbage; a second step of pickling the washed cabbage in distilled water containing enzymes; a third step of dehydrating the pickled cabbage; a fourth step of manufacturing and cooling glutinous rice paste by using glutinous rice flour; a fifth step of manufacturing a seasoning by mixing fish sauce, red pepper powder, radish, garlic, onion, ginger, salt, and sugar with the glutinous rice paste; and a sixth step of evenly spreading the seasoning on the dehydrated pickled cabbage.

title_en: Souce for fish cake using red pepper powder and hot pepper soybean
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fish cake sauce containing red pepper paste and red pepper powder, and more specifically, to a fish cake sauce containing red pepper paste and red pepper powder, which stimulates appetite by containing red pepper paste, red pepper powder and Sichuan red pepper to visually redden, and makes a flavor by reducing the fishy taste of fish cakes.

title_en: mixture containing musk rat musk having anti-obesity activity and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: a composition containing muskrat musk having anti-obesity activity which contains musk obtained from muskrat as an active component to have anti-obesity activity and to be manufactured in an easy-to-eat form; and a method for manufacturing the same. The composition according to the present invention can be used as a very ideal prophylaxis and treatment.

title_en: Fermentation control compositions and Their Manufacturing Methods
abstract_en: A fermentation control composition and a manufacturing method thereof according to the present invention contains alcohol, acetic acid, lactic acid, and adipic acid. According to the present invention, alcohol, acetic acid, lactic acid, and adipic acid are included in various foods such as kimchi, so that it is possible to inhibit fermentation, improve edible period and quality of food, and induce the extension of a shelf life.

title_en: Transgenic Ardisia pusilla with Increased Toluene Purification using CYP2E1 Gene and Use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to transgenic Viburnum odoratissimum with increased toluene purification ability using a CYP2E1 gene and uses thereof. Viburnum odoratissimum transformed with the CYP2E1 gene has a significantly excellent toluene reduction rate than a toluene reduction rate of general Viburnum odoratissimum, thereby being able to be usefully used for toluene purification in the atmosphere.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating dementia comprising Houttuynia cordata or isolated compounds of Houttuynia cordata
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating dementia, containing a Houttuynia cordata extract or a compound isolated from the same as an active component. More specifically, the present invention relates to a composition which contains a Houttuynia cordata extract or a compound isolated from the same as an active component, wherein the composition has an excellent antioxidant effect and acetylcholinesterase inhibitory activity, thereby being able to be usefully used as a material of pharmaceuticals and functional foods that can prevent, alleviate and treat dementia.

title_en: DNA aptamer specifically binding to glutathione and use of the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a single-stranded DNA aptamer that is bonded to glutathione to inhibit oxidation of glutathione or stabilize glutathione, and specifically, to a single-stranded DNA aptamer that has one or more stem-loop structures, a method for preventing oxidation of glutathione or stabilizing glutathione using the aptamer, and application to various fields such as medicines, cosmetics, and foods using the aptamer. The aptamer of the present invention can be applied in various fields such as medicines, cosmetics, and foods which require oxidation prevention and stabilization of glutathione.

title_en: Automatic cooking method in korean-style cooking of microwave oven
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic cooking method of Korean food which categorizes Korean dishes with similar heating times, such as soups, steamed dishes, stews, and stir-fries, in a group in a microwave oven, and determines a menu while cooking, so that Korean dishes are automatically cooked by one switch operation. As shown in FIG. 1, a typical microwave oven includes a heating chamber (1) for heating food, an exhaust port (2) formed to discharge hot steam and gas generated during food cooking to the outside, and a humidity sensor (3) and a gas sensor (4) coupled to the exhaust port (2) for detecting whether the hot steam generated when food is heated in the heating chamber (1) is saturated.

title_en: dietary supplements for weight loss of pill type
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a supplementary food for weight loss having a pill form, which is composed of a mixture of 45% of Asparagus cochinchinensis, 15% of Codonopsis lanceolata, 15% of Platycodon grandiflorus, 11% of Coix lacryma-jobi, 5% of red ginseng, 4% of Sophora japonica fruits, and 5% of glutinous rice, and formed in the pill form. The present invention has the pill form to be easy to take, is safe due to have no side effects, is capable of long-term storage, and has an excellent effect on weight loss.

title_en: A pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating metabolic disease comprising icam-2 binding material as active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention identifies ICAM-2, which is a novel target capable of inducing secretion of GLP-1. A material capable of binding to the molecule can promote the secretion of GLP-1 through ICAM-2. GLP-1 is an appetite regulating hormone known to alleviate metabolic disorders. Conventionally, GLP-1 is known to be secreted by G protein coupled receptor (GPCR) of intestinal endothelial cells. In the present invention, a novel molecule capable of promoting secretion of GLP-1 was identified. Therefore, the present invention identified a screening method for promoting secretion of GLP-1 by screening an ICAM-2 binding material. In addition, a material binding specifically to ICAM-2 can be utilized as a therapeutic agent for diabetes mellitus and metabolic disorders.

title_en: Apparatus for manufacturing scorching rice
abstract_en: A device for manufacturing scorching rice comprises: a raw ingredient supply unit discharging a raw ingredient of scorching rice downward; a lower plate on which the raw ingredient of scorching rice discharged from the raw ingredient supply unit is seated; a forming unit flattening the raw ingredient of scorching rice discharged on the lower plate; an upper plate rotatably connected to the lower plate to pressurize the raw ingredient of scorching rice on the lower plate; a transfer line transferring the lower plate and the upper plate; a heating device disposed on the transfer line to heat the lower plate; and a discharging device separating cooked scorching rice from the lower plate.

title_en: Composition Comprising Locusta migratoria extract for preventing or treating Obesity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating obesity containing a Locusta migratoria extract. The Locusta migratoria extract according to the present invention has no side effects, has excellent safety, and has excellent anti-obesity effects, thereby being able to be used as a preventive or therapeutic agent for obesity or obesity-related diseases, a food composition, health functional food, and a feed composition.

title_en: Method of manufacturing traditional oriental functional soup for pork bossam
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing oriental functional soup for pork wrap. The method includes: a) an ingredient collection and trimming step of removing surface foreign matter after collecting dried cornus, hovenia, acanthopanax, angelica, and licorice; b) a step of blending the trimmed ingredients at the ratio of cornus: 25 to 35 wt%, hovenia: 20 to 30 wt%, acanthopanax: 15 to 25 wt%, angelica: 10 to 15 wt%, and licorice: 3 to 7 wt%; c) a step of putting the blended ingredients into a container and extracting it as water of 10 times for 4 to 8 hours at 100 to 140 degrees Celsius; d) a step of filtering the extract with a 30 mesh filter; e) a step of concentrating the obtained filtrate to 20 to 40 brix in a concentrator; and f) a step of injecting a certain amount of the concentrate into a packaging container and sealing the packaging.

title_en: A Manufacturing Method of Cheonggukjang Mixed with Aquilaria Agallocha
abstract_en: The present invention relates to functional Cheonggukjang (fast-fermented bean paste) using aloeswood leaves and a method for preparing the same. More specifically, the present invention has been described step by step. The present invention comprises: a first step of cleanly washing soybeans from which foreign substances are removed and immersing the soybeans in water at a temperature of 15-30℃ for 10-14 hours; a second step (roasting step) of roasting aloeswood leaves that have been dried and washed with water at a temperature of 130-170℃; a third step (grinding step) of grinding the roasted aloeswood leaves into powder; a fourth step (mixing step) of mixing the soaked soybeans with the aloeswood leaf powder at a weight ratio of 10:0.1-3.0; and a fifth step of mixing the mixture ingredients thereof with rice straw or inoculating the mixture ingredients with Bacillus subtilis and fermenting the mixture ingredients in a fermentation chamber for 48-72 hours. Accordingly, the preparation method of the present invention has the effects of: providing functional Cheonggukjang using aloeswood leaves, which is obtained by suppressing unique strong and unpleasant odor and taste of Cheonggukjang; increasing the unique scent of aloeswood; adding the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang and the efficacy of aloeswood leaves so that Cheonggukjang can be provided as food which can be consumed by men and women of all ages without any repulsion; and maximizing advantages of Cheonggukjang by the combination of the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang with the efficacy of aloeswood leaves. In particular, Cheonggukjang of the present invention can be used as a local specialty, and thus, it is expected that the present invention will increase farm income, create jobs, and further contribute to an increase in export.

title_en: Convenient Meal Replacement Containing Cheonggukjang, and Method for Manufacturing the Same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simple substitute meal which is manufactured by mixing fast-fermented bean paste powder with dextrin, alpha starch powder, grain powder, bean powder, and sugar, and which contains several useful ingredients in a balanced way to be easily consumed as a meal or a snack substitute. The simple substitute meal containing fast-fermented bean paste according to the present invention can provide balanced nutrition by containing fast-fermented bean paste in the grain powder, the bean powder, and the like, and can reduce the feeling of rejection when ingested because the fast-fermented bean paste powder is wrapped by a coating film of the dextrin so that unpleasant odor is suppressed. In addition, the simple substitute meal dissolves easily without clumping when mixed with water, thereby being quickly and conveniently consumed.

title_en: Method for manufacturing dried shrimp with microwave vacuum drying
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a method for manufacturing dried salted shrimps using low-temperature microwave vacuum drying, in which the unique characteristics of salted shrimps are maintained and the salted shrimps can be stored for a long time without deterioration. According to the present invention, the method comprises a salted shrimp manufacturing step, a salted shrimp odor prevention step, a salted shrimp drying step by low-temperature microwave vacuum drying, and a flavoring step of flavoring dried salted shrimps. Accordingly, since moisture is selectively removed at a low temperature by microwave, excellent preservation of taste, aroma, and nutrition is provided without changing the quality of the texture, thereby providing the unique effect of salted shrimps. In addition, since sterilization is performed and fishy smell is removed during manufacturing and drying processes, excellent preservation, convenient packaging, good storage, and the like are provided to increase consumer acceptance, thereby providing a commercial advantage.

title_en: Baekgimchi Manufacturing Method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a baekgimchi manufacturing method including: a) a grass ingredient mixing step of mixing grass ingredients including water, flour, deodeok, salt, and sugar; b) a grass ingredient heating step of heating the mixed grass ingredients for a first preset time; c) a grass cooling step of cooling the heated grass ingredients for a second time longer than the first time after the passage of the first time; d) a cabbage pickling step of pickling cabbage in salt for a third time longer than the first time and shorter than the second time; e) a vegetable preparation step of grinding and mixing vegetables including onion, pear, and garlic; and f) a final mixing step of mixing the grass cooled in step c), the cabbage pickled in step d), and the vegetables from step e).

title_en: Method of manufacturing jam using green tangerine and green tangerine jam prepared thereby
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a jam using a green tangerine and a green tangerine jam prepared by the method including: a freeze-dried green tangerine powder preparation step (S100) of preparing freeze-dried green tangerine powder by green tangerine preparation and freeze-drying; a mixing step (S200) of preparing a mixture by mixing the freeze-dried green tangerine powder with milk, oligosaccharide, pectin, stevia extract, pineapple concentrate, and whole milk powder; a stirring step (S300) of stirring the mixture in a mixer (S300); a heating step (S400) of heating and boiling the stirred mixture; and a cooling step (S500) of preparing a green tangerine jam by lemon juice and avocado oil addition to the boiled mixture, stirring, and cooling. By the jam preparation method of the present invention, it is possible to easily ingest the nutrients of green tangerines higher in vitamin C content than regular tangerines and satisfy health-oriented modern people's preferences.

title_en: Peptide derivative with collagenase inhibitory activity and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a peptide derivative having a collagenase inhibitory activity or a use thereof, and has advantages of increasing percutaneous absorption, inhibiting collagenase activity, and alleviating wrinkles. Since the peptide derivative of the present invention is effective for wrinkle alleviation, there is the advantage that the peptide derivative can be widely used as a material in various fields such as the pharmaceutical industry, the food industry, and the cosmetic industry.

title_en: Collagen leaf tea, and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a collagen leaf tea and a producing method thereof. More specifically, in a process of producing leaf tea by withering, bruising, and flavoring the leaf, the present invention relates to the collagen leaf tea that contains collagen while effectively expressing a unique scent and flavor of the leaf in a finally produced leaf tea by dividing and performing a collagen coating process into two as a first collagen coating step of immersing a leaf in a collagen solution and a second collagen coating step of spraying the collagen solution on the leaf surface while withering-processing the leaf and producing the collagen leaf tea; and the producing method thereof. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having a beneficial advantage to the health.

title_en: A meth0ed for manufacturing sturgeon extract and the sturgeon extract manufactured by the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a sturgeon extract comprising a first sturgeon extract and a second sturgeon extract. Provided is the manufacturing method of the sturgeon extract which comprises the following steps of: decontaminating sturgeon raw materials; performing hot water extraction of the decontaminated sturgeon raw materials to obtain the first sturgeon extract and residual sturgeon raw materials; performing a corresponding process by using microorganisms in the residual sturgeon raw materials; and manufacturing the second sturgeon extract by performing a pressure extraction process on the remaining sturgeon raw materials in which the corresponding process has been performed.

title_en: A feed additive for improving meat quality comprising emulsifier and steviol glycoside, a feed composition and a breeding method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a feed additive for improving poultry meat quality including an emulsifier and steviol glycosides as active ingredients, and a feed composition and a breeding method using the same. Specifically, the present invention uses a mixture of an emulsifier and steviol glycosides as a feed additive and by doing so, it is possible to improve poultry growth, reduce feed conversion rate and increase energy digestibility in feed. It is also possible to reduce juice loss and heating loss, effectively improve poultry production, and improve meat quality by providing high-quality poultry meat with improved texture. Thus, the present invention can contribute to the improvement of the economic feasibility of the food industry using poultry meat as a raw material.

title_en: Milk composition for companion animals
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a milk composition for a companion animal. The milk composition for a companion animal according to the present invention has properly balanced essential nutritional components such as protein, fat, and inorganic salts in the composition, and has a low lactose content, so that the milk composition does not cause digestive diseases of companion animals, but improve energy supply, nutritional status, fur and skin conditions. In addition, the milk composition of the present invention has activities in anti-oxidation and anti-inflammation to be effective in maintaining immunity and have a high preference among companion animals of all ages. Further, when the milk composition is stored for a long term at various temperatures such as a low temperature, room temperature, and a high temperature, bacteria aren't generated and acidity can be constantly maintained, so that the milk composition has very excellent stability of storage.

title_en: Composition for anti-wrinkle comprising compound isolated from gallic acid oxide as effective component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for ameliorating skin wrinkles containing a gallic acid-derived compound as an active ingredient. The compound according to the present invention is highly effective in inhibiting MMP-1 activity and inducing the synthesis of type 1 procollagen, so that it is expected to be effectively used as a raw material for a cosmetic composition for ameliorating skin wrinkles, a food, and an external preparation for the skin.

title_en: Method of smoked pork skin and processed food process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of cooking smoked pork rinds. The method for cooking pork rinds which even customers who are reluctant to eat pork rinds can enjoy comprises: a washing step; a boiling step; a dredging step including additives; a drying step of drying pork rinds dredged with the additives, and a heating step of heating the pork rinds.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating diabetes comprising extract of Rorippa palustris or a fraction thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: a pharmaceutical composition, a food composition, and a health functional food composition which contain a Rorippa palustris extract or a fraction thereof as an active component; and a method for treating diabetes comprising a step of administering the pharmaceutical composition. The composition containing the Rorippa palustris extract or the fraction thereof of the present invention can be administered orally while reducing main symptoms of hyperglycemia or diabetes, and thus can be widely used in the prevention or treatment of diabetes.

title_en: composition for improving skin condition comprising extracellular vesicles derived from plant, and method for producing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for improving skin conditions comprising plant or tissue culture-derived extracellular vesicles, and a method for producing the same. Through the method for producing the plant or tissue culture-derived extracellular vesicles according to one aspect, a large amount of extracellular vesicles with excellent functional activity can be obtained, and the vesicles can be usefully used for preparing the composition for improving skin conditions. The method for producing the plant or tissue culture-derived extracellular vesicles comprises: a step of obtaining a pulverized plant or tissue culture; a step of filtering the pulverized culture; and a step of performing ultrafiltration on the filtered culture.

title_en: Method for manufacturing freeze dried strawberry snack and strawberry snack prepared by using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a freeze-dried strawberry snack and a strawberry snack produced using the same. The strawberry snack produced by the method for producing a freeze-dried strawberry snack according to an aspect of the present invention is provided with a crispy, dense, and soft texture, and with a balanced taste without damaging the taste of the strawberry, which is a raw material, such that there is an effect of improving consumer preference. In addition, since the method minimizes the amount of fat and artificial additives used, healthy snacks can be prepared. Moreover, according to the strawberry snack produced by the method, it is possible to minimize the amount of loss due to shape deformation by minimizing crumbling caused by external force or gravity.

title_en: A composition comprising fermented Stichopus japonicus extract and fermented Black ginseng extract for improvement of immunity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an immunity enhancing composition containing a fermented sea cucumber extract and a fermented black ginseng extract as active ingredients. The composition of the present invention increases cytokine (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β) secretion ability and nitric oxide secretion ability without increasing reactive oxygen species and induces phosphorylation of MAPKs, expression of NF-κB, and expression of cell surface activators.

title_en: Dough cutting device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a dough cutting apparatus which can uniformly cut dough by a cutting device coaxially connected to an extruder, set the cutting length of the dough by speed control of a speed control motor, and uniformly cut the dough even if the cutting speed is maximized, thereby guaranteeing reliability of the apparatus. The present invention provides the dough cutting apparatus enabling the dough (F/P) that is pressurized through an extruder (10) to be manufactured with a set shape due to frying by being compressed in an inner extrusion space (141) of an extrusion molding cylinder (140), at the same time, being discharged through the dough discharge holes (142, 142a, 142b, 143c) of the rotating extrusion molding cylinder (140) rotating in synchronization by driving a speed control motor (180), and at the same time, being discharged through a cutting outlet (122) as soon as being cut by a cutting knife (121) of a cutting blade cylinder (120).

title_en: Composition for preventing, improving, or treating cachexia containing extract of Buddlejae Flos
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing, alleviating, or treating cachexia, including an extract of Buddleja officinalis. The extract of Buddleja officinalis according to the present invention has an effect of fundamentally alleviating symptoms of cancerous cachexia by inhibiting the loss of weight, muscle, and fat caused by tumors, not due to an increase in feed intake through appetite enhancement, is safe, and has no side effects, thereby being able to be used for preventing, alleviating, or treating cachexia.

title_en: Antioxidant composition containing apo-9'-fucoxanthinone compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antioxidant composition containing an apo-9'-fucoxanthinone compound. Oxidative stress can be effectively alleviated by using an antioxidant composition containing apo-9'-fucoxanthinone.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for treating of brain dieases comprising antibodies specifically binding to asm protein
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a use of an antibody specifically binding to acid sphingomyelinase (ASM) protein. Specifically, the antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof according to the present invention specifically binds to the ASM protein with high binding capacity, significantly inhibits the activity of the ASM protein existing in a cellular membrane, and exhibits an effect of improving cognitive memory, an effect of inhibiting the ASM protein activity, an effect of inhibiting the accumulation of amyloid-β and tau proteins, and an effect of inhibiting nerve inflammation occurrence, thereby being able to usefully used in treating brain diseases.

title_en: Method for preparing skin clearum-tang by body temperature extraction method to promote human metabolism
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing skin clearum-tang by a body temperature extraction method to promote human metabolism, which extracts raw materials at 36.5℃, which is the human body temperature, in a manufacturing process using plant ingredients containing a large amount of collagen so that during drinking, the same can move smoothly into the human body with the same body temperature, thereby improving the human absorption rate of the collagen. To this end, the method comprises: an ingredient preparation step of preparing gold hibiscus leaf, houttuynia cordata, parsley, bitter melon, glasswort, hawthorn, malt, and licorice ingredients (ST 1); a washing step of washing the prepared ingredients by washing water (ST 2); a cutting step of cutting the washed ingredients into a size (ST 3); an extraction step of extracting an extract by low-temperature heating at a temperature of 36.5℃ for 50-60 hours while the cut ingredients are immersed in an immersion liquid (ST 4); a heating step of heating the extract at a high temperature of 100℃ for 5-10 hours (ST 5); a post-processing step of irradiating UV light for 10-20 minutes to sterilize the heated extract (ST 6); and a packaging step of vacuum packaging the post-processed extract in a wrapping (ST 7).

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating inflammatory diseases comprising extracts of Acorus gramineus and Dendropanax morbifera
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating inflammatory diseases comprising an Acorus gramineus extract and a Dendropanax morbifera extract, and more specifically, to a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of inflammatory diseases with increased anti-inflammatory efficacy according to the mixture of the Acorus gramineus extract and the Dendropanax morbifera extract. In the present invention, it was confirmed that the anti-inflammatory efficacy was remarkably increased while the cytotoxicity was rather decreased when the mixture of the Acorus gramineus extract and the Dendropanax morbifera extract was used. Therefore, the Acorus gramineus extract and the Dendropanax morbifera extract of the present invention can be usefully used for the pharmaceutical composition for the treatment and prevention of inflammatory diseases or for a health functional food and a cosmetic composition for anti-inflammatory.

title_en: Composition for treating or preventing breast cancer comprising indacaterol
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing, treating, or alleviating breast cancer comprising indacaterol or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof as an active ingredient. The composition of the present invention exhibits cytotoxicity by inducing apoptosis specifically in breast cancer cells, especially triple-negative breast cancer or HER2-positive breast cancer, without affecting normal cells, thereby being able to be used for preventing or treating breast cancer.

title_en: Manufacturing method of jujube jinger tea and jujube jinger tea manufactured by the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing jujube ginger tea which maintains the beneficial ingredients of jujube based on jujube and ginger, which are known to be very beneficial to health, can increase a pharmacological effect by adding natural additional functional ingredients that are in harmony with the beneficial ingredients of jujube, and can be easily consumed by anyone, regardless of gender or age and to jujube ginger tea produced thereby. According to the present invention, provided are the method for producing jujube ginger tea and the jujube ginger tea produced thereby. The method comprises: a jujube washing step of washing jujubes; a jujube concentrate preparation step of preparing a jujube concentrate by using the washed jujube; a jujube-Schisandra chinensis grain syrup preparation step of mixing the prepared jujube concentrate and a Schisandra chinensis sweet rice drink, and braising and boiling the same to prepare jujube-Schisandra chinensis grain syrup; a jujube-Schisandra chinensis grain syrup freezing step of rapidly freezing and drying the prepared jujube-Schisandra chinensis grain syrup; a step of grinding the freeze-dried jujube-Schisandra chinensis freeze-dried product into powder; and a jujube tea completion step of mixing ginger with the prepared jujube-Schisandra chinensis freeze-dried powder at a ratio of 1 : 1 to complete the jujube ginger tea.

title_en: Composition for anti-oxidation, anti-inflammation, anti-diabetes, whitening, anti-wrinkle, or inhibition of gout, comprising extract of Pyrrosia lingua
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for anti-oxidation, anti-inflammation, anti-diabetes, skin-whitening, wrinkle improvement, or gout inhibition comprising an extract of Pyrrosia lingua. The extract of Pyrrosia lingua according to the present invention inhibits DPPH radicals, ABTS radicals, and TBARs and increases PFs to exhibit an antioxidant effect, and inhibits hyaluronidase to exhibit an anti-inflammatory effect. In addition, the extract of Pyrrosia lingua inhibits tyrosinase to exhibit a skin-whitening effect and inhibits elastase or collagenase to exhibit a wrinkle improvement effect. Also, the extract of Pyrrosia lingua inhibits α-amylase or α-glucosidase to exhibit an anti-diabetes effect and inhibits xanthine oxidase to exhibit a gout (arthritis) suppressing effect. Therefore, the extract of Pyrrosia lingua can be expected to be usefully used for a pharmaceutical composition, a food composition, a cosmetic composition, etc. having the above-mentioned physiological activity.

title_en: Composition comprising Yeast vacuoles for inhibiting adipogenesis or accumulation of lipid in adipocyte
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of yeast-derived vacuoles to inhibit adipocyte differentiation and lipid accumulation. A composition containing yeast-derived vacuoles provides activity for preventing, ameliorating or treating obesity or metabolic diseases induced from obesity.

title_en: Method for natural fermented sauce
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a natural fermented sauce to manufacture a fermented soybean lump with increased Bacillus subtilis content. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: preparing mixed water in which water containing Bacillus subtilis extracted from rice straw and loess water are mixed; immersing soybeans mixed in the mixed water to soak the soybeans; adding water to the soaked soybeans and boiling the mixture in a ceramic kiln for a predetermined time; scooping out and grinding the boiled soybeans; putting the ground soybeans into a mold to form the ground soybeans; drying the surface of the formed soybean lump; fermenting the dried soybean lump in a red clay room; and naturally drying the fermented soybean lump.

title_en: Chimeric endolysin ClyY with lytic activity and binding affinity against Clostridium perfringens
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the chimeric endolysin ClyY, which has lytic capacity and binding affinity for Clostridium perfringens, wherein the endolysin ClyY newly developed in the present invention shows specific lytic action against strains of the genus Clostridium, one of causative bacteria that causes food poisoning, and in particular, has excellent binding activity against bacteria to be used in food and animal medicine industries.

title_en: Auricularia auricula liquid tea and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing Auricularia auricular liquid tea, which contains a large amount of active ingredients of Auricularia auricular such as vitamin D2 and has excellent taste and aroma preference. The method comprises the steps of: a) adding dried Auricularia auricular, jujube, and licorice to purified water and heating the same to obtain a mixed extract; and b) mixing fructooligosaccharide with the mixed extract.

title_en: Fermented product of garlic and mulberry leaf with antioxidant activity, and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a complex fermentation product of garlic and mulberry leaves obtained by fermenting natural products containing garlic and mulberry leaves with a specific Bacillus subtilis strain. According to the present invention, the complex fermentation product of garlic and mulberry leaves has a higher nitric oxide content and significantly better antioxidant activity than the garlic fermentation product prepared using the same strain and the same method, and is useful in various fields requiring excellent antioxidant activity.

title_en: Method for preparing amino acid product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method for producing amino acid granules from a fermentation broth, and bacteria have been removed from the produced amino acid granules. The method for producing the amino acid granules comprises a first step of preparing a fermentation filtrate by removing bacterial cells from the fermentation broth containing amino acids; and a second step of forming the granules from the fermentation filtrate. One purpose of the present application is to provide the method for producing a granular product with a higher amino acid content compared to an existing fermentation broth and a uniform content by particle size.

title_en: Method for preparing liquefied composition with nipa fruticans wurmb
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a composition for food additives using alcohol extract from flower stalks and flower buds of a nipa palm, more specifically, the manufacturing method comprising the steps of: cleaning flower stalks and flower buds of a nipa palm; blanching the cleaned flower stalks and flower buds in boiling water for 10-40 minutes; drying the blanched flower stalks and flower buds; mixing the dried dry matter and malabar spinach; roasting the mixed mixture; grinding the roasted mixture; and adding alcohol or alcohol aqueous solution to the ground mixture, extracting for 1-5 hours at a temperature between 20-40℃, and filtering and drying the same. According to the present invention, there are advantages in that it is possible to add the composition to various foods to help maintain the health of consumers and provide functional food capable of improving the flavor of food by manufacturing a composition for food additives which is rich in various nutrients and excellent in antioxidant, anti-inflammatory activation, and detoxification functions. In addition, there are effects in improving the functionality of food and nutritional value as well as improving flavor and bettering preservation to prevent the use of additional chemical additives.

title_en: Health supplement food
abstract_en: The present invention, in a health supplement food, manufactures a mixture by mixing a number of natural ingredients, including 760 g of Liriope muscari tuber root, 490 g of Phragmites communis stem and root, 15.5 g of ginger root, 530 g of Lycium chinense berry, and 18 g of black garlic root. The mixture is immersed in 3.5 times the amount of purified water for 2 hours, extracted with stagnant water at 90 ℃ for 10 to 11 hours, and filtered. The filtered extract is first concentrated at 45 ℃ and secondly concentrated by reduced pressure concentration of a solid content upto 70 % to consume helath supplement food manufactured in a liquid form, thereby being able to improve weakened immunity.

title_en: Meat processing method added with beer gourd and meat products produced by said processing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for processing meat using brewer's grain and a meat product produced by the processing method, and in particular, to a method, in which ingredients, such as discarded brewer's grain, are used in a meat processing method so as to improve the nutritional value of beer and enhance the meat tenderization, and a processed meat product produced through the method. The method for processing meat using brewer's grain, of the present invention, improves components of meat products, such as protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals, and thus can improve the nutritional value thereof, and through a fibrous component of brewer's grain, the meat tenderization of meat tissue can be enhanced. In addition, the amount of discarded brewer's grain is minimized. Accordingly, the method has a high environmental value and makes it possible to produce high-value-added food.

title_en: Composition for inhibiting skin damage caused by UV rays containing mixed extract as an active ingredient comprising rice bran extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for reducing skin damage caused by ultraviolet rays containing a mixed rice extract as an active ingredient, and provides a cosmetic composition for reducing skin damage caused by ultraviolet rays containing, as an active ingredient, a mixed extract of one or more extracts selected from the group consisting of rice extract and barley extract, mugwort extract, or rice bran extract. The mixed rice extract of the present invention has an effect of suppressing the production of inflammatory cytokines and the expression of transcription factors thereof, to protect the skin from skin damage caused by ultraviolet rays and improve damaged skin, and has a whitening effect of inhibiting melanin production caused by ultraviolet rays.

title_en: Storage kits to maintain freshness of fruits, vegetables and foods in a controlled atmosphere
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology applied to maintain the freshness of foods such as fruits, vegetables, meat, and the like stored in small sealed plastic bags, paper boxes, refrigerators, and the like, to which small food storage spaces are applied, to prevent spoilage for a long time. According to the technical idea of the present invention, a storage kit comprises a configuration applied to continuously supply a composition of a reducing agent provided to reduce the amount of oxygen present inside small packaging containers such as sealed plastic bags, paper boxes, refrigerators, etc., a carbon dioxide component capable of delaying ripening and aging of fruit, and alcohol capable of inhibiting the growth and reproduction of microorganisms, thereby maintaining the freshness of fruits, vegetables, and foods in a controlled atmosphere in which a supply composition of mixed effective gases functioning to maintain the freshness of food is mixed and formed. The configuration comprises 1.0 to 15 parts by weight of an oxidizing agent composition and 2.5 to 30 parts by weight of a composition containing yeast, sugar, and carbon components functioning to continuously supply alcohol with respect to 100 parts by weight of a reducing agent composition.

title_en: System for manufacturing food using rice wine lees, and method thereof
abstract_en: A food manufacturing system using rice wine lees is disclosed. The food manufacturing system using the rice wine lees according to one aspect of the present invention may include: a re-fermentation tank for re-fermenting the rice wine lees collected from a brewery; a dehydrator for dehydrating the re-fermented rice wine lees and separating the rice wine lees into dehydrated rice wine lees and a dehydrated liquid of the rice wine lees; a drying system for drying the dehydrated sake lees to manufacture the dehydrated rice wine lees; a concentrated fermentation tank for concentrating and fermenting the dehydrated liquid; and a filter for filtering the concentrated fermented dehydrated liquid to manufacture organic acid and lactic acid bacteria alcohol.

title_en: Method for producing pear jam comprising pear skins and pear jam comprising pear skins prepared by the method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing pear jam including a pear skin and pear jam including a pear skin produced by the method, in which the method comprises: a washing step of washing a surface of a pear with water; a material preparation step of preparing a separate container by separating the pear skin from the pear after the washing step, preparing a crushed pear pulp by crushing a pulp obtained by removing a content inside the pear, and preparing a subsidiary material mixture including a calamansi extract, fructooligosaccharide, and pectin; a first heating step of injecting the pear skin, cinnamon powder, Hamcho salt, and water into a prepared heating container to crush and then primarily heat the same; a second heating step of injecting the crushed pear pulp into the heating container after the first heating step, stirring the same, mixing the same, and then secondarily heating the same to remove moisture; and a third heating step of temporarily stopping heating after the second heating step, injecting the subsidiary material mixture into the heating container, and then additionally heating the same. According to the present invention, the pear skin in which various nutrients are more concentrated in the pear pulp is included in the pear jam, thereby reinforcing nutrients, improving the texture, and increasing the overall preference compared to a conventional pear jam.

title_en: Manufacruting Method for beef sushi
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method capable of providing processed meat for beef sushi which is easy to cook by processing meat to a specific size and providing a standardized shape. According to the present invention, processed meat can be manufactured in a compressed form of a rectangular parallelepiped to provide convenience for packaging. Since there is no loss when cutting the processed meat before cooking, waste of materials and discharge of food waste are minimized. Since the processing pressure and moisture content are appropriately maintained when pressing raw meat, the processed meat for sushi with the same meat quality can be manufactured, and thus uniform quality beef for sushi can be provided. In addition, by secondary maturing the pressed raw meat including beet and citron peel, the smell of the raw meat is removed, and the red beet color permeates the meat surface in which browning due to oxidation occurs so that processed meat with excellent color can be provided. Moreover, processed meat for sushi can be provided by immersing the pressed raw meat obtained after primary and secondary maturation in a mixture of carbonated water and radish sprouts for masking to remove blood and replenish moisture, thereby further maximizing the soft texture. The manufacturing method of the processed meat for sushi comprises the steps of: removing fat and fascia of raw meat; coating the surface of the raw meat; pressing and mutually bonding the plurality of raw meats; maturing the pressed raw meat in a temperature range of -5 to 10℃; and cutting the pressed raw meat into a specific size and individually packaging the meat.

title_en: Pressing plate for kimchi box
abstract_en: Disclosed is kimchi pressing late which prevents kimchi from floating by pressing kimchi by a pressing plate when a lid is closed on a kimchi barrel main body to minimize the exposure of the surface of the kimchi to the air, thereby preventing the kimchi from oxidizing or developing efflorescence, and further dissolving dissolved carbon dioxide into the kimchi broth to maximize the fresh taste of the kimchi.

title_en: Fermented food manufacturing containers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fermentation container for manufacturing fermented food products, and more particularly to a fermentation container for manufacturing fermented food products that can prevent abnormal fermentation and spoilage by facilitating the circulation of air inside a container. The fermentation container of the present invention comprises a main body having a storage space inside which contents to be fermented are stored and an inlet formed in communication with the storage space, and a ventilation medium inserted from one side of the main body and penetrating through the other side of the main body to cross the storage space and circulating air between the outside and inside of the main body.

title_en: Composition comprising extract of Paeonia lactiflora for enhancing innate and acquired immune response based on macrophage activation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition having an effect of enhancing innate or acquired immune response based on macrophage activation comprising a Paeonia lactiflora extract as an active ingredient. The Paeonia lactioflora extract activates a phagocytosis of macrophage, increases production of NO, iNOS, COX-2, IL-β, and TNF-α, and induces stimulation of TLR4. In addition, the present invention proposes that the Paeonia lactioflora extract can be applied to various health functional foods by showing immune enhancement activity by activating macrophage autophagy.

title_en: The Appratus for Producing Vegetarian Meat Having Anisotropic Fiber Structure and Preparation Method Using The Same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus for manufacturing vegetable substitute meat having an anisotropic fiber structure, comprising: a fixed-phase outer cylinder; a reactant inflow unit formed on one side of the outer cylinder and into which a dispersion or emulsion containing at least two biopolymers selected from proteins, polysaccharides, and lipids, which are reactants, is introduced; an inner cylinder disposed in the outer cylinder in a longitudinal direction and rotated by an outer motor; and a reaction space unit formed on the outer surface of the inner cylinder and the inner surface of the inner cylinder.

title_en: A method of selling a plurality of the walnut cake or the like as a separably interconnected planar set
abstract_en: In walnut snacks or similar foods, a plurality of walnut snacks are connected in the production process to form a single plate, and a cutting mark for separation is provided for each piece so that the plurality of walnut snacks are sold as a single plate, so that a customer eats the individual pieces one by one from the single plate using the cutting mark when desired.

title_en: A method of decomposing plastic using Zophobas atratus
abstract_en: According to the present invention, it is confirmed that polystyrene decomposition efficiency is the best when 5 g per 10 cm^2 is supplied to polystyrene and breeding is performed for 4 weeks without supplying separate feed. therefore, it is possible to obtain excellent decomposition efficiency when polystyrene is decomposed by using american mealworm under the conditions according to the present invention.

title_en: Composition for Anti-inflammation, for Improving Skin Wrinkles and for Skin Moisturizing Using an Extract of Seeds of Irvingia gabonensis
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition for anti-inflammation, skin wrinkle improvement and skin moisturization using an Irvingia gabonensis seed extract that not only inhibits NO production in a concentration-dependent manner in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated mouse macrophages (RAW 264.7 cells) without showing any special cytotoxicity, but also increases collagen gene expression in human keratinocytes (HaCaT cells) in a concentration-dependent manner, inhibits the increase in MMP-1, -3, -9 expression due to oxidative stress, inhibits elastase activity, and increases hyaluronic acid synthase 2 (HAS2) expression in human keratinocytes (HaCaT cells) in a concentration-dependent manner.

title_en: Anti-obese composition comprising melinjo leaf
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-obesity composition containing melinjo leaves like crushed melinjo leaves or a melinjo leaf extract. The melinjo leaves, according to the present invention, provide an excellent effect on the reduction of weight and body fat by reducing the fat accumulation of adipocytes and inhibiting the mRNA expression of genes related to the differentiation of preadipocytes (PPARγ, C/EBPα, and SREBP-1c) and genes related to lipogenesis (LPL, FAS, and ACC). The present invention is a natural product to be safely used without side effects, thereby being useful for manufacturing food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, or feed additives.

title_en: Hemp seed beverage composition with anti-anxiety and alleviating migraine and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a new hemp seed energy drink and a manufacturing method thereof. The hemp seed energy drink can be consumed in a form of an energy drink with a rich nutritional component and an excellent taste by using a hemp seed. Provided is a hemp seed energy drink composition comprising: 100 parts by weight of carbonated water, 10 to 15 parts by weight of an acidity regulator, 8 to 11 parts by weight of a citrus extract, 7 to 9 parts by weight of a citric acid, 7 to 9 parts by weight of taurine, 5 to 6 parts by weight of inositol, 1 to 3 parts by weight of sodium benzoate, 1 to 3 parts by weight of acesulfame potassium, 1 to 3 parts by weight of purple yam color, 1 to 3 parts by weight of a cabbage extract, 1 to 3 parts by weight of steviol glycosides, 1 to 3 parts by weight of nicotinamide, 1 to 3 parts by weight of calcium pantothenate, 1 to 3 parts by weight of sucralose, and 1 to 5 parts by weight of a hemp seed extract. The hemp seed energy drink according to the present invention includes nutritional components that help improve energy and vitality while reducing the content of solids, thereby making it easy to consume and providing excellent sensory qualities.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating neuropathic pain comprising probiotics
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating neuropathic pain containing beneficial intestinal bacteria. According to the present invention, lactobacillus bacteria, bifidus bacteria, and streptococcus, which are beneficial intestinal bacteria, have excellent analgesic effects and pain persistence in pain behavior experiments of a neuropathic pain mouse model. In addition, the mechanism of alleviating pain by reducing the expression of tnf-α was confirmed. Therefore, it is expected to be widely used for the prevention and treatment of neuropathic pain.

title_en: Preparation method of makgeolli using gaba rice
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing GABA rice makgeolli. The method comprises the steps of: washing and soaking GABA rice; pulverizing the washed and soaked GABA rice and steaming the washed and soaked GABA rice in a steamed white rice cake state; adding koji, yeast, diastatic enzyme, and water to the steamed GABA rice and mixing the same; fermenting the mixture; and aging the fermented mixture. The mixing, fermentation, and aging steps are implemented by using a manufacturing machine comprising: a top chamber having an inner top space opened downward and an upper inlet communicating therewith; a bottom chamber disposed on a lower side of the top chamber and having an inner bottom space opened upward connected to the top space of the top chamber; a stirring means installed in the top chamber and mixing GABA rice, koji, yeast, diastatic enzyme, and water; a mesh-type porous plate inserted into the top chamber to slide horizontally to partition the top space and the bottom space; and an adsorption member disposed in the bottom space of the bottom chamber. The present invention provides optimal fermentation and aging conditions to provide no hangover and no unpleasant burp or odor to suit consumers' preferences.

title_en: Production of xylo-oligosaccharides by a new xylanase from Sporotrichum thermophile
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a xylanase having different properties from known xylanases, and more specifically, to a novel xylanase having excellent stability under a considerably wide ph condition including alkali or neutral conditions, a polynucleotide encoding the same, a vector comprising the polynucleotide, a transformant in which the polynucleotide or the vector is inserted into a host cell, a composition comprising the xylanase, and a method for producing xylooligosaccharide using the same.

title_en: A method of transferring ionic mineral substances to germinated brown rice and a method of manufacturing functional rice products using the
abstract_en: The present patent relates to a method for manufacturing a product having functionality by processing 1 kg of non-glutinous brown rice. First, the rice is washed 3 to 5 times with clean water and soaked in 800 to 900 g of purified water for 8 to 10 hours, and the residual water is removed. Next, 10 to 50 parts by weight of an ion solution selected from Zn, Mg, Ti, Ca, Ge, Se, V, S, Y, Fe, Li, and Si is added, and the rice is germinated in a sprout germination room at 20 to 30℃ for 40 to 50 hours. Then, it is dried in a dryer at 50 to 80℃ for 2 to 3 hours and ground to a particle size of 50 to 100 mesh using a grinder. A product having various functionalities can be manufactured by utilizing the rice powder obtained through such a treatment process. This method contributes to the efficient processing of rice and to the enhancement of nutritional components, providing useful technologies for the food industry.

title_en: Composition of fraxetin for reducing body fat
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for reducing body fat containing fraxetin. The present invention confirms the body fat-reducing effect in a model of obesity induced by type 2 diabetes. Furthermore, by containing fraxetin as an active ingredient, a composition for reducing body fat is prepared that is effective in the prevention and treatment of obesity.

title_en: Method for manufacturing intestine and large intestine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing gipchang. The method includes: a step (s11) of subdividing gipchang; a washing step (s12) of removing foreign substances from the gipchang; a step (s13) of refining the gipchang to remove odors; a step (s14) of rotating the refined fat of the gipchang with a grinder and grinding the same; a step (s15) of refrigerating and storing the ground fat of the gipchang to have viscosity and performing viscosity treatment; a step (s16) of unfolding the entrance of the gipchang and connecting to the outlet of a filler; a step (s17) of putting the viscosity-treated filler of the gipchang fat into the filler and inserting the same into the inside of the gipchang; a step (s18) of separating the gipchang from the filler, tying the other side with a thread, and molding the same manually; and a step (s19) of drying the molded gipchang at a predetermined temperature, storing the same in a freezer, and freezing and storing the same. According to the present invention, by using the method for manufacturing gobdaechang, the unique off-flavor and fishy taste of gobdang and the unpleasant taste generated when eating are removed, and in addition to the elastic skin, the meat quality is softened so that anyone of all ages and sexes can enjoy eating.

title_en: Novel method for micropropagation of Panax ginseng
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing Panax ginseng, Panax ginseng produced by the method, and a method for culturing Panax ginseng in vitro. According to the culture method of the present invention, Panax ginseng without genetic differences can be mass-produced in a short period of time through the generation of somatic embryos using Panax ginseng zygotic embryos, thereby overcoming difficulties in distributing Panax ginseng varieties due to a long breeding cycle and a small seed production amount in the related art and being usefully used to mass-produce Panax ginseng.

title_en: Korean beef aging method using big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for aging korean beef using big data and artificial intelligence. According to the present invention, a method for aging korean beef using big data and artificial intelligence comprises the steps of: registering an original image of korean beef; registering a livestock product history of korean beef; and inputting an age group and an address of a user. by using an artificial intelligence-based analysis model, the method for aging korean beef is determined by matching the original image, the livestock product history, and the age group information with pre-stored information including time, temperature, humidity, wind direction, wavelength, and dry state.

title_en: Chicken ribs sausage, hot dog including the same, and preparing method the same
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for manufacturing a sausage using dak-galbi as an ingredient, and a dak-galbi sausage manufactured thereby. The dak-galbi sausage comprises: raw meat including chicken; dak-galbi sauce; and a casing containing the raw meat and the dak-galbi sauce. The dak-galbi sauce is included in an amount of 10 to 40 parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the raw meat. According to the present invention, a dak-galbi sausage having improved physical properties such as hardness, cohesiveness, gumminess, elasticity, and chewiness, as well as improved sensory properties such as appearance, flavor, tenderness, off-flavor, and overall preference, can be provided.

title_en: Enzyme pretreatment method for manufacturing meat tenderizer and meat tenderizer using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a meat tenderizer for enzyme pretreatment, and the meat tenderizer using the same, and more specifically, to a method for manufacturing the meat tenderizer for enzyme pretreatment, which improves chewing by tenderizing meat quality of meat through a tenderizer containing fruit and vegetable extracts, increases preference with a soft texture, maximizes elution of protease of fruits and vegetables, and at the same time increases elution of antioxidants. To this end, the method comprises the steps of: separating and preparing fruits and vegetables, respectively, and pretreating the prepared fruits and vegetables in a paste form; mixing the pretreated fruit paste and vegetable paste at a weight ratio of 1:1 to obtain a mixed paste; and treating the mixed paste with a fiber-degrading enzyme or a complex enzyme including the same in a single or complex manner.

title_en: Method for manufacturing drinking tea mixed with herbs and medicinal herbs and drinking tea prepared thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a drinking tea in which herbs and medicinal herbs are mixed, and a drinking tea manufactured therefrom, and more specifically, to a method for manufacturing a drinking tea in which herbs and medicinal herbs are mixed, which can help improve body functions such as liver function improvement, waste discharge, and emotional stability by mixing herbs and medicinal herbs, and a drinking tea manufactured therefrom. In addition, the present invention can help improve liver function and physical function by providing drinking tea containing a mixture for improving liver function to consumers. In addition, the present invention provides drinking tea containing a mixture for body toxin discharge to consumers, thereby helping to discharge body toxins such as promoting digestion, promoting body circulation, and hangover relief. In addition, the present invention provides a drinking tea containing an emotion-stabilizing mixture to a consumer, thereby relieving tension and stress and helping a consumer to sleep well.

title_en: Composition for promoting melanin synthesis comprising sedum pachyphyllum extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for promoting melanin production containing an extract of Eunyeosim, wherein the composition promotes melanin synthesis by enhancing the expression and activity of CREB1, MITF and tyrosinase genes, which are melanin synthesis factors, and thus can be used for the prevention, improvement or treatment of depigmentation diseases caused by insufficient melanin synthesis.

title_en: Composition for improving liver health comprising gallocatechin gallate and isoquercitrin
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present specification is a composition for improving liver health. In one aspect, the composition of the present invention includes a complex component of gallocatechin gallate and isoquercitrin to effectively reduce oxidative stress and chronic inflammatory responses generated during the accumulation of lipids in liver tissues, thereby improving liver health and being able to be used for preventing, alleviating or treating various liver diseases such as hepatitis, liver cirrhosis, and liver cancer.

title_en: Preparation of pepper paste powder
abstract_en: The present invention, in a powdered red pepper paste manufacturing method manufactured with red pepper paste, relates to the powdered red pepper paste manufacturing method comprising: a pulverization step of pulverizing by spray-drying after mixing red pepper paste and dextrin in water; a granulating step of adding ethanol to the pulverized red pepper paste and granulating with alcohol granules; and a drying step of drying the granulated red pepper paste at 35-45℃ for 5-6 hours.

title_en: A Bugak manufacturing method using juju natural materials
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing Bugak (traditional deep-fried vegetable chips). Specifically, the method involves basic steps of "cutting-drying-aging-frying," where an aging process prior to frying enhances the characteristic appearance and crispy texture of Bugak during the frying process. In particular, during the manufacture of potato Bugak and shiitake mushroom Bugak, natural raw materials from Jeju, which can compensate for the disadvantages of potatoes or shiitake mushrooms, are added as functional additives. This provides a method for manufacturing Bugak using Jeju natural raw materials that can increase the functionality of potato Bugak and shiitake mushroom Bugak in addition to providing the unique appearance and crispy texture.

title_en: Method for producing cheonggukjang composition containing turmeric powder
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fast-fermented bean paste composition manufacturing method comprising turmeric powder comprising turmeric powder used as a medicinal ingredient, comprising: an ingredient preparation step of preparing a mixture by mixing washed turmeric with grains comprising at least any one among glutinous barley, soil barley, mung beans, and rice buds; a turmeric fermentation step of manufacturing fermented turmeric by adding and fermenting fermenting-bacteria to the mixture; a drying step of drying the turmeric fermented in the reinforced fermentation step; a grinding step of manufacturing turmeric powder by grinding the turmeric dried in the drying step; a blending step of blending a fast-fermented bean paste mixture by mixing small black soybeans and lactic acid bacteria with the turmeric powder ground in the grinding step; a fast-fermented bean paste manufacturing step of manufacturing fast-fermented bean paste by fermenting the fast-fermented bean paste mixture blended in the blending step; and a fast-fermented bean paste powder manufacturing step of grinding after drying the fast-fermented bean paste manufactured in the fast-fermented bean paste manufacturing step.

title_en: Hypoglycemic Composition Comprising Liriope platyphylla Extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition containing a liriope muscari extract and having effects of lowering blood sugar, improving blood flow, and preventing brain damage, wherein the lowering of blood sugar lowers blood sugar rise caused by cerebrovascular diseases.

title_en: Composition for improving male sexual function through inhibitory activity of phosphodiesterase 5 containing extracts of Asparagus cochinchinensis (Lour.) Merr as active ingredients
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for improving male sexual function through inhibitory activity of phosphodiesterase 5 comprising an astronomical cordyceps extract as an active ingredient. The composition for improving male sexual function through the inhibitory activity of phosphodiesterase (pde) 5 of the present invention comprises an astronomical cordyceps extract as an active ingredient. In the present invention, the asparagus cochinchinensis extract used as an active ingredient exhibiting inhibitory activity on pde5 exhibits inhibitory effects on pde5 and pde9 in a concentration-dependent manner. In addition, cell proliferation is inhibited in prostate stromal cell lines, gene expression of igfbp3, collagen1, collagen3a, and α-sma increased by gf-β is inhibited, and cell proliferation-related protein expression is also inhibited. Therefore, the composition for improving male sexual function of the present invention comprising an astronomical cordyceps extract as an active ingredient can be used as a novel functional material which is a natural material with few side effects and exhibits excellent pde5 inhibitory activity.

title_en: Use for preventing, improving or treating diseases related to reduced muscle containing indigestible maltodextrin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising indigestible maltodextrin for preventing, alleviating or treating muscle reduction-related diseases.

title_en: Manufacturing methiod of sweetner treated ginseng
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of sweetener-added fresh ginseng capable of exhibiting excellent sweetness while minimizing damage to fresh ginseng by containing a sugar component having a lower absorption rate into a body compared to sugar, thereby improving health promotion effects and consumer preferences.

title_en: Composition for preventing or treating liver disease comprising Callicarpa dichotoma (Lour.) K. Koch leaf extract as an active ingredient
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for the prevention or treatment of liver disease comprising a leaf extract of *Sargassum fusiformis* as an active ingredient. Specifically, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity in Kupffer cells and can treat and improve liver disease caused by liver fibrosis by directly inhibiting fibrosis through a reduction in the expression levels of α-SMA and phosphorylated Smad2/3 in hepatic stellate cells induced by TGF-β.

title_en: Plant-based fat spread containing coconut oil and method of manufacturing it
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vegetable fat spread containing coconut oil and a manufacturing method thereof. According to the present invention, the vegetable fat spread containing the coconut oil manufactured by using the method for manufacturing the fat spread has an effect of giving a cool feeling by being rapidly dissolved in the mouth, and has excellent physical properties such as having excellent spreadability.

title_en: Natural excipient and method for making same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a natural excipient composition capable of contributing to the promotion of public health by not adding chemical excipients such as silicon dioxide, magnesium stearate, and the like, which are commonly used in the manufacture of pharmaceuticals or functional foods, and a method for manufacturing the same. By adding seaweed powder, korean wheat, sweet potato starch, corn starch, and whole wheat powder, which are vegetable raw materials, it is an excellent invention that can contribute to a safe and safe and safe pharmaceutical composition or health functional food industry.

title_en: A package of a frozen rice food and a frozen cookery that could fit inside a microwave oven-allowable container, and its application
abstract_en: As a method for converting various Asian foods into fast food, a rice food such as cooked rice or rice cake is frozen, and a dish to be eaten with the rice food is also frozen, so that the frozen rice food and the frozen dish are sold as a package of frozen food, wherein sizes and shapes of the frozen rice food and the frozen dish are determined so that the package can be contained as it is in a container usable inside a microwave oven, and a restaurant franchise and a plurality of food manufacturers providing dozens or more of dishes may form a consortium to serve various menus worldwide at a low price.

title_en: Functional mixed oil containing pine nut oil
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a functional mixed oil comprising: (a) pine nut oil; and (b) at least one selected from the group consisting of perilla oil and hemp seed oil, and to a manufacturing method of the functional mixed oil.
