The functional mixed oil comprising (a) pine nut oil and (b) at least one selected from the group consisting of perilla oil and hemp seed oil of the present invention has a nutritionally recommended appropriate composition ratio of omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, and thus can be usefully utilized as a new health functional edible oil and fat.

title_en: Manufacturing method of bread using sugar-resistant yeast
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a banh mi baguette frozen dough using yeast with excellent sugar tolerance and, more specifically, to a method for manufacturing a banh mi baguette frozen dough using a Saccharomyces cerevisiae FRUITFLY strain (accession number KCTC 15094BP) which maintains fermentation power in high sugar dough.

title_en: Mixed herbal medicine extract on antioxidation and preadipocyte differentiation inhibition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a herbal mixture for antioxidant activity and inhibition of adipocyte differentiation and a manufacturing method thereof, and specifically, relates to the herbal mixture configured to exhibit an antioxidant effect and a preadipocyte differentiation prevention effect by mixing herbal extracts obtained from Cornus officinalis, Kalopanax septemlobus, Astragalus membranaceus, Phellinus linteus, Glycyrrhiza uralensis, and Cnidium officinale; and the manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: Composition improving, preventing or treating allergic asthma comprising Lactobacillus reuteri EFEL6901
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for improving, preventing or treating allergic asthma comprising Lactobacillus reuteri EFEL6901 (KACC 81105BP) as an active ingredient. The composition comprising the Lactobacillus reuteri EFEL6901 (KACC 81105BP) strain as an active ingredient can exhibit effects of improving, preventing or treating allergic asthma.

title_en: Premix capable of improving fat digestion and absorption and growth performance of weaned piglets
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a premix capable of improving fat digestion and absorption and growth performance of weaned piglets, including the following components in weight percent: 60-75% of protein type substance, 1-2% of complex enzyme, 0.3-1% of complex mineral, 0.3-1% of complex vitamin, 2-7.5% of inorganic composition, 7-10% of cane sugar, 0.3-1% of tributyrin, 0.5-1% of formic acid, 0.8-1.3% of antioxidant, 1500-2000 mg/kg of choline or/and 2000-3000 mg/kg of bile acid, 5-7% of yeast extract, and 6-9% of wheat shorts. When mixed with corn-soybean meal in a proportion of 10-30%, the premix provided by the present invention can significantly improve fat digestion and absorption of weaned piglets, improve growth performance, save energy feedstuff and increase energy utilization rate. Furthermore the premix is simple in preparation, and is suitable for large-scale use.

title_en: Preparation method of preserved grass carp with pomelo aroma and honey flavour
abstract_en: The disclosure discloses a preserved grass carp with pomelo aroma and honey flavour and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method includes the following steps: (1) slaughtering fresh and live grass carps; removing impurities; removing bones; and slicing the obtained fish flesh; (2) salting the fish flesh with salt, sodium bicarbonate and lemon juice for a short time to remove fishy taste; (3) conducting primary salting and seasoning with spices; (4) preparing salting liquid with tea leaves and pomelo peel; and conducting secondary salting and seasoning by artery pumping; (5) drying the salted fish flesh in a hot air drier; (6) taking out the dried fish flesh; and coating a honey layer; (7) spreading white sesame seeds outside the honey layer; and baking the fish flesh in an oven; (8) drying the baked preserved fish in the hot air drier at a medium temperature; and (9) cooling the dried preserved fish to a room temperature; and performing vacuum packing. The preserved fish product prepared in the disclosure has excellent aroma and taste, is golden yellow in colour, obvious in pomelo aroma and moderate in sweetness, and well eliminates the fishy taste of the fish flesh.

title_en: Liver-clearing and eyesight-improving blueberry wine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a liver-clearing and eyesight-improving blueberry wine, and relates to the technical field of health-care medicinal wine. The liver-clearing and eyesight-improving blueberry wine includes the following raw materials in parts by weight: 8-12g of Lonicera japonica, 8-12g of Dendranthema Morifolium, 180-220g of Vaccinium spp., 8-12g of Lycium chinene Mill., 1-2 of Daucus carota L. var. sativa Hoffm., 3-7g of Panax Notoginseng (Burk.), 4-6 of Apis cerana Fabricius and 4-7g of Panax ginseng C. A. Mey slices. A taste of the liver-clearing and eyesight-improving wine is adjusted by Dendranthema Morifolium, Vaccinium spp. and Apis cerana Fabricius, so as to improve a drinking effect; Lonicera japonica has effects of heat clearing and detoxifying, and inflammation diminishing and bacteria resistance, and can be used for clearing liver and improving eyesight, and clearing away heat and detoxifying; and Vaccinium spp., rich in anthocyanins and vitamin C, has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.

title_en: Method for Improving Hybrid Seed Setting Rate of Double Clone Tea Plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving hybrid seed setting rate of double clone tea plants, includes following steps: (1) spraying abscisic acid (ABA); (2) temperature raising and moisture removal; (3) overall fertilization; (4) moisture raising to promote flowering; (5) ring-binding to promote flowering; (6) collecting and preserving male pollen; (7) pollinating artificially; (8) promoting differentiation. The invention belongs to the technical field of hybrid breeding of tea plants, in particular to a method for improving hybrid seed setting rate of double clone tea plants with more efficient fertilizer absorption, more flowers, high cultivation success rate and high seed setting probability.

title_en: Edible cherry preservative based on natural extract and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of fruit preservation, and specifically discloses an edible cherry preservative based on natural extracts and a preparation method thereof. The edible cherry preservative includes the following ingredients in proportion: 5%-15% of lavender oil, 20%-30% of chitosan, 0.1%-1% of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and 63.9%-74.9% of water. In the present invention, the lavender oil, the chitosan, the superoxide dismutase (SOD) and the water are selected as main components of the preservative, so as to achieve a synergistic effect of various natural extracts in preservation of cherries. The lavender oil has antibacterial and antioxidant properties, which can prolong the preservation period of cherries, the chitosan can form a protective film, which reduces water loss and prevents microbial invasion, and the SOD can effectively scavenge free radicals and protect cherry cells from oxidative damage.

title_en: Process for producing and purifying a biosurfactant from salibacterium sp and its application as emulgent in systems with high salinity, temperature, and ph.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for obtaining a novel natural biosurfactant of microbial origin and low molecular weight, soluble in water, of the lipopeptide type and its application for emulsifying activity in systems with high salt content, a wide range of pH, and temperature. Also, it relates to the microorganism for obtaining lipopeptide-type biosurfactant (Salibacterium sp 4CTb) and to the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic products or compositions that use said polysaccharide and microorganism.

title_en: Antipathogenic compositions and methods thereof.
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are compositions, devices and methods for inactivating viruses, bacteria, and fungi. The compositions, methods, and devices may include coatings or slurries such as silicon nitride powder coatings or slurries for the inactivation of viruses, bacteria, and/or fungi.

title_en: Animal feed compositions and uses thereof.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to animal feed compositions comprising polypeptides having muramidase activity and carotenoids and uses thereof.

title_en: Functional corn and chickpea tortilla with high nutritional and nutraceutical value.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to obtaining functional tortillas with a high protein and dietary fiber content, higher essential amino acid content values, in vitro protein digestibility, calculated protein efficiency ratio, and better nutraceutical properties than tortillas made with 100% nixtamalized corn flour. Also, it characterizes by adding extruded chickpea flour to the nixtamalized corn flour, improving nutritional and nutraceutical properties (antihypertensive and hypoglycemic potential) compared to traditional corn tortillas. Further, it proposes the optimal extrusion conditions to produce optimized extruded whole chickpea flour (HGIEO) with high antioxidant activity (AAox), total phenolic compounds (CFT), and in vitro protein digestibility (DPIV) to prepare a mixture of 70% flour of commercial nixtamalized corn (HMNC)+ 30% HGIEO suitable for making a functional tortilla for older adults (TFAM) with high protein quality, AoxA, and acceptability (A).

title_en: Polypeptides having phytase activity.
abstract_en: The present invention discloses novel phytases that have improved phytase activity, compositions comprising them, recombinant host cells suitable for their production, and their use in feed applications.

title_en: Diet formulations for ruminants.
abstract_en: Methods for formulating an adjusted diet and/or a dietary supplement for a ruminant are disclosed. The adjusted diet and/or dietary supplement are formulated to mitigate an amino acid deficiency of the ruminant's unaltered diet and provide the ruminant with an amino acid-balanced diet. Methods of administering the adjusted diet and/or dietary supplement also are disclosed.

title_en: Dietary butyrate and its uses.
abstract_en: 1. Use of a compound having the formula (1), formula (2), formula (3) or formula (4), or combinations thereof, for promoting and/or accelerating myelination, wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 and R6 are independently a long chain fatty acid having between 16 and 20 carbons.

title_en: Chocolate composition.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a chocolate composition comprising at least 30 weight% of cocoa solids and less than 2 weight% of milk solids, based on the total weight of the chocolate composition, characterized in that it further comprises 0.5-15 weight% plant-based protein and 0.5-10 weight% of a plasticizer ingredient, wherein the chocolate composition is substantially free from soy protein.

title_en: Process for preparing a prize for pets based on tenebrio molitor insects.
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a process for making biscuits for pets using insects of the Tenebrionidae family (Tenebrio molitor) integrated into a formula with 15-25% soy and wheat flour with egg as an adherent and additives, such as salt and saturated fats to obtain a treat for pets in the form of a cookie that has a size between three and five centimeters in diameter with 10-30% of dark insects incorporated into the total constituents of the treat, evaluated through tests palatability in pets.

title_en: Sialyltransferases for the production of 6'-sialyllactose.
abstract_en: Disclosed are enzymes, compositions, genetically engineered cells and methods for the fermentative production of 6'-sialyllactose.

title_en: Uses of bifidobacterium longum transitional microorganism.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to use of a B.longum transitional microorganism that has a preferential utilization of 3-FL over 2'FL. It also relates to methods and to a composition comprising the B.longum transitional microorganism and uses thereof.

title_en: Device and method for the production of wort.
abstract_en: The invention relates to an impact mill (1) provided with water injectors (8, 9), in particular for grinding green malt. The impact elements can be hammers (6) and/or knives (7). The invention also relates to a method for producing a wort from green malt or any other germinated cereal which simultaneously undergoes grinding and mashing operations.

title_en: Method and device for increasing nutraceutical content in vegetables
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for increasing the nutraceutical content in vegetables commonly consumed by the human being, as well as a specially designed device for carrying out said method. More specifically, the present invention discloses a method focused on increasing the antioxidant content of different vegetables through UVB radiation-based stimulation.

title_en: Lower calorie baked products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to baked products having an energy content of no more than 1670KJ per 100g, the product comprising: 1.0 to 20g per 100g total dietary fibre; at least 16g per 100g total fat; 0.05 to 4.00g per 100g of one or more caloric sugars; 5 to 33g per 100g of one or more sugar alcohols; no more than 12g per 100g of one or more carbohydrates having an energy content of below 0.5 kcal/gram; and 0.1 to 16 wt.% of total moisture by weight of the baked product; wherein a combined total theoretical heat of solution of the one or more sugar alcohols and/or the one or more carbohydrates having energy content below 0.5 kcal/gram is not lower than -6 j/g.

title_en: Culture media based on protein hydrolysate and a process for preparing thereof
abstract_en: of the Disclosure The invention relates to culture media suitable for cell cultivation, and the processes for preparation thereof. The culture media may be prepared essentially by dissolving or mixing the individual media components in water or in a suitable aqueous buffer. The important step of media preparation is the step of sterilization. The culture media according to present invention may comprise protein hydrolysate as amino acids source. The advantageous process of protein hydrolysis into shorter peptide chains and/or single amino acids is also provided by the present invention.

title_en: Process for manufacturing lysed cell suspension
abstract_en: The invention pertains to a process for manufacturing a lysed cell in oil suspension with a solids content of at least 10 wt.% and a particle size Dv90 of 100 to 300 microns, comprising the steps of a) adding a first portion of microbial cell matter to an oil, b) subjecting the mixture of microbial cell matter and oil to one or more shear steps to effect lysis of at least part of the cells and produce a suspension comprising lysed cells in oil, c) adding a further portion of microbial cell matter to the suspension comprising lysed cells in oil, d) subjecting the mixture of microbial cell matter and the suspension comprising lysed cells in oil to one or more shear steps to effect lysis of at least part of the cells and produce a further suspension comprising lysed cells in oil. In one embodiment, the microbial cell matter has a water content of less than 10 wt.%. The invention pertains to a new lysed cell in oil suspension having a solids content of at least 10 wt.% and a particle size Dv90 value of 100 to 300 microns. The lysed cell in oil suspension produced by the present method generally has at least 70%, at least 75%, at least 80%, at least 85%, at least 90%, at least 95%, or at least 98% cell lysis. The invention pertains to a composition comprising the lysed cell in oil suspension and one or more components useful in a feed. The invention also pertains to a feed product comprising the composition, to a method for manufacture of a feed product, to a method of raising an animal comprising feeding an animal the feed product and to a method of sustainably producing a meat product by feeding an animal the feed product.

title_en: Process for the production of sugars from biomass
abstract_en: Process for the production of sugars from biomass including at least one polysaccharide which comprises putting a biomass in contact with an aqueous solution of at least one organic acid having from 1 to 6 carbon atoms, preferably from 1 to 3 carbon atoms, the pH of said aqueous solution being ranging from 0.6 to 1.6, preferably ranging from 0.9 to 1.3. The sugars thus obtained can be advantageously used as carbon sources in fermentation processes for the production of alcohols (e.g., ethanol, butanol), diols (e.g., 1,3-propanediol, 1,3-butanediol, 1,4-butanediol, 2,3-butanediol), lipids, or other intermediates or products. Said alcohols, diols, lipids, or other intermediates or products, can be advantageously used in the chemical industry or in the formulation of fuels for motor vehicles. Said alcohols and said diols can also be advantageously used in the bio-butadiene production.

title_en: Age-tailored nutritional compositions with a varying protein content
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an age-tailored nutritional composition system comprising at least one nutritional composition A that is administered to an infant from birth and until 3-6 months of life of said infant, at least one nutritional composition B that is administered to an infant from 3-6 months and until 1 year of life of said infant, at least one nutritional composition C that is administered after the first year of life of the young child, and wherein the amount of protein of the different nutritional compositions A, B, C decreases with the sequence of administration. The present invention furthermore relates to the uses of said nutritional composition system.

title_en: Antiviral and antibacteria agents based on quaternary ammonium compound complexed with boric acid and its derivatives
abstract_en: The present document describes compounds resulting from the complexation of quaternary ammonium compounds with boric acid and/or its derivatives, and methods of making the same, and methods of using the same for the treatment of pathogenic infections.

title_en: Pet food compositions
abstract_en: Described herein are pet food compositions comprising a blood glucose management component comprising soy isoflavone and yeast beta-glucan (Î²-glucan); along with methods of making and using same.

title_en: Sodium contrast for reducing sodium content
abstract_en: The invention allows for the production of a savory food product with reduced sodium content. The savory food product is formed from a mixture of cooked food pieces selected from a first portion and a second portion at a predetermined application ratio. The first portion of food pieces is salted a first salt intensity and the second portion of food pieces is salted at a second salt intensity. Preferably, the first and the second salt intensities have an application amplitude of at least 20% so that sodium content can be reduced without sacrificing the perceived saltiness of the savory food product.

title_en: Methods for improving agricultural production of fowl by administration of microbial consortia or purified strains thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to isolated microorganisms-including novel strains of the microorganisms-microbial consortia, and compositions comprising the same. Furthermore, the disclosure teaches methods of utilizing the described microorganisms, microbial consortia, and compositions comprising the same, in methods for modulating the production of poultry, disease resistance, and egg yield. In particular aspects, the disclosure provides methods of increasing feed efficiency, and methods of preventing colonization of pathogenic microbes.

title_en: Odorant secondary alcohols and their compositions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to new classes of odorous alcohols (odorants) derived from 2,3- dimethylbutene which are useful as fragrance or flavor materials in particular in providing natural piney olfactory notes with a complex profile to perfume, aroma or deodorizing/masking compositions.

title_en: Clonal propagation of coconut tree
abstract_en: In general present invention concerns a method of clonal multiplication of coconuts via proliferating meristems. More particularly, the invention concerns clonal propagation of Cocos species that does not make use of a callus phase but coconut plantlets originating from zygotic embryos derived from mature coconuts whereby the coconut plantlets are trimmed resulting in a disc (stem) containing the meristem. In a particular embodiment this disc is then longitudinally divided into 2 pieces that are almost equal for proliferation in a medium, for instance a Y3 medium, that comprises either a 1,2,3-Thiadiazole urea derivatives, for instance 1-fenyl-3-(1,2,3-thiadiazol-5-yl)ureum (CAS-nummer 51707-55-2 and also called Thidiazuron) or a phenylurea derivative, for instance 1-fenyl-3-(1,2,3-thiadiazol-5-yl)ureum (CAS-number 51707-55-2 and also called Thidiazuron) or 1-(2-chloropyridin-4-yl)-3-phenylurea (CAS-number 68157-60-8 and also called 4-CPPU).

title_en: Methods for induction of endogenous tandem duplication events
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods of deliberately increasing a rare endogenous genome modification called tandem duplication events in the cells of an organism. The invention also provides methods for identifying and/or selecting a cell with a trait of interest that is the result of such tandem duplication events. Methods for screening a population of cells and identifying and/or selecting a cell with a desired trait are also provided herein. A population of plant cells, plant parts or plants obtained by the methods described herein are also provided.

title_en: Improved method for preparation of protein-enriched products from plant material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparation of protein-enriched products, such as plant protein isolates or protein-fibre formulations, from plant materials such as oilseeds, as well as to the uses of the products obtainable via said process in human food and/or animal feed. In particular, the presented herein processes advantageously make use of solvents based on low-boiling azeotropic mixtures made of an apolar and lipophilic organic ester having up to 5 carbon atoms, With an alcohol having up to 5 carbon atoms, which solvents not only make the need to use noxious hexane-based solvents obsolete, but also can undergo reutilisation cycles by being easily obtainable and recoverable from spent solvents and/or mother liquors as used in the presented herein processes, and consequently render the disclosed processes extremely energy-efficient, suitable for large-scale industrial production, as well as eco-friendly.

title_en: Storage and delivery system
abstract_en: Provided is a storage and delivery system that includes a container containing a stable liquid composition therein for increasing the viscosity of an aqueous liquid or aqueous liquid solid mixture foodstuff and having a viscosity of less than 3000 cP and a water activity of greater than 95%, wherein the composition comprises one or more thickening agents and one or more polysaccharides, and a pump dispenser sealingly attached to the container and having a valve for inhibiting or preventing drying of the composition in the container. Further provided is a method of delivering a stable liquid composition to an aqueous liquid or aqueous liquid solid mixture foodstuff by use of the storage and delivery system. A method for increasing the viscosity of an aqueous liquid or aqueous liquid solid mixture foodstuff by adding the stable liquid composition thereto is also provided.

title_en: Effervescent beverage having improved quality of taste exhibited by sugar and sweetener
abstract_en: The present invention pertains to a effervescent beverage having improved taste qualities of a sugar and a sweetener and a method for manufacturing the effervescent beverage.

title_en: Composition for inhibiting hmf production comprising allulose disaccharide
abstract_en: The present application relates to a novel use of an allulose disaccharide for suppressing hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) generation and preventing browning.

title_en: Strains of agrobacterium modified to increase plant transformation frequency
abstract_en: Agrobacterium strains that harbor transformation-enhancing genes on a plasmid capable of replication independently of the Agrobacterium chromosome, the Ti plasmid, and plant transformation binary vectors, and uses for these Agrobacterium strains are provided. Additionally, Agrobacterium strains that are deficient in DNA recombination functions that result in instability or rearrangement of plant transformation binary vectors, and that harbor transformation-enhancing genes on a plasmid capable of replication independently of the Agrobacterium chromosome, the Ti plasmid, and plant transformation binary vectors, and uses for these strains, are also provided. Further included are Agrobacterium strains that harbor transformation-enhancing genes integrated into the Agrobacterium chromosome at a locus that does not interfere with or otherwise compromise the normal growth and plant transformation ability of the Agrobacterium cells, and uses for these Agrobacterium strains. Plants made using these Agrobacterium strains are also described.

title_en: Compositions for use in improving stool consistency or frequency in infants or young children
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nutritional composition comprising at least one fucosylated oligosaccharide for use in preventing and/or treating constipation and/or in improving stool consistency/frequency in an infant or a young child.

title_en: Antidiabetic herbal tea
abstract_en: An antidiabetic seaweed tea comprising of 100 pcnt (by weight) dry extract of Caulerpa racemosa and Ulva lactuca

title_en: Composition comprising mannose oligosaccharide and process for making same and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising mannose oligosaccharide and a process for making such. The present invention further relates to a composition comprising mannose oligosaccharide for use in the treatment of a human or animal.

title_en: BLACK RICE â ARROWROOT WINE AND THE PROCESS IN MAKING THEREOF
abstract_en: This present invention generally relates to a beverage but more particularly to a wine product comprising primarily of black rice and arrowroot and the process of making thereof. It consists of organic glutinous black rice, arrowroot flour, yeast, sugar and water together with the uses thereof. Based on the study conducted the current technology has moderate alcohol content and low acidity that made the respondents extremely liked it. In terms of sensory properties such as color, aroma and taste, scores ranged from very much to extremely liked in the hedonic scale. Furthermore, this product could be a potential income-generating project (IGP) in the community which also promotes camaraderie among friends and new acquaintances.

title_en: Improving the sensory quality profile of plant protein based compositions
abstract_en: The invention relates generally to the field of improving the sensory quality profile of plant protein based compositions. In particular, the invention relates to the removal of undesired plant-like aroma and astringent / bitter taste from plant protein based compositions. For example, the invention relates to a process for improving the sensory quality of a plant protein containing composition comprising the steps of bringing the plant protein containing composition in contact with a food grade oily composition, and removing the oily phase from the plant protein containing composition.

title_en: Tissue culture method use in producing chayote planting materials
abstract_en: This present utility model relates to produce clean planting materials but more particularly to a process of producing good quality chayote planting materials which comprises the steps of: a.preparing culture media; b.collecting flashes from chayote vine pacing in a jar with distilled water; c.washing said flashes with detergent soap and distilled water; d.soaking washed flashes with soap and tap water for 15 minutes; e.sterilizing soaked seeds and runner tips with 10% sodium hypochlorite with 2-3 drops of surfactant for 30 minutes; f.washing sterilized seeds and runner tips with sterilized distilled water for three; g.cutting off flashes and remove outer leaves, leaving two or three leaf primordia with the meristem; h.inoculating said culture in a Modified Murashige and Skoog medium with Benzyl Amino Purine and Gibberellic Acid having 40 grams of sucrose and 6 g/l agar; i.subdividing shoots into a single node and transferring into a multiplication medium from step (a); j.elongating of plantlets by transferring the culture to rooting stage; k.transferring rooted plants to a greenhouse; l. washing plantlets with tap water; m.soaking plantlets in commercial fungicide for five minutes; n.transplanting soaked plantlets in individual plastic bags containing growing media consisting of mountain sand, burned rice hull, and alnus compost; o.maintaining the plantlets inside the greenhouse and watering once a day until ready to plant in the plantation

title_en: CONCENTRATE FROM MEAT OF CAGAYCAY (Venerupis philippinarium)
abstract_en: The present utility model is related to the preparation of a food concentrate from cagaycay (Venerupis philippinarium) shellfish and the product obtainable therefrom, which is a concentrate from meat extract of said cagaycay shell fish that was obtained from 50% of the boiled broth.

title_en: GARLIC-FLAVORED VACUUM-FRIED UNDULATED SURF CLAMS (Paphia undulata)
abstract_en: This utility model disclosed a garlic-flavored vacuum-fried undulated surf clams (Paphia undulata) as a food protein source and as a snack food. An undulated surf clams (Paphia undula) processed using the vacuum frying method.

title_en: A Composition for Dietary Supplement
abstract_en: The present invention relates to medicinal preparations of undetermined constitution containing material from plants and traditional herbal medicines. More particularly, the present invention relates to a composition for dietary supplement in capsule, tablet and syrup form and consumed as dietary supplement. A composition for dietary supplement comprising an amount of Ashitaba (Angelica keiskei); an amount of Garlic (Allium sativum); an amount of Turmeric (Curcuma longa); an amount of Horseradish Tree leaves (Moringa oleifera); an amount of Neem (Azadirachta indica); an amount of Makabuhay (Tinospora cordifolia) ; an amount of Soursop (Annona muricata); an amount of Sodium Ascorbate; an amount of Thiamine (B1); an amount of Pyridoxine (B6); an amount of Methylcolabamine; and an amount of piperine.

title_en: Lubas (spondias pinnata) wine
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to the composition of fruit wine from lubas fruit. The composition comprising of 42.06% lubas fruit extract, 42.06% water, 15.77%, sugar, and .11% yeast. Through this utility model, lubas fruit is tapped as a local raw ingredient in wine making. Lubas wine making involves preparation of ingredients including selection of fruit, cleaning and cutting of fruits, blending and extraction of fruits, cooking of the mixture, cooling of the cooked mixture, inoculating of the yeast, fermenting, and racking/aging/clarifying.

title_en: Formulation of baked breadfruit rice cake
abstract_en: The present utility model discloses the formulation of rice cakes merging it with steamed breadfruit meat. Rice cakes are made in many cultures and have a wide range of processing and produce characteristics. The Filipino rice cake is consumed daily as a breakfast, dessert or snack food (Arendt and Zannini, 2013). On the other hand, Breadfruit (Artocarpus altilis, Fosb.) of the family Moraceae is a seasonal tropical fruit tree that is undervalued and underutilized fruit in the Philippines. When in season, this tree produces plenty of fruits that are just wasted and left to rot. Some people uses it for food by steaming it and adding coconut milk and sugar. There is a need to explore on fruit utilization methods and other processing techniques to improve the value of this very prolific crop. Incorporating the two will help us formulate a more nutritious food. Utilizing this commodity into another way of preparation and presentation is therefore, a welcome development.

title_en: Composition of caramelized roasted cacao nibs
abstract_en: This utility model discloses a composition of caramelized cacao nibs comprising the following: Cacao nibs 800 grams, Water 100 grams, Brown sugar 165 grams, Vanilla 5 grams, Salt 3 grams, Melted butter 10 grams.

title_en: Shelf-stable food bar
abstract_en: A shelf-stable food bar is disclosed, comprising roasted peanut, roasted pumpkin seeds, oats, extruded corn flour, dried green mango, dried pineapple, raisins, salt, and a carbohydrate-based syrup. The shelf-stable food bar better retains its sensory acceptability, color, moisture content, protein content, and microbiological control even after long periods of storage without need for additional preservatives.

title_en: Process of Producing String Beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) Leaf and Ternate (Clitoria ternatea) Flower Tea
abstract_en: Disclose is the utility model for a process of producing string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) leaf and ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flower tea, comprising the steps: collecting fresh leaves of string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) and fresh ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flowers, cleaning the collected string beans (Vigna unguiculata) and fresh ternate (Clitoria ternatea subsp. Sesquipedalis) flowers with clear, clean water, separating the cleaned string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) leaves from cleaned ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flowers and storing on separate screened container, drying the string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) leaves and cleaned ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flowers under the sunlight for one to two days until the color turned brownish, collecting and powdering the dried string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) leaves and ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flowers and mixing and securing the powders in a small tea bag with a composition of: 50 pcnt powdered string beans (Vigna unguiculata subsp. Sesquipedalis) leaves and 50 pcnt powdered ternate (Clitoria ternatea) flowers.

title_en: Process of producing coconut-ginger refreshing drink
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a process of producing coconut-ginger refreshing drink which includes the following steps: dilution of powdered coconut powder and ginger either in iced or warm water, the addition of honey extract to neutralize the taste of the mixture, addition of a thin slice of lemon to balance the minty taste of the ginger. The coco-ginger refreshing drinks are composed of 1tbsp (15 ml) ginger powder, 2tbsp (30 ml) coconut water powder,1tbsp (15 ml) Honey syrup,1thin slice of Lemon, and 350 ml water.

title_en: FORMULATION OF NEW COCOYAM (Xanthosoma sagittifolium (L) Schott) CAKE ROLL
abstract_en: The present utility model discloses the formulation of producing New Cocoyam cake roll. Cake rolls are a type of rolled sponge cakes filled with cream, jam, icing, or other fillings, which is usually sugar and margarine. On the other hand, New Cocoyam also known as "Bisol", "Karlang" or "Takudo" in Eastern Visayas is a fast-growing crop that is widely cultivated because of its economic value. It can produce up to 10 or more corms filled with vitamins and minerals, carbohydrates, fiber and starch. Incorporating "bisol" in making cake rolls is a welcome development which introduced versatility of new cocoyam as an ingredient in making bakery products. This development also offers nutritious treat to consumers.

title_en: Protein-vitamin-mineral forage mixture for feeding pigs in the growing-fattening stage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pelletized protein-vitamin-mineral forage mixture, prepared by combining, in various proportions, proteins, vitamins and minerals ingredients, the mixture being meant to be used in the process of growing and fattening pigs, and to a proteinaceous-fibrous product PPF included in the mixture. According to the invention, the forage mixture is in the form of yellow-greenish pellets with a size of 6 mm and consists of 27...29% PPF, 27...40% soya grits, 11...14% sunflower grits, 6...9% extruded linen, 4...4.7% calcium carbonate, 0.6% salt, 0.5...0.55% L-lysine, 0.06...0.08% DL-methionine, 0.28 choline premix, 0.02...0.03% phytase and 2.8% vitamin - mineral premix, the forage mixture providing 2594 Kcal/Kg metabolisable energy, 29.55% raw protein, 2.13% crude lysine, 1.84% digestible lysine, 0.95% raw methionine and cystine, 0.79% digestible methionine and cystine, 2.2% calcium, 0.58% total phosphorus, 0.09% available phosphorus and 12.3% raw cellulose, the forage mixture ensuring the increase of digestibility and nitrogen retention by 4.61% and 16.27%, respectively, the decrease of nitrogen excreted in manure by 15.82% and reduces the ammonia emissions released into the atmosphere.

title_en: Vegetable paste composition made of pea and hemp protein powder and process for preparing the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a food product as spreadable vegetable paste meant for vegetable preserves industry. According to the invention, the product consists of 61.5% pea puree, 10.3% boiled carrots, 8.5% ripe red pepper, 3% onion, 6.1% hemp protein powder, 3.7% lemon juice, 3.7% vegetable oil, 1% salt, 2% garlic as powder, 0.2% coriander, the percentage being expressed by mass.

title_en: Potato selection material selection method
abstract_en:
FIELD: agriculture. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agriculture, in particular to selection of potatoes, and can be used for selection of source material on the basis of darkening of pulp of tuber. Proposed method comprises assessment of potato tuberous club flesh browning on 9-point scale six hours after specimen maintenance in 6% water solution of table salt. 
     EFFECT: technical result is shorter time for assessment of sample samples on the basis of darkening of raw pulp. 
     1 cl, 1 ex, 1 tbl

title_en: Method for producing a probiotic supplement for poultry
abstract_en:
FIELD: agriculture. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to biotechnology and agriculture, specifically to a method for producing a probiotic supplement based on lactic acid bacteria for feeding poultry. The method for producing a probiotic supplement for poultry involves introduction of a Lactobacillus parabuchneri strain B-13061 into a nutrient medium containing feed molasses, K 2 HPO 4 , a yeast extract, powdered apple pectin and distilled water in predetermined amounts, in an amount with a titer of at least 1.0x10 5  CFU/ml and cultivating at a temperature of 37.0°C for 24 hours resulting in a probiotic supplement. 
     EFFECT: invention provides a possibility to increase the live weight of quails. 
     1 cl, 6 tbl, 2 ex

title_en: New peptide
abstract_en:
FIELD: medicine. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a new peptide for promoting regeneration of hard tissue and/or dental pulp tissues and treating dentin - dental pulp diseases and/or periodontal diseases, a polynucleotide encoding a peptide, an expression vector including a polynucleotide, and a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating dentin - dental pulp diseases and/or periodontal diseases, including a peptide, a quasi-medicinal composition for preventing or alleviating dentin - dental pulp diseases and/or periodontal diseases, including a peptide, and a composition of a functional healthy dietary product for preventing or alleviating dentin - dental pulp diseases and/or periodontal diseases, including a peptide. 
     EFFECT: production of a new peptide for treating dental pulp and periodontal diseases. 
     12 cl, 13 dwg, 33 tbl, 2 ex

title_en: Method for production of a composition of a fermented milk product with an increased iodine content with the addition of an iodized food composite
abstract_en:
FIELD: biotechnology.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to biotechnology and the dairy industry. The method for production of a composition of a fermented milk product with an increased iodine content with the addition of an iodized food composite is carried out as follows. Milk is normalized, homogenized, pasteurized and cooled to a temperature of 43±1°С. Kefir ferment is introduced, mixed and an additive is added, as which the iodized food composite “Yodonorm” is used in an amount of 100 micrograms per 1000 kg of product. They are mixed, packaged in consumer containers and sealed. They are fermented in a thermostat chamber for 8-12 hours at 20±1°C to form a homogeneous dense clot and achieve titratable acidity of 85-88° T, pH 4.55-4.65.   
     EFFECT: invention provides for the production of a fermented milk product enriched with an iodized additive “Yodonorm”, having functional properties, improved organoleptic properties, in particular rheological, expansion of the assortment of functional fermented milk products.  
     1 cl, 2 tbl, 3 ex

title_en: Method of treating malting barley grains before preparing malt
abstract_en: The method of pretreating malting barley grains before preparing malt is characterized in that low-temperature plasma is applied to the malting barley grains, with the exposure time being 5 to 60 seconds, preferably 10 to 15 seconds.

title_en: Method for extracting cocoa beans into cocoa powder capable of extracting cocoa beans into pure natural cocoa powder while preserving nutritional value and retaining the original color without adding pigments
abstract_en: A method for extracting cocoa beans into cocoa powder includes: taking Trinitarian cocoa beans, steaming them in hot water at 90 DEG C to 95 DEG C for 2 to 5 hours, and then draining the water; selecting cocoa beans with a color corresponding to the color of the to-be-finished product; using a grinder to grind the cocoa beans for 1 to 5 hours to a particle size of 0.03mm to 0.1mm to form a homogeneous cocoa paste; mixing the cocoa paste with water at a ratio of 1kg:500 to 1200cc and stirring with a homogenizer for 3 to 10 minutes at a temperature of 20 DEG C to 50 DEG C to form homogeneous cocoa butter; using a low-temperature dryer to dehydrate the cocoa butter for 8 to 24 hours at a temperature of -15 DEG C to 60 DEG C to form a dried cocoa mass with a moisture content of 1% to 6%; and breaking the cocoa mass to form cocoa powder.

title_en: Production method of DHA milk which adds algal oil, lecithin, and vitamin E (50% concentration) in the dairy cow's ration concentrate to increase more than 56.5 mg of DHA per 100 ml milk
abstract_en: A production method of docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, C22:6 [omega]3) milk is to add 6% algal oil, 0.4% lecithin, and 0.2% vitamin E (50% concentration) in the dairy cow's ration concentrate. Three field experiments are performed for 24 weeks, and the result shows that the produced milk contains more than 56.5 mg of DHA per 100 ml without affecting the milk yield, thereby greatly increasing CP value of the milk and improving the health of the drinker.

title_en: Composition for increasing immunoglobulin a amount and inhibiting oral pathogens in oral cavity and use of the same
abstract_en:
The invention provides a use of probiotics for preparing composition of increasing an amount of immunoglobulin A (IgA) and inhibiting oral pathogenic bacteria in an oral cavity. The probiotics includes
         Lactobacillus plantarum LPL28 as an effective ingredient, which can efficiently increase the IgA amount and/or inhibit the pathogens in the oral cavity, as well as potentially prevent teeth cavities and/or periodontal diseases.

title_en: Carbonation machine with rotatable carbonation head
abstract_en: A carbonation machine includes a rotatable carbonation head including at least one pressure release valve, a carbonation tube connectable via piping to a gas canister and a flange for engaging a neck of a bottle filled with liquid to be carbonated by screwing the neck into or onto the flange to firmly hold the bottle with the carbonation tube maintained inside the bottle, and for disengaging the neck of the bottle from the flange by unscrewing the neck off the flange. The rotatable carbonation head is configured, when screwing the neck into or onto the flange, to be rotated from a release position to a lock position, and is configured, when unscrewing the neck off the flange, to be rotated from the lock position to the release position. In the release position said at least one pressure release valve is operated to open so as to release excess pressure if such excess pressure exists in the bottle, and in the lock position said at least one pressure valve remains closed.

title_en: Use of thiolated chitosan for body weight control
abstract_en: The present invention relates to use of a thiolated chitosan for manufacturing a composition for weight control. In particular, the thiolated chitosan of the present invention contains a plurality of thiol groups covalently bound to the chitosan moiety thereof. The thiolated chitosan of the present invention can be orally administered, which is effective in slowing down body weight gain and has good biocompatibility.

title_en: Composition and method for omega-3 and plant flavonoids for increasing hdl cholesterol and decreasing ldl cholesterol and triglyceride levels
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nutritional supplements for the human diet used to manipulate HDL cholesterol, LDL cholesterol, and triglyceride levels in human blood plasma. The invention contains a novel combination of eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) present in Fish Oil, alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) present in Flaxseed Oil, Vitamin E in the form of d-alpha-tocopherol, Allicin present in Garlic, Phosphatidylcholine present in Lecithin, plant phytochemicals present in Parsley herb, citrus flavonoids present in Lemon fruit and Rutin (from Sophora japonica), and Capsaicin present in Cayenne Pepper.

title_en: Food raw material, method for manufacturing the same, and food
abstract_en: The object of the invention is to provide a food raw material that utilize the residue but are easier to produce the flavor of cacao than the fermented products of the existing fermented residue. The food material manufacturing method according to the present invention comprises a first drying step and a processing step. In the first drying step, the coffee bean extraction residue or its pulverized product is dried to obtain a dry residue. In the treatment step, the dried residue is subjected to fermentation treatment or enzyme treatment to obtain a treated product. Further, in this treatment step, the dried residue having an average particle size within the range of 0.015 mm or more and 2.20 mm or less is subjected to fermentation treatment or enzyme treatment.

title_en: Adipose tissue-like food
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of developing a food like animal adipose tissue by using a vegetable-derived material. According to the present invention, a food like animal adipose tissue can be obtained by blending rice flour, vegetable protein, and oil and fat.

title_en: Method of producing soy sauce comprising using npii gene-disrupted koji mold
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a method of producing soy sauce with reduced formation of burnt residue. The objective is achieved by a method of producing soy sauce including subjecting soy sauce raw materials to koji production treatment using a transformed strain of Aspergillus genus in which neutral protease II gene located on the chromosome has been inactivated to obtain soy sauce koji; and a transformed strain of Aspergillus genus in which neutral protease II gene located on the chromosome has been inactivated.

title_en: Use of complex probiotic for use of manufacturing composition for imrpoving exercise performance of subject with low intrinsic aerobic exercise capacity
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a use of a complex probiotic use of manufacturing composition for improving exercise performance of a subject with low intrinsic aerobic exercise capacity. The composition, which includes  Lactobacillus rhamnosus  GKLC1,  Bifidobacterium lactis  GKK24 and  Clostridium butyricum  GKB7, can be administered to a subject with low intrinsic aerobic exercise capacity in a continuation period, for 
reducing levels of serum latic acid serum urea nitrogen after aerobic exercise, lowering the proportion of offal fat and/or elevating the level of glucogen in the liver and muscle, thereby being as an effective ingredient for use in preparation of various compositions.

title_en: Characteristics of meat products
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods and compositions useful for the production of slaughter-free meat products, and the characterizations of the same. The slaughter-free meat products contain several points of distinction when compared to conventional meat procured by harvesting the tissue of a dead animal. Such points of distinction include, but are not limited to, significantly reduced or substantially no: steroid hormones, antibiotics, or microbial contamination; lower fat content; no vasculature; and extended shelf life both at room temperature and when refrigerated.

title_en: Short-hyphae mycelium, method of manufacturing the same and composition including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a short-hyphae mycelium, a method of manufacturing the same, and an oral composition including the same. A filamentous fungi is cultured in a culture medium including zinc ion and subjected to a multi-step process, without affecting the yield of dry weight and/or protein, so as to obtain the short-hyphae mycelium, thereby being applied to elderly-friendly food products.

title_en: Cake with low ratio of egg yolk
abstract_en: A cake with low ratio of egg yolk includes 100-125 parts by weight of flour, 120-200 parts by weight of egg white, 60-100 parts by weight of egg yolk, 40-50 parts by weight of liquid fat, and 0.001-0.2 parts by weight of phospholipid enzyme and 0.001~0.05 parts by weight of lignocellulose enzyme. It can effectively reduce costs of the cake and maintain the softness, elasticity and taste of the cake.

title_en: A cup of kombucha drink beverage infused with fruit
abstract_en:
This disclosure provides an innovative cup for kombucha drinks containing fruit 
to meet consumers' demands for diverse tastes and natural ingredients. The composition of the drink's cup includes a cup body, kombucha liquid, fresh fruit, ice cubes, and at least one other tea liquid. Furthermore, frozen fruit pieces and ice cream are added, and the combination of these ingredients gives the drink a rich taste and layered sensation.

title_en: Breeding method for tetraploid Ricinus communis
abstract_en: The present invention provides a breeding method for tetraploid ricinus communis. The method comprises: collecting a ricinus communis germplasm resource, performing morphologic character analysis and chromosome ploidy identification, selecting good diploid varieties, carrying out mutagenesis by using colchicine and oryzalin; performing chromosome ploidy identification on F1 generation seeds, selecting homozygous tetraploids, and performing economic character analysis and identification on the F2 generation, so as to breed good tetraploid ricinus communis.

title_en: Fulvic acid and humic acid mix for alcoholic beverages method and devices
abstract_en: The embodiments disclose a method including processing ingredients including carbon, essential vitamins, essential minerals, trace minerals, fulvic acid, and humic acid for preparation of black shot products, blending the ingredients processed into powders into powder based products, concentrating the ingredients processed into a liquid blend to create concentrated syrup products, blending the ingredients into a fresh fruit flavored smoothie, and blending the ingredients into a black shot beverage.

title_en: Plants and seeds of corn variety CV771799
abstract_en: According to the invention, there is provided seed and plants of the corn variety designated CV771799. The invention thus relates to the plants, seeds and tissue cultures of the variety CV771799, and to methods for producing a corn plant produced by crossing a corn plant of variety CV771799 with itself or with another corn plant, such as a plant of another variety. The invention further relates to corn seeds and plants produced by crossing plants of variety CV771799 with plants of another variety, such as another inbred line. The invention further relates to the inbred and hybrid genetic complements of plants of variety CV771799.

title_en: Plants and seeds of corn variety CV456829
abstract_en: According to the invention, there is provided seed and plants of the corn variety designated CV456829. The invention thus relates to the plants, seeds and tissue cultures of the variety CV456829, and to methods for producing a corn plant produced by crossing a corn plant of variety CV456829 with itself or with another corn plant, such as a plant of another variety. The invention further relates to corn seeds and plants produced by crossing plants of variety CV456829 with plants of another variety, such as another inbred line. The invention further relates to the inbred and hybrid genetic complements of plants of variety CV456829.

title_en: Peroxide dispersions
abstract_en: The viscosity of aqueous dispersions of normally solid organic peroxides may be advantageously lowered through the use of surfactants which are polyglyceryl esters of C6-C12 fatty acids. The reduction in viscosity facilitates milling the peroxides to reduce particle size and also provides dispersions of small particle size peroxides which may be readily poured or pumped. The aqueous dispersions are useful as components of pharmaceutical, personal care, and cleaning products and the like and are effective decolorizing agents for food products, industrial products and the like.

title_en: Method and system for reducing the unfermentable solids content in a protein portion at the back end of a corn dry milling process
abstract_en: A method and system for reducing the unfermentable solids content in a protein portion, via a counter current wash, at the back end of a corn dry milling process for making alcohol is disclosed. The method can include separating the whole stillage byproduct into an insoluble solids portion and a stillage (centrate) portion, which includes protein. Thereafter, the stillage portion can be separated into a water soluble solids portion and a protein portion. The protein portion may be mixed with clean water to wash and dilute the protein portion. The diluted protein portion may be dewatered to form a dewatered protein portion and a centrate. A portion of the centrate may be used as a protein counter current wash when the protein portion is being separated from the stillage portion. The protein counter current wash reduces the amount of unfermentable solids in the protein portion and the centrate.

title_en: Method of using Cistanche tubulosa extract to prevent, slow down, or treat an eye disease caused by oxidative stress
abstract_en: This invention provides a method of using extract of  Cistanche tubulosa . The extract was used to prevent, slow down, or treat an eye disease caused by oxidative stress. The method includes administrating to a subject in need a therapeutically effective amount of the extract of  Cistanche tubulosa  to prevent, slow down, or treat an eye disease caused by oxidative stress.

title_en: Quantitative in-situ texture measurement apparatus and method
abstract_en: A measurement apparatus and method for in-situ quantitative texture measurement of a food snack. The apparatus includes an acoustic capturing device and a data processing unit. The physical interaction in the mouth with saliva, when a human being eats/drinks a food snack, sends pressure waves that propagate through the ear bone and produce an acoustic signal. The acoustic capturing device records and forwards the signal to a data processing unit. The data processing unit further comprises a digital signal processing module that smoothens, transforms and filters the received acoustic signal. A statistical processing module further filters the acoustic signal from the data processing unit and generates a quantitative acoustic model for texture attributes such as hardness and fracturability. The quantitative model is correlated with a qualitative texture measurement from a descriptive expert panel. Another method includes a food snack fingerprinting using an in-situ quantitative food property measurement.

title_en: R-beta-hydroxybutyrate, S-beta-hydroxybutyrate, and RS-beta-hydroxybutyrate mixed salt compositions
abstract_en: Beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) mixed salts are formulated to induce or sustain ketosis in a subject. The BHB mixed salts provide a biologically balanced set of cationic electrolytes and avoid detrimental health effects associated with imbalanced electrolyte ratios. BHB mixed salt compositions include two, three or four of sodium BHB, potassium BHB, calcium BHB, or magnesium BHB. BHB mixed salt compositions include R-BHB and/or S-BHB, such as enriched with either R-BHB or S-BHB. BHB mixed salt compositions may include BHB mixed salts and beta-hydroxybutyric acid. BHB mixed salts may be provided as or mixed with a dietetically or pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. BHB mixed salt compositions can be a solid, such as a powder, or a liquid, such as a beverage. A mixed salt-acid composition is particularly well-suited for flavored beverages.

title_en: Maternal vitamin B6 administration for the prevention of increased adiposity, overweight or obesity in the offspring
abstract_en: The present invention generally relates to the early prevention of overweight, obesity, excessive fat accumulation and/or associated metabolic disorders in infants or children. For example, the present invention relates to the prevention of overweight, obesity, excessive fat accumulation and/or associated metabolic disorders in infants or children through appropriate nutrition for women desiring to get pregnant and/or during pregnancy and/or lactation. Embodiments of the present invention relate to the Vitamin B6 for use in the prevention of overweight, obesity, excessive fat accumulation and/or associated metabolic disorders in the offspring, wherein the vitamin B6 is administered to women desiring to get pregnant and/or to the mother during pregnancy and/or lactation and to maternal food compositions that can be used for this purpose.

title_en: System and method for automatically cleaning and washing ice cream or yogurt machine
abstract_en: A system for automatically cleaning and washing an ice cream machines includes a liquid container for storing raw materials; a freezing cylinder connected with the liquid container through a cleaning pathway; a water tank for storing rinse water to rinse the freezing cylinder and the cleaning pathway; a detergent tank for storing detergents to clean and wash the freezing cylinder and the cleaning pathway; a pump arranged on the cleaning pathway to selectively pump the raw material, the rinse water or the detergent; and a control panel adapted to control an on/off and cleaning.

title_en: Cookware and cook-packs for narrowband irradiation cooking and systems and methods thereof
abstract_en: A methodology and product or system configurations are provided which allow food to be directly irradiated for cooking applications which involve the impingement of direct radiant energy on food or comestible items. Cooking vessels or cook-packs are used that are optically transmissive in visible or infrared narrow wavelength bands emitted in suitable narrowband cooking or heating systems.

title_en: UV sterilization of container, room, space or defined environment
abstract_en: Provided herein are portable ultraviolet (UV) devices, systems, and methods of use and manufacturing same. Methods of use include methods for UV disinfection and sterilization, more specifically, methods for UV disinfection and sterilization of a container, a room, a space or a defined environment. The portable UV devices, systems and methods are particularly useful for the UV disinfection and sterilization of a container, a room, a space or defined environment used in various industries. Provided are also portable UV devices, systems, and methods for inhibiting the growth of one or more species of microorganisms present in a container, a room, a space or a defined environment, preferably for inhibiting the growth of one or more species of microorganisms present on an interior surface of a container, a room, a space or a defined environment.

title_en: Cheese and method for its manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for making cheese wherein cheese is salted with a salting agent comprising milk minerals and NaCl or a mixture thereof. The invention also relates to ripened cheese having a ratio of K/Na of 0.39 to 4.0 and a K content of more than 0.08%.

title_en: Tomato line FIR-A818-0003
abstract_en: The invention provides seeds and plants of tomato line FIR-A818-0003. The invention thus relates to the plants, seeds, plant parts, and tissue cultures of tomato line FIR-A818-0003 and to methods for producing a tomato plant produced by crossing such plants with themselves or with another plant, such as a tomato plant of another genotype. The invention further relates to seeds and plants produced by such crossing. The invention further relates to plants, seeds, plant parts, and tissue cultures of tomato line FIR-A818-0003 comprising introduced beneficial or desirable traits.

title_en: Soybean variety 01077377
abstract_en: The invention relates to the soybean variety designated 01077377. Provided by the invention are the seeds, plants and derivatives of the soybean variety 01077377. Also provided by the invention are tissue cultures of the soybean variety 01077377 and the plants regenerated therefrom. Still further provided by the invention are methods for producing soybean plants by crossing the soybean variety 01077377 with itself or another soybean variety and plants produced by such methods.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preparing food
abstract_en: Air-based fryer including a food preparation chamber including an outer wall, an inner wall defining a food receiving space with an air inlet and an air discharge opening, and a circulation channel defined between the outer wall and the inner wall. The fryer includes an air heater for heating air in the food preparation chamber, a fan for moving a flow of hot air successively through the air inlet, the food receiving space, the discharge opening, and the channel. The fryer includes a steam generator including at least one nozzle extending into the food receiving space for spraying temperature-controlled steam onto the food; and a controller adapted to control the steam generator to spray steam to food placed in the food receiving space for a first predetermined period, and to control the air heater and the fan to circulate hot air to the food for a subsequent second predetermined period.

title_en: Rotary screw blancher
abstract_en: A food processing apparatus includes a pressure vessel defining a compartment having an inlet end for receiving food product and an outlet end for discharging food product, an open-top screen mounted within the compartment and movable relative to the compartment between a first position, for food processing, and a second position, to facilitate cleaning, a rotatable auger mounted such that at least a portion of the auger is within the screen, the auger being operable to advance food product within the compartment from the inlet end of the pressure vessel toward the outlet end, and a transfer mechanism including a conduit in communication with the compartment, a fluid discharge positioned substantially within the conduit, and a pressurized fluid source in communication with the fluid discharge and operable to propel a fluid through the fluid discharge to move food product through the conduit.

title_en: Tomato hybrid SVTM9016 and parents thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides seeds and plants of tomato hybrid SVTM9016. The invention thus relates to the plants, seeds, plant parts, and tissue cultures of tomato hybrid SVTM9016 and to methods for producing a tomato plant produced by crossing such plants with themselves or with another plant, such as a tomato plant of another genotype. The invention further relates to seeds and plants produced by such crossing. The invention further relates to plants, seeds, plant parts, and tissue cultures of tomato hybrid SVTM9016 comprising introduced beneficial or desirable traits.

title_en: Lettuce variety nun 06147 LTL
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a new and distinct variety of lettuce variety NUN 06147 LTL as well as seeds and plants and heads or leaves thereof. NUN 06147 LTL is a Romaine short day variety comprising resistance Downy Mildew ( Bremia lactucae ) isolates B1:16-35 EU,  Nasonovia ribisnigri  Biotype Nr:0, and Lettuce Necrotic Spot Virus (LNSV).

title_en: Hyperimmunized egg product for treatment of necrotic enteritis in poultry
abstract_en: In one aspect, the present invention is directed to a method for preventing or treating necrotic enteritis by administering a hyperimmunized egg product obtained from an egg-producing animal to an avian. The hyperimmunized egg product may contain an antibody specific to an antigen selected from the group consisting of  Clostridium perfringens  α-toxin,  Clostridium perfringens  elongation factor Tu (EF-Tu),  Clostridium perfringens  necrotic enteritis B-like (NetB) toxin,  Clostridium perfringens  Pyruvate: Ferredoxin oxidoreductase (PFO), and  Eimeria tenella  elongation factor 1-alpha.

title_en: Fish feed compositions containing a neonicotinoid for preventing and treating parasite infections
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods of preventing or treating parasite infection in a plurality of fish in need thereof, comprising administering to the fish an effective amount of a medicated fish feed. The medicated fish feed comprises fish feed granules or pellets coated with a composition comprising a neonicotinoid such as imidacloprid and a carrier having a high apparent digestibility coefficient such as a processed/cooked corn protein concentrate.

title_en: Devices and methods for the preparation of a nutritional formula
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the disclosure may be drawn to a device having an inlet and a chamber. Immobilized lipase, immobilized protease, and immobilized amylase may be contained within the chamber. The device may also include an outlet, wherein a flow path extends from the inlet, through the chamber, and to the outlet.

title_en: Animal nutrition compositions and related methods
abstract_en: Animal nutrition compositions include a carrier and a fermentation product applied to the carrier. Liquid fermentation products are fluidly applied to dry carriers, such as phyllosilicates or other earthen components, while mixing and applying air flow, under appropriate temperature and pH conditions, to bind the fermentation product to the carrier and dry the reaction product to appropriate moisture content. Fermentation products are also mixed with liquid carriers, such as water. Fermentation products include components of a microbial fermentation culture, such as liquid medium, microbial cellular components, and fermentation metabolites produced by microorganisms. Some compositions include a pH buffering agent and/or additional components to further enhance beneficial effects of the composition, such as improved weight gain and feed conversion, reduced gut lesions, harmful gut bacteria count, and decreased mortality. Compositions can be mixed with animal feeds or otherwise administered. Compositions can inhibit fungal growth on animal feeds.

title_en: Root extracts from plants of the Morus genus and uses of same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a root extract from plants of the  Morus  genus (in particular  Morus albaet, Morus nigra ) that is rich in prenylated polyphenols chosen from: moracenin A, moracenin B, kuwanon C, wittiorumin F and mulberrofuran T, a method for preparing such an extract and a cosmetic composition and a pharmaceutical or nutraceutical composition, the compositions including, as the active ingredient, at least one root extract from plants of the  Morus  genus according to the invention.

title_en: Canola variety 18GG0505L
abstract_en: Provided is a canola variety designated 18GG0505L and seed, plants and plant parts thereof produced from a cross of inbred varieties. Methods for producing a canola variety comprise crossing canola variety 18GG0505L with another canola plant. Methods for producing a canola plant containing in its genetic material one or more traits introgressed into 18GG0505L through backcross conversion and/or transformation, and to the canola seed, plant and plant part produced thereby are described. Canola variety 18GG0505L, the seed, the plant produced from the seed, plant parts and variants, mutants, and minor modifications of canola variety 18GG0505L are disclosed.

title_en: Maize inbred PH4CNB
abstract_en: A novel maize variety designated PH4CNB and seed, plants and plant parts thereof are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant comprise crossing maize variety PH4CNB with another maize plant are provided. Methods for producing a maize plant containing in its genetic material one or more traits introgressed into PH4CNB through backcross conversion and/or transformation, and to the maize seed, plant and plant part produced thereby are provided. Hybrid maize seed, plants or plant parts are produced by crossing the variety PH4CNB or a locus conversion of PH4CNB with another maize variety.

title_en: Soybean variety 01078759
abstract_en: The invention relates to the soybean variety designated 01078759. Provided by the invention are the seeds, plants and derivatives of the soybean variety 01078759. Also provided by the invention are tissue cultures of the soybean variety 01078759 and the plants regenerated therefrom. Still further provided by the invention are methods for producing soybean plants by crossing the soybean variety 01078759 with itself or another soybean variety and plants produced by such methods.

title_en: Lactic acid bacterium and use thereof
abstract_en: A new lactic acid bacterium of the present invention produces, as an exopolysaccharide, a neutral polysaccharide having a structure in which N-acetylglucosamines are linked with each other via α-1,6 bond, is obtained from a fig, has a hyaluronidase inhibitory, an anti-alcoholic damage activity effect, and the like, and is therefore useful in a food and drink, a medicine, a feed, a cosmetic and the like exerting an antiallergy effect, an anti-alcoholic damage effect, and the like.

title_en: Growth-stimulating Lactobacillus strains
abstract_en: The present invention concerns novel  Lactobacillus plantarum  strains capable of promoting the growth of a subject, and more particularly the juvenile or prenatal growth of farm animals, and their uses as probiotics.

title_en: Nutritional formulations including human milk oligosaccharides and antioxidants and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are nutritional compositions including human milk oligosaccharides in combination with long chain polyunsaturated fatty acids and/or carotenoids that can be administered to preterm infants, term infants, toddlers, and children for reducing inflammation and the incidence of inflammatory diseases.

title_en: Process for extraction of protein from plant or algal matter
abstract_en: A method for separating protein from plant or algae material is disclosed. The method comprises mixing the protein-containing material with a solvent, preferably water; extracting the protein-containing material at pH>7; and acidifying the mixture, thereby precipitating protein and fiber together. In some embodiments of the invention, the separation additionally comprises decanting the mixture to recover a protein/fiber solid; adding water to the protein/fiber solid; adding a predetermined quantity of base to the protein/fiber/water system, thereby precipitating fiber; separating the fiber from the protein in a decanter; and drying the protein solution. In other embodiments, the protein/fiber solid is processed directly, e.g. by being passed to an extruder. The use of the fiber as a carrier for the protein makes the inventive method more efficient than methods known in the art; in particular, the inventive method does not require the use of a high-g clarifier centrifuge.

title_en: Soybean cultivar 01230324
abstract_en: A soybean cultivar designated 01230324 is disclosed. The invention relates to the seeds of soybean cultivar 01230324, to the plants of soybean cultivar 01230324, to the plant parts of soybean cultivar 01230324, and to methods for producing progeny of soybean cultivar 01230324. The invention also relates to methods for producing a soybean plant containing in its genetic material one or more transgenes and to the transgenic soybean plants and plant parts produced by those methods. The invention also relates to soybean cultivars or breeding cultivars, and plant parts derived from soybean cultivar 01230324. The invention also relates to methods for producing other soybean cultivars, lines, or plant parts derived from soybean cultivar 01230324, and to the soybean plants, varieties, and their parts derived from use of those methods. The invention further relates to hybrid soybean seeds, plants, and plant parts produced by crossing cultivar 01230324 with another soybean cultivar.

title_en: Lactobacillus acidophilus TW01 isolate and use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is an isolated strain of  Lactobacillus acidophilus  TW01, which is deposited at Deutsche Sammlung von Mikroorganismen and Zellkulturen GmbH under an accession number DSM 33990. Also disclosed herein are uses of the isolated strain of  Lactobacillus acidophilus  TW01 for alleviating an inflammation-related disorder and for improving gut health.

title_en: Separation of fat and lean using a decanter centrifuge
abstract_en: Methods for separating lean and fat from beef or other meats and the separation apparatus are shown. The methods use microbiocidal fluids to reduce or eliminate possible sources of contamination.

title_en: Device and method for imparting smoked flavors to beverages and foodstuffs
abstract_en: Disclosed is a smoker device for imparting smoked flavors to beverages and foodstuffs can include a base having at least a wall defining a first end and a floor with an opening defining a second end, a cover capable of being positioned over the base first end, thereby defining an enclosed cavity, and a conduit portion defining an open channel at a first end and closed at a second end, the first end connecting to a perimeter of the base floor opening, creating a passageway from the enclosed cavity to the channel. Also disclosed is a method for using the smoker device to impart smoked flavors to beverages and foodstuffs.

title_en: Materials and methods for dietary calcium supplementation of animals
abstract_en: Methods for providing dietary calcium to livestock and other animals and the compositions for use in providing dietary calcium to livestock are disclosed. Kits to provide the animal with a desired amount of supplemental calcium during normal watering is also disclosed.

title_en: Lycopene composition having improved colorant properties
abstract_en: The present invention provides a tomato-derived composition comprising lycopene crystals at a concentration of at least 70% (w/w) and methylene chloride-insoluble material at a concentration of 10% (w/w) or less, wherein the size of said lycopene crystals is less than 1 micron. The present invention also encompasses a process for preparing said composition from tomato pulp.

title_en: Method for producing a coffee extract employing enzymes having beta-1,3-galactanase activity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a coffee extract which comprises use of an enzyme having β-1,3-galactanase activity and to a coffee extract which comprises at least 20% based on the total weight of soluble coffee solids of total galactose.

title_en: Coffee composition and items made therefrom
abstract_en: A structured coffee composition and to various items made using such coffee composition are provided. The structured coffee composition is suitable for use in one or more of automatic drip coffee makers, single serving coffee makers, percolating coffee makers, moka pot coffee makers, French press coffee makers, vacuum coffee makers, expresso coffee makers, thermal coffee makers, or any combination of two or more thereof.

title_en: P62 ligand compound, and composition for preventing, ameliorating or treating proteinopathies comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel p62 ligand compound, a stereoisomer, hydrate, solvate or prodrug thereof, and a pharmaceutical or food composition for preventing or treating proteinopathies comprising the same as an active ingredient. The p62 ligand compound according to the present invention can be usefully used as a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention, amelioration or treatment of various proteinopathies by activating autophagy in cells and thus selectively eliminating in vivo proteins, organelles and aggregates.

title_en: System and method for automatically cleaning and washing ice cream or yogurt machine
abstract_en: A system for automatically cleaning and washing an ice cream machines includes a liquid container for storing raw materials; a freezing cylinder connected with the liquid container through a cleaning pathway; a water tank for storing rinse water to rinse the freezing cylinder and the cleaning pathway; a detergent tank for storing detergents to clean and wash the freezing cylinder and the cleaning pathway; a pump arranged on the cleaning pathway to selectively pump the raw material, the rinse water or the detergent; and a control panel adapted to control an on/off and cleaning.

title_en: Wheat cultivar 01095213
abstract_en: The invention relates to the wheat cultivar designated 01095213. Provided by the invention are the seeds, plants and derivatives of the wheat cultivar 01095213. Also provided by the invention are tissue cultures of the wheat cultivar 01095213 and the plants regenerated therefrom. Still further provided by the invention are methods for producing wheat plants by crossing the wheat cultivar 01095213 with itself or another wheat cultivar and plants produced by such methods.

title_en: Lactobacillus sp. strain having ability to inhibit growth of vaginal pathogenic microorganisms
