with additive compared to blends prepared without additive. The innovation in this work is to 
incorporate cow urine, which escalates the quality of the Diesel- unusable cooking oil blends to 
use as fuel in internal combustion engines, thereby decreasing the fuel price and stabilizing the 
economy of the region.

title_en: A method of preparation of aqueous extract of sida rhombifolia linn for antibacterial activity
abstract_en:
A METHOD OF PREPARATION OF AQUEOUS EXTRACT OF SIDA RHOMBIFOLIA 
LINN FOR ANTIBACTERIAL ACTIVITY 
Aqueous extract of stems of Sida rhombifolia Linn. exhibited inhibitory effect towards the 
pathogenic organisms. The zone of inhibition values of aqueous extrtact of stems of Sida 
rhombifolia Linn. in against two Gram positive microorganisms viz. Bacillus subtilis and 
Clostridium tetani and two Gram negative microorganisms viz. Salmonella typhi and 
Pseudomonas aeruginosa of these species, the aqueous extract of stems of Sida rhombifolia 
Linn. showed significant activity. The solvent (distilled water) used, as control exerted no effect 
against the microorganisms in broth medium.

title_en: A process for developing nano-inspired ultra-thin large surface area anti-slippery self-cleaning anti-bacterial mattress
abstract_en:
The present invention generally relates to a process for developing 
nano-inspired ultra-thin large surface area anti-slippery self-cleaning anti
bacterial mattress comprises introducing a mattress structure with a 
rational nano-pattern at the bottom to prevent both transverse and 
longitudinal slip-modes with the floor of contact; coupling a self-cleaning 
highly hydrophobic top surface for promoting a highly in-toxic anti
microbial as well as self-cleaning; and coating nanostructured materials at 
the bottom to achieve enhanced friction which makes zero-slippery 
situation while coating the metal oxide and hybrid metal oxide nano
material on the top surface.

title_en: Antimicrobial compounds, compositions, and uses thereof
abstract_en:
Antimicrobial compounds and compositions of Formulas (I) to (III) and methods of 
use are disclosed.

title_en: Multi-aziridine compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-aziridine compound having: a) from 2 to 6 of the following structural units (A): whereby R', R" are as defined herein m is an integer from 1 to 6; b) one or more linking chains wherein each one of these linking chains links two of the structural units A; and c) a molecular weight in the range from 840 Daltons to 5000 Daltons. The multi-aziridine compound can be used for example for crosslinking of for example carboxylic acid functional polymers dissolved and/or dispersed in an aqueous medium.

title_en: Plasma coating method and apparatus for biological surface modification
abstract_en: The present invention concerns a method for providing a bio-active layer on a surface, comprising the steps of: a) ionizing a plasma gas at low temperature of 150°C or lower, and at about atmospheric pressure, thereby creating a plasma; b) introducing a precursor into said plasma; c) exposing the surface to said plasma comprising said precursor, thereby forming a coating onto said surface, whereby said plasma gas is ionized by means of electrodes, whereby said plasma gas is ionized by said electrodes with a power of at most 10 Watt per cm² of the electrode surface, whereby the bio-active layer is an antibiofouling layer, an antibacterial layer, an antiviral layer and/or an microbial collecting layer, whereby said plasma gas comprises inert gas for at least 99 % by volume, whereby said inert gas is a non-noble gas.

title_en: Process for synthesizing sulfonated triaryl methane compounds
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for the preparation of a compound of formula [Chem I], formula (I), said method being characterized in that it comprises at least one step of oxidizing sulfonated triphenyl methane of formula [Chem V] with a quinone selected from 1,4-benzoquinone, 1,2-benzoquinone, a (C

title_en: Medical devices and materials comprising biodegradable polyesters
abstract_en: The present invention provides a formulation comprising a biodegradable polyester compounded with a compound of Formula (I): AA-AA-AA-X-Y. The invention further provides methods of making these formulations, medical devices such as sutures comprising said formulations and methods of making said devices.

title_en: Biochar as a microbial carrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microbial delivery system where biochar acts as a carrier for microbes.

title_en: Board material processing composition, board material laminate, and method for manufacturing board material laminate
abstract_en: Provided is a board material processing composition enabling manufacture of a board material laminate which is non-combustible and superior in adhesive performance. In order to solve this problem, a board material processing composition that inhibits combustion of a board material due to heating contains: an inorganic carbonization promotion component that promotes carbonization of an organic component in the board material during the heating; an inorganic chain inhibition component that inhibits a reaction chain to adjacent components due to a product of endothermic decomposition generated during the heating; and inorganic hydrophobic binder particles that adhere the organic component in the board material with the carbonization promotion component and the chain inhibition component.

title_en: Design for fluid loss requirement of a cement slurry using bulk blend materials
abstract_en: A method may include providing a fluid loss model, providing a fluid loss requirement, generating a cement slurry recipe using the fluid loss model and the fluid loss requirement such that a calculated fluid loss of the cement slurry recipe using the fluid loss model meets or exceeds the fluid loss requirement; and preparing a cement slurry based on the cement slurry recipe.

title_en: Synthesis and composition of neurolenin d mesylate — a new drug for the treatment of parasitic nematode infections in humans, animals and plants
abstract_en: The natural product neurolenin D is isolated from Neurolaena lobata using continuous extraction, stirring over charcoal, flash column chromatography, and recrystallization. The secondary alcohol in this molecule is converted into a methane sulfonyl ester (mesylate) to generate a new molecule, neurolenin D mesylate. This previously unknown molecule has been tested for biological activity in assays for human toxicity, mutagenicity, and nematocidal potency. It is not toxic or mutagenic and demonstrates the ability to kill nematodes responsible for the neglected tropical disease lymphatic filariasis and is likely to have the same ability to kill other nematodes responsible for a wide range of diseases in humans, animals and plants. Additional esters of neurolenin D are claimed and procedures are outlined for their synthesis.

title_en: Herbicidal compositions
abstract_en: The invention relates to herbicidal compositions that contain an N-(1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)arylcarboxylic acid amide and further herbicides

title_en: Recombinant phage and method for preparing same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide: a recombinant phage that disables the anti-phage defence system of bacteria including drug-resistant bacteria, is capable of infecting the bacteria, further proliferates within the bacteria, and is ultimately capable of sterilizing the bacteria; and a method for preparing the recombinant phage. The present invention relates to a recombinant phage and a method for preparing the same, the recombinant phage containing at least one of a gene encoding a Retron inhibitor and a gene encoding a tRNA that functions in a target bacterium.

title_en: Removal of phthalates
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for reducing the content of phthalates from a vegetable oil, wherein the process is comprising the step of subjecting a vegetable oil to an evaporation, wherein the evaporation is performed in a stripping column at a pressure of between 1 and 4 mbar, preferably between 2 and 3 mbar, and a temperature in a range of from 270 to 320°C, with a residence time of the oil of preferably from 1 to 10 minutes, more preferably from 1 to 5 minutes and obtaining a retentate vegetable oil. It further relates to the use wherein the evaporator is applied at a pressure, preferably between 2 and 3 mbar and a temperature of from 270 to 320°C with a residence time of the oil of below 20 minutes for obtaining a retentate vegetable oil having a reduced content of phthalates.

title_en: Devices, methods, and compositions for enhancing coverage and retention of liquid solutions sprayed on plant surfaces
abstract_en: Presented herein are systems, methods, and devices for enhancing coverage and retention of liquid solutions sprayed onto plant surfaces. More particularly, in certain embodiments, presented herein are systems, methods, and devices for distributing adjuvant in sprayed droplets to concentrate adjuvant within a partial volume near to the droplet surface (e.g., a "cloaking volume"), with lower adjuvant concentration in a bulk interior volume that includes the droplet center.

title_en: A coating composition comprising an epoxy resin and a corrosion inhibitor and a coated metal substrate
abstract_en: A coating composition comprising a resin component comprising an epoxy resin, a corrosion inhibitor comprising one or more thiol groups, and an alkyl ester of phosphoric acid, wherein the corrosion inhibitor comprising one or more thiol groups is or comprises a thiazole, an azole thiol, a trithiocyanuric acid, or a salt thereof, and wherein the resin component is substantially free of water. Use of an alkyl ester of phosphoric acid as stabilizer for such resin component, and a metal substrate at least partly coated with a coating layer deposited from such coating composition, wherein the corrosion inhibitor comprising one or more thiol groups comprises 2-mercaptobenzothiazole, 2,5-dimercapto-1,3,4-thiadiazole, a salt of 2,5-dimercapto-1,3,4-thiadiazole, or a combination of two or more thereof.

title_en: Drain treatment composition
abstract_en: A single-part drain treatment composition comprising a mixture of divided solid components comprises from 30 wt% to 70 wt% of an alkali metal percarbonate and at least 30 wt% of sodium sulfite. The drain treatment composition may be used in cleaning and/or unblocking kitchen drains. Also disclosed is a method of treating a drain containing standing water, comprising dispensing the drain treatment composition into the drain such that the composition mixes with the standing water.

title_en: Processes for producing lipids
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of producing lipids. In particular, the present invention relates to methods of increasing the level of one or more non-polar lipids and/or the total non-polar lipid content in a vegetative plant part or a transgenic organism or part thereof.

title_en: Colicins for the control of ehec
abstract_en: The invention provides a method of preventing or reducing contamination of an object such as food with enterohaemorrhagic E. coli (EHEC), comprising contacting said object with colicin M or a derivative thereof.

title_en: Process for acidizing
abstract_en: The invention relates to in-situ acidizing processes that involve the dissolution of an acid- soluble material. Treatment fluids have been identified that can effectively dissolve acid- soluble materials at low temperatures, such as temperatures of 30 °C or lower. In some embodiments, the processes may also be usefully employed at higher temperatures. The processes and treatment fluids of the invention can advantageously be used to dissolve acid-soluble materials, including filter cakes, in underground formations.

title_en: Surfactant assisted oil recovery using alcohol ether sulfonates and cationic surfactants
abstract_en: A composition comprising an alcohol ether sulfonate and a quaternary ammonium salt is provided for use in methods of increasing recovery of crude oil from a subterranean hydrocarbon-containing formation.

title_en: Fabric treatment composition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fabric treatment composition comprising: a) from 50 to 95 wt.% of polyethylene glycol; b) from 0.1 to 15 wt.% of perfume; c) from 0.1 to 2.5 wt.%  of cationic polymer; and, d) from 0.1 to 5 wt.% of anionic silicone. The fabric treatment composition of the disclosure improves the fragrance intensity performance during the laundry process.

title_en: Fatty acid composition
abstract_en: This invention relates to the field of renewable oil compositions and especially to the use of renewable oil compositions for production of hydrocarbon compositions, which can be used for traffic fuels and other solutions. Especially, the current invention relates to a composition comprising free fatty acids and triglycerides, in a concentration of free fatty acids from 15 wt-% to 80 wt-% and the rest being predominantly triglycerides. The invention relates also to a method for producing hydrocarbons from a renewable oil feedstock, in which the feedstock comprising free fatty acids from 15 wt-% to 80 wt-%, and the rest being predominantly triglycerides is subjected to a pretreatment process followed by a hydrotreatment process for obtaining hydrocarbons.

title_en: Asphaltene dispersant additive and uses thereof
abstract_en: Use of an alkylphenol-aldehyde resin modified by at least one alkylamine in a crude oil composition or in a product derived from a crude oil composition, as asphaltene dispersant additive. Process for treating a crude oil composition or a derived product, that makes it possible to prevent the precipitation of the asphaltenes, in particular in crude oils and products that are derived therefrom by refining and/or extraction processes. Bituminous compositions comprising an alkylphenol-aldehyde resin modified by at least one alkylamine.

title_en: Sand composites and methods of using the same to control dust
abstract_en: A composite is characterized by particulates of sand wherein at least a portion of the surface of the particulates is coated with a polycationic polymer. The presence of the polycationic polymer on the surface of the particulates reduces the amount of dust generated during handling and use of the sand. The polycationic polymer further reduces the amount of dust generated during transport of the sand as well during manufacture, treatment or processing of the sand.

title_en: Lightweight proppant and methods for making and using same
abstract_en: Lightweight proppant particles are disclosed. The lightweight proppant particle can include a proppant particle having an apparent specific gravity of at least about 1.5 g/cc, a coating of a hydrophobic material formed on an outer surface of the proppant particle, and a coating of an amphiphilic material formed on an outer surface of the coating of the hydrophobic material.

title_en: Imidazolium sulfur-containing binuclear molybdate salts as lubricant additives
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound of the Formula I: and a lubricating composition containing and a method for preparing the same. In Formula I, R1-R5 and R6-R10 are independently selected from the group consisting of hydrogen, hydrocarbyl groups and hydrocarbyl groups containing heteroatoms, such that the total carbon atoms from Q1 and Q2 is from 6 to 166 carbon atoms, and molybdate anion (Y) is a binuclear sulfur-containing dianion selected from the group consisting of [Mo2S8O2]2-, [Mo2S9O]2-, and [Mo2S10]2.

title_en: Determining residual friction reducer concentrations for subterranean treatment fluids
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for treating subterranean formations. An embodiment of the present disclosure is a method comprising: introducing a fluid comprising an aqueous base fluid and a friction reducer into a wellbore penetrating at least a portion of a subterranean formation at a pressure sufficient to create or enhance one or more fractures within the subterranean formation; recovering at least a portion of the fluid from the wellbore; adding a reactive agent to a sample of the portion of the fluid that has been recovered from the wellbore, wherein the reactive agent reacts with the friction reducer to form a photo-detectable compound in the sample; measuring a light absorbance of the sample of the fluid that has been recovered from the wellbore at a selected wavelength of light; and using the measured absorbance and a calibration curve for the selected wavelength of light to determine the concentration of the friction reducer in the fluid that has been recovered from the wellbore.

title_en: Decoking process
abstract_en: In chemical processes for cracking hydrocarbons, reactors are subject to coking. This results in carburization of the metal substrate for the reactor leading to a reduced reactor life. If the reactor is subject to a decoke process, followed by a steam scour and nitrogenating there is a reduced tendency to carburization of the metal substrate improving the reactor life.

title_en: Improved biomass conversion process
abstract_en: The present invention provides a process for producing liquid hydrocarbon products from a feedstock comprising at least one of a solid biomass-containing feedstock and a solid biomass-derived feedstock and in the range of from 50 to 15000 ppmw of chlorides, said process comprising the steps of: a) incorporating a chloride trap material into said feedstock to provide a combined feedstock/chloride trap material; b) densifying the combined feedstock/chloride trap material to form densified feed in the form of pellets or briquettes; c) contacting said densified feed with a hydropyrolysis catalyst composition and molecular hydrogen in a hydropyrolysis reactor vessel at a temperature in the range of from 350 to 600°C and a pressure in the range of from 0.50 to 7.50 MPa to produce a product stream comprising a deoxygenated hydrocarbon product, H2O, H2, CO2, CO, C1 - C3 gases, char and catalyst fines; and d) removing all or a portion of said char and catalyst fines from said product stream.

title_en: Improved urea-based composition comprising elemental sulphur and method for the manufacture thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a homogeneous, solid, particulate, urea-based composition comprising elemental sulphur and a urease inhibitor of the type phosphoric triamide, wherein the urea-based composition comprising elemental sulphur is further characterized in that one or more of the following measures applies: a) it comprises 5 weight% or less, relative to the total weight of the composition, of one or more alkaline or alkaline-forming inorganic or organic compounds; or b) it comprises an anticaking and/or moisture-repellent coating. The composition according to the invention has improved properties for reducing ammonia loss by urease activity in the soil and is in particular suitable as a fertilizer. The invention further relates to a method for the manufacture of a homogeneous, solid, particulate urea-based composition comprising urea, elemental sulphur and a urease inhibitor of the type phosphoric triamide, in particular N-(n-butyl) thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT), as well as to a composition of kit of parts comprising: a) one or more alkaline or alkaline-forming inorganic or organic compounds; b) the urease inhibitor of the type phosphoric triamide in solid particulate or a liquid form, preferably wherein the urease inhibitor is N-(n-butyl) thiophosphoric triamide (nBTPT); c) optionally, one or more anticaking and/or moisture-repellent compounds.

title_en: Well apparatus and associated methods
abstract_en: A method of sealing in a bore, such as plugging a well for abandonment. The method comprises applying a swellable in particulate form to the bore. The swellable comprises a polymer. The particulate swellable is positioned in place within the bore at a desired location. The method includes swelling the swellable so as to form a seal at the desired location. Embodiments include a well comprising a bore with a seal applied by injecting the swellable in particulate form as a flowable into the bore.

title_en: Coke plant tunnel repair and flexible joints
abstract_en: A coke plant includes multiple coke ovens where each coke oven is adapted to produce exhaust gases, a common tunnel fluidly connected to the plurality of coke ovens and configured to receive the exhaust gases from each of the coke ovens, multiple standard heat recovery steam generators fluidly connected to the common tunnel where the ratio of coke ovens to standard heat recovery steam generators is at least 20:1, and a redundant heat recovery steam generator fluidly connected to the common tunnel where any one of the plurality of standard heat recovery steam generators and the redundant heat recovery steam generator is adapted to receive the exhaust gases from the plurality of ovens and extract heat from the exhaust gases and where the standard heat recovery steam generators and the redundant heat recovery steam generator are all connected in parallel with each other.

title_en: Reusable, water-resistant, adherable tape and use thereof
abstract_en: A tape is provided which is adherable in the absence of an adhesive layer and is water-resistant, the tape comprising a fabric layer which includes a first side and a second side and a mixture of beeswax, tree resin and jojoba oil, the mixture infusing the fabric layer and forming a first outer layer on the first side and a second outer layer on the second side, wherein the tape is between about a half inch to four inches in width and can be cut to length.

title_en: Methods for enhancing and maintaining effective permeability of induced fractures
abstract_en: Systems and methods for treating subterranean formations for treating subterranean formations using propellant fracturing and hydraulic fracturing to detonate and inject in sequential stages, A method comprises.disposing a propellant fracturing tool downhole into a well here; introducing a fracturing fluid into a work string coupled to the fluid: conduit to pressurize and set. an upper packer and a lower packer against the well bore; detonating sequentially a plurality of propellant band stages to produce one or more fractures; introducing: sequentially a series of treatment fluids Into a well bore penetrating at least a portion of a subterranean formation, wherein the sequential 'introduction of the series of treatment fluids occurs between the sequential detonation of the plurality of propellant band stages; and depositing at least a portion of the treatment fluids in at. least a portion of the subterranean formation.

title_en: Pressurised dispensing container
abstract_en: A pressurised dispensing container (10) comprising a container (11) for product to be dispensed, and a valve fixed to the container, wherein the container contains a propellant comprising 1, 1-difluoroethane or a derivative thereof and optionally ethanol. The valve comprises a valve stem (15), a valve body (16, 18) and one or more seals (20, 21), the valve stem being slidable within the valve body, the one or more seals co-operating with the valve stem for regulating discharge of a fluid. The valve further comprises a sealing gasket (14) for sealing the valve to the dispensing container. The one or more seals (20, 21) is/are formed from (i) an elastomeric composition, preferably an elastomeric composition comprising an ethylene-propylene-diene terpolymer. The sealing gasket (14) is formed from (ii) an elastomeric composition comprising an isobutylene polymer or co-polymer thereof.

title_en: Autonomous device for in-field conversion of biomass into biochar
abstract_en: Systems, methods and apparatus for the thermal conversion of biomass into biochar. A mobile platform may be used to maneuver a mobile biochar generation system within a field of biomass. The biomass may be harvested, preprocessed and pyrolyzed. After pyrolyzation, the biochar may be cooled to a predetermined temperature by integrating water and liquid nutrients into the biochar. The system may then control the application of the infused biochar by adjusting a spreading attachment and a plowing attachment.

title_en: Compositions for delivery of an element to a plant and methods of making same
abstract_en: The invention provides compositions comprising a polymeric carrier of cellulose and/or starch, and an element. The carrier is insoluble in water and a salt of the element is soluble or partially soluble in water. The compositions include at least about 5% (wt/wt) of the element, based on a total weight of the composition, and have particle sizes between about 0.05 mm and about 1.5 mm. Also provided are methods of making such compositions and methods for using the compositions to deliver the element to a plant.

title_en: Programmable non-explosive electronic initiator for rock blasting, and exothermic reaction and testing process of the initiator
abstract_en: The present development comprises a programmable non-explosive electronic initiator and an exothermic reaction and testing process of the initiator, the purpose whereof is to initiate, in a controlled and safe manner, the blasting of rock. Its application is principally in the mining and civil works sectors. This system solves a sensitive issue in the industry, namely the non-activation of the devices at the time of blasting (dud charges) and reducing the operating risks of fragmentation works, endowing the on-site operations with continuity. The foregoing is based on the fact that this initiator enables precise operation times for controlling vibrations by means of pre-set delays; immediately identifies non-operative initiators due to faulty lines or connections; as it has no explosive components, it can be programmed remotely if so desired by the user; and finally, each initiator is programmed as unique and unrepeatable.

title_en: Opto-electronic device comprising a patterning coating comprising a plurality of materials
abstract_en: A formulation and a layered semiconductor device comprising a patterning coating and a deposited layer. The formulation and the patterning coating may comprise a plurality of materials. In the formulation, each material may be a patterning material. The patterning coating may be provided in a first portion and the deposited layer may be provided in a second portion of a lateral aspect of the device. The patterning coating may be adapted to impact a propensity of a vapor flux of a deposited material to be condensed thereon. The deposited layer may comprise the deposited material.

title_en: Apparatus for producing filled film bags
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus for producing filled film bags (50). The apparatus comprises plate elements (9), each having at least one mold recess (10), a first processing station (1) with a deep-drawing arrangement (5) for deep-drawing a base film (11) into the mold recesses (10) in order to form filling cavities (13), a second processing station (2) with a filling arrangement (6) for filling the filling cavities (13) with a filling substance (14), and a third processing station (3) with a sealing arrangement (7) for sealing a cover film (12) onto the base film (11) while respectively forming a continuous circumferential seal edge (15) around each of the filling cavities (13). The third processing station (3) with the sealing arrangement (7) is followed by a fourth processing station (4) with a testing device (8) for optical acquisition and quality assessment of the seal edge (15). The testing device (8) comprises an optical camera (16), means for increasing the contrast of the images recorded by the camera (16), an illumination device (17), and an evaluation unit (18) for the images recorded by the camera (16).

title_en: Circular economy for plastic waste to polypropylene via refinery fcc unit
abstract_en: Provided is a continuous process for converting waste plastic into recycle for polypropylene polymerization. The process comprises selecting waste plastics containing polyethylene and/or polypropylene and preparing a stable blend of petroleum and the selected plastic. The amount of plastic in the blend comprises no more than 20 wt. % of the blend. The blend is passed to a refinery FCC unit. A liquid petroleum gas C3 olefin/paraffin mixture is recovered from the FCC unit. The C3 paraffins and C3 olefins are separated into different fractions with the C3 olefin fraction passed to a propylene polymerization reactor, and the C3 paraffin fraction passed optionally to a dehydrogenation unit to produce additional propylene.

title_en: Circular economy for plastic waste to polypropylene and base oil via refinery crude unit
abstract_en: Provided is a continuous process for converting waste plastic into recycle for polypropylene polymerization. The process comprises selecting waste plastics containing polyethylene and/or polypropylene and preparing a stable blend of petroleum and the selected plastic. The amount of plastic in the blend comprises no more than 20 wt. % of the blend. The blend is passed to a refinery crude unit. A liquid petroleum gas Cs olefin/paraffin mixture is recovered from the crude unit. The C3 paraffins and C3 olefins are separated into different fractions with the C3 olefin fraction passed to a propylene polymerization reactor, and the C3 paraffin fraction passed to a dehydrogenation unit to produce additional propylene. Product streams from the crude unit can also be passed to a hydrocracking unit, with a recovered heavy fraction then being passed to an isomerization dewaxing unit to prepare base oil.

title_en: Fuel borne catalyst composition for oxidative soot removal
abstract_en: The present invention provides fuel borne catalyst compositions for oxidative soot removal comprising a Ce (III) long-chain carboxylate in an organic solvent. Preferred embodiments provide a cerium composition for use as a soot reduction catalyst system, comprising: Ce (III) neodecanoate; Ce (III) carboxylate, wherein said carboxylate has a general formula RCOO-, wherein R is H or a C1 to C4 alkyl; neodecanoic acid; and an organic solvent.

title_en: Fabric conditioner composition free of softening agents other than bentonite
abstract_en: ABSTRACT Fabric compositions, such as fabric conditioner compositions for providing softening benefits to fabric are disclosed herein. In accordance with an aspect of the invention, provided is a fabric conditioner composition that includes from about 20 to about 70 wt.%, based on the total weight of the fabric conditioner composition, of a softening agent comprising a clay; from about 25 to about 70 wt.%, based on the total weight of the fabric conditioner composition, of a filler selected from a metal sulfate, a metal carbonate, and a combination of two or more thereof; and from about 1 to about 15 wt.%, based on the total weight of the fabric conditioner composition, of a polyol.

title_en: Acidic gas removal from a post combustion process stream
abstract_en: A method for removing acidic gases from a post combustion process stream, the method comprising the steps of: receiving the post combustion process stream into hollow fibres of at least one MBC cell, each hollow fibre gas permeable, liquid impermeable; passing a lean solvent in contact with an external surface of said hollow fibres; exchanging said acidic gas into the solvent through the hollow fibre; venting a treated lean gas stream; exiting an acidic gas rich solvent.

title_en: Water Washable Ink or Paint
abstract_en: Colored compositions are provided. The colored compositions include at least one non-aqueous solvent, at least one leuco dye, at least one developer compound, and, optionally, at least one thickener and at least one solvent. The colored compositions as described herein may be decolored when exposed to water or a water-containing liquid.

title_en: Process for preparing sulphur-containing soil improvers
abstract_en: A process for preparing an elemental sulphur-containing composition suitable for use as a fertilizer and/or soil improver comprises wet grinding elemental sulphur in a liquid to produce a micronized sulphur slurry for application to soil, and further comprises adding a prophylactic scavenging additive for fixing sulphur dioxide and hydrogen sulphide gases released downstream of the mill.

title_en: Tar gasification circulating device and gasification system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid fuel gasification and gasification collection and utilization, and provides a tar gasification circulating device which comprises a separator, a tar gasification pipe and a filtering device, wherein the separator, the tar gasification pipe and the filtering device are connected with a gasification furnace. The tar gasification channel is provided with a first liquid inlet, a first liquid outlet communicated with a drying chamber of the gasification furnace and a second gas outlet communicated with the gasification chamber of the gasification furnace, and a first flue gas outlet arranged on the flue gas channel is connected with the filtering device. The tar produced by the gasifier can be recycled to the gasifier, so that the tar is repeatedly cracked. The separator is provided with a first air inlet, a first air outlet and a first liquid outlet, wherein the first air inlet is used for being communicated with a drying chamber and a pyrolysis chamber which are arranged in the gasification furnace, the first air outlet is used for being connected with the gasification chamber which is arranged in the gasification furnace, and the first liquid outlet is communicated with the first liquid inlet. The separator filters and separates the mixed gas generated in the gasifier, removes the moisture in the mixed gas, and can improve the heat value of the fuel gas.

title_en: Composition containing hole carrier material and fluorine-containing polymer and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions comprising a hole carrier material, typically a conjugated polymer, and a fluoropolymer, ink compositions comprising a hole carrier material and a fluoropolymer, and their use, for example in organic electronic devices.

title_en: Functional essence suitable for heating non-combustion tobacco products
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tobacco, and particularly relates to a functional essence suitable for heating a non-combustion tobacco product. A functional flavoring suitable for heating non-combustible tobacco products, the functional flavoring comprises the following components by weight percent: 1-3% of m-dimethoxyphenol, 0-5% of p-dimethoxyphenol, 0.5-2% of 2, 6-dimethoxyphenol, 0-3% of p-ethylphenol, 1-5% of 2-isopropylphenol, 0-4% of 3, 4-dimethylphenol, 0-0.5% of m-dimethoxybenzene, 0-0.5% of p-dimethoxybenzene, 0-0.5% of 1-methyl-3-methoxy-4-isopropylbenzene, 1-3% of eugenol, 0-1% of isoeugenol, 0.5-2% of guaiacol and 0.5-1% of propenyl ethyl guaiacol; 70-90% of solvent. The functional spice of the invention has stable property, strong pertinence, convenient use and simple production process.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent material and device
abstract_en: The present application relates to organic electroluminescent materials and devices. Novel metal complexes are disclosed which contain a substituted fused aromatic moiety comprising a first ligand L  A  having a structure according to formula I:  Substituents on the fused aromatic moiety fine tune molecular energy levels and solid state self-assembly, contributing to improved material properties of devices useful in phosphorescent organic light emitting devices.

title_en: Sc-based carbonitride fluorescent powder and device containing same
abstract_en: The invention relates to Sc-based carbonitride fluorescent powder. The phosphor comprises an inorganic compound consisting of M 1 、Sc、M 2 N, C and a luminescence center Ce, the chemical formula of which is M 1   a Sc b M 2   c N d C e : xCe, wherein M 1 One or more selected from rare earth metal elements Y, La, Gd and Lu, M 2 One or more elements selected from Si, Al, Ga and B; a is more than 0 and less than 2, b is more than 0 and less than 2, c is more than 3 and less than or equal to 5, and d is more than or equal to 5<7, e is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2, and x is more than 0 and less than or equal to 0.2. The invention also relates to a device containing the fluorescent powder and a preparation method of the fluorescent powder. The fluorescent powder has the advantages of high efficiency, uniformity, no impurity phase and the like, and the preparation method is simple and easy to industrialize, and is particularly suitable for ultraviolet-violet excited white light LEDs.

title_en: Method for improving corrosion resistance of desulfurization dust remover shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the corrosion resistance of a desulfurization dust remover shell, which comprises the following operation steps: (1) cleaning the surface of the outer shell of the desulfurization dust remover, and then brushing primer on the surface; (2) and then coating two layers of high-temperature-resistant anticorrosive paint on the surface of the outer shell of the desulfurization dust remover. The method for improving the corrosion resistance of the shell of the desulfurization dust remover is simple to operate and low in cost, the surface of the treated desulfurization dust remover has excellent wear resistance, high temperature resistance and oxidation resistance, and the service life of the shell of the desulfurization dust remover is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Preparation method of luminous adjustable copper-doped zinc sulfide quantum dot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a light-emitting adjustable copper-doped zinc sulfide quantum dot, and belongs to the technical field of synthesis of nano-scale solid light-emitting materials. According to the method, zinc acetate is used as a zinc source, copper sulfate is used as a copper source, mercaptopropionic acid or thioglycolic acid is used as a stabilizer and a sulfur source, the three substances are uniformly dispersed in deionized water, the pH value is adjusted to be alkaline to obtain a precursor solution, and the precursor solution is subjected to microwave reactor-assisted heating reaction to control different reaction times to prepare the copper-doped zinc sulfide quantum dots with adjustable luminescence. The obtained quantum dots have uniform particle size, good water solubility and high fluorescence stability, the fluorescence emission peak of the quantum dots is adjustable between 500-595nm, and the quantum dots can be widely applied to the fields of fluorescence sensors, biological imaging, construction of solar cells and optical devices and the like. Compared with the traditional synthesis method, the method takes the protective agent as the sulfur source, and avoids various defects of extra introduction of the sulfur source, complex operation, environmental problems and the like. The copper-doped zinc sulfide quantum dots with adjustable luminescence are simply and rapidly prepared through simple mixed reaction raw materials after one-step microwave-assisted reaction, and the regulation of the fluorescence emission peak within the wide range of 500-595nm is realized through controlling the reaction time.

title_en: Catalytic cracking catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A catalytic cracking catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The catalytic cracking catalyst comprises the following components in percentage by mass of 100 percent of the catalyst: 10-50% of zeolite molecular sieve, 5-40% of binder and 20-70% of mesoporous rare earth pillared clay material; wherein, the mesoporous rare earth pillared clay material is obtained by the following method: mixing a block polymer template agent, acid, clay and water, stirring at 40-60 ℃ for 12-24 hours, and filtering to obtain a filter cake, wherein the addition amount of the block polymer template agent is 2-20% of the mass of the clay; mixing and pulping the obtained filter cake with ethanol and rare earth salt, wherein the rare earth salt is calculated by the mass of the rare earth oxide, and the adding amount of the rare earth salt is 1-10% of the mass of the clay; and drying the obtained slurry, and roasting the obtained solid at 400-700 ℃ for 2-6 h to obtain the final mesoporous rare earth pillared clay. The catalyst has excellent heavy oil catalytic cracking and heavy metal pollution resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of ternary nano composite wave-absorbing material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a ternary nano composite wave-absorbing material, which takes terbium oxide, europium oxide, barium nitrate and ferric nitrate as raw materials, prepares terbium and europium codoped barium ferrite nano particles by a coprecipitation method, then obtains a binary compound of the polyaniline-coated terbium and europium codoped barium ferrite nano particles by an in-situ polymerization method, and finally uniformly mixes graphene oxide and the binary nano compound in an aqueous solution, and takes hydrazine hydrate as a reducing agent to obtain the ternary nano composite wave-absorbing material. The method is simple, easy to operate and low in cost, and the prepared wave-absorbing material is high in dielectric loss and magnetic loss, wide in wave-absorbing frequency band and good in wave-absorbing performance, and has great potential application value in the field of wave absorption.

title_en: Aqueous coating composition and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an aqueous coating composition comprising a multi-step aqueous emulsion polymer, anionic colloidal silica and a thickener. The aqueous coating composition provides low gloss while maintaining good physical stability and clarity.

title_en: Electrorheological fluid and electrical equipment
abstract_en: An electrorheological fluid comprising particles for electrorheological fluid in an amount of 10 to 50 vol% in a dispersion medium having a fluorine atom content of more than 0 wt% and not more than 50.0 wt% based on the total volume of the dispersion medium and the particles for electrorheological fluid, wherein the particles contain a sulfonic acid group-containing polymer having a sulfonic acid group content of 30 to 70 wt%.

title_en: Composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises water, a polyurethane polymer and a water-soluble salt of a chelating agent; the polyurethane polymer comprises hydrolyzable groups, the polyurethane polymer being the reaction product of reaction components comprising: component a) an isocyanate, component B) an isocyanate-reactive group containing compound comprising at least one group that can form said hydrolyzable group, optionally component C) an emulsifier, optionally component D) a solvent, and optionally component E) a reactive diluent; the water-soluble salt of the chelating agent is present in an amount of 0.04 to 1.8% by weight, based on 100% by weight of the polyurethane polymer; the water-soluble salt of the chelating agent comprises a water-soluble monovalent salt of a chelating agent, and the content of the water-soluble monovalent salt of the chelating agent is not less than 30 wt% based on 100 wt% of the weight of the water-soluble salt of the chelating agent.

title_en: Fully-synthetic water-based antirust complexing agent as well as evaluation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fully-synthetic water-based antirust compound agent as well as an evaluation method and application thereof, wherein the fully-synthetic water-based antirust compound agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-20 parts of organic antirust agent, 0.2-8 parts of inorganic antirust agent, 5-25 parts of organic base, 0.005-5 parts of lubricating antirust additive and the balance of water. The fully-synthetic water-based antirust complexing agent disclosed by the invention is green and environment-friendly, has excellent antirust performance, and can be used for inter-process antirust of ferrous metals; meanwhile, the lubricating oil has certain lubricating and wear-resisting properties and can be used for grinding ferrous metals.

title_en: Novel hard carbon black reacting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel stereoplasm carbon black reacting furnace, air distributor, gas distributor, burning zone and the straight section axial coaxial sealing connection of choke form the carbon black reacting furnace body, the panel central point of carbon black reacting furnace body puts the axial level and is equipped with the raw materials oil gun, the muzzle of raw materials oil gun is in deep to the straight section front 200-300mm department of choke. The invention has the technical effects that: under the condition of not changing the reaction furnace body, carbon black with different types can be produced, the requirement on the quality of raw oil can be reduced by adopting the reaction furnace to produce the carbon black, the production cost of enterprises is reduced, the product has high coloring intensity and high compression oil absorption value, the quality requirement of the all-steel radial tire can be met, and the preheated air, the coal gas and the raw oil do not damage the reaction furnace body in the combustion reaction process, so that the service life of the reaction furnace is prolonged.

title_en: Fungicidal or bactericidal composition and method for controlling diseases
abstract_en: Novel compositions for bactericides or bactericides are provided. A composition for a bactericide or bactericide, which comprises an oxime-substituted amide compound represented by the formula (I), an N-oxide thereof or a salt thereof as an active ingredient A, and a bactericidal or bactericidal compound as an active ingredient B. [ formula 1] [G 1 Represents G 1 Structure of-1, G 2 Represents G 2 -1, W represents an oxygen atom or the like, X 1 Represents difluoromethyl or the like, X 2 、X 3 、X 4 And X 5 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom or the like, Y 1 Represents a halogen atom or the like, Y 2 Represents a hydrogen atom or the like, Y 3 Represents a halogen atom or the like, Y 4 Represents a hydrogen atom or the like, R 1 Is represented by C 1 ～C 6 Alkyl, etc., R 2 And R 3 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom or the like, R 4 Represents a hydrogen atom or the like, R 5 Represents a methyl group.]。

title_en: Thickening composition for glufosinate-ammonium and methoxone and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a thickening composition for glufosinate-ammonium and methoxone and preparation and application thereof, and relates to the field of pesticide chemistry. The thickening composition consists of the following components: 1-3% of pyrrolidine ammonium dithiocarbamate, 15-55% of surfactant, 1-5% of salt and the balance of water; the surfactant is one or two of (A) and (B). A method of making the thickened composition comprising: adding water into the ammonium pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate and the surfactant according to the formula amount, heating to 40-50 ℃, stirring until the solid is dissolved, adding the salt according to the formula amount, and stirring until a uniform system is obtained. The thickening composition is specially used for a water aqua of glufosinate-ammonium and methoxone, can improve the adhesion of liquid medicine on leaf surfaces, reduce the loss of the medicine caused by mutual collision and friction of plant leaves due to rain wash and wind blowing, improve the use effect, and has a simple and efficient preparation method.

title_en: Improvement and conservation method for acidic tobacco planting soil
abstract_en: The invention provides an improvement and conservation method of acid tobacco-planting soil, and relates to improvement and conservation of acid soilThe technical field of sports comprises the following specific steps: (1) preparing a modifier, (2) finishing tobacco fields, namely applying the modifier to the acidic tobacco planting soil for 2-3cm, turning over and mixing with a plough layer, scattering phosphogypsum powder into the turned acidic tobacco planting soil, turning over for the second time, inserting pipes into the fields, wherein the density of the inserted pipes into the fields is 1 root/3 m 3 Meanwhile, spraying warm water to cut weeds, and then spreading the cut weeds on the acidic tobacco-planting soil, covering for 4-8 days, (3) fertilizing: during the weed covering period, compound fertilizer mixed liquor is poured into the inserting pipe every day, and after the fertilization is finished, the pipe is pulled out and turned over for three times, so that the improvement and the conservation are finished.

title_en: Wearable fetal movement and uterine contraction monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable fetal movement and uterine contraction monitoring device, which comprises a belt body and a sensor arranged in the belt body, wherein the belt body is provided with a belt body; the belt body comprises an outer layer baffle, an inner layer baffle and a bottom layer belt body which are sequentially arranged; the sensor is characterized in that a positioning and mounting belt used for fixedly mounting the sensor is arranged on the bottom layer belt body, the inner layer baffle is pressed on two sides of the surface of the sensor, the inner layer baffle is connected with the surface of the bottom layer belt body through a magic tape or a snap fastener, and the outer layer baffle is pressed on the inner layer baffle. The invention can monitor the fetal condition in real time during non-obstetric examination of pregnant women, can lighten the burden of manually counting fetal movements of the pregnant women, reduces counting errors, is convenient to wear and is convenient for the pregnant women to use in various environments. The length of the wearable fetal movement and uterine contraction monitoring device is convenient to adjust, so that different users or the same user can use the device in different periods. The invention has simple structure, convenient use and good application prospect.

title_en: Household garbage cascade utilization system and method based on double-bed pyrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a household garbage cascade utilization system and method based on double-bed pyrolysis, comprising a circulating fluidized bed combustion system for fully oxidizing and burning garbage coke to generate steam for heating or generating power; the fixed bed garbage pyrolysis system is used for converting the dried household garbage into coke and synthesis gas; the synthesis gas treatment system is used for cooling and purifying the synthesis gas, separating impurities such as tar and the like and obtaining combustible gas. According to the invention, the garbage coke is combusted instead of pulverized coal, the coal consumption is reduced, the household garbage is efficiently treated, the tar, the combustible gas and the thermoelectric products are produced through the coupled combustion and pyrolysis processes, the pyrolysis temperature can be regulated and controlled based on market demands, different product distribution is obtained, and the cascade utilization of the garbage is realized.

title_en: High-wear-resistance high-gloss UV coating for PC (polycarbonate) substrate of automotive interior optical part and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-wear-resistance high-gloss UV coating for a PC (polycarbonate) substrate of an automotive interior optical part, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 35-55 parts of polyurethane acrylic resin A, 10-20 parts of polyurethane acrylic resin B, 5-15 parts of 1, 6-hexanediol diacrylate, 5-10 parts of a wear-resistant auxiliary agent, 1-3 parts of a leveling agent, 1-2 parts of an ultraviolet absorbent, 2-5 parts of a photoinitiator, 10-20 parts of a solvent and 40-60 parts of a diluent, wherein the functionalities of the polyurethane acrylic resin A and the polyurethane acrylic resin B are respectively 6-8 and 3.5-4. The coating can be directly coated on the PC surface, not only meets the conventional paint performances such as chemical resistance, weather resistance and the like required by automobile interior decoration, but also meets the light transmittance required by optical parts, and has the greatest advantage of meeting the requirement of high wear resistance which passes the test of GMW14444-2014(ASTM D-1044).

title_en: Environment-friendly lubricating grease with high lubricating performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly lubricating grease with high lubricating property, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 85 parts of base oil, 20 parts of 12-hydroxystearic acid, 8 parts of lithium hydroxide powder, 1 part of composite heat stabilizer, 0.4 part of auxiliary heat stabilizer, 0.5 part of carboxymethyl cellulose, 1 part of sodium dodecyl sulfate, 1 part of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, 0.3 part of antioxidant, 0.3 part of graphite and 0.3 part of glycerol; wherein the base oil is formed by mixing epoxidized soybean oil and chlorinated paraffin in a mass ratio of 7:3, the composite heat stabilizer comprises peanut oil and tea tree oil in a mass ratio of 2:1, and the auxiliary heat stabilizer comprises calcium silicate, zinc oxide and aluminum oxide in a mass ratio of 3:2: 2. Simultaneously provides a preparation method of the environment-friendly lubricating grease with high lubricating performance. The lubricating property provided by the invention has high lubricating property, good biodegradability and small environmental pollution.

title_en: Zinc zinc complex of mercaptopyridine resorcinol calix [4] arene and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses mercaptopyridine resorcinol calix [4]]An aromatic zinc complex of the formula [ Zn 2 (m‑bdc) 2 (L)]·8DMF·2CH 3 OH, the DMF is N,N -dimethylformamide; and the preparation method comprises the following steps: 0.012g,0.04mmol of Zn (NO) 3 ) 2 ·6H 2 O, 0.007 g,0.04mmol of isophthalic acid and 0.012g,0.10mmol of ligand L are added into a reaction kettle, 5mL of DMF and 3 mL of methanol are taken as reaction solventsHeating at 100 deg.C for 3 days; the complex has a layered structure, and has strong synthesis repeatability and stable product performance; as a heterogeneous catalyst, the catalyst has high catalytic efficiency; the complex can selectively detect Cr 2 O 7   2‑ Anion and Fe 3+ A metal cation.

title_en: Method for discharging liquid and producing gas by adopting solid oil-resistant foam water discharging agent composition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for draining liquid and producing gas by adopting a solid oil-resistant foam water discharging agent composition. The foam drainage agent mainly solves the problems that the existing foam drainage agent has insufficient foam oil resistance, poor foam drainage performance and difficult filling of the liquid foam drainage agent in the development process of a condensate oil-gas well. The invention adopts a liquid drainage gas production method, which comprises the following steps: 1) throwing the foam scrubbing agent composition into an aqueous gas well; 2) contacting the foam scrubbing composition with a gas and water or oil-water mixture in an aqueous gas well to form a foamed fluid, and then lifting the foamed fluid to the surface; wherein the foam scrubbing agent composition comprises the following components: 1)1 part of alkylamine polyether benzene sulfonate; 2) 0.1-50 parts of a long-chain polyether nitrogen-containing compound; 3) 0.2-100 parts of solid filler; 4) the technical scheme of 0-0.5 part of adhesive well solves the problem and can be used in the drainage and gas production industry of gas wells. 。

title_en: Water-soluble fertilizer synergistic composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A water-soluble fertilizer synergistic composition and a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of water-soluble fertilizers, and the water-soluble fertilizer synergistic composition comprises, by weight, 10% -20% of L-arabinose, 10% -20% of D-galactose, 4% -6% of L-rhamnose, 4% -6% of D-glucuronic acid, 15% -18% of glutamic acid, 25% -35% of citric acid, 10% -15% of betaine, 1% -1.2% of vitamin C, and vitamin B 1 0.1% -0.3%, vitamin B 3 0.2% -0.5%, vitamin B 6 0.1% -0.3%, vitamin B 12 0.01 to 0.05 percent. The water-soluble fertilizer synergistic composition has the effects of balancing nutrition, effectively avoiding antagonism among elements and facilitating absorption and transportation of nutrient elements; meanwhile, the fertilizer has the effects of improving plant resistance, conditioning soil and improving the utilization rate of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. The synergistic composition of the fertilizer has the advantages of simple production process, convenient use and contribution to large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Water-repellent substrate
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a base material which is less likely to have reduced water repellency even when used in an environment exposed to ultraviolet light for a long period of time. The present invention relates to a substrate having a surface-treated layer, wherein a static contact angle of water after an accelerated weather resistance test performed under the following conditions for 400 hours is 100 degrees or more.<Conditions for accelerated weather resistance test>UVB-313 lamp (irradiance at 310nm of 0.63W/m) was used 2 ) The surface treatment layer of the substrate was wiped with water and ethanol every 24 hours of irradiation and dried, assuming that the distance between the lamp and the surface treatment layer was 5 cm.

title_en: Conductive adhesive for anti-aging solar laminated tile assembly and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive adhesive for an anti-aging solar laminated tile assembly and a preparation method thereof, and solves the problems that the existing conductive adhesive technology is poor in damp-heat aging resistance, and the contact resistance is obviously increased along with the aging time under the aging condition of 85 ℃ and 85%. The invention comprises 15-25% of acrylate prepolymer, 10-30% of acrylate monomer, 1-5% of anti-aging auxiliary agent, 1-5% of bonding auxiliary agent, 0.3-1.5% of initiator and 40-65% of conductive filler. The invention has excellent ageing resistance, high bonding strength, lower volume resistance and contact resistance and very obvious effect.

title_en: Graphene oxide composite hydroxyapatite sulfur-loaded quantum dot antibacterial coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sulfur quantum dot-loaded graphene oxide composite hydroxyapatite antibacterial coating, which comprises a substrate, wherein the substrate is covered with a composite coating, and the composite coating is prepared by compounding graphene oxide with hydroxyapatite and loading sulfur quantum dots. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing a substrate; s2, preparing a graphene oxide composite hydroxyapatite coating; s3, preparing a sulfur quantum dot solution; s4, loading the sulfur quantum dots in a vacuum environment, and thus obtaining the composite coating with antibacterial performance. The coating provided by the invention is convenient to prepare, has excellent antibacterial performance, does not cause bacteria to generate drug resistance, has good biocompatibility and can be applied to medical implant materials.

title_en: Silicon carbide fiber containing nano aluminum nitride and metal nickel, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon carbide fiber containing nano aluminum nitride and metallic nickel, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, nitrogen, aluminum and nickel elements are introduced in the preparation process of the silicon carbide fiber, and the alumina introduced in the early stage of the preparation process has high-temperature fluidity at high temperature, so that the growth of beta-silicon carbide can be inhibited by utilizing the property, and the alumina can heal surface cracks in the sintering process of the silicon carbide fiber to a certain extent, so that the silicon carbide fiber has excellent mechanical properties; the alumina is converted into the aluminum nitride at the later stage, and the material has stable property under the high-temperature condition by virtue of high thermal conductivity; in addition, metal nickel is added, so that the resistivity of the fiber is greatly reduced due to the increase of the content of nickel element, and the conductivity and the electromagnetic shielding property of the silicon carbide fiber can be enhanced; finally, the prepared silicon carbide fiber has stable high-temperature performance, can be used as a structural microwave absorbent, and shows good application prospects in the fields of aerospace, weaponry and the like.

title_en: Polyisocyanate composition, blocked polyisocyanate composition, hydrophilic polyisocyanate composition, coating composition and coating film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polyisocyanate composition and the like, which comprises a polyisocyanate compound represented by the general formula (I), (II), (III) or (IV) (wherein a plurality of R exist 11 、R 21 、R 31 And R 41 Each independently is an organic group, there being a plurality of R 11 、R 21 、R 31 And R 41 At least one of them is a general formula (V) (in the formula, there are plural Y' s 1 Each independently a single bond, etc. R 51 Hydrogen atom, etc. Wavy line means a bond) and the like. In the general formula (III), R 32 A residue obtained by removing 1 hydroxyl group from a monohydric or higher alcohol).

title_en: Offshore drilling rod device with rubber air spring capable of being continuously used
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore drilling rod device with a continuously usable rubber air spring, which comprises a drilling rod, a drilling rod lifting device and the rubber air spring, wherein the rubber air spring comprises an upper cover plate, a lower cover plate and a rubber air bag, the upper cover plate, the lower cover plate and the air bag form a closed space, and a gas generating device is arranged in the closed space; the gas generating device is internally provided with a gas generating agent, the top end of the drill rod is fixedly connected with the lower cover plate, and the drill rod lifting device is fixedly connected with the upper cover plate. The invention improves the existing offshore drilling rod device, a rubber air spring is arranged between the drilling rod lifting device and the drilling rod, when the offshore drilling rod device is used at ordinary times, the upper cover plate of the rubber air spring is meshed with the edge gear of the lower cover plate, the normal operation of the offshore drilling rod device is not affected, the rubber air spring is inflated in severe weather such as typhoons, and the like, the drilling rod is prevented from being broken and damaged due to severe shaking, and meanwhile, the gas generating agent supply device is arranged in the rubber air spring and can be used continuously.

title_en: Warm white light sign convenient to change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a warm white-light signboard convenient to replace, which comprises a signboard body and a fixed plate, wherein the fixed plate is arranged on the back of the signboard body, one end of the fixed plate is hinged with the label body, a display cavity is arranged in the label body, more than one display board is arranged in the display cavity, one side of the sign body corresponding to the display cavity is provided with an LED lamp for emitting warm white light, the LED lamp is made of dodecafluoro germanate red light materials, the display board is hollowed out, light of the LED lamp penetrates through the hollowed-out position of the display board, the other side of the signboard body, which is opposite to the fixed plate, is provided with a clamping groove, a transparent shielding plate which is matched with the clamping groove is arranged in the clamping groove, the sign body one end is provided with the opening, the opening with show chamber, the draw-in groove is linked together, the opening part is provided with dustproof spare. By adopting the technical scheme, the manufacturing is convenient and easy, the manufacturing cost is low, and the replacement cost is low.

title_en: Styrene and organic phosphaphenanthrene methylene acrylate block copolymer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A styrene and organic phosphaphenanthrene methylene acrylate block copolymer and a preparation method thereof relate to a preparation method of the block copolymer. The flame retardant is used for solving the technical problem that the flame retardant property retention period of the benzene plate is short due to poor compatibility or volatility of the conventional flame retardant for the benzene plate and a matrix. The structural formula of the block copolymer is as follows: wherein m is 150-300, and n is 20-60. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a polystyrene macromolecular initiator by using styrene as a raw material, alpha-ethyl bromoisobutyrate as an initiator, cuprous bromide as a catalyst and N, N, N' -pentamethyldiethylenetriamine as a ligand through an atom transfer polymerization method; secondly, carrying out atom transfer reaction on the polystyrene macroinitiator and the organic phosphaphenanthrene methylene acrylic ester to prepare the flame-retardant block copolymer. The organic phosphaphenanthrene methylene acrylic ester is fixed in polystyrene macromolecules, can be permanently flame-retardant and is used in the field of polystyrene board materials.

title_en: Scale inhibition proppant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a scale inhibition proppant and a preparation method thereof. The apparent density of the scale inhibition proppant is 1.00-1.08g/cm 3 The bulk density is 0.40-0.50g/cm 3 The scale inhibition proppant comprises the following raw material components by taking the total weight of the raw material components as 100 percent: 40-55% of chemically modified first powder material, 20-33% of chemically modified second powder material, 15-20% of prepolymer of thermosetting resin adhesive, 2-4% of organic solvent, 0.1-2% of pore-forming agent and 0.1-2% of scale inhibitor. The technical scheme provided by the invention is simple and convenient, the industrial production is easy to realize, and the effective scale inhibition volume ratio V of the prepared scale inhibition proppant water /V proppan Not less than 800, and apparent density less than 1.20g/cm 3 Volume density of less than 0.60g/cm 3 It can be used for supporting and inhibiting the scale of the oil and gas reservoir fracture.

title_en: Water-based adhesive remover safe to coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based adhesive remover safe to a coating, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 1 to 5 percent of pH regulator; 0.5 to 2 percent of corrosion inhibitor; 1 to 5 percent of accelerant; 25 to 40 percent of swelling agent; 25 to 40 percent of penetrant; 10% -15% of solubilizer; 5 to 10 percent of emulsifier; 10 to 20 percent of water. The degumming agent can maintain the pH of the system in a weakly alkaline environment through the pH regulator, and promotes the permeation and swelling of the compound solvent system on the residual gum by utilizing the anions and cations hydrolyzed by the electrolyte, so that the residual gum of the workpiece is removed in an environment-friendly and efficient manner on the premise of ensuring the safety of a plating layer. The adhesive removing performance of the adhesive removing agent is obviously superior to that of the traditional solvent type adhesive removing agent, and the adhesive removing agent has no pungent smell, is not easy to burn and explode, and is safe and environment-friendly. Compared with the strong acid and strong base type adhesive remover, the adhesive remover has the advantages that the safety of the coating is obviously exceeded, and the adhesive can be removed without damaging the coating.

title_en: Anisotropic conductive film, composition for forming the same, and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anisotropic conductive film, a composition for forming the same and application thereof. The composition comprises: the film-forming resin composition comprises a film-forming resin, conductive particles, a radical polymerizable compound and a ketoxime ester type photopolymerization initiator, wherein the ketoxime ester type photopolymerization initiator has a structure represented by the formula (I). The ketoxime ester type photopolymerization initiator with the structure shown in the formula (I) is added, so that the composition has high photoinitiation activity, can be cured at a low temperature or without heating, has relatively complete curing degree and low on-resistance, and has excellent electrical connection performance. In addition, the ketoxime ester type photopolymerization initiator has the advantage of being less prone to migration due to its relatively high molecular weight, so that an anisotropic conductive film formed by using the composition has excellent adhesion compared with the conventional anisotropic conductive film.

title_en: Hydrogenation modification and hydrofining combined process for inferior diesel oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined process of hydrogenation modification and hydrofining of poor diesel oil. Firstly, fractionating a diesel raw material into a light fraction and a heavy fraction, and extracting the light fraction by aromatic hydrocarbon to obtain a light aromatic hydrocarbon fraction and a light non-aromatic fraction; the heavy fraction enters a hydrofining reactor, and a material passing through a first hydrofining catalyst bed layer is divided into two parts; one material is pumped out of the refining reactor and mixed with the light aromatic hydrocarbon fraction, and then enters a supplementary hydrogenation refining reactor for supplementary hydrogenation reaction; the other material and light non-aromatic fraction are mixed and then continuously flow downwards through a hydrofining catalyst bed layer at the lower part, the hydrofining material flow continuously enters a hydro-upgrading reactor, and the obtained hydro-upgrading reaction material and the supplementary hydro-upgrading reaction material are respectively subjected to gas-liquid separation and fractionation to obtain a high-quality diesel product and a high-quality FCC feed. The invention provides a hydrogenation combined process for simultaneously producing more than two different-purpose diesel fractions on one set of hydrogenation process device for the first time.

title_en: Polyurethane sealant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyurethane sealant and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of buildings, wherein the polyurethane sealant comprises the following raw materials: 20-40 parts of polyurethane prepolymer, 10-30 parts of plasticizer, 0-3 parts of latent curing agent and 0.01-1 part of catalyst; wherein the raw materials for forming the polyurethane prepolymer comprise xylylene diisocyanate. The polyurethane sealant can achieve good ageing resistance, does not need to add an anti-aging agent, has long service life, and is particularly suitable for adhering prefabricated product components for assembled buildings.

title_en: Hydrocracking catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrocracking catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The hydrocracking catalyst is a bulk phase catalyst and comprises a hydrogenation active metal component and a carrier component, wherein the hydrogenation active metal component is WO 3 And NiO, after vulcanization, WS 2 An average number of stacked layers of 5.0 to 7.0, WS 2 The average length of the lamella is 4.0-6.0 nm. The catalyst is prepared by the steps of carrying out a gel-forming reaction on a mixed solution A containing Ni, W and Al components and a precipitator in a parallel flow manner, aging the obtained slurry, adding a mixed solution B containing W, Si and Al components and the precipitator in the parallel flow manner into the aged slurry for reaction, adding a suspension of a molecular sieve, aging, and carrying out post-treatment. The hydrocracking catalyst is suitable for medium oil type hydrocracking catalysts, and has good activity and selectivity.

title_en: High-toughness high-temperature-resistant impact-resistant road material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-toughness high-temperature-resistant impact-resistant road material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: soaking pretreated poly (p-phenylene benzobisoxazole) fibers in an ethylenediamine methanol solution to obtain ammoniated poly (p-phenylene benzobisoxazole) fibers; step two, mixing the aminated poly-p-phenylene benzobisoxazole fiber prepared in the step one with acrylic ester for addition reaction to obtain acrylic ester-poly-p-phenylene benzobisoxazole fiber; step three, grafting the acrylate-poly (p-phenylene benzobisoxazole) fiber prepared in the step two with hyperbranched polysiloxane to prepare modified poly (p-phenylene benzobisoxazole) fiber; and step four, uniformly spreading and flatly spreading the modified poly-p-phenylene benzobisoxazole fibers prepared in the step three to form fibers, adding a curing agent into epoxy resin to prepare a casting material, uniformly casting the casting material on a flatly laid fiber framework, and curing to prepare the high-toughness high-temperature-resistant impact-resistant road material.

title_en: Pyrazole oxime ester compound containing pyridine-difluoride pyrazole structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pyrazole oxime ester compound (I) containing a pyridine-difluoride pyrazole structure and a preparation method and application thereof. Is obtained by condensing chloropyridyl polyfluoropyrazole formyl chloride (II) and pyrazole oxime (III). The pyrazole oxime ester compound containing the pyridine-difluoride pyrazole structure has an effective control effect on harmful insects, and can be used for preparing pesticides in the fields of agriculture, horticulture and the like.

title_en: Paint removing composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a paint removing composition and a preparation method thereof. The paint removing composition comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-70 parts of main solvent, 20-40 parts of cosolvent, 1-20 parts of accelerator and 0.01-5 parts of corrosion inhibitor, wherein the main solvent is selected from at least one of dichloromethane, trichloromethane, dichloropropane, N-methylpyrrolidone, N-dimethylformamide and dimethyl sulfoxide, the cosolvent is selected from at least one of aliphatic alcohol and aromatic alcohol, and the accelerator is selected from at least one of acid and phenol. The paint removing composition has high paint removing efficiency and light corrosion to the base material.

title_en: Method for preparing carbon quantum dots based on straws and application
abstract_en: A method for preparing carbon quantum dots based on straws is characterized in that biomass straws are used as a carbon source, and blue fluorescent carbon dots are obtained by high-temperature calcination, water dissolution and filtration. The method comprises the following steps: crushing the washed rice straws by using a crusher, washing the rice straws for three times by using absolute ethyl alcohol, drying the rice straws, taking 1g of the dried straw powder, putting the dried straw powder into a crucible, putting the crucible into a muffle furnace, calcining the mixture for 30-90min at 350-450 ℃ in an air atmosphere, taking the sample out of the muffle furnace, adding distilled water, vibrating the sample for 30-90min by using ultrasonic waves, filtering the vibrated sample by using a 0.22 mu m filter membrane to obtain an orange solution, freeze-drying the orange solution, preparing a carbon quantum dot solution, and using the carbon quantum dot solution for the selective detection of ferric ions in water.

title_en: Light-operated plant disease control agent containing 1,3, 4-oxadiazole azobenzene and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pesticide bactericides and discloses a light-operated plant disease control agent containing 1,3, 4-oxadiazole azobenzene and application thereof. The control agent has a structure shown as a chemical structural formula I, wherein X is F, Cl or Br; the synthesis method comprises the steps of oxidation cyclization, reduction, diazotization coupling and methylation reaction in sequence. The structure can generate photoisomerization after being irradiated by ultraviolet light, and the trans-configuration with low activity is converted into the cis-configuration with high activity, so that the drug activity can be regulated and controlled as required. After stopping light stimulation, the high-activity cis-structure can automatically weaken the activity along with the prolonging of time, and the accumulation of the active medicine in the environment can be reduced. The invention can overcome the defects of the traditional chemical pesticide bactericide which has high residue and is easy to generate drug resistance.

title_en: Electrostatic spraying anti-rust oil for cold-rolled steel sheets and preparation and performance test methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides electrostatic spraying anti-rust oil for a cold-rolled steel plate and a preparation method and a performance test method thereof, wherein the electrostatic spraying anti-rust oil for the cold-rolled steel plate comprises the following components in parts by weight: 70-90 parts of base oil; 5-20 parts of an antirust agent; 0.5-10 parts of film forming agent; 0.5-5 parts of cosolvent; 0.1-2 parts of antioxidant; all the components account for 100 parts; the rust inhibitor comprises Deo Add C111 and calcium petroleum sulfonate.
