According to the electrostatic spraying anti-rust oil for the cold-rolled steel sheet, the De Add C111, the calcium petroleum sulfonate and the film-forming agent are compounded, so that the wet-heat anti-rust and salt-fog anti-rust capabilities are obviously improved, and the comprehensive performance is excellent.

title_en: Biomass sugar alcohol hydrogenolysis catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysts, and particularly relates to a biomass sugar alcohol hydrogenolysis catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The application provides a biomass sugar alcohol hydrogenolysis catalyst comprising: a CMK-3 mesoporous carbon support; ru loaded on a CMK-3 mesoporous carbon carrier; mo loaded on a CMK-3 mesoporous carbon carrier; the loading of Ru is 1.0-5.0 wt%; the loading of Mo is 1.0-10 wt%. The application also provides a preparation method of the compound, which comprises the following steps: and mixing the CMK-3 mesoporous carbon carrier, the ruthenium acetylacetonate solution and the molybdenum acetylacetonate solution, and then drying and roasting the mixture in sequence to prepare the biomass sugar alcohol hydrogenolysis catalyst. The application also discloses application of the biomass sugar alcohol hydrogenolysis catalyst in preparation of alcohol compounds by catalyzing biomass sugar alcohol aqueous solution. The catalyst of the application fills the vacancy of the prior art which lacks a catalyst for catalytically synthesizing alcohols with two or more carbon atoms.

title_en: Silver nanocluster fluorescent nanorod, preparation method thereof and application thereof in white light LED
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silver nanocluster fluorescent nanorod, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a white light LED (light-emitting diode), wherein the fluorescent nanorod is made of Ag 9 Self-assembled with hydrochloric acid in aqueous solution. Ag prepared by the invention 9 The fluorescent nanorod has outstanding optical property, the excellent fluorescence property is still kept after the fluorescent nanorod is freeze-dried into powder, the LED emitting orange-red light and good in stability can be manufactured, and meanwhile, the fluorescent nanorod is mixed with commercial blue and green fluorescent powder according to the mass ratio of 10:5:1 to prepare the LED emitting white light. The luminous silver clusters can successfully replace the light conversion material of the traditional material, and provide possibility for preparing environment-friendly LEDs. The preparation method of the silver nanocluster fluorescent nanorod is simple and low in cost; the prepared LED has excellent luminous intensity and meets the requirement of environmental protection.

title_en: Acrylic emulsion with wide particle size distribution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of acrylic emulsion with wide particle size distribution, which adopts a production process of a seed emulsion polymerization and circulating dropping method, wherein the polymerized seed emulsion is continuously returned to a pre-emulsion tank and continuously dropped into a reaction tank together with a pre-emulsified monomer, and the particle size of the seed emulsion is adjusted to obtain the acrylic emulsion. The emulsion particle size is continuously distributed, the emulsions with different particle sizes are mutually filled to reach the maximum accumulation, and the problem of poor stability caused by too large particle size difference or emulsion with large particle size can not occur.

title_en: Preparation method of mineral source potassium fulvate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of mineral source potassium fulvate, which comprises the following steps of a, extracting free humic acid from minerals by alkali; b, extracting binding-state humic acid from the residue in the step a by using acid; c, combining the humic acid and converting the humic acid into potassium humate by using a potassium hydroxide solution; and d, adding hydrogen peroxide to oxidize the potassium humate into potassium fulvate. The method can effectively extract the binding-state humic acid, and improves the reaction efficiency in the oxidation step, so the high-content potassium fulvate can be obtained with higher yield.

title_en: Room-temperature-curing epoxy pouring sealant used under warm-flushing environmental condition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epoxy pouring sealant solidified at room temperature and used under a warm-flushing environment condition and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of pouring sealants used under the warm-flushing environment condition. The composition comprises the following components in parts by mass: 100 parts of composite epoxy resin; 10-30 parts of a composite curing agent; the composite epoxy resin is composed of liquid bisphenol A epoxy resin, liquid glycidyl ester epoxy resin and polyether epoxy; the composite curing agent consists of liquid composite polyether amine and a curing accelerator. The composite epoxy is compounded by using high-activity, good-adhesion performance, low-temperature-resistant epoxy, high-toughening epoxy and bisphenol A epoxy, simultaneously using low-temperature-resistant and high-toughness polyetheramine as a main curing agent, and simultaneously adjusting the curing speed of the glue by using a curing accelerator, so that the balance of the activity, toughness, adhesion performance and technological performance of the glue is realized, the pouring sealant does not crack under the environmental conditions, does not debond from metal, and has good technological performance.

title_en: Double-tower type adsorption purification process for natural gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas double-tower type adsorption purification process which comprises an adsorption pipeline, a communication pipeline, a conveying pipeline and an electric cabinet, wherein two ends of the communication pipeline are respectively communicated with the adsorption pipeline and the conveying pipeline, an electronic one-way valve is installed on the adsorption pipeline, an adsorption module and a moisture detection probe are arranged in the adsorption pipeline, the moisture detection probe is connected with the electric cabinet through a data line, and the electric cabinet is connected with the electronic one-way valve through a data line. According to the invention, through the disconnected connection of the adsorption pipeline and the conveying pipeline, when the molecular sieve in the adsorption pipeline is subjected to a regeneration process, the standby adsorption pipeline can be connected to the conveying pipeline, so that the transportation of natural gas cannot be influenced in the regeneration process of the molecular sieve.

title_en: Novel aschersonia with bacteriostatic ability and lignocellulose degradation activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a novel colletotrichum gloeosporiosa (Pezicula neosporulosa M51-1) strain of fir endophytic fungi and activity thereof. The invention discloses a new colletotrichum gloeosporioides M51-1, which is a new colletotrichum gloeosporosa (Pezicula neosporulosa) with the accession number: CGMCC No: 18137. the invention also discloses the application of the new aschersonia M51-1: is used for improving the resistance of plants to pathogenic bacteria and/or providing engineering bacteria for degrading lignocellulose.

title_en: Liquid laundry detergent compositions
abstract_en: A liquid laundry detergent composition comprising: (i)50-80 wt% linear alkyl benzene sulphonic acid surfactant; (ii)15 to 45 wt% of an alkyl ether carboxylic acid surfactant of the structure: r 1 ‑(OCH 2 CH 2 ) n ‑OCH 2 -COOH, wherein: r 1 Selected from saturated C 16 ‑C 22 A straight or branched alkyl chain, and wherein n is selected from 10-24; (iii) less than 10% by weight water; (iv)0-20 wt% of a nonionic surfactant of the structure: r 2 ‑(OCH 2 CH 2 ) n -OH, wherein: r 2 Selected from saturated C 12 ‑C 22 A straight or branched alkyl chain, and wherein n is selected from 5 to 30; wherein the pH of the formulation is 0.3-2.0; and wherein the weight ratio of linear alkylbenzene sulfonic acid surfactant to alkyl ether carboxylic acid surfactant is from 1.5:1 to 5: 1.

title_en: Energy storage wood construction method taking alkylated carbon black as filler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing energy storage wood by taking alkylated carbon black as a filler. The method mainly comprises the following steps: (1) the wood is delignified to open cell wall gaps and improve energy storage space. (2) Glycidyl methacrylate is selected as a base material to prepare an organic solution. And then blending the organic solution and polyethylene glycol 800 to prepare a phase change energy storage material (3), dispersing carbon black in a sulfuric acid solution, heating to prepare hydroxylated carbon black, dispersing the hydroxylated carbon black in a Tris buffer solution, adding dopamine, and regulating and controlling reaction conditions to prepare dopamine modified carbon black. And carrying out alkylation treatment on the dopamine modified carbon black by using octadecyl isocyanate. And finally dispersing the phase change energy storage material in the phase change energy storage material (4) immersing the phase change energy storage material in wood by adopting a vacuum pressurization full cell method to obtain the energy storage wood.

title_en: Decontamination self-cleaning insulator protective agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decontamination self-cleaning insulator protective agent, which consists of the following bottom treatment agent and surface treatment agent in parts by weight: the bottom treatment agent consists of 3-8 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 1-15 parts of micron-sized particles and 85-95 parts of mixed solvent; the surface treating agent consists of 3-15 parts of low surface energy resin, 15-35 parts of hydrophobic nano particles and 30-85 parts of ethyl acetate; the invention also discloses a preparation method of the decontamination self-cleaning insulator protective agent. The decontamination self-cleaning insulator protective agent provided by the invention has excellent cleaning performance, has good adhesive force to various base materials, and has the characteristics of good super-hydrophobicity, wear resistance, durability and the like of a protective film formed on the surface of a treated object.

title_en: Micron or nano-scale liquid metal water-based dispersion liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of liquid metal dispersion liquid, in particular to a micron or nano liquid metal water-based dispersion liquid which is prepared and stably stored by using microgel as a protective layer and a preparation method thereof. Adding liquid metal into the soluble natural polymer dispersion liquid, uniformly mixing, and performing low-temperature ultrasonic cavitation to obtain the dispersion liquid with uniform particle size and uniform dispersion; wherein the soluble natural polymer dispersion liquid consists of soluble polymer and water-based solution; wherein the soluble polymer is one or more of Sodium Alginate (SA), Hyaluronic Acid (HA), sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC), and quaternized chitosan (Qch). The liquid metal dispersion liquid prepared by the method has the characteristics of high preparation efficiency, adjustable particle size, stable dispersion, long-term storage, high biocompatibility and the like. Can be used as conductive "ink" and used in the fields of printed electronics, wearable sensors, actuators, or biomedical conductive parts.

title_en: Synthetic rubber adhesive, adhesive sheet, and polishing member laminate
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthetic rubber adhesive, an adhesive sheet and a polishing member laminate, which have excellent heat resistance and substrate adhesion, can inhibit offset, peeling and the like even under high-temperature environment, and are suitable for application under high-temperature environment. The synthetic rubber adhesive of the present invention contains: a synthetic rubber (A) containing a styrene-isoprene block copolymer, a tackiness imparting resin (B), and a fatty acid ester (C) having a weight loss rate of 1 wt% or less after heating at 150 ℃ for 10 minutes. The content of the adhesion imparting resin (B) is 5 to 60 parts by weight and the content of the fatty acid ester (C) is 0.1 to 10 parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the synthetic rubber (A).

title_en: Preparation method of blended coal-water coal slurry
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of blended coal-water slurry, which comprises the following steps: mixing and crushing raw material coal, petroleum coke and fly ash to obtain first slurry; mixing petroleum coke, fly ash, water and an additive to obtain a second slurry; mixing and stirring the first slurry and the second slurry to obtain a third slurry, then shaping and finely grinding to obtain a fourth slurry, and screening the fourth slurry to obtain a fifth slurry and a sixth slurry as a screen residue; returning part of the sixth slurry to be mixed with the second slurry, and returning the rest sixth slurry to be shaped and finely ground; and outputting the fifth slurry to obtain the coal water slurry. The method adopts a coal blending technology, petroleum coke and fly ash are added on the basis of raw material coal to form blended coal, the blended coal improves the slurry forming performance of coal types and the concentration of the coal water slurry, and the stacking efficiency of the coal water slurry can be improved by matching the granularity among coal components, so that the heat value of the coal water slurry is improved, and the coal water slurry can be better used as gasified coal water slurry.

title_en: Purely natural fruit and vegetable washing liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A purely natural fruit and vegetable washing liquid and its preparation method are provided. The fruit and vegetable washing liquid comprises 1.0% -1.5% of rhizoma atractylodis volatile oil, 0.8% -1.2% of cassia twig volatile oil, 0.1% -0.2% of sodium citrate, 0.05% -0.06% of soda, 2% -3% of cocamide DEA, 6% -7% of sodium lauryl ether sulfate, 10% -12% of TEA dodecyl sodium sulfate, 2% -3% of cocamidopropyl betaine, 3% -4% of glycerin and 1% -1.5% of essence. The fruit and vegetable washing liquid formula disclosed by the invention organically combines a plurality of natural surfactants, foaming agents and emulsifying agents, so that the fruit and vegetable washing liquid has excellent sterilization performance and excellent washing and decontamination capacities. In addition, the fruit and vegetable washing liquid adopts edible raw materials, and only needs to be washed by a little water, so that the fruit and vegetable washing liquid has great advantages in the aspects of health and environmental protection.

title_en: Coating for producing structured surfaces
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a coating composition comprising: (i) at least one polyol component (a), (ii) at least one crosslinker component (B) having groups reactive toward the hydroxyl groups of component (a), (iii) at least one polyamide component (P1) in which the amide groups are linked by saturated aliphatic hydrocarbon groups having from 6 to 10 carbon atoms, the components being used in the form of particles, the particle size distribution of the primary particles having a median particle diameter (D) of from 20 to 100 μm 50 ) And (iv) at least one polycarboxamide component (P2), wherein the polycarboxamide component (P2) has the formula Wherein S is 1,2 or 3, t is 0 or 1, and S + t is 2 or 3, R is a specific (S + t) -valent organic radical, and the radical R is 1 And R 2 At least one of which carries at least one hydroxyl group. The invention also relates to the production of such coating compositions, to the use thereof in the production of multi-track paint systems, and to the use of the combination of (P1) and (P2) as additives in coating compositions for producing structured coating films, in particular structured clearcoats.

title_en: Antifouling weather-resistant protective coating for reaction kettle equipment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of paint preparation, and relates to an antifouling weather-resistant paint for reaction kettle equipment, which consists of a primer, a middle paint and a finish, wherein the primer is 30-50% of bisphenol A epoxy resin, 12-20% of melamine formaldehyde resin, 5-8% of a filler, 10-15% of fatty amine, 2-5% of a mildew inhibitor, 1-5% of an antirust agent, 1-3% of a flatting agent and a solvent; the intermediate coat is prepared from 40-50% of epoxy grafted chlorinated polypropylene resin, 1-3% of cellulose resin, 2-10% of attapulgite, 2-8% of talcum powder, 3-10% of kaolin, 2-6% of calcium stearate, 2-5% of silane coupling agent, 4-8% of aliphatic polyamine and mixed solvent; the finish paint is composed of 30-40% of acrylic acid modified polycarbonate, 15-20% of polytetrafluoroethylene resin, 2-6% of titanium fluoride, 5-10% of flake aluminum powder, 2-5% of zinc phosphate, 5-8% of mica powder, 5-8% of calcium carbonate, 4-8% of isocyanate, 2-4% of antioxidant, 1-3% of defoaming agent and mixed solvent. The coating meets the protection requirement of the reaction kettle equipment through coating matching and component blending, excellent weather resistance and antifouling property are realized, the adhesive force performance is excellent, and the service life of the reaction kettle equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Composition for preventing and treating plant diseases and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for preventing and treating plant diseases, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural prevention and treatment and comprises validamycin and zhongshengmycin, wherein the mass ratio of the validamycin to the zhongshengmycin is (1-15) to (1-15). The invention has obvious synergy after the validamycin and the zhongshengmycin are mixed, can greatly improve the pesticide effect and reduce the using amount of pesticide and the use cost of the pesticide. Meanwhile, the bactericidal composition provided by the invention can improve the lasting period of validamycin.

title_en: Composite organic fiber brake pad
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite organic fiber brake pad, which comprises a friction layer and a heat dissipation bonding layer, and has the advantages of light specific gravity, strong wear resistance, good toughness, low noise, long service life and the like, and can keep the stability of friction performance at the use temperature of 100-450 ℃. The heat dissipation area ensures that the advantages of all materials are fully exerted in the friction material by reasonably collocating a plurality of components, has good temperature resistance, good heat stability and lower heat conduction force, and meets the technical requirements of high wear resistance, high speed, safety and the like of the brake pad.

title_en: Open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid, preparation method thereof and method for constructing fracturing reservoir by using open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid
abstract_en: The invention provides an open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid, a preparation method thereof and a method for constructing a fractured reservoir by using the open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid, wherein the open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid is prepared by the following steps: step 1, mixing 30-40% of cement, 45-55% of sand, 0.5-2% of water reducing agent and 9-12% of water according to the total mass percentage of the open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid to obtain cement slurry; step 2, adding 1-3% of foaming agent into cement paste, introducing gas, and controlling the gas velocity to be 0.5-2.0mL/50cm 3 And min, stirring to obtain the open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid. The method for constructing the fracturing reservoir comprises the following steps: pressing open-cell foam cement into the formation; and after fracturing is finished, continuously introducing gas and closing the well to realize solidification of the open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid so as to form an open-cell foam reservoir stratum. The open-cell foam cement fracturing fluid is solidified after fracturing to obtain open-cell foam cement, has all-dimensional communicating pore passages, and can ensure higher oil gas seepage capability.

title_en: Adhesive layer, optical film with adhesive layer, optical laminate, and image display device
abstract_en: An adhesive layer comprising, as a monomer unit, at least a (meth) acrylic polymer (A) containing an alkyl (meth) acrylate and a silicon compound (B) which is an organopolysiloxane compound, wherein the adhesive layer of a polarizing film with an adhesive layer is bonded to an indium-tin complex oxide layer on a transparent conductive substrate having a transparent substrate and the indium-tin complex oxide layer to form a laminate, the laminate is subjected to autoclave treatment at 50 ℃ and 5 atmospheres for 15 minutes and then the adhesive layer is peeled, and when the ratio of silicon element detected on the indium-tin complex oxide layer surface by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy to the total amount of the elements of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, silicon, indium, and tin is 0.5atomic% or more and 5atomic% or less, the polarizing film with an adhesive layer has the adhesive layer and a polarizing film. The adhesive layer of the present invention has reworkability and high durability for the transparent conductive layer.

title_en: Household light hydrocarbon air blowing and infusing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a household light hydrocarbon air-blowing and infusing device, which is suitable for the technical field of gas application and comprises a body, wherein an air making tank and a liquid storage tank with the bottom communicated with the air making tank through an oil hole are sealed in the body, light hydrocarbon oil is arranged in the liquid storage tank and the air making tank, a gasification bed communicated with a fan through an air inlet pipe is arranged in the air making tank, the fan is communicated with an air inlet hole, the gasification bed is arranged below the boundary of the light hydrocarbon oil-gas liquid, and an air outlet pipe communicated with gas consuming equipment is arranged in the air making tank; the invention adopts cavitation and thermal effects to realize bubbling gasification on the light hydrocarbon oil, has stable and reliable work, good gasification effect and high safety coefficient, meets various requirements of users, enriches the utilization ways of the light hydrocarbon gas, can be used as primary energy to replace secondary energy such as liquefied gas, diesel oil, electricity and the like, and has important strategic significance and practical significance for optimizing energy structures and improving energy utilization rate.

title_en: Puncture sealing agent and puncture repair system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a puncture sealing agent, which comprises natural rubber latex, an aqueous solution of an adhesive and an antifreezing agent. The binder is a carbohydrate and the puncture sealing agent contains solids derived from natural rubber latex in an amount of 21wt% or less based on the total weight of the puncture sealing agent.

title_en: Multifunctional trichoderma reesei and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional trichoderma reesei and application thereof. The multifunctional Trichoderma reesei is Trichoderma reesei (Trichoderma reesei) H-LS, and the preservation number is CGMCC No. 18108. The invention also discloses application of the trichoderma reesei H-LS in promoting plant growth and/or inhibiting phytopathogen and/or preventing and treating plant diseases caused by phytopathogen infection and/or preventing and treating nematodes and/or improving quality of vegetables and/or forage grass and/or improving soil nutrients. The trichoderma reesei H-LS has the characteristics of high growth speed, large sporulation amount, wide action spectrum, strong stress resistance, capability of realizing mass colonization at plant roots and the like. The invention has great value for preventing and treating related diseases caused by phytopathogen and nematode, and has great application value for promoting the growth of vegetables and forage grass, improving the nutritional quality and improving the physical and chemical properties of soil.

title_en: Powder metallurgy brake pad friction material for high-speed train and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a powder metallurgy brake pad friction material for a high-speed train and a preparation method thereof. The powder metallurgy brake lining friction material for the high-speed train comprises metal matrix powder and graphene/MoS 2 A nanocomposite material, and the graphene/MoS based on 100 parts by weight of the powder metallurgy brake lining friction material 2 The content of the nano composite material is 6-20 parts by weight, wherein the graphene/MoS 2 MoS in nanocomposites 2 The particles are attached to graphene nanoplatelets. According to the invention, graphene/MoS is added into a powder metallurgy brake pad friction material formula 2 The nano composite material reduces the blocking effect of the non-metallic raw material in the metal matrix while ensuring the high-temperature lubricating performance, so that the powder metallurgy brake pad for the high-speed train can still maintain higher strength during high-load braking, and excellent high-speed braking performance is obtained.

title_en: Aqueous acrylic pressure sensitive adhesive for clothing and method for preparing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a water-based acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive for clothing and a method for preparing the same. Since the specific internal crosslinking agent is used in a predetermined range during the polymerization of the acrylic emulsion resin, the glass transition temperature and the degree of internal crosslinking can be controlled while maintaining the physical properties of the resin to be the same as those of the existing adhesives, and thus, the residual rate of the pressure-sensitive adhesive can be greatly reduced when removing the pressure-sensitive adhesive from a substrate such as a fabric for clothing.

title_en: High-color rendering index and high-light efficiency complex-phase fluorescent ceramic for LED/LD illumination and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-color rendering index and high-light efficiency complex phase fluorescent ceramic for LED/LD illumination and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical general formula of the complex phase fluorescent ceramic is as follows: a (Ce) x Y 1‑x ) 3 Al 5 O 12 ‑b(Eu y Y 1‑y ) 2 O 3 Or c (Ce) x Y 1‑x ) 3 Al 5 O 12 ‑dEu z Sr 1‑z AlSi 4 N 7 (ii) a Firstly preparing Ce: YAG fluorescent powder and then mixing with commercial Y 2 O 3 :Eu 3+ Powder or commercial SrAlSi 4 N 7 :Eu 2+ Mixing the powder, a dispersing agent and absolute ethyl alcohol according to a certain proportion, ball-milling, drying and sieving mixed slurry obtained by ball-milling; and calcining the sieved powder, then performing spark plasma sintering, cooling to room temperature, and performing double-sided polishing treatment to obtain the complex phase fluorescent ceramic. The multiphase fluorescent ceramic material provided by the invention emits low-color-temperature high-color-rendering-index white light under the excitation of an LED (300-500 mA)/LD (2-10W), emits main peaks of 530 nm-550 nm and 600 nm-640 nm, has a relative color temperature of 2500-3700K, a color rendering index of 80-88 and a visual luminous efficiency of 290-350 lm/W. The complex phase fluorescent ceramic has simple preparation process and is easy for industrial production.

title_en: Wild rice antibacterial peptide OrR935 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology, and particularly discloses wild rice antibacterial peptide OrR935 and application thereof, wherein the applicant establishes a wild rice cDNA library of Zhangpu, and finally separates out wild rice antibacterial peptide OrR935, and the applicant finds that antibacterial peptide OrR935 has an inhibiting effect on the growth of a plurality of germs such as tomato canker germ, bacterial wilt of ralstonia solanacearum, wheat seedling blight germ, rice leaf blight germ, rice blast germ and the like, has strong thermal stability, is insensitive to a plurality of enzymes, is harmless to mammals and human beings, and can be applied to biological control of plant diseases and insect pests, or can be used as an antibacterial agent.

title_en: Device and method for preparing bio-based aldehydes and ketones
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device of preparation biobased aldone, includes pyrolysis reaction system I, NTP catalysis-regeneration reaction system II, product collecting system III, NTP catalysis-regeneration reaction system II includes catalytic reactor, spiral combustor, NTP generator and oxygen feeding device, and catalytic reactor outside is equipped with spiral combustor and NTP generator, oxygen feeding device is connected with catalytic reactor and spiral combustor respectively. The device realizes the self-heating NTP on-line catalysis-regeneration to prepare the bio-based aldones, so that the used catalyst generates high-energy particles and active substances to oxidize carbon deposition on the catalyst through the NTP, the catalyst is regenerated, the regeneration temperature is low, the catalyst structure is kept intact, and the catalyst can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to a quantum dot and a preparation method thereof. The quantum dots are water-soluble quantum dots, and the water-soluble quantum dots comprise II-VI group quantum dot cores and carbon coating layers coated on the surfaces of the II-VI group quantum dot cores. Compared with the existing quantum dot material, the water-soluble quantum dot has better safety and stability, and the effect is obvious, and can be widely applied to the technical fields of display devices and illumination due to the prior art.

title_en: Hydrophobic oleophobic antistatic PVC composite film
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-fouling antistatic PVC composite film which comprises the following components in parts by weight: an antistatic PVC composite film is taken as a substrate, and an anti-fouling self-cleaning agent is screen-printed on the surface of the substrate; the antistatic PVC composite film comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 4565% of polyvinyl chloride, 10-14% of polytetrafluoroethylene, 12-18% of acrylic monomer, 6-10% of hydroxylated graphene, 4-6% of aminated graphene, 0.1-0.5% of catalyst, 1.8-4% of hyperbranched polystyrene, 1-2% of polypyrrole and 0.1-0.5% of dispersant; the antifouling self-cleaning agent comprises the following components in percentage by weight: nano TiO2  2  30-55% of sol, 5-10% of nano silver powder, 10-15% of lotus leaf hydrophobic agent, 10-15% of perfluorooctyl triethoxysilane and 2030% of perfluoroalkyl ethyl acrylate. The method utilizes the chemical crosslinking action of the graphene with a special functional group structure and the acrylic resin to introduce the graphene into an acrylic polymer molecular chain, and utilizes the principle of similar compatibility among media to ensure that the modified graphene conductive particles are stably compatible with the PVC resin, so that the PVC composite film has permanent antistatic capability.

title_en: Antireflection film and polarizing plate with the same
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-reflection film and a polarizing plate with the anti-reflection film. The low refractive index layer includes a polysiloxane resin modified with fluorine and acrylate, a plurality of hollow silica nanoparticles, an initiator, and a leveling agent including a (meth) acryl-modified organosilicon compound having a perfluoropolyether functional group, and thus can provide better processability. The reflectivity of the anti-reflection film is less than 1.1%, and the water contact angle is between 90 degrees and 125 degrees. The anti-reflection film of the polarizing plate is arranged on the surface of the polarizing element, and the cross-linking density of the low-refractive-index layer of the anti-reflection film is improved, so that the polarizing plate has better scratch resistance and lower reflectivity; the low refractive index layer can avoid the problem that the optical property is influenced by film surface unevenness or white fog after drying and forming, thereby improving the quality of the anti-reflection film and the polarizing plate with the anti-reflection film.

title_en: P-type titanium dioxide/n-type tungsten trioxide heterojunction catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in photochemical synthesis of fuel
abstract_en: The invention provides a p-type titanium dioxide/n-type tungsten trioxide heterojunction catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in photochemical synthesis of fuels, and relates to the technical field of catalysis 2 WO n type 3 The heterojunction catalyst includes: p-type TiO 2 And supported on the p-type TiO 2 Superficial n-type WO 3 . The invention innovatively combines n-type WO 3 Supported on the p-type TiO 2 The catalyst has high catalytic efficiency, and is especially suitable for photocatalytic synthesis of fuel.

title_en: Epoxy resin for gasoline and salt fog resistant self-extinction 50/50 powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of epoxy resin preparation, and particularly relates to epoxy resin for gasoline and salt spray resistant self-extinction 50/50 powder, and a preparation method of the epoxy resin. The epoxy resin is prepared by reacting bisphenol A, epichlorohydrin, sodium hydroxide, tartaric acid, octafluoro adipic acid, citric acid, triglycidyl isocyanurate and the like which are mainly used as raw materials, and the epoxy equivalent of the finally obtained epoxy resin is 700-750g/mol, and the acid value is lower than 2 mgKOH/g. The epoxy resin obtained by the invention has higher functionality, so that the crosslinking density of a cured coating is high, the solvent resistance and neutral salt spray resistance of the final coating are excellent, and the self-extinction performance is excellent when the epoxy resin is used in 50/50 powder coating.

title_en: VOC (volatile organic compound) -emission-free environment-friendly UV gloss oil for coated iron and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of metal decorating packaging, in particular to VOC (volatile organic compound) -emission-free environment-friendly UV gloss oil for coated iron and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides VOC (volatile organic compounds) -emission-free environment-friendly UV gloss oil for coated iron, which has the advantages that the adhesive force on UV ink and coated iron reaches more than 2 grades, the UV ink has good hardness and high toughness, and each physical and chemical property of the UV gloss oil reaches the same physical and chemical property of a paint film prepared by a traditional baking process; and the applicant uses the gloss oil in the processing technology of the coated iron, realizes the packaging of the coated iron in a UV curing mode, does not need to use high-temperature baking in the whole process, avoids the defect that the coated iron is easy to deform during baking, saves energy, avoids VOC emission, and is beneficial to environmental protection.

title_en: Preparation method of oregano oil, oregano oil and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of oregano oil, which comprises the following steps: s1, freeze-drying the whole oregano, crushing and pulping to obtain pulp; s2, cooling, heating and carrying out enzymolysis on the slurry; s3, centrifuging the enzymolysis product for 10-12min under the condition of 5000-; s4, freeze-drying the precipitate, and adding the precipitate into a supercritical reaction kettle to perform supercritical carbon dioxide extraction on the precipitate in the supercritical reaction kettle; and S5, combining the liquid extract and the supernatant, performing molecular distillation, and concentrating and filtering the molecular distillation product to obtain the oregano oil. The method can obviously improve the yield of the oregano oil and the content of active ingredients, monitor the pressure in the preparation process in real time, and remind personnel to execute different processing schemes according to the monitoring result so as to eliminate the hidden troubles of production to the maximum extent.

title_en: Candida sorbosa and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides candida sorbatidis, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center in 11 and 18 months in 2019 under the preservation name YN-1 with the preservation number of CGMCC No. 18954. The candida sorboso is used for preparing the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer by fermenting molasses alcohol concentrated solution, and the method for preparing the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer comprises the following steps: 1) taking out the cryopreserved candida sorbus protospecies, streaking and separating a single colony on a PDA culture medium, selecting the single colony to be inoculated in a liquid culture medium for activated culture, taking activated seed liquid to transfer to a new liquid culture medium, and performing expanded culture to obtain candida mycoderma liquid; 2) inoculating candida mycoderma liquid to molasses alcohol concentrated solution, firstly carrying out aeration culture, then standing and fermenting, and then carrying out enzymolysis reaction to obtain the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer. The candida sorboso can grow in the molasses alcohol concentrated solution with high brix, and can ferment the molasses alcohol concentrated solution to become an excellent fertilizer.

title_en: Viscoelastic icephobic surfaces
abstract_en: The viscoelastic icephobic surface of the present disclosure comprises organogel particle beads dispersed in an elastomeric matrix. These surfaces are highly repellent to ice formation, easy to use and cost effective, and have long-term durability for harsh outdoor applications.

title_en: Glycerol esterification method for high acid value oil
abstract_en: The invention provides a glycerol esterification method for high-acid-value grease, which comprises the following specific steps: mixing and heating glycerin, monoglyceride, a targeting inducer and high-acid-value grease under a vacuum condition to perform esterification reaction to obtain esterified grease; wherein the mass of the targeted inducer accounts for 0.1-5% of the mass of the high acid value grease; the mass of the glycerol accounts for 1-50% of that of the high-acid-value oil, and the mass of the monoglyceride is 1-10 times of that of the glycerol. According to the invention, through the synergistic effect of glycerol, monoglyceride and a targeted inducer, in the field of edible oil, the original oil characteristics can be improved, and the nutritional value can be improved, and in the field of biodiesel, the saturated fatty acid and the unsaturated fatty acid of the raw materials are separated through conventional physical means such as winterization and fractionation, so that the classification of the characteristics of the raw materials is realized, and the diversity of products can be enriched.

title_en: Impact-resistant glass coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact-resistant glass coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the impact-resistant glass coating comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of condensed type silicon resin, 2-10 parts of vinyl silicon resin, 1-5 parts of curing agent, 1-5 parts of adhesion promoter, 0.1-1 part of flatting agent and 55-65 parts of solvent; the impact-resistant glass coating prepared by the preparation method can improve the impact resistance of glass by over 80 percent, has high hardness and no yellowing, and has good high and low temperature resistance, weather resistance and water resistance.

title_en: Device and method for compacting coking by utilizing thermal expansibility of coal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for compacting and coking by utilizing the thermal expansibility of coal, wherein the coking device comprises concentric or parallel furnace walls, a plurality of pressure-moved partition plates are sequentially distributed between the adjacent furnace walls, the internal space of the adjacent furnace walls is further divided into a plurality of heating furnace chambers, each heating furnace chamber is sealed by the furnace walls, a coke outlet gate, the partition plates and a furnace top, a coal charging port with a sealing cover is arranged on the furnace top corresponding to each heating furnace chamber, and an independently controlled heating source is arranged in each heating furnace chamber. The method for coking by utilizing the coal thermal expansibility and compacting comprises three processes of coal charging, coking and coke discharging, under the condition of not utilizing external force, the coking coal in adjacent heating furnace chambers is acted by self expansion force in the coal coking process to be compacted in a cold state or a hot state, the coal charging bulk density is increased, the coke porosity is reduced, and the effect of improving the coke quality is obvious.

title_en: Flame-retardant self-adhesive for composite gas isolation plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides flame-retardant self-adhesive for a composite gas isolation plate and a preparation method thereof, and solves the technical problem that a water channeling channel is formed between a primary lining and a secondary lining structure to cause large-area leakage of the structure in the composite gas isolation plate in the prior art because a common waterproof plate cannot be fully bonded with the secondary lining structure. The composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 18% -21% of SIS elastomer; 10% -18% of a first polyisobutylene; 6% -8% of second polyisobutene; 25% -30% of a first C5 petroleum resin; 5% -12% of second C5 petroleum resin; 10% -20% of flame retardant; 2% -5% of polyethylene wax; 1 to 1.5 percent of antioxidant; 0.5 to 1.5 percent of uvioresistant agent; the sum of the weight percentages of the raw materials is 100 percent. When the invention is applied to the composite gas isolation plate, a water channeling channel between the primary lining and the secondary lining structure is avoided, and the large-area leakage of the structure can be avoided.

title_en: Adhesive film for packaging photovoltaic module with multilayer structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a back layer adhesive film for packaging a photovoltaic module with a multilayer structure. The back layer adhesive film for packaging the photovoltaic module comprises an upper bonding layer, a foaming layer and a lower bonding layer which are sequentially superposed, wherein at least one structural layer of the upper bonding layer, the foaming layer and the lower bonding layer contains peroxide. Compared with the common adhesive film, the back adhesive film has lower modulus, and can greatly reduce the risks of fragment, hidden crack, grid breakage and the like of the battery piece in the packaging and using processes.

title_en: Self-repairing anticorrosive coating for waste gas recovery pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of corrosion prevention of chemical structures, and discloses a self-repairing anticorrosive coating for a waste gas recovery pipeline, aiming at the problem that the anticorrosive coating in the prior art is lack of corrosion durability, wherein the self-repairing anticorrosive coating comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 54-60 parts of methyl siloxane modified epoxy resin latex solution, 6-10 parts of self-repairing slow-release balls, 4-6 parts of plasticizer and 4-8 parts of filler; the concentration of the methyl siloxane modified epoxy resin latex solution is 60-70 wt%; the self-repairing slow release ball comprises copolymer-mesoporous SiO 2 Shell and SiO supported in copolymer-mesopore 2 A self-healing agent within the shell. According to the invention, the self-repairing agent is released in the self-repairing slow-release ball in time under the triggering condition to promote the repair of the base material of the anti-corrosion coating, so that the service cycle and the anti-corrosion effect of the anti-corrosion coating are greatly promoted, and the maintenance cost is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Functional proppant for increasing permeability of low-permeability polluted site and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a functional proppant for increasing permeability of a low-permeability polluted site and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing solid waste-based porous proppant aggregate; magnetizing the proppant aggregate to obtain magnetic aggregate; and (3) conducting film coating on the magnetic aggregate to obtain a finished product of the functional proppant for increasing the permeability of the low-permeability polluted site. The functional proppant for permeability enhancement of the low-permeability polluted site, which is obtained by the preparation method, can meet the requirement of fracturing and permeability enhancement of the rock soil of the self-adaptive low-permeability polluted site layer, and provides a representation basis for comprehensively inverting stratum information, dynamically evaluating the permeability enhancement effect and the fracture expansion degree and the flow path of the proppant by monitoring the change of the stratum magnetism and the conductivity on the ground or in the well.

title_en: Method for separating multiple active ingredients from African Voacanga chalotiana
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for separating various active ingredients from African strobilus cuscutae, which comprises the following steps: (1) extracting and separating the Voacanga seed volatile oil: crushing Voacanga chalotiana Linn raw material, adding lipophilic organic solvent, heating and reflux-extracting, passing the extractive solution through silica gel chromatographic column, and concentrating the eluate to obtain Voacanga chalotiana Linn volatile oil; (2) extraction and separation of water-soluble polysaccharide: adding water into the organic solvent extraction residues to obtain a water extraction solution, sequentially passing through an anion exchange resin column and a cation exchange resin column, concentrating and drying to obtain the water-soluble polysaccharide of the Voacanga seed; (3) extraction and separation of tabersonine: adding acid water containing betaine into the water extraction residue to obtain acid water extractive solution; the tabersonine finished product is obtained through the subsequent steps of centrifugation, ceramic membrane filtration, alkali neutralization, chromatographic alumina resin column adsorption, acetic acid aqueous solution elution, extraction and the like. Can comprehensively utilize the strobilus cuscutae resources, has coherent and simple process, low production cost, high content of various active ingredients and high yield.

title_en: Coke oven for producing formed coke by anthracite
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slag discharge of a coke oven, in particular to a coke oven for producing formed coke by anthracite, which comprises an oven body, an impeller and an oil cylinder, wherein the impeller and the oil cylinder are arranged in the oven body, an upper carbonization chamber and a lower control chamber are arranged in the oven body, the upper carbonization chamber and the lower control chamber are divided by a horizontal bearing plate, a mixing and collecting chamber is arranged at one side of the lower control chamber, the lower end surface of the horizontal bearing plate is symmetrically hinged with a supporting plate of a split door mechanism, the oil cylinder is arranged on the inner bottom and surface wall of the lower control chamber through bolts, and a horizontally arranged bidirectional telescopic rod is welded at the top of an oil cylinder shaft of the oil cylinder. According to the invention, the horizontal bearing plate with the bearing function is arranged at the bottom of the upper carbonization chamber, the horizontal bearing plate is provided with a plurality of material discharging circular holes, the bottom of the horizontal bearing plate is hinged with two supporting plates with a split door structure, and the oil cylinder controls the opening and closing actions of the two supporting plates through the bidirectional telescopic rod, so that sundries in the carbonization chamber can be conveniently discharged and can slide into the mixed collection chamber through the guide plate, and the slag can be conveniently and intensively collected.

title_en: Pretreatment method for removing biomass ash by using water-phase bio-oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pretreatment method for removing biomass ash by using water-phase bio-oil, which comprises the following steps: (1) crushing biomass into powder and drying, performing fast pyrolysis on the crushed biomass to prepare bio-oil, and performing refrigeration, standing, layering and separation on the bio-oil to obtain water-phase bio-oil; (2) the biomass powder is soaked in water-phase bio-oil, ash in the biomass is dissolved in the water-phase bio-oil solution by heating and stirring to remove the biomass, and then the biomass with the ash removal rate of more than 90% is obtained by filtering and washing. Compared with a simple water washing deashing method, the water-phase biological oil deashing method has higher ash removal rate, can remove sand and stone and metal elements which are easy to dissolve in water, and can also remove metals which are difficult to dissolve in water. Compared with an inorganic acid deliming method, the deliming agent has lower cost and higher ash removal rate, and can avoid the serious hydrolysis phenomenon of biomass.

title_en: Polyether-based pesticide auxiliary agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyether-based pesticide auxiliary agent, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pesticide auxiliary agents. According to the invention, 1-dodecylamine and 1, 12-dodecyldiamine are grafted on epoxy groups of glycerol propoxytriglycidyl ether by virtue of amino groups to form monomers, and free epoxy groups on the glycerol propoxytriglycidyl ether are catalyzed by 1-methylimidazole to undergo inter-polymerization to form a polyester main chain, so that the polyether-based pesticide auxiliary agent is obtained. The invention can obviously improve the surface adhesion quantity and the adhesion firmness of the leaf blade of the liquid medicine, and the polyether-based pesticide auxiliary agent is added into the pesticide liquid solution according to the mass ratio of 1:500-1:4000, and the contact angle of pesticide microdroplet on the tobacco leaf blade is between 0 degree and 50 degrees; soaking for 12 hours after drying, wherein the pesticide storage amount reaches 50% -87%.

title_en: White conductive primer for PP (polypropylene) and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a white conductive primer for PP and a preparation method thereof, wherein the conductive primer comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 30-35 parts of conductive titanium dioxide, 30-35 parts of modified acrylic resin, 1-2 parts of dispersing agent, 1-2 parts of anti-settling agent, 10-15 parts of toluene, 10-15 parts of xylene and 3-6 parts of blocked isocyanate. Compared with the prior art, the prepared PP white conductive primer has higher covering power and can completely cover black PP materials under the film thickness of 14-18 microns; the paint has good conductivity, adhesive force, water resistance and steam jet resistance; the high pigment ratio does not bring negative influence on the flexibility of the dry film and does not influence the assembly of the plastic part after spraying; the invention can solve the problem that the current PP bumper is white in pearly luster in spraying, can reduce four coatings into three coating structures by using the invention, can greatly reduce the working procedures of a coating factory, and has the advantages of cost reduction and efficiency improvement.

title_en: Sodium bicarbonate slow release tablet for packaging sodium bicarbonate injection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium bicarbonate sustained-release tablet for packaging a sodium bicarbonate injection, which solves the problem that the existing sodium bicarbonate solid tablet is not suitable for packaging an injection. The sodium bicarbonate slow-release tablet is positioned between the container body and the outer packaging bag and is prepared from the following components: 95-105 parts of sodium bicarbonate, 5.7-6.3 parts of ethyl cellulose, 2.47-2.73 parts of low-substituted hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, 0.95-1.05 parts of high-substituted hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, 0.95-1.05g of triethyl citrate and 53-59ml of absolute ethyl alcohol. The invention has simple components, easy manufacture, controllable requirement of slow release, no toxicity and no harm, has no adverse effect on the liquid medicine, and is suitable for packaging the sodium bicarbonate injection.

title_en: Oxygen-free quality-improving, grading and classifying system for low-rank coal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-rank coal oxygen-free quality improvement grading quality classification system, belonging to the technical field of raw gas production; the technical scheme includes that the low-rank coal anaerobic quality improving grading quality dividing system comprises a whole circulating production system consisting of a heat exchange furnace, a cooler, a rotary kiln, a raw coal preheater, a cyclone dust collector, a total fan, a desulfurizing tower, a raw coal conveyor and a carrier output fan, heat of high-temperature combustion gas is transferred to a raw coal gas carrier in a heat conduction mode, the raw coal gas carrier enters the rotary kiln in a closed anaerobic environment to carry out pyrolysis reaction with the low-rank coal to generate a large amount of raw coal gas, and the heat carrier is the same product and is extremely small in doped impurities, so that the influence of combustion coal impurities and air impurities on products is avoided, and low-rank coal on the market is consumed to form benefits of enterprises.

title_en: Novel ecological toilet
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel ecological toilet, which comprises a house body, wherein the house body comprises a wall and a roof; the interior of the house body is divided into a toilet area and a treatment area; a squatting pan and a urine bucket are arranged in the toileting area; a excrement treatment box and a urine treatment box are arranged in the treatment area; the squatting pan comprises a urinal, wherein the bottom of the urinal is provided with a urine channel and a stool channel; the urine channel and the urine funnel are both connected to the urine treatment box through urine tubes; the excrement channel extends to the excrement treatment box; the excrement treatment box and the urine treatment box are internally provided with ultrasonic material level sensors and excrement discharge pipes extending to green belts outside the house body, and the excrement discharge pipes are provided with conveying pumps; the lower side of the roof is provided with an ultraviolet lamp, a lighting lamp and a storage battery, and the storage battery is powered by a solar cell panel arranged on the upper side of the roof. And a health screening module remotely connected with the hospital service terminal is also arranged in the compartment. The invention not only can carry out ecological treatment on the excrement after going to the toilet, but also has the function of health screening on the people going to the toilet.

title_en: Mixed refrigerant and air conditioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed refrigerant and an air conditioning system, wherein the mixed refrigerant comprises a first component, a second component and a third component, wherein: the first component is ammonia, the second component is difluoromethane, and the third component is trans-1-chloro-3, 3, 3-trifluoropropene or 1,1, 1-trifluoroethane. The mixed refrigerant has low GWP and good thermal performance, the GWP value can reach less than 150, the COP (coefficient of performance) of the mixed refrigerant is much higher than that of R134a, and the volumetric refrigerating capacity can be much higher than that of R134a, so that the problem of high GWP of other alternative R134a refrigerants is effectively solved, and the problem of poor thermal performance of other refrigerants is also solved. And the slip temperature of the mixed working medium can be lower than 0.5 ℃, the adverse effect caused by the temperature slip is eliminated, and the potential safety hazard caused by combustible refrigerants can be reduced or even eliminated by the secondary loop automobile air conditioning system.

title_en: Active targeting folic acid receptor near-infrared fluorescent molecule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of near-infrared surgical navigation fluorescent molecules, cell marker imaging and the like, and particularly discloses a structure of an active targeting near-infrared fluorescent small molecule and a preparation method thereof. The active targeting near-infrared fluorescent micromolecules taking pemetrexed disodium and derivatives thereof as active targeting groups are prepared by an organic total synthesis method. The active targeting near-infrared fluorescent molecule has the advantages of high active targeting property, strong specificity, good water solubility, high fluorescence quantum yield and the like.

title_en: Environment-friendly antifouling agent, antifouling paint, multilayer protective film structure and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly antifouling agent, an antifouling paint, a multilayer protective film structure and application thereof. The environment-friendly antifouling agent comprises furan oxime and/or furan oxime metal complex and the like, has good antifouling performance, low toxicity, high efficiency and environmental friendliness, has the ecological toxicity to non-target organisms below 15% of organic matters such as copper, barrier metal and benzo-oxa, and can remarkably improve the barrier effect of the coating on typical corrosion factors due to the excellent barrier performance of the furan ring structure to small molecules such as oxygen, water vapor and the like, and can greatly improve the corrosion resistance of the coating system when being matched with an anticorrosive coating system. Meanwhile, the antifouling agent is easy to synthesize, has good compatibility with self-polishing resin, abrasive resin and the like, is suitable for preparing antifouling paint, is very suitable for being applied to ships, mariculture facilities, ocean platform facilities and the like, and can efficiently prevent and remove fouling organisms.

title_en: Fluorescent carbon dot preparation method beneficial to improving quantum yield and fluorescence intensity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing fluorescent carbon dots beneficial to improving quantum yield and fluorescence intensity, which comprises the steps of completely dissolving a carbon source, a nitrogen source and a boron source in ultrapure water to form a solution, placing the solution in a high-pressure kettle, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction at 160-240 ℃ for 2-10 h; and cooling to room temperature of 25 ℃ after reaction to obtain boron-nitrogen co-doped fluorescent carbon dot solution, centrifugally cleaning with deionized water or absolute ethyl alcohol, and filtering the supernatant through a 0.22 mu m injection type filter membrane to obtain boron-nitrogen co-doped fluorescent carbon dots. According to the invention, fluorescent carbon dots with different colors are synthesized by a hydrothermal method, and the fluorescence quantum efficiency can be improved and the fluorescence intensity is obviously enhanced by a boron-nitrogen co-doping method.

title_en: Composite soil conditioner and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound soil conditioner and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite soil conditioner is formed by combining bactericidal essential oil serving as a core material and a slow-soluble polymer serving as a capsule wall material. The compound soil conditioner has a strong inhibiting effect on fusarium oxysporum in soil, slowly releases the fusarium oxysporum, has a long effective time, can slowly release components for promoting plant growth in degradation, can effectively prevent harm caused by excessive local oily substances due to the grafted modified montmorillonite on the capsule shell material, can also effectively prevent soil agglomeration, and improves the water retention and water retention capacity of the soil.

title_en: Formaldehyde removing device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formaldehyde removing device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the formaldehyde removing device comprises an air purification filter screen and a plasma generating device which are coaxially arranged, the plasma generating device and the air purification filter screen are respectively close to an air inlet and an air outlet, a nano zinc oxide graphene coating is uniformly arranged on the surface of the air purification filter screen, the thickness of the nano zinc oxide graphene coating is 0.3-1.5 mm, the nano zinc oxide graphene coating comprises nano zinc oxide and graphene, and the mass ratio of the nano zinc oxide graphene coating to the nano graphene is (50-300): (1-3). The formaldehyde removing device provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, strong practicability, safety, no pollution and high efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrogel fire-extinguishing inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a hydrogel fire-extinguishing inhibitor and the hydrogel fire-extinguishing inhibitor prepared by the preparation method. The preparation method is that a large amount of urea is adsorbed in the hydrogel, and the urea is used as a chemical inhibitor to prevent free radical chain reaction in the oxidation reaction of coal, so that the hydrogel has both physical inhibition and chemical inhibition. Meanwhile, the chitosan is adopted as one of the main raw materials for synthesis, and the product has the characteristic of degradability. Therefore, the product of the invention is a high-efficiency inhibitor which integrates the physical resistance, chemical resistance and degradability.

title_en: Combined perfusion system and perfusion method for isolated heart and lung
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an isolated heart-lung combined perfusion system and a perfusion method, which are used for preserving an isolated organ by using an organ perfusion method, avoid ischemia reperfusion injury caused by low-temperature preservation and solve the problem that the isolated heart-lung organ can not be simultaneously perfused and preserved, and comprise an organ cabin, a circulation cabin, a control cabin, a simple breathing cabin, a cardiac pacemaker, a visualization and control panel and a base, wherein the organ cabin is connected with the circulation cabin, the control cabin and the simple breathing cabin, the control cabin is connected with the visualization and control panel, the organ cabin, the circulation cabin, the control cabin, the simple breathing cabin and the visualization and control panel are arranged on the base, a simple breathing machine is arranged in the simple breathing cabin, the simple breathing machine and the cardiac pacemaker are respectively connected with the isolated heart-lung to form an isolated heart-lung support system, and the cardiac pacemaker monitors and outputs signals to the control cabin, the control cabin controls the work of the cardiac pacemaker.

title_en: Waterproof heat-insulating coating for external wall and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an exterior wall waterproof heat-insulation coating and a preparation method thereof, and the exterior wall waterproof heat-insulation coating comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of styrene-acrylic emulsion, 15-20 parts of reinforcing fiber and TiO 2 5-10 parts of modified hollow glass beads, 10-12 parts of silk fibroin solution, 10-14 parts of nano filler, 3-5 parts of epoxidized soybean oil, 2-3 parts of lauryl methacrylate, 3-4 parts of polymethyl triethoxysilane, 1-3 parts of dispersing agent, 0.2-0.5 part of antiseptic bactericide, 1-2 parts of film forming additive and 15-25 parts of water.

title_en: Compound for organic photoelectric device, composition for organic photoelectric device, and display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound for an organic photoelectric device, a composition for an organic photoelectric device, and a display device, wherein the compound for an organic photoelectric device is represented by chemical formula 1. The detailed information of chemical formula 1 is as described in the specification.

title_en: Beauveria bassiana strain MQ-08 and application and microbial preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a beauveria bassiana strain MQ-08, application thereof and a microbial preparation. The preservation number of the beauveria bassiana strain is CGMCC NO. 19378. The strain has good sporulation quantity, spore germination rate and adaptability to temperature, particularly shows high-temperature resistance, has a high growth rate at a high temperature of 32 ℃, and is suitable for being applied to tropical crops; the strain has strong pathogenicity on coffee berry bark beetles, tea plant bug adults and advanced nymphs, and has high batryticated insect rate, which is pathogenic fungi with pathogenicity on two pests reported for the first time in China.

title_en: Green plant slope protection structure, green plant cement additive and application of green plant cement additive
abstract_en: The invention provides a green plant slope protection structure, a green plant cement additive and application of the green plant cement additive, which are characterized in that a prefabricated planting groove containing the green plant cement additive is arranged, green plants are planted in the prefabricated planting groove, A slope protection structure with a plurality of prefabricated planting grooves distributed in a row is formed, and meanwhile, the formula for adding the green planting cement and the application method of the green planting cement additive are provided. The slope protection structure provided by the invention can improve the slope stability, and simultaneously ensure mineral and organic nutrition required by green plant growth, so that the green plant is easier to survive, thereby forming effective vegetation coverage on the slope more quickly, and achieving the purpose of preventing the phenomena of water and soil loss, landslide, collapse and the like of the slope before the vegetation coverage.

title_en: Preparation method of quantum dots, quantum dot film and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of quantum dots, the quantum dots, a quantum dot film and a display device, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a mixed solution containing a first zinc source and quantum dots with a first shell layer; and S2, adding an acid etching agent into the mixed solution, and etching the first shell layer by the acid etching agent. The invention has the following advantages: firstly, a first zinc source is adopted to protect quantum dots with a first shell layer, and then an acid etching agent is adopted to etch the first shell layer, so that the negative effect caused by the surface oxidation of the first shell layer of the quantum dots is eliminated, and conditions are provided for the growth of the subsequent shell layer; after etching, a second shell layer is continuously grown on the surface of the first shell layer, so that quantum dots with thicker shell layers can be formed, the stability of the quantum dots is further enhanced, and the quantum yield of the quantum dots can be kept basically not to be reduced after the quantum dots are placed for 300 days; the quantum dots are prepared into the quantum dot film, the quantum dot film has high efficiency and good stability, and the quantum yield of the quantum dot film under thermal cycle is basically unchanged.

title_en: Far-red light-near infrared light LED device preparation method and LED device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a far-red light-near infrared light LED device and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: fully mixing the far-red fluorescent powder and the red fluorescent powder in a predetermined ratio in transparent silica gel to obtain a mixture; and packaging the mixture and the blue LED chip based on a preset packaging structure and a packaging process to obtain the LED device. The far-red fluorescent powder is Cr 3+ A mixture of activated rare earth borate and rare earth boroaluminate; the chemical formula of the red phosphor is (Ca, Sr) AlSiN 3 :Eu 2+ Or M 2 Si 5 N 8 :Eu 2+ (M ═ Sr, Ca, Ba, Mg). The LED device is manufactured by the manufacturing method. According to the invention, the problem that Mn is adopted in the prior art can be solved 4+ Or Cr 3+ Far-red prepared from activated phosphorThe light-near infrared LED device has the problems of small radiant luminous flux and low photoelectric efficiency.

title_en: Special superfine heavy calcium carbonate for latex gloves and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of filler preparation, and provides superfine heavy calcium carbonate special for latex gloves, and a preparation method and application thereof. The low molecular weight dispersant and the water-soluble high molecular weight dispersing auxiliary agent can coat the surface of calcium carbonate powder under the condition of ball milling, so that the particle size distribution of the calcium carbonate powder is uniform; and the surface of the calcium carbonate is completely coated, so that the dispersibility of the calcium carbonate is improved. The calcium carbonate powder is dispersed in a low-viscosity medium (especially natural latex) in a small particle state by the modification treatment of the titanate coupling agent, is not agglomerated for a long time, has good suspension property and better compatibility with the natural latex, meets the requirement of the latex gloves on the sedimentation prevention of the ultrafine heavy calcium carbonate, can greatly reduce the defective rate of the latex gloves and improve the production efficiency.

title_en: High-dust-content and high-chlorine-content coal tar purification treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal chemical industry, and particularly relates to a high-dust-content and high-chlorine-content coal tar purification treatment system and method. The system comprises a first separation device and a second separation device, wherein the first separation device is internally provided with a rough washing section and a fine washing section which are communicated, and the top of the rough washing section is provided with a raw material coal tar inlet; the bottom of the first separation device is provided with a stirrer, and the top of the first separation device is provided with a second oil gas outlet; the bottom of the fine washing section is provided with a heavy tar outlet, and the top of the fine washing section is provided with a light tar backflow inlet; a heavy tar backflow inlet is arranged between the heavy tar outlet and the light tar backflow inlet; and the second separation device is respectively communicated with the second oil gas discharge port and the fine washing section and is used for carrying out three-phase separation on gas discharged from the second oil gas discharge port to obtain light tar. The system can be used for purifying coal tar with high dust content and high chlorine content, the dust content and chlorine content of the obtained light tar and heavy tar are low, the coal tar can be comprehensively utilized, no waste residue is generated, and the system is economical and environment-friendly.

title_en: Printable and writable mold release agent, film material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printable and writable release agent, a film material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the printable and writable release agent comprises a non-silicon release agent and an auxiliary agent added into the non-silicon release agent, the addition amount of the auxiliary agent is 5-10 wt% of the non-silicon release agent, and the auxiliary agent comprises 35-45 wt% of hydroxyl-containing amphiphilic surfactant, 40-50 wt% of amino-containing amphiphilic surfactant, 10-15 wt% of fluorine-containing prepolymer, 0.5-0.8 wt% of 2, 6-di-tert-butyl-4-methylphenol and 0.3-0.5 wt% of 2-amino-3-methylphenol. The printable and writable release agent simultaneously has the functions of printing, printing and water writing, and simultaneously effectively solves the problem of adhesion of oily and water-based ink on the release layer.

title_en: Haemobacter and application thereof in prevention and treatment of cucumber fusarium wilt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a haemophilus and application thereof in prevention and treatment of cucumber fusarium wilt. The haemophilus is haemophilus Sanguibacter sp.M0055, and is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.20597 and the preservation date of 2020, 9 and 4. M0055 has a significant antagonistic effect on Fusarium oxysporum cucumber specialization (Fusarium oxysporum) causing cucumber Fusarium wilt. The bacterial suspension of the strain is used for root dipping treatment when the cucumber is transplanted to seedlings, the cucumber fusarium wilt disease is remarkably reduced, the prevention effect on the cucumber fusarium wilt is equivalent to that of a carbendazim effect, long-term field planting can be carried out at the rhizosphere of the cucumber after the bacterial suspension is used, and long-term protection can be carried out on the cucumber. The invention provides important strain resources for pollution-free prevention and treatment of cucumber diseases and has important practical value.

title_en: Quick manufacture equipment of compound microbial organic fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick manufacturing device of a compound microbial organic fertilizer, which structurally comprises: the fermentation box comprises a fermentation box body, a feeding hopper, a stirring motor, a feeding pipe and a control box, wherein a through hole in the top of the right side of the fermentation box body is fixedly welded with the feeding hopper, the axis of the fermentation box body is in a straight line with the center of the stirring motor, the feeding pipe is arranged at the bottom of the fermentation box body, and the control box is connected with the stirring motor through a lead; has the advantages that: according to the invention, the feeding screw rod and the material delivery outer ring are driven by the driving shaft to rotate simultaneously when the material delivery middle rod and the material delivery outer ring are fermented in a matched manner for a certain time, the fertilizer accumulated in the middle part is extruded to the inside of the positioning middle ring by the material delivery outer ring, and the fertilizer is conveyed to the top to wrap the external unfermented complete fertilizer, so that the fermentation efficiency is accelerated, and the heat energy of the fertilizer is fully utilized.

title_en: Phosphorus-dissolving bacterial fertilizer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphorus dissolving bacterial fertilizer which comprises phosphorus dissolving bacteria and an organic matrix. According to the invention, the phosphorus-dissolving bacteria are added into the organic fertilizer, so that the release of phosphorus in soil can be promoted, the soil quality can be improved, the soil fertility can be improved, and the plant growth can be promoted. The application of the phosphorus-dissolving bacterial fertilizer can better improve the content of crude ash, crude protein, crude fat and cane sugar in the moso bamboo spring bamboo shoots and improve the nutritional ingredients and the taste of the moso bamboo spring bamboo shoots.

title_en: Method and equipment for preparing synthesis gas by diversified mixing of biomass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy regeneration, in particular to a method and equipment for preparing synthesis gas by diversified mixing of biomass. The method can mix, dry, pyrolyze, gasify, separate and cool the multi-element biomass to obtain the synthesis gas, solves the technical problem of how to recycle the biomass energy, can fully utilize various biomass raw materials by matching with corresponding production equipment, and overcomes the problem of single biomass raw material.
