The invention makes full use of the unused biomass raw materials in the farm and the periphery, and improves the environmental problem caused by the accumulation of the biomass.

title_en: Silica sol with convex colloid surface and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor chemical mechanical polishing, and particularly discloses silica sol with a convex colloid surface, a preparation method and application thereof. The silica sol with the surface of the colloid being convex comprises a liquid medium and colloid particles, wherein the colloid particles are wolf tooth rod-shaped silica colloid particles with protrusions on the surface, and the height H of the protrusions is 1-8 nm; the nitrogen adsorption BET specific surface area fitting particle size of the silicon dioxide colloidal particles is D 1 The grain diameter of the short axis obtained by the characterization of a transmission electron microscope is D 2 Particle diameter D as measured by dynamic light scattering 3 ，1.2≤D 2 /D 1 Not more than 1.8, and not more than 2.0 of D 3 /D 1 Less than or equal to 6.3. The silica sol provided by the invention has higher roughness and profile tolerance, can effectively reduce the contact time with an object to be ground, reduces the generation of defects and scratches, and is beneficial to improving the polishing efficiency when being used in polishing solution.

title_en: Ink for ink jet and recording system
abstract_en: The invention provides an ink for ink jet and a recording system. The ink for inkjet contains pigment particles, first resin particles, wax particles, alpha, omega-alkanediols of C3 to C5, and water. The first resin particles contain a first resin having a styrene unit. The proportion of the styrene unit in the total repeating units of the first resin is 27 mass% or more and 75 mass% or less. The wax particles contain a polyethylene resin. The wax particles have a volume-median diameter of 20nm to 100 nm.

title_en: Insecticide containing silkworm chrysalis powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pesticide containing silkworm chrysalis powder, which comprises the following steps: mixing radix Sophorae Flavescentis, tobacco, radix Aconiti and rhizoma et radix Veratri, drying, pulverizing in a pulverizer, and sieving with 100 mesh sieve to obtain a prefabricated material; drying pupa Bombycis powder, parching with slow fire in a hot pan, pulverizing while hot, and sieving to obtain pretreated pupa Bombycis powder; adding the prefabricated material and the pretreated silkworm chrysalis powder into absolute ethyl alcohol, immersing at the temperature of 50-60 ℃, performing ultrasonic treatment, filtering, sending the filtrate into a rotary concentration instrument, adding purified water with the same amount, and performing vacuum concentration to obtain a concentrated solution; adding chitosan into the concentrated solution, stirring, centrifuging, collecting supernatant, and concentrating to obtain pesticide containing pupa Bombycis powder. The product of the invention has no harm to crops, no residue, no pollution to environment and agricultural products, no teratogenic, carcinogenic and mutagenic harm to mammals, strong killing effect on pests, high insecticidal efficiency of more than 99 percent, and especially obvious effect on meloidogyne incognita, grubs and leek maggots.

title_en: Biological pesticide fertilizer for preventing and treating tea seedling root knot nematode disease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological pesticide fertilizer for preventing and treating root knot nematode disease and a preparation method thereof. The biological medicine fertilizer is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight: 10-30% of glutamic acid residue, 0.1-0.3% of microbial agent, 0.5-1.5% of paecilomyces lilacinus and the balance of traditional Chinese medicine residue. The compound preparation is scientifically compounded, raw materials are cooperated, the application is simple, the compound preparation has good immune prevention and control effects on the tea seedling root knot nematode disease, meanwhile, pesticides, chemical fertilizers and labor cost are saved, the pollution to the environment is reduced, and the compound preparation has good application prospects.

title_en: Multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system and profile control and flooding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system, which consists of a multiphase gel foam system, a multi-foam emulsion flooding system, a heterogeneous flooding system and a gel system. The multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system provided by the invention can be freely combined and matched according to different oil field conditions to form the multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system capable of realizing deep selective profile control and flooding. The multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system disclosed by the invention is injected into the stratum in different functional slug forms, so that plugging of a high-permeability layer of the stratum and displacement of residual oil in a medium-low permeability layer are realized, the combination forms are various, and the multi-effect composite nitrogen foam profile control and flooding system can be adjusted according to the problem conditions of different oil layers so as to achieve the optimal profile control and flooding effect.

title_en: Novel water-based adhesive for polyester filament canvas shoes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel water-based adhesive for polyester filament canvas shoes and a preparation method thereof. The novel water-based adhesive for polyester filament canvas shoes has the advantages that a combined body of natural latex and an environment-friendly adhesive is used as a main body material, molecules of the latex basically keep the original state, so that the high initial bonding capacity of the novel water-based adhesive for polyester filament canvas shoes is ensured, and the adhesive after vulcanization crosslinking and an adhered part form a high-strength unity without changing rubber polymers and have high final adhesion strength, so that the requirement on the surface viscosity of the adhered part is low, the requirement on the temperature of the adhered part is low, and the requirement on the heat preservation performance of the adhered material is reduced. Because the initial adhesive force and affinity with the glued component are improved, the plastic flow of molecules on the adhesive surface of the glue component at the initial stage of high-temperature vulcanization is prevented, so that the glue component and the upper are firmly glued together by the adhesive, and the three mass problems of lace delamination, base cloth delamination and large sole elastic edge of the rubber shoe are effectively solved.

title_en: Paraffin extraction element is used in polytetrafluoroethylene production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paraffin extraction device for polytetrafluoroethylene production, which is characterized in that separation reaction is carried out in a separation box, an emulsion is stirred by a stirring component, a reaction temperature is controlled by a temperature control component, paraffin separation is carried out by the separation component, a layered paraffin solution enters a drying box, a temperature controller sets required temperature for paraffin separation and drying, a fan conveys air through an air inlet cover to accelerate drying effect, an air inlet pipe is ventilated for the fan to supply air, a one-way valve is controlled by a controller to operate, the air supply state of the fan is controlled, and the one-way valve is matched with a conveying pump to be used, so that paraffin is conveniently extracted, and further the paraffin separation effect is better.

title_en: P-N-C type intumescent flame retardant, preparation method thereof and application thereof in fireproof coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coatings, and discloses a P-N-C type intumescent flame retardant, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a fireproof coating. The preparation method of the intumescent flame retardant comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving trihydroxymethyl aminomethane and sodium hydroxide in deionized water, adding the obtained mixed solution into acetone solution of cyanuric chloride, and carrying out ice bath reaction; (2) adding sodium carbonate and p-hydroxybenzaldehyde to react, filtering, washing and drying; (3) adding a polyamine compound and the product obtained in the step (2) into ethanol, stirring and refluxing, evaporating the ethanol, washing with the ethanol for three times, and drying to obtain a product; (4) and (3) stirring the mixed solution of ethanol and water in a nitrogen atmosphere, adding APP and the product obtained in the step (3), refluxing, detecting no ammonia gas emission, filtering, washing with ethanol, washing with water, and drying. The method modifies three components of the P-N-C type intumescent flame retardant, improves the water resistance of the P-N-C type intumescent flame retardant through a chemical bonding mode, and can improve the water resistance of the fireproof coating.

title_en: Preparation method of oxidation desulfurization catalyst based on Zr-MOFs composite material
abstract_en: A preparation method of an oxidation desulfurization catalyst based on a Zr-MOFs composite material. The invention takes three materials of Zr-MOFs, heteropoly acid and mesoporous silicon molecular sieve as raw materials, and prepares the composite Zr-MOFs catalyst with high catalytic activity by using a simple one-pot method. In the method, the mesoporous silicon molecular sieve is loaded on the surface of Zr-MOFs with a highly regular shape, and the heteropoly acid nanoparticles are highly dispersed in the Zr-MOFs and the mesoporous silicon, so that the composite heteropoly acid @ mesoporous silicon molecular sieve @ Zr-MOFs catalyst is obtained. The catalyst prepared by the method has the advantages of simple preparation method, low process cost and extremely high catalytic activity, the desulfurization efficiency can reach 100% in 10 minutes, and the desulfurization efficiency of the catalyst can reach 100% in a state close to normal temperature. The preparation method can be widely applied to the high-efficiency and environment-friendly fuel oil desulfurization process.

title_en: Ceramic tile structure with concave-convex textures and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic tile structure with concave-convex textures and a manufacturing process thereof, which are characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: manufacturing a ceramic tile blank, drying and cooling to room temperature; glazing the ceramic tile blank through glazing equipment; thirdly, spraying die ink on the surface of the brick body obtained by using a ceramic ink-jet printer, wherein the path of the die ink is matched with a pre-designed pattern, glazing again along the position of the die ink, drying and cooling; fourthly, coloring the surface of the brick body obtained in the step by using a ceramic ink-jet printer, wherein a coloring ink layer covers the second glaze layer; fifthly, sintering in a kiln; the die ink composition in the step III comprises the following components: ester solvents, fatty acid methyl esters, ceramic mixtures, hydrotreated middle distillates, polymeric dispersants, and aluminosilicates. The invention forms the convex patterns by using the die ink for spraying, realizes the concave-convex three-dimensional sense of the surface of the ceramic tile, has better sense of reality, and has convenient construction, high efficiency and low cost.

title_en: Process system and process method for producing coal gas and tar and co-producing synthesis gas through low-temperature pyrolysis of low-rank coal
abstract_en: The invention provides a process system and a process method for producing coal gas and tar and co-producing synthesis gas by low-temperature pyrolysis of low-rank coal. The process system comprises a dryer, a dust remover I, a dust remover II, a pyrolysis furnace, a gasification furnace, a gas-solid separator and a heat exchange system, wherein the dryer is respectively connected with the dust remover I, the heat exchanger, the pyrolysis furnace and the gasification furnace, and the pyrolysis furnace is connected with the dust remover II and the gasification furnace. According to the invention, raw material coal is dried by the dryer and then pyrolyzed to obtain coal gas and oil gas, the semicoke product enters the gasification system to obtain a synthesis gas product, and heat energy and materials of each system are integrated to be recycled and reused to the maximum extent, the heat energy utilization rate of the whole system is high, the technical problems of low utilization rate of low-order crushed coal, high coal pyrolysis energy consumption and the like in the prior art are solved, and clean utilization of pulverized coal is realized.

title_en: Organic fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural fertilizers, in particular to an organic fertilizer. A production method of an organic fertilizer comprises the following steps: 1) measuring the water content of the feces, and mixing the Chinese medicine residue and the animal feces in proportion to keep the water content of the mixture between 40% and 65%; adding a leaven or a fermentation strain; 2) adding calcium hydroxide accounting for 0.5-1% of the mass ratio of the materials obtained in the step one into the materials obtained in the step one, and uniformly stirring, 3) crushing the straws and the wood chips and then paving the crushed straws and the crushed wood chips into a layer at the bottom of a fermentation device, paving the materials obtained in the step two on the straw layer and the wood chip layer, and alternately paving the layers; 4) and (5) carrying out stacking fermentation. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the reactant rich in calcium, nitrogen, sulfur and other components is added in the preparation process, so that the content of the elements in the reaction product is increased while the fermentation is promoted, and the fertility of the organic fertilizer is effectively improved. Meanwhile, waste products such as traditional Chinese medicine residues, straws, excrement and the like are used for organic fertilizer reproduction, so that the method has great benefit for improving the environment.

title_en: Novel metal ion selective nano sensor based on Hill type pH response rhodamine derivative, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel metal ion selective nano sensor based on Hill-type pH response rhodamine derivatives, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the novel metal ion selective nano sensor is obtained by taking a Hill-type rhodamine derivative PHX2 with diethylaminophenol functional groups and two interactive pH sensitive sites as a charged chromogenic ion carrier, and polycaprolactone and O-acetyl tributyl citrate as matrixes of the nano sensor through a one-step precipitation method. Based on an ion exchange sensing mechanism, the invention takes sodium and potassium ion selective carriers as an example, and further applies the carriers to the preparation of a fluorescent nano optical device with metal ion specificity, and researches show that the fluorescent nano optical device has the performance of monitoring the concentration of intracellular ions in real time. According to the present invention, there is provided a novel metal ion selective nanosensor having low toxicity and high biocompatibility and useful for long-term monitoring of intracellular ions.

title_en: Method for synthesizing biuret polyisocyanate by using microchannel reactor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing biuret polyisocyanate by using a microchannel reactor and application thereof. It is prepared by reacting at least one diisocyanate selected from aliphatic diisocyanate and alicyclic diisocyanate with biuretizing agent under the action of solubilizer and emulsifier through a microchannel reactor. The biuret polyisocyanate contains a triisocyanate prepolymer including a biuret structure and a compound containing a biuret group in the entire reaction intermediate, the biuret polyisocyanate having a content of triisocyanate prepolymer having a biuret structure of not less than 60% by weight. The reaction raw material liquid which is uniformly mixed into one phase combines the strong mass transfer and heat transfer effects of the micro-channel, so that the feeding amount of aliphatic diisocyanate and alicyclic diisocyanate in the raw materials is reduced, the reaction time is reduced, the side reaction and the by-product are reduced, the later separation cost is reduced, and the economical efficiency and the competitiveness of the reaction process of the biuret polyisocyanate are greatly improved.

title_en: Culture method for carambola pollen in-vitro germination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for culturing carambola pollen in vitro germination, which comprises the following steps: collecting the anther of the carambola flower in the travel time of the region to be collected from the laboratory within 4h, and then putting the anther into a storage culture device for culture; the travel time of the region to be collected with the carambola flowers from the laboratory is beyond 4h, the collected carambola anthers are put into a collection bag and put into a preservation culture device for preservation, and the carambola anthers are cultured after returning to the laboratory; adding a culture solution into the grooves of the germination culture groove glass slide, putting the carambola anther into the culture solution, and slightly pressing the anther by using tweezers to disperse the medicinal powder into the culture solution so as to germinate pollen; after the culture is finished, the groove glass slide is placed on an object stage of a microscope, and the pollen germination rate in the visual field is observed and recorded. The carambola pollen cultured by the method has high germination rate; the method combines with a preservation culture device to effectively solve the problems that pollen is not easy to preserve and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing microwave absorbing material by utilizing red mud and coal gangue and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a microwave absorbing material by utilizing red mud and coal gangue and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of solid waste utilization and microwave absorbing materials, solves the technical problem of efficient and reasonable comprehensive utilization of solid wastes of red mud and coal gangue, and adopts the following solution: firstly, carrying out filter pressing and dispersion on red mud slurry to obtain dispersed red mud clusters, then crushing, ball-milling and screening the coal gangue to obtain coal gangue powder with moderate granularity, then respectively weighing the red mud and the coal gangue powder according to a certain proportion, uniformly mixing, and finally carrying out roasting treatment under inert atmosphere to obtain the Fe-loaded coal gangue powder 3 O 4 、Fe 3 O 4 The magnetic composite microwave absorbing material of the/Fe, Fe/FeC or Fe simple substance has the main phases of fayalite, nepheline and carbon. The composite wave-absorbing material is prepared by taking the solid waste red mud and the coal gangue as raw materials, so that the effective recycling of the red mud and the coal gangue is realizedAnd reference is provided for comprehensive utilization of the red mud and the coal gangue.

title_en: Plant nutrient solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant nutrient solution which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 2-6 parts of Jingyang streptomycete, 4-8 parts of bacillus subtilis, 5-12 parts of bacillus amyloliquefaciens, 3-5 parts of bacillus mucilaginosus, 6-10 parts of bacillus laterosporus, 1-3 parts of rhodospirillum, 5-12 parts of sillimerian extract, 8-15 parts of pyrrosia breynia extract, 9-13 parts of sophora flavescens extract, 20-30 parts of macroelements, 0.05-2 parts of trace elements, 3-8 parts of vitamins and 1-3 parts of amino acids. The plant nutrient solution has the advantages of safe and easily-obtained raw materials, rich and balanced nutrition, comprehensive and efficient functions, and contribution to absorption and growth of plants.

title_en: Multicolor fluorescent anti-counterfeiting ink and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multicolor fluorescent anti-counterfeiting ink and a preparation method and application thereof. The multicolor fluorescent anti-counterfeiting ink comprises carbon quantum dots, rare earth metal salt and gloss oil, wherein the gloss oil comprises an organic solvent, high polymer resin and an auxiliary agent. The fluorescent anti-counterfeiting ink has different fluorescent colors under different excitation wavelengths, has high anti-counterfeiting grade, and can be used for anti-counterfeiting applications of various commodities, such as paper money anti-counterfeiting, security anti-counterfeiting, train ticket anti-counterfeiting, information encryption and the like.

title_en: Storage, transportation and injection preparation method of target exosome injection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, in particular to a method for storing, transporting and preparing targeted exosome injection. The invention discloses a method for storing and transporting a targeted exosome injection, which comprises the following steps of: a. immediately placing the prepared targeting exosome injection at 4 ℃ for 30 min; b. placing the exosome injection in a freezing storage tube, and keeping the temperature at-20 ℃ for 2 h; c. placing the frozen tube at-80 ℃ for 24 h; d. and (5) placing the freezing tube in a liquid nitrogen tank for long-term storage. The beneficial effects are that: according to the invention, the membrane of the exosome is a phospholipid bilayer, so that the exosome has the advantage of strong freezing resistance, the targeted exosome injection is placed in a liquid nitrogen tank for long-term storage in a step freezing mode, the targeted exosome injection does not need to be converted into freeze-dried powder, and the operation steps are simple and effective.

title_en: Butylbenzene emulsion for carpet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a butylbenzene emulsion for a carpet and a preparation method thereof, wherein the butylbenzene emulsion comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0-100 parts of seed emulsion; 1-15 parts of a carboxylic acid monomer; 10-200 parts of butadiene; 90-110 parts of (methyl) styrene; 0.5-5 parts of silane; 0.2-5 parts of a molecular weight regulator; 0.5-5 parts of an anionic emulsifier; 0.2-2 parts of a nonionic emulsifier; 0.2-2 parts of dodecyl dimethyl amine oxide; 0.5-5 parts of an initiator; 1-15 parts of alkaline substances; 0.1-1 part of antioxidant; 65-600 parts of water. The addition of a small amount of silane and an antioxidant into the butylbenzene emulsion for the carpet can obviously improve the pile cluster extraction force of the carpet, the added small amount of silane can react with carpet fibers in the film forming process of the butylbenzene emulsion, and the addition of the antioxidant inhibits the oxidation reaction of the butylbenzene emulsion, so that the intermolecular force between carpet back glue and the carpet fibers is greatly improved in the drying process; unexpectedly, the addition of silane and antioxidant significantly increases the tuft pull-out force of the carpet.

title_en: Pesticide fertilizer granules containing chlorantraniliprole and dinotefuran
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide fertilizers, and particularly relates to pesticide fertilizer granules containing chlorantraniliprole and dinotefuran and application thereof. The pesticide fertilizer granules containing chlorantraniliprole and dinotefuran comprise the following components in percentage by weight: 0.01-0.5% of chlorantraniliprole, 0.01-1.0% of dinotefuran, 25-65% of fertilizer, 1-10% of dispersing aid, 2-5% of binder and the balance of filler to 100%; the fertilizer comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 10-25% of urea, 5-20% of ammonium chloride, 2-30% of ammonium sulfate, 3-20% of monoammonium phosphate and 10-20% of potassium chloride. The pesticide fertilizer granules have good control effect on sugarcane borers, and can also control other sugarcane pests such as woolly aphids, thrips and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of green environment-friendly water-based graphene quantum dot cutting fluid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cutting fluids, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a green environment-friendly water-based graphene quantum dot cutting fluid. The preparation method specifically comprises the steps of firstly preparing 2-5 layers of graphene quantum dots, then scientifically preparing the graphene quantum dots with a green and nontoxic surfactant, an antirust agent, a corrosion inhibitor, a preservative, a defoaming agent and the like, testing according to the quality index of GBT/T6144-2010, and preparing stable cutting fluids with different formulas. The lubricating performance of the obtained graphene quantum dot lubricant is improved by 70%, the heat dissipation performance is improved by 50%, the technology is simple and feasible, the labor and material cost is greatly saved, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale popularization.

title_en: Method for breeding black soldier fly larvae by using pig manure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for breeding black soldier fly larvae by using pig manure, which belongs to the technical field of environmental management and comprises the following steps: 1) mixing pig manure and pig urine to obtain pig manure urine, mixing the pig manure urine and black soldier fly larvae, and then culturing in an insect breeding tray; the ratio of the mass of the pig manure to the number of the hermetia illucens larvae is 4-6 mg to 1; 2) spreading escape-preventing materials around the disc wall of the insect breeding disc on the first day, adding the pig manure in the step 1) every day from the second day to the sixth day, separating black soldier fly larvae from manure residues on the seventh day, and harvesting the black soldier fly larvae; controlling the temperature of the pig manure to be 25-35 ℃ in the breeding process from the first day to the sixth day; in the breeding process of the hermetia illucens larvae, the humidity of the hermetia illucens larvae is controlled to be 60-85%. The method provided by the invention provides a better growth environment for the hermetia illucens larvae, fully utilizes the consumed pig manure and urine, and realizes effective and environment-friendly treatment of the pig manure and urine.

title_en: Collection processing recovery unit to oil smoke discharges
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collecting, processing and recycling device aiming at oil smoke emission, which comprises a base, wherein four support columns which are symmetrically arranged are fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the base, one ends of the four support columns, far away from the base, are jointly and fixedly connected with a blanking box, a collecting box is arranged on the base and is over against the blanking box, a working box is fixedly connected to one side wall of the blanking box, far away from the base, the inner wall of the working box is fixedly connected with a plurality of connecting blocks which are centrosymmetrically arranged, one ends of the connecting blocks, far away from the working box, are jointly and fixedly connected with an outer ring, and one side wall of the outer ring, far away from the connecting blocks, is fixedly connected with a plurality of partition plates which are arranged at. The invention can complete the energy-saving treatment work of the oil smoke in high quality and large batch, recover and generate the usable biodiesel, greatly facilitate the treatment of the oil smoke by users and ensure the safety of the air.

title_en: Asphalt manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an asphalt manufacturing facility which can save space and shorten construction period when the facility is arranged and has flexibility. The regenerated material storage tank (18) and the regenerated material metering tank (16) form a regenerated material tower (6) in a manner of being divided into a regenerated material metering unit (17), a regenerated material storage lower unit (19), a regenerated material storage middle unit (20) and a regenerated material storage upper unit (21). The height dimensions of at least the same-stage units of the fresh material tower (5) and the regeneration material tower (6) are made to be the same, and the long side portions of the units of the fresh material tower (5) and the regeneration material tower (6) are connected and arranged to face each other on a stirrer base (2) on which a stirrer (4) is mounted, thereby forming an integral structure.

title_en: Colored curable resin composition, color filter, and display device
abstract_en: The conventionally known colored curable resin compositions have not sufficiently satisfied solubility in a developer used for producing a color filter. The present invention relates to a colored curable resin composition, a color filter and a display device formed by using the same, wherein the colored curable resin composition comprises a colorant, a resin, a polymerizable compound, a polymerization initiator and a compound containing cobalt (III), the colorant comprises triarylmethane lake, and the maximum value of the molar absorption coefficient of the compound containing cobalt (III) in a visible light region is smaller than the maximum value of the molar absorption coefficient of the colorant in the visible light region.

title_en: Application of sulforaphane and derivatives thereof as bacterial effector protein transcription inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of sulforaphane and a derivative thereof as a bacterial effector protein transcription inhibitor. The invention provides application of sulforaphane and derivatives thereof in any one of the following 1) -7): 1) preventing and treating pathogenic bacteria; 2) increasing the resistance of plants to pathogenic bacteria; 3) inhibiting the pathogenicity of pathogenic bacteria; 4) inhibiting the function of pathogenic bacteria type III secretion system; 5) inhibiting the expression of pathogenic bacteria type III secretory system effector protein related genes; 6) inhibiting the expression of the pathogenic bacteria transcription factor hrpL; 7) as an inhibitor of the transcription of effector proteins by pathogenic bacteria. Experiments prove that: the sulforaphane and the derivatives thereof can inhibit the function of a pathogenic bacterium III type secretion system by specifically inhibiting the transcription of the pathogenic bacterium III type secretion system, can resist the invasion of pathogenic bacteria without destroying the interaction between plants and beneficial microorganisms, and have wide application prospect in preventing and treating plant pathogenic bacteria.

title_en: Silica gel-based carbon material oriented heat-conducting interface material and electromagnetic preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silica gel-based carbon material oriented heat-conducting interface material and an electromagnetic preparation method thereof, wherein the silica gel-based carbon material oriented heat-conducting interface material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 70-90 parts of carbon fiber magnetized powder and 10-30 parts of curable sizing material. The carbon fiber magnetized powder is Fe 3 O 4 Carbon fiber composite powder coated with nano particles. By aligning carbon fiber watchThe surface is magnetized, so that the conductive balance of the carbon material can be improved, and the mechanical property and the processability of the carbon material can be improved by adding a curable material.

title_en: Adhesive and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adhesive, application thereof and a product bonded by using the adhesive. The adhesive comprises: a. at least one aqueous polyurethane dispersion; b. at least one surface-deactivated polyisocyanate; c. at least one polycarbodiimide having a weight average molecular weight of 500 to 100000; optionally a carbodiimide having a carbodiimide group functionality of 1. The coating formed by the adhesive provided by the invention has good hydrolysis resistance.

title_en: Thermotropic flame-retardant anti-dripping aromatic liquid crystal copolyester and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermotropic flame-retardant anti-dripping aromatic liquid crystal copolyester and a preparation method thereof, wherein the aromatic liquid crystal copolyester comprises a main chain which is copolymerized by rigid mesomorphic elements and polyester granules, an end sealing group is a phenylacetylene group or a norbornene acetylene group, and the mesomorphic elements are composed of a full aromatic diphenol monomer, a full aromatic diacid monomer and an AB type full aromatic monomer containing a terminal carboxyl A and a terminal hydroxyl B. The aromatic liquid crystal copolyester has lower melting processing temperature and flame-retardant anti-dripping performance, can effectively reduce life and property loss caused by fire, has wide application prospect in the fields of civil textiles and high-temperature protective materials, has controllable molecular weight in the polymerization process, is simpler, more efficient and environment-friendly in preparation process, and does not generate harmful gas during combustion.

title_en: Adsorbent for synergistically removing sulfur and mercury and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adsorbent for synergistically removing sulfur and mercury and a preparation method and application thereof. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method has the advantages of high capacity of synergistic desulfurization and demercuration, and the like, and the obtained adsorbent has the advantages of rich pore structure, high dispersion of active components and the like.

title_en: Quinoline derivative, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preventing and treating plant viruses and killing bacteria
abstract_en: The invention relates to 2-bit alkenyl substituted quinoline derivatives, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in the aspects of preventing and treating plant viruses and sterilizing, wherein the meanings of all groups in the general formula are shown in the specification; the 2-bit alkenyl substituted quinoline derivative has the activity of resisting plant viruses and also has broad-spectrum bactericidal activity.

title_en: Internal circulation type spiral pyrolysis system with heat carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal circulation type spiral pyrolysis system with a heat carrier, which comprises a spiral pyrolysis A section system, a spiral pyrolysis B section system and a distributor, wherein the spiral pyrolysis A section system is connected with the distributor through a pipeline; the spiral pyrolysis A section system and the spiral pyrolysis B section system are connected through a distributing device, and all electric equipment is controlled by a control system. The internal circulation type spiral pyrolysis system with the heat carrier has the advantages of convenience in installation, high heat transfer efficiency, high energy utilization rate, difficulty in material agglomeration and good pyrolysis effect in actual operation.

title_en: Pesticidal mixtures containing spiroheterocyclic pyrrolidine diones
abstract_en: A pesticidal mixture comprising as active ingredient a mixture of component A and component B, wherein component A is a compound of formula (I) Wherein Q is i or ii Wherein X, Y and Z, m and n, A, G and R are as defined in claim 1, and component B is a compound selected from the following insecticides: a) pyrazinone; b) one kind of compound selected from the group consisting of triclopyrPyrethroids of the group consisting of esters, lambda-cyhalothrin, gamma-cyhalothrin; c) a macrolide selected from the group consisting of abamectin, emamectin, and spinetoram; d) a diamide selected from the group consisting of chlorantraniliprole and cyantraniliprole; e) thiamethoxam; f) sulfoxaflor; g) fenpyrad. The invention also relates to a method for controlling plant pests using said mixture.

title_en: Formaldehyde-removing interior decoration coating based on visible light catalysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to visible light catalysis-based formaldehyde-removing interior decoration coating. The coating comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 20-35% of a coating matrix, 15-30% of a solvent, 0.5-3% of an auxiliary agent, 20-30% of a pigment filler and 10-20% of a photocatalyst, wherein the sum of the mass percentages of the raw materials is 100%. Wherein the photocatalyst is modified nano TiO 2 Powder, suitably nano TiO 2 The mass ratio of the particles to the sum of the chromium nitrate and the molybdenum nitrate can improve the photocatalytic performance of the coating and is beneficial to the degradation of formaldehyde. Reasonable reaction temperature and time can ensure the formed modified nano TiO 2 The powder is mainly spherical, has no agglomeration phenomenon, has uniform particle size distribution, and has photocatalytic performanceBetter, the purification efficiency of formaldehyde is better. The pigment and filler are iron oxide red, talcum powder and silicon dioxide, and the iron oxide red, the talcum powder and the silicon dioxide can improve the activity and the chemical stability of the photocatalyst. The coating of the invention has good formaldehyde degradation effect, and the impact resistance, the damp-heat resistance and other comprehensive properties of the coating are excellent.

title_en: Water-based environment-friendly anti-fouling scrub-resistant interior wall coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based environment-friendly anti-fouling scrub-resistant interior wall coating and a preparation method thereof. The interior wall coating comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 58-63 parts of polyurethane resin, 3-7 parts of light calcium carbonate, 3-7 parts of kaolin, 13-16 parts of titanium dioxide, 0.2-0.6 part of dispersing agent, 0.1-0.2 part of pH regulator, 0.5-2 parts of defoaming agent, 15-18 parts of composite auxiliary agent, 1-3 parts of film forming agent, 0.3-0.7 part of surfactant, 1-2 parts of wetting agent, 0.1-0.2 part of bactericide, 1-3 parts of thickening agent and isocyanate curing agent; the interior wall coating prepared by the invention has the characteristics of strong scrubbing resistance and self-cleaning resistance, and can be used as interior wall finishing coatings of families, office buildings and factory buildings.

title_en: Moisture-sensitive controlled-release chelated iron fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moisture-sensitive controlled-release chelated iron fertilizer, which comprises core layer particles, wherein the surfaces of the core layer particles are sequentially coated with a controlled-release inner layer, a nutrient outer layer and a controlled-release outer layer, and the core layer particles and the nutrient outer layer respectively comprise citric acid, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, urea and attapulgite; the controlled release inner layer and the controlled release outer layer both comprise calcium sulfate and attapulgite. Citric acid, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, urea and attapulgite are prepared into chelate liquid, and then calcium sulfate and the attapulgite are prepared into a controlled release material; drying the chelating solution to prepare core layer particles, and then spraying the controlled-release material, the chelating solution and the controlled-release material in sequence to obtain the moisture-sensitive controlled-release chelated iron fertilizer. The fertilizer prepared by the invention can provide citric acid-ferrous urea with high effectiveness and long lasting period for crops, and simultaneously can reduce the alkalinity of soil and improve salinization, and no additional fertilizer is needed in one-time fertilization; effectively treat iron deficiency yellow leaf phenomenon of crops and promote the improvement of the yield and the quality of the crops.

title_en: Preparation method of corrosion-resistant marine paint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of corrosion-resistant marine paint, which comprises 20-30 parts of epoxy resin, 4-10 parts of polycarbonate, 4-12 parts of VAE emulsion, 6-12 parts of polyethylene wax, 4-10 parts of linseed oil pentaerythritol alkyd resin, 6-14 parts of polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fiber, 3-9 parts of mica powder, 2-4 parts of aluminum dioxide, 6-10 parts of zirconia powder, 2-6 parts of nickel powder, 4-10 parts of polytetrafluoroethylene and 6-12 parts of methyl phenyl vinyl silicone rubber according to parts by weight.

title_en: Tank type centrifugal separation oil-water separator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tank type centrifugal separation oil-water separator, which structurally comprises a liquid cup, a connector and a centrifugal separator, wherein the liquid cup is provided with a liquid discharge pipe and a pressure reducing valve, the connector is provided with a gas discharge valve, a gas inlet pipe and a circulating pipe, the centrifugal separator is provided with a separation pipe and a liquid separator, the separation pipe is welded on the centrifugal separator, and the liquid separator is arranged in the centrifugal separator, and the tank type centrifugal separation oil-water separator has the beneficial effects that: through separating oil cover and micro motor and mutually supporting, drive machine oil and liquid water and separate for liquid water carries out water conservancy diversion rapidly, and machine oil gets back to the engine combustion chamber again through the separator tube and burns in leading-in separator tube rapidly through leading the oil groove under centrifugal action simultaneously, makes oil-water separation more thorough, and machine oil is purer, improves fuel power, avoids oil-water separation thoroughly to cause the problem that the automobile power is not enough.

title_en: Surfactant oil displacement system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surfactant oil displacement system and a preparation method thereof. The surfactant flooding system comprises: a surfactant, an organosilicon compound and a silane coupling agent; the content of the organic silicon compound is 0.05 to 10 percent based on the weight of the surfactant as 100 percent; the content of the silane coupling agent is 0.01-5%. The preparation method comprises the following steps: and adding the organosilicon compound and the silane coupling agent into the surfactant according to the dosage to prepare the surfactant oil-displacing system. The invention can reduce the adsorption of the surfactant on the stratum, thereby improving the oil displacement effect and the economic benefit.

title_en: Fungus for promoting compost maturity, screening method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fungus for promoting compost maturity, a screening method and application, and relates to the technical field of biology, wherein the preservation number is as follows: CGMCC No.21024, a method for screening fungi for promoting compost maturity, comprising the following steps: s1: adding the decomposed chicken manure and the sterilized water into a triangular flask according to the weight part ratio of 1:9, sucking supernatant, and diluting the supernatant into 10 by using sterile water ‑5 A concentration gradient of bacterial suspension; s2: respectively sucking 0.1mL of bacterial suspensions with different concentrations, coating the bacterial suspensions on a martin culture medium for culturing for 7d, wherein the culturing temperature is 25 ℃, and selecting fungi with different forms to perform point grafting on the improved martin culture medium for purification; s3: preparing purified fungus bacterial suspension by receiving the improved martin culture medium, and culturing in a constant-temperature incubator at 25 ℃ for 7 d; s4: mixing a chicken manure sample and deionized water according to the weight part ratio of 1:9 mixing in a triangular flask, by counting the seedsAnd screening fungi for promoting compost maturity by using the germination index. Can accelerate the decomposition process and shorten the composting period.

title_en: Acrylic copolymer, pressure-sensitive adhesive, preparation method and application in polarizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an acrylic copolymer, a pressure-sensitive adhesive, a preparation method and an application in a polarizer, wherein the acrylic copolymer comprises the following components, by mass, 20-35% of a soft monomer, 3-9% of a hard monomer, 0.5-5% of a functional monomer, 0.05-0.5% of a free radical initiator and 55-75% of a solvent. And uniformly mixing the acrylic copolymer, the cross-linking agent, the silane coupling agent and the solvent, standing for defoaming to obtain a pressure-sensitive adhesive coating liquid, uniformly coating the pressure-sensitive adhesive coating liquid on a release film, and performing a drying process and a curing process to obtain the pressure-sensitive adhesive. The acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive has good adhesion to a polarizer, high temperature and high humidity resistance, good aging resistance and high light transmittance; and the reaction process is mild and easy to control, and the volatile monomer residue is less.

title_en: Resin composition and flexible display screen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resin composition and a flexible display screen, wherein the resin composition comprises the following components: titanium dioxide-hybridized polymethyl methacrylate, urethane acrylate with cyclohexyl, acrylate with ethylene glycol group and photoinitiator; the urethane acrylate having a cyclohexyl group and the acrylate having an ethylene glycol group each independently contain at least two reactive functional groups. According to the invention, the synergistic effect of titanium dioxide hybridized polymethyl methacrylate, cyclohexyl carbamate acrylate and ethylene glycol acrylate is utilized to ensure that the obtained resin composition has good hardness and flexibility after curing, and can be applied to flexible display hard coatings.

title_en: Method for extracting plant hydrolat by combining eutectic solvent and distillation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting plant hydrolat by combining an eutectic solvent and a distillation method, which is characterized in that the eutectic solvent and deionized water are uniformly stirred to prepare an extraction solvent; pouring the extraction solvent into a container for placing plants, and infiltrating; and (4) putting the soaked container in an oil bath, and distilling and extracting. The hydrolat prepared by the method has mellow smell.

title_en: Microbial compound bacterium agent for improving yield and quality of codonopsis pilosula, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial compound microbial inoculum for improving the yield and the quality of codonopsis pilosula, a preparation method and application, belongs to the field of microbial agricultural application, and particularly relates to the field of microbial compound microbial inoculants to overcome the defects that the conventional microbial inoculants cannot well promote the growth of codonopsis pilosula and enhance the stress resistance under the normal growth condition, wherein the compound microbial inoculants comprise pseudomonas fluorescens, and the strain preservation number is CGMCC NO:20094, Geobacillus, the preservation number of the strain is CGMCC NO:20095 and cell recovery promoting factor Rpf protein, the compound microbial agent can remarkably promote the growth and metabolism capacity of the codonopsis pilosula, remarkably increase the soluble sugar and chlorophyll content of the codonopsis pilosula under the synergistic effect, increase the fresh weight and seedling height of seedlings of the codonopsis pilosula, particularly improve the root activity of the codonopsis pilosula and the capacity of synthesizing SOD and PPO, remarkably improve the growth condition of the codonopsis pilosula, and improve the yield and quality of the codonopsis pilosula.

title_en: Acrylic acid water-based industrial paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of industrial paint, and particularly discloses acrylic acid water-based industrial paint which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 36-40 parts of acrylic emulsion, 8-12 parts of styrene-acrylic emulsion, 8-12 parts of antirust agent, 4-6 parts of film forming agent, 1.3-1.7 parts of dispersing agent, 0.1-0.3 part of defoaming agent, 0.1-0.3 part of wetting agent, 0.4-0.8 part of thickening agent, 13-17 parts of pigment, 0.2-0.5 part of base material wetting agent, 0.2-0.5 part of adhesion promoter, 0.2-0.4 part of anti-flash embroidery agent, 1.4-2.2 parts of organic silicon and 18-22 parts of water; wherein, the organic silicon is obtained by grafting acrylic acid polymer through hyperbranched polyester and then reacting with KH 550; has the advantage of improving the dispersibility of organic silicon in the water-based paint, and also provides a preparation method of the acrylic water-based industrial paint.

title_en: Anti-slip powder coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-skid powder coating, which comprises the following raw materials: carboxyl-terminated polyester resin, a curing agent, a filler, talcum powder, titanium dioxide, mica powder, an anti-slip additive, a wear-resistant additive, a curing accelerator, a three-dimensional sand-textured agent, a conventional additive, a surface roughening agent, a dispersing agent and a pigment. According to the invention, two carboxyl-terminated polyester resins with different acid values are subjected to crosslinking reaction with the curing agent, so that the weather resistance of the prepared anti-skid powder coating is improved, the crosslinking reaction of the two carboxyl-terminated polyester resins with different acid values and the curing agent can be effectively accelerated by adding the curing accelerator, the coating is rapidly cured, and the anti-skid performance of the coating is improved; the mica powder, the dispersing agent and the anti-skid auxiliary agent are pre-mixed and then added, and the mica powder, the dispersing agent and the anti-skid auxiliary agent are synergistic with the anti-skid auxiliary agent, the three-dimensional sand pattern agent, the surface roughening agent and the wear-resistant auxiliary agent, so that the concave-convex state is formed on the surface of the coating, the three-dimensional effect is realized, and the anti-skid powder coating has remarkable anti-skid performance, wear resistance, weather resistance and scratch resistance.

title_en: High-low temperature composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-low temperature composite film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-low temperature composite film is formed by compounding a high-temperature film and a low-temperature film; the preparation raw materials of the high-temperature membrane comprise polyester polyol, first isocyanate, a first catalyst and a first chain extender; the preparation raw materials of the low-temperature film comprise polyether polyol, second isocyanate, a second catalyst, a second chain extender, white carbon black and an epoxy silane coupling agent with a branched structure. The high-low temperature composite film forms an interpenetrating chemical crosslinking network in the film and among layers by screening and compounding the components, particularly introducing an epoxy silane coupling agent with a branched structure, and the bonding property and the mechanical property of the high-low temperature composite film are remarkably improved. The high-low temperature composite film is prepared by a composite film blowing machine set, two-layer compounding is realized in a die head, a laminating process is omitted, the preparation process of the high-low temperature composite film is greatly simplified, and the high-low temperature composite film has a good industrial production prospect.

title_en: Aerogel modified glue solution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of aerogel modified glue solution, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing an aerogel aqueous dispersion; (2) Taking a certain amount of water-based polyurethane adhesive, stirring the water-based polyurethane adhesive by using a stirring device, and adding a proper amount of cosolvent under stirring to prepare a first mixture; (3) Adding the aerogel aqueous dispersion prepared in the step (1) into the first mixture in the step (2), and continuing stirring after the addition is finished to prepare a second mixture; (4) Placing the second mixture mixed in the step (3) together with the container into an ultrasonic device for ultrasonic oscillation operation; (5) standing; (6) Removing sediment at the bottom of the container, and collecting the emulsion with uniform upper layer, thereby obtaining the aerogel modified glue solution. The aerogel modified glue solution prepared by the method can effectively improve the adhesive property and the heat conduction property so as to fully exert the anti-elastic property of the material.

title_en: Nanometer material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a nanomaterial and nanomaterial prepared by the method, the method comprising: a. preparing a carbon dot solution; b. uniformly mixing a silicon source, an active center source, organic alkali and optional water to obtain a first mixture; c. mixing the carbon dot solution with the first mixture to perform hydrolysis reaction to obtain a second mixture; d. and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the second mixture, collecting a solid product, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the nano material. The nano material disclosed by the invention has excellent catalytic activity in the phenol oxidation reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic stability and repeatability are good.

title_en: Butyl rubber self-adhesive material, weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulating film and self-adhesive waterproof roll
abstract_en: The invention relates to a butyl rubber self-adhesive material, a weather-proof waterproof heat-insulating film and a self-adhesive waterproof coiled material, belonging to the field of waterproof materials, wherein the butyl rubber self-adhesive material consists of butyl rubber, polyisobutylene, an anti-aging agent and carbon black; the weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulation film is of a four-layer structure and comprises a PET resin layer, a PVC resin layer, an aluminum powder layer and a fluorocarbon layer which are sequentially arranged; the self-adhesive waterproof coiled material consists of the butyl rubber self-adhesive material and the weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulation film, wherein the butyl rubber self-adhesive material is coated on the surface of a fluorocarbon layer of the weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulation film; the self-adhesive material disclosed by the invention is simple in component, the weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulation film is good in low-temperature flexibility, the low-temperature of-40 ℃ and the high-temperature of 90 ℃ can be kept without cracking, after the self-adhesive material and the weather-resistant waterproof heat-insulation film are compounded, the self-adhesive waterproof coiled material can keep a good bonding effect at-40 ℃ through a smaller gluing thickness, the coiled material is lighter and thinner as a whole, and the application range of the product is favorably expanded.

title_en: Amide auxiliary agent capable of being used as lubricant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an amide auxiliary agent capable of being used as a lubricant and a preparation method thereof, wherein the amide auxiliary agent comprises the following general structureA mixture of one or more of the formulae: wherein X is NH; r 1 、R 2 、R 3 Each independently is one of alkyl groups having 8 to 20 carbon atoms. The amide auxiliary agent disclosed by the invention is almost smokeless, low in viscosity, wide in range of melt drop points, free of metal ions, lubricating and biodegradable.

title_en: Gas barrier laminate
abstract_en: The present invention provides a gas barrier laminate having a laminate structure in which a curable adhesive layer, a gas barrier film, and a protective film are sequentially arranged, wherein the gas barrier laminate is bonded to a glass plate by bringing the curable adhesive layer into contact with the glass plate by a roller under the following condition (α), and then peeled off under the following condition (β), and the other conditions are according to JIS Z0237:2000, and the adhesion force a between the glass plate and the adhesive layer and the adhesion force b between the gas barrier film and the protective film, which are measured, satisfy the following formula (1): a > b (1). Condition (α): the temperature is 23 ℃, the pressure is 0.2MPa, and the speed is 0.2 m/min; condition (β): after the application, the sheet was left to stand at 23 ℃ and 50% relative humidity for 24 hours and then peeled at a peeling speed of 300 mm/min.

title_en: Sterilization regulation synergistic liquid fertilizer containing polyglutamic acid and amino-oligosaccharin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sterilization regulation synergistic liquid fertilizer containing polyglutamic acid and amino-oligosaccharin, which comprises, by weight, 20-30 parts of polyglutamic acid, 20-30 parts of amino-oligosaccharin, 5-10 parts of a compound microbial agent, 10-20 parts of urea, 5-10 parts of monopotassium phosphate, 2-5 parts of magnesium sulfate, 2-5 parts of zinc sulfate, 2-5 parts of ferric sulfate, 2-5 parts of copper sulfate, 10-20 parts of ethanol and 40-50 parts of water. The invention can change the soil microflora, promote the growth of beneficial microorganisms to inhibit some plant pathogenic bacteria, the chitosan oligosaccharide can stimulate the growth of plants to increase the yield and harvest of crops and fruits and vegetables, can induce the disease resistance of the plants, has the effects of generating immunity and killing various fungi, bacteria and viruses, can effectively balance the acid-base value of the soil and avoid the acid soil caused by long-term use of chemical fertilizers.

title_en: Single-component silicon-carbon modified real stone paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-component silicon-carbon modified real stone paint and a preparation method thereof, wherein the single-component silicon-carbon modified real stone paint comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of hydroxyl-terminated silicon-carbon copolymer, 10-60 parts of plasticizer, 1-200 parts of filler, 100-1000 parts of natural color stone, 3-8 parts of cross-linking agent, 0.5-5 parts of tackifier and 0.01-2 parts of catalyst; mixing the hydroxyl-terminated silicon-carbon copolymer with a plasticizer, adding the filler and the natural colored stone, hermetically and uniformly mixing under a vacuum condition, and dehydrating at high temperature to obtain a silicon-carbon modified real stone paint base material; and adding a cross-linking agent, a catalyst and a tackifier into the obtained silicon-carbon modified stone-like paint base material, uniformly mixing under vacuum, and removing bubbles to obtain a finished product. The invention has the advantages of overcoming the defects of the existing material, having excellent high and low temperature resistance, weather resistance and water resistance.

title_en: Organic silicon primer coating composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a silicone primer composition comprising: A) acrylic polymers containing both silicon vinyl groups and silicon hydrogen bonds; B) a solvent. The organic silicon primer coating composition provided by the invention forms a coating layer in a functional area of an LED device, and can be used for bonding the LED device with a sealing material consisting of an addition reaction organic silicon composition for sealing the LED device. After the organic silicon primer coating composition is cured, the contact between external impurities and a silver layer can be isolated, and the sulfuration resistance is improved. The adhesion between the LED device and a sealing material composed of an addition reaction silicone composition for sealing the LED device is improved, and corrosion of a metal electrode formed on a substrate is prevented. Meanwhile, the performance requirements of vulcanization resistance and cold and hot impact resistance are met.

title_en: Gliocladium roseum, gliocladium roseum bacterial liquid and application thereof in preventing and treating sunflower sclerotium disease
abstract_en: The invention relates to gliocladium roseum and gliocladium roseum bacterial liquid and application thereof in preventing and treating sunflower sclerotium disease. The gliocladium roseum MES72701 adopted by the invention has the following preservation unit name: china general microbiological preservation management center, preservation number: CGMCC 3.11519; the invention provides a gliocladium roseum bacterial liquid, wherein the content of gliocladium roseum spores is 1.8 multiplied by 10 7 2.3X 10 units/mL 7 The preparation method comprises the following steps: selecting fresh mycelial of gliocladium roseum after activated culture, inoculating the mycelial to a plate containing a solid PDA culture medium, and then placing the mycelial in a constant temperature incubator at 25-30 ℃ for culturing for 12-16 days; then adding 20-30mL of the culture dishTween 80 in sterile water, spores were washed off with an applicator, filtered, and diluted with an 8-12-fold gradient. The gliocladium roseum bacterial liquid provided by the invention has an obvious antagonistic effect on sclerotinia causing sunflower sclerotiorum, can prevent or reduce the occurrence of sunflower sclerotinia, promotes the stable yield and the yield increase of sunflower, and improves and enhances the yield and the quality of sunflower.

title_en: Dicing tape and dicing die-bonding film
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dicing tape and a dicing die-bonding film. A dicing tape or the like is provided which comprises a base material layer and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer having a higher adhesiveness than the base material layer, wherein the volume crystallinity of the base material layer calculated from the results of differential scanning calorimetry is 20J/cm 3 Above 120J/cm 3 The thickness of the base material layer is 80 μm or more.

title_en: Humanized insect-resistant gene B1F6, protein B1F6 coded by same and application of humanized insect-resistant gene B1F6
abstract_en: The invention provides a humanized insect-resistant gene B1F6, and a protein coded by the same and application thereof, belonging to the fields of genetic engineering and biological control, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the humanized insect-resistant gene B1F6 is shown as SEQ ID No. 1; the amino acid sequence of the insect-resistant protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 2; the insect-resistant protein coded by the humanized insect-resistant gene B1F6 is a single-domain antibody with insecticidal activity obtained by screening from a humanized single-domain antibody library, has small molecular weight and simple preparation, is derived from a human autoantibody, is used for agricultural insect pest control, is safe to human bodies, has important scientific and practical significance for expanding and enriching novel insecticidal gene resources.

title_en: Impact-resistant termination adhesive tape for lithium ion battery and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact-resistant termination adhesive tape for a lithium ion battery, which is characterized by comprising an edge layer, a first functional layer and a second functional layer, wherein the first functional layer and the second functional layer are arranged on any one side of the edge layer, the first functional layer is connected with the second functional layer, the edge layer is a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer which is used for adhering a cell pole coil, and the first functional layer and the second functional layer can deform and separate when meeting electrolyte.

title_en: High-strength water-resistant cellulose-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength water-resistant cellulose-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of cellulose materials. According to the invention, by using a blending method, catechols are added into cellulose under specific conditions to obtain the high-strength waterproof adhesive. Compared with the existing cellulose-based adhesive prepared by a modification method, the production is simpler and more efficient, and the strength and the water resistance are more excellent. The processing method is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the prepared high-strength waterproof adhesive is pollution-free and biodegradable, and is an environment-friendly adhesive.

title_en: Composite solvent for separating cyclane and aromatic hydrocarbon from naphtha
abstract_en: A composite solvent suitable for separating cyclane and arene from naphtha is prepared from N, N-dimethyl formamide, cyclodextrin and 1-butyl-3-methylimidazole dicyanamide salt through mixing, and mixing in the ratio of N, N-dimethyl formamide to cyclodextrin to 1-butyl-3-methylimidazole dicyanamide salt = 80-90 to 10-20 to 1. Compared with sulfolane, the compound solvent has the selectivity of 3.2 to the cycloparaffin, and the removal rate of the cycloparaffin can reach more than 62 percent; the selectivity of the compound solvent to aromatic hydrocarbon can reach 37.2, and the removal rate of the aromatic hydrocarbon can reach more than 95%.

title_en: Liquid crystal polyester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid crystal polyester, which consists of the following repeating units: (I) 49.8 to 89.8mol% of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, (II) 10 to 50mol% of 2-hydroxy-6-naphthoic acid, (III) 0.01 to 5mol% of 3-substituent-4-hydroxybenzoic acid, (IV) 0.01 to 5mol% of 3-substituent-1, 4-phthalic acid, and (V) 0.01 to 5mol% of 3-substituent-1, 4-benzenediol, wherein the substituents of (III), (IV), (V) and (V) are hydrogen atoms and C1-C14 alkyl groups, but the substituents of (III), (IV) and (V) are not hydrogen atoms at the same time. By introducing monomer flexible alkyl to replace aromatic rings, the stacking among molecular chains is inhibited to form a regular structure through the steric hindrance effect of the aromatic rings, so that the crystallinity of the LCP resin is reduced, but the dielectric constant/dielectric loss performance is kept low. The liquid crystal polyester has low crystallinity, and the melting enthalpy measured by DSC is only 0.1-0.7J/g under the same condition; meanwhile, the liquid crystal polyester also has good dielectric property, the dielectric constant is 3.0-4.0, and the dielectric loss tangent value is 0.001-0.002.

title_en: Bio-based environment-friendly trace lubricant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a lubricant composition, which is characterized by being prepared from konjac polysaccharide and myristic acid; the weight component ratio of the konjac polysaccharides to the myristic acid is as follows: 100 parts of konjak polysaccharide; myristic acid 100-120. Adding konjac polysaccharides and myristic acid into a reaction kettle, adding a catalyst, and reacting at the temperature of 180-220 ℃ for 3-5 hours under the protection of nitrogen; the water is removed by pressure reduction in the reaction process; namely the myristic acid ester of the konjac polysaccharide. The konjac polysaccharide myristate is a good nonionic surfactant and a good lubricant, and has good lubricating property; meanwhile, the biodegradability is good, and the environment is friendly. The invention also provides a bio-based environment-friendly micro lubricant containing the lubricant composition, which is prepared from the following components: lubricant composition, myristyl acrylate, rhamnolipid, myristyl lactate, dioctyl sodium sulfosuccinate, dimyristyl phosphate and deionized water.

title_en: Hydro-upgrading catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydro-upgrading catalyst and application thereof, and the hydro-upgrading catalyst comprises a catalyst carrier, an acid component and an active component, wherein the catalyst carrier comprises mesoporous alumina and mesoporous amorphous silicon-aluminum, the acid component is a Y-type molecular sieve, and the active component comprises at least one of VIB group metal and VIII group metal; wherein the pore volume of the mesoporous alumina within the range of 12-20nm is 0.36-0.60 mL/g, and the pore volume of the mesoporous amorphous silicon-aluminum within the range of 12-20nm is 0.51-0.70 mL/g. The hydrogenation modified catalyst contains a highly mesoporous carrier material, can effectively reduce the bulk density of the catalyst, has good macromolecular raw material reaction space, and shows the technical characteristics of excellent hydrogen utilization rate, higher liquid yield, large diesel cetane number increase range, high naphtha aromatic hydrocarbon potential and the like when processing poor catalytic diesel raw materials.

title_en: Dispersion adhesives
abstract_en: The invention relates to formulations for aqueous dispersion adhesives based on aqueous polyurethane or polyurethane-urea dispersions and to the use of said adhesive formulations for adhering foam substrates by spray coagulation.

title_en: Oil extraction device and soybean oil processing production are with integrative device that extracts oil of breakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil pressing device.A pressing end of a pressing device moves sequentially to form a first stroke and a second stroke, and at the stage of the first stroke, the pressing end of the pressing device can drive a lower pressure plate to move downwards in a position direction close to the lower pressure plate and drive a grinding disc to rotate through a rotary transmission device, so that materials on the grinding disc are pressed in a rotating state; in the second stroke stage, when the pressing end of the pressing device moves to drive the grinding disc to rotate until the sliding part of the grinding disc is staggered with the supporting part, the grinding disc can move downwards relative to the bin body. The invention also discloses a crushing and oil pressing integrated device and a soybean oil discharging and pressing device for soybean oil processing production. The invention has the advantages of improving the separation degree of oil residue, improving the oil output quality and having strong flowing water property in the oil pressing process.

title_en: Ancient handmade herbal soap and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient handmade herbal soap and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ancient handmade herbal soap is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 31-40% of alkali powder, 5% of mint powder, 2-3% of radix angelicae powder, 2-3% of nettle powder, 2-3% of radix codonopsis powder, 2-3% of snow lotus powder, 2-3% of rose powder, 2-3% of wormwood powder, 10% of olive oil, 8% of milk, 5-8% of essential oil and 20% of sheep tail oil; the preparation method of the alkali powder comprises the following steps: burning the chenopodium album into ash powder by a smelting furnace, dissolving the ash powder by boiled water, collecting the obtained solution in a container, evaporating to dryness, and naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain khaki alkali powder; the long-term use of the bath lotion can prevent scabies, eczema, tinea of feet and hands, skin acne, acne mark, wrinkle, dryness, darkness and skin itch, and the bath lotion can quickly grow hair, remove scurf, promote blood circulation and regulate blood pressure, and especially has obvious effects of removing miliaria, rash and diseases and dispelling cold when being used for bathing infants.

title_en: Naphtha and pre-ether C4 mixed aromatization device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a naphtha and pre-ether C4 mixed aromatization device and a using method thereof, the device comprises a plurality of hollow spheres with deformation capacity, naphtha is contained in the hollow spheres, a catalyst layer is arranged on the inner wall of the hollow sphere positioned on the outermost layer, catalyst layers are arranged on the inner wall and the outer wall of the hollow sphere positioned on the inner layer, a plurality of communicating pipes which are uniformly distributed are arranged between the hollow spheres, a container is arranged outside the hollow sphere positioned on the outermost layer, a water source is filled between the container and the hollow sphere positioned on the outermost layer, a cavity is arranged in the container, an external connecting pipe communicated with the cavity is arranged on the container and is used for introducing pre-ether C4, one end of each communicating pipe penetrates through the hollow sphere positioned on the outermost layer and is communicated with the cavity in the container, the other end of each communicating pipe is communicated with the hollow sphere positioned on the innermost layer, the device can effectively reduce the problem that a reactor with the, the difference of catalytic effect is large due to overlarge temperature drop, and explosion is easy to occur.

title_en: Aging-resistant adhesive for wall decoration plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aging-resistant adhesive for wall decorative plates and a preparation method thereof, wherein the aging-resistant adhesive for the wall decorative plates comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of modified epoxy resin, 5-8 parts of ethanol, 4-8 parts of glycerol, 1-2 parts of glass fiber, 1-3 parts of basalt fiber, 3-5 parts of plasticizer, 1-3 parts of coupling agent, 1-3 parts of antioxidant, 3-5 parts of stabilizer, 3-5 parts of defoaming agent and 3-5 parts of antibacterial agent, and the modified epoxy resin is prepared by the steps of dissolving, mixing, adding auxiliary agent and the like, wherein the epoxy resin modified by lignin and organic silicon is added, so that the modified epoxy resin has aging resistance and corrosion resistance, and under the action of the antioxidant and the antibacterial agent, the obtained adhesive has good aging resistance, weather resistance and waterproof performance.

title_en: Sinking type liquid delay foaming agent for gas production foam drainage and sand carrying
abstract_en: The invention provides a sinking type liquid delayed foaming agent for gas production foam drainage and sand carrying, which solves the technical problem that in the prior art, a liquid foaming agent cannot disperse and sink in accumulated liquid, so that the concentration of an effective foaming agent in the middle or the bottom of the underground accumulated liquid is too low or even not high, and the drainage effect is seriously influenced. The preparation method comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 60% -80% of nonionic surfactant; 4% -6% of fluorocarbon surfactant; 8% -10% of titanium dioxide; 0.1% -0.3% of xanthan gum; the balance of antifreeze solution. The invention can freely sink and delay foaming in the shaft effusion by a conventional pump injection construction mode, thereby improving the effective equivalent concentration of the foaming agent in the shaft effusion and achieving excellent foam discharging effect.

title_en: Green preparation method and application of zinc-based metal-organic framework material with small molecule recognition performance
abstract_en: A green preparation method and application of a zinc-based metal-organic framework material with small molecule recognition performance are provided, wherein a zinc-based metal-organic framework material with a three-dimensional structure is obtained by a hydrothermal synthesis method, and the molecular formula is C 24 H 18 Cl 0.5 N 4 O 14.5 Zn 3 The material has high hydrothermal stability and air stability. The synthetic route of the zinc-based metal-organic framework material is to add zinc perchlorate hexahydrate, 5-nitro-1, 2, 3-benzenetricarboxylic acid and 4, 4' -bipyridyl into an aqueous solution in proportion, adjust the pH value by lithium hydroxide monohydrate, react at 80 ℃ and then cool to room temperature to obtain a target product. The target product can rapidly and selectively identify n-hexane, n-heptane and isooctane micromolecule compounds. The material disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation method, green and environment-friendly, low in cost, high in yield, good in application effect, good in water and thermal stability and capable of realizing selective recognition capability on small molecules.

title_en: Humidification and fixation integrated device for firing bamboo charcoal and finished bamboo charcoal
