abstract_en: The invention provides a humidifying and fixing integrated device for firing bamboo charcoal and finished bamboo charcoal, which comprises a shell, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the top of the shell, an air outlet pipe is arranged on the right side of the shell, an air inlet pipe is arranged on the left side of the shell, and a discharging hole are formed in the bottom of the shell. The invention provides a humidifying and fixing integrated device for firing bamboo charcoal and finished bamboo charcoal, which effectively solves the problems that the surface of the bamboo charcoal contains a large amount of dust after the processing of the bamboo charcoal is finished, and the bamboo charcoal is not beneficial to being used for air purification, filtration and the like, and greatly reduces the post-treatment cost of bamboo charcoal products.

title_en: Adhesive and method for bonding polypropylene
abstract_en: A two-part polyurethane adhesive exhibits excellent adhesion to low surface energy substrates such as polypropylene. The adhesive is comprised of a polyol component and a polyisocyanate component that are combined and cured to form an adhesive bond. The polyol component is characterized by containing a monohydric alcohol having a molecular weight of 100 to 2000. The presence of the monohydric alcohol promotes strong bonding and a preferred cohesive failure mode in vehicle applications.

title_en: Kitchen garbage purification processor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of kitchen waste machines, in particular to a kitchen waste purifying processor which comprises a base, wherein a machine shell is arranged on the base, a machine frame is arranged in the machine shell, a material bin mechanism is arranged in the machine frame and comprises a material bin assembly and a transmission assembly, the material bin assembly is slidably arranged on the machine frame, the transmission assembly is arranged in the machine shell and is in transmission connection with the material bin assembly, a first purifying device and a second purifying device are arranged in the machine shell, a first bin cover is arranged on the machine shell, a motor is arranged on the first bin cover, a second bin cover is arranged on the first bin cover, an output shaft of the motor is connected with one end of the second bin cover, and the kitchen waste purifying processor is used for solving the problems that the existing kitchen waste machine is inconvenient to take out materials and clean, and the household garbage is treated on site, so that the problems that the garbage is stacked, the stacked garbage is easy to smell, the environment is polluted and the centralized treatment of the garbage is complicated are solved.

title_en: Single-component water-based quick-drying high-gloss paint for high-humidity environment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-component water-based quick-drying high-gloss paint for a high-humidity environment and a preparation method thereof, wherein the paint comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: acrylic emulsion, silica sol, functional additive, film forming additive, thickening agent, pigment, filler and distilled water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing acrylic emulsion and silica sol, and then adding a functional auxiliary agent to obtain a solution I; stirring the pigment, the filler and the distilled water uniformly, and adding the functional auxiliary agent into the mixture to obtain a solution II; and slowly adding the solution II into the solution, controlling the adding flow rate to be 0.5L/min, then adding bentonite and a thickening agent into the solution, then adding a film-forming aid into the solution, and uniformly mixing the solution and the thickening agent. The surface drying time of the coating is between 6 and 28.5min in a 60 to 95 percent high-humidity environment, and the coating has the advantage of short surface drying time; the preparation method of the coating is matched with the raw materials of the coating, and the method has the advantages of reasonable design, easily controlled process and easy production.

title_en: Pseudoxanthomonas mexicana strain and application thereof in promoting breeding of hybrid broussonetia papyrifera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to a Pseudoxanthomonas mexicana and application thereof in promoting the breeding of a hybrid structure, wherein the Pseudoxanthomonas mexicana (Pseudoxanthomonas mexicana) HTZ4 is preserved in the common microorganism center of China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms in 1 month and 13 months in 2021 year, the preservation number is CGMCC No.21617, the Pseudoxanthomonas mexicana HTZ has the effect of nitrogen fixation, can be used as a microbial nitrogen fertilizer for the growth of the hybrid structure tree, and can effectively promote the growth of the root of the axillary bud twig cutting seedling of the hybrid structure tree; the strain also has an inhibiting effect on alternaria solani and fusarium solani, can be used as a microbial bacteriostatic agent, can effectively improve the rooting rate and rooting rate of axillary bud twig cuttage of the hybrid broussonetia papyrifera, increases the survival rate of the cuttage propagation of the hybrid broussonetia papyrifera, reduces the cost of tissue culture seedling propagation, and has great significance for the planting and popularization of the hybrid broussonetia papyrifera.

title_en: Surfactant assisted preparation method of lavender essential oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surfactant assisted preparation method of lavender essential oil, which comprises the following preparation steps: (1) placing 40-100g of lavender dried flower and 0.01-2.5g of surfactant in a beaker; injecting 0.2-2.5L of water into the beaker filled with the dried lavender flowers and the surfactant; (2) ultrasonic extraction of lavender essential oil: ultrasonic extracting at 20-60 deg.C for 5-35 min; (3) distilling the mixture after ultrasonic treatment in water, salting out the distillate, standing at low temperature, and separating liquid from liquid to obtain lavender essential oil. The method introduces the surfactant with low irritation into the extraction and enrichment process of the lavender essential oil, and carries out treatment by ultrasonic, so that the method achieves the effects of simplifying the operation process, reducing organic solvent pollution and improving the extraction efficiency of effective components, and has important contributions in operation simplification, energy conservation, environmental protection and cost saving.

title_en: Pressure sensitive adhesive compositions and related aqueous polymer dispersions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pressure sensitive adhesive composition comprising an aqueous polymer dispersion comprising at least one polymer having monomer units derived from a monomer composition comprising: a)60 to 95% by weight of 2-ethylhexyl acrylate, b)0.1 to 15% by weight of butyl (meth) acrylate, C)0.5 to 5% by weight of a vinyl aromatic monomer, d)0.1 to 4% by weight of at least one ethylenically unsaturated acid, e)0 to 20% by weight of a vinyl ester of a C2-C8 carboxylic acid, f) optionally, monomers other than a), b), C), d) and e) as defined above, g) at least 0.005% by weight of at least one chain transfer agent relative to the total weight of the monomers a) + b) + C) + d) + e) + f), the sum of a) + b) + C) + d) + e) + f) being equal to 100%, and with the proviso that the monomer composition does not comprise any C-C2 alkyl (meth) acrylate. The invention also relates to said aqueous polymer dispersion and to its use in PSA compositions.

title_en: Water-based paint for automotive interior leather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based paint for automobile interior leather, which mainly comprises the following components in parts by weight: 16-31 parts of water-based epoxy resin, 5-15 parts of water-based polyurethane elastomer, 3-9 parts of water-based fluorine-silicon modified acrylate, 25-45 parts of deionized water, 0-30 parts of water-based pigment, 0.1-2 parts of dispersing wetting agent and 6-12 parts of photoinitiator. The water-based paint for the automotive interior leather provided by the invention has the advantages that the synergistic effect of the multi-component mixed resin is exerted, the curing efficiency of the paint is high, the energy consumption is low, and the environment is friendly; meanwhile, the coating has good adhesive force, weather resistance, stain resistance and bending resistance, is smooth and non-sticky in touch, and is particularly suitable for the surface of automotive interior leather.

title_en: Preparation method of label-free fluorescent aptamer probe for detecting exosome based on MOF (metal-organic framework) templated sulfur quantum dot array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a label-free fluorescent aptamer probe for detecting exosomes based on an MOF (metal organic framework) templated sulfur quantum dot array, which comprises the steps of carrying out in-situ hydrothermal preparation on a sulfur quantum dot array in a metal organic framework by taking MOF as a template, then carrying out self-assembly on the sulfur quantum dot array and a specific tumor exosome single-chain DNA aptamer adsorbed with electron receptor dopamine to form a composite system, taking the composite system as a label-free fluorescent aptamer probe, and carrying out aptamer-ligand specific binding on the single-chain DNA aptamer and exosomes when the specific tumor exosomes exist, so that dopamine is competitively separated from sulfur quantum dots, and the dopamine is separated from sulfur quantum dotsAmine-induced quenching of the sulphur quantum dot fluorescence is inhibited as a function of exosome concentration (C) Exosome ) Increasing the intensity of the fluorescence emission peak of the sulfur quantum dot (I) SQDs ) Enhancement, fitting C Exosome And I SQDs The linear relation between the probe and the probe constructs a label-free fluorescent aptamer probe for detecting the exosome, and the label-free fluorescent aptamer probe is used for the fluorescent quantitative detection of the exosome in the biological fluid sample.

title_en: Water culture method for medicinal cannabis sativa
abstract_en: The invention provides a water culture method of medicinal cannabis sativa, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: seedling raising, water bed preparation, transplanting, growth period management and maturation period management; the seedling culture: preparing a seedling culture medium by adopting a mixture of sphagna, peat and fertilizer, and selecting hemp seeds with plump seeds from a medium block for dibbling; and (4) placing the seeded matrix block on a tidal seedling bed for seedling. And (3) transplanting: placing the hemp seedling with matrix blocks into the holes of the floating plate, wherein the planting density is 18 pieces per square. Continuously oxygenating the nutrient solution for 24 hours to ensure that the oxygen content in the water is more than 6mg/L. The water culture nutrient solution is strictly controlled and adjusted, and the obtained hemp has high yield, stable medicinal components, water saving and fertilizer saving by matching with environment regulation and accurate cultivation.

title_en: Michelia figo extract for removing acne and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a michelia figo extract for removing acne, a preparation method and application thereof. The michelia figo extract comprises an extract obtained by extracting and purifying michelia figo. The preparation method comprises placing Michelia figo in shade place, and naturally drying; extracting and purifying the naturally dried michelia figo to obtain a michelia figo extract; wherein the michelia figo comprises michelia figo in the remote mountain which is picked in 4-15 days after blooming. The application of the michelia figo extract comprises the application in preparing perfumed soap or bath foam, the application in preparing antifungal agents, anti-inflammatory agents, aromatic agents and the like, and the application in foods, masks and the like. The beneficial effects of the invention can include: the preparation method is simple and convenient and has low cost; the michelia figo extract has quick curative effect on acne, small side effect and low recurrence rate, and can effectively solve the problems that the acne is placed on a large face for a long time, and unsightly traces are left after large-area outbreak and scabbing.

title_en: Access pipe operating mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an access tube operating mechanism which comprises a freezing tube extracting assembly, wherein the freezing tube extracting assembly comprises a mounting base, a base lifting device for driving the mounting base to lift, a driving motor arranged on the mounting base, a hollow speed reducer with an input shaft connected with an output shaft of the driving motor, a driving nut connected with an output end of the hollow speed reducer, a lifting screw rod in threaded connection with the driving nut and a ventilation joint communicated with an inner cavity of the lifting screw rod, and an opening communicated with the inner cavity of the lifting screw rod is arranged at the bottom end of the lifting screw rod. The access tube operating mechanism can automatically access the frozen storage tube, and has high access efficiency and small risk of biological samples.

title_en: Composite profile control agent system, injection method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite profile control agent system, an injection method and application thereof. The composite profile control agent system comprises a first suspension system and a second suspension system, wherein the first suspension system comprises polymer elastic microspheres, the second suspension system comprises inorganic rigid particles, and the bulk modulus of the inorganic rigid particles is 6-12 GPa. Because the composite profile control agent system comprises a first suspension system with polymer elastic microspheres and a second suspension system with inorganic rigid particles, the composite profile control agent system has the advantages of two systems, namely, the elasticity and the rigidity are combined and mutually supplemented, the composite profile control agent system can be transported to the deep part of a stratum, the plugging strength is high, the plugging effect on an extra-high permeable layer and a large pore passage is good (the plugging rate is more than 97%), the scouring resistance is excellent (the plugging rate is reduced by no more than 5%), and the total effective period of profile control is long.

title_en: Liquid crystal composition, liquid crystal display element and liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a liquid crystal composition, a liquid crystal display element containing the liquid crystal composition and a liquid crystal display, and belongs to the field of liquid crystal display. The liquid crystal composition disclosed by the invention comprises a compound shown in a formula I and at least 2 compounds shown in a formula II, and has large optical anisotropy, high-definition bright spots and good stability after UV illumination and high-temperature treatment.

title_en: Industrial closed gear lubricating oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial closed gear lubricating oil and a preparation method thereof, wherein the lubricating oil comprises 94.2-98.7% of mineral base oil by mass fraction; 0.1-0.3% of antioxidant; 0.1-0.5% of antirust preservative; 0.5-2.0% of extreme pressure antiwear agent; 0.5-3% of detergent dispersant and 0.01-0.02% of antifoaming agent; the viscosity index of the mineral base oil is not less than 95; the detergent dispersant is one or more selected from petroleum sulfonate, alkyl phenate and alkyl salicylate. The industrial closed gear lubricating oil has the oxidation resistance, abrasion resistance, rust resistance and foam resistance of common closed gear oil, also has pollution resistance, can obviously reduce the pollution of a small amount of dust, coal ash, water and other impurities to oil products, and prolongs the service life of the oil products.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device and etching solution
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device and an etching solution. In a wet etching process for patterning a metal layer (e.g., a p-type metal work function layer) on a dielectric layer (e.g., a high-k gate dielectric layer), an inhibitor may be used to increase the selectivity of the wet etching solution to the metal layer and to the dielectric layer. These inhibitors may include phosphoric acid, carboxylic acids, amino acids, or hydroxyl groups.

title_en: Copper-containing catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a copper-containing catalyst which is selected from any one of substances with a structure shown as a formula I. According to the method, the copper-containing catalyst is introduced into the natural raw lacquer, the synergistic effect of the cellulose Schiff base copper and laccase is utilized, the urushiol monomer is promoted to be rapidly oxidized to generate urushiol quinone free radical, and the urushiol monomer is further polymerized to form a high-molecular polymer, so that the purpose of rapid drying of the raw lacquer is realized, and the curing speed of the natural raw lacquer is greatly accelerated.

title_en: Guar gum-humic acid type oil and gas field fracturing fluid flowback fluid water retention and sand fixation agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a guar gum-humic acid type oil and gas field fracturing fluid flowback fluid water-retaining sand-fixing agent and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: adding a demulsifying flocculant into the fracturing flow-back fluid of the oil and gas field, mixing and stirring for 15-25 min, standing for 2-3 h, filtering, adding a peroxide and a catalyst into the filtrate, and stirring and reacting for 3-4 h to obtain a pretreated fracturing flow-back fluid of the oil and gas field; step two: adding a proper amount of modifier into the pretreated fracturing flow-back fluid of the oil and gas field to obtain the fracturing flow-back fluid of the oil and gas field to prepare a sand fixing agent; the modifying agent is humic acid and guar gum, the addition amount of the humic acid is 0.5-3 wt%, and the addition amount of the guar gum is 0.5-2 wt%; the invention not only solves the problems of difficult treatment, large dosage, environmental pollution, waste of water resources and the like of the flowback liquid, but also solves the ecological problem of land desertification by the prepared sand-fixing agent.

title_en: Film-like adhesive, laminate sheet, composite sheet, and method for producing laminate
abstract_en: The film-like adhesive of the present embodiment is used for bonding a circuit-forming surface of a chip and a light-transmissive cover, and at least one surface of the film-like adhesive is substantially free of an aromatic compound.

title_en: Environment-friendly water-based paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of water-based paint, in particular to environment-friendly water-based paint and a preparation method and application thereof. The environment-friendly water-based paint is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 15 parts of calcium carbonate, 3 parts of a leveling agent, 3 parts of a defoaming agent, 20 parts of hydroxyl acrylic resin, 12 parts of polysiloxane emulsion, 2 parts of pigment, 8 parts of a thickening agent, 3 parts of a dispersing agent and 50 parts of water; a preparation method of the environment-friendly water-based paint comprises the following steps: (A) spraying liquid raw materials on a continuously-driven belt from a spray head in sequence; (B) putting the powder raw materials into a semicircular box in sequence, driving a plurality of rotating strips to rotate, and spraying the powder raw materials on a plurality of convex plates on a belt which is continuously driven; (C) the mixing of the liquid material and the powder material is accomplished within the trapezoidal box. An application of an environment-friendly water-based paint, wherein the environment-friendly water-based paint is applied to the field of building interior walls.

title_en: IR printing ink and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sweet potato vermicelli processing, and discloses IR (infrared radiation) ink which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: the material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 110-120 parts by weight of purple ink, 45-55 parts by weight of transparent ink and 10-14 parts by weight of diluent solution. A blending method of IR printing ink comprises the following blending steps: step S1: 25 wt% of acrylic resin M109, 8 wt% of terpene resin solution, 10 wt% of fumaric acid resin and 10 wt% of permanent violet RL. According to the invention, 115 parts by weight of purple ink, 50 parts by weight of transparent ink, 12 parts by weight of diluent solution, 8 parts by weight of surfactant, 12 parts by weight of curing agent, 11 wt% of amino polyamide resin, 13 wt% of polyglycerol fatty acid ester and 9 wt% of dicyclopentenyloxyethyl acrylate are mixed, so that the light shielding property of the IR ink in visible light is effectively improved, the adhesiveness of the IR ink is improved, and the ink coating is convenient.

title_en: Extraction method of lavender essential oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting lavender essential oil, which comprises the following steps: (1) crushing the dry lavender flowers into lavender particles; (2) mixing the lavender crushed aggregates and a surfactant, adding water, and stirring to obtain a mixed feed liquid; (3) carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the mixed material liquid to extract essential oil in the lavender crushed aggregates; (4) distilling the mixed material liquid after ultrasonic treatment, salting out, standing at low temperature, and separating to obtain lavender essential oil. According to the lavender essential oil extraction method, the low-irritation surfactant is utilized to assist in extraction and enrichment of the lavender essential oil, and the low-irritation surfactant is introduced into the extraction and enrichment process of the lavender essential oil, so that the effects of simplifying the operation process, reducing organic solvent pollution and improving the extraction efficiency of effective components are achieved, and the lavender essential oil extraction method has important contributions in operation simplification, energy conservation, environmental protection and cost saving. According to the extraction method disclosed by the invention, the natural characteristic of surfactant increasing and dissolving is fully utilized, the preparation cost of the lavender essential oil is greatly reduced, and the extraction method is more environment-friendly and safer.

title_en: Fig dwarfing planting method and dwarfing device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dwarfing planting method and a dwarfing device for figs. A dwarfing planting method for figs comprises the following steps: soil improvement: applying 50-100kg of fermented fertilizer per mu, mixing with soil, and ridging; planting: planting in the middle ten days of 3 months, wherein the row spacing is 1-1.5m, and the plant spacing is 0.5-0.7 m; pruning after planting: topping when young shoots grow to 10-15 cm, reserving 4-5 strong buds after the young buds germinate, completely removing the rest buds, and pruning in winter: sawing off all the bearing branches in the last 12 th month; spring pruning: 2-3 buds are left at the base of the annual branch; after the buds on the short branches germinate, 4-5 buds growing to the two sides of the ridge are reserved on each tree, and the rest buds are completely removed. The invention also provides a fig dwarfing device which comprises a plurality of groups of limiting devices and limiting rods, wherein two ends of each limiting rod are respectively connected to two adjacent groups of limiting devices. The invention meets the requirements of tourists on picking, forms a good landscape, is convenient for the tourists to pick and is beneficial to improving the yield.

title_en: Compound agent for preventing and treating potato pathogenic bacteria and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound agent for preventing and treating potato pathogenic bacteria and application thereof, in particular to the field of biological prevention and treatment. The invention provides a compound agent for preventing and treating potato pathogenic bacteria, which comprises Bacillus beiLeisi HN-Q-8 fermentation liquor and azoxystrobin suspending agent; the preservation number of the Bacillus beleisi HN-Q-8 is CGMCC No. 19554; the azoxystrobin suspending agent comprises a ningnan azoxystrobin suspending agent or a thifluzamide azoxystrobin suspending agent. The compound agent disclosed by the invention can be used for preventing and treating plant diseases, accords with the green prevention and control trend of the reduction and the enhancement of the application of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and can also avoid the problems of soil hardening, pesticide residue, environmental pollution and the like; meanwhile, the compound agent has good prevention effect and quick response.

title_en: Environment-friendly disperse dye composition, disperse dye, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly disperse dye composition, a disperse dye, a preparation method and application thereof. The disperse dye composition comprises the following components: component A of formula (I): a component B represented by the formula (II): the low-temperature disperse dye composition and the disperse dye have the characteristics of safety and environmental protection, and under normal use conditions, the dye and the textile can meet the requirements of Oeko-Tex standard 100. And when being applied to dyeing of hydrophobic fiber materials, the color fastness is excellent.

title_en: Preparation method for regulating morphology and fluorescence wavelength of inorganic perovskite nanocrystal by using pH value of aqueous solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method for regulating and controlling the morphology and the fluorescence wavelength of inorganic perovskite nano crystals by utilizing the pH value of an aqueous solution. Univalent cation compound, halide, ligand, weak polar or non-polar organic solvent and neutral or acidic aqueous solution are mixed, continuous ultrasonic or stirring is carried out at room temperature, metal halide inorganic perovskite nanocrystalline can be prepared by one step, and organic perovskite nanocrystalline powder can be obtained after separation, purification and drying. The added water solution is changed from neutrality to acidity, the inorganic perovskite nano crystal is changed from nano block to nano wire, and the fluorescence wavelength is blue-shifted. The preparation method is simple to operate, the fluorescence wavelength can be accurately regulated and controlled, the quantum efficiency is high, the cost is low, and the application value is very strong.

title_en: Compound, organic light-emitting material and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The present application provides aThe compound of the general formula (I) has a parent structure of s-triphenyl substituted anthracene, has high bond energy among atoms, good thermal stability, is favorable for intermolecular solid-state accumulation, has large bandwidth, has a light-emitting region in a blue light region, high light-emitting intensity, has a proper energy level with an adjacent layer, and is favorable for exciton injection and transfer. When the blue light host material is used as a blue light host material in a light-emitting layer, the driving voltage of an organic electroluminescent device can be effectively reduced, the light-emitting efficiency is improved, and the service life is prolonged. The present application also provides an organic electroluminescent device and a display device comprising the compound of formula (I).

title_en: Adhesive sheet and image display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adhesive sheet and an image display device. The pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet (15) has a first pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (51) on one main surface of a transparent film substrate (59), and a second pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (53) on the other main surface. The first adhesive layer has a thickness larger than that of the second adhesive layer, and is disposed in contact with the front transparent plate and the second adhesive layer is disposed in contact with the image display panel in the formation of the image display device.

title_en: Emulsion suitable for aluminum plate stamping and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emulsion suitable for aluminum plate stamping and a preparation method thereof, wherein the emulsion comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 15.0-30.0% of base oil, 0.005-1.0% of emulsifier, 0.005-2.0% of oiliness agent, 0.005-3.0% of extreme pressure antiwear agent, 0.005-2.0% of antirust agent and 77.0-84.98% of deionized water. Wherein the base oil is 15# industrial white oil, and the emulsifier consists of AEO-9 and TX-7; the oiliness agent consists of butyl stearate and ethyl oleate; the extreme pressure agent consists of T309, T321 and ZDDP; the antirust agent consists of benzotriazole BTA and dodecenylsuccinic acid T746. The invention improves the formula of the emulsion to improve the lubricity and the cooling property of the emulsion, so that the emulsion is more suitable for an aluminum plate stamping process and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dispersant polymers and compositions comprising the same
abstract_en: A polymer comprising the reaction product of A, B and C and optionally D, wherein: a is a polyepoxide as follows: condensation products of phenol, formaldehyde and epichlorohydrin, condensation products of bisphenol a, formaldehyde and epichlorohydrin, or combinations of said condensation products; b is at least one polyoxyalkylene having a terminal primary amine group, wherein each polyoxyalkylene comprises an ethyleneoxy moiety and a propyleneoxy moiety and independently has the structure:  Wherein R is a hydrogen atom or a C  1 -C 4  group, and wherein x and y are each independently 0 to about 500 and x+y >0; and, C is an anchoring compound as follows: secondary amines, monocarboxylic acids, cyclic imines, or combinations thereof; and D is an alkylating agent. The polymer is included in a composition that further includes a compound such as a particulate solid.

title_en: Colored curable resin composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a colored curable resin composition comprising a colorant (A), a resin (B), a polymerizable compound (C), and a polymerization initiator (D), wherein the colorant (A) comprises a perylene compound (1) having a maximum absorption at 400 to 560nm and no maximum absorption at 560 to 780nm inclusive, and an isoindoline pigment (A1).

title_en: Grafting and planting method for hazelnuts
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filbert grafting and planting method, which belongs to the technical field of filbert grafting and planting and comprises the following steps: (1) selecting Sichuan hazelnuts with the root and stem thickness of 0.8-1cm and capable of growing for two years as stocks; (2) selecting 1-year-old branches of Pingyou hybrid hazelnuts with the thickness of 0.7-0.9cm as scions; (3) grafting by adopting a tongue grafting method, wherein the grafting time is 3-4 months; (4) adopting a root transplanting mode to dig holes to plant grafted seedlings, wherein the planting density is 3m of row spacing and 2m of plant spacing; (5) removing tillers 7 days after grafting; (6) and (3) performing later-stage management, propagating a large number of hazel seedlings by adopting a grafting method, and simultaneously preventing root tillers from sprouting by adopting a root tillering removing agent in the planting process, so that the grafting survival rate is improved, and the planting cost is reduced.

title_en: anti-UV OCA optical adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-UV OCA optical adhesive which comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 10-60 parts of acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive, 0.1-1 part of ultraviolet absorbent, 0.001-0.1 part of curing agent and 30-80 parts of solvent; the ultraviolet absorbent is 2- (2 '-hydroxy-5' -heptyl phenyl) benzotriazole. The invention also discloses an anti-UV OCA optical adhesive film which is obtained by sequentially coating and curing the anti-UV OCA optical adhesive. The OCA optical adhesive disclosed by the invention has an excellent anti-ultraviolet effect, and the curing degree of the formed optical adhesive film can reach 100%, so that the OCA optical adhesive film has an excellent anti-UV effect on the basis of complete curing of the adhesive layer.

title_en: Thin shell quantum dots for enhanced blue light absorption
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nanostructure synthesis. The present invention provides highly luminescent nanostructures, particularly highly luminescent quantum dots, comprising a nanocrystal core and at least two thin shell layers. The nanostructure may have an additional shell layer. The invention also provides a method of preparing the nanostructure, a film comprising the nanostructure, and a device comprising the nanostructure.

title_en: Polymer formulation for lining a metal core and method for producing a composite piezoelectric fiber
abstract_en: The present invention relates to multicomponent fibers having a piezoelectric effect comprising an electroactive fluorinated polymer sheath bonded to a metal core. The invention also relates to a solvent fluorinated polymer formulation that enables optimal adhesion to bare conductive wires. The invention also relates to a method for producing these composite fibers and to the use thereof in the fields of textile, filtration and electronics of various technologies.

title_en: Crop sunscald control agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop sunscald control agent, which comprises sodium humate, polyethylene glycol and acer mono leaf-pawpaw extract; the components are as follows by weight: 3-8 parts of sodium humate, 10-20 parts of polyethylene glycol and 60 parts of acer mono leaf-pawpaw extract; the acer saccharum leaf-pawpaw extract is a compound extract of acer saccharum leaf and pawpaw pulp. The crop sunscald control agent is mainly obtained by extracting natural green plants, is non-toxic and pollution-free, and is healthy and environment-friendly; and the apple sunscald control agent has good control effect on apple sunscald, improves the fruit quality and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Nano-reinforced environment-friendly organic silicon antifouling antibacterial coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-reinforced environment-friendly organic silicon antifouling antibacterial coating, which comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight of 100 percent: 10-50% of polysiloxane; 1-20% of quaternary ammonium salt fluorine-silicon polymer; 0.05-0.5% of a catalyst; 0.5-20% of a filler; 40-85% of an organic solvent; the quaternary ammonium salt fluorine-silicon polymer has the following structural general formula: in the formula, R 1 And R 3 Independently selected from H or CH 3 ，R 2 Is selected from C 4 F 9 、C 6 F 13 、C 10 F 21 、N(CH 3 )SO 2 C 4 F 9 Or N (CH) 3 )SO 2 C 6 F 13 ，R 4 Is selected from C 12 H 25 、C 16 H 33 Or C 6 H 5 CH 2 And X is Cl or Br. The organic silicon antifouling antibacterial coating prepared by the invention has excellent antifouling performance, is environment-friendly, has higher mechanical strength, and can be used in the fields of marine antifouling and biomedical treatment.

title_en: Structurally colored articles and methods of making and using structurally colored articles
abstract_en: The present application relates to structurally colored articles and methods of making and using structurally colored articles. One or more aspects of the present disclosure provide a component for an article of manufacture, the component having a film with an optical element that imparts a structural color to the component. The present disclosure also provides methods for manufacturing a component having a film and an optical element, and articles of manufacture including the component.

title_en: Continuous friction-resistant ultraviolet-curing antifogging coating composition and preparation of coating thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an ultraviolet curing antifogging coating composition with continuous friction resistance and a preparation method thereof. The super-hydrophilic coating obtained after photocuring of the coating has excellent continuous antifogging performance and excellent abrasion resistance, so that some defects of antifogging coatings on the market are overcome, the coating still has excellent antifogging performance after being soaked in water for a long time (such as swimming goggles), the continuous antifogging time can reach 1-2 years, and the coating is very suitable for being applied to the fields with antifogging requirements, such as swimming goggles, car lamps, windshields, bathroom mirrors, optical lens materials and the like.

title_en: Extraction and refining process of rice bran oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rice bran oil production, and particularly relates to an extraction and refining process of rice bran oil, which adopts extrusion foaming puffing and microwave drying enzyme deactivation technologies to realize the conditioning of rice bran, deactivate lipase and enhance the fresh-keeping effect of the rice bran, is favorable for the fresh-keeping of the rice bran and the improvement of leaching yield.

title_en: Optical film adhesive, adhesive layer, optical element, and image display device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an optical film adhesive having improved durability under severe conditions (high temperature, high humidity and thermal shock) while suppressing bending and scratch of both sides even when used for one side protection of a polarizing plate, and also having excellent reworkability (workability). An adhesive for an optical film comprises (a) (meth) acrylate copolymer comprising: (a1) About 10 to 95wt% of units derived from alkyl (meth) acrylate monomers; (a2) About 5 to 90wt% of units derived from an alkyl (meth) acrylate monomer having an alkoxyalkyl or alkoxyalkyleneglycol group; and (a 3) units derived from a functional group-containing monomer which is a (meth) acrylic acid derivative monomer having 1 radical polymerizable functional group in an amount of more than about 0wt% and less than about 5wt% (wherein the sum of the amounts of units (a 1), (a 2) and (a 3) is 100 wt%), and the glass transition temperature of the (meth) acrylic acid ester copolymer (a) is higher than about-55 ℃ and less than or equal to about-50 ℃ and the weight average molecular weight is about 700,000-2,000,000.

title_en: OLED display device
abstract_en: The invention provides an OLED display device. The OLED display device comprises an OLED panel, a first driving circuit, a second driving circuit and a driving circuit, wherein the OLED panel is used for displaying images; a backplane assembly for supporting an OLED panel; the bonding layer is arranged between the OLED panel and the back plate assembly and is used for bonding the OLED panel to the back plate assembly; wherein the bonding layer comprises: a first adhesive tape having adhesiveness; and the second adhesive tape is different from the first adhesive tape, and the stripping property of the second adhesive tape is stronger than that of the first adhesive tape. The OLED display device provided by the invention can be reworked and has lower maintenance cost.

title_en: Assembled building waterproof sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an assembly type waterproof sealant for buildings and a preparation method thereof, wherein the waterproof sealant comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises an MS prepolymer, fumed silica, a plasticizer, a thixotropic agent, a light stabilizer, an antioxidant and a modifier; the component B comprises a curing agent; the modifier comprises at least one of active calcium carbonate, heavy calcium carbonate, montmorillonite, zinc powder and nano calcium carbonate. The performance of the assembly type waterproof sealant for the building is equivalent to that of the sealant in the existing market in the aspect of performance, and in addition, the elasticity recovery rate of the assembly type waterproof sealant is better than that of the existing sealant; in the aspect of ageing resistance, the waterproof sealant disclosed by the invention shows the characteristic of volume expansion, and the waterproof performance of the sealant is further improved.

title_en: Terpyridyl primary amine organic corrosion inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A terpyridine primary amine organic corrosion inhibitor has a structural formula: wherein R represents C 8 ‑C 15 Olefin or benzene aromatic hydrocarbon with the number of benzene rings not more than 3, and the organic corrosion inhibitor is subjected to substitution reaction with 4 '-4- (4-hydroxyphenyl) -2, 2' -6 ', 2' -terpyridine through bromoalkylphthalimide and then deprotection reaction to synthesize a series of terpyridyl-primary amine organic corrosion inhibitors for the marine anticorrosive paint. Terpyridyl and Fe of terpyridyl primary amine organic corrosion inhibitor 2+ Has strong chelating coordination capacity, can play a role in high-efficiency corrosion inhibition when applied to a marine anticorrosive coating, and can effectively enhance the marine anticorrosive coatingCompactness, the infiltration of the corrosion medium is prevented, and the technical support is provided for the development of the long-life heavy anti-corrosion coating.

title_en: Mouth-connecting glue for slow-release fragrance-holding cigarette and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tobacco, and particularly relates to a nozzle adhesive for slow-release cigarette, and a preparation method and application thereof. The slow-release fragrance-holding milk flavor takes modified silicon dioxide microsphere powder with a supermolecular structure as a carrier, the carrier adopts natural L-histidine to catalyze and synthesize silicon dioxide nano microspheres, the silicon dioxide nano microspheres are modified into the supermolecular structure by 3-aminopropyltrimethoxysilane, then heated and molten milk flavor resin is added to carry out physical coating, vanillin is heated to react to carry out chemical modification, the adsorbability and the dispersion uniformity of the carrier are improved, the prepared tip connection glue can be applied to the production of the cigarette industry on line, natural and strong milk flavor characteristic fragrance is provided, the stability at normal temperature is good, and the characteristic of the milk flavor released by heat during burning or heating is obvious, lasting and uniform.

title_en: Rapeseed oil production and processing is with squeezing preliminary treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides squeezing pretreatment equipment for producing and processing rapeseed oil. The pressing pretreatment equipment for rapeseed oil production and processing comprises a box body; the cleaning frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the top of the box body; the feeding hopper is fixedly arranged at the top of the box body and communicated with the box body; the sieve plate is installed on the feed hopper in a sliding and sealing mode; the stirring rod is rotatably arranged in the cleaning frame; the stirring blades are fixedly arranged on the stirring rod; the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the box body and comprises a water outlet plate and a plurality of spray heads, and the water outlet plate is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the top of the box body. The pressing pretreatment equipment for producing and processing the rapeseed oil provided by the invention has the advantages of convenience in use, labor force reduction and high working efficiency.

title_en: Method for reactivating non-regenerated spent catalyst from a gasoline hydrodesulfurization process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for reactivating an at least partially spent catalyst produced by a hydrotreating process, the at least partially spent catalyst being produced from a fresh catalyst comprising a group VIIl metal, a group VIb metal, an oxide support and optionally phosphorus, the at least partially spent catalyst further comprising carbon in an amount of 2 to 20 wt.% relative to the total weight of the at least partially spent catalyst and sulfur in an amount of 1 to 8 wt.% relative to the total weight of the at least partially spent catalyst, the process comprising the steps of: a) Contacting the spent catalyst with an impregnating solution comprising a group VIb metal-containing compound, b) performing a drying step at a temperature of less than 200 ℃.

title_en: High-purity recovery method for gasoline desulfurization alcohol oil gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-purity recovery method of gasoline desulfurization alcohol oil gas, which belongs to the technical field of petrochemicals, impurities and oil drops are filtered in advance by adding a prefilter chain to replace an air filter, the prefilter chain triggers self-breaking action after absorption saturation to realize self-breaking, the rest prefilter chains continue to play a role in filtering, the oil gas of the filtered impurities is discharged from a container and subjected to conventional compression condensation treatment to recover liquid, the fallen prefilter chain is recovered to desorb and recover the oil stored in the prefilter chain, the filtering effect and efficiency of the oil gas are improved, and the subsequent recovery pressure is reduced.

title_en: Hydrogenation device and method for pulverized coal pyrolysis tar combined bed
abstract_en: The invention provides a pulverized coal pyrolysis tar combined bed hydrogenation device and a method, wherein the device comprises a raw material pretreatment unit, a suspension bed hydrogenation unit, a hydrogen supply solvent hydrogenation unit and a first fixed bed hydrogenation unit, wherein a lower outlet, a middle outlet and an upper outlet of the raw material pretreatment unit are correspondingly connected with the suspension bed hydrogenation unit, the hydrogen supply solvent hydrogenation unit and the first fixed bed hydrogenation unit, a lower outlet of the hydrogen supply solvent hydrogenation unit is connected with the suspension bed hydrogenation unit, an upper outlet of the hydrogen supply solvent hydrogenation unit is connected with the first fixed bed hydrogenation unit, and an upper outlet and a middle outlet of the suspension bed hydrogenation unit are connected with the first fixed bed hydrogenation unit. Aiming at the characteristics of the pulverized coal pyrolysis tar, the pulverized coal pyrolysis tar is cut and separated firstly, and different processes are adopted to respectively carry out hydrotreating according to different boiling points of fractions, so that the components in the pulverized coal pyrolysis tar are fully utilized, and the yield of light oil and the quality of oil products are improved; the device can effectively solve the problems of high processing cost and difficult processing, and ensures the long-period stable operation of the device.

title_en: High-strength modified epoxy resin material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength modified epoxy resin material and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of coatings; the high-strength modified epoxy resin material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of nano two-dimensional graphite, 3-8 parts of dolomite, 0.3-0.6 part of initiator, 4-8 parts of methyl potassium silicate, 5-9 parts of lignin and the balance of epoxy resin. The ability of potassium methyl silicate and lignin to interact with other components in the present application can significantly improve the strength of the epoxy resin; the epoxy resin material prepared by the invention has high tensile strength and high compressive strength.

title_en: Rich oil debenzolization heating system utilizing coke oven crude gas heat
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil-rich debenzolization heating system utilizing coke oven crude gas heat, which comprises: the system comprises a steam pipeline, a steam preheater group, a superheated steam pipeline, a rich oil preheater and a rich oil output pipeline, wherein the steam pipeline conveys steam to the steam preheater group; the steam preheater group is arranged on the periphery of a coke oven riser through which high-temperature coke oven crude gas is introduced, and preheats steam by utilizing the heat of the high-temperature coke oven crude gas to generate superheated steam; the superheated steam pipeline conveys the superheated steam to the rich oil preheater, the superheated steam heats rich oil in the rich oil preheater, and the heated rich oil is conveyed to the debenzolization tower through the rich oil output pipeline for debenzolization. The system effectively combines the heat of the coke oven crude gas with the rich oil debenzolization, simplifies the cooling process of the coke oven crude gas, reduces the sensible heat waste of the coke oven crude gas, saves a large amount of gas, and reduces the environmental pollution problem caused by harmful substances such as sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxide and the like.

title_en: Reaction monomer, preparation method thereof and manufacturing method of display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reaction monomer, a preparation method thereof and a manufacturing method of a display panel. The structural general formula of the reaction monomer is shown as the following formula: wherein X is S, Se or Te, R  1  And R  2  Are both substituted or unsubstituted aromatic groups. The reaction monomer provided by the invention has a lower energy band, can absorb light with longer wavelength, and can control the energy band of the reaction monomer by replacing heteroatoms to absorb light with different wavelengths, so that the reaction monomer provided by the invention can complete an alignment process under light sources with different wavelengths, thereby expanding the wavelength selection range of the light sources in the optical alignment process and improving the yield of the optical alignment process.

title_en: Dark red nitrogen oxide fluorescent powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dark red nitrogen oxide fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical general formula of the fluorescent powder is as follows: ba 1‑x Al 2 Si 3 O 4 N 4 :xSm 2+ The value range of x is more than or equal to 0.02 and less than or equal to 0.18. The fluorescent powder has good chemical stability, the excitation band covers 300-600 nm, and the fluorescent powder has wider strong light emission in the wavelength range of 650-850 nm and is suitable for plant illumination.

title_en: Preparation method of ketone anhydride-polyphenol acid active oxygen molecule finishing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ketoanhydride-polyphenolic acid active oxygen molecule finishing agent, which relates to the technical field of textile processing, wherein a ketoanhydride-polyphenolic acid compound is synthesized and added into the finishing agent as an effective antibacterial and acarid-proof component, and the fiber base cloth is endowed with excellent antibacterial and acarid-proof performance through an after-finishing process, the antibacterial and acarid-proof performance is obtained by releasing active oxygen through the ketoanhydride-polyphenolic acid compound, so that high-efficiency killing of bacteria and acarid is realized, and the finishing agent is safe, non-toxic, colorless and tasteless, belongs to a green antibacterial and acarid-proof agent, can ensure that the bacteria killing rate is more than or equal to 99 percent and the acarid repelling rate is more than or equal to 80 percent, and the antibacterial and acarid-proof performance of the fiber base cloth is not obviously attenuated after being subjected to dark drying and storage for 3 months at 37 ℃.

title_en: Flame-retardant polyurethane waterproof coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant polyurethane waterproof coating and a preparation method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of waterproof coatings, which comprises the following steps: polyether polyol, 1, 6-hexamethylene diisocyanate, an organic metal catalyst, a defoaming agent, an organic solvent and a composite filler. The invention can effectively improve the temperature change resistance of the flame-retardant polyurethane waterproof coating, ensure the waterproof flame-retardant performance of the coating at different temperatures and avoid the flame-retardant performance reduction of the coating after long-time use in a low-temperature or high-temperature environment; the graphite and the boron nitride are made into a nano layered graphite/nano boron nitride material under the ultrasonic microwave irradiation stripping treatment, so that the flame retardant property and the temperature change resistance of the coating can be effectively enhanced; the adhesion and the interface shear strength between the carbon fibers and the epoxy resin can be effectively improved, and then the bonding effect between the composite fillers is effectively enhanced, so that the temperature change resistance and the waterproof flame retardant property of the coating are further improved.

title_en: Silicone gel composition, silicone gel comprising same, packaging structure and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicone gel composition, a silicone gel comprising the same, a packaging structure and a semiconductor device. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, the heat conductivity of the silica gel prepared by using the silica gel is improved. Meanwhile, the organic titanium compound and the silane coupling agent in the silicone gel composition can improve the adhesive property of the obtained silicone gel and promote the silane coupling agent to react with the base material through the synergistic effect, so that the adhesive property of the silicone gel is further improved. Therefore, the silicone gel composition can be mixed with the first hydrogen-containing polysiloxane with crosslinking property to form single-component silicone gel, and can also be used as a component B to form double-component silicone gel with the component A with crosslinking property, and the single-component silicone gel and the double-component silicone gel have high heat conductivity and high adhesion property at the same time.

title_en: Plant new energy fuel formula
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant new energy fuel formula which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 40-70 parts of corn straw powder, 30-65 parts of sunflower straw powder, 5-10 parts of plant ash, 5-10 parts of rice hull, 5-10 parts of bagasse, 7-14 parts of cattle manure, 2-5 parts of poplar branches, 5-10 parts of willow branches, 3-7 parts of oak branches, 4-6 parts of camphor branches, 0.2-0.6 part of calcium hydroxide, 0.2-0.5 part of zinc peroxide, 0.5-1 part of chemical catalyst, 10-15 parts of sulfonated oil and 30-70 parts of ethanol. The invention can improve the utilization rate of plants by recycling wastes on the plants, has simple preparation method of the formula and convenient operation, can improve the complete combustion rate of fuel, and can effectively improve the combustion efficiency of a boiler.

title_en: Waterproof roll capable of automatically monitoring leakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof coiled material capable of automatically realizing leakage monitoring, which comprises a waterproof base layer, wherein a heat insulation layer and an ultraviolet-proof layer are sequentially arranged at the top end of the waterproof base layer, a leakage monitoring layer, a hydrophobic layer, a reinforcing layer and a self-adhesive layer are sequentially arranged at the bottom end of the waterproof base layer, a plurality of reinforcing components are uniformly arranged inside the reinforcing layer, a stripping layer is arranged at the bottom end of the self-adhesive layer, a sensor array is embedded inside the leakage monitoring layer, and the sensor array is externally connected with a buzzer and a power supply device. Has the advantages that: the invention greatly improves the actual service performance of the waterproof coiled material through the design of a multilayer structure, wherein the waterproof base layer, the heat insulation layer and the ultraviolet-proof layer respectively increase the waterproof, heat insulation and ultraviolet-proof capabilities of the waterproof coiled material, in addition, the leakage monitoring layer can be arranged to realize the automatic monitoring of the roof leakage, and the buzzer is used for alarming, thereby facilitating the maintenance and overhaul of the roof waterproof engineering.

title_en: N- (2-aryl formaldehyde) -1-aminoindole derivative and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an N- (2-aryl formaldehyde) -1-aminoindole derivative and a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein indoline compounds and o-nitrobenzyl alcohol compounds are used as main raw materials, acetic acid is used as acid, tetraethylammonium iodide is used as an additive, dichloromethane is used as a solvent, 385-405nm ultraviolet light is used for irradiation at room temperature, and the N- (2-aryl formaldehyde) -1-aminoindole derivative is obtained after reaction for 24 hours. The method has the advantages of low cost, high yield, simple and convenient operation, no metal or photocatalyst, environmental protection and the like, and has potential industrial application prospect; meanwhile, the aldehyde group modified N- (2-substituted phenyl) -1-aminoindole derivative fluorescent probe and the synthesis method thereof are disclosed, and the method has the characteristics of simplicity, easiness in operation, high yield and high efficiency and sensitivity.

title_en: Continuous granulating process equipment for trichlorfon
abstract_en: The invention provides continuous granulating process equipment for trichlorfon, which is characterized in that a synthesized trichlorfon material is placed in a heat-insulating kettle to be gradually cooled, the material is ensured to be in a liquid state, and then the material is conveyed to a pre-crystallizer through a feed pump to be slightly cooled. And d, conveying the trichlorfon slurry flowing out of the pre-crystallizer to a granulator. The material is dripped on the annular steel belt through the distributor, and a cooling liquid spraying device can be arranged between the distributor and the annular steel belt, so that the trichlorfon liquid drips in the cooling liquid to form hard spherical white particles and then flows out, and finally, drying and cooling treatment are carried out. The invention basically has no three wastes discharge, reduces occupational health injury; the heat generated by the synthesis of the trichlorfon is recycled through heat exchange, so that the environment is protected and the energy is saved; the particle size of the finished product is more uniform and mellow, and the appearance and the production efficiency of the product are improved.

title_en: Hypochlorite fluorescent probe, preparation method and application thereof, and hypochlorite detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hypochlorite fluorescent probe, a preparation method and application thereof, and a hypochlorite detection method, and relates to the technical field of biochemical materials. The hypochlorite fluorescent probe provided by the invention has the advantages of high sensitivity, good selectivity, high response speed and accurate detection result on hypochlorite ions. Compared with the existing hypochlorous acid fluorescent probe, the hypochlorite fluorescent probe provided by the invention is simple in preparation method, low in detection reagent cost, simple and rapid in detection process, and suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Wall crack-resistant putty powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of putty powder for buildings, in particular to putty powder for cracking resistance of a wall and a preparation method thereof, wherein the putty powder comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: white cement, coarse whiting powder, palm fiber, inorganic antibacterial powder, a dispersant and a thickener; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining raw materials of putty powder; deoiling the palm fibers to obtain deoiled palm fibers; carrying out first stirring on the heavy calcium powder and the thickening agent to obtain a first mixture; carrying out second stirring on the white cement, the inorganic antibacterial powder and the dispersing agent to obtain a second mixture; thirdly stirring the first mixture and the second mixture, adding deoiled palm fibers, and then ultrasonically oscillating and drying to obtain putty powder; the palm fibers, the inorganic antibacterial powder, the dispersing agent and the thickening agent are added on the basis of the white cement and the coarse whiting powder, and then the raw material particles are uniformly distributed by stirring for three times, so that the putty powder with the toughness and the hardness meeting the standard is obtained, and is non-toxic and harmless.

title_en: Preparation method of water-based aluminum paint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of water-based aluminum paint, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding aluminum powder into diethyl alcohol monobutyl ether and a dispersing agent, and uniformly mixing to obtain aluminum paste; s2, adding the silane modified acrylic emulsion into deionized water, sequentially adding a wetting agent, a leveling agent and dipropylene glycol butyl ether, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed emulsion; s3, pouring the aluminum paste into the mixed emulsion, uniformly stirring, adjusting the pH value to 8.0-8.5, and filtering to obtain the water-based aluminum paint; wherein the mass ratio of the aluminum powder, the diethanol monobutyl ether, the dispersing agent, the silane modified acrylic emulsion, the deionized water, the wetting agent, the leveling agent and the dipropylene glycol butyl ether is (2-10): (4-8): (0.5-1): (50-70): 10: (0.2-0.5): (0.2-0.5): (5-10). The water-based aluminum paint prepared by the preparation method has high hardness, high adhesion fastness and strong solvent resistance.

title_en: System and method for cleaning hydrocarbon storage tanks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a modular clean-up hydrocarbon storage tank system and a clean-up method capable of recovering crude oil from waste sludge contained in a hydrocarbon storage tank. Furthermore, the invention relates to the use of the chemical mixture applied in a hydrocarbon storage tank cleaning process. The invention enables the recovery of crude oil from waste sludge contained in the tank.

title_en: Concentrated solid hard surface cleaner
abstract_en: A solid hard surface cleaning composition suitable for use in place of a liquid formulation while providing at least equivalent or enhanced cleaning performance, including at lower concentrations. The solid hard surface cleaning composition comprises an alkali metal carbonate alkalinity source, an aminocarboxylate chelant, an amphoteric surfactant, a polyacrylate polymer, and an anionic surfactant. The solid hard surface cleaning composition may comprise additional functional ingredients, such as corrosion inhibitors. The solid hard surface cleaning composition is free of hydroxide alkalinity and advantageously provides a stable, ready-to-use formulation that is safe to contact and compatible with soft metals without the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

title_en: Ready-to-use peroxyacetic acid disinfectant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ready-to-use peroxyacetic acid disinfectant and a preparation method thereof, comprising 0.1 to 0.2 percent of peroxyacetic acid, 22 to 26 percent of antifreeze and the balance of low-temperature stabilizer by weight percentage; the low-temperature stabilizer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: (6-10), (1.5-2.5), (10-12), (22-25) and water; the ready-to-use peroxyacetic acid disinfectant prepared by effectively combining the low-temperature stabilizer compounded by the triacetin, the alkyl glycoside and the sodium polyacrylate and the composite antifreezing agent has the advantages of high stability, easiness in use and quick-acting property, the freezing point and the corrosivity of the peroxyacetic acid disinfectant are greatly reduced, and the peroxyacetic acid disinfectant can be better applied to spraying disinfection and fumigating air disinfection on the surface of a frozen object.

title_en: Method for preventing and treating Chinese chestnut epidemic disease
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forestry disease prevention and treatment, and particularly relates to a method for preventing and treating Chinese chestnut epidemic disease, which comprises the following steps of preparing raw material components by weight, namely 1-3% of litsea cubeba extract, 4-8% of citral, 10-15% of ethanol and the balance of water; then spraying the extract on leaves and trunks of chestnut trees, wherein the litsea cubeba extract is prepared by grinding litsea cubeba into powder, mixing with water, adjusting the pH to 4-6, then heating under microwave to obtain heating liquid, mixing the heating liquid with ethanol, heating to 80-90 ℃, and carrying out reflux extraction to obtain the litsea cubeba extract; the pesticide has the advantages of simple raw materials, low cost and good control effect, can effectively control and kill after epidemic diseases occur.

title_en: Fertilizer for planting rice with high trace elements and high SOD (superoxide dismutase) and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of energy-saving and environment-friendly high-new agricultural science and technology, and particularly discloses a special fertilizer for rice with high trace elements and high SOD (superoxide dismutase) and a planting application thereof. The special fertilizer comprises a special microelement-rich slow-release base fertilizer, a fertilizer for promoting the flowering period of rice, a fertilizer for protecting the flowering period of rice and a fertilizer for grouting period of rice. According to the growth characteristics of the rice in each growth period, different fertilizers are arranged to promote the synthesis of enzymes such as SOD and the like in the growth process of the rice and move and transfer the enzymes to rice grains, so that the fertilizer quantity is small, the fertilizing times are few, the energy is saved, the environment is protected, and the rice product with high contents of enzymes such as SOD and the like and high contents of trace elements is finally obtained.

title_en: Preparation method of thickness-insensitive double-layer wave-absorbing coating material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a thickness-insensitive double-layer wave-absorbing coating material, which is characterized in that a magnetic absorbent, namely one of carbonyl iron powder, iron cobalt powder, iron silicon aluminum powder and nano iron powder, is blended with a base material in a certain proportion to serve as a bottom layer wave-absorbing material, a modified magnetic absorbent is blended with the base material in a certain proportion to serve as a surface layer wave-absorbing material, and the thickness of each layer of the double-layer wave-absorbing coating material can be finely adjusted within a certain range when the same level of wave-absorbing performance of the double-layer wave-absorbing coating material is maintained through optimization of the filling proportion of the magnetic absorbent, modification, coating thickness design and the like, so that the construction process is simplified, and design and application research of the high-performance wave-absorbing coating material can be simplified and realized.

title_en: Microbial inoculum and application thereof in-situ degradation of high-salt high-oil kitchen waste
abstract_en: The invention provides a microbial inoculum and application thereof in-situ degradation of high-salt high-oil kitchen waste, and the microbial inoculum provided by the invention can quickly decompose the kitchen waste and achieve the flora with deodorizing function, so that the defects of the prior art are overcome. The microbial inoculum provided by the invention comprises bacillus licheniformis, thermophilic bacillus thiobacillus, bacillus amyloliquefaciens and bacillus subtilis. The composite microbial agent can effectively improve the temperature, reduce the moisture of kitchen waste, reduce pathogenic bacteria, maintain a neutral degradation environment and obviously improve the degradation rate of the kitchen waste on the basis of no odor in the degradation process of the high-salt high-oil kitchen waste. Meanwhile, under the action of the microbial agent, the residual quantity of the kitchen waste is greatly reduced, the degradation period is shortened, the personnel cost caused by treatment is reduced, the deodorizing effect is obvious, and the metabolite can be used as a fertilizer for greening and the like, so that the on-site recycling, harmless and reduced quantity and low cost are realized.

title_en: Method for preparing a selective hydrogenation catalyst comprising a step of forming a Ni-Cu alloy in a pre-dip
abstract_en: A process for preparing a selective hydrogenation catalyst comprising nickel, copper and a support, said support comprising at least one refractory oxide, said process comprising the steps of: -contacting the support with a solution containing at least one copper precursor and at least one nickel precursor; -drying the catalyst precursor at a temperature below 250 ℃; -reducing the catalyst precursor by contacting the precursor with a reducing gas at a temperature of 150 ℃ to 250 ℃; -contacting the catalyst precursor with a solution comprising a nickel precursor; -a step of drying the catalyst precursor at a temperature lower than 250 ℃; -reducing the catalyst precursor by contacting the precursor with a reducing gas at a temperature of 150 ℃ to 250 ℃.

title_en: Organic resins bearing tertiary amine and carboxylic acid groups for two-component crosslinkable compositions and aqueous dispersions comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to specific organic resins, in particular acrylic, vinylic or acrylic-vinylic, bearing tertiary amine and carboxylic acid groups, capable of forming aqueous dispersions free of surfactants, a process for preparing aqueous dispersions, and crosslinkable coating compositions comprising said resins or said aqueous dispersions for the preparation of crosslinked coatings without the use of isocyanates.

title_en: Bacterial strain for antagonizing pathogenic bacteria of tobacco target spot and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strain for antagonizing pathogenic bacteria of tobacco target spot, which is pseudomonas aeruginosa GT-6, is preserved in China center for type culture collection, has the preservation date of 2021 year, 7 months and 30 days, and has the preservation number of CCTCC NO: m2021953, the preservation address is China, Wuhan university, the taxonomy is named as Pseudomonas aeruginosa GT-6; the strain which antagonizes the pathogenic bacteria of the tobacco target spot is applied to the prevention and treatment of the tobacco target spot, so that the pathogenic bacteria can be prevented from generating drug resistance, and the prevention and treatment effect is improved.

title_en: Acrylate-polymerizable quaternary ammonium salt copolymer demulsifier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acrylate-polymerizable quaternary ammonium salt copolymer demulsifier and a preparation method thereof, wherein the acrylate-polymerizable quaternary ammonium salt copolymer demulsifier is prepared by the following steps: adding acrylate, polymerizable quaternary ammonium salt, acrylamide, dispersant polyethylene glycol 20000 and chelating agent disodium ethylene diamine tetraacetate into a prepared ether-water mixed solvent, mixing and stirring uniformly to obtain a mixed solution, introducing nitrogen into the mixed solution to remove oxygen for 30min, adding an initiator, heating to a reaction temperature, keeping the temperature for reaction for a period of time, cooling and discharging to obtain a demulsifier; the acrylate-polymerizable quaternary ammonium salt copolymer demulsifier provided by the invention has the characteristics of simple and convenient preparation method, safe raw materials and mild conditions, effectively reduces the safety risk in the production process of the conventional demulsifier, has good demulsification effect, and provides a new idea for selection and application of W/O type crude oil emulsion demulsifying agents.

title_en: Zero-dimensional organic-inorganic hybrid metal halide luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-dimensional organic-inorganic hybrid metal halide luminescent material and a preparation method thereof. The chemical general formula of the zero-dimensional organic-inorganic hybrid metal halide luminescent material is as follows: (C) 9 NH 20 ) 9 [Pb 3 Cl 11 ](MnCl 4 ) 2‑2x (SbCl 5 ) 2x Wherein, C 9 NH 20   + Is the cation of 1-butyl-1-methylpyrrolidine; x is more than 0 and less than 100mol percent. The excitation wavelength range of the luminescent material is 300-450nm, the luminescent material has double-peak emission, and the emission peaks are positioned at 518nm and 660 nm. By changing the excitation wavelength and the value of x, the intensity values of the two emission peaks can be changed, and the continuous change of the light-emitting color from green to warm white to orange is realized. The luminescent material can be used for manufacturing multi-light color luminescent devices, and can be applied to the fields of fluorescent powder, anti-counterfeiting, spectrum conversion, tracing marks and the like.

title_en: Temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and a using method thereof, and the device comprises a boiler, a boiler cover, a first pipeline, a first collecting tank, a second pipeline, a condensing tank, a second collecting tank, a smoke extractor and a frame, wherein the boiler is connected with the boiler cover through bolts, an electric furnace tray and a material basket are installed in the boiler, a thermometer is fixedly installed on the wall of the boiler, one end of the first pipeline penetrates through the boiler cover to be communicated with the boiler, the other end of the first pipeline is communicated with the first collecting tank, the first collecting tank is communicated with one end of the condensing tank through the second pipeline, the other end of the condensing tank is communicated with the second collecting tank through a third pipeline, and the second collecting tank is communicated with the smoke extractor through a fourth pipeline. The electric furnace plate with the adjustable heating temperature heats materials, the temperature in the furnace can be heated to 800 ℃, dry distillation can be carried out on different materials, the rotating speeds of a smoke extractor and a cooling fan are adjusted, zero emission of waste gas can be realized, and distillate generated by the dry distillation of a radiator and a cooling tank is cooled twice, so that the distillate generated by the dry distillation is cooled as far as possible to form dry distillation liquid.

title_en: Cooling liquid for large-size solar-grade silicon wafer diamond wire cutting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooling liquid for cutting a diamond wire of a large-size solar-grade silicon wafer, which comprises the following components in parts by mass: 50-75% of silicon powder surface modifier, 8-12% of lubricant, 5-20% of stabilizer and the balance of deionized water. Adding deionized water into a reaction kettle; starting stirring, sequentially adding the silicon powder surface modifier, the lubricant, the silicon powder activity inhibitor and the stabilizer in a room temperature environment, and stirring for 2-4 hours to completely dissolve the silicon powder surface modifier, the lubricant, the silicon powder activity inhibitor and the stabilizer; stopping stirring, and aging for 2 to 3 hours to obtain the cooling liquid for cutting the diamond wire of the large-size solar-grade silicon wafer.
