The silicon powder cutting fluid has excellent silicon powder dispersing capacity, excellent wetting performance, excellent extreme pressure lubricating performance, extremely strong cooling fluid heat carrying performance and excellent foam control performance, and can meet the technological performance requirements of large-size silicon wafer cutting.

title_en: Adhesive resin composition and easily releasable film
abstract_en: An adhesive resin composition comprising: an ethylene/vinyl acetate copolymer (A) having a content of a structural unit derived from vinyl acetate of 3 to 18 mass% and a melt mass flow rate (MFR, JIS K7210:1999, 190 ℃ C., 2160g load) of 5 to 40g/10 min; a tackifying resin (B); and an ethylene/vinyl acetate copolymer (C) having a viscosity of 15,000 mPas to 300,000 mPas measured at 180 ℃ using a Brookfield viscometer.

title_en: Fluorocarbon gemini anti-oil-foam discharging agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorocarbon gemini anti-oil-foam discharging agent, which comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 0.5% -5% of a fluorocarbon gemini surfactant, 20% -60% of a betaine surfactant, 1% -5% of coconut oil fatty acid diethanolamide, 5% -15% of dodecyl/tetradecyl dimethyl amine oxide, and the balance of water, wherein the raw materials are calculated by 100%. The foam scrubbing agent can be mutually dissolved with water, has high dissolving speed, high mineralization resistance of 150000mg/L and condensate oil resistance of 40 percent (volume ratio), can be used within the temperature range of 20-90 ℃, has excellent foaming, foaming and foam stabilizing properties and large liquid carrying amount, is completely suitable for the foam scrubbing process of a natural gas well containing condensate oil, and meets the use requirement on site. In addition, the foam water discharging agent has good compatibility with medicaments such as methanol, corrosion inhibitor, scale inhibitor and the like, and has no corrosion to equipment and pipelines.

title_en: Efficient water-soluble fertilizer containing bamboo liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bamboo liquid efficient water-soluble fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fertilizer comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 38-40% of bamboo liquid, 38-40% of amino acid, 8-10% of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium, 6-8% of zinc sulfate, 1-2% of boric acid, 3-5% of plant ash, 0.5-1.5% of humic acid, 2-3% of alginic acid and 0.1-0.5% of trace elements. According to the bamboo liquid high-efficiency water-soluble fertilizer and the preparation method thereof, the bamboo liquid is adopted as the main water-soluble fertilizer, so that the bamboo liquid high-efficiency water-soluble fertilizer not only can improve the soil, but also can be used as a plant growth regulator to promote the growth of plants, inhibit the growth of weeds, reduce the dosage of pesticides, and be a pest repellent.

title_en: Phosphor powder and light-emitting device
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention is a phosphor powder containing Eu-activated β -type sialon phosphor particles as a main component. A phosphor powder, wherein the phosphor powder which has not been subjected to an ultrasonic homogenizer treatment has a median diameter (D) measured by wet measurement using a laser diffraction particle size distribution measuring apparatus 50 ) D1 represents the median diameter (D) of the phosphor powder subjected to the ultrasonic homogenizer treatment under the following conditions, which was measured by wet measurement using a laser diffraction particle size distribution measuring apparatus 50 ) D2, wherein D1/D2 is 1.05-1.70. (Condition) 30mg of the phosphor powder was uniformly dispersed in a 0.2% aqueous solution of sodium hexametaphosphate100ml of the dispersion was poured into a cylindrical container having an inner diameter of 5.5cm on the bottom. Next, ultrasonic waves were irradiated to the dispersion at a frequency of 19.5kHz and an output of 150W for 3 minutes in a state where a cylindrical chip having an outer diameter of 20mm of an ultrasonic homogenizer was immersed in the dispersion for 1.0cm or more.

title_en: KCl-Pr-based 3+ Method for preparing X-ray induced photochromic material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a KCl-Pr-based catalyst  3+  The preparation process of X-ray induced photochromic material belongs to the field of photochromic material technology. The invention leads to high purity K  2  CO  3  NaCl and Pr  6  O  11  Grinding and mixing uniformly to obtain mixed powder A; placing the mixed powder A into an oxidizing atmosphere at 1200-1250 ℃ for high-temperature sintering for 6-10 h, and grinding to obtain mixed powder B; the mixed powder B is placed under X-ray irradiation to induce color change, and then the material is heated to restore the original color to obtain the KCl-Pr-based material  3+  Is an X-ray induced photochromic material. The method is based on KCl: pr  3+  The X-ray induced photochromic material has obvious color change, can repeatedly adjust the color of a sample for a long time, can quickly generate color response under the induction of X-rays, and has the characteristics of high color differentiation, high stability, quick color response and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of novel electrorheological fluid
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of novel electrorheological fluid, which is characterized in that the electrorheological fluid comprises the following components: an insulating base liquid and a copper phthalocyanine coated with a polyvinylidene fluoride-trifluoroethylene copolymer (P (VDF-TrFE)) suspended in the insulating base liquid. The invention adopts the ferroelectric copolymer P (VDF-TrFE) to coat the copper phthalocyanine with a large conjugated structure and uses the irradiation crosslinking as the disperse phase of the electrorheological fluid, the disperse phase has low density, good dispersibility, good non-settling property and high shearing strength, and the viscosity is sharply increased under the action of an electric field and is changed from a liquid state to a solid state.

title_en: Intelligent sun-shading material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sun-shading material and a preparation method and application thereof. The sun-shading material disclosed by the invention has excellent sun-shading, heat-insulating and self-cooling effects, higher ultraviolet resistance, certain temperature and illumination self-adaption characteristics and good film-forming property and adhesive force, can be widely applied to various sun-shading products, and plays a role in heat insulation and energy conservation. Meanwhile, the used materials are safe, non-toxic, free of volatile organic compounds and environment-friendly; the preparation process is simple, and the production cost is controllable.

title_en: Pressure-sensitive adhesive with low stripping force and polaroid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-stripping-force pressure-sensitive adhesive and a polaroid, wherein the low-stripping-force pressure-sensitive adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 26-33 parts of soft monomer, 24-28 parts of hard monomer, 4-7 parts of functional monomer, 0.1-0.2 part of initiator, 2-4 parts of curing agent and 0.2-0.6 part of silane coupling agent, wherein the hard monomer comprises a substrate and a modified monomer, the substrate is at least one of methyl methacrylate or vinyl acetate, the modified monomer is a mixture of dimethylaminoethyl methacrylate and a coupling agent, and the coupling agent is a polyfunctional group isocyanic acid radical compound.

title_en: Coke oven plant for producing coke, method for operating a coke oven plant and use
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coke oven plant (10) for producing coke, comprising a plurality of double heating flues (13) with heating ducts, which are each delimited in pairs by a partition (14) and are separated by two mutually opposite, brick-like composite walls (15), wherein at least one inlet from the following group is provided in a lower region on the base (5.4) of the respective heating duct: a coke oven gas inlet (18), a combustion air inlet (16) and a mixed gas inlet (17); wherein, on the respective base (5.4), the ratio (y1: y2) of the distance (y1) between the facing edges of the combustion air inlet (16) and the mixed gas inlet (17) to the distance (y2) of the inner edge of the bulkhead (14) is at least 10%, wherein the distance (y1) between the facing edges of the combustion air inlet (16) and the mixed gas inlet (17) is at least 50mm, wherein at least one of the combustion air inlet and the mixed gas inlet (16, 17) is eccentrically arranged at an x-distance greater than 0.7 times the absolute x-length of the heating duct between the opposite brick-faced composite walls (15). The invention also relates to a corresponding method.

title_en: Kitchen waste treatment process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kitchen waste treatment process, which comprises the following steps: conveying the kitchen waste into a pre-treatment system for screening, pulping and heating; conveying the kitchen waste treated by the pre-treatment system to a recycling system for three-phase separation, and separating crude oil, slag and wastewater; the crude oil and the slag in the recycling system are processed and recycled, and the wastewater enters an anaerobic reactor through a pretreatment system; conveying biogas generated by the anaerobic reactor to an energy recovery system, and conveying wastewater and floating oil generated by the anaerobic reactor to a post-treatment system; the post-treatment system purifies and discharges the generated wastewater, and the activated sludge generated by the post-treatment system is returned to the recycling system; the kitchen waste treatment process can fully utilize energy and resources in the waste, and the kitchen waste is treated in a harmless manner after the resources are utilized, so that the overall process is environment-friendly and clean, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Inorganic putty powder with humidity adjusting function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field and discloses inorganic putty powder with a humidity adjusting function, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: heavy calcium carbonate, talcum powder, double flying powder, white cement, novel silica gel particles, inorganic resin glue, inorganic latex powder, novel silica gel particles comprise silica gel particles, the outer wall of the silica gel particles is provided with an anti-cracking silica gel cover, a rotating groove is formed in the anti-cracking silica gel cover, the anti-cracking silica gel cover is arranged, external humidity can be sensed through the silica gel particles in the anti-cracking silica gel cover, when the external humidity is too high, the silica gel particles in the anti-cracking silica gel cover can be triggered to absorb external moisture through a large ventilation hole and a small ventilation hole, the effect of adjusting humidity is achieved, when the external humidity is too low, absorbed moisture can be discharged from the large ventilation hole and the small ventilation hole due to the difference of the internal humidity and the external humidity, and meanwhile, the automatic adjustment of the humidity caused by the fact that the silica gel particles break due to too much moisture absorption can be prevented through the arrangement of the anti-cracking silica gel cover.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant basalt flake polyurethane coating and coating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrosion-resistant basalt flake polyurethane coating which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of diisocyanate, 40-100 parts of polyol, 60-90 parts of organic silicon resin, 50-80 parts of solvent, 30-80 parts of basalt scales, 10-20 parts of iron powder, 5-10 parts of nickel powder, 5-10 parts of zinc powder, 10-15 parts of leveling agent and 15-25 parts of dispersing agent. According to the invention, iron powder and nickel powder particles are added into the basalt scale polyurethane coating, and after the coating is coated, the coating is subjected to unidirectional repeated scraping test by using a strip magnet before the coating is not solidified, so that the iron powder and nickel powder particles in the coating can be directionally moved, the directional movement of the basalt scales is driven, and the basalt scales are moved in parallel, so that the purpose of increasing the coating anti-corrosion performance by using the basalt scales with relatively less content can be achieved.

title_en: Aqueous polyurethane dispersion and process for producing the same
abstract_en: An aqueous polyurethane dispersion is provided. The aqueous polyurethane dispersions contain a residual portion of the hydroxyl terminated siloxane compound of the backbone and exhibit good block resistance and/or wet color fastness while maintaining excellent mechanical properties. Also provided is a laminated synthetic leather article prepared with the aqueous polyurethane dispersion and a method for preparing the synthetic leather article.

title_en: Agricultural microbial hydrogel agent with disease resistance and yield increase
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural microbial hydrogel agent with disease resistance and yield increase, which is characterized by comprising gamma-polyglutamic acid-chitosan-gelatin composite hydrogel and microbial powder, wherein the microbial powder comprises one or two of fermentation powder of bacillus subtilis MES810 and fermentation powder of bacillus licheniformis MES 816. The microbial hydrogel agent can be used for crop seedling raising, agricultural product yield increase, bacteriostasis and soil and water conservation.

title_en: Pesticide composition containing 28-high brassinolide and choline chloride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pesticide composition containing 28-high brassinolide and choline chloride, which belongs to the technical field of pesticide compositions, wherein 28-high brassinolide and choline chloride are prepared into a suspending agent, an aqueous emulsion, a microemulsion, a wettable powder, a water dispersible granule, a granule and a soluble agent to be applied to plants, so that the plant yield can be effectively improved.

title_en: Perfume or flavour mixture
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fragrance or flavor mixture having a fruity, pear-like taste profile comprising (i) (E) -2-methyl-but-2-enedicarboxylic acid diester, (ii) (Z) -2-methyl-but-2-enedicarboxylic acid diester and (iii) 2-methylenebutanedicarboxylic acid diester, a process for preparing these fragrances or flavors or fragrance mixtures for producing fruity, pear-like odour or taste profiles or for preparing fragrance mixtures or perfume oils, cosmetic preparations, spreaders, detergents and cleaners, foods, animal feeds or pharmaceutical products, and products prepared therefrom to experience an effective amount of the fragrance or flavor mixture.

title_en: Spirofluorene derivative amine compound and organic electroluminescent device comprising the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spirofluorene derivative amine compound and an organic electroluminescent device containing the same, which have the following chemical structure Y is selected from R  1  –R  10  Each independently selected from hydrogen, substituted or unsubstitutedSubstituted alkyl or alkoxy having 1 to 20 carbon atoms, substituted or unsubstituted aryl having 6 to 30 ring-forming carbon atoms, substituted or unsubstituted heteroaryl having 5 to 30 ring-forming carbon atoms, or combined with adjacent groups to form a substituted or unsubstituted ring, a-d are each independently selected from integers of 0 to 4, L is absent or phenylene, X  1  And X  2  Independently selected from single bond, O, S, -NR-or-CRR' -. According to the invention, 3 triarylamines are connected to the 9, 9-spirofluorene derivative, so that the organic light emitting diode has three amine units, namely three possible hole transmission sites, good hole mobility and stable molecular structure, and can reduce the power consumption of OLED (organic light emitting diode) and prolong the service life of the device when being used as a hole transmission material.

title_en: Cabbage type rape seed initiator, initiation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a cabbage type rape seed initiator, an initiation method and application, and relates to the technical field of seed treatment. The raw materials of the initiator comprise common calcium chloride, chitosan oligosaccharide, sucrose and proline. The invention also provides a seed initiation method matched with the initiator, and the seed initiation treatment has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, greenness, high efficiency and good matching with the existing cultivation mode. Compared with the method without seed initiation treatment, after the initiation treatment is carried out on the brassica napus seeds, the germination and emergence rates are improved under the drought condition, the emergence is neat, the growth cycle of the brassica napus is shortened, the crop rotation contradiction is relieved, the plantable area is enlarged, the emergence rate can be improved by 13.7 percent, the use amount of the seeds and a coating agent is saved by 20.9-25.4 percent, and the yield is improved by 18.1 percent.

title_en: Compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound and application thereof, wherein the compound has a structure shown in formula I, and a substituent L is introduced into 1-position of a naphthalene ring 1 ‑Ar 1 Not only can adjust the steric hindrance of the 1-position, but also can effectively adjust and control the twist degree of the molecule so as to reduce the crystallinity of the molecule; secondly, the first step is to carry out the first,the group with a specific structure is introduced on the naphthalene ring 2-substituted N-atom and is matched with the naphthalene ring structure, so that the integral three-dimensional structure of the molecule can be effectively regulated and controlled, the accumulation density of the molecule is improved, and the refractive property of the molecule can be effectively improved, thereby further improving the performance of the device prepared by using the naphthalene ring. Especially, the effect of the material as an electron blocking layer is better, the luminous efficiency of the device can be improved, the driving voltage is reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Method for removing organic chlorine in inferior crude oil
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing organic chlorine in inferior crude oil. Screening a plurality of oil phase demulsifiers, and selecting the oil phase demulsifier with the highest salt rejection rate as the best oil phase demulsifier; screening a plurality of water-phase demulsifiers, and selecting the water-phase demulsifier with the highest salt rejection rate as the best water-phase demulsifier; determining the optimal mass concentration of the oil phase demulsifier and the water phase demulsifier on the basis of determining the optimal oil phase demulsifier and water phase demulsifier; and then carrying out an electric desalting evaluation experiment with the chlorine transfer agent according to the determined optimal mass concentration of the demulsifier of the oil phase and the water phase. The method uses two demulsifiers and one chloride transfer agent in a compounding way without changing the original electric desalting device, and properly adjusts the operating temperature, so that organic chloride in the crude oil is removed after the inferior crude oil which is difficult to be demulsified and dechlorinated passes through the electric desalting unit, the dechlorination rate can reach more than 95 percent, the operation is simple, and the method has good economy.

title_en: Method for the aqueous extraction of biosurfactants from corn steep water
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for extracting biosurfactants from among solids contained in corn steep water by using a buffered aqueous solution having a pH of 6 to 8. The invention also relates to the biosurfactant extract obtained by the process of the present invention and its use in the cosmetic, food, pharmaceutical, agrochemical and environmental industries. The biosurfactant obtained is in the form of a white powder with foaming capacity and is capable of reducing the surface tension of water by at least 16-20 units.

title_en: Method for preparing ammonium dinitramide aqueous solution
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing ammonium dinitramide aqueous solution, belonging to the field of energetic materials. The method takes sulfamate as a raw material and red smoke nitric acid as a nitration reagent, and efficiently prepares the ammonium dinitramide aqueous solution under the action of a catalyst. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, adding red smoke nitric acid and a catalyst into a reactor, cooling to-30 ℃ to-50 ℃, slowly adding sulfamate, and fully stirring for reaction; after the reaction is finished, quenching the reaction by ice water, introducing ammonia gas for neutralization, and purifying by adopting activated carbon to obtain ammonium dinitramide aqueous solution. The method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple synthesis and purification process, capability of efficiently preparing the ammonium dinitramide aqueous solution and suitability for industrial application.

title_en: Preparation method of environment-friendly aromatic solvent for high-grade printing oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an environment-friendly aromatic solvent for high-grade printing oil, which comprises the following components: 50-65% of C10+ distillate oil, 3-5% of initiator, 5-8% of anhydrous ether, 1-2% of methanol, 3-5% of solid alkali, 10-20% of white particle powder and 1-3% of nitrogen; the following devices are required; weighing device, two stirred tank reactors, heater, pressure and temperature safety monitoring system, dripping instrument, methanol feeder, filtering instrument, distillation tower, nitrogen input instrument and separator. The high-precision aromatic hydrocarbon solvent prepared by the preparation method of the environment-friendly aromatic hydrocarbon solvent for the high-grade printing oil enables the environment-friendly performance of the aromatic hydrocarbon solvent to be more excellent in the using process, and improves the product quality.

title_en: Method for solid-phase synthesis of high-quality fluorescent carbon dots in air by taking mesoporous molecular sieve as template
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synthesizing high-quality fluorescent carbon dots in solid phase in air by taking a mesoporous molecular sieve as a template, taking organic micromolecules as a single carbon source, filling the mesoporous molecular sieve as the template into pore channels of the molecular sieve by an impregnation method, directly heating in the air for reacting for a plurality of hours, cooling, and then extracting and eluting by water, ethanol or other solvents to collect product carbon dots. The synthesis method is simple, convenient and quick, does not need a reaction condition of a solvent and high pressure, has high safety, and is suitable for preparing a large number of carbon points with consistent size morphology, composition structure, property and function. The molecular sieve is internally provided with Lewis acid catalytic sites, so that high yield can be realized in a short time; meanwhile, the molecular sieve has good thermal stability, and can be recycled through high-temperature calcination after reaction, so that the preparation cost is greatly reduced. Ethanol or other solvents for extracting carbon points can be recycled through distillation, so that the discharge of waste liquid is reduced, and the method accords with the basic principle of green chemistry.

title_en: C4-C7 fraction of cracked pyrolysis oil
abstract_en: The hydrocarbon cracker stream is combined with the recovered component pyrolysis oil to form a combined cracker stream, and the combined cracker stream is cracked in a cracker furnace to provide an olefin containing effluent. The r-pyrolysis oil may be fed to the cracker feed. Alternatively, the r-pyrolysis oil having a predominantly C4-C7 fraction may be fed to the cracker feed. The furnace may be a gas feed furnace or a cracking furnace.

title_en: Preparation method and analysis method of planar explosive LLM-105 solvate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and an analysis method of a planar explosive LLM-105 solvate, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding the LLM-105 raw material and a solvent into a conical flask, sealing the bottle mouth by using an air balloon, heating in an oil bath pot, and completely dissolving the LLM-105 by magnetic stirring; (2) naturally cooling the LLM-105 solution obtained in the step (1) to room temperature to obtain an LLM-105 supersaturated solution; (3) placing the LLM-105 supersaturated solution in a constant temperature incubator, standing for more than one week to form orange needle-shaped LLM-105 solvent compound crystals at the bottom of the conical flask. The invention realizes the synthesis of the LLM-105 solvate and the crystal structure analysis thereof for the first time.

title_en: Environment-friendly ultrahigh-solid-content epoxy coating orange paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly type epoxy coating with ultrahigh solid content, namely orange paint, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein d-limonene is used for replacing a traditional chemical solvent to reduce the viscosity of a solvent-free epoxy coating, so that the solvent-free epoxy coating with ultrahigh solid content is formed, the solid content of the solvent-free epoxy coating is more than 95 percent, the solvent-free epoxy coating can be directly used without adding a diluent, the excellent corrosion resistance is kept, harmful gas volatilization is avoided, the environment-friendly type epoxy coating with ultrahigh solid content is beneficial to the health of construction personnel, and the environment-friendly type epoxy coating with ultrahigh solid content does not pollute air and soil and water.

title_en: Self-adhesive waterproof coiled material sizing material with improved low-temperature workability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waterproof coiled materials, and particularly discloses a self-adhesive waterproof coiled material sizing material with improved low-temperature workability, and a preparation method and application thereof. The self-adhesive waterproof coiled material sizing material for improving the low-temperature workability comprises the following components: petroleum asphalt, softening oil, base oil, pour point depressant, SBS modifier, SBR modifier, tackifying resin, rubber powder and filler; the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1) heating up petroleum asphalt, base oil and softening oil, adding a pour point depressant, stirring at a controlled temperature, heating, and adding an SBS modifier and an SBR modifier to obtain a colloid; and 2) stirring at controlled temperature, grinding the colloid, adding the rubber powder and tackifying resin, stirring, adding the filler, and uniformly stirring to obtain the self-adhesive waterproof coiled material rubber material with improved low-temperature workability. The self-adhesive waterproof roll prepared by the self-adhesive waterproof roll sizing material with the improved low-temperature constructability has lower low-temperature sensitivity, and contributes to improving the construction efficiency of the self-adhesive waterproof roll.

title_en: Energy-saving environment-friendly refrigerant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving environment-friendly refrigerant and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the liquid phase mixture of difluoromethane and pentafluoroethane, and mass ratio of difluoromethane is 20% -80%, and mass ratio of pentafluoroethane is 20% -80%. According to the energy-saving environment-friendly refrigerant and the preparation method thereof, difluoromethane and pentafluoroethane are mixed according to the proportion of 20 percent during preparation: 80 percent, 30 percent, 70 percent, 40 percent, 60 percent, 50 percent, 40 percent, 60 percent, 30 percent, 70 percent, 40 percent, 60 percent, 30 percent, 50 percent, 40 percent, 60 percent, 30 percent, 70 percent and 20 percent, 80 percent are mixed into seven raw materials, then the seven raw materials are respectively added into seven independent preparation containers, then the pressure of the preparation containers is adjusted to 5.83KPM, then the raw materials are reacted in the preparation containers after waiting for 60min, and finally the environment-friendly refrigerant freon 134a is obtained, because the ODP value of the freon 134a is 0, and the GWP value is between 0.24 and 0.29, the environment damage can be effectively reduced during the use.

title_en: Crosslinkable compositions with low viscosity for coatings and materials with high refractive index and high heat deflection temperature
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crosslinkable composition comprising a) at least one bisphenol fluorene diglycidyl ether tetra (meth) acrylate, and b) at least one diluent from among mono (meth) acrylates of monohydric alcohols having a biphenyl, cumyl or benzyl structure, and at least one optional component from among components c), d) and e). The invention also relates to the use thereof for coatings or materials, in particular for 3D printed articles for optical applications, and the invention further relates to crosslinked compositions and finished products, in particular 3D articles obtained therefrom.

title_en: Impurity removal separator for rapeseed oil processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an impurity removing and sorting machine for processing rapeseed oil, which comprises an operation table, wherein the upper surface of the operation table is provided with a conveying groove for conveying the rapeseed, the bottom end inside the conveying groove is obliquely arranged, one end of the top of the operation table is fixedly provided with an impurity removing chamber, the impurity removing chamber is internally provided with an impurity removing mechanism for cleaning impurities with light quality, the inner surface of the conveying groove is provided with a flattening mechanism for cleaning impurities with larger volume, the bottom of one end of the operation table, which is far away from the impurity removing chamber, is fixedly provided with a sorting chamber, and the sorting mechanism for sorting the rapeseed is arranged inside the sorting chamber, so that the problems that the existing impurity removing and sorting machine for processing the rapeseed oil is insufficient in impurity removal of the rapeseed, the impurity removing effect is poor, and the quality of the produced rapeseed oil is low are solved, meanwhile, the rapeseed can not be sorted, so that the rapeseed with different qualities are mixed together, the quality of the rapeseed oil is influenced, and the economic benefit is reduced.

title_en: Fluorescent carbon quantum dot, preparation method thereof and warm white light emitting LED
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluorescent materials, and particularly discloses a fluorescent carbon quantum dot, a preparation method thereof and a warm white light emitting LED. The raw material components for preparing the fluorescent carbon quantum dots comprise a carbon source, a nitrogen source and a cationic surfactant, wherein the cationic surfactant comprises ammonium bromide salt; the preparation method of the fluorescent carbon quantum dot comprises the following steps: adding a carbon source and a nitrogen source into an organic solvent, performing hydrothermal synthesis, filtering, and centrifuging to obtain a carbon dot solution; adding the carbon dot solution into the cationic surfactant, mixing, taking supernatant, and purifying to obtain the fluorescent carbon quantum dot. The fluorescent carbon quantum dot provided by the invention has the advantages that the preparation process is simple, the raw materials are nontoxic, the price is low, the photon stability and the thermal stability are good, warm white light emission can be generated under the excitation of blue light, the light efficiency can reach 70.21lm/w, the damage of blue light leakage caused by the excitation of the blue light can be avoided, and the fluorescent carbon quantum dot is suitable for being made into healthy warm white light emission LEDs.

title_en: Heat dissipation membrane and heat dissipation adhesive film for portable terminal
abstract_en: A heat dissipation membrane and a heat dissipation adhesive film for a portable terminal relate to the technical field of heat dissipation of electronic equipment, wherein the heat dissipation membrane is a copper graphene composite membrane, the copper graphene composite membrane is a mesh copper net with a graphene solution coated on the surface, and the heat dissipation adhesive film comprises a graphene resin layer, a copper graphene composite membrane and a heat conduction adhesive layer which are sequentially compounded.

title_en: Preparation method and application of 2, 7-dimethoxycarbazole fused compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 2, 7-dimethoxycarbazole fused compound, a preparation method and application thereof, in particular to a synthetic method of the compound and application thereof as a fluorescent molecular probe, belonging to the technical fields of chemical environment sensing and biology. The invention provides a series of 2, 7-dimethoxycarbazole fused compounds or salts thereof, wherein the chemical structure general formula is as follows: wherein, R, R 1 ‑R 7 As described in the claims and specification. The compound can be used as a chemical sensor sensitive to solvent environment and temperature, and can also be prepared into a fluorescent probe molecule for identifying specific DNA.

title_en: Bacteriostatic combination liquid for preventing and treating tobacco bacterial wilt as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bacteriostatic combined solution for preventing and treating tobacco bacterial wilt, a preparation method and application, belonging to the technical field of plant disease prevention and treatment, wherein the bacteriostatic combined solution is prepared by mixing a microbial liquid and a chemical composition; the microbial solution is obtained by mixing lactobacillus bulgaricus lysate and bacillus pumilus fermentation liquor fermented to logarithmic growth phase in a volume ratio of 1: 1; the chemical composition comprises fulvic acid, sinapine, boron plus selenium, puerarin, ellagic acid and chitosan oligosaccharide; the pH value of the antibacterial combined liquid is 7.2-7.8. The antibacterial combination liquid is prepared by effectively combining a microbial agent and chemical components, has a remarkable inhibition effect on tobacco bacterial wilt bacteria through effective proportioning, has a certain promotion effect on the growth and development of tobacco seedlings, and has great significance on the prevention and treatment of tobacco bacterial wilt.

title_en: Tin-doped ternary metal halide material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tin-doped ternary metal halide material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of perovskite crystal material preparation. The preparation method comprises adding ZnCl into the mixture under stirring 2 Slowly dripping KCl DMF solution into the DMF solution, adding stannous chloride, concentrated hydrochloric acid, hypophosphorous acid and sodium citrate into the system, sealing and heating to 120-200 ℃, maintaining for 5 hours, carrying out procedure cooling for 10-36 hours to room temperature for annealing and washing, soaking the crystal into ethanol solution of polyvinyl alcohol, taking out and drying, and carrying out cooling treatment for 1-3 hours to obtain the K with high purity and enhanced fluorescence efficiency 2 ZnCl 4 : sn crystal. The invention successfully grows the K by a hydrothermal method 2 ZnCl 4 : the crystal of Sn shows strong orange red light emission under 302nm excitation and has the advantages of no lead and chromium, high quantum efficiency and environmental stability.

title_en: Application of trichoderma harzianum or fermentation liquor thereof in treating and/or preventing dragon fruit tree rot
abstract_en: The invention provides application of trichoderma harzianum or fermentation liquor thereof in treating and/or preventing the rot disease of pitaya trees. The research of the invention shows that the Trichoderma harzianum fermentation liquor has good control effect on the dragon fruit tree rot caused by the diffusion of the conidia of the acrosporidium bicolor, can be used for preparing various preparations for preventing or treating the dragon fruit tree rot, and provides a novel, high-efficiency and environment-friendly biocontrol preparation source for the control of the dragon fruit tree rot.

title_en: Packaging material capable of being rapidly solidified and transparent flowing at room temperature and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a packaging material which is rapidly solidified at room temperature and transparent and flowing and a preparation method thereof, wherein the packaging material comprises the following components in parts by mass: 15-75 parts of linear hydroxyl end-capped polysiloxane; 15-85 parts of alkoxy end-capped polysiloxane; 0.5 to 10 parts of alkoxy cross-linking agent; 0.5 to 3 parts of novel curing agent; 1.0 to 10.0 parts of modified composite catalyst; 0.03-0.5 part of fluorescent indicator. The invention also provides a preparation method of the packaging material. The packaging material has the characteristics of low viscosity, good fluidity, environmental protection, high transparency, extremely high surface drying speed at room temperature and the like.

title_en: Washable long-acting antibacterial fabric care agent composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a washable long-acting antibacterial fabric care agent composition, which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: the composition comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 5 to 15 percent of composition A; 1% -10% of nonionic surfactant; 0.5 to 2 percent of adhesion promoter; 1 to 5 percent of chelating agent; 0.5 to 20 percent of auxiliary agent; 0.005-0.02% of preservative; the balance of solvent; the composition of the invention has long-lasting antibacterial efficacy for the washed fabric, and can endure at least two times of washing and keep the time unchanged; the long-acting antibacterial effect and broad antibacterial spectrum relate to bacteria and fungi; the technical scheme is simple, convenient and easy to implement, can be completed only in a daily washing process, and has the beneficial effects that the steps of heating, curing and the like for fabric care are not additionally added.

title_en: Soil conditioning composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a soil conditioning composition, which is characterized by comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 51-78 parts of gold tailings, 5-20 parts of magnetite modified biochar, 3-18 parts of diatomite modified chitosan composite material and 10-45 parts of dolomite; wherein, SiO in the gold tailings 2 The content is more than or equal to 60 percent. According to the application, the heavy metal cadmium in the soil can be passivated through the competition effect of the silicon element rich in the gold tailings and the heavy metal cadmium ions in the soil, the absorption of crops to the heavy metal ions is inhibited, the stress effect of the heavy metal cadmium on the plants is reduced, and the silicon element can also promoteThe growth of the plant can enhance the disease resistance and stress resistance of the crop. Particularly, the alkaline sodium salt modified gold tailing material can obviously passivate cadmium ions in soil and has more excellent performance.

title_en: Foaming agent for improving muck of shield of cohesive soil layer, preparation method and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foaming agent for improving muck of a shield of a cohesive soil layer, which comprises a foaming agent base solution, powder abelmoschus manihot gum as an additive and water; the foaming agent base liquid and the water are in a volume ratio of 3-15: 100, the mass part ratio of the additive to the water is 0.025-0.1: 100, respectively; the foaming agent base liquid comprises a solid material of alkyl cane glycoside serving as a main foaming agent, a liquid material of fatty alcohol-polyoxyethylene ether sodium sulfate serving as an auxiliary foaming agent, and the volume part ratio of the alkyl cane glycoside to the fatty alcohol-polyoxyethylene ether sodium sulfate is 2: 1. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a preparation method of the foaming agent for improving the muck of the cohesive soil layer shield and a use method of the foaming agent for improving the muck of the cohesive soil layer shield. The foaming agent is suitable for improvement construction of muck of a cohesive soil layer soil pressure balance shield, the foaming multiplying power of the foaming agent is higher than 20 times, the half-life period is higher than 1200s, the half-life period is almost zero within 5min, the generated foam has high stability, the gas-liquid level strength is high, the foam concentration is high, and the foaming agent can enter a soil body gap to improve the flow plasticity of the soil body.

title_en: Carbon-cleaning powerful gas cleaning agent and preparation and use methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide recycling, and discloses a preparation method and a use method of a carbon-cleaning powerful gas cleaner, wherein the water after cleaning a water circulation device pipeline by adopting a gas cleaner prepared by pressurizing carbon dioxide, nitrogen, helium and argon is the same as PH in the original device, the PH value is not changed, no acid pollution can be directly discharged, meanwhile, the device and the pipeline are not damaged completely, the operation and the service life of the device can be prolonged, during cleaning, online cleaning can be realized, the gas cleaner is added into a water system by a dosing device, the normal operation of the device is not influenced by the addition of the cleaner under the condition of no shutdown, the carbon dioxide tail gas produced by enterprises is captured and recovered by adopting a physical absorption capturing technology of taking polyethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a capturing reagent, the emission of carbon dioxide is reduced, and the carbon dioxide is neutralized and utilized.

title_en: Composite adhesive film, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite adhesive film, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module. Therefore, through the embedded composite molding of the inner film layer and the outer film layer, the POE layer is coated on the outer surface of the EVA layer, the performance of the adhesive film is improved, the POE adhesive film and the EVA adhesive film have the advantages of both the POE adhesive film and the EVA adhesive film, and the laminating efficiency and quality of the adhesive film on the cell piece are improved while the service life of the photovoltaic module is prolonged.

title_en: Preparation method and application of perovskite solar cell with copper phthalocyanine carbon dots as hole transport layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a perovskite solar cell taking copper phthalocyanine carbon dots as a hole transport layer. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking one end of a conductive substrate as a blank, preparing an electron transport layer in the rest part, depositing a perovskite absorption layer, coating copper phthalocyanine carbon dot dispersion liquid, annealing to obtain a copper phthalocyanine carbon dot hole transport layer, scraping carbon paste, heating and drying to obtain the perovskite solar cell. According to the invention, insoluble macrocyclic molecule copper phthalocyanine is treated by a hydrothermal method, so that solubilization and carbonization processes are combined, carbon dots are synthesized from bottom to top, a hole transport layer of the copper phthalocyanine carbon dots is prepared from a solution and does not contain a doping agent, and the hole transport layer is applied to a perovskite solar cell, and the cell efficiency is as high as 13%. The invention breaks through the bottleneck that insoluble organic matters cannot be used as a hole transport layer in solution processing perovskite solar cells, improves the optical performance and the thermal stability of the perovskite solar cells, and reduces the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Corn planting method for protecting black land by performing groove fermentation based on full-amount straw remaining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corn planting method for protecting black land by groove fermentation based on full-amount straw remaining, and belongs to the technical field of crop planting. The method comprises the following steps: chopping the straws, and raking the chopped corn straws into a row every seven ridges; digging a straw fermentation groove on a ridge platform on one side, which is close to the straws and is raked into a line, by using a dry field ditcher, pushing the raked chopped corn straws into the fermentation groove, and spraying fermented liquid livestock and poultry (human) feces on the straws; carrying out protective cultivation on 6 ridges of corns, and not planting corns on the grooves; in autumn, newly digging a straw fermentation groove on the ridge close to one side of the straw fermentation groove by using a dry land ditching machine, and repeating the previous year operation procedure; the straws are fully decomposed and leisure for one year, and corns are sown again on the straws in the third year through land preparation, and fertilizer is applied in a reduced manner. By adopting the corn planting method disclosed by the invention, groove fermentation is carried out, the organic matter content of plough layer soil and the thickness of a black soil layer can be increased, the soil nutrients are increased, the soil fertility is improved, and the black soil is protected; and the fertilizer reduction can be achieved, the production cost is reduced, and the sustainable development of the planting industry is realized.

title_en: Fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antirust coatings, and particularly relates to a fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion and a preparation method thereof. The invention first mixes the fatSynthesizing fatty acid modified monomer with acid and glycidyl methacrylate in the presence of catalyst, adding styrene and acrylic acid monomer in certain proportion, and synthesizing fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion through semi-continuous seed emulsion polymerization. The fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion prepared by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, high feasibility, no addition of any organic solvent in the synthesis process, greenness and environmental protection. The antirust coating prepared from the fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion has excellent comprehensive performance and can isolate H 2 O，O 2 Etc. to prevent corrosion of the metal substrate. The paint film surface of the fatty acid modified styrene-acrylic emulsion has high glossiness, flatness and smoothness, good stability, long-time storage and outstanding effect in the aspect of metal corrosion resistance.

title_en: High-transparency reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-transparency reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The high-transparency reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-45 parts of amorphous polyester polyol, 10-50 parts of polyether polyol, 10-40 parts of isocyanate, 10-30 parts of acrylic resin, 0.2-2.5 parts of adhesion promoter, 0.5-3 parts of latent curing agent, 0.01-0.2 part of catalyst, 0.5-2 parts of ultraviolet absorber and 0.5-2 parts of antioxidant; the isocyanate is one or more of cyclohexylmethane diisocyanate, isophorone diisocyanate and hexamethylene diisocyanate; the acrylic resin has a glass transition temperature greater than 50 ℃. The reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesive has excellent transparency, good yellowing resistance, large initial adhesion, high curing speed, no obvious bubbles generated in an adhesive layer during curing, excellent bonding performance and high final bonding strength.

title_en: Vegetable insulating oil and purification method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a purification method of plant insulating oil, which comprises the following steps: mixing and reacting the crude vegetable insulating oil, acetic acid and water at 60-80 ℃, standing for layering, and taking an organic phase; the crude product of the plant insulating oil is prepared by alkali refining. Mixing the crude vegetable insulating oil, acetic acid and water at a specific temperature, wherein the acetic acid can react with ionic surfactant fatty acid sodium salt generated in alkali refining vegetable insulating oil to generate fatty acid, so that the fatty acid sodium salt with an emulsifying effect is removed; meanwhile, the solubility of the fatty acid sodium salt in water is good, the effective separation of the oil phase and the water phase is realized after the standing, and the fatty acid sodium salt with an emulsifying effect can be further removed, so that the purity of the vegetable insulating oil is high, and the stability is good.

title_en: Polyurethane spraying foam for building energy conservation and sound insulation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polyurethane spraying foam for energy conservation and sound insulation of buildings and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyurethane spraying foam comprises the following raw material components: polyester polyol, flame retardant, stabilizer, isocyanate, inorganic sound insulation material, aerogel material, auxiliary crosslinking agent, modifier and foaming agent; the aerogel material includes one or more of hydrophobic aerogel particles, hydrophobic aerogel powder, and hydrophobic aerogel blocks. The composition can be used for preparing a porous sound insulation material which is light in weight, environment-friendly, excellent in sound absorption and noise reduction performance and good in elasticity, is simple and convenient to prepare and can be widely popularized.

title_en: Production method and application of Paenibacillus epidermidis microbial inoculum for preventing and treating plant fungal diseases
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production method and application of a paenibacillus pickles for preventing and treating plant fungal diseases, which can effectively solve the problem of a fungicide for preventing stem rot of plants Paenibacillus peoriae ) LS20-2-2 is inoculated on LB slant culture medium, cultured for 24-48 h at 25-30 ℃ to obtain activated seeds, the lawn is scraped by a sterilization inoculating ring and inoculated in a nutrient broth liquid culture medium, the shake culture is carried out, the cell concentration is adjusted to 1 × 10 8 Preparing seed culture solution per mL; inoculating the seed culture solution to fermentationFermenting and culturing in a culture medium to obtain LS20-2-2 bacterial suspension, adsorbing LS20-2-2 bacterial suspension by using a carrier, airing, adding potassium fulvate, chitosan, alginate oligosaccharides, a water-retaining agent, sugar alcohol calcium and sugar alcohol zinc, and uniformly mixing to obtain an LS20-2-2 solid microbial inoculum; the Paenibacillus epidermidis microbial inoculum prepared by the invention is effectively used for preventing and treating stem base rot, ensures good growth of crops and high yield of the crops, and has remarkable economic and social benefits.

title_en: Organic compound for organic electroluminescent device and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: An organic compound having a structure represented by formula (1): wherein, X 1 And X 2 Each independently selected from CR 1 R 2 、NR 3 O, S or SiR 4 R 5 One of (1); when R is 1 ～R 5 Any one or more ofWhen present, it is optionally cyclized with Ring A or Ring D; ring A, ring D and ring E are each independently selected from one of a substituted or unsubstituted C5-C30 aromatic ring, C3-C30 aromatic heterocycle, and at least one has a structure represented by formula (a) which is fused with ring A, ring D and ring E through ring F; the ring F and the ring G are respectively and independently selected from one of substituted or unsubstituted C5-C23 aromatic rings and C3-C23 aromatic heterocyclic rings; y is 1 And Y 2 Each independently selected from CR 6 R 7 、NR 8 O, S or SiR 9 R 10 One of (1); r 1 ～R 10 Independently selected from one of hydrogen, halogen, cyano, nitro, hydroxyl, substituted or unsubstituted C1-C10 chain alkyl, C3-C10 cycloalkyl, C1-C10 alkoxy, amino, substituted or unsubstituted C1-C10 silyl, C6-C30 aryl and C3-C30 heteroaryl.

title_en: A raw materials mixing apparatus for nursing preparation of essential oil
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of essential oil preparation, and provides raw material mixing equipment for nursing essential oil preparation, which comprises a mixing box, wherein the bottom of the mixing box is fixedly provided with a supporting leg, the mixing box is connected with a weighing mechanism, a feed hopper is arranged on the weighing mechanism, the weighing mechanism comprises a weighing cylinder and a bottom plate which are fixedly connected, the inner wall of the weighing cylinder is provided with a reciprocating oil pushing component, and the bottom plate is connected with an automatic discharging component; the internally mounted of mixing box has multi-angle rabbling mechanism, install reciprocating type oil outlet mechanism on the inner wall of mixing box. The invention is provided with the reciprocating type oil outlet mechanism which is contacted with the inner wall of the equipment, thereby solving the problem of residual redundant essential oil materials on the inner wall of the equipment, and is also provided with the multi-angle stirring mechanism which can fully mix and stir the raw materials for compounding to achieve good mixing effect.

title_en: Medicinal fertilizer for planting sophora flavescens and planting method of sophora flavescens
abstract_en: A medical fertilizer for planting sophora flavescens and a planting method of sophora flavescens belong to the field of Chinese herbal medicine planting. The pesticide fertilizer for planting the radix sophorae flavescentis comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 40-60% of radix sophorae flavescentis fibrous root crushed material, 15-25% of radix sophorae flavescentis seed crushed material, 7-18% of radix sophorae flavescentis straw crushed material, 0-10% of isatis root crushed material, 0-20% of cortex dictamni peeled root core crushed material and 100% of the total mass percentage of all the raw materials. After soil preparation and fertilization, seedling planting and drip irrigation, primary topdressing and multiple topdressing, the nutrition substances of the stichopus japonicus seedlings can be comprehensively absorbed, various insect pests and mildew can be prevented, and the planting yield of the stichopus japonicus seedlings can be improved.

title_en: Compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound and application thereof, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula I, and the compound can be used as an electron transport material, and not only has higher stability, but also has high charge transfer capacity and high glass transition temperature. The organic electroluminescent device has high luminous efficiency, low driving voltage and long service life.

title_en: Pesticide-resistant biological control bacillus amyloliquefaciens for wheat take-all disease and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pesticide-resistant colas-resistant biocontrol bacillus amyloliquefaciens for wheat take-all disease and application thereof, belonging to the field of agricultural microorganisms. Bacillus amyloliquefaciens (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens) is named NQ36 and is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of the China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms with the preservation number of CGMCC NO. 22695. The bacillus amyloliquefaciens has good tolerance to pesticide Kulas, has good antagonistic action on pathogenic bacteria of wheat take-all, can be used together with the Kulas for preventing and treating the wheat take-all, and realizes pesticide decrement on the basis of ensuring the prevention effect.

title_en: Bisphenol fluorene oxime ester photoinitiator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bisphenol fluorene oxime ester photoinitiator as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation raw material cost of the invention is low, the invention does not relate to high boiling point solvent, is suitable for industrialized production, and can be used in important technical fields of paint, printing ink, dental materials, photoresist and the like.

title_en: Internal part device and method of split-type structure filtering separator containing filter element
abstract_en: An internal part device and a method of a split-type structure filtering separator containing a filter element belong to the technical field of machinery. The outer circumference of the other end of the branch pipe is connected with the core holder, one end of Z-shaped steel is connected with the inner circumference of the core holder, the other end of the Z-shaped steel is connected with one end of the pull rod, the end of the framework without a supporting rib plate is connected with the step of the core holder, the inner cavity of the framework is connected with the front supporting rib plate, the other end of the pull rod is connected with the front supporting rib plate through a fastening nut, the framework is divided into a framework left end and a framework right end, port parts of the framework left end and the framework right end are non-porous areas, porous areas are arranged between the non-porous areas, an O-shaped sealing ring is connected with the inner cavity of the core holder, one end of the filter layer is connected with the lower end cover, the lower end cover is connected with the core holder, the other end of the filter layer is connected with the upper end cover, and the support is connected with the filter core handle. The filter element and the mounting and fixing structure form can effectively reduce sealing points and reduce leakage risks. The invention can effectively reduce the workload of filter element replacement and greatly shorten the replacement time.

title_en: Novel ink printing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel ink printing process, in particular to the technical field of printing, which respectively prepares ink A and ink B, and respectively carries out same-position layered printing on the ink A and the ink B, so that the printed ink B can present different colors when the temperature changes, the printed product has better presenting effect, the preparation and the addition of slow-release type fragrant particles can effectively fuse spices and the ink A, the original taste of the spices is kept, molecules of the two materials can be perfectly combined with each other when the spices and the ink are subjected to ink jet molding to form a durable fragrant ink product, the fragrant particles can be prepared according to the taste corresponding to the product during production, the fragrant particles can emit the taste corresponding to the product, and people can directly feel the taste of the product through the printed product, the waste phenomenon is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Imidazole cation one-dimensional edge-shared metal halide material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imidazole cation one-dimensional edge-shared metal halide material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of organic-inorganic hybrid materials. The chemical formula of the material is ABX 3 A is a cation with triplet energy level in imidazole, and B is a divalent metal ion Pb 2+ 、Sn 2+ 、Ge 2+ 、Mn 2+ Or Zn 2+ X is a halogen ion Cl ‑ Or Br ‑ (ii) a The triplet energy level of the A-site cation is positioned in the inorganic framework BX 3 Lower part of the guide belt, inorganic skeleton BX 3 The conduction band is between the singlet and triplet energy levels of the a cation. The material is prepared by a cooling crystallization method, an anti-solvent method or a slow volatilization method. The material can realize efficient green phosphorescence at room temperatureWith an ultra-long lifetime in milliseconds.

title_en: Polyolefin resin foamed sheet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polyolefin resin foaming sheet, aiming at solving the problems that the prior polyolefin resin foaming sheet is difficult to simultaneously balance degumming performance and waterproof performance, the research of the invention finds that the ratio of the half-peak width and the peak height of the DSC melting peak of the polyolefin resin foaming sheet is controlled within a certain range, so that the polyolefin resin foaming material can realize good waterproof performance, is difficult to degum, and can simultaneously balance degumming performance and waterproof performance. The polyolefin resin foamed sheet of the present invention is particularly suitable for use in waterproofing electronic devices such as smart mobile communication devices, notebook computers, electronic books, tablet terminals, game devices, cameras, wearable electronic devices, and the like.

title_en: Safe quick-setting roadway sealing coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe quick-setting roadway sealing coating and a preparation method thereof, the coating solves the problem of compatibility of inorganic phases and organic phases, and has the advantages of quick setting, good flame-retardant antistatic performance, excellent sealing performance and excellent storage stability of products. It is a mixture of 1:1, wherein the component A consists of the following substances in percentage by mass: water glass 150-; 5-25 parts of silane coupling agent; 2-15 parts of a chain extender; 10-50 parts of amino-terminated polyether; 0.1-1.5 of catalyst; the component B comprises the following substances in percentage by mass: 75-95 parts of isocyanate; 30-45 parts of urethane modified MDI prepolymer; 10-45 parts of ester viscosity reducer.

title_en: Heat-reflecting heat-insulating colorful coating for building exterior wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-reflective heat-insulating multicolor coating for an exterior wall of a building, which comprises 25-35% of silicone-acrylic emulsion, 10-15% of modified hollow glass microspheres, 11-14% of titanium dioxide, 5-9% of infrared ceramic powder, 6-10% of talcum powder, 10-13% of heavy calcium carbonate powder, 2-6% of dispersing agent, 0.1-1% of wetting agent, 3-8% of film-forming additive, 0.1-1% of defoaming agent, proper amount of pH regulator, proper amount of thickening agent and the balance of water 2 O 3 、Fe 2 O 3 、TiO 2 The coating is respectively coated on the surfaces of the hollow glass beads, so that the problem of non-ideal dispersion performance of the hollow glass beads in the water-based coating is solved, the color is introduced for the hollow glass beads, a new preparation process is provided for preparing the color composite type outer wall heat-insulating coating, and the prepared color heat-insulating coating belongs to the field of color composite type outer wall heat-insulating coatingsThe composite heat-insulating coating which is rare in the market at present has three functions of reflection, obstruction and radiation, and the reflection and obstruction functions of the coating are obviously improved along with the addition of the modified hollow glass beads and the rutile titanium dioxide.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant flame-retardant polymer antique eave sealing plate and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a corrosion-resistant flame-retardant polymer antique eave board and a processing method thereof, wherein the antique eave board comprises the following components: PVC resin powder, calcium carbonate particles, basalt fibers, CPE powder, PETG powder, methyl tin stabilizer, polypropylene lubricant, silane coupling agent, antioxidant, flame retardant, curing agent, thickening agent, graphite powder, fine sand, polyurethane and cage type polysilsesquioxane particles, wherein the processing method comprises the following steps: s1, crushing and sieving the raw materials; s2, continuously adding the raw materials and stirring; s3, adding an antioxidant and a flame retardant; s4, injection molding; s5, pressing; and S6, spraying and curing. The invention has reasonable design and simple processing, enhances the anticorrosion effect of the polymer antique eaves-sealing plate by various corrosion-resistant materials, and effectively enhances the fireproof effect of the product by various flame-retardant materials.

title_en: Water-fading water-based protective ink and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based protective ink capable of fading and a preparation method thereof, wherein the water-based protective ink capable of fading comprises the following components in percentage by weight: aqueous resin: 50% -70%; and (3) water-based leveling agent: 0.3% -2%; water-based defoaming agent: 0.3% -2%; aqueous wetting agent: 0.3% -2%; aqueous matting powder: 3% -10%; filling: 5% -10%; pigment: 0.1% -0.5%; water: 5% -30%; cosolvent: 0-10 percent, short demoulding time, no residue, wide applicable process and good high temperature resistance after film forming. The preparation method has the advantages of environment-friendly and pollution-free preparation process, simple and easy operation of the proportioning process, and suitability for industrial production.

title_en: Foliar application fertilizer for rapidly increasing selenium content of crops
abstract_en: The utility model provides a promote fertilizer is used to leaf surface of crop selenium content fast, belongs to fertilizer science and technology field, comprises folic acid, sodium selenite, cockroach polypeptide mixture and deionized water, its characterized in that: the ratio of folic acid, sodium selenite, cockroach polypeptide mixture and deionized water is 0.999 parts of folic acid, 2 parts of sodium selenite, 0.001 part of cockroach polypeptide mixture and 6 parts of deionized water, when in preparation, the deionized water is heated to 40-50 ℃, the hot deionized water is mixed with the sodium selenite, the mixture is stirred for 10-20 minutes to prepare sodium selenite solution, then the cockroach polypeptide mixture is added, the stirring is continued to prepare selenium peptide, the selenium peptide is poured into a closed stirrer with an electric stirring device inside, finally the folic acid is added, the electric stirring is carried out for 30-60 minutes, and the liquid foliar application fertilizer raw liquid capable of rapidly increasing the selenium content of crops can be prepared. The selenium-enriched compound fertilizer is low in cost and convenient to use, and the selenium content of crops can be rapidly increased after the selenium-enriched compound fertilizer is applied.

title_en: High-barrier anti-seepage new material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-barrier anti-seepage new material which comprises aggregate particles, chlorinated polyethylene, hydrophobic epoxy resin, propylene glycol methyl ether, polyurethane, acrylate, soft water, a multifunctional assistant and a defoaming agent, wherein the components are mixed to form a mixture, and the mixture comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-15 parts of aggregate particles, 8-14 parts of chlorinated polyethylene, 5-10 parts of hydrophobic epoxy resin, 0.8-1 part of propylene glycol methyl ether, 3-5 parts of polyurethane, 1-2 parts of acrylate, 5-10 parts of soft water, 0.5-1 part of multifunctional additive and 1-1.5 parts of defoaming agent, wherein all the components are fully stirred and uniformly mixed to finally form the anti-seepage material, the multifunctional additive is AMP-95 and a dispersing agent, and the defoaming agent is one of silicon resin or silicon dioxide fine powder.

title_en: Silver conductive adhesive for high-conductivity interconnection die bonding of high-power LED chips and components
abstract_en: The invention provides a silver conductive adhesive for high-conductivity interconnection die bonding of high-power LED chips and components, which comprises the following components: the silver paste comprises silver powder in the shape of a flat slab, active nano silver powder and an organic carrier, wherein the organic carrier contains a self-sintering surfactant, and the tap density of the silver powder in the shape of the flat slab is 5.8-6.5 g/cm 3 (ii) a The decomposition temperature of the organic vehicle is not higher than 210 ℃. According to the technical scheme, the silver conductive adhesive can be sintered and solidified, the conductive filler silver powder is self-ignited and melted, the organic carrier is decomposed and volatilized under the initiation of the self-sintering surfactant, the silver powder is solidified to form a complete conductive circuit, the substrate, the chip and the component are welded (bonded) and locked to form high-conductivity interconnection, and the adhesion, bonding and conductivity of the silver conductive adhesive are borne by the single crystal-solidified silver crystal, so that the resistance is extremely low, and the conductivity and the thermal conductivity are high.

title_en: Water-and oil-repellent member and method for producing water-and oil-repellent member
abstract_en: A water/oil repellent member comprising a primer layer as a 1 st layer on at least one surface of a substrate, and a water/oil repellent layer as a 2 nd layer on an outer surface of the primer layer, wherein the primer layer comprises a layer having a thickness of 0.5 to 500nm and containing nanodiamond, the layer comprising an organosilicon compound having a plurality of silanol groups in the molecule as a main component, and the layer having a thickness of 0.5 to 30nm and containing a cured product of a hydrolyzable fluorine-containing compound as a main component, and the water/oil repellent member can stably and easily give a water/oil repellent coating excellent in abrasion resistance to various substrates, and further, the primer layer and the water/oil repellent layer can be applied by a room-temperature (25 ℃) process.

title_en: Pressure monitoring and adjusting device of screw oil press and screw oil press
abstract_en: A spiral oil press pressure monitoring and adjusting device and a spiral oil press are provided, wherein the spiral oil press comprises a pressing cage, a feeding module and a discharging module, the pressure monitoring and adjusting device comprises a processing module and a pressure monitoring module, the pressure monitoring module is arranged in the pressing cage and used for monitoring the pressure in the pressing cage, and the processing module controls the feeding amount of the feeding module and the discharging amount of the discharging module according to a pressure signal monitored by the pressure monitoring module; the screw oil press comprises the pressure monitoring and adjusting device of the screw oil press. The pressure monitoring and adjusting device of the screw oil press can automatically adjust the pressure in the barrel according to the pressure signal monitored by the pressure monitoring module, so that the pressure in the barrel is stable, the oil pressing efficiency and the oil outlet quality are improved, and the barrel explosion accident is prevented.

title_en: Oxobutylene (-2-olefine acid) compound, preparation method thereof, herbicide composition, application thereof and herbicide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of herbicides, and discloses an oxobutabut (-2-enoic acid) acid compound, a preparation method thereof, a herbicide composition, application thereof and a herbicide, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula (I). The oxo-butabut (-2-olefine acid) acid compound provided by the invention has higher herbicidal activity when being used for preventing and controlling weeds.

title_en: Anti-aging PVC composite floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-aging PVC composite floor, which comprises an upper layer, a middle layer and a lower layer, wherein the upper layer comprises a UV coating layer, the UV coating layer is a composite anti-aging acrylate coating, and the UV coating layer is composed of the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of 1, 6-ethylene glycol diacrylate, 30-50 parts of urethane acrylate, 6-10 parts of 2-isopropyl decyl acrylate, 1-3 parts of curing agent, 1-3 parts of light curing agent, 2-5 parts of anti-aging agent A, 1.5-3 parts of anti-aging agent B and 0.5-1 part of anti-aging agent C. The UV paint for the conventional PVC floor is improved, three kinds of anti-aging agents are added and used to act on different links, the anti-aging performance of the UV paint is greatly improved based on different anti-aging mechanisms, and the problem that the conventional PVC floor is insufficient in anti-aging performance is solved.

title_en: Pineapple flowering phase accurate regulation and control preparation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pineapple crossbreeding, and particularly discloses a pineapple flowering phase accurate regulation and control preparation which comprises a flowering phase advanced regulation and control agent, wherein the flowering phase advanced regulation and control agent is an aqueous solution, and the flowering phase advanced regulation and control agent comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3-8 parts of 6-benzyl aminopurine, 1-4 parts of gibberellin, 3.5-8 parts of monopotassium phosphate, 2-7 parts of brown algae oligosaccharide, 1-4 parts of catechin, 0.5-3 parts of calcium chloride, 3-8 parts of glucose, 30-50 parts of ethanol and 100-150 parts of water. The accurate regulation and control preparation for the pineapple flowering phase has the function of bidirectionally regulating and controlling the pineapple flowering phase, and can induce different varieties to bloom simultaneously by regulating and controlling the component proportion and the component concentration. The method is also beneficial to the formation and development of pollen, can ensure the fertility and the pollen quantity of the pollen after the regulation and control of the flowering phase, and is beneficial to improving the effect of cross breeding.

title_en: Rock asphalt-based demercuration adsorbent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock asphalt base demercuration adsorbent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out hydrothermal reaction treatment and drying on the rock asphalt to obtain hydrothermal rock asphalt; washing and drying the hydrothermal rock asphalt by using an organic solvent to obtain asphaltene, and processing the asphaltene into asphaltene particles; adding alkali into the asphaltene particles for carbonizationActivating to obtain a mixture containing the rock asphalt-based demercuration adsorbent; mixing the mixture with water to form a mixed solution, and adding acid into the mixed solution to make the mixed solution acidic to obtain an acidic mixed solution; and carrying out suction filtration on the acidic mixed solution by using water until the filtrate is neutral, filtering out residues, and drying to obtain the rock asphalt-based demercuration adsorbent. The invention develops an adsorbent to increase Hg in 0 The absorption of the mercury-removing agent realizes the high-efficiency removal of mercury in the flue gas of the coal-fired power plant, and ensures the standard emission of the mercury in the flue gas.

title_en: Repair liquid, surface treatment method of ultrathin glass, ultrathin glass and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a repair liquid, a surface treatment method of ultrathin glass, the ultrathin glass and a display device. The repair liquid consists of the following components: 2-15% by weight of hydrofluoric acid; 0.3 to 4% by weight of ammonium fluoride; 2-15 wt% of inorganic acid and the balance of water. The repair liquid and the treatment method for the surface of the ultrathin glass can effectively passivate or remove the surface defects of the ultrathin glass, so that the damage effect of stress on the surface of the glass is reduced, and the strength of the glass is improved.

title_en: Thermal laminating film for printed matter and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of printed matter laminating, and particularly discloses a thermal laminating film for printed matters and a preparation method thereof.
