The hot mounting film for the printed matter comprises a base layer and an adhesive layer, wherein the adhesive layer comprises the following components: mixed emulsion of polyvinyl acetate and vinyl acetate-ethylene copolymer, modified solution, emulsifier, water, defoamer, tackifier, wetting agent and filler; the modifying solution comprises N-methylol acrylamide, isopropyl silicate and ammonium sulfate. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing the mixed emulsion of polyvinyl acetate and vinyl acetate-ethylene copolymer with other formula components to obtain a bonding layer; and carrying out corona treatment on the surface of the substrate layer bonded with the adhesive layer, coating the prepared adhesive layer on the surface of the substrate layer subjected to corona treatment, and drying to obtain the hot laminating film for the printed matter. The hot laminating film for the printed matter can be used for laminating the printed matter and has the advantage of improving the line explosion phenomenon of the printed matter after laminating in the indentation process.

title_en: Red fluorescent powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to red fluorescent powder. The general chemical formula of the red fluorescent powder is Ba 3‑x Y 3.76 O 9 :0.04Bi 3+ ,0.2Eu 3+ ,xZn 2+ Wherein x is a mole fraction, and the value range of x is 0.001-3. The red fluorescent powder of the chemical formula prepared by the method has micron-sized particles to realize high-efficiency luminous efficiency, and the preparation method can realize industrial preparation.

title_en: Organic thin film, method for producing organic thin film, organic electroluminescent element, display device, lighting device, organic thin film solar cell, thin film transistor, photoelectric conversion element, coating composition, and material for organic electroluminescent element
abstract_en: The present invention provides an organic thin film which can obtain excellent electron injection property and electron transport property when used for an electron injection layer of an organic EL element; a coating composition which can be suitably used in the production of the organic thin film; and materials for organic EL elements which are raw materials for these organic thin films and coating compositions. The present invention relates to an organic thin film, which is characterized by being a single-layer film comprising a 1 st material which is a compound having a structure represented by general formula (1) below and a 2 nd material which transports electrons, or a laminated film comprising a film comprising the 1 st material and a film comprising the 2 nd material. title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for repelling mosquitoes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for repelling mosquitoes and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations. The traditional Chinese medicine composition for repelling mosquitoes comprises the following raw materials: perilla leaf, elsholtzia, mint, agastache rugosus, amomum cardamomum, lavender, dried orange peel, rosemary, fennel, lemongrass, clove, pepper and grassleaf sweelflag rhizome. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has good mosquito repelling effect, no side effect and low possibility of forming drug resistance. According to the preparation method, the raw materials are aged and crushed, so that volatile substances of the medicinal materials can volatilize conveniently, the volatile substances can repel or kill mosquitoes, the medicinal materials do not need to be in direct contact with the skin, the safety of the traditional Chinese medicine composition in use is improved, side effects are almost avoided, and meanwhile, the medicinal materials are natural components, so that the possibility of forming drug resistance is low.

title_en: Waterproof coating suitable for low-temperature high-humidity environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a waterproof coating suitable for a low-temperature high-humidity environment, which comprises a solid-phase component and a liquid-phase component, wherein the solid-phase component comprises the following components in parts by mass: 110-130 parts of cement powder, 10-15 parts of fine sand, 10-20 parts of calcium salt powder, 0.1-0.3 part of early strength agent and 0.01-0.03 part of water reducing agent. The liquid phase component comprises: 100 parts of emulsion with the mass concentration of 50-60%, 0.1-0.3 part of defoaming agent, 0.1-0.3 part of film forming agent and 10-30 parts of water. Wherein the emulsion is prepared by vinyl chloride participating in the emulsion polymerization reaction of EVA. The waterproof coating of the invention effectively improves the cracking resistance of the cement-based EVA waterproof coating in low-temperature and high-humidity environment, especially in the waterproof of the internal corner of a building in the low-temperature and high-humidity environment.

title_en: Method and system for preparing hydrogen-rich synthesis gas by chemical chain reforming of carbon-based solid fuel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of solid fuel thermal conversion and utilization, and particularly relates to a method and a system for preparing hydrogen-rich synthesis gas by reforming a carbon-based solid fuel chemical chain. The carbon-based solid fuel is subjected to pyrolysis reaction in the pyrolysis reactor to generate volatile matters and coke, the volatile matters comprise micromolecular pyrolysis gas and macromolecular tar, the volatile matters enter the reforming reactor, and the coke is fed into the regeneration reactor; the tar is catalytically cracked under the catalytic action of the oxygen carrier to generate micromolecular pyrolysis gas, and the micromolecular pyrolysis gas reacts with lattice oxygen in the oxygen carrier to generate hydrogen-rich synthesis gas; the coke introduced into the regeneration reactor and air are subjected to combustion reaction to release heat, and the reacted oxygen carrier is fed into the regeneration reactor to react with the air to supplement lattice oxygen; the oxygen carrier carries heat into the reforming reactor, provides lattice oxygen and heat, and exerts a catalytic effect. The separation of the pyrolysis reaction and the reforming process is realized, and the gasification efficiency and the quality of the product synthetic gas are improved.

title_en: Preparation of long weather-proof microcapsule type photochromic pigment and ink thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long weather-proof microcapsule type photochromic pigment and preparation of printing ink thereof, belonging to the technical field of photochromic materials. According to the long weather-proof microcapsule type photochromic pigment provided by the invention, the high weather-proof solvent is added in the core material formula of the traditional microcapsule type photochromic pigment preparation process, so that the weather resistance of a product is obviously improved, and meanwhile, the pigment is used for preparing the ink with long weather-proof effect, and the excellent weather resistance can meet the actual application requirements. The long weather-resistant microcapsule photochromic pigment and the ink thereof have simple preparation process, do not need to upgrade the existing process or equipment on a large scale, have wide application range and high product competitiveness, and have good application prospect.

title_en: Exterior wall paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coatings, and discloses an exterior wall finish and a preparation method thereof.A component A comprises deionized water, nano polyacrylate emulsion, an organic-inorganic compound material, a hydrophobic modified dispersant, a fluorocarbon surfactant, superfine barium sulfate and diamond dust; the component B comprises titanium dioxide filter cake, nano silicone-acrylate emulsion, polyethylene wax, activated carbon, wetting dispersant, film forming additive, antifreezing agent, defoaming agent, pH value stabilizer, thickening agent, antiseptic bactericide and the balance of deionized water. Respectively and uniformly mixing the raw materials of the component A and the component B; and uniformly mixing the component A mixture and the component B mixture to obtain the exterior wall finish. The exterior wall paint disclosed by the invention has the advantages of excellent anti-permeability, excellent stain-resistant effect and simple construction, can be applied to various building veneers, has good adhesive force, can be combined with various base materials, is firm and durable, and remarkably reduces the maintenance and cleaning cost of buildings.

title_en: Foaming agent for improving shield muck of coastal silt soil layer, preparation method and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foaming agent for improving shield muck of a coastal silt soil layer, which comprises a foaming agent base solution, a evergreen dispersing agent, powder abelmoschus manihot gum, flaxseed gum and water; the foaming agent base liquid and water are 4-12 parts by volume: 100, the volume part ratio of the liquid additive to water is 2-10: 100, the volume part ratio of the powder additive to water is 0.01-0.12: 100, the mass part ratio of powder abelmoschus manihot gum to flaxseed gum is 1: 1; the foaming agent base solution comprises liquid material alkyl cane glycoside and solid material fatty alcohol-polyoxyethylene ether sodium sulfate, and the volume part ratio is 2.5: 1. The invention also discloses a preparation method and a using method of the composition. The foaming multiplying power of the foaming agent is higher than 25 times, the half-life period is higher than 1500s, the half-life period is zero within 5min, the foam stability is high, the gas-liquid level strength is high, the foam density is high, the foaming agent can enter a soil body gap to improve the soil body flow plasticity, and the adhesion of silt cohesive soil is reduced.

title_en: Compositions and methods for tissue clearing
abstract_en: Investigation of delicate tissue structures, such as those in non-neural, non-bone tissues or organs, is best done in intact tissue. Described herein are compositions and methods for transparentizing tissue for subsequent three-dimensional analysis. The composition of the present invention as a tissue clearing composition is composed of four core components: (1) homogenizers, such as N-methylglucamine, urea, thiourea, guanidine, guanidinium chloride, lithium perchlorate, ethylenediamine and derivatives thereof; (2) water-soluble regulators, such as iohexol, sodium thiosulfate, polyethylene glycol and derivatives thereof; (3) fat-soluble regulators, such as 2,2' -thiodiethanol, propylene glycol and derivatives thereof; and (4) borate compounds such as boric acid, tetraboric acid, disodium tetraborate, and derivatives thereof. The disclosed tissue clearing compositions are particularly useful for non-neural, non-bone tissues or organs. These tissues or organs may be fresh, archived or recovered from paraffin-embedded tissues.

title_en: Microbial functional flora for improving flavonoid glycoside content in ginkgo leaf as well as preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial functional flora for improving the content of flavonoid glycoside in ginkgo leaf, and preparation and application thereof. The functional microbial flora provided by the invention comprises paenibacillus, bacillus amyloliquefaciens, bacillus subtilis, bacillus bailii and bacillus pumilus. The functional flora is applied to ginkgo seedlings, the content of quercetin, kaempferol and isorhamnetin in ginkgo leaves is increased by 82% -102%, 97% -101% and 36% -45%, the total flavonoid glycoside is increased by 41% -53%, and the efficacy is durable after application. The invention solves the problems of poor adaptability and difficult colonization of the compounded functional flora under natural conditions, and remarkably improves the flavonoid glycoside content in ginkgo leaves. The invention provides a certain theoretical basis and technical support for the large-scale production of ginkgo leaf flavone.

title_en: Anti-aging nano water-based ceramic coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-aging nano water-based ceramic coating which consists of a component A, a component B and a component C; the component A comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-30 parts of nano silica sol, 5-25 parts of nano alumina sol, 2-5 parts of organic silicon modified acrylic resin and 1-4 parts of anti-settling agent; the component B comprises: 10-15 parts of siloxane monomer; the component C comprises 1-3 parts of an auxiliary agent; the auxiliary agent consists of polyether glycol and propylene glycol, and the molar ratio of the polyether glycol: and the propylene glycol is 1: 2-3.5. The paint provided by the invention has strong adhesion to a base material, good flexibility, capability of forming a smooth coating and excellent ageing resistance.

title_en: Pre-sulfurization method of hydrogenation catalyst, obtained pre-sulfurization hydrogenation catalyst and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prevulcanization method of a hydrogenation catalyst, the obtained prevulcanization hydrogenation catalyst and application thereof, wherein the prevulcanization method comprises the following steps: step 1, dispersing a sulfur-containing compound in a solvent to form an impregnation liquid; step 2, dipping a hydrogenation catalyst into the dipping solution, standing and drying to obtain a presulfurization precursor; and 3, treating the vulcanization precursor in the presence of a reducing agent to obtain the pre-vulcanized hydrogenation catalyst. In step 1, the sulfur-containing compound is selected from at least one of polysulfide salt, thiosulfate salt, sulfite salt, carbon disulfide, dimethyl disulfide. In step 3, the reducing agent is selected from organic acids, preferably at least one of acetic acid, oxalic acid and formic acid. In the prior art, the conventional reducing gas for catalyst presulfurization treatment is hydrogen, but the invention adopts organic acid because the organic acid is milder than hydrogen, the hydrogenation activity is improved, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Catalyst for preparing aromatic hydrocarbon from methanol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for preparing aromatic hydrocarbon from methanol, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0.5-20 parts of zinc oxide and/or gallium oxide; 80-99.5 parts of a porous carrier; the porous carrier contains the following modified elements: based on the weight of the porous carrier, the weight content of phosphorus is 0.05-3.0%, the weight content of sodium is 0.01-0.50%, the weight content of chlorine is 0.01-0.35%, and the weight content of sulfur is 0.002-0.10%. The catalyst can solve the problems of poor stability and short service life of the catalyst in the prior art, and has the advantages of good stability and long service life when being used for preparing aromatic hydrocarbon from methanol.

title_en: Rare earth ion Tb3+Doped LiTaO3Multi-band emission pressure luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rare earth ion Tb 3+ Doped LiTaO 3 Multiband emission pressure luminescent material, preparation method and application thereof, and rare earth ion Tb 3+ Doped LiTaO 3 The chemical general formula of the multiband emission pressure luminescent material is Li 1‑x TaO 3 :xTb 3+ Wherein x is more than or equal to 0.005 and less than or equal to 0.03.

title_en: Temperature sensing material based on trivalent terbium and trivalent europium codoping, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature sensing material based on trivalent terbium and trivalent europium codoping, which is characterized in that the general chemical composition formula of the temperature sensing material is Ba 9 Y 1.94‑x Si 6 O 24 :0.06Tb 3+ ,xEu 3+ And x is the molar ratio coefficient of the doped europium ion, and the value range is as follows: x is more than or equal to 0.01 and less than or equal to 0.06; the temperature sensing material is prepared by a high-temperature solid phase method, has the characteristics of high sensitivity and high signal discrimination, and simultaneously has a wider temperature detection range.

title_en: Application of compound 3-methyl-butyric acid in controlling plant meloidogyne incognita
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of a compound 3-methyl-butyric acid in controlling plant meloidogyne incognita. The invention screens out small molecular compound 3-methyl-butyric acid which can effectively induce the meloidogyne incognita to generate evading reaction from volatile substances of biocontrol bacteria bacillus thuringiensis (Bacillus thuringiensis) Bt79 and Bt80 strain fermentation liquor. Compared with positive control aniline and n-octanol, the 3-methyl-butyric acid has better effect of avoiding the meloidogyne incognita. Concentration dependence experiments show that after 3-methyl-butyric acid is diluted in the ratio of 1:1000, 1:100 and 1:10, the compound has obvious concentration dependence on the evading effect of the meloidogyne incognita.

title_en: Carrier material and preparation method thereof, catalyst and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier material, a preparation method thereof, a catalyst and application, wherein the carrier material is hollow carbon-containing alumina, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a carrier mother ball; (2) preparing a carrier precursor; (3) preparing a carrier. Introducing active metal components into the prepared carrier material, and further drying and roasting to obtain the hydrogenation catalyst. The carrier material provided by the invention is carbon-containing alumina with a hollow structure, and the catalyst prepared by taking the carrier material as a carrier can greatly shorten the diffusion path of reactants in the catalytic material, improve the pore channel utilization rate of the catalytic material, reduce the use amount of active metal of the catalyst, improve the utilization rate of the active metal, and have proper actions between the carrier and the active metal, so that the obtained catalyst has high impurity removal activity, and is particularly suitable for the field of heavy oil and residual oil hydrogenation catalysis.

title_en: Plugging agent for drilling fluid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plugging agent for drilling fluid and a preparation method thereof. The plugging agent for the drilling fluid comprises the following components: 58-90 parts of high-elastic modified asphalt particles; 5-21 parts of a fiber material; 5-21 parts of graphite material; the high-elasticity modified asphalt particles have a core-shell structure, and rubber powder is used as a core, and modified asphalt is used as a shell. The plugging agent is suitable for oil-based drilling fluid, has good compatibility with the oil-based drilling fluid, high plugging speed and strong high-temperature resistance, and has wider adaptability to different sizes of holes or cracks of a leaking layer.

title_en: Pre-treatment desulfurization profile of bunker fuel oil using pre-treatment desulfurization agent
abstract_en: The present invention is characterized by comprising: the desulfurizer storage tank is used for storing the liquid-state pretreatment desulfurizer; and a constant delivery pump for feeding the desulfurizing agent from the desulfurizing agent storage tank into a fuel supply line of a marine engine for supplying marine fuel oil in a predetermined ratio; sulfur oxides are adsorbed and removed during combustion of the mixed fluid by supplying the bunker fuel oil to a marine engine in a state of being mixed with a pretreatment desulfurizing agent.

title_en: Method for ecological maintenance of high and steep slope rock mass by utilizing FP member and thick-layer base material spray-seeding combined process
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for ecological maintenance of a rock mass with a high and steep slope by utilizing an FP member and thick-layer base material spray-seeding combined process, which comprises the following steps: 1) And slope surface treatment: firstly, cleaning up floating soil, pumice, weeds and broken stones on the slope surface of a high and steep slope rock mass, and filling a pit hole with the diameter of more than 20cm with a plant growth bag; 2) And digging plant growing holes on the slope: punching plant growing holes on the slope surface of the high and steep slope rock mass, wherein the density of the plant growing holes is 3-5 per square meter; 3) Installing an FP component and hanging a net: installing an FP component and a fixing net on the slope surface; 4) And spraying and seeding the base material: spraying a bottom layer base material, a middle layer base material, an upper layer base material and a seed layer base material on the slope surface hung with the fixing net in sequence, wherein each layer is sprayed by 2-3cm; initial maintenance and later maintenance; the method adopts a mode of combining the FP member hanging net and the four layers of base materials to repair the rock mass with the high and steep slope, effectively improves the survival rate of vegetation and achieves the purpose of improving the ecological environment of the slope.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method of penoxsulam herbicide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation method of penoxsulam herbicide, relates to the technical field of penoxsulam herbicide, and aims to solve the problem that in the preparation process of the existing penoxsulam herbicide, workers cannot effectively monitor and control the one-by-one preparation process, so that the preparation reaction is incomplete. The upper end of preparation platform is provided with powder processing case, solution volume and gets platform, test-tube rack, pre-mixing tank, switch and supervisory control computer, one side of preparation platform is provided with the preparation container, the top of preparation container is provided with movable top cap, be provided with light and surveillance camera machine on the inner wall of activity top cap, be provided with on the front end position of preparation container and connect the workbin, the inside of powder processing case is provided with the screen cloth, the below of crossing the screen cloth is provided with the inside box, the solution volume is got the upper end of platform and is provided with the metering tank, sealed lid is installed at the top of pre-mixing tank.

title_en: Intelligent production process of plant essential oil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant essential oil extraction, and discloses an intelligent production process of plant essential oil, wherein in the step of S3, a weight sensing device is arranged in a reaction kettle, the enzymes added into the reaction kettle are cellulase and pectinase, 4L of distilled water is added into each 1Kg of raw material, and 40g of enzyme is added into each 1Kg of raw material, the ultrasonic crushing device is arranged to facilitate the acceleration of the dissolution of effective components of plants, in addition, ultrasonic secondary effects such as mechanical vibration, emulsification, diffusion, crushing, chemical effects and the like can also accelerate the diffusion and release of extracted components and fully mix with a solvent to facilitate the extraction, wherein the biggest advantages are short extraction time, lower temperature and high yield, the cell walls of plants can be damaged by adding the enzymes, and the extraction rate of the plant essential oil can be further improved, by adding the alum water, a certain impurity removal effect is facilitated.

title_en: Tail vegetable wastewater recycling microbial inoculum and application thereof in preparation of plant enzymes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group of waste water recycling microbial inoculum of waste water of Chinese cabbage, which comprises an aerobic microbial inoculum HQY-hyd-002 and an anaerobic microbial inoculum HQY-silage-002. The strain in the microbial agent disclosed by the invention is selected from strains which are not used for toxicological tests in general technical guidelines for biological safety of microbial fertilizers (NY 1109-2006) and strains which are issued by Ministry of health and informed by List of strains which can be used for food, does not contain heavy metals and toxic and harmful chemical substances, and solid products are non-toxic and non-irritant. The microbial inoculum has the advantages of no secondary pollution to the environment and no additional burden in practical application, belongs to an environment-friendly compatible microbial inoculum product, and is simple, convenient and efficient to store, transport and put in. The process is simple to operate, no external chemical is added, and the fermented soil improvement plant enzyme is rich in organic matters, organic acids and trace elements and can improve slight salinization and organic matter-deficient soil.

title_en: Compound, material for organic electroluminescent element, and electronic device
abstract_en: Provided are a compound which further improves the performance of an organic EL element, an organic electroluminescent element which further improves the element performance, an electronic device comprising such an organic electroluminescent element, a compound represented by the following formula (1), an organic electroluminescent element comprising such a compound, and an electronic device comprising such an organic electroluminescent element. title_en: Dicarbazole compound, intermediate, organic electroluminescent device and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to and provides a dicarbazole compound, an intermediate, an organic electroluminescent device and a display device. The dicarbazole compound has a structure shown in a formula (I), wherein Ar has a benzimidazole structure shown in a formula (II). According to the invention, through the design of the structural formula of the dicarbazole compound, the dicarbazole compound with a specific structure is used as an electron transport material or a red light main body material, and the prepared organic electroluminescent device has lower driving voltage, higher current efficiency and longer service life.

title_en: Liquid composition set, porous resin production apparatus, and porous resin production method
abstract_en: A set of liquid compositions is provided. The liquid composition set comprises: a liquid composition X comprising a polymerizable compound X and a solvent X; and a liquid composition Y comprising a solvent Y. The liquid composition X will form a porous resin and will have a lower surface tension than the liquid composition Y.

title_en: Resin composition, adhesive member, and display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a resin composition, an adhesive member, and a display device. The resin composition includes: at least one of a monofunctional (meth) acrylate having an imide ring structure and a monomer having a 2-pyrrolidone backbone and a free radical curable group, present in an amount of about 0.1 to about 5 weight percent based on the total weight of the resin composition, wherein the resin composition has a viscosity of about 5 to less than about 50 millipascal seconds at 25 ℃, and wherein the glass transition temperature of the resin composition after curing satisfies a value of about-50 to less than about 0 ℃.

title_en: Preparation method of chlorine dioxide disinfection and odor removal granules
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of granules for disinfecting and removing peculiar smell by chlorine dioxide, which comprises the following steps in sequence: s1: uniformly mixing methyl cellulose, polyethylene glycol wax, sodium chlorite and water to obtain a suspension A; s2: uniformly mixing activated alumina, zeolite, montmorillonite, chloride and water to obtain a mixture B; s3: uniformly mixing the suspension A and the mixture B to obtain a first agent; s4: mixing the super absorbent resin, the chitin, the activating agent and water uniformly, adding the adhesive, and stirring uniformly to obtain an agent B; s5: mixing the agent A and the agent B, drying and granulating to obtain the chlorine oxide granules for disinfecting and removing peculiar smell. The chlorine dioxide disinfection and odor removal particles prepared by the invention have good moisture retention and pressure retention capabilities, are not easy to change the release rate of chlorine dioxide due to the influence of external humidity and pressure, and can play a role in decomposing and inhibiting acrylamide generated by SAP decomposition by adding chitin.

title_en: Zero-dimensional blue luminescent perovskite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-dimensional blue luminescent perovskite material, which comprises the following components: inorganic metal ion a  + , trivalent metal ion In  3+ , and halogen ion B  ‑ . The chemical formula of the catalyst is A  3 InB 6 . The invention also discloses a preparation method of the zero-dimensional blue luminescent perovskite material, which comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing precursor powder in an argon environment, and sealing the precursor powder into a quartz tube by using an adapter. And2, connecting the quartz tube on the double-row tube, introducing argon into the double-row tube, ventilating for a plurality of times, and vacuumizing the quartz tube after cleaning. And 3, sealing the quartz tube for the second time. And 4, placing the quartz tube in a light-proof crucible, placing the crucible in a muffle furnace for calcination, and growing by a heating-constant temperature-cooling method to obtain the zero-dimensional blue luminescent perovskite material. The invention obtains several zero-dimensional indium-based perovskite materials with blue photoluminescence property by regulating and controlling A-site ions. This has profound significance for commercialization of perovskite fluorescent materials.

title_en: Biomass charcoal-based bacterial fertilizer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomass charcoal-based bacterial fertilizers, and particularly relates to a biomass charcoal-based bacterial fertilizer and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention is based on biomass charcoal, and constructs a carrier suitable for the propagation of soil biocontrol bacteria. The method takes ginseng cultivation biocontrol probiotics-Bacillus vallismortis as a probe to construct a proper carbon-based microorganism composite system (namely biomass carbon-based bacterial fertilizer), thereby achieving the purposes of increasing the number of viable biocontrol bacteria, prolonging the field control time and enhancing the control effect.

title_en: Processing equipment of vegetable oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vegetable oil processing, and particularly discloses vegetable oil processing equipment, which comprises a rotary storage mechanism, a squeezing mechanism and a discharging mechanism which are arranged on an installation frame, wherein a containing cavity for storing raw materials is arranged in the rotary storage mechanism, the squeezing mechanism comprises a cylinder I and a squeezing block, the squeezing block comprises a cylindrical squeezing shell which is fixedly arranged on a telescopic end of the cylinder I and is provided with a downward opening, a movable block which is in sliding connection and matching is sleeved in the squeezing shell, an installation groove is formed in the upper end surface of the movable block, an elastic connecting rod which is vertically arranged is arranged in the installation groove, the squeezing shell and the movable block form a cavity, a suspended impact block is arranged in the cavity, a spring for connecting the impact block and the top of the squeezing shell is arranged between the impact block and the top of the squeezing shell, the downward movement acceleration of the movable block is controlled by controlling the air inlet speed of the cylinder I, and the extrusion force is controlled by controlling the downward movement acceleration of the movable block, the extrusion force can be adjusted in a stepless manner conveniently.

title_en: Chlorella biofertilizer capable of promoting growth and improving disease resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chlorella biofertilizer for promoting growth and improving disease resistance. Belongs to the technical field of biological fertilizers. The biological fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by volume: 1000 parts of chlorella extract and 1-3 parts of intelligent agent. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: (1) the chlorella extract and the intelligent intelligence in the chlorella biofertilizer provided by the invention have a synergistic effect, so that the effects of promoting plant growth and improving plant disease resistance are obviously higher than those of using a single component, the root activity is effectively promoted, the photosynthesis of leaves is obviously improved, the yield of crops is obviously improved, the metabolic efficiency of plants is improved, and the resistance to diseases is increased; (2) the chlorella biofertilizer disclosed by the invention is few in components, simple and feasible in preparation process, low in production cost, easy to control in production process, beneficial to large-scale industrial production and field application and easy to popularize and apply, and can effectively extract and retain bioactive substances in chlorella.

title_en: Synthetic method of diarylene COFs material and application of diarylene COFs material in light-operated adsorption
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of light-operated stimulus response functional materials, and particularly relates to a synthesis method of diarylene COFs materials and application of the diarylene COFs materials in light-operated adsorption. The invention firstly prepares the covalent organic framework material by Schiff base reaction based on structural units containing alkynyl diaryl alkene and pyrene, and confirms the photochromic property and the light-operated adsorbability to nitrogen and alkyne through follow-up experimental investigation, thereby filling the blank of the photochromic diaryl alkene covalent organic framework material constructed by the rigid plane pyrene structural units and diaryl alkene structural units.

title_en: Cold chain transportation visual photonic crystal time-temperature joint monitoring tag, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of indication monitoring materials, and particularly relates to a cold chain transportation visual photonic crystal time-temperature joint monitoring tag, a preparation method and application. According to the cold chain transportation visual photon crystal time-temperature joint monitoring tag, high refractive index particles with uniform particle size are taken as a construction unit, and polymers formed by copolymerization of different monomers are taken as a matrix; the label can record the temperature and the related time change history by utilizing the color change, so as to obtain the heat intensity information of temperature and time accumulation. The monitoring tag has the advantages that no phase change or temperature change material is needed to be added, and the risk of leakage of small molecules does not exist; the device has smaller volume, can be applied to a cold chain system with strict requirements on temperature and time, and can realize the close-fitting temperature history monitoring of each transported product.

title_en: Coal gasification catalyst, loading method thereof and application of coal gasification catalyst in microwave gasification of low-rank coal
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal gasification catalyst, a loading method thereof and application thereof in microwave gasification of low-rank coal, belonging to the technical field of coal cleaning. In the coal gasification catalyst provided by the invention, K can obviously improve the gasification rate and improve the gasification product; fe has the advantages of good catalytic effect, adjustable product gas and the like, and can form more obvious dielectric effect in a magnetic field in the microwave heating process, thereby achieving the purposes of energy conservation and rapid temperature rise; in addition, Ca also has certain catalytic activity, although the catalytic activity of Ca is weaker than that of alkali metal, the source of Ca is wide and the cost is low, and Ca can be preferentially combined with partial mineral substances in coal, so that the proportion of the mineral substances in the coal combined with K is reduced, the catalytic activity of K can be promoted, a synergistic effect is formed, and the catalysis of the K source on gasification is further promoted. The catalyst is used for low-rank coal microwave gasification, and has the advantages of high catalytic activity, high catalytic speed and capability of better improving gasification products.

title_en: Antibacterial agent, preparation method thereof and antibacterial composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial agent, a preparation method thereof and an antibacterial composition, which comprise chitosan and PrF  3  Adding the mixture into acetic acid solution, and reacting for 20-24 hours at normal temperature to obtain mixed solution; mixing the mixed solution, copper nitrate, glucose solution, deionized water and potassium hydroxide, reacting at 70-90 ℃ for 16-20h, filtering, washing and drying to obtain Cu/chitosan/PrF  3  An antibacterial agent. The antibacterial agent can promote the antibacterial performance of thermoplastic plastics on one hand, and can expand the types of antibacterial agents on the other hand, thereby meeting the requirement of high antibacterial environment.

title_en: Substitution process for recycling CO2 through full-temperature-range pressure swing adsorption for amine absorption decarburization in natural gas SMB hydrogen production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-temperature-range pressure swing adsorption CO recovery method for amine absorption decarburization in natural gas SMB hydrogen production 2 Instead of the process, the full-temperature-range pressure swing adsorption FTrPSA is adopted to recover CO 2 Method for absorbing and decarbonizing organic amine solvent or amine solution and recovering CO in hydrogen production process of natural gas steam reforming SMB 2 The process is based on PSA, and utilizes SMB converted gas as raw material gas and most of H 2 Small amount of CO and CH 4 Is mainly non-adsorption phase gas component and main adsorbate CO 2 The impurity components have the adsorption separation coefficient and the difference of physicochemical properties within the temperature range of 60-160 ℃ and the pressure range of normal pressure-2.4 MPa, and the conversion gas has high yield, high purity, low energy consumption and low costSeparation and purification of the desired CO 2 And make the non-adsorption phase gas generated in the medium temperature pressure swing adsorption system-CO in the hydrogen-rich gas 2 The content is less than 1 percent without influencing PSA purification H in SMB hydrogen production process 2 The efficiency and the load of the working procedure realize the minimization of carbon emission in the hydrogen production process of natural gas SMB.

title_en: Preparation method of self-healing coating taking overdue drug cefalexin as corrosion inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention designs a preparation method of a self-repairing coating taking overdue medicine cefalexin as a corrosion inhibitor, belonging to the field of metal anticorrosive coatings. The method is characterized in that mesoporous nano-silica microspheres filled with the cefalexin corrosion inhibitor are dispersed into an epoxy resin coating, when the coating generates microcracks, cefalexin is released from a mesoporous silica nano container, is protonated under an acidic condition and is adsorbed on the surface of a steel plate to form a compact adsorption layer, and the corrosion reaction is prevented; the invention takes overdue drug cefalexin as corrosion inhibition, not only solves the problem of high cost of the conventional corrosion inhibitor, but also realizes the recycling of the overdue drug, and has certain environmental protection significance.

title_en: Polyacrylamide profile control, flooding control weak gel composite blocking remover for low-permeability oilfield water injection well and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyacrylamide profile control, flooding control weak gel composite blocking remover for a low-permeability oilfield water injection well, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite blocking remover comprises the following raw materials: 3.0 to 8.0 percent of dioctyl sodium sulfosuccinate, 1.0 to 3.0 percent of octylphenol and ethylene oxide condensate OP-50, 20.0 to 25.0 percent of methanesulfonic acid, 14.0 to 18.0 percent of bis 1, 6-hexamethylene triamine pentamethylene phosphonic acid BHMTPMPA, 15.0 to 18.0 percent of n-butyl alcohol and the balance of water. The composite blocking remover performs a complexing reaction on a component with complexing performance and organic chromium or organic aluminum, so that weak gel loses the crosslinking performance, the solubility of the polyacrylamide weak gel in water is improved, inorganic scales such as near-well calcium carbonate scale and ferric hydroxide are removed, the permeability of a near-well zone is improved, and the aims of reducing the injection pressure of a water injection well and improving the water injection efficiency are finally achieved.

title_en: Application of insecticidal composition containing fluorine chloantraniliprole in preventing and treating lepidoptera and hemiptera pests of crops
abstract_en: The invention provides a use of a fluorine-containing chlorantraniliprole-containing insecticidal composition for preventing and controlling lepidoptera and hemiptera pests of crops, wherein the insecticidal composition comprises an active ingredient A and an active ingredient B, the active ingredient A is the chlorantraniliprole, and the active ingredient B is chlorfenapyr; the mass ratio of the active component A to the active component B is 20: 1-1: 30. The insecticidal composition can control various crop pests, and has the advantages of good control effect, low dosage, obvious synergistic effect, drug resistance delay and the like.

title_en: Antimony pentachloride fluorescent compound, crystal, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluorescent materials, and particularly relates to an antimony pentachloride fluorescent compound, an antimony pentachloride fluorescent crystal, and a preparation method and application thereof. The compound has the luminescence wavelength of 595-710 nm, is yellow to orange under the irradiation of ultraviolet rays, has stable luminescence and good moisture stability, and can keep bright luminescence after being basically placed in the air for 3 months; and the preparation method of the compound is very simple, can avoid the adoption of solvents with strong taste and toxicity, is green and environment-friendly, and is very suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: SiOC hydrogen-resistant film and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an SiOC hydrogen-resistant film and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the SiOC hydrogen-resistant film is obtained by catalyzing polymethylhydrosiloxane and tetramethyltetravinylcyclotetrasiloxane raw materials to carry out low-temperature crosslinking curing reaction by taking a complex of noble metal Pt as a catalyst. The SiOC hydrogen-blocking film provided by the invention is an oxide film with high hydrogen-blocking efficiency in a uniform amorphous state, and a large number of silicon methyl groups exist in the film, so that hydrogen atoms can be effectively repelled, and further, hydrogen can be blocked on the surface of the film, so that the hydrogen can not diffuse in the film, and an effective barrier for blocking the hydrogen diffusion is formed. When the SiOC hydrogen-resistant film provided by the invention is applied to steel hydrogen embrittlement protection, the SiOC hydrogen-resistant film is tightly combined with steel, is not easy to fall off, and has high hydrogen-resistant efficiency.

title_en: Environment-friendly high-temperature-resistant high-salt-resistant lubricant for water-based drilling fluid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly high-temperature-resistant high-salt-resistant lubricant for water-based drilling fluid, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: heating polyalcohol to a first reaction temperature, adding boric acid, and carrying out heat preservation reaction under the protection of nitrogen to obtain an intermediate product; directly adding long-chain fatty acid and a catalyst into the obtained intermediate product, and heating to a second reaction temperature for reaction; and after the reaction is finished, cooling to obtain the environment-friendly high-temperature-resistant high-salt-resistant lubricant. The lubricant prepared by the invention can effectively reduce the lubricating coefficient of the drilling fluid under the conditions of high temperature and high salt, has good environmental protection and biodegradability, can be applied to drilling of wells with complex structures in deep stratums, and solves the problems of large friction resistance and serious pressure supporting in the process of drilling deep horizontal wells, highly-deviated wells and the like by using the conventional water-based drilling fluid.

title_en: Method and system for producing gasoline blend oil by using carbon five raffinate oil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petrochemical industry, in particular to a method and a system for producing gasoline blend oil by using carbon five raffinate oil. The method comprises the following steps: mixing carbon five raffinate oil, hydrogen and part of catalytic gasoline, carrying out pre-hydrogenation treatment on the obtained mixed material to convert dialkene in the mixed material into mono-olefin, then mixing the pre-hydrogenated material with the rest of catalytic gasoline, and carrying out S Zorb desulfurization. According to the invention, a set of pre-hydrogenation treatment system is added in front of an S Zorb device, after alkadiene in the ethylene-carbon-five raffinate oil is converted into mono-olefin, the mono-olefin and the catalytic gasoline enter the S Zorb device together for adsorption desulfurization, high-grade clean gasoline blend oil is produced, and the processing route of the carbon-five olefin component is widened. The project implementation investment is small, the construction period is short, the operation cost is low, and the demonstration and popularization effects are good.

title_en: Bactericidal composition containing agricultural antibiotic and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural sterilization, and discloses a sterilization composition containing agricultural antibiotics, which comprises an active ingredient A and an active ingredient B, wherein the active ingredient A is flurindoxacarb, the active ingredient B is an agricultural antibiotic bactericide, the agricultural antibiotic bactericide is either polyoxin or validamycin A, and the mass ratio of the active ingredient A to the active ingredient B is 1: 30-15: 1. The bactericidal composition can control various plant pathogenic fungi, has remarkable control effect on ascomycotina and deuteromycotina particularly, reduces the dosage and reduces the agricultural production cost.

title_en: Preparation equipment of antibacterial, mildewproof and waterproof coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building coatings, and particularly relates to an antibacterial mildew-proof waterproof coating and a preparation process thereof, wherein S1: putting deionized water, elastic emulsion and waterborne polyurethane into a box body through a liquid inlet pipe, starting a motor, driving a first rotating shaft to rotate by the motor, driving a stirring rod to rotate, and stirring for 10-15min; s2: then, titanium dioxide, modified styrene-acrylic latex powder, VAE rubber powder and modified diatomite enter the box body through a powder inlet pipe, when the motor drives the first rotating shaft, the second rotating shaft drives the blanking plate to rotate and evenly blanking, and the stirring time is 30-40min; the waterproof coating solves the problems that when the waterproof coating is exposed in a humid environment for a long time, various microorganisms such as mould fungi are easily bred on the surface of the waterproof coating, the mould fungi can enter pores of cement, film forming substances are damaged, the waterproof performance of the waterproof coating is reduced, and even the impermeable waterproof performance is lost.

title_en: Marsh gas purification device with flexibly replaced filler in situ
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biogas purification device with flexibly replaced fillers in situ, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the air inlet valve and the air outlet valve are arranged at two opposite corners of the box body, the box body is partitioned into a plurality of layers of transverse air passages from top to bottom through air passage partition plates in the box body, adjacent air passages are communicated end to end, the head end of the air passage at the uppermost layer is connected to the air inlet valve through a first necking joint section, and the tail end of the air passage at the lowermost layer is connected to the air outlet valve through a second necking joint section; the box still is equipped with the fixed slide rail of a plurality of units, the fixed slide rail of unit is located the box inside front and back, and the horizontal air flue of perpendicular to is arranged, secondary reaction unit with the fixed slide rail sliding connection of unit has plant ash-porous carbon coupling filler in the secondary reaction unit. The advantages are that: the sliding connection of the secondary reaction unit realizes the filling design of the drawer type reaction unit, and the high-efficiency reaction of the device and the recycling of the filler are ensured through the layout of a plurality of layers of air passages; the plant ash-porous carbon coupling filler realizes the resource utilization of waste.

title_en: Bi-component epoxy crack sealer capable of being used for wet construction and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bi-component epoxy crack sealer capable of being constructed in a wet manner and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the epoxy crack sealer capable of being constructed in the wet manner comprise a component A and a component B, and the component A comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 82-90 parts of epoxy resin; 3-8 parts of benzyl alcohol; 6-10 parts of fumed silica; 0.1-0.3 part of water repellent agent; 0.1-0.3 part of defoaming agent; the component B comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 25-35 parts of alicyclic amine; 5-10 parts of polyether amine; 30-40 parts of benzyl alcohol; 20-25 parts of epoxy resin; 5-8 parts of fumed silica; 8-15 parts of pigment; 1-3 parts of a thixotropic agent; 0.1-0.3 part of coupling agent; 0.1-0.3 part of defoaming agent; 0.1 to 0.3 portion of water repellent agent. The crack sealer has stable performance under a humid air environment in spring and after construction in rainy days, and avoids the problems of non-drying, color change, falling off and the like caused by the humid construction of the crack sealer or delayed delivery time caused by the fact that construction cannot be carried out in humid weather and the like.

title_en: Special hydrolysis equipment and process for organic matter treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a special hydrolysis device and a special hydrolysis process for organic matter treatment, relates to the technical field of organic matter hydrolysis devices, and can be used as an important matched device in an organic matter recycling treatment process. The equipment mainly comprises a box body, an upper cover, a heat-preservation interlayer, a feeding hole, a feeding electromagnetic valve, a fixing frame, a tubular hydrolysis reactor, a discharging electromagnetic valve, a discharging hole, an electric heating rod, a circulating water pump, an automatic exhaust valve, a temperature sensor, a constant-temperature circulating water pipe, a pressure detection tank and an electric control system. The invention pumps the activated organic biomass slurry into the tubular hydrolysis reactor through the feed inlet, and the hydrolysis reaction is carried out under the set pressure and the catalyst environment. The biological organic matters such as starch, cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin, protein, grease and the like are hydrolyzed into nutrient substances which are dissolved in water and can be directly absorbed by passive plants, so that the harmless treatment of organic waste resources such as human, livestock and poultry excrement, crop straws, agricultural product processing leftovers, kitchen waste and the like is realized, the waste is recycled, and the purposes of green agriculture and ecological agriculture are achieved.

title_en: Integrated control device for smashing and composting based on straw agricultural wastes
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides smash compost integrated control device based on straw class agricultural waste, relates to agricultural waste treatment technical field. Should smash compost integrated control device based on straw class agricultural waste includes: a composting chamber, a crushing and feeding mechanism and a sealing mechanism. The crushing and feeding mechanism comprises a feeding pipe, a crushing piece and a first motor, the bottom end of the feeding pipe is communicated with the top end of the composting chamber, the crushing piece is rotatably installed inside the feeding pipe, and an output shaft of the first motor is in transmission connection with the crushing piece; the closure mechanism includes a first closure member and a second closure member. This application is through extensible member and two connecting rod cooperations, can make first closed member and two second closed members seal the inlet pipe in proper order, and the open time of inlet pipe when reducing the feeding can reduce scattering and disappearing of indoor steam of compost when carrying out the feeding through the inlet pipe, reduces thermal loss.

title_en: High-heat-absorption high-conductivity billet anti-oxidation coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-heat-absorption high-conductivity billet anti-oxidation coating which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of glass powder, 10-20 parts of ammonium paratungstate powder, 40-65 parts of copper oxide powder and 5-10 parts of soda ash, and finally, 20-40 parts of the total solid powder by weight of auxiliary material water is added. The high-heat-absorption high-conductivity anti-oxidation coating for the steel billet prepared by the invention can effectively isolate air, reduce the burning loss rate of the steel billet, increase the conduction of radiant heat and conductive heat of the steel billet, improve the heating rate of the steel billet, quickly separate the coating from the steel billet at low temperature, and ensure that the surface of a prepared finished product is smooth and attractive.

title_en: High-performance super-dispersion resin liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resin liquid, and discloses high-performance super-dispersion resin liquid and a preparation method thereof. The aqueous color paste developed by the ultra-dispersed resin liquid has excellent fluidity and high gloss, is an ideal material for preparing high-solid low-viscosity color paste, and has the advantages of no layering, no precipitation, no thickening and high storage stability based on the strong anchoring capability and the super steric hindrance of the ultra-dispersed resin liquid to pigments, and solves the problems of the aqueous coating color paste in the prior art that a dispersing agent is generally expensive and has large dosage, so the cost is high; the water-based ink paste has poor glossiness, thicker fineness, poor fluidity and unsatisfactory printing adaptability and storage stability.

title_en: Water-based inorganic anti-mildew ceramic finishing coat and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-based inorganic anti-mildew ceramic finish paint, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of functional coatings, wherein the ceramic finish paint comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of a bactericide, 0.1-0.5 part of a herbicide, 30-60 parts of an inorganic resin, 20-40 parts of a filler, 10-30 parts of silica sol and 0.1-0.8 part of an auxiliary agent; wherein the bactericide comprises ferriporphyrin, and the herbicide comprises at least one of zineb, sodium chlorate and parachlorophenol. The invention solves the technical problems of finish paint delustering, chalking and mold growing caused by metabolism of microorganisms on the surface of a moist organic coating and self aging of the organic coating in the service process of the organic coating in a moist atmosphere corrosion environment, and achieves the technical effect of obviously inhibiting bacteria, microorganisms and plants from growing on the surface of the coating.

title_en: Flame-retardant silane modified polyether composition and sealant
abstract_en: The application relates to a flame-retardant silane modified polyether composition and a sealant. The composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-150 parts of silane modified polyether; 1-10 parts of epoxy resin; 80-230 parts of a flame retardant; 2-7 parts of a coupling agent; 0.2-2 parts of catalyst. According to the invention, the epoxy resin and the silicon modified polyether polymer are uniformly dispersed, and the coupling agent capable of simultaneously reacting with the epoxy group and the alkoxy group is added, and the epoxy polymeric group with higher crosslinking density is introduced on the polyether polymer crosslinking reaction chain segment, so that the performance attenuation degree of the intumescent environment-friendly flame retardant filler in the heat aging process of the sealant can be reduced, and the aging resistance of the flame retardant sealing adhesive is improved.

title_en: Anti-fingerprint glass organic silicon pressure-sensitive adhesive and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of organic silicon pressure-sensitive adhesives, and provides an anti-fingerprint glass organic silicon pressure-sensitive adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof. The stripping force of the pressure-sensitive adhesive, the anti-fingerprint glass and the steel plate is adjusted by adjusting the content of the vinyl MQ silicon resin, the molecular weight of the raw rubber, the vinyl content, the proportion of different vinyl raw rubbers, the mass ratio of the hydroxyl MQ resin to the vinyl MQ resin, the weight ratio of the resin to the raw rubber, and the type and the adding amount of the hydrogen-containing silicone oil. By adjusting the type and the dosage of the anchoring agent, the adhesiveness of the pressure-sensitive adhesive and the base material is improved, and the pressure-sensitive adhesive is resistant to boiling for 2 hours and does not come unstuck.

title_en: Lipid-droplet fluorescent probe containing carbazole-pyridine formylhydrazine group and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lipid-droplet fluorescent probe containing carbazole-pyridine formylhydrazine group, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structural formula of the lipid-droplet fluorescent probe is as follows: the fluorescent probe has multifunction, and Cu can be realized by a colorimetry and a fluorescence spectrometry  2+  The ion identification and quantitative detection have good anti-interference performance, high selectivity and sensitivity under the condition that other ions exist; meanwhile, the probe can be used for imaging in cells, has good targeting property on lipid droplets, is expected to play a role in industrial production and clinical medicine, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: chrysene derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Derivatives and uses thereof, the invention The derivative has The novel compound which is combined with the heteroatom O, S or N to form a large plane conjugated structure has small molecular steric hindrance and small influence on film formation, so that the novel compound is excellent in molecular film formation and charge transmission performance, and the efficiency and the service life of an organic electroluminescent device containing the novel compound are improved.

title_en: Novel indium-based efficient heat-conducting gasket
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel indium-based efficient heat-conducting gasket, which is characterized in that indium metal and indium-bismuth-tin alloy are used as materials of the heat-conducting gasket, the indium metal and the indium-bismuth-tin alloy are rolled into square metal sheets, the square metal sheets are manufactured into a dam-shaped heat-conducting gasket with indium-bismuth-tin alloy on the upper surface and the lower surface through cutting, superposition and pressurization, and the heat-conducting gasket is reduced in contact thermal resistance and meets the requirement of high-power heat dissipation by reducing gaps among the heat-conducting gasket, a chip and a radiator.

title_en: Chemical sensitization foaming agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chemical sensitization foaming agent and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of industrial explosives. Including A component, B component and C component, A component includes sensitizer, foam stabilizer, thickener, water, bubble micturition agent, B component includes the chloride or the sulfate of calcium, magnesium, zinc, foam stabilizer, thickener, water, antifreeze, bubble micturition agent, C component includes ammonium salt, thiocyanate, foam stabilizer, thickener, water, antifreeze and bubble micturition agent. The invention does not need acid catalysis, does not need to add acid substances into the water phase, thoroughly avoids the damage of the acid substances to the latex oil film and the corrosion of equipment, is favorable for the stability of the storage performance of the explosive, prolongs the service life of the equipment, and combines calcium, magnesium and zinc metal ions with SCN  ‑  Can greatly promote NH under non-acidic conditions  4   +  With NO  2   ‑  The reaction speed of the emulsion explosive is high, the sensitization is completed instantly, and the emulsion explosive is suitable for a chemical sensitization process of various emulsion explosives, in particularIs suitable for medium and low temperature chemical sensitization in alpine regions.

title_en: Preparation method and application of thiafluorenyl aggregation-induced emission compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a thiofluorene-based aggregation-induced emission compound, and relates to the field of organic synthesis. The thiofluorene-based aggregation-induced emission compound provided by the invention has a structure shown in formula 1, and the compound is simple in synthesis method and simple and convenient in separation and purification operation process. The product molecule of the invention has aggregation-induced emission property, enriches the varieties of aggregation-induced emission compounds, and has wide application prospect in the field of organic functional materials.

title_en: ENF-grade artificial board adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ENF-grade artificial board adhesive which is prepared by mixing ultralow-molar-ratio melamine-urea-formaldehyde copolycondensation resin, polymethylol melamine-urea-glyoxal copolycondensation resin and a multi-branched polyamide compound according to the absolute dry weight ratio of 100: 5-15: 0.5-5.0; in the ultralow-molar-ratio melamine-urea-formaldehyde copolycondensation resin, the molar ratio of urea to formaldehyde to melamine is 1: 0.65-0.99: 0.01 to 0.3; in the poly (hydroxymethyl) melamine-urea-glyoxal copolycondensation resin, the molar ratio of urea to glyoxal to melamine is 1: 1.0-2.0: 0.01 to 0.3; the multi-branched polyamide compound has at least four or more degrees of branching and has an amide at the molecular end. Also provides a preparation method of the ENF-grade artificial board adhesive. The adhesive can remarkably improve the crosslinking degree of resin, improve the curing speed, and improve the performance of the artificial board while the formaldehyde emission of the artificial board reaches ENF level.

title_en: Antirust gear oil for wind power yaw variable pitch system, production device and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lubricating oil production, in particular to antirust gear oil for a wind power yaw variable pitch system, which comprises the following components in parts by mass: base oil: 80-95 parts of poly-alpha olefin base oil and 5-15 parts of synthetic ester base oil; compound additive: 1.5-5 parts of the following substances: sodium alkyl sulfonate, boronized polyisobutylene succinimide, sulfurized isobutylene, alkyl diphenylamine and methyl silicone oil; antirust agent: 0.2-5 parts of any one or more of imidazoline derivatives, succinic acid half-ester derivatives and amines; metal deactivators: 0.2-2 parts of benzotriazole and derivatives thereof, and in the production process of a lubricating oil pipeline, the production device can carry out emergency on oil transportation in the pipeline when the pipeline cable is damaged, so as to prevent the condition that the production condition of the lubricating oil cannot be monitored due to the damage of the cable in the pipeline.

title_en: Conductive adhesive with low silver solid content and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A low silver solid content conductive adhesive is applied to passive components, integrated circuits or chip packages, and comprises: acrylic resin and dendritic silver powder. Wherein the acrylic resin comprises an acrylic monomer and a curing agent. The dendritic silver powder is ground and rolled for multiple times and uniformly mixed in the acrylic resin, and the dendritic silver powder accounts for more than 0wt% and less than 40wt% of the low-silver solid-content conductive adhesive. The invention further comprises a manufacturing method of the conductive adhesive with low silver solid content.

title_en: Preparation method of ratio-type fluorescent gold-copper nanocluster, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ratio-type fluorescent gold-copper nanocluster, a product and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of metal nanoclusters. The preparation method takes a compound formed by combining polyvinylpyrrolidone and 2-mercaptobenzothiazole as a ligand and ascorbic acid as an aggregation inducer to prepare the ratio type fluorescent gold copper nanocluster, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing polyvinylpyrrolidone, 2-mercaptobenzothiazole, tetrachloro-gold acid and copper chloride, adding ascorbic acid, performing light-proof reaction, and purifying to obtain the ratio type fluorescent gold-copper nanocluster. The preparation method is simple to operate, and the reaction conditions are mild and rapid; the prepared nanocluster can be applied to the preparation of the rationed fluorescence detection sulfur ions and visual detection test paper.

title_en: Modified polyurethane material for bridge expansion joints and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road and bridge materials, in particular to a modified polyurethane material for a bridge expansion joint and a preparation method thereof, wherein the modified polyurethane material for the bridge expansion joint is formed by mixing a component A and a component B according to the weight ratio of 100:100-150; the component A comprises the following components in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of polyether polyol, 40-60 parts of amine curing agent, 1-5 parts of water absorbent, 1-3 parts of carbon black, 0.5-1 part of defoamer and 0.5-1 part of silane coupling agent; the component B comprises the following components: 70-90 parts of polyurethane prepolymer, 10-20 parts of phase change material and 5-15 parts of plasticizer, and the modified polyurethane material for the bridge expansion joint has higher thixotropy in one-stage epoxy curing reaction, effectively resists flowing and improves paving surface flatness; the polyurethane in two stages has the advantages of deblocking and curing reaction, stable reaction rate, high strength and good flexibility of a cured product, controllable viscosity and thixotropy of a resin system in the whole curing process, and excellent construction and workability.

title_en: Adhesive label and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adhesive label and a preparation method thereof, wherein the self-adhesive label comprises the following components in sequence: a surface layer; the hot melt adhesive layer comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 15-60 parts of thermoplastic elastomer, 30-70 parts of tackifying resin, 10-30 parts of plasticizer and 0.3-1.2 parts of antioxidant; a silicon oil layer; and (7) a base paper layer. The method has the following beneficial effects: the self-adhesive label prepared by the method has the advantages of good initial adhesion, high peel strength and good adhesive holding capacity, has excellent die cutting performance, can be used for high-speed coating in the preparation process, has good fluidity, and can meet the coating speed of 450 m/min.

title_en: Two-component coating system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a two-component coating system comprising a first component and a second component, each of the first component and the second component being separate and distinct from each other, wherein the first component comprises a carboxylic acid functional polymer dissolved and/or dispersed in an aqueous medium, and the second component comprises a polyethylenimine compound having a) from 2 to 6 structural units (a), wherein m is an integer from 1 to 8, and R' and R "are both H, b) one or more linking chains, wherein each of these linking chains links two of the structural units a, c) one or more linking groups, wherein each of the linking groups links two of the structural units a, and d) a molecular weight in the range of 840 to 5000 daltons, wherein the molecular weight is measured using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry.

title_en: Botanical insecticidal composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide compounding, and relates to a botanical insecticidal composition and application thereof, wherein the botanical insecticidal composition comprises an active ingredient A and an active ingredient B, the active ingredient A is carvacrol, the active ingredient B is matrine, and the mass ratio of the two active ingredients is 1: 20-50: 1. The active ingredients of the invention belong to pure natural substances, and the invention has good compatibility with the environment, safety, environmental protection, wide sources and low cost, and target pests are not easy to generate drug resistance.

title_en: Photo-curing polyurethane acrylate prepolymer and hardened coating liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of light-cured resin, in particular to a light-cured urethane acrylate prepolymer and a hardened coating liquid. The prepolymer synthesis raw materials comprise: isocyanate, hydroxyl-terminated hyperbranched polyester, hydroxyl acrylate, fluorinated acrylate, a catalyst and a solvent; the hydroxyl number of the hydroxyl-terminated hyperbranched polyester is 4-24, the molecular weight is 600-4000, and the hydroxyl value is 300-520 mg KOH/g. The invention has the advantages of high toughness, high hardness and high wear resistance.

title_en: Block polyether and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block polyether, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the block polyether has the following structure R- (PO)  a  ‑(EO)  b  ‑(PO)  c  ‑(EO)  m  ‑(PO)  n  ‑(EO)  p  The block polyether with the structure shown in the formula (I) is obtained by multiple addition of hydroxyl compounds serving as an initiator, alkaline earth metals serving as catalysts and propylene oxide and ethylene oxide serving as raw materials, and the block polyether has a large molecular weight and can increase the emulsifying power of the block polyether to pesticides. The block polyether comprises a plurality of alternating blocks connected in sequence: polypropylene oxide block, polyepoxideThe block type pesticide has the advantages that the ethane block, the polypropylene oxide block, the polyethylene oxide block, the polypropylene oxide block and the polyethylene oxide block are formed, the anchoring points in the polymer are increased due to the blocks, the pesticide is not easy to desorb, the stability of the pesticide is improved, and the problems that the effective components are difficult to uniformly disperse and even agglomerate due to the fact that layering and precipitation are easy to occur in the storage process of the pesticide are solved.

title_en: Novel graphene modified universal epoxy coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel graphene modified universal epoxy coating and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of graphene, and comprising a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises an epoxy resin modifier, a graphene dispersion liquid, a silicon dioxide dispersion liquid, a pigment coating, deionized water and an auxiliary agent, and the component B is a semisolid epoxy coating. According to the novel graphene modified universal epoxy coating, the epoxy resin modifier, the graphene dispersion liquid, the silicon dioxide dispersion liquid, the deionized water and the semisolid epoxy coating are fully mixed, ground and filtered, so that the processed graphene epoxy coating has a better anticorrosion effect, the processing is more convenient, and the obtained graphene epoxy coating has a better effect after being coated. Meanwhile, the first epoxy resin and the second epoxy resin are mixed and practical, so that the excellent chemical properties of the first epoxy resin and the second epoxy resin can be fully exerted, and the method has good practical value and application prospect.

title_en: Novel self-adhesive rubber SBS modified asphalt crack plaster and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road engineering construction, and provides a novel self-adhesive rubber SBS modified asphalt crack plaster and a preparation method thereof, wherein the plaster is prepared from the following raw materials: 30-60 parts of asphalt, 3-6 parts of SBS modifier, 5-8 parts of waste rubber powder, 4-6 parts of peptizer, 4-8 parts of stabilizer, 4-6 parts of tackifier, 3-5 parts of sulfur powder, 30-50 parts of filler, 3-5 parts of vitamin connecting agent and 2 parts of isolating membrane. The novel self-adhesive rubber SBS modified asphalt crack sticker has the advantages of high tear strength, no flowing at high temperature, no brittle fracture at low temperature, high elastic recovery rate and excellent durability, and can effectively prevent the crack from re-expanding; meanwhile, the material has the normal-temperature self-adhesive property, does not need to be heated during construction, is simple to operate, saves energy, is environment-friendly and has no pollution; in addition, the waterproof effect of the invention is excellent, and because the waterproof adhesive has good low-temperature flexibility and large adhesive force, a permanent seamless adhesive layer is formed after the waterproof adhesive is attached and compacted, so that rainwater can not infiltrate into cracks of the road base.

title_en: Trace asphalt recycling device and recycling method
