abstract_en: The invention discloses a trace asphalt recycling device and a trace asphalt recycling method, comprising a centrifugal separation mechanism and a distillation recycling mechanism which are connected; the centrifugal separation mechanism is used for extracting asphalt solution from raw materials and comprises a separation shell, a separation container arranged in the separation shell and a first control device arranged at the bottom of the separation shell, wherein the first control device is used for rotating and heating the separation container; the distillation recovery mechanism is used for carrying out asphalt separation on an asphalt solution and comprises a second control device, an oil bath heater arranged on the second control device, a detachable silica gel flask arranged in the oil bath heater, a condensing pipe connected with the silica gel flask and a solvent recovery bottle connected with the condensing pipe, wherein the second control device is used for respectively carrying out rotation and heating regulation and control on the silica gel flask and the oil bath heater. The invention can improve the asphalt recycling efficiency, avoid the problem that the recycling container adheres to asphalt, and realize trace recycling of asphalt.

title_en: Composite film for grain storage and packaging and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite film for grain storage packaging and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite films, wherein the composite film for grain storage packaging comprises a PET non-woven fabric, a high-strength breathable film, a waterproof film and an insect-repelling film; in the preparation process of the high-strength breathable film, raw materials and proportion of the high-strength breathable film are changed, and then the prepared high-strength breathable film has high strength and high oxygen permeability effects, in the preparation process of the waterproof film, the preparation raw materials of the film are changed into polyethylene fibers, polypropylene fibers and high water absorption fibers, water in the air can be absorbed through the high water absorption fibers, and then the probability of mildew of grains is reduced.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot anti-counterfeiting transfer film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of anti-counterfeiting, and particularly relates to a carbon quantum dot anti-counterfeiting transfer film and a preparation method thereof. The anti-counterfeiting transfer film structurally comprises a peelable layer, and a protective layer, a quantum dot information layer and an aluminum plated layer which are sequentially arranged on the peelable layer. The quantum dot information layer is prepared by coating carbon quantum dot fluorescent anti-counterfeiting ink on the protective layer, a water-soluble fluorescent product is obtained by a one-step hydrothermal method to prepare the carbon quantum dot fluorescent ink, the carbon quantum dot fluorescent ink is transferred to the transfer film in a gravure coating mode, and the fluorescent pattern is realized by engraving the gravure plate. The fluorescent ink disclosed by the invention has strong fluorescence and stability. Before the carbon quantum dot anti-counterfeiting transfer film is compounded with paper, effect treatment such as mould pressing laser can be added, the visual effect is stronger, the preparation process is simple, green and low in cost, the carbon quantum dot anti-counterfeiting transfer film is suitable for large-scale production, and a new way is provided for effective and safe anti-counterfeiting marks of packages.

title_en: Serrated metal chelate plugging agent, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a serrated metal chelate plugging agent, a preparation method and application. The preparation method comprises the following steps: under an acidic condition, carrying out a first polymerization reaction on a hydroxyl-substituted quinoline compound and formaldehyde to obtain a first polymerization intermediate; under the action of a first acid-binding agent, cyanuric chloride and a diethylamine compound are subjected to a second polymerization reaction to obtain a second polymerization intermediate; carrying out a third polymerization reaction on the second polymerization intermediate and a piperazine compound to obtain a third polymerization intermediate; under the action of a second acid-binding agent, carrying out a fourth reaction on the first polymerization intermediate and the third polymerization intermediate to obtain a fourth intermediate; and carrying out a complexing reaction on the fourth intermediate and an organic metal compound to obtain the metal chelate plugging agent. The metal chelate plugging agent has good ductility, is not easy to break, is in a multi-face zigzag shape, has large frictional resistance with the stratum, has good dispersion stability and high acid solubility, is easy to realize acidification and plugging removal, and effectively protects the reservoir.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Ag-loaded layered double hydroxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of double metal hydroxide, in particular to a preparation method and application of Ag-loaded layered double metal hydroxide, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving zinc nitrate hexahydrate, aluminum nitrate nonahydrate and silver nitrate in deionized water to obtain a mixed solution; s2: dripping the mixed solution obtained in the step S1 into a formamide solution, and then stirring at a low temperature in an inert gas atmosphere to obtain a reaction stock solution; s3: and (4) dropwise adding a sodium hydroxide solution into the reaction stock solution obtained in the step S2 to control the pH value and react, and centrifuging and washing the reaction product to obtain the Ag-loaded layered double hydroxide. Compared with the prior art, the synthesis method is simple, simple and convenient to operate, mild in condition, high in purity of the target product, safe and non-toxic, and capable of being synthesized in large scale at low cost.

title_en: Fertilizer core pretreatment equipment and treatment method for coated controlled release fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention provides fertilizer core pretreatment equipment and a treatment method for coated controlled release fertilizer, wherein the fertilizer core pretreatment equipment for the coated controlled release fertilizer comprises a front screening machine for screening out small granular fertilizer cores, a polishing machine for polishing medium granular fertilizer cores and large granular fertilizer cores and a rear screening machine for screening out the large granular fertilizer cores; after small granular fertilizer cores in the fertilizer cores are screened and removed by the front screening machine, the rest medium granular fertilizer cores and large granular fertilizer cores are polished by the polishing machine so that part of large granular fertilizer cores are changed into medium granular fertilizer cores, and then the large granular fertilizer cores are screened and removed by the rear screening machine and are re-injected into the polishing machine, so that all the large granular fertilizer cores are finally changed into medium granular fertilizer cores meeting the requirements, the recycling rate of the fertilizer cores is improved, and the use cost of the fertilizer cores is effectively reduced.

title_en: Soil remediation agent prepared from crop straws and biochar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil repairing agent prepared from crop straws and biochar and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of soil repairing, wherein the soil repairing agent is formed by modified crop straws, nano modified biochar, a compound microbial agent, an organic material, a decomposition agent and a medium trace element solution, heavy metal ions in the modified crop straws and the nano modified biochar are strongly adsorbed, the comprehensive action of the modified crop straws, the organic material and the decomposition agent neutralizes and regulates excessive salt in soil, organic matters and elements and beneficial microorganisms necessary for plant growth are released, the soil permeability is increased, the compound microbial agent is used for decomposing phosphorus and potassium, reducing soil salt damage and regulating the soil pH value, and meanwhile, the compound microbial agent prevents and controls soil-borne diseases by bacteria, activates the activity of plant cells and promotes the development of root systems; the synergistic effect of the components solves the problems of overhigh salt content, acidification and rich heavy metal ions of the soil, and simultaneously improves the micro-ecological environment of the soil.

title_en: Water-based formaldehyde-free adhesive for cigarette packaging and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-based aldehyde-free adhesive for cigarette packaging and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the water-based aldehyde-free adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 80-90 parts of waterborne polyurethane resin; 10-20 parts of acrylic resin; 0.2-0.5 of sodium hydroxide solution; 1-3 parts of diethanolamine; 0.5-1.0% of isocyanate; 0.5-1.0% of defoaming agent; 1-2 parts of a wetting agent; 0.1 to 0.3 of a thickener. The water-based formaldehyde-free adhesive for cigarette packaging is mainly applied to cigarette packaging and manufacturing, has good adhesive force, high drying speed, good compatibility with alcohol and good flexibility and high bonding strength, is impermeable to the surface of a base material, and can increase the flexibility, the flatness and the smoothness of cigarettes and cigarette holders.

title_en: Mildew preventive containing BCM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building coating, and particularly relates to a mildew inhibitor containing BCM. A mildew preventive containing BCM comprises active ingredients of BCM and bergenia lactone according to the proportion of 1-15:8-1 by mass ratio. The mildew preventive containing BCM is formed by combining BCM and bergenia lactone according to a certain mass ratio, has a synergistic effect on various existing mildew, can improve the inhibition effect on the mildew compared with a single mildew preventive component, is beneficial to improving the resistance of interior wall paint to external microorganisms, and ensures that the paint does not produce spoilage in production, storage and use; and secondly, the consumption of the anti-corrosion components and the anti-corrosion cost can be reduced, and the anti-corrosion agent is beneficial to protecting the life health and safety of people.

title_en: Method for reducing self-water absorption of hydraulically fractured shale reservoir
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reducing the self-water absorption capacity of a hydraulic fracturing shale reservoir, which comprises the following steps: preparing a core sample of a shale reservoir to be hydraulically fractured; determining the formation water mineralization degree of the core sample; preparing modified slick water, wherein the mineralization degree of the modified slick water is greater than that of the stratum water; and carrying out hydraulic fracturing operation by using the modified slick water so as to reduce the self-water absorption of the hydraulic fracturing shale reservoir. According to the method for reducing the self-water absorption capacity of the hydraulic fracturing shale reservoir, the self-water absorption capacity of the shale can be reduced to zero by enabling the self-water absorption resistance to exceed or be equal to the other self-water absorption power (namely capillary force) under the condition that the mineralization degree of modified slick water is greater than or equal to the preset mineralization degree.

title_en: Equipment for preparing paraffin plasticizer and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plasticizer production equipment, in particular to equipment for preparing paraffin plasticizer and a using method thereof, and the equipment comprises a waxing mechanism, a reaction kettle, a stirring mechanism and a constant temperature mechanism, wherein the top end of the reaction kettle is provided with a supporting table, supporting columns are arranged on the periphery of the bottom end of the supporting table, the waxing mechanism comprises a supporting frame, a waxing box, a temporary storage box and a weighing mechanism, the supporting frame is arranged at the top end of the supporting table, the waxing box is arranged at the top end of the supporting frame, the weighing mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting frame, the temporary storage box is arranged on the weighing mechanism, the top end of the supporting frame is provided with a heater and an insulation box, liquefied paraffin within a weight range specified by a person can be accurately added into the reaction kettle through the weighing mechanism, and the constant temperature mechanism is used for enabling the temperature of the reaction kettle to reach an appropriate temperature range of reaction, can ensure the normal operation of the reaction kettle.

title_en: Off-on near-infrared two-zone fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic compound probes, in particular to an off-on near-infrared two-region fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a compound or a salt thereof, wherein the structural formula of the compound is shown as a formula I. The compound or the salt thereof provided by the invention has the characteristics of novel structure, good stability, high biological safety, capability of biological identification and the like.

title_en: Design and synthesis of acridine fluoroboron fluorescent dye with large Stokes displacement
abstract_en: The invention relates to design and synthesis of acridine boron fluoride dye with large Stokes displacement, belonging to the technical field of preparation of organic functional materials. The molecular structure is as follows: wherein R is Me, HNCOCH  3  Br, CN. Compared with the traditional fluorine boron dye, the novel fluorine boron dye has longer emission wavelength, large Stokes shift and high fluorescence quantum yield, and has good application prospect in aspects of biological imaging and the like.

title_en: Corrosion inhibitor load BTA@ZIF-8/SiO with core/shell structure 2 Preparation method of composite powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation technology of a metal anti-corrosion coating material, and aims to provide a corrosion inhibitor load BTA@ZIF-8/SiO with a core/shell structure  2  A preparation method of composite powder. Comprising the following steps: dissolving benzotriazole BTA and 2-methylimidazole in absolute ethyl alcohol; dissolving benzotriazole BTA and zinc nitrate hexahydrate in deionized water; mixing the two solutions, reacting, centrifugally separating, washing and drying; adding the prepared composite powder into absolute ethyl alcohol for ultrasonic dispersion, and adding hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide and ammonia water; then dripping the mixture of tetraethoxysilane and absolute ethyl alcohol, separating, washing and drying the reaction product to obtain BTA@ZIF-8/SiO  2  And (5) compounding powder. The invention does not need additional loading steps such as vacuum impregnation and the like, and simplifies the loading process. The product has good dispersibility, is not easy to agglomerate, is easier to store, and expands the application range of the corrosion inhibitor. SiO in composite powder  2  The shell structure can effectively reduce the release rate of the corrosion inhibitor, prolong the action aging of the composite powder, and improve the compatibility of the powder and the coating.

title_en: Environment-friendly offset printing ink and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of printing ink, and particularly discloses environment-friendly offset printing ink and a preparation method thereof. The environment-friendly offset printing ink comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 10-20% of pigment, 20-30% of rosin modified phenolic resin, 10-20% of vegetable oil fatty acid ester, 0.1-1% of trigger, 0.3-1% of other auxiliary agents and the balance of vegetable oil; wherein the trigger is obtained by wrapping phospholipase with starch, and the other adjuvants are obtained by wrapping pulvis Talci and magnesium carbonate with lac soft resin. The environment-friendly offset printing ink does not contain volatile organic compounds basically, can show corresponding drying speed at different stages, and is good in printing quality.

title_en: Heavy oil viscosity reduction strengthening device capable of continuously adjusting flow based on jet cavitation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heavy oil viscosity reduction equipment, in particular to a heavy oil viscosity reduction strengthening device capable of continuously adjusting flow based on jet cavitation, which comprises a pipeline with a flow cavity, a first air pump and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the pipeline is provided with a flow cavity; the flow cavity channel comprises an inlet transition section, a contraction section, a throat section, an expansion section and an outlet transition section which are sequentially arranged from the head end to the tail end, the flow area of the contraction section is gradually reduced from the head end to the tail end, and the flow area of the expansion section is gradually increased from the head end to the tail end; install the bubble in the expansion section and take place the piece, a plurality of gas pocket units have been seted up on the bubble takes place the piece in proper order, the gas pocket unit includes a plurality of first gas pockets, the output of first air pump and the input intercommunication of first gas pocket through the installation of bubble emergence piece, make heavy oil produce more bubbles at the bubble primary stage of cavitation, improve the cavitation effect, it is comparatively simple to be equipped with structural style, and operation structural style is comparatively simple.

title_en: Special environment-friendly oil stain cleaning agent for cleaning escalator steps
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly oil stain cleaning agent special for cleaning escalator steps, which comprises 15-20% by mass of alkyl glycoside, 15-20% by mass of sodium carbonate, 3-8% by mass of complexing agent, 3-8% by mass of corrosion inhibitor, 0.5-1.5% by mass of builder, 3-5% by mass of defoaming agent, 3-8% by mass of detergent and 20-60% by mass of deionized water. The special environment-friendly oil stain cleaning agent for cleaning the escalator steps is a special environment-friendly cleaning agent for cleaning the steps, is unique, has no corrosivity, can not damage water paint on the surfaces of the steps, is environment-friendly, nontoxic and nuisanceless, has no influence on the health of human bodies and no pollution to the discharge of the environment, can be biodegraded, and is an environment-friendly product.

title_en: Cultivation method of Honghuadajinyuan flue-cured tobacco
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivation method of Honghuadajinyuan flue-cured tobacco, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the raw materials for root fertilization comprise: comprises a raw material A, a raw material B, a raw material C, a raw material D, a raw material E and a raw material F. By the cultivation technical method of planting the flue-cured tobacco Honghuadajinyuan on the 'semi-immature soil', the tobacco seedlings can grow normally after being transplanted, and the effect of normal mellow soil cultivation can be completely achieved.

title_en: A cooling save set for liver and kidney are transplanted
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling and storing device for liver and kidney transplantation, which solves the technical problem that the existing kidney transplantation needs strict low-temperature cooling and low-temperature storage and is easy to have uneven cooling. The kidney transplantation refrigerator comprises a heat preservation box body and a box cover, wherein the heat preservation box body comprises an inner cavity for caching transplanted kidneys, a cooling medium cavity arranged outside the inner cavity and a heat preservation cavity arranged outside the cooling medium cavity, the bottom of the inner cavity is a concave surface, a box cover flange is arranged on the outer side of the box cover, the bottom of the box cover is a convex surface, the box cover flange and the convex surface of the box cover are respectively in sealing fit with the cooling medium cavity and the inner cavity, a fixing lug is arranged outside the heat preservation box body and connected with a lifting handle, a box cover lifting handle is arranged at the top of the box cover, a temperature sensor is arranged at the convex surface of the box cover, and a temperature display screen connected with the temperature sensor is arranged at the top of the box cover. The invention has simple structure, scientific and reasonable design and convenient use, can maintain low-temperature environment for a long time, simultaneously ensures uniform cooling of the kidney and effectively improves the survival rate of the kidney source.

title_en: Polyether demulsifier using decyl tetradecyl alcohol as initiator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyether demulsifier taking decyl tetradecyl alcohol as an initiator, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of demulsifier preparation. The polyether demulsifier using decyl tetradecanol as an initiator provided by the invention has the following structural formula (I): wherein, the value range of m is any integer from 490 to 610, and the value range of p is any integer from 400 to 650. The polyether demulsifier has the characteristics of large molecular weight, high cloud point, strong surface activity and the like; the lipophilic group with the branched chain has strong penetrability in crude oil, has special demulsification effect on shale oil, and has clear water quality and clean oil-water interface.

title_en: High-thermal-conductivity wear-resistant material for circulating fluidized bed boiler and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-heat-conductivity wear-resistant material for a circulating fluidized bed boiler and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of refractory materials. A preparation method of a wear-resistant high-heat-conductivity high-temperature-resistant material comprises the following steps: s1, preparing high-thermal-conductivity fine powder; s2, preparing modified high-thermal-conductivity fine powder; s3, preparing a porous alumina-coated high-thermal-conductivity fine powder material; s4, preparing a high-thermal-conductivity fine powder material coated with modified porous alumina; s5, coating graphene oxide @ porous alumina preparing a high-heat-conductivity fine powder material; s6, preparing the graphene @ porous alumina coated high-thermal-conductivity fine powder material. The high-heat-conductivity wear-resistant material for the circulating fluidized bed boiler has excellent wear resistance, high temperature resistance, fire resistance and heat conductivity, has good mechanical property, can adapt to harsh conditions of the circulating fluidized bed boiler, improves the strength of the formed boiler lining, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Antistatic PET film for electronic product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antistatic PET film for electronic products, which comprises a substrate layer, a first antistatic coating and a second antistatic coating, wherein the first antistatic coating and the second antistatic coating are respectively positioned on the upper surface and the lower surface of the substrate layer, a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer is positioned between a release layer and the second antistatic coating, the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer is positioned on the surface of the second antistatic coating opposite to the substrate layer, and the coating liquid comprises the following components in parts by weight: polyurethane resin, polyvinyl alcohol, sodium octyl sulfate, N-ethyl-N- (3-sulfopropyl) -3-methylaniline sodium salt, dioctyl terephthalate, N-butanol, isobutyl acetate, castor oil polyoxyethylene ether, triethylenetetramine, silane coupling agent, antioxidant and leveling agent. The invention not only improves the antistatic performance, but also ensures that the surface resistance of the antistatic PET film for the electronic product has little change and stable antistatic performance under the condition of larger ambient humidity shadow change.

title_en: Waterborne modified alkyd resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterborne modified alkyd resin and a preparation method thereof, wherein the waterborne modified alkyd resin is prepared from the following raw material components: 43-46 parts of alkyd resin, 26-36 parts of comonomer and 25-30 parts of cosolvent; the comonomer is at least one or more of acrylic acid, methacrylic acid, styrene, butyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate and methyl methacrylate which contain acrylic acid. The invention uses basic alkyd resin and acrylic acid and other comonomers to modify the alkyd resin, thereby obtaining the water-based resin which has good water solubility, low resin cost, high drying speed, high film hardness, good initial water resistance and good hydrolysis resistance stability and can meet the market demand.

title_en: Water-based aluminum pigment with mirror effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based aluminum pigment with a mirror effect, a preparation method and application thereof. The water-based aluminum pigment with the mirror effect, the preparation method and the application thereof provided by the invention have high corrosion resistance and good dispersibility, and the inherent metallic luster of the aluminum pigment is maintained under the condition that the surface smoothness of the aluminum pigment is not damaged, so that the water-based aluminum pigment with the mirror effect and long-term storage effect is obtained.

title_en: Superfine fly ash grinding aid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrafine fly ash grinding aid and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of cement concrete building materials, the ultrafine fly ash grinding aid comprises 5-15wt% of modified triethanolamine, 5-15wt% of diethanol monoisopropanolamine, 5-15wt% of saccharides, 3-10wt% of sodium silicate, 10-15wt% of sodium sulfate and the balance of water; 1. the superfine fly ash grinding aid takes various properties and characteristics of physical and chemical properties, particle fineness, specific surface area and the like of superfine fly ash as research objects, a special grinding aid product with specificity, pertinence and high efficiency is obtained by compound development, and the specific surface energy of the superfine fly ash particles is effectively reduced and the phenomenon of agglomeration is reduced in the grinding aid process; 2. the ultrafine fly ash grinding aid disclosed by the invention has excellent grinding aid effect, also has activity enhancement effect, and can improve the workability, the fluidity and the cohesiveness of fly ash in the using process.

title_en: Environment-friendly flame retardant, preparation method and environment-friendly flame retardant viscose fiber
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly flame retardant and a preparation method thereof. The invention also provides an environment-friendly flame-retardant viscose fiber which is prepared by uniformly mixing an environment-friendly flame retardant and a viscose spinning solution and then carrying out a wet spinning process. The environment-friendly flame retardant has good interfacial compatibility with the viscose spinning solution, small dosage, uniform dispersion of the mixed environment-friendly flame retardant viscose spinning solution and good spinnability, and greatly improves the physical and mechanical properties and flame retardant efficiency of the flame retardant viscose fiber.

title_en: Agrochemical formulations
abstract_en: An aqueous agrochemical formulation comprising a) an agriculturally acceptable salt of dicamba, B) at least one anionic surfactant comprising at least one naphthalene sulfonate, C) an aqueous solvent, D) optionally, at least one thickener, E) optionally, a further pesticide, F) optionally, further formulation auxiliaries.

title_en: Elaeagnus conferta potted plant planting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planting elaeagnus conferta pot plants, which comprises the following steps of (a) selecting seedlings, and selecting plants with 1-2 branches with strong uprightness as planting seedlings; (b) Selecting a vertical column type frame, (c) transplanting, firstly filling planting soil with the thickness of 2-5cm into the bottom of the planting bag, inserting the vertical column type frame, transplanting the planting seedlings into a non-woven fabric planting bag, and pouring enough root fixing water; (d) Managing after transplanting, dwarfing, and supplementing nutrition and fertilizing; (e) Pruning, topping until the goat milk fruit branches grow to a position 10-15cm away from the top of the upright column, promoting the lateral buds to be drawn out again, and culturing the fruit branches; and uniformly distributing and retaining the newly-extracted lateral bud branches. The method can dwarf and potted elaeagnus conferta roxb plants, is convenient to carry and move, and can be used for daily common family ornamental planting and urban greening.

title_en: Preparation method of core-shell fluorescent microsphere profile control and plugging agent for offshore oilfield high-permeability oil reservoirs based on quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a core-shell fluorescent microsphere profile control and plugging agent for offshore oil field high-permeability oil reservoirs based on quantum dots, and belongs to the technical field of oil exploitation. The core-shell type microsphere with the fluorescent tracing function is prepared by adopting a two-step method, the fluorescent quantum dots are introduced in the process of preparing the core microsphere solution, and then the fluorescent quantum dots are mixed with shell layer monomer water solution and adsorbed to prepare the core-shell type microsphere solution, so that the fluorescent quantum dots are positioned in the core-shell type fluorescent microsphere and cannot be separated, and the subsequent detection precision is improved; after the core-shell type fluorescent microsphere plugging agent is injected into an oil well, whether the core-shell type fluorescent microsphere plugging agent is produced or not and the produced concentration can be judged by detecting the fluorescence emission spectrum in the water phase of the produced liquid of the oil well, and the detection method is simple and has high accuracy. The results of the examples show that the core-shell fluorescent microsphere plugging agent prepared by the invention can achieve a detection accuracy of +/-5% compared with a standard product obtained by weighing and preparing after being injected into an offshore oilfield.

title_en: Extender composition and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extender composition and application thereof in a polyaspartate polyurea composition, and a method for prolonging the service life of the polyaspartate polyurea composition by using the extender composition. The extender composition comprises 30-80 parts of polyamine resin, 0.01-30 parts of ketone solvent and 10-80 parts of silicon-containing inorganic substance. The extender can effectively prolong the service life of the polyaspartic ester polyurea composition and provide enough construction operation time for different applications of the polyaspartic ester polyurea composition. The polyaspartic acid ester polyurea composition with the prolonged working life can be applied to different types of base materials such as metal, concrete, plastic, composite materials and the like, and has the performances of low-temperature rapid curing, high solid content, low VOC (volatile organic compounds) emission, good base material adhesion, outdoor durability and the like.

title_en: Silicon rubber sealant for bonding LED lamp tube and lamp strip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon rubber sealant for bonding a light bar of an LED lamp tube, which is prepared from the following raw materials: 100 parts by weight of alpha, omega-dihydroxy polydimethylsiloxane; 2-30 parts of dimethyl silicone oil; 10-100 parts of light calcium carbonate; 10-150 parts of heavy calcium carbonate; 0-10 parts of color paste; 5-25 parts by weight of a silane coupling agent; the silane coupling agent is more than two of dichloromethyl triethoxysilane, chloromethyl triethoxysilane, methyl triethoxysilane, phenyl triethoxysilane, aniline methyl triethoxysilane, diethylamino methyl triethoxysilane and 3-aminopropyl triethoxysilane. Compared with the prior art, the silicon rubber sealant for bonding the LED lamp strip provided by the invention adopts specific content components, realizes better overall interaction, can rapidly bond the LED lamp strip and the LED lamp strip at room temperature, has excellent bonding performance and ageing resistance, and cannot react with a fluorescent layer on the surface of the LED lamp strip to cause yellowing and corrode the fluorescent layer.

title_en: Organic compound, application thereof and organic electroluminescent device comprising organic compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound, application thereof and an organic electroluminescent device containing the compoundThe compound has the following structure, wherein X  1  And X  2  Each independently is N or B; ring A represents a benzene ring, a naphthalene ring or an anthracene ring; ring B and ring C each independently represent a benzene ring, a naphthalene ring or an anthracene ring; ring D and ring E each independently represent a C8-C60 fused aromatic hydrocarbon. The compound of the present invention shows excellent device performance and stability when used as a light emitting material in an OLED device. The invention also protects the organic electroluminescent device adopting the compound with the general formula.

title_en: High-surface-bonding-strength zero-VOC aldehyde-free back coating adhesive for impregnated paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-surface bonding strength zero-VOC aldehyde-free back coating for impregnated paper and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of new materials, solves the problem of formaldehyde release caused by melamine-formaldehyde glue for the traditional impregnated paper, and realizes real aldehyde-free home decoration; according to the formaldehyde-free impregnated back coating prepared by the invention, the functional group for the combination reaction of the paper and the hydroxyl on the plate is increased by introducing the monomer for improving the adhesive force on the resin structure, so that the adhesive strength of the pressed and pasted paper and the plate is improved, and the problem of poor adhesive property of the pressed and pasted plate of the impregnated paper is solved; the back glue of the impregnated paper does not contain any solvent, so that real zero VOC is realized; the invention introduces the cross-linking technology after high-temperature pressing and pasting, and solves the problems that the curing is not completely affected with damp and sticky, and the curing is completely pressed and pasted, and the bonding force is poor, so that the balance is difficult; based on the high surface bonding strength of the formaldehyde-free back coating adhesive, the invention meets the requirements of steam resistance and cold and heat cycle resistance after subsequent impregnation of a paper plywood.

title_en: Method for preparing oil from superheated steam type efficient liquefied plastic garbage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing oil by using superheated steam type high-efficiency liquefied plastic garbage, which comprises the following steps: fully mixing the plastic waste to be treated with a solvent according to a preset proportion; starting the reaction kettle, and checking whether the working state of the reaction kettle is normal; placing the mixture of the mixed plastic waste and the solvent into a reaction kettle, and starting a temperature-rising and overheating reaction process; carrying out a heat preservation process after the temperature rise and overheating reaction; and (4) cooling the substance obtained after heat preservation, and then taking out the obtained oil. The invention has strong practicability and functionality, and can be widely applied to the technical fields of harmless treatment and resource utilization of waste plastics.

title_en: Bioelectrode composition, bioelectrode, and method for producing bioelectrode
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bioelectrode composition, a bioelectrode, and a method for producing a bioelectrodeThe manufacturing method comprises the following steps. The present invention addresses the problem of providing a bioelectrode composition that can form a bioelectrode contact layer for a bioelectrode that is flexible and has excellent flexibility and adhesiveness, is lightweight, can be produced at low cost, and has excellent electrical conductivity and biocompatibility, and does not significantly decrease in electrical conductivity even when wetted with water or dried. The invention provides a bioelectrode composition comprising (A) silicone; the (A) polysiloxane is bonded to an ionic polymer and has a structure containing a T unit represented by the following general formula (T1) (except a cage structure); (R)  0  SiO  3/2  ) (T1) wherein R  0  Is a linking group to the ionic polymer; and the ionic polymer is a polymer containing a repeating unit having a structure selected from the group consisting of ammonium salts, lithium salts, sodium salts, potassium salts, and silver salts of fluorosulfonic acid, fluorosulfonylimide, and N-carbonyl fluorosulfonamide.

title_en: Organic fertilizer production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic fertilizer production process which is characterized by comprising the following steps: s1: preparing raw materials, collecting combustible and perishable wastes such as chaff, sawdust, straw, straws, leaves, excrement leaves and the like, and placing the wastes into a preparation groove; s2: mixing and stirring, namely intermittently adding the prepared raw materials in the S1 into a mixing mechanism (9) through a feed chute (8) and a transmission cover assembly (7) of an organic fertilizer production device for stirring, and adding zeolite powder for deodorization in the stirring process; s3: fermenting, wherein the mixed raw materials in the S2 are discharged out of the mixing box body (93) through a spiral roller (92) and enter the barrel body (51) for fermentation; s4: the tail gas generated by fermentation in the S3 enters the exhaust pipe (11) through the transmission cover component (7), and is absorbed, filtered and degraded through the filter screen layer (14), the graphene absorption layer (13) and the photocatalyst plate (12) and then is discharged into the environment; organic matters generated by fermentation are discharged through a discharge port (6) of the electromagnetic valve.

title_en: Pile turning machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pile turning machine which comprises a rack, wherein the left side and the right side of the rack are respectively provided with a crawler belt which is convenient for the device to move, the left side and the right side of each crawler belt are respectively and rotatably connected with a transverse connecting shaft, the connecting shafts are positioned at the front sides of the crawler belts, the outer sides of the connecting shafts are fixedly provided with idler wheels, the idler wheels are abutted against the ground, a first braking box fixedly connected with the outer wall of the rack is arranged above the connecting shafts, and the pile turning machine plays a braking role on the connecting shafts when the device needs to be braked through the action of a first braking piece, so that the sliding time of the connecting shafts and the idler wheels is reduced, the braking efficiency of the device is improved, the abrasion of emergency braking on machine parts of the device is reduced, and the braking efficiency of the device is improved.

title_en: Weeding composition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a weeding composition, which comprises an active component (A) flumioxazin and an active component (B) of one or more of oxaziclomefone, oxadiargyl, pentoxazone, triafamone, simetryn, thiobencarb, mefenacet, fentrazamide, pyraclonil, benzobicylon and metazosulfuron, wherein the weight ratio of the active component (A) to the active component (B) is 100-1. The invention also relates to the use of said herbicidal composition for controlling the germination or growth of weeds in useful plants; the useful plants are selected from wheat, barley, rye, triticale, oats, maize, rice, soybean, peanut, oilseed rape, canola, potato, sugar beet, sugarcane, cotton, flax, sorghum, pasture grasses, turf; particularly useful for controlling the germination or growth of weeds in rice crops.

title_en: Planting and breeding waste compost suitable for high-quality production of open-field cabbages and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planting and breeding waste compost suitable for high-quality production of open-field cabbages and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Adding other components except animal manure (sheep manure and/or cow manure) in the material into a pulverizer to pulverize to obtain a mixture. (2) Adding fresh animal wastes and microbial inoculum into the mixture in proportion, stacking into piles, fully and uniformly stirring by using a pile turning machine or a loading machine, then covering a plastic film on the pile, and detecting and recording the temperature of the pile. When the temperature rises to above 60 ℃ from the day of building the stack, a stack turning machine or a loader is used for turning the stack for the first time, then turning and mixing are carried out once every 7 days, the surface and the central part of the stack are uniformly turned and mixed during turning, the inner layer and the outer layer of the stack are ensured to reach the maturity standard, and the humidity is controlled to be 50-70% in the fermentation process. And (5) obtaining the agricultural waste compost after fermentation. The compost prepared by the method can obviously promote the growth of the cabbages, improve the yield and improve the quality.

title_en: Biological carbon-based soil modifier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biochar-based soil conditioner and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of soil remediation. The modifier disclosed by the invention is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-60 parts of organic fertilizer components, 5-10 parts of urea, 5-10 parts of monopotassium phosphate, 40-80 parts of modified biochar and 4-12 parts of composite microbial agent. According to the invention, the biochar is modified and then the microorganism is loaded, so that on one hand, the soil improvement effect of the biochar is enhanced, the physicochemical property of the soil is improved, the level of heavy metal elements in the soil is reduced, the biological activity of the soil is improved, and on the other hand, the microorganism microbial agent is also effectively protected, so that the microorganism microbial agent can continuously and effectively regulate the soil environment and promote the growth of crops.

title_en: Coating for improving tone quality in sound box and preparation method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of sound box coatings, and particularly discloses a coating for improving tone quality in a sound box and a preparation method thereof. The coating for improving the sound quality in the sound box comprises the following components in percentage by mass: emulsified asphalt: 76% -82%; asbestos: 12 to-16 percent; adhesive: 3% -6%; auxiliary agent: 2% -3%; the adhesive at least comprises chloroprene rubber; the auxiliary agent at least comprises a solvent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding emulsified asphalt, asbestos and an auxiliary agent into a reaction kettle, heating to 250-280 ℃, stirring for 1-1.5 h, filtering, removing impurities, cooling to 180-200 ℃, adding an adhesive, filtering, removing impurities, cooling to 100-120 ℃, continuously stirring for 0.5-1h, cooling to 80-90 ℃ while stirring, standing for 0.5-1h at 80-90 ℃, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the coating for improving the sound quality in the sound box. The application of improve the coating of tone quality in the audio amplifier can carry out certain improvement to audio amplifier tone quality, has better sound absorbing effect simultaneously.

title_en: Molecular perovskite type compound (C) 6 H 14 N 2 )K(NO 3 ) 3 Use as additive component of dual-based propellant powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular perovskite type compound (C)  6  H  14  N  2  )K(NO  3  )  3  The additive component can improve the powder strength of the double-base propellant and reduce the burning temperature of the double-base propellant.

title_en: Glue for wallpaper and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses glue for wallpaper and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glue for wallpaper comprises an agent A and an agent B, wherein the agent A comprises the following components: isooctyl acrylate, tackifying resin, a leveling agent, organic bentonite, silicon dioxide, aluminum trioxide and water; the agent B consists of the following components: modified peach gum, matrix, emulsifier, defoamer, ethanol water solution and calcium oxide. The preparation method comprises the preparation of isooctyl acrylate and the preparation of modified peach gum. The glue for wallpaper prepared by the invention has the advantages of high stability, high solid content, high bonding strength, greenness, no pollution and capability of realizing the full-sticking effect of wallpaper.

title_en: Production process of environment-friendly waterproof asphalt coiled material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of an environment-friendly waterproof asphalt coiled material, which relates to the technical field of asphalt coiled material production, and is based on a processing device, and the production process of the asphalt coiled material specifically comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: adding the heated asphalt material into a processing device, and heating the processing device to 190-200 ℃; step two: sequentially adding SBS and rubber powder in a processing device; step three: after the rubber powder is swelled, adding IPP particles, and after the IPP particles are melted, adding talcum powder into a processing device; step four: in the steps, the processing devices are all stirred, and the stirring speed is 15r/min-20r/min; the negative pressure component is used for continuously pumping air from the interior of the tank body, so that the air pressure in the tank body is continuously reduced, air in the stirred material can be discharged, the air environment in a production workshop is ensured, the generation of bubbles in the material is effectively reduced, and the quality of subsequent products is favorably ensured.

title_en: Organic fluorescent molecule and preparation method thereof, mesoporous silica material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic fluorescent molecule and a preparation method thereof, and a mesoporous silica material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method of the mesoporous silica material has the characteristics that: step one, preparing hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium chloride, triethanolamine and deionized water to obtain a first solution; step two, adding a mixed solution of tetraethyl orthosilicate and cyclohexane as a silane precursor into the first solution, and reacting for a first preset time to obtain a product I; step three, washing the first product by using an ethanol solution to obtain a second product; and step four, reacting the product II with the organic fluorescent molecules prepared by the method in toluene solution for a second preset time to obtain the mesoporous silica material.

title_en: Rust-proof oil composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-rust oil composition which is prepared by mixing the following components in percentage by mass: 15 to 20 percent of saturated straight-chain fatty acid butyl ester with 20 to 30 carbon atoms, 1 to 2 percent of succinic acid with at least 10 carbon atoms, 10 to 15 percent of alkyl naphthalene sulfonate, 15 to 20 percent of naphthenic base oil and the balance of volatile base oil. The rust-preventive oil takes the saturated straight-chain fatty acid butyl ester with 20-30 carbon atoms as a film forming substance, and the saturated straight-chain fatty acid butyl ester has good solubility in base oil and volatile solvent oil, so that the solubility problem of the existing rust-preventive oil after the esterification of oxidized wax is avoided; meanwhile, the salt spray resistance of an oil film formed on the surface of a metal workpiece is greatly improved through succinic acid and alkyl naphthalene sulfonate in a synergistic system, the formed oil film is compact and firmly attached to the metal workpiece, and water and oxygen cannot pass through a film layer, so that the rust resistance of the workpiece is effectively improved.

title_en: Method for preparing second-generation biodiesel by catalyzing grease hydrogenation by using Ni-Fe/HAP
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing second-generation biodiesel by catalyzing grease hydrogenation by Ni-Fe/HAP, which comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing three solutions; nickel nitrate hexahydrate, calcium nitrate tetrahydrate and ferric nitrate nonahydrate are dissolved in deionized water to obtain solution A; dissolving diamine hydrogen phosphate in deionized water to obtain a solution B; sodium hydroxide is dissolved in deionized water to obtain solution C; at 30 ℃, A, B, C solutions are added into a three-neck flask by a peristaltic pump in a dropwise manner, mixed and stirred for 30min, and kept stand for 24h. Washing the solid to be neutral by deionized water, drying, calcining, placing in a tube furnace, and reducing to obtain a Ni-Fe/HAP catalyst; adding a Ni-Fe/HAP catalyst, grease and dodecane into a reaction kettle, filling hydrogen, and keeping the initial pressure at 2-3 MPa; the alkane yield of 30 percent Ni-7.5 percent Fe/HAP catalytic oleic acid hydrogenation is 97.07 percent when the reaction temperature is 200-240 ℃ and the reaction time is 3h and the reaction pressure is 2MPa and the reaction temperature is 240 ℃, which is far higher than that of 30 percent Ni-7.5 percent Fe/HAP catalyst (12.02 percent) prepared by the conventional dipping method.

title_en: Heat-insulating and sound-insulating glass laminating adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to glass laminating adhesive, in particular to heat-insulating and sound-insulating glass laminating adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The packaging adhesive film comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 100 parts of matrix resin, 0.05-1.5 parts of coupling agent, 0.1-2 parts of anti-aging auxiliary agent, 0.1-3 parts of cross-linking agent, 0.1-1 part of nano-modifier and 0.1-2 parts of damping material. The laminated glass is used for the interlayer of the car window windshield, and the appearance is good after the high pressure of an autoclave, so that the safety performance of the laminated glass is achieved.

title_en: Electrode assembly for crude oil emulsion electric field demulsification and oil-water separator
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrode assembly for crude oil emulsion electric field demulsification and an oil-water separator, relates to the technical field of crude oil-water separation, and solves the technical problem that most of non-grounding electrodes in the electrode assembly in the prior art adopt insulating plate electrodes, and the weight of a single insulating plate is large. The electrode assembly comprises a metal support frame, metal plate electrodes, insulating electrodes, a limiting frame structure and a line collecting pipe, wherein the metal plate electrodes are fixed on the metal support frame, the insulating electrodes are of bent pipe structures, the insulating electrodes are supported on the metal plate electrodes through the limiting frame structure, the metal plate electrodes and the insulating electrodes are distributed alternately, and the line collecting pipe is connected with the insulating electrodes. The insulated electrode is used as a high-voltage electrode, the metal plate electrode is used as a grounding electrode, a non-uniform electric field is formed between the insulated electrode and the grounding electrode, and a fluid flow channel is formed. The bent pipe is used as the insulated electrode, so that the structure is simple, the cost is low, the installation and maintenance are convenient, and the situation that impurities such as sand particles are accumulated and blocked in the flow channel of the electrode assembly can be prevented.

title_en: Potassium cryolite type rare earth scintillation material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elpasolite type rare earth scintillating material, the chemical general formula of which is Cs  2  LiRE  1‑x  Pr  x  Cl  6  RE is one or more of rare earth elements Sc, Y, la, gd and Lu, wherein x is more than 0 and less than 0.002. Through adding activating ion Pr of potassium cryolite type rare earth scintillation material  3+  The concentration is controlled to be more than 0 and less than 0.002, thus effectively avoiding Pr  3+  Strong concentration quenching effect, thereby obtaining excellent light output and energy resolution; the elpasolite type rare earth scintillating material has ultrahigh neutron/gamma discrimination capability, and simultaneously has ultrahigh fast component decay time, excellent light output and energy resolution; as a scintillation material for neutron detection, the overall performance is obviously superior to that of a commercial CLYC-Ce scintillation material.

title_en: EB (Electron Beam) cured coating process and EB cured coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coatings, in particular to an EB (Electron Beam) cured coating process and an EB cured coating thereof, wherein the EB cured coating process comprises the following steps: (1) inorganic board on-line; (2) sanding with fixed thickness; (3) rolling and coating penetrating primer; (4) leveling on 8-20 m infrared flow leveling equipment; (5) forward and reverse roller coating sanding priming paint; (6) entering EB curing equipment; (7) EB curing; (8) discharging EB curing equipment; and (9) sanding. The method solves the problem that the decorative layer is easily layered with the inorganic board due to the unqualified surface strength of the inorganic board substrate by optimizing and selecting the proper light-cured resin and the proper active monomer and a specific coating process, simplifies the production process, reduces the cost and the emission of industrial pollutants, does not contain a photoinitiator, has the odor-free paint film and is environment-friendly; the roller coating equipment is convenient to use for full-automatic coating construction, and the paint can be recycled.

title_en: Light-emitting element, light-emitting device, electronic device, lighting device, and novel organic compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light-emitting element, a light-emitting device, an electronic device, a lighting device, and a novel organic compound. One embodiment of the present invention is a light-emitting element including an EL layer between a pair of electrodes. The EL layer includes a first compound and a second compound. The first compound is a phosphorescent iridium metal complex having a LUMO level of-3.5 eV or more and-2.5 eV or less, and the second compound is an organic compound including a pyrimidine skeleton. In addition, another embodiment of the present invention is a light-emitting element including an EL layer between a pair of electrodes. The EL layer includes a first compound and a second compound. The first compound is a phosphorescent iridium metal complex including a diazine skeleton, and the second compound is an organic compound including a pyrimidine skeleton.

title_en: Method for promoting quick incense formation of Kyara
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for promoting quick agilawood formation of Kyara, which relates to the technical field of agilawood formation and comprises the following steps: selecting high-quality Qinan eaglewood trees which grow for 3-5 years, have luxuriant leaves, no diseases and have the diameter at breast height of more than 12cm in 9-10 months; applying an organic fertilizer to each Qinan eaglewood tree 2 months before fragrance promotion, ditching and applying fertilizer to the projection edge of the crown, covering a substrate on the fertilizer and compacting after application, and spraying a nutrient solution to the Qinan eaglewood trees every two days; selecting hole positions above the diameter of the chest of the aquilaria sinensis tree, and drilling holes at the position 15-25cm away from the ground at the base of the trunk; the incense forming agent is led into the hole, the nursing liquid is smeared at the orifice, the incense forming agent is led in once every 20-40 days, and the nursing liquid is smeared at the orifice once every 40-60 days.

title_en: Photo-thermal actuating film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photo-thermal actuating film and a preparation method and application thereof. The photothermal actuation film material is of a double-layer structure in composition, the total thickness is 35-50 mu m, in the thickness direction of the film, the range from one surface of the film to the thickness of 15-25 mu m is composed of high molecular polymers, the rest thickness range is composed of the high molecular polymers and photothermal fillers uniformly dispersed in the high molecular polymers, the mass ratio of the high molecular polymers to the photothermal fillers is (70-97): 3-30), the high molecular polymers have high thermal expansion coefficients, and the photothermal fillers have low thermal expansion coefficients. The photo-thermal actuating film mechanism is simple, easy to prepare and high in response speed, and can be used in the fields of flexible robots, bionic systems and the like.

title_en: High-extrusion low-oil-permeability single-component heat-conducting gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-extrusion low-permeability oil single-component heat-conducting gel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-extrusion low-permeability oil single-component heat-conducting gel is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 1-10% of vinyl silicone oil, 0.001-2% of chain extender, 0.00001-1% of cross-linking agent, 0.00001-0.1% of inhibitor, 0.00001-0.1% of platinum catalyst, 0-2% of dye, 0.2-20% of surface-treated boron nitride, 10-90% of alumina and 0-60% of zinc oxide. The preparation method of the high-extrusion low-permeability oil single-component heat-conducting gel comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing vinyl silicone oil, a chain extender, a cross-linking agent, an inhibitor and a platinum catalyst according to the proportion, reacting for 2-4 hours at 125-135 ℃, and then cooling to room temperature to obtain a premix; and sequentially adding dye, aluminum oxide, zinc oxide and surface-treated boron nitride into the premix, and stirring and uniformly mixing to obtain the high-extrusion low-permeability oil single-component heat-conducting gel. The heat-conducting gel has the effects of high extrusion rate and low oil permeability.

title_en: High-toughness high-thermal-stability flame-retardant electronic packaging adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-toughness high-thermal-stability flame-retardant electronic packaging adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The electronic packaging adhesive prepared by the invention has the advantages of high toughness, high thermal stability, high flame retardance, good cohesiveness, safety and environmental protection after solidification, and the product provided by the invention has a simple formula and a simple production process, and is suitable for packaging and protecting various high-power electronic devices under high-voltage direct-current working conditions.

title_en: Tobacco essence suitable for heating non-combustible tobacco products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tobacco essence suitable for heating non-combustible tobacco products, which comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 3 to 6 percent of Barbary dry tobacco extract, 3 to 5 percent of Quercus salicina wood chip extract, 3 to 5 percent of Virginia cedarwood oil, 3 to 5 percent of ku-ban-xiang oil, 3 to 5 percent of walnut shell extract, 2.4 to 3.6 percent of flavoring agent, 3 to 6 percent of sea cable oil, 2 to 6 percent of sensitive plant oil, 1 to 5 percent of yellow sunflower seed oil, 1 to 3 percent of Lv-kangcheng oil, 3 to 6 percent of German chamomile oil, 3 to 6 percent of Morocco jasmine extract and 45 to 60 percent of cosolvent. The tobacco essence can increase tobacco fragrance, has unique fragrance, has better harmony and permeability, improves comfort, and improves quality defects of insufficient fragrance, poor taste and the like of tobacco products in China, thereby having good practical production significance and economic value; the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the preparation process is simple.

title_en: Preparation method of ratio type fluorescent probe for detecting nucleic acid amplification product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ratio type fluorescent probe for detecting a nucleic acid amplification product, which comprises the following steps: 1) Synthesizing carbon quantum dots by adopting raw materials comprising aminosalicylic acid, 5,10,15, 20-tetra (4-hydroxyphenyl) porphyrin and 4-mercaptophenylboronic acid through a hydrothermal method; 2) Preparing a ratio-type fluorescent carbon dot complex: 3) Preparing carboxyl polystyrene microspheres; 4) And (3) modifying the ratio type fluorescent carbon dot complex obtained in the step (2) onto the carboxyl polystyrene microsphere obtained in the step (3) to obtain the ratio type fluorescent probe. The invention prepares the ratio type fluorescent carbon dot complex with double fluorescent emission, and then modifies the complex to carboxyl polystyrene microsphere to construct the ratio type fluorescent probe for detecting the nucleic acid amplification product, thereby realizing high-sensitivity and high-accuracy detection of the nucleic acid amplification product.

title_en: Compound, liquid crystal composition, cured product and film
abstract_en: The compound of the present invention has a structure a represented by the following a and a structure B represented by the following B in a molecule, and has 2 or more structures B in a molecule. A: has at least 1 or more aromatic ring structures, and the total number of pi electrons of the aromatic ring structures in the molecule is 8 or more. However, the arylamine structure represented by the specified structural formula is excluded. B: a fluorine-containing terminal structure represented by a predetermined structural formula.

title_en: Preparation method of low-oxygen and high-stripping graphene oxide and application of obtained product
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of low-oxygen and high-peel graphene oxide and application of an obtained product, and belongs to the technical field of graphene preparation, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Mixing expanded graphite, ethanol and water, and shearing and dispersing the obtained mixture; 2) Homogenizing, filtering, drying and pulverizing; 3) Mixing graphite sheet material with concentrated sulfuric acid, performing ultrasonic treatment, adding potassium permanganate, and performing ultrasonic treatment for 0.1-0.5 h at a temperature lower than 10 ℃ to obtain a material to be reacted; 4) Heating the material to be reacted to 30 ℃ for reaction for 2 hours, continuously heating to 40 ℃ for reaction for 1.5 hours, and continuously heating to 50 ℃ for reaction for 1 hour; 5) Separating concentrated sulfuric acid, washing with water, and filtering; 6) Acid washing and filtering to obtain a solid material after acid washing; 7) Homogenizing to obtain graphene oxide with low oxygen content and high peeling. The product prepared by the method has low oxidation degree, good dispersibility and more environmental protection.

title_en: Sound-insulation texture coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional coatings, and particularly discloses a sound-insulation texture coating and a preparation method thereof. The sound-proof texture coating comprises base paint and sound-proof filler, wherein: the preparation raw materials of the base paint comprise silicone-acrylic emulsion; the sound insulation filler comprises modified ethylene propylene diene monomer, sepiolite and vermiculite; the modified ethylene propylene diene monomer comprises zinc methacrylate, methacrylate alkoxy phosphate and triallyl cyanurate as modified raw materials. The modified ethylene propylene diene monomer can not only improve the mechanical property of the ethylene propylene diene monomer, but also improve the compatibility of the sound insulation filler and the base paint and the adhesive force to the base material, thereby realizing excellent sound insulation effect, effectively improving the adhesive force of the sound insulation texture coating to the base material and reducing the falling off and cracking of the coating after construction. The standard bonding strength of the sound insulation texture coating and the base material is 0.82-1.2MPa, and no crack exists after initial drying for 3 hours; the weighting impact sound pressure level improvement amount DeltaLw is 26-28dB.

title_en: One-dimensional SiO2-TiO2-Eu3+ luminous and photocatalytic dual-functional composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a one-dimensional SiO  2  ‑TiO  2  ‑Eu  3+  A luminescent and photocatalytic dual-function composite material and a preparation method and application thereof relate to the technical field of photocatalytic materials. The invention mixes tetraethyl orthosilicate, glacial acetic acid and ethanol to obtain SiO  2  Precursor solution; mixing tetrabutyl titanate, europium nitrate and ethanol to obtain TiO  2  Precursor solution; mixing the two precursor solutions with polyvinylpyrrolidone, performing hydrolysis condensation reaction, and performing electrostatic spinning to obtain the final product containing polyvinylpyrrolidoneSiO  2  ‑TiO  2  ‑Eu  3+  A composite fiber membrane; calcining the composite fiber membrane to obtain one-dimensional SiO  2  ‑TiO  2  ‑Eu  3+  A luminescent and photocatalytic dual-function composite material. The invention successfully prepares the one-dimensional SiO  2  ‑TiO  2  ‑Eu  3+  The luminescent and photocatalytic dual-function composite material has simple process and easy operation; and the obtained composite material has excellent photocatalytic performance and luminescent performance.

title_en: Coating film and coated article based on same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating film and a coated article based on the coating film, wherein the coating film comprises a fire extinguishing agent microcapsule which breaks after being exposed to the temperature of not lower than 75 ℃ and/or an open fire environment and can be vaporized to release fire extinguishing materials to achieve the purposes of low temperature and/or fire prevention and/or fire extinguishing. In order to overcome the current situation that the traditional fireproof, fire-extinguishing and flame-retardant coating can only prevent the spread of a fire area but is difficult to sensitively and actively extinguish the fire in a short time, the coating and/or the coating film which can actively cool down, prevent the fire and extinguish the fire and has short response time, fire-extinguishing components stably exist in the coating and/or the coating film and can repeatedly trigger the fire to extinguish the fire are provided.

title_en: High-temperature-aging-resistant organic silicon pouring sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an addition type organic silicon pouring sealant with high temperature aging resistance, which comprises a component A and a component B; the component A comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by weight: 20 to 30 portions of premix, 45 to 65 portions of vinyl silicone oil, 1 to 3 portions of tackifier, 0.1 to 2 portions of catalyst and 15 to 25 portions of heat conducting agent; the component B comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by weight: 8 to 15 portions of premix, 40 to 50 portions of vinyl silicone oil, 10 to 20 portions of hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 8 to 15 portions of flame retardant, 0.05 to 0.5 portion of inhibitor and 10 to 20 portions of heat conducting agent; the premix comprises the following preparation raw materials in parts by weight: 20 to 35 portions of vinyl silicone oil, 65 to 75 portions of silicon micropowder and 0.6 to 1.2 portions of coupling agent. The organic silicon pouring sealant prepared by selecting the specific raw materials has stronger adhesion and excellent cold and heat aging resistance.

title_en: Optical silica gel OCA (optical clear adhesive) film for attaching reflecting sheet and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical silica gel OCA adhesive film for attaching a reflector plate, which comprises a heavy release film layer, a silica gel OCA adhesive film layer and a light release film layer which are sequentially attached; the main component of the silica gel OCA film layer is silica gel OCA, and the silica gel OCA comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-100 parts of vinyl silicone oil; 0.5-5 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil cross-linking agent; 0.5-5 parts of platinum catalyst; 0.1-2 parts of alkynol inhibitor; 50-300 parts of solvent. The invention also relates to a preparation process of the adhesive film. The adhesive film prepared by the silica gel OCA component can replace the traditional acrylic OCA adhesive film, and has higher viscosity than the conventional silica gel OCA adhesive film.

title_en: Liquid crystal composition containing polymerizable compound and liquid crystal display element using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal composition containing a polymerizable compound and a liquid crystal display element using the same, wherein the liquid crystal composition containing the polymerizable compound can provide a liquid crystal display element with low residual monomer content, low Voltage Holding Ratio (VHR), pretilt angle formation and good low-temperature storage property. A liquid crystal composition containing a polymerizable compound, which contains one or two or more polymerizable compounds represented by the general formula (i), one or two or more sensitizer compounds, and one or two or more liquid crystal compounds, and a liquid crystal display element using the same.

title_en: Catalyst for producing gasoline and low-carbon olefin by heavy oil catalytic cracking and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A catalyst for producing gasoline and low-carbon olefin by heavy oil catalytic cracking, a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst contains carrier 30-79 wt%, phosphorus-containing and metal core-shell type molecular sieve 5-15 wt%, 15-45 wt% of Y-type molecular sieve, 1-10 wt% of molecular sieve with pore opening diameter of 0.65-0.70 nm; wherein, the core phase of the phosphorus-containing and metal core-shell type molecular sieve is ZSM-5 molecular sieve, and the shell layer is beta molecular sieve which is a mixture of  27  In AlMASNMR, the ratio of the peak area of resonance signal with chemical shift of 39 + -3 ppm to the peak area of resonance signal with chemical shift of 54 + -3 ppm is 0.01-infinity: 1, and the total specific surface area is more than 420m  2  (ii) in terms of/g. The preparation method comprises the steps of forming slurry which comprises a carrier, a phosphorus-containing and metal core-shell type molecular sieve, a Y-type molecular sieve, a molecular sieve with a pore opening diameter of 0.65-0.70 nanometer and water, and carrying out spray drying. The catalyst is used for heavy oil conversion, and has higher conversion rate and gasoline and low-carbon olefin yield.

title_en: Large condensed ring organic compound, application thereof and organic electroluminescent device comprising large condensed ring organic compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large condensed ring organic compound, belongs to the technical field of organic luminescent materials, and also relates to application of the compound and an organic electroluminescent device containing the compound. The organic compound has a structure shown in a formula (1). The compound of the invention takes indolophenylfuran or indolophenylthiophene as a parent nucleus and contains an arylamine structure, has good transmission performance and stability, and is applied to organicWhen the electroluminescent device is used, the material is suitable for being used as a luminescent main body material, and the service life of the device can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Durable PID (potential induced degradation) resistant packaging adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a durable PID (potential induced degradation) resistant packaging adhesive film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of hot melt adhesives. When the durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film is prepared, p-vinylphenyl dichlorophosphate is prepared by reacting p-hydroxystyrene with phosphorus oxychloride, and modified nano-alumina is prepared by reacting nano-alumina with p-vinylphenyl dichlorophosphate and bisphenol A after reacting with p-hydroxyphenyltriethoxysilane; reacting ammonia methanol solution with methyl acrylate to prepare a prepolymer, and reacting the prepolymer, p-amino styrene and ethylenediamine to prepare modified hyperbranched polyamide; mixing, melting and extruding the ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, the modified nano aluminum oxide, the modified hyperbranched polyamide, the mixed additive and the crosslinking assistant, and preparing the durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film through casting molding, surface embossing, cooling, traction, slitting and rolling. The durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film prepared by the invention has excellent flame retardant property, mildew resistance and stripping resistance.

title_en: Pouring sealant for photovoltaic module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of IPC (International patent Classification) C09J183/07, in particular to a pouring sealant for a photovoltaic module and a preparation method thereof. The pouring sealant for the photovoltaic module comprises a component A and a component B; the component A at least comprises: polysiloxanes, silicone oils; the component B at least comprises: silicone oil, organic tin salt, assistant, silicate ester and nano filler. The pouring sealant prepared by the application has good cohesiveness and thermal conductivity, effectively reduces the half-gel phenomenon of the pouring sealant, has excellent yellowing resistance and water vapor resistance, is suitable for popularization in the field of electronic element processing, and has a wide development prospect.

title_en: Single-component elastic binder for rock plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of C09J binders, and in particular provides a single-component elastic binder for a rock plate and a preparation method thereof. The application uses the alkoxy end-sealing silicon-containing linear polymers with different viscosities, reasonably compounds the linear polymers, and performs synergistic effect with substances such as diphenyl isophthalate, vinyl triethoxysilane, gamma-chloropropyl trichlorosilane and the like, and the prepared adhesive has excellent tensile elongation at break, bonding strength and high temperature resistance, and has profound significance in the field of rock plate splicing.

title_en: Adhesive sheet for display and display comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an adhesive sheet for a display, which comprises an optically transparent adhesive film as a cured product of an adhesive composition comprising an acrylic resin, an ultraviolet initiator and a post-curing crosslinking agent, wherein the post-curing crosslinking agent comprises vinyl cinnamate, and thereby the display can be bonded excellently even in a portion where a height difference or a bending occurs, without causing a warpage phenomenon.
