title_en: Antirust agent composition, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rust inhibitor composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the rust inhibitor composition comprises the following components in percentage by mass based on the total mass of the rust inhibitor composition: 20 to 50 percent of alkenyl succinic acid; 15 to 45 percent of alkenyl succinic acid half ester; 15% -45% of gemini imidazoline; 0 to 50 percent of base oil; wherein the alkylene group in the alkylene succinic acid has 2-20 carbons, the alkylene group in the alkylene succinic acid half ester has 2-20 carbons, and the gemini imidazoline has a structure shown as the following formula I: R  1  、R  2  independently selected from hydrocarbon groups of 10 to 21 carbons. The antirust agent composition has good oil solubility, small dosage, excellent antirust performance and low acid value, and can be used for preparing various industrial lubricating oil products and antirust grease.

title_en: UV ink-jet ink containing metal special-effect pigment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses UV (ultraviolet) ink-jet ink containing metal-effect pigments, which comprises the following components: at least one hyperbranched acrylate having a functionality in the range of from 6 to 20; at least one monofunctional (meth) acrylate monomer; at least one photoinitiator; a metallic special-effect pigment, wherein the metallic special-effect pigment is d more than 450nm  50  ＜1μm、d   98  Pigment with the diameter-thickness ratio of not more than 1 mu m and not more than 15 and not more than 50; a difunctional (meth) acrylate monomer. The PVD metal pigment with smaller particle size (less than or equal to 1 mu m) is adopted to prevent the ink-jet printing head from being blocked, the pigment has large diameter-thickness ratio, the pigment is favorably paved in an ink film, the influence of light diffuse reflection accumulated by the pigment is eliminated, and high-functional (F is more than or equal to 6) photocuring hyperbranched (methyl) acrylic resin is adopted to be compatible with the commonly used monofunctional monomer and bifunctional monomer, so that the printed product has better metal effect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of compound microbial fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite microbial agent which contains two or more of Siamese bacillus, eastern acetic acid bacteria, streptomyces bifidus, streptomyces forensic and Trichoderma asperellum, and also provides a composite microbial fertilizer and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention combines different functional microorganisms to form the composite microbial agent, has good prevention and control effects on banana wilt, can promote banana seedling growth, recover soil microorganism ecology damaged by pathogenic bacteria and the like, can obtain the efficient, stable and community diversity-rich composite microbial fertilizer after fermentation, can well colonize soil, synergistically promote growth and propagation of soil probiotics and antagonistic bacteria, increase the diversity of soil microorganisms, further inhibit growth and propagation of pathogenic microorganisms in the soil, optimize community structure of the soil microorganisms and influence dominant population of the soil microorganisms.

title_en: Chamfering method of MLCC
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chamfering method of an MLCC (multilayer ceramic chip carrier), which comprises the following steps of: s100: preparing an MLCC sintered green body; s101: mixing and chamfering a first grinding medium and a nonionic surfactant type cleaning agent with the MLCC sintered green body to obtain a first MLCC chamfered body, wherein the nonionic surfactant type cleaning agent has lipophilicity and hydrophilicity; s102: cleaning the first MLCC chamfer blank by using pure water, and then drying; s103: mixing and chamfering a second grinding medium, a modifier and the first MLCC chamfering blank subjected to the step S102 to obtain a second MLCC chamfering blank, wherein the modifier is not oleophilic; s104: cleaning the second MLCC chamfer blank by using pure water, and then drying; s105: and (5) dipping slurry at two ends of the second MLCC chamfer blank processed in the step S104, and then drying. The chamfering method of the MLCC has the advantages of low improvement difficulty and good improvement effect.

title_en: Coating system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a coating system comprising: a lower coat layer formed from a first coating composition, and an upper coat layer formed from a second coating composition comprising effect pigments, the first coating composition and the second coating composition being cured simultaneously, wherein the upper coat layer has a dry film thickness of 3 to 12 μm, and the difference in wet film solids content between the lower coat layer and the upper coat layer is at least 20wt%. Also disclosed are substrates coated with the above coating system, and a method of coating a substrate. The method of coating a substrate may further comprise applying a varnish composition over at least a portion of the topcoat to form a varnish layer.

title_en: Amino functionalized graphene oxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amino functionalized graphene oxide and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of pre-oxidizing graphite powder, and then adding an oxidant for reaction to obtain graphene oxide; after the graphene oxide, thionyl chloride and N, N-dimethylformamide are mixed and heated to react, adding 2-amino-4, 6-dichloropyrimidine, continuing stirring to react, and adding acetamide to react to obtain sec-amidated graphene oxide; and mixing the sec-amidated graphene oxide, methanol and sodium hydroxide, and heating for reaction to obtain the amino functionalized graphene oxide. The amino functionalized graphene oxide has good dispersion uniformity in resin, is more firmly and tightly combined with the resin, prolongs the time for corrosive media to permeate into a base material, and further enhances the long-acting corrosion resistance of the resin. The band gap width of the amino modified graphene oxide is increased, so that the resistance of resin to photo-aging is enhanced, and the service time of the coating is prolonged.

title_en: Lubricant blends for reducing refrigerant solubility
abstract_en: The compositions, methods, systems, and applications herein are directed to lubricant blends that balance refrigerant solubility and viscosity, wherein in certain instances the lubricant blends herein help reduce the solubility of the refrigerant. A lubricant blend includes a mixture of two or more lubricant types to reduce refrigerant solubility.

title_en: Animal and plant wax refining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refining method of animal and vegetable wax, which relates to the technical field of wax refining and comprises the following steps: loading animal and vegetable wax wool wax into a chromatographic column of a siliceous mixture, eluting with lower alcohol and lower ester in sequence, collecting and combining the two eluate fractions, and distilling under reduced pressure to constant weight to obtain refined animal and vegetable wax. The product prepared by the method has high quality, low colloid content of the vegetable wax, higher clarity and transparency, good chromaticity and strong oxidation resistance; and the process is simple, the operability is strong, and the industrial amplification is easy.

title_en: Methods of making and using aqueous cotton refreshing compositions
abstract_en: There is provided a process for preparing an aqueous cotton refreshing composition for refreshing soiled cotton-containing fabrics, the process comprising: providing a liquid carrier; providing a cellulase enzyme; selecting a protectant polymer comprising: 25 to 65% by weight, based on the weight of the protectant polymer, of structural units of formula (I), wherein each R1 is independently selected from hydrogen and-CH  3  A group; and polymerization based on the protective agentFrom 35% to 75% by weight, based on the weight of the compound, of structural units of the formula (II), wherein each R  2  Is independently selected from-C  2‑3  An alkyl group and wherein each R  3  Independently selected from hydrogen and methyl groups; providing the selected protectant polymer; and combining the liquid carrier, the cellulase enzyme and the selected protectant polymer to form the aqueous cotton refreshing composition. A method of refreshing a soiled cotton-containing fabric is also provided.

title_en: Metal complex, preparation method and application thereof in photocatalysis and antibiosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal complex, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in photocatalysis antibacterial aspect, belonging to the technical field of photocatalysis material synthesis. The invention takes pyridine-2-methylamine, pyridine-2-formaldehyde and metal chloride as raw materials, prepares the metal complex by a hydrothermal method, has easily obtained raw materials, simple equipment and process, easy operation and high yield, and the obtained metal complex has good photocatalytic antibacterial activity under visible light and LED lamps, has good antibacterial activity on gram-negative bacteria such as escherichia coli and gram-positive bacteria staphylococcus aureus, has broad sterilization spectrum, and has wide practical value and application research prospect in production and life.

title_en: Water-based double-component polyurethane middle coating suitable for electrostatic spraying
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coatings and automatic coating, and relates to a water-based two-component polyurethane primer surfacer which can be suitable for electrostatic spraying and can be used for thick coating, and a preparation method thereof. The primer surfacer is composed of a component A containing water-borne acrylic polyurethane resin and a component B containing hydrophilic aliphatic polyisocyanate according to the mass ratio of 4-6:1, wherein the component A contains water-borne acrylic polyurethane dispersoid accounting for 40-50 parts of the mass of the component A, propylene glycol methyl ether accounting for 3-6 parts of the mass of the component A, a conductive regulator accounting for 0.2-0.5 part of the mass of the component A and a thickening agent accounting for 0.1-0.5 part of the mass of the component A; the component B contains 60-90 parts of hydrophilic aliphatic polyisocyanate curing agent and 10-40 parts of propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate diluent. When the paint prepared by the invention is used, a paint film has the characteristics of quick drying, weather resistance, easy polishing, high binding force for starting and stopping and the like of the waterborne acrylic polyurethane resin used as a middle paint.

title_en: Manganese ion activated germanate red fluorescent powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of luminescent materials, and discloses manganese ion activated germanate red fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof  2  B  x  GeO  y  F  z  Mn, the doped ions comprise positive monovalent alkali metal ions A, positive divalent alkaline earth metal ions B and negative monovalent fluorine ions; the positive monovalent alkali metal ions are selected from any one of lithium, sodium, potassium and cesium, the positive divalent alkaline earth metal ions are selected from any one of magnesium, calcium, strontium and barium, wherein x is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 6, y is more than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to 8, and z is more than or equal to 0.05 and less than or equal to 1.5; the content of manganese ions is less than 10 percent of the relative germanium atom number; the fluorescent powder can be effectively excited by near ultraviolet/blue light, and the preparation method of the fluorescent powder is simple and convenient to operate and is suitable for industrial large-scale production.

title_en: Special laundry detergent for sportswear and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special laundry detergent for sports clothes and a preparation method thereof, wherein the special laundry detergent for sports clothes comprises the components of a surfactant, a detergent, a photocatalyst, a suspending dispersant, a dirt anti-redeposition agent, sodium hydroxide, sodium chloride and deionized water; the surfactant comprises a combination of a nonionic surfactant and an anionic surfactant in a mass ratio of 1 (3-5). The special laundry detergent for the sports clothes, disclosed by the invention, is simple in preparation method, can continuously and effectively kill and decompose bacteria and organic gas which generate peculiar smell, and thoroughly removes the peculiar smell generated by wearing the sports clothes. Meanwhile, the formula of the laundry detergent is neutral, mild and low-stimulation, and the laundry detergent can maximally care the functionality of the fabric while ensuring decontamination.

title_en: Biological deodorization system for waste gas treatment of fermentation tank for producing large organic fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment, and aims to provide a biological deodorization system for waste gas treatment of a large organic fertilizer production fermentation tank. The beneficial effects are that: according to the invention, the biomass filler filter tank is added after the spraying treatment of the spray tower, and the waste wood is used as the filler, so that the absorption principle of forest ground humus is simulated, the biomass filler filter tank can be taken out after being used for 3-5 years and used as an organic fertilizer raw material, secondary pollution is avoided, and meanwhile, the filler is easy to obtain and low in cost, the filter tank is simple in structure, low in investment and maintenance cost, and has good economic benefits and wide market prospects.

title_en: Azobenzene polymer supramolecular assembly with controllable chirality and chiral regulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polymer synthesis, and relates to an azobenzene polymer supramolecular assembly with controllable chirality and a chiral regulation and control method thereof. The azobenzene polymer supermolecule assembly is obtained by carrying out supermolecule chiral assembly on a chiral side chain type azobenzene polymer in a mixed system of a good solvent and a poor solvent; the chiral side chain type azobenzene polymer is PAzo-L-m or PAzo-D-m and is obtained by RAFT polymerization of a chiral azobenzene monomer, wherein m refers to the distance between a chiral center and azobenzene and is an integer of 3 or 6-16. The azobenzene polymer supermolecule assembly can realize the change of the spiral direction and the chiral signal intensity of the polymer assembly by adjusting the odd-even alternate change of the distance from the chiral center to azobenzene, and can conveniently and efficiently regulate and control the supermolecule chirality in a polymer system.

title_en: High-permeability double-component primer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-permeability double-component primer, which comprises a component A and a component B which are matched for use, wherein the mass ratio of the component A to the component B is 10:1; the component A comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 20-30% of aqueous acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous hydroxyl acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous polyurethane emulsion, 0.8-1.0% of defoamer, 1.2-1.8% of dispersant, 1.5-2.5% of matting powder, 0.1-0.2% of anti-settling auxiliary agent, 0.3-0.5% of anti-sagging auxiliary agent, 4.0-6.0% of film forming auxiliary agent, 0.6-1.2% of wetting leveling agent, 2.0-3.0% of wax auxiliary agent, 0.1-0.5% of thickener and the balance of deionized water; the component B adopts modified HDI polyisocyanate. The high-permeability double-component primer paint prepared by the invention solves the problems of poor wetting, round eyes, no third dimension and the like of a base material with smaller surface tension, meets the requirements of environmental protection standards, and can permeate open pores on various different base materials to reflect the third dimension.

title_en: Special glue for bobbin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The special glue for the bobbin is characterized by comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3 parts of hemicellulose, 9 parts of corn starch, 4 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 1 part of catalyst, 60 parts of water, 0.07 part of cross-linking agent, 11 parts of white cement, 9 parts of kaolin, 2 parts of yellow clay, 0.2 part of preservative and 0.05 part of defoaming agent. The invention also provides a preparation method of the special glue for the yarn bobbin. The special glue for the bobbin is prepared by combining polyvinyl alcohol crosslinking and corn starch gelatinization with inorganic components, is applied to the production process of bobbin paper, boxboard paper, regenerated kraft liner and other paper seeds, has good mechanical property and strong stability, and effectively improves the strength indexes such as bonding strength between paper layers, ring crush index, breaking strength and the like.

title_en: Self-suction type circulating low-pressure hydrogenation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-priming circulation low-pressure hydrogenation device, which aims at the problem of uneven mixing caused by the fact that hydrogen is driven to advance together by utilizing the advance of gas petroleum in the prior art. The invention can fully mix hydrogen and gasified petroleum in the middle box, and can monitor the hydrogen concentration in real time through the concentration detector, ensure the supply quantity and the proportion of oil gas, and improve the reaction efficiency.

title_en: Synergistic biocide composition with polyglycerol esters
abstract_en: Provided herein are disinfecting compositions having a synergistic effect of biocides with polyglycerol esters that allow for a reduction in the amount of biocides required to be effective disinfecting compositions.

title_en: Optical assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to optical assemblies comprising a Liquid Crystal (LC) medium, which can operate in the infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum. The invention also relates to the use of said LC medium in the Infrared (IR) region and to a device comprising said optical component. The invention also relates to LC media comprising one or more compounds of the formulae I, II and III The radicals and parameters which appear next have the meanings defined in claim 1 and preferably comprise one or more compounds of the formula RO Wherein the radicals and parameters are as defined in claim 2.

title_en: Hole transport material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hole transport material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the hole transport material is selected from at least one of compounds shown in a formula (A): in the formula (A), ar  1  、Ar  2  、Ar  3  、Ar  4  Each independently selected from C6-C30 substituted aryl or C6-C30 unsubstituted aryl, R  1  、R  2  Each independently selected from hydrogen, C1-C10 alkyl, C1-C10 substituted alkyl or C6-C10 aryl. The hole transport material has good thermal stability and higher HOMO energy level, and the organic electroluminescent device prepared by the hole transport material has higher efficiency, lower working voltage and longer service life.

title_en: Preparation method and use method of soil reinforcing agent based on charcoal loading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a use method of a soil reinforcing agent loaded based on biochar, belongs to the fields of solid waste resource utilization and environmental science and engineering, and relates to a soil reinforcing agent and a use method. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1. preparing fiber biochar; 2. preparing concentrated bacterial liquid; 3. soaking the fiber biochar in concentrated bacterial liquid, and drying to obtain the fiber biochar. The using method comprises the following steps: adopting different reinforcement methods according to the size and the dispersion degree of the activated carbon, dispersing the activated carbon in the soil for the particles with the size of more than 500 micrometers by adopting a mode of premixing the particles with the soil body in advance, and then pouring slurry mixed by urea, soluble calcium and nutrients; the activated carbon with the size less than 500 microns is preferably subjected to secondary grouting, namely, the substrate slurry is injected firstly, and then the activated carbon solution with the microorganisms immobilized is injected. The reinforced and modified soil can effectively avoid the distribution difference of calcium carbonate in the soil, increase the curing depth, improve the uniformity of the soil performance, and the reinforced product is non-toxic and harmless.

title_en: Microwave heating catalysis biomass gasification reaction device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass gasification equipment, in particular to a microwave heating catalytic biomass gasification reaction device, which comprises a gasification furnace body, a crushing mechanism and an air distribution mechanism, wherein the gasification furnace body comprises a feed inlet, a gasification furnace chamber, a grate and an air outlet pipe; the invention can realize automatic feeding and automatic temperature control, and can realize directional production of high-yield biomass gas by adding a catalyst in the pyrolysis reaction; the microwave heating mode has no pollution, low power consumption, fast reaction speed, high heat value of the gas, and the main components of the gas including CH, H and CH  4  CO, etc., the gas value is 20-30MJ/m  3  It can be used as gas fuel.

title_en: Food-grade white special lubricating grease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses food-grade white special lubricating grease and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lubricating grease; the food-grade white special lubricating grease comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A consists of base oil, fatty acid, calcium hydroxide and titanate; the component B consists of an extreme pressure antiwear agent, an antioxidant and a solid additive. The food-grade white special lubricating grease disclosed by the invention passes food-grade authentication, has the characteristics of high temperature resistance, water resistance, mechanical shear resistance, corrosion resistance and the like, and can be applied to medical instruments, food machinery or textile machinery.

title_en: Glass wool product with low corrosion to metal and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glass wool product with low corrosion to metal and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glass wool product comprises a glass wool layer, a bottom layer and a surface layer, wherein the bottom layer and the surface layer are arranged on two surfaces of the glass wool layer; the glass wool layer comprises a plurality of glass fibers, and an electrostatic antirust filler is filled among the glass fibers and comprises perlite particles which are saturated and adsorbed with electrostatic antirust oil and a polyurethane adhesive for coating the perlite particles; the bottom layer comprises an adhesive layer which is attached to the bottom surface of the glass wool layer and can accommodate the permeation of the electrostatic rust preventive oil; the surface layer comprises a waterproof oxygen-insulating packaging layer which is attached and packaged on the outer surface of the glass surface layer, and the invention has the advantages that perlite particles adsorbed with static anti-rust oil are added into the glass wool layer as a static anti-rust filler, so that the static anti-rust oil can be continuously released to infiltrate the metal surface attached with the glass wool, and the continuous anti-rust effect is achieved.

title_en: Low-corrosivity endoscope disinfectant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-corrosivity endoscope disinfectant and a preparation method thereof, wherein the disinfectant comprises a liquid A and a liquid B, the liquid A is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 0.1 to 30 percent of novel corrosion inhibitor, 0.1 to 10 percent of auxiliary surfactant, 0.01 to 5 percent of chelating agent, 1 to 50 percent of solvent, 0.1 to 20 percent of pH regulator, 0.1 to 20 percent of auxiliary agent and deionized water, wherein the novel corrosion inhibitor is a reaction product of blocked polyether and o-phenylenediamine derivative; the solution B is a peroxyacetic acid solution with the concentration of 5 to 35wt%. The invention can play a role in protecting instruments and has good disinfection effect.

title_en: Preparation and application of organic extract of penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an organic extract of penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth, relates to the field of biotechnology, and aims to separate effective components which can not promote plant growth from the penicillium fermentation product at present. The technical scheme includes that the organic extract of the penicillium fermentation product is obtained by drying the penicillium fermentation product at a high temperature of 100 ℃, adding methanol for extraction, then extracting with ethyl acetate, and separating the ethyl acetate extract with a silica gel column. The organic extract of the penicillium fermentation product for promoting plant growth, the preparation method and the application thereof provided by the invention have the advantages of simple operation and low cost, change the penicillium fermentation product into valuable, and realize the recycling of organic waste.

title_en: Near-infrared carboxylesterase small-molecule fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carboxylesterase fluorescent probes, and discloses a near-infrared carboxylesterase small molecule fluorescent probe, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention synthesizes a small molecular fluorescent probe for detecting carboxylesterase by connecting a structure with a hydroxymethyl phenyl dimethyl carbamate group on a thionile red matrix. The fluorescent probe does not emit fluorescence due to PET effect, after the fluorescent probe reacts with carboxylesterase, the carbamate structure is hydrolyzed to release hydroxyl, further the chloro benzene ring structure is self-eliminated, and the fluorescence of the fluorescent group is restored again, so that the specific detection of the carboxylesterase is realized. The fluorescent probe is a near infrared fluorescent probe, avoids the background interference of biological macromolecules, has higher sensitivity, can detect carboxylesterase in a slightly acidic and neutral environment, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Climate response type nano herbicide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a climate response type nano herbicide and a preparation method thereof. The weather-responsive nano herbicide is mainly formed by ZIF-8 loaded bispyribac-sodium, can respond to stimulation of ultraviolet light of the sun and different pH conditions to release the coated bispyribac-sodium, and can improve the adhesion capability of leaves under the scouring action of rainwater and play a role in stronger drug property. The prepared weather response type herbicide is a novel green herbicide, has no toxicity to non-target microorganisms, plants and animals, and has a good weeding effect; the preparation method of the weather-responsive nano herbicide is characterized in that bispyribac-sodium (BIS) is directly added in the synthesis process of ZIF-8 by a one-pot method and stirred, and the synthesis process is simple. The application of the climate response type nano herbicide is that the water solution of the nano herbicide is sprayed on the surface of a plant, and the weeding effect is better than that of a bispyribac-sodium agent after the water solution is irradiated by sunlight or washed by rainwater.

title_en: Preparation method of phenanthroline carbon quantum dot polar fluorescent probe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon nano materials and the field of fluorescent probes, in particular to a preparation method of a carbon quantum dot synthesized by taking phenanthroline as a raw material, which comprises three processes of pretreatment, one-step synthesis and aftertreatment: after the phenanthroline precursor is pretreated, the phenanthroline precursor does not need to be matched with other compounds, and the carbon quantum dots with high yield can be independently prepared. The microwave one-step synthesis makes the method simpler, energy-saving and efficient. The phenanthroline-based carbon quantum dots have higher purity and better fluorescence characteristic due to post-treatment, and simultaneously have up-conversion luminescence and down-conversion luminescence, so that the phenanthroline-based carbon quantum dots are used as fluorescent probes, the fluorescence intensity and the solution polarity form a good linear relationship, and the up-conversion fluorescence mode R is adopted  2  =0.9909, down-conversion fluorescenceOptical mode R  2  ＝0.9374。

title_en: Aromatic base rubber plasticizer with high aromatic hydrocarbon content and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high aromatic base rubber plasticizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out hydrotreating reaction on solvent extract oil of naphthenic base or intermediate base vacuum distillate oil, and cutting light fraction of the obtained hydrogenated oil to obtain remaining heavy fraction as first treated oil; (2) Carrying out hydrotreating reaction on naphthenic base vacuum distillate oil, and cutting light fraction of the obtained hydrogenated oil, wherein the remaining heavy fraction is second treated oil; (3) And mixing the first treated oil and the second treated oil to obtain the aromatic rubber plasticizer with high aromatic hydrocarbon. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in process, high-value-added products are obtained from raw materials with low additional values, the source of the raw materials is expanded, the obtained rubber plasticizer has the characteristics of high viscosity, high aromatic hydrocarbon content and high yield, and A1820 or A2530 series products meeting the GB/T33322-2016 index requirements can be prepared.

title_en: Microwave calcination method based on aryl sulfonium hexafluoroantimonate noctilucent fiber
abstract_en: The invention provides a microwave calcination method based on aryl sulfonium hexafluoroantimonate noctilucent fibers, and relates to the technical field of noctilucent fiber preparation. The microwave calcination method based on the aryl sulfonium hexafluoroantimonate luminescent fiber comprises the following specific steps: step one, raw material pretreatment: firstly, putting a rare earth material and boric acid into a pulverizer for pulverization, and then putting the pulverized rare earth material and boric acid into a mixer for mixing; step two, vacuum degree adjustment: and D, pouring the raw material mixture prepared in the step I onto a crucible, then placing the crucible containing the raw material mixture into a microwave calcining furnace body, and completely pumping out the oxygen-containing gas in the microwave calcining furnace by using a vacuum pump after a furnace door is closed. Before microwave calcination, the gas in the microwave calcination furnace is vacuumized, the oxygen-containing gas is pumped out, and then the protective gas is added into the microwave calcination furnace, so that the raw material after microwave calcination is prevented from containing oxide impurities, and the purity of the raw material after microwave calcination is improved.

title_en: Lubricant for preparing copper and copper alloy and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lubricant for preparing copper and copper alloy, which is characterized in that: the lubricant comprises, by mass, 5-20% of talcum powder and/or carborundum powder, 2-5% of sodium polyacrylate, 1-5% of butyl hydroxy anisole, 1-5% of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 1-3% of dinaphthyl methane disulfonate and the balance of beef tallow. By adding talcum powder and/or carborundum, sodium polyacrylate, butyl hydroxy anisole, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, dinaphthyl methane disulfonic acid sodium and beef tallow and controlling respective addition amount, the adhesion force of lubricating oil on the surface of a copper material, the thickness and the heat dissipation of the oil film are finally realized, the wire drawing friction resistance is reduced, the surface smoothness is improved, meanwhile, the problem of surface color difference of a bar can be solved, the surface quality of the copper material is improved, and the technical effect of a mirror surface is finally realized.

title_en: Water-based coating liquid, preparation method thereof and gas barrier film
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aqueous coating liquid, a preparation method thereof and a gas barrier film. The aqueous coating liquid comprises 100 parts by weight of water-soluble polymer, 10-150 parts by weight of siloxane hydrolysate and nano oxide, 0.1-20 parts by weight of first cross-linking agent, 0.1-10 parts by weight of second cross-linking agent and 1000-12000 parts by weight of solvent, wherein the first cross-linking agent comprises a covalent cross-linking agent, and the second cross-linking agent comprises a dynamic cross-linking agent. The aqueous coating liquid has the advantages of good stability, strong coatability and environmental friendliness, and the formed coating has excellent gas barrier capability and stable gas barrier performance, and the interlayer stripping force and the barrier performance are not obviously deteriorated after being subjected to continuous mechanical deformation, pressure cooking and other external effects.

title_en: Hot-melt cloth-based double-sided adhesive tape and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot-melt cloth-based double-sided adhesive tape and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hot-melt cloth-based double-sided adhesive tape comprises a release paper layer, an adhesive B layer, a laminating layer, cloth-based gauze and an adhesive A layer which are sequentially arranged, the laminating layer is a mixed-melting casting layer of an LDPE/HDPE blend, and the mass ratio of LDPE particles to HDPE particles in the LDPE/HDPE blend is 1:1, the coating amount of the PE-coated layer on the cloth-based gauze is 10-40g per square meter. According to the invention, by optimizing the structure of the adhesive tape and the composition of the adhesive, the problems of poor gluing controllability and low bonding strength caused by the cloth-based base material are effectively improved, so that the quality of the product is greatly improved.

title_en: Water lubricating material surface structure based on bionic hydrophilic principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water lubricating material surface structure based on a bionic hydrophilic principle, and solves the problem that the lubricating performance of the existing water lubricating material is to be further improved under the limit working condition. The surface structure of the water lubricating material comprises a substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a bionic smooth structure-enhanced hydrophilic surface. The water-lubricated material has the advantages of simple structure, easy production and manufacture, low cost and capability of effectively improving the good water-lubricated effect of the water-lubricated material under the severe working conditions.

title_en: Velvet down jacket care washing liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a velvet down jacket nursing washing liquid and a preparation method thereof. The washing liquid comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 5-6% of glutamine, 1-5% of sodium citrate, 2-4% of polyisobutylene, 5-9% of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, 4-6% of ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid, 5-9% of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 4-7% of sodium sulfite heptahydrate, 3-5% of sodium carbonate, 5-8% of propylene glycol, 5-9% of ethylene glycol monobutyl ether acetate, 2-4% of glycerol, 3-6% of an emulsifier, 3-6% of a cross-linking agent, 1-2% of a softening agent and 0.1-0.2% of essence; the cleaning solution extracts the active ingredients of mistletoe, and is mixed with the common down coat cleaning solution to prepare the cleaning solution with the sterilization effect, so that fungi and bacteria on the down coat can be effectively killed, and the propagation of the fungi and the bacteria is inhibited, thereby reducing the number of the bacteria on the down coat, and ensuring that the fungi and the bacteria on the down coat cannot harm the human health.

title_en: Pyrazole compound, energetic ionic salt thereof and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention designs and synthesizes a pyrazole compound, and an energetic ion salt and a preparation method thereof, wherein the 3-amino-4- (4, 5-diamino-1, 2, 4-triazole-3-yl) pyrazole ion salt has higher density, better oxygen balance, lower sensitivity and high decomposition temperature basically higher than 240 ℃ through DSC test; the synthesis method has the advantages of safe and reasonable process, short reaction time, mild reaction condition, higher yield, low production cost, basically no three wastes and environmental friendliness; the 3-amino-4- (4, 5-diamino-1, 2, 4-triazole-3-yl) pyrazole energetic ionic salt has good thermal stability, lower impact sensitivity and excellent detonation performance, and can be applied to energetic materials such as explosives, propellants, pyrotechnic technology and the like.

title_en: Polymerization-induced luminescence type non-traditional intrinsic luminescence polymer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymerization-induced luminescence type non-traditional intrinsic luminescence polymer and application thereof. The polymer of the invention has the advantages that the monomer does not emit light, but the polymer emits bright green light in a solid state, the detection of the polymer on explosives can reach ppm level, and the fluorescence enhancement on commercial dyes can be realized. The invention also provides a preparation method of the non-traditional intrinsic luminescent polymer with polymerization-induced luminescence property, and the method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple and convenient operation, mild condition and high conversion rate. The polymerization-induced luminescence property of the polymer can avoid the problem of luminescence monomer pollution in practical application, greatly widens the application of the polymer in the field of fluorescence detection, has high sensitivity to explosive detection and has remarkable enhancement effect on the fluorescence of commercial dyes.

title_en: Protective material for silicon wafer cutting and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a protective material for silicon wafer cutting and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of wafer cutting protection. The protective material for silicon wafer cutting comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-40 parts of water-soluble resin, 0.5-1 part of carbon nano tube, 7-12 parts of aromatic carboxylic anhydride, 3-8 parts of long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid, 0.2-1 part of wetting agent, 0.1-1 part of defoamer, 10-20 parts of organic solvent and 40-60 parts of water. The protective material for silicon wafer cutting can rapidly form a film on the surface of a wafer, has high strength after film formation, has good heat resistance, can effectively prevent condensed silicon vapor or other scraps generated in the processing process from being deposited on the surface of a chip during wafer processing, improves the quality and reliability of products, and has good film removing property.

title_en: Acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of C09J151/00, in particular to acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The pressure-sensitive acrylate adhesive is prepared with acrylic acid and its derivative 13-23 weight portions, elastomer 10-20 weight portions, solvent 12-18 weight portions, initiator 0.1-0.5 weight portions, and emulsifier 2-3.5 weight portions. According to the invention, by adopting the elastomer, the prepared acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive has excellent tensile strength and tear strength and good wetting property. According to the invention, the elastomer is matched with acrylic acid and derivatives thereof, so that the prepared acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive has excellent wetting capacity on non-polar materials, and can meet the requirement of high-speed automatic labeling of a machine.

title_en: Multifunctional super-bright carbon dot with endoplasmic reticulum targeting capability and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional super-bright carbon dot with endoplasmic reticulum targeting capability, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the carbon dot comprises the following components in a molar ratio of 1:0.5 to 1:2, and cysteine. The carbon dot is prepared from the manglared and the cysteine through magnetic stirring and a one-step hydrothermal method, can realize endoplasmic reticulum specific imaging of living cells, is simple to prepare, and has the advantages of high quantum yield, high biological safety, fluorescence emission independent of excitation wavelength, narrow fluorescence emission peak width and the like. In addition, the carbon dots can also be used for bacterial gram negative and positive differentiation and fungal imaging.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant organic silicon crosslinked starch fluid loss agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-temperature-resistant organic silicon crosslinked starch fluid loss additive, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention prepares organosilicon cross-linking agent with double bond and epoxy group; and then adding an acrylamide monomer, an anionic monomer, a cationic monomer and an organosilicon cross-linking agent into the gelatinized starch solution to perform free radical polymerization reaction, thereby preparing the high-temperature resistant organosilicon cross-linked starch fluid loss additive. The organic silicon cross-linking agent serves as a common chemical cross-linking point of the ethylene copolymer and the starch, so that the temperature resistance of the modified starch fluid loss agent is enhanced; the acrylamide monomer enables the filtrate reducer to have excellent gel protection capability; the introduction of the anionic monomer enhances the temperature hydration resistance of the polymer; the introduction of the cationic monomer significantly reduces the fluid loss. The high-temperature resistant organic silicon crosslinked starch fluid loss additive prepared by the invention still has excellent fluid loss performance after aging at high temperature (200 ℃), and the constructed high-temperature resistant environment-friendly drilling fluid system has good comprehensive performance.

title_en: Solid wood composite wood floor and production method thereof
abstract_en: The solid wood composite wood floor comprises a base material layer (1), a bulk pore material layer (2), a heat insulation expansion flame-retardant layer (3), a melamine formaldehyde resin impregnated paper curing flame-retardant layer (4), a decorative wood panel layer (5), an UV flame-retardant primer layer (6) and an UV finish paint curing layer (7); coating heat-insulating expanded flame-retardant coating on the surfaces of the scattered pore materials of the base material and scattered pore material combination, paving melamine formaldehyde resin impregnated paper above a gluing layer, uniformly spraying 18-34 v% of ethanol aqueous solution on the melamine formaldehyde resin impregnated paper, arranging and soaking an ammonium polyphosphate decorative wood panel, sending the panel into a cold press for prepressing, sending the panel into a hot press, keeping the panel at the temperature of 130-140 ℃ and the pressure of 1.2-2.0 MPa for 5-7 min, taking out and cooling, sawing and sanding the panel to form a floor specification plate blank, coating water-based or oil-based pigment or dye on the upper surface of the floor specification plate blank, coating UV paint on the upper surface of the floor specification plate blank, and drying the floor specification plate blank to obtain the solid wood composite wood floor.

title_en: Coal blending and coal blending method for entrained flow coal gasification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal gasification, in particular to coal blending and a coal blending method for entrained flow coal gasification, wherein the coal blending is obtained by blending at least two basic coals, ash content of the coal blending is 5wt% < A  d  <20wt%, a <18wt%, 1<b/c <10, 1< (b+c)/(a+d) <5, wherein a is the weight content of Fe  2 O 3  in ash of the coal blending, b is the weight content of SiO  2  in ash of the coal blending, c is the weight content of Al  2 O 3  in ash of the coal blending, and d is the weight content of CaO in ash of the coal blending. The invention restricts the property parameters of the coal blending within a specific range, so that the coal blending can be used for the entrained-flow gasifier, and has remarkable practical significance for guaranteeing the stable, efficient and economic operation of the entrained-flow gasifier.

title_en: Compost fermenting installation is used in organic fertilizer production
abstract_en: The application discloses be applied to compost fermenting installation for organic fertilizer production in organic fertilizer production field, this compost fermenting installation is through installing mutually perpendicular's organic fertilizer silo and microorganism shower below position department at the feed barrel for the feed barrel is rotatory in-process under can driving organic fertilizer silo and microorganism shower synchronous rotation, with organic fertilizer and microorganism layer by layer encircle the inside of laying at the fermentation cylinder body, be favorable to forming the compost mode of one deck organic fertilizer one deck microorganism, the contact comprehensiveness of microorganism and organic fertilizer has been promoted effectively, and then effectively promote the treatment effeciency of microorganism to the organic fertilizer in the compost fermentation process, avoid organic fertilizer and microorganism contact inhomogeneous in the organic fertilizer production process, the compost fermentation efficiency of the device to the organic fertilizer has been promoted to a certain extent.

title_en: High-viscosity powder coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-viscosity powder coating, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of powder coatings. The high-viscosity powder coating comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-60 parts of modified epoxy resin; 2-3 parts of polar curing agent; 0.1-0.5 part of catalyst; 0.5-1 part of brightening agent; 0.2-0.5 part of benzoin; 0.5-1 part of pigment; 20-50 parts of filler; wherein the modified epoxy resin is prepared by reacting bisphenol A type epoxy resin with high-surface Zhang Lila and high-hydroxyl cellulose. The high-adhesion powder coating can be applied to the brake pad backboard, can not only ensure the requirements of salt mist resistance, engine oil resistance and the like of the brake pad backboard, but also enable the silencing sheet not to fall off easily, and has excellent development prospect.

title_en: Detergent builder composition and detergent gel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of daily chemicals and provides a detergent synergistic composition, a detergent and detergent gel beads. The soil release enhancing composition comprises a surfactant, an enzyme preparation and an enhancing agent; the mass ratio of the surfactant to the synergist is 10:1-1:4; the surfactant is one or more of fatty alcohol polyoxyethylene ether and fatty alcohol polyoxyethylene-propylene ether, wherein the fatty alkyl of the fatty alcohol is saturated or unsaturated C8-C15 linear or branched alkyl; the synergist is one or more of urea, sodium bisulphite, tea polyphenols, sucrose, gallic acid, sodium silicate nonahydrate, benzoic acid, sodium sulfite, xylitol, quercetin, baicalin, sodium sulfate and polyethylene glycol 400-8000. The detergent synergistic composition can be used in most detergent formulations, and can improve the removal capacity of starch stains such as dry rice stains and the like.

title_en: Efficient anti-caking agent for water-soluble fertilizer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-soluble fertilizer efficient anti-caking agent, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of chemical fertilizer additives. The efficient anti-caking agent for the water-soluble fertilizer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 2% -20% of inorganic powder, 20% -80% of isolating agent and 5% -20% of water-soluble polymer; the release agent is a surfactant. The anti-caking agent has the characteristics of small addition amount, low cost, simple process and convenient use, and is beneficial to popularization and production; the anti-caking agent is in a powder state and has good water solubility, can be used for water-soluble fertilizers, is especially suitable for the treatment of powdery water-soluble fertilizers, has good anti-caking effect, and can ensure that the powdery water-soluble fertilizers are not caking or slightly caking after being stored for 3 months at normal temperature.

title_en: Carbon microsphere conductive coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon microsphere conductive coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the carbon microsphere conductive coating is prepared from the following components in parts by weight by taking acrylic resin emulsion as a film forming substance and taking carbon microspheres as a main conductive material: 15-30 parts of acrylic resin emulsion, 0.3-0.5 part of bentonite, 0.1-0.3 part of pH regulator, 1-4 parts of wetting agent, 1-2 parts of dispersing agent, 0.1-0.5 part of flatting agent, 0.1-0.3 part of defoamer, 0.5-1 part of antibacterial agent, 10-40 parts of carbon microsphere, 30-45 parts of filler and 8-15 parts of water. The carbon microsphere is prepared by taking resorcinol and formaldehyde as carbon sources, preparing the polymer microsphere through a hydrothermal polymerization method, and carbonizing at a high temperature to obtain a finished product.

title_en: Process method for producing naphthenic rubber filling oil by hydrogenation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process method for producing naphthenic base rubber filling oil through hydrogenation. The cycloalkyl vacuum distillate is used as raw material, first, hydrotreating-hydrodewaxing reaction is carried out, and after high-pressure steam stripping is carried out on the effluent of the hydrotreating-hydrodewaxing reaction, H  2  S, NH  3  and other impurities which have influence on the noble metal catalyst are removed, the effluent enters a deep-complement refining reaction zone, so that the stability of the oil is improved. The method can obtain a high-quality naphthenic rubber filling oil product, and simultaneously produces a high-quality special oil product, greatly reduces energy consumption caused by two-stage method of boosting, reducing, boosting, heating, reducing and heating, and has the advantages of simple process and small occupied area.

title_en: Anchor coating agent and method for manufacturing flexographic printing material using same
abstract_en: The invention provides an anchor coating agent which has proper viscosity, can inhibit the phenomenon of flying ink, can uniformly transfer required amount to a printing medium and can obtain a coating film with excellent coating film tolerance. The invention relates to an anchor coating agent comprising an emulsion, a cellulose ether and/or a polyvinyl alcohol and an aqueous medium.

title_en: Boron nitride compound, composition containing boron nitride compound and application of boron nitride compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a boron nitrogen compound, a composition containing the same and application thereof. The boron-nitrogen compound is a binuclear BN compound containing carbazole skeletons, effective red shift of BN derivative spectra can be achieved by constructing a binuclear strategy, and efficient narrow spectrum TADF emission is achieved by the organic electroluminescent device prepared from the compound and the composition thereof.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of rupestonic acid fluorescent probe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method and application of a rupestonic acid fluorescent probe, and belongs to the fields of organic synthesis technology and cell imaging. The synthesis method of the invention is that the low-cost raw material 4-di-p-toluidine benzaldehyde is subjected to two-step conversion such as Aldol condensation dehydration and carboxylic acid amidation reaction, and the like, so as to obtain the rupestonic acid fluorescent probe-compound 5- (4- (di-p-toluidine amino) benzylidene) -3- (rupestonic acid acyl) thiazolidine-2, 4-dione. Use of a rupestonic acid fluorescent probe 5- (4- (di-p-toluylamino) benzylidene) -3- (rupestonic acid acyl) thiazolidine-2, 4-dione obtained by the method in the preparation of cell imaging.

title_en: Precoated fin sheet
abstract_en: The pre-coated fin material (1) has a substrate (2) and a resin coating film (3) formed on the substrate (2). The resin coating film (3) contains a modified polyvinyl alcohol (A) having a molecular structure represented by the following general formula (1) and an acrylamide polymer (B). The content of the modified polyvinyl alcohol (A) is 0.5 to 2.0 times the content of the acrylamide polymer (B) in terms of mass ratio. Wherein R  1  in the general formula (1) is an organic group having a linear structure and having 5 to 10 carbon atoms, and m and n are positive integers satisfying the relationship of 0.005.ltoreq.n/m.ltoreq.0.025.

title_en: Bi (Bi) 3+ Cyan-doped fluorescent powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bi  3+  Cyan-doped fluorescent powder, preparation method and application thereof, and Bi  3+  The chemical formula of the doped cyan fluorescent powder is as follows: sr (Sr)  3  In  2(y‑x)  Bi  2x  (GeO  4  )  3  ，0<x is more than or equal to 0.5,1.02 and y is more than or equal to 1.05. The Bi is  3+  The matrix in the doped cyan fluorescent powder is Sr  3  In  2  (GeO  4  )  3  Belonging to garnet structure and having good chemical stability, wherein Bi  3+  Occupied is In  3+  Position, form Bi  3+  The doped fluorescent powder can be effectively excited by blue light and near ultraviolet light to generate cyan luminescence. The main peak of the fluorescence emission spectrum is positioned at 494nm and covers the range of 440-560 nm, the main peak of the excitation spectrum is positioned at 415nm and covers the range of 365-450 nm, which indicates that the fluorescent light can be excited by near ultraviolet light and blue light. The fluorescent powder has high adaptability with the current commercial near ultraviolet and blue-violet light chips, and can be widely usedUsed in the fields of solid state lighting, display, etc.

title_en: Thiabendazole cadmium metal organic complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thiabendazole cadmium metal organic complex, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of organic synthesis, wherein the complex is a thiabendazole 2,2 '-cadmium phthalate metal complex, and the chemical formula of the thiabendazole 2,2' -cadmium phthalate metal complex is Cd  2 (TBZ) 2 (DPA) 2 H 2  O. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cadmium nitrate tetrahydrate, 2-biphenyl dicarboxylic acid and thiabendazole are reacted in a mixed solvent formed by secondary deionized water and organic matters, the pH value is regulated by ammonia water, the reaction is carried out at 120-180 ℃, the reaction is cooled to room temperature, and the complex is obtained after filtration and washing. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the thiabendazole 2,2' -cadmium phthalate metal complex is simple to prepare, can detect low-concentration carbon disulfide or benzaldehyde, is simple to operate and short in detection time, and the crystal material with the three-dimensional structure can generally show high thermal stability.

title_en: Microbial preparation for preventing and treating ginger bacterial wilt, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial preparation for preventing and treating ginger bacterial wilt, which comprises compound microorganisms, compound minerals and traditional Chinese medicine extracts; the compound microorganism comprises streptomyces microflavus, streptomyces pactamus and bacillus licheniformis; the composite mineral comprises serpentine powder, dolomite powder and granite powder; the traditional Chinese medicine extract comprises dandelion, wormwood, chinese yam and chrysanthemum extracts. The microbial agent of the application shows excellent effect of preventing and treating ginger bacterial wilt by mutual cooperation of the compound microorganism, the compound mineral and the traditional Chinese medicine extract in the microbial agent through different antibacterial mechanisms; the ginger bacterial wilt prevention and treatment agent does not influence the quality safety of ginger and the quality of soil environment, is a green preparation for preventing and treating ginger bacterial wilt, and achieves better ginger bacterial wilt prevention and treatment effect under a smaller dosage; and the yield and quality of ginger can be obviously improved.

title_en: High-performance alkali-resistant yellow reactive dye and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance alkali-resistant yellow reactive dye and a preparation method thereof, wherein the yellow reactive dye is a compound shown in a structural general formula I, and X is F or Cl in the structural general formula I; m is-H or an alkali metal; the R is  1  is-H, -SO  3  M or-OCH  3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The R is  2  is-SO  2  CH  2  CH  2  OSO  3  M、–SO  2  CHCH  2  or-CONHCH  2  CH  2  SO  2  CH  2  CH  2  OSO  3  M; the R is  3  is-H or-SO  3  M; the D is selected from compounds shown in a structural general formula II or III. The reactive yellow dye provided by the invention contains a color body taking m-bis as a coupling component, a color body composition taking pyrazolone or pyridone compounds as a coupling component, 3 active groups, a plurality of water-soluble groups and a plurality of active groups of different structure types, ensures that the dye has high salt and alkali resistance stability, and overcomes the defects of the dye through the synergistic effect among a plurality of active groups of different structuresThe problem of low fixation rate of the existing reactive yellow dye is solved, and the method has wide application prospect.

title_en: Ultra-long-time near-infrared water-soluble afterglow luminous carbon dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-long-time near-infrared water-soluble afterglow luminescent carbon dot and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of fluorescent carbon nano materials. The preparation method of the near infrared water-soluble afterglow luminescent carbon dot comprises the following steps: (1) Crushing plant stems and leaves, and then soaking the crushed plant stems and leaves in an organic solvent for 1-48 hours to obtain a plant stem and leaf soaking solution; (2) Filtering the plant stem and leaf soaking solution, and performing heat treatment at 20-200deg.C for 1-24h to obtain carbon dot solution; (3) Performing chromatography on the carbon dot solution by taking dichloromethane as a drainage agent, and collecting a green solution separated out by the first layer to obtain a dichloromethane solution of the carbon dot; (4) Polyether F127 is added into the dichloromethane solution of the carbon point, water is added for ultrasonic emulsification after stirring, stirring is continued and heating is carried out to 20-70 ℃ for reaction for 1-6 hours, so as to obtain the aqueous solution of the carbon point, and the aqueous solution of the carbon point is freeze-dried, so that the ultra-long-time near infrared water-soluble afterglow luminescent carbon point which shows near infrared afterglow luminescence with the service life exceeding 4 hours in the aqueous solution is obtained.

title_en: Composite operation planting method for transformation of low-yield oil tea forests
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil tea planting, and discloses a composite operation planting method for transformation of low-yield oil tea forests. The organic fertilizer prepared by the preparation method of the organic fertilizer has high fertilizer efficiency; meanwhile, the method for estimating the oil tea forest adopts the low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, has the characteristics of flexible operation, high data acquisition efficiency, low image cost and strong timeliness, and can rapidly acquire the spatial distribution information of the oil tea forestation in the test area; compared with the traditional manual picking and weighing method, the method has the advantages of rapidness, no damage, high accuracy and large scale; the method can realize rapid detection, counting and evaluation of the oil tea transformation forest yield data.

title_en: Use of MAPK pathway inhibitors against pathogen infection
abstract_en: The invention discloses the use of MAPK pathway inhibitors against pathogen infection. In particular, the invention discloses the use of MAPK pathway inhibitors for the preparation of pharmaceutical formulations or compositions against pathogenic infection. The MAPK pathway inhibitors of the present invention are effective in controlling pathogen infection by promoting intracellular wave protein (vimentin) diffusion, thereby controlling pathogen proliferation and/or reducing pathogen numbers in host cells.

title_en: Coal water slurry processing device and method, coal water slurry processing electric control system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal water slurry processing device and a processing method, and a coal water slurry processing electric control system and a control method. The coal water slurry processing device consists of an upper coal hopper, a hammer crusher assembly, a feeder, a ball mill and an electric cabinet which are sequentially connected into a production line through a conveying belt; the hammer crusher assembly comprises a base and a crushing assembly sleeved on the base. The pulverized coal crushing particle size is controllable, the discharging is not blocked, the weighing and proportioning continuous grinding production is automatically controlled, and the processing and preparation efficiency of the coal water slurry is high.

title_en: Polyimide insulating paint material resistant to high voltage and corona and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic wire insulating paint materials, in particular to a polyimide insulating paint material with high voltage resistance and corona resistance and a preparation method thereof. The insulating paint material comprises resin and nano inorganic particles, wherein the resin contains polyimide and/or polyamide acid structures, the resin is prepared from dianhydride and diamine, the diamine comprises silane and/or siloxane containing a diamino structure and aromatic diamine, and the mass ratio of the resin to solid in the nano inorganic particles is 99:1-50:50. The invention has the advantages of excellent heat resistance, mechanical toughness, high pressure resistance and corona resistance, simple processing, excellent storage stability, high solid content and low viscosity.

title_en: Reactive red dye compound and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of textile printing and dyeing, in particular to an active red dye compound, and preparation and application thereof. The reactive red dye compound has a structure shown in a formula (I), wherein the formula (I) is as follows: r is R  1  、R  2  Selected from-SO  2  CH  2  CH  2  OSO  3  M  1  ；R  3  Selected from the group consisting of-NH- (CH)  2  )  n  ‑COOM  2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Wherein M is  1  And M  2  Independently selected from-H or a metal cation, n is an integer from 0 to 4; x is selected from Cl, br and F. Reactive red dye compounds of the present applicationBesides excellent dyeing effect and difficult color difference generation, the dye has the characteristic of no generation of cleavable cancerogenic aromatic amine.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant auxiliary agent with active corrosion resistance and passive corrosion resistance functions and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of anticorrosive paint, in particular to an anticorrosive additive with active and passive anticorrosive functions, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preservative aid comprises a two-dimensional layered material, cation exchange resin, anion exchange resin and a binder. The anti-corrosion auxiliary agent is applied to the coating, so that the anti-corrosion performance of the coating can be greatly improved, the salt spray resistance time is greatly improved, and furthermore, the mechanical performance of the coating, such as the impact resistance of the coating, can be improved when the coating is applied to the coating. The anti-corrosion auxiliary agent is suitable for various coating systems, including oil paint, water paint and powder paint systems. The preparation method adopted by the invention has low cost and high universality, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Composition containing menthanediol and application of composition in mosquito-repellent microemulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composition containing menthanediol and application thereof in mosquito repellent microemulsion, wherein the composition containing the menthanediol comprises, by mass, 2-9 parts of the menthanediol, 4-10 parts of a surfactant and 2-5 parts of a cosurfactant. Compared with the common high-content surfactant aqueous system with the stable menthanediol, the aqueous system with the stable menthanediol has clear and transparent appearance, is not sticky and greasy in use feeling, has milder components, has low manufacturing cost, low irritation and good skin feel, and has excellent practical value.

title_en: Rare earth complex material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rare earth metal material synthesis, and discloses a rare earth complex material, a preparation method and application thereof. The rare earth complex material is prepared by a volatilization method and is formed by jointly constructing rare earth (III) element, 2,3,4,5, 6-pentafluorobenzoic acid and 4, 7-dimethyl-1, 10-phenanthroline. The preparation method is simple and feasible, and is easy to operate, and precious precise instruments and equipment are not needed. The rare earth complex material has excellent fluorescence performance and can selectively identify specific Cd in specific environment  2+  The fluorescent probe can be used for Cd  2+  And detecting Cd as a fluorescent probe  2+  The invention has the characteristics of low detection limit, strong anti-interference performance and quick response time, and the rare earth complex is used as the raw material for preparingPortable test paper sensing detection device realizes Cd  2+  Is a rapid visual inspection of (c).

title_en: Super-hydrophobic metal organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-hydrophobic metal organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal organic frameworks. The crystal appearance of the metal organic frame is connected with cashew phenol aldehyde through chemical modification, the structure of the organic ligand of the metal organic frame contains amino, and the molar ratio of the amino of the metal organic frame to the aldehyde group of the cashew phenol aldehyde is 1:1-1:5. The preparation method comprises the steps of self-assembling metal ions and organic ligands to form a metal organic frame, and then reacting cashew phenol aldehyde with the metal organic frame. The super-hydrophobic metal organic framework prepared by the invention has the performances of weakening bacterial adhesion and sterilization, is high in stability and strong in hydrophobicity, and has good application prospects in the aspects of solving gas adsorption and separation, oil-water separation and antibiosis.

title_en: Film and flexible display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a film and a flexible display device. A film comprising at least 1 polyamide imide resin, and at least 1 amine compound.

title_en: Apparatus and method for continuously activating catalyst, and Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction device and method containing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalyst activation, and discloses equipment and a method for continuously activating a catalyst, and a Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction device and a Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction method containing the equipment. The device comprises at least one catalyst storage tank, a gas-solid reactor and a purifier, wherein at least one partition plate is arranged in the gas-solid reactor, overflow ports and/or communication ports are formed in the partition plate, the gas-solid reactor is provided with at least two groups of air injection pieces, each treatment space corresponds to one group of air injection pieces, the air injection pieces are used for injecting hydrogen and/or CO into the corresponding treatment space so as to adjust the hydrogen-carbon volume ratio of activated gas in the corresponding treatment space, and the purifier is used for purifying the activated gas to obtain purified recycle gas. The equipment can finish Fischer-Tropsch catalyst activation with high quality, furthest shortens activation time, realizes continuous activation of the Fischer-Tropsch catalyst, simplifies process control difficulty and greatly improves production efficiency.

title_en: Anti-sagging water-based middle coating for automobiles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-sagging water-based middle coating for an automobile, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-12 parts of amino resin; 5-10 parts of acrylic resin; 5-10 parts of polyester resin; 1-10 parts of polyurethane resin; 1-3 parts of modified polyol; 0.01-2.2 parts of thickener; 0.1-0.8 part of wetting agent; 0.5-1.5 parts of macromolecular dispersing agent; 0.1-1 part of PH regulator; 0.1-0.5 part of defoaming agent; 1-20 parts of pigment; 10-30 parts of filler; 2-9 parts of a solvent; 10-30 parts of deionized water. The water-based intercoat can solve the problems that the technology of the automobile water-based intercoat in wet-on-wet process has great influence on the construction of products and paint film performance, and sagging, flooding and the like are often caused. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the aqueous middle coating.

title_en: Thrips attractant, method for preparing trapping core by using thrips attractant as core material and trapping and killing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thrips attractant which is prepared by mixing methyl benzoate, 3-hydroxybenzaldehyde, cis-3-hexenal, geranyl linalool and phenylacetaldehyde according to the mass ratio of (1-20): 1-10): 1-20. The invention also discloses a method for preparing the trapping core by taking the thrips attractant as a core material, which comprises the steps of dissolving the thrips attractant in normal hexane and then slowly releasing the thrips attractant in a carrier. The invention also discloses a combined trapping and killing device for thrips, which is obtained by suspending a trapping core prepared by the thrips attractant core material on a blue insect sticking plate or a yellow insect sticking plate. The thrips attractant has the advantages of simple use method, stable product performance, multiple attracting types, environmental protection and the like, greatly reduces the use amount of chemical pesticides, effectively controls the harm of thrips pests to vegetables, fruits or flowers, and opens up a new idea for the comprehensive control technology of thrips pests.

title_en: Mildew-proof method for natural rubber
abstract_en: The invention provides a mildew-proof method for natural rubber, and belongs to the field of natural rubber processing. The invention provides a natural rubber mildew-proof method, wherein the mildew-proof agent comprises one or more of isothiazolinone, 1-hydroxy-4-methyl-6- (2, 4-trimethyl amyl) -2 (1H) -pyridone ethanolamine salt and dodecyl dimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride. The mildew preventive adopted by the invention can kill and inhibit various fungi and mildew very efficiently, effectively delay or prevent the mildew phenomenon of natural rubber in the long-term storage process, prolong the shelf life of the product, and ensure that the 1-hydroxy-4-methyl-6- (2, 4-trimethyl amyl) -2 (1H) -pyridone ethanolamine salt and dodecyl dimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride material are suitable for various natural surface environments for a long time, have good weather resistance and are suitable for environments with wide pH value ranges and extremely high temperatures.

title_en: Method and device for regenerating and treating waste dechlorinating agent of blast furnace gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for regenerating a waste dechlorinating agent of blast furnace gas, wherein the method comprises the steps of deashing, purging, assaying, directly recycling the waste dechlorinating agent after assaying if the composition meets the standard, returning to the step I for continuous treatment until the composition meets the standard if the composition does not meet the standard, and sequentially connecting a waste dechlorinating agent storage bin, a waste dechlorinating agent transmission device, a vibration deashing device and a steam purging regeneration device after the waste dechlorinating agent is discharged from a dechlorinating tower, wherein the regenerated dechlorinating agent returns to the transmission device of the dechlorinating tower and a good dechlorinating agent storage bin arranged at the top of the dechlorinating tower. The invention realizes the regeneration and recycling of the waste dechlorinating agent, does not use alkali liquor, does not generate a large amount of wastewater, saves energy and reduces consumption, and has low operation cost.

title_en: Organic fertilizer for cow dung and urine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cow dung-urine organic fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of organic fertilizer preparation. According to the invention, through fermenting the padding, cow dung and urine can be mixed and fermented with the padding and microorganisms in the padding in daily life, and the mixture of the padding and the cow dung and urine is subjected to secondary fermentation, so that the effective components in the cow dung and urine and the padding are further improved. The preparation method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that cow dung and urine are not required to be treated separately, the steps are simple, the cost is low, the fertilizer organic matters of the obtained organic fertilizer can be improved to more than 80%, and the fertilizer efficiency of the organic fertilizer is obviously improved.

title_en: Luminescent material, application thereof and organic electroluminescent device comprising luminescent material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescence, in particular to an organic compound and application thereof, and an organic electroluminescent device containing the compound. The compounds of the present invention have a structure represented by the following formula (1), wherein X  1  And X  2  Are each independently NR  1  O, S or Se, ring A and ring B are each independently selected from one of a substituted or unsubstituted C6-C60 aromatic ring, a substituted or unsubstituted C3-C60 heteroaromatic ring, R  12  、R  13  Independently selected from cyano, benzonitrile, halogen substituted C1-C20 linear or branched alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted nitrogen containing heteroaryl, and the like. OLED devices prepared using the compounds of the present inventionHas low starting voltage, high luminous efficiency and better service life.
