title_en: High-performance direct-liquid type environment-friendly ink and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ink, and in particular relates to high-performance direct-liquid type environment-friendly ink and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-performance direct-liquid type environment-friendly ink comprises, by weight, 5-10 parts of edible color paste, 18-25 parts of propylene glycol, 4-6 parts of a connecting material, 0.5-2 parts of a surfactant, 0.1-0.4 part of an antibacterial agent, 0.2-0.5 part of an antirust agent, 0.5-1.5 parts of a pH neutralizer and 60-65 parts of deionized water; the connecting material is a mixed solution of polyurethane emulsion and epoxy resin emulsion with the weight ratio of 1.5-2.5:3. According to the invention, the formula is optimized, the safe and environment-friendly material is used as the raw material, the obtained ink is safe and environment-friendly to use, has no harm to human body, long storage time, good stability, dry resistance, film forming performance and leakage resistance, and can be used in a direct liquid type water pen.

title_en: Phase-change fog seal material containing phase-change material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase-change fog seal material containing a phase-change material, a preparation method and application thereof, S1, 10-100 parts of emulsified asphalt and 25-35 parts of water are mixed at room temperature, and 200r/min is stirred for 1-10min to obtain a mixture; s2, adding 25-35 parts of anti-slip particles and 5-15 parts of phase change materials into the mixture in the step S1, and stirring for 1-10min to obtain the phase change fog seal layer material. The phase-change fog seal layer material containing the phase-change material and the preparation method and application thereof can repair tiny cracks on a road surface, avoid water damage to the road surface structure, reduce the temperature of the road surface by utilizing the self-temperature-adjusting function of the phase-change material, reduce the height Wen Binghai of the road surface, prolong the service life of an asphalt road surface, and reduce the urban heat island effect to play a role in environmental protection.

title_en: Wiping-free cleaning liquid acting on hard surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning agents, and discloses a wiping-free cleaning solution acting on a hard surface, which comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 8209 thickener 0.5%, EDTA-4NA chelating agent 0.8%, hydroxy ethylene diphosphonate tetrasodium HEDP-4NA1%, sodium gluconate 0.5%, 8035 anionic surfactant 1%, 173 nonionic surfactant 2%, OEP-70 nonionic surfactant 3%, deoiling agent 0.5%, sodium hydroxide 4%, food-grade pigment 0.05%, and the balance of reverse osmosis pure water. The cleaning liquid can fully emulsify and disperse various stains after self-permeation within 3-9 seconds, so that the cleaning liquid can be peeled off from a hard surface, and the cleaning effect is achieved. The cleaning preparation also has high-efficiency and rapid biodegradability, and does not influence the environment ecology.

title_en: System and method for treating solid waste and coupling coal-fired unit power generation
abstract_en: A solid waste treatment and coupling coal-fired unit power generation system and method relate to the technical field of solid waste treatment and solve the problem of pollution caused by solid waste treatment. The system comprises a feeding bin, a feeder, a slag cooler, a slag storage bin, a carbonization reactor, a driving motor, a cyclone separator, an induced draft fan and a coal-fired boiler; the feeder feeds the solid waste in the feeding bin to the carbonization reactor, the head part of the carbonization reactor is communicated with the feeder, the tail part of the carbonization reactor is communicated with a high-temperature area of the coal-fired boiler through a flue gas inlet and a pipeline, and the carbonization reactor is used for the reverse convection heat exchange reaction of the solid waste and the high-temperature flue gas; the carbonized product after the heat exchange reaction enters a slag cooler for cooling; and the flue gas after heat exchange is conveyed to a cyclone separator through a flue gas outlet, gas-solid separation is carried out on the flue gas, the separated clean flue gas is conveyed to a low-temperature area of a coal-fired boiler through a draught fan, the clean flue gas is combusted and generated by coupling with the coal-fired boiler, solid products are cooled together with carbonized products by falling into a slag cooler, and the solid products fall into a slag storage bin through a cooling object outlet.

title_en: Tank bottom protein recycling and semi-finished product desulfurization deacidification system
abstract_en: The application relates to a tank bottom protein recovery and semi-finished product desulfurization deacidification system which comprises a tank body, wherein a liquid inlet pipe is arranged on the left side of the upper end of the tank body, two paths of feeding pipes are arranged on the left side of the inside of the tank body, a gas washing tower is arranged on the upper and lower sides of the left end of the gas washing tower respectively, a process water inlet pipe and a gas inlet pipe are arranged on the right side of the upper end of the tank body, the upper end of the gas washing tower is provided with a gas outlet pipe, the right end of the gas washing tower is provided with a circulating pipeline, a circulating pump and a self-circulating valve are arranged on the circulating pipeline, a liquid outlet of the circulating pump is connected with a liquid outlet pipe, a liquid inlet of the discharging pump is connected to the lower part of the right end of the tank body through the liquid outlet pipe, and a discharge outlet of the discharging pump is connected with the liquid outlet pipe. The device provided by the embodiment of the application can reduce the reject rate of finished products, the loss of bioethanol and the recovery rate of protein feed.

title_en: High-heat-conductivity wave-absorbing gasket and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-heat-conductivity wave-absorbing gasket and a preparation method thereof, wherein the gasket comprises raw materials such as matrix resin, hydrogen-containing silicone oil, metal magnetic powder, fibrous heat-conducting filler, inhibitor, catalyst and the like; the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing materials: uniformly mixing and stirring vinyl silicone oil, hydrogen-containing silicone oil, inhibitor, catalyst, fiber heat-conducting filler, inorganic heat-conducting filler, metal magnetic powder and other raw materials according to a proportion, and vacuumizing to obtain a mixed material; injecting the mixture into a hollow mold under high shear force, wherein the fibrous heat-conducting filler is oriented along the flowing direction along with the flowing of the matrix resin; and (3) placing the die into a baking oven at 130 ℃ for curing for 10min, and then cutting according to a direction perpendicular to the orientation of the heat conducting fibers to obtain the wave-absorbing high heat conducting silica gel gasket. The gasket prepared by the invention not only has strong electromagnetic wave absorption capacity, but also has high heat conductivity coefficient, and can meet the heat conduction requirement.

title_en: Method for preparing filtrate reducer for drilling fluid by using modified lignite resin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a filtrate reducer for drilling fluid by using modified lignite resin. The filtrate reducer is prepared from modified lignite resin, sodium hydroxide, formaldehyde, sodium metabisulfite, phenol, triethylamine, n-bromobutane, ethanol and hydrolyzed polyacrylonitrile ammonium salt. The preparation method of the filtrate reducer comprises the steps of preparing phenolic resin, and sulfonating and modifying the phenolic resin to obtain modified sulfonated phenolic resin; preparing modified lignite resin, namely preparing humic acid from lignite, and sulfonating the humic acid to obtain modified lignite resin; and preparing the filtrate reducer by using the modified lignite resin, the modified sulfonated phenolic resin and the hydrolyzed polyacrylonitrile ammonium salt. The filtrate reducer provided by the invention has high temperature resistance, salt resistance and filtrate reduction performance, and also has the functions of reducing viscosity and preventing collapse.

title_en: Fungicidal composition containing cytoskeletal and kinesin inhibitor bactericides and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of agricultural bactericides, and in particular relates to a fungicidal composition and application thereof. The composition comprises A, B two active components, wherein the weight ratio of the active component A to the active component B is 1:99-99:1; the active component A is selected from compounds shown in the following general formula I and salts thereof, and the active component B is selected from cytoskeleton and kinesinInhibitors of bactericides. The fungicidal composition is particularly suitable for preventing and treating various plant pathogenic fungal diseases such as scab, bakanae disease, fusarium wilt, verticillium wilt, banded sclerotial blight, damping off, black spot, scab, white rot, black pox, powdery mildew, downy mildew, epidemic disease, late blight and damping off.

title_en: Continuous carbonization method and equipment for biomass waste by utilizing aerodynamic method
abstract_en: The invention provides a biomass waste continuous carbonization method and equipment by utilizing a gas dynamic method, wherein the method comprises pretreatment, process control and feeding, carbonization, carbon-gas separation, energy self-supply and gas self-circulation; the method for determining the technological parameters comprises the steps of obtaining physical characteristics of the straw, obtaining performance parameters of carbonization equipment, establishing a thermodynamic equation, solving the technological parameters of a production process, and checking the effectiveness of the technological parameters; the equipment comprises a venturi tube, a blower, a feed controller, a hopper, a multi-layer tower carbonization furnace, a cooling discharge mechanism, a gas distributor, a burner and a gas mixer. The method and the equipment thereof have the advantages of continuous carbonization, real-time treatment, high carbonization efficiency, large yield, compact equipment structure, portability and the like.

title_en: Asphalt cleaning agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an asphalt cleaning agent and a preparation method thereof. The asphalt cleaning agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-25 parts of 120# petroleum ether; 10-25 parts of acetone; 10-30 parts of methyl cyclohexane; 5-15 parts of tetrachloroethylene; 25-45 parts of propellant. The proposal provided by the application can efficiently and rapidly remove asphalt, tar, shellac, tree viscosity, insects, bird droppings and the like through the synergistic effect of four solvents, is convenient and simple to use, and has no harm to human body, quick volatilization and no residue, is suitable for cleaning asphalt on surfaces of materials such as paint, metal parts, glass and the like, and accords with the national standard GB 38508-2020.

title_en: Plant growth regulator compound with good water solubility, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound shown in a formula III and a preparation method thereof. The preparation process is simple, green and environment-friendly, and the product has high purity and yield, and has obvious economic benefit, social benefit and environmental benefit. The compound shown in the formula III is used as a plant growth regulator, and the water solubility is improved by more than 300 times while good plant growth regulating performance is maintained, so that the compound has good environmental benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Temperature-sensitive plugging agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature-sensitive plugging agent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the temperature-sensitive plugging agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 15-100 parts of thermosetting resin prepolymer, 3-30 parts of latent acid catalyst and 5-20 parts of filler. Through selection and compounding of components, the temperature-sensitive plugging agent is in a liquid state with normal rheological property at low temperature, and generates a crosslinking curing reaction along with the rise of the ambient temperature to form a high-strength curing body, so that the one-time plugging success rate is high, the dependence of plugging construction on high-risk technologies such as open hole lost circulation logging and the like is reduced, blindness of the plugging agent grading process is reduced, high-quality plugging is formed, the breaking strength is higher than that of cement, and the temperature-resistant, salt-resistant, suction-resistant, non-deformable, mechanical and physicochemical properties are stable, and the risk of secondary leakage in subsequent drilling operation is reduced; and the plugging operation is simple and safe, the drilling tool is not required to be replaced, the construction risk is low, no waste is generated in the plugging construction, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Preparation method of waterproof composite fabric
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a waterproof composite fabric, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of textile composite fabrics. The invention discloses a preparation method of a waterproof composite fabric, which comprises an antibacterial lining layer and a flame-retardant cloth surface layer attached to one side of the antibacterial lining layer, wherein a waterproof moisture-permeable film is attached to the outer surface of the flame-retardant cloth surface layer; the preparation method of the waterproof composite fabric comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing an antibacterial lining layer and a flame-retardant cloth surface layer; 2) Performing fabric lamination by using a flame-retardant adhesive to obtain a pre-composite fabric; 3) The waterproof moisture-permeable film is arranged, and the thickness of the flame-retardant adhesive is half of that of the flame-retardant adhesive in the step 2). According to the invention, the antibacterial lining layer and the flame-retardant cloth surface layer are compositely fixed by the flame-retardant adhesive with the flame-retardant function, so that the whole fabric has the advantages of water resistance, moisture permeability, antibacterial and flame retardance, the comprehensive effect of the fabric is improved, and the application range of the fabric is widened.

title_en: Method for manufacturing electronic component, method for manufacturing display device, and supporting tape
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide: a method for manufacturing an electronic component capable of suppressing residual glue on a chip component and transferring the chip component with good yield; a method for manufacturing a display device using the method for manufacturing an electronic component; a support belt for use in the manufacturing method. The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing an electronic component, comprising: a step (1) of disposing a chip component on a curable adhesive layer of a support tape having the curable adhesive layer on at least 1 surface thereof; a step (2) of irradiating energy rays from a surface of the support tape on which the chip components are disposed, the surface being opposite to the surface on which the chip components are laminated; and (3) applying a stimulus from a surface of the support tape opposite to the surface on which the chip component is laminated, and transferring the chip component from the support tape to a next member, wherein the curable adhesive layer contains a polymerizable polymer and a reaction initiator, the ultraviolet absorption at a wavelength of 365nm before the irradiation of the energy ray of the curable adhesive layer is 95% or more, and the ultraviolet absorption at a wavelength of 365nm after the irradiation of the energy ray is 95% or more.

title_en: Macroporous modified hydrogenation catalyst and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a macroporous modified hydrogenation catalyst and a production method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) The organic solvent, the polar metal seed crystal, the acid solution I containing the modifier and the alkaline solution I containing the modifier are added into a first reaction kettle in parallel flow for gel formation, so that a generated liquid I is obtained; (2) The generated liquid I enters a settling tank for settling separation to obtain an upper layer, namely an organic solvent, and a lower layer, namely sol II; (3) The sol II and an acidic solution II containing a modifier or an alkaline solution II containing a modifier flow in parallel and enter a second reaction kettle to be neutralized into gel, so that a generated liquid III is obtained; (4) The generated liquid III enters an aging kettle, and a polymerization monomer and an initiator are added for aging polymerization; (5) Drying and roasting the aged material to obtain a macroporous modified hydrogenation catalyst; wherein the alumina, the hydrogenation active metal and the modifier are introduced into the hydrogenation catalyst from an acidic solution containing the modifier and/or a basic solution containing the modifier. The catalyst of the invention can be used as a modified hydrogenation catalyst of inferior raw materials.

title_en: Asphalt pavement hydrophobic material and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophobic material of asphalt pavement and a preparation process thereof, wherein nano titanium dioxide is used as a main material, and is subjected to hydrophobic modification treatment, so that the modified titanium dioxide has excellent performances of self-cleaning, pollution prevention and the like of a self-photocatalyst, and the surface hydrophobicity is greatly improved; the epoxy resin has stable physicochemical property and self-repairing capability, the modified titanium dioxide nano particles are combined with the epoxy resin to prepare an inorganic-organic composite solution, and then the composite solution is sprayed on the asphalt surface by using a one-step spraying method. The super-hydrophobic coating material and the preparation method have synergistic effect, can be used for preparing the super-hydrophobic coating material for asphalt pavement, greatly improve the damage problem of the asphalt pavement, and can play a certain role in degrading automobile exhaust.

title_en: Fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fresh cut flower flowering phase extender containing pullulan and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of antistaling agents. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender provided by the invention comprises pullulan polysaccharide, fulvic acid, potassium chloride and sodium benzoate, and the components act together, so that compared with the existing fresh cut flower flowering phase extender in the market, the fresh cut flower flowering phase extender has the characteristics of small dosage, low cost, cold resistance, heat resistance and lasting effect, and has a good effect of prolonging the fresh cut flower flowering phase within the range of 5-25 ℃. The fresh cut flower flowering phase extender formula does not contain silver salt with strong physiological toxicity and environmental pollution, and is efficient, environment-friendly and environment-friendly; has antibacterial, antiseptic, nutrient supplementing, and water metabolism balancing effects; the preparation method is scientific, reasonable, simple and feasible.

title_en: Weather-resistant anti-oxidation photovoltaic reflective adhesive film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather-resistant anti-oxidation photovoltaic reflective film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a UV optical structure layer with periodic repeating units is prepared on a PET substrate layer by a photo-curing molding method; preparing an aluminized layer serving as a reflecting layer on the UV optical structure layer; coating an EVA adhesive film layer on the other surface of the PET substrate layer opposite to the UV optical structure layer; and (3) carrying out anodic oxidation treatment on the EVA adhesive film layer/the PET substrate layer/the aluminized layer through electrolyte, and forming an anodic aluminum oxide layer on the surface of the aluminized layer to obtain the weather-resistant anti-oxidation photovoltaic reflective adhesive film of the EVA adhesive film layer/the PET substrate layer/the aluminized layer/the anodic aluminum oxide layer. The weather-resistant anti-oxidation photovoltaic reflective adhesive film prepared by the invention improves the air oxidation resistance, high temperature resistance, humidity resistance and other weather resistance of the aluminized PET material.

title_en: High-refractive-index photo-curing adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high refractive index photo-curing adhesive which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of high-refractive-index acrylate resin, 25-35 parts of high-refractive-index acrylate monomer, 10-20 parts of high-tensile-strength acrylate resin, 5-10 parts of adhesion promotion acrylate, 1-5 parts of photoinitiator and 0.1-0.5 part of polymerization inhibitor. The invention greatly improves the stripping force of the low refractive index adhesive by applying the high refractive index acrylic resin, and obviously improves the high temperature and high humidity resistance.

title_en: Dry powder emulsion paint obtained by manual stirring and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dry powder emulsion paint obtained by manual stirring, a preparation method and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of paint, wherein the dry powder emulsion paint obtained by manual stirring comprises a first powder bag and a second powder bag in parts by weight; the raw materials of the first powder pack comprise: 0.5-40 parts of titanium dioxide and 0.2-3 parts of dispersing agent; the raw materials of the second powder pack comprise: 10-30 parts of redispersible rubber powder. According to the invention, the titanium dioxide powder and other powder materials with proper proportion are separated for independent dispersion, and under the action of the dispersing agent, the titanium dioxide large-particle complex polymer can be naturally deaggregated, and the dispersion can be promoted by manual stirring, so that the dispersibility of the dry powder emulsion paint is remarkably improved, the high-power stirring equipment and grinding equipment are not needed, the energy consumption in the use process is greatly reduced, and the technical problems that the dispersibility of the existing dry powder emulsion paint is poor, the use process is limited by mechanical equipment and the like are effectively solved.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant pressure pipeline
abstract_en: The application relates to a corrosion-resistant pressure pipeline, and relates to the technical field of pipelines; the corrosion-resistant pressure pipeline comprises a pressure pipeline body and a corrosion-resistant coating, wherein the corrosion-resistant coating is obtained by coating the inner wall of the pressure pipeline body with a corrosion-resistant coating, and the corrosion-resistant coating comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 42-54% of epoxy resin, 12-18% of metal organic framework, 0.3-1% of auxiliary agent and 100% of toluene; the corrosion-resistant coating produced by taking the metal-organic framework as one of the raw materials is coated on the inner wall of the pressure pipeline body, so that the pressure pipeline has better corrosion resistance.

title_en: High-weather-resistance organic silicon sealant for automobiles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sealants, in particular to a high weather-resistant organic silicon sealant for automobiles and a preparation method thereof, wherein branched silicon rubber is used as base rubber, and chemical grafting is realized by utilizing hydrosilylation of allyl double bonds in synthetic allylated phenolic resin and silicon rubber side groups; performing functionalization treatment on the MXene, and growing a small molecular substance biphenyl liquid crystal containing benzene rings and phenolic hydroxyl groups on the MXene in situ; adding carbon nanotubes to further synergistically improve the weather resistance of the sealant by MXene; the preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out modification treatment on a carbon nano tube, carrying out impregnation treatment on the carbon nano tube, depositing porous polyether sulfone on the surface of the carbon nano tube, preparing a bamboo-like structure porous polyether sulfone-based carbon nano tube, then synthesizing molybdenum disulfide in situ, obtaining a composite carbon nano tube, namely a hybrid of the carbon nano tube and the molybdenum disulfide, and carrying out surface modification on the composite carbon nano tube by using amino-terminated hyperbranched polyamide to obtain the branched polyamide modified composite carbon nano tube.

title_en: Antibacterial self-repairing microcapsule for water-based paint on wood surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial self-repairing microcapsule used in a water-based paint on the surface of wood and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following raw materials: urea, aqueous formaldehyde solution, polyvinyl alcohol, triethanolamine, ethanol extract of pomelo peel, sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, distilled water and sodium chloride; according to the invention, urea and formaldehyde are used as capsule wall raw materials, polyvinyl alcohol is added to prepare a modified wall material, a shaddock ped extract is used as a capsule core to prepare a modified urea resin coated shaddock ped ethanol extract microcapsule, shaddock ped glycoside, naringenin and other antibacterial components in the shaddock ped extract are utilized, yellow Bai Nazhi and other esters in the shaddock ped extract are utilized to carry out self-healing on microcracks of the coating, a microcapsule technology is utilized to synthesize a material with an antibacterial self-repairing function integration, the material is applied to a water-based paint, the service performance of the water-based paint on the surface of a wood product is ensured, and the surface coating of the wood material has low glossiness, wear resistance, impact resistance and antibacterial self-repairing compatibility.

title_en: Lead-acid storage battery sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead-acid storage battery sealant and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of sealants, and the sealant comprises a component A and a component B according to the mass ratio of 100:25-40 parts of a component A, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 70-80 parts of fluorine-silicon modified epoxy resin, 10-15 parts of silicon dioxide based reinforcing agent, 5-15 parts of diluent and 1-2 parts of defoamer; the component B comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 10-15 parts of fatty amine, 20-30 parts of aromatic amine, 25-35 parts of diluent, 5-10 parts of bisphenol A epoxy resin and 20-30 parts of benzyl alcohol; according to the invention, the fluorine-silicon modified epoxy resin and the silicon dioxide-based reinforcing agent are introduced into the sealant, so that the bonding part of the sealant after curing has high bonding strength, impact resistance and vibration resistance, better toughness and acid resistance, and low curing temperature, and can be cured at room temperature, thereby providing convenience for the production of lead-acid storage batteries.

title_en: Intelligent balance separation device and method for industrial gas
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent balance separation device and method for industrial gas, wherein the device comprises the following components: a support frame; a reaction generating unit; a processing unit; and the pressing treatment unit. Under the rotation of the inside synchronous movable cavity of reaction generation unit, make synchronous movable cavity drive clearance unit wholly rotate, the depression bar can extrude stirring to the carbide of processing intracavity portion along with the rotation of clearance unit, and the cooperation of the traction lever at clearance unit top and lug, can be in the rotation of clearance unit, make lug promote the intermittent type down motion of traction lever, and then make the depression bar move down and extrude the carbide of processing intracavity portion, and then make carbide surface attached calcium hydrate can be under the rotatory extrusion of processing intracavity portion and traction lever and the rotatory intermittent type down the extrusion of depression bar, make the calcium hydrate on processing intracavity portion carbide surface get more thoroughly removed, and then reduce the stop of calcium hydrate to the carbide reaction, improve the efficiency of acetylene gas separation reaction.

title_en: Coating composition and application thereof in anti-scouring and corrosion-resistant coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline protection, and particularly relates to a coating composition and application thereof in a scouring-resistant corrosion-resistant coating. The invention discloses a coating composition, which comprises composite powder and a binder, wherein the composite powder comprises the following components in percentage by mass (10-20): (3-5): (3-5), a composite carbide, a composite oxide and a composite metal powder. The coating composition can make the prepared coating have excellent abrasion resistance and flushing resistance and also have excellent corrosion resistance and oxidation resistance through the synergistic effect of the composite carbide, the composite oxide and the composite metal powder.

title_en: Soldering flux cleaning agent for chip packaging, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a scaling powder cleaning agent for chip packaging, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention relates to a scaling powder cleaning agent, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 0.01-0.1 part of active enzyme; 0.1-1.5 parts of stabilizer; 10-25 parts of aprotic solvent; 5-20 parts of wetting agent; 10-40 parts of polar organic solvent; alcohol amine 5-25 parts; 45-60 parts of ultrapure water. The active enzyme is one or more selected from protease, lipase and cellulase. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the scaling powder cleaning agent and application of the scaling powder cleaning agent in the field of scaling powder cleaning. The scaling powder cleaning agent is safe, environment-friendly and efficient, does not corrode the metal surface, and can maintain extremely excellent cleaning efficiency under the pure soaking process condition of cleaning without matching an ultrasonic process.

title_en: Agricultural composition containing fenoxycarb and spinosad
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide compounding, and relates to an agricultural composition containing fenoxycarb and spinosad. The invention provides an agricultural composition containing fenoxycarb and spinosad, which comprises an active ingredient of a component A and a component B, wherein the component A is fenoxycarb and a Bacillus thuringiensis BT pesticide, and the component B is spinosad and/or ethylspinosad. In a certain proportioning range, the composition has excellent performance in preventing and controlling grain crops and vegetable insect pests, particularly agricultural lepidoptera insect pests such as cotton bollworms, plutella xylostella, cabbage caterpillars, asparagus caterpillar, prodenia litura, cabbage prodenia litura and the like, has excellent insecticidal activity and shows a synergistic effect.

title_en: Composite thickening agent for fracturing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite thickening agent for fracturing and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of oil and gas field development and comprise the following components in parts by weight: 2-6 parts of vegetable gum, 1-5 parts of polyacrylamide, 1-5 parts of synergistic tackifier, 0.3-0.4 part of fungal cellulase, 0.1-0.2 part of modified multi-wall carbon nano tube, 0.1-0.2 part of cosolvent and 0.1-0.2 part of sodium sulfate. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively preparing the vegetable gum and the synergistic tackifier into aqueous solutions, and uniformly mixing the aqueous solutions to obtain gel solution I; adding fungal cellulase, polyacrylamide and sodium sulfate into the gel solution I, uniformly mixing, standing, centrifuging, and removing precipitate to obtain a gel solution II; and adding the cosolvent and the modified multiwall carbon nanotube into the gel solution II, and uniformly mixing to obtain the composite thickening agent for fracturing. The composite thickener for fracturing has higher shearing resistance, can meet the high-flow fracturing construction, and has better use prospect.

title_en: Esterase-triggered photodynamic nano pesticide controlled release system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an esterase-triggered photodynamic nano pesticide controlled release system which is characterized in that an amphiphilic conjugate is ultrasonically assembled in an aqueous solution to prepare a nano micelle with a spherical core-shell structure; the amphiphilic conjugate is formed by connecting carboxyl polysaccharide and hematoporphyrin photosensitizer through ester groups; the invention adopts carboxyl polysaccharide with good water solubility, biodegradability and innocuity, and forms conjugate with hematoporphyrin photosensitizer through ester group grafting, which can improve the water solubility of hematoporphyrin; the nano micelle formed by self-assembly of the conjugate in the aqueous solution has good water solubility, and simultaneously, the photodynamic activity of hematoporphyrin can be obviously reduced due to the fluorescence quenching effect caused by porphyrin molecule self-aggregation, so that the photostability of the photosensitizer is improved, and the utilization rate and the retention time of pesticides are optimized; when the nano micelle is absorbed by the harmful organism, the system can respond to the stimulation of enzyme in the harmful organism, release the photosensitizer and trigger the high-efficiency photodynamic activity to generate the killing effect.

title_en: Compound and application thereof, and organic electroluminescent device comprising compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound and application thereof, and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the compound, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula I, has good hole transmission and electron blocking performance through the design of a molecular structure, can effectively block electrons and excitons of a luminescent layer from diffusing to the hole layer, has higher charge mobility, and is an organic electroluminescent material with compact space structure, good film stacking morphology and good film forming property. The preparation method of the compound has simple steps, is beneficial to large-scale production, is suitable for being used as an electron blocking layer material and/or a hole transport layer material in an organic electroluminescent device, can improve and balance the transport of carriers in the device, effectively improves the efficiency and stability of the device, prolongs the service life, reduces the driving voltage and achieves better luminous effect.

title_en: Coumarin fluorescent probe based on benzoxazole derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of chemical analysis and test, and particularly relates to a coumarin fluorescent probe based on a benzoxazole derivative and application thereof. 7-hydroxy-4-methylcoumarin-3-acetic acid and 6-bromobenzo [ d ] oxazole are dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide solution, and the reaction solution is heated and refluxed for 3-4 hours at 70-90 ℃ under the alkaline condition of potassium carbonate. And separating and purifying the crude product by a thin layer chromatography to obtain the coumarin fluorescent probe SYL-4 based on the benzoxazole derivative. The coumarin fluorescent probe obtained by the invention can rapidly identify Biogenic Amine (BAs) in Cetyl Trimethyl Ammonium Bromide (CTAB) surfactant aqueous solution.

title_en: Boron-sulfur doped condensed ring aromatic hydrocarbon containing pyrrole ring, and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses boron-sulfur doped condensed ring aromatic hydrocarbon containing pyrrole rings, a synthesis method and application thereof. The property study involved ultraviolet, fluorescence and CV tests, and mercury ion tests were performed. The method has the characteristics of shorter reaction path, simple operation method, mild reaction conditions and the like, and the compound not only has the potential of being applied to the field of photoelectric devices, but also can be applied to mercury ion identification.

title_en: Flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological materials and photochromic materials, in particular to a flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility and a preparation method thereof. The flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility is an ionic compound obtained by synthesizing deoxyribonucleic acid and quaternary ammonium salt compound containing diarylethene structure in water phase and combining by electrostatic force. The flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility can generate a color change phenomenon under the stimulation of ultraviolet light and visible light, and the color change state can be kept stable under heating conditions and in a water phase. The flexible photochromic nucleic acid material with thermal stability and water insolubility prepared by the invention can be applied to the related fields of optical signal memory and the like.

title_en: Europium (III) complexes as pH sensors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound of formula (I), wherein R  1 、R 2 、R 3  and R  4  are as defined in the specification. The invention also relates to europium (III) complexes obtained from compounds of formula (I) or from complexing agents comprising said compounds, and to the use of such complexes for labeling organic or biological molecules.

title_en: High molecular weight polyimide epoxy resin, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high molecular weight polyimide epoxy resin, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials comprise the following components in parts by mass: 100-300 parts of multifunctional reaction monomer, 120-500 parts of anhydride, 300-500 parts of solvent A, 380-450 parts of epoxy resin, 70-90 parts of active monomer, 80-120 parts of solvent B, 2-6 parts of initiator, 100-110 parts of alcohol amine, 120-300 parts of curing agent and 50-100 parts of neutralizer. The prepared resin has the advantages of excellent physical and chemical stability, good temperature resistance, good selectivity, high exchange capacity, organic pollution resistance, high mechanical strength, good permeation resistance and the like, and can be applied to electrophoretic paint, building paint, engineering plastics and composite materials.

title_en: Special modified aqueous single-component metal anti-corrosion paint
abstract_en: The invention relates to a special modified aqueous single-component metal anti-corrosion paint, belonging to the technical field of C1-C3 anti-corrosion grade application sites, which comprises aqueous acrylic modified alkyd resin, epoxy resin emulsion, transparent anti-rust pigment, styrene-acrylic emulsion, heavy calcium, zinc phosphate, defoamer, dispersant, wetting leveling agent, PH value regulator, water, film forming additive, thickener, hollow glass microsphere, iron oxide red, zinc phosphate, nano tungsten trioxide dispersoid, acrylic emulsion, high-hardness resin, aluminum phosphate, silicone-acrylic emulsion, emulsifier, preservative, mildew inhibitor, wetting agent, titanium pigment, rust inhibitor and anti-settling agent. High temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, aging resistance, weather resistance, dirt resistance, crack resistance, good low temperature elongation and film forming property, and can be directly coated on steel materials.

title_en: Dual-purpose environment-friendly solvent-free bi-component polyurethane waterproof coating as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-purpose environment-friendly solvent-free bi-component polyurethane waterproof coating and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of coatings. The polyurethane waterproof paint comprises the following raw materials: component A: a first polyether polyol and diphenylmethane diisocyanate; component B: a second polyether polyol, a filler, water and a catalyst. The polyurethane waterproof coating has excellent performance and relatively low cost, can be used for wet interface construction, and solves the problems that the elevation construction is easy to sag and the upper part is thin and the lower part is thick. In addition, the polyurethane waterproof coating provided by the invention has excellent leveling property and can be used for plane construction.

title_en: Flavobacterium aureum and application thereof in promoting growth of Chinese yam tissue culture seedlings
abstract_en: The invention provides a golden yellow bacillus strain and application thereof in the field of Chinese yam tissue culture seedling raising. The classification of the golden yellow bacillus CS-LD15 is named golden yellow bacillus @ Chryseobacterium aahli ) The strain is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) for 2 months and 20 days in 2023, and the preservation number is CGMCC NO.26596. When the content of the chrysobacterium in each g of matrix is 0.2 hundred million CFU, the growth of the Chinese yam tissue culture seedlings can be obviously promoted, and the concrete steps are as follows: the Chinese yam seedlings can be obviously promoted to grow by two times of inoculation under indoor conditions; and after transplanting in the field, the seedlings can be promoted to grow by continuing to inoculate once. In sum, the addition of golden yellow bacillus promotes the growth of Chinese yam seedlings.

title_en: Multi-field composite non-contact polishing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field compound non-contact polishing device and a method, which can realize high-efficiency and high-quality polishing of a workpiece under the multi-field compound of a temperature field, an electric field, a magnetic field, a chemical field and a mechanical field, and a temperature control system can realize constant control of the temperature of non-contact polishing liquid so as to ensure that the polishing liquid always maintains good shear thickening effect in a constant temperature field in the polishing process. The abrasive particles polarized in the dielectric medium by the alternating power supply are subjected to dielectrophoresis force to generate motion, so that most of abrasive particles are prevented from settling in the polishing process, and the polishing removal rate is improved. A magnetic field is applied between the polishing tool and the workpiece, so that the magnetic abrasive particles in the polishing solution are attracted to the processed surface of the workpiece, the abrasive particles can enter corners of the complex surface of the workpiece more, the pressure of the abrasive particles on the surface of the workpiece during polishing is increased, and the polishing efficiency is improved. The oxidizing agent in the polishing solution removes the surface oxide layer through the mechanical action of abrasive particles, so that the surface with high quality can be finally achieved by repeated cycles.

title_en: Coatable vulcanized fluorescent adhesive cement and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tires and rubber, and relates to a coatable vulcanized fluorescent adhesive cement, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the coatable vulcanized fluorescent adhesive cement comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-40 parts of liquid styrene-butadiene rubber, 60-70 parts of halogenated butyl rubber, 0.5-3.0 parts of zinc oxide, 0.5-2.0 parts of stearic acid, 0.5-1.0 parts of high-temperature protective wax, 0.5-1.0 parts of low-temperature protective wax, 0.5-2.0 parts of non-pollution anti-aging agent, 0.2-2.0 parts of sulfur, 0.5-3.0 parts of accelerator DM, 0.5-3.0 parts of accelerator DPG, 5-130 parts of fluorescent powder, 0.5-9 parts of accelerator PX and 0.5-5 parts of accelerator BZ. The transparent sizing material with certain fluidity and capable of being coated on the tire is prepared by mixing raw rubber with transparent texture, non-pollution type anti-aging agent, accelerant, long-acting fluorescent powder and other materials by a specific method, so that the effect of making the tire emit fluorescence at night is achieved.

title_en: Conductive foam component with window and production process thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a conductive foam component with a window and a production process thereof. The conductive foam assembly comprises foam at an inner layer, a conductive cloth layer wrapped at the periphery of the foam, and an insulating film layer partially wrapped at the periphery of the conductive cloth layer, wherein a layer of conductive double-sided adhesive layer is locally attached to one surface of the conductive cloth layer without an insulating film, and at least one window for exposing the conductive cloth layer is formed in the insulating film layer. The utility model adopts a high-speed rotary die-cutting machine to produce a wrapped semi-finished product material belt, and sequentially passes through a wrapping jig, a thermoplastic shaping jig and a cooling shaping jig together with a strip-shaped foam material belt to finish wrapping, and finally, a circular cutter cutting machine provided with a visual identification camera is used for positioning and cutting to obtain a finished product. The utility model adopts a high-speed rotary die cutting process and an automatic package forming process to realize high-efficiency production, and is matched with a circular cutter cutting machine with a visual positioning system to accurately position and cut the product to a fixed length, thereby saving the cost and improving the precision of the product.

title_en: High-compatibility emulsion resistance reducing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of preparation of resistance reducers, and particularly discloses a high-compatibility emulsion resistance reducer and a preparation method thereof. The application relates to a high-compatibility emulsion resistance reducing agent which is mainly prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 15-20 parts of water; 0.2-0.5 part of initiator; 0.3-0.5 part of emulsifying agent; 1-2 parts of auxiliary agent; the auxiliary agent is at least two of chitosan, montmorillonite and sodium carbonate; 20-30 parts of mixed monomers, wherein the mixed monomers are at least two of acrylamide, 3-acrylamide-3-methylbutyric acid and 2-methacryloyloxyethyl-dimethyl dodecyl ammonium bromide; the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) raw material mixing: mixing the mixed monomer and water to obtain a solution, and adjusting the pH to obtain a mixed solution; and (2) preparing a resistance reducing agent: adding the emulsifier, the auxiliary agent and the initiator into the mixed solution, and mixing and reacting to obtain the finished product. The apparent viscosity and drag reduction rate of the friction reducer prepared by the application are better.

title_en: Preparation method and application of reactive disperse dye with dichloro-s-triazine as active group
abstract_en: The inventionThe preparation process and application of active disperse dye with dichloro-s-triazine as active group includes the following steps: mixing and dissolving paranitroaniline and dilute hydrochloric acid, cooling to ice bath, and mixing with sodium nitrite aqueous solution under ice bath condition to prepare diazonium salt solution; phenol and Na  2  CO  3  Adding the mixture into water to prepare a solution, dropwise adding the solution into the diazotization solution, and after the reaction is finished, carrying out suction filtration and recrystallizing a filter cake to obtain a compound; dissolving cyanuric chloride in organic solvent, and cooling with ice bath  2  CO  3  Dissolving in a mixed solvent of an organic solvent and water, dropwise adding into the cyanuric chloride solution, performing the whole reaction in an ice bath, filtering, washing a filter cake after the reaction is finished, and drying in vacuum to obtain the finished product. The dye obtained by the invention has small molecular weight and weak molecular polarity, so that the solubility of the dye in supercritical carbon dioxide fluid is greatly improved, and the problem of small solubility of disperse dye in supercritical carbon dioxide fluid is solved.

title_en: Heat conduction material with high heat conduction coefficient and wide application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat conduction materials, and discloses a heat conduction material with high heat conduction coefficient, which comprises a heat conduction matrix and heat conduction nano particles, wherein the heat conduction matrix is made of a material with high heat conduction coefficient and comprises graphene nano sheets, thermoelectric graphene, carbon nano tubes, carbon-based ultrathin films, gallium arsenide silver, boron alkene, black phosphorus, diamond ceramics and metal organic frame materials; the heat conducting nano particles comprise phase change energy storage particles, thermomagnetic nano particles, gel phase change nano particles, near infrared light-heat conversion nano particles, thermoelectric material nano rods, vibration heating nano particles and isotope nano particles; and the heat conducting filler and the additive have shorter heat conducting path and higher heat conducting efficiency by more than 10 times compared with the traditional material because the heat conducting matrix is a high heat conducting coefficient material, has higher heat conducting property and can better meet the application scene of high heat conducting property requirement.

title_en: Ultralow-temperature preservation method for pumpkin pollen
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultralow temperature preservation method for pumpkin pollen, and relates to the technical field of agriculture. The method comprises the following steps: s1, selecting male flowers of pumpkin; s2, peeling pumpkin pollen; s3, precooling pumpkin pollen; s4, preserving pumpkin pollen at ultralow temperature; s5, thawing pumpkin pollen. The application reduces nutrient substances such as soluble sugar and the like consumed in metabolic processes such as respiration of pumpkin pollen and the like by utilizing ultralow temperature, and the denaturation of enzymes, proteins and the like in the metabolic processes is participated in the metabolic processes so as to achieve the aim of effectively prolonging the preservation practice of the pumpkin pollen, and reduces injuries such as cell membrane damage and the like caused by overhigh water content of the pollen in the ultralow temperature preservation process by utilizing low-temperature precooling and cold water bath thawing, thereby making up the blank in the aspect of ultralow temperature preservation of the pumpkin pollen and forming a standardized ultralow temperature preservation operation flow of the pumpkin pollen.

title_en: Hydrophilic equilateral triangle BODIPY photodynamic sterilization fluorescent probe 3N-IBDP and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly discloses a hydrophilic equilateral triangle BODIPY photodynamic sterilization fluorescent probe 3N-IBDP and a preparation method thereof, wherein the invention adopts CF  3  COO  ‑  As a protecting group of an N-H bond, a BODIPY compound and a tert-butyl carbamate derivative are subjected to Knoevenagel condensation reaction to obtain the 3N-IBDP compound. The equilateral triangle structure can effectively improve the stability of molecules, is favorable for maintaining the molecular configuration, and can form interaction between atoms to ensure that the molecules have aggregationInducing luminescence properties and red light emission characteristics. By introducing a tert-butyl carbamate derivative as an electron donor, increasing the intra-molecular ICT, the energy level difference (deltaest) between the singlet and triplet states can be minimized and the heavy atomic iodine can be introduced at its 2,6 positions to produce more active oxygen that kills bacteria. The oleophobic group ammonia cation imparts good water dispersibility, excellent stability and excellent biocompatibility.

title_en: Preparation method of non-planar nano composite liquid crystal elastomer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a non-planar nano composite liquid crystal elastomer, which comprises the steps of directionally arranging silver nanowires into a highly oriented array by a Langmuir-Blodgett method, depositing the array on a glass substrate, drying the array to form a torsion type liquid crystal box, filling a mixture containing double-end acrylate group liquid crystal molecules, single-end acrylate group liquid crystal molecules and an initiator into the assembled liquid crystal box for polymerization in a heating and melting mode, and finally taking out the polymerized liquid crystal elastomer from the liquid crystal box, and cutting the polymerized liquid crystal elastomer along different directions to obtain a left-right chiral spiral driver or an achiral circular driver respectively.

title_en: Biological sample storage library
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological sample storage, and particularly provides a biological sample storage library. The automatic storage device aims at solving the problem that the sample is easy to damage due to tube picking operation in the process of storing and taking the frozen storage tubes of the existing automatic storage device. The biological sample storage warehouse comprises a box body, a lifting and transferring device, a code scanning device, a tube picking device and a freezing box transferring device, wherein the box body is internally provided with a storage room, a tube picking room and a sample receiving room, the tube picking room is communicated with the storage room, the sample receiving room is communicated with the upper part of the tube picking room and is communicated with the tube picking room through a first inlet and a second inlet, the sample receiving room is communicated with the external environment of the box body through a second inlet and a second outlet, the lifting and transferring device is arranged in the sample receiving room, and the code scanning device, the tube picking device and the freezing box transferring device are arranged in the tube picking room. The tube picking and storing room is communicated, so that the temperatures of the tube picking and storing room are consistent, a sample cannot be deactivated in the tube picking operation process, and the sample deactivation risk is reduced.

title_en: Double-component composite sweet ink and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of printing ink, in particular to a double-component composite sweet ink and a preparation method thereof. The double-component composite sweet ink comprises, by mass, 2-10 parts of acrylic emulsion, 50-100 parts of a solvent and 3-15 parts of a sweetener, and comprises, by mass, 5-20 parts of a resin matrix, 2-5 parts of a modified resin, 0.5-2 parts of a plasticizer, 0.1-5 parts of an auxiliary agent and 50-90 parts of a solvent. The sweet ink provided by the invention can obviously improve the echelon feel of the sweet taste of the ink on the basis of keeping a good printing effect of the ink, and can effectively preserve the sweet taste, so that the ink can keep the sweet taste of the ink to the greatest extent in a long-term printing preservation period, and the attenuation phenomenon of the sweet taste is inhibited.

title_en: Porous oil-storage self-lubricating wear-resistant polymer alloy coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous oil-storage self-lubricating wear-resistant polymer alloy coating and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out grinding and dispersing on polyphenylene sulfide resin dispersion liquid, and then carrying out dispersing and grinding on polytetrafluoroethylene by using absolute ethyl alcohol; weighing polyphenylene sulfide resin dispersion liquid and polytetrafluoroethylene dispersion liquid, and mixing to obtain a coating; preparing the prepared coating on the surface of a sample by adopting a spraying method, solidifying at high temperature, and cooling to room temperature to obtain a polytetrafluoroethylene-polyphenylene sulfide polymer alloy coating; and then the porous self-lubricating wear-resistant coating is secondarily constructed through the fusion/viscoelastic rheology of the high polymer material by utilizing the high temperature of 400 ℃ or the high temperature-centrifugal force action of 200 ℃, so that the constructed porous coating has good oil storage performance and self-lubricating wear-resistant performance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of functionalized mesoporous material modified acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesives, and discloses a functional mesoporous material modified acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive, wherein phosphate-isocyanurates functional mesoporous SiO  2  is used as a composite flame retardant, phosphate-isocyanurates functional groups are used as nitrogen and phosphorus synergistic flame retardant components, excellent flame retardant performance is given to the acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive under the synergistic effect of mesoporous nano SiO  2 , and mesoporous nano SiO  2  is used as inorganic nano filler and uniformly dispersed in an acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive matrix to form stable physical crosslinking sites, so that the crosslinking degree and cohesive strength of molecular chains are improved, the movement of the acrylate molecular chains is limited, and the proper amount of mesoporous nano SiO  2  is added, so that the thermal decomposition temperature and thermal stability of the acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive can be effectively improved, and the adhesive property and the peeling strength of the acrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive are not influenced.

title_en: Film-like adhesive and method for producing connection structure
abstract_en: A film-like adhesive (1) for circuit connection, which is a film-like adhesive (1) comprising: solder particles (2) having a Bi content of 20 to 60 mass% and a Sn content of 40 to 80 mass%, a radical polymerizable compound, and a thermal radical initiator, wherein the average particle diameter of the solder particles (2) is 0.6 to 1.5 times the thickness (d 1) of the film-like adhesive.

title_en: Preparation method of pigment blue 60 with excellent dispersibility
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of pigment blue 60 with excellent dispersibility, which comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing the salt A and the salt B to form mixed salt, and then uniformly mixing the mixed salt, vat blue 4 and an organic solvent to form pigment paste; (2) Adding an auxiliary agent into the pigment paste, and carrying out grinding treatment to obtain a treated pigment paste; (3) Mixing the treated pigment paste with the aqueous solution, and heating and stirring to form uniform mixed solution, namely organic pigment mixed solution; (4) The organic pigment mixed solution was subjected to filtration treatment to obtain pigment blue 60 having excellent dispersibility. The pigment blue 60 prepared by the invention is more suitable for being used together with high polymer materials, so that the tinting strength and dispersibility of the synthesized pigment product are obviously improved.

title_en: Multifunctional composite propping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional composite propping agent and a preparation method thereof, comprises aggregate and a composite organic coating layer which is coated outside the aggregate and consists of a plurality of polymers. The compound organic coating layer absorbs water and swells to form loose and soft floccules, so that the specific gravity of the propping agent is reduced, and self-suspension in water is realized; the propping agent particles are contacted through a loose and soft elastic machine coating layer, so that the propping agent has a slick effect, and the conveying resistance can be reduced to achieve a self-drag reduction effect; when the water-soluble organic molecules are injected into the underground and meet the high temperature of the stratum, the bonding phase in the composite organic coating layer is thermally decomposed, and some water-soluble organic molecules which are bonded by the bonding phase are separated and decomposed into small molecules, so that the self-viscosity-reducing effect is achieved. Therefore, the composite propping agent has the characteristics of self-suspension, self-resistance-reduction and self-hydrolysis, and has the effects of remotely carrying sand, improving sand spreading section, reducing construction pressure and cost, relieving reservoir injury, improving crack diversion, improving oil and gas well yield and the like in the transformation of unconventional oil and gas reservoirs.

title_en: Preparation for inhibiting volatilization of organic matters and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional polymer materials, and particularly relates to a preparation for inhibiting volatilization of organic matters and application thereof. The preparation for inhibiting the volatilization of the organic matters comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of water, 1-5 parts of fluorine-containing acrylic resin, 1-5 parts of hydroxyalkyl cellulose ether and 0.05-0.5 part of film forming auxiliary agent. The invention adopts hydroxyalkyl cellulose ether compounded fluorine-containing acrylic resin as an isolation medium for volatilizing organic matters, and utilizes hydroxyl in the hydroxyalkyl cellulose ether and carboxyl in the fluorine-containing acrylic resin to form hydrogen bonds, thus obtaining a novel preparation for inhibiting volatilizing organic matters, which has stable film forming performance. The preparation disclosed by the invention can be applied to land and water surface dangerous chemical leakage environments by matching with a high molecular absorbent, can effectively reduce volatilization of organic matters, prevents accidents such as explosion, fire, toxic gas diffusion and the like, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Self-repairing scratch-resistant paint protective film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-repairing scratch-resistant paint protective film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of polyurethane and acrylic resin. Adopting trimethoyl alcohol as a chain extender, polymerizing polytetrahydrofuran glycol and polyisocyanate into hyperbranched polyurethane prepolymer, and introducing an acrylic resin chain segment containing indole rings into the hyperbranched polyurethane prepolymer. The self-repairing scratch-resistant paint protective film can be applied to aircraft, trains, automobiles or wind power blades, can be used as a self-repairing layer, can effectively resist scratches, improves the protective effect of paint and prolongs the service life, and has wide application prospect. In the process of preparing polyurethane, the trimellitic alcohol is used as a chain extender, so that the polyurethane can form a hyperbranched structure, the mechanical property of the whole molecule is more excellent, and in addition, the existence of benzene rings in the trimellitic alcohol enables the polyurethane molecule to have certain rigidity at the same time, so that the wear resistance of the polyurethane is further improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high heat-resistant polyurethane adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high heat-resistant polyurethane adhesive, and relates to the technical field of adhesives. The preparation method of the polyurethane adhesive comprises the following steps: s1: the polyester diol is decompressed and dehydrated, and reacts with toluene diisocyanate in the presence of dibutyltin dilaurate in the nitrogen atmosphere to obtain a prepolymer; s2: the prepolymer reacts with dimethylolpropionic acid, 1, 4-butanediol and modified silicon dioxide, and then is neutralized to form salt under the action of a salifying agent triethanolamine, so as to obtain a polyurethane prepolymer; s3: and modifying the organosilicon in the process of emulsifying the polyurethane prepolymer to prepare the polyurethane adhesive. The adhesive prepared by the application has the advantages of excellent water resistance and heat resistance.

title_en: Low VOC and food grade resealable label
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an opening and closing sealing label (311, 411, 511, 611) having a low content of volatile organic compounds. The opening and closing seal label (311, 411, 511, 611) includes a face (101) and an adhesive layer (102) adjacent to the face. The face (101) contains a film-like material, and the adhesive layer (102) contains a removable pressure-sensitive adhesive. The removable pressure sensitive adhesive comprises an aqueous acrylate polymer dispersion and is arranged to emit minimal volatile emissions at conventional operating temperatures. The film-like material and the removable pressure sensitive adhesive are food grade materials. A label laminate web (100) for providing an open and close seal label (311, 411, 511, 611) is disclosed. A method for producing the label laminate web (100) is also provided. Further, the present description relates to a package (310) comprising an opening and closing sealing label (311, 411, 511, 611) with a low content of volatile organic compounds.

title_en: OCA optical cement for vehicle-mounted large screen, adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OCA optical adhesive for a vehicle-mounted large screen, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 90 to 110 portions of acrylate prepolymer, 0.05 to 0.2 portion of photoinitiator A, 0.1 to 0.3 portion of photoinitiator B, 0.1 to 0.3 portion of photoinitiator C, 0.01 to 0.05 portion of flatting agent, 0.02 to 0.1 portion of defoamer, 0.1 to 0.3 portion of coupling agent, 0.2 to 0.5 portion of adhesion tackifier, 0.1 to 0.3 portion of cross-linking agent and 0.08 to 0.2 portion of molecular weight regulator. According to the invention, three photoinitiators with different absorption wavelengths are added into the formula, and as the absorption peaks of the three photoinitiators are different, when the glue of the same formula is cured by UV light with different wave bands, the glue film with different curing degrees can be obtained, and the requirements of people on various filling performances are met.

title_en: Liquid-crystalline medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Liquid Crystal (LC) medium (having negative dielectric anisotropy) as defined in claim 1, and its use for optical, electro-optical and electronic purposes, in particular in LC displays.

title_en: Bamboo charcoal production facility
abstract_en: The application relates to bamboo charcoal production equipment, which comprises a first working platform, a charcoal kiln, a kiln base and a transfer device, wherein the first working platform is arranged above the ground, a height difference exists between the first working platform and the ground, and a feed inlet is formed in the first working platform; the charcoal kiln is arranged on the first working platform and is positioned above the feed inlet; the kiln base is attached to the feeding hole from bottom to top and is detachably connected with the first working platform; the transfer device is used for transferring the kiln base and transferring and clamping the kiln base into the feed inlet; the transfer device comprises a moving mechanism and a lifting mechanism; the lifting mechanism is arranged on the moving mechanism and is used for lifting the kiln base and clamping the kiln base into the feeding port; or the lifting mechanism is used for descending the kiln base; the moving mechanism is used for driving the lifting mechanism and the kiln base to move so as to move the kiln base to the position below the feed inlet. The whole process is simple and convenient to operate, time-saving and labor-saving, the working efficiency is improved, and the operation safety is improved.

title_en: Water-based industrial mildew preventive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based industrial mildew preventive and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of industrial mildew preventive and are composed of, by weight, 50 parts of benzothiadiazine, 8-10 parts of an emulsifying agent, 2-5 parts of an auxiliary emulsifying agent, 1-4 parts of an organic acid, 0.1-1 part of a stabilizing agent, 0.1-1 part of a defoaming agent, 0.1-0.5 part of a thickening agent and the balance of deionized water. The product prepared by the method of the invention is free from adding organic solvent, the content of the effective component of the benzothicyano is up to 40%, and the product has good storage stability and good practical effect.

title_en: N10 chain-containing gas generating agent and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas generating agent containing N10 chain and a synthesis method thereof, the molecular formula of the gas generating agent is C  4  H  2  N  18  . The method comprises the following steps: dissolving 1,5' -bitetrazole potassium salt obtained by reacting 1,5' -bitetrazole with potassium hydroxide solution in a solvent, and carrying out amination reaction with THA solution to synthesize 5 hydrogen- [1,5' -bitetrazole]-2' -amine; 5H- [1,5' -bitetrazole]And (3) carrying out oxidative coupling reaction on the 2' -amine in the presence of excessive potassium permanganate and concentrated hydrochloric acid to prepare a target product. The thermal decomposition characterization of the compound is carried out by adopting a differential scanning calorimeter, so that the thermal stability of the structure is good, and a large amount of nitrogen is rapidly decomposed and discharged when the compound is heated to 118 ℃, and the compound can be used as an environment-friendly gas generating agent. The compound has high nitrogen content, high positive formation enthalpy and good detonation performance, and the synthesis method is simple, high in yield and low in cost.

title_en: Pollution-resistant aluminized zinc color-coated steel plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution-resistant aluminum-zinc-plated color-coated steel plate and a manufacturing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of color-coated steel plates. The substrate comprises a front side and a back side, wherein the front side of the substrate is provided with a first alloy plating layer, a primer coating layer and a top coating layer from inside to outside in sequence, the first alloy plating layer, the primer coating layer and the top coating layer are mutually tightly combined, the back side of the substrate is provided with a second alloy plating layer and a back coating layer from inside to outside in sequence, and the second alloy plating layer and the back coating layer are mutually tightly combined. The invention solves the problem that the existing color-coated steel plate is easy to pollute, and the prepared anti-pollution paint is coated on the surface of the primer layer and dried and cured to obtain the anti-pollution aluminum-zinc color-coated steel plate with the top paint layer formed on the surface of the primer layer, and the anti-pollution paint can improve the anti-pollution performance of the color-coated steel plate, so that the surface of the color-coated steel plate is not easy to be polluted.

title_en: Water-based epoxy rust-carrying penetration coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based epoxy rust penetration coating and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of coating preparation; comprises aqueous epoxy resin, polyurethane resin, wetting dispersant, modified aluminum tripolyphosphate, modified chitosan, graphene oxide, sepiolite modified by silane coupling agent and calcium carbonate modified by titanium pigment; the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing modified chitosan into an aqueous solution, adding modified aluminum tripolyphosphate, fully dispersing, adding graphene oxide, and drying after fully dispersing to obtain chitosan aerogel; s2, preparing aqueous epoxy resin and a wetting dispersant into a film material, adding chitosan aerogel, sepiolite modified by a silane coupling agent and titanium dioxide modified calcium carbonate into the film forming material of filler particles, and fully dispersing to obtain a mixed solution; s3, adding polyurethane resin into the filler particle mixed solution, fully dispersing, and filtering to obtain the coating; the coating has remarkable corrosion resistance and can effectively protect a substrate.

title_en: Heterocyclic organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt and active carbon blending bactericide for oil and gas field and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a heterocyclic organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt and active carbon blending bactericide for oil and gas fields and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of bactericides for oil and gas fields, and solves the technical problem that the expected sterilization efficiency still cannot be achieved after the existing bacteria generate drug resistance; the application introduces corresponding heterocyclic structures such as quinoline and the like into the organosilicon quaternary ammonium salt bactericide to form the characteristic of structural diversity, can enhance the sterilizing efficiency, has strong compatibility with active carbon, has obviously stronger sterilizing effect than the traditional sterilizing, has a continuous sterilizing function, and has the advantages of higher sterilizing speed, longer lasting effect, less environmental pollution and less harm to human bodies.

title_en: Preparation method of bulk hydrofining catalyst containing rare earth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bulk phase hydrofining catalyst containing rare earth, which comprises the following steps: (1) Performing gel forming reaction on a first precipitator, a sodium molybdate solution and a Ni-Si-containing solution, adding an anionic surfactant in the reaction process, and performing first aging to obtain a first slurry; (2) Adding a solution containing Ni, al, a sodium tungstate solution, a second precipitant and the first slurry into water and grease liquid to carry out a second gel forming reaction, reducing the pH value in the reaction process in a plurality of times, adding a part of rare earth solution after the reduction times are equally divided, and carrying out second aging to generate a second slurry; (3) And (3) aging the second slurry, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a formed product, and carrying out desalting treatment to obtain the catalyst. The method has the advantages of low cost, clean process, larger pore volume and pore diameter of the catalyst, better synergistic effect of the hydrogenation metal and the rare earth metal in the catalyst, improved hydrogen storage capacity, reduced carbon deposition of the catalyst and better activity stability when the inferior distillate oil raw material is treated.

title_en: Film surface treatment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of printing, and particularly relates to a film surface treatment method.
