The film surface treatment method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: s1, uniformly mixing a casting polyurethane prepolymer, polyester polyol resin and a cross-linking agent to obtain a mixed solution, and casting the obtained mixed solution in a forming centrifuge; s2, placing the liquid dispersion of the nano-scale particles in a spray gun; s3, after the casting step S1, the mixed solution starts to be converted into a gel and semi-solid state, and at the moment, the spray gun is used for uniformly and uniformly spraying the liquid dispersion of the nano-level particles onto the mixed solution in the gel and semi-solid state; s4, solidifying the film, wherein nano-scale particles are attached to the surface of the film. According to the invention, the particle coating layer is added on the surface of the film, so that the surface tension of the film can be improved, and the performances of wear resistance, dirt resistance, surface charge giving/receiving performance and the like can be improved; the charging performance of the printer toner is effectively controlled; and increases the useful life of the film.

title_en: Preparation method of polymer modified cement waterproof coating with low viscosity and high resistance
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of waterproof paint preparation, in particular to a preparation method of a polymer modified cement waterproof paint with low viscosity and high resistance. Technical problems: the preparation method aims at solving the technical problems that the waterproof coating in the prior art is high in porosity, the waterproof coating performance is reduced, and the solid content is improved and is not easy to process. The technical scheme is as follows: a preparation method of a polymer modified cement waterproof paint with low viscosity and high resistance comprises the following steps: s1: preparing modified styrene-acrylic emulsion. The application uses carboxylic acid monomer to modify acrylic ester emulsion to enhance compatibility of organic phase and inorganic phase, and can enhance intermolecular force between polymer and cement and hydration products, thus enhancing compaction degree of waterproof coating film.

title_en: Coating system and coated article
abstract_en: The present application relates to a coating system and a coated article. The coating system comprises: (a) A first coating layer formed from a first two-component coating composition, the first two-component coating composition comprising component A1 and a curing agent component B1, component A1 comprising a first film-forming resin and an organic solvent; (b) A second coating layer formed of a second two-component coating composition comprising a component A2 and a curing agent component B2, the component A2 comprising a second film-forming resin and an organic solvent, coated on the first coating layer; the hydroxyl value of the first film-forming resin is 70 to 170mg KOH/g, and the hydroxyl value of the second film-forming resin is 30 to 150mg KOH/g. Also relates to coated articles comprising the coating system. The coating system of the present application is capable of providing very low or no odor, and good adhesion to substrates, especially carbon fibers, and preferably also provides an appearance meeting aesthetic performance requirements, as well as excellent weatherability, chemical resistance, abrasion resistance, aging resistance, environmental protection, and the like.

title_en: Packaging adhesive film adapting to low-temperature series welding process and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a packaging adhesive film adapting to a low-temperature series welding process and a preparation method thereof. The compound of the resins with different melting points improves the infiltration of the battery piece, helps to improve the adhesion, reduces the occurrence probability of bad appearance such as bubbles and the like caused by low fluidity of the film, can effectively shorten the melting time of the adhesive film, and improves the lamination efficiency; the first functional resin and the second functional resin with the side chains modified are used, so that the problems of high haze, low transmittance and high resin hardness caused by high-melting-point resin are effectively solved, the power and the yield of the component are improved, the high polarity caused by the side chains of the first functional resin and the second functional resin is also improved, the durable adhesive force of the adhesive film to the battery piece is also effectively improved, and the long-term stable use of the component is ensured.

title_en: Sorghum pelleting seed coating agent for long-acting prevention and control of borers and aphids and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plant protection, in particular to a sorghum pelleting seed coating agent for long-acting prevention and control of borers and aphids and application thereof. The invention provides a sorghum pelleting seed coating agent, wherein active substances in the sorghum pelleting seed coating agent comprise chlorantraniliprole, thiamethoxam and tebuconazole, the content of active ingredients of the chlorantraniliprole in the sorghum pelleting seed coating agent is 6g/kg of seeds, the content of active ingredients of the thiamethoxam is 10mL/kg of seeds, and the content of active ingredients of tebuconazole is 0.4g/kg of seeds. The sorghum pelleting seed coating agent provided by the invention can reduce the dosage of pesticides and the application times.

title_en: Construction and application of protein membrane macromolecular probe for biological detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses construction and application of a protein membrane macromolecular probe for biological detection, belonging to the field of biological detection and information encryption. The invention connects the fluorophore with ligand unit with biological orthogonal property to synthesize a series of novel fluorescent molecules capable of combining with biological macromolecules. And further, the micromolecules are covalently combined with HaloTAG proteins through optimizing biological orthogonal reaction, so that the protein membrane macromolecular probe with good response performance is prepared. The protein membrane probe adopts fusion protein to replace an antibody unit in ELISA, can realize rapid and convenient detection of an object to be detected on a solid-phase interface, can recycle an actual sample, and solves the problem that the probe and the object to be detected are difficult to separate in a liquid phase detection system. Compared with a small molecular probe, the protein membrane probe has higher sensitivity and signal-to-noise ratio to an object to be detected.

title_en: Neutral chelating enzyme operation workover fluid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an operation workover fluid of neutral chelating enzyme, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 12-30 parts of tetrasodium iminodisuccinate, 1-10 parts of aminotrimethylene phosphonic acid, 2-10 parts of amylase, 0.5-5 parts of protease, 5-15 parts of alkyl glucamide, 0.5-2 parts of coconut diethanolamide, 0.5-8 parts of trehalose, 1-5 parts of chitosan and 25-60 parts of deionized water. The invention also provides a preparation method of the operation workover fluid. In conclusion, the invention can carry out biodegradation, is environment-friendly, can effectively remove deposition blockage of inorganic scale and organic scale, eliminates emulsification blockage, improves the permeability of a well, has good swelling prevention, chelation and scale inhibition performances, removes and avoids water-sensitive and salt-sensitive injuries, and prolongs the effective period of operation.

title_en: Preparation method of solid particles in solid-liquid multi-cavity gel beads
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of solid particles in solid-liquid multi-cavity gel beads, which comprises the following steps: step one, adding soap powder, an anionic surfactant, sodium a-alkenyl sulfonate, sodium bicarbonate, a builder, anhydrous sodium sulfate and EDTA-2Na into a stirring and mixing tank, and mixing and stirring; spraying pigment solution through a spraying device at the top of the mixing cylinder, stirring for 5 minutes, and then closing stirring and discharging; step three, adding the stirred materials in the step two into a common rotary conical mixer, then adding an enzyme preparation, then starting the equipment, mixing and stirring for 10 minutes, and discharging; step four: adding the uniformly mixed material in the step three into a material adding bin of a granulator, starting equipment, and granulating; step five: sieving the produced particles; step six: adding the particles into solid-liquid gel bead filling equipment to be filled into a finished product; the invention controls the feeding speed and the outlet of the strip discharging machine to be matched with strip discharging steel plates with equal aperture so as to lead the sizes of the produced particles to be equal.

title_en: Flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane coating, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of automobile coatings. The flame-retardant waterborne polyurethane coating comprises, by weight, 50-80 parts of waterborne polyurethane resin, 5-10 parts of a compound flame retardant, 2-5 parts of dipropylene glycol methyl ether, 4-6 parts of a dispersing agent, 1-5 parts of a defoaming agent, 2-3 parts of a wetting agent, 0.2-0.5 part of fumed silica, 0-15 parts of a pigment and 10-30 parts of deionized water, wherein the compound flame retardant consists of aluminum hydroxide, tributyl phosphate and montmorillonite in a mass ratio of 2-3:1-2:4-5. The coating after the coating is cured has excellent mechanical properties and good flame retardant property.

title_en: Flexible ultrathin conductive adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of conductive adhesive, in particular to a flexible ultrathin conductive adhesive film and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the flexible ultrathin conductive adhesive film comprises the following steps: mixing vinyl triethoxysilane and an ethanol aqueous solution to prepare silane hydrolysate, reacting with graphene oxide, continuing to react with silver nitrate and ascorbic acid to obtain silver-loaded reduced graphene oxide aerogel, and reacting with triethoxysilane to obtain silver-loaded reduced graphene oxide aerogel conductive filler; reacting 4- (1-imidazolyl) benzyl amine, ethanolamine and side chain acrylate silicone oil to prepare a latent epoxy resin curing agent; mixing an acrylic compound, benzophenone epoxy resin, a latent epoxy resin curing agent and silver-loaded reduced graphene oxide aerogel conductive filler, and performing ultraviolet light curing to obtain a flexible ultrathin conductive adhesive film. The flexible ultrathin conductive adhesive film prepared by the invention has good conductivity and strong adhesion, and still has good conductivity in a bending state.

title_en: Biopesticide for preventing and treating anthracnose of avocado
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biopesticides, and in particular relates to a biopesticide for preventing and treating anthracnose of avocado. The biological pesticide for preventing and treating the anthracnose of the avocado is prepared by compounding active ingredients of trichoderma harzianum with polyoxin, berberine or difenoconazole, wherein the trichoderma harzianum is 200 hundred million cfu/g trichoderma harzianum DS-10 parent drug. The trichoderma harzianum and polyoxin, berberine or difenoconazole are compounded, the co-toxicity coefficient of the trichoderma harzianum and the difenoconazole is greater than 120, and the trichoderma harzianum and the difenoconazole are synergistic, so that the control effect on the anthracnose of the pyritic pear can be improved, the use amount of pesticides is reduced, and the control cost is reduced.

title_en: Organic fluorescent probe for detecting tricyclazole as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic fluorescent probe for detecting tricyclazole, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of organic synthesis and analytical chemistry, wherein the organic fluorescent probe takes cyano stilbene as chromophore, and (1R, 2R) -1, 2-cyclohexanediamine and crown ether chain are introduced to modify the cyano stilbene to prepare a fluorescent macrocyclic structure, namely the organic fluorescent probe, the chemical name of which is (1R, 2R) -cyclo-tri (ethoxy) -bridged-di (4-phenyl (Z-1-cyanovinyl) phenyl) -4-oxyacetylcyclohexamethylenediamine; the organic fluorescent probe has good sensing capability and strong anti-interference capability on tricyclazole, can realize real-time visual selective detection of tricyclazole, generates remarkable fluorescence quenching when the tricyclazole exists in the environment, can obtain the concentration of tricyclazole in a sample according to the good linear relation between the fluorescence intensity and the equivalent concentration of tricyclazole, has high efficiency, simple detection steps and important reference significance in the field of agricultural detection.

title_en: Goat sperm biomembrane protective agent and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goat sperm biomembrane protective agent and an application method thereof, wherein the goat sperm biomembrane protective agent comprises the following components of 0.036g/ml Tris, 0.01g/ml glucose, 0.02g/ml citric acid, 6% glycerol by volume fraction, 1% blue chain mycin mixture by volume fraction, 20 mug/ml peroxidase-6, 10-30 mug/ml glutathione peroxidase 5 and ultrapure water. The invention can resist the oxidative damage of the sperm biomembrane in the freezing recovery process, so that the sperm can play a normal physiological function. Compared with the conventional diluent, the sperm membrane integrity is improved by 27.63%, the acrosome membrane integrity is improved by 15.3% and the mitochondrial membrane potential is improved by 47.2% under the same condition. The goat sperm biomembrane protective agent can fully improve the utilization rate of breeding ram, and is beneficial to developing the improvement breeding work of livestock.

title_en: Sludge compost and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to sludge compost and a preparation method thereof, which are used for reducing the bioavailability of heavy metals in sludge, so as to reduce the absorption of plants to the heavy metals and further reduce the environmental risk. The preparation method of the sludge compost comprises the following steps: s100: pretreating sludge; dehydrating and crushing sludge, and regulating the carbon-nitrogen ratio of the sludge to 20-30 by using straw to obtain pretreated sludge; s200: preparing biochar; after the biomass raw material is air-dried, the biomass raw material is placed in a nitrogen atmosphere and heated for 2 hours at 500 ℃, then cooled to room temperature, and the biochar is taken out for crushing and grinding; s300: fermenting; and (3) adding a biological fertilizer starter and the biological carbon obtained in the step (200) into the pretreated sludge obtained in the step (100), regulating the water content of the mixed material to be 50-60%, uniformly stirring, fermenting at 50-60 ℃ for 20-25 days, and then air-drying, crushing and sieving to obtain the sludge compost.

title_en: Photothermal hydrophobic coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a photothermal hydrophobic coating, a preparation method and application thereof. The photothermal hydrophobic coating comprises a first component and a curing agent component; the first component comprises a modified nanoparticle material, a photothermal absorption conversion material, a resin material and a solvent, wherein the modified nanoparticle material comprises a nanoparticle matrix and a fluorosilane coupling agent modifier; the light-heat absorption conversion material is one or more selected from carbon-based light absorption materials and inorganic semiconductor materials; the curing agent component is one or more selected from isocyanate curing agents, amine curing agents, acid curing agents and anhydride curing agents. The photo-thermal hydrophobic coating provided by the disclosure has good photo-thermal absorption conversion efficiency and can play a good role in anti-icing or deicing.

title_en: Pearlescent pigment, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of pearlescent pigment, the pearlescent pigment prepared by the method and application thereof, wherein the pearlescent pigment matrix is coated, then the coated pearlescent pigment is modified by a surface modifier, the polarity of the pearlescent pigment matrix is changed, and when the modified pearlescent pigment is used for preparing pearlescent slurry, the pearlescent pigment is uniformly dissolved and mixed in an organic solvent, sedimentation and delamination are not easy to occur, and the pearlescent slurry with good stability can be obtained.

title_en: Furnace top coal charging hole sealing intelligent device
abstract_en: An intelligent sealing device for a furnace top coal charging hole is a sealing device applied to a coke oven top coal charging car. The invention comprises an upper guide sleeve, a lower guide sleeve, a cover uncovering machine, a coal charging hole cleaning machine, a furnace cover cleaning scraper, a slurry pouring system, a movable trolley and a guide rail frame, wherein the upper guide sleeve and the lower guide sleeve are matched to form three sealing points. The dry-wet diversion mode is adopted, so that the problem that the slurry blocks the pipeline is effectively avoided. Before use, the water and the dry powder are stored separately, the powder and the water are quantitatively conveyed into the mixer and mixed during use, the mixed slurry is released to the gap between the furnace cover and the coal charging hole seat, and a small amount of clear water is used for cleaning the mixer after slurry pouring is completed. The design has the advantages of 1. Greatly reducing the labor intensity of workers and reducing the harm of high temperature and smoke dust to human bodies. 2. Obviously reduces the overflow of harmful gases and effectively protects the environment. 3. The degree of automation is high, and unmanned operation of sealing the furnace top coal charging hole can be realized.

title_en: Intelligent photo-electromechanical control bionic extraction equipment for fresh flowers and aromatic plants
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of extraction equipment, in particular to optical-mechanical-electrical intelligent control bionic extraction equipment for fresh flowers and aromatic plants, which comprises a machine body, wherein an extraction chamber is embedded in the machine body, a plurality of mesh screens are sequentially arranged in the extraction chamber from bottom to top, a full spectrum lamp is arranged on the periphery of each mesh screen and is arranged on the inner wall of the extraction chamber, a fan is arranged on the machine body, the air outlet end of the fan is communicated with the extraction chamber, a detector is arranged in the extraction chamber, a micro-control computer is arranged on the machine body and is used for generating detection signals according to the light intensity, the wind pressure, the temperature and the humidity in the extraction chamber and sending the detection signals to the micro-control computer, the micro-control computer is used for controlling the fan and the full spectrum lamp according to the detection signals, and a collecting mechanism is arranged on the machine body and is used for collecting aromatic substances generated in the extraction chamber. The application has the effect of improving the quality of the collected extract.

title_en: Squeezing purification device and purification process for pig feed production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pig feed production, in particular to a squeezing and purifying device and a purifying process for pig feed production. The technology switching mechanism that sets up realizes the switching to the material loading of soybean, flat material, squeeze and unload sediment process, forms the circulation structure that flows to very big improvement the efficiency that the fodder was squeezed, carry out swing material loading through the feed mechanism that sets up, throw in the soybean to squeeze more evenly distributed in the cavity, avoid the soybean to concentrate in a place to pile up, and the flat material mechanism of setting carries out the flat pressure repeatedly to the soybean that fills up the inside of the cavity of squeezing of soybean, presses the top of soybean to be level, avoid the soybean to spill over from the top of cavity.

title_en: Tar purification device of high-efficient biogas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tar purification device of high-efficiency biogas, which comprises an absorption tower for injecting vegetable oil through an oil injection pipe; one end of the oil injection pipe extending into the absorption tower is connected with a spray head; the top of the absorption tower is connected with an exhaust pipe, the bottom of the side wall is connected with an air inlet pipe, and the bottom of the absorption tower is connected with an oil exhaust pipe; a plurality of filter components are arranged below the spray head in a stacked mode in the absorption tower, and gaps are formed between the filter components. The invention adopts vegetable oil as the purifying medium, the purifying efficiency can reach 70% -80%, the decoking efficiency is higher than that of the common decoking equipment which adopts water as the purifying medium, and meanwhile, the filtering components which are arranged in a laminated way are adopted, so that the flow velocity of biomass gas in the purifying device can be slowed down, the air inlet temperature is reduced, the precipitation of tar is facilitated, and the purifying effect is improved.

title_en: fuel composition
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a fuel composition comprising: (a) a base fuel suitable for use in an internal combustion engine; (b) a tetraalkylalkylethane compound having formula (I): wherein Ar represents an aryl group and each X is independently selected from a hydrogen atom, a substituted or unsubstituted straight or branched C  1  ‑C  12  Alkyl group, (CH)  2  )  n  OH or (CH)  2  )  n  NH  2  Wherein n is in the range of 1 to 9, provided that each CX  3  At least one of the X groups in the group is a hydrogen atom. The fuel compositions of the present invention provide improved power and acceleration benefits, as well as increased flame speed and combustion duration.

title_en: Application of beta-caryophyllene in contact killing of bemisia tabaci
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of insect control and discloses application of beta caryophyllene in contact bemisia tabaci. The invention discovers that the beta-caryophyllene can play a role in killing bemisia tabaci and can cause rapid death of bemisia tabaci MED cryptospecies adults in a short time. The beta-caryophyllene liposome preparation prepared from the beta-caryophyllene liposome has good stability and dispersibility, and improves the control effect on bemisia tabaci.

title_en: Quantitative inhibitor adding device for fertilizer production and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative inhibitor adding device for fertilizer production and a using method thereof, which relate to the technical field of quantitative inhibitor adding, and currently propose the following scheme that the quantitative inhibitor adding device comprises two support frames and a transverse moving mechanism, wherein the transverse moving mechanism is arranged between the two support frames; the vertical moving mechanism is arranged on the transverse moving mechanism; the longitudinal moving mechanism is arranged on the vertical moving mechanism; the quantitative discharging mechanism is mounted on the longitudinal moving mechanism and comprises a plurality of control valves, the bottoms of the control valves are communicated with a quantitative cylinder, and an outer cylinder is fixed outside the quantitative cylinder; according to the invention, the inhibitor particles are added into the fertilizer raw material in a three-dimensional manner by the vertical quantitative matrix adding manner, so that the inhibitor particles are uniformly distributed in the fertilizer raw material, the vertical quantitative matrix adding manner can greatly shorten the mixing time, and the mixing efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Streptomyces nordshurica NK27 for producing gourmet powder and application thereof in plant disease control
abstract_en: The invention discloses Streptomyces nordstocus NK27 producing glutathione and application thereof in plant disease control, belonging to the technical field of plant disease control, wherein the preservation number of the Streptomyces nordstocus NK27 is CGMCC No.28268; the invention also discloses a broad-spectrum antibacterial agent, which comprises the strain, fermentation liquor or metabolite of the streptomyces nordsi NK27. The invention prepares the microbial products with obvious antibacterial effects on botrytis cinerea, tobacco black shank germ, apple rot germ, apple ring rot germ, sclerotinia sclerotiorum, cotton fusarium wilt, tobacco red star germ, poplar canker germ, wheat sharp eyespot germ, pepper epidemic disease germ and corn big spot germ through experimental screening, effectively prevents and treats various plant diseases, and provides a safe and reliable new way for preventing and treating various plant diseases.

title_en: Preparation method of matte mica powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mica powder, and provides a preparation method of matte mica powder, which comprises the following steps of S1, adding a pretreatment agent into mica sheets, then, crushing and grading to obtain mica sheet slurry, wherein the pretreatment agent is formed by mixing benzalkonium chloride, sodium pyrophosphate and water in a mass ratio of 2-4:2:100, S2, carrying out filter pressing dehydration on the mica sheet slurry, grinding to obtain ground slurry, S3, adjusting the mass fraction of the mica powder in the ground slurry, dispersing, vibrating and sieving to obtain mica powder with a diameter-thickness ratio of more than 90, and S4, rinsing the mica powder with the diameter-thickness ratio of more than 90, precipitating for removing impurities, dehydrating and drying to obtain the matte mica powder. Through the technical scheme, the problem of poor matte effect of mica powder in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Water-based protective baking paint for hardware parts and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of amino baking varnish, and particularly relates to water-based protective baking varnish for hardware parts and a preparation method thereof. The aqueous hydroxy acrylic resin is used as a film forming substance of the aqueous protective baking paint, and the obtained paint film has poor adhesive force on the surface of a metal substrate and poor salt spray resistance. Aiming at the problems, the invention provides the water-based protective baking varnish for the hardware parts, wherein the obtained epoxy modified polyurethane dispersoid has rich epoxy polar groups reserved in a main resin structure, and the adhesive force and salt spray resistance of the amino baking varnish are obviously improved.

title_en: EVA hot melt adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of EVA hot melt adhesive films, and discloses an EVA hot melt adhesive film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the EVA hot melt adhesive film comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of EVA main resin; 15-40 parts of EVM (VA content is more than or equal to 60 percent); 3-10 parts of tackifying resin; 0.01 to 1 part of antistatic agent; 0.01 to 1 part of antioxidant; 0.01 to 1 part of light stabilizer; the EVA hot melt adhesive film can increase the adhesiveness of the EVA hot melt adhesive film in use by adding the EVM and the tackifying resin into the raw materials, has good use effect and low temperature resistance, can improve the ageing resistance of the EVA hot melt adhesive film by adding the antistatic agent, the antioxidant and the light stabilizer into the raw materials, and can also improve the physical property and the service life of the EVA hot melt adhesive film, so that the EVA hot melt adhesive film has good use effect and low temperature resistance.

title_en: Low-modulus OCA optical pressure-sensitive adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-modulus OCA optical pressure-sensitive adhesive and a preparation method thereof. Wherein the block copolymer adopts reversible addition fragmentation chain transfer emulsion polymerization, and the block copolymer is prepared by controlling the types of monomers and the feeding sequence and controllably designing; the homopolymer is formed by reversible addition fragmentation chain transfer solution polymerization, has lower modulus compared with emulsion polymerization, and is prepared by mixing the prepared segmented copolymer with the homopolymer and forming a film through the solution. The OCA optical pressure-sensitive adhesive prepared by the invention has a plurality of excellent characteristics, high stretchability, high transparency, low haze, low modulus and high rebound resilience, and becomes an ideal choice for preparing raw materials of optical adhesive, thus having great application prospect in the fields of optical devices such as liquid crystal display screens, organic light-emitting diodes (OLED), mobile phones, cameras and the like.

title_en: Epoxy pouring sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epoxy pouring sealant and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adhesives. The epoxy pouring sealant is obtained by mixing a composition A and a composition B, wherein the mass ratio of the composition A to the composition B is (1-5): 1. The invention also provides a preparation method of the epoxy pouring sealant, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a composition A: mixing bisphenol A type epoxy resin, liquid epoxy resin and nano core-shell toughening agent, and then adding a coupling agent, first wollastonite and carbon black for dispersion to obtain a composition A; preparation of composition B: stirring the first curing agent, the second curing agent and the accelerator, and then adding the second wollastonite for dispersion to obtain a composition B; s2, mixing the composition A and the composition B to obtain the epoxy pouring sealant. The epoxy pouring sealant provided by the invention has the excellent performances of high toughness and cracking resistance.

title_en: Polyether water-based viscosity reducer for oil field and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petrochemical assistants for oil field development, and discloses a polyether water-based viscosity reducer for an oil field, a preparation method and application thereof. The viscosity reducer consists of polyoxyethylene polyether, fluorocarbon surfactant, oleic acid diethanolamide, stabilizer and solvent; the preparation method comprises three steps of preparing the lactic acid glyceride, preparing the lactic acid glyceride polyoxyethylene polyether and preparing the viscosity reducer. The viscosity reducer has the outstanding characteristics of good compatibility, small dosage and high viscosity reduction rate; the oil reservoir oil recovery agent has strong adaptability to oil reservoirs, can be widely applied to the field of viscosity reduction of thickened oil, and can effectively improve the oil recovery speed and recovery ratio of the thickened oil; the method has no influence on the crude oil pipe conveying process, and effectively improves the conveying efficiency.

title_en: Molecular filter membrane composting fermentation system and fermentation process
abstract_en: The application relates to a molecular filter membrane compost fermentation system and fermentation technology relates to the technical field of agricultural waste pollution-free recovery processing, wherein, a molecular filter membrane compost fermentation system is including piling up fermentation tank that has fermentation material and setting up filter membrane system, ventilation system and intelligent control system around the fermentation tank, and filter membrane system is including covering the molecular filter membrane on fermentation material in the fermentation tank, and ventilation system is used for carrying out the oxygen suppliment to fermentation material in fermentation tank bottom, intelligent control system and ventilation system signal connection, and intelligent control system is used for controlling ventilation system and opens and close. The organic matter composting fermentation device has the effect of conveniently completing composting fermentation of organic matters and reducing the influence on the environment.

title_en: Catalytic conversion method for producing light aromatic hydrocarbon
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalytic conversion method for producing light aromatic hydrocarbon, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of sending light raw oil into a first reactor to contact a first catalyst for first catalytic conversion to obtain a first catalyst to be stripped and a first rising oil gas product, and carrying out first stripping on the first catalyst to be stripped to obtain a first catalyst to be regenerated and a first stripped product; the first reactor is a bubbling fluidized bed reactor or a turbulent fluidized bed reactor; and sending the first rising oil gas product and the first stripping product into a riser reactor, contacting the riser reactor with a second catalyst, contacting the riser reactor with heavy raw oil to perform second catalytic conversion to obtain a material after the second catalytic conversion, and performing gas-solid separation and stripping on the material after the second catalytic conversion to obtain a second oil gas product and a second spent catalyst. Through the technical scheme, the conversion rate and selectivity of the catalytic conversion for producing the light aromatic hydrocarbon are effectively improved.

title_en: Pseudomonas with broad-spectrum resistance to plant pathogenic bacteria and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses aPseudomonas for broad-spectrum plant pathogen resistance and application thereof relate to the technical field of microorganisms, and the technical scheme is as follows: the Pseudomonas is named as Pseudomonas FP607 strain and is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center with the preservation number of CGMCC No.27743. The pseudomonas FP607 has remarkable inhibition effect on bacterial leaf blight bacteria, bacterial canker bacteria of tomatoes, bacterial leaf spot bacteria of rice, black rot bacteria of cruciferae, acidophilic bacteria of watermelons and ralstonia solanacearum; p.wuhanensis FP607 can produce siderophores and NH  3  And secretion of auxin, etc., thereby effectively improving soil nutrient environment and being beneficial to plant growth; the P.wuhanensis FP607 is a plant rhizosphere probiotics which is easy to culture, convenient to preserve, broad-spectrum, efficient and environment-friendly, and has the prospect of being used as a novel microorganism resource for development and application.

title_en: Electrochromic device with high-low temperature tolerance
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrochromic device with strong high-low temperature tolerance. The electrochromic device with high and low temperature tolerance comprises: a first transparent electrode, an electrochromic layer, a composite gel electrolyte layer, and a second transparent electrode laminated in this order; the composite gel electrolyte layer is obtained by coating and solidifying a mixed solution obtained by mixing an alginate solution and resin slurry containing cations.

title_en: Glossy privet seed setting inhibitor containing gibberellic acid and naphthylacetic acid and protective net thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glossy privet seed setting inhibitor containing gibberellic acid and naphthylacetic acid and a protective net thereof, which relate to the technical field of glossy privet seed setting inhibition and comprise the following raw materials in parts by weight: spraying 3-6 parts of gibberellic acid, 4-8 parts of naphthylacetic acid and 86-93 parts of water in the full bloom stage of glossy privet, and achieving the aim of inhibiting glossy privet seed setting by changing the proportion of raw materials and a matched control ring; the invention has strong practicality, the structure is safer to the glossy privet, the fallen leaf risk is reduced, the use in the full bloom stage is very convenient and efficient, the effect of inhibiting the seed setting of the glossy privet is better, meanwhile, the artificial damage to the glossy privet is prevented, the pollution to the environment caused by the falling of fruit pulp is prevented, and the impurity after the falling of the glossy privet petals is collected.

title_en: Organic compound, application thereof and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic electroluminescent devices, and discloses an organic compound and application thereof, and an organic electroluminescent device, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula (1). The organic compound of the invention has lower driving voltage and higher luminous efficiency when being used as a red light main body material in an organic electroluminescent device.

title_en: Low-density ceramsite propping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of petroleum and natural gas exploitation, and particularly relates to a low-density ceramsite proppant and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, calcining oil sludge dry slag at a high temperature for standby, S2, mixing the oil sludge dry slag calcined at the high temperature with titanium-containing blast furnace slag to obtain a mixture, S3, crushing and granulating the mixture obtained in the step S2, sintering in a rotary kiln, and then transferring into a cooling device for quenching to obtain the low-density ceramsite propping agent. According to the preparation method of the low-density ceramsite proppant, the oil sludge dry slag and the titanium-containing blast furnace slag are used as raw materials to prepare the low-density ceramsite proppant, other materials are not doped, so that the waste recycling is realized, and the requirement of the low-density ceramsite proppant for bauxite resources is reduced. In addition, the invention adopts the titanium-containing blast furnace slag to provide titanium as a coagulation core formed by microcrystals, shortens the crystallization time, greatly reduces the time required by sintering and reduces the sintering cost.

title_en: Aqueous adhesive for lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of aqueous adhesives, and particularly provides a lithium ion battery aqueous adhesive. The lithium ion battery aqueous adhesive is formed by mixing a first aqueous solution containing a first polymer, a second aqueous solution containing a second polymer and a third aqueous solution containing a third polymer, comprehensively exerts the different performance characteristics of the three polymers, realizes high dispersibility of active particles of a negative electrode material, and has the advantages of good stability of the obtained slurry, high adhesion to a pole piece, high cohesive force, flexible pole piece and low impedance of a final pole piece, thereby bringing low internal resistance to an electric core.

title_en: Water-soluble lubricating fluid for hot rolling and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-soluble lubricating fluid for hot rolling and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of rolling lubrication. The lubricating liquid comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 1-10% of high-temperature lubricating grease; 80.4 to 4 percent of span; 0.05 to 0.075 percent of oleic acid diethanolamine; 0.1 to 0.2 percent of triethanolamine oleate; 0.01 to 0.05 percent of bactericide; fe (Fe)  3  O  4  0.1 to 1.5 percent of nano particles and the balance of water. Through the synergistic emulsification of Tween 80, oleic acid diethanolamine and oleic acid triethanolamine, stable and uniform liquid is formed, and good lubricity and cooling performance are achieved; the problem of deterioration of the lubricating liquid caused by microbial contamination is avoided by adding the bactericide; by adding Fe  3  O  4  The nano particles improve the lubricating effect of the lubricating fluid at high temperature. In addition, the lubricating liquid can be prepared into lubricating liquids with different concentrations and different lubricating effects according to actual rolling requirements. The hot rolling oil supply device is simple and convenient to use, ensures the cooling of the roller, has a lubricating function, and does not need a special hot rolling oil supply system.

title_en: All-bio-based formaldehyde-free adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-biology-based formaldehyde-free adhesive and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of biomass refining. The preparation method of the formaldehyde-free adhesive comprises the following steps: s1, evaporating and concentrating a biomass extract, and then carrying out dehydration reaction; s2, adding a proper amount of alkali into the reaction system, and carrying out a crosslinking reaction on the in-situ generated bio-based aldehyde substance and lignin under the catalysis of sodium hydroxide to obtain the formaldehyde-free adhesive. Compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention uses biomass extract as a raw material, adopts a one-pot method to prepare the formaldehyde-free adhesive, is simple in process, environment-friendly and low in cost, and has good popularization and application values.

title_en: High-temperature suspension stabilizer for well cementation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of suspension stabilizers, in particular to a high-temperature suspension stabilizer for well cementation and a preparation method thereof, wherein N, N-dimethylacrylamide with high temperature resistance and self-made long-chain alkyl silicone oil with hydrophobic property are added in the process of a high-temperature-resistant anionic copolymer and a high-temperature-resistant cationic copolymer, so that the prepared high-temperature-resistant anionic copolymer and the prepared high-temperature-resistant cationic copolymer respectively have relatively stable high-temperature resistance and hydrophobic property, and then the high-temperature resistant anionic copolymer and the high-temperature resistant cationic copolymer are compounded through the strong electrostatic action between positive and negative ions, so that a tight cross-linked network structure can be formed between polymer molecules, thereby suspending cement particles, keeping the molecular structure unchanged at high temperature, having better thickening effect and high-temperature resistance, and the added Gao Wensuo-resistant methylcellulose can improve the suspension stability of the high-temperature suspension stabilizer for well cementation.

title_en: Natural gas tail gas treatment device based on decorating paper production
abstract_en: The application relates to a natural gas tail gas treatment device based on decorating paper production, which belongs to the technical field of activated carbon adsorption and comprises an adsorption tower and a desorption tower which are rotationally connected; a plurality of storage pipes for containing active carbon are arranged in the adsorption tower and the desorption tower in a sliding way; a filter cavity is arranged in the adsorption tower; a plurality of accommodating cavities are arranged in the desorption tower; the inner peripheral surface of the filter cavity is provided with a first guide groove, and a first transmission sheet is arranged in the first guide groove in a sliding manner; a magnetic sheet I is fixedly connected in the guide groove I; a magnetic attraction piece I which can be magnetically attracted with the magnetic sheet I is fixedly connected on the transmission piece I; a magnetic sheet II is fixedly connected to the first transmission sheet, and a magnetic suction sheet II which can be adsorbed by the magnetic sheet II is fixedly connected to the storage tube; the inner peripheral surface of the accommodating cavity is provided with a second guide groove, and a second transmission plate is arranged in the second guide groove in a sliding manner; a magnetic sheet III is fixedly connected in the guide groove II, and a magnetic attraction sheet III which can be attracted with the magnetic sheet III is fixedly connected on the top surface of the transmission sheet II; and a magnetic sheet IV which can be adsorbed with the magnetic attraction sheet II is fixedly connected on the transmission sheet II. The application has the effect of automatically replacing the activated carbon.

title_en: Compound, functional material, electronic element and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, and discloses a compound, a functional material, an electronic element and an electronic device. The compound has the following structural general formula: wherein ring A is an alicyclic ring, and the number of carbon atoms in the alicyclic ring is e; r is R  4  Selected from deuterium or deuterium substituted R  8  A group. The compound is formed by connecting deuterated alkyl fluorene and nitrogen heterocycle, has the advantages of good film forming property, good optical, electrical and thermal stability, high luminous efficiency, low voltage, long service life and the like, can be used in organic light-emitting devices, and particularly has potential application prospects in various industries such as AMOLED (active matrix organic light-emitting diode) and the like as a hole blocking layer material or an electron transport material layer.

title_en: Saline-alkali soil improvement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a saline-alkali soil improvement method, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out engineering improvement on a saline-alkali soil block in the early stage, then carrying out preliminary thawing on the soil of a spring cultivation layer, uniformly spreading a biological organic fertilizer of a music fertilizer on the saline-alkali soil block, carrying out rotary tillage and ploughing, then carrying out field soaking and salt washing operation on the saline-alkali soil block, then carrying out air-curing and spreading a microbial inoculum for the saline-alkali soil improvement, ploughing, covering a mulching film, planting crops, spraying a microbial compound beneficial bacteria nutritional agent in the critical growth period of the crops, carrying out the biological organic fertilizer of the music fertilizer before the soil is frozen in autumn after the crops are harvested in the same year, then carrying out ploughing and sun-drying, and carrying out rotary tillage and smashing after the soil of spring cultivation is thawed. According to the invention, desalination and alkali reduction treatment are carried out on saline-alkali soil blocks, then saline-alkali soil is improved by utilizing microorganisms, finally physiological regulation and control are carried out on planted crops, healthy soil environment is restored and rebuilt, soil alkalinity is reduced, soil structure is improved rapidly, soil evapotranspiration is reduced, high efficiency and water saving are realized, and high yield of planted crops in saline-alkali soil is realized.

title_en: Reactive zero-valent palladium fluorescent probe compound and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reactive zero-valent palladium fluorescent probe based on BDP dye molecules and a synthetic method thereof, wherein the structural formula of the reactive zero-valent palladium fluorescent probe is shown as formula I:  Wherein r=h or NH  2 . The probe is a first reactive zero-valent palladium fluorescent probe based on BDP dye molecules, the preparation method is simple and efficient, the fluorescent response is obvious and rapid, the change of the fluorescent intensity from on to off can be completed within 8 minutes, the probe has extremely high sensitivity and the detection limit is as low as 0.3ppb, and the probe has high selectivity to zero-valent palladium and has no obvious response to divalent palladium ions and other 18 interference metal cations.

title_en: Formula and production process of functional PET (polyethylene terephthalate) coating glue
abstract_en: The invention provides a functional PET coating glue formula and a production process thereof, comprising the following steps: and cleaning the workpiece, clamping the workpiece, starting a heat treatment furnace to heat treat the workpiece, introducing ammonia gas, and quenching and tempering the workpiece twice. According to the method, the workpiece is subjected to nitriding heat treatment in the ammonia atmosphere, so that the surface of the workpiece is nitrided, the surface hardness of the workpiece is obviously improved, and the wear resistance, corrosion resistance and fatigue resistance of the workpiece are improved; the invention sets two quenching and tempering procedures, the two quenching procedures can obviously enhance the internal hardness of the workpiece, and the tempering procedure can eliminate the stress generated by quenching.

title_en: Condensed ring organic compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of light-emitting devices, and provides a condensed ring organic compound, a preparation method and application thereof. The electron acceptor on the rigid plane is connected with various aromatic ring derivatives to form electron groups through Ullmann reaction, a sigma single bond connection closed ring structure is further formed through Heck reaction, the obtained molecular structure is flat, HOMO and LUMO energy level electron clouds form obvious trend, a singlet-triplet state energy gap (delta E  ST ) is large, high-energy triplet state excitons can form luminous singlet state excitons through reverse interstitial leap (RISC), and the series of molecules have obvious hybridization local charge transfer excited state properties. The organic electroluminescent device prepared from the condensed ring organic compound has high brightness, low starting voltage and high maximum external quantum efficiency. The condensed ring organic compound of the present invention has excellent light-emitting performance.

title_en: Self-assembled polymer material for mesenchymal stem cell encapsulation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-assembled polymer material for mesenchymal stem cell encapsulation, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the self-assembled polymer material comprises a hyaluronic acid main chain and a short peptide side chain; the structure of the short peptide comprises: naphthalene-phenylalanine-lysine-phosphorylated tyrosine residues. The hyaluronic acid in the self-assembled polymer material provided by the invention can be specifically combined with the mesenchymal stem cell surface membrane protein CD44, so that the polymer material targets the mesenchymal stem cell membrane surface. The short peptide molecule initiates a self-assembly process under the catalysis of alkaline phosphatase, and is crosslinked on the surface of a cell membrane to form a fiber network structure, so that the encapsulation of cells is completed. The self-assembly material provided by the invention can be used for preparing self-assembly natural polymer nanofibers driven by short peptides and hydrogel coatings for encapsulating mesenchymal stem cells, and raw materials used in the preparation process are all natural materials, so that the normal functions and the activity of the cells are maintained.

title_en: Noctilucent film and processing equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of noctilucent film processing, and discloses a noctilucent film and processing equipment thereof, wherein the noctilucent film comprises a base and a rolling mechanism; the utility model provides a roll-in mechanism, including first motor, first gear, compression roller, second gear, flower roller, drive assembly and impression mechanism, the upside of base is provided with first gear, one side of first gear is through connecting axle fixedly connected with flower roller, be provided with the even knurling of distribution on the flower roller, the upside meshing of first gear has the second gear, one side of second gear is through connecting axle fixedly connected with compression roller, first gear, second gear are provided with two with flower roller, compression roller symmetry respectively, compression roller, flower roller are provided with two, impression mechanism is one side flower roller provides the coating, one side flower roller realizes the impression operation to the film, the opposite side flower roller realizes the impression operation to the film, through its cooperation operation, and then realizes carrying out automated production to the night light film.

title_en: Environment-friendly copolymer emulsion for decoration and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly copolymer emulsion for decoration and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of copolymer emulsion and comprise the following components in percentage by weight: 4 to 6 percent of emulsion colloid, 6 to 15 percent of polymer monomer, 5 to 8 percent of starch, 2 to 5 percent of filler, 0.1 to 0.3 percent of initiator, 0.2 to 0.5 percent of plasticizer, 0.1 to 0.3 percent of bactericide and 64.2 to 82.35 percent of deionized water; 0.1 to 0.3 percent of pH value regulator; 0.1 to 0.3 percent of emulsifying agent; 0.05 to 0.1 percent of defoaming agent; the preparation method of the copolymer emulsion comprises the procedures of dissolution, pulping, polymerization, gelatinization, plasticization and the like, and the copolymer emulsion is environment-friendly, nontoxic and easy to degrade, has high peel strength and good adhesion, and has the advantages of low water absorption, good impermeability, high temperature resistance, good stability such as freeze thawing resistance, dilution by a mechanical stirrer, stable emulsion property, good hydrophobicity, strong durability and wide application.

title_en: Method for preparing high-viscosity lubricating oil base oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydroisomerization of coal-based liquefied products, and particularly relates to a method for preparing high-viscosity lubricating oil base oil, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of taking a coal indirect liquefied product as a raw material, contacting the coal indirect liquefied product with a modified hydroisomerization catalyst, and carrying out isomerization dewaxing reaction to obtain high-viscosity base oil with the brand number of 10cSt and above; the indirect coal liquefaction product is one or more of full fraction of Fischer-Tropsch refined bottom-reducing oil/cracked bottom-reducing oil and heavy narrow fraction of Fischer-Tropsch refined bottom-reducing oil/cracked bottom-reducing oil; the modified hydroisomerization catalyst comprises an active component and a carrier, wherein the carrier comprises a composite molecular sieve, and the composite molecular sieve is a combination of 30-80wt% of ZSM-48 molecular sieve and 20-70wt% of MCM-41 molecular sieve. The method of the invention can produce high-viscosity base oil with the brand number of 10cSt and above with high selectivity and high yield.

title_en: Environment-friendly ice bag and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly ice bag and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the ice bag comprises a bag body with a three-layer structure, a binding belt and a microcapsule bag, the microcapsule bag is accommodated in a sealing layer in the bag body, a solution is also arranged in the sealing layer, the microcapsule bag is soaked in the solution, and a palmitic acid-graphite composite material is coated in the microcapsule bag.

title_en: Combined regulator for relieving long-term low-temperature stress and promoting germination of rice seeds and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, and particularly discloses a combined regulator for relieving long-term low-temperature stress and promoting rice seed germination and application thereof, wherein the effective components of the combined regulator consist of 5-10mg/L gibberellin and 0.4-0.6% Chitosan (CS). The optimal initiator is selected by adopting a method of combining the non-hormonal regulator and the osmotic regulator, namely 10mg/L gibberellin and 0.5% chitosan combined regulator, so that the mixed initiator not only has higher germination rate (94.67%) in low-temperature environment, but also has higher germination index (40.63), and the germination index is obviously larger than that of the common regulator, and the mixed initiator is particularly suitable for being used in areas with longer duration of 'cold in the back spring' or longer duration of low temperature in sowing seasons.

title_en: Heterogeneous nano heterojunction photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous nano heterojunction photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein carbon quantum dots (CDs) are introduced through doping technology to modify the surface of a g-C3N4 photocatalyst, and the CDs/g-C3N4 composite photocatalyst is free from conventional metal catalysis, simple in preparation process, low in cost and capable of being recycled repeatedly for multiple times without deactivation, so that the catalyst becomes a novel composite photocatalyst with very good prospects in the technical field of visible light catalytic oxidation. The catalyst has good benefits when applied to the selective catalytic oxidation of visible light to synthesize a drug lenalidomide key intermediate 3- (4-nitro-1-oxo-1, 3-dihydro-2H-isoindole-2-yl) piperidine-2, 6-dione.

title_en: Flaky zinc powder, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of flaky zinc powder, which comprises the following steps: step S1, ball milling: carrying out wet ball milling on raw zinc powder to obtain ball milling slurry; step S2, dispersing: diluting and ultrasonically dispersing the ball-milling slurry to obtain pre-dispersed slurry; step S3, sectional centrifugation: sequentially carrying out N-section centrifugal separation on the pre-dispersed slurry, wherein the centrifugal rotation speed adopted in each section centrifugal separation process is sequentially increased, and N is more than or equal to 3; step S4, drying: and (3) drying the solid obtained by centrifugal separation in the 2 nd to N-1 th sections to obtain the flaky zinc powder. According to the technical scheme, sectional centrifugation and solid-liquid separation are organically combined together, so that the steps of air flow classification or screening are better replaced, the equipment dependence is reduced, and zinc powder oxidation caused in the traditional classification process is effectively avoided.

title_en: Fluorescent probe for detecting heavy water content in water
abstract_en: The application discloses a fluorescent probe for detecting heavy water content in water in the field of fluorescent dyes, which is based on intramolecular charge transfer effect, wherein a charge acceptor is hydroxy tricyanopyrrole, and a charge donor is phenol and derivatives thereof, and the structure is shown as follows: the fluorescent molecule is synthesized by organic reaction, has a simple structure and a definite chemical structure, is low in preparation cost and is easy to popularize. The probe comprises two kinds of fat-soluble fluorescent molecules and two kinds of water-soluble fluorescent molecules, and based on the difference of pH values of light water and heavy water, phenolic hydroxyl groups are used as response sites, and the probes are specific to the heavy waterThe water has high sensitivity, not only can judge the approximate content of heavy water through color change, but also can rapidly and accurately measure the heavy water content through absorption or fluorescence emission spectrum, has wide detection linear range (0-100% of heavy water content), basically does not interfere with other components in the detection process, and has good application prospect in the detection and imaging fields.

title_en: Triphenylethylene-xanthene derivative, preparation method and viscosity detection fluorescent probe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical sensing imaging detection, in particular to a triphenylethylene-xanthene derivative, a preparation method and a viscosity detection fluorescent probe. The triphenylethylene-xanthene derivative has a general formula shown in a formula I: the synthetic triphenylethylene-xanthene derivatives have a greater stokes shift compared to rhodamine B. In addition, the fluorescence intensity of the triphenylethylene-xanthene derivative increases with an increase in viscosity in cells. In addition, the triphenylethylene-xanthene derivative can be further used for detecting mitochondrial viscosityThe mitochondria targeting is good. In a word, the probe improves Stokes shift, has wide pH value range of optical response and excellent mitochondrial targeting.

title_en: Ionizing radiation resistant high-thermal-conductivity phase-change microcapsule and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an ionizing radiation resistant high-thermal conductivity phase-change microcapsule, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the phase-change microcapsule comprises a shell layer and a phase-change core material, the shell layer consists of barium carbonate and hydrophobically modified graphene, and the core material consists of n-octadecane and n-eicosane. The phase-change microcapsule has the anti-ionizing radiation performance, high shell heat conductivity and sensitivity to environmental temperature change, can be applied to the anti-ionizing radiation and temperature control walls of specific places such as medical C-T chamber walls, and can well meet the requirements of multifunctional engineering applicability.

title_en: Energy-saving engine oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lubricating oil, and relates to energy-saving engine oil with low ash content and high compatibility for an internal combustion engine. The acrylic resin microsphere antiwear liquid grafted with graphene oxide has high stability, and the energy-saving engine oil containing the resin microsphere antiwear liquid comprises base oil, a lubricant, the resin microsphere antiwear liquid, an antioxidant, a viscosity index improver, a pour point depressant and the like. The engine oil has better bearing capacity and extreme pressure resistance through the acrylic resin compounded resin microsphere anti-wear liquid with medium molecular weight, and changes the deposited oil sludge into valuables in long-term use, and the deposited oil sludge forms a stable protective layer with good heat insulation performance on the metal surface of the engine, so that the working efficiency of the engine is improved, the engine oil is stable in performance, more energy-saving and environment-friendly, and the oil change period is prolonged.

title_en: In-situ self-generated large-size nano-sheet reinforced and toughened hydrogen permeation resistant coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an in-situ self-generated large-size nano-sheet reinforced and toughened hydrogen permeation resistant coating and a preparation method thereof, which can be suitable for permeation of hydrogen and isotopes thereof in various hydrogen-related fields such as fusion reactor cladding module structure materials, hydrogen storage devices and the like. The composite coating takes phosphate and alumina powder as precursors, and aluminum phosphate nano-sheets are generated in situ in the coating. The composite coating combines the hydrogen/deuterium/tritium permeation resistance characteristics of phosphate and alumina, and not only improves the hydrogen/deuterium/tritium resistance of the coating, but also improves the fracture toughness of the coating by nearly 5 times and prolongs the service life of the coating through the reinforcing and toughening effects of the in-situ authigenic nano-sheet. The preparation process of the slurry dipping and lifting can be suitable for coating the surface of the material with the complex structure, and the practical value of the composite coating is greatly improved. The whole process method is simple, healthy and environment-friendly, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Coating for superfine fine wire ultrathin insulating coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wire enamel, and discloses a coating for a superfine fine wire ultrathin insulating coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials of the coating comprise 40-60 parts of matrix resin, 18-23 parts of modified polyimide epoxy resin, 3-5 parts of photoinitiator, 0.1-0.5 part of adhesion promoter and the balance of filler, the coating can form a film of the ultrathin insulating coating in a photo-curing mode, the film forming speed is high, the temperature is low, the film thickness is 2-5 mu m, the prepared wire enamel is not cracked in a winding test, the thermal shock is not cracked at 1D 155 ℃ for 30min, the salt water pinhole of a paint film with the length of 30m is 0, the breakdown voltage is 5700V-6000V, and the paint film performance is excellent; the modified polyimide epoxy resin is introduced into the matrix resin to achieve the effects of reducing the viscosity of the matrix resin and increasing the film performance of the insulating paint film after film formation.

title_en: Near infrared fluorescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near infrared fluorescent material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chemical general formula of the near infrared fluorescent material is GdAL  1‑x  Ni  x  D  x  O  3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Wherein x is more than 0 and less than or equal to 0.02; the D is a metal element, and the valence of the metal element is +4. The near infrared fluorescent powder provided by the invention emits 900-1300nm near infrared light under the excitation of 588nm, and can meet the requirements of near infrared illumination and detection. On the other hand, the near infrared fluorescent powder has excellent thermal stability, still keeps the emission intensity of room temperature to 100% at the working temperature of an LED (about 150 ℃), and does not show any obvious loss.

title_en: Preparation process of special magnesium oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of special magnesium oxide, which relates to the technical field of special magnesium oxide preparation and comprises the following steps of crushing magnesite, processing into a plurality of ore blocks, screening ore blocks with high magnesium content, further crushing, setting the initial rotating speed of a converter, starting the converter and preheating, pouring the ore blocks into the converter, continuously heating the converter, closing the converter and stopping heating when the temperature and the heating time of the converter reach requirements, finishing the first firing of the magnesium oxide after the converter is cooled to the ambient temperature, resetting the rotating speed of the converter, starting the converter and heating, closing the converter and stopping heating when the temperature and the heating time of the converter reach requirements, cooling the converter to the ambient temperature, taking out the repeatedly fired special magnesium oxide, mixing and bagging to finish the preparation of the special magnesium oxide. The invention adopts the repeated calcination method, and the prepared magnesia has higher catalytic performance, thereby improving the combustion performance of the double-base propellant.

title_en: Processing method of fertilizer particles for relieving scab of coating roller
abstract_en: The invention provides a fertilizer granule processing method for relieving scab of a coated roller, which comprises the following steps: after the coating roller is arranged, starting a coating roller speed reducer, adjusting the rotating speed of the coating roller to be 6-8rpm, and throwing fertilizer particles from a material inlet, wherein the throwing amount of the fertilizer particles per minute is matched with the rotating speed of the coating roller; starting a coating oil spraying device and coating powder conveying equipment, wherein the adding ratio of the coating oil to the coating powder is 1:2-1:3. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the proper addition positions of the coating oil and the coating powder are found out, and the retainer ring is matched to realize the full coating of the materials, and meanwhile, the addition amount of the coating oil and the coating powder is reduced; the optimal spraying angle and atomization degree of the coated oil are explored, and the maximization of the quality of the coated oil is realized; the optimal rotating speed among different varieties and yields is explored by adjusting the rotating speed of the coating roller; the addition quantity and proportion of the coating oil and the coating powder are adjusted, and the problem of scabbing inside the coating roller is relieved to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method and device for producing round granular large-particle ammonium sulfate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for producing round granular large-particle ammonium sulfate. The device comprises an adsorption unit, a crystallization unit and a separation unit, wherein the crystallization unit comprises a crystallizer, a vapor recompression system, a circulating mother liquor heater and an acid-base regulating unit; the separation unit comprises a thickener and a centrifugal drying part, and the overflow surface at the upper end of the thickener is also connected with the boiling surface of the crystallizer through a pipeline. The present application also provides a method for producing large-particle ammonium sulfate by the above device. The device and the method of the application improve the duty ratio of the ammonium sulfate particles with the diameter of more than or equal to 2.0mm and the yield of large-particle ammonium sulfate while saving the steam consumption.

title_en: Methanol fuel for high-cleanness vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-cleanness methanol fuel for a vehicle, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 75.00-80.00% of methanol, 18-20% of dimethylbenzene, 1.10-2.50% of polyalcohol, 0.20-0.80% of polyisobutylene succinimide and 0.02-0.05% of benzotriazole; the methanol fuel for the high-clean vehicle is prepared from methanol, dimethylbenzene, polyalcohol, polyisobutylene succinimide and benzotriazole, has strong fuel power, does not have corrosion effects on an oil pump, an oil way system and an oil nozzle, has the swelling effect on plastics equivalent to that of gasoline, is safe, energy-saving and environment-friendly, and is a renewable fuel, and the renewable fuel has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low price, no toxicity, no harm, high heat value, low energy consumption, low condensation point and high flash point, and completely accords with the national policy.

title_en: Long-acting antiviral water-based paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a long-acting antiviral water-based paint which comprises, by mass, 40-60 parts of water-based acrylic resin, 10-25 parts of plant antiviral components, 1-3 parts of dispersing agents, 1-2 parts of wetting agents, 1-3 parts of defoamers, 1-3 parts of preservatives, 5-10 parts of auxiliary agents, 10-20 parts of fillers and 20-40 parts of water, wherein the plant antiviral components are obtained by enzymolysis of plant raw materials by means of complex enzymes, the complex enzymes comprise alpha-amylase, xylanase, cellulase and pectase, and the plant raw materials comprise sweet wormwood, garden balsam stem, common andrographis herb and perilla. In the water-based paint provided by the invention, the plant antiviral component obtained by introducing complex enzyme to carry out enzymolysis on specific plant raw materials has remarkable antiviral activity and antiviral long-acting performance on viruses such as influenza A virus (H3N 2), enterovirus (EV 71) and the like, so that the paint has excellent long-acting antiviral efficacy.

title_en: Novel method for preparing carbon point with capability of detecting Fe < 3+ > and ascorbic acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon dots with Fe < 3+ > and ascorbic acid capabilities, and discloses a novel method for preparing the carbon dots with the capability of detecting Fe < 3+ > and ascorbic acid, which comprises the following detailed preparation steps and methods of the carbon dots: s1: 15g of Chili prune and 15g of golden melon are weighed, smashed and uniformly mixed, and put into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, and S2: the reaction kettle is placed in an oven and heated for 6 hours at the constant temperature of 150 ℃, and then the temperature is reduced to 25 ℃, S3: the brown solution obtained was put into a dialysis bag of 500Da and put into a beaker with 2L of ultrapure water for dialysis to remove impurities, thereby obtaining a carbon dot solution. The novel method for preparing the carbon dots with the capability of detecting the Fe & lt3+ & gt and the ascorbic acid takes Chili prune and golden melon as precursors, and the carbon dots of the Fe & lt3+ & gt and the AA in the Chili prune juice are prepared by a hydrothermal method, and the raw materials are simple and easy to obtain, are simple and convenient to prepare and can be quantitatively detected.

title_en: Laminating adhesive composition
abstract_en: A fire retardant polyurethane-based laminating adhesive composition comprising: (a) at least one polyol component; and (b) at least one polyisocyanate component; and (c) at least one alkoxysilane hydrolysate or at least one aryloxysilane hydrolysate; wherein the fire retardant polyurethane-based laminating adhesive composition has a fire rating of HB in the UL94HB test; a process for preparing the above-described fire retardant adhesive composition; and a method of bonding two substrates together using the above-described fire retardant adhesive composition.

title_en: Biomass complex ester total synthesis base oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of base oil, in particular to biomass complex ester total synthesis base oil and a preparation method thereof, wherein the biomass complex ester total synthesis base oil is prepared by polymerizing pentaerythritol, isomerism acid, polyacid and diacid through esterification reaction, and the mole ratio of the pentaerythritol, isomerism acid, polyacid and diacid is 1:2-5:0.1-1:0.1-0.3, the preparation method comprises a one-step synthesis method and a two-step synthesis method, the complex ester total synthesis base oil prepared by the invention has lower condensation point and pour point, the degree of influence of temperature on the viscosity of the oil is lower, and the viscosity index is higher; the engine oil suitable for winter and extremely cold areas or high-temperature environment engine oil can be prepared through fine adjustment of a synthesis scheme; viscosity index of 160 or more; CCS (-30 ℃) apparent viscosity is lower than 5500 viscosity units; iron ion content in antiwear experiment is 20-70; the evaporation loss is 5% -7%; the test value of the rotary oxygen bomb is between 260 and 550, and the excellent oxidation stability is shown.

title_en: Axial chiral luminescent material with double luminescent centers and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of organic luminescent materials, and relates to a novel axial chiral luminescent material containing double luminescent centers, and a synthesis method and application thereof. Compared with the existing fluorescent material, the series of double-luminescence center materials not only have the advantages of high luminescence efficiency, stable chemical property, easy sublimation and purification and the like, but also have larger steric hindrance on the periphery due to the introduction of the octahydrobinaphthyl structure, so that the molecular accumulation is effectively inhibited, and the luminescence efficiency is improved; on the other hand, the octahydrobinaphthyl skeleton has circular polarization luminescence property due to the axial chiral characteristic brought by the octahydrobinaphthyl skeleton.
