In addition, through modifying the conjugated nitrogen heterocyclic structure, the luminous position and luminous efficiency of the material can be adjusted in the visible light wavelength range, which provides convenience for the design and production of the organic electroluminescent display and the illumination light source. Meanwhile, the synthesis method of the series of chiral materials with double luminous central axes is simple, the yield is high, and the chemical modification of the structure is flexible.

title_en: Natural adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural adhesive and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the application field of natural non-synthetic materials. The invention takes natural fresh tung fruit extrusion liquid as a core, and water, a thickening agent and an emulsifying agent are added to improve the performance of the glue. The natural adhesive is cheap in preparation raw materials, fully utilizes immature green tung fruits, and has the characteristics of high viscosity, good adhesiveness, environment friendliness and the like.

title_en: Deep profile control density controllable multistage expansion pre-crosslinked gel particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep profile control density controllable multistage expansion pre-crosslinked gel particle and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of oilfield chemistry, wherein the gel particle comprises: monomers (acrylamide, triphenyl ethyl phenol polyoxyethylene ether methacrylate), hydroquinone/hexamethylenetetramine with the mol ratio of 1:1, polyethylene glycol diacrylate, modified inorganic light additive and flexibilizer. The invention improves the strength of the pre-crosslinked gel particles through the toughening agent, controls the amount of the modified inorganic lightweight additive to realize the controllable density of the gel particles, delays the initial water absorption expansion process of the gel particles through the structure of the triphenyl ethyl phenol polyoxyethylene ether methacrylate, endows the gel particles with multistage expansion characteristics under different temperature conditions through the network structure formed by hydroquinone/hexamethylenetetramine and polyethylene glycol diacrylate, and solves the problems of sedimentation and expansion too fast, weak blocking strength and short migration distance of the gel particles in the crack channeling prevention process.

title_en: Water-coal-slurry additive and preparation method of water-coal-slurry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal water slurry additive and a preparation method of the coal water slurry. The preparation method of the coal water slurry additive comprises the following steps: (1) Performing ring-opening polymerization on the styrene oxide waste liquid under the action of an initiator, and controlling the polymerization degree of the styrene oxide waste liquid through an electrode; (2) Separating organic matters with a certain polymerization degree from water by using a high-efficiency extractant, and distilling to obtain a high-purity polymer; (3) And (3) carrying out sulfonation and hydrolysis treatment on the obtained high-purity polymer, and finally adjusting the pH value of the polymer to obtain the water-coal-slurry additive solution. Compared with the traditional additives such as lignin sulfonic acid system, naphthalene system and the like, the obtained water-coal-slurry additive has better dispersion effect and better fluidity, can prepare high-concentration water-coal-slurry, realizes recycling, changes waste into valuables, reduces carbon emission and reduces environmental pollution.

title_en: Petroleum hydrogenation catalytic reforming system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of petrochemical industry, in particular to a petroleum hydrogenation catalytic reforming system and a control method thereof, comprising the following steps: s1: firstly, removing impurities and moisture in raw oil by workers, then filling materials into a reaction device, heating the pretreated raw oil, and filling hydrogen to raise the oil temperature and maintain a certain hydrogen pressure; s2: under the action of a catalyst, carrying out catalytic reforming reaction on the heated raw oil to rearrange the molecular structure of hydrocarbons; s3: after reforming is finished, reaction products are separated to obtain reformed gasoline, liquefied petroleum gas and hydrogen, and the support disc structure is arranged, so that the design is simple and convenient to operate, and when materials are processed, the materials at the bottom can be upwards floated and mixed, so that the materials in the reactor body are uniformly mixed, and the processing quality is improved.

title_en: Acrylic ester base solution, preparation method thereof and plugging agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acrylic ester base solution, a preparation method thereof and a plugging agent, which solve the problems of low viscosity, insufficient temperature resistance, weak gel strength and poor bearing capacity of the existing acrylic ester base when being used for preparing the plugging agent, and the technical scheme comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing acrylic monomers and an initiator for polymerization reaction to obtain a polymerization solution; (2) Mixing the polymerization solution obtained in the step (1) with a stabilizer to obtain an initial solution; (3) Mixing the initial liquid obtained in the step (2) with acrylic ester monomers to obtain acrylic ester base liquid; the plugging agent comprises the acrylic ester base fluid, the initiator and the regulator, wherein the acrylic ester base fluid is prepared by the method and has good viscosity, good retention in a leakage stratum and difficult loss. The plugging agent containing the base liquid has high compressive strength, strong bearing capacity and excellent plugging effect.

title_en: Nanocomposite modified organic silica material reinforcing agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of silicon materials, and discloses a nanocomposite modified organic silica material reinforcing agent which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-6 parts of graphene oxide modified organic silicon resin, 88-92 parts of solvent, 0.2-0.5 part of pH regulator, 1-2 parts of surfactant, 0.1-0.8 part of transfer agent, 1-2 parts of flatting agent, 1-2 parts of wetting agent, 1-2 parts of defoamer, 0.1-0.3 part of filler, 0.1-0.2 part of coupling agent and 0.1-0.2 part of curing agent; wherein the solvent is one or a mixture of more of toluene, xylene, acetone, ethyl acetate and butyl acetate. The nano composite material modified organic silica material reinforcing agent has excellent adhesive force, water resistance, weather resistance and better high-temperature mechanical strength, and can be used for protective coating of stone cultural relics.

title_en: Protective film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of high polymer materials, in particular to a protective film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the protective film comprises a polyethylene matrix film, a pressure-sensitive adhesive and a release film; the polyethylene matrix film comprises the following components in parts by weight: 40-60 parts of polyethylene, 1-5 parts of maleic anhydride derivative, 10-20 parts of polystyrene-b-polyvinylpyrrolidone segmented copolymer, 5-10 parts of nanocellulose and 0.1-0.5 part of antioxidant.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant solvent-resistant ultrathin adhesive tape for shielding case and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of single-sided adhesive protection tapes, and discloses a high-temperature-resistant solvent-resistant ultrathin adhesive tape for a shielding case and a preparation method thereof; according to the invention, ultrathin polyimide is selected as a base material, an adhesive which is prepared by mixing and toughening acrylic resin solutions with different molecular weights, hydroxyethyl acrylate polymers, epoxy resin and isocyanate and has high-temperature-resistant viscosity stability is selected as an adhesive layer, and the adhesive is mixed with an organic silica gel adhesive and p-tert-butylphenol formaldehyde resin to prepare a primer which is used as a primer layer, so that the high-temperature-resistant solvent-resistant ultrathin adhesive tape is prepared. The adhesive tape has higher mechanical property, is not easy to tear and break in the punching process of the shielding case, and has stable stripping force at the high temperature of more than 300 ℃ in reflow soldering; the adhesive does not bulge in the process of cleaning and drying hydrocarbon cleaning liquid, and has excellent bonding stability; the adhesive tape is removed from the copper foil, the adhesive tape has good removability, and the adhesive residue rate of the adhesive tape is less than 3%.

title_en: Polyethylene cable conduit and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyethylene cable conduit and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of power cable accessory preparation. The polyethylene cable conduit comprises a conduit inner pipe and a protective layer arranged on the outer surface of the conduit inner pipe, wherein the conduit inner pipe is formed by cross-linking extrusion of high-density polyethylene and linear low-density polyethylene, the protective layer is formed by coating outer protective liquid and the like on the surface of the conduit inner pipe and cross-linking and curing, and the outer protective liquid comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 8-12 parts of vinyl end-sealing methylphenyl silicone oil, 0.24-0.48 part of methyl hydrogen-containing silicone oil, 0.06-0.1 part of platinum catalyst and 50-55 parts of outer filler, and the vinyl end-sealing methylphenyl silicone oil is utilized to form an organic silicon rubber protective layer with high strength on the surface of the inner tube of the conduit, so that the impact resistance, the surface wear resistance and the heat aging resistance of the cable conduit are improved.

title_en: Processing method of food container with patterns
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for processing a food container with a pattern, which comprises the following steps: taking a thermoplastic material for injection molding and processing into a planar product; treating the planar product to improve its surface adhesion; attaching a pattern to the surface of the treated planar product; heating the planar product with the pattern to soften the planar product; and processing the softened planar product into a required container for food containers. The method utilizes the characteristic that the thermoplastic material can be heated, softened and repeatedly molded, the material is initially processed into a planar product, then the pattern is attached to the surface of the planar product, the pattern is more conveniently processed on the planar product, the pattern effect of multicolor, fine and embossment is also facilitated to be realized, and compared with the pattern processing mode of the thermosetting material, the method is more favorable for manufacturing the product with the pattern fully covered on the surface.

title_en: Graphene anticorrosive paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene anticorrosive paint and a preparation method and application thereof. The graphene anticorrosive paint mainly comprises, by weight, 20-40 parts of epoxy resin, 25-50 parts of polyaniline modified hexagonal boron nitride, 20-50 parts of anticorrosive filler, 0.2-1.0 part of modified graphene slurry, 1-5 parts of an auxiliary agent, 10-20 parts of an organic solvent, 20-40 parts of a curing agent and the like. According to the invention, the modified graphene slurry is added into the epoxy resin, the two-dimensional lamellar graphene can improve the barrier property of the coating, and meanwhile, the graphene dispersing agent phytic acid in the slurry can not only passivate metal, but also can perform chelation reaction with rust on the surface of a metal substrate, so that the rust coating property of the coating is improved.

title_en: Films comprising aliphatic thermoplastic polyurethane and polyvinyl acetal useful as automotive films
abstract_en: Thermoplastic films suitable for use as automotive films are disclosed. The film includes a thermoplastic polymer layer comprising a thermoplastic polyurethane polymer and a polyvinyl acetal polymer. The film also includes a patterned adhesive layer. The thermoplastic film: a final load of about 0.02 to about 0.3 lbf when tested by the 25% thermal relaxation test at a thickness of about 0.006 inches; and when tested by the 25% elastic recovery test, exhibited a one minute residual strain of 2% or more.

title_en: Organic compound, organic electroluminescent device and electronic device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of organic electroluminescence, and relates to an organic compound, an organic electroluminescence device using the same and an electronic device.

title_en: Water-based color-mixing-free pigment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pigments, and discloses a water-based non-cross color pigment, which is characterized in that a nonionic color fixative, modified nano zinc oxide and modified tea polyphenol are added into the components of the pigment, so that the phenomenon that water-based pigments with different colors are easy to cross color when not completely dried is improved, the ultraviolet absorption performance of the water-based non-cross color pigment is enhanced, the ultraviolet aging phenomenon of the pigment under illumination is avoided, the corrosion resistance of the water-based non-cross color pigment is enhanced by adding natural antibacterial preservative tea polyphenol, the corrosion phenomenon generated after bacteria are bred on the surface of the pigment is avoided, and the antibacterial and anti-corrosion performance of the water-based non-cross color pigment is further enhanced by matching with the photocatalytic antibacterial effect of nano zinc oxide.

title_en: Method and system for treating caprolactam liquid phase rearrangement concentrated waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for treating caprolactam liquid phase rearrangement concentrated waste liquid, which ensure that the solubility of ammonium sulfate in the concentrated waste liquid is reduced by mixing a low-boiling point auxiliary agent and the concentrated waste liquid, so that the ammonium sulfate is separated out from the concentrated waste liquid, the ammonium sulfate is effectively removed, and the solid content in the concentrated waste liquid and the risk of corrosion to equipment are greatly reduced. And (3) mixing the low-boiling-point auxiliary agent with the concentrated waste liquid to obtain a solid-liquid mixture, and performing filter pressing to obtain an ammonium sulfate solid, thereby realizing recycling of ammonium sulfate. After the supernatant fluid obtained by mixing the low-boiling-point auxiliary agent and the concentrated waste liquid is rectified, the low-boiling-point auxiliary agent and most of low-COD and salt-free waste water can be recovered, and the recycling of the low-boiling-point auxiliary agent and water resources is realized. The waste oil obtained after rectification and desalination has high heat value, can be used as fuel to be sent to a gasification furnace for burning, fully utilizes the waste heat and improves the utilization rate; and also can reduce environmental pollution. The method and the system have simple principle, simple and convenient operation, low equipment investment and operation cost and suitability for popularization and application.

title_en: Continuous oil-water separation equipment for refining fish oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fish oil refining, in particular to continuous oil-water separation equipment for fish oil refining, which comprises a base, wherein an oil collecting box and a water collecting box which are mutually attached are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a separation tank is fixedly arranged at the tops of the oil collecting box and the water collecting box, and an evaporation tank is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the separation tank. This a continuous oil water separating equipment for fish oil is refined makes the motion track of puddler for longitudinal distribution through horizontal pivoted center pole, stirs the upper strata with the water that is located the lower floor, stirs the fish oil that is located the upper strata to the lower floor, so after the temperature of fish oil raw materials rises the gasification point of water, the moisture in the fish oil can be evaporated fast, forms vapor and has entered into in the condensation tank through communicating pipe, so through the different longitudinal stirring of cooperation puddler of boiling point of fish oil and water in the fish oil raw materials improvement fish oil raw materials oil water separating's speed and thoroughly.

title_en: Oxidative desulfurization catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxidative desulfurization catalyst which is lychee shell activated carbon loaded with phosphomolybdic acid; the litchi rind activated carbon is prepared by activating litchi rind carbon. According to the invention, phosphomolybdic acid is loaded on the litchi shell activated carbon carrier, so that the phosphomolybdic acid is combined with oxygen-containing functional groups on the surface of the litchi shell activated carbon, HPMo is highly dispersed on the surface of the litchi shell activated carbon carrier, more HPMo acid centers are provided for oxidation reaction, and the litchi shell activated carbon carrier has good catalytic oxidation desulfurization activity. According to the invention, an impregnation method is adopted for preparing the oxidative desulfurization catalyst, phosphomolybdic acid is easy to load on the surface of the litchi shell activated carbon, the Keggin structure of phosphomolybdic acid is not broken, namely HPMo molecules of a complete Keggin structure exist on the catalyst, and Mo (VI) sites of HPMo molecules can interact with oxidant hydrogen peroxide to generate active free radical species, so that desulfurization efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Triarylamine fracturing tracer, tracing method, fracturing fluid and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triarylamine fracturing tracer, a tracer method, fracturing fluid and application. The triarylamine fracturing tracer has the structural formula:  Wherein R  1 ～R 15  is the same or different and is one of H, methyl, methoxy, ethyl, ethoxy and fluorine respectively and independently. The triarylamine fracturing tracer provided by the invention has higher stability under the mineralization degree condition of 0-50000mg/L at room temperature-80 ℃, is suitable for stratum with severe conditions, has small dosage, is environment-friendly, sensitive in detection and low in detection limit, and can be used for multi-stage fracturing tracer technology of oil fields.

title_en: High-gel-strength water-absorbent resin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A polyacrylamide water-absorbent resin with high gel strength and high temp resistance and its preparing process are disclosed. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing titanium nitrile to obtain uniformly dispersed titanium nitrile aqueous dispersion; placing acrylamide, a hydrolyzer, a cross-linking agent, water and titanium carbonitrile aqueous dispersion into a polymerizer, regulating temperature, deoxidizing, adding an initiator, and reacting to obtain a polymeric colloid; granulating, drying and crushing the polymeric colloid to obtain the polyacrylamide water-absorbent resin. The temperature resistant effect and the gel strength of the obtained polyacrylamide water-absorbent resin are obviously improved.

title_en: Dehydrochlorination process and system for chlorinated paraffin
abstract_en: The invention provides a chlorinated paraffin dehydrochlorination process and a system, which are characterized in that a single-effect falling film evaporator is selected for degassing chlorinated paraffin, evaporated gas is subjected to heat exchange and cooling through a graphite heat exchanger, cooled alkane and water are collected through a fiber demister and enter an oil-water separation tank, uncondensed hydrogen chloride enters a hydraulic ejector through the fiber demister, water is used for dissolution and absorption, and the hydraulic ejector provides required vacuum for single-effect falling film evaporation. The invention has the beneficial effects of shortening the degassing time, improving the degassing efficiency, reducing the number of required equipment, reducing the production cost and enabling the equipment to continuously operate.

title_en: Herbal antibacterial detergent formula and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a herbal antibacterial liquid detergent formula and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of daily chemicals, wherein the herbal antibacterial liquid detergent formula comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3-7 parts of natural citric acid, 3-10 parts of lauryl alcohol, 2-5 parts of fatty alcohol sodium sulfate, 3-6 parts of fatty acid methyl ester polyoxyethylene, 3-5 parts of natural glycerin, 2-7 parts of aloe extract, 2-7 parts of gynura divaricata extract, 2-7 parts of goat horn leaf extract, 2-7 parts of cnidium fruit extract, 2-7 parts of radix sophorae flavescentis extract, 2-7 parts of radix stemonae extract, 2-7 parts of phellodendron extract, 2-7 parts of cortex pseudolaricis extract, 2-8 parts of a hydrotrope and 60-85 parts of deionized water; the herbal antibacterial detergent disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation method, strong in sterilization capability, and free from the phenomena of dryness, molting and roughness of hands after long-term use, and can protect the hands of a user.

title_en: Low-mechanical-sensitivity octogen-polyaniline composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energetic materials, and particularly discloses an octopus gold-polyaniline composite material with low mechanical sensitivity and a preparation method thereof, wherein the octopus gold-polyaniline composite material comprises polyaniline and octopus gold, and the polyaniline is coated on the surface of the octopus gold to form a core-shell structure; the octopus-polyaniline composite material has higher coating strength and low mechanical sensitivity; when the polyaniline coating amount is 1%, the impact sensitivity characteristic of HMX can be improved by 2.2 times or more by increasing H  50 , and the friction sensitivity can be reduced by about 30%.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ambergris spice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of ambergris perfume, which uses tobacco branches capable of synthesizing ambergris precursor compound Libaidang diterpene in high quantity as raw materials, the raw materials are subjected to modulation treatment, then glycerin or propylene glycol is used as entrainer, and distillation is carried out in high vacuum, and distillation condensation components are collected, so that the ambergris perfume disclosed by the invention can be obtained. The spice provided by the invention is used for fumigating, and has obvious antibacterial activity, so that aerosol generated by fumigating has obvious inhibition effect on the growth of staphylococcus aureus, escherichia coli, bacillus subtilis, aspergillus niger and bacillus proteus, and has an obvious air purifying effect. In addition, the incense has elegant and comfortable ambergris fragrance, and the generated aerosol can effectively relieve pressure, relax mind, relieve tension headache and has obvious curative effect of the incense.

title_en: Preparation method and application of encapsulated magnetic nano stirrer adsorbent
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an encapsulated magnetic nano stirrer adsorbent, which comprises the following steps: preparing a magnetic nano stirrer by adopting a hydrothermal synthesis method; wrapping a layer of nonporous silica shell outside the magnetic nano stirrer by an improved sol-gel method; coating a layer of porous shell material outside the non-porous silicon dioxide shell again, removing the non-porous silicon dioxide shell by a selective etching method, and removing the pore-forming agent by a roasting or extraction method to prepare the nanospheres for packaging the magnetic nano-stirring rod; and compounding the metal organic frame with the nanospheres for packaging the magnetic nano-stirrers in an in-situ growth mode, so as to realize the packaging of the nano-stirrers in the adsorbent. According to the invention, the magnetic nano stirrer positioned in the inner cavity of the adsorbent is remotely regulated and controlled by using an external magnetic field, so that controllable nano stirring is realized, the fluid mixing rate in the adsorbent is accelerated, the mass transfer limitation of the traditional industrial adsorbent is broken, and the adsorption desulfurization performance of the fixed bed is improved.

title_en: Cu/Fe3O4Water gas shift reaction catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Cu/Fe  3 O 4  water gas shift reaction catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of water gas shift hydrogen production. Firstly, mixing a copper source, an iron source, citric acid and water to obtain a mixed solution; and then carrying out hydrothermal reaction, freeze drying and roasting treatment on the mixed solution in sequence to obtain the Cu/Fe  3 O 4  water gas shift reaction catalyst. According to the invention, the molar ratio of the copper source to the iron source is adjusted, and the copper element is highly dispersed in the Fe  3 O 4  by combining a hydrothermal reaction and a freeze drying process, so that sintering aggregation of the catalyst under a high-temperature condition can be effectively inhibited, the thermal stability of the Cu/Fe  3 O 4  water gas shift reaction catalyst is improved, and the CO conversion rate in a high-temperature region of 400-450 ℃ is higher than 90%.

title_en: Polyester resin for closed isocyanate curing self-extinction powder coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polyester resin, and discloses polyester resin for a closed isocyanate curing self-extinction powder coating, which is prepared by polycondensation of raw materials comprising oxalic acid, dimethyl terephthalate, isophthalic acid, endo-methenyl tetrahydrophthalic anhydride, citric acid, 2-bis (4-hydroxycyclohexyl) propane, 1,2, 4-benzene tricarboxylic acid-methacrylic acid- (2-hydroxy) propylene glycol ester, 2-dimethyl-1, 3-propylene glycol and tricyclo [5.2.1,2,6] decane dimethanol. The polyester resin for the closed isocyanate curing self-extinction powder coating is composed of carefully selected raw materials, and the content of each raw material is optimized, so that the obtained powder coating has excellent fineness, leveling property, high hardness, mechanical property and stable extinction effect, and the powder formula does not need to additionally add an expensive extinction agent; since the curing agent epoxy resin and TGIC are not used any more, the technical route can obtain the very environment-friendly extinction powder coating.

title_en: Strong-adsorption polysiloxane plugging agent and water-based drilling fluid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong adsorption polysiloxane plugging agent and water-based drilling fluid, and belongs to the technical field of drilling of oil and gas fields. The raw materials of the strong adsorption polysiloxane plugging agent are N, N-bis (2-hydroxyethyl) -N, N-bis (trimethoxysilylpropyl) ethylenediamine, (dimethylamino) acetyl chloride, brominated compounds containing sulfonic acid groups, amino-containing siloxane substances and silicate compounds. The particle size of the strong adsorption polysiloxane plugging agent provided by the invention is 45.1-344.9 nm. The plugging agent can be directly added into water-based drilling fluid for use, and has little influence on rheological property of the drilling fluid. Compared with the drilling fluid without the plugging agent, the plugging performance of the drilling fluid with the strong-adsorption polysiloxane plugging agent is obviously improved, and the core plugging rate is increased along with the increase of the addition amount of the plugging agent. When the addition amount of the plugging agent is 1.0%, the plugging rate reaches 90.55%. The modified boron carbide strong adsorption plugging agent has excellent plugging performance, can effectively maintain the stability of a well wall, reduces the drilling period and saves the drilling cost.

title_en: Oil extraction method for multi-medium displacement and throughput linkage of heavy oil reservoir
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil extraction method of multi-medium displacement and throughput linkage of a heavy oil reservoir, which comprises the following steps: injecting at least more than two displacement mediums into an injection well, injecting a viscosity-reducing and energy-increasing system into a production well, and synchronously displacing and huff and puff, so as to perform linkage oil extraction; the oil extraction method greatly improves the recovery ratio of the high-water-content ultra-deep heavy oil reservoir through multi-well group injection and well oil extraction linkage development, and can be suitable for the high-water-content heavy oil reservoir with the reservoir depth of more than 1800m, thereby widening the technical limit of heavy oil exploitation.

title_en: Novel environment-friendly paint for automobile interior decoration and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile coatings, and particularly discloses a novel environment-friendly coating for automobile interiors and a preparation method thereof. The coating comprises 40-60 parts of aqueous epoxy resin, 30-40 parts of aqueous acrylic ester, 1-5 parts of Gr-CeO  2 -Bi 2 MoO 6  compound, 2-7 parts of modified attapulgite, 4-8 parts of chitosan, 3-5 parts of dispersing agent, 1-3 parts of film forming additive, 0.1-0.5 part of defoamer, 2-4 parts of pigment and 35-45 parts of water; gr-CeO  2 -Bi 2 MoO 6  complex; and the surface grafting activator of the modified attapulgite is prepared by mixing N-hydroxyethyl-2-imidazolidone and 2-aminobenzimidazole; the paint has the advantages of simple formula and strict proportion, can effectively degrade and remove formaldehyde, can be cured to form a coating with strong adhesive force, high wear resistance and excellent antibacterial property, is suitable for automobile interior trim, is green and environment-friendly, and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Slick water and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses slick water and preparation and application thereof, wherein the slick water comprises the following components in parts by mass: 1-3 parts of emulsifying agent; 1-3 parts of dispersing agent; 1-3 parts of thickening agent; 50-70 parts of disperse phase; a proper amount of dispersion medium. The slick water provided by the invention has low cost, the preparation method is simple and convenient, and the on-site construction difficulty and time are saved; the drag reduction rate of the slick water used as fracturing fluid can reach 70%, and the stability is good.

title_en: Ultraviolet excited tellurium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet fluorescent powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ultraviolet excited tellurium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet fluorescent powder, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a gel sol method is adopted, tellurium ions with low toxicity and low price are used as luminescent ions, and the prepared ultraviolet excited tellurium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet (Y  3‑   x Al 5 O 12 :xTe 4+ , YAG: te) fluorescent powder has broadband emission covering 350-600 nm under the effective excitation of ultraviolet light 280nm, has a full width at half maximum (FWHM) close to 150nm, and can meet the requirement of high-quality illumination; compared with the solid phase method, the method can not only effectively avoid volatilization of the high-temperature TeO  2 , but also synthesize pure-phase Te doped YAG at low temperature.

title_en: Pond moss control disinfectant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pond moss control disinfectant, which comprises 0.01-10% of sodium chlorite, 0.01-7% of citric acid, 0.01-4% of cation, 0.01-8% of nonionic, 0.01-5% of anion, 0.01-6% of tween-80 and the balance of deionized water. The pond moss control disinfectant is suitable for various cultivation water bodies and large algae in various spore forms, and comprises the following components: enteromorpha prolifera, yellow tube vegetable, sponge flower, green tube vegetable, spirogyra and other harmful filamentous algae. The product has no irritation, no corrosion, no residue, no teratogenesis, no carcinogenesis, and no mutation, and can control moss of various spore types from source, strongly penetrate into cell membrane of harmful algae, coat moss, block nutrition penetration spore, and inhibit algae flooding. The product is convenient and quick to use, saves time and labor, and has better use effect by directly pyrolling with the pyrolling device. Can also be sprayed on the dense moss part, and has better effect when being used for a plurality of times.

title_en: Deflagration packing element and method for manufacturing deflagration packing element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deflagration packing element, wherein the deflagration packing element comprises the following components: (a) at least one pyrotechnic material; (B) At least one processing aid based on a monocarboxylic acid of the formula R-COOH, wherein R represents an organic residue. Furthermore, a method for producing a deflagration packing element is described.

title_en: Surfactant for oil displacement in oil field, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tertiary oil recovery, and relates to a surfactant for oil displacement in an oil field, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: sequentially adding m-phenylenediamine-4, 6-disulfonic acid and methanol into a four-neck flask, stirring, adding 4, 4-trifluorobutyryl chloride, carrying out heat preservation reaction, and maintaining the pH of the solution to be 6-7; adding lauroyl chloride into the four-neck flask, and carrying out heat preservation reaction, wherein the pH value of the solution is maintained to be 7-8; and (3) distilling the mixed solution under reduced pressure, adding deionized water, adjusting the pH to 2-3, cooling, separating out solid, and drying overnight to obtain the surfactant for oil displacement. The surfactant for oil displacement in the oil field has the characteristics of low surface tension and good viscosity reduction effect, the surface tension can reach 23.8mN/m, the interface tension can reach 0.0035mN/m, and the viscosity reduction rate of 11000 mPa.s of thick oil can reach more than 99%.

title_en: Full-prefabricated self-adhesive polyurethane runway coiled material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of runway materials, and particularly discloses a full-prefabricated self-adhesive polyurethane runway coiled material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the coiled material comprises a polyurethane elastic layer, a self-adhesive layer and a polyurethane color surface layer, wherein the self-adhesive layer and the polyurethane color surface layer are formed by coating on two sides of the polyurethane elastic layer, and an anti-slip layer is further arranged on one side of the polyurethane color surface layer, which is far away from the polyurethane elastic layer; the polyurethane elastic layer is prepared by hot-pressing and kneading recovered sponge particles and polyurethane glue; the preparation method comprises the following steps: hot-pressing and kneading the recovered sponge particles and polyurethane adhesive, and then cutting into polyurethane elastic layers; one side of the polyurethane elastic layer is coated with a self-adhesive film to form a self-adhesive layer, the other side is coated with a colored polyurethane coating to form a polyurethane colored surface layer, colored EPDM particles are uniformly spread when the polyurethane colored surface layer is not dried to form an anti-skid layer, and then the anti-skid layer is solidified. The application has the characteristics of convenient construction and remarkable improvement on the aspects of the environmental protection performance, elasticity, durability and other functional layers compared with the cast-in-situ technology in the prior art.

title_en: Enhanced acylhydrazone Schiff base fluorescent probe, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Al  3+  concentration detection, in particular to an enhanced acylhydrazone Schiff base fluorescent probe, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the fluorescent probe takes an acylhydrazone Schiff base structure and a C=N bond with characteristic absorption as an Al  3+  recognition group and a fluorescent chromophore, and when Al  3+  recognition is carried out, the structure of the fluorescent probe changes to obviously enhance the optical signal output of the fluorescent group, so that the detection of Al  3+  is realized. Mixing methyl nicotinate and hydrazine hydrate to react to obtain 3-pyridine formylhydrazine; reacting 3-pyridine formylhydrazine with 3-amino-2-hydroxyacetophenone to obtain an intermediate; the enhanced acylhydrazone Schiff base fluorescent probe can be obtained by reacting the intermediate with salicylaldehyde in three simple steps, the method is simple, the operation is easy, the harsh reaction conditions and equipment are not needed, the raw material sources are wide, the cost is low, and the method is suitable for industrialization. The problems of complex synthesis process, high cost, poor anti-interference performance and low accuracy of detection results of the Al  3+  fluorescent probe are solved.

title_en: Preparation method of polymer interface layer solution, preparation method of polymer interface layer modified zinc metal electrode and solid electrolyte and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a polymer interface layer solution, a preparation method and application of a polymer interface layer modified zinc metal electrode and a solid electrolyte. The polymer interface layer solution is coated on the surfaces of the zinc metal electrode and the solid electrolyte to obtain the polymer interface layer, and the polymer interface layer solution has the advantages of high ionic conductivity, good mechanical property, low cost, easiness in preparation, strong repeatability and the like, and can better solve the problem of low effective contact area of the interface of the zinc metal electrode and the solid electrolyte, thereby reducing the interface resistance of the electrode and the solid electrolyte; the polymer interface layer has the characteristics of self-healing property, high elasticity, viscosity and the like, can self-heal and repair the damage of the polymer interface layer caused by the electrode or the solid electrolyte surface interface after the battery circulates for a long time, and has high elastic deformation capability to adapt to the rough interface caused by uneven deposition of the electrode, so that the integrity and the affinity of the interface between the electrode and the interface layer are ensured.

title_en: Silver ion antibacterial composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antibacterial compositions, in particular to a silver ion antibacterial composition and a preparation method thereof, and the silver ion antibacterial composition comprises the following material components in percentage by weight: 2.5-3.5 parts of nano silver, 54.2-6.5 parts of MOF-54.5 parts of chelating agent, 2.5-3.5 parts of film forming agent, 8-12 parts of film forming auxiliary agent, 4-6 parts of adhesive, 6-9 parts of deionized water and 85-95 parts of deionized water; firstly, adding nano silver, MOF-5 and deionized water into a stirring kettle for stirring, so that the nano silver is adsorbed in gaps on the surface of the MOF-5, and when the silver ion antibacterial composition works, the nano silver in the gaps on the surface of the MOF-5 can be continuously released, thereby realizing the purpose of continuous efficient antibacterial; the adhesive property of the silver ion antibacterial composition can be improved through the use of the adhesive, the film forming agent and the film forming auxiliary agent, so that the silver ion antibacterial composition can be attached to an article needing antibacterial effect, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Flow pattern regulator and oil-based drilling fluid
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow pattern regulator and an oil-based drilling fluid. The flow-type regulator comprises a component A, a component B and a component C; wherein component a is a first copolymer comprising structural units provided by trimerized fatty acids, structural units provided by polyetheramine compounds, and structural units provided by fatty acid diethanolamides; the component B is a second copolymer containing a structural unit provided by nano silicon dioxide, a structural unit provided by a silane coupling agent containing C=C double bond, a structural unit provided by a methacrylic acid alkyl ester compound and a structural unit provided by a temperature-sensitive monomer; the component C is an ether compound. The flow pattern regulator provided by the invention is used for oil-based drilling fluid, so that the oil-based drilling fluid can keep the dynamic shear force, the low-shear rate viscosity and the static shear force relatively constant in a large temperature range of 4-150 ℃ under the condition of not adding soil phase, and the safety drilling requirement of deep water drilling at the present stage is met.

title_en: UV (ultraviolet) curing adhesive for bonding PI (polyimide) film and plastic
abstract_en: The invention provides a UV curing adhesive for bonding a PI film and plastic, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-40% of double-layer shell core-shell structure acrylic ester, 50-60% of reactive diluent, 0.5-1% of active agent and 1-10% of photoinitiator, wherein the double-layer shell core-shell structure acrylic ester consists of hard monomers: methyl methacrylate MMA, soft monomer: n-butyl acrylate BA and functional monomers: the UV curing adhesive disclosed by the invention is prepared by a two-step emulsion polymerization method through exposing active groups outside a shell layer through a core-shell structure, grafting a siloxane oxygen branched chain on the shell layer, so that the crosslinking density is greatly improved, the adhesive property of a PI film is improved while the strength of a UV colloid is improved, and the quantity of crosslinking points is increased while the heat conduction property of the colloid is improved by introducing a silicon oxygen chain, so that the UV curing speed is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-heat-conductivity crystalline flake graphite/copper composite material
abstract_en: A preparation method of a high-heat-conductivity crystalline flake graphite/copper composite material relates to a preparation method of a crystalline flake graphite/copper composite material. The method aims at solving the problems that the existing copper and the flake graphite are poor in chemical inertness and wettability and the oriented arrangement of the flake graphite is difficult. According to the invention, firstly, the flake graphite is pretreated, then, a nano chromium carbide plating layer is plated on the surface of the flake graphite by a molten salt method, a high-orientation flake graphite preform is obtained by a liquid phase extrusion mode, and finally, the flake graphite/copper composite material with high density and high orientation is prepared by an air pressure infiltration mode, so that the prepared composite material has the characteristics of high orientation, high density, high thermal conductivity and low density, and can meet the performance requirements of heat dissipation materials in electronic devices.

title_en: Technology and device for converting waste plastics biomass into clean energy through physical pyrolysis
abstract_en: A process and a device for converting waste plastics biomass into clean energy by physical pyrolysis. Relates to a high-temperature flame heating method formed by chemical combustion, which converts garbage plastics and biomass into combustible gas by physical properties. The gasification furnace is arranged, the waste plastics and biomass are directly heated by high-temperature flame formed by chemical combustion, and the physical property of the waste plastics and biomass is converted into the combustible gas in the direct heating process of the high-temperature flame. The gasified combustible gas passes through a steam heavy oil gas separation device; a device for separating carbon dioxide from water by dissolving carbon dioxide in water; a carbon dioxide purifying device. The water vapor, heavy oil and carbon dioxide contained in the combustible gas are separated and purified, and are converted into high-quality regenerated clean energy which is used for power generation, boiler heating, catering and civil use.

title_en: Pretreatment system and method for directly reducing raw material gas by coke oven gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pretreatment system and a pretreatment method for directly reducing raw material gas by coke oven gas, wherein the pretreatment system comprises a primary compression unit, a deep purification unit and a secondary compression unit; the first-stage compression unit comprises a first-stage compressor, a filter, a heat exchanger and a No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank; the coke oven gas pipeline is communicated with the inlet of the first-stage compressor through the filter, the outlet of the first-stage compressor is communicated with the inlet of the heat exchanger, and the outlet of the heat exchanger is communicated with the No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank; the deep purification comprises a deep purification adsorption tower and a filter; the outlet of the No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank is communicated with the inlet of the deep purification adsorption tower, the outlet of the deep purification adsorption tower is communicated with the inlet of the filter, and the outlet of the filter is communicated with the direct reduction heating furnace; the secondary compression unit comprises a secondary compressor, a cooling tower and a No. 2 gas-liquid separation tank. The system fully considers the requirements of the direct reduction process, adopts the coupling of graded compression and deep purification, and can effectively improve the purification effect.

title_en: Polymer builder and detergent containing same
abstract_en: The invention provides a polymer builder, the preparation method of which comprises the following operations: s1, mixing an emulsifying agent and water to prepare an emulsion, and adding a monomer emulsion and an initiator into the emulsion at 88-92 ℃ to prepare a first reaction solution; s2, adding monomer emulsion and an initiator into the first reaction liquid at 88-92 ℃, then preserving heat at 88-92 ℃ to prepare a second reaction liquid, and preparing a polymer builder from the second reaction liquid; the monomer emulsion comprises an emulsifier and a monomer, wherein the monomer comprises a carboxyl-containing unsaturated monomer and/or salt thereof and a hydrophobic group-containing unsaturated monomer, and the mass ratio of the carboxyl-containing unsaturated monomer and/or salt thereof to the hydrophobic group-containing unsaturated monomer is 15-85:15-85; the carboxyl-containing unsaturated monomer and/or its salt has 3-6 carbon atoms, and the hydrophobic-group-containing unsaturated monomer has 4-24 carbon atoms. The polymer builder provided by the invention has excellent detergency and anti-redeposition performance, and has excellent stability, and is convenient to store and apply.

title_en: Fluororubber coated boron composite material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluororubber coated boron composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, the method comprises the steps of adding a first organic solvent into a reactor, heating to 60-80 ℃, keeping the temperature for 0.5-2 h under the condition of continuously introducing protective gas, adding boron powder into the reactor, continuously stirring for 6-10 h at the stirring rate of 200-800 r/min, sequentially filtering, washing and drying to obtain hydroxylated boron powder, adding a second organic solvent into the reactor, heating to 60-80 ℃, keeping the temperature for 0.5-2 h under the condition of continuously introducing protective gas, sequentially adding the formula amount of methacryl dopamine, allyl-containing organic fluoride, an initiator and hydroxylated boron powder into the reactor, continuously stirring for 12-24 h at the stirring rate of 100-300 r/min under the condition of continuously introducing protective gas, and washing and drying to obtain the fluororubber coated boron composite material. The coating layer formed on the surface of the boron powder is firm and stable, is not easy to fall off, can prevent the oxidation of the boron powder, and the prepared fluororubber coated boron composite material is used for preparing fuel-rich propellant.

title_en: Single-component structural adhesive composition based on epoxy resin, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to a single-component structural adhesive composition based on epoxy resin, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises 5-40 parts of epoxy resin A, 5-40 parts of epoxy resin B, 0-10 parts of reactive diluent, 1-4 parts of dicyandiamide curing agent, 0.1-2 parts of accelerator and 20-70 parts of inorganic filler. The composition prepared by the invention has higher filler concentration than the conventional adhesive composition and does not negatively affect the bonding strength, thereby being capable of being produced at lower cost and being suitable for occasions with special bonding requirements such as bonding of mechanical parts.

title_en: Thermal protective glass lubricant for profile extrusion process and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-temperature lubrication, and particularly discloses a heat protection glass lubricant for a profile extrusion process and a preparation method thereof. According to the preparation method of the glass lubricant, a group of high-softening-point glass powder and a group of low-softening-point glass powder are respectively obtained through a melt quenching method and are mechanically mixed according to a certain proportion, so that the glass lubricant has a large temperature range, zrO  2  introduced into glass promotes crystallization while the high-temperature viscosity is improved, and the lubricating effect is further promoted by the aluminum magnesium silicate and magnesium silicate nano particles formed at high temperature in situ. The glass lubricant for hot extrusion prepared by the invention contains no toxic and environment-friendly materials such as F, heavy metal and the like in the preparation process, so that the temperature range of the glass lubricant can be enlarged, and the stable and excellent lubricating effect in the temperature range of 800-1150 ℃ can be realized. The preparation process is simple, easy to realize, environment-friendly and capable of realizing effective lubrication in a wider temperature range.

title_en: Interpenetrating prepolymer, composition of UV adhesive, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interpenetrating prepolymer, a composition of a UV adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof. The interpenetrating polymer of the invention is prepared by reacting raw materials including a compound shown in a formula 1, isocyanate and polycarbonate polyol. The composition of the UV adhesive comprises a photopolymerization monomer, a photoinitiator, an interpenetrating prepolymer, a coupling agent and an auxiliary agent. The adhesive of the invention has the characteristics of quick drying, high strength and stability. The adhesive cured product has the advantages of high bonding strength, small volume shrinkage and good heat resistance.

title_en: Barrier film, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier film and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Applying a metal composition on a substrate so as to form a layer of solid particles of the metal composition on at least one side of the substrate, the metal composition comprising a metal compound and/or a boron-containing compound, a water-insoluble resin and a water-soluble resin; (2) Applying a functional mixture to a side of the metal composition solid particle layer remote from the substrate layer to form an organic functional layer on the metal composition solid particle layer, the functional mixture including a carboxyl group-containing resin, a volatile acid, a solvent, and a crosslinking agent. The method solves the problem of gel of the metal compound and the carboxylic acid-containing resin in the same coating liquid system, omits a humidity adjusting process for preparing the barrier film in a lamination mode, remarkably reduces the complexity of the process, is suitable for continuous production, and obtains the barrier film with excellent barrier performance.

title_en: Ethanol fuel suitable for frequent start-stop working condition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of internal combustion engines and fuels, and particularly relates to an ethanol fuel suitable for frequent start-stop working conditions. The ethanol fuel provided by the invention comprises the following components in percentage by volume: 18-23% of alkylated gasoline, 1-3% of raffinate oil, 3-5% of naphtha, 4-9% of reformed gasoline, 50-55% of hydrogenated gasoline, 1-3% of isopentane and 8-12% of ethanol. The invention optimizes the composition of the fuel components, so that the provided ethanol fuel has the characteristics of high OS, low C  9+  aromatic hydrocarbon and olefin, multi-paraffin and isoparaffin, is suitable for the ignition type gasoline engine for the vehicle on a multi-power platform, and can realize the advantages of low particulate matter emission, low hydrocarbon emission and low oil consumption.

title_en: Method for modifying hydrophilicity of inner surface of microchannel reactor and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for modifying the hydrophilicity of the inner surface of a microchannel reactor and application thereof, and aims to provide a method which has high efficiency, low cost, good safety, environmental protection and capability of preparing the hydrophilic coating of the inner surface of the microchannel in a large scale; preparing modified silicon dioxide by using a silane coupling agent and tetraethoxysilane, dispersing the modified silicon dioxide and aqueous polyurethane into an absolute ethyl alcohol solution, introducing air by a spraying method, spraying a modified coating on pretreated 316L stainless steel, and testing contact angle performance after vacuum drying to obtain a microchannel reactor with hydrophilic inner surface of a reaction channel; the invention provides a method for preparing the hydrophilic coating on the inner surface of the microchannel in a large scale, which has the advantages of high efficiency, good safety, environmental protection and low cost; belongs to the technical field of chemical industry.

title_en: Exposed water-based asphalt-based waterproof coating, preparation method thereof and waterproof laminate
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exposed water-based asphalt-based waterproof coating, a preparation method thereof and a waterproof laminate, which comprises anionic emulsified asphalt, polymer emulsion, filler and an auxiliary agent, wherein the anionic emulsified asphalt is prepared by melting and mixing matrix asphalt and a composite weather-resistant additive, and the composite weather-resistant additive is a combination of an antioxidant and an ultraviolet absorbent according to a mass ratio of 0.5-2:1; the polymer emulsion is one or a combination of a plurality of weather-proof styrene-acrylic emulsion, weather-proof pure acrylic emulsion and weather-proof silicone-acrylic emulsion. According to the invention, the antioxidant and the ultraviolet absorbent are introduced into the anionic emulsified asphalt, so that the stability of a waterproof coating system is improved, the demulsification phenomenon is avoided, meanwhile, the weather resistance of the prepared waterproof coating is greatly improved by combining the use of weather-resistant polymer emulsion and matched with fillers and auxiliaries, and the waterproof system can be used as an exposed product for waterproof construction of long-term exposed environment buildings, and the protection effect of white sintered sand adhered to the surface of the coating and the effect of reflecting sunlight are also achieved.

title_en: Multistage spraying fractional condensation device for biomass pyrolysis gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biomass treatment and utilization, in particular to a biomass pyrolysis gas multistage spray fractional condensation device which comprises a first sprayer, a second sprayer, a third sprayer, a first oil collecting tank, a second oil collecting tank and a third oil collecting tank. The first to third sprayers are provided with gas pipelines which are sequentially connected, the first sprayer is provided with a pyrolysis gas inlet, the third sprayer is provided with a non-condensable gas outlet, the first to third sprayers are further provided with a cooling liquid spraying system for temperature-controlled condensation of pyrolysis gas, and the lower ends of the first to third sprayers are respectively provided with first to third oil collecting tanks which are connected with the first to third oil collecting tanks so as to be used for collecting condensed liquid phase products. The device has the advantages of ingenious, compact and compact structural design, convenient operation, stable operation, convenient cleaning and maintenance and high automation degree, and can effectively ensure that pyrolysis gas is fully condensed to obtain biological oil with different qualities.

title_en: Pseudomonas aeruginosa phage and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pseudomonas aeruginosa phage and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms. The invention separates and identifies a new lytic phage Pa_WF01 infecting pseudomonas aeruginosa, and carries out biological characteristic research, morphological observation and total genetic evolution relation analysis on the phage, and determines that the phage Pa_WF01 is a member of the genus Litunavirus of the Schitoviridae class of the no-tail phage Caudoviricetes. The invention uses a carbapenem-resistant pseudomonas aeruginosa CRPA infected mouse model to evaluate the in-vivo treatment effect and safety of phage Pa_WF01, and the result shows that phage Pa_WF01 can be used for treating CRPA infection and relieving inflammatory reaction caused by CRPA infection. In addition, the combination of the bacterial strain and the Acinetobacter baumannii phage Ab_WF01 can further promote the antibacterial effect.

title_en: Carbon black for black hole technology, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of black hole liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon black preparation, and particularly discloses carbon black for a black hole process, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing black hole liquid. The preparation method of the carbon black for the black hole process comprises the following steps: (1) Adding carbon black into water, then adding sodium lignin sulfonate, and uniformly stirring to obtain carbon black mixed solution; (2) Adding metal salt into the carbon black mixed solution, uniformly mixing, then adding carbonate, stirring for 2-4 hours, and separating solid; (3) Calcining the solid separated in the step (2) at 1000-1300 ℃ for 2-4 hours to obtain a calcined solid; and taking calcined solids to obtain the carbon black for the black hole process. Research shows that the black hole liquid prepared by the black hole process carbon black prepared by the method can greatly improve the conductivity of the prepared conductive layer and the preservation time of the black hole liquid.

title_en: Water-based multicolor self-spraying paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-based multicolor self-spraying paint, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the water-based multicolor self-spraying paint comprises water-based multicolor paint and a propellant; the water-based multicolor paint comprises acrylic ester copolymer emulsion, artificial composite rock slices, a solvent, pigment and filler and an auxiliary agent; the preparation raw materials of the acrylic ester copolymer emulsion comprise a polymerizable surfactant and acrylic ester monomers; the mesh number of the artificial composite rock slices is 20-120 mesh. The aqueous multicolor self-spraying paint provided by the invention can be stably stored in a spraying pressure tank, can be smoothly sprayed out, has multicolor stone imitation effect, can be applied by pressing a spray head for spraying, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Acid-soluble bridge plug plugging agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid-soluble bridge plug plugging agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the agent comprises, by mass, 20-40 parts of shell slag, 10-20 parts of limestone, 5-10 parts of floating beads, 1-2 parts of bentonite, 4-9 parts of acid-soluble fibers, 0.5-1 part of sheet-like films and 1-2 parts of silane coupling agents. The bridge plug type plugging agent prepared by the invention not only has excellent gap plugging performance, but also has strong compression resistance and bearing capacity, high acid dissolution rate and good comprehensive performance, is suitable for various leakage layers, and has good plugging effect.

title_en: Method for recycling discharged gas of coke dry quenching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling discharged gas of coke dry quenching, which comprises the following steps: s1, circulating gas from a dry quenching boiler is sent into a heat pipe exchanger by a circulating fan; s2, taking out a part of circulating gas after the heat pipe exchanger as dry quenching and diffusing gas; s3, performing desulfurization and dust removal treatment on the dry quenching scattered gas; s4, delivering the dry quenching scattered gas after desulfurization and dust removal into a reheating type coke oven or a single-heating type coke oven for combustion; in the step S4, before the dry quenching scattered gas is sent into the reheating type coke oven, the dry quenching scattered gas is mixed with high-heat-value gas and blast furnace gas, wherein the high-heat-value gas is the coke oven gas or the analysis gas generated after the coke oven gas hydrogen production; in the step S4, before the dry quenching exhaust gas is sent into the single-heat type coke oven, the dry quenching exhaust gas is mixed with the coking VOCs gas, the coke oven flue gas or the analysis gas generated after the coke oven gas hydrogen production. The method for recycling the dry quenching diffused gas can effectively recycle the analysis gas, the dry quenching Jiao Fangsan gas and the coking VOCs gas in the coke oven gas, can effectively reduce environmental pollution and improve energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Planting method and planting device for golden aster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planting method and a planting device of golden aster, comprising the following steps: s1: preparing soil; s2: seedling raising; s3: planting; s4: performing field management; s5: preventing and treating; s6: harvesting until the flowering period is finished; compared with the prior art, the planting method of the golden-silk king chrysanthemum is simple and easy to popularize and implement, is suitable for large-area planting application, can effectively refer to the operation of the planting industry of the golden-silk king chrysanthemum by combining the prior planting method, and particularly, the invention designs a mode of performing planting land treatment by quicklime, sheep manure organic fertilizer, color hump and Ruimex in the aspect of preventing and treating root rot of the golden-silk king chrysanthemum, further assists in spraying the mancozeb and Ruimex medicament, effectively reduces the incidence rate, ensures the harvest of planting, and in addition, provides equipment convenient for planting plants with soil, and is convenient for performing the efficiency of planting the plants cultivated by split pot culture.

title_en: Transparent anti-fog self-cleaning coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent anti-fog self-cleaning coating and a preparation method thereof, and the transparent anti-fog self-cleaning coating comprises the following specific steps: (1) Weighing tetrabutyl titanate, concentrated hydrochloric acid and a silane coupling agent with certain mass, dissolving in an organic solvent, stirring for proper time, and marking as a reaction solution 1; (2) Weighing a certain mass of acrylamide, polyvinyl alcohol, amino polysilsesquioxane, ammonium persulfate and N, N-methylene bisacrylamide, dissolving in water, uniformly stirring, and marking as a reaction solution 2; (3) And spin-coating the reaction liquid 1 on a clean glass sheet, drying and taking out, and spin-coating the reaction liquid 2, and continuing drying to obtain the transparent anti-fog and anti-frost coating with lasting anti-fog performance. The preparation process is simple, and the prepared coating has excellent anti-fog performance, anti-frost performance, anti-fouling performance, transmittance and stability, and is a problem that the application of the anti-fouling coating in scenes such as photovoltaic glass, front windshield glass and the like with requirements for transparency is limited.

title_en: Method for recycling biogas slurry nutrients through pyrolysis and activation of low-grade phosphorite by alkaline residue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recovering biogas slurry nutrients by using alkali residue pyrolysis to activate low-grade phosphorite, which utilizes the alkali residue pyrolysis to activate the low-grade phosphorite to improve the content of citrate-soluble phosphorus and water-soluble phosphorus in the low-grade phosphorite; then oxalic acid is used for carrying out acid leaching pretreatment on the activated phosphorite, so that the water-soluble phosphorus content is further improved to serve as a phosphorus source of MAP reaction, and the inhibition effect of calcium ions on MAP reaction is slowed down; finally, through MAP reaction and physical adsorption of activated phosphorite, nitrogen and phosphorus nutrients in biogas slurry are cooperatively recovered. The method has obvious recovery effect by utilizing the alkaline pyrolysis activated low-grade phosphorite recovery biogas slurry nutrient process, 99% of phosphorus and 96% of nitrogen in the biogas slurry are recovered, and the slow-release nitrogen-phosphorus fertilizer rich in struvite can be produced. Solves the difficult problem of disposing biogas slurry, low-grade phosphorite and industrial sodium/potassium alkali waste residue and waste in the agricultural pig farm, provides an innovative process for recycling the agricultural waste, and belongs to the technical field of recycling the agricultural waste.

title_en: Novel multi-effect decontaminating agent, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and discloses a novel multi-effect decontaminating agent and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the main components of the decontaminating agent comprise 1-5% of sulfhydrylation carboxymethyl cellulose, 0.2-1.2% of DOTA, 0.5-3.0% of DPTA, 5-10% of EDTA and 100nmol of polydopamine nano particles, EDC and NHS with mass fractions being equal to or more than 0.01%, and the balance of MES buffer solution with a pH value being 5.0. The preparation method of the decontaminating agent comprises the following steps: dissolving sulfhydrylation carboxymethyl cellulose prepared by adopting a cysteine or cysteamine modification method in MES buffer solution, adding three chelating agents with different mass fractions after regulating the pH value, fully dissolving and dispersing, adding polydopamine nano particles, adding excessive EDC and NHS into the solution, and fully stirring for more than 12 hours under the conditions of light shielding and nitrogen protection; the reaction product is fully dialyzed and filtered in deionized water and RC-S-CMC is recovered by a freeze drying method; the decontaminating agent has freezing resistance, high decontaminating efficiency on various radionuclides, low cost and convenient use.

title_en: Plant disease-resistant agent containing antibacterial peptide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant disease-resistant agent containing antibacterial peptide and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of plant disease-resistant agents, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a carrier, preparing a composite nanowire, preparing an antibacterial peptide solution, loading and mixing; mixing the carrier, the antibacterial peptide and distilled water, stirring at room temperature, centrifuging, taking a precipitate, cleaning, and freeze-drying the precipitate to obtain a load; mixing, namely mixing the load with the composite nanowire, and stirring at room temperature to obtain a plant antibacterial agent containing antibacterial peptide; the plant disease-resistant agent containing the antibacterial peptide has the advantages that the disease-resistant effect is little influenced by temperature and the content of salt in soil, agglomeration is not easy to occur in the use process, and the dispersibility in water is good.

title_en: Flame-retardant high-insulation epoxy composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of powder coatings, and discloses a flame-retardant high-insulation epoxy composite material and a preparation method thereof. The flame-retardant high-insulation epoxy composite material comprises A, B components, wherein the component A comprises the following components in parts by weight: 70-90 parts of bisphenol A epoxy resin, 30-40 parts of filler, 2-3 parts of flatting agent, 2-3 parts of accelerator, 0.7-1.2 parts of defoamer and 5-8 parts of flame retardant toughening agent; the component B is 6.5-8.5 parts of accelerated dicyandiamide curing agent. The flame-retardant high-insulation epoxy composite material prepared by the invention has good mechanical property, flame retardance and insulativity, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Sample loading device for perfusion application and perfusion system
abstract_en: The invention provides a sample loading device for perfusion application, which comprises a sample loading module, wherein a bearing space for loading biological samples is arranged in the sample loading module; and the sample carrying module is connected into a conveying pipeline for intersecting, mixing and conveying each reagent solution. A perfusion system for applying the sample loading device as described above, further comprising: the delivery modules are used for being connected with reagent solutions, outlets of the delivery modules of the reagent solutions are intersected to a delivery pipeline, and the delivery pipeline is connected with a sample loading module, so that the delivery modules are communicated with the bearing space; the temperature control module is connected with the sample carrying module; the data processing module stores a temperature curve which is adapted to the corresponding biological sample and a conveying curve corresponding to each conveying module to form a perfusion control scheme; the data processing module controls the working states of the temperature control module and each conveying module. By applying the perfusion system setting of the sample loading device, the effective positioning of the biological sample in the perfusion infiltration process and the perfusion infiltration of the effective tissue mixed solution are realized, and the automation of the perfusion infiltration is realized; the mixed solution with different concentrations is not required to be manually configured, so that operation errors caused by human influence factors are eliminated, and the stability of biological samples, tissue perfusion infiltration and resuscitation operation is improved.

title_en: Water-based carboxyl-terminated nitrile rubber binder for lithium iron phosphate anode, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of binders for batteries, in particular to a water-based carboxyl-terminated nitrile rubber binder for a lithium iron phosphate anode, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation raw materials comprise the following components in parts by weight: 5-10% of carboxyl-terminated nitrile rubber, 15-35% of (methyl) acrylic acid, 15-35% of N- (3-aminopropyl) methacrylamide, 15-40% of acrylonitrile and 5-20% of nonpolar monomer. The final product has no VOC residue, and is an environment-friendly, nontoxic and pure green water-based adhesive; the toughness of the adhesive is enhanced by more than 2 times, and better adhesive force is embodied; the prepared battery has a capacity retention rate of more than 85% after 6000 times of circulation.

title_en: Distillation equipment for removing sweet wormwood oil residual solvent
abstract_en: The invention discloses distillation equipment for removing residual solvent of sweet wormwood oil, which comprises the following components: the outer frame unit, outer frame unit includes the support frame and installs the rotation driving source in the support frame lateral part, includes: and the distillation treatment unit is rotatably arranged in the support frame. The accommodating cavity formed by the first closing plate and the second closing plate is lifted upwards, the filter pressing block is pressed into the accommodating cavity, the sweet wormwood solvent mixed solution flows into the surface of the heating annular plate through the filter holes in the filter pressing block, sweet wormwood powder is left in the accommodating cavity, the sweet wormwood solvent mixed solution is enabled to downwards move along the surface of the heating annular plate along with the gravity of the sweet wormwood solvent mixed solution, the rotation of the barrel body is accompanied, the mixed solution is enabled to spirally descend on the surface of the heating annular plate to form a movable film, and therefore the mixed solution can be horizontally and rotationally spread and fully heated by the second heating cavity at the bottom of the heating annular plate, and therefore the solvent with the boiling point lower than that of sweet wormwood oil in the mixed solution is evaporated and discharged.

title_en: Alkaline blocking remover applicable to inorganic blocking object solubilization and film removal and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an alkaline blocking remover suitable for inorganic blocking object solubilization and film removal, which comprises the steps of adding a chelating agent, a catalyst and a surfactant into water, then adopting an alkaline pH regulator to regulate the pH value of a system to 8-12, heating and stirring to fully dissolve the chelating agent, and then adding a synergist and a scale inhibitor to prepare a main agent; and adding a corrosion inhibitor, an iron ion stabilizer and a clay stabilizer into the main agent while stirring, and adjusting the pH value of the system to 8-12 again to finally prepare the alkaline blocking remover. The alkaline blocking remover is suitable for inorganic blocking object solubilization and stripping, can effectively strip existing inorganic salt scale films, can increase the solubility of scale forming ions in a system, prevents inorganic blocking objects from further forming, and has good solubilization and stripping performance; in addition, the blocking remover has good stability, wide applicable temperature range, small corrosion to equipment, environmental protection and no toxicity, and can be used for blocking caused by inorganic salt scale.

title_en: Dispersing agent for dispersing cobalt phosphide catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispersing agent for dispersing cobalt phosphide catalysts, which comprises one or more of carbon disulfide, phosphorus oxychloride, trichloroethylene, chloroform and furan phenol. When the cobalt phosphide catalyst is dispersed, the method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a dispersing agent and a cobalt phosphide catalyst under ultrasonic conditions; adding Nafion solution, and continuing ultrasonic treatment to obtain catalyst dispersion liquid.
