The dispersing agent provided by the invention can effectively disperse cobalt phosphide catalysts, so that catalyst dispersion liquid with good dispersion stability is prepared, and the performance of a membrane electrode prepared by the dispersing agent is good.

title_en: Perfluoro caprylic acid three-mode detection method based on regulation and control of MIP-MOF (Fe) peroxidase activity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental and food pollutant detection, and particularly relates to a perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) three-mode detection method based on regulation and control of MIP-MOF (Fe) peroxidase activity. According to the invention, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, terephthalic acid and ethylenediamine are used as synthesis substrates, MIP-MOF (Fe) nanoenzyme with peroxidase-like activity is synthesized in one step through a hydrothermal method, and the MIP-MOF (Fe) nanoenzyme is wrapped through a Molecular Imprinting (MIP) method, so that PFOA can be specifically identified. The method has the advantages of wide raw material sources, low cost and economy, can provide built-in cross reference correction through three-mode detection, greatly improves the reliability and accuracy of PFOA detection in complex environment samples, and avoids false positive output of detection results.

title_en: Pesticidally active heterocyclic derivatives with sulfur containing substituents
abstract_en: Compounds of formula (I) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim 1. Furthermore, the present invention relates to agrochemical compositions comprising compounds of formula (I), to the preparation of these compositions and to the use of these compounds or compositions in agriculture or horticulture for combating, preventing or controlling animal pests, including arthropods and in particular insects, molluscs, nematodes or representatives of the order acarina.

title_en: Pressure forming equipment is used in production of living beings shaping granule
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure forming equipment is used in biomass molding granule production, belong to the living beings field, for the raw materials that has solved current living beings granule is the biomass crushing and mixing and is made, its raw materials can be comparatively viscidity, this leads to its inside bubble that appears very easily, the bubble can lead to the inside cavity that contains of extruded product, the outward appearance is unaesthetic, influence granule combustion performance, reduce combustion efficiency's problem, a pressure forming equipment is used in biomass molding granule production, including the shell, the discharge gate of setting in the shell below inside, the first baffle of setting at the shell lower surface, through being provided with reciprocating mechanism, when making the start-up cylinder drive reciprocating mechanism and carry out reciprocating motion, make the air current can be quick follow the surface of raw materials flow, make the atmospheric pressure outside the raw materials reduce, make the bubble break more easily, for prior art, make the inside bubble of raw materials can reduce, thereby reached the purpose that improves combustion efficiency.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel cleaning solution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic panel cleaning liquid and a preparation method thereof, wherein the photovoltaic panel cleaning liquid comprises water, sodium citrate dissolved in the water, EDTA-4Na, isomeric alcohol polyoxyethylene ether, betaine, sodium dodecyl diphenyl ether disulfonate, polyoxyethylene fatty acid ester, maleic acid-acrylic acid copolymer and sodium carbonate, wherein the mass percent of the sodium citrate is less than or equal to 10%, the mass percent of the EDTA-4Na is less than or equal to 5%, the mass percent of the isomeric alcohol polyoxyethylene ether is less than or equal to 20%, the mass percent of the betaine is less than or equal to 20%, the mass percent of the sodium dodecyl diphenyl ether disulfonate is less than or equal to 10%, the mass percent of the polyoxyethylene fatty acid ester is less than or equal to 10%, the mass percent of the maleic acid-acrylic acid copolymer is less than or equal to 10%, and the mass percent of the sodium carbonate is less than or equal to 5%. The invention has the advantages of high dispersion, strong descaling performance and high cleaning speed, and is beneficial to reducing the cleaning strength and improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Waterborne polyurethane antistatic aging-resistant finishing paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aqueous polyurethane antistatic aging-resistant finish paint and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of antistatic, and aims to solve the problems that an existing aqueous polyurethane antistatic paint in the prior art is deep in color of a conductive agent, incapable of color matching to meet customer requirements, large in addition amount of the conductive agent, high in cost, low in aging resistance, water resistance and abrasion resistance, and unstable in ESD performance, and the resistivity of the antistatic paint is greatly influenced by ambient temperature and humidity and film thickness of a paint film. The component A comprises the following components: 40-50 parts of aqueous hydroxy acrylic resin, 5-10 parts of aqueous polycarbonate dihydric alcohol, 0.5-2 parts of conductive agent, 10-20 parts of titanium pigment, 5-10 parts of barium sulfate, 0.2-0.5 part of PH regulator, 0.5-1.0 part of fumed silica, 1-5 parts of cosolvent, 1-3 parts of dispersing agent, 0.2-0.5 part of defoaming agent, 0.2-0.5 part of wetting agent, 0.5-1 part of adhesion promoter, 0.5-1 part of thickening agent and 15-25 parts of deionized water; the component B comprises the following components: 60-80 parts of isocyanate curing agent and 20-40 parts of cosolvent.

title_en: Environment-friendly organic ecological controlled release fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly organic ecological controlled release fertilizer, which comprises 100-523 parts of fertilizer particles and 15-55 parts of coating; the fertilizer particles are prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 42-50 parts of fermentation waste residue, 8-10 parts of urea ammonium polyphosphate, 5.5-7 parts of calcium ammonium nitrate, 6-9 parts of calcium hydrophosphate, 7-10 parts of potassium chloride, 11-15 parts of anhydrous sodium sulfate, 24-68 parts of pig manure, 62-76 parts of rabbit manure, 18-55 parts of chicken manure, 10-50 parts of waste residue, 26-35 parts of earthworm powder, 3-9 parts of biological bacteria, 3-5 parts of trace elements, 3-6 parts of water-retaining agent, 0.4-3 parts of dispersing agent and 3-6 parts of conditioner; the coating is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 11-37 parts of animal glue, 3-3 parts of sodium phosphate, 7-10 parts of boron fiber, 2-4 parts of silicon carbide fiber, 1.8-3.4 parts of calcium phosphate, 1.2-1.9 parts of moisture-proof agent, 0.9-1.8 parts of oxidant, 0.8-1.6 parts of cross-linking agent, 0.5-1.2 parts of cold-resistant agent, 0.8-1.6 parts of waterproofing agent, 0.3-0.6 part of synergistic agent, 2.4-3.5 parts of diatomite, 1.8-2.8 parts of sludge, 0.6-1.2 parts of tackifier and 1.4-2.6 parts of ammonium nitrate.

title_en: Slow-release fertilizer for increasing yield of potatoes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slow release fertilizer for increasing yield of potatoes and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of potato planting. The invention takes the nitrogen fertilizer, the phosphate fertilizer, the potash fertilizer, the trace elements and the sodium alginate slow release particles as raw materials, and the nitrogen, the phosphorus and the potassium are taken as essential elements for the growth of the potatoes, so that the plants can grow robustly, the cold resistance and the disease resistance of the plants are enhanced, the dry matter content, the protein content and the yield of tubers are improved, the healthy growth and the development of the potatoes are ensured by adding the trace elements, and the sodium alginate slow release particles are used for controlling the release of the slow release fertilizer, so that the slow release particles conform to the nutrient absorption law of the potato production period, thereby improving the yield and the quality of the potatoes, and simultaneously improving the utilization rate of the slow release fertilizer.

title_en: Zinc-based carbon nanocomposite powder for corrosion-resistant coating, method for producing same, and corrosion-resistant coating
abstract_en: The present invention relates to zinc-based carbon nanocomposite powder for corrosion-resistant coating materials, a method for producing the same, and a corrosion-resistant coating material. A method for producing zinc-based carbon nanocomposite powder for corrosion-resistant coating materials, comprising: (a) A step of producing zinc-based carbon nanocomposite powder in which carbon nanomaterial is intercalated and dispersed; and (b) a step of adjusting the particle size and shape of the carbon nanocomposite powder in a shape suitable for use as an additive for corrosion resistant coatings, the (a) step comprising: selecting a carbon nanomaterial and zinc-based powder, charging the carbon nanomaterial and zinc-based powder together with a dispersion medium into a grinding container of a high-energy grinder, and uniformly mixing the carbon nanomaterial and zinc-based powder while dispersing the carbon nanomaterial at a low speed; and a step of separating the carbon nanomaterial at a high speed and inserting and dispersing the carbon nanomaterial into the zinc-based powder particles.

title_en: Color-changing ink, activation ink and timing label
abstract_en: The invention discloses color-changing ink, activating ink and a timing label. The color-changing ink comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 15-45 parts of a connecting material; 5-20 parts of carotenoid; 20-50 parts of a first solvent. The activated ink is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 35-60 parts of pressure-sensitive adhesive; 1-10 parts of an activating material; 15-40 parts of a second solvent; wherein the activating material comprises an activating component which is capable of color reacting with the carotenoid. The timing label comprises a color-changing component and an activating component, wherein the color-changing component comprises a color-changing layer and a first substrate layer which are arranged in a laminated mode, the activating component comprises an activating layer and a second substrate layer which are arranged in a laminated mode, the color-changing layer comprises a color-changing area, the color-changing area is obtained by printing the color-changing ink, and the activating layer is obtained by printing the activating ink. According to the timing label, the color change rate of the color-changing layer depends on the migration rate of the activating component in the activating layer, so that the timing precision is greatly improved.

title_en: Biomass carbonization system with safety explosion-proof valve device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves, in particular to a biomass carbonization system with a safe explosion-proof valve device, which comprises a carbonization furnace, an explosion-proof valve body, pretreatment equipment, cooling equipment, gas recovery equipment and a gas storage tank, wherein the pretreatment equipment performs drying and screening treatment on biomass raw materials, and then the biomass raw materials are input into the carbonization furnace; under the condition that the pipeline is easy to break due to earthquake, the valve can be closed by electric control, so that the explosion risk caused by gas leakage is reduced, and the reaction is quicker; under the condition that the power supply is lost in advance and the valve cannot be closed through electric control, the earthquake can be detected through a mechanical structure, the valve is triggered to be closed, and double protection is achieved.

title_en: Water treatment method and water treatment device
abstract_en: The water treatment method of the present invention comprises: a step of separating the water to be treated into permeate water and concentrate water by supplying the water to a reverse osmosis membrane; and a step of intermittently adding a bactericide to the water to be treated supplied to the reverse osmosis membrane, wherein the step of intermittently adding the bactericide, as a bactericide, a stabilized hypobromous acid composition containing bromine and a sulfamic acid compound, an iodine-based oxidizer, or 2, 2-dibromo-3-nitropropionamide (DBNPA), comprises: a step of evaluating the degree of biological contamination of the reverse osmosis membrane; and adjusting the amount of the bactericide to be added to the water to be treated for a predetermined time in a range in which at least one of the oxidation-reduction potential and the total chlorine concentration of the water to be treated to which the bactericide is added does not exceed a predetermined value set in advance, based on the evaluated degree of biological contamination.

title_en: Method for preparing a solution for activating platelets
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of preparing a solution in a container for activating platelets and/or extracting growth factors from platelets in a container for regenerative medical therapy, the method comprising adding a first anticoagulant which is a sodium citrate solution and which is added with a recombinant collagen preparation and with a second anticoagulant; sodium chloride solution was added. The invention also relates to a method of activating platelets and/or extracting growth factors from platelets in blood, wherein the method comprises introducing into a container containing a solution according to the first aspect of the invention, adding blood to the container, centrifuging the container, and finally extracting the treated blood or a fraction of the treated blood.

title_en: Pt/Fe with Janus structure3O4@mC&mSiO2Catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Pt/Fe  3 O 4 @mC&mSiO 2  catalyst with a Janus structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Preparing Fe  3 O 4 &mSiO 2  asymmetric nano particles; (2) Dispersing Fe  3 O 4 &mSiO 2  asymmetric nano particles in a mixed solution of ethanol, deionized water, dopamine hydrochloride and a template agent, performing ultrasonic dispersion, and mechanically stirring to obtain a uniform transparent solution; (3) Adding mesitylene into the transparent solution, mechanically stirring, adding tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane to adjust the pH, and introducing H  2 PtCl 6  into a reaction system after adding the tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane for not less than 1H; after the reaction, the solid product is washed and then calcined in a high-temperature nitrogen environment to obtain the Pt/Fe  3 O 4 @mC&mSiO 2  nano-particles with Janus structure.

title_en: Forming method of copper-based desulfurization adsorbent for ultra-deep thiophene removal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forming method of a copper-based desulfurization adsorbent for ultra-deep thiophene removal, which comprises the steps of uniformly mixing a copper-based desulfurization adsorbent with a binder accounting for 30-60% of the copper-based desulfurization adsorbent and an extrusion aid accounting for 1-10% of the copper-based desulfurization adsorbent, adding a silica sol nitric acid aqueous solution, kneading to obtain a wet material, extruding and forming by a strip extruder, standing at normal temperature for aging and drying, and roasting at 350-550 ℃ for 3-8 hours to obtain the formed desulfurization adsorbent, wherein the binder is a mixture obtained by mixing pseudoboehmite and kaolin according to the mass ratio of 1:1-3, and the extrusion aid is sesbania powder. The invention ensures that the prepared formed desulfurization adsorbent meets the mechanical strength of industrial application and has excellent desulfurization performance.

title_en: Shale gas composite slick water fracturing fluid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shale gas composite slick water fracturing fluid and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fracturing fluid comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 0.01-0.2% of resistance reducing agent, 0.2-1% of clay stabilizer, 0.1-0.8% of cleanup additive, 0.01-0.15% of gel breaker, 25-40% of self-suspension propping agent and the balance of water; the resistance reducing agent comprises guar gum and sesbania gum, and the mass ratio of the guar gum to the sesbania gum is 1-3:3-5. The slick water fracturing fluid has high dissolution efficiency, strong temperature resistance and strong sand carrying capacity, and can effectively solve the problems of the existing fracturing fluid.

title_en: Polymer type surfactant and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surfactants and discloses a high-molecular surfactant and a preparation process thereof, wherein the high-molecular surfactant is prepared by adopting an initiator to initiate a terminal olefine polytetrahydrofuran component and a quaternary ammonium cationic component to carry out free radical polymerization reaction, natural vegetable oil is used as a reaction raw material, the environment-friendly sustainable development idea is met, meanwhile, the controllable regulation of hydrophilic groups in a surfactant structure is realized by a synthesis mode of free radical copolymerization, the compatibility of the high-molecular surfactant and other water-soluble auxiliary agents is improved, and the high-molecular surfactant has lower surface tension and good surface activity through tests.

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: Disclosed is a resin composition which can provide a cured product having excellent adhesion strength to a conductor layer, while suppressing warpage, and which has a low dielectric loss tangent. A resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin, (B) an epoxy resin curing agent, (C) an imide-skeleton-containing polymer resin having a polybutadiene structure, and (D) an imide-skeleton-containing polymer resin not having a polybutadiene structure, wherein the mass ratio of the (C) component to the (D) component ((C) component content/(D) component content) is 0.2 to 4.

title_en: Packaging material, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The invention provides an encapsulating material which is used for encapsulating a photovoltaic module, wherein the encapsulating material comprises a high-reflection layer and a coating layer arranged on at least one side surface of the high-reflection layer; the high-reflection layer is a foaming film layer, after the packaging material is aged for 2000H at 85 ℃ under the environment of 85% humidity, the high-reflection layer is peeled into a first peeling layer and a second peeling layer by using hot melt adhesive, the average reflectivity of a non-tearing surface of the first peeling layer in a 380-1400nm wave band is R1, the average reflectivity of one side surface of the high-reflection layer in the 380-1400nm wave band is R2, and the average reflectivity difference delta R of the high-reflection layer in the 380-1400nm wave band is=R2-R1; the average reflectivity difference delta R of the high-reflectivity layer in the wave band of 380-1400nm is more than or equal to 1%. The packaging material provided by the invention is used for packaging the photovoltaic module, has the functions of prolonging weather resistance and reducing power attenuation of the photovoltaic module, is especially applied to the photovoltaic module for photoelectric building, and has better chromaticity matching and attractive appearance.

title_en: Super weather-proof roof waterproof paint
abstract_en: A super weather-proof roof waterproof paint belongs to the technical field of paint, and consists of two components, namely A and B, wherein A consists of polyacrylate emulsion, rubber coated nano silicon dioxide, modified lignin emulsion, film forming auxiliary agent, plasticizer, defoamer and deionized water; b consists of silicate cement, quartz powder, a secondary cross-linking agent and a cross-linking agent; the surface drying time of the obtained paint is 0.8 to 1.3 hours, the actual drying time is 2.2 to 2.7 hours, the water impermeability is water impermeability under the conditions of 0.3MPa and 30 minutes, the low-temperature flexibility is-36 to-42 ℃, the freeze thawing damage resistance is 38 to 43 times, the artificial climate aging resistance is realized, and the abnormal time is 4394 to 4659 hours.

title_en: Foam drainage composition, foam drainage agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a foam drainage composition, a foam drainage agent and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of foam drainage agents. In the foam drainage composition, cocoamidopropyl betaine is used as a main agent of a foaming agent, has excellent foaming power and wetting power, has better foaming liquid carrying performance in extreme environments containing high mineralization degree, high methanol, high condensate oil and hydrogen sulfide, can improve the strength of a foam network skeleton by using tetradecyl dimethyl tertiary amine as a foam stabilizer, controls the structural stability of a bubble liquid film, ensures that surfactant molecules are orderly distributed in the bubble liquid film, and endows the foam with good elasticity and self-repairing capability, and the sodium perfluorononenoxybenzenesulfonate is a fluorocarbon anion surfactant, can reduce the surface tension and the oil-water interfacial tension of aqueous solution and improves the drainage effect. The foam drainage composition disclosed by the invention has the multiple functions of high oil resistance, abundant foam, high-efficiency drainage and the like when being used for foam drainage in a gas well, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Method for realizing efficient compounding of graphene foam/phase-change material by combining positive pressure and negative pressure
abstract_en: The invention designs a method for realizing high-efficiency compounding of graphene foam/phase-change material by combining positive pressure and negative pressure, which is used for solving the problems of low compounding rate and poor product quality of large-size porous graphene foam and phase-change material. The graphene foam/phase-change composite material prepared by the method has high phase-change enthalpy and high thermal conductivity, effectively maintains the constant temperature of an electronic device, and ensures the service life and the use safety.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display, in particular to an organic electroluminescent compound and application thereof. The organic electroluminescent compound provided by the invention has the following structure:  The organic electroluminescent device comprising the organic electroluminescent compound can have lower driving voltage, higher luminous efficiency and longer service life.

title_en: Activated carbon adsorption oil gas recovery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an activated carbon adsorption oil gas recovery system, which relates to the field of oil gas recovery, and is technically characterized in that: comprises an absorption tower, a membrane separation assembly and an adsorption tower; the absorption tower comprises a spraying device, an absorption device and an oil storage tank; the spraying device comprises a spraying interface; the oil storage tank is provided with a reflux interface; the top of the absorption tower is provided with a first exhaust port; the absorption tower is also provided with a first air inlet; the membrane separation assembly comprises a second air inlet, a return air inlet and a second air outlet; the adsorption tower comprises a third air inlet and a third air outlet; the adsorption tower is filled with activated carbon; the oil gas enters the absorption tower through the first air inlet; the spraying interface is communicated with the oil storage tank through an absorbent supply pump; the reflux interface is communicated with the oil storage tank; the first exhaust port is communicated with the second air inlet of the membrane separation assembly; the air return port is communicated with the first air inlet of the absorption tower; the second exhaust port of the membrane separation assembly is communicated with the third air inlet of the adsorption tower. The purpose of improving the oil gas removal efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Flexible polar coating composition, coating material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible polar coating composition, a coating material, a preparation method and application thereof. The flexible polar coating composition comprises a first component and a second component, wherein the first component comprises SER modified resin, pigment filler, auxiliary agent and solvent, the second component comprises polyamide resin and solvent, the SER modified resin is prepared by pre-adding bisphenol A epoxy resin and 3-isocyanatopropyl trimethoxy silane to prepare Sil-EP modified resin, and then adding hydroxy-terminated polydimethyl silane to prepare the flexible polar coating composition. The flexible polar coating composition and the coating material provided by the invention have excellent adhesive force, flexibility and high-low temperature alternating resistance under the polar temperature (-60 ℃) condition, and can effectively prevent paint film damage and falling phenomena of the surface of a steel structure under a low-temperature environment caused by mechanical impact and cold-hot temperature change, thereby improving the corrosion protection life of the coating material on the surface of the steel structure under the polar environment.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling 3-chloropropanol ester in edible vegetable oil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vegetable oil refining and risk factor control, and particularly relates to a method for controlling the resistance of 3-chloropropanol ester in edible vegetable oil. According to the method for preventing and controlling the 3-chloropropanol ester in the edible vegetable oil, weak alkaline water is added into the decolorized vegetable oil for water washing treatment, then oil-water separation and drying are carried out to obtain alkaline water washing grease, and further deodorization treatment is carried out on the alkaline water washing grease, so that the 3-chloropropanol ester in the grease deodorization process can be avoided, the 3-chloropropanol ester content in the grease can be effectively reduced, and refined vegetable oil with low 3-chloropropanol ester content is obtained. The control method disclosed by the invention can provide a simpler and more convenient processing strategy for effectively controlling the 3-chloropropanol ester for oil processing enterprises, is beneficial to improving the safety quality of edible oil products, and is suitable for popularization and application of the oil processing enterprises.

title_en: Application of pseudomonas taiwanensis P11 in false smut prevention and treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of pseudomonas taiwanensis P11 in false smut prevention and treatment, which can be realized by the following steps: 1) Activating strains and culturing seeds to obtain seed liquid; 2) Preparing fermentation supernatant: fermenting the seed liquid to obtain a bacterial liquid, and centrifuging to obtain a fermentation supernatant; 3) And (3) drying: drying the fermentation supernatant to obtain a fermentation liquor dried product; 4) And dissolving the fermentation liquor dry matter in water, and spraying the fermentation liquor dry matter on the leaf surfaces of the rice, preferably spraying the fermentation liquor dry matter in both the booting stage and the grouting stage of the rice. The strain P11 of Pseudomonas taiwanensis can have remarkable control effect on false smut, is environment-friendly and has continuous effect, and has good research and application prospects.

title_en: Cracking reaction catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cracking reaction catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, preparing a 13X type molecular sieve: step S2, mixing a platinum-containing compound with water to obtain a platinum precursor solution; step S3, adding the 13X molecular sieve into a platinum precursor solution, stirring, filtering and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor; and step S4 to step S5, the catalyst precursor is calcined twice to obtain the cracking reaction catalyst. The invention firstly designs and controls the whole process flow to obtain the 13X type molecular sieve with good performance; and then, introducing platinum metal into the obtained 13X-type molecular sieve under specific experimental conditions, adding active sites on the platinum metal, and calcining twice to ensure that the obtained cracking catalyst has good reaction activity and stability, can realize efficient cracking reaction at a lower temperature, and finally improves the economic benefit of oil refining.

title_en: Composite microbial fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound microbial fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the compound microbial fertilizer comprises the following raw materials: 2-5% of microbial flora, 20-50% of organic matters, 10-20% of minerals, 15-25% of auxiliary materials and 20-30% of water, wherein the microbial flora comprises beneficial bacteria and beneficial fungi, the beneficial bacteria comprise bacillus subtilis, lactobacillus, bacillus licheniformis and actinomycetes, the beneficial fungi comprise arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi, penicillium and rhizopus, and the auxiliary materials comprise natural stabilizers, biological promoters, pH regulators and nutritional additives. The microbial fertilizer has the advantages that the microbial flora with higher stability is used, the activity of microorganisms is prevented from being reduced in the storage and use processes, the use effect of the microbial fertilizer is prevented from being reduced, the microbial flora is more in variety, the microbial fertilizer is more comprehensive and efficient due to the synergistic effect, and the soil environment and plant growth are improved; the auxiliary materials are added, the functions of the microbial fertilizer are added through mutual cooperation, and the soil improvement effect is better.

title_en: Lithium ion battery diaphragm coating binder, lithium-rich diaphragm, preparation method of lithium-rich diaphragm and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery diaphragm coating binder, a lithium-rich diaphragm, a preparation method of the lithium-rich diaphragm and a battery, and relates to the technical field of battery diaphragms. The chemical formula of the lithium ion battery diaphragm coating binder is [ C  6 H 7 O 2 (OH) 2 OCH 2 COONa x Li 1‑x ] n  ], wherein x is more than 0.75 and less than or equal to 0.80. According to the invention, by accurately controlling the proportion of lithium ions and sodium ions in the adhesive CMC, the ion conductivity of the diaphragm is improved, the ion permeability of the diaphragm is maintained, and stronger adhesive force is provided, the stability of the battery structure is maintained, so that the electrochemical performance of the battery is improved.

title_en: Biocontrol flora CL95 for preventing and treating ginseng rust rot and promoting ginseng growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biocontrol flora CL95 for preventing and treating ginseng rust rot and promoting ginseng growth; it comprises the following steps: bacillus methylotrophicus NJ13, bacillus bailii NT35, bacillus amyloliquefaciens FG14, pseudomonas aeruginosa TU26 with a collection number of CCTCC M2024220, pseudomonas sevietahl JI6, arthrobacter nicotinovorans JI39-2; the biocontrol flora CL95 obviously resists the infection of I.robusta on ginseng, reduces the content of pathogenic bacteria in the ginseng body, improves the activity of soil enzymes, defends the gene expression quantity of enzymes, promotes the growth of ginseng, and can show better disease prevention effect. Colonization in plants and soil is more stable, and microorganisms enriched in ginseng roots and soil can affect plant health by direct antagonism, induction of systemic resistance, or indirect modulation of pathogens via soil microorganisms. The pseudomonas aeruginosa TU26 strain of the rhizosphere bacteria of the ginseng has certain nitrogen fixation capacity and stronger phosphorus and potassium dissolving capacity, can promote the growth and development of the ginseng and improve the yield of the ginseng; the use effect of the biological control bacteria is more obvious.

title_en: Antibacterial and antiviral resin member
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial and antiviral resin component. The antibacterial and antiviral resin component comprises a matrix formed by resin and an antibacterial and antiviral agent contained in the matrix, wherein the charged charge amount of the antibacterial and antiviral resin component is more than 0 muC/m  2  and less than 7 muC/m  2 .

title_en: CO based on polybasic acid2Heterogeneous supermolecule inclusion synergistic system for oil reservoir flooding, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous supermolecule inclusion synergistic system of a CO  2  oil displacement reservoir based on polybasic acid, and a preparation method and application thereof. The supermolecule inclusion synergistic system consists of acid-resistant hydrophobic polymer microspheres, acid-resistant cyclodextrin polymer and polybasic acid. The hydrophobic cavity structure in the acid-resistant cyclodextrin polymer molecular chain can efficiently identify hydrophobic groups on the surface of the acid-resistant hydrophobic polymer microsphere, the acid-resistant hydrophobic polymer microsphere is included by the inclusion of a host and a guest to form a new aggregate structure, and then a certain mass of polybasic acid is added into the aggregate structure to construct a supermolecular network through electrostatic interaction, so that a supermolecular inclusion synergistic system is formed. The system has shear recovery performance, the supermolecule effect is destroyed under the high shear condition when the system is injected, the viscosity of the system is reduced, the injectability can be improved, the in-situ thickening of the stratum after shearing is realized through self-assembly when the system is injected into the ground, the plugging of a gas channeling channel is effectively realized, and the system has important significance for improving the oil displacement effect of CO  2 .

title_en: Application of amide compound in preventing and controlling plant root-knot nematode
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of an amide compound in preventing and controlling plant root-knot nematodes. The amide compound is N- (2- (5- (1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl) thiophen-2-yl) ethyl) -2- (trifluoromethyl) benzamide and/or an agropharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. According to detection, the amide compound N- (2- (5- (1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl) thiophene-2-yl) ethyl) -2- (trifluoromethyl) benzamide has very strong killing effect on southern root-knot nematodes, java root-knot nematodes and caenorhabditis elegans at 24 hours, has very strong killing effect on the southern root-knot nematodes, java root-knot nematodes and caenorhabditis elegans at 5.04 mug/ml, 5.30 mug/ml and 5.11 mug/ml, has very strong killing effect on the half-killing effect on the southern root-knot nematodes, java root-knot nematodes and caenorhabditis elegans at 48 hours, has very strong killing effect on the caenorhabditis elegans at 48 hours, and can be used for preventing and controlling the plant root-knot nematodes.

title_en: Oil stain cleaning composition containing coco dimethyl amine oxide and ethanol
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil stain cleaning composition containing coco dimethyl amine oxide and ethanol, which comprises coco dimethyl amine oxide, ethanol, anionic surfactant, nonionic surfactant and an aqueous carrier, wherein the weight ratio of the anionic surfactant to the nonionic surfactant to the ethanol is 2.4-1:1.4-0.7:1, the weight ratio of coco dimethyl amine oxide to the ethanol is 1-2.4:1, and the coco dimethyl amine oxide content is 10-15 wt% and the ethanol content is 5-10 wt% based on the total weight of the composition. The invention also relates to the use of the cleaning composition for cleaning greasy dirt from household tableware and to a visual evaluation method for removing greasy dirt from the surface of tableware.

title_en: Two-component polyurethane adhesive composition
abstract_en: Provided herein is a two-part polyurethane adhesive composition.

title_en: Water-based lignin-based epoxy resin coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based lignin-based epoxy resin coating and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high value-added utilization of biomass resources and epoxy resin intersection. The water-based lignin-based epoxy resin coating comprises, by weight, 30-50 parts of epoxy modified lignin, 10-20 parts of epoxy polymer, 8-12 parts of epoxy resin curing agent, 0.020-0.030 part of epoxy resin accelerator, 4-6 parts of emulsifier, 10-20 parts of diluent, 0.5-0.8 part of defoamer and 80-100 parts of deionized water, wherein the preparation method of the epoxy modified lignin comprises pretreatment, cyclopropyl modification of lignin, collection and purification of cyclopropyl modified lignin and epoxy modification of lignin. The method utilizes the organic aldehyde acid with higher reactivity with lignin to carry out grafting reaction, further oxidizes cyclopropyl into epoxy group, and successfully grafts the epoxy group into lignin molecular chain.

title_en: Preparation method and application of solid fluorescent PMMA material
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid fluorescent PMMA material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of dissolving 4,4' -bipyridine in acetonitrile, heating in a water bath, stirring uniformly, adding bromopropene, continuing stirring reaction in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain 4,4' -allyl bipyridine salt, adding the 4,4' -allyl bipyridine salt into 100g MMA solution, stirring fully under the conditions of nitrogen protection and oil bath, adding 200mg dibenzoyl peroxide, continuing stirring reaction to obtain a prepolymer, and transferring the prepolymer into a mold for continuing polymerization to obtain the PMMA transparent material. The preparation process is simple and convenient, the energy consumption is low, the detection of specific MnO  4   ‑  ions can be realized, the PMMA optical material can be repeatedly utilized in the detection process, the operation is simple and convenient, and excessive complicated steps are not needed. The PMMA material is greatly popularized in the aspect of optical sensing.

title_en: Self-repairing anti-corrosion coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-repairing anti-corrosion coating, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of protective coatings. The self-repairing coating comprises two-dimensional nano sheets, a polyphenol bio-based material, polyolefin alcohol, active hydrogen atom-containing polymer resin, an isocyanate curing agent and a dispersion medium. The preparation method of the self-repairing coating comprises the steps of firstly forming a two-dimensional nano-sheet, a polyphenol bio-based material and polyolefin alcohol into nano-sheet hydrosol, then forming gel microspheres which are uniformly distributed in polymer resin containing active hydrogen atoms through emulsification and freeze thawing, and then uniformly mixing the polymer resin with an isocyanate curing agent to obtain the self-repairing coating. The self-repairing coating has the advantages of simple preparation, high environmental protection, small loss of mechanical properties of the coating, good shielding performance and strong self-repairing performance, and also has good anti-corrosion and anti-fouling properties.

title_en: High-barrier PVC (polyvinyl chloride) coating film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-barrier PVC (polyvinyl chloride) coating film and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of film material production. The high-barrier PVC coating film comprises a PVC film and a barrier coating arranged on the PVC film, wherein the PVC film is subjected to plasma surface treatment and is connected with long-chain acrylic ester and hydroxy acrylic ester, and the barrier coating is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of PVA, 6-12 parts of formaldehyde, 10-15 parts of glycidyl ether containing two epoxy groups and 0.1-1 part of a crosslinking accelerator. The PVC film has the advantages of improving the barrier property and weather resistance of the PVC film.

title_en: Composition for repairing heavy metal contaminated soil and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polluted soil treatment, in particular to a composition for repairing heavy metal polluted soil, a preparation method and application thereof. The composition for restoring the heavy metal contaminated soil consists of a microbial agent for heavy metal treatment and a Fe  3 O 4 @TiO 2  @C material, wherein the microbial agent for heavy metal treatment is loaded on the Fe  3 O 4 @TiO 2  @C material. The composition can perform physical repair, chemical repair and biological repair simultaneously, adopts Fe  3 O 4  and C to generate physical adsorption effect on heavy metal ions, enriches the heavy metal ions on the composition, adopts Fe  3 O 4 @TiO 2  @C to perform chemical photocatalytic degradation on the heavy metal ions, and then adopts microorganisms to convert the heavy metal ions, thereby realizing high-efficiency treatment on the heavy metal ions in soil through the composition.

title_en: Preparation method of pigment for ceramic ink-jet printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pigment for ceramic ink-jet printing, which relates to the field of ceramic ink-jet pigment and comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a mixed solution by 1.5-2 mol of tetraethoxysilane, 1.4-1.8 mol of zirconium oxychloride, 0.04-0.2 mol of nano ferric oxide, 6-7 g of mineralizer and water according to the following proportion, S2, granulating the mixed solution through spray drying to obtain powder particles, S3, fully mixing the powder particles and a foaming agent according to the mass ratio of 6-10:1, calcining, S4, rinsing the calcined material, drying and crushing to obtain the pigment with the D50 particle size of 0.5-0.8 mu m. The preparation method of the invention has the advantages of improving the color development stability, the antibacterial stability and the durability of the pigment.

title_en: Continuous degreasing and purifying system for waste edible oil
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of edible oil purification, specifically a continuous degreasing and purification system for waste edible oil, comprising an installation cylinder, wherein a fixed tube is fixedly installed at a coaxial position inside the installation cylinder, and a cover plate is fixedly installed at the upper end of the installation cylinder. The fixed tube is provided with a filtering mechanism for filtering waste edible oil, and the installation cylinder is provided with a pressing mechanism for pressing the residue in the waste edible oil. The present invention uses a driving component to drive the annular filter plate to intermittently rotate, so that the annular filter plate can filter the waste edible oil through different positions on it, and the sieve holes of the annular filter plate can be unblocked through the insertion column on the lower clamp plate, without the need to remove and clean the annular filter plate, thereby improving the filtration efficiency. Efficiency, when the insertion column on the lower clamp is used to clear the filter screen, The annular filter plate can still filter waste edible oil without stopping the machine, further improving the filtration efficiency.

title_en: Method for treating inner wall of high-purity special gas cylinder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating the inner wall of a high-purity special gas cylinder. The fluorine-containing polymer finishing paint is prepared by cleaning a gas cylinder, carrying out sand blasting, pretreatment of spraying, spraying primer, spraying finishing paint for multiple times, then cleaning and drying, wherein the fluorine-containing polymer finishing paint prepared by the invention is prepared by reacting sodium dodecyl sulfate, nonylphenol polyoxyethylene ether, n-butyl alcohol, tetrafluoropropanol, perfluoroalkyl ethyl acrylate, bis- (2-methallyl) cycloocta-1, 5-diene ruthenium, (-) -IPC2B (allyl) borane, styrene, distilled water and an initiator, has high fluorine element content and strong carbon-fluorine bond polarity, can obviously improve the corrosion resistance of the material, and the bis- (2-methallyl) cycloocta-1, 5-diene ruthenium can form a stable complex with other components in a monomer, so that the structural optimization also improves the resistance of the polymer to chemical corrosion.

title_en: Management method for promoting acanthopanax root cutting rooting
abstract_en: The invention provides a management method for promoting rooting of acanthopanax root by cutting, and relates to the technical field of artificial breeding of acanthopanax root. The management method mainly comprises the steps of setting indoleacetic acid, wood vinegar, soaking liquid prepared from walnut green seedcase extracts, treating cutting branches by using disinfectants prepared from quicklime and cooked rice milk, and setting river sand, walnut green seedcase treatment materials, perlite and organic fertilizer as cutting substrates to carry out cutting treatment on acanthopanax. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, effectively improves the survival rate of acanthopanax branch cuttage, further promotes the cuttage rooting of acanthopanax, improves the growth efficiency of cuttage seedling, and is convenient for later transplanting and planting.

title_en: Two-component polyurethane adhesive composition
abstract_en: A two-part thermally conductive polyurethane adhesive comprises a component a and a component B. The component A is an NCO-terminated prepolymer prepared by reacting at least one polyol having a Mn of greater than 2,000Da and an OH functionality of 2-3 with 30-45wt% based on the total weight of the component A of at least one polyisocyanate selected from the group consisting of aliphatic polyisocyanates and mixtures of 2,4'-MDI and 4,4' -MDI. The component B comprises at least one polyol having Mn less than 1,000Da and an OH functionality of at least 2. An adhesive assembly includes a first substrate and a second substrate bonded to the first substrate by a polyurethane adhesive made by mixing the component a and component B together.

title_en: Use of specific base oils for reducing particulate emissions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of a lubricant composition comprising a base oil or a mixture of base oils having a viscosity (BOV or base oil viscosity) of less than or equal to 4 for reducing particulate emissions from an engine. The present invention relates to the use of a lubricant composition for reducing particulate emissions of an engine, the lubricant composition comprising a base oil or a mixture of base oils, wherein the base oil or the mixture of base oils has a kinematic viscosity measured at 100 ℃ of less than or equal to 4.5mm  2 /s and the lubricant composition has a viscosity at 150 ℃ and at constant shear of greater than or equal to 2.4 mPa-s.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of carbonyl sulfide low-temperature hydrolysis catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method and application of a carbonyl sulfide hydrolysis catalyst, which comprises the steps of mixing pseudo-boehmite, ammonium bicarbonate, sodium carbonate and a binder, granulating to obtain a granular mixture, sequentially drying and calcining the granular mixture to obtain gamma-Al  2 O 3  carrier pellets, placing the gamma-Al  2 O 3  pellets in impregnating solution, carrying out pressure impregnation treatment, and then drying and calcining to obtain the carbonyl sulfide hydrolysis catalyst. The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing gamma-Al  2 O 3  balls as carriers, then loading zirconium, sodium and potassium on the gamma-Al  2 O 3  balls, wherein gamma-Al  2 O 3  has stronger adsorptivity to carbonyl sulfide, zrO  2  has good acid resistance and water resistance, plays a role in protecting a catalyst, metals such as Na, K and the like exist in the form of carbonate in blast furnace gas, weak alkaline centers reduce the activation energy of reaction, SO that carbonyl sulfide is hydrolyzed into H  2  S and CO  2 , and the standard emission of SO  2  at a user end of the blast furnace gas is realized by matching with a H  2  S removal technology.

title_en: Method for refining aroma type vegetable oil by using plasma activated water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for refining aroma type vegetable oil by utilizing plasma activated water. The method mainly comprises the steps of adding 0.1-2.0% of plasma activated water into pressed crude oil, stirring at a speed of 5-20 rpm/min for 15-30 min, settling at 4-35 ℃ for 10-48 hours, and centrifuging the settled oil to remove sediment to obtain refined aromatic vegetable oil. The method adopts the plasma activated water to refine the aromatic vegetable oil, not only can rapidly remove impurities affecting the quality of the grease, but also can retain more flavor substances and nutrient components in the grease, is simple to operate and short in time consumption, does not adopt any chemical reagent in the implementation process, and is an efficient and green aromatic vegetable oil refining method.

title_en: Preparation method and application of double-base low-foam ether ester nonionic surfactant
abstract_en: The preparation method of the double-base low-foam ether ester nonionic surfactant comprises the following steps of mixing linoleic acid and polyethylene glycol dilaurate, adding a catalyst A, adding a solvent B, replacing nitrogen for reaction until no water is produced in a reaction container, and obtaining a reaction solution after the reaction is finished, and step 2, evaporating the reaction solution to obtain liquid, thereby obtaining the double-base low-foam ether ester nonionic surfactant. The invention also comprises the application of the double-base low-foam ether ester nonionic surfactant in the paint. The double-base low-foam ether ester nonionic surfactant prepared by the method can solve the problem that the existing surfactant has slightly poor stability in an acidic medium. The problems of poor water resistance, poor glossiness and the like of the coating are solved by adding the ether ester nonionic surfactant.

title_en: Application of Paenibacillus clarkii space mutant DeltaPS 04-17 strain in prevention and treatment of cucumber mosaic virus
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a Paenibacillus clarkii space mutant DeltaPS 04-17 strain in prevention and treatment of cucumber mosaic virus. Researches show that the DeltaPS 04-17 strain has the effect of inhibiting CMV, can obviously reduce the incidence of CMV host plants, has a relative prevention effect of 54.72 percent on plant diseases caused by CMV after being treated by DeltaPS 04-17, reduces the incidence of tobacco cucumber mosaic virus diseases, can effectively inhibit the propagation of CMV in plants, delay the incidence of the disease, prevent the occurrence of the cucumber mosaic virus diseases and prevent premature senility of the plants, and meanwhile, the DeltaPS 04-17 strain can promote the growth of tobacco, promote the growth of root systems, increase the leaf area of tobacco, enhance the growth vigor of the tobacco and increase the yield, and the DeltaPS 04-17 strain is green and safe, can reduce the use of pesticides, is beneficial to the development of environmental safety, can be used for green prevention and control of the CMV, and has important significance on the prevention and the production of the tobacco diseases.

title_en: Smokeless sulfur-free firework propellant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energetic materials, and provides a smokeless sulfur-free firework propellant and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of smokeless sulfur-free firework propellant. According to the invention, the first cotton nitrocellulose and/or the second cotton nitrocellulose are used as nitrocellulose, so that the finally obtained firework propellant is smokeless and sulfur-free, and has an excellent gunpowder force value. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate and easy to operate. The nitrogen content of the smokeless sulfur-free firework propellant provided by the invention is 6.813-12.6%, the viscosity is 3.24-4.9 Entitre, the loose density is 0.82-0.89 g/cm  3 , the powder strength is 842.6-897.6 kj/kg, the specific heat ratio is 1.1023-1.2588, the flame temperature is 1435K-2042K, and the residual capacity is 776-1067 cm  3 /kg.

title_en: Silicon modified Beta zeolite molecular sieve, catalytic diesel hydrocracking catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon modified Beta zeolite molecular sieve, a catalytic diesel hydrocracking catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The silicon modified Beta zeolite molecular sieve has a silicon-aluminum oxide molecular ratio of 80-300, preferably 100-200, and an acid amount of 0.05-0.35mmol/g, preferably 0.1-0.3mmol/g. The invention adopts the silicon modified Beta zeolite molecular sieve as a part of active components for acid functional cracking of the catalyst, and can effectively improve the yields of light aromatic hydrocarbon and xylene products of the conventional Beta zeolite molecular sieve-based catalytic diesel hydrocracking catalyst.

title_en: Anti-reflection eye protection film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of films, in particular to an anti-reflection eye protection film and a preparation method thereof. The anti-reflection eye protection film is obtained by mixing nano hollow microspheres A and nano hollow microspheres B and then coating the mixture on the surface of a glass substrate, wherein the nano hollow microspheres A are obtained by emulsion polymerization of methyl methacrylate, hydroxyethyl methacrylate and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate by taking amphiphilic macromolecular RAFT reagent A as an emulsifying agent, and the nano hollow microspheres B are obtained by emulsion polymerization of methyl methacrylate, epoxypropyl methacrylate and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate by taking amphiphilic macromolecular RAFT reagent B as an emulsifying agent. The anti-reflection eye protection film prepared by the invention has excellent light transmittance and extremely low reflectivity, and can maintain excellent optical performance for a long time in the actual use process, so that the anti-reflection eye protection film is suitable for various application scenes, such as glasses, display screens and other optical devices.

title_en: Sesame oil extraction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of edible oil extraction, and discloses a sesame oil extraction process which comprises the following steps of raw material pretreatment, primary sesame treatment through cleaning, drying and crushing, enzymatic auxiliary cell wall rupture, composite degradation of cell walls by using cellulase, pectase and protease, subcritical fluid extraction, sesame oil extraction by using solvents such as butane or propane under the condition of low temperature and low pressure, oil refining, impurity removal through physical filtration, enzymatic degumming and vacuum deodorization, oil quality improvement, finished product packaging, and filling of the refined sesame oil by using a light-resistant sealed container. Compared with the traditional process, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the extraction rate of the grease and the retention rate of the functional components, reducing the peroxide value, remarkably shortening the extraction time, along with strong process adaptability, environmental protection and energy saving, and suitability for industrialized popularization.

title_en: Method for processing restaurant residual food into fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing restaurant residual food into fertilizer, which comprises the steps of carrying out impurity removal treatment and desalination treatment on the collected restaurant residual food containing leftovers, leftovers and impurities, removing the impurities and salt in the collected restaurant residual food to obtain the restaurant residual food containing the leftovers, carrying out high-temperature sterilization treatment on the restaurant residual food, carrying out stirring treatment on the restaurant residual food while carrying out high-temperature sterilization treatment on the restaurant residual food, detecting the content change rate of water vapor generated by the high-temperature sterilization treatment on the restaurant residual food during the high-temperature sterilization treatment and stirring treatment, and regulating the heating temperature according to the detected content change rate of the water vapor and the high-temperature sterilization treatment time to process the restaurant residual food into sterile basic fertilizer capable of being stored for a long time.

title_en: Preparation method and application of fluorescent Cu-MOFs nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a fluorescent Cu-MOFs nano material, which comprises the steps of mixing and stirring polyvinylpyrrolidone, terephthalic acid, copper chloride dihydrate and triethylamine to obtain a suspension, carrying out ultrasonic treatment and centrifugation on the suspension to obtain a precipitate, and washing, freezing and drying the precipitate to obtain the fluorescent Cu-MOFs nano material, wherein the mass ratio of the polyvinylpyrrolidone to the copper chloride dihydrate is (0.01-0.2): 1, the ultrasonic power is 20-80 KHZ, and the fluorescent Cu-MOFs nano material has fluorescent property, can be excited to emit fluorescent signals, has active sites on the surface, is beneficial to adsorbing and extracting fingerprint components, and is simple in operation steps, high in safety coefficient, low in cost and wide in application range.

title_en: Organic composite nano-calcium foliar fertilizer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic fertilizer preparation, in particular to an organic composite nano-calcium foliar fertilizer and application thereof. The organic composite nano-calcium foliar fertilizer is prepared from the following components, by mass, 45-55 parts of a green nano-calcium agent, 80-120 parts of an organic compound and 8-12 parts of a surfactant. The invention synthesizes the green nano calcium material and reasonably cooperates with the organic active substances to prepare the organic composite nano calcium fertilizer, and the foliar spraying is carried out in the bud stage, the flowering and pod stage and the grain-swelling mature stage of crops, thereby promoting the growth of the crops, the absorption and accumulation of edible part calcium, improving the bioavailability and the nutrition quality of calcium in agricultural products, and producing the calcium-enriched functional agricultural products promotes the nutrition and health of human calcium.

title_en: Boron-containing organic silicon, optical adhesive, organic silicon OCA and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a boron-containing organic silicon, an optical adhesive, an organic silicon OCA and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the boron-containing organic silicon comprise silanol, siloxane monomers and boric acid compounds, the ratio of the total molar quantity of hydroxyl groups to the total molar quantity of alkoxy groups in the preparation raw materials of the boron-containing organic silicon is (0.8-1.1): 1, and the ratio of the total molar quantity of B elements to the total molar quantity of Si elements is (5-11.5). The boron-containing organic silicon provided by the invention has good compatibility with organic silicon materials in the optical adhesive through the design of the preparation raw materials, has excellent tackifying effect on the optical adhesive, and has excellent low temperature resistance and high temperature and high humidity resistance.

title_en: Super-weather-resistant high-gloss titanium dioxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses super-weather-resistant high-gloss titanium dioxide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of adding deionized water into meta-titanic acid for pulping to prepare meta-titanic acid slurry, adding a salt treatment agent for reaction, wherein the salt treatment agent comprises potassium salt, phosphorus salt, zinc salt and aluminum salt, the addition amount of the phosphorus salt is 0.01-0.15% of the mass of TiO  2  based on the mass of P  2 O 5 , the addition amount of the zinc salt is 5-10% of the mass of TiO  2 , the addition amount of the potassium salt is 0.25-0.45% of the mass of TiO  2 , the addition amount of the aluminum salt is 0.05-0.2% of the mass of TiO  2  based on the mass of Al  2 O 3 , and sequentially and uniformly coating a coating of hydrated SiO  2  and compact aluminum on the surface of titanium dioxide particles. The method for combining the excessive zinc salt and the small amount of aluminum salt is used for filling the lattice defect of TiO  2 , preventing the diffusion of gaps, promoting the recombination of particles, and achieving the effect of inhibiting the photocatalytic reaction so as to meet the requirement of the ultra-weather-resistant high-gloss titanium dioxide.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant Ce doped silane film on stainless steel surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a corrosion-resistant Ce-doped silane film on the surface of stainless steel and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of composite materials. The invention solves the problem that steel is corroded due to contact with the atmospheric environment in the storage and transportation processes. The preparation method of the Ce-doped silane film comprises the steps of (1) preprocessing a stainless steel substrate, (2) adding the silane coupling agent and a cerium source into a solution consisting of ethanol and deionized water, stirring, standing and hydrolyzing to obtain a hydrolysate, and (3) immersing the steel substrate into the hydrolysate for dip-coating and curing to obtain the corrosion-resistant Ce-doped silane film on the surface of the stainless steel.

title_en: Deacidification process for kitchen waste grease
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste grease treatment and provides a kitchen waste grease deacidification process which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out activation treatment on activated carbon, uniformly mixing the activated carbon with chitosan, grinding to obtain chitosan modified activated carbon, S2, uniformly mixing the chitosan modified activated carbon with a sodium hydroxide solution, filtering, drying to obtain solid alkali, S3, uniformly mixing the solid alkali with kitchen waste grease, carrying out suction filtration, washing and centrifuging to obtain deacidified oil phase. Through the technical scheme, the problem of low deacidification rate of the kitchen waste grease deacidification process in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Protective sheet
abstract_en: The protective sheet of the present invention comprises a protective layer, a first release liner disposed on one surface of the protective layer, and a second release liner disposed on the other surface of the protective layer, wherein the protective layer comprises a water-soluble polymer compound, and when the release force of the first release liner to the protective layer is P  A  and the release force of the second release liner to the protective layer is P  B , the release forces P  A  and P  B  satisfy the following relational expression that P  A ＜P B 、P B  is less than or equal to 2000mN/25mm.

title_en: Nutrient solution for promoting strong seedlings of potatoes and enhancing stress resistance, culture method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutrient solution for promoting strong seedlings of potatoes and enhancing stress resistance, a culture method and application thereof. According to the invention, through a nutrient solution culture contrast test, an improved 1/2Hoagland nutrient solution is found, the short-term and strong effects of potato seedlings can be promoted by increasing the use amount of phosphorus and zinc elements, the growth of the tissue culture seedlings can be better promoted and the stress resistance of the tissue culture seedlings can be enhanced by adding the seaweed oligosaccharide, and the tissue culture seedlings are cultured only by adopting an ionic liquid nutrient solution, so that the method is suitable for water culture and matrix culture, and is simple and rapid, and good in strengthening effect.

title_en: Streptomyces you su phenanthrenei strain and application of metabolite cis-3-indoleacrylic acid thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Streptomyces you-Phellinus strain and application of its metabolite cis-3-indoleacrylic acid, belonging to the technical field of microbial pesticides. The preservation name of the Streptomyces you-Phellinus strain is Streptomyces you-Phellinus Streptomycesyoussoufiensis YMF3.862 strain, which is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms), the preservation date is 2024, 5 and 20 days, and the preservation number is CGMCC No.30698. The invention has the characteristics of low use cost, good prevention effect, no residue and safety to human, livestock and environment, and the prevention effect of the biological pesticide prepared by YMF3.862 strain and the metabolic compound cis-3-indoleacrylic acid thereof on tobacco root knot nematode disease, tobacco bacterial wilt and composite diseases caused by the tobacco root knot nematode disease and the tobacco bacterial wilt is more than 60%.

title_en: Surfactant composition for oil displacement and production device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil displacement surfactant production equipment, in particular to an oil displacement surfactant composition and a production device thereof, wherein the surfactant composition comprises the following raw materials of trisiloxane, polyoxyethylene sorbitan monooleate, methacryloylethyl betaine, polymethacrylic acid, a foaming agent, a foam stabilizer and deionized water; the surfactant composition has strong wetting dispersibility and high oil displacement efficiency, can effectively reduce the cost of oil extraction, has no toxicity, does not harm stratum, has good compatibility, can be compositely applied with other chemical oil displacement agents, greatly improves the oil recovery ratio, and has mild reaction conditions, simple preparation process and reasonable process, thereby being suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Facility vegetable field restoration agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a facility vegetable field restoration agent and a preparation method and application thereof. The facility vegetable field restoration agent comprises boron mud doped kitchen waste biomass charcoal, amino functional diatomite powder, growth-promoting disease-inhibiting compound and photosensitive active soil-regulating compound. The invention adopts the environment-friendly concept of 'treating pollution with waste', fully utilizes agricultural waste resources such as boron mud, kitchen waste, silkworm excrement, kitchen compost and the like, and prepares the boron mud doped with kitchen waste biomass charcoal, amino functional diatomite powder, growth-promoting disease-suppressing compound and photosensitive active soil-regulating compound into a powdery facility vegetable field repairing agent with multiple functions through scientific formula and modification process, and has the positive effects of relieving soil acidification, improving soil fertility, passivating heavy metal cadmium, promoting crop growth, inhibiting fusarium oxysporum growth, reducing cucumber morbidity and the like, thereby being beneficial to solving the problems of facility vegetable field degradation and cadmium pollution.

title_en: Long-life organic electroluminescent compound and organic electroluminescent device comprising same
abstract_en: The invention provides a long-life organic electroluminescent compound and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same. The organic electroluminescent compound contains a benzonaphthofuran fragment, the benzonaphthofuran structure is used for replacing dibenzofuran, pi electron cloud conjugation length is prolonged, negative charges can be effectively dispersed on the benzonaphthofuran fragment when molecules are converted into an anion state after electrons are accepted, local energy overhigh caused by nonuniform negative charge distribution is avoided, so that the stability of a material can be improved, and further, the benzonaphthofuran fragment has better planeness, and the stability of the material can be obviously improved through partial deuteration.

title_en: Re-soluble self-adhesive paint-brushing wallpaper and its preparing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of self-adhesive wallpaper, in particular to a re-soluble self-adhesive paint brushing wallpaper and a preparation method thereof, and the self-adhesive paint brushing wallpaper comprises an adhesive layer, a base material and a surface decorative layer, wherein the adhesive layer comprises, by weight, 80-120 parts of polyvinyl alcohol resin, 50-60 parts of cellulose, 1.5-6 parts of defoamer, 10-12 parts of stabilizer, 7.5-9 parts of 4, 5-dichloro-2-octyl-3 (2H) -isothiazolone and 400-500 parts of purified water. The re-soluble self-adhesive paint-brushing wallpaper disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the self-soluble self-adhesive paint-brushing wallpaper is non-adhesive after being dried, the viscosity can be recovered after being coated with water, good adhesion effect can be ensured during construction, repeated construction and free movement can be realized, the self-adhesive paint-brushing wallpaper is self-adhesive, additional adhesive brushing is not needed, the operation is simple and convenient, the construction time and the labor cost are greatly saved, the problems that the conventional self-adhesive wallpaper is made of self-adhesive materials, the self-adhesive wallpaper is difficult to move and adjust once being adhered in the construction process, and the wall surface or paper per se can be damaged during disassembly, so that the secondary use is difficult are solved.

title_en: Method for preparing organic fertilizer from avermectin residues
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an organic fertilizer from abamectin residues, and relates to the technical field of organic fertilizers. When the abamectin dregs are used for preparing the organic fertilizer, firstly, gamma-glycidoxypropyl trimethoxy silane is used for treating ferroferric oxide, amino cyclodextrin is grafted to obtain pre-modified ferroferric oxide, chlorophyll extracted from spinach leaves is reacted with hydrochloric acid and then reacted with ferric sulfate to obtain modified chlorophyll, the modified chlorophyll is reacted with the pre-modified ferroferric oxide to obtain modified ferroferric oxide, secondly, the abamectin dregs, the modified ferroferric oxide and acetone are mixed and treated under an ultraviolet lamp, magnet separation is used for obtaining the pre-treated dregs, finally, the pre-treated dregs, bacillus subtilis, aspergillus niger and soluble starch are mixed, and the organic fertilizer is prepared through aerobic composting fermentation, aging drying and crushing granulation, so that the abamectin dregs are reduced, harmless and recycled.

title_en: Multi-effect soil conditioner based on waste and inferior tobacco leaves and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil improvement and discloses a multi-effect soil conditioner based on waste and inferior tobacco leaves, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw materials of the conditioner comprise, by mass, 26-30% of waste and inferior tobacco leaves, 24-28% of mushroom residues, 24-28% of tea seed shells, 10-15% of pig manure, 1-2% of bacillus subtilis powder, collecting raw materials of waste and inferior tobacco leaves, mushroom residues, tea seed shells and pig manure, carrying out raw material detection and proportioning, mixing the raw materials after adding bacillus subtilis, fermenting for thirty days, turning piles once every ten days, carrying out detection to obtain the multi-effect soil conditioner, applying the soil conditioner to a farmland with 20-25cm surface layer of soil to be fertilized to the farmland according to the total weight of 100 kg/mu-150 kg/mu, covering soil, turning 8-12cm of the farmland after soil covering, and planting flue-cured tobacco, so that the conditioner can achieve the effects of improving physical and chemical properties of the tobacco leaves, promoting growth, improving the production quality and enhancing the stress resistance of the tobacco.

title_en: Active repairing agent for road network cracks and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an active repairing agent for road network cracks and a preparation method and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of road materials, and aims to solve the technical problems that after the road network cracks are repaired, the strength is slowly improved, and the traffic is limited after the repair. The active repairing agent comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass of 20-40 parts of active diluent, 20-30 parts of modified asphalt, 10-30 parts of toughening agent, 4-8 parts of silane coupling agent and 100 parts of filler, and the component B is curing agent solution. The invention is fast cured by complexing the active diluent and the inorganic calcium salt curing agent and interweaving the active diluent and the inorganic calcium salt curing agent to form a space reticular structure, and the active curing agent has the characteristics of strong permeability and fast strength formation, and can open traffic after the network crack is repaired.

title_en: Preparation method and application of magnesium powder dust settling agent with high agglomeration and flame retardance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dust settling agents, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of a magnesium powder dust settling agent with high agglomeration and flame retardance, which comprises the following components of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazole ethyl sulfate salt, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazole trifluoro methane sulfonate, N-butylimidazole tetrafluoroborate, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazole tetrafluoroborate, 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazole trifluoro methane sulfonate, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazole bromide salt, plant glycoside, sodium sulfate, magnesium chloride and the balance of water, wherein the water accounts for 60-80% of the weight of all the components. The preparation method and the application of the magnesium powder dust settling agent with high agglomeration and flame retardance solve the problem that the single-component metal magnesium powder dust settling agent in the prior art cannot meet the current dust prevention requirement of metal magnesium production, and simultaneously have effective explosion suppression capability, so that the safety of workers and factories in the metal magnesium processing process is ensured.

title_en: Enclosed water-based polyurethane resin and synthetic method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of aqueous polyurethane polymer materials, and particularly relates to a closed aqueous polyurethane resin and a synthetic method and application thereof. The closed aqueous polyurethane resin comprises the following preparation raw materials of macromolecular polyol, a micromolecular chain extender, a hydrophilic chain extender, diisocyanate, a sealing agent, diethanolamine and a neutralizing agent. The invention synthesizes the water-based polyurethane resin with a special structure by utilizing the tailorability of the molecular structure of the water-based polyurethane.
