The invention synthesizes a closed aqueous polyurethane resin by a prepolymer method, wherein the closed aqueous polyurethane contains partial hydroxyl groups, and under a certain temperature, the closed isocyanate can be unsealed to release isocyanate so as to carry out crosslinking reaction with the hydroxyl groups contained in the closed aqueous polyurethane resin. The closed aqueous polyurethane resin has no problem of open time in use, high crosslinking degree compared with two components, less side reaction after high-temperature deblocking, and reduced cost.

title_en: Zinc ammonium phosphate pigment for water-based epoxy paint and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc ammonium phosphate pigment for a water-based epoxy paint and a synthesis method thereof, comprising the steps of preparing a zinc ion solution with a pH value of 1-5, preparing an ammonium ion solution with a pH value of 1-5, preparing a phosphate ion solution with a pH value of 7-14, mixing the ammonium ion solution with the zinc ion solution to obtain a mixed solution, atomizing the phosphate ion solution into the mixed solution to obtain a zinc ammonium phosphate solution, placing the zinc ammonium phosphate solution in an ultrasonic vibration and microwave heating auxiliary device for ultrasonic refining, heating and heat preservation, filtering precipitation in the zinc ammonium phosphate solution, and drying to obtain the zinc ammonium phosphate pigment, and aims to solve the problems that the zinc ammonium phosphate pigment prepared by the prior method has coarse particle size, low solubility, weak hydrolysis capability and poor compatibility between an inorganic pigment and an organic resin interface in the curing process, thereby improving the corrosion protection capability of a new generation of zinc phosphate-based inorganic pigment in the water-based epoxy paint.

title_en: Ink and preparation method thereof, light-emitting device and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to ink, a preparation method thereof, a light-emitting device and a display panel. The ink comprises nanoparticles, a silane copolymer and an organic solvent. The silane copolymer can enhance the solubility and film forming property of the ink, and can adjust gaps among nano particles, so that the nano particles and the silane copolymer are distributed more uniformly. The quantum dot luminescent layer prepared by the ink can reduce the permeation of the alcohol ether organic solvent into the film at the lower layer of the quantum dot luminescent layer in the preparation process of the luminescent device, thereby reducing the damage of the alcohol ether organic solvent to the film at the lower layer.

title_en: Long-acting mildew-proof joint beautifying agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-acting mildew-proof joint beautifying agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the joint beautifying agent comprises a component A and a component B, the component A is prepared from silane modified polyether, reinforcing filler, hydrophobic fumed silica, a light stabilizer, an antioxidant, a coupling agent and an epoxy curing agent, the component B is prepared from epoxy resin, hydrophobic fumed silica, reinforcing filler, water and a catalyst, and the coupling agent is a fluorine-containing coupling agent and an aminosilane coupling agent in a weight ratio of 1.5-2.5:1. The joint compound disclosed by the invention has a good mould-proof effect, can prevent mildew for a long time, is good in elasticity, is resistant to bending and scraping, is small in internal stress, is not easy to cause common cracking problems of joint compound, is not easy to damage ceramic tiles due to displacement and other conditions, is high in bonding strength with ceramic tiles, is not easy to fall off, is environment-friendly and attractive, and has a great prospect in the field of joint compound.

title_en: Preparation and application of terbium-doped titanium carbide quantum dot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of terbium-doped titanium carbide quantum dots, which comprises the following steps of mixing Ti  3 C 2  MXene with an alcohol solvent, heating for reaction, centrifuging a reaction product to obtain a supernatant to obtain a Ti  3 C 2  QDs solution, dissolving water-soluble terbium salt and EDTA in water to obtain a terbium ion solution, and uniformly mixing the terbium ion solution with the Ti  3 C 2  QDs solution to obtain the terbium-doped titanium carbide quantum dots. The prepared Ti  3 C 2  QDs are mixed with terbium ions (Tb  3+ ), and a terbium-doped Ti  3 C 2  QDs ratio fluorescent probe for detecting ciprofloxacin is constructed. The invention develops a rapid and simple method for detecting ciprofloxacin based on the characteristics of good biocompatibility, low toxicity, hydrophilicity and the like of Ti  3 C 2  QDs and the specific recognition effect of Tb doped Ti  3 C 2  QDs on the ciprofloxacin, thereby realizing quantitative detection of the ciprofloxacin in an aqueous solution sample.

title_en: Process and device for preparing aromatic hydrocarbon and carbon nano tube by PVC catalytic pyrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process and a device for preparing aromatic hydrocarbon and carbon nano tubes by PVC catalytic pyrolysis, which comprise a screw feeder for conveying PVC materials, wherein the output end of the screw feeder is provided with a reaction bin, and the output end of the reaction bin is provided with a second cyclone separator. According to the process and the device for preparing the aromatic hydrocarbon and the carbon nano tube by the PVC catalytic pyrolysis, the low-temperature plasma and the catalyst are coupled in the PVC catalytic pyrolysis system, the plasma is effectively utilized in the early dechlorination process to reduce the temperature required for removing the HCl, the synergistic effect of the low-temperature plasma and the catalyst is utilized in the subsequent catalytic pyrolysis process to realize the directional regulation and control of waste plastic pyrolysis products, the hydrocarbon gas yield and the quality of pyrolysis oil are improved, the reaction efficiency is improved, the selectivity and the yield of target products are improved, the added value of the products is improved, the decomposition and heat absorption effects of MgCO3 are effectively utilized to control the temperature during the calcination of nickel-based catalyst gas, and more fibrous carbon deposits are reserved.

title_en: Polishing method for optical glass lens and cerium oxide polishing powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polishing method of an optical glass lens and cerium oxide polishing powder, the polishing method comprises the steps of preparing cerium oxide polishing liquid and adopting the cerium oxide polishing liquid to polish the optical glass lens, wherein the cerium oxide polishing liquid is formed by dispersing the cerium oxide polishing powder in a solvent, the method for preparing the cerium oxide polishing powder comprises the steps of continuously adding carbonate precipitant into cerium chloride rare earth feed liquid at 55-65 ℃ for reaction until the pH value of the system reaches 6.0-6.5, obtaining rare earth carbonate slurry, purifying, adding polyethylene glycol with proper molecular weight, stirring and ageing, heating to above 90 ℃, preserving heat, pressing and filtering after preserving heat, drying, calcining, cooling by water, ball milling, and the cerium oxide polishing liquid prepared by adopting specific cerium oxide polishing powder is used for polishing the optical glass lens, thus not only having excellent polishing quality, high polishing efficiency, but also being safe and environment-friendly and long in polishing life.

title_en: Vegetable seedling raising and strengthening microorganism composition, matrix and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetable seedling-raising and seedling-strengthening microbial composition, a matrix and a preparation method, and belongs to the technical field of microbial agents. The invention provides a microorganism composition for vegetable seedling culture, which comprises bacterial solutions of various bacteria, wherein the bacterial types of the bacteria comprise bacillus subtilis, bacillus amyloliquefaciens, paenibacillus polymyxa and azospirillum brasilense, and the bacteria have synergistic effects, so that the germination time of seeds can be obviously shortened, and the root length and the lateral root number can be improved. The invention also takes the microorganism composition as a basis, and the microorganism composition and the mushroom waste, the straw, the fresh livestock manure and the like are subjected to closed fermentation to prepare the substrate for vegetable seedling cultivation, so that seeds can be directly planted in the substrate for vegetable seedling cultivation, the germination time of the seeds can be further shortened, and statistics is carried out within the same time after germination.

title_en: Preparation method of large-size graphene heat conducting film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a large-size graphene heat conducting film. Before splicing, clamping the graphene oxide film by two layers of tight polyester cloth, soaking in deionized water, and effectively increasing the cohesiveness of the graphene oxide film in the subsequent splicing process by utilizing the swelling capacity of the graphene oxide in water, so that a large-size graphene heat conducting film with high tensile breaking strength is finally obtained, and the limitation of the prior art on the size and equipment in the preparation process of the graphene heat conducting film is overcome.

title_en: Sheet for workpiece processing and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a sheet for processing a workpiece, comprising a base material and an adhesive layer laminated on one side of the base material, wherein the adhesive layer is composed of an acrylic adhesive, and the acrylic adhesive is formed from a solvent-free adhesive composition containing a retarder for delaying a crosslinking reaction. The sheet for work processing is capable of reducing environmental load, and the adhesive composition for forming the adhesive layer has a sufficient pot life.

title_en: Enhanced water-based chromium-free zinc-aluminum coating, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced water-based chromium-free zinc-aluminum coating, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the coating comprises a component A and a component B, the component A comprises, by mass, 10-20 parts of a silane binder, 1-4 parts of a corrosion inhibitor and 20-80 parts of a solvent, and the component B comprises, by mass, 30-60 parts of flaky zinc-aluminum alloy powder, 10-20 parts of a silane binder, 1-3 parts of polydopamine modified nano silicon dioxide and 17-32 parts of an auxiliary agent. The polydopamine adopted by the invention has strong adhesiveness, can be adsorbed on the surface of metal, has chelating effect with Fe  2+ , and can play a certain role in inhibiting metal corrosion.

title_en: Fruit-flavored essence for cigarettes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fruit-flavored tobacco essence and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fruit-flavored tobacco essence comprises 1-2 parts of sodium benzoate, 0.5-1.5 parts of trehalose, 6-8 parts of isoamyl isovalerate, 20-45 parts of fruit Maillard extract, 0.5-1.8 parts of maltol, 2-3 parts of cocoa tincture, 8-10 parts of hexaaldehyde diacetal and 6-9 parts of geranyl acetate. The invention has the advantages that sodium benzoate, trehalose and isovalerate can be used for moisturizing tobacco, ensuring the quality of the tobacco, maltol and cocoa tincture can be used for obviously enhancing the aroma of the tobacco, ensuring the smell of the tobacco to be more mellow and fragrant, improving the taste of the tobacco, reducing the dry bitter taste of the oral cavity and throat after smoking, ensuring smoother and more comfortable mouth and throat feeling, having certain antiseptic and antibacterial effects, prolonging the shelf life of the tobacco, enhancing the fruit aroma of fruit Maillard extract by using the hexaaldehyde diacetal and the geranyl acetate, filtering pectin, sugar and short-time quick Maillard reaction, ensuring that the scorched aroma of the product is not obvious and the fruit aroma of the fruit Maillard reactant is obvious.

title_en: Blue light main body material, preparation method and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of organic electroluminescent materials, and discloses a blue light main body material, a preparation method and an organic electroluminescent device. The structure of the blue light main body material is shown as a chemical formula I:  . After the blue light main body material provided by the invention is used for an organic electroluminescent device, the driving voltage of the photoelectric device can be reduced, the luminous efficiency of the photoelectric device can be improved, and the service life of the photoelectric device can be prolonged.

title_en: Polyisocyanate composition and aqueous two-component urethane coating composition
abstract_en: A polyisocyanate composition and an aqueous two-component urethane coating composition. Disclosed are a polyisocyanate composition and an aqueous two-component urethane coating composition which have high compatibility with a main agent, have a good pot life when mixed with the main agent, and have good hardness and weather resistance when formed into a coating film. [ solution ] A polyisocyanate composition which is the reaction product of an isocyanate compound, a nonionic hydrophilic component and a long-chain polyol component, wherein the content of isocyanate groups is 3-24 mass% and the molar ratio of isocyanurate groups to allophanate groups is 40:60-25:75.

title_en: Release coating, release film and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aqueous MLCC ceramic slurry tape casting processes, in particular to a release coating, a release film and application thereof, wherein the release coating comprises a polymer with hydrophilic groups and a crosslinking curing agent, the polymer at least comprises one hydrophilic group of amino groups, hydroxyl groups and hydroxymethyl groups, and the release coating can be coated and cured on the surface of a substrate layer to form a release layer of the release film, so that the aqueous MLCC ceramic slurry can better wet the surface of the release layer, the interaction force between the slurry and the release layer is enhanced, the interface property between the release layer and the slurry is optimized, the optimal peeling performance and slurry molding quality are achieved, and the water contact angle of the surface of the release layer can be controlled to 80-96 degrees by adjusting the mole ratio of different hydrophilic groups in the release coating so as to adapt to different aqueous MLCC ceramic slurry tape casting processes.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant coating type magnetostriction ultrasonic transducer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant coating type magnetostrictive ultrasonic transducer, and belongs to the field of ultrasonic nondestructive detection. The transducer consists of a high-temperature-resistant ceramic coil and a high-temperature-resistant magnetostrictive coating prepared based on Fe  3 O 4 /AlNiCo composite powder. The method comprises the steps of spraying Fe  3 O 4 /AlNiCo composite powder onto the surface of a workpiece to be detected to form a magnetostrictive coating tightly combined with the surface of the workpiece to serve as a sensing unit for ultrasonic excitation and reception, magnetizing the coating by utilizing a magnetizing device to establish a stable static bias magnetic field, removing the magnetizing device, applying pulse current signals to a ceramic coil to generate a dynamic alternating magnetic field, and finally exciting and receiving ultrasonic waves in the coating based on the magnetostrictive effect to realize detection of defects in the workpiece to be detected. The transducer has the advantages of high temperature resistance and high signal to noise ratio, and is suitable for rapid spot check detection and long-term on-line monitoring of structures such as high-temperature pipelines, high-temperature pressure containers and the like.

title_en: Carbonized polymer/cellulose nanocrystalline composite material with efficient circularly polarized luminescence and phosphorescence emission, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbonized polymer/cellulose nanocrystalline composite material with high-efficiency circularly polarized luminescence and phosphorescence emission, and preparation and application thereof. The preparation method of the composite material comprises the steps of fully dispersing polyethylene glycol, rhodamine B and hydrochloric acid aqueous solution in water, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, filtering, dialyzing, concentrating and freeze-drying to obtain a red light carbonized polymer, fully dispersing the red light carbonized polymer in cellulose nanocrystalline aqueous solution, and drying to obtain the carbonized polymer/cellulose nanocrystalline composite material with high-efficiency circular polarized luminescence and phosphorescence emission. The preparation method is simple, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, the composite material is environment-friendly, the mechanical strength of the composite material is greatly improved, the composite material shows high-efficiency red circular polarized luminescence, the composite material has extremely high asymmetric factor value, meanwhile, the composite film realizes room-temperature phosphorescence emission, the fluorescence life is greatly prolonged, and obvious long afterglow emission is observed under the room-temperature condition.

title_en: Heat-conducting composite lubricating oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-conducting composite lubricating oil and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite lubricating oil comprises, by weight, 500-600 parts of base oil, 5-10 parts of a modified additive, 10-15 parts of octadecyl primary amine, 20-30 parts of cyclohexylamine, 40-50 parts of diphenylmethane diisocyanate and 20-25 parts of a modified filler, wherein friction occurs in the use process of the lubricating oil, the bond energy of carbon-sulfur bonds in the modified additive is small, and then the modified additive breaks, sulfide containing an organosilicon chain segment is generated and is combined with a metal surface to form an iron sulfate film, meanwhile, the film contains an organosilicon component, so that the rust-proof effect of a metal contact surface can be improved, benzotriazole generated by breaking can be coordinated with metal ions, the protection of the lubricating oil on the metal surface can be further enhanced, and the addition of the modified filler can rapidly conduct heat generated by friction, so that the lubricating effect of the lubricating oil on the effective surface is reduced due to heat aging.

title_en: Fluffy liquid laundry detergent for down jackets and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid laundry detergent and discloses a fluffy liquid laundry detergent for down clothes and a preparation method thereof, wherein citric acid and allyl alcohol undergo esterification reaction under the catalysis of p-toluenesulfonic acid to obtain an intermediate 1, alkenyl in the intermediate 1 and secondary amine in diethanolamine undergo addition reaction to obtain an intermediate 2, then the intermediate 2 and phenolic hydroxyl in cardanol undergo substitution reaction to obtain an intermediate 3, the intermediate 3 and hexamethylene diisocyanate undergo reaction to obtain a cardanol-based citric acid surfactant, finally the cardanol-based citric acid surfactant and an alkyl glycoside surfactant are added into deionized water and stirred and dispersed, and then a solubilizer, hydrogen peroxide, alkaline protease and the like are added into the mixture and stirred and dispersed to obtain the fluffy liquid laundry detergent for down clothes.

title_en: Lead sulfide quantum dot with adjustable short wave infrared light absorption range, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead sulfide quantum dot with adjustable short wave infrared absorption range, a synthesis method and application. The method comprises the direct synthesis preparation of PbS quantum dots with different light absorption ranges and the preparation of solar cell devices constructed by the quantum dots. According to the invention, pbS quantum dots with adjustable light absorption range are directly synthesized in one step under the action of butylamine by adjusting the temperature rising mode of reaction, the reaction temperature and the precursor content, and the quantum dots are dissolved in a polar solvent to obtain quantum dot ink, and a film forming process is adopted to prepare the photoactive layer of the photoelectric device. The technical scheme of the invention overcomes the defects of small light absorption range and low yield of the ink for directly synthesizing the quantum dots in the prior art, can obtain the quantum dots with the light absorption range reaching 1000 nm-1650 nm wavelength, and realizes the preliminary application of the large-size quantum dots in the solar cell.

title_en: Method for reducing fluorescence half-peak width of core-shell indium phosphide quantum dot by aluminum doping and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing fluorescence half-peak width of core-shell indium phosphide quantum dots by aluminum doping and a product thereof, belonging to the technical field of luminescent materials. According to the invention, aluminum isopropoxide is added in the nucleation step of the core-shell indium phosphide quantum dot, so that the aluminum isopropoxide is used for passivating the surface defects of the quantum dot, inhibiting the formation of defect states and inhibiting Ostwald ripening in the nucleation process, so that the size distribution of the core is more uniform. The method has the advantages of simple process, convenient synthesis and easy mass production, and the prepared core-shell indium phosphide quantum dot has the characteristics of narrower fluorescence half-peak width, higher quantum yield, environmental friendliness and the like, and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Composition of phenol compound and naphthylacetic acid substance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel plant regulator composition, in particular to a composition of a phenol compound and a naphthylacetic acid substance and application thereof. A composition of phenol compounds and naphthylacetic acid substances comprises the phenol compounds and naphthylacetic acid in a mass ratio of 1:40-40:1, wherein the phenol compounds are 4- (2- (methyl-2- (4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl) cyclopent-3-en-1-yl) phenol, the molecular formula is C  18 H 24  O, the relative molecular mass is 256.4, the structural formula is as follows, The invention can promote the root growth of crops, strengthen plants, resist the phytotoxicity caused by excessive medicament or high toxicity and make up the loss caused by the phytotoxicity by mixing the psoralea seed extract with the naphthylacetic acid, in particular to root irrigation. The naphthalene acetic acid has the functions of promoting root development and increasing the number of branches and root hairs of the root system, and the fructus psoraleae seed extract possibly contains certain components for promoting plant growth or enhancing stress resistance, and the two components are combined to produce a synergistic effect.

title_en: Lipid-droplet sensitive fluorescent probe based on seleno-benzothiadiazole, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a lipid-droplet sensitive fluorescent probe based on seleno-benzothiadiazole, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of small organic molecule fluorescent probes. The preparation method of the lipid-droplet sensitive fluorescent probe based on the seleno-benzothiadiazole comprises the following steps of preparing a compound b, preparing a compound 1b and preparing the lipid-droplet sensitive fluorescent probe. The lipid-droplet sensitive fluorescent probe based on the seleno-benzothiadiazole can accurately dye and track the intracellular LD with high fidelity, improve the selectivity and the cell imaging effect, reduce the cytotoxicity, and has low cytotoxicity in HepG2 cell imaging experiments and can accurately position cells.

title_en: Anti-adhesion soft package battery manufacturing process protection film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-adhesion soft package battery manufacturing process protective film which comprises a glue layer and a substrate layer, wherein the glue layer comprises 15-25 parts of modified perfluorinated sulfonic acid resin, 4-8 parts of modified polyacrylate, 2-4 parts of anti-adhesion components, 1.5-2.5 parts of polyarylsulfone soft particles and 5-10 parts of diluent, and the substrate layer comprises BOPP plastic films. The prepared soft package battery manufacturing process protective film has low surface energy and easy stripping performance, has good anti-adhesion effect, can be better applied to soft package batteries, increases the surface roughness of the soft package batteries under the action of polyarylsulfone soft particles, supports gaps among the protective films between particles, reduces the adsorption force among the protective films, prevents the falling risk of the batteries, and can be stripped without glue remaining.

title_en: Low-brittleness high-wear-resistance finishing varnish and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photo-curing coatings, and particularly discloses a low-brittleness high-wear-resistance finishing varnish and a preparation method thereof. The low-brittleness high-wear-resistance finishing varnish comprises, by weight, 5-10 parts of hexa-functionality aliphatic polyurethane acrylate, 15-20 parts of deca-functionality aliphatic polyurethane acrylate, 5-8 parts of trifunctional aliphatic polyurethane acrylate, 0.5-1 part of organosilicon modified acrylate, 13-22 parts of mixed monomers, 2.5-4 parts of photoinitiators and 33-45 parts of solvents. The low-brittleness high-wear-resistance finishing varnish is compounded by the polyurethane acrylic ester with six-functionality, ten-functionality and three-functionality, is not easy to be brittle, is compounded with the organosilicon modified acrylic ester, and endows the coating with lasting stability and smoothness so as to improve the wear resistance, and the coating is not broken after being rubbed for 500 circles under the condition of 175g force in a paper tape wear-resistance experiment.

title_en: Preparation method of high-activity humic acid biofertilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a high-activity humic acid biofertilizer, belonging to the technical field of agricultural fertilizers, which comprises the following raw materials of 30-35 parts of livestock manure, 40-50 parts of inorganic fertilizer, 15-20 parts of modified humic acid, 3-5 parts of composite beneficial bacteria, 1-3 parts of auxiliary agent and 50-60 parts of deionized water; according to the technical scheme, the humic acid is intercalated on the organic clay to prepare the composite material, the adsorption capacity of the organic clay is enhanced by the humic acid, the modified composite material is prepared by grafting the silane coupling agent on the composite material, the leaching of an organic part can be avoided, the dispersibility of the composite material is improved, the modified humic acid is prepared by combining the maleic anhydride grafted lignin with the modified composite material, the ion exchange capacity of the modified humic acid is enhanced, the modified humic acid has better compatibility with microbial groups in soil, the composite beneficial bacteria have higher viable count and stronger stress resistance, the biological activity of fertilizer can be further improved, and the yield and quality of crops are improved.

title_en: Burkholderia BK-1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, provides Burkholderia BK-1 which is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the preservation number of M20242135 in year 2024 and also provides application of the Burkholderia BK-1 in reducing accumulation of heavy metals in crops. The Burkholderia BK-1 provided by the disclosure not only has mercury reducing capability, but also has the capabilities of dissolving phosphorus and producing siderophores, so that the accumulation of heavy metals in crops can be reduced, for example, the accumulation of mercury in rice can be reduced.

title_en: Dynamic covalent bond crosslinked I-PDMS/DEA@alpha-ZrP-SH self-repairing friction-resistant super-hydrophobic anticorrosive paint, preparation method and coating thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic covalent bond crosslinked I-PDMS/DEA@alpha-ZrP-SH self-repairing friction-resistant super-hydrophobic anticorrosive paint, a preparation method and a coating thereof, relates to the technical field of anticorrosive paint, and aims to solve the problems that the existing super-hydrophobic anticorrosive paint often causes the decline of super-hydrophobic performance due to mechanical friction and severe working environment, has low anticorrosive efficiency, or causes the damage of the paint when impacted, and further causes the failure of anticorrosive capacity. The self-cleaning heat-conducting anticorrosive paint comprises the steps of (1) preparing alpha-ZrP nano-sheets by taking zirconium oxychloride octahydrate and phosphoric acid solution as raw materials, slowly adding diethanolamine into alpha-ZrP suspension to enable Diethanolamine (DEA) to be intercalated into alpha-ZrP to prepare DEA@alpha-ZrP, (2) adding n-dodecyl mercaptan into the DEA@alpha-ZrP suspension, standing to enable n-dodecyl mercaptan to be grafted onto the surface of the DEA@alpha-ZrP to obtain DEA@alpha-ZrP-SH nano-sheets, (3) taking PDMS as a coating substrate and diluting the DEA@alpha-ZrP-SH nano-sheets, adding BTC and mixing to obtain I-PDMS diluent, and then adding the DEA@alpha-ZrP-SH nano-sheets for uniform dispersion and adding a curing agent.

title_en: Tab protection adhesive without adapter piece design and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of adhesives, and particularly relates to tab protection adhesive without a transfer piece design, a preparation method and a protection method and application thereof. The tab protection adhesive comprises 100 mass percent (15-400) of (5-200) of polyolefin resin, tackifying resin, anhydride modified wax and modified polybutadiene resin, wherein the modified polybutadiene resin is at least one of hydroxyl modified polybutadiene resin, silane modified polybutadiene resin and anhydride modified polybutadiene resin. The tab protection adhesive provided by the invention has excellent electrolyte resistance, and can meet the use requirement of long-term exposure in electrolyte.

title_en: Replaceable polyaniline filler for conductive coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a replaceable polyaniline filler for conductive paint and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following preparation steps of S1, acidifying toluene diisocyanate, namely mixing toluene diisocyanate kettle bottom material with acid to obtain an acidified toluene diisocyanate system, S2, synthesizing a conductive polymer, namely slowly dripping an oxidant into the acidified toluene diisocyanate system in the S1 step to react to obtain conductive polymer slurry, and S3, cleaning, drying and grinding the conductive polymer slurry obtained in the S2 step to obtain conductive polymer powder, namely the replaceable polyaniline filler for the conductive paint. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages that the process is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the waste generated by industrially synthesizing TDI can be treated in an environment-friendly way, so that the waste becomes precious, and the conductivity of the synthesized polymer is not weaker than that of polyaniline.

title_en: Bio-based thumb adhesive for automobiles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based thumb glue for an automobile and a preparation method thereof, wherein the thumb glue is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 60-70 parts of a high-melting-point bio-based premix, 10-20 parts of a reinforcing resin, 2-5 parts of a curing agent, 5-10 parts of a reinforcing filler and 20-30 parts of a rheology regulator. The method comprises the steps of 1) putting a high-melting-point bio-based premix into a reaction kettle, heating to 50 ℃, sequentially adding reinforcing resin, a curing agent and reinforcing filler, stirring at 75 ℃ for 30 minutes at 200 revolutions per minute to obtain a mixture, 2) transferring materials in the reaction kettle into a kneader when the consistency of the sampled and tested mixture is in a range of 6.0-7.5, and 3) adding a rheology regulator into the kneader, mixing at 40 ℃ for 20 minutes at 20 revolutions per minute, and discharging when the penetration of the sampled and tested material is in a range of 100-250 to obtain the bio-based thumb glue. The thumb glue and the method can reduce the dependence on the traditional o-benzene and the raw materials of the benzene plasticizer on the premise of not reducing the performance.

title_en: Coking inhibiting composition, coking inhibiting agent and method for using coking inhibiting composition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of boiler coking inhibition, in particular to a coking inhibition composition, a coking inhibitor and a using method of the coking inhibition composition. The coking inhibition composition comprises, by mass, 60-70 parts of an expandable layered aluminosilicate and 20-40 parts of a lubricating layered aluminosilicate, wherein the expandable layered aluminosilicate comprises one or more of bentonite, montmorillonite and activated clay, and the lubricating layered aluminosilicate comprises one or more of talc, mica, pyrophyllite, asbestos and serpentine. The coking inhibition composition provided by the application can obviously reduce the thickness of boiler coking, so that the composition has the advantage of easy cleaning, and in addition, the composition has the advantages of low cost and safety.

title_en: Triazolyl carbinols as nitrification inhibitors for fertilizer applications
abstract_en: Nitrification inhibitor compositions and methods for inhibiting nitrification of ammonia in soil are disclosed. Also disclosed are methods of preparing the nitrification inhibitors.

title_en: Gold nanoflower enhanced flavonoid compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gold nanoflower enhanced flavonoid compound, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) mixing chloroauric acid, ascorbic acid, a protective agent and water to obtain a gold nanoflower solution, (2) mixing the gold nanoflower solution obtained in the step (1) with the flavonoid compound solution to obtain a gold nanoflower-flavonoid compound solution, and (3) mixing the gold nanoflower-flavonoid compound solution obtained in the step (2) with a biotin-PEG-SH solution to obtain the gold nanoflower enhanced flavonoid compound. The gold nanoflower enhanced flavonoid compound provided by the invention effectively enhances the fluorescence intensity of flavonoid traditional Chinese medicine small molecules at tumor positions, provides more accurate and clear tumor images, and has the advantage of good targeting effect.

title_en: Pickering emulsion applied to concrete demoulding and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pickering emulsion applied to concrete demoulding and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of building materials. The Pickering emulsion comprises the following raw materials of 200-600 parts of base oil, 50-60 parts of composite emulsifier, 50-60 parts of auxiliary emulsifier, 1-2 parts of dispersed phase pour point depressing component, 0.5-1 part of antioxidant, 8-10 parts of continuous phase thixotropic stabilizing component, 10-15 parts of color regulating agent and 500-550 parts of water. The Pickering emulsion has excellent concrete demoulding performance, self-curing performance and ultraviolet resistance, can effectively improve the structural strength of concrete, prolongs the service life of concrete and ensures the appearance quality of concrete. The invention solves the problems of the traditional release agent, provides additional functionality and aesthetic property for concrete products, is suitable for various building and infrastructure projects, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Device and method for realizing low-carbon green manufacture of glass by taking biological heavy oil as fuel power
abstract_en: The application discloses a device and a method for realizing low-carbon green manufacturing of glass by taking biological heavy oil as fuel power, belonging to the technical field of chemical engineering. The device comprises a membrane emulsifying system for producing biological heavy oil W/O emulsion, a kiln system for realizing low-carbon preparation of glass by utilizing the biological heavy oil W/O emulsion, a medium-concentration product membrane separation system for capturing CO  2  in flue gas and producing medium-concentration CO  2  product gas, a biological carbon fixation system for producing high-added-value products by utilizing aquatic organism metabolism, combining a CO  2  photocatalysis mediating material and carrying out CO  2  fixation and utilization by cooperating with an aquatic organism compatibilization technology, and a compensation-high-concentration product membrane separation system for carrying out secondary concentration on the medium-concentration CO  2  product gas. The application uses the biological heavy oil emulsion to replace or partially replace fossil fuel, reduces carbon emission in the melting stage, captures CO  2  in flue tail gas, and forms a multifunctional CO  2  cascade utilization process.

title_en: High-density long-chain alkane dehydrogenation catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysis, and discloses a high-density long-chain alkane dehydrogenation catalyst and a preparation method thereof. A high-density long-chain alkane dehydrogenation catalyst uses medium-and microporous alumina as carrier to load Pt, sn, ni, fe and alkali metal or its oxide. The catalyst is mainly used for the reaction process of preparing mono-olefin by dehydrogenation of long-chain normal alkane (C10-C13), the catalyst uses a high-density carrier formed by rolling balls, the preparation process is safer and more environment-friendly, the dehydrogenation service life of the catalyst is prolonged, and the dehydrogenation stability is improved by 15-30%.

title_en: High-octane gasoline antiknock agent
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-octane gasoline antiknock agent, and belongs to the technical field of fuel additives. In the gasoline antiknock agent, the first component is selected from para-amino anisole, para-amino phenetole, para-amino phenethyl isopropyl ether, N-methyl para-amino phenetole or N-methyl para-amino phenethyl isopropyl, the second component is selected from styrene, 2, 5-dimethyl styrene, indene or 1, 2-dihydronaphthalene, the third component is selected from diisobutylamine, tertiary octylamine, tertiary octyldimethylamine, aniline, diisobutylaniline, diphenylmethylamine and octyldiphenylamine, and the fourth component is selected from o-isopropyl phenol, 4-ethyl-2-methylphenol and 4, 5-dimethyl-2-ethylphenol. The invention can effectively improve the octane number of gasoline, has stable property and good thermal stability, has good combustibility, does not generate sediment or residue, has little damage to an engine and no damage to a three-way catalyst, does not contain heavy metal, is nontoxic and does not pollute the environment.

title_en: High fire-retardant high viscosity glass fiber net double-sided fixed adhesive tape
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-flame-retardance high-viscosity glass fiber grid double-sided fixing adhesive tape, which relates to the technical field of double-sided fixing adhesive tapes and comprises a first acrylic adhesive, a first glass fiber grid, super-temperature-resistant heat-insulation fiber cotton, a second glass fiber grid, a second acrylic adhesive and release paper; in the invention, all parts cooperatively endow the adhesive tape with high viscosity, high strength, heat insulation, flame retardance and other performances, and the release paper also protects the adhesive surface; the adhesive tape has excellent performance, achieves flame retardant vo grade, strong viscosity, high shearing and breaking strength, excellent heat insulation and flame retardance, and has the multifunctional characteristics of compression resistance and support, compressibility, no layering of a coiled material, capability of being matched with automatic pasting and the like. In the production operation, each step from raw material preparation to shipment is strict and standard, so that the product quality is ensured, the market demand is met, and the customer satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Modified cross-linking agent, dealcoholized silicone sealant with high curing speed and good heat resistance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified cross-linking agent, a dealcoholized silicone sealant with high curing speed and good heat resistance and a preparation method thereof. The invention synthesizes a modified alkoxy cross-linking agent containing three ureido groups by taking a compound substrate containing a triaminobenzene structure and isocyanate trimethoxy silane as raw materials. The dealcoholized silicone sealant is prepared by mixing the crosslinking agent with alpha, omega-dihydroxyl polydimethylsiloxane, inorganic filler, crosslinking agent, catalyst, coupling agent and the like under an alcohol system. Compared with the original system, the curing depth and the heat resistance of the silicone sealant prepared by the method are improved, meanwhile, the good mechanical property is maintained, the mechanical strength is partially improved, the requirements of the industry and the building industry on the heat resistance and the curing speed of the silicone sealant are overcome to a certain extent, the use scene of the dealcoholized silicone sealant is expanded, and the method has great significance in improving the workability and prolonging the service life of the silicone sealant in a high-temperature environment.

title_en: Curable reactive branched isobutenyl quaternary phosphonium salt polymer, preparation method thereof, curable epoxy resin composition and waterproof and antifouling coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of functional coatings, and discloses a cured active branched isobutylene quaternary phosphonium salt polymer, a preparation method thereof, a curable epoxy resin composition, a waterproof and antifouling coating. The polymer has a star-branched structure comprising a plurality of branches, the branches comprising structural units A, B, C and optionally D, structural units A being derived from isobutylene, structural units B being derived from alkylstyrenes containing quaternary phosphonium salt groups, structural units C being derived from alkylstyrenes containing curing reactive functional groups, structural units D being derived from alkylstyrenes. The branched chain structure of the polymer is provided with quaternary phosphonium salt groups and curing active functional groups, has good compatibility with epoxy resin, can be used together with the epoxy resin and co-cured, and can obviously improve the ageing resistance, the cohesiveness and the waterproof capability of the epoxy resin coating while improving the antifouling performance of the epoxy resin coating.

title_en: Method for preparing nano palladium or platinum carbon monoxide combustion improver
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of combustion-supporting agents, in particular to a method for preparing a nano palladium or platinum carbon monoxide combustion-supporting agent, which comprises the following steps of weighing 1-5 parts by mass of a palladium-containing or platinum-containing precursor, 0.5-3 parts by mass of a composite surfactant, 2-8 parts by mass of a reducing agent, 50-80 parts by mass of a special carrier, 0.5-1.5 parts by mass of a benzoin defoaming agent and 0.3-1 part by mass of a silane coupling agent. According to the invention, the mesoporous alumina and graphene composite carrier is adopted, and the composite carrier effectively inhibits migration and agglomeration of metal particles through physical domain limiting effect and chemical synergistic effect, and simultaneously enhances the abrasion resistance of the carrier.

title_en: Harmless treatment process for waste vegetable leaves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmless treatment process for waste vegetable leaves, and belongs to the technical field of recycling. S1, squeezing the waste vegetable leaves, namely crushing the waste vegetable leaves and squeezing to obtain waste vegetable She Canye I and residues, S2, recycling the residues, namely recycling the residues of the waste vegetable leaves, S3, coagulating and precipitating the residual liquid I, namely enabling the residual liquid of the waste vegetable leaves to enter a coagulating sedimentation tank, and simultaneously adding a coagulant into the coagulating sedimentation tank to coagulate and precipitate to obtain residual liquid II and sludge I. Crushing waste vegetable leaves and squeezing the crushed waste vegetable leaves, recycling the residues, avoiding the random discarding of the residues to pollute the environment, improving the economic benefit and increasing the income, and simultaneously, after coagulating sedimentation, hydrolytic acidification, spiral shell stacking machine treatment, anaerobic treatment, anoxic treatment, aerobic treatment, secondary sedimentation, ozone oxidation and artificial wetland treatment, the effluent can be used as irrigation water to irrigate farmlands, thereby achieving the purpose of saving water resources and green development.

title_en: Non-conductive high-heat-conductivity laminating film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-conductive high-heat-conductivity laminating film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the non-conductive high-heat-conductivity laminating film comprises 16 to 44 weight percent of aqueous resin, 55 to 75 weight percent of amino functional group compound modified epoxy resin and 55 to 10 weight percent of inorganic nano powder, wherein the inorganic nano powder is selected from the group of SiO2, cuO, al2O3, znO or AlN, and is subjected to surface modification by 1 to 10 weight percent of silane coupling agent. The preparation method comprises the steps of modifying inorganic nano powder on the surface of a silane coupling agent to obtain modified inorganic nano powder, adding modified inorganic nano powder into modified epoxy resin to obtain mixed sizing material, grinding and dispersing the mixed sizing material by three rollers to obtain a laminating film material, adding a solvent, coating, forming, drying and laminating the laminating film material to obtain the non-conductive high-heat-conductivity inorganic nano laminating film. The thickness of the non-conductive high-heat-conductivity inorganic nanometer bonding film is smaller than 15 mu m, and the thermal conductivity is between 1.38W/mK and 3.5W/mK.

title_en: Binder for solid-state battery, preparation method of binder, electrolyte membrane, preparation method of electrolyte membrane and solid-state battery
abstract_en: The application provides a binder for a solid-state battery and a preparation method thereof, an electrolyte membrane and a preparation method thereof, and the solid-state battery, and relates to the field of secondary batteries. The binder for a solid-state battery comprises a first repeating unit having a structural formula as shown in formula I:  Wherein R  1  comprises a hydrocarbon group, R  2  comprises one of carboxyl, siloxy, epoxy, fluoro, and alkyl, R  3  comprises a bond, hydrocarbon group, or phenyl, and R' comprises an alkyl group. The adhesive has hydrophobicity, can effectively prevent moisture from entering the inside of the battery, reduces the risk of short circuit and corrosion caused by the moisture, and is beneficial to improving the safety and stability of the battery.

title_en: Polishing solution for flattening high-K dielectric metal gate ruthenium gate of chip and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical mechanical polishing, and discloses a polishing solution for flattening a ruthenium gate of a chip high-K dielectric metal gate, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polishing solution comprises the following concentration components of 0.05-0.2wt% of alumina abrasive particles, 0.05-0.2wt% of oxidant, 20-80 mmol/L of complexing agent and deionized water, the complexing agent is DTPA (NH  4 ) 5  composite complexing agent), the polishing solution prepared by the invention can effectively improve the removal rate of the ruthenium gate in the chemical mechanical polishing process, ensure the surface of the polished ruthenium gate to have nano-scale surface roughness and defect-free characteristics, solve the problem of low polishing rate caused by high hardness and high chemical inertia of ruthenium, and realize high-quality surface processing of the ruthenium gate.

title_en: Low-melting-point low-aromatic-hydrocarbon environment-friendly deoiling wax and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-melting-point low-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling wax and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out wax crystallization on a mixture of deoiling wax raw oil and a non-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling solvent to obtain a crystallized mixture material, and then carrying out a solvent deoiling process to obtain the low-melting-point low-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling wax, wherein the non-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling solvent is a mixture containing C4 ketone and cyclohexane, and the content of the C4 ketone is 45-95wt%. The invention provides a novel non-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling solvent, which takes light wax oil fraction as a raw material to perform three-stage solvent deoiling, so that the low-melting-point (< 52 ℃) low-aromatic environment-friendly deoiling wax can be produced, the subsequent solvent separation effect can be improved, and the low-carbon environment-friendliness of the production process can be improved.

title_en: Pyrethrum urea/SPc/dsCHS multi-element composite pesticide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a avermectin/SPc/dsCHS multi-element composite pesticide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite pesticide comprises a avermectin/SPc complex and dsCHS, the mass ratio of the dsCHS to the SPc in the avermectin/SPc complex is 0.1-5:1, and the nucleotide sequence of dsCHS is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The CHS in the diflubenzuron/SPc/dsCHS multi-element composite pesticide is a chitin synthase gene, after treatment of the diflubenzuron, the CHS gene expression of insects is increased to feed back reduction of chitin, and after dsCHS silence the chitin synthase gene through RNAi, the chitin synthesis of aphids is further destroyed, so that the mortality rate of the aphids is increased from 46.67% to 82.22%.

title_en: Eupatorium adenophorum plant source bactericide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a eupatorium adenophorum plant source bactericide, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw materials of the eupatorium adenophorum plant source bactericide comprise, by mass, 10-20% of eupatorium adenophorum extract, 10-15% of 55% of diatz alcohol, 40-50% of organic solvent and 20-30% of emulsifying agent. After the eupatorium adenophorum plant source bactericide is diluted by adding water, the bactericide can be used for dipping fruits and roots before fruit and vegetable picking and vegetable seedling transplanting and root dipping and the like, tests prove that the bactericide has better prevention and control effects on fungal diseases and vegetable seedling transplanting rhizosphere soil fungal diseases during the picking and storage period of pears, peaches, apples, red dates, grapes, strawberries, tomatoes, oyster mushrooms and the like, the antibacterial rate of 100 times of the eupatorium adenophorum plant source bactericide on gray mold, pineapple black spot bacteria, banana fusarium wilt bacteria, irregular mucor and fusarium oxysporum reaches more than 99%, the antibacterial rate of the bactericide on alternaria is more than 80%, the bactericide meets the current development direction of green environmental protection requirements, and the bactericide has good development and application potential.

title_en: Bio-based wear-resistant fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a bio-based wear-resistant fabric and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of textile, wherein the bio-based wear-resistant fabric comprises a bio-based nylon fabric layer, a polytetrafluoroethylene electrostatic spinning nano-film layer and nylon warp-knitted base yarns which are sequentially arranged; the preparation method comprises the steps of taking a polytetrafluoroethylene electrostatic spinning nano film layer as an intermediate layer, respectively attaching a bio-based nylon fabric layer and nylon warp-knitted base yarns to two sides of the polytetrafluoroethylene electrostatic spinning nano film layer by using a bio-based hot melt adhesive, respectively adding hydrophobic silica nanoparticles modified by a silane coupling agent into the bio-based hot melt adhesive and the polytetrafluoroethylene electrostatic spinning nano film layer, wherein the silica nanoparticles added into the nano film layer are modified to form a core-shell structure, and preparing the bio-based wear-resistant fabric which has high waterproof and moisture permeability, good wear resistance and difficult blocking of gaps by combining the introduction and modification of the hydrophobic silica nanoparticles, so that the overall performance and the service life of the fabric are improved.

title_en: Bacillus kurleri CBK-5 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to bacillus kurleri (Bacillus korlensis) CBK-5 with a preservation number of CGMCC No.33651. The strain not only has the capabilities of releasing silicon, decomposing potassium, producing siderophores and IAA, but also has the capability of broad-spectrum plant pathogenic fungi resistance. In addition, the strain can well grow at the pH of 5-9 and the temperature of 20-45℃, naCl and the concentration of 0-6%, and has certain heavy metal resistance. The invention also discloses application of the strain in promoting plant growth and improving soil quality. The strain has good application prospect in the aspects of barrier soil improvement, ecological reclamation of the soil in a tailing area, development of novel bio-organic fertilizer and biocontrol microbial inoculum, cultivation matrix and the like.

title_en: Saline-alkali soil improvement microbial inoculum formula real-time adjustment method based on environmental elements
abstract_en: The application discloses a real-time adjustment method of a saline-alkali soil improvement microbial agent formula based on environmental elements, which comprises the steps of obtaining the distribution position of a microbial agent dispenser of the saline-alkali soil and obtaining environmental information of the distribution position, obtaining the microbial agent formula dispensed by the microbial agent dispenser of the saline-alkali soil, obtaining the type and concentration of dispensed microbes based on the microbial agent formula, obtaining the environmental information of the distribution position, generating environmental disturbance after the microbial agent is dispensed, obtaining environmental disturbance quantity, obtaining the environmental elements after disturbance by obtaining the environmental information of the distribution position under the action of the environmental disturbance quantity, obtaining or predicting the weather condition of the saline-alkali soil, obtaining the weather disturbance quantity and the environmental elements under the action of weather based on the weather condition, and adjusting the microbial agent formula based on the environmental elements after disturbance or the environmental elements under the action of weather to obtain the adjusted microbial agent formula. Solves the problem of insufficient analysis of environmental elements after the microbial inoculum is put in at present, thereby ensuring the accurate adjustment of the microbial inoculum formula under any environmental elements.

title_en: Method for extracting 3 beta-acetoxy-15 alpha, 22-dihydroxyhopane from metarhizium anisopliae
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting 3 beta-acetoxy-15 alpha, 22-dihydroxyhopane from metarhizium anisopliae, which comprises the steps of carrying out activation culture on metarhizium anisopliae in a PDA (personal digital assistant) culture medium, transferring the metarhizium anisopliae to a PDB (digital versatile B) culture medium for primary culture, inoculating the metarhizium anisopliae to a rice culture medium for secondary culture, carrying out ultrasonic extraction and extraction combined with ethyl acetate, concentrating to obtain a crude extract, and separating and purifying the crude extract by a decompression column and a normal phase silica gel column in sequence to obtain 3 beta-acetoxy-15 alpha, 22-dihydroxyhopane. The invention firstly separates 3 beta-acetoxy-15 alpha and 22-dihydroxyhopane from the metarhizium anisopliae, and proves that the invention can be used for biological control of tea geometrid.

title_en: Method for producing non-fibrous water-soluble products
abstract_en: A method of making a particulate-containing, non-fibrous, water-soluble product includes a) providing a first continuous, water-soluble, non-fibrous substrate comprising a first side and moving in a first direction, b) providing a discretizing unit comprising one or more pockets, the one or more pockets comprising an opening, c) providing a continuous feed of first particles through the pocket opening to at least one pocket of the one or more pockets of the discretizing unit, thereby at least partially filling the at least one pocket of the one or more pockets, d) delivering the first particles from the pocket through the opening onto a portion of the first side of the first continuous, water-soluble, non-fibrous substrate, and e) at least partially covering the first side of the first continuous, water-soluble, non-fibrous substrate.

title_en: Preparation method of efficient weather-resistant metal anti-corrosion coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-efficiency weather-resistant metal anti-corrosion coating, and relates to the technical field of metal protective coatings. The method selects a resin matrix with excellent weather resistance, is matched with pigment, auxiliary agent and weather resistance auxiliary agent, and is prepared by a special cross-linking and curing process. The coating has excellent ultraviolet resistance and temperature resistance, has a high-strength three-dimensional network structure, and can remarkably improve the weather resistance and the corrosion resistance of the metal base material. The invention also comprises a spraying construction and curing process, and can be widely applied to the corrosion protection of various industrial equipment and facilities.

title_en: Anti-collision rebound colorful stone-like paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-collision and rebound multi-color stone-like coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the anti-collision and rebound multi-color stone-like coating comprises the following components in parts by weight of 10-30 parts of protective adhesive solution, 50-70 parts of color-mixing slurry and 10-30 parts of continuous phase emulsion. The anti-collision rebound colorful stone-like coating disclosed by the invention is prepared from the components such as modified titanium dioxide, polyether polyol, cellulose, silicate, hollow microspheres and the like as raw materials, wherein the modified titanium dioxide has good compatibility with organic components such as polyether polyol, silicone emulsion, cellulose and the like, is favorable for dispersing all the components in a system, ensures that the system is more uniform and stable, simultaneously ensures that the gelation of separated protective adhesive is more complete, and has tighter network structure combination. In addition, when the colorful paint product is knocked and dented, the hollow micro beads are expanded again by utilizing the invasion of natural rainwater, so that the fine dents are restored to the original state, and the overall attractiveness of the building is maintained.

title_en: Preparation method of silver oxide doped copper oxide antibacterial agent rich in oxygen vacancies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a silver oxide doped copper oxide antibacterial agent rich in oxygen vacancies, which comprises the following steps of firstly dissolving sodium hydroxide, polyvinylpyrrolidone and sodium citrate in deionized water, then adding copper chloride, heating and stirring to obtain copper oxide, secondly dissolving copper oxide and silver nitrate in deionized water, collecting and drying sediment to obtain precursor powder, thirdly grinding the precursor powder, and then calcining to obtain the silver oxide doped copper oxide antibacterial agent rich in oxygen vacancies. According to the invention, copper oxide is prepared firstly, then the copper oxide and silver nitrate are heated and stirred and then calcined, so that the silver oxide doped copper oxide antibacterial agent rich in oxygen vacancies is obtained, wherein the oxygen vacancies can enhance the electron transfer capability of the surface of the catalyst, so that the surface of the catalyst can keep sufficient active oxygen species, high-efficiency catalytic reaction can be maintained, active oxygen species can be spontaneously generated under the dark condition, and pathogenic microorganisms can be inactivated under the dark condition.

title_en: Compound fertilizer containing multiple nutrient elements with slow release and controlled release and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial fertilizer manufacturing, in particular to a slow-release and controlled-release compound fertilizer containing multiple nutrient elements and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a slow-release controlled-release compound fertilizer containing multiple nutrient elements, which comprises a major element, a medium trace element, a compound microbial agent, a carrier and a controlled-release factor, wherein the major element comprises nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium, the medium trace element comprises copper, zinc, manganese, iron, magnesium, sodium, calcium, boron and silicon, the compound microbial agent comprises spore powder of bacillus and spore powder of Rake white-bag Rake, the carrier comprises vermiculite powder, seaweed fertilizer and humic acid, the controlled-release factor comprises silicon dioxide, chitosan, lignin and silicon carbide coupled magnetic beads, and the preparation method of the silicon carbide coupled magnetic beads comprises the step of coupling silicon carbide and magnetic beads under the action of percarboxylic acid ester and distearoyl oxyisopropyl aluminate. The compound fertilizer can obviously promote the growth of crops.

title_en: Environment-friendly slurry suitable for deep coal seam and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drilling fluid, and discloses environment-friendly slurry suitable for deep coal seams, which comprises an anti-collapse agent HB-PA-S, a filtrate reducer DAADS, a viscosity increasing agent GZN, a lubricant MPA, a nano plugging agent AR/SiO  2  and a reservoir protecting agent, and a preparation method of the environment-friendly slurry suitable for deep coal seams. The invention realizes the improvement of salt resistance, temperature resistance and environmental protection performance of drilling fluid, has high sealing property, can prevent or delay water from entering the rock pores of the well wall from the well bore at 200 ℃ and in saturated saline water, increases the coupling force among mineral particles in the rock, and improves the surface property of soil layers.

title_en: Phosphor powder and light-emitting device
abstract_en: The phosphor powder of the present invention is a phosphor powder comprising particles of a phosphor represented by the general formula M  x (Si,Al) 2 (N,O) 3±y , wherein M is Li and one or more alkaline earth metal elements, x is 0.52≤0.90, y is 0≤0.36, and a part of the surface of the particles of the phosphor contains a surface modified part in which the surface is raised.

title_en: Positive dielectric liquid crystal composition and liquid crystal display device comprising same
abstract_en: The invention provides a positive dielectric liquid crystal composition and a liquid crystal display device comprising the same. The liquid crystal composition comprises at least one compound shown as a general formula I, at least one type II compound, at least one type III compound and at least one type III compound, wherein the type II compound is selected from a group consisting of a compound shown as a general formula II-A and/or a compound shown as a general formula II-B, and the type III compound is selected from a group consisting of a compound shown as a general formula III-1 and/or a compound shown as a general formula III-2. The liquid crystal composition provided by the invention has proper dielectric anisotropy, proper clearing point, better optical anisotropy, lower rotational viscosity, faster response speed, larger elastic constant, better contrast ratio, better low-temperature storage property and wider nematic phase temperature range, and is suitable for display modes such as VA, PSVA, IPS, NFFS with quick response.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Ir (III) metal organic cage for packaging Cu (I)
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of an Ir (III) metal organic cage for packaging Cu (I) belong to the technical field of drug synthesis. Ir (III) -based metal organic cages encapsulate Cu (I) ions therein to synergistically generate multiple Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS), thereby enhancing the utilization of O  2  in tumor cells. Ir (III) metal organic cage is used as a carrier to encapsulate Cu (I) ions, so that the Cu (I) ions can enter tumor cells efficiently and accumulate in mitochondria specifically, and the cells are prevented from maintaining copper steady state through Cu (I) ion excretion. The presence of Cu (I) ions enhances the cytotoxicity of the photosensitizer, since Cu (I) can not only generate hydroxyl radicals OH by Fenton-like reaction, but also reduce singlet oxygen  1 O 2  (type II PDT) to superoxide anion O  2   •⁻ , thereby maximizing the utilization of O  2 . The invention highlights the potential of the bimetallic complex in the efficient ROS-mediated synergistic cancer treatment, and provides a promising direction for the development of future anticancer drugs.

title_en: Photo-curing insulating adhesive composition, photo-curing insulating adhesive and application
abstract_en: The application provides a photo-curing insulating adhesive composition, a photo-curing insulating adhesive and application. The photo-curing insulating adhesive composition comprises resin, a photoinitiator and an unsaturated monomer, wherein the resin comprises matrix resin and auxiliary resin, the mass ratio of the auxiliary resin in the resin is 20% -40%, and the surface tension of the auxiliary resin is 10% -40 mN/m. The application helps to promote the rapid fusion and escape of bubbles in the photo-curing insulating adhesive in the screen printing process and the initial stage of the photo-curing reaction by controlling the surface tension of the auxiliary resin within the above range. The application helps to reduce such defects by controlling the mass ratio of the auxiliary resin in the resin within the above range, thereby improving the cohesiveness and insulation of the photo-cured insulating adhesive, because the air bubbles can damage the continuity and integrity of the photo-cured insulating adhesive and reduce the insulation performance thereof.

title_en: System and method for directional production of 1-decene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of olefin synthesis, and discloses a system and a method for directionally producing 1-decene. The method comprises the steps of enabling biomass grease to be in contact with methanol to carry out transesterification reaction in the presence of a base catalyst to obtain a crude fatty acid methyl ester product, carrying out separation treatment I on the crude fatty acid methyl ester product to obtain a C  18  fatty acid methyl ester mixture containing methyl oleate, methyl linoleate and methyl linolenate, carrying out selective hydrogenation reaction on the C  18  fatty acid methyl ester mixture in contact with hydrogen in the presence of a hydrogenation catalyst to obtain the crude fatty acid methyl ester product, carrying out separation treatment II on the crude fatty acid methyl ester product to obtain the methyl oleic acid product, and carrying out double decomposition reaction on the methyl oleic acid product in contact with ethylene and a double decomposition catalyst to obtain the 1-decene product. The method can directionally prepare the 1-decene by taking the biomass grease as the raw material, the conversion rate of the methyl oleate is more than 75%, and the selectivity of the 1-decene is more than 99%.

title_en: Self-repairing photo-thermal deicing liquid coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A self-repairing photo-thermal deicing liquid coating and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of coating preparation. The coating is formed by combining self-repairing microcapsules and liquid-like coatings, wherein the microcapsules are prepared by taking carefully-prepared diphenylmethane diisocyanate (MDI) as a wall material and isophorone diisocyanate (IPDI) as a core material through 1, 4-Butanediol (BDO) crosslinking and Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate (SDS) emulsification, and meanwhile, photo-thermal dyes such as Polyaniline (PANI) nanofibers, graphene Oxide (GO) or Polydopamine (PDA) are introduced into the wall material diphenylmethane diisocyanate (MDI) to prepare polyurethane system microcapsules with photo-thermal conversion capability, so that the polyurethane system microcapsules are endowed with high-efficiency photo-thermal conversion capability, can quickly absorb light energy and convert the light energy into heat energy, and realize quick deicing.

title_en: Natural gas decarbonization and CO by combining membrane separation with alcohol amine method2Purification liquefaction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a membrane separation combined alcohol amine method natural gas decarbonization and CO  2  purification liquefaction process. The invention comprises a membrane separation module, an alcohol amine decarbonization module, a purification liquefaction module and a propane circulation refrigeration module. The membrane separation module comprises a gas-liquid separator, a membrane separator, a compressor and a mixer, the alcohol amine decarbonization module comprises an absorption tower, a throttle valve, a gas-liquid separator, a heat exchanger, a cooler, a circulating pump, a regeneration tower cooler and a regeneration tower reboiler, the purification liquefaction module comprises a compressor, a heat exchanger, a gas-liquid separator, a low-temperature rectification tower cooler and a low-temperature rectification tower reboiler, and the propane circulation refrigeration module comprises a heat exchanger, a compressor, a cooler and a throttle valve. The process combines a membrane separation technology with an alcohol amine method to remove CO  2  and performs a CO  2  purification liquefaction process, the recovery rate and purity of CO  2  are improved by a finally established system, the concentration of produced natural gas CO  2  is low, the energy consumption of the system is less, and a liquid CO  2  product can be produced.

title_en: Wear-resistant and anti-slip aluminum profile for passenger boarding vehicle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum profiles, in particular to a wear-resistant and anti-slip aluminum profile for a passenger boarding car and a preparation method thereof. The invention comprises the steps of uniformly mixing polyester polyol, hydroxy acrylic resin, pigment, defoamer, flatting agent, dispersing agent, wetting agent, ultraviolet absorber and diluent to obtain a component A, uniformly mixing aliphatic polyisocyanate curing agent, accelerator and diluent to obtain a component B, uniformly mixing aluminum oxide whisker and modified silicon carbide to obtain a component C, uniformly mixing the component A, the component B and the component C to obtain the wear-resistant and anti-slip coating, and step three, namely, taking an aluminum profile, polishing, cleaning and drying the surface, coating the surface with primer, and coating the surface with the wear-resistant and anti-slip coating after curing to obtain the wear-resistant and anti-slip aluminum profile for the passenger boarding vehicle.

title_en: Process for recovering hydrogen during hydroprocessing of a feedstock comprising oxygenates
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a process for hydrotreating a feedstock comprising oxygenates comprising the steps of a. Directing the feedstock, an amount of make-up hydrogen and recycle gas to contact a catalyst having hydrotreating activity under active hydrotreating conditions to provide a hydrotreated product stream b. Separating a vapor product fraction and a liquid product fraction from the hydrotreated product stream by gas-liquid separation at a pressure above 80% and a temperature above 200 ℃, C. Separating a gaseous product fraction and a light liquid product fraction from the vapor product fraction by gas/liquid separation at a pressure above 80% and a temperature below 100 ℃, d. Directing at least an amount of the gaseous product fraction to a gas purification unit to provide a hydrogen rich gas fraction and a hydrogen lean gas fraction, wherein the hydrogen rich gas fraction has a molecular weight above 12g/mole and the hydrogen lean gas fraction has a molecular weight above 12g/mole, and at least a portion of the hydrogen lean gas fraction is provided as a recycle or recycle gas. This has the associated advantage of being able to provide pure recycle gas even for partially hydrotreated product streams (which have a low capacity to capture CO  2 , CO and CH  4 ).

title_en: Phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator and phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator and a phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system and a method, wherein the phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system comprises a heat exchanger and a phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator, the phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator comprises an evaporator body and a circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline connected with the evaporator body, two sides of the evaporator body are respectively provided with a circulating ammonium phosphate inlet and an ammonium phosphate product outlet, the position of the ammonium phosphate product outlet is higher than that of the circulating ammonium phosphate inlet, the top of the evaporator body is provided with a gas outlet, the bottom of the evaporator body is provided with a circulating ammonium phosphate outlet, two ends of the circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline are respectively communicated with the circulating ammonium phosphate inlet and the circulating ammonium phosphate outlet, an ammonia inlet and an acid inlet are respectively arranged on the circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline, the ammonia inlet is positioned behind the acid inlet along the circulating direction of ammonium phosphate, a heating medium inlet of the heat exchanger is connected with the gas outlet of the evaporator body, a condensate pipeline is connected with a refrigerant inlet of the heat exchanger, and the refrigerant outlet of the heat exchanger is connected with the acid inlet through a pipeline.

title_en: Microbial preparation for inhibiting plant pathogenic bacteria in soil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of microbial preparations and discloses a microbial preparation for inhibiting plant pathogenic bacteria in soil and a preparation method thereof, wherein the microbial preparation comprises, by weight, 15-25 parts of active ingredients, 30-50 parts of carrier matrixes, 10-20 parts of functional auxiliary agents and 20-30 parts of moisturizing protective agents.
