title_en: Boron-containing resonance type organic compound and organic electroluminescent device comprising same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a boron-containing resonance type organic compound and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same, belonging to the technical field of semiconductors, wherein the structure of the compound is shown as a general formula (1):  when the compound is used as a doping material in a luminescent layer material of an organic electroluminescent device, the compound can be used as a green doping material of the luminescent layer of the organic electroluminescent device, so that the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Calcium-based MOF crystal material with photoelectric effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a calcium-based MOF crystal material with photoelectric effect, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the material takes levorotatory 2-malic acid (L-malic acid) as an organic ligand, and calcium ions as a metal center to form a three-dimensional network structure with an mbr topology type. The calcium-based MOF crystal material has a photoelectric effect, shows a main peak at a lambda ex=440 nm, shows Jiang Ruifeng at a lambda_em=550 nm when an emission spectrum is fixed at the lambda_ex=440 nm, has a Stokes shift of delta lambda=125 nm, has obvious lattice relaxation in an excited state, can be used as a fluorescent matrix material to prepare a light-excited material and a light-excited device, is prepared from aloe serving as a raw material, takes organic components in aloe as organic ligands to participate in MOF formation, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, mild preparation conditions and low production cost.

title_en: Bottom surface matched heat-resistant coating system and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-resistant coating system matched with a bottom surface and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the coating system is formed by high-temperature sintering after being matched with a primer and a finish, the primer comprises methyl phenyl silicone resin, glass powder, A-type high-heat-conductivity alumina, yttrium-modified nano zirconia, high-temperature pigment, toluene, a dispersing agent, a defoaming agent and a wetting leveling agent, and the finish comprises B-type high-heat-conductivity alumina, yttrium-modified nano zirconia, a low-boiling-point solvent, a medium-boiling-point solvent, a silane coupling agent, a defoaming agent and a wetting leveling agent. The heat-resistant coating system matched with the bottom surface of the micro-nano-scale coarse structure design has the characteristics of strong adhesive force, excellent temperature impact resistance, outstanding anti-adhesion capability at high temperature and the like, and has wide market application prospect.

title_en: Synthesis and application of fluorescent probe for simultaneously distinguishing and detecting sulfite and viscosity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent probe for distinguishing and simultaneously detecting sulfite and viscosity, which has the following chemical structural formula:  . The probe can realize the differential detection of sulfite and viscosity by utilizing different fluorescence channels, and emits 466 blue fluorescence of nm under the excitation wavelength of 400 nm after the specific chemical reaction of the probe and the sulfite, and emits 553 nm yellow-green fluorescence under the excitation wavelength of 470 nm in a high-viscosity environment. Because of the fluorescence quenching effect of the strong electron withdrawing group nitro group in the coumarin parent nucleus, the probe and other active substances do not have the effect, and the sulfite and the viscosity can be detected with high selectivity and high fidelity. The probe for detecting the sulfite has the advantages of high reaction speed, high sensitivity and the like, and can be used for selectively distinguishing and detecting the sulfite and the viscosity in an in-vitro environment and distinguishing fluorescence imaging analysis of the sulfite and the viscosity in biological systems such as cells and the like. Has a great application prospect in the technical fields of analytical chemistry, life science, chemical biology and the like.

title_en: Thermal expansion stone cracking medicine tube and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal expansion split stone medicine tube, which comprises an outer tube body, a thermal expansion agent and a core ignition tube, wherein the thermal expansion agent and the core ignition tube are positioned in the outer tube body, the outer tube body is used for igniting the thermal expansion agent in the outer tube body through a group of ignition wires to rapidly heat, and the thermal expansion agent consists of carbon black, coal gangue powder, straw powder, sodium nitrite, potassium perchlorate and starch adhesive and is used for rapidly expanding after being heated. The invention utilizes the thermal expansion agent to rapidly gasify and expand under the condition of rapid heating, has better breaking and damaging force, does not have dangerous conditions such as production, storage, transportation explosion and the like, can not meet the conditions of fire combustion explosion, is safe and convenient, has weak vibration, small noise and little noise pollution, does not basically have noise pollution, simultaneously has small vibration of the broken stone, can not generate a large amount of dust, has a damage range in a designated range, and has small influence on the surrounding environment on the working site greatly limited by site factors.

title_en: Composite material gasket and production process thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a composite material pad and a production process thereof, wherein the production process comprises the steps of carrying out plasma surface activation treatment on a foam substrate to obtain an activated foam substrate; the method comprises the steps of placing an activated foam substrate and a polyester film in ultraviolet irradiation equipment for modification and compounding treatment to obtain a compound substrate, irradiating the compound substrate line by line along a preset grid pattern based on a laser, forming a groove network structure on the surface of the compound substrate to obtain a grid substrate with grid identification lines, carrying out nano coating spraying treatment on the grid substrate to obtain a coating substrate, carrying out hot press setting treatment on the coating substrate to obtain a semi-finished gasket product, and carrying out laser cutting treatment on the semi-finished gasket product according to the preset size to obtain the compound material gasket. The application obviously overcomes the technical bottleneck of insufficient processing precision of the surface structure in the prior art by the integrated process design, and obviously improves the applicability and reliability of the product in the industries of electronic equipment, automotive interiors and packaging.

title_en: Compound microbial agent for preventing and treating fruit and vegetable bacterial diseases and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound microbial agent for preventing and treating fruit and vegetable bacterial diseases and a preparation method thereof, wherein the compound microbial agent comprises Brevibacterium, pseudomonas aeruginosa and Streptomyces, and the ratio of the viable count of the Brevibacterium, pseudomonas aeruginosa and Streptomyces is (1-3) (2-4) (1-2). According to the invention, the antibacterial peptide is secreted by the short bacillus to directly inhibit bacteria, the pseudomonas aeruginosa competes for the ecological niche through the siderophore, the streptomycete generates antibiotics, and multiple bacterial strains cooperate to form a multiple mechanism of bacteriostasis-competition-immune activation, so that high-efficiency control on the fruit and vegetable bacterial diseases is realized.

title_en: Solid fabric care formulations
abstract_en: Solid fabric care formulations solid particulate formulations for softening textile fabrics comprise a softening agent, a curing and dispersing aid, a superdisintegrant, a microenvironment pH adjuster, a filler material and optionally a flow aid/anti-caking agent, wherein the ratio of the ingredients is from 1:3:0.1:1:1 to 1:3:2:2. The softening agent is preferably a non-tallow based esterquat derived from a vegetable source, and the ingredients used in the preparation of the formulation are also environmentally friendly. The fabric softening formulation is biodegradable, stable, liquid-tight and easily dispersible.

title_en: Temperature-sensitive color-changing and reflective heat-insulating dual-functional water-based paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature-sensitive color-changing-reflecting heat-insulating bifunctional water-based paint and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of functional paint. The amphoteric ion temperature-sensitive grafted microsphere has the advantages of improving dispersibility and temperature-sensitive regulation and control capability through grafting modification. The preparation method comprises dispersing the components, stirring and mixing at low speed, adjusting viscosity, filtering and packaging, and has simple and controllable process. The coating can realize dual functions of temperature response color development and intelligent heat insulation, and effectively improves the comprehensive performance and application adaptability of the coating.

title_en: Ti (titanium)3C2Tx/MoS2Heterojunction preparation method, application of heterojunction in lubricating oil and lubricating oil composition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a Ti  3 C 2 T x /MoS 2  heterojunction, and application of the Ti  3 C 2 T x /MoS 2  heterojunction in lubricating oil and a lubricating oil composition, and relates to the technical field of lubricating oil, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a few-layer Ti  3 C 2 T x , namely adding a Ti  3 AlC 2  precursor into a mixed etchant containing HCl and LiF, and etching and corroding the Ti  3 AlC 2  precursor by using the mixed etchant containing HCl and LiF to obtain a few-layer Ti  3 C 2 T x ; S2, preparing a mixed original solution, namely sequentially adding a molybdenum source and a sulfur source into deionized water, and carrying out ultrasonic mixing to obtain a uniform mixed original solution. According to the preparation method, the MoS  2  nano sheet is directly grown on the Ti  3 C 2 T x  sheet layer, so that the composite efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, compared with Ti  3 C 2 T x ,Ti 3 C 2 T x /MoS 2 , the dispersion stability in lubricating oil is greatly improved. In addition, the Ti  3 C 2 T x /MoS 2  heterojunction is used as a lubricating additive to be applied to industrial lubricating oil, so that the wear resistance of the lubricating oil is remarkably improved, and the wear volume can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Bacillus bailii S-34 and application thereof in preventing and controlling anthracnose of mango leaf
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural microorganisms, and relates to a bacillus belicus (Bacillus velezensis) strain S-34 and application thereof in preventing and controlling anthracnose of mango leaves, wherein the bacillus belicus strain S-34 is separated from rhizosphere soil of a mango variety 'Jin Huang' with high anthracnose resistance, and is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) at a date of 29 in 2025 and with a preservation number of CCTCC No. M20251225. The bacillus belicus S-34 provided by the invention can prevent and treat anthracnose of mango leaves, and has good antagonism effect on various mango leaf pathogenic fungi. In addition, bacillus belicus S-34 and aseptic fermentation liquid and volatile gas thereof can inhibit the processes of spore germination and epidermis penetration of the Siamese anthrax, thereby inhibiting the infection process of the Siamese anthrax on plants. The invention provides a novel biocontrol microbial inoculum and a preparation method for efficiently preventing and controlling anthracnose and other leaf diseases of mango leaves in agricultural production, and is beneficial to green and healthy development of mango industry.

title_en: Method for efficiently preparing aromatic hydrocarbon oil by low-temperature catalytic conversion of polystyrene without hydrogen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for efficiently preparing aromatic hydrocarbon oil by low-temperature catalytic conversion of polystyrene without hydrogen, belonging to the technical field of plastic chemical recovery. The method for efficiently preparing aromatic hydrocarbon oil by low-temperature catalytic conversion of polystyrene without hydrogen comprises the following steps of pre-softening polystyrene, and then adding a MgAl-MMO porous catalyst for catalytic reaction to obtain the aromatic hydrocarbon oil, wherein the MgAl-MMO porous catalyst is prepared from a magnesium source, an aluminum source, sodium carbonate and sodium bicarbonate. The invention constructs a synergistic catalytic system driven by a heat activated catalyst at a low temperature (280-300 ℃) and normal pressure, which remarkably reduces the energy consumption and the equipment requirements. Meanwhile, by optimizing the reaction conditions, the high-efficiency catalytic degradation of the Polystyrene (PS) can be realized under the mild environment without solvent and hydrogen, the PS is converted into aromatic hydrocarbon oil with high added value, and in addition, the yield of the obtained aromatic hydrocarbon oil is high, so that the high-value recovery of the polystyrene plastic can be realized.

title_en: Protective coating for steel structure surface layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cured coatings, and particularly discloses a protective coating for a steel structure surface layer and a preparation method thereof. The protective coating for the steel structure surface layer comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A comprises, by weight, 20-30 parts of hydroxyl fluorine-containing acrylic emulsion, 20-30 parts of inorganic filler, 5-10 parts of bisphenol A type epoxy resin, 1-2 parts of emulsifier, 0.2-0.5 part of film forming auxiliary agent, 0.2-0.4 part of leveling agent, 0.1-0.2 part of defoaming agent, 0.1-0.3 part of thickener, 0-0.05 part of preservative, 15-25 parts of water, and the component B comprises hydrophilic aliphatic polyisocyanate, wherein in the component A and the component B, NCO is-OH= (1.1-1.3): 1. The protective coating disclosed by the application has excellent capabilities of resisting chloride ions and moisture and also has good adhesive force, impact resistance and surface hardness after being cured.

title_en: Antifouling paint for ships and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional coatings, and particularly relates to an antifouling coating for ships and a preparation method thereof. The invention aims to solve the problem that the existing ship antifouling paint is difficult to consider the broad-spectrum antifouling effect and the environmental safety. The invention provides an antifouling coating, which is prepared by chain-extending polymerization of polycaprolactone polyol and polydimethylsiloxane diol to obtain a block copolymer, emulsification and solidification of butenolide and polycaprolactone diol to obtain an antifouling microcapsule, self-assembling and crosslinking to obtain a response microcapsule, mixing a dispersing aid, a compound solvent and a functional filler to obtain a compound aid, mixing the dispersing aid, the compound solvent and the functional filler to obtain the compound aid, and phase-separating and solidifying of the antifouling coating to obtain the antifouling coating. The anti-fouling paint prepared by the invention has good ageing resistance and corrosion resistance, has obvious inhibition effect on the adhesion of fouling organisms, and has high environmental safety.

title_en: Method for preparing oxygen-containing organic chemicals by coupling biological pretreatment and catalytic pyrolysis of lignite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing oxygen-containing organic chemicals by coupling biological pretreatment of lignite and catalytic pyrolysis, which relates to the technical field of energy and chemical industry and comprises (1) pretreatment of lignite microorganism, namely crushing and screening raw lignite, and high-pressure sterilization and drying of a coal sample to obtain a sterile coal sample; the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) pretreating a sterile coal sample by microorganisms to obtain residual coal, (2) preparing a catalyst Ni/Al  2 O 3  by a ternary coprecipitation method, (3) carrying out catalytic pyrolysis on the residual coal to obtain an oxygen-containing organic chemical, namely weighing the residual coal, ni/Al  2 O 3  and n-hexane, placing the obtained mixture into a reaction kettle for reaction, removing a reaction mixed solution, and carrying out decompression and suction filtration to obtain the oxygen-containing organic chemical. The invention constructs a new path for high-valued conversion of low-rank coal through the synergistic effect of biology and catalysis, breaks through the high-temperature energy consumption limit of traditional pyrolysis, realizes the directional preparation of target chemicals, and provides a solution with economical efficiency and environmental protection for clean and efficient utilization of low-rank coal.

title_en: Multifunctional magnetic graphene quantum dot sensor, preparation method thereof and Cu in detection wastewater2+Applications of (2)
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional magnetic graphene quantum dot sensor, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in detecting Cu  2+  in wastewater, belonging to the technical field of water pollution control and treatment. The multifunctional magnetic graphene quantum dot sensor comprises aminated Fe  3 O 4 @SiO 2  nano particles and graphene quantum dots, wherein the graphene quantum dots are grafted on the surfaces of the aminated Fe  3 O 4 @SiO 2  nano particles. The magnetic graphene sensor has excellent recognition capability on Cu  2+ , can rapidly perform qualitative and quantitative analysis on copper ions in a solution, realizes detection and treatment of Cu  2+  ions in wastewater, has strong selectivity and high sensitivity, rapidly enriches and separates Cu  2+  from a water body by utilizing magnetism of the sensor under the action of an external magnetic field, can treat pollution and recycle, effectively avoids secondary pollution, is environment-friendly, is renewable, and can be called as three-in-one.

title_en: Self-repairing polyurethane blade anticorrosive paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-repairing polyurethane blade anticorrosive paint and a preparation method thereof, wherein the self-repairing polyurethane blade anticorrosive paint comprises a polyurethane prepolymer, a self-repairing microcapsule, nano SiO  2  powder, a gamma-aminopropyl silane coupling agent, a UV absorber and a dibutyl tin distearate catalyst, the self-repairing microcapsule is a double-layer gradient shell, an outer layer high-crosslinking urea formaldehyde-boric acid ester shell provides anti-fatigue strength, an inner layer low-crosslinking urea formaldehyde-polyester shell is easy to crack, a repairing agent is released at the beginning of cracks, a reversible dioxane crosslinking bond is introduced into the polyurethane prepolymer to realize closed regeneration after network fracture, a formula-process closed loop is constructed through built-in acoustic emission and electrochemical impedance monitoring in a preparation-curing stage, the initial microcrack triggering repairing agent release and network closure are realized, the coating is kept complete and stable under the complex working condition, the anticorrosive life is remarkably prolonged, and the production consistency is improved.

title_en: Formula of acid type trace element water-soluble fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid type trace element water-soluble fertilizer formula which is composed of raw materials with the mass ratio of 2.8-24% of zinc sulfate monohydrate, 5-35% of zinc sulfate heptahydrate, 10-48% of ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, 43-60% of magnesium sulfate heptahydrate and 2-5% of industrial sulfuric acid. The finished product is prepared by premixing, ultrasonic drying, superfine grinding, sieving and packaging, and contains 2 to 9 percent of zinc, 1 to 8 percent of iron, 4 to 6 percent of magnesium and 2 to 5 percent of free acid. The free acid in the fertilizer can neutralize alkaline substances and sedimentary salts in soil, improve soil environment, maintain the activities of microelements such as zinc, iron, magnesium and the like, prevent ferrous ions from oxidative inactivation, and combine the ultrasonic drying and superfine grinding processes to ensure that nutrient components are uniformly dispersed and easily absorbed, thereby effectively promoting crop growth, improving yield and quality, and preventing the fertilizer from caking after the storage period is more than half a year.

title_en: MiRNA for preventing and controlling chilo suppressalis and application of miRNA in cultivation of insect-resistant rice
abstract_en: The invention relates to miRNA for preventing and treating chilo suppressalis and application thereof in cultivation of insect-resistant rice. The invention verifies that the over-expression of miRNA-989 in a Chilo suppressalis body obviously reduces egg yolk protein deposition in oocytes, so that the number of oocytes in a nest is obviously reduced, and further integrates miR-989 into a rice genome for over-expression based on an amiRNA technology, so that the resistance of miRNA-transferred rice to Chilo suppressalis is verified, the safety and stability of miRNA-transferred rice are evaluated, a new germplasm resource is provided for the prior art, and a new effective prevention and control strategy is provided for green prevention and control of agricultural pests.

title_en: High-dispersion Niδ+Preparation method and application of base MOFs catalytic hydrogenation material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a high-dispersion Ni  δ+  -based MOFs catalytic hydrogenation material, and belongs to the fields of nanocomposite materials and green catalysis. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly mixing aqueous solutions of rare earth Ce salt, cr salt and ligand BDC-NH  2 , adding a regulator NaOH to synthesize a bimetallic CeMIL-101-NH  2  matrix, then selecting an aqueous solution of another Ni metal salt, stirring for a period of time, and then carrying out reduction treatment through an aqueous solution of NaBH  4 . Filtering, washing with water and drying to obtain the catalytic hydrogenation material of the mixed metal MOFs anchored Ni  δ+ . The preparation method has the advantages that (1) a novel catalytic hydrogenation material with bi-metal nodes (CeCr  2 ) and ligands (BDC-NH  2 ) anchoring active Ni together is developed, (2) the prepared bi-metal MOFs-based catalytic material has excellent cycling stability, (3) the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain by using the method provided by the invention, the process is simple, the reaction condition is warm, the cost is low, and the active site Ni anchored on the bi-metal nodes CeCr  2  and-NH  2  is adjustable in electron and geometry.

title_en: Preparation method of lanthanide metal marked amino modified fluorescent nano plastic microsphere
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of lanthanide metal marked amino modified fluorescent nano plastic microspheres, which comprises the steps of respectively dissolving and mixing 0.5-0.8g of europium chloride hexahydrate and 1-1.5g of 2-thenoyl trifluoroacetone, precipitating and filtering to obtain lanthanide metal chelate, adding 0.2-0.5g of polyvinylpyrrolidone and the like into a three-necked flask, adjusting pH, heating, introducing nitrogen for deoxidization, mixing and dispersing the chelate, styrene monomer and a cross-linking agent to prepare an initiator solution, finally adding the mixed solution into the flask, pouring the initiator, stirring at a high speed at 60-80 ℃ for reacting for 8-12h, and carrying out suction filtration and dialysis to obtain the microspheres. The method comprises the steps of firstly synthesizing a fluorescence enhanced lanthanide metal chelate, combining the lanthanide metal chelate with polyvinylpyrrolidone to form a core-shell structure fluorescence inner core, and then coating the core-shell structure fluorescence inner core with polystyrene. The obtained microsphere has uniform particle size, the polystyrene shell has the characteristic of plastic pollutant, the microsphere can be used for micro-nano plastic influence experiments, and the coating of polyvinylpyrrolidone can prevent lanthanide metal chelate from being quenched by free radicals and avoid the influence of pH change.

title_en: Plant growth agent for growth of citrus trees and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant growth agents for growing citrus trees, and in particular relates to a plant growth agent for growing citrus trees and a preparation method thereof, wherein the plant growth agent comprises, by weight, 2.1-10.1 parts of benzylaminopurine, 2-5 parts of boric acid, 8-18 parts of anhydrous citric acid, 4-40 parts of a solvent, 26.9-62.9 parts of deionized water and 1-6 parts of a synergistic auxiliary agent. The invention has high solubility, is convenient for fruit tree absorption, and can improve the fruit quality and the fruit yield.

title_en: Biogas slurry-based watermelon package fertilizer capable of increasing sugar and yield and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biogas slurry-based watermelon package fertilizer capable of increasing sugar and yield and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fertilizers for watermelons. The biogas slurry-based watermelon package fertilizer provided by the invention has the advantages of remarkably improving the comprehensive efficiency of the fertilizer, meeting the nutritional requirements of watermelons in the whole growth period, optimizing the photosynthetic efficiency, effectively promoting plant root systems and nutrient growth, improving the nutrient utilization rate, remarkably increasing the yield of watermelons and the income of melon farmers, greatly improving the flavor and the nutritional value of fruits, remarkably improving the water content and the porosity of applied soil, further effectively improving the soil structure, improving the water retention and the air permeability of the soil, greatly reducing the production cost, simultaneously reducing the waste treatment pressure, reducing the application amount of the fertilizer, reducing the environmental pollution, improving the microbial community structure of the soil, relieving the continuous cropping obstacle, and being a green fertilization scheme with high yield, high quality and sustainable development, and having extremely high popularization value and application prospect.

title_en: Escherichia coli phage PD2061, phage composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of phages, and discloses an escherichia coli phage PD2061, a phage composition and application thereof, wherein the escherichia coli phage PD2061 has a preservation number of CGMCC NO.46163, is preserved in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of the China general microbiological culture Collection system for 8 months and 16 days in 2024, and has a preservation address of North Star Xishu No. 1 and No.3 in the Korean region of Beijing city. The escherichia coli phage PD2061 not only has high cracking rate on escherichia coli, but also has certain cracking performance on salmonella, and has greater advantages in preventing and treating diseases of escherichia coli and salmonella mixed infection. The phage can be used for preparing a pharmaceutical preparation for treating or preventing animal-derived colibacillosis and/or salmonellosis, so that the survival rate of birds suffering from colibacillosis/salmonellosis or mixed infection is improved, the utilization rate of feed is improved, and the death and panning rate of birds in cultivation is reduced.

title_en: Bacterial fertilizer containing rosa roxburghii slag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bacterial fertilizer containing rosa roxburghii slag and a preparation method thereof. The mass ratio of the roxburgh rose dreg to the charcoal powder in the bacterial fertilizer is 1-5:5-1. The pH value of the bacterial manure is regulated to 7.0+/-0.2 by adopting a sodium hydroxide solution. The method comprises the steps of firstly mixing dried rosa roxburghii slag and charcoal powder in proportion, adjusting the pH value to 7.0+/-0.2,60 ℃ by using 0.4mol/L sodium hydroxide, drying, and secondly sterilizing the carrier obtained in the first step for 30min at 121 ℃ or performing microwave sterilization to obtain the rosa roxburghii slag bacterial fertilizer. The bacterial fertilizer carrier formula can be loaded with a plurality of microbial agents. The carrier has a water content of about 64%, is very suitable for bacterial growth, is prepared into bacterial manure, has an effective viable count of not less than 10  9  cfu/g after being stored for 30 days at normal temperature, and is suitable for various soil environments.

title_en: Blue crab antibacterial peptide SPERMACIN43-70And application thereof in corrosion prevention and fresh-keeping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blue crab antibacterial peptide SPERMACIN  43‑70  and application thereof in corrosion and fresh keeping, and the amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 01. The invention has broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, high safety, fruit preservative effect, promotion of growth of fruit seeds, excellent thermal stability, natural environment protection and wide application prospect.

title_en: Burkholderia cepacia ZJ15 and microbial fertilizer and application thereof in preventing and controlling diseases of mulberry and oak
abstract_en: The invention discloses Burkholderia cepacia (Burkholderia cepacia) ZJ15 and a microbial fertilizer and application thereof in preventing and controlling diseases of mulberries and oaks. The strain is preserved in the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at 2025, 06 and 05, and the preservation number is GDMCC No:66469. The strain not only can promote the germination of mulberry seeds, but also has the capabilities of dissolving inorganic phosphorus, dissolving organic phosphorus, producing auxin, producing siderophores and fixing nitrogen, can promote the growth of the mulberry, has comprehensive growth promoting function, has better antagonism on the mulberry and oak pathogenic bacteria such as colletotrichum grub, storek tree bacillus, enterobacter cloacae and the like, can be developed into a microbial fertilizer with the effects of preventing and treating diseases and promoting growth, and has good application prospect and application value in the aspects of preventing and treating the diseases and promoting growth of the mulberry and oak.

title_en: Anti-crystal transformation and low-solubility CL-20 composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CL-20 composite materials, in particular to a CL-20 composite material with anti-crystal transformation and low solubility and a preparation method thereof, wherein CL-20 is poured into Tris-HCl buffer solution, stirred until CL-20 is uniformly mixed, added with a biological initiation type adhesive material monomer for reaction, filtered, washed and dried to obtain a CL-20@biological initiation type adhesive material, subjected to vacuum dehydration treatment, then loaded on a rotary base, sputtered with a fluorine-containing polymer target material on the surface layer of the CL-20@biological initiation type adhesive material, deposited to obtain a fluorine-containing polymer barrier layer, and cooled to obtain the CL-20 composite material. The preparation method of the CL-20 composite material with crystal transformation resistance and low solubility has the characteristics of simple preparation process, high efficiency and short time consumption, and is accurate and controllable in temperature in the preparation process, safe in operation process and capable of supporting kilogram-level continuous production.

title_en: Efficient composite drag reduction injection-increasing agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency composite drag reduction injection increasing agent and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of oilfield water injection exploitation. The drag-reducing and injection-increasing agent comprises, by mass, 10% -15% of a scale-dissolving agent, 3% -5% of a gemini surfactant, 1% -3% of a degradation agent, 10% -20% of a mutual solvent, 0.5% -1% of a solubilizer and the balance of water. The adhesive force of crude oil on the rock surface can be effectively reduced, the wettability of the rock surface is changed, and the seepage resistance is reduced. The crude oil stripped from the rock surface is dispersed into small oil drops under the action of the surfactant, so that the flowing capability of the crude oil passing through the throat is improved, the reservoir permeability is improved, the stratum is dredged, the oil well liquid supply capability is recovered, the normal water injection of the water well is realized, the oil well plugging device can be used for injecting water with poor quality, the water injection well with high stratum scaling and residual oil saturation and the oil stain plugging well caused by long-term water recovery, and the pressure of the water injection well can be effectively reduced by more than 30%.

title_en: High-pressure crude oil filtering separator with pressure self-adaptive adjustment function
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-pressure crude oil filtering separator with pressure self-adaptive adjustment, which relates to the technical field of filtering separation devices and comprises a shunt pipe, wherein the bottoms of the two ends of the shunt pipe are provided with a filter box, the top of the filter box is fixedly provided with a connecting pipe, the inside of the connecting pipe is rotatably provided with a propeller through a spoke, the middle top of the shunt pipe is fixedly provided with an oil inlet pipe, one side of the bottom of the filter box is provided with an oil outlet pipe, the rear end of the filter box is provided with a separator, the top of the oil outlet pipe is fixedly provided with a conveying pipe, and compared with the prior art, two groups of filter boxes alternately feed crude oil through the shunt pipe, filter and separate the crude oil through a drain frame and a conical filter plate in the filter box, and compare the crude oil output efficiency at the bottom of the filter box according to the conditions of insufficient crude oil or blockage of the filter structure, clean the filter structure or accelerate the rotating speed of the propeller according to requirements, and improve the pressure and accelerate the passing rate of the crude oil.

title_en: Adhesive for support film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to an adhesive for a support film and a preparation method thereof. The high-molecular weight polymer type hindered amine light stabilizer and the hydrolysis resistant agent are compounded according to a specific mass ratio, photooxidative degradation and hydrolysis chain reaction are cooperatively inhibited, the peeling strength stability is kept under the conditions of high temperature and high humidity accelerated aging, the long-acting aging resistance is realized, and the full life cycle reliability requirement of a vehicle-mounted electronic component is met. The prepared adhesive is suitable for severe working condition scenes such as vehicle-mounted support films and the like, and provides an innovative solution for high-reliability bonding.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine waste compost quality assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of compost quality test, and particularly discloses a traditional Chinese medicine waste compost quality evaluation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting traditional Chinese medicine waste, preprocessing the traditional Chinese medicine waste, analyzing a preprocessing result, judging whether to adjust preprocessing process parameters of the traditional Chinese medicine waste, and analyzing preprocessing efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine waste after the preprocessing process parameters are adjusted so as to perform composting treatment on the traditional Chinese medicine waste; the method comprises the steps of monitoring composting process parameters of each monitoring area of traditional Chinese medicine waste, judging whether the composting process parameters of each composting monitoring area of the traditional Chinese medicine waste are effective, screening out each effective composting monitoring area, evaluating composting quality of each effective composting monitoring area and integrating, judging whether the pretreatment process of the traditional Chinese medicine waste is regulated, integrating pretreatment, composting monitoring and composting quality evaluation through modularized design, reducing human intervention errors, and improving efficiency and reliability of composting quality evaluation.

title_en: Gel propellant, preparation method thereof and application of gel propellant in power system of aerospace engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gel propellant, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a power system of an aerospace engine. The gel propellant comprises, by 100% of the total mass of the gel propellant, 5% -15% of carbon powder, 35% -45% of aluminum powder, 4% -6% of a gelling agent and 44% -46% of liquid fuel, wherein the particle size D32 of the carbon powder is 30nm-20 mu m, and the particle size D32 of the aluminum powder is 1 mu m-100 mu m. The gel propellant can improve incomplete combustion of aluminum in the combustion process, has higher volume combustion heat, can reduce the viscosity of the high-concentration gel propellant, is easy to atomize, and can further simply and inexpensively improve the energy performance and practicality of the gel propellant.

title_en: High-initial cohesive strength bio-based polyurethane hot melt adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reactive polyurethane hot melt adhesives (PUR), and relates to a high initial cohesive strength bio-based polyurethane hot melt adhesive and a preparation method thereof, wherein the hot melt adhesive comprises, by mass, 10-30 parts of polyether polyol, 5-15 parts of bio-based amorphous polyester polyol, 10-40 parts of bio-based crystalline polyester polyol, 10-20 parts of petroleum-based crystalline polyester polyol, 1-20 parts of TPU elastomer, 10-20 parts of isocyanate curing agent and 0.1-0.5 part of catalyst. The TPU containing the isosorbide and the dynamic disulfide bonds is introduced into the polyurethane hot melt adhesive, the isosorbide effectively improves the initial rigidity and tensile strength of the PUR, the polyurethane hot melt adhesive has excellent initial cohesive strength, the compound with the disulfide bonds and the hydroxyl groups is added into the TPU, the problem of difficult sizing caused by overhigh viscosity of the glue caused by directly adding the compound into the polyurethane hot melt adhesive is avoided, and meanwhile, the disulfide bonds have dynamic reaction characteristics, so that the PUR self-healing function is provided.

title_en: Heat storage and exchange particle of high-heat-conductivity sphere and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat storage and exchange particle of a high-heat-conductivity sphere and a preparation method thereof, wherein the heat storage and exchange particle is prepared from the following components A, B and C, the weight percentage sum of the raw materials is 100%, the component A is 22% -97%, the component B is 0.5% -20%, the component C is 2.5% -77.5%, the component A is one or more of flake graphite, soil graphite, expanded graphite or artificial graphite, the component B is one or more of diatomite and/or bentonite, and the component C is one or more of liquid phenolic resin, epoxy resin, polyacrylic acid, emulsified asphalt or silica sol. The heat exchange particles provided by the invention have high heat conductivity and mobility of sphere particles, are suitable for being used as solid heat carriers, and realize rapid storage, transmission and release of heat.

title_en: High-performance release agent for self-cleaning vibration-free concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance release agent for self-cleaning vibration-free concrete and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of building material chemical additives, wherein the high-performance release agent for self-cleaning vibration-free concrete comprises, by mass, 20-40 parts of a hydrophobic modifier, 10-20 parts of a nano porous material, 50-100 parts of a bubble blocking agent, 400-550 parts of base oil, 100-150 parts of an emulsifier, 2-10 parts of a defoaming agent and 130-418 parts of water; the high-performance release agent for self-cleaning vibration-free concrete can optimize the appearance quality (mainly comprising surface smoothness, bubbles and chromatic aberration) of the concrete under the construction conditions that a concrete template is difficult to clean and vibration is difficult, and simultaneously, the template is free from cleaning the release agent.

title_en: Heat-conducting gel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat conducting materials, in particular to a heat conducting gel and a preparation method thereof. The heat-conducting ceramic composite material comprises, by weight, 80-120 parts of a heat-conducting filler, 70-100 parts of a ceramic filler, 1-3 parts of vinyl silicone oil and 0.5-5 parts of an auxiliary agent, wherein the auxiliary agent comprises a modifier, the heat-conducting filler comprises modified diamond, and the modified diamond comprises diamond with a graphene coating rate of 60-85%. The thermal conductivity of the thermal conductive gel obtained by the specific formula and the preparation method can reach more than 20W/mk, the extrusion rate can reach 30g/min, the hardness after solidification can reach shore 0030-50, and the breakdown voltage can be more than 6kV/mm.

title_en: Antioxidant corrosion inhibitor for oil well and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-oxidation corrosion inhibitor for an oil well and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of petrochemical corrosion and protection. The preparation method of the anti-oxidation corrosion inhibitor comprises the following steps of dissolving thiourea in an alcohol organic solvent, heating to 40-60 ℃, adding trimesic acid and a catalyst, heating and refluxing for 6-8 hours, carrying out distillation purification, washing and vacuum drying to obtain an intermediate, dissolving glucose in water, heating to 30-35 ℃, adding sodium hydroxide and the intermediate, heating and refluxing for 6-8 hours, and carrying out reduced pressure rotary evaporation to obtain the anti-oxidation corrosion inhibitor. The antioxidant corrosion inhibitor has the advantages of difficult decomposition and strong adsorption at high temperature, good solubility and dispersibility in high mineralization simulated formation water, and the like, and has wide application prospect in oil well exploitation.

title_en: Bisphenol A-free polyester transparent oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of food packaging coatings, and particularly discloses a transparent polyester oil without bisphenol A and a preparation method thereof. The preparation raw materials of the transparent polyester oil without bisphenol A comprise liquid polyester resin, a closed polyisocyanate curing agent, an alkyl etherified melamine formaldehyde resin curing agent, polyester phosphate resin, a scratch resistant agent, a catalyst, a leveling agent, shrink resistance Kong Chuji, a diluent and a solvent, wherein the liquid polyester resin is linear polyester containing long-chain alkyl groups. The transparent polyester oil without bisphenol A can effectively reduce the curing temperature of the coating and solve the balance problem of low-temperature curing and high performance.

title_en: Edible oil production distillation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distillation device and a method for edible oil production, belonging to the technical field of edible oil processing, wherein the distillation device comprises two distillation tank bodies which are arranged in front and back, a knocking component is arranged at the outer side of the distillation tank body at the back side and close to the bottom, a mixing component is arranged in the inner cavity of the distillation tank body at the front side, a collecting box is arranged at the other side of the distillation tank body at the front side, a supporting frame is arranged at the back side of the collecting box, and in the process of distilling edible oil, the rear side of support frame is provided with the water tank, and is adjacent peg graft jointly between the top of the distillation tank body and the collection box has the honeycomb duct, under the cooperation of mixing assembly use, can make adjacent movable block and movable seat reciprocating motion from top to bottom, can make the articulated slab swing from top to bottom under the articulated of adjacent articulated rod, and then can be at the in-process of stirring to swing from top to bottom, can fully mix edible oil, shorten the time to the distillation purification of edible oil, improve the efficiency of purification.

title_en: High-cohesiveness coating diaphragm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-cohesiveness coating diaphragm and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-cohesiveness coating diaphragm comprises the following components: the preparation method of the high-cohesiveness coating diaphragm comprises the steps of coating slurry on a base film, extracting, drying and obtaining the coating on the base film to obtain the high-cohesiveness coating diaphragm, wherein the slurry comprises ceramics, a binder, a pore-forming agent and a slurry solvent. According to the invention, the heat resistance, the bonding force between the diaphragm and the pole piece, the breakdown voltage, the liquid absorption rate and the liquid retention rate of the diaphragm are improved through the cooperation of the lithium aluminum titanium phosphate, the hydrogenated styrene-butadiene segmented copolymer and the polyacrylic acid, and the ventilation value of the diaphragm is reduced.

title_en: Novel double-emission dissimilar metal MOFs (metal-organic frameworks), preparation method thereof and application of MOFs as ratio type fluorescent temperature sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel double-emission dissimilar metal MOFs with a chemical formula of [ Eu  2 (na) 6 (CH 3 OH) 2 (Cu 4 I 4 ) ], wherein na  ‑  is nicotinic acid radical ion. The MOFs have two secondary structural units, namely a cubane [ Cu  4 I 4  ] cluster and a 1D inorganic-organic chain [ Eu (na)  3 ] n , wherein each [ Cu  4 I 4  ] cluster serves as a four-connecting node, and the 1D [ Eu (na)  3 ] n  chain is connected through a nitrogen atom of a na  ‑  ligand, so that the MOFs are expanded into a three-dimensional framework structure. The present invention has been found by experiments that compounds exhibit two emission centers when excited with ultraviolet light of 338 nm at room temperature, wherein the broad emission peak at 557 nm is assigned to the cluster-center triplet emission of the [ Cu  4 I 4  ] cluster, and the sharp peak emission at 591, 611 and 701 nm corresponds to the characteristic emission of Eu  3+ . The compound has good linear relation between the intensity ratio of two fluorescence emission peaks at 567 nm and 610 nm and the temperature in the temperature range of 125-300K, is a sensitive ratio type fluorescence temperature sensing material, and provides a new thought for the application of the ratio type fluorescence temperature sensing material.

title_en: Organosilicon modified polyester and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of organic silicon modified polyester, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out esterification reaction on dihydric alcohol, polybasic acid/anhydride or ester thereof and alpha, beta-unsaturated carbonyl compounds in the presence of an esterification catalyst to obtain prepolymer, S2, carrying out polycondensation reaction on the prepolymer after the esterification reaction is finished to obtain matrix resin containing alpha, beta-unsaturated carbonyl compounds, and S3, carrying out Michael addition reaction on the matrix resin containing alpha, beta-unsaturated carbonyl compounds prepared in the step S2 and hydroxyl-terminated organic silicon monomers in the presence of a Michael addition catalyst to obtain the organic silicon modified polyester. The preparation method thoroughly solves the problem of self-polymerization of the organic silicon, improves the uniformity and performance of the product, adopts a melt polymerization process, does not need an organic solvent or a silane coupling agent in the whole process, and avoids the problem of solvent pollution, thereby greatly simplifying the synthesis process, reducing the cost and improving the environmental protection.

title_en: Trichoderma harzianum and application thereof in deltamethrin degradation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to trichoderma harzianum and application thereof in deltamethrin degradation. The trichoderma harzianum is named Trichoderma harzianum GZUAS681023 and is deposited in the microorganism strain collection of Guangdong province at the month 07 of 2024 and the deposition number is GDMCC NO:64912. The trichoderma harzianum GZUAS681023 provided by the invention has good tolerance to environmental factors such as pH value, temperature and the like, has higher and stable degradation efficiency to deltamethrin in high-temperature and low-temperature, acidic and alkaline environments, and provides technical support for developing efficient deltamethrin degrading bacteria.

title_en: Low rainbow line polyester film and coating equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of film production, and particularly relates to a low rainbow-grain polyester film, which comprises a base film and an interference layer arranged on the surface of the base film, wherein the interference layer is formed by mixing aqueous polyurethane, aqueous polyester, melamine resin, an organic solvent, a wetting agent, nanoparticles, a pH value regulator and deionized water to form a coating liquid and then coating the coating liquid on the surface of the base film, and the interference layer is synchronously stirred by coating equipment and then coated on a base material.

title_en: Reaction system based on presulfiding catalyst and application method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalysis experiments, and particularly discloses a reaction system based on a presulfiding catalyst and a use method thereof, wherein the reaction system comprises an air supply assembly, a liquid supply assembly, a preheating assembly and a catalytic assembly, the air supply assembly is connected with an air passage in parallel, the preheating assembly internally comprises a front-section spiral pipe and a rear-section spiral pipe, the width and the length of a hydrostatic vaporization bin are both larger than the diameter of the front-section spiral pipe, the bottom surface of the hydrostatic vaporization bin is a right angle, and a dispersion guiding inclined plate is arranged in the hydrostatic vaporization bin; the process of converting gas-liquid two-phase heating into a gas single phase is optimized, the influence of unvaporization of liquid drops on a catalyst is avoided or reduced, and the optimized structure meets the recoil function. The mode meets the requirement of backflushing application, and the discharge channel can recover liquid under the condition of overlarge liquid feeding amount, and the scheme considers various factors in the whole experimental process, expands the selection range of experimental parameters and has extremely high applicability to multi-parameter comparison experiments.

title_en: Silicone oil modified lubricant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicone oil modified lubricant and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of silicone oil modified lubricants. The preparation method of the silicone oil modified lubricant comprises the following steps of (1) dissolving hyaluronic acid in water to prepare hyaluronic acid solution, then mixing the hyaluronic acid solution with magnesium hydroxide solution, stirring the mixture solution uniformly, placing the mixture solution in ice bath conditions, (2) dissolving dodecanoyl chloride or stearic acid acyl chloride in 1, 4-dioxane, dropwise adding the mixture obtained in the step (1) to react, and (3) concentrating the product obtained in the step (2) after the reaction is finished, precipitating the product with ethanol, washing the precipitate, dissolving the precipitate with deionized water, and freeze-drying the precipitate. After the silicone oil modified lubricant is mixed with silicone oil, balls can be spontaneously formed, and the rolling lubrication effect is exerted, so that friction is greatly reduced.

title_en: Vulcanized porous active carbon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulcanized porous active carbon composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic functional materials. According to the invention, the biomineralization strategy is adopted to synthesize the copper sulfide/chitosan quaternary ammonium salt composite particles, the copper sulfide/chitosan quaternary ammonium salt composite particles are deposited on the biomass porous activated carbon material to obtain the vulcanized porous activated carbon composite material, the biomass porous activated carbon material is used as a carrier, the copper sulfide/chitosan quaternary ammonium salt composite particles are uniformly loaded, the vulcanized porous activated carbon composite material shows excellent photo-thermal conversion performance, high temperature is generated after illumination treatment, and the structure of the biomass porous activated carbon material and the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt is combined, so that the vulcanized porous activated carbon composite material not only shows strong adsorption capacity on organic pollutants in sewage, but also can effectively inhibit and kill bacteria attached to the surface of the sewage.

title_en: Semi-coke wastewater treatment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water treatment, relates to a method for treating semi-coke wastewater, and aims at the problems of high coke powder content and high chemical oxygen demand concentration in semi-coke wastewater, the invention carries out multistage treatment on the wastewater with the characteristics of high phenol content, and the treatment process flow comprises chemical separation, reverse reaction, centrifugal separation, pyrolysis, acid precipitation and recycling. The method separates and recycles the coke powder in the wastewater while extracting and removing the phenol, solves the problems of medicament loss, medicament application efficiency reduction and the like caused by coke powder blocking equipment and coke powder-separating agent-water three-phase emulsification, and simultaneously realizes the recycling of phenolic compounds and coke powder.

title_en: Sesame stir-fry equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses sesame stir-frying equipment, and relates to the technical field of sesame oil production and processing. The sesame stir-frying equipment comprises a feed hopper, an inner cylinder assembly and an outer cylinder assembly, wherein the feed end of the inner cylinder assembly is used for receiving an output port of the feed hopper, the inner cylinder assembly consists of an inner cylinder and a first stirring assembly, the first stirring assembly is coaxially arranged inside the inner cylinder and used for axially conveying sesame and simultaneously carrying out radial stirring, and the outer cylinder assembly is coaxially sleeved outside the inner cylinder and used for receiving a discharge port of the inner cylinder assembly. Can realize the processing of not shutting down of sesame stir-fry through inner tube, interior helical blade, urceolus, outer helical blade, improve production efficiency, and set up including the disconnect-type of section of thick bamboo and urceolus, realize segmentation accuse temperature demand, under the cooperation of helical blade and second stirring leaf, can realize sesame quick, even high Wen Jihuo dehydration, through outer helical blade and first stirring leaf cooperation, can realize the high-efficient stirring when sesame is fried thoroughly, through driving the periodic collision of ram and outer helical blade, can avoid outer helical blade adhesion sesame.

title_en: Aqueous block copolymer and application thereof in high-density water-based drilling fluid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of drilling in petroleum industry, and particularly relates to a water-based block copolymer and application thereof in high-density water-based drilling fluid. The water-based block copolymer is a diblock copolymer and comprises a first block and a second block, wherein the first block is a random copolymer of a monomer type D and a monomer type E, and the second block is a random copolymer of a monomer type G, a monomer type H and a monomer type L.

title_en: Tomato source antibacterial protein, application of tomato source antibacterial protein in preventing and treating gray mold of tomatoes and biological preparation for preventing and treating gray mold of tomatoes
abstract_en: The invention relates to tomato source antibacterial protein, application of the protein in preventing and controlling tomato gray mold and a biological agent for preventing and controlling the tomato gray mold, and belongs to the technical field of tomato disease control. In order to solve the problem that tomato source antibacterial proteins for preventing and treating tomato gray mold are lack in the prior art, the invention provides tomato ABS258 antibacterial protein and tomato ABS121 antibacterial protein, wherein the amino acid sequence of the tomato ABS121 antibacterial protein is the 1 st to 121 th positions of the amino acid sequence of the tomato ABS258 antibacterial protein. The specific botrytis cinerea protein provided by the invention can effectively inhibit the growth of botrytis cinerea mycelium at low concentration, prevents pathogenic bacteria from infecting tomato leaves, has the natural advantages of definite gene source and high compatibility with tomatoes, and the differentiated protein structure provides flexible selection for pesticide development aiming at different application scenes.

title_en: Bar compositions with improved skin benefits
abstract_en: A bar composition is disclosed comprising 20-80% by weight total fatty material, 0.1-5% by weight electrolyte, 0.001% -5% by weight PPAR activator selected from 10-hydroxystearic acid or 12-hydroxystearic acid, 1-45% by weight complex carbohydrate comprising starch, and 10-50% by weight water.

title_en: Laundry detergent compositions containing monohydric alcohols
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a laundry detergent composition comprising a monohydric alcohol.

title_en: Water-based composite binder for silicon-based negative electrode of lithium ion battery, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-based composite binder for a silicon-based negative electrode of a lithium ion battery, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium batteries. The aqueous composite binder for inhibiting the volume expansion of the silicon-based negative electrode is prepared by cross-linking fucoidin and gallic acid. The water-based composite adhesive prepared by the invention has the advantages of good dispersibility, strong self-healing property and cohesiveness and the like. The three-dimensional network structure formed by the bonding agent after crosslinking is beneficial to the transmission of electrons and ions, the mechanical property and interface stability of the bonding agent are greatly improved, the SiOx electrode can keep good integrity in the circulating process, the volume expansion of the SiOx anode material in the electrode charging and discharging process can be effectively inhibited, and the SiOx anode shows good circulating stability and durability.

title_en: Double-marker double-mode quantitative detection probe and application thereof in aortic dissection diagnosis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of diagnostic reagents, in particular to a double-marker double-mode quantitative detection probe, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in aortic dissection diagnosis. Compared with the traditional probe, the dual-marker dual-mode quantitative detection probe has the advantages that fluorescence-magnetic resonance relaxation dual-mode signals are not mutually interfered, and synchronous quantification can be realized. The application of the method in aortic dissection diagnosis has the advantages that the simultaneous detection of the double markers can obviously improve the detection rate of aortic dissection and avoid the misdiagnosis generated during the detection of the single markers. Meanwhile, double indexes can be obtained through single detection, repeated sampling is avoided, and the detection time is effectively shortened.

title_en: Treatment method for restoring landscaping soil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation and landscaping, in particular to a treatment method for landscaping soil remediation, which comprises the steps of 1, soil pretreatment, 2, pH value adjustment, 3, application of a composite modifier, 4, inoculation of functional microorganisms, 5, plant-microorganism cooperative remediation, and 6, maintenance after remediation. The treatment method for restoring the landscaping soil realizes the optimization of the soil structure, the balance of nutrients and the slight pollution purification through the synergistic effect of physics, chemistry and biology, simultaneously improves the ecological function of the soil, provides healthy growth environment for garden plants, and is suitable for the soil improvement and ecological function restoration of urban parks, green belts, landscape parks and other scenes.

title_en: Polymer adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymer adhesive, which takes sulfonated polyether-ether-ketone, polyether-sulfone and polyacrylonitrile as main polymers, has good flexibility and tensile strength, has good compatibility with electrode active materials and electrolytes, avoids falling or loosening of active substances after multiple cycles of electrodes, takes polyaniline and polythiophene as conductive polymers, forms a coordination effect with the main polymers, provides a transmission channel for charges, and effectively improves the conductivity of the adhesive, thereby improving various performances of solid batteries.

title_en: Anti-slip and anti-fouling glazed tile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of glazed tiles, in particular to an anti-slip and anti-fouling glazed tile and a preparation method thereof. The anti-slip and anti-fouling glazed tile sequentially comprises an anti-slip and anti-fouling layer, a glaze layer and a ceramic tile blank from top to bottom, wherein the glaze layer comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of quartz sand, 6-12 parts of calcined magnesia, 10-15 parts of magnesia-alumina spinel, 7-15 parts of calcium carbonate, 10-20 parts of strontium-boron glass powder, 2-5 parts of yttrium-stabilized zirconia and 1-3 parts of hydroxyapatite nanorods. According to the invention, the glaze layer and the anti-skid and anti-fouling layer are sequentially arranged on the surface of the green brick, wherein the glaze layer is arranged by a plurality of high-strength and wear-resistant components, so that the high hardness, the wear-resistant shock resistance and the thermal shock resistance of the glaze surface are ensured, the anti-skid and anti-fouling layer takes the fluorosilicone resin as a base material, and a plurality of additives are added, so that the intelligent balance of skid resistance and self cleaning is realized, and the anti-skid and anti-fouling composite material is particularly suitable for high-humidity and high-greasy dirt scenes such as bathrooms and kitchens.

title_en: Composition and application of ionic liquid resin as adhesive
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to an application of an ionic liquid resin as an adhesive, an adhesive composition, an adhesive, an application and a composite part. The invention provides an application of an ionic liquid resin as an adhesive, which has a structure shown in a formula I, wherein m and n in the formula I are respectively and independently selected from integers of 1-10, and L  ‑  is selected from anions. The ionic liquid resin with the structure shown in the formula I is used as the effective component of the adhesive, so that the adhesive has good binding force and low viscosity, can make up the gap between the metal seal head and the plastic liner, has good low-temperature toughness, and further improves the sealing property of the plastic liner;

title_en: Power adapter shell, manufacturing method and power adapter
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a power adapter shell, a manufacturing method and a power adapter, and relates to the technical field of electronic products; the method comprises the steps of obtaining temperature distribution data of an upper shell and a lower shell of the power adapter shell when the accommodating cavities of the upper shell and the lower shell are all in a space-time power adapter shell under an ideal thermal steady state, dividing a bottom plane of the lower shell into a central temperature zone and a plurality of edge temperature zones according to the temperature distribution data, enabling the temperature range of the central temperature zone to be larger than that of each edge temperature zone, determining a target heat conduction coefficient and a target phase change temperature of phase change materials to be filled into the accommodating cavities based on the temperature distribution data of each temperature zone, enabling the target phase change temperature to be higher than the heat source temperature of the edge temperature zone and lower than a preset safety temperature threshold, filling the liquid phase change materials into the accommodating cavities, and assembling the lower shell and the upper shell after the phase change materials are solidified to obtain the target power adapter shell. The embodiment of the application can improve the use safety.

title_en: Method for preparing hydrocarbon from naphthalene in molybdenum-based catalyst and waste lubricating oil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalysts, in particular to a molybdenum-based catalyst and a method for preparing hydrocarbons from naphthalene in waste lubricating oil. The molybdenum-based catalyst is a supported catalyst, the carrier is a molecular sieve, and the active ingredient is molybdenum oxide, wherein the content of the molybdenum oxide in the molybdenum-based catalyst is 5-50wt%. The molybdenum-based catalyst mainly uses molybdenum oxide as an active component, can efficiently catalyze naphthalene to be converted into C7-C12 hydrocarbons, the maximum naphthalene conversion rate is 99.2%, and the yield of the C7-C12 hydrocarbons can reach 59.3%. The method for preparing C7-C12 hydrocarbon from naphthalene is simple and convenient to operate, does not need an external hydrogen source, is mild in reaction condition, can continuously generate a production process, is green and efficient, can obviously improve the recycling of waste lubricating oil, has higher economic benefit and has very wide application prospect.

title_en: Antibacterial coating for bathroom products and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coatings, in particular to an antibacterial coating for bathroom products and a preparation method thereof, wherein the antibacterial coating for bathroom products comprises, by weight, 60-80 parts of polyacrylate emulsion, 6-10 parts of polyoxyethylene ether, 2-4 parts of calcium carbonate, 1.5-2.5 parts of adhesion promoter and 0.5-1 part of flatting agent BYK333, and the top coating comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of tridecafluorooctyl trimethoxy silane, 25-30 parts of polysiloxane, 15-20 parts of polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion, 5-8 parts of 3-aminopropyl triethoxy silane, 0.8-1.5 parts of calcium carbonate, 1-2 parts of talcum powder, 6-10 parts of composite antibacterial agent and 3-5 parts of defoamer BYK 088.

title_en: High-strength and high-toughness UV-curable bio-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength and high-toughness UV-curable bio-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly reacting alcohol amine with diisocyanate under ice bath condition to synthesize a biurea-based chain extender, then reacting with bio-based polyol, a hydrophilic chain extender, a micromolecular chain extender, diisocyanate and a catalyst at 80-90 ℃ for 3-6 h to prepare a bio-based polyurethane prepolymer, blocking by using hydroxy acrylic ester, and obtaining high-toughness UV-curable aqueous bio-based polyurethane emulsion after neutralization and emulsification dispersion, wherein the UV-curable coating has excellent high strength (tensile strength 31 MPa), high toughness (elongation at break 134%), excellent water resistance (the coating has no obvious change in 96 h when being soaked in water), alcohol resistance (the coating has no obvious change in 1 h when being soaked in 50% ethanol solution) and adhesive property (adhesive force 1 level), and can be widely applied to the fields of coating and adhesives.

title_en: Amphiphilic nickel catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in viscosity reduction of thickened oil
abstract_en: The invention provides an amphiphilic nickel catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in viscosity reduction of thickened oil, and belongs to the technical field of viscosity reduction of thickened oil. The amphiphilic nickel catalyst has a structure shown in the following formula, wherein n=2-4;R =c6-C12 alkyl chains. The preparation method of the amphiphilic nickel catalyst is simple, can exert the advantages that hydrophilic groups are easy to attract hydrogen electron clouds in heavy components to enable C-C bonds to have polarity and are easy to break, and meanwhile, the amphiphilic nickel catalyst can exert the advantages that the solubility of the lipophilic groups is good, the hydrophilic groups promote hydrolysis and the C-C bonds are easy to break, can realize the effect of modifying oil products, and also has good thermal stability, good catalytic viscosity reduction effect and wide application range.

title_en: Surface treating agent
abstract_en: The present invention provides a composition comprising (component A) a silane coupling agent comprising a carbon chain having at least 1 etheric oxygen atom, and (component B) a silane coupling agent comprising a siloxane structure.

title_en: Temperature-rising reaction equipment for fish oil production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fish oil production, in particular to heating reaction equipment for fish oil production, which can ensure that a catalyst can be uniformly added into a device, and can ensure that stirring is uniform at the same time, so that fish oil is fully reacted, and the problem of local reaction rate blocking is avoided. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the catalytic box, the device can automatically add the catalyst, ensure uniform addition, avoid accumulation, realize multiple stirring functions through the mutual cooperation of the catalytic box and the reaction component, realize uniform stirring functions, ensure the reaction efficiency of the fish oil of the device through the functions of uniform addition and uniform stirring of the additive, and avoid local reaction blocking or excessive reaction.

title_en: Benzothiazolyl hydrazone zinc ion fluorescent probe, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a benzothiazolyl hydrazone zinc ion fluorescent probe, a preparation method and application thereof, and the probe can solve the defects of complex synthesis, low sensitivity, long response time and the like of the existing zinc ion detection fluorescent probe. The preparation method of the probe comprises the steps of introducing an acylhydrazone group containing oxygen and nitrogen into the 2 nd benzothiazole to synthesize 1, 3-benzothiazole-2-carbohydrazide, and then carrying out condensation reaction with 1-hydroxy-2-naphthaldehyde under the condition of liquid phase. The benzothiazolyl hydrazone zinc ion fluorescent probe prepared by the application can recognize zinc ions in DMSO/HEPES buffer (V: V=9:1, HEPES buffer concentration is 10 mmol/L, pH 7.4) solution in a naked eye manner to form a 1:1 complex, and the response time is about 6 s. Meanwhile, the probe has better selectivity and stronger anti-interference capability in the zinc ion detection process, and the detection limit is 9.8X10  ‑9  mol/L. The pH is in the range of 4-12, the detection performance of the probe on zinc ions is good, and trace detection of zinc ions in a water sample can be realized in practical environment application.

title_en: Lithium slag-based soil remediation agent and method for synergistically solidifying heavy metals by using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium slag-based soil restoration agent and a method for synergistically curing heavy metals by using the same, wherein the lithium slag-based soil restoration agent comprises, by weight, 60-80 parts of lithium slag, 10-20 parts of an alkaline activator, 5-10 parts of a crystallization auxiliary agent and 10-30 parts of deionized water. The invention has the advantage of environmental protection, and solves the problems that the existing soil restoration agent is inconvenient to recycle lithium slag in the use process, so that the material cost in the preparation process is higher and the restoration cost of polluted soil is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of moldable fiber board
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial boards, and relates to a preparation method of a moldable fiber board, which comprises the steps of raw material preparation, fiber preparation, sizing, drying, paving pre-pressing, hot pressing and post-treatment, wherein 1-10% of water-based plastic (acrylic emulsion) is added during sizing, 0-20% of urea-formaldehyde resin and/or 0-5% of isocyanate are matched, the moisture content of the dried fiber is 6-10%, the hot pressing temperature is 160-200 ℃ and the pressure is 2-5MPa, and the density of a board is controlled to 600-800kg/m  3 . The obtained fiberboard can directly realize deep die pressing of more than or equal to 4mm without pretreatment, the production efficiency can be greatly improved compared with a routing process, meanwhile, the die pressing process has no high requirement of the routing process on the density of the fiberboard, the density of the board can be reduced according to the requirement, the wood raw material is saved, and the waste of the routing process on the raw material can be saved. The method has the advantages of no cracking and layering after mould pressing, low formaldehyde release, capability of manufacturing aldehyde-free plates, high raw material utilization rate, suitability for existing production lines and suitability for scenes requiring three-dimensional modeling such as furniture, architectural decoration, door industry and the like, and mechanical properties reach national standards.

title_en: Composite decorative film with controllable optical effect and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite decorative film with a controllable optical effect, which sequentially comprises a substrate layer, a matte primer layer, a bright oil paint layer and a transparent finish paint layer from bottom to top, wherein the glossiness of the matte primer layer is less than or equal to 4GU@60 ℃, the glossiness of the bright oil pattern layer is more than or equal to 85GU@60 ℃, the matte primer layer is provided with a fold structure, and the bright oil pattern layer is provided with silk screen printing or grain patterns.
