title_en: Composite initiator for improving germination rate of dipsacus asper seeds and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite initiator for improving germination rate of dipsacus root seeds and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of plant seeds. The composite initiator consists of gibberellin GA  3 , polyethylene glycol ‌ 6000 and CaCl  2 . Experiments show that each germination index of a single initiator PEG6000 and CaCl  2  is superior to GA  3 , the germination index is obviously influenced by different proportions of the composite initiator, and the germination rate of the seeds treated by the composite initiator is highest, so that the initiation effect on the length of the overground part of the dipsacus root and the weight of a single plant is superior to that of the single initiator. The invention can effectively promote the growth of the teasel root seedlings and play a role in strengthening the seedlings while improving the germination rate of the teasel root seeds.

title_en: Coating composition for metal substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of coatings, in particular to a coating composition for a metal substrate and a preparation method thereof. The application discloses a coating composition for a metal substrate, which comprises, by weight, 60-80 parts of a high-boiling aromatic hydrocarbon solvent, 3-10 parts of an ester solvent, 5-15 parts of a polyether-ether-ketone resin, 0.1-0.5 part of a leveling agent and 3-10 parts of color paste, wherein the high-boiling aromatic hydrocarbon solvent is clear liquid composed of aromatic hydrocarbon hydrocarbons. The application can obviously optimize the construction performance, film forming quality and final coating performance of the coating by precisely regulating and controlling the types and the proportion of the high boiling aromatic hydrocarbon solvent, the ester solvent, the polyether-ether-ketone resin and the flatting agent, so that the coating is especially suitable for metal coatings (such as kitchen ware) with strict requirements on high temperature resistance and surface flatness.

title_en: Production process of acid dye with low salt precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-salting-out acid dye production process, which relates to the technical field of acid dyes, and comprises the steps of selecting a core raw material for acid dye synthesis, removing inorganic salt impurities in the raw material, preparing a reaction solvent and an auxiliary agent, selecting a salt-free cosolvent, putting the refined raw material into a reaction kettle, introducing compressed air, stirring for reaction, tracking the reaction progress by an online concentration monitor, and stopping the reaction when the concentration of a dye intermediate reaches a set concentration threshold value to obtain a reaction solution. According to the invention, the salt-free cosolvent is selected from the source, the ultrafiltration and nanofiltration fractionation membrane separation technology is combined to replace the traditional salting-out technology, and the atomization spray washing is matched, so that the salt content of the final wet dye crystal is controlled within 0.3%, the dissolubility and the coloring uniformity of the dye are effectively improved, and the color light stability and the color fastness are improved. The molecular imprinting material prepared by the auxiliary of the dummy template molecules can accurately capture organic byproducts and homologs in the nanofiltration concentrated solution, greatly improve the purity of the dye and ensure the stable performance of the product.

title_en: Zinc hydrometallurgy cathode plate protective coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a zinc hydrometallurgy cathode plate protective coating and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of industrial coatings; the component A is prepared from epoxy resin, hydroxyl silicone oil, a silane coupling agent, wear-resistant filler, lubricating filler, a solvent and a catalyst through in-situ polymerization reaction, the component B is a phenolic amine curing agent, the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing raw materials, carrying out in-situ polymerization reaction under heating and stirring, hydrolyzing the silane coupling agent, bridging organic resin and inorganic filler, carrying out wet ball milling and filtering to obtain the component A, mixing the component A and the component B during construction, and then coating the mixture on the surface of a cathode plate, wherein the coating is formed by modifying the epoxy resin through an organosilicon block, and an organic-inorganic interpenetrating network structure is constructed by utilizing the coupling agent, so that the zinc hydrometallurgy cathode plate has excellent dilute sulfuric acid corrosion resistance, heat resistance, high adhesive force, good hydrophobicity and mechanical toughness, can effectively prolong the service life of the zinc hydrometallurgy cathode plate in a high-temperature high-humidity acid mist environment, and is easy to obtain raw materials, has controllable cost, and is suitable for large-scale application.

title_en: Near infrared fluorescent powder, preparation method and application thereof, light conversion film and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides near infrared fluorescent powder, a preparation method and application thereof, a light conversion film, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fluorescent materials. The near infrared fluorescent powder can emit yellow-green light with the wavelength of 470-700 nm and near infrared light with the wavelength of 700-900 nm under the excitation of light with the wavelength of 300-500 nm. The excitation range of the fluorescent powder covers ultraviolet light and blue light in sunlight, the emission spectrum mainly covers near infrared light of 700-900 nm, and the fluorescent powder can convert the ultraviolet light and the blue light into the near infrared light, so that the problem of spectrum mismatch of the silicon-based solar cell is solved, the utilization rate of the silicon-based solar cell to the sunlight is improved, and the purpose of improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency of a solar device is achieved.

title_en: Method and system for removing chloroaluminate ionic liquid sediment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for removing chloroaluminate ionic liquid sediments, which comprise the following steps of 1) preparing a washing solvent containing alkane and alkene, 2) washing the inner wall of a device attached with the chloroaluminate ionic liquid sediments by using the washing solvent to obtain a washed material, 3) carrying out solid-liquid separation on the washed material to obtain a solid material and a liquid material, wherein the liquid material comprises chloroaluminate ionic liquid floccules formed by complexing the chloroaluminate ionic liquid sediments with alkene, 4) mixing the liquid material with electrolyte, carrying out an electrowinning reaction to obtain sediments and a liquid mixed material containing part of alkane and part of alkene, and 5) returning the liquid mixed material to the washing solvent. The invention can simplify the cleaning step, reduce the cost and realize the effective cleaning of the chloroaluminate ionic liquid sediment.

title_en: Chitin derivative binder and application thereof in all-solid-state battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of solid-state batteries, in particular to a chitin derivative binder and application thereof in all-solid-state batteries. The structural formula of the chitin derivative binder is shown as the following formula:  Wherein R is independently selected from H, X-C=O-, alkyl 、-CH 2 CH(OH)CH 3 、Y-NH-C=O-、-CH 3 (CH 2 )、-CH 3 COONa, X, Y is alkyl, and n is an integer not less than 10. The application synthesizes the chitin derivative binder for the first time and applies the chitin derivative binder to composite solid electrolyte film formation, and the composite electrolyte prepared by the chitin derivative has higher flexibility and ion conductivity, is suitable for various electrode materials, is suitable for the existing lamination process, and has rapid industrialization prospect.

title_en: Leaking stoppage cement paste for weak cementing layer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses plugging cement paste for a weak cementing layer and a preparation method and application thereof. The cement slurry comprises, by mass, 100 parts of cement, 0.2-1.2 parts of plugging materials, 2-6 parts of fluid loss additives, 0.2-1.5 parts of dispersing agents, 0.1-0.6 parts of defoaming agents and 40-50 parts of water. The preparation method of the cement slurry comprises the following steps of 1) mixing cement, plugging materials, a fluid loss agent and a dispersing agent according to the mass ratio to obtain a solid mixture, 2) mixing water and a defoaming agent according to the mass ratio to obtain slurry preparation water, and 3) adding the solid mixture into the slurry preparation water which is stirred at a low speed, and stirring at a high speed after the addition is finished to obtain the cement slurry for plugging. The plugging cement paste for the weak cementing layer is applied to preparation of a weak cementing layer material for well cementation of an oil gas well. The system improves the plugging performance of cement slurry, reduces the leakage risk in the well cementation process, improves the cementing strength of a first interface and a second interface of well cementation, and ensures the well cementation quality.

title_en: Mechanochromatic bimodal fluorescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanochromatic bimodal fluorescent material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the mechanochromatic bimodal fluorescent material is shown in a formula (I), has fluorescent properties in a solution state and a solid state, can change fluorescence emission wavelength and color by grinding in the solid state, and can recover the fluorescence emission peak position to an initial state by solvent fumigation; (I)。

title_en: Aspergillus for inducing dragon tree to form resin rapidly and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses aspergillus for inducing a dragon tree to quickly form resin and application thereof. The aspergillus is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) with the preservation number of CGMCC No.42107. The aspergillus has the capability of efficiently inducing the dragon trees to generate the dragon blood, and the aspergillus is inoculated to the Hainan dragon trees, so that the formation time of the dragon blood can be obviously shortened, the yield and quality of the dragon blood are improved, and a new effective way is provided for the mass production of the dragon blood.

title_en: Recyclable wireless structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recyclable wireless structure, a preparation method and a use method thereof.

title_en: Fusion enzyme for producing rare ginsenoside Rh2 and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enzyme engineering, and discloses a fusion enzyme for producing rare ginsenoside Rh2, and a preparation method and application thereof. The active part of the fusion enzyme is obtained by sequentially connecting beta-glucosidase Bglpm, connecting peptide and beta-glucosidase Bgp. According to the invention, two enzymes are fused into one enzyme molecule through a gene fusion technology, and the fusion enzyme obtained after screening and optimizing effectively improves the catalytic efficiency of the enzyme, so that the reaction rate of converting ginsenoside Rd into rare ginsenoside Rh2 is obviously improved.

title_en: Phase change material for ice bag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase change material for ice bags and a preparation method thereof, the phase change material for the ice bag consists of ammonium chloride, super absorbent resin, nano silicon dioxide, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and water. The super absorbent resin is prepared by using chemically modified chitosan as a macromolecular cross-linking agent, sodium persulfate as an initiator, and acrylic acid, 1-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone and 2-acrylamide-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid as monomers through reversed-phase suspension polymerization. The chitosan molecule is quaternized and grafted with polyethylene glycol chain segments, and then is used as a macromolecular crosslinking agent to participate in polymerization, so that a more stable and tough gel network structure can be formed, and bacteria invasion and migration are prevented. The sulfonate ions with negative charges can form a firm hydration layer with water molecules, maintain the swelling state of gel in salt solution, and can effectively improve the water absorption capacity of the material in the salt solution.

title_en: Repellent and poisoning synergistic sweet wormwood-tolfenpyrad pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synergistic repellent and toxic-killing type sweet wormwood-tolfenpyrad pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, wherein the active ingredients of the pharmaceutical composition comprise sweet wormwood extract and tolfenpyrad, and the mass ratio of the sweet wormwood extract to tolfenpyrad is 1:0.1-1:1. The pharmaceutical composition obtained by compounding the sweet wormwood extract and the tolfenpyrad can generate better repellent and toxic-killing effects on the red palm weevil and the two warts rhinoceros, improve the control effect on the red palm weevil and the two warts rhinoceros, reduce the pollution to the environment and the pesticide residue, and is beneficial to realizing the ecological control of palm plant pests, namely the red palm weevil and the two warts rhinoceros, and has very important significance for controlling the palm plant pests.

title_en: Production process of high-concentration compound fertilizer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of compound fertilizer production, and particularly discloses a production process of a high-concentration compound fertilizer, which comprises the steps of weighing 200-300 parts of potassium chloride, 500-1000 parts of phosphoric acid, 200-400 parts of sulfuric acid, 100-150 parts of liquid ammonia, 100-150 parts of ammonium nitrate and phosphorus, 5-10 parts of boric acid, 2-5 parts of ammonium molybdate, 5-10 parts of zinc sulfate, 15-25 parts of diatomite and starch aqueous solution according to parts by weight, and preparing the high-concentration sulfur-based 15-15-15 nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium compound fertilizer through the process steps of crushing, pulping, granulating, drying and cooling. The diatomite can increase the porosity of the inside of the granules after fertilizer granulation, a channel is provided for moisture escape during fertilizer granule drying, and the wet granules after granulation are subjected to primary drying through a first cabin of a drying system to break the source of 'external drying and internal wetting' of the fertilizer granules, and are subjected to secondary drying through a second cabin to rapidly take away the evaporated moisture on the surfaces of the granules, so that the aim of rapid and internal and external uniform drying of the granules is fulfilled.

title_en: High-selectivity gas-sensitive coating composition for humanoid robot electronic nose chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating compositions, and discloses a high-selectivity gas-sensitive coating composition for a humanoid robot electronic nose chip, which comprises 40 to 60 parts of film-forming matrix selected from polyvinylidene fluoride or vinyl fluoride-vinyl ether alternating copolymer, 15 to 25 parts of gas-sensitive filler selected from metal organic frameworks ZIF-8, 2 to 5 parts of conductive agent selected from unmodified multi-wall carbon nano tubes, 1 to 3 parts of compatibility regulator selected from perfluorooctyl triethoxysilane, and a binary solvent system consisting of good solvent dissolving the film-forming matrix and non-solvent dispersing the gas-sensitive filler but not dissolving the film-forming matrix.

title_en: Top-loading coke oven coal charging device based on multi-parameter fusion and dynamic metering method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coke oven coking, in particular to a top-loading coke oven coal charging device based on multi-parameter fusion and a dynamic metering method. The device comprises a scanning imaging radar, an online moisture measuring instrument, a control processing module, a vibrator and four sets of bins and screw conveyors which are connected in parallel. The method comprises the steps of initializing moisture W  0  and bulk density rho  0  of coal materials, starting a system, enabling a vibrator to level the coal materials with specific parameters, scanning an imaging radar to dynamically monitor the volume, calculating real-time coal loading according to a formula M=rho×V, and detecting the bulk density again and updating calculation when the fluctuation of the moisture is more than or equal to 2%. The invention realizes independent, real-time and accurate measurement and control of four coal charging holes through multi-parameter fusion and dynamic correction of volume, moisture and bulk density, and fundamentally solves the problems of poor coal charging uniformity and accuracy caused by post metering and incapability of hole separation regulation in the prior art.

title_en: Pseudomonas LSZ22 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pseudomonas LSZ22 and application thereof, wherein the strain is classified and named Pseudomonas Pseudomonas extremorientalis extremorientalis LSZ and is preserved in China center for type culture collection (China center for type culture collection) in the year 2025, 9 and 29, and the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M20252165. The invention can promote the growth of plants by using the pseudomonas LSZ22, induce the up-regulated expression of drought-resistant related genes of the plants, and promote the water absorption capacity of the plants, thereby improving the adaptability of the plants in drought environments.

title_en: Low-coke heavy oil cracking catalyst with gradient pore canal and dynamic active crystal face and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-coke heavy oil catalytic cracking catalyst with gradient pore channels and dynamic active crystal faces and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of petroleum refining catalysts. The catalyst comprises, by weight, 10-30% of zirconium-titanium-lithium dynamic active matrix, 20-40% of ultra-stable Y-type molecular sieve coated by tantalum doped mesoporous cerium oxide, 30-50% of gradient pore carrier, 10-30% of clay and 5-15% of inorganic oxide binder. The preparation method comprises complex roasting of dynamic active matrix, hydrothermal synthesis of the limited-area encapsulation molecular sieve, mixing forming of the carrier and each component, and gas phase silanization post-treatment. The catalyst optimizes heavy oil macromolecular mass transfer by constructing a gradient pore system, and inhibits excessive cracking and coking by utilizing the B/L acid ratio of dynamic change of active components, so that the heavy oil conversion rate is more than 86%, the coke yield is reduced to below 4.0%, and the catalyst has high mechanical strength and good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Atomic oxygen-resistant epoxy resin adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atomic oxygen resistant epoxy resin adhesive and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of adhesives. According to the invention, the epoxy resin adhesive with atomic oxygen resistance is prepared by introducing the autonomously synthesized epoxy end-capped T-phenyl polysiloxane with fluorine atoms on side chains as a modifier into an epoxy resin system. The modifier molecule takes a flexible silicon-oxygen bond as a main chain, a side chain has the rigidity of phenyl and the strong stability of trifluoropropyl, and the terminal epoxy group ensures the dispersibility of the modifier, and the tight combination of components is realized by a covalent bond chemical bonding mode. The fluorocarbon bond in the trifluoropropyl effectively resists the denudation attack of space atomic oxygen by virtue of extremely high bond energy, optimizes the atomic oxygen resistance of the material, and combines toughness improvement and space environment tolerance on the basis of keeping the inherent strength of epoxy resin, thereby being applicable to the field of bonding spacecraft structures with strict requirements on reliability and durability.

title_en: Ageing-resistant water-based paint suitable for leather surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aging-resistant water-based paint suitable for leather surfaces, and belongs to the technical field of paint. The anti-aging water-based paint consists of a component A, a component B, a free radical capturing agent, a leveling agent and a defoaming agent, wherein the component A is acrylic ester copolymer emulsion containing weather-resistant functional monomers, and the component B is silane end-capped water-based polyurethane emulsion. The weather-resistant functional monomer is synthesized through three steps of reaction, integrates ultraviolet absorption, light energy conversion and crosslinking functions, wherein the component A is prepared through pre-emulsification semi-continuous seed polymerization, the component B is prepared through pre-polymerization, hydrophilic chain extension, silane end capping and emulsification, and the component B is prepared through adding an auxiliary agent after hybridization according to a proportion, and the pH and viscosity are regulated to obtain the finished product. The invention builds a complete anti-aging protection system, has excellent adhesive force, flexibility and friction resistance, is suitable for leather working conditions, has low VOC content, can avoid yellowing and falling of the coating, and prolongs the service life of leather products.

title_en: Pseudomonas aeruginosa and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural microorganisms, and particularly relates to pseudomonas aeruginosa and application thereof. The invention discloses a pseudomonas aeruginosa Pseudomonas aeruginosa Pseudomonas aeruginosa R-2, the number of which is CGMCC No.34796. The strain can secrete a plurality of active substances such as siderophores, chitinase and the like, and can effectively inhibit the growth of a plurality of pathogenic bacteria such as fusarium oxysporum, verticillium dahliae, rhizoctonia solani, fusarium graminearum and the like. Experiments show that the microbial inoculum containing the strain has remarkable control effect on medlar root rot and tomato fusarium wilt caused by fusarium oxysporum. The invention provides a new and environment-friendly microbial resource for preventing and controlling soil-borne fungus diseases of crops such as medlar, tomatoes and the like, and has important application value.

title_en: PS foam polyurethane foaming bonding splicing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PS foam polyurethane foaming bonding splicing method, and belongs to the technical field of composite material processing. The method comprises the following steps of carrying out sand paper polishing and ethanol cleaning surface pretreatment on a PS foam surface to be bonded, mixing and stirring an A component and a B component of a double-component polyurethane foaming agent according to a mass ratio of 100:80-100:110, coating the mixed polyurethane foaming agent on the PS foam surface to be bonded, coating the thickness of 1.5-3.0 mm, aligning and bonding two PS foams when the polyurethane foaming agent is started, applying pressure of 0.02-0.05 MPa for pressure maintaining, curing for 24-48 hours in an environment of 15-30 ℃, and finishing overflowing foams. The splicing joint has high strength, simple and convenient operation and low cost, and solves the problems of low splicing strength and easy breakage of the traditional iron wire fixing method and wood frame reinforcing method.

title_en: Methane carbon capturing system based on heat pump preheating rich liquid and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a methane carbon capturing system based on a heat pump preheating rich liquid and an operation method thereof, and belongs to the field of absorption carbon capturing and waste heat utilization. The system comprises an absorption carbon trapping unit, a heat pump unit and a hot water supply circulating runner, wherein the absorption carbon trapping unit is used for purifying anaerobic fermentation biogas of kitchen waste, removing impurities such as CO  2 、H 2  S and the like to produce biological natural gas, and realizing CO-trapping of CO  2 , the heat pump unit is used for recovering high-temperature waste heat and external low-temperature waste heat of the flue gas of a waste incineration power plant and outputting medium-temperature waste heat to a rich liquid preheater, and the hot water supply circulating runner is used for transferring heat output by the heat pump unit to the rich liquid preheater. The invention uses double-effect incremental absorption heat pump and lean liquid flash evaporation recompression technology, utilizes flue gas high-temperature waste heat and external low-temperature waste heat to generate a medium-temperature heat source, and supplies the medium-temperature heat source to the inlet rich liquid of the desorption tower, thereby improving the top temperature of the desorption tower.

title_en: Epoxy-terminated liquid butadiene polymer, preparation method and application thereof, composition and application thereof, and polymer coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of polymers, and discloses an epoxy-terminated liquid butadiene polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, a composition, application and a polymer coating. The functionality of the epoxy-terminated liquid butadiene polymer is 1.9-2, the total content of 1, 2-structural units and cyclized 1, 2-structural units is 60-74.5 wt% based on the total weight of the epoxy-terminated liquid butadiene polymer, the content of 1, 4-structural units is 25.5-40 wt%, and the content of cyclized 1, 2-structural units is 15-35 wt% based on the total weight of the 1, 2-structural units and cyclized 1, 2-structural units in the epoxy-terminated liquid polybutadiene polymer. The epoxy-terminated liquid butadiene polymer has good performance, and a polymer coating formed by the polymer has a lower thermal expansion coefficient under the condition of keeping higher peeling strength with a metal matrix.

title_en: Preparation process of adhesive tape with high peeling stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stripping stability adhesive tape and a preparation process thereof. The adhesive tape comprises a PET polyethylene terephthalate substrate subjected to corona treatment, an acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, a release layer and an antistatic liquid coating. The acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive layer is composed of acrylic monomers, saturated polyester resin, bisphenol F, bisphenol A epoxy resin and amino resin. The preparation process comprises corona pretreatment of polyethylene terephthalate base material, antistatic liquid coating, pressure sensitive adhesive coating, release layer compounding and curing treatment. The change rate of the stripping force of the adhesive tape after wet heat aging and low temperature aging is less than 5 percent, which is far lower than the industry standard, has excellent stripping stability, antistatic property and weather resistance, and is suitable for the fields of electronic product protection, automobile paint spraying shielding and the like.

title_en: Compound and lubricating grease, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lubricating grease, and discloses a compound, lubricating grease, a preparation method and application thereof. The application is the application of a compound with a structure shown as a formula (I) in thickening grease and/or improving the antioxidation of the grease. The compound provided by the invention can be used in lubricating grease, and can play a good thickening effect and an oxidation resistance effect at the same time. The lubricating grease provided by the invention has better oxidation stability, excellent adhesiveness, colloid stability, high dropping point and other performances.

title_en: Method for purifying polymer-based materials
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for reducing or completely eliminating extraneous compounds and contaminants present in polymer granules made of materials derived from waste of the sort collection or industrial waste, so that the recovered polymer material can be used for industrial reuse and does not generate odors and toxic residues during the reuse process.

title_en: Thermal foaming water-based ink and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printing ink, and discloses thermal foaming water-based ink and a preparation method and application thereof; the surfactant compounding and moderate polymer molecular weight are optimized, the wetting, film forming property and adhesive force are improved, the water-soluble organic solvent is introduced to improve the water volatilization rate, prevent the spray head from drying, and give consideration to the drying efficiency and the printing reliability, and the water is taken as the main solvent to greatly reduce VOCs, does not need UV curing, so that the method is suitable for office and food contact scenes. The thermal foaming water-based ink prepared by the invention has the beneficial effects of high printing quality, strong adhesive force, quick drying, environment friendliness, low odor, good thermal foaming stability and the like.

title_en: Water-based ceramic coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a water-based ceramic coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of introducing ozone for activation under the stirring state of rubber powder to obtain activated rubber powder; mixing a solution containing a silane coupling agent with a solution containing an acid catalyst and carrying out water bath reaction to obtain a silane prepolymer, adding the silane prepolymer into the dispersion liquid of the activated rubber powder to carry out reaction to obtain the dispersion liquid of the modified rubber powder, and mixing and curing the dispersion liquid of the modified rubber powder, the aqueous silica sol, the silane and the acid catalyst to obtain the aqueous ceramic coating. The preparation method disclosed by the application can be used for remarkably improving the coating thickness and flexibility of the water-based ceramic coating, is relatively simple and environment-friendly in preparation process, and can be applied to large-scale industrialization.

title_en: System and method for continuously preparing nano carbon material by electromagnetic induction induced catalytic cracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for continuously preparing a nano carbon material by electromagnetic induction induced catalytic cracking. The device comprises a waste plastic pyrolysis unit, a pyrolysis oil grading unit, an induction heating catalytic pyrolysis unit and a pyrolysis gas disposal unit, wherein the induction heating catalytic pyrolysis unit comprises an induction coil, an infrared temperature measurement and control system, an induction heating reactor, a feed pump, a nitrogen purging device and a tail gas flowmeter. The method mainly comprises pyrolysis pretreatment of waste plastics, oil gas classification generated by pyrolysis, catalytic pyrolysis of light pyrolysis oil from bottom to top through a reaction bed layer of an induction heating reactor to form carbon reaction, collection of carbon products and tail gas treatment. The invention can continuously operate, uses the polyolefin plastic waste material obtained in the scrapped lithium battery recycling industry to produce the carbon nano tube, uses the carbon nano tube as a conductive agent in the lithium battery manufacturing industry, promotes the lithium battery manufacturing industry and the scrapped lithium battery crushing recycling industry to form a closed loop, and has good environmental protection and economic benefits.

title_en: Lubricating oil composition for diesel engine and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a lubricating oil composition for a diesel engine and a preparation method thereof. The lubricating oil composition for the diesel engine comprises (A) a viscosity index improver, (B) a boronated ashless dispersant and/or a polyisobutene succinate ashless dispersant, (C) a sulfonate and/or sulfurized alkylphenate metal detergent, (D) zinc dialkyldithiophosphate, (E) dialkyl dithiocarbamate, (F) an amine antioxidant, (G) a thiophenol ester antioxidant and (H) lubricating base oil, wherein the viscosity index improver is a copolymer of C  8 ～C 12  alkyl methacrylate, C  13 ～C 18  alkyl methacrylate and N-vinylimidazole. The diesel engine lubricating oil composition has excellent soot dispersing, wear-resisting and high-temperature cleaning performances, and can meet the requirements of API CI-4, ACEA E4 and E7 grade high-performance diesel engine lubricating oil.

title_en: Amino acid active silicon water-soluble fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an amino acid active silicon water-soluble fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fertilizers. The amino acid active silicon water-soluble fertilizer comprises 9.5-12 w/v% of free L-alpha-amino acid, 1-3 w/v% of zinc element, 0.2-0.5 w/v% of silicon element, 0-0.1 w/v% of molybdenum element, 30-55 w/v% of polyethylene glycol, 1-3 w/v% of hydrogen chloride and the balance of water according to mass volume percentage. The amino acid active silicon water-soluble fertilizer contains amino acid zinc and active silicon, has high biological activity, has double biological stimulation and stress resistance promotion effects on crops, and can obviously enhance stress resistance and commodity performance of crops while improving the nutrition absorption efficiency of crops.

title_en: Water-based engineering machinery anticorrosive paint and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aqueous engineering machinery anticorrosive paint, and a preparation method and application thereof. The waterborne engineering machinery anticorrosive paint comprises an epoxy primer and a polyurethane finish paint, wherein the epoxy primer comprises a component A and a component B, the polyurethane finish paint comprises a component C and a component D, the component A comprises bisphenol A epoxy resin, a filler, a pigment, a dispersing agent, a defoaming agent, a wetting agent, a leveling agent, a rheological aid, an antirust agent, a cosolvent and water, the component B comprises an organic amine curing agent, a curing accelerator, an anti-flash rust agent and a cosolvent, the component C comprises hydroxyl-containing polyacrylate resin, a filler, a pigment, a neutralizing agent, a dispersing agent, a defoaming agent, a wetting agent, a leveling agent, a rheological aid, a cosolvent and water, and the component D comprises an isocyanate curing agent, a water scavenger and a cosolvent. The epoxy-polyurethane composite coating formed by the water-based engineering machinery anticorrosive paint has excellent corrosion protection performance and high-gloss decorative effect, and is suitable for corrosion prevention and decoration of engineering machinery.

title_en: Preparation method of growth-promoting agricultural microbial agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a growth-promoting agricultural microbial agent, which comprises the following steps of S1, independent fermentation and propagation of strains, S2, step-by-step loading, S3, coating of a slow-release protective layer and S4 and post-treatment, wherein the optimal physiological activities of different strains are guaranteed through step-by-step independent fermentation, physical space isolation of biocontrol bacteria and growth-promoting bacteria is realized by using a pore grading carrier, the growth-promoting bacteria are loaded on the surface of porous composite carrier particles in macropores, the biocontrol bacteria are loaded in micropores in the porous composite carrier particles, the release time sequence of flora is accurately controlled by combining with a temperature-responsive slow-release wall material solution, antagonism among the strains is thoroughly avoided, the carrier microporous structure provides physical protection for the strains, the slow-release wall material automatically adjusts the disintegration rate according to the soil temperature, so that the growth-promoting bacteria preferentially colonize root systems to form a barrier, and the subsequent release of the biocontrol bacteria plays a long-acting antibacterial function.

title_en: Method for producing organosilicon compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for preparing organosilicon compounds and to the use of the compounds thus obtained.

title_en: Preservation method for improving pork liver quality
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a preservation method for improving pork liver quality. The preservation method establishes a quantitatively-operable static cold preservation process of the pork liver through the specific steps of optimizing the perfusion technology. The proposal provided by the application can prolong the preservation time of the pig liver, improve the quality of the pig liver and provide stable and reliable technical support for the related research of pig liver transplantation.

title_en: Adhesive tape, bonded assembly and method for electrically debonding bonded assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an adhesive tape, an adhered assembly, a method for electrically debonding an adhered assembly and the use of an adhesive tape for adhering components in electronic devices, motor vehicles, medical devices and dental devices. The adhesive tape comprises at least one adhesive layer D, wherein the adhesive of the adhesive layer D is a reactive heat activatable adhesive and comprises at least one electrolyte.

title_en: Aluminum-based material surface protective coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating, in particular to an aluminum base material surface protective coating and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of S1, carrying out surface pretreatment on an aluminum base material, and carrying out anodic oxidation treatment on the pretreated aluminum base material surface to form an anodic oxidation bottom layer; S2, preparing and curing a sol-gel transition layer on the surface of the anodic oxidation bottom layer, and S3, coating the copolymer coating solution on the surface of the sol-gel transition layer, and curing to form a polymer surface layer. According to the invention, a composite coating system is constructed on the surface of the aluminum base, and the coating shows good adhesive force, higher hardness and excellent corrosion resistance by utilizing the synergistic effect of the components of each layer, so that the coating is suitable for the aluminum base with higher surface protection requirement.

title_en: High-thixotropic aqueous acrylic acid dispersoid and synthesis process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high thixotropic aqueous acrylic acid dispersion and a synthesis process thereof, wherein the dispersion comprises, by weight, 18-27 parts of aliphatic amine, 17-23 parts of diisocyanate, 50-55 parts of diethylene glycol dimethyl ether, 60-110 parts of long-chain hydrophilic acrylic ester, 145-155 parts of organic solvent, 75-100 parts of soft monomer, 175-210 parts of hard monomer, 50-68 parts of functional monomer, 35-45 parts of initiator, 16-20 parts of neutralizer and 528-555 parts of water. The dispersion introduces a polyurea structure and a polyethylene glycol hydrophilic structure into an acrylic acid system, so that the thixotropic property of the system can be increased, the wettability of the system to pigment and filler can be improved, and the stability of the system can be improved.

title_en: Microbacterium oxydans XZT347 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fermentation engineering and microbial disease control thereof, and particularly relates to a microbacterium oxydans XZT347 and application thereof. The invention provides a strain of micro-bacillus oxydans XZT347, and experiments show that the micro-bacillus oxydans XZT347 has better antagonism on Colletotrichum acutatum, Fusarium oxysporum f.sp.cucumerinum Owen, Phytophthora capsici Leonian and Ralstonia solanacearum, and the incidence of plant pepper anthracnose, pepper epidemic disease, pepper bacterial wilt and cucumber fusarium wilt is obviously reduced.

title_en: SnO2RGO composite thermosensitive material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials, in particular to a SnO2/RGO composite thermosensitive material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out one-step solvothermal reaction on reactants and a dispersing agent to prepare the SnO2/RGO composite thermosensitive material. According to the preparation method disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, RGO is doped in SnO2, wherein the RGO is introduced to provide a high-mobility conductive network for the composite material, so that the linear response of the composite material serving as a temperature sensor is improved, the response time is shortened, and the performance of the SnO2/RGO composite thermosensitive material is improved.

title_en: Non-fluorine binder for positive electrode of lithium ion battery, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-fluorine binder for a lithium ion battery anode, which comprises a copolymer main chain formed by free radical polymerization, wherein the copolymer main chain comprises an acrylonitrile monomer polymerization unit, an acrylic ester monomer polymerization unit and an acrylic acid monomer polymerization unit, and divalent metal ions are bonded on at least part of carboxyl groups in the acrylic acid monomer polymerization unit. The binder realizes the balance of strong binding force, moderate flexibility and excellent electrolyte resistance on a molecular level through unique monomer combination and cross-linking design. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the adhesive.

title_en: Water-saving carburetion fertility-enhancing artificial soil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses water-saving carburetion and fertility-improving artificial soil and a preparation method thereof. According to the multi-objective optimization requirement of degraded soil, aiming at the problems of single function, incomplete product quality evaluation and unstable performance among batches of the current artificial soil, the high-nutrient organic compost, the strong-water-storage organic compost and the yellow core soil are compounded according to a primary formula to prepare a primary screening material, the basic physicochemical property, the hydraulic characteristic and the feeding capability are represented, a minimum data set is constructed, an optimal formula is preferably determined by utilizing a soil quality index evaluation method, and then the artificial soil product is prepared in a large scale. The artificial soil prepared by the technical scheme has higher organic matter and nutrient content and good water infiltration-storage performance, provides a multi-effect and stable-performance improved material for ecological management, and is suitable for the fields of urban greening land construction, mine ecological restoration, house reclamation and the like.

title_en: High-strength corrosion-resistant coating, preparation method thereof and application thereof in automobile brake disc
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength corrosion-resistant coating, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in an automobile brake disc, and relates to the technical field of coatings. The high-strength corrosion-resistant coating comprises, by weight, 20-25 parts of zinc powder, 8-10 parts of aluminum powder, 6-8 parts of tungsten carbide, 2-3 parts of a silane coupling agent, 4-6 parts of a dispersing agent, 1.5-2 parts of fumed silica, 25-30 parts of an organosilicon modified epoxy resin, 1.5-2.5 parts of a corrosion inhibitor, 1-2 parts of an enhanced anti-aging agent, 4-6 parts of a leveling agent, 8-12 parts of a curing agent and 30-40 parts of deionized water. The coating prepared by the invention has excellent impact resistance, ageing resistance, corrosion resistance and wear resistance, and is suitable for application in the aspect of automobile brake discs.

title_en: Magnesium modified ZSM-5 molecular sieve, propylene and ethylene auxiliary agent for increasing yield by catalytic cracking and preparation method of both
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnesium modified ZSM-5 molecular sieve, a catalytic cracking propylene production-increasing ethylene auxiliary agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the magnesium modified ZSM-5 molecular sieve comprises the steps of mixing and pulping the ZSM-5 molecular sieve and water, adding a pore blocking agent, stirring to block pore channels of the molecular sieve, adding a pre-prepared magnesium hydroxide colloid, stirring to load the magnesium hydroxide colloid on the outer surface of the ZSM-5 molecular sieve, and roasting to obtain the magnesium modified ZSM-5 molecular sieve, wherein the mass content of magnesium in the magnesium modified ZSM-5 molecular sieve calculated by oxide is 3-10%. The invention loads magnesium hydroxide colloid on the external surface of ZSM-5 molecular sieve, provides effective alkali catalysis environment on the external surface, does not interfere the internal pore canal structure and acidity characteristic of the molecular sieve, obviously improves the selectivity and yield of propylene and ethylene in the catalytic cracking process, and reduces the occurrence of side reaction.

title_en: Self-repairable bio-based epoxy resin coating for sports equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic high polymer materials, in particular to a self-repairable bio-based epoxy resin coating for sports equipment. The bio-based epoxy resin coating is obtained by solidifying a biomass-derived epoxy compound or a carboxyl-containing compound under the catalysis of a transesterification catalyst. The dynamic fracture and rearrangement of the network structure are realized by the promotion effect of the catalyst, so that the self-repairing of the damaged part of the epoxy resin coating layer is realized. Meanwhile, by means of the unique chemical structure of the biomass raw material, the mechanical strength, wear resistance, corrosion resistance and other performances of the coating layer are improved, the service life of sports equipment is effectively prolonged, and the maintenance cost is reduced. The preparation process is simple, quick and environment-friendly, and the prepared self-repairable bio-based epoxy resin coating has better economic benefit, so that the self-repairable bio-based epoxy resin coating has wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for improving yield of gastrodia elata
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of edible fungus cultivation, and particularly relates to a method for improving yield of gastrodia elata. The invention can effectively shorten the whole cultivation period of the gastrodia elata and is beneficial to shortening the cultivation period, can effectively reduce the 'fungus-removing' phenomenon of armillaria mellea, and compared with the traditional cultivation bacterial bed, the armillaria mellea is only perforated and not completely opened, and even if part of armillaria mellea dies in the cultivation process, new armillaria mellea can germinate in the bag to promote the growth of the gastrodia elata and prevent fungus-removing, the invention prepares the high-nutrition armillaria mellea fungus stick, the fungus stick formula is suitable for supplementing organic nitrogen lacking in wood, and can promote the growth of the armillaria mellea, and when the gastrodia mellea is planted, the armillaria mellea can not be inoculated with wood and gastrodia elata seed is the biggest risk point.

title_en: Organic compound, optical film and display panel
abstract_en: The application relates to an organic compound, an optical film and a display panel, wherein the organic compound has a structure shown in a formula I:  The organic compound provided by the application has stronger characteristic absorption to light in a blue light wave band, has lower characteristic absorption to light in a red light wave band and a green light wave band, can better meet the requirement of a material on a blue light shading function, and increases the shading selectivity of the material.

title_en: Inorganic hydrophobic anticorrosive repair coating for magnesium phosphate, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of coatings, and particularly relates to a magnesium phosphate inorganic hydrophobic anti-corrosion repair coating, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding an organosilane coupling agent into an ethanol aqueous solution, stirring uniformly, adding powder to be modified, stirring continuously, cleaning, centrifuging and drying to obtain hydrophobic particles, mixing KH  2 PO 4 , a retarder and deionized water uniformly, adding MgO and the hydrophobic particles, and stirring uniformly to obtain the magnesium phosphate inorganic hydrophobic corrosion-resistant repair coating. According to the invention, by utilizing the cohesiveness of the magnesium phosphate cement-based cementing material and combining the hydrophobic slag particles, the surface roughness and the surface energy are regulated and controlled, and a durable, fireproof and corrosion-resistant magnesium phosphate cement-based hydrophobic coating can be rapidly formed by brushing the surface of the low carbon steel at normal temperature.

title_en: Clay stabilizer for water injection compounded by inorganic matter and cationic organic matter
abstract_en: The invention provides a clay stabilizer for water injection, which is compounded by inorganic matters and cationic organic matters, and discloses a clay anti-swelling agent compounded by inorganic matters and cationic organic matters, wherein the clay stabilizer is prepared by taking trimethyl monoallyl ammonium chloride as a raw material, adding a p-benzoquinone polymerization inhibitor, preventing polymerization in the use process, enabling small cationic monomer molecules containing double bonds to be used as the organic clay stabilizer, and being used together with the raw material cationic organic matters with small molecular weight, namely 2-hydroxyethyl trimethylammonium chloride, has clay swelling prevention performance, anti-scouring capability and long-acting performance, and has better clay swelling prevention performance after being compounded with cheap inorganic matters, namely aluminum chloride, dipotassium hydrogen phosphate and industrial ammonium chloride, so that the clay swelling prevention agent compounded by the inorganic matters and the cationic organic matters, prepared by the invention, has excellent clay swelling prevention capability, good washing resistance, and innovating effects on preventing clay swelling and migration damage to a storage layer and improving water injection recovery rate in water injection.

title_en: Long-acting polymer microsphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polymer microsphere, a preparation method and application thereof. The polymer microsphere comprises an initial cross-linking network and a later reinforcing cross-linking agent, wherein the later reinforcing cross-linking agent is modified polyethyleneimine with acetyl groups, the acetyl groups are cross-linking delay protection units, and the initial cross-linking network is formed by copolymerization of components including acrylamide, anionic monomers, cationic monomers, nonionic monomers and cross-linking agents. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing the raw materials according to the parts by weight, and carrying out emulsification reaction to obtain the polymer microsphere. The prepared polymer microsphere has stronger plugging efficiency after long-term aging at high temperature, can obviously prolong the plugging validity period of the microsphere, and can be applied to oil-gas field development under high-temperature oil reservoir conditions.

title_en: Cultivation method for improving active ingredients of golden camellia
abstract_en: The invention provides a cultivation method for improving active ingredients of golden camellia, and relates to the technical field of golden camellia cultivation. The method comprises 1) pouring a biological treatment agent A on roots of golden camellia flower buds in physiological differentiation period, wherein the biological treatment agent A is formed by compounding dark-colored isolated endophytic fungi HS40 fermentation liquor and bamboo leaf extract according to the volume ratio of (1-3): 1, 2) spraying a biological treatment agent B on leaves 30-45 days before harvesting, wherein the biological treatment agent B is prepared by enzymolysis of golden camellia flower extraction residues, and 3) carrying out directional trimming before tip extraction in spring, so that an included angle between a main branch and a main trunk is maintained at 45-60 degrees, and the light transmittance of a crown is ensured to be not lower than 40%. According to the invention, two biological treatment agents are applied in a specific period and combined with directional pruning, and all the technical means are synergistic, so that the total saponins and total flavonoids content of camellia nitidissima leaves are effectively improved, and the recycling of agricultural byproducts is realized.

title_en: Gestational placenta refrigerating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gestation placenta refrigerating device, which relates to the technical field of placenta refrigerating, and comprises a plurality of storage units which are configured to be stacked and stored mutually, wherein each storage unit comprises a rotating frame, each rotating frame is configured to be provided with a plurality of independent storage cavities for storing the storage frames, the rotating frame is provided with a control device for enabling the storage cavities of the rotating frame to be exposed out of a shell in sequence, the control device comprises selection parts which are used for selecting and taking out target objects and correspond to the target objects one by one, and further comprises a driving device which corresponds to each selection part and is configured to drive the selected target objects to reach a structure of a taking out window after the target objects are selected.

title_en: CuInS2/FeS2Preparation method of wood mildew-proof antibacterial agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a CuInS  2 /FeS 2  wood mildew-proof antibacterial agent, which comprises the steps of dissolving cuprous chloride, indium trichloride tetrahydrate, ferric trichloride hexahydrate and thiourea or thioacetamide in glycol, carrying out one-step solvothermal reaction and calcination to obtain the CuInS2/FeS2 composite antibacterial agent, wherein the material has the triple functions of photo-thermal, photo-catalytic and copper ion slow release, and can inhibit mildew and decay fungi on the wood surface under the visible-near infrared illumination or no illumination condition. By adding NH  4 VO 3  and 2-methylimidazole into a reaction system and calcining in an ammonia-containing atmosphere, a V  5+ /V 4+  redox pair can be formed on the surface, near infrared absorption is further widened, electron-hole recombination is delayed, and long-acting antibacterial effect under weak light is realized. The invention has simple process, does not contain chromium-arsenic heavy metal, and is suitable for environmental protection of wooden materials.

title_en: Preparation method of magnetic carbon-loaded slow-release fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a magnetic carbon-loaded slow-release fertilizer, belonging to the technical field of compounding of agricultural fertilizers and new materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly, acidizing and activating attapulgite by sulfuric acid, then, reacting with ferric salt solution with a specific molar ratio under an alkaline condition to generate magnetic attapulgite, then, mixing the magnetic attapulgite with biochar according to a proportion, coupling by means of an organosilicon compound to form a composite carrier material, then, adsorbing a mixed fertilizer solution by utilizing the carrier material under the assistance of ultrasound, efficiently collecting an adsorption saturated fertilizer carrier core by a magnetic separation technology, and finally, carrying out fluidized bed coating treatment on the fertilizer carrier core, thereby constructing the magnetically-responsive slow-release fertilizer with a core-shell structure. The product obtained by the preparation method can realize controllable slow release of nutrients, and greatly improves the fertilizer utilization rate.

title_en: Antifogging heat insulation film and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-fog heat-insulating film and a manufacturing method thereof, comprising the steps of providing a lower insulating layer film material, and coating an infrared absorption layer on one surface of the lower insulating layer film material; coating a transparent conductive layer on the surface of the infrared absorption layer, laminating an electrode, laminating an upper insulating layer on the surface of the transparent conductive layer for packaging, coating a glue layer on the other surface of the lower insulating layer film material, and attaching a release layer to obtain the anti-fog heat insulation film.

title_en: Tin-containing catalyst for bi-component sealant, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a tin-containing catalyst for a bi-component sealant, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adhesives. The structural formula of the tin-containing catalyst is R  x Sn(OOCR') 4‑x , wherein R is C4-C12 alkyl, R 'is C11-C17 alkenyl when x=0 or 1, and R' is C13-C17 alkenyl when x=2. When the alkoxy-terminated polydimethylsiloxane is used as a raw material to prepare the bi-component dealcoholized silicone sealant, the sealant obtained by adopting the tin-containing catalyst has the advantages of high curing speed, good mechanical property, strong adhesive force and long storage period.

title_en: Security feature, value document and printing pigment
abstract_en: A security feature for protecting a document of value, wherein the security feature is formed on the basis of a luminescent material which has a different excitation behavior in pure form than when applied in diluted form to the document of value, wherein the luminescent material is based on an inorganic host lattice doped with Mn (V) as a luminophore, the amount fraction of substances in the luminescent material being less than 2%, and the host lattice of the luminescent material is selected from apatite of the type a  5 (PO 4 ) 3  Z, fluorapatite of the type a  2 PO 4  Z and phosphates of the type a  3 (PO 4 ) 2 , wherein a = Ca, sr, ba and mixtures thereof and Z = F, cl, OH and mixtures thereof.

title_en: Electron donor-acceptor type benzothiadiazole liquid luminescent material, preparation method thereof and piezochromic application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electron donor-acceptor type benzothiadiazole liquid luminescent material, a preparation method and a piezochromic application thereof, wherein the liquid luminescent material is a single component compound with the following structural formula, wherein an N, N-diphenyl naphthalene-1-amine group is used as an electron donor, the benzothiadiazole group is used as an electron acceptor, the electron donor-acceptor endows the benzothiadiazole group with a narrower excited state-ground state energy gap, the Stokes displacement is greatly expanded, the self-absorption problem is avoided, meanwhile, a tetraethylene glycol chain space isolates the benzothiadiazole unit, pi-pi accumulation among conjugated molecules is blocked, and aggregation-induced quenching and photo-bleaching problems of condensed phase fluorescent groups are inhibited. The luminescent material is oily, emits light in bright red, is extremely sensitive to hydrostatic pressure, has the characteristics of reversible piezochromic property, printing, integration and the like due to the liquid property, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, mild reaction condition and great application potential.

title_en: UV adhesive composition, decorative film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a UV adhesive composition, a decorative film and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of UV adhesives. The UV adhesive composition comprises, by weight, 30-50 parts of polyurethane acrylate prepolymer, 40-60 parts of functional monomers, 2-5 parts of photoinitiators and 5-8 parts of coupling agents, wherein the functional monomers comprise at least three compounds of isobornyl acrylate, tetrahydrofuranyl acrylate, 2-hydroxybutyl acrylate, 4-hydroxybutyl acrylate and hydroxyethyl acrylate. According to the application, the UV adhesive composition and the component amounts are optimized, so that the high-strength bonding of PET, PP, PVC and other decorative film materials can be realized without pre-coating treatment, and the UV adhesive has excellent wet heat resistance and wide application prospect.

title_en: Coating composition and preparation method thereof, isolating film, electrode plate, battery monomer and battery device
abstract_en: The application discloses a coating composition and a preparation method thereof, an isolating film, an electrode plate, a battery monomer and a battery device. The coating composition comprises inorganic particle powder, wherein the inorganic particle powder is spherical primary particles and is dispersed in the coating composition, the inorganic particle powder comprises one or more of bismuth oxide powder and lead oxide powder, and the specific surface area of the inorganic particle powder is 8-10 m  2 /g. According to the embodiment of the application, the coating composition is used for the electrode assembly, so that the risk of deterioration of the electrode assembly and the electrolyte by rays can be reduced, and the stability of the battery cell is improved.

title_en: Anticorrosive paint composition, anticorrosive paint, preparation method of anticorrosive paint composition and coating
abstract_en: The invention provides an anticorrosive paint composition, an anticorrosive paint, a preparation method and a coating thereof, wherein the anticorrosive paint composition comprises thermosetting resin, a curing agent and modified waste wind power blade powder, the addition amount of the modified waste wind power blade powder is 10% -30% based on the total mass of the thermosetting resin and the curing agent, and the anticorrosive paint is obtained by mixing the anticorrosive paint composition, a solvent and an auxiliary agent. The method comprises the steps of (1) adding a solvent, a dispersing agent, a defoaming agent and thermosetting resin into a stirring kettle, dispersing to form a mixed solution Y-1, (2) adding modified waste wind power blade powder into the mixed solution Y-1 to form a mixed solution Y-2, and (3) adding a curing agent and a rheological additive into the mixed solution Y-2 to obtain the anti-corrosion coating. The invention provides an anticorrosive coating formed by the anticorrosive coating. According to the anti-corrosion coating composition, the wind power blade is subjected to alkali treatment and silane treatment, so that the compatibility of wind power blade powder and resin is improved, and the corrosiveness of a coating is improved.

title_en: High-stability composite additive of M100 green methanol fuel for vehicles and ships and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of clean energy additives, in particular to a high-stability composite additive of M100 green methanol fuel for vehicles and ships, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite additive comprises tetrahydrodicyclopentadiene or decalin; xylene; C12-C16 isoparaffins; triethanolamine oleate; ethylene glycol dimer acid ester; benzotriazole; isooctyl nitrate; dimethyl carbonate; nano cerium oxide; a terminal polyetheramine; 2, 6-di-tert-butyl-p-cresol; octyl butyl diphenylamine; triethylhydroxylamine; propylene glycol methyl ether; isobutanol; an ether modifier; polyethylene glycol dimethyl ether; sorbitan monostearate; an alkylate; the composite additive has the advantages of green high heat value, good stability, vehicle satisfaction and high temperature stability at the temperature of 60 ℃ and is ensured by a ship, and the cold start is carried out at the temperature of 25 ℃.

title_en: Flexible perovskite fluorescent pattern and ink-jet printing preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible perovskite fluorescent pattern, an ink-jet printing preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of flexible fluorescence. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing perovskite precursor ink containing a polyamide additive, dissolving perovskite precursor and polyamide in a solvent, uniformly mixing and filtering to obtain perovskite precursor ink, preparing a high-molecular polymer substrate, dissolving polyvinylpyrrolidone in isopropanol to prepare a solution with the concentration of 50-150 mg/mL, stirring, dissolving and filtering, forming the high-molecular polymer substrate on a transparent flexible film in a spin coating mode, printing the perovskite precursor ink into a preset pattern on the high-molecular polymer substrate by adopting an ink jet printing technology, synchronously depositing the polyamide and the perovskite precursor in the printing process, and performing low-temperature drying treatment on the printed pattern to obtain the flexible perovskite fluorescent pattern. The flexible perovskite fluorescent pattern prepared by the invention has high luminous intensity and good stability.

title_en: Soil biological regulator capable of rapidly improving earthworm proliferation rate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil biological regulator for rapidly improving the proliferation rate of earthworms, which consists of a compound microbial agent, a functional enzyme preparation and a humic acid carrier containing calcium alginate, wherein the compound microbial agent comprises bacillus amyloliquefaciens (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens), azotobacter chroococcus (Azotobacter chroococcum) and saccharomyces cerevisiae (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), and the functional enzyme preparation comprises cellulase and chitinase. The modifier can simulate and strengthen the natural soil ecological process by constructing a ternary synergistic system consisting of the composite microbial agent, the functional enzyme preparation and the humic acid carrier containing calcium alginate, and realize the whole-course efficient regulation and control on earthworm nutrition supply and environment improvement.

title_en: Novel emulsification process of self-repairing polyurethane coating base material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel emulsification process of a self-repairing polyurethane coating substrate, which belongs to the technical field of emulsification processes and comprises the following steps of reacting polyol and diisocyanate under anhydrous conditions to obtain an isocyanate-terminated polyurethane prepolymer, introducing a reversible bond precursor group Xpr in a protection state and a protonatable amine group Y into a molecular chain of the prepolymer, controlling the temperature of the prepolymer to be 40-80 ℃ and controlling the mass fraction of free isocyanate matrix to be 1.0-6.0%, and introducing a switchable hydrophilization self-emulsifying mechanism triggered by carbon dioxide in an emulsification stage and implementing degassing and inverse switching after emulsification, so that the polyurethane prepolymer containing a self-repairing structure can still stably form an aqueous emulsion with controllable particle size and stable long-term storage under the condition of not depending on an external small molecular surfactant, thereby solving the problems of narrow emulsification window and easiness in polymerization layering of the existing self-repairing aqueous polyurethane system.

title_en: Preparation method and application of core-shell structured composite abrasive with magnetic core
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a core-shell structured composite abrasive with a magnetic core, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing technology and ultra-precision machining, comprising the following steps of S1, weighing FeCl  3 ·6H 2  O and FeCl  2 ·4H 2  O, adding deionized water and ammonia water for reaction, magnetically separating, washing and drying; S2, ultrasonically dispersing the product obtained in the step S1, adding ethyl silicate and ammonia water for reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying, S3, dispersing the product obtained in the step S2 in deionized water, adding nano metal oxide for reaction, centrifuging, washing and calcining, S4, dispersing the product obtained in the step S3 in absolute ethyl alcohol, adding KH550 and a high-molecular polymer for reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain the abrasive. The invention provides a compound abrasive, which can be stably recycled for 8-10 times, the single use cost is only 15-20% of that of the traditional abrasive, and the process cost is reduced by more than 60%.

title_en: Organometallic compound, organic light-emitting device including the same, and electronic apparatus including the organic light-emitting device
abstract_en: Provided are an organometallic compound represented by formula 1, wherein in formula 1 Ln  1  is a ligand represented by formula 1A, ln  2  is a ligand represented by formula 1B, n1 is 1 or 2, and n2 is 1 or 2, wherein other groups and variables are as described herein, an organic light emitting device comprising the organometallic compound, and an electronic apparatus comprising the organic light emitting device.

title_en: Pyrolysis online detection regulation and control system and method based on high-temperature in-situ Raman spectrum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pyrolysis process online detection and control, and particularly relates to a pyrolysis online detection and control system and method based on a high-temperature in-situ Raman spectrum. The method comprises a high-temperature in-situ pyrolysis reactor, an in-situ Raman acquisition module, a product detection module, a data processing and machine learning module and an optimization and feedback control module, wherein the detection system is compatible with a high-temperature environment in the pyrolysis process of the carbon-based solid fuel, so that in-situ detection of intermediate products or solid-phase residues formed in the pyrolysis process of the carbon-based solid fuel raw materials is realized, further, a pyrolysis process product prediction model is established by utilizing machine learning, a pyrolysis product optimization objective function is established by taking the pyrolysis product prediction model as an evaluation function, an optimal pyrolysis condition and a raw material proportioning scheme are obtained by solving, and then the pyrolysis process is accurately regulated and controlled in real time according to the optimal pyrolysis condition and the optimal raw material proportioning scheme, so that the closed-loop on-line control of continuous detection, prediction, optimization and regulation is realized, and the efficient directional generation of the target product is realized.

title_en: Ceramic fracturing propping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil and gas fracturing propping agent processing, and particularly relates to a ceramic fracturing propping agent and a preparation method thereof. The ceramic fracturing propping agent comprises, by weight, 100-110 parts of low-grade bauxite, 6-12 parts of aluminum ash, 2-5 parts of dolomite, 5-10 parts of FCC spent catalyst and 2-5 parts of Tm  2 O 3 , wherein the mass ratio of the FCC spent catalyst to the dolomite is less than or equal to 3. According to the invention, low-grade bauxite is adopted as a main raw material, a certain amount of aluminum ash and dolomite are added, meanwhile, the FCC waste catalyst and the rare earth oxide Tm  2 O 3  can play a role of component complementation, the sintering temperature is reduced, solid waste materials such as low-grade bauxite and FCC waste catalyst can be effectively utilized through the mutual coordination of the raw materials, the double solid waste utilization is realized, the stacking risk of solid waste is reduced, and the ceramic fracturing propping agent with high compressive strength and good stability is obtained.

title_en: Liquid hollow nano acidic silicon fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid hollow nano-acid silicon fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of agricultural fertilizers, and the liquid hollow nano-acid silicon fertilizer is prepared by taking alkaline silicon as a silicon source through core procedures of enzymolysis catalysis of phytic acid, directional pore forming by acidification, synergistic integration of nutrient elements and the like, wherein the content of each liter of silicon in a finished product is more than or equal to 169g, and the liquid hollow nano-acid silicon fertilizer is rich in phytase, plant source small molecular peptide and various nutrient components of silicon, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium.

title_en: Zn (II) -Tb (III) complex ratio fluorescence sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coordination chemistry and analytical sensing, and particularly relates to a Zn (II) -Tb (III) complex ratio fluorescence sensor, and a preparation method and application thereof. The sensor is a bimetallic coordination polymer formed by coordination of Zn (II) ions, tb (III) ions, nitrogen-containing organic ligands and carboxylic acid organic ligands. Under excitation conditions, the ligand simultaneously generates an emission signal generated by coordination of Zn (II) and a characteristic emission signal of Tb (III) ions, so that intrinsic double emission is formed. By monitoring the fluorescence intensity ratio (I395/I549) of the two characteristic emission peaks of 395 nm and 549 nm, the ratio fluorescence detection of propyl gallate can be realized, and the detection limit is as low as 0.35 mu M. The sensor has the advantages of simple synthesis method, rapid detection process, realization of internal calibration by using the ratio signal, strong anti-interference capability, and suitability for detecting propyl gallate in actual samples such as edible oil.

title_en: Efficient energy-saving ship segmented shell outfitting and coating integrated process
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ship anti-corrosion coating, and discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving ship segmented shell outfitting and coating integrated process, which comprises the steps of preparing a component A containing raw materials such as bisphenol A epoxy resin and the like; the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic hydrogen bond end capping on phenolic hydroxyl groups of cashew nut shell oil modified phenolic amine by using acetylacetone, adding ketimine, polyamide wax micropowder and the like to prepare a component B, adding the two components into a high-pressure airless sprayer for mixing, maintaining the working pressure of a pipeline to be 15.0-20.0 MPa, heating the mixed paint to 43-47 ℃ through an inline heater, spraying out the mixed paint, initiating adiabatic expansion by using pressure drop, promoting the acetylacetone to flash vaporization to unseal catalytic sites, and absorbing latent heat to reconstruct a thixotropic network. The application solves the problems of slow crosslinking and curing, easy water absorption and whitening of a paint film and easy gel blocking of a mixed paint in a pipeline of spraying equipment in a low-temperature high-humidity environment, and realizes the combination of long in-equipment pot life and quick shaping, curing and film forming on the surface of a substrate.

title_en: Low-odor flexographic printing ink for breathable film and preparation method thereof
