abstract_en: The invention discloses low-odor flexographic printing ink for a breathable film and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of water-based flexographic printing ink, and aims to solve the technical problems that the existing flexographic printing ink for the breathable film is heavy in odor, high in VOC (volatile organic compound) emission, serious in air permeability damage, poor in adhesion to PE (polyethylene) base materials, insufficient in wear resistance and storage stability, and incapable of synergistically improving multiple performances. The ink takes the core-shell structure water-based acrylate composite emulsion as a core film-forming main body, is matched with components such as composite pigment, low-odor film-forming auxiliary agent, composite dispersing agent and the like to optimize the proportion, and is matched with the preparation process of pre-dispersing, grinding, paint mixing and filtering deaeration. The obtained printing ink can cooperatively realize the flexible printing requirements of PE breathable films in the fields of sanitary articles, medical protection, food packaging and the like, wherein the PE breathable films have low odor, low VOC, high air permeability retention, strong adhesion, high wear resistance and high storage stability.

title_en: Composite biological pond cleaning agent containing tea saponin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological agents for aquaculture, and discloses a composite biological pond cleaning agent containing tea saponin and a preparation method thereof. The composite biological pond cleaning agent comprises, by weight, 3-10 parts of tea saponin, 60-70 parts of yu teng root powder, 10-20 parts of buddleia, 5-10 parts of composite microbial powder, 3-8 parts of an auxiliary agent and 10-20 parts of a carrier, wherein the auxiliary agent is a mixture of sodium lignin sulfonate and sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, the composite microbial powder is formed by mixing bacillus subtilis and photosynthetic bacteria, and the carrier is diatomite. The invention combines three natural active ingredients of tea saponin, derris root powder and buddleia, combines proper auxiliary agents and carriers, can enlarge the pond cleaning range, has good killing or inhibiting effects on enemy organisms such as wild fishes, shrimps, crabs and snails and various pathogens, has thorough pond cleaning, is easy to degrade raw materials, has no residue, is ecological and environment-friendly, has long lasting period, and has important significance for promoting the green sustainable development of aquaculture.

title_en: Bamboo charcoal making equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of charcoal making equipment, and discloses bamboo charcoal making equipment, which comprises a first supporting leg and a second supporting leg, wherein a side supporting component is fixedly arranged on the first supporting leg, the bamboo charcoal making equipment can support a furnace body and support subsequent rotation operation by respectively arranging the side supporting component and the second supporting disc on two sides of the furnace body, a conduction component is arranged in the furnace body on one side where the side supporting component is arranged, and when the furnace body is driven to rotate under the action of an external driving motor, the conduction component can drive the structure on the side supporting component to rotate, so that the center component and the furnace body can rotate in opposite directions, and the center component and the furnace body are respectively provided with a first spiral blade and a second spiral blade, so that the mixing effect of high-temperature steam and raw materials is improved to the greatest extent by opposite rotation.

title_en: Filter material of fuel filter and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel filter material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite filter materials. The fuel filter material comprises a first filter layer, a second filter layer and a third filter layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the raw material components of the first filter layer comprise polybutylene terephthalate and a conductive agent, the raw material components of the second filter layer comprise glass fibers, polybutylene terephthalate fibers, conductive fibers and auxiliary fibers, and the raw material components of the third filter layer comprise polybutylene terephthalate and an antibacterial agent. The filter material for the fuel filter provided by the invention can solve the technical problems of poor acid corrosion resistance, low oil-water separation efficiency, insufficient filtering precision, easiness in static accumulation, easiness in microorganism breeding and short service life of the filter material for biodiesel in the related technology.

title_en: Dual-mode colorimetric-fluorescent method for detecting cyanide ions and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dual-mode colorimetric-fluorescent probe for detecting cyanide ions, which uses a compound 1- (4- (1, 2-triphenylvinyl) phenyl) -1H-pyrrole-2, 5-dione (TPE-M) as a probe molecule, can be detected by a colorimetric method by observing color change through naked eyes or detecting ultraviolet-visible absorption spectrum through an instrument after reacting with the cyanide ions in a sample to be detected, and can also be detected by fluorescence. The method can be used for qualitative and quantitative analysis, is simple and convenient to operate, is suitable for various detection environments in a broad spectrum, has the advantages of rapid detection, good selectivity, high sensitivity and dual-mode mutual authentication, breaks through the bottleneck of complex operation, high degree of specialization, high cost and single-mode detection in the prior art, and helps to realize the upgrading of the technology of the cyanide ion detection industry.

title_en: High-performance sealant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance sealant and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of sealants, wherein 10-20 parts of diisononyl phthalate is added into 100 parts of hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene for stirring, 60-90 parts of filler is added for stirring, and 18-43 parts of composite functional auxiliary agent is added for stirring to obtain a premix base material; adding 15-25 parts of polymethylene polyphenyl polyisocyanate and 4-8 parts of silane coupling agent, adding 0.1-0.3 part of composite catalyst, adding ultraviolet absorbent and antioxidant, stirring to obtain a catalytic modified mixture, and carrying out vacuum defoaming and curing to obtain the high-performance sealant. The high-performance sealant prepared by the invention can improve flexibility and displacement resistance, obviously improves elongation at break, has a displacement capacity grade of 20, can flexibly adapt to slight deformation of a building structure caused by temperature fluctuation, foundation settlement and the like, avoids cracking and falling phenomena, and keeps good fireproof sealing performance for a long time.

title_en: Preparation method of imidazoline corrosion inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation of an oilfield chemical corrosion inhibitor, in particular to a preparation method of an oleic acid imidazoline corrosion inhibitor. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out amidation reaction on organic acid and organic amine in a specific proportion for 2-4 hours at the normal pressure of 140-160 ℃, heating to 200-220 ℃, carrying out cyclization reaction for 2-4 hours under a specific vacuum condition or under the condition of blowing inert gas to obtain an imidazoline intermediate, and S2, carrying out reaction on the intermediate obtained in the S1 and a quaternization reagent epichlorohydrin to obtain the imidazoline quaternary ammonium salt corrosion inhibitor. The preparation method has the advantages of low reaction temperature, short reaction time, no need of adding water carrying agent and other solvents, reduced production cost, green and economic applicability to industrial production, good slow release effect of the prepared corrosion inhibitor, low toxicity and no pungent smell.

title_en: Superhard cerium-based rare earth polishing powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses superhard cerium-based rare earth polishing powder and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of rare earth polishing powder. The preparation method of the superhard cerium-based rare earth polishing powder provided by the invention has the advantages that the proportion of lanthanum and cerium ions in a rare earth solution is accurately controlled, and an oxidant is added to regulate and control the valence state of cerium, so that the chemical activity in the polishing process is enhanced, the coprecipitation of a phosphorus-and fluorine-containing precipitant under a specific pH condition is further utilized, the component height uniformity and regular morphology of a precursor on a microscopic scale are realized, the stable growth of crystals is promoted through ageing, a compact oxide crystal structure is generated through firing, and finally the superhard cerium-based rare earth polishing powder is obtained through mechanical grinding. The preparation method of the invention synergistically optimizes the chemical components, crystal structures and physical forms of the polishing powder, thereby realizing the remarkable improvement of the cutting efficiency of the high-hardness glass material (the abrasion degree is lower than 70).

title_en: Fattening synergistic deicing and snow-melting agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of snow-melting agents. The invention provides a fattening synergistic deicing and snow-melting agent which comprises, by weight, 10-30 parts of urea, 1-10 parts of potassium acetate, 20-30 parts of 1, 3-propanediol, 10-50 parts of ethylene glycol, 1-10 parts of triethanolamine and 1-10 parts of monopotassium phosphate. The deicing and snow-melting agent prepared by the invention has the effects of high deicing and ice-melting efficiency, environmental protection, low corrosion, degradability, fattening and synergy and the like, can release plant nutrient components while melting snow, and realizes dual functions of snow melting and soil improvement.

title_en: Long wavelength photoinitiator, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel cationic sulfonium salt photoinitiator, a preparation method and application thereof. The photoinitiator has a structure shown in the following formula (I). The sulfonium salt photoinitiator provided by the invention can be used for curing long-wavelength UV-LED light sources, has lower mobility and better absorption to long-wavelength light sources, and solves the problem of long-wavelength light source adaptation of the conventional photoinitiator UV-LED light sources.

title_en: Sugar-modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of organosilicon modified glycoside, and a sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier prepared by using the product and application thereof. The preparation method of the organosilicon modified glycoside comprises the steps of firstly, reacting a ketone compound with a saccharide compound under an acid catalyst to prepare a reaction system containing a saccharide intermediate, then adding a glycidyl ether compound containing a carbon-carbon double bond into the reaction system containing the saccharide intermediate to prepare an alkyl glycoside, and then, reacting the alkyl glycoside with hydrogen-containing siloxane to prepare the organosilicon modified glycoside. The organosilicon modified glycoside is dispersed in cyclomethicone, dimethicone or isododecane to obtain the sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier. According to the preparation method, hydroxyl on sugar is protected, self-polycondensation of the sugar in the preparation process of alkyl glycoside is reduced, meanwhile, glycidyl ether compound containing epoxy groups and sugar intermediate are adopted to prepare the alkyl glycoside, water generated in the preparation of the alkyl glycoside is consumed, normal operation of reaction is promoted, and the sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier prepared by the preparation method has good emulsion stability.

title_en: Solid waste pyrolysis furnace and solid waste pyrolysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid waste pyrolysis furnace and a solid waste pyrolysis system, which relate to the technical field of solid waste treatment, wherein the pyrolysis furnace is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, the feed inlet is used for introducing solid waste to be treated, and the discharge outlet is used for discharging a high-valued product with reuse value, which is obtained by pyrolysis reaction conversion after pyrolysis; the feeding port and the discharging port are both provided with flexible connecting pieces, and the feeding port and the discharging port are both used for being connected with the feeding part and the discharging part respectively through the flexible connecting pieces. The solid waste pyrolysis furnace and the solid waste pyrolysis system provided by the invention can prolong the service life of the pyrolysis system, can efficiently separate and convert resin and glass fibers in solid waste materials such as retired wind power blades, waste glass fiber reinforced plastics and the like through the pyrolysis system, directionally produce pyrolysis oil, synthesis gas and reusable glass fiber materials, and realize closed-loop recycling of waste resources.

title_en: Polyimide negative electrode binder capable of self-catalyzing at low temperature, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-temperature autocatalytic polyimide negative electrode binder, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the binder is prepared from binary anhydride, diamine containing pyridine groups and a blocking agent through low-temperature polycondensation, blocking and imidization under a specific molar ratio, the binder can realize low-temperature autocatalytic imidization at 185 ℃ under the base catalysis of the pyridine groups in a molecular chain, the energy consumption and the process complexity can be obviously reduced without additional catalysts or high-temperature treatment, the abundant aromatic rings in the molecular structure of the binder can endow the material with excellent mechanical strength and elastic buffer capacity, the volume expansion in the process of embedding/removing lithium of a silicon-based negative electrode can be effectively inhibited, meanwhile, the pyridine groups can form firm hydrogen bonds with the surface of the silicon-based material, the bonding strength of the binder is more than or equal to 15 MPa, the ion conduction performance is synergistically improved, and the cycle life and the interface stability of a battery are also obviously improved.

title_en: All-inorganic perovskite film with high fluorescence quantum yield, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-inorganic perovskite film with high fluorescence quantum yield, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lead-free perovskite photoelectric devices. The preparation method of the film comprises the following steps of dissolving tin dibromide and cesium bromide in an organic solvent to obtain a precursor solution, adding N- (diphenylphosphoryl) -P, P-diphenylphosphinamide, coating the obtained perovskite precursor solution on a substrate, and then annealing to obtain the full-inorganic perovskite film with high fluorescence quantum yield, wherein the full-inorganic perovskite film is CsSnBr  3  perovskite film. The CsSnBr  3  perovskite film prepared by the preparation method has higher fluorescence quantum yield and improves film coverage rate. The CsSnBr  3  perovskite film with high fluorescence quantum yield prepared by the invention can be applied to the fields of perovskite light-emitting devices, perovskite solar cells, perovskite photodetectors and the like.

title_en: Green low-carbon municipal sludge classified collection treatment method
abstract_en: A green low-carbon municipal sludge classifying and collecting treatment method comprises the steps of 1, classifying and collecting municipal sludge according to components and sources, temporarily storing the municipal sludge in a closed container, pasting labels containing parameters such as sludge sources, components, physicochemical properties and the like to obtain grit chamber sludge, primary sedimentation tank sludge, secondary sedimentation tank sludge and materialized treatment tank sludge, 2, screening the grit chamber sludge, treating oversize products as construction waste, press-filtering undersize products, sending filter cakes into brick making machines or as backfill soil for use, sending filtrate into a sewage treatment unit for treatment, 3, mixing, tempering and dehydrating the primary sedimentation tank sludge and the secondary sedimentation tank sludge, sending the primary sedimentation tank sludge into a fermentation system for anaerobic or aerobic fermentation to obtain fermentation clinker, and then using the fermentation clinker as an organic fertilizer or adding different nutrients for mixed granulation to prepare compound fertilizer products. The invention can effectively solve the problems of high treatment difficulty and high cost of the mixed sludge of the current sewage treatment plant, and realize the recycling utilization of the sludge.

title_en: Controlled-release nitrogen-doped fertilizer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a controlled-release nitrogen-doped fertilizer, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of organic fertilizers. The nitrogen-release-controlled nitrogen-doped fertilizer comprises a nitrogen fertilizer, a phosphate fertilizer, a potash fertilizer, a medium trace element fertilizer and a microbial agent, wherein the nitrogen fertilizer is of a multi-layer wrapped core-shell structure and sequentially comprises a urea core layer, a first wrapping layer, an intermediate urea interlayer, a second wrapping layer and a urea outer layer. The nitrogen fertilizer structure can realize three-stage gradient release of nitrogen, matches the nitrogen requirement law of crops in the whole growth period, and the microbial agent consists of bacillus subtilis and trichoderma harzianum and has the synergistic effects of promoting growth, preventing diseases and activating soil nutrients. The fertilizer disclosed by the invention is suitable for field crops such as corn, wheat, rice and the like, can obviously improve the nitrogen utilization rate, the crop yield and the crop quality by one-time basal application, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Interconnected coal pyrolysis system of coal-fired power plant and interconnected coal pyrolysis method of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal-fired power plant interconnected coal pyrolysis system and a coal-fired power plant interconnected coal pyrolysis method. The interconnected coal pyrolysis system of the coal-fired power plant comprises a coal-fired boiler unit, a coal pyrolysis unit, a flue gas-nitrogen heat exchanger, a nitrogen generator and an emission system. The coal-fired boiler unit comprises a coal-fired boiler, and a flue gas port is arranged on the coal-fired boiler. The coal pyrolysis unit comprises a pyrolysis industrial kiln and a grading cooling separation system, the pyrolysis industrial kiln comprises a pyrolysis raw material inlet, a nitrogen inlet and a volatile component outlet, the volatile component outlet is connected with the grading cooling separation system, a flue gas heat exchange runner and a nitrogen heat exchange runner which exchange heat mutually are arranged in a flue gas-nitrogen heat exchanger, the flue gas heat exchange runner is communicated with a first inlet and a first outlet, the nitrogen heat exchange runner is communicated with a second inlet and a second outlet, the first inlet is connected with a flue gas inlet, and the second outlet is connected with a nitrogen inlet. According to the interconnected coal pyrolysis system of the coal-fired power plant, the quality improvement and utilization of coal are realized, and the energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Municipal sludge pure physical separation purification and valuable substance extraction treatment process
abstract_en: The invention discloses municipal domestic sludge and similar solid waste pure physical closed ultra-long standing groups, and belongs to the technical field of solid waste recycling and environmental protection. The invention has no chemical agent addition, high-temperature incineration or mechanical disturbance in the whole process, is suitable for municipal sludge, natural bottom sludge of river and lake, solid waste deposited by livestock and poultry manure and sludge deposited by urban pipe networks, and realizes the up-and-down layered enrichment of the solid waste by utilizing the natural physical laws of colloid static agglomeration and integral dead weight gravity sedimentation. The invention is matched with a clean water pure physical spraying odor locking and micro-positive pressure unidirectional airflow anti-overflow structure, thoroughly eliminates chemical pollution and odor diffusion, and simultaneously carries a full-automatic unmanned mechanical regulation system to optimize the enrichment environment in a steady state, greatly improve the treatment efficiency and save the labor cost. The process is divided into two-stage closed-loop treatment, firstly removing the heavy metal core pollution source with the greatest harm, then preparing the residual organic matters into organic fertilizer, avoiding newly increasing pollution in the whole process and avoiding leakage of pollutants, solving the problems of large pollution, resource waste, low efficiency of the traditional standing process, narrow application range and industrial pain caused by residual pollution of chemical treatment in the traditional incineration process, being low-carbon, environment-friendly, safe and stable, being capable of being popularized on a large scale and realizing the bidirectional recycling and high-efficiency utilization of various deposited solid wastes.

title_en: Composite coating with rust conversion and active corrosion prevention functions and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite coating with rust conversion and active corrosion prevention functions, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of coating corrosion prevention. The composite coating with the rust conversion and active corrosion prevention functions comprises, by mass, 0.1% -0.35% of corrosion inhibition components, 2.5% -4% of tannic acid, 15% -25% of phosphoric acid, 0.5% -2% of Texanol, 1% -5% of diethylene glycol monomethyl ether, 0.1% -0.3% of wetting agent and the balance of polyvinylidene chloride and acrylic acid copolymer emulsion, wherein the corrosion inhibition components are composite corrosion inhibitors obtained by modifying Ti  3 C 2 T x  MXene through a silane coupling agent and then inserting L-histidine. The composite coating has triple functions of rust layer conversion, barrier protection and active corrosion prevention, avoids the problem that the rust conversion agent excessively corrodes a substrate, and does not need to be coated with other coatings.

title_en: Low-temperature fast-curing wave-absorbing coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surface engineering, in particular to a low-temperature rapid-curing wave-absorbing coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the wave-absorbing coating comprises, by mass, 20-80% of a wave-absorbing agent, 20-80% of epoxy resin, 10-50% of a diluent and 2-7% of epoxy resin modified polythiol. The preparation method of the wave-absorbing coating comprises the steps of mixing a wave-absorbing agent, epoxy resin and a diluent with a set mass ratio to obtain mixed slurry, mixing pentaerythritol, thioglycollic acid, paratoluenesulfonic acid and toluene, carrying out esterification reaction, mixing polythiol generated by the reaction with bisphenol A type epoxy resin to obtain epoxy resin modified polythiol, mixing the epoxy resin modified polythiol with the mixed slurry to obtain the wave-absorbing coating, spraying the wave-absorbing coating on a substrate, and curing to obtain the wave-absorbing coating. The low-temperature fast-curing wave-absorbing coating and the preparation method thereof aim to solve the problems of slower curing speed and poorer environmental protection performance of the wave-absorbing coating at low temperature.

title_en: Continuous disinfectant supply system with temporary storage and intelligent scheduling functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous disinfectant supply system and method with temporary storage and intelligent scheduling functions. The system comprises a disinfectant stock solution preparation module, a disinfectant solution preparation module, a temporary storage bin and a first conveying module. After receiving the user instruction, the control unit firstly detects the residual quantity of the disinfection stock solution in the temporary storage bin and compares the residual quantity with the requirement, and accordingly, the intelligent decision is made whether to prepare the stock solution directly or firstly. Through the cooperation of three-way solenoid valve and circulating pump, the system can be with the stock solution in the electrolysis storehouse selectively transport to temporary storage storehouse safe storage or be used for the circulation stirring. The invention realizes independent anti-corrosion storage of the disinfection stock solution and intelligent scheduling management of the allowance, ensures long-term reliability of equipment, realizes rapid and continuous supply of the disinfection stock solution, and greatly improves user experience.

title_en: Optical laminate, optical laminate with polarizing film, image display device, and adhesive sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical laminate including a liquid crystal alignment fixing layer, which can inhibit generation of linear unevenness and reduce recess caused by local load. The present invention also provides an optical laminate with a polarizing film, which comprises such an optical laminate and a polarizing film. The present invention also provides an image display device including such an optical laminate. Further, the present invention provides an adhesive sheet preferably used for bonding of a liquid crystal alignment fixing layer. An optical laminate according to an embodiment of the present invention includes, in order, a 1 st liquid crystal orientation fixing layer, an adhesive sheet having a thickness of less than 20 [ mu ] m, an average refractive index of the adhesive sheet being n, an average refractive index of the 1 st liquid crystal orientation fixing layer being n1, and an average refractive index of the 2 nd liquid crystal orientation fixing layer being n2, wherein the largest average refractive index difference selected from the average refractive index difference calculated by |n-n1| and the average refractive index difference calculated by |n-n2| is less than 0.11, and the adhesive sheet has a press-in hardness at 25 ℃ of more than 0.019MPa.

title_en: Soil conditioner for recovering fertility of black land and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of soil amendments, in particular to a soil amendment for recovering the fertility of black land and a preparation method thereof. The soil conditioner for recovering the fertility of the black land comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 50-70 parts of a composite organic matrix, 4-10 parts of a nutrient chelating synergist and 8-15 parts of a humic acid derivative. The preparation method of the soil conditioner for recovering the fertility of the black land comprises the steps of putting the composite organic matrix and the nutrient chelating synergist into a mixer, stirring, adding the humic acid derivative, and uniformly mixing to obtain the soil conditioner for recovering the fertility of the black land. The soil conditioner has obvious beneficial effects on the recovery of the fertility of the black land, the pH value of the soil after the improvement is obviously improved, the problem of acid degradation can be effectively improved, the soil capacity is reduced, the total void ratio is improved, the soil porosity is optimized, the growth of the root system of crops is facilitated, and the fertility of the black land can be effectively recovered.

title_en: Method for preparing high-activity bio-organic fertilizer based on multi-flora ecological fermentation bed padding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high-activity bio-organic fertilizer based on multi-flora ecological fermentation bed padding, and relates to the technical fields of livestock and poultry breeding manure reclamation and bio-organic fertilizer preparation. The invention takes a plurality of natural microorganism flora ecological fermentation bed culture aging padding as the only core raw material, and the ecological biological organic fertilizer with high living bacteria, high organic matters, balanced nutrition and long-acting slow release is prepared by carrying out secondary expansion culture by relying on the original natural compound flora through closed loop processes of raw material screening and sorting, physical tempering, microecological secondary enrichment fermentation, gradient high-temperature harmless decomposition, aging stability and fine granulation processing. The invention realizes the zero emission and full-scale recycling closed loop of the manure, the product accords with the NY/T525 organic fertilizer standard, and has the effects of improving soil, inhibiting bacteria and suppressing diseases, promoting root and seedling growth, preserving water and fertilizer, and the like, the recycling utilization rate is 100%, the process is simple, the environment is protected, and the industrialization value is high.

title_en: Ultralow-structure carbon black material with high dispersion stability and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultralow-structure carbon black material with high dispersion stability and application thereof. The material is prepared by reacting 3, 4-dihydroxyphenethylamine, a carbonyl coupling agent, N-dimethyl-1, 3-propane sultone and 1, 3-propane sultone to prepare a reactive low-melting microphase auxiliary agent, then compounding the auxiliary agent with urea and choline acetate, dispersing the auxiliary agent in ethylene tar, and carrying out incomplete combustion, quenching, elution and homologous stabilization treatment. The invention utilizes microphase isolation of the composite microphase auxiliary agent in the carbon black forming process to reduce branching degree of carbon black aggregates, and forms a stabilizing layer containing catechol/quinone anchoring structure and sulfobetaine structure through post treatment to improve water dispersion stability of carbon black. The obtained carbon black material has the advantages of low structure, low metal residue, narrow particle size distribution, good sedimentation resistance and the like, and can be used for water-based paint, water-based ink, water-based conductive slurry and water-based polymer composite material.

title_en: Water-based environment-friendly epoxy paint and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water-based paint, in particular to water-based environment-friendly epoxy paint and a preparation method thereof, wherein the water-based environment-friendly epoxy paint comprises, by weight, 100:15-30 parts of a component A and a component B, the component A comprises, by weight, 40-65 parts of a water-based epoxy resin emulsion, 10-20 parts of a modified core-shell structure acrylic ester copolymer, 3-8 parts of polyaniline modified zinc phosphate, 5-12 parts of a composite flame retardant, 0.5-2.0 parts of a wetting dispersant, 0.2-1.0 parts of a defoaming agent and 10-25 parts of deionized water, the component B comprises, by weight, 80-95 parts of a water-based epoxy curing agent and 5-15 parts of an adhesion promoter, and the water-based epoxy resin emulsion and the modified core-shell structure acrylic ester copolymer are compounded to form a compact crosslinked network, wherein vinyl triethoxysilane groups introduced by the core-shell copolymer can be subjected to hydrolytic condensation, so that the sealing property and the hydrophobicity of the coating are further improved.

title_en: Transparent flexible radiation refrigeration energy-saving film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent flexible radiation refrigeration energy-saving film which is of a multilayer composite film structure and sequentially comprises a weather-proof protective layer, a middle infrared emission layer, an infrared selective reflection layer, a substrate layer, an installation adhesive layer and a release film from outside to inside, wherein the film has high transmittance in a visible light wave band of 380-780nm, high reflectivity in a near infrared wave band of 780-2500nm and high emissivity in a middle-far infrared wave band of 8-13 mu m. The film disclosed by the invention realizes efficient integration of the triple functions of transparency, flexibility and radiation refrigeration, has high transmittance in a visible light wave band of 380-780nm, meets the lighting requirements of scenes such as building doors and windows, glass curtain walls, automobile glass and the like, realizes heat resistance through high reflectivity in a near infrared wave band of 780-2500nm, realizes passive radiation refrigeration through high emissivity in a middle-far infrared wave band of 8-13 mu m, not only resists heat, but also dissipates heat, and greatly improves the heat insulation and energy conservation effects.

title_en: Self-recovery near-infrared power-induced luminescent germanate material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-recovery near-infrared luminescent germanate material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of luminescent materials. The expression general formula of the self-recovery near infrared luminescent germanate material is Al  2(1‑x) GeO 5 :2xCr 3+ , wherein x=1-10%. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking aluminum hydroxide as an aluminum source precursor, weighing the aluminum hydroxide, germanium oxide and chromium oxide according to the molar ratio of elements in a chemical formula, mixing the weighed raw materials, grinding uniformly to obtain a mixture, and calcining the mixture at a high temperature to obtain the self-recovery near infrared power-induced luminescence germanate material. According to the invention, the solid phase reaction path is regulated and controlled by the high-activity precursor, and the obtained material can realize self-recovery near infrared forced luminescence without pre-irradiation treatment. The sensing film prepared by the material is expected to realize real-time visual monitoring of infrastructure cracks, quantitative imaging of stress concentration and quantitative evaluation of repair effect, and is convenient for industrialized mass production and application.

title_en: Lignin pyrolysis oil hydrodeoxygenation catalyst, preparation method and hydrodeoxygenation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lignin pyrolysis oil hydrodeoxygenation catalyst, a preparation method and a hydrodeoxygenation method, and relates to the technical field of synthesis, wherein the hydrodeoxygenation catalyst comprises a carrier, MO  x  and transition metal (x E (1, 2)) which are arranged on the carrier, wherein the MO  x  is 0.3-6% and the transition metal is 0.8-1.2% based on the hydrodeoxygenation catalyst and calculated by mass percentage, M comprises one or a combination of at least two of cerium, titanium or zirconium, and the transition metal comprises one or a combination of at least two of palladium, platinum or ruthenium. According to the hydrodeoxygenation catalyst provided by the invention, the composition ratio of the catalyst is optimized, so that the catalyst contains partially reduced oxidized M and transition metal to form an MO  x  -transition metal interface site structure, the aromatic selectivity and catalytic conversion effect of the catalyst on phenolic compounds are improved, and the efficient preparation of aromatic components in biological aviation kerosene is realized.

title_en: Valve casting based on precoated sand shell mold and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stainless steel, in particular to a valve casting based on a precoated sand shell mold and a processing technology thereof. According to the invention, the corrosion-resistant coating is obtained by adding the POSS modified silicon material, the POSS modified graphene material, the curing agent and the organic silicon resin. The wear-resistant coating is obtained by adding a POSS modified silicon material, a POSS modified graphene material, nickel silicate coated alumina, a curing agent and organic silicon resin. And (3) pouring the molten stainless steel casting raw material into the inner cavity of the precoated sand shell mold, cooling and separating to obtain the stainless steel valve casting, coating the surface of the stainless steel valve casting with the corrosion-resistant coating, then coating with the wear-resistant coating, and solidifying to obtain the finished product. The finished product prepared by the method has excellent corrosion resistance and wear resistance, so that the method has wide application prospect in the technical field of stainless steel.

title_en: Curable pressure-sensitive adhesive having high adhesive strength and good peel adhesion in cured state
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a curable pressure-sensitive adhesive comprising, based on the mass of the curable pressure-sensitive adhesive, a) one or more matrix (co) polymers selected from the group consisting of (co) polymers of vinyl esters, (co) polymers of vinyl alcohols, and (co) polyvinyl acetals that can be prepared from copolymers of vinyl alcohols by acetalization, in a combined mass fraction of 10% or more, b) one or more (meth) acrylate block copolymers in a combined mass fraction in the range of 5% to 35%, c) one or more polymerizable epoxy compounds, and d) one or more cationic initiators, the combined mass fraction of (meth) acrylate block copolymers and matrix (co) polymers being 25% or more, based on the mass of the curable pressure-sensitive adhesive.

title_en: Adhesive, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof. The adhesive consists of a component A, a component B and a component C, wherein the component A comprises 5-15 parts of multifunctional epoxy resin, 3-10 parts of bio-based modified epoxy resin, 0.5-2.5 parts of environment-friendly reactive diluent, 0.2-0.6 part of silane coupling agent, 0.6-2.4 parts of thixotropic agent, the component B comprises 2-6 parts of amine curing agent, 1.5-4 parts of bio-based phenolic amine curing agent, 0.5-2 parts of accelerator, 40-60 parts of high-strength high-modulus inert filler and 0.2-0.4 part of environment-friendly pigment, the component C comprises 10-30 parts of surface active filler, and A, B, C parts of independent package and are mixed according to the weight ratio of 1:3:1 for use during construction. The adhesive provided by the invention can realize the cooperative unification of the low-temperature construction performance and the normal-temperature high-strength performance, and can give consideration to the bonding performance, the rheological performance and the high-strength characteristic under the normal-temperature and low-temperature conditions.

title_en: Durable photo-thermal super-hydrophobic FT-CNT@EPP coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a durable photo-thermal super-hydrophobic FT-CNT@EPP coating, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the coating comprises the following steps: a continuous matrix and hybrid particles, wherein the hybrid particles are embedded in the continuous matrix, the continuous matrix is a double-network hydrophobic resin, and the hybrid particles are carbon fluoride nano tube-titanium dioxide hybrid particles. Through the scheme, the invention can effectively improve the mechanical durability and the photo-thermal conversion efficiency of the coating and improve the stability of different environments.

title_en: Polyaspartic acid preparation method of potassium acid
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of chemical fertilizers, in particular to a preparation method of potassium polyaspartate, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out catalytic reaction on L-aspartic acid in a water solvent system through a catalyst to obtain polysuccinimide, wherein the reaction temperature is 70-90 ℃, S2, adding potassium hydroxide to adjust the pH value to be not lower than 10, continuing full reaction, S3, filtering to remove the catalyst, S4, evaporating to remove the solvent, wherein the catalyst at least comprises gamma-alumina, and the mass ratio of the catalyst to the L-aspartic acid is 0.02-0.2:1. In the application, the catalyst can avoid the use of organic solvents, reduce the discharge and residue of phosphorus, and can be repeatedly used, thereby having better economic effect and environmental protection effect.

title_en: Blue light emission leadless perovskite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor devices, and discloses a blue light emission lead-free perovskite material, and a preparation method and application thereof. In addition, the surface defects are passivated by introducing aniline organic matters in the preparation process, the absolute quantum yield exceeding 90% is finally realized, and the fluorescence intensity is reduced by less than 5% after the Cs  2 NaIn 1‑x Sb x Cl 6  leadless perovskite is stored for 3 months under natural conditions. The biological toxicity of Na, in, sb and other elements is weaker than that of Pb, so that the high toxicity of the lead-based material is solved, and the luminous efficiency and the stability of the material are improved.

title_en: Anti-adhesion treatment method for paper printed matter based on bright film and matte oil combination
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of post-printing processing of paper printed matters, in particular to an anti-adhesion treatment method for paper printed matters based on a bright film and matte oil composite; the method comprises the steps of coating a polymer bright film, adding a polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane multifunctional anti-adhesion crosslinking agent to prepare modified matt oil, coating leveling and solidifying, wherein the method combines a rigid inner core with peripheral grafted acrylate double bond and a low surface energy chain segment to construct a coating network, the core is that the leveling treatment is utilized to enable the crosslinking agent to migrate towards an interface far away from the bright film, the low surface energy chain segment is self-assembled and anchored under ultraviolet light to form a molecular-level lubrication isolation layer, the scheme of adding a higher-component conventional physical anti-adhesion agent is abandoned, the problem of physical adhesion of post-printing stacking is solved by utilizing self-assembly and covalent bonding, and the adhesive force is enhanced, meanwhile, the whitening and the fogging of the coating are effectively prevented, and the color saturation is maintained.

title_en: Waterproof heat-resistant composite coating and application thereof in color printing packaging paper
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coatings, in particular to a waterproof heat-resistant composite coating and application thereof in color printing packaging paper, wherein the waterproof heat-resistant composite coating comprises, by mass, 50-65 parts of epoxy soybean oil acrylic ester, 15-25 parts of reactive diluent, 8-12 parts of bio-based adhesion promoter, 2-4 parts of free radical photoinitiator, 0.2-0.4 part of leveling agent, 0.2-0.4 part of polymerization inhibitor and 0.1-0.2 part of defoaming agent. According to the invention, the epoxy soybean oil acrylic ester is matched with the bio-based adhesion promoter constructed by itaconic acid and deacetylated glucopyranose units, so that the interfacial binding force between the coating and the paper substrate is obviously improved, the adhesion reaches 0 level, the Cobb value is reduced to 5.8-6.9 g/m  2 , the Kit value is initially 9-11, and the Kit value is still kept at 8-10 after heat treatment at 90 ℃ for 2 h.

title_en: Bacillus aromaticus TCX-17 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides bacillus aromaticum TCX-17 and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microorganisms, wherein the bacillus aromaticum TCX-17 is bacillus tequilensis (Bacillus tequilensis) and is preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) No.37237, and the strain has the advantages of high growth speed, strong environmental tolerance and excellent aroma-producing metabolism capability. When fermentation is carried out by using a culture medium containing tobacco powder, the strain can directionally generate typical flavor substances endowing tobacco with compound flavor, and the content of key flavor substances such as ketones, esters, heterocycles and the like is obviously improved. Meanwhile, the generated pyrazine substances endow the fermentation liquor with intense baking fragrance and nut fragrance. The tobacco flavor prepared by fermenting the waste tobacco powder by using the strain has the advantages of strong fragrance, rich layering, and flower fragrance, sweet fragrance, baking fragrance and nut fragrance. The cigarette additive can be applied to cigarettes, can obviously improve the quality and quantity of aroma, reduce miscellaneous gases and irritation, and improve aftertaste, thereby realizing comprehensive improvement of the quality of smoke.

title_en: Deep desulfurization process and deep desulfurization system for dry gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep desulfurization process for dry gas. The process comprises (1) removing hydrogen sulfide from refinery dry gas through a primary amine liquid absorption tower, (2) introducing primary amine liquid absorption tail gas into a low-temperature absorption tower for organic sulfur removal treatment, (3) sequentially exchanging heat between the absorption tail gas and raw material dry gas, exchanging heat between the absorption tail gas and hydrolysis tail gas, heating the absorption tail gas, introducing the absorption tail gas into a hydrolysis reactor for converting carbonyl sulfur into hydrogen sulfide, and (4) introducing the hydrolysis tail gas into a secondary amine liquid absorption tower, and carrying out countercurrent absorption with lean amine liquid in the tower for removing hydrogen sulfide in the dry gas. The invention can purify and remove sulfide in the dry gas, reduce the content of organic sulfur and hydrogen sulfide in the gas, reduce the content of SO  2  in flue gas discharged by heating furnaces of subsequent devices, and ensure the safe, environment-friendly, efficient and stable operation of the heating furnaces of the whole plant.

title_en: Disease-preventing growth-promoting microbial agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disease-preventing and growth-promoting microbial agent, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The microbial agent for preventing diseases and promoting growth comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 45-60 parts of a functional microbial agent, 5-10 parts of a protective agent, 1-3 parts of a dispersion stabilizer, 2-5 parts of a nutritional auxiliary agent and 100 parts of deionized water, wherein the functional microbial agent comprises trichoderma densefense, streptomyces golgi and geobacillus genuinensis. The three functional strains screened by the invention have broad-spectrum disease prevention, effectively prevent and treat three fungal diseases of powdery mildew, anthracnose and gray mold of strawberries, wherein the control effect on the gray mold disease of strawberries is the best, and the effect of promoting growth and increasing yield of strawberries is achieved.

title_en: Bacillus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microorganisms and application thereof, in particular to Bacillus and application thereof, and particularly relates to Bacillus sp, which is deposited in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) with the strain number of A75 and the deposit number of CCTCC NO: M2026849. According to the invention, bacillus substances and fermentation products thereof are applied to sweet potato blocks, so that the disease development of the sweet potato infected by black spot bacteria can be effectively inhibited, and a relatively ideal control effect can be achieved. And bacillus and fermentation products thereof are applied in wheat planting, so that seed germination of wheat can be effectively promoted, and an ideal growth promoting effect can be achieved.

title_en: Preparation method of nanoscale prometryn suspending agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pesticide preparations, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a nano-scale prometryn suspending agent. Aiming at the problems of uneven particle size distribution, poor storage stability and insufficient drug effect exertion of the traditional prometryn suspending agent, the invention prepares the core-shell structure composite dispersion stabilizer, mixes the core-shell structure composite dispersion stabilizer with prometryn raw material, auxiliary dispersing agent, wetting agent, thickening agent, antifreezing agent, preservative and defoaming agent, and prepares the nano-scale suspending agent through high-shear pre-dispersion and sanding processes. The composite dispersion stabilizer takes gas phase nano silicon dioxide modified by a silane coupling agent as a core, and grafts carboxylic acid main monomers and sulfonic acid functional comonomers to form a polymer shell. The composite dispersion stabilizer of the invention can fundamentally inhibit the desorption and the Orsate ripening of the dispersing agent because of the covalent bond fixation of the polymer chain, the prepared nano-scale prometryn suspending agent has uniform and fine particle size, is difficult to delaminate, agglomerate and settle in the storage process, has full efficacy and long lasting period, and meets the market demand.

title_en: High-weather-resistance scratch-resistant handfeel auxiliary agent and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high weather-resistant scratch-resistant handfeel auxiliary agent and a preparation process thereof, belonging to the technical field of coating auxiliary agents. The formula of the scratch-resistant handfeel auxiliary agent comprises, by weight, 10-20 parts of organosilicon modified acrylic resin, 3-5 parts of modified silicon dioxide, 2-3 parts of maleic anhydride grafted Fischer-Tropsch wax, 1-2 parts of light stabilizer, 0.5-0.7 part of light absorber, 0.2-0.4 part of polyether modified polysiloxane and 30-40 parts of propylene glycol methyl ether acetate. The hand feeling additive prepared by the formula and the preparation process has high weather resistance, scratch resistance and fine and smooth hand feeling.

title_en: Hematite coated organic alcohol phase change microcapsule for drilling fluid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hematite coated organic alcohol phase change microcapsule for drilling fluid and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of drilling fluid chemistry in petroleum industry. The preparation method of the phase-change microcapsule comprises the steps of (1) adding a phase-change core material into a silane coupling agent solution for reaction, standing for sedimentation, washing and drying to obtain a modified phase-change core material, (2) dissolving a hematite precursor into deionized water, adding a surfactant A, stirring uniformly to obtain a shell material precursor solution, (3) adding the modified phase-change core material obtained in the step (1) and urea into the deionized water, adding a surfactant B, stirring uniformly to obtain a suspension, adding the shell material precursor solution obtained in the step (2) into the suspension for reaction, and cooling, ageing, centrifuging, washing and drying after the reaction is completed to obtain the phase-change microcapsule. The phase-change microcapsule of the invention can be used for delaying the temperature rise of drilling fluid of a high-temperature deep well, an ultra-deep well and a geothermal well.

title_en: Composition for improving saline-alkali soil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural soil improvement, and particularly relates to a composition for improving saline-alkali soil and a preparation method thereof. The composition for improving the saline-alkali soil comprises, by weight, 30-45 parts of straw powder, 1-3 parts of microbial agents, 5-8 parts of film forming agents, 12-15 parts of humic acid, 5-10 parts of biochar gel microspheres and 15-20 parts of desulfurized gypsum. According to the saline-alkali soil improvement composition provided by the invention, the straw powder, the microbial agent, the film forming agent, the humic acid, the biochar gel microspheres and the desulfurized gypsum are mutually synergistic, so that the soil dispersion degree is improved, the soil hardening is relieved, the salt content of the soil is effectively reduced, and a new thought is provided for comprehensive treatment of the saline-alkali soil.

title_en: Anticorrosive coating applied to marinated fat sausage refrigeration and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-corrosion coating applied to marinated fat sausage refrigeration, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of coatings. The anti-corrosion coating provided by the application realizes functional adaptation of corrosion resistance, mildew resistance and condensation resistance, effectively solves the problems of metal corrosion, mold breeding and condensed water accumulation and dripping of the metal wall of the refrigeration house under the working condition of low temperature and high humidity, and solves the technical pain points of difficult low temperature and high humidity solidification, paint film embrittlement and mildew resistance loss of the traditional epoxy heavy anti-corrosion coating method, insufficient wet adhesion and limited condensation resistance of the polyurethane waterproof coating method.

title_en: Breathable elastic water-based paint and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breathable elastic water-based paint, a preparation method thereof and a use method thereof on living trees or ancient building wood members. The existing protective coating has the defects of compactness, air impermeability, poor elasticity, toxic auxiliary agent and the like, and can not simultaneously meet the requirements of tree ventilation, keep-alive, flexible adaptation growth and ecological safety. The water-based paint of the invention takes hydrophilic-hydrophobic block modified water-based polyurethane and water-based acrylic emulsion as film forming base materials to form a high-elasticity Interpenetrating Polymer Network (IPN), takes modified bark micro powder and diatomite micro powder as fillers, constructs through pore channels in the paint film, and forms a surface hydrophobic interface by matching with directional arrangement of hydrophobic chain segments to realize water blocking and ventilation. The paint film can synchronously stretch and contract along with the growth and deformation of the tree, and outdoor progressive degradation is realized through point weak adhesion and a porous structure. The preparation method adopts a pre-sealing and pore-forming double-insurance process, and effectively protects the filler pore canal from being invaded by resin. The water paint is ecological and nontoxic, and has double functions of long-acting protection and healthy growth of trees.

title_en: Salt-tolerant bacillus and application thereof in prevention and control of corn ear rot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salt-tolerant bacillus and application thereof in prevention and control of corn ear rot. The invention provides a salt-tolerant bacillus, namely salt-tolerant bacillus (Bacillus halotolerans) GZL67, with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: M2026827. The invention also provides a salt-tolerant bacillus GZL67 microbial agent. The invention also provides application of the salt-tolerant bacillus GZL67 or the salt-tolerant bacillus GZL67 microbial inoculum in inhibiting fusarium, reducing mycotoxin content in plants infected with fusarium, preventing and controlling plant diseases caused by the fusarium and preventing and controlling corn ear rot. The salt-tolerant bacillus GZL67 has ideal control effect on fusarium ear rot and mycotoxin pollution, and has good production and application values.

title_en: Precise filtering and deslagging equipment and method for corn crude oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise filtering and deslagging device and a precise filtering and deslagging method for corn crude oil, and relates to the technical field of corn crude oil processing. The series precise filtering assembly comprises a first barrel, a second barrel and a third barrel which are sequentially communicated, and filtering parts are respectively arranged in the barrels. The filter component comprises a fixed hopper, a filter cylinder and a scraper, the filter cylinder is rotationally connected with the fixed hopper, the scraper is in contact with the inner wall of the filter cylinder, and the drive component drives the filter cylinder to rotate relative to the scraper so as to scrape attached oil residues. The method comprises the steps of steady flow oil feeding, pre-separation, graded filtration, scraping and deslagging and flushing, and can reduce the possibility of centralized blockage of the filtering holes by oil residues.

title_en: Low-hysteresis carbon black and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of carbon black preparation, and particularly discloses low-hysteresis carbon black and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of pretreating a carbon black matrix by a pretreatment agent, adding a composite modifier for grafting modification, wherein the pretreatment agent is prepared by carrying out esterification reaction on PSS- (3-mercapto) propyl-heptaisobutyl substitution and 2, 3-dimercaptosuccinic acid, and the composite modifier is prepared by carrying out in-situ polymerization reaction on toluene diisocyanate, nano silicon dioxide and gamma-aminopropyl triethoxysilane. The low-hysteresis carbon black prepared by the method is used as rubber reinforcing filler, can synchronously realize low hysteresis heat generation and high wet skid resistance, overcomes the defects of limited hysteresis reduction and insufficient wet skid resistance and improves the existing modified carbon black, and is suitable for the application requirements of green tires.

title_en: Composition for forming resist underlayer film for nanoimprint
abstract_en: Provided is a composition for forming a resist underlayer film for nanoimprint, which exhibits extremely high hydrophobicity and good planarization even during high-temperature firing, and can be adjusted to be suitable for the optical constants and etching rates of a process by changing the molecular skeleton. A resist underlayer film forming composition for nanoimprint comprising a novolak resin having a repeating unit structure represented by the following formula (1) [ in formula (1), a group A represents an organic group having an aromatic ring, a condensed aromatic ring, or a condensed aromatic heterocycle, a group B represents an organic group having an aromatic ring or a condensed aromatic ring, a group E represents a single bond, or a branched or straight chain alkylene group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms which may be substituted and may contain an ether bond and/or a carbonyl group, a group D represents an organic group having 1 to 15 carbon atoms represented by the formula (2), and n represents a number of 1 to 5. (in formula (2), R  1 、R 2 、R 3  is independently a fluorine atom or a linear, branched or cyclic alkyl group, and any two of R  1 、R 2 、R 3  may be combined with each other to form a ring.) ].

title_en: Acidified soil restoration functional material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of acid soil conditioners, and particularly relates to an acid soil restoration functional material and a preparation method thereof. Adding a calcium nitrate solution into a carboxymethyl cellulose dispersion liquid to obtain a mixed solution, dropwise adding a diamine hydrogen phosphate solution into the mixed solution to obtain a reaction liquid, immediately adding attapulgite powder when precipitation begins to appear in the reaction liquid, adjusting the pH value to 10-11 to obtain a final solution, standing, aging and washing the final solution, and obtaining the precipitate which is the acidified soil restoration functional material. The invention synthesizes hydroxyapatite and simultaneously bonds carboxymethyl cellulose on the hydroxyapatite, and takes carboxymethyl cellulose as a connector to effectively bridge attapulgite powder, thereby preparing the organic-inorganic composite material by a one-step in-situ synthesis method. The synthesis method is quick, simple and convenient, does not need high temperature, has low energy consumption and is easy to expand the production scale. The material can efficiently and slowly release and adjust the pH value of the acidified soil for a long time, is environment-friendly, and can realize the safe restoration of the acidified soil.

title_en: Frameless natural gas filter element structure
abstract_en: A skeleton-free natural gas filter element structure belongs to the technical field of machinery. The utility model aims to solve the problem that the prior automatic flipping and heating device for plant frying processing has poor stir-frying effect, resulting in uneven internal mixing and affecting the taste of subsequent finished products. The inside of the automatic turning heating mechanism is provided with a stir-frying groove, One end of the stir-frying tank is provided with a servo motor, The output end of the servo motor is provided with a coupling transmission rod, The other end of the stir-frying tank is provided with a driven rod, And the servo motor is transmitted and connected with the stir-frying tank through the coupling transmission rod, The outer wall of the front end surface of the stir-frying slot is provided with stir-frying motors, and the stir-frying motors are provided with three groups; the output end of the stir-frying motors is provided with stir-frying rods; the outer walls on both sides of the stir-frying rods are provided with stir-frying shovels; the stir-frying motors are transmitted and connected with the stir-frying shovels through the stir-frying rods; and the bottom of the stir-frying slot is provided with an electric heating wire layer.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of essence particle preparation devices and discloses an essence particle preparation device based on a concurrent flow technology, which comprises a granulation container, wherein an air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the granulation container, a heater is fixedly arranged at the input end of the air inlet pipe, a sieve plate is fixedly arranged at the inner bottom end of the granulation container, a filter is fixedly arranged at the inner top end of the granulation container, a liquid delivery pipe is fixedly arranged at the upper side of the outer end wall of the granulation container, and a nozzle is fixedly connected to the output end of the liquid delivery pipe.

title_en: Fertilizer turns over throwing machine with double helix stirring head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of double-screw stirring heads, and discloses an organic fertilizer turning and throwing machine with double-screw stirring heads, wherein the right sides of a first double-screw stirring head and a second double-screw stirring head are fixedly connected with a transmission mechanism, and the top of a fixing plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting mechanism; the adjusting mechanism comprises a moving assembly and an inclining mechanism, the inclining mechanism is arranged on the moving assembly, the moving assembly comprises a T-shaped groove, the T-shaped groove is formed in the right side of the fixed plate, a T-shaped block is slidably connected inside the T-shaped groove, the top of the T-shaped block is fixedly connected with a mounting seat, and the top of the mounting seat is fixedly connected with a second motor. This fertilizer turns over machine of throwing with double helix stirring head through setting up adjustment mechanism, can rotate first double helix stirring head and second double helix stirring head when stirring the fertilizer, can stir to different transverse positions with adjusting, also can stir according to the fertilizer of different degree of depth simultaneously, convenient and fast.

title_en: Multi-coating cover plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-coating cover plate, which comprises a cover plate substrate with water-soluble protective ink coated on the top, wherein a first printing layer printed on the water-soluble protective ink is arranged above the cover plate substrate, a second printing layer is printed on the top of the first printing layer, a third printing layer is printed on the top of the second printing layer, the same UV layer is coated on the top of the third printing layer and the left side of the top of the cover plate substrate, and the UV layer is also coated on the left side of the first printing layer, the left side of the second printing layer and the left side of the third printing layer. The utility model can achieve the effect of complete 1:1 of the multi-layer stacking, and the problem of uneven light transmission at the edge of the sleeve is avoided.

title_en: Cold accumulation system with cold accumulation and evaporation integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of hydrate cold accumulation, and particularly discloses a cold accumulation system with a cold accumulation and evaporation integrated device, which comprises a cold accumulation and evaporation integrated device and a water chilling unit, wherein the water chilling unit cools cold accumulation working media in the cold accumulation device to enable a cold accumulation groove in the cold accumulation device to store cold, the cold accumulation groove is a container with a water injection port at the upper top, and the cold accumulation working media are injected into the cold accumulation groove through the water injection port; the heat exchange part is arranged on the outer side wall of the cold accumulation groove; the cold accumulation coil pipe is arranged in the cold accumulation groove, a secondary refrigerant is arranged in the cold accumulation coil pipe, one end of the cold accumulation coil pipe is communicated with the water inlet of the heat exchange part through a branch pipeline III, the other end of the cold accumulation coil pipe is communicated with the water outlet of the heat exchange part through a branch pipeline IV, and the solution pump is arranged on the branch pipeline III. The cold accumulation device is convenient to carry and meets the cooling requirement of outdoor activities.

title_en: Antistatic termination adhesive tape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antistatic termination adhesive tape, which relates to the technical field of termination adhesive tapes and comprises a termination adhesive tape coiled material and a substrate layer, wherein the substrate layer is arranged on the outer side of the termination adhesive tape coiled material, a tensile structure layer is attached to the top of the substrate layer, raised particles are arranged on the outer surface of the tensile structure layer, a first rubber layer is attached to the bottom of the substrate layer, a heat-resistant layer is attached to the bottom of the first rubber layer, a puncture-resistant layer is attached to the bottom of the heat-resistant layer, and a second rubber layer is attached to the bottom of the puncture-resistant layer. The utility model provides an antistatic termination adhesive tape, which not only effectively enhances the tensile resistance of a termination adhesive tape coiled material, but also reduces the contact area between an adhesive layer and the tensile structure layer when the termination adhesive tape coiled material is coiled, and can reduce static generated by friction when the termination adhesive tape coiled material is pulled and pulled, thereby improving the operation stability of automation equipment and the product quality in the production process of lithium batteries.

title_en: Medicine dipping device for electronic detonator electronic ignition element
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medicine dipping device of an electronic detonator electronic ignition element, which comprises a medicine storage component, wherein the medicine storage component comprises a medicine dipping disc and a pushing mechanism, a containing groove is formed in the medicine dipping disc, the pushing mechanism comprises a first driving structure, a mounting frame, a first lifting driving piece and a scraping plate which are sequentially connected, the scraping plate is positioned above the containing groove, and the scraping plate can extend into the containing groove under the driving of the first lifting driving piece. The pushing mechanism capable of disturbing the liquid medicine in the medicine dipping tray is additionally arranged, so that the flow of the liquid medicine in the accommodating groove is quickened, the liquid medicine in the accommodating groove can be kept in a plane shape before each time of medicine dipping, the medicine dipping effect is improved, and the production yield is improved. The device for dipping the powder on the electronic ignition element of the electronic detonator has simple structure and is convenient to process and manufacture.

title_en: Cell preservation tube protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell preservation tube protection device which comprises a storage box, a cooling mechanism, a battery module, a controller, a storage plate, a positioning buffer mechanism, a rubber plate and a temperature sensor, wherein the storage plate is fixed in the storage box, a plurality of storage tanks are arranged on the storage plate, two positioning buffer mechanisms are arranged in each storage tank, the rubber plate is arranged in the storage box below the storage plate, the cooling mechanism extending into the storage box is arranged on the left side of the storage box, the battery module and the controller are arranged on the left side of the storage box, and the temperature sensor is arranged in the storage box. The utility model has good buffering performance, and prevents the damage of the cell preservation tube caused by shaking and jolting in the transportation process; the temperature reduction is convenient, the low-temperature preservation environment is conveniently provided for the cell preservation tube, and the cell death in the cell preservation tube is prevented.

title_en: Composting device for kitchen waste treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composting device for kitchen waste treatment, which comprises an anti-seepage pit, wherein a breathable filler layer is arranged in the anti-seepage pit, a fermentation barrel without a bottom is arranged on the breathable filler layer, a support column is buried in the breathable filler layer, the support column stretches into the fermentation barrel, a plurality of support pieces are axially arranged on the side wall of the support column, the support diameters of the support pieces are sequentially reduced from bottom to top, an air guide filter screen is supported on each support piece, and the diameters of inner holes of the air guide filter screens are sequentially reduced from bottom to top. When the kitchen garbage fermentation device is used, the air guide filter screen is firstly arranged at the bottommost part of the fermentation barrel, then kitchen garbage on the same day or near the same day is arranged above the air guide filter screen, and then a layer of air guide filter screen is arranged above the kitchen garbage, so that the subsequent kitchen garbage can be isolated from the kitchen garbage which is fermented in advance. The composting device disclosed by the utility model can not only realize aerobic fermentation of the kitchen waste with sufficient oxygen, but also avoid the condition of poor quality of fertilizer caused by mixing of raw and cooked fertilizer.

title_en: Device for adjusting coal leveling mechanism to improve coal loading height of carbonization chamber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for adjusting a coal leveling mechanism to improve the coal loading height of a carbonization chamber, which comprises 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 carrier rollers which are sequentially arranged at intervals from near to far from a small furnace door of the carbonization chamber, wherein the heights of the carrier rollers relative to the plane of the bottom of a carrier roller bracket are as follows: the carrier rollers 1 and 6 are 870mm in height, the carrier rollers 2 and 5 are 860mm in height, and the carrier rollers 3 and 4 are 850mm in height. The device can reduce the residual coal quantity brought out by the coal leveling rod in the coal charging process, increase the coal charging quantity of the carbonization chamber, improve the production efficiency and reduce the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Coke oven flue gas desulfurization equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses coke oven flue gas desulfurization equipment, which belongs to the technical field of flue gas desulfurization, and comprises a tower body, wherein a first air inlet pipe is communicated with the outer side of the tower body close to the lower part of the tower body; when the flue gas of the coke oven is purified by the desulfurization equipment, the purified flue gas exchanges heat with the high-temperature flue gas before being purified by the heat exchange mechanism in the heat exchange box, so that the heat of the high-temperature flue gas before being purified can be recovered, the low-temperature flue gas of the purified flue gas can be heated, the energy can be effectively saved, and the purified flue gas can be directly discharged through the tower.

title_en: High efficiency compound fertilizer diolame device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-efficiency compound fertilizer coating device which comprises a support frame, wherein a rotating assembly and a stirring assembly driven by the rotating assembly are rotatably arranged on the support frame, a coating assembly is arranged on the stirring assembly, the rotating assembly is used for stirring compound fertilizer under the cooperation of the stirring assembly, coating liquid is sprayed out when the coating assembly is used for stirring the compound fertilizer, the stirring assembly is driven by the rotating assembly to fully stir the compound fertilizer and the coating liquid, and the compound fertilizer is uniformly coated.

title_en: Mixed transportation strong exhaust liquid treatment washing tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of washing tanks, and provides a mixed transportation strong exhaust liquid treatment washing tank which comprises a high-pressure air inlet pipe, a vertical telescopic pipe, a floating plate and a rotating structure. The high-pressure gas introduced through the high-pressure gas inlet pipe can enter the cavity of the rotating structure through the vertical telescopic pipe and then flow out of the air holes of the fan blades, and the rotating structure is driven to rotate under the action of high-pressure gas flow, so that liquid-phase fluid is mixed and stirred. The liquid phase fluid can be mixed while the pressurizing and discharging of the washing tank are realized, solid impurities are prevented from depositing at the bottom of the washing tank, the pressure relief discharging effect is improved, the equipment overhaul and maintenance frequency is reduced, and the safe operation of equipment is ensured.

title_en: Powder spraying structure of Fischer-Tropsch wax granulating and powder spraying tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder spraying structure of a Fischer-Tropsch wax granulating and spraying tower, which relates to the technical field of the powder spraying tower.

title_en: Turning and throwing device for organic fertilizer fermentation
