abstract_en: The utility model relates to a turning device for fermenting organic fertilizer, which comprises a rotating roller, wherein a turning swinging device and a shaking device are arranged in the rotating roller, the turning swinging device comprises a plurality of telescopic components arranged on the inner wall of the rotating roller, a plurality of seven-shaped inserting rods are arranged at the execution ends of the telescopic components, the shaking device comprises a plurality of connecting rods arranged on the inner wall of the rotating roller, the connecting rods are all provided with rotating components connected through hinges, and the rotating components are connected with the shaking device.

title_en: Sesame oil filtering and cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sesame oil filtering and cooling device, and belongs to the technical field of sesame oil filtering and cooling. The cooling device comprises a main body, wherein a refrigerating box is arranged on the side wall of the main body, and a cooling pipe is arranged at the output end of an air outlet pipe. According to the utility model, cold air in the refrigeration box is sucked into the cooling pipe through the air pump to cool sesame oil for the first time, air enters the air outlet groove formed in the push block through the hose and is discharged through the air outlet, the sesame oil is cooled again, the cooling effect is better, the motor drives the threaded rod to rotate, the push block moves on the threaded rod and removes impurities from the first filter plate at the bottom, the plurality of scraping plates are fixedly arranged on the circumferential outer wall of the rotating roller, impurities on the side wall of the push block can be removed, and the push block is prevented from accumulating more impurities on the first surface of the filter plate; the inside of guide way has set firmly a plurality of semicircle filter blocks, can filter it again when leading sesame oil, and the filter effect is better.

title_en: Spliced disc base of organic matter treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spliced disc base of organic matter treatment equipment, which comprises a middle sub-base, a first side sub-base and a second side sub-base, wherein the two sides of the middle sub-base are respectively connected with a first screw plate and a second screw plate, the side part of the first side sub-base is connected with a third screw plate, the side part of the second side sub-base is connected with a fourth screw plate, the first screw plate can be attached to the third screw plate and can be detachably connected with the third screw plate, and the second screw plate can be attached to the fourth screw plate and can be detachably connected with the fourth screw plate, so that the middle sub-base, the first side sub-base and the second side sub-base can be spliced into a disc structure. The utility model forms a disc-shaped structure by the middle sub-seat, the first side sub-seat and the second side sub-seat, so that the disc-shaped structure can be used as a disc base of traditional organic matter treatment equipment, and can be effectively disassembled and assembled by separating or combining corresponding screw plates due to the adoption of a spliced design, so that the disassembly and assembly difficulty is low, the independent sub-seats can be conveniently carried, the carrying difficulty is effectively reduced, and the flexibility is high.

title_en: Low-temperature carbonization furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbonization equipment and discloses a low-temperature carbonization furnace, which comprises a base, wherein the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a plurality of brackets, a carbonization furnace body is fixedly arranged between the top ends of two adjacent brackets, a rotating assembly is arranged at the top end of the base, a cleaning mechanism is arranged between the side ends of two adjacent brackets, a lifting mechanism is arranged between the top end of the base and the side end of the carbonization furnace body, and a scraping mechanism is arranged between the inner side end and the outer side end of the carbonization furnace body.

title_en: Weathered coal humic acid activation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a weathered coal humic acid activating device, which comprises an activating box, wherein the rear side of the activating box is communicated with a mounting shell, a first electric telescopic rod is arranged on the rear side of the mounting shell in a penetrating manner, a push plate is connected to the front side of the first electric telescopic rod through a bolt, a storage box is communicated with the front side of the activating box, a sealing plate is connected to the bottom of the front side of the storage box through a bolt, and a crushing cylinder is communicated to the right side of the top of the activating box. According to the utility model, the grinding cylinder, the grinding seat, the top plate, the first motor, the second electric telescopic rod, the connecting plate, the connecting sleeve, the driving shaft and the grinding head are adopted, so that raw materials can be conveniently ground, the raw materials can be conveniently kept uniform in size, and the raw materials can be conveniently stirred and filtered by adopting the fixed cover, the second motor, the threaded rod, the threaded block, the filter plate, the vertical plate, the stirring rod, the gear and the third motor, so that sundries in the raw materials can be conveniently filtered.

title_en: Spacer gum
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spacer adhesive, in particular to the technical field of adhesive, which comprises a mounting belt, wherein a plurality of adhesive blocks which are distributed at intervals are arranged at the top of the mounting belt; the outside of each rubber block is provided with a protection component for preventing collision and impact; the protection component comprises a top paper shell, the top paper shell is arranged at the top of the glue block, side paper shells are arranged at the bottoms of two ends of the top paper shell, and a bottom paper shell is arranged at the bottom end of the side paper shells. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the two bottom paper shells, the two side paper shells and the top paper shell, the outside of the release paper can be shielded and protected, and the damage to the release paper caused by the external collision and impact is avoided, so that the protection effect of the release paper on the glue block can be ensured, the damage of the release paper is prevented from affecting the use effect of the strong bonding layer, and meanwhile, the top paper shell and the side paper shell can be easily taken down by a user through the tearable side paper shells and the bottom paper shells, and the convenience of the user for disassembling the top paper shell and the side paper shells is improved.

title_en: Fertilizer prilling granulator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fertilizer granulating device, which comprises a base, wherein two sides of the top of the base are fixedly connected with supporting plates, a bearing plate is fixedly connected between the tops of the two supporting plates, the top of the base is fixedly connected with two supporting seats, and a collecting box is fixedly connected between the tops of the two supporting seats, and compared with the prior art, the fertilizer granulating device has the following beneficial effects: through starting the air exhauster that two negative pressures removed the inside blast pipes of grain subassembly intercommunication, through the inside air of blast pipe extraction negative pressure section of thick bamboo to can follow the inside air of suction hopper through negative pressure follow inlet pipe and conveyer pipe department in proper order, can with the compound fertilizer granule suction that blocks in the granulation roller group roll surface gap, and filter in the section of thick bamboo is strained to the filter cartridge of negative pressure section of thick bamboo inside along with the air conveying, need not the manual work and clear up the granulation roller, effectively improved fertilizer prilling device's clean efficiency, thereby improved compound fertilizer granulation machining efficiency.

title_en: Refining device of high-purity helium
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of helium refining, and discloses a refining device of high-purity helium; including the bottom plate, still include: the utility model can facilitate condensing natural gas by arranging the condensing assembly, thereby improving the purity of helium purification, and can cause blockage and damage when the filter screen is used for a long time by arranging the dismounting assembly, thereby maintaining the filter screen, solving the problems that the filter screen in the existing refining device of high-purity helium can cause blockage and damage when being used for a long time, being inconvenient to disassemble and replace the filter screen, reducing the practicability of equipment, simultaneously being inconvenient to condense natural gas and influencing the purification of the natural gas.

title_en: Repairing coating structure for cracking steel coating
abstract_en: The utility model provides a repairing coating structure for cracking of a steel coating, which belongs to the technical field of coating cracking repair and comprises steel to be repaired and a new coating, wherein the steel to be repaired is provided with an old coating which is cracked, a repairing groove is formed in the old coating, cracking points of the old coating are positioned in the repairing groove, and the longitudinal section of the repairing groove is of a trapezoid structure with a large upper part and a small lower part; a new coating is coated in the repair groove, wherein the new coating comprises a primer layer, a middle paint layer and a top paint layer which are coated in sequence from bottom to top. According to the repair coating structure for steel cracking, the trapezoid structure repair groove is arranged, the side wall of the trapezoid structure repair groove is of the inclined structure with the gradient, so that the new coating and the old coating have an overlapping area, the transition between the new coating and the old coating is ensured, the obvious fault influence on the repair effect is avoided, and the stability of the whole coating on the surface of the steel is ensured.

title_en: Modified asphalt metal impurity separation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modified asphalt metal impurity separation device, which comprises a filter box and a fixed box; the bottom of the filter box is provided with a bottom plate, a filter structure is arranged in the filter box, the top of the filter box is provided with a mounting rack, and the bottom of the filter box is provided with a fixed box; the inside of fixed case is provided with revolution mechanic, and the both sides of fixed bottom of the case end are provided with the collecting box, and filtration includes filter, heater, stripper plate, cylinder and filter screen, and the cylinder sets up in the top of mounting bracket. According to the utility model, through the use of the heater, the viscosity of the modified asphalt in the filter box can be reduced by heating, then through the cooperation of the filter plate and the filter screen, the modified asphalt can be subjected to primary filtration, metal parts and impurities in the modified asphalt are filtered, and through the cooperation of the extrusion plate and the air cylinder, the modified asphalt can be extruded to accelerate the filtration speed, so that the filtration speed is faster.

title_en: Wear-resistant repair adhesive tape
abstract_en: A wear-resisting repair adhesive tape relates to the technical field of adhesive tapes, and comprises a top adhesive layer and a middle adhesive layer, wherein a sealing cavity is formed between the top adhesive layer and the middle adhesive layer, and a wear-resisting layer is arranged in the sealing cavity; the bottom of middle glue film is provided with from type paper, the top of top glue film is provided with the surface course. The utility model solves the defect of long time required by the traditional outside maintenance scheme, and can complete the repair work of the abrasion leakage point only by about five minutes, so that the equipment can quickly recover the work; the wear-resisting effect is good, manual operation is not needed, equipment is not needed, fire is not needed, the labor intensity is low, and the technical requirements on workers are low; the problems of stress concentration, material annealing, damaged internal wear-resistant layers, easy corrosion and the like caused by welding are avoided; the wear-resistant repair method is suitable for wear-resistant repair scenes comprising various shapes and positions such as planes, pipelines, elbows and the like.

title_en: Forestry fire prevention median
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forestry fireproof isolation belt, which comprises an isolation fence main body, wherein a butt joint frame is fixedly connected to one side of the isolation fence main body, a component is installed on the other side of the isolation fence main body, a mounting groove is formed in one side of the mounting frame, a water spraying mechanism is fixedly connected to the top of the isolation fence main body, a base is fixedly connected to the bottom of the isolation fence main body, water pipe interfaces are formed in two sides of the base, a booster pump is fixedly connected to one side of the base through the water pipe interfaces, a water storage tank is fixedly connected to one side of the booster pump, a fixing component is fixedly connected to the front and the back of the base, a water pump is fixedly connected to the inner part of the isolation fence main body, and a water supply pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the water pump.

title_en: Automotive acrylic foam adhesive tape with high anti-fouling performance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of foam tapes, and discloses an acrylic foam tape with strong stain resistance for vehicles, which comprises a tape main body; the adhesive tape main body comprises a material base layer positioned in the middle, wherein an outer acrylic acid glue layer and an inner acrylic acid glue layer are respectively arranged on the top surface layer and the bottom surface layer of the material base layer, an outer bottom glue layer and an inner bottom glue layer are respectively arranged between the outer acrylic acid glue layer and the inner acrylic acid glue layer and the material base layer, the outer bottom glue layer and the inner bottom glue layer are both polyurethane adhesives, the material base layer consists of an upper heat insulation layer, an acrylic acid foam layer A, an acrylic acid foam layer B and a lower heat insulation layer, and the top surface layer of the acrylic acid foam layer B is provided with the acrylic acid foam layer A; the acrylic foam adhesive tape for the vehicle has strong stain resistance, high tensile strength, certain pressure-resistant effect and difficult damage.

title_en: Asphalt quick hot melting tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an asphalt rapid hot melting tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein a melting promoting stirrer driven by a motor is arranged in the tank body, the melting promoting stirrer comprises a central shaft, a supporting shaft and a scraping plate, the central shaft is rotatably arranged on the tank body, a plurality of supporting shafts and at least one scraping plate are positioned in the tank body, the supporting shaft is arranged on the central shaft, the scraping plate is arranged on the supporting shaft, and the scraping plate is attached to the inner wall of the tank body; the central shaft, the support shaft and the runner on the scraper form a passage, and a heat conducting medium passes through the passage. The hot melting tank adopts an uncharged internal heating mode to rapidly heat asphalt in the hot melting tank, firstly, an electrified heating structure is avoided, the structure of the hot melting tank is greatly simplified, secondly, the hot melting tank is durable, the hot melting tank cannot easily break down due to the electrified heating structure, and the overhaul is extremely convenient. In addition, the hot melting tank depends on a heat conducting medium, and can heat asphalt by means of the existing equipment such as a boiler and the like, so that energy sources are greatly saved.

title_en: Continuous high softening point spinnable asphalt production device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous high-softening-point spinnable asphalt production device which comprises a first rectifying tower, a second rectifying tower and a third rectifying tower which are sequentially connected in series, wherein the first rectifying tower, the second rectifying tower and the third rectifying tower are respectively connected with a rectifying tower vacuum pump, a first reaction system is respectively connected with the second rectifying tower and the third rectifying tower in a three-phase manner, the second reaction system is connected with the first reaction system in series/in parallel, the second reaction system is connected with the second rectifying tower, the first reaction system and the second reaction system are both connected with a strip-making packaging system, and the second rectifying tower and the third rectifying tower are both connected with the second strip-making packaging system. The utility model can improve the processing amount on the premise of realizing low energy consumption by connecting the tower and the kettle in series and parallel, and a plurality of production lines can simultaneously produce the spinnable asphalt with high softening point. In view of the structures of the rectifying tower and the reaction kettle, the aim of higher coking value of asphalt with the same softening point can be fulfilled.

title_en: Solid waste domestic garbage cracking condenser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solid waste household garbage cracking condenser, which relates to the technical field of solid waste household garbage cracking, in particular to a solid waste household garbage cracking condenser, comprising a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly provided with a treatment box, the inside of the treatment box is rotatably connected with a stirring shaft, the stirring device is characterized in that a stirring frame is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the stirring shaft, a driven belt pulley is fixedly arranged at one end of the stirring shaft, a motor frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the treatment box, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the motor frame, and a driving belt pulley is fixedly arranged at the output end of the driving motor. This solid useless domestic waste schizolysis condenser, through the setting of stirring frame, make this solid useless domestic waste schizolysis condenser possess just turn the effect to solid useless domestic waste to played the higher effect of schizolysis effect, reached the purpose that improves schizolysis efficiency.

title_en: Leaching device for sunflower oil processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leaching device for sunflower oil processing, which relates to the technical field of sunflower oil processing and comprises a processing box, a stirring mechanism and a solvent storage mechanism, wherein the stirring mechanism is arranged in the processing box, and the solvent storage mechanism is arranged on the right side of the processing box. It can pour the oil into the processing incasement portion through processing case, the feeder hopper, rabbling mechanism and solvent storage mechanism, through control switch control water pump operation, under depositing the case, the drinking-water pipe, the outlet pipe, hollow dwang, hollow puddler and go out the cooperation of liquid head, make solvent blowout then leach the operation to the oil, through control switch control motor operation, under the cooperation between pivot, the bearing, hollow dwang, hollow puddler and sealed bearing, stir oil and solvent, make its abundant contact, this setting can make solvent and oil carry out the omnidirectional abundant contact, it is more thorough to make the oil leach, improve leaching efficiency, avoid leading to the oil extravagant.

title_en: High temperature resistant PET protection film
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-temperature resistant PET protective film, which comprises a first antistatic layer, a temperature resistant layer, a PET base material, a temperature resistant barrier layer, a second antistatic layer, an antistatic adhesive layer and a release film which are sequentially arranged, wherein by the design of the multilayer structure, the high-temperature resistant PET protective film has excellent high-low temperature resistance, can not generate obvious deformation and shrinkage after multiple times of high temperature, can effectively separate out small molecules, further can ensure that the surface of a stuck object is not polluted, and has good antistatic effect on four sides.

title_en: Film coating machine for compound fertilizer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coating machine for compound fertilizer, which comprises a base, a supporting plate, a coating roller, a rotating shaft, a first motor, an atomization system, an atomization nozzle, a stirring rod, a row brush, a feed hopper, a material receiving box and a second motor. The method comprises the steps of arranging an atomizing nozzle with atomizing holes uniformly distributed on a spherical surface, spraying atomized liquid drops to cover the interior of a coating roller by 360 degrees, arranging a row brush and a stirring rod, scraping particles on the inner wall of the coating roller to prevent particle deposition or blockage, dispersing and stirring the particles on the bottom of the coating roller to wet each particle, generating atomized liquid drops of a coating agent by an atomizing system, spraying the atomized liquid drops of the coating agent into the interior of the coating roller through the atomizing nozzle, and rapidly wetting the surfaces of fertilizer particles by the atomized liquid drops of the coating agent to realize the coating of the fertilizer particles by the atomized coating agent. The utility model solves the problems of deposition, agglomeration or caking of fertilizer particles, and uneven coating, and realizes the purposes of uniform coating and improved coating quality.

title_en: Waste tire cracking kettle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste tire treatment, in particular to a waste tire cracking kettle which comprises a kettle body, wherein a filter screen knocking mechanism is arranged in the kettle body, the outer wall of the kettle body is fixedly connected with a first pipeline, and the inner wall of the first pipeline is communicated with the inner part of a second pipeline. Through the cooperation of cauldron body and filter screen knocking mechanism, the first connecting rod passes through the spout and drives the slider and remove, and the slider drives the second connecting rod and removes, can avoid first filter screen by demolishing great tire granule through above-mentioned mode and block up, this has just improved the work efficiency of schizolysis cauldron, through the cooperation of box and filter screen moving mechanism, the rack drives the gear rotation when driving the spring extension, the rack drives the second filter screen through above-mentioned mode and gets back to in the second pipeline, can carry out secondary filtering to gas through above-mentioned mode, can clean the second filter screen simultaneously, this has just improved the operating mass of schizolysis cauldron.

title_en: Anti-dazzle eye-protection toughened film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-dazzle eye-protection toughened film, which relates to the technical field of toughened films and comprises a toughened glass layer, an oleophobic coating, a blue light resistant layer, an AG atomized layer, a matte diffuse reflection layer and an adhesive layer, wherein the oleophobic coating is arranged on the outer surface of the toughened glass layer, the blue light resistant layer is arranged on the inner surface of the toughened glass layer, the AG atomized layer is arranged between the blue light resistant layer and the toughened glass layer, the matte diffuse reflection layer is arranged between the AG atomized layer and the blue light resistant layer, the adhesive layer is arranged on the lower surface of the blue light resistant layer, the toughened glass layer provides basic hardness and shock resistance protection, the oleophobic coating is arranged on the outermost layer, fingerprint and grease adhesion are reduced, the screen is kept clean and smooth in touch, the blue light resistant layer reduces damage to eyes, the AG atomized layer and the matte diffuse reflection layer work cooperatively, screen reflection and strong light are reduced, vision is more comfortable, and glare is reduced.

title_en: Automatic change sugar spices processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic sugar spice treatment device, which realizes the automatic production of small-batch products and has the characteristics of high process control precision and good automatic stirring uniformity. The automatic cleaning and automatic blowdown device has the advantages that the quality stability of the essence is guaranteed through the functions of quick mechanical stirring, automatic heating and heat preservation, the weight of the fed essence and the weight of the discharged essence can be displayed in real time in the process of configuration and essence discharging, the essence meets the technological proportioning requirement, and the manual cleaning cost is effectively reduced through the automatic cleaning and automatic blowdown functions of the tank after the tank body is completely discharged.

title_en: Grain and oil extraction device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of grain and oil extraction equipment, and particularly relates to a grain and oil extraction device, wherein a conveying pipeline is arranged between an oil inlet box and an oil storage box, a first pump body matched with the conveying pipeline is arranged on the oil storage box, an oil outlet pipeline is arranged at the lower end of the oil storage box, a second pump body matched with the oil outlet pipeline is arranged at the lower end of the oil storage box, a groove body is arranged on the conveying pipeline, a cleaning box corresponding to the groove body is arranged at the bottom of the conveying pipeline, a lifting plate is arranged in the groove body, a filter plate is fixedly connected with the lifting plate, a transition hole matched with the filter plate is formed in the inner side wall of the conveying pipeline, a circulating pump is arranged at the bottom of the cleaning box, an air inlet pipeline and an air outlet pipeline are connected between the inlet end and the outlet end of the circulating pump and the cleaning box, and the lifting plate is driven by a power device.

title_en: Electric frying pan for processing rapeseed oil with convenience in stir-frying
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of electric frying pans, in particular to an electric frying pan for processing rapeseed oil with convenient stir-frying, which comprises a heater and a pan body, wherein the pan body is arranged on the top of the heater, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the pan body, a supporting plate is arranged above the fixed plate, a connecting mechanism is arranged between the supporting plate and the fixed plate, a stir-frying structure is arranged on the supporting plate, the stir-frying mechanism comprises a stirring motor, a connecting plate, an L-shaped rod and a stir-frying plate, the stirring motor is fixedly arranged on the top of the supporting plate, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the stirring motor, a plurality of L-shaped rods are arranged on the outer side of the connecting plate, the stir-frying plate is arranged at the bottom end of the L-shaped rod, and the connecting mechanism comprises a rotating hole, a rotating sleeve and a moving rod. The utility model has reasonable design, and the stir-frying plate is convenient to put into the pot body or take out from the pot body by moving and rotating, so that the purpose of stir-frying the rapeseeds can be realized by rotating the stir-frying plate.

title_en: Biological organic fertilizer adds fungus jar equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microbial organic fertilizer adding tank device, belongs to the technical field of feeding devices, and aims to solve the technical problems that part of microbial organic fertilizer and microbial agents are deposited at the bottom of a tank body in the microbial adding process in the prior art, the microbial agents are difficult to ensure to be added into the microbial organic fertilizer in a uniformly dispersed manner, and the uniformity and the use effect of microbial organic fertilizer adding are reduced. This bio-organic fertilizer adds fungus jar equipment includes and adds fungus jar body for bio-organic fertilizer adds the fungus and mixes, it installs the axostylus axostyle to add the internal vertical rotation of fungus jar, the axostylus axostyle bottom is provided with a pair of first stirring piece at least radially, first stirring piece includes integrated into one piece's oblique layer board and first crooked shovel board. The microbial organic fertilizer adding tank device can uniformly disperse the added microbial organic fertilizer in the microbial organic fertilizer tank body through scooping, supporting, pushing and shoveling, free scattering and scraping of the microbial organic fertilizer and bacterial colonies in the microbial organic fertilizer tank body, so that uniform microbial addition of the microbial organic fertilizer is realized.

title_en: Device for recycling tar and naphthalene by increasing gas primary cooler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for increasing tar and naphthalene recovery of a gas primary cooler, which relates to the technical field of coking production processes, wherein the content of tar and naphthalene in raw coke oven gas is analyzed by arranging a first sampling port and a second sampling port, the ratio of tar to ammonia water flowing into a condensate tank at the middle section is controlled to be 4:6 by a second valve, a second flowmeter, a fourth valve and a fourth flowmeter, the ratio of the tar to the ammonia water flowing into the condensate tank at the lower section is controlled to be 2:8 by the first valve, the first flowmeter, the third valve and the third flowmeter, and the consumption of spraying liquid (4.0-10.0 m3 (spraying liquid)/km 3 (raw coke oven gas)) is correspondingly adjusted according to the content of tar and naphthalene in raw coke oven gas analyzed by sampling at the front end and the rear end of the primary cooler, so that the recovery of tar and naphthalene is increased to the greatest extent.

title_en: Compact oil supercritical carbon dioxide extraction testing device under in-situ temperature and pressure conditions
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of supercritical carbon dioxide extraction, in particular to a compact oil supercritical carbon dioxide extraction testing device under an in-situ temperature and pressure condition. A compact oil supercritical carbon dioxide extraction testing device under an in-situ temperature and pressure condition comprises an intermediate container, a reaction device and a separation device which are sequentially connected, wherein the inlet end of the intermediate container is connected with a pressurized gas input device, a saturated oil core is arranged in the reaction device, and the reaction device is also connected with a pressure regulating device and a temperature control device. The device for testing supercritical carbon dioxide extraction of compact oil under the condition of in-situ temperature and pressure comprises an intermediate container, a reaction device and a separation device which are sequentially connected, wherein the inlet end of the intermediate container is connected with a pressurized gas input device which is internally provided with a saturated oil core, and the reaction device is provided with a pressure regulating device and a temperature control device.

title_en: Heating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heating, in particular to a self-heating device which comprises a packaging bag body, a heated main body and a heating body arranged on one side of the heated main body, wherein the heated main body and the heating body are sealed in the packaging bag body, the heating body comprises a self-heating body and a breathable sheet, the self-heating body is arranged on the outer side face of the heated main body, the breathable sheet covers the self-heating body, and the periphery of the breathable sheet is adhered to the heated main body. This heating device can heat for packaged products such as wet wipe, facial mask, and the heating member setting is in the outside of being heated the main part, simple structure can realize heating to multiple type product, in the production process, is heated the main part and is sealing state, sets up the heating device that the processing easily produced the dust on it and also can not pollute inside heated object, and this just makes whole cleaner health of product, safe and reliable.

title_en: Granulating cylinder for phosphate fertilizer production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a granulating cylinder for producing phosphate fertilizer, which comprises a horizontally arranged cylindrical cylinder body, a feeding hole arranged at the top end of the cylinder body, a bracket arranged on the cylinder body, a granulating device arranged in the middle of the cylinder body, and a discharging hole arranged at one side of the bottom of the cylinder body, wherein the granulating device comprises a granulating plate, a rotating device and a granulating roller, the granulating plate is of an annular plate-shaped structure, the cross section of the granulating plate in the direction of the annular radius is an arc, a plurality of granulating holes are formed in the granulating plate, the rotating device comprises a driving device arranged at the center of the granulating plate, a rotating seat arranged on the driving device, symmetrical rotating shafts are horizontally arranged at two sides of the rotating seat, the rotating seat coaxially and horizontally rotates relative to the granulating plate, the granulating rollers are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the rotating seat, coaxially rotate along with the rotation of the rotating seat, and the shape of the granulating roller is matched with the arc of the granulating plate, so that phosphate fertilizer particles are extruded.

title_en: Fecal fermentation decomposing equipment capable of improving fermentation efficiency
abstract_en: The utility model provides fecal fermentation and decomposition equipment capable of improving fermentation efficiency, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with a fermentation tank, the front side of the fermentation tank is provided with a stirring assembly, the stirring assembly comprises a transmission case, the transmission case is fixedly connected to the front side of the fermentation tank, the left side and the right side of an inner cavity of the transmission case are movably connected with threaded rods through bearings, and the surfaces of the threaded rods are in threaded connection with threaded sleeves. Through the output drive puddler rotation of rotating the motor, the puddler drives the stirring leaf and rotates, stirs the excrement and urine of fermentation vat, at stirring in-process, through servo motor's output drive threaded rod rotation, the threaded rod passes through the effect drive thread bush of screw thread and moves to the right side, and the thread bush passes through the transfer line and drives the stirring leaf and move along the left side to the right side of fermentation vat, makes excrement and urine in the fermentation vat obtain intensive mixing, avoids appearing stirring dead angle, has improved faecal fermentation efficiency.

title_en: Insect specimen box capable of preventing insects and moisture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a insect prevention and moisture prevention insect specimen box, which relates to the technical field of insect research and comprises a box body, wherein a placing plate and an inner box are arranged in the box body, insect needles are arranged on the placing plate, the needle heads of the insect needles are upwards arranged, insect repellent and water absorbent are placed in the inner box, and air holes are formed in the inner box. The utility model can effectively prevent insects and moisture, thereby enabling the insect specimens to be preserved for a long time.

title_en: Natural gas filtering and purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural gas filtering and purifying device, which comprises a purifying tower (12), a first spraying component (22) and a first filter (52), wherein an inlet (13) and an outlet (11) are formed in the purifying tower (12), the first filter (52) and the first spraying component (22) are both arranged in the purifying tower (12), and the first spraying component (22) is arranged above the first filter (52). The natural gas filtering and purifying device disclosed by the utility model has a simple structure, can effectively filter mixed impurities in natural gas, and can greatly reduce the production cost.

title_en: Circulating fluidized bed pyrolysis gas quenching tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heat exchange equipment, in particular to a circulating fluidized bed pyrolysis gas quenching tower, which comprises an exhaust end socket which is arranged at the upper end and the lower end and is communicated with a produced gas buffer tank, and a material returning end socket which is communicated with cyclone separation equipment, wherein a tower body is arranged between the exhaust end socket and the material returning end socket in a sealing way, a plurality of groups of tower bodies are arranged in parallel along the up-down direction, a vulcanizing plate and a collecting plate which are connected in an inclined way are arranged in the tower body, a gas passing pipe group is arranged on the vulcanizing plate in a penetrating way, a cooling fin is arranged on the collecting plate, a cooling coil is arranged on the cooling fin, a primary gas pipe, a secondary gas pipe and a material supplementing pipe are arranged on the side wall of the tower body in a communicating way, the outer parts of the primary gas pipe and the secondary gas pipe are mutually communicated and are arranged on one side close to the vulcanizing plate, the primary gas pipe is positioned below the vulcanizing plate, the secondary gas pipe is positioned above the vulcanizing plate, and the material supplementing pipe is arranged on one side close to the collecting plate and is positioned above the vulcanizing plate. The circulating fluidized bed pyrolysis gas quenching tower provided by the utility model realizes cooling and impurity removal of pyrolysis gas.

title_en: Ash removal device of biomass gasification stove
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ash removal device of a biomass gasification furnace, which relates to the technical field of biomass gasification furnaces and comprises an ash collecting hopper, wherein the top of the ash collecting hopper is communicated with an ash falling part of the biomass gasification furnace, a motor is arranged outside the ash collecting hopper, a spiral conveying rod is arranged in the bottom of the ash collecting hopper, the spiral conveying rod is in an inclined shape, a driving shaft of the motor is connected with the spiral conveying rod, a blocking cover is arranged at the bottom of the front end of the ash collecting hopper, a movable baffle is arranged in the top of the ash collecting hopper in an arrangement shape, a movable frame is connected outside the ash collecting hopper, a handle is arranged at the front end of the movable frame, the movable frame is connected with the end part of the movable baffle, and a lock pin is connected with the front end of the movable frame and is connected with the ash collecting hopper. According to the utility model, the movable frame is pulled forwards before ash removal operation, and the movable frame drives the movable baffle to rotate, so that the movable baffle is horizontal, and the top of the ash collecting hopper is sealed through the movable baffle, so that the influence of ash removal operation on the high temperature and anoxic environment in the biomass gasification furnace is avoided.

title_en: Rapeseed oil extraction and refining equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rapeseed oil extraction and refining, in particular to rapeseed oil extraction and refining equipment which comprises a refining tank and a stirring mechanism, wherein the stirring mechanism comprises a movable rod rotatably connected to the inner wall of the refining tank, the movable rod, a sliding rod and a movable frame are used for realizing that a digging frame and a sliding block move longitudinally in an annular mode in the device, further, the rapeseed oil in the refining tank is stirred and lifted, the movable rod, a fixed rod, an arc block and a placing frame are used for realizing that the arc block and the placing frame move annularly to stir the rapeseed oil, further, the mobility of the rapeseed oil at each position in the refining tank is increased, and compared with the prior art, the rapeseed oil at a specific position in the tank is stirred, so that the mobility of the rapeseed oil far away from the specific position is slower.

title_en: Absorption tower for purifying gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an absorption tower for purifying coal gas, which comprises a base and a body, wherein the top surface of the base is fixedly connected with the body, one side surface of the body, which is close to the bottom, is in through connection with an air inlet pipe, the other side surface of the body, which is close to the top, is in through connection with an air outlet pipe, the middle of the bottom surface of the body is in through connection with an air outlet pipe, one side of the base is provided with a water tank, the top surface of the water tank is fixedly provided with a water pump, one side surface of the water pump is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe, the top surface of the water pump is fixedly connected with a conveying pipe, and one side surface of the conveying pipe, which is close to the top, is in through connection with a limiting frame.

title_en: Fermenting installation is used in fertilizer production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fertilizer production, in particular to a fermentation device for fertilizer production. Its technical scheme includes planking, inner panel and fermenting case body, fermenting case body both sides outer terminal surface all is fixed with the support frame, and support frame lower surface threaded connection has fixing bolt, the spout has been seted up to the support frame inside, and the inside sliding connection of spout has the mounting bracket, the mounting hole has been seted up to the inside of mounting bracket, the inside embedding of fermenting case body is fixed with the protection pad, and the inside of protection pad has seted up logical groove, the inner wall of protection pad is fixed with the fixed plate, and the inside of fixed plate has seted up spacing hole, the lower fixed surface of planking has the gag lever post, and the planking passes through the gag lever post to be pegged graft in the inside and the fixed plate in spacing hole, the planking is pegged graft in the inside of leading to the groove, and the activity of one side outer terminal surface of planking is pegged graft there is the inner panel, the lower fixed surface of inner panel has the outer pole. The utility model can prevent the peculiar smell from directly following the fertilizer to be dispersed.

title_en: Shock-resistant adhesive tape with double-layer buffer structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adhesive tapes and discloses an anti-seismic adhesive tape with a double-layer buffer structure, which comprises buffer and upper-layer isolation paper, wherein a tearing line is arranged on the inner side of the upper-layer isolation paper, the bottom of the upper-layer isolation paper is fixedly connected with a buffer shock-absorbing component, the buffer shock-absorbing component comprises an upper-layer adhesive surface, the bottom of the upper-layer adhesive surface is fixedly connected with a buffer adhesive layer, the bottom of the buffer adhesive layer is fixedly connected with a vacuum layer, and the bottom of the vacuum layer is fixedly connected with an anti-seismic adhesive layer. According to the utility model, the buffer adhesive layer, the vacuum layer and the anti-vibration adhesive layer on the inner side play a role together, so that when external force impact, vibration and other conditions are met after the article is fixed, the energy is effectively absorbed and dispersed, the buffer and vibration-reducing effects are achieved, the reliable fixation of the article on the expected position is ensured, the normal service cycle of the article is prolonged, and the reliability of the whole use is improved.

title_en: Peanut oil processing is with frying seed device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of peanut oil processing and discloses a seed frying device for peanut oil processing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the inside of the fixed plate is rotationally connected with a connecting shaft, the outer diameter of the connecting shaft is fixedly connected with a heating mechanism, a frying pan is arranged at the top of the heating mechanism, and one side of the fixed plate, which is far away from the heating mechanism, is fixedly connected with an adjusting block. This seed device is fried with peanut oil processing, staff promote the handle, topple over staff to the inside peanut of frying pan through the inside promotion button of push rod, the button drives the regulation pole and removes when removing to make the regulation pole drive the inside that the inserted block inserted the slot, inject the position of connecting axle, through above-mentioned setting, make things convenient for the staff to fix the angle of frying pan, can rotate the frying pan simultaneously, make the unloading more convenient.

title_en: Quick locking mechanism convenient for automatically disassembling die cover body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick locking mechanism convenient for automatically disassembling a die cover body, which comprises a locking body, a locking rod, a locking ring and locking balls, wherein when the die cover body is locked, the locking rod is rotated to push each locking ball to extend outwards in the radial direction through a conical positioning surface on the side wall of the front end of the locking rod, so that the quick locking mechanism is axially limited by each locking ball and a die body opening flange, then the locking ring is rotated to clamp and fix the die cover body and the die body opening flange forwards, and when the die cover body is disassembled, the locking rod is rotated to enable the locking rod to move backwards to open a channel for radially retracting each locking ball, and at the moment, the quick locking mechanism can be taken out from a connecting hole of the die cover body and the die body opening flange. The quick locking structure can realize quick assembly and disassembly of the die cover body and the flange.

title_en: Refining device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refining plant, relates to fish oil production facility technical field, includes reation kettle, one side of reation kettle upper end is installed the fish oil and is advanced the pipe, reation kettle's internally mounted has fish oil rabbling mechanism for mix water and fish oil and come unstuck, reation kettle's below is provided with decoloration mechanism for adsorb residual gum and natural pigment in the fish oil, first three-way valve is installed to decoloration mechanism's bottom, the unloading pipe is installed to first three-way valve's one end, the extrusion filter cartridge is installed to the lower extreme of unloading pipe, and the extrusion filter cartridge is arranged in filtering residual impurity in the fish oil, the fish oil exit tube is installed to extrusion filter cartridge's one end, the mouth of pipe department of pump installs the second three-way valve, the one end of second three-way valve has a distillation section of thick bamboo through the pipe connection for heat deodorization to fish oil, this scheme has solved fish oil refining plant and to natural pigment, oxidation product and the relatively poor problem of volatile peculiar smell removal effect.

title_en: Plant essential oil extraction device with weighing structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plant essential oil extraction device with a weighing structure, which belongs to the technical field of plant essential oil extraction devices and comprises a mounting frame, wherein an extraction tank body is arranged on the mounting frame, an end socket top cover is arranged at the top of the extraction tank body, a conical base is arranged at the bottom of the extraction tank body, a connector is arranged at the top of the end socket top cover, a heat exchange component is connected with the connector, a feed head is further arranged at the top of the end socket top cover, heating rings are arranged in the extraction tank body and the conical base, the heat exchange component is connected with a plurality of groups of separation tanks, a weighing component is arranged below the separation tanks, and through the arrangement of the weighing component, a user can measure the weight of plant essential oil, the metering accuracy of the device is improved, the production management capability of the device is improved, and the user can use the heat exchange component to divide the primarily treated plant essential oil into the plurality of groups of separation tanks, so that the user can perform the split operation of the essential oil, and the split flow efficiency of the device is improved.

title_en: Polymer microsphere's preparation facilities
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of polymers and discloses a preparation device of polymer microspheres, which comprises a preparation cylinder, wherein the top end of the preparation cylinder is fixedly connected with a sealing cover, the top end of the sealing cover is fixedly connected with a first motor, the output end of the first motor extends to the bottom end of the sealing cover and is fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the top end of the rotating plate is provided with a plurality of stirring through holes, the inside of each stirring through hole is rotationally connected with a stirring rod, the top ends of the stirring rods are fixedly connected with rotating gears, the stirring preparation efficiency is further improved by the rotation of the stirring plates, and compared with the stirring effect of the prior art by only relying on a single stirring blade, the device rotates through the rotation of the rotating plates and through the gear engagement, so that the phenomenon of material stacking corners is avoided, and the stirring effect of polymer microsphere materials is improved.

title_en: Acrylic foam adhesive tape with multifunctional composite structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an acrylic foam adhesive tape with a multifunctional composite structure, which comprises a first surface adhesive layer, a first acrylic foam layer, a substrate layer, a second acrylic foam layer, a second surface adhesive layer and a release layer which are sequentially laminated and attached, wherein the substrate layer is a plastic layer, the first surface adhesive layer and the second surface adhesive layer are respectively acrylic adhesive layers, and the thickness of the first surface adhesive layer is larger than that of the second surface adhesive layer. The acrylic foam adhesive tape has good adhesive property, good temperature resistance and waterproof property, and can buffer and resist shock and absorb assembly stress.

title_en: Fuel oil treatment system
abstract_en: The application provides a fuel oil treatment system which comprises a filter, a benzene distillation tower, an SRV rectifying device and a cyclohexanone steam air cooler which are sequentially communicated, wherein the benzene distillation tower is also sequentially connected with the benzene steam air cooler and a benzene buffer tank. In the system, after solid components such as a catalyst in fuel oil are filtered out by a filter, trace benzene is distilled and recovered by a benzene distillation tower, the bottom product of the benzene distillation tower enters an SRV rectifying device for rectification treatment, cyclohexanone is obtained at the top of the tower, cyclohexanol is obtained at the middle side line, heavy oil is obtained at the bottom of the tower, the recycling of the fuel liquid is realized, the loss of cyclohexanol ketone is reduced, the production cost is reduced, and the recovered material is expected to be 120m  3  a week, so that the system has good practical value. In addition, by adding a cyclohexanone steam air cooler at the rectifying section in the SRV rectifying device and adding a reboiler at the stripping section, 66% of circulating water and 45% of steam consumption can be saved, and the production cost is further reduced.

title_en: Nanometer emulsification paraffin normal atmospheric temperature emulsification all-in-one device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a normal-temperature emulsification integrated machine device for nano-emulsified paraffin, which comprises a reaction tank, wherein an end cover is arranged at the upper end of the reaction tank, a notch is arranged on the end cover, an agitation disturbance device is arranged at the notch, the agitation disturbance device comprises an outer shell, a central shaft is fixedly arranged in the outer shell, the central shaft is arranged in a hollow mode, a rotating shaft is arranged in the central shaft, a biting piece is arranged at the lower end of the rotating shaft, a driving structure is connected to the upper end of the rotating shaft, a shaft wall of the central shaft is connected to a first air inlet source outside the reaction tank through a connecting pipe, a heat conducting pipe is arranged outside the lower portion of the outer shell, one end of the heat conducting pipe is connected to a second air inlet source outside the reaction tank, and the other end of the heat conducting pipe is connected to an air outlet pipe extending out of the reaction tank. According to the utility model, compressed air enters the central shaft to impact liquid in the reaction tank, so that strong disturbance is caused, and the high-shear biting piece is matched to rotate to integrally crush particles of the emulsified paraffin, so that a solution system is fully emulsified, and stable emulsion is formed.

title_en: Asphalt sedimentation separation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of asphalt sedimentation separation, in particular to an asphalt sedimentation separation device. The automatic discharging device comprises a sedimentation cylinder, a discharging assembly and a heating block, wherein the top end of the sedimentation cylinder is communicated with a discharging hopper and an exhaust pipe, a sleeve is arranged on the sedimentation cylinder, the discharging assembly comprises a top frame arranged on the sedimentation cylinder, a motor arranged on the top frame, a discharging pipe arranged at the output end of the motor, a bottom pipe detachably arranged at the bottom end of the sedimentation cylinder, a bearing and a sealing ring arranged on the discharging pipe, the discharging pipe is provided with a discharging through groove, and the heating block is annularly arranged on the sedimentation cylinder in a plurality. According to the utility model, the discharge pipe is rotated by the motor, so that the discharge through groove is partially overlapped with the sleeve, asphalt flows out from the overlapped part, and the function of accurately controlling the asphalt to flow out is maintained under the condition of improving the structure of the device.

title_en: High-efficiency desulfurizing tower for underground coal gasification gas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground coal gasification, and discloses a high-efficiency desulfurizing tower for underground coal gasification gas. The upper-section internal component is a metal structured packing layer, the lower-section internal component comprises a multi-layer sieve plate structure, the liquid extraction component collects liquid flowing down from the upper-section space and guides the liquid to the outside of the tower body, and the liquid treatment component carries out filtration treatment on the discharged liquid and then reinjects the liquid to the lower-section space. The utility model solves the technical problems of low desulfurization efficiency, poor capability of resisting fluctuation of synthesis gas components and easy foam flooding generation of the traditional desulfurizing tower by a two-section type internal part combination and liquid extraction, filtration and reinjection mechanism, and realizes the technical effects of high-efficiency desulfurization, stable operation and foam resistance.

title_en: Fusion proteins, recombinant bacteria, and exosporium fragments for pest control and plant health
abstract_en: family members or exosporium fragments derived therefrom for nematode control are also provided.

title_en: Method of producing concentrated organic fertilizer from raw sheep wool
abstract_en: Process for producing concentrated organic fertilizer from raw sheep's wool, in which the raw sheep's wool is first heated at higher than 50 °C and at the same time lower than 100 ° C for 5 to 90 minutes by alkaline hydrolysis with an aqueous potassium hydroxide solution with a potassium hydroxide concentration of 20 to 100 g / l, the weight ratio of the raw sheep's wool to potassium hydroxide solution is 1: 3 to 1:50, during which the polypeptide chains are cleaved, depolymerized and the disulfide bridges of the raw sheep's wool are broken, and form a hydrolyzate containing free amino acids and a solid phase formed by the cleaved polypeptide chains. The pH of this hydrolyzate is then reduced to 8 to 10 by adding phosphoric acid thus preparing a concentrated organic fertilizer containing organic nitrogen, potassium, the source of which is potassium hydroxide, and phosphorus, the source of which is phosphoric acid. This concentrated organic fertilizer is then diluted with water for the final application according to the need and method of application in a ratio of 1:5 to 1:100.

title_en: Ectoparasite reduction
abstract_en: A method of injuring or killing an aquatic ectoparasite comprises exposing the aquatic ectoparasite to an aqueous solution comprising hydrogen peroxide and exposing the aquatic ectoparasite to sound waves.

title_en: Plant growth regulating compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel strigolactam derivatives, to crop enhancement, plant growth regulator or seed germination promoting compositions comprising these derivatives and to methods of using these derivatives in controlling the growth and physiology of plants and/or promoting the germination of seeds.

title_en: Cyclopentanone compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use as perfuming ingredients, e.g. to impart odor notes of the fruity, fruity-exotic types, of cyclopentanone compounds of formula (I) in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or a mixture thereof, and wherein n represents 1 or 2.

title_en: Hydration of gas streams
abstract_en: Techniques for humidifying a gas stream using a hydration system includes directing a gas stream through a contact zone of at least one hydration system; directing a hydration solution into the contact zone using a pump; contacting the gas stream with the hydration solution; evaporating water from the hydration solution into the gas stream to form a humidified gas stream, transporting the humidified gas stream out of the at least one hydration system; and collecting the remaining hydration solution in a hydration solution collection basin below the contact zone. The at least one hydration system is fluidly coupled to at least one downstream process and the humidified gas stream from the at least one hydration system is transported as a feed stream to the at least one downstream process.

title_en: Aav-compatible laminin-linker polymerization proteins
abstract_en: The present invention relates to recombinant laminin adeno-associated viral vector (AAV) constructs and related methods for restoring laminin expression in deficient mammals, or in mammals with basement membrane instability.

title_en: Lubricants with in-situ formation of dlc layers
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of new lubricants for the in-situ formation of diamond-like carbon (DLC) layers. The invention particularly relates to a lubricant in the form of an oil or grease on the basis hydrocarbons, which contains nonferrous metal particles and simultaneously a nonferrous metal deactivator.

title_en: Herbicidally active substituted phenylpyrimidines
abstract_en: The invention relates to substituted phenylpyrimidines of general formula (I), to their agrochemically acceptable salts (I), and to the use thereof in the field of plant protection.

title_en: Photocurable hydrophilic polymer, coating composition based thereon, hydrophilic lubricant coating, and product
abstract_en: Provided are a photocurable hydrophilic polymer, a coating composition based thereon, a hydrophilic lubricant coating, and a product. The photocurable hydrophilic polymer is formed by the copolymerization of a polymerizable photosensitive monomer having a specific structure and a hydrophilic monomer. The photocurable hydrophilic polymer has high photocuring efficiency, and the preparation method thereof is simple with high production efficiency and less environmental pollution. Further, there is basically no problem of gelation. By curing the coating composition, a hydrophilic coating having high firmness and lubricity and excellent biosafety and compatibility can be obtained.

title_en: Aqueous binder composition
abstract_en: The invention is directed to an aqueous binder composition for mineral fibers.

title_en: Multi-benefit personal care compositions and methods for the same
abstract_en: Personal care compositions and methods for increasing the production of natural moisturizing factors (NMFs) and increasing the production of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) in skin are provided. The personal care compositions may include a carrier and an effective amount of one or more sulfated polysaccharides to increase NMFs and AMPs in skin when applied to the skin.

title_en: Automatic dishwashing composition with dispersant polymer
abstract_en: An automatic dishwashing composition is provided including a builder; a phosphonate; a nonionic surfactant; and a dispersant polymer, comprising: structural units of formula I wherein each R 1  is independently selected from a hydrogen and a ‑C(O)CH 3  group; and structural units of formula II wherein each R 2  is independently selected from a hydrogen and a ‑CH 3  group; and wherein the automatic dishwashing composition contains ≤ 0.1 wt% of dispersant polymer having a lactone end group and wherein the dispersant polymer has a weight average molecular weight of 1,500 to 10,000 Daltons.

title_en: Method for fixed-bed reforming using a catalyst having a particular form
abstract_en: Method for fixed-bed reforming of a hydrocarbon feedstock comprising n-paraffin, naphthenic and aromatic hydrocarbons, at a temperature of between 400 and 700°C, a pressure of between 0.1 and 4 MPa, and a mass flow of feedstock processed per unit mass of catalyst and per hour of between 0.1 and 10 h -1 , by bringing said feedstock into contact with a catalyst comprising platinum, a promoter metal selected from the group consisting of rhenium and iridium, a halogen selected from the group consisting of fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine, and a porous aluminium support in the form of an extrusion characterised by a length 'l' of between 1 and 10 mm, a section comprising four lobes, wherein the largest diameter 'D' of the cross-section of said extrusion is between 1 and 3 mm.

title_en: Antimicrobial peptides
abstract_en: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), small compounds that often exhibit broad spectrum antimicrobial activity, are garnering interest as potential therapeutics against antibiotic- resistant bacterial pathogens. Development of new AMPs is arduous due to the practical limitations of classical protein-based discovery approaches. A high throughput bioinformatics approach is described which is able to confirm identification of known AMPs from the North American bullfrog (Rana (Lithobates) catesbeiana) genome, and a bioinformatics approach is used to develop new AMPs. The described AMPs exhibit antimicrobial activity against Mycobacterium smegmatis via microtitre broth dilution assays, indicating broader efficacy.

title_en: Encapsulated pesticide
abstract_en: A method for encapsulating a pesticide(for example glyphosate) includes the steps of (a) mixing a first biopolymer which is an alginate with a viscosity from 4 to 100 centipoise (a 1% aqueous solution at 20 centigrade) and a second biopolymer in solution, (b) adding the product of step (a) to a solution of pesticide, and (c) adding a surfactant to the product of step (b).

title_en: Process for preparing pellets for firing an industrial furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing pellets which are capable of providing free flowing powder suitable for firing an industrial furnace from municipal and/or other waste, the process comprising the following steps: (i) providing waste material comprising one or more thermoplastic material(s) of more than 40%, based on the total dry weight of the waste and one or more cellulosic material(s) of more than 30%, based on the total dry weight of the waste, wherein the waste has a particle size distribution with more than 80% larger than 5 mm, more than 95% smaller than 60 mm, (ii) subjecting the waste material through a pelletiser with holes between 4-16 mm and a length ratio of more than 2, and subjecting the pellets through a second pelletiser with holes between 4 and 10 mm, and a length ratio of more than 2 to provide pellets with a diameter between 4 and 10 mm, and a length of between 3 and 50 mm. The invention also relates to pellets obtained and having advantageous properties.

title_en: Advanced methods for automated high-performance identification of carbohydrates and carbohydrate mixture composition patterns and systems therefore as well as methods for calibration of multi wavelength fluorescence detection systems therefore, based on new fluorescent dyes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to improved (simplified/easier, more robust and more reproducible) methods for identification of carbohydrates compositions, e.g. out of complex carbohydrate mixtures, as well as the determination of carbohydrate mixture composition patterns (e.g.: of glycosylation patterns) based on advanced internal standards to determine precise and highly reproducible migration and retention time indices using novel fluorescent dyes in combination with high performance separation technologies, like capillary (gel) electrophoresis (C(G)E) or (ultra)high performance liquid chromatography (U)HPLC with a highly sensitive detection like (laser induced) fluorescence detection. In a first aspect, the present invention relates to methods for an automated determination and/or identification of carbohydrates and/ or carbohydrate mixture composition pattern profiling as well as a method for an automated carbohydrate mixture composition pattern profiling based on the use of at least a first and second fluorescent label for labelling the migration/retention time alignment standard and sample or different samples, respectively, whereby the at least one of that fluorescent dye is a compound as defined herein. Moreover, the present invention relates to a method for calibration of multi wavelength fluorescence detection systems as well as calibration systems or calibration standards and new compounds suitable for calibration are described. The present invention relates further to a kit or system for determining or identifying carbohydrate mixture composition patterns as well as a kit or system for determining and/or identifying carbohydrate mixture composition pattern. Further, a carbohydrate dye conjugate comprising the dye as defined herein for use in a method according to the present invention is provided. The dyes employed for forming the carbohydrate dye conjugate have formula A or B below:

title_en: Antimicrobial scaffolds
abstract_en: Three-dimensional printed antibiotic scaffolds are provided as well as methods of use thereof and methods of making.

title_en: Two-part curable composition
abstract_en: The present invention concerns a two-part curable composition comprising: • a first part (component A) comprising at least 51 % by weight based on the total weight of the first part, of one or more cyanoacrylate monomer(s), provided that at least one of the cyanoacrylate monomer(s) is a cyanoacrylate monomer comprising a group -X-O- R b  wherein X is a linear or branched alkylene radical optionally interrupted with one or several oxygen atom(s), and R b  is an alkyl group; • a second part (component B) comprising: at least one Michael acceptor M selected from the group consisting of (meth)acrylic monomers, (meth)acrylic functionalized oligomers, (meth)acrylic functionalized resins, and mixtures thereof, provided that at least one of the Michael acceptor(s) M comprises at least one group of formula -0(CHR a -CH 2 O) n - where n ranges from 1 to 10 (Michael acceptor M1), and R a  represents CH 3  or H; and a nucleophilic initiator; the second part being characterized in that: - the total content of Michael acceptor(s) M1 is of at least 20% by weight based on the total weight of the second part; and - it does not comprise cyanoacrylate monomer.

title_en: Boron-free impregnating solution for a wick and boron-free wick
abstract_en: The invention relates to a boron-free impregnating solution for a wick, to a boron-free wick and to a candle having said wick. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for impregnating a wick with an impregnating solution according to the invention.

title_en: Method for producing a biofuel by steam cracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a biofuel by continuous or discontinuous steam cracking of lignocellulosic biomass, characterized in that: - recording a digital model of the optimal steam cracking parameters as a function of the nature and the content of the contaminants; - introducing a biomass containing at least part of the contaminated biomass into the steam cracking reactor; - measuring at least once during the treatment the nature and content of the contaminants; - controlling the adjustment of the steam cracking parameters as a function of the nature and the content of the measured contaminants and of said digital model.

title_en: Low drift, rainfastness, high uptake and ulv tank mix adjuvant formulation
abstract_en: The instant invention refers to a tank mix adjuvant formulation comprising providing improved drift, high uptake and rainfastness to an agrochemical formulation comprising at least one agrochemical pesticide. Further the invention is directed to the tank mix of an agrochemical formulation comprising at least one pesticide with the adjuvant combination, as well as the use of both the adjuvant formulation and the ready tank mix for ULV applications and conventional spray volume applications.

title_en: Hydrogel compositions comprising protist cells
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to hydrogels composition comprising protist cells. In particular, the present disclosure relates to hydrogel compositions which may be used to encapsulate or suspend ciliated protist cells, and methods of preparing the same. The present disclosure further relates to methods of infecting molluscs with a ciliated protist cell, and methods and compositions for stabilising ciliated protist cells.

title_en: Pitch variable optical devices and systems containing the same
abstract_en: An optical device is provided. The optical device includes an optical grating. The optical grating includes two electrodes arranged opposite to each other and a liquid crystal (LC) composition sandwiched between the electrodes. The two electrodes provide a driving voltage to the optical grating. The LC mixture includes a host LC and one or more LC dimers dissolved as a guest in the host LC. The host LC and the one or more LC dimers have respective dielectric anisotropies of opposite signs in nematic phase. A net dielectric anisotropy of the LC mixture is substantially neutral at a predetermined temperature.

title_en: An acoustic damping material comprising renewable raw materials
abstract_en: The invention is directed to an acoustic damping material comprising a binder matrix comprising a bitumen component or a polymer component, and filler component comprising at least one solid particulate cellulose-containing filler. The acoustic damping material is suitable for use in damping of undesired vibrations and noise in mechanical structures and components of manufactured articles. The invention is also directed to use of the acoustic damping material for damping of vibrations and noise in transportation vehicles and white goods, to a vibration and noise damping element comprising a damping layer composed of the acoustic damping material, to a method for applying a vibration and noise damping element to a noise emitting surface of a substrate, and to a vibration damped system comprising a substrate and the vibration and noise damping element bonded to a noise emitting surface of the substrate.

title_en: Polymer coated particles
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a core-shell particle, wherein the core comprises at least one chemical element, under the provision that in the case that one chemical element is present, said chemical element is not silver, and/or a compound thereof, and the shell comprises a copolymer comprising at least one monomer derived from ethylene dicarboxylic acid and at least one monomer derived from an olefin, to the use of this core-shell particle, and to a process for separating at least one first material from a mixture comprising said at least one first material and at least one second material.

title_en: Polymerizable flame retardant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to non-halogenated and non-metal polymerizable flame retardants, their preparation, compositions containing the same and uses thereof. These flame retardants may be polymerized with other ethylenically unsaturated compounds and chemically bound to the resin matrix thus limiting their migration out of the finished product. The flame retardants of the invention are also more environmentally friendly than conventional halogen-based or metal-based flame retardants.

title_en: Polishing composition
abstract_en: A polishing composition including a colloidal silica containing colloidal silica particles, a pH adjusting agent, and a chelating agent provides a substrate that has a surface having a high flatness, low defects and a low surface roughness with low cost and high productivity, and a substrate having high surface quality suitable as a substrate for mask blanks such as a glass substrate containing SiO 2  as a main component, particularly, as a substrate for mask blanks used in EUVL.

title_en: Use of a paraffinic gasoil
abstract_en: Use of a paraffinic gasoil in a diesel fuel composition for reducing the amount of SCR reagent required by an SCR system fitted to a compression ignition internal combustion engine. The present invention has the advantage that the number of SCR reagent vehicle fills per year is reduced, hence minimising the user's exposure to a corrosive liquid.

title_en: Self-healing oligomers and the use thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are self-healing oligomers according to the structure [UPy – (D m  – U –D m )( 2+q )] – [A(G)( n-1 ) – D m ] k  – Z; wherein UPy, D, m, U, q, A, G, n, k, and Z are defined and described further herein, and wherein the oligomer possesses at least 3 urethane linking groups and comprises a backbone derived from a polyether polyol, a polyester polyol, a poly(dimethylsiloxane), a disulfide polyol, or combinations thereof. Also described and claimed are various compositions containing such oligomers as part of a self-healing component, wherein such compositions also include an optional reactive monomer and/or oligomer component and a photoinitiator component. Yet further described and claimed are articles cured from the compositions elsewhere described using the oligomers elsewhere described.

title_en: Liquid crystal composition having extremely low dielectric loss, and high-frequency component comprising same
Floor cover
