abstract_en: The invention relates to a floor cover (1), in particular a disposable carpet, comprising a textile layer (2), the textile layer (2) comprising a textile material formed from a textile fibre composite, an adhesive layer (3), the adhesive layer (3) comprising an adhesive material, and a cover layer (4), the cover layer (4) comprising a preferably tear-resistant cover film, the textile layer (2), the adhesive layer (3) and the cover layer (4) being arranged substantially parallel to one another, and the adhesive layer (3) being arranged between the textile layer (2) and the cover layer (4), the adhesive layer (3) being designed in such a way that the floor cover (1) is self-adhesive and can be detached again without leaving behind any residue, and the adhesive material being infiltrated at least in part into the textile fibre composite so that the adhesive layer (3) is anchored in the textile layer (2). The invention also relates to a method for producing a floor cover (1).

title_en: A stabilization system for an agrochemical composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a stabilization system for an agrochemical composition comprising at least one steric stabilizer and at least one static stabilizer. The present invention further provides an aqueous insecticidal composition comprising at least one insecticide and said stabilization system. The present invention also discloses process of preparing aqueous insecticidal composition, a method of controlling pests and use of said composition as insecticide.

title_en: Multifunctional film
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multifunctional film for a vacuum bag that may include a flexible barrier film that may include a textured surface. The multifunctional film may further include a release coating overlying the textured surface of the flexible barrier film. The multifunctional film may further have an oxygen (O2) permeability of not greater than about 1100 cc/(m2-day-atm) and a stability rating of not greater than about 90%, where the stability rating is defined as the maximum percent decrease in elongation at break as measured using ASTM D882 after being exposed to a temperature of 200 °C for 12 hours.

title_en: Compositions and methods for detecting pyrophosphate products of enzyme reactions using pyridylazoaniline dyes
abstract_en: Provided herein is a composition comprising an enzyme that releases pyrophosphate from a substrate and a dye of Formula 1. A method for detecting pyrophosphate is also provided. A kit comprising a polymerase that releases pyrophosphate by hydrolysis of nucleoside triphosphates during nucleic acid replication, a divalent manganese salt, and the dye are also provided. The present composition, method and kits provide a way to detect and/or quantify substrates or products of enzyme reacted substrates associated with the release pyrophosphate (e.g., nucleic acid amplification reactions and other reactions that hydrolyze ATP) via a distinct color change without substantially affecting the sensitivity and/or specificity of the reaction.

title_en: Multi-component system
abstract_en: Multi-component system comprising at least one first material and at least one second material, the first material and the second material being available in one or more material portions.

title_en: Colored liquid, colored-liquid set, recording medium, and coloring method
abstract_en: Provided is a colored liquid comprising: a colorant having a naphthalene skeleton in the molecule; a compound having two or more naphthalene skeletons in the molecule (which is neither the colorant having a naphthalene skeleton in the molecule nor a compound having a pyrazine skeleton in the molecule) and/or a compound having a pyrazine skeleton in the molecule (which is not the colorant having a naphthalene skeleton in the molecule); and water. Also provided are a colored-liquid set including the colored liquid, a recording medium on which the colored liquid or the colored liquids of the set have been deposited, and a coloring method in which the colored liquid or the colored-liquid set is used.

title_en: Plant growth promoters
abstract_en: The present invention concerns the use of small molecule DELLA degradation promoters of formula (I) in promoting plant growth.

title_en: Upgrading asphalt by incorporation of bio-oils
abstract_en: Asphalt compositions are provided that include bio-oil. Some compositions allow for upgrading of deasphalter rock to asphalt with a performance grade suitable for use as paving asphalt by addition of bio-oil to the deasphalter rock. Other compositions allow for upgrading of paving grade asphalt to roofing asphalt by addition of bio-oil followed by oxidation. Methods of forming asphalt compositions including bio-oil are also provided.

title_en: Polyimides having low dielectric loss
abstract_en: The present invention relates to novel polyimide polymers containing certain fluorinated diamine moieties, said polyimide polymers being characterized by excellent dielectric performances. The present invention also relates to the use of said polyimide-based polymers in polymer compositions in microelectronics applications.

title_en: Removal of unwanted mineral oil hydrocarbons
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for reducing the content of MOSH and/or MOAH in lauric oil, wherein the process is comprising the step of: a) Splitting a lauric oil into a fatty acid fraction and an aqueous glycerol fraction, b) purifying the fatty acid fraction from step a) into whole distilled lauric oil fatty acids, and c) esterifying the whole distilled lauric oil fatty acids from step b) and glycerol, and obtaining a MOSH and/or MOAH-reduced lauric oil.

title_en: Aqueous pigment dispersion liquid, aqueous ink-jet ink, and dry coating
abstract_en: There is provided an aqueous pigment dispersion that makes it possible to prepare an environmentally conscious aqueous inkjet ink in which a pigment is finely dispersed in a stable manner and at a high level and which is capable of recording an image having excellent durability, glossiness, color developability, and adhesiveness to various printing substrates. The aqueous pigment dispersion is an aqueous pigment dispersion containing a pigment, water, a water-soluble organic solvent, and a polymeric dispersant that disperses the pigment, wherein the polymeric dispersant is a polymer including a constitutional unit (i) derived from at least one of (meth)acrylic acid and itaconic acid, and a constituent unit (ii) derived from a (meth)acrylate derived from biological material, such as ethyl (meth)acrylate, having an acid value of 30 to 250 mgKOH/g, having a number average molecular weight of 1,000 to 30,000, and having a polydispersity index (weight average molecular weight/number average molecular weight) of 2.5 or less, wherein the content of the constituent unit (ii) is 50% by mass or more, and at least part of carboxy groups are neutralized with an alkali.

title_en: Lubricant composition
abstract_en: An object is to provide a lubricating oil composition having excellent low-temperature storage stability, excellent copper corrosion resistance, and a high fuel efficiency. Then, this object is achieved by using a lubricating oil composition containing a base oil (A), a molybdenum-based friction modifier (B), and a benzotriazole-based compound (C). The molybdenum-based friction modifier (B) contains a specific compound (B1), a content of the benzotriazole-based compound (C) is 0.03 mass% or less based on a total amount of the lubricating oil composition, and a kinematic viscosity at 100°C of the lubricating oil composition is 9.3 mm 2 /s or less.

title_en: Self-preserving compositions and multi-use dispensers for administering alpha-1062
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-preserving anti-microbial pharmaceutical composition, comprising a compound Alpha-1062 or salt thereof, wherein the composition is essentially absent of additional antimicrobial preservatives. The invention relates preferably to such compositions in the form of a liquid. The invention further relates to a multi-use dispenser configured for transmucosal administration of a pharmaceutical composition in the form of a liquid comprising Alpha-1062 or salt thereof. The invention further relates to Alpha-1062 or salt thereof for use in the treatment of neurological disease in a subject, wherein said subject suffers additionally from a microbial infection, or for use in treating a microbial infection. The invention further relates to a method of killing a microorganism or a method for disinfecting, e.g. disinfecting a pharmaceutical composition, comprising contacting a microorganism with Alpha-1062 or salt thereof.

title_en: Pigment for meat substitute compositions
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are pigment compositions for meat substitutes and meat substitutes including such pigment compositions. The pigment compositions include a thermolabile AlacDFX variant polypeptide, e.g. a thermolabile DFX polypeptide including a sequence at least 80% identical to SEQ ID NO:1 and including a mutation at a position selected from the group consisting of I76, H68, E106, K58, E108, K90, I15, I16, I89, Q88, F102, Y80, Y7, and combinations thereof relative to SEQ ID NO:1. The pigment compositions provide a pink and/or red color to a meat substitute composition that transitions to a brown color after cooking.

title_en: Novel method for removing demulsifiers from a feedstock
abstract_en: Present invention relates to a novel method or process for removing or reducing demulsifiers from a feedstock.

title_en: Method and plant for processing biological substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for processing biological substrate, comprising the steps of: a) introducing the biological substrate into an apparatus for dry fermentation, b) carrying out dry fermentation to recover methane, forming fermentation residue, c) transferring the fermentation residue obtained in step b) to an apparatus for solid-liquid separation, d) carrying out solid-liquid separation of the fermentation residue, forming a fermentation residue solid phase and a fermentation residue raw liquid phase, e) transferring the fermentation residue raw liquid phase obtained in step d) to an apparatus for separating solids, f) carrying out separation of solids from the fermentation residue raw liquid phase, recovering a fermentation residue liquid phase, g) introducing the fermentation residue liquid phase obtained in step f) into an apparatus for wet fermentation, h) carrying out wet fermentation to recover methane, forming liquid fermentation residue, i) returning at least some of the liquid fermentation residue formed in step h) as inoculum to the apparatus for dry fermentation.

title_en: Aqueous ink composition, ink set, printed matter, and production method for printed matter
abstract_en: One object of the present invention is to provide an aqueous ink composition with a high degree of freedom in adjustment to an optimum hue and with a high optical density, without causing color unevenness or muddiness in printed matter, and with favorable ejectability. An aspect of the present invention relates to an aqueous ink composition for use in an inkjet recording method comprising: an aqueous pigment dispersion having a hue angle h 1  in L*C*h color space determined using a spectrophotometer; and an aqueous dye composition having a hue angle h 2  in L*C*h color space determined using a spectrophotometer, wherein the hue angle h 2  of the aqueous dye composition satisfies predetermined conditions.

title_en: Temperature-stabilization of convertible functional inks by disruption of conduction paths
abstract_en: An ink stabilizing composition includes a polymeric network including an acrylate polymer and a plurality of high aspect ratio particles each having an aspect ratio of about 2:1 to about 30:1 and an average particle diameter of about 0.5 to about 1.2 micrometers.

title_en: Nano bio-carrier with plant additives combined with chemical fertilizers
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are fertilizer compositions formed by a method comprising reacting an aqueous polysaccharide and cross-linking agent to provide a polysaccharide polymer scaffold; reacting the polysaccharide polymer scaffold with a plant additive under conditions effective to form a polysaccharide nanocomposite; and combing the polysaccharide nanocomposite with a urea fertilizer to form an aqueous urea-polysaccharide nanocomposite solution; and evaporating or freeze drying the urea-polysaccharide nanocomposite solution to provide a urea- polysaccharide nanocomposite. The urea-polysaccharide nanocomposite may be applied to soil as the fertilizer composition.

title_en: Apparatus and process for hydrocarbon steam cracking
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for hydrocarbon steam cracking, more specifically to a cracking furnace for steam cracking a hydrocarbon feedstock, wherein the furnace comprises one or more reactor tubes for transporting the hydrocarbon feedstock and dilution steam; wherein each reactor tube comprises one or more tube passes, and wherein the furnace comprises an electrically heated infrared emitter comprising one or more electrically powered heating elements for transferring heat to the reactor tubes, and wherein the furnace comprises an enclosure surrounding the one or more reactor tubes and the electrically heated infrared emitter. The present invention also relates to a process for hydrocarbon steam cracking using said apparatus.

title_en: Composition comprising hueing agent
abstract_en: This invention relates to a laundry care composition comprising a laundry care ingredient and a polymeric thiophene hueing agent.

title_en: Synthetic fuel and production method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing synthetic fuel from water and carbon dioxide. The method includes the steps of (a) preparing water-derived hydrogen, (b) preparing carbon dioxide, (c) introducing the hydrogen and carbon dioxide into a first reaction to produce a first product comprising synthesis gas, (d) introducing the synthesis gas into a second reaction to produce a second product comprising syncrude, (e) dividing the syncrude oil into a plurality of fractions comprising a first fraction, (f) introducing at least one fraction of the plurality of fractions into a hydrogenation reaction to produce a third product, and (g) recovering a fraction corresponding to a boiling point range of the first fraction from the third product. The present invention also provides an aviation fuel produced by the method.

title_en: Low viscosity lubricating oil
abstract_en: A lubricating oil composition for internal combustion engine with a roller follower type valvetrain is disclosed. The composition includes major amount of an oil of lubricating viscosity; one or more magnesium detergents in an amount to provide 100 to 1000 ppm of magnesium to the lubricating oil composition; 0.1 to 0.5 wt% of organic friction modifier; and d) optionally a viscosity modifier present at no more 0.5 wt%. The composition is substantially free of molybdenum friction modifier and has a total boron content ranging from 20 to 200 ppm.

title_en: Formaldehyde-free aqueous pigment composition and coated articles prepared with the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a formaldehyde-free aqueous pigment composition comprising (A) an aqueous emulsion comprising a hydroxyl group functionalized copolymer, (B) an aqueous dispersion comprising a carboxylic acid group functionalized (co) polymer, (C) pigment and (D) thickener. The aqueous pigment composition can be used for forming delicate printing pattern on the surface of various substrates and has superior performance properties such as washing resistance, bond strength, weathering resistance, yellowing resistance, cracking resistance, delamination resistance, and the like. A coated article having a coating layer formed with the aqueous pigment composition is also disclosed.

title_en: Propellants and emulsification compositions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a stable micro-emulsion comprising: water; a water soluble, hydroxy-containing polymeric material; (c) at least one a hydrotrop; and (d) a propellant comprising trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene.

title_en: Alkoxy heteroaryl- carboxamide or thioamide compounds
abstract_en: Compounds of formula (I) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim 1, and the agrochemically acceptable salts, stereoisomers, enantiomers, tautomers and N-oxides of those compounds, can be used as insecticides.

title_en: Thermal management method
abstract_en: A passive thermal managing method adopts immersion cooling for a battery pack, comprising: providing a battery pack, comprising a thermal conducting shell, a plurality of battery cells, and a circulation space, wherein the battery cells and the convection space are in the thermal conducting shell; vacuuming the battery pack; immersing the battery cells with a dielectric liquid, wherein a natural circulation of the dielectric liquid is formed in the circulation space for transferring heat, wherein the dielectric liquid comprises a plurality of fillers for reducing a viscosity of the dielectric liquid.

title_en: Primer coating system and composition for achieving excellent water resistance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a primer coating system comprising at least two components A) and B) being different and separate from one another, wherein component A) inter alia comprises besides at least constituent a2) at least one condensation product a3), which is obtainable at least by reaction of (i) at least one organosilane bearing at least one hydrolyzable group with (ii) at least one kind of silica, wherein component B) comprises at least one organic constituent b2) bearing on average two or more NCO-groups, a primer coating composition obtainable by mixing at least components A) and B) with each other or a 1K primer coating composition comprising besides a film-forming polymer at least the aforementioned condensation product a3), a use of said primer coating composition according to claim for improving water and/or moisture resistance of cured coating films and multilayer coating obtainable therefrom, a method of coating a substrate by at least applying said primer coating composition, a coated substrate obtainable therefrom, a method of preparing a multilayer coating system comprising at least one primer coating film obtainable from said primer coating composition and a multilayer coating system as such.

title_en: Storage stabilization agent for stabilizing aqueous compositions, process for stabilizing and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a storage stabilization agent for stabilizing an aqueous composition upon storage comprising at least two different water soluble or water dispersible ion sources selected from the group consisting of water soluble or water dispersible source of bismuth ions, water soluble or water dispersible source of magnesium ions, water soluble or water dispersible source of sodium ions, water soluble or water dispersible source of potassium ions and water soluble or water dispersible source of zinc ions. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an aqueous preparation comprising the storage stabilization agent, a process for stabilizing an aqueous preparation upon storage as well as the use of the storage stabilization agent for stabilizing the pH value of an aqueous preparation or preventing microorganisms as well as viruses and/or bacteriophages from growing or both.

title_en: Method for increasing flavonoid content in plant through treatment with low-molecular-weight sulfur compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for increasing the flavonoid content in a plant, comprising treating the plant with a sulfur compound; a method for producing a plant with increased flavonoid content; a plant with increased flavonoid content, produced by the production method; an antioxidant composition or food composition comprising the plant, an extract thereof or a fraction thereof; and a composition for increasing the flavonoid content in a plant, comprising a compound represented by Formula (1) or (2) as an active ingredient. The sulfur compounds S17 and 3-(2-S) of the present invention activate the flavonoid pathway, which is a repository of various functional secondary metabolites, and thus, may strongly trigger the accumulation of functional flavonoids when applied to crops, thereby efficiently improving the added value of crops.

title_en: Method for the replication of a hologram by means of an optical adhesive film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for the replication of a hologram into a light-sensitive composite web. The method according to the invention preferably comprises providing a master element comprising a substrate body and at least one master hologram, applying a light-sensitive composite web to a surface of the master element, exposing the master element in order to replicate the at least one master hologram into the light-sensitive composite web, and detaching the exposed composite web from the master element. The method furthermore comprises temporarily applying an optical adhesive film between the light-sensitive composite web and the surface of the master element. The optical adhesive film mediates an optical contact between the master element and the light-sensitive composite web during the exposure. In a further aspect, the invention relates to a method for the replication of a hologram into a light-sensitive composite web using a coupling-in element, wherein an optical adhesive film is introduced between composite web and coupling-in element.

title_en: Systems and processes for temperature control in fluidized catalytic cracking
abstract_en: A process for controlling catalyst temperature in a fluidized catalytic cracking ("FCC") system includes regenerating a spent catalyst feed in a regenerator at a first temperature to produce a regenerated catalyst feed, withdrawing at least a portion of the regenerated catalyst feed to a reactor, and cooling the portion of the regenerated catalyst between an outlet of the regenerator and an inlet of the reactor. A fluidized catalytic cracking ("FCC") system includes a catalyst regenerator configured and adapted to regenerate a spent catalyst feed at a first temperature to produce a regenerated catalyst, a reactor downstream from an outlet of the catalyst regenerator, a catalyst cooler between the outlet of the catalyst regenerator and an inlet of the reactor. The catalyst cooler is configured and adapted to cool at least a portion of a regenerated catalyst from the catalyst regenerator. In embodiments, the FCC system is a downer FCC system including at least one downer reactor and a spent catalyst riser regenerator.

title_en: Lubricating oil composition
abstract_en: There has been a demand for a lubricating oil composition that has excellent cooling performance and insulating properties. This lubricating oil composition contains a base oil (A), solid particles (B) that have an average primary particle diameter of 500 nm or less, and a dispersant (C); the content of the solid particles (B) is 0.1 to 30% by mass based on the total amount of the lubricating oil composition; and the content of the dispersant (C) is 0.1 to 20% by mass based on the total amount of the lubricating oil composition.

title_en: Curable silicone compositions containing additives
abstract_en: The invention relates to curable compositions based on polyorganosiloxanes with silicon-containing terminal groups, a polymer having at least one silane-functional group, and optionally at least one curing catalyst. The invention also relates to adhesive, sealant, and/or coating materials comprising said composition and the use of said composition.

title_en: Method for the treatment of complex waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for treating a mixture M1 comprising at least organic matter, the method comprising: a) a step of hydrolysing the mixture M1 making it possible to obtain a hydrolysed mixture M1h; b) pressurising the mixture M1h in order to obtain a stream M1p; c) a step of heating the mixture M1p resulting from step b) in order to obtain a mixture M2; d) a solubilisation step carried out on at least one fraction of the mixture M2 resulting from step c), optionally a heating step, and a separation step in order to obtain a stream M4 enriched with soluble materials and a stream M3 depleted of soluble materials; e) a step of cooling and expanding at least one fraction of the stream M4 enriched with soluble materials resulting from step d) in order to obtain a stream M5; and f) a digestion step implemented on at least one fraction of the stream M5 resulting from step e).

title_en: Gas-solid co-current downflow fluidised bed reactor with homogeneous flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a process for gas-solid co-current downflow fluidised bed catalytic cracking comprising/using: a pipeline (1) suitable for carrying a downflow (4) of catalyst particles; a mixing chamber (2) connected to the pipeline (1) and suitable for being fed by the pipeline with a downflow, the mixing chamber comprising an inner wall and at least one first injector (5) of hydrocarbon feed (6); a gas-solid co-current downflow fluidised bed reactor (3) connected to the mixing chamber and suitable for being fed by the mixing chamber with a mixture comprising catalyst particles and hydrocarbon feed, the downflow gas-solid co-current fluidised bed reactor comprising an inner wall, wherein the inner wall of the mixing chamber and/or of the downflow gas-solid co-current fluidised bed reactor comprises one or more obstacles (9).

title_en: Polypeptides having protease activity for use in detergent compositions
abstract_en: In the present invention new protease enzymes are provided. More specifically, genetically engi- neered protease enzymes, compositions comprising the enzymes, and methods of making and using the enzymes or compositions comprising the enzymes are provided.

title_en: Two component intumescent coating system
abstract_en: A liquid intumescent coating composition comprising a resin system is described herein. The resin system comprises at least one polymeric component, one or more ethylenically unsaturated monomeric components, an inhibitor, and at least one intumescent ingredient. The coating composition is provided as a two-pack system that can be applied via a single-leg spray process and is curable to a solid state in a free-radical polymerization reaction.

title_en: Pyrimidinone derivatives as pesticidal compounds
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound of formula (I) G(I), wherein the variables are defined in the specification. It also relates to a pesticidal mixture comprising the compound of formula (I); the use of compounds of formula (I) as an agrochemical pesticide; a method for combating or controlling invertebrate pests, a method for protecting growing plants from attack or infestation by invertebrate pests, seed comprising a compound of the formula (I); the use of a compound of the formula (I) for protecting growing plants from attack or infestation by invertebrate pests; and a method for treating or protecting an animal from infestation or infection by invertebrate pests.

title_en: A plurality of microcapsules and use thereof in polymers
abstract_en: A plurality of microcapsules having a cross-linked polymeric shell encapsulating an active ingredient, wherein the crosslinked polymeric shell comprises or consists of at least one polymer selected from aliphatic epoxidized poly acrylates, e.g. soy bean oil acrylates, bisphenol A based epoxy acrylates, glyceryl propoxy triacrylates, difunctional polyester acrylate oligomers, aliphatic polyester based urethane dimethacrylates or diacrylates and amine modified polyether acrylates. A plurality of microcapsules having a mechanical resistance such that when a dispersion of the plurality of microcapsules in an inert medium is submitted to a shear stress of equal to or greater than 3 kPa at a temperature of about 20°C the rate of broken capsules observed by microscopy after submitting said dispersion to said shear stress for 10 minutes is less than 10%.

title_en: Composition for organic light-emitting element encapsulation and organic light-emitting display device comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for encapsulating an organic light-emitting device and an organic light-emitting display apparatus including the same, and more specifically, to a composition for encapsulating an organic light-emitting device and an organic light-emitting display apparatus including the same, wherein the composition not only secures the performance and lifespan of an organic light-emitting device by effectively blocking, from the outside, moisture or oxygen flowing into an organic light-emitting display apparatus, but also has low permittivity characteristics to improve touch sensitivity of a touch panel.

title_en: Multifunctional vitrimer composites
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semi-finished product comprising at least one vitrimer, a method of joining using the semi-finished product with a subcomponent, a component produced by the method, and a method of debonding such component.

title_en: Pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet
abstract_en: Provided is a pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet that can be suppressed from being increased in peel strength even when an aqueous pressure-sensitive adhesive composition is used. The pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet includes: a base material; and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer formed of a water-dispersed pressure-sensitive adhesive composition containing a water-dispersed polymer. A surface concentration of a carboxyl group in a surface of the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer obtained by an X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (ESCA) gas-phase chemical modification method is equal to or less than a detection limit.

title_en: Pollen activation solution
abstract_en: A pollen activation solution (1) includes: an aqueous solution containing a substance that activates pollen germination and pollen tube elongation; and a powdered carbon constituent added to the aqueous solution. The carbon constituent has not been subjected to an activation treatment. Examples of the substance that activates pollen germination and pollen tube elongation, which can be used herein, include sucrose, boric acid, magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, calcium chloride, potassium chloride, and gelatin. An example of the powdered carbon constituent that can be used herein is bamboo leaf charcoal powder made by pulverizing bamboo leaf charcoal.

title_en: Diamond-based polishing compositions with improved silicon carbide removal rate
abstract_en: Provided is a polishing composition for polishing semiconductor wafer surfaces, including a surface-modified monocrystalline diamond with a D(50) particle size ranging from about 0.10 μm to about 1 μm; a vehicle selected from the group consisting of water-based vehicles, glycol-based vehicles, oil-based vehicles, and hydrocarbon-based vehicles; and optionally one or more additives. Further presented are associated methods for polishing semiconductor wafer surfaces.

title_en: Photochromic article, spectacles, and method for producing photochromic article
abstract_en: Provided is a photochromic article having a substrate, a primer layer formed from a primer layer forming polymer composition, and a photochromic layer containing a photochromic compound in this order. The primer layer forming polymer composition contains a polymer having a hydroxy group and a (meth) acryloyl group, and a blocked isocyanate.

title_en: Alkaline composition, its use and a process for cleaning substrates comprising cobalt and copper
abstract_en: The presently claimed invention relates to an alkaline composition for cleaning a substrate comprising i) copper or copper alloy and ii) cobalt or cobalt alloy, the composition comprising: a) at least one pH adjustor selected from compound of formula (I), wherein Ra, Rb and Rc are independently of each other selected from unsubstituted linear or branched C 1 -C 5  alkyl, with the proviso that at least one of Ra, Rb and Rc is not same, such that two or more of Ra, Rb and Rc may be bonded to form one or more 5 or 6 or 7 membered rings; b) at least one complexing agent selected from C 2  to C 12  hydrocarbon having at least two sulfonic acid or carboxylic acid groups, c) at least one polymeric dispersing agent having a weight average molecular weight ≥ 1000 g/mol; and d) a solvent comprising water.

title_en: Method to improve a plant's growth, development and resistance to (a)biotic stress
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to improve the growth, development and/or resistance to abiotic stress/biotic stress of a plant.

title_en: Stabilized liquid boron-free enzyme compositions
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid boron-free enzyme composition, comprising aliphatic 1,2-diols, which exhibit excellent physical and microbial stability.

title_en: Bioreactors for growing micro-organisms
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bioreactor (100, 200, 400) for growing micro-organisms in a reaction mixture (102A, 102B) comprising a reaction medium and micro-organisms. The bioreactor comprises a first reaction chamber (104), a second reaction chamber (110) and means for connecting (116, 206, 208, 410) the first reaction chamber to the second reaction chamber. The first reaction chamber has first volume for containing first number of micro-organisms, a first input (106) for providing reaction mixture thereto, and a first output (108) for removing excess gases (122) therefrom. The second reaction chamber, arranged downstream from first reaction chamber, has a second volume for containing a second number of micro-organisms, a second input (112) for providing gases thereto, and a second output (114) for removing reaction mixture therefrom. The means for connecting is the sole input for allowing the reaction mixture to flow from the first reaction chamber to the second reaction chamber and for gases to flow from the second reaction chamber to the first reaction chamber.

title_en: Method of detecting an analyte
abstract_en: A method of identifying a target analyte in a sample containing a light- emitting marker configured to bind to the target analyte and detecting emission from the light-emitting marker. The light-emitting marker comprises a light-emitting polymer comprising a repeat unit of formula (I): The analyte may be a target cell and the method may be flow cytometry.

title_en: Fuel gas mixture and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fuel gas mixture and use thereof for a gas burner, in particular to generate heat for heating a space and/or supplying hot water. The fuel gas mixture comprises a methane gas substitute, in particular propane or butane, and hydrogen in pre-definable proportions and use thereof. The fuel gas mixture has properties relevant to combustion that are substantially like those of methane, including a Wobbe index, flame temperature or minimum air requirement substantially like that of methane.

title_en: Composition containing coolant, use thereof, and refrigerator having the same and method of operating the refrigerator
abstract_en: To provide a novel low-GWP mixed refrigerant.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a composition containing a coolant. The coolant contains trans-1,2-difluoroethylene (HFO-1132(E)), 1,1-difluoroethylene (HFO-1132a) and 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoro-1-propene (R1234yf) and difluoromethane (R32).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Gas generator
abstract_en: To provide a gas generator whose gas output characteristic is improved.SOLUTION: A gas generator includes a cylindrical peripheral wall part provided with a gas jetting port, a top plate part for closing one end in an axial direction of the peripheral wall part, and a bottom plate part for closing the other end in the axial direction of the peripheral wall part. The gas generator further includes a short cylindrical housing having a combustion chamber accommodating a gas generating agent in its interior, and an igniter that is assembled to the bottom plate part and includes an ignition part accommodating transfer charge which is ignited during operation. The gas generator also includes a cup-shaped member composed of a single bottomed cylindrical member that includes a transfer chamber accommodating the transfer charge in its interior and arranged to be protruded toward the combustion chamber such that the interior space faces the ignition part. The cup-shaped member is composed of a brittle material and is ruptured, deformed, or melted in response to the operation of the ignitor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet and intermediate laminate
abstract_en: To provide a pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet of which the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer can be colored by being irradiated with an active ray in an optional timing, and with which the part other than the colored part can be suppressed from being colored by external light, and to provide an intermediate laminate obtained by using the pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet.SOLUTION: A pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet 1 includes a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer 2 composed of a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition of which the visible light transmittance at a wavelength of 550 nm can be lowered by irradiation of an active ray. The pressure-sensitive adhesive composition includes a pressure-sensitive adhesive polymer being a polymer of a monomer component, a compound colored with an acid, and a photoacid generator. The photoacid generator has a maximum absorption wavelength at 300 nm or less in a wavelength range of 250-400 nm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Compositions and methods comprising thermolysin protease variants
abstract_en: To provide thermolysin enzymes, nucleic acids encoding the same, and compositions and methods related to the production and use thereof.SOLUTION: Provided are a thermolysin enzyme variant or an active fragment thereof comprising an amino acid substitution for a parent thermolysin enzyme having at least 90% sequence identity with an amino acid sequence consisting of a particular sequence, the substitution occurring at a productive position, the productive position and the amino acid substitution being selected from the group consisting of Q283E, A180E, I244T and T48E, and the amino acid positions of the thermolysin variant being numbered by correspondence with the amino acid sequence of thermolysin shown in an amino acid sequence consisting of the above particular sequence; and a cleaning composition comprising at least one thermolysin enzyme variant.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound having perfluoroalkyl group, and use therefor
abstract_en: To provide a nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound having a perfluoroalkyl group and having a suitable light emission wavelength, and a technique for use of it.SOLUTION: This nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound having a perfluoroalkyl group has N carbazole rings (N being an integer greater than or equal to 2), wherein two adjacent carbazole rings are linked by (A) a direct bond, (B) a bond mediated by a π-conjugated linking group or (C) a condensation bond, and the total number of perfluoroalkyl groups substituent in the N carbazole rings is greater than or equal to 1 and less than 2N.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Double-sided adhesive sheet
abstract_en: To provide a double-sided adhesive sheet which can be repeatedly used many times for attaching, processing, and detaching a work-piece, such as a film-like substrate and a semiconductor member, to a conveyance tool, capable of suppressing static build-up by peeling, and hard to peel off even when impact is applied to the double-sided adhesive sheet.SOLUTION: The double-sided adhesive sheet is obtained by laminating a first conductive adhesive layer, a metal layer, and a second conductive adhesive layer, where the first conductive adhesive layer and the second conductive adhesive layer contain a silicone adhesive, and a conductive filler, the adhesive strength of the first conductive adhesive layer is greater than that of the second conductive adhesive layer, and the sheet has a conductivity in a thickness direction penetrating through the first conductive adhesive layer and the second conductive adhesive layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coating material set
abstract_en: To provide a coating material which suppresses progress of deterioration such as discoloration and cracking caused by a pattern coated film while activating designability of the pattern coated film, and can hold appearance over a long period of time.SOLUTION: The coating material set forms a laminate coated film having transparency. The coating material set is composed of at least a first coating material and a second coating material. The first coating material and the second coating material each contain a resin component containing 20 wt.% or more of alkyl (meth)acrylate (A) having an alkyl group having 3 or more carbon atoms as a binder in a resin component, and contain alkyl (meth)acrylate (a1) having an alkyl main chain having 3 or more carbon atoms as the component (A). When a weight ratio of the component (a1) in the component (A) is represented by r, r(r1) in the binder of the first coating material is larger than r(r2) in the binder of the second coating material.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Crosslinking block copolymer and hot-melt adhesive
abstract_en: To provide a cross-linking block copolymer excellent in coating property due to low viscosity, and excellent in the adhesion property, in particular, in the peel resistance, and a hot-melt adhesive using the same.SOLUTION: A crosslinking block copolymer of the present invention comprises a polymer block A containing a crosslinkable monomer unit, and a polymer block B, in which, after crosslinking, a shorter spin-spin relaxation time T2 (1) is 40 to 90 μsecond when the decay curve obtained by the solid echo method is fitted to the two-component relaxation curve using the nonlinear least squares method at 1H pulse NMR (20 MHz) at 40°C, and a component ratio A1 of the relaxation curve having the spin-spin relaxation time T2 (1) is 10 to 35%.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Oil-based ink composition for writing instruments, water-based ink composition for writing instruments and ballpoint
abstract_en: To provide an ink composition for writing instruments having excellent dispersibility of a coloration component, and a ballpoint that includes such an ink composition for writing instruments and has excellent writing feel and high handwriting fastness.SOLUTION: The foregoing problem is solved by an ink composition for writing instruments containing a compound having a specific structure.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Continuous-type inkjet ink composition
abstract_en: To provide a continuous-type inkjet ink composition that has excellent storage stability, excellently prevents a metal member from rusting, and allows for printing with excellent image quality.SOLUTION: A continuous-type inkjet ink composition contains a pigment and a resin, contains thiocyanate metal salt of 0.05-1.7 mass% in the composition, and contains tetraalkylammonium hexafluoro phosphate of 0.05-2.7 mass% in the composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Pressure-sensitive adhesive composition and pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet
abstract_en: To provide a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition in which curing inside the film progresses sufficiently during photo curing even when a thick film is formed, which provides a cured product excellent in adhesion and step following properties and hardly causing whitening and yellowing under wet heat conditions, and further to provide a pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet using the pressure-sensitive adhesive composition for an adhesive sheet.SOLUTION: There is provided a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition comprising a (meth)acrylic acid ester copolymer and a photopolymerization initiator, in which the photopolymerization initiator is a dialkyl peroxide having a thioxanthone skeleton represented by the following general formula (1) (where R1, R2, R3 and R4 each independently represents a methyl group or an ethyl group, R5 represents an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms or a phenyl group, R6 is an independent substituent and represents an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms, an alkoxy group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms or a chlorine atom, and n represents an integer of 0 to 2).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polishing agent composition
abstract_en: To provide a polishing agent composition which enables the rise in the post-polishing flatness of a polished surface and the increase in polishing rate while suppressing noise of carriers during polishing in polishing an oxide monocrystalline material substrate.SOLUTION: A polishing agent composition comprises: silica particles; a water-soluble polymer compound; and water. The silica particles include: small-size silica particles of 10-60 nm in average particle diameter; and large-size silica particles of 70-200 nm in average particle diameter. The proportion of a mass of the small-size silica particles to a total mass of the small-size silica particles and large-size silica particles is 50-95 mass%. The water-soluble polymer compound consists of polysaccharide, and it is used to perform a polishing treatment of a lithium tantalate monocrystalline material or lithium niobate monocrystalline material.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Insect proof net
abstract_en: To provide an insect proof net which has less impact applied to an environment, and is excellent in an insect pest entry prevention effect.SOLUTION: There is provided an insect proof net obtained by adhering at least one kind of fatty acid ester of glycerin selected from the following group consisting of: at least one kind of fatty acid ester of glycerin including, glycerol caprylate, diglycerol caprylate, glycerol diacetomonocaprylate, glycerol diacetomonocaprate, triglycerol mono-dicaprylate, and triglycerol mono-dicaprylate, the fatty acid ester of glycerin including as a constituent fatty acid, capric acid and/or caprylic acid; at least one kind of fatty acid ester of glycerin including laurate as a constituent fatty acid and being selected from glycerin diacetomonolaurate and diglycerol laurate; and at least one kind of fatty acid ester of glycerin including oleate as a constituent fatty acid, and being selected from glycerol tri-olate, diglycerol mono-diolate, decaglycerol olate and glycerol diacetomonoolate.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Polymer photopolymerization sensitizer
abstract_en: To provide a photopolymerization sensitizer which will not cause problems of dusting or coloring of a cured product by bleeding of additives such as the photopolymerization sensitizer on the surface, such as by blooming, at the time of photo-curing or during storage of the cured product, and which imparts a practically sufficient photo-curing rate.SOLUTION: A polymer photopolymerization sensitizer contains an oligomer of a 9,10-bis(substituted oxy)anthracene compound having repeating units represented by the general formula (4) in the figure. (In the general formula (4), n represents a repetition number and is from 2 to 50; X and Y are identical or different and each represent a hydrogen atom, a C1-8 alkyl group, or a halogen atom; and G represents a C1-20 alkylene group or a C6-20 arylene group, where the alkylene group may comprise an oxygen atom, a nitrogen atom, a sulfur atom, a benzene ring or a naphthalene ring).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Silk protein coating
abstract_en: To provide a novel, suitable method for modifying an inert synthetic material or inorganic material, for example, an inert synthetic thread or inorganic thread, after production, preferably at a low temperature and without using a toxic solvent.SOLUTION: A method for coating a naturally occurring material with a silk polypeptide, comprises the steps of: i) preparing a solution which comprises at least one silk polypeptide comprising at least two identical repetitive units and a solvent; and ii) applying the solution on the naturally occurring material and thereby coating the naturally occurring material with the silk polypeptide. In the method for coating the naturally occurring material with the silk polypeptide, the naturally occurring material is at least one selected from the group consisting of hair, skin, and cotton.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Conductive laminate, adhesion structure using the same, natural potential measurement sensor, chloride ion sensor and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a conductive laminate that can be firmly adhered to an adherend in a state of exhibiting high conductivity.SOLUTION: The problem is solved by a conductive laminate that is characterized by a conductive laminate of a conductive hot-melt adhesive layer and a conductive layer each containing a thermoplastic resin and a conductive filler, and in which the volume resistivity of the conductive hot-melt adhesive layer is 1×10-1 Ωcm or more and less than 1×103 Ωcm and the volume resistivity of the conductive layer is 1×10-5 Ωcm or more and less than 1×100 Ωcm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Connecting body and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ensure conductivity between electronic components and a circuit board and to prevent shorts between electrode terminals of electronic components even when a wiring pitch of the circuit board and electrode terminals of electronic components are finer pitched. 
     SOLUTION: In a connecting body 10 in which electronic components 18 are connected via an anisotropic conductive adhesive 1 on a circuit board 12, the anisotropic conductive adhesive 1 has a configuration in which conductive particles 4 are regularly arranged in a binder resin 3, connecting electrodes 19 formed on the electronic components 18 and board electrodes 17 formed on the circuit board 12 are misaligned in a direction of arrangement of the connecting electrodes 19 and board electrodes 17, the minimum distance in the direction of arrangement of the connecting electrodes 19 and the board electrodes 17 is less than four times the particle diameter of the conductive particles 4, and distances between the conductive particles 4 in a space 23 between the connecting electrodes 19 are longer than distances between the conductive particles 4 trapped between the substrate electrodes 17 and the connecting electrodes 19.

title_en: Antifogging article and production method of the same
abstract_en: To provide an antifogging article excellent in water scale-removing property, suppressing elusion of a hydrophilic agent, and excellent in antifogging property.SOLUTION: The problem is solved by adopting an antifogging article based on the hydrophilic property of a water-absorbing resin, which comprises: a water-absorbing resin coat comprising a cured product of a water-absorbing resin composition containing a water-absorbing polyol having an oxyethylene unit as the repeating unit, and an acrylic polyol; a hydrophilic agent; a colloidal silica; and a base material having the coat on the main surface.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Lubricant oil composition
abstract_en: To provide a novel lubricant oil composition capable of exhibiting excellent energy saving performance.MEANS FOR SOLVING THE PROBLEM: The lubricant oil composition is characterized by including: (A) lubricant oil base oil comprising at least one selected from mineral oil, PAO and GTL (Gas to Liquid) base oil and; (B) a polyalkylene glycol (PAG) comprising a structure obtained by the addition polymerization of propylene oxide alone with an alcohol or a structure obtained by the addition polymerization of a combination of propylene oxide, and ethylene oxide and/or butylene oxide with an alcohol, with an oxygen/carbon weight ratio therein being 0.35 or more and less than 0.45, and/or a compound obtained by blocking either or both of the terminal hydroxy groups of the polyalkylene glycol (PAG); and (C) a fatty acid ester with an oxygen/carbon weight ratio therein being from 0.05 to 0.35.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Aqueous ink for inkjet recording
abstract_en: To provide an aqueous ink for inkjet recording capable of preventing migration of a chemical substance such as a surface active agent contained in an ink even in recording to a water non-absorbing recording medium, and capable of obtaining a recorded article excellent in image quality such as solid printing evenness and whiteness degree.SOLUTION: An aqueous ink for inkjet recording for a water non-absorbing recording medium includes: a white pigment; a polymer particle; a water-soluble organic solvent; a surface active agent; and water, where the surface active agent includes an acetylene glycol-based surface active agent (a), and a polyether-modified silicone-based surface active agent (s), the content of the acetylene glycol-based surface active agent (a) is 1.2 mass% or more in the aqueous ink, and the mass ratio (s)/(a) of the polyether-modified silicone-based surface active agent (s) to the acetylene glycol-based surface active agent (a) is 0.4-1.2.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Thermal conductor
abstract_en: To provide a thermal conductor exhibiting excellent substantial thermal conductivity for a long term.SOLUTION: A thermal conductor according to the present invention comprises a plurality of thermal conduction parts, and bonding parts to bond the plurality of thermal conduction parts. The bonding parts consist of a material including a hardened object of a curable resin material functioning as a binder and resin fibers with a thickness of 1.0 μm or more and 30 μm or less. It is preferable that the resin fiber is made of polyester, particularly polyethylene terephthalate. It is preferable that the thermal conduction parts contain graphite. It is preferable that the thermal conduction parts are substantially made of a single component.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Active energy ray-curable resin composition and substrate with cured coating film
abstract_en: To provide an active energy ray-curable resin composition capable of forming a cured coating film which is excellent in anti-slip properties and caster resistance while having excellent smoothness without impairing an aesthetic appearance.SOLUTION: The active energy ray-curable resin composition of the present invention contains (A) a urethane (meth)acrylate having a structure derived from caprolactone, (B) a (meth)acrylate monomer, and (C) silica particles. The apparent volume of the silica particles (C) is 15% or more based on the total volume of the active energy ray-curable resin composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Organic electroluminescent compound, multiple host materials, and organic electroluminescent device including the same
abstract_en: To provide an organic electroluminescent compound, multiple host materials, and an organic electroluminescent device including the same.SOLUTION: An organic electroluminescent compound represented by the formula. The organic electroluminescent compound and/or multiple host materials according to the present disclosure allow an organic electroluminescent device with low driving voltages and/or high luminous efficiency and/or long lifetime characteristics to be manufactured.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Water-in-oil emulsion ink
abstract_en: To provide a water-in-oil emulsion ink that has high storage stability and gives a printed material to show little deformation after printing when the ink is applied to plain paper, and a method for producing the water-in-oil emulsion ink.SOLUTION: An water-in-oil emulsion ink has an aqueous phase in an oil phase, the aqueous phase containing a pigment and a polymer dispersant A, the pigment being at least one yellow pigment selected from a disazo pigment, a benzimidazolone monoazo pigment, and a quinoxaline pigment, and the water-in-oil emulsion ink having a water content of 20 mass% or less. There is also provided a method for producing the water-in-oil emulsion ink.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Organopolysiloxane and coating composition containing the same
abstract_en: To provide an organopolysiloxane that gives a cured product having both hardness and bending resistance and also having excellent hydrophobicity and water droplet slip-down properties, can be quickly cured even when an amine compound is used as a curing catalyst, and also gives a composition for coating having high safety.SOLUTION: Disclosed is an organopolysiloxane having a constituent unit represented by a formula (1), a constituent unit represented by a formula (2), and a group represented by a formula (3) that is directly bonded to a silicon atom. (R1 represents an alkyl group or an aryl group.) (R2 each independently represents an alkyl group or an aryl group, n is each independently 2 or 3, and m is an integer of 5 to 100.) (R3 represents a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group, or an aryl group.)SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Surface protective film and optical component
abstract_en: To provide a surface protective film and an optical component which have a wide application range of an adherend, reduce contamination on the adherend, and suppress a peeling charge voltage.SOLUTION: A surface protective film 10 includes a base material film 1, an adhesive layer 2, and a release film 3. The adhesive layer 2 is formed of an adhesive containing a (meth)acrylate copolymer, an antistatic agent, a silicone-based surface active agent, a fluorine-based surface active agent, and a crosslinking agent. The crosslinking agent crosslinks the (meth)acrylate copolymer.
