title_en: Nitride fluorescent material and light emitting device
abstract_en: To provide a nitride phosphor capable of obtaining a higher luminous flux when constituting a light-emitting device.SOLUTION: A nitride fluorescent material includes a group 2 element including at least one selected from the group consisting of Mg, Ca, Sr, and Ba, Eu, Si, Al, and N in a composition, wherein a ratio of a total molar content of the group 2 element and Eu to a molar content of Al in the composition is 0.8 or more and 1.1 or less, a ratio of a molar content of Eu is 0.002 or more and 0.08 or less, a ratio of a molar content of Si is 0.8 or more and 1.2 or less, and a ratio of a total molar content of Si and Al is 1.8 or more and 2.2 or less. In the nitride fluorescent material, an average value of an aspect ratio, which is a ratio of a minor axis to a major axis, is 0.72 or more and 0.77 or less, and an average circularity is 0.82 or more and 0.92 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Grease composition for constant velocity universal joint and constant velocity universal joint
abstract_en: To provide a grease composition for a constant velocity universal joint capable of improving boundary lubrication performance and further improving wear resistance and peeling resistance to obtain high durability, and to provide the constant velocity universal joint.SOLUTION: The lubricating oil composition comprises a grease containing a base oil, a thickener and an extreme pressure additive, and a traction oil, wherein the weight% of the traction oil is ≥1 wt.% and ≤50 wt.%.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for manufactruing a fire extinguishing film with fire extinguishing function constaining fire extinguishing capsules
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a fire extinguishing film with a fire extinguishing function containing a fire extinguishing capsule realized to manufacture a fire extinguishing film containing a fire extinguishing capsule containing a fire extinguishing agent. The method includes: a base film preparation step of manufacturing a base film; an adhesive solution application step of applying an adhesive solution to the lower side of the base film; a release paper attachment step of attaching release paper to the adhesive surface of the base film to which the adhesive solution is applied; and a coating solution application step of applying a flame retardant coating solution containing a fire extinguishing capsule containing a fire extinguishing agent on the upper side of the base film by using a coating device.

title_en: Composition of Buoy using Recycled Composite Resin and Glass Bead and Manufacturing Method of Buoy using thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for a buoy using a recycled composite resin and glass beads and a manufacturing method of a buoy using the same, wherein the composition contains 55 to 65 wt% of the recycled composite resin and 35 to 45 wt% of the glass beads, and by optimally containing the glass beads in the recycled composite resin, the strength of the buoy is improved and a molding time is shortened by speeding up a cooling rate, and there is an advantage that glass bead powder is uniformly distributed in the recycled composite resin by optimizing molding temperature.

title_en: Organic and inorganic hybrid-type sanitary safety flooring materials combined with inorganic silver ceramic powder and soluble urethane and implant type construction method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flooring material with excellent impact resistance and chemical resistance. The flooring material according to the present invention comprises: a resin part including a water-soluble urethane A part including caster oil, water, and diisononyl phthalate and a urethane curing agent B part including isocyanic acid polymethylenepoly phenylene ester, and diphenyl methane diisocyanate; and a C part including white cement, alumina cement, slaked lime, silica sand having a particle size of 90-110 mesh, silica sand having a particle size of 60-80 mesh, silica sand having a particle size of 18-30 mesh, a white dye and silver nano antibacterial powder, wherein the A part is contained in an amount of 10-20 wt%, the B part is contained in an amount of 10-20 wt%, and the C part is contained in an amount of 65-75 wt%.

title_en: Method for manufacturing Washing tablet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a detergent tablet for washing and, more specifically, to a detergent tablet for washing that has been improved in many aspects. The detergent tablet for washing of the present invention is coated with a film that dissolves in water so that it is not easily decomposed during storage due to excellent moisture barrier properties thereof. The detergent tablet for washing also dissolves easily in washing water and generates thick and longer-lived bubbles when washing, thereby allowing a user to get a bubble washing effect. Furthermore, the detergent tablet for washing of the present invention is made of eco-friendly ingredients, so that it can prevent environmental pollution.

title_en: Air dome house with bottom finishing film
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air dome house equipped with a lower finishing film, in which loss of air pressure and soil through the ground of a space part spaced between an inner house and an outer house can be prevented by a lower finishing film, so that the management efficiency of the air dome can be improved. To this end, according to the present invention, in an air dome house in which an inner house (10) maintaining a constant air pressure inside is formed in a dome shape and an outer house (20) is configured to surround the outside by forming a space part (S) spaced apart from the inner house (10) at a predetermined distance, a lower finishing film (30) is embedded at a certain depth in the ground of the space part (S) between the inner house (10) and the outer house (20), and both ends of the lower finishing film (30) are connected to an inner film fixing part (11) of a lower portion of the inner house and an outer film fixing part (21) of a lower portion of the outer house.

title_en: antibacterial picture frame
abstract_en: Provided is an antibacterial picture frame, comprising: a picture frame wherein a seating groove is formed on the upper surface; and an antibacterial sheet which is seated in the seating groove, which shows deodorization and antibacterial functionality, and wherein a picture or a photo are printed thereon. An objective of the present invention is to provide the antibacterial picture frame having excellent deodorization and antibacterial functionality.

title_en: Laundry detergent for desalting and color transfer prevention containing natural surfactant and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laundry detergent for desalination and color transfer prevention which comprises a detergent composition including a naturally derived surfactant, and a water-soluble polymer film for packaging the detergent composition, wherein the detergent composition contains 20 to 40 wt% of a first naturally derived surfactant, 1 to 15 wt% of a second naturally derived surfactant, 1 to 25 wt% of a high molecule polymer, 5 to 15 wt% of polyethylene glycol, 5 to 15 wt% of a solubilizing agent, 1 to 8 wt% of natural oil, and 1 to 8 wt% of an enzyme.

title_en: Furniture handle with antibacterial and advertising function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a furniture handle having an antibacterial function and an advertising function, which prevents the spread of various infectious diseases, comprising: a handle body (10); an assembly (20) of a metal material; an antibacterial coating body (30) molded of a synthetic resin material; an LED lamp (40); a cover member (50) made of a transparent or translucent material; and a filter sheet (60) to be observed from the outside.

title_en: Paint composition with thermal insulation performance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a paint composition having thermal insulation performance, which is formed by mixing, based on 100 parts by weight of a main raw material of a paint in which a resin selected from polyurethane resin, vinyl chloride resin, silicone resin, and isocyanate resin is dissolved in ketone or ester: 2 to 2 parts by weight of propylene glycol; 5 to 10 parts by weight of butylacryl-2ethylhexyl acrylate methyl methacrylic acid-acrylic silane copolymer; 20 to 30 parts by weight of colloidal silica; 5 to 10 parts by weight of an antibacterial agent; 5 to 10 parts by weight of a plasticizer; 3 to 6 parts by weight of an emulsifier; 10 to 15 parts by weight of pozzolan or cenosphere; 20 to 30 parts by weight of Insullad; and 5 to 10 parts by weight of a fragrant substance. The paint composition causes no harm to the human body.

title_en: A square tube member for non-welding construction and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a non-welded architectural square tube member and a method of manufacturing the same, which not only do not require welding work, but also do not require the use of nuts, and improve constructability by simplifying joint and joining work. The present invention relates to an architectural square tube member used as a sub-member of a building, such as a sub-column installed between main columns of a steel building or a window frame for installing windows. According to the present invention, the architectural square tube member has a cylindrical fastening tube with a female thread on at least one of the four sides of the square tube protruding toward an inner space of the square tube, and paint is applied to the outer surface. The fastening tube has a removable filler material inserted to prevent the inflow of the paint.

title_en: Eco-friendly coating type anti-slip paving material and the manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly coating-type anti-slip packaging material and a manufacturing method thereof, and more specifically, to an eco-friendly coating-type anti-slip packaging material which has excellent adhesion to a road surface by forming a coating by applying an eco-friendly material to an anti-slip paint, and has improved antibacterial properties, snow removal properties, wear resistance, and durability, and a manufacturing method thereof. According to the present invention, the packaging material includes an anti-slip paint, a water repellent, a snow-removing agent, and an antimicrobial agent, and an anti-slip agent that is used by recycling an eco-friendly material, wherein the anti-slip agent is applied by mixing a shell with silica at a weight ratio of 1.5 to 2.0:1.2 to 1.7.

title_en: Method of waterproofing construction using eco-friendly inorganic elastic coating waterproofing agent
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a waterproofing construction method using an eco-friendly inorganic elastic coating waterproofing agent which improves waterproof properties by applying a waterproof structure having an inorganic elastic coating waterproof layer with an elongation percentage of 120-150%. The waterproofing construction method using an eco-friendly inorganic elastic coating waterproofing agent comprises: a background surface cleaning step (S1) of breaking a protruding portion and a rising portion of a construction portion, and removing impurities hindering adhesion of a waterproofing material; a primer coating step (S2) of mixing primer consisting of inorganic powder and aqueous acryl emulsion by an electric blender, and then coating and drying the mixture on the construction portion with one among a brush, a roller, and a spray to be overlapped in a horizontal direction and a vertical direction to form a primer layer; a concrete putty construction step (S3) of mixing concrete putty consisting of inorganic powder and aqueous silicon emulsion by an electric blender, and then filling small and large openings of the construction portion with a rubber scraper or a darby for plastering; and a waterproof layer coating step (S4) of coating and drying an inorganic elastic coating waterproofing agent three times to be overlapped in a horizontal direction and a vertical direction to form a waterproof layer with an elongation percentage of 120-150%.

title_en: Construction method of anti-skid road pavement with sound generating function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of constructing anti-slip road pavement, and more specifically to a method of constructing road pavement material that has a sound source generation function, and significantly improved physical properties such as anti-slip performance, durability and wear resistance. The present invention may include a surface modification step; a first anti-slip layer formation step; an embossed surface treatment step; an intermediate curing performing step; and an uneven surface treatment step.

title_en: Polyurea paint composition and its construction method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyurea paint composition and a method for application thereof, and more specifically, to a polyurea paint composition having light-absorbing, waterproofing, and antibacterial properties and a method for application thereof. The polyurea paint composition of the present invention comprises: a first component comprising at least one of a polyether polyol resin, an amine, a fluoropolymer, an additive, and a solvent; and a second component comprising at least one of a polyether polyol resin, an isocyanate, and a solvent. The polyurea paint composition application method of the present invention comprises: a first step of preparing a polyurea paint composition; a second step of forming a lower layer on an application target; a third step of applying the polyurea paint composition to an upper surface of the lower layer; a fourth step of drying the application target; and a fifth step of controlling the application thickness.

title_en: Eco-friendly water-based coating insulation composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly aqueous coating heat insulation composition and, more specifically, to an eco-friendly aqueous coating heat insulation composition which can exhibit an excellent heat insulation effect by forming a coating film after being applied to the surface of a material, and can improve safety when applying inner and outer walls of a building due to excellent flame retardancy and heat resistance. To this end, the heat insulation composition comprises purified water, aerogel, porous mineral powder, an ethylene-based copolymer, and an additive.

title_en: Manufacturing Method of Connector of Lazer medical device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a laser treatment device connection rod, wherein a technical feature of the present invention comprises: a step (Step 1) of increasing a surface roughness by surface-treating a surface of an aluminum alloy extrusion material; a step (Step 2) of preparing a binder solution; a step (Step 3) of manufacturing an aluminum alloy extrusion material treated with a bonding agent by immersing the aluminum alloy extrusion material with increased surface roughness in the bonding agent solution for 20 minutes and drying the same at a temperature of 50-55℃ for 30 minutes; and a step (Step 4) of coating 100 parts by weight of the aluminum alloy extrusion material treated with the bonding agent with 1-5 parts by weight of a composition for a thin film, thereby having an advantage of being able to suppress the occurrence of scratches on the laser treatment device connection rod, and having an advantage of excellent adhesion between the laser treatment device connection rod and a coating material.

title_en: Bridge waterproofing method using waterproofing materials for bridge surfaces
abstract_en: The present invention comprises the steps of: removing ascon pavement on an upper portion of a bridge; forming a primer layer by applying a primer on the removed upper portion of the bridge; forming a waterproof layer by applying a waterproof material on an upper portion of the primer layer; installing a protective material on an upper portion of the formed waterproof layer; and pavement of ascon on an upper portion of the protective material, wherein the primer comprises 60-65 wt% of oxidized asphalt and 35-40 wt% of hydrodesulfurization naphtha, and the waterproof material comprises: 100 parts by weight of a waterproof material comprising 15 wt% of natural asphalt, 65 wt% of straight asphalt, and 20 wt% of synthetic resin; and 100 parts by weight of a fine aggregate binder comprising 70 wt% of fine aggregate, 1 wt% of reinforcing fiber, and 29 wt% of cement.

title_en: Method for manufacturing packaging materials using eco-friendly ink composition for gravure printing
abstract_en: The method for manufacturing a packaging material using an eco-friendly water-based ink composition for gravure printing according to the present invention is the water-based ink composition in which a solvent used in the ink composition is a water-based ink composition containing ethanol and water as main components, and thus is not eco-friendly during conventional gravure printing, is harmful to the human body, and has a low flash point, thereby minimizing the problem of increasing the risk of workers during the printing process. In addition, long-term stability of the printing process is excellent, such as maintaining initial printing quality for a long period of time by minimizing a plate-mame problem even when the long-term printing process is continuously performed. Furthermore, the present invention minimizes the amount of volatile organic compounds used, thereby being eco-friendly, improving human body stability, improving drying properties compared to a conventional alcohol-based ink composition during printing, having excellent printing speed and working speed, and providing a high-quality printed matter having excellent color development power, peeling strength, and the like.

title_en: Natural fertilizer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a natural fertilizer manufactured by including a natural product and a method for manufacturing the same. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps: manufacturing a first extract by mixing and pulverizing coffee gourd, banana peel, and kelp, and then extracting with water; manufacturing a second extract by extracting with water, alcohol, or an aqueous alcohol solution after pulverizing at least one raw materials selected from a group consisting of Portulaca oleracea, Gingko biloba leaves, Helianthus tuberosus, Melia azedarach, and Cinnamomum verum; and mixing and aging the first extract and the second extract. According to the present invention, it is possible to save resources by recycling the discarded natural materials and to prevent environmental pollution caused by chemical fertilizers.

title_en: Novel compound and organic light emitting device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel compound and an organic light emitting device using the same. The present invention provides a compound represented by chemical formula 1. The compound represented by the chemical formula 1 can be used as a material for an organic layer of the organic light emitting device, and can improve efficiency, lower driving voltage, and/or improve lifespan characteristics in the organic light emitting device.

title_en: White light emitting material comprising luminescent aluminum hydroxide and white light emitting device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a white light emitting material including a luminescent aluminum hydroxide and a white light emitting device including the same. According to the present invention, synthesis thereof can be easy and excellent white light emission characteristics can be shown even in a long wavelength region (300 to 750 nm) by using a single inexpensive inorganic material without using an existing expensive rare earth metal as a white light emitting material.

title_en: Bio-Diesel with Palm oil
abstract_en: The present invention relates to biodiesel using palm oil and a manufacturing method therefor, wherein the method comprises: a heating step; an oxidation step; a mixing step; and a separation step, and problems of environmental pollution can be solved and high efficiency and practicality becomes possible.

title_en: A semi-nonflammable insulation material and manufacturing method for it
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semi-noncombustible heat insulating material and a manufacturing method thereof. In particular according to the present invention, as the semi-noncombustible heat insulating material comprising a heat insulating material layer and a surface layer, a nonwoven fabric is bonded to a cover layer of the surface layer. The nonwoven fabric comprises a flame retardant coating layer coated with a curved mixture comprising: a) graphite; b) a binder; c) sugar; and d) calcium carbonate. According to the present invention, the semi-noncombustible insulating material and the manufacturing method of the semi-noncombustible insulating material which can be manufactured with high productivity. The semi-noncombustible insulating material is with excellent flame retardancy, with excellent waterproof properties, can significantly reduce generation of harmful gases in case of fire, with excellent thermal insulation properties, is lightweight and easy to be installed, with excellent strength, with a beautiful appearance, and durable. A method of manufacturing a semi-non-combustible insulating material that can be manufactured with high productivity can be provided.

title_en: An ecofriendly Anti-biotic deodorizaton composition and a process for the preparation thereof
abstract_en: An anti-biotic disinfectant and deodorant composition of the present invention is a volatile clear distillate obtained from cinnamon, ginkgo leaves, honeysuckle, licorice, pine needles, and oak leaves through distillation, thus providing an excellent deodorizing ability without leaving any sediment and, as well as providing an effect of having antibacterial activity to inhibit or sterilize the growth of microorganisms. Thus, the anti-biotic deodorant composition of the present invention uses a distillate obtained by using only eco-friendly natural materials, and thus is not harmful to the human body even when used at home tables, sinks, and refrigerators and can be also used as a hand sanitizer at office or restroom. Furthermore, the composition has an excellent deodorizing effect for pet animals, is harmless, and environmentally friendly, and thus can be used in various fields related to people's lives, such as deodorization, food, water treatment, life, and hygiene.

title_en: Nutrient solution supply device of solid raw material dispensing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solid raw material dispensing-type nutrient solution supply device including: nutrient solution raw material powder storage portions storing different types of nutrient solution raw material powder; a nutrient solution raw material powder extraction unit installed in each nutrient solution raw material powder storage portion and measuring the amount of the nutrient solution raw material powder and then extracting the measured nutrient solution raw material powder; a nutrient solution raw material powder moving unit supplied with the extracted nutrient solution raw material powder and then supplied with raw water so that the nutrient solution raw material powder moves through the raw water; and a nutrient solution tank accommodating the moved nutrient solution raw material powder and the raw water and accommodating a nutrient solution produced by supply of the raw water after the accommodated nutrient solution raw material powder is dissolved in the raw water.

title_en: functional soundproofing block for preventing deformation and purifying air and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a functional soundproof block which prevents deformation and purifies an air and a manufacturing method thereof. The functional soundproof block which prevents the deformation and purifies the air of the present invention is light due to formation of fine pores of perlite chips, and has excellent sound insulation, deodorization and heat insulation, utilizes non-combustible properties, and is composed of various material combinations. In order to achieve an objective of the present invention, the functional soundproof block is composed of a multi-layer structure so as not to be affected by a sudden temperature change, and each layer is configured to have a unique function to effectively exhibit a function.

title_en: Etchant compositions and methods of manufacturing semiconductor device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an etching composition and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device using the same, wherein the etching composition includes an inorganic acid and a silane-based compound. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an effective oxide film height (EFH) can be easily adjusted as an etching rate of an oxide film is adjusted because the etch selectivity of a nitride film is high.

title_en: Composition for antibiotic, deodorizing and anti-virus using natural products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibacterial, deodorizing and antiviral composition comprising only natural products including Eutrema japonicum extracts, processed green tea leaf extracts, Zanthoxylum piperitum, Lespedeza cuneata extracts, Citrus bergamia extracts, rice husk charcoal powder and the like, and specifically, to a natural product-derived antibacterial, deodorizing and antiviral composition that is harmless to a human body and consistently exhibits excellent antibacterial, deodorizing and antiviral functions.

title_en: Method for producing oil from PET
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for efficiently emulsifying waste PET as a method of recycling waste PET together with PP and PE which have been mainly used for emulsifying waste plastics in the prior art. The present invention can increase the yield of fuel oil that can be obtained by adding metal oxide, activated carbon, choline chloride, and the like during hydrolysis of waste PET.

title_en: Method for producing organic fertilizer having activity of plant disease control using spent mushroom substrate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing an organic fertilizer having plant disease controlling activity using a medium after harvesting mushrooms. The organic fertilizer of the present invention is an eco-friendly fertilizer simply prepared at low cost using waste medium that is discarded after being used for mushroom cultivation, and can be effectively used for controlling plant diseases.

title_en: Surface protecting adhesive film for semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: The present invention provides an adhesive film for protecting the surface of a semiconductor wafer having excellent interfacial adhesion. The present invention includes a substrate layer, an uneven absorption layer and an adhesive layer.

title_en: Functional red pepper, red pepper powder, and functional food, and method of manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to functional pepper, red pepper powder, functional food using the same and a method for manufacturing the same and, more specifically, to: red pepper cultivated and harvested which contains a quercetin ingredient, which is a type of flavonoid; red pepper powder using the same; red pepper paste containing an anti-cancer ingredient by using the same; red pepper paste food; and a method for manufacturing the same. The present invention comprises the steps of: preparing a functional mixture concentrate containing a quercetin concentrate, a humic acid concentrate, and a calcium concentrate in order to cultivate functional red pepper (S1); preparing a fertilizer solution by mixing the functional mixture concentrate prepared in the step (S1) with water (S2); and cultivating and harvesting the functional red pepper by continuously spraying the fertilizer solution, prepared through the step (S2), on red pepper seedlings for 28 to 35 days, and after planting the dicotyledonous red pepper seedlings in the field, irrigating the field, on which the red pepper seedlings are planted, with the fertilizer solution by 2.5 to 3.5 L per pyeong once a week. A food material which can conveniently supply the quercetin can be provided.

title_en: Covalently bonded fluorescent nanoparticles of mesoporous silica particles with beta-diketone europium complexes and preparation method therefore
abstract_en: The present invention relates to porous silica fluorescent nanoparticles including beta-diketone europium complexes by covalent bonds and a method for manufacturing the same, and more specifically, to porous silica fluorescent nanoparticles including beta-diketone europium complexes by covalent bonds and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the porous silica fluorescent nanoparticles have high luminescence properties by introducing a silane coupling agent layer that is a covalent bond medium on the surface of porous silica, and performing a step-by-step coating process to activate functional groups capable of covalent bonds on the surface of porous particles, and being chelated into a lanthanide-based beta-diketone europium complex.

title_en: Cmp slurry composition for polishing tungsten pattern wafer and method for polishing tungsten pattern wafer using the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are: a CMP slurry composition for polishing tungsten pattern comprising a solvent, and silica satisfying formula 1 and formula 2; and a method for polishing a tungsten pattern wafer using the same. In the present invention, there is no need to use different polishing compositions in each step according to the polishing film quality in the tungsten pattern wafer polishing process.

title_en: An antibacterial composition comprising champsocephalus gunnari extract or notothenia rossii extract
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antibacterial composition comprising an antarctic meckel smelt (Champsocephalus gunnari) extract or antarctic marbled blackfish (Notothenia rossii) extract as an active ingredient. Since the antarctic meckel smelt (Champsocephalus gunnari) extract or antarctic marbled blackfish (Notothenia rossii) extract of the present invention has excellent antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, a composition containing it as an active ingredient has an antibacterial activity and can be usefully used in as pharmaceuticals (external skin preparations), quasi-drugs, food, all-purpose cleanser (skin cleanser, hair cleanser, vaginal wash, mouthwash, bathroom cleaner, kitchen detergent, etc.), preservatives (cosmetic preservatives, food preservatives, pharmaceutical preservatives), antiseptic, additive (food additive, cosmetic additive, feed additive) material as well as cosmetics. In particular, the Champsocephalus gunnari or Notothenia rossii is edible as natural substances, so the antibacterial composition of the present invention containing an extract derived therefrom has the advantage of remaining safe even for long-term use.

title_en: Wet fatty acid coating process through wastewater recycling
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wet fatty acid coating process through wastewater recycling and, more specifically, to a wet fatty acid coating process comprising: (a) a coating agent preparation step of mixing a predetermined amount of water, fatty acid, and a surfactant to prepare a coating agent; (b) a wet coating step of supplying a raw material in a powder form and water at a given ratio to introduce the coating agent prepared in the coating agent to coat the surface of the powder through heating and agitation; (c) a sludge separation step of separating sludge and process water from the mixed solution in the wet coating step by using a filter press; (d) a drying step of drying the sludge extracted in the sludge separation step; and (e) a coating completion step of storing the sludge dried in the drying step and packaging the same, wherein the process water separated in the sludge separation step is recovered and then recycled to the wet coating step. According to the present invention, the generated process water is recovered and recycled in the wet coating process without being discharged or treated as wastewater when coating flame retardant magnesium hydroxide or aluminum hydroxide powder with fatty acid in a wet mode, thereby preventing environmental pollution. In addition, the process water heated in advance is reused to save energy necessary for performing reheating in the wet coating process.

title_en: A Reusable correcting tape device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reusable correction tape device. More specifically, after using up all a correction tape with correction fluid applied to one side to correct incorrect letters, it is possible to use the other side of the correction tape with adhesive applied to reuse the correction tape as an adhesive tape. In a process of winding the crystal tape with one side facing outward in the first drum section, the other side is wound toward the outside. In addition, a simple structure is applied to facilitate a process of replacing the positions of the first and second drum parts for reuse. In addition, multiple correction tape devices with different colors of correction tapes can be easily connected and carried together for use.

title_en: Composition for controlling plant diseases and pests comprising culture solution of Streptomyces sp. JCK-6131 strain or extract thereof, manufacturing methods thereof and controlling method for plant diseases and pests
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for controlling plant diseases and pests comprising a culture solution of a Streptomyces sp. JCK-6131 strain or an extract thereof, a manufacturing method thereof and a method for controlling plant diseases and pests, and when the culture solution of the strain or the extract thereof is treated, antibacterial activity and induction resistance are excellent to be used to control the plant diseases and pests.

title_en: Ink composition for direct writing of structure color structure and method for manufacturing structure color structure using same
abstract_en: Disclosed is an ink composition for direct-writing a structural color structure, which includes silica particles dispersed in polymer and does not include a volatile solvent, wherein the polymer is capable of hydrogen bonding with the silica particles, and the silica particles are included in the ink composition at a volume fraction of φ_tr-0.05 to φ_tr-0.01, and φ_tr is the solid phase transition volume fraction of the ink composition. According to one aspect of the present invention, the ink composition provides effects of enabling mass-production customized to various shapes to be manufactured and enabling printing without restrictions on a substrate. In addition, when a structural color structure is manufactured by using the ink composition, there are advantages of, unlike existing processes, not requiring the evaporation of a dispersion medium to be manufactured in a short time, having high viscoelasticity to facilitate control of the flow rate so that printing can be performed at high speeds, and adjusting the viscosity of the dispersion medium according to the desired characteristics to manufacture a photonic crystal structure or optical glass structure.

title_en: Paint composition for prevention of root
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-root epoxy paint composition in which 15 to 25 parts by weight of a hardener is mixed based on 100 parts by weight of a main material. The main material includes: 5 to 15 wt% of a BPA type resin; 5 to 15 wt% of rubber modified epoxy; 5 to 20 wt% of urethane-modified epoxy; 50 to 80 wt% of a filler; and 4 to 11 wt% of a freeze resistance agent, so that the durability of a building can be maintained stably while implementing a rooftop greening system.

title_en: Multifunctional exfoliated graphite filler and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention manufactures a red phosphorus-exfoliated graphite binder by putting a red phosphorus with excellent flame retardancy and electric insulation and an exfoliated graphite with excellent electrical conductivity and thermal conductivity into a ball miller and ball-milling the same to physically bind the red phosphorus and the exfoliated graphite. Then, silica particles providing electric insulation are attached to the red phosphorus-exfoliated graphite binder, a filler with excellent flame retardancy and thermal conductivity but low electric conductivity is manufactured. The filler manufactured thereby is put into a matrix (epoxy resins, phenol resins, etc.), and the matrix is heated, pressed, and cooled, and accordingly, a composite material with flame retardancy, insulation, and heat dissipation can be manufactured. According to the present invention, flame retardancy, electric insulation, and heat conductivity of the filler can be easily adjusted.

title_en: Adhesive composition with excellent adhesion and reliability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an adhesive composition having excellent adhesion and reliability and, more specifically, to an adhesive composition that includes a first resin containing a cationically curable functional group and a second resin containing a radically curable functional group as a heterogeneous resin, and has excellent adhesion and adhesion reliability.

title_en: Polyester film with reduction in rainbow and oligomer precipitation
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a polyester film excellent in reducing rainbow phenomenon and oligomer precipitation phenomenon. The polyester film of the present invention comprises a primer layer formed of a composition containing a binder on at least one side of a base film, wherein the binder contains 50 to 70 parts by weight of refractive polyester with a refractive index of 1.59 to 1.61, 15 to 35 parts by weight of crosslinkable polyester with a glass transition temperature (Tg) of 60 to 90℃, and 5 to 25 parts by weight of a urethane resin, based on 100 parts by weight of a total binder.

title_en: Novel bacteriophage effective for soft rot bacteria and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel bacteriophage and a use thereof and, more specifically, to: an isolated bacteriophage with the accession number, KCTC14860BP that has a specific killing ability for Pectobacterium odoriferum; a pesticide composition containing the bacteriophage as an active ingredient; an antibacterial agent containing the bacteriophage as an active ingredient; a disinfectant or detergent containing the bacteriophage as an active ingredient; a Pectobacterium carotovorum lysis method including a step of treating the bacteriophage; and a Chinese cabbage soft rot controlling method including a step of treating the bacteriophage. The novel bacteriophage of the present invention has a specific killing ability for Pectobacterium odoriferum and has excellent acid resistance and heat resistance to be used for preventing or treating Chinese cabbage soft rot caused by the Pectobacterium carotovorum and also to be widely used as an antibacterial agent, a disinfectant, a detergent, or the like.

title_en: Light-emitting element, display device, electronic device, and lighting device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a light-emitting device with high luminous efficiency. The present invention is a light-emitting device having a first organic compound and a second organic compound, which is a combination of the first organic compound and the second organic compound forming an excited complex. The first organic compound is a compound which exhibits phosphorescence without fluorescence at any temperature ranging from low temperature to room temperature. The luminescence quantum yield of the first organic compound is 0% or more and 40% or less at room temperature. The light emitted by the light-emitting device is the light emitted by the exciplex formed from the first organic compound and the second organic compound.

title_en: Evaporative rust inhibitor with excellent long-term rust prevention properties
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vaporizable rust inhibitor with excellent long-term rust resistance, which replaces an organic solvent with a water-soluble solvent without using dichan or dipan, which is harmful to the human body, so that the manufacturing cost is low, the working environment is pleasant, the health of workers is promoted, and there is no risk of wastewater or pollution, thereby being eco-friendly.

title_en: Heterorhabditis megidis NB-GJ1-2, control composition comprising the same, and control method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heterorhabditis catgidis nb-gj1-2 nematode, a pest control composition comprising the same, and a pest control method using the same. the nematode and the composition according to the present invention exhibit an effect of effectively controlling pests without exhibiting harm, thereby being expected to be used as an insecticide for plant pests.

title_en: Hard coating composition, hard coating film and flexible display window
abstract_en: The hard coating composition of the embodiments of the present invention may include a compound represented by chemical formula 1. Accordingly, a hard coating film having improved mechanical properties and bending properties can be manufactured. In Chemical Formula 1, R_1 and R_2 are each independently a single bond, a C_1 to C_10 hydrocarbon group, or a C_2 to C_10 ether group, and m and n are each independently an integer of 1 to 10.

title_en: Antibacterial functional filling composition
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide an antibacterial filling composition for a wet-type air conditioner that can prevent evaporation of water stored in a cyclone body of a wet-type air conditioner and impart an antibacterial function. The present invention provides an antibacterial filling composition for a wet-type air conditioner containing water, ethanol, and essential oil. The present invention imparts an antibacterial function to a wet-type air conditioner and prevents evaporation of water, thereby increasing a replacement cycle of the filling composition, and allows an aromatherapy effect to be enjoyed with the refreshing scent of natural oil.

title_en: Soil management sheet comprising lactobachillus complex and plant byproducts and biological soil management method of soil pollution
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a soil improvement sheet including lactobachillus complex and plant byproducts and a biological soil improvement method of soil pollution using the same capable of preventing acidification of soil. The soil improvement sheet including lactobachillus complex and plant byproducts comprises: a matrix layer including natural powder and the lactobachillus complex; and a mineral layer formed at a lower part of the matrix layer.

title_en: Recycled resin and ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer composition and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a recycled resin and an ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer composition and a method for preparing the same. specifically, the present disclosure relates to an adhesive composition and a method for preparing the same, in which a certain level of pcr resin is easily distinguished by a capillary rheometer and the ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer is mixed, thereby having excellent processability, low gel content, and excellent adhesion.

title_en: Manufacturing method of crayon and crayon produced by the same method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing crayons and crayons produced by the same method. More specifically, the invention relates to a method for manufacturing crayons that are harmless to the human body and can protect the user's skin by adding coconut oil to wax and pearl pigment, and to crayons produced by the same method. According to the present invention, the method for manufacturing crayons comprises: a first step of putting pearl pigment and colored starch into a predetermined container; a second step of heating and melting beeswax; a third step of heating and melting paraffin wax; a fourth step of putting the beeswax obtained in the second step and the paraffin wax obtained in the third step into the container, and mixing them with the pearl pigment and the colored starch to produce a viscous material, wherein the fourth step includes a process of adding coconut oil having antibacterial properties into the container to be added to the viscous material; and a fifth step of pouring the viscous material produced in the fourth step into a mold and cooling it to manufacture the crayon.

title_en: Method for manufacturing inorganic antibacterial agents and organic antibacterial agents mixed hybrid antibacterial coating angents and coating method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a hybrid antibacterial coating agent mixed with an inorganic antibacterial agent and an organic antibacterial agent, and a coating method using the same, wherein a hybrid antibacterial coating agent in which an organic antibacterial agent and an inorganic antibacterial agent are mixed is coated and processed on polyester yarn to have antibacterial properties against covid-19.

title_en: Quantum dot-containing composite, and electronic device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a quantum dot-containing composite and an electronic device including the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a quantum dot-containing composite including: a quantum dot; and a first ligand formed on a surface of the quantum dot and represented by the following chemical formula 1. In chemical formula 1, R_1 is hydrogen or C1-5 alkyl, L_1 is -Ar-(CH_2)_a-, Ar is an arylene group of C6-18, a is an integer of 0 to 10, and X is Cl, Br, or I.

title_en: A Manufacturing method of multi-functional coatings using nano-diamond
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a functional coating agent using nanodiamonds that can be used for various buildings and structures, and more specifically, to a method for manufacturing a functional coating agent using nanodiamonds that optimizes the surface treatment and dispersion method of nanodiamonds to maximize durability and antifouling, anti-flame, and antibacterial properties as a coating agent for coating walls or interior materials for glass, buildings, and especially interiors, and is economically producible, and in particular, has excellent chemical resistance such as corrosion resistance, water resistance, and salt water resistance so that it can be applied to various buildings and structures, and also has excellent physical performance such as wear resistance and scratch resistance, and further, has multifunctionality with enhanced flame retardancy and durability, and is usable for various buildings and structures.

title_en: Composition for cleaning abandoned fishing net and method of recycling abandoned fishing net by using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for providing an eco-friendly polyamide material having excellent mechanical properties, stability, and quality while meeting both a circulation economy and carbon neutrality by recycling a waste fishing net, and a composition for cleaning a waste fishing net for the same. The waste fishing net cleaning composition comprises an ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) system water-soluble material and polyvalent organic acid.

title_en: Polyurea resin coating waterproofing material with excellent insulation performance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a polyurea resin coating film waterproofing material with improved insulation and a waterproofing material manufactured using thereof, comprising a step of forming an inorganic elastic coating film by coating and drying an inorganic elastic coating film waterproofing agent on the bottom surface, and a step of forming a polyurea resin coating film by coating a polyurea waterproofing material on the upper part of the inorganic elastic coating film; and further comprising a main agent comprising an active amine group (-NH_2) and having a urea bond within a molecular structure, 10-30 parts by weight of a curing agent having an isocyanate group (-N=C-O) based on 100 parts by weight of the main agent, and 10-20 parts by weight of silica hollow particles.

title_en: Composition for organic material layer of organic light emitting device and organic light emitting device comprising same
abstract_en: Provided is a composition for an organic material layer of an organic light-emitting device, the composition comprising: a heterocyclic compound represented by chemical formula A; and a heterocyclic compound represented by chemical formula B. In the chemical formulae A and B, L1 to L4 are identical to or different from each other, and each independently represents a direct bond; a substituted or unsubstituted C6 to C60 arylene group; or a substituted or unsubstituted C2 to C60 heteroarylene group. According to one embodiment of the present application, the composition for the organic material layer includes a heterocyclic compound represented by the chemical formula A, which is usable as a unipolar P-type host material having excellent hole mobility, and a compound represented by the chemical formula B, which is usable as a unipolar N-type host material having excellent electron mobility. When the compounds are mixed in an appropriate ratio and used as a material of a device, the efficiency and lifetime of the device are improved.

title_en: A separator for electrochemical device and an electrochemical device comprising the same
abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, provided are a separator for an electrochemical device, which can reduce resistance when applied to an electrochemical device, improve adhesion to an electrode, and control the shape of an adhesive layer even based on an aqueous solvent to have adhesion equal to or higher than that of an organic solvent-based coating separator, and an electrochemical device including the same. The electrochemical device includes: a substrate layer; and an adhesive layer disposed on at least one surface of the substrate layer and including a bead having a first polymer component and a chain having a second polymer component, wherein the first polymer component has a glass transition temperature of 35℃ or higher, the second polymer component is water-soluble or has a glass transition temperature lower than the glass transition temperature of the first polymer component, and the bead and the chain may be mixed in the adhesive layer.

title_en: A dye compound and a disperse dye composition comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dye compound represented by chemical formula 1 and a disperse dye composition comprising the same. In the chemical formula 1, r1 is methyl or -nhco-(c1-c2)alkyl, r2 is (c1-c4)alkyl, cyanoethyl, (c1-c4)alkoxyethyl, 2-cyanoethoxyethyl or (c1-c2)alkoxycarbonyl(c1-c2)alkyl, and x1 and x2 each independently represent hydrogen, halogen, methyl or methoxy group.

title_en: Fluorescent tape with photoluminescent properties
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a phosphorescent fluorescent tape. The phosphorescent fluorescent tape comprises: a base sheet having a plurality of protrusions on one side surface; and a reflection unit connected to one end of the base sheet and reflecting light incident from the outside. The phosphorescent fluorescent tape increases visibility of a footrest during a night repair work process to prevent a loss accident caused by a fall or a slip in advance, thereby preventing a safety accident.

title_en: Primer composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a primer composition which can be used for both glass and plastic materials. The primer composition according to the present invention comprises: a first silane-modified urethane polymer; a second silane-modified urethane polymer; a phosphate-based polyisocyanate; a polyisocyanate not including a phosphate group; and an additive.

title_en: Fertiliser compositions and use thereof for improving the solubilisation of potassium from soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a fertiliser composition P, K, N, NP, PK, NK o NPK that includes an extract of <em>Enterobacter xiangfangensis</em>, strain CECT 9264, and niacin as a bacterial growth stimulator, in addition to a source of carbon and micronutrients.

title_en: Process for producing oils and defatted meal by means of solid/liquid extraction.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for producing an oil and defatted meal by means of solid/liquid extraction. The process comprises a step of solid/liquid extraction using a solvent containing 2-methyloxolane and water.

title_en: Corrosion inhibitor formulation for geothermal reinjection well.
abstract_en: A method of inhibiting corrosion of a metal surface in contact with geothermal system is provided. The method may include contacting the metal surface with a corrosion inhibitor composition by adding the composition to geothermal process water. The corrosion inhibitor composition may include an organic phosphonate, an ortho phosphate, and zinc or a salt thereof.

title_en: Silica nanoparticles for crude oil recovery using carbon dioxide, and crude oil recovery method.
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a hydrosol used in CO2 foam flooding from among EOR flooding methods for recovering crude oil by injection into an oil stratum in an inland or offshore oil field, the hydrosol for increasing the long-term and high-temperature/high-pressure stability of a foam against salt water, and for enhancing the crude oil recovery rate. [Solution] A hydrosol for increasing the stability of a foam or emulsion in a mixture that includes carbon dioxide, water, and oil in CO2 foam flooding for enhanced oil recovery (EOR), wherein silica particles which have an average particle diameter of 1-100 nm measured by dynamic light scattering, and in which surfaces thereof are at least partially covered by a silane compound having hydrolyzable groups, are dispersed as a dispersoid in an aqueous solvent as a dispersion medium having a pH of 1.0-6.0 inclusive.

title_en: Herbicide compositions comprising dicamba monoethanolamine salt and a ppo-inhibitor.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of crop protection. The present invention primarily relates to herbicide compositions comprising as compound (A) one or more protoporphyrinogen oxidase (PPO) inhibitor herbicide(s) and as compound (B) dicamba monoethanolamine salt, in particular to formulations of a certain type and preferably containing further constituents, said compositions and formulations having improved properties. The invention also relates to methods of manufacturing such compositions and formulations and the use of such compositions and formulations.

title_en: Heat transfer compositions, methods, and systems.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a refrigerant composition comprising at least about 98.5% by weight of the following three compounds, with each compound being present in the following relative percentages: 16.5% to 21.5% by weight difluoromethane (HFC-32); 68.5% to 80.5% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and 3.0% to 10.0% by weight fluoroethane (HFC-161), and to the use of the refrigerant in a heat exchange system, including air conditioning, refrigeration applications and heat pump applications and to the use of such compositions as a replacement of the refrigerant R-410A or R1234yf for heating and cooling applications.

title_en: Coating compositions and methods including carbodiimides.
abstract_en: Coated substrates and methods may comprise a multi-unit carbodiimide. The multi-unit carbodiimide may also be combined with a siloxane. The multi-unit carbodiimide and/or the siloxane may be used in a surface coating applied to a substrate, and an overcoat may be applied to the surface coating. The surface coating may chemically interact with the overcoat and/or the substrate to improve corrosion resistance and other properties of the coated substrate.

title_en: Insecticidal composition comprising of diamide, moulting hormone agonist and pyrethroid.
abstract_en: The present provides a synergistic insecticidal composition comprising Chlorantraniliprole, Methoxyfenozide and at least one insecticidal compound selected from Deltamethrin or Lambda-Cyhalothrin, process of preparation of the composition and uses thereof.

title_en: Agricultural and horticultural fungicidal composition.
abstract_en: The problem addressed by the present invention is to provide an agricultural and horticultural fungicidal composition excelling in fungicidal activity, and for which there is no worry of phytotoxicity with respect to a useful plant.ã¿¿The present invention is an agricultural and horticultural fungicidal composition containing an ingredient (I) and an ingredient (II) as active ingredients, wherein the ingredient (I) is a compound represented by formula (I), and the ingredient (II) is a fungicidal agent and the like apart from ingredient (I).

title_en: Quantum dot nanofluids.
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method for recovery of an oil from a porous medium comprises contacting the porous medium with an aqueous nanofluid, solubilizing oil from the porous medium via the nanoparticles to form a dispersion comprising the oil and the aqueous nanofluid, and collecting at least some of the dispersion. The aqueous nanofluid may contain a combination of amphiphilic quantum dots and hydrophilic quantum dots, in a continuous phase. At least 90% of the quantum dot nanoparticles may have an aspect ratio of from 1:1 to 1:6. In another embodiment, a method for recovery of an oil from a porous medium includes adding quantum dots to foaming surfactants to enhance foam lamella stability under reservoir conditions and provide conformance and mobility control in porous media and hydraulic fractures.

title_en: Processes for producing biocarbon pellets with high fixed-carbon content and optimized reactivity, and biocarbon pellets obtained therefrom.
abstract_en: Some variations provide a process for producing biocarbon pellets, comprising: pyrolyzing a biomass-containing feedstock in a first pyrolysis reactor to generate a first biogenic reagent and a pyrolysis vapor; introducing the pyrolysis vapor to a separation unit, to generate a pyrolysis precipitate in liquid or solid form; contacting the first biogenic reagent with the pyrolysis precipitate, thereby generating an intermediate material; pelletizing the intermediate material, to generate intermediate pellets; optionally, drying the intermediate pellets; separately pyrolyzing the intermediate pellets in a second pyrolysis reactor to generate a second biogenic reagent and a pyrolysis off-gas; and recovering the second biogenic reagent as biocarbon pellets. Some variations provide a similar process that utilizes a carbon-containing condensed-matter material, which is not necessarily a pyrolysis precipitate. The disclosure provides improved processes for producing biocarbon compositions, especially with respect to carbon yield and biocarbon properties, such as reactivity.

title_en: PROCESS FOR SCAVENGING MERCAPTANS USING A SCAVENGER THAT HAS UNDERGONE A STEP OF CO<sub>2</sub> PASSIVATION.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for scavenging mercaptans contained in a hydrocarbon-based feedstock containing sulfur, optionally partially desulfurised following a step of catalytic hydrodesulfurisation, at a temperature of between 40Â°C and 250Â°C, a pressure of between 0.2 MPa and 5 MPa, at an hourly space velocity, defined as the volumetric flow rate of the incoming feedstock over the volume of scavenger, of between 0.1 h<sup>-1</sup> and 50 h<sup>-1</sup>, in the presence of a scavenger comprising an active phase based on at least one metal from group VIII, IB or IIB, and an oxide or a porous oxide mixture, the active metal of which has been activated beforehand by reduction and then passivated with a view to the loading thereof by a carbon dioxide treatment.

title_en: Arthropod control compositions.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to arthropod control compositions, methods and uses to control arthropods as well as arthropod control articles comprising the same.

title_en: Heat-transfer fluid with low electrical conductivity
abstract_en: The present invention concerns heat-transfer fluid compositions, such as concentrated and ready-to- use heat-transfer fluid compositions, comprising a base fluid, a divalent metal cation and an organophosphorus acid or a salt thereof, wherein the compositions have an electrical conductivity at 25 Â°C of less than 500 ÂµS/cm, wherein the base fluid consists of water and alcohol, wherein the alcohol is present in an amount in the range of 10-99.5 wt.% by weight of the base fluid, and wherein the composition comprises more than 75 wt.% of the base fluid by total weight of the composition.

title_en: Fuel borne catalyst composition for oxidative soot removal
abstract_en: The present invention provides fuel borne catalyst compositions for oxidative soot removal comprising a Ce (III) long-chain carboxylate in an organic solvent. Preferred embodiments provide a cerium composition for use as a soot reduction catalyst system, comprising: Ce (III) neodecanoate; Ce (III) carboxylate, wherein said carboxylate has a general formula RCOO-, wherein R is H or a C1 to C4 alkyl; neodecanoic acid; and an organic solvent.

title_en: Delivery particles based on amine-thiol-ene conjugates and derivatives
abstract_en: An improved delivery particle comprising a benefit agent core material and a shell encapsulating the core material is described, along with a process for forming such a delivery particle and articles of manufacture. The shell is the reaction product of an ATEC (amine-thiol ene) conjugate, which can be further reacted with one or more multifunctional (meth)acrylates or isocyanates, or both. The delivery particle of the invention has improved release characteristics, and embodiments exhibit enhanced degradation characteristics in OECD test method 301B.

title_en: Dissolvable solid cleaning articles containing taurate surfactants
abstract_en: A dissolvable solid cleansing article comprising: (a) from about 5% to about 60%, by weight on a dry article basis, of a polymeric structurant; and (b) from about 13% to about 90%, by weight on a dry article basis, of a surfactant system comprising from about 10% to about 54% by weight on the dry article basis, of a taurate surfactant comprising an acyltaurate surfactant. A molten composition for making the dissolvable solid cleaning article is also disclosed. The present disclosure provides dissolvable solid articles, especially dissolvable solid fibrous articles containing taurate surfactants, especially when using polyvinyl alcohols (PVOH) as polymeric structurant.

title_en: Reactive compositions that include acid functional compounds and compositions derived therefrom
abstract_en: A reactive composition that includes a first compound containing from 1 to 12, such as from 1 to 10, or from 1 to 6, or from 1 to 5 or from 1 to 4 carboxylic acid functional groups according to the structure: where R<sup>1</sup> can be a C<sub>1</sub> to C<sub>6</sub>, such as a C<sub>1</sub> to C<sub>4</sub> or C<sub>1 </sub>to C<sub>3</sub> linear or branched alkyl group and X can be O, S or NR<sup>2</sup>, where R<sup>2</sup> can be H, methyl, ethyl, propyl or isopropyl. The reactive composition also includes a second compound that includes a functional group reactive with the carboxylic acid functional groups in the first compound. Also disclosed are compositions derived from the reactive composition and methods of making and using the reactive composition and compositions derived therefrom.

title_en: A fragrance pastille
abstract_en: Suggested is a fragrance pastille, obtained or obtainable according to the following steps: (a) providing a shell-forming material; (b) providing at least one fragrance raw material; (c) blending said shell forming material and said at least one fragrance raw material with a solvent to obtain a capsule slurry; (d) providing at least one matrix material; (e) blending said capsule slurry of step (c) with said at least one matrix material to obtain a pastille pre-mix; (f) subjecting said pastille pre-mix to a heat treatment; (g) subjecting said heated pastille pre-mix to a mechanic press to obtain the pastille; and (h) optionally drying said pastille.

title_en: Pesticidal mixtures including spiroheterocyclic pyrrolidine diones
abstract_en: A pesticidal mixture comprising as active ingredient a mixture of component A and component B, wherein component A is a compound of formula (I), in which Q is i or ii wherein X, Y and Z, m and n, A, G,and R, are as defined as in claim 1, and component B is a compound selected from the insecticides as defined in claim 1. The present invention also relates to methods of using said mixtures for the control of plant pests.

title_en: Pendimethanlin microcapsules with a shell made of tetramethylxylylene diisocyanate and a pol-yamine with at least three amine groups
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a a composition comprising microcapsules, which comprise a polyurea shell and a core, wherein the core comprises pendimethalin and the shell comprises a polymerization product of a tetramethylxylylene diisocyanate, and a polyamine with at least three amine groups, and where the polymerization product comprises less than 5 wt% of further isocyanate monomers in polymerized form, based on the weight of the tetramethylxylylene diisocyanate; a method for preparing the composition comprising the steps of contacting water, the pendimethalin, the tetramethylxylylene diisocyanate, and the polyamine; and to a method of controlling undesired plant growth, wherein the composition is allowed to act on the soil and/or on undesired plants and/or on the crop plants and/or on their environment.

title_en: Acetic acid recovery from wood acetylation
abstract_en: Disclosed is the integration of the production of acetic anhydride from ketene, and the acetylation of wood using acetylation fluid comprising acetic acid and acetic anhydride. The invention involves combining acetic acid obtained from distillation of acetylation fluid with a residual aqueous acetic acid stream as obtained from ketene production. Disclosed is the integration of the production of acetic anhydride from ketene, and the acetylation of wood using acetylation fluid comprising acetic acid and acetic anhydride. The invention involves combining acetic acid obtained from distillation of acetylation fluid with a residual aqueous acetic acid stream as obtained from ketene production. Disclosed is the integration of the production of acetic anhydride from ketene, and the acetylation of wood using acetylation fluid comprising acetic acid and acetic anhydride. The invention involves directly using raw acetic anhydride as obtained in the production thereof from ketene, as a wood acetylation fluid.

title_en: Fumed silica for superhydrophobic, superhydrophilic or omniphobic surfaces
abstract_en: A coating composition includes a fumed silica present in an amount from about 2 to 12 weight percent of the total weight of the coating composition, a resin in an amount from about 5 to 10 weight percent of the total weight of the coating composition, and a polar solvent being the balance.

title_en: Methods to improve organ viability
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods to improve the viability of an organ, or organs, by continuously administering a composition comprising NO<sub>x</sub> gas directly to the organ(s). A method to improve the viability of an organ intended for transplant, the method comprising continuously administering a composition comprising NO<sub>x</sub> gas directly to the organ via an organ perfusion system or ventilation.

title_en: Tape for semiconductor processing
abstract_en: A tape for semiconductor processing that can prevent the generation of wrinkles in the metal layer at the time of sticking to a semiconductor wafer is provided. The tape for semiconductor processing (10) of the invention includes a dicing tape (13) having a base film (11) and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (12); a metal layer (14) provided on the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (12) for protecting the back surface of a semiconductor chip; and an adhesive layer (15) provided on the metal layer (14) for adhering the metal layer (14) to the back surface of a semiconductor chip, in which the loop stiffness of the dicing tape (13) is 20 mN or more and less than 200 mN.  (Fig.1)

title_en: Herbicides
abstract_en: The present invention relates to herbicidally active pyridino-/pyrimidino-pyridine derivatives. The invention further provides processes and intermediates used for the preparation of such derivatives. The invention further extends to herbicidal compositions comprising such derivatives, as well as to the use of such compounds and compositions in controlling undesirable plant growth: in particular the use in controlling weeds, in crops of useful plants.

title_en: Binder for printing ink, laminate ink composition for soft packaging, and printed article
abstract_en: A binder for printing ink comprises a polyethylene glycol (hereinafter, referred to as PEG)-containing polyurethane resin, and a vinyl chloride-vinyl acetate copolymer resin, wherein the PEG-containing polyurethane resin is a resin obtained by reacting at least (A) a polyester polyol having a number average molecular weight of 1000 to 6000, (B) PEG, a (C) diisocyanate compound, and (D) a chain extender; and a content rate of the (B) PEG is within the range of I to 40 parts by mass based on 100 parts by mass of the PEG-containing polyurethane resin.

title_en: Polishing liquid composition
abstract_en: In an aspect of the present invention, a polishing liquid composition with which the polishing speed can be ensured and scratches on the polished surface of a substrate can be reduced is provided. An aspect of the present disclosure relates to a polishing liquid composition containing an abrasive (component A), a water-soluble polymer (component B), an acid (component C), and an aqueous medium. The component B is a cationic polymer having a phenyl ether skeleton in the main chain or side chain thereof.

title_en: A method for additive manufacturing comprising at least one thermochemical component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for additive manufacturing. The present invention also relates to an additive manufacturing apparatus for carrying out such a method for additive manufacturing. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a form stable thermochemical entity manufactured according to such a method and to the application thereof, namely in a heat storage or heat pump system.

title_en: Process for forming a solid fuel composition from mixed solid waste
abstract_en: Systems and methods of producing a solid fuel composition are disclosed. In particular, systems and methods for producing a solid fuel composition by heating and mixing a solid waste mixture below atmospheric pressure to a maximum temperature sufficient to melt the mixed plastics within the solid waste mixture is disclosed.

title_en: A biological insecticide composition and the process on making thereof
abstract_en: The biological insecticide comprising of mechanically blended Metarhizium anisoplae inoculated and grown in cooked rice, molasses from sugar cane, detergent powder soap and water. The prepared biological insecticide compound was placed in plastic bottle and tightly closed. The product was stored for at least 7 months and is ready for use. This product applied as spray, can kill Rice Bug, Black Bug and Seven Spotted Beetle.

title_en: Improved composition
abstract_en:
FIELD: automatic dishwashers. 
     SUBSTANCE: present invention relates to the use of a composition containing polyalkyleneimine and/or its salts or derivatives thereof and an amphoteric polymer during an automatic dishwashing process. Described is a method for automatic dishwashing, comprising introducing into an automatic dishwasher a composition containing: polyalkyleneimine and/or its salt or its derivative and at least one amphoteric polymer, with the amphoteric polymer being a water-soluble or water-dispersible copolymer comprising, in form of polymerized units, at least one monomer having an amino functional group, and at least one hydrophilic monomer of acidic nature.  
     EFFECT: overcoming poor rinsing ability.  
     10 cl, 3 tbl

title_en: Associated petroleum gas processing unit producing propane-butane fraction (variants)
abstract_en:
FIELD: gas processing. 
     SUBSTANCE: present invention relates to variants of an associated petroleum gas (APG) processing unit producing a propane-butane fraction (PBF). One of the variants of the unit includes a compressor station located on an APG and stabilization gas mixture supply line, a fractional column with an external cold source, a stabilization apparatus, a separator with gas and residue outlet lines and a unit for drying and/or purifying the gas from hydrogen sulfide and mercaptans. The unit therein is equipped with an APG supply line with a two-stage compressor station wherein a stabilization gas supply line is adjacent between the first and second stages thereof and a recuperative heat exchanger and a separator are located after the compressor station, said separator equipped with a residue outlet line with a reducing apparatus and a gas outlet supply line, located whereon are a gas drying and/or purifying unit and a fractional column with an external cold source equipped with a reflux outlet line with a reducing apparatus and a reflux gas outlet line, located whereon is a recuperative heat exchanger equipped with a dry stripped gas outlet line, a three-phase separator is installed on the reduced separation residue outlet line as a stabilization apparatus, equipped with a water condensate outlet line and an unstable hydrocarbon condensate outlet line, located whereon are an adjoinment of the reduced reflux outlet line and a stripping column with a heated bottom equipped with a PBF outlet line and an offgas outlet line connected to the gas outlet line of the three-phase separator forming a stabilization gas supply line. 
     EFFECT: proposed variants allow reducing metal consumption of the unit and reducing power consumption for cooling compressed gas. 
     4 cl, 4 dwg

title_en: Liquid composition of a thermosetting polymer coating based on organic solvents for painting by the coil coating method
abstract_en:
FIELD: coatings. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a liquid composition of a thermosetting polymer coating based on organic solvents for painting by the coil coating method. The liquid composition includes at least a linear or branched polyester resin, a crosslinking agent, a viscosity regulator, and a catalyst. Hydroxyfunctional resin is taken as a polyester resin, and chitosan is taken as a crosslinking agent in an amount of up to 5% of the mass of the finished liquid composition of the coating. 
     EFFECT: technical result is an improvement in the weather resistance and hardness of the produced polymer coating with the maintained or improved bending and extensibility thereof. 
     6 cl, 4 tbl, 6 ex

title_en: Heat-resistant shaped charge
abstract_en:
FIELD: chemistry. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to compositions which can be used in making shaped charges of perforators for the oil industry. Heat-resistant shaped charge used in oil and gas wells contains an explosive substance of Okfol 3.5. When making a shaped charge, activated carbon powder and an additive in the form of potassium perchlorate are added to it as a sorbent, with the following ratio of components, wt.%: Okfol 3.5 80–99, activated carbon powder 0.5–5, potassium perchlorate 0.5–15. 
     EFFECT: higher heat resistance of shaped charge to 200 °C and increased penetration of steel or concrete targets.
