Sn doped CsPbI 3 The nanobelt is CsPb 0.922 Sn 0.078 I 3 A perovskite nanobelt, an application method thereof comprises the following steps: covering the surface with SiO 2 Respectively carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the Si substrate in acetone, ethanol and distilled water, and then treating in an ultraviolet ozone cleaning agent; mixing CsPb 0.922 Sn 0.078 I 3 Dispersing the perovskite nano-belt in hexane to form a transparent solution, and dripping the transparent solution on the treated Si substrate; the nano-belt photoelectric detector is assembled by sequentially depositing Au interdigital electrodes on the nano-belt by adopting photoetching, thermal evaporation and stripping; the photoelectric detector is used as a working device and is arranged on a four-probe test platform, and the light detection performance of the photoelectric detector is tested by using a semiconductor test system. CsPb 0.922 Sn 0.078 I 3 The perovskite nanobelt can be effectively applied to photoelectric detection and has high performance and stability.

title_en: Martensitic stainless steel sheet
abstract_en: The martensitic stainless steel sheet comprises, in mass%, C: 0.030% or more but less than 0.20%, Si: 0.01% or more and 2.0% or less, Mn: 0.01% or more and 3.0% or less, P: 0.050% or less, S: 0.010% or less, Cr: 10.0% or more and 16.0% or less, Ni: 0.01% or more and 0.80% or less, Al: 0.001% or more and 0.50% or less, Zr: more than 0.005%, less than 0.50%, and N: 0.030% or more but less than 0.20%, and the balance being Fe and inevitable impurities.

title_en: Method and device for removing organic matters in aluminum oxide mother liquor cooperatively by aluminum ash sintering method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aluminum preparation by metallurgy, and discloses a method and a device for removing organic matters in aluminum oxide mother liquor by an aluminum ash sintering method, which have the technical key points that: the method comprises the steps of firstly guiding raw slurry into a rotary kiln through a raw material pipe, guiding natural gas and air into the rotary kiln through a fuel pipe and an air delivery pipe respectively, carrying out a sintering reaction, guiding clinker obtained by the sintering reaction into a cooling machine through a cooling pipe, finally conveying the clinker cooled by the cooling machine into a ball mill through a conveyor, and sintering endosperm alumina evaporation mother liquor again to finish removing alumina mother liquor organic matters, so that inert aluminum ash in the aluminum ash can be safely and effectively treated, the total recovery rate of aluminum in the aluminum ash reaches over 95 percent, the overall recovery rate of organic matters is over 85 percent, and the problems of high additive consumption cost, difficult operation, difficult regeneration, low recovery efficiency and the like of the conventional crystallization method, oxidation method, roasting method, ion exchange method, causticization method and the like for removing the organic matters in the aluminum oxide are solved.

title_en: Steel slag permeable asphalt mixture based on waste rubber powder modified high-viscosity asphalt
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steel slag permeable asphalt mixture based on crumb rubber modified high-viscosity asphalt, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 82-86 parts of steel slag coarse aggregate, 10-14 parts of basalt fine aggregate, 4 parts of limestone filler and 4.4-4.6 parts of waste rubber powder modified high-viscosity asphalt. According to the invention, the steel slag is used for replacing coarse aggregates, and the waste rubber powder is added for modifying the high-viscosity asphalt, so that the porosity of the prepared steel slag permeable asphalt mixture meets the requirement, and the steel slag permeable asphalt mixture has higher Marshall stability and smaller Schlumberger leakage loss and Kentberg scattering rate.

title_en: Tetragonal phase two-dimensional CuFeSe2Liquid phase preparation method of nanosheet crystal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid-phase preparation method of a tetragonal-phase two-dimensional CuFeSe2 nanosheet crystal, which comprises the following steps: soluble substances of copper, iron and selenium are adopted, and a molar ratio of Cu to Fe to Se is 1: 1-1.5: 2-4; heating and dissolving a copper source in a reaction medium consisting of organic amine, oleic acid and octadecene in a volume ratio of 1: 1-2: 6 to obtain a solution A; heating and dissolving a selenium source in octadecylene to obtain a solution B, and adding the solution B when the solution A is heated to a certain temperature; heating and dissolving an iron source in oleylamine to be used as a solution C, adding the solution C when the A + B mixed solution is heated to a certain temperature, continuously heating to 230-260 ℃ for reaction for 5-120 min, washing a product with absolute ethyl alcohol and methylbenzene after the reaction is finished, and performing centrifugal separation to obtain a tetragonal-phase two-dimensional CuFeSe2 nanosheet crystal. The method provided by the invention is mild in condition, simple in process and low in cost, and the prepared two-dimensional CuFeSe2 nanosheet is low in cytotoxicity and strong in near infrared light absorption, and can be used as a novel photothermal conversion reagent and a magnetic targeting drug carrier to be applied to the field of tumor treatment research.

title_en: Artificial colored sand adhesive and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial sintered colored sand adhesive and application thereof, wherein the artificial colored sand adhesive comprises the following components: sodium water glass, amphoteric oxide buffer solution and phosphate; the sodium silicate is 80-120 parts by weight, the amphoteric oxide buffer solution is 5-10 parts by weight, and the phosphate is 4-6 parts by weight of phosphate which is difficult to dissolve in water or 12-16 parts by weight of water-soluble phosphate; according to the invention, effective components and proportion are screened through experiments, the sodium silicate is modified by adopting amphoteric oxide buffer solution and phosphate, each component is synergized under a specific formula, and the artificial colored sand with excellent water resistance and boiling water resistance is finally prepared through optimization, so that the artificial colored sand has wide application prospect and great market value; the method has simple process, can realize industrialized large-scale production, can bring good economic benefit for enterprises, and has wide prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of flaky zinc sulfide and application of flaky zinc sulfide in photocatalytic degradation of dye wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of flaky zinc sulfide and application thereof in photocatalytic degradation of dye wastewater, wherein 2.5g of lotus powder is placed in a 250mL round-bottom sesame seed cake, 150mL of secondary water is added, the mixture is subjected to water bath in a constant-temperature water bath kettle at 35 ℃ for 12 hours, and then the mixture is centrifuged to obtain a pollen dissolved substance; adding 5mL of dodecyl ammonium bromide with the molar concentration of 0.05mol/L and 4mL of acetic acid with the molar concentration of 1mol/L into 30mL of the obtained pollen extract, stirring for 5min, adding 4mL of zinc acetate solution with the molar concentration of 0.5mol/L and 4mL of thioacetamide solution with the molar concentration of 0.5mol/L, carrying out water bath at 60 ℃ for 7h, centrifuging, and carrying out vacuum drying for 48h to obtain the flaky zinc sulfide. The synthetic process of the flaky zinc sulfide is simple and the cost is low; the synthesized flaky zinc sulfide is insoluble in water, so that the recovery and the recycling of the photocatalyst are facilitated; the synthesized flaky zinc sulfide has absorption in both ultraviolet light regions and visible light regions, and has good application prospects in the fields of sewage treatment, organic pollutant degradation and the like.

title_en: Polycrystalline diamond structure
abstract_en: Polycrystalline diamond structures are disclosed that are formed from a mixture of diamond grains that include a first volume of fine-grained diamond grains and a second volume of coarse-grained diamond grains. The fine-grained diamond particles are partially graphitized, and the coarse-grained diamond particles are not graphitized. The mixture of diamond particles is subjected to high pressure/high temperature sintering process conditions in the presence of a sintering aid to form polycrystalline diamond. The contact regions between the coarse grain diamond grains in the polycrystalline diamond structure are substantially free of graphite.

title_en: Carbon nanotube structure and method for producing same
abstract_en: According to the present invention, it is possible to manufacture a carbon nanotube structure only by a simple process of pulverizing and mixing carbon nanotubes in a dispersion solvent without using a dispersant, then freezing, and then removing the dispersion solvent. This method does not require a dispersant and a binder, so that the manufactured carbon nanotube structure can be composed of only carbon nanotubes, and does not rely on other additives to form the carbon nanotube structure, so that there is little possibility of damaging and contaminating the structure during a structure collecting process after the structure is formed.

title_en: Low impurity content graphite alkene continuous production system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-impurity-content graphene continuous production system which comprises a graphene oxide purification device, a low-layer graphene oxide preparation device and a reduction device, wherein the graphene oxide purification device comprises a first feeding hole, a tank body, a first partition plate, a second partition plate, an ultrasonic generation unit and a first discharging hole; the low-layer graphene oxide preparation device is used for freeze drying the purified graphene obtained by the graphene oxide purification device and comprises a hydrogel forming unit, a low-temperature drying unit and a conveying mechanism; the reduction device comprises a bin, a traveling mechanism, a reaction unit and an atmosphere control unit, wherein the bin is used for reducing the graphene oxide with the second layer number obtained by the low-layer graphene oxide preparation device. The system disclosed by the invention is simple in structure and high in production efficiency, and can realize continuous production of graphene.

title_en: Composite material with high energy storage density and charge-discharge performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite material with high energy storage density and charge-discharge performance and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the composite material is (Bi) 0.32 Sr 0.42 Na 0.2 □ 0.06 )TiO 3 (MgO), wherein □ represents a vacancy. Compared with the prior art, the lead-free energy storage material disclosed by the invention is an environment-friendly material, and compared with antiferroelectric materials and other relaxivity materials, the system disclosed by the invention has very high energy storage density (the energy storage density is 2.09J/cm) 3 ) And charge and discharge performance (current density: 1671A/cm) 2 Power density of 150MW/cm 3 ) And has an extremely short discharge time (-0.15 mus). In particular, the material has good temperature stability in energy storage density and charge-discharge characteristics. These excellent properties are advantageous for pulsed capacitor applications, especially in high temperature applications.

title_en: Iron mold with pouring cup and casting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron mold with a pouring cup and a casting method thereof, comprising an upper iron mold body and a lower iron mold body which are matched with each other, wherein an upper cavity is arranged in the upper iron mold body, a pouring gate is arranged on the upper iron mold body, a funnel-shaped pouring cup is arranged on the pouring gate, a first sand coating layer is arranged on the inner walls of the upper cavity and the pouring gate, a second sand coating layer is arranged on the inner walls of the pouring cup, and a pouring cup movable block is arranged in the pouring cup; a lower cavity is arranged in the lower iron mold body, and a third sand coating layer matched with the first sand coating layer is arranged in the lower cavity; and a die cavity is formed between the first sand coating layer and the third sand coating layer. According to the pouring cup, the pouring cup is arranged on the upper iron-type body, so that the steps of pouring cup discharging and pouring cup shoveling during casting are omitted, the production process is simplified, the production cost is saved, and the product percent of pass is improved.

title_en: Coated glass does not have clamp seal anchor clamps
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clamp-free clamp for coated glass. The fixture comprises at least one substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a front surface, the front surface of the substrate is used for laminating and fixing glass, an included angle smaller than 10 degrees is formed between the front surface of the substrate and a vertical surface, and the normal line of the front surface is inclined and directed to the upper side; the front surface of the base plate is provided with a horizontal supporting bar, the supporting bar protrudes from the front surface of the base plate and is used for supporting glass from below the glass; the front surface of the substrate is also fixedly provided with a clamping block, the thickness of the clamping block is not larger than the height of the surface to be sprayed of the glass from the front surface of the substrate, and the clamping block is contacted with the side edges of the glass and clamps the glass from the two sides of the glass. The fixture ensures that the glass is accurately positioned, the glass cannot tilt forwards, meanwhile, clamp marks are not left on the surface of the glass, a plurality of problems are solved on the basis that the manufacturing cost is not improved, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: Small molecular sieve oxygen generator and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small molecular sieve oxygen generator and a control system thereof. When the small-sized molecular sieve oxygen generator is stopped or is suddenly powered off, the battery switching module is communicated with a circuit between the battery and the power supply voltage stabilizer to supply power to the small-sized molecular sieve oxygen generator, the microprocessor sends a power-down protection control instruction to the two-position four-way electromagnetic valve according to a control phase currently executed by a pressure swing adsorption period program, and the two-position four-way electromagnetic valve is adjusted to be opened or closed, so that the compressor is in a low-pressure load state and is not easy to generate violent buffeting, and the phenomenon that the compressor body is damaged due to mechanical impact or the compressor body is violently vibrated to impact a protective shell or other parts of the oxygen generator are violently vibrated to cause faults is avoided.

title_en: Titanium slag extraction lime stabilized macadam material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a titanium slag-extracting lime stabilized macadam material and a preparation method thereof. The material is prepared from a binding material, broken stones, an additive and water, wherein the mass ratio of the binding material to the broken stones is 20-40: 50-70, wherein the binder comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 50-70% of titanium extraction slag, 4-16% of lime, 15-30% of steel slag micro powder and 0-20% of fly ash, wherein the crushed stone comprises graded crushed stone or steel slag crushed stone; the mass of the additive is 4-6% of that of the lime, and the additive comprises one or more of gypsum, sodium carbonate, water glass, sodium sulfate and calcium formate; the mass of the water is 4-18% of the total mass of the binder, the broken stone and the admixture in a dry state. The preparation method can adopt the raw materials to prepare. The beneficial effects of the invention can include: the raw materials are low in price and low in cost; a large amount of industrial waste residues including titanium extraction residues can be obtained; the construction process is simple and convenient; the strength of the material is increased quickly, the working period can be shortened, and the construction cost is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of electric-melting barium zirconate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of electric melting barium zirconate, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: putting any one of the powder-shaped monoclinic zirconia and the barium oxide or the barium carbonate serving as a raw material into a mixer, and uniformly mixing to prepare a mixed material; step two: putting the mixed material into an electric arc for melting and refining, wherein the melting and refining temperature is 2600-3000 ℃, and the mixed material is fully melted into a molten state; step three: naturally cooling the mixed material in the molten state to below 50 ℃ to form a gray solid finished product; step four: and smashing, selecting and crushing the off-white solid finished product to form barium zirconate powder. The invention prepares the whole barium zirconate phase powder by an electric melting method, has the characteristics of low porosity, high volume density, capability of being processed into particles and fine powder with various granularity levels, good high-temperature volume stability and the like, and solves the problems that the prepared barium zirconate powder has low purity and contains unreacted barium carbonate phase.

title_en: Multi-element doped graphene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are graphene doped with different dopants and a method for preparing the same. The method for preparing the multi-element doped graphene comprises the following steps: mixing a metal-based dopant and at least one organic-based dopant to prepare a doping solution; stacking graphene layers on a substrate; and doping the graphene layer with a doping solution comprising the metal based dopant and the at least one organic based dopant. The method maintains the transparency of the prepared graphene and minimizes the sheet resistance of the graphene, while not damaging the substrate on which the graphene is stacked.

title_en: Vibration damper and nitrogen-oxygen separation device using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration damper and a nitrogen-oxygen separation device using the same, wherein the vibration damper comprises foot pads, springs and a support, the foot pads, the springs and the support are connected in series and assembled below a mechanism to be damped, the upper ends of the foot pads are inserted into foot holes of the mechanism to be damped, the springs penetrate through the support in the foot pads to form a suspension structure, and the mechanism to be damped is in a suspension state. The vibration damper adopts a special suspension structure design, has obvious vibration damping effect, and can effectively absorb and reduce the vibration of a mechanism to be damped so as to reduce the running noise; by adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the stable value of the maximum A weight calculating sound pressure level reaches about 42dB through testing, which is about 8dB lower than that of the oxygen generator on the market, and the noise reduction effect is very obvious. In addition, the suspension structure is designed, so that the installation is convenient, the structure is simple, and the assembly and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant and high-hydrophobicity electric-grade magnesium oxide powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-temperature-resistant and high-hydrophobicity electric-grade magnesium oxide powder and a preparation method thereof. The product of the invention is characterized in that the inside of the particle is high-purity magnesium oxide, and the outside is an inorganic silicon oxide coating. The preparation process comprises the following steps: pulverizing and sieving to obtain fused magnesite with a certain mesh number, and ageing and growing the fused magnesite with a silicon solution. The method specifically comprises the following operations: crushing and screening fused magnesia; then adding at least one organic silicon solvent and the fused magnesia for mixing and stirring; then adding an inducer; aging for a period of time, filtering, drying, and finally roasting to obtain the high-temperature-resistant and high-hydrophobicity electric-grade magnesium oxide powder. The method has the advantages of simple operation and low energy consumption, and the prepared electrical grade magnesium oxide has excellent hydrophobicity and high temperature resistance.

title_en: High-strength nitrogen-containing economical austenitic stainless steel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The high-strength nitrogen-containing economical austenitic stainless steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: c: 0.05-0.15%, Si: 0.3-1%, Mn: 8.5-11.0%, Cr: 14.0-16.0%, Ni: 1.0-2.5%, N: 0.10 to 0.25% of P<0.08％，S<0.01%, Cu: 0.5-2.0%, Mo: 0.1-0.5%, the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities, and Md 30/50 Not less than 20 ℃. In the manufacturing process, the invention refines crystal grains by two times of cold rolling and flexible annealing and utilizing the generation and inversion of deformed martensite, and finally obtains the crystal grains with the size below 500nm, thereby greatly improving the strength of the material, and the specific properties are as follows: the yield strength is more than or equal to 650MPa, the tensile strength is more than or equal to 1000MPa, the elongation is more than or equal to 35 percent, and the method is suitable for preparing high-strength thin-specification precise strip steel.

title_en: Method for recycling magnesium oxysulfate building material waste based on magnesite tailings and product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of construction waste recycling, and particularly relates to a method for recycling magnesium oxysulfate building material waste based on magnesite tailings, and further discloses a product prepared by the method. The method for recycling the magnesium oxysulfate building material waste based on the magnesite tailings is characterized in that the magnesium oxysulfate building material waste is heated and activated by a flue, and the performance of a magnesite tailing gel material is assisted, so that the compressive strength of a building material product is higher than 42.5MPa, the softening coefficient is higher than 0.9, and the building material product has the advantages of high strength and good water resistance; the material has the characteristics of high hardness, early strength and the like, and can be used for repairing materials; meanwhile, the product has uniform quality, stable performance and long service life, the main material in the product is composed of more than 95% of waste, the waste recycling rate can reach 90%, the method is economical, environment-friendly, energy-saving and emission-reducing, and the problems of recycling of magnesium building material waste, waste accumulation of low-grade magnesite tailings, use of magnesium sulfate produced by waste acid and the like are solved.

title_en: Surface in-situ metallization method based on cation conductive glass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface metallization method based on cation migration, reaction and in-situ growth in cation conductive glass under the composite action of a temperature field and an electric field. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of butting cation conductive glass and a metal foil between a positive electrode and a negative electrode in a vacuum furnace, applying certain axial pressure and heating, activating cations in the glass at high temperature to generate ionization, loading a direct current electric field, forming directional migration transport by the cations, enriching the cations on the side surface of a glass negative electrode, generating an oxidation reduction reaction with free charges to generate a simple substance, then growing a metal layer in situ in a surface micro-nano structure, generating a diffusion or eutectic reaction with the butted metal foil, avoiding the contact of the metal layer and the electrode, and increasing the metallization thickness. The invention has the advantages that the metal layer is closely attached to the surface of the glass to grow, the connection strength is high, the spreading and wetting performance of the metal layer on the surface of the glass after melting is excellent, and the welding and packaging performance of the glass is obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent temperature-adjusting sentry box with heat-insulating and energy-saving functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent temperature-adjusting sentry box with heat insulation and energy saving functions, and belongs to the field of energy-saving buildings. The intelligent temperature-regulating sentry box with heat-insulating and energy-saving functions is characterized by that on the basis of main beam frame said sentry box is formed from top cover, wall body, door and window, and the glass used for said window is formed from glass base body and M adhered to or coated on its surface x WO 3 /WO 3 /VO 2 The composite nano particle film is characterized in that the top cover and the wall body are composed of steel plates and heat insulation felts attached to the steel plates. The heat-insulating energy-saving/intelligent temperature-regulating sentry box disclosed by the invention not only can be applied to expressways and charging stations of parking lots, but also can be widely applied to duty sentry boxes of rapid bus stations, property districts, squares, parks, waiting halls, various public places and the like, and the M is mentioned x WO 3 /WO 3 /VO 2 The composite particles and the film have wide application prospect in the fields of building window glass and automobile glass.

title_en: Dressing and smelting process of complex copper-zinc ore containing gold and silver
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dressing and smelting process of complex copper-zinc ore containing gold and silver, which is characterized in that the dressing and smelting process is combined by flotation, acid leaching and cyaniding leaching, namely, the flotation of silver-gold copper sulfide ore is carried out after ore grinding to obtain concentrate containing gold and silver and copper; if the copper oxide mineral belongs to an easily floatable copper mineral, performing copper oxide flotation on tailings subjected to silver-gold copper sulfide mineral flotation, grinding copper oxide concentrate to a certain fineness, leaching copper and zinc by adopting an acid leaching process and separating, performing cyanidation process on tailings subjected to gold and silver leaching-copper oxide flotation after pulp conditioning on tailings of the concentrate, leaching copper and zinc by adopting the acid leaching process and separating, and performing cyanidation process on tailings subjected to pulp conditioning on the tailings of the concentrate to leach gold and silver; if the copper oxide mineral belongs to a copper mineral which is difficult to float, the tailings of the flotation of the silver-gold copper sulfide mineral are directly leached out of copper and zinc by adopting an acid leaching process and separated, and the tailings are subjected to a cyaniding process to leach out gold and silver after size mixing. The process provided by the invention can improve the resource utilization rate and bring higher economic benefits for enterprises.

title_en: Postweld cooling method for high-frequency induction welded steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a postweld cooling method for a high-frequency induction welded steel pipe, belonging to the technical field of welded steel pipes; according to the invention, the formation of a metallographic structure of a welding seam of the welded steel pipe is controlled by water cooling and controlling the cooling speed to be 15-30 ℃/s, wherein the metallographic structure comprises granular bainite and/or lath bainite and ferrite, so that the fine control of the welding seam structure is realized, the softening of a heat affected zone is eliminated, and the cracking problem of a high-frequency induction welded pipe in a flattening experiment is solved; the high-frequency induction welded pipe obtained by cooling by the method can pass a 1/2-diameter flattening test experiment, and the welding seam shows excellent deformability when the welding seam is in positive back pressure.

title_en: Method for preparing sintered water permeable brick by using waste alumina adsorbent and sludge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a sintered water permeable brick by using a waste alumina adsorbent and sludge. The sintered permeable brick comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 35-45 parts of waste alumina adsorbent, 18-25 parts of municipal sludge, 8-13 parts of clay, 5-10 parts of feldspar, 8-12 parts of water glass and 10-15 parts of water. The preparation method comprises the steps of material preparation, mixing, ageing, molding, microwave drying and firing. The invention realizes the resource utilization of solid wastes, reduces the production cost of the water permeable brick, and has simple preparation process, high production efficiency, environmental protection and energy saving.

title_en: Homogenizing method for improving conductivity of aluminum alloy ingot and aluminum alloy ingot prepared by homogenizing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a homogenizing method for improving the conductivity of an aluminum alloy ingot, which comprises the following steps: step (1), homogenizing: heating the cast aluminum alloy ingot to the heat preservation temperature of 500-600 ℃, and preserving heat for 10-20 hours; step (2), discharging: stably pulling the aluminum alloy cast ingot out of the furnace; step (3), cooling: cooling by strong wind for 0.5-2 hours, then cooling by water mist and strong wind, wherein the cooling speed is more than 200 ℃/h; and (4) discharging. The invention also provides the aluminum alloy ingot prepared by the homogenizing method for improving the conductivity of the aluminum alloy ingot. The homogenizing method changes the cooling mode from the original water cooling to the air cooling and the water mist cooling, improves the cooling speed during homogenizing, and ensures that the conductivity of the aluminum alloy cast ingot obtained by the homogenizing method exceeds 30 Ms/m.

title_en: Combined production of methanol, ammonia and urea
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the co-production of methanol and ammonia from a hydrocarbon feed together with the production of urea without the need to vent carbon dioxide captured from methanol or ammonia synthesis gas to the atmosphere and without the use of expensive air separation units and water gas shift. Carbon dioxide is removed from the flue gas from the reforming section to convert all ammonia partially or totally to urea. Methanol, ammonia and urea are co-produced to produce a coating for urea production.

title_en: Concrete water-saving heat-preservation and moisture-preservation device and maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-saving, heat-preserving and moisture-preserving device for concrete, which comprises a concrete chamber, a water collecting tank and a plurality of pairs of water delivery structures, wherein the water collecting tank is positioned below a vault of the concrete chamber and on the inner side of a side wall; the utility model discloses a water delivery structure, including water-absorbing core line and water delivery heart yearn, the one end of water-absorbing core line is located the inside of water catch bowl, the other end of water-absorbing core line and the one end fixed connection of water delivery heart yearn, the water delivery heart yearn closely laminates with the inner wall of concrete chamber, the fixed maintenance membrane that is used for keeping warm to moisturize that is equipped with in the outside of water delivery heart yearn, maintenance membrane and the inseparable overlap joint of the other end of water delivery heart yearn, the maintenance membrane covers the inner wall of concrete chamber completely. The invention also relates to a concrete water-saving heat-preserving and moisture-preserving curing method which has the advantages of high water-saving efficiency, good curing effect and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal and method for preparing tungsten-based nanosheet electrochromic film material by using same
abstract_en: A preparation method of a two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal and a method for preparing a tungsten-based nanosheet electrochromic film material by using the same relate to a preparation method of a tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal and a method for preparing a tungsten-based nanosheet electrochromic film material by using the same. The invention aims to solve the problem that the existing method is difficult to prepare the two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal. The preparation method of the two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a layered material after proton exchange reaction; secondly, preparing a layered material after intercalation reaction; and thirdly, mechanically stripping to obtain the two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal. And spin-coating the two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal onto the indium tin oxide conductive glass by using a spin coating instrument, and then placing the indium tin oxide conductive glass in a drying box for drying to obtain the tungsten-based nanosheet electrochromic film material. The invention can obtain a two-dimensional tungsten-based nanosheet liquid crystal and a tungsten-based nanosheet electrochromic film material.

title_en: Benzene ring substituted phthalocyanine/graphene oxide composite nonlinear optical material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benzene ring substituted phthalocyanine/graphene oxide composite nonlinear optical material and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of composite nonlinear optical materials, and aims to solve the problem of poor three-order nonlinear optical performance of the existing nonlinear optical material. The nonlinear optical material is prepared by bonding tetra-alpha- (4-hydroxymethyl benzyloxy) phthalocyanine compound and graphite oxide. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, 3- (4-hydroxymethyl benzyloxy) phthalic nitrile, n-amyl alcohol and Zn (CH) 3 COO) 2 Adding DBU and the phthalocyanine into a reaction container, and heating and reacting at 120-160 ℃ to obtain tetra-alpha- (4-hydroxymethyl benzyloxy) phthalocyanine; II, preparing GO; and thirdly, placing the DMF solution of GO and DCC in a reaction container, adding tetra-alpha- (4-hydroxymethyl benzyloxy) phthalocyanine after activation, and reacting at normal temperature under the protection of nitrogen. The composite optical material has good three-order nonlinear optical performance.

title_en: Method for treating tungsten ore
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating tungsten ore, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing tungsten ore with alkali liquor, performing alkali decomposition, and performing solid-liquid separation to obtain tungstate filtrate and first filter residue containing iron-manganese precipitate and tungsten slag; (2) performing acid dissolution on the first filter residue containing the iron-manganese precipitate and the tungsten residue, and performing solid-liquid separation to obtain a second filter solution containing iron and manganese and the tungsten residue; (3) mixing tungsten slag with sodium nitrate, urea and flake caustic soda, and then calcining and oxidizing to obtain sodium tungstate molten slag; (4) carrying out water leaching on the sodium tungstate molten slag, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain sodium tungstate and filter pressing slag; (5) adsorbing the second filtrate containing ferromanganese by an ion exchange column and then desorbing to obtain an external liquid containing ferromanganese and a desorption liquid containing tungstate and chromate; (6) and (3) removing impurities from the desorption solution containing tungstate and chromate, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain tungstate-containing pressure filtrate and chromium-containing slag, and returning the tungstate-containing pressure filtrate to the step (1).

title_en: Preparation method of morphology-adjustable copper hydroxyphosphate multi-level micron material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a morphology-adjustable copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material. The method comprises the following steps: uniformly stirring soluble copper salt and a buffer solution and standing to obtain a solution A; and carrying out hydrothermal synthesis reaction on the solution A, and washing and drying to obtain the copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material with different morphologies. The invention takes the buffer solution as a reaction medium, an alkali source and a phosphoric acid source, can effectively control the appearance of a product by changing the pH value of the buffer solution, has strong controllability and high practicability; the prepared copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material has a special multilevel structure, excellent monodispersity and good crystallinity, and has potential application value in the field of photocatalysis; the synthesis method and the required equipment are simple, the operation is simple and convenient, the product is free from other impurity products, subsequent purification, calcination and other treatment are not needed, the method is green and environment-friendly, and the method has high practicability.

title_en: Online monitoring device and method for sand mold printing process
abstract_en: The invention provides an online monitoring device for a sand printing process, which comprises an industrial camera, a monitoring system industrial personal computer, a printer controller, a display and a printer nozzle, wherein the industrial camera is fixedly connected to the printer nozzle, the printer controller is electrically connected with the printer nozzle and controls the printer nozzle to work, and the monitoring system industrial personal computer is electrically connected with the printer controller, the industrial camera and the display respectively. According to the invention, a dynamic monitoring mode is adopted, namely, the industrial camera moves along with the printer nozzle to shoot, the whole workbench plane is not required to be monitored, the requirements on resolution and frame frequency are not high, the two industrial cameras arranged on two sides of the printer nozzle are used for respectively monitoring the states before printing and after printing, so that higher image monitoring quality is obtained, and the real-time monitoring of the sand mould printing process is realized.

title_en: High-strength flame-retardant magnesium alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength flame-retardant magnesium alloy, and belongs to the technical field of magnesium alloys. The high-strength flame-retardant magnesium alloy disclosed by the invention comprises the following elements in percentage by weight: 1.8-2.7% of Sn, 1.2-1.8% of Bi, 0.2-0.6% of Ca, 0.4-0.6% of Nb, 0.3-0.45% of Sb, 4.5-6% of rare earth elements, and the balance of Mg and inevitable impurities. The high-strength flame-retardant magnesium alloy disclosed by the invention utilizes a multi-component microalloying method, and simultaneously improves the flame retardant property and the mechanical property of the magnesium alloy.

title_en: Au/CuSe tangential heterogeneous nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an Au/CuSe tangential heterogeneous nano material, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a nano gold colloidal solution in a hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide system, wherein the particle size of a gold nano ball is 18-22 nm; s2, preparing a sodium hydroselenide solution, adopting a water-phase synthesis method to take gold nanospheres as a growth substrate, sodium hydroselenide and copper acetate as precursors, ascorbic acid as a reducing agent and hexadecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide as a surfactant, and growing a two-dimensional copper selenide nano disc in the tangential direction of the gold nanospheres by vacuum reaction in the presence of hexamethylenetetramine to obtain an Au/CuSe tangential heterogeneous nanomaterial aqueous solution; and S3, separating, cleaning and drying to obtain the Au/CuSe tangential heterogeneous nano material. The Au/CuSe tangential heterogeneous nano material is prepared by using an all-water phase method, and the obtained heterogeneous nano material has a stable shape structure, an obvious double-plasmon coupling effect and excellent performance of photocatalytic hydrogen generation.

title_en: Method and device for preparing sodium bichromate by taking chromite as raw material in one step
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for preparing sodium bichromate by taking chromite as a raw material in one step, which specifically comprises the following steps: mixing and stirring chromite, soda ash, sodium hydroxide and water according to the mass ratio of 1: 1-1.1: 0.4-0.5: 5, and heating to 100 ℃ to obtain a mixed liquid material;reacting the mixed liquid material for 2-3 h under the oxygen pressure of 3-3.5 Mpa and the temperature of 200-230 ℃; after the reaction is finished, changing oxygen into carbon dioxide gas, wherein the pressure is 1.2-1.3 Mpa, the temperature is 60-70 ℃, and reacting for 2-3 h to obtain a mixed product; separating supernatant from the mixed product, obtaining white sodium bicarbonate crystals from the supernatant at the temperature of 10-15 ℃, separating the sodium bicarbonate, concentrating the solution, and cooling to obtain a sodium bichromate product; in the present invention, CO obtained by decomposing sodium hydrogencarbonate 2 And sodium carbonate is recycled, thereby realizing CO 2 The soda ash and the heat energy are efficiently and automatically recycled, and the waste of energy is reduced.

title_en: Method for refining and spheroidizing primary silicon in high-silicon aluminum alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for refining and spheroidizing primary crystal silicon in a high-silicon aluminum alloy, wherein in the related high-silicon aluminum alloy, the mass percent of Si is 18-50%, the mass percent of P is 0.003-0.02%, and the method for refining and spheroidizing the primary crystal silicon comprises the effective combination of the following methods, namely high-temperature melt overheating treatment, P salt modification treatment and thermal diffusion treatment.

title_en: High-nickel positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-nickel anode material and a preparation method thereof. The chemical composition of the high-nickel cathode material is Li  m  Ni  x  Co  y  Mn  z  M  1‑x‑y‑z  O  2  Wherein m is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 1.2; x is more than or equal to 0.5 and less than or equal to 0.9; y is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.3; z is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.2; 0 is more than or equal to 1-x-y-z is less than or equal to 0.1; m is one or more selected from alkali metal elements, alkaline earth metal elements, group 13 elements, group 14 elements, transition metals and rare earth elements; the discharge specific capacity of the cathode material at a multiplying power of 0.2C is between 190mAh/g and 205 mAh/g. The material has the characteristics of layered crystal structure, high tap density, narrow particle size distribution, high capacity and the like.

title_en: Production process of high-strength moisture-proof formaldehyde-purifying gypsum board
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a production process of a high-strength moisture-proof formaldehyde-cleaning gypsum board, which comprises the following steps: s100, injecting an unstable foaming agent, a stable foaming agent and a foam regulator into a foaming mold for foaming to form foaming water for later use; s200, adding the calcined gypsum powder, the inorganic fibers and the water into a mixer, and uniformly mixing to prepare a primary mixed slurry; s300, primarily mixing an organic binder and organic fibers in a dry adding device to form mixed powder, adding the mixed powder into a mixer to be mixed with the passive roller primarily mixed slurry to form remixed slurry; s400, foaming water is foamed into a mixing machine by adopting a dynamic foaming device and then mixed with slurry to form board core slurry; s500, pouring the mixed core slurry into a mold, and demolding after gypsum is solidified to form the gypsum board.

title_en: Dew point method for preventing surface oxidation of steel coil in heat-insulating cover
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dew point method for preventing the surface oxidation of a steel coil in a heat-insulating cover, which is characterized in that after hot coil rolling, coiling and bundling, the steel coil is directly transferred to a cold rolling unit by a steel coil conveying chain or a moving trolley, in the steel coil conveying process, the heat-insulating cover is adopted to carry out on-line heat-insulating treatment on the steel coil, and the annealing tempering is directly finished by utilizing the waste heat of the hot coil; the heat-insulating cover is provided with an exhaust hole and a corresponding control valve; the heat-insulating cover is of a composite structure and adopts heat-insulating materials as interlayers.

title_en: Macroscopic cement composition, method for producing macroscopic cement, engineered form of macroscopic cement and multistage homogenization process for preparing cementitious material
abstract_en: Macroscopic cements useful in the preparation of slurries, mortars, concretes and other cementitious materials having high workability, density, and strength, and related methods are disclosed. Methods for producing macroscopic cements include cements, supplementary Cementitious Materials (SCMs) including siliceous submicron particles and nanoscale particles, and polymers in the form of liquid or dry powder chemical admixtures for concrete. The cement mixture can be used for preparing ultra-high performance concrete (UHPC).

title_en: Low-density ITO target material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-density ITO target material and a preparation method thereof. The method prepares the low-density ITO target material through material mixing, primary sintering, ball milling purification, granulation molding and secondary sintering, does not need any additive or degreasing process, and can obtain the loose and porous ITO target material with the relative density of 35-70 percent only by placing the ITO target material in air and normal pressure sintering atmosphere under the action of pure water and sintering at high temperature. The production process of the invention does not produce waste gas, and the equipment is simple, the cost is low and the period is short.

title_en: Method for efficiently producing silicon tetrafluoride and sodium fluoride by using sodium fluosilicate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for efficiently producing silicon tetrafluoride and sodium fluoride by using sodium fluosilicate, which comprises a dehydration drying process, a decomposition process, a desilication process and an absorption process, and specifically comprises the following steps: dehydrating and drying the sodium fluosilicate to obtain anhydrous sodium fluosilicate; then, performing a decomposition process to obtain silicon tetrafluoride and a semi-finished product sodium fluoride; returning one part of the silicon tetrafluoride to the decomposition process to be used as fluidizing gas, and taking the other part of the silicon tetrafluoride as a silicon tetrafluoride product; directly performing a desiliconization process on part of the semi-finished product sodium fluoride to obtain a sodium fluoride product and generate silicon tetrafluoride tail gas; and the other part of the semi-finished product sodium fluoride is used for absorbing silicon tetrafluoride in the desiliconized tail gas to obtain a semi-finished product sodium fluosilicate, the semi-finished product sodium fluosilicate is returned to the decomposition process, and the tail gas in the absorption process is sent to an alkaline tower for treatment. The method is suitable for preparing silicon tetrafluoride and sodium fluoride by decomposing sodium fluosilicate, and has the advantages of short flow, low energy consumption, environmental friendliness, high product added value and the like.

title_en: Method and apparatus for cooling syngas
abstract_en: Method and device for cooling synthesis gas produced by catalytic steam reforming of a hydrocarbon-containing feed gas, which synthesis gas has been cooled by heat exchange with boiler feed water, thereby converting the boiler feed water into steam, while separating off the aqueous condensate formed, wherein further cooling is provided and only two steps are provided, namely heating the device to degas the boiler feed water and cooling by heat exchange with ambient air, whereby further cooling is performed, which requires only a small constructional height due to the small number of cooling steps required.

title_en: Activation process of defect-free DD3R molecular sieve membrane
abstract_en: The invention relates to an activation process of a defect-free DD3R molecular sieve membrane, which is used for activating and removing a template agent from the DD3R molecular sieve membrane to prepare the defect-free DD3R molecular sieve membrane and has high selectivity and high permeability. The process can effectively avoid the formation of the intercrystalline defects of the film and ensure the compactness of the film layer. Compared with the method of low-temperature ozone activation of the stripper plate agent, the preparation efficiency is obviously improved.

title_en: 3D printing device for laser selective solidification metal and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a 3D printing device for laser selective solidification of metal, and belongs to the field of additive manufacturing. The device comprises a 3D printing control device, a slurry printing spray head, a fixing frame, a spring clamp, a laser curing device, a printing platform and a direct current power supply. Mixing metal powder and liquid photosensitive resin to form slurry with proper solid phase volume, adopting slurry printing nozzle with special design and manufacture, extruding the slurry from nozzle with certain diameter by screw extruder; meanwhile, in the process of extrusion, dispersion and accumulation of slurry streamline, fine laser beam selection is adopted to synchronously scan the slurry streamline plane, so that the slurry streamline is locally and rapidly solidified and formed, and the slurry streamline is circularly reciprocated, thereby forming metal parts with certain shapes can be realized. The invention can directly form high-precision complex material parts, has high forming speed, low requirements on raw materials, wide adaptability and low cost, and has no special requirements on working environment.

title_en: Method for preparing composite metal plate by centrifugal casting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of steel smelting, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a composite metal plate by centrifugal casting. The method comprises the following steps: preheating a mould, hanging heat insulation coating, controlling the components and superheat degree of molten metal to be cast, casting when the rotating speed of the mould reaches the standard, immediately pouring second molten metal through a launder after the first metal is completely solidified, naturally cooling when the rotating speed of a centrifugal machine is zero, taking out a pipe blank, opening the composite pipe blank along an axis of the pipe blank, and heating and rolling the pipe blank by a heating furnace. The invention adopts centrifugal casting to prepare the composite pipe blank, cuts the composite pipe blank along the axial direction, heats the pipe blank with the cut, and then rolls the composite plate into the required specification through a rolling mill, and finally obtains the flat alloy plate.

title_en: Preparation method of copper-coated graphene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of copper-coated graphene, which comprises the following steps: 1) mixing and stirring graphene and water, homogenizing, and filtering to obtain graphene slurry; 2) mixing the graphene slurry with a surfactant, and performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a modified graphene slurry; 3) mixing the modified graphene slurry, soluble copper salt, sulfuric acid, a chloride ion additive, a copper luster additive, a carrier and water to obtain electroplating solution; 4) placing the electroplating solution in an electroplating device, and electroplating by taking a copper plate containing phosphorus as an anode and a titanium screen plate as a cathode; 5) filtering the electroplating solution after electroplating, mixing filter residues with a passivation solution, and performing passivation treatment; 6) and filtering, washing and drying the passivated slurry. According to the invention, the surface of graphene is treated by the surfactant, so that the problems of weak combination of copper and graphene and uneven material mixing density are solved, and the prepared graphene composite material has uniform particle size distribution and good density consistency and is convenient for subsequent stable production.

title_en: Manufacturing method of motor stator iron core
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a motor stator iron core, belonging to the technical field of motors and comprising the steps of preparing Fe78Si9B13 amorphous alloy, preparing an amorphous alloy strip, cutting the strip, carrying out isothermal annealing treatment on the strip, selecting a coating of the strip, stacking and solidifying the strip, cutting the strip and manufacturing an iron core sample. The invention has the effects of reducing the loss of the stator core of the motor and improving the efficiency of the motor.

title_en: Method for preparing ternary cathode material of lithium ion battery by hydrothermal auxiliary coprecipitation strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a ternary cathode material of a lithium ion battery by a hydrothermal auxiliary coprecipitation strategy, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing Ni by a hydroxide coprecipitation method 1‑x‑y Co x Mn y (OH) 2 Precursor, x + y<1; then carrying out hydrothermal crystallization treatment on the precursor, and finally carrying out lithium mixing roasting to obtain the lithium ion battery ternary cathode material LiNi 1‑x‑y Co x Mn y O 2 ，x+y<1. The prepared anode material has higher charge-discharge specific capacity and cycling stability, and the method has remarkable effect on improving the electrochemical performance of the ternary anode material of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Steel slag treatment method for improving recovery rate of iron in steel slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel slag processing method for improving the recovery rate of iron in steel slag, which can effectively improve the porosity in the steel slag and increase the inner diameter of pores by pretreating the steel slag before solid-phase modification, introducing nitrogen into the original steel slag in a molten state, cooling the steel slag, and then carrying out liquid nitrogen low-temperature crushing and grinding on the cooled steel slag, and simultaneously fully contacting oxygen in a high specific surface area state, so that oxygen in the air can enter the steel slag to fully react when the steel slag is modified in a solid phase, the cold steel slag is calcined in the air, iron oxide and magnesium oxide in the steel slag are promoted to be more fully converted into the strong-magnetism pleonaste, further improves the iron recovery rate of the treated steel slag during magnetic separation, and after the iron and magnesium impurities in the steel slag are converted into strong magnetic magnesium iron spinel, the grindability of the steel slag can reach a more ideal level, and the strength of the tailings used as cement can be improved to a great extent.

title_en: Aluminum-silicon electronic packaging material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum-silicon electronic packaging material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing aluminum-silicon alloy powder by using a gas atomization or strip casting process; 2) placing the obtained aluminum-silicon alloy powder into a sheath, compacting, and then carrying out cold isostatic pressing to obtain a cold isostatic pressing compact; 3) and (4) carrying out hot extrusion by adopting the obtained cold isostatic pressing compact to obtain the aluminum-silicon electronic packaging material. The prepared silicon-aluminum electronic packaging material has the advantages of high density of the silicon-aluminum alloy, high tensile strength and elongation and better thermal conductivity, and simultaneously, the method can be used for large-scale and large-batch production.

title_en: Na3Mg3(PO4)3MgO photocatalytic material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to Na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 Photocatalytic material and process for producing the sameSeed Na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 MgO photocatalytic material, preparation method and application; na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 MgO photocatalytic material, said Na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 the/MgO photocatalytic material comprises MgO and Na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 MgO and Na 3 Mg 3 (PO 4 ) 3 The mass ratio is as follows: (88.4% -97.2%): (2.8% -11.6%); the preparation method mainly comprises grinding and roasting; use of photocatalytic material for the conversion of CO under simulated solar radiation 2 Reducing to CO. The magnesium and the phosphorus are safe, nontoxic and cheap, and the composite material has the advantage of no secondary pollution to the environment.

title_en: Pulling and vibrating driving equipment of blast furnace maintenance and disassembly robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses pulling, vibrating and driving equipment of a blast furnace maintenance, disassembly and assembly robot and a working method thereof. The pulling and vibrating driving device comprises a supporting seat, a pulling driving device and a vibrating driving device, the pulling driving device comprises a cylinder body and a first piston rod, the vibrating driving device comprises a vibrating plate and an elastic component, the first piston rod can move between a first position and a second position, the elastic component can move between an initial position and a shrinkage position, and when the elastic component moves from the shrinkage position to the initial position, the elastic component drives the vibrating plate to impact the vibrating block so as to drive one end of the first piston rod extending out of the front cover of the cylinder body to move from the second position to the first position. The driving device can provide pulling force and vibration and pulling force for the windband with welding condition to detach the windband. And the structure is compact, the arrangement is reasonable, the practicability is strong, and the device is suitable for the complex environment of a steel mill.

title_en: Titanium alloy sheet and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium alloy sheet and a processing method thereof, the titanium alloy sheet is subjected to plasma arc cladding technology, lead iodide powder and tungsten carbide powder are mixed to generate a coating capable of strengthening the electromagnetic protection of the titanium alloy sheet on the surface of the titanium alloy sheet, the weight of the alloy is further reduced on the premise of ensuring the alloy hardness, and electromagnetic waves are enabled to change the direction in the transmission process and to advance along a metal material, so that the electromagnetic shielding effect is effectively exerted, and the spacecraft is ensured to be free from the radiation of space ions.

title_en: Coal gangue chemical foaming concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal gangue chemical foaming concrete and a preparation method thereof, wherein the concrete comprises the following raw materials: the quick hardening sulphoaluminate cement or ordinary portland cement, the mixture of coal gangue and quicklime, the foaming cement waterproof foam stabilizer, the foaming cement early strength reinforcing agent, the naphthalene water reducer, manganese dioxide, water and potassium chlorate solution. The coal gangue chemical foaming concrete prepared by the invention has the characteristics of small slurry water cement ratio, high later strength of the foaming concrete, low foaming speed and the like. The requirement on the environmental temperature is not strict, the production can be carried out in the environment with lower temperature, the production period is prolonged, and the production conditions are reduced. The coal gangue chemical foaming concrete prepared by the invention has the advantages of light weight, high strength, good heat preservation effect, low construction cost, high safety factor and the like. The method can be used for building external wall heat preservation, roof heat preservation, sedimentation type toilet backfill and mine goaf filling.

title_en: Semi-solid continuous pulping system
abstract_en: The invention provides a semi-solid continuous pulping system which comprises a large-quantity heat preservation furnace, a small-quantity heat preservation furnace, stirring equipment and a die-casting island, wherein an extraction pipeline is arranged between the large-quantity heat preservation furnace and the small-quantity heat preservation furnace, and a conveying pipeline is arranged between the small-quantity heat preservation furnace and the die-casting island. The alloy melt is extracted from the large holding furnace to the small holding furnace, the small holding furnace is utilized to improve the holding precision, and the pipeline extraction is used for transferring and transporting the slurry, so that Shang Dengxiang-closing mobile transportation equipment in the traditional pulping process is reduced, the preparation cost is reduced, and the operation is simple; the semi-solid preparation method can be used for continuously pulping, so that the pulping time is greatly saved, the production and preparation efficiency is improved, and purer alloy melt can be extracted to prepare the pulp by the method, so that the die casting with higher quality is obtained.

title_en: Method for preparing ceramic composite coating of refractory transition metal compound
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a refractory compound ceramic composite coating of transition metals. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing metal simple substance/silicon carbide composite powder; the metal elementary powder is any x of zirconium, titanium, hafnium, tantalum, niobium, vanadium, chromium, molybdenum or tungsten, and x is 1,2,3 or 4; secondly, pretreating the surface of the base material of the coating; thirdly, spraying the metal simple substance/silicon carbide composite powder on the surface of the substrate material by adopting a thermal spraying method, thereby synthesizing the refractory compound ceramic composite coating of the transition metal through in-situ reaction. The invention overcomes the defects of complex process, high cost, large pollution, low deposition efficiency, low coating thickness, poor coating performance and unsuitability for large-scale industrial production in the prior art for preparing the refractory compound ceramic composite coating of transition metals.

title_en: Method for reducing free oxygen content of converter end-point metal molten pool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the free oxygen content of a converter end-point molten metal pool, belongs to the technical field of metallurgy, and solves the problem that clean smelting of molten steel cannot be achieved due to the fact that the free oxygen content of the converter end-point molten metal pool is too high in the prior art. A method for reducing the free oxygen content in the end point metal molten pool of converter features that the carbon-oxygen reaction interface of metal molten pool is increased, the CO partial pressure in metal molten pool is reduced, and the free oxygen content is reduced by controlling the gas supply of bottom-blowing gas supply element, the oxygen supply of top-blowing at the end point of converter and the combined blowing of bottom-blowing and top-blowing gas supply.

title_en: Low-molybdenum niobium alloy cast iron cylinder sleeve and preparation method thereof and iron alloy
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-molybdenum niobium alloy cast iron cylinder sleeve, a preparation method thereof and an iron alloy, wherein the iron alloy comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 2.8-3.0% of C; 1.6-2.3% of Si; 0.1-0.2% of Mo; 0.1-0.18% Nb; 0.05 to 0.1% of S; less than 0.1% P; less than 0.3% Mn; the balance being Fe. The invention optimizes the content of each element in the cylinder sleeve, so that the cylinder sleeve has good mechanical property, higher corrosion resistance and low cost. The experimental result shows that the properties of the cast iron cylinder sleeve material are as follows: HBW240-300, tensile strength greater than 370MPa, elastic modulus greater than 135 GPa. The cylinder sleeve provided by the invention has the advantages that the matrix structure of the cylinder sleeve is mainly fine lamellar pearlite, the structure is stable, the phase change is not easy to occur, the corrosion is not easy to occur, and the using effect is excellent. The preparation method has the advantages of simple and stable preparation process and low cost.

title_en: High-strength composite grouting reinforcement material with island structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength composite grouting reinforcement material with an island structure and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of engineering grouting reinforcement. The material comprises a component A (silicate aqueous solution, polyisocyanate, polyol, reaction stabilizer and film-forming additive) with the viscosity of less than 300mpa.s and a component B (reaction promoter, reinforcing agent and cooling agent) with the viscosity of less than 200mpa.s, and has a sea-island structure through content adjustment of proper components, the compressive strength of the material can reach more than 65Mpa, self-extinguishing within 1s after leaving fire can be realized, the material has high safety, good stability, low viscosity, strong permeability and large diffusion radius, and the material is applied to the fields of coal mine roof and floor reinforcement, roadway reinforcement, slope reinforcement, soft soil foundation reinforcement and the like, so that the mechanical structure of a working surface can be effectively improved, and the bearing capacity of the working surface can be improved; meanwhile, the preparation method is simple and easy to operate, and the preparation cost of the reinforcing material can be further reduced.

title_en: Replacement type grouting forming duct piece plugging method for high-pressure punching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a replacement type grouting forming duct piece leakage stopping method for high-pressure punching, which is characterized in that a double-channel pipe body is arranged, and the double-channel pipe body is provided with a first channel and a second channel which are connected in parallel; firstly, high-pressure water flow is introduced through the second channel to form a flushing channel in the direction towards a water leakage point in a soil body, and simultaneously, slag discharge and pressure relief are carried out through the first channel; and then, plugging slurry is introduced through the first channel, and grouting is formed towards a water leakage point through the flushing channel, so that replacement type grouting leakage plugging is realized. The invention can lead the leakage stopping slurry to smoothly reach the leakage point, realize effective leakage stopping, simultaneously realize pressure relief by utilizing the double-channel pipe body, effectively avoid the increase of the pressure at the back of the pipe piece, ensure the assembling quality of the pipe piece and ensure the smooth surface appearance.

title_en: Fireproof material for protective building material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof material for protective building materials and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fireproof material is prepared by processing the following raw materials in parts by weight, 0.3-0.8 part of modified aerogel, 20-40 parts of magnesium oxide, 8-12 parts of calcium carbonate powder, 0.2-0.5 part of mortar concrete fiber, 0.5-2 parts of redispersible latex powder, 25-30 parts of magnesium sulfate solution and 2-6 parts of light-cured resin; according to the invention, the mould poured with the slurry is treated, so that a large amount of air is prevented from being mixed, the slurry is quickly leveled, the slurry is also added with the photocureable resin as a raw material, after the slurry in the mould is leveled and bubbles are removed, the slurry is sent into the primary shaping device through the conveyor belt, and the ultraviolet light is emitted by the ultraviolet LED lamp to promote the solidification of the slurry, so that the surface of the slurry in the mould has certain strength and cannot be deformed due to transfer, thereby facilitating the batch transfer of the mould and the maintenance and shaping of the slurry, separating the slurry pouring and maintenance places, and being beneficial to the high efficiency of industrial production.

title_en: Method and apparatus for depositing a coating on continuous fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for depositing a coating from a coating precursor (140) on a continuous carbon fibre or silicon carbide fibre (150), said method comprising at least heating segments of said fibre in the presence of said coating precursor in a microwave field so as to bring the surfaces of said segments to a temperature at which said coating can be formed on said segments from said coating precursor. The invention also relates to a device for carrying out said method.

title_en: Method for cladding complex curved surface revolution body by ultra-high-speed laser
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser cladding technology, in particular to a method for cladding a complex curved surface revolving body by ultrahigh-speed laser. Firstly, setting parameters such as a cladding linear velocity V and the like according to process requirements; according to the lap joint rate delta and the ultrahigh-speed laser cladding single-track width D L Performing fitting calculation on a contour bus of the complex curved surface revolving body according to the parameters, and setting an ultrahigh-speed laser cladding path of the complex curved surface revolving body into an i-section space spiral line; obtaining the rotation angular velocity omega when the ultra-high speed laser cladding complex curved surface revolution body i And the moving speed of the laser cladding head along the X axis Speed of movement along Y-axis And the rotational angular velocity epsilon of the laser cladding head i And the maintenance of the cladding linear velocity V is ensured to be stable. By the method, the relative movement of the ultrahigh-speed laser cladding head and the complex revolving body revolving at high speed can be efficiently regulated, the stability of parameters in the ultrahigh-speed laser cladding process is effectively ensured, the cladding efficiency is stabilized while the cladding quality is ensured, and the cladding layer with better metallurgical bonding, compactness and uniform thickness is prepared.

title_en: Method for converting regenerated cryolite into aluminum fluoride
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for converting regenerated cryolite into aluminum fluoride, which solves the problem of high cost of leaching and precipitating fluorine in carbon slag by adopting aluminum nitrate. The method comprises the steps of separating fluorine and chlorine from cryolite separated from carbon slag by using sodium hydroxide to obtain a sodium fluoride and sodium aluminate mixed solution, reacting sodium fluoride with an acidic solution in an acid solution adding mode to obtain hydrogen fluoride and sodium salt, reacting the hydrogen fluoride with water in the solution to obtain hydrofluoric acid, and reacting the obtained hydrofluoric acid with sodium aluminate to obtain an aluminum fluoride precipitate. The invention realizes the recycling of the carbon slag, and adopts the following reactants: the price of sodium hydroxide is very low compared with that of aluminum nitrate, and the price of one ton of sodium hydroxide in the current market is only about one third of that of one ton of aluminum nitrate, so that the industrial production cost of aluminum fluoride is greatly reduced, and the large-scale industrial popularization is facilitated.

title_en: Common-mode iron core transverse magnetic treatment charging rack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a common-mode iron core transverse magnetic treatment charging frame, which relates to the technical field of metal heat treatment and comprises an upright post, a charging tray locking device, a charging tray upper cover plate, a charging tray and a base, wherein the upright post is fixedly connected with the center of the base, the upright post is vertically arranged with the base, a plurality of first ventilation holes are formed in the base, the number of the charging trays is multiple, the center of each charging tray is provided with a first through hole, each charging tray is sequentially sleeved on the upright post through each first through hole and stacked on the base, each charging tray is provided with a plurality of second ventilation holes, the charging tray locking device is sleeved on the upright post, each charging tray can be tightly pressed by the charging tray locking device, a charging tray upper cover plate is arranged between the charging tray locking device and the uppermost layer of charging tray, and a cover plate heat dissipation hole is formed in the charging tray upper cover plate. According to the invention, the plurality of trays are arranged to hold the iron cores, and the ventilation holes are arranged, so that heat is fully dissipated in the treatment process, the locking device is arranged to prevent the iron cores from falling off, the single-furnace production capacity is improved, the charging efficiency is improved, the production cost is reduced, and the product breakage can be prevented.

title_en: Magnesium alloy surface toughening treatment process method and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnesium alloy surface toughening treatment process method and a device thereof, comprising the following steps: preparing a magnesium alloy rod/pipe, and horizontally and fixedly placing the magnesium alloy rod/pipe; the magnesium alloy rod/pipe is horizontally moved by using external force; the die of the rotary friction machine is contacted with the surface of the magnesium alloy rod/pipe, the inner surface of the die is uneven, and the rotary friction machine drives the rotary friction die to do rotary motion, so that the whole outer surface of the magnesium alloy rod/pipe can be subjected to great shearing deformation; and when the outer surface of the magnesium alloy rod/pipe is sheared, closing the rotary friction machine to stop the movement of the die and stop the movement of the magnesium alloy rod/pipe. The magnesium alloy surface toughening treatment process and the device thereof provided by the invention improve the toughness of the magnesium alloy bar surface, are not easy to damage and drop slag when the magnesium alloy is collided or pressed, and greatly improve the wear resistance and corrosion resistance of the magnesium alloy surface after treatment.

title_en: Transition metal hydroxide-graphene composite material for efficient photocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transition metal hydroxide-graphene composite material for efficient photocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, nitrate and trisodium citrate (C) are added into graphene oxide 6 H 5 O 7 Na 3 ) And heating Hexamethylenetetramine (HMTA), and freeze-drying to obtain different transition metal hydroxide-graphene composite materials. The nickel hydroxide-graphene composite material can efficiently and selectively reduce carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide in a solvent of terpyridyl ruthenium as a photosensitizer, triethanolamine as a sacrificial agent and hexanenitrile and water under the illumination of visible light.
