The method is simple and effective to operate, and provides beneficial theoretical and experimental basis for preparing the carbon dioxide material and the reaction system which are more efficiently reduced.

title_en: White, opaque, beta-spodumene glass-ceramic articles having inherent damage resistance and methods of making the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to white, opaque, beta-spodumene glass-ceramic articles having inherent damage resistance and methods of making the same. Crystallizable glasses, glass-ceramics, IX-compatible glass-ceramics, and IX-compatible glass-ceramics are disclosed. The glass-ceramic exhibits β -spodumene ss as the predominant crystalline phase. These glasses and glass-ceramics comprise, in mole%: 60-75 SiO  2  (ii) a 10-18 of Al  2  O  3  (ii) a 5 to 14 of Li  2  O; and 4.5 of B  2  O  3  . The glass-ceramic also has a vickers crack initiation threshold of at least about 25 kgf.

title_en: Ultrathin porous bismuth oxide nanosheet loaded graphene composite material and preparation method thereof, lithium ion battery cathode and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrathin porous bismuth oxide nanosheet loaded graphene composite material and a preparation method thereof, a lithium ion battery cathode and a lithium ion battery.

title_en: High-efficiency low-cost thermal reduction nickel plating method for silicon carbide particle surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency low-cost thermal reduction nickel plating method for silicon carbide particle surfaces, which comprises the steps of adopting basic nickel carbonate, polyacrylamide and ammonia water as surface modifiers to carry out surface modification treatment on silicon carbide powder particles to obtain silicon carbide powder particles wrapped by the basic nickel carbonate; and (3) placing the silicon carbide powder subjected to surface modification treatment in a hydrogen reduction furnace for heating reduction treatment to obtain silicon carbide powder particles with the surfaces coated with nickel coatings. The invention omits the coarsening process of strong corrosive medicines such as hydrofluoric acid, nitric acid or sodium hydroxide and the like adopted in common chemical plating by adopting the reduction plating method, and also solves the problems of difficult treatment and serious environmental pollution of the plating solution after the traditional chemical plating by adopting the thermal reduction method.

title_en: High-heat-conductivity energy pile and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-heat-conductivity energy pile and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the high-heat-conductivity energy pile comprises a concrete pile body, a steel bar framework and a heat exchange tube structure, wherein the steel bar framework is embedded in the concrete pile body, the steel bar framework is a cylindrical steel bar net, and the heat exchange tube structure comprises a plurality of heat exchange tubes fixedly arranged on the inner side of the steel bar net, a liquid inlet convergence cavity connected with liquid inlets of the heat exchange tubes, a liquid inlet tube connected with the liquid inlet convergence cavity, a liquid outlet convergence cavity connected with liquid outlets of the heat exchange tubes and a liquid outlet tube connected with the liquid outlet convergence cavity. According to the high-heat-conductivity energy pile, the heat exchange tube structure is fixed on the inner side of the steel reinforcement framework, so that the heat exchange tube structure and the steel reinforcement framework form a connected whole, the stability of the energy pile is enhanced, the plurality of heat exchange tubes form a general branch structure through the liquid inlet gathering cavity and the liquid outlet gathering cavity, liquid contacts heated concrete with a larger area through the plurality of heat exchange tubes, heat is gathered conveniently, and the temperature of the liquid is increased rapidly.

title_en: Preparation method of graphene/carbon nanotube reinforced magnesium-lithium-based composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a graphene/carbon nano tube reinforced magnesium-lithium based composite material, which comprises the following steps: a. firstly, respectively preparing an Mg-Li-Al alloy ingot and an Mg-Al-based composite ingot containing carbon nano tubes/graphene reinforced phases; b. reheating two different alloy ingots to form alloy slurry; c. mixing the two alloy slurries, and casting to obtain a cast ingot of the Mg-Li-based composite material containing the carbon nano tube/graphene reinforced phase; d. and carrying out heat treatment and plastic deformation on the prepared Mg-Li-based composite material ingot. The method can effectively solve the problem that the strengthening effect is reduced because the graphene/carbon nano tube is easily eroded by Li element in the traditional composite material preparation process through a simple process.

title_en: Method for improving sintering yield of titanium concentrate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of titanium metallurgy, and particularly relates to a method for improving the sintering yield of titanium concentrate. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing a method for improving the sintering yield of titanium concentrate, which comprises the following steps: a. weighing coke powder, a binder and the wet-milled titanium concentrate, then adding water into the binder, the titanium concentrate and part of the coke powder for mixing and granulating to obtain a sintering mixture; b. uniformly paving a bottom material at the bottom of the sintering equipment, then uniformly paving a sintering mixture, punching a hole on the surface of the sintering mixture, scattering the residual coke powder on the surface of the sintering mixture, and then igniting and sintering. The method can improve the air permeability of the material surface in the sintering process and improve the sintering yield of the titanium concentrate.

title_en: Black titanium dioxide optical nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium dioxide nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photocatalysts. The preparation method adopts a method combining sol-gel and solid phase synthesis, and the method comprises the steps of dissolving soluble titanium salt and then adding alkaline solution to obtain precipitate; then reacting the precipitate with a reducing agent to obtain titanium dioxide precursor gel with electronegative groups; sintering the titanium dioxide precursor gel with electronegative groups in inert gas to obtain the pure titanium dioxide nano material rich in oxygen vacancy defects. The titanium dioxide nano material which is rich in oxygen vacancy defects and prepared by the preparation method has the oxygen vacancy content of 8 percent, the energy band gap of 1.94eV, and has higher photocatalytic activity compared with other titanium dioxide. The method has the advantages of green, simplicity, high purity, strong safety, energy conservation, environmental protection and large-scale mass production, and the material can be applied to the fields of organic dye degradation, gas purification and the like.

title_en: Quenching device for push-plate type quenching and tempering production line
abstract_en: A quenching device for a push-plate type quenching and tempering production line comprises a furnace body, a cooling water tank, a first feeding unit, a second feeding unit, an air supply unit, a sensor unit, a heating unit, a water circulation unit and a power unit, wherein the first feeding unit and the heating unit are arranged in the furnace body, and the second feeding unit is arranged in the cooling water tank in a lifting manner; the feeding end of the second feeding unit is connected with the discharging end of the first feeding unit; the power unit comprises a first motor, a second motor and a cylinder, the first motor provides power for the first feeding unit and the second feeding unit, and the second motor provides power for the air supply unit and the water circulation unit; the cylinder provides power for the lifting of the second feeding unit; the first feeding unit conveys the parts to be quenched into the furnace body 1 for high-temperature quenching, and then conveys the parts to the second feeding unit, and the second feeding unit lifts and lowers to bring the parts into the cooling box for rapid cooling.

title_en: Method for extracting iron by reducing iron scale with converter slag
abstract_en: A method for extracting iron by reducing iron scale with converter slag specifically comprises the following steps: adding iron scale into the slag pot before slag discharging, and uniformly spreading the iron scale on the bottom of the pot; pouring 1/3 slag into the slag pot after tapping to fully mix the slag with the iron scale, and then manually throwing coke powder into the slag pot; after the reaction is completed, 1/3 slag is poured in, and the coke powder is added again in the same method; finally, pouring the residual slag and replenishing the coke powder again; after deslagging, inserting the slag into the liquid level of a slag tank by using an air blowing gun, blowing nitrogen and stirring, and adding river sand in batches while blowing and stirring to modify the converter slag; standing and cooling; and (6) turning over the tank and tapping. According to the invention, the coke powder is added as a reducing agent, and the heat of the converter slag is utilized to directly reduce the iron scale, so that on one hand, the heat of the converter slag is fully utilized, and on the other hand, the iron scale and the ferrous oxide in the converter slag can be directly reduced to obtain the metallic iron with the content of more than 90%.

title_en: High-thermal-stability equiaxed nanocrystalline Ti6Al4V-Cr alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a titanium alloyThe field of gold materials, in particular to an equiaxed nanocrystalline Ti6Al4V-Cr alloy with high thermal stability and a preparation method thereof. The titanium alloy comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: al: 5.0 to 7.0; v: 3.0 to 5.0; cr: 0.01 to 6.5; the balance being Ti. The preparation method of the titanium alloy comprises the following steps: firstly, after preserving the heat for a period of time above 950 ℃, rapidly cooling to room temperature to obtain a nano-batten precursor; then, the nano-lath precursor is subjected to temperature of 650-850 ℃ and strain rate of 0.1-5 s ‑1 The total strain amount is more than or equal to 70 percent, so that the nano lath precursor is converted into an equiaxed nano crystal structure. The high-thermal stability nanocrystalline Ti6Al4V-Cr alloy prepared by the invention has excellent comprehensive mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to a plurality of important fields of aerospace, biomedical treatment, petrochemical industry, automobile industry, ocean engineering and the like.

title_en: Ultra-large-volume high-strength low-hydration-heat concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of concrete, and particularly discloses super-large-volume high-strength low-hydration-heat concrete and a preparation method thereof; the super-large-volume high-strength low-hydration-heat concrete is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: cement, coarse aggregate, fine aggregate, silicon nitride, fly ash, water and acrylic acid-acrylamide solid composite resin; the acrylic acid-acrylamide resin is prepared by reacting the following raw materials in parts by weight: acrylic acid, acrylamide, a cross-linking agent, an initiator, ammonia water and water; the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing and stirring raw materials of acrylic acid-acrylamide resin to obtain acrylic acid-acrylamide resin; s2, mixing and stirring the coarse aggregate, the fine aggregate, the acrylic acid-acrylamide resin, the silicon nitride and the fly ash, and then sequentially adding cement and water to stir to obtain concrete; the present application has the advantage of reducing the rate of hydration exotherm while maintaining the strength of the concrete.

title_en: Zinc-containing blast furnace gas ash smelting device and smelting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a zinc-containing blast furnace gas ash smelting device and a smelting method, which belong to the technical field of gas ash smelting methods, wherein the smelting device comprises a smelting furnace, a feeding mechanism, a discharging mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, the smelting furnace is in a strip shape, the lower part of the smelting furnace is buried under the ground, the bottom surface of the smelting furnace is arranged at an included angle with the horizontal plane, the smelting furnace is used for smelting zinc-containing gas ash and producing molten iron and zinc oxide crude products, the feeding mechanism is used for conveying blast furnace gas ash dry balls into the smelting furnace, the discharging mechanism is used for receiving molten iron and liquid slag output from the smelting furnace, and the monitoring mechanism is used for monitoring the temperature and the material reaction process in the smelting furnace; compared with blast furnace smelting, the zinc-containing blast furnace gas ash smelting device and the smelting method have the technical effects that the strip-shaped smelting furnace can be used for smelting zinc-containing gas ash, and the reaction is stable and rapid in the smelting process.

title_en: Process method for improving surface hardness of curved surface material through jet cavitation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of surface strengthening of metal materials, and relates to a process method for improving the surface hardness of a curved surface material by jet cavitation. And machining the metal material into a curved surface sample with a fixed structure. And (4) pretreating the curved surface sample by utilizing electrolytic polishing and ultrasonic cleaning. Fixing the pretreated metal material in a cavitation cavity, and carrying out submerged water jet cavitation treatment on the curved surface sample by using a double-layer annular nozzle. And respectively carrying out hardness test on the metal material subjected to jet cavitation and the metal material subjected to pretreatment but not subjected to jet cavitation, loading the load for 2.94N, and maintaining the pressure for 15 s. After the water jet cavitation strengthening treatment is carried out on the metal sample by using the method, the hardness of the surface of the material is obviously improved compared with the sample which is not subjected to the water jet cavitation strengthening treatment.

title_en: Array spherical hot runner plate heat exchanger
abstract_en: An array spherical hot runner plate type heat exchanger is an array spherical hot runner plate type evaporator based on a heat pump technology and a vacuum low-temperature evaporation technology, and 1, a falling film plate type heat exchanger is formed by welding stamping plates which are high in heat conduction 6063-T6 and enhanced in heat conduction and strength through vacuum heat diffusion nano-diamond. 2. Consists of plates with the same height and gradually widened. 3. The bottom is conical to contain the raw materials. 4. The full-automatic process of qualified product of feeding evaporation monitoring is formed. The invention solves the problems of large occupied area, high energy consumption, complex and fussy working procedures and the like of the traditional multi-effect evaporation concentration, and is particularly suitable for concentrating and extracting juice sugarcane juice or Chinese herbal medicine with heat sensitivity and easy oxidation. Vacuum low-temperature concentration is completed in one tank body, food safety is guaranteed, secondary pollution or manual sterilization links are eliminated, labor intensity and working requirements are reduced, and the like.

title_en: Method and device for improving environmental protection performance of sand spraying machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving the environmental protection performance of a sand-sprinkling machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the slurry dripping process of the mechanical arm, obtaining a first direction of movement of the mechanical arm; obtaining a first speed of movement of the manipulator arm; inputting a first direction and a first speed into a first neural network model, wherein the model is trained using a plurality of sets of training data, each set of training data in the plurality of sets of training data comprising: a first direction, a first speed, and identification information identifying a first result; obtaining output information of the model, wherein the output information comprises a first result, and the first result represents a result of whether the operation of the mechanical arm in the slurry dripping process meets the construction requirement; and obtaining a first instruction according to the first result, wherein the first instruction is used for executing an instruction for continuing or adjusting the slurry dripping action of the mechanical arm. The technical problem that workers are in close contact with equipment in the sand sprinkling process and the health of the workers is affected is solved.

title_en: Method for increasing nixing pottery kiln variability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for increasing the nixing pottery kiln variability. The method comprises the following steps: 1) mixing and grinding nixing pottery clay and a transmutation agent, sieving, and adding a transmutation agent to prepare a blank, wherein the transmutation agent comprises magnesium oxide, iron oxide and titanium oxide, and the transmutation agent comprises yttrium oxide, low-melting-point glass powder and ball clay; 2) placing the blank into a kiln for firing, firstly heating to a temperature 0-50 ℃ higher than the melting point of the low-melting-point glass powder, then primarily firing, continuously heating to a firing temperature of 1100-1150 ℃, and then stopping firing; wherein, when the temperature is continuously raised to 1000-1050 ℃, smoke generating materials are added for combustion and smoking; the tobacco-producing material is in a flaky or shell-shaped plant structure, is soaked in an acidic solution before entering a kiln, and then the water content is adjusted to 15-20%. The method effectively improves the kiln rate of the nixing ceramics, so that more high-quality nixing ceramics products are prepared, the requirements of more consumers are met, and the economic value of the nixing ceramics products and the economic benefit of enterprises are improved.

title_en: Automatic quenching device for motorcycle aluminum alloy hub after demolding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic quenching device for a motorcycle aluminum alloy wheel hub after demoulding, which comprises a base, wherein a stove is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a heating chamber is fixedly arranged at one side of the stove, a motor is fixedly arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the heating chamber, a wire roller is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, a supporting plate is arranged on the wire roller through steel cable transmission, a supporting column is fixedly arranged inside the supporting plate, and a disc is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the supporting column. Meanwhile, steam generated during cooling is sent by the ventilation equipment and is utilized by matching with external equipment, so that the energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Flexible control method for yield ratio of high-strength steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible control method of yield ratio of high-strength steel, belonging to the technical field of steel rolling, wherein a cooling process is controlled, the open cooling temperature is more than or equal to 760 ℃, a cooling mode of ultra-fast cooling DQ + accelerated cooling ACC is adopted, the cooling speed of a DQ section is controlled to be 20-40 ℃/s, after entering an ACC section, selecting a temperature value between 390 and 540 ℃ as an air cooling starting temperature, carrying out air cooling for 3-5s from the selected air cooling starting temperature, then carrying out water cooling, wherein the water cooling speed is controlled to be 10-20 ℃/s, so that the on-line control and adjustment of the yield ratio of the Q500MD high-strength steel are realized, an ideal bainite mixed structure is obtained, the requirements of users on different yield ratios are met on the premise that all properties of the finished steel plate meet GB/T1591 and 2018, the component route is avoided being redesigned, and the difficulty in steel-making and production scheduling is reduced.

title_en: Stone dry particles and rock plate with simulation effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of brick product coatings, and discloses stone dry particles and a rock plate with simulation effect, and a preparation method and application thereof. The main flux is potassium feldspar, the quartz is used as a filler and plays a role of a framework structure, and the addition of the cerium oxide not only enables the dry stone particles to have a colorful flashing effect, but also helps to reduce the high-temperature viscosity of the dry stone particles. In addition, the borocalcite, the zinc oxide, the dolomite and the calcite are all used as fluxing agents, which is beneficial to reducing the viscosity of dry stone grains at high temperature, and the leveling effect is good; barium carbonate and aluminum oxide are used as high-temperature raw materials, which is helpful for improving the initial melting point of dry stone particles. The dry stone particles obtained by the invention can be used as one of the raw materials for preparing the rock plate, have moderate transparency, distinct gradation, simulation effect and three-dimensional effect of real dry stone particles, higher initial melting point, more proper high-temperature viscosity and other performance requirements, and wide application prospect.

title_en: Low-fluorine lithium-free covering slag for titanium-containing welding wire steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses low-fluorine lithium-free covering slag for titanium-containing welding wire steel, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 25-40% of CaO; SiO2 2  25～40％；Mn 2 O 3  2～6％；B 2 O 3  3～10％；Al 2 O 3  2～5％；Na 2 6-8% of O; 5-7% of MgO; c6-15%; f is 0-2%; the balance being other unavoidable impurities. The low-fluorine lithium-free covering slag is environment-friendly covering slag with low F content and no Li, and the low-fluorine lithium-free covering slag can greatly improve the performance stability of covering slag of titanium-containing wire steel in the continuous casting process, thereby not only ensuring the stable and smooth continuous casting process of the titanium-containing wire steel, but also obviously improving the quality defects of the surface of a casting blank of the wire steel, such as scabs and slag inclusion.

title_en: Winter casting process for pipe sheet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winter casting process for a duct piece, and belongs to the technical field of production and manufacturing of tunnel duct pieces. The invention adopts the Portland cement to manufacture and form the semi-fluid concrete, and the aggregate does not have ice blocks and frozen block masses; the concrete stirring time is prolonged by 30s, and hot water is adopted for stirring, so that the mold-entering temperature of the concrete is ensured to be more than 10 ℃; the pouring of the concrete adopts a numerical control material distributor. The invention adopts the Portland cement to manufacture and form the semi-flowing concrete, thereby improving the quality of the segment manufactured in winter and improving the shear resistance of the segment. When the invention is used, the concrete has good performances of salt ion corrosion resistance, freeze-thaw cycle damage resistance, high permeation resistance and the like.

title_en: High-thermal-stability equiaxial nanocrystalline Ti-Fe alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of titanium alloy materials, in particular to an equiaxial nanocrystalline Ti-Fe alloy with high thermal stability and a preparation method thereof. The titanium alloy comprises the following chemical components (in weight percent): fe: 0.01 to 4.2; the balance being Ti. The preparation method of the titanium alloy comprises the following steps: firstly, after preserving the heat for a period of time above 860 ℃, rapidly cooling to room temperature to obtain a nano-lath precursor; then, the nano-lath precursor is subjected to a temperature of 670-750 ℃ and a strain rate of 0.02-1 s ‑1 The total strain amount is more than or equal to 70 percent, so that the nano lath precursor is converted into an equiaxed nano crystal structure. The high-thermal-stability nanocrystalline Ti-Fe alloy prepared by the invention has excellent comprehensive mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to aerospace, biomedical treatment, petrochemical industry, automobile industry, ocean engineering and the likeAn important field.

title_en: Method for recycling manganese from waste zinc-manganese dry battery positive electrode material and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling manganese from a waste zinc-manganese dry battery anode material, which comprises the following steps of firstly adopting a sodium sulfate solution to carry out discharge treatment on a waste zinc-manganese dry battery, manually disassembling and separating after reaching a safe voltage to obtain a manganese-containing anode active material, and then adopting an acid + oxidant system to carry out pressurization resource leaching on the anode active material. The method can effectively recycle manganese in the waste batteries, and can obtain the battery cathode material zinc sheet. The method adopts an acid + oxidant system to carry out acid leaching on the manganese battery material, obtains good recovery effect, realizes the recovery and utilization of manganese and zinc resources, provides a new idea for green and environment-friendly recovery of the battery, and has the characteristics of good recovery effect, low operation cost, no pollution to the environment and the like. The invention also discloses application of the method in resource recovery of manganese from the anode material of the waste zinc-manganese dry battery.

title_en: Powder paving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powder spreading device, which comprises a base, an anti-skid block, a die, a lower pressure head, a hopper opening limiting insertion plate, a hopper turntable, a nut, an upper pressure head fixing device, an upper pressure head and a hopper turntable support, wherein: the base top sets up mould and hopper carousel support, and hopper carousel support top sets up the hopper carousel, sets up hopper and last pressure head fixing device on the hopper carousel, and the hopper below sets up hopper opening restriction picture peg, goes up pressure head fixing device and goes up the upper pressure head through the nut, is equipped with the direction mouth on the base, sets up the non slipping spur in the direction mouth, and the non slipping spur top sets up down the pressure head, and the pressure head upper end extends to the mould hole down. The invention can realize the powder layer-by-layer laying in the powder forming process at the early stage of powder sintering, is suitable for preparing laminated materials, can control the thickness of each layer of powder and improves the forming quality of biscuit.

title_en: Annealing device for metal wire production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of annealing equipment, and discloses an annealing device for metal wire production, which comprises a metal wire forming device and also comprises: the wire outlet of the metal wire forming device is erected on the support frame; the annealing furnace is connected to the support frame and is internally provided with a heating device; the conveying wheel is arranged between a wire outlet of the metal wire forming device and the annealing furnace; a shielding gas device connected to the annealing furnace; wherein, annealing stove includes: the heating furnace comprises a heating furnace body, wherein a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the heating furnace body; the furnace cover is buckled on the heating furnace body, the feeding port is formed in the furnace cover, the feeding port and the discharging port are arranged oppositely, the wide applicability of the annealing device for producing the metal wire is guaranteed, the universality of the annealing device for producing the metal wire is improved, the protective gas device is connected to the bottom of the annealing furnace, the protective gas can completely discharge the air in the annealing furnace from the bottom of the annealing furnace, and the annealing effect of the device is guaranteed.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant and high-temperature-resistant sacrificial anode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a corrosion-resistant and high-temperature-resistant sacrificial anode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the material comprises, by mass, 4-6% of Zn, 0.035-0.05% of In, 0.04-0.1% of Sns, 0.3-1.0% of Mgs, 0.01-0.02% of Las, 0.01-0.02% of Y, 0.01-0.02% of Nds, less than or equal to 0.26% of impurity content, and the balance of Al. Melting electrolytic primary aluminum into an aluminum alloy solution, then blowing, refining, degassing, removing slag, adding Zn, in, sn and Mg, melting at 760-800 ℃, and cooling; heating to 800-820 ℃, adding Al-La intermediate alloy, al-Y intermediate alloy and Al-Nd intermediate alloy, refining, degassing and slag drawing at 840-860 ℃; finally, the temperature is kept at 700-720 ℃ for 60-80 min, and then the temperature is cooled to room temperature.

title_en: Blast furnace gas flow state identification method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blast furnace ironmaking, and discloses a blast furnace gas flow state identification method, a blast furnace gas flow state identification system and a storage medium, wherein the blast furnace gas flow state identification method is based on image identification and comprises the following steps: obtaining an infrared image of the blast furnace top charge level, and selecting a proper picture as an analysis object; denoising the image by using a 'degradation model' to obtain a filtered image; carrying out target identification on the filtered image according to the calibration relation between the image gray level and the temperature, obtaining a brightness zone area where the center of the gas flow is located through feature extraction, finding out the position of the center of a bright spot of the gas flow, and determining the distribution of the charge level temperature field; obtaining a clustering model of the incidence relation between the charge level temperature field distribution and one or more blast furnace production parameters through clustering training; and identifying the position of the center of the bright spot and the distribution of the charge level temperature field according to the trained clustering model to obtain an identification result. The method can compare the difference of technical and economic indexes among different air flow types and provide guidance for the operation of the blast furnace.

title_en: Electric heating baking device for refractory cement pouring ladle and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrothermal baking device for a refractory cement pouring ladle and a manufacturing method thereof.A ring-shaped cylinder is fixed at the top edge of a bottom disc, a middle hollow upright post is fixed at the central part of the bottom disc, a plurality of circles of connecting ribs are uniformly distributed on the outer wall of the middle hollow upright post from bottom to top, a cage-shaped core bar is welded at the tail end of each connecting rib, and the bottom end of the cage-shaped core bar is fixed on the bottom disc and is concentric with the middle hollow upright post; the position of the cage-shaped core is poured by refractory cement to form an insulating cylinder, and the cage-shaped core is wrapped inside the insulating cylinder; insulating ceramic rods for winding the resistance tapes are uniformly distributed on the outer wall of the insulating cylinder; the resistance band is connected with an electric cabinet for controlling temperature. The defects of the conventional ladle baking method are overcome, the ladle baking process is safe and environment-friendly, the ladle is heated uniformly, and the service life of the casting ladle is obviously prolonged.

title_en: Additive/equal-material preparation method for blade tenon
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of measuring the cross section area and the grinding mark length of a grinding mark of the blade tenon, and multiplying the cross section area by the grinding mark length to obtain the grinding mark volume; executing step S02-1 when the grinding scar volume is larger than the judgment value; performing S02-2 when the wear scar occurs and the volume is less than the determination value; s02-3 is performed for the new blade that is not worn, step S02-1: cutting off and polishing the blade tenon, then performing tenon part additive repair by taking the bottom of the blade as a base material, and performing in-situ preheating on the base material by using laser after defocusing amount is changed, and step S02-2: polishing the surface of the blade tenon, performing performance recovery heat treatment on the blade tenon, placing the blade tenon in a fixture to keep a preset temperature gradient, preparing an epitaxial strengthening layer on the surface of the blade tenon by using additive repair, and performing S02-3: and (4) mechanically polishing the new blade which is not worn, removing the surface oxidation layer, and placing the new blade in a clamp for remelting or printing.

title_en: New method for producing polymeric ferric sulfate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new method for producing polymeric ferric sulfate, belonging to the technical field of polymeric ferric sulfate production, and the new method comprises the following steps: s1, feSO  4  ·7H  2  Respectively putting O and water into a reaction kettle according to the mass ratio of 5: to mix and stir until FeSO  4  ·7H  2  Completely dissolving the O; s2, adding KClO intermittently under stirring  3  Adding KOH and KOH into a reaction kettle, introducing low-pressure steam, boiling for 3-5min, and continuously reacting for 10-20min to obtain a precipitate; and S3, washing, neutralizing and drying the obtained precipitate to obtain the solid polymeric ferric sulfate. The invention has the advantages of high utilization rate of equipment, no generation of harmful gas or other harmful byproducts in production and wide application range of products.

title_en: Cast aluminum alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cast aluminum alloy and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of aluminum alloy material preparation. The cast aluminum alloy comprises the following components in percentage by weight: cu: 4.0 to 5.5; mg: 0.05 to 0.35; mn: 0.1 to 0.5; ti:0.05 to 0.20; zr:0.05 to 0.20; v: 0.05 to 0.20; ag is less than or equal to 0.20; fe is less than or equal to 0.2; si is less than or equal to 0.2; the balance being Al. The smelting steps of the invention are as follows: preparing an alloy; alloy smelting; and (4) alloy casting. The invention obviously improves the heat resistance of the aluminum alloy, and improves the service temperature of the aluminum alloy from 250 ℃ to 300 ℃; meanwhile, the smelting difficulty of the alloy is reduced, and the casting performance of the alloy is improved; because the use of noble metal elements is reduced and avoided, the production cost of the aluminum alloy is reduced.

title_en: Foundry sand mold preparation facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casting sand mold preparation device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two first supporting plates and two second supporting plates are respectively arranged on the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate, four first electric slide rails are respectively arranged on the inner walls of the two second supporting plates, the first electric slide rails are divided into an upper section and a lower section, and the inner walls of the four upper section first electric slide rails are connected with a cope flask in a sliding manner. According to the invention, the first limiting blocks, the key induction switches, the first limiting holes and the second limiting holes are arranged, when the cope flask and the drag flask are in contact with the mold, the first limiting blocks positioned at the upper end and the lower end of the sliding plate are respectively inserted into the first limiting holes and the second limiting holes, so that the two key induction switches are extruded, the key induction switches send electric signals to the control panel after being extruded, the control panel immediately controls the first electric slide rail to stop running after receiving the signals, the cope flask and the drag flask are prevented from excessively extruding the mold, the damage to the mold is avoided, and the running safety of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Investment casting process of shaft blank
abstract_en: The application relates to an investment casting process of a shaft blank, which is applied to the field of shaft blank casting and comprises the following steps: a1, designing and processing a mould according to a part drawing; a2, manufacturing a wax mould; a3, cleaning a wax mould; a4, welding the wax pattern on the gate rod by a heated welding knife; a5, cleaning the wax mould and the gate rod, coating a coating and spreading quartz sand after cleaning, hardening and drying the wax mould and the gate rod with the quartz sand, and repeating the steps of coating, sanding, hardening and drying for multiple times to obtain a shell; a6, cutting a groove in the shell, and feeding the shell into a wax melting furnace for heating to melt the wax in the shell; a7, taking out the shell and feeding the shell into a roasting furnace for roasting; a8, casting and molding; a9, removing the shell; a10, cutting and grinding the blank. The method has the effect of improving the surface quality of the blank.

title_en: Directional solidification nickel-based high-temperature alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional solidification nickel-based superalloy, which comprises the following components: 9-10 wt% Co; 13.7-14.3 wt% Cr; 4.35-4.75 wt% Al; 2.1-2.55 wt% Ti; 4.55 to 4.95 wt% Ta; 0.75 to 1.25 wt% Nb; 3.75-4.25 wt% W; 1.3-1.7 wt% Mo; 0.08-0.11 wt% C; 0.008-0.012 wt% B; 0.03 to 0.07 wt.% Zr; the balance being Ni. The directionally solidified nickel-based high-temperature alloy provided by the invention adjusts the contents of Al, Ti, Ta, Nb, C, B and Zr, and particularly adds Nb, so that the alloy has a stable structure, uniform carbide distribution, and better castability, oxidation resistance and mechanical property.

title_en: Ultra-thin glass substrate processing method and display panel processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing method of an ultrathin glass substrate and a manufacturing method of a display panel, wherein the manufacturing method of the ultrathin glass substrate comprises the following steps: providing a glass base material, wherein n substrate areas and a framework area surrounding the substrate areas are preset on the glass base material, and n is more than or equal to 2; forming a panel functional layer on at least one side of the upper surface and the lower surface of a substrate area of a glass base material, wherein the panel functional layer comprises one or a combination of a TFT (thin film transistor) backboard, an organic light-emitting layer, a touch detection layer, a fingerprint identification layer and a cover plate, and an etching protective layer is formed on one side of the panel functional layer, which is deviated from the substrate area; etching at least the framework region of the glass base material to separate the substrate region from the glass base material and form a stress dissipation edge at the edge of the substrate region; and removing the etching protective layer to obtain the independent glass substrate. The invention can simultaneously process the functional layers in a plurality of areas while obtaining the glass substrate from the glass base material, and can avoid the damage of cutter wheel cutting and laser cutting to the formed functional layers.

title_en: Low-cost preparation method of carbon aerogel precursor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-cost preparation method of a carbon aerogel precursor, which comprises the following steps: adding phenol into a formaldehyde aqueous solution, adding a catalyst, and stirring for dissolving to obtain a mixture aqueous solution; refluxing the mixture aqueous solution at the temperature of 55-85 ℃ to a critical state to be solidified, then rapidly cooling, and stopping the reaction process to obtain a precursor aqueous solution with a certain crosslinking degree; adding a surfactant into the white oil, and uniformly stirring at room temperature to prepare a white oil mixed solution; taking a small part of the white oil mixed solution for standby, and heating the rest white oil mixed solution to a certain temperature; controlling the flow ratio of the precursor aqueous solution and the cold white oil mixed solution to fully mix the precursor aqueous solution and the cold white oil mixed solution into suspension in an emulsification pump; the suspension liquid is directly fed into hot white oil from an emulsification pump to be fully reacted to obtain precursor white oil slurry; and finally, filtering and washing the slurry to obtain the carbon aerogel precursor. The method has the advantages of low raw material price, low production cost, high product performance, safety and environmental protection.

title_en: Method for preparing lithium carbonate and ternary precursor by recycling waste ternary lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing lithium carbonate and a ternary precursor by recycling waste ternary lithium batteries, and belongs to the field of solid waste recycling. Graphite and a binder carried in black powder obtained after pretreatment of the waste ternary battery are used as a reducing agent, and the structure of the ternary material is destroyed through self-reduction phase conversion; converting lithium carbonate into lithium bicarbonate which is easy to be immersed in water by adopting a carbonated water immersion method, thereby realizing preferential leaching of lithium; the material after lithium extraction is directly leached by sulfuric acid without adding a reducing agent to obtain a nickel-cobalt-manganese solution. Impurities such as copper, iron, calcium and the like in the solution are deeply removed through an impurity removal process, the content of aluminum and magnesium in the solution is controlled, then nickel, cobalt and manganese in the solution are extracted into an organic phase by adopting synchronous extraction, a nickel, cobalt and manganese sulfate solution is obtained after back extraction by using sulfuric acid, and a high-quality ternary cathode material precursor can be prepared after the metal proportion is adjusted. The method has the advantages of high recovery rate of valuable metals of lithium, nickel, cobalt and manganese, short process, good product quality, economy and environmental protection.

title_en: Benzene-free ceramic tile daub
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building materials, and discloses benzene-free tile plaster, the tile plaster comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-40 parts of cement; 60-80 parts of silt; 0.1-0.5 part of hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose; 0.1-0.5 part of starch ether; 0.1-0.6 part of latex powder; 0.1-0.6 part of instant rubber powder; 0.1-0.6 parts of resin adhesive; 0.1-0.6 part of early strength agent; a water reducing agent. The application has the following advantages and effects: polycarboxylate molecules are adsorbed on the surfaces of cement particles in a directional mode, so that negative charges are carried on the surfaces of the cement particles to form an electrostatic repulsion effect, the cement particles can be further dispersed after the calcium lignosulfonate and the polycarboxylate are mixed, a flocculation structure is damaged, and wrapped water is released to participate in flowing, so that the flowability of the tile mortar is effectively improved, and the bonding performance is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-densification SiCf/SiC clad composite pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-densification SiCf/SiC cladding composite pipe, which comprises the following steps: s1: preparation of Low Density SiC f The SiC preform: weaving or winding the SiC fiber tube, and then carrying out PyC interface layer deposition and short-time SiC matrix deposition on the surface of the fiber by a CVI process to obtain low-density SiC f a/SiC preform; s2: preparation of SiC f A SiC blank: dispersing the nano SiC sintered powder and organic additive in an organic dispersant to prepare NITE-SiC slurry, and diffusing the NITE-SiC slurry into the low-density SiC by infiltration f Pores of SiC preformsDrying to obtain SiC f A SiC blank; s3: and (3) heat treatment: mixing SiC f Carrying out degumming heat treatment on the SiC blank under the protection of inert gas atmosphere; s4: and (3) hot isostatic pressing sintering: the blank after the heat treatment is subjected to gas phase pressure sintering in the inert gas atmosphere to obtain the high-densification SiC f the/SiC cladding composite pipe. The preparation method can obtain the SiCf/SiC cladding composite material with high density and solves the problem of SiC f The problem that the SiC pipe fitting is difficult to form.

title_en: Refining slag composition for ferrosilicon external furnace refining with aluminum content less than 0.1%
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ferrosilicon refining, in particular to a refining slag composition for ferrosilicon external refining with the aluminum content lower than 0.1 percent, which is prepared from raw materials of quartz sand, fluorite and lime in a specific ratio, has the characteristics of low melting point, good fluidity and good aluminum and calcium reduction effects, and can ensure that the removal rate of aluminum reaches 85 percent, the removal rate of calcium reaches 95 percent and the aluminum content of ferrosilicon can be controlled below 0.1 percent when the refining slag composition is applied to the external refining of the ferrosilicon.

title_en: Sintering forming process of refractory material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sintering and molding process of a refractory material, which utilizes a proportional mixture of magnesium oxide, silicon carbide, boron carbide, aluminum nitride or silicon nitride with the grain diameter less than 1mm as a matrix; the method comprises the following steps of (1) utilizing a proportional mixture of three types of alkali-resistant clay, calcined bauxite and cordierite with different particle sizes as aggregate; the composite material is prepared by taking a mixture of perlite, vermiculite and foamed alumina with the particle size of 1-3 mm as a light filler and mixing the mixture with a two-component binding agent, wherein the carbon material modified phenolic resin is added into the binding agent, the two-component binding agent is added twice to be mixed, the mixture is pressed into a refractory material green body after the mixing is finished, and the refractory material green body is naturally cooled to room temperature along with a furnace after three-stage heat treatment to obtain a finished product. The refractory material prepared by the method has excellent thermal shock property and compactness, so that the material has the characteristic of stable crack propagation, the compactness and the thermal shock property of a product are improved, and the mechanical property is also improved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano zinc oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano zinc oxide, which comprises the following steps: 1) preparing ammonia-ammonium carbonate mixed liquor: ammonia and ammonium carbonate solution were mixed as 1: (2-3) mixing uniformly according to the volume ratio to prepare an ammonia-ammonium carbonate mixed solution, wherein the solubility of the ammonia water is 0.5-1mol/L, and the concentration of the ammonium carbonate solution is 4-5 mol/L; 2) slowly adding zinc oxide into the ammonia-ammonium carbonate mixed solution, wherein the mass volume ratio of the zinc oxide to the ammonia-ammonium carbonate mixed solution is 1-2kg/30L, and uniformly stirring; 3) adding zinc powder, wherein the mass ratio of the added zinc oxide to the zinc powder is 1: (3-4), keeping the temperature of the mixed solution at 40-50 ℃, and filtering to obtain filtrate; 4) slowly heating the filtrate, keeping at 80-90 deg.C for 40-60min, and heating to obtain zinc carbonate precipitate; 5) washing, drying and calcining to obtain the nano zinc oxide. The preparation method of the invention can prepare high-quality nano zinc oxide with high yield and good appearance character under the condition of the same level of cost.

title_en: Hot-mix fine asphalt mixture, preparation method and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot-mix fine asphalt mixture which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 88 to 95 percent of refined aggregate, 4 to 6 percent of high-strength asphalt, 1 to 5 percent of filler and 0 to 0.5 percent of additive. A preparation method and a construction method of a hot-mix fine asphalt mixture. The invention adopts discontinuous gradation to improve the skid resistance of the pavement, can select the functions of water permeability and water impermeability according to the reality, is used for corrective maintenance of slight and medium diseases, can also be used for ultrathin layer cover surfaces of expressways, and is a low-cost and rapid maintenance scheme.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant coating for steel ladle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature resistant coating for a steel ladle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the coating comprises the following raw materials in percentage by weight: 10-20% of 5-3 mm brown corundum, 25-35% of 3-1 mm brown corundum, 15-25% of 1-0 mm brown corundum, 5-15% of white corundum powder, 5-10% of brown corundum dust removal powder, 3-6% of activated alumina micro powder, 1-3% of alumina micro powder, 8-15% of binding agent and 0.1-0.5% of dispersing agent; the invention has the beneficial effects that: after the newly built ladle or the ladle is repaired, the steel ladle working lining is sprayed or smeared, so that the oxidation of the ladle working lining can be reduced, the erosion of ladle slag can be reduced, the furnace life of the ladle can be prolonged, the service life of the ladle can be prolonged, and great benefits can be achieved.

title_en: Production process of low-magnesium core-spun yarn
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of a low-magnesium cored wire, relates to the technical field of low-magnesium cored wires, and aims to solve the problem that magnesium is easily oxidized prematurely when a steel belt is fed due to high magnesium content of the existing cored wire. Step 1, preparing magnesium-containing alloy powder; step 2: conveying the prepared magnesium metal to a casting machine for casting to form a magnesium ingot; and step 3: the steel belt is subjected to feeding and splicing, because the length of the steel belt is less than that of the whole roll of cored wire, the steel belt is spliced after being sheared by an angle of 45 degrees and is butted together by a 250A/300A direct-current argon arc welding machine and placed into a material storage cage; and 4, step 4: the steel strip starts to be preliminarily formed, and is rolled into a C-shaped open slot with an opening of 8-15 mm through a forming die; and 5: and (3) completely forming the steel strip, pressing magnesium metal into a molten pool in a vacuum furnace after molten steel is melted, and casting and rolling the molten magnesium metal into a steel strip sheet with the thickness of 0.2-0.5mm in an inert atmosphere.

title_en: Preparation method of 550 MPa-grade excellent-performance steel strip for automobile transmission shaft pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a steel strip with excellent 550 MPa-level performance for an automobile transmission shaft tube, which adopts Nb + Ti component system design, has low alloy cost, adopts controlled rolling and controlled cooling technology, has the tensile strength of 620-680MPa, the yield strength of more than or equal to 500MPa and the elongation of more than or equal to 32 percent, and realizes larger economic benefit.

title_en: Sulfide stress corrosion resistant martensitic stainless steel material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sulfide stress corrosion resistant martensitic stainless steel material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the martensitic stainless steel material comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: c: 0.03-0.045%, Si: 0-0.6%, Mn: 0-0.8%, P: 0-0.02%, S: 0-0.005%, Cr: 15.0-17.0%, Ni: 4.0-5.0%, Mo: 0-0.15%, Cu: 0-0.15%, V: 0-0.08%, Al: 0-0.04%, N: 0.02-0.05% of Ti, 0-0.015% of Ti and the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities. According to the invention, the contents of main components in the material, particularly the contents of chromium, nickel and nitrogen elements, are controlled, and then the chromium equivalent, the nickel equivalent and the ratio of the chromium equivalent to the nickel equivalent are controlled, so that a certain content of reverse transformed austenite is obtained to ensure the sulfide stress corrosion cracking resistance of the stainless steel material, and finally, the novel martensitic stainless steel material with the cost equivalent to that of a 17-4PH material and the sulfide stress corrosion resistance far superior to that of the 17-4PH material is manufactured.

title_en: Graphene quantum dot-loaded graphene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and provides a graphene quantum dot loaded composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1), taking oxidized graphene to disperse in deionized water to obtain oxidized graphene dispersion liquid; and 2) adding an organic matter into the obtained graphene oxide dispersion liquid, stirring and dissolving, completely reacting by a microwave-assisted hydrothermal method, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain the graphene oxide dispersion liquid. The graphene oxide quantum dot-loaded graphene oxide/graphene composite material is prepared by adopting graphene oxide as a raw material and loading graphene quantum dots on the surface of graphene by a microwave-assisted hydrothermal method, and can improve the photoelectric effect and the dispersibility of the graphene quantum dots.

title_en: Aggregate for plastering mortar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aggregate for plastering mortar, which is a synthetic aggregate prepared from a solid material and a transmitter water through homogenizing, mixing, granulating and solidifying; the technical scheme, the process parameters and the embodiment of the invention show that the invention can reduce the resource consumption of natural sand and machine-made sand, and has the advantage of low cost of raw materials; the invention can adopt the prior conventional equipment for production and has the advantages of easy implementation and easy realization of industrialized large-scale production; the invention can directly use the wet phosphogypsum and the wet flue gas purification gypsum, overcomes the defect that the traditional phosphogypsum and wet flue gas purification gypsum can be used as a cementing material after being dried and calcined, can realize the purpose of solid waste recycling, and has positive significance of resource saving, resource regeneration and the like.

title_en: Casting coating composition for casting moulds for metal casting, use thereof and casting mould provided with a casting coating composition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a foundry coating composition comprising an aqueous carrier liquid, a refractory base material and a CH-acidic compound, and to their use for casting moulds, and to casting moulds coated with the foundry coating composition.

title_en: Preparation method of high-performance ceramic reinforced iron-based composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-performance ceramic reinforced iron-based composite material and a preparation method thereof; belongs to the technical field of composite materials; the composite material comprises an iron matrix and three-dimensional network ZTA ceramics; the three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic is macroscale three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic, and the iron matrix penetrates through the three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic and is coated on the surface of the three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic. The preparation method comprises the steps of sintering zirconia and alumina ceramic mixed powder slurry by a template replication method to obtain three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic; and casting and infiltrating the molten iron into the three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic to obtain the three-dimensional network ZTA ceramic reinforced iron-based composite material. The composite material designed and prepared by the invention has excellent shock resistance, impact resistance and wear resistance under various severe working conditions.

title_en: Preparation method of nano-loaded hexavalent chromium reducing agent for cement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a hexavalent chromium reducing agent for nano-load type cement, belonging to the technical field of preparation of building materials. The method comprises the following specific steps: adding a certain amount of antimony compound, organic alkali and a carrier into a glass flask in sequence, stirring for a certain time at a certain temperature, and standing. And (3) carrying out suction filtration on the obtained precipitate, washing the precipitate with deionized water and absolute ethyl alcohol respectively, and drying the precipitate at a certain temperature to obtain the nano supported hexavalent chromium reducing agent for the cement. The hexavalent chromium reducing agent prepared by the invention has the advantages of low doping amount, high reduction efficiency, no negative influence on the related performance of cement and the like, and the method is simple, easy to operate and has industrial popularization value.

title_en: Blast furnace gas injection device, blast furnace gas injection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blast furnace gas injection airflow distribution device which comprises an annular pipe and a plurality of uniformly spaced branch pipes extending from the annular pipe in a downward inclined manner, wherein the branch pipes are respectively communicated with the annular pipe, and a plurality of injection holes are arranged on the annular pipe and the branch pipes, wherein the annular pipe and the branch pipes are arranged so that gas entering through the branch pipes enters the annular pipe and is injected out through the injection holes.

title_en: Electronic grade high-purity aluminum crystallization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic grade ultra-high purity aluminum crystallization method, which comprises the steps of selecting high purity aluminum raw materials with the purity of 4N5 and above to be melted into aluminum liquid in a crucible, inserting a crystallization device into the crucible, and enabling a graphite pipe sleeve to extend into the aluminum liquid to a depth of 300-600 mm; starting a driving device to drive the graphite pipe sleeve to synchronously rotate, then introducing cooling gas into the rotating body to start crystallization, and keeping the rotating speed of a crystallization machine and the stability of the cooling gas in the crystallization process to directionally solidify and separate out inverted mushroom-shaped crystallized substances with certain thickness on the surface of the graphite pipe sleeve contacted with the aluminum liquid; when the set crystallization time is up, firstly stopping the rotation of the crystallization device, then closing a vent valve of an air cooling system of the crystallization device, lifting the crystallization device out of a graphite crucible, removing crystals on a graphite pipe sleeve below the crystallization machine, cutting off the head of the crystals by 40-60 mm to obtain high-purity crystals, pouring out the residual aluminum liquid in the crucible, and putting the high-purity crystals into the crucible again to repeat crystallization to obtain the crystals with higher purity.

title_en: EW420 extra-thick marine steel plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EW420 extra-thick marine steel plate, which relates to the technical field of steel production, reduces internal defects such As blank segregation and looseness and controls inclusion elements such As As, Sn, Sb, Pb, Bi and B by smelting clean steel; crushing columnar crystals and refining austenite crystals under rough rolling at high temperature and low speed and high pressure; the aims of controlling the structure form and the grain size are achieved by finish rolling accumulated deformation and matching with controlled cooling.

title_en: Method for synthesizing low-silicon SAPO-17 molecular sieve by two-step method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a low-silicon SAPO-17 molecular sieve by a two-step method. The method comprises the following steps: a) according to 1.0Al 2 O 3 :(0～0.1)SiO 2 :(0.8～1.2)P 2 O 5 :(0.1～2.0)R:(30～200)H 2 The initial molar ratio of O, namely uniformly mixing an aluminum source, a silicon source, a phosphorus source, a template agent R and water to obtain a mixture, then carrying out hydrothermal crystallization, and drying to obtain a product containing an intermediate; b) taking the product containing the intermediate obtained in the step a) as a substrate, wherein the alumina accounts for 1.0Al 2 O 3 ：(0～0.1)SiO 2 :(0～1.5)R:(30～100)H 2 Adding a silicon source, a template agent R and water into the O, uniformly mixing to obtain a mixture, and then carrying out hydrothermal crystallization to obtain the SAPO-17 molecular sieve; wherein the adding amount of the silicon source in the step a) and the step b) is not 0 at the same time. The method can effectively inhibit layered impurities and synthesize the low-silicon pure-phase SAPO-17 molecular sieve by a two-step method.

title_en: High-strength three-dimensional graphene macroscopic body and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength three-dimensional graphene macroscopic body and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing salts into a graphene oxide aqueous solution to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the salts are at least one of sodium carbonate, sodium chloride, ammonium carbonate, potassium chloride, potassium bicarbonate, calcium chloride, calcium bicarbonate, magnesium sulfate, zinc chloride and potassium sulfate, and the salts in the mixed solution are in a supersaturated state; (2) and reacting the obtained mixed solution at 100-400 ℃ for 0.5-8 hours, and then cleaning and drying to obtain the three-dimensional graphene macroscopic body.

title_en: Manufacturing method of aluminum-silicon target material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of an aluminum-silicon target material, which comprises the steps of providing an AlSi ingot casting, drawing, wherein the drawing step adopts cold drawing operation, and the forging ratio in the cold drawing operation is more than or equal to 1 and less than X1 and less than 2; a primary upsetting step, wherein the forging ratio is controlled to be more than or equal to 2 and less than X2 and less than 3, and cold heading operation is adopted for primary upsetting; an intermediate heat treatment step, namely keeping the product within a first preset temperature range, and quickly placing the product in cold water after keeping the temperature for a first preset time; a secondary upsetting step, wherein the forging ratio is controlled to be more than or equal to 2 and less than X3 and less than 3, and cold heading operation is also adopted for secondary upsetting; a preheating treatment step; a rolling step, wherein the product is rolled for multiple times, and the rolling reduction is reduced along with the increase of rolling passes; and (4) annealing heat treatment process, namely, keeping the temperature within the annealing temperature range for the third time, and performing water cooling treatment to form a final target product. According to the invention, the forging ratio is reasonably controlled, and water cooling is adopted to reduce Si element precipitation, so that the microstructure and the processing performance of the target material are ensured.

title_en: Preparation method of forsterite-magnalium spinel heat-insulating refractory material
abstract_en: A preparation method of a forsterite-magnesia-alumina spinel heat-insulating refractory material is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: a. mixing 20-30 wt% of magnesium carbonate raw material, 30-45 wt% of aluminum hydroxide and 25-50 wt% of silica according to mass percentage, ball-milling, spraying and granulating, and calcining at 1200-1350 ℃ for 1-3 hours to obtain porous pellets containing low-melting-point phase; b. and (b) adding the porous pellets containing the low-melting-point phase prepared in the step (a) into a magnesia material in a proportion of 20-50 wt%, uniformly mixing the raw materials, adding 1-5 wt% of a bonding agent, pressing under a pressure of 20-100 MPa to prepare a blank, drying, keeping the temperature of 1500-1600 ℃ for 2-4 hours, calcining, and cooling to obtain the forsterite-magnesium aluminate spinel heat-insulating refractory material.

title_en: Multi-temperature maintenance manufacturing method of combined structure and combined structure
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a multi-temperature curing composite structure and the composite structure comprise a part A and a part B. Part A has cavity, part B is the solidifiable material filled in the cavity, and is acted by pressure in the solidification process. The B part comprises a B1 part and a B2 part, the B1 material is a cement-based material, the B2 material is a settable material, and the B2 material has relatively higher fluidity than the B1 material. The B1 and B2 materials in the cavity of part a undergo a temperature-pressure process in the cavity. A combined column containing a single column, a lattice column containing a single column, wherein the single column is manufactured by adopting a manufacturing method of a multi-temperature maintenance combined structure.

title_en: Safe and energy-saving preparation process of tire bead steel wire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safe and energy-saving preparation process of a tire bead steel wire, which comprises the following process steps: pretreatment, rough drawing, intermediate heat treatment, fine drawing, tempering and bronze plating. According to the safe and energy-saving preparation process of the tire bead steel wire, the pretreatment device, the rough drawing device, the intermediate heat treatment device, the fine drawing device, the tempering device and the bronze plating device on the tire bead steel wire production line are optimized and improved, potential safety hazards caused by exposure of mechanical operation equipment and direct injection of high-temperature steam are eliminated, the occupied area of the equipment is saved, the energy storage and heat preservation capacity of a heating furnace body is improved, the waste heat utilization efficiency is higher, the service life of the heating furnace is prolonged, the production energy consumption is greatly saved, the production efficiency is improved, the equipment maintenance is simpler, the cost is lower, and the equipment failure rate is reduced.

title_en: Single crystal aluminum-rich cascade hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve and green preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A monocrystal aluminum-rich cascade hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve and a green preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of uniformly mixing a copolymer, deionized water, an aluminum source, an alkali source and a silicon source according to a certain proportion, carrying out hydrothermal crystallization, centrifuging and drying an obtained product, and removing a template agent through acid treatment to obtain the single crystal aluminum-rich stepped hole HZSM-5 molecular sieve. The copolymer can be used as a dispersing agent to effectively improve the fluidity of the aluminum-rich concentrated gel and inhibit the generation of mixed crystals, and can act with an aluminum source to promote the aluminum source to enter a molecular sieve framework and guide the synthesis of the single crystal aluminum-rich ZSM-5 molecular sieve. The ketal copolymer is stable under alkaline conditions and decomposed under acidic conditions, and can be removed from the molecular sieve structure only by acid treatment without roasting treatment. The ZSM-5 molecular sieve prepared by the method has Si/Al = 4-8, is a step pore molecular sieve, and has the advantages of high Al content, nano single crystal structure, high specific surface area and pore volume and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing emerald glass ceramics based on phlogopite seed crystals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing emerald glass ceramics by mica seed crystals, belonging to the technical field of material synthesis. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the key points that: prepared from aluminium silicate, sodium silicate and phlogopite as raw materials by mixing with jade (NaAlSi) 2 O 6 ) The theoretical mass fraction ratio of each element in the molecular formula (1) is proportioned, the precursor is treated to prepare glass frit under high temperature and normal pressure, and the glass frit is crushed and then mixed with phlogopite as seed crystal to be sintered in a high temperature furnace to prepare a sample. Mica seed crystal is adopted to induce high temperature and normal pressure to prepare jade, and a new process for artificially preparing jade microcrystalline glass is developed; seed crystal induction promoting NaAlSi 2 O 6 Crystallization forms plate-like crystals, reducing the productionPreparation conditions and cost.

title_en: Method for recovering platinum catalyst of waste proton exchange membrane fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recovering a waste proton exchange membrane fuel cell platinum catalyst. The method comprises the following steps: 1) platinum in the catalyst layer was electrolyzed using cyclic voltammetry: the catalyst layer is used as a working electrode, a carbon rod is used as a counter electrode, an Ag/AgCl electrode is used as a reference electrode, and a eutectic solvent is used as electrolyte for electrolysis; wherein the potential window is set to be 1-2V; 2) and (3) electrodeposition reaction: and after electrolysis, replacing the catalyst layer with an electrode made of a conductive material, setting a potential window to be-3 to-2V, and performing electrodeposition reaction for multiple times under an ultrasonic condition to obtain the metal platinum. The platinum metal particles recovered by the method of the invention have uniform size, no other metal impurities and high purity.

title_en: Electric tractor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of metallurgical transportation equipment, and particularly relates to an electric tractor which comprises a tractor body, a shed, a wheel set, a cable drum, a traveling transmission mechanism and a coupler. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the volume is littleer, and the cost is lower, has realized simplifying by a wide margin of body structure, and two wheel pairs all have power drive, have increased the traction power of tractor, make the performance of tractor can satisfy the traction requirement of metallurgical enterprise's ladle car completely.

title_en: Method for preparing calcium pyrophosphate fluorescent powder by hydrothermal method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing calcium pyrophosphate fluorescent powder by a hydrothermal method, which comprises the following specific steps: the method comprises the following steps: dissolving Ca (NO) in deionized water 3 ) 2· 4H 2 O, excess HNO at 80 ℃ 3 Dy is completely dissolved in the solution 2 O 3 (ii) a Step two: dissolving Ca (NO) 3 ) 2 And Dy (NO) 3 ) 3 After the solution was mixed and stirred for 5 minutes, a fixed amount of H was added 3 PO 4 Stirring the solution for 5 minutes, adding ammonia water into the mixed solution to adjust the pH value, and continuously stirring for 25 minutes to obtain a precipitate; step three: putting the obtained precipitate into a reaction kettle, preserving the heat at 180 ℃ for 24 hours, and finally annealing the obtained powder for 3 hours to obtain Ca 2 P 2 O 7 And (3) fluorescent powder. The invention obtains Ca by a hydrothermal method 2 P 2 O 7 Fluorescent powder with regular shape and grain size of about 10 micronsThe obtained powder has uniform grain size and regular shape, the quantum efficiency reaches 70 percent, and the Ca is prepared by adopting the method provided by the invention 2 P 2 O 7 The process of the fluorescent powder does not need high-temperature calcination, and has low energy consumption, simple and convenient operation and high practicability.

title_en: Small-size horizontal cavity glass multistation closes piece system
abstract_en: The invention provides a small horizontal hollow glass multi-station laminating system which comprises an upper laminating table, a glass cleaning device, a glass drying device, a conveying workbench, a plurality of laminating tables, a rolling transition table, a laminating mechanism and a lower laminating table, wherein the upper laminating table is arranged on the upper laminating table; the glass sheet feeding device is characterized in that an upper sheet table, a glass cleaning device, a glass drying device, a conveying workbench, a rolling transition table, a pressing mechanism and a lower sheet table are sequentially arranged on the ground, and a plurality of sheet combining tables used for combining glass sheets are respectively arranged on two sides of the conveying workbench. The invention provides a production line type operation flow for the glass sheet combining operation, saves space and labor and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Q420GJ medium steel plate for low-yield-ratio, low-cost and high-performance building structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a Q420GJ medium plate steel for a low-yield-ratio low-cost high-performance building structure, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: 0.14 Wt% -0.17 Wt%, Si: 0.20 Wt% -0.40 Wt%, Mn: 1.4 Wt% -1.6 Wt%, P: less than or equal to 0.020 Wt%, S: less than or equal to 0.01 Wt%, Alt: 0.020-0.050 Wt%, Nb: 0.040 Wt% -0.055 Wt%, V: 0.025 Wt% -0.040 Wt%, Ti: 0.015 Wt% -0.030 Wt%, CEV: less than or equal to 0.44 Wt%, and the balance of Fe and inevitable trace elements; the yield ratio is 0.72-0.78. The invention can obtain the qualified high-performance Q420GJ for the building structure with low yield ratio and low cost.

title_en: Nozzle and smelting furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nozzle and a smelting furnace, wherein the nozzle comprises a material channel for feeding powdery materials into a reaction tower of the smelting furnace, the material channel is provided with a material adjusting structure for adjusting the cross section area of an outlet, and the material adjusting structure can adjust the speed of the powdery materials entering the reaction tower according to the feeding amount of the powdery materials; the gas channel is used for feeding reaction gas into the reaction tower, and the gas channel and the material channel are sleeved with each other. When the feeding amount of the powdery material is low, the cross section area of the outlet of the material channel is reduced by the material adjusting structure, so that the speed of the powdery material entering the reaction tower is increased; when the input of powdery material is higher, the cross sectional area of material passageway exit is increaseed to the material regulation structure, avoids powdery material to block up material passageway to can avoid blocking up material passageway when guaranteeing the powdery material velocity of flow, and then improved the mixing and the reaction effect of the powdery material of different input and reaction gas in the reaction tower of smelting furnace.

title_en: Automatic clamping system and detection method thereof
