abstract_en: The application relates to an automatic clamping system, which comprises a main frame, wherein a driving assembly for driving the main frame to move is arranged on the main frame, a first arm and a second arm are arranged on the main frame, a first lifting assembly is arranged between the first arm and the main frame, a second lifting assembly is arranged between the second arm and the main frame, a clamping assembly is arranged on the first arm, and a spraying assembly is arranged on the second arm; the spraying assembly comprises a plurality of spraying units, and each spraying unit corresponds to one die-casting die local area. The application has the following effects: the controller obtains the temperature that corresponds die mould local area that each unit detection of spraying obtained and the temperature of presetting of current material carry out the comparison to control sprays or stops spraying the coolant liquid to the die mould local area that the unit corresponds at present, makes the temperature of every die mould local area can not be too high or low excessively, has solved among the correlation technique and has only sprayed die mould wholly and lead to the problem that has the difference in temperature between the part.

title_en: High-clarity crystallization back extraction method in uranium extraction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of uranium hydrometallurgy, in particular to a high-clarity crystallization back extraction method in a uranium extraction process. The high-clarity crystallization reextraction method in the uranium extraction process comprises the following steps: mixing and reacting the organic phase loaded with uranium, a back-extraction agent and uranyl tricarbonate slurry, and keeping the reaction temperature at 30-50 ℃ to obtain a mixed phase; the stripping agent is ammonium carbonate and/or ammonium bicarbonate; and inputting the mixed phase into a double-interface complementary-collection three-phase separation device, stirring the rake of the double-interface complementary-collection three-phase separation device, continuously discharging underflow slurry, and preparing the uranium tricarbonate by using the discharged crystallization mother liquor and the back-extraction agent. The invention solves the problems of difficult phase separation and poor crystal form, realizes the stable and benign operation of the crystallization back extraction, ensures that the phase separation effect is good, the two phases are clear and transparent, and the obtained AUC crystal has large particles and good crystal form, thereby achieving good back extraction and crystallization effects.

title_en: Aluminum electrolysis cell waste refractory material treatment process and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment process and a treatment system for waste refractory materials of an aluminum electrolytic cell, and belongs to the technical field of treatment of waste of electrolytic aluminum. The method for treating the waste refractory material of the aluminum electrolytic cell comprises the following steps: mixing the waste refractory material powder with water to leach cyanide and soluble fluoride, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain water leaching slag and water leaching solution; oxidizing the water leaching solution to break cyanogen to obtain a cyanogen breaking solution; performing primary fluorine precipitation on the cyanogen breaking liquid to obtain calcium fluoride solid and primary fluorine precipitation liquid; secondary fluorine precipitation is carried out in the primary fluorine precipitation liquid to obtain secondary fluorine precipitation liquid and crude calcium fluoride; carrying out alkaline leaching on the leaching residue to detoxify to obtain detoxified residue and alkaline leaching solution; neutralizing the detoxified slag to obtain harmless slag; regenerating lime of the alkaline leaching solution and reusing the lime for alkaline leaching detoxification; collecting smoke and treating smoke in environment. The invention realizes the harmless treatment of the waste refractory materials of the aluminum electrolytic cell, recycles fluorine and sodium alkali resources, avoids the harm of the treatment of the waste refractory materials of the aluminum electrolytic cell to the environment and realizes the reclamation of overhaul residues to a certain extent.

title_en: Modified graphite material, preparation method and application thereof, and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified graphite material, a preparation method and application thereof and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing an amphiphilic carbon material aqueous solution, wherein the amphiphilic carbon material aqueous solution comprises an amphiphilic carbon material, a pH regulator and water, and the pH of the amphiphilic carbon material aqueous solution is 9-14; preparing a graphite suspension liquid, wherein the graphite suspension liquid comprises graphite and an organic solvent, and the organic solvent is an organic solvent which is immiscible with water and has a boiling point higher than 120 ℃; dropwise adding the amphiphilic carbon material water solution into the graphite suspension, heating and stirring, centrifugally collecting precipitate, washing and drying to obtain a precursor; and carbonizing the precursor to obtain the carbon nano tube. The modified graphite material provided by the invention has the advantages of regular shape and high tap density, the lithium ion battery prepared by the modified graphite material has high energy storage capacity and good lithium intercalation rate performance, and the preparation method has the advantages of simple process and low cost and is beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: High-transparency microcrystalline glass containing scintillation nanocrystals and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-transparency glass ceramics containing scintillation nano-crystals and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glass ceramics contain a microcrystalline phase KLa  1‑   x  Gd  x  F  4  ：Ce  3+  Wherein x is 0-1, and the activating ion is Ce  3+  . The invention prepares the microcrystalline glass by the traditional glass preparation method and the heat treatment mode. Successfully realizes partial substitution of Gd ions for KLaF in the heat treatment process  4  La in (e) to precipitate KLa  1‑x  Gd  x  F  4  ：Ce  3+  The crystal not only increases the density of the glass ceramics, but also Gd can be used as a sensitizing agent in the crystal to improve the energy transfer efficiency between ions. The light output capability of the prepared microcrystalline glass is obviously improved, and the fluorescence intensity under the excitation of X-rays is obviously higher than that of commercial scintillation crystal BGO.

title_en: Modified asphalt mixture and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of pavements, and particularly discloses a modified asphalt mixture and a preparation method thereof. The mixture is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 4-7 parts of modified asphalt, 90-98 parts of aggregate, 8-10 parts of mineral powder and 0.1-0.9 part of fiber stabilizer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, uniformly mixing the aggregate and the mineral powder according to a set proportion, and heating to 190-220 ℃ for later use to obtain a mixture; s2, adding the modified asphalt preheated to 170-175 ℃ into the mixture heated in the S1, keeping stirring at 180 ℃ for 40S, adding the fiber stabilizer, and keeping the temperature at 180 ℃ and stirring for 23-25S to obtain the modified asphalt mixture. The modified asphalt mixture has the advantages of improving the cracking resistance and durability of asphalt.

title_en: Preparation method for improving fatigue performance of upper anvil of hydraulic press
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method for improving the fatigue performance of an upper anvil of a hydraulic press, which comprises the following steps: and (3) processing the upper anvil to a final size according to requirements, carrying out heat treatment according to the process steps of normalizing → annealing → quenching → tempering, and carrying out carburization coating on the anvil surface during quenching heating to prepare the upper anvil of the hydraulic press. The upper anvil of the hydraulic press is subjected to graded quenching, so that the anvil surface part of the upper anvil obtains high hardness and the rest part obtains low hardness, and the anvil surface is simultaneously carburized, so that the prepared upper anvil of the hydraulic press has the characteristics of wear resistance, impact resistance and fatigue resistance, namely the working surface of the upper anvil is wear-resistant and high in strength, and the rest part is good in plasticity, impact resistance and fatigue resistance. Compared with the prior art, the service life of the upper anvil of the hydraulic press manufactured by the method is prolonged by 2-5 times.

title_en: Integral stopper rod for air curtain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air curtain integral stopper rod which comprises a rod head and a rod body, wherein the rod head is arranged at the top end of the rod body, an argon channel is formed in the rod body, the argon channel extends to the interior of the rod head, and an air curtain block is arranged at the upper end of the rod head. The invention provides an integral gas curtain stopper rod, which can continuously provide argon bubbles by means of an argon bubble gas curtain formed by a ventilation area at the top of the stopper rod, has a large action area, is more beneficial to floating and removing impurities in molten steel and improves the purity of the molten steel; argon forms the gas curtain protection at the stick head, has solved the bad condition of traditional tube beam form gas jet, has avoidd molten steel inclusion and has gathered the deposit on the stick head surface, influences the problem with the cooperation accuse stream precision of mouth of a river bowl portion.

title_en: Treatment method for generating scratches on surface of continuous casting slab to wide-surface foot roll or bent section of crystallizer
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for treating scratches on the surface of a continuous casting slab, which occur on a wide-surface foot roll or a bent section of a crystallizer, and comprises the following steps: step S1: preparing a new bending section and a crystallizer spare part, and waiting for replacement when the continuous casting machine stops production; step S2: reducing the pulling speed, increasing the cooling strength, carrying out the stopping operation of a withdrawal and straightening machine, and embedding the accumulated iron scale into a casting blank shell and then taking the casting blank shell out of a continuous casting machine; step S3: after the service life of the tundish reaches the standard, the continuous casting machine is stopped to produce and the spare parts prepared in the step S1 are adopted to replace the new horizontal section. When the invention is used, when the iron scale is accumulated on the wide-face foot roller and the bending section of the crystallizer, the probability of taking the accumulated iron scale out of a continuous casting machine is over 90 percent when the temperature of molten steel is enough.

title_en: 3D prints metal powder collection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D printing metal powder collecting device, which comprises a base, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged above the base through a fixing frame; through setting up the driving gear, driven gear and swinging arms drive the lift post up-and-down motion, thereby drive centre gripping subassembly downstream, press from both sides the product of printing on the workstation, and blow through the fan and help blowing remaining metal powder on the product off, drive the product rotation through setting up the second motor, thereby shake off remaining metal powder on the product, drive the receiving hopper vibrations through setting up vibrating motor, be favorable to collecting remaining metal powder on the workstation and accept in the steamer tray, can cushion receiving hopper through setting up the shock-absorbing post, increase device's stability, the device novel structure, multiple functional, recovery efficiency is high, therefore, the clothes hanger is strong in practicability.

title_en: Device and process for producing aluminum oxide from high-carbon bauxite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a process for producing alumina by high-carbon bauxite.A soda removal and salt removal device which is parallel to a forced salt removal device is arranged between a discharge pipe of an evaporation station and a salt settling tank, the soda removal and salt removal device comprises a collection tank, and the collection tank is provided with a feed pipe connected with the discharge pipe of the evaporation station and a mother liquor circulating pipe connected with a salt removal and filtrate collection device; a filter cloth regenerating device is arranged on the salt discharge filter; the method can ensure that the carbonate of the alumina system is in balance, greatly reduce the influence of high carbon alkali on an alumina production system, and ensure that the system stably runs under the high carbon alkali, thereby improving the carbon-containing use amount of the bauxite and effectively solving the problem of resource shortage caused by high impurity content of the bauxite; meanwhile, the method can be deeply combined with a production line, and the preparation of the desulfurizer by using the causticized waste residue is favorable for on-line desulfurization.

title_en: Automatic mud loading device for blast furnace mud gun
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic mud loading device for a blast furnace mud gun, which comprises a hydraulic feeding system and a mud gun system, wherein the hydraulic feeding system comprises a mud gun conveying piston cylinder, the middle part of the mud gun conveying piston cylinder is upwards communicated with a mud gun hopper, the front end of the mud gun conveying piston cylinder is provided with a hydraulic oil cylinder, the rear end of the mud gun conveying piston cylinder is communicated with a vertical discharging pipe, the mud gun system comprises a hydraulic mud gun, the hydraulic mud gun is provided with a mud gun mud adding port, the vertical discharging pipe and the mud gun mud adding port are correspondingly arranged, and the mud gun falling into the mud gun conveying piston cylinder through the mud gun hopper is pushed to the vertical discharging pipe through the hydraulic oil cylinder.

title_en: Remanufacturing and repairing method for failed gas turbine blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remanufacturing and repairing method for a failed gas turbine blade. The invention is carried out according to the following steps: firstly, adopting a laser cladding process to recover the size of a failed gas turbine blade, then carrying out shot blasting strengthening treatment on the outer surface of the gas turbine blade after the first step, wherein the shot blasting material is glass shots with the diameter of 0.8-1.2mm, the shot blasting pressure of 0.4-0.5MPa and the shot blasting time of 80-100s, and finally adopting a plasma spraying process to spray the blade through shot blasting treatment, wherein the spraying material is WC-12Co metal ceramic powder, the thickness of a spraying layer is 240-280 mu m at the windward side part, and the thickness of a non-windward side part is 180-220 mu m. The gas turbine blade repaired by the process method has good wear resistance and corrosion resistance, and the service life of the blade can be greatly prolonged by 2-3 times of that of the original blade.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method of Mg-C nano composite hydrogen storage material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation method of a Mg-C nano composite hydrogen storage material, wherein the preparation device of the Mg-C nano composite hydrogen storage material comprises a tube furnace system, a quartz tube is arranged in the tube furnace, a graphite sleeve is arranged in the quartz tube and used for placing magnesium, an inductance coil is sleeved outside one side of the quartz tube close to a gas outlet, the inductance coil is connected with a radio frequency power supply, and a product collection area is arranged between the position where the magnesium is placed in the graphite sleeve and the position where the inductance coil is sleeved; the preparation method of the Mg-C nano composite hydrogen storage material comprises the following steps: magnesium is put into the graphite sleeve, and the quartz tube is flushed by argon; introducing a mixed gas of argon, hydrocarbon gas and hydrogen into the quartz tube; starting a tube furnace system, heating the quartz tube to generate magnesium vapor in the graphite sleeve; and starting a radio frequency power supply, decomposing hydrocarbon gas to generate carbon, and realizing uniform composition of magnesium and carbon in a product collection area to form the Mg-C nano composite hydrogen storage material.

title_en: Pressure swing adsorption integration in steam cracking ethylene plants
abstract_en: The present invention provides a process for increasing the recovery of high purity hydrogen from a steam cracking process where the yield of by-product methane is high relative to hydrogen. After the hydrocarbon gas stream is sent through the cold box and the demethanizer, a small proportion of the methane is sent through the pressure swing adsorption unit, separated from the gas stream containing hydrogen, to increase the high purity hydrogen recovery by 6%.

title_en: Anti-mud polycarboxylate superplasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of concrete admixtures, and particularly discloses an anti-mud polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the water reducing agent is prepared by polymerizing the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-15 parts of acrylic acid, 10-25 parts of hydroxyethyl methacrylate, 25-35 parts of 2-methyl-2-butenoic acid, 6-10 parts of ethyl methacrylate sodium sulfonate, 30-40 parts of propenyl polyoxyethylene ether, 1-3 parts of an initiator, 1-2 parts of a chain transfer agent and 1-2 parts of a sacrificial agent; the preparation method of the anti-mud type polycarboxylate superplasticizer comprises the steps of solution preparation, heating reaction and acidity neutralization.

title_en: Rare earth doped transition metal sulfide/carbon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rare earth doped transition metal sulfide/carbon composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium-sulfur batteries. The invention provides a preparation method of a rare earth doped transition metal sulfide/carbon composite material, which comprises the following steps: mixing a rare earth compound, a transition metal compound, a carbon source and a solvent, and drying to obtain precursor powder; carbonizing the precursor powder to obtain the rare earth doped transition metalA carbon composite; oxidizing the rare earth doped transition metal/carbon composite material to obtain a rare earth doped transition metal oxide/carbon composite material; and mixing the rare earth doped transition metal oxide/carbon composite material with sulfur, and vulcanizing under a protective atmosphere to obtain the rare earth doped transition metal sulfide/carbon composite material. Doping transition metal sulfide with rare earth metal ions to further improve Li content of transition metal sulfide 2 S n Catalytic decomposition of (1).

title_en: Series based on Ca3TeO6Structural green camouflage pigment and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a series of Ca-based products 3 TeO 6 The green camouflage pigment with the structure and the preparation method and the application thereof, wherein the molecular formula of the green inorganic pigment is Ca 3‑2x Mn x Li x TeO 6 Wherein x is more than or equal to 0.1 and less than or equal to 0.4; the preparation method of the green camouflage pigment comprises the following steps: mixing raw materials including calcium-containing compound, tellurium-containing compound, manganese-containing compound and Li 2 CO 3 Weighing the components according to the molar ratio, mixing, grinding uniformly, calcining at 900-1200 ℃, and cooling to obtain the green camouflage pigment. The preparation method is simple and environment-friendly, the raw materials are cheap and nontoxic, the prepared green inorganic pigment is acid-alkali resistant, the color of the pigment below 1100 ℃ can be kept unchanged, and the reflectivity value of the pigment is similar to that of green plants, so that the pigment can be used for coating camouflage materials.

title_en: Preparation method and application of iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube electrode, which comprises the following steps: dissolving a polymer and a zinc salt in a solvent, and performing electrostatic spinning to obtain a zinc/polymer fiber; soaking the zinc/polymer fiber in a nitrogen-containing organic ligand solution and a mixed solution of ferrous salt and zinc salt in sequence, and repeating the process for a plurality of times to obtain a metal-organic framework/polymer fiber growing layer by layer; soaking the metal-organic framework/polymer fiber in a solvent to dissolve a polymer, so as to obtain a metal-organic framework nanotube with a three-dimensional space structure; carbonizing to obtain the iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube with a three-dimensional space structure; and uniformly mixing the iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube, the conductive agent and the binder, coating the mixture on a current collector, and drying to obtain the iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube electrode. The iron-nitrogen doped carbon nanotube electrode prepared by the invention is used for desalting the salt water in the capacitive deionization technology, and has the advantages of large desalting capacity, strong long-term desalting stability and high desalting rate.

title_en: Method for preparing nano chromium-magnesium spinel by using chromium sludge and magnesium desulphurization slag
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solid waste resource utilization, and particularly relates to a method for preparing nano chromium-magnesium spinel by using chromium sludge and magnesium desulphurization slag. The method comprises the steps of dissolving magnesium flue gas desulfurization slag and chromium mud generated by a chemical precipitation method under an acidic condition by using the magnesium flue gas desulfurization slag and the chromium mud as raw materials, filtering the solution, and adjusting the pH value to be neutral to generate chromium-magnesium coprecipitation; dehydrating and drying the precipitate, and roasting the precipitate in a muffle furnace; washing the roasted sample with dilute hydrochloric acid, filtering and drying to obtain the nanometer chromium-magnesium spinel powder with the particle size of 80-500. The method takes the chromium mud and the flue gas desulfurization waste as the raw materials for preparing the chrome-magnesium spinel, realizes the resource utilization of the waste while performing harmless treatment on the waste, and thus generates obvious economic benefit, social benefit and environmental benefit.

title_en: Copper strip annealing equipment and process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses copper strip annealing equipment, which comprises an equipment main body, a copper strip feeding device, a heating device, an air extracting device and a cooling device, the upper end of the equipment main body is provided with a heating device, two sides of the heating device are provided with copper strip feeding devices, the invention is provided with a vacuum tank, an air pump and an air exhaust pipe, after annealing is finished, air in the vacuum tank can be pumped out through the air pump, the annealed copper strip is sent into the fixed sleeve in the vacuum tank for cooling, the annealed copper strip is prevented from generating oxidation reaction with the air under a high temperature state, so that the quality of the surface of the copper strip is prevented from being deteriorated, the production quality of the product is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the production efficiency of the copper strip is improved due to the fact that the copper strip is cooled.

title_en: Composite glass pane having electrically controllable optical properties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite glass pane having electrically controllable optical properties, comprising an outer glass pane (1) and an inner glass pane (2) which are joined to one another by means of a thermoplastic intermediate layer (3), wherein an opto-electronic functional element (4; S) having electrically controllable optical properties is embedded in the intermediate layer (3), which opto-electronic functional element comprises an active layer (5) between a first carrier film (6) and a second carrier film (7), which active layer is assigned transparent planar control electrodes (8, 9) on both surfaces, and wherein a capacitive touch switching element (T; 11) is arranged between the active layer (5) and the thermoplastic intermediate layer (3) in direct contact with the second carrier film (7) pointing in the direction of the inner glass pane (2).

title_en: Special anti-adsorbent for iron tailing sand and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a special anti-adsorbent for iron tailing sand and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of building materials and comprising the following components in percentage by mass: 80-85% of main material, 10-15% of fluidity adjusting component, 5-10% of expansion stabilizing component and anti-adsorbent, wherein the dosage of the anti-adsorbent is 0.5-1% of the dosage of the cementing material and the iron tailing powder. The special anti-adsorption agent for iron tailing sand provided by the invention is directly added with water and mixed with the iron tailing sand, the anti-adsorption effect can be achieved by uniformly stirring, the adsorption of a water reducing agent is reduced, under the action of electrostatic repulsion, cement and stone powder can be effectively dispersed, the agglomeration among particles is reduced, the existence of water among the particles is reduced, the workability of concrete is improved, and the slump loss is small.

title_en: Organic clay and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an organic clay and a preparation method and application thereof. The organic clay comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 100 parts of an organic solvent; 1-50 parts of raw ore clay; 0.1-5.0 parts of modifier. The organic clay provided by the invention has good settling stability and gelling rate, and is beneficial to enhancing the stability of the oil-based drilling fluid. The preparation method is different from the preparation method of the conventional organic clay, and the organic clay is subjected to surface modification in an organic solvent, so that the obtained organic clay has high hydrophobic property, can be easily dispersed in oil-based drilling fluid base oil such as white oil, diesel oil and the like, is favorable for improving the stability of an oil-based drilling fluid system, and has good popularization and application potentials.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant material and preparation method of corrosion-resistant street lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new material processing, and discloses a corrosion-resistant material and a preparation method of a corrosion-resistant street lamp, wherein the corrosion-resistant LM6 aluminum ingot alloy material is prepared according to the following requirements that Cu is less than or equal to 0.1 wt%, Si: 10.0 to 13.0 weight percent of Mg, less than or equal to 0.1 weight percent of Zn, less than or equal to 0.6 weight percent of Fe, less than or equal to 0.5 weight percent of Mn, less than or equal to 0.1 weight percent of Ni, less than or equal to 0.2 weight percent of Ti, less than or equal to 0.1 weight percent of Pb, less than or equal to 0.05 weight percent of Sn, and the balance of Al. According to the corrosion-resistant material and the preparation method of the corrosion-resistant street lamp, the LM6 aluminum ingot alloy material coating is added, so that the outer surface of the lamp housing of the street lamp can be exposed for a long time, and the problems of corrosion, cracking and the like can be avoided.

title_en: Chromium-free fire clay for ladle sliding plate nozzle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chromium-free fireclay for a ladle sliding plate nozzle, wherein electric melting white corundum can improve the high temperature resistance of the finally obtained chromium-free fireclay; sintered plate-like corundum and alpha-Al 2 O 3 The powder acts together, so that the change rate of medium and high temperature lines of the chromium-free fire clay is greatly reduced; the addition of the electric melting spinel obviously improves the high-temperature thermal shock stability of the chromium-free fire clay; the white clay, the yellow dextrin, the sodium carboxymethylcellulose, the polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent, the sodium hexametaphosphate, the sodium tripolyphosphate and the aluminum dihydrogen phosphate act together, on one hand, chromium oxide is replaced to play a role of a binding agent, the mutual fusion of other components is promoted, and the strength of the chromium-free fire clay is improved. Through the interaction of the components, the obtained chromium-free fire clay has the excellent performances of small linear change rate, high breaking strength and high compressive strength.

title_en: Ozone spraying framework of concentrated transmission type xenon excimer light source ozone generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disinfection and killing of harmful microorganisms such as viruses, bacteria and the like by using ozone. The concentrated transmission type xenon excimer light source ozone generator and the basic components thereof are used as technical cores, a series of ozone spraying basic frameworks of the concentrated transmission type xenon excimer light source ozone generator are designed, the ozone spraying basic frameworks of the concentrated transmission type xenon excimer light source ozone generator form a series of core components of a sterilizing equipment product using the concentrated transmission type xenon excimer light source ozone generator, and the ozone sterilizing equipment of the ozone spraying system designed by the invention can exert an unparalleled effect on the sterilizing effect of ozone.

title_en: TiN(B)@TiO2Core-shell particle powder material and method of preparation
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to a novel composite ceramic granuleThe technical field of particle material synthesis and discloses TiN (B) @ TiO 2 Core-shell particle powder material, TiN (B) @ TiO and process for producing the same 2 The core-shell particle powder material consists of TiN (B) core and TiO coated outside the TiN (B) 2 A shell layer; the TiN (B) @ TiO 2 The core of the core-shell particle powder material is TiN with B element dissolved in solid, wherein the component of B is 0.5-8 at%, which is expressed as TiN (B), and the core-shell particle powder material has a TiN type crystal structure and better electrical conductivity than TiN; TiO2 2 Growing in situ on the core of TiN (B), tightly combining with TiN (B), having micropores on the outside, large surface area, containing B element, and the content of B is 0.2-1 at%. The invention can improve the output power and stability of Li-S battery and super capacitor as electrode, and can enhance the wave-absorbing effect as wave-absorbing material.

title_en: Saltpetering inhibitor for portland cement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a saltpetering inhibitor for portland cement, which at least comprises carbon nano tubes, activated carbon powder, diatomite powder, oxalic acid, slag powder, latex powder, ferrous sulfate and bentonite in parts by weight, and the saltpetering inhibitor at least comprises 1-2 parts of carbon nano tubes, 10-15 parts of activated carbon powder, 10-15 parts of diatomite powder, 7-10 parts of oxalic acid, 5-8 parts of slag powder, 3-5 parts of latex powder, 3-5 parts of ferrous sulfate and 10-15 parts of bentonite, and further comprises: acetone, cellulose ether, zeolite powder, benzoic acid, starch ether, calcium formate and triisopropanolamine. The invention can obviously improve the efflorescence resistance and durability of the cement base material under the condition of ensuring that the performance of the cement mortar and the concrete cement base material is not reduced or improved, thereby greatly improving the quality of buildings, the aesthetic feeling of appearance and the durability.

title_en: Outer ring constraint die-free deep cooling spinning forming method for aluminum alloy thin-wall curved surface part
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outer ring constraint die-free deep cooling spinning forming method for an aluminum alloy thin-wall curved surface part. The method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out solid solution aging strengthening treatment on the aluminum alloy plate; (2) continuously spraying liquid nitrogen to the plate spinning processing area to enable the plate spinning processing area to be in a deep cooling environment, carrying out outer ring constraint die-free deep cooling spinning forming on the plate, and spinning the plate into a conical piece; (3) in a deep cooling environment, the conical part is expanded to be a curved part through 1-3 spinning passes, and the spinning direction is reverse spinning. The outer ring constraint die-depth-free cold pressing process provided by the invention can reduce the residual stress in the spinning process, improve the deformation stability of a spinning part, obtain a high-diameter-thickness ratio thin-wall curved part with high forming precision and excellent performance, and avoid the defects of wrinkling, cracking and the like in the spinning process.

title_en: Unexposed concrete repair mortar and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses unexposed concrete repair mortar and a preparation method thereof, wherein the unexposed concrete repair mortar comprises the following raw materials: quick-hardening sulphoaluminate cement, portland cement, fly ash, sand, water, a water reducing agent and regenerated micro powder; and the components of the raw materials in parts by weight are as follows: 22-38 parts of quick-hardening sulphoaluminate cement, 3-17 parts of portland cement, 2-7 parts of fly ash, 42-57 parts of sand, 11-22 parts of water, 0.8-4 parts of a water reducing agent and 3-7 parts of regenerated micro powder. According to the invention, through the matching of the components in parts by weight, various raw materials are perfectly and uniformly mixed, so that the mortar has a high setting speed, can be set more quickly in unit time than other products, is convenient to fill small cracks, is low in corrosion due to weak alkali of the mortar, slows down the corrosion speed of concrete, forms a hard polymer after the mortar is set in the cracks and is bonded in the cracks to repair the cracks, and the problems of low setting speed, low strength, strong corrosion, poor wear resistance and poor bonding property of the traditional unexposed concrete repair mortar are solved.

title_en: Method of forming magnesium-based alloy articles at high strain rates
abstract_en: A method of making a magnesium-based alloy component, such as an automotive component, includes treating a casting including a magnesium-based alloy in a first deformation process to form a preform. In one aspect, the first deformation process has a first maximum predetermined strain rate of greater than or equal to about 0.001 a/sec to less than or equal to about 1 a/sec in an environment having a temperature of greater than or equal to about 250 c to less than or equal to about 450 c. In another aspect, the first deformation process is cold deformation, which is followed by annealing. The preform is then subjected to a second deformation process having a second highest predetermined strain rate of greater than or equal to about 1/second to less than or equal to about 100/second in an environment having a temperature of greater than or equal to about 150 ℃ to less than or equal to about 450 ℃ to form a magnesium-based alloy component substantially free of cracks. Solid magnesium-based alloy components having a selected microstructure are also provided.

title_en: Heat treatment equipment and method for titanium alloy die forging
abstract_en: The invention discloses heat treatment equipment and a heat treatment method for a titanium alloy die forging, and relates to the technical field of industrial processing equipment. The utility model provides a titanium alloy die forging piece heat treatment facility and method, including the heat treatment electric stove, the left surface lower extreme of heat treatment electric stove runs through and has seted up opening and fixedly connected with breather pipe, the left surface upper end of heat treatment electric stove runs through and has seted up and place opening one, the inner wall of placing opening one has seted up spout one, the inner wall sliding connection of spout one has baffle one, the left surface lower extreme fixedly connected with handle one of baffle one, the equal fixedly connected with handle two in both ends around the upper surface of heat treatment electric stove, the lower surface four corners fixedly connected with supporting leg one of heat treatment electric stove, it takes special protective device to have solved the argon gas that current titanium alloy die forging piece heat treatment facility does not have when using, argon gas is nontoxic under the ordinary pressure, but during high concentration, argon gas makes oxygen partial pressure reduce.

title_en: Self-insulation system foam concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-insulation system foam concrete which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 20-40 parts of sulphoaluminate cement, 20-40 parts of animal protein foaming agent, 6-15 parts of alpha-sodium alkenyl sulfonate, 6-15 parts of sodium dodecyl sulfate and 6-15 parts of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate. The preparation method comprises the steps of diluting the animal protein foaming agent, mixing the slurry with the prepared foam, pouring and curing. According to the invention, the ionic animal protein modifier is added, so that the stability of foam is enhanced, the porosity is increased, and the heat insulation performance of foam concrete is improved. The foam concrete is prepared by utilizing sulphoaluminate cement, and CO is reduced 2 The prepared foam concrete test block has high porosity, can reduce foam collapse in foam concrete during pouring and maintenance by utilizing the quick setting property of sulphoaluminate cement, and has the advantages of good heat preservation and insulation performance, high compressive strength and wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for treating cadmium-containing waste residue and preparing high-purity metal cadmium by precipitation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating cadmium-containing waste residue and preparing high-purity metal cadmium by a precipitation method, which comprises the following steps: a) ball-milling the cadmium-containing material, leaching the cadmium-containing material with a chlorinated coordination leaching agent, and performing liquid-solid separation to obtain a cadmium-containing leaching solution and leaching residues; b) adding zinc and copper extracting agents into the cadmium-containing leaching solution respectively, and separating Zn and Cu in the cadmium-containing leaching solution to obtain a cadmium-containing solution; c) and adding ammonia water into the cadmium-containing solution to adjust the pH value so as to precipitate metal cadmium ions, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain solid cadmium slag and a cadmium-precipitated solution. The method for treating the cadmium-containing waste residue and preparing the high-purity metal cadmium by adopting the precipitation method with the structure has the advantages of convenient operation, high separation efficiency, low operation cost, good appearance forming of the prepared metal cadmium plate, high purity and realization of regeneration and cyclic utilization of the leaching agent and the precipitating agent.

title_en: Nickel-titanium shape memory alloy material, alloy wire material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-titanium shape memory alloy material, an alloy wire material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of alloy preparation. The preparation method of the nickel-titanium shape memory alloy material comprises the following steps: and casting and cooling the melted nickel-titanium alloy melt under mechanical vibration to obtain an ingot, wherein the mechanical vibration frequency is 45-55 Hz, and the amplitude is 12-20 cm. The nickel-titanium shape memory alloy material is prepared by the preparation method provided by the embodiment of the invention. The preparation method of the nickel-titanium shape memory alloy wire comprises the step of drawing and forming the nickel-titanium shape memory alloy material or the memory alloy material prepared by the preparation method of the alloy material provided by the invention. The nickel-titanium shape memory alloy wire is prepared by the preparation method provided by the embodiment of the invention. The alloy material and the alloy wire prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention have good mechanical properties, and can be widely applied to the field of medical instruments.

title_en: Preparation method of lanthanum sulfate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of lanthanum sulfate, which comprises the steps of carrying out hydration reaction on water, sulfuric acid and lanthanum oxide to obtain lanthanum sulfate, and then filtering, drying and crushing to obtain a finished product of lanthanum sulfate. The whole reaction process is simple, the production cost is low, the economy is considerable, the product quality is stable, meanwhile, the filtrate can be recycled for a plurality of times, no waste water is discharged, and the national environmental protection requirement is met.

title_en: High-strength and high-toughness titanium alloy with good additive manufacturing forming performance and used at high temperature of 600 DEG C
abstract_en: A high-strength and high-toughness titanium alloy with good additive manufacturing performance for high temperature 600 ℃, which belongs to the technical field of metal additive manufacturing. The titanium alloy comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 6.2-7.5, V: 1.2 to 4.5, Mo: 1.2 to 4.5, Nb: 0.5 to 2.0, Zr: 3.2-9.6, Mn is less than or equal to 0.02, C is less than or equal to 0.02, Ni is less than or equal to 0.01, Si is less than or equal to 0.20, Sn is less than or equal to 0.20, Cr is less than or equal to 0.04, O is less than or equal to 0.02, P is less than or equal to 0.01, S is less than or equal to 0.01, N is less than or equal to 0.006, Ti: the balance; and the mass percentage ratio of Al/(V + Mo + Nb + Zr) is 5: 4.2-13. According to the invention, through the design of alloy components, the alpha phase is refined to improve the strength, the beta phase content is optimized to improve the plasticity, and the thermal stability of a melt is enhanced, so that the toughness of the alloy at the high temperature of 600 ℃ is improved to the maximum extent, and the alloy can be used for additive manufacturing and forming.

title_en: High-corrosion-resistance non-aging steel for food can and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The high-corrosion-resistance non-aging steel for the food can comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: less than or equal to 0.004%, less than or equal to 0.030% of Si, Mn: 0.8-1.0%, P is less than or equal to 0.015%, S is less than or equal to 0.013%, Als: 0.020 to 0.060%, Ti: 0.02-0.04% or Nb: 0.02-0.04% or both of them in an amount of 0.02-0.04% by weight, B: 0.0005-0.0012% and N less than or equal to 0.004%; the method comprises the following steps: smelting in a converter and carrying out vacuum treatment, and then continuously casting to form a blank; heating a casting blank; hot rolling; laminar cooling; coiling; cold rolling after acid washing; continuously annealing after degreasing and electrolytic degreasing; and electroplating tin after leveling. The invention can simultaneously realize no timeliness and achieve HR30Tm hardness value of 57 +/-4, can still keep good performance when in stock, and does not generate processing strain marks in the processing process.

title_en: Adjustable metal centrifugal casting mould with quick heat dissipation cooling function
abstract_en: The invention provides an adjustable metal centrifugal casting mold with a rapid heat dissipation and cooling function, and relates to the technical field of new metal material processing. This adjustable metal centrifugal casting mould that has quick heat dissipation cooling function, including the mould base, the inside fixed mounting of mould base has driving motor, the inside fixed mounting of mould base on driving motor right side has standby battery group. The adjustable metal centrifugal casting mold with the rapid heat dissipation and cooling functions has the advantages that the height-adjustable baffle is used, the pipeline mold is formed through centrifugal force, the structure of a centrifugally cast metal casting is compact, the mechanical property is good, the defects of traditional casting can be reduced, the detachable side plates are arranged, the processes of transferring, dissipating heat and discharging metal solution are realized through mechanical transmission during centrifugal casting, and the mold has the functions of efficiently dissipating heat and facilitating rapid cooling of the casting during actual use.

title_en: Large-breadth 3D printing forming bin structure
abstract_en: A large-breadth 3D printing porous air wall forming bin belongs to the field of structural design of a laser selective melting forming bin. Comprises a first main porous air wall, a second side porous air wall, a third side porous air wall, an air outlet device, a forming table top and other forming bin protection structures. The first main porous air wall, the second side porous air wall and the third side porous air wall are designed in a continuous inclined plane structure, so that when protective gas flows in, the airflow speed of the first main porous air wall is enabled to be maximum, and smoke generated by forming in the forming bin is carried by the protective gas to be discharged to the gas outlet device to the maximum extent. After the protective gas passes through the second side porous air wall and the third side porous air wall, the flow velocity can be reduced relative to the first main porous air wall, the smoke and dust is discharged in a maximized mode, airflow above the forming table top can be enabled to form forward airflow, the problem of smoke and dust accumulation can be reduced, the blocking and processing of the smoke and dust on the laser lens can be prevented, a good heat dissipation effect can be further achieved, and the processing quality of products is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of manganese vanadium lithium phosphate cathode material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a manganese vanadium lithium phosphate cathode material. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a manganese vanadium phosphate precursor; weighing and mixing initial raw materials of a manganese source compound, a vanadium source compound and a phosphorus source compound according to a molar ratio, and then pouring the mixture into a liquid-phase medium to stir on an automatic stirrer; adding ammonia water serving as a buffering agent into the stirred liquid, adding sodium hydroxide to adjust the pH value, filtering out precipitates after the precipitates appear in the solution, repeatedly washing, drying, crushing, and dehydrating at high temperature to obtain a precursor; mixing the precursor dehydrated at high temperature with a lithium source and a carbon source, and grinding and crushing; and (3) sintering the dry powder material in an oxygen-free environment, and then grinding and crushing to form a final product. The prepared manganese vanadium lithium phosphate has small particle size, uniform particle size distribution, good performance, high quality and stable structure, is easy to coat and dope and modify, and better improves the material performance.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped vanadium carbide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of SCR denitration catalyst recycling, and particularly relates to nitrogen-doped vanadium carbide and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of separating the pretreated raw materials at the temperature of 690-750 ℃ to obtain vanadium oxide; carbonizing the carbon source and the nitrogen source for the first time to obtain a nitrogen-doped carbon material; and mixing the vanadium oxide and the nitrogen-doped carbon material, and performing secondary carbonization reaction to obtain the nitrogen-doped vanadium carbide. The method can separate vanadium oxide from the waste SCR denitration catalyst by utilizing the characteristic of low melting point of vanadium oxide under the normal pressure condition. The method needs to strictly control the reaction temperature, and vanadium oxide in the waste SCR denitration catalyst is in a molten liquid state and is mixed with other components (such as TiO) 2 、WO 3 、MoO 3 Etc.) without using vacuum equipment, has the advantages of low separation reaction temperature and low cost。

title_en: Graphene quantum dot/ZnO/chlorella composite film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene quantum dot/ZnO/chlorella composite film and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the film comprises 15-21% zinc oxide nano crystal grains, 60-69% carbonized chlorella, 4-10% graphene quantum dots and 2-10% platinum nano particles; the preparation method of the film comprises the following steps: (1) preparing carbonized chlorella; (2) preparing a platinum nanoparticle low-carbon alcohol solution; (3) Adding a zinc precursor and graphene quantum dots into low-carbon alcohol, uniformly stirring, performing ultrasonic dispersion, adding platinum nano particles, and performing ultrasonic dispersion uniformly to obtain a mixed solution; (4) Adding carbonized chlorella, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed solution; (5) Spin-coating the mixed solution on a device substrate with interdigital electrodes, and sequentially performing post heat treatment and oxygen plasma treatment; and (6) heat treatment to obtain the composite film. The film has high sensitivity, low detection limit, 3.3 sensitivity to 50ppb concentration of methanol and excellent selectivity to methanol.

title_en: Molten iron full-domain impact mixing long-life stirrer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molten iron global impact mixing long-life stirrer which comprises a stirrer connecting flange, a stirring shaft and stirring blades, wherein the stirring shaft is arranged on the stirrer connecting flange; the stirring blades are single-layer special-shaped stirring blades, the top surface and the bottom surface of each stirring blade are planes, the outer side surface is an arc surface, the upper iron facing surface and the upper back iron surface are forward spiral surfaces, and the lower iron facing surface and the lower back iron surface are reverse spiral surfaces; the junction of the forward spiral surface of the upper iron-facing surface and the reverse spiral surface of the lower iron-facing surface is an arc transition surface, and the junction of the forward spiral surface of the upper back iron surface and the reverse spiral surface of the lower back iron surface is an arc transition surface. Through the structural design and the optimization of structural parameters of the special-shaped stirring blades, the molten iron scouring wear area and the scouring damage process of the stirrer are obviously reduced, the service life of the stirrer is greatly prolonged, the size of an upper and lower stirring circulating flow area is enlarged, the speed and the kinetic energy of an upper and lower circulating flow are improved, and the reliability and the stability of a radial discharge jet impact flow field of the upper and lower stirring circulating flow are ensured.

title_en: Method for preparing undoped single coal gangue ceramsite based on moving bed and ceramsite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing undoped single coal gangue ceramsite based on a moving bed and ceramsite. The method comprises the steps of sequentially crushing, grinding and granulating coal gangue to obtain raw ceramsite, and sequentially drying, preheating, roasting and cooling the raw ceramsite on a moving bed to obtain the raw ceramsite with the bulk density of 550-850 kg/m 3 The method is low in energy consumption and environment-friendly, the obtained ceramsite product meets the national standard, the accumulation amount of the coal gangue and the environmental pollution caused by accumulation of the coal gangue are expected to be reduced, heavy metals in the coal gangue are solidified, the release of toxic metal elements is reduced, the comprehensive utilization of the coal gangue is realized, and the adverse effect of the coal gangue on the ecological environment is eliminated.

title_en: Surface heat treatment process for 9Ni steel forging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to machining, and discloses a surface heat treatment process for a 9Ni steel forging, which comprises a base, wherein a fan is fixedly arranged in the middle of the bottom end of the base, an air box communicated with an air outlet of the fan is fixedly arranged on the surface of the base, a flow conveying plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the air box, a flow distributing hole for communicating air flow in the air box with the outside is formed in the surface of the flow conveying plate, the flow distributing holes are formed in the surface of the flow conveying plate at equal intervals, and a support frame is movably arranged on the inner wall of each flow distributing hole. According to the invention, the flow distribution holes with equal intervals are formed in the flow conveying plate, and the magnetic blocks magnetically attracted with the metal plate are arranged on the flow distribution holes, so that the metal plate floats due to the air flow blown out through the flow distribution holes and the adsorption of the magnetic blocks on the plate in the working process, the heat treatment surface of the plate is uniformly ejected by the air flow, the plate is not in contact with the fixed part, the overheating phenomenon of the contact part is avoided, and the purpose of comprehensive and uniform air cooling is finally achieved.

title_en: Self-learning control method for sintering machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-learning control method of a sintering machine, which comprises the steps of obtaining initial parameter information and preset operation information; when the initial parameter information accords with a normal production state, storing the initial parameter information and generating an initial structure array; acquiring real-time parameter information after the initial structure array is generated; when the fluctuation state is normal fluctuation, judging whether the real-time parameter information conforms to a normal production state; when the real-time parameter information accords with a normal production state, storing the corresponding real-time parameter information and generating a real-time structure array; and reading the preset operation information, calling the structure array matched with the operation requirement in real time when the preset operation information is matched with the actual production requirement, and controlling the operation of a machine in the production process according to the set parameters in the called structure array, so that the sintering process can realize stable high yield.

title_en: Preparation of In 2 Se 3 Apparatus and method of
abstract_en: The inventionDiscloses a method for preparing In  2  Se  3  The device comprises a swinging furnace, a quartz tube and a quartz crucible, wherein a first heating area and a second heating area are arranged in the swinging furnace, the quartz tube is vertically placed in the swinging furnace, the lower end of the quartz tube corresponds to the first heating area, the upper end of the quartz tube corresponds to the second heating area, the quartz crucible is vertically placed in the upper end of the quartz tube through a supporting plate, and a material nozzle penetrating through the supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the quartz crucible. In addition, the invention adopts a two-step method to prepare In  2  Se  3  First, in is preliminarily synthesized  2  Se  3  Then for the preliminarily synthesized In  2  Se  3  And carrying out homogenization treatment. The invention can produce a large amount of In a single batch  2  Se  3  Less heat released In unit time, lower reaction temperature, high safety, less volatilization loss of Se, and uniform distribution of In  2  Se  3  。

title_en: Fiber gypsum board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fiber gypsum board which is prepared from the following raw materials: gypsum powder, paper fiber, waterproofing agent and wood fiber; the waterproof agent comprises latex powder and silicone oil. The fiber gypsum board provided by the invention is mainly used for suspended ceiling and partition wall systems, and has high strength and long service life. The invention also provides a preparation method of the fiber gypsum board.

title_en: High-compactness tungsten-copper alloy material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-compactness tungsten-copper alloy material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the high-compactness tungsten-copper alloy material comprises 70-85 parts of tungsten powder, 12-25 parts of copper powder, 0.1-1 part of cerium oxide powder and 0.1-1 part of cobalt powder. The tungsten-copper alloy material has good compactness and bending strength, compact structure and uniform structure; the cerium oxide powder and the cobalt powder are added into the tungsten-copper alloy, so that gaps between tungsten and copper and between tungsten can be effectively filled, the wettability between tungsten and copper is improved, the sintering performance of the whole alloy powder is improved, and the density and the strength are obviously improved; according to the formula system, the stainless steel grinding balls and the acetone are used as grinding media, so that the generation of impurities can be controlled most effectively, edges and corners of tungsten powder are improved through wet high-energy ball milling, the structures of the tungsten powder, copper powder, cerium oxide powder and cobalt powder are further refined, the apparent density is increased, the surface energy is reduced, subsequent sintering is facilitated, and sintering densification is promoted.

title_en: Coke oven gas desulfurization process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coke oven gas desulfurization process, which adopts a concentrated ammonia water desulfurization process, separates the gas desulfurization process from the deamination process, utilizes the ammonia resource of the gas as an alkali source for desulfurization, and utilizes high-temperature concentrated ammonia gas at the top of an ammonia still to be introduced into a negative pressure deacidification tower as a heat source for deacidification, thereby having low energy consumption and good desulfurization effect. The waste gas of the process is cooled and then sent to a coal gas negative pressure system, so that secondary pollution is avoided. The purified acid gas is used for producing sulfur by using a Claus furnace, the product quality is high, and the environment is clean. The whole system has no waste water which is difficult to treat.

title_en: Enamel cold-rolled steel sheet excellent in resistance to scaling and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cold-rolled steel sheet for enamel excellent in resistance to scale explosion and a method for manufacturing the same. The cold-rolled steel sheet for enamel with excellent scale explosion resistance according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises the following components by weight: 0.05 to 0.09%, mn:0.1 to 0.3%, si:0.001 to 0.03%, al:0.01 to 0.08%, P:0.002 to 0.02%, S:0.001 to 0.02%, sb:0.01 to 0.089%, N: less than 0.005% (excluding 0%), O:0.002% or less (excluding 0%), the remaining amount of Fe and unavoidable impurities, the area fraction of the micropores being 0.28 to 0.85%, the scale explosion resistance relationship index (a) represented by the following relational expression 1 satisfying 10500 to 35000, the surface adhesion relationship index (T) represented by the following relational expressions 2 and 3 satisfying 0.0045 to 0.060, and the workability relationship index (F) satisfying 3000 to 8000.[ relation 1 ]]A＝([Mn]/[S])*(Dvoid/[Sb]) [ relation 2 ]]T＝([Mn]*[Sb])*(D  cementite  /[Si]) [ relation 3 ]]F＝([Al]/[N])*(D  cementite  /[C])。

title_en: Ferritic stainless steel with improved corrosion resistance and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Ferritic stainless steel having improved corrosion resistance is disclosed. The disclosed ferritic stainless steel comprises, in weight percent, 0.02% or less (excluding 0) C, 0.02% or less (excluding 0) N, 0.5% or less (excluding 0) Si, 0.3% or less (excluding 0) Mn, 16% to 20% Cr, 0.4% or less (excluding 0) Ni, and balance Fe and unavoidable impurities, wherein the amount of Cr in weight percent of the thickness region 3nm from the surface of the passivation layer is at least 1.2 times the amount of Cr in weight percent of the stainless steel base metal.

title_en: Iron-aluminum-based plated steel sheet for hot pressing excellent in hydrogen-induced delayed fracture characteristics and spot weldability, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an iron-aluminum-based plated steel sheet and a method for producing the same, the iron-aluminum-based plated steel sheet comprising: a base steel plate; and a plating layer formed on a surface of the base steel sheet, wherein the alloy plating layer includes: a diffusion layer containing a cubic Fe-Al intermetallic compound; and an alloying layer formed on the diffusion layer and composed of an alloy phase different from a cubic structure, wherein the diffusion layer has a thickness of 3 to 20 μm, and the diffusion layer has a thickness exceeding 50% of the total thickness of the plating layer.

title_en: Negative electrode material, pole piece containing same, electrochemical device and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a negative electrode material, pole piece, electrochemical device and electron device that contain this material satisfies through control negative electrode material: 0 < I A /I D Less than 2 and 0-I E /I A And < 5, the crystalline silicon is completely converted into amorphous silicon after the electrochemical device containing the cathode material is cycled, and the volume change of the cathode material in the electrochemical device is reduced, so that the cycle performance and the expansion performance of the electrochemical device are improved.

title_en: High-toughness aluminum alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-toughness aluminum alloy for a flux-cored wire and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-toughness aluminum alloy for the flux-cored wire comprises 6-8 parts of Si, 3-5 parts of Cu, 0.1-0.2 part of Mg, 0.2-0.3 part of Mn, 0.1-0.2 part of Fe, 0.1-0.2 part of Sb and 85-90 parts of Al. The Mg, the Fe and the Sb are arranged and added in the silicon-aluminum alloy, and the components of all materials are optimized, so that the Mg element is dissolved in the Al alloy matrix to generate a solid solution strengthening effect, the high-temperature performance of the aluminum-silicon alloy is realized, on the basis, the high-content Cu and Mg element can simultaneously enhance the formation of theta phase and delta phase, the strength and the ductility of the alloy are improved, and meanwhile, after trace Sb is optimized, the size of eutectic silicon can be greatly refined and the appearance of the eutectic silicon can be improved, so that the prepared silicon-aluminum alloy has good toughness and strength.

title_en: 820 MPa-level large-thickness steel plate for ships and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 820 MPa-level large-thickness steel plate for ships, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 0.11 to 0.16 percent; si: 0.05 to 0.14 percent; mn: 0.80% -1.60%; s: less than or equal to 0.002 percent; p: less than or equal to 0.008 percent; and Als: 0.02 to 0.05 percent; n: 0.003 to 0.010 percent; ni: 0.35 to 0.55 percent; cr: 0.70% -1.00%; mo: 0.55 to 0.75 percent; nb: 0.02% -0.04%; cu: 0.15 to 0.30 percent; ti: 0.008% -0.015%; the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities, and Cu/Ni is less than or equal to 0.9. Can meet the technical requirements of the marine steel plate in severe and harsh marine environments.

title_en: Application of molten residue obtained after municipal waste treatment by utilizing thermal plasma technology in foam concrete
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building materials, and particularly relates to application of melting residues obtained after urban garbage is treated by utilizing a thermal plasma technology in foam concrete. Therefore, the invention not only solves the problem of garbage stacking, achieves the purposes of environmental protection, energy conservation and waste recycling, but also provides a new application of MWTPT and provides a new foam concrete.

title_en: Bio-based nano modified regenerated pervious concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides bio-based nano modified recycled pervious concrete and a preparation method thereof, which can improve the mechanical property and frost resistance of the pervious concrete and improve the water permeability coefficient. The bio-based nano modified recycled pervious concrete comprises the raw materials of cement, fly ash, granulated blast furnace slag powder, silica fume, nano cellulose, an air entraining agent, recycled coarse aggregate and water; the mass ratio of cement, fly ash, granulated blast furnace slag powder, silica fume, nano cellulose, air entraining agent and regenerated coarse aggregate is 1: 0.1-0.4: 0.1-0.5: 0-0.05: 0.0002-0.002: 0-0.0002: 4.2-5.0: 0.36-0.56. The preparation method of the bio-based nano modified recycled pervious concrete comprises the following steps: adding nano-cellulose into water for pre-dispersion, wherein the weight ratio of water: the mass ratio of the nano-cellulose is = 2-3; uniformly mixing the recycled coarse aggregate, the cement, the fly ash, the granulated blast furnace slag powder and the silica fume, adding water and stirring for 1-2 min; adding the pre-dispersed nano-cellulose and the air entraining agent, and then stirring for 2-4min to be uniform.

title_en: Ammonium sulfate solution concentration drying system, process and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a concentration drying system, a process and an application of an ammonium sulfate solution, belonging to the field of chemical industry; the device comprises a cyclone, a vacuum belt filter, a vacuum pumping system, a blower, a hot air heater, a flash evaporation dryer, a cyclone dust collector storage tank, a bag-type dust collector, an induced draft fan, a hopper, a spiral conveyer, a packing machine, a liquid feed tank, a liquid feed pump, an auxiliary pipeline and other components. The device is characterized in that the ammonium sulfate solution conveyed by an external system is subjected to step-by-step dehydration treatment, so that the water content of the final ammonium sulfate solid material is reduced to be within 0.5 percent, and the standard of direct packaging and external selling is achieved.

title_en: Barium titanate modified zirconia ceramic material for clinical use
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of powder metallurgy zirconia materials, and particularly relates to a barium titanate modified zirconia ceramic material complex. The ceramic composite material is prepared by doping barium titanate powder with 5mol% into 3 mol% of yttrium oxide stabilized tetragonal zirconia polycrystalline ceramic powder to obtain 5mol% BT/3Y-TZP composite ceramic. The 5mol% BT/3Y-TZP composite ceramic provided by the invention has uniform porosity through scanning electron microscope detection, and has good hydrophilicity through water contact angle experimental detection. After co-culturing the material and human osteoblasts (MG63), the material is proved to have no cytotoxicity, and meanwhile, the ALP and related osteoblast gene expression level are obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method of modified graphene oxide and formula for preparing slump-retaining mother liquor by using modified graphene oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing modified graphene oxide and a formula for preparing slump-retaining mother liquor by using the modified graphene oxide, which comprises the following steps: s1, taking a proper amount of graphene oxide for modification, preparing 2g/l graphene oxide dispersion liquid, and dispersing for 2h under an ultrasonic condition; s2, weighing 1000g of graphene oxide dispersion liquid, placing the graphene oxide dispersion liquid in a reaction kettle, stirring, and heating in a water bath to 70 ℃; s3, weighing 4g of vinyltriethoxysilane, and adding the vinyltriethoxysilane into the reaction kettle in a dropwise manner for 0.5 hour; s4, continuing the reaction for 0.5 hour after the dropwise addition is finished; according to the method and the formula, the graphene oxide is subjected to certain chemical modification, so that the graphene oxide can participate in the synthesis of the slump-retaining polycarboxylic acid mother liquor, the product can effectively weaken the tackifying effect of the graphene oxide on concrete, the utilization rate of the graphene oxide is improved, and the slump-retaining performance of the graphene modified concrete in a period of time is ensured.

title_en: Integrated processing device for compound
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated processing device for a compound, and relates to the technical field of compound processing. The integrated processing device of the compound comprises a heating module, a refrigerating module, a dust removal assembly and a shell. The interior of the housing includes a dust removal space and a processing space. At least one partition board is arranged in the processing space of the shell, and the partition board is used for dividing the calcining chamber and the cooling chamber in the processing space of the shell. The heating module is arranged at the calcining chamber. The refrigeration module is arranged in the cooling chamber. The dust removal assembly is installed in the dust removal space of the shell. The invention solves the technical problem that when the compounds needing to be dehydrated, such as semi-hydrated gypsum and the like, are produced by utilizing an air flow + fluidized bed two-step process or a steam rotary process in the prior art, dust removing equipment needs to be arranged in the dehydration process and the cooling process respectively, so that a plurality of machines need to be arranged on a production line, and great manpower and material resources need to be invested in the operation and the later maintenance process in the production process.

title_en: Method for preparing regenerated wrought aluminum alloy from waste aluminum alloy
abstract_en: A method for preparing a regenerated wrought aluminum alloy from a scrap aluminum alloy comprises the following steps: cleaning waste aluminum, roasting to remove pollutants and water, fully melting, and preserving heat at 745-755 ℃; cooling, and adding pure aluminum, al-30Si, al-10Mg, al-30Mn, al-30Cr and Al-RE intermediate alloy according to the alloy components for adjustment; melting, slagging off and preserving heat to obtain the regenerated wrought aluminum alloy with adjusted components. The invention can convert impurities which are difficult to remove in the regenerated aluminum alloy into the enhanced phase, simultaneously, the rare earth and manganese chromium elements effectively refine the alloy structure, and the iron-rich phase is modified, so that the processing quality of subsequent alloy products is stable; the raw material cost is low, meanwhile, the light rare earth elements with rich reserves and low price are used, the addition amount is very small, and the production cost can be greatly reduced; the preparation method is simple and reliable, is easy to popularize, is beneficial to industrialization, and reduces the technical difficulty and the production cost.

title_en: Decomposition of waste acid neutralization residue for preparing H2Method of S
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing H by decomposing waste acid neutralization slag 2 S, the method comprising the steps of: 1) drying; 2) low-temperature decomposition: carrying out low-temperature reduction reaction on the dried waste acid neutralization slag and a carbonaceous reducing agent to obtain CaS; 3) absorption and mineralization: mixing CaS with water and CO 2 Gas to CO 2 Absorption mineralization to obtain CaCO 3 Products and H 2 S gas; 4) treating waste acid: subjecting the obtained H to 2 S gas is introduced into non-ferrous metal smelting waste acid for sulfuration and precipitation, solid-liquid separation is carried out, sulfide precipitation is used for recovering heavy metal and arsenic,and (3) adding lime into the filtrate for neutralization treatment, and directly returning the obtained waste acid neutralized slag to the step (1) for treatment. The invention decomposes the acid neutralized slag of the hazardous waste and the waste acid at low temperature and then carries out CO 2 Absorbing and mineralizing to obtain calcium carbonate and H as by-products 2 S gas, H obtained 2 The S gas is continuously used for treating the nonferrous metal smelting waste acid, no waste is generated in the whole process, and the resource treatment of the hazardous waste acid neutralization slag and the direct industrial application of the product hydrogen sulfide gas are realized.

title_en: Steel smelting high temperature waste residue environmental protection processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environment-friendly treatment of steelmaking waste residues, in particular to an environment-friendly treatment system for high-temperature waste residues generated in steel smelting, which comprises a tank body, an annular main pipe, a screw conveyer mechanism, a driving motor, a main shaft, a stirring rod, a main crushing cutter, an auxiliary crushing cutter and a spray pipe, wherein the main shaft is driven to rotate by the driving motor, so that the main crushing cutter and the auxiliary crushing cutter can rotate relatively to crush the high-temperature waste residues, the subsequent heat exchange operation of the high-temperature waste residues is facilitated, water is sprayed into the tank body through the annular main pipe and the spray pipe, namely, the waste residues attached to the main crushing cutter and the auxiliary crushing cutter are cleaned, the water is also contacted with the crushed high-temperature waste residues, the heat exchange between the water and the heat in the crushed high-temperature waste residues is realized, in the process, the water and the crushed high-temperature waste residues are stirred through the stirring rod, and the heat exchange efficiency between the water and the heat in the high-temperature waste residues is improved, the crushing and stirring operation in the tank body is realized, and the working efficiency of waste residue treatment is improved.

title_en: High-strength high-elasticity copper-titanium alloy and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength high-elasticity copper-titanium alloy and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the copper-titanium alloy comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 2.3 to 3.8 percent of Ti2.3 percent of Ni, less than or equal to 0.3 percent of Fe, less than or equal to 0.1 percent of Y, less than or equal to 0.1 percent of La, the balance of Cu and inevitable impurity elements, and the balance of Cu and Ti, wherein the Cu and Ti are more than or equal to 99.3 percent.
