The method has the beneficial effects that a vacuum high-temperature smelting environment is provided through vacuum smelting, so that the active titanium element in the alloy is strictly controlled, the contents of hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, impurities and the like in the prepared copper-titanium alloy are low, the purification degree of the copper-titanium alloy is high, gas, impurities and non-metallic impurities of copper and titanium metal are removed in the refining process, and the quality of the prepared copper-titanium alloy is improved.

title_en: Waterproof and moistureproof ceramic tile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building materials, and particularly discloses a waterproof and moistureproof ceramic tile and a preparation method thereof, wherein the waterproof and moistureproof ceramic tile is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 75-85 parts of kaolin, 2-5 parts of calcium bentonite, 1-2.5 parts of an inorganic aluminum salt waterproof agent, 0.1-0.5 part of a dispersing agent, 7-18 parts of Portland cement and 15-25 parts of water, wherein the weight ratio of the inorganic aluminum salt waterproof agent to the Portland cement is 1: (5-9). The utility model provides a dampproofing and waterproofing ceramic tile has good dampproofing and waterproofing performance.

title_en: High solid content piezoelectric ceramic slurry for direct-writing 3D printing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high solid content piezoelectric ceramic slurry for direct-writing 3D printing and a preparation method thereof, wherein the piezoelectric ceramic slurry comprises 85-90% of piezoelectric ceramic base material, 8.0-12% of PVA, 1.0-2.0% of glycerol and 1.0-2.0% of dispersing agent, and the piezoelectric ceramic base material is lead zirconate titanate or barium titanate piezoelectric ceramic powder with the particle size of about 500 nm. The direct-writing slurry of the invention takes water as a solvent, effectively solves the problem of solvent volatilization, has light toxicity and harmlessness to human bodies due to polyvinyl alcohol and ammonium polyacrylate, has simple preparation method, and can overcome the defects of high toxicity, high cost and complex preparation process of ceramic slurry materials prepared by similar processes. And in subsequent sintering, the problems of collapse, volume shrinkage and the like can be reduced due to the high solid content.

title_en: Recycling method of retired lithium ion battery positive electrode material
abstract_en: The invention provides a recycling method of a retired lithium ion battery anode material. Compared with the prior art, the invention introduces CO 2 The lithium ion battery can be recycled as a leaching agent and a precipitating agent, no extra precipitating agent is required to be added, the consumption of acid-base reagents can be reduced, and no anion and cation impurities are introduced, so that the purity of a lithium product is improved; in addition, the invention extracts lithium element first, can realize one-step separation of lithium element and iron phosphorus element, and achieves the purpose of selectively extracting lithium; meanwhile, only leaching and thermal decomposition processes are needed, the process is short, the process is simple, the leaching process can be carried out in a weak alkaline environment without harsh conditions such as microwave heating and the like, the corrosion is less, the requirement on the material of production equipment is low, and the method is suitable for being carried out in a weak alkaline environmentAnd the cost is low for large-scale production.

title_en: Method for treating arsenic-containing waste liquid and solidifying arsenic slag
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hazardous waste treatment, and particularly discloses a method for treating arsenic-containing waste liquid and solidifying arsenic slag. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: adding a calcium source into the arsenic-containing waste liquid, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain waste water and waste residue; step 2: mixing the waste residue with a curing material and water, pressing and forming, and curing to obtain a cured body; the solidified material comprises cement, fly ash, slag and broken stone; the weight ratio of the waste residue to the solidified material is (1-3): (0.7-2); the water-cement ratio is 0.15-0.32. Adding a calcium source into the waste liquid, and reacting pollutants such as arsenic, fluorine and the like in the waste liquid with the calcium source to generate precipitate; solid-liquid separation, safe discharge of waste water, interaction of waste residue and cementing materials such as cement, fly ash and slag to form a solidified body, direct use of the solidified body in safe landfill, namely direct discharge of waste water after arsenic-containing waste liquid treatment, direct use of waste residue in safe landfill, and no secondary pollution to the environment.

title_en: Preparation method of glutathione-S-transferase protected copper nanocluster and application of glutathione-S-transferase protected copper nanocluster in aureomycin detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of copper nanocluster synthesis, in particular to a preparation method of glutathione-S-transferase protected copper nanoclusters and application thereof in aureomycin detection, which specifically comprises the following steps: and (3) preparing glutathione-sulfur transferase-copper nanocluster stock solution under a specific pH condition by using glutathione-sulfur transferase as a template, and further performing dialysis purification. Under the excitation wavelength of 325nm, the copper nanocluster presents blue fluorescence, and an emission peak is arranged at 400 nm; the relative quantum yield of the glutathione-sulfur transferase-copper nano-cluster is 1.36 percent by taking quinine sulfate as a standard reference substance; the copper nanocluster as an effective environment-friendly fluorescent probe can be used for detecting aureomycin (CTC) in a solution. The fluorescent copper nano cluster has unique photophysical characteristics, low price, almost no toxicity and excellent biocompatibility, and the method for detecting aureomycin is quick and simple, has good detection sensitivity, and is an ideal fluorescent nano material applied to the fields of biology and medicine.

title_en: Metal alloy wire smelting waste residue recovery processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal smelting processing, in particular to a metal alloy wire smelting waste residue recovery processing device, which comprises a processing box; a cylindrical isolating part is arranged in the treatment box, the inner cavity of the isolating part is a stirring cavity, a stirring screening component is arranged in the stirring cavity, a filtering screen is arranged in the isolating part at the upper left end of the stirring cavity, and a blanking cavity is arranged in the treatment box outside the filtering screen; a feeding cavity is arranged at the right upper end of the stirring cavity; a material distribution cavity is arranged in the treatment box right below the isolation part, and a first collection cavity and a second collection cavity are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side below the material distribution cavity; and a magnet is arranged in the separation part between the stirring cavity and the material distributing cavity. According to the invention, the stirring cavity, the filtering screen, the stirring and screening component and the magnet are adopted, so that the stirring and screening component can carry out primary stirring and screening on the metal waste residues; carry out magnetism through the magnet to the metal waste residue after the screening, to the secondary screening of waste residue, effectively guarantee the categorised recovery processing of metal waste residue.

title_en: rGO-Au @ PdPt composite nanomaterial, preparation method thereof and ammonia nitrogen detection electrode
abstract_en: The invention provides an rGO-Au @ PdPt composite nano material which comprises reduced graphene oxide and Au @ PdPt core-alloy shell nano particles loaded on the reduced graphene oxide, wherein the diameter of the Au @ PdPt core-alloy shell nano particles is less than 50 nm. The rGO-Au @ PdPt composite nanomaterial disclosed by the invention is a novel composite nanomaterial, has a good ammonia nitrogen sensitivity characteristic, and graphene has good physical and chemical properties, a large specific surface area and a large number of potential active sites. Therefore, the electrode material obtained by compounding the graphene and the nano material containing various noble metal components can combine the advantages of the noble metals and the graphene, and further realize high-performance ammonia nitrogen detection. The invention also provides a preparation method of the rGO-Au @ PdPt composite nano material and an ammonia nitrogen detection electrode.

title_en: Petal-shaped loaded ZnIn2S4Preparation method of bismuth oxide composite visible light catalytic material and product prepared by same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loaded petal-shaped ZnIn 2 S 4 The preparation method of the bismuth oxide composite visible light catalytic material comprises the steps of firstly synthesizing Bi by taking Bi-MOF as a precursor 2 O 3 Synthesizing ZnIn by hydrothermal method 2 S 4 (ii) a Then using Bi 2 O 3 And ZnIn 2 S 4 Synthesizing the raw materials by a hydrothermal method to obtain the loaded petal-shaped ZnIn 2 S 4 The bismuth oxide is compounded with the visible light catalytic material. In addition, the preparation method is also disclosedThe product of (1). The bismuth oxide composite visible light catalytic material prepared by the invention is of a rod-shaped structure and a petal-shaped structure ZnIn 2 S 4 The water-soluble bismuth oxide is uniformly dispersed on the surface of a rod-shaped bismuth oxide structure, so that the specific surface area of the material is effectively increased, more active sites are exposed, the hydrogen production performance is excellent, the water can be rapidly and efficiently photolyzed to produce hydrogen, the water-soluble bismuth oxide has a wide application prospect, and a reliable theoretical and practical support is provided for practical application.

title_en: Monitoring protection mechanism for high-temperature furnace machining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring protection mechanism for high-temperature furnace processing, which comprises a protection box, a bottom frame and a lamp bracket, wherein the protection box comprises a box shell and a signal bracket, the signal bracket is arranged on the rear end surface of the box shell, the signal frame is fixedly connected with the case shell, the underframe is arranged on the lower end surface of the case shell and is fixedly connected with the case shell, the lamp frames are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the case shell, and the lamp bracket is connected with the box shell in a sliding way, a user can fix the protection mechanism and the outside through the positioning bracket, therefore, the positioning frame can stably support the bending frame, the protection box and the internal monitoring equipment can be conveniently supported by the bottom frame, when the monitoring equipment is not used, a user can stably lock the sealing door at the front end of the top shell, the mounting opening is guaranteed to be shielded and protected through the sealing door, and meanwhile, the user can also install a signal frame inside the middle shell.

title_en: Efficient resin separation method for platinum-palladium-rhodium mixture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency resin separation method for a platinum-palladium-rhodium mixture, which adopts two resin adsorption materials to selectively adsorb rhodium and platinum-palladium respectively and then desorb rhodium, palladium and platinum respectively, namely two-step adsorption and three-step desorption, so that the platinum, the palladium and the rhodium are thoroughly separated, and the whole process is carried out under a closed condition, thereby being safer and more environment-friendly; according to the method, the content of platinum and palladium in the obtained rhodium desorption solution is lower than 0.5ppm by controlling the exchange and desorption conditions; the platinum content in the palladium desorption liquid obtained by simultaneously adsorbing platinum and palladium and desorbing platinum and palladium step by step is lower than 20ppm, and the palladium content in the platinum desorption liquid is even lower than 2ppm, so that the subsequent platinum and palladium refining effect is not obviously influenced; the recovery process disclosed by the invention is utilized to recover rhodium, platinum and palladium in the mixed solution, the purity of the recovered product is not lower than 99.95%, the recovery rate of rhodium is more than 96%, and the recovery rate of platinum and palladium is as high as more than 99%.

title_en: Synthesis method and application of nano corn cob Ag-ZnO composite catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method and application of a nano corn cob Ag-ZnO composite catalyst, belonging to the field of preparation of photocatalytic materials. The invention has the beneficial effects that: a novel shape nano corn cob Ag-ZnO composite catalyst is synthesized; the method is simple, has good repeatability, can be used for mass production, and the obtained composite catalyst has good chemical stability and is easy to store; by utilizing the metal plasma resonance principle, the energy band of ZnO is changed, the response range of light is expanded, and the catalytic activity is improved, so that the utilization rate of solar energy and the catalytic efficiency of the composite catalyst are greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano-copper particles for solar cell panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano-copper particles for a solar cell panel, which relates to the technical field of solar cell panels 2 Roasting under protection to obtain purple black nano copper powder particles, and then continuously introducing N 2 And (5) protecting until the temperature is cooled to room temperature. The method takes the gaps on the surface of the porous starch as a template, graphite as a reducing agent and ammonia water as a precipitating agent to prepare the nano-copper, has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost and safe and environment-friendly use of raw materials, and the prepared nano-copper particles have the characteristics of high purity, small granularity, narrow particle size distribution interval, good dispersibility and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of nap-covered recycled concrete
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a recycled concrete with a velvet covering layer, belonging to the technical field of recycled concrete, the invention can slightly corrode the surface of recycled aggregate by dilute acid solution, directly corrode tiny pores on the surface into larger pores, then inlay granular iron powder, can improve the strength of the aggregate and simultaneously improve the impermeability, then introduce a velvet covering chain, one magnetic end of the velvet covering chain actively enters the pores by virtue of the adsorption effect between the velvet covering chain and the iron powder, partially dissolves residual moisture in the pores, shows viscosity to perform a certain bonding effect, and simultaneously triggers the expansion effect to be combined with the pores on the surface of the recycled aggregate, thereby forming a velvet covering action on the surface of the recycled aggregate, on one hand, the roughness of the surface of the recycled aggregate is improved, which is beneficial to the combination with cement with high contact area, on the other hand, the velvet covering chain can be pre-buried in the connecting surface of the recycled aggregate and the cement, thereby remarkably improving crack resistance.

title_en: Manufacturing process of aluminum differential case shell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to casting of electric vehicle differential cases, and discloses a manufacturing process of an aluminum differential case shell, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: si 2.0-3.0%, Ti 1.2-2%, Cu 0.1-0.25%, Zn 0.2-1.2%, Mg 1.2-1.3%, Fe 0.1-0.3%, Ni 0.5-0.6%, and the balance of A1 and inevitable impurities, wherein the manufacturing process comprises the following steps of S1, one-time mixing: preparing raw materials according to required ingredients, and adopting simple substance raw materials or alloy raw materials of ingredients; s2, smelting: and (4) drying the raw materials prepared in the step (S1), and introducing the dried raw materials into a smelting furnace for high-temperature smelting. This aluminium system differential case casing manufacturing process, through carrying out once batching to the composition of aluminium system differential case and then smelt to the molten state, after going out molten metal liquid impurity, carry out accurate secondary composition analysis to the aluminium system metal liquid under the molten state, improved the processingquality of the follow-up thermal treatment of differential case casing, effectual aluminium system differential case casing manufacturing process to the electric motor car optimizes.

title_en: Preparation method of surface coating taking amorphous fiber as raw material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a surface coating taking amorphous fiber as a raw material. Comprises the following steps; 1) taking nickel-based or iron-based self-fluxing alloy powder with the grain diameter of 40-60 mu m and amorphous SiO with the length of 70-100nm  2  The fibrous particles were mixed, and the mass ratio of the former to the latter was 7: 3. 2) Preparing the coating from the mixed powder in the step 1) by using a plasma spraying mode to obtain a fibrous coating. 3) Placing the sample with the fibrous coating in a heating furnace into which cooling water can be introduced, heating to 950 ℃ along with the furnace, wherein the heating rate is 10 ℃/min, and keeping the temperature for 10-30 min; and rapidly cooling to room temperature along with the furnace, wherein the cooling rate is 15 ℃/min, and the cooled fibrous coating has a dendritic crystal-fiber coating structure. Amorphous SiO  2  Adding fibrous particles to obtain a coating with a fibrous structure, increasing the strength and wear resistance of the coating, and performing plasma spraying and heat treatment to obtain a dendritic crystal-fibrous structure, dendritic crystals and amorphous SiO  2  The fibers are crossed, so that the strength and the wear resistance of the coating are enhanced.

title_en: Polymer carbon dot fluorescent probe for ppb level aniline detection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polymer carbon dot fluorescent probe for ppb level aniline detection, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding polyaniline and 2, 3-diaminonaphthalene into N, N-dimethylformamide to prepare a dark green to black solution; s2, placing the solution prepared in the step S1 in a reaction kettle to obtain suspension; s3, purifying the suspension liquid in the step S2 to obtain a transparent solution; and S4, drying the transparent solution obtained in the step S3, adding N, N-dimethylformamide, and diluting to obtain the fluorescent probe reagent for aniline detection. According to the invention, the fluorescent probe has good selectivity, good sensitivity and strong anti-interference capability.

title_en: Method for preparing fluxed carbon-containing low-titanium pellets by using large-particle-size iron ore powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing fluxed carbon-containing pellets by using large-particle-size iron ore powder, which is characterized in that high-iron low-silicon ferrotitanium ore powder with the particle size of 4-6 mm is used as a pelletizing core, and pelletizing is carried out twice to produce fluxed carbon-containing low-titanium pellets with double alkalinity and carbon-containing raw materials in gradient distribution on the inner layer and the outer layer of the pellets, so that the metallurgical property of the fluxed carbon-containing low-titanium pellets is improved, the iron material production range of the fluxed carbon-containing low-titanium pellets is widened, and the production cost of the pellets is reduced.

title_en: Conductive paste and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides conductive paste and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the conductive paste comprises, by weight, 55-65 parts of flake silver powder, 24-28 parts of tin-bismuth-silver alloy coated spherical silver powder, 3-9 parts of an organic binder and 2-8 parts of an organic carrier. The conductive paste provided by the invention has good conductive effect and strong adhesive force.

title_en: Cobalt-based catalyst and CO2Method for preparing CO by catalytic hydrogenation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic conversion of carbon dioxide, and particularly relates to a cobalt-based catalyst and CO adopting the cobalt-based catalyst 2 A method for preparing CO by catalytic hydrogenation. The cobalt-based catalyst comprises an SBA-15 substrate and a cobalt active center loaded on the SBA-15 substrate, wherein the cobalt active center is obtained by reducing a cobalt oxide deposition layer loaded on the SBA-15 substrate, and the cobalt oxide deposition layer is formed in an atomic layer deposition mode. The cobalt-based catalyst has better catalytic activity and stability. When the cobalt-based catalyst of the present invention is usedIn catalyzing CO 2 And the catalyst has better selectivity and stability when being used for preparing CO by hydrogenation.

title_en: Metal powder injection molding feed, metal powder injection molding method and amorphous surgical clip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal powder injection molding feed, a metal powder injection molding method and an amorphous surgical clamp. The feed comprises metal powder and a binder, wherein the metal powder comprises 60-75% of Zr, 10-15% of Cu, 10-15% of Ni and 5-10% of Al in percentage by mass. The invention designs a unique metal powder injection molding feed, and obtains an amorphous product through a metal powder injection molding process. The amorphous product has higher hardness and convenient fine processing technology due to the self property, can solve the processing problems of complex structure, tiny characteristics and the like, and ensures the consistent precision of the product.

title_en: Lightweight concrete with strong waterproof performance and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight concrete with strong waterproof performance and a production process thereof, wherein the lightweight concrete comprises the following components: water; cement; foaming agent, stone powder; anti-crack fibers; wood flour; foaming; pulverized coal slag; iron bars; grit, compare in current traditional lightweight concrete, lie in the use of foam ball among this technical scheme, wherein, the effect that the saw-dust played in lightweight concrete has very strong water absorption capacity after its thorough drying, when having who infiltrates on the lightweight concrete surface, partly water can be absorbed by dry saw-dust gradually, wherein the use of ironbar, lie in playing quick heat absorption, bear the insolateing with the concrete after, the heat that the foam ball absorbed carries out the quick transfer, avoid the too big damage that causes the concrete of foam ball inflation, and simultaneously, the ironbar can also carry out oxidation reaction when using, absorb remaining moisture in the saw-dust, conveniently carry out the work of next absorption moisture.

title_en: Reinforced hot-pressing columnar diamond composite impregnated drill bit and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced hot-pressing columnar diamond composite impregnated drill bit and a manufacturing method thereof. The diamond composite drill bit comprises a drill bit steel body, a plurality of supporting bodies arranged at the end part of the drill bit steel body, a gauge welding layer for welding the drill bit steel body and the supporting bodies, and a water gap, wherein the water gap is positioned between the adjacent supporting bodies, the gauge welding layer is positioned between the drill bit steel body and the supporting bodies, a plurality of diamond composite bodies are arranged in the supporting bodies in a two-ring or three-ring arrangement, and are distributed in the supporting bodies, and the diamond composite bodies occupy 55-80% of the area of a working bottom lip of the drill bit; the diamond composite body adopts SMD  40  diamond, and the support body adopts SMD  30  diamond. The drill bit has unique structure, high drilling specific pressure, good diamond cutting edge and long service life, and can drill in hard, compact and weakly abrasive rock stratum under the normal drilling regulation condition.

title_en: Metal magnetic particle, inductor, method for producing metal magnetic particle, and method for producing metal magnetic core
abstract_en: The present invention relates to metal magnetic particles, an inductor, a method for producing metal magnetic particles, and a method for producing a metal magnetic core. The metal magnetic particle (1) is characterized in that an oxide layer is provided on the surface of an alloy particle (10) containing Fe and Si, the oxide layer comprises a first oxide layer (20), a second oxide layer (30), a third oxide layer (40), and a fourth oxide layer from the alloy particle side, and in line analysis using scanning transmission electron microscope-energy dispersive X-ray analysis of the element content, the first oxide layer (20) is a layer having a maximum Si value, the second oxide layer (30) is a layer having a maximum Fe value, the third oxide layer (40) is a layer having a maximum Si value, and the fourth oxide layer (50) is a layer having a maximum Fe value.

title_en: Zinc powder wet-adding device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc powder wet adding device and a method, wherein the zinc powder wet adding device comprises a zinc powder wet adding device and a zinc powder wet adding device; the upper part of the size mixing tank is provided with a dust collection bag and at least one feed inlet, and the lower part of the size mixing tank is provided with a liquid outlet; the upper part of the circulating tank is provided with a first liquid inlet and a second liquid inlet, the lower part of the circulating tank is provided with a liquid outlet, the first liquid inlet of the circulating tank is connected with the liquid outlet of the size mixing tank through a first conveying system, and the liquid outlet of the circulating tank is connected with the second liquid inlet of the circulating tank through a second conveying system; and at least one liquid outlet is arranged in the second conveying system, and the at least one liquid outlet in the second conveying system is connected with the purification reaction tank for zinc hydrometallurgy. The zinc powder and water are added into a size mixing tank for centralized size mixing, then conveyed to a circulating tank and then conveyed to a purification reaction tank for zinc hydrometallurgy for use, so that the zinc powder wet addition is realized, and the problems of zinc powder flying loss and environmental pollution in the zinc powder dry addition process are solved.

title_en: Ceramic digital ink with matte carving effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ceramics, and discloses ceramic digital ink with a matte carving effect and application thereof. The digital ink with the matte carving effect consists of powder, a solvent and an auxiliary agent, wherein the powder consists of albite, wollastonite, limestone, calcined zinc oxide, quartz, corundum and high-calcium zinc-containing frit. The ceramic digital ink of some examples of the invention is particularly suitable for preparing digital mould ceramic tiles, the mould effect is good, the mould depth can reach 0.1-0.3mm, the lines are clear, particularly the turning parts are also clear, and the ceramic digital ink has an obvious matte carving effect. The ceramic digital ink of some examples of the invention has simple preparation method and low production cost, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: N, N-dialkyl amino carboxylic acid compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an N, N-dialkyl amino carboxylic acid compound and a preparation method and application thereof. The N, N-dialkyl amino carboxylic acid compound can be used as an extracting agent for enriching rare earth elements from low-concentration rare earth raw materials, separating and purifying yttrium elements from mixed rare earth raw materials, and separating elements such as aluminum, iron, radioactive thorium, radioactive uranium, actinium and the like from the mixed rare earth raw materials. The compound has simple synthesis, low cost and good chemical stability as an extractant, and can tolerate strong acid and strong alkali without decomposition.

title_en: Online monitoring device and detection method for furnace temperature of motor core heat treatment tunnel furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online monitoring device for the furnace temperature of a tunnel furnace for heat treatment of a motor iron core, which comprises a temperature measuring mechanism and a material frame for placing the motor iron core, wherein the motor iron core is placed in the material frame in a stacking mode, the temperature measuring mechanism is placed at the side part of the motor iron core, a temperature measuring contact of the temperature measuring mechanism is arranged in a stacked motor iron core or between stacked motor iron cores, the material frame with the temperature measuring mechanism and the stacked motor iron cores arranged is integrally hung on a feeding roller way of the tunnel furnace and carries out heat treatment on the motor iron cores along with the operation of the tunnel furnace, and the temperature measuring mechanism monitors the real-time temperature online. The problem of production technology among the prior art can't on-line monitoring motor core thermal treatment tunnel furnace whole section actual temperature value is solved, the accurate monitoring of the interior thermal treatment temperature of tunnel furnace has been realized, the temperature of providing guarantee for motor core thermal treatment and the stacking volume of iron core has guaranteed motor core's final performance when high-efficient production. The method also discloses an online monitoring method for the furnace temperature of the tunnel furnace for the heat treatment of the motor iron core.

title_en: Production process of automobile aluminum die casting, application of production process and production system
abstract_en: The invention provides a production process of an automobile aluminum die casting, and application and a production system thereof. The process is characterized in that after die assembly and before material injection, the charging barrel is lubricated by spraying atomized lubricating oil, after the aluminum liquid is injected, because the aluminum liquid has higher temperature, the atomized lubricating oil explodes under the high-temperature condition, the pressure in the charging barrel and the die cavity rises suddenly, and a large amount of gas is extruded out of the charging barrel and the die cavity by pressure. The invention also provides a production system for realizing the process method. The invention effectively reduces the gas content in the die casting in an explosion exhaust mode on the premise of not transforming production equipment, thereby improving the quality of the die casting.

title_en: Magnesium silicate nano powder with high specific surface area, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides magnesium silicate nano powder with a high specific surface area, a preparation method and application, and relates to the field of nano material preparation. The magnesium silicate nano powder with high specific surface area comprises the following preparation raw materials: the preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: preparing a magnesium compound solution; step two: preparing a silicide solution: step three: mixing a magnesium compound solution and a silicide solution, wherein the molar ratio of silicon to magnesium is 1: 1; step four: carrying out microwave hydrothermal treatment; step five: and separating, washing and drying to obtain the product. The chemical reaction rate is controlled by using water as a solvent and adopting a microwave hydrothermal technology, no template agent is needed, no special solution treatment or long-time high-temperature high-pressure steps are needed, high-temperature calcination is not needed, the raw material source is wide, the high-specific-surface-area magnesium silicate nano powder can be quickly and efficiently prepared under the relatively low-temperature condition, and the method is simple in process, short in time and high in efficiency.

title_en: Heat conduction pipe loop structure in mould
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loop structure of a heat conduction pipe in a mould, which comprises an upper mould and a lower mould, wherein a core is arranged in the upper mould or a convex mould of the lower mould, the core is provided with a cooling hole, the upper mould and the lower mould are respectively provided with a cooling water channel comprising a water inlet and a water outlet, a heat conduction pipe with two closed ends is arranged in the cooling hole, one end of the heat conduction pipe is a heat absorption end extending into the core cooling hole, the other end of the heat conduction pipe is a heat dissipation end extending into the cooling water channel, phase change liquid is arranged in the heat conduction pipe, the inner side wall of the heat conducting pipe is provided with a sintering layer, the mold core can transfer heat to the heat absorbing end of the heat conducting pipe, thereby make the phase transition liquid gasification in the heat absorption end, gaseous phase transition liquid flows to the heat dissipation end of heat pipe, and the cooling water cools off the heat dissipation end that stretches into the cooling water course, and the condensation of the gaseous phase transition liquid of heat dissipation end is liquid, then flows back to the heat absorption end under the capillary action of sintered layer. The invention can rapidly and effectively cool the small-sized mold core, is beneficial to improving the production efficiency and can improve the product quality.

title_en: Shifting fork surface high-frequency quenching process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shifting fork production, in particular to a shifting fork surface high-frequency quenching process, which comprises the following steps: s1, cleaning the finish-machined automobile shifting fork (1) to remove dirt on the surface; s2, clamping the cleaned automobile shifting fork (1) on a clamping table, and moving an installation plate (4) to enable a high-frequency quenching induction coil of an external high-frequency quenching device to be sleeved outside a shifting fork pin (13) of the automobile shifting fork (1), wherein the frequency of the high-frequency quenching induction coil is 250KHz, the power of the high-frequency quenching induction coil is 90-120KW, and the preheating time is 4-6 seconds; according to the invention, through the modes of preheating, high-frequency quenching and tempering at last, better quenching quality can be obtained at the fork pulling foot; through the arrangement of the positioning process hole, the fixing rod and the positioning pin, the accurate positioning of the automobile shifting fork can be realized in a mode that the positioning pin is inserted into the positioning process hole, and further the influence on the quenching quality of the high-frequency quenching induction coil due to the deviation of the position of the automobile shifting fork is avoided.

title_en: High-stability lead-free piezoelectric ceramic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-stability lead-free piezoelectric ceramic, which has the following chemical formula: (1-x-y) (0.50 KNbO  3  ‑0.50NaNbO  3  )‑xMgTiO  3  ‑yBa(Zr  0.5  Ti  0.5  )O  3  +zSm  2  O  3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Wherein x=0.03 to 0.07, y=0.04 to 0.08, and z=0.008 to 0.02. The lead-free piezoelectric ceramic adopts a preparation method of the lead-free piezoelectric ceramic which has the advantages of simple process, high efficiency, low energy consumption, low cost and high practicability, the prepared KNN-MT-BZT lead-free piezoelectric ceramic has diamond crystal grains, the average crystal grain is 3 microns, and the lead-free piezoelectric ceramic replaces the square crystal grains of the prior KNN system after sintering, and has higher density, stable property, compactness and good performance.

title_en: Ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg, ultrahigh-temperature ceramic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg, ultrahigh-temperature ceramic and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg comprises the following steps: ball-milling and mixing the raw materials of the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg with a solvent, adjusting the pH value to 7.5-9.0, controlling the viscosity value to be 200-CPS, and performing spray drying and sieving to obtain the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg, wherein the raw materials of the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg comprise the following components in parts by mass: 90.60-97.55 parts of ultrahigh-temperature ceramic powder, 1.45-6.25 parts of organic resin and 0.75-3.25 parts of carbon black. The method for preparing the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic by using the carbon-containing prepreg comprises the steps of forming the ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg, carbonizing and impregnating liquid-phase silicon, wherein the bending strength of the carbon-containing preform is more than 50MPa, and the porosity is less than 0.5%. The ultrahigh-temperature ceramic prepreg has the characteristics of long-term storage, easiness in molding, high strength of a biscuit after biscuit firing, good processing performance, large-scale production and the like, and realizes near net-size molding and rapid densification of ultrahigh-temperature ceramic.

title_en: System for utilize zinc-containing danger waste material to remove copper and improve gained sponge copper grade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for removing copper and improving the grade of obtained sponge copper by using zinc-containing hazardous waste materials, and relates to the technical field of metallurgical equipment. This utilize zinciferous danger waste material to remove copper and improve system of gained copper sponge grade, including sealed brick room, the observation window has been seted up on the front left side in sealed brick room, its characterized in that: the positive right side in sealed brick room is provided with control panel, the upside in sealed brick room is provided with first air exhauster, the left side front side in sealed brick room is provided with the second air exhauster. This utilize zinc-containing dangerous waste material to remove copper and improve system of gained copper sponge grade is provided with control panel, first material case, second thing workbin, metering device and electronic control valve, can freely adjust the input ratio of control zinc-containing waste material and iron fillings, is convenient for change zinc-containing waste material and iron fillings input ratio control copper sponge grade is stable at higher level, can throw the material automatically, reduces the human input.

title_en: Antique iron crude pottery fired by oxidizing flame and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antique iron crude pottery fired by oxidizing flame and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise the following components in parts by weight: iron ore slag, Longyan soil, white porcelain clay, coffee porcelain clay, grey porcelain clay and albite tailings; in the antique iron crude pottery, the weight content of silicon dioxide is 68-71%, the weight content of aluminum oxide is 19-21%, the weight content of ferric oxide is 3.8-4.2%, the weight content of titanium oxide is 0.5-1.0%, the weight content of potassium oxide is 1.5-2.0%, the weight content of sodium oxide is 2.5-3.0%, the weight content of calcium oxide is 0.5-1.0%, and the weight content of magnesium oxide is 0.5-1.0%; the invention has low production cost, good thermal stability and stable chromatic value, and fills the gap that the gray crude pottery is prepared by firing the iron pottery clay in an oxidizing atmosphere.

title_en: Support casting adopting V-method casting process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a support casting adopting a V-method casting process, which comprises single casting bodies, wherein one side of each casting body is a lug end, the other side of each casting body is a positioning end, the support casting comprises an open riser, a blind riser, a heating core, a first sand core and a second sand core, the two casting bodies are provided with two groups, the positioning ends of the two groups of casting bodies are oppositely arranged, the second sand core is arranged between the two groups of casting bodies and used for separating the two groups of casting bodies, the open riser is arranged at the top of the second sand core and covers the upper end surfaces of the two groups of casting bodies, the blind riser is arranged at the lug end of each casting body, the top end of the blind riser is provided with a blind hole, the heating core is arranged in the blind hole, and the first sand core is connected with the casting bodies to form a cavity of the casting bodies. The bracket casting adopts a structure form that the positioning ends of two casting monomers are commonly used as an open riser, the lug end is designed as a blind riser, and meanwhile, a heating core is designed at the blind riser, so that the feeding efficiency of the blind riser can be further improved.

title_en: Au/Ga2O3/AuGa2Multiphase composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides Au/Ga 2 O 3 /AuGa 2 The preparation method of the multiphase composite material comprises the following steps: adding liquid metal gallium into chloroauric acid solution, performing ultrasonic treatment, centrifuging, and drying to obtain Au/GaOOH/AuGa 2 A composite material; the obtained Au/GaOOH/AuGa is then used 2 The composite material is annealed to obtain Au/Ga 2 O 3 /AuGa 2 A multiphase composite material. The multiphase composite material prepared by the invention has remarkable antibacterial activity on escherichia coli and staphylococcus aureus. The preparation method has low cost, is simple and quick, and can directly realize Ga in the ultrasonic process 2 O 3 And the synthesis of Ga alloy provides a new thought for synthesizing gallium oxide based compound, and the method of the invention has high universality and can be used for synthesizing other liquid metal oxides and liquid metal alloy.

title_en: Preparation method and application of antimony sulfide nanorod
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an antimony sulfide nano rod. Dissolving an antimony source into an absolute ethyl alcohol beaker with a certain volume by taking absolute ethyl alcohol and oleylamine as solvents, carrying out ultrasonic stirring for a few minutes, adding a sulfur source after the antimony source is uniformly dissolved, stirring on a magnetic stirrer for 0.5h until the antimony source is completely dissolved, finally adding oleylamine solution into the mixed solution, continuously stirring for 0.5h, pouring the mixed solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle for reaction, cooling to room temperature, respectively centrifuging for three times by using cyclohexane and glacial acetic acid, and drying the obtained black precipitate in a drying box to prepare the uniform ladder sulfide nanorod. The method has the advantages of simple equipment, simple experimental operation, short production period, good particle dispersibility, low cost and easy industrial production, and provides a preparation method for solving the problems of obvious volume effect, poor electric conductivity and the like of the cathode material of the sodium ion battery, thereby effectively improving the electrochemical performance of the electrode material.

title_en: Carbon-coated nickel-manganese binary cobalt-free positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon-coated nickel-manganese binary cobalt-free cathode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out solvothermal reaction on an ion replacement matrix, graphene and a solvent, wherein the ion replacement matrix adopts a general formula MO n Or M (OH) n Obtaining a solution containing a hydroxide/graphene composite material, K of the hydroxide sp Is (1 × 10) ‑40 )～(1×10 ‑11 ) Wherein M is selected from the group consisting of group IIA, group IIIA, group IVA, group IIIB, group IVB, group VIB, group VIIB or group VIII, and n is 2-4; and carrying out ion exchange on the nickel-manganese binary cobalt-free positive electrode material and a solution containing the hydroxide/graphene composite material to obtain the carbon-coated nickel-manganese binary cobalt-free positive electrode material. By adopting the preparation method, a compact and stable carbon coating layer can be formed on the surface of the nickel-manganese binary cobalt-free anode material.

title_en: Preparation method of low-expansion-coefficient direct twistless roving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of direct twistless roving with a low expansion coefficient, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic non-metallic materials. The preparation method of the low-expansion coefficient direct twistless roving comprises the following steps: weighing raw materials according to a proportion, putting the raw materials into a glass melting furnace, carrying out vitrification and melting treatment, then carrying out spinning forming to obtain glass fibers, coating a sizing agent after cooling, then winding the glass fibers into low-expansion-coefficient direct twistless roving by a direct twistless roving drawing machine, and drying the twistless roving. According to the invention, through the limitation of the glass fiber raw material and the limitation of the components of the coated impregnating compound, the direct twistless roving with low expansion coefficient, high breaking strength and bending strength of the pultruded bar and low hairiness can be successfully obtained.

title_en: Preparation method of full mold casting lost foam plate material mixed with STMMA beads and EPS beads
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a full-mold casting lost foam plate material mixed with STMMA beads and EPS beads, and relates to the technical field of lost foam plate material preparation. The invention comprises prefoaming, drying and curing, molding and drying; the pre-foaming comprises the following steps: flushing steam into an intermittent pre-foaming machine for preheating, uniformly stirring mixed beads by a stirring rod of pre-foaming equipment, reducing pressure in a pre-foaming barrel, opening a material door for discharging, passing through a fluidized drying bed, and conveying the mixture to a curing bin; and (3) separately putting the EPS beads and the STMMA beads into a preheated batch type pre-foaming machine, respectively carrying out pre-foaming in the steps, and mixing in a vulcanization drying bed after the pre-foaming is finished. The lost foam material produced by the process method has the advantages of high density and strength, good bending resistance, difficult deformation, high overall gasification rate, less gasification residues, difficult slag inclusion of castings, good overall stability and good quality, and has good market popularization and application prospects.

title_en: Method for growing gold nanoflowers with sharp tips by using metal film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for growing gold nanoflowers with sharp tips by utilizing a metal film. The invention directly utilizes the macroscopic visible metal film to synthesize the nano-particles with the microscopic scale, the method has simple and rapid operation and low requirements on synthesis conditions, and the method can be carried out at normal temperature. The obtained gold nanoflowers have sharp tips on the surfaces, good dispersibility, stable chemical properties, strong absorption and surface plasmon resonance in the range from visible light to near infrared. The method has the advantage of improving the efficiency of surface enhanced Raman scattering, and a single particle can be used for detecting molecular Raman signals.

title_en: Cementing material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cementing material. The cementing material comprises the following components: composite micro powder, an excitant and a water reducing agent; the composite micro powder comprises steel slag, water-quenched slag and casting residue. The composite micro powder prepared by mixing the steel slag, the water-quenched slag and the casting residues realizes the component complementation of active mineral phases, and can directionally form a target product by selecting a proper excitation system, thereby improving the strength and the stability of the cementing material.

title_en: Inorganic fire prevention and extinguishing filling material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inorganic fire prevention and extinguishing filling material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the inorganic fire prevention and extinguishing filling material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: mixing materials: water: 20-50 parts of cement: 30-80 parts of fly ash: 20-70 parts of an accelerator: 0.5-5 parts; 0.2-10 parts of a water reducing agent; foam liquid: foaming agent: 0.2-5 parts of water: 20-50 parts. The inorganic foaming material prepared by the invention has the functions of fire extinguishing inhibition and filling, and is used for controlling and filling fire in the coal mine goaf. The filling plugging material plays a critical role in the fire zone treatment process, on one hand, the material filling performance can be utilized to wrap the fire-catching object, on the other hand, the coal body in the goaf is isolated from being contacted with oxygen through foaming plugging, the treatment effect is consolidated, and the re-combustion is prevented. The method is suitable for solving the goaf fire area treatment and filling engineering of vast mine enterprises.

title_en: Deep undercooling rapid solidification method for preparing pyrochlore structure Bi2Ti2O7Method for producing ceramic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing pyrochlore structure Bi by a deep undercooling rapid solidification method 2 Ti 2 O 7 A method of making a ceramic, comprising the steps of: mixing a bismuth source and a titanium source, grinding into powder, pressing into a green body, performing heat treatment to obtain a sample, placing the sample in a suspension container, continuously introducing Ar gas into the bottom of the suspension container to suspend the sample in the Ar gas, and then using CO to suspend the sample in the Ar gas 2 Heating the sample to be melted by a laser, stopping heating after the melted sample is suspended and stabilized in Ar gas, and cooling to obtain the pyrochlore structure Bi 2 Ti 2 O 7 The method has simple process, no by-product, good repeatability and the prepared pyrochlore structure Bi 2 Ti 2 O 7 The block material has high purity, and the proportion range of the preparation raw material proportion is wide, and is not limited to single proportion.

title_en: Oxide ceramic electrolyte membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an oxide ceramic electrolyte membrane, which comprises the following steps: mixing solid electrolyte powder, a binder solution, a plasticizer, a dispersant solution and a solvent in proportion to obtain casting slurry; and carrying out tape casting on the tape casting slurry, carrying out low-temperature rubber discharge, and carrying out high-temperature sintering to obtain a finished product. Wherein the casting slurry comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of solid electrolyte powder, 5-25 parts of binder solution, 0.5-2 parts of plasticizer, 1-10 parts of dispersant solution and 10-40 parts of first solvent. Correspondingly, the invention also provides an oxide ceramic electrolyte membrane, the preparation method has simple process, and the obtained oxide ceramic electrolyte membrane has thin thickness and high ionic conductivity and is suitable for multi-scale and multi-shape processing.

title_en: Speed reducer with rotatably mounted toothed element and method for producing a speed reducer with toothed element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reduction gear having a rotatably mounted toothed part and to a method for producing a reduction gear having a toothed part, wherein the toothed part has a bearing receptacle and a toothed part, wherein the toothed part, in particular together with the toothed part, is produced from sintered metal powder, in particular wherein the toothed part is designed in one piece, in particular in one piece.

title_en: Medical carbon rod outer tube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical carbon rod outer tube and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing carbon black and coal tar low-temperature asphalt, heating to 220 ℃ or higher, uniformly stirring, and then pressing into cakes for roasting; crushing the roasted material in the first step, mixing the crushed material with ultra-high power graphite powder, and grinding into powder with the particle size of 200-250 meshes; mixing the ground powder with coal tar high-temperature asphalt, uniformly stirring, then making a cake, and pressing into a hollow carbon rod blank; and fourthly, dipping wax at two ends of the carbon rod blank, and roasting the carbon rod to obtain the medical carbon rod outer tube. The medical carbon rod outer tube has the advantages of good appearance smoothness, good dimensional stability, less product impurities, long combustion time, stable heating and luminescence, good treatment effect and high strength.

title_en: Copper-containing graphite composite coating, insulator sliding rail and preparation method of copper-containing graphite composite coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper-containing graphite composite coating, an insulator sliding rail and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of copper coatings. The copper-containing graphite composite coating is prepared by depositing preparation raw materials by a supersonic low-temperature flame solid particle deposition method; the preparation raw materials comprise copper-based material powder and graphite powder. By carrying out deposition in the above way, the preparation temperature is low, the period is short, the cost is low, the efficiency is high, and graphite can be uniformly dispersed in the copper-based composite coating on the premise of not changing the structure performance. Compared with other coating preparation technologies, the obtained copper-based coating has low oxygen content, high bonding strength and high conductivity. The graphite component in the preparation raw material can be completely retained in the coating, and the preparation process can not be oxidized and volatilized. The self-lubricating advantages of the related conductive coatings are obvious, graphite particles can fall off in the process of high-speed friction of the insulator sliding rail with the composite coating, a graphite lubricating film with high lubricity is formed between friction pairs, and the effect of reducing friction is achieved.

title_en: Anti-seismic twisted steel based on crystal optimization and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-seismic twisted steel based on crystal optimization and a production process thereof, wherein the ratio of steel bar materials is as follows: 0.26-0.36% of C, Si: 1.5-1.7%, Mn: 0.7-1.0 percent of V, 0.08-0.15 percent of V, less than or equal to 0.045 percent of P, less than or equal to 0.045 percent of S, less than 0.10 percent of niobium and titanium, and the balance of Fe; the percentage is mass percent, the QTB water treatment technology is adopted, so that the yield strength and the extensibility of the steel bar are higher, the tensile strength of the steel bar is greatly improved, and the anti-seismic effect is achieved.

title_en: Composite metal oxide, preparation method and application thereof, and iodine removal method
abstract_en: Composite metal oxide, preparation method and application thereof, and iodine removal method, wherein the composite metal oxide is Bi 2 O 3 And MnO with MnO 2 The composite metal oxide of (1); the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing an oxidant with manganeseDissolving the precursor compound in water to obtain solution A; dissolving a precursor compound of bismuth in water to obtain a solution B; mixing the solution A and the solution B, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction; after the hydrothermal reaction is finished, separating the product from the reaction solution, washing and drying to obtain Bi 2 O 3 And MnO with MnO 2 The composite metal oxide of (3). The composite metal oxide can effectively remove iodide ions in iodine-containing water, has a good iodine removal effect, has in-situ ultraviolet light/visible light catalytic oxidation regeneration capacity, is easy to regenerate, and reduces the iodine removal cost.

title_en: Method for separating transition metal from waste positive electrode material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for separating a transition metal from a waste positive electrode material, wherein the method comprises: step 1: preparing a waste positive electrode material represented by formula 1; step 2: heat-treating the waste positive electrode material in an inert gas atmosphere or an oxygen atmosphere to phase-separate the waste positive electrode material into lithium oxide and metal oxide; and step 3: cooling the product obtained in the step 2 to room temperature in an inert atmosphere; and step 4: the cooled product cooled to room temperature in step 3 is mixed with distilled water, and then the mixture is filtered to leach out the transition metal.

title_en: Process for treating wastewater from disperse dye production and recycling salt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for treating wastewater from disperse dye production and recycling salt resources, which comprises the following steps: q1: and (3) neutralization treatment: generating sodium sulfate; q2: ECO subcritical water catalytic oxidation: macromolecular organic matters are degraded into micromolecular organic matters, acidic substances and CO under the action of catalyst 2 Water; q3: gas-liquid separation: performing coarse filtration by a gas-liquid separator to obtain residual oxidizing liquid; q4: freezing and crystallizing: freezing the oxidizing solution to obtain sodium sulfate decahydrate; q5: concentrating and separating by using a nanofiltration membrane: circularly concentrating the oxidizing solution until the total recovery rate of the sodium sulfate decahydrate is 90-99.9%; q6: and (3) biochemical treatment: recovering sodium formate salt or formic acid, and treating until reaching discharge standard. The whole process can recover the salt and the organic solvent in the disperse dye production wastewater to achieve the maximum recyclingThe method achieves the aim of zero discharge of wastewater, can shorten a process treatment route, reduce the operation cost and the actual operation difficulty, and has outstanding substantive characteristics and remarkable progress.

title_en: Casing pipe forming process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a casing forming process in the technical field of casing forming, which comprises the steps of preprocessing a mould, and sticking aluminum silicate fiber paper on a core mould; cutting the high silica fiber mesh cloth; preparing 140 materials and stirring the materials into 140 material slurry; placing the core mold on an auxiliary tool, rotating the core mold, winding the grid cloth in multiple layers, and coating 140 material slurry among the layers; curing and removing the core mold; turning; sintering; spraying NB coating to form a coating, and naturally drying to obtain a finished product. The invention has reasonable forming process and simple operation, and is convenient for production; the produced sleeve has higher breaking strength and thermal shock resistance, does not crack in the aluminum alloy bar casting process, and is ensured not to be corroded by aluminum liquid because aluminum materials are filled between the grid cloth layers of the sleeve, thereby having very long service life.

title_en: Recovery method of nickel cobalt lithium manganate and lithium iron phosphate mixed waste
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery method of nickel cobalt lithium manganate and lithium iron phosphate mixed waste, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out resin adsorption separation on a nickel cobalt manganese phosphorus lithium pickle liquor obtained by acid leaching, and washing with sulfuric acid to obtain a nickel cobalt manganese sulfate mixed liquor, wherein the mixed liquor can be subjected to precipitation to obtain a nickel cobalt lithium manganate positive electrode material precursor, the obtained phosphorus iron lithium solution can be subjected to lithium precipitation to obtain lithium salt precipitation, concentrating the precipitation liquid, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain an iron phosphate/carbon material. The process can comprehensively recycle the mixed waste of the nickel cobalt lithium manganate and the lithium iron phosphate, can realize the directional circulation of the waste nickel cobalt lithium manganate material and the lithium iron phosphate material, can reduce the agglomeration phenomenon of the material by preparing the iron phosphate through an electrostatic spinning method, and can improve the specific surface area of the material by adopting a fiber network structure.

title_en: Brake casting, die-casting die and die-casting process thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stopper foundry goods production technical field, in particular to stopper foundry goods and die casting die and die casting technology thereof, through forming the heavy groove structure on the stopper foundry goods, make the whole thickness of stopper foundry goods tend to the equilibrium, prevent the local deformation of foundry goods, simultaneously through designing organ formula distribution, and narrow and dark bar cell body, it is more abundant to make the die cavity exhaust, reduce the gas pocket in the stopper product, prevent the inside production gas pocket of stopper, realize drawing empty the effect of subtracts the material through designing the bar cell body, improve the die-casting shaping quality of stopper. Set up the evacuation structure on die casting die, realize controlling the filling chronogenesis of foundry goods through the mode of control into gluey position and evacuation, guarantee the plumpness of foundry goods, the bubble content in the finished product foundry goods that significantly reduces simultaneously satisfies the high-quality demand of product. Through a proper die-casting process, the qualification rate of die-casting forming of the casting is ensured, and the requirement of high-quality production is met.

title_en: Aluminum alloy powder material for SLM (selective laser deposition) and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum alloy powder material for SLM, a preparation method and an application method thereof, wherein the aluminum alloy powder material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: si:6.5-7.5%; mg:1.2-1.5%; tiB (TiB)  2  :2.5-5.0%; the balance being Al and unavoidable impurities. According to the aluminum alloy powder material for the SLM, the preparation method and the application method thereof, the aluminum alloy powder material is used for processing the metal parts with excellent mechanical properties such as yield strength, tensile strength, elastic modulus or elongation and the like, and the preparation difficulty of the aluminum alloy powder material is relatively low.

title_en: Low-temperature casting preparation method and application of Al-Ta intermediate alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal materials, in particular to a low-temperature casting preparation method and application of an Al-Ta intermediate alloy, wherein the alloy consists of the following components in parts by weight: 2-20 wt.% of Ta, the balance being Al. In casting aluminum-silicon alloy, the intermediate alloy can refine alpha-Al and eutectic silicon in the casting aluminum-silicon alloy. The method mainly comprises the following steps: the Al-Ta intermediate alloy has refining effect on alpha-Al and eutectic silicon, and has simple and convenient preparation method, better refining and modification effect and good application prospect.

title_en: Flexible metal powder spreading device for additive manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal powder flexible spreading device for additive manufacturing, which comprises a storage shell, a dispersing and conveying cavity, a connecting seat, a guide groove, a rotating body, a groove, a linkage assembly and the like; the invention has the advantages of reasonable and simple structure, low production cost and convenient installation, the first motor can drive the roll shaft and the rotating body to rotate, the rotating body drives the sliding plate to integrally vibrate left and right through the groove and the linkage assembly, so that metal powder in the storage shell enters all the dispersing grooves and uniformly falls after being screened through the sieve plate, the roll shaft and the strip body can uniformly throw the falling metal powder onto the conveying belt through rotation, the subsequent spreading uniformity is ensured, and the loss of the metal powder is avoided; the spreading mechanism provided by the invention can uniformly convey the metal powder to the spreading position for spreading through the conveying belt, and in addition, the continuous supply of the metal powder is not influenced, so that the defect of the metal powder in spreading is avoided.

title_en: Method for treating concentrated mother liquor of O, O' -dimethyl thiophosphoryl chloride
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of environmental protection, and in particular relates to a method for treating concentrated mother liquor of O, O' -dimethyl thiophosphoryl chloride. The processing method comprises the following steps: (1) contacting the mother liquor with oxygen in the presence of a catalyst to perform catalytic wet oxidation to obtain an oxidation solution; (2) freezing and crystallizing the oxidation solution, and performing first solid-liquid separation to obtain a first solid phase and a first liquid phase; (3) recrystallizing the first solid phase, and carrying out second solid-liquid separation to obtain a second solid phase and a second liquid phase; in the step (1), the mother liquor is contacted with oxygen in the following manner: relative to 1L of mother liquor, oxygen is continuously introduced at a flow rate of 30-60L/h. The method is simple to operate, can treat the O, O' -dimethyl thiophosphoryl chloride mother liquor with high COD, high phosphorus and high salt, realizes the recycling of phosphorus resources, and solves the problem that the engineering application is restricted by corrosion of equipment materials and the like in the engineering process.

title_en: Method for preparing carbon composite lithium ferrous silicate by ilmenite based on sol-gel method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries and manufacturing thereof, and provides a sol-gel method-based method for utilizing ilmenite (FeTiO) 3 ) Preparation of polyanionic anode material carbon composite lithium ferrous silicate (Li) for lithium ion battery 2 FeSiO 4 The preparation method of the compound is shown in the specification. The method comprises the steps of crushing ilmenite, adding hydrochloric acid for extraction, and obtaining leaching solution rich in iron ions; adding excessive oxalic acid into the leaching solution to obtain a precipitate, heating and boiling the precipitate until the precipitate is dried to obtain a ferrous oxalate precursor; adding lithium source, silicon source and carbon source, and heating reflux solAnd preparing a gel precursor by a gel method, drying, and sintering in a protective atmosphere to obtain the carbon composite lithium ferrous silicate material. Ilmenite is an iron source rich in ferrous ions, has rich and cheap sources, and is simple in sol-gel preparation process and low in cost.

title_en: ZSM-5/beta core-shell molecular sieve and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic material synthesis, and relates to a ZSM-5/beta core-shell molecular sieve, a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein the ratio of 2 theta=22.4 DEG peak height to 2 theta=23.1 DEG peak height in an X-ray diffraction spectrogram of the ZSM-5/beta core-shell molecular sieve is 0.1-10:1. The synthesis method of the ZSM-5/beta core-shell molecular sieve comprises the following steps: (1) Contacting ZSM-5 molecular sieve with surfactant solution to obtain ZSM-5 molecular sieve I; (2) Contacting ZSM-5 molecular sieve I with slurry containing beta zeolite to obtain ZSM-5 molecular sieve II; (3) Crystallizing the synthetic solution containing the silicon source, the aluminum source, the template agent and the deionized water at 50-300 ℃ for 4-100h to obtain synthetic solution III; (4) And mixing the ZSM-5 molecular sieve II with the synthetic solution III, and crystallizing. The ZSM-5/beta core-shell molecular sieve has good catalytic performance.

title_en: Glass composition, glass, preparation method of glass and method for judging thermal shock temperature of glass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of glass and glass detection, and discloses a glass composition, glass, a preparation method of the glass and a method for judging the thermal shock temperature of the glass. The glass composition contains the following components which are stored independently or in a mixture of more than two of the components: siO 2  2  、Al  2  O  3  、Na  2  O、K  2  O、MgO、CaO、MoO  2  、SnO  2  (ii) a The glass prepared from the composition has the advantages of high strength, proper strain temperature and expansion coefficient, low melting temperature, good clarification effect, high visible light transmittance, suitability for being used as solar photovoltaic glass, photothermal glass and the like, can be used as protective glass after being strengthened, has excellent impact resistance, and can effectively prevent the impact on the surface of the glass.

title_en: High-temperature thermal stress crack resistant material, crystallizer copper plate and meniscus treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal surface treatment processes, and provides a high-temperature thermal stress crack resistant material, a crystallizer copper plate and a meniscus treatment method, wherein the alloy material comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 0.02 to 0.2 percent of chromium, 0.01 to 0.06 percent of zirconium, 0.2 to 0.6 percent of silver, 0.01 to 0.015 percent of iridium dioxide and the balance of copper. The method for treating the meniscus of the copper plate of the chromium-zirconium-copper crystallizer of the continuous casting machine comprises cutting, flaw detection, laser 3D printing and cutting, so that the high-temperature thermal stress crack resistant material is printed on the meniscus of the copper plate of the chromium-zirconium-copper crystallizer of the continuous casting machine through laser, and the copper plate of the chromium-zirconium-copper crystallizer of the continuous casting machine with the meniscus having a high-temperature thermal stress crack resistant layer is obtained. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the performance of the integrally cast crystallizer copper plate at the meniscus position in the prior art is not enough to meet the requirement of high-temperature thermal stress crack resistance and the service life of the crystallizer copper plate is influenced is solved.

title_en: Al-Si-Mg-Cu-Sc-Zr-Sr casting alloy and preparation and heat treatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Al-Si-Mg-Cu-Sc-Zr-Sr casting alloy, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 8.0 to 12.0 percent of Si; 0.4 to 1.0 percent of Mg; 0.8 to 2.4 percent of Cu; sc, 0.15% -0.35%; 0.1 to 0.25 percent of Zr; 0.05 to 0.2 percent of Sr; the balance being aluminum. The preparation method comprises the steps of material preparation, melting, silicon element, strontium element, zirconium element, scandium element and copper element addition, refining degassing, magnesium element addition, pouring, solid solution treatment and aging treatment. The invention greatly improves the room temperature strength, elongation, pressure resistance and corrosion resistance of the aluminum-silicon cast alloy, has obvious silicon phase modification, grain refinement and heat treatment strengthening effects, and has strong feasibility of the preparation method and simple operation process.

title_en: Gantry type double-station differential pressure casting main machine major component conveying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gantry type double-station-difference pressure casting host heavy component conveying device, which comprises a left upright post, a right upright post, a fixed cross beam and a horizontal feeding mechanism, wherein the left upright post, the right upright post and the fixed cross beam form a pair of gantry frames in a bolt fixed connection mode, the gantry frames are divided into an upper tank and a sand mold two areas, namely two stations, which are respectively used for conveying a sand mold and the upper tank, and sand mold stations can complete the grabbing, lifting and separating actions of the sand mold, and specifically comprise a U-shaped movable beam, a left side pin inserting and pulling mechanism, a right side pin inserting and pulling mechanism, a sand mold vertical lifting mechanism and a sand mold safe pin inserting and pulling mechanism; the device for conveying the upper tank does not need to separate the upper tank from the gantry and comprises an upper tank vertical lifting mechanism, an upper tank safety plug pin mechanism and the like; the gantry conveying device can simultaneously complete the actions of conveying sand molds and loading the sand molds in the horizontal and horizontal directions and the vertical directions and horizontally and longitudinally grabbing the sand molds, and adopts the layout of one gantry double station to ensure that the equipment is compact and the occupied space of the equipment is saved.

title_en: Functionally graded material gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functionally graded material gear, and belongs to the technical field of gear manufacturing. The functional gradient material structure gear sequentially comprises a core part, a gradient part and a tooth part from inside to outside, wherein the gradient part is connected between the core part and the tooth part to play a role in reducing component difference at two sides of the gear; the components of the core part and the tooth part are designed in a gradient way; the toughness of the core part, the gradient part and the tooth part is weakened in sequence, and the hardness of the core part, the gradient part and the tooth part (3) is enhanced in sequence. According to the invention, through the design of the materials of the tooth part, the gradient part and the core part, the production cost of the gear is reduced, the performance of the gear is improved, and the problem of interface mismatching such as interface cracking and bending deformation caused by large component difference at two sides of the gear is solved through the design of the gradient part.

title_en: Preparation method and application of four-component SiHfBC polymer ceramic precursor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a four-component SiHfBC polymer ceramic precursor, relates to the field of organic high polymer materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a ceramic precursor. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the oxygen content of the prior multi-component ceramic precursor is too high. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving hafnium tetrachloride in a tetrahydrofuran solvent to prepare a precursor solution; adding methyl vinyl dichlorosilane and borane dimethylsulfide for reaction; heating to carry out crosslinking reaction; and (5) curing treatment. And pyrolyzing the four-component SiHfBC polymer ceramic precursor to prepare the SiHfBC polymer ceramic.
