The reaction process of the invention can effectively adjust the structure of the SiHfBC polymer ceramic precursor and ensure the uniformity of element distribution in the precursor. Micromolecules are removed through a curing reaction to form a high polymer, and finally the SiHfBC polymer ceramic with stable covalent bond connection is formed through pyrolysis. The method is used for preparing the SiHfBC polymer ceramic.

title_en: Porous disc-shaped lithium manganate electrode for extracting lithium from salt lake and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a porous disc-shaped lithium manganate electrode for extracting lithium from a salt lake and a preparation method thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: adding acetylacetone into manganese salt water solution, and then adding polyvinylpyrrolidone to form transparent solution;adding hydrazine hydrate under stirring to form yellow precipitate, and centrifuging and drying the precipitate to obtain yellow precursor; calcining the obtained precursor in air to obtain Mn  5  O  8  Mn is then added to  5  O  8  Mixing with lithium salt, calcining at high temperature by using a temperature-controlled muffle furnace, and naturally cooling to obtain the porous disc-shaped lithium manganate. The porous disc-shaped lithium manganate electrode has high selectivity to lithium ions and large adsorption capacity, and can be used for extracting lithium from electrochemical salt lakes.

title_en: Preparation method of inorganic fiber density board
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inorganic fiber density board and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the mineral wool fiber board comprises mineral wool fibers, a binder, a water repellent and silane, wherein the inorganic fiber density board comprises the following components in parts by weight: 85-95 parts of rock-mineral cotton fiber, 8-12 parts of binder, 1-3 parts of water repellent and 1-3 parts of silane, wherein the rock-mineral cotton fiber comprises the following components in parts by weight: the mineral wool fiber comprises basalt, slag, limestone, a water repellent and silane, wherein the mineral wool fiber comprises the following components in parts by mass: 35-42 parts of basalt, 15-25 parts of slag, 4-6 parts of limestone, 1-3 parts of a water repellent and 1-3 parts of silane. When the fireproof and waterproof composite board is used, compared with the traditional fiber density board, the rock mineral wool fiber is used as the main material of the fiber density board, so that the fiber density board has good fireproof performance, moisture-proof and waterproof performance, mildew-proof and antibacterial performance and heat-insulating performance, the raw materials can be recovered by 100%, the production raw materials are easy to obtain, the ecology is not damaged, meanwhile, the subsequent processing of the board is simple, and the use is very convenient.

title_en: Optical glass and optical element
abstract_en: The present invention provides an optical glass having a temperature coefficient of refractive index dn/dT of less than 0 DEG C ‑1 And a fluorophosphate glass having a glass transition temperature Tg of 550 ℃ or lower and an Abbe number vd of less than 50.

title_en: ZG25CrNiMoA alloy steel and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: A ZG25CrNiMoA alloy steel and a preparation process thereof belong to the technical field of heat treatment and solve the technical problem of hardenability of the ZG25CrNiMoA alloy steel, wherein the content of each chemical element in the alloy is optimized in the ZG25CrNiMoA alloy steel, particularly, the content of aluminum element is strictly controlled, an alloy steel ingot is prepared by preparing an equivalent round sand mold, smelting steel liquid, casting, unpacking and removing a casting head, the alloy steel ingot is subjected to heat treatment through four processes of high-temperature diffusion annealing, normalizing, quenching and tempering, the tensile strength, the yield strength, the elongation and the section shrinkage rate of the ZG25CrNiMoA alloy steel after heat treatment are remarkably improved, and the hardenability is remarkably improved, so that the core part and the surface of a casting part with the thickness of below 140mm can meet the requirements of technical standards through the method.

title_en: Filling device and filling method for cooling tower in potassium nitrate production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling tower filling device and a filling method for potassium nitrate production, and relates to the technical field related to cooling tower filling devices. Through the cooperation use between above each device, can promote the liquefaction rate of water distillation process, promote distilled water preparation efficiency to can make distilled water's preparation stable going on.

title_en: Fluorine spraying device for glass bottle production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine spraying device for glass bottle production, which comprises a storage seat, a storage tank and a spreading plate, wherein the storage tank and the spreading plate are respectively arranged above the storage seat; the side view of two oblique baffles is circular-arcly, locate to the edge slope by putting thing seat center and reduce gradually, locate to install the filling tube that is used for adding the material in storage tank top surface center, storage tank bottom surface with put thing seat top surface welded fastening, the both ends downwardly extending of storage tank and with put two relative side laminating of thing seat, install the suction pump on the storage tank, the center department of putting thing seat bottom surface installs the shower nozzle of being connected with the suction pump, take out the fluorine material in the storage tank through the suction pump work and spray on the flitch through the shower nozzle, the both sides of flitch top surface form the upper slope of two relative weighings. The fluorine spraying device for producing the glass bottle solves the problems that in the prior art, the coating at the center is more and thicker, and the coating at the edge is less and thinner.

title_en: Carbon material and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a carbon material and application thereof, wherein the carbon material comprises a plurality of stacked carbon atom layers, the interlayer rotating stacking proportion of the plurality of stacked carbon atom layers in the carbon material is more than or equal to 20%, and the in-plane thermal diffusion coefficient of the carbon material is more than or equal to 750mm  2  And s. The carbon material of the embodiment of the application has the advantages that the interlayer rotating stacking ratio of the carbon atom layers is controlled to be more than or equal to 20% through a specific process, so that the carbon material has a high in-plane heat diffusion coefficient, and the heat dissipation requirement of high-heat-flux equipment can be met. The application also provides electronic equipment, a heat dissipation module, a battery system and a semiconductor structure comprising the carbon material.

title_en: Imitation ceramic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ceramic-like material and a preparation method and application thereof. Based on the total weight of the ceramic-like material, the ceramic-like material comprises 30-60 parts by weight of alumina, 5-20 parts by weight of silica, 5-20 parts by weight of zirconia and 20-30 parts by weight of organic polymer material. The ceramic-like material is easy to process and injection-molded, does not need high-temperature sintering, reduces the production cost, and has high strength, high impact resistance and ceramic texture.

title_en: Aluminum discharging ladle device with inlet and outlet of ejector connected in rapid assembling and disassembling mode
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrolytic aluminum production, in particular to an aluminum discharging ladle device with an ejector inlet and an ejector outlet connected in a rapid assembling and disassembling way; the vacuum ladle comprises a vacuum ladle and an ejector arranged at the top of the vacuum ladle, wherein an ejector air inlet pipe and an exhaust pipe are arranged on the ejector, a vacuum gas inlet pipe is arranged on the ejector air inlet pipe, a conical joint is arranged on the vacuum gas inlet pipe, a joint rubber pipe is connected and arranged on the conical joint, a second quick joint is arranged at the tail end of the joint rubber pipe, a bent pipe is connected onto the second quick joint, a first quick joint is arranged at the tail end of the bent pipe, and the first quick joint is connected with a compressed air rubber pipe joint; the operation is nimble, the leakproofness is good, can dismantle fast, need not the ladder operation of stepping on the package again, only need in compressed air joint department insert the tuber pipe quick-operation joint can.

title_en: Vehicle with fuel enrichment
abstract_en: To power the vehicle, a high energy density fuel is preferred. However, such fuels can be hazardous to handle, for example, when the high energy fuel is a high concentration of hydrogen peroxide; especially when the person handling the fuel is a normal consumer filling the fuel reservoir of his vehicle at a filling station. The present invention therefore provides a vehicle arranged to receive dilute, and therefore safer, fuel and enrich such fuel to a low amount of concentrated fuel on board the vehicle for direct use. To this end, a fuel enricher is provided in a vehicle arranged to receive liquid diluted fuel and arranged to provide a concentrated fuel based on the diluted fuel, the concentrated fuel having a higher energy density than the diluted fuel. A power conversion module of the vehicle is arranged to convert the enriched fuel into kinetic energy for powering the vehicle.

title_en: Production line for producing concrete from construction waste
abstract_en: The invention provides a production line for producing concrete from construction waste, and belongs to the technical field of machinery. The method solves the problems that the building waste treatment production line has low treatment efficiency and can not treat the building waste into directly used concrete. This production line of concrete is made to construction waste, including the feed bin that sets gradually, the batcher, jaw breaker, central feed bin, the reaction crusher, shale shaker one, shale shaker two, the system sand machine, sand washer, the concrete mixing plant, a plurality of not unidimensional grit can be sorted out respectively to shale shaker one and shale shaker two with the grit after smashing and export through corresponding the output tape, sand washer links to each other with one of them output tape, the concrete mixing plant includes a plurality of storage silos, conveyer belt and mixer, the equal design weighing scale of downside of storage silo, the conveyer belt links to each other with the feed inlet of mixer. This production line that building rubbish made concrete has can directly make building rubbish concrete and production efficiency height, safe environmental protection's advantage.

title_en: Self-supporting porous dendritic graphite foam, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of self-supporting porous dendritic graphite foam, which comprises the steps of firstly growing Ni-Cu alloy dendritic branches on foam nickel by an electrochemical deposition method, and then growing graphite on a metal semi-finished product by chemical vapor deposition in hydrogen and ethylene to obtain graphite metal foam; and finally, soaking the graphite metal foam, and removing the metal framework through chemical etching to obtain the self-supporting porous dendritic foam only containing graphite. The invention has the remarkable effects of being capable of being used as a dielectrophoresis electrode to remove bacteria in water, short in bacteria removal time, high in efficiency, low in energy consumption, long in service life, low in cost, safe and nontoxic, and suitable for practical production.

title_en: Production process of silver mirror
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of a silver mirror, relates to the field of production and manufacturing of mirrors, and aims to solve the problems of short service life and low reflectivity of the silver mirror, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: a production process of a silver mirror comprises the following steps: cleaning and polishing glass; sensitizing; performing hypersensitization; silver plating; passivating; preheating; spraying a primer; baking the primer; spraying epoxy resin masking liquid; spraying finish paint; air cooling; pickling the surface; cleaning the surface; and (5) drying. The production process of the silver mirror can ensure the effects of long durability, high reflectivity and long service life of the silver layer.

title_en: Method for producing a cylinder crankcase and cylinder crankcase
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cylinder crankcase with foreign matter encapsulation for reducing casting material and better component cleanliness. A method for producing a cylinder crankcase with a foreign body enclosure is described for reducing the casting material and for better cleaning of the produced component, wherein in particular the casting material is removed or displaced from the region below the water jacket between the tensioning anchors in order in this way to prevent dirt from penetrating into the component during subsequent operation of the motor, a separate tensioning anchor core is implemented below the water jacket in the region between the tensioning anchors, and a pin is driven into the tensioning anchor core for subsequent mounting on the water jacket core, so that the tensioning anchor core is completely surrounded by the casting material after casting in the component and merges with the casting material, the tensioning anchor core remaining in the produced component and being located in the enclosed space created by the casting material.

title_en: Preparation method of layered aluminum/steel composite plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a layered aluminum/steel composite plate, which comprises the steps of S1), respectively placing rolled aluminum coils and steel coils on two uncoilers for uncoiling; s2), uncoiling, and cleaning by adopting HCl and NaOH solutions respectively; s3), mechanically processing the surface to be combined of the aluminum plate and the steel plate for 12-15S by a rotary wire brush method; s4), placing the aluminum plate and the steel plate in an acetone solution for ultrasonic cleaning for 3-5 min; s5), pre-stretching or pre-compressing the surface-treated aluminum plate or steel plate, S6), welding the edges of the pre-stressed aluminum plate or steel plate; s7), carrying out preheating treatment on the welded steel aluminum plate before rolling; s8), and then annealing treatment is carried out in a continuous annealing furnace, the metal aluminum plate and the steel plate are combined together by hot rolling and rolling, the interface shear strength is more than or equal to 110MPa, the tensile strength is more than or equal to 300MPa, and the repeated bending times is more than or equal to 10 times.

title_en: Q420qE steel plate for improving fire straightening performance and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Q420qE steel plate for improving the fire straightening performance and a manufacturing method thereof, and the steel plate comprises the following components: c: 0.06-0.09%, Si: 0.15 to 0.35%, Mn: 1.50-1.60%, P: less than or equal to 0.016 percent, S less than or equal to 0.004 percent, Nb: 0.010-0.020%, V: 0.040-0.050%, Mo: 0.13-0.20%, Als: 0.015-0.045%, Ti: 0.010-0.020%, and the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities; the method is characterized in that low carbon is adopted, vanadium and molybdenum elements are properly added, and the process parameters of the steel plate after rolling and ultra-fast cooling are controlled to produce the Q420qE steel plate with acicular ferrite, equiaxed ferrite, pearlite and bainite tissues, so that the problems of internal stress removal by high-temperature tempering or strength reduction of a fire straightening plate of the Q420qE steel plate delivered by TMCP are solved.

title_en: Compression molding process of optical glass part for optical lens camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical glass, in particular to a press molding process of an optical glass type part for an optical lens camera. Which comprises the following steps: preparing a high-temperature resistant die by adopting a superhard alloy material, and polishing the surface of the high-temperature resistant die; crushing and grinding the glass raw materials, and then mixing to obtain a mixture; adding the mixture into a platinum crucible, heating and melting, and stirring to remove bubbles to obtain glass liquid; the glass liquid is added into a mould for mould pressing, and is cooled after being heated, so that a glass finished product is obtained.

title_en: Method for improving reduction resistance of PTCR (thermal sensitive ceramic)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the reduction resistance of PTCR heating ceramic, which comprises the following steps: in BaTiO 3 、PbTiO 3 、MnO 2 To which Zmol% of Ta is added 2 O 5 The powder is prepared by the following steps of (1) taking z as a powder, wherein the value range of z is more than 0 and less than or equal to 0.05; adding a semiconducting agent and a sintering aid, sintering in an atmospheric atmosphere, grinding the sintered ceramic surface, and coating an electrode. According to the invention, the voltage resistance strength and the room temperature resistance change rate of the PTCR ceramic wafer before and after reduction are continuously reduced by adding Ta, and the reduction resistance performance of the manufactured heater is obviously improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing frozen casting mold
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a frozen casting mold comprises the steps of freezing raw sand to form a low Wen Yuansha (1) with the temperature of-10 ℃ to-30 ℃, fixing a mold (2) with an air permeable plug on a bottom plate (3) with the air permeable plug, then placing a sand box (4), injecting the low Wen Yuansha (1) into the sand box (4), then moving a sand box upper cover (5) with a plurality of water mist nozzles (6) above the sand box (4), spraying high-pressure water mist into the sand box (4) through a high-pressure water mist generator, enabling the high-pressure water mist to be in contact with the low Wen Yuansha in the sand box (4) to condense into ice, bonding the sand by the ice together, and stripping to obtain the frozen casting mold (8); the manufacturing method of the frozen casting mold can realize the flow production of sand casting by taking water as a binder, has high production efficiency and low production cost, has little demand on the mold in the production process, can not generate toxic and harmful substances, and can recycle the poured waste sand.

title_en: Gas atomizing nozzle
abstract_en: An aerosolizing nozzle comprising: the nozzle comprises a nozzle outer shell, a pressure regulating bypass, a pressure regulating valve, a pressure regulating controller, a rotary annular seam, a nozzle inner shell, a pressure regulating chamber outer shell and a replaceable crucible guide pipe. The upper part of the nozzle outer shell and the upper part of the nozzle inner shell form a compressed gas pressure equalizing chamber, a pressure regulating chamber is formed by the nozzle outer shell and the pressure regulating chamber outer shell, compressed gas enters the gas pressure equalizing chamber from a compressed gas inlet, a pressure regulating valve is controlled by a pressure regulating controller, and overpressure compressed gas can enter the pressure regulating chamber from a pressure regulating bypass, so that the pressure of the compressed gas entering the pressure equalizing chamber is stable. The rotary circular seam is arranged below the pressure regulating bypass, compressed gas after pressure stabilization forms rotary airflow through the rotary circular seam, the lower part of the nozzle outer shell and the lower part of the nozzle inner shell form a laval pipeline, the rotary compressed gas is sprayed out through the laval pipeline to form stable rotary airflow, and the molten metal flowing out of the replaceable crucible flow guide pipe is beaten into powder by the airflow.

title_en: Method for preparing porous silicon material by controllable reducing agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a controllable preparation method of a porous silicon material, which uses silicon oxide SiO  x  As a main raw material, magnesium boride is used as a reducing agent, a mixture of elemental silicon, magnesium oxide and the like is obtained through a magnesian reduction reaction, and the porous silicon material is obtained after acid washing. The porous silicon material prepared by the invention maintains the typical morphological characteristics of the original material and shows rich mesoporous structure. The unique adjustable porous structure not only can effectively relieve mechanical strain caused by volume change, but also is beneficial to improving the transmission dynamics of the electrochemical reaction process. Meanwhile, the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, controllable reaction, general strategy and the like. The micro-and nano-porous silicon material prepared by the method has potential application prospect in the field of new energy sources such as lithium ion batteries and the like.

title_en: Method and device for reducing inner diameter of part hole body in local heating mode of hole wall
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of machinery, in particular to the field of machinery, and specifically relates to a method and a device for reducing the inner diameter of a part hole body in a local heating mode, wherein the method comprises the following steps: placing a workpiece to be heated on the upper part of the heat-resistant cushion block, wherein a copper pipe heating inductor extends into a central hole of the workpiece, and the copper pipe heating inductor is not contacted with the inner wall of the central hole of the workpiece; setting heating time, current and frequency parameters of a high-frequency quenching machine, keeping warm time, starting the high-frequency quenching machine, adjusting the heating depth of a hole wall within the range of 3-15mm, cooling a workpiece in the modes of natural air cooling, water cooling, oil cooling, lime heat preservation and the like after heating is finished, and measuring the inner diameter size and cylindricity of the reduced workpiece hole by using an inner diameter meter according to actual conditions.

title_en: Drum strength prediction method for sinter of each material layer of sintering trolley
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the drum strength of sinter of each material layer of a sintering trolley, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out sintering cup experiments under different process conditions based on trolley production raw materials to obtain different sinter, then carrying out drum strength test, simultaneously carrying out test analysis on the porosity, typical mineral content and typical mineral micromechanics of the sinter, establishing a quantitative relation model between the porosity, typical mineral content, typical mineral micromechanics and the drum strength of the sinter, and then substituting the porosity, typical mineral content and corresponding mineral micromechanics of the sinter sample to be tested of each material layer of the sintering trolley into a first quantitative relation model, so as to predict the drum strength of the sinter sample to be tested. The invention establishes a method for predicting the drum strength of each material layer of the sintering trolley, and realizes that the drum strength of the sintering ores in different areas of the sintering trolley is rapidly obtained through microsampling and miniature tests.

title_en: Honeycomb reduced graphene oxide foam/nickel nanoparticle wave absorbing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wave-absorbing materials, in particular to a honeycomb-shaped reduced graphene oxide foam/nickel nanoparticle wave-absorbing agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the wave-absorbing agent takes honeycomb-shaped reduced graphene oxide foam as a carrier, and nickel nanoparticles with the average particle size of 80nm are anchored and loaded on the reduced graphene oxide foam; it has the following beneficial effects: according to the invention, the melamine foam is used as a template, and the reduced graphene oxide is recombined on the surface of the melamine foam by utilizing the three-dimensional cross-linked network structure of the melamine foam, so that the three-dimensional honeycomb foam-like structure of the reduced graphene oxide is endowed, the self geometric effect of the material is enhanced, and the multiple reflection effect on electromagnetic microwaves is achieved; according to the invention, the magnetic nanoparticles are introduced into the reduced graphene oxide foam material, so that the reduced graphene oxide foam material has more excellent wave-absorbing performance than single graphene or magnetic Ni, and has the advantages of deep wave-absorbing strength, wide wave-absorbing frequency band, light weight, good mechanical property and the like.

title_en: Nickel-platinum core-shell nano-structure material, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-platinum core-shell nano-structure material, a synthesis method and application, belonging to the field of nano-material science, wherein nickel salt, a surfactant, a reducing agent and platinum salt are added into a solvent, and then the mixture is stood at 175-210 ℃ until metal salt in a system is reduced to prepare a nickel template nano-material; adding excessive ligand into platinum salt to completely coordinate the platinum salt, and standing until a clear and transparent colorless or light yellow solution is obtained to prepare a platinum precursor solution; adding a surfactant, a reducing agent and a platinum precursor solution into a nickel template nano material, and then stirring at 120-180 ℃ until platinum is reduced to prepare the nickel-platinum core-shell nano material.

title_en: High-performance high-efficiency preparation method of tantalum alloy hyperboloid space structural member
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a tantalum alloy hyperboloid space structural member, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the multi-pass radial split forming and the cold extrusion forming are combined; the multi-pass radial split forming comprises an isothermal and isobaric step and a forming step, wherein the isothermal and isobaric step is to heat a die and a tantalum alloy blank to 650+/-15 ℃ and the vacuum degree reaches 5 multiplied by 10  ‑2  Pa, the extrusion pass of multi-pass radial split forming is 2-5 times, so that the blank is in radial streamline organization along the curved surface. The invention provides a vacuum isothermal radial shunt forming method for the first time, so that a tantalum alloy hyperboloid space structural member obtains required tissue performance through plastic deformation; and by combining cold extrusion and small-allowance precise cutting processing technology, the curved surface of the tantalum alloy hyperboloid space structural member is not processed, the surface quality meets the design requirement, the comprehensive service performance of the tantalum alloy structural member is obviously improved, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Covering slag and method for improving pit pitting surface on surface of medium carbon steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses mold flux and a method for improving pit pitting surfaces on the surface of medium carbon steel, and relates to the technical field of steel smelting. The mold flux includes: siO (SiO)  2  ：27～32.45，Al  2  O  3  ：12～18，CaO：25～29.25，MgO：3.5～6.5，Na  2  O:3.05 to 3.95, T.C: 21-26, F: 4-6, and the balance of water and unavoidable impurities. On the one hand, na is reduced  2  The content of O can reduce the melting rate of the protective slag and the slag rolling probability; at the same time, the content of free carbon (T.C) is increased, and Na can be reduced  2  The O content is coordinated, so that the melting rate of the protective slag is reduced, the slag rolling probability is reduced, and the pit pitting defect rate is reduced; on the other hand, by increasing Al  2  O  3  The content of the protective slag can be improved, the surface tension of the protective slag is improved, the slag rolling probability is reduced, and the pit pitting defect rate is reduced in cooperation with reducing the melting rate.

title_en: Device and method for uniformly adding casting powder into continuous casting crystallizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for uniformly adding casting powder into a continuous casting crystallizer, wherein the device comprises a casting powder main guide pipe and a continuous casting crystallizer, an outer ring pipe is arranged around the outer side of the casting powder main guide pipe, the inner side of the outer ring pipe is uniformly communicated with a gas inlet pipe of the casting powder main guide pipe, the other end of the gas inlet pipe of the casting powder main guide pipe is communicated with the casting powder main guide pipe, one side of the outer ring pipe is communicated with a gas inlet pipe, and the bottom end of the outer ring pipe is uniformly communicated with a casting powder four-branch pipe. According to the invention, argon or nitrogen is blown through the crystallizer, so that secondary oxidation of molten steel is better prevented, blowing is carried out before four branches of the covering slag draft tube, the covering slag is further distributed more evenly in the four branches, and the argon or nitrogen is blown through the crystallizer, so that secondary oxidation of the molten steel is better prevented, and further the quality of a casting blank is further improved.

title_en: Particle sound absorption board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a particle sound absorption plate and a preparation method thereof, the particle sound absorption plate comprises a binder, sound absorption particles, grid cloth and a sound absorption plate body, the surface of the sound absorption particles is covered with a layer of the binder, the sound absorption particles comprise filling particles, framework particles, aeolian sand and sand grains, the framework particles and the filling particles are both composed of round calcium oxide and silicon dioxide polymer particles, the grid cloth is arranged inside the sound absorption plate body, and the particle sound absorption plate has the beneficial effects that: the sound absorption particles comprise skeleton particles of round calcium oxide and silicon dioxide polymer particles and natural irregular polyhedral diamond-shaped filling particles of sand particles, because the irregular polyhedral diamond-shaped characteristic of the natural sand particles is skillfully divided and assembled by the round calcium oxide and silicon dioxide polymer particles to fill gaps with different specifications and shapes, and the sound absorption coefficient NRC is 0.7-0.95.

title_en: Steel fiber geopolymer concrete material and performance calculation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steel fiber geopolymer concrete material and a performance calculation method thereof. Through tests, performance characteristic quantities such as compressive strength, peak strain, peak stress, elastic modulus and the like of the steel fiber geopolymer concrete axis and a stress-strain constitutive model are obtained. According to the steel fiber geopolymer concrete material obtained by the invention, the steel fiber can improve the weak interface between the aggregate and the cementing material, so that the development of cracks is effectively inhibited, and compared with common geopolymer concrete with the same proportion, the steel fiber geopolymer concrete material has higher strength and better plasticity; with the increase of the mixing amount of the steel fibers, the strength and the plasticity of the concrete are greatly improved, the stress-strain constitutive model can accurately describe the mechanical behaviors of axial compressive strength, elastic modulus, strain strengthening, softening and the like of the steel fiber geopolymer concrete, and the steel fiber geopolymer concrete has wide applicability.

title_en: Bismuth oxide nanorod and application thereof in light transmittance adjustment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano materials, in particular to an oxygen group element compound nano rod of bismuth and application thereof in adjusting light transmittance, wherein the chemical formula of the oxygen group element compound of bismuth is Bi  2 X 3 , X is at least one of O, S, se, te, and the nano rod is at least one of the oxygen group element compounds of bismuth. The light valve prepared from the bismuth oxide nano-rod has the advantages that the change of the transmittance of the light valve to visible light and infrared light can reach more than 60%, compared with the traditional quinine iodide sulfate particles, the bismuth oxide nano-rod particles are better in stability, stronger in internal dipole moment, not easy to be thermally decomposed, and capable of adjusting the light transmittance in a wider range, meanwhile, the bismuth oxide nano-rod is rich in color, and high-efficiency absorption of light can be realized.

title_en: Middle box body sand mold molding system and using method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diesel engine cylinder block production, in particular to an intermediate box sand mold molding system and a using method thereof, aiming at the problems that the intermediate box sand mold molding system in the prior art is easy to have loose and untimely sand mold and is inconvenient to install, the invention provides the following scheme, which comprises a template, an upper box compacting plate and a fixing mechanism, wherein the top surface of the template is provided with a cavity, the bottom of the cavity is provided with a wire cutting exhaust insert, the inside of the template is provided with an exhaust passage communicated with the wire cutting exhaust insert, the top surface of the template is provided with an intermediate hole communicated with the exhaust passage, and the top surface of the template is provided with four pouring ports; and the bottom surface of the upper box compacting plate is provided with a pouring gate bar and a pouring exhaust passage. The sand mould has the advantages of reasonable structure and simple operation, can effectively discharge redundant air in the mould plate, thereby ensuring the compactness of the sand mould, is convenient for fixing and disassembling the mould plate, and is easy to popularize and use.

title_en: Method for synthesizing bone-shaped gold nanorods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a claviform gold nanorod, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a seed solution; (2) preparing a growth solution; (3) a bone-shaped gold nanorod. According to the invention, CTAC and oleylamine are used as double surfactants, 1,2,4 trihydroxybenzene is used as a reducing agent, the amount of required reactants is small, the cost is low, the reaction rate is extremely high, the reaction condition is easy to control, the obtained gold nanorods have good dispersibility, longer size, large two ends and small middle, are like a rod bone, are more suitable to be used as a material for self-assembly of the gold nanorods, and have wider application prospect in the medical field.

title_en: Rare earth doped permanent magnetic ferrite and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth doped permanent magnetic ferrite and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor magnetic materials. The permanent magnetic ferrite material is prepared from the following raw materials: 100-150 parts of ferric oxide, 9-11 parts of strontium carbonate, 3-6 parts of aluminum oxide, 3-7 parts of calcium carbonate, 2-6 parts of silicon dioxide and 0.5-1.5 parts of nano cerium oxide compound. According to the invention, the ferric oxide and strontium carbonate main body materials are added with a proper amount of silicon dioxide, so that the density of the ferrite can be improved, the remanence can be improved, the crystal grains can be refined, and the coercivity can be improved. Due to the addition of the nano cerium oxide composite material, rare earth element Ce enters crystal lattices and participates in the formation of a main phase, and is gathered at a crystal boundary to influence the growth of crystal grains.

title_en: Modified graphite material, preparation method and application thereof, and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified graphite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method of the modified graphite material comprises the following steps: carrying out heat treatment, crushing and graphitization treatment on the first artificial graphite raw material to obtain first artificial graphite particles; carrying out heat treatment, graphitization treatment, coating treatment and carbonization treatment on the second artificial graphite raw material to obtain second artificial graphite particles; mixing and screening the first artificial graphite particles and the second artificial graphite particles; the mass ratio of the first artificial graphite particles to the second artificial graphite particles is 5:5-7: 3. The preparation method of the modified graphite material is simple and controllable, and the prepared modified graphite material has the advantages of less surface defects, excellent high-temperature performance, good quick-charging performance, long cycle life, high safety performance and excellent comprehensive performance.

title_en: Bottom pouring type casting device, bottom pouring type casting method and guide block
abstract_en: The application discloses end notes formula casting device, end notes formula casting method and guide block relates to the casting field, and the end notes formula casting device of this application includes: the device comprises a sand box, a cavity, a first sprue, a first duckbilled sprue, a second sprue, a cross sprue and an ingate; wherein the cavity is arranged in the sand box; the first straight pouring gate is arranged in the sand box; one end of the first duckbill pouring channel is connected with the first straight pouring channel; one end of the second sprue is connected with the other end of the first duckbill sprue; the cross pouring gate is connected with the other end of the second straight pouring gate; and at least one ingate which is arranged on the horizontal runner and is connected with the cavity. The utility model provides a bottom pouring type casting device is through setting up the first duckbilled runner in the middle of first sprue and second sprue for when the metallic liquid was watered through first duckbilled, its velocity of flow slowed down, thereby improved the quality of foundry goods.

title_en: Hierarchical pore MRE molecular sieve with adjustable pore acid distribution degree, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a hierarchical porous alumina-silica-alumina-silica (MRE) molecular sieve with adjustable pore acid distribution degree, which comprises the following steps: (1) uniformly mixing alkali liquor, a structure directing agent solution, a silicon source, an aluminum source and water, and crystallizing for 1-5 days at 150-170 ℃; (2) separating the product to obtain a solid, washing the solid to be neutral, and drying the solid at the temperature of 100-120 ℃; (3) pre-calcining the solid; (4) carrying out alkali treatment on the solid, and then carrying out ammonium ion exchange; (5) calcining the substance for a period of time to obtain the hierarchical porous alumina MRE molecular sieve with adjustable pore acid distribution degree. The invention also discloses the graded porous alumina MRE molecular sieve with adjustable pore channel acid distribution degree and application of the graded porous alumina MRE molecular sieve in the hydroisomerization reaction of long-chain normal paraffin.

title_en: Method for improving service stability of superalloy disc or ring and obtained disc or ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manufacturing of high-temperature alloy materials, in particular to a method for improving service stability of a high-temperature alloy disc or ring-shaped piece and the obtained disc or ring-shaped piece. The method for improving the service stability of the superalloy disc or ring comprises the following steps: and carrying out solution heat treatment on the high-temperature alloy disc or ring-shaped piece, then rotating to enable the hub part to generate 0.005-0.1 plastic deformation, and then carrying out aging heat treatment. The invention rotates after solution heat treatment, and the rotating speed required for inducing specific plastic deformation is lower, so that the process is effectively controllable; and the solid solution heat treatment is carried out, then the solid solution heat treatment is carried out, reasonable plastic deformation is induced at the hub part, more substructures are introduced, the precipitation of a strengthening phase near the substructures of the material can be promoted in the subsequent aging heat treatment process, and the strength and creep resistance of the material are improved.

title_en: Novel energy-saving CO 2 Recovery device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to CO  2  The technical field of recovery equipment, and discloses a novel energy-saving CO  2  The recovery device comprises a base, wherein a low-temperature washing tower is arranged at the top of the base; according to the invention, the novel method for producing the food-grade carbon dioxide without an adsorption drying system is realized by removing volatile organic matters from chemical reaction according to the chemical and physical characteristics of various toxic and harmful substances in carbon dioxide gas of alcohol fermentation, removing heavy and light substances according to the molar weight of the substances, condensing and degrading according to the principle of slight mutual solubility and mutual solubility of different substances and the boiling point principle of different substances, and the removal of various toxic and harmful substances can be realized completely without an adsorption drying mode, so that a large amount of washing water can be saved, and compared with the conventional recovery equipment, the method has the advantages of small occupied area, simple process flow and low energy consumption index by 10% -15% compared with the conventional adsorption drying recovery system, and has no worry and trouble of sewage and solid waste treatment.

title_en: Shell for investment casting of directional crystallization blade and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a shell for investment casting of a directional crystallization blade, which comprises the following steps: step a: connecting a blade wax mould with a seeding wax mould, connecting a lower inner runner wax mould with the seeding wax mould, connecting an upper inner runner wax mould with a sprue cup wax mould, and respectively connecting the other ends of the lower inner runner wax mould and the upper inner runner wax mould with the side surface of a boss wax mould; step b: assembling the assembled wax mold into a shell, and cutting one end surface of the boss wax mold after the shell is manufactured; step c: dewaxing the shell, roasting the shell, and cleaning the shell; step d: and placing the filter screen with the working surface as the side surface into a cylindrical filter cavity formed by dewaxing the boss wax mold, placing a cover plate, and coating a sealing layer on the cover plate. By adopting the shell for directional crystallization blade investment casting and the preparation method thereof, the molten steel filtering effect is better, and the rejection rate of slag inclusion of the directional crystallization blade is greatly reduced.

title_en: Heat-insulating wall anti-cracking building block and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-cracking building block for a heat-insulating wall, which is characterized by sequentially comprising a waterproof plinth decorative layer, a first concrete layer, a heat-insulating layer and a second concrete layer from outside to inside. This scheme is in the same place concrete layer, insulating layer and the compound of waterproof plinth decorative layer, improves the efficiency of building a wall. On the left side surface and the right side surface of the heat insulation wall anti-cracking building block, a first bulge is arranged on one side, a first groove is arranged on the other side, and the first bulge is matched with the first groove. The tenon-and-mortise structures on four sides of the building block can enhance the connection strength between the building blocks, so that the whole wall has better tensile and anti-cracking performance.

title_en: Inside aluminium skeleton preparation forming device of cavity glass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow glass internal aluminum skeleton preparation forming device which comprises a workbench, wherein a conveying mechanism is fixed at one end of the workbench, a fixing mechanism is fixed at one side of the top end of the workbench, a limiting block is fixed at one end, far away from the conveying mechanism, of the top end of the workbench, a welding mechanism is fixed at one side, far away from the fixing mechanism, of the workbench, a first forming mechanism is fixed at the top end of the interior of the workbench, and a second forming mechanism is fixed at the bottom end of the interior of the workbench. Has the advantages that: the device can be used for carrying out one-time forming work on the hollow aluminum strip, quickly and conveniently preparing the aluminum framework, can be used for carrying out forming work on the aluminum strip at multiple angles, is better in accuracy, can be used for carrying out fixed welding work on the aluminum strip, and effectively improves the forming work efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method of anti-mud factor and anti-mud polycarboxylate superplasticizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a mud-resistant polycarboxylate water reducer, which is prepared in two steps, wherein in the first step, 1, 4-dibromobutane and triphenylphosphine are taken as raw materials, dissolved in organic solvents such as ethanol or acetonitrile and the like, and subjected to quaternary phosphonium chlorination reaction at the temperature of 60-80 ℃ to prepare a mud-resistant factor; and the second step is to take acrylic acid, polyoxyethylene ether macromonomer, acrylic ester, sulfonate and mud-resistant factor as main raw materials, and carry out free copolymerization reaction under the conditions of chain transfer agent and redox to obtain the polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent with good mud-resistant effect. The raw reducing material prepared by the method is cheap and easy to obtain, the reaction condition is mild, the synthesis step is simple and convenient, the post-treatment is easy, the slump loss resistance is good, the stability is good, the preparation process is simple, and the method is safe and environment-friendly and is suitable for mixing concrete with high mud content.

title_en: Resin-based carbon negative electrode material, preparation method and application thereof, and battery containing resin-based carbon negative electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resin-based carbon negative electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, and a battery containing the resin-based carbon negative electrode material. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1: pretreating a thermoplastic resin raw material to obtain resin powder; the pretreatment sequentially comprises crushing, oxidation, re-crushing and removal of non-solidified components; the D50 of the resin powder is less than 50 μm; s2: and sequentially carrying out low-temperature heat treatment and high-temperature heat treatment on the resin powder to obtain the resin-based carbon negative electrode material. The invention adopts resin with wide resources, low price, high carbon residue value and low cost as a main material, and resin-based carbon as a negative electrode material, and the lithium battery and the sodium battery both have better electrical properties, meet the commercial performance requirements of the lithium ion and sodium ion batteries with high energy density and high first coulombic efficiency, and are particularly suitable for the fields of lithium batteries, sodium ion batteries and super capacitors such as consumer electronics, large-scale energy storage, low-cost batteries and low-temperature fields.

title_en: Carbon dots with hawthorn as carbon source and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of nano materials, in particular to a carbon dot taking hawthorn as a carbon source and a preparation method thereof. The average particle size of the carbon dots is 1.68-3.02nm, the carbon dots have good size uniformity, and good pH detection and cell imaging effects are shown through photoluminescence characteristics of the carbon dots when the carbon dots are used. The carbon dots are controlled to have narrow size distribution, namely the size difference of the carbon dots is small, so that the luminous purity can be ensured, and the method has important significance on the properties and the application of the carbon dots; meanwhile, the carbon dots with small and uniform sizes have better and more stable fluorescence performance and higher fluorescence intensity.

title_en: High-nonlinearity ZnO-based polycrystalline ceramic and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high non-linear ZnO-based polycrystalline ceramic and a preparation method and application thereof, a natural Schottky barrier structure can be formed at a ZnO polycrystalline ceramic crystal boundary formed by a sintering process, and a back-to-back Schottky barrier model device is formed in a series mode by utilizing a metal electrode and the prepared ZnO polycrystalline ceramic, so that the influence of the defects of the electrode and the material of the device on the performance of a nuclear radiation detector is reduced, and the X-ray detector with the ultra-large volume and the time resolution of 10ns order is realized at extremely low cost.

title_en: C/C-Ti 3 AlC 2 Composite material and method for producing the same
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses C/C-Ti  3  AlC  2  A composite material and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of C/C composite materials. System for makingThe preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing mixed powder formed by mixing TiC powder, ti powder, al powder and Si powder according to a molar ratio of 2; preparing a C/C porous composite material; coating the C/C porous composite material with the mixed powder, then carrying out reaction infiltration under the protection of inert gas, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the C/C-Ti  3  AlC  2  A composite material. The C/C-Ti provided by the embodiment of the invention  3  AlC  2  The composite material is Ti  3  AlC  2  The phase-modified C/C composite material is obtained, so that the heat-conducting property of the C/C composite material is improved, and the good mechanical property of the C/C composite material at high temperature is enhanced. Meanwhile, the preparation method only needs to coat the C/C porous composite material with the mixed powder of TiC powder, ti powder, al powder and Si powder and then carry out reaction infiltration under the protection of inert gas, so that the preparation method has the advantages of simple process, convenience in operation and low cost.

title_en: Method for manufacturing vegetation greening base material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of vegetation greening base materials, belonging to the technical field of greening material preparation, and the manufacturing method comprises the steps of preparing a mixture, performing primary treatment, performing secondary treatment, maintaining and performing heat treatment; the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing zeolite powder, slag ash, volcanic ash, potassium sulfate, ammonium sulfate, pregelatinized corn starch, betaine and stearic acid diethanol amine, carrying out first ball milling, obtaining a first mixed material after the first ball milling is finished, adding nano clay into the first mixed material, carrying out second ball milling, and obtaining a mixed material after the second ball milling is finished; the prepared vegetation greening base material can ensure high shape stability, air permeability and durability, improve water retention capacity, toughness and impact resistance, and reduce firing temperature and brittleness.

title_en: Precipitation hardening alloy
abstract_en: The invention provides a precipitation hardening alloy, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: (C + N): 0.01% -1.2%; si: 0.1% -1.0%; mn: 0.1% -0.8%; (Mo + 0.5W): 10% -32%, and Mo: 6 to 30 percent; co: 15% -35%; ti: 0.01 to 6 percent, and the balance of Fe and impurities. According to the precipitation hardening alloy, the second phase is mainly precipitated in a precipitation hardening mode in a matrix in a desolvation way to form a metal ceramic precipitated phase, and the precipitation hardening alloy has the characteristics of high hardness and high thermal stability; besides, the alloy has excellent comprehensive properties including high red hardness, wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high-temperature oxidation resistance and the like.

title_en: Sintered iron ore proportioning method and system based on wet capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sintered iron ore proportioning method based on wet capacity performance and a sintered iron ore proportioning system based on wet capacity performance, which comprises the steps of obtaining chemical composition data of N iron ore raw materials in a drying state and obtaining excessive wet performance data of each iron ore raw material; calculating the nondimensional index of the excessive humidity performance of each iron ore raw material according to the excessive humidity performance data; performing simulated mixing on at least two iron ore raw materials to obtain M simulated ore blending schemes and M simulated target mixed ores; calculating to obtain the comprehensive evaluation index of the overwetting performance of each simulation target mixed ore; and determining a simulated ore blending scheme with the value of the comprehensive evaluation index of the overwetting performance meeting a preset condition as a simulated ore blending scheme for guiding the mixed ore. According to the method for preparing the sintered iron ore based on the wet capacity performance, disclosed by the invention, in addition to the fact that the chemical components of the simulation target mixed ore meet sintering requirements in the ore preparation process, the over-wet performance of the simulation target mixed ore is comprehensively considered in advance.

title_en: Light gold
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel composite material comprising elemental gold in single crystal form, amyloid fibres and a polymer. This composite is similar to glass plastic, but lighter than aluminum, and has a golden gloss similar to 18K gold. Due to its unique properties, this composite material is called "light gold". The composite material is suitable for watches, jewelry, radiation shielding, catalysis and electronics. The invention further provides an environmentally friendly method of making such a composite.

title_en: Lightweight concrete
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building materials, and particularly discloses lightweight concrete. The lightweight concrete comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 350-420 parts of cement, 450-600 parts of multilayer lightweight aggregate, 200-300 parts of fine aggregate, 300-500 parts of coarse aggregate, 18-23 parts of admixture and 160-175 parts of water; the fibrous multi-layer lightweight aggregate is a composite material which takes aramid fiber as a core material, takes a polydopamine layer as a secondary outer layer and takes an amino silicone oil modified silicon dioxide particle layer as an outermost layer; the multilayer lightweight aggregate adopted in the application can endow concrete with better construction performance, keeps excellent toughening property in the hydration reaction process, overcomes the defect that the traditional lightweight aggregate is easy to float, and optimizes the internal structure of the lightweight concrete, so that the lightweight concrete has excellent compressive strength, flexural strength and lower water absorption.

title_en: Rare earth core-spun yarn for silicon killed steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rare earth core-spun yarn for silicon-killed steel and a preparation method thereof. The invention has the advantages of convenient division and accurate measurement, and overcomes the defects of complicated sealing and inconvenient use that the rare earth metal needs to be soaked in oil or a special metal barrel and the like in the processes of storage and transportation. The preparation method provided by the invention has the characteristics of simplicity, practicability and convenience for large-scale production. The invention has positive significance for reducing the use cost and saving rare earth resources.

title_en: Recycling method of calcified vanadium extraction tailings
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wet metallurgy of vanadium, and discloses a method for recycling calcified vanadium extraction tailings. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Adding water into calcified vanadium extraction tailings for pulping, then adding ammonium carbonate under a stirring state, and carrying out solid-liquid separation after stirring reaction to obtain a solid phase and a liquid phase, wherein the calcified vanadium extraction tailings contain iron compounds, calcium sulfate and vanadium; (2) Washing the solid phase with water, mixing the obtained washing liquid with the liquid phase, evaporating and concentrating to obtain an ammonium sulfate solid and condensed water, wherein the ammonium sulfate solid is returned to the vanadium precipitation process to be used as an ammonium salt additive, and the condensed water is returned to be used as calcified vanadium extraction tailings pulping water or solid phase washing water; (3) The washed solid phase is dried and crushed, and returned to the calcification roasting process to be used as calcium salt and thermal diluent. The method can realize recovery of vanadium in the tailings, simultaneously safely and effectively utilize valuable elements such as calcium, manganese, magnesium and the like, reduce the cost of auxiliary materials, and improve the yield of vanadium.

title_en: Novel powder collecting system of gas atomization powder process equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of metal powder manufacturing, in particular to a powder collecting system of novel gas atomization powder manufacturing equipment, which comprises a powder collecting tank and a cooling system, wherein the powder collecting tank is arranged below an atomization chamber and used for collecting powder, the cooling system is used for cooling the powder in the powder collecting tank, and the cooling system comprises a circulating gas supply device and a stirring device, the circulating gas supply device is communicated between a smelting chamber and the powder collecting tank, and the stirring device is rotatably connected into the powder collecting tank; the circulation air feeder is arranged in carrying the gas of smelting chamber to the powder collecting tank in for the powder provides cooling gas, agitating unit is arranged in stirring the powder in the powder collecting tank, the circulation air feeder with agitating unit connects in order to drive through the gas that the circulation air feeder carried agitating unit rotates. This application has the cooling time that can shorten the powder, improves the effect of powder process efficiency.

title_en: Composite material and battery composite diaphragm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite material and a battery composite diaphragm. A composite material comprising a transition metal sulfide intercalation and coated montmorillonite; the chemical formula of the transition metal sulfide is MS 2 M includes any one or more of Fe, Cu, Mo, Ti, Co, Ni, Mn, Nb, Zr, W, Re, and Ta. A battery composite separator includes a substrate; a coating is coated on the surface of the base material; the coating comprises a composite material. The composite material provided by the invention is montmorilloniteThe strong adsorption effect on lithium polysulfide and the catalytic effect of transition metal sulfide are organically combined, so that adsorption and catalytic synergistic effects are formed by utilizing adsorption and catalytic active sites inside and outside the composite material, the adsorption and conversion processes of polysulfide in the charging and discharging processes of the lithium-sulfur battery are strengthened, the shuttle effect of polysulfide is effectively inhibited, and the cycle stability of the lithium-sulfur battery is greatly improved.

title_en: Method for preparing nano copper powder by using copper oxide as raw material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing nano copper powder by taking copper oxide as a raw material, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding copper oxide into the eutectic ionic liquid at the temperature of 80-150 ℃, and stirring and dissolving to obtain a bright yellow solution A; adding ascorbic acid or sodium ascorbate into the solution A, and stirring to dissolve to obtain a solution B; adding the hydroxide particles into the solution B, and stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution C; s2, placing the solution C in a reaction container, stirring and reacting for 6-20 hours at 100-120 ℃, then separating the product in an inert atmosphere, washing the product with absolute ethyl alcohol and ultrapure water for 3-5 times respectively, drying in vacuum, and then sealing and storing with inert gas to obtain the nano copper powder with the purity of more than or equal to 99.99%. The method is simple and controllable, and the prepared nano copper powder has high purity and uniform particle size distribution.

title_en: Oxygenerator of adjustable temperature of giving vent to anger
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxygen generator capable of adjusting air outlet temperature, which comprises a machine body, wherein the upper surface of the machine body is provided with an annular groove, an annular block is rotationally connected in the annular groove, the upper end of the annular block penetrates and extends out of the machine body and is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, an adjusting cavity is arranged in the fixed seat, and the lower ends of the two adjusting cavities are respectively penetrated and provided with an air inlet hole, so that the oxygen generator has the following beneficial effects that: when using, can heat or refrigerate exhaust air through heating ring and refrigerator to when needs are adjusted, can remove the fixed to annular piece and fixing base in taking the dead lever out the fixed slot through the handle, later can rotate the fixing base, adjust from the output with the discharge hole and refrigerated regulation chamber or the regulation chamber of heating, thereby conveniently heat or refrigerate exhaust oxygen, thereby improve user's use and experience.

title_en: Expansive soil improving agent and expansive soil improving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an expansionSoil improving agent and expansive soil improving method. The expansive soil modifier comprises blast furnace slag, steel slag powder, sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and NaAl (SO)  4  )  2  And (4) and the like. The expansive soil is air dried and crushed, then mixed with the expansive soil improving agent, added with water and stirred uniformly, sealed and braised, pressed and molded after braising, and maintained. The method is used for improving the performance of the expansive soil, the free expansion rate and the unconfined compressive strength are obviously improved, the soaking stability is obviously improved, the improved material is simple and environment-friendly, no special equipment is needed, and the method is particularly suitable for the application of the actual slope engineering in rainy climate areas.

title_en: Preparation method of boron carbide-based nano composite powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses boron carbide-based composite powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein a molten salt method is adopted, and B is obtained by optimized raw material proportion and granularity selection and reasonable process condition design 4 C‑TiB 2 Composite powder of TiB 2 Nanoscale flaky particles are uniformly attached to B 4 The surface of the irregular particles is superior to the uniformity of the traditional mechanical mixing method; TiB 2 Is nano-scale flaky particles, has high sintering activity, is beneficial to forming a sintering neck at a lower temperature and overcomes the defect of B 4 C is a disadvantage of being difficult to sinter; the mass ratio of the prepared powder TiB 2 ：（TiB 2 +B 4 C) And 5% -15%. The molten salt method is favorable for the diffusion of reactants, so that the products are uniformly distributed; the reaction temperature is reduced, the reaction time is shortened, the energy consumption is low and the efficiency is high; is favorable for the growth and development of the anisotropic structure. In preparation B 4 C‑TiB 2 In the process of compounding the powder, the solubility is removed by washingThe salt is recycled, and the process is environment-friendly and green.

title_en: Method for preparing closed-cell foam steel by laser additive manufacturing technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing and forming, and particularly relates to a method for preparing closed-cell foam steel by a laser additive manufacturing technology, which comprises the following steps: fully mixing steel powder and glass powder to obtain mixed powder; and selecting laser processing parameters and scanning tracks by taking the mixed powder as a raw material according to the size requirement, inputting the laser processing parameters and the scanning tracks into a corresponding laser processing operation system to obtain two-dimensional information, and performing laser additive manufacturing to obtain the closed-cell foam steel. The invention develops a novel laser preparation method of closed-cell foam steel, which utilizes the program setting of a laser and the scanning of laser beams to realize the preparation of the closed-cell foam steel, and the aperture is generally within 100 mu m; the problem of harm of residues caused by conventional foam steel casting and sintering methods is solved; meanwhile, the design is more free, the environment is harmless, the limitation of a die is broken through, and the flexibility of manufacturing are greatly increased.

title_en: Liquid interface treating agent, environment-friendly waterproof slurry and preparation method and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid interface treating agent, an environment-friendly waterproof slurry, a preparation method and a construction method thereof, wherein the environment-friendly waterproof slurry is obtained by mixing the interface treating agent with solid powder, and the liquid interface treating agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-15 parts of silicate hybrid emulsion, 5-15 parts of butylbenzene emulsion, 50-60 parts of carboxylic butylbenzene emulsion, 0.1-0.2 part of wetting agent, 0.2-0.3 part of defoaming agent and 2-6 parts of suspension of hydrated calcium silicate. The environment-friendly waterproof slurry adopts silicate hybrid emulsion to compound nano styrene-butadiene emulsion and carboxyl styrene-butadiene emulsion, and is added with nano-particle size calcium silicate hydrate early strength agent and silane coupling agent, so that a base layer can be sealed and reinforced through an interface treating agent, wetting construction is avoided, the waterproof slurry is fast-setting and early-strength, the waterproof layer has high bonding strength in the early and later stages, the construction efficiency is improved, the construction period is shortened, and the cost is saved.

title_en: Method for calculating fuel distribution in sintering and granulating pellets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating fuel distribution in sintering and granulating pellets, which comprises the steps of calculating the property characteristics of each grade of granulating pellets when an ore blending structure is given according to the influence of the ore blending structure and granulating moisture on the distribution coefficient of each component, analyzing the distribution conditions of the raw material components in different granulating pellets after granulation according to three conditions of the grade of the raw material components, namely the maximum grade, the adhesive layer grade and the middle grade, calculating the coke powder ratio in each grade of granulating pellets and the mass fraction of each grade of granulating pellets when the ore blending structure is given by combining the distribution of the coke powder in the ore blending structure, and calculating the fuel distribution of the granulating pellets. The method establishes a new fuel distribution calculation method according to a mechanism model, provides a basis for the efficient utilization of the sintering fuel, and has important application value.

title_en: Method for preparing rare earth carbonate from ionic rare earth ore
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing rare earth carbonate from ionic rare earth ore, belonging to the technical field of rare earth metallurgy. The invention uses the extraction resin for adsorption-desorption, can realize the removal of impurities Mg and Fe and most of Si and Ca, the extraction resin can be recycled, the high-efficiency removal of Al can be realized through the procedures of residual acid neutralization of the desorbed liquid and Al removal by an aluminum remover, the rare earth loss is less, and the aluminum remover can be recycled. Finally, the rare earth carbonate product with the total rare earth content of more than 93wt percent after the rare earth is calcined can be obtained through precipitation. The method has the advantages of good production environment, high impurity removal rate, low consumption of chemical reagents, high purity of rare earth precipitation products, low impurity content and low later-stage rare earth smelting separation cost.

title_en: Heat exchange filtering device, hydrogenation system and hydrogenation method for preparing hydrogen peroxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of hydrogen peroxide, in particular to a heat exchange filtering device, a hydrogenation system and a hydrogenation method for preparing hydrogen peroxide. The hydrogenation system provided by the invention comprises a slurry bed reactor and at least one heat exchange filtering device arranged outside the slurry bed reactor, and particularly, an annular area of the slurry bed reactor is communicated with the heat exchange filtering device through a slurry inlet pipeline, so that slurry can exchange heat and filter in the heat exchange filtering device from top to bottom, the blockage of the device caused by the deposition of solid particles in a heat exchange part, a filtering part and the slurry bed reactor is avoided, the continuous and stable operation of the device is realized, the bed temperature difference of the slurry bed reactor is basically eliminated, uniform temperature distribution is provided, the reaction selectivity, the system efficiency and the hydrogenation efficiency are favorably improved, and the service life of a hydrogenation catalyst is prolonged.

title_en: Coal-based graphene quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal-based graphene quantum dot and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: mixing a coal-based raw material with excessive nitric acid to perform a pre-oxidation reaction on the obtained mixture to obtain a pre-oxidation reaction mixture; carrying out microwave digestion treatment on the pre-oxidation reaction mixture to obtain an oxidation reaction product; nitric acid in the oxidation reaction product is removed, and the resulting solid is washed and dried. The method conditions can reduce the severity of graphene quantum dots prepared by oxidation reaction, shorten the reaction time, and are favorable for realizing high-value utilization of coal-based raw materials.

title_en: Dehydrogenation process of hydrogen chloride synthesis gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dehydrogenation process of hydrogen chloride synthetic gas, which relates to the technical field of synthesis gas dehydrogenation and comprises the steps of constructing a dehydrogenation device, dissolving hydrogen chloride in water in a synthesis gas separation tank, introducing hydrogen recovered in a hydrogen recovery tank and oxygen in an oxygen tank into a combustion device, introducing hydrochloric acid solution into an analytical tower, adding a catalyst, collecting reaction heat generated by hydrogen combustion reaction into a heating jacket, heating the analytical tower by using the heating jacket, cooling hydrogen chloride gas separated out from the analytical tower by using a cooler, performing primary dehydration by using an adsorption column, and performing multistage dehydration on the hydrogen chloride gas subjected to the primary dehydration; the synthesis gas separation tank is utilized to separate hydrogen chloride gas and hydrogen, and the exothermic heat of the reaction of the separated hydrogen and oxygen is utilized as a heat source in the analysis process of the hydrogen chloride solution, so that the reasonable utilization of resources can be effectively realized, and the product water generated by the reaction of the hydrogen and the oxygen can be used as the dissolution water when the hydrogen chloride gas is dissolved in the synthesis gas separation tank.

title_en: Coffee residue transparent glaze and manufacturing method of product thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glaze, in particular to a coffee slag transparent glaze, which is formed by mixing coffee slag and original glaze; the method for manufacturing the glazed product by using the glaze comprises five steps of mixing, calcining, grinding, glazing and firing. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: according to the coffee slag transparent glaze, substances such as trace mineral substances, trace elements, nitrate, ammonia and the like contained in coffee slag can be expressed into a transparent vitreous structure through firing temperature and oxidizing calcination, so that a transparent enamel effect is brought to a base blank; the manufacturing method of the coffee grounds transparent glaze product is convenient to operate, and the product prepared by the method is transparent in enamel and good in visual effect; through detection, the material does not contain heavy metal substances, and further, the adverse effect of the raw materials on workers in the production process is avoided.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant oil pipe valve and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature-resistant oil pipe valve and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by weight: c:0.08-0.14%, si:0.15-0.45%, mn:0.50-0.95%, P: less than or equal to 0.025 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.025 percent, cr:11.5-13.5%, ni:0.42-0.6%, mo: less than or equal to 0.025 percent, V: less than or equal to 0.01 percent, nb: controlling the Ti, cu, al, H, O, N, W, B, co, ca content to be less than or equal to 0.05 percent; the gas content satisfies: h is less than 1.8PPM, O is less than or equal to 20PPM, and N is less than or equal to 70PPM. The invention aims at the martensitic heat-resistant stainless steel 12Cr13, improves the comprehensive performance of the material mainly by controlling the smelting mode, chemical components, forging deformation and heat treatment process of the raw materials, improves the production efficiency, has high one-time qualification rate and reduces the reworking cost and time.

title_en: Industrial silicon dioxide manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon dioxide manufacturing device, in particular to an industrial silicon dioxide manufacturing device. The technical problems to be solved are as follows: provides an industrial silicon dioxide manufacturing device which has higher working efficiency and can automatically feed.
