The invention provides industrial silicon dioxide manufacturing equipment which comprises a machine body shell, a first support column, a heating machine, a round bottom flask, a heat insulation pipe and the like, wherein the first support column is arranged on the left side of the inner bottom of the machine body shell, the heating machine is arranged at the top of the first support column, the round bottom flask is arranged in the middle of the top of the heating machine, the heat insulation pipe is arranged on the outer side of the top of the heating machine, and the round bottom flask is positioned in the heat insulation pipe. According to the invention, after the aerogel is condensed into the silica gel, the silica gel can enter the drying round bottle, and the motor is started, so that the first heating plate and the second heating plate generate friction heat, and the silica gel is solidified, so that waiting time of people is reduced, and working efficiency of people is improved.

title_en: Continuous casting method of non-calcium-treated low-carbon aluminum-killed phosphorus-containing steel
abstract_en: A continuous casting method of non-calcium-treated low-carbon aluminum-killed phosphorus-containing steel relates to the technical field of continuous casting of low-carbon aluminum-killed phosphorus-containing steel, and in particular belongs to a continuous casting method of non-calcium-treated low-carbon aluminum-killed phosphorus-containing steel. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, optimizing molten iron conditions: the molten iron is treated by 'pre-desulfurization', so that the sulfur content of molten iron entering a furnace is reduced to below 0.02%; step 2, optimizing converter operation and tapping control: controlling the alkalinity of converter slag and properly reducing gun positions; step 3, LF refining: ladle LF in-place molten steel temperature is not lower than 1550 ℃; step 4, continuous casting: the injection protection pouring adopts a refractory material protection sleeve immersed nozzle and inert gas shielding; and the tundish is added with a covering agent and simultaneously is fully protected by argon. The invention can improve the steelmaking environment, realize green steelmaking and has obvious economic benefit and ecological environmental protection benefit by carrying out non-calcium treatment on the premise of ensuring the smooth casting of molten steel.

title_en: Clamping mechanism with clamping structure for shell mold transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clamping mechanism with a clamping structure for shell mold transmission, which comprises a first plate body, a water collecting tank, a clamping block and a mounting plate, wherein a sliding block is arranged at the tail end of the first plate body, and a second plate body is arranged on the outer side of the first plate body. The invention has the beneficial effects that: this fixture is used in shell mould transmission with card fixed structure, be provided with the grip block of arcwall face, the centre gripping and the later stage transportation process to irregular face shell mould have been realized, practicality and commonality are stronger, and through the design of orifice, the water that gets into the inner chamber will directly see through the orifice blowout, and direct and centre gripping mould in the inboard contacts, the physics cooling to it has been realized, thereby avoid its surface temperature too high to bring the damage to other spare parts such as grip block, this fixture's whole life has been prolonged to a certain extent, the arch of equidistance distribution has effectively increased and has treated the friction between centre gripping thing and grip block, make processes such as later stage centre gripping and transportation safer and stable.

title_en: Method for recovering sodium cyanide and heavy metals from cyanide-containing wastewater through acidification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering sodium cyanide and heavy metals from cyanide-containing wastewater by acidification, which comprises the following steps: s1, controlling the temperature of the alkaline cyanide-containing high-concentration wastewater through a steam heat exchanger; s2, carrying out top-reducing cultivation on the heat-exchanged wastewater according to the speed of 2 m/h-5 m, then adding concentrated sulfuric acid, and carrying out top-reducing cultivation on the concentrated sulfuric acid at the speed of 25-30kg/m until the PH value is less than 2; the invention sends the waste water containing high concentration of alkaline cyanogen to the acidification spray tower through the steam heat exchanger, and then accelerates the reaction speed by adding the heat emitted by concentrated sulfuric acid, and the formed HCN is sent to the alkali absorption tower to be absorbed by the solution to form NaCN again, thereby achieving the purpose of recycling NaCN in the waste water; and part of CN & lt- & gt forms a complex with heavy metal ions such as Cu, Zn and the like in the wastewater, the complex formed by the heavy metal and cyanide is destroyed through secondary acidification, insoluble salt precipitation is generated, and HCN generated by the insoluble salt precipitation is absorbed through secondary alkali to form NaCN for recycling.

title_en: High-strength high-whiteness ceramic product and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength high-whiteness ceramic product and a processing technology thereof, wherein the high-strength high-whiteness ceramic product comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of tempered glass, 30-40 parts of nano precursor, 5-8 parts of quartz, 6-8 parts of magnesium oxide, 10-12 parts of binder, 10-15 parts of bentonite and 18-20 parts of kaolin; the processing technology of the high-strength high-whiteness ceramic product comprises the following steps: s1, stirring and mixing the reinforced glass, quartz, magnesium oxide, bentonite and kaolin, and ball-milling and sieving by a 200-mesh sieve to obtain a mixture; s2, adding the binder and the nano precursor into the mixture obtained in the step S1, and continuously stirring to obtain a molding material; and S3, molding, degumming and sintering the molding material obtained in the step S2 to obtain the high-strength high-whiteness ceramic product. The high-strength high-whiteness ceramic product prepared by the method has high whiteness, excellent strength and good mechanical properties.

title_en: Ceramic glazing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a ceramic glazing method, which comprises the following steps: step 1: taking 40-50% of metal oxide, 10-20% of fluorite powder, 10-22% of calcite, 2-4% of potassium oxide, 3-6% of kaolin, 3-6% of binder and 4-12% of ferric oxide according to weight percentage, and then adding 40-60% of water to grind the mixture to glaze with the concentration of pH value of 8; step 2: adding glaze into a glazing machine, spraying glaze slurry onto a ceramic product blank at 65-70 ℃ to form a glaze layer, and drying. The embodiment of the application can improve the quality of the ceramic product, enables the glaze of the ceramic product to be more complete, improves the overall ornamental value of the ceramic product, reduces the manufacturing procedures of the ceramic product and reduces the cost.

title_en: Coal gangue and steel slag pavement base mixture without alkali activator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road base construction, and provides an alkali-activator-free coal gangue and steel slag pavement base mixture and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mixture comprises the following components in parts by weight: 95-98 parts of coal gangue steel slag solid waste material and 2-5 parts of cementing material, wherein the coal gangue steel slag solid waste material comprises 55-65 parts of coal gangue and 30-40 parts of steel slag. Through the technical scheme, the problem of low strength of the coal gangue road surface base mixture in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Er and Pr added high-strength corrosion-resistant Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-strength corrosion-resistant Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy added with Er and Pr and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of metal alloys. The components by weight percentage include Zn7.20-8.00%, Mg2.00-2.32%, Cu2.00-2.46%, Zr0.15-0.22%, Er0.10-0.13%, Pr0.15-0.20%, Si less than or equal to 0.1%, Fe less than or equal to 0.1%, other single impurity less than or equal to 0.05%, total impurity less than or equal to 0.15%, and the balance of Al. Wherein Zn/Mg is more than or equal to 3.1 and less than or equal to 4.0, and Zr + Er + Pr is more than or equal to 0.40 and less than or equal to 0.55 percent. The invention also provides a preparation method of the high-strength corrosion-resistant Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy, and the produced high-strength corrosion-resistant Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy has the tensile strength of 620-635MPa, the yield strength of 395-415MPa, the elongation of 9.5-11.5 percent and the electrical conductivity of 34.0-35.0 percent IACS, has excellent comprehensive performance and is suitable for being used as a high-strength corrosion-resistant structural member.

title_en: Micro-nano hard soft magnetic two-phase hybrid particle reinforced aluminum-based composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-nano hard soft magnetic two-phase hybrid particle reinforced aluminum matrix composite material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal material metallurgy and heat treatment. Selecting micron-sized strong magnetic neodymium iron boron particles (Nd) 2 Fe 14 B) And amorphous nanocrystalline soft magnetic particles (Fe) 76 Si 9 B 10 P 5 ) Hybrid reinforced 7075 aluminum alloy. The invention puts the parent metal of the composite material block into a high-intensity magnetic field microwave short-time sintering furnace, adopts the high-intensity magnetic field auxiliary microwave sintering process and carries out solid solution treatment and magnetic field oil bath coupling aging treatment on the prepared parent metal to prepare the hybrid particle reinforced aluminum-based composite material with high strength, toughness and high magnetic performance. By regulating and controlling the proportion of different reinforcing particles and the magnetic field oil bath coupling aging treatment process, the aluminum-based composite material with excellent comprehensive mechanical property and magnetic property is obtained.

title_en: Equipment for preparing sulfuric acid and preheating method of equipment for preparing sulfuric acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment for preparing sulfuric acid and a preheating method of the equipment for preparing sulfuric acid, and relates to the technical field of sulfuric acid preparation. The equipment for preparing sulfuric acid comprises a waste heat boiler, a converter and a condenser. A steam drum is arranged above the waste heat boiler, the waste heat boiler is connected with a start-up steam pipe, and the start-up steam pipe is provided with a steam valve; a catalyst, an inter-bed cooler and a process gas cooler are arranged in the converter, one end of the converter is communicated with the waste heat boiler, the inter-bed cooler is communicated with the top of the steam drum, and the process gas cooler is communicated with the bottom of the steam drum; the condenser is in communication with the bottom of the converter. The equipment for preparing the sulfuric acid can ensure that the whole system has a faster heating rate, and can accurately control the heating rate of the process gas cooler, thereby protecting the condenser.

title_en: Zirconium dioxide powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of zirconium dioxide powder, which comprises the following steps: mixing the first raw material and the second raw material, and rubbing and drying to obtain precursor powder; and calcining the precursor powder to obtain the zirconium dioxide powder. Wherein the first raw material is a high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide solution or the first raw material comprises a high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide solution and a metal salt solution; the second raw material is a solid auxiliary agent which can be decomposed under the condition of heating or friction. The high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide comprises more than one of zirconium n-butoxide, zirconium isopropoxide, zirconium n-propoxide or zirconium ethoxide. The solid auxiliary agent comprises more than one of ammonium bicarbonate, ammonium carbonate or ammonium carbamate. The zirconium dioxide powder prepared by the preparation method is also provided. The preparation method of the zirconium dioxide powder provided by the invention has the advantages of simple steps, loose preparation conditions, uniform particle size, small particles, few impurities and the like.

title_en: Mo (molybdenum) 2 C and carbon-coated molybdenum-based heterostructure material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Mo  2  C and carbon-coated molybdenum-based heterostructure material, preparation method and application thereof, and Mo is grown in situ on the surface of the material  2  CT  X  Constructing a molybdenum-based material on the surface, and carbonizing the polymer on the surface of the material to obtain Mo  2  C and carbon-encased molybdenum-based heterostructure material. The material has a three-dimensional structure formed by self-assembly of a two-dimensional sheet structure, and high-conductivity Mo is respectively introduced into two sides of a molybdenum-based material  2  C and carbon construct and press from both sides the lamellar molybdenum-based heterostructure, can not merely raise the conductivity of the heterostructure material, but also can buffer the volume change in the charge-discharge process of the heterostructure material.

title_en: Method for recovering valuable metal by smelting copper dross
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for smelting and recovering valuable metals from copper dross. Copper dross slag, scrap iron, a slagging agent and a reducing agent are taken as raw materials to be proportioned; adding the prepared materials into a smelting furnace for heating reduction smelting, and generating lead bullion, smelting slag, copper matte and flue gas through reduction smelting; lead metal in the copper dross enters the crude lead, tin metal enters the crude lead, and copper metal enters the copper matte; the generated crude lead enters a tin removing procedure, and enters a crude lead electrolysis procedure after tin making slag to generate electrolytic lead; transferring the matte into a copper smelting system for recycling; the flue gas is subjected to dust collection treatment, the treated flue gas enters a tail gas system for emptying, and the obtained soot is returned to the smelting process to be used as an ingredient for reutilization. By adopting the technical scheme, the fluidity of the copper dross smelting slag is obviously improved, the layering effect of slag, copper matte and lead bullion in the furnace is enhanced in the smelting process, the phenomena of slag adhesion and material collapse in the furnace are reduced, the slag index is obviously reduced, the operation is safe and controllable, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Synthesis method of superfine monodisperse nano Ag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of superfine monodisperse nano Ag, belonging to the technical field of inorganic material preparation processes. The preparation method takes metal inorganic salt as a raw material, reacts in a long-chain amine solvent at 160-200 ℃ for 20-60 minutes, and forms the superfine monodisperse nano Ag with good crystallization, controllable composition, structure, morphology and size and particle size smaller than 5nm by controlling the reactant molar ratio, the reactant concentration and the reaction temperature experiment parameters. The method has the advantages of cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, less reaction time consumption, simple operation, good process repeatability, stable product quality, safe and reliable operation and suitability for industrial scale-up production.

title_en: Low-grade manganese ore reduction roasting system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-grade manganese ore reduction roasting system and a method. The reduction roasting method comprises the processes of drying, pulverizing, roasting, primary powder-gas separation, secondary powder-gas separation, high-temperature hot gas recycling, dust removal, desulfurization and the like. The invention can realize the large-scale reduction roasting of low-grade manganese ore, and coal gas is sprayed into the bottom of the sectional type reduction furnace, so that the contact area and the contact time are increased, and the manganese ore powder is fully reduced. The roasting temperature in the sectional type reduction furnace is controlled according to the amount of bituminous coal and coal gas, and the temperature is monitored in real time, so that the required temperature in the sectional type reduction furnace is always kept, and the waste of energy sources and the over reduction of manganese ore powder are avoided. High-temperature hot air is respectively conveyed to the sectional type reducing furnace and the drying equipment, so that the high-temperature hot air is effectively recycled, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Ni-RE series corrosion-resistant low-carbon hot-rolled steel strip and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel products, and provides a Ni-RE corrosion-resistant low-carbon hot rolled steel strip which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: c: less than or equal to 0.04 percent, si: less than or equal to 0.02 percent, mn: less than or equal to 0.12 percent, P: less than or equal to 0.015 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.005 percent, ti:0.015% -0.030%, als:0.025% -0.04%, RE:0.04% -0.05%, ni:0.80 to 1.00 percent, and the balance of iron and inevitable impurities, and also provides a production process of the Ni-RE corrosion-resistant low-carbon hot rolled steel strip. Through the technical scheme, the problem of poor corrosion resistance of the steel belt in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Preparation method of hydroxyl nano-alumina with controllable hydroxyl content
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of hydroxyl nano-alumina with controllable hydroxyl content, belonging to the technical field of nano-alumina. H 2 O 2 After dissolved in water, a large number of hydroxyl free radicals are dissociated, and the invention uses H 2 O 2 The solution is used as a solvent for precipitation reaction, in the precipitation reaction process, a precipitate is generated by soluble aluminum salt and a pore-expanding agent under an alkaline condition, and hydroxyl free radicals are distributed on the surface of the precipitate. During the drying process, hydroxyl free radicals are converted into bound water which is distributed on the surface and in pores of the aluminum hydroxide precursor, and during the roasting process, the bound water is bondedThe water of hydration is destroyed to form hydroxyl radicals. The invention can control H 2 O 2 The concentration of the solution regulates and controls the hydroxyl content of the hydroxyl nano-alumina, the hydroxyl content of the hydroxyl nano-alumina and the H 2 O 2 The concentration of the solution is positively correlated.

title_en: Preparation method of high-thermal-conductivity graphite film
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-thermal-conductivity graphite film, which takes graphite-phase nitrogen carbide and polyimide composite material as a graphite film precursor, and in the high-temperature carbonization and graphitization processes, the graphite-phase nitrogen carbide is taken as an orientation and crystallization inducer to promote the graphitization of polyimide, so that the high-thermal-conductivity graphite film is prepared. The method can reduce the temperature of the graphitization process and reduce energy consumption; the crystallinity of the graphite film can be improved, the flexibility is good, the thermal conductivity is high, the requirement of high heat dissipation in the existing microelectronic industry can be met, the defect of amorphous state of the graphite film is reduced, and the thermal conductivity and mechanical property of the graphite film are improved.

title_en: Hydraulic self-healing mortar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of concrete materials, and particularly relates to hydraulic self-healing mortar and a preparation method thereof. The hydraulic self-healing mortar is prepared by mixing 270-290 parts of a glue material, 700-750 parts of an aggregate, 4-4.5 parts of an additive, 1.5-9 parts of a repairing agent, 100-110 parts of water and 0.5-1.2% of fibers accounting for the total volume in parts by weight. The composite material is prepared by four steps of preparation, dry mixing, pulping and forced stirring. And repairing and inspecting the prepared mortar through five steps of preparation, die filling, crack reservation, maintenance and repair detection tests. The mortar has the functions of self-diagnosing cracks and self-repairing cracks, can provide a new research approach for improving the crack resistance of a concrete matrix or reducing the existing cracks of concrete, and can also provide guarantee measures for improving the performance of concrete materials so as to prolong the service life of concrete buildings.

title_en: Graphite-phase carbon nitride photocatalyst for sewage treatment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphite phase carbon nitride photocatalyst for sewage treatment and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials of the catalyst are as follows: the mass ratio of melamine to hexamethylenetetramine is 4200 (50-1000), and the preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: carrying out hydrothermal reaction on melamine and hexamethylenetetramine in a closed environment to obtain a novel precursor; calcining the modified precursor at high temperature to obtain modified graphite-phase carbon nitride; the photocatalytic degradation activity test result of the photocatalyst shows that compared with the activity before modification, the activity is improved by 8.5 times, the modified graphite phase carbon nitride introduces defects, the interlayer spacing is increased, the band gap is narrowed, stronger photocurrent response is achieved, and the carrier recombination is inhibited.

title_en: High-strength ZK60 magnesium alloy, magnesium-based composite material and preparation method
abstract_en: In order to solve the technical problem of low strength of the existing magnesium alloy preparation method, the invention provides a high-strength ZK60 magnesium alloy, a magnesium-based composite material and a preparation method thereof. The high-strength ZK60 magnesium alloy is composed of the following three ZK60 alloy powders with different grain diameters and mass proportions, wherein 25-45 mu m accounts for 20-30%, 45-75 mu m accounts for 40-60%, and 75-150 mu m accounts for 20-30%. On the basis of preparing the magnesium alloy and the composite material by the powder metallurgy method, the invention combines the hot extrusion process to further refine the grain sizes of the magnesium alloy and the composite material, thereby preparing the high-performance magnesium alloy and the composite material thereof and expanding the application range of the magnesium alloy and the magnesium-based composite material. The yield strength of the high-strength ZK60 magnesium alloy and magnesium-based composite material prepared by the invention is up to more than 250MPa, the tensile strength is up to more than 340MPa, and the strength of the high-strength ZK60 magnesium alloy and magnesium-based composite material is greatly superior to that of the magnesium alloy and magnesium-based composite material prepared by the prior art.

title_en: High-strength and high-toughness cast magnesium rare earth alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength and high-toughness cast magnesium-rare earth alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the magnesium alloy comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 2.6 to 3.0 percent of Nd,0.1 to 0.4 percent of Zn,0.1 to 0.4 percent of La,0.3 to 0.7 percent of Zr, less than 0.2 percent of total amount of impurity elements Si, fe, cu and Ni and the balance of Mg; the preparation method comprises the working procedures of material drying, magnesium melting, alloying element addition, refining, casting forming, heat treatment and the like. According to the invention, through microalloying of low-cost La element and optimization of a subsequent hot-treatment process, the room-temperature yield strength of the Mg-Nd series alloy is obviously improved, and meanwhile, the manufacturing cost of the alloy is not obviously increased, so that the popularization and application of the Mg-Nd series alloy are facilitated.

title_en: Martensitic stainless steel for valve body and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses martensitic stainless steel for a valve body and a preparation method thereof, which are prepared by selecting high-quality raw materials and adopting the processes of EAF furnace primary smelting → AOD furnace refining → LF furnace refining → VD furnace degassing → die casting → steel ingot annealing → forging → post-forging annealing, strictly controlling parameters in each process, further controlling the contents of impurity elements such as S, P and the like on the basis of Cr13 martensitic steel, improving the purity of the steel, controlling the contents of gas elements H and O, reducing white spots and cracking tendency, controlling the contents of C, cu, V and five harmful elements, and improving the impact property of the steel.

title_en: High-toughness and high-thermal-stability die steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-toughness and high-thermal-stability die steel and a preparation method thereof, and the effects of modifying inclusions, reducing the sizes of the inclusions and refining as-cast structures are achieved by limiting the composition and the process of the die steel, so that the die steel with good toughness, good thermal stability and good wear resistance is prepared, the die steel still keeps high toughness and excellent thermal fatigue resistance in a working environment of more than 600 ℃, and the service life of the die steel is greatly prolonged; the method comprises the steps of selecting a non-vacuum induction furnace, refining in an LF furnace, and VD degassing to prepare a low-oxygen die steel body, wherein when the die steel body is prepared, the impact toughness of the die steel is remarkably improved by limiting the contents of vanadium, cerium and yttrium and eliminating the influence caused by overlarge size of inclusions generated by yttrium in the low-oxygen die steel by cerium; using tungsten carbide powder and (Co) 34 Fe 8 Cr 29 Ni 8 B 14 ) 100‑   x Si x The powder carries out laser cladding on the surface of the die steel body, so that the thermal stability and the wear resistance of the die steel are greatly improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic rolling surface strengthening method for optimizing surface performance of nickel-based single crystal superalloy
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrasonic rolling surface strengthening method for optimizing the surface performance of a nickel-based single crystal superalloy, and relates to the technical field of deformation processing of alloy plates. The invention adopts the surface ultrasonic rolling technology, and further prepares the nickel-base single crystal superalloy plate with excellent surface performance by controlling parameters such as the down force of an ultrasonic vibration processing head, ultrasonic frequency, amplitude, a feeding route, a feeding speed, a cooling method and the like of a machine tool. Under the combined action of ultrasonic impact load and plane shearing force, residual compressive stress is effectively introduced on the surface of the nickel-based single crystal superalloy plate, the residual compressive stress gradually decreases from the surface layer to the matrix structure, the microhardness value of the surface layer is obviously improved, the residual compressive stress gradually decreases from the surface layer to the matrix structure, and meanwhile, the surface roughness value of the original cutting surface of the plate is obviously reduced by surface ultrasonic rolling processing, so that the surface quality of the material is effectively improved. The surface quality of the material is improved in many aspects without grain refinement on the surface, so that the fatigue resistance of the material is obviously improved.

title_en: Cement material processing device and cement material processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cement material treatment device and a cement material treatment method, wherein the device comprises: a pre-decomposition section; the pre-firing part comprises a first material inlet, a first circulating inlet and a first circulating outlet; a firing section including a second material inlet and a second circulation outlet, and a second fuel inlet and a second air distribution inlet; the material inlet of the separator is communicated with the first circulating outlet; the distributor is provided with a first inlet, a first distribution port and a second distribution port, wherein the first distribution port and the second distribution port are communicated with the first inlet; the material outlet of the pre-decomposition part is communicated with the first material inlet, and the second circulating outlet is communicated with the first circulating inlet; and a cooling part adapted to cool the cement material from the firing part.

title_en: Casting wax and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides casting wax and a preparation method thereof, wherein the casting wax comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 70-80 parts of methylene polymer, 15-25 parts of microcrystalline wax, 1.5-5 parts of modified rosin and 1-5 parts of PE oligomer. Through specific compounding of the raw materials, the prepared casting wax has excellent bending strength, surface hardness, viscosity, small linear shrinkage and ash content, and better thermal stability, so that the mechanical property, the technological property and the thermal stability of the casting wax meet the requirements, the related indexes are close to those of foreign imported products, the casting wax is suitable for medium-temperature precision casting products, and the casting wax also has better coating property, fluidity and reusability and strong product competitiveness.

title_en: Metal bond, metal bond diamond grinding wheel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a metal bond, a metal bond diamond grinding wheel and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the metal bond comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 35-60% of copper powder, 2-10% of tin powder, 5-20% of Babbitt metal, 10-30% of hydroxyl iron powder, 3-15% of red copper fiber and 1-5% of graphite particles. According to the metal bond, the metal bond diamond grinding wheel and the manufacturing method thereof, tin-based Babbitt alloy is added into the metal bond, so that the strength and hardness of the grinding wheel can be improved, tin powder is hardly separated out during high-temperature pressing, and the stability of the performance of the grinding wheel is greatly improved.

title_en: Aerogel composite, method for producing same, support member with aerogel composite, and heat insulating material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aerogel composite, a method for producing the same, a support member with the aerogel composite, and a heat insulating material. The method for producing an aerogel composite according to the present invention comprises the steps of: a step of preparing a liquid composition containing silica particles and at least one selected from the group consisting of a silicon compound having a hydrolyzable functional group in a molecule and a hydrolysis product of the silicon compound; a step of preparing a sol from the liquid composition; and a step of drying the wet gel produced from the sol.

title_en: Rare earth magnesium alloy wire suitable for electric arc additive manufacturing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a rare earth magnesium alloy wire material suitable for electric arc additive manufacturing, which comprises the following steps: s1: provides a rare earth magnesium alloy cast rod which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: gadolinium (Gd): 8.0 to 12.0%, yttrium Y: 2.5-4.5%, zn:0.5 to 2.5%, zr: 0.3-0.8%, other single impurity elements: ≦ 0.1%, total of other impurity elements: less than or equal to 0.2 percent, the balance being magnesium Mg, and the diameter of the rare earth magnesium alloy cast rod is 150-170 mm; s3: forging and forming; s4: extrusion molding; s5: drawing and forming; s6: and (6) peeling. Through the procedures of homogenization treatment, forging forming, extrusion forming, drawing forming, annealing heat treatment, peeling and the like, the prepared rare earth magnesium alloy wire has the advantages of long and thin equal diameter, uniform structure, good surface quality and stable wire feeding performance.

title_en: Rotary seat die and casting process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swivel base mould and a casting process thereof, which has the technical scheme that the swivel base mould comprises an upper mould and a lower mould, a die core group is arranged between the upper die and the lower die, the upper die, the lower die and the die core group are mutually matched, a first iron chill is arranged in the ring groove, a second iron chill is arranged in the positioning cavity, an aluminum chill is arranged in the concave cavity, the aluminum chill also comprises a first ring block and a second ring block, the second ring block is positioned above the first ring block, the surface where the side wall of the shaft cavity is positioned is superposed with the surface where the inner side surface of the aluminum chill is positioned, so that the side wall of the shaft cavity can be rapidly cooled by the aluminum chill, and improve the cooling rate of cavity diapire, make it follow the cooling rate of location chamber department for cool off more evenly, reduce the bad condition of feeding in cavity diapire corner and appear.

title_en: Refractory castable for lime spray gun and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refractory castable for a lime spray gun and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the refractory castable for the lime spray gun comprises raw materials and a water reducing agent; the raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by weight: 28-30% of M70 sintered mullite; 35-40% of flint clay; 5-7% of titanium calcium aluminate; 11-15% of ceramic micro powder; 10-12% of a wax stone; 0.7-1.2% of pure calcium aluminate cement; 1.5-2.0% of silicon micropowder; the water reducing agent accounts for 0.03-0.06 wt% of the raw material. According to the invention, by designing the components and the proportion of the refractory castable for the lime spray gun, the lime spray gun can have good high-temperature mechanical strength, thermal shock resistance stability and slag erosion resistance at the temperature of 1350-1400 ℃, so that the lime spray gun has a good service life.

title_en: Photocatalytic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical catalysts, and particularly relates to a photocatalytic material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the amount of carbon nitride doped in boron nitride and the preparation process are adjusted to prepare the carbon nitride modified boron nitride photocatalytic material, and the photocatalytic material can rapidly remove typical new pollutants in a water body under the illumination condition, so that the photocatalyst is an environment-friendly photocatalyst with an energy-saving effect. The preparation method of the invention can realize the combination of the carbon nitride modified boron nitride photocatalyst and the cellulose filter membrane by two simple processes of crosslinking and drying, has the advantages of less raw materials, simple synthesis process and good repeatability, and also has basic conditions for large-scale production, higher application potential and use value.

title_en: Low-water-absorption organic/inorganic composite silicon-based coating on concrete surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic/inorganic composite silicon-based coating with low water absorption on a concrete surface and a preparation method thereof, wherein the coating comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 1-3 parts of acid catalyst, 10-20 parts of KH570, 40-80 parts of absolute ethyl alcohol, 40-80 parts of deionized water, 10-20 parts of ethyl orthosilicate, 5-15 parts of modifier 1 and 1-10 parts of modifier 2; the modifier 1 is one or two of hydroxyl-terminated polydimethylsiloxane and vinyl-terminated dimethylpolysiloxane; the modifier 2 is one or two of nano clay and nano silicon dioxide, and the acidic catalyst is one or two of acetic acid and hydrochloric acid. The invention uses a sol-gel method to prepare an organic/inorganic mixed coating applied to the surface of concrete so as to reduce the water absorption of the concrete and achieve the effect of protecting the concrete.

title_en: Fe 3 O 4 @MnO 2 -CeO 2 Nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of catalyst materials, and discloses Fe  3  O  4  @MnO  2  ‑CeO  2  A preparation method and application of the nano material. The Fe  3  O  4  @MnO  2  ‑CeO  2  The nano material has multiple enzyme-like activities, has activities of peroxidase-like enzyme, superoxide dismutase-like enzyme and phenol oxidase besides conventional oxidase-like activity, and can be used for preparing oxidase-like enzyme, peroxidase-like enzyme, superoxide dismutase-like enzyme or phenol oxidase catalyst. The material has the characteristics of easy preparation, high stability, low cost and strong catalytic capability, and can be used for chemical treatmentChemical catalysis, biological treatment, chemical detection, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Potassium nitrate purifying device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a potassium nitrate purification device and a method, relating to the technical field of potassium nitrate purification devices and comprising the following steps: a feed cylinder, a feed cylinder rotates the inside of connecting at protective housing, the feeding subassembly is when possessing the feeding filler function, also compromise the function of purification subassembly internal seal shutoff, thereby avoid the harmful vapor excessive that produces in proposing the dissolution operation, guarantee operational environment's clean and tidy safety, and the pressure control subassembly can be automatic carry out the safety purification according to the orderly purification subassembly inside harmful vapor of will purifying in the subassembly discharges to specific clarification plant of gas pressure, can effectively collect and purify harmful vapor, the dissolving tank of having solved current purification device is uncovered design, do not have any sealed or purification structure, lead to nitric acid to form the vapor that contains a large amount of harmful potassium nitrate to the human body in the hot dissolution in-process and overflow, the relatively poor problem of security.

title_en: Preparation method of special nano calcium carbonate for polyester family degradable plastics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano calcium carbonate special for polyester family degradable plastics, which adopts a zirconium alcohol compound as a crystal form control agent, so that the problem of high moisture absorption rate of the nano calcium carbonate caused by residual crystal control agent can be effectively avoided; the associative polyurethane thickener is added in the later stage of carbonation reaction, and the water-based thixotropic network constructed by polyurethane is used for replacing a hydrogen bond network on the surface of calcium carbonate, so that the aggregation phenomenon generated by crystals can be effectively reduced, and the phenomenon of high water content of nano calcium carbonate caused by the aggregation phenomenon is avoided; meanwhile, the invention adopts aprotic solvent to wash the filter cake for multiple times in the filter pressing process, so that a residual hydrogen bond network system of the nano calcium carbonate filter cake can be removed as much as possible, capillary pore effect caused by the filter cake drying process is reduced, the drying efficiency of the nano calcium carbonate finished product is further improved, and the technical effect that the nano calcium carbonate with the moisture content less than 0.1% can be produced in conventional drying equipment and preparation systems is realized.

title_en: Burr microspheric MnO 2 Preparation method of material and application of material in sterilization and disinfection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrode active materials, and particularly relates to burr microspheric MnO  2  A preparation method of the material and sterilization and disinfection application. In the invention, urea is added in the reaction process, and the hydrothermal reaction time is controlled, so that burr microspherical MnO can be prepared  2  A material having a regular, stable microstructure and a higher specific surface area; further reducing burr to micro-spherical MnO  2  The material is deposited on the electrode, the water quality to be treated is firstly subjected to voltage electrification treatment to change the permeability of cell membranes, and then is subjected to ozone aeration treatment, so that the material can be more easily treatedDirectly decompose substances such as protein, nucleic acid and the like in cells through cell membranes, cause irreversible lethal damage to the cells and achieve remarkable sterilization and disinfection effects.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding glass fiber and rigid circuit board
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic shielding glass fiber, which comprises the following raw materials: 30-45 wt% of silicon dioxide; 25-30 wt% of aluminum oxide; 1-5 wt% of boron oxide; 5-10 wt% of calcium oxide; 7-10 wt% of magnesium oxide; 0-3 wt% of sodium oxide; 2-5 wt% of potassium oxide; 0-2 wt% of lithium oxide; 0.5-1 wt% of iron-based soft magnetic alloy; 2-5 wt% of ferrite. The iron-based soft magnetic alloy and the ferrite are introduced into the electromagnetic shielding glass fiber, and the ranges of the iron-based soft magnetic alloy and the ferrite are adjusted, so that the obtained electromagnetic shielding glass fiber has the characteristics of wide electromagnetic shielding range or high resistivity according to performance requirements.

title_en: Self-preheating ignition heat preservation furnace with tube bank radiation heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sintering ignition furnaces, and particularly discloses a self-preheating ignition heat-preserving furnace with a tube row radiation heat exchanger, which comprises a trolley, an ignition region and a heat-preserving region, wherein the ignition region and the heat-preserving region are arranged above the trolley, a plurality of ignition nozzles capable of igniting iron ore are arranged in the ignition region, a heat exchange assembly capable of exchanging heat is arranged in the heat-preserving region, the heat exchange assembly comprises a heat exchange shell, an air inlet gas collecting box fixedly connected in the heat exchange shell, a plurality of radiation heat exchange tubes communicated with the air inlet gas collecting box, and an air outlet gas collecting box communicated with the free ends of the radiation heat exchange tubes, and outlet pipelines communicated with the air outlet gas collecting box are arranged on the nozzles.

title_en: Hybrid cam Kong Shaxin with metal chill for cast aluminum cylinders
abstract_en: A system for manufacturing a hybrid cam hole sand core with a metal chill for an engine block includes an engine block casting of aluminum material. The camshaft bore extends through the engine block. A cam bore sand core having at least one metal chill is positioned within the cam bore. During casting of the engine block, the body portion of the at least one metallic chiller is positioned in direct contact with the cam bearing surface of the at least one cam bearing member to increase a cooling rate of the at least one cam bearing member and to produce a depth of crystalline material of the cam bearing member having enhanced mechanical properties.

title_en: High-strength rock plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength rock plate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-strength rock plate comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-55 parts of kaolin, 15-25 parts of bauxite, 10-15 parts of feldspar, 2-5 parts of talc, 10-20 parts of quartz, 1-10 parts of ceramic fiber, 20-25 parts of diatomite, 5-10 parts of basalt, 20-25 parts of montmorillonite and 10-20 parts of zirconium white frit, mixing the components together according to a set dosage ratio to prepare a mixed slurry, performing spray drying granulation on the mixed slurry to obtain spherical granular powder with certain fluidity, sieving and ageing to obtain green body powder with the water content of 5-10%, performing ground glaze distribution, ink-jet decoration and surface glaze distribution on the surface of a dried biscuit, firing and molding, and then cooling, edging, polishing and waxing to obtain the rock plate. The invention has higher strength and certain antibacterial ability.

title_en: Seamless steel pipe for drilling and production and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seamless steel pipe for drilling, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: c: 0.10% -0.14%, Si: 0.55-0.70%, Mn: 0.30% -0.50%, P: less than or equal to 0.010 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.003 percent, Cr: 1.55-1.70%, Mo: 0.50% -0.70%, V: 0.03% -0.05%, Ni: 0.81-1.00%, Ti: 0.055% -0.080%, B: 0.0005% -0.0050%, N: 0.010% -0.019%, Als: 0.01% -0.05%, H: less than or equal to 0.0002 percent, O: less than or equal to 0.0021 percent and Ti/N is more than or equal to 3.5 percent; the balance being Fe. The invention can greatly improve the use safety of steel pipes needing high strength grade, such as high-pressure wells, deep wells and the like in complex environment. The manufacturing process of the steel pipe is green and environment-friendly, the working procedures are fewer, the production period is shorter, and the economic cost and the time cost are reduced.

title_en: Slag multi-mode cooling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slag multi-mode cooling system, which comprises a water cooling tower and an air cooling box which are arranged in parallel, wherein the top of the water cooling tower is provided with an open feeding port, a lifting cylinder which downwards extends into the water cooling tower is fixed at the feeding port, the top of the lifting cylinder is communicated with the air cooling box through a transfer channel, the upper part of the side surface of the water cooling tower is provided with a tower water replenishing port for inputting cooling water, the bottom of the side surface of the water cooling tower is provided with a tower water outlet for discharging hot water, and a separation net for separating slag and water is arranged in the water cooling tower; this system water cooling tower, forced air cooling case and washing heat exchange box's cooperation setting carries out solid washing, solid forced air cooling and gas heat exchange's multimode cooling to the slay of high temperature respectively, not only can realize the cooling of slay fast to can effectual recovery heat, reduce the loss of the energy, whole process automation seals goes on, has also avoided the production of pollution, adapts to large-scale mill and carries out the quick cooling of slay, improves cooling efficiency, reduces the production spending.

title_en: Center feeding die-casting die suitable for large-size parts
abstract_en: The invention discloses a center feeding die-casting die suitable for large-size parts, which comprises a movable die, a fixed die and a die core, wherein the die core is arranged between the movable die and the fixed die; the cutting module is arranged above the runner of the fixed die and used for extruding and cutting the molded product and the runner; the cooling module is arranged in the flow channel and used for cooling the flow channel; the runner on the fixed die is arranged at intervals along a straight line or at intervals along the circumferential direction from the center of the fixed die. This application reduces the product flow length through the mode that adopts the center feeding, satisfies the performance requirement to jumbo size die casting, improves the uniformity of product.

title_en: Process for treating fluorine-containing waste water as resource
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for treating fluoride-containing wastewater as resource, which comprises adding sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide to adjust the pH value of the wastewater to 7-9, adding hydrochloric acid or nitric acid to control the pH value of the wastewater to 4-6, separating porous flocculent silica gel in the wastewater, adding a calcium-containing precipitator into clear water to generate calcium fluoride crystals, carrying out coagulation reaction on the clear water without the calcium fluoride crystals, and removing flocculent precipitate generated by the coagulation reaction to obtain water capable of being discharged in three stages.

title_en: Method for improving copper recovery rate from copper-cadmium slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the recovery rate of copper from copper-cadmium slag. Placing the copper-cadmium slag in a leaching tank, adding dilute sulfuric acid for leaching, and filtering after leaching to obtain enriched copper slag and leaching liquid; carrying out primary replacement reaction on the obtained leaching liquid to obtain sponge cadmium, and returning residual cadmium slag obtained by secondary replacement reaction to a leaching tank for recycling cadmium repeatedly; pickling the enriched copper slag, and carrying out filter pressing after pickling to obtain pickled copper slag and pickling solution; the pickling solution is returned to prepare dilute sulfuric acid for leaching copper-cadmium slag; washing the obtained acid-washed copper slag with water, carrying out filter pressing after washing with water to obtain copper ash and a copper slag washing liquid, and sending the obtained copper ash to a copper factory for pyrometallurgical smelting; and introducing the obtained copper slag water washing liquid into the obtained leaching liquid for secondary replacement reaction, and returning the generated residual cadmium slag to the leaching tank again to recover copper and cadmium. By adopting the method for treating the copper-cadmium slag, the copper recovery rate is improved to 55.01% from the existing 48.5% to the maximum; and the process operation is simple, and equipment is not increased.

title_en: Converter capable of preventing fast descending
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of converters, and particularly relates to a converter capable of preventing fast descending, which comprises a converter body, wherein a fixed seat is arranged at the middle height of the front side and the rear side of the converter body, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the central position of the fixed seat, a clamping block is arranged outside the rotating shaft, a rectangular blade is fixed on the rotating shaft, a rectangular open slot is arranged in the middle of the rectangular blade, a rotating sleeve is sleeved on the rotating shaft at the corresponding position of the rectangular open slot, a one-way blocking piece is connected to the rotating sleeve and comprises a filling block matched with the rectangular open slot and a blocking piece connected with the filling block, and resistance oil is filled in a column-shaped empty slot; the jib is connected to the overhead traveling crane, jib bottom fixed connection piece, is equipped with the screens logical groove that matches with the screens piece in the middle of the connecting block. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages: through reasonable arrangement of the rectangular blades and the one-way blocking pieces, the converter can receive flexible resistance when descending by matching with resistance oil, the descending speed is reduced, the operation difficulty of workers when the converter body is lifted is reduced, and the steel-making efficiency is improved.

title_en: 20CrMo round steel and production process method
abstract_en: The invention discloses 20CrMo round steel and a production process method thereof, wherein the round steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: 0.17 to 0.22 percent of C, 0.18 to 0.34 percent of Si, 0.40 to 0.68 percent of Mn, less than or equal to 0.020 percent of P, S, 0.80 to 1.08 percent of Cr, less than or equal to 0.030 percent of Ni and Cu, Mo: 0.15-0.23, and the balance of iron. According to the specification, under the condition of adding a small amount of microalloy elements, the comprehensive performance of the product is improved by controlling the smelting and rolling process, the use requirement of the sucker rod can be met, the slag discharge amount of the converter smelting process is strictly controlled by a double-slag method, the converter smelting process adopts a high-alkalinity, high-oxidability and low-temperature mode to blow for 7-10 minutes, then slag is poured once, and then slag is formed again, so that molten steel is cast after reaching the design components and the casting temperature, the continuous casting pulling speed fluctuation is less than 0.1m/min, the carbon content, the sulfur content and the phosphorus content can be reduced, and the strength, the toughness and the fatigue strength of steel are ensured to meet the requirements of the sucker rod.

title_en: Laser 3D printing multi-metal material forming device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser 3D printing multi-metal material forming device which comprises a light path system, a bottom plate, a powder collecting module, a left vertical plate, a right vertical plate, a powder falling module, a powder feeding mechanism, a slide rail, a sliding connection block, a rear scraper, an L-shaped support, a powder storage strip and a front scraper. The powder feeding mechanism and the powder paving mechanism are organically integrated, the space of a molding cabin is not occupied, the powder paving and compacting functions of the selective laser melting technology and the real-time powder feeding function of the laser cladding technology are utilized, the limitation that the selective laser melting technology can only mold a single material is broken through, the integrated rapid molding of various metal materials is realized, and the application field is widened.

title_en: Building regenerated micro-powder non-fired ceramsite and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a complete invention name of a building regeneration micro powder non-sintered ceramsite and a preparation method thereof, wherein the building regeneration micro powder non-sintered ceramsite comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of construction regenerated micro powder, 5-15 parts of straw ash, 10-30 parts of cement, 3-9 parts of lime, 6-18 parts of gypsum, 0.35-0.5 part of cellulose ether and 15-30 parts of water; the building regeneration micro powder raw material is waste concrete subjected to ball milling, and the particle size of the waste concrete subjected to ball milling is not larger than 200 meshes. The technical indexes of the building regenerated micro-powder baking-free ceramsite produced by the method meet the standard of common lightweight aggregate in GB174311-2010, can meet the requirements of the building market, replace the traditional natural aggregate, relieve the problem of building material resource shortage, and promote the development road of green, environment-friendly, recyclable and economic building materials in the future.

title_en: Control method for linear defects of hot rolled edge of low-carbon aluminum killed steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method for linear defects of a hot rolled edge part of low-carbon aluminum killed steel, which belongs to the technical field of ferrous metallurgy and comprises the following steps: s1, converting molten iron until the components and the temperature of the molten iron at the converting end point meet preset values, and tapping to obtain tapped molten steel; s2, lifting the tapped molten steel to a refining furnace for refining, and coarsely adjusting components according to the result of an incoming steel sample, wherein the content ratio of aluminum to nitrogen is more than or equal to 6, and the content ratio of manganese to sulfur is more than or equal to 30; obtaining molten steel; s3, conveying the molten steel to a continuous casting machine for casting to obtain a plate blank; and S4, rolling the cast slab to obtain a qualified hot rolled steel coil. The invention only starts from the smelting angle, namely, the aim of improving the high-temperature plasticity of the steel and reducing the linear defects of the hot rolled edge is achieved by adjusting the chemical components of specific elements in the steel.

title_en: Production process of bromine from desalted concentrated seawater
abstract_en: The invention provides a production process of bromine from desalinated concentrated seawater, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: acidifying and oxidizing brine; step two: an air blowing step; step three: an absorption and enrichment step; step four: an oxidation distillation step; step five: and (5) tail gas recovery. The method of the invention provides a process technology for extracting bromine from concentrated seawater after seawater desalination for the first time, wherein dilute acid is adopted to adjust the pH value to 2.0-4.0, chlorine gas is added to carry out oxidation reaction in a pipeline reactor, and the addition amount of the chlorine gas is 1.05-1.35 times of the theoretical addition amount. The process flow is simple, the extraction rate of bromine is high, the utilization rate of elements is high, the cost is low, and the quality of industrial bromine of a product obtained by separating bromine water reaches the QB/T2021-1994 high-class product standard.

title_en: Method for extracting manganese from acid leaching modified manganese-rich slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting manganese from acid leaching modified manganese-rich slag, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgical chemical industry. The method of the invention is characterized by modifying the manganese-rich slag: uniformly mixing the manganese-rich slag and the modifier according to a certain mass ratio, putting the mixture into a container, covering a layer of carbon-containing substances on the surface of the mixture, covering the container, sealing the container to enable the mixture to be in a molten state, and preserving heat for a period of time; grinding, acid leaching and separating to obtain pickle liquor. The method can ensure the complete high-temperature modification reaction, reduce the impurity carrying-in amount and improve the leaching rate of Mn; the acid consumption can be effectively reduced, the influence of atmosphere on the technology is avoided, and the reproducibility, stability, adaptability and applicability of the technology are improved; the reaction temperature condition can be effectively improved, sufficient thermal compensation is provided, and the slag discharging sensible heat of the high-temperature hot manganese-rich slag is reasonably utilized.

title_en: Production device of high-activity potassium fluoride
abstract_en: The application provides a production device of high activity potassium fluoride, belongs to potassium fluoride production technical field. This apparatus for producing of high activity potassium fluoride includes the support frame, the top of support frame is fixed with drying chamber body and liquid reserve tank, the liquid reserve tank sets up one side of drying chamber body, the top of liquid reserve tank is fixed with the drawing liquid pump, the output of hot-blast furnace with a intercommunication bloies, the top of drying chamber body is provided with the stirring piece, the output of suction pump with the top intercommunication of drying chamber body, the below intercommunication of drying chamber body has row material pipe, the collecting box is fixed the top of shallow is favorable to improving drying effect and the drying quality to potassium fluoride, is favorable to reducing dry time, can reduce the consumption of the energy, is convenient for collect and transport solid-state potassium fluoride, is favorable to carrying out the persistence drying to potassium fluoride for potassium fluoride's production efficiency.

title_en: Rotary hearth furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary hearth furnace, belongs to the technical field of direct reduction of rotary hearth furnaces, and solves the problems of high carbon emission amount, low product metallization rate and no recovery of high-temperature sensible heat of metallized pellets in the direct reduction of the rotary hearth furnace. The rotary hearth furnace comprises a reduction section, a first cooling section and a discharge end which are communicated in sequence; the online cooling device is arranged above the first cooling section and comprises a hydrogen-rich gas generating unit and a hydrogen-rich gas conveying unit which are connected; the hydrogen-rich gas generating unit is used for providing hydrogen-rich gas; the hydrogen-rich gas conveying unit comprises a conveying pipeline, and the conveying pipeline is arranged at the top of the rotary hearth furnace and is communicated with the first cooling section of the rotary hearth furnace; the hydrogen-rich gas is generated by the hydrogen-rich gas generating unit and then is conveyed to the first cooling section by the hydrogen-rich gas conveying unit, and the metallized pellets are cooled and deeply reduced by the hydrogen-rich gas in the first cooling section. The invention can reduce the reduction energy consumption of the rotary hearth furnace.

title_en: Stainless steel for separator of polymer fuel cell having excellent corrosion resistance
abstract_en: The present specification relates to stainless steel for a separator of a polymer fuel cell having excellent corrosion resistance. More specifically, disclosed is stainless steel for a separator of a polymer fuel cell, which has excellent corrosion resistance in a sulfuric acid environment, which is an operating environment of the fuel cell. According to one embodiment of the disclosed stainless steel for a separator of a polymer fuel cell, the stainless steel comprises, in weight%: c: 0.09% or less, Si: 1.0% or more and less than 2.5%, Mn: 1.0% or less (excluding 0), S: 0.003% or less, Cr: 20% to 23%, Ni: 9% to 13%, W: 1.0% or less (excluding 0), N: 0.10 to 0.25% of N, and Fe and other inevitable impurities in the remainder, and a corrosion resistance index represented by the following formula (1) is 7 or more: (1) 3W +1.5Si +0.1 Cr + 20N-2 Mn, wherein in formula (1), W, Si, Cr, N and Mn each represent the content (wt%) of each element.

title_en: Preparation device, preparation method and application of rare earth magnesium alloy powder
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation device, a preparation method and application of rare earth magnesium alloy powder, wherein the preparation device comprises a box body, an ingot fixing device for fixing a rare earth magnesium alloy ingot is arranged on the box body, a gas pressurizing device and a powder collecting device are respectively arranged above and below the rare earth magnesium alloy ingot, a mechanical arm is also fixed on the box body, a polishing motor is arranged on the mechanical arm, an alloy polishing head is rotatably arranged in the polishing motor, and the alloy polishing head is in contact with the rare earth magnesium alloy ingot. The method adopts the preparation device, adopts the processing temperature of 200-300 ℃ and prepares the rare earth magnesium alloy powder in the environment with the oxygen content of 100-500 ppm. The preparation device can realize omnibearing polishing of the rare earth magnesium alloy cast ingot and collection of small-particle-size powder, and can also avoid element burning loss and oxidation aggravation of the rare earth magnesium alloy powder. The rare earth magnesium alloy powder can be used as metal raw material powder for preparing selective laser melting materials.

title_en: Device and method for preparing hydrogen and oxygen by irradiating liquid water with electrons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for preparing hydrogen and oxygen by irradiating liquid water with electrons, comprising an electron source chamber and a reaction chamber, wherein the electron source chamber and the reaction chamber are isolated by a metal film with high melting point; the cathode, the insulating core transformer, the rectifier filter, the accelerator and the metal film as the anode are arranged in the electron source chamber; a gas-collecting cathode, a gas-collecting anode, a hydrogen separation chamber and an oxygen separation chamber are arranged in the reaction chamber, and the gas-collecting anode and the gas-collecting cathode are connected with the anode and the cathode of a direct current power supply DC; compared with the traditional method and device, the method has many advantages, does not need catalysts, solutes, water vapor and auxiliary carrier gas, and has the advantages of separation of an energy source and a reactor, stability, safety and the like. The method is novel and has not been reported. The invention has good practical value, provides a sustainable route for synergistically converting rich water and energy resources into hydrogen, and can provide reference for hydrogenation and gasification of fossil fuels.

title_en: Material distribution method of blast furnace
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a material distribution method of a blast furnace, which comprises the following steps: when a planned wind stopping signal for the blast furnace is triggered, reducing coke load and central coke proportion of the blast furnace step by step; when the air supply recovery signal for the blast furnace is triggered, the coke load and the central coke proportion of the blast furnace are increased step by step. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the application can avoid the overhigh temperature of the central gas when the air is stopped and the air supply is recovered to a certain extent, thereby prolonging the service life of blast furnace equipment.

title_en: Non-quenched and tempered steel for engineering machinery wheel shaft and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses non-quenched and tempered steel for an engineering machinery axle and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method comprises the working procedures of smelting, LF refining, VD vacuum treatment, continuous casting, rolling and cooling; carrying out temperature-controlled rolling on the non-quenched and tempered steel billet; specifically, the temperature is heated to 1150-1200 ℃ before rolling, and the temperature is kept for 1.5-2.5 h; the initial rolling temperature is 950-1080 ℃; the finishing temperature is controlled to be 850-880 ℃; and (3) cooling at a controlled speed after rolling, specifically, controlling the cooling speed to be 5.0-8.5 ℃/s to 550-600 ℃ through water penetration, and then cooling to room temperature at the speed of 1.5-2.5 ℃/s. The method improves the performance of the non-quenched and tempered steel by controlling the cooling speed after rolling; meanwhile, the strength of the steel is further improved by using the microalloy elements.

title_en: Sheet metal part heat treatment device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for heat treatment of sheet metal parts, wherein the device comprises: the heating furnace comprises a furnace body, a furnace cover and a heating element; the rotary equipment comprises a rotary shaft, a plurality of rotary bottom plates, a guide ring, a driving mechanism and a plate mounting frame; the cooling equipment is connected with the furnace body and used for providing cooling air for cooling in the furnace body; and a control device connected to the heating element, the drive mechanism and the cooling device. The sheet metal part heat treatment device can greatly eliminate the influence of temperature differences of different horizontal positions and height positions on the heat treatment effect in the processes of heating, heat preservation and the like, so that the heat treatment effects of all plates in the same furnace are closer, and the difference is reduced; on the other hand, all the plates can be more fully and uniformly contacted with cooling air in the cooling treatment process to be cooled, so that the uniformity of the cooling treatment can be improved, and the cooling effect is effectively improved.

title_en: Floor slab pouring method for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a floor slab pouring method for a building, belonging to the technical field of buildings; the method comprises the following steps: step S1: installing a template: erecting a floor slab template on the Nth layer in an area surrounded by the wall body on the Nth layer; step S2: and (3) binding floor slab reinforcing steel bars: binding the floor slab reinforcing steel bars on the Nth layer on the upper surface of the floor slab template on the Nth layer, and binding and fixing the floor slab reinforcing steel bars on the N layer and the upper ends of the wall body reinforcing steel bars on the Nth layer; step S3: pouring: pouring concrete of the Nth floor by adopting the concrete after temperature adjustment; after the temperature of the poured concrete is adjusted, the temperature of the poured concrete is directly controlled, so that the temperature load is reduced, the pouring quality is improved, and various problems such as moisture regain, water leakage, rain leakage and the like caused by cracks are avoided.

title_en: PAO/SA particles prepared based on electrostatic spraying method and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides PAO/SA particles prepared based on an electrostatic spraying method, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of new material preparation; according to the invention, the electrostatic atomization technology and the uranium extraction technology are combined, the size-controllable uranium extraction particles PAO/SA are efficiently prepared based on the electric field strengthening effect, the particle size of the PAO/SA is adjustable and controllable, the particle size can be accurately controlled according to different uranium extraction conditions, the particles can be quickly and efficiently recovered through gravity sedimentation, the material recovery efficiency is greatly improved, the material recovery energy consumption is reduced, and the method has good application in adsorbing and extracting uranium as an adsorbent.

title_en: Preparation method of porous nanocomposite and application of porous nanocomposite in ammonia borane hydrolysis hydrogen production
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a porous nanocomposite and application of the porous nanocomposite in ammonia borane hydrolysis hydrogen production; the method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing metal salt, a polydentate organic ligand and a first solvent, then performing ultrasonic dissolution, and continuously stirring after dissolution to obtain a first solution; wherein the metal salt comprises one or more of copper salt, cobalt salt and nickel salt; the first solvent is N, N-dimethylformamide; s2, heating the first solution, and keeping constant temperature and standing to obtain a second solution; s3, cooling the second solution, performing suction filtration and separation, soaking and washing to obtain a filter cake, and then performing constant-temperature drying on the filter cake to obtain MOFs powder products; s4, grinding and mixing the MOFs powder product with a co-calcinating agent to obtain mixed powder; s5, calcining the mixed powder by taking inert gas as shielding gas to obtain a porous nanocomposite; the synthetic method is simple and easy to regulate, and the synthesized composite material has the advantages of large specific surface area, high porosity, small metal nano particles and the like.

title_en: Low-cost coal tar pitch-based foam carbon and preparation method of precursor thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal tar pitch-based foam carbon preparation, in particular to a preparation method of low-cost coal tar pitch-based foam carbon and a precursor thereof. Taking coal-based refined maltene as a raw material, performing reduced pressure distillation in a distillation kettle to obtain distilled asphalt, preparing modified maltene by adopting an air oxidation or thermal polymerization method, and fully oxidizing to obtain a foaming precursor; then placing the mixture in a high-pressure reaction kettle, heating to a pre-foaming temperature, filling inert gas to reach an initial pressure, keeping the temperature for a certain time, heating to a final foaming temperature, keeping the temperature for a certain time under the foaming pressure, and naturally cooling and reducing the pressure to obtain a foam carbon primary body; naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain the coal tar pitch-based foam carbon. The coal pitch which is cheap and easy to obtain is used as a raw material, the composition of a foaming precursor can be effectively regulated and controlled without adopting a solvent, the foam carbon with uniform pore bubbles and controllable pore bubble size and pore wall thickness is prepared by foaming at low pressure, and the method is suitable for different purposes and meets the requirements of low-cost and continuous production of the foam carbon.

title_en: Method for green synthesis of nano ruthenium oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for green synthesis of nano ruthenium oxide, which comprises the following steps: firstly, adding ruthenium chloride into pure water, stirring and dissolving to obtain a ruthenium chloride solution, then adding sodium citrate into the ruthenium chloride solution, stirring and dissolving, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying the centrifugal precipitate to obtain nano ruthenium particles; and secondly, putting the nano ruthenium particles into a tubular furnace for heating to obtain the nano ruthenium oxide. According to the invention, sodium citrate is used as a reducing agent to carry out hydrothermal reaction with a ruthenium chloride solution, simple substance nano ruthenium particles with uniform and stable size are prepared by controlling the hydrothermal reaction, and then nano ruthenium oxide with uniform size is obtained by heating and oxidizing, so that the control of the granularity and the morphology of the nano ruthenium oxide is realized, the raw materials and the reducing agent are safe and nontoxic, the source is wide, the cost is low, the safety problem of preparing the nano ruthenium by using a toxic reagent is solved, and the method is green and environment-friendly, and is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Casting method for relieving copper brittle cracks of weathering steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a casting method for reducing copper embrittlement cracks of weather-resistant steel, which is characterized in that nitrogen addition is avoided during molten steel casting by improving protection casting during casting by a casting machine, secondary cooling water is used for dynamically distributing water, and casting process parameters of the casting machine are optimized, so that copper embrittlement cracks of a casting blank after heating and rolling are avoided, and a steel plate with excellent surface quality is obtained.

title_en: Method for preparing mixed gas from methanol and catalyst used in method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of fuel gas preparation, and discloses a method for preparing mixed fuel gas from methanol. The preparation method is a composite catalyst GO-NH  x  ‑AlCl  y  Dissolving the methanol in methanol, and reforming and gasifying the methanol into mixed gas containing hydrogen, carbon monoxide, methane, ethane, isopropane and dimethyl ether; the composite catalyst GO-NH  x  ‑AlCl  y  Wherein x ranges from 0 to 2 and y ranges from 0 to 2.
