The heat value of the mixed gas prepared from each kilogram of methanol is higher than the heat value of the methanol in single combustion; the mixed gas can be directly used for combustion, and additional devices such as separation, purification and the like are not needed; the GO-NHx-AlCly composite catalyst and the methanol are gasified and taken away at the same time, and the problems of carbon deposition and the like are avoided.

title_en: Method for preparing positive electrode active material for rechargeable lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The present invention provides a powdered positive electrode active material for a lithium ion secondary battery having particles comprising Li, M and O, the particles having a Li/M molar ratio higher than or equal to 0.98 and lower than or equal to 1.10, the powdered positive electrode active material being characterized in that the powder has a flow index of at least 0.10 and at most 0.30 when the powder has a D50 of at least 4.0 μ ι η and at most 6.0 μ ι η, or at least 0.10 and at most 0.20 when the powder has a D50 of higher than 6.0 μ ι η and at most 10.0 μ ι η, wherein the D50 is the median particle size of the powder.

title_en: Regeneration method of water glass casting waste sand and obtained regenerated sand
abstract_en: The invention provides a regeneration method of water glass casting waste sand, which comprises the following steps: (1) crushing the blocky waste casting water glass sand; (2) roasting the rice hulls and the crushed waste foundry water glass sand to obtain a roasted product; (3) mixing and stirring the roasted product and a NaOH aqueous solution, and carrying out solid-liquid separation after the reaction is finished to obtain wet sand and a sodium silicate aqueous solution; (4) and washing, dehydrating and drying the wet sand in sequence by using clean water to obtain the finished product reclaimed sand. The method can realize the comprehensive utilization of solid waste resources such as waste foundry sand, rice hulls and the like, even if the water glass with the surface of the waste foundry sand losing activity can be continuously recycled by the method; because the rice hull is added in the roasting process, the process energy consumption is low, and the energy is reduced and the emission is reduced; the obtained reclaimed sand has less surface ion residues, low conductivity and stable quality.

title_en: Non-melting glass combination identification platform and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-melting glass combination identification platform and a method, wherein the platform comprises: the glass fixing mechanism comprises a first fixing plate body and a second fixing plate body, and is used for vertically fixing two glass flat plates which need to be combined by a non-melting method and keeping the distance between the two glass flat plates equal to a set distance value; an adhesive injection mechanism for facing the gap between the two glass plates to perform a preset dosage of adhesive injection operation; and a numerical judgment device for determining whether to issue a bonding failure signal based on the numerical analysis result. The non-melting glass combination identification platform and the method have intelligent operation and certain automation level. The combination structure of the glass plate non-melting method with the specific design can be built to provide convenience for combination and detection, and a visual detection mechanism is introduced to carry out numerical analysis on the combination quality of the combined glass plate, so that the reliability of the glass combination process and the combination quality identification result is ensured.

title_en: Blast furnace lower heat system maximum influence factor analysis method based on tuyere monitoring
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a blast furnace lower heat system maximum influence factor analysis method based on tuyere monitoring, which comprises the steps of constructing a blast furnace tuyere monitoring system, realizing intelligent acquisition of tuyere images based on different brightnesses, realizing automatic analysis of tuyere brightness, realizing automatic adjustment of acquisition parameters of the tuyere monitoring system by a pre-calibration method so as to effectively acquire tuyere brightness images, and adopting a partial least square method to realize automatic analysis of blast furnace lower heat system maximum influence factors on blast furnace blast volume, blast temperature, furnace burden descent speed, blast furnace iron output, smelting period and other related process parameters and tuyere brightness change trend. The invention can effectively solve the problem of brightness overexposure in the image monitoring of the blast furnace tuyere, realizes the automatic adjustment of the tuyere image, combines the tuyere brightness monitoring result with the blast furnace process parameters at the same time, so as to effectively perform the automatic analysis of the maximum influencing factor of the lower heat system of the blast furnace, optimize the lower regulation of the blast furnace and improve the control level of the blast furnace.

title_en: Heating device
abstract_en: The application provides a heating device, which comprises a shell, wherein a gas-liquid mixing chamber is formed in the shell, a liquid inlet flow channel for conveying a fluid to be reacted towards the gas-liquid mixing chamber is arranged in the shell, and a catalytic reaction device is arranged on one side of the gas-liquid mixing chamber; a blower fan arranged in the shell and used for conveying air to the gas-liquid mixing chamber so as to mix the air and the fluid to be reacted in the gas-liquid mixing chamber to form a mixture, and blowing the mixture into the catalytic reaction device for catalytic heat release, wherein the heat of the catalytic heat release is used for heat exchange of the methanol reforming process; at least one electric heating device is arranged in the shell and used for preheating the fluid to be reacted and/or the mixture. The application provides a heating device, the heating is stable and even.

title_en: Method for preparing ultrathin porous graphite phase carbon nitride nanosheets in large scale
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing ultrathin porous graphite phase carbon nitride nanosheets in a macro-scale, which comprises the following steps: calcining a precursor containing a triazine unit structure at high temperature to obtain bulk graphite phase carbon nitride; step two, fully grinding the bulk graphite phase carbon nitride, and then dissolving the ground bulk graphite phase carbon nitride in an organic solvent, wherein the mass ratio of the bulk graphite phase carbon nitride to the organic solvent is 1 (100-10000); placing the graphite phase carbon nitride material in a shearing container for high-efficiency shearing and stripping to obtain a graphite phase carbon nitride material with fewer sheets, and then placing the graphite phase carbon nitride material in an oven for drying to obtain a graphite phase carbon nitride powder; and thirdly, placing the graphite phase carbon nitride powder obtained in the second step into a high-temperature furnace for high-temperature thermal oxidation sintering to obtain the ultrathin porous graphite phase carbon nitride nano-sheet with the yield of more than 24%. The preparation method is simple, has low requirements on equipment, low-cost and easily-obtained raw materials, high yield, can realize large-scale mass production, and has wide application prospects in the fields of catalysis, separation and the like.

title_en: Formula of ceramic moonlight white glaze and firing process of moonlight white glaze ceramic
abstract_en: The invention provides a formula of a ceramic moonlight white glaze and a firing process of the moonlight white glaze, wherein the ceramic moonlight white glaze comprises calcium carbonate, zinc oxide, kaolin, silica, zirconium carbonate, magnesium oxide and albite in a weight ratio, and the moonlight white glaze ceramic is obtained through the change of a firing temperature curve of primary biscuit firing and the change of a firing temperature curve of glazing and glaze firing, so that a final glaze layer presents the effect of light yellow in the white as clear moonlight at night, and a matrix is mild, delicate and smooth. On the basis of the original white porcelain firing process, the invention adopts calcium carbonate, zinc oxide, kaolin, silica, zirconium carbonate, magnesium oxide and albite as raw materials to prepare glaze slurry, adopts different heating rates in the firing process, fully utilizes the effects of the raw materials in different temperature sections, and forms a glaze layer which is bright and bright like moonlight at night on the appearance of a blank body to obtain the moonlight white glaze ceramic, and has elegant and mild visual effect and deeper sense.

title_en: Method for recovering copper, zinc and cadmium from copper ash leachate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering copper, zinc and cadmium from a copper ash leachate, which adopts a circulating extraction process, namely copper extraction, zinc extraction, co-extraction and cadmium extraction, and specifically comprises the following steps: adjusting the pH value of the copper soot leaching solution to 1-2 for copper extraction to obtain copper extraction raffinate and a copper-loaded organic phase; controlling the concentration of zinc in the loaded organic phase, performing zinc extraction on the copper extraction raffinate, performing co-extraction on the zinc extraction raffinate to obtain a metal co-loaded organic phase and an externally discharged raffinate, and performing sulfuric acid back extraction on the metal co-loaded organic phase to obtain a copper-zinc-cadmium enrichment solution; carrying out cadmium extraction on the copper-zinc-cadmium enrichment solution to obtain a cadmium-loaded organic phase and a cadmium extraction residual solution; carrying out back extraction on the cadmium-loaded organic phase by using sodium hydroxide to obtain cadmium hydroxide precipitate, and filtering and separating the cadmium hydroxide precipitate and mother liquor; the copper, zinc and cadmium contained in the mother liquor and the cadmium extraction residual liquid are merged into the copper ash leachate to return to the main flow to recover the metal, the metal recovery rate is high, and the loss rate of each metal is less than or equal to 0.05 percent.

title_en: Preparation method of novel phosphorus and metal-containing ZSM-5 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular sieve preparation, in particular to a preparation method of a novel phosphorus and metal containing ZSM-5 molecular sieve. Uniformly mixing phosphate, an aluminum source and a silicon source, and placing the mixture in a closed reaction container for reaction to obtain an intermediate product; then uniformly mixing the template agent, water and the intermediate product, placing the mixture in a closed reaction container for hydrothermal crystallization, and then sequentially carrying out hydrothermal crystallizationWashing, drying and roasting to obtain the sodium type molecular sieve; and finally, carrying out ion exchange on the sodium type molecular sieve for multiple times by using an ammonium nitrate solution, and sequentially carrying out suction filtration, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the ZSM-5 molecular sieve containing phosphorus and metal. The preparation process is simple and convenient, phosphorus and metal elements are introduced into the ZSM-5 molecular sieve at one time, and the obtained molecular sieve is used for preparing propylene from methanol  2‑4   ＝  High selectivity, low selectivity of byproducts such as aromatic hydrocarbon and the like and good stability.

title_en: Method and device for preparing graphene by catalyst-assisted microwave excitation metal discharge
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for preparing graphene by catalyst-assisted microwave excitation metal discharge. The invention mixes the carbon source and the catalyst, then spreads the mixture in a high temperature resistant container, covers the container with a metal wire array, and puts the container and the container in a microwave special device in an anaerobic environment. The catalyst absorbs the micro-waveform to form local high temperature and local plasma, which can enhance the rapid discharge of the front end of the microwave-induced metal wire array to generate high-density and continuous electric explosion, and the high-temperature and high-chemical-activity plasma can rapidly convert the carbon source into graphene. The preparation device comprises catalyst powder, carbon source powder, a powder stirring module, a high-temperature resistant container module, a microwave reaction module and a powder screening module. The invention adopts low-cost carbon source as raw material to replace graphite oxide prepared by expensive and chemical methods, solves the problem of high energy consumption, and simultaneously has the price of microwave equipment far lower than that of high-voltage pulse power supply equipment, thereby realizing low-cost preparation of graphene, being capable of mass production and having market competitiveness.

title_en: Cotton collection device of melting blast furnace slag system sediment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for collecting slag wool produced by melting blast furnace slag, and belongs to the technical field of blast furnace slag utilization. The device includes the barrel, the feed unit, rotatory broken unit, press the sediment collection unit, harrow sediment shaping unit and push away sediment conveying unit, the fibrous sediment cotton is cut into to the melting blast furnace sediment through rotatory broken unit, and then pass through the sweep in pressing the sediment collection unit, the stirring, collect, make fibrous sediment cotton get into harrow sediment shaping unit downwards, further carry out the harrow sediment to the scattered sediment cotton and become the group, carry out the collection cotton output to it through pushing away sediment conveying unit at last, have good collection sediment cotton effect, more be favorable to sediment cotton shrink group to carry, and to making the high temperature air that the cotton in-process produced of sediment collection get into waste heat boiler through the exhanst gas outlet and carry out the electricity generation, and then recycle the heat, effectively reduce the energy cost, reduce greenhouse gas's emission simultaneously, realize the comprehensive application to blast furnace sediment fiber-forming technology.

title_en: Method for preparing lithium iron manganese phosphate electrode material by recycling ferro-manganese from stainless steel slag
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of industrial solid waste resource utilization, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a lithium iron manganese phosphate electrode material by recycling iron and manganese from stainless steel slag. The invention provides a method for preparing lithium iron manganese phosphate by recycling stainless steel slag, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing stainless steel slag with an acid solution and roasting; (2) Leaching the roasted solid by water to obtain a ferro-manganese extracting solution; (3) Supplementing an iron source and ascorbic acid to the ferromanganese extracting solution to prepare a ferromanganese precursor solution; (4) And mixing the ferro-manganese precursor solution with a lithium source and a phosphorus source solution, performing hydrothermal treatment, and separating solids after the reaction to obtain the manganese ferric lithium phosphate material. The method is feasible and reliable, simple to operate and high in efficiency, can effectively recover the ferro-manganese resources from the stainless steel slag and regenerate the ferro-manganese lithium phosphate materials, takes the steel slag waste as the raw material to replace part of the conventional raw material, reduces the production cost and realizes solid waste circulation.

title_en: Preparation method of high-wettability graphite-based composite powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to Si  2  N  2  A preparation method of O-SiC coated graphite-based composite powder. The invention firstly uses crystalline flake graphite and SiThen mixing the silicon-coated graphite precursor with a polyvinyl alcohol solution to obtain a precursor with a structure that silicon is coated on the surface of graphite, and then drying, crushing and calcining at 900-1500 ℃ to obtain the Si with a core-shell structure  2  N  2  The graphite-based composite powder is coated by O-SiC. The method has the characteristics of simple process, environmental friendliness and low energy consumption; the prepared Si2N 2O-SiC-coated graphite-based composite powder with high wettability has excellent wettability.

title_en: Preparation method and application of alkoxy polysilazane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of alkoxy polysilazane, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing at least one of chlorosilane shown in formula 1 and at least one of alkoxy silane shown in formula 2 in proportion under inert atmosphere, reacting, and removing byproduct R  2  R  3  R  4  SiCl, preparing a precursor; (2) And (3) carrying out ammonolysis reaction on the precursor prepared in the step (1) to prepare the alkoxy polysilazane. The invention quantitatively forms the precursor by controlling the proportion of the chlorosilane shown in the formula 1 and the alkoxy silane shown in the formula 2, thereby precisely controlling the structure and the composition of the alkoxy polysilazane formed after the precursor is ammonolyzed.

title_en: Continuous extraction preparation method and device of coal-based organic micro-nano spheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous extraction preparation method of coal-based organic micro-nanospheres and a continuous extraction preparation device for realizing the method, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of: (1) pretreating raw coal of coal; (2) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the coal slurry in a reactor; (3) After the reaction is finished, gradually cooling the liquid-phase reactant solution to separate out the coal-based organic micro-nanospheres; (4) Filtering out the coal-based organic micro/nanospheres by a filter collector; (5) And collecting the coal-based organic micro-nanospheres from the filter membrane of the filter collector. According to the continuous extraction preparation method and the device, the filter collector which is alternately used is additionally arranged at the downstream of the outlet at the top of the reactor, so that the coal-based organic micro-nano spheres can be continuously collected after being separated out; the continuous hydrothermal separation reaction is ensured in the reactor, and simultaneously, the sedimentation separation of solid-liquid phase reaction products can be realized; and the continuous and continuous feeding of slurry in the extraction process can be ensured, and the continuous production of the coal-based organic micro-nano spheres is realized.

title_en: Spoke feeding device of disc brake hub
abstract_en: The invention provides a spoke feeding device of a disc brake hub, which is provided with an insert conveying part, so that a plurality of inserts required by producing a spoke of the disc brake hub can be conveyed to a specified position, and the inserts are arranged according to a preset rule, thereby facilitating the grabbing of a workpiece grabbing part; due to the fact that the workpiece grabbing portion is arranged, a plurality of arranged inserts can be grabbed simultaneously, the inserts are placed at the preset insert placing positions in the die of the disc brake hub, the spoke of the disc brake hub with the inserts can be automatically fed and produced, production efficiency is greatly improved, and potential safety hazards caused by manual placement are avoided. Furthermore, because the inserts conveying part still has inserts location inductor, consequently can also snatch a plurality of inserts that the portion snatched simultaneously to the work piece and detect, avoid having the condition that the inserts lacked to guarantee the quality of final product.

title_en: Device and method for separating primary large-scale graphite from molten iron pretreatment desulfurization slag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molten iron desulfurization, in particular to a device and a method for separating primary large-scale graphite from molten iron pretreatment desulfurization slag. The invention can carry out protective recovery on the primary large-scale graphite in the desulfurization slag, avoids physical damage of extraction equipment such as a ball mill and an extraction process flow, and protects the primary morphology and the size of the large scale.

title_en: Method for manufacturing three-dimensional object and three-dimensional shaping device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a three-dimensional shaped object, which can manufacture a large-sized high-density metal three-dimensional shaped object. In the method for manufacturing a three-dimensional object, layers are laminated to manufacture the three-dimensional object, and the method includes: a 1 st metal powder supply step of supplying a 1 st metal powder having a 1 st average particle diameter to a molding table; a layer forming step of compressing the 1 st metal powder supplied to the modeling table to form a layer; a 1 st liquid supply step of supplying a 1 st liquid containing a 2 nd metal powder and a binder to at least a part of a constituent region of the three-dimensional shaped object, the 2 nd metal powder having an average particle diameter of a 2 nd average particle diameter of 1/10 or more and 1/2 or less of the 1 st average particle diameter; a 2 nd liquid supply step of supplying a 2 nd liquid containing a binder and not containing a metal powder to at least a part of the surface layer region in the constituent region; and a sintering step of heating the laminate to sinter the metal in the constituent region.

title_en: Laser-assisted metal micro-jet liquid additive manufacturing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser-assisted metal micro-jet liquid additive manufacturing device and method, and relates to the field of metal additive manufacturing. According to the invention, heat is input through the laser auxiliary heat source, so that the remelting of molten drops and the metallurgical bonding are ensured, the comprehensive mechanical property of the structural part prepared by additive is obviously improved, the working temperature of the nozzle is reduced, the size of the additive is improved, and meanwhile, a foundation is laid for the additive development of the subsequent free-form high-melting-point metal part.

title_en: Preparation method of stone-like PC water permeable brick
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of water permeable bricks, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a stone-like PC water permeable brick, which comprises the following steps; s1, material preparation; s2, forming; s3, putting the materials into a kiln for curing; s4, finish machining of the surface layer; s5, stacking and maintaining; and S6, leaving the factory. This application adds organic glue and brightener in the brick that permeates water, bonds the brick inner material that permeates water through organic glue, constitutes three-dimensional netted network, suppresses oozing of soluble salt, reduces the production of the brick whitening phenomenon that permeates water to improve the brick outward appearance quality that permeates water through the brightener, effectively promote the pleasing to the eye degree of the brick that permeates water, make the brick surface color that permeates water clear, the line is clear.

title_en: Preparation method of homogeneous mullite fiber-based porous ceramic
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of homogeneous mullite fiber-based porous ceramic, belonging to the technical field of thermal protection materials, and comprising the following process steps: (1) removing impurities from mullite fiber; (2) chopping mullite fibers; (3) preparing mullite fiber slurry; (4) Molding the prepared mixed slurry by adopting a gravity settling method, and then sintering; (5) And placing the dried blank into a high-temperature furnace for calcining and binder removal. The density of the porous ceramic prepared by the method of the invention is 0.34g/cm 3 ‑0.60g/cm 3 The mullite fiber-based porous ceramic material has the porosity of 84.8-74.2 percent, the thermal conductivity of 0.0683W/(m.K) -0.2546W/(m.K), and the compressive strength of 1.35MPa-0.33MPa, and has uniform structure and good performance.

title_en: Preparation method of multifunctional polycarboxylate water reducer excitant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of concrete additives, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a multifunctional polycarboxylate water reducer excitant, which comprises the steps of carrying out neutralization reaction on a macromonomer, a small monomer, a functional monomer A and a functional monomer B under the action of an initiating system to obtain a target product; the macromer is one or more than two of APEG, HPEG, TPEG, GPEG and methacrylic acid MPEG ester; the small monomer is one or more than two of itaconic acid, maleic anhydride, maleic acid, fumaric acid, acrylic acid, methacrylic acid and hydroxy-2-hydroxypropyl methacrylate; the functional monomer B contains phosphate ester groups, anionic groups and glycoside groups; the initiation system adopts a redox initiation system. The invention has the advantages of low synthesis cost, good workability, ideal wrapping property and slump retention, no segregation, no drowning of slurry, low dosage sensitivity, and capability of enhancing the strength of concrete and improving the initial water reduction rate.

title_en: Assembled house and be applied to multi-functional integrated form wall body in this house
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled house and a multifunctional integrated wall body applied to the assembled house.

title_en: Ultrathin glass cover plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrathin glass cover plate and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: providing ultra-thin glass with the thickness a; dry etching is carried out on any surface of the ultrathin glass to obtain an ultrathin glass intermediate with the thickness of b, wherein the value range of the ratio of b to a is as follows: 0.95-0.995; forming a silane layer with the thickness of c on the surface of the ultrathin glass intermediate subjected to dry etching, wherein the value range of the ratio of c to b is as follows: 0.001-0.1; sequentially forming a stress buffer layer and a hard layer on the surface of the silane layer far away from the ultrathin glass to obtain an ultrathin glass cover plate; the preparation method can reduce the bending radius of the ultrathin glass cover plate and improve the folding performance of the ultrathin glass cover plate, so that the ultrathin glass cover plate is better applied to a flexible display screen.

title_en: Green low-carbon decorative concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building materials, in particular to green low-carbon decorative concrete and a preparation method thereof. The green low-carbon decorative concrete comprises raw materials of cement, vanadium-titanium slag powder, ecological sintering materials, carbon fibers, coarse aggregates and fine aggregates, wherein the mass of the carbon fibers is 0.3-0.5% of the total mass of the cement, the vanadium-titanium slag powder and the ecological sintering materials. The green low-carbon concrete can improve the utilization rate of solid wastes such as vanadium-titanium slag powder, ecological sintering materials and the like, and the concrete structure is naturally maintained, so that the obtained product has better strength increase, low shrinkage rate, durability and fresh water facing effect.

title_en: Hydroquinone molecular imprinting photoelectrochemical sensor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a hydroquinone molecular imprinting photoelectrochemical sensor, a preparation method and an application thereof. The sensor comprises a reference electrode, an auxiliary electrode and a working electrode, wherein the reference electrode, the auxiliary electrode and the working electrode form a three-electrode system, the working electrode is a molecular imprinting modification electrode, and the molecular imprinting modification electrode comprises a conductive materialThe composite material is loaded on the conductive substrate; wherein the conductive substrate is L-shaped glassy carbon electrode, and the composite material is CdS nanoparticles/ZnIn  2  S  4  The nano-sheet heterostructure and the molecularly imprinted polymer film layer are prepared by adopting an electropolymerization-elution method. The present disclosure is based on CdS nanoparticles/ZnIn  2  S  4  The nano-sheet heterostructure is used as a photoelectric conversion layer, and a molecularly imprinted membrane capable of identifying hydroquinone is modified through an electropolymerization technology, so that the analysis and detection of the hydroquinone are realized. The sensor has the advantages of wide detection range, high sensitivity and good selectivity, and the detection limit of the sensor can reach 0.7nmol/L.

title_en: Method for preparing metal ceramic parts with complex shapes based on spherical feeding printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a metal ceramic part with a complex shape based on spherical feeding printing, which comprises the following steps: step 1, kneading and mixing metal ceramic powder and a thermoplastic binder A at 180-200 ℃ to obtain a feed consisting of metal ceramic powder particles and the binder; step 2, performing suspension shaping on the feed particles obtained in the step 1; step 3, using the spherical feeding particles obtained in the step 2 as a powder bed, and carrying out binder jet printing by using a binder B; step 4, degreasing the printing blank body with the complex shape obtained in the step 3; step 5, pre-sintering the printing blank with the complex shape obtained in the step 4; and 6, immersing the pre-sintered part obtained in the step 5 into liquid silicon rubber: step 7, sintering and densifying the cold isostatic pressed blank obtained in the step 6; the method of the invention has the advantages that: the preparation cost is saved, the porosity is reduced, and the density of the part is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity calcium carbonate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mineral processing, and particularly relates to a preparation method of high-purity calcium carbonate. The method comprises the steps of leaching high-purity calcium chloride from magnesium carbonate-containing minerals serving as raw materials, synthesizing high-purity magnesium carbonate trihydrate crystals from magnesium elements in the magnesium carbonate-containing minerals, and synthesizing high-purity calcium carbonate products by utilizing element replacement reaction. The preparation method of the high-purity calcium carbonate can realize the removal of impurities in a reaction system under mild test conditions, and aims to shorten the process route for preparing the high-purity calcium carbonate, reduce the production cost and simplify the production equipment. The technology of the invention can not only reduce the requirement on the purity of the calcium carbonate raw ore, but also increase the economic benefit of enterprises, is beneficial to environmental protection and has wide development prospect.

title_en: RH vacuum refining device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an RH vacuum refining device and a method, wherein the RH vacuum refining device comprises a ladle, a dip pipe and a vacuum chamber, the lower end of the dip pipe is communicated and immersed in the ladle, and the upper end of the dip pipe is communicated with the vacuum chamber; the dip pipe is provided with an ascending pipe and a descending pipe which are arranged in a bilateral symmetry manner, and the sections of the ascending pipe and the descending pipe are enclosed by an inward concave inner arc section, an outward convex outer arc section and a chamfer angle arc section for connecting the inner arc section and the outer arc section; the ascending pipe and the descending pipe are isolated by a refractory partition wall; and a plurality of air blowing openings are uniformly distributed at the lower end positions of the inner arc section and the outer arc section of the ascending pipe. In the molten steel circular refining, the flowing state of the molten steel can be obviously improved, so that the molten steel flows more uniformly in a vacuum chamber, the proportion of piston flow is larger, the proportion of dead zones is reduced, the refining efficiency is improved, and the refining limit of an RH refining system is increased.

title_en: Control method for reducing air temperature fluctuation in low air temperature stage during blast furnace baking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method for reducing air temperature fluctuation in a low air temperature stage during blast furnace baking, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgy. The method comprises the following steps: step one: when the combustion of each hot blast stove is finished, the temperature of the vault is controlled to not more than 1280 ℃ and the temperature of the waste gas is controlled to not more than 380 ℃; step two: confirming that the three hot blast stoves are finished in a rest state, and closing a backflow damping valve; step three: confirming that the fan room starts a fan, and supplying air to the position of the air release valve, wherein the air quantity is 400m  3  A/min; step four: opening a mixing damper valve of the 3# hot blast stove at the far end of the blast furnace, and opening a mixing damper valve to a 100% manual position; step five: closing a cold air release valve, wherein the air supply temperature is about 100 ℃; step six: when the temperature is required to be raised, firstly opening the equalizing gate valve, then opening the equalizing valve to 50%, and opening the hot air valve; and then gradually opening the pressure equalizing regulating valve according to the air temperature requirement. The invention can uniformly and stably raise the air supply temperature during furnace baking, improve furnace baking effect and prolong the service life of the blast furnace.

title_en: Positive electrode material and battery
abstract_en: The positive electrode material (1000) comprises a positive electrode active material (110) and a coating layer (120) for coating the positive electrode active material (110), wherein the coating layer (120) contains lithium and carbon, the positive electrode active material (110) and the coating layer (120) form a coating-type active material (130), and the ratio (C/Li) of the carbon content to the lithium content in the surface layer part of the coating-type active material (130) is 3.27 or more in terms of atomic number ratio.

title_en: Preparation method of aluminum nitride reinforced aluminum alloy cylinder sleeve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an aluminum nitride reinforced aluminum alloy cylinder sleeve, wherein an aluminum nitride reinforced phase in an aluminum alloy cylinder sleeve material is generated in situ through Al and N reactions in the arc additive manufacturing process, aluminum nitride is fully crushed through backfill type stirring friction processing, the cylinder sleeve material contains dispersed aluminum nitride particles, grains in a sediment are fully refined through backfill type stirring friction processing, the sediment is continuously transformed between an extrusion state and a backfill state in a die, the volume of the sediment is always kept constant, when the temperature of the sediment reaches a preset temperature, the sediment is backfilled in the die, stirring friction processing is carried out to form the cylinder sleeve in the extrusion state, and the aluminum nitride reinforced aluminum alloy cylinder sleeve is obtained through semisolid forming.

title_en: Inclusion control method for reducing sand hole defect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inclusion control method for reducing sand hole defects, and belongs to the technical field of ferrous metallurgy. Firstly, converter smelting bottom argon blowing promotes carbon-oxygen reaction balance, and after converter tapping, ladle top slag modification is not needed to directly enter an RH process; step two, RH vacuum treatment, namely controlling the dissolved oxygen to be 380-420 ppm, and adding aluminum particles; after decarburization is finished, setting a circulation time according to the addition amount of aluminum particles; after all the alloy is added, controlling the depth of a molten pool of the RH vacuum chamber within the range of 100-250 mm; the net circulation time from the completion of the addition of all the alloys to the breaking of the alloy is 4 to 8 minutes; and step three, continuous casting. According to the invention, the quantity of inclusions and the refinement size are reduced by controlling the addition amount of RH aluminum particles and optimizing the RH inclusion removal dynamics condition, and the risk casting blank is screened out by identifying abnormal conditions in the continuous casting process, so that the occurrence rate of sand hole defects of the finished product is reduced.

title_en: Processing technology for ceramic pressure chamber of hot chamber die casting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing technology of a ceramic pressure chamber of a hot chamber die casting machine, which comprises the following steps: selecting materials: the ceramic pressure chamber is manufactured by the method according to the process flows of proportioning, premixing, pulping, (drying and granulating), molding, green body drying, sintering (nitriding), processing, grinding, assembling and the like, so that a hot chamber die casting machine can have the functions of high-pressure die casting and quick filling, the hot chamber die casting production of an aluminum alloy die casting piece is realized, and the aim of effectively improving the mechanical property of the aluminum alloy die casting piece is fulfilled.

title_en: Low metal brake block preparation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-metal brake pad preparation system, which relates to the technical field of brake pad preparation and comprises a bottom frame, wherein a support frame is arranged at the position, located at the center, of the upper end of the bottom frame, a feeding support table, a hot-pressing support table and an unloading support table are arranged at the upper end of the bottom frame around the support frame, a stepping motor is arranged on the support frame, a support disc is arranged at the two ends of the support frame, a plurality of convex blocks are arranged on one side of the support disc, the output end of the stepping motor is rotatably connected with a support rod, the output end of the stepping motor is coaxially connected with a support column, the upper end of the support column is rotatably connected with a spring shock absorber, and one end of the spring shock absorber is rotatably connected onto the support rod. This device pass through step motor drive bracing piece and rotate, and the bracing piece is when the lug, along with the high and low amplitude luffing motion of lug to make the powdery material flattening in the die platen through jolting, thereby avoid causing the uneven distribution of material to lead to the fact the result that splits and drop unable braking when hot pressing brace table hot pressing.

title_en: Inversion type Cs 8 Sn 3 GaI 24 /Cs 8 Sn 3 InI 24 Hybrid composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic-inorganic hybrid semiconductor materials, and particularly relates to an inverse Cs  8  Sn  3  GaI  24  /Cs  8  Sn  3  InI  24  Hybrid composite materials and methods of making the same; inversion Cs in the invention  8  Sn  3  GaI  24  /Cs  8  Sn  3  InI  24  The morphology of the hybrid composite material is nanometerCubic thin film structure of Ga  3+  And In  3+  Ion combined regulation and control of energy level to form inverse Cs  2  SnI  6  The crystal form is a face-centered cubic structure, the surface appearance is a nanocube, and hollow structures are distributed on the surface; the prepared hybrid film has uniform and compact surface, good crystallography characteristic and photoelectric property, and good application prospect in the fields of solar photovoltaic devices, light-emitting diodes, sensors and the like; in addition, the preparation method does not need high-temperature calcination, has simple production process, good production efficiency, low synthesis cost, environmental protection and energy saving, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Grouting material for prestressed duct of highway bridge
abstract_en: The application discloses a prestressed duct grouting material for a highway bridge, and relates to the technical field of highway bridge construction. The raw materials comprise, by mass: 48 to 58 parts of cement, 2 to 8 parts of fly ash, 2 to 8 parts of microbeads, 3 parts of expanding agent, 0.99 to 1.03 parts of water reducing agent, 0.02 to 0.06 part of sodium lignin sulfonate and 0.25 part of sodium metasilicate pentahydrate. According to the application, on the premise that the fluidity of the grouting material meets the standard requirement, the repeated blending of sodium lignin sulfonate and the polycarboxylate superplasticizer is utilized, the time loss of the fluidity is reduced, and the stability and the strength of the grouting material are improved. The application utilizes the complex doping of sodium lignin sulfonate and sodium metasilicate pentahydrate to exert a synergistic corrosion inhibition effect, so that the grouting material has better corrosion inhibition performance.

title_en: Calcium deoxidizer beneficial to industrial production and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial deoxidizer production, and discloses a calcium deoxidizer beneficial to industrial production and a preparation method thereof.

title_en: Nickel-coated copper composite strip with high bonding strength and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite metal strips, and discloses a nickel-coated copper composite strip with high bonding strength and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nickel-coated copper composite strip comprises a rod-shaped copper core, a transition metal tube and an outermost nickel tube from inside to outside; the copper core and the transition metal tube are mutually diffused, the two ends of the copper core are totally enclosed by the nickel tube, the transition metal tube is one of titanium, manganese, chromium, silver and lanthanum, a solid solution which prevents diffusion is generated when copper and nickel are heated, the difficulty in inter-diffusion between atoms is high, a transition metal layer which is mutually diffused with copper and nickel is added, the diffusion difficulty between different metal layers is greatly reduced, under the condition of pressurization after heating, the transition metal, copper and nickel are mutually combined and diffused, tiny cracks between different metals are filled, and the bonding strength between different metals is greatly increased. The nickel-coated copper strip has the advantage of high bonding strength between different metal layers due to the specially set transition metal materials and temperature parameters.

title_en: Method for deeply removing impurities from waste lithium battery negative electrode powder and performing targeted repair on regenerated graphite negative electrode material
abstract_en: A method for deeply removing impurities and performing targeted repair on waste lithium battery negative electrode powder to regenerate a graphite negative electrode material relates to a method for regenerating the graphite negative electrode material by using the waste lithium battery negative electrode powder. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the recycling rate of the graphite cathode of the lithium ion battery is not high in the prior art. The system of the invention researches the failure characteristics of the waste cathode graphite, and simultaneously provides a set of targeted repair scheme based on the failure characteristic analysis. After the waste negative graphite is treated by the repair scheme provided by the invention, the impurity residual quantity meets the relevant standard, the graphite modified coating layer can be effectively repaired, and the repaired negative graphite has the capacity equivalent to that of commercial graphite after 450 times of cycle test at the current density of 1C. The method provides a new idea for repairing the graphite cathode of the waste lithium ion battery, and has important significance for promoting the closed cycle of the production of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Preparation method and application of layered manganese dioxide capable of storing sodium by virtue of charge transfer
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of layered manganese dioxide capable of storing sodium by means of charge transfer and application thereof. The material has stronger oxygen electronegativity, and can generate charge transfer behavior and store more sodium ions in a voltage window of water. The co-intercalation structure of ammonium ions and sodium ions can better modulate the crystal structure of manganese dioxide and optimize the storage capacity of sodium ions, and the preparation method has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, short period and better industrial application prospect.

title_en: Spinel type aluminum-rich manganese oxide positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemical energy storage battery materials, and particularly relates to a non-negative-electrode aqueous aluminum ion secondary battery. The general formula of the aluminum-rich manganese oxide is Al  x  Mn  3‑x  O  4  X is more than or equal to 4/3 and less than or equal to 2, and the structure of the aluminum-rich manganese oxide is a spinel structure. The preparation method has the beneficial effects that the spinel aluminum-rich manganese oxide positive electrode material of the aluminum ion secondary battery is prepared by uniformly mixing a manganese source and an aluminum source and then sintering at high temperature, and has the advantages of low cost, simple process, environmental friendliness and suitability for industrial production. The anode material prepared by the invention has the advantages of spinel structure, proper working voltage, high specific capacity, long cycle life, low price and the like.

title_en: Four-phase mixed sodium-ion battery layered oxide positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrode materials, and discloses a four-phase mixed sodium-ion battery layered oxide positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the four-phase mixed sodium-ion battery layered oxide positive electrode material comprises the following steps: mixing and grinding a Ni source, a Co source, a Mn source, a Li source and a Na source according to a set proportion; calcining the ground mixed material for the first time; grinding the calcined product after the primary calcination is finished, pressing the calcined product into a sheet shape, then carrying out secondary calcination, wherein the calcination temperature is 700-900 ℃, the calcination time is 11-16h, cooling the calcined product from 400-600 ℃ to 200-300 ℃, and then cooling and quenching the calcined product in argon or dry air; after quenching is finished, grinding the flaky product into powder to obtain the product; the problems that the first cycle coulomb efficiency is low, multiple phase changes occur in the charging and discharging process and the like of the existing Na-P2 phase sodium ion battery layered oxide positive electrode material can be solved.

title_en: Foamed ceramic prepared from granite waste stone powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a foamed ceramic prepared by utilizing granite waste stone powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the foamed ceramic comprises the following components in percentage by mass: the waste granite powder is taken as a base material, the optimizing agent accounts for 4-14% of the waste granite powder by 100%, and the foaming agent accounts for 0.5-2% of the total of the waste granite powder and the optimizing agent; the material is prepared by the processes of ball milling, mixing, pressing, sintering and the like. The invention utilizes the fluxing and foam stabilizing functions of the optimizing agent in the foaming ceramic sintering process to adjust the formula design, combines a proper sintering process, realizes high utilization rate of granite waste stone powder in the foaming ceramic preparation process at a lower sintering temperature, and simultaneously improves the uniformity of the pore structure of the foaming ceramic, thereby obtaining the foaming ceramic with excellent performance. The foamed ceramic prepared by the invention has the advantages of uniform pore size, high closed porosity, good mechanical property and good thermal insulation property. Not only broadens the way of resource utilization of solid wastes, but also provides a green energy-saving material.

title_en: Flexible control method of ultrasonic impact device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible control method of an ultrasonic impact device, which comprises the following steps: building a working platform model; establishing a mathematical model, and calculating to obtain related parameters in the motion process of the permanent magnet synchronous motor at each moment; the control and adjustment of the permanent magnet synchronous motor are simplified; reducing deviation in related parameters of the permanent magnet synchronous motor; setting simulation input parameters to obtain a specific simulation output result of the motor; obtaining guide rail coordinate data, and calculating an expected track of the motion of the ultrasonic impact device according to the guide rail coordinate data; and establishing a linear function relation between the X-axis guide rail coordinate and the Y-axis guide rail coordinate according to the relation that the guide rail coordinate changes along with the motion time of the permanent magnet synchronous motor, establishing an incremental model of the guide rail coordinate track, and optimizing input according to the incremental model. The invention can avoid a plurality of defects in the conventional ultrasonic strengthening processing part, and has good effects of accurately controlling the processing area, reducing the working time and prolonging the service life of the workpiece.

title_en: Double-layer toughened glass's bonding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bonding device for double-layer toughened glass, which is characterized in that a clamping strip is arranged to serve as initial edge sealing glue, a glue injection thin plate is inserted between two pieces of glass in advance, and the thickness of the glue injection thin plate is consistent with that of the clamping strip, so that the width of a gap between the two pieces of glass can be controlled by setting the thicknesses of the glue injection thin plate and the clamping strip in advance. When the injecting glue, earlier through the logical groove evacuation on the card strip, both taken out the air in advance, have ensured that two-sided glass can closely laminate on the card strip, both fixed two-sided glass, glass takes place to rock when preventing the injecting glue operation, influences final finished product quality, can guarantee the leakproofness again, air admission during preventing the injecting glue operation between the two-sided glass. When the glue injection sheet is drawn away, the negative pressure generated in the gap between the two glass surfaces automatically sucks the glue, so that the glue is completely filled, and the glue filling amount does not need to be calculated in advance.

title_en: Antibacterial ceramic, preparation method thereof, regeneration method thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial ceramic, a preparation method thereof, a regeneration method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing, melting and molding antibacterial ceramic raw materials to obtain a precursor; and (3) eroding the precursor by adopting acid to obtain the antibacterial ceramic. In the preparation method, the steps of melting and forming can ensure that the antibacterial active component is highly dispersed in the antibacterial ceramic, the step of acid erosion can increase the exposure sites of the antibacterial active component, and the high dispersion and the multiple exposure sites of the antibacterial active component can greatly improve the antibacterial activity of the antibacterial ceramic.

title_en: Surface-modified zinc oxide particles, dispersion liquid, and cosmetic
abstract_en: Surface-modified zinc oxide particles having a silane coupling agent having an alkoxy group on the surface, wherein the d50 is 4 [ mu ] m or less as measured by the following measurement method using a laser diffraction/scattering particle size distribution measuring apparatus. (measurement method) A mixed solution was obtained by mixing 10g of surface-modified zinc oxide particles, 88g of cyclopentasiloxane, and 2g of polyglycerin-3-polydimethylhydroxyethylpolydimethylsiloxane, and a dispersion was obtained by dispersing the obtained mixed solution at 9500rpm for 5 minutes by using a homogenizer to prepare a measurement solution in which the content of surface-modified zinc oxide particles in the dispersion obtained by dilution with cyclopentasiloxane was 0.01 mass%, and the d50 was measured by a laser diffraction/scattering particle size distribution measurement apparatus using the obtained measurement solution.

title_en: Automatic powder filling device for conical die
abstract_en: The invention relates to powder forming, and provides an automatic powder loading device for a conical die in order to improve the powder loading efficiency and the powder loading effect of the conical die, wherein the automatic powder loading device comprises an operating platform, a supporting platform arranged on the upper surface of the operating platform in a sliding manner, a supporting plate arranged on the supporting platform, an ejector rod arranged below the supporting plate, an impact device, a feeding device, a powder pressing device and a horizontal driving device; the feeding device comprises a base, a vertical driving device for driving the base to lift, a powder bin fixedly arranged on the base, a weighing device arranged below the outlet end of the powder bin, and a discharge hopper arranged below the weighing device; the mould is detachably and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the supporting plate; the weighing device and the discharge hopper are both connected with the base; the powder pressing device comprises a first electric telescopic cylinder and a pressing head arranged at the end part of the first electric telescopic cylinder; the pressure head is arranged downwards. The automatic powder filling device for the conical die can efficiently and automatically fill powder into the conical die, so that the powder filling uniformity is high, and the powder filling efficiency is high.

title_en: Broad-spectrum curing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broad-spectrum curing agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the curing agent comprises a gelling component, an alkali-activated component, an early strength component and a water-retention healing component; the gelling component is granulated blast furnace slag micro powder or fly ash; the alkali-activated component is selected from carbide slag, magnesium oxide or calcium oxide; the early strength component is gypsum powder or sodium sulfate; the water-retaining healing component comprises sodium carboxymethylcellulose and coupling modified polypropylene fiber. Silicon and calcium elements in the gelling component are excited by the alkali-excited component to perform a volcanic ash reaction with metal ions in the alkali-excited component to generate a gelling product, the early-strength component assists a hydration reaction, the hydrophilic polymer absorbs water to effectively block pores, the coupling modified fiber increases the interfacial binding force between the organic fiber and the inorganic material, a large number of fine cracks are generated under the load effect, water is effectively retained, cracking is inhibited, and self-healing is realized. The broad-spectrum curing agent has the characteristics of self-healing capability, deformation resistance, water retention and cracking resistance after loading, good seepage-proofing performance and gas barrier performance, and is suitable for various engineering implementation scenes.

title_en: Carbon-loading engineering process method and ecological system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a negative carbon engineering process method and an ecological system, wherein the negative carbon engineering process method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting carbon dioxide; s2, preparing the carbon dioxide collected in the step S1 into solid dry ice; s3, applying the dry ice obtained in the step S2 to a warehouse for killing insects and mice or cleaning equipment in a factory; s4, forming gaseous carbon dioxide after the dry ice is subjected to heat exchange in the step S3; s5, sending the carbon dioxide obtained in the step S4 into a farmland vegetable greenhouse for photosynthesis; through the carbon dioxide to the surrounding environment transform into solid-state dry ice in this scheme and utilize, the dry ice converts gaseous carbon dioxide into at the in-process of using, and gaseous carbon dioxide shifts to and cooperates the plant to carry out photosynthesis in farmland vegetable greenhouse, realizes the consumption to carbon dioxide.

title_en: Pedestrian walkway water permeable brick prepared from construction waste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building materials, in particular to a sidewalk water permeable brick prepared from building garbage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sidewalk water permeable brick comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of silicate cement, 10-20 parts of vanadium-titanium-iron tailings, 60-80 parts of fine aggregate, 5-10 parts of expanded perlite, 5-10 parts of coal gasification ash, 5-10 parts of quicklime, 3-6 parts of polymer emulsion, 0.5-1 part of polycarboxylic acid water reducing agent and 25-30 parts of water.

title_en: Samarium cobalt recovery method of samarium cobalt magnetic material
abstract_en: The invention provides a samarium cobalt recovery method of a samarium cobalt magnetic material. The samarium cobalt recovery method comprises the following steps: step S1, crushing a samarium cobalt magnetic material by adopting an electrochemical dissolution method to obtain a decomposed solid material and an electrolyzed solution; s2, carrying out acid dissolution on the decomposed solid material to obtain leaching liquid and leaching slag; s3, precipitating samarium in the leaching solution to obtain samarium double salt precipitate and a samarium-removed solution; step S4, deironing the samarium-removed solution to obtain iron-containing slag and a deironing solution; s5, extracting the solution after iron removal to obtain a cobalt-containing solution; and step S6, electrolyzing the cobalt-containing solution to obtain electrolytic cobalt. The samarium cobalt magnetic material is changed into granular material or even powder material by an electrochemical method, and then subsequent acid dissolution treatment is carried out. The electrochemical dissolution method does not need mechanical power to participate, so that the power consumption is less, and the process is wet operation, does not generate dust, and is more beneficial to construction.

title_en: High-uniformity and high-drawing-performance steel fiber hot-rolled wire rod
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of steel for steel fibers, and particularly relates to a steel fiber hot-rolled wire rod with high uniformity and high drawing performance. The main components are C: 0.005-0.015%, si:0.40 to 0.60%, mn:0.80 to 1.00%, al: 0.005-0.010 percent of Ti, 0.050-0.060 percent of Ti, P, S not more than 0.015 percent and Cr, ni and Cu not more than 0.10 percent. Through optimization of component design, smelting process and controlled rolling and cooling, the microstructure uniformity of the steel fiber hot-rolled wire rod is improved, the high-uniformity steel fiber steel hot-rolled wire rod for the steel fiber with the tensile strength of less than or equal to 10MPa is obtained, the drawing performance of the steel fiber hot-rolled wire rod is greatly improved, steel wires with the diameter of less than 0.30mm are continuously drawn by the steel fiber hot-rolled wire rod with the diameter of 5.5mm without annealing, the strength fluctuation value of the steel fiber is obviously reduced, the length-diameter ratio of the steel fiber is increased, and the reinforcing effect of the steel fiber is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of alpha-alumina with edges and corners
abstract_en: The application provides a method for preparing alpha-alumina powder by adopting a twice high-temperature calcination process. The method comprises the following steps of taking aluminum oxide to calcine for the first time to obtain aluminum oxide powder, mixing the prepared aluminum oxide powder with water, continuously stirring and dispersing until the mixture is uniform to obtain a mixed solution, carrying out ball milling on the mixed solution to obtain a mixture, drying and then further crushing the obtained mixture to obtain dry powder, and carrying out secondary calcination on the obtained dry powder to obtain the alpha-aluminum oxide with edges and corners. The alpha-alumina powder prepared by the method has sharp edges and corners, the particle size is 250-350nm, the particle size distribution is uniform, and the purity is high, so that the polishing efficiency of the substrate material can be greatly improved.

title_en: Graphene filling material, preparation method thereof and composite heat conduction material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene filling material, a preparation method thereof and a composite heat conduction material, and relates to the technical field of material preparation. Compared with the graphene powder prepared by the conventional oxidation-reduction method and the mechanical stripping method, the graphene filling material sheet prepared by the method disclosed by the invention is thicker in diameter and thickness, can resist wrinkles and bending in the dispersion process of a matrix, and improves the orientation, so that the heat conduction performance is improved.

title_en: Method for improving quality and efficiency of ammonium sulfate product produced by ammonia-acid flue gas desulfurization wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for improving the quality and the efficiency of an ammonium sulfate product produced by ammonia-acid flue gas desulfurization wastewater. The method comprises the steps of taking an absorption mother liquor containing ammonium thiosulfate impurities as a processing object, introducing ozone into the absorption mother liquor, oxidizing for 0.5-4.5 h under the conditions that the ultrasonic power density is 50-800W/L, the temperature is 30-60 ℃, the stirring speed is 400-1200 r/min, and the gas flow at an ozone generator gas outlet is 0.1-1.8L/min, wherein the processed solution does not need to be oxidized by concentrated sulfuric acid, and the quality of an ammonium sulfate product meeting the standard requirement of a primary product is obtained only through neutralization, evaporation and crystallization. The invention utilizes the ultrasonic and ozone synergistic advanced oxidation technology to replace the concentrated sulfuric acid oxidation technology in the traditional ammonia acid method, and avoids the problem that the ammonium sulfate product turns yellow because the ammonium thiosulfate impurities generate sulfur under the action of concentrated sulfuric acid.

title_en: Recycled red brick coarse aggregate high-flow concrete and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regenerative red brick coarse aggregate high-flow concrete and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the regenerative red brick coarse aggregate high-flow concrete comprises the following components: 50-100 parts of cement, 580-600 parts of recycled brick and tile coarse aggregate, 700-760 parts of recycled machine-made sand, 160-200 parts of stone powder, 90-130 parts of fly ash, 7-10 parts of modifier and 180-250 parts of water. The invention replaces the gravel with the coarse aggregate of the recycled bricks and tiles by 100 percent to obtain the high-flow concrete which achieves the effects of vibration-free and self-compaction and can be suitable for parts with lower strength requirements, such as a base course, a subbase and the like, thereby solving the problem that equipment, such as a large road roller and the like, required by compaction of plain soil, gravel and cement stable gravel is in contradiction with the narrow space of an operation platform in the construction process of roads, buildings and the like, and achieving the purposes of saving resources and recycling wastes.

title_en: High-entropy ceramic dielectric material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-entropy ceramic dielectric material and a preparation method thereof. The chemical formula of the high-entropy ceramic dielectric material is PbAO  3  Wherein A is selected from at least five elements of Zr, hf, sn, nb, ti, yb, lu, tm, sc, mg, W, each element having a subscript equal and equal to 1.

title_en: High-cohesiveness emulsified asphalt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-cohesiveness emulsified asphalt which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 45-70 parts of asphalt, 1-5 parts of emulsifier, 2-4 parts of pH regulator, 0.1-0.7 part of amine auxiliary agent and 25-52 parts of water, wherein the amine auxiliary agent comprises one of amino-containing compound and derivatives thereof, amido-containing compound and derivatives thereof and nitrogen heterocyclic alkaloid; the amine assistant is added into the asphalt to ensure that the asphalt becomes wet and hydrophilic, and the amine in the amino or amino derivative amine chemical and the hydrocarbon on the surface of the aggregate generate a combination, so that the adhesion between the aggregate and the asphalt is improved, the process is simple, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the industrial production is easy to realize. The modified emulsified asphalt provided by the invention is used for the road surface, has excellent high-temperature performance and water stability, improves the durability of the road, prolongs the service life of the road surface, and can be used for the road base layer, the middle layer and the lower layer.

title_en: Equipment and method for releasing residual stress of copper foil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrolytic copper foil manufacturing methods, and discloses equipment and a method for releasing residual stress of a copper foil.

title_en: Positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: Aiming at the problem that a positive electrode material with excellent energy density and ion conductivity is lacking in the prior art, the embodiment of the application provides a positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery, which are used for improving the ion conductivity of a lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material, so that the capacity of the positive electrode material is improved. The positive electrode material comprises an inner layer material and a coating layer for coating the inner layer material, wherein the inner layer material is LiFe  x Mn 1‑x PO 4 , and the coating layer comprises Nb  2  C MXene and carbon, wherein x is more than 0 and less than or equal to 0.5.

title_en: Glass with far infrared function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass production and processing, in particular to glass with a far infrared function, and a preparation method and application thereof. The formula of the glass with the far infrared function disclosed by the invention is as follows: 50-60 parts of quartz sand, 17-19 parts of soda ash, 2-3 parts of borax, 2-3 parts of sodium nitrate, 3-4 parts of calcium powder, 0.2-0.3 part of sodium fluosilicate, 0.2-0.3 part of aluminum hydroxide, 0.2-0.3 part of salt, 3-4 parts of cobalt, 7-8 parts of erbium oxide and 3-20 parts of mineral powder. The glass has the far infrared function, changes water into micromolecular water, improves the pH value of the water, changes the micromolecular water into alkalescent water, and changes the mouthfeel when drunk. When the tea is brewed, tea polyphenol is separated out for many times, coffee is brewed, and caffeine is separated out for many times.

title_en: Near-infrared thermal coupling curing non-oxide ceramic slurry and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses near infrared thermal coupling curing non-oxide ceramic slurry as well as a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the ceramic slurry comprises the following components: 40 to 90 portions of non-oxide ceramic powder, 0.5 to 20 portions of photosensitive resin, 1 to 40 portions of photosensitive monomer, 0.25 to 4 portions of photoinitiator, 0.25 to 4 portions of thermal initiator, 0.75 to 5 portions of auxiliary agent and 0.5 to 4 portions of up-conversion luminescent material; the non-oxide ceramic powder is Si  3  N  4  、TiN、BN、AlN、SiC、WC、TiC、ZrC、TiB  2  、ZrB  2  One or more of (a). The invention integrates a near-infrared up-conversion photochemical and photo-thermal dual curing system to solve the problem of insufficient curing in the single photocuring or thermocuring process, and is combined with near-infrared light source-driven additive manufacturing to realize the rapid molding of the high-solid content non-oxide ceramic slurry, thereby constructing a high-fidelity non-oxide ceramic structure.

title_en: High-hydrophobicity mesoporous Y-type molecular sieve and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-hydrophobicity mesoporous Y-type molecular sieve and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of hydrophobic molecular sieves. The aperture of the Gao Shushui mesoporous Y-type molecular sieve is more than 2nm, the molecular sieve has a mesoporous structure, the unit cell parameter range is 24.20-24.35A, the silicon-aluminum ratio is less than 80, the water absorption is less than 5%, and the phosphorus content is 0.1-1%; the acidity of the molecular sieve is modulated by the phosphorus modified NaY molecular sieve, so that the stability of the framework is improved; the dealumination, mesoporous making and cell shrinkage are synchronously carried out by using high-temperature acid steam treatment in an anaerobic environment, so that the process flow can be shortened, the use amount of organic acid is greatly reduced, and the problem of collapse of a molecular sieve framework is avoided; free acid on the surface of the molecular sieve is neutralized by weak base, free aluminum and sodium ions on the surface of the molecular sieve and in the pore space are removed, a unit cell is quickly shrunk through high-temperature hydrothermal treatment, and the acidity of the molecular sieve is reduced through high-temperature roasting treatment, so that the hydrophobic property of a product is improved.

title_en: Wave-absorbing heating material, preparation method and ceramic vessel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ceramic material, in particular to a wave-absorbing heating material, which comprises ferrite and basic glaze, wherein the content of the ferrite is 16-22%, and the rest is the basic glaze; the base glaze comprises: petalite, suzhou clay, bentonite, dolomite, quartz, calcite, zinc oxide, talc, melanin, and strontium carbonate; wherein: 52-63 parts of petalite; 2-3 parts of quartz; 2-5 parts of Suzhou soil; 1-3 parts of calcite; 1-2 parts of bentonite; 1-3 parts of zinc oxide; 1-2 parts of dolomite; 2-4 parts of talc; 6 parts of melanin; 1-4 parts of strontium carbonate. The wave-absorbing heating material can be used on open fire or in a microwave oven, reaches 150-200 ℃ within 5 minutes of microwave heating, does not rapidly raise the temperature within a short time, carbonizes and scorches food.

title_en: Thermochromic low-temperature sintering colored sand and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermochromic low-temperature sintering colored sand and a preparation method thereof, wherein copper tailing sand grains are used as base materials, the outer surfaces of the sand grains are wrapped with thermochromic coatings, and the thermochromic coatings comprise: thermochromic pigment, binder, caustic dolomite powder, talc, mineralizer; the thermochromic pigment comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 18 parts of formaldehyde-urea mixed solution, 1 part of heat-sensitive dye, 2 parts of bisphenol AF, 7 parts of tetradecanol, 1 part of modifier, 15 parts of 3wt% of Arabic gum solution and 5 parts of 10wt% of ammonium chloride solution; the invention solves the problem of easy adhesion in the process of producing the color sand in the prior art, and the color sand prepared by the invention has rich color system, high color degree, simple preparation process, low sintering temperature and good water resistance, wear resistance and weather resistance.

title_en: Intermediate entropy ceramic with spinel structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a medium-entropy ceramic with a spinel structure and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ceramic materials. The chemical formula of the intermediate entropy ceramic with spinel structure is (Me)  3  O  4  The Me in the chemical formula is four metal elements with equal molar ratio, and the preparation method is to prepare the final target material by ball milling the raw materials and then performing pressureless sintering twice.

title_en: Preparation method for producing HRB400E superfine crystal straight-bar anti-seismic steel bars with nominal diameters of 12mm through high-speed bars
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing HRB400E superfine crystal anti-seismic steel bars with nominal diameter of 12mm by high-speed bar production, which is characterized by low production cost, strong controllability and the like by integrating and innovating chemical component design, converter smelting, deoxidization alloying structure, continuous casting, steel rolling heating system, pre-finish rolling, finish rolling unit and post-finish rolling cooling control process, fully exerts the refining and strengthening effects of ferrite grains, and has the advantages of excellent and stable technological mechanical property, fine and uniform microstructure, good plasticity and toughness, excellent anti-seismic performance and the like, various indexes are comprehensively superior to GB/T1499.2-2018, and the production cost is reduced by 65 yuan/T compared with the prior vanadium microalloying process  Steel and method for producing same  The production cost of the HRB400E straight bar with the nominal diameter of 12mm is greatly reduced, the market competitiveness of the product is improved, and the method has remarkable economic and social benefits.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nickel monatomic carbon nitride composite photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photocatalysts, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a nickel monatomic carbon nitride photocatalyst. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel oxalate tetrahydrate in absolute ethyl alcohol, and stirring under a water bath condition to obtain a solution A; mixing phytic acid and absolute ethyl alcohol to obtain a solution B, then dripping the solution B into the solution A, carrying out reaction, centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, washing with the absolute ethyl alcohol, drying, and grinding to obtain nickel phytate; finally, mixing and grinding urea and nickel phytate, and calcining to obtain a nickel monatomic carbon nitride composite photocatalyst; the prepared catalyst has uniformly distributed nickel monoatomic atoms on the surface, greatly promotes the separation of photon-generated carriers and the adsorption of oxygen, can be used in the fields of photocatalytic degradation of pollutants and photocatalytic water decomposition, and has a removal rate of 94.1% in 1 h; the performance of water decomposition for hydrogen production is also obviously improved.

title_en: Method for preparing molybdenum alloy complex precise structural part by additive manufacturing technology
