abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a molybdenum alloy complex precise structural part by using an additive manufacturing technology, which mainly comprises the following steps: firstly, weighing Mo powder and TiC powder according to the mass percent of 50-70% of Mo and 30-50% of TiC, preparing 3D printing powder by a method of mixing, pressing, sintering and plasma rotating electrode atomization, and then preparing a molybdenum alloy complex precise structural member by an electron beam melting forming method; and then carrying out heat treatment on the molybdenum alloy complex precise structural part to eliminate residual thermal stress in the process of melting and forming the powder by electron beams from liquid drops to solid state condensation, finally carrying out finish machining on the molybdenum alloy complex precise structural part after heat treatment to reach the product size, and then inspecting, cleaning and packaging. The molybdenum alloy complex precise structural member prepared by the method has no cracks in the interior and at the edge, low O and N contents and good wear resistance.

title_en: Process flow for piston rod of electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The invention provides a process flow of a piston rod of an electromagnetic valve, and relates to the technical field of piston rod processing. The process flow of the piston rod of the electromagnetic valve comprises the following steps: cleaning and drying; friction welding, deburring and grinding; heat treatment and grinding treatment; machining and three-stage grinding; carrying out ultrasonic cleaning, electroplating process treatment and dehydrogenation treatment on the piston rod; flaw detection is carried out on the piston rod through eddy current flaw detection, and ultra-precision thread machining is carried out on the piston rod; after the piston rod is cleaned and dried for three times by ultrasonic waves, the two sections of piston rods are subjected to friction welding, and flash removal treatment is carried out; and machining the piston rod. The piston rod process flow can synchronously process the piston rod in multiple sections, and synchronously process the piston rod in multiple sections through a friction welding process, so that the processing efficiency of the piston rod can be effectively improved, and the time spent by the whole process is greatly reduced.

title_en: Bearing roller heat treatment equipment and heat treatment process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bearing balls, in particular to bearing roller heat treatment equipment and a heat treatment process thereof.

title_en: Silica pellets for heat treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides fumed silica granules having a BET surface area of 20m  2 /g to 500m  2 /g, a number average particle diameter d  50  of 350 μm to 2000 μm, a span of the particle size distribution (d  90 -d 10 )/d 50  of 0.8 to 3.0; bulk density of >4nm pores of not more than 1.5cm  3 /g, a process for their preparation and their use as catalyst support, support for liquid substances, in cosmetic applications, for thermal insulation, as pharmaceutical excipients, in the preparation of heat treated silica granules, as abrasive, as component of silicone rubber.

title_en: Positive electrode active material for nonaqueous electrolyte secondary battery and nonaqueous electrolyte secondary battery
abstract_en: The positive electrode active material contains a lithium transition metal composite oxide containing 85 mol% or more of Ni relative to the total molar amount of metal elements other than Li. The lithium transition metal composite oxide contains at least 1 metal element M1 selected from Mg, ti, nb, zr and V in an amount of 3 mol% or less relative to the total molar amount of metal elements other than Li. In addition, the ratio of the concentration of the metal element M1 contained in the shell to the concentration of the metal element M1 contained in the core of the primary particles of the composite oxide is 1.01 to 20 inclusive, and at least 1 metal element M2 selected from Ca and Sr is present on the surface of the primary particles in an amount of 1 mol% or less relative to the total molar amount of the metal elements other than Li.

title_en: Method and system for preparing anhydrous magnesium chloride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preparing anhydrous magnesium chloride. The method comprises the following steps: inputting magnesium chloride dihydrate into a rotary kiln device, and performing dehydration reaction in the atmosphere of hydrogen chloride gas to prepare anhydrous magnesium chloride; wherein, the magnesium chloride dihydrate is subjected to sectional reaction in a rotary kiln device, the first-stage reaction temperature is 180-200 ℃, the second-stage reaction temperature is 200-230 ℃, and the third-stage reaction temperature is 230-300 ℃. The invention adopts the rotary kiln process for dehydration under the atmosphere protection, effectively solves the problem of corrosion of dehydration equipment, and has the advantages of simple process flow, good product quality and strong operability.

title_en: Preparation technology of ceramic rock plate with clear granular sense and ceramic rock plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of a ceramic rock plate with clear granular sensation and the ceramic rock plate, belonging to the field of ceramic rock plate manufacturing, and the preparation process comprises the following steps: (1) ball milling powder: ball grinding the blank base powder and the spot powder with different colors into slurry according to the formula proportion, and aging for more than 48 hours; (2) spray drying: feeding the slurry into a spray drying tower for spray drying, and sieving the powder with a 30-mesh drum sieve; (3) mixing: adding the powder into a rotary screen, passing through a 60-mesh rotary screen, and then mixing through a 100-mesh rotary screen; (4) pressing: before entering a press, the powder passes through a 50-mesh sieve and is pressed; (5) drying: (6) sintering and post-treatment: and obtaining the ceramic rock plate with clear particles. Compared with the existing ceramic rock plate with the spot size of about 30 meshes, the ceramic rock plate prepared by the method has finer spot texture and clearer granularity, and can meet the requirements of higher-end home decoration.

title_en: Method and device for removing cracks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing cracks in a metal material (M) in a metal production process. The method comprises the following steps: -determining the presence of a crack (C) and its crack depth during a metal manufacturing process by means of an inductance measurement by a crack detection unit (30, 16), -sending a crack detection signal (D) and a Crack Depth (CD) to a crack removal unit (40, 25) arranged at a Known Distance (KD) from the crack detection unit, the crack removal unit comprising an ejector (42, 26), the ejector (42, 26) being configured as an ejection engraving means (44, 27), and-varying the intensity of the ejected engraving means, -removing the detected crack by activating the ejector based on the crack detection signal to at least the intensity of the ejected engraving means based on the crack depth.

title_en: Method and device for removing cracks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing cracks in a metal material (M) during the manufacture of the metal. The method comprises the following steps: determining the presence of a crack (C) and its crack depth during a metal manufacturing process by means of an inductance measurement by a crack detection unit (30, 16), sending a crack detection signal (D) and a Crack Depth (CD) to a crack removal unit (40, 25) arranged at a Known Distance (KD) from the crack detection unit, the crack removal unit comprising an injector (42, 26), the injector (42, 26) being configured to inject an engraving device (44, 27) and varying the intensity of the injected engraving device, removing the detected crack by activating the injector based on the crack detection signal at least on the intensity of the injected engraving device of the crack depth.

title_en: Coastal coal-fired electricity-gas comprehensive energy production method for absorbing offshore wind power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coastal coal-fired electricity-gas comprehensive energy production method for absorbing offshore wind power, the coastal coal-fired electricity-gas comprehensive energy production system for absorbing offshore wind power comprises an offshore wind power generation system, a coastal hydrogen preparation system, a coastal coal-fired power generation system, a waste gas separation system, a methanation gas mixed preparation system, a gas storage system and an energy delivery system. According to the invention, the offshore wind power is utilized to manufacture hydrogen, so that the problems of cost and system operation safety caused by remote grid connection of wind power are solved, meanwhile, carbon-containing waste gas generated by a traditional coal-fired power plant is separated and treated to form high-purity carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide gas, and the high-purity carbon monoxide and the carbon dioxide gas are taken as production raw materials of methanation gas together with the hydrogen, so that the carbon emission of the coal-fired power plant is reduced, the wind power consumption rate is improved, the overall operation cost of the system is reduced, the energy production efficiency is improved, and the comprehensive supply capacity of an regional energy system is improved.

title_en: Deep degassing device and method for liquid sulfur
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a liquid sulfur deep degassing apparatus and method. The liquid sulfur cooler with a vertical structure is adopted and extends into the liquid sulfur tank, so that the liquid sulfur to be degassed can flow automatically in the liquid sulfur cooler under the action of gravity for heat exchange and cooling, the process is simplified, low-temperature liquid sulfur can directly flow automatically into the liquid sulfur tank for degassing, and power systems such as a conveying pump and the like are not required to be additionally arranged, the integration level of the device can be improved, the scale of the device is reduced, and the energy consumption for power transmission is greatly reduced; the cooling medium is introduced in the liquid sulfur cooling process, and the heat released in the liquid sulfur cooling process can be recycled; according to the method, the liquid sulfur product obtained from the liquid sulfur tank and the deaerated waste gas in the tank are subjected to secondary deaeration through the ejector, and are recycled to the liquid sulfur tank for continuous deaeration after being separated by the liquid sulfur liquid separating tank, so that deep deaeration of the liquid sulfur is realized, and the H  2  S content in the product is far lower than the standard required concentration.

title_en: Damage-resistant aluminum lithium alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a damage-resistant aluminum-lithium alloy material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of preparation and processing of aerospace craft structural materials; the aluminum-lithium alloy material comprises, by mass, 1.3-1.8% of Cu, 1.5-1.9% of Li, 0.6-1.0% of Mg, 0.05-0.2% of a first microalloying element and/or 0.05-0.1% of a second microalloying element and aluminum; according to the invention, the damage resistance of the aluminum lithium alloy material is ensured by controlling the contents of Cu, li and Mg elements; meanwhile, microalloying elements are added, so that the cold plastic deformation processability of the aluminum lithium alloy material is further improved, the alloy has a damage-resistant aging heat treatment time window with wider aging state of the aluminum lithium alloy, and the industrial engineering production and application requirements of high damage resistance and strong cold plastic deformation processability of the aluminum lithium alloy material for aerospace at present can be met.

title_en: Heat treatment method for pearlite heat-resistant steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a surface modification treatment method for a steel material, in particular to a heat treatment method for pearlite heat-resistant steel, which solves the technical problem that a 2Cr3WMoV material is difficult to meet the performance requirement of high-speed operation of an aircraft fuel accessory. The heat treatment method of the pearlite heat-resistant steel comprises the following steps: step 1: pre-treating, quenching and insulating the bar stock made of 2Cr3WMoV-1 material, and then carrying out air cooling or oil cooling; then tempering and heat preservation are carried out, and water cooling or oil cooling is carried out to obtain a bar stock with the hardness HRC less than or equal to 32; then processing the bar stock into a gear to be processed; then processing the bar stock into a gear to be processed; and 2, step: performing carbonitriding; and step 3: and performing sub-temperature quenching, cold treatment and tempering to finish the heat treatment of the gear to be treated, so that the pearlite heat-resistant steel has higher hardness and wear resistance.

title_en: Machining clamp and machining method for dead head of precision casting blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machining clamp and a machining method for a dead head of a precision casting blade, which comprise the following steps: the supporting device is used as a support and is arranged on the working platform; the movable device is movably arranged on the supporting device and is provided with a positioning cavity for accommodating the precision casting blade and enabling the riser end of the precision casting blade to extend out of the first movable end of the movable device; the clamping device is arranged on the movable device and used for fixing the precision casting blade in the positioning cavity; and the adjusting device is used for controlling the moving range of the movable device on the supporting device so as to control the moving range of the riser of the precision casting blade. Compared with a handheld machining mode, the fixture can be used for quickly clamping, manual positioning is replaced, the labor intensity is reduced, high-temperature burn of a handheld machining casting during grinding is avoided, and the safety is high; the clamping is quick and stable, the processing efficiency is greatly improved, the processing accuracy is high, and the qualification rate is obviously improved.

title_en: Manufacturing method for regulating heat treatment deformation of similar magnetizer inductor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat treatment deformation, in particular to a manufacturing method for adjusting heat treatment deformation of similar magnetizer inductors, which comprises a symmetrical inductor with a symmetrical size, an asymmetrical inductor with an asymmetrical size and a symmetrical induction part with a symmetrical size, wherein different inductors adopt magnetizers with different thicknesses for compensating deformation, inductors with small deformation adopt magnetizers with large thickness, and inductors with large deformation adopt magnetizers with small thickness; the size of the induction part is asymmetric, and the deformation amount is adjusted through the deflection amount of the installation position of the magnetizer. The induction deformation amount is reduced in the area with thick deflection, the induction deformation amount is increased in the area with thin deflection, and the controllable deformation area can be obtained by continuously adjusting the thickness and the deflection amount; meanwhile, the stability is good, and the manufacturing requirement on the inductor is reduced.

title_en: Comprehensive recycling method for uranium beryllium ore
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wet metal recovery, in particular to a comprehensive uranium beryllium ore recovery method. The method comprises the following steps: concentrating beryllium in uranium-beryllium raw ore by a beneficiation process to obtain beryllium concentrate and beryllium tailings; uniformly mixing beryllium concentrate and concentrated sulfuric acid in proportion, heating and roasting the mixed ore, cooling, adding water, stirring and leaching; adjusting the pH value of the leached ore pulp to 1.5-2, and then carrying out vacuum filtration to obtain a leaching solution; absorbing uranium in the leaching solution by adopting anion exchange resin, and allowing beryllium to enter absorption tail liquid; leaching the loaded uranium resin to obtain qualified uranium liquid, and precipitating to obtain sodium diuranate products; extracting the adsorption tail liquid, carrying out countercurrent back extraction on the organic phase loaded with beryllium by using ammonium carbonate solution to obtain qualified beryllium solution, and boiling the back extraction solution to obtain Be (OH)  2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And carrying out conventional stirring leaching on beryllium tailings to obtain qualified uranium liquid, and precipitating to obtain an SDU product. The invention realizes uranium and beryllium separation and purification, has simple flow, is easy to operate and saves production cost.

title_en: Filter pressing washing method for tantalum-niobium slurry decomposition liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter-pressing washing method of tantalum-niobium slurry decomposition liquid, which comprises the following steps: step 1: performing filter pressing on the slurry decomposition liquid to obtain primary tantalum-niobium filtrate and a pulp filter cake, wherein the primary tantalum-niobium filtrate is used for producing tantalum-niobium products; washing the ore pulp filter cake by using process water to recover tantalum and niobium in the ore pulp filter cake to obtain water after cake washing and the washed ore pulp filter cake, wherein the water after cake washing is used for producing tantalum and niobium products or is used as consumed water for other working procedures of tantalum and niobium metallurgy; and squeezing the washed ore pulp filter cake by using high-pressure water to obtain the ore pulp filter cake with low water content. According to the filter-pressing washing method for the tantalum-niobium slurry decomposition liquid, disclosed by the invention, tantalum and niobium are recycled layer by layer, the tantalum-niobium recycling efficiency is improved, and the automation of the filter-pressing washing of tantalum and niobium is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of single-layer graphene oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of single-layer graphene oxide, which comprises the following steps: step one, uniformly mixing hydrogen peroxide and concentrated sulfuric acid, adding crystalline flake graphite when the mixed solution is cooled to room temperature, and soaking at room temperature; step two, after the soaking reaction is completed, washing and suction filtering are carried out by using deionized water, and after the washing and suction filtering are completed, drying is carried out to obtain expanded graphite; and step three, uniformly mixing the expanded graphite and the potassium permanganate, slowly dropwise adding concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated phosphoric acid under an ice bath condition to perform secondary oxidation intercalation reaction, heating and stirring after the reaction is finished, adding ice water and hydrogen peroxide after the stirring is finished, performing centrifugal washing by using deionized water until the mixture is neutral, and performing freeze drying to obtain the single-layer graphene oxide with the sheet diameter of 438 microns. The method is characterized in that expanded graphite is prepared at room temperature, and oxidation intercalation treatment is carried out on the expanded graphite to obtain the large-sheet-diameter single graphene oxide, so that the problem that graphene oxide sheets prepared by the existing preparation process are easy to crack is solved.

title_en: H13 ingot casting forging hot-work die steel and production method thereof
abstract_en: Compared with the prior art, the H13 ingot forging hot work die steel and the production method thereof have the advantages that in the ingot homogenizing stage, the inner and outer portions of the ingot are uniformly heated through slow temperature rise preheating/heating, and the internal quality defect caused by thermal stress generated due to the fact that the temperature rise rate is too high in the heating process is avoided. The adoption of the 1250-1280 ℃ long-time high-temperature homogenization heating process ensures that the elements are effectively and fully diffused, so that the element diffusion is more uniform, and the defect of element segregation caused by ingot casting is eliminated. After high temperature homogenization, the temperature is quickly reduced to 1240 +/-20 ℃ for heat preservation, so that the over-burning defect of the billet caused by long-time high-temperature heating is prevented. The effect of eliminating the liquated carbide is achieved through the method. According to the invention, through three piers and three pulls and three-way forging, the technological parameters of each time are controlled, the core tissues of the cast ingot are ensured to be fully crushed in the forging process, the tissue segregation is thoroughly eliminated, the difference value of the transverse and longitudinal mechanical properties is reduced, and the service life of the die is prolonged.

title_en: Amorphous nanocrystalline magnetically soft alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of amorphous nanocrystalline magnetic materials, in particular to an amorphous nanocrystalline magnetically soft alloy and a preparation method thereof. The elemental composition of the soft magnetic alloy comprises Fe  100‑a‑b‑c‑d‑   e  Si  a  B  b  Cu  c  M  d  L  e  Wherein M is Co and/or Ni, L is one or more of Ta, nb, mo and V; a. bC, d, e and 100-a-B-c-d-e respectively represent the molar percentage of each element in the soft magnetic alloy, and the molar percentage of Si, B and the metal elements M and L satisfy the following relational expression: according to the invention, by regulating and controlling the relative contents of Si and B and metal elements M and L, the magnetic permeability attenuation rate of the amorphous nanocrystalline magnetically soft alloy after being stressed can be obviously reduced, and meanwhile, higher magnetic permeability is ensured, so that the stability and accuracy of an amorphous nanocrystalline device are improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of coal-based asphaltene carbon quantum dots capable of being efficiently converted
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a high-conversion high-yield carbon quantum dot, wherein the main preparation process comprises the following steps: (1) Putting coal-based asphaltene into a reactor, adding a pre-oxidant, stirring and performing ultrasonic treatment; (2) Washing the suspension to neutrality, filtering, rotary evaporating, and concentrating; (3) Adding the concentrated liquid into a chemical solution as required for grafting characteristic functional groups, and stirring; (4) Continuously filtering the suspension, and then performing rotary evaporation and concentration; (5) Dialyzing, drying and grinding the concentrated solution to obtain carbon quantum dots; the process has the advantages of simple operation, rich raw material sources, large-scale production, high carbon source conversion rate, high yield of the obtained carbon quantum dots, controllable functional groups and excellent optical performance.

title_en: Ultrasonic vibration powder distribution method for powder compression molding process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic vibration powder distribution method for a powder compression molding process, which mainly comprises the following steps: the material shoe, the die cavity, the base plate and the ultrasonic vibration system. Which comprises the following steps: conveying the powder into the material shoe through the conveying pipe to form accumulation in the material shoe; the material shoe is positioned on the base plate and reciprocates on the base plate, and powder falls into the cavity under the action of self gravity in the process that the material shoe passes through the cavity to complete filling. In the powder filling process, the ultrasonic vibration system positioned around the cavity enables the mold cavity to vibrate at high frequency, so that the powder fluidity in the cavity is improved, and the powder distribution compactness and uniformity of the powder in the mold cavity are further optimized. The method can improve the powder distribution quality on the basis of ensuring the efficiency and can improve the quality of the final formed product.

title_en: Silver-loaded graphite carbon nitride nanosheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silver-loaded graphite carbon nitride nanosheet and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly mixing ammonium salt and a carbon source, drying, then calcining at high temperature to generate graphite carbon nitride nanosheets, secondly mixing the graphite carbon nitride nanosheets, a reducing agent and a silver source in a solvent, and obtaining the silver-loaded graphite carbon nitride nanosheets through hydrothermal reaction. The preparation method is simple, low in cost and environment-friendly, and the silver-loaded graphite carbon nitride nanosheet prepared by the method has the advantages of high specific surface area, low photoproduction electron-hole recombination rate and wide visible light absorption range.

title_en: Low-temperature one-step synthesis of AgBiS2Nanocrystalline method
abstract_en: A method for synthesizing AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline at low temperature in one step, which relates to a method for synthesizing AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline. The invention aims to solve the problems that the conventional methods for synthesizing AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline, such as a heat injection method, a hydrothermal method, a solvothermal method and the like, have complex process, high demand on synthesis reaction temperature, long synthesis reaction time, high cost and incapability of obtaining complete AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline. The method comprises the following steps: 1. preparing a solution; 2. adding the solution II into the solution I; 3. washing and drying to obtain AgBiS  2  nano-crystal with uniform particle size. The method for synthesizing AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline adopts low-temperature synthesis, and has the advantages of simple operation, short time, low cost and Yi Hong quantification. The AgBiS  2  nanocrystalline provided by the invention can be used in novel photoelectric devices such as solar cells and thermoelectric devices.

title_en: Phosphorus supply spray gun structure of yellow phosphorus combustion furnace and phosphorus supply method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphorus supply spray gun structure of a yellow phosphorus combustion furnace and a phosphorus supply method, comprising an outer pipe and an inner pipe; a phosphorus spraying pipeline is arranged inside the inner pipe; a compressed gas inlet pipe is arranged on the outer pipe and is communicated with the inner pipe; the end part of the outer pipe is provided with a steam generating chamber, and a water inlet pipe and a spiral coil pipe are arranged between the inner pipe and the inner wall of the outer pipe; the outer side of the outer pipe is also provided with a turntable assembly, and the turntable assembly comprises a first base and a second base; the first base is rotatably arranged on the second base; and the middle part of the first base is provided with a mounting ring, and the mounting ring is used for mounting a spray gun. In the invention, the heat preservation effect of the water vapor generated by utilizing the heat in the combustion furnace is better, and the water vapor can be reused after being condensed, thereby further saving resources. The rotary table component arranged on the outer pipe drives the spray gun to rotate at multiple angles, so that the spraying of the liquid yellow phosphorus in the combustion furnace is more uniform, and the combustion of the yellow phosphorus is more sufficient.

title_en: Rare earth permanent magnet with carbon fiber protective film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rare earth permanent magnet with a carbon fiber protective film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the permanent magnet comprises a block magnet and a carbon fiber film solidified on the surface of the block magnet, the carbon fiber film is provided with a first carbon fiber layer and a second carbon fiber layer, the first carbon fiber layer is a carbon fiber film containing resin impregnating materials, the second carbon fiber layer is a carbon fiber film containing resin impregnating materials and/or a carbon fiber film without impregnating materials, the permanent magnet is prepared by the following steps of preparing the block magnet, adhering the first carbon fiber layer, adhering the second carbon fiber layer, vacuumizing and solidifying, and the obtained carbon fiber film protects the rare earth permanent magnet.

title_en: Chromium-doped zinc titanate photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chromium-doped zinc titanate photocatalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a proper amount of zinc titanate and chromium nitrate nonahydrate according to a certain proportion, adding the mixture into deionized water, and performing ultrasonic treatment to form a uniform dispersion solution; drying the obtained dispersion liquid to obtain a precursor; calcining the precursor, cooling, cleaning, centrifuging and drying to obtain the chromium-doped zinc titanate photocatalyst. The chromium-doped zinc titanate material provided by the invention participates in catalytic reaction, has better photocatalytic nitrogen fixation and ammonia production performances, and improves the photocatalytic activity.

title_en: Well cementation cement slurry and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides well cementation cement slurry and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of well cementation. The well cementation cement slurry comprises the following components in parts by mass: the well cementation cement slurry has good heat preservation, solves the problems of insufficient strength and insufficient heat preservation capability of the existing well cementation cement slurry of a geothermal well, and also has lower density, good rheological property, lower water loss and proper thickening time, and all performance indexes of the cement slurry completely meet the requirements of field well cementation.

title_en: Grain refinement and homogenization method for 9-12% Cr rotor steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for refining and homogenizing grains of 9-12% Cr rotor steel, and belongs to the technical field of heat-resistant steel materials. The method for refining and homogenizing the 9-12% Cr rotor steel grains comprises the steps of obtaining a forging piece after the 9-12% Cr rotor steel is forged, wherein the diameter size of the forging piece is more than 700mm, carrying out material waiting for the forging piece at 600-750 ℃ for more than 100mm/1h, cooling to 160-350 ℃ after the material waiting is finished, preserving heat for more than 100mm/2h, then heating to 1000-1110 ℃, preserving heat for more than 100mm/1.5h, further cooling to 680-750 ℃, preserving heat to enable the forging piece to generate balanced phase change, and then cooling to below 250 ℃ on the surface of the forging piece. The invention can realize the refinement and homogenization of the grain size of the rotor steel with the diameter of 9-12% of the large size.

title_en: Catalyst and preparation method thereof, and hydrogen storage material containing catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and a hydrogen storage material containing the catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The catalyst contains components X and TiO  2  (ii) a The component X is selected from a simple metal M, a hydride of M or a borohydride of M; the metal M is at least one selected from Li, na, K and Rb; tiO2  2  Is in at least one of a rutile type structure or an anatase type structure; component X with TiO  2  The mass ratio of (1). The hydrogen storage material has better hydrogen absorption and desorption performance, the hydrogen absorption and desorption temperature is obviously reduced compared with the original magnesium-based hydrogen storage material, and the initial dehydrogenation temperature and the peak temperature are respectively reduced to about 185 ℃ and 240 ℃; the hydrogen absorption capacity at room temperature is not less than 3.5wt%, the preparation process is simple, the method is suitable for large-scale amplification, activation is not required, and the method has good performance under mild conditionsThe cycle stability and the high quality hydrogen storage density have good development prospect and practical application value.

title_en: Heat treatment furnace for magnesium-aluminum alloy parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat treatment furnace for magnesium-aluminum alloy parts, which comprises a shell, wherein a heat treatment cavity is arranged in the shell, an opening is arranged above one end of the heat treatment cavity, and a blank plate is arranged in the opening. A plurality of groups of annular chains are arranged in the heat treatment cavity. And a second motor is fixed outside the shell and drives the chain to travel. One end of the chain is positioned below the blank plate, a basket is erected between two chains in the same group, and a plurality of baskets are arranged along the length direction of the chains. The invention has small opening, is convenient for heat preservation, adopts fuel combustion to provide a heat source and reduces the dependence on electric energy.

title_en: Method for reducing water content of flue gas desulfurization gypsum product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gypsum wet desulfurization, in particular to a method for reducing the water content of a flue gas desulfurization gypsum product, which comprises the following steps in sequence: s1, primary dehydration: treating gypsum slurry by using a cyclone, and taking underflow of the cyclone to obtain primary dehydrated slurry; s2, secondary dehydration: treating the primary dehydrated slurry by using a vacuum belt dehydrator, and controlling the thickness of a filter cake to be 10-45mm to obtain a gypsum product. The technical problem that the water content of the gypsum product produced by the existing process is high is solved, the gypsum dehydration method can be applied to practical operation of gypsum dehydration in wet flue gas desulfurization, the water content of the gypsum product is reduced, and the quality of the gypsum product is improved.

title_en: Method for synthesizing molecular sieve and molecular sieve prepared by same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a molecular sieve and the molecular sieve prepared by the method. The method for synthesizing the molecular sieve comprises the steps of (1) preparing a first solution containing an organic solvent and a silicon source, (2) preparing a second solution containing a first organic template agent T, the organic solvent and an aluminum source, and (3) introducing the first solution and the second solution into a hypergravity reactor in two ways, directly crystallizing under the condition of hypergravity rotation stirring, and reacting to obtain a molecular sieve product. The method provided by the invention does not need a conventional aging process, adopts a supergravity strengthening technology in the reaction process, directly heats up and crystallizes, and has short synthesis time, thus obtaining the molecular sieve with special morphology and particle size.

title_en: Molecular sieve membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a molecular sieve membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the membrane thickness of the molecular sieve membrane is 10-500 mu m, preferably 30-200 mu m. The invention provides a preparation method of a molecular sieve membrane, which comprises the following steps: a) Preparing a colloid slurry from molecular sieve seed crystals, a silicon source, water, optionally an aluminum source, optionally a colloid stabilizer; b) Uniformly dispersing the colloid slurry on the surface of a carrier framework, and drying to obtain a blank; c) And (3) carrying out heat treatment on the green body in the presence of organic amine to convert the surface coating of the green body into a molecular sieve membrane. According to the method, the thickness of the molecular sieve film can be effectively adjusted, meanwhile, the organic amine solution and the coating slurry are prepared separately, and the coating slurry can be repeatedly used; the crystallized organic amine solution can be repeatedly used or recycled because of almost no chemical change, so that the amount of waste mother liquor is greatly reduced, and the method is particularly suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Method for recycling ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and sulfuric acid from titanium dioxide waste acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and sulfuric acid from titanium dioxide waste acid, which comprises the following steps: pre-concentrating titanium white waste acid to obtain pre-concentrated acid; step two: cooling the pre-concentrated acid through a heat exchanger, and freezing and crystallizing for a period of time to obtain ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and crystallization mother liquor respectively; step three: concentrating the crystallization mother liquor in a waste acid evaporation system to obtain suspended concentrated acid containing precipitated impurity salt and evaporation condensate water; step four: curing and cooling the suspension concentrated acid, and then entering a filter pressing dehydration system to respectively obtain a metal mixed salt filter cake and filtered finished acid; the metal mixed salt filter cake is used as a raw material for extracting rare noble metals such as titanium, manganese, magnesium, scandium, vanadium and the like and iron to recycle resources, and the finished acid is returned to an ilmenite acidolysis section.

title_en: Annealing platform and method for magnetic alloy ring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an annealing platform and a method of a magnetic alloy ring, wherein the annealing platform of the magnetic alloy ring comprises: the device comprises supporting legs, a bracket, a core frame, an upper pole head, a lower pole head, an upper coil, a lower coil, a heat insulation cover and a furnace body; a furnace chamber for placing the magnetic alloy ring is formed in the furnace body, and a vent hole is arranged on the furnace body; the diameter of the upper pole head and the diameter of the lower pole head are both larger than the diameter of the magnetic alloy ring; after the upper coil and the lower coil are electrified, a transverse magnetic field is formed between the upper pole head and the lower pole head, and the magnetic alloy ring is heated for annealing. The upper coil, the lower coil, the upper pole head and the lower pole head form a larger transverse magnetic field, and heat the magnetic alloy ring to realize annealing. The magnetic domains of the nanocrystals of the magnetic alloy ring with larger size can be arranged transversely and thoroughly to obtain high-frequency performance, so that the nanocrystals break through the limitation of the use frequency band, and the performance of other similar products can still be shown at more than 1 Mhz.

title_en: Assembly line for annealing iron core
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production line for annealing iron cores, which comprises a roller line, wherein the roller line comprises a plurality of rollers which are parallel to each other; the center frame comprises a plurality of ribs which are mutually perpendicular and crossed, planes of the ribs are vertical, and a first hollow hole which is vertically communicated is formed between every two adjacent ribs; the iron core is provided with a second hollow hole which is vertically communicated, and the center frame penetrates through the second hollow hole and is contacted with the iron core; the tray is made of insulating materials, is positioned on the roller line, the center frame and the iron core are arranged on the tray, and a third hollow hole is formed in the middle of the tray; the lifting rope passes through the gap between the adjacent rollers, and passes through the first hollow hole, the third hollow hole and lifts the center frame, the iron core and the tray together. The invention realizes the whole-flow butt joint of the assembly line and the crown block by adopting the material feeding and discharging of the annealing process of the iron core, and greatly saves the manpower. The protection, limit and hoisting designs of all parts are better, simple and reliable.

title_en: Double-liquid slurry injection for freezing engineering gushing water and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-liquid slurry grouting material for freezing engineering gushing water and a preparation method thereof, wherein the double-liquid slurry grouting material comprises liquid A and liquid B; the solution A and the solution B are uniformly mixed; the component of the solution A is cement, bentonite, fly ash and water; the liquid B is water glass; the scheme utilizes the reaction of the quick-setting cement and the water glass to prepare the double-liquid slurry grouting material for blocking the sudden water surge disaster in the freezing engineering, and has the advantages of quick setting time and high strength; meanwhile, the initial setting time is slightly increased in a low-temperature environment, the strength is slightly reduced, and the plugging requirement of the gushing water disaster in the low-temperature environment can be met.

title_en: GH4169 high-temperature alloy and smelting process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GH4169 superalloy, which comprises the raw materials of return materials, carbon particles, industrial pure iron, electrolytic nickel, metallic chromium, molybdenum, niobium, nickel-magnesium alloy; the returned material accounts for 70-98% of the total raw materials in percentage by mass; the return comprises a GH4169 superalloy return and/or other near-constituent steel grade returns, wherein the other near-constituent steel grade comprises a GH3039 alloy and a GH4080A alloy; the mass percentage of oxygen in the GH4169 alloy is not higher than 10 multiplied by 10  ‑6  percent. The invention also discloses a smelting method of the high-temperature alloy. The smelting control process can use a vacuum induction smelting furnace to smelt the high-temperature alloy GH4169 with the returned material accounting for 70-98 percent, which is far higher than the current industry level with the returned material blending ratio of less than 60 percent by weight, and plays a great role in reducing the cost and enhancing the efficiency of enterprises in smelting links.

title_en: Sulfur-tolerant shift catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: A sulfur tolerant shift catalyst and a method of making the same are provided. The catalyst comprises a carrier, an active component, a first auxiliary agent and a second auxiliary agent, wherein the active component is uniformly dispersed in a carrier structure, and the carrier comprises an alkaline multi-element composite metal oxide; the active component comprises a cobalt-containing compound and a molybdenum-containing compound; the first auxiliary agent comprises at least one selected from lanthanum element or cerium element; the second auxiliary agent comprises potassium element. The catalyst has good structure and activity stability, is suitable for low-temperature, high-pressure and high-CO content conversion conditions, has lower alkali metal loss and longer service life, and has good economic benefit and application prospect.

title_en: High-aluminum steel and continuous casting method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses high-aluminum steel and a continuous casting method thereof. The method comprises providing high aluminum steel molten steel; continuously casting molten steel of the first steel grade and high-aluminum molten steel from the first ladle to the second ladle in sequence; the high-aluminum steel molten steel is not used as the molten steel of the first casting order, and the molten steel of the first steel grade and the high-aluminum steel molten steel are cast successively and continuously; covering the liquid surface of the high-aluminum steel molten steel poured into the second ladle by using a pure steel covering agent; pouring high-aluminum steel molten steel into a crystallizer using crystallizer casting powder to form shells, so as to form a casting blank containing blank shells; and drawing the casting blank containing the shell from the crystallizer for cooling to obtain the continuous casting blank of the high-aluminum steel. The method can stably and smoothly pour the high-aluminum steel molten steel with the Al content of 3.0-6.0 wt%, the continuous casting bonding alarm speed reduction occurrence rate is less than or equal to 0.25 times/heat, and no steel leakage accident occurs. The continuous casting blank prepared by continuous casting has good internal quality, no crack on the surface and no slag inclusion defect, and well meets the requirement of steel rolling.

title_en: Reducing device, reducing method and steel slag tank for metal smelting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reducing device for metal smelting, which relates to the technical field of metal smelting and comprises an outer tube, an inner tube and a stress arc head. The outer tube and the inner tube are integrated by means of expansion, and the stress arc head embedded into the push rod under the action of the elastic force of the blocking spring is arranged in the outer tube. Based on the method, when the flow guide pipe is not expanded, the outer pipe is blocked or opened under the drive of the push rod, and when the flow guide pipe is blocked and stopped after being heated and expanded, the stress arc head is pushed away by utilizing the power of the push rod, so that the force conduction of the push rod to the outer pipe is reduced, the outer pipe pushes the inner pipe to extend out of the outer pipe, and the flow guide pipe is blocked by the inner pipe instead of the outer pipe, thereby realizing diameter changing. So as to block the flow guide pipe with smaller aperture after being heated and expanded in time, and avoid explosion caused by insufficient water quenching of steel slag.

title_en: Recovery method of high-purity silver target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recovery method of a high-purity silver target, which comprises the following steps: (1) Heating the sputtered silver target assembly, separating the silver target from the back plate in the target assembly after the solder is melted, removing indium solder on the welding surface of the silver target, and cooling to obtain a separated silver target; (2) Pickling the separated silver target obtained in the step (1), and then sequentially carrying out ultrasonic cleaning and drying to obtain a cleaned silver target; (3) And (3) carrying out vacuum induction melting on the cleaned silver target obtained in the step (2) to obtain molten metal, and casting the molten metal to obtain a high-purity silver cast ingot. The recovery method provided by the invention is simple to operate, low in cost and low in impurity content, and meets the requirement of high-purity target sputtering performance.

title_en: Method for improving oxidation rate of magnesium sulfite
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the oxidation rate of magnesium sulfite, and belongs to the technical field of air pollution control. The invention provides a method for improving the oxidation rate of magnesium sulfite, which comprises the following steps: mgSO  3  Mixing the slurry with a Co-MCM-22 catalyst, and carrying out oxidation reaction in an oxygen-containing atmosphere; the Co-MCM-22 catalyst comprises an MCM-22 molecular sieve and Co loaded on the MCM-22 molecular sieve  3  O  4  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The preparation method of the Co-MCM-22 catalyst comprises the following steps: immersing MCM-22 mesoporous molecular sieve in cobalt salt solution, evaporating to dryness and calcining in turnThe Co-MCM-22 catalyst is obtained. The method can improve the rate of oxidizing magnesium sulfite into magnesium sulfate, improve the oxygen utilization rate, reduce the energy consumption, save the cost of producing sulfate, and has low catalyst residue and recycling property.

title_en: Preparation method of pure-phase SAPO-5 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular sieve preparation methods, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a pure-phase SAPO-5 molecular sieve, which comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving an aluminum source and a phosphorus source in water, then adding a silicon source, triethylamine and di-n-butylamine, and stirring to prepare a mixture; s2, drying the mixture prepared in the step S1 into dry glue to prepare a solid mixture; s3, adding water into the solid mixture prepared in the step S2, and crystallizing at the temperature of 140-200 ℃ under the pressure of 10-12 Mpa; s4, after crystallization, solid-liquid separation, drying and roasting at 500-600 ℃ to obtain the pure-phase SAPO-5 molecular sieve. The invention has the advantages of simple operation, lower cost and purer SAPO-5 molecular sieve, and is suitable for industrial production and application.

title_en: Manufacturing method of hypereutectic high-chromium cast iron screw
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manufacturing method of a hypereutectic high-chromium cast iron screw. Comprises 1) intermediate frequency furnace smelting: the charging material is high-quality scrap steel, high-purity pig iron, low-phosphorus alloyed iron alloy or industrial pure metal, and P in molten iron is less than or equal to 0.015%; reducing slag is produced in the furnace. 2) And (3) ladle molten iron treatment: tapping temperature>Mixing iron slag at 1600 deg.c, stirring molten iron with inert gas to form molten iron with S less than or equal to 0.010% and O less than or equal to 25ppm. 3) Pouring: the pouring ladle is blocked on a fixed-point pouring truck for fixed-point pouring, and a top cap, a pouring chute and a pouring cup cover are adopted for whole-course CO  2  Or N  2  And (3) protecting, inoculating with the rheological substances, and pouring filter residues of the ceramic filter screen. 4) And (3) casting cleaning: and cleaning by adopting a cold working mode, and thus, fire cannot be moved. 5) Heat treatment and processing: and (5) processing after softening, and blasting after hardening treatment. The utility model reduces the content of sulfur, phosphorus, oxygen and other impurities in molten iron from multiple aspects and has the advantage of high hardness and toughness of pure castings.

title_en: Micro-nano synergistic reinforced metal-based composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a micro-nano cooperative reinforced metal matrix composite, which has a two-stage structure, wherein the one-stage structure is as follows: consists of a metal matrix and nano reinforcing phases uniformly distributed in the grain structure of the metal matrix; secondary structure: is assembled by the primary structure and the micron reinforcing phase; in the primary structure, the metal matrix and the nano reinforcing phase form a layered structure micro-region, different micro-regions are randomly oriented, and the stress field distribution of the metal matrix is fundamentally changed by optimizing the structural design of the composite material, so that the mechanical property of the metal composite material is improved.

title_en: Efficient casting aluminum bar for aluminum profile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of casting aluminum bars, and in particular discloses a high-efficiency casting aluminum bar for aluminum profiles, which is characterized by comprising the following raw materials in parts by weight: 65-70 parts of aluminum, 2-5 parts of nickel, 1-3 parts of manganese, 1-3 parts of chromium, 2-4 parts of tin, 3-7 parts of modified silicon powder synergist and 75-85 parts of aluminum borate whisker modified compound coupling agent treatment liquid. According to the invention, the whisker structure of the aluminum borate whisker is matched with the coupling agent compound agent to be subjected to interface treatment, and meanwhile, the aluminum borate whisker is distributed on the alloy bar matrix through the synergistic improvement of the coordination synergist composed of the raw materials such as nano titanium dioxide, so that the strength and toughness performance of the alloy are obviously improved, the corrosion resistance effect of the product is optimized, and the use efficiency of the product is improved.

title_en: Method for preparing aluminum alloy plate in short process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an aluminum alloy plate in a short process, which comprises the steps of cold-rolling an aluminum alloy hot-rolled blank, obtaining a cold-rolled intermediate plate after cold-rolling from a first pass to a second last pass, carrying out final-pass cold-rolling on the cold-rolled intermediate plate to obtain a cold-rolled plate with a target thickness, and carrying out online annealing, coiling and cooling on the cold-rolled plate to room temperature to obtain the aluminum alloy plate. According to the invention, the recovery degree required by the incomplete annealing (H2 x) or stable annealing (H3 x) state of the aluminum alloy is realized by on-line annealing after final cold rolling and by utilizing the self-tempering of the coiled material, so that the production flow is greatly shortened, the production cost is reduced, and the uniformity of the head-tail tissue performance of the coiled material can be improved.

title_en: Ion doped manganese-based sodium ion positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an ion doped manganese-based sodium ion positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of mixing an ion solution, a doping element solution, a complexing agent and a precipitant, introducing a base solution into the base solution under a protective atmosphere, stopping feeding after the particle size D50 reaches a target particle size, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain an ion doped manganese-based ternary precursor; mixing a sodium source with an ion doped manganese-based ternary precursor, and sintering in an oxygen-containing atmosphere to obtain an ion doped manganese-based sodium ion positive electrode material, wherein a mixed ion solution comprises soluble manganese salt, nickel salt and copper salt, and a doped element solution comprises any one or a combination of at least two of soluble aluminum salt, zirconium salt and titanium salt. The precursor obtained by the preparation method has narrower particle size distribution, can be monocrystalline during sintering, adopts Ni, cu and doping elements to improve the manganese-based sodium ion positive electrode material, and improves the structural stability and air stability of the finally obtained positive electrode material.

title_en: Hub tilting casting machine and hub tilting casting method
abstract_en: A hub tilting casting machine and a hub tilting casting method. A hub tilting casting machine comprises an aluminum melting furnace, a tilting casting device, a material taking device and a cooling device. The tilting casting device comprises a frame, a tilting platform, a lifting frame and a tilting arm. The tilting platform is rotatably arranged on the frame, and is provided with a lower die and an aluminum liquid bag; the turnover arm is rotatably arranged on the lifting frame, one end of the turnover arm is provided with an upper die, and the cooling device comprises a water tank and a lifting table. A method of tilt casting a hub, comprising the steps of: the tilting platform is reversed to enable the aluminum liquid bag and the die cavity on the tilting platform to tilt, and the aluminum liquid in the aluminum liquid bag flows into the tilted die cavity. The hot molten aluminum of the aluminum liquid ladle flows into the die cavity in an inclined state, and the aluminum liquid flows stably in the whole casting process along with the continuous inflow of the aluminum liquid, so that the die cavity can be fully filled.

title_en: Control of ammonia synthesis loop at partial load
abstract_en: A method for synthesizing ammonia, wherein an ammonia synthesis loop comprises an ammonia converter in which make-up gas reacts to form ammonia, and the loop is controlled at partial load by reducing synthesis pressure and maintaining the reduced pressure within a desired range by controlling a bypass line of the make-up gas of the converter.

title_en: Method for catalyzing sodium borohydride to quickly produce hydrogen at low temperature by nonmetal catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for catalyzing sodium borohydride to produce hydrogen rapidly at low temperature by a nonmetal catalyst, which takes lignin substances (including lignin monomers, lignin or lignosulfonate) as a catalyst, methanol or a mixed solution of methanol and water as a reaction solvent and NaBH  4  As a raw material for hydrogen production, naBH is carried out  4  Is used for the alcoholysis hydrogen production reaction. The catalyst used in the invention has rich sources and low price, can catalyze sodium borohydride to prepare hydrogen by rapid alcoholysis under a wider reaction temperature range, has stable catalytic performance, high hydrogen production rate, good catalytic durability and reusability, and has important significance for application and popularization of sodium borohydride in the field of hydrogen preparation.

title_en: Full-automatic metal powder cold pressing and drying integrated device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic metal powder cold pressing and drying integrated device which comprises a frame and a device shell fixed outside the frame, wherein a frame plate is fixed at the top of the frame, an outer cover is fixed at the top of the frame plate, and a sliding seat is arranged in front of the frame in a sliding manner. This full-automatic metal powder dry integrated device that colds pressing, through drive rabbling mechanism's setting, be convenient for carry out back and forth reciprocating motion stirring through the hollow stirring board wherein, and the hollow stirring board direction of motion of inside and outside is opposite all the time, make the material can not always follow a direction stirring, and then make stirring efficiency higher, the material can mix more evenly and abundant, and only need a motor alright realize high-efficient stirring, effectively energy-conservation, through auxiliary stirring mechanism's setting, be convenient for realize the hollow stirring board individual drive to the outside, make hollow stirring board when rotating along with first sleeve, can also independently rotate, further improve the mixing efficiency of material.

title_en: Formula of high-strength high-toughness porcelain insulating material based on multistage grinding technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength high-toughness porcelain insulating material formula based on a multistage grinding technology, which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-40 parts of bauxite, 35-45 parts of plastic clay, 5-10 parts of potassium feldspar and 10-15 parts of Chancolat soil. The invention adopts the scheme of reinforcing by corundum phase and designing matrix phase composition and structure, namely, the corundum phase is introduced in the form of calcined bauxite to reach 48-52% of alumina content, and as the key for improving mechanical properties, 0.5-1% of large-atomic-radius low-melting-point oxide is introduced to reduce the liquid phase forming temperature, thereby reducing the firing temperature, solving the problem of high firing temperature caused by high alumina content and simultaneously not deteriorating the electrical properties of porcelain pieces.

title_en: Ni, cr and Cu composite regulation low-alloy stress corrosion resistant anchor cable steel and preparation method thereof and anchor cable
abstract_en: The application provides Ni, cr and Cu composite regulation low-alloy stress corrosion resistant anchor cable steel, a preparation method thereof and an anchor cable, and relates to the field of low-alloy steel manufacturing. The anchor cable steel comprises the following components in percentage by mass: c:0.50-0.65%, si:0.20-0.25%, mn:0.75-0.85%, P is less than or equal to 0.03%, S is less than or equal to 0.03%, ni:2.0-4.0%, cr:0.5-1.5%, cu:0.40-0.60%, and the balance being Fe. The preparation method comprises the following steps: smelting raw materials to obtain a steel billet, heating the steel billet to an austenite temperature, preserving heat to enable the steel billet to be completely austenitized, cooling the steel billet to a target temperature along with a furnace, and then carrying out hot rolling to obtain a wire rod; the wire is spray cooled and air cooled in sequence, cold drawing to obtain the steel wire. The anchor cable steel provided by the application has excellent corrosion resistance and fracture performance and mechanical property, and has important engineering practical value.

title_en: Glass tube for a pharmaceutical container and method for producing a glass tube
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a glass tube for a pharmaceutical container and a method of producing a glass tube. The glass tube is characterized by low alkali leaching and no lamp ring.

title_en: Hollow inorganic particle and method for producing the same
abstract_en: Provided are hollow inorganic particles which have excellent strength despite high porosity. Provided is a hollow inorganic particle wherein the thickness of the shell is at least 0.80. The hollow inorganic particles of the present technology can be produced by a production method having: a coating step of coating core particles formed of an organic polymer with an organosilicon compound; and a core particle removing step of removing the core particles, wherein the covering step is performed by: a dispersant addition step of adding a dispersant to the core particle dispersion; and a surfactant addition step of adding a cationic surfactant after the dispersant addition step.

title_en: Preparation method and application of oval-like sphere niobium diselenide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of elliptic-like niobium triselenide. Uniformly mixing niobium powder and selenium powder in a molar ratio of 0.2:1-0.5:1, pressing into tablets, and placing the tablets between the cathode and the anode horizontally placed in a direct current arc plasma discharge device. Under the protection of a water cooling system and an argon atmosphere, the air pressure is increased to 20-60kPa, the reaction current is 120-140A, the anode and cathode arc discharge is carried out, and the reaction is completed and then the reaction is cooled and passivated to the room temperature. Collecting gray black powder in graphite pot, and its microscopic morphology is ellipsoidal Nb-like  2  Se  3  The long axis range is 0.5-2 μm. Will contain spheroid Nb  2  Se  3  Niobium selenide material as hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst at 5 mV.s  ‑1  Is similar to ellipsoidal Nb at the scanning speed  2  Se  3  At-10 mA.cm  ‑2  Is of the current density of (1)The overpotential of 304mV can be realized, which indicates that the alloy contains ellipsoidal Nb  2  Se  3  The niobium selenide material has certain hydrogen evolution catalytic activity.

title_en: Zinc oxide roasting equipment convenient to cool
abstract_en: The invention discloses zinc oxide roasting equipment convenient to cool, which belongs to the technical field of zinc oxide processing equipment and comprises a base, wherein a collecting barrel is fixedly arranged on the base, an agitating component, a scraping component and a turnover component are arranged on the base, the agitating component can agitate raw materials, the phenomenon that zinc in the raw materials cannot be gasified sufficiently due to nonuniform heating caused by accumulation of the raw materials is avoided, the waste of the raw materials is caused, the condenser and a reaction tube are arranged, the oxidation reaction can be carried out on the upper half section of the reaction tube to generate zinc oxide, the rapid cooling and solidification of zinc oxide can be realized under the action of the condenser on the lower half section of the reaction tube, the mutual cooperation of the agitating component, the scraping component and the turnover component is not needed, the scraping and cleaning of adhered impurities on a roasting moving cylinder, a roasting bottom plate and an agitating rod can be realized at any time, and the scraped impurities are dumped.

title_en: Nonferrous metal recovery reaction device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of metal smelting, provides a nonferrous metal recovery reaction device, and solves the problems that the gas is not easy to cool due to accumulation of waste residues at the bottom of a furnace body of the conventional device, and the gas escapes when the waste residues are discharged, so that the treatment is not thorough; the device comprises: the recovery reaction main body comprises a recovery reaction seat, and a recovery reaction cavity is arranged in the recovery reaction seat; an auxiliary cooling component in the recovery reaction cavity is arranged; the anti-blocking mechanism is matched with the auxiliary cooling component to work and is arranged in the recovery reaction cavity; be provided with anti-blocking mechanism in this application, anti-blocking mechanism can carry out broken processing to the waste residue in the recovery reaction chamber, drives the waste residue simultaneously and flows, has made things convenient for harmful gas's release, can also fully absorb the heat in waste residue and the waste gas, prevents anti-blocking mechanism and supplementary cooling assembly cooperation work simultaneously, has avoided thermal excessive loss.

title_en: Portable molecular sieve oxygenerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable molecular sieve oxygenerator, which relates to the technical field of molecular sieve oxygenerators and comprises an air inlet bin, a compressor, a multi-way valve, a molecular sieve, an oxygen storage tank and a respiration regulator, wherein the air inlet bin is detachable and is used for filtering air, the air inlet bin is communicated with an air inlet of the compressor, a battery is electrically connected with the compressor and is also electrically connected with the multi-way valve and the respiration regulator respectively, the multi-way valve is provided with valve air inlet, a public port and valve air outlet, the valve air inlet is communicated with an air outlet of the compressor, the public port is communicated with the molecular sieve, the molecular sieve is communicated with the oxygen storage tank, a pressure equalizing valve is arranged between the connection of the molecular sieve and the oxygen storage tank, the respiration regulator is used for detecting and regulating the oxygen concentration and the oxygen outlet flow, the oxygenerator can improve the oxygenerator efficiency and regulate the output oxygen with different gears, and the technical problem of low oxygenerator efficiency of the existing molecular sieve oxygenerator is solved.

title_en: Preparation method of low-resistance thin stainless steel sheet composite material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a low-resistance thin stainless steel sheet composite material, which comprises the following steps: checking and accepting raw materials: checking and accepting the raw material steel coil, distinguishing qualified products from defective products, handling and warehousing the raw material steel coil which is checked to be qualified, and remarking the size and specification of the raw material steel coil on a warehouse entry bill; acid washing treatment, cleaning and drying, edge cutting and coiling: placing the raw material steel coil subjected to the S3 treatment into a slitting machine for edge cutting treatment, and then uncoiling the raw material steel coil through an uncoiler to prepare a strip blank; cold rolling treatment, annealing treatment, leveling treatment, withdrawal and straightening shearing, pre-etching, alkali washing, etching, nickel plating, oiling treatment, packaging and warehousing. According to the preparation method of the low-resistance thin stainless steel sheet composite material, nickel plating operation is performed on the surface of the stainless steel sheet, so that the low resistance in power can be controlled in the power industry, and the functionality of the stainless steel sheet can be improved.

title_en: Wear-resistant repairing material feeding device and method for CFB circulating fluidized bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant repairing material feeding device and a wear-resistant repairing material feeding method for a CFB circulating fluidized bed, and relates to the technical field of circulating fluidized bed repairing, wherein the device comprises a crushing barrel, a stirring and mixing assembly connected with the crushing barrel through a detachable feeding pipe, and a forming die connected with the stirring and mixing assembly through a detachable discharging pipe, wherein the stirring and mixing assembly comprises two symmetrically arranged mixing barrels, and two mixing augers are symmetrically arranged between the two mixing barrels; the method comprises the following steps of S1, crushing, S2, primary stirring and mixing, S3, secondary stirring and mixing, S4, and molding. According to the preparation process and the performance of the circulating fluidized bed repairing material, the stirring and mixing assembly is optimally arranged, so that the mixing effect is further improved, the material can be fed while mixing, the purpose of uniform mixing is realized through alternate conveying of materials in two mixing barrels, the mixing effect is improved, and the strength of the repairing material is further improved.

title_en: Preparation method of anhydrous magnesium chloride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of anhydrous magnesium chloride, which comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out gas-solid reaction on anhydrous magnesium formate powder and mixed gas of anhydrous hydrogen chloride and chlorine or carrying out liquid-solid reaction in an anhydrous organic solvent to obtain an anhydrous magnesium chloride crude product; (2) And (3) carrying out post-treatment on the anhydrous magnesium chloride crude product to obtain anhydrous magnesium chloride. According to the invention, anhydrous magnesium chloride is prepared by reacting the mixed gas of anhydrous hydrogen chloride and chlorine with anhydrous magnesium formate powder, and the reaction activity of the anhydrous magnesium formate can be obviously improved under the condition that the anhydrous hydrogen chloride and the chlorine exist simultaneously, so that the conversion rate of the magnesium formate is improved. The anhydrous magnesium chloride product produced by the method has lower water content, and can better meet the strict requirements of the electrolytic magnesium industry on the quality of the anhydrous magnesium chloride product.

title_en: Preparation method of in-situ vertically grown tin sulfide nanosheets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of in-situ vertically grown tin sulfide nano-sheets, which prepares SnO by a hydrothermal method  2  ‑TiO  2  The nano hollow sphere is used as a precursor; dispersing the precursor and sulfur source in water solution in proper proportion, performing vulcanization reaction under hydrothermal condition, cleaning, and drying to obtain SnO  2  ‑TiO  2  SnS vertically grown on nano hollow sphere in situ  2  A nano-sheet battery cathode material. The invention directionally controls the SnS by adjusting the reaction time and the reaction temperature  2  The growth of the nano-sheet is used for regulating and controlling the morphology structure, improving the stability of the material structure and SnS  2  The generation of the nano-sheet is beneficial to the electron transfer, improves the conductivity of the material, reduces the electrochemical polarization, and improves the electrochemical performance of the material.

title_en: Device and method for drawing quartz fiber by using electric melting quartz glass preform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for drawing quartz fibers by using an electric melting quartz glass preform, wherein the device comprises a rod feeding mechanism, an electric heating furnace, an annular spraying device, an oiler, a beam collecting groove and a wire drawing machine which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, wherein the electric heating furnace is provided with a furnace channel in a penetrating manner from top to bottom, and the rod feeding mechanism is used for fixing the quartz glass preform and feeding the quartz glass preform into the furnace channel from the furnace opening of the electric heating furnace; a heating area is arranged in the electric heating furnace, and an alloy crucible molten pool is fixed at the position of the furnace channel corresponding to the heating area. According to the device and the method for drawing the quartz fiber by using the electric melting quartz glass preform, the electric melting quartz glass preform is drawn through the alloy crucible, so that the long-time stable production operation under the environment without hydroxyl (electric heating) is realized. The introduction of hydroxyl (-OH) in the production process of quartz fiber is effectively avoided. The method does not need to use fuel gas, and solves the production hidden trouble of the existing flame fusion process in the safety.

title_en: Anti-dazzle glass, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The application relates to an anti-dazzle glass and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: melting and forming raw materials to prepare base glass; coarsening one surface of base glass to form particles on the surface to prepare coarsened glass; and carrying out heat treatment on the coarsened base glass to planarize the surfaces of the particles, thereby preparing the anti-dazzle glass. Wherein, the raw materials comprise the following components in percentage by mass: 55 to 65 percent of SiO  2 , 12 to 21 percent of Al  2 O 3 , 12 to 16 percent of Na  2  O, 2 to 5 percent of MgO, 0 to 3 percent of K  2  O, 0 to 3 percent of Li  2  O, 0 to 2.3 percent of ZrO  2 , 0 to 3 percent of B  2 O 3 , 0 to 1.5 percent of BaO and 0 to 2 percent of ZnO. And the sum of the mass percentages of K  2 O、Li 2  O and B  2 O 3  is 0.2-5%, and the sum of the mass percentages of ZrO  2 , baO and ZnO is 0.2-5%. The anti-dazzle glass prepared by the method has higher glossiness while ensuring anti-dazzle effect.

title_en: Novel high-strength acoustic enhancement material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel high-strength acoustic reinforcing material, which relates to the technical field of acoustic materials and has the technical key points that: the novel high-strength acoustic enhancement material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 30-50% of powder, 4-6% of adhesive, 0.01-0.05% of antistatic agent, 0.01-0.05% of antifreezing agent, 0.1-0.5% of dispersing agent, 0.1-0.5% of surfactant, 0.1-0.5% of zeolite particles with average particle size of 1-5 mu m, 0.1-0.6% of artificial diamond powder, 0.1-0.4% of adhesive, 0.01-0.04% of sodium alginate, 0.01-0.03% of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and the balance of water. The novel high-strength acoustic enhancement material is simple in preparation process and easy to operate, is suitable for mechanized mass production, has high strength, has certain elasticity, can maintain a good form, can increase the volume of a virtual rear cavity in a limited space, and improves the audio quality.

title_en: Glue-fixed powder-based filling material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gel-solid powder-based filling material, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of coal mine filling and exploitation; the gel-solid powder-based filling material is prepared from coal gangue, fly ash, gel-solid powder and weak alkaline mine water which are used as raw materials in a certain proportion; the gel-cured powder-based filling material can achieve filling and curing effects similar to those of cement-based goaf filling materials; h generated by physical-chemical reaction of the gel-solid powder-based filling material  2  The amount of the catalyst is far smaller than that of cement-based filling slurry, so that the catalyst reduces the interference to an underground CO electrochemical gas sensor and has good application in the field of coal mine filling exploitation.
