title_en: Ultra-high dispersion type water reducer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An ultra-high dispersion type water reducer and a preparation method thereof. Relates to the field of concrete additives. Comprises the following components in parts by weight: hyperbranched polyether: 40-85 parts of a lubricant; modified alkylene polyoxyethylene ether: 110-150 parts; acrylic acid: 16-25 parts of a lubricant; sodium methallyl sulfonate: 10.0-15.0 parts; and (3) an initiator: 1-6 parts; chain transfer agent: 0.7-4 parts; reducing agent: 0.23-2 parts; water: 180-300 parts. The modified alkylene polyoxyethylene ether is one or more of ethylene glycol monovinyl polyethylene glycol ether and 4-hydroxybutyl vinyl polyethylene glycol ether. The invention improves the durability of concrete, prolongs the service life, and reduces carbon emission, construction waste and other environmental pollution caused by building dismantling. By reducing the cement consumption and the water consumption.

title_en: Manganese-copper bimetal doped carbonized polymer dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manganese-copper bimetal doped carbide polymer dot and a preparation method thereof. And centrifuging and dialyzing the obtained manganese-copper bimetal coarse doped carbonized polymer dot for a period of time, and freeze-drying to obtain manganese-copper bimetal doped carbonized polymer dot powder. And redissolving the powder in water to obtain the purified Mn-Cu bimetal doped carbonized polymer dot solution. The invention realizes excellent free radical removal capability through exploring the inhibition effect on superoxide free radicals and hydroxyl free radicals. The preparation method of the material is simple and convenient, the process is quick, and the material is easy to realize.

title_en: Die casting method for die casting aluminum-silicon alloy and refining pre-crystallized structure
abstract_en: A die casting method for die casting aluminum-silicon alloy and refining pre-crystallized structure relates to the technical field of aluminum-silicon alloy materials, solves the problem of poor mechanical property of die casting aluminum-silicon alloy, and can be applied to manufacturing of automobiles, high-speed trains and large aircrafts. The alloy comprises 8 to 11wt% silicon, 0.3 to 0.8wt% iron, 0.2 to 0.6wt% manganese, 0.1 to 0.5wt% molybdenum, 0.1 to 0.5wt% vanadium, 0.1 to 0.5wt% zirconium, 0.01 to 0.5wt% niobium, 0.1 to 0.5wt% titanium, 0.01 to 0.3wt% boron, 0.01 to 0.2wt% nickel, 0.02 to 0.1wt% strontium, not more than 0.1wt% impurities, and the balance aluminum. Placing the alloy ingot into a heat preservation furnace for melting, preserving heat, introducing argon and stirring; carrying out slag skimming treatment on the aluminum liquid to remove surface scum; and standing the aluminum liquid, reducing the temperature to a specific temperature, performing high-pressure die casting, and vacuumizing by a vacuum machine.

title_en: Heat treatment method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of heat treatment, and discloses a heat treatment method and a heat treatment device. The heat treatment method comprises the steps of placing a workpiece to be treated in a closed cavity, injecting protective gas into the closed cavity to press out air in the closed cavity, placing the closed cavity in an air furnace, performing aging treatment in the air furnace, and releasing pressure of the closed cavity outwards when the pressure in the closed cavity is higher than a preset pressure in a temperature rising stage of the aging treatment.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped carbon dot, preparation method thereof and Fe3+Application in detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a nitrogen-doped carbon dot which is prepared by taking nitrogen-containing tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane as a carbon source and adopting a hydrothermal method. The fluorescent powder has the advantages of good dispersibility, uniform size, high fluorescence intensity, good water solubility and good light stability. The invention also provides a preparation method of the nitrogen-doped carbon dot and application of the nitrogen-doped carbon dot in Fe  3+  detection. The preparation method of the nitrogen-doped carbon dot has the advantages of simple and feasible process, environmental protection and strong applicability. The application of the nitrogen-doped carbon dot in Fe  3+  detection has good selectivity and sensitivity, and can be used for high-sensitivity detection of trace Fe  3+  solution.

title_en: Floating ring turbine bearing for super wear-resistant and high-temperature-resistant turbocharger and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super wear-resistant high-temperature-resistant floating ring bearing and a preparation method thereof, and is characterized in that copper-based alloy powder with a certain material proportion is printed and formed by a 3D printer, the formed floating ring bearing comprises a bearing bush and a floating ring, 3D printing is one of additive manufacturing technologies, and compared with the traditional subtractive manufacturing, the utilization rate of materials is greatly improved, and the production cost is obviously reduced; then respectively carrying out laser cladding on the inner surface and the outer surface of the bearing bush and the floating ring, wherein the clad bearing surface can obtain a clad layer with higher hardness, wear resistance and high temperature resistance; and finally, processing the inner surface and the outer surface of the bearing bush and the floating ring which obtain the cladding layer by an ultrasonic rolling technology, forming tiny grains on the surface layer, reducing the surface roughness, and further improving the wear resistance and the corrosion resistance of the surface, thereby obtaining the super wear-resistant high-temperature-resistant floating ring bearing.

title_en: Method for recycling lithium iron manganese phosphate waste powder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of recycling of lithium iron manganese phosphate positive waste. The invention discloses a method for recycling lithium iron manganese phosphate waste powder, which comprises the following steps: powdering a lithium iron manganese phosphate pole piece, sieving and collecting dust to obtain lithium iron manganese phosphate pole piece powder; calcining lithium iron manganese phosphate electrode powder, and cooling to obtain an oxidation mixture; mixing the oxidation mixture with a lithium source, a phosphorus source, an iron source and a carbon source, adding the mixture into pure water, and performing ball milling and spray drying to obtain a lithium iron manganese phosphate precursor; and sintering and purifying the lithium iron manganese phosphate precursor under the protection of inert gas to synthesize the lithium iron manganese phosphate anode material. The invention has simple process, short process flow and high recovery rate of lithium, iron, manganese and phosphorus.

title_en: Preparation method of modified graphene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of modified graphene, which comprises the following steps: (1) Dispersing graphite and a modifier in water to prepare pretreated graphite dispersion liquid; (2) Stripping and modifying the pretreated graphite dispersion liquid obtained in the step (1) to prepare modified graphene dispersion liquid; (3) And (3) freeze-drying the modified graphene dispersion liquid obtained in the step (2) to obtain modified graphene. According to the method, graphite is used as a raw material, calcein is used as a stripping auxiliary agent and a modifier, the graphite is stripped into graphene by utilizing the effect of the ultrahigh shear rate of a micro-jet homogenizer, and the graphene is modified; the whole process takes water as a medium, does not add strong acid or strong oxidant, and is environment-friendly; the surface of the obtained graphene contains active groups and has high conductivity.

title_en: Leadless ligand-free perovskite nano-material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead-free ligand-free perovskite nano material, a preparation method and application thereof. The perovskite Cs  3 Sb 2 Br 9  nano material is hollow sphere, and is constructed by a simple template-free method without a surfactant. Compared with the traditional halide perovskite with a solid nano structure, the hollow nano structure enables the prepared halide perovskite catalyst to have better photocatalysis effect. More importantly, the oxidation of methanol to produce near stoichiometric value added formic acid while reducing carbon dioxide allows for efficient use of the reactants. The preparation method is simple, the production process is low in toxicity, the preparation parameters are easy to control, the large-scale production and preparation are easy, and the preparation method has wide application prospects in the field of photocatalysis.

title_en: Method for preparing alumina fiber reinforced alumina ceramic matrix composite material rapidly at low cost
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing an alumina fiber reinforced alumina ceramic matrix composite material rapidly and at low cost. The method comprises the following steps: pretreating the alumina fiber preform to remove the wetting agent; preparing lanthanum phosphate interface slurry; vacuum dipping the pretreated alumina fiber preform in lanthanum phosphate interface slurry, and then drying and sintering to obtain a preform containing lanthanum phosphate interface layer; preparing alumina slurry; carrying out vacuum impregnation on the preform containing the lanthanum phosphate interface layer in alumina slurry, and then drying to obtain a sheet-shaped prepreg; preparing an alumina raw material sheet from the alumina slurry by tape casting; and (3) arranging the alumina raw material sheets and the sheet-shaped prepregs alternately in a mould, and then sintering to obtain the alumina fiber reinforced alumina ceramic matrix composite. The invention can realize the preparation of the high-performance continuous alumina fiber reinforced alumina composite material with short period and low cost, and has important significance for industrialization of the material.

title_en: Process for producing microcrystalline glass by using dangerous waste incineration ash shaft furnace and electric melting glass kiln
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recycling and recovery of dangerous waste, in particular to a process for producing microcrystalline glass by using a dangerous waste incineration ash shaft furnace-electric melting glass kiln. The process is realized based on a shaft furnace and an electrothermal glass kiln, and comprises the following steps: step one: adding hazardous waste material into the shaft furnace; step two: oxygen-enriched air is sprayed into the shaft furnace, the temperature in the shaft furnace is increased, and a fused product obtained after the dangerous waste raw materials are fused is obtained; step three: separating slag and molten iron in a molten product obtained after the hazardous waste raw material is molten; step four: adding the separated slag into an electric heating glass kiln; step five: performing modulation operation in an electric heating glass kiln, and adding a crystal nucleus agent after modulation is finished; step six: and (3) leading out the melt in the electric heating glass kiln into a die, and then conveying the die into a heat treatment furnace for heat treatment to obtain the microcrystalline glass blank. The process is used for recycling dangerous waste.

title_en: Value-added utilization method of calcium molybdate-containing slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for value-added utilization of calcium molybdate-containing slag; belonging to the field of molybdenum smelting and ceramic material preparation. Adding an aluminum-containing additive and a calcium-containing additive into calcium molybdate-containing slag, mixing, pressing, heating to 1350-1450 ℃ in an oxygen-containing atmosphere, and then carrying out heat preservation and roasting for 0.5-3 h to obtain a complex-phase heat insulation material; and in the heating and roasting processes, collecting smoke dust at the same time to obtain a molybdenum-rich product. The method integrates molybdenum separation and recovery and preparation of heat insulation materials, realizes full value-added of the molybdenum industrial solid waste through a short process, has simple operation in the production process, high added value of products, high resource recovery rate and good equipment applicability, and is suitable for industrial application.

title_en: Functional solution, method for improving Lab value of glass, glass and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a functional solution, a method for improving Lab value of glass, glass and a preparation method thereof. The functional solution comprises, by mass, 10% -60% of an inorganic alkaline reagent, 2% -8% of a chelating agent, 1% -4% of a corrosion inhibitor and 28% -87% of water, wherein the mass ratio of the corrosion inhibitor to the chelating agent is 1 (1) - (4), the mass ratio of the corrosion inhibitor to the inorganic alkaline reagent is 1 (5) - (50), the inorganic alkaline reagent is at least one of potassium hydroxide and lithium hydroxide, and the chelating agent is at least one of trisodium citrate, sodium gluconate, tetrasodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate and sodium hexametaphosphate. The proposal can lead the color of the glass surface to be recovered to a normal state, and Lab reaches the required range.

title_en: Cement waterproof agent composition and application thereof for prolonging durability of cement
abstract_en: A cement waterproof agent composition and application thereof for prolonging the durability of cement are provided, wherein the cement waterproof agent composition is composed of at least one of ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid, L-aspartic acid, sodium sulfate, sodium silicate and nano silicon dioxide. Durability studies show that the chlorine ion permeation resistance and sulfate erosion resistance of the five chemical components of the invention to the concrete matrix are improved.

title_en: Copper-chromium alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a copper-chromium alloy and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of copper alloy materials. The copper-chromium alloy provided by the invention comprises the following chemical components in mass: 0.4 to 1.2 percent of Cr, 0.02 to 0.15 percent of Zr0.02 to 0.25 percent of Fe, 0.02 to 0.15 percent of P, and the balance of copper and unavoidable impurities. The copper-chromium alloy provided by the invention strictly limits the content of alloy elements, so that the copper-chromium alloy has the characteristics of medium strength, medium elongation, high hardness, high conductivity and high bending property, also has the characteristics of high purity and low alloying, has excellent comprehensive performance even higher than that of foreign patent alloy, and has high application value.

title_en: Preparation method of high-activity renewable active carbon for phosgene synthesis and online regeneration process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of high-activity renewable active carbon suitable for phosgene synthesis and an online regeneration process thereof, which comprises the following steps: 1. taking a nitrogenous aromatic ring compound as a raw material, carrying out catalytic synthesis reaction at high temperature, and cleaning to obtain carbon powder, mixing the carbon powder with common activated carbon powder to obtain a raw material, and carrying out acid washing to remove metal ions to prepare the high-activity activated carbon suitable for phosgene synthesis; 2. the active carbon regenerating process includes electric heater, temperature monitoring inside the synthesizing tower, heat transferring system design, and on-line regeneration of active carbon with high temperature CO and high temperature nitrogen.

title_en: Round bead roundness reprocessing die for precision bearing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bearing ball processing, and discloses a ball roundness reprocessing die for a precision bearing, which comprises a conveying mechanism connecting bottom plate, wherein the top of the conveying mechanism connecting bottom plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of material storage bases which are distributed in a straight line at equal intervals, the top of the material storage base is fixedly connected with a ball sealing module, the ball sealing module comprises a lower die holder, an upper die holder, an inner bracket and a lifting driving piece.

title_en: Turnover modularized vertical concrete member maintenance blanket and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turnover modularized vertical concrete member maintenance blanket and a construction method thereof, wherein the outer side is waterproof cloth, the inner side is permeable cloth, the middle heat-insulating cotton layer has a certain water storage function, and the heat-insulating blanket can be soaked in water at high temperature in summer and then put on the wall, so that a certain moisture-preserving and curing effect is achieved. In addition, the turnover modularized vertical concrete member maintenance blanket is magnetically adsorbed on the outer side of the vertical concrete member through the first magnetic attraction piece, the plurality of maintenance blanket bodies are mutually adsorbed or lapped and enclosed through the second magnetic attraction piece to form the turnover modularized vertical concrete member maintenance blanket so as to maintain the vertical concrete member, the turnover modularized vertical concrete member maintenance blanket can be disassembled in the later period in a lossless manner, is suitable for the vertical concrete members with various specifications, has high turnover utilization rate, and reduces the construction cost of building engineering. The invention solves the problems of poor curing effect and low turnover utilization rate of the traditional curing coating of the vertical concrete member.

title_en: Ferritic stainless steel with improved strength, workability and corrosion resistance
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present specification is a ferritic stainless steel having improved strength, workability, and corrosion resistance, which can be applied to various industrial fields such as washing machines, refrigerators, and all kinds of home appliances. One embodiment of the disclosed ferritic stainless steel includes 0.0005% to 0.02% of C, 0.005% to 0.02% of N, 0.7% to 1.0% of Si, 16.0% to 17.0% of Cr, 0.05% to 0.3% of Ti, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities in weight%, wherein the ferritic stainless steel may have a value satisfying the following formula (1) of 21 to 25, a tensile strength of 470MPa or more, and an elongation of 27% or more. (1) Si+cr, wherein Si and Cr represent the content of each element (wt%).

title_en: Combined sand mould additive manufacturing multi-material integrated sand paving device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined sand mould additive manufacturing multi-material integrated sand paving system which mainly comprises a printing platform foundation mechanism, a combined quantitative sand paving device, a grid sand scraping mechanism and a movable charging barrel mechanism. The printing foundation platform mechanism provides support for the whole system device and the molding sand printing function to realize the droplet ejection of the adhesive; the combined quantitative sand spreading device is a plurality of quantitative sand spreading mechanism combinations, wherein each quantitative sand spreading mechanism can realize independent sand falling, and the whole quantitative sand spreading mechanism combination realizes quantitative sand falling in a specific grid sand scraping mechanism according to casting slice information; the grid sand scraping mechanism mainly divides different areas of the printing platform in a grid mode according to the performance requirements of the sand mold, and meanwhile, the area sand scraping can be realized by moving the grid; and the feed cylinder can be moved by the feed cylinder moving mechanism to realize shakeout of the combined quantitative sand paving device. The integrated sand paving system is high in efficiency and great in engineering application value, and can realize the paving of different types of sand at different positions and the paving of the facing sand and the back sand of a complex casting.

title_en: Automatic blank information tracking and receiving control method based on steel rolling heating furnace
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic blank information tracking and receiving control method based on a steel rolling heating furnace, which relates to the technical field of steel production and comprises the following steps of firstly receiving blank coding information from a steel making system through access gateway communication equipment between steel making and steel rolling, secondly judging whether the coding information is correct, returning to re-receive the coding information and returning an error instruction to the steel making system when the coding information is not in accordance with rules, thirdly calling an information decoding module to carry out protocol decoding on the received data after receiving the data in accordance with the rules, and fourthly, decoding the decoded data according to data definition to generate a tracking sequence.

title_en: Micro-expansion anti-cracking agent for concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a micro-expansion anti-cracking agent for concrete and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of concrete additives, and the micro-expansion anti-cracking agent for concrete comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20 to 40 parts of fluorogypsum powder, 30 to 50 parts of magnesia powder, 5 to 15 parts of talcum powder and 0.1 to 0.5 part of beta-cyclodextrin. The micro-expansion anti-cracking agent for concrete has the characteristics of high expansion rate, good compensation shrinkage effect, simple formula and the like, and takes fluorogypsum powder, magnesia powder and hydrotalcite powder as expansion sources together, so that the expansion rate of the micro-expansion anti-cracking agent for concrete is remarkably improved; meanwhile, a small amount of beta-cyclodextrin is added to play a role in stabilizing fluorogypsum powder, magnesia powder and talcum powder, so that the synergistic effect of three expansion sources is enhanced, shrinkage generated in each age of concrete can be synchronously compensated, and the improvement of mechanical properties such as cracking resistance, compressive strength and the like of the concrete is facilitated.

title_en: Stone coal magnetic separation vanadium enrichment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mineral separation, in particular to a stone coal magnetic separation vanadium enrichment process. The invention comprises the following steps: s1: crushing and drying; s2: a powder ball making stage; s3: a pellet material drying stage; s4: a reduction roasting stage; s5: a water quenching cooling stage; s6: crushing and drying; s7: a dry magnetic separation stage; s8: a high-pressure roller grinding operation stage; s9: a wet magnetic separation stage; s10: and a stage of dehydrating and drying the magnetic product. According to the invention, by utilizing the reduction characteristic of stone coal, the occurrence state of vanadium in stone coal is changed through reduction roasting, and the scattered occurrence vanadium in stone coal is reconstructed into a vanadium-containing enrichment phase with uniform occurrence state and easy separation; separating the reconstructed vanadium-containing enrichment phase by magnetic separation and other methods to obtain high-grade vanadium-containing concentrate; the reducing roasting is consistent with the reducing characteristic of stone coal, so that the roasting efficiency is high, and the required energy consumption is relatively low.

title_en: Decorative plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a decorative plate and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the decorative plate comprises: the first layer body and the second layer body are fixedly connected together; the manufacturing material of the first layer body is an energy-saving temperature-regulating material, and the manufacturing material of the second layer body is a heat-insulating sound-insulating material; the energy-saving temperature-regulating material comprises the following components: 100 parts of Portland cement, 18-25 parts of temperature-regulating energy-saving materials, 18-25 parts of fibers, 16-18 parts of VAE-707 emulsion and 65-70 parts of water. The invention has good heat preservation performance, can realize the storage, release and temperature regulation of heat energy, and better meets the living demands of people.

title_en: Preparation method of nano sulfur particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano sulfur particles, which comprises the following steps: (1) Adding a stabilizer into purified water, stirring and dissolving, then adding a mixture of sulfur and sodium sulfide nonahydrate into the purified water, stirring and dissolving, and then adding a thickener into the mixture, stirring and dissolving; wherein the stabilizer is one of sodium carbonate, sodium hydroxide and sodium bicarbonate or a plurality of mixtures with any proportion; (2) Adding an oxidant into the mixed system obtained in the step (1) at a constant speed, stirring, and stopping stirring when the mixed system is changed from yellow transparent to white emulsion, and ending the reaction; (3) Transferring the reaction liquid obtained in the step (2), standing, centrifugally separating, recovering the separated liquid for later use, washing the separated product with purified water, repeating the standing and centrifugally washing operation for 2 times, vacuum drying the separated product, and crushing by a ball mill to obtain the nano sulfur particles. The method provided by the invention has mild reaction conditions and is easy to control.

title_en: Method for improving clarification of zinc sulfate solution neutralization indium precipitation solution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for improving clarification of zinc sulfate solution neutralization indium precipitation solution, belonging to the technical field of zinc hydrometallurgy, comprising the following steps: q1: neutralizing and precipitating indium: slowly and uniformly adding zinc suboxide powder into the zinc sulfate solution to neutralize and precipitate indium, wherein the pH value of the end point of the neutralization and precipitation reaction is controlled to be 3.5-4.5; q2: neutralization of residual acid: adding lime powder into the liquid after indium precipitation in the step Q1 to neutralize residual acid, and regulating and controlling the pH value of a reaction end point to be 5.2-5.4; q3: clarifying and filtering: adding a flocculating agent into the liquid after the reaction in the step Q2 for thickening and clarifying, filtering the liquid, and sending the obtained supernatant to a subsequent iron removal and purification process, and sending the obtained indium slag precipitate to a subsequent indium recovery process; the method improves the recovery amount of indium in the zinc sulfate solution, and improves the clarification degree of the clarified liquid at the same time, thereby being convenient for subsequent utilization.

title_en: High-temperature oxidation-resistant wear-resistant coating material and preparation and application methods thereof
abstract_en: The high-temperature oxidation-resistant wear-resistant coating material comprises chromium, nickel and metal ceramic powder, wherein the metal ceramic powder is ceramic powder coated with metal powder on the surface; the ceramic powder comprises Cr  3  C  2  And CeO  2  At least one of (a) and (b); the metal powder includes at least one of iron, aluminum, and titanium. The high-temperature oxidation-resistant wear-resistant coating material is particularly suitable for flue gas pipeline equipment, and has super high-temperature flue gas resistance and super high-temperature flue gas resistanceThe chimney flue condensate water has good corrosion effect, high temperature resistance, wear resistance, acid resistance, alkali resistance, tar adhesion resistance, good expansion coefficient and service life of more than 10 years.

title_en: Solar thermochemical hydrogen production power generation system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a solar thermal chemical hydrogen production power generation system and method; relates to the technical field of fuel power generation. The system comprises: the light focusing device is used for focusing solar energy; the thermochemical reactor is used for receiving heat generated by the light condensing device through focusing solar energy and providing a closed space and a heat preservation environment for the reaction process; an oxygen carrier for generating a reduction reaction by heating with heat and releasing oxygen, and generating an oxidation reaction with steam introduced into the thermochemical reactor to generate hydrogen; the thermoelectric power generation component is arranged on the heat preservation layer of the thermochemical reactor and is used for generating power by utilizing the temperature difference between the inner side and the outer side of the heat preservation layer so as to recycle the heat dissipated through the heat preservation layer in the reaction process. The thermoelectric power generation component is utilized to recycle heat dissipation loss of the thermochemical reactor in the reaction process, so that the utilization rate of heat in the thermochemical reactor is improved, and further, the solar thermochemical hydrogen production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Baking-free process for ecological stone for road
abstract_en: The invention discloses a baking-free process of ecological stones for roads, which comprises ten process steps of raw material crushing, raw material mixing, injection molding, compression molding, demolding, steam curing, drying, film coating, cooling and polishing, and comprises the following specific steps: s1, crushing the raw materials: pouring slag, ore tailings, coal ash and waste ceramic tile residues for producing ecological stones for roads into a pulverizer, and pulverizing into raw materials meeting the particle size requirements; the invention adopts steam curing to replace kiln sintering to prepare the ecological stone for the road, avoids generating harmful substances due to chemical reaction caused by high-temperature sintering, reduces the emission of sulfur and nitrogen dust, has good coagulation effect between the raw materials of the ecological stone for the road, has more beautiful surface, forms protection to prevent the surface of the ecological stone for the road from generating broken slag after being directly rubbed, and adopts physical means to reduce the residual quantity of the harmful substances.

title_en: Tin ore smelting and dissolving device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tin ore smelting and dissolving device, which belongs to the technical field of tin ore smelting and comprises the following components: the smelting base, smelt the base top and place and dissolve the shell, dissolve and be equipped with climbing mechanism between shell and the smelting base, dissolve shell operation face outer wall rigid coupling and have the controller, dissolve shell top one side rigid coupling and have the tin ore import, tin ore import top has placed the apron, apron one end and tin ore import same end rotation are connected with first connection pivot; the invention also discloses a tin ore smelting and dissolving method; the device is divided into two parts of the smelting base and the dissolution main body, and the two parts are connected in a jacking mode through the jacking mechanism, namely the device is jacked and inclined at the time of completing dissolution discharging, and at the moment, the residual materials adhered to the inner wall of the dissolution cavity can slide downwards along the inclination of the inner wall under the action of gravity, so that the dissolution materials are discharged more completely, and the problem of waste of the dissolution materials is avoided.

title_en: Connector for instrument and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a connector for an instrument and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the device comprises a main chamber and a micropore chamber connected with the main chamber, wherein the main chamber is communicated with the micropore chamber, the main chamber is used for connecting a process pipeline, the main chamber is communicated with the process pipeline, the micropore chamber is used for being connected with a detection mechanism of an instrument in a sealing way, and a detection area of the detection mechanism is positioned in the micropore chamber. The connecting piece for the instrument adopts integral connection, adopts the integrated instrument connecting piece to connect the measuring instrument to the process pipeline of the nuclear power plant, reduces the connecting piece among instrument joints, instrument joints and the measuring instrument, simultaneously cancels the welding of the instrument joints on the process pipeline, brings the instrument joints into the range of the process pipeline, ensures that the welding between the two ends of the main chamber and the process pipeline is similar to the welding between the process pipeline and the process pipeline, belongs to a mature welding technology, and is beneficial to improving the monitoring precision of each measuring instrument and the operation safety of the process system pipeline.

title_en: Mold for injection molding made by additive manufacturing
abstract_en: A mold for injection molding, comprising a mold body (10) having a plurality of boundary surfaces (10 a-10 f) including at least one molding surface (10 b) configured to define a mold cavity, wherein the mold body is made by additive manufacturing. The mold body comprises a functional area portion (13) on which a plurality of boundary surfaces and a molding surface are formed, and an application area portion (14) consisting of a solid and continuous material structure occupying a portion of the mold body (10), and the application area portion is complementary to the functional area portion (13) in the mold body (10), the application area portion consisting of a three-dimensional material lattice structure comprising orderly repeating unit cells comprising a minimum periodic surface, wherein at least one geometric parameter of the minimum periodic surface is locally adjusted to form unit cells having different material densities.

title_en: Heterogeneous nano flower electrocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous nano flower electrocatalyst and a preparation method thereof, wherein the electrocatalyst is formed by intersecting and assembling an ultrathin palladium-based alloy nano sheet and a ferroferric oxide nano sheet, the heterogeneous nano flower comprises two phases of palladium-based alloy and ferroferric oxide, the palladium-based alloy nano sheet and the ferroferric oxide nano sheet are intersected with each other to form a clear interface, the preparation method is simple and feasible, and the process is controllable, and the heterogeneous nano flower electrocatalyst has abundant interface sites, can obviously enhance the electrocatalytic performance, is a novel alloy/oxide coupling material system, and has important significance for improving the electrocatalytic activity and durability.

title_en: Method for producing inositol and byproducts by using corn steep liquor at low cost
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing inositol and byproducts by corn steep liquor at low cost, which comprises the steps of pumping supernatant fluid after primary precipitation of corn steep liquor into an anion exchange resin column for sequentially carrying out adsorption and desorption, collecting desorption liquid, concentrating the desorption liquid by a membrane to obtain phytic acid concentrated solution, sequentially carrying out hydrolysis and filtration on the phytic acid concentrated solution, concentrating filtrate, separating by chromatography to obtain inositol phase and salt phase, concentrating salt phase by a ceramic membrane, concentrating by a nanofiltration membrane, cooling and crystallizing the concentrated solution, filtering, precipitating and drying to obtain byproduct potassium dihydrogen phosphate, concentrating inositol phase by the ceramic membrane and the nanofiltration membrane, cooling and crystallizing the concentrated solution, filtering, precipitating and drying to obtain inositol. The process eliminates four-effect, six-effect and MVR concentration procedures, saves a great amount of steam consumption, simultaneously reduces exhaust emission and cooling water consumption in the cooling water tower, and greatly reduces the production cost of inositol and byproducts.

title_en: Carbon material with honeycomb porous structure, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon material with a honeycomb porous structure, a preparation method and application thereof. The carbon material is prepared from C, N and O elements according to the weight ratio of 1020-1164: 28-98: 16-128, it is macroscopically block-shaped and microscopically composed of holes with 12-385 nm diameter. The carbon material with the honeycomb porous structure synthesized by the invention has good wave absorbing performance. The weight ratio of the carbon material to the paraffin is 1: 4-8, and under the condition of matching thickness of 1.5-5.5 mm, in the range of effective absorption frequency of 3.63-18 GHz, its minimum reflection loss is-12.9 to-46.4 dB, and effective absorption bandwidth is 1.5-4.8 GHz.

title_en: Low-cost flame-retardant magnesium alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of magnesium alloy as a metal material, and discloses a low-cost flame-retardant magnesium alloy and a preparation method thereof. Based on the total weight of the low-cost flame-retardant magnesium alloy, the low-cost flame-retardant magnesium alloy comprises: 4.0 to 6.0 weight percent of Al, 1.0 to 3.0 weight percent of Ca, 0.4 to 0.7 weight percent of Mn, 0 to 0.6 weight percent of Gd, 0 to 0.6 weight percent of Ce, 0 to 0.3 weight percent of Y and the balance of Mg. The invention solves the problems of high cost and insufficient ignition point of the existing flame-retardant magnesium alloy.

title_en: Steel for producing thick 320MPa high-toughness tubular pile from thin blank and production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to steel for producing thick 320MPa high-toughness tubular piles by thin billets and a production method thereof, wherein the steel for producing thick 270MPa high-toughness tubular piles by thin billets is characterized by comprising the following chemical components in percentage by weight: 0.056 to 0.068 percent of C, 0.05 to 0.15 percent of Si, 0.39 to 0.49 percent of Mn, less than or equal to 0.020 percent of P, less than or equal to 0.020 percent of S, 0.005 to 0.020 percent of Als, 0.022 to 0.030 percent of Ti, 0.13 to 0.18 percent of Cr, and the balance of iron and unavoidable impurities. The invention can realize continuous casting and rolling of thin slabs (135-170 mm) to produce thick-specification (20-24 mm) 320MPa high-strength and high-toughness steel hot-rolled coil for tubular piles.

title_en: Preparation method of degradable rare earth-containing iron-based medical material for biliary-intestinal anastomat
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomedical metals, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a degradable rare earth-containing iron-based medical material for a biliary intestinal anastomat, which comprises, by mass, 30-40% of Mn, 3-10% of Ge, 0.02-1% of RE and the balance of Fe. The invention has the beneficial effects of higher mechanical property, more fitting degradation rate with wound healing, more excellent blood compatibility, cell compatibility and antibacterial property, and is expected to become a potential degradable biomedical material.

title_en: High alpha-Al2O3Preparation method of aluminum hydroxide with content and high alpha-Al thereof2O3Aluminum hydroxide in content and use
abstract_en: A process for preparing the aluminium hydroxide with high content of alpha-Al  2 O 3 , its aluminium hydroxide with high content of alpha-Al  2 O 3  and its application include adding alpha-Al  2 O 3  crystal seed to sodium aluminate solution, induced decomposing to obtain aluminium hydroxide, separating and washing. According to the application, alpha-Al  2 O 3  with different processing performances produced by different processes is selected as a raw material, and a powder system column product of the superfine alpha-Al  2 O 3  with high activity and narrow distribution can be prepared by grinding and sorting, and a series of products with different particle sizes and appearances can be produced by parameter regulation and control of a seed crystal induced decomposition process. The content of alpha-Al  2 O 3  in the aluminum hydroxide product prepared by the method is 1-15%, and the aluminum hydroxide product can be regulated and controlled, provides high-quality raw materials for soft polishing and fine polishing, and can be applied to the fields of refractory materials, electronic ceramics, grinding and polishing materials, catalyst carriers and the like.

title_en: Production process and device for ultrathin aluminum rolled plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process and a device for an ultrathin aluminum rolled plate, which belong to the technical field of ultrathin aluminum rolled plate production and comprise aluminum ingot molding and pretreatment integrated platforms, a cold rolling mill, fixed side plates, a combined type surrounding baffle plate assembly, a double-sided water spray cooling and internal detection mechanism, a distance adjustable roller conveying assembly, a lifting turnover type bottom plate adjusting assembly and a bearing baffle plate, wherein the number of the aluminum ingot molding and pretreatment integrated platforms is two, the two aluminum ingot molding and pretreatment integrated platforms are respectively positioned at two sides of the cold rolling mill, the aluminum ingot forming pretreatment integrated platform comprises a fixed side plate, wherein a combined type surrounding baffle plate assembly is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the fixed side plate, a double-sided water spraying cooling and internal detection mechanism is fixedly arranged on the fixed side plate, and bearing baffles are welded on two sides of the fixed side plate.

title_en: Fuming sulfuric acid evaporator with converted gas as heat source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuming sulfuric acid evaporator which converts gas into a heat source, wherein an upper guide cylinder and a lower guide cylinder are respectively arranged at two ends of a shell side cylinder; the ends of the upper guide cylinder and the lower guide cylinder are respectively provided with an upper pipe box cylinder body and a lower pipe box cylinder body; an upper tube plate is arranged between the upper tube box cylinder body and the upper guide cylinder; the end part of the upper pipe box cylinder body is sealed by an upper elliptical head; a lower tube plate is arranged between the lower tube box cylinder body and the lower guide cylinder, and the end part of the lower tube box cylinder body is sealed through a lower elliptical head; the bottom of the lower elliptical head is provided with a tube side drain; the upper elliptical end socket is connected with the cylinder section; a silk screen foam remover is arranged in the cylinder section; the top of the cylinder section is provided with a top elliptical head; the tube bundles are axially arranged in the lower guide cylinder, the upper guide cylinder and the shell side cylinder, and the tube bundles are axially provided with a plurality of baffle rod assemblies. The evaporator has the advantages of short processing period, small occupied area, low cost, long service life and high evaporation efficiency.

title_en: C/C composite cathode plate, combined electrode, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a C/C composite cathode plate, a combined electrode, a preparation method and application. The preparation method of the C/C composite cathode plate comprises the steps of mixing raw materials including graphite powder, phenolic resin and carbon fibers, adding carbon nanotube slurry to obtain a mixture, volatilizing a solvent of the mixture, adding the mixture into a die for hot press molding to obtain a green body, and placing the green body in a carbonization furnace for carbonization treatment to obtain the C/C composite cathode plate. The cathode plate has low resistance, high strength, low density and good electrical property, can be stably used for a long time, and is not easy to introduce impurities when in use. The combined electrode formed by the cathode plate and the TiMn alloy anode plate has the advantages of good electrochemical performance, strong stability, long service life and the like, when the combined electrode is used for preparing electrolytic MnO  2 , the tank voltage of electrolytic MnO  2  can be obviously reduced, the energy consumption can be reduced, the combined electrode can adapt to high-acidity and high-current density environments, and the crystal form and the purity of MnO  2  can be effectively regulated and controlled.

title_en: Porous alumina doped titanium dioxide nanotube coated lithium cobalt oxide composite material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous alumina doped titanium dioxide nanotube coated lithium cobalt oxide complexThe preparation method of the porous alumina-doped titanium dioxide nanotube-coated lithium cobalt oxide composite material comprises the following steps: tiO doped with Al-MOF precursor by solvothermal method  2  The nano tube is then calcined to obtain porous Al  2  O  3  Doped TiO  2  A nanotube; porous Al  2  O  3  Doped TiO  2  Uniformly mixing the nano tube and the lithium cobaltate material, and performing high-temperature treatment to obtain porous Al  2  O  3  Doped TiO  2  The nano tube is coated with the lithium cobalt oxide composite material. The composite material has excellent electrochemical properties such that LiCoO using the same as a positive electrode active material  2  The battery has excellent specific discharge capacity, mass energy density and cycle stability.

title_en: Double-carbon modified rhenium disulfide nanosheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-carbon modified rhenium disulfide nanosheet, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the inventionThe composite material has unique structure, regular shape, uniform composition, no impurity phase and excellent electrochemical property, wherein the carbon structure of the inner layer and the outer layer and the ReS  2  The synergistic effect of the electrode material not only enhances the conductivity of the electrode material, but also provides a large internal gap buffer area for sodium ion intercalation/deintercalation, realizes rapid and stable intercalation/deintercalation of sodium ions, and shows excellent sodium storage performance.

title_en: Molecular sieve silence oxygenerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular sieve mute oxygenerator, which comprises an oxygenerator shell, wherein a compressor, a molecular sieve and a scavenging valve are arranged in the oxygenerator shell; the gas exchange valve is provided with a valve gas inlet, a valve gas outlet and a nitrogen discharge port, the valve gas inlet is communicated with the compressor, and the valve gas outlet and the nitrogen discharge port are both communicated with the molecular sieve; the nitrogen exhaust port is connected with a nitrogen exhaust silencer, the nitrogen exhaust silencer comprises a first-stage silencing box and a second-stage silencing box which are sequentially connected, the first-stage silencing box is arranged in the accommodating cavity and is connected with the nitrogen exhaust port, the second-stage silencing box is arranged in the base, the second-stage silencing box comprises an air inlet pipe, a silencing cavity and an air exhaust pipe which are sequentially arranged, the air inlet pipe and the air exhaust pipe are respectively connected at two ends of the silencing cavity, the air inlet pipe is connected with the first-stage silencing box, and the air exhaust pipe is communicated with the silencing cavity and the accommodating cavity; according to the molecular sieve mute oxygenerator, on the premise of not increasing the volume of the oxygenerator, the internal space of the oxygenerator is reasonably utilized, and a good silencing effect is obtained by reasonably arranging the silencer.

title_en: Preparation method of bittern carbonization synergistic reinforcement recycled aggregate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of bittern carbonization synergistic reinforcement recycled aggregate, which comprises the following steps: (1) spray pretreatment: carrying out repeated bittern and lime milk alternate spraying treatment on the recycled aggregate at intervals at the temperature of 4-70 ℃ and the pressure of 0.05-0.6 MPa until the surface of the recycled aggregate is wet; (2) carbonization strengthening: standing for 2-4 hours, and then introducing waste gas containing carbon dioxide, wherein the holding time is 4-8 hours; and (3) pickling and air-drying: immersing in water to remove soluble impurities on the surface of the recycled aggregate, and air-drying to obtain the bittern carbonization synergistic reinforced recycled aggregate. The method has lower requirements on temperature, pressure intensity, treatment duration and concentration of carbon dioxide in the waste gas, realizes effective reinforcement of the recycled aggregate under the conditions of normal temperature, normal pressure and short time and directly utilizing the waste gas containing low concentration of carbon dioxide, has simple process, convenient operation, easily obtained raw materials, is beneficial to reducing production cost and realizes industrial continuous production.

title_en: Iron notch drill with large rotation angle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a large-rotation-angle iron notch drill, wherein a drilling and feeding mechanism of the iron notch drill is connected with a rotation mechanism through a hanging mechanism, and the rotation mechanism is a large-rotation-angle mechanism; the large swivel angle mechanism includes: the cantilever support is characterized by comprising a rotating arm connected with the hanging mechanism, a rotating shaft arranged at the end part of the rotating arm, a connecting rod hinged with the rotating shaft, a U-shaped rod hinged with the connecting rod and a cantilever support hinged with the U-shaped rod; the large rotation angle mechanism drives the large rotation angle mechanism to rotate through a rotation oil cylinder, and the rotation oil cylinder is movably hinged with the U-shaped rod; the hinge of the rotary shaft and the connecting rod is fixedly hinged, the hinge of the connecting rod and the U-shaped rod is movably hinged, and the hinge of the U-shaped rod and the cantilever mount is fixedly hinged; the rotary oil cylinder pushes the U-shaped rod and the connecting rod to rotate, and the connecting rod drives the rotating arm to rotate in a large angle. The utility model adopts the cooperation of the U-shaped rod and the connecting rod, the rotary oil cylinder drives the U-shaped rod, and the U-shaped rod drives the rotary mechanism, thereby driving the drilling feeding mechanism and the hanging mechanism to complete the large-angle rotation of the tapping machine.

title_en: Tempered-brittleness-free alloy structural steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a tempering-free brittle alloy structural steel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the technological processes of blast furnace molten iron smelting, desulfurization, converter smelting, LF refining, RH degassing, continuous casting, slab heating, rough rolling, finish rolling, coiling, air cooling, leveling, heating, quenching and tempering, wherein in the continuous casting process, the ladle molten steel comprises the following components ：C：0.03％～0.75％;S≤0.0004％;Ca：0.0006％～0.0016％;P≤0.0040％;Sb≤0.0005％;Sn≤0.0030％;As≤0.0015％;Pb≤0.0005％;N：0.0030％～0.0050％;Ti：0.0108％～0.0200％;H≤0.00015％;Als：0.04％～0.06％; in percentage by mass, wherein the mass percentage relation of the components satisfies that Ca/S is more than or equal to 2, ti/N=3.6-5.0, si+Mn+Cr+Ni+Mo+V+Nb=0.5-12.0%. According to the preparation method of the alloy structural steel without tempering brittleness, provided by the application, the first type tempering brittleness and the second type tempering brittleness of the alloy structural steel are avoided by adjusting the chemical components and the content of the chemical components in the steel plate, so that the problem that the quenched steel plate of the alloy structural steel is embrittled in the tempering brittleness temperature range during service is solved.

title_en: Method for producing a rolling bearing component
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a rolling bearing component (1), wherein the rolling bearing component (1) is formed from rolling bearing steel and has a wall thickness or diameter of at least 85mm at least one point, wherein the rolling bearing component (1) is heated to form an austenitic structure and is then cooled in a warm salt bath below the martensite start temperature of the rolling bearing steel, such that the rolling bearing component (1) is formed to have a martensitic structure in the region of the edge layer of the rolling bearing component (1) and a structure comprising pearlite and/or upper bainite in the core region of the rolling bearing component (1). The invention also relates to a rolling bearing component (1) and a rolling bearing (2).

title_en: Compound S-Sn-Sr and S-Sn-Sr infrared optical crystal, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a compound S-Sn-Sr and S-Sn-Sr infrared optical crystal, a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical formula of the compound is Sr  2  SnS  4  Molecular weight is 422.17, and the crystal is monocrystal particle of sulfur tin strontium with chemical formula Sr  2  SnS  4  Molecular weight 422.17, two phases, both belonging to orthorhombic system, space group respectively Pnma (designated as α ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  ) And Ama 2 (designated as β ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  ) Wherein, the method comprises the steps of, wherein, α ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  the unit cell parameters are a =11.2443(3)Å, b =8.8625(3)Å, c = 7.6143 (3) a, unit cell volume 758.78 (4) a  3  ； β ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  The unit cell parameters are a =9.977(1)Å, b =10.311(2)Å, c = 7.2432 (10) a, unit cell volume 745.13 a  3  . Is prepared by a high-temperature melting spontaneous crystallization method. α ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  Calculated band gap based on HSE06 functional is 3.21eV, calculated birefringence at 1064nm is 0.123; β ‑Sr  2  SnS  4  the calculated band gap based on HSE06 functional was 3.67eV, the calculated birefringence at 1064nm was 0.064, and the doubling effect was silver gallium sulfide (AgGaS  2  ) Has potential application value of double refraction and nonlinear optics.

title_en: Sodium hypophosphite continuous crystallization process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical raw material preparation, in particular to a sodium hypophosphite continuous crystallization process. Which comprises the following steps: adding sodium carbonate, calcium oxide and water into a reaction kettle, preheating, collecting gas, cooling, and adding white phosphorus into the reaction kettle; adding an auxiliary agent into the reaction kettle, introducing the collected gas into the reaction kettle, and filtering the solution in the reaction kettle to obtain crude liquid; the crude liquid is subjected to primary concentration, precipitation is filtered again, and after concentration and crystallization, crude crystals are obtained through centrifugal filtration; after washing the crude crystals with deionized water, the crude crystals were dissolved in double distilled water and filtered through a membrane, followed by recrystallization to obtain sodium hypophosphite crystals. The method utilizes discharged carbon dioxide gas to ensure that residual calcium hydroxide fully reacts to generate calcium carbonate precipitate, and completely removes the calcium carbonate precipitate after twice filtration, and obtains high-purity sodium hypophosphite crystals by combining continuous crystallization with washing and membrane filtration.

title_en: Sodium supplementing material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, electrode assembly, battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a sodium supplementing material and a preparation method thereof, an anode plate, an electrode assembly, a battery and an electric device. The chemical formula of the sodium supplementing material comprises Na  x  M1O  4‑   y  M2  y  Wherein x is more than or equal to 2 and less than or equal to 8,0.01, y is more than or equal to 0.35, M1 comprises at least one of Ni, co, mn, fe, ru, ir, sn, cr, cu, nb, mo, and M2 comprises at least one of F, N, P, S. By adopting M2 element to replace part of lattice oxygen, the structural stability of the sodium supplementing material can be improved, and the oxygen release in the sodium removing process can be reduced, so that the performance of the battery is improved.

title_en: Method for introducing 111 texture into molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for introducing 111 textures into molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy, which comprises the steps of firstly, sequentially pressing and sintering molybdenum powder to obtain a molybdenum blank, or sequentially pressing and sintering the molybdenum powder and rhenium powder after mixing to obtain a molybdenum-rhenium alloy blank, secondly, sequentially performing hot extrusion and rolling on the molybdenum blank or the molybdenum-rhenium alloy blank to obtain a molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy forging rod, thirdly, performing vacuum heat treatment on the molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy forging rod to obtain recrystallized molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy, and fifthly, performing high-temperature compression on the recrystallized molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy to introduce 111 textures into the molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy. According to the invention, through selection of components of molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy and process design, the recrystallized molybdenum-rhenium alloy is obtained, and then 111 textures are introduced into the molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy in a high-temperature compression deformation mode, so that the molybdenum or molybdenum-rhenium alloy has higher structural stability and comprehensive mechanical properties, and the process is simple and convenient and easy to operate.

title_en: Nickel alloy bar and surface treatment equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel alloy bar and surface treatment equipment thereof, in particular to the technical field of nickel alloy bar processing, the invention comprises a nickel alloy bar body and a polishing machine, wherein the nickel alloy bar body mainly comprises a round nickel core and a plurality of metal layers coated on the surface of the round nickel core, and the metal layers coated on the outer surface of the round nickel core are a chromium layer, a tungsten layer and a copper layer in sequence from inside to outside; the brush of the brush is detached from the rectangular rod by arranging the device convenient to replace, so that the brush is convenient to replace; through setting up collection device, conveniently collect recovery processing to the nickel alloy piece that the clearance was got off, improve the utilization ratio of resource.

title_en: Non-layered low-thermal-conductivity indium selenide-based material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-lamellar low-thermal-conductivity indium selenide base material, which has a chemical formula of In  x Se y X z , wherein X is any one element of I, te and La, x=1 or x=1-z, y=1 or y=1-z, and z=0.01-0.1. The preparation method of the non-lamellar low-thermal-conductivity indium selenide-based material provided by the invention has the advantages of abundant sources of raw materials, low cost, simple production process and production equipment, and good controllability and repeatability, wherein the initial raw materials are subjected to dry grinding and wet grinding in sequence to obtain powder, and are dried and sintered, so that the non-lamellar low-thermal-conductivity indium selenide-based material can be directly obtained without melting and other steps, the preparation steps and processes are simplified and optimized, and the cost is saved.

title_en: Low-crystalline iron-based SCR catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a low-crystalline iron-based SCR catalyst, which takes prepared bimetal composite MOFs as a catalyst precursor, enhances the interaction between Fe and Ce, and ensures that Ce doping modification effectively promotes Fe  2  O  3  The electron migration characteristic of the catalyst is enhanced, the low-temperature oxidation property of the catalyst is widened, the electron migration of sulfur dioxide and Fe sites is weakened, and the formation and deposition of surface sulfate are effectively avoided, so that the catalyst has good low-temperature denitration activity and sulfur resistance; the organic ligand is used as a precipitator, and structural defects formed under different ligands not only weaken the crystallinity of active components and expose more active sites, but also are beneficial to the formation of oxygen vacancies and enhance active oxygen in SCR reactionThe formation finally realizes the enhancement of surface acidity and redox, and improves the activity and sulfur resistance of the catalyst.

title_en: Method for removing organic matters and chlorides from copper-containing material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing organic matters and chlorides from copper-containing materials and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of copper smelting, wherein the method comprises the following steps: weighing copper sulfide material and anthracite powder, adding a binder, uniformly mixing, and granulating to obtain raw materials; drying raw materials, adding anthracite into a rotary kiln, igniting the anthracite, and controlling the roasting temperature of the rotary kiln by controlling the content of oxygen in oxygen-enriched air and the air flow; controlling the negative pressure of a kiln tail feed inlet and a kiln head discharge outlet of the rotary kiln, and enabling flue gas generated in the recovery roasting process to enter a dust collection and tail gas treatment system for treatment; controlling the inclination angle and the rotation speed of the rotary kiln to enable clinker to fall into a grate cooler of the kiln head from a discharge hole of the kiln head for cooling; and (5) removing crushed aggregates and coal cinder generated in the roasting process by using a vibrating screen after cooling, and completing removal of organic matters and chlorides. The invention realizes the purpose of comprehensively treating and recycling the copper sulfide material containing the organic matters and the chlorides, and has the characteristics of energy conservation, environmental protection and high efficiency.

title_en: Compact ship carbon capture system, method and application based on methanol reforming coupling high-efficiency membrane separation
abstract_en: The invention provides a compact ship carbon capture system method based on methanol reforming coupling high-efficiency membrane separation and application thereof, wherein methanol aqueous solution is used as raw material, and the processes of reforming, reformate separation, hydrogen combustion and the like are adopted to provide propulsion power for ships; the hydrogen fuel is prepared by reforming methanol and steam, so that the potential safety hazard of high-pressure hydrogen storage in the prior art is solved; the separated carbon dioxide is compressed, liquefied and stored, so that high-efficiency carbon capture is realized; and the exhaust flue gas waste heat is utilized to provide heat for reforming methanol steam and preheating fuel, so that the comprehensive utilization of energy is realized. The invention realizes that the ship utilizes hydrogen energy under the condition of not storing and transporting hydrogen, and solves the filling problem of limiting the development of a hydrogen fuel power system; the method has the advantages of reducing the emission of greenhouse gases, reducing the dependence on fossil fuels, improving the energy utilization efficiency of ships and the like, and is beneficial to pushing the ship industry to progress toward green, low-carbon and sustainable development.

title_en: Multifunctional concrete surface reinforcing material and preparation method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building materials, in particular to a multifunctional concrete surface reinforcing material, which comprises a first component and a second component in a mass ratio of 1-1.5:1.1-1.7; the first component is taken as a penetration enhancing part and comprises silicate, penetrating agent, silane modified inorganic fiber and epoxy resin, so that the first component can be subjected to chemical reaction with internal concrete components to achieve the effect of compaction and enhancement; the second component is used as a filling enhancement part and comprises fluorosilicate, alkali modified nano almond shell powder and a silane coupling agent, so that the compactness of the concrete surface can be ensured, and cracks can be prevented from appearing again after long-time use. The multifunctional concrete surface reinforcing material prepared by the method can effectively solve the technical problems that the bonding capability of the concrete surface reinforcing material in the prior art is poor, the reinforcing effect is difficult to maintain for a long time, the waterproof performance of the concrete cannot be improved, and the cost is high.

title_en: High-strength aluminum alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength aluminum alloy, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of alloys, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, smelting a raw material containing Al, si, fe, mn, zn and Ce for the first time to prepare a first mixture; s2, adding the tantalum-nitrogen-containing graphene-copper aluminum alloy into the first mixture, and smelting again to obtain a second mixture; s3, post-treating the covering agent and the second mixture to prepare a third mixture; s4, casting the third mixture. The invention utilizes the abundant oxygen-containing functional groups on the surface of the graphene oxide, thereby realizing the full dispersion of tantalum element, copper element and aluminum powder; thereby preparing a master alloy with smaller granularity; the dispersion degree of the elements in the finally prepared aluminum alloy material is further improved, so that the overall strength of the aluminum alloy material is improved.

title_en: Double-laser coaxial selective melting repair equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-laser coaxial selective melting repair device and a method, wherein the device comprises the following components: the device comprises an upper computer, a multidimensional adjustment and powder spreading module, a visual detection module, a laser scanning module and a light source module, wherein the multidimensional adjustment and powder spreading module, the visual detection module, the laser scanning module and the light source module are electrically connected with the upper computer; the multidimensional adjusting and powder spreading module comprises a repairing platform, a clamping and fixing device, a powder spreading device and a height adjusting device; the visual detection module is used for respectively detecting the surface of the part to be repaired, the powder spreading state and the repair result and transmitting detection data to the upper computer; the light source module comprises a first laser source, a second laser source and a reflecting mirror, and laser emitted by the first laser source and laser emitted by the second laser source are coaxially converged through the reflecting mirror; the laser scanning module is used for adjusting the scanning path of the coaxial double laser beams and carrying out scanning melting repair treatment on the powder spreading area of the area to be repaired. The invention adopts the laser selective melting technology to realize the shape control of the repair area, and has high precision and good forming structure performance.

title_en: Method for preparing artificial loess with strong collapsibility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of artificial loess with strong collapsibility, which uses barite powder, river sand, kaolin, cement, industrial salt and quicklime as basic materials to prepare the artificial loess with strong collapsibility. The weight sensitive material of the barite powder and the river sand can adjust the specific gravity change of the soil sample, the river sand is used for adjusting the internal friction angle and the deformation modulus of the soil sample, the cement is used as an auxiliary cementing material, the kaolin and the industrial salt can play a cementing role between soil particles, and the quicklime can form calcium carbonate in the process of reacting with carbon dioxide and water, so that the special structure of collapsible loess can be formed. The raw materials are common and cheap, the preparation method is simple, the large-scale preparation can be realized, the physical and mechanical properties of the prepared artificial collapsible loess are similar to those of the undisturbed loess, the artificial collapsible loess has strong collapsibility, and the similar requirements of an indoor model box test on the materials can be met.

title_en: Geppa-grade high-strength and high-toughness BCC high-entropy alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength and high-toughness BCC high-entropy alloy with high Gipa grade and a preparation method thereof; the high-entropy alloy consists of 5-6 elements in Ti, zr, hf, V, nb, mo and Ta, and the selection of the types and the contents of the elements in the alloy is guided according to parameters such as atomic size difference, shear modulus, valence electron concentration, mixing enthalpy and the like of the alloy, so that the structure, strength and plasticity of the alloy are controlled. The high-entropy alloy provided by the invention has the yield strength of more than 1GPa, the room-temperature tensile elongation of more than 18%, the problem that the alloy is difficult to combine with the strong plasticity is solved, the requirement of high-performance metal structural materials is met, and the high-entropy alloy has the characteristics of convenience in preparation, simplicity in process, low specific gravity and the like, and has wide application prospects in the fields of aerospace, nuclear industry, biomedicine and the like.

title_en: Alloy ingot demoulding device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of metal casting, in particular to an alloy ingot demoulding device, which comprises a casting mechanism, a driving part and a mould, wherein the casting mechanism comprises a supporting part, an output disc assembly and a driven gear disc which are rotatably arranged on the supporting part, chains are arranged on the output disc assembly and the driven gear disc, an alloy ingot mould is arranged on the chains, and the driving part is arranged on the supporting part; the support piece comprises a support post and a bearing sleeve arranged on the support post; in the application, since the tooth block and the alloy ingot mold correspond to each other regardless of the change of the rotation speed of the turntable, the impact block can impact each alloy ingot mold accurately, and therefore, when the conveying speed of the alloy ingot mold is changed, the knocking frequency of the impact block can be synchronously adjusted without deviation.

title_en: Preparation method of calcium hydroxide with high specific surface area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high specific surface area calcium hydroxide, which belongs to the technical field of calcium hydroxide preparation, and comprises the following steps: preparing calcium carbonate, modifying and calcining; crushing quicklime, mixing the crushed quicklime with water, stirring at 60-70 ℃ for digestion, then adding hydrochloric acid aqueous solution, continuously stirring, filtering, adding ammonia water into filtrate, stirring at 60-80 ℃, filtering, adding ammonium carbonate aqueous solution and calcium carbonate microspheres into the filtrate, stirring at 60-80 ℃, standing at 60-80 ℃, filtering, washing filter residues with water, and drying after washing is finished to obtain calcium carbonate; the specific surface area of the calcium hydroxide prepared by the method is more than 40m  2  And/g, the particle size distribution is uniform, the purity is high, agglomeration is not easy to occur, and the adsorption capacity is high.

title_en: Method for recycling lithium carbonate and ferric phosphate from waste lithium iron phosphate battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling lithium carbonate and ferric phosphate in waste lithium iron phosphate batteries, which comprises the steps of uniformly mixing, grinding, sieving and drying the positive electrode material of the waste lithium iron phosphate batteries; cutting a graphite sheet; weighing a positive electrode material and a binder polyvinylidene fluoride, adding an N, N-dimethylacetamide solvent, uniformly mixing, coating on a graphite sheet, drying to obtain a ferric phosphate powder electrode sheet, and placing the ferric phosphate powder electrode sheet in an electrolytic tank; adding electrolyte solution, taking an iron phosphate powder electrode sheet as an anode, and taking a titanium sheet electrode as a cathode to perform oxidation reaction; taking out the iron phosphate powder electrode slice, cleaning and drying to obtain a lithium-removed iron phosphate powder electrode slice, and heating and concentrating the leaching solution to obtain lithium carbonate precipitate; and taking the electrode plate of the lithium-ion-removed iron phosphate powder as a cathode, and taking the titanium plate electrode as an anode to perform a reduction reaction. The invention adopts electrochemical technology to recover valuable metals in the waste lithium iron phosphate battery step by step, thus realizing selective recovery of lithium carbonate and ferric phosphate.

title_en: Method and device for producing tetrafluoro oxygen sulfur
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tetrafluoro-oxy-sulfur production device, which comprises a medium-temperature electrolytic tank, a charcoal reactor, a primary dust remover, a fluorine buffer tank, a secondary dust remover, an SOF4 microchannel reactor, a steel bottle, an S0F2 storage tank, an SOF2 condensation collection tank, an SOF2 synthesis reaction kettle, a two-stage washing circulation tank, a gas-water separator and a flame arrester. The equipment in the invention divides the tetrafluoro-oxy-sulfur synthesis technology into two steps, namely, firstly synthesizes difluoro-oxy-sulfur through the SOF2 synthesis reaction kettle, and then prepares fluorine gas fluorinated difluoro-oxy-sulfur through the medium-temperature electrolytic tank to synthesize tetrafluoro-oxy-sulfur, so that the raw materials are easy to obtain, the price is low, the oxidation synthesis method using expensive tetrafluoro-sulfur as the raw materials is avoided, the reaction process is mild and controllable, and the high-temperature and high-pressure safety problem of the process for preparing tetrafluoro-oxy-sulfur by oxidizing tetrafluoro-sulfur is avoided.

title_en: Antibacterial ceramic material, preparation method and application thereof, and tableware
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial ceramic material, a preparation method and application thereof, and tableware. The modified ceramic material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-57 parts of zirconia, 20-41 parts of alumina, 5-16 parts of silicon dioxide, 3-9 parts of yttrium oxide, 2-7 parts of boron nitride and 0.5-3.2 parts of nano materials. The modified ceramic material has high strength, hardness and toughness, is more suitable for the application in the field of tableware, has low sintering temperature, and reduces energy consumption and cost.

title_en: Bentonite-containing thickening concrete and preparation method thereof
