abstract_en: The invention discloses a thickening type concrete containing bentonite and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of concrete preparation, wherein the thickening type concrete is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 300-400 parts of cement, 200-300 parts of modified bentonite, 100-150 parts of modified loess, 600-700 parts of coarse aggregate, 400-500 parts of fine aggregate, 50-100 parts of fiber additive, 2-4 parts of water reducer and 150-200 parts of water. The method specifically comprises the following steps: s1: weighing raw materials in parts by weight for later use; s2: mixing the coarse aggregate and the fine aggregate, and stirring for 20-30min to obtain a mixture A; s3: mixing cement, modified bentonite, modified loess and a water reducing agent with water, and stirring for 30-50min to obtain a mixture B; s4: and mixing the mixture A and the mixture B with the fiber additive, and stirring for 30-40min to obtain the thickened concrete. The concrete of the invention is viscous, convenient for construction, good in mechanical property, not easy to crack and good in seepage-proofing effect, and can be widely applied to seepage-proofing engineering or grouting engineering.

title_en: Quick-setting early-strength inorganic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a quick-setting early-strength inorganic material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the inorganic material mainly comprises the following raw material components in parts by weight: 10 to 60 parts of aluminate cement, 15 to 50 parts of high-calcium minerals, 15 to 40 parts of gasified slag, 10 to 35 parts of bauxite slag and 0.06 to 0.5 part of retarder; wherein the content of free calcium oxide in the high-calcium mineral is 2-40%, the retarder is organic acid containing carboxylate, and the weight ratio of aluminate cement to the high-calcium mineral is 1 (0.5-4). The preparation method of the invention comprises the following steps: mixing aluminate cement, high-calcium minerals, gasified slag, bauxite slag, retarder and plasticizer to obtain a solid master batch; mixing the solid master batch with water, wherein the liquid-solid ratio is 0.1-0.8, and uniformly stirring to prepare the quick-setting early-strength inorganic material. The invention shortens the setting time of the cementing material and has higher early strength by controlling the adding proportion of the high-calcium mineral, the aluminate cement and the retarder.

title_en: Ternary positive electrode material for regulating crystal face growth by molybdate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ternary positive electrode material for regulating crystal face growth by molybdate and a preparation method thereof, wherein nickel salt, cobalt salt and manganese salt are used as raw materials, urea is used as a chelating agent, molybdate is used as a nucleating agent, a precursor is prepared by a hydrothermal method, then the precursor is mixed with lithium salt, and Li (Ni) is obtained by high-temperature sintering  0.8  Co  0.1  Mn  0.1  )  1‑x  Mo  x  O  2  Ternary positive electrode material. Wherein, in the hydrothermal synthesis, molybdate is preferentially absorbedAttached to the electrochemically active (010) crystal face, its surface energy is lowered, and the crystal is induced to grow along the crystal face to obtain a crystal having a crystal growth promoting effect of Li  +  Rapidly diffusing the precursor; whereas Mo  6+  And transition metal ions in the ternary material crystal structure are partially replaced, so that the Ni valence state is effectively reduced and the electrode reactivity is increased. In addition, the bond energy of the Mo-O bond in the doped structure is large, so that the bonding force with oxygen crystal lattice can be enhanced, the transition metal layer is stabilized, the structural stability is improved, and the electrochemical performance of the anode material is further effectively improved.

title_en: Preparation process of mildew-proof antibacterial color ceramic plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mildew-proof antibacterial color ceramic plate preparation, in particular to a mildew-proof antibacterial color ceramic plate preparation process which comprises the following steps of premixing, intermediate mixing, final mixing, extrusion molding, surface treatment and firing, wherein the surface treatment comprises the steps of preservative coating, chitin coating and glaze coating.

title_en: NbCr for knife and scissors2/MoSi2Preparation method of gradient material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a Laves phase NbCr  2 /MoSi 2  gradient material, belonging to the field of composite materials. The method comprises the steps of fully mixing NbCr  2  powder required by each layer and element powder required by synthesizing MoSi  2  according to designed gradient components, gradient layers and component content in each layer, mechanically alloying to obtain mixed powder required by each layer, respectively cold pressing the mixed powder required by each layer to obtain semi-densified powder blanks, layering the semi-densified powder blanks according to the designed gradient components, gradient layers and component content in each layer to obtain a preform, placing the preform in a rolling mill, and carrying out multi-pass cumulative rolling at a certain temperature to obtain the Laves phase NbCr  2 /MoSi 2  gradient material for knife cutting. The Laves phase NbCr  2 /MoSi 2  gradient material prepared by the method has the advantages of full reaction, high density, good bonding quality between gradient interfaces, simple process and low cost.

title_en: Curtain grouting construction process suitable for karst geological dam engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of curtain grouting, and discloses a curtain grouting construction process suitable for karst geological dam engineering, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: s1: measuring and positioning, and determining curtain grouting holes on a dam gallery, wherein the number of curtain grouting holes is multiple; s2: drilling a pilot hole, carrying out a sectional water pressing test on the pilot hole, storing a rock core and recording geological data; s3: drilling the common through hole, wherein the drilling adopts a geological core drilling machine, and the geological core drilling machine adopts a rotary drilling machine to drill and form holes by matching with a hard alloy or diamond bit; s4: carrying out a pressurized water test and grouting, namely carrying out the pressurized water test on curtain grouting holes, finding faults and the like in drilling holes, introducing pasty slurry to carry out grouting to form a barrier layer, and drilling after solidification for a period of time; s5: checking grouting effect, drilling a checking hole after curtain grouting construction is completed for 14 days, detecting Kong Yanxin and performing a pressurized water experiment on the checking hole. The anti-seepage grouting device can solve the problem of poor anti-seepage performance after fault and karst grouting.

title_en: Method for preparing low-carbon olefin and co-producing high-purity carbon monoxide by chemical chain reforming of landfill gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite perovskite type oxygen carrier and landfill gasification based on the oxygen carrierA method for preparing low-carbon olefin and co-producing high-purity carbon monoxide by chemical chain reforming. The chemical formula of the composite perovskite type oxygen carrier is La  x  A’  1‑x  Fe  y  B’  1‑y  O  3  Wherein the A' position is selected from one or more of Li, cs, na, sr, ba; b' is selected from one or two of Mn and W; x is more than 0 and less than 1, and y is more than 0 and less than 1. The composite perovskite type oxygen carrier not only can remarkably improve the selectivity of low-carbon olefin and the conversion rate of methane to low-carbon olefin, but also can be used for being matched with CO  2  Chemical chain splitting is carried out to realize the preparation of high-purity CO. The method sequentially carries out the steps of pretreatment, decarburization treatment, chemical chain reforming, chemical chain cracking and the like on the landfill gas, and finally realizes the preparation of low-carbon olefin and high-purity CO. The method has CH  4  High conversion rate and high CO purity, CH  4  The highest conversion rate can reach 85.37%, and the purity of CO is more than or equal to 96%.

title_en: Preparation method of approximately-formed tantalum-tungsten alloy special-shaped piece
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an approximately formed tantalum-tungsten alloy special-shaped piece, which comprises the following steps: 1. preparing tantalum-tungsten alloy spherical powder by adopting a plasma rotary electrode atomization method; 2. designing and preparing a niobium mold; 3. putting the tantalum-tungsten alloy spherical powder into a niobium mold for vibration, and sealing the preform; 4. performing hot isostatic pressing on the prefabricated part to obtain a pressed body of the approximately-formed tantalum-tungsten alloy special-shaped piece; 5. and removing the niobium mould, carrying out finish machining and then carrying out vacuum heat treatment to obtain the approximately formed tantalum-tungsten alloy special-shaped piece. The tantalum-tungsten alloy spherical powder prepared by the plasma rotary electrode atomization method is filled into a designed sheath for compaction, and is combined with hot isostatic pressing and high-temperature vacuum heat treatment to form the large thin-wall approximately-formed tantalum-tungsten alloy shell, so that the tantalum-tungsten alloy spherical powder has low impurity content and good mechanical property, and can be used as a functional structural material with high temperature resistance, high pressure resistance, corrosion resistance and the like to be applied to the fields of chemical industry, aerospace, atomic energy industry and high temperature technology.

title_en: Integrated multi-laser directional scanning 3D printing system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a 3D printing system and a method for integrated multi-laser directional scanning, wherein the system comprises a printing bin module, a construction bin module, a powder spreading module, a circulating filter module, a control module and an optical module; the number of the optical modules is at least one, and each optical module comprises at least two groups of laser standard units; the laser standard units are mutually arranged in parallel and integrally packaged; each group of laser standard units realizes laser full coverage on the printing platform; the application realizes higher temperature preheating through the system; the precise directional heating is adopted, so that the heat affected zone is reduced, the adverse effect caused by heating is further reduced, and the problem of residual stress is effectively solved; accelerating the heating speed and eliminating the cooling waiting; realizing dynamic heating aiming at the actual state of a molten pool; heating to implement dynamic fine control; heating and printing are not wrong; the system stability is improved; the splicing strategy is more flexible; the production efficiency is improved, and the range of processable powder materials is wider.

title_en: Preparation method of mesoporous calcium phosphate and mesoporous calcium phosphate
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of mesoporous calcium phosphate and the mesoporous calcium phosphate, wherein the preparation method of the mesoporous calcium phosphate comprises the following steps: mixing an ammonium phosphate polymer with water to obtain a mixed solution; mixing soluble calcium salt, soluble phosphate and the mixed solution for reaction, and separating to obtain a solid; and drying the solid to obtain the mesoporous calcium phosphate. The mesoporous calcium phosphate which has good stability and can be stored for a long time can be obtained by adopting the preparation method of the application.

title_en: Preparation method of nano zinc oxide antibacterial fiber material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nano zinc oxide antibacterial fiber material, which comprises the following steps: adding a certain amount of ZnO nano powder into a cellulose solution with the weight of 1.5%, stirring the mixture by adopting stirring and mixing equipment, adding a dispersing agent into the mixture, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment; pouring the mixture subjected to ultrasonic treatment on glass by utilizing a scraper, and curing in a mixture of isopropanol and deionized water to obtain a nano ZnO/cellulose film; testing the antibacterial efficacy of the prepared nano ZnO/cellulose film, and judging the antibacterial effect; the nano ZnO composite material prepared by the existing ultrasonic auxiliary processing is improved, the nano ZnO is treated in advance by adopting a high molecular compound, then the cellulose film is immersed, and the nano ZnO composite material with excellent stability and the nano ZnO composite material with improved antibacterial effect are prepared after drying by ultrasonic auxiliary.

title_en: Application of full solid waste cementing material in treatment of waste antimony smelting slag
abstract_en: The application provides an application of a full solid waste cementing material in treating waste antimony smelting slag, which is used for preparing a solidified glue block material from the waste antimony smelting slag so as to solidify arsenic and antimony contained in the waste antimony smelting slag; wherein, in the cured rubber block material, the curing rate of arsenic and antimony is not lower than 90 percent; the application comprises the following steps: step 1, screening waste antimony smelting slag, adding a full solid waste cementing material and a proper amount of water into the screened waste antimony smelting slag, and stirring by a stirrer to obtain paste; and step 2, injecting the paste into a mould, compacting, and placing the mould into a curing box for curing for 3-28 d to obtain the cured rubber block material. The solidification rate of the arsenic and antimony elements of the obtained solidified glue block material reaches 90%, so that migration of the arsenic and the antimony in waste antimony smelting slag is effectively prevented, and one-step solidification of the arsenic and the antimony is realized. And the cured glue block material with greatly improved compressive strength is obtained, and the compressive strength is as high as 34Mpa, so that the cured glue block material can be applied to building materials.

title_en: Preparation facilities of purification sulfuric acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device for purifying sulfuric acid, which belongs to the field of concentrated sulfuric acid purification and comprises a purification box, wherein a cover plate is arranged above the purification box, a driving motor is arranged on the cover plate, the output end of the driving motor is connected with an evaporation preparation tank through a driving piece, the inner wall of the evaporation preparation tank is fixedly connected with an axle center column, a steam collecting cover is arranged on the cover plate, the top of the steam collecting cover is provided with a steam extraction pipe, the steam collecting cover is connected with a plurality of resistance type heating plates through a linkage adjusting piece, and the top of the axle center column is connected with a pumping fan blade positioned in the steam collecting cover through a transmission component. According to the invention, the sulfuric acid in the evaporation preparation tank is rotated, the internal dilute sulfuric acid can enter under the action of centrifugal force and flows to the outside under the action of centrifugal force, and the dilute sulfuric acid is heated and evaporated by the resistance heating plate in the process of flowing to the outside, so that the rapid evaporation of more moisture in the low-concentration sulfuric acid solution is realized, and the purification efficiency of the sulfuric acid is remarkably improved.

title_en: Functional paper surface gypsum board prepared from waste felt carbon fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waste felt carbon fiber functionalization utilization, in particular to a functional paper surface gypsum board prepared by utilizing waste felt carbon fibers, which is used for solving the problems that the existing waste felt carbon fibers are high in recycling and recycling difficulty, and the existing paper surface gypsum board is easy to crack, poor in conductivity and poor in electromagnetic pollution resistance; the invention utilizes nano TiO  2  The waste felt carbon fiber is modified to prepare modified waste felt carbon fiber, and then the modified waste felt carbon fiber is added into the functional paper surface gypsum board, so that the obtained functional paper surface gypsum board has high mechanical strength and greatly improved cracking resistance, and the surface of the functional paper surface gypsum board has good electric conductionSex. Finally, the novel paper-surface gypsum board with the functions of cracking resistance, conductivity, radiation protection and the like is prepared, the high-valued recycling of the waste felt carbon fibers is realized, and the multifunctional paper-surface gypsum board is prepared, so that the economic and environmental benefits are remarkable, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Large-diameter weather-proof high-strength fastener heat treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-diameter weather-proof high-strength fastener heat treatment device which comprises a box body, wherein the top of the box body is connected with a sealing cover, the top of the sealing cover is provided with a water inlet pipe groove, the inner cavity of the water inlet pipe groove is provided with a water inlet pipe, the bottom of the water inlet pipe is connected with a spray head, one side of the box body is connected with a supporting rod, one end of the supporting rod is connected with a side plate, a roller is connected between the two side plates, the outer ring of the roller is sheathed with a belt, one end of the roller is connected with a motor, the inner cavity of the box body is connected with a connecting rod, one end of the connecting rod is connected with a sliding rail, one end of the sliding rail is connected with a material collecting plate, the bottom of the sliding rail is connected with a limiting rod, and one end of the sealing cover is provided with a material inlet groove. Through the cooperation of slide rail, gag lever post and gathering the flitch and use, can carry out independent transportation to the work piece to make the contact of work piece and coolant liquid more even.

title_en: Large forging stable heat treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stable heat treatment device of large-scale forging, its characterized in that, includes the storage water tank, the storage water tank intussuseption is filled with water, be equipped with filter equipment in the storage water tank, filter equipment divide into the quaternary, the filter equipment first layer is the cotton and the cotton combination of filtration of PP, the filter equipment second floor is compressed activated carbon, the filter equipment third layer is the milipore filter, the filter equipment fourth layer is rear-mounted activated carbon and ceramic ring combination, the storage water tank is fluted, the recess is connected with inlet tube and outlet pipe respectively, the inlet tube with the outlet pipe all sets up inside the storage water tank, the inlet tube includes first inlet tube and second inlet tube, the outlet pipe below is equipped with the outlet duct, the outlet duct with the outlet pipe is connected the condenser pipe jointly. The large forging stable heat treatment device can improve the heat treatment stability of the forging, and improve the cleaning of the water storage environment and the recycling of water.

title_en: Method for producing medium plate blank by using N08120 alloy slab ingot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing a medium plate blank by using an N08120 alloy slab ingot, which belongs to the technical field of medium plates, and comprises the following specific steps: alloying, batching, intermediate frequency furnace +LF +VOD, blank polishing, forging, flaw detection, polishing blanking, hot rolling, solid solution pickling, trimming, leveling, flaw detection, physicochemical detection, packaging and warehousing, wherein the specific process of forging is as follows: the 7200 ton press is used for drawing the slab ingot, the rolling reduction of each time is 60-80mm, the total rolling reduction is 100-150mm, the rolling reduction is carried out for 2-2.5h after the rolling reduction is carried out for 30-40mm, and the slab ingot is drawn after 6 times of fire and shaped to obtain the final forged slab.

title_en: Microcosmic-adjustable FeCoNi@C electromagnetic wave absorption composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic wave absorption, and discloses a FeCoNi@C electromagnetic wave absorption composite material with an adjustable microstructure, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention adopts coprecipitation method, oxidation polymerization method and pyrolysis method to prepare, and polypyrrole can be converted into light nitrogen-doped carbon material after pyrolysis, so that the introduction of polypyrrole not only improves the dielectric loss of FeCoNi@C composite material, but also obviously improves the electromagnetic wave absorption performance. The dielectric constant and the magnetic permeability are adjusted by changing the content of polypyrrole, so that the requirements of adjustable dielectric constant and magnetic permeability and optimized impedance matching of the electromagnetic wave absorbing material are met. An electromagnetic wave absorbing composite excellent in the wave absorbing property can be obtained when the sample filling amount is 40%. When the matching thickness is 1.8mm, the minimum reflection loss can reach-52.4 dB, the corresponding effective absorption bandwidth can reach 5.18GHz, and the method has wide application prospect in the field of electromagnetic wave absorption.

title_en: Waste acid treatment process technology for producing 2-ethyl anthraquinone
abstract_en: The invention adopts the active carbon/diatomite composite powder as the adsorbent to treat the waste dilute sulfuric acid discharged in the production process of the 2-ethyl anthraquinone, reduces the COD content of organic matters in the waste acid to below 200mg/L, and the treated dilute sulfuric acid is clear and transparent and can be used for producing aluminum sulfate, magnesium sulfate and ammonium sulfate; the activated carbon/diatomite composite filter cake after adsorbing the organic matters is pulped, is neutralized by calcium hydroxide, is subjected to pressure filtration, drying and crushing, and the obtained superfine powder material is used as a rubber filling reinforcing agent and can replace classical rubber reinforcing agents such as carbon black, white carbon black and the like. The waste acid of the 2-ethyl anthraquinone treated by the process technology can effectively recycle organic byproducts and adsorbents generated in the production process, and the comprehensive production cost of the 2-ethyl anthraquinone is obviously reduced.

title_en: Process for treating alkaline copper etching waste liquid by broken vein copper deposition method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for treating alkaline copper etching waste liquid by a vein breaking and copper precipitating method, which comprises the steps of adding alkaline copper etching waste liquid into a copper precipitating reaction tank, adding a vein breaking agent while stirring, adding basic copper salt seed crystal, reacting to obtain a primary reaction product, filtering the primary reaction product to obtain basic salt precipitate and ammonium chloride mother liquor, stirring, rinsing, dehydrating and drying the obtained basic salt precipitate to obtain basic salt, so that when the basic copper etching waste liquid is vein broken to generate water-insoluble basic salt precipitate, generated basic salt molecules are continuously collided with the basic copper salt seed crystal to be separated out under the full stirring of the copper precipitating reaction tank, the basic salt molecules can be well attached to the basic copper salt seed crystal, the basic salt molecules can be promoted to be sufficiently separated out from a reaction solution, the recovery and regeneration efficiency and the recovery rate of the basic copper etching waste liquid can be greatly improved, the basic copper etching waste liquid is fully converted into environment-friendly and pure substances, and the recycling of waste is realized.

title_en: Polycarboxylate superplasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polycarboxylate superplasticizer and a preparation method thereof. In order to improve the fluidity of the cement material, the invention adds a composite solubilizer consisting of diethyl maleate/sodium tripolyphosphate in the preparation process of the polycarboxylate water reducer. The research shows that the addition of the composite solubilizer can obviously improve the fluidity of the clean slurry of the cement, and the test effect of the composite solubilizer is more excellent than the effect of singly using diethyl maleate or sodium tripolyphosphate.

title_en: Treatment method of coking wastewater sludge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a treatment method of coking wastewater sludge, which comprises the steps of 1) uniformly mixing coke powder, iron ore powder, coking wastewater sludge, tar slag and a solvent, extruding the mixture into a briquette, carrying out cold consolidation on the briquette, drying the briquette until the water content is not more than 2%, carrying out roasting pretreatment for 0.5-5 hours at 500-800 ℃ under the condition of no oxygen or inert gas protection, paving a coke briquette below the dried briquette, roasting to obtain a carbonization briquette, continuously heating the carbonization briquette to 1350-1550 ℃, introducing H  2  or CO for direct reduction for 0.2-3 hours, further generating direct reduced iron and slag, directly dripping the direct reduced iron in a liquid state, then introducing N  2  or Ar, cooling the slag into amorphous powder, and separating the slag powder from the coke briquette by cyclone centrifugal separation after the complete cooling. According to the invention, the direct reduced iron is prepared from the coking wastewater sludge, so that the recovery and reutilization of valuable elements in the sludge are realized, the emission of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon and benzene pollutants is reduced, the cyclic utilization of tail gas and heat is realized, and the green and low-carbonization production is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of porous graphite/silicon oxide composite lithium ion battery anode material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a porous graphite/silicon oxide composite lithium ion battery cathode material, which comprises the steps of dissolving graphite, nickel chloride hexahydrate and anhydrous sodium hydroxide in a mixed solution of methanol and deionized water, and performing ultrasonic dispersion to prepare a mixed solution; adding hydrazine monohydrate into the mixed solution, heating the solution in air atmosphere, centrifugingObtaining a nickel-adsorbed graphite material; nickel-adsorbed graphite material in H  2  Annealing in atmosphere, and obtaining a porous graphite material after Ni catalytic hydrogenation reaction; ball milling the prepared porous graphite material and silica, and drying after ball milling to obtain the SiO-coated porous graphite material. The porous graphite/silicon oxide composite anode material with excellent structure and good electrochemical stability is prepared by adopting a nickel catalytic hydrogenation method to prepare the porous graphite material and combining a high-energy ball milling method with silicon oxide.

title_en: Ferric sodium sulfate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a sodium ferric sulfate positive electrode material, the chemical formula of which is Na  2+2y  M  2y  (SO  4  )  3  . The preparation process includes weighing and dissolving ferrous sulfate and sodium sulfate separately; mixing the obtained solution, and adding sodium acetate and glucose to mix uniformly; evaporating and crystallizing the obtained mixed solution under the condition of heating in a water bath, and then drying in an oven; crushing the material obtained after evaporating, crystallizing and drying to obtain powder; and (3) sintering the obtained material at a high temperature in a box furnace, and sieving the material obtained by sintering by controlling the temperature and the atmosphere uniformity in the sintering process to obtain the sodium iron sulfate anode material.

title_en: Environment-friendly regenerated casting aluminum alloy melt processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly regenerated casting aluminum alloy melt processing method, which comprises the steps of social recovery of waste aluminum wheel double-chamber furnace smelting, standing furnace composite refining, high-purity argon degassing, tubular filtration deslagging and the like. A356 regenerated aluminum raw material such as waste aluminum wheels or castings and the like recovered in society is placed on a bridge of a secondary chamber of a double-chamber furnace for paint removal and melting, the furnace temperature of the secondary chamber of the double-chamber furnace is controlled at 800-900 ℃, the temperature of a main chamber is controlled at 950-1150 ℃, a standing furnace adopts regenerated cast aluminum alloy refining agent for refining and standing, high-purity argon is adopted for degassing, RA-level 2801 tubular filtration is adopted for deslagging, and then the product is produced by pouring into a die casting machine. By adopting the treatment method, the waste aluminum wheels do not need to be subjected to independent paint removal treatment in advance, the aluminum wheels or other chassis castings are directly regenerated and produced, the production process is simplified, the carbon emission is reduced, the quality of regenerated aluminum liquid is high, and high-end wheels or other chassis castings can be produced.

title_en: High-grade non-oriented silicon steel with excellent surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-grade non-oriented silicon steel with excellent surface and a preparation method thereof. The non-oriented silicon steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: less than or equal to 0.0025 percent of C, 1.80 to 2.40 percent of Si, 0.40 to 0.60 percent of Al, 1.5 to 2.0 percent of Mn, less than or equal to 0.02 percent of P, less than or equal to 0.003 percent of N, more than or equal to 200,0.058 and less than or equal to 11 x [ Si ] -14 x [ Mn ] +21 x [ Al ] +24 x [ P ] < 0.078, and the balance of Fe and inclusions. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Steelmaking and preparing a continuous casting blank with the thickness of 220-240 mm; 2) Carrying out hot rolling, normalizing, acid washing, cold rolling, finished product annealing, cooling, coating and finishing on the continuous casting blank to prepare a non-oriented silicon steel finished product; wherein, in the finished product annealing process, the annealing temperature is 880-900 ℃ and the temperature is kept for 60-90 s.

title_en: Method for improving performance (Q value) of high-frequency resonant cavity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the performance Q value of a high-frequency resonant cavity. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Ultrasonically cleaning the high-frequency resonant cavity by using an acidic cleaning agent diluent, and then washing by pure water under high pressure; 2) Performing electrochemical polishing treatment on the high-frequency resonant cavity treated in the step 1) for at least 2 times, and then washing with pure water under high pressure; 3) And (3) carrying out high-temperature vacuum annealing treatment on the high-frequency resonant cavity treated in the step (2). The invention abandons the conventional mechanical polishing method for improving the Q value of the cavity, precisely controls the polishing rate and thoroughly removes the residual chemical liquid on the surface through a plurality of steps, has no mechanical damage layer, no greasy dirt, no oxidation layer and the like on the surface after cleaning, has obvious mirror surface effect on the treated surface, greatly improves the Q value and has higher practical value.

title_en: Method for preparing nitrogen-rich biochar by using melamine impregnated paper waste and application of nitrogen-rich biochar in adsorbing Cr (VI) in water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycling treatment method of impregnated paper waste containing melamine, which belongs to the technical field of impregnated paper waste recovery, and adopts industrial nitrogen-rich waste impregnated paper waste as a pyrolyzed nitrogen source to reutilize waste, thereby solving the problem of waste pollution; the porous structure of the prepared biochar can be effectively improved by chemical activation and pyrolysis of the mixture of the impregnated paper waste and the biomass, the specific surface area is increased, the carbon material with rich N content is prepared, the electronic structure of the biochar is changed, the surface physical form of the biochar is further improved, and the treatment of Cr (VI) pollution is realized by complexation, cation-pi ion exchange, electrostatic interaction and precipitation.

title_en: Waste heat and cooling crystallization coupling process for soda ash production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for coupling waste heat and cooling crystallization for soda production, and belongs to the technical field of soda production. The invention relates to a process for coupling waste heat and cooling crystallization for sodium carbonate production, which is used for recovering low-grade waste heat or/and high-grade waste heat in the sodium carbonate production process, preparing chilled water or/and liquid ammonia through a waste heat utilization unit, and generating cold energy for sodium carbonate or ammonium chloride production by utilizing the heat exchange of the chilled water or/and the evaporation of the liquid ammonia; the heat source of the low-grade waste heat comprises at least one of ash conversion tail gas, calciner gas and lime kiln tail gas; the heat source of the high-grade heat comprises steam condensate or/and low-pressure steam with the temperature of more than 100 ℃. The invention has scientific design and ingenious conception, fully utilizes waste heat in the soda ash production, is coupled with carbonization or ammonium chloride cooling crystallization heat exchange process, optimizes the production process and reduces the heat consumption of the system production.

title_en: 1000 MPa-grade steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides 1000MPa grade steel and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of steel production. The preparation method of the 1000MPa grade steel comprises the steps of obtaining a casting blank with a set chemical composition, heating the casting blank in stages, rough rolling the heated casting blank, performing first descaling treatment on the casting blank in the rough rolling process to obtain a rough rolling plate, performing second descaling treatment on the rough rolling plate, performing finish rolling on the rough rolling plate after the second descaling treatment, and performing third descaling treatment in the finish rolling process to obtain a finish rolling plate. The invention can lead the steel to have excellent mechanical property, the yield strength is more than or equal to 900MPa, the tensile strength is 1000-1500 MPa, the elongation is more than or equal to 10 percent, the surface characteristics of the steel plate are improved on the basis of high strength, and the technical requirements of surface treatment-free or coating-free direct use can be met. Thereby solving the technical problem that the existing high-strength steel can not meet the requirement of high surface quality.

title_en: Strip steel deviation monitoring and early warning method for cold-rolling continuous annealing furnace
abstract_en: A strip steel deviation monitoring and early warning method for a cold rolling continuous annealing furnace comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining strip steel shape data of an L1, L2 and L3 three-level computer through a multi-source data acquisition module, S2, carrying out feature extraction of shape information according to the obtained strip steel shape data, S3, judging the extracted features according to a set feature extraction rule, and giving an early warning result according to a judging result. According to the strip steel deviation monitoring and early warning method for the cold-rolling continuous annealing furnace, on the basis of the information integration of the cross process, the early warning of strip steel deviation and the integrated monitoring of strip steel cross process data at the same time and the same position are realized, the running stability of the strip steel of the cold-rolling continuous annealing furnace is improved, and the phenomenon of scraping edges of the strip steel in the furnace is reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Semiconductor quartz ring and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of semiconductor devices, and particularly discloses a semiconductor quartz ring and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of performing machine tool rough machining on a quartz blank to obtain a quartz ring primary product, placing the quartz ring primary product in a first alkaline cleaning agent for ultrasonic cleaning, performing ultrasonic rinsing with water, placing the quartz ring primary product in a hydrofluoric acid solution for corrosion and rinsing, placing the quartz ring primary product in a second alkaline cleaning agent, soaking the quartz ring primary product in 1.5-3 h at 80-90 ℃ for high-temperature alkaline cleaning, performing ultrasonic rinsing, repeating the ultrasonic cleaning steps again, and performing ultrasonic rinsing and drying to obtain the semiconductor quartz ring with the surface roughness Ra of more than 20 mu in. The preparation method can ensure the consistency and uniformity of the surface quality of the quartz ring manufactured by the same batch processing without adopting manual sand blasting and finishing steps.

title_en: 2100 MPa-grade low-alloy high-strength high-toughness steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to 2100 MPa-grade low-alloy high-strength high-toughness steel and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ultrahigh-strength alloy steel. Solves the problem that the strength and toughness performance are not matched when the alloy content in the existing alloy steel is low. The low alloy high strength and high toughness steel of the invention comprises the alloy components of ：C：0.37～0.42％、Mn：0.4～1.2％、Si：1.40～1.80％、Cr：3.0～4.0％、Ni：0.4～1.5％、Mo：0.4～1.0％、W：0.4～0.8％、Nb≤0.02％、V≤0.02％, percent by weight, the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, and the microstructure of the steel consists of martensite and film austenite, and the preparation process comprises forging, normalizing, quenching and tempering, wherein oil quenching, slow cooling and tempering are adopted for quenching, and the prepared low alloy steel has high strength and high toughness.

title_en: Nickel-cobalt-iron series high-entropy magnetic nano powder for magnetic hyperthermia and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano material production, and particularly relates to nickel-cobalt-iron series high-entropy magnetic nano powder for magnetic thermal therapy and a preparation method thereof. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method is simple to operate, simple in synthesis method, fine and uniform in powder and excellent in magnetic and thermal properties. The magnetic nano powder can be used as a magnetic thermal therapeutic agent of tumor cells, when an alternating magnetic field with the intensity of 46Oe and the frequency of 266KHz is applied, the specific loss power of the high-entropy magnetic nano powder under the magnetic fluid concentration of 5mg/ml is up to 527W/g, and the magnetic nano powder is a cheap high-performance magnetic thermal therapeutic material and can be applied to the biomedical fields such as tumor magnetic thermal therapy and the like.

title_en: Forming die carrier of undercarriage pillar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forming die frame of a landing gear strut, which belongs to the technical field of forming die frames and comprises an upper die, a lower die, an upper die frame and a lower die frame, wherein the upper die frame is arranged above the lower die frame, the upper die is arranged below the upper die frame, the upper die and the upper die frame are detachably connected, the lower die is arranged above the lower die frame, the lower die and the lower die frame are detachably connected, the forming die frame further comprises a limiting component and a locking component, the limiting component and the locking component are arranged above the upper die and the lower die, two groups of limiting components and locking components are symmetrically arranged on a single side surface of the lower die, the limiting component is used for locking the lower die on the lower die frame, the limiting component is fixedly connected with the outer side surface of the lower die, the limiting component is partially embedded into the lower die frame, the limiting component can be selectively clamped with the lower die frame, the locking component is connected with the limiting component, the two groups of locking components which are symmetrically arranged on the same side surface can be fixedly clamped, the dies on the same side surface can be rapidly installed and disassembled, and the die frame can be replaced, and the time can be reduced.

title_en: Delayed cracking resistant and abrasion resistant steel plate for hardness 550HBW slurry dredging pipe and production method thereof
abstract_en: The delayed cracking resistant and abrasion resistant steel plate for the hardness 550HBW slurry dredging pipe and the production method thereof have the components of ：C 0.28～0.32％,Si 0.1～0.3％,Mn 1.2～1.6％,P≤0.015％,S≤0.005％,Al 0.02～0.04％,Cr 1.8～3.6％,Cu 0.15～0.35％,Ni 0.05～0.15％,B 0.001～0.003％,N≤0.005％; containing one or two of 0.01-0.03% of Nb and 0.01-0.03% of Ti by weight percent, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, wherein the content of Nb+Ti is less than or equal to 0.04 and is 6.65N. The yield strength is more than or equal to 1400MPa, the tensile strength is more than or equal to 1700MPa, the elongation is more than or equal to 8%, the hardness is 550+/-30 HBW, the low-temperature impact power value at-40 ℃ is more than or equal to 40J, the abrasion resistance reaches 3 times that of common carbon steel materials such as Q235B, and meanwhile, the cracking time under the condition of a U-shaped bending 0.1mol/L hydrochloric acid solution soaking test is more than 500h, so that the excellent delayed cracking resistance is reflected.

title_en: Ammonium bicarbonate preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical industry and discloses a preparation device and a preparation method of ammonium bicarbonate, wherein the preparation device comprises a preheater, an inlet material of the preheater is a mixture of urea, dihydric alcohol and a catalyst, a gas phase outlet of the preheater is connected with an inlet of a reaction condenser, a liquid phase outlet of the preheater is connected with an inlet of a reactor, a gas phase outlet of the reactor is connected with an inlet of the reaction condenser, a liquid phase outlet of the reaction condenser is connected with an inlet of a gas-liquid separation tank, a gas phase outlet of the reaction condenser is connected with an inlet of a first-stage absorption tower, and a liquid phase outlet of the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with a liquid phase reflux port of the reactor. The invention provides a new preparation method of ammonium bicarbonate, ammonia generated by the reaction of urea and dihydric alcohol (such as ethylene glycol and propylene glycol) reacts with carbon dioxide to generate ammonium bicarbonate, and carbonate (such as ethylene carbonate and propylene carbonate) can be produced at the same time and used for electrolyte of lithium battery.

title_en: Lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material, preparation method, battery positive electrode and battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material, a preparation method, a battery positive electrode and a battery, comprising the steps of mixing citric acid, a lithium source, a nickel source, a cobalt source, a manganese source and a doping source to form a first mixed solution, wherein the doping source is composed of a sodium source and/or a potassium source; drying the reacted first mixed solution to obtain a first precursor, sintering the first precursor to obtain first powder, mixing the first powder with citric acid, and then sintering to obtain the lithium-rich manganese-based anode material.

title_en: Nanometer metal 3D printing method based on ultrafast laser multiphoton decomposition and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoscale metal 3D printing method based on ultrafast laser multiphoton decomposition and application thereof, the method comprises the steps of S1 providing a substrate with a liquid storage tank, wherein a metal carbonyl compound solution is arranged in the liquid storage tank, the metal carbonyl compound solution at least comprises one metal element, S2 carrying out ultrafast laser 3D printing on the metal carbonyl compound solution in the liquid storage tank in a protective atmosphere, and S3 removing impurities to obtain nanoscale metal with a 3D structure. The invention induces the decomposition of metal carbonyl compounds under the action of ultrafast laser, and the products are metal and trace carbon monoxide, and do not contain other solid components, so that the product metal has high purity, higher mechanical strength and bending resistance, the component proportion in the alloy product can be regulated and controlled by changing the concentration proportion of different metal carbonyl compounds, and meanwhile, the line width of the printed metal material can be easily regulated based on the flexibility of laser 3D printing, thereby improving the performance of the metal material.

title_en: Online monitoring device and method for laser powder bed fusion forming by applying OCT
abstract_en: The invention provides an online monitoring device and method for fusion forming of a laser powder bed by applying OCT. According to the method, an OCT imaging scanning technology is added in the powder bed melting and forming process, a layer is formed, and a layer is scanned, so that the surface morphology of the forming process can be accurately represented, the functions of accurately identifying the defect morphology, classifying and distributing are realized, the influence of process parameters on the forming quality can be accurately researched, the method is convenient to operate, the production and detection efficiency is high, and the production efficiency of laser powder bed melting can be further improved.

title_en: High performance fiber glass compositions with improved elastic modulus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to high performance fiber glass compositions having improved elastic modulus. Such applications include woven fabrics and aerospace structures used in forming wind turbine blades.

title_en: Regenerated fan blade fiber reinforced concrete decorative product and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated fan blade fiber reinforced concrete decorative product and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of concrete composite materials; the preparation method comprises the following steps: designing, preparing materials and a mold, preparing mortar, pouring, demolding, curing and finishing; the manufacturing materials of the decorative layer and the structural layer comprise cement, mineral admixture, sand and regenerated fan blade fibers, the regenerated fan blade fibers in the decorative layer are combined with the crack self-repairing agent, so that the cracking resistance and durability of the decorative product can be improved, and the recycled use of the fan blade can be promoted; the elastic properties of the dispersible latex in the structural layer can increase the toughness and ductility of the decorative article, making it more mechanically and durable. The decorative product doped with the regenerated fan blade fiber has excellent durability and environmental protection performance, and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Precipitation separation and ceramic solidification method for radioactive waste liquid strontium and uranium with tetravalent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precipitation separation and ceramic solidification method of radioactive waste liquid strontium and uranium, and relates to the field of treatment and disposal of radioactive waste liquid. The U in the high-level radioactive waste liquid exists in the form of hexavalent uranyl (UO  2   2+ ), and the ionic radius of U  4+ ,Sr 2+  and U  4+  prepared by hydrogenation catalytic reduction is greatly different from that of Ln  3+ , so that CePO  4 ·0.667H 2  O water phosphocerite with stronger nuclide containing capacity is selected as a separating precipitant for synchronously precipitating and enriching Sr  2+  and U  4+ . Select UO 2 (NO 3 ) 2 ·6H 2 O.Sr(C 2 H 3 O 2 ) 2 、NH 4 H 2 PO 4 、Ce(NO 3 ) 3 ·6H 2 O and other cheap raw materials. By controlling the ion ratio of Sr  2+ :U 4+ , the reaction time, the temperature and the pH value, the water phosphocerite solid solution precipitate with good grain development and large solid solution quantity of Sr  2+ /U 4+  is prepared. By utilizing the discharge plasma solid-phase sintering technology, the crystal grain agglomeration bonding in the high-temperature dehydration and crystal form transformation process of the phosphocerite is avoided. In addition, the pressure sintering can promote the further growth of nano crystal grains, promote the homogenization of U  4+  and Sr  2+  in the monolithic ceramic solidified body, and realize the one-step preparation of the monolithic ceramic solidified body by the water-phosphorus-lanthanides solid solution.

title_en: Normalizing rolling production method of Q420NE wind power steel plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a normalizing rolling production method of a Q420NE steel plate for wind power, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: 0.16 to 0.18 percent of Si:0.22 to 0.32 percent of Mn:1.52 to 1.70 percent, P: less than or equal to 0.010 percent, S: less than or equal to 0.003 percent, nb is 0.035 to 0.045 percent, V:0.035 to 0.045 percent, 0.010 to 0.020 percent of Ti, als:0.017 to 0.027 percent, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities; the steel plate for the Q420NE wind power is obtained through desulfurization pretreatment, converter smelting, LF refining, RH vacuum treatment, continuous casting, heating and specific normalizing rolling processes. The steel plate has good mechanical properties, and after 10 minutes of normalizing at 860 ℃, the performance still meets the standard requirements, and can be used for manufacturing wind power tower tubes with confidence.

title_en: Positive electrode material, preparation method thereof, secondary battery and electric equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of batteries, and discloses a positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a secondary battery and electric equipment. The positive electrode material comprises body particles and a first coating layer arranged on the surfaces of the body particles, wherein protrusions are formed on the first coating layer; the bulk particles comprise lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and the cobalt content b in the protrusions  1  Higher than the cobalt content b in the first coating layer  2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The positive electrode material satisfies the following conditions: u is more than or equal to 0.15 and less than or equal to 30, wherein,U＝(π×Dv50  2  ×C×BET×d  1  )/12. title_en: Method for recovering lithium chloride from lithium-containing waste acid water of chiral lactone
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for recycling lithium chloride from lithium-containing waste acid water of chiral lactone, and belongs to the technical field of waste water recycling. The process method of the invention comprises the following steps: taking lithium-containing waste acid water, slowly adding lithium carbonate into the waste acid water for neutralization while fully stirring, stopping adding the lithium carbonate when the pH value of a system is accurately controlled to be 3-4, and standing to obtain lithium chloride mother liquor; adding a decoloring agent for stirring decoloring, carrying out suction filtration and reduced pressure distillation, and finally, carrying out spray drying on a reduced pressure distillation product to obtain a high-purity lithium chloride product. The invention obviously improves the recovery rate of lithium ions in the lithium-containing waste acid water of chiral lactone, and the obtained lithium chloride can also be used for synthesizing lithium hydroxycarboxylic acid salt so as to be directly reused for synthesizing chiral lactone, thereby comprehensively reducing the production cost and reducing the waste water discharge.

title_en: Method for producing oriented electrical steel sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides an oriented electromagnetic steel sheet which maintains excellent magnetic characteristics and has good processing precision in rolling processing, and a manufacturing method thereof. title_en: Titanium tetrachloride refining system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of titanium tetrachloride refining, in particular to a titanium tetrachloride refining system. The titanium tetrachloride refining system comprises a mixing tank, a superheater, a flash tank and a packing tower which are sequentially connected through a circulating pipeline; the lower end of the flash tank is also communicated with the mixing tank through a circulating pipeline, and a fatty acid adding point is arranged on the circulating pipeline from the flash tank to the mixing tank; the filling tower is connected with a condenser, the condenser is connected with a refined titanium tetrachloride storage tank through a U-shaped pipe, the U-shaped pipe is also connected with the upper part of the filling tower, the condenser is also connected with a cooler, and the cooler is connected with the refined titanium tetrachloride storage tank; and a throttle plate is further arranged on the circulating pipeline between the superheater and the flash tank, and the diameter of the central circular hole of the throttle plate is 1/2-2/3 of the inner diameter of the circulating pipeline. Compared with the prior art that the heated titanium tetrachloride gas is directly introduced into the flash tank, the technical scheme of the present disclosure has the advantages of higher safety, stronger stability and longer service life of the device.

title_en: Charging device, charging method and press
abstract_en: The application relates to a feeding device, a feeding method and a press. The feeding device includes: the material box assembly comprises a plurality of material box assemblies which are sequentially arranged, and each material box is provided with a material cavity with two open ends; the material baffle plate is used for sealing the bottom end opening of the feeding box and is provided with sieve holes; the vibrator is arranged on the feeding box; an air inlet assembly movable relative to the feed cassette so as to close a top opening of the feed cassette for delivering air into the feed chamber; the driving assembly is used for driving the material box assembly to move; the distributor is arranged in the feeding cavity and is positioned at the joint of the second conical part and the discharging part. The feeding device can evenly distribute raw material powder in the die cavity, and improves the performance of a magnet.

title_en: Zn (zinc) 0.5 Cd 0.5 S/WO 3 Heterojunction multifunctional photocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Zn (zinc)  0.5  Cd  0.5  S/WO  3  A heterojunction multifunctional photocatalyst and a preparation method thereof belong to the fields of solar energy conversion and photocatalytic degradation. The invention aims to solve the problem of multifunctional photocatalysisThe technical problem of how to effectively improve the solar energy conversion efficiency in high-quality preparation of the chemical agent composite material. The method comprises the following steps: 1. respectively dissolving cadmium acetate dihydrate, zinc acetate dihydrate and thioacetamide in triethylene glycol, stirring, transferring into a reaction kettle, heating for reaction, cooling to room temperature, taking out, centrifuging, washing, and drying to obtain Zn  0.5  Cd  0.5  S nano particles; 2. zn prepared in the step one  0.5  Cd  0.5  S nano particles are dispersed in deionized water, sodium tungstate dihydrate is added into the solution, hydrochloric acid is used for adjusting the aqueous solution to be acidic, oxalic acid is added into the solution according to 1/5 of the mass of the sodium tungstate dihydrate, and the solution is stirred and dissolved and then transferred into a reaction kettle for heating reaction. Cooling to room temperature, centrifuging, washing, and drying to obtain stable Zn  0.5  Cd  0.5  S/WO  3  An artificial photosynthetic photocatalytic composite material.

title_en: Comprehensive treatment method for titanium dioxide waste acid and electroplated nickel recovery liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for comprehensively treating titanium pigment waste acid and electroplated nickel recovery liquid, which comprises the following steps: s1, treating titanium dioxide waste acid, and separating sulfuric acid; s2, treating the electroplated nickel recovery liquid, and separating nickel salt; s3, reacting the sulfuric acid obtained in the step S1 with the nickel salt obtained in the step S2 to obtain nickel sulfate. According to the method, titanium dioxide waste acid and nickel-containing recovery liquid are comprehensively treated for the first time, sulfuric acid obtained by treating the titanium dioxide waste acid is used as a raw material for treating the nickel-containing recovery liquid, so that resources are saved, waste utilization can be realized, the treatment pressure of waste acid of a titanium dioxide factory is reduced, and better economic and environmental benefits are obtained.

title_en: Solidification treatment method of thermal state steel slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solidification treatment method of thermal steel slag, which comprises the following steps: step one: directly pouring steel slag at about 1500 ℃ in the hot state of the converter which is just discharged into a quality-regulating furnace; step two: feeding power and heating, and adjusting the temperature and fluidity of the liquid steel slag in the quenching and tempering furnace; step three: adding a carbonaceous silicon-aluminum modifier, removing free calcium and magnesium in slag, reducing iron oxide in slag, and greatly reducing phosphorus in slag; step four: moving the thermal steel slag in the third step to a thermal steel slag solidification crystallizer; step five: the hydraulic rotating system of the barrel cover of the thermal steel slag solidifying crystallizer is started, and a cooling unit is quickly inserted into the thermal steel slag solidifying crystallizer. The invention can extract 150-220Kg of metal iron from each ton of steel slag, effectively recover the solidifying and heat stewing waste heat of the hot steel slag, improve the economic benefit of comprehensive utilization of the hot steel slag, and realize the solidifying and heat stewing processes of the hot steel slag, thereby being environment-friendly, civilized, safe and stable. And the operation time is greatly shortened.

title_en: Oxidized pellet production system of chain grate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oxidized pellet production, in particular to a grate oxidized pellet production system, which comprises a pellet production device main body, wherein a mixing bin for mixing raw materials is arranged on one side of the pellet production device main body, a vibrating screen mechanism for vibrating and screening and removing impurities of the raw materials is arranged in the mixing bin, and a vibrating screen motor is fixedly assembled in an equipment box. This chain grate oxidation pellet production system contains the feed chute of thick sieve through the inside that sets up in the top of blending bunker to inside with the blending bunker is sent into to different raw and other materials, and the inside that sets up at the blending bunker lower surface rotates the conveying pipeline that has the conveying impeller be convenient for carry out intensive mixing with the raw and other materials in the blending bunker and then transmit to pellet apparatus main part department and carry out production and handle, and the vibration sieve that rotates on the blending bunker inner wall and connect is by push pedal control bullet, thereby realizes the vibration sieve edulcoration to raw and other materials handle.

title_en: Plastic industrial product regenerated from inorganic solid waste, raw material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plastic industrial product raw material regenerated from inorganic solid waste, a preparation method thereof, a method for preparing a product by using the plastic industrial product raw material and application thereof, wherein the plastic industrial product raw material comprises active inorganic powder, inactive inorganic powder, plant starch, plant fiber, acrylic emulsion or building rubber powder and water. After being pressed into products, the plastic industrial product raw materials of the invention have the advantages of environmental protection, biodegradability and reusability compared with the existing plastic products, and meanwhile, the plastic industrial product raw materials are better than the existing plastic products in mechanical properties, and can be used for replacing plastics to prepare shells of various electromechanical devices and daily necessities.

title_en: High-temperature alpha alumina roasting system and roasting process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of alumina roasting, in particular to a high-temperature alpha alumina roasting system stage roasting process, which comprises a feeding device, a dryer, a preheating system, a cooling system, a high-temperature reactor and a dust collector, wherein the preheating system comprises a first cyclone preheater, a plurality of middle cyclone preheaters, a second cyclone preheater and a third cyclone preheater which are arranged from top to bottom in sequence, and the cooling system comprises a cyclone cooler and an indirect heat exchange cooler; the feeding device is connected with a feeding port of the dryer, and materials in each feeding pipeline are contacted with gas introduced by a lower stage, so that the materials are in a suspension state; the discharge port of the high-temperature reactor is connected with a cooling system. Through making the material be in suspension state, can accomplish the heat transfer before getting into next level cyclone preheater, realize suspension calcination, the alumina product steady quality of production has the heat transfer effectual, and heat exchange efficiency is high, and area is little advantage, reduces the fault rate, promotes operating efficiency, reduces the loss of dispelling the heat.

title_en: Manufacturing process of fireproof EPS decorative board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a fireproof EPS decorative board, which belongs to the technical field of building material manufacturing, and comprises the following specific manufacturing process steps: step one: preparing materials, namely weighing 100-130 parts of high-strength flame-retardant polystyrene, 60-80 parts of water, 50-70 parts of unsaturated dibasic acid, 40-60 parts of fibrous magnesium-rich clay mineral, 30-60 parts of ceramic cement, 30-60 parts of toughness reinforcing part, 25-40 parts of dihydric alcohol, 20-40 parts of inorganic anti-aging polymer emulsion and 20-35 parts of color paste according to a proportion. According to the invention, the fireproof performance of the decorative plate is effectively enhanced by arranging the high-strength flame-retardant polystyrene, the ceramic cement and the inorganic anti-aging polymer emulsion, the integral toughness and strength of the decorative plate are greatly enhanced by the toughness reinforcing piece, the alkali-resistant glass fiber mesh cloth, the rock wool fiber yarns and the cement plate, and the alkali-resistant glass fiber mesh cloth is subjected to batch and regular cutting by the cutting device, so that the alkali-resistant glass fiber mesh cloth can be better attached.

title_en: Mortar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The mortar provided by the invention comprises the following components in parts by mass: 15-25 parts of cement, 55-65 parts of sand stone, 8-12 parts of water and 8-12 parts of modified nonmetal powder of the waste circuit board. By adopting the modified nonmetal powder of the waste circuit board as the reinforcing material of the mortar, waste circuit board materials can be recycled, energy is saved, environment is protected, resin components contained in the modified nonmetal powder of the waste circuit board can be uniformly distributed in a mortar system, and the mechanical property of the mortar can be effectively improved, so that the compression resistance and the crack resistance of a finished product after the mortar is solidified are improved, the durability is greatly improved, and the safety performance of the mortar in application is improved.

title_en: Insulated screwdriver and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an insulating screwdriver and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of electrical tools. The insulating screwdriver comprises a screwdriver rod and an insulating handle, wherein the screwdriver rod comprises a screwdriver rod body, and a Zr-Al-N composite seepage layer, an AlN-ZrO  2  middle plating layer and a surface insulating layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the screwdriver rod body. The preparation method of the insulating screwdriver comprises the steps of quenching and tempering the screwdriver rod body, and then sequentially carrying out Zr-Al-N co-permeation treatment, alN-ZrO  2  vacuum coating treatment and vapor plating treatment to obtain the insulating screwdriver. The insulated screwdriver prepared by the application can keep insulation under the voltage of 300V-1500V, and the plating layer on the surface of the screwdriver rod body has higher binding force, high hardness and good wear resistance, and is difficult to fall off.

title_en: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material modified by magnetic transition metal oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-carbon negative electrode material modified by magnetic transition metal oxide and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium ion battery micro-nano materials. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low price, simple preparation process flow, easy operation, low energy consumption in the preparation process and environmental friendliness. The prepared silicon-carbon negative electrode material has a uniform and compact modification layer containing magnetic transition metal oxide, and can effectively improve the conductivity, high specific capacity and cycle stability of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material. The initial coulomb efficiency reaches more than 80%, the specific capacity can be stabilized to 1127mAh/g after 100 times of circulation, and the average level of the material is far higher than that of the existing material. In addition, the prepared silicon-carbon anode material has excellent mechanical flexibility, can be directly used for assembling lithium ion batteries, and has strong application potential on flexible wearable electronic devices in the future.

title_en: Negative electrode material containing metal antimony carbon fiber coated silicon lithium ion battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon lithium ion battery anode material coated with metal antimony carbon fiber and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery electrode materials. According to the invention, through adjusting preparation process parameters, trivalent antimony ions are converted into zero-valent antimony metal and limited in a carbon fiber shell, the initial coulomb efficiency of the prepared product serving as a lithium ion battery anode material reaches 80%, and the specific capacity is stabilized at 790mAh/g after 100 charge and discharge cycles and is higher than the average level of the current silicon-carbon anode material. In addition, the preparation method provided by the invention adopts cheap and abundant raw materials, is easy to operate in preparation flow, has no pollution to the environment, and is suitable for batch preparation.

abstract_en: In the steelmaking process, refining reactions such as deoxidation, denitrification and desulfurization when hydrogen plasma is applied to molten steel in a ladle are rapidly performed, and high-purity molten steel with few impurities is efficiently smelted. In a process for stirring molten steel by blowing a stirring gas into molten steel (9) contained in a ladle, a plasma treatment is performed on the surface of molten steel in a fluidized state by stirring treatment, wherein hydrogen gas or an inert gas containing hydrogen gas is irradiated as a plasma gas from plasma generating devices (11, 12) disposed above the molten steel in the ladle under conditions satisfying the following formula (1), and the content of 1 or 2 or more elements selected from oxygen, nitrogen and sulfur contained in the molten steel is reduced. title_en: Carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon-coated Na  4  Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  P  2  O  7  Material and preparation method thereof, and carbon-coated Na  4  Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  P  2  O  7  The preparation method of the material comprises a dissolving step, and Fe (NO  3  )  3  ·9H  2  0 is dissolved in deionized water, and citric acid is added to be fully stirredAfter that, naH is added  2  PO  4  Wherein Fe (NO)  3  )  3  ·9H  2  0、NaH  2  PO  4  The ratio of the amount of the substances to the citric acid is (2.85-3.15): (3.9-4.3): (1.5-3.5); a drying step, namely drying the mixed solution obtained in the dissolving step to obtain a dried powder precursor; a heat treatment step, wherein the powder precursor is subjected to low-temperature solid phase reaction at 250-350 ℃ in inert atmosphere, and then subjected to high-temperature solid phase reaction at 450-700 ℃ to obtain the carbon-coated Na  4  Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  P  2  O  7  A material. The preparation method can avoid synthesizing material Na  4  Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  P  2  O  7  Contains Na  2  FeP  2  O  7  And NaFePO  4  And the impurity phases are equal, the phase purity is high, and the battery anode material has good electrochemical performance.

title_en: Method for denitriding molten steel, method for simultaneously denitriding and desulfurizing molten steel, and method for producing steel
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for performing a denitrification process capable of stably reaching an extremely low nitrogen concentration range at a high speed, and further performing the denitrification process and the desulfurization process in the same process, and efficiently performing denitrification or denitrification and desulfurization of molten steel. title_en: Nickel-manganese-copper-iron carbonate precursor, preparation method and application thereof in preparation of sodium-ion battery anode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-manganese-copper-iron carbonate precursor, a preparation method and application thereof in preparing a sodium ion battery anode material, which can realize complexation of four metal ions of Ni  2+ 、Mn 2+ 、Fe 2+ 、Cu 2+  and slow release of the metal ions under the action of a precipitator, realize coprecipitation of the four metal ions, ensure that the prepared precursor is free from segregation in shape, reduce impurities such as sodium, sulfur and the like in a precipitated product through post-treatment of the product, and improve the content of copper in the precursor.

title_en: Method for preparing porous geopolymer by using superfine high-alumina iron tailings
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of porous geopolymer preparation, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a porous geopolymer by using superfine high-alumina iron tailings, which comprises the following steps: 1) Drying the red mud, and grinding the dried red mud into red mud micropowder which is sieved by a 100-mesh sieve; 2) Uniformly mixing the superfine high-alumina iron tailings and the red mud micro powder to obtain a mixture A, wherein the mole ratio of silicon to aluminum in the mixture A is 1.5-2.5; 3) Adding sodium percarbonate into the mixture A, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixture B; 4) Adding water into the mixture B, and stirring to obtain mixed slurry; 5) And pouring the mixed slurry into a mould, and curing to obtain the geopolymer porous material. The invention takes superfine high-alumina iron tailings with the mesh number less than 300 which are difficult to be utilized in the building material industry and industrial solid waste red mud discharged during alumina extraction in the aluminum production industry as main raw materials, and sodium percarbonate is utilized as an additive integrating foaming and alkali excitation, so that a geopolymer porous material capable of being utilized in the building material industry can be prepared.

title_en: Technological method for improving performance of Mg-Zn magnesium alloy
abstract_en: Provides a process method for improving the performance of Mg-Zn magnesium alloy, belonging to the technical field of nonferrous metal material production. Suitable magnesium alloys have the following composition: 3-6wt% Zn, 0.008-1wt% Zr, sr, ca, cu, and the balance Mg and unavoidable impurities; the method comprises the following steps: preparing an ingot of a magnesium alloy material; heating the magnesium alloy ingot to 360-370 ℃ at the speed of 480-570 ℃/h under the condition of inert shielding gas or vacuum, and preserving heat for 6-7 hours; and immediately carrying out low-temperature quenching after discharging from the furnace. According to the scheme, the molten magnesium alloy is subjected to low-temperature solution treatment, so that MgZn second phases of the alloy are in solid solution into a matrix, solid solution strengthening is achieved, and meanwhile grains are refined and alloy elements are homogenized. And then rapidly cooling, keeping the state, and obviously improving the mechanical, forming and corrosion resistance of the magnesium alloy. The method has the advantages of simple flow, clear key technological parameters, high repeatability, obvious improvement of efficiency and cost saving.

title_en: Alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production separation device and hydrogen production system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolytic hydrogen production, and provides a hydrogen production separation device and a hydrogen production system by alkaline water electrolysis, wherein the hydrogen production separation device by alkaline water electrolysis comprises an oxyhydrogen separation module, and is used for separating generated hydrogen and oxygen in the water electrolysis process; lyeThe circulating module is detachably arranged at the bottom of the hydrogen-oxygen separation module; the cooling heating module is communicated with the oxyhydrogen separation module and is detachably connected to the bottom of the oxyhydrogen separation module; the cooling and heating module is used for cooling and recycling heat of alkali liquor generated by the oxyhydrogen separation module. The hydrogen-oxygen separation system comprises a plurality of modules, the data parameters of the hydrogen-oxygen separation module and the alkali liquor circulation module can be changed according to the hydrogen production quantity of the whole hydrogen production system, the adaptability is strong, the integration level is high, the hydrogen production system can be modularly constructed according to the requirements of different hydrogen production systems, the hydrogen production system can adapt to different large-scale hydrogen production separation systems, and the requirement of 1000Nm is met  3  The above requirements can also fully utilize the heat in the alkali liquor.
