title_en: Preparation method of boron-doped lithium vanadate/carbon composite lithium ion battery anode material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a boron-doped lithium vanadate/carbon composite lithium ion battery anode material. The method comprises the following steps: taking outAdding polyvinyl alcohol into water, stirring uniformly to obtain colorless transparent solution A, adding vanadium pentoxide and lithium hydroxide into water, stirring uniformly to obtain colorless transparent solution B, adding boric acid into water, and stirring uniformly to obtain solution C. To obtain a uniform mixture of Li  3  VO  4  Mixing solution A and solution B, stirring, dripping solution C into the mixed solution to obtain gel, lyophilizing, and sintering at 500-600deg.C under nitrogen to obtain spherical Li  3  VO  4  the/BC composite material can be used as a negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery. The invention is characterized in Li  3  VO  4  In the synthesis of the anode material, the chemical crosslinking action of BA and PVA is utilized for the first time to form gel, and simple freeze drying is utilized for synthesizing spherical Li  3  VO  4  BC composite material, solving the problems of Li  3  VO  4  The cathode material has the advantages of poor conductivity and difficult shape regulation, and can show excellent electrochemical performance when used as a cathode material of a lithium ion battery.

title_en: Preparation method and application of gap-type H-atom doped photocatalyst taking tungsten oxide as carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a photocatalyst with tungsten oxide as a carrier gap doped with H atoms, which is prepared by dissolving WCl  6  in absolute ethyl alcohol to prepare WO  3  through hydrothermal reduction, and synthesizing the photocatalyst with H atoms doped into a WO  3  lattice gap through a lactic acid solution photo-assisted in-situ reduction method. The H  x WO 3  obtained in the invention has high ammonia yield in the photocatalytic nitrogen reduction process, and has wide prospect in the aspects of solar energy utilization and realization of conversion from dual energy to high added value chemicals.

title_en: Production process and system of food-grade potassium hydroxide
abstract_en: The application relates to a production process and a system of food-grade potassium hydroxide, wherein soft white sugar solution is added in the process of producing 48% potassium hydroxide products by a three-effect countercurrent falling film evaporation system, so that the soft white sugar and chlorate can rapidly complete reaction at 155-165 ℃ to reduce the chlorate content in the 48% potassium hydroxide solution.

title_en: Method for synthesizing battery grade lithium carbonate and ferric phosphate by efficiently removing impurities from waste lithium iron phosphate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for efficiently removing impurities from waste lithium iron phosphate to synthesize battery-grade lithium carbonate and ferric phosphate, and belongs to the field of waste battery recovery. The method comprises the following steps of firstly burning waste lithium iron phosphate in an oxidizing atmosphere, then soaking the obtained powder in a solvent, uniformly mixing, filtering to obtain a lithium filtrate containing copper and aluminum impurities and extracted lithium slag, removing impurities from the lithium filtrate containing copper and aluminum impurities, concentrating, carbonizing to obtain lithium carbonate, and carrying out acid leaching, adjustment of the phosphorus-iron ratio, aging and high-temperature calcination on the iron phosphate slag to obtain the iron phosphate. The method can efficiently and selectively extract high-value lithium from the waste lithium iron phosphate, can avoid the difficulty in purifying the ferric phosphate caused by mixing impurity metals and iron phosphorus, and has the advantages of simple flow, high impurity removal rate, high recovery rate of valuable metals, complete and thorough impurity removal and strong practicability.

title_en: Optical glass, glass preform, optical element, and optical instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides optical glass, which comprises the following components in percentage by weight: siO (SiO)  2  ：1～18％；B  2  O  3  ：4～18％；La  2  O  3  ：35～60％；Y  2  O  3  ：6～30％；ZrO  2  ：2～15％；Nb  2  O  5  : 2-18%. By reasonable component design, the invention can obtain the optical glass with the expected refractive index and Abbe number with lower raw material cost.

title_en: Electric furnace cover and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of metallurgical refractory materials, and discloses an electric furnace cover and a preparation method thereof, wherein the electric furnace cover comprises the following raw material components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of mullite with the grain size of 8-5mmM, 15-25 parts of mullite with the grain size of 5-3mmM, 10-28 parts of platy corundum with the grain size of 3-1mm, 15-22 parts of platy corundum with the grain size of 1-0mm, 1-8 parts of silicon carbide with the grain size of 1-0mm, 8-18 parts of fused white corundum with the grain size of 120 meshes, 1-3 parts of fused zirconium mullite with the grain size of 65 meshes, 1-5 parts of fused white corundum with the grain size of 180 meshes, 2-10 parts of CL370 corundum micropowder, 5-10 parts of alpha-alumina, 1-5 parts of silicon carbide with the grain size of 240 meshes, 0-5 parts of silica fume, 0-1 part of additive, 1-3 parts of steel fiber and 0-1 part of explosion-proof fiber. According to the invention, the cement-free binder is adopted, the M70 mullite, the fused zirconia mullite, the SiC and the like with excellent thermal shock resistance are comprehensively adopted, the physical and chemical properties of the electric furnace cover are greatly improved, the service life is longer, meanwhile, the chromium-free technology is adopted, the production process is free of emission of toxic and harmful substances such as chromium oxide and the like, the environment is friendly, and the environment protection requirement is met.

title_en: Pouring device for aluminum ingot casting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum ingot casting tools, in particular to a pouring device used in aluminum ingot casting, which comprises a supporting substrate, a die discharging assembly, a conveying assembly and a pouring assembly, wherein the die discharging assembly is used for realizing the automatic feeding function of a die, so that the use convenience of the device is improved, the die discharging assembly can drive the die to move up and down by driving a first hydraulic cylinder, the die can be gently placed on the conveying assembly by driving the die to move up and down, the die is prevented from colliding with the conveying assembly, the die and the conveying assembly are prevented from being damaged, the service life of the device is prolonged, and the lifting block can be more stably moved up and down by using the sliding fit of a first sliding ring and a first sliding rod, so that the die discharging assembly can be more stably adjusted up and down.

title_en: Bamboo activated carbon and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bamboo activated carbon preparation, in particular to bamboo activated carbon and a production process thereof, aiming at the problems that the existing wire drawing phenomenon appears in the crushing process, the crushing effect is affected, and additional instruments are needed for sieving, a large amount of time is consumed in the transportation process, and the use is inconvenient, the invention provides a scheme which comprises the following steps of; s1, firstly, conveying bamboos into production equipment for cutting, drying the cut bamboos by the equipment, and crushing and sieving the dried bamboos by the equipment; s2, drying by a drying device; according to the bamboo crushing machine, the crushing effect of the bamboo can be improved through the cooperation of the crusher, the drying box and the cutting box, the bamboo can be prevented from being influenced for crushing longer, and meanwhile, the drying box and the cutting box realize power output through the first motor, so that the use of a power source can be reduced, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and the bamboo crushing machine is convenient to use.

title_en: High-strength silicon carbide ceramic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of silicon carbide ceramics, and particularly relates to high-strength silicon carbide ceramics and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the high-strength silicon carbide ceramic comprises the following steps of preparing a main raw material from 80-95wt% of submicron alpha-silicon carbide micro powder, 1-7wt% of aluminum oxide, 1-8wt% of yttrium oxide, 1-3wt% of polyethylene glycol and 1-2wt% of polyvinyl alcohol, adding deionized water into the main raw material for ball milling and dispersing to obtain a water-based slurry, spraying and granulating the water-based slurry to obtain ceramic granulating powder, and hot-pressing and sintering the ceramic granulating powder to obtain the high-strength silicon carbide ceramic.

title_en: Method for recovering valuable metals
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for recycling valuable metals, which comprises a mixing procedure for mixing a valuable metal-containing substance to be recycled, acid and a reducing agent to obtain mixed slurry, a roasting procedure for roasting the mixed slurry to obtain a roasting product, a leaching procedure for mixing the roasting product and the leaching agent and carrying out leaching treatment, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a lithium-containing leaching solution, wherein the reducing agent comprises a first regenerated reducing agent obtained by activating a deactivated reducing agent by a first acid-containing tail gas generated in the mixing procedure of the valuable metal-containing substance to be recycled and the acid, and/or a second regenerated reducing agent obtained by activating the deactivated reducing agent by a second acid-containing tail gas generated in the roasting procedure. The application skillfully utilizes the acid-containing tail gas generated in the mixing procedure and the roasting procedure to activate the deactivated reducing agent to obtain the regenerated reducing agent, and then the regenerated reducing agent is put into the front end to be mixed with the valuable metal-containing to-be-recovered material and the acid together, thereby accelerating the extraction of lithium in the roasting process and increasing the lithium yield.

title_en: Device and method for additive connection
abstract_en: The device comprises a laser, a workbench, a special fixture for material addition connection, a laser deposition head, a deposition bin and a powder feeder, wherein the laser is electrically connected with the laser deposition head, the special fixture for material addition connection and the workbench are arranged in the deposition bin, the special fixture for material addition connection is arranged on the workbench, a powder feeder powder conveying pipe is communicated with a powder inlet of the laser deposition head, and a plurality of air inlets are formed in the deposition bin. According to the invention, the pressure of the connecting device to the connecting piece is regulated for many times in the process of material adding and connecting of the segmented components, so that mechanical constraint force is provided for the connected components of the material adding and connecting to improve the cracking problem of the high-temperature titanium alloy caused by accumulation of residual stress of solid phase change, the mechanical property of the connected components of the material adding and connecting are improved, the dimensional accuracy of the connected components of the material adding and connecting are improved, a certain amount of hydrogen is added in protective atmosphere, the plasticity of the connected components of the material adding and connecting is improved by utilizing hydrogen softening, and the cracking problem in the process of material adding and connecting is solved.

title_en: Carbon nanotube purification method and application and conductive paste
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon nano tube purification method and application and conductive slurry. The purification method of the carbon nano tube comprises the steps of (1) blending carbon nano tube raw powder, a non-thickening ionic dispersing agent and a first solvent for carrying out first dispersion treatment so as to obtain carbon nano tube slurry, (2) carrying out gas phase purification on the carbon nano tube slurry after freeze drying so as to obtain carbon nano tube powder, and (3) carrying out acid washing and water washing on the carbon nano tube powder so as to obtain the carbon nano tube. The method can obviously improve the purification effect of the carbon nano tube, reduce the amorphous carbon content and the metal impurity content in the carbon nano tube, and is simple and easy to realize.

title_en: Multipurpose high-strength steel production line
abstract_en: A multipurpose high-strength steel production line sequentially comprises the following stations: uncoiling, welding, inlet looping, cleaning, central continuous post-treatment, intermediate looping, flattening, outlet looping, finishing and coiling; the central continuous post-treatment station comprises a preheating section, a heating section, a soaking section, a slow cooling section, a rapid cooling section, a reheating section, two parallel treatment lines and a final water cooling section; the preheating section comprises jet radiant tube preheating and jet direct fire preheating; the heating section comprises longitudinal magnetic induction heating, direct fire heating, front transverse magnetic induction heating, jet-radiation composite heating, radiant tube heating and rear transverse magnetic induction heating; the soaking section comprises jet-radiation composite soaking and radiant tube soaking; the rapid cooling section comprises high-hydrogen cooling, aerosol cooling and water quenching which are arranged in parallel; one of the two parallel treatment lines sequentially comprises a furnace nose, a zinc pot, an air knife, alloying heating and soaking, and cooling after plating; the other treatment line sequentially comprises a moving channel, overaging and final air-jet cooling.

title_en: Sulfur-doped carbon carrier with optimized pore structure, preparation method, catalyst and fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalysis, and particularly relates to a sulfur-doped carbon carrier with an optimized pore structure, a preparation method, a catalyst and application. By introducing the sulfur-containing material, the sulfur-containing site modifies the hydrophilic property of the carbon carrier, thereby effectively improving the service life and gas transportation characteristics of the carbon carrier. The sulfur-containing site can provide a site for the load anchoring of the subsequent noble metal on the carbon carrier, so that the dispersion capability of the noble metal is improved, and meanwhile, the strong interaction force between the noble metal and sulfur can improve the sintering resistance and electrochemical cycling stability of the noble metal particles. The sulfur-containing surfactant is introduced to enable a sulfur source to enter holes of the carbon carrier, so that a relatively deep hole is filled, noble metal particles are prevented from entering the too deep hole and cannot be utilized, in addition, the introduction of the sulfur-containing surfactant is beneficial to the dispersion of the carbon carrier, the better dispersibility of the carbon carrier can enable the carrier material to be fully contacted with the metal precursor, and the uniform loading and dispersion of the noble metal nanoparticles on the carrier surface are promoted.

title_en: Spray strengthening process for light glass bottle
abstract_en: The spray strengthening process for the light glass bottle comprises a liquid storage unit, a mixing stirring unit and a spraying unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the liquid storage unit is connected with the mixing stirring unit through a first infusion pump, the mixing stirring unit is connected with the spraying unit through a second infusion pump, the liquid storage unit comprises a liquid storage barrel, a cover and a handle, the mixing stirring unit comprises a stirring barrel, a barrel heat insulation interlayer, a barrel heat insulation layer, a steam coil, a stirring pump, a liquid level meter, a first thermometer, a first stirring blade and a second stirring blade, and the spraying unit comprises: the spraying box, the spraying component, the box body heat insulation interlayer, the box body heat insulation layer and the second thermometer; and the outer walls of the second liquid inlet pipe, the second liquid outlet pipe and the liquid inlet pipe are sequentially provided with a steam heat insulation interlayer and a heat insulation layer. The light glass bottle spray strengthening process realizes accurate control of spray temperature, solution concentration and spray time.

title_en: Production method of low-yield-ratio 780 MPa-grade bridge steel
abstract_en: The production method of the low yield ratio 780MPa grade bridge steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: c=0.07 to 0.10%, si less than or equal to 0.14%, mn=1.40 to 2.00%, P less than or equal to 0.010%, S less than or equal to 0.0060%, cu=0.20 to 0.40%, ni=0.6 to 1.20%, cr=0.50 to 0.90%, mo=0.30 to 0.60%, al=0.030 to 0.050%, ti=0.010 to 0.015%, and the balance Fe and unavoidable impurities. The method for realizing recrystallization refinement and multiple heat preservation quenching refinement homogenization of austenite grains by utilizing the limit deformation of the austenite grains in the hot rolling process of the Nb-free steel realizes refinement homogenization of the transformation martensite structure and the lath bainite structure, and ensures that the bridge steel plate with the thickness of 50mm and 780MPa has the characteristics of high strength, excellent low-temperature toughness and low yield ratio under the combined action of fine precipitation.

title_en: Preparation method of yttrium oxide with large specific surface area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of yttrium oxide with a large specific surface area, which comprises the following preparation steps of S1, dissolving yttrium salt, adding tetramethylammonium hydroxide for precipitation, S2, adding distilled water for washing, centrifugally dewatering, S3, washing with ethanol, dewatering, S4, adding diethylene glycol monobutyl ether, uniformly mixing to form paste, S5, burning the paste formed after the step S4 at a low temperature to form powder, S6, adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the powder prepared in the step S5 for ball milling, and S7, drying. The invention adopts tetramethyl ammonium hydroxide for precipitation, the space structure can reduce the agglomeration phenomenon, ethanol is adopted for washing for multiple times after washing, water is removed, diethylene glycol monobutyl ether solution is added to mix into paste, the agglomeration is further reduced during firing, and the firing temperature only needs 600-750 ℃, thereby saving energy and protecting environment. And during ball milling, absolute ethyl alcohol is added, no water is contained in the ball milling process, and agglomeration is reduced. The specific surface area of the yttrium oxide prepared by the method reaches 100-200m  2 /g.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity alumina fiber reinforced alumina composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-purity alumina fiber reinforced alumina composite material, which comprises the following steps of adding chopped alumina fibers into water, adding a small amount of acid, using high-purity alumina balls for barreling, adding high-purity nano alumina dispersion liquid, continuously adding alumina sol, fully dispersing the mixture, performing spray drying to obtain alumina fiber reinforced alumina composite powder, preparing the composite powder into ceramic balls with the diameter of 5-30mm after dry pressing and isostatic pressing, and performing high-temperature sintering. The fiber powder is fiber under microcosmic, macroscopic is powder, the fiber powder is easier to form into balls, toughness is greatly increased after use, nano alumina powder has excellent sintering activity, sintering is carried out at lower temperature, alumina grains are not easy to grow up, better toughness is achieved, alumina sol is used as an adhesive, low-temperature sinterability is achieved, the powder and the fiber are bonded, finally alumina is generated after high-temperature sintering, no impurity exists, and the yield is high.

title_en: Preparation method of multi-element titanium alloy cast ingot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a multi-element titanium alloy cast ingot, which comprises the following steps: 1. according to the composition content of a target product, adopting 0-level titanium sponge and multi-element intermediate alloy with more than four elements as raw materials; 2. weighing the raw materials, and mixing, distributing and pressing the raw materials to obtain an electrode block; 3. carrying out vacuum copper electrode plasma assembly welding treatment on a plurality of electrode blocks to obtain consumable electrodes; 4. and (5) carrying out vacuum consumable arc melting on the consumable electrode to obtain the multi-element titanium alloy cast ingot. The invention adopts the multi-element intermediate alloy with more than four elements as alloy raw materials, neutralizes the melting point difference and the density difference among the elements, avoids the phenomena of element burning loss caused by the melting point difference, uneven components caused by the density difference and the like in the smelting process, improves the uniform stability of the intermediate alloy components, further avoids the metallurgical hidden troubles such as element segregation, inclusion and the like in the multi-element titanium alloy cast ingot, improves the quality of the multi-element titanium alloy cast ingot, and is suitable for the fields of aerospace and the like.

title_en: Glass cover plate and processing technology and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a processing technology of a glass cover plate, which comprises the following steps: placing the planar glass substrate into a first die for texture pressing treatment to obtain 2D glass with surface textures; s2, placing the 2D glass with the surface textures into a 3D forming die for shape hot bending treatment to obtain the glass cover plate. The processing technology disclosed by the invention has good productivity and yield, and can be used for manufacturing texture patterns with sharp textures and small spacing.

title_en: Determination method for scrap steel content in converter metal material under condition of insufficient heat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the content of scrap steel in a converter metal material under the condition of insufficient heat, which mainly solves the technical problems that the benefit of increasing the consumption of scrap steel of a converter can not be evaluated and the optimal content of scrap steel in the converter metal material can not be determined under the condition of insufficient heat of the converter. The method for determining the scrap steel content in the converter metal material under the condition of insufficient heat comprises the following steps: 1) Determining the amount of a heating agent; 2) Calculating the heat supplementing cost in the converter; 3) Calculating the preheating cost of the waste steel outside the converter; 4) Calculating the input cost of converter increment scrap steel; 5) Calculating the incremental scrap steel benefit of the converter; 6) And determining the content of scrap steel in the converter metal. The method can determine the optimal scrap steel content in the converter metal material under the condition of increasing production according to market changes, thereby realizing the maximization of benefits.

title_en: High-plasticity low-cost steel with tensile strength of more than 2600MPa and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of ultra-high strength steel, and provides high-plasticity low-cost steel with tensile strength more than 2600MPa and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, smelting alloy raw materials with set proportions, and casting into casting blanks or steel ingots; S2, heating a casting blank or a steel ingot to a set temperature, preserving heat, forging the casting blank or the steel ingot into a forging blank with a round or square cross section in a rotating state for multiple times, cooling the forging blank to room temperature, carrying out furnace return heat preservation treatment at least once between each pass, and S3, carrying out low-temperature tempering treatment on the forging blank. The hot forging and direct tempering process solves the problems that the traditional ultra-high strength low alloy steel is difficult to industrially produce and has long production flow, and simultaneously solves the problem that the strength and the plasticity of the ultra-high strength steel are difficult to be compatible, and the total elongation of more than 10 percent is obtained when the tensile strength is more than 2600MPa, so that the hot forging and direct tempering process can be used in the special engineering field with extremely high requirements on strength and plasticity.

title_en: Short-process preparation method of high-strength copper-nickel-silicon alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-process preparation method of a high-strength copper-nickel-silicon alloy, which relates to the technical field of copper alloy materials, and comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out solution treatment on the as-cast C70250 copper alloy, and then carrying out hot rolling to obtain a hot rolled copper alloy; (2) And sequentially performing primary aging treatment, cryogenic rolling and secondary aging treatment on the hot rolled copper alloy to obtain the high-strength copper-nickel-silicon alloy. The scheme can adopt a short-flow process, shortens the process flow and obtains the copper-nickel-silicon alloy with high strength and excellent conductivity.

title_en: Hydraulic cementing material utilizing metallurgical solid wastes and production method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid waste recycling, in particular to a hydraulic cementing material utilizing metallurgical solid waste, a production method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise 28-32 parts of steel slag tailings, 48-52 parts of slag, 13-17 parts of desulfurized gypsum and 3-7 parts of fly ash by weight, wherein the total weight is 100 parts; wherein the steel slag tailings are residual steel slag tailings after the converter steel slag is subjected to heat stewing and iron separation; the slag is granulated blast furnace slag after water quenching; the desulfurization gypsum is produced by a CaO desulfurization method, and takes CaSO  4  as a main component; the fly ash is the fly ash collected after the coal powder is combusted. The invention can synchronously consume various metallurgical solid wastes and realize good resource utilization; the prepared hydraulic cementing material has good mechanical properties, can replace cement to produce concrete, reduces the production cost of cement and concrete, and has high economic benefit.

title_en: Roller bottom type salt bath quenching device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quenching equipment, in particular to a roller bottom type salt bath quenching device which comprises a salt bath quenching box, a salt bath roller way, a heating furnace roller way and a discharging table roller way, wherein a variable-volume component for changing the liquid level of molten salt is arranged in the salt bath quenching box and below the salt bath roller way, the variable-volume component comprises a fixed cavity fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the salt bath quenching box, two movable cavities respectively movably sleeved on the front side and the rear side of the fixed cavity, and an electric push rod for driving the two movable cavities to reversely move, and an electric heating plate and a stirring component are fixedly arranged on the variable-volume component. According to the invention, the molten salt liquid level can be changed through the variable-volume assembly, quenching can be realized without lifting the salt bath roller way, the salt bath roller way is simple to install and maintain, and molten salt is discharged through the movable cavity, so that the molten salt flows longitudinally and transversely, the temperature difference balance of a molten salt flow field is ensured, and the quenching effect is improved.

title_en: High-aluminum black corundum ceramic material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-aluminum black corundum ceramic material, which comprises the following components in parts by mass: 97-98 parts of aluminum oxide, 0.4-0.5 part of cobalt oxide, 1.0-1.9 parts of manganese dioxide, 0.1 part of magnesium oxide, 0.1 part of alum pentoxide, 0.1 part of silicon dioxide, 0.15 part of titanium dioxide and 0.15 part of boric acid; the alumina consists of 87-88 parts of coarse alumina powder and 10 parts of fine alumina powder. Through the use of the aluminum oxide coarse powder and the aluminum oxide micro powder in a compounding way, in the high-temperature sintering process, coarse particles induce the development of fine particle grains so as to promote sintering, manganese dioxide and titanium dioxide are added into a reaction system, the co-melt of MnO  2 -TiO 2  has the effect of promoting sintering on aluminum oxide ceramic, and the addition of boric acid enables liquid phase to be generated in the sintering process, wets powder particles, achieves the effect of liquid phase sintering, promotes sintering, can greatly reduce the sintering temperature and energy consumption, thereby reducing the preparation cost, improving the competitiveness compared with foreign electronic ceramic, and being beneficial to popularization.

title_en: Ultra-high-strength high-elasticity fine-grain Cu-Ni-Mn alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high-strength high-elasticity fine-grain Cu-Ni-Mn alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the alloy comprises the following main components in percentage by mass: 18% -25%, mn:18% -25%, nb:0.1% -1.0%, Y:0.05% -0.2% of copper and unavoidable impurities as the rest; according to the invention, through adding an alloy element Nb and a rare earth element Y, adopting low-temperature solid solution and aging treatment, nb and Ni form intermetallic compound Ni  3  Nb, Y and Ni form intermetallic compound Ni  2  Y, refining grains, reducing recrystallization temperature, promoting recrystallization, inhibiting precipitation of discontinuous precipitation phases (DP), improving distribution of alloy aging precipitation phases, and obtaining high-strength high-elasticity Cu-Ni-Mn alloy with tensile strength of more than or equal to 1500MPa and elastic modulus of more than or equal to 150 GPa; the Cu-Ni-Mn alloy prepared by the invention has uniform and fine structure, the grain size of the alloy after aging treatment is 2-3 mu m, and the alloy has excellent comprehensive properties of high strength, good elasticity and good plasticity.

title_en: Method for analyzing extrusion sticking die of magnesium alloy section bar
abstract_en: A method for analyzing the adhesion of magnesium alloy profile includes such steps as 1) determining the chemical element types of alloy and die steel, 2) obtaining the compound components possibly generated by interface between alloy and die steel by thermodynamic calculation software Thermal-Calc, 3) obtaining the Gibbs free energy of all the compound possibly generated by Thermal-Calc, predicting the most likely generated compound on interface between alloy and die steel, 4) hot dip plating, preheating die steel, putting it in the alloy melt with fixed temp. for Thermal insulation, 5) microscopic observation, 6) analyzing the element distribution of interface by EDS, and 7) combining the results of steps 5) and 6). According to the invention, thermodynamic calculation, hot dip coating interface microscopic characterization and interface element analysis are combined, and the problem of die sticking in the extrusion process of the magnesium alloy section is analyzed.

title_en: Flake silver powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides flake silver powder, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of mixing solution A and solution B, and then carrying out reaction to prepare the flake silver powder, wherein the solution A comprises Ag  + , silver nano-flake seed crystal and ions with oxidation, the solution B comprises ions with reduction, and the ions with oxidation comprise at least one of Ce  4+  or Fe  3+ . According to the preparation method of the flaky silver powder, a high-molecular dispersing agent or a high-molecular surfactant is not required to be added in the preparation process of the flaky silver powder, the flaky silver powder is prepared through a one-step reduction method, and under the combined action of the ions with the oxidation effect in the solution A and the silver nano-sheet seed crystal, the flakiness, the surface smoothness and the flatness of the prepared flaky silver powder are improved, and the conductivity of the prepared flaky silver powder is further improved.

title_en: High-strength high-toughness carbon ceramic brake disc and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-strength high-toughness carbon ceramic brake disc, which comprises N carbon fiber unidirectional cloth layers and N chopped carbon fiber layers, wherein the carbon fiber unidirectional cloth layers and the chopped carbon fiber layers are stacked in a staggered manner, the thickness of the carbon fiber unidirectional cloth layers is 0.4-0.8mm, and the thickness of the chopped carbon fiber layers is 0.5-1mm. Through optimizing brake disc blank structure, set up carbon fiber unidirectional cloth layer and chopped carbon fiber layer in turn, compare ordinary carbon fiber unidirectional cloth and net child's combination mode, can further improve the bulk strength and the toughness of brake disc.

title_en: Method for preparing quartz stone plate by taking recycled material as raw material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a quartz stone plate by taking a recycled material as a raw material, which comprises the following steps: mixing matrix agent, unsaturated polyester resin and methyl ethyl ketone peroxide according to the weight ratio of 10:2:0.3, feeding into a pressing machine, pressing and forming, wherein the pressing pressure is 10-15MPa, and pressing for 1-2min. The preparation method of the quartz stone plate adopts the waste quartz sand to pretreat by adopting hydrochloric acid solution, then the waste quartz sand is subjected to synergism by the whisker modifier and the regulator together, the performance effect of the system is improved, the system is stirred and modified in the modifying liquid, the interfacial property between the raw materials of the system is optimized, finally the unsaturated polyester resin and the methyl ethyl ketone peroxide raw materials are matched, and the strength and the wear resistance of the quartz stone plate obtained through compression molding and curing are improved in a coordinated manner, the acid corrosion resistance stability of the product is obviously improved, and the service efficiency of the product is improved.

title_en: Raw material composition for damping ceramic material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microwave attenuation materials, and discloses a raw material composition for an attenuation ceramic material, the attenuation ceramic material, a preparation method and application thereof. The raw material composition comprises a medium phase, an attenuation phase and a sintering aid, wherein the medium phase is silicon nitride, and the attenuation phase is a carbon nano tube. The damping ceramic material has mechanical property, thermal property, electrical property and chemical stability, silicon nitride is used as a medium phase for the first time, and a carbon nano tube is used as a damping phase, so that the prepared damping ceramic material can be suitable for high frequency, particularly has high damping performance, high thermal conductivity and high strength when used under the conditions of W wave band and Y wave band.

title_en: Device system for analyzing performance of laboratory-sized lime water permeable pavement
abstract_en: The invention provides a device system for analyzing the performance of a lime water permeable pavement in a laboratory size, which comprises a rainfall unit and a lime water permeable pavement unit; the rainfall unit comprises a water delivery device, a flow monitoring device, a water outlet valve and a water spraying device which are connected in sequence; the lime water permeable pavement unit comprises a pavement with a full water permeable structure or other pavement with a full water permeable structure; the water spraying device is arranged right above the lime water permeable pavement unit; the lime water permeable pavement unit is arranged in the container; the bottom of the container is provided with a water outlet. The device system can simulate the real rainfall process, and can carry out various performance analysis and research on the lime water permeable pavement in a laboratory, and the lime water permeable pavement meeting engineering requirements can be obtained by setting raw materials with proper proportions.

title_en: Tungsten trioxide containing surface oxygen vacancy, preparation method thereof and application of tungsten trioxide in photocatalytic acetonitrile oxidation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalytic materials, and particularly relates to tungsten trioxide containing surface oxygen vacancies, and preparation and photocatalytic acetonitrile oxidation application thereof. Dropwise adding a sodium tungstate solution into a hydrochloric acid solution under stirring, stirring for reaction after the dropwise adding is finished, centrifuging, washing and drying a precipitate after the reaction is finished to obtain monoclinic phase tungsten trioxide; and annealing the obtained monoclinic phase tungsten trioxide to obtain tungsten trioxide containing surface oxygen vacancies. The tungsten trioxide containing the surface oxygen vacancies prepared by the invention can catalyze the acetonitrile to be oxidized to formic acid in a high-activity and high-selectivity way, thereby realizing the efficient degradation of the acetonitrile and conversion of the acetonitrile to formic acid products with the same economic value. According to the invention, by means of photocatalysis, the formic acid product with higher added value is obtained while the acetonitrile waste water is degraded, the treatment cost can be greatly reduced, the performance of the catalyst is not reduced in the catalytic test of 30 h in five cycles, and the catalyst has a wide prospect in the aspect of practical application.

title_en: Pt/MnO for reverse water gas reactionxCatalyst and methods of making and using the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Pt/MnO  x  catalyst for reverse water gas reaction and a preparation and use method thereof. The catalyst is prepared by a one-step method, manganese oxide (MnO  x ) is used as a carrier to load Pt, a series of Pt/MnO  x  catalysts are prepared, and the Pt can still exist in a single-atom form under the condition of high Pt load (2 wt%) and has atomic fraction dispersity and high stability. In addition, the catalyst obviously improves the activity and selectivity of the reverse water gas reaction, the CO  2  conversion rate is close to the thermodynamic equilibrium, the CO selectivity reaches 100 percent, and the preparation method is simple to operate, the reaction process is controllable, and the preparation method has good application prospect.

title_en: Cellulose ether modified sulfur aluminate cement and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cellulose ether modified sulphoaluminate cement and a preparation method thereof, and the cellulose ether modified sulphoaluminate cement comprises the following components in parts by mass: 85-95 parts of sulphoaluminate cement clinker, 0.1-0.5 part of cellulose ether modifier and 5-15 parts of gypsum. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of obviously improving the water retention and cohesiveness of the sulphoaluminate cement and the like.

title_en: Method for blowing oxygen in earlier stage of 250 ton converter smelting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for blowing oxygen in the earlier stage of 250 ton converter smelting, which mainly solves the technical problem that a large-sized converter blown by a secondary combustion oxygen lance in the prior art easily causes explosion venting of an electrostatic precipitator in the earlier stage of smelting. The technical proposal is that the method for blowing oxygen in the earlier stage of 250 ton converter smelting adopts a secondary combustion oxygen lance for blowing in the converter smelting process, and comprises the following steps: 1) The first oxygen step converting is 3-5% of the total oxygen supply of the smelting furnace; 2) The second oxygen step converting is 2-4% of the total oxygen supply of the smelting furnace; 3) The third oxygen step is to blow, and the third oxygen step is to blow 1-3% of the total oxygen supply of the smelting furnace; 4) Fourth oxygen step converting, which is 15-30% of total oxygen supply of smelting furnace. The mass content of CO in the flue gas in the electrostatic precipitator at the earlier stage of converter smelting is less than or equal to 8%, so that the mixed gas of CO and O  2  is prevented from reaching the explosion venting condition of the electrostatic precipitator.

title_en: Preparation method of electric brush for high-power generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an electric brush for a high-power generator, which belongs to the field of carbon product processing and comprises the following steps: firstly, uniformly mixing raw materials of graphite, a graphite interlayer compound and asphalt which are prepared according to the weight parts; adding phenolic resin into a solvent to prepare phenolic resin solution; uniformly mixing the mixed material with a phenolic resin solution, and grinding and screening; pressing the screened powder material to prepare a brush blank; roasting the blank under the protection of inert gas to prepare a brush blank; and finally, machining the blank, riveting or filling the brush braid to prepare the electric brush for the generator. The electric brush for the generator, which is prepared by the method, is suitable for the generator of a thermal power plant, has low volume density, and is suitable for application scenes of high linear speed; the brush body of the electric brush is soft, good in lubricating performance, less in impurity, long in maintenance period or service life of the slip ring; saving production and use cost, and being convenient for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Bipolar membrane electrodialysis device containing isolation chamber and preparation method of high-purity lithium hydroxide
abstract_en: The invention provides a bipolar membrane electrodialysis device with an isolation chamber. Compared with the prior art, the bipolar membrane electrodialysis device provided by the invention has the advantages that the isolation chamber is arranged between the acid chamber and the alkali chamber, the solution in the isolation chamber adopts the sulfuric acid solution with extremely low concentration, hydrogen ions generated by the bipolar membrane enter the isolation chamber, and then enter the acid chamber through the isolation chamber to stably provide the hydrogen ions for the acid chamber; on the other hand, the sulfate ions migrating from the acid chamber to the isolation chamber under the action of the electric field can be blocked by the cation exchange membrane to a large extent, a small amount of sulfate ions can enter the isolation chamber, and the concentration of sulfate ions in the solution in the initial isolation chamber is extremely low, so that the concentration of sulfate ions in the whole isolation chamber can be ensured to be in a lower state, and finally the sulfate ions leaked from the isolation chamber to the alkali chamber through the bipolar membrane can be greatly reduced, the purity of alkali-producing lithium hydroxide in the alkali chamber is greatly improved, and the method has great economic value and important significance for recycling waste lithium batteries and is a simple and green method for recycling lithium.

title_en: Manufacturing method of anti-dazzle ultralow-reflection high-transmittance coated glass
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of glass, in particular to a manufacturing method of anti-dazzle ultra-low reflection high-transmittance coated glass, which comprises the following steps: comprising the following steps: s1, selecting base material glass; s2, cleaning the surface of the substrate glass; s3, preparing a coating solution, and adding coarse particles and fine particles with proper sizes into the coating solution; s4, adding the coating solution into coating equipment; s5, placing the substrate glass into coating equipment for coating; s6, setting an annealing device for preventing the substrate glass from being oxidized after the coating is finished, and placing the glass into the annealing device for annealing after the coating is finished; s7, waiting for cooling the glass after the annealing of the substrate glass is finished, taking out and packing the substrate glass by using the manual sucking disc, so that the transmittance is increased, and the technical problems that the glass is polished very thinly to realize high transmittance and ultralow reflectance in the prior art, but the thin glass is not applicable in some scenes can be solved.

title_en: Extractant for extracting scandium and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extractant for extracting and separating scandium, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structure of the extractant is shown in formula I or formula II:  compared with the existing carboxylic acid-based ionic liquid with short alkyl chain, the strong hydrophobicity of the extractant ensures that the components of the extractant hardly enter into the water phase in the extraction process, the extractant can be recycled, scandium (III) can be selectively separated from other rare earth metals and aluminum solutions, and the extractant has higher separation efficiency and extraction rate, and the extraction rate of scandium can reach 100 percent. The extractant has the advantages of cheap and easily obtained raw materials, simple and environment-friendly synthesis method, reduced synthesis cost of the ionic liquid, simplified synthesis process of the ionic liquid and convenience for mass synthesis.

title_en: Curved surface vacuum glass powder coating thickness monitoring device
abstract_en: The device comprises a moving mechanism, a double-cylinder printing mechanism and a controller, wherein the moving mechanism comprises a vertical fixed guide rail, a vertical moving seat, a vertical moving driving mechanism, a traversing cylinder, a traversing seat, a rotating seat, a first substrate fixing seat, a second substrate fixing seat and a spacing adjusting cylinder; the first curved glass substrate is fixedly installed on the installation surface of the first substrate fixing seat, the second curved glass substrate is fixedly installed on the installation surface of the second substrate fixing seat, the first curved glass substrate and the second curved glass substrate are oppositely arranged, and a double-cylinder printing mechanism is arranged between the two installation surfaces of the first substrate fixing seat and the second substrate fixing seat. The scheme can accurately control the thickness of the glass powder paste coating on the two pieces of curved glass, so that the sealing paste can be completely melted to form a high-quality sealing body, and bubbles and pores cannot be generated due to uneven thickness.

title_en: Tin alloy material resistant to extreme temperature and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tin alloy materials, in particular to a tin alloy material resistant to extreme temperature, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the tin alloy material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: silver 1-8%, copper 0.3-1.5%, bismuth 0.5-5.0%, indium 0.1-2.0%, antimony 0.1-5.0%, nickel 0.05-0.5%, germanium 0.05-0.5%, cobalt 0.05-0.3%, yttrium 0.05-0.3%, cerium 0.05-0.3%, and tin in balance. The tin alloy material is prepared by the following steps: sequentially adding silver, copper, bismuth, indium, antimony and nickel into melted tin, then raising the temperature, sequentially adding germanium, cobalt, yttrium and cerium, and finally cooling, raising the temperature and stirring to obtain a target product. Compared with the prior art, the tin alloy material has the limit temperature resistant range of minus 68 ℃ to plus 70 ℃.

title_en: Preparation and application of self-adaptive radiation cooling film based on vanadium dioxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of vanadium dioxide film/silicon dioxide microsphere/low-e glass. The process steps comprise arranging silicon dioxide microspheres, sputtering vanadium metal and annealing vanadium dioxide in sequence, wherein the process comprises the basic operation flows of cleaning a substrate, setting sputtering parameters, vacuumizing, performing direct current sputtering at normal temperature, annealing in a tube furnace, setting reaction temperature, time, atmosphere and the like. The scheme of preparing the composite film by utilizing the direct current sputtering and tube furnace heat treatment oxidation modes at normal temperature realizes the self-adaptive regulation of radiation cooling. The invention changes the singleness of the traditional radiation cooling film, increases the transmittance of certain visible light, has lower sunlight absorptivity in a high temperature state, and the proposed composite film structure is beneficial to the application of intelligent regulation windows for construction and aerospace.

title_en: Powder cleaning device for laser additive manufacturing multi-material powder bed
abstract_en: The invention provides a powder cleaning device for a laser additive manufacturing multi-material powder bed, which comprises: the movable seat can move along the direction parallel to the powder laying plane and along the direction perpendicular to the powder laying plane, the powder sucking mechanism is connected with the movable seat, each powder storing bin is respectively connected with the sucking mechanism and the powder sucking mechanism, the powder sucking mechanism can be selectively communicated with only one powder storing bin at the time of sucking powder, the sucking mechanism is communicated with each powder storing bin, and the sucking mechanism is used for providing suction force for sucking the powder into the powder storing bin through the powder sucking mechanism. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, the technical problems that multiple material powders are not easy to be classified and recycled and the molding quality is influenced when the powder is paved for multiple times in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Mine acid wastewater high-value utilization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine acidic wastewater high-value utilization method which comprises the steps of concentration, reduction reaction, vulcanization dezincification, neutralization dealuminum, oxidation, calcium and magnesium removal, oxidation synthesis, aging washing and the like. The method and the device realize the rapid and efficient utilization of valuable resources such as acid iron, copper, zinc and the like in the mine acidic wastewater, change waste into valuable, and take the iron in the mine acidic wastewater as an iron source for preparing the ferric phosphate, thereby not only effectively solving the problem of mine acidic wastewater treatment, but also solving the source and cost bottleneck problem of preparing the ferric phosphate iron source, and having remarkable economic, social and environmental benefits.

title_en: Method for extracting and preparing high-purity quartz sand from granite and melting quartz glass
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting and preparing high-purity quartz sand from granite and melting quartz glass; the invention belongs to the technical field of non-metal mineral material deep processing. According to the physical and chemical property differences of different mineral components in the ore and the characteristics and inclusion characteristics of the quartz crystal, a method for separating associated and associated non-quartz minerals of the quartz crystal is provided pertinently, the quartz crystal is effectively extracted, trace and even trace impurity elements in the quartz are removed through further optimization, and a high-purity quartz sand product with the content of SiO  2  being more than or equal to 99.99% is obtained. The quartz glass body with no color spots, no impurity spots, no obvious bubbles, high transparency and good high-temperature heat stability can be prepared by high-temperature melting.

title_en: Injection molding material, maraging steel with ultrahigh yield strength prepared by injection molding material and application of maraging steel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of powder metallurgy materials and intelligent manufacturing, relates to a metal material, and in particular relates to an injection molding material, a maraging steel with ultrahigh yield strength and application thereof. An injection molding material comprises the following chemical elements in percentage by mass: 16.5-19 wt% of Ni, 8.5-15 wt% of Co, 5.6-8 wt% of Mo, less than or equal to 0.03wt% of C, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurity elements. The material has excellent plasticity, and can be used for adjusting the ultra-high strength steel with yield strength respectively more than 1800MPa, 1900MPa and 2000MPa in the component range. The maraging steel can be applied to aerospace and medical appliances, and particularly can be applied to application scenes of '3C' intelligent wearing equipment, wherein the application scenes are high in strength and light in weight.

title_en: Domestic waste leachate anaerobic biogas slurry resource utilization device
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for recycling anaerobic biogas slurry of domestic garbage leachate, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by reforming biogas slurry. Including reation kettle, fixedly connected with spacing base on reation kettle's the inner wall, install reforming hydrogen manufacturing subassembly in the spacing base, reforming hydrogen manufacturing subassembly is used for carrying out reforming hydrogen manufacturing to the natural pond liquid and handles, reforming hydrogen manufacturing subassembly is connected with spacing base, installs hydrogen collection subassembly in the spacing base, and hydrogen collection subassembly is used for collecting the hydrogen that reforming hydrogen manufacturing subassembly and natural pond liquid reaction produced, and hydrogen collection subassembly is connected with spacing base. According to the invention, the reforming hydrogen production assembly is arranged, so that the methane liquid can be subjected to reforming hydrogen production reaction treatment, and the methane liquid reforming hydrogen production efficiency can be improved. Through setting up hydrogen collection subassembly, not only can collect the hydrogen that hydrogen production subassembly and natural pond liquid reaction produced again, can not mix other mixed gas in the collection process moreover, and then make and collect hydrogen purity and promote greatly.

title_en: Preparation method of silica aerogel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aerogel, and provides a preparation method of silicon dioxide aerogel, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing a silicon source, water and an alcohol solvent, hydrolyzing under the action of an acid catalyst, and condensing under the action of an alkaline catalyst to obtain wet gel; s2, aging the wet gel, replacing with a low-surface tension solvent, and drying to obtain silica aerogel; the silicon source is composed of methyltrimethoxysilane, 3-aminopropyl triethoxysilane and a silicon source A; the silicon source A is one or two of vinyl trimethoxy silane and vinyl tri (2-methoxyethoxy) silane. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the specific surface area and the porosity of the silica aerogel are low when the silica aerogel is prepared by normal-pressure drying in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Industrial ironmaking solid waste treatment system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial ironmaking solid waste treatment system, in particular to an industrial ironmaking solid waste treatment system and a control method thereof. Solves the technical problems of zinc resource waste and environmental pollution caused by waste residues in the prior iron-making solid waste. The system comprises a reduction furnace, a centrifugal compressor, a gear box, a motor, a synchronous clutch and a gas turbine which are connected in sequence in a transmission way; the reduction furnace is respectively connected with the centrifugal compressor and the gas turbine; the reduction furnace is used for smelting iron-making solid wastes; the centrifugal compressor is used for generating compressed air required by the reduction furnace; when the gas turbine works, the motor is connected with the synchronous clutch, the gas turbine uses the gas generated by the reduction furnace to do work, and the gas turbine and the motor drive the centrifugal compressor together to generate compressed air; when the gas turbine is stopped, the motor is disconnected from the synchronous clutch, the motor provides driving force, and the centrifugal compressor is driven by the gear box to generate compressed air.

title_en: High-ductility sustainable engineering material compositely excited by red mud and chemical exciting agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-ductility sustainable engineering material excited by red mud and a chemical exciting agent in a composite way, which comprises the following components: 20-40 parts of red mud, 20-30 parts of slag powder, 5-7 parts of micro silicon powder, 12-15 parts of sand, 8-17 parts of chemical exciting agent, 0.1-0.2 part of additive, 1-2 parts of fiber and 12-15 parts of mixing water. According to the invention, the alkaline component in the red mud is effectively utilized, the dependence on traditional chemical alkali excitant is reduced, the reutilization of the industrial waste is realized, and the environmental impact and the manufacturing cost are reduced.

title_en: Phosphate rock powder briquetting roasting system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphorite powder briquetting roasting system and method, the system comprises a batching subsystem, a roller subsystem, a screening and distributing subsystem, a roasting and cooling subsystem, a finished product screening subsystem and a hot air circulation subsystem. The invention solves the problem of resource waste caused by the fact that the powdered rock phosphate cannot be reused in the existing phosphorite processing, solves the problem of land resource waste caused by the fact that a large amount of powdered rock phosphate is piled up in the existing phosphorite processing, realizes the recycling of powdered rock phosphate, and also greatly saves land resources. Meanwhile, the prepared lump ore product has the advantages of good quality, high strength, convenience for subsequent transportation, strong portability, low water content and low carbonate content, effectively reduces the power consumption of the subsequent lump ore for preparing phosphorus, and improves the purity of the phosphorus.

title_en: Stainless steel fiber/ZA 27 porous material with high strength, high sound absorption and high damping and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stainless steel fiber/ZA 27 porous material with high strength, high sound absorption and high damping and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of porous metal materials. The volume fraction of the stainless steel fiber in the porous material is 2-8vol%, the porosity is 81-83%, the pore size is 0.5mm, the diameter of the stainless steel fiber is 30-60 mu m, the length of the stainless steel fiber is 1mm, and the porous material which is prepared and obtained and exists in the ZA27 alloy matrix in the form of embedding, penetrating and extending out can effectively improve the material strength, sound absorption and damping performance, thereby being beneficial to meeting more stricter application requirements.

title_en: Rare earth sulfide with silicon dioxide coating layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a rare earth sulfide with a silicon dioxide coating layer and a preparation method thereof, relating to the chemical field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: adding rare earth sulfide into alkaline first dispersion liquid, then adding a first auxiliary agent and a first silicon source for a first reaction, heating and curing to obtain first coating sulfide, and maintaining the pH and the temperature of the first dispersion liquid to be consistent with those before adding the rare earth sulfide in the first reaction process; and adding the first coating sulfide into the second dispersion liquid, then adding a second auxiliary agent and a second silicon source to carry out a second reaction, and keeping the pH and the temperature of the second dispersion liquid consistent with those before the first coating sulfide is added in the second reaction process to obtain the rare earth sulfide with the silicon dioxide coating. The rare earth sulfide obtained by the method has better stability.

title_en: Method for coating at least one fiber with boron nitride mesophase
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for coating at least one fiber (11) with a boron nitride mesophase, comprising treating said at least one fiber with a treatment medium comprising ammonia borane, said treatment medium having a temperature of 100 ℃ or more and a pressure of 1 bar or more.

title_en: Joining techniques for composite ceramic bodies
abstract_en: In joining composite ceramic bodies, at least one ceramic body has varying concentrations between two or more ceramic materials and is graded by composition. The compositionally graded ceramic body terminates at a butt-joint layer consisting essentially of a single ceramic material. The compositionally graded ceramic body is bonded to another ceramic body, which may also be compositionally graded or made of a single ceramic material, and the butt layer of the other ceramic body is the same composition as the butt layer of the compositionally graded ceramic body. In certain embodiments, the ceramic body may be joined by diffusion bonding. In certain embodiments, the ceramic body comprises a ceramic platen and a ceramic stem of a wafer pedestal implemented in a plasma processing apparatus.

title_en: Porous tantalum fusion device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a porous tantalum fusion device and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of medical appliances, wherein polyvinyl alcohol, a pore-forming agent, magnesium chloride, zinc chloride, strontium chloride and a sintering aid are mixed, tantalum metal is added and uniformly mixed to prepare a porous tantalum fusion device blank, the porous tantalum fusion device blank is subjected to briquetting treatment, and atmosphere protection sintering is adopted to prepare the porous tantalum fusion device; the porous tantalum fusion cage prepared by the novel formula design and pore-foaming agent sintering process has excellent biocompatibility and tissue regeneration and repair promoting effects, can form a tight bonding interface with human tissues, improves the combination stability and mechanical property of the fusion cage and the human tissues, is matched with the human tissues, and can be applied to clinical tissue defect repair treatment.

title_en: Porous carbon fiber material with high fracture toughness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of porous materials, and particularly relates to a porous carbon fiber material with high fracture toughness and a preparation method thereof. Aiming at the problems that the fracture toughness of the porous carbon material in the prior art is generally poor, the porous carbon material is easily broken due to external pressure, and the final crystallization result is not ideal enough, the invention provides the porous carbon fiber material with high fracture toughness and the preparation method thereof, wherein the unit fracture toughness of the porous carbon fiber material is 16-22 (MPa.m  1/2 *cm 3 )/g; where, unit fracture toughness = fracture toughness/density; the density was 0.92g/cm  3 . The invention provides a porous carbon fiber material with higher unit fracture toughness, and the porous carbon fiber material with supporting function is not easy to fracture in the crystal growth process, so that the crystallization result is ensured.

title_en: Method for smelting industrial silicon from serpentine hydrochloric acid leaching residues
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for smelting industrial silicon from serpentine hydrochloric acid leaching residues. Comprising the following steps: step S1, pretreatment: washing and press-filtering serpentine hydrochloric acid leaching residues to obtain washing acid leaching residues; step S2, mixing and ball pressing: mixing a binder with filter residues of the washing acid leaching residues, and pressing the mixture into pellets; the binder comprises sodium silicate; step S3, roasting: roasting the pellets to obtain thermal pellets and roasting smoke; step S4, smelting: smelting the thermal pellets to obtain industrial silicon and smelting flue gas. The technical scheme of the invention can produce industrial silicon, the flue gas and smoke dust obtained by smelting can be recycled, the process method is simple, and the recycling of serpentine leaching residues and the recycling comprehensive utilization of various elements in serpentine minerals can be realized.

title_en: Preparation method of silica opening agent for optical film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical film opening agents, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a silicon dioxide opening agent for an optical film, which comprises the following steps of S1, maintaining the temperature of a reaction kettle A at 200-300 ℃ and the pressure at 0.3-1.0 mpa, simultaneously injecting a water glass solution W1 and sulfuric acid F1 into the reaction kettle A, maintaining the pH at 0.5-2.0 to form a silicon dioxide sol, S2, transferring the silicon sol into a reaction kettle B, maintaining the temperature at 15-25 ℃, simultaneously emulsifying and dispersing, regulating the pH to 10-12, then simultaneously adding the water glass solution W2 and sulfuric acid F2 into the reaction kettle B, heating to 80-100 ℃ for aging, regulating the pH to 3.0-5.0, aging to form silicon dioxide precipitate, S3, washing the precipitate, and then carrying out wet grinding, and S4, carrying out spray drying on the slurry. The silicon dioxide for the optical film synthesized by the method has large pore volume, small particle size and low conductivity, has good openness and transparency in the field of optical films, and is successfully applied to the field of optical films.

title_en: Magnesium-aluminum hydrotalcite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the field of nano materials, and the magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material with small bulk density (less than or equal to 0.22g/cm  3 ), high specific surface area (more than or equal to 130m  2 /g) and mesoporous structure (3-10 nm) pore diameter is prepared by regulating and controlling synthesis conditions, such as reaction temperature, dropwise adding speed of metal salt solution and alkali solution, and the like in the process of preparing the magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite by a double-dropwise method. The magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite material and the preparation method thereof are suitable for catalyst carriers or catalysts, harmful gas adsorbents and the like in heterogeneous catalysis due to large specific surface area, and in addition, the preparation method has simple process, convenient operation and no need of adding surfactant, thereby having industrial production and application prospects.

title_en: Preparation method of hierarchical-structure CoAl/NiC/C composite heat-conducting wave-absorbing material and corresponding material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat-conducting wave-absorbing materials, in particular to a preparation method of a hierarchical structure CoAl/NiC/C composite heat-conducting wave-absorbing material and a corresponding material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing cobalt aluminum double hydroxide material by adopting cobalt chloride hexahydrate, aluminum chloride hexahydrate, urea and deionized water; preparing a cobalt aluminum double hydroxide/nickel hydroxide material by adopting nickel chloride hexahydrate, ammonia water, a cobalt aluminum double hydroxide material and deionized water; preparing a cobalt-aluminum double hydroxide/nickel hydroxide/polydopamine material by adopting dopamine hydrochloride, a cobalt-aluminum double hydroxide/nickel hydroxide material and a Tris-hydrochloric acid buffer solution; carbonizing the cobalt-aluminum double hydroxide/nickel hydroxide/polydopamine material in an inert atmosphere to obtain the cobalt-aluminum alloy/nickel carbide/carbon composite heat-conducting wave-absorbing material with a flaky hierarchical structure. The invention can obtain the heat conduction wave-absorbing material with high wave-absorbing strength and high heat conductivity.

title_en: Smelting method of SUH409L steel grade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smelting method of SUH409L steel grade, namely adopting a one-step process of three-stripping/dephosphorizing+AOD converter+LF furnace to smelt SUH409L. Adding the triple-dephosphorization molten iron into an AOD converter, controlling the content of furnace burden grade ferrochrome Si at 2.0-3.0%, controlling the content of reduced Si at 0.15-0.2%, controlling the content of reduced slag at 3t-4.5t, controlling the alkalinity R of the reduced slag at 1.9-2.0, tapping Si to be less than or equal to 0.4%, tapping N to be less than or equal to 80ppm, tapping C to be less than or equal to 90ppm, and controlling the theoretical content of Al  2 O 3  in the steel slag to be more than 11.0%, and then feeding alloy wires and finely adjusting components in an LF furnace. Compared with the two-step smelting process of three-step dephosphorization, AOD converter, VOD and LF furnace, the one-step smelting process has the advantages that the cost of refractory materials is greatly reduced because molten steel is not treated by VOD, and the cost of smelting SUH409L steel grade by one-step method is reduced by about 270 yuan/ton.

title_en: Preparation method and application of superfine-grain NbTi-based superconducting alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an ultrafine grain NbTi-based superconducting alloy, and belongs to the technical field of superconducting material processing. The method takes metal hydride as a raw material, forms supersaturated solid solution powder through mixing and mechanical alloying, and then carries out annealing treatment and spark plasma sintering to prepare the superfine grain NbTi-based superconducting alloy. The grain size of the prepared superfine grain NbTi-based superconducting alloy is about 100 nm. By introducing an artificial nailing and rolling center, the critical current density, critical magnetic field and hysteresis loss performance of the finished superconducting wire can be effectively improved. The invention takes metal hydride as raw material, the ball milling process can effectively avoid welding and combination with a ball milling tank, the powder yield of the mechanical alloying process is improved, and the invention provides a high-efficiency preparation method for the NbTi-based superconducting alloy with nano-scale ultrafine grains.

title_en: Modified ferric phosphate material, lithium ferric phosphate material, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified ferric phosphate material, a lithium ferric phosphate material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ferric phosphate materials. The modified iron phosphate material is in a sheet shape as a whole, and comprises zirconium phosphate with a lamellar structure, wherein simple substance silver and lithium oxide are loaded between the layers of the zirconium phosphate, and iron phosphate is formed on the outer surface of the zirconium phosphate. The modified ferric phosphate material can be further prepared into a lithium iron phosphate material and applied to a battery, and can improve the rate capability, coulombic efficiency, capacity and conductivity of the battery. The preparation methods of the modified ferric phosphate material and the lithium iron phosphate material are simple, and the modified ferric phosphate material and the lithium iron phosphate material can be industrially produced.

title_en: Modified hydrogel adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a modified hydrogel adsorbent, a preparation method and applications thereof, the preparation method comprising the steps of: (1) Mixing a first polymer solution with an acid solution to obtain a solution A, mixing a second polymer, a cross-linking agent and a solvent to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B to obtain a mixed solution, adding a lithium ion sieve to obtain a pre-polymerized solution, and carrying out freezing treatment after reaction to obtain a hydrogel adsorbent; (2) And mixing the linear polymer monomer and the initiator to obtain a modified precursor solution, mixing the hydrogel adsorbent and the modified precursor solution, and carrying out light reaction to obtain the modified hydrogel adsorbent. The method has the advantages that the adsorbent/ion sieve is wrapped in the hydrogel, the hydrogel adsorbent with good mechanical stability is prepared, the impurity ion level in the adsorbent is constant, the lithium extraction method for concentrating brine by utilizing illumination can be realized, lithium is extracted while concentration is carried out, and byproduct salt is obtained, and no additional concentration step is needed.

title_en: Automatic pickling equipment for glass fibers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of glass fiber processing, and particularly relates to automatic glass fiber pickling equipment, which comprises a frame, wherein a pickling tank is fixedly arranged on the frame, a guide plate device is fixedly arranged at the left end of the pickling tank, a conveying belt device is arranged on the guide plate device and is in transmission connection with a driving device, a draining box device is arranged at the right end of the pickling tank, a wire lifting device and a lifting device are arranged on the draining box device, a draining device is arranged in the draining box device, the draining device is connected with the wire lifting device and the lifting device, and a moving platform device is arranged on the pickling tank; according to the invention, the filter baffle and the airing draining board are arranged on the pickling tank, the movable platform device and the draining box device are matched, and the conveyer belt device and the draining device are combined, so that the glass fiber can be automatically pickled and drained, the draining time is long, the effect is good, the equipment working process is continuous, and the utilization and the operation efficiency of the equipment are greatly improved.

title_en: Open supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage system and operation method
