abstract_en: The invention discloses an open supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage system and an operation method, wherein the open supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage system comprises a thermal power plant unit, a supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage unit, a calcium carbonate heat storage unit and a microalgae unit, carbon dioxide discharged by the thermal power plant unit is used as a working medium for supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage, the supercritical carbon dioxide energy storage unit can store surplus power in the process of wind energy and solar energy power generation peak, the calcium carbonate heat storage unit can store compression heat and sunlight heat in the compression process and is used for supplementing heat before the supercritical carbon dioxide expansion, the microalgae unit can utilize carbon dioxide discharged by acting to finish acting as raw materials for microalgae reaction to generate biodiesel, the energy storage time can be prolonged when wind energy and solar energy power generation peak, and the supercritical carbon dioxide can be stored in a sealing mode to the seabed, and the problems of excessive carbon emission of the thermal power plant, randomness of wind energy and solar energy and volatility are solved.

title_en: Deodorizing and sterilizing nano copper wire film for refrigerator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deodorizing and sterilizing nano copper wire film for a refrigerator and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Dissolving copper chloride dihydrate in water, adding glucose and sodium borohydride into the solution, stirring for 10-60 min, slowly adding octadecylamine into the solution, stirring for 10-15 h at normal temperature to obtain a blue solution, pouring the blue solution into a reaction kettle, and reacting for 15-30 h at 100-150 ℃ to obtain a crude product of the nano copper wire; (2) Sequentially centrifuging and washing the crude product of the nano copper wire with deionized water, absolute ethyl alcohol and normal hexane, clarifying supernatant to obtain a pure product of the nano copper wire, and storing the pure product of the nano copper wire in normal hexane; (3) The nanometer copper wires are injected into the spray gun through ultrasonic dispersion and are evenly sprayed on the inner wall of the circulating air duct of the refrigerator and/or the inner surface of the drawer cover plate of the refrigerator, so that the nanometer copper wire film is formed. The nano copper wire is synthesized by a hydrothermal method, and is uniformly sprayed on the inner wall of a circulating air duct of the refrigerator and the inner surface of a fresh-keeping drawer cover to remove odor and sterilize the refrigerator.

title_en: Scandium ion selective adsorbent in multi-metal ion mixed solution, preparation method and adsorption method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scandium ion selective adsorbent in a multi-metal ion mixed solution, a preparation method and an adsorption method thereof. A preparation method of scandium ion selective adsorbent in a multi-metal ion mixed solution comprises the steps of carrying out sulfonic acid and polyfluoro modification on a Zr metal center organic framework material UiO-66 to obtain scandium ion selective adsorbent UFS  X , wherein X refers to the molar quantity of modified sulfonic acid functional groups, and X=0.10-0.45. The new material synthesized by the invention has good selective adsorption capacity to Sc (III), the addition of the fluoride ion group enhances the hydrophobicity of the synthetic material, conditions are provided for enhancing the adsorption capacity, and the synthetic modification mode can obtain the adsorption material with better structural stability and stronger adsorption performance.

title_en: Preparation method of low-carbon universal cement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of low-carbon universal cement, which comprises the main technical method that raw materials containing silicon-aluminum-calcium-magnesium-potassium-sodium oxide are selected and ground into raw material powder, oxidized and calcined at the temperature of not lower than 1210 ℃ until the phase is stable, and then quenched to obtain clinker; the latter is externally mixed with 0-3% caustic alkali and ground to obtain cement powder, and the cement powder needs to be preserved for more than 7 days at normal temperature after hydration. The cement has the advantages of low carbon, energy conservation, waste utilization, environmental protection and good expected durability.

title_en: Strong-combination anti-ablation high-entropy ceramic coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong-combination anti-ablation high-entropy ceramic coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein TiC, zrC, hfC and TaC are mixed, ball milling, pressing and sintering are carried out to prepare the high-entropy ceramic coating, and TiC, zrC, hfC and TaC have extremely high melting point and thermal stability, and meanwhile, tiC, zrC, hfC and TaC have good compatibility. In particular, the high-entropy ceramic coating is prepared by spark plasma sintering, the period is short, the binding force between the prepared high-entropy ceramic coating and a carbon matrix is very strong, and the problems of large difference between interface compatibility and thermal expansion coefficient and the like are hopeful to be thoroughly solved.

title_en: Conductive material paste for secondary battery electrode, secondary battery electrode comprising same, and secondary battery
abstract_en: Provided is a conductive material paste for secondary battery electrodes, which has low viscosity and low surface resistance. The conductive material paste for a secondary battery electrode according to the present invention contains a conductive material and a dispersant for dispersing the conductive material, wherein the dispersant contains a cellulose compound and a conductive polymer, and the content of the conductive material is 0wt% or more and 2.5 wt% or less based on the total weight of the conductive material paste for a secondary battery electrode.

title_en: Graphene quantum dot, preparation method, glyphosate detection method and detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a graphene quantum dot, a preparation method, a glyphosate detection method and a detection device. The graphene quantum dots have two emission wavelengths of 425nm and 525nm, and the naked eyes can primarily identify the concentration range of the glyphosate based on the colors of light rays of the graphene quantum dots. The intensities of the 425nm and 525nm emitted lights are changed in synchronization with the intensity of the excitation light, so that the intensity ratio between the 425nm and 525nm lights is hardly affected by the intensity of the excitation light. In addition, when other impurities exist in the liquid to be detected, the intensity ratio between 425nm and 525nm light rays is hardly influenced, and the intensity ratio between 425nm and 525nm light rays is hardly influenced by the concentration of the glyphosate, so that the graphene quantum dot can allow quantitative concentration detection of the glyphosate by adopting a bimodal intensity ratio method, and a more accurate concentration value of the glyphosate is obtained.

title_en: Induction heating system for preparing dental glass ceramic and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an induction heating system for preparing dental glass ceramic and application thereof, wherein the induction heating system comprises a furnace body, an intermediate frequency induction heating device, an optional stirring device, a conductive crucible, an atmosphere control device, a vacuum device and a control system; the furnace body is provided with an inner layer cavity and a heating interlayer, and the conductive crucible is arranged in the inner layer cavity; the intermediate frequency induction coil of the intermediate frequency induction heating device is arranged in the heating interlayer; the stirring body of the optional stirring device is arranged in the conductive crucible. According to the induction heating system, impurities are prevented from entering through vacuumizing or introducing different atmospheres, the frequency and the power of the medium-frequency induction coil are accurately controlled, high current is generated through frequency conversion to form a strong magnetic field, and induction heating is performed on materials in the conductive crucible and the conductive boiler, so that the effects of uniformly heating and stirring molten materials are achieved. The system does not use a platinum crucible, saves smelting time and cost, and provides a reliable and efficient induction heating system for preparing dental restorations.

title_en: Method for regulating type and size of carbide in steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating and controlling carbide type and size in steel, which comprises the steps of optimizing alloy components, rolling and heat treatment. According to the invention, through optimizing 40CrN i2S i2MoVA steel alloy components and combining a heat treatment process, the carbide type and the size in 40CrN i2S i2MoVA steel are regulated and controlled, the mechanical property of 40CrN i2S i2MoVA steel is obviously improved, and a beneficial guide is provided for the research and development of ultra-high strength steel. By adopting the method, the carbide in the matrix is only M  6  C, the size is 50-120 nm, the strength can reach 2000-2230MP, the elongation is 7.8-8.0%, and the original austenite grain size is 7.2-8.5 mu M.

title_en: Synthesis method of ammonia-resistant proton conductor material of direct ammonia fuel cell
abstract_en: The application provides a synthesis method of an ammonia-resistant proton conductor material of a direct ammonia fuel cell, which comprises the following steps of firstly selecting a proton conductor material, weighing metal salt containing corresponding metal elements according to the molar ratio of metal cations in the proton conductor material, mixing the metal salt with an energetic solvent to obtain a mixed solution, secondly heating and stirring the mixed solution in an ultrasonic environment, adjusting the pH value of the solution until the metal salt is fully dissolved to obtain a clear mixed precursor solution, thirdly, carrying out heat preservation treatment on the clear mixed precursor solution, generating a precursor droplet group through an aerosol generator, fully mixing the precursor droplet group with carrier gas to form precursor aerosol, and fourthly, introducing the precursor aerosol into an ammonia-containing flame field for reaction to obtain the novel ammonia-resistant proton conductor material. The synthesis method has the advantages of continuous process, simple and effective method, accurate and controllable process, strong ammonia resistance of the product, stable quality and easy realization of large-scale synthesis.

title_en: Carbon composite ferric sodium sulfate positive electrode material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of battery material preparation, and particularly relates to a carbon composite sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises (1) mixing and sanding a carbon source, a sodium source, an iron source and a dispersing agent to obtain slurry; wherein the median particle diameter of the slurry is 220-450nm; (2) The slurry is subjected to solid-liquid separation after suction filtration or filter pressing to obtain a precursor; (3) sintering the precursor. According to the method, wet mixing, suction filtration or filter pressing are combined, the particle size of the slurry after sanding is controlled, and when the carbon composite sodium ferric sulfate positive electrode material is prepared, the raw materials are uniformly mixed, the problems of loosening and the like do not occur, so that the prepared carbon composite sodium ferric sulfate positive electrode material has high compaction density. When the method is used for preparing the carbon composite ferric sodium sulfate positive electrode material, the particle size of primary particles can be thinned by controlling the fineness of slurry after sanding, the reactivity of raw materials is improved, and the obtained ferric sodium sulfate positive electrode material has high phase purity.

title_en: Riser production system and riser production process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of riser production, in particular to a riser production system and process, comprising drying equipment, a vacuum settling tank, vacuum equipment, stirring equipment and a mounting frame, wherein the bottom end of the mounting frame is slidably provided with a control board, the bottom end of the control board is provided with a riser mold, a communicating pipe is used for conducting the vacuum settling tank and the riser mold, a pneumatic cylinder, the setting is on the top of mounting bracket to be connected with the riser mould for control the upward movement or the downward movement of riser mould, rotate the subassembly, set up in the inside of control panel, be used for controlling the riser mould and rotate, the screed sets up in one side of riser mould, and the screed sets up to the L type, through foretell structure cooperation, can effectually improve the quality of riser production.

title_en: Preparation method of reinforced aluminum bismuth alloy doped with surface copper-plated graphene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a reinforced aluminum bismuth alloy doped with surface copper-plated graphene, and belongs to the technical field of new materials. According to the invention, ethanol and graphene are subjected to ultrasonic stirring and dispersion to obtain graphene suspension, copper nitrate, glucose solution and sodium hydroxide solution are respectively added, and stirring reaction is carried out to obtain surface copper plating graphene powder; mixing and dispersing flaky aluminum powder, bismuth powder and deionized water to obtain an aluminum-bismuth suspension, adding surface copper-plated graphene powder into the aluminum-bismuth suspension, stirring, vacuum drying at the temperature of minus 30 ℃ to minus 15 ℃, and grinding to obtain composite mixed powder; and pressing the composite mixed powder by using a press to obtain a sample block, and adopting plasma sintering to obtain the reinforced aluminum bismuth alloy doped with the surface copper-plated graphene. The graphene plated on the surface is introduced into the aluminum-bismuth alloy, and the friction and wear properties of the aluminum-bismuth alloy are achieved; meanwhile, the alloy is used for photocatalytic degradation of methyl orange, tetracycline antibiotic pollutants and the like, and the degradation rate is improved.

title_en: Die casting and injection molding feeding system of multi-material integrated forming equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a die-casting and injection molding feeding system of multi-material integrated forming equipment, which integrates two feeding systems of die-casting and injection molding, and can complete the die-casting and injection molding process by using the same equipment. Compared with the procedures and equipment which are commonly adopted in the prior art and are carried out by stages of die casting and injection molding, the invention can obviously improve the production efficiency and reduce the production, equipment use and maintenance cost, and is more beneficial to the high-quality large-scale production of large complex parts if the forming equipment with the multidirectional die assembly function is combined.

title_en: Method for reducing content of elemental zinc in zinc oxide smoke dust by fuming furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the content of elemental zinc in zinc oxide smoke dust by a fuming furnace, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgy. The method comprises the following steps: adding zinc-rich slag into a fuming furnace, spraying pulverized coal and process air into the fuming furnace for fuming and blowing, supplementing reburning air in the region of 250-650 ℃ of the rising section of a boiler of the fuming furnace, fuming and blowing to obtain dust-containing flue gas and fuming slag, intermittently discharging slag, and cooling the dust-containing flue gas to obtain zinc oxide smoke dust and flue gas. The invention can reduce the content of simple substance zinc in the zinc oxide smoke dust, can effectively inhibit the ignition probability in the storage process, and avoid the damage to the field operation environment caused by ignition and the influence on the occupational health and safety of operators; effectively improving the production process index of the zinc system; the intrinsic safety of zinc system production is effectively improved; effectively reduces the metal content of waste slag and is beneficial to the improvement of the metal recovery amount.

title_en: Lithium aluminum silicon ultrathin glass and forming process and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass material forming, in particular to lithium aluminum silicon ultrathin glass and a forming process and a forming device thereof. The forming process of the lithium aluminum silicon ultrathin glass comprises the following steps of: preliminary molding molten glass liquid by adopting an overflow method to obtain a glass substrate; drawing and overflow calendaring are carried out on the glass substrate to obtain a glass ribbon with the thickness of 1-2 mm; and (3) carrying out horizontal rolling treatment, crystallization treatment and annealing treatment by adopting a horizontal rolling method when the temperature of the glass ribbon is more than or equal to 950 ℃ to obtain the lithium aluminum silicon ultrathin glass. The invention adopts a forming process combining an overflow method and a horizontal calendaring method, and further controls the thickness of the glass ribbon and the temperature of the glass ribbon during the turning of the overflow calendaring process, thereby realizing one-step forming and crystallization of the lithium aluminum silicon ultra-thin glass, solving the problems that the forming of the lithium aluminum silicon ultra-thin glass is difficult and the thickness of the glass is difficult to control, further improving the yield of the lithium aluminum silicon ultra-thin glass and obviously improving the performance of the product.

title_en: Carbon dioxide generating device capable of controlling generating rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon dioxide generating device capable of controlling a generating rate, which belongs to the technical field of carbon dioxide generating devices and comprises a shell, wherein a one-way door is arranged on the shell, a carrying plate is fixedly connected to the shell close to the one-way door, a first hydraulic rod is fixedly connected to the upper top wall in the shell, a transfer mechanism is fixedly connected to the lower end of the first hydraulic rod, a second limiting frame is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the shell, a plurality of reaction tanks are connected between the second limiting frames in a sliding manner, and an adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected to the inner bottom of the shell. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the carrying plate, the transfer mechanism, the regulating mechanism and the reaction tank, calcium carbonate and hydrochloric acid can be separated in the middle of reaction to stop the reaction, and meanwhile, the reaction tank is convenient to put in and take out, so that the separation of subsequent products is facilitated.

title_en: Preparation method of lithium titanate material, lithium titanate material and lithium battery
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a lithium titanate material, the lithium titanate material and a lithium battery, wherein the preparation method of the lithium titanate material comprises the following steps: providing a first mixture comprising a lithium source, a titanium source, and polyaniline; grinding the first mixture to obtain a precursor; and calcining the precursor to obtain the lithium titanate material, wherein the prepared lithium titanate material has higher electronic conductivity and specific capacity compared with lithium titanate, so that the lithium titanate material has better electrochemical performance; the lithium battery comprises the lithium titanate material prepared by the preparation method of the lithium titanate material or the lithium titanate material, and has the advantages of good capacity, ideal circulation stability and high safety, and the primary discharge capacity is more than 170mAh/g under the condition of 0.5C of power buckling.

title_en: Powder and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a powder containing zirconia as a main component and at least a transition metal element, a method for producing the same, and at least one of a calcined body, a sintered body and a method for producing the same, which are obtained from the powder, and can obtain a calcined body having mechanical characteristics more suitable for processing the calcined body. A zirconia powder comprising a stabilizing element and a transition metal element, wherein the difference between the minimum value and the maximum value of the transition metal element/zirconium in the frequency distribution of the element ratio obtained by plotting the transition metal element/zirconium at 0.005 intervals is less than 0.25.

title_en: Ti-Al-Zr-Ni powder modified laser melting Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing, and discloses a Ti-Al-Zr-Ni powder modified laser melting Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy and a preparation method thereof. The Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy has high content of elements, wide solidification temperature interval, poor welding performance, and high residual stress generated by solidification shrinkage due to high thermal gradient and cooling rate in the forming process, and columnar grains and hot cracks are extremely easy to form. Adding Ti-Al-Zr-Ni alloy powder into the Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy powder to prepare mixed powder. Drying and selective laser melting to obtain a formed piece, and then performing heat treatment to prepare the high-strength aluminum alloy with the tensile strength of more than 500MPa and the elongation of more than 10%. The introduced Ti, zr and Ni elements have the effect of grain refinement, the grain size is smaller than 1 mu m, and the problem of hot cracking of the Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy by selective laser melting is solved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity anhydrous rare earth iodide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-purity anhydrous rare earth iodide, belonging to the technical field of chemical intermediate preparation. Firstly, adding hydriodic acid into rare earth oxide to make low-temperature reaction, then adding trimethylamine, continuously making low-temperature reaction, removing water and heating treatment so as to obtain the invented high-purity anhydrous rare earth iodide. The yield of the high-purity anhydrous rare earth iodide prepared by the method can reach 71.5-90.07%, and the purity can reach 99.9%. The method is safe, simple, low in power consumption, environment-friendly, relatively cheap in raw materials and suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Efficient catalyst for preparing hydrogen by reforming methanol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency catalyst for preparing hydrogen by reforming methanol and a preparation method thereof, wherein the active component of the catalyst is copper oxide, the first promoter is zinc oxide, the second promoter is chromium oxide, the third promoter is aluminum oxide, and the catalyst is prepared by the following steps: step S1, weighing a proper amount of copper oxide, zinc oxide, chromium oxide and aluminum oxide, dissolving the proper amount of copper oxide, zinc oxide, chromium oxide and aluminum oxide in a proper amount of distilled water, stirring the mixed solution by a stirrer for 5-8 minutes, wherein the rotating speed of the stirrer is set to be 200r/min, slowly dripping the mixed solution in the step S1 into a proper amount of supersaturated Na2CO3 solution, continuously stirring the mixed solution by the stirrer in the dripping process, and setting the rotating speed of the stirrer to be 40r/min, and standing the mixed solution after the dripping is completed. The high-efficiency catalyst for preparing hydrogen by reforming methanol and the preparation method thereof have simple production process and higher product activity and stability.

title_en: Bearing pedestal casting mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing seat casting mold, which comprises a mold bottom plate, wherein a mold cover plate is assembled at the top end of the mold bottom plate, a mold accommodating box is arranged in the mold bottom plate, supporting grooves are formed in both ends of the bottom of the mold cover plate, supporting plates are connected in a sliding manner in the supporting grooves, hinging blocks are fixed on both sides of the bottom end of the supporting plates, connecting blocks are connected in a rotating manner on the inner sides of the hinging blocks, a threaded sliding block is connected in a rotating manner at one end, far away from the supporting plates, of the connecting blocks, the bottom end of the threaded sliding block is connected with the mold bottom plate in a sliding manner, and driving mechanisms for driving the supporting plates to lift are arranged at both ends in the mold cover plate. According to the invention, the driving mechanism is started to drive the two threaded sliders to move in the direction of approaching each other, so that the threaded sliders and the die cover plate stably slide, the threaded sliders drive the connecting blocks to extrude the supporting plates, and the supporting plates jack up the supporting grooves and the die cover plate, so that the die cover plate is conveniently opened.

title_en: Black liquor based biochar, black liquor based biochar loaded Fe3O4Aerobic granular sludge prepared from same and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and particularly relates to black liquor-based biochar, black liquor-based biochar-supported Fe  3 O 4 , aerobic granular sludge prepared from the same and application of the aerobic granular sludge. The invention adopts eucalyptus sulfate pulping black liquor as raw material to prepare black liquor-based biochar, loads Fe  3 O 4  with the black liquor-based biochar, and forms aerobic granular sludge by using the black liquor-based biochar and the loaded Fe  3 O 4 . The method effectively improves the granulation process of the sludge, obviously shortens the formation time of aerobic granular sludge, obviously improves the concentration, precipitation performance, extracellular Polymer (EPS) content and particle size of the sludge, and shows excellent treatment efficiency, structure and performance stability in the wastewater treatment process.

title_en: Method for rapidly eliminating strip steel indentation in continuous annealing line vertical annealing furnace
abstract_en: A method for rapidly eliminating strip steel indentation in a continuous annealing line vertical annealing furnace comprises the following steps: step one: measuring the period of the indentation by using a box ruler at an annealing furnace outlet inspection table when the indentation occurs; step two: after determining the area in the indentation generating furnace, adjusting parameters in the furnace; step three: sequentially adjusting deviation correcting rollers in an area in an indentation generating furnace and in a previous area according to the running direction of the strip steel, and separating bulges on the furnace roller, which cause the indentation, from the furnace roller through multiple deviations of the strip steel; step four: and (3) observing whether the indentation on the strip steel is eliminated or not through the outlet, and if not, continuing the operation of the step three until the indentation is eliminated. The invention can utilize the transverse displacement between the deviation correcting roller and the strip steel, thereby driving the strip steel of the furnace roller generating the foreign matters to generate the deviation, forming the friction force between the strip steel and the furnace roller, removing the foreign matters attached to the furnace roller under the drive of the higher moving speed of the strip steel, and ensuring the surface quality of the strip steel.

title_en: Hard carbon negative electrode material with customized pore structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sodium battery cathodes, and in particular discloses a hard carbon cathode material with a customized pore structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein biomass carbon sources are pre-crushed, and materials with target granularity are screened in a grading manner; mixing the material with carbonate to make the carbonate inlaid in the material, using the product of the previous step as a framework material at the temperature of T  1 , adopting a carbon material to coat the surface of the framework material to obtain a core-shell structure, performing medium-temperature heat treatment on the core-shell structure obtained in the previous step at the temperature of T  2 , performing high-temperature heat treatment on the product of the previous step at the temperature of T  3 , and screening, wherein the temperature is T  3 ＞T 2 ＞T 1 . The preparation method provided by the invention can realize the gradient design of the hard carbon anode material from small pore diameter to large pore diameter from the core to the shell, ensure the smooth of a sodium ion conveying channel, and the obtained product has rich sodium storage sites, thereby being beneficial to improving the specific capacity of a sodium battery.

title_en: Quartz pellet for silicon alloy production and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quartz pellet for silicon alloy production, which comprises more than 96% of SiO ₂, less than 0.8% of Al ₂ O ₃ and less than 0.8% of Fe ₂ O ₃ by weight percent. The quartz pellets are approximately spherical in shape, when the quartz pellets are used for producing silicon-based alloy, the quartz pellets and carbonaceous reducing agent fall from a material pipe freely and enter the ore-smelting furnace burden surface, the large spheres are quartz pellets, the small spheres are carbonaceous reducing agent pellets, the large spheres are tightly filled, the distribution is uniform, deflagration and explosion cannot occur below the furnace temperature of 1700 ℃, the quartz pellets have the characteristics of high reducibility, high antiknock property, high specific surface area, high porosity in the pellets, low reduction initial temperature, energy conservation, environmental protection and the like, the reducing atmosphere is good, a large amount of reducing gas can enter the pores in the pellets to carry out microcirculation reaction, no ignition phenomenon exists, and the heat energy conduction efficiency is high.

title_en: Method for rapidly preparing high-thermal-stability silicon-zirconium binary aerogel under normal-pressure drying condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly preparing high-thermal-stability silicon-zirconium binary aerogel under a normal-pressure drying condition, and belongs to the technical field of aerogels. Mixing a silicon source, an organosilane modifier and ethanol, and then adding water and an acid catalyst for hydrolysis to obtain a solution A; mixing a zirconium source, water and ethanol, and then hydrolyzing to obtain a solution B; mixing the solution A and the solution B to obtain a modified silicon zirconium precursor sol; then adding an alkali catalyst to coarsen the gel skeleton, standing until the gel reaction is complete, and drying to obtain the silicon-zirconium binary aerogel with high thermal stability. The invention creatively combines the novel process for preparing aerogel by modifying by a co-precursor method and combining the strength of the framework enhanced by the alkali catalyst by normal pressure drying, and achieves the effects of reducing capillary force and ensuring that the structural morphology is not destroyed during rapid drying. The method eliminates the complicated aging stage of solvent exchange and hydrophobic modification, greatly shortens the preparation time of conventional normal-pressure drying, and only takes 8.5 hours at maximum.

title_en: Method for preparing concrete antifreezing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concrete antifreezing agent manufacturing method, which relates to the technical field of concrete antifreezing agent manufacturing, and comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing raw materials according to a proportion; crushing the recycled aerated concrete aggregate. The method for manufacturing the concrete antifreezing agent is applied to the stirring processing of concrete, and can solve the problems that the quality of the traditional air entraining agent is uneven, the air content in the stirring construction process is not easy to control, the concrete has the antifreezing and antifreezing performances, the recycled aerated concrete building solid waste is recycled, the product is environment-friendly, the building quality and normal use are not influenced, the phenomena of soft material and water-powder-contacting of the recycled aerated concrete aggregate are overcome by modifying the recycled aerated concrete aggregate, only the micro air bubbles in the traditional antifreezing concrete are replaced by the micro air bubbles generated by adding the air entraining agent in the form of micro solid, the antifreezing durability of the traditional antifreezing concrete is improved, and the problem of poor antifreezing performance of the traditional antifreezing concrete is solved.

title_en: Production process and preparation method of Ce-containing thick-wall hot-rolled S275J0 steel pile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production method of a steel pile of a deep foundation pit steel support system, in particular to a production process and a preparation method of a Ce-containing thick-wall hot-rolled S275J0 steel pile. The Ce-containing thick-wall hot-rolled S275J0 steel pile comprises ：C：0.12%-0.16%,Si：0.15%-0.30%,Mn：0.90%-1.05%,P≤0.025%,S≤0.025%,N：0.004%-0.008%,Ce：0.0015%-0.0055%,Al＞0.015%, parts by mass of Fe and unavoidable impurities. The reasonable matching of strength and impact toughness can be achieved only by adding Ce and Al elements into steel without adding other common alloy elements such as V, ti, nb and the like, and the theoretical calculation and the determination of the steel slag components show that the addition of the Ce and Al elements into the steel improves the utilization rate of silicon and manganese in molten steel, and simultaneously, the molten steel and modified inclusions are purified, so that the aims of improving the mechanical property and reducing the production cost are achieved.

title_en: Low-cement-doped fluid-state solidified soil capable of utilizing waste to reduce carbon and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low cement mixing amount fluid state solidified soil utilizing waste to reduce carbon and a preparation method thereof. The fluid solidified soil comprises the following components: 100-110 parts of fine soil, 10-13 parts of cement, 2-5 parts of fly ash, 0.5-1 part of semi-hydrated gypsum, 0.5-2 parts of polyurethane, 0-0.5 part of water reducer and 35-45 parts of water. The fine-grained soil and cement are mixed according to the weight ratio of 9-10: 1. the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, determining the proportion of the fluid solidified soil according to the requirements of fluidity, slump and strength required by engineering; s2, pre-weighing polyurethane and semi-hydrated gypsum according to the proportion, and mixing to obtain a mixture A; s3, obtaining a mixture B; s4, adding water and uniformly mixing to form fluid solidified soil; s5, pumping the fluid solidified soil to an application area. The invention obviously reduces the consumption of cement, realizes the recycling of waste and the purpose of reducing carbon, and can further enhance the cementing acting force among soil particles and improve the compressive strength in the subsequent curing period.

title_en: Magnesium-based composite hydrogen storage material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid hydrogen storage materials, in particular to a magnesium-based composite hydrogen storage material and preparation and application thereof. The magnesium-based composite hydrogen storage material comprises molybdenum disulfide, magnesium and cobalt; wherein, in the magnesium-based composite hydrogen storage material, the mass fraction of molybdenum disulfide is 70-90%, the mass fraction of magnesium is 5-15%, and the rest is cobalt. In the invention, molybdenum disulfide is used as a grinding aid, cobalt is used as a catalytic active ingredient, and the hydrogen storage performance of magnesium is synergistically improved. In the catalytic process, the existence of molybdenum disulfide provides a carrier for cobalt, and the cobalt improves the hydrogen absorption performance of the molybdenum disulfide, so that the molybdenum disulfide is easier to capture hydrogen molecules, and a composite hydrogen storage material with excellent hydrogen release performance is obtained.

title_en: High-strength clay aerogel heat insulation material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat preservation and heat insulation, and discloses a high-strength clay aerogel heat insulation material and a preparation method thereof, wherein a polyvinyl alcohol solution and a chitosan solution are mixed to obtain a mixed solution, then clay and a coupling agent are added, and clay slurry is obtained after uniform stirring and mixing; transferring the clay slurry into a container, and freeze-drying to obtain the high-strength clay aerogel. In the invention, the blending of the polyvinyl alcohol and the chitosan adjusts the microstructure of the aerogel, forms a closed pore canal and a closed surface, is beneficial to blocking air convection and reducing the thermal conductivity; meanwhile, the double organic components improve the processability of the aerogel; the clay and chitosan form chemical crosslinking through the coupling agent, so that the compression strength and compression modulus of the aerogel are improved; the aerogel heat insulation material obtained by the invention has good heat insulation performance and excellent strength.

title_en: Anti-slip and anti-fouling ceramic tile and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-slip and anti-fouling ceramic tile and a production process thereof, which relate to the technical field of ceramic tile preparation, wherein a pretreated base material is soaked in composite sol for dipping and pulling, dried and sintered, and finally soaked in heptadecafluorodecyl trimethoxy silane solution to prepare the anti-slip and anti-fouling ceramic tile, after the pretreated base material is soaked and pulled in the composite sol, a glaze is formed on the surface during sintering, but cyclodextrin is carbonized and falls off due to the existence of cyclodextrin, the glaze on the surface generates tiny holes, the roughness of the surface of the ceramic tile can be increased due to the existence of the holes, the anti-slip effect of the ceramic tile is further improved, the ceramic tile is finally soaked in heptadecafluorodecyl trimethoxy silane solution, under the action of deionized water, siloxane on the heptadecafluorodecyl trimethoxy silane can be hydrolyzed and grafted with hydroxyl on the surface of the glaze, and meanwhile, the siloxane enters the holes on the surface to form a long-chain fluorocarbon film, so that the surface energy can be reduced, and the adsorption of stains can be avoided.

title_en: Auto-parts die casting make-up machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of die-casting forming, in particular to an automobile fitting die-casting forming machine which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a pressing assembly is arranged above the bottom plate, driving assemblies are arranged at two ends of the bottom plate, and a forming die assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate; the molding die assembly comprises a fixed die and a movable die, the fixed die is fixed on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the movable die is arranged on the driving assembly, and the side wall of the movable die is also provided with a pushing assembly; the upper surface of the bottom plate is also provided with a spraying component which is arranged at one side of the fixed mould; a material ejection assembly is arranged below the bottom plate; this auto-parts die-casting make-up machine for link up between step and the step more closely, orderly the execution, and in auto-parts blank unloading in-process, can realize the spraying of release agent, with spraying drawing of patterns step orderly cuttage to the assembly line in, need not to take the time of spraying drawing of patterns step to count into whole production link in, improve die-casting production efficiency.

title_en: Environment-friendly gypsum toner and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, and provides environment-friendly gypsum toner as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The environment-friendly gypsum toner comprises, by weight, 55-65 parts of gypsum powder and 35-45 parts of dye mixed solution, wherein the dye mixed solution comprises, by mass, 55-60% of water, 25-35% of high-molecular dye, 8-12% of aqueous emulsion, 0.5-2% of dispersing agent and 0.1-1% of defoamer. The environment-friendly gypsum powder prepared by the method is rich in color, uniform in color, free of bleeding, free of heavy metal and other harmful substances, environment-friendly, and capable of being widely used in building decorative coatings, gypsum artware and the like.

title_en: Method for improving field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting material and treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting material
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials and the treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials, and belongs to the field of high-temperature superconducting materials. The method comprises the steps of carrying out twice irradiation on REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials by utilizing a fast heavy ion beam, and changing the incidence angle of the fast heavy ions in the twice irradiation, so that columnar defects which are distributed in a crossing way are introduced into REBCO, the movement of vortex kinks is restrained, and the field lossless current carrying capacity of the REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of silica powder slurry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of silicon materials, in particular to a preparation method of silicon powder slurry. The invention adds the dried silicon powder, the additive and the solvent 1 into a sand mill for sand mill dispersion to obtain slurry, and then adds the slurry into a double planetary mixer for dispersion and stirring to obtain stirring slurry. The colloid can be pre-dissolved before stirring, so that the time is saved. After the slurry is dispersed and stirred, the ultrasonic disperser is put into a double planetary stirrer, after ultrasonic dispersion, the pre-dissolved colloid and the class II plasticizer are added for stirring, and after the stirring is finished, vacuum defoamation is directly started without slurry transfer. The preparation time of the silicon powder slurry prepared by adopting the double-planetary stirring machine can be shortened to 7 hours, the efficiency is obviously improved, the slurry is not required to be transferred to other equipment, the problems of loss, skinning and the like are avoided, and the quality of the slurry is ensured.

title_en: Multifunctional auxiliary agent modified composite catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional auxiliary agent modified composite catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is an M1-MgAlM M3 catalyst and comprises a first metal auxiliary agent M1, mg, al, a second metal auxiliary agent M2 and a semiconductor auxiliary agent M3, and the catalyst comprises, by mass, 0.1-10wt% of M1, 5-40wt% of Mg element, 5-40wt% of Al element, 0-20wt% of M2 and 0-50wt% of M3. The preparation method has the advantages of simplicity, mild condition, high reaction controllability, low cost, high preparation efficiency and capability of realizing large-scale production, and the preparation method has excellent comprehensive catalytic performance when being applied to photo-thermal catalysis of methane dry reforming reaction, has the capability of efficiently activating CO  2 、CH 4  under the photo-thermal condition, can stably generate synthesis gas for 120 hours, and has good stability and difficult inactivation.

title_en: Optical glass and optical element
abstract_en: The invention provides optical glass, which comprises ：P 2 O 5 ：20～34％;Nb 2 O 5 ：38～53％;TiO 2 ：8～22％;Na 2 O：1～12％;BaO：0～8％, parts by weight (Nb  2 O 5 +Na 2 O+BaO)/TiO 2  is 1.8-5.5. Through reasonable component design, the optical glass has higher bubble degree and streak degree grade, and meets the application of high-performance optical instruments.

title_en: Ferric oxide nanorod and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ferric oxide nano rod, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photocatalytic materials. The preparation method of the ferric oxide nano rod provided by the invention comprises the following steps: taking water as a solvent, adding a nonionic surfactant and an iron source, stirring uniformly, taking the nonionic surfactant as a template under the hydrothermal condition at 110-130 ℃, dissolving and recrystallizing the iron source to form ferric hydroxide, and then carrying out solid phase conversion on the ferric hydroxide to obtain the ferric oxide nanorod. The operation method is simple, and the prepared ferric oxide nanorod has excellent photocatalytic performance.

title_en: Wood grain rock plate glass manufacturing device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass manufacturing, in particular to a wood grain rock plate glass manufacturing device and a control method thereof, comprising a device main body and a main sliding rail arranged on the device main body, wherein the outer wall of the main sliding rail is connected with a sliding part in a sliding way, the top of slider is provided with spraying device, rectangular channel I has all been seted up on two outer walls of slider inboard, two rectangular channels II have been seted up to slider's inside, rectangular channel II's inside and rectangular channel I communicate each other. The spraying device is born to the slider and is shifted along the outer wall of main slide rail, and the post gear rotates along with the slider displacement, and synchronous drive each tooth piece one produces the displacement and promotes the tooth piece two in each filling component in proper order, and lubricating oil can be automatic extrude near ball two, reaches the purpose of automatic lubrication main slide rail and slider contact surface, replaces the manual work, and the setting of stress subassembly makes the conflict board can be dismantled by the efficient, does benefit to subsequent replacement or repair.

title_en: Modified lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of battery materials, and particularly relates to a modified lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) mixing cobaltosic oxide with lithium salt according to the mole ratio of Co in cobaltosic oxide to Li in lithium salt of 1:1.05 to obtain a mixture, (2) calcining the mixture to obtain a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, (3) mixing the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material with aluminum triethoxide according to the mole ratio of Co in aluminum triethoxide of 1 (gamma multiplied by delta) in the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, calcining to obtain aluminum oxide coated lithium cobalt oxide, and (4) mixing the aluminum oxide coated lithium cobalt oxide with a lithium source, a titanium source and a phosphorus source according to the mole ratio of Al in lithium cobalt oxide to Li in lithium source to Ti in phosphorus source to P in phosphorus source to delta (1+delta) to (2-delta) 3, and calcining to obtain the modified lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material. The modified lithium cobalt oxide anode material prepared by the invention remarkably improves the cycle performance of the battery.

title_en: Curing agent modified concrete in concrete
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of concrete materials, and particularly relates to a modified concrete of an internal curing agent of concrete. The preparation method of the internal curing agent comprises the following steps: (1) preparing hollow nano silica particles; (2) preparing an aramid nanofiber dispersion; (3) Sequentially adding hollow nano silicon dioxide particles and deionized water into the aramid nanofiber dispersion liquid to obtain a mixed solution; (4) And (5) carrying out steam bath treatment and freeze drying to obtain the concrete internal curing agent. The hollow nano silicon dioxide particle modified aramid nanofiber gel is used as the internal curing agent of the concrete, so that the volume shrinkage of the internal curing agent after water release can be restrained, and the strength and durability of the concrete are improved. The steam of the protonated solvent can protonate the aramid nanofibers in the solution, the gel preparation process is simple and efficient, and the complex crosslinking process in the traditional method for directly preparing the gel compound is avoided.

title_en: High-strength plastic TC4 alloy wire prepared through texture regulation and structure refinement and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength plastic TC4 alloy wire prepared by texture regulation and structure refinement and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, putting mixed metal particles into a vacuum arc furnace, and smelting in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain an ingot with the initial state phi of 12.0 mm; the mixed metal particles are formed by mixing the following metal simple substance particles in percentage by mass: 5.50 to 6.75 percent of Al, 3.50 to 4.50 percent of V, 0.15 to 0.35 percent of Fe and the balance of Ti; step 2, cogging, forging and rolling the cast ingot in sequence to obtain a hot rolled blank; and 3, after the hot rolled blank is peeled and subjected to flaw detection, the wire with phi 4.0mm is hot-stretched, and the deformation is 0.89, so that the high-strength plastic TC4 alloy wire is obtained. The TC4 alloy wire prepared by texture regulation and structure refinement of the invention presents a nearly equiaxial uniform structure and has excellent comprehensive mechanical properties.

title_en: Powder metallurgy precipitation strengthening cobalt-based superalloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powder metallurgy precipitation strengthening cobalt-based superalloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein reduced Co powder, atomized spherical Co powder, al powder, ni powder, ti powder, W powder, ta powder and Nb powder are mixed to obtain mixed powder, the mixed powder is pressed and molded to obtain a pressed compact, the pressed compact is sintered to obtain a sintered body, and the sintered body is subjected to heat treatment to obtain the cobalt-based superalloy; according to the invention, the cobalt-based superalloy is prepared by adopting a powder metallurgy method, and the raw material Co powder adopts two types of reduced Co powder and atomized spherical Co powder, wherein the reduced Co powder is used as a main body of cold-pressing plastic deformation, and the atomized spherical Co powder has a certain stirring effect in the powder mixing process, and on the other hand, the melting point of the atomized spherical Co powder is higher than that of the reduced Co powder, so that the melting point of the alloy can be improved, and the high-temperature performance of the cobalt-based superalloy is improved.

title_en: Crystallizer liquid level control system with disturbance observer and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystallizer liquid level control system with a disturbance observer and a control method. The two-degree-of-freedom crystallizer liquid level control system formed by combining the PID controller with the set disturbance observer is formed, and the system completes the setting under the constraint of the robustness and stability of the system. The corresponding control method completes the suppressed feedback of the uncertainty disturbance of the system by solving the plug rod adjustment quantity calculated based on the PID controller and the compensation quantity calculated based on the disturbance observer observation gain regulator in each sampling period of the system. The crystallizer liquid level control system with the disturbance observer and the control method thereof have ingenious design as a whole, strong anti-interference capability, small fluctuation and strong practicability.

title_en: Partition additive manufacturing method for complex thin-wall structure of bearing and high-temperature resistant heterogeneous material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing, and provides a partition additive manufacturing method for a complex thin-wall structure of a bearing high-temperature-resistant heterogeneous material, which comprises the following steps: dividing structural areas: dividing the structure into a bearing area and a high-temperature area according to the actual use scene of the complex thin-wall structure; partition material selection: selecting high-strength titanium alloy as a structural material of a bearing area, and selecting high-temperature resistant refractory high-entropy alloy as a heat-resistant material of a high-temperature area; selecting an additive process: manufacturing a titanium alloy bearing area by adopting an SLM according to the structural complexity and the additive process characteristics, and manufacturing a refractory high-entropy alloy high-temperature area by adopting an LMD; and (3) a structure forming step: based on region division, material selection and material adding process selection, an SLM and LMD process is adopted to cooperatively print a complex thin-wall structure, and gradient transition is adopted between different materials to realize smooth interface transition. According to the invention, two technology collaborative additive manufacturing technologies are introduced in the additive manufacturing of the complex thin-wall structure carrying the high-temperature resistant heterogeneous material, the high-temperature resistance of a high-temperature area is improved on the premise of ensuring the bearing capacity of a main body, and a solution way for manufacturing the complex thin-wall structure of the heterogeneous material is provided.

title_en: Pre-water-adding balling equipment of cement clinker calcining kiln
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cement clinker calcining kiln pre-water adding and ball forming device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a discharging assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a stirring assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the discharging assembly, and a water spraying assembly and a collecting assembly are respectively arranged at the top of the bottom plate; the invention relates to the technical field of cement clinker calcining kilns, in particular to a discharging assembly, which comprises a fixed rod and a rotating plate, wherein the fixed rod is fixedly arranged at the top of a bottom plate; according to the cement clinker calcining kiln pre-water adding and balling equipment, the cement balls can be discharged through the arranged discharging component, the discharging is simple and convenient, no residual condition exists after the discharging, the discharging effect is better, the inconvenience of manual discharging is effectively solved, no residual condition exists in the equipment after the discharging is completed, and the excellent appearance without residues is achieved.

title_en: Alumina composite material for injection molding and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of alumina composite materials, in particular to an alumina composite material for injection molding and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite material comprises powder and a binder, wherein the mass ratio of the binder to the powder is (15-19) (81-85); the powder comprises the following components in parts by weight: 96.0-99.9 parts of aluminum oxide, 0.5-2.0 parts of sodium oxide, 0.2-1.0 parts of ferric oxide and 0.3-1.0 parts of calcium oxide/magnesium oxide; the specific surface area of the powder is 6-8m  2 /g; the loose density is 0.8-1.1g/cm  3 ; the viscosity value is 150 Pa.s-350 Pa.s, and the flow value is 100g/10min-250g/10min. The alumina composite material for injection molding provided by the invention can be directly used for thermal de-esterification of injection molded products, the size and structure of the products are not limited, and part of the sizes can be processed.

title_en: Lead brass alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lead brass alloy which comprises Cu, pb and Zn, and is 56.0% -or less than m  Cu ≤59.0％,2.2％≤m Pb % -or less than 3.2%, wherein m  Cu  represents the mass percentage of Cu in the brass alloy, m  Pb  represents the mass percentage of Pb in the brass alloy, the lead brass alloy comprises a matrix phase and a second phase, the matrix phase comprises an alpha phase and a beta phase, the second phase comprises a gamma phase, a Pb phase and an intermetallic compound, the intermetallic compound comprises at least one of FeAlCE, fe  3 B、AlB 2 , feNiB or AlZrEr, the area percentage of the beta phase is 64% -68%, the area percentage of the Pb phase is 0.1% -0.5%, and the area percentage of the intermetallic compound is 0.01% -0.1%. The lead brass alloy provided by the invention has excellent cutting characteristics during machining, avoids the phenomenon of curling foam particles common to traditional materials, ensures that crushed aggregates which are easy to process are produced during drilling, ensures that cut edges are round and uniform, has no problems of broken edges and powder falling, ensures that the surface flatness is below 0.05mm, ensures that the surface hardness fluctuates within 5%, ensures that the length is +/-0.10, ensures that the width is +/-0.10, and ensures that the thickness is +/-0.05, and remarkably improves the production quality and the efficiency of the floor drain.

title_en: In-based2O3Preparation method of nano material and application of nano material in formaldehyde gas sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a formaldehyde gas sensor based on an In  2 O 3  nano material, belonging to the field of metal oxide semiconductor gas sensors. In the design and preparation process of the gas-sensitive material, a simple and efficient hydrothermal method is adopted, and the gas-sensitive material has excellent gas-sensitive performance by changing the temperature of a calcining step in the preparation method. The whole production process has low cost, simple process, good controllability, no toxicity and no harm, and the prepared In  2 O 3  material has high purity, high crystallinity and good dispersibility, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production. The In  2 O 3  nano material prepared by the invention has higher sensitivity, quicker response-recovery characteristic and good selectivity and stability to formaldehyde, so that the material has wide application prospect In the aspect of detecting formaldehyde gas In the environment.

title_en: Sealing powder material for long-life spark plug and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sealing powder material for a long-life spark plug and a preparation method thereof. The powder material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 45-55% of aluminum silicate powder, 8-12% of carbon nano tube, 4-6% of graphene, 18-22% of zirconia powder and 13-17% of silica gel. Wherein the carbon nano tube is a multi-wall carbon nano tube with the tube diameter of 10-20 nm and the length of 1-10 mu m; the grain diameter of the zirconia powder is 100-200 nm; the silica gel is room temperature vulcanized silica gel. The powder material has the characteristics of high strength, high toughness, excellent heat conductivity, high temperature resistance, good formability and the like. By optimizing the component proportion and the preparation process, the material provided by the invention has excellent comprehensive performance under high temperature and high stress environments, and has wide application prospect and remarkable innovation value.

title_en: Method for separating or recovering molybdenum and chromium from molybdenum and chromium-containing samples
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of resource recovery, and discloses a method for separating or recovering molybdenum and chromium from a molybdenum and chromium-containing sample, which comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing the waste salt, the solvent and the coagulant for coagulation pretreatment, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain alkaline clear liquid; (2) absorbing Mo and Cr in the alkaline clear liquid by resin; (3) desorbing the resin to obtain a desorption solution containing Mo and Cr; (4) Adsorbing the desorption solution containing Mo and Cr by using activated carbon to obtain activated carbon produced water containing Cr; (5) Desorbing the adsorbed active carbon to obtain a desorption liquid containing Mo; (6) Optionally, carrying out precipitation treatment on the activated carbon produced water and the desorption liquid containing Mo to obtain a Cr-containing product and a Mo-containing product. The method can separate and recycle chromium and molybdenum from the samples containing molybdenum and chromium with high efficiency and high quality.

title_en: Large single-chamber type metal magnesium vertical tank reduction furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reduction furnaces for producing magnesium metal, in particular to a large single-chamber type magnesium metal vertical tank reduction furnace, wherein a furnace chamber is provided with a plurality of vertical tanks, the top of the furnace chamber is provided with a plurality of rows of vaults along the length direction of the furnace chamber, the plurality of vertical tanks in a closed state are arranged in a matrix, one row of vertical tanks corresponds to the lower part of each row of vaults, two side walls of the furnace chamber in the closed state along the length direction are respectively provided with a heat storage chamber, partition walls are arranged between the adjacent rows of vertical tanks and at one side of the heat storage chamber facing the furnace chamber, the partition walls in the closed state are provided with fire passing holes, one end of the heat storage chamber is communicated with the furnace chamber through an air port, the other end of the heat storage chamber is communicated with the outside of the furnace, the two heat storage chambers are alternately in a heat release state and a heat storage state, two end walls of the furnace chamber in the closed state are provided with a plurality of rows of burners along the width direction, and each row of burners corresponds to the positions of each row of vertical tanks. Through setting up the regenerator at the side wall, set up the nozzle at the end wall to be equipped with the partition wall that has the fire hole, formed large-scale single chamber and erect jar reducing furnace, reduced the energy consumption when promoting output.

title_en: Distribution operation method of sintering mixture
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized sintering mixture distribution operation method, which comprises the steps of carrying out two-stage mixing on sintering iron-containing materials, fuel and flux through a cylinder mixer, detecting and adjusting the moisture value of the mixture at regular time, adjusting the opening value of a main gate of a fan-shaped hopper according to the average thickness of a material layer when the sintering trolley is paved, and timely adjusting the opening value of an auxiliary gate through observing the flatness of the material surface to optimize the distribution of the material layer, recording and setting valve position feedback values of the main gate, the auxiliary gate and a distribution valve when the abnormal condition occurs, quickly recovering the opening values of the main gate and the auxiliary gate when the sintering machine is restarted, and carrying out fine adjustment after the average thickness of the material layer reaches a preset range, thereby ensuring the uniform distribution of heat in the sintering process, reducing the quality problem, improving the integral quality of products, simultaneously responding to the abnormal production in time, reducing the maintenance requirement of equipment, improving the production continuity and stability, and further improving the production efficiency and the product yield.

title_en: Additive manufactured powder with improved physical properties, method of manufacturing the same and use thereof
abstract_en: In additive manufacturing operations, the powders used in the stereolithography process need to be precisely spread out in a uniform manner at each stage of the stereolithography process to ensure predictability of the powder surface morphology. In general, this is difficult to achieve with conventional powders, as these powders often have poor flowability which can further degrade over time and impair the efficiency of the stereolithography process. The present disclosure describes additive manufactured powders having improved physical properties, methods of manufacture thereof, and uses thereof, and in particular, additive manufactured powders having improved physical properties, such as flowability and tap density, that are less or less sensitive to environmental humidity. For example, the present application describes a powder comprising spherical particles having a particle size distribution of less than 1000 microns and having a measurable flowability as determined according to ASTM B213 at 75% relative humidity.

title_en: Preparation method of continuous flow ultraviolet light chemical reaction quartz glass chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a continuous flow ultraviolet chemical reaction quartz glass chip, which comprises the following steps: performing direct writing modification on the surface of the quartz glass by using femtosecond laser, and processing a micro-channel modification area on the surface of the quartz glass; putting the quartz glass with the surface modified into high-temperature mixed molten salt for etching treatment, and then putting the quartz glass into water for boiling until the surface of the quartz glass shows a microstructure; aligning and attaching the microstructures of the two quartz glasses, and then performing pre-pressing bonding; and annealing the bonded quartz glass under vacuum condition to obtain the continuous flow ultraviolet chemical reaction quartz glass chip. According to the invention, femtosecond laser direct modification is carried out on the surface of quartz glass, a flow channel microstructure is formed by etching a modified region through high-temperature molten salt, the etching selection ratio is more than 1:500, the increase of the surface roughness of unmodified quartz glass and the change of the whole surface are avoided, and finally, a micro flow channel quartz glass chip is formed through pre-pressing bonding, so that the corrosion efficiency is high, and the bonding yield is high.

title_en: Method for preparing arsine by electro-catalysis with arsenic ash as arsenic source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing arsine by electro-catalysis with gray arsenic as an arsenic source, which comprises the steps of taking a PdFe bimetallic alloy nanoparticle electrode loaded on nickel foil as a working cathode, arranging a counter electrode anode, taking gray arsenic as an arsenic source, and preparing arsine by catalytic reduction of gray arsenic in alkaline electrolyte through a constant current electrolysis method. The invention can realize the high-efficiency synthesis of arsine in a wider current density range, takes common and easily available gray arsenic as an arsenic source, takes the PdFe/NF electrode simply prepared by electrodeposition as a catalytic working cathode, has mild reaction conditions, does not need high temperature and high pressure and chemical reducing agent, can reuse the electrocatalyst, and provides a green, safe and high-efficiency method for the synthesis of arsine.

title_en: Preparation method and application of photosensitive glass
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of photosensitive glass are provided, wherein in the preparation method of photosensitive glass, two opposite main surfaces of a first region of substrate glass comprising a first region and a second region are subjected to masking treatment, and the second region is not subjected to masking treatment, so that substrate glass with the same structure after double-sided masking is obtained; the two main surfaces of the substrate glass with the same structure after double-sided masking are subjected to radiation treatment, so that the edge halation phenomenon of the exposure area of the bright glass can be obviously improved; and can make the exposure area have good shading performance.

title_en: Preparation method of high-hardness high-adhesion composite coating decorative embossed glass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughened glass, in particular to a preparation method of high-hardness high-adhesion composite coating decorative embossed glass, which comprises the following steps of 1, designing a fine pattern on a PET film, then directly writing, scanning and engraving the PET film according to the designed pattern, 2, embossing a tin surface of the toughened glass by using UV ink according to the texture obtained in the step 1, then curing to obtain the embossed toughened glass, and 3, sealing a bottom on an air surface of the embossed toughened glass obtained in the step 2 by using water-based acrylic acid gloss oil, and curing to obtain a finished product. The invention uses the aqueous acrylic acid type gloss oil printed on the air surface of the glass as the back cover, and uses the air surface of the glass as the protective layer of the air exposed surface of the glass after curing treatment, thereby playing the roles of protecting the glass and preventing the glass from being scratched, and having the advantages of high strength, high hardness, high adhesive force and good ageing resistance.

title_en: Method for treating garbage fly ash by using manganese slag
abstract_en: The application provides a method for treating garbage fly ash by utilizing manganese slag, which comprises the following steps: mixing the pretreated manganese slag and the garbage fly ash, and then sequentially carrying out deamination and desulfurization treatment to obtain cement active materials; the preparation method of the pretreated manganese slag comprises the following steps: mixing electrolytic manganese slag, chitosan, carboxylated polyvinyl alcohol, calcium alginate and acid, solid-liquid separation and drying. According to the application, the cement active material is finally prepared by deaminizing and desulfurizing the electrolytic manganese slag and the garbage fly ash after being mixed, so that the recycling utilization of waste residues is realized.

title_en: Fluorine-free preparation process of high-purity quartz sand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorine-free preparation process of high-purity quartz sand, which comprises the following steps of: s1, crushing and screening quartz raw ores; s2, magnetic separation; s3, floatation; s4, calcining and water quenching; s5, hot-pressing acid leaching; s6, chloridizing and calcining; s7, hot-pressing acid leaching; s8, cleaning and drying to obtain the high-purity quartz sand. The prepared high-purity quartz sand has the total impurity content of less than 50ppm and the purity of more than 99.99 percent, has obvious advantages compared with the traditional hydrofluoric acid pickling system in the aspects of environmental friendliness, selectivity, economy, safety, application universality and the like, meets the urgent requirements of the current society on green production, energy conservation and emission reduction, improves the product quality and production efficiency through technical innovation, and provides powerful support for transformation and upgrading in the related industrial fields.

title_en: Vegetable asphalt matrix asphalt mixture and application thereof in semi-flexible pavement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plant asphalt matrix asphalt mixture and application thereof in semi-flexible pavement. The invention adopts plant asphalt as cementing material, and adds coarse aggregate, fine aggregate, mineral powder and curing agent with proper proportion to prepare large-gap matrix asphalt mixture, and realizes effective combination with the plant asphalt matrix asphalt mixture by pouring cement-based slurry, thereby forming the innovative semi-flexible pavement material. In the construction process, the plant asphalt matrix asphalt mixture does not need heating equipment, plant asphalt made of biological heavy oil is completely used, obvious advantages are shown in the aspects of reducing environmental pollution, reducing energy consumption and the like, and meanwhile, the construction efficiency and convenience are realized; the transformation of the highway industry to the development of high efficiency, energy saving, durability and green is promoted, and the application range of the plant asphalt is enlarged.

title_en: Preparation method of high-temperature alloy powder for additive manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of additive manufacturing, in particular to a preparation method of high-temperature alloy powder for additive manufacturing. The preparation method of the high-temperature alloy powder for additive manufacturing comprises the following steps of (1) preparing doping Al  2 O 3  powder, (2) preparing modified Al  2 O 3  powder, (3) preparing a composite alloy ingot by melting, (4) forging and (5) preparing powder by a plasma electrode atomization method. The high-temperature alloy powder for additive manufacturing has excellent sphericity and lower oxygen content, can meet the basic requirements of additive manufacturing on the powder, and a printed part obtained by printing has excellent microhardness, and most importantly, the printed part prepared by the high-temperature alloy powder for additive manufacturing still has good tensile strength and excellent plasticity under the high-temperature condition, and has wide application prospect in the field of additive manufacturing.

title_en: Method for preventing open caisson from subsidence again after construction to designed elevation by soft foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of open caisson construction, in particular to a method for preventing a soft foundation from settling again after the open caisson construction reaches a designed elevation, which comprises the steps of grouting and reinforcing the soft foundation with abundant underground water for open caisson construction, so that a grouting layer with certain strength is formed, the bearing capacity of the foundation is improved, the sinking of a shaft for open caisson construction after the shaft for open caisson construction is settled to the designed elevation is effectively controlled, the reworking and repairing workload is reduced, and the primary qualification rate of open caisson construction is effectively improved; the method has the characteristics of high construction speed, small pollution to the surrounding environment, simple construction operation, safety and reliability and the like.

title_en: Pushed slab kiln for reducing artificial diamond raw materials and reduction method thereof
