abstract_en: The invention relates to a pushed slab kiln for reducing artificial diamond raw materials and a reduction method thereof; the push plate kiln comprises a feeding pipe section, a heating pipe section, a cooling pipe section and a discharging pipe section which are sequentially connected, push plates are arranged in the push plate kiln in a queue mode, two lifting kiln doors are arranged on the feeding pipe section and the discharging pipe section, an air inlet pipe is arranged at the tail of the cooling pipe section, cooled high-pressure nitrogen-hydrogen mixed gas is introduced into the air inlet pipe, and a drain pipe is arranged at the head of the heating pipe section. The lifting kiln door enables the inside of the pushed slab kiln to form a closed state, high-pressure nitrogen-hydrogen mixed gas passes through the cooling pipe section and the heating pipe section in sequence and is discharged from the sewage pipe, one side of the high-pressure nitrogen-hydrogen mixed gas exchanges heat with raw materials, excess heat of the raw materials of the cooling pipe section is transferred to the raw materials of the heating pipe section, the whole energy consumption is reduced, the other side of the high-pressure nitrogen-hydrogen mixed gas performs reduction reaction with the raw materials in both the heating pipe section and the cooling section, and the raw materials are ensured to completely remove volatile impurities. The reduction method has lower energy consumption and higher reduction quality.

title_en: Ceramic shell melts and seals anchor clamps
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sealing clamps, in particular to a ceramic shell sealing clamp. The invention provides a ceramic shell sealing clamp capable of quickly adjusting clamping sizes to adapt to ceramic shell sealing processing of different sizes. A ceramic shell sealing clamp comprises a mounting plate, handles, a supporting plate and the like, wherein the handles are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the mounting plate, and the supporting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting plate. Through setting up clamping assembly and pushing component, when needs change ceramic shell size, the user puts into square lug with the size module in, starts electric putter, and electric putter drives horizontal splint and the vertical splint that are located on the upper left corner department casing of mounting panel and draw close to the middle part, and it is quick with the size module clamp to be equipped with, and vertical splint and horizontal splint on other casings are promoted by carriage A and carriage B and are carried out quick location this moment, are convenient for install the quick of different model size ceramic shell.

title_en: Niobium dioxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to niobium dioxide, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein calcium carbide and niobium pentachloride are used as raw materials, and the niobium dioxide is directly prepared by adopting a normal-temperature mechanical ball milling method. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of no need of high-temperature heat treatment, simplicity, rapidness, energy conservation and the like, and the prepared niobium dioxide can be applied to the secondary battery anode material, and the application of the niobium dioxide serving as the anode material is mainly based on the unique physical and chemical properties, including high theoretical capacity, good electrochemical stability and thermal stability.

title_en: Preparation method of radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing functional structure integrated ceramic matrix composite
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an integrated ceramic matrix composite with a radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing function structure, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing a silicon carbide (SiC) prefabricated cloth and coating slurry, secondly uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of the SiC prefabricated cloth and laminating and fixing the SiC prefabricated cloth, and finally carrying out Chemical Vapor Infiltration (CVI) process on the laminated and fixed prefabricated body to deposit a silicon nitride (Si  3 N 4 ) matrix for densification. The preparation method provided by the invention realizes the structural integration of the radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing functions of the ceramic matrix composite, so that the radiation shielding material is in service in a higher temperature environment, and the overall comprehensive performance and the high temperature environment applicability of the ceramic matrix composite are improved.

title_en: High-precision rolling process for rolled steel bar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision rolling process of a steel rolling bar, which belongs to the technical field of steel rolling and comprises the following steps of mixing steel component raw materials and reinforcing fillers, smelting and refining, casting into a steel billet, placing the steel billet into a hot rolling mill, spraying a water-based nano lubricant, and carrying out hot rolling treatment to obtain the steel rolling bar. The steel matrix can penetrate into gaps of the concave-convex structures on the surface of the nano silicon carbide, the binding force of the nano silicon carbide and the steel matrix is improved, a compact steel material is formed, spherical nano molybdenum disulfide is formed on the surface of the nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet, a rolling lubrication effect is generated, friction force between a steel billet and a rolling mill assembly in a rolling process is reduced, graphene oxide is arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the modified nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet, a stable sliding space is provided for the spherical nano molybdenum disulfide on the surface of the modified nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet, and stripping of the spherical nano molybdenum disulfide from the nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet in the friction process is avoided.

title_en: Grain-oriented SiAlON ceramic cutting blade and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cutting tools and discloses a grain-oriented S iAl ON ceramic cutting blade and a preparation method thereof, wherein the blade comprises a S iAl ON ceramic layer and at least one matrix, grains in the S iAl ON ceramic layer are arranged along a preferred orientation at the cutting edge of the blade, the matrix and the S iAl ON ceramic layer are composited through an interface with an interlocking penetrating structure, the interface structure comprises a composite layer formed by at least one heterogeneous material, each cutting edge of the blade has consistency in the grain orientation, and the grain orientation relative angle of each tip is kept consistent. The novel S iAl ON ceramic blade with the synergistic design of the novel integral and microstructure can solve the problems of poor durability, poor groove abrasion resistance, low integral strength and the like of the conventional ceramic blade.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Au-ITO composite SERS substrate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of SERS detection, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of an Au-ITO composite SERS substrate. Firstly preparing gold nanoparticles with uniform distribution and same size by a sodium citrate reduction method, and then loading the gold nanoparticles and the gold nanoparticles on an ITO glass sheet to prepare a novel SERS substrate. The novel SERS substrate constructed by combining the ITO glass sheet and the gold nanoparticles is different from the conventional SERS substrate which uses the independent Au nanoparticles, and can detect the stronger intrinsic Raman signals of the probe molecules. Because the SERS substrate needs to be prepared by compounding with the ITO glass sheet, stronger electric field intensity can be obtained at a compounding interface, and then the intrinsic Raman signal of the probe molecule can be enhanced, so that the SERS substrate can be better used for detecting and analyzing chemical substances.

title_en: Carbon ceramic brake disc and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon ceramic brake discs, and particularly relates to a carbon ceramic brake disc and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of a carbon ceramic brake disc, which comprises the steps of carrying out carbon densification on a carbon fiber preform through chemical vapor deposition, carrying out glue distribution treatment on the surface of a C/C brake disc through glue stock before carrying out siliconizing, then carrying out heat treatment and mould pressing treatment, enabling the glue stock to permeate into the inside of the C/C brake disc, bonding inorganic powder (silicon carbide powder and/or carbon powder) and the C/C brake disc into a whole through liquid resin, and then carrying out siliconizing treatment, so that white spot defects on the disc surface of the obtained carbon ceramic brake disc can be effectively avoided, and the obtained silicon carbide ceramic coating is not easy to fall off and has long service life. Meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the invention only needs to carry out glue distribution, heat treatment and mould pressing treatment on the surface of the C/C brake disc, and has low preparation cost.

title_en: Nano SiO2Modified basalt fiber material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of basalt fibers and discloses a nano SiO  2  modified basalt fiber material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nano SiO  2  modified basalt fiber material comprises SiO  2  @basalt fibers, polyamino acid composite fibers and porous silicon particles, and the polyamino acid composite fibers comprise regular molecular chains formed by connecting identical amino acids through peptide bonds and irregular molecular chains formed by connecting different amino acids through peptide bonds. By additionally arranging the polyamino acid composite fiber between basalt fiber base materials, the polyamino acid composite fiber simultaneously contains regular molecular chains and irregular molecular chains, so that the fiber material can be endowed with good toughness and strength, and the polyamino acid composite fiber is combined between basalt fiber base materials through porous structure particles, so that the problems of unstable toughness and decline of the existing basalt fiber material in the use process can be solved.

title_en: Gold waste-based high-purity target preparation process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of a high-purity target material based on gold waste, and belongs to the technical field of target material preparation. By optimizing the purification steps and the process parameters, the high-efficiency purification of gold waste is realized, the vacuum smelting process parameters are regulated and controlled, the energy consumption and the emission of harmful substances are reduced, and the concept of sustainable development is met. Preferably, the mixed solution of dibutyl carbitol and sec-octyl alcohol is used as an extractant, so that the gold purification efficiency and selectivity are obviously improved, and the gold is ensured to be accurately separated from waste materials. The gold target material with uniform components, high mechanical strength and excellent performance is prepared by adopting a two-stage smelting technology and reasonably setting annealing parameters. The invention not only realizes the recycling utilization of gold waste, but also reduces the environmental load, and the prepared target material meets the high-performance application requirement and has obvious economic and environmental benefits.

title_en: Heat treatment method for strengthening high-temperature compression creep property of high-niobium TiAl alloy by inducing carbide precipitation and regulating and controlling second phase distribution configuration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat treatment method for strengthening high-temperature compression creep property of a high-niobium TiAl alloy by inducing carbide precipitation and regulating and controlling a second phase distribution configuration, and relates to the technical field of high-niobium TiAl alloys. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of insufficient creep property of the current high-niobium TiAl alloy. The method comprises the steps of smelting to prepare alloy ingots, determining the phase transition temperature of the as-cast alloy, and carrying out solid solution and aging two-step heat treatment on the alloy. The original structure of the high-niobium TiAl alloy prepared by the method is of a near-lamellar structure, no carbide is precipitated, a large-size strip Y  2 O 3  second phase exists, the structure morphology is basically unchanged after heat treatment, the structure is still of a near-lamellar structure, but the carbide is precipitated at a lamellar interface, Y  2 O 3  becomes a tiny ellipsoid, and a part of B2 phase also has a spheroidization phenomenon. The invention simplifies the production process through a two-step heat treatment process, and obviously improves the creep property on the premise that the original structure is basically unchanged and the room temperature plasticity of the alloy is not obviously reduced. The invention is used for improving the creep property of the high-niobium TiAl alloy.

title_en: Method for reinforcing steel slag and simultaneously recycling iron and phosphorus by using direct-current electric field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for strengthening steel slag and simultaneously recovering iron and phosphorus by using a direct current electric field, belonging to the field of steel slag treatment. The method comprises the steps of reducing alkali in steel slag, modifying the steel slag, uniformly mixing the steel slag and a siliceous modifier at a temperature of more than 1400 ℃ to ensure the fluidity of the steel slag, primarily reducing and recycling, mixing the modified steel slag with high-carbon hot molten iron, primarily reducing iron and phosphorus in the steel slag through the reduction action of the high-carbon molten iron, deeply reducing and recycling, further strengthening the oxidation-reduction reaction between the steel slag and gold through electric field reinforcement, reducing volatilization of phosphorus, and further recycling the iron and the phosphorus in the steel slag through the promotion action of an electric field. The invention aims to solve the problems of high-efficiency treatment of the phosphorus-containing steel slag and simultaneous recovery of valuable element phosphorus in the steel slag, and has the advantages of high phosphorus removal rate, high speed and low cost, and the low-phosphorus steel slag and the phosphorus-containing steel water can be reused, so that the economic benefit of enterprises is improved.

title_en: Negative electrode active material, negative electrode including the same, secondary battery including the negative electrode, and method of preparing the negative electrode active material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a negative electrode active material comprising silicon-based particles and a coating layer formed on at least a part of the silicon-based particles, wherein the silicon-based particles comprise SiO  x  (0 < x < 2) and a Li compound, and a carbon layer is formed on at least a part of the surface thereof, and the coating layer comprises an amphiphilic polymer.

title_en: Purifying coarse ZrCl4Molten salt method using zinc ion Lewis acid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of zirconium sponge production, in particular to a zinc ion Lewis acid molten salt method for purifying crude ZrCl  4 , which comprises the following steps: step 1: drying ZnCl2, naCl and KCl in sufficient quantity in a drying oven, setting the drying temperature of the drying oven to 105 ℃, setting the working time of the drying oven to 10 hours, and after the drying is finished, separately storing ZnCl2, naCl and KCl, wherein the drying oven comprises a heat insulation shell, a heating bin, a screening plate, a sealing top cover, a driving motor, a heating device, a heat conduction shaft, a stirring rod and a scraping plate, the zinc ion Lewis acid molten salt method for purifying the crude ZrCl  4  is combined, so that the crude ZrCl4 can be purified, the total mass percentage of Zr is increased to 36%, the total mass percentage of Fe element is reduced to 0.004%, the total mass percentage of Al is reduced to 0.001%, the purification effect on Fe and Al impurities in the crude ZrCl  4  is obvious, and the purified ZrCl  4  is reduced to generate simple-substance zirconium with high purity and good crystallinity.

title_en: Asphalt mixture compositely modified by Qingchuan rock asphalt-castor oil-rice hull ash and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an asphalt mixture compositely modified by Qingchuan rock asphalt-castor oil-rice hull ash and a preparation method thereof, aiming at solving the technical problem of insufficient road performance of the asphalt mixture. The asphalt mixture is prepared from the following raw materials, by weight, 100 parts of mineral aggregate, 4-6 parts of asphalt, 0.5-0.75 part of Qingchuan rock asphalt, 0.4-0.6 part of castor oil, 0.45-0.7 part of rice hull ash, 0.35-2 parts of a treating agent and 0.01-0.015 part of a compatibilizer. The asphalt mixture road has excellent performance, simple preparation process and nontoxic and harmless raw materials, can enhance the high-temperature stability, low-temperature crack resistance, water stability, toughness and ductility of the asphalt road, and prolongs the service life of the asphalt road.

title_en: Lithium ion battery negative electrode material, preparation method thereof, lithium ion battery negative electrode plate and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium batteries, and discloses a lithium ion battery negative electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a lithium ion battery negative electrode plate and a lithium ion battery. The negative electrode material comprises carbon-I with a crystalline structure and carbon-II with an amorphous structure, wherein the weight ratio of the carbon-I to the carbon-II is 1 (0.6-20), and the graphitization degree of the carbon-II in the negative electrode material is 1-2. The carbon-I with crystalline structure and the carbon-II with amorphous structure are beneficial to improving the diffusion rate of lithium ions by controlling the weight ratio of the carbon-I to the carbon-II and the graphitization degree of the carbon-II due to the recombination of the carbon-I with long-range order and the carbon-II with short-range order, and the existence of the crystalline flake graphite improves the crystallization degree of the hard carbon precursor in the high-temperature carbonization process, so that the carbon-I is uniformly distributed among the carbon-II, defect sites on the surface of the carbon-II are reduced, and the lithium ion battery containing the anode material has excellent performance.

title_en: Vertical continuous graphitizing furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphitizing furnaces and discloses a vertical continuous graphitizing furnace which comprises a vertical furnace body, wherein a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the vertical furnace body, a distributing disc is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the vertical furnace body, a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, a distributing disc is arranged between a heating bin and a discharging bin and is used for controlling the time interval of materials entering the discharging bin from the heating bin, namely, after the heating bin is aligned with a discharging hole on the distributing disc, graphitized materials can enter the discharging bin from the heating bin, a rotating shaft is driven to rotate by the servo motor, a mounting frame is driven to rotate, the heating bin is driven to do circular motion by the rotation of the mounting frame, the graphitizing operation of the materials is controlled by controlling the rotation speed of the rotating shaft, and the graphitizing operation of the materials is controlled in comparison with the heating and cooling modes.

title_en: Cemented carbide, preparation method thereof and application of cemented carbide in cemented carbide cutter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hard alloy, and provides a hard alloy, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a hard alloy cutter. The hard alloy consists of binder 8-15 weight portions, regulator 0.5-3 weight portions, vanadium carbide, ruthenium and tantalum carbide 10 weight portions in 1-6 weight portions, and tungsten carbide the rest. The preparation method comprises the following steps of ball milling, drying and granulating, compression molding and hydrogen sintering. The invention obtains the hard alloy with excellent strength and toughness by optimizing the components and limiting the dosage of each component, and has long service life when being applied to the blade.

title_en: Production method of niobium-containing microalloyed high-strength steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of niobium-containing steel, in particular to a production method of niobium-containing microalloyed high-strength steel, which solves the defects existing in the prior art and comprises the following components of 90-95 parts of iron, 0.05-0.2 part of niobium, 0.01-0.05 part of gallium, 0.001-0.01 part of thallium, 0.01-0.05 part of tellurium, 0.01-0.1 part of antimony, 0.3-0.8 part of carbon, 1-3 parts of manganese, 0.5-2 parts of silicon and 0.05-0.2 part of carbon nano fibers. According to the invention, through a carefully designed component formula, such as niobium, gallium, thallium, manganese, silicon and carbon nanofibers, the unique alloy element proportion promotes the effects of fine-grain strengthening and dispersion strengthening, and the ingenious blending of the carbon nanofibers further strengthens the microstructure of the steel, so that the synergistic effect of niobium precipitates and the carbon nanofibers forms a unique strengthening phase network and a twin crystal structure, and the overall performance of the material is improved.

title_en: FeCrAl-based ODS alloy material for accident-resistant fuel element and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a FeCrAl-based ODS alloy material for accident-resistant fuel elements, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass, ：Cr 9.0～11.5％,W 1.5～2.5％,Al 3.0～4.0％,Ta 0.6～1.5％,Si 0.9～1.5％,Y 2 O 3  0.25～0.5％,C≤0.008％,N≤0.008％, balance iron and unavoidable impurities. The invention also provides a preparation method of the FeCrAl-based ODS alloy material for the accident-resistant fuel element. The FeCrAl-based ODS alloy material for the accident-resistant fuel element and the preparation method thereof provided by the invention have excellent high-temperature oxidation performance under the condition of 1000 ℃ water vapor, higher high-temperature strength and tissue thermal stability under the condition of 800 ℃, and excellent mechanical strength and plasticity under the condition of room temperature.

title_en: Method for preparing microcrystalline glass by using coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal gangue resource utilization, in particular to a method for preparing microcrystalline glass by using coal gangue, which is used for solving the problems that the existing microcrystalline glass prepared by using coal gangue is low in compactness, low in mechanical strength and poor in chemical stability, and the application of the microcrystalline glass in high-strength and acid-base environments is limited; according to the method, the coal gangue is used as a main raw material, so that the recycling of the coal gangue is realized, the pollution of the coal gangue to the environment is reduced, meanwhile, the production cost of the microcrystalline glass is reduced, the microstructural stability of the microcrystalline glass is enhanced after the epoxy modified carbon nano tube is added, the mechanical strength and the thermal stability of the microcrystalline glass are improved, the service performance and the service life of the microcrystalline glass are improved, the crystal grains of the microcrystalline glass are uniform and fine after the hyperbranched refiner is added, the compactness of the microcrystalline glass is greatly improved, and finally, the prepared microcrystalline glass has excellent mechanical strength, chemical stability and economy.

title_en: Needle coke calcining device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a needle coke calcining device, which relates to the technical field of needle coke calcining, and comprises a low-temperature area peripheral wall and a high-temperature area peripheral wall, wherein the bottom of the low-temperature area peripheral wall is connected with the upper end of a high Wen Ouzhou wall, a furnace top cover plate is buckled at the top of the low-temperature area peripheral wall, flame paths are respectively built at the front, middle and rear positions of the low-temperature area peripheral wall, two preheating areas are formed between the front, middle and rear flame paths, the high-temperature area peripheral wall corresponds to a calcining area below the preheating area, and electrodes are respectively arranged at the positions corresponding to the left side wall and the right side wall of the calcining area.

title_en: Hydrogen separation, recovery and purification device and purification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen separation, recovery and purification device and a purification method, in particular to hydrogen separation equipment, which comprises a shell, wherein a first extraction opening is respectively arranged in the shell and is used for discharging separated hydrogen; the device comprises a first separation bin, a second separation bin and a first separation device, wherein the first separation bin is provided with a first separation membrane, the second separation bin is fixedly communicated with the first separation bin and comprises a plurality of water drop channels which are sequentially communicated, each water drop channel comprises a bending channel and an inclined channel symmetrically arranged on the bending channel, and the second separation membrane is arranged on the bending channel. After the compressed gas is introduced into the first separation bin, the pressure in the first separation bin is reduced along with the permeation of the hydrogen along the first separation membrane, and then the gas is separated along two inclined channels and is intersected at the connecting point of the water drop channels so as to increase the resistance of the output gas of the curved channel, thereby increasing the pressure of the curved channel part and improving the efficiency of separating the hydrogen by the second separation membrane.

title_en: Nano-silicon filled microcrystalline graphite negative electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite anode material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite negative electrode material comprises the steps of taking microcrystalline graphite as a matrix material, depositing silane between sheets of microcrystalline graphite by a gradient heating method to obtain a nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite composite material, and finally, coating and carbonizing by a carbon source to form the nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite negative electrode material with a porous structure on the surface of the nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite composite material. According to the nano silicon filled microcrystalline graphite anode material with the core-shell structure, the inner core is a silicon-graphite composite material formed by filling microcrystalline graphite with nano silicon, nano silicon particles are filled in the surfaces and gaps of crystal grains of microcrystalline graphite, the volume expansion of nano silicon is inhibited by a microcrystalline graphite matrix material in the charge-discharge process, and particularly, the volume expansion of the microcrystalline graphite material which can counteract the stress effect due to different structural orientations is further inhibited.

title_en: Graphite negative electrode material for lithium battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a graphite negative electrode material for a lithium battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) preparing modified phenolic resin, (2) adding natural graphite and modified phenolic resin into a reaction kettle, continuously adding modified graphene, stirring, heating and coating under a nitrogen atmosphere, specifically, heating to 150-200 ℃ at 1-2 ℃ per min, preserving heat for 100-120min, heating to 550-600 ℃ at 4-6 ℃ per min, preserving heat for 180-200min, cooling to obtain coated graphite, and (3) placing the coated graphite into an atmosphere furnace for carbonization, and sieving to obtain the graphite negative electrode material for the lithium battery. When the negative electrode material is used for preparing a lithium battery, the capacity retention rate is high, the multiplying power performance is good, the impedance is low, and the lithium precipitation point of quick charge is high.

title_en: Dispersing method of silicon nanowires, prepared dispersing powder and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nano material preparation. The invention provides a dispersion method of silicon nanowires, a prepared dispersion powder and application thereof, the dispersing method comprises the steps of uniformly stirring and mixing a dispersing coating agent, a solvent, silicon nanowires and a conductive agent, crushing, and then carrying out spray granulation on the obtained slurry to obtain the silicon nanowire dispersing powder. According to the invention, chemical dispersion coating agent is added, and the spongy silicon nanowire blocks can be primarily dispersed into slurry through physical dispersion by high-speed stirring, then fine dispersion is carried out through physical crushing dispersion modes such as further ball milling or sand grinding, and finally, silicon nanowire particles with coating layers and good dispersion are finally obtained through centrifugal spray granulation.

title_en: Rare earth extraction and separation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth extraction and separation method. Relates to the technical field of chemical industry. Mixing a certain proportion of P507 extractant and diluent, placing the mixture into an extraction reactor, adding a certain amount of ammonia water for saponification, reacting for a certain time in the reactor, standing to obtain saponified P507, placing the saponified P507 and rare earth chloride into the reactor for reaction for a certain time, standing until phase separation, and obtaining an extracted organic phase and a water phase. The invention effectively reduces the emission of VOCs in the extraction and separation process, can reduce the separation time of organic phase and water phase in the extraction and separation process, and improves the extraction and separation efficiency.

title_en: Ferritic stainless steel and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a ferritic stainless steel having excellent high temperature yield strength and excellent oxidation resistance. The composition was set to a predetermined composition, and the amount of Nb in solid solution was set to be more than 1.00 mass%.

title_en: Preparation method of foam metal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of foam metal, and belongs to the technical field of porous metal preparation. The metal sheet is formed into a single-layer foam half-pore structure through a mould pressing process, closed-pore combination is carried out after surface treatment and functional material filling, a single-layer foam structure is formed, and the single-layer foam structure is piled and combined in a three-dimensional space to obtain the foam metal. According to the product use, selecting metal sheets with different materials, selecting different kinds of dies for compression molding according to the shape of air holes and the material of the metal sheets, selecting different surface treatment processes or filling functional materials according to the product use, and the combination modes of single-layer foam structures comprise welding, riveting, gluing, high-temperature sintering and the like. According to the invention, the effective control of the size and shape of the air hole is realized through the design of the die, the process period is greatly shortened, the functional material filling can be realized in the air hole, and the single-layer foam half-hole structure can also endow the foam metal with a new function through surface treatment.

title_en: Transparent colorless spinel glass ceramic, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to transparent colorless spinel glass ceramics, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the glass ceramics contains (Zn, mg) Al  2 O 4  serving as a main crystal phase and tetragonal ZrO  2  serving as a secondary crystal phase, does not contain TiO  2 , and is obtained by heat treatment at a temperature of not more than 800 ℃ when the oxide contained in the glass ceramics satisfies a relation Al 2 O 3 /(MgO+ZnO)＝1.40～2.00;(K 2 O+Li 2 O+Na 2 O+B 2 O 3 )/(SiO 2 +Al 2 O 3 )＝0.10～0.20; in terms of mole percent of oxide. The microcrystalline glass has a transmittance of 85.0% or more under light with a wavelength of 550nm, is subjected to an anti-sand paper drop test by adopting 80-mesh sand paper, has an average anti-sand paper drop height of 1.00m or more, has a Vickers hardness of 800HV or more, and has a fracture toughness of 1.200 MPa-m  1/2  or more. According to the invention, colorless transparent spinel glass ceramics with high transparency and excellent mass production can be obtained, and the glass ceramics can be used for chemically strengthening strengthened glass ceramics with excellent deep stress characteristics.

title_en: High-strength metal matrix composite and method for producing high-strength metal matrix composite
abstract_en: The present invention provides an aluminum alloy-based composite body which has high strength but good workability, and which has high economic and practical value and can suppress manufacturing costs, and a method for manufacturing the composite body, which cannot be realized by conventional manufacturing techniques. Specifically, provided are a high-strength metal-based composite obtained by impregnating and filling a porous filler or molded body (preform) with molten aluminum or an aluminum alloy, wherein the porous filler or molded body (preform) is formed from a mixed powder obtained by adding 1 or more aluminum/aluminum alloy powders selected from the group consisting of aluminum powders and aluminum alloy powders having an average particle diameter of 10 [ mu ] m to 300 [ mu ] m to 1 or more fine powders selected from the group consisting of metal powders and ceramic powders having an average particle diameter of 0.3 [ mu ] m to 8 [ mu ] m, and the filler ratio of the fine powders is 10 vol% to 50 vol% and the bending strength of the composite is 500MPa to 800MPa.

title_en: Positive electrode active material for all-solid-state lithium ion secondary battery and method for producing same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a positive electrode active material that improves charge/discharge cycle characteristics in an all-solid-state battery. The positive electrode active material for an all-solid-state lithium ion secondary battery has particles of a lithium-nickel composite oxide having a crystal structure belonging to space group R-3M, and containing Li, ni, mn and an element M, wherein the mass ratio of each element is represented by Li: ni: mn: M=a (1-x-y) x: y (0.95.ltoreq.a.ltoreq.1.10, 0< x.ltoreq.0.5, 0< y.ltoreq.0.5, 0< x+y.ltoreq.0.7), the Li site occupancy is 92% or more and 98.5% or less, D50 is 8 μm or less, the crystallite diameter is 70nm or more and 140nm or less, the amount of eluted lithium ions is 0.05 mass% or more and 0.50 mass% or less, and the coating layer is a composite oxide containing Li and at least one element selected from Al, si, ti, V, ga, ge, zr, nb, mo, ta and W.

title_en: Positive electrode active material, in-situ electrochemical modification method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anode active material, an in-situ electrochemical modification method and application thereof. Relates to the technical field of anode materials. The in-situ electrochemical modification method of the positive electrode active material comprises the following steps of mixing LiNi  0.5 Mn 1.5 O 4  serving as the positive electrode active material with a conductive agent, an adhesive and a solvent to obtain slurry, coating the slurry on a metal foil to obtain a slurry layer, drying to obtain a positive electrode plate, assembling the positive electrode plate, electrolyte containing ferrocene hexafluorophosphate and a negative electrode into a battery, and completing in-situ electrochemical modification of the positive electrode active material through charge-discharge circulation. In the method, in-situ electrochemical modification is completed in charge-discharge cycle, and the charge-discharge cycle process of the battery is the modification process of the CEI film and the doping process of Fe ions, so that the modification of the LiNi  0.5 Mn 1.5 O 4  material is completely carried out.

title_en: Shakeout cooling equipment for casting
abstract_en: The application relates to shakeout cooling equipment for casting, which belongs to the technical field of sand recovery and comprises a cooling box chamber, wherein an air supply outlet and an air outlet are formed in the cooling box chamber, a shakeout paving device is arranged in the cooling box chamber and comprises a vibrating table, a central cooling pipe arranged on the vibrating table and a spiral disc coiled on the central cooling pipe, the central cooling pipe is vertically arranged, two ends of the central cooling pipe are closed, a water cooling device is arranged in the central cooling pipe, a shakeout chassis is further arranged on the central cooling pipe, the shakeout chassis is arranged on the lower side of the spiral disc, and a shakeout outlet is formed in the shakeout chassis. According to the application, the shakeout is paved on the spiral disc through the shakeout paving device, and the shakeout is promoted to be cooled rapidly through a water cooling and air cooling combined mode, so that the cooling efficiency of the casting sand is improved.

title_en: Casting equipment for producing seamless steel tube mould
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of casting, in particular to casting equipment for producing a seamless steel tube mould, which comprises a cover plate, a locating plate, a cylinder II, a cylinder III, a sand sleeve and a locking assembly, wherein the cover plate is arranged on the locating plate; the cover plate is inserted on the cope flask, the positioning plate is connected with the cover plate, the positioning plate is provided with a positioning hole, the positioning plate is connected with a cylinder II in a sliding manner, a cylinder III is fixedly connected to the cylinder II, and the cylinder III penetrates through the positioning hole. Through apron and locating plate matched with for the manual work only needs to insert the sand cover in the locating hole, can make sand cover align the rising head, avoided because of sand cover and rising head do not align a great deal of problem that arouses, simultaneously, be used for carrying out the locating plate of location to the sand cover, also be used for blockking spacing to cylinder two, avoided because of the too big problem that is difficult to control the sand mould piece two of cylinder two and cylinder three that leads to of application of force direction of application of force crush.

title_en: Concrete for expressway escape way brake bed and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of concrete, and particularly discloses concrete for a highway escape route brake bed, and a preparation method and application thereof. The concrete comprises 20-30 parts of cement, 20-30 parts of carbon mineralized mineral material, 3-7 parts of modified fiber, 0.4-0.8 part of foaming agent, 0.02-0.06 part of foam stabilizer, 2-6 parts of water reducer and 100-150 parts of mixing water, wherein the light aggregate is prepared by mixing hollow glass microspheres and ceramsite according to the weight ratio of 0.3-1:1, and the modified fiber is prepared by mixing polyvinyl alcohol fiber, propenyl triethoxysilane and starch, then placing the mixture in a water solution of boric acid with the concentration of 2-6wt% for reaction for 24-72 hours, and drying the mixture. By utilizing the technical scheme, the prepared concrete has the advantages of long-term stable collapse energy absorption, small maximum collapse depth and large friction coefficient.

title_en: Foam ceramic derived from full solid waste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foam ceramic derived from full solid waste and a preparation method thereof, wherein the foam ceramic comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 60-69% of Dexing copper mine tailings, 7-8% of electrolytic manganese slag and 23-33% of fly ash. The preparation method comprises ball milling and drying the three raw materials, uniformly mixing the three raw materials with an organic binder (7 wt% polyvinyl alcohol solution) accounting for 5% of the total mass of the raw materials in a ceramic mortar according to a designed mass ratio to obtain a batch, then filling the batch into a metal mold, pressing the batch into a precursor under the pressure of 20MPa of a small-sized manual sample pressing machine, and sintering the precursor in a high-temperature muffle furnace at 1160-1220 ℃ for 1h, and cooling the precursor along with the furnace to obtain the foamed ceramic. The raw materials of the foamed ceramic are all from industrial solid wastes, and the synthesized foamed ceramic has excellent properties of light weight (volume density: 0.30-0.81g/cm  3 ), high porosity (64.52-91.92%), high compressive strength (0.41-3.35 MPa) and the like, and has wide application prospect in the fields of building walls and heat-insulating fireproof materials.

title_en: Recycled aggregate for concrete and preparation method of fully recycled concrete
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field part, and provides a preparation method of recycled aggregate and full recycled concrete, which comprises the following steps of S1, sorting, S2, pretreatment of the recycled concrete, S2, synchronous primary crushing, primary screening, primary flushing, secondary crushing and secondary flushing of the recycled aggregate and natural stone, S3, multistage treatment of the recycled concrete, preparation of recycled coarse aggregate, preparation of recycled aggregate, primary shaping and four-stage screening of 5-31.5 mm recycled aggregate obtained in the step S3, preparation of recycled coarse aggregate of 0-5 mm and final recycled coarse aggregate of 5-31.5 mm, preparation of recycled fine aggregate, three-stage crushing, five-stage fine flushing of the recycled aggregate of 0-5 mm, 31.5-50 mm obtained in the step S3 and recycling of 0-5 mm obtained in the step S4, and preparation of the recycled aggregate of the recycled concrete with good performance.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium gold sulfite solution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a gold sodium sulfite solution, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing chloroauric acid, S2, slowly dropwise adding the prepared chloroauric acid into a sodium sulfite solution, temporarily stopping dropwise adding the chloroauric acid when the solution becomes pale yellow, adjusting pH, continuously dropwise adding the chloroauric acid after the solution becomes colorless and transparent until the chloroauric acid is completely dropwise added to obtain a crude gold sodium sulfite solution, S3, adding ethanol into the crude gold sodium sulfite solution, precipitating a crystal product by an antisolvent, carrying out solid-liquid separation, and then washing the crystal product for a plurality of times by ethanol to obtain gold sodium sulfite crystals, and S4, dissolving the obtained gold sodium sulfite crystals into the sodium sulfite solution to prepare the gold sodium sulfite solution.

title_en: Method for obtaining low-iron white steel slag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steelmaking waste treatment, in particular to a method for obtaining low-iron white steel slag, which comprises the following steps of crushing, screening and magnetically separating steel slag, grinding magnetic separation residues again until all materials pass through a screen to obtain steel slag powder, carrying out first acidolysis on the steel slag powder, carrying out solid-liquid separation on obtained reaction products to obtain first liquid materials and first solid materials, carrying out second acidolysis on the first solid materials, carrying out solid-liquid separation on obtained reaction products to obtain second liquid materials and second solid materials, cooling, crystallizing and carrying out solid-liquid separation on the second liquid materials to obtain CaCl  2  crystals, wherein a mixture of the second solid materials and CaCl  2  crystals is the steel slag after iron removal. The method can remove the simple substance iron, ferrous iron and ferric iron in the steel slag respectively in sequence, so that iron elements in the steel slag are completely separated out, and the iron-removed steel slag is obtained. The content of simple substance iron in the steel slag after iron removal is less than 0.5%, and ferrous iron and ferric iron are both less than 3.0%.

title_en: Tungsten dispersion material for reactor control rod and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The manufacturing method of the tungsten dispersion material for the reactor control rod comprises the steps of uniformly mixing W particles and Ni powder, pressing the mixture into blank blocks through cold isostatic pressing, sintering the blank blocks, and then carrying out hot isostatic pressing and quenching to obtain a finished product of the tungsten dispersion material for the reactor control rod. The material has good mechanical property, heat conduction property and corrosion resistance, and can effectively improve the safety and reliability of the reactor control rod. The invention also provides a tungsten dispersion material for the reactor control rod and the reactor control rod.

title_en: Production process for replacing vanadium-nitrogen alloy with composite vanadium-nitrogen alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process for replacing vanadium-nitrogen alloy by using composite vanadium-nitrogen alloy, which is applicable to steel grades of HRB400[ E ] X and has the specification of phi 12-25mm, wherein a converter keeps the original process unchanged, the composite vanadium-nitrogen alloy is added in a refining furnace to replace part of vanadium-nitrogen alloy, the composite vanadium-nitrogen alloy is added after molten steel enters a station, the vanadium-nitrogen alloy is added to complement the rest V component, the refining smelting time is more than or equal to 20min, the argon blowing time is more than or equal to 4min, the V component is controlled to be 0.019% -0.023%, the tapping amount is more than 65 tons, the composite vanadium-nitrogen adding amount is 45kg, the rest components are complemented by the vanadium-nitrogen alloy, the tapping amount is less than 65 tons, the composite vanadium-nitrogen adding amount is 40kg, and after rolling, the vanadium-nitrogen alloy adding amount is increased and decreased according to the specific value of the mechanical property of steel according to the proportion, and the mechanical property of the steel meets the requirement.

title_en: Chemically strengthened glass ceramic, cover plate glass, electronic equipment and glass device
abstract_en: The application provides chemically strengthened glass ceramics, cover plate glass, electronic equipment and glass devices, which belong to the technical field of glass ceramics, and the ratio of the tensile stress linear density value of the chemically strengthened glass ceramics to the stress integral of a tensile stress layer close to the middle position to the thickness t meets a specific difference relation, so that the internal stress distribution of the chemically strengthened glass ceramics can be ensured to be safer under the condition of ensuring that the chemically strengthened glass ceramics has higher integral stress level, thereby being beneficial to keeping the chemically strengthened glass ceramics in a safe stress state.

title_en: Aluminum alloy foil for temperature control element, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aluminum alloy foil for a temperature control element, a preparation method and application thereof. The aluminum alloy foil comprises 1.7-1.9% of Mn, 0.2-0.5% of Cr, 0.1-0.3% of Ti, 0.05-0.2% of V, 0.1-0.2% of Fe, 0.5-1.5% of Si and less than or equal to 0.2% by weight of other unavoidable impurity elements, and the balance of Al. According to the invention, by adding metal elements in a specific proportion and adopting a copper mold casting blank with cooling water, a large amount of effective elements are dissolved in a matrix, and the effective elements are separated out by combining a single-pass small cold rolling deformation amount, so that the aluminum alloy foil for the temperature control element with high resistivity and easy processing is obtained, and is suitable for a resistance heating element.

title_en: Electrochemical preparation method of component-controllable indium-indium oxide nanosphere composite catalyst and CO thereof2Reduction application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrochemical preparation method of a component-controllable indium-indium oxide nanosphere composite catalyst and CO  2  reduction application thereof, the raw materials involved in the invention are indium nitrate, urea, trisodium citrate, deionized water, absolute ethyl alcohol, carbon paper electrode, nafion, different indium oxide nanosphere precursors are synthesized under the high-temperature and high-pressure reaction condition of a one-step hydrothermal method, the precursors are placed in a muffle furnace for high-temperature calcination to obtain indium oxide nanospheres, the obtained indium oxide nanospheres are subjected to electrode flaking, and the composition-controllable indium-indium oxide nanosphere composite catalyst is obtained through electrochemical reduction treatment and is applied to CO  2  electrochemical reduction.

title_en: High-temperature radiation furnace tube for enhancing heat transfer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature radiation furnace tube for enhancing heat transfer and a preparation method and application thereof. The high-temperature radiation furnace tube for enhancing heat transfer comprises a high-temperature radiation furnace tube with the inner surface subjected to roughness treatment, namely a thick tube, and/or a high-temperature radiation furnace tube with the inner surface sequentially subjected to roughness treatment and surfacing treatment of a bypass structure, namely a bypass terminal, wherein the roughness parameter Ra of the inner surface of the thick tube is 3.2-40.5 mu m, and the bypass structure is in one or more of a spherical shape, a raindrop shape and a strip shape. The invention can obviously improve the heat conduction effect, the temperature and the air flow uniformity of the furnace tube through the combination of slight increase of the inner surface area and the micron-sized inner surface bypass structure within a certain range, and simultaneously does not influence the filling volume of the catalyst in the furnace tube, and avoids the obvious pressure drop at the outlet end of the furnace tube.

title_en: Cementing material, ultra-high performance concrete and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-strength concrete, and particularly relates to a cementing material, ultra-high-performance concrete and a preparation method thereof. The cementing material is prepared by mixing and grinding lime, slag powder, fly ash, desulfurized gypsum and an exciting agent. The ultra-high performance concrete is prepared from the cementing material, microbeads, machine-made sand, steel fibers, a water reducing agent and water. The ultra-high performance concrete prepared by the cementing material has the advantages of low shrinkage rate and high compressive strength under the natural curing condition, and has lower cost. The ultra-high performance concrete is suitable for the fields of various concrete building engineering such as large-volume bearing platforms, bridge heads and the like.

title_en: Ammonia fuel cracking supply system of gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention provides an ammonia fuel cracking supply system of a gas turbine, which comprises a liquid ammonia storage tank, a liquid ammonia supply pump, an air vaporizer, a heat exchanger, a first ammonia cracker, a compression and expansion integrated machine, the gas turbine and the like. The liquid ammonia is supplied to the air vaporizer through the liquid ammonia supply pump, one end of the heat exchanger is communicated with the air vaporizer, the other end of the heat exchanger is communicated with the first ammonia cracker, one end of the compression and expansion integrated machine introduced by the system is communicated with the heat exchanger, and the other end of the compression and expansion integrated machine is communicated with the gas turbine. The air vaporizer adopts an exhaust heat source to gasify liquid ammonia into ammonia gas. Ammonia gas discharged from the air vaporizer enters the heat exchanger, exchanges heat with cracked gas after cracking to raise temperature, and is then led into the first ammonia cracker. The ammonia is decomposed into hydrogen and nitrogen mixed gas in the first ammonia cracker, the mixed gas can enter a heat exchanger, and after the mixed gas is subjected to heat exchange and temperature reduction in the heat exchanger, the mixed gas enters a compression and expansion integrated machine, is subjected to supercharging and cooling treatment, and is conveyed to a gas turbine.

title_en: Metal oxide and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a metal oxide and application thereof. The metal oxide has a face-centered cubic structure, the space group is Fd-3m, and the lattice constant a of the metal oxide is To The tensile residual stress F  1  in the metal oxide is 0.105MPa to 5.51MPa, or the compressive residual stress F  2  is 1.05MPa to 8.6MPa, the metal oxide is prepared by spray pyrolysis, and the pyrolysis rate K is 0.361 to 48.611. The metal oxide provided by the invention not only has higher crystallinity and stability, but also has high activity, and is beneficial to improving the intercalation property of sodium ions or lithium ions when preparing the anode material, thereby improving the comprehensive electrical property.

title_en: Lime refractory clinker production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production method of lime refractory clinker, which comprises the steps of mixing CaO-containing raw materials and inhibitors, calcining the raw materials into clinker at 1350-1550 ℃, wherein the inhibitors account for 0.5-4% of the mass of the mixture, the granularity of the CaO-containing raw materials is below 1mm, and the mass percentage of the granularity is not less than 50% and less than 0.5 mm. The method has the advantages that natural mineral limestone with lower cost is directly introduced as a raw material in the preparation process, the inhibitor is added, and clinker is produced by one-step simple calcination, so that the problem of lime clinker hydration delay is solved.

title_en: Calcium oxide-based raw material for producing cement clinker based on green electric energy, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cement, and provides a green electric energy-based calcium oxide raw material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out high-temperature decomposition on a limestone raw material mainly composed of limestone blocks to obtain a lime product taking blocky lime as a main product; grinding the lime product to obtain the calcium oxide-based raw material, and calcining the calcium oxide-based raw material to obtain the cement clinker. Compared with the existing conventional raw materials for producing and preparing cement clinker, the calcium oxide-based raw material provided by the invention not only reduces the raw material amount of raw material grinding, but also can greatly reduce grinding energy consumption by porous loose and very easy-to-grind lime products taking blocky lime as main products. In addition, the lime product obtained by the method is directly subjected to heat exchange and grinding with other raw materials, and the process flow is simplified on the basis of fully utilizing energy.

title_en: Thickening rock-based mineral admixture and concrete
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building materials, and discloses a thickening rock-based mineral admixture and concrete. The thickening rock-based mineral admixture comprises, by weight, 75-90 parts of rock components, 10-20 parts of activating components and 2-5 parts of modifying components. The rock component is ground carbonate cavity slag selected from one of limestone, marble and dolomite. The invention prepares the high-activity thickening rock-based mineral admixture by utilizing the characteristic of good hydrophilicity of carbonate stone powder, improves the cohesiveness of concrete and enhances the cohesiveness of sprayed concrete and tunnel rock walls. Meanwhile, the tunnel slag produced in the tunnel excavation process is prepared into homogeneous admixture and aggregate, and the homogeneous admixture and aggregate are matched with other components to prepare sprayed concrete, so that the tunnel slag can reach 100% utilization rate, and the tunnel slag is applied to a tunnel and is used in the green production concept of the tunnel, and has the advantages of environmental protection, obvious economic benefit, stable concrete quality and the like.

title_en: Method and device for manufacturing concrete precast block by sea sand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for manufacturing a concrete precast block by sea sand, which concretely comprise the following steps of preparing raw materials, namely, using 300 parts of sea sand as fine aggregate, and selecting 200 parts of proper coarse aggregate, 800 parts of broken stone, 150 parts of admixture, 130 parts of water, 400 parts of cement, 15 parts of water reducer and 10 parts of reinforcing steel bar rust inhibitor additive, wherein the admixture comprises fly ash and slag mixture, plant fiber and silica fume, the coarse aggregate is river sand, and the sea sand is purified. According to the method and the device for manufacturing the concrete precast block by using the sea sand, disclosed by the invention, the fly ash and the slag act simultaneously, so that the effect of resisting chloride ions in the later period of sea sand concrete is stronger, the sea sand can improve the impermeability and carbonization resistance of the concrete, the addition of the fiber can improve the crack resistance and freezing resistance of the concrete to a limited extent, and the silica fume can improve the freezing resistance of the sea mountain concrete to a certain extent.

title_en: Environment-friendly ramming material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly ramming material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the environment-friendly ramming material is prepared from, by weight, 70-80 parts of waste silicon carbide brick particles, 50-60 parts of superfine alumina, 35-40 parts of brown corundum, 6-18 parts of graphite micro powder, 5-15 parts of alumina micro powder, 5-12 parts of metal silicon micro powder, 4-8 parts of a composite binder and 2-5 parts of a dispersing agent, the composite binder is prepared from, by weight, 35-40 parts of phenolic resin, 20-30 parts of absolute ethyl alcohol, 0.2-1 part of modified white carbon black and 0.03-0.8 part of a formaldehyde scavenger, and the formaldehyde scavenger is a compound containing primary amine groups. The invention uses waste silicon carbide bricks as the base material of ramming mass, can reduce the waste of resources and the damage of environment, and adopts the modified phenolic resin of formaldehyde scavenger to reduce the content of free aldehyde.

title_en: Gray cast iron
abstract_en: The invention relates to gray cast iron, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: c: 2.5-3.5%, si: 1.0-1.8%, mn: 0.6-1.5%, cr is less than or equal to 0.4%, mo: 0.3-0.7%, cu: 0.6-1.3%, W: 0.5-1.5%, ca: 0.02-0.08%, P is less than or equal to 0.18%, S is less than or equal to 0.15%, the balance is Fe and unavoidable impurities, and the mass percentage of W and Ca satisfies: w/ca=13.8-36.5.

title_en: Steel sheet having excellent corrosion characteristics after press hardening and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: A steel sheet coated with a metal coating comprising, in weight percent, 7.5 to 9.0% zinc, 1.1 to 4.0% silicon, 1.1 to 8.0% magnesium, up to 3.0% iron, optionally elements selected from Pb, ni, zr, or Hf, the content of each element being less than 0.3% by weight, optionally up to 100ppm calcium, and up to 0.02% unavoidable impurities, the balance being aluminum, and wherein the coating weight of the metal coating is 50g/m  2  to 500g/m  2  for the sum of the two sides of the steel sheet.

title_en: Preparation method of nano zinc oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano zinc oxide. In particular to a preparation method of nano zinc oxide, which comprises the following steps of mixing an alkali solution with a mixed solution containing zinc salt and polyvinylpyrrolidone in a microreactor, and reacting at 120-180 ℃ to prepare the nano zinc oxide. The preparation method of the nano zinc oxide meets one or more of the following advantages that (1) the prepared nano zinc oxide is low in size and uniform in particle size distribution, (2) the reaction time is short, (3) the efficiency is high, and (4) the preparation method is safe and can be industrially amplified.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ionic liquid modified thorium-based MOF material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an ionic liquid modified thorium-based MOF material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) reacting water-soluble thorium salt with tetra [4- (4' -carboxyphenyl) phenyl ] ethylene in the presence of an acidic regulator and a solvent to obtain the thorium-based MOF material, (2) reacting the thorium-based MOF material with the ionic liquid in the presence of the solvent to obtain the ionic liquid modified thorium-based MOF material, wherein the ionic liquid is one or more of terminal halogenated 1-alkyl 3-methylimidazole ionic liquids [ MIM (CH  2 ) n  X ] Y, n=2-6, X is Cl, br or I, and Y is Cl, br or I. The thorium-based MOF material prepared by the method and the ionic liquid modified thorium-based MOF material have stable crystalline structures, and the terminal halogenated ionic liquid modified thorium-based MOF material has excellent photocurrent response and multiple active sites, can be used as a photocatalyst to efficiently catalyze and reduce carbon dioxide to generate carbon monoxide and methane, and has good circulation stability.

title_en: Hollow microsphere with low thermal conductivity and low emissivity as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow microsphere with low thermal conductivity and low emissivity, and a preparation method and application thereof. The hollow microsphere comprises a hollow core, a glass sphere shell layer, a porous silicon oxide layer and a metal layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, wherein the metal layer consists of a plurality of metal areas which are mutually and physically isolated. The hollow microsphere has the advantages of low density, high mechanical stability, low thermal conductivity and low emissivity, and good cooperative control capability of heat conduction and heat radiation heat transfer.

title_en: Equipment and method for preparing cement lightweight aggregate by using power plant incineration slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses equipment and a method for preparing cement lightweight aggregate by utilizing power plant incineration slag, which comprise a bottom frame, an installation rail arranged on the bottom frame, a long plate and an elliptic plate which are respectively arranged at the upper part and the middle part of the installation rail, wherein a transmission groove formed in the long plate and the elliptic plate jointly form a transmission groove, a chain wheel transmission assembly is arranged in the transmission groove, and a plurality of preparation mixing basket assemblies which are arranged at the front side of the chain wheel transmission assembly and can be kept horizontal are also included. According to the invention, through the sequential actions of the preparation mixing basket assembly, the pretreatment device and the mixing material preparation device, the residual metal AI and sulfide content in the slag can be effectively reduced by the pretreated slag, the apparent density of the mixed sand is reduced under the action of the mixing material preparation device, and the particles are matched with each other to fill gaps, so that the grading is improved, the void ratio is reduced, and the performance of the mixed sand is improved.

title_en: Method for preparing geopolymer from waste glass and curing waste soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing geopolymer by waste glass for curing treatment of waste soil, which comprises the following steps of performing thermochemical treatment on waste glass by alkali to prepare sodium silicate powder; uniformly mixing the prepared sodium silicate powder with industrial waste rich in active silicon dioxide and aluminum oxide according to a proportion to obtain waste glass derivative polymer, uniformly mixing waste soil and waste glass derivative polymer according to a proportion, filling the mixture into a mould, compacting, demoulding and curing to obtain the waste glass derivative polymer solidified soil. According to the invention, the sodium silicate powder prepared from the waste glass is mixed with the industrial waste to generate the polymer derived from the waste glass, and the waste soil is solidified, so that the problem of disposal of the waste glass and the waste soil is solved on the one hand, the resource utilization way of the waste glass is widened, and the utilization rate of the waste glass is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of copper nano sheet and copper nano sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a copper nano sheet and the copper nano sheet, the method prepares the copper nano-sheet by adopting chemical reaction of copper salt, a protective agent, a blocking agent and a reducing agent in a solution. The method uses halogen ions (specifically bromide ions or iodide ions) as the end capping agent, so that the environmental pollution and waste emission in the production process are remarkably reduced, the high cleanness of the surface of the copper nano sheet is ensured due to the avoidance of long-chain end capping agents, the yield and purity of the copper nano sheet are further improved, the precise regulation and control of the particle size of the copper nano sheet in the range of 100nm to 50 mu m are realized by controlling different reduction systems, the copper nano sheet can flexibly adapt to diversified industrial application requirements, excellent high efficiency and wide applicability are shown, in addition, the raw material cost adopted by the method is low, the overall production cost is effectively controlled, and a solid foundation is laid for the large-scale and continuous production of the copper nano sheet.

title_en: High-cleanliness glue discharging and annealing dual-purpose heat treatment furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-cleanliness glue discharging and annealing dual-purpose heat treatment furnace, which comprises a furnace shell, wherein a fireproof heat preservation layer is arranged on the inner side of the furnace shell, and an isolation layer for blocking oil gas from a hearth to enter the fireproof heat preservation layer is arranged on the inner side of the fireproof heat preservation layer. Through set up the isolation layer in refractory insulation inboard, can effectively block oil gas from furnace entering refractory insulation to avoided the condensation and the secondary in refractory insulation of oil gas to spill over, guaranteed the cleanliness factor in the furnace in the annealing process, improved the heat treatment quality of metal material. Therefore, the heat treatment furnace disclosed by the invention can be used for discharging glue and annealing at the same time, so that the transferring step between the two processes is omitted, the production efficiency can be improved, and the energy consumption can be reduced.

title_en: Process for treating hypophosphite by potassium permanganate method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for treating hypophosphite by a potassium permanganate method, and relates to the technical field of hypophosphite. Step one, pretreatment, step two, oxidation reaction, step three, pH adjustment, step four, precipitation separation, step five, oxidant addition, step six, flocculation precipitation, step seven, solid-liquid separation, including bearing structure, fixed baseplate stirring structure is installed to the inboard bolt at bearing structure top, the feed divider structure is installed to bearing structure's top bolt, bearing structure includes fixed baseplate, through when using potassium permanganate method to handle, utilizes the storage bucket to distribute the inner chamber of buret with the material, utilizes buret to measure the material use amount to measure the use amount that detects through infrared detector, lets the control panel control the timing emission groove, makes it monitor the material of discharging and reduces the use amount of manual work preparation material.

title_en: Positive electrode material of sodium ion secondary battery, preparation method of positive electrode material, sodium ion secondary battery and electric equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a positive electrode material of a sodium ion secondary battery, a preparation method of the positive electrode material, the sodium ion secondary battery and electric equipment, and relates to the field of sodium ion batteries. The chemical formula of the positive electrode material of the sodium ion secondary battery provided by the application is Na  a Ni x Fe y Mn z M 1‑x‑y‑   z O 2 , wherein a is more than or equal to 0.9 and less than or equal to a 1.05,0< x <1.0,0< y <1.0,0< z <1.0,0< 1-x-the y-z is less than 1, and M is a metal element with the valence more than or equal to 2. The positive electrode active material of the positive electrode material of the sodium ion secondary battery provided by the application is doped with metal elements with the valence of +2, +3, +4, +5 or +6 to regulate the molar quantity of O  ‑  ions in lattice oxygen relative to O  2‑  to be less than or equal to 2.5% when the positive electrode material is in a full-electric state, so that the bonding strength of the doped metal elements and oxygen is improved, the content of high-activity O  ‑  free oxygen is reduced, and the sodium-electric O3 structure has stronger structural stability.

title_en: Lead-acid battery recycling equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides lead-acid battery recycling equipment, which is characterized in that a plurality of water tanks are arranged on a cleaning tank, overflow ports are arranged at the top of one side, close to the upstream, of the water tanks, each stirring device comprises a plurality of stirring structures, each stirring structure is arranged in a corresponding water tank, each stirring structure is used for taking up materials in each water tank and conveying the materials to the position of the corresponding water tank, each flushing device comprises a plurality of spraying pipes, each spraying pipe is arranged above the corresponding water tank and used for spraying water to flush materials in a lower way, a first water receiving tray and a second water receiving tray are arranged below the cleaning tank, each first water receiving tray is used for receiving overflow liquid of at least two water tanks at the tail end and used for flushing the upstream part, each second water receiving tray is used for receiving overflow liquid of the other water tanks, and liquid at the first water receiving tray is pumped by the flushing device and sprayed to the water tanks corresponding to the second water receiving tray.

title_en: Composite material with adjustable porosity, its preparation and use
abstract_en: Provided herein are composite materials for use in electrical energy storage systems (e.g., high capacity batteries) and methods for making the same. The composite material of the present disclosure comprises a three-dimensional carbon network and optionally silicon particles. The composite material further comprises macropores, at least some of which are formed by carbonizing sacrificial particles dispersed throughout the three-dimensional network. The macropores advantageously provide space for accommodating strain and stress in the electrode structure due to volume changes of silicon (particles) during charging and discharging of the electrical energy storage system.

title_en: Silica composite material with high-efficiency heat protection and wave transmission performance for radome
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon dioxide composite material for a radome with high-efficiency heat protection and wave transmission performance, and belongs to the technical field of high-temperature radomes and structural wave transmission composite materials. The invention prepares the preform by using a needling lamination process, thereby overcoming the defect of unsatisfactory effect of mechanical properties between 2D fabric structural layers. The high-efficiency thermal protection and wave-transparent silicon dioxide composite material prepared by the method has excellent comprehensive performance, low dielectric loss tangent value and dielectric constant and excellent mechanical property, and is a novel multifunctional material. The invention plays an important role in the radio systems of space aircrafts such as radomes, carrier rockets, spacecraft, missiles, return satellites and the like.

title_en: Blast furnace hearth slag iron control method, blast furnace hearth slag iron control equipment, storage medium and blast furnace hearth slag iron control product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blast furnace hearth slag iron control method, equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting production parameters when raw materials are planned to be put into a blast furnace to smelt steel, calculating a first volume of slag iron theoretically generated in the blast furnace according to the production parameters, measuring a second volume of slag iron actually discharged by the blast furnace when the blast furnace finishes smelting steel, calculating the height of residual slag iron in a hearth of the blast furnace according to the difference between the first volume and the second volume, and executing control operation on the blast furnace according to the residual slag iron and the height. The method comprises the steps of collecting various production parameters in the process of pouring raw materials into a blast furnace to smelt steel, calculating the first volume of theoretical slag iron based on the parameters, combining the second volume of slag iron which is actually discharged after the blast furnace smelting is finished, comparing the two volumes to calculate the height of residual slag iron in a hearth, improving the accuracy of detecting the height of residual slag iron in the hearth of the blast furnace and improving the safety of the blast furnace to smelt steel.

title_en: Rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforced manganese steel-based composite lining plate and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforced manganese steel base composite lining plate, which comprises a manganese steel base body and a plurality of rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforcements embedded in the manganese steel base body, wherein each rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforcement consists of a ceramic shell and a rubber core coated in the ceramic shell, the rubber core and the ceramic shell form gradient transition, and meanwhile, the ceramic shell and the connected manganese steel base body also form gradient transition.
