The invention also provides a preparation method of the rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforced manganese steel-based composite lining plate and application of the rubber-ceramic core-shell structure reinforced manganese steel-based composite lining plate as a semi-autogenous mill feeding trolley lining plate material. The lining board combines the characteristics of manganese steel, ceramic and rubber, fully exerts the wear resistance of the ceramic, the impact resistance of the rubber and the work hardening effect of the manganese steel, and remarkably prolongs the service life of the lining board.

title_en: Method for reducing tundish slag in ladle exchange process
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for reducing tundish slag in a ladle exchange process, which solves the technical problem of slag in the ladle exchange process in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of stopping pouring and rising a first ladle, gradually descending a second ladle above a tundish, simultaneously blowing air to a long nozzle of the second ladle until the long nozzle of the second ladle is inserted below 280-320 mm of the liquid level in the tundish, connecting the long nozzle of the second ladle with a skimming device comprising a connecting section and a skimming section which are connected, reducing the outer diameter of the skimming section from top to bottom in sequence, opening a sliding plate of the second ladle to enable molten steel in the second ladle to flow into the tundish through the long nozzle to finish ladle exchange, and reducing slag by the blowing air amount when the insertion depth H of the long nozzle is not more than 150mm and the blowing air amount when the insertion depth H of the long nozzle is more than 150 mm. The method provided by the application can reduce the slag quantity of molten steel, improve the cleanliness of the molten steel and reduce the stamping cracking rate of finished products.

title_en: Biochar electroactive bacteria complex for strengthening degradation of hydrophobic organic pollutants and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biochar electroactive bacteria complex for strengthening degradation of hydrophobic organic pollutants and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of (1) pyrolyzing lignocellulose-based biomass under a high-temperature anaerobic condition to obtain original biochar, (2) mixing the original biochar, naNO  3 , concentrated sulfuric acid and KMnO  4  under an ice bath condition to perform a first oxidation reaction, keeping continuous stirring, (3) adding a sulfuric acid solution for a second oxidation reaction of the biochar, adding an H  2 O 2  solution to terminate the reaction after the temperature is reduced by 60 ℃, and (4) cleaning the modified biochar material with a mixed solution of sulfuric acid and H  2 O 2 , an HCl solution and deionized water respectively until the pH value is neutral, thereby finally obtaining the modified biochar material. The invention combines the advantages of physical adsorption and biodegradation, and provides a high-efficiency, green and sustainable solution for removing hydrophobic organic pollutants in water.

title_en: Industrial tailing premixed mortar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses industrial tailing premixed mortar and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of building material preparation. The cementing material of the industrial tailing premixed mortar is prepared from an industrial waste slag raw material to replace part of cement, and is uniformly mixed with a ternary composite alkali-activated agent and a series of additives, wherein the premixed mortar comprises the components of cement, industrial tailing ultrafine powder, alkali-activated agent, cellulose and water reducer, and the preparation method specifically comprises the steps of activating the industrial waste slag raw material, preparing a ternary composite alkali-activated agent solution, preparing, shaping and curing premixed mortar slurry, and optimizing the process for preparing the premixed mortar. The inorganic cementing material is environment-friendly, energy-saving and environment-friendly, is favorable for reducing carbon emission, has popularization value, accords with the current social development trend, and has good economic benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Composition, ceramsite and preparation method of ceramsite
abstract_en: The application provides a composition which comprises Ca (OH)  2 、CaCO 3  and free carbon in a mass ratio of 32-45:5-10:9-15. The application also provides a composition, a ceramsite composition, ceramsite and a preparation method of the ceramsite. According to the application, ca (OH)  2 、CaCO 3  and free carbon with the mass ratio of 32-45:5-10:9-15 are used as gas generating substances, bentonite, fly ash and red mud are matched to prepare the ceramsite, the gas generating substances have good gas generating effect, the density of the obtained ceramsite can be improved and the strength of the ceramsite can be improved under the condition of low consumption, for example, the stacking density of the ceramsite is 400kg/m  3 ～600kg/m 3 , the water absorption rate is 3-12%, and the barrel pressure strength is 3.0-6.0 MPa.

title_en: CO of hydrogen-enriched carbon circulating oxygen blast furnace2Method and system for circularly blowing iron
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CO  2  circulation blowing iron-smelting method of a hydrogen-rich carbon circulation oxygen blast furnace, which is characterized in that CO  2  separated and trapped in top gas of the blast furnace is heated to more than 2500 ℃, then is circularly blown into the blast furnace from a tuyere, and the residual CO and H  2  in the top gas of the blast furnace are further purified and purified to prepare chemical products. The invention also discloses a CO  2  circulating blowing iron smelting system of the hydrogen-rich carbon circulating oxygen blast furnace. The invention solves the problems that the carbon emission reduction potential of the hydrogen-rich carbon circulating oxygen blast furnace process is not fully utilized, and the CO  2  separated and trapped in the top gas is not fully utilized.

title_en: Method for efficiently extracting lithium from lithium-containing mother liquor by carbon dioxide catalysis without alkali consumption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrometallurgy, and particularly discloses a method for efficiently extracting lithium from lithium-containing mother liquor by catalyzing alkali consumption-free carbon dioxide, which comprises the following steps of S1, introducing carbon dioxide into the lithium-containing mother liquor to adjust the pH of the lithium-containing mother liquor; S2, mixing a polyfluoro-substituted diketone extractant, a synergistic extractant and a diluent to prepare the extractant, S3, mixing the prepared extractant with the lithium-containing mother liquor with the pH adjusted to extract according to a certain ratio to obtain raffinate and loaded organic, washing and back-extracting the loaded organic to obtain lithium-containing back-extract, and S4, preparing battery-grade lithium sulfate or battery-grade lithium hydroxide or battery-grade lithium carbonate. The invention adopts carbon dioxide to adjust pH, does not need to consume a large amount of acid and alkali, can recycle the carbon dioxide generated in the extraction process, can prepare the battery-grade lithium carbonate or lithium hydroxide monohydrate and battery-grade lithium sulfate products with high purity, has the advantages of easy control of the whole extraction system, simple operation, short process flow and high lithium recovery rate, and has breakthrough significance in the battery recovery industry.

title_en: High-doping-amount salt gypsum-based roadbed material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-doping-amount salt gypsum roadbed material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of salt gypsum roadbed materials, wherein the roadbed material comprises, by mass, 85% of salt gypsum and 15% of binder, the binder comprises slag and carbide slag, the mass ratio of the slag to the carbide slag is 1:7, the high-doping-amount salt gypsum roadbed material further comprises sodium silicate and cationic neoprene latex, and the mass ratio of the salt gypsum, the sodium silicate and the cationic neoprene latex is 85:1-3:2-4. The invention also provides a preparation method of the roadbed material. The invention uses high-doped salt gypsum and slag and carbide slag, to realize the resource utilization of solid waste, and improve the water resistance and compression strength of roadbed material.

title_en: Preparation of hard-carbonized anode material based on petroleum coke (raw coke) and application of sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a hard carbonized negative electrode material based on petroleum coke (green coke) and application of a sodium ion battery. The invention takes petroleum coke (raw coke) as a raw material, preoxidizes and carbonizes at high temperature in an oxygen-containing atmosphere to obtain a hard-carbon anode material, and prepares a low-cost sodium ion battery by using the material. The preparation method is simple in preparation process, green and environment-friendly in raw materials, and suitable for mass production, and the prepared hard-carbonized material has excellent electrochemical performance when applied to sodium ion batteries and can be used as a negative electrode material of the sodium ion batteries.

title_en: Magnesium-based hydrotalcite for treating multi-metal co-pollution and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and soil remediation, in particular to a magnesium-based hydrotalcite for treating multi-metal CO-pollution, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the magnesium-based hydrotalcite is used for treating complex working conditions of multi-metal anion-cation CO-pollution, the magnesium-based hydrotalcite is prepared by regulating and controlling trivalent metal elements of a magnesium-based hydrotalcite host laminate and guest interlayer anions, wherein the trivalent metal elements are one of Al (III), fe (III) and the like, and the guest interlayer anions are one of CO  3   2‑ 、NO 3   ‑  and the like. Preferably, the magnesium-based hydrotalcite is MgAl-CO  3 、MgAl-NO 3 、MgFe-CO 3  or MgFe-NO  3 . The LDHs-based material can hyperstable mineralize heavy metal ions, is suitable for rapidly, efficiently and stably removing various heavy metals at the same time, and mineralized products have extremely low K  sp  (about 10  ‑50 ), so that secondary pollution caused by re-dissolution of the heavy metals is avoided.

title_en: In-situ MOF-74 derived carbon coating for graphite surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ MOF-74 derived carbon coating for a graphite surface and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of cleaning a porous graphite substrate, drying, depositing metal zinc on the surface of the porous graphite substrate by adopting an electrochemical deposition method, washing and drying after the process is finished, soaking the porous graphite substrate in a methanol solution of 2, 5-dihydroxyterephthalic acid, dissolving zinc on the surface of a graphite sheet into zinc ions, bonding the zinc ions with a2, 5-dihydroxyterephthalic acid ligand, growing an MOF-74 coating on the surface of the graphite sheet in situ, cleaning and drying to obtain a graphite sheet with the MOF-74 grown on the surface in situ, and carrying out pyrolysis carbonization to obtain the porous graphite sheet. According to the method, metal zinc is introduced into the graphite surface by utilizing an electrochemical deposition method, MOF-74 is grown in situ on the graphite surface by utilizing the characteristic of rapid nucleation of the MOF-74 material through a simple liquid phase reaction, and further high-temperature heat treatment is carried out in an inert gas atmosphere, so that the in-situ coating of the hard carbon coating on the graphite surface is realized, and the method has the advantages of rapid reaction, simplicity in operation and good application prospect in the field of construction of the surface coating of the graphite material.

title_en: Internal circulation fluidized bed and method for calcium circulation catalytic methane dry reforming
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal circulating fluidized bed and a method for calcium circulating catalytic methane dry reforming, wherein the internal circulating fluidized bed comprises an external reactor and an internal reactor, the external reactor is sleeved outside the internal reactor, the inside of the internal reactor is used as a carbon capturing zone for carrying out carbon dioxide adsorption reaction, the area between the internal reactor and the external reactor is used as a carbon conversion zone for carrying out methane dry reforming and catalyst regeneration reaction, the bottoms of the carbon capturing zone and the carbon conversion zone are communicated through a circulating feed inlet, a discharge port at the top of the carbon capturing zone is connected with a gas-solid separator, a solid outlet of the gas-solid separator is connected with the carbon conversion zone, an exhaust gas inlet and an air distribution plate are arranged at the bottom of the internal reactor, a raw material gas inlet is arranged at the bottom of the side wall of the external reactor, and a synthetic gas outlet and a feed inlet are arranged at the top of the external reactor.

title_en: High-quality organic-inorganic hybrid perovskite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor materials, and discloses a high-quality organic-inorganic hybrid perovskite material and a preparation method thereof. Co  2+  and H  2 NCHNH 2   +  ions are simultaneously doped in a CH  3 NH 3 PbX 3  (wherein X is Cl, br or I) perovskite material, wherein Co  2+  ions occupy the lattice site of perovskite B to strengthen the perovskite lattice, intrinsic defects and grain boundary defects of the perovskite material are reduced, and H  2 NCHNH 2   +  ions occupy the lattice site of perovskite A to inhibit lattice distortion caused by doping Co  2+  and reduce Co  2+  ion defects. Therefore ,(CH 3 NH 3 ) 1‑a (H 2 NCHNH 2 ) a Pb 1‑b Co b X 3 (0<a<1,0<b<1) perovskite materials have high quality and good stability. The high-quality perovskite material and the preparation method thereof disclosed by the patent provide a material and a process foundation for preparing a perovskite photoelectric device with high performance and stability.

title_en: Heat insulation baffle plate for magnesium ingot smelting reduction tank, baffle plate extractor and magnesium ingot reduction device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat insulation baffle plate for a magnesium ingot smelting reduction tank, a baffle plate extractor and a magnesium ingot reduction device. The heat insulation baffle plate for the magnesium ingot smelting reduction tank comprises a shell and a filter screen, wherein the size of the shell is matched with the size of a tank opening of the reduction tank, when the shell is installed, the shell is in transition fit with the tank opening of the reduction tank, one end of the shell is provided with an air inlet for magnesium vapor in the reduction tank to enter the shell, and the center of the other end of the shell is provided with an air outlet for guiding the magnesium vapor to be input into a crystallization barrel. The heat insulation baffle plate provided by the invention can force magnesium vapor in the reduction tank to enter the shell only through the air inlet and then enter the crystallization barrel through the air outlet. Because the position design of the air outlet is just to the center of the crystallization barrel, the magnesium vapor which is diffused everywhere originally can be intensively guided into the crystallization barrel, and the crystallization of the magnesium vapor on the outer wall of the crystallization barrel is avoided, thereby greatly reducing the generation of big head magnesium.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for determining adding amount of refining agent in furnace
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining the adding amount of a furnace refining agent. The method comprises the step of collecting various data (such as the adding amount condition, the basic data, the stirring intensity and the temperature in the furnace) and the ambient humidity of the refining agent in the refining process, and evaluating the natural adhesion condition, namely the first adhesion rate, of the refining agent in the refining process based on the basic data (granularity, surface roughness and category) of the refining agent, the stirring intensity and the temperature in the furnace. Further, by considering the influence of the environmental humidity on the adhesion condition of the refining agent, determining the second adhesion rate accordingly, enhancing the practicability and accuracy of the method, calculating the adjustment amount of the refining agent by combining the first adhesion rate and the second adhesion rate, and determining the actual addition amount of the refining agent accordingly, thereby ensuring the accuracy and rationality of the addition amount of the refining agent and being beneficial to improving the refining effect and the product quality.

title_en: High-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery electrode materials. Aiming at the problems of poor circulating performance and water resistance of the existing sodium iron sulfate under high multiplying power, the high-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material comprises sodium zinc calcium zinc sulfate particles and carbon nanotubes, wherein the mass ratio of the sodium iron sulfate particles to the carbon nanotubes is 85-95:5-15. The method comprises the steps of ball milling anhydrous ferrous sulfate, anhydrous sodium sulfate, anhydrous calcium phosphate, anhydrous zinc phosphate and carbon nanotubes in an inert atmosphere ball milling tank to obtain a roasting precursor, and then placing the roasting precursor in an inert atmosphere tube furnace for roasting at 360-400 ℃ for 16-24 hours to obtain the ferric zinc calcium sodium sulfate phosphate composite electrode material. The electrode material provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and convenient preparation method, low cost, good air stability and rate capability, good cycle stability (6000 times) and the like, and has stronger market competitiveness in the field of large-scale energy storage application.

title_en: Positive electrode composite material and electrolyte of water-based zinc ion battery and application of positive electrode composite material and electrolyte
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anode composite material of a water system zinc ion battery, electrolyte and application thereof. According to the invention, an ion pre-insertion method and a heterostructure design are adopted, vanadium pentoxide and zinc citrate are mixed and heated for reaction, so that the ZVO@ZVOH composite material is formed. The material has rich heterogeneous boundaries and active sites, and can be used as a positive electrode material of a zinc ion battery, so that the chemical dissolution problem in the circulating process of the vanadium-based compound is remarkably solved. The heterogeneous boundary in the ZVO@ZVOH is beneficial to electron transport, more Zn  2+  storage sites are provided, so that the rate performance is effectively improved, and ZVOH is used for effectively inhibiting the dissolution problem of the positive electrode in the circulating process, so that the circulating stability is effectively improved. And the mixed Zn (CF  3 SO 3 ) 2  and ZnSO  4  electrolyte can effectively reduce the dissolution of ZVO@ZVOH and inhibit the dendrite growth of Zn cathode.

title_en: Low-carbon gel material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon gel material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of metallurgy. The method comprises the steps of fully mixing industrial solid waste with metal alkaline hydroxide, silicon oxide and coal dust according to a certain proportion to obtain a mixed material, roasting the mixed material at a certain temperature, grinding to obtain roasted industrial solid waste, wherein the roasting temperature is 300-1000 ℃, the roasting time is 1-8 hours, adding an alkali-exciting agent into the roasted industrial solid waste, fully mixing, and carrying out hydration maintenance to obtain the high-strength low-carbon gel material. The preparation method of the low-carbon gel material adopts multi-industrial solid waste synergistic heat treatment, and the potential activity of the solid waste is greatly excited by a method of synergistic heat treatment of various solid waste and additives, the synergistic gel effect between the solid waste is exerted, and the potential activity of the solid waste can be greatly excited under the action of a conventional alkali excitant and low-temperature roasting, so that the high-strength low-carbon gel material is obtained.

title_en: Method for preparing iron oxide red pigment by utilizing iron-precipitating slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing iron oxide red pigment by utilizing iron-precipitating slag, and belongs to the technical field of iron oxide pigments. The invention takes hematite method iron slag and sulfuric acid aqueous solution as raw materials, and carries out hydrothermal reaction in an autoclave at 200-220 ℃, solid-liquid separation is carried out after the reaction is finished, and the iron oxide red pigment is obtained by drying. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out normal-pressure acid washing to remove salts such as zinc sulfate, sulfate and the like adsorbed on the surface of the hematite process iron-precipitation slag, then carrying out a high-temperature hydrothermal reaction to decompose and dissolve iron-containing phases in the iron-precipitation slag, converting ferric ions into ferric oxide under a high-temperature hydrothermal condition, and increasing the content of ferric oxide in an iron oxide red product, wherein the prepared iron oxide red pigment has very good high-temperature resistance, can resist 500 ℃ high temperature, and can be widely applied to some high-temperature resistant fields.

title_en: Gas recovery regulation and control method and system based on automatic control and data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas recovery regulation and control method and a system based on automatic control and data processing, which relate to the technical field of industrial gas recovery regulation and control, wherein in the process of collecting N times of historical operation, characteristic gas characteristic points are collected from a basic detection system to a calibration system, historical detection data in the process of circulating from the calibration system to a front end detection system of a switching valve are collected in the actual operation process, actual comparison detection data in the process of circulating from the basic detection system to the calibration system of the characteristic gas characteristic points are collected, a similar historical operation process set is screened out according to the actually detected time from the basic detection system to the calibration system and the time comparison from the basic detection system to the calibration system in the historical operation process, and the action time is calculated based on the historical detection data of the similar historical operation process set; the purpose of improving the recovery amount of industrial gas and preventing extreme safety accidents is achieved.

title_en: 5.5Ni steel with excellent ultralow-temperature impact toughness, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses 5.5Ni steel with excellent ultralow-temperature impact toughness, and a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical components of the 5.5Ni steel comprise, by mass, 0.04% -0.1% of C, 0.04% -0.15% of Si, 0.5% -1.5% of Mn, 5.0% -6.0% of Ni, 0.2% -0.3% of Mo, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities. The preparation method comprises smelting, thermo-mechanical treatment and heat treatment by a quenching-two-phase zone quenching-tempering process. According to the 5.5Ni steel provided by the invention, only a certain mass fraction of Mo element is added, the problems of insufficient hardenability and strength caused by Ni element reduction are solved, and the difficult problem of low-temperature toughness faced by replacing 9Ni steel with 5.5Ni steel is solved by a QLT heat treatment process of thermo-mechanical treatment and quenching-two-phase zone quenching-tempering process, so that the impact absorption work of-196 ℃ of the 5.5Ni steel reaches more than 250J, the yield strength is more than 580MPa at room temperature, and the requirements of the steel for LNG storage tanks on the strength and the low-temperature toughness are met.

title_en: Stainless steel powder treatment device and method for balance weight production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stainless steel powder treatment devices, in particular to a stainless steel powder treatment device and a method for producing a balance weight, the stainless steel powder treatment device comprises a tank body, wherein a stirring frame is arranged on the tank body, a top shell is fixedly arranged at the top end of the tank body, a screen is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the top shell, a driving motor is arranged on the top shell, an auger frame matched with the top shell and the screen is fixedly arranged at the output end of the driving motor, and a side shell is fixedly arranged on the top shell; according to the invention, the driving motor is controlled to operate, the screw thread blocks are driven to move through the transmission of the reciprocating screw rod, so that the screw thread blocks can drive the arc frame to move along the screen, and the arc frame drives the clamping blocks to be clamped and moved with the screen holes on the screen by using the first springs, so that the clamping blocks can clean the stainless steel powder blocked in the screen holes by using the elasticity of the first springs, and the stainless steel powder is prevented from being conveyed to be blocked.

title_en: Manufacturing method and equipment for titanium alloy piece
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of titanium alloy preparation, in particular to a method and equipment for manufacturing a titanium alloy piece. The manufacturing method of the titanium alloy part adopts the processes of powder paving and laser heating to print and manufacture the titanium alloy part, and comprises the following steps: firstly, a layer of titanium alloy powder is paved on a substrate, the paved powder is melted by laser according to a set path, and the melted powder is solidified to form a titanium alloy sample. And (3) performing repeated powder spreading and laser heating processes to print and manufacture the required titanium alloy piece. During the manufacturing process, the titanium alloy sample is heated and pressed flat when printed to a specified number of layers. The surface of the titanium alloy sample is heated, so that some unmelted particles in the titanium alloy sample can be melted, and then the surface of the titanium alloy sample is flattened in a pressing flattening mode, so that the melted particles can fill a part of air holes, and the quality of the manufactured titanium alloy is improved.

title_en: Anti-cracking additive for secondary lining concrete of tunnel, construction and acceptance checking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crack-resistant additive for secondary lining concrete of a tunnel, construction and acceptance method, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel construction, wherein the crack-resistant additive is prepared according to the time from a production machine to the time when concrete is conveyed into a pump truck and the temperature when the concrete is conveyed into the pump truck, can resist the negative influence that a crack-resistant functional material is excessively consumed prematurely and excessively quickly due to long-time transportation, stirring and shearing of a stirring tank truck and high temperature, and further improves the crack resistance of the concrete. The invention can realize the technical effects that the crack resistance of the secondary lining concrete of the tunnel can be improved, the shrinkage crack can be restrained, the crack resistance effect can be checked and accepted, and the technical scheme can be popularized.

title_en: Super-retarding type ester polycarboxylate superplasticizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of concrete additives, in particular to an ultra-retarding type ester polycarboxylate superplasticizer and a preparation method thereof. The super-retarding ester polycarboxylate water reducer is prepared by polymerizing a comonomer under the action of an initiator, a chain transfer agent and an emulsifier, wherein the comonomer comprises an ester macromonomer, polyoxyalkyl ether containing ester groups and a rigid benzene ring structure, an ester small monomer and unsaturated acid. The super-retarding type ester polycarboxylate water reducer can effectively improve the initial dispersion performance and slump retaining performance of concrete, improve the strength of the concrete, reduce the sensitivity of the concrete and have good long-acting slump retaining effect. The super-retarding type ester polycarboxylate superplasticizer can be prepared by reaction at normal temperature, the reaction condition is mild, and the energy is effectively saved.

title_en: Control process for improving shrinkage defect of bearing steel hot-rolled blank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control process for improving shrinkage defects of a bearing steel hot rolled blank, which comprises a heating step, wherein the heating step adopts a two-stage heating and soaking process, when the temperature of a casting blank is more than or equal to 500 ℃, the temperature of one stage of heating is controlled according to 800-1000 ℃, the total heating time is controlled according to 5-6 hours, the casting blank is free from empty steps in a heating furnace, when the temperature of the casting blank is less than 500 ℃, the casting blank is slowly cooled to room temperature, the temperature of one stage of heating is controlled according to 500-800 ℃, the total heating time is controlled according to 6-7 hours, the matched rolling casting blank is added before and after the casting blank in the furnace, and no empty steps exist among all casting blanks. The method does not need to increase equipment and investment, fully utilizes the prior equipment and process, adopts reasonable steel billet charging temperature, heating furnace sectional heating parameter control, special steel charging mode and heating time control, effectively solves the shrinkage cavity of the bearing steel hot-rolled billet, solves the subsequent quality risk and reduces the quality loss.

title_en: High-strength high-conductivity heat-resistant aluminum-based composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength high-conductivity heat-resistant aluminum-based composite material, which is formed by composite sintering of 90-95wt% of an aluminum alloy matrix and 5-10wt% of a conductive fiber film. Zr, hf and B elements are added in trace amount in the aluminum alloy matrix, so that the effects of refining grains, purifying impurities and improving the conductivity, heat resistance and comprehensive mechanical properties of the alloy matrix can be achieved. The conductive fiber membrane is a polyaniline/polyacrylonitrile composite conductive fiber membrane doped with nano copper particles and cerium oxide particles, the strength and stability of the fiber membrane can be improved through polyaniline and polyacrylonitrile blending spinning, and the conductivity of the fiber membrane and the bonding strength of the fiber membrane and an aluminum alloy matrix can be further improved through doping of the nano copper particles and the cerium oxide particles. The aluminum-based composite material has good conductivity, heat resistance and excellent comprehensive mechanical properties.

title_en: Iron-containing catalyst, preparation method and application thereof, and ammonia decomposition hydrogen production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ammonia decomposition catalyst preparation, and discloses an iron-containing catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, and a method for preparing hydrogen by ammonia decomposition. The iron-containing catalyst comprises a magnesium titanate carrier and iron element loaded on the magnesium titanate carrier, wherein the iron content is 5-20 wt% based on the total weight of the catalyst and calculated on the iron element. The catalyst has higher activity, is applied to ammonia decomposition hydrogen production, and has higher ammonia decomposition conversion rate at low temperature and higher reaction space velocity.

title_en: Negative electrode material of sodium ion battery and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a sodium ion battery anode material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving sodium lignin sulfonate and a load material to obtain a mixed solution; and (3) carrying out spray drying on the mixed solution to obtain microsphere particles, heating the microsphere particles in a rotary furnace in an inert atmosphere to carbonize sodium lignin sulfonate and a load material, decomposing the sodium lignin sulfonate at the same time to obtain a pre-sodiumized inner core, and coating the pre-sodiumized inner core in the rotary furnace by chemical vapor deposition to obtain the sodium ion battery anode material. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple in process, and solves the problem of low initial efficiency of the negative electrode material of the sodium ion battery by performing pre-sodium treatment on the negative electrode material.

title_en: Sintered stone self-compacting concrete and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides sintered stone self-compacting concrete and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of constructional engineering and hydraulic engineering. The self-compacting concrete is prepared from the following components, by mass, 243 parts of cement, 233 parts of fly ash, 1055-1112 parts of sand, 515-623 parts of sintered stone, 204-210 parts of water, 6-8 parts of an additive and 5 parts of sodium silicate. When the self-compacting concrete for the calcined stone is prepared, the calcined stone is used as coarse aggregate, so that the preparation cost is reduced, and the porous structure of the calcined stone is beneficial to improving the contact area with the cementing material, thereby improving the compressive strength.

title_en: Method for melting iron material by composite stirring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for melting iron materials by composite stirring, which belongs to the field of electric furnace metallurgy in ferrous metallurgy. Meanwhile, a furnace wall oxygen lance or a burner or a carbon spraying gun side blowing device of the electric furnace is arranged, and the installation angle of the water-cooling matrix and the rear base plate in the horizontal direction is changed, so that the molten steel and the slag form rotary circulation. The shape and the number of the charging slide pipes are changed aiming at the solid iron material, so that the direction of the solid iron material added into the molten steel is changed to impact the molten pool, and the molten steel and the slag form rotary circulation. When the electrode of the electric furnace is heated, the electromagnetic field of direct current or alternating current generates Lorentz force, so that molten steel and slag of a molten pool form rotary circulation. Finally, the rotation directions of 4 kinds of circular currents formed by bottom blowing, side blowing, solid iron material flow and electromagnetic stirring are kept consistent, and under the action of electrode heating, the compound stirring and the solid iron material melting are enhanced, so that the iron material bonding problem is solved.

title_en: Deep oil removal treatment method and device for acidic water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid water oil removal treatment method and device in the petrochemical field, which mainly comprise an acid water booster pump, an acid water preheater, an acid water dealkylation tower and a condenser, wherein the acid water booster pump, the acid water preheater and the acid water dealkylation tower are sequentially connected through an acid water pipeline, and the top of the acid water dealkylation tower is directly connected with the condenser to form a whole. The invention can improve the purity of the byproduct acid gas in the purification section of the downstream acid water stripping device, reduce the hydrocarbon content in the acid gas and recycle most of oil and gas resources.

title_en: Polymer-coated solid waste-based phase change material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in temperature self-regulating asphalt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymer-coated solid waste-based phase change material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in temperature self-regulating asphalt, and belongs to the technical field of asphalt pavement materials. The polymer-coated solid waste-based phase change material comprises, by weight, 70-90 parts of phase change material, 20-35 parts of solid waste-based carrier material and 10-25 parts of shell material. The polymer-coated solid waste-based phase change material is mixed with a dispersing agent and petroleum asphalt to prepare the temperature self-regulating asphalt. After the temperature self-regulating asphalt is paved on a road surface for formal service, the phase change material fully utilizes the characteristics of multiple holes and supportability of solid waste base materials, simultaneously expands sustainable resource utilization paths, integrates and reduces the influence on environment and the waste of resources, and the material can undergo phase change reaction when the road surface is heated or cooled, so that the heat is absorbed or released, the self-regulation of the road temperature is realized, and the service life and the durability of the asphalt road surface are further improved.

title_en: Multistage continuous crystallization method of high-purity large-granularity ellipsoidal baking soda crystals
abstract_en: The invention provides a multistage continuous crystallization method of high-purity large-granularity ellipsoidal baking soda crystals. The continuous crystallization comprises a reaction crystallization process, a primary cooling crystallization process and a secondary cooling crystallization process which are arranged continuously, compared with intermittent crystallization, the continuous crystallization can improve the production efficiency of sodium bicarbonate crystals, reduce the difference between batches and reduce energy consumption, and in addition, the sodium bicarbonate crystals prepared by the continuous crystallization method are good in morphology, are in a monodisperse block shape, are uniform in particle size, have the average particle size of 300-450 microns, are good in product flowability, have the repose angle of 25-35 degrees, have the product purity of higher than 99.5%, and are less in impurity, and accord with the quality standard of Chinese pharmacopoeia.

title_en: Pressureless sintering welding method for aluminum nitride ceramics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressureless sintering welding method of aluminum nitride ceramics, which comprises the following steps of ball-milling mixed solder to obtain solder slurry, coating the solder slurry on an aluminum nitride substrate in a screen printing mode to form a solder coating, and performing pressureless sintering on the aluminum nitride substrate coated with the solder coating after drying treatment, wherein the solder slurry comprises solder and a solvent, and the solder comprises aluminum nitride, a sintering aid, a slow-drying agent and an oil-opening agent. The slow-drying agent and the oil-removing agent are additionally added into the solder used in the invention, meanwhile, the solder slurry is coated on the aluminum nitride ceramic matrix in a screen printing mode, the slow-drying agent and the oil-removing agent are beneficial to the uniformity of the coating of the solder slurry, the solder slurry is distributed on the aluminum nitride ceramic in a grid shape, the uniform distribution of the slurry in the subsequent pressureless sintering process is facilitated, the pressureless sintering mode is adopted in the invention, and the same pressureless sintering furnace equipment as that used in the aluminum nitride sintering process is used in the welding process, so that higher welding strength is realized.

title_en: Continuous annealing and continuous drawing production equipment for cable production
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cable production, in particular to continuous annealing and continuous drawing production equipment for cable production, which comprises a wire drawing machine, an annealing machine and a winding device, wherein the annealing machine is arranged between the wire drawing machine and the winding device, copper wires sequentially pass through the wire drawing machine, the annealing machine and the winding device and are fixedly connected with the winding device, a synchronous transmission device is arranged between the wire drawing machine and the annealing machine and comprises a driving shaft, a driven shaft and a synchronous belt, the driving shaft is arranged at a discharge hole of the wire drawing machine, the driven shaft is arranged at a feed hole of the annealing machine, the synchronous belt is connected with the driving shaft and the driven shaft, the driving shaft is connected with a driving device in the wire drawing machine, the driving shaft is connected with a wire outlet wheel, the driven shaft is connected with a steering wheel, the steering wheel is used for conveying the copper wires into the annealing machine, and the copper wires sequentially pass through the wire outlet wheel and the steering wheel. The continuous annealing and continuous drawing production equipment has the effects of reducing the labor intensity of workers and improving the production efficiency of cables.

title_en: Liquid level control method and automatic casting method for slab caster crystallizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid level control method and an automatic casting method of a slab continuous casting machine crystallizer, belonging to the technical field of metallurgy, wherein the control method comprises the steps of firstly raising the liquid level of the crystallizer from a liquid level initial value to a first liquid level set value in a liquid level control stage, secondly raising the liquid level of the crystallizer from the first liquid level set value to a second liquid level set value in the liquid level control stage, wherein the second liquid level set value is the liquid level when a casting blank starts to be pulled out, judging whether the parameters are abnormal, adjusting the opening degree of the stopper rod according to the judging result, performing crystallizer liquid level control, performing univariate statistical process control and multivariate statistical process control respectively through univariate analysis and multivariate analysis, and further adjusting and controlling the opening degree value of the stopper rod, so that the crystallizer liquid level control in automatic casting operation is realized, unnecessary shutdown and adjustment time are avoided, the efficiency of a continuous casting production line is improved to the maximum extent, the productivity of production equipment is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of the production line is greatly improved.

title_en: Pouring drainage device and method for molten steel tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pouring drainage device and a pouring drainage method for a molten steel tank, wherein an ejection cover plate is covered on the top of a nozzle pocket brick, the edge of the left half side of the ejection cover plate is matched with the nozzle pocket brick through a round corner connecting structure, the edge of the right half side of the ejection cover plate is matched with the nozzle pocket brick through a step connecting structure, an ejection gas impact area is arranged between the lower edge of the right half side of the ejection cover plate and the nozzle pocket brick, an ejection gas channel is arranged in a pocket brick sleeve, the ejection gas channel is communicated with one end of a semi-circular seam of the ejection gas channel, and the ejection gas impact area is communicated with the other end of the semi-circular seam of the ejection gas channel. The invention has the advantages that the drainage sand of the traditional drainage sand process can pollute molten steel, so that the oxygen content of the molten steel is increased, compared with the traditional drainage sand process, the invention almost completely eliminates the pollution of the drainage sand to the molten steel, has higher casting rate success rate than the traditional drainage method, and has simple equipment, less investment, simple operation, easy maintenance and low use cost.

title_en: Preparation method of quick-drying mortar based on aluminum hydroxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of quick-drying mortar based on aluminum hydroxide, which relates to the technical field of mortar preparation, and comprises the following steps of raw material preparation, river sand pretreatment, aluminum hydroxide pretreatment, mixing and stirring, auxiliary reagent addition and packaging: by adopting the jet milling dispersion method and combining the treatment mode of the spray drying tower and the surface modification of the silane coupling agent, the high-efficiency grinding, dispersing and surface modification of the aluminum hydroxide powder particles are realized, the method not only remarkably improves the dispersibility of the aluminum hydroxide powder and the interfacial adhesion with a cement matrix, the distribution uniformity of the aluminum hydroxide in the mortar is optimized, so that the overall mechanical property, durability and impermeability of the mortar are enhanced, and the aluminum hydroxide is pretreated by utilizing an airflow crushing and dispersing method, so that the particles are crushed and dispersed more uniformly, and the agglomeration phenomenon of the aluminum hydroxide in the mortar is prevented.

title_en: 1500 MPa-level zinc-based plated steel sheet excellent in low-temperature formability, method for producing same, hot forming method, and member
abstract_en: The invention provides a 1500 MPa-level zinc-based coated steel plate with excellent low-temperature forming performance, which comprises a substrate and a coating, wherein the substrate comprises, by weight, ：C：0.18％～0.24％,Si：0.15％～0.45％,Mn：1.50％～2.50％,P≤0.02％,S≤0.02％,Al：0.03％～1.50％,Nb：0.02～0.10％,Ti：0.02～0.10％,B≤0.005％,Cr：0.15％～0.60％, parts of Fe and other unavoidable impurities, and the coating comprises, by weight, 0.15-3.50% of Al, and the balance of Zn. The invention also provides a manufacturing method of the 1500 MPa-level zinc-based coated steel plate with excellent low-temperature forming performance, which comprises smelting, casting, hot rolling, pickling cold rolling and hot dip plating. And a hot stamping method of a 1500 MPa-level zinc-based coated steel plate with excellent low-temperature forming performance, which comprises the steps of steel plate heating, steel plate cooling and hot stamping. The hot stamping formed part produced by the method has tensile strength of more than 1500MPa, yield strength of more than 1000MPa, elongation of more than 6 percent and excellent delayed fracture resistance.

title_en: Toughened carbonaceous glass material
abstract_en: In some implementations, a carbon-containing glass material includes a surface-air interface and a mesophase region extending from the surface-air interface in a direction toward a depth within the carbon-containing glass material. The surface-air interface may be exposed to ambient air, and the mesophase region may include a plurality of few-layer graphene (FLG) nanoplatelets formed in response to recombination and/or self-nucleation of a plurality of carbon-containing radicals implanted within the mesophase region. The FLG nanoplatelets have an aperiodic orientation configured to at least partially inhibit microcrack and/or microporosity formation or propagation in the carbonaceous glass material. The glass material may further include a compressive stress layer disposed between the mesophase region and the surface and air interface of the carbon-containing glass material, the compressive stress layer being induced by ion bombardment of the carbon-containing glass material with a plurality of ionized inert gas particles.

title_en: Smelting process of sulfur-containing stainless steel continuous casting blank for granular material ring die
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smelting process of a sulfur-containing stainless steel continuous casting blank for a granular material ring die, wherein an alkaline electric furnace burden comprises three or more stages of scrap steel and pig iron, a carburant and lime are added into a furnace before charging, an induction furnace is switched to an alloy molten steel station after steel tapping of a steel ladle, the induction furnace burden comprises medium-carbon ferromanganese and medium-carbon ferrochrome, the alloy molten steel is discharged into the same steel ladle after proper temperature, refining is carried out outside a converter after steel receiving, vacuum degassing is carried out after proper temperature, the temperature is measured after the steel ladle of the VD station is in place, the sufficient time is kept under the condition of less than or equal to 0.7mbar, on-line hydrogen determination is carried out after breaking, a sulfur supplementing line is carried out, the temperature is proper after the steel ladle is subjected to continuous casting station pouring after weak stirring before hanging, an argon blowing plug rod and an integral invasive water gap are selected as a tundish in the continuous casting station, argon gas is filled into the tundish after baking and stopping baking, a non-carbon covering agent and a carbonized rice hull are selected as a middle covering cover, the steel billet is annealed for standby, the material utilization rate is improved by more than 5 percent on the premise of not affecting service life.

title_en: Carbonitriding high-frequency quenching device and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection positioning devices, in particular to a carbonitriding high-frequency quenching device and a processing method thereof, wherein the carbonitriding high-frequency quenching device comprises a processing control console, a control box, an automatic conveying mechanism, a limiting disc, a quick blanking mechanism, a supporting rod, a device mounting plate, a carbonitriding chamber and a quenching chamber; the automatic feeding and discharging device comprises a control box, a limiting disc, a quick discharging mechanism, four groups of support rods, a device mounting plate and a carbonitriding chamber, wherein the control box is arranged at the lower end part of a machining control console, an automatic conveying mechanism capable of automatically and transversely conveying parts is arranged in the control box, the limiting disc is arranged at the upper end part of the automatic conveying mechanism, the quick discharging mechanism capable of rapidly ejecting and pushing the machined parts is arranged at the upper end part of the limiting disc, the four groups of support rods are arranged at the upper end part of the machining control console, the device mounting plate is arranged at the upper end part of the support rods, and the carbonitriding chamber is arranged at one side of the upper end of the device mounting plate.

title_en: Negative electrode material, preparation method thereof, secondary battery and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a negative electrode material and a preparation method thereof, a secondary battery and electronic equipment, wherein the negative electrode material comprises silicon-carbon particles, the silicon carbon particles include elemental metal including at least one of Sn or Ge. The negative electrode material provided by the application can improve DCR performance and heat storage performance of the secondary battery under low SOC.

title_en: Sheet for thermal bonding, sheet for thermal bonding with dicing tape, method for producing bonded body, and power semiconductor device
abstract_en: A sheet for heat bonding has a pre-sintered layer containing copper particles and polycarbonate.

title_en: Vacuum distillation ingot-falling boat forming device for rare earth metal
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rare earth purification, in particular to a vacuum distillation ingot-falling boat forming device for rare earth metals. The device comprises a transverse furnace and a longitudinal furnace, wherein the bottom end of the longitudinal furnace is communicated with the middle of the transverse furnace, a positioning mechanism which is longitudinally arranged is arranged in the longitudinal furnace and used for placing a graphite sleeve with a material, and a boat forming mechanism is arranged below the positioning mechanism in the transverse furnace. The positioning mechanism is used for accurately fixing and guiding the strip graphite sleeve, so that purified rare earth metal can be automatically separated from the graphite sleeve, the operation of manually knocking and demolding in the traditional process is avoided, the metal splashing and pollution risks are reduced, the demolding efficiency is improved, the boat forming mechanism directly receives molten metal falling from the graphite sleeve, the step of knocking metal blocks and manually transferring in the traditional process is omitted, the automatic transfer of metal from distillation to collection is realized, and the operation efficiency of secondary purification is remarkably improved.

title_en: Carbon-based Prussian blue composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of adsorption material development and resource comprehensive utilization, and particularly relates to a carbon-based Prussian blue composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes biomass material as a carbon source and prepares the carbon-based Prussian blue composite material by adopting an impregnation method or a limited-domain in-situ etching method. The carbon-based Prussian blue composite material is used for extracting cesium in liquid resources and removing cesium in wastewater, has the characteristics of high adsorption capacity, high adsorption rate and the like, has the adsorption capacity of more than 100mg/g, and has the advantages of good cyclic stability, high resource recovery rate, no pollutant emission, easiness in large-scale production and important significance for comprehensive utilization of resources and radioactive wastewater treatment.

title_en: Processing equipment applied to die casting of high-voltage distribution box
abstract_en: The invention discloses processing equipment applied to die casting of a high-voltage distribution box, which belongs to the technical field of processing of high-voltage distribution boxes and comprises a workbench, a first mounting plate, a second mounting plate, a fixed die mechanism and a movable die mechanism. According to the movable die mechanism, the movable die, the plurality of transverse plates, the box body, the second hydraulic cylinder and the liquid circulation assembly are arranged, the liquid circulation assembly pumps out cooling liquid in the box body, the cooling liquid passes through the movable die and then returns to the box body again, the temperature of the movable die is quickly reduced through circulation of the cooling liquid, and therefore workpieces are quickly cooled and fixed, and production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Forming device convenient to drawing of patterns of aluminium die casting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forming device convenient for demolding of an aluminum die casting, which comprises a fixed seat, wherein grooves are formed in two ends of the fixed seat, a fixed die with adjustable positions is arranged in the grooves, movable rods are arranged at four corners of the inside of the fixed seat in a penetrating manner, movable dies are arranged at two ends of the movable rods, and an extrusion mechanism convenient for demolding is arranged in the movable dies. According to the invention, the driving piece in the prior art is connected to one side of a group of movable dies, the driving piece controls the movable dies to approach and move away from the fixed seat in the direction of the fixed seat, when the movable dies on one side are controlled to move towards the fixed seat, the movable bars drive the other group of movable dies to move away from the fixed seat, and the movable dies moving towards the fixed seat can squeeze the fixed dies at corresponding positions to move towards the direction of the grooves so as to compress the first springs until the fixed dies move into the grooves, so that the staggered work between the two groups of movable dies and the fixed dies is realized, the continuous die casting work of double-station interchange is realized, and the work efficiency is accelerated.

title_en: Method for preparing acidolysis titanium solution by acidolysis of ilmenite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing acidolysis titanic solution by acidolysis of ilmenite, which comprises the steps of adding mineral powder A into a first sulfuric acid solution according to an acid-ore ratio of 0.4-0.55, stirring, heating, controlling temperature, curing, enabling all ferric oxide in the mineral powder A to react with the first sulfuric acid solution to generate ferric sulfate solution, enabling 16-42% ferrous oxide to react with the first sulfuric acid solution to generate ferrous sulfate solution, cooling to room temperature, filtering, washing to remove reactants, drying to obtain mineral powder B, adding mineral powder B into a second sulfuric acid solution according to an acid-ore ratio of 1.7-1.85, stirring, heating to obtain a solid phase, curing, taking out the solid phase, crushing, adding water, stirring, heating, curing to obtain the titanic solution, adding a flocculating agent to enable the titanic solution to settle, heating the titanic solution until an upper layer of clear solution and a lower layer of separation substance appear in the titanic solution, and obtaining the upper layer of clear solution which is acidolysis titanic solution. The invention does not need to add iron powder and ferric iron for reduction during acidolysis, and has the advantages of simple operation, good stability of the prepared acidolysis titanic solution, low iron-titanium ratio, low cost and high acidolysis degree of ilmenite.

title_en: Method for preparing 1T-phase molybdenum disulfide/tin dioxide heterojunction material by one-step method, product thereof and application of product in battery material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a 1T-phase molybdenum disulfide/tin dioxide heterojunction material by a one-step method, a product thereof and application of the product in battery materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of sequentially dissolving a molybdenum source, a sulfur source and a tin source in continuously stirred deionized water to obtain a milky mixed solution, continuously stirring, carrying out ultrasonic pre-reaction to obtain a uniform light gray blue precursor solution, continuously stirring at room temperature, placing the light gray blue precursor solution in a reaction kettle to react for a period of time at 180-220 ℃, and washing, drying and naturally cooling a heated product to obtain the 1T-phase molybdenum disulfide/tin dioxide heterojunction material. The heterojunction plays an important role in improving the utilization rate of sulfur, relieving the volume change of the positive electrode in the charge and discharge process and inhibiting the shuttle effect of polysulfide, and is used as a negative electrode material of a sodium ion battery or a positive electrode material of a lithium sulfur battery to show excellent electrochemical performance.

title_en: Preparation method of copper-based heterojunction nano material with excellent chemical power treatment effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a copper-based heterojunction nanomaterial with an excellent chemical kinetics treatment effect, which is a novel nanomaterial based on inorganic chemistry, and realizes efficient inhibition of tumors by utilizing the excellent catalytic performance of the novel nanomaterial. The synthesis of the nano heterojunction mainly comprises two processes of room temperature reaction and hydrothermal reaction. The preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) mixing and stirring copper chloride and ammonium metavanadate at room temperature to form a mixture, 2) centrifuging the obtained mixture, 3) finally, redispersing the precipitate obtained by centrifugation in a mixed solvent of glycol and water, placing the mixed solvent in a high-pressure reaction kettle to react for a certain time at a specific temperature, and then, centrifuging, washing, drying and the like to obtain the heterojunction nano-material of the copper-vanadium bimetallic oxide. The nano material has excellent peroxidase activity, good biocompatibility, biological safety and excellent tumor treatment effect.

title_en: Method for refining alloy material by blowing powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molten steel refining, in particular to a method for refining alloy materials by blowing powder, which comprises the steps of drying refined powder to obtain pretreated refined powder; and blowing the pretreated refined powder into the middle-lower layer of the molten steel through a blowing pipe, and carrying out vacuum refining treatment on the molten steel. According to the invention, refined powder is blown into the middle-lower layer of molten steel by utilizing argon or helium, the refined powder fully reacts with oxygen, sulfur, nitrogen and other impurities in the molten steel, the formed impurities gradually float up to the surface of the molten steel, so that the deoxidization, desulfurization and denitrification efficiency is remarkably improved, the refining time is reduced, the refining requirements on high-performance special alloy materials can be better met, the dextrin is used as a binder for mixing and bonding calcium powder, silicon powder and aluminum powder, the dextrin is removed by high-temperature heat treatment, and the gas is generated by decomposing the dextrin, so that more pore channels are generated in the silicon-calcium composite powder, the quality is lighter and the floating up is facilitated, and the rapid contact with the molten steel is facilitated, and the refining efficiency is improved.

title_en: Pot body, cooking utensil and preparation method of pot body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of household appliances, and provides a pot body, a cooking utensil and a preparation method of the pot body. According to the pot body provided by the embodiment of the invention, the pot body comprises the pot bottom, the transition section and the side wall which are sequentially connected, and the thickness of the pot bottom is larger than that of the side wall. According to the pot body disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the thickness of the pot bottom is larger than that of the side wall, so that the heat storage of the pot bottom is improved, the heat diffusion of the side wall can be accelerated, and the heat conduction and heat storage effects are regulated through the differentiation of the wall thickness, so that a local temperature difference is formed between the pot bottom and the side wall, the heat flow rolling is enhanced, and the food materials are heated more uniformly.

title_en: Method and device for preparing lattice structure by multi-field auxiliary laser selective melting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of additive manufacturing, in particular to a method and a device for preparing a lattice structure by multi-field auxiliary laser selective melting, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data of a material to be processed and performance indexes of a target lattice structure; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-field coupling physical model, predicting the material melting, solidification and lattice structure evolution result under a multi-field environment, constructing a self-adaptive multi-field environment regulation algorithm, adjusting the space-time distribution of an electric field, a magnetic field and a sound field by analyzing the laser-material interaction process in real time, constructing a process optimization method based on deep learning, adjusting the process parameters such as laser power, scanning speed and powder layer thickness in real time by the deep learning model, outputting the combined data of the optimal material components, the laser process parameters and the multi-field environment parameters, and adjusting the laser selective melting process to prepare the target lattice structure. The invention can obviously improve the dimensional accuracy, the surface quality and the mechanical property of the lattice structure and expand the application field of the lattice structure.

title_en: Preparation method of iron-based polyanion type composite positive electrode material, pole piece and battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sodium ion batteries, and particularly provides a preparation method of an iron-based polyanion type composite positive electrode material, a pole piece and a battery. The preparation method of the iron-based polyanion composite positive electrode material comprises the steps of mixing precursor powder doped with M element Na  4 Fe 3‑3x  M 3x (PO 4 ) 2 (P 2 O 7 ) with a carbon source to form a mixture, wherein 0<X is less than or equal to 0.2, the Dv50 particle size of the precursor powder is less than or equal to 20 mu M, and sintering the mixture under the condition of no oxygen to obtain Na  4 Fe 3‑3x  M 3x (PO 4 ) 2 (P 2 O 7 ) @ C. The invention improves the energy density of the material by improving the gram capacity and the compaction density of the positive electrode material.

title_en: Aluminum alloy material for new energy automobile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum alloy material for a new energy automobile and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of aluminum alloy materials. The aluminum alloy material comprises, by mass, 0.5-0.6% of silicon, 0.95-1.05% of magnesium, 0.15-0.25% of copper, 0.1-0.2% of iron, 0.02-0.025% of titanium, 0.05-0.15% of chromium, less than or equal to 0.15% of manganese, less than or equal to 0.25% of zinc, less than or equal to 0.1% of other unavoidable impurity elements and the balance aluminum. The aluminum alloy material improves the conductivity of the aluminum alloy material by optimizing the content of alloy elements, reducing the density of crystal boundaries and dislocation, strengthening the heat treatment of the material and the like, and realizes the common promotion of the conductivity and the mechanical property. And the aluminum base material of the aluminum alloy material adopts the mixture of 99.70% high-purity aluminum and 6061 aluminum alloy extruded white material, so that the advantages of the aluminum base material and the mixture can be combined to obtain the aluminum alloy material with conductivity and high strength.

title_en: Preparation and molding process of two-dimensional olefinic carbon material for electromagnetic shielding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and molding process of a two-dimensional ethylenic carbon material for electromagnetic shielding, and relates to the field of two-dimensional ethylenic carbon materials for electromagnetic shielding, comprising the following steps of carrying out gas phase etching and plasma high-temperature treatment on a precursor MAX material, and grinding the treated two-dimensional ethylenic carbon material into ethylenic carbon powder; the preparation method comprises the steps of obtaining electromagnetic shielding effectiveness indexes to be met, establishing a concentration-shielding effectiveness relation model according to historical data to obtain preparation concentration of the allyl carbon solution, preparing a nonionic surfactant, PVP K30, ethanol, ammonia water, KH550, PEG 400, preparing a dispersion mixture and a surface spraying agent, and accurately determining the preparation concentration of the allyl carbon solution by establishing the concentration-shielding effectiveness relation model to provide powerful support for a subsequent allyl carbon powder adding range and ensure that the electromagnetic shielding performance of a finished product reaches the standard.

title_en: Modification method for simply and remarkably improving crystal structure and cycle stability of ultra-high nickel cobalt-free positive electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modification method for simply and remarkably improving the crystal structure and the cycle stability of an ultra-high nickel cobalt-free cathode material, which is characterized in that Nb/Ti elements are doped into a LiNi  0.9 Mn 0.1 O 2  crystal structure by a one-step high-temperature solid-phase sintering process, so that the microscopic morphology of the material is optimized, and a stable crystal frame is constructed. The technology adjusts the primary particle structure, improves the particle strength, inhibits the dissolution of transition metal and the decomposition of electrolyte, reduces the particle breakage and structural distortion in the circulation process, and enhances the reversibility of electrode reaction. The modified positive electrode has high specific capacity, excellent cycle stability and rate capability, and the capacity retention rate of the full battery assembled by taking graphite as a negative electrode after 500 times of cycle is up to 98%. The invention obviously improves the material structure and the cycle stability through the Nb/Ti double doping strategy, has simple process, low cost and easy mass production, and has outstanding commercial application potential.

title_en: Preparation method of aluminum oxide-quartz fiber three-dimensional fabric reinforced aluminum-silicon ceramic matrix composite material with honeycomb sandwich structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite materials, in particular to a preparation method of an aluminum oxide-quartz fiber three-dimensional fabric reinforced aluminum silicon ceramic matrix composite material with a honeycomb sandwich structure. The matrix material of the composite material is alumina-silica mixed sol, and the reinforcing material is alumina fiber-quartz fiber mixed woven fabric with honeycomb sandwich structure. The preparation method comprises the steps of preprocessing an alumina fiber-quartz fiber mixed woven fabric of a honeycomb sandwich structure, preparing silica-alumina sol and performing ultrafiltration treatment, performing vacuum impregnation, pressure impregnation and gel treatment on the alumina fiber-quartz fiber mixed woven fabric of the honeycomb sandwich structure by using the silica-alumina sol to obtain a mixed gel preform, and then drying and sintering. The invention effectively solves the problems of relatively high alumina fiber density and poor ablation resistance while improving the temperature resistance of the wave-transparent composite material, and has wide application prospect in the light and reusable wave-transparent material of an aircraft.

title_en: Hot rolled steel sheet
abstract_en: A hot-rolled steel sheet having a predetermined chemical composition, wherein the metal structure contains, in terms of area%, at least 1 of ferrite and bainite, total 80-98%, and martensite, 2-10%, and when a boundary having an orientation difference of 15 DEG or more is defined as a grain boundary, and a region surrounded by the grain boundary and having an equivalent circle diameter of 0.3 [ mu ] m or more is defined as a crystal grain, the proportion of the crystal grain having an orientation difference of 5-14 DEG in the crystal grain is 10-60% in terms of area%, the average value of {110} <111> and {112} <111> orientation in a region from the surface to a plate thickness 1/6 position is 2.50 or more, and the average value of {100} <011>, {211} <011> and {332} <113> orientation in a region from a plate thickness 2/5 position to a plate thickness 3/5 position is 7.00 or less.

title_en: Method for preparing lithium carbonate from carbonate salt lake sediment lithium ore
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing lithium carbonate from lithium ores of carbonate salt lake sediments, which comprises the steps of dissolving lithium-containing particles at normal pressure and normal temperature by using fresh water to obtain a solution and a water insoluble substance, leaching the water insoluble substance and an ammonium acetate solution at normal pressure and normal temperature, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a first leaching solution and a first leaching slag, carrying out normal pressure leaching on the first leaching slag and an acetic acid solution, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a second leaching solution and a second leaching slag, mixing the solution, the first leaching solution and the second leaching solution to obtain a mixed solution, heating, adding ammonia water to carry out hydrolysis iron and aluminum treatment, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain an aluminum iron precipitate and a first separation solution, carrying out calcium and magnesium removal treatment after evaporation concentration of the first separation solution to obtain a second calcium and magnesium separation solution, continuing to carry out evaporation concentration of the second separation solution to obtain a high-temperature lithium-rich solution, and carrying out heat preservation, alkali adding and lithium precipitation, washing and drying to obtain a lithium carbonate product. The invention realizes the effective separation, enrichment and extraction of lithium in lithium ores of salt lake sediments.

title_en: Preparation process and production equipment of sulfur-resistant high-temperature corrosion-resistant high-nickel alloy coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-nickel alloy coating production, and particularly relates to a preparation process and production equipment of a sulfur-resistant high-temperature corrosion-resistant high-nickel alloy coating. According to the preparation process of the high-nickel alloy coating with sulfur and high temperature corrosion resistance and the production equipment thereof, nickel alloy powder is stored in the storage tank, and then the reciprocating mechanism drives the movable piston in the piston cylinder to reciprocate when the hollow shaft rotates, so that the movable piston can pump external air into the hollow blade and blow the air out, and then the nickel alloy powder in the storage tank can be subjected to stirring and drying treatment while blowing.

title_en: Forming die life monitoring method and system based on powder metallurgy metal material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molding die life monitoring method and system based on powder metallurgy metal materials, comprising the steps of performing multiple fitting and updating on an initial data set formed by pressing process data and die life change data to obtain a predicted model of the die life change data under normal conditions, and data sets under normal conditions and extreme conditions, obtaining the predicted model of the die life change data under the extreme conditions according to the pressing process data, duration and the die life change data of a data segment formed by data points at adjacent moments in the data sets under the extreme conditions, and obtaining a die life change value after the molding die to be evaluated completes the current pressing process according to the pressing process data belonging to the normal conditions and the extreme conditions and combining with the predicted model of the die life change data, and superposing the predicted model with the die life value after the last pressing process to obtain the die life value after the current pressing process. The invention can comprehensively and accurately estimate the service life change of the die.

title_en: Production system and method for preparing industrial ammonia water by utilizing ammonia-containing tail gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production system and a method for preparing industrial ammonia water by utilizing ammonia-containing tail gas.
