The jet flow is formed by the nozzle of the parallel flow ejector, and the jet flow can generate local negative pressure, so that ammonia-containing tail gas is introduced, the ammonia-containing tail gas and dilute ammonia water are mixed in the ejector, the two-phase fluid is in a high-speed turbulence state, the gas-liquid contact surface is greatly increased, and efficient gas-liquid mixing and mass transfer are realized. The tail gas absorption tower adopts the principle of sectional absorption, dilute ammonia water is introduced into the middle part of the tower, clean desalted water is introduced into the top of the tower, the ammonia content in the absorbed tail gas is low, the concentration of the dilute ammonia water is high, and the ammonia gas is fully recovered.

title_en: Cerium oxide powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses cerium oxide powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) mixing water-soluble cerium salt, a nitrogen-containing substance and a solvent to obtain an initial mixture, wherein the nitrogen-containing substance is at least one of ammonium bicarbonate, ammonium carbonate, ammonia water and urea, the solvent is a mixture of C2-C4 alkyl glycol and water in a volume ratio of 0.3-1:1, 2) reacting the initial mixture in a sealed reaction kettle at 100-180 ℃ to obtain a reactant, 3) separating solid from liquid of the reactant, drying the separated solid to obtain a precursor, and 4) roasting the precursor to obtain the cerium oxide powder. The preparation method can obtain the nano cerium oxide powder with the (200) crystal face mainly exposed.

title_en: Ceramic recycling waste residue, ceramic green brick and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ceramics, in particular to a ceramic recycling waste residue, a ceramic green brick and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the ceramic reclaimed waste residue comprises the following steps of S10, carrying out primary crushing and secondary crushing on waste residue raw materials to enable the waste residue raw materials to form fine particles with the particle size smaller than 1mm, S20, carrying out primary magnetic separation iron removal and secondary magnetic separation iron removal treatment on the fine particles to enable the iron content in the fine particles to be reduced to be smaller than 0.5%, and S30, carrying out acid washing, complexing heavy metal removal and surface modification treatment on the fine particles in sequence to obtain the reclaimed waste residue. The recycled waste residue is subjected to crushing, iron removal, acid washing, complexing to remove heavy metals and surface modification treatment, so that the influence on the quality of the green bricks can be effectively reduced, the usage amount of the waste residue in the green bricks is increased, and the recycling rate is improved. In addition, the invention ensures that the high content of the recycled waste residue is used without degrading the performance of the ceramic green bricks by optimizing the formula of the ceramic green bricks.

title_en: Lithium aluminosilicate glass ceramics
abstract_en: The invention relates to lithium aluminosilicate glass ceramics having a thermal expansion coefficient in the range of 20 ℃ to 700 ℃ of-0.5 to 1.9ppm/K and uses thereof. The glass ceramic contains the following components ：SiO 2  60-70、Al 2 O 3  17-25、Li 2 O 1.5-<3.0、MgO 0-1.4、K 2 O>1-3 in the indicated amounts by weight, based on oxides, and SnO  2  0.1- <1.

title_en: Conversion method suitable for high carbon monoxide content
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conversion method suitable for high carbon monoxide content, which relates to the technical field of chemical industry, and comprises the following steps of dividing raw material gas into two parts, mixing the first part of raw material gas with water vapor, and then entering a first-stage conversion reaction furnace to obtain first-stage conversion gas after conversion reaction; the first-stage conversion gas is divided into two parts, and the first-stage conversion gas of the first part is mixed with steam and the second-stage raw gas to perform a second-stage conversion reaction, so that the second-stage conversion gas is obtained. The invention fills the conversion catalysts with different CuO contents, assists different steam amounts, controls the progress of the reaction, expands the reaction to a surface to a certain extent, thereby effectively controlling the exothermic amount of the reaction, further effectively controlling the hot spot temperature of the catalyst bed layer and avoiding sintering of the catalyst at high temperature, thus being particularly suitable for converting the raw material gas containing high-concentration carbon monoxide.

title_en: Preparation method and application of fluorine-doped cuprous oxide with heat-stable oxygen vacancy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of fluorine doped cuprous oxide with a heat stable oxygen vacancy. The structure regulates and controls oxygen vacancies through fluorine doping, so that the structure is stable at the temperature of more than 300 ℃, and the catalytic performance is obviously enhanced. The molar ratio of the copper source to the fluorine source is 1-5:1. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving a copper source and a fluorine source in glycol, mixing, adjusting the pH to 4-5, performing hydrothermal reaction for 12-24 hours, and washing and drying to obtain a product. When the concentration of the copper solution is 0.2-0.5 mol/L, uniformly doping by ultrasonic treatment of 20-40 kHz, and adding the bad blood acid with the molar ratio of 1:1-10 to the copper source to optimize oxygen vacancy formation. The material is used as a catalyst for high-temperature catalytic reactions such as fuel combustion and ammonium perchlorate decomposition, has high-temperature stability and high-efficiency activity, and can be applied to the fields of energy, chemical industry and propellants. The invention has simple process and low cost, and provides a new scheme for the design of high-temperature catalytic materials.

title_en: Composite perovskite type wave-absorbing material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A composite perovskite type wave-absorbing material and a preparation method thereof relate to a perovskite type wave-absorbing material and a preparation method thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the current LaNiO  3  system and the LaFeO  3  system are poor in wave absorbing capacity. The invention provides a perovskite structure material-based composite material, which is prepared by co-firing and compounding two perovskite structure materials LaNiO  3  and LaFeO  3  through low-temperature molten salt, wherein the two perovskite structure materials belong to a perovskite structure, the generated interface polarization greatly improves dielectric loss, the compounded material has remarkable wave absorption capacity, and the wave absorption loss can reach-40 dB at about 6.3GHz, so that the material has a higher application prospect.

title_en: Calcination decarbonization-supercritical expansion stripping method for graphite regenerated graphene of waste lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calcination decarbonization-supercritical expansion stripping method for graphite regenerated graphene of a waste lithium battery, and belongs to the field of lithium battery recovery and nanomaterial preparation. The method comprises the steps of processing waste lithium batteries to obtain mixed powder of positive and negative electrodes of the waste lithium batteries, roasting to obtain battery powder, leaching the battery powder in nitric acid solution to obtain purified graphite slag, mixing the graphite slag with supercritical gas fluid, processing, rapidly decompressing to normal pressure, and separating to obtain graphene. The method is based on the interlayer structure characteristic of the waste graphite cathode, organic matters and amorphous carbon are removed through multistage calcination, and the low-damage dissociation is realized by utilizing microcracks of graphite by combining a supercritical N  2 /CO 2  mixed fluid permeation and decompression expansion collaborative stripping technology. The method is used for coupling physical stripping and liquid nitrogen quenching strengthening, and the obtained graphene sheet has high integrity and few structural defects, and can be directly used for manufacturing conductive composite materials and energy storage devices.

title_en: Aluminum alloy conductive piece and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an aluminum alloy conductive piece, which comprises the following components, by mass, 80% -99.5% of aluminum element, 0.1% -1.4% of magnesium element, 0.01% -3% of bismuth element and 0.1% -1.5% of silicon element, wherein the molar quantity of the magnesium element is x, the molar quantity of the bismuth element is y, and the molar quantity of the silicon element is z, so that the following relational expression of x=ay+2z is satisfied, and a is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 1.5. According to the invention, by adding bismuth element, two reinforced phases of Mg  3 Bi 2  and Mg  2  Si are formed, so that the composite material has high strength and high conductivity.

title_en: Visible light responsive photocatalytic carbon mineralized cement-based coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visible light responsive photocatalytic carbon mineralized cement-based coating and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials of the visible light responsive photocatalytic carbon mineralized cement-based coating comprise 91-99 parts of inorganic cementing material, 1-9 parts of composite photocatalytic medium, 1-10 parts of auxiliary carbonizing agent and 80-110 parts of water. The preparation method of the visible light responsive photocatalytic carbon mineralized cement-based coating comprises the steps of mixing a photocatalyst with water, performing ultrasonic treatment for 30min to obtain a photocatalyst suspension, adding an inorganic cementing material and an auxiliary carbonizing agent into the photocatalyst suspension, fully stirring the mixture to obtain a slurry containing the photocatalyst, spraying the slurry on the surface of a base material, performing in-situ carbonization on the surface of the base material, and curing to obtain the visible light responsive photocatalytic carbon mineralized cement-based coating. The coating prepared by the scheme has the characteristic of playing a photocatalytic role under visible light, and achieves the effect of carbon fixation while meeting the requirements of mechanical property, bonding property and durability.

title_en: Aluminum profile die casting edge waste cutting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum casting processing, and discloses an aluminum profile die casting edge scrap cutting device which comprises a frame, a rotary table arranged on a working table surface of the frame, a clamping assembly arranged on the rotary table and used for clamping the lower end of a cylindrical aluminum casting, and a movable arm arranged on the side wall of the frame, wherein the free end of the movable arm is provided with a cleaning assembly which is arranged at the edge of the upper end of the cylindrical aluminum casting and used for cleaning a release agent. The invention is provided with the cleaning component and is erected on the upper edge of the cylindrical aluminum casting, when the cleaning component works, the motor drives the turntable, the clamping component and the cylindrical aluminum casting to rotate, the cleaning component cleans the upper edge of the cylindrical aluminum casting, the release agent can be removed efficiently, when the subsequent die cutting tool is used for cutting scraps, the tool abrasion caused by carbonization of the release agent is greatly reduced, meanwhile, the pollution of the carbonized release agent to a workpiece is avoided, the processing quality is ensured, and the service life of the tool is prolonged.

title_en: Inorganic light ceramic microbead material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ceramic microbeads, in particular to an inorganic light ceramic microbead material and a preparation method and application thereof. An inorganic lightweight ceramic microbead material is characterized by comprising composite ceramic particles with a multi-stage pore structure, wherein the multi-stage pore structure comprises large pores with the pore diameter of 50-150 mu m and small pores with the pore diameter of 1-10 mu m. The application realizes the coordination of material lightening and functionalization by introducing a multi-stage pore structure of a large pore (50-150 μm) and a small pore (1-10 μm). The large pores reduce weight by reducing material density while providing stress buffering space, and the small pores reduce thermal conductivity by limiting air convection and thermal radiation. The gradient distribution of the multi-stage pores can optimize the mechanical bearing path and avoid stress concentration. Due to the composite structure of the large pores and the small pores, the ceramic microbead material has balanced lightening and heat insulation performance, and the multistage pores cooperatively improve the compressive strength and the heat shock resistance, so that the ceramic microbead material is suitable for high-temperature heat insulation scenes.

title_en: High-apparent-density tantalum oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metallurgy, and particularly relates to high-apparent-ratio tantalum oxide and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of high-apparent-density tantalum oxide, which comprises the following steps of adding urea solution into fluorotantalic acid solution, carrying out a first neutralization reaction to obtain fluorotantalic acid neutralization solution, adding ammonia water into the fluorotantalic acid neutralization solution, carrying out a second neutralization reaction to obtain tantalum hydroxide, and calcining the tantalum hydroxide to obtain the high-apparent-density tantalum oxide. The invention adjusts on the traditional technology, adopts a two-stage neutralization method to prepare the tantalum oxide with high apparent density, uses urea for neutralization in the first stage, has high solubility of urea and good dispersion degree in solution, can form uniform and fine crystal nucleus without precipitate after urea is added in the first stage for neutralization, and slowly neutralizes by ammonia water to enable the crystal nucleus to slowly grow up, thus forming the tantalum oxide which is easy to wash and filter, difficult to agglomerate, good in dispersion, regular in crystal form, uniform in appearance and high in apparent density.

title_en: Processing method of 7-series aluminum alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of 7-series aluminum alloy, which solves the contradiction that the high strength and high corrosion resistance of the existing 7-series aluminum alloy cannot be achieved, and solves the problems that the material performance of the existing 7-series aluminum alloy aging method is not fully exerted or the multistage aging process is complex and the applicability is poor. The method can well solve the problems, the novel method is simple and convenient to operate, the prepared 7-series aluminum alloy material is higher in strength and better in corrosion resistance and meets the use requirements, in addition, certain Zr and Sc elements are added in combination with optimization of chemical components to cooperatively inhibit recrystallization, the strength of the aluminum alloy is improved, meanwhile Mn elements are combined, toughness of the aluminum alloy is cooperatively provided, sc forms Al  3  Sc nano particles, the structure is refined, the corrosion resistance is improved, galvanic corrosion of a grain boundary precipitated phase is further reduced in combination with a subsequent treatment process, and the 7-series aluminum alloy with the strength, toughness and corrosion resistance meeting the requirements is obtained as a whole.

title_en: High-strength anti-seepage hydraulic asphalt concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-strength anti-seepage hydraulic asphalt concrete and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic asphalt concrete. According to the invention, polyacrylic acid, graphene oxide and the like are adopted to carry out modification treatment on the coarse aggregate, so that the cohesiveness between the coarse aggregate and asphalt is greatly improved, the modified coarse aggregate, asphalt, fine aggregate, fly ash and composite fiber are compounded, and the prepared hydraulic asphalt concrete has good mechanical properties and seepage prevention performance, wherein the porosity is less than 0.5%, the compressive strength is up to 6.46-6.83 MPa, the relative permeability coefficient is less than 0.1 x 10  ‑8  cm/s, and the urgent requirements for safety of large hydraulic engineering are met.

title_en: Method for realizing quick open of blast furnace by utilizing microwaves
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blast furnace ironmaking, in particular to a method for realizing rapid blowing-in of a blast furnace by utilizing microwaves. The method comprises the following steps of S1, installing a microwave generator and a waveguide tube at a tap hole, a tuyere, a furnace belly, a lower part of a furnace body and an upper part of the furnace body of a blast furnace, wherein an inner cavity of the furnace body is used as a heating cavity, S2, installing thermocouples at the upper part of the furnace body, the tuyere and the tap hole of the blast furnace and used for measuring the temperature of materials in the furnace, S3, loading the materials after the leakage test of the furnace is finished, filling coke below the furnace belly, filling light load materials below the furnace belly, and filling normal materials above the middle part of the furnace body, S4, opening all the microwave generators to heat the materials in the furnace, controlling the temperature of the materials at the upper part of the furnace body to be lower than the temperature of the materials at the lower part of the furnace body to be lower than the furnace cylinder, S5, cooling the furnace top by steam or nitrogen gas when the materials are heated, and S6, closing the microwave generator and blowing and opening the furnace after the materials are heated to a preset state. Has the advantages of high heating speed, high efficiency and no pollution.

title_en: Metal composite lithium iron phosphate solid-phase deposition coated lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal composite lithium iron phosphate solid-phase deposition coated lithium manganese iron phosphate anode material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery anode materials. The preparation method of the metal composite lithium iron phosphate solid-phase deposition coated lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a lithium iron manganese phosphate material, sintering, S2, grinding lithium iron phosphate to nano particles, mixing with a sugar source to form lithium iron phosphate nano slurry, S3, transferring the lithium iron manganese phosphate nano slurry into a CVD fluidized bed in a cooling sintering stage, spraying the lithium iron phosphate nano slurry, realizing gasification drying of the lithium iron phosphate material, solid-phase deposition coating the lithium iron manganese phosphate material on the surface of the lithium iron manganese phosphate, and S4, carrying out composite coating of carbon and metal oxide on the lithium iron manganese phosphate coated with the lithium iron phosphate. The method solves the problem of poor uniformity of the lithium iron phosphate coated lithium iron manganese phosphate, improves the electrical property of the lithium iron manganese phosphate, improves the dissolution of ferromanganese, and improves the cycle performance.

title_en: Waste graphite-based repairing and regenerating material for removing heterogeneous carbon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of waste battery recovery, and particularly discloses a waste graphite-based restoration and regeneration material for removing heterogeneous carbon, and preparation and application thereof, wherein waste graphite is subjected to flotation in a flotation reagent to obtain graphite concentrate, the flotation reagent comprises an inhibitor, a collector and a foaming agent, the graphite concentrate is subjected to reselection treatment to obtain graphite reselection concentrate, the graphite reselection concentrate is subjected to first-stage heat treatment in advance under the high-temperature condition of protective atmosphere and temperature T1, then the atmosphere is switched to atmosphere a, and is subjected to second heat treatment under the low-temperature condition of temperature T2 to obtain the waste graphite-based restoration and regeneration material for removing heterogeneous carbon, the temperature T1 is 900-1200 ℃, the temperature T2 is 300-600 ℃, the atmosphere a comprises oxygen and also comprises auxiliary gas, and the auxiliary gas comprises at least one of alcohol and hydrocarbon. The invention can solve the problems of graphite in waste graphite, selective separation of heterogeneous carbon and the like, and can obtain high-performance active materials.

title_en: Device and method for intelligently conveying slab
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for intelligently conveying slabs, comprising a casting flow roller way, a slab conveying vehicle roller way, a steel moving machine roller way, a slab conveying vehicle, a steel moving machine, a hot rolling conveying roller way, a conveying fire clearing machine roller way, an in-place detection switch, a position detection device and a controller which are arranged side by side, wherein the slab conveying vehicle roller way is vertically arranged at the downstream of the casting flow roller way, the slab conveying vehicle is arranged on the slab conveying vehicle roller way, the hot rolling conveying roller way and the conveying fire clearing machine roller way are respectively and vertically arranged at two sides of the slab conveying vehicle roller way, the position of the steel moving machine roller way is vertically crossed with the hot rolling conveying roller way and is parallel to the slab conveying vehicle roller way, and the steel moving machine is arranged on the steel moving machine roller way; according to the number, time and speed of the slab conveying vehicles of the casting flow roller table, the single-vehicle slab conveying mode, the double-vehicle slab conveying mode or the three-vehicle slab conveying mode is selected, the automatic control is realized, the manual slab conveying process is replaced, the production safety accident is reduced, and the slab conveying efficiency can be effectively improved.

title_en: Continuous demolding and conveying device and method for multi-station automobile die-casting parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of die-casting and demolding of automobile parts, in particular to a continuous demolding and conveying device and method for multi-station automobile die-casting parts, wherein the continuous demolding and conveying device comprises a front side two first side plates, a rear side two second side plates and a conveying belt, a plurality of movable mould components are arranged between the two first side plates, a fixed mould component is arranged between the two second side plates, and a flat-laying component is arranged below the fixed mould component. The device is provided with the horizontally-arranged component, the automobile die-casting accessory does not need to be manually taken down during demolding, the formed accessory is prevented from being directly broken after demolding, the fixed mold can be knocked during demolding through the knocking structure, the demolding of the formed accessory is accelerated, and the demolding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Nano silicon dioxide sol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano material preparation, and relates to a nano silicon dioxide sol and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving a silicon source in absolute ethyl alcohol, then adding deionized water and hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin, stirring uniformly, then adding an acid solution dropwise, stirring and reacting for a period of time, and (2) adding a silane coupling agent containing three alkoxy groups into the reaction solution in the step (1), and stirring and reacting to obtain the nano silicon dioxide sol. The hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin forms a protective layer on the surface of the silica gel particle to prevent the silica gel particle from overgrowing. The silane coupling agent can be combined with hydroxyl on the surface of the nano silicon dioxide after hydrolysis, so that the stability of a system is improved, the agglomeration phenomenon of nano silicon dioxide particles is improved, the nano silicon dioxide sol with small particle size and uniform particle size distribution is prepared, the process is simple, and the method is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Novel CdS quantum dot glass, preparation method and application of light source
abstract_en: The invention relates to novel CdS quantum dot glass, a preparation method and an application of a light source, wherein the novel CdS quantum dot glass comprises the following raw materials of base glass in percentage by mass, wherein the content of rare earth doped compound of black talcum powder ：55～70wt.%;K 2 CO 3 ：5～15wt.%;Li 2 CO 3 ：5～15wt.%;SrCO 3 ：5～10wt.%;H 3 BO 3 ：5～20wt.%;CdS：1～15wt.%; is 0-2wt% of the total mass of other raw materials (black talcum powder+K  2 CO 3 +Li 2 CO 3 +SrCO 3 +H 3 BO 3  +CdS), and the content of clarifying agent doped into the base glass is 0.2-2wt% of the total mass of other raw materials (black talcum powder+K  2 CO 3 +Li 2 CO 3 +SrCO 3 +H 3 BO 3  +CdS). The CdS quantum dot glass can be effectively excited by 395nm purple light, has the characteristics of high luminous efficiency, excellent thermal quenching resistance, adjustable light color and the like, and the packaged white light source has the characteristics of warm white light output, high color rendering index, high lumen efficiency and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength thin-tire ceramic material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of thin-tire ceramic materials, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a high-strength thin-tire ceramic material, which comprises, by weight, 55% of alpha-Al  2 O 3  matrix powder, 10% of SiO  2 ：20wt％、t-ZrO 2 , 10% of high-entropy oxide microspheres and 5% of silicon boride long fibers, wherein the SiO  2  and rare earth stabilized ZrO  2  are involved in sintering together to promote formation of a mullite phase and a ternary eutectic network. The reticular structure has good interface binding force, can disperse acting force concentration areas and slow down the stress concentration effect of crack tips, thereby further improving the toughness and the thermal shock resistance. The spherical particles with uniform morphology are obtained through atomization and drying, high fluidity and compact accumulation of powder can be realized, the ceramic is enabled to obtain near theoretical density in the isotropic high-pressure environment in the subsequent hot isostatic pressing process, the inherent pores and micro-cracks are eliminated, and the dual promotion of strength and density is realized.

title_en: Nano material prepared from manganese slag, and method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano material prepared by manganese slag, a method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of environmental material preparation and application, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: manganese slag is dried, crushed, ball-milled and sieved to obtain manganese slag powder A, the manganese slag powder A is dissolved in sulfuric acid solution, the manganese slag powder A is centrifugally filtered to obtain filtrate, and the filtrate is subjected to pH adjustment and then is kept stand to obtain iron-manganese-containing filtrate B. Stirring the filtrate B, regulating pH, filtering to obtain ferric hydroxide filter residues, drying to obtain solid ferric hydroxide particles, dissolving in hydrochloric acid to obtain ferric chloride solution, and adding nickel chloride hexahydrate to obtain nickel-iron mixed solution C. And (3) preparing green tea extract D, dripping the green tea extract D into the solution C, standing to obtain iron-nickel mixed suspension E, and carrying out suction filtration, washing and drying to obtain nZVN-I@Fe  2 O 3  with the surface covered with the Fe  2 O 3  shell. The material has good stability and good preservation performance, can effectively activate persulfate to degrade antibiotics in water, and provides a new method for manganese slag resource utilization and antibiotic pollution control.

title_en: Hydrogen purification method based on magnesium-based solid hydrogen storage material
abstract_en: S11, packaging the magnesium-based solid hydrogen storage material into a plurality of purification units, connecting the two purification units in parallel, and arranging a heat exchange unit between the two parallel purification units to form a primary purification module; S2, purifying, namely introducing low-purity hydrogen into the purifying module, so that the low-purity hydrogen respectively performs multiple hydrogen absorption reactions and hydrogen discharge reactions in the parallel purifying units, purifying the low-purity hydrogen, supplying heat to the purifying units performing the hydrogen discharge reactions through the heat exchange units, and storing heat energy released by the hydrogen absorption reactions. Based on the selective adsorption capacity of the solid hydrogen storage material to hydrogen, the solid hydrogen storage material is utilized to adsorb the hydrogen and discharge impurity gas, so that the purity of the hydrogen is improved, and the heat energy released by the hydrogen absorption reaction is stored and used for the hydrogen discharge reaction by utilizing the heat exchange unit, so that the energy consumption in the purification process is reduced.

title_en: Full-continuous short-process production method for metal plate strip
abstract_en: A full-continuous short-process production method for a metal plate strip comprises smelting, tundish induction heating, strip continuous casting, rolling, no. 1 flying shear, cooling after rolling, acid-free descaling, no. 2 flying shear and strip steel coiling, and a steel coil with no oxide scale on the surface is obtained. The metal plate strip comprises, by weight, 0.01-0.06% of C, less than or equal to 0.15% of Si, less than or equal to 0.85% of Mn, less than or equal to 0.02% of P, less than or equal to 0.005% of S, less than or equal to 0.001% of Als, less than or equal to 0.0050% of Ca, and the balance of Fe and other unavoidable impurities. The invention carries out online hot rolling on the cast strip cast by the double rolls through an online six-roll mill, and then obtains a steel coil without oxide scale on the surface after an acid-free descaling procedure. The product produced by the invention has high elongation, good forming performance and high surface quality, and can truly realize the 'substitution of heat for cold' in the field of high-end products.

title_en: SiC (silicon carbide)f/TiMoNb-Ti2AlNb/Ti2AlNb laminated composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of continuous SiC fiber reinforced metal matrix composite materials, and particularly relates to a SiC  f /TiMoNb-Ti 2 AlNb/Ti 2  AlNb laminated composite material and a preparation method thereof. The composite material is of a composite structure that a precursor wire and a Ti  2  AlNb sheath outside the precursor wire are subjected to hot isostatic pressing, the precursor wire is formed by uniformly distributing SiC fibers in a TiMoNb-Ti  2  AlNb laminated alloy matrix, the volume fraction of the SiC fibers accounts for 40-55% of the total volume fraction of the SiC  f /TiMoNb-Ti 2 AlNb/Ti 2  AlNb laminated composite material, and the composite material is well combined, compact and pore-free. The invention TiMoNb-Ti  2  AlNb lamination is introduced to enable the composite material to be compact under lower hot isostatic pressure parameters, and the effect of improving the performance can be achieved after the technological parameters are optimized.

title_en: Method and system for preparing lithium carbonate from lepidolite ore
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preparing lithium carbonate from lepidolite, which relate to the field of lithium compounds, and the method comprises the steps of (1) taking leaching liquid of a roasting clinker of the lepidolite, and adding sodium hydroxide and sodium carbonate to obtain a purifying liquid; the method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out multistage countercurrent extraction on a purifying liquid and an organic phase, then washing the purifying liquid and the organic phase with pure water or dilute hydrochloric acid to obtain a lithium-loaded organic phase, (3) introducing the lithium-loaded organic phase into a stripping liquid containing a carbon source, reacting under a pressurized condition to generate a lithium bicarbonate solution, and (4) carrying out pyrolysis on the lithium bicarbonate solution under a negative pressure and low temperature condition to precipitate lithium carbonate crystals. The invention replaces the traditional multi-stage purification and concentration by one-step purification, obviously shortens the flow, has high process stability and obviously reduces the energy consumption, and the purity of the prepared lithium carbonate is more than or equal to 99.99 percent, can directly meet the battery level requirement and does not need secondary purification.

title_en: Method and system for extracting lithium by lepidolite roasting and leaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for extracting lithium by roasting and leaching lepidolite, wherein the method comprises the following steps of grinding lepidolite mineral powder by a ball mill, and granulating to form spherical lepidolite particles; the spherical lepidolite particles are preheated by hot air, the preheated flue gas is sent into a tail gas treatment process, the preheated spherical lepidolite particles are sent into a defluorination roasting furnace to be roasted with preheated steam-containing gas, HF-containing roasting flue gas generated by the reaction is discharged from an outlet at the top of the defluorination roasting furnace, HF in the roasting flue gas is reacted with a fluorine-fixing agent to generate fluoride to be discharged, the defluorination roasting flue gas is used as a heat source for the preheated air, the defluorination roasting clinker enters an acidification roasting furnace to be subjected to selective sulfation reaction with H  2 SO 4  steam, and the acidification roasting clinker is subjected to water leaching, filtration, concentration evaporation and neutralization lithium precipitation to obtain lithium carbonate. The invention can realize the leaching rate of lithium, rubidium and cesium of >90%, the recycling utilization rate of fluorine thallium of >90% and the slag decrement of >35%.

title_en: High-temperature wear-resistant steel with large thickness and high thermal stability and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of steel materials, and discloses high-temperature wear resistant steel with large thickness and high thermal stability and a preparation method .C：0.35～0.40%、Si：1.2～1.7%、Mn：1.0～1.5%、Cr：2.1～3.0%、Mo：0.7～1.0%、Ti：0.4～0.6%、W：0.8～1.3%、S≤0.005%、P≤0.003%, thereof, and the balance of Fe and impurities. The mass ratio of Ti to C is 1.2-1.6, the ratio of Cr to Mo is 3:1-5:1, and Si and W form a synergistic softening resistant mechanism. After the steel is subjected to air cooling, quenching and tempering treatment after rolling, a martensite-TiC composite structure is formed, and the structure in the thickness direction is uniform. The tensile strength is more than or equal to 1600MPa at room temperature, the hardness is more than or equal to 550HV, the impact energy is more than or equal to 20J, the elongation is more than or equal to 9%, and the wear resistance at 550 ℃ is improved by more than 2 times compared with the traditional NM 450.

title_en: Ultra-high performance concrete based on surface modified steel fibers and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to ultra-high performance concrete based on surface modified steel fibers and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of building materials. The invention provides an ultra-high performance concrete based on surface modified steel fibers, which aims to solve the problem of insufficient bonding strength between steel fibers and a matrix for the existing ultra-high performance concrete. According to the invention, graphene oxide is uniformly deposited on the surface of the steel fiber through an electrophoretic deposition technology, so that a layer of rough coating with high surface activity is formed. The coating can effectively improve the physical friction and chemical bond action between the steel fiber and the concrete matrix by changing the physical and chemical characteristics of the steel fiber surface, remarkably enhance the bonding strength of the fiber-matrix interface, further improve the macroscopic mechanical property of the ultra-high performance concrete, and improve the tensile strength of the ultra-high performance concrete by 15.4 percent and the flexural strength by 35.6 percent compared with the tensile strength of the ultra-high performance concrete before the surface modification of the steel fiber.

title_en: Construction method of SBS composite modified asphalt based on tire rubber
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of modified asphalt preparation and construction methods, and particularly relates to a construction method of SBS composite modified asphalt based on tire rubber. The construction method of the SBS composite modified asphalt based on the tire rubber comprises the following steps of S1, mixing matrix asphalt, regenerated desulfurization tire rubber powder, SBS materials and a compound emulsifier to prepare the SBS composite modified asphalt, S2, mixing broken stone, mineral powder and slaked lime to form a pretreatment material, adding the SBS composite modified asphalt to stir to obtain an asphalt stabilized broken stone material, S3, paving the asphalt stabilized broken stone material, and compacting the asphalt stabilized broken stone material after paving by using a road roller. The invention effectively improves the storage stability and low-temperature bending damage strain of asphalt and realizes the construction of SBS composite modified asphalt based on tire rubber.

title_en: High-rate sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-rate sodium ion battery, and belongs to the technical field of power grid frequency modulation. The battery core of the sodium ion battery comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and electrolyte, wherein the active material of the positive plate is graphene-coated potassium ion doped sodium ferric sulfate, the chemical formula of the potassium ion doped sodium ferric sulfate is Na  6‑2x‑y K y Fe x (SO 4 ) 3 , the active material of the negative plate is secondary carbon-coated sodium titanium phosphate, the primary particle size D90 of the secondary carbon-coated sodium titanium phosphate is 100-800 nm, the porosities of the positive plate and the negative plate are respectively 50-60%, the electrolyte consists of electrolyte salt, an additive and a solvent, the electrolyte salt comprises sodium hexafluorophosphate and sodium difluorosulfimide, and the additive comprises 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazole bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide and sodium lignin sulfonate. The sodium ion battery has excellent specific capacity, cycle stability and rate capability.

title_en: Device and method for preparing large cast ingot by layer-by-layer solidification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of continuous casting, in particular to a device and a method for preparing a large-sized cast ingot by layer-by-layer solidification, which keep the liquid level of a molten metal in a heat-preserving riser during the process of preparing the large-sized cast ingot layer by layer, the composition, microstructure and mechanical property of each layer of the metal ingot are kept continuous, uniform and consistent, and metallurgical connection between the layers is realized. The device for preparing the large-sized cast ingot by layer-by-layer solidification is small in size, large-sized cast ingots with different heights can be prepared according to requirements without preparing a crystallizer or a casting mould with the same size as the cast ingot, the manufacturing cost and the storage space of equipment are saved, and the demoulding operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: High-strength heat-resistant aluminum-copper alloy component design and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength heat-resistant aluminum-copper alloy component design and a preparation process thereof, which are characterized in that metal aluminum and metal copper are used as main components, metals with other components are additionally added, a plurality of metals are uniformly mixed and degassed in a high-temperature molten state by means of a medium-frequency induction furnace crucible, then molten state metals are poured into a steel mould, demoulding is carried out after solidification and cooling, and finally solution aging heat treatment and two-stage aging treatment are carried out on the molten state metals.

title_en: Method for metallizing surface of optical fiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for metallizing the surface of an optical fiber, which relates to the technical field of optical fiber surface treatment and comprises the following specific steps of S1, removing a protective layer and removing oil, immersing the optical fiber in concentrated sulfuric acid to remove the protective layer, adopting alkaline solution to treat grease and other dirt on the surface of the optical fiber, then carrying out ultrasonic cleaning by deionized water, S2, roughening, adopting hydrofluoric acid to carry out weak corrosion on the surface of the optical fiber, S3, sensitizing, adopting sensitization liquid to treat the optical fiber to enable the surface of the optical fiber to adsorb some substances easy to oxidize, S4, activating, adopting catalytic activity to activate the sensitized optical fiber by virtue of activating liquid palladium chloride solution, S5, adopting an electroless nickel plating method to deposit a layer of Ni-P alloy on the surface of the optical fiber, S6, adopting an electroplating method to thicken the chemically plated optical fiber, and improving the mechanical reliability and high temperature resistance of the optical fiber.

title_en: Antibacterial ultrathin inorganic artificial stone and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial ultrathin inorganic artificial stone, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of artificial stones, wherein the antibacterial ultrathin inorganic artificial stone comprises the following components of white cement, calcium powder, metakaolin, modified calcium carbonate powder, emulsion, modified fiber, a water reducing agent and water; wherein, the quaternary ammonium salt surfactant is adopted to modify the calcium carbonate powder to obtain the modified calcium carbonate powder, silver ions are adopted to modify the fiber to obtain the modified fiber, according to the invention, the modified calcium carbonate powder and the silver ion treated fiber are used as antibacterial materials, so that the antibacterial performance of the material is endowed, and the weather resistance and mechanical properties of the material are improved, so that the 10mm ultrathin inorganic artificial stone can meet the strength and toughness requirements.

title_en: Diamond aluminum nitride composite material, preparation method and heat dissipation substrate
abstract_en: A diamond aluminum nitride composite material, a preparation method and a heat dissipation substrate belong to the technical field of electronic devices. And ball-milling and mixing 94-99wt% of the main material and the balance of the additive to obtain a mixture, and sintering the mixture to obtain the diamond aluminum nitride composite material. The main material of 94-99wt% comprises 20-70wt% of titanium-coated diamond particles and 24-79wt% of aluminum nitride powder, and the additive comprises 1-6wt% of sintering auxiliary agent, so that the diamond aluminum nitride composite material with higher thermal conductivity and breakdown voltage can be prepared. The method can ensure the thermal conductivity and breakdown voltage resistance of the composite material, has simple and quick process, can improve the industrial production of the diamond aluminum nitride composite material, and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Low-carbon aggregate based on solid waste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-carbon aggregate based on solid waste and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of solid waste resource utilization, wherein the low-carbon aggregate comprises a solid waste layer, and a stabilizing layer and a bearing layer which are sequentially coated on the solid waste layer from inside to outside; the invention designs the low-carbon aggregate into three layers, each layer is strictly controlled in thickness, the innermost layer is a solid waste layer, a small amount of materials with hydration activity are utilized to preliminarily fix waste residues, then the steel slag, desulfurized gypsum and the like are utilized to prepare a stable layer with higher compactness, the waste residues are firmly wrapped in the stable layer, harmful elements are not leached out, and finally the silica fume, cement, the steel slag, the desulfurized gypsum and the like are utilized to prepare a pressure-bearing layer with higher strength, so that the strength is provided for the low-carbon aggregate.

title_en: Hard pressing-in repairing process for blast furnace lining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard press-in repair process for a blast furnace lining, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a hard press-in material, S2, preparing a hardening agent solution, S3, selecting a weak part of the blast furnace lining to open a hole, welding a pressing short pipe at the hole of a furnace shell, installing a ball valve and a quick connector, connecting the hole with a press-in machine through a pipeline, S4, conveying the hard press-in material to a press-in port through hard press-in equipment, conveying the hardening agent solution to the press-in port through a hardening agent pump, mixing the hardening agent solution with the hard press-in material, pressing the hardening agent solution into a furnace, expanding the hardening agent between the furnace lining and the furnace burden, hardening the hardening agent under the action of the furnace temperature and the hardening agent, and bonding the hardening agent with the furnace shell lining into a whole, and finishing the hard press-in repair of the blast furnace lining. According to the invention, through improving the hard pressing-in material, a plurality of high-performance components are organically combined, so that the comprehensive performance of the hard pressing-in material is obviously improved.

title_en: Graphite-copper uniform layered composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a graphite-copper uniform layered composite material, which comprises the following steps of plating a metal coating on the surface of a graphite flake; preparing slurry from the product, a freezing medium and a binder, solidifying the obtained slurry at a fixed liquid-solid interface solidification speed by using a freezing casting method, freeze-drying the solidified slurry to obtain a layered porous graphite skeleton green body, degreasing and sintering the layered graphite skeleton green body, and then infiltrating copper to obtain the graphite-copper uniform layered composite material. The invention also discloses a graphite/copper uniform laminar composite material, wherein the volume fraction of copper in the composite material is 30% -70%, the thermal conductivity is 400-650W/(m.K), and the thermal expansion coefficient is (0-3) multiplied by 10  ‑6 /K. The graphite-copper uniform laminar composite material prepared by adopting the ice template-infiltration method has the advantages of consistent orientation of graphite flakes, low and adjustable thermal expansion coefficient and high thermal conductivity.

title_en: Biphase composite ferrite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biphase composite ferrite material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the biphase composite ferrite material comprise SrM ferrite, liZn ferrite and a doping agent. The invention combines SrM ferrite and LiZn ferrite, and the LiZn ferrite has the advantages of high remanence ratio, low linewidth and high Curie temperature, and improves the microstructure and magnetic property of the dual-phase composite ferrite by matching with the doping of other elements, so that the composite ferrite has the advantages of high remanence ratio, low linewidth, higher saturation magnetization and the like.

title_en: Device and method for eliminating residual welding stress of ultra-thick nonferrous metal part
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stress relief devices, and discloses a device and a method for relieving residual stress of welding ultra-thick nonferrous metal pieces, wherein the device comprises an explosion tank and a hardening container, wherein the explosion tank generates explosion impact to relieve the residual stress of the metal pieces in the hardening container; the hardening container is provided with a guide channel, the inside of the guide channel is provided with a self-adaptive channel, the self-adaptive channel can be self-defined and adjusted to correspond to the shape of a welding seam of a metal workpiece, and the gaps of the two groups of flexible clamping plates form a conducting channel through which explosion impact passes, and the explosion impact is conducted to the welding seam of the metal workpiece through the conducting channel. The invention forms a directional conduction channel through the gap between the flexible clamping plates, so that the impact wave energy is efficiently focused on the welding seam, thereby accurately eliminating stress, avoiding energy scattering, resisting explosion and stabilizing, and the flexible clamping plates made of metal braiding materials have the shock resistance and flexible deformation capacity, maintain the channel tightness under high-pressure explosion and prevent energy leakage.

title_en: LIBS spectrum modeling method for temperature time-varying molten steel in RH refining process
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature time-varying molten steel LIBS spectrum modeling method in an RH refining process, which belongs to the field of steel smelting, and comprises the steps of firstly obtaining molten steel LIBS spectrum data, selecting N element modeling analysis lines from the spectrum data, calculating the average value and variance of the spectrum intensity of N times excitation of a single analysis line, selecting an analysis line corresponding to the spectrum intensity value of the minimum variance of N times excitation of the N analysis lines as a starting point analysis line, drawing slope curves of normal temperature T  0  and corresponding high temperature T with the rest analysis lines, then calculating the spectrum intensity values of the normal temperature and corresponding high temperature of the N analysis lines, deducing the index relation of the slope and the spectrum intensity along with the temperature change, further deducing the sensitivity coefficient of the slope and the spectrum intensity to the temperature, correcting the element concentration predicted values under different temperatures according to the sensitivity coefficient a  i  of the slope to the temperature and the sensitivity coefficient b  i  of the spectrum intensity to the temperature, and weighting and correcting the element concentration predicted values under different temperatures according to the regression coefficient.

title_en: Nickel-copper nano titanium carbide reinforced heat treatment-free aluminum-silicon alloy material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of aluminum-silicon alloy materials, and particularly discloses a nickel-copper nano titanium carbide reinforced heat-treatment-free aluminum-silicon alloy material and a preparation method thereof. The aluminum-silicon alloy material comprises, by mass, 8.5-9% of Si, 0.45-0.5% of Mg, less than or equal to 0.12% of Fe, 2-2.5% of Cu, 1-1.4% of Ni and 0.12-0.2% of Ti, and the preparation method comprises heating, dissolving, refining and degassing, composite treatment, detection and correction, and casting molding. According to the application, silicon and magnesium are adopted to form Mg  2  Si reinforced phase to improve the strength of a matrix, copper and nickel are adopted to form Al  7 Cu 4  Ni reinforced phase, nano titanium carbide is used as a nucleation core to refine the Al  7 Cu 4  Ni reinforced phase and inhibit the growth of crystal grains, strontium is used as an modifier in cooperation with nickel, the form of eutectic silicon is improved, and the aluminum-silicon alloy material with high strength, high toughness and good wear resistance can be obtained without heat treatment.

title_en: Preparation method of tantalum pentoxide/silicon nitride gradient composite infrared antireflection film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a tantalum pentoxide/silicon nitride gradient composite infrared antireflection film, belonging to the field of antireflection film materials. Through designing 5 layers of gradient structures, each layer has the thickness of 0.4-0.8 mu m, nano Ta  2 O 5 , nano Y  2 O 3  and nano Si  3 N 4  powder are mixed according to a proportion, and the nano-Si nano-composite material is prepared through planetary ball milling, cold isostatic pressing, sectional pressure-controlled sintering and graded polishing. The sintering adopts sectional pressure control to ensure densification and interfacial fusion, and finally the low-roughness film layer is obtained through polishing of diamond suspension. The method solves the problems of defects, weak adhesive force, discontinuous gradient refractive index, difficult high-temperature densification, insufficient mechanical property and the like, remarkably improves the optical property, mechanical property and environmental adaptability, and is suitable for high-performance infrared optical elements.

title_en: Processing and manufacturing process of Guqin
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing and manufacturing process of an ancient musical instrument, which belongs to the technical field of musical instrument processing, wherein the processing and manufacturing process is to uniformly mix bionic porous ceramic aggregate with raw lacquer, and then add carbon fiber, beeswax, polyvinyl butyral and nano silicon dioxide to prepare a gray embryo; after the sand paper of the musical instrument embryo is taken and polished, the gray embryo is uniformly scraped on the surface of the musical instrument embryo, after the fine gray embryo on the surface of the musical instrument embryo is thoroughly dried, the gray embryo is polished to smooth and re-arrange brake sound, then the musical instrument body is painted with a color paint coating, dried, ground to display, rubbed with a transparent finish paint, dried and repeatedly rubbed with the finish paint, the string eyes are prepared on one side of the musical instrument body, which is exposed near the mountain, through a drilling process, and meanwhile, the Yanzu, the bridge and seven guqin strings are arranged on the waist of the bottom plate of the gum support, so that the ancient musical instrument is prepared. The bionic porous ceramic aggregate is adopted, so that the raw material cost can be reduced, the material is more uniform, the ash mould has higher hardness and lower brittleness, the ancient musical instrument is prevented from being broken, and further the abrasion and cracking of the ancient musical instrument are prevented, so that the manufactured ancient musical instrument is more beneficial to long-term collection and preservation.

title_en: Lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, which are used for solving the problems of low electrochemical performance, poor charge and discharge efficiency and short cycle life of the existing lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material; the lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material is prepared from silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, conductive carbon black and polyvinylidene chloride, wherein divalent silver ions are doped in the silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, and three-dimensional interconnection conductive carbon networks are coated on the interior and the surface of the silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, so that the lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material has the advantages of excellent electrochemical performance, high charge and discharge efficiency, long cycle life and the like, and can meet the requirements of high-performance lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Gear production die with impurity removal function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gear production die with a impurity removing function, belonging to the technical field of nonferrous metal casting. Including the operation panel, the operation panel is provided with the fixed plate, the fixed plate rotates and is connected with the pivot, the pivot rigid coupling has the upper die, the upper die is provided with feed inlet and exhaust hole, the operation panel has the bed die through the mounting bracket rigid coupling, the upper die with the equal sliding connection of bed die has the equidistant sliding plate of distribution in circumference, equidistant the common rigid coupling of sliding plate has solid fixed ring, the upside gu fixed ring with go up between the mould and the downside gu fixed ring with all be provided with the extension spring between the bed die, the sliding plate is kept away from one side of solid fixed ring articulates there is the scraper blade. According to the invention, the upper die and the lower die are uniformly scraped by the scraper, the parts of the upper die and the lower die, which are positioned outside the reference circle, do not need to be cleaned one by one, and the cleaning efficiency of the upper die and the lower die is improved.

title_en: Artificial stone board sand and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, and discloses artificial stone board sand and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the preparation method of the artificial stone plate sand, the black talcum is calcined to generate phase transformation, so that the artificial stone plate sand with zero crystalline silicon is generated. Compared with the traditional method, on one hand, the method is safer, the zero-crystallization silicon basically eliminates the silicosis risk due to the characteristics of the zero-crystallization silicon, the health guarantee of operators is greatly improved, on the other hand, the method is more economical, the comprehensive cost is reduced by about 24.6%, the raw material supply is stable, on the other hand, the method is more environment-friendly, the pollutants such as acid wastewater and crystalline silicon dust can be reduced, and the sustainable development trend of the artificial stone industry is met.

title_en: Modified raw soil material based on copper tailings and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified raw soil material based on copper tailings and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of building materials. The invention optimizes the properties of traditional raw soil materials by using alkali excitant solution (prepared by sodium hydroxide solution and sodium silicate solution), copper tailings, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, ceramic fragments and the like, wherein the reasonable parameters of each material are 10% of copper tailings, 2% of sodium hydroxide, 4% of sodium silicate, 4% of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, 4% of ceramic fragments and 0.6% of straw, and the mechanical property, the water resistance and the like of the modified raw soil materials are obviously improved.

title_en: High-consistency silver powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-consistency silver powder and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of powder preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of providing a silver source solution, a reducing agent solution, a compound dispersing agent solution and a coating agent solution respectively, adjusting the pH value of the reducing agent solution to be acidic, dropwise adding the reducing agent solution and the silver source solution into the compound dispersing agent solution step by step, stirring, adding the coating agent solution, continuously stirring to obtain a suspension, settling the suspension, and carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain the silver powder with high consistency. According to the silver powder preparation method, the silver powder with uniform particle size distribution and high consistency can be prepared by using the compound dispersing agent of the low-molecular-weight polyvinylpyrrolidone and the high-molecular-weight polyvinylpyrrolidone, and meanwhile, the reducing agent solution and the silver source solution are subjected to a simultaneous step-by-step dropwise adding process, so that the uniformity and consistency of the particle size distribution of the silver powder can be further improved. Therefore, the method has better application prospect.

title_en: Reflective heat-insulation type railway pier concrete composite structure and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reflective heat-insulation type railway pier concrete composite structure and a construction method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of concrete materials. The composite structure sequentially comprises a heat insulation reflecting layer, a temperature control deformation layer, a flexible woven net and a rigid supporting layer from outside to inside, and is prepared by the construction method of (1) determining the actual thickness of the temperature control deformation layer, (2) installing the flexible woven net, (3) pouring temperature-change coordinated elastic fresh concrete and fresh concrete with the strength grade of more than C40 by adopting a synchronous pouring process to complete the forming of the composite structure, and (4) removing a mould and coating core-shell particle modified aerogel slurry. The solar reflectance of the core-shell particle modified aerogel slurry is more than or equal to 85%, the heat conductivity coefficient is less than or equal to 0.025W/(m.K), along with the temperature rise, the deformation capacity of the temperature change coordinated elastic concrete is improved by 10% -40%, the elastic energy absorption effect is improved by 5% -15%, the crack resistance at 20-80 ℃ is improved by 10% -20%, and the structural integrity and the service life can be ensured in a plateau large-temperature-difference environment.

title_en: Crystal-controllable high-efficiency titanium dioxide photocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystal form controllable high-efficiency titanium dioxide photocatalyst and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving potassium titanium oxalate in water, sequentially adding ammonium sulfate and sodium chlorite, uniformly stirring to obtain a homogeneous mixed solution, and then dropwise adding concentrated sulfuric acid to obtain a precursor solution; and carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the precursor solution, alternately washing the obtained precipitate with water and ethanol, and drying to obtain the high-efficiency titanium dioxide photocatalyst. The accurate regulation and control of the crystal phase composition of the product are successfully realized by accurately regulating and controlling the dosage of sodium chlorite, and the prepared powder is in the shape of blocky particles and has excellent monodispersion characteristic. The preparation process of the invention does not need subsequent high-temperature calcination or complex modification steps, reduces energy consumption, avoids doping element loss, and remarkably improves the photocatalysis performance of titanium dioxide while the preparation process is simple and economical. Compared with a commercial P25 photocatalyst, the biphasic titanium dioxide photocatalyst prepared by the invention has high-efficiency degradation performance.

title_en: Carbon monoxide purification system and purification method
abstract_en: The application discloses a carbon monoxide purification system and a purification method, and relates to the technical field of carbon monoxide preparation. The carbon monoxide purification system comprises a gas source, a cryotrap and a purification device. The low-temperature cold trap is communicated with the air source, and is used for removing part of impurities in the overhead air, and the purification device is communicated with the output end of the low-temperature cold trap and is used for reducing metal ions in the overhead air. The carbon monoxide purification system provided by the application can effectively remove gas phase impurities and metal ions in carbon monoxide gas by adopting the combination of the cryogenic cold trap and the purifier, so that the investment cost of using cryogenic rectification equipment is avoided, the liquid nitrogen energy consumption caused by using cryogenic rectification equipment is reduced, and the whole process is simpler and more efficient.

title_en: Medical intelligent molecular sieve oxygenerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical intelligent molecular sieve oxygenerator, which relates to the technical field of oxygenerators and comprises a shell, a first connecting channel, a power connection port, an air compressor, a rotary valve, a molecular sieve cylinder, an oxygen tank, an air pump and a sealing component, wherein the first connecting channel is arranged on the outer wall of the shell, the power connection port is arranged on the outer wall of the shell, the air compressor is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, and the rotary valve is arranged at one end of the air compressor. According to the intelligent molecular sieve oxygenerator, the first connecting rod is arranged to move to drive the first clamping head to move, the first clamping head moves to drive the first spring to move, the first spring moves to enable the first clamping head to move out of the second port, the organic door is arranged on the outer wall of the shell, the molecular sieve cylinder is moved after the organic door is opened, the molecular sieve cylinder moves to enable the molecular sieve cylinder to move out of the first clamping groove, the molecular sieve cylinder is replaced, the sealing gasket seals between the molecular sieve cylinder and the first clamping groove, and the function of reducing oxygen production maintenance time of the intelligent molecular sieve oxygenerator for quickly replacing the molecular sieve is achieved.

title_en: Method for preparing polyimide-based porous carbon spheres in large scale by utilizing liquid nitrogen rotary freezing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing polyimide-based porous carbon spheres in large scale by utilizing a liquid nitrogen rotary freezing method, which is prepared by utilizing a liquid nitrogen rotary freezing method, wherein four raw materials of polyimide acid, triethylamine, biomass starch and water are only used in the preparation process, and the preparation process comprises the following steps: the polyimide-based porous carbon spheres obtained through three main steps of liquid nitrogen rotation freezing shaping, freeze drying and stepwise carbonization have controllable particle size, a sphericizing rate of more than 90%, a good three-dimensional cross-linked pore structure and a large specific surface area, and the material is low-carbon, environment-friendly, pollution-free and low in cost. The preparation method is simple and efficient, is beneficial to large-scale industrial production, has remarkable advantages in the aspects of resource utilization and environmental protection, and accords with the concept of sustainable development.

title_en: Method for recycling process water in APT production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling process water in an APT production process, which relates to the field of water recycling in the APT production process and comprises the steps of S1, recycling waste water of an alkali extraction system, S2, recycling back extraction liquid evaporation ammonia water, S3, chemical treatment of pure ammonium tungstate evaporation ammonia water, S4, closed-loop utilization of ammonium molybdate evaporation ammonia water, and S5, recycling ammonia gas in a crystallization section. The invention remarkably improves the recovery rate of tungsten and molybdenum in the tail liquid by optimizing the working procedures of recycling waste water of an alkali extraction system, recovering ammonia water by evaporating back extraction liquid and the like, and circularly utilizes one part of the tail liquid in the pulping working procedure, and realizes zero emission of waste water by evaporating the other part of the tail liquid, and the evaporated condensed water can be recycled for preparing the back extraction agent, thereby further improving the utilization rate of water resources, reducing the production cost and simultaneously meeting the environmental protection requirement.

title_en: Energy-saving low-pressure PSA central oxygen-enriched system and oxygen supply method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving low-pressure PSA central oxygen-enriched system and an oxygen supply method thereof, relating to the technical field of oxygen supply devices, and comprising an oxygen generator set for preparing oxygen sources, wherein the oxygen generator set consists of one or more oxygen generators, and each oxygen generator consists of one or more groups of independent oxygen generating units; the control system automatically adjusts the quantity of the starting oxygenerator groups and whether to boost and store oxygen or not by detecting the information such as the pressure of the buffer tank, the pressure of the oxygen storage tank, the oxygen flow and the pressure on the main pipeline and calculating the time of each oxygenerator unit and the booster pump, and ensures that the working time of each oxygenerator (or oxygenerator unit) is close. The system has long service life, low energy consumption, good oxygen-enriched effect and long oxygen-feeding distance.

title_en: Manufacturing method of deformation-resistant silver jewelry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of anti-deformation silver jewelry, which comprises the steps of S1, preparing alloy components, S2, manufacturing blanks, S3, carrying out solution treatment, S4, carrying out bar rolling, S5, drawing silver wires, S6, manufacturing a filament blank, S7, carrying out aging treatment, and S8, wherein the alloy components comprise 0.1-0.5% of copper, 0.1-0.3% of zinc, 0.04-0.2% of tin, 0.03-0.15% of germanium, 0.1-0.3% of titanium, 0.02-0.1% of rare earth and the balance of silver. According to the method, through the optimized combination of alloy components and the process, the intermediate phase can be dispersed and separated out by the low-temperature aging treatment of the jewelry formed by welding in the processes of solution treatment, bar rolling, silver wire drawing, aging treatment and the like, so that the hardness of the yarn-made jewelry is obviously improved, a self-healing passivation protective film can be formed on the surface of the alloy, and the anti-color-changing capability is improved.

title_en: Processing method of metal hose without heat treatment for removing stress and obtained metal hose
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of metal hose processing, and in particular relates to a metal hose processing method capable of removing stress without heat treatment and an obtained metal hose, comprising the following steps of 1, manufacturing a corrugated pipe by adopting a cold forming process; the method comprises the steps of step 2, uniformly winding a woven mesh on the outer side of a corrugated pipe to ensure that the woven mesh is tightly attached to the corrugated pipe, step 3, sleeving a processed outer retaining ring on the outer side of the woven mesh to tightly combine the outer retaining ring, the woven mesh and the corrugated pipe together, step 4, adopting a TIG automatic welding process to weld a welding joint with the corrugated pipe, the woven mesh and the outer retaining ring, adopting high-temperature resistant rubber at the contact part of a fixture clamp, the corrugated pipe, the welding joint and the outer retaining ring in the welding process to allow a workpiece to generate tiny thermal expansion displacement during welding, and step 5, adopting a vibration aging method to perform stress relief treatment on the assembled and welded metal corrugated pipe.

title_en: Covalent organic framework material based on thiadiazole ring connection and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalytic materials, and particularly relates to a covalent organic framework material based on thiadiazole ring connection, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a locking enhancement combination vulcanization strategy aiming at a C=N bridge, which synthesizes a COFs based on thiadiazole ring connection by using Lawesson reagent as a vulcanization reagent to carry out vulcanization, cyclization and oxidation reaction on an acylhydrazone bond in a Covalent Organic Framework (COFs) connected with the acylhydrazone bond, and realizes asymmetric electron distribution by introducing S heteroatom to form a thiadiazole ring.

title_en: Recovery method of aluminum in electrolytic aluminum ash
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering aluminum in electrolytic aluminum ash, and belongs to the technical field of pretreatment of metal raw materials. The method for recycling aluminum in the electrolytic aluminum ash comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out interfacial infiltration pretreatment on the electrolytic aluminum ash by using an oxidant, S2, carrying out acid leaching on a solid product obtained in the step S1, wherein the acid leaching comprises primary acid leaching and secondary acid leaching which are sequentially carried out. The recovery method provided by the invention can effectively inhibit the violent hydrogen release reaction and the ammonia production reaction of acid leaching, can obviously improve the total recovery rate of the rate, and realizes the safe and full utilization of aluminum resources.

title_en: Method for preparing high-purity quartz sand by reverse flotation
