abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-purity quartz sand by reverse flotation, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing raw ore to obtain quartz sand, S2, floating, namely, placing the quartz sand obtained in S1 into a flotation tank, adjusting the mass concentration of ore pulp to 30-60%, adding an adjusting agent into the ore pulp, adjusting the pH value of the ore pulp to 2-4, adding an inhibitor, stirring for 3-5 min, continuously adding a collector, stirring for 10-20 min, finally adding a foaming agent, introducing air, performing reverse flotation, stirring, scraping, and washing to obtain quartz sand concentrate, wherein the inhibitor is modified starch with the particle size of less than 500 nm and the substitution degree of 0.1-1.0, the dosage is 50-250 g/t, carboxyl and aldehyde groups are introduced into the modified starch, the quartz sand concentrate after floating is subjected to secondary acid leaching and high-temperature chlorination to obtain high-purity quartz sand, the modified starch is taken as the inhibitor, meanwhile, hydroxyl (-OH) in starch molecules and the quartz surface form hydrogen bonds, the quartz surface is covered, the adsorption of the collector on quartz is blocked, and quartz loss is reduced.

title_en: Modularized casting method for lightweight axle housing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of axle housing casting, and discloses a lightweight axle housing modularized casting method, which comprises the steps of dividing an axle housing die into five dies, namely a first axle tube segment die, a first connecting segment die, a middle segment die, a second connecting segment die and a second axle tube segment die, arranging flanges at the end parts of the dies, realizing radial accurate positioning of the dies by using trapezoid positioning tongue-and-groove groups uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction, sleeving high-strength alloy steel fastening hoops on the peripheries of the flanges of the dies, generating uniform compressive stress through hydraulic expansion and radial contraction to offset thermal expansion tension, embedding sintered copper heat pipes in the dies and communicating adjacent cooling channels, triggering cooling water in the heat pipes to evaporate in a high-temperature zone of 500 ℃ to form 200-300 m/s supersonic steam flow in 1-2 seconds, conducting heat to low-temperature zones at two sides, realizing continuous heat exchange of the condensate through capillary structure backflow, controlling the temperature difference of a splicing surface to be less than or equal to +/-15 ℃, and solving the problem of parallelism deviation caused by thermal deformation.

title_en: High-performance aluminate inorganic anti-corrosion mortar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-performance aluminate inorganic anti-corrosion mortar and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mortar comprises, by weight, 200-260 parts of aluminate cement clinker, 20-30 parts of an active admixture, 5-10 parts of a nano functional component, 220-260 parts of anti-corrosion aggregate, 1.2-2.0 parts of a composite retarding and hardening accelerator, 0.6-0.9 part of a polycarboxylate water reducer, 2-3 parts of a microcapsule MgO expanding agent, 2-4 parts of polymer modified latex powder, 1.0-1.5 parts of a fiber toughening component and 0.28-0.32 of a water-to-material ratio. The high-performance aluminate inorganic anti-corrosion mortar solves the problems of traditional aluminate mortar that the strength is reduced and the weather resistance of the organic mortar is poor, realizes the performances of high corrosion resistance, high strength, high durability, micro expansion and self-repairing, and can be widely suitable for industrial environment anti-corrosion and urban underground pipe network non-excavation repairing requirements.

title_en: Copper alloy powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses copper alloy powder and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of alloy powder. The preparation method of the copper alloy powder comprises the following steps of S1, immersing a copper alloy powder body in passivation solution under ultrasonic conditions, drying at 40-60 ℃, heating to 80-100 ℃ and drying to form a pre-passivation layer, S2, firstly, preserving heat of the dried copper alloy powder body at 200-350 ℃, then preserving heat according to a heating rate of 2-3-450 ℃ and then preserving heat according to a heating rate of 5-10-800-1000 ℃, and finally forming the passivation layer. The copper alloy powder prepared by the invention can realize long-term oxidation resistance.

title_en: Rust inhibitor for marine reinforced concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rust inhibitor for marine reinforced concrete and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of rust inhibitors. The rust inhibitor is double-layer wall shell nano microcapsule powder with the average grain diameter of 50-100 mu m, a core phase comprises an inorganic corrosion inhibitor, an organic film forming agent, a pH adjusting and mineralizing component and/or sacrificial anode particles, and an outer shell phase consists of an inner shell, an outer shell and nano additives. The rust inhibitor realizes triple protection in concrete through physical separation, electrochemical stabilization and nanostructure self-adaptive response, and can be coated on the surface of a steel bar to form a temporary protective film in the construction period. The preparation adopts a W/O/W double-emulsification, shell layer solidification and spray drying process, and ensures controllable release and stable components. The continuous protection from the construction period to the whole life cycle can be realized in the application, and the durability and the chloride ion corrosion resistance of the marine reinforced concrete are obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-performance Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-performance Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strip. The preparation method adopts a hot-cold combined casting continuous casting technology to prepare alloy blanks, then carries out cold deformation, high-temperature short-time solid solution, secondary cold deformation and recrystallization treatment at high temperature to obtain solid solution state alloy plates, and then sequentially carries out low-temperature aging, small cold deformation and high-temperature aging treatment to obtain the high-performance Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strips. The preparation method omits a hot rolling cogging link in the traditional process, and the alloy can directly enter a cold deformation stage, so that the preparation yield of the material is effectively improved, the treatment time is obviously shortened, the energy consumption is reduced, and the process efficiency and the energy utilization rate are higher. The Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strip obtained by cutting has ultrahigh strength and good plasticity, the strength-plastic product of the Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strip is about 3-4 times that of a conventional process treatment material, excellent comprehensive mechanical properties are shown, and the Cu-Ni-Sn alloy strip has wide engineering application prospect.

title_en: Graphite purification parameter optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphite purification parameter optimization system, which relates to the technical field of graphite purification and comprises the steps of collecting a graphite characteristic information set of graphite ore to be purified, obtaining a dimension-reduced graphite characteristic information set, an impurity dimension-reduced graphite characteristic information set and a structural dimension-reduced graphite characteristic information set, optimizing the concentration of pickling solution in graphite purification parameters according to dimension-reduced impurity content information to obtain an optimized pickling solution concentration set, optimizing stirring parameters in the graphite purification parameters according to dimension-reduced graphite ore size information to obtain an optimal purification parameter combination, obtaining optimal auxiliary agent component parameters, and adding the optimal purification parameter combination to serve as a graphite purification parameter optimization result. The technical problems that the existing graphite purification parameters are difficult to accurately grasp the essential characteristics of graphite ore, and further the graphite purification parameters are inaccurate in optimization, low in purification efficiency and insufficient in graphite purity are solved, and the technical effect of improving the graphite purification efficiency and quality is achieved.

title_en: Saw blade metal matrix heat treatment equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides heat treatment equipment for a metal matrix of a saw blade, and relates to the field of metal heat treatment. The electric heating wire device comprises a furnace body, an electric heating wire and a placement mechanism, wherein the electric heating wire is installed in the furnace body, the placement mechanism is in a plurality of places, the placement mechanism is equidistantly placed in the furnace body and is controlled to limit the edge of a saw blade placed in the placement mechanism, and the placement mechanism comprises an installation seat, a lifting frame, a longitudinal clamping arm, a rotating shaft, a rotating rod, a first limiting groove, a second limiting groove, a connecting frame, a second limiting rod, a transverse clamping arm, a second sliding groove and a second sliding rod. The self gravity of saw bit can be utilized to carry out spacing to it, and the surface can be stable expose in the thermal environment when guaranteeing the heat treatment, and can carry out the spacing of horizontal direction to it voluntarily, guarantees to remain stable in the handling process.

title_en: Heat treatment process method for wheel
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat treatment process method for a wheel, and belongs to the technical field of heat treatment of wheels. Aiming at blank wheels after welding forming, the process sequentially comprises three core steps of gradient heating, double-water-channel pulse quenching cooling and tempering cooling, and the temperature, the cooling mode and the technological parameters of each stage are precisely controlled, so that the thermal stress of the blank is effectively reduced, oxidation is prevented, the uniformity of the wheel structure is ensured, the wheel strength is obviously improved, meanwhile, the quenching internal stress is eliminated, the brittleness is reduced, the structure is stabilized, and finally, the wheel product with excellent performance is obtained. Experimental data show that the tensile strength of the wheel treated by the process is improved by 15-23% compared with that of the wheel treated by the traditional process, the yield strength is improved by 18-25%, the internal stress residual quantity is reduced by 30-42%, and the problems that the wheel is prone to cracking, uneven in structure, unstable in performance and the like in the traditional heat treatment process are solved, so that the method is suitable for large-scale wheel production.

title_en: Silver copper oxide electrical contact material applied to new energy charging pile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a silver copper oxide electrical contact material applied to a new energy charging pile and a preparation method thereof, the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, vacuum smelting silver ingots, copper ingots, cerium ingots and indium ingots, cooling by a crystallizer to obtain silver alloy continuous casting wires, wherein the diameter of each silver alloy continuous casting wire is 8-10 mm, cu accounts for 6-10wt%, in accounts for 0.3-0.8wt%, ce accounts for 0.1-0.4wt% and the balance is Ag In each silver alloy continuous casting wire, S2, drawing the silver alloy continuous casting wires obtained In the step S1 by adopting multi-pass cold drawing, and then granulating by adopting ultrasonic vibration, S3, oxidizing the granules obtained In the step S2 to obtain oxidized granules In a step, and the preparation method is low In energy consumption, high In processing efficiency and uniform In oxidation of the prepared electrical contact material.

title_en: Fire-resistant heat-insulating flame-retardant mica plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of functional boards, in particular to a fire-resistant heat-insulating flame-retardant mica plate and a preparation method thereof. The fire-resistant heat-insulating flame-retardant mica plate comprises, by mass, 100-120 parts of a phlogopite substrate, 40-60 parts of a bonding system composition, 15-25 parts of a heat-insulating functional phase, 8-15 parts of a reinforcing composition, 4-8 parts of a polymerization auxiliary agent, 10-20 parts of a flame retardant functional phase, 1-3 parts of a coupling agent and 0.01-0.03 part of a platinum catalyst. The application provides a fire-resistant heat-insulating flame-retardant mica plate and a preparation method thereof. The mica plate finally prepared by the application not only can keep excellent fire resistance, heat insulation and flame retardance, but also can simultaneously have excellent service life, balance the performance of the plate and keep good waterproof, corrosion-resistant and ageing-resistant performances.

title_en: Low-C low-Cr corrosion-resistant pipeline steel plate, preparation method and pipeline steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline steel for oil and gas transmission, in particular to a low-C low-Cr corrosion-resistant pipeline steel plate, a preparation method and a pipeline steel pipe, wherein the content of each chemical element in the low-C low-Cr corrosion-resistant pipeline steel plate is ：C≤0.03wt.%,Sb≤0.025wt.%,Al 0.50～1.20wt.%,Mg 0.0005～0.0012wt.%,Ca 0.0012～0.0042wt.%,Cr≤0.50wt.%,Ni 0.10～0.30wt.%,Si 0.10～0.30wt.%,Mn 1.20～1.80wt.%,Mo 0.10～0.30wt.%,Nb 0.02～0.06wt.%,V 0.03～0.08wt.%,Ti 0.01～0.03wt.%,P≤0.01wt.%,S≤0.001wt.%,N≤0.005wt.%, as shown below, and the balance is Fe and unavoidable impurity elements. The steel plate manufactured by the invention has low manufacturing cost, and excellent mechanical properties such as yield strength, tensile strength, elongation, impact toughness, corrosion resistance, hydrogen induced cracking resistance and the like, and is suitable for submarine and land oil gas transmission pipeline engineering in a high Cl  ‑ 、CO 2 /H 2  S corrosion environment.

title_en: Device and method for improving PCM adsorption capacity in ceramsite
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for improving the PCM adsorption capacity in ceramsite, the device comprises an ultrasonic pretreatment cavity, a vacuum dynamic impregnation cavity and a centrifugal auxiliary filling cavity, wherein a double-layer stainless steel pipe, an ultrasonic generator, a transducer, a luffing device, a temperature control system, a telescopic aggregate feeding port, a porous tray and a telescopic bracket are arranged in the ultrasonic pretreatment cavity, the temperature control system is integrated on the outer wall of the ultrasonic pretreatment cavity, the porous tray is positioned at the bottom of the cavity, a vacuum pump, an exhaust pipe, a pressure display, a rotary stirring paddle, a pulse pressurizing device, an interlayer temperature control system and a liquid supplementing pipe are arranged in the vacuum dynamic impregnation cavity, the centrifugal auxiliary filling cavity comprises a centrifugal machine, a blower, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe and a fixed rod, and the multi-process is realized through the combined design of the ultrasonic pretreatment cavity, the vacuum dynamic impregnation cavity and the centrifugal auxiliary filling cavity, so that the adsorption capacity of the PCM in the ceramsite is effectively improved.

title_en: Green high-strength concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of concrete, and particularly relates to green high-strength concrete and a preparation method thereof, wherein an organic phase-change material with a phase-change temperature of 0-10 ℃ is packaged by a polymethyl methacrylate shell to prepare organic microcapsules, an inorganic phase-change material with a phase-change temperature of 50-95 ℃ is packaged by a urea resin shell to prepare inorganic microcapsules, the organic microcapsules and the inorganic microcapsules are mutually combined into microcapsule pairs, a silicon dioxide shell is wrapped outside the microcapsule pairs to obtain phase-change particles, and the phase-change particles are mixed into the concrete to obtain the high-strength concrete. The green high-strength concrete comprises two phase change materials with different phase change temperatures, can store heat when the temperature is raised internally, effectively reduces the temperature rise rate of the interior of the concrete, and simultaneously, can cope with the low temperature of the outer wall, relieves the influence of freezing injury, reduces the temperature difference between the inside and the outside, reduces the thermal stress caused by the temperature difference, and further reduces the cracking risk.

title_en: Concrete utilizing industrial solid waste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete, in particular to concrete utilizing industrial solid waste and a preparation method thereof, wherein the concrete comprises, by weight, 380-500 parts of cementing materials, 250-400 parts of lightweight aggregate, 10-60 parts of healing agents, 20-60 parts of microorganism carriers, 150-250 parts of water, 500-650 parts of fine aggregate, 700-1050 parts of coarse aggregate and 4-6 parts of water reducing agents, the lightweight aggregate is microorganism reinforced solid waste porous ceramsite, the healing agents comprise urea and calcium lactate in a molar ratio of 1:1, and the microorganism carriers are porous lightweight materials loaded with microorganisms. The invention solves the problems of the current concrete industry such as natural resource shortage, serious industrial solid waste pollution, easy cracking of concrete structure and insufficient self-repairing capability, realizes the high-value utilization of industrial solid waste, and simultaneously endows the concrete with the dual performance of light weight, high strength and high-efficiency self-repairing.

title_en: Quick-drying type self-leveling repair mortar for pavement and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building materials, and particularly discloses quick-drying type self-leveling repair mortar for a pavement and a preparation method thereof. The quick-drying self-leveling repair mortar for the pavement comprises, by weight, 100-120 parts of quick-setting gelling materials, 160-240 parts of graded quartz sand, 5-10 parts of graphene quantum dot modified nano calcium carbonate, 2-5 parts of isocyanate-terminated polyether-siloxane copolymer, 2-5 parts of steel fibers, 3-6 parts of styrene-acrylic emulsion, 0.1-0.3 part of retarder, 0.03-0.08 part of air entraining agent, 2-4 parts of water reducer and 30-40 parts of water. The repairing mortar disclosed by the application meets the comprehensive performance requirements of quick drying, self-leveling, high freezing resistance and high adhesion through the synergistic effect of various key substances, breaks through the defects of poor freezing and thawing resistance and poor binding force with a pavement base layer of the repairing mortar in the prior art, and effectively prolongs the service life of a repairing layer.

title_en: Ceramic matrix composite aeroengine flame tube sweating cooling method based on gradient in-situ autogenous pore structure
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of structural materials for aviation, and discloses application of gradient pore ceramic matrix composite material sweat cooling in heat protection of an aeroengine flame tube. The ceramic matrix composite comprises a preform, wherein the preform comprises single-layer fiber cloth which is arranged in a stacked mode, the single-layer fiber cloth comprises fiber bundles which are arranged in a weaving mode, the fiber bundles comprise a plurality of fiber filaments which are combined together, and a silicon carbide matrix which is deposited on the surface of the preform. The ceramic matrix composite has the advantages of high temperature resistance and light weight, is applied to manufacturing the wall surface of the flame tube of the combustion chamber of the aeroengine, performs sweating and cooling by taking in-situ autogenous holes in the material as airflow flowing channels, changes the pore distribution rule of the material by utilizing a porosity adjusting scheme, achieves the aim of preparing gradient pore materials, and further adjusts the cooling air consumption.

title_en: Immunohistochemical detection kit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of immunohistochemistry, and provides an immunohistochemical detection kit which comprises a primary antibody, ferritin bionic manganese oxide nano particles and a chromogenic solution, wherein the primary antibody is a specific antibody of target protein, the ferritin bionic manganese oxide nano particles are a compound of fusion ferritin and manganese oxide, the fusion ferritin is a fusion protein of ferritin and protein combined with an Fc structural domain of the antibody, and the ferritin bionic manganese oxide nano particles are used for combining with the primary antibody and catalyzing a substrate in the chromogenic solution to develop color and do not comprise hydrogen peroxide. The invention can avoid the use of H  2 O 2  and solve the problems of high detection cost, endogenous peroxidase interference and potential safety hazard caused by H  2 O 2  in the existing immunohistochemical technology.

title_en: High-uniformity nano silver particles, continuous preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides high-uniformity nano silver particles, a continuous preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano silver. The method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving water-soluble silver salt in water, then adding a coordination atomic reagent to form a uniform complex precursor solution, dissolving a reducing agent and a high-molecular dispersing agent in another part of water to obtain a reducing agent/dispersing agent solution, (2) atomizing the complex precursor solution and the reducing agent/dispersing agent solution into micron-sized liquid drops respectively by using a nozzle, (3) carrying out collision and fusion on the liquid drops in a spraying area to finish a reduction reaction in a short time and generate silver nano particles, (4) collecting the liquid drops after the reaction, separating the silver particles, washing and drying to obtain the high-uniformity nano silver particles. According to the method, the instantaneous mixing and uniform nucleation of reactants are realized by constructing a microscale liquid drop reaction system which does not depend on a reaction container, so that silver nano particles with finer particle sizes and narrower distribution are obtained.

title_en: Ceramic product crystal stacking color process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic product crystal-overlapping color process which comprises the following steps of S1 preparing powdery ground glaze and transparent color glaze, S2 preparing liquid ground glaze and liquid transparent color glaze by adopting water respectively, S3 hand-painting the prepared ground glaze into blank patterns drawn on a ceramic product in advance, then firing in an electric kiln, S4 taking out the ground glaze after firing to be naturally cooled to normal temperature, hand-painting the transparent color glaze onto the ground glaze already fired on the ceramic product, then firing in the electric kiln, S5 taking out the ground glaze after firing to be naturally cooled to normal temperature, washing and dyeing, first firing after washing and dyeing, taking out the ground glaze to be naturally cooled to normal temperature, and finally hand-painting a layer of transparent white glaze.

title_en: Cold-rolled hot-dip galvanized steel and cold rolling method for producing hot dip galvanized steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses cold-rolled hot-dip galvanized steel, which comprises, by mass, 0.1-0.18% of C, 0.4-0.8% of Si, 1.8-2.5% of Mn, 0.01-0.2% of Al, less than or equal to 0.002% of B, less than or equal to 0.02% of P, less than or equal to 0.01% of S, less than or equal to 0.008% of N, and the balance Fe and unavoidable impurities, wherein the average Fe content in an alloyed hot-dip galvanized layer of the cold-rolled hot-dip galvanized steel is 9-12% by mass, the surface phase structure composition of the alloyed hot-dip galvanized layer contains a polygonal zinc-iron alloy phase, the polygonal zinc-iron alloy phase is delta phase, and the proportion of the polygonal zinc-iron alloy phase accounts for more than 80% of the total area of alloy phase in the alloyed hot-dip galvanized layer. The steel plate has low cost and good formability and punching performance. The invention also discloses a manufacturing method of the cold-rolled hot-dip galvanized steel, which improves the relation between the steel plate matrix and the coating by controlling the air-fuel ratio, the dew point, the heating rate in the continuous annealing step and the alloying temperature and the heating rate in the alloying step, thereby improving the formability and the stamping performance of the steel plate.

title_en: Die-casting forming device for aluminum alloy shell
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of shell die casting, and relates to an aluminum alloy shell die casting forming device which comprises a bracket, a hydraulic cylinder, a bottom plate, a guide rod, an elastic piece I, a lower die, an upper die and a bearing plate, wherein the hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the inner bottom of the bracket, the bottom plate is connected with a telescopic rod of the hydraulic cylinder, guide rods are connected to four corners of the top of the bottom plate, a supporting plate is connected between the guide rods in a sliding mode, a lower die is connected to the top of the supporting plate, the guide rods are in sliding fit with the lower die, an upper die is connected to the upper portion in the support, and a plurality of first elastic pieces are connected between the supporting plate and the bottom plate. When the die casting device is used for die casting aluminum alloy, after the upper die and the lower die are closed, the piston plate can be controlled to move upwards to draw air in the cavity through the air duct, so that air bubbles in a formed shell are avoided due to the existence of air in the cavity, and the quality of a formed workpiece is ensured.

title_en: Lanthanum oxide-containing tungsten-based rare earth heating wire powder spheroidizing and vertical smelting sintering preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of tungsten-based rare earth heating wire powder spheroidizing and vertical melting sintering containing lanthanum oxide, and relates to the technical field of heating wire preparation. The invention adopts tungsten-based powder containing rare earth element lanthanum oxide, and prepares the tungsten-based heating wire with refined crystal grains and compact oxide film by optimizing technological parameters. The method can effectively improve the high-temperature strength and oxidation resistance of the heating wire and prolong the service life of the heating wire. The invention is suitable for the fields of high-temperature heating scenes, such as electric heaters, electric furnaces and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for recovering trisodium phosphate, tripotassium phosphate, iron oxide red and graphite from iron phosphate slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recycling trisodium phosphate, tripotassium phosphate, ferric oxide red and graphite from iron phosphate slag, which comprises the following steps of 1, pulping, namely, putting the iron phosphate slag into pulping equipment, adding a proper amount of deionized water, starting the equipment to perform pulping, fully dispersing the iron phosphate slag to form uniform slurry materials, wherein the purpose of pulping is to increase the contact area of the iron phosphate slag and a subsequent reagent, improve the efficiency of subsequent reaction, 2, stirring and leaching, namely, transferring the slurry materials obtained by pulping into a stirring and leaching reaction kettle, adding 32% liquid alkali into the reaction kettle according to a proportion of 20%, then starting a stirring device, controlling the temperature in the reaction kettle to be 25-40 ℃, and enabling the stirring and leaching time to be 30-60 minutes, so that the liquid alkali fully reacts with the components in the iron phosphate slag.

title_en: Method for upgrading and regenerating lithium iron phosphate by using waste lithium iron phosphate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for upgrading and regenerating waste lithium iron phosphate into lithium manganese phosphate, which comprises the steps of mixing waste lithium iron phosphate powder with sulfuric acid solution, adding ascorbic acid after dissolving in 80 ℃ oil bath, then adding a manganese source and a phosphorus source to form solution A, wherein the proportion of Mn to Fe to P is X to 1-X to 1, adding a lithium source into the solution A, adjusting pH to be neutral to form suspension B, adding polyethylene glycol solution with the same volume as that of the lithium source solution, carrying out solvothermal reaction after mixing, and washing and drying to obtain the lithium manganese phosphate material. According to the invention, the direct upgrading and reconstruction of the waste lithium iron phosphate is realized by a one-step solvothermal method, the process is simple, the cost is low, the prepared lithium iron manganese phosphate material has a uniform shuttle structure, high crystallinity and excellent electrochemical performance, the first discharge specific capacity reaches 152.61mAh/g, the first coulomb efficiency reaches 97.4%, and the problems of complex traditional recovery process, high energy consumption and low energy density of the regenerated material are effectively solved.

title_en: Cooling control process for improving hardness of 38CrMoAl bar for injection molding machine barrel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling control process for improving the hardness of a 38CrMoAl bar for an injection molding machine barrel, which belongs to the technical field of steel, and comprises the steps of rapidly feeding the 38CrMoAl hot rolled bar to a cooling bed, covering a heat preservation cover, and slowly cooling to 350-400 ℃; then the steel is put into a heat preservation pit for stress relief and slow cooling, so that the problems of high hardness and non-uniformity of the cross section of the 38CrMoAl hot rolled bar are effectively solved, the center drilling processing requirements of customers on products are completely met, meanwhile, the defect of steel bending is effectively overcome, and the product quality is comprehensively improved.

title_en: Method for improving molybdenum yield in molybdenum oxide direct alloying process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving molybdenum yield in a molybdenum oxide direct alloying process, which comprises the following steps of firstly adjusting a gun position of an oxygen gun, detecting a sonar slag formation curve and a CO curve, judging slag foaming performance by combining the sonar slag formation curve and a furnace gas CO curve in a smelting process, secondly adding molybdenum oxide, enhancing bottom blowing and reducing the gun position of the oxygen gun, thirdly, further reducing the gun position, simultaneously reducing the gun position to be 0.1-0.3 m below a basic gun position, improving decarburization speed to be more than 0.3%/min, and inhibiting volatilization of the molybdenum oxide by utilizing slag foaming and high CaO content, thereby improving the molybdenum yield. According to the invention, the slag component and the foaming performance are controlled by adjusting the lance position of the oxygen lance, the slag foaming performance is judged by combining sonar slag melting and a furnace gas CO curve, the molybdenum oxide raw material is added when the slag foaming performance is good, and meanwhile, the volatilization of the molybdenum oxide is inhibited by utilizing slag foaming and high CaO content. Effectively prevents molybdenum oxide from sublimating, the yield of metallic molybdenum can reach more than 95 percent, and reduces the production cost of molybdenum-containing steel.

title_en: Silicon anode material, preparation method and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon anode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery, and relates to the technical field of battery anode materials. Stable lithium compound nano particles are generated by deposition or transformation on the inner wall of the porous carbon, and silicon or silicon oxide or silicon lithium alloy is induced to form nano particles in the vapor deposition process and distributed by taking the lithium compound nano particles as the center. The lithium compound has high boiling point, can provide crystallization sites for silicon stabilization during vapor deposition to prevent agglomeration of silicon nano particles, is a lithium ion conductor, has high mechanical strength, can improve kinetics during lithium intercalation of a silicon negative electrode, and can slow down expansion of the silicon negative electrode.

title_en: Bulk material conveying system and method for conveying bulk material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bulk material conveying system, in particular for conveying raw material powder into a device for producing three-dimensional workpieces by irradiation of a raw material powder layer with electromagnetic radiation or particle radiation. The bulk material conveying system comprises a conveying pipe which is designed to convey a gas flow and to convey a bulk material flow driven by the gas flow at least in sections, and a metering device which is designed to supply a predetermined amount of bulk material per unit time to the gas flow. The quantity is determined by a control value supplied to the metering device. The bulk material conveying system further comprises a conveying device designed to convey the gas flow through the conveying conduit, and at least one measuring device for measuring at least one parameter of the gas flow. The bulk material conveying system further comprises a control device which is designed to determine the gas density of the gas flow on the basis of the measured at least one parameter of the gas flow, to determine the bulk material mass flow of the bulk material flow on the basis of the control value supplied to the metering device, to determine the target speed of the gas flow on the basis of the gas density and on the basis of the bulk material mass flow, and to control the conveying device to convey the gas flow at the determined target speed.

title_en: Bright rod preparation device and method with crystallizer of four-layer structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bright rod preparation, in particular to a bright rod preparation device and method with a crystallizer of a four-layer structure, comprising a fixing frame, wherein a pouring position and a forming position are arranged on the fixing frame, a crystallizer body is arranged in the fixing frame, the device comprises an outer shell, the top and the bottom of the outer shell are respectively provided with an opening, a graphite emulsion-based smooth layer, a ceramic inner tube and an asbestos heat insulation layer are sequentially arranged in the outer shell from inside to outside, a partition plate is arranged in the graphite emulsion-based smooth layer, the use safety and reliability of the bright rod are remarkably improved through the direction-selecting crystallization function of the crystallizer body, the cooling function of a cooling assembly on a threaded column and the dynamic temperature control of the spiral rising of a heating rod, the ordered solidification of metal liquid from bottom to top can be realized, the internal dendrite structure and loose defects formed in the traditional ingot solidification process can be greatly reduced, the internal cracks caused by stress concentration during subsequent forging and hot rolling can be avoided, and the fracture failure of finished products can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Separation147Pm and146Nd method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for separating  147  Pm and  146  Nd, which comprises the steps of S1, pretreatment of AG 50W multiplied by 8 chromatographic columns, S2, loading feed liquid containing  147  Pm and  146  Nd on the chromatographic columns, S3, leaching the chromatographic columns by using hydrochloric acid solution, S4, leaching the chromatographic columns by using deionized water, S5, leaching the chromatographic columns by using alpha-hydroxyisobutyric acid solution, and collecting leached eluent. By the method, milligram grade  147  Pm can be extracted from gram grade  146  Nd, the separation effect is good, and the recovery rate of  147  Pm is high.

title_en: Optimization method and system for aerosolized powder preparation nozzle
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimization method and system of an aerosolized powder making nozzle, and relates to the field of aerosolized powder making; according to the parameters of the aerosolized powder process, based on a Navier-Stokes equation set, carrying out dimensional analysis on the melt crushing behavior of the aerosolized process to determine dimensionless parameters related to the aerosolized process, establishing a data-driven dimensionless parameter-nozzle structure-powder particle size distribution mapping model according to the target powder particle size and the dimensionless parameters to optimize the structure of an aerosolized nozzle spray pipe, based on the optimized structure of the aerosolized nozzle spray pipe, adopting a aerosolized powder process multi-field full-coupling numerical simulation model to simulate the aerosolized powder process to obtain physical field distribution information, and optimizing the structure of the aerosolized nozzle according to the physical field distribution information to obtain an optimal nozzle structure. The application greatly reduces the powder preparation cost and improves the quality and the yield of the powder.

title_en: Ultrathin flexible glass containing flexible material coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass material preparation, and particularly discloses ultrathin flexible glass containing a flexible material coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ultrathin flexible glass containing the flexible material coating is provided with an acrylic modified organic silicon resin as a main film forming matrix, so that the coating is endowed with excellent weather resistance and chemical stability, the toughness, wear resistance and ultraviolet aging resistance of the coating are obviously enhanced by introducing composite modified polyurethane, and vinyl silicone oil plays roles of enhancing the flexibility and improving the leveling property and surface smoothness of the coating, and meanwhile, the surface tension of the coating can be reduced, so that the coating is more uniformly distributed on the surface of the glass; benzoyl peroxide is used as an initiator, so that the resin is promoted to crosslink and solidify under the low-temperature condition, the crosslinking density is improved, the transmission of external impact is effectively blocked, and the impact resistance of the coating is improved.

title_en: Method for improving extraction efficiency of copper and zinc in zinc leaching residues by utilizing ultrasonic waves and manganese dioxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrometallurgy, and discloses a method for improving the extraction efficiency of copper and zinc in zinc leaching residues by utilizing ultrasonic wave to cooperate with manganese dioxide. The method effectively removes the passivation layer on the surface of the copper mine by using the cavitation effect and the microjet effect of ultrasonic waves, enhances the reaction contact between the leaching solution and minerals, and realizes synchronous and efficient leaching of copper and zinc by oxidizing copper sulfide and spinel type zinc ferrite by high-valence manganese ions generated by manganese dioxide in an acidic medium. The method can obviously improve the leaching rate of copper under mild conditions, and has the advantages of zinc recovery, low energy consumption and environmental friendliness.

title_en: Solid-state hydrogen production equipment with micro-channel structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses solid hydrogen production equipment with a micro-channel structure, which comprises a shell (1), wherein a solid hydrogen production pile structure (2) is arranged in the shell (1), a cold water inlet pipe (4) and a hot water inlet pipe (3) are respectively arranged at the lower end of the solid hydrogen production pile structure (2), an air outlet pipe (6) is arranged at the upper end of the solid hydrogen production pile structure (2), the solid hydrogen production pile structure (2) comprises a plurality of hydrogen production modules (7) which are stacked up and down, end plates (8) are arranged outside the hydrogen production modules (7) at the two ends, the two ends of the two end plates (8) are connected through a screw rod (9), the hydrogen production modules (7) comprise sealing gaskets (71), a first diamond-shaped net (72), a magnesium felt (73), a second diamond-shaped net (74) and a micro-channel assembly (75) which are distributed in sequence, water which reacts with the solid hydrogen production pile structure is also stored in the shell (1), and the pH value of the water is 2-5. The invention has the characteristics of simple and convenient hydrogen production.

title_en: Pore-forming method of graphite oxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pore-forming method of graphite oxide, and belongs to the technical field of graphite oxide. The method comprises the steps of firstly uniformly mixing graphite oxide with an alkali solution formed by mixing NaOH and KOH according to a molar ratio of 1-2:1-2, wherein the mass ratio of the alkali to the graphite oxide is 1:2-4, then drying the mixed solution and grinding the mixed solution to enable the granularity of the material to reach 0.070-0.078mm, then carrying out high Wen Ke corrosion reduction on the ground material in a tubular furnace at 700-900 ℃ for 0.5-2h, then carrying out ultrasonic oscillation washing with deionized water for 2-3 times, and finally drying the washed material to obtain porous redox graphene with through holes, wherein the micropore volume is 0.02-0.04cm  3 ·g ‑1 , and the specific surface area in micropores is 41.2-47.08m  2 ·g ‑1 . According to the invention, by controlling key factors influencing pore distribution and size in an alkali etching method, mild pore forming is realized, the pore size and the pore distribution rate of the obtained product are balanced and reasonable, the ionic conductivity and the electronic conductivity are balanced, the rate performance of the lithium ion battery is effectively improved, and the problem of large ionic steric hindrance of the traditional graphene conductive slurry is solved.

title_en: Bearing outer ring local induction heating and hardness softening equipment and process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing outer ring local induction heating and hardness softening device and a process thereof, wherein the device comprises a base and a rotating shaft, the base is connected with a supporting column, a rotating hole is axially formed in the supporting column, a mounting head is formed at the initial end of the rotating shaft, a heating component for performing induction heating on the bearing outer ring to be processed is arranged on the mounting head, a driving component for driving the rotating shaft to operate is arranged on the base, and a cooling component for cooling the local part of the mounting head is arranged between the base and the mounting head. The method also comprises a processing technology, and specifically comprises the following steps of S1, installing a bearing to be processed, S2, debugging the position of an electromagnetic heating coil, S3, running a cooling assembly, S4, running a driving assembly, and S5, running the heating assembly. The invention solves the problems that the temperature generated by heating when the bearing outer ring of which the hardness is required to be locally reduced in a specific area is in an induction heating mode is easy to influence the corresponding raceway area, so that the hardness of the raceway area is reduced and the bearing capacity of the raceway is influenced in the prior art.

title_en: Energy-saving motor set, potassium-containing precipitate ball milling equipment and lithium precipitation mother liquor separation process
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving motor unit, potassium-containing precipitate ball milling equipment and a lithium precipitation mother liquor separation process, which relate to the technical field of energy-saving grinding and comprise a bottom plate, a driving mechanism and a positioning assembly, wherein the driving mechanism comprises a mounting seat arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a motor is arranged on the upper surface of the mounting seat through bolts, a driving gear is connected with a key groove of an output shaft of the motor, a driving belt wheel and a driven belt wheel are respectively connected in the mounting seat in a rotating way, and belts are sleeved on the outer walls of the driving belt wheel and the driven belt wheel. The scheme generates power through inertial rotation of the motor, then converts electric energy into an energy storage state, and finally can recycle the starting motor to work, and the core is inertial kinetic energy generated in the shutdown or deceleration process of the motor, wherein the inertial kinetic energy mainly comes from revolution, combines rotation, stores grinding tanks, grinding media and the rotational inertia of materials, converts the inertial kinetic energy into electric energy through the motor, and recycles the electric energy through an energy storage or feedback device, so that the grinding energy conservation of the motor is finally realized.

title_en: Preparation method of wear-resistant copper-chromium-zirconium alloy
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a wear-resistant copper-chromium-zirconium alloy, which belongs to the technical field of alloy preparation and comprises the steps of designing alloy components through thermodynamic calculation, determining alloy raw material proportions with the weight percentage of Cu-0.8Cr-0.15Zr-0.05Si, selecting raw materials according to the proportions, placing the raw materials in a vacuum non-consumable smelting furnace, controlling the vacuum degree and the smelting temperature, smelting for multiple times to obtain alloy blanks with uniform components, placing the alloy blanks in a high-temperature box type furnace, preprocessing to enable the alloy to separate out a disperse phase to obtain an alloy sample, processing the alloy samples into a sample, and carrying out wear resistance test by a friction and wear testing machine according to preset friction pair and testing parameters to finally obtain the wear-resistant copper-chromium-zirconium alloy. The invention obviously improves the wear resistance of the alloy by controlling the alloy components, smelting uniformity, alloy microstructure and performance, has good repeatability and stability, and is suitable for the scene with higher requirements on the wear-resistant copper alloy in industrial production.

title_en: Low-expansion high-capacity silicon-carbon composite anode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of secondary battery cathode materials. More particularly, relates to a low-expansion high-capacity silicon-carbon composite anode material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of providing a porous carbon carrier, preparing a solution containing a silicon compound as an impregnating solution, impregnating the porous carbon carrier in the impregnating solution, controlling a drying or aging process in a programmed manner, inducing the silicon compound to form gradient distribution in pore channels of the porous carbon carrier to obtain a precursor, and carrying out heat treatment on the precursor in an inert atmosphere to pyrolyze the silicon compound to obtain the silicon-carbon composite anode material. In the gradient distribution, the silicon element located inside the material particles is at least partially in the form of elemental silicon, and the silicon element located on the surface of the material particles is at least partially in the form of silicon oxide and/or silicon carbide.

title_en: Preparation method of nano calcium carbonate for electronic adhesive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano calcium carbonate for electronic glue, which relates to the technical field of nano calcium carbonate production and comprises the steps of preparing aged lime milk suspension with deionized water according to a proportion, sieving and removing impurities to obtain lime milk diluent, sending the lime milk diluent into a carbonization kettle, adding a compound dispersing agent and a compound crystal form control agent into the carbonization kettle, sending kiln gas into the carbonization kettle, stopping conveying kiln gas when the pH value of feed liquid in the carbonization kettle is 6.5-7.3, stirring and ageing, performing secondary carbonization to obtain suspension, adding a compound coating agent into the suspension, then adding a surface treatment agent for modification to obtain modified nano calcium carbonate, and flash drying and crushing the modified nano calcium carbonate to obtain finished nano calcium carbonate. Therefore, the composite use of a plurality of crystal form control agents leads the nano calcium carbonate particles to form cubic and chain-shaped multiple conversion, improves the mechanical property of the electronic adhesive, and improves the dispersibility of the nano calcium carbonate through a secondary aging carbonization process.

title_en: Integrated continuous basalt fiber wire drawing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated continuous basalt fiber wire drawing device, which belongs to the technical field of basalt fiber preparation and comprises a feeding device, a heating device and a wire drawing device, wherein the feeding device comprises a spiral feeder and a feeding funnel, the feeding funnel is arranged at the lower end of an outlet of the spiral feeder, the feeding funnel is arranged above the heating device, the heating device comprises an electromagnetic induction heating device, the spiral feeder and the feeding funnel are matched to uniformly disperse basalt mineral powder into the electromagnetic induction heating device to be heated into solution, and the wire drawing device is arranged below the electromagnetic induction heating device and is used for drawing basalt solution. The integrated continuous basalt fiber wiredrawing device can effectively solve the problems that in the prior art, continuous basalt fibers have irreversible damage to crucible furnaces, kilns and the like for melting, the service life of equipment is seriously influenced, the operation efficiency of the equipment and the yield of products are seriously influenced, and the like when formula tests are carried out.

title_en: Method for treating spent hydrogenation catalyst, method for hydrotreating heavy oil and/or residuum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste catalyst treatment, and discloses a treatment method of a waste hydrogenation catalyst, a hydrogenation catalyst, heavy oil and/or residual oil hydrogenation treatment method, which comprises (1) carrying out charcoal burning treatment on the waste hydrogenation catalyst in an oxygen-containing atmosphere, (2) leaching part of metals in the catalyst obtained in the step (1) by adopting an acid solution to obtain a leaching solution and a leaching residual catalyst, wherein compared with the waste hydrogenation catalyst, the leaching rate of vanadium in the leaching residual catalyst in terms of oxide is 62-94 percent, (3) carrying out extraction treatment on the leaching solution to obtain an extract solution and a raffinate containing V  4+ , and (4) carrying out high-temperature activation treatment at 600-800 ℃ by adopting the leaching residual catalyst obtained in the step (2). The hydrogenation catalyst obtained by the treatment method is applied to the heavy oil and/or residual oil hydrogenation treatment process, and has better demetallization performance and higher desulfurization activity stability.

title_en: Preparation method of superfine crystal high-strength and high-toughness magnesium-based composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ultrafine-grain high-strength and high-toughness magnesium-based composite material, and belongs to the technical field of alloy material preparation. Aiming at the bottlenecks of nano reinforced phase agglomeration, difficult grain refinement and the like of the existing magnesium-based composite material, the mechanical property and microstructure uniformity of the magnesium-based composite material are obviously improved by the innovation and cooperative breakthrough of the whole process technology and the optimization of the composition of a grain refiner, the multistage ultrasonic treatment and the liquid nitrogen cold die technology. Through tests, the tensile strength and the yield strength are obviously improved, the comprehensive performance is obviously better than that of the comparative example and the conventional AZ91D magnesium alloy, and the method has good industrial application prospect.

title_en: PH value online detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrometallurgy, and discloses an online pH value detection method. The method comprises the steps of carrying out first acid adding treatment on vanadium-containing solution in an acid adding tank at a first acid adding flow, extracting the first solution from the acid adding tank, detecting the first pH value of the first solution, adjusting the first acid adding flow according to the first pH value, sending the vanadium-containing solution after the first acid adding to the vanadium precipitating tank, carrying out second acid adding treatment on the vanadium-containing solution in the vanadium precipitating tank at a second acid adding flow, extracting the second solution from the vanadium precipitating tank, detecting the second pH value of the second solution, and adjusting the second acid adding flow entering the vanadium precipitating tank according to the second pH value. By the scheme of the invention, the accurate online detection and automatic control of the pH value in the vanadium precipitation process are realized.

title_en: Hexagonal boron nitride ceramic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hexagonal boron nitride ceramic material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ceramic materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) mixing hexagonal boron nitride, a sintering aid, a solvent, a dispersing agent, a binder and a plasticizer to obtain ceramic slurry, (2) sequentially defoaming and casting the ceramic slurry obtained in the step (1) to obtain a green sheet, and (3) sequentially degreasing and hot-pressing the green sheet obtained in the step (2) to obtain the hexagonal boron nitride ceramic material. According to the invention, the raw materials are mixed to obtain ceramic slurry, the ceramic slurry is subjected to tape casting, flaky hexagonal boron nitride is preliminarily rearranged in the tape casting process to form an oriented structure, and then hot-pressed sintering is further carried out to further promote rearrangement of hexagonal boron nitride, so that a hexagonal boron nitride ceramic material with high texture is obtained, and the hexagonal boron nitride ceramic material has high oriented heat conduction performance.

title_en: Method for preparing phosphoric acid and co-producing white carbon black by high-silicon low-phosphorus ore wet method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing phosphoric acid and co-producing white carbon black by a high-silicon low-phosphorus ore wet method, which comprises the steps of crushing high-silicon low-phosphorus ore, phosphoric acid extraction and sulfuric acid reaction to obtain phosphoric acid slurry, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain phosphoric acid and high-silicon phosphogypsum, preparing the slurry from the high-silicon phosphogypsum and water, carrying out reaction with sulfuric acid and ammonium fluoride solution under a negative pressure condition, absorbing a gas phase product generated by the reaction by ammonia water to obtain white carbon black emulsion, taking the solid phase remained by the reaction as phosphogypsum slurry, carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying on the white carbon black emulsion to obtain a white carbon black product, and carrying out solid-liquid separation and washing on the phosphogypsum slurry to obtain high-quality phosphogypsum. According to the invention, through specific reaction conditions and material proportion, efficient extraction of silicon dioxide and deep purification of phosphogypsum are successfully realized, high-purity white carbon black and building material grade phosphogypsum with low impurity content are synchronously obtained, the difficult problem of recycling high-silicon phosphogypsum is solved, and full-element and high-value utilization of solid waste of phosphorite is realized.

title_en: Bio-based composite activation auxiliary agent for producing active calcium phosphate by using renewable resources and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bio-based composite activation auxiliary agent for producing active calcium phosphate by using renewable resources, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of active calcium phosphate preparation. The bio-based composite active auxiliary comprises, by mass, 20-40 parts of bio-based organic acid or bio-based organic acid salt, 15-30 parts of polysaccharide or derivative thereof, 25-45 parts of alkali metal silicate and 5-15 parts of alkali metal carbonate. The bio-based composite activating auxiliary agent is prepared through multi-component cooperation, is matched with phosphorus-containing solid waste and is used for preparing active calcium phosphate, so that the integration of 'regeneration resource high-valued-active calcium phosphate high-performance-electronic ceramic performance upgrading' is realized, meanwhile, the auxiliary agent is ensured to be green and nontoxic, is adapted to various scenes, and reduces the production cost and the environmental risk.

title_en: Biphase rare earth metal-based high-entropy oxygen carrier for gasifying waste plastics and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of recycling and high-value conversion of organic solid wastes, and particularly discloses a biphase rare earth metal-based high-entropy oxygen carrier for gasifying waste plastics, and a preparation method and application thereof. The oxygen carrier has a general formula Fe  a Ni b Co c Mg d M e O y , wherein a, b, c, d, e is 5-35% of atomic ratio respectively, and satisfies a+b+c+d+e=100%, M is rare earth metal Ce or La, and y is in a range of 0-4 but not 0. The diphase structure formed after the rare earth metal is introduced enhances the surface oxygen vacancy content of the oxygen carrier, is beneficial to the migration of lattice oxygen to participate in gasification reaction, meanwhile, the high-entropy oxygen carrier lattice is distorted, and the metal-oxygen bond is weakened, so that the oxygen release capability is further promoted, the catalytic cracking capability on waste plastics is improved, and the yield of synthesis gas and the circulation stability of the oxygen carrier are improved. The oxygen carrier preparation method is simple, can be widely applied to the field of waste plastic gasification, and has higher use value.

title_en: Roadbed material prepared by treating phosphogypsum with soil ash-tuff and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed material prepared by treating phosphogypsum with soil ash-tuff and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of roadbed material preparation. The modified naphthalene water reducer has the advantages that the high-strength and stable characteristics are provided for roadbed materials by utilizing the geological polymerization reaction of the soil ash-tuff and the phosphogypsum to cooperatively generate a gel-ettringite compact structure, the modified naphthalene water reducer is introduced with amino groups and phosphonic acid groups, so that the compactness is improved, heavy metal ions can be strongly chelated to form chemical fixation, the phosphogypsum is harmless, and the modified naphthalene water reducer is cooperated with the phosphogypsum to realize large-scale resource utilization of the phosphogypsum, ensure the long-term mechanical property and the environmental safety of roadbed engineering, and have remarkable environmental protection and economic benefit.

title_en: Ti (titanium)2AlNb powder alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of Ti  2  AlNb powder alloy, which comprises the following steps of S1 preparing Ti  2  AlNb powder, S2 carrying out hot isostatic pressing treatment on the Ti  2  AlNb powder, wherein the temperature of the hot isostatic pressing treatment is 900-950 ℃, S3 carrying out heat treatment on the hot isostatic pressing powder alloy obtained in the step S2 and then cooling, and the temperature of the heat treatment is 1010-1050 ℃. According to the preparation method of the Ti  2  AlNb powder alloy, the coarsening of crystal grains and the surface oxidation are inhibited through low-temperature hot isostatic pressing treatment, and the morphology and the distribution of O phase are regulated and controlled through a specific heat treatment process, so that the room temperature and high temperature mechanical properties of the Ti  2  AlNb powder alloy are remarkably improved.

title_en: Spinning forming method of thin-wall cylindrical part
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spinning forming method of a thin-wall cylindrical part, which comprises the processing flows of blanking, spheroidizing annealing, blank machining before spinning, spinning forming, quenching and tempering, and finish machining of a flat end face. The spinning forming is to sleeve the spinning blank on the core mold, clamp the spinning blank axially with the core mold via the forward spinning locating stage in the front end port, forward spin the spinning blank from the front end of the spinning blank with the spinning wheel to match the wall thickness of the front half section of the spinning blank with the wall thickness of the product until the back end of the spinning blank extends to the back end of the core mold, and back spin the spinning blank with the spinning wheel from the end of forward spin to match the wall thickness and length of the middle part of the spinning blank with the wall thickness and length of the middle part of the cylindrical product. The spinning forming method combines the two forming methods of forward spinning and reverse spinning of the rotary blank, thereby realizing the forming processing of the thin-wall cylindrical part with large length-diameter ratio.

title_en: Preparation method of lanthanum cerium oxide for reflective heat-insulating coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rare earth hydrometallurgy, and discloses a preparation method of lanthanum cerium oxide for a reflective heat-insulating coating. The method specifically adopts a molecular mixing reactor (supergravity) and autoclave (aging reaction) combined process, adopts sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, polyethylene glycol, polyvinylpyrrolidone and the like as dispersing agents, solves the problems of larger solid-phase preparation particles, overlarge liquid-phase local mixed alkali amount and the like, realizes uniform mixing of precipitant and lanthanum cerium ions and preparation of nanoscale lanthanum cerium carbonate, adopts lanthanum carbonate, ammonia water and ammonium bicarbonate as main raw materials of the process, and reduces the production cost from the raw materials.

title_en: Aluminum profile with improved anti-stripping corrosion performance and casting and heat treatment process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum profile with improved anti-stripping corrosion performance and a casting and heat treatment process thereof, wherein the mass percentage of ：Si：0 .60-0 .7%,Fe：0 .10-0 .15％,Cu：0 .08-0 .12％,Mn：0 .15-0 .25％,Mg：0 .5-0 .65％,Cr：0 .14-0 .2％,Zn：0 .015-0 .003％,Ti：0 .03-0.06%,Pb≤ 0.01％, is shown as follows, the total content of other impurity elements is less than or equal to 0.15 percent, the balance is Al, the content of alkali metal Na is less than or equal to 0.0004 percent, the content of Ca is less than or equal to 0.0002 percent, and the content of hydrogen is 0.15ml/100g. According to the invention, the corrosion resistance of the 6005A aluminum alloy material is improved by reasonably adjusting the chemical component proportion and the casting process flow, the corrosion resistance is easy to realize by domestic existing aluminum alloy smelting and casting equipment, and the spalling corrosion resistance of the finally obtained aluminum alloy section is obviously improved by adopting the aluminum alloy with optimized components.

title_en: Method and device for recycling aluminum fluoride from aluminum electrolysis solid waste
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recycling aluminum fluoride from aluminum electrolysis solid waste, and relates to the technical field of aluminum fluoride recycling; the invention comprises a supporting base, wherein the top end of the supporting base is fixedly provided with a grinding mechanism, the grinding mechanism is provided with a leakage-proof mechanism and a scraping mechanism which are matched with each other for use, the top end of the grinding mechanism is communicated with a grinding mechanism which is matched with each other for use, one end of the grinding mechanism is provided with a connecting mechanism which is matched with the grinding mechanism for use, the grinding mechanism, the connecting mechanism and the material control mechanism are matched with each other for use, the first grinding roller and the second grinding roller can be driven to synchronously rotate reversely, and the first receiving hopper and the second receiving hopper can be driven to do circular reciprocating alternating motion, so that the first grinding plate and the second grinding plate can be driven to do circular reciprocating alternating motion, and materials can be fully ground and the materials after being fully ground can be conveniently and fully ground, and the guarantee is provided for the full and rapid reaction of the subsequent waste electrolytes.

title_en: Two-dimensional material wet transfer device and two-dimensional material wet transfer method
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-dimensional material wet transfer device and a two-dimensional material wet transfer method, wherein in the operation process, a porous filter plate is positioned at a third position, and can stably bear two-dimensional materials after etching and cleaning, so that the two-dimensional materials can be kept in a flat state, and when cleaning liquid is released for the last time, a substrate bearing plate is positioned at a second position and is in an inclined state, the two-dimensional materials stably descend to the surface of a target substrate along with the liquid level by slowly rotating and controlling liquid drainage, the liquid between the two-dimensional materials and the target substrate can be effectively discharged through the inclined angle design, the integrity and flatness of the two-dimensional materials are ensured to the greatest extent, and the wrinkles or the damages of the two-dimensional materials are effectively avoided, so that a complete two-dimensional film material is obtained.

title_en: Production method of low-cost galvanized structural steel for export
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of low-cost galvanized structural steel for an outlet, which comprises a smelting process, a hot rolling process, an acid rolling process and an annealing process, wherein the balance of the chemical composition range ：C 0.06-0.08％,Si 0.01-0.04％,Mn 0.31-0.39％,P 0.008-0.013％,S 0.002-0.003％,Alt 0.033-0.038％,Ca 0.0008-0.015％,N 0.0032-0.0045％, in percentage by mass is iron and impurities, the mechanical properties of the product are ensured by adding C, mn elements and microalloy elements, and meanwhile, the optimal configuration of the product cost is ensured by means of adjusted process system measures, so that the product with qualified performance and meeting the use requirements of customers can be produced in batches.

title_en: 17Cr16Ni2 steel shaft part and secondary continuous quenching method for 17Cr16Ni2 steel shaft part
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 17Cr16Ni2 shaft part which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass, 0.12-0.22% of C, less than or equal to 1.00,Cr 15.00~17.00,Ni 1.50~2.50,Mn and less than or equal to 1.50% of Si, less than or equal to 0.030% of S, less than or equal to 0.040% of P, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities. The heat treatment process provided by the invention fully utilizes the metal phase transformation rule, intentionally increases the plastic phase and the toughness phase in the structure of the steel, can absorb more crack shape success and crack expansion work during impact, thereby improving the toughness of the material, has the advantages that the temperature of the second heating is lower than the conventional heat treatment temperature, is in a two-phase region, can play roles of refining grains, reducing the harm of S, P impurity elements, improving the toughness of the product, reducing the deformation of the workpiece and the like, and effectively improves the comprehensive mechanical property of the 17Cr16Ni2 steel part.

title_en: Magnetic control semi-filled microsphere flexible sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic control half-filled microsphere flexible sensor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of sensors, wherein the sensor comprises a flexible dielectric layer and an electrode layer, and the flexible dielectric layer comprises a flexible matrix and an internal core-shell structure magnetic control half-filled microsphere; the magnetically controlled semi-filled microsphere comprises a rigid insulating shell and a magnetic conductive powder in the inner cavity. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a polymer microsphere inner core containing magnetic conductive powder, coating a silicon dioxide shell layer on the surface of the microsphere, then performing high-temperature heat treatment under a protective atmosphere to form a porous structure, dispersing the obtained functional microsphere in a precursor of a flexible matrix, and curing and forming. The invention constructs a unique core-shell structure and a porous microstructure, utilizes an external magnetic field to regulate and control the distribution of powder in the microsphere, changes the effective compressible volume and supporting rigidity of the microsphere in the compression direction, solves the problems of poor dispersibility, easy agglomeration and weak interfacial binding force of the traditional magnetic conductive material in a flexible matrix, and realizes the regulation and control of the sensitivity and the measuring range of the sensor.

title_en: High-strength spheroidal graphite cast iron rail transit wheel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ductile iron rail transit wheel, which is prepared and formed by Cu alloying, smelting and casting and heat treatment, wherein the spheroidization rate is more than or equal to 90%, the room-temperature tensile strength reaches more than 950.0 MPa, and the elongation after break reaches more than 7.0%.

title_en: Powder metallurgy sintering device and process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powder metallurgy sintering device and a process, in particular to the field of sintering equipment, the device comprises a box body, a plurality of heaters are arranged in the box body, the heaters are arranged on all inner side surfaces of the box body, the box is internally provided with a placement mechanism, the placement mechanism comprises a supporting frame, the supporting frame is rotationally arranged in the box, the bottom of the supporting frame is provided with a plurality of detachable connecting rods, and a plurality of fixing components are vertically arranged on the connecting rods at equal intervals. According to the invention, the placing mechanism and the angle adjusting mechanism are arranged, so that the workpieces are arranged on the fixed assembly, and the workpieces are driven to do circular motion and horizontally reciprocate during sintering, so that interlayer temperature difference is not generated between the workpieces on the multi-layer placing station, temperature difference in the workpieces is not generated between different surfaces of the workpieces, the sintering efficiency is improved, the shrinkage rate and the densification degree between the workpieces in the same batch are ensured to be consistent, and the quality of the workpieces is ensured.

title_en: Production process of alloy structure steel bar material smelted by adopting ecological electric furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production process of an alloy structural steel bar by adopting an ecological electric furnace for smelting, wherein the chemical components of the alloy structural steel bar are C：0.39%～0.44%,Si：0.17%～0.37%,Mn：0.50%～0.80%,P≤0.020%,S≤0.020%,Cr：0.90%～1.20%,Ni≤0.30%,Mo：0.15%～0.25%,Nb：0.02%～0.03%,V：0.05%～0.10%,Cu≤0.20%, and the balance of Fe and impurities, and the production process comprises the steps of ecological electric furnace smelting, LF refining, RH refining, continuous casting, heating, rolling, heat preservation and heat treatment. The smelting process flow of ecological electric furnace smelting, LF refining and RH refining is adopted, so that the high-steel purity index is achieved, and the alloy structural steel bar has excellent comprehensive mechanical properties and high surface quality level.

title_en: V-based2C/V2O5/SnO2EMC gas composition prediction method of sensor and GRU-Attention
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas sensor detection, and particularly relates to an EMC gas component prediction method based on a V  2 C/V 2 O 5 /SnO 2  sensor and GRU-Attention. The EMC gas component prediction method comprises the steps of S1, preparing a multilayer V  2  C MXene, S2, preparing a V  2 C/V 2 O 5 /SnO 2  composite material, S3, preparing a gas sensor, S4, measuring resistance signals, and S5, establishing a GRU-Attention gas detection model. The invention successfully synthesizes the V  2 C/V 2 O 5 /SnO 2  heterojunction gas-sensitive film, and the heterojunction provides a large number of adsorption and reaction sites for methyl ethyl carbonate molecules at a low temperature of 150 ℃ through the synergistic effect among the high conductivity of V  2  C, the excellent gas-sensitive characteristic of SnO  2  and the catalytic activity of V  2 O 5 .

title_en: Sand mould exhaust top box and method for magnesium-lithium alloy low-overheating and overpressure rapid filling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sand mould exhaust top box and a method for low-overheating and overpressure rapid filling of a magnesium-lithium alloy, and belongs to the technical field of magnesium-lithium alloy casting. The exhaust unit comprises an exhaust float, a conduit and a valve, wherein the exhaust float is connected with the low-pressure transition tank through the conduit, the conduit is provided with the valve, and the exhaust float is used for exhausting gas and preventing the solution from overflowing after the exhaust is discharged. The invention adopts the combined sand mould exhaust top box to regulate the mold filling back pressure of the mold cavity, rapidly discharges the gas in the mold cavity, and ensures that the melt is rapidly filled in the mold cavity under the overpressure state.

title_en: High-strength high-flatness glass substrate for chip packaging and preparation method thereof
