abstract_en: The invention provides a high-strength high-flatness glass substrate for chip packaging and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of chip packaging glass, wherein the glass substrate comprises the following raw materials of silicon dioxide, aluminum oxide, boron oxide, magnesium oxide, calcium oxide, yttrium oxide, a composite clarifying agent, a reinforcing agent, a surface modifying agent and a heat stabilizer; the composite clarifying agent is a mixture of sodium sulfate and antimony dioxide, the reinforcing agent is a mixture of zirconium oxide and titanium dioxide, the surface modifying agent is a mixture of zinc oxide and strontium oxide, the glass substrate is polished by polishing liquid, the polishing liquid comprises silicon oxide, aminotrimethylene phosphonic acid, a composite dispersing agent, a buffering agent and deionized water, and the composite dispersing agent is a mixture of sodium polyacrylate and sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate. The glass substrate for chip packaging prepared by the invention has excellent mechanical strength and flatness.

title_en: Bar high-frequency heating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical manufacturing heating. The high-frequency bar heating device comprises a frame, a defect diagnosis unit, a temperature control unit, a heating unit, a fixing assembly, a conveying unit and a central control module, wherein the units are electrically connected with the central control module to realize cooperative control. The defect diagnosis unit screens qualified bars, the temperature control unit precisely controls the temperature through the surface infrared thermometer and the core temperature measuring assembly, the dual-frequency power supply module is adapted to different processes, the heating unit realizes stable heating through the cooperation of the telescopic induction coil and the current feedback module, and the fixing assembly flexibly clamps the bars through the cylinder driving shrinkage block. The device has high automation degree and excellent heating precision, and is suitable for bar forging and heating before heat treatment.

title_en: Target surface treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target surface treatment system and method, wherein the system comprises a laser generating and modulating unit, a laser transmitting and processing unit and a control unit, wherein the laser generating and modulating unit is configured to emit a laser beam and adjust laser parameters to output energy required by target surface treatment, the laser beam is a pulse laser beam, the laser transmitting and processing unit is configured to focus the laser beam and guide a scanning path of the laser beam for scanning the target surface, the execution unit is configured to receive the focused laser beam and bear the target and adjust a target moving track so that the focused laser beam acts on the target surface in an omnibearing manner, and the control unit is configured to send control instructions to the laser generating and modulating unit, the laser transmitting and processing unit and the execution unit to control the laser parameters, the scanning path and the target moving track so as to realize target surface cleaning, repairing or homogenizing treatment. The femtosecond laser pulse is extremely short, the heat affected zone is small, and the nano-scale surface flatness can be realized.

title_en: Space-saving rock wool production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-saving rock wool production line which comprises a cotton collecting drum, a pressing machine and a curing furnace, wherein an exhaust port of the cotton collecting drum is connected with an exhaust pipeline, a sealing box is arranged outside the pressing machine, an air inlet pipe communicated with the exhaust pipeline is arranged at the top of the sealing box, a main hot air inlet pipe parallel to the length direction of the curing furnace is arranged at one side of the curing furnace, the lower side part of the sealing box is connected with the front port of the main hot air inlet pipe through an air guide pipe, the main hot air inlet pipe is connected with the lower part of the curing furnace through a plurality of branch hot air inlet pipes, the upper part of the curing furnace is connected with an air outlet pipeline, and the outlet of the air outlet pipeline is connected with an exhaust fan. The invention utilizes the high-temperature waste gas generated in the rock wool production line to be directly injected into the curing furnace, the high-temperature air flow dries and cures the rock wool, the binder in the rock wool plate adsorbs dust carried in the air flow, the rock wool plate in the curing process plays a role of a filter, the energy consumption is reduced, the cost is saved, and the equipment and the occupied area for filtering a large amount of dust are reduced.

title_en: Method for impregnating graphite electrode by secondary roasting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphite electrode roasting, and discloses a method for impregnating a graphite electrode by secondary roasting, which realizes high-precision temperature stable control of a secondary roasting process by the synergistic effect of an intelligent synergistic temperature control method, a full-flow inert protection system, a waste heat cascade utilization path and clean combustion directional pollution discharge, and compresses the activation temperature fluctuation of coke powder to be as low as possible And meanwhile, the waste heat of one-time roasting is utilized, so that the utilization rate of waste heat is greatly improved, the gas consumption is reduced, the reuse times of the coke powder is improved, and the dual improvement of the product quality stability and the production economy is finally realized.

title_en: PVB composite film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polymer composite materials, in particular to a PVB composite film and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of carrying out surface modification on infrared absorption particles by adopting a silane coupling agent to obtain modified infrared absorption particles, carrying out melt blending on the modified infrared absorption particles, hollow silica microspheres, PVB resin and a plasticizer, then forming to obtain a PVB prefabricated film, and carrying out hot-pressing compounding on the PVB prefabricated film and an elastic fiber net to obtain the PVB composite film. The invention successfully solves the difficult problem that the traditional technology is difficult to consider various performances through the innovative design and synergistic effect of the components, realizes the synergistic promotion of sound insulation, heat insulation, optical and mechanical properties, and meets the requirements of the laminated glass for buildings on multifunctional integrated materials.

title_en: Cooling process of die steel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal material processing, in particular to a cooling process of die steel. The cooling process of the die steel comprises the steps of respectively sleeving the two ends of the die steel with slow cooling covers, and then carrying out water cooling and air cooling alternate circulation processes. The slow cooling cover is made of stainless steel, comprises a stress buffer layer, a connecting layer and an alloy layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, or comprises a flexible heat insulation layer and alloy net structures arranged on the surfaces of two sides of the flexible heat insulation layer. The invention utilizes the slow cooling cover to isolate the direct heat exchange between the end part of the die steel and the cooling medium, thereby slowing down the cooling speed at the corner of the end part, reducing the cooling speed difference between the end part and the center of the die steel die, and further avoiding the stress cracking and deformation of the die steel.

title_en: Impeller for pump and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an impeller for a pump and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fluid machinery. The method comprises the steps of identifying a stress concentration and corrosion cavitation high risk area through simulation analysis based on the running condition of the impeller, designing a functional gradient material layer in the area in a three-dimensional model of the impeller, adopting a laser additive manufacturing process, manufacturing an impeller blank with continuous gradient changes of components, tissues and performances through layer-by-layer cladding by adjusting the proportion of various raw materials in real time, and finally carrying out post-treatment processing. The method realizes the accurate reinforcement of the key areas of the impeller, remarkably improves the anti-fatigue, corrosion-resistant and cavitation-resistant performances of the impeller, simultaneously avoids the problem of overhigh cost caused by integrally using high-performance materials, and takes reliability, durability and economy into account.

title_en: Bioactive glass and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses bioactive glass and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of bioactive substances. The invention provides a preparation method of bioactive glass, which comprises the steps of dissolving cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide in water, adding ethyl acetate, stirring to form microemulsion liquid drops to obtain ethyl acetate-cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide-water microemulsion, sequentially adding ethyl orthosilicate, triethyl phosphate, calcium nitrate and ferric nitrate to obtain Fe-BG precipitate, and drying, calcining and grinding the Fe-BG precipitate to obtain Fe-BG powder. The invention also provides bioactive glass based on the preparation method and application thereof. The bioactive glass provided by the invention has stronger procoagulant capability by doping iron ions, and the Fe-BG material has obviously shortened clotting time, meets the blood compatibility requirement of biomedical materials, and is suitable for clinical hemostasis and wound repair.

title_en: Easy-to-clean antibacterial ceramic tile and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easy-to-clean antibacterial ceramic tile and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the technical field of ceramic tile processing, and is used for solving the technical problems that the antibacterial durability, easy-to-clean and wear resistance of the antibacterial ceramic tile in the prior art are to be further improved. According to the invention, the antibacterial ceramic tile blank is prepared by optimizing the proportioning composition of raw materials and the preparation process, and then the composite antibacterial powder is prepared by compounding the copper-cobalt doped titanium gel, the phosphate-based metal salt and the nano silver, and the antibacterial reinforcing agent is obtained by modifying the organosilicon to reinforce the antibacterial glaze, so that the antibacterial performance and the antibacterial durability of the antibacterial ceramic tile are effectively improved, and the wear resistance, the easy cleaning performance and the impact toughness of the antibacterial ceramic tile are also improved.

title_en: Creep-resistant high-elasticity-modulus high-damping magnesium alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a creep-resistant high-elasticity-modulus high-damping magnesium alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the creep-resistant high-elasticity-modulus high-damping magnesium alloy comprises, by mass, 1.2% -3.5% of Zn element, 2.5% -12% of Gd element, 0.5% -6% of Yb element, 0.15% -1.2% of Ni element, 0.3% -0.8% of Mn element, 0% -0.5% of Cu element, 0.1% -5% of HRE element and the balance of Mg element, the HRE element is one or more of Dy element, sm element and Tb element, and the mixing enthalpy delta H of the creep-resistant high-elasticity-modulus high-damping magnesium alloy is-1.1 kJ/mol to-0.2 kJ/mol. The creep-resistant high-elasticity-modulus high-damping magnesium alloy is suitable for the fields of aerospace, precise instruments, transportation, 3C electronics and the like, and has remarkable technical and economic values.

title_en: Off-line measurement method for casting section roller set of slab continuous casting machine based on three-dimensional point cloud
abstract_en: The invention provides a slab caster casting section roller set offline measurement method based on three-dimensional point cloud, which relates to the technical field of three-dimensional measurement, and particularly relates to a method for performing space geometric optimization on an actual measurement axis by establishing a global measurement coordinate system based on a centering reference plane and acquiring complete three-dimensional point cloud and taking a theoretical curve model constructed by design parameters as constraint, so that an optimal theoretical roller column reference curve can be reconstructed, a global reference conforming to design intent can be intelligently fitted directly from actual measurement data, dependence on a physical standard model is eliminated, manufacturing errors and long-term deformation errors possibly caused by the latter are eliminated, meanwhile, bearing seat pose deviation calculated based on the optimization reference has high reliability, structural adjustment can be accurately performed accordingly, the transition from traditional empirical adjustment to one-time accurate adjustment is realized, the maintenance period can be obviously shortened, and uniform stress of each bearing seat after adjustment and long-term stability of roller column radian are ensured.

title_en: Universal lost foam coating for cast steel and cast iron as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a general lost foam coating for cast steel and cast iron, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of lost foam casting. The raw materials of the lost foam coating comprise quartz powder, kaolin and iron liquid spheroidizing slag micro powder, wherein the iron liquid spheroidizing slag micro powder is obtained by calcining iron liquid spheroidizing slag, the iron liquid spheroidizing slag is obtained by spheroidizing and deslagging iron liquid in a nodular cast iron process, the mass percentage of the iron liquid spheroidizing slag micro powder in the raw materials is 4-17%, the mass ratio of the quartz powder to the iron liquid spheroidizing slag micro powder is 4-16:1, and the mass ratio of the kaolin to the iron liquid spheroidizing slag micro powder is 0.6-3:1. The lost foam coating has proper air permeability, high crack resistance and bending strength in a wide temperature range, can be simultaneously applied to cast iron and cast steel, realizes the universal design of the coating, reduces the production cost and improves the recycling rate of resources.

title_en: Sulfide solid electrolyte precursor, preparation method of sulfide solid electrolyte, and sulfide solid electrolyte precursor
abstract_en: The application discloses a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor, a preparation method of the sulfide solid electrolyte and the sulfide solid electrolyte precursor, wherein the preparation method of the precursor comprises the steps of mixing Li  2  S powder and LiCl powder to obtain Li  2  S-LiCl composite powder; heating the P  2 S 5  powder to form P  2 S 5  vapor, and depositing P  2 S 5  vapor on the particle surfaces of the Li  2  S-LiCl composite powder to obtain sulfide solid electrolyte precursor powder, wherein the precursor has a core-shell structure, and the core-shell structure takes the Li  2  S-LiCl composite powder as a core and takes amorphous P  2 S 5  coated on the particle surfaces of the Li  2  S-LiCl composite powder as a shell. According to the application, the sulfide solid electrolyte precursor with the core-shell structure is prepared, so that the mixing uniformity of each component on a microcosmic level is improved, and the sulfide solid electrolyte with uniform and stable structure is prepared.

title_en: Forming assembly of die casting die and die casting die
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of die casting dies and discloses a molding assembly of a die casting die and the die casting die, wherein the molding assembly is used for molding a flange, the inner ring of the flange is provided with a sealing groove, the molding assembly comprises a fixed die module and a movable die module, the fixed die module comprises a fixed die core and an inner drawing slide block, the fixed die core is provided with a mounting groove, the inner drawing slide block is movably arranged in the mounting groove and is provided with a groove and at least one arc-shaped convex edge, the arc-shaped convex edge stretches into a cavity for molding a part of the sealing groove, the movable die module comprises a movable die core, a draw hook is arranged on the movable die core and is movably arranged in the groove, and when the movable die module moves to a side far away from the fixed die module for die opening, the draw hook pulls the inner drawing slide block to enable the inner drawing slide block to slide close to the side of the movable die module and slide inwards, and the inner drawing slide block is separated from the molded flange. The invention has the advantages that the forming assembly can effectively reduce the machining allowance at the sealing groove of the flange plate and improve the forming quality of the flange plate.

title_en: Smelting method of G115 martensitic heat-resistant steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smelting method of G115 martensitic heat-resistant steel, which comprises the steps of slag-free tapping of an electric arc furnace, LF large-slag-amount white slag refining, VD deep degassing, B/N cooperative regulation and control, soft argon blowing pouring and the like. The method is characterized by comprising the steps of selecting low-carbon low-phosphorus chromium alloy and high-purity electrolytic cobalt, adding the low-carbon low-phosphorus chromium alloy and the high-purity electrolytic cobalt in batches, controlling the temperature, supplementing nitrogen by using chromium nitride alloy, wrapping Fe-B alloy by using pure iron foil, inserting the alloy in batches, accurately controlling N, B content, deoxidizing by using Ca-Si wires, removing impurities by soft argon blowing, and filling argon under the protection of the atmosphere. The process omits redundant working procedures, shortens the production period, effectively controls the contents of sensitive elements such as carbon, boron, nitrogen, cobalt and the like, ensures that the O of molten steel is less than or equal to 25PPm, ensures that the inclusion removal rate is more than or equal to 95 percent, and ensures that the high-temperature endurance strength is more than or equal to 135Mpa at 650 ℃.

title_en: Air circulation cooling device and method in phosphorus trichloride production process
abstract_en: The invention provides an air circulation cooling device and method in the production process of phosphorus trichloride, wherein the device comprises a chlorination kettle, the chlorination kettle is connected with a phosphorus washing tower, the phosphorus washing tower is connected with a condenser, and the condenser is connected with an induced draft fan. The cooling process comprises the following steps of S1, setting reference air flow Q  0 , setting reference frequency f  0  of a draught fan, setting air flow Q  set =Q 0 ×K t  entering a condenser by a control system according to ambient temperature T  a , enabling yellow phosphorus and chlorine to enter a chlorination kettle for reaction, enabling the draught fan to start synchronously, enabling the draught fan to introduce air into a condenser tube side, and S3, enabling gas phase generated in the chlorination kettle to enter a condenser shell side after being purified by a phosphorus washing tower, and exchanging heat with tube side air to obtain a condensed phosphorus trichloride product. According to the invention, air is adopted to replace circulating water as a cooling medium, so that the explosion and flushing risk caused by contact of water and phosphorus trichloride due to perforation of a condenser is thoroughly eliminated, and the operation process is safer and more reliable.

title_en: Modification method of ore raw material, mineralized filter element and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water purification, in particular to a modification method of an ore raw material, a mineralized filter element and a preparation method thereof, and aims to solve the problem that the existing mineralized filter element influences drinking water safety of users due to the risk of heavy metal precipitation. The application provides a modification method of an ore raw material, which comprises a first modification method, wherein the first modification method comprises the steps of carrying out acid washing complexing treatment and calcination treatment on the ore raw material in sequence, the acid washing complexing treatment is carried out by reacting the ore raw material with an acidic reagent and then reacting with a complexing agent, and the calcination treatment is carried out by calcining the ore raw material subjected to the acid washing complexing treatment in a protective gas atmosphere, wherein the ore raw material comprises at least one of medical stone and zeolite. The application can effectively remove heavy metals in mineralized raw materials, improve drinking water safety of users, increase specific surface area of ore raw materials, improve solubility of silicon and be more beneficial to release metasilicic acid.

title_en: Method for synthesizing MXene material by using low-temperature molten salt solvent-free method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for synthesizing an MXene material by using low-temperature molten salt without a solvent and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of synthesizing MAX phases of various precursors by a high-temperature solid phase method. And then mixing various MAX carbides with ammonium fluoride and a solid small molecule intercalating agent, and successfully preparing various MXene materials through solvent-free reaction in a reaction kettle. The method discards hydrofluoric acid (HF) with strong corrosiveness and severe toxicity commonly used in the traditional method on the selection of the etchant, and adopts ammonium fluoride as the etchant, so that the risk of HF acid is avoided, and the environment-friendly performance of the reaction is ensured. In addition, compared with the traditional etching process relying on a liquid-phase strong acid system, the method utilizes the solid molten salt system to realize high-efficiency selective etching of the MAX phase A layer at a lower temperature, has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, mild condition and easy process control, does not need an organic solvent in the whole process, and really realizes clean solvent-free preparation.

title_en: Method for improving low-temperature toughness of EH51 steel under low compression ratio
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal material processing, and discloses a method for improving the low-temperature toughness of EH51 steel under a low compression ratio. theproblemsofrefinementofthecorestructureofthemediumplatewithextremelylowcompressionratioandoptimizationoftheM-Aislandshapearesolvedbycombiningthetwoheatingandrollingprocesseswithanultra-fastcoolingprocess. And after finish rolling, the temperature is cooled to the reddish temperature of 290-310 ℃ in an ultra-fast way, and ferrite and bainite tissues are obtained after air cooling. The steel plate produced by the method has the yield strength of more than or equal to 550MPa, the elongation rate of not less than 17 percent, the core impact energy of the steel plate at the temperature of minus 40 ℃ of not less than 200J, the strength is controllable, the stability and the toughness are good, and the industrial application value is good.

title_en: Cooperative regulation and control method for improving strong plasticity and corrosion resistance of arc additive forming heavy rare earth magnesium alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative regulation and control method for improving the plasticity and corrosion resistance of an arc additive formed heavy rare earth magnesium alloy, and belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of preparing wires through multi-pass hot drawing, performing additive manufacturing by adopting a multi-axis magnetic field assisted CMT technology, inhibiting turbulence of a molten pool and promoting component homogenization by utilizing a composite magnetic field, performing multi-stage solid solution-aging treatment on a formed part, optimizing a precipitated phase structure, and finally performing three-dimensional variable path compression in a solid-liquid two-phase region to realize tissue ultrafining. The method can obviously improve the strong plastic matching and corrosion resistance of the magnesium alloy component.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional borohydride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of two-dimensional borohydride, and belongs to the technical field of two-dimensional nanomaterial preparation. The method comprises the steps of dispersing metal boride and purified hydrogen ion exchange resin in an organic solvent with DN value less than 19, carrying out sealing reaction under the protection of inert gas, and then carrying out magnetic stirring and centrifugal treatment to obtain the two-dimensional borohydride.

title_en: Red mud recycling treatment system and method based on mineral carbonization passivation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a red mud recycling treatment system and method based on mineral carbonization passivation, wherein the system comprises a red mud pretreatment unit, a mineral carbonization passivation unit, a solid-liquid separation and desalination unit, a metal recovery pretreatment unit, a metal recovery unit, a residue materialization utilization unit, and a three waste treatment and recycling unit and a process detection and automatic control unit which are respectively communicated with the above units, and the method comprises (1) red mud pretreatment, (2) mineral carbonization passivation, (3) solid-liquid separation and desalination, (4) metal recovery pretreatment, (5) metal recovery, (6) residue materialization utilization, and (7) three waste treatment and recycling. The invention can obviously reduce the alkalinity and the soluble salt content of the red mud, improve the adaptability of the subsequent process, improve the metal recovery efficiency and economy, realize the coupling of the fixation of acid gas minerals such as CO  2 /SO 2  and the like and the reduction of the red mud, realize the materialization utilization of residues and obviously relieve the solid waste storage pressure.

title_en: Multi-element alloy material for movable steel rail shear tool and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel rail shears and discloses a multi-element alloy material for a movable steel rail shear tool and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise 0.85-1.05% of C, 4.5-6.0% of Cr, 1.8-2.5% of Mo, 1.2-1.8% of W or V, 0.8-2.3% or 0.4-0.8% of Co and 1.0-1.5% of Ni, 0.3-0.6% of Si, 0.4-0.8% of Mn, less than or equal to 0.02% of P, less than or equal to 0.015% of S, and the balance Fe and unavoidable impurities, the steel rail shear tool forms stable carbide and optimizes microstructure through the synergistic effect of elements such as C, cr, mo, W, co, V, ni, si, mn and ensures that the HRC of the steel rail shear tool reaches 58-62, the impact toughness is more than or equal to 18J, the impact toughness of the steel rail shear tool is still more than 15J under the condition of-40 ℃, the condition that the steel rail shear tool can still be used in the high cold environment (-40 ℃), and the fatigue of the steel rail is reduced to below 0.5% by 1000 times of continuous shear tests.

title_en: Porous lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide thermochemical reaction material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide thermochemical reaction material, a preparation method thereof and a solar thermochemical reactor. The lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide skeleton comprises a communicated macropore formed by burning a polyurethane foam template, micropores distributed in a skeleton body and submicron holes distributed in gaps among grains of the skeleton, a continuous or semi-continuous cerium-rich solid solution layer is coated on the surfaces of the grains of the lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide skeleton, the cerium-rich solid solution layer is a composite phase formed by in-situ reaction of fluorite-structured cerium oxide and perovskite-structured lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide, and the concentration of cerium element in the cerium-rich solid solution layer is in gradient decreasing distribution from the outer surface to the inside of the lanthanum strontium cobalt iron composite oxide grains. The material has the oxygen production rate attenuation of less than 3 percent, and the attenuation of the prior art is as high as more than 35 percent, thereby having extremely high engineering application value.

title_en: Method for preparing high-gloss titanium alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high-gloss titanium alloy, and belongs to the field of powder metallurgy. Firstly, taking Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-4V-0.5Fe powder as raw materials, pressing or injection molding to obtain a green body, then degreasing and pressureless vacuum sintering the green body sample to obtain a titanium alloy sintered sample, carrying out surface nitriding modification and precise polishing treatment on the sintered sample, and finally, wherein the surface glossiness of the titanium alloy with nitriding of 1 h reaches 607+/-5 Gu, the microhardness reaches 705+/-88 HV  1.0 , and the roughness is lower than 0.041 mu m. According to the invention, trace Fe elements (0.5 wt percent) and liquid phase sintering are added to refine grains, pores are reduced, nitriding treatment is carried out after sintering, an extremely thin and compact titanium nitride layer is formed, and then multistage precision polishing is matched, so that the surface hardness is improved, the roughness is obviously reduced, the glossiness is improved, and the method has the characteristics of simple process, economy, high efficiency, suitability for large scale and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of rare earth magnesium alloy material with bimodal structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a rare earth magnesium alloy material with a bimodal structure, which relates to the field of magnesium alloy material preparation and comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a raw material, S2, semi-solid heating, S4, performing temperature-control extrusion on the rare earth magnesium alloy blank subjected to electromagnetic solid solution to obtain a rare earth magnesium alloy material with a bimodal structure, wherein the rare earth magnesium alloy material is cast into a cylindrical blank with a required size, the rare earth magnesium alloy cylinder is heated to a semi-solid temperature range in a heating furnace with a protective atmosphere, semi-solid heat preservation is performed to obtain a semi-solid blank containing a liquid phase with a required volume fraction, the semi-solid blank is transferred into ice water for rapid cooling, S3, electromagnetic solid solution is performed, the cooled semi-solid blank is transferred into an electromagnetic induction furnace with the protective atmosphere, the heating is performed to a solid solution temperature, semi-solid heat preservation is performed to obtain the rare earth magnesium alloy blank with a supersaturated solid solution structure, and S4, and the temperature-control extrusion is performed on the rare earth magnesium alloy blank subjected to electromagnetic solid solution.

title_en: Process and device for drying lump ore by utilizing sintering machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ferrous metallurgy sintering, in particular to a process and a device for drying lump ore by using a sintering machine, wherein the process comprises the following steps: the automatic feeding device comprises a sintering machine main body, wherein one side of the sintering machine main body is fixedly connected with a first driving motor, the inside of the sintering machine main body is movably connected with a pair of first rotating shafts, the outer walls of the pair of first rotating shafts are in transmission connection with a first transmission belt, and the upper surface of the sintering machine main body is provided with a mixture conveying mechanism and a bottom material paving mechanism.

title_en: Low-deformation high-precision heat treatment method for new energy electric car gear shaft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-deformation high-precision heat treatment method for a gear shaft of a new energy electric car, which comprises the steps of loading, pre-cleaning, pretreatment, carburizing and quenching, post-cleaning and tempering, wherein the loading step adopts a vertical clamping mode of combining a fractal topological supporting structure with a spherical crown-shaped micro-plane array to optimize cooling uniformity, the pretreatment step adopts a ladder preheating process to eliminate machining residual stress, the carburizing and quenching step comprises a double carburizing stage of high-temperature strong infiltration and cooling diffusion, and a double-stage oil-cooling quenching of immersing a workpiece into quenching oil at 120+/-10 ℃ for quick cooling and then transferring the workpiece to quenching oil at 80+/-10 ℃ for slow cooling. The method can cooperatively control the heat treatment deformation and performance of the gear shaft, realize the surface hardness of 58-63HRC, the effective hardening layer depth fluctuation of less than or equal to +/-0.08 mm, and respectively inhibit the end face runout and the coaxiality at extremely low levels of less than or equal to 0.04mm and less than or equal to 0.03mm, and can meet the requirement of high-precision assembly without subsequent straightening.

title_en: Die-casting high-fluidity high-modulus magnesium alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die-casting high-fluidity high-modulus magnesium alloy and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of high-performance magnesium alloy preparation, wherein the content of x=4.5 in magnesium alloy Mg  97‑x Y x Ni 3  is 4-5at%, the content of Ni is 2.5-3.5at%, the balance is Mg, magnesium alloy Mg  97‑x Y x Ni 3  is prepared by smelting metal raw materials containing Mg, Y and Ni and then die-casting, and the invention aims at the difficult problem in the field of high-modulus and high-fluidity mismatching of magnesium alloy, obtains a large amount of LPSO phase generation by regulating the Y/Ni ratio, and obtains alpha-Mg/LPSO dual-phase structure in Mg  92.5 Y 4.5 Ni 3  alloy, and further realizes the aim of synergistic promotion of high fluidity and high-modulus performance by a pressure casting mode.

title_en: Novel vermicular cast iron material for iron mold sand coating mold and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a novel vermicular cast iron material for an iron mold sand coating mold and a processing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of iron castings. The novel vermicular cast iron material comprises the following components ：C：2.2%-2.8%,Si：4.5%-5.0%,Mn：≤0.5%,P：≤0.05%,S：≤0.015%,Mo：0.3%-0.5%,V：0.3%-0.5%,Cr：0.2%-0.4%,Bi：0.01%-0.03%,N：80-120ppm,, the balance being iron and unavoidable impurities. The vermicular cast iron material of the application comprises 60-80% of vermicular graphite cast iron, and the balance of spheroidal graphite, and has good thermal fatigue resistance and high temperature stability, wherein the flaky graphite is hardly present.

title_en: Flux pellet based on medium-high silicon iron concentrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluxed pellet based on medium-high silicon iron concentrate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fluxed pellet is of a three-layer composite core-shell structure, the content of SiO  2  in the iron concentrate is gradually reduced from the spherical core to the shell of the fluxed pellet, the three-layer composite fluxed pellet is prepared, the alkalinity stability of the fluxed pellet is ensured, the alkalinity and quality of the pellet are synchronously optimized, the phenomenon of excessive adhesion in the process of producing high silicon fluxed product is reduced, the internal structure of the pellet is optimized, the production and operation cost is finally reduced, and a new idea is provided for preparing alkaline pellets from low-grade high silicon iron concentrate.

title_en: 2460 MPa-level hot-rolled wire rod for stranded wire and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 2460 MPa-level hot rolled wire rod for a stranded wire and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein after high-carbon chemical components of high Si-Al are adopted to roll and spin the wire rod as the wire rod, the wire rod is subjected to on-line molten salt isothermal annealing treatment, the wire rod is firstly subjected to front-stage molten salt treatment and rapidly cooled, enters a sorbite phase region from an austenite state to form a tissue mainly comprising sorbite tissue, is subjected to rear-stage molten salt treatment, the circulation amount of the molten salt is reduced, the non-converted retained austenite is promoted to be continuously converted into sorbite and is subjected to isothermal tempering, part of sorbite sheets are promoted to fuse, and finally, the hot rolled wire rod of a mixed tissue formed by micro-structures comprising tempered sorbite, tempered ferrite and fused sorbite is slowly cooled through a roller way, so that the material cost can be controlled, the abnormal tissue can be effectively restrained, the tensile strength is 1595-1645 MPa, the section shrinkage rate is 32-37%, the production efficiency and the energy consumption are taken into account, and the ultra-high strength stranded wire is produced through off-line heat treatment.

title_en: Cobalt-containing heterogeneous composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cobalt-containing heterogeneous composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the cobalt-containing heterogeneous composite material is composed of at least two nanoparticles of Co, coO and CoN, heterogeneous interfaces are formed among the Co, coO and CoN nanoparticles, the defects of the prior art are overcome, a nonlinear gradient barrier heterostructure of Co/CoO, co/CoN and CoO/CoN is constructed through adjusting the concentration ratio of metal ions and high electronegativity atoms in a gradient thermal field reaction system, and the contribution of different polarizations and conductivities to the electromagnetic performance of the composite material is separated by utilizing the unique charge behaviors of different contact interfaces, so that the electromagnetic wave absorption performance of the heterostructure in the composite material is optimized.

title_en: Anti-hygroscopic environment-friendly precoated sand and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly precoated sand with moisture absorption resistance and a preparation method thereof. The invention prepares an organosilicon hydrophobing agent with epoxy reaction activity by carrying out cohydrolytic polycondensation on long-chain alkyl trialkoxysilane and an epoxy silane coupling agent under an acidic condition, then in a film coating process, firstly coats the hydrophobing agent on the surface of hot sand, then sequentially adds thermosetting phenolic resin and a curing agent, and finally obtains a final product after mixing grinding, cooling and crushing. According to the method, a hydrophobic interface layer anchored by chemical bonds is constructed between sand grains and resin, a stable physical water-blocking barrier is formed by long-chain alkyl, and firm combination of the interface is realized by reactive group reaction, so that the moisture absorption resistance of precoated sand is fundamentally improved. Meanwhile, the environment-friendly resin with low free formaldehyde and low free phenol is combined, so that the gas generation amount of the product is obviously reduced.

title_en: Bainite and pearlite dissimilar steel rail post-welding partition temperature control heat treatment process and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of post-weld heat treatment of steel rails, in particular to a post-weld zoning temperature control heat treatment process and system of a bainite and pearlite heterogeneous steel rail. The technology comprises the steps of preprocessing a welded joint and cooling the welded joint to room temperature, adopting a zoned induction heating device to heat and preserve heat of a bainite steel rail heat affected zone and a pearlite steel rail heat affected zone on two sides of the welded joint synchronously and independently, then carrying out independent control on the heat affected zones on the two sides for first-stage cooling, wherein the pearlite side passes through a phase change zone of the pearlite side by adopting a quick cooling and then slow cooling process, the bainite side passes through a bainite phase change zone of the pearlite side by adopting a quick cooling and isothermal process, and finally carrying out natural cooling. According to the scheme, through accurate temperature control in the partition, refined pearlite and uniform lower bainite structures are respectively obtained on two sides of the dissimilar joint, so that hard and brittle phases are effectively avoided, the hardness uniformity, the toughness and the fatigue life of the joint are remarkably improved, and the technical problem of performance degradation of the dissimilar steel rail welded joint is solved.

title_en: Method for modifying red mud through microwave heating and enriching valuable metals through magnetic separation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of red mud recycling and discloses a method for modifying red mud through microwave heating and concentrating valuable metals through magnetic separation, which comprises the steps of selecting undersize red mud particles, regulating and controlling the water content to 3.0% -5.0%, and mixing the undersize red mud particles with a microwave absorbing reducing agent; in microwave heating equipment, inert gas is introduced to raise temperature fast to produce internal stress crack by means of water evaporation, mixed gas containing carbon dioxide is introduced to maintain temperature, the reduction degree is regulated and controlled via gas phase buffering to convert hematite into magnetite, and after cooling, slurry is mixed with dispersant and separated via multistage magnetic separation to obtain fine iron powder. The method has the advantages of high treatment efficiency, iron recovery rate of more than or equal to 85%, iron concentrate grade of more than or equal to 60%, and realization of efficient enrichment of valuable metals in the red mud.

title_en: Method for leaching and separating cerium and non-cerium rare earth from monazite
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for leaching and separating cerium and non-cerium rare earth from monazite, which belongs to the technical field of rare earth metallurgy, and comprises the steps of carrying out alkaline leaching reaction on the monazite to obtain alkaline leaching products, wherein the alkaline leaching products comprise alkaline leaching residues containing rare earth elements and alkaline leaching residues containing phosphorus elements, placing the alkaline leaching residues in a microwave roasting furnace, carrying out microwave roasting in an oxidizing gas atmosphere to convert Ce (OH)  3  in the alkaline leaching residues into CeO  2  to obtain ore phase conversion products, and carrying out acidic leaching reaction on the ore phase conversion products to obtain acidic leaching products, wherein the acidic leaching products comprise acidic leaching residues containing non-cerium rare earth elements and acidic leaching residues containing cerium elements. The invention realizes the clean separation of cerium and non-cerium rare earth elements in the monazite, is beneficial to the accurate extraction of high-value rare earth elements (such as praseodymium and neodymium), and improves the comprehensive utilization efficiency of monazite resources.

title_en: Method for preparing molybdenum-vanadium-aluminum intermediate alloy by adopting calcium vanadate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a molybdenum vanadium aluminum intermediate alloy by adopting calcium vanadate, which comprises the steps of uniformly mixing calcium vanadate, molybdenum trioxide, metal aluminum and cold materials according to the mass ratio of 38-40:24-26:32-35:5.5-11 to obtain metal powder, then filling the metal powder into a graphite crucible for tamping, and finally directly igniting the metal powder for reduction reaction to obtain the molybdenum vanadium aluminum intermediate alloy. According to the invention, the calcium vanadate is adopted to prepare the molybdenum-vanadium-aluminum intermediate alloy, so that the heat release rate is effectively delayed, the splashing is reduced, meanwhile, the recovery rate of molybdenum and vanadium is improved, and the recovery rates of molybdenum and vanadium can reach more than 96wt% and 97wt% respectively.

title_en: Novel high-strength and high-toughness gradient nano twin crystal pipeline steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses novel high-strength and high-toughness gradient nano twin crystal pipeline steel and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pipeline steel preparation. The pipeline steel comprises, by mass, 0.02-0.09% of C, 0.6-1.80% of Mn, 0.1-0.30% of Si, 0.05-0.3% of Nb, 0.06-0.10% of V, and the balance of iron and unavoidable impurities. The preparation method comprises the steps of smelting, forging and rolling, wherein pulse current parallel to the rolling direction and an alternating frequency pulse magnetic field perpendicular to the rolling surface are synchronously applied in the rolling process, and the gradient nano twin crystal structure from the steel forming surface layer to the core part and the high-density nano precipitated phase are formed by combining the synergistic effect of Nb and V microalloy. The yield strength of the pipeline steel prepared by the method is 805-840MPa, the tensile strength is 890-950MPa, the elongation is 15-18%, and the strength and plasticity are cooperatively improved, so that the pipeline steel is suitable for extreme oil and gas conveying environments such as deep sea, high and cold.

title_en: Mould device
abstract_en: A mold device that avoids or inhibits sticking to a mold. The mold device is configured to obtain a molded article of a predetermined shape by injecting a molding material in which a powder and a binder are mixed into a cavity formed by a fixed mold and a movable mold, and comprises a movable portion which faces an inner surface of the cavity or an inner surface of a portion communicating with the cavity and is capable of retracting from the cavity, and an elastic member which presses the movable portion toward the cavity side or the portion side, wherein an elastic force of the elastic member is set to be smaller than a pressing force generated by the molding material when the molding material is injected into the cavity, and a size of the movable portion is set to be pressed back toward the cavity after the completion of the filling into the cavity.

title_en: Purification process of potassium nitrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purification process of potassium nitrate in the technical field of inorganic functional materials, which comprises the steps of dissolving a potassium nitrate crude product, primarily removing impurities through active carbon, and then deeply purifying by using a multistage pore manganese doped silicon aluminum composite oxide zero-valent iron-carbon composite adsorbent, wherein the adsorbent can selectively adsorb calcium and magnesium ions and degrade organic impurities, and filtrate after purification is cooled and crystallized to obtain a high-purity potassium nitrate product, and the adsorbent can be regenerated and recycled. The preparation method of the adsorbent comprises the steps of forming a water-skid layer on the surface of the iron-carbon microsphere through a coprecipitation method, constructing a multi-level pore canal composite oxide shell through manganese loading, silicon source cladding and high-temperature calcination, performing hydrophobic modification through gas phase silanization, and finally performing acid activation and reduction treatment to obtain a final product. The process has high purification efficiency, integrated adsorbent function and recycling, and is suitable for industrial production of high-purity potassium nitrate.

title_en: RGO supported copper monoatomic catalyst/g-C3N4Composite electrode material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: RGO loaded copper monoatomic catalyst/g-C  3 N 4  composite electrode material, and a preparation method and application thereof, relating to the technical field of uranium resource recovery and water treatment. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving melamine in deionized water, stirring and dissolving, heating, carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying on an obtained product, carrying out heat treatment in an inert atmosphere to obtain g-C  3 N 4 , adding graphene, copper oxalate and chitosan into an acidic aqueous solution, stirring, carrying out heat treatment in the inert atmosphere after drying to obtain a rGO-supported copper monoatomic catalyst, dispersing the rGO-supported copper monoatomic catalyst and g-C  3 N 4  into an organic-water mixed solvent containing Nafion, adding phytic acid, carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain catalyst ink, coating the catalyst ink on the surface of a substrate, and drying to obtain the composite electrode material. The composite electrode material prepared by the invention can realize high-efficiency and high-selectivity photoelectrocatalytic reduction of uranium in water bodies such as uranium-bearing wastewater, seawater desalination strong brine, sea salt plant strong seawater, salt lake water and the like.

title_en: Modified protective material for marine concrete and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modified protective material for marine concrete and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a component A of the material consists of a modified epoxy resin matrix, a toughening compatilizer and an auxiliary agent, a component B consists of a functional compound curing agent, silane modified composite anti-corrosion filler and a curing accelerator, the modified epoxy resin matrix is amino-terminated polyether modified bisphenol A epoxy resin, the functional compound curing agent is a compound of an amine curing agent and organosilicon modified imidazole, and the silane modified composite anti-corrosion filler is a mixture of silane modified nano silicon dioxide, graphene and mica powder. Under the combined action of the raw material components, the modified protective material has the characteristics of high adhesive force, high toughness, long-acting corrosion resistance and the like, can be widely used for protecting marine concrete, can ensure the stability of the coating construction quality and the protective effect, has high use value and good application prospect, and is a novel corrosion-resistant protective material with excellent performance.

title_en: Ceramic coating, preparation method thereof and application of ceramic coating on surface of continuous casting crystallizer
abstract_en: The invention provides a ceramic coating, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a continuous casting crystallizer, and relates to the technical field of ceramic coatings of continuous casting crystallizers. The preparation method of the ceramic coating comprises the steps of carrying out mixed ball milling on silicon carbide, silicon nitride and alloy powder, carrying out heat treatment to obtain ceramic powder, carrying out wet ball milling on the ceramic powder and graphene oxide, separating and drying to obtain composite powder, mixing the composite powder with metal oxide, covering the surface of a graphene blank of a graphite crystallizer, and carrying out gradient sintering at high temperature and high pressure to obtain the ceramic coating. The invention can effectively prolong the service life of the graphite crystallizer and improve the quality of the surface of a casting blank.

title_en: Suspension type crushing equipment for large casting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large casting piece production and processing, in particular to suspension type crushing equipment for a large casting system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a casting piece is placed below the equipment main body, the equipment main body comprises a rim charge crushing mechanism, a position control mechanism and a reset protection mechanism, the rim charge crushing mechanism is arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the equipment main body and is used for removing rim charges around the casting piece.

title_en: Salt-fog-resistant offshore photovoltaic glass and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides salt spray resistant offshore photovoltaic glass and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of solar devices, wherein the salt spray resistant offshore photovoltaic glass comprises a glass substrate, a compact passivation layer and a surface hydrophobic layer, wherein the thickness of the compact passivation layer is 20-40 nm; the thickness of the surface hydrophobic layer is 110-150 nm, and the compact passivation layer comprises silicon dioxide, zirconium dioxide, rare metal oxide and nano particles. When the silica sol and the zirconium silicate sol are used for preparing the compact passivation layer, a Zr-O-Si three-dimensional network structure can be formed, and the three-dimensional network structure and the nanometer particles are synergistic with the silica, the zirconium dioxide, the rare metal oxide and the nanometer particles, so that the light transmittance of the offshore salt spray resistant glass can be improved, and the weather resistance of the salt spray resistant photovoltaic glass can be improved.

title_en: Preparation method of flame-retardant asphalt mixture for tunnel pavement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flame-retardant asphalt mixture for a tunnel pavement, and relates to the technical field of road engineering materials. The modified flame retardant auxiliary agent is introduced into the traditional asphalt mixture system, and the efficient dispersion and function exertion of the flame retardant are realized by reasonably replacing mineral powder, controlling the mixing amount of the flame retardant, optimizing the mixing temperature, compacting process and maintenance flow. The prepared mixture not only has the road performances of conventional high-temperature rut resistance, low-temperature crack resistance, water stability and the like, but also obviously improves the ignition temperature, delays combustion spreading and reduces smoke release. The method has simple construction process, is easy to be fused with the existing asphalt pavement construction flow, and is particularly suitable for the pavement safety promotion of tunnels and places with high fire risks.

title_en: Refractory material, preparation method, application and heat treatment device
abstract_en: The application provides a refractory material, a preparation method and application thereof, and a heat treatment device, wherein the first raw material for preparing the refractory material comprises 23.5-67.5% of fused zirconia, 10-20% of zirconium mullite, 0-12% of zirconia, 19-31% of stabilizer, 3-21% of material containing aluminum element and 0-4.5% of auxiliary agent by mass percent; the application solves the problems that the refractory material has reduced apparent porosity, improved corrosion resistance and other performances, and still maintains excellent compressive strength and thermal shock resistance through the interaction formed by specific raw materials in proportion, avoids the risks of cracking and crazing of the refractory material in the firing process, further improves the general range of the refractory material, improves the use effect of the refractory material in specific application scenes, and better improves the quality of products.

title_en: Silicon modified molecular sieve, preparation method thereof and method for preparing 2, 6-diisopropylnaphthalene
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon modified molecular sieve, a preparation method thereof and a method for preparing 2, 6-diisopropyl naphthalene. The preparation method of the silicon modified molecular sieve comprises the steps of immersing the molecular sieve in a modifying liquid containing a silicon source for silicon treatment, removing a solvent, drying and roasting to obtain the silicon modified molecular sieve, wherein the molecular sieve comprises at least one of an MCM-56 molecular sieve, an MCM-22 molecular sieve and an MP01 molecular sieve. The silicon modified molecular sieve provided by the invention is used for the reaction of naphthalene and/or 2-isopropyl naphthalene and propylene to prepare 2, 6-diisopropyl naphthalene, and has the advantages of high naphthalene source conversion rate and high selectivity of 2, 6-diisopropyl naphthalene.

title_en: Eutectic solvent-based metal sulfide nano-enzyme and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal sulfide nano-enzyme based on a eutectic solvent and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano-enzyme preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing and heating a sulfur-containing hydrogen bond donor and a hydrogen bond acceptor according to a molar ratio of 2-3:1 to 70-80 ℃ for 2-2.5 hours to obtain a eutectic solvent, mixing and reacting the eutectic solvent and a bimetallic chelate according to a weight ratio of 1:3-4 to obtain a bimetallic sulfide suspension, and crystallizing the bimetallic sulfide suspension to obtain the metal sulfide nano-enzyme. The metal sulfide nano-enzyme prepared by the preparation method has good enzyme-like catalytic activity.

title_en: Tungsten copper powder surface synergistic modification method for inhibiting polyoxymethylene decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tungsten copper powder surface synergistic modification method for inhibiting polyformaldehyde decomposition, which relates to the technical field of degradation resistance modification of high polymer materials, and aims at the problems that tungsten copper powder is easy to catalyze severe degradation of polyformaldehyde in the process of mixing and injecting PIM tungsten copper feed, so that the feed fluidity is poor, the injection is unstable, the product size and weight fluctuation is large, and the yield is low, firstly, low-temperature plasma etching activation is carried out on the tungsten copper powder, and a reaction interface is constructed; and preparing a silicon dioxide barrier film by taking tetraethoxysilane as a silicon source, modifying by fluorine and silicon, loading a metal soap neutralizer, grafting a hindered phenol antioxidant, and simultaneously introducing an epoxy active group to construct a multi-element synergistic degradation inhibition system. According to the invention, through multi-step collaborative modification, the modification process is accurately regulated and controlled, the decomposition of the polyformaldehyde is inhibited in an omnibearing manner, the end-capping reaction can be carried out when the modified powder is blended with the polyformaldehyde, the polyformaldehyde zipper type degradation path is blocked, the compatibility of the filler and the matrix is improved, and the continuous and stable preparation and injection processes of the PIM tungsten copper feed are ensured.

title_en: Submicron cuprous oxide cube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-nano materials, and provides a submicron cuprous oxide cube and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of adding a sodium hydroxide solution into a copper precursor compound solution, adjusting the pH value of a system to be more than or equal to 10, and then adding a morphology control agent solution and a reducing agent solution for oxidation-reduction reaction to obtain submicron cuprous oxide cubes, wherein the morphology control agent is a water-soluble nonionic cellulose derivative, and the reducing agent is an ascorbic acid reducing agent. According to the invention, through the cooperative regulation and control of the concentrated alkali environment and the morphology control agent, the pure-phase submicron cuprous oxide cube is successfully prepared, the morphology of the product is regular, the edges and corners are clear, and other heterogeneous morphology is avoided; meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the invention is environment-friendly, simple to operate, high in safety and strong in controllability, and is suitable for industrial mass production.

title_en: Preparation process of 1500 MPa-grade cold-rolled hot-formed steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of 1500 MPa-grade cold-rolled hot-formed steel, which comprises the following main process parameters of (1) a smelting-continuous casting production process flow, a molten iron pretreatment process flow, a converter process flow, an LF refining process flow, a casting machine molten steel component C：0.20~0.25%,Si：0.20~0.40%,Mn：1.20~1.40%,Cr：0.15~0.35%,Ti：0.020~0.045%,Al：≤0.060%,B：≤0.0050%,P≤0.025%,S≤0.012%, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, (2) a hot-rolling production process flow, (3) an acid pickling cold-rolling process flow, and (4) a cover annealing process flow. The 1500 MPa-level cold-rolled hot-formed steel has high strength and formability, low cost of alloy per ton steel and good product quality stability, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Dual-functional catalyst with shell-core structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shell-core structure bifunctional catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The deoxidizing core of the catalyst is oxide containing one or more of Mn, cu, ni, ce non-noble metals or Pt, pd, rh, ru, au, ag noble metals, and the desulfurizing shell is oxide containing one or more of Al, mg, zr, zn, fe, ni, mo, W, co. Aiming at the problems that the sulfur-oxygen purification flow of the synthesis gas is long, a deoxidization catalyst is easy to be poisoned and deactivated, and tail gas CO  2  is directly discharged to cause carbon emission and resource waste in the existing coal chemical low-temperature methanol washing process, the ultra-deep removal of all-state sulfides and oxygen in the synthesis gas is synchronously completed in a single reactor through the independently developed shell-core structure dual-function catalyst, and the high-value recycling of CO  2  in the tail gas is synchronously realized.

title_en: Preparation method and device of high-strength high-conductivity aluminum rod
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a device of a high-strength high-conductivity aluminum rod, which comprises the following steps of injecting molten aluminum into a first refining furnace for batching and refining treatment to obtain first molten aluminum, conveying the first molten aluminum into a casting ladle, synchronously feeding a 2-series aluminum alloy monofilament at a casting nozzle, enabling the molten aluminum alloy monofilament and the molten aluminum flowing out of the casting ladle to enter a casting crystallization wheel together for rapid solidification to form a blank, conveying the blank into a rolling mill for hot rolling treatment to obtain an aluminum rod core, and conveying the aluminum rod core and the second molten aluminum output by a second refining furnace into a cladding crystallizer together for surface cladding aluminum after surface blowing, surface roughening and heating treatment to obtain the high-strength high-conductivity aluminum rod. The aluminum rod structure obtained by the invention is composed of 3 layers (reinforcing core, core layer and coating layer), the core layer is in special-shaped connection with the coating layer, the contact surface is larger, the interface combination is more stable, the aluminum rod structure can realize internal bearing force and external current carrying, and the application scene requirement of high strength and high conductivity is met.

title_en: Powder fluoride granulating method and production system based on secondary sintering and closed-loop grading circulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a powder fluoride granulating method and a production system based on secondary sintering and closed-loop hierarchical circulation, and belongs to the technical field of fluoride processing. Based on the high-temperature fusion bonding characteristic of fluoride, the method innovatively adopts a secondary sintering process comprising heating-power-off soaking-re-heating and a sectional crushing process comprising jaw coarse crushing-roller fine crushing, and builds a closed-loop material circulation system for grading and orienting super-grain particles and fine powder to return to corresponding working procedures. The production system comprises a quantitative box loading unit, a secondary sintering unit, a sectional crushing unit, a closed-loop grading circulation unit and a finished product packaging unit which are connected in sequence. The invention ensures the strength and the compactness of the sintered body through secondary sintering, realizes the high-efficiency utilization of more than 95% of the raw material utilization rate through closed-loop grading circulation, thoroughly solves the technical problems of serious dust emission and poor fluidity of powdery fluoride, and has uniform particle size (60-200 meshes) of the obtained particle product, thereby being suitable for large-scale continuous clean production.

title_en: Metal and alloy workpiece carburizing treatment method based on flash evaporation joule heat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal and alloy carburizing treatment method based on a flash evaporation Joule heating technology, and belongs to the technical field of metal material surface strengthening treatment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out pretreatment such as impurity removal, polishing, drying and the like on a workpiece to be treated, placing the workpiece in a heating action area of a flash evaporation Joule thermal carburizing reaction cavity, introducing gaseous, liquid and/or solid carbon sources under the condition of inert gas purging to form a carburizing system, applying instantaneous pulse voltage to generate a Joule thermal effect, enabling the surface layer of the workpiece to be rapidly heated to 800-1050 ℃ in millisecond time, inducing the carbon sources to decompose to generate active carbon atoms and diffusing into the workpiece to form a carburized layer, and then rapidly cooling and tempering to eliminate residual stress. The invention utilizes the flash joule heat instantaneous high temperature characteristic to realize the rapid and efficient completion of the carburization process, compared with the traditional carburization process, the energy consumption is obviously reduced, the depth and hardness of a carburized layer can be accurately regulated and controlled, the hardness and the wear resistance of the surface layer of a workpiece are considered, and meanwhile, the good toughness of the core part is maintained, so that the invention is suitable for the surface strengthening treatment of various metal and alloy workpieces.

title_en: Efficient Gao Reliang magnesium-based solid-state hydrogen storage reaction equipment and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of green hydrogen preparation and application, and relates to high-efficiency Gao Reliang magnesium-based solid-state hydrogen storage reaction equipment and a use method thereof. The device comprises a shell, wherein a heat exchange tube system penetrating through the shell is arranged in the shell along an axis in a sealing manner, a hydrogen storage precast block bed formed by arranging a plurality of hydrogen storage precast blocks in a multi-layer manner is filled in the shell, the heat exchange tube system penetrates through the hydrogen storage precast block bed, a supporting cooling ring is arranged among the plurality of hydrogen storage precast blocks, one end of the shell is of a flange structure, the flange structure is connected with a flat plate end socket in a sealing manner, a hydrogen inlet and a hydrogen outlet communicated with the interior of the shell are formed in the flat plate end socket, and a purifier is arranged between the hydrogen inlet and the hydrogen storage precast block. The device design fully considers the high-temperature waste heat utilization in the hydrogen charging and discharging process, and the heat exchange medium can be recycled by optimizing the thermal management system, so that the energy cascade utilization is realized, the running cost of the magnesium-based solid hydrogen storage device is effectively reduced, and the overall energy efficiency of the system is improved.

title_en: Heterojunction with ultrasonic-assisted photo-deposition supported cocatalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterojunction of an ultrasonic-assisted photo-deposition supported cocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of adding ZnIn  2 S 4 /metal sulfide heterojunction and triethanolamine into water, and uniformly mixing to obtain a solution A; and (3) dropwise adding a platinum source solution into the solution A to obtain a solution B, removing dissolved oxygen in the solution B, placing the solution B in an ultrasonic environment, synchronously applying visible light irradiation to the solution B, and collecting a product after the reaction is finished, namely the heterojunction of the ultrasonic-assisted photo-deposition supported cocatalyst. The promoter formed by the ultrasonic-assisted photo-deposition load reduces the actual load of the promoter, thereby reducing the overall production cost, and simultaneously, the combination of firm interface Pt-S bonds improves the stability of the promoter in the reaction process, avoids agglomeration and falling off, and ensures that the catalytic system can maintain high-efficiency activity for a long time.

title_en: Manufacturing method of spiral fin tube compression piece module of floating type generator set waste heat boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a spiral fin tube compression piece module of a floating type generator set waste heat boiler, which comprises the steps of adopting an infrared positioning instrument to position a tube plate with high precision, preassembling positioning sleeves on the spiral fin tubes, adopting a bottom-up transverse tube penetrating sequence, matching a guiding tool and a tube conveying tool to penetrate tubes, adopting a pyramid type sequence from bottom to top and from middle to two sides to carry out connecting tube assembly welding, adopting a mode of tiling a heating plate and filling gaps with heat preservation materials to form a box-like furnace unit to carry out post-welding local heat treatment, dividing the module into a plurality of independent passages to respectively carry out a hydraulic test before assembling a header, and adopting compressed air to purge and dry after the test. The invention solves the problems of easy damage of the tube penetrating of the ultra-long spiral fin tube between the dense tube plates, low local heat treatment efficiency of a large number of T91/T22 welded junctions and rust caused by incomplete drainage after water pressure, the welded junction qualification rate reaches 98%, and the heat treatment efficiency is improved by 8 times.

title_en: Section steel and section steel preparation method
abstract_en: The section steel of one embodiment of the present invention comprises 0.04 to 0.14 weight percent of carbon (C), 0.10 to 0.55 weight percent of silicon (Si), 0.90 to 1.65 weight percent of manganese (Mn), more than 0 weight percent and less than or equal to 0.02 weight percent of phosphorus (P), more than 0 weight percent and less than or equal to 0.007 weight percent of sulfur (S), 0.015 to 0.055 weight percent of aluminum (Al), 0.03 to 0.2 weight percent of molybdenum (Mo), 0.01 to 0.08 weight percent of vanadium (V), 0.005 to 0.025 weight percent of titanium (Ti), 0.01 to 0.05 weight percent of niobium (Nb), and the balance of iron (Fe) and other unavoidable impurities, thereby ensuring high strength and low temperature impact toughness.

title_en: Non-color-difference uniform luminous concrete and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems that luminescent powder is easy to hydrolyze and sedimentation in alkaline cement and physical coating obviously reduces luminous efficiency, white silicate cement, refined quartz sand, uncoated rare earth doped strontium aluminate luminescent powder and rutile type titanium dioxide are taken as basic mixed raw materials, and in the preparation process, multicomponent liquid phase containing sodium polyacrylate, sodium gluconate, sodium metaaluminate, strontium nitrate, polyvinyl alcohol and sodium tetraborate are added into slurry in a step-type manner and stirred. According to the invention, by utilizing the interfacial adsorption and local homoionic effect of sodium polyacrylate, a micro-environment with hydrolysis-resistant thermodynamic equilibrium is constructed around the luminescent powder, and meanwhile, polyvinyl alcohol and sodium tetraborate are crosslinked to form an in-situ transient rheological network so as to prevent the luminescent powder from settling, and as cement hydration is carried out, the gel is automatically disintegrated, titanium dioxide is close to the luminescent interface to generate light scattering so as to eliminate chromatic aberration, and uniform and high-brightness luminescence of concrete can be realized without physical coating.

title_en: Method for recovering valuable metals in cyanidation gold-extracting carbon sludge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valuable metal recovery, in particular to a recovery method of valuable metal in cyanide gold-extracting carbon sludge, which comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly mixing the carbon sludge, lime, quartz and borax, putting the mixture into a smelting device, placing an extractant at the top of the mixture, carrying out high-temperature smelting, and separating slag from copper-iron alloy after cooling; S2, continuously adding the copper-iron alloy obtained in the step S1 into an extracting agent, putting the extracting agent into a smelting device for high-temperature melting extraction, cooling after extraction, taking out an iron-rich phase when the extracting agent is not solidified after the iron phase is separated out, and continuously cooling the residual metal melt, and S3, carrying out vacuum distillation on the valuable metal alloy obtained in the step S2, and taking out the volatile extracting agent and the gold-silver-copper alloy after cooling. The recovery method of valuable metals in the cyanide gold-extracting carbon sludge can simply and efficiently recover the valuable metals in the carbon sludge, and has good application value.

title_en: Bimetal combustion chamber and laser composite additive manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bimetal combustion chamber and a laser composite additive manufacturing method, which comprises the steps of S1, adopting a laser powder bed to melt LPBF to form a flange plate for being connected with an injector, S2, constructing a gradient metallurgy transition interface between the flange plate and a copper alloy lining in the forming process, S3, forming the copper alloy lining with a regeneration cooling runner in situ in the same LPBF forming process to form an integral structure of the flange plate and the copper lining with the runner, S4, adopting laser directional energy to deposit LDED on the outer surface of the copper lining to deposit an outer wall reinforcing layer, S5, carrying out heat treatment and hot isostatic pressing treatment after finishing the deposition, and carrying out finish machining on the connecting surface of the flange plate. The invention is suitable for the field of combustion chambers of liquid rocket engines and other bimetal structural members which need high-heat-conductivity inner liners and high-strength outer walls to work cooperatively, and can realize high-quality and controllable integrated manufacture.

title_en: High-stability enhanced cement-based material hydrophobic additive, and preparation method and application thereof
