abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability reinforced cement-based material hydrophobic additive, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw material components of the hydrophobic additive comprise 1-5% of Janus particles, 10-50% of hydrophobic oil phase substances and 50-90% of water in percentage by weight, and the hydrophobic oil phase substances are selected from at least one of siloxanes, fatty acids or salts thereof and alkane compounds. The hydrophobic additive has better stability, can be uniformly distributed in the cement-based material, and improves the mechanical strength of the cement-based material.

title_en: Lithium extraction method of lithium-containing composite material
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium extraction method of a lithium-containing composite material, which comprises the following steps of sequentially mixing, briquetting and roasting the lithium-containing composite material, a first auxiliary agent and a second auxiliary agent to obtain a roasting material, leaching and solid-liquid separating the roasting material to obtain a lithium-containing leaching solution and leaching residues, and completing the lithium extraction, wherein the lithium-containing composite material comprises less than 60wt% of lepidolite, less than 30wt% of lithium-containing waste sagger and less than 30wt% of lithium-containing waste glass, the first auxiliary agent comprises sulfate and carbonate, and the second auxiliary agent comprises fluoride and/or borate. According to the lithium extraction method, the lithium extraction efficiency is improved by adjusting the proportion of the three raw materials and combining with the specific auxiliary agent, so that the lithium recovery rate is up to more than 92%.

title_en: Ceramic for manufacturing ceramic plate for probe card
abstract_en: A ceramic comprising 25.0 to 65.0 mass% Si  3 N 4  as a first main component and 45.0 to 85.0 mass% ZrO  2  as a second main component, characterized by comprising 0.01 to 4.9 mass% of an oxide or oxides. The ceramic solves the object of the invention, namely to provide a ceramic having a coefficient of thermal expansion which is as close as possible to that of a silicon wafer and having as high a mechanical strength as possible.

title_en: Nickel-based chromium carbide powder, preparation method thereof and coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alloy powder, aims to solve the problem that wear resistance is difficult to ensure when chromium carbide is adopted to replace tungsten carbide in the prior art, and provides nickel-based chromium carbide powder, a preparation method thereof and a coating. A preparation method of nickel-based chromium carbide powder comprises the following steps of S100, preparing prealloyed particles by sintering, cooling and crushing chromium carbide and nickel, S200, preparing nickel-based chromium carbide powder by adding prealloyed particles into molten metal and atomizing to prepare powder, wherein the molten metal contains nickel. According to the invention, the nickel and the chromium carbide form prealloyed large particles after sintering, so that the surfaces of the nickel and the chromium carbide particles are subjected to diffusion and metallurgical bonding to form a nickel-based alloy coating layer, the wettability of the chromium carbide and the molten metal can be improved, and the dissolving, separating out and recrystallizing processes of the chromium carbide are reduced, so that the chromium carbide maintains the original crystal form in the molten metal as much as possible, and the wear resistance of the product is further ensured.

title_en: Lithium-containing oxide precursor, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application discloses a lithium-containing oxide precursor, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the lithium-containing oxide precursor comprises secondary particles formed by primary particles, and the primary particles on the surfaces of the secondary particles are radially distributed and are in nano strip shapes. The nano strip-shaped primary particles in the lithium-containing oxide precursor are distributed on the surfaces of the secondary particles in a radioactive mode, the radial structure can shorten the diffusion path of lithium ions in the charging and discharging process, the strip-shaped primary particles can provide additional lithium ion melting diffusion channels for lithium supplement in positive electrode sintering, lithium of the positive electrode material obtained through sintering is distributed more uniformly, the electrochemical performance of the positive electrode material is improved, and particularly, the strip-shaped primary particles which are approximately arranged in a radial mode can release internal stress more effectively when the lithium ions are inserted into/separated from the material, and the cycling stability and safety of the material are enhanced.

title_en: Ultrathin glass, unequal-thickness ultrathin glass and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides ultrathin glass, unequal-thickness ultrathin glass, and a preparation method and application thereof. The unequal-thickness ultrathin glass comprises a bending region, non-bending regions and a buffer region, wherein the buffer regions are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the bending region, the non-bending regions are respectively positioned on one side of the buffer region far away from the bending region, the thickness of the non-bending regions is larger than that of the bending region, the thickness of the non-bending regions is 0.1-0.35 mm, the warping degree of the unequal-thickness ultrathin glass is less than or equal to 0.2mm, the film-covered falling stroke impact height of the unequal-thickness ultrathin glass is more than or equal to 200mm, and the unequal-thickness ultrathin glass comprises ：57wt%~61.5wt% SiO 2 、17wt%~19wt% Al 2 O 3 、0~1wt% CaO、0~2wt% Li 2 O、15.8wt%~19wt% Na 2 O、0.5wt%~3wt% K 2 O、1wt%~4wt% MgO、0.5wt%~3wt% ZrO 2 、0~1wt% B 2 O 3 . ultrathin glass and unequal-thickness ultrathin glass according to the mass percentage of oxides, and has excellent optical performance, impact resistance, bending performance and anti-falling performance.

title_en: Pulse energy storage dielectric ceramic material with high-entropy perovskite structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pulse energy storage dielectric ceramic material with a high-entropy perovskite structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical composition formula of the ceramic material is (Ba  x Ca y Sr z Zn w )(Ti (1‑a) Zr a )O 3 ; and satisfies x+y+z+w=1), the preparation method comprises the steps of weighing main crystal phase raw materials according to a metering ratio, mixing, calcining at 800-1000 ℃, granulating and forming the obtained powder, and sintering at 1160-1220 ℃.

title_en: Method for manufacturing quantum dot and quantum dot
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a method for manufacturing quantum dots capable of improving EQE and the quantum dots. The method for producing a quantum dot is characterized by comprising a step of producing a core and a step of coating the surface of the core with a shell, wherein the step of coating the shell is carried out by mixing an acidic compound and a zinc halide compound with a shell raw material. In the present invention, the step of coating the shell is preferably divided into at least a first half and a second half, and the shell is coated a plurality of times by using a shell material in the first half, in which the acid compound is mixed, but not the zinc halide compound, and using a shell material in the second half, in which both the acid compound and the zinc halide compound are mixed.

title_en: Heat treatment station device for automobile chassis parts and anti-drop equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat treatment of automobile parts, in particular to a heat treatment station device for automobile chassis parts and anti-drop equipment. The heat treatment station device for the automobile chassis parts comprises an appliance frame, two flange tool assemblies and two end tool assemblies. The invention can form a double fixing mechanism of pneumatic pressing and mechanical hard locking, ensure that the constant clamping force is kept for the automobile chassis parts, avoid falling of the parts, and carry out both ends of the end body and the flange end of the automobile chassis parts to cooperatively and rigidly clamp the automobile chassis parts, further ensure the stable clamping of the automobile chassis parts, in addition, ensure the constant and stable control of the clamping force in the heat treatment process, and ensure that the automobile chassis parts can carry out certain thermal expansion and expansion in the heat treatment process, avoid the thermal stress generated by rigid clamping, ensure the dimensional precision and the stable posture of the whole process of the workpiece, and realize the consistent positioning standard of the whole process of the heat treatment.

title_en: Positive electrode active material, positive electrode plate, battery and electric equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a positive electrode active material, a positive electrode plate, a battery and electric equipment, wherein the positive electrode active material comprises secondary particles formed by stacking primary particles, the primary particles comprise iron-based phosphate coated with carbon, and the average internal porosity of the secondary particles is less than or equal to 15%. The secondary particles of the positive electrode active material have relatively low internal porosity, and can realize high compaction density of the positive electrode plate, thereby improving the energy density of the battery core.

title_en: Vacuum low-pressure carburizing heat treatment method for improving structure and performance of 1Cr13 steel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vacuum low-pressure carburizing heat treatment method for improving the structure and performance of 1Cr13 steel. The method sequentially comprises vacuum preactivation, pulse low pressure carburization, three-stage diffusion homogenization, high-temperature short-time austenitization, multistage stage quenching and three-time stabilization tempering. The surface oxide film is removed by vacuum preactivation, the carburization activity is improved, the continuous gentle carbon gradient and the diffusion carbide are formed on the carburized layer by combining pulse low-pressure carburization and three-stage diffusion, and martensite is refined by multistage stage quenching and three-time tempering, so that the stress peak value is reduced, and the residual austenite is stabilized. The hardness of the treated seepage layer is HRC 54-59, the depth is 0.75-1.05 mm, the wear resistance is improved by 2-3 times, the salt fog test is 720-960 hours without pitting corrosion. The invention is suitable for strengthening the wear-resistant and corrosion-resistant parts such as the 1Cr13 steel valve core, the rotating shaft, the die mandrel and the like.

title_en: Water-based permeable inorganic waterproof agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of waterproofing agents, and particularly relates to an aqueous permeable inorganic waterproofing agent and a preparation method thereof. The water-based permeable inorganic waterproof agent consists of, by mass, 40-50 parts of composite alkali metal silicate, 10-15 parts of modified nano silicon dioxide dispersion liquid, 3-6 parts of crystallization accelerator, 2-4 parts of sodium montmorillonite aqueous dispersion liquid, 1-1.5 parts of inorganic micro powder, 0.5-1 part of polyether nonionic surfactant, 0.5-1 part of antifreeze agent, 0.1-0.3 part of defoaming agent and 100 parts of water. The water-based permeable inorganic waterproof agent prepared by the invention has the advantages of large permeation depth, excellent anti-whiskering property and stable storage.

title_en: Method and system for utilizing full components of clay-containing mineral polluted soil and preparation method of high-performance geopolymer slurry
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for utilizing all components of clay-containing mineral polluted soil, relates to the recycling of the polluted soil, and belongs to the fields of energy, environment and material intersection. The invention realizes the full-component recycling of the clay-containing mineral polluted soil by the fractional and hierarchical composite thermochemical-mechanical activation of the polluted soil, improves the additional economic value of the clay-containing mineral polluted soil, and has better application prospect. The method for treating clay-containing mineral polluted soil provided by the invention has the advantages of environment-friendly treatment process, simplicity and easiness in operation, suitability for large-scale treatment and the like. The geopolymer prepared from the recovered product obtained by the method has higher strength and toughness and better application prospect.

title_en: Bacterial strain for enriching lithium element in salt lake brine and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a strain WXL2025-01 of psychrophilic bacillus (Psychrobacter alimentarius), which has a preservation number of CGMCC No. 37430 in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms. The strain has good tolerance to high-concentration salt, can grow in a culture medium containing 90 g/L NaCl, and can enrich Li element in salt lake brine containing complex ion environment on thalli at a low temperature (10 ℃) of 15 d, wherein the enrichment rate reaches 22%. The invention also provides a culture medium and a culture method of the strain. The invention provides a core excellent strain for effectively enriching Li element in brine, increases specificity, saves resources, has no secondary pollution, and is suitable for large-scale fermentation production.

title_en: 3D printing powder spreading device for hard alloy powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D printing powder spreading device for hard alloy powder, relates to the technical field of hard alloy powder spreading, and aims to solve the technical problem that the existing powder spreading roller lacks effective designs for inhibiting plow cutting scratch and air blocking effect. The invention forms a complete special powder paving system for hard alloy by gradually progressing and cooperatively coupling four large structures of bidirectional variable pitch spiral grooves, constraint micro-vibration, air compression anti-static and vibration extrusion forced deformation, wherein the spiral grooves realize basic gas breaking and smoothing, micro-vibration realizes global plow cutting prevention, air compression realizes static prevention and secondary gas breaking, and vibration extrusion realizes forced driving and long-acting stability, thereby solving the series defects of plow cutting scratch, air blocking, static bias aggregation, roll surface adhesion, powder surface protrusion fault and the like in the powder paving process of hard alloy powder, obviously improving the density, uniformity and forming stability of a powder bed, and meeting the use requirements of high-end equipment on high precision, high reliability and long service life of hard alloy components.

title_en: Photochromic composite film material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment decoration materials, and particularly relates to a photochromic composite film material and a preparation method and application thereof. The photochromic composite film material comprises a base material, and a silicon-oxygen-nitrogen blocking layer, an yttrium oxyhydride photochromic layer, a silicon-oxygen-nitrogen packaging layer and a protective layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the base material, wherein the protective layer is made of fluorine-containing polysilazane, fluorosilane or fluorine-containing siloxane, the thickness of the silicon-oxygen-nitrogen blocking layer is 80-400 nm, and the thickness of the silicon-oxygen-nitrogen packaging layer is 400-1000 nm. The invention realizes the function of keeping photochromism under the combined action of each layer, improves the blocking capability of the film layer to water vapor and oxygen, and realizes the comprehensive tone design of the base material in the bleached state by adjusting the thicknesses of the bottom silicon-oxygen-nitrogen blocking layer and the top silicon-oxygen-nitrogen packaging layer, so that the obtained base material has decorative, durable and dynamic color change effects.

title_en: System and method for preparing 5N-grade ammonium rhenate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for preparing 5N-grade ammonium rhenate, wherein the system for preparing 5N-grade ammonium rhenate comprises a dissolving tank, a precipitation reaction tank, a buffer tank, a two-stage purification device, an ultrasonic freezing crystallization device, a centrifugal machine, a dissolution returning tank and a vacuum drying box. The double-stage filtering device comprises a top liquid inlet, a side liquid inlet, a hollow cylindrical shell, a liquid inlet chamber, a first-stage filtering membrane, a first-stage permeation chamber, a second-stage filtering layer, a second-stage permeation chamber, a bottom liquid outlet, a interception chamber, a liquid flow column and a discharge pipeline, so that the defects that a traditional filtering mode is easy to block pores and the loss rate of target products is high can be overcome, meanwhile, the adopted double-stage filtering device realizes separation of impurities by utilizing the principle of cross-flow filtering, the cross-flow filtering can protect an ion exchange membrane from being blocked, the ion exchange membrane can make up the defect that small molecular ions cannot be removed by the cross-flow filtering, and the ammonium rhenate is basically not adsorbed, so that the recovery rate of ammonium rhenate is ensured.

title_en: Powder cleaning hole filling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a powder cleaning hole filling method, belongs to the technical field of additive manufacturing, and solves one of the problems that the existing filling plugging technology is poor in suitability for filling plugging of powder cleaning holes with different diameters and different depths and local stress concentration is easy to generate in the using process of a filling plugging sleeve. The clear powder hole filling method comprises the following steps of S1, measuring the diameter and depth of a clear powder hole to be filled and blocked, obtaining parameter data of the clear powder hole, S2, adjusting the length of a distance adjusting unit according to the depth parameter data of the clear powder hole, enabling the axial position of a filling and blocking unit to be matched with the hole depth of the clear powder hole, and S3, inserting a filling and blocking device into the clear powder hole, and controlling the radial expansion of the filling and blocking unit to fill and block the clear powder hole. The invention realizes the filling and plugging of the powder cleaning holes with different diameters and depths, and improves the suitability of filling and plugging of the powder cleaning holes with different specifications.

title_en: In-plane graphite-diamond-silicon carbide composite heat dissipation material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat dissipation materials, in particular to an in-plane graphite-diamond-silicon carbide composite heat dissipation material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of mixing graded diamond powder with a binder, sequentially carrying out compression molding, degreasing treatment and water jet cutting to form a clamping groove array to obtain a porous diamond prefabricated body, inserting a porous graphite sheet into the clamping groove array of the porous diamond prefabricated body to obtain a graphite-diamond composite body, carrying out chemical vapor infiltration on the graphite-diamond composite body to generate silicon carbide in situ, and obtaining the in-plane graphite-diamond-silicon carbide composite heat dissipation material. The composite heat-dissipating material prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of high interface bonding strength and high vertical heat conductivity, and the composite heat-dissipating material has the characteristics of large size and ultra-thin property, and can realize low-cost mass production.

title_en: Coating, coating method of coating in steel wire and steel wire rope
abstract_en: The application relates to a zinc-aluminum-magnesium-rare earth alloy coating, a plating method of the zinc-aluminum-magnesium-rare earth alloy coating in a steel wire and a steel wire rope. The zinc-aluminum-magnesium rare earth alloy coating comprises Al and Mg, at least one microalloying element selected from Nb, ti and V, rare earth elements, and the balance Zn and unavoidable impurities, wherein the rare earth elements are introduced into the coating in the form of organic rare earth compounds. In the coating, the organic rare earth compound releases active rare earth atoms in situ by thermal decomposition in the hot dip plating process, CO and H  2  generated by cracking the organic groups form a micro-area reducing atmosphere to protect rare earth from secondary oxidation, the rare earth atoms are released at an interface, the wettability of a plating solution to a steel base is improved, a residual oxide film is reduced, a grain boundary is purified, and trace carbon and the rare earth form an RE-C grain boundary composite segregation layer, so that the performance of a steel wire product can be improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing display glass substrate and glass product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display, in particular to a manufacturing method of a display glass substrate and a glass product, which are characterized in that after coarsening and plasma surface treatment, sputtering deposition and catalytic treatment of a NiCr layer, a Ti layer and a Cu layer are sequentially carried out, then current density increasing stepwise is carried out for electroplating, finally, the glass product obtained by developing and nickel plating treatment is carried out, a metal layer can be more tightly adhered to the glass substrate, the adhesion is better, the plating layer is more uniform, the condition of uneven plating thickness does not occur, and the problem of poor adhesion between a display glass panel and the metal layer is successfully solved.

title_en: Differential pressure driving type composite disc spring energy storage extrusion feeding device, system and using method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of die-casting forming dies, in particular to a differential pressure driving type composite disc spring energy storage extrusion feeding device, a differential pressure driving type composite disc spring energy storage extrusion feeding system and a using method. The extrusion feeding device is a purely mechanical type local feeding mechanism, a spring bin is used as an installation carrier, a belleville spring which is alternately arranged in the front-back direction is coaxially compressed and stacked in the spring bin, a first-stage energy storage structure is formed by matching with outer ring springs which are uniformly distributed in the circumferential direction, a guide post is coaxially arranged on the spring bin and the inner ring of the belleville spring in a penetrating way, a plurality of pressing plates and the inner ring springs are sleeved on the guide post to form a second-stage energy storage structure, the outer edges of the pressing plates clamp the belleville springs to separate the inner ring so as to synchronously drive the belleville springs to axially deform, and an adjusting bolt is rotatably arranged at the tail end of the guide post, so that the initial compression amount of an elastic element can be adjusted to set a feeding trigger threshold value. The device does not need an external hydraulic power and electric control sensing system, and automatically triggers feeding by means of dynamic pressure difference of metal hydraulic pressure and elastic force, has zero response delay, compact structure and strong working condition adaptability, and can eliminate shrinkage cavity and shrinkage porosity defects of a large-sized die casting hot joint with high reliability.

title_en: Medical glass bottle vulcanizing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical glass bottle vulcanizing device, which belongs to the technical field of glass product processing and aims to solve the problems that the vulcanizing treatment depends on manpower and the vulcanizing attachment is uneven in glass bottle production, and comprises a machine case, wherein the machine case comprises a control box, a combustion chamber and a mounting table arranged above the control box and the combustion chamber, the installation bench is provided with a feed box, a rotary channel is arranged between the bottom of the feed box and the installation bench, one end of the rotary channel penetrates through the inside of the feed box, the other end of the rotary channel is communicated with a leakage channel at the top of the combustion chamber, a conveying chain is arranged in the rotary channel, and a chimney for connecting the glass bottle annealing chamber is arranged at the top of the combustion chamber.

title_en: Water-rich fractured rock mass volume micro-expansion geopolymer high-strength solid grouting material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grouting reinforcement of water-rich fractured rock mass, in particular to a high-strength reinforced grouting material of a polymer of a micro-expansion type of the volume of the water-rich fractured rock mass, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes multi-source solid wastes such as blast furnace slag powder, carbide slag powder, tailing powder, red mud powder, high-calcium fly ash and the like as raw materials to prepare the low-carbon environment-friendly geopolymer grouting material with excellent durability, good economy, and the addition of the steel slag, the biomass ash and the phosphogypsum promotes the micro-expansion of the system because the anionic polyacrylamide, the agar, the xanthan gum, the modified hydroxyethyl methyl cellulose ether, the polyethylene glycol and the polycarboxylate water reducer are used in a compounding way.

title_en: Nanometer tungsten carbide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of powder metallurgy, in particular to nano tungsten carbide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing tungsten oxide with a carbon source, sieving, sequentially adding a structurant, layering and centrifugally granulating to obtain a spherical material; and (3) in a nitrogen atmosphere, preserving the temperature of the spherical material at 400-600 ℃ for 20-40 min, sequentially carrying out reduction carbonization and batch carbon supplementing to obtain carbonized material, and finally passivating and crushing the carbonized material to obtain the nano tungsten carbide. The application adopts a simple centrifugal granulation technology, solves the problem of hollow materials, strengthens the structural strength of spherical materials, avoids the problem of poor consistency of tungsten carbide powder caused by crushing of the spherical materials in the subsequent process, and forms a gas channel by introducing a structural agent to construct the internal macrostructure of the spherical materials, thereby avoiding the problem of material structure damage caused by gas generated in the reaction process, and obviously improving the quality and the production efficiency of nano tungsten carbide powder.

title_en: Method for preparing tetragonal phase barium titanate powder with assistance of microwaves
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing tetragonal barium titanate powder by microwave assistance, which comprises the steps of mixing a barium source and a titanium source to obtain non-hydrolytic sol, carrying out microwave assistance gelation reaction on the non-hydrolytic sol to obtain wet gel, drying the wet gel to obtain xerogel, carrying out heat treatment on the xerogel in protective atmosphere to obtain presintered powder, carrying out microwave assistance calcination on the presintered powder to obtain calcined powder, and washing and drying the calcined powder to obtain barium titanate powder. The method provided by the invention carries out microwave-assisted gelation reaction on the sol, and can shorten the gelation time and reduce the calcination temperature under the action of the microwave in two steps of gelation and calcination, thereby synchronously realizing the cooperative regulation and control of the high purity, superfine particle size and high tetragonal phase content of the barium titanate powder. The method provided by the invention is simple and controllable, has low energy consumption, is suitable for industrial mass production, and the prepared barium titanate powder can be widely applied to the preparation of ceramic capacitors, and can obviously improve the reliability and miniaturization capability of devices.

title_en: Defect phosphazene catalyst, electrochemical synthesis method thereof and application thereof in nitrogen reduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrochemical synthesis method of a defective phosphazene catalyst and application thereof in nitrogen reduction. The catalyst is a few-layer phosphane rich in-plane phosphorus vacancies, has a porous two-dimensional sheet structure, has a thickness of 1-3 nm, and has an in-plane aperture of 5-15 nm. The invention adopts an anhydrous organic electrolyte system, and a black phosphorus sheet is clamped between two platinum electrodes in a pressing contact mode to form a platinum-black phosphorus-platinum sandwich cathode, and the platinum electrode is used as a counter electrode. In anhydrous organic electrolyte containing quaternary ammonium salt cation intercalation agent, through step-type application of negative potential, quaternary ammonium salt cation is intercalated into black phosphorus layer under the action of electric field. Meanwhile, hydrogen generated by platinum catalysis forms high-pressure hydrogen bubbles in situ, and a black phosphorus atomic layer is etched dynamically, so that stripping and defect construction of black phosphorus are realized in one step. The phosphorus vacancy in the obtained defective phosphazene can be used as a Lewis acid site, so that sigma-donation electrons and pi-feedback electrons of nitrogen are obviously enhanced, and N [ identical to ] N triple bonds are efficiently activated. The Lewis acid site can also improve the energy barrier of hydrogen evolution reaction and inhibit side reaction. The method provided by the invention avoids the problem of phosphazene oxidation caused by traditional water phase etching, is simple and convenient to operate and efficient, and is expected to be popularized and applied to other two-dimensional materials and electrocatalytic fields.

title_en: Low specific surface area palladium powder with bimodal particle size distribution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of noble metal powder preparation, in particular to low specific surface area palladium powder with bimodal particle size distribution and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, the nucleation-growth kinetics is accurately regulated and controlled by adopting a composite alkali liquor system, specifically, the complex alkali can form a stable complex with palladium ions, the reduction process of palladium is delayed, the non-complex alkali only provides an alkaline environment and has no complex effect, the nucleation-growth kinetics of the system can be accurately regulated and controlled by compounding the complex alkali with the non-complex alkali, the reasonable matching of the nucleation rate and the grain growth rate is realized, and a particle system with bimodal grain size distribution can be generated in situ in a single reduction process. The structure effectively controls the specific surface area of palladium powder below 2.0 m  2 /g, not only maintains the high activity characteristic given by main fine particles (about 100 nm), but also obviously reduces the surface energy by introducing a proper amount of coarse particle components, thereby fundamentally solving the problems of serious agglomeration, poor dispersibility and the like caused by overlarge specific surface area of the traditional nano palladium powder.

title_en: Carbon alkali removal method in Bayer process alumina production
abstract_en: The application discloses a carbon alkali removal method in Bayer process alumina production, which comprises the following steps of providing bauxite and lime, carrying out mixed grinding on the bauxite, the lime and a caustic alkali-containing solution to obtain mixed slurry, carrying out dissolution reaction on the mixed slurry to obtain a dissolution solution, wherein the dissolution reaction temperature is 260-270 ℃, diluting the dissolution solution, then adding an aluminum hydroxide seed crystal for decomposition reaction and solid-liquid separation to obtain an aluminum hydroxide crystal and a solution containing sodium carbonate, carrying out evaporation concentration on the solution containing sodium carbonate to obtain a concentrated alkali solution, taking at least part of the concentrated alkali solution as a salt solution to be discharged, and adding a composite seed crystal into the salt solution to be discharged for evaporation concentration and solid-liquid separation, wherein the composite seed crystal comprises sodium carbonate and sodium sulfate, and the addition amount of the composite seed crystal is 0.1-0.3% of the mass of the salt solution to be discharged. The method can improve the carbon alkali removal efficiency.

title_en: Cobalt hydroxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cobalt hydroxide, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of introducing a divalent cobalt solution containing a reducing agent and liquid alkali into a microchannel reactor containing bottom water for precipitation reaction, collecting slurry, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the cobalt hydroxide, wherein the pH value of the bottom water is 13.0-14.0, and the flow rate of the divalent cobalt solution containing the reducing agent is 5.0-30.0g/min. The preparation method of the cobalt hydroxide, provided by the invention, can effectively control the particle size of the cobalt hydroxide by regulating and controlling the inflow rate of the bivalent cobalt solution containing the reducing agent and the liquid alkali, and obtain the hexagonal flaky nano cobalt hydroxide with uniform particle size, particle size smaller than 0.5 mu m, regular shape and larger specific surface area.

title_en: Low-shrinkage high-performance cement and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses low-shrinkage high-performance cement and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of building materials. The cement comprises 2-5% of mixed gypsum, 5-10% of auxiliary cementing material, 85-93% of low-shrinkage high-performance silicate cement clinker and a modified shrinkage reducer accounting for 0.5-1.0% of the total mass of the components. The invention solves the problem that the existing ultra-high performance concrete prefabricated part is easy to shrink and crack by optimizing the clinker composition and matching with the modified shrinkage reducing agent, and realizes the low shrinkage and high performance of cement.

title_en: Tungsten-based heavy alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A tungsten-based heavy alloy and a preparation method thereof are provided, wherein the tungsten-based heavy alloy is a radial gradient tungsten alloy material and comprises an inner layer material and an outer layer material coated on the periphery of the inner layer material, the inner layer material comprises, by weight, 95-98% of W, 1-2% of X, 1-2% of Ni, 0-1% of Fe, 0-1% of Co, 0-1% of X and Mo or Ta, the outer layer material comprises, by weight, 90-93% of W, 4-7% of Ni, 1-3% of Fe and 0-1% of Co. The radial gradient tungsten alloy material can improve the interface bonding capability and mechanical property.

title_en: Efficient energy-saving ozone double-gap discharge electrode and ozone generating device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ozone generation, in particular to an efficient and energy-saving ozone double-gap discharge electrode and an ozone generating device, which comprise an outer electrode, wherein a special glass medium tube is penetrated in the outer electrode, an auxiliary electrode net layer is penetrated in the special glass medium tube, an inner electrode is penetrated in the auxiliary electrode net layer, the outer electrode and the auxiliary electrode net layer are connected with an electrode connector, the outer electrode, the special glass medium tube, the auxiliary electrode net layer and the inner electrode are coaxially arranged, a first discharge air gap is arranged between the outer electrode and the special glass medium tube, and a second discharge air gap is arranged between the inner electrode and the auxiliary electrode net layer. The high-efficiency energy-saving ozone double-gap discharge electrode and the ozone generating device can adjust the output voltage and the frequency of a power supply in real time according to the load working condition, and adopt a double-gap discharge structure, so that the total effective discharge area is greatly improved, the ozone output efficiency is remarkably improved, the overall electric energy utilization rate is far higher than that of a traditional single-gap ozone generator, and the energy-saving effect is outstanding.

title_en: Sodium iron pyrophosphate positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium iron pyrophosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of sodium ion battery positive electrode materials. The molecular formula of the sodium ferric pyrophosphate positive electrode material is Na  4 Fe 3‑x Al x (PO 4 ) 2‑2y F y P 2 O 7 /C, wherein x is more than or equal to 0.001 and less than or equal to 0.4, and y is more than or equal to 0.001 and less than or equal to 0.2. The invention utilizes Al/F co-doping to improve the electrochemical performance of the material and the intrinsic electronic conductivity and sodium ion diffusion coefficient of the material. The invention also ensures the uniform distribution of each element in the liquid phase and the gel network by introducing high-speed shearing treatment in the liquid phase stage so as to reduce the generation of NFP heterogeneous phase.

title_en: Pressureless sintered diamond bead and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diamond tools, in particular to a pressureless sintered diamond bead and a preparation method thereof, the method comprises the steps of granulating metal powder to obtain metal granules, carrying out diamond wrapping pretreatment to enable the metal powder to be uniformly adhered on the surface of diamond to obtain weighted diamond, carrying out cold press molding, wherein a mold core is gradually lowered three times during feeding, annular blank pressing is obtained through bidirectional cold press molding, the pressure maintaining time is controlled to be 0.9-1.2 seconds, the cold press compactness reaches 80% -90%, and soaking pressureless sintering is carried out, namely, putting the diamond bead into a mesh belt furnace in an ink box of a belt Kong Dan, and pressureless sintering is carried out in a hydrogen-nitrogen mixed atmosphere to obtain the diamond bead. The invention realizes the high consistency of different diamond beads by optimizing the formula and the powder form of the matrix and strictly controlling the pressing and sintering processes, the outer diameter difference of the metal matrix is reduced from 0.3mm to less than 0.1mm, and the sintering compactness difference is also controlled within 1%.

title_en: Chloride ion adsorption modified fiber for marine cement and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine cement functional fibers, and provides a chloride ion adsorption modified fiber for marine cement and a preparation method thereof, wherein the modified fiber is prepared by performing air corona or normal-pressure air plasma activation on polypropylene fibers, and mineralizing calcium sources, sodium aluminate, sodium hydroxide and deionized water on the surfaces of the polypropylene fibers in situ to form a calcium-aluminum layered double hydroxide-calcium aluminate hydrate composite mineralized layer, the fiber has surface chloride ion binding sites, mineralized layer adhesion stability and dispersibility in a cement mixing system, improves the chloride ion binding capacity while controlling the monofilament tensile strength retention rate, mineralized layer shedding rate and agglomeration beam content after surface activation treatment, solves the problem that the mineralized load is improved, the mechanical retention and dispersion stability are difficult to be compatible, and is suitable for mixing scenes which need fiber dispersion and chloride ion binding functions in marine cement and marine concrete.

title_en: Method for preparing HFO-1234yf by using R142b
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organofluorine industry, and discloses a method for preparing HFO-1234yf by utilizing R142b, which comprises the following steps of introducing liquid R142b into a one-step fixed bed reactor filled with ZnCl  2 /activated carbon catalyst after vaporization, carrying out dehydrochlorination reaction at 220-280 ℃ and 0.2-0.4 MPa to generate HCFO-1233xf, drying the obtained HCFO-1233xf, mixing the dried HCFO-1233xf with hydrogen, introducing the dried HCFO-1233xf into a two-step fixed bed reactor filled with palladium/carbon catalyst, and carrying out catalytic hydrogenation dechlorination reaction at 120-180 ℃ and 0.6-1.5 MPa to generate HFO-1234yf. The reaction product is purified by a low-temperature rectification tower to obtain HFO-1234yf with the purity more than or equal to 99.5 percent. The purity of the byproduct HCl after purification is more than or equal to 99 percent, the hydrogen recovery rate is more than or equal to 95 percent, and the residual liquid at the bottom of the rectifying tower is returned to the first step for recycling. The method has the advantages of low raw material cost, high reaction selectivity, high product purity, less waste discharge and the like, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Manufacturing method of thick-specification deep-drawing hot dip plated steel plate with thickness of 1.5-1.8 mm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a thick deep drawing grade hot dip plated steel plate with the thickness of 1.5-1.8 mm, belonging to the technical field of cold rolling hot dip plated steel plate manufacturing. The metallographic structure of the thick deep drawing hot dip coating steel plate with the thickness of 1.5-1.8 mm produced by the method is recrystallized ferrite and a small amount of two-phase particles, the grain size grade of the ferrite is I6.5-I7.0, the yield strength of the steel plate is 150-180 MPa, the tensile strength is 275-300 MPa, the plastic strain ratio is 2.20-2.75, and the coating of the steel plate is zinc or aluminum zinc alloy. The invention ensures the deep drawability and strength of the thick product by the combined design of component design, hot rolling finish rolling, coiling, slightly higher cold rolling reduction rate and horizontal continuous annealing process, simultaneously produces the thick cold-rolled hot-dip plated steel product with excellent appearance and high deep drawability in batches by a more economic production process, and meets the requirement of high surface and high performance of downstream users under the condition of strictly controlling the cost. The yield is improved, the production efficiency can be greatly improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Emergency braking system for tempering furnace mesh belt fracture and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency braking system for net belt fracture of tempering furnace and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of safety protection of metal heat treatment equipment, comprising a net belt fracture detection unit composed of a tension sensor and a speed sensor, an actual net belt linear speed detection unit containing a non-contact speed sensor, a control unit and an emergency braking unit composed of an electromagnetic band brake and a pneumatic pressing device, the control unit receives the tension signal and the speed signal simultaneously, and when the tension drop rate exceeds a threshold value and the deviation between the theoretical linear speed of the driving wheel and the actual linear speed of the net belt exceeds a preset range, the power supply of the driving motor is immediately cut off, and the electromagnetic band-type brake locking driven wheel and the pneumatic pressing device are triggered to clamp the net belt according to a preset time sequence. According to the invention, false triggering is effectively prevented through double redundancy judgment, quick and soft emergency braking is realized through composite braking and grading pressure control, and the running safety and reliability of the tempering furnace are obviously improved.

title_en: Silicon-containing austenitic electrothermal alloy hot rolled coil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-containing austenitic electric heating alloy hot rolled coil and a preparation method thereof, wherein the silicon-containing austenitic electric heating alloy hot rolled coil comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: less than or equal to 0.03 percent of C, less than or equal to 0.007 percent of N, less than or equal to 0.30 percent of Mn, less than or equal to 0.015 percent of P, less than or equal to 0.0020 percent of S, less than or equal to 18.00 percent of Cr, less than or equal to 20.00 percent of 35.00 percent of Ni, less than or equal to 37.00 percent of 1.70 percent of Si, less than or equal to 0.10 percent of Ti, less than or equal to 0.25 percent of 0.10 percent of Nb, less than or equal to 0.18 percent of 1.1 percent of Ti/Nb, less than or equal to 0.15 percent of Al, less than or equal to 0.25 percent of 0.0045 percent of B, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities; the invention improves the hot processing performance of the alloy, reduces hot coil rolling layering and edge cracking, and realizes stable production of hot rolled coils.

title_en: Seven-oxazine-triazine carbon nitride S-shaped homojunction photocatalyst with semi-coherent interface, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heptazine-triazine carbon nitride S-shaped homojunction photocatalyst with a semi-coherent interface, a preparation method and application thereof, which takes melamine as a precursor, lithium chloride and potassium chloride as binary fused salts, preparing an oligomeric heptazine-triazine carbon nitride mixture precursor by fused salt assisted thermal polymerization, and then annealing to obtain the heptazine-triazine carbon nitride S-shaped homojunction photocatalyst with a semi-coherent interface. The method has the characteristics of simple steps, mild reaction conditions, high safety, high repeatability, low cost and availability of materials and the like, and the obtained heptazine-triazine carbon nitride S-type homojunction photocatalyst with the semi-coherent interface has triazine and heptazine phases with different work functions, and the triazine and the heptazine phases induce a huge interface built-in electric field at the tightly connected semi-coherent interface, so that the separation and migration of photogenerated carriers can be accelerated, and the heptazine-triazine carbon nitride S-type homojunction photocatalyst can be applied to the hydrogen production by decomposing pure water under visible light, can improve the reaction efficiency and has potential application prospect.

title_en: Cylindrical battery end face metal powder hot-press forming method and high-temperature pressing furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cylindrical battery end face metal powder hot-press molding method which comprises the steps of carrying out cold pressing pre-leveling on the end face of a full tab of a cylindrical battery core, eliminating buckling deformation generated by tab turning, forming a continuous powder bearing base surface, filling a metal powder layer on the end face of the leveled tab, enabling the metal powder to be completely embedded into a concave-convex gap formed by stacking the tabs, enabling the upper surface of the powder layer to be flush with the highest position of the end face, vertically clamping the battery core filled with the metal powder layer into a high-temperature pressing furnace, carrying out heat insulation coating positioning on a non-molding main body part of the battery core, enabling the end face to be molded to face upwards and be coaxially aligned with the axial pressing mechanism, introducing inert protective atmosphere into the furnace to maintain an anaerobic environment, adopting a partition heating mode to intensively heat the end face region to a sintering temperature which is lower than the heat-resistant temperature of a diaphragm inside the battery core, applying constant axial pressure to the metal powder layer through the axial pressing mechanism, keeping the temperature, compacting until the metal powder layer is compacted and forming metallurgical bonding with the surface of a tab foil.

title_en: Solid waste-based cementing material for deep stirring slurry spraying construction and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cementing materials, and particularly relates to a solid waste-based cementing material for deep stirring slurry spraying construction, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the cementing material comprises a solid waste precursor material, an alkali activator and water, the solid waste precursor material comprises a main solid waste precursor material and red mud, the main solid waste precursor material comprises 3% -10% of the total mass of solid components of the alkali activator, and the red mud accounts for 0.6-1:1, wherein the mass ratio of the fly ash, the blast furnace slag and the carbide slag is (2-4) (4-6) (2-4), the alkali activator is a mixed alkali solution of sodium hydroxide and sodium silicate, the effective modulus of the alkali activator is 1-1.4, the effective mass ratio of the sodium silicate and the sodium hydroxide is 1.2-1.8:1, the equivalent Na  2  O provided by the alkali activator is 6% -10% of the mass of the main solid waste precursor material, and the red mud accounts for 3% -10% of the total mass of the solid components of the alkali activator, and the water gel ratio is 0.6-1:1. The method can be used for reinforcing soft soil foundation, solidifying high-water-content powdery clay or silt and treating roadbed engineering foundation.

title_en: Method for recovering lithium from alkaline low-concentration lithium-containing solution through saponification extraction and countercurrent back extraction
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for recovering lithium from alkaline low-concentration lithium-containing solution through saponification extraction and countercurrent back extraction, belonging to the technical field of lithium-containing wastewater recovery. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing alkaline low-concentration lithium-containing solution, preparing an extracted organic phase by adopting HBL121 and sulfonated kerosene, performing saponification treatment by adopting sodium hydroxide solution, wherein the saponification degree is 20% -100%, mixing and extracting the saponified organic phase and a solution to be processed according to the ratio of O/A=1:2-2:1 for 1-9 minutes to obtain a lithium-loaded organic phase, and performing back extraction by adopting sulfuric acid aqueous solution to obtain a lithium-rich back extraction solution and a blank organic phase. The application breaks through the limitation that the HBL121 system is only suitable for high alkaline systems with pH more than 13 through saponification pretreatment, reduces the pH value range of a suitable solution to 11, can efficiently and selectively extract lithium without adding a synergistic agent, reduces the alkali consumption by 81%, ensures that the single-stage lithium extraction rate is more than 99%, ensures that the total stripping rate of three-stage countercurrent stripping is more than 99.5%, ensures that the extractant has no obvious attenuation after 5 times of circulating performance, and has the advantages of simple process, low cost and easy industrialization.

title_en: 250 Kiloamp high-voltage large-current zinc oxide varistor and varistor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of zinc oxide piezoresistors, and discloses a 250 kiloampere high-voltage type through-current zinc oxide piezoresistor sheet and a piezoresistor. In the varistor, a resistor substrate is made of gradient doped zinc oxide ceramic materials, electrode layers are respectively arranged on two end faces of the resistor substrate, the electrode layers are of double-layer composite structures formed by ohmic contact layers and flow guide layers, the ohmic contact layers are tightly attached to the end faces of the resistor substrate, the flow guide layers are tightly covered on the surfaces of the ohmic contact layers, a coating layer is an inorganic insulating heat dissipation composite layer, the coating layer is tightly coated on the side faces of the resistor substrate, and two ends of the coating layer are respectively connected with edges of the two electrode layers in a sealing mode. The invention can bear 250 kiloampere high-voltage impact, has stable through-flow, excellent heat dissipation and reliable insulation, and meets the use requirement of lightning protection of an ultra-high voltage transmission system.

title_en: Small methanol reforming hydrogen production device system utilizing tail gas waste heat
abstract_en: The application discloses a small methanol reforming hydrogen production device system utilizing waste heat of tail gas, which comprises a raw material storage tank, a raw material pump, a first regulating valve, a preheater, a reformer, a third regulating valve and a tail gas fan, wherein a thermometer is arranged on the reformer, a heat exchange interlayer is arranged on the outer side of the reformer, and the preheater adopts a heat exchanger structure; the hot tail gas is drawn by a tail gas fan to sequentially pass through a heat exchange interlayer on the outer side of the reformer and a hot channel of the preheater to be heated, a methanol water solution is preheated through a cold channel of the preheater under the conveying action of a raw material pump and then enters a reforming catalyst bed layer of the reformer to react, and the reformer discharges a hydrogen product generated by the reaction. The small methanol reforming hydrogen production device system can be used as an important component of a portable fuel cell power system design, is applied to vehicle-mounted hydrogen fuel cells, produces hydrogen through onboard reforming of methanol for oxidation-reduction reaction, and can solve the problems of difficulty in transportation and difficulty in storage of the hydrogen.

title_en: Machining die for gear transmission shaft for combined die core of passivation device
abstract_en: A passivation device makes up the processing mould of the gear drive shaft for mold core, it is a technical field of machining, the inner wall of each quadrant is from top to bottom the step structure formed by inner wall of tooth form, arc inner wall and trough-shaped wall sequentially, after a plurality of quadrants are combined, a plurality of inner walls of tooth form connect and form the complete tooth form counter bore, a plurality of inner walls of arc form the smooth round counter bore, a plurality of trough-shaped inner walls form the complete hexagon counter bore, the tooth form counter bore, round counter bore and hexagon counter bore connect and communicate to form and pour the cavity, pour the liquid metal into and pour into the cavity and cool, move the quadrant to six directions through the hand grip after cooling, can obtain the upper portion and have gears, the middle part has drive shafts, the bottom has gear drive shaft of the hexagon step, the utility model can omit the appearance processing with complicated shape, can save a large amount of manufacturing, the cost is reduced.

title_en: Device for recycling sodium chloride and diethylene glycol in permanent violet kneading wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device of resource recovery sodium chloride and diethylene glycol in permanent violet kneading waste water relates to permanent violet waste water resource utilization technical field. The method comprises a sodium chloride recovery unit, a diethylene glycol enrichment unit and a diethylene glycol recovery unit which are connected in sequence, wherein sodium chloride and diethylene glycol-rich wastewater generated in the permanent violet kneading process is subjected to a spray drying process to recover sodium chloride. And absorbing the dry flue gas generated by spray drying by using an absorption liquid to enrich the diethylene glycol in the dry flue gas, and separating the extracting solution from the diethylene glycol by reduced pressure distillation after the concentration of the diethylene glycol in the absorption liquid reaches a preset value to recover the diethylene glycol. The method successfully separates and recycles sodium chloride, diethylene glycol and part of water from the permanent violet kneading wastewater, has simple flow, does not need large-scale equipment and facilities, and greatly reduces the equipment land. In the operation process, large-scale inspection and maintenance are almost not needed, and the operation cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Production line equipment for curing concrete under microwave-vacuum system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a production line device for curing concrete in a microwave-vacuum system, which comprises a control cabinet, a microwave generating device, an exhaust and dehumidification pipeline, a microwave heating box, a transmission system, a vacuum pump and a cooling device; the transmission system is fixed on the bridge body, and the transmission system is respectively fixed with the suppressor and the lifting type box door at the open ends of the two sides of the microwave heating box; the microwave generating device is arranged in an electrical appliance box on the microwave heating box; the air exhaust and moisture removal pipeline is arranged above the electric appliance box and communicated with the microwave heating box; the vacuum pump and the cooling device are fixed at the lower end of the bridge body and are connected with the microwave heating box through a pipeline; the vacuum pump and the cooling device are electrically connected with the electric appliance box; the electrical apparatus case is connected with the switch board electricity. The utility model discloses process flow is simple, can carry out the solidification of concrete on a large scale, realizes safe, green, the high-efficient solidification of concrete, improves the quality of concrete, effectively solves present concrete curing inefficiency, the big scheduling problem of energy consumption.

title_en: Vacuum and temperature interlocking device of sodium chlorite concentration reaction kettle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a concentrated reation kettle vacuum of sodium chlorite and temperature interlocking device relates to concentrated reation kettle technical field, including reation kettle and collecting box, reation kettle's inside fixedly connected with inner tank, fixedly connected with resistance heating wire between reation kettle's the interior diapire and the bottom of inner tank, reation kettle's top fixedly connected with kettle cover. This concentrated reation kettle vacuum of sodium chlorite and temperature interlocking device, come to take out the inside air of inner tank through starting the vacuum pump, make the inside formation vacuum environment of inner tank, the data transmission that can detect through the temperature sensor who sets up gives the PLC controller, the output of PLC controller control resistance heating wire heaies up or cools down, when the high temperature, PLC controller control water pump, the cooling of inner tank inside is accelerated to the inside cooling that spiral raceway is carried to the liquid that the cooling of collecting box inside is good to the water pump, the evaporation of water is reduced through the inside temperature of control inner tank, thereby concentrated effect has been improved.

title_en: Core setting tool for big snail shell casting
abstract_en: The utility model provides a core frock under big snail shell foundry goods, includes rings and long screw rod, and the top welding of rings and screw rod, the screw thread has been seted up to the lower part of screw rod, and threaded connection has outer hexagonal nut on the screw thread, the utility model discloses simple structure, practicality have solved in the casting process because of lower core is unstable, cause the psammitolite to collide with the casting mould, fall the sand, influence foundry goods blank inner chamber, appearance imperfections scheduling problem, reduced follow-up decoration work that relapses, easy operation, convenience reduce to 3 people from former 4 people of operation, have reduced the labour.

title_en: Dip-coating device for lost foam
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disappearance mould is with dip-coating device, it includes the dip-coating case, dip-coating incasement sets up plate turnover, dip-coating case curb plate top inwards sets up and stretches out the board, it sets up the telescopic link to stretch out the board lower part, plate turnover connects the output at the telescopic link, plate turnover includes the motor, the pivot with establish the board that turns over in the pivot, the pivot is on a parallel with the bottom of dip-coating case, turn over the board and be on a parallel with the pivot setting, the output of motor is connected in the pivot, through motor drive, the motor is established in the seal box, the output of telescopic link is connected on the upper portion of seal box, the device adopts and sets up plate turnover in the dip-coating incasement, be convenient for put into the automatic dip-.

title_en: Dissolving device for recovering metal platinum in catalyst waste
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dissolving device for recovering platinum in catalyst waste, which comprises a tank body and an annular microwave reactor arranged on the annular outer side of the tank body, wherein the upper end of the tank body is jointed with a cover plate, the middle position of the upper end of the cover plate is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the lower end of the cover plate is fixedly connected with an inner cylinder, the bottom end in the inner cylinder is fixedly connected with a circular filter screen, an output shaft of the driving motor penetrates through the cover plate and is fixedly connected with a main shaft, a plurality of stirring rods are uniformly and fixedly connected on the annular outer side of the main shaft, the edge position of the lower end of the cover plate is fixedly connected with an annular pipe, the design promotes the reaction potential energy of the catalyst waste and reaction liquid through the annular microwave reactor, propels the catalyst waste dissolving reaction to be carried out, simultaneously, the main, the contact area of the two is increased, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Blast furnace cooling wall structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a blast furnace stave structure belongs to blast furnace smelting equipment technical field, including the multistage stave, be equipped with a plurality of cooling tubes in the wall body of every section stave, the lower extreme of each section stave is the water inlet, the upper end is the delivery port, the stove outer covering of the blast furnace that is located the stave outside is worn out to water inlet and delivery port, the cooling tube of adjacent upper and lower section stave connects gradually through the contact pipe, form a plurality of cooling passage from bottom to top, the vertical parallel range of a plurality of cooling tubes in the wall body of every section stave, the water inlet and the delivery port of adjacent cooling tube are the level stagger respectively and arrange, water inlet and the delivery port that arrange with the level stagger of cooling tube on the stove outer covering are equipped with the trompil respectively one-to-one. The cooling tube directly advances directly out, and trompil and water inlet and delivery port are a pair of many settings respectively on solving current stove outer covering, lead to the trompil to destroy stove outer covering structural strength too greatly, and cooling tube and contact tube have more to buckle and hinder the problem that cooling water flows, contact tube and valve installation difficulty.

title_en: Cast steel pipe horizontal centrifuge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cast steel pipe horizontal centrifuge. The centrifugal machine comprises a heating device, a spraying device, a pipe pushing device and a pipe connecting device; the push pipe device comprises a push head, a push rod, a push pipe hydraulic cylinder and a push pipe trolley, wherein the push head is movably connected to the front end of the push rod, the push rod is supported by upper and lower positioning supporting wheels, a rack is fixed on the bottom surface of the push rod, the lower part of the push pipe trolley is connected with the push pipe hydraulic cylinder, and a push pipe oblique beam welded on the push pipe trolley corresponds to a push pipe lug welded on the push rod. The pipe connecting device is positioned in a pipe connecting pit in the middle of the track of the injection trolley and consists of 2-4 pipe connecting supports with V-shaped wheels arranged at the tops. The gas pipe of the heating device is a double-pipe sleeving structure. The spraying rod and the spray head of the spraying device are positioned in the hollow push rod of the push pipe device. The utility model discloses a single-station centrifuge of operation in an organic whole such as heating of collection pipe mould, coating spraying, molten steel pouring, pipe cooling, ejector sleeve, pipe die clearance practices thrift workshop area, practices thrift the equipment investment.

title_en: Bending-resistant compression-resistant high-strength double-steel hollow glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two steel cavity glass of bending resistance high strength, including frame and first toughened glass, second toughened glass, first toughened glass all links to each other with the frame is fixed with the second toughened glass both ends, frame one side both ends all are equipped with accepts the piece, accept one side respectively in first toughened glass or the fixed linking to each other of second toughened glass, just all be equipped with sealing glass between the piece, be equipped with the cavity between the sealing glass, first toughened glass all is equipped with the enhancement layer with second toughened glass one side, enhancement layer one side is equipped with fire-retardant layer, fire-retardant layer one side is equipped with the heat preservation, heat preservation one side is equipped with transparent resin layer, this kind of two steel cavity glass of bending resistance high strength, bending resistance compression effect is good, and flame retardant efficiency is good, and the heat preservation is effectual, and anti-skidding is effectual.

title_en: Roasting device for metal oxide powder material
abstract_en: The utility model provides a roasting device of metallic oxide powder material, including roasting case, maintenance structure and heating structure, roasting case top welds with the charge door mutually, and the charge door top is rotated through pivot and top cap and is connected, and the roasting case surface passes through the screw and can dismantle with maintenance structure and be connected, and heating structure passes through the fix with screw in roasting case below, and roasting case one side is through screw and pressure tank fixed connection.
