title_en: Rotary joint drawing device for fan-shaped roller section of continuous casting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fan-shaped section roller rotary joint draw-off gear of conticaster belongs to metallurgical industry steelmaking production technical field. The technical scheme is as follows: the handheld fixing frame (3) is in a stepped cylindrical shape with a center hole, one end of the handheld fixing frame (3) is a handle, the rotating shaft (2) is arranged in the center hole of the handheld fixing frame (3), one end, located at the handle of the handheld fixing frame (3), of the rotating shaft (2) is provided with the butterfly nut (1), the other end of the rotating shaft (2) is provided with the conical fixing disc (8), and the two shifting claws (6) are symmetrically arranged on the conical fixing disc (8) through fixing pin shafts (7) respectively; the flange (5) is positioned on the handheld fixing frame (3) through the fixing nut (4), and a jackscrew (12) is arranged in the circumferential direction of the flange (5). The utility model has the advantages that: the rotary joint can be conveniently and quickly replaced, and the secondary water leakage accident caused by damage to the inner hole of the roller mandrel due to knocking is avoided.

title_en: Cooling device for wax plastic molding
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of investment casting, in particular to a cooling device for wax-plastic molding, which comprises a cooling box, an alarm mechanism and a transmission mechanism; a cold source is configured on the cooling box; the alarm mechanism comprises an alarm which is arranged on the cooling box; the transmission mechanism is fixedly connected with the cooling box. The utility model discloses an above structure is placed the wax matrix and can be realized the automatic function of business turn over cooler bin of wax matrix on transmission device, has avoided the manpower transport, has alleviateed the human labor, the wax matrix cools off fast in the cooler bin, set up cooling time through alarm mechanism, alarm mechanism sends out the police dispatch newspaper after arriving the cooling time and reminds the operation personnel in time to tak away the wax matrix, avoid because the wax matrix temperature is low excessively, cause the wax matrix of different structure departments can't obtain qualified wax because of the shrinkage factor difference and mould off-the-shelf problem.

title_en: Automatic temperature control device for mass concrete
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a concrete equipment field discloses an automatic temperature control device of bulky concrete to carry out automatic temperature control to the concrete at concrete placement, maintenance process. The utility model comprises a liquid cooling system main body, a temperature control system, a data transmission structure and a medium transmission structure which are connected with the liquid cooling system main body and the temperature control system; the liquid cooling system main body comprises a pressure-resistant pipe, a liquid-isolating pipe and a temperature sensing element, wherein the temperature sensing element is arranged in the liquid-isolating pipe, the liquid-isolating pipe is arranged in the pressure-resistant pipe, and a closed medium cavity is formed between the pressure-resistant pipe and the liquid-isolating pipe; the temperature control system comprises a temperature monitoring system, a hydraulic control system and a brake system contained between the temperature monitoring system and the hydraulic control system, the temperature monitoring system is in data communication with the temperature sensing element through a data transmission structure, and the hydraulic control system is in temperature control medium circulation with the medium cavity through a medium transmission structure. The utility model is suitable for a concrete placement, maintenance.

title_en: Polymeric ferric sulfate processing reaction kettle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polyferric sulfate processing reation kettle, which comprises a tank body, the lateral wall fixedly connected with water tank of the jar body, the top fixedly connected with pipeline two of water tank, the left end fixedly connected with water pump of pipeline two, the output fixedly connected with pipeline three of water pump, hollow groove has been seted up between the pipe wall of the jar body, the bottom fixedly connected with pipeline one in hollow groove, the inside in hollow groove is provided with the heater, the pipe wall in hollow groove just is located a pipeline upside fixedly connected with temperature sensor, the top fixedly connected with pressure controller of the jar body, the top of the jar body just is located one side fixedly connected with air inlet of pressure controller, the top of the jar body just is located the front side fixedly connected with feed inlet of pressure controller, the inside ball valve that is provided with of feed inlet. The utility model discloses, through the continuous circulation of water tank and water pump and a plurality of pipeline to water, reduce the temperature of water in the circulation process, avoid jar body temperature height.

title_en: Device for leaching magnesium ions at high temperature by using ammonium chloride
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an utilize device of ammonium chloride high temperature leaching magnesium ion, including high temperature leaching jar, with the nitrogen gas input mechanism that the high temperature leaching jar air inlet links to each other, and with the tail gas processing mechanism that the alkaline gas discharge port at high temperature leaching jar top links to each other, the multistep circulation wet process of adoption, with ammonium chloride as the leaching agent of magnesium ion, through means efficient cyclic utilization such as condensation, improved the leaching efficiency of magnesium ion greatly, just the utility model discloses in use through each valve cooperation, can guarantee the safety and stability of high temperature reaction, solve prior art, reaction system pressure is low, and the carrier gas mobility is not enough scheduling problem to the leaching rate of magnesium ion has been improved; in addition, through the effect of tail gas treatment mechanism, can condense tail gas through the cold trap, can realize the recycling of material, can handle tail gas again and discharge, played the environmental protection effect.

title_en: Aluminum ingot rapid solidification system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminium ingot rapid solidification system, which comprises a base, the aluminium ingot mould, aluminium liquid distributor, the base is equipped with two parallel support draw runner and two conveying chain that parallel, support the downside horizontal segment that the draw runner is used for supporting conveying chain, conveying chain comprises a plurality of chain links, the chain link is equipped with the connection piece that transversely extends inwards, two corresponding chain links in conveying chain position are a set of, aluminium ingot mould is rectangular shape, aluminium ingot mould is equipped with annotates the liquid chamber, the top side of aluminium ingot mould is equipped with the opening, the both ends of aluminium ingot mould all are equipped with the connection external flange, the length direction that the connection external flange was followed aluminium ingot mould extends, the opening parallel and level of connection external flange and aluminium ingot mould, two connection external flanges of arbitrary aluminium ingot mould pass through bolted connection with two connection pieces of belonging to a set of same genus respectively, aluminium ingot rapid solidification system is equipped with the cooling bath. The utility model discloses make aluminium liquid in the aluminium ingot mould cool off, solidify into the aluminium ingot sooner to improve the production efficiency of aluminium ingot.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant pipe penetrating device for water pipe of water leakage cooling wall of blast furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blast furnace leaks water and cools off high temperature resistant poling device for wall water pipe, including the bellows body, the part cover that lies in on the bellows body outside the stave water pipe is equipped with the protection hose, is provided with a plurality of protruding package groups and the protection festival along its length direction distribution on the protection hose, and protruding package group is including a plurality of protruding package pieces that distribute, and the protection festival is the annular and its inner wall is towards the outer wall protrusion of bellows, and the one end of protection hose is provided with the moisture detector, and the moisture detector is located the low potential point of protection hose, is provided with the pilot lamp on the moisture detector. The utility model utilizes the protection hose to play the role of prolonging the service life of the corrugated pipe body on one hand, and on the other hand, the protection hose can be matched with the moisture detector to find out the damaged corrugated pipe body in time, and avoid large-area pollution caused by water leakage; the service life of the protection hose is longer, the protection effect to the bellows body is higher, and the cooling effect and the increase of service life to improving this device all have positive meaning.

title_en: Copper line annealing and wire changing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a copper line annealing device of trading relates to wire rod processing technology field, and when aiming at solving the trade line, the annealing machine need be shut down, is connected to the annealing machine with the stub of the wire rod of next take-up pulley on, shuts down the problem that can reduce machining efficiency. Its technical scheme main points are, including cylindric spool and the bottom plate of coaxial coupling on the spool bottom surface, the cross-section of bottom plate is circular, the ring channel has been seted up on the circumference side of bottom plate, set up the round hole that supplies the wire rod to penetrate on the top surface of bottom plate, the round hole communicates with each other with the ring channel. When the wire rod on one winding wheel is completely used up and the wire rod on the next winding wheel needs to be replaced, the slipknot at the tail end of the wire rod is opened, one section of wire rod hidden in the annular groove is drawn out from the round hole, and the wire head of the section of wire rod is connected to the annealing machine, so that the switching of a new coil of wire rod can be realized under the condition of no shutdown, the shutdown time is saved, and the processing efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Medium-frequency induction device for quenching and tempering steel pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medium-frequency induction device for hardening and tempering steel pipes, which comprises a supporting workbench, a medium-frequency induction furnace, a circulating cooling mechanism and a control mechanism, wherein the medium-frequency induction furnace is arranged on the supporting workbench and comprises a furnace body, a graphite crucible is transversely arranged in the center of an inner cavity of the furnace body, an induction coil is wound on the graphite crucible and spirally advances along the outer surface of the graphite crucible, a diatomite heat-insulating layer and a ceramic fiber heat-insulating layer are sequentially sleeved between the induction coil and the graphite crucible from outside to inside, and a quartz sand heat-insulating layer is arranged on the outer side of the induction coil. The utility model has the advantages of safety, high efficiency, little pollution and long service life, solves the problems of large deformation of workpieces, long manufacturing period and high production cost in the process of quenching and tempering the steel pipe, and realizes the stable heating of the steel pipe at the early stage of the quenching and tempering process.

title_en: Novel tundish lower nozzle baking device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of metallurgy, and particularly relates to a novel tundish lower nozzle baking device which comprises a tundish body, a lower nozzle, a steel pipe, a fixing buckle, an air suction sleeve, a first air suction pipe, a second air suction pipe and an air suction device; a water outlet is fixedly connected to the bottom of the tundish body; a steel pipe is fixed at the bottom of the lower nozzle through a fixing buckle; the bottom of the steel pipe is fixedly connected with an air suction sleeve; a first air suction pipe is fixedly connected to the side end of the air suction sleeve; the outer wall of the first air suction pipe is sleeved with a second air suction pipe; an air suction device is fixedly connected to the side end of the second air suction pipe; the problem of flow blockage caused by explosion of the drain due to large temperature difference between the molten steel and the drain is avoided.

title_en: Zero gradient mould of OEM product low pressure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wheel casting molds, and relates to an OEM product low-pressure zero-gradient mold, which comprises: hub part and rim part, the gradient angle of rim part is reduced by present 1 and is 0, the rim part still contains mould cooling opening, side form cooling opening, die block cooling opening, it includes mould rim water-cooling mouth, last mould rim heat-insulating structure, goes up mould core water-cooling mouth and mould reposition of redundant personnel awl water-cooling mouth to go up the mould cooling opening, the side form cooling opening includes side form rim water-cooling mouth, side form R angle water-cooling mouth, the die block cooling opening is PCD water-cooling mouth down. The gradient angle of the rim part is reduced to 0 degree from the existing 1 degree, the temperature gradient of the die in the rim solidification process is improved through adjusting the cooling structure and the thickness of the die, the sequential solidification feeding capability of the rim part is improved, the quality of the rim is ensured, the temperature gradient of the die in the rim solidification process is improved, and the sequential solidification feeding capability of the rim part is improved.

title_en: Polymerization tank for producing polyaluminium chloride
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polymerization tank for producing polyaluminium chloride, and relates to the technical field of polyaluminium chloride production equipment. This a polymerization jar for producing polyaluminium chloride, including the install bin, the opening has been seted up at the top of install bin, and open-ended inside fixed mounting has the polymerization jar, and the top of polymerization jar is provided with defoaming mechanism and heating mechanism. This a polymerization jar for producing polyaluminium chloride, pass through the motor, the axis of rotation, first umbelliform gear, the inlet pipe, the right angle dwang, the second umbelliform gear, hollow dwang, the third umbelliform gear, the stirring rake, the suction pump, the cooperation of first conveyer pipe and second conveyer pipe is used, at the in-process of production polyaluminium chloride, the foam suction that will produce because of the stirring, the foam that prevents to produce in the production process of polyaluminium chloride influences off-the-shelf polyaluminium chloride quality, the production time of polyaluminium chloride has also been reduced simultaneously, the production efficiency of production polyaluminium chloride has been increased.

title_en: Coated glass powder spraying adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a regulating device for spraying powder on coated glass, which relates to the technical field of coating devices and aims at solving the problem of inconvenient use, which comprises a spraying box, the middle of the spraying box is fixedly connected with a feed pipe, the outer wall of the feed pipe is sleeved with a moving pipe in a sliding way, the outer wall of the moving pipe is fixedly sleeved with a moving frame, the top of the moving frame is fixedly connected with a pneumatic cylinder fixedly connected with the spraying box, one side of the moving frame is fixed with a motor for understanding anxiety, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft which is rotationally connected with the moving frame through a coupler, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly sleeved with the driving wheel, the utility model has simple structure and convenient use, the micro-adjustment can be conveniently carried out, the stability of the flow and the quantity of the spraying are ensured, and the requirements of different works are met.

title_en: Rotary hearth furnace discharging chute
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rotary hearth furnace discharging chute which comprises a channel main body communicated with a rotary hearth furnace and a cooling device, wherein the channel main body comprises a channel top end and a channel bottom end which are detachably connected, a high-temperature resistant refractory brick is arranged on the inner wall of the channel top end, and high-temperature resistant and wear-resistant ceramic is arranged on the inner wall of the channel bottom end. According to the utility model, the feeding chute is divided into the top end of the channel positioned above and the bottom end of the channel positioned below, and the top end of the channel and the bottom end of the channel are detachably connected through the side surfaces, so that the damaged part of the feeding chute can be maintained or replaced conveniently without integrally replacing the feeding chute.

title_en: Doubling equipment is used in cavity glass production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a doubling device for hollow glass production, and relates to the field of supports, support frames, conveyor belts, support plates, compression rollers, roller frames, cover plates, belt shafts, stabilizing frames, hydraulic assemblies, limiting grooves, heat conducting frames, prepressing layers, driving shafts, connecting end plates and heating devices; the height of the press roller can be easily adjusted by the hydraulic assembly, so that the purpose of enabling the press roller to transfer pressure according to the needs of products is achieved, heat is generated by a heating device and is transmitted to an external annular prepressing layer through the heat conduction frame, the whole prepressing roller is driven to roll by the driving shaft, and therefore the laminated glass prepressing roller can directly heat laminated glass in the prepressing process, extra heating equipment is reduced, a certain gap is formed between the supporting plate and the roller frame, the damage to the edge of the glass is reduced, the press roller is prevented from being directly pressed on the edge of the glass, the edge of the glass is enabled to bear large force, the glass is damaged, and the purpose of protecting the glass in the process of rolling the glass is achieved.

title_en: Mesh belt controllable atmosphere continuous furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mesh belt controlled atmosphere continuous furnace, which comprises a conveying mechanism, and a preheating furnace, a tempering furnace and a quenching furnace which are sequentially arranged on the right side of the conveying mechanism, wherein gate mechanisms are fixedly connected to the left sides of the preheating furnace, the tempering furnace and the quenching furnace, and a deviation rectifying mechanism is fixedly connected between the top of a rack of the conveying mechanism and the left side of the left gate mechanism. This controllable atmosphere of guipure continuous furnace, through at the material loading in-process, add the mechanism of rectifying and rectify a deviation, can keep the position of work piece to be in the centre of being positive, and then can avoid blockking up at the thermal treatment equipment entry, or the uneven problem of being heated in the processing procedure, the mechanism of rectifying simultaneously adopts the mode of both sides developments centre gripping rectifying to replace current simple and easy deflector that stews, still can avoid crooked work piece card between the deflector that stews, better effect of rectifying has been guaranteed, and then the quality after having guaranteed the normal clear and the product processing of processing.

title_en: High strength bolt wire balling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength bolt wire spheroidizing device, which comprises a furnace body, wherein the top of the furnace body is provided with a furnace cover, the bottom of the furnace body is provided with a base, one side of the furnace body is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, a motor is fixedly arranged above the mounting plate, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the top end of the rotating shaft is fixedly provided with a connecting plate, the bottom of one side of the connecting plate, which is far away from the rotating shaft, is fixedly provided with a hydraulic cylinder, the bottom of a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with an electromagnetic adsorption device, the middle part of the base is fixedly provided with a fan, an output shaft of the fan penetrates through the bottom of the furnace body and is connected with fan blades, a guide plate is also arranged in the furnace body and is positioned above the fan blades, a support plate is fixedly arranged above the guide plate, so that automatic feeding and discharging are realized, the efficiency is improved, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and the labor cost is reduced, the performance of the finished product is more stable and reliable, and the spheroidization quality is improved.

title_en: Pellet dosing unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pellet batching device which comprises a filtering bin, a blanking pipe, a mixing bin and a transmission shaft, wherein a heating layer is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the mixing bin, holes are formed in the two sides of the mixing bin, bearings are embedded in the holes, the inner walls of the two bearings are respectively and fixedly connected with the two ends of the outer wall of the transmission shaft, stirring fans are fixedly arranged on the transmission shaft in an annular array mode, the bottom end of the mixing bin is provided with a hole and is communicated and installed with the top end of the blanking pipe, the bottom end of the blanking pipe is communicated and installed with the top end of the filtering bin, and a control device body is fixedly arranged on the front face of the mixing bin through a connecting rod. The utility model solves the problems that a large amount of water vapor is stored in the mixed material, so that the pellets are difficult to form and the chemical reaction speed is reduced.

title_en: Stirring device for preparing calcium carbonate rod-shaped nano particles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stirring device for preparing calcium carbonate rodlike nano particles, which comprises a cylindrical tank body; the utility model discloses a device for the carbonization of solid particles, including the cylindricality jar body, the lateral surface lower extreme middle part of the cylindricality jar body is equipped with T type tee bend pipe, the medial surface sealing connection of T type tee bend pipe has the cylindricality sealing plug, the lower terminal surface of T type tee bend pipe is equipped with the connecting plate, the connecting plate passes through the bolt and links to each other with pneumatic telescopic link, the up end of pneumatic telescopic link and the lower terminal surface fixed connection of cylindricality sealing plug, the device, can seal the stirring to the raw materials, and stirring efficiency is high, enable carbonization time to shorten, make the particle diameter diminish, product quality has been guaranteed, the fineness improves the micron order, and guarantee the product does not anti-alkali, can let in the inside of the cylindricality jar body with protective gas nitrogen gas through the intake pipe, can blow the solid particle feeding and blow away through the gas blow pipe, the piling up of raw materials has been avoided, reaction efficiency is improved, the setting up of cylindricality sealing plug has avoided the raw materials to pile up in the inside of T type tee bend pipe.

title_en: High-purity tellurium anaerobic casting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anaerobic casting, and discloses a high-purity tellurium anaerobic casting device, which comprises: the improved air conditioner comprises a main body, the upper surface of the main body is fixedly connected with a first flange piece, the bottom of the first flange piece is fixedly connected with a fixing piece, the fixing piece is movably connected with a buckle, the upper surface of the first flange piece is movably connected with a second flange piece, the top of the second flange piece is fixedly connected with a top cover, the upper surface of the top cover is fixedly connected with a lifting lug, and one side of the lifting lug is provided with an air outlet pipe. This high-purity tellurium anaerobic casting device is through the setting of first flange spare, second flange spare, buckle, exhaust tube and outlet duct, and when using, first flange spare and the meshing of second flange spare mutually, it is fixed with it through the buckle, takes the inside cavity out through the exhaust tube again, has reached that the vacuum effect is good and be difficult for causing the product effect that the gas pocket appears, has solved among the existing equipment that the vacuum effect is poor and has caused the product problem that the gas pocket appears easily.

title_en: Steel ball surface strengthening machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel ball surface strengthening machine, and relates to the technical field of steel ball production and processing. Including a supporting seat, the top of supporting seat is fixed with the motor, the right side of motor output end is fixed with the dwang, the right side of dwang is fixed with a reinforcement section of thick bamboo, the right side of a reinforcement section of thick bamboo is provided with the apron, it has the bull stick to run through in the apron, the top of bull stick is provided with clean mechanism, clean mechanism includes the fixed plate, the bottom slidable mounting of fixed plate has first semicircle piece, the left side of first semicircle piece is fixed with the connecting plate, the top of connecting plate is fixed with clean brush, the top of clean brush and the inner wall laminating of a reinforcement section of thick bamboo, this steel ball surface strengthening machine, rotatory handle, it is rotatory to make the laminating of clean brush strengthen a section of thick bamboo inner wall through the cooperation of bull stick, fixed plate, connecting plate, first semicircle piece, second spring, clean brush rotatory drive clean brush in the time.

title_en: Hexahedron heating device of heat treatment furnace
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heating devices, and discloses a hexahedral heating device of a heat treatment furnace, which comprises a furnace body, wherein the furnace body is connected with a mounting bracket, a device main body is mounted on the mounting bracket, the appearance of the device main body is hexahedral, the cross section of the device main body is rectangular, the device main body comprises a front heating element, an upper heating element, a rear heating element, a left heating element, a right heating element, a bottom heating element, a material rest and a heating wire hanging frame, the front heating element, the upper heating element, the rear heating element, the left heating element, the right heating element and the bottom heating element are respectively matched and mounted with a high-precision thermocouple, a heating wire is hung on the heating wire hanging frame, and the heating wire is hung and fixed on the front heating element, the upper heating element, the rear heating element, the left heating element, the right heating element and the bottom heating element through the heating wire hanging frame, the heating wire is connected with an extraction electrode, and the extraction electrode is connected with a heating power supply.

title_en: Coking strong brine is used for towards processing system of sediment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a treatment system for coking strong brine used for flushing slag, which comprises a cooling tower, wherein the upper end of the cooling tower is provided with a strong brine inlet and a flushing slag water return port, the bottom of the cooling tower is provided with a water outlet, the outer end of the water outlet is connected with a granulation tank through a flushing slag water pipe, the upper end of the granulation tank is provided with a slag iron inlet, the lower end of the granulation tank is provided with a water outlet, the outer end of the water outlet is connected with a bottom filter tank through a pipeline, the bottom filter tank is provided with a water return pipe, the water return pipe is connected to the flushing slag water return port, and the water return pipe is provided with a return pump; the utility model consumes strong brine on the premise of not increasing cost, is environment-friendly and has certain economical efficiency.

title_en: Aluminum alloy product processing and smelting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum alloy product processing and smelting device which comprises a main body frame, a negative pressure fan and an inner container, wherein the bottom end inside the main body frame is fixedly connected with the negative pressure fan, the inner container is arranged above the inside of the main body frame, an electric heating wire is wound on the outer side wall of the inner container, a gas collecting hood is arranged above the main body frame, one end of the gas collecting hood is fixedly connected with a first ventilation pipe, and an auxiliary structure is arranged inside the inner container. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the waste gas collecting structure, one end of the second vent pipe is connected with the negative pressure fan, and the other end of the second vent pipe is connected with the first vent pipe in a sliding manner, so that the gas collecting hood can generate larger negative pressure under the action of the negative pressure fan, when high-temperature harmful gas is generated by smelting in the inner container, the gas can be drawn by the negative pressure near the gas collecting hood and recovered, and various processing devices are arranged at the other end of the negative pressure fan to correspondingly process the absorbed gas, so that the collection of external heat dissipation capacity and the harmful gas is realized.

title_en: Quenching tool for aluminum profile
abstract_en: The application relates to a quenching tool for aluminum profiles, which comprises a base, wherein a plurality of support columns are symmetrically fixed on the upper surface of the base, ejector rods are symmetrically fixed at the top ends of the support columns, transmission motors are arranged at the end parts of the two ejector rods, transmission screw rods are rotatably arranged in the two ejector rods, top plates are arranged on the two transmission screw rods in a sliding manner, lifting devices are arranged in the top plates, grabbing plates are arranged at the bottom ends of the lifting devices, grabbing motors and grabbing screw rods are symmetrically arranged in the grabbing plates, sliding plates are respectively arranged on the two grabbing screw rods in a sliding manner, grabbing devices are arranged at the bottom ends of the two sliding plates, a placing plate, a heating device and a water tank are sequentially fixed on the upper surface of the base, a control box and a transmission plate are arranged on the side wall of the base, reciprocating devices are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface of the transmission plate, moving columns are arranged in the two reciprocating devices in a sliding manner, and inclined plates are arranged at the top ends of the two moving columns, the aluminum profile quenching device has the advantages of being capable of rapidly transmitting aluminum profiles and achieving stable quenching.

title_en: Movable ozone generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable ozone generator, including the ozone generator body, control panel is installed to the one end position department on the upper side of ozone generator body, the one end position department on the lower side of ozone generator body is provided with heat radiation structure, the universal wheel is installed to the bottom of ozone generator body, the top of the ozone generator body other end is provided with the push-and-pull structure, the both sides of ozone generator body all are provided with butt joint structure. The utility model discloses a form the butt joint groove between butt joint inner tube and the holding piece, when the connecting pipe butt joint was on the lateral wall of butt joint inner tube, the mouth of pipe of connecting pipe can insert the inside of butt joint groove, and be provided with protruding block rubber on the inside wall of holding piece, rotatory thread bush can control the holding piece and inwards gather together, encircle the outer wall of holding the connecting pipe, consolidate the connecting pipe and be connected of butt joint inner tube, increase the leakproofness of pipeline butt joint, realized quick butt joint to make ozone generator be convenient for the pipeline butt joint.

title_en: Annealing device for copper strip production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a copper strips production technical field, concretely relates to annealing device is used in copper strips production, which comprises a frame, install in the leading-in subassembly of frame in proper order, annealing subassembly, cooling module, and derive the subassembly, annealing subassembly includes first annealing roller and second annealing roller, first annealing roller and second annealing roller are used for the copper strips to anneal, cooling module includes the cooling water tank that is located first annealing roller below, cooling water tank is provided with the water tank deflector roll, cooling water tank is equipped with leading-in passageway and derivation passageway, leading-in passageway and derivation passageway all communicate the water tank deflector roll, first annealing roller sends the passageway into leading-in passageway, the copper strips after the derivation passageway will cool off are derived to deriving the subassembly; the utility model discloses an annealing roller, set up annealing subassembly before the copper strips calendering or in the back transmission course and be used for annealing to the copper strips, set up cooling module after annealing and cool off the copper strips, overall structure is simple, has simplified the preparation process, has promoted production efficiency.

title_en: Physical-chemical composite strengthening integrated equipment for recycled aggregate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a physical-chemical composite strengthening integrated device for recycled aggregates, which comprises a physical-chemical composite reaction device and a conveying device which are arranged on a movable vehicle plate, wherein a spiral distributor is arranged between the physical-chemical composite reaction device and the conveying device; the physical-chemical composite reaction device comprises a first frame, wherein a second frame is arranged in the first frame, microwave generators are respectively arranged on side frames at two sides of the second frame, a spraying device is arranged right above the second frame, an inclined stirring barrel is arranged in the second frame, and sieve pores, a stirring barrel feeding port and a stirring barrel feeding port which are uniformly distributed are arranged on the barrel wall of the stirring barrel. The utility model can remove cement mortar adhered to the surface of the recycled aggregate by using a composite method combining chemical strengthening and physical strengthening, reduce the water absorption of the aggregate, improve the strength of the aggregate and improve the strengthening efficiency of the aggregate.

title_en: Casting mould convenient for material injection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dies, in particular to a casting die convenient for material injection, which comprises an upper die and a lower die, wherein the sizes of the upper die and the lower die are matched with each other, an L-shaped plate is matched with an inserting plate, a limiting hole is formed in the inserting plate, a through hole is formed in the L-shaped plate, a bolt penetrating through the limiting hole and the through hole is inserted into one side of the outer part of the L-shaped plate, and the size of the bolt is matched with that of the limiting hole. According to the utility model, raw materials enter the molding cavity from the injection port, the whole molding cavity is filled with the raw materials to form a primary shape of a product under the action of gravity, and the positions of the upper die and the lower die are fixed through the connecting structure, so that the injection efficiency and the quality of a finished product are effectively improved.

title_en: Novel improved pressure chamber and sprue bush combination
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of die casting machines, and discloses a new improved combination of a pressure chamber and a sprue bush, which comprises a pressure chamber body and a front-end sprue bush of the pressure chamber, wherein the pressure chamber body and the front-end sprue bush of the pressure chamber are integrally formed, a pressure chamber flow channel is arranged in the pressure chamber body, a sprue bush flow channel port integrally transiting with the pressure chamber flow channel is arranged in the front-end sprue bush of the pressure chamber, and two groups of circulating constant temperature components are arranged in the front-end sprue bush of the pressure chamber. The reject ratio of the product can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Automatic stamping device with automatically, get work piece function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic stamping device with a function of automatically taking workpieces, which comprises a stamping component, a manipulator and a conveying component, wherein the conveying component is arranged on the side surface of the stamping component, the manipulator is arranged above the conveying component and can move into the stamping component to clamp the workpieces, the manipulator comprises a bracket fixed on the conveying component, a first slide rail fixed on the bracket and transversely arranged, and a second slide rail slidably connected on the first slide rail and transversely arranged, a third slide rail is vertically arranged on the second slide rail, a clamping jaw is fixed at the lower end of the third slide rail, the stamping component, the manipulator and the conveying component form the automatic stamping device, under the stamping of the stamping component, a slag ladle part and a workpiece part of the workpiece with a slag ladle are separated, and the workpiece is further moved to the conveying component through the clamping of the manipulator, the processing technology of automatically removing the slag ladle is completed, and the participation of manpower is reduced, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the automation is improved, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the safety is improved.

title_en: Intermediate package device for atomized copper powder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of subsequent treatment of metal recovered from etching solution, in particular to a tundish device for atomized copper powder. The utility model relates to a tundish device for atomizing copper powder, which comprises a tundish body and a slag prevention device, wherein the slag prevention device is in a spherical crown shape, the top of the slag prevention device is provided with a discharge hole, and the discharge hole penetrates through the tundish body and the slag prevention device. The slag preventing device is adopted, and after the molten copper is poured, the molten copper can be accumulated between the slag preventing device and the tundish body, so that the effect of buffering the flow speed when the molten copper is just poured is achieved, and the problems that when the tundish is recycled, the impurities are not thoroughly cleaned, the molten copper impacts the discharge hole at an excessively high speed, and the production is influenced due to blockage of the tundish are avoided. The utility model is beneficial to improving the production efficiency and has the advantage of long service life.

title_en: Neodymium iron boron magnet high temperature annealing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neodymium iron boron magnet high-temperature annealing device, which relates to the technical field of neodymium iron boron magnet production and aims at solving the problems that the conventional neodymium iron boron magnet is not uniformly heated and annealed in the high-temperature annealing process and the neodymium iron boron magnet is not conveniently placed in a high-temperature annealing furnace; the receiving mechanism comprises a driving motor, a sealing cover, a heating rod, a receiving cylinder and a threaded cover. According to the neodymium iron boron magnet high-temperature annealing device, the whole storage cylinder does not need to be manually pushed into the annealing furnace, so that the neodymium iron boron magnet is more conveniently placed into the high-temperature annealing furnace, and meanwhile, the neodymium iron boron magnet in the storage cylinder can be driven to rotate, so that the neodymium iron boron magnet is more uniformly heated and annealed.

title_en: Heating equipment of gear heat treatment production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heat treatment, in particular to heating equipment of a gear heat treatment production line, wherein a base is arranged at the bottom end inside an outer shell, a heating plate is arranged at the top end of the base, a plurality of conical heating pipes are uniformly arranged at the top end of the heating plate, the outer diameter of one end, close to the heating plate, of each conical heating pipe is larger than that of one end, far away from the heating plate, of each conical heating pipe, a lifting element is arranged at the center of the top end of the outer shell and extends into the outer shell, a heating cover is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the lifting element inside the outer shell, an oxygen probe is arranged on one side of each lifting element and extends into the outer shell.

title_en: Manganese ore leaching device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of manganese ore processing, and provides a manganese ore leaching device, which comprises: a leaching tank; the filtering box is arranged in the leaching box and used for storing manganese ore, the bottom of the filtering box is connected with a hollow box, and the connecting position of the hollow box and the filtering box is a connecting part; the driving mechanism is arranged on the leaching tank and used for driving the filtering tank to rotate; the buoyancy supporting mechanism is connected with the filter box and used for supporting the filter box; the movable baffle seat is abutted against the connecting part and can move along the axis of the filter box; and the material receiving box is arranged at the bottom of the leaching box, is positioned under the filter box and is used for limiting the conical disc, thereby realizing the impurity removal work easy to operate.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant lining plate of ammonia converter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of anticorrosive materials, in particular to an ammonia converter anticorrosive lining plate, which is characterized in that: including last barrel protective structure, lower barrel anticorrosion structure and interface protective structure, go up barrel protective structure and include plywood, outer welding steel sheet and outer anticorrosive sheet, lower barrel anticorrosion structure is including packing, anticorrosive mortar and connection steel sheet, and interface protective structure is including setting up flange and the photocuring sheet on the interface. The barrel body part is welded by stacking a plurality of layers of laminates, and a plurality of layers of composite anti-corrosion structures are added, so that a deep circumferential weld is avoided, the barrel wall is thin, and the anti-corrosion and anti-leakage performance is good; the cylinder body and the cylinder seat adopt a socket structure, so that the bending strength is high; the interface is fixed through the mounting flange, seals through flange, reduces seam crossing stress, and flange's junction does not have the gasket, directly welds through dark V welding seam, and the leakproofness is good.

title_en: Lime kiln top gate plate support and lime kiln top gate plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lime kilns, in particular to a lime kiln top gate plate support and a lime kiln top gate plate. The lifting hydraulic cylinder has reasonable and compact structure and convenient use, can be arranged on a lever of the lime kiln top gate to compensate the lost length of the lifting hydraulic cylinder due to the breakage of the cylinder head, and ensures that the lifting hydraulic cylinder with the broken cylinder head can still lift the lever, so that a new lifting hydraulic cylinder is not required to be replaced, and the maintenance cost of the lime kiln top gate is reduced.

title_en: Ladle dumping and dust removing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ladle dumping and dedusting system which comprises an inclined chute and a ladle, and further comprises a one-way oil cylinder, a cover body, a side baffle, a two-way oil cylinder, a T-shaped plate, an elastic sliding lock and an exhaust fan, wherein a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the side of the ladle; side baffles are respectively fixed at the bottoms of the two ends of the cover body; the side walls of the cover body below two ends of the bidirectional oil cylinder are fixed with T-shaped plates, the bottoms of the T-shaped plates slide to form elastic sliding locks, the end parts of telescopic rods of the bidirectional oil cylinder are connected and fixed with the elastic sliding locks through steel wire ropes, and the side edges of the chute are fixed with side clamping strips matched with the elastic sliding locks for locking connection; the cover body is internal the top to be fixed with the distributor pipe, and the air intake of exhaust fan puts the hose and the distributor pipe exit linkage of the cover body through wearing, advantage: the position of the discharge port is low, the outflow drop of the molten iron is small, the flow speed is low, and impurities gradually float on the top of the liquid level in the flowing process of the molten iron, so that the molten iron and the impurities are prevented from being mixed, and the alloy quality is improved; the exhaust fan generates negative pressure to the air suction in the distribution pipe, and the smoke is sucked and exhausted, thereby protecting the environment.

title_en: Activation pretreatment equipment for preparing hydrophobic zsm-5 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an activation pretreatment device for preparing a hydrophobic zsm-5 molecular sieve, which comprises a pretreatment box, wherein the tops of two sides of the pretreatment box are respectively provided with an installation through hole, a sieving roller is rotatably connected between the two installation through holes, the bottoms of the two installation through holes are respectively and fixedly provided with an adjusting bracket, and one side of each of the two adjusting brackets is respectively provided with an adjusting chute. Low resource utilization rate, simple and convenient operation and stable and reliable work.

title_en: Light brick produced by utilizing homogeneous plate waste
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light brick produced by utilizing homogeneous plate waste in the field of light bricks, which comprises a brick body, wherein the brick body comprises a surface layer, an inner layer and a reinforcing layer, the reinforcing layer is arranged in the middle layer of the brick body, the inner layer is arranged at the top and the bottom of the reinforcing layer, the surface layer is arranged at the top and the bottom of the inner layer, a first supporting plate and a second supporting plate are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the brick body respectively, a first cavity and a second cavity are formed in the brick body, a communicating hole is formed in the bottom of the brick body, the bottom of the second cavity is communicated with the top of the communicating hole, a fixing block is fixedly connected to the top of the brick body, a clamping block is fixedly connected to one side of the brick body, a clamping groove is formed in the other side of the brick body, the surface of the brick body is smooth, the brick body is of a cuboid structure or a cube structure, the number of four fixing blocks is provided, and the fixing blocks are of the cuboid structure. The utility model solves the problems that a large amount of waste residues are generated in the production of the plate, the waste residues are not effectively utilized, and a large amount of hidden dangers are caused to the environment.

title_en: Waste water incinerator tail gas denitration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste water incinerator tail gas denitration device, including the denitration jar body, the inboard fixed mounting of denitration jar body bottom has the heat insulating layer, the division board is installed to the up end on heat insulating layer, six gaseous honeycomb ducts are evenly installed to the inboard of division board, the inboard sliding connection at heat insulating layer middle part has the transmission shaft, driving motor is installed to the upper end of transmission shaft, one side of the denitration jar body is provided with the tail gas injection pipe, the hot steam injection pipe is installed to the opposite side of the denitration jar body, the outside of transmission shaft is located the inboard of the denitration jar body and installs three stirring frame, one of them liquid water injection pipe is installed to one side of gaseous honeycomb duct, another the nitric acid discharge pipe is installed to one side of gaseous honeycomb duct, the gas circulation pipe is installed to the top of hot steam injection pipe. The utility model discloses a nitrogen dioxide of steam in to tail gas reacts for can fully get rid of in the circulation reaction process.

title_en: Movable quenching water tank suitable for porous extrusion bar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable quenching water tank suitable for a porous extruded bar, and belongs to the technical field of quenching of extruded bars. Including last box and lower box of mutually supporting, it is half-cylinder structure to go up the box, the box is rectangle box structure down, the left and right sides of lower box sets up semi-circular opening, it forms complete cylinder structure with lower box to go up the box, it has a plurality of rows of water spray nozzles to surround the even spaced distribution of axis of last box on the inside wall of last box, the inside of lower box is provided with the symmetrical water spray nozzle of water spray nozzle with last box equally, the water spray nozzle is used for spraying cooling medium to the rod, the bottom of lower box is provided with the outlet, the symmetrical strutting arrangement who is used for supporting the extrusion rod that is provided with of lower box at last box both ends, strutting arrangement can realize the regulation of height when supporting the extrusion rod. The device can improve the yield of products.

title_en: Aluminum bar pouring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aluminum bar pouring system, which comprises a pouring device, a lifting device and a clamping mechanism, wherein the pouring device comprises a pouring head, a lifting device and a clamping mechanism; the pouring device is fixedly arranged below the lifting device, the movable end of the lifting device is fixedly connected with the clamping mechanism to drive the clamping mechanism to move in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction, the clamping mechanism is provided with a plurality of clamping cavities capable of being folded or unfolded, when the clamping cavities are folded, the aluminum bar can be clamped by the clamping cavities, and when the clamping cavities are unfolded, the clamping cavities are separated from the aluminum bar. Compared with the prior art, the aluminum bar pouring system provided by the utility model is additionally provided with the lifting device and the clamping mechanism on the basis of the existing pouring device. When needing to carry out the unloading, the staff only needs to grasp the one end of aluminium bar through fixture, and rethread hoisting accessory takes the aluminium bar whole out to remove to one side, alright accomplish the unloading, whole process automation degree is higher, more convenient.

title_en: Convenient fastening's antithetical couplet row casting sand box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of casting, in particular to a conveniently fastened row casting sand box. The sand box comprises a box body, a box cover and a pair of fastening strips, wherein the box body is provided with a casting cavity, a hoisting part is arranged at the upper end of the box body, a gap is reserved between the two sides of the hoisting part and the box body, the two ends of the fastening strips are located in the gap, and the non-end parts of the fastening strips are provided with adjusting parts corresponding to the casting cavity. Through the fastening strip of adjustable fastening degree, make the molding sand in the box compressed tightly respectively to avoided the difference of the fastening degree that different molding sand weight leads to, reduced the filling precision of molding sand, can guarantee the quality of product simultaneously, consequently this sand box has simple structure, simple to operate's beneficial effect.

title_en: Nickel-chromium alloy continuous casting device capable of realizing rapid demoulding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nickel-chromium alloy continuous casting device capable of realizing rapid demoulding, which comprises a continuous casting machine which is horizontally arranged, wherein a plurality of ingot casting mould components are arranged on a conveying chain of the continuous casting machine, a rapid demoulding device matched with the ingot casting mould components is arranged at one side of the continuous casting machine, and when the continuous casting machine runs, the rapid demoulding device enables ingots in the ingot casting mould components to be loosened or generate a loosening trend; the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the automatic demolding device is simple in structure, firstly, the ingot casting mold assembly is designed into a split sliding structure, secondly, the quick demolding device matched with the ingot casting mold assembly is designed, the advancing power of a continuous casting machine is ingeniously utilized, the sliding bottom plate is enabled to move, the ingot casting bottom and the mold bottom are prevented from being adhered, automatic demolding can be achieved, the working efficiency is effectively improved, the degree of automation is high, and the automatic demolding device is worthy of being popularized and used in a large range.

title_en: Drill bit cooling device of tapping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drill bit cooling device of a tapping machine, which comprises a connecting piece, wherein a rotating piece is rotatably arranged below the connecting piece, a supporting plate is arranged below the rotating piece, a control piece is arranged on the supporting plate, an adjusting piece is rotatably arranged below the supporting plate, a sliding piece is slidably arranged on the adjusting piece, a drill bit rod is arranged on the sliding piece, and a first telescopic cylinder is arranged on the adjusting piece; be equipped with inlet channel on the supporting shoe, be equipped with inlet channel on the supporting shoe, inlet channel passes through the connecting hole intercommunication with inlet channel, and the intercommunication is equipped with the blow down tank on the connecting hole, and the below intercommunication of blow down tank is equipped with the atomizing nozzle of array distribution. The cooling device has the capability of rapidly cooling the drill bit by spraying atomized water, reduces the damage rate of the drill bit when the drill bit continuously opens into the furnace, prolongs the service life and has good cooling effect; the cooling device has the function of adjusting the inclination of the opening, so that molten metal in the furnace can flow out conveniently, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Self-sealing feeding and exhausting device of gypsum steam drying calcining kiln
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-sealing feeding and exhausting device of a gypsum steam drying and calcining kiln, which comprises a self-sealing feeder, a water vapor channel, a heating sleeve, an air distribution pipe, an adjusting valve and a tail gas exhaust pipe, wherein the self-sealing feeder consists of a transmission device, a tubular spiral shell and a spiral belt conveying section, the outside of the spiral belt conveying section is provided with a U-shaped shell, an opening at the upper part of the U-shaped shell is communicated with the water vapor channel, and a spiral shaft and a spiral belt connected with the spiral shaft are arranged in the U-shaped shell; be equipped with the striker plate in the steam passageway, the striker plate links to each other with the U type casing of spiral shell area transport section, and the heating jacket lower part is equipped with hot-blast import, and heating jacket upper portion is equipped with the air distribution pipe, and the air distribution pipe communicates with tail gas exhaust pipe, is equipped with the governing valve on the air distribution pipe, tail gas exhaust pipe and steam passageway intercommunication. The hot air is converged into the tail gas exhaust pipe through the air distribution pipe and the regulating valve to improve the temperature of the tail gas, the tail gas is prevented from being condensed, and the problem of water vapor discharge of a feeder of a kiln head feeding system of a steam drying calcining kiln is well solved.

title_en: Adjustable powder laser processing nozzle and laser metal powder processing device thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of and discloses an adjustable powder laser processing nozzle, which comprises an aligning base, wherein a fixed hole is arranged in the aligning base, and a horizontal adjusting mechanism is arranged on the aligning base in the circumferential direction of the fixed hole; the aligning seat is adjustably fixed on the fixing hole through a horizontal adjusting mechanism, and a vertical adjusting mechanism is arranged on the peripheral surface of the aligning seat extending out of the fixing hole; and the ring seat is internally provided with a laser processing assembly, one end of the ring seat facing the aligning seat is provided with a guide groove matched with the vertical adjusting mechanism, and the ring seat is adjustably fixed on the aligning seat through the vertical adjusting mechanism. Through the setting of horizontal adjustment mechanism and vertical adjustment mechanism, make the nozzle have the ability of adjusting position in horizontal direction and vertical direction, satisfied the use of a nozzle adaptation multiple scene, reduced the use cost of nozzle moreover, reduced the time of changing the nozzle, improved the efficiency of laser metal powder processing.

title_en: Liquid distribution device for preparing hydrogen by hydrolyzing sodium borohydride solution
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth liquid device for sodium borohydride solution hydrolysis hydrogen manufacturing, including the hydrogen manufacturing box, vertically establish a plurality of groups cloth liquid unit in the hydrogen manufacturing box, every group cloth liquid unit all includes the annular flushing unit that from top to bottom interval set up in proper order, annular cloth liquid unit and catalyst unit, annular flushing unit is located the outside flushing tank of hydrogen manufacturing box through sparge water inlet pipe way intercommunication, annular cloth liquid unit is located the outside sodium borohydride solution storage tank of hydrogen manufacturing box through sodium borohydride solution inlet pipe way intercommunication, hydrogen manufacturing box and sodium borohydride solution storage tank intercommunication. The utility model overcomes reaction is unstable and insufficient problem when current hydrogen manufacturing installation of hydrolysising obtains large-traffic hydrogen, has improved stability, homogeneity, the suitability of cloth liquid, makes the reaction more rapidly and abundant, has the significance to the abundant reaction of hydrogen manufacturing of hydrolysising, and safe in utilization, the hydrogen yield is big, and hydrogen purity is high, obviously improves the production efficiency of entire system, is fit for the industrialization and uses widely.

title_en: Casting ladle slag removing device
abstract_en: A casting ladle slag removing device comprises an operation platform, a slag receiving platform and a casting ladle platform, wherein the three platforms are sequentially arranged from left to right; the bottom of the casting ladle platform is connected with a casting ladle supporting structure; a scum collecting bin is arranged on the scum receiving platform, and the scum collecting bin is of a box-shaped structure with an open top surface; the operating platform comprises a personnel standing platform and a slag-raking rod supporting mechanism, and the slag-raking rod supporting mechanism is positioned on the right side of the personnel standing platform; the slag-raking rod supporting mechanism comprises a door-shaped frame, a slag-raking rod placing platform and a slag-raking rod supporting roller; the slag removing rod placing platform is connected to the left side of the portal frame, and the slag removing rod supporting roller is installed on the slag removing rod placing platform; after the casting ladle supporting structure is provided with the casting ladle, the height of the upper edge of the casting ladle is higher than that of the top surface of the scum collecting bin; the height of the upper edge of the slag removing rod supporting roller is higher than that of the upper edge of the casting ladle. The slag removing device is convenient to use, can complete one-time slag removing operation before molten iron is poured, and is beneficial to improving the quality of castings.

title_en: Device for preparing nitrogen oxide by thermal decomposition
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermal decomposition preparation nitrogen oxide device belongs to chemical industry equipment technical field. The device comprises a decomposer tank body, wherein a nitric acid inlet pipe and an electric heating rod surrounding the nitric acid inlet pipe are inserted into the top of the tank body; a nitrogen oxide outlet pipe extends from one side of the top; the lower end of the nitric acid inlet pipe is provided with an atomizing nozzle positioned at the upper part in the tank body, the lower part of the tank body is provided with at least one layer of sieve plate, and the bottom of the tank body extends out of a waste outlet pipe; one side of the tank body is communicated with a vertical liquid level meter pipe through an upper communicating pipe and a lower communicating pipe. Because the electric heating rods around the atomizing spray head and the electric heating furnace at the periphery of the decomposer are matched with each other, the temperature control precision can be ensured to be +/-1 ℃, and the requirement of constant temperature required in the pyrolysis reaction process is met; meanwhile, the acid liquor is sprayed into the heating rod and the decomposer by the atomizing nozzle in the form of micro liquid drops, so that the thermal decomposition efficiency can be obviously improved.

title_en: Top die guide pillar positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a top mould guide pillar location technical field, and disclose a top mould guide pillar location structure, it is poor to have solved present top mould guide pillar positioning effect, the installation difficulty, and bolt fracture influences the outward appearance, the poor problem of finished product rate, it includes guide pillar, reducing post, positioning base, fixed orifices and connecting bolt, the guide pillar lower extreme is connected with the reducing post, and notch has been seted up to guide pillar upper portion one side, and the notch upper end is seted up flutedly, and reducing post lower extreme is connected with positioning base, and positioning base upper end four corners has all been seted up the fixed orifices, and the fixed orifices internal connection has connecting bolt, the utility model discloses, the guide pillar is fixed through 4 positioning fastening bolts, has stopped the guide pillar because of the screw looseness problem of rotation, guarantees that the square groove position at guide pillar top is fixed controlled, has promoted the installation effectiveness and the accuracy of mould; effectively improve guide pillar atress intensity, the mould assembly security is higher, has stopped the appearance problem that the bolt broke and leads to, has reduced the process production abnormity.

title_en: Alloy ingot refining and slagging-off device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal smelting, in particular to an alloy ingot refining and slag removing device; the slag raking device comprises a movable base, slag raking rods and slag raking plates, wherein lifting frames and fixing frames are respectively arranged at two ends of the upper surface of the movable base, hinged seats are respectively arranged at the upper ends of the lifting frames and the fixing frames, a first guide sleeve is rotatably connected in each hinged seat, the slag raking rods are arranged between the two first guide sleeves, the end parts, close to the lifting frames, of the slag raking rods are connected with first handle pieces, the end parts, close to the fixing frames, of the slag raking rods are connected with the slag raking plates, and manual assemblies for driving the lifting frames to ascend are arranged on the movable base; the slag raking device is simple in structure, the defect that floating slag cannot be effectively raked out due to the fact that floating impurities are skimmed to two sides when the existing slag raking device is horizontally pushed into the hearth is effectively overcome, and the using effect is excellent.

title_en: Split type barrel-type slag dragging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slag device is dragged for to split type cartridge type belongs to metallurgical industry molten iron and drags for sediment equipment technical field, it is big mainly to have solved the current slag instrument of dragging for the iron loss rate when dragging for the sediment, drag for the problem of sediment inefficiency, including the hoisting cable suspension device who is located the top, hoist and hang the device below and be connected with and drag for the sediment ware, drag for the sediment ware and include outer barrel and set up the movable bobbin base under outer barrel, the bottom is provided with the shrouding on the outer barrel, the movable bobbin base is the toper structure, encircle to be provided with down the shrouding in the outside of movable bobbin base simultaneously, it corresponds the cooperation with lower shrouding to go up the shrouding, the top intermediate position at the bottom of the movable bobbin base is connected with the lift peg, the top of lift peg is provided with rings, still be provided with the cutting ferrule between lift peg and the outer barrel, the device still is provided with unloads the sediment device. The device has the advantages of simple manufacture, low input cost, small occupied area of equipment, high slag removal efficiency, less iron content in slag removal and great reduction of iron loss rate.

title_en: Strong-stability vertical tank ozone generation chamber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a strong vertical tank ozone generating chamber of stability, including the reaction chamber, top one side of reaction chamber is provided with air compressor, air compressor's output fixedly connected with ozone generating pipe, the one end that ozone generating pipe kept away from air compressor runs through the reaction chamber and extends to the outside of reaction chamber, ozone generating pipe is the heliciform around locating the inner wall of reaction chamber, the top center department of reaction chamber rotates and is connected with the hollow tube, the inside of hollow tube is provided with the first three-way pipe, the surface of the first three-way pipe rotates and is connected with the gear box, the gear box with reaction chamber fixed connection, the inside of gear box is provided with the reversal mechanism that makes hollow tube and first three-way pipe counter-rotate; through the setting of mechanism of intaking, in the device's use, improved the radiating effect of ozone generating pipe, be favorable to the production of ozone, and then improved the output and the concentration of ozone.

title_en: Rubber for preparing oiler rubber sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an oiler gum cover technical field just discloses a rubber for preparing oiler gum cover, which comprises a substrate, the top of substrate is provided with the enhancement layer, the cavity layer has been seted up to the inside of enhancement layer, the inside of cavity layer is provided with the tensile layer, the enhancement layer top is provided with the buffer layer, first dashpot, second dashpot, third dashpot have been seted up to the inside of buffer layer, the top and the anti-corrosion coating bottom fixed connection of buffer layer. title_en: Heating furnace roller way bearing seat cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating furnace roller way bearing frame cooling device, including setting up the stifle on the roller way bearing frame, the outside contaction nature of stifle is provided with the water tank that supplies cooling water circulation, sets up on the water tank and can realize that cooling water gets into, the water supply connector and the water connectors that flow on the upper portion from the lower part of water tank. Through the mode, to advance, go out behind the water swivel simultaneously intercommunication to the circulating water pipe network in the factory, cooling water can get into from the lower part of water tank, flow out from the upper portion of water tank again after waiting to be fully full of the water tank, flow back to the circulating water pipe network again, thereby the cyclic utilization of in-factory cooling water has been realized, water use has not only been practiced thrift, a great deal of shortcoming of splash formula cooling system in the past has been avoided, and along with the circulation flow of cooling water in the water tank, a large amount of heats in stifle department have in time been taken away, effectively reduce the bearing frame temperature, isolated high temperature radiation, guarantee that bearing lubrication function is normal, improve the operating stability of the regional roll table of furnace gate and guarantee that the production organization goes on smoothly.

title_en: Large casting deburring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-scale foundry goods burring system, including vertical cylinder, foundry goods body to and locate support, the rotating electrical machines on the bottom plate, be equipped with vertical splint on the vertical cylinder, be equipped with controller, screw rod on the support, be equipped with vertical brush on the screw rod, shake the dish, be equipped with the mount pad on the rotating electrical machines, be equipped with the fixed plate on the mount pad, fix a position the spiral shell round pin, be equipped with first cylinder, second cylinder on the fixed plate, be equipped with first motor on the first cylinder, be equipped with horizontal brush on the first motor, be equipped with the second motor on the second cylinder, be equipped with horizontal splint on the second motor. title_en: Heat treatment device for aluminum alloy welding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heat treatment device technical field specifically is a heat treatment device is used in aluminum alloy welding, including the board, the spout has been seted up to the upper surface symmetry of board, and the motor is installed to the one end symmetry of board, and the lead screw is installed to the output of motor, and positive and negative screw thread has been seted up to the surface symmetry of lead screw, and the lead screw runs through the inside that sets up at the spout, and the surface symmetry cover of two sets of lead screws is equipped with the locating plate, and the board is kept away from the one end of motor and is installed the end platform, and the last surface mounting of end platform has the cylinder, and the fixed plate is installed to the output of cylinder, the last surface mounting electric telescopic handle of fixed plate. title_en: Precoated sand mulling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a precoated sand mulling system, which comprises a mulling machine, wherein the mulling machine comprises a mulling barrel, a barrel cover which is detachably arranged above the mulling barrel, and a stirring mechanism which is arranged on the barrel cover; the liquid pipes are arranged on the periphery of the sand mulling barrel, and a plurality of holes are formed in the circumferential direction of the side wall of the sand mulling barrel corresponding to the positions of the liquid pipes; feeding hoppers are arranged on two sides of the cylinder cover, the lower ends of the feeding hoppers are long-strip-shaped and extend into the sand mixing cylinder, guide plates which are obliquely arranged are detachably arranged on two sides in the sand mixing cylinder, and the feeding hoppers correspond to the guide plates vertically; the barrel cover middle part sets up rabbling mechanism, rabbling mechanism include agitator motor, (mixing) shaft and stirring vane and stirring rack bar, agitator motor is connected with the agitator shaft, and bolted connection is a plurality of on the (mixing) shaft stirring vane, (mixing) shaft lower extreme bolted connection stirring rack bar. title_en: Efficient casting machine capable of realizing batch processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency casting machine capable of being processed in batches, which comprises: a compression molding mechanism; the compression molding mechanism comprises a base arranged on the ground, the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a clamping plate, the output end of the first telescopic cylinder is fixedly connected with a pushing block, one side of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a first motor, and the peripheral side face of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a stop block. The utility model provides a high-efficiency casting machine capable of being processed in batches, which is characterized in that a cross rod is driven to rotate by a third motor, the cross rod drives a shovel block to rotate in a sandbox by a push rod, silica sand in the sandbox can be stirred, silica sand on the inner wall of the sandbox can also be scraped, the flow rate of the silica sand can be controlled by the rotation of a baffle, when the silica sand flows between two groups of clamping plates from a feed opening, a foam mold is placed between the two groups of clamping plates, when the silica sand flows fully, the silica sand is extruded by a push block and a stop block, so that the silica sand is extruded into blocks, the push block pushes a silica sand block mold rightwards, and the silica sand block mold moves to the upper end of a conveying mechanism.

title_en: Tilting gravity casting die of copper water tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tilting gravity casting die of a copper water tank, which comprises a pouring cup, an upper die and a lower die, wherein the pouring cup is arranged on one side of the lower die; the lower die comprises a lower die body, a lower die cavity is formed in the lower die body, a lower die cavity boss is arranged in the lower die cavity, and the pouring cup is communicated with the lower die cavity through at least one runner; the upper die boss is matched with the lower die cavity, and the upper die and the lower die are buckled together up and down. The tilting gravity casting die for producing the copper water tank has the advantages of bottom pouring and top pouring, the molten metal flows stably in the cavity, the flow speed of the molten metal is much smaller than that of the conventional gravity casting during pouring, the temperature gradient distribution of the molten metal is more reasonable, and the feeding of the molten metal is facilitated.

title_en: Anti-blocking desktop 3D printer printing spray head
