abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-blocking desktop 3D printer printing nozzle, and relates to the field of 3D printers. This prevent desktop 3D printer of jam prints shower nozzle, including the body, the inboard fixedly connected with protective housing of body, body below fixedly connected with passageway, passageway below fixedly connected with shower nozzle, the inboard fixedly connected with one-level telescopic link of body. This prevent desktop 3D printer of jam prints shower nozzle, drive the gear rotation through starting rotating electrical machines, the gear engagement drives rack board and slides downwards, the rack board drives second grade telescopic link and slides downwards along the baffle, second grade telescopic link drives solid axle and top platform and slides downwards, top platform is pushing up the motion of residual material, until residual material contact cutting blade and by cutting material cutting, later by placing the piece clearance shower nozzle, the effect of printing the inside residual material of shower nozzle can't be effectively cleared up has been reached, the problem that the shower nozzle was blockked up because of the unable clearance shower nozzle of simple structure has been solved to the printing shower nozzle.

title_en: Water-cooling device for quenching automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water cooling device for quenching automobile parts, which relates to the technical field of automobile part quenching and comprises a base and a pressing groove, wherein the upper end of the outer side of the base is fixedly connected with a box body, the upper end of the outer side of the box body is fixedly connected with a top plate, the two ends of the inner side of the top plate are provided with first sliding rails, one end of the outer side of a first sliding block is provided with a first telescopic rod, the lower end of the outer side of a second telescopic rod is provided with a connecting plate, one end of the outer side of a motor is rotationally connected with a threaded rod, the lower end of the outer side of the second sliding block is fixedly connected with a clamping plate, the lower end of the third telescopic rod is in telescopic connection with a pressing plate, and the pressing groove is arranged in the middle of the inner side of the base. Compared with the existing water cooling device for quenching common automobile parts, the water cooling device for quenching automobile parts enables the clamping plates to clamp and move the plate springs, saves the time for operators to take and place manually, and prevents high-temperature hot air from burning operators.

title_en: Recycling device for filter residues in silicon-manganese alloy production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a recycling device of filter residues in the production of silicon-manganese alloy, which comprises a stirring assembly, wherein the stirring assembly comprises a cylinder body, a first feeding pipe, a second feeding pipe, a first motor, a stirring shaft and a stirring blade plate; the upper surface of the cylinder body is communicated with a first feeding pipe and a second feeding pipe, and a first motor is arranged on the upper surface of the cylinder body; and a drying component is arranged at the bottom of the stirring component. According to the utility model, the electric furnace filter residues and the binder are respectively added into the cylinder through the feeding pipe, the stirring is fully carried out through the stirring shaft, so that the materials are uniform, the filter residues are molded and dried through the drying component, the dust-shaped filter residues are processed into large-particle silicon-manganese ores and recycled as silicon-manganese alloy production raw materials, the pollution of the filter residues to the environment is avoided, the waste of resources is reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, meanwhile, the filter residues are treated in a closed manner in the recycling process, and the influence on the health of workers caused by the dust-shaped filter residues entering the air is prevented.

title_en: Hydrogen processing apparatus is used in caustic soda production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen treatment device for caustic soda production, which relates to the technical field of caustic soda production and adopts the following scheme: including purifying the structure, purifying the top activity joint of structure has dry construction, purifying the structure including purifying the box, purifying the inner wall fixed mounting of box and having first baffle and second baffle, the outside fixed mounting of first baffle has the water tank, after hydrogen is through immersive water purification, the impurity that again loops through a plurality of filter screens can contain in the hydrogen can more abundant absorption and filtration, finally make the hydrogen that gets into dry construction purer, the drier in the drying structure of the retooling deposits the board and can carry out multistage drying to the hydrogen after purifying for the water content in the hydrogen is lower, but filter screen and drier deposit the board of plug style simultaneously can be taken out from the device inside after periodic use and clear up or change, thereby further improved the device to the treatment effect of hydrogen.

title_en: Tooth-shaped water jacket of reduction furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tooth-shaped water jacket of a reducing furnace, and belongs to the technical field of reducing furnaces. The inner lining refractory brick wall mainly comprises a water jacket and embedded teeth, wherein the embedded teeth are uniformly and fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the water jacket, the embedded teeth are rectangular teeth, mounting grooves matched with the embedded teeth are cut on the inner lining refractory bricks, the embedded teeth are embedded into the mounting grooves, and the inner lining refractory bricks and the embedded teeth are embedded and piled to form the inner lining refractory brick wall; through setting up profile of tooth at the water jacket inboard and inlay the dress tooth, inside lining firebrick and inlay the dress tooth and pile up, can stably support inside lining firebrick, improve the adhesion of inside lining firebrick and water jacket, effectively reduce or avoid inside lining firebrick blocking to drop or collapse phenomenon, extension inside lining firebrick life, extension inside lining firebrick replacement cycle, improvement production efficiency.

title_en: Copper wire production heat treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a copper wire production heat treatment device, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is internally provided with the following components in sequence from a wire inlet to a wire outlet: first cavity, second cavity, third cavity are equipped with electric heating pipe in the first cavity, and the inner wall laminating of second cavity has the heat preservation cotton, has set gradually from top to bottom in the third cavity: the cooling device comprises an upper cavity, a middle cavity provided with a heat dissipation hole, and a lower cavity provided with an infusion pump, wherein the upper cavity is filled with a cooling liquid with a preset volume, an electric two-way valve communicated with the upper cavity is fixedly arranged in the middle cavity, a first valve of the electric two-way valve is communicated with a cooling pipe which is arranged in a winding way, a second valve of the electric two-way valve is communicated with the infusion pipe, the cooling pipe is communicated with the other end of the cooling pipe and the lower cavity, and the infusion pipe is communicated with the cooling pipe. This practicality provides copper wire production heat treatment device, can carry out the cold circulation to the coolant liquid in the upper chamber and trade, need not to consume a large amount of coolant liquid, and not only the cooling effect is good, and with low costs.

title_en: Atomizing equipment is used in alloy powder production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses atomizing equipment for producing alloy powder, which comprises an alloy powder storage tank and an atomizing mechanism arranged at the top of the alloy powder storage tank, wherein the atomizing mechanism comprises an air duct and a centrifugal atomizing crucible rotationally connected with the top of the air duct, an impeller is rotationally connected inside the air duct, the top of a central shaft of the impeller is fixedly connected with the bottom of the centrifugal atomizing crucible, and one side of the air duct is fixedly communicated with a compression cold air pipe; the utility model relates to the technical field of alloy powder production, and discloses a centrifugal atomizing crucible with inclined side walls. This atomizing equipment is used in alloy powder production utilizes the compression air that blows in to provide centrifugal atomizing crucible's driving force through setting up the impeller in the dryer, realizes its centrifugal atomizing's effect, and compression air can follow centrifugal atomizing crucible edge blowout simultaneously, carries out the cooling shaping to the alloy solution that has thrown out into fog droplet, has reduced equipment cost, still can avoid unseparated powder cooling adhesion's problem in advance.

title_en: Multistage mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides multistage mixing heat exchange type drying and calcining equipment, and relates to the technical field of gypsum calcination. The multistage mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining equipment comprises a calcining system, wherein the calcining system comprises a mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining machine and a high-temperature flue gas heat exchange chamber, a kiln body is arranged in the mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining machine, a heat exchange pipe network and a heat exchange central pipe are arranged in the kiln body, the high-temperature flue gas or high-temperature tail gas carries out three-stage indirect heat exchange with the dihydrate gypsum raw materials fed into the mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining machine through a part of cylinders, a heat exchange pipeline and the like, the low-temperature flue gas after heat exchange is purified through a flue gas dust collector and then is fed into the mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining machine body through a hot air inlet again, and the low-temperature flue gas is directly contacted with gypsum to carry out direct heat exchange, so that the purposes of rapid heating, drying and dehydration of the dihydrate gypsum raw materials fed into the mixed heat exchange type drying and calcining machine are achieved.

title_en: Dust collection device for sand mold filling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust collection device for sand mold filling, which comprises a bin body, wherein a workbench is arranged in the bin body, and consists of a plurality of turning plates capable of synchronously rotating and arranged side by side without gaps; the first driving assembly is used for driving each turning plate to synchronously rotate so as to turn over upwards and downwards; and the collecting box is arranged at the lower side of the turning plate and is used for receiving the falling dust when the turning plate turns over. The sand mould filling machine can be used for placing sand moulds to fill sand, the compacted and smoothed excessive sand falls on the upper side of the working table, then the filled sand mould is firstly taken away, the excessive dust and sand is remained on the upper surface of the working table, the driving assembly is started to drive the turning plates to synchronously turn up and down, and then the dust and sand can be sent into the collecting box to be collected.

title_en: Coke oven gas hydrogen production device for improving hydrogen yield
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydrogen production equipment, in particular to a coke oven gas hydrogen production device for improving hydrogen yield, which is characterized by comprising the following technical scheme: the device comprises a coke oven gas cleaning unit, a plurality of pipelines, a coke oven gas pressure increasing unit, a coke oven gas pre-separation unit, a coke oven gas alternating pressure separation unit, a hydrogen buffer unit, a desorption gas pressure increasing unit, a desorption gas decomposition unit, a desorption decomposition gas cooling unit, a desorption decomposition gas conversion unit and a desorption decomposition conversion gas cooling unit. The utility model has the advantages of improving the hydrogen generation efficiency and improving the hydrogen quality.

title_en: Rack casting system for green sand casting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a frame pouring system for green sand casting, belonging to the field of frame pouring. The pouring device comprises a template body, wherein a pouring cup is arranged on the template body, a horizontal pouring gate is arranged at the bottom of the pouring cup, three vertical pouring gates are arranged below the horizontal pouring gate, and feeding heads and a module casting are arranged on the vertical pouring gates. The utility model solves the problems of light weight and low yield of the existing product, the metal liquid is poured into the horizontal pouring gate through the pouring cup and enters each feeding head through the vertical pouring gate, the feeding heads adopt bottom pouring to fill and feed the module castings, the total number of the module castings is fifteen, and the fifteen module castings are staggered and discharged, so that a row of module castings is added on the basis of the original twelve, and the purpose of improving the weight of the single form is achieved; the productivity of the casting production line is fully utilized, so that the production efficiency is improved, and the large-scale production is facilitated.

title_en: Aluminum liquid degassing and filtering device for cast-rolled aluminum plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum liquid degassing and filtering device for cast-rolling aluminum plates, which comprises an aluminum liquid tank, wherein a filtering chamber is arranged on the aluminum liquid tank, a filtering screen is arranged at the liquid outlet end of the filtering chamber, a slag discharging opening corresponding to the filtering screen is arranged on the inner wall of the filtering chamber, a first electric push rod corresponding to the slag discharging opening is arranged on the filtering chamber, and the telescopic end of the first electric push rod extends into the filtering chamber and is provided with a hydraulic cylinder. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: can be convenient for observe the liquid level of filtering indoor aluminium liquid through setting up the observation window, the pneumatic cylinder drives the position that the dregs removing shovel goes up and down and can adjust the dregs removing shovel to make the dregs removing shovel clear up the dross on the aluminium liquid accurately, effectively improve the slagging-off effect to the aluminium liquid, guarantee aluminium plate's cast rolling quality, set up air pump and gas-supply pipe and carry gas to the filter chamber through the venthole, can effectively bring aluminium liquid inside hydrogen and impurity to the surface of aluminium liquid, effectively improve equipment's edulcoration exhaust efficiency.

title_en: Wear-resistant steel ball heat treatment mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear-resistant steel ball heat treatment mechanism, which relates to the technical field of steel ball heat treatment and aims to solve the problems that a cooling device used in the cooling step in the existing steel ball heat treatment drives an internal spiral structure to rotate through a roller, a stop lever is used for stopping the steel ball to move and rise in the spiral structure, the steel ball has certain flexibility after being heated and is easy to be extruded and deformed by the stop lever, and after cooling, the steel ball is hardened to influence the final product of the steel ball, and meanwhile, cooling water flows out from the lower part of the roller, so that the steel ball cannot be immersed into water for cooling and is not uniform. A water tank is arranged below the treatment cooler; the water tank is arranged in the water tank, a screw conveying mechanism is arranged in the water tank, the screw conveying mechanism is in threaded connection with the water tank through a connecting column and a bolt, and screw conveying rollers are arranged on two sides of the screw conveying mechanism; and the rolling conveyor belt is arranged at the rear end above the spiral conveying mechanism.

title_en: Local heat treatment device for special-shaped welding joint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a local heat treatment device of a special-shaped welding joint, which comprises a main heating unit and an auxiliary heating unit, wherein the main heating unit comprises an intermediate frequency induction heater, the intermediate frequency induction heater is set to provide a first heating temperature and comprises a main heat-insulating part and an electromagnetic induction coil, the main heat-insulating part is used for being coated outside a welding line and a new connecting pipe, and the electromagnetic induction coil is wound on the main heat-insulating part; the auxiliary heating unit comprises a flexible ceramic resistance heater which is set to provide a second heating temperature and is used for being coated on the tee shell. The utility model can effectively supplement the heat dissipated in the area during heat treatment, overcomes the defect of poor heating effect caused by insufficient turns of the electromagnetic induction coil, ensures that the welding seam can reach the set high-temperature tempering temperature during heat treatment, avoids the condition of overtemperature of base materials at two sides, and can effectively ensure the heat treatment effect; high heating efficiency, high heating speed and uniform heating.

title_en: Metal casting die
abstract_en: The utility model provides a metal casting die-casting die, which relates to the die-casting die field, and comprises: the static mold and the movable mold are of rectangular structures, two strip-shaped fixing plates are symmetrically welded at the left side and the right side of the bottom of the static mold, and the static mold is locked and fixed on the operation platform through the two strip-shaped fixing plates; the center of the top end of the movable die is provided with a mounting disc with a circular structure, and the mounting disc is fixedly connected with a piston rod of the hydraulic driving device through locking by a screw; the right side of the middle position of the top end of the static mold is welded with a vertical supported molten metal filling pipe, and a liquid outlet at the bottom of the molten metal filling pipe is communicated with a mold cavity in the movable mold.

title_en: Core shooting machine is used in processing of accurate wear-resisting agricultural machinery accessory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precise abrasion-resistant core shooter for processing agricultural machine accessories, which relates to the technical field of core shooters and comprises a support base, wherein the middle part of the top end of the support base is fixedly connected with a mounting main body, both sides of the middle part of the top end of the support base are fixedly connected with equidistant fixing plates, one side of each fixing plate is fixedly connected with a hydraulic pump, one side of the top of the support base is fixedly connected with an L-shaped plate, the middle part of one side of the top of the support base is fixedly connected with a third motor, and the hydraulic pump is arranged.

title_en: Surface shot peening strengthening device for metal parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of metal part processing and discloses a surface shot peening strengthening device for metal parts, which comprises a guide rail, wherein a shot peening strengthening box is arranged at the upper end of the guide rail, the shot peening strengthening box comprises a box body arranged in the middle of the upper end of the guide rail, a bearing filter plate is arranged at the inner side of the box body, the lower end of the bearing filter plate in the box body is in an inverted cone funnel shape, a box door is arranged at the front of the box body, material tanks are arranged at two sides of the box body, a part clamping assembly is arranged in the material tanks, the part clamping assembly comprises a first bearing seat arranged on the box body, a plurality of shot peening heads are arranged in the box body, and part adjusting assemblies are arranged at two sides of the box body on the guide rail; according to the utility model, through the cooperation of the part clamping assembly, the part adjusting assembly and the shot blasting head, the shot blasting head strengthens the movement of the rotating edge, so that the surface strengthening effect of a single part can be achieved without adjustment.

title_en: Energy-saving broken slag recovery device for production of low-carbon ferrochrome for interlocking industry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving slag recycling device for producing low-carbon ferrochrome for interlocking industry, wherein one side of the top end of a shell is provided with a connecting pipe, one side of the upper end of the connecting pipe is connected with a condensing pipe, the upper side of one end of the condensing pipe, which is close to the connecting pipe, is provided with a water inlet, the lower side of one end of the condensing pipe, which is far away from the water inlet, is provided with a water outlet, one end of the condensing pipe, which is far away from the connecting pipe, is provided with a condensate outlet, and two ends of the inner part of the shell are connected with rollers through bearings, and the energy-saving slag recycling device has the following advantages: the first gear of cooperation through driving motor rotates, the second gear rotates, the gear ring can drive the cylinder and rotate to this is convenient for cool off in leading-in cylinder of outer slag, carries the condenser pipe through the water inlet with the cooling water in the outside water tank through the water pump, gets into inside the shell from the delivery port department again, makes water smoke get into in the condenser pipe become liquid and discharges to collecting device from the condensate outlet, not only can avoid the fog to distribute extravagant. And the spreading of water mist in the air can be avoided.

title_en: Metal material quenching device for compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal material quenching device for a compressor, which comprises a slideway and a skip, wherein the slideway comprises an upper slideway and a lower supporting seat, the slideway is used as a passage from a heating furnace to a cooling device, the lower supporting seat is used for raising the upper slideway, one end of the upper slideway, which is close to the cooling device, is inclined downwards, one end, which is close to the cooling device, is a low point, the inclined arrangement is convenient for the skip to slide into the cooling device when the skip is close to the cooling device, the skip is splice welded and formed and can be arranged on the slideway, the skip comprises a material box, in the actual use process, the quenched metal material is placed in the material box, the skip moves on the slideway, the metal material in the material box enters the cooling device to finish cooling, and the technical scheme is used for quenching processing of the metal material, so that the time from the heating furnace to the cooling device can be effectively shortened.

title_en: Aluminum profile aging furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum profile aging furnace which comprises a furnace body, a baffle door, a water storage tank, an exhaust pipe and a cleaning assembly, wherein a groove is formed in the inner wall of the furnace body, the baffle door is rotatably connected with the furnace body through a bearing, the water storage tank is arranged at the front end of the furnace body, a drain pipe is arranged on the right side of the water storage tank, the exhaust pipe is arranged on the left side of the furnace body, and the cleaning assembly comprises a water pipe, a connecting pipe, a plurality of first spray heads and a plurality of second spray heads, wherein the water pipe is arranged on the inner wall of the furnace body, the connecting pipe is arranged on the left side of the water pipe, and the first spray heads are arranged on the water pipe. The cleaning component provided by the utility model can be connected with a tap water pipe, tap water after connection can be conveyed to the first spray head and the second spray head through the water pipe, water sprayed by the first spray head can flush the top part in the furnace body, and water sprayed by the second spray head can flush the side wall and the bottom part in the furnace body so as to clean, and sewage after cleaning can flow into the water storage tank through the groove under the action of gravity and is discharged through the sewage discharge pipe so as to intensively treat sewage.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant chute heat-insulating cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-temperature-resistant chute heat-insulating cover, which comprises a lining arranged above a chute, wherein a high-temperature-resistant heat-insulating composite layer is arranged on the upper surface of the lining, a stainless steel net layer is arranged on the upper surface of the high-temperature-resistant heat-insulating composite layer, the lining, the high-temperature-resistant heat-insulating composite layer and the stainless steel net layer are combined to form the chute cover, a hasp is further arranged on the chute cover, and adjacent chute covers are connected through the hasp. The heat-insulating cover integrates high temperature resistance, heat preservation and portability, not only meets the field working condition, but also reduces the difficulty for operators, and in addition, the heat-insulating cover has good air tightness, can be buckled and connected with each other, reduces gaps, and can also effectively reduce the escape of smoke.

title_en: Core setting clamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sand core clamping, and discloses a core setting clamp which solves the problems that in the casting production process, sand cores are required to be placed at designated positions, manual driving is required to be used for core setting, the operation is complex and the efficiency is low. The utility model provides a group core setting anchor clamps, includes fixed establishment and the stop gear of setting in the fixed establishment below, and stop gear is provided with two sets of, fixed establishment includes the fixed plate, fixed plate upper end fixedly connected with mounting panel, fixed plate lower extreme fixedly connected with inserted bar, and the inserted bar below is provided with fixed subassembly, through the setting of inserted bar, fixed subassembly, gag lever post subassembly and holding down plate, has realized the purpose of fixed psammitolite, has solved in casting production process, needs put the psammitolite to appointed position, needs to adopt the manual work to use the driving to carry out the core setting, complex operation, inefficiency's problem.

title_en: Mould for automobile front longitudinal beam inner plate convenient to demolding
abstract_en: The utility model provides a die for an automobile front longitudinal beam inner plate, which is convenient to demold. Including the base, the top of base is fixed with two support frames, and the top of support frame is fixed with first support, and just is located the bottom of first support on the support frame and is fixed with the second support, the bottom of first support is fixed with first hydraulic stem, and the output of first hydraulic stem is fixed with the cope match-plate pattern, the bottom of cope match-plate pattern is provided with first mould groove, the top of second support is fixed with the second hydraulic stem, and the output of second hydraulic stem is fixed with the bed die board, the top of bed die board is provided with the second mould groove with first mould groove looks adaptation. The mold for the automobile front longitudinal beam inner plate convenient to demold solves the problems that after pouring is completed, the front longitudinal beam inner plate is not well demolded, the mold is required to be knocked and demolded manually, and the structures of the mold and the front longitudinal beam inner plate are extremely easy to damage.

title_en: Conductor casting dead head cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conductor casting riser cleaning device, which belongs to the casting field, and comprises three parts, namely a floating workbench, a conductor mounting plate and a positioning tool, wherein when a riser needs to be cleaned, after the floating workbench, the conductor mounting plate and the positioning tool are assembled, a fixing plate is fixed on the cleaning workbench, parts of a conductor casting are fixed by the positioning tool, the conductor mounting plate is grabbed by a propulsion device and pushed forward to complete cutting, in the grabbing process, the propulsion device contacts the conductor mounting plate and can generate relative displacement with the conductor mounting plate, and the conductor mounting plate drives the floating plate and the fixing plate to generate relative displacement, so that a floating spring is compressed and contracted, the flexible buffering effect is achieved, the deviation of positioning of the conductor casting is avoided, and the risk of damage to the product is reduced; the cleaning device has simple principle and structure, is convenient to disassemble, assemble and operate and has good popularization and application values.

title_en: Lost foam production device for large-piece production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lost foam production device for large-scale production, which comprises a sand storage box, wherein a sand adding mechanism is arranged below the sand storage box, the sand adding mechanism comprises a base, a support column is arranged on the base, a sand adding hopper is arranged at the top end of the support column, a plurality of groups of sand conveying structures are arranged on the sand adding hopper, the sand conveying structures are obliquely arranged downwards, a sand box is arranged below the sand conveying structures, and a switch structure is arranged on the sand adding hopper; the sand conveying structure comprises a sand conveying pipe I, one end of the sand conveying pipe I is connected with a sand adding hopper, a sand conveying pipe II is sleeved on the sand conveying pipe I, a power element for driving the sand conveying pipe II to stretch out and draw back is arranged on the sand conveying pipe I, and sand conveying machines are arranged inside the sand conveying pipe I and the sand conveying pipe II. The lost foam production device for large-piece production with the structure can solve the problem of low production efficiency of the existing lost foam production device.

title_en: Multifunctional ozone generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning equipment, in particular to a multifunctional ozone generator, which comprises a machine case and an auxiliary device, wherein the surface of the machine case is rotationally connected with a box door, the inner wall of the machine case is provided with a fan body, the inner wall of the machine case is provided with a tubular ozone generator, one side of the inner wall of the machine case, which is close to the tubular ozone generator, is provided with a pump body, the input end of the pump body is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe, the output end of the pump body is fixedly connected with a water outlet pipe, the auxiliary device is arranged in the inner wall of the machine case, and the auxiliary device comprises a gas collecting pipe.

title_en: Wet phosphoric acid comprehensive impurity removing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemical production and discloses a wet-process phosphoric acid comprehensive impurity removing device, which comprises a box body, wherein one side of the box body is communicated with a discharge pipe valve, the top of the box body is provided with a feeding mechanism, the back of the box body is bolted with a shell, the interior of the shell is rotationally connected with a reciprocating screw rod through a bearing, the surface of the reciprocating screw rod is in threaded connection with a threaded plate, the bottom end of the reciprocating screw rod is fixedly sleeved with a first motor, the front surface of the threaded plate is welded with a fixed plate, the interior of the fixed plate is rotationally connected with a rotating rod through a bearing, and the other end of the rotating rod penetrates into the interior of the box body and is provided with a stirring blade; can realize mixing effectually, make the material quick contact of different layers, improve edulcoration efficiency, can possess the shock attenuation simultaneously and fall the function of making an uproar, avoid bumping and forming noise with ground, improved surrounding operation environment, the practicality is high.

title_en: Catalyst feeding structure for ammonia decomposition hydrogen production device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ammonia decomposition, and discloses a catalyst feeding structure for an ammonia decomposition hydrogen production device, which comprises a furnace, wherein an upper cover body assembly is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the furnace, a lower cover body is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the furnace, and an air outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the left side of the upper cover body assembly. This a catalyst reinforced structure for ammonia decomposition hydrogen plant, grafting mounting structure through slot and nickel catalyst looks adaptation, can be convenient for quick installation nickel catalyst, through air vent and hole looks adaptation structure, can be convenient for gas through reinforced baffle body and nickel catalyst contact catalytic decomposition, the location when stacking of reinforced baffle subassembly can be convenient for through the grafting structure of constant head tank and reference column looks adaptation, and reach the purpose that the air vent position corresponds, and the regular installation mode that stacks, practice thrift the space in the stove courage, the threaded connection structure of external screw thread and internal thread looks adaptation is convenient for tear upper cover body subassembly and lower cover body open, be convenient for carry out reinforced and unload.

title_en: Hot galvanizing iron wire high temperature annealing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hot galvanizing iron wire high-temperature annealing device which comprises an annealing furnace shell, wherein a heating device is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the annealing furnace shell, a first sealing seat is fixedly connected to the bottom of the annealing furnace shell, a furnace seat is arranged at the bottom of the first sealing seat, a first rotary table is arranged at the bottom of the inner part of the annealing furnace shell, positioning pile modules which are uniformly distributed penetrate through the top of the first rotary table, and a first plane thrust bearing is arranged at the bottom of the first rotary table. According to the utility model, firstly, the motor is started and drives the first turntable to rotate, so that the galvanized iron wire coil revolves, the heating temperature difference caused by different temperatures of different parts in the annealing furnace shell is avoided, meanwhile, the gear can interact with the toothed ring, then the gear can conduct self-transmission, and the galvanized iron wire coil and the second turntable rotate together through the transmission of the connecting shaft and the second turntable, so that the galvanized iron wire coil is uniformly heated.

title_en: Wave-shaped salt core for piston
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of piston oscillation cooling, and discloses a wave-shaped salt core for a piston. This a wave salt core for piston, cooling effect is not ideal when the cooling oil is in vibration cooling down in order to avoid, through being provided with wave salt core, can form the unrestrained cooling oil channel of upper surface wave in piston top inside after the casting is accomplished, and the passageway inner wall sets up to the arc, is fit for liquid cooling oil and flows, and the cooperation bottom is provided with the guiding gutter simultaneously, guarantees the mobility of cooling oil, prevents that cooling oil from concentrating on several position oscillations, makes the cooling oil can evenly cool down the combustion chamber.

title_en: High-efficient steady horizontal overlap joint fish tail formula water knockout drum
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pouring systems, in particular to a high-efficiency stable horizontal lap joint fish tail type water diversion structure. The device comprises a cross runner, a first inner runner and a second inner runner which are communicated with each other respectively, wherein a fish tail shape is formed among the cross runner, the first inner runner and the second inner runner, and the first inner runner and the second inner runner are symmetrically arranged and are provided with radians. The utility model has the advantages that: according to the technical scheme, the fish tail-shaped water distribution structure is designed, so that the middle part is free of redundant space, the weight of a pouring system is reduced by at least 0.4kg, meanwhile, the runner is guaranteed to be directly connected with the ingate and is arranged in a certain radian, a gentle transition effect is achieved during circulation, the mold is quickly and stably filled, oxidizing slag generated by oxidizing molten iron and air is greatly reduced, and sand washing and scabbing at a water distribution position of horizontal lap joint are effectively prevented.

title_en: Blast furnace distributing device movable arm bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blast furnace distributors, in particular to a movable arm bracket of a blast furnace distributor, which comprises a positioning frame, a positioning plate and a bottom supporting plate: the locating rack is located the side of locating plate, the side outer wall of locating plate is provided with the collet board, the inside of locating rack is provided with high adjustment mechanism, the side of locating rack is provided with power unit, the top of locating rack is provided with sealing mechanism, the side of locating plate is provided with portable change mechanism, and this blast furnace distributing device movable arm bracket can drive rack and gear drive and then drive the sealing plate and seal the conflict hole that the passage was offered when the locating plate was down moved, can in time stop the pay-off when making to change cloth chute board through above-mentioned setting, and then does not have the material to continue to flow from the passage when having guaranteed to change, has guaranteed the security when changing, and whole practicality is better.

title_en: Low-temperature waste heat recovery device for preparing acid from sulfur or pyrite
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sulfuric acid industrial waste heat recovery, and particularly relates to a low-temperature waste heat recovery device for preparing acid from sulfur or pyrite. The utility model comprises the following steps: the sulfuric acid circulation absorption pipeline comprises: the heat recovery tower is provided with a liquid accumulation section, a high temperature section, a low temperature section and a demisting section; the circulating groove is communicated with the effusion section; the evaporator is communicated with the circulating groove; the evaporator is respectively communicated with the diluter and the deaeration water heater, wherein the diluter is communicated with the high-temperature section; the desalted water preheater is communicated with the deaerated water heater, and the desalted water preheater is communicated with the dry absorption circulation tank; the desalted water production low-pressure steam pipeline comprises: the desalted water station provides desalted water to the desalted water preheater; the deaerator is communicated with the desalted water preheater, the deaerated water at the outlet of the deaerator is divided into two paths, one path enters the deaerated water heater, and then enters the evaporator from the deaerated water heater to form low-pressure steam in the evaporator; the other path enters the diluter. The utility model can solve the technical problem that the low-temperature waste heat recovery efficiency is not high enough in the existing sulfuric acid production process.

title_en: Strip steel pressing device and broadband patenting system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a strip steel pressing device and a broadband patenting system, which comprises: the lifting driving mechanism and the pressing executing mechanism; the lifting driving mechanism is provided with the pressing executing mechanism and drives the pressing executing mechanism to move, and the pressing executing mechanism is pressed on the strip steel. The structure that the sinking roller is added to the edge of the lower pressing plate is adopted, so that the problem that the strip steel is damaged and the quality of the strip steel is affected when the strip steel is pressed into lead liquid by the lower pressing plate is solved.

title_en: Polymerized phosphate production system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polymerized phosphate production system, and relates to the technical field of polymerized phosphate preparation; comprises a first polymerization tank, a second polymerization tank, a feed pipe, a first discharge pipe, a second discharge pipe, a steam pipe and a condensate pipe; the first polymerization tank comprises a first polymerization tank body, a first stirring device and a first heating pipeline; the second polymerization tank comprises a second polymerization tank body, a second stirring device and a second heating pipeline; one end of the feeding pipe is communicated with the material, and the other end of the feeding pipe is communicated with the bottom of the first polymerization tank body; one end of the first discharging pipe is connected with the side edge of the first polymerization tank body, and the other end of the first discharging pipe is led into the bottom of the second polymerization tank body; one end of the second discharging pipe is connected with the side edge of the second polymerization tank body, and the other end of the second discharging pipe is used for discharging materials; the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the production efficiency of the product is ensured, and the production cost of the product is saved.

title_en: Positioning device for laser quenching equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laser quenching, in particular to a positioning device for laser quenching equipment, which comprises a workbench, wherein two fixing seats are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, movable seats are slidably arranged in one ends, close to each other, of the two fixing seats, the lower ends of the two movable seats are connected with a driving mechanism, the driving mechanism comprises a bidirectional screw rod, two ends of the bidirectional screw rod are rotatably arranged in an installation groove, positioning plates are arranged at one ends, close to each other, of the two movable seats, and the positioning plates comprise rotating positioning plates.

title_en: Temperature control long-life die-casting charging barrel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature control long-life die-casting charging barrel, which comprises a charging barrel body, wherein the structure is further improved on the basis of sleeving the charging barrel body and a bushing, on one hand, a cavity is formed in front of the middle peripheral wall of the charging barrel body and the bushing, an inlet is added, an outlet is connected with the outside, liquid for heating or cooling and the like can be introduced according to requirements, temperature control adjustment is realized, a charging nozzle is added at a charging inlet of the charging barrel body, a jogged fixing mode is adopted, a fastener is matched with a limit groove on a convex edge for locking, the charging nozzle and the bushing are consistent in material quality as required, such as ceramic type, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Device for accelerating carbonization of coarse particles
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of recycled concrete equipment. An apparatus for accelerated carbonization of coarse particles is disclosed, comprising: the liquid container is internally provided with a soaking area positioned below and a blowing area positioned above; the aggregate container is arranged in the liquid container and communicated with the liquid container, and is switched to the blowing area for receiving air after being soaked in the soaking area; the air supply device is matched and communicated with the natural air outlet end and the air blowing area; the controller is used for controlling the aggregate container to be switched and the air feeder to be opened and closed; the aggregate container comprises: the lifting leakage table is matched with the inner wall of the liquid container and is limited to slide in the liquid container, and aggregate is placed on the top surface of the lifting leakage table; the lifting piece is used for driving the lifting leakage table to switch between the soaking area and the blowing area. The utility model can realize the convenient operation of the contact process of the soaked aggregate, the aggregate which is separated from the solution and separated from the solution, and the natural wind, and simultaneously improves the flow velocity of the natural wind, thereby improving the carbonization rate of the aggregate.

title_en: Quenching device for heat treatment of self-aligning roller bearing ring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quenching device for heat treatment of a self-aligning roller bearing ring, which relates to the technical field of bearing ring quenching and comprises a top plate, a movable plate, an upright post, a hanging bracket, a threaded rod, a supporting plate, a bottom plate, a base, a refrigeration cycle machine, a liquid inlet pipe, a liquid outlet pipe, a quenching tank, a filter tank, a coil, an alternating current power supply box, an electric appliance control box, a hanging rod, a hanging hook, a loop bar and a motor; the movable plate is welded with the loop bar; the motor is fixedly arranged on the upper side surface of the bottom plate through a bolt, and is connected with the threaded rod through a key; the alternating current power supply box is connected with the coil through a wire, and the alternating current power supply box is connected with the electric appliance control box through a wire; through setting up coil, alternating current power supply box, threaded rod, loop bar, motor, fly leaf and stand, realized that the quenching in-process preheats to quick cooling integration and automation, solved bearing ring quenching work inefficiency and from preheating to quick cooling process incoherent problem.

title_en: Preparation system of ferric phosphate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a preparation system of ferric phosphate, and belongs to the technical field of recycling of chemical production byproducts. The device comprises a storage tank for disodium hydrogen phosphate, a storage tank for glycine byproduct ammonium chloride, a storage tank for hydrochloric acid, a reaction kettle, a centrifugal device I, a crystallization device I, a centrifugal device II, a dissolving device, a centrifugal device III, a storage tank for hydrogen peroxide, a storage tank for titanium pigment byproduct ferrous sulfate, an iron phosphate synthesis device, a filtering device, a washing device and an ageing kettle, wherein a continuous path for synthesizing and purifying iron phosphate is formed among the reaction kettle, the centrifugal device I, the crystallization device I, the centrifugal device II, the dissolving device, the centrifugal device III, the iron phosphate synthesis device, the filtering device, the washing device and the ageing kettle, so that the device can be well matched with the iron phosphate preparation process, realize reutilization of various byproducts, change waste into valuable and save cost; meanwhile, the discharge of waste liquid and waste residue is reduced, and the method is environment-friendly.

title_en: Fourth column type furnace cover lifting mechanism of electric arc furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fourth column type furnace cover lifting mechanism of an electric arc furnace, which belongs to the technical field of metallurgical steelmaking equipment and comprises a furnace body platform, a fourth column type furnace cover lifting mechanism of the electric arc furnace, a frame platform, a guide wheel and a furnace cover lifting mechanism, wherein the guide wheel is rotatably provided with a base, the base is fixedly arranged on the frame platform to guide the furnace cover lifting column, the furnace cover lifting mechanism is fixedly arranged in the frame platform, a connecting frame is fixedly arranged on the furnace cover lifting mechanism, a furnace cover is fixedly arranged on the connecting frame, a water-cooled type oil cylinder is adopted for the lifting oil cylinder and is positioned between the furnace cover and the furnace cover lifting column, the moment arm and the bending moment are reduced, the stress structure is optimized, the diameter of the oil cylinder can be properly reduced, the cost is reduced, the service life is prolonged, the accident rate is low, the replacement and the maintenance are convenient, the productivity is improved, meanwhile, other equipment is not arranged above the furnace cover, the operation space is relatively simple, the use and the replacement of the furnace cover is convenient.

title_en: Ultra-high purity quartz production device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ultra-high purity quartz production device which comprises an oxygen source module, a melting module, a mixing module and an atomization crystallization module, wherein the mixing module comprises a quartz Y-pipe and a ceramic nozzle, a first input port of the quartz Y-pipe is connected with the oxygen source module, a second input port of the quartz Y-pipe is connected with the melting module, and an output port of the quartz Y-pipe is provided with the ceramic nozzle; the atomization crystallization module comprises an evaporator and a condensation pipe, wherein the evaporator is used for atomizing silicon dioxide and reflecting the silicon dioxide to the condensation pipe, and the condensation pipe is used for condensing quartz particles. The ultra-high purity quartz production device takes IC-grade recovered monocrystalline silicon or polycrystalline silicon as a raw material, adopts an innovative technology, namely gas phase synthesis, overcomes passivation phenomenon in silicon oxidation reaction, and can industrially produce ultra-high purity quartz materials in large quantities; the device is further simplified, ultrasonic equipment is abandoned, new impurity generation of metals and the like is avoided, and the quality of the ultra-high purity quartz is optimized.

title_en: Full core-pulling die-casting die for die-casting brake cover
abstract_en: The full core-pulling die-casting die for the die-casting brake cover comprises a movable die and a fixed die, wherein a die cavity is formed in the joint box surface of the movable die and the fixed die, a core-pulling box is arranged on the movable die, the front end of the core-pulling box stretches into the die cavity, and a guide hole is formed in the front end of the core-pulling box; the fixed die is provided with a through hole for inserting the core pulling rod into the cavity, and the axial lead of the through hole is coaxial with the axial lead of the guide hole of the core pulling box; the installation support is arranged on the fixed die, the installation support is fixedly connected with the driving device, a driving rod of the driving device is connected with a core pulling rod for forming a mounting hole of the speed meter, the core pulling rod is a stepped shaft rod and comprises a sealing section, a forming section and a guiding section, the sealing section is a large-diameter section and is positioned at the rear end of the core pulling rod, the guiding section is a conical section and is positioned at the front end of the core pulling rod, the forming section is positioned between the sealing section and the guiding section, the guiding hole on the core pulling box is a conical hole, the guiding section for the core pulling rod is inserted, and the diameter of the sealing section is matched with the aperture of the through hole on the fixed die.

title_en: Metal casting mould easy to clamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal casting mold easy to clamp, which relates to the technical field of metal casting molds easy to clamp, and comprises a support frame, wherein the middle part of one end of the support frame is fixedly connected with a left inner nut.

title_en: Adjusting and installing device for feeding barrel and hammer head of die casting machine
abstract_en: The application discloses an adjusting and installing device for a feeding cylinder and a hammer head of a die casting machine, which comprises a core rod and a measuring assembly, wherein the core rod is installed in the feeding cylinder and is coaxially arranged with the feeding cylinder, the measuring assembly is movably installed on the core rod and is suitable for detecting coaxiality of the hammer head and the core rod, a first datum plane is arranged on the measuring assembly and is parallel to an XOY plane, a first level gauge is installed on the first datum plane, and the first level gauge is suitable for controlling levelness of the measuring assembly in the moving process along an X axis. The application aims to provide an adjusting and installing device for a feeding cylinder and a hammer head of a die casting machine, which is accurate in adjustment of the feeding cylinder and the hammer head and small in installation deviation.

title_en: Waste material cleaning device of core shooter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste cleaning device of a core shooter, which structurally comprises a base, a blanking table and a cleaning device, wherein the cleaning device is arranged on the inner side of the base, a rocker arranged on the inner side of the cleaning device is convenient for driving a sliding block to slide left and right, so that wind flow generated by a fan can swing left and right, accumulated scraps can be cleaned, a user can save time and labor during cleaning, the situation that the scraps generated by the core shooter are accumulated is avoided, the limiting groove is convenient for multi-direction insertion with a limiting plate, and the cleaning work is better assisted with the scraps.

title_en: Aluminum liquid refining degassing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum liquid refining, in particular to aluminum liquid refining degassing equipment, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, a heat preservation tank and a stirring assembly, wherein the stirring assembly comprises a supporting frame, a sliding frame, a limiting frame, a lifting block, a connecting frame, a mounting plate, stirring blades, a rotating member and a driving member, the supporting frame is fixedly connected with the fixed bottom plate, the sliding frame is in sliding connection with the supporting frame, the limiting frame is fixedly connected with the fixed bottom plate, the lifting block is in sliding connection with the limiting frame and is fixedly connected with the sliding frame, the connecting frame is fixedly connected with the sliding frame, the mounting plate is fixedly connected with the connecting frame, the stirring blades are connected with the mounting plate through the rotating member, the rotating member is arranged on the mounting plate and is connected with the stirring blades, and the driving member is arranged on the fixed bottom plate and is connected with the lifting block, so that the stirring blades move up and down to uniformly stir aluminum liquid in the heat preservation tank, and the whole stirring degassing effect of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Dialysis device for recovering waste sulfuric acid
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dialysis device for recovering waste sulfuric acid, which relates to the technical field of dialysis equipment and comprises the following components: the bipolar membrane, the bottom installation of bipolar membrane is connected with the collection box, the sliding tray has been seted up to the inner wall of collection box, the inner wall sliding connection of sliding tray has two pistons, the one end installation of piston is connected with the baffle, the one end installation of piston is connected with the threaded rod, the one end of threaded rod has a screw section of thick bamboo through threaded connection, two the inner wall screw thread of screw section of thick bamboo is opposite direction. According to the utility model, the two baffles are matched with each other through the threaded cylinder, the threaded rod, the piston, the conveyor belt, the optical axis and the rotating shaft, so that the two baffles are moved in opposite directions, the volume of liquid is extruded through the moving distance, the dialysis reaction time is shorter as the moving distance is longer, the practicability of the dialysis device is improved, the cost of enterprises is reduced, and more recyclable sulfuric acid water can be produced in a limited time.

title_en: Aluminum alloy liquid degassing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy smelting, and discloses aluminum alloy liquid degassing equipment, which comprises a mounting plate, a stirring unit and a nitrogen supply unit, wherein the stirring unit comprises a power piece, the power piece is mounted on the mounting plate, an output shaft of the power piece is fixedly connected with a hollow shaft, the free end of the hollow shaft penetrates through the mounting plate and is rotationally connected with the mounting plate, the free end of the hollow shaft is fixedly connected with a stirring disc, a nitrogen containing cavity is arranged in the stirring disc, the hollow shaft is communicated with the nitrogen containing cavity, a plurality of diversion channels communicated with the nitrogen containing cavity are arranged on the stirring disc, the diversion channels incline towards the opposite rotating direction of the stirring disc, a flow blocking plate is fixedly connected on the mounting plate on the same side of the stirring disc, the flow blocking plate is obliquely arranged along the radial direction of the stirring disc, and the nitrogen supply unit is used for supplying nitrogen to the hollow shaft. According to the technical scheme, the gas in the aluminum alloy liquid can be effectively discharged, the air holes are prevented from being generated in the casting, the strength of the aluminum casting is effectively improved, and the leakage risk of products is reduced.

title_en: Tool bit hot pressing mechanism of annular mould frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool bit hot-pressing mechanism of an annular die frame, which comprises a frame, wherein a top plate is arranged at the top of the frame, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged in the middle of the top end of the top plate in a penetrating manner, a lifting seat is arranged at the bottom of the top plate, and an upper die holder is arranged at the bottom of the lifting seat. Through being provided with the protection component at the edge at frame top, protect the processing position when tool bit hot pressing through protection frame and front end backplate when using, with prevent that staff maloperation from taking place the incident, and can be convenient for carry out real-time accuse to hot pressing course of working through first observation window and second observation window, and operating workman's accessible handle push-and-pull front end backplate is in order to open it, conveniently get and put the tool bit, simultaneously lift slider is along with in prescribing a limit to the spout lift slip in order to stabilize the front end backplate, thereby effectually improved tool bit hot pressing mechanism's safety protection performance, and do not influence tool bit hot pressing and get the blowing operation, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Die assembly for notebook die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of die assemblies and discloses a die assembly for a notebook die, which comprises a plurality of first brackets and a fixed plate, wherein the upper sides of the first brackets are fixedly connected with a workbench fixedly connected with the lower side of the fixed plate, one side of the workbench is fixedly connected with a second bracket, one side of the second bracket is fixedly connected with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a first gear, one side of the first gear is fixedly connected with a limiting rod, one side of the limiting rod is slidably connected with a threaded sleeve, one side of the threaded sleeve is sleeved with a threaded rod, one side of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with a second gear which is rotatably connected with one side of the second bracket.

title_en: Glass fiber reinforced plastic traction device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glass fibers, in particular to a glass fiber reinforced plastic traction device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two symmetrical supporting plates are fixedly connected to the upper end face of the bottom plate, the inner sides of the two supporting plates are jointly connected with two symmetrical first rotating shafts in a rotating mode, the first rotating shafts penetrate through the supporting plates, the outer walls of the first rotating shafts are fixedly connected with first rotating drums, the upper end faces of the two supporting plates are jointly connected with a top plate, the upper end face of the top plate is fixedly connected with a water tank, the lower end face of the water tank is fixedly connected with a water spraying pipe, the water spraying pipe is fixedly connected with a water spraying head, and one side of the water tank is fixedly connected with a return pipe. The utility model uses the water spray pipe and the water spray head to spray the water in the water tank onto the glass fiber, thereby achieving the functions of cleaning and water cooling, uses the water pump to pump the water collected below and return the water to the water tank above, thereby achieving the effect of circulating water cooling, solving the problem that the impurities on the glass fiber cannot be removed before, and achieving the effect of circulating water cooling, and saving time and labor.

title_en: Integrated device for producing carbon-fixing auxiliary cementing material based on two-step method
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated device for producing carbon-fixing auxiliary cementing materials based on a two-step method, and belongs to the technical field of civil engineering equipment. The device includes the shell, go up the isolation layer, lower isolation layer, a motor, the second motor, dry process stirring leaf and wet process stirring leaf, wherein, upper portion and lower part are provided with isolation layer and lower isolation layer respectively in the shell, go up isolation layer upper portion space and be the dry process carbonization chamber, go up the isolation layer and lower isolation layer between the space be the wet process carbonization chamber, the fixed first motor that is provided with in shell top, first motor output shaft has the axis of rotation, axis of rotation upper portion is provided with the air inlet, evenly be provided with a plurality of hollow dry process stirring leaf in the axis of rotation, the shell bottom is provided with a plurality of second motors, be provided with the wet process stirring leaf on the second motor output shaft. The utility model has the advantages of continuous material treatment, greatly improved solid waste treatment capacity, reduced solid waste, innocuity and reclamation, and solves the problems of solid waste treatment and recycling.

title_en: Die casting die
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of dies, and provides a die casting die, which comprises: a fixed die holder; the movable die holder is movably arranged below the fixed die holder, and a product cavity is formed between the movable die holder and the fixed die holder after the movable die holder is attached to the fixed die holder; the fixed die core block is arranged in the fixed die base and used for extending into a product shape required by the molding of the product cavity; the insert is detachably connected to the periphery of the bottom of the fixed mold core block, and a molding part and a clamping part are formed on the insert. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that through the split design of the insert and the fixed mold core block, the product can be accurately molded by the molding part, and meanwhile, the product can be timely disassembled and replaced after being worn, so that convenience is provided, meanwhile, the clamping part is movably clamped on the fixed mold core block along the inclined direction, the positioning effect is achieved on the installation of the insert, the insert is ensured to be positioned at a required position to mold the product, and the molding stability of the product is improved.

title_en: Casting mould capable of being rapidly cooled and molded
abstract_en: The application relates to a casting mould for rapid cooling forming, which comprises a base, an upper mould and a lower mould, wherein cooling water pipes are arranged in the lower mould and the upper mould, two ends of each cooling water pipe are respectively provided with a water supply pipe and a water return pipe, a cooling box communicated with the water supply pipe and the water return pipe is arranged on the base, a water supply pump is arranged on the water supply pipe, a water return pump is arranged on the water return pipe, a cooling component for cooling liquid is arranged in the cooling box, the cooling box and the cooling component are arranged for cooling the cooling liquid with increased temperature, the cooled cooling liquid flows into the cooling water pipes again, and the cooling capacity of the cooling liquid is improved. The application has the effect of improving the cooling efficiency of the parts in the forming groove.

title_en: Hydrogen peroxide purifying system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydrogen peroxide purification system, wherein a plurality of parallel pipelines are arranged on an inlet pipeline and an outlet pipeline of a container filled with resin of a hydrogen peroxide purification unit, and each pipeline is used for conveying different process media; switch valves are arranged on the plurality of parallel pipelines and used for controlling the flow of materials; the on-off valve is controlled to be opened and closed by a program, so that the flow of different materials during adsorption and desorption is realized, and the mutual channeling is prevented, thereby achieving the purposes of operating the purification unit for adsorption and desorption, and ensuring the operation safety of the process device.

title_en: Positioning tool for quenching track shoe forging of engineering machinery
abstract_en: The utility model provides a positioning tool for quenching a track shoe forging of engineering machinery, which relates to the technical field of track shoe machining and comprises the following components: the top of the mounting seat is fixedly provided with a moving assembly for clamping the track shoe; the first correcting component is movably arranged in the moving component and is used for correcting the stroke of the moving component; the second correcting component is movably arranged at the other end inside the moving component and is used for correcting the stroke of the moving component; the displacement sensor is fixedly arranged at the top of the first correcting component; the clamping assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the first correcting assembly, and the clamping assembly is also fixedly arranged at the top of the second correcting assembly. According to the utility model, simultaneous positioning and clamping of multiple sides are realized, offset is avoided, automatic clamping is realized, and scalding caused by manual operation is avoided.

title_en: Automatic clear brake disc molding back sand device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic clearance brake disc molding sand backing device, which comprises a molding machine table top, wherein a sand box is fixed on the upper part of the molding machine table top through a fixing column; the sand box is filled with back sand; two support columns are arranged on the side face of the sand box in parallel; the lower parts of the two support columns are provided with walking devices; and a back sand cleaning plate is arranged between the walking devices. The back sand in the production process of the brake disc can be automatically removed, and the effects of not affecting the molding strength and having high production efficiency are achieved.

title_en: Energy-saving type nitrate tank system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving type nitrating pot system, which relates to the technical field of marinating and hydration, and comprises the following components: the device comprises an evaporator, an atmospheric condenser, a hot water tank and a hot water pump, wherein the output end of the hot water pump is connected with a tubular heat exchanger, the tubular heat exchanger is connected with a nitrate melting tank through a pipeline, the nitrate melting tank is connected with a buffer tank through a pipeline, and the buffer tank is connected with a nitrate cleaning tank through a pipeline; the nitrate dissolving tank is used for dissolving mirabilite of raw materials and clarifying the nitrate water, and the buffer tank is used for buffering the clear nitrate water overflowed from the nitrate dissolving tank. According to the utility model, the temperature of the clear water is raised by using the secondary steam of the clear water absorption evaporator, and the temperature of the clear water is further raised by using condensed water, so that the energy-saving effect is achieved. In addition, the amount of secondary steam evaporated by the evaporator and the water component in the clear water entering the evaporator can generate a water balance, namely, the evaporated water is used for dissolving mirabilite, and the water for dissolving the mirabilite is not required to be increased.

title_en: Turbocharger shell wax mould processing mould
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of turbochargers, in particular to a turbocharger shell wax mould processing mould, which aims at the problems that the existing turbocharger shell wax mould processing mould cannot clamp and block a side drawing block arranged on a lower mould base and possibly slide down during pouring, and provides a scheme which comprises a base, wherein a fixing assembly is arranged on the base, two upright posts are symmetrically and fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the base, the tops of the two upright posts are fixedly connected with the same top plate, the top of the top plate is fixedly provided with a push rod motor, the push rod motor is provided with a clamping assembly, the base is abutted against a lower die holder, the top of the lower die holder is abutted against an upper die holder, the lower die holder is connected with a plurality of side check blocks in a sliding manner, the side check blocks are fixedly connected with handles, and the lower die holder is provided with a blocking assembly.

title_en: Glass bead coloring processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of coloring equipment, and particularly provides processing equipment for coloring glass beads. The utility model comprises a coloring component, a drying component and a linkage component, wherein the coloring component comprises a coloring bin, a top cover is arranged at the top end of the coloring bin, an air heater is arranged at the top end of the drying bin, the bottom end of the drying bin is fixedly connected to the right side of the top end of a base, the linkage component comprises a mounting seat which is fixedly connected to the rear ends of the coloring bin and the drying bin, and a second servo motor is arranged at the right end of the mounting seat.

title_en: Casting ladle convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a casting ladle convenient to clean, which comprises a casting ladle body, a casting nozzle, a lining plate component and a transmission component, wherein the casting nozzle is fixedly arranged on the casting ladle body, the casting nozzle is communicated with the casting ladle body, the lining plate component is inserted into the casting nozzle, and the transmission component is arranged on the casting ladle body and is used for driving the casting ladle body to rotate.

title_en: Circulation through type powder electroplating or electrolytic impurity removing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating through type powder electroplating or electrolytic impurity removing device, which relates to the technical field of electrochemistry and comprises a first electrode chamber, a second electrode chamber and a pump, wherein the first electrode chamber, the second electrode chamber and the pump are communicated to form a circulating liquid path, a material inlet is formed in the top of the circulating liquid path, a material receiving opening capable of opening and closing is formed in the bottom of the circulating liquid path, a screen plate and an electrode plate which are made of conductor materials are respectively arranged in the first electrode chamber and the second electrode chamber, the screen plate and the electrode plate are respectively used as metal electrodes, and are electrically communicated with an electrode of a power supply. The utility model uses the net plate arranged in the first electrode chamber and the circulating flow of the fluid in the circulating liquid path to keep the impact of the powder material on the net plate and realize the repeated circulating flow of the powder material at the net plate so as to strengthen the collision between powder particles and the metal electrode, increase the contact area between the powder particles and the metal electrode, improve the electroplating or electrolytic quality and the electroplating or electrolytic efficiency, and the electrolyte or the electroplating liquid separated by the powder recovery device can be recycled, thereby being beneficial to the control of the electrolysis or the electroplating cost.

title_en: New energy automobile heating core vacuum die casting die
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile part production, in particular to a vacuum die casting die for a heating core body of a new energy automobile, which comprises a fixed die, a movable die and a heating core body, wherein a feed inlet is arranged on the movable die, a cavity is arranged at the center of the top of the fixed die, guide sleeves are vertically arranged at four corners of the top of the fixed die, a partition plate is fixed in the cavity, shaping assemblies are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the fixed die, and a vacuumizing assembly is arranged in the fixed die.

title_en: Sand box for lost foam casting processing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of casting sand boxes, in particular to a sand box for lost foam casting processing, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein side wall plates are hinged to the upper ends of the side walls of the fixed frame, fixed U grooves are fixedly arranged at the upper ends of the side wall plates, locking holes are formed in the side walls of the two ends of the fixed U grooves, the sand box also comprises right-angle plug plates, when the side wall plates are rotated to be perpendicular to the end faces of the fixed frame, the adjacent fixed U grooves are connected through the right-angle plug plates, locking pins are slidably arranged in the right-angle plug plates, the locking pins are arranged at positions of the right-angle plug plates corresponding to the locking holes, and inclined planes are arranged at the two sides of the side wall plates and the two ends of the fixed U grooves. The movable side wall plate is arranged to rotate outwards, so that the side wall plate is separated from the molding sand position, and the lost foam is convenient to demold after casting is finished.

title_en: Drum brake drum casting forming device
