abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drum brake drum casting forming device, which relates to the technical field of brake drum casting forming and comprises a base, wherein a main body of the base is of a rectangular structure, and the drum brake drum casting forming device is provided with a guide shaft capable of rotating around a movable seat, so that when the drum brake drum casting forming device is used, a motor arranged on the outer side of a mounting plate can be started to rotationally drive a bevel gear, the current seat body and a die can be rapidly turned over and driven through meshing transmission among the bevel gears, and a circulating pipe, a liquid inlet pipe and a liquid outlet pipe are arranged between the base and a bottom plate, so that when cooling is required after the die is formed, cooling liquid can be efficiently circulated through the circulating pipe, and when the drum brake drum casting forming device is used, the rapid cooling operation of the die can be realized, and the purpose of assisting in demoulding is further achieved.

title_en: Spray set for ingot casting
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spraying device for cast ingots, which relates to the technical field of production and processing equipment and comprises an adjusting component, wherein the adjusting component comprises a base, a lifting base body is slidably inserted on the base, a spraying component is slidably inserted on the lifting base body, the spraying component comprises a spraying tee joint, the spraying tee joint can change positions relative to the base in the vertical direction, and the spraying tee joint and the base can also change positions in the horizontal direction. The utility model has the advantages that the adjusting component is arranged, the vertical adjustment of the spray tee joint and the position adjustment on the horizontal plane can be realized, so that the distance and the range of the spray metal ingot can be adjusted according to the actual demand, and the impact force of the spray water body on the metal ingot can be adjusted.

title_en: Atomizing powder spraying device for enriching noble metal from lean and impure materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an atomization powder spraying device for enriching noble metals from lean and impure materials, which comprises a support, wherein a material containing bag is arranged on the support, one side of the lower part of the material containing bag is provided with an ultrasonic generator, one side of the upper part of the material containing bag is provided with a feed inlet, the top of the material containing bag is provided with a smoke exhaust pipe, the upper part of the smoke exhaust pipe is connected with a reducing bent pipe through a regulating valve, the outer side of the reducing bent pipe is horizontally provided with a cold air pipe, the reducing bent pipe is connected with a smoke guide pipe through a flange, the outlet of the smoke guide pipe is connected with an ash collecting bin, the smoke guide pipe enters the ash collecting bin along the tangential direction of the side wall of one side of the ash collecting bin, the bottom of the ash collecting bin is provided with an ash discharging valve, the top of the smoke exhaust pipe is connected with an induced draft fan, the outlet of the draft fan is connected with a bag type dust collector through a gate valve, and the bottom of the bag type dust collector is provided with a fine material collector. The utility model utilizes ultrasonic technology to finely atomize molten metal, so that metal powder is more uniformly separated, the working procedures are less, the efficiency is high, the safety is high, and the closed treatment system is arranged, so that the pollution is small.

title_en: Quenching liquid filtering and cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quenching liquid filtering and cooling device which comprises a main body unit and an operation unit, wherein the main body unit comprises a quenching box and a filtering box, the quenching box is fixedly connected to the upper end face of the filtering box, the lower end of the filtering box is provided with a cooling box, the quenching box and the cooling box are jointly provided with a reflux assembly, and the operation unit comprises a rotating block, and a circular hole is formed in the side wall of the filtering box. According to the utility model, the tool is inserted into the cross groove of the rotating block, the rotating tool can drive the rotating block to rotate, the knocking head can be driven to move through the arrangement among the rotating block, the rotating rod, the rotating gear, the toothed plate and the vertical rod, when the knocking head moves downwards to be impacted on the filter screen plate, the filter screen plate can vibrate, and the filtered scraps on the filter screen plate can be discharged from the material through hole along the filter screen plate, so that the filtered scraps can be conveniently collected and treated, and the filter effect of the device is reduced by preventing the scraps from blocking the filter holes of the filter screen plate.

title_en: Atmosphere protection mechanism of heating furnace
abstract_en: The application discloses a heating furnace atmosphere protection mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of heating furnaces. The quantitative feeding mechanism mainly comprises a furnace shell, a hearth, an air inlet, an air vent pipe, a heating mechanism and a quantitative feeding mechanism, wherein the hearth is fixedly arranged in the furnace shell, the air inlet is fixedly arranged on the side face of the furnace shell, the air vent pipe is arranged at the interface end of the air inlet, the heating mechanism is arranged on the air vent pipe in a clamping mode, the quantitative feeding mechanism comprises a semi-column cover, the semi-column cover is clamped on the air vent pipe, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged in the semi-column cover, a round hole is formed in the surface of the fixing plate, and a heating pipe penetrates through the round hole. According to the atmosphere protection mechanism of the heating furnace, when inert gas is added into the heating furnace, the heating mechanism is started to heat the vent pipe, and heat is transferred to the inert gas through the vent pipe, so that the temperature field in the hearth is not affected by the inert gas with lower temperature entering the hearth and is not uniform.

title_en: Drying chamber for precision casting shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of casting and discloses a drying chamber of a precision casting shell, which comprises a workbench, table legs fixedly arranged at the bottom of the workbench, a drying assembly arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, and a sliding assembly arranged in the drying assembly, wherein the drying assembly comprises a drying chamber fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the workbench, one side of the drying chamber is provided with an air inlet, and the upper surface of the drying chamber is provided with an air outlet. When the sliding groove plate slides to a proper position, the spring rebounds to drive the sliding connection rod to slide on the inner wall of the fixed sliding groove block, meanwhile, one end of the sliding connection rod can be clamped in the groove of the sliding groove plate to fix the sliding groove plate, at the moment, the casting shell can be placed on the upper surface of the filtering pore plate, and then the sliding connection rod is pulled, so that one end of the sliding connection rod slides out of the groove of the sliding groove plate and is pushed back to the fixed connection plate, and similarly, the casting shell can be taken out after the machining is finished, so that the effect of conveniently taking and placing the casting shell is achieved.

title_en: Rotor, permanent magnet synchronous motor and die
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotor for a permanent magnet synchronous motor, which comprises a rotor frame and permanent magnets, wherein the rotor frame is constructed as a hollow cylinder, the rotor frame is provided with a plurality of spacing grooves along the circumferential direction, the rotor frame is divided into a plurality of rotor frame sub-parts by the spacing grooves, the permanent magnets are arranged in the spacing grooves, the rotor frame is cast integrally through a pouring gate, the rotor frame sub-parts are provided with pouring gate material heads corresponding to the pouring gate, the pouring gate material heads are positioned on the end face of the rotor frame, and the pouring gate material heads are closer to the outer circumference of the rotor frame than the inner circumference of the rotor frame. The utility model further relates to a permanent magnet synchronous motor comprising the rotor and to a mould for casting the rotor.

title_en: Stirring scraping device of sand mixer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sand mixers and discloses a stirring scraping device of a sand mixer, which comprises a stirring barrel, wherein three supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the stirring barrel, the supporting legs are distributed in an equilateral triangle shape, the top of the stirring barrel is fixedly connected with a top cover, the top of the top cover is fixedly connected with three feeding pipes, the three feeding pipes are respectively communicated with the inside of the stirring barrel, the center of the upper part of the top cover is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the center of the upper part of the top cover, the output shaft of the motor is rotationally connected with the top cover, the bottom end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom end of the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the center of the inner bottom wall of the stirring barrel, the outer wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with two stirring plates, the stirring plates are anticlockwise inclined along the outer wall of the rotating shaft from the top, and the centers of the two stirring plates are symmetrically distributed.

title_en: Double-injection die-casting vacuum system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-injection die casting vacuum system which comprises a vacuum pump, a die and a main negative pressure device, wherein the main negative pressure device is communicated with a cavity of the die through a first pipeline, a first valve component for controlling the opening and closing of the pipeline is arranged on the first pipeline, the die is provided with a sprue runner communicated with the cavity, the double-injection die casting vacuum system also comprises an auxiliary negative pressure device, the auxiliary negative pressure device is communicated with the sprue runner through a second pipeline, a second valve component for controlling the opening and closing of the pipeline is arranged on the second pipeline, and the vacuum pump is respectively communicated with the main negative pressure device and the auxiliary negative pressure device so as to absorb air flow in the main negative pressure device and the auxiliary negative pressure device. The utility model solves the problem of poor casting quality caused by the fact that gas in a cavity and a gate area cannot be removed in time because molten metal fills the cavity at a high speed in the double injection die casting process.

title_en: Hardware continuous casting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses hardware continuous casting equipment which comprises a bottom plate, a balancing weight, a driving assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the bottom of the balancing weight is fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, the driving assembly comprises a U-shaped frame, a rotating column, a driven gear, a driving gear and a motor, the bottom of the U-shaped frame is fixedly connected with the top of the balancing weight, the outer surface of the rotating column is rotationally connected with the inside of the U-shaped frame, one end of the rotating column is fixedly connected with the inside of the driven gear, the driven gear is meshed with the driving gear, and the inside of the driving gear is fixedly connected with a driving shaft of the motor. According to the scheme, the bottom plate, the balancing weight, the driving assembly, the melting furnace, the sensing assembly, the crystallizer, the cooling water tank and the liquid guide tank are arranged, through the structure, the melting furnace can be timely controlled to stop falling when molten metal is about to be filled, the effect of preventing the molten metal from overflowing and scalding workers is achieved, and the filtering assembly is arranged, through the structure, refractory matters in the molten metal are screened out, and the effect of enabling the quality of cast products to be higher is achieved.

title_en: Cooling device of rotary assembly of blast furnace mud gun machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a cooling device of a rotary assembly of a blast furnace mud gun machine, wherein the working end of a mounting frame and the table top of a rotary table are arranged at intervals, water pipes are vertically arranged and are arranged on the mounting frame, water outlets are formed in the inner side surfaces of the water pipes, nozzles are arranged on the water pipes and are arranged in a fan shape from top to bottom under the projection of a plumb bob, a three-way pipe is arranged between adjacent nozzles, and the output end of the three-way pipe faces one side of the nozzles. The arrangement path of the mounting frame is consistent with the outline of the table top of the mounting table, so that the first nozzle can cool the rotary table while flushing slag and fly ash on the table top of the rotary table, and the output ends of the first nozzle are arranged in a fan shape in the vertical plane, so that the first nozzle can spray at different positions and different angles of the rotary table. The first nozzles are arranged in a plurality of mode to improve the cleaning effect and the cooling efficiency of the first nozzles on the rotary table. The output end of the three-way pipe faces the first nozzle and sprays the water pipe and the mounting frame reversely so as to realize the self-cleaning function of the cooling device.

title_en: Multi-pipeline quenching equipment
abstract_en: The application provides multi-pipeline quenching equipment which comprises a quenching tank and a quenching liquid circulating system, wherein the quenching liquid circulating system comprises a circulating pump, a liquid outlet pipeline and a liquid return pipeline, the liquid outlet pipeline and the liquid return pipeline are connected with the circulating pump, the liquid outlet pipeline is provided with a liquid outlet, the liquid outlet is arranged at the bottom of the quenching tank, the liquid return pipeline is provided with a liquid inlet, the liquid inlet is arranged at the bottom of the quenching tank and is higher than the liquid outlet, the liquid outlet pipeline is provided with at least two liquid spraying pipelines which are arranged in parallel, and the liquid outlet with an upward opening is arranged on each liquid spraying pipeline. According to the scheme, the circulating pump is used for circulating the quenching liquid, so that heat of the workpiece is quickly diffused in the quenching liquid, the temperature of each part of the quenching liquid is balanced in a short time, the difference of the temperatures of the quenching liquid contacted with each part of the workpiece during quenching is reduced, and the quenching effect is improved. Solves the problems that the local temperature difference of quenching liquid is larger and the quenching effect of the workpiece is affected when the workpiece subjected to heat feeding in the prior art is quenched.

title_en: Hot aluminum ash separator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hot aluminum ash separator which comprises a pot body, wherein a feeding part, a discharging part, a smoke outlet part and a stirring part are arranged on the pot body, the stirring part comprises a stirring shaft and a driving piece, the driving piece is used for driving the stirring shaft to rotate in the pot body, a plurality of groups of vibration mixing pieces are arranged on the outer side of the stirring shaft, each vibration mixing piece comprises a driving shell and a stirring column, one end of the driving shell is arranged on the stirring shaft, the other end of the driving shell is arranged on one end of the stirring column, a plurality of stirring blocks are arranged on the outer side of the stirring column, a vibrating piece is arranged in the driving shell and is used for driving the stirring column to vibrate in the axial direction of the stirring column. The utility model can rotate and stir the materials in the pot body and can continuously vibrate and flap the materials, so that the materials in each position in the pot body can be effectively stirred when the stirring range of the materials is improved, and the separation effect of hot aluminum ash is effectively improved.

title_en: Material changing mechanism for quenching furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quenching, in particular to a material changing mechanism for a quenching furnace, which comprises a bracket, wherein a conveying mechanism is arranged in the bracket and comprises a guide block, a threaded hole and an auxiliary hole are formed in the guide block, a threaded rod is arranged in the threaded hole, a driving motor is arranged at one end of the threaded rod, and a lifting rod is arranged at the bottom of the guide block. This mechanism of reloading for quenching furnace, the cooperation through guide block and lifter is used, plays the effect of control splint height and position, plays the effect that drives the slide bar and go up and down through adding the telescopic link, uses through backup pad, connecting rod and link cooperation, plays the effect that control splint opened and shut, through using above structure, has reduced contact between manual work and the work piece, the effectual danger that reduces the work.

title_en: Organic matter removal system in alumina production process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for removing organic matters in an alumina production process, which comprises a seven-effect falling film evaporation unit, a five-stage self-evaporation unit, a circulating mother liquor tank and a filter, wherein one branch of an evaporation raw liquor feeding pipe is connected with a V-effect evaporator and sequentially enters an IV-effect evaporator, a III-effect evaporator, a II-effect evaporator and an I-effect evaporator, the other branch is connected with a VI-effect evaporator and enters a VII-effect evaporator, the discharge of the I-effect evaporator is communicated with the I-stage flash tank and is connected with the II-stage flash tank, the III-stage flash tank, the IV-stage flash tank and the V-stage flash tank, the V-stage flash tank is communicated with the circulating mother liquor tank, one branch of a VII-effect evaporator discharging pipe is communicated with the circulating mother liquor tank, the other branch is communicated with the filter, and a filtrate outlet is communicated with the circulating mother liquor tank. According to the utility model, through cross-flow evaporation from the V-effect evaporator and the VI-effect evaporator, the sodium aluminate solution is rapidly evaporated at low temperature and low pressure, and the oxalate is rapidly crystallized and separated out, so that the method has the advantages of simple flow, low investment, low operation cost and good site working environment.

title_en: Desulfurizing tower with spray set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a desulfurizing tower with a spraying device, which comprises a desulfurizing tower body, wherein all desulfurizing cavities are arranged in the desulfurizing tower body, a spraying mechanism is arranged on the inner side of each desulfurizing cavity, and an active carbon filter plate is fixedly connected on the inner side of each desulfurizing cavity and above the spraying mechanism, and the desulfurizing tower has the beneficial effects that: according to the utility model, through arranging the stirring tank, the sludge pump, the material pumping pipeline, the material conveying pipeline, the transverse plate, the lifting rope and the spraying pipeline, lime, limestone powder and water are put into the stirring tank together to be mixed into slurry, then the sludge pump is started to pump out the slurry by using the material pumping pipeline positioned in the stirring tank, the slurry is directly conveyed into the spraying pipeline by using the material conveying pipeline, the slurry is sprayed out by a spraying mechanism in the spraying pipeline, and sulfur dioxide in the flue gas, calcium hydroxide in the slurry and air blown from the lower part of the tower are subjected to oxidation reaction to generate calcium sulfate.

title_en: Aging device for aluminum profile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum profile processing, in particular to an aluminum profile aging device which comprises a furnace body, a fixing frame, mounting frames, door plates and air outlet pipes, wherein first conveying mechanisms for conveying aluminum profiles are arranged at two ends of the furnace body, second conveying mechanisms are arranged in the furnace body, the two mounting frames are respectively connected with two ends of the furnace body, the door plates are respectively provided with two mounting frames and are in sliding connection with the mounting frames, lifting mechanisms which are used for adjusting the height of the door plates are respectively arranged on the two mounting frames, the fixing frame is arranged on one first conveying mechanism, the fixing frame is provided with mounting holes, the air outlet pipes are connected with the mounting holes, and a plurality of cooling fans are arranged in the mounting holes. According to the utility model, the first conveying mechanism sequentially conveys a plurality of groups of aluminum profiles into the furnace body, and when the aluminum profiles are heated in the furnace body, the cooling fan on the first conveying mechanism cools the aluminum profiles subjected to the previous group of treatment, so that the ageing treatment efficiency is improved and the use is convenient.

title_en: Acid-base balancing equipment after pickling for producing high-purity silicon
abstract_en: The utility model discloses acid-alkali balance equipment after acid washing for high-purity silicon production, which comprises a washing box, wherein four support columns which are symmetrically distributed in pairs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the washing box, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the washing box, a conical screen plate is movably arranged on the mounting frame, a stirring mechanism for stirring raw materials and a washing mechanism for washing the raw materials are arranged on the washing box, and the stirring mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a motor, a stirring shaft and two stirring rods. The utility model has reasonable design and good practicability, can continuously stir the raw materials when the raw materials are washed, increases the contact probability of the raw materials and clear water, improves the cleaning efficiency and the cleaning quality of the raw materials, washes the raw materials from a plurality of angles, further improves the cleaning quality of the raw materials, can air-dry the raw materials after cleaning the raw materials, improves the drying efficiency of the raw materials, and further improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Blast furnace slag double-flow gate valve switching device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of waste heat recovery, in particular to a blast furnace slag double-channel gate valve switching device. The blast furnace is provided with a plurality of tapping holes, blast furnace slag runners correspondingly connected with each tapping hole, wherein the blast furnace slag runners are communicated through a communicating slag runner, a tundish, wherein the tundish is connected with the blast furnace slag runners, and a plurality of flashboard mechanisms are arranged on the blast furnace slag runners and the communicating slag runners. The device utilizes a plurality of blast furnace slag runners to convey blast furnace slag to the tundish, and the tundish blast furnace slag jet granulating device is used for granulating the blast furnace slag, so that when one of the blast furnace slag runners is in a problem or needs maintenance, the other blast furnace slag runner can be manually or automatically switched to supply slag to the tundish, thereby ensuring that stable and reliable molten blast furnace slag can be provided for the blast furnace slag granulating device, improving the reliability of a recovery system, enabling a large amount of sensible heat energy in the blast furnace slag to be utilized, and reducing resource waste.

title_en: Aluminum profile quenching mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum profile quenching mechanism which comprises a cover body and a placing box, wherein the bottom of the cover body is provided with an installation rod fixedly connected with the cover body, the middle of the placing box is provided with a through hole corresponding to the installation rod, the placing box comprises a box body and a bottom plate, the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the box body, the bottom plate is provided with a through hole arranged in an annular array, the bottom plate is provided with an accommodating cavity, and a baffle plate rotating around the through hole is arranged in the accommodating cavity. According to the utility model, the baffle capable of being pushed is arranged on the base, so that quenching parts can be conveniently leaked to the lower part through the through hole by pushing and pulling the baffle, when the quenching device is used, the placing box is fixed on the mounting rod, aluminum parts to be quenched are placed in from one side of the placing box, after quenching is finished, the baffle is driven to move by the deflector rod, when the deflector rod moves, the baffle is retracted into the accommodating cavity, the through hole is opened, meanwhile, the pushing rod pushes one side of quenching parts into the opened through hole, and the quenching parts are taken out layer by layer, so that the quenching parts can be conveniently taken out.

title_en: Water spraying maintenance system for shallow round bin wall
abstract_en: The application discloses a water spraying maintenance system for a shallow circular bin wall, which belongs to the technical field of shallow circular bin construction and has the technical scheme that the water spraying maintenance system comprises a water tank, a conveying assembly, an outer water spraying assembly, an inner water spraying assembly and a water spraying maintenance device, wherein the conveying assembly is connected with the water tank and can convey water in the water tank, the outer water spraying assembly comprises an outer annular pipe, an outer branch pipe and an outer spray nozzle, the outer annular pipe is sleeved on the bin wall and is connected with an outer operation platform through a fixing assembly, the outer annular pipe is connected with the conveying assembly, the outer branch pipe is circumferentially arranged along the outer annular pipe, one end of the outer branch pipe is communicated with the outer annular pipe, the other end of the outer branch pipe is communicated with the outer spray nozzle, the outer spray nozzle faces the bin wall, the outer branch pipe comprises a first outer pipe and a second outer pipe, the lengths of the first outer pipe and the second outer pipe are different, the first outer pipe and the second outer pipe are staggered, the inner water spraying assembly is arranged on the inner side of the bin wall and is connected with the inner operation platform, the inner water spraying assembly is connected with the conveying assembly, and the inner water spraying assembly is time-saving and labor-saving, and the water spraying maintenance on the bin wall is uniformly sprayed and the waste of water resources is reduced.

title_en: Preparation facilities is used in silica powder production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a preparation device for producing silicon dioxide powder, which comprises a water bath main body, wherein a first placement component and a second placement component are respectively arranged on the surface of the water bath main body, a first positioning component is arranged on one side of the inner wall of a first placement frame, a second positioning component is arranged on one side of the inner wall of a second placement frame, an arc-shaped baffle is arranged at one end of the first positioning component, a rectangular baffle is arranged at one end of the second positioning component, and a first fixing component and a second fixing component are respectively arranged on the side of the first placement frame and the side of the second placement frame. According to the preparation device for producing the silicon dioxide powder, the first positioning assembly, the second positioning assembly, the arc-shaped baffle plate, the rectangular baffle plate, the first fixing assembly, the second fixing assembly, the plurality of arc-shaped long plates and the plurality of rectangular long plates are respectively arranged in the first placing frame and the second placing frame, and can be used in a matched mode, so that containers with different sizes and containers with different shapes can be fixed at the same time.

title_en: Low-melting-point metal continuous evaporation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of processing of hydrogen storage metal powder, and provides low-melting-point metal continuous evaporation equipment, which comprises a vacuum smelting furnace and an evaporation chamber, wherein the vacuum smelting furnace is connected with the evaporation chamber through a flow control device, the flow control device comprises a liquid supply runner, a thermocouple and a pouring control device, the liquid supply runner is arranged in a downward inclined mode, the upper end of the liquid supply runner is connected with a crucible in the vacuum smelting furnace, the lower end of the liquid supply runner is connected with the top of the evaporation chamber, the thermocouple is arranged on the periphery of the liquid supply runner, and the pouring control device is arranged at the end part of the lower end of the liquid supply runner. The utility model effectively realizes the control of the flow rate of the molten liquid through the flow control device, realizes the accurate control of the flow rate of the molten liquid through a plurality of valves, improves the production efficiency and quality of hydrogen storage metal, and in addition, the transition bin arranged on the feeding device effectively ensures the continuous addition of raw materials in a vacuum state, thereby being convenient for continuous production.

title_en: Novel grate cooler top cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grate coolers, and discloses a novel grate cooler top cover which comprises a top cover frame, an upper temperature-resistant steel plate and a lower temperature-resistant steel plate, wherein the upper temperature-resistant steel plate is connected to the top of the top cover frame in a sliding manner, the upper temperature-resistant steel plate is distributed on the left side and the right side of the top cover frame, the lower temperature-resistant steel plate is connected to the bottom of the top cover frame in a sliding manner, the lower temperature-resistant steel plate is distributed on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the top cover frame, a connecting component is arranged on the outer wall of the top cover frame, and a stabilizing component is arranged outside the top cover frame. This novel cold quick-witted top cap of comb is through setting up bent rod one and bent rod two, slide bent rod one and bent rod two for two bent rods one and two bent rod two block into the outer wall of two upper temperature resistant steel plates and the outer wall of two lower temperature resistant steel plates respectively, through taking out the inside air of bent rod two this moment, make the inside of bent rod two produce the negative pressure, thereby accomplish the fixed to bent rod one, two upper temperature resistant steel plates and two lower temperature resistant steel plates accomplish the fixed respectively this moment.

title_en: Multiple-effect evaporation concentration system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of chemical industry, and discloses a multi-effect evaporation concentration system which comprises a deamination unit, an ammonia-containing material concentration unit, a taurine-containing material concentration unit, a gas-liquid separation unit and a steam recovery unit, wherein deamination and concentration of ammonia-containing materials are completed in the deamination unit and the ammonia-containing material concentration unit, the low-concentration taurine-containing materials are concentrated in the taurine-containing material concentration unit by taking steam generated by the deamination unit as a heat source, and ammonia in the steam is condensed in the unit, so that heat of the ammonia-containing steam can be recovered, the ammonia can also be recovered as ammonia water, and the waste of the materials is avoided. The multi-effect evaporation concentration system provided by the utility model has the advantages of simple process flow, low energy consumption, small equipment occupation area, full-automatic operation and safety and reliability.

title_en: Lime calcination system for enriching carbon dioxide
abstract_en: A lime calcination system rich in carbon dioxide is a lime shaft kiln. The lime shaft kiln is internally provided with a calcination chamber which is sequentially divided into a plurality of combustion areas connected in series from top to bottom, and fuel injection combustion mechanisms are respectively and independently arranged in the combustion areas. According to the lime calcination system for enriching carbon dioxide, provided by the utility model, the calcination chamber is sequentially divided into a plurality of combustion areas which are connected in series from top to bottom, fuel and combustion-supporting gas are introduced into the calcination chamber in a segmented manner, the concentration of CO  2  is controlled to be in a distribution mode of gradually rising from top to bottom, the inhibition effect of high-concentration CO  2  on CaCO  3  decomposition is reduced, the oxygen concentration at the upper part in the calcination chamber is improved, and the burnout rate and the utilization rate of fuel are improved.

title_en: Casting die for sealing high-temperature water chamber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a casting die for a sealed high-temperature water chamber, which comprises a fixed frame, an upper die and a lower die, wherein four supporting legs are fixedly connected to the fixed frame, the upper die is installed at the top end of the fixed frame through a lifting mechanism, the lower die is positioned in the fixed frame, the front end and the rear end of the lower die are fixedly connected with rotating shafts, the two rotating shafts are rotatably connected with the fixed frame, the front end of the rotating shaft positioned at the front side is fixedly connected with a square column, the rear side of the outside of the square column is fixedly connected with a first fixed ring, the outside of the square column is slidably provided with a pipe fitting, the rear end of the pipe fitting is fixedly connected with a second fixed ring, a plurality of extension springs are fixedly connected between the first fixed ring and the second fixed ring, and two fixed plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the second fixed ring, so that the cast water chamber is prevented from being taken down by hands, and hand damage caused by long-time contact of a water chamber of a worker is avoided, and the practicality and safety of the use of the water chamber are improved.

title_en: Heatable casting launder structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heatable casting launder structure, and belongs to the technical field of metal casting equipment. Comprises an inner groove body and an outer groove body attached to the outer part of the inner groove body; the bottom of the outer groove body is slidably connected with a heat conducting plate through a plurality of groups of trapezoidal guide strips, a plurality of groups of heating units are embedded in one side of the heat conducting plate, which faces the outer groove body, gaps are reserved between the heat conducting plate and the trapezoidal guide strips, and fastening bolts which can be in threaded connection with the trapezoidal guide strips are movably arranged on the heat conducting plate in a penetrating mode; the heatable casting launder structure is simple and durable in structure, and can independently detach the heating unit, thereby being convenient to replace and maintain.

title_en: High-efficient normal pressure reaction tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency normal-pressure reaction tank which comprises a tank body, wherein a liquid outlet is connected to the side surface of the upper part of the outer wall of the tank body and is used for leading out liquid reacted by the tank body, a tank cover is connected to the top of the tank body, a chlorine pipe, a liquid inlet pipe, a steam pipe, an air outlet, a compressed air pipe and a manhole are arranged on the tank cover, a guide cylinder with a semicircular section is welded on the inner wall of the tank body along the vertical direction, the chlorine pipe provides chlorine required by the reaction, the liquid inlet pipe provides ore pulp required by the reaction, the steam pipe is used for heating ore pulp and providing temperature required by the reaction, an air outlet is connected with an exhaust gas absorbing device and is used for removing waste gas generated by the reaction, the compressed air pipe is inserted into the bottom of the guide cylinder and is used for providing kinetic energy to enable the ore pulp qualified by the reaction to be discharged out of the tank body, a stirring motor is fixed in the center of the upper surface of the tank cover, the bottom of the stirring motor is connected with a stirring device, the stirring device stretches into the tank body, and the stirring device comprises a stirring shaft and stirring blade, the upper blade, the middle blade and the stirring blade are respectively provided with upper blade and lower blade.

title_en: Purifying device for crystal lattice explosive quartz sand of plasma microwave oven
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a purifying device for crystal lattice explosive quartz sand of a plasma microwave oven, which comprises a purifying cylinder, wherein the inner diameter of the purifying cylinder is gradually reduced from the middle section to two ends so as to be in a fusiform structure, the outer wall of the middle section of the purifying cylinder is provided with a material opening, the material opening is externally screwed with a sealing cover, the purifying cylinder is also wrapped with a heating body, two ends of the purifying cylinder are rotationally connected with a supporting frame, one end of the purifying cylinder is communicated with an exhaust gas output pipe through a rotary joint, the other end of the purifying cylinder is communicated with an introducing pipe through a rotary joint, a low-temperature plasma generator is arranged outside the introducing pipe, and the outer end of the introducing pipe is communicated with a plurality of single pipes through a gas input pipe. According to the utility model, the material inlet and outlet is arranged on the outer side wall of the purification barrel, so that the trouble of repeatedly disassembling and assembling the gas conveying channel during feeding is avoided, and meanwhile, the quartz sand is arranged in a fusiform shape, so that quartz sand can be automatically gathered and discharged to the material inlet under the guiding action of the inclined surface of the purification barrel, and the material inlet and outlet operation is more convenient and quicker.

title_en: Continuous annealing's wire drawing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wire drawing, in particular to continuous annealing wire drawing equipment which comprises a base, wherein a wire drawing box is arranged on the base, a heating box is arranged on the base, a contact wheel is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the heating box, the contact wheel is connected with a second control panel through an internal circuit, a water tank is arranged on the base, cooling water is arranged in the water tank, two groups of guide wheels are rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the water tank, and in the process of contacting a copper wire with the contact wheel, an electrode uniformly guides high current to a copper wire through the contact wheel, so that the copper wire is heated to an annealing temperature of 500-550 ℃, after wire drawing is completed, the copper wire is immersed in the cooling water of the water tank for annealing and cooling, the structure realizes the control of the temperature of the copper wire, realizes the continuous annealing treatment of the copper wire, improves the ductility and toughness of the copper wire, and is beneficial to improving the quality of wire drawing.

title_en: Membrane method helium and neon separation integrated process system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a membrane helium and neon separation integrated process system, which is characterized in that a raw material gas pipeline is connected with a feed inlet of a low-temperature adsorption purifier, the low-temperature adsorption purifier is used for separating raw material gas into high-purity helium and regenerated gas, a first-stage membrane separator and a second-stage membrane separator are both used for separating the regenerated gas into helium-rich permeation and neon-rich cut-off gas, a product side outlet of the low-temperature adsorption purifier is provided with a product gas pipeline, a regeneration side outlet of the low-temperature adsorption purifier is connected with a regenerated gas compressor inlet, a gas outlet of the regenerated gas compressor is connected with a feed inlet of the first-stage membrane separator, a first interception side outlet of the first-stage membrane separator is connected with a discharge gas pipeline, a first permeation side outlet of the first-stage membrane separator is connected with a feed inlet of the second-stage membrane separator, a gas outlet of the second-stage membrane separator is connected with the feed inlet of the low-temperature adsorption purifier after being connected with the raw material gas pipeline through a seventh pipeline, and a second interception side outlet of the second-stage membrane separator is connected with the first pipeline through a fifth pipeline. So as to reduce the loss rate of helium and effectively recycle high-value helium in the regenerated gas.

title_en: Quenching device for rope grooves of ring-forged pulleys
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ring-forged pulley rope grooves and discloses a ring-forged pulley rope groove quenching device which comprises a heating box and a heater, wherein an annular plate is arranged in an inner cavity of the heating box, an extrusion spring is connected to the inner wall of the annular plate and connected with a side clamping plate, a U-shaped seat is additionally arranged at the lower part of the U-shaped seat, a driven wheel is additionally arranged at the top of the driven wheel, a driving wheel is connected between the driven wheel and the driving wheel, a first driving motor is coaxially connected to the back of the driving wheel, and limiting side plates are arranged at the two sides of the second driving motor. According to the ring-rolling pulley rope groove quenching device, the side clamping plates are attached to the ring-rolling pulley rope groove through the extrusion springs, the second driving motor can drive the U-shaped seat to rotate, and the first driving motor drives the driving wheel, the driving wheel and the driven wheel, so that the annular plate is pitching. The ring-forging pulley rope groove can be driven to rotate in two directions, so that the ring-forging pulley rope groove can be heated comprehensively and uniformly.

title_en: Integral pressing forming die for hard alloy liner of high-capacity ball mill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integral compression molding die for a hard alloy liner of a high-capacity ball mill, which comprises a shell and a bottom plate, wherein the shell is a small cylindrical surface, a small conical surface, a large conical surface and a large cylindrical surface which are sequentially connected from top to bottom, the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the large cylindrical surface, the die is an assembled die and comprises a square mandrel and four internal dies attached to four sides of the square mandrel, and the external side shape of the four internal dies is matched with the shell after the four internal dies are spliced to the four sides of the square mandrel. The utility model can facilitate the installation and demoulding of the mould by combining the square mandrel with the four-piece internal mould.

title_en: Lead-tin separation vacuum furnace with clearance heating function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of lead-tin separation equipment and discloses a lead-tin separation vacuum furnace with a gap heating function, which comprises a box body, wherein an arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the bottom wall of the interior of the box body, a plurality of layers of stirring mechanisms are arranged in the box body and on the upper side wall of the arc-shaped plate, each multilayer stirring mechanism comprises a protection box, a first motor, a sleeve and two device boxes, the right side wall of the protection box is fixedly connected to the left side wall of the box body, and the outer side of the first motor is fixedly connected to the interior of the protection box. The utility model can solve the problems of incomplete separation and uneven temperature caused by the arrangement of the multilayer stirring mechanism, and finally obtained lead and tin products have unstable purity and cannot achieve the effect of complete separation, and can effectively improve the consistency of the lead and tin separation process in different batches of production by rotating the rotating rod, so that the components of the final product are more stable, and reliable quality assurance is provided for the processing and use of subsequent products.

title_en: System for continuously extracting lithium by utilizing waste electrolyte
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for continuously extracting lithium by utilizing waste electrolyte, which comprises a control center, a continuous ball milling device, cascade reaction kettles and a drying and packaging device, wherein each cascade reaction kettle comprises N cascade reaction kettles and a reaction liquid overflow groove, N is an integer greater than or equal to 3;N, each reaction kettle is sequentially hung on one common reaction liquid overflow groove, a plurality of reaction kettles are sequentially arranged from high to low, a stirring mechanism is arranged in each reaction kettle, a first reaction kettle is provided with a reaction liquid overflow pipeline, the rest reaction kettles are provided with a reaction kettle inflow pipeline and a reaction liquid overflow pipeline, the reaction kettle inflow pipeline and the reaction liquid overflow pipeline are respectively provided with a first electric control valve, a plurality of second electric control valves are arranged on the reaction liquid overflow groove, the first electric control valves and the second electric control valves are controlled by a field controller, the controller is in communication connection with the control center, and the system can realize continuous lithium extraction and is easy to realize whole process control.

title_en: Core shooter sand shooting device convenient for sand injection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand shooting device of a core shooter convenient for sand injection, which relates to the technical field of core shooters and comprises a base, wherein a filter box and a sand shooter body are fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base respectively, the filter box is communicated with the sand shooter body, a filter plate is obliquely arranged in the filter box, a plurality of vibrating motors are arranged on the bottom surface of the filter plate, and a fixing seat is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base. When the utility model is used, the vibration motor increases the filtering efficiency of the filter plate and can reduce the blockage of the filter plate, meanwhile, the filtered large cold core sand can enter the crushing mechanism through the material conveying mechanism and be crushed again into the hopper through the crushing mechanism, and the material is injected into the core shooter again, so that the labor cost and the time cost are saved, and the blockage caused by different sizes of the cold core sand when the cold core sand is conveyed by the hopper can be avoided.

title_en: Face gear pouring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a face gear pouring device, which can solve the phenomena of shrinkage cavity and shrinkage porosity in the cooling process and simultaneously solve the problem that the positions of a thick wall and a thin wall cannot be synchronously cooled; the face gear mold comprises a face gear mold, a main runner, a buffer runner, an auxiliary runner and a cross runner, wherein the main runner is arranged at the center of the face gear mold and consists of a runner port and a sprue, the sprue is of a circular channel structure with unequal diameters, the cross runner is arranged above the face gear mold, the end part of the cross runner is provided with a sprue port, the buffer runner is arranged below the face gear mold and is detachably connected with the sprue, the buffer runner is fixedly connected with one end of the auxiliary runner, the other end of the buffer runner is provided with an exhaust port, the exhaust port is communicated with the face gear mold, a riser is further arranged on the upper surface of the face gear mold, and one end of the auxiliary runner, which is connected with the sprue, is further provided with the buffer runner.

title_en: Continuous casting dummy bar head structure and dummy bar
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of metal blank production and processing equipment, and discloses a continuous casting dummy bar head structure and a dummy bar. The continuous casting dummy bar head structure dummy bar head base body and the bottom block, wherein the dummy bar head base body is of a strip shape, one end of the dummy bar head base body is a working end, the other end of the dummy bar head base body is a connecting end, a first mounting groove is formed in the peripheral side of the working end, the connecting end can be detachably connected to a bar body of the dummy bar, the bottom block is configured to be detachably connected to the working end, the bottom block and the working end can be spliced into a cylindrical structure, a second mounting groove is formed in the bottom block, the second mounting groove can be communicated with the first mounting groove to form a dummy bar groove, a dummy bar hook is detachably mounted in the dummy bar groove, and a tension leveler can be propped against the bottom block. The bottom block and the dummy bar head matrix are mutually spliced and matched, if the bottom block is crushed and deformed by the tension leveler, the operation can be continued by replacing the bottom block, the dummy bar head is not required to be integrally replaced, the production cost is greatly saved, and meanwhile, the quality of a continuous casting operation finished product is ensured.

title_en: Toothed plate high-frequency quenching device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a toothed plate high-frequency quenching device, and relates to the technical field of high-frequency quenching. The utility model comprises a water tank, wherein a plurality of water outlet pipes and water inlet pipes are respectively arranged at the bottom and the upper part of the water tank, a conveying belt is arranged at the side part of the water tank, a pneumatic clamping jaw is arranged above the conveying belt and can move in three directions, a die holder is arranged in the water tank in a lifting manner, a supporting block is connected to the bottom of the die holder and is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the water tank, a die groove with the shape corresponding to a toothed plate is arranged at the top of the die holder, induction heating equipment is arranged at the upper part of the water tank, the induction heating equipment comprises induction coils, the arrangement track of the induction coils is matched with the profile of the toothed plate, and the induction coils are positioned on the track of the vertical lifting of the die holder. The utility model improves the degree of automation of high-frequency quenching and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Wall spraying equipment is built in room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building wall spraying device which comprises a moving assembly and a spraying assembly, wherein the moving assembly comprises a supporting plate, the spraying assembly comprises a water tank, a water outlet pipe is arranged on the side wall of the water tank near the bottom, a water pump is arranged at one end of the water outlet pipe far away from the water tank, a water delivery pipe is arranged on a liquid outlet of the water pump, a communicating pipe is rotatably arranged at one end of the water delivery pipe far away from the water pump, a spraying pipe is arranged at one end of the communicating pipe far away from the water delivery pipe, and a plurality of nozzles are arranged on the side wall of the spraying pipe. The utility model is provided with the spraying component, and the water in the water tank is conveyed to the spraying pipe after being pressurized, so that the water with pressure is atomized through the nozzle and then uniformly sprayed on the wall body, the curing effect on the wall body is better, the sprayed water consumption is reduced so as to save a water source, the spraying pipe can adjust the angle according to the requirement, and the practicability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Heating quenching device for automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quenching devices, in particular to a heating quenching device for automobile parts, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a high-frequency induction heater and a cooling tank are arranged on the supporting table, an induction coil of the high-frequency induction heater horizontally extends to the middle part above the cooling tank, a moving mechanism is arranged in the cooling tank and is used for placing gear parts, a door-shaped frame is further arranged above the cooling tank on the supporting table, a clamping device is arranged on the door-shaped frame and clamps the gear parts placed by the moving mechanism into the induction coil, the quenching device is firmly clamped and uniformly heated, quenching uniformity is improved, and further service life and performance of the gear parts are prolonged.

title_en: Bromine recovery device in decabromodiphenyl ethane production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bromine recovery device in decabromodiphenyl ethane production, which comprises a distillation kettle, a condenser, a bromine water separator, an acid washing tower and a drying tower which are connected in sequence through pipelines, wherein a feed inlet of the distillation kettle is also connected with a pretreatment box through a pipeline, the pretreatment box consists of an air inlet guide cylinder, a mechanical filter cylinder and an electrostatic filter cylinder which are connected in sequence through flanges, a primary filter screen and a secondary filter screen are arranged in the mechanical filter cylinder, a bracket is arranged in the electrostatic filter cylinder, a plurality of dust collecting electrode plates are uniformly arranged on the bracket, and a plurality of corona electrode rods are arranged between the adjacent dust collecting electrode plates. According to the bromine-containing waste gas purifying device, the pretreatment box consisting of the air inlet guide cylinder, the mechanical filter cylinder and the electrostatic filter cylinder is arranged to filter and remove particles from bromine-containing waste gas before the bromine-containing waste gas enters the distillation still, so that subsequent equipment is protected, and the service life of the equipment in the whole bromine recovery system is prolonged.

title_en: Dust collector for diffusing flue gas of furnace top charging bucket of iron-smelting blast furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blast furnace top dust removal, in particular to a dust removal device for diffusing flue gas of a charging bucket of an ironmaking blast furnace top, which is characterized in that a driving motor is started, a connecting block is fixedly connected with the driving motor and rotates together with the driving motor, so as to drive a connecting sleeve and a filter screen bucket to rotate together with the connecting sleeve, because the filter screen barrel rotates constantly, the air inlet is fixed to make the filter face constantly replace, reach the purpose that flue gas was removed dust, and through taking out the filter screen barrel from the connecting block, thereby conveniently dismantle the filter screen barrel, be convenient for wash and change, improve dust removal efficiency.

title_en: Prefabricated iron component heat treatment temperature control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prefabricated iron component heat treatment temperature control device which comprises a stable underframe, wherein a rotating frame is rotationally connected to the front part and the rear part of the stable underframe, driving motors are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the upper part of the stable underframe, gears are respectively connected to the output shafts of the driving motors, gears are respectively connected to the outer sides of the middle parts of the rotating frame, adjacent gears are meshed, hydraulic cylinders are respectively arranged on the outer sides of the rotating frame, mounting frames are respectively connected to the telescopic ends of the hydraulic cylinders, a heating assembly is arranged on the left part of the stable underframe, the heating assembly comprises a first heating frame, the upper side of the left part of the stable underframe is connected with the first heating frame, and the middle part of the stable underframe is connected with a second heating frame. According to the utility model, the hydraulic cylinder and the rotating frame are matched with each other, so that the rapid positioning of components with different sizes and shapes can be satisfied, meanwhile, the rotating frame is driven by the driving motor to rotate anticlockwise, the components can be sequentially subjected to heat treatment and cooling treatment, the multi-station parallel treatment can be realized, the equipment downtime can be reduced, and the heat treatment efficiency of the components can be accelerated.

title_en: Annealing wiring structure of wire drawing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of annealing equipment, in particular to an annealing wiring structure of a wire drawing machine, which comprises a fixed frame, a connecting plate, two conveying rollers, a heating roller, two guide rollers and three connecting rollers, wherein the fixed frame can play a role of shielding, two side surfaces of the fixed frame are fixedly connected with fixed seats, the inner side surfaces of the fixed seats are fixedly connected with hydraulic rods, the connecting plate is arranged at the top of the fixed frame, and the output end of the hydraulic rods is in transmission connection with the bottom surface of the connecting plate. According to the utility model, the output end of the hydraulic rod is in transmission connection with the connecting plate, the connecting roller can be moved upwards by the hydraulic rod, a plurality of wires can be horizontally penetrated through the bottom of the connecting roller, the top of the heating roller and the top of the guiding roller, the difficulty of wire threading and winding is reduced, the wires can be conveniently and rapidly threaded and wound, the connecting roller can drive the backing plate to move, the wires can be supported and guided by the backing plate, and the wires can be conveniently and rapidly threaded and wound.

title_en: Induction quenching positioning fixture for gear disc machining
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of induction quenching, in particular to an induction quenching positioning fixture for gear disc machining. Including the locating plate, locating plate upper end center be equipped with the through-hole, locating plate upper end left and right sides is equipped with the hold-down subassembly respectively, the hold-down subassembly include support, fork frame, hold-down plate, compact heap, locating plate upper end linking bridge, the support upper end rotates and connects fork frame, fork frame other end connection compact heap, compact heap lower extreme connection compact heap. The gear disc is tightly pressed through the pressing component after being sleeved on the positioning pipe of the quenching machine tool, so that the phenomenon of shaking and shifting of the gear disc is prevented, normal operation of quenching and cooling is ensured, and the quenching quality of products is improved.

title_en: Novel hydraulic gas cylinder forging forming die
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel hydraulic gas cylinder forging forming die which comprises an insert body, an insert body and an insert groove, wherein the lower die, the middle die and the upper die are connected through a butt joint assembly, a middle rod is vertically arranged at the inner bottom of the lower die, an extension assembly is arranged on the middle rod, a pouring opening is arranged at the top of the upper die, the novel hydraulic gas cylinder forging forming die is provided with a mounting plate, the insert body, a limiting body and the insert groove, when the integral height of the die is required to be adjusted, the middle die is connected to the top of the lower die in a butt joint mode, the insert body is inserted into the insert groove formed in the limiting body, the middle die is fixed at the top of the lower die, the upper die is fixedly connected to the top of the middle die in a butt joint mode, the integral height of the die is adjusted, and workpieces with different lengths are conveniently processed.

title_en: Feeding device for blast furnace ironmaking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding device for blast furnace ironmaking, and relates to the technical field of blast furnace ironmaking. The utility model comprises a feed bin which can be fixed at a feed inlet of a blast furnace, an elliptical toothed ring, an arc-shaped track, a rotating shaft, a gear and a crushing roller, wherein the elliptical toothed ring is coaxially fixed on the surface of the feed bin, the arc-shaped track symmetrically penetrates through the surface of the feed bin, the rotating shaft is slidably arranged on the inner wall of the arc-shaped track, the gear is coaxially fixed on the peripheral side surface of the rotating shaft and is meshed and matched with the elliptical toothed ring, and the crushing roller is fixed at the bottom end of the rotating shaft and is positioned in an inner cavity of the feed bin. According to the utility model, by arranging the oval toothed ring and the arc-shaped track parallel to the oval toothed ring, when the rotating shaft moves on the inner wall of the arc-shaped track, the sides of the crushing rollers are driven by the gears to mutually approach to each other and slide and rotate, so that the distance between the crushing rollers and the extrusion force are dynamically changed, and the crushing efficiency of raw materials is improved.

title_en: Extraction tank for rare earth extraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extraction tank for rare earth extraction, which comprises a tank body, wherein a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of the tank body, a feeding pipe and a motor are arranged on a cover plate at the top of the tank body, a rotating shaft which extends into the tank body and is provided with a stirring paddle is arranged on the motor, a lower grinding seat which divides the tank body into a grinding cavity and an extraction cavity is arranged at the top of the tank body, a conical grinding tank is arranged at the top of the lower grinding seat, a blanking hole for the rotating shaft to pass through is arranged at the bottom of the grinding tank, an upper grinding seat which is matched with the grinding tank is arranged in the grinding cavity, the upper grinding seat is fixed on the rotating shaft, a liquid inlet pipe is arranged on the side wall of the tank body above the extraction cavity, a convex seat and a fan blade are also arranged on the rotating shaft at the top of the extraction cavity, a heating mechanism I is also arranged at the outer side of the tank body, wherein the heating mechanism I is connected with a pump body and a heating mechanism II in the rotating shaft and the stirring paddle through two groups of circulating pipes, and one group of circulating pipes is provided with a pump body. The invention has simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Silica sol casting module belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of cleaning devices, in particular to a cleaning device for a silica sol casting module, which comprises a cleaning box, wherein a fixing frame is fixed on the outer side of the cleaning box, a transmission rail is fixed on the fixing frame, a hanging tool is movably connected to the transmission rail, the hanging tool comprises a fixed rod fixedly connected with the moving end of the transmission rail, the bottom of the fixed rod is rotatably connected with a rotating wheel, the bottom of the rotating wheel is fixedly provided with a connecting rod, and through the structural design of a motor, a driving roller, a supporting plate, a driven roller and a belt, the hanging tool is rotated in the process of moving into a drying stage to drive the wax mould hung on the hanging tool to be omnidirectionally exposed in air flow, so that the limitation of the prior art that only two sides of the wax mould can be dried by blowing is changed, all parts such as the front end and the rear end of the wax mould can be fully dried, and moisture residues are effectively avoided.

title_en: Potassium sulfate processing reaction furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of potassium sulfate processing and discloses a potassium sulfate processing reaction furnace which comprises a baffle plate, a connecting plate, a threaded block and a threaded rod, wherein the baffle plate is connected to the top of the reaction furnace in a sliding manner, one end of the baffle plate penetrates through and extends into a feeding pipe, the connecting plate is fixedly connected to one end of the baffle plate, which is far away from the feeding pipe, the threaded block is connected to the outside of a screw rod in a threaded manner, and the threaded block is connected to the top of the reaction furnace in a sliding manner and is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting plate, which is far away from the baffle plate. The sulfuric acid is injected into the feeding pipe, the power supply of the mixing mechanism and the servo motor is started, the servo motor drives the screw rod to perform positive rotation and reverse rotation according to a certain rule, the threaded block drives the baffle to reciprocate on the feeding pipe through the connecting plate, when the baffle is gradually inserted into the feeding pipe, the flow of the sulfuric acid is reduced in cross-sectional area, the flow is correspondingly reduced, when the baffle gradually extends out of the feeding pipe, the flow of the sulfuric acid is increased in cross-sectional area, the flow is correspondingly increased, the reciprocating movement of the baffle achieves the effect of reciprocating addition of the sulfuric acid, and the reaction uniformity is improved by matching with the mixing mechanism.

title_en: Powder metallurgy part stamping press mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stamping and pressing dies and discloses a powder metallurgy part stamping and pressing die which comprises a workbench, wherein a support frame is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the support frame, an upper die is fixedly connected to the bottom of the hydraulic cylinder, a lower die is fixedly connected to the inside of the workbench, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench, a powder inlet cover is fixedly connected to the front of the air cylinder, a powder removal installation mechanism is arranged on the front of the powder inlet cover, an auxiliary cleaning mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the support frame, in the using process, a connecting block moves and a spring is matched, so that a dust adhering roller can be conveniently and always attached to the workbench to remove dust, the position of the connecting frame can be conveniently adjusted through the operation of a first motor, the subsequent installation and the disassembly of the dust adhering roller by workers can be conveniently realized, and the rotating column can be rotated through the operation of a second motor, and the up-down reciprocating swing of a dust absorption plate can be conveniently realized.

title_en: Aluminum ash processing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum ash treatment system which comprises an aluminum ash pretreatment unit and a recycling unit. The aluminum ash pretreatment unit comprises an aluminum ash bin, a crusher, a ball mill, a first screening mechanism and an aluminum melting furnace which are sequentially connected in series. The recycling recovery unit comprises an aluminum ash bin, a slag aluminum catalytic separation mechanism, a second screening mechanism, a reaction mechanism, a flocculation sedimentation mechanism and a filtering and drying mechanism which are sequentially connected in series. According to the utility model, by combining the dry pretreatment unit with the wet recycling unit, the recovery effect and efficiency of aluminum resources in the aluminum ash are improved, the discharge of secondary pollutants is greatly reduced or even avoided, and the efficient and green recovery of the aluminum ash is realized. The method has the advantages of good quality, high strength, high economic benefit, simple system structure, easy operation, environmental protection, low running cost and the like of the recovered product.

title_en: Dummy bar head for continuous casting machine convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dummy bar heads, in particular to a dummy bar head for a continuous casting machine, which is convenient to adjust, and comprises a rectangular dummy bar head, wherein an embedded groove is formed in the upper side surface of the rectangular dummy bar head, the embedded groove extends out of the rectangular dummy bar head, a dummy bar is fixedly connected to the right side surface of the rectangular dummy bar head, side plates are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the rectangular dummy bar head, first grooves are respectively formed in the upper side and the left side and the right side surfaces of the side plates, the interiors of the three first grooves are communicated, a second groove is formed in the upper side surface of the rectangular dummy bar head, and a communicating groove is formed in the bottom wall of the second groove; through the arrangement of the two side plates, the rectangular dummy bar head can be conveniently switched into the square dummy bar head, and the square billet and the rectangular billet production dummy bar head can be quickly switched under the condition that the whole rectangular dummy bar head is not dismounted, so that the tasks of improving the equipment operation rate, reducing the labor intensity of maintenance personnel, reducing the cost and improving the productivity are achieved.

title_en: Crystal silicon growth furnace with heat preservation cover
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of reduction furnaces, and provides a crystal silicon growing furnace with a heat preservation cover, which comprises a furnace bottom component, a heat preservation cover component and a gas circulation system, wherein the heat preservation cover component is covered on the furnace bottom component, the gas circulation system is arranged on the furnace bottom component, the furnace bottom component is provided with an air inlet, an air outlet and an electrode mounting opening, the heat preservation cover component comprises an inner cover and an outer cover, the inner cover is a high-temperature-resistant nonmetallic material part, the outer cover is a heat preservation material part, the outer side of the heat preservation cover component is also covered with a double-layer water-cooling metal cover, and the furnace bottom component comprises a double-layer water-cooling metal bottom plate and a high-temperature-resistant nonmetallic material bottom sleeve. The inner cover is made of high-temperature-resistant nonmetallic materials, so that metal impurity pollution is effectively avoided, and the purity of a product is effectively ensured.

title_en: Novel platinum net supporting device of ammonia oxidation furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel platinum net supporting device of an ammonia oxidation furnace, which is mainly applied to the chemical industry and nitric acid production. The utility model comprises a bracket beam, a bracket ring, a lower cone, a furnace wall, a bracket, a plurality of lugs and a plurality of bolts, wherein the bracket ring is arranged in the furnace wall, the bracket beam is arranged on the inner side of the furnace wall, the lower part of the furnace wall is provided with the lower cone, the bracket is arranged at the bottom of the bracket beam, the lugs are fixed on the bracket ring, and the bolts are arranged on the bracket ring. The utility model has reasonable structural design, is safe and reliable, reduces maintenance cost and difficult maintenance, improves the integral rigidity of the support, avoids the collapse of the support and meets the use requirement.

title_en: Spline shaft quenching heat treatment processing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spline shaft quenching heat treatment processing device which comprises a material guide mechanism, a quenching mechanism and a rolling mechanism, wherein the material guide mechanism comprises a thick pipe and a thin pipe connected with the bottom end of the thick pipe, the quenching mechanism comprises a water tank sleeved at the bottom of the thick pipe, a water pump connected with the bottom of an inner cavity of the water tank, two water outlet pipes connected and communicated with the water pump, and a shunt pipe sleeved at the top end of the water outlet pipe. According to the utility model, when the spline shaft enters the thin pipe from the thick pipe, the water pump is triggered to run for a short time, cold water in the water tank is pumped to the water outlet pipe, the shunt pipe and the spray head are matched to spray the whole body of the spline shaft, the spline shaft is assisted to move into the thin pipe under the action of gravity, the diameter of the thin pipe is small, the spline shaft fills the inner space of the thin pipe to cause water inflow to be faster than water outflow, the spline shaft is fully surrounded by the cold water, uniform cooling is realized, meanwhile, the motor drives the roller to rub the spline shaft to rotate, so that cooling efficiency is further improved, and water consumption is reduced.

title_en: Sulfur removal system for calcined petroleum coke
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calcined petroleum coke sulfur removal system which comprises mixed heating equipment, washing equipment and drying equipment, wherein the drying equipment comprises a drying box body, an internal conveying device and a material tiling device, a hopper communicated with an inner cavity of the drying box body is arranged at the top of the drying box body, the internal conveying device is arranged in the drying box body, a material inlet end of the internal conveying device is positioned right below the hopper, materials falling from the hopper can fall into a material inlet end of the internal conveying device, a material outlet end of the internal conveying device is positioned above a material outlet of the drying box body, materials can fall into the material outlet from the material outlet end of the internal conveying device, the internal conveying device can overturn the materials in the material conveying process, and the material tiling device is arranged in the drying box body and is used for uniformly tiling the materials at the material inlet end of the internal conveying device on the internal conveying device. The sulfur removal system for the calcined petroleum coke can improve the drying effect of the petroleum coke and reduce the drying time.

title_en: Semi-automatic saw cutting tool
