abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-automatic frock of saw cutting, including rotatable workstation, the higher authority of workstation is provided with the fixed establishment who is used for carrying out the location to the die casting, and the below of workstation is provided with the support, and the top of support is provided with the removal seat that drives the workstation displacement, and the inside of support is provided with the first actuating mechanism that the seat was shifted in the drive, and the both sides that remove the seat all are provided with the rotatory second actuating mechanism of drive workstation, the utility model discloses a mode of adjustment fixed plate inclination, the gesture of adjustment die casting for saw cutter is aimed at to the stub bar root on the die casting, and the motor drives the die casting and is close to saw cutter afterwards, separates stub bar and die casting, adjusts the gesture of die casting many times, thereby all cuts the stub bar in a plurality of positions on the die casting, makes the die casting can adjust the gesture in the clamping state, has improved die casting saw cutting efficiency.

title_en: Atmosphere control device and Ma Fushi bright heat treatment furnace with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an atmosphere control device and Ma Fushi bright heat treatment furnace with the same, wherein the atmosphere control device is arranged between a furnace body and a hydrogen main air inlet pipeline and comprises a humidifying storage tank, a humidifying cavity is limited in the humidifying storage tank and used for containing humidifying liquid, an air inlet, a liquid supplementing port and a liquid discharging port which are communicated with the humidifying cavity are arranged at the bottom of the humidifying storage tank, an air outlet and an air outlet are arranged at the top of the humidifying storage tank, a multistage decompression regulation bypass is arranged at the bottom of the humidifying storage tank, the multistage decompression regulation bypass is communicated between the hydrogen main air inlet pipeline and the air inlet of the humidifying storage tank, and the multistage decompression regulation bypass comprises a decompression pipe and a plurality of decompression valves which are arranged on the decompression pipe in series and used for decompressing gas conveyed by the hydrogen main air inlet pipeline to working pressure in multiple stages. The utility model has the beneficial effects of accurately regulating and controlling atmosphere and humidity atmosphere, avoiding the phenomenon of steel sticking scratch and reducing the polishing cost of the appearance of the product.

title_en: Lost foam blank precise casting mold type assembly structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lost foam blank precise casting mold type assembly structure, and relates to the technical field of lost foam casting. The device comprises a base and mounting frames which are oppositely arranged at the left side and the right side of the upper end of the base, wherein the mounting frames at the left side are fixed with the base, the mounting frames at the right side are in sliding connection with the base in the left-right direction through sliding pieces, the mounting frames are vertically arranged, at least two rows of mounting holes are distributed on the mounting frames from top to bottom, adjusting limiting assemblies are arranged in the mounting holes, each adjusting limiting assembly comprises a supporting disc which is rotatably sleeved in the mounting hole, a handle is fixed on the supporting disc, a connecting frame corresponding to the supporting disc is fixed on the mounting frames, first fixing bolts used for positioning the supporting disc are connected onto the connecting frame in a threaded mode, and bases are connected onto the ends, close to each other, of the supporting discs at the left side and the right side. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the positioning support can be carried out on the model split parts to be assembled so as to improve the precision of the assembled model.

title_en: External expansion shaping die for heat shaping processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heat setting processing, and particularly relates to an external expansion setting die for heat setting processing, which comprises a half-moon assembling plate and a half-moon butt plate arranged on the butt joint surface of the half-moon assembling plate, wherein lifting rings are arranged on the surfaces of the half-moon assembling plate and the half-moon butt plate, assembling bolts are connected at openings at two ends of the half-moon assembling plate in a penetrating way, assembling nuts are arranged at the positions, close to the openings of the assembling bolts, of the half-moon butt plate.

title_en: Hydrogen production separating tower
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of hydrogen purification, and relates to a hydrogen production separation tower which comprises a separation tower body, a separation assembly, an air inlet channel and a flow guide assembly, wherein the separation tower body is provided with a hydrogen outlet, the separation assembly is arranged in the separation tower body, the air inlet channel is arranged at the bottom of the separation tower body, the flow guide assembly is arranged in the air inlet channel, and the flow guide assembly is used for guiding the flow of hydrogen-rich mixed gas. According to the utility model, the flow guide assembly is arranged below the separation assembly, so that the hydrogen-rich mixed gas enters the inner cavity of the separation tower body and is guided by the flow guide assembly, and then is separated by the separation assembly, so that the hydrogen-rich mixed gas is uniformly distributed when the impurity gas is separated, the separation effect of the impurity gas in the hydrogen-rich mixed gas is improved, and finally the separation purity of hydrogen is improved.

title_en: One-die-multiple-piece combined core
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined mold core with multiple mold pieces, which comprises a mold core base, an adjusting screw and a lower cylinder connecting plate, wherein a plurality of core rods are arranged above the mold core base, the lower end of the mold core base is connected with the inner threads of the adjusting screw, the outer part of the adjusting screw is connected with the inner threads of the mold core base, the outer threads of the adjusting screw and the inner threads of the mold core base are left-handed threads, and the lower part of the mold core base is connected with the lower cylinder connecting plate. The core base is connected with the core base through the adjusting screw, the lower end of the core base is connected with the inner screw thread of the adjusting screw, the outer part of the adjusting screw is connected with the inner screw thread of the core base, and the height of the core base can be adjusted by rotating the adjusting screw.

title_en: Casting transfer mechanism for casting processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a casting transfer mechanism for casting processing, which comprises a supporting plate frame and a material frame placed on the supporting plate frame, wherein one side of the material frame is provided with a cover plate in an opening design and in a rotating manner, a plurality of partition plates for placing castings are arranged in the material frame in a sliding manner, the casting transfer mechanism also comprises telescopic support rods symmetrically and rotatably arranged on the cover plate, limiting columns are arranged on the inner walls of the material frame, and the free ends of the telescopic support rods can be hung on the outer surfaces of the limiting columns. This foundry goods transport mechanism for casting processing sets up rotatable apron through material frame opening part to cooperate telescopic strut and spacing post's structure, when the apron is opened and telescopic strut hangs and establishes on spacing post, apron upper surface can be with baffle lower surface parallel and level, pulls out the baffle this moment, and part can be placed on the apron, and the staff need not to go deep into the material frame inside with the hand, can easily place the foundry goods, has simplified operation flow by a wide margin.

title_en: Vertical grinding machine for zinc powder production with uniform and stable grinding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical grinder for uniformly and stably grinding zinc powder production, which comprises a machine body, wherein a top cover is distributed above the machine body, an air cylinder is arranged at the corner of the bottom of the top cover, a first motor is arranged in the middle of the top end of the top cover, the output end of the first motor is connected with a rotating shaft, a first grinding roller is sleeved on the outer surface of the rotating shaft, a second grinding roller is distributed below the first grinding roller, the grinding treatment of materials can be conveniently and fully realized by utilizing the arranged first motor, the rotating shaft, the grinding roller and a first bump, the materials to be ground can be ground to a proper fine degree, the follow-up use is convenient, the rotating shaft can rotate along with the first motor when the first motor works, the synchronous movement of the grinding roller is realized by combining the arrangement of a plurality of first bumps, the full grinding treatment of the materials can be realized, and the whole structure has higher grinding effect.

title_en: Surface roughening treatment device for aluminum nitride ceramic substrate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ceramic substrate processing equipment, in particular to an aluminum nitride ceramic substrate surface roughening treatment device which comprises a roughening treatment box body, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged on the surface of the roughening treatment box body, a plurality of bearing tables are arranged on the upper surface of the feeding mechanism, a lifting assembly is arranged on the side wall of the roughening treatment box body, a movable cover is arranged on the outer surface of the lifting assembly, a square air pipe is arranged on the top of the inner wall of the movable cover, a dust screen is arranged in the square air pipe, an air supply assembly is arranged in the square air pipe, a ventilation pipe is arranged on the side wall of the square air pipe, and the ventilation pipe penetrates through the side wall of the roughening treatment box body.

title_en: Barium carbonate production method
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a method for economically producing fine barium carbonate having a specific surface area of larger than 45 m 2 /g with little burden on the environment. The present invention relates to a method for producing barium carbonate, including: 
(a) adding citric acid and/or a salt thereof to at least one barium compound selected from the group consisting of barium hydroxide, barium chloride, barium nitrate, barium acetate, or barium oxide; 
(b) reacting with carbon dioxide and/or a carbonate compound; and 
(c) adding at least one selected from a polybasic carboxylic acid, an acid anhydride thereof, or a salt thereof, the polybasic carboxylic acid being represented by the following formula (1): 
 
        HOOC-X-(COOH) n      (1) 
 
wherein X is a divalent or trivalent linking group, the linking group being a C1 or C2 saturated hydrocarbon group, a C2 unsaturated hydrocarbon group, or a group derived from a benzene ring, each optionally containing a hydroxy group as a substituent; and n is 1 or 2, 
a mol% A of the added (a) citric acid and/or a salt thereof and a mol% B of the added (c) at least one selected from a polybasic carboxylic acid represented by the formula (1), an acid anhydride thereof, or a salt thereof, each relative to 100 mol% of barium atoms in the barium compound, satisfying the following expressions (I) and (II):      6.0   ≤   A   +   B   ≤   16             0.01   ≤   A   /   B   ≤   7.0

title_en: Changeable recoater approach angle
abstract_en: A method of forming a component by powder bed fusion includes depositing a bed of metal powder on a platform (18) by moving a recoater blade (14) across the platform at a first angle of approach. A layer of the component is formed by sintering at least a portion of the bed of metal powder. A subsequent bed of metal powder is deposited on the platform by moving the recoater blade across the platform and the bed of metal powder at a second angle of approach. A subsequent layer of the component is formed by sintering at least a portion of the subsequent bed of metal powder.

title_en: Foldable glass substrate and foldable display device including the same
abstract_en: A foldable glass substrate includes a top surface, a bottom surface, and a side surface. The side surface includes a first side surface extending at a first angle from the top surface, a second side surface extending at a second angle from the bottom surface, and a third side surface extending from each of the first side surface and the second side surface. A length of the third side surface in a direction substantially perpendicular to at least one of the top surface and the bottom surface is equal to or greater than about 0.3 times and equal to or less than about 0.7 times of a minimum distance between the top surface and the bottom surface. The minimum distance is equal to or greater than about 15 micrometers (µm) and equal to or less than about 100 µm.

title_en: Ceramic structure
abstract_en: A ceramic structural body according to the present disclosure includes a substrate that is composed of a ceramic(s), a hole that is opened on a surface of the substrate, and a seal material that is positioned at an opening portion of the hole.

title_en: Method for monitoring the wear of a refractory lining of a blast furnace
abstract_en: A method for monitoring the wear of a refractory lining of a blast furnace using modelling of a part of the blast furnace and thermal field calculation. Computer program allowing to perform such a method.

title_en: Positioning means for additive manufacturing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a positioning method for an additive build-up (12) on a pre-existing component (10). The method comprises, a), providing the pre-existing component (10) as a substrate for the build-up (12), b), forming surface alignment features (13) of predefined dimensions and coordinates on a substrate surface of the component (10), c), recording an image of the substrate surface (10), wherein the image includes a contour (15) of the surface (11) as well as the alignment features (13), d), scaling the recorded image to real dimensions based on the predetermined dimensions of the alignment features (13), e) providing a geometry of the build-up (12), and, f), aligning the geometry of the build-up (12) and the scaled geometry of the substrate surface (11) based on the predefined coordinates. Moreover, an according computer program product, an apparatus and a method of additively manufacturing the build-up are provided.

title_en: Silicon nanoparticles, non-aqueous secondary battery negative electrode active material using said silicon nanoparticles, and secondary battery
abstract_en:
Silicon nanoparticles are obtained which significantly contribute to enhancing the performance of negative electrode active materials. A negative electrode active material is obtained which allows a battery to attain excellent charging/discharging capacities, high initial Coulombic efficiency and good capacity retention after charging and discharging repetitions. 
     The present invention pertains to silicon nanoparticles for negative electrode active material in lithium ion secondary batteries in which the silicon nanoparticles have a  29 Si-NMR peak which has a half width of 20 ppm to 50 ppm centered at -80 ppm and is broad ranging from 50 ppm to -150 ppm, and the silicon nanoparticles have a length in the major axis direction of 70 to 300 nm and a thickness of 15 to 70 nm or less. The present invention also pertains to a negative electrode active material for lithium ion secondary batteries that includes the silicon nanoparticles and a silicon inorganic compound in which the silicon nanoparticles are embedded, the silicon inorganic compound having a  29 Si-NMR peak assigned to SiC 4  bond structural units and having an equivalent composition ratio [SiC 4  bonds/(SiC 4  bond structural units + D units (SiO 2 C 2 ) + T units (SiO 3 C) + Q units (SiO 4 ))] in the range of 0.05 to 0.55. The present invention also pertains to a negative electrode for lithium ion secondary batteries including the negative electrode active material, and to a lithium ion secondary battery including the negative electrode.

title_en: Glass tube
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glass tube, in particular a glass tube for the production of containers for storage of pharmaceutical compositions, a method of making it and its use. The glass tube facilitates production of pharmaceutical containers with particularly high quality. Further, the glass tube has a relative cross-sectional area deviation defined as              QF   max     −     QF   min         1.5   m              wherein              QF   max     −     QF   min         1.5   m       <   k   ⋅   x   +   t          wherein QF max  is the highest cross-sectional area and QF min  is the lowest cross-sectional area of at least two cross-sections of the tube, wherein the cross-sections are spaced apart from each other along the length of the glass tube, and k is 0.0023 m -1 , t is less than 0.15 mm 2 /m and x is              QF   max     +     QF   min       2     .

title_en: Multi-piece mandrel for cmc components
abstract_en: A mandrel (130) for a molding process. The mandrel (130) includes a first portion (132;334;434;534;634) that has a first draft surface (140;340;440;540;640) and a second draft surface (138;338;438;538;638). A second portion (148;348;448;548;648) and a third portion (158;358;458; 558 658) are included. The second portion (148;348;448;548;648) has a third draft surface (154;354;454;554;654) and the third portion (158;358;458; 558 658) has a fourth draft surface (164;364;464;564;664) wherein the first draft surface (140;340;440;540;640) engages the third draft surface (154;354;454;554;654) and the second draft surface (138;338;438;538;638) engages the fourth draft surface (164;364;464;564;664). A channel (174;372;472;572) extends along a length of the mandrel (130) at an interface between the first, second, and third portions such that the second portion (148;348;448;548;648) does not contact the third portion (158;358;458; 558 658).

title_en: Motor core
abstract_en: In the production of a motor core obtained by making a rotor core material and a stator core material from the same non-oriented electrical steel sheet, the non-oriented electrical steel sheet has the chemical composition containing by mass% C: not more than 0.0050%, Si: 2-7%, Mn: 0.05-2.0%, P: not more than 0.2%, S: not more than 0.005%, Al: not more than 3%, N: not more than 0.005%, Ti: not more than 0.003%, Nb: not more than 0.005% and V: not more than 0.005% and then subjecting to a finish annealing and a stress-relief annealing, conditions of the finish annealing and stress-relief annealing are adjusted so that a yield stress of the steel sheet after the finish annealing is not less than 400 MPa and a ratio (B 50S /B 50H ) of a magnetic flux density B 50S  of the steel sheet subjected to the stress-relief annealing after the finish annealing to a magnetic flux density B 50H  of the steel sheet after the finish annealing is not less than 0.99, whereby a non-oriented electrical steel sheet being high in the strength after the finish annealing and small in the decrease of magnetic flux density after the stress-relief annealing is obtained.

title_en: Methods and materials for repairing a thermal barrier coating of a gas turbine component
abstract_en: A sprayable thermal barrier coating powder mixture (208) for a gas turbine engine (10) includes: a dry composition having a low surface area ceramic powder (214) having a median particle size distribution greater than 5 microns and less than 50 microns, and a high surface area ceramic powder (216) having a median particle size distribution smaller than 5 microns, wherein the low surface area ceramic powder (214) makes up at least 50% by weight of the dry composition of the sprayable thermal barrier coating powder mixture (208).

title_en: Composition and method for conducting a material removing operation
abstract_en: A composition suitable for chemical mechanical polishing a substrate can comprise abrasive particles, a multi-valent metal borate, at least one oxidizer and a solvent. The composition can polish a substrate with a high material removal rate and a very smooth surface finish.

title_en: Magnetic ribbon and magnetic core using same
abstract_en: A magnetic ribbon (1) according to an embodiment has a crystallinity degree of 0.05 or higher and 0.4 or lower when the magnetic ribbon (1) is subjected to XRD analysis, the magnetic ribbon (1) being Fe-Nb-Cu-Si-B-base,and the crystallinity degree being expressed by "a peak total area of a crystalline phase"/("a peak area of an amorphous phase" + "the peak total area of the crystalline phase"). Also, the magnetic ribbon (1) is preferred to have a region in which a KIKUCHI pattern is detected when the crystalline phase is subjected to EBSD analysis. Also, the thickness of the magnetic ribbon is preferred to be 25 µm or less.

title_en: Lithium complex oxide for lithium secondary battery positive active material and method of preparing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a lithium complex oxide and method of manufacturing the same, more particularly, a lithium complex oxide effective in improving the characteristics of capacity, resistance, and lifetime with reduced residual lithium and with different interplanar distances of crystalline structure between a primary particle locating in a internal part of secondary particle and a primary particle locating on the surface part of the secondary particle, and a method of preparing the same.

title_en: Methods of furnace-less brazing
abstract_en: A method (300) of furnace-less brazing of a substrate (106) is provided. The method (300) includes providing a substrate (106) having a braze region thereon; disposing braze precursor material (108) containing a nickel powder, an aluminum powder, and a platinum group metal powder on the braze region; and initiating an exothermic reaction of the braze precursor material (108) such that the exothermic reaction produces a braze material that reaches a braze temperature above the solidus temperature of the braze material. A braze precursor material (108) is also provided.

title_en: Method for preparing secondary battery cathode material
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a secondary battery cathode material includes preparing Li 2 O powder by separating CO 2  from Li 2 CO 3  powder, forming a mixed powder by mixing the Li 2 O powder with nickel-cobalt-manganese (NCM) precursor powder, and firing the mixed powder using a rotary kiln.

title_en: Ammonium sulphate production on industrial scale
abstract_en: The invention provides a process for the production of crystalline ammonium sulfate, wherein the process comprises performing a Beckmann rearrangement reaction, neutralizing the Beckmann rearrangement reaction mixture, separating a first aqueous ammonium sulfate phase and an aqueous ε-caprolactam phase, charging the first ammonium sulfate phase to a first evaporative type crystallization section wherein crystalline ammonium sulfate is obtained, discharging from the first evaporative type crystallization section mother liquor enriched in organic components, extracting the aqueous ε-caprolactam phase to obtain an extracted ε-caprolactam phase and a second aqueous ammonium sulfate phase, discharging the mother liquor that is discharged from the first evaporative type crystallization section and/or the second aqueous ammonium sulfate phase to a second evaporative type crystallization section wherein evaporative type crystallization is performed so that a three-phase system occurs. At least a liquid oily phase is recovered from the three-phase system. The invention further provides a plant suitable to carry out the process of the invention, crystalline ammonium sulfate and a liquid oily phase obtained by the process of the invention.

title_en: Improvement of glass strength and fracture toughness by a non-brittle abrasion resistant coating
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the use of a coating for improving glass strength and fracture toughness comprising the hydrolytic polycondensation product of one or more alkoxysilane(s) with one or more metal oxide(s) and/or metal alkoxide(s) in the presence of water and a catalyst.

title_en: Composition for glass fiber
abstract_en: Provided is a composition for a glass fiber having a high elastic modulus and satisfactory productivity. The composition for a glass fiber includes, in terms of mass%, 0% to 1% of Li 2 O+Na 2 O+K 2 O, and has SiO 2 /Al 2 O 3  of from 1 to 4 and MgO/CaO of from 0.2 to 3.9 in terms of mass ratio.

title_en: Method and evaluation component for monitoring a die casting or injection molding production process of a mechanical component with an according production machine
abstract_en:
The present invention describes a method for monitoring a die casting or injection molding production process of a mechanical component with a die casting or injection molding production machine (100), 
• wherein the die casting or injection molding process comprises a first process element taken from the following group of process elements: cooling, core-process, injection, lubrication, electric power, and tie-bar strain, 
• wherein sensor values and/or control values of the die casting or injection molding production machine (100) are recorded during the die casting or injection molding production process of the mechanical component, 
• wherein the recorded sensor values comprise a first selection of sensor values being assigned to the first process element and/or the control values comprise a first selection of control values being assigned to the first process element, 
• and wherein the sensor values and/or the control values are evaluated by an evaluation component (188, 500, 720), 
whereas the method is further designed and set up, 
• that the evaluation component (188, 500, 720) comprises an ML-model (502) set up by means of a machine learning method, and 
• that the evaluation component (188, 500, 720), and/or the ML-model (502), outputs a warning message, if an evaluation of the sensor values and/or the control values by the evaluation component (188, 500, 720) results in an increased probability for a defect or anomaly of the mechanical component produced or the die casting or the injection molding production machine, 
• that the ML-Model (502) comprises a first ML-Model-component (810, 820, 830), 
• and that the evaluation of the sensor values and/or the control values by the evaluation component (188, 500, 720) comprise a first evaluation step for creating a first evaluation result using the first ML-Model-component (810, 820, 830), whereas the first evaluation result is based on the first selection of sensor values and/or the first selection of control values.

title_en: Oxygen injection for reformer feed gas for direct reduction process
abstract_en: A direct reduction plant is disclosed. The direct reduction plant includes an oxygen injection system, a reformer, and a shaft furnace. The oxygen injection system includes an oxygen injection reactor and a main oxygen burner. The oxygen injection reactor is adapted to receive a gas mixture. The main oxygen burner is adapted to increase a temperature of the gas mixture by burning a mixture of fuel and oxygen fed to the main oxygen burner. The reformer is adapted to reform the gas mixture with the increased temperature. The shaft furnace is adapted to reduce iron ore using the reformed gas mixture.

title_en: Glass body
abstract_en: The glass body according to the present invention includes a plate-like glass plate having a first surface and a second surface; and an antibacterial film that is formed on the first surface and in which copper ions are dispersed.

title_en: Cozrta(x) sputtering target with improved magnetic properties
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sputtering target consisting of an alloy consisting of Co, Zr, Ta and, optionally, one or more further element(s) X from the group of Mo, Pd, Ni, Ti, V, W, and B, characterized in that the target has a maximum magnetic permeability µ max  of 60 or lower and/or characterized in that the target has a maximum pass through flux (PTF) variation (F Max -F Min )/F Average  of 0.2 or lower, preferably of 0.15 or lower, and most preferably of 0.10 or lower.

title_en: Conductive composition for bonding, bonding structure using same, and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A conductive composition for bonding includes a copper powder and a carboxylic acid mixed therewith. The carboxylic acid has a branched carbon chain in its structure. The copper powder comprises first copper particles and second copper particles. The first copper particles have a volume-based cumulative particle size D 50  of 0.11 µm or more and less than 1 µm at a cumulative volume of 50 vol% in a region of particle sizes of less than 1 µm in a particle size distribution of the copper powder that is determined using a scanning electron microscope. The second copper particles have a volume-based cumulative particle size D 50  of 1 µm or more and 10 µm or less at a cumulative volume of 50 vol% in a region of particle sizes of 1 µm or more in the particle size distribution of the copper powder that is determined using the scanning electron microscope. The carboxylic acid is contained in an amount of 6 parts by mass or more and 24 parts by mass or less per 100 parts by mass of the copper powder.

title_en: Martensitic stainless steel for nitrogen-enriching treatment and martensitic stainless steel member
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a martensitic stainless steel for a nitrogen-enriching treatment, consisting of: 0.10 mass% ≤ C ≤ 0.30 mass%; Si ≤ 0.20 mass%; 0.20 mass% ≤ Mn ≤ 1.50 mass%; P ≤ 0.05 mass%; S ≤ 0.01 mass%; Cu ≤ 0.3 mass%; 10.5 mass% ≤ Cr ≤ 17.0 mass%; 0.50 mass% ≤ Ni ≤ 3.00 mass%; 0.50 mass% ≤ Mo ≤ 3.00 mass%; 0.1 mass% ≤ Nb ≤ 0.5 mass%; Ti ≤ 0.5 mass%; and V ≤ 1.0 mass%, with the remainder being Fe and inevitable impurities, having an area ratio of a ferrite phase of 50% or more, and satisfying the following formulae (1) and (2), 1.00 ≤ [Ni]*[Mo] ≤ 9.00 (1), [Nieq]/[Creq] ≥ 1.00 (2), in the formulae, [X] represents a content (mass%) of an element X, [Nieq] = [Ni] + 30[C] + 0.5[Mn] + 8, and [Creq] = [Cr] + [Mo] + 1.5[Si].

title_en: Clad steel plate, member, and production methods for same
abstract_en: A clad steel plate having tensile strength (TS) of 780 MPa or more, excellent bendability, collision resistance, and LME resistance. The clad steel plate having a base metal and a cladding metal on front and back surfaces of the base metal, and the chemical composition and microstructure of the base metal and the cladding metal being appropriately controlled so that the average Vickers hardness (HVL) of the cladding metal is 260 or less, the average Vickers hardness (HVL) of the cladding metal divided by the average Vickers hardness (HVB) of the base metal is 0.80 or less, the boundary roughness between the base metal and the cladding metal is 50 µm or less at the maximum height Ry, and the number of voids at the boundary between the base metal and the cladding metal is controlled to 20 or fewer per 10 mm length of the boundary.

title_en: Grain-oriented electromagnetic steel sheet
abstract_en: Disclosed is a grain-oriented electrical steel sheet that exhibits excellent transformer characteristics and that has low iron loss and low magnetostriction properties. The grain-oriented electrical steel sheet has a magnetic flux density B-magnetostriction waveform λ, referred to as a butterfly curve, when excited to 1.5 T or more, such that an amount of steel sheet elongation (Δλ) with a magnetic flux density B ranging from 1.0 T to 1.5 T is 0.010 × 10 -6  or more and 0.240 × 10 -6  or less, and a length of a closure domain in the rolling direction, referred to as a closure domain width, is 20 µm or more and 240 µm or less.

title_en: Metal paste for joining, joint, and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: A metal paste for bonding includes metal particles, a dispersion medium, a reducing agent, and a reduction aid, in which the metal particles contain copper particles, the reduction aid includes a coordinating compound having electron back-donation properties, the coordinating compound is at least one selected from the group consisting of an organic phosphorus compound and an organic sulfur compound, and the metal paste for bonding contains, as a reducing agent, 1.6 parts by mass or more and 10 parts by mass or less of a polyol-based compound with respect to 100 parts by mass of the total mass of the copper particles.

title_en: Ultra-early strength concrete mix
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ultra-early strength concrete mix comprising at least one fine aggregate and at least one set accelerator in addition to at least one cement material, said concrete comprising said set accelerator in a range of 5 to 15 wt% of the ultra-early strength concrete mix. The present invention further discloses a method for preparing an ultra-early strength concrete mix. The weight ratio of the fine aggregate to the cement material is in the range of 0.8 to 1.2.

title_en: Sacrificial yarns for use in ceramic matrix composites, methods of manufacture thereof and articles comprising the same
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a composite co-fiber comprising a plurality of ceramic tows; one or more sacrificial yarns; where the sacrificial yarns are operative to undergo dissolution, decomposition or melting upon being subjected to an elevated temperature; and wherein the sacrificial yarns leave open spaces in the co-fiber upon being subjected to decomposition, dissolution or melting.

title_en: Composition for forming a copper-containing interlayer comprising internal pores
abstract_en:
The invention concerns a composition for forming a copper-containing interlayer between a first solid substrate and a second solid substrate which composition comprises or consists of the following components: 
     An organic binder and copper-containing flakes of elementary metal, wherein the copper-containing flakes comprise internal pores, wherein the copper-containing flakes have a multi-layer lamellar structure.

title_en: Method for fabrication of a ceramic matrix composite part
abstract_en: A method of fabricating a ceramic matrix composite material into a part, including applying a semi-permeable membrane over a stack of composite plies pre-impregnated with ceramic matrix. The semi-permeable membrane comprises a porous plastic material and may have a thickness of approximately 0.002 to 0.008 inches. The method may include compressing the semi-permeable membrane and the stack together and heating the semi-permeable membrane and the stack to cure the stack into the composite part. The semi-permeable membrane may be a porous plastic having pores large enough to allow volatile gasses to escape therethrough during curing but equal to or smaller than solid ceramic particles or clusters of the solid ceramic particles suspended in the ceramic matrix. The composite plies may contain approximately 35 percent to 45 percent of the ceramic matrix by weight relative to an overall weight of the stack of the composite plies pre-impregnated with the ceramic matrix.

title_en: Wire rod for fine steel wire cord, steel wire, cord, and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the technical field of production method for wire rods, in particular relates to a wire rod for fine steel wire cord, steel wire, cord, and manufacturing methods therefor. The wire rod includes chemical components in percentage by mass: 0.79%-0.84% of C, 0.15%-0.30% of Si, 0.45%-0.55% of Mn, less than or equal to 0.015% of P, 0.0030%-0.010% of S, 0.0008%-0.0022% of total oxygen, 0.0002%-0.0012% of Als, 0.0002%-0.0012% of Mg, 0.0003%-0.0009% of Nb, 0.0003%-0.0012% of Mo, and balance of Fe and inevitable impurities. According to the present invention, the hardness distribution of cross-section of each the wire rod and the steel wire is homogeneous through designs of chemical component and production process, meeting users' requirements for plying performance in machining process from wire rod to fine steel cord.

title_en: Porous metal coupon with braze material infiltration barrier for repairing component, component with same and related method
abstract_en: A metal coupon (200) for repairing a component (202) includes an additively manufactured (AM) metal member (210) having at least two porous regions (300) and a braze material infiltration barrier (304) positioned between the at least two porous regions (300). The braze material infiltration barrier (304) has a lower porosity than the at least two porous regions (300). A component (202) using the metal coupon (200) may also include a braze material (310) coupling the metal coupon (200) in a coupon opening (204) in the body (206). The braze material (310) infiltrates at least one of the two porous regions (300), and the braze material infiltration barrier (304) separates the braze material (310) in the at least one of the two porous regions (300) from at least one other of the at least two porous regions (300). Different braze materials may be used in each porous region.

title_en: 100 kg-grade ultrahigh-strength galvanized steel sheet and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a 100 kg-grade ultra-high-strength galvanized steel sheet having excellent resistance spot welding properties and excellent resistance to liquid metal embrittlement (LME) cracking. The steel sheet contains the following components in percentage by weight: C: 0.17-0.25%, Mn: 1.7-2.7%, Si: 0.35-1.5%, Al: 0.01-1.0%, 0.7%≤Si+Al≤1.7%, and at least one of Nb, Ti and B, with the balance being Fe and unavoidable impurities. When the thickness of the steel sheet is t, the resistivity thereof is 0<R 1 ≤50µΩ·cm; and, in the direction from the coating layer/steel sheet substrate interface to the steel sheet substrate, when the thickness of the steel sheet is in the range of greater than or equal to 0.010t to less than or equal to 0.035t the resistivity thereof is 0<R 2 ≤15µΩ·cm, and when the thickness of the steel sheet is in the range of greater than 0.035t to less than or equal to 0.065t the resistivity thereof is 0<R 3 ≤30µΩ·cm, wherein (R 2 /2+R 3 /3)≤(3.1R 1   1/2 -1.5) is satisfied.

title_en: A method of manufacturing molten pig iron into an electrical smelting unit
abstract_en: The invention deals with a method of manufacturing molten pig iron into an electrical smelting unit 13. The method comprises the following successive steps: - providing a directly reduced iron product 12, - feeding the DRI product 12 into the smelting unit 13, - feeding together with the DRI product 13 at least one steel or ironmaking by-product-based material having an iron content upper than 20% in weight, at least a part of said iron being under an oxidized form, - melting the DRI product 13 and the at least one steel or ironmaking by- product-based material to produce molten pig iron. The invention also deals with a steel manufacturing method using said pig iron.

title_en: Selective extraction of rhodium from hydrochloric acid solutions comprising rhodium and iridium
abstract_en: A method of selectively extracting rhodium from an aqueous hydrochloric acid solution comprising rhodium and iridium, the method comprising: mixing a first aqueous hydrochloric acid solution comprising rhodium and iridium with an immiscible organic solution comprising a first organic solvent and an extractant system which selectively extracts the rhodium into the organic solution, wherein the first aqueous hydrochloric acid solution has a hydrochloric acid concentration in a range 2 M to 7 M; separating the organic solution comprising the rhodium from the first aqueous hydrochloric acid solution; mixing the separated organic solution with an aqueous stripping solution in order to strip the rhodium from the organic solution into the aqueous stripping solution; separating the organic solution from the aqueous stripping solution; and re-using the organic solution for further extraction of rhodium.

title_en: Process for performing an endothermic reaction in a reactor with less coemissions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for performing an endothermic reaction in a reactor, the process particularly comprising heating a combustible stream comprising NH 3  to a temperature in the range of from 25 to 850 °C, wherein heating comprises transferring heat of a reaction from a chemical conversion process to the combustible stream; feeding the heated combustible gas stream into a combustion chamber, wherein a portion of a reactor passes through the combustion chamber; combusting the combustible gas stream with oxygen in the combustion chamber, for heating the portion of the reactor passing through the combustion chamber to a temperature in the range of from 500 to 2100 °C; feeding a feedstock gas stream comprising one or more reactants into the heated reactor for performing the endothermic reaction; and reacting the feedstock gas stream in the heated reactor.

title_en: Process for operating a thermal treatment line for the flexible thermal treatment of metal pre-products
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for operating a thermal treatment line for the flexible thermal treatment of metal pre-products, to a thermal treatment line configured and suitable for carrying out the process, and to a casting-rolling mill and a process for operating a casting-rolling mill having a thermal treatment line according to the invention. In comparison with previous thermal treatment lines and processes for operating said thermal treatment lines, the thermal treatment line according to the invention allows flexible operation. Emissions and production costs in the process are thereby reduced.

title_en: Lined internal board comprising pyrolized bio-aggregate
abstract_en: A construction product and a method of manufacturing the construction product is provided. The method comprises: obtaining bio-aggregate, pyrolyzing the bio-aggregate to obtain a pyrolyzed bio-aggregate, and mixing a binder comprising at least one of: an alkaline earth metal oxide and/or alkaline earth metal hydroxide with the pyrolyzed bio-aggregate to form a mixture for the construction product. The method further comprises forming the mixture into a predetermined geometric shape, and providing a planar lining material on one or more outer faces of the predetermined geometric shape.

title_en: Hot-rolled steel plate
abstract_en: Provided is a hot rolled steel sheet having a predetermined chemical composition, and a microstructure comprising, by area ratio, ferrite: 60 to 80%, bainite: 15 to 30%, and martensite: 3 to 10%, wherein TiC precipitates having a diameter of 1.0 to 5.0 nm are present in the ferrite in a number density of 1.0×10 16  to 100.0×10 16 /cm 3 , and the hot rolled steel sheet has a tensile strength of 780 MPa or more tensile strength.

title_en: Combustion system having a fuel cell and a carbon capture system
abstract_en: A combustion system is provided. The combustion system includes a topping cycle generating a flow of exhaust gas and a bottoming cycle. The combustion system further includes a heat recovery steam generator (HRSG) that receives the exhaust gases from the topping cycle. The HRSG generates a flow of steam for use in the bottoming cycle. A fuel cell includes an anode side, a cathode side, and an electrolyte. The cathode side receives the flow of exhaust gas from HRSG via a cathode inlet line. The cathode side removes a first portion of pollutants from the exhaust gas. A carbon capture system is fluidly coupled to cathode side via a cathode outlet line. The carbon capture system removes a second portion of pollutants from the exhaust gas.

title_en: Method for production of clean hydrogen
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for production of clean hydrogen and, more specifically, to a method for production of clean hydrogen comprising: a methane reforming step of converting methane-containing gas into a reformed gas containing hydrogen, CO, and CO2 through a reforming reaction using steam; a step of obtaining a hydrogen and carbon dioxide mixed gas by performing a water-gas shift (WGS) on the reformed gas; a separation step of separating hydrogen and carbon dioxide from the mixed gas; and a step of mixing the separated carbon dioxide with sodium sulfate, ammonia, and water.

title_en: Non-oriented electrical steel sheet and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-oriented electrical steel sheet and a method for manufacturing same, and more specifically to a non-oriented electrical steel sheet preferably usable as an iron core of a motor, and a method for manufacturing same. One aspect of the present invention is for providing a non-oriented electrical steel sheet having low high-frequency iron loss, and a method for manufacturing same.

title_en: Use of 1-methyl-6,7-dihydro-5h-cyclopenta[b]pyridine-1-ium cation as structure directing agent for the preparation of emm-65
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to the use of 1-methyl-6,7-dihydro-5H-cyclopenta[b]pyridine-1-ium cation as structure directing agent (SDA) for the preparation of EMM-65. This disclosure also relates to compositions of matter, designated as EMM-65, obtainable by using this SDA, as well as a method of making the same and uses thereof.

title_en: Method for additive manufacturing of a part
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for additive manufacturing of a part, comprising the following successive steps: forming a layer of powder on a construction support; using a high-energy device to perform a melting step in which the layer of powder thus formed is illuminated by means of at least one beam and the at least one beam is moved in order to form a temperature profile at each point of the layer, said profile including successively: a first, positive thermal gradient G1 for gradually preheating the powder, a melting peak for melting the powder, and a second, negative thermal gradient G2 for gradually cooling the powder.

title_en: Supercapacitor comprising nanostructure of a metal-chalcogen compound
abstract_en: Symmetric and asymmetric supercapacitors are disclosed. The symmetric supercapacitor comprises: a first electrode; an electrolyte; and a second electrode. The first and second electrodes comprise carbon-based material and nanostructure of metal-chalcogen compound, wherein the metal is selected from Cu, Va, Ni, Fe, Ag, Co, Mn, Sn, and any combination thereof, and the chalcogen is selected from Te, Se, and S. The asymmetric supercapacitor comprises: a substrate; a first electrode comprising a first carbon-based material and a first nanostructure of a metal-chalcogen compound, wherein the metal is selected from Cu and Sn, and the chalcogen is selected from Te, Se, and S; an electrolyte; and a second electrode comprising a second carbon-based material.

title_en: Gas reforming system
abstract_en: A gas reforming system, which serves as an environmental energy solution, is proposed. More specifically, a gas reforming system utilizing plasma is proposed. A gas reforming system according to an embodiment may include a pre-treatment unit including a desulfurization process module and a first gas separation module, a plasma reforming unit including a discharge tube, an RF generation unit, an antenna structure, and an additional reaction module, and a post-treatment unit including a gas conversion module and a second gas separation module.

title_en: Stabilizing admixture for mineral binder compositions
abstract_en: An admixture for mineral binder compositions, comprising, with respect to the overall weight of the admixture: a) 0.1 – 30 wt.%, especially 5 – 25 wt.%, in particular 10 – 20 wt.%, of an alkali swellable polymer; b) 0 – 45 wt.%, preferably 1 – 40 wt.%, more preferably 5 – 35 wt.%, still more preferably 10 – 22 wt.%, in particular 14 – 19 wt.%, of a defoamer; c) 0 – 25 wt.%, preferably 0.01 – 25 wt.%, especially 0.05 – 5 wt.%, in particular 0.1 – 1 wt.%, of a surfactant, especially an anionic surfactant and/or a non- ionic surfactant; d) 0 – 10 wt.%, preferably 0.001 – 10 wt.%, especially 0.01 – 5 wt.%, in particular 0.1 – 3 wt.%, of one or more processing additives; e) 0 – 75 wt.%, especially 10 – 60 wt.% of water, in particular 20 – 40 wt.% of water; whereby at least one of the defoamer and the surfactant is present with a proportion > 0 wt.%.

title_en: Improved process for the smelting reduction of iron ores
abstract_en: Process for improving the sustainability of the smelting reduction (SR) of iron ores which makes use of synthetic gas (syngas) produced by means of Short Contact Time Catalytic Partial Oxidation (SCT-CPO) in a process utilizing off-gases derived from the reduction of iron ores and, optionally, hydrogen and or CO and oxygen produced with electrolytic means. The process uses also oxygen produced by cryogenic separation of air or by electrolysis. The syngas produced via SCT-CPO can also be used in Blast Furnace and Direct Reduction processes for reducing Iron Ores.

title_en: Additive manufacturing system and method for compression of material
abstract_en: A directed energy deposition (DED) additive manufacturing system (100) for manufacturing a component (102) from a material includes a deposition assembly (120) having a deposition head (122) through which material is deposited to form a top surface (102c) of a component (102). The top surface (102c) defines a width (w) measured in millimeters (mm). The deposition assembly (120) also includes compression rig (140) having a compression head (246). The compression head (246) is configured to apply a compressive force (F) measured in kilonewtons (kN) to the top surface (102c) of the component (102). The compression rig (140) also defines a target load (Y).

title_en: Low-stress optical surfacing on reaction bonded silicon carbide
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for low-stress optical surfacing on reaction bonded silicon carbide. A reaction bonded silicon carbide (RB-SiC) based structure may include a substrate, a physical vapor deposition (PVD) or other suitable vacuum deposition (VD) based optical layer on top of the substrate, and optionally one or more PVD (or other suitable vacuum deposition (VD) technique) based tacking layers disposed immediately on the surface of the substrate.

title_en: LUMINESCENT BUILDING MATERIAL (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Luminescent construction material that, formed from a mass (2) composed of a mixture of cements, plasters, limes, plasters, mortars, or any of its mixtures or variants, is characterized by the fact that said mass (2) includes a proportion of photoluminescent pigments of a phosphorescent substance such that they give it light capacity in the dark when excited with light, to be able to be seen at night in areas with little or no artificial light; and because in addition to said mass (2) it incorporates an internal dendritic structure (3) of transparent material with an indeterminate shape that runs through the entire mass (2) of the material in such a way that it acts inside the material itself as a conductive microskeleton both of the light to excite said pigments and of a conductor of their luminescence. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title_en: Method for extracting nickel from high matte nickel leaching residue
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a method for extracting nickel from a high matte nickel leaching residue. The method comprises: firstly, adding a crushed material of a high matte nickel leaching residue to an organic solvent in which sulfur is dissolved, heating same for reaction, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a first filtrate and a first filter residue; adding the first filter residue to a copper sulfate solution, heating same for reaction, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a second filtrate and a second filter residue; and evaporating, condensing and concentrating the second filtrate, and filtering same to obtain copper sulfate crystals and a nickel-containing filtrate. In the present invention, by using the oxidizing property of elemental sulfur in the organic solvent, Cu2S, Ni3S2, CuFeS2, a nickel-iron-copper alloy, etc. in the high matte nickel leaching residue are oxidized into CuS, NiS and FeS; in addition, in the presence of the organic solvent, elemental sulfur in the high matte nickel leaching residue is dissolved in the solvent; NiS and FeS are then replaced with the copper sulfate solution into more insoluble CuS; and nickel ions and ferrous ions enter the solution, such that the copper content in the leaching residue is further improved. Throughout the whole reaction, only a small amount of sulfur and copper sulfate are consumed, and the organic solvent can be recycled.

title_en: Radial nickel-based precursor and preparation method therefor
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a radial nickel-based precursor and a preparation method therefor. The overall form of the precursor is a secondary sphere formed by agglomeration of primary crystal grains; the interior of the precursor is provided with a loose and porous inner core of a net-shaped structure; the exterior of the precursor is provided with uniform and regular strip-shaped primary crystal grains; and the strip-shaped crystal grains grow outward perpendicular to the surface of the inner core, and are radially and tightly arranged. The precursor structure provided by the present invention is more suitable for the positive electrode material of a high-power power supply because such an internal loose structure is easier to form a gap in the center in the preparation process of the positive electrode material, such that a contact area between an active substance and an electrolyte can be enlarged, a transmission path of Li ions in the material is shortened by means of a combination of the hollow structure and the radial crystal grains, deformation stress caused by the expansion and contraction of the volume of the grains can be relieved on a macrostructure, and the cycle performance of a battery material can be better improved.

title_en: Purification apparatus and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a purification system for purifying a gaseous product produced by electrolysis comprising: a separation vessel (10) configured to contain a separating liquid (12), and where the gaseous product is passed through the separating liquid (12) to at least partially remove a contaminant from the gaseous product in use. A condenser vessel (30) operatively connected downstream of the separation vessel (10), the condensing vessel (30) comprising a condenser (24) configured to condense one or more contaminant out from the gaseous product. The separation vessel (10) and the condensing vessel (30) are provided as separate, fluidly connected vessels.

title_en: Recycled battery composition
abstract_en: A method of preparing a cathode active material composition involves combining a first cathode active material including recycled lithium 40 with a second cathode active material 41; wherein the ratio of the first cathode active material to the second cathode active material is controlled such that the cathode active material composition 43 includes at least 6% recycled lithium. The first cathode active material and the second cathode active material preferably have the same chemical composition and may be lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC). A cathode active material for an electrochemical storage device, such as a battery, includes lithium with a recycled content of at least 6% and may further include cobalt with a recycled content of at least 16% and nickel with a recycled content of at least 6%. An apparatus for preparing a cathode active material composition includes an inlet to supply a first cathode active which includes recycled lithium; an inlet to supply a second cathode active material; a mixing chamber to uniformly distribute the two materials; and control means for controlling the weight ratio such that the composition includes lithium with a recycled content of at least 6%.

title_en: Selective separation of elements or commodities of interest in aqueous streams
abstract_en: To provide a process for selectively separating a metallic constituent in a mixture from other metals and other materials.SOLUTION: The process comprises the step of providing the mixture in an aqueous solution such that the metallic constituent forms a complex anion in the solution. One or more of the other metals form a cation or a complex cation in the solution. Another step includes contacting the solution with one or more additives to form layered double hydroxide (LDH) material in situ such that the complex anion is intercalated within interlayers of the LDH material and wherein one or more of the other metals are incorporated into the LDH material's crystal structure or matrix. Another step involves the addition of an LDH to an aqueous solution. The process involves selectively recovering the metallic constituent from the interlayer of the LDH by subjecting the LDH to a recovery treatment step(s) and as required, methods to modify the LDH to facilitate metal separation and recovery or contaminant stabilization.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: High-concentration iron-based flocculant, and method for producing same
abstract_en: To enable an ultra-high concentration polyferric sulfate solution, which could not be produced through conventional production methods due to a long reaction time, to be produced in a short time.SOLUTION: When a sulfate ion concentration is [SO42-] and the total iron concentration is [T-Fe] (in molar concentration), raw materials are adjusted such that the following relationships are satisfied, and said polyferric sulfate solution is produced through a high-temperature and high-pressure reaction of the raw materials. The molar ratio (SO42-/T-Fe) of sulfate ions to total iron is at least 1.2, and when the weight concentration of sulfate ions is [SO42-], [SO42-] is at most 35 wt.%.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Austenitic stainless steel material
abstract_en: To provide an austenitic stainless steel material that has an excellent water vapor oxidation resistance even in a high temperature environment of 650°C or higher.SOLUTION: A steel material of the present embodiment is, in mass%, C: 0.01 to 0.15%, Si: 0.01 to 1.00%, Mn: 2.00% or less, P: 0.040% or less, S: 0.010% or less, Cr: 20.0 to 25.0%, Ni: 23.0 to 32.0%, Nb: 0.10 to 1.00%, Mo: 0.01 to 2.50%, W: 2.5 to 6.0%, Al: 0.010 to 0.300%, V: 0.01 to 1.00%, B: 0.0005 to 0.0500%, REM: 0.001 to 0.100%, N: 0.15 to 0.35%, Cu: over 1.00 to 5.00%, Co: over 1.0 to 3.0% and the balance consisting of Fe and impurities, and in which the crystal grain size number D satisfies the equation (1) and the oxygen concentration at a position of depth of 1 μm from the surface is less than 1.00 mass%. 2W/7-Mo+3D/4≥3.00 (1).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Honeycomb structure
abstract_en: To provide a honeycomb structure capable of effectively suppressing a separation of honeycomb segments due to a crack.SOLUTION: A honeycomb structure includes a honeycomb segment conjugate 10 in which a plurality of prismatic honeycomb segments 4 are joined by a joint layer 14. A honeycomb segment 4 has, on one side face thereof, a groove-like recess 8 arranged to extend in an axial direction, starting from one of a first edge face or a second edge face. In the honeycomb segment conjugate 10, two honeycomb segments 4 having recesses 8 respectively are arranged adjacently so that the recesses 8 on their respective one sides are opposing to each other, and inside the two recesses 8 arranged opposingly, a rod-like connection member 7 is arranged so as to bridge the two recesses 8 at their insides.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: High-temperature component and metal powder
abstract_en: To provide a high-temperature component made of a γ' precipitation strengthened Ni-based alloy whose creep resistance is improved.SOLUTION: A high-temperature component made of a γ' precipitation strengthened Ni-based alloy containing, by mass%, C of 0.002% or larger and 0.07% or smaller, Al + Ti of 6.00% or larger and 7.50% or smaller, Nb + TA of 1.50% or larger and 3.00% or smaller, Cr of 11.00% or larger and 15.00% or smaller, Mo of 3.80% or larger and 5.20% or smaller, B of 0.005% or larger and 0.020% or smaller, and Zr of 0.05% or larger and 0.20% or smaller, in which an average crystal grain diameter is 150 μm or larger, its crystal grain structure is an equiaxial structure in all cross-sections in three orthogonal directions and a non-dendrite structure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Mold for forming nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material, nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material, and method for manufacturing mold for forming nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material
abstract_en: To provide a mold for forming a nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material, capable of: being used repeatedly because the nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material can be easily peeled off; and performing easy processing.SOLUTION: A mold for forming a nonoxide-based vapor-phase deposited ceramic material comprises: a base material comprising a graphite; and an alumina film formed on a surface of the base material.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Admixture for mortar/concrete, hydraulic composition, cement composition, and concrete
abstract_en: To provide an admixture for mortar/concrete that makes it possible to obtain mortar/concrete having excellent chloride osmosis resistance without impairing basic performance such as compression strength and fresh properties.SOLUTION: An admixture for mortar/concrete contains silica fume, metakaolin and metal oxide with a density of 3.5-9.0 g/cm3. In the admixture for mortar/concrete 100 pts.mass, the silica fume content is 20-50 pts.mass, the metakaolin content is 20-50 pts.mass, and the metal oxide content is 16-35 pts.mass. In the metakaolin 100 pts.mass, amorphous content is 80 pts.mass or more.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Waste gas purification catalyst composition and manufacturing method of bea type zeolite
abstract_en: To provide a waste gas purification catalyst composition that can maintain a skeleton structure under severe thermal environment and contains BEA type zeolite with improved heat resistance, and a manufacturing method of the BEA type zeolite.SOLUTION: The exhaust gas purification catalyst composition containing BEA type zeolite, in which the BEA type zeolite has a meso pore volume V1 having a pore diameter measured by a BJH method in the range of 2 to 50 nm is in the range of 0.03 to 0.10 cm3/g and a phosphorous content to entirety is 0.01 mass% or lower. The BEA type zeolite is subjected to a thermal endurance test under specific condition, and when a maximum peak intensity before the thermal endurance test at a diffraction angle of 2θ=22.4°±1.0° of X-ray diffraction spectrum is set to Ib, and a maximum peak intensity after the thermal endurance test is set to Ia, a crystallinity maintaining rate expressed by a ratio of Ia to Ib is 40% or larger.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Structural composition learning device, structural composition learning method, and structural composition learning program for sintered ore
abstract_en: To provide a structural composition learning device that can create a learning model that can accurately estimate the structural composition of sintered ore.SOLUTION: A structural composition learning device 1 for sintered ore has: an image data acquisition unit 21 that acquires a plurality of pieces of image data showing a plurality of cross-sectional images obtained by picking up images of the cross-section of sintered ore; a learning data generation unit 23 that generates a plurality of pieces of data for learning by associating a plurality of areas in the cross-sectional images with ore phases included in the sintered ore; a learning processing unit 24 that causes a learning model to learn the relationship between the plurality of cross-sectional images and the structural composition of the sintered ore by using the plurality of pieces of data for learning; and a learning model output unit 25 that, based on the learned relationship between the plurality of cross-sectional images and the structural composition of the sintered ore, outputs the learning model that estimates the structural composition of the sintered ore from the cross-sectional images obtained by picking up the images of the cross-section of the sintered ore. The plurality of pieces of data for learning is generated by associating at least three types of sintered ore of hematite, magnetite, calcium ferrite, and silicate slag with the plurality of areas.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Method for painting on porcelain
abstract_en: To provide a method for painting digitized characters and images on porcelains and the like at high resolution.SOLUTION: A method for painting on porcelains includes: applying a painting pigment on an object to be painted; fusing, sintering and temporarily adhering an inorganic component of the painting pigment by performing scanning while modulating intensity of a converged radiant energy; and thereafter cleaning and then removing a non-adhered part, and performing calcination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Co2 methanation reaction device having co selective oxidation catalyst and removal method of co in gas
abstract_en: To provide a method and a device for producing a methane-rich gas with a lower carbon monoxide concentration and a method for reducing a carbon monoxide from a gas containing carbon monoxide and methane.SOLUTION: A method of producing a methane-rich gas PG includes adding hydrogen to a gas containing a carbon dioxide, causing a CO2 methanation reaction to obtain a gas containing primarily methane and secondarily a carbon monoxide, and adding oxygen to the obtained gas in the presence of a CO selective oxidation catalyst to perform an oxidation reaction of the carbon monoxide. Also, a method of reducing a carbon monoxide from a gas containing mainly methane and secondarily a carbon monoxide includes adding oxygen to the gas containing mainly methane and secondarily a carbon monoxide to perform an oxidation reaction of the carbon monoxide in the presence of a CO selective oxidation catalyst.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Positive electrode active material, power storage device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a positive electrode active material in which the diffusion speed of lithium is high, and a power storage device with high output. 
     SOLUTION: A positive electrode active material includes a plurality of particle aggregates, and a particle diameter of each of the plurality of aggregates is 300 nm or more and 3 μm or less. Each aggregate includes two or more particles. Each of the two or more particles in the plurality of aggregates is lithium-containing composite phosphate including one or more of iron, nickel, manganese, and cobalt. Each of a first particle and a second particle in a first aggregate includes a major axis and a minor axis on an upper surface viewed from a predetermined direction. The first particle and the second particle are disposed with their major axes arranged approximately parallel to each other when viewed from the predetermined direction. The major axis of the first particle is twice or more and six times or less the minor axis of the first particle. The minor axis of the first particle is 20 nm or more and 130 nm or less.

title_en: Water glass-coated sand
abstract_en: To provide casting sand in a dry state using sodium silicate having fluidity at ordinary temperature, requiring no high temperature steam from the outside upon molding and capable of molding a core having more sufficient strength by heating a mold for molding.SOLUTION: Casting sand in a dry state is obtained by coating a surface of casting sand with sodium silicate, sodium hydroxide and water absorptive powder, has fluidity at ordinary temperature and can mold a core by thermal hardening.

title_en: Highly concentrated highly dispersed slurry composition and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a manufacturing method of a highly concentrated highly dispersed slurry composition, the method enabling increase of a filler content in a slurry composition.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method of a highly concentrated highly dispersed slurry composition is provided, comprising: a dispersion step of preparing highly dispersed slurry composition by dispersing a filler material constituted of a spherical inorganic material having a volume average particle size of 0.1 μm or larger and 3.0 μm or smaller in a dispersion medium being liquid in such a manner that a solid content is 52 vol.% or less based on a total mass; and a separation and concentration step of continuously circulating the highly concentrated highly dispersed slurry composition to a cross-flow filter to separate a part of the dispersion medium by filtration to concentrate until the solid content becomes over 52 vol.% based on a total mass, wherein the separation and concentration step is performed under the condition that coagulation is not generated on a filter membrane surface of the cross-flow filter.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Bonding agent and use thereof
abstract_en: To provide a bonding material (active metal wax material or metal paste) which can effectively bond even a thick copper plate to a ceramic substrate at a low temperature, and can form a joint layer (or copper-pasted board) which has excellent durable reliability (thermal shock resistance) and good appearance, a copper-pasted board formed by use of this bonding material, and a method for manufacture of the same.SOLUTION: A bonding agent contains: an inactive metal component (1) containing at least one kind selected from Ag and Cu, and Sn; and an active metal component (2) containing an active metal; and an organic vehicle (3). A composition ratio [unit: atm%] of Ag, Cu and Sn prepares a metal paste existing in an area surrounded by (Ag,Cu,Sn)=(74,0,26), (67,12,21), (58,25,17), (47,40,13), (43,46,11), (33,54,13), (23,62,15), (15,65,20), (0,59,41), (0,13,87), (35,13,52), (32,6,62) and (29,0,71) on triangular coordinates or at an outer edge thereof.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Colloid containing platinum group supported on microwave-treated carrier, colloid containing platinum group supported on sulfonated carbon carrier, colloid containing platinum group supported on water repellent-treated tin oxide carrier, and high concentration continuous synthetic method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing platinum group fine particles supported on a carbon carrier, which enables a sulfonation treatment of a carbon carrier and a water repellent treatment of an oxide carrier to be performed in a short time, enables a metal fine particle catalyst supported on a surface-modified carrier to be synthesized efficiently, improves characteristics of gas diffusion, hydrogen ion conduction, and water management in a solid polymer fuel cell, and reduces production cost.SOLUTION: Provided is a high-performance and inexpensive method for producing a metal fine particle catalyst supported on a surface-modified carrier, by which a sulfonation treatment of a carbon carrier and a water repellent treatment of an oxide carrier can be performed with high productivity by using a microwave continuous method and by appropriately selecting a solvent, reaction conditions, and microwave irradiation conditions.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Induction heating device and manufacturing method of bearing
abstract_en: To provide an induction heating device that can precisely control the temperature of an object to a desired temperature by passing an induced current of the originally required amount when a steel part is induced and heated, and a manufacturing method of a bearing using the induction heating device.SOLUTION: An induction heating device 100 includes an inverter 10, an output load 40, and a transformer 20. The transformer 20 is provided between an inverter 10 and an output load 40. The transformer 20 includes an output coil 21b and a plurality of taps 22 capable of switching the output coil 21b to different turns. The plurality of taps 22 includes a first tap 22a and a second tap 22b. The transformer 20 further includes a switching mechanism 23 that can switch between the first state in which the output coil 21b is connected by the first tap 22a and the second state in which the output coil 21b is connected by the second tap 22b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Optical glass, optical element composed of optical glass, optical system, interchangeable lens and optical device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical glass that allows vitrification even if its composition is controlled to have an increased refractive index. 
     SOLUTION: In the inventive optical glass, by mol% in terms of cations, the total amount of La 3+ , Y 3+ , and Gd 3+  components is 5-65%, and the total amount of Zr 4+ , Hf 4+ , and Ta 5+  components is 5-65%, and the relation represented by the formula (1) holds true. (La 3+ +Y 3+ +Gd 3+ )×(Zr 4+ +Hf 4+ +Ta 5+ )≥400 (1). 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
