title_en: Flash device and residue extraction method after stop of operation thereof
abstract_en: To provide a flash device and a method for efficiently extracting a residue such as a leach residue left inside a flash tank.SOLUTION: A flash device 9 is positioned on a downstream side of an autoclave 4 which performs exudation processing with a sulfuric acid in a high temperature/high pressure condition on ore slurry which is prepared by adding water to ore including metal, receives the exuded high temperature and high pressure slurry generated by the exudation processing, and flashes the same. The flash device comprises: a flash tank 10 for separating steam generated by the flash into a gas and liquid, and discharging the exuded low temperature and low pressure slurry after the flash by overflow; and a supply pipeline system 20 for high pressure gas and industrial water which is coupled to a drain pipe 13 coupled to a bottom drain nozzle of the flash tank 10 through a partition valve 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Particle containing aluminum alloy
abstract_en: To provide a particle that has a mixed phase of two types of aluminum alloy in the form of a primary particle.SOLUTION: A particle containing aluminum alloy, in a primary particle state, is generally spherical and comprises a mixed phase of a phase represented by a composition MxAly and a phase represented by MzAlw, where M is of a metal other than Al, 0<x<1, 0<y<1, 0<z<1, 0<w<1, x/y≥1, z/w<1, and x+y=1, z+w=1, in which the content of aluminum is in a range of 8 mass% to 50 mass%.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hydrocarbon adsorbent and method for adsorbing hydrocarbon
abstract_en: To provide a hydrocarbon adsorbent showing high hydrocarbon absorption performance at low temperature and excellent in hydrocarbon sustained releasability accompanying temperature rise after reaching a desorption start temperature, and a method for adsorbing hydrocarbon using the same.SOLUTION: A hydrocarbon adsorbent includes two or more kinds of alkali metals and zeolite having a ring structure having 10 or more membered-rings. The molar ratio of sodium to the total amount of the two or more kinds of alkali metals is 0.1 or more and 0.9 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Polishing method, method for producing metal die-cast article, polishing device, computer program and controller
abstract_en: To provide a polishing method that can suitably polish even a member of interest having a complicated surface, and a method for producing a metal die-cast article, a polishing device, a computer program and a controller.SOLUTION: A polishing method has a step for polishing a surface of a workpiece W held by a robot arm 20 so that a brush B, a rotating polisher, moves over it. The robot arm has a flexible drive mechanism. The workpiece W is a metal die-cast molding to be polished.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of manufacturing hot-rolled steel sheet
abstract_en: To provide a method capable of increasing productivity by enabling a pickling load to be reduced because the occurrence of internal oxidation of high-tension steel sheet can be inhibited by a totally new method.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a hot-rolled steel sheet is characterized as follows: a steel material including 0.5-2.0 mass% of Si, 1.0-3.0 mass% of Mn and 0.1-2.0 mass% of Al is hot-rolled to be turned into the hot-rolled steel sheet; and an Sn inclusion adheres to a surface of the hot-rolled steel sheet prior to a roll-up step in and after a final descaling step, when the hot-rolled steel sheet is rolled up in a coil form.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for increasing the purity of iron(ii) chloride
abstract_en: To provide a method for increasing the purity of iron(II) chloride that can increase the purity of iron(II) chloride with a high recovery rate.SOLUTION: A method for increasing the purity of iron(II) chloride includes a step (A) for heating and concentrating a solution containing iron(II) chloride to yield a concentrate, and a step (B) for cooling the concentrate while stirring it, resulting in crystal of iron(II) chloride 4-hydrate. In the step (B), the cooling is performed at a cooling rate of 0.01°C/min to 1°C/min. In the step (B), the stirring is performed at 10 rpm to 80 rpm.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Sodium ferrite particle powder and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a sodium ferrite particle powder that adsorbs carbon dioxide in a temperature range from room temperature to 100°C, can recover carbon dioxide by heating at 150°C or lower, and has superior moldability and processability, and a method for producing the particle powder.SOLUTION: A sodium ferrite particle powder contains at least one divalent metal acid sodium selected from divalent metal acid sodiums composed of Na2[Zn(OH)4] and Na2SnO2 of 1 wt.%-20 wt.% with the molar ratio of Na/Fe being 1.0-1.5.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: secondary battery
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide immobilized selenium body and its production method. 
     SOLUTION: A method for producing an immobilized selenium system or an immobilized selenium body includes steps of: (a) mixing selenium and carbon to form a selenium-carbon mixture; and (b) heating the mixture of step (a) to a temperature higher than the melting temperature of selenium; and (c) forming an immobilized selenium body by cooling the heated mixture of step (b) to ambient or room temperature. The immobilized selenium body makes selenium more stable than selenium by itself, requiring higher temperatures or higher kinetic energies for selenium to separate from the immobilized selenium body and enter a gas system. Immobilized selenium localized in a carbon skeleton may be utilized in a secondary battery. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Floating power generation unit
abstract_en: To provide a floating power generation unit capable of improving fishing ground by promoting growth of plankton by increasing activity of aerobic organisms by spreading oxygen content into water as fine bubbles while carrying out floating power generation.SOLUTION: A floating power generation unit 1 including a power generator 2, and an oxygen separator 3 for separating oxygen and nitrogen in air by using power supplied by the power generator 2, and a float 4 floating on water is installed with the power generator 2 and the oxygen separator 3 on a top surface of a float 4 includes: a first fine bubbles generation medium 33 for supplying oxygen separated by the oxygen separator 3 as fine bubbles into water; and a second fine bubbles generation medium 34 for supplying nitrogen separated by the oxygen separator 3 as fine bubbles into water.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cement admixture, cement admixture manufacturing method, and cement composition
abstract_en: To provide a cement admixture that has excellent fire resistance and has excellent residual ratios of compressive strength and Young's modulus after heat receiving, as well as excellent neutralization resistance after heat receiving.SOLUTION: A cement admixture of the invention contains a dicalcium silicate compound having an average particle size of 5 to 100 μm as measured by microscopic observation and an average aspect ratio expressed as (major axis diameter/minor axis diameter) of 1.3 or greater.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Yag ceramics-joined body and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a joined body formed by joining a YAG ceramic with a YAG ceramic or a joined body formed by joining the YAG ceramic with an optical glass, which suppresses reflection of light at a joined interface, and to provide a method of manufacturing the same. 
     SOLUTION: A YAG ceramic joint body formed by joining a YAG ceramic with either a YAG ceramic or an optical glass has a glass as a joined layer, wherein a rate of change in transmission is within 7%. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: None 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Circuit board and semiconductor device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a circuit board and a semiconductor device capable of improving bonding strength. 
     SOLUTION: A circuit board of an embodiment includes a substrate, a metallic member having a circuit form, and a joint layer. The joint layer is provided between the substrate and the metallic member. The joint layer includes a first particle including a carbon layer, a first region including metal, and a second region including titanium. The second region is provided between the first particle and the first region. A mass concentration of titanium in the second region is higher than a mass concentration of titanium in the first region. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method for manufacturing flexible meshing-type gear device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately set the hardness of an internal gear. 
     SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a flexible meshing-type gear device including an excitation body 10A, an external gear 12 to be deflected and deformed by the excitation body, an internal gear 23g with the external gear engaged therewith, and a main bearing 33 for supporting the internal gear includes a groove formation step for forming an internal tooth of the internal gear at an inner periphery, and forming a groove for forming an inner ring rolling surface to a formation material of an internal gear member on which the inner ring rolling surface of the main bearing is integrally provided at an outer periphery, a first heat treatment step for performing first heat treatment to the formation material, a second heat treatment step for performing second heat treatment to a groove for forming the inner ring rolling surface of the formation material after the first heat treatment step, and an internal gear formation step for forming the internal tooth after the second heat treatment step. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Reflux tube fitting structure in lower tank of vacuum degassing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a reflux tube fitting structure to a lower tank of a vacuum degassing apparatus, even when a steel sheet covering each reflux tube is tilted by thermal deformation, capable of easily fitting the same to a lower face of an isolation part of a lower tank without executing many cuttings to the isolation part and each reflux tube and easily executing the replacement operation of each eroded reflux tube.SOLUTION: In a lower tank 1 of a vacuum degassing apparatus, an insole part 3 is formed into a thick planar shape obtained by drilling a through hole with reflux tubes 5, 5, also the circumference of the through hole with the reflux tubes 5, 5 in a lower face of the isolation part 3 is formed into a recessed spherical shape, and the surface of each reflux tube 5, 5 is formed into a projecting spherical shape with a curvature radius same as that of the recessed spherical face at the lower face of the insole part 3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Recovery method of non-ferrous metal waste
abstract_en: To provide a technique of efficiently recovering non-ferrous metal waste from burned ash.SOLUTION: A recovery method of non-ferrous metal waste comprises: a preparation step of preparing burned ash including a soot dust sticking object in which soot dust sticks to a surface of the non-ferrous metal waste; a magnetic force selection step of applying magnetic force selection to the burned ash and separating it into a magnetized material and a non-magnetized material including the soot dust sticking object to obtain the non-magnetized material; an eddy current selection step of applying eddy current selection to the non-magnetized material and separating it into a conductive product including the soot dust sticking object and a non-conductive product to obtain the conductive product; a washing step of rotationally washing the conductive product under the existence of water by supplying it to a rotational washing device and removing soot dust from the soot dust sticking object to obtain slurry including non-ferrous metal waste; a solid-liquid separation step of applying solid-liquid separation to the slurry to obtain a solid content; and a recovery step of applying classification or hue selection to the solid content to recover the non-ferrous metal waste.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing cylindrical structure
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a large-sized cylindrical structure by fiber-reinforced concrete.SOLUTION: Fiber-reinforced concrete is prepared, the orientation of fibers in the fiber-reinforced concrete is controlled, and it is installed into a cylindrical form. When the thickness of the cylinder is below 300 mm, the installation is executed from a place based on mobility in a horizontal direction using a tremie pipe 11, and when the thickness is 300 mm or more, the installation is executed by free fall from a hopper 10. When the installation is executed by free fall, the height of the free fall is 3 m or less. When the installation is executed by the tremie pipe 11, it is executed while rotating the tremie pipe 11 or the cylindrical structure itself. Regarding concrete used for the fiber-reinforced concrete, a water-binder ratio (W/B) is controlled to a range of 10 to 20%, the usage of a high performance water-reducing agent is controlled to a range of 1 to 2% with respect to the binder, and a flow value is controlled to a range of 240 to 320 mm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method of manufacturing rolling sliding member
abstract_en: To provide a method of manufacturing a rolling sliding member having a small hydrogen content and sufficient hardness.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a rolling sliding member includes: (1) a step of preparing a workpiece made of a high carbon chromium bearing steel material in substantially the same shape as the rolling sliding member; (2) a quenching step of heating the workpiece so that the entire workpiece is heated to 820-880°C and then rapidly cooling the heated workpiece; and (3) a tempering step of heating the quenched workpiece in an air atmosphere so that the entire workpiece is heated to 160-180°C, soaking the heated workpiece for 8 hours or more, and air-cooling the soaked workpiece.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method for producing sintered body having carbon dioxide absorbed
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a sintered body having carbon dioxide absorbed, which can, when producing the sintered body having carbon dioxide absorbed by letting carbon dioxide absorbed by using a mixture obtained by mixing coal ash and a Ca source, increase an absorption amount of carbon dioxide by the sintered body.SOLUTION: When producing a sintered body having carbon dioxide absorbed by irradiating a mixture, obtained by mixing coal ash (for example, fly ash) with a Ca source (for example, waste concrete), with microwave under a carbon dioxide atmosphere to raise the temperature to a sintering temperature or higher, the microwave is configured to be irradiated with water added to the mixture.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Aluminum alloys for fluxless brazing applications, methods of making the same, and uses thereof
abstract_en: To provide improved clad aluminum alloys and brazing processes that can produce a sound brazing joint with other metal parts without the use of flux.SOLUTION: Provided are new aluminum alloys for use as one or more cladding layer(s) in clad aluminum alloy products for brazing applications. The cladding layer(s) include constituents that break and remove an oxide film on metal parts to be joined to produce high-strength brazing joints without the use of corrosive flux. Also provided herein are corrosion-resistant aluminum sheet packages including one or more of the aluminum alloy cladding layer(s) and an aluminum alloy core.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Zirconia composition, and method of producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a calcined body easier to process than a conventional one, with a suppressed difference of hardness among production lots, a method of producing the same, a sintered body produced thereby, and at least some of zirconia compositions that can be a raw material of a calcined body such as this one.SOLUTION: A zirconia composition includes one or more of first transition metal elements selected from the group consisting of manganese (Mn), iron (Fe), cobalt (Co), nickel (Ni), copper (Cu), molybdenum (Mo), technetium (Tc), ruthenium (Ru), rhodium (Rh), palladium (Pd), and silver (Ag), at least any of coloring elements selected from lanthanoid rare earth elements and second rare earth metal elements different from the kinds of the first rare earth metal elements, and stabilizing element-containing zirconia, with a content of the first transition metal elements being 100 mass ppm or more, and a content of the second transition metal elements being less than 100 mass ppm.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Window glass for vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a window glass for vehicle in which a crack from a chamfered part is suppressed even in the case of being installed to a vehicle of a molding-less mode.SOLUTION: A window glass for vehicle includes a glass plate having a first principal plane, a second principal plane and an end face, where the glass plate is arranged on a vehicle such that the first principal plane faces outside the vehicle, the second principal plane faces inside the vehicle. The glass plate has: a first chamfered part in which at least a part of the first principal plane side of the end face is chamfered; and a second chamfered part in which at least a part of the second principal plane side of the end face is chamfered, and the first chamfered part is coated by an ink layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: S-containing stainless steel with excellent surface properties and producing method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a S-containing stainless steel with excellent surface properties, achieved by precisely controlling the composition of oxide inclusions and rendering the oxide inclusions harmless.SOLUTION: A S-containing stainless steel comprises, by mass%: C: 0.30 wt.% or less, Si: 0.2-1.0 wt.%, Mn: 1.0-2.0 wt.%, Ni: 5-10 wt.%, Cr: 15-20 wt.%, Mo: 0.05-0.60 wt.%, Cu: 0.05-0.60 wt.%, Al: 0.005 wt.% or less, S: 0.15-0.25 wt.%, Ca: 0.0001-0.0035 wt.%, Mg: 0.0010 wt.% or less, O: 0.0020-0.0080 wt.% (excluding 0.0080 wt.%), with the balance being Fe and inevitable impurities, wherein oxide inclusions consist of one or two among CaO-SiO2-MgO-Al2O3-MnO-based inclusions and MgO-Al2O3-MnO-based inclusions, and the MgO-Al2O3-MnO-based inclusions contain 1-15 wt.% of MnO.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for predicting sintered ore quality and method for producing sintered ore therewith
abstract_en: To provide a method for predicting sintered ore quality capable of managing a yield by capturing a melting rate of sintered ore online and a method for producing sintered ore therewith.SOLUTION: In a method for predicting the quality of sintered ore produced by sintering a loading layer by forming the loading layer by loading a sintered raw material into an endless mobile pallet trolley of a Dwight-Lloyd type sintering machine, the sintering temperature history in the loading layer is calculated using the sintered ore manufacturing conditions and heat transfer model, the melting rate of the sintered ore is predicted using the calculated sintering temperature history and chemical components, and the yield is predicted from the melting rate of the predicted sintered ore.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of manufacturing mold, system for manufacturing mold and method of manufacturing casting
abstract_en: To provide a technique for reducing deformation of a mold containing liquid glass during pouring of melt.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a mold, for manufacturing a mold containing a binder consisting of liquid glass, includes the steps of making up a mold, de-molding the made-up mold, and dehydration-treating the de-molded mold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Glass including crystal phase
abstract_en: To provide a glass that includes a crystal phase having high transparency.SOLUTION: A glass that includes a crystal phase is such that: when in an X-ray diffraction spectrum obtained by an X-ray diffraction method, a diffraction intensity of a diffraction peak existing at a position of a diffraction angle 2θ=23.50°-24.00°is I1, a diffraction intensity of the diffraction peak existing at a position of a diffraction angle 2θ=24.05°-24.55°is I2, a diffraction intensity of the diffraction peak existing at a position of a diffraction angle 2θ=24.60°-25.05°is I3, and a diffraction intensity of the diffraction peak existing at a position of a diffraction angle 2θ=25.20°-26.60°is I4, (I3+I4)/(I1+I2) is 1.60 or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Stone-tone building material panel
abstract_en: To provide (1) dry building material panels that combine practical adhesion/surface strength, non-combustibility, and designability, (2) to provide a dry building material panel that uses a flexible base material, has sufficient bending properties and non-combustibility, and can be applied to non-planar wall surfaces, and (3) to provide dry building material panels where stone-tone decorations are applied to surfaces thereof.SOLUTION: (1) It was confirmed that building material panels with desired adhesion/surface strength, non-combustibility, and designability can be produced by mixing water and vinyl acetate resin into cement at a ratio within a predetermined range. (2) It was confirmed that building material panels with desired adhesion/surface strength, non-combustibility, bending performance and designability can be produced even when coated on a non-combustible flexible substrate by mixing cement with water and vinyl acetate resin at a ratio within a predetermined ratio. (3) Stone-tone decorations are applied to surfaces of these building panels by UV printing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Silsesquioxane polymer and coating composition comprising the same
abstract_en: To provide a silsesquioxane polymer that is applied to coat a glass base material so as to improve the strength of the glass base material, and a coating composition comprising the same.SOLUTION: A silsesquioxane polymer includes repeating units of the following formulae, where R1s are each independently hydrogen, deuterium, halogen, an amine group, an epoxy group, a hydroxy group, a thiol group, an isocyanate group, a nitrile group, a nitro group, and an organic group, and R2s are each independently hydrogen, deuterium, halogen, an isocyanate group and an organic group.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing single-walled carbon nanotube
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a carbon nanotube capable of more conveniently obtaining a single-walled carbon nanotube.SOLUTION: A method for producing single-walled carbon nanotubes of the invention includes following steps: a first step of cleaning a metal substrate 50; a second step of forming an Al2O3 buffer layer 51 on the surface of the metal substrate 50; a third step of depositing Ir (iridium) 20 on the surface of the Al2O3 buffer layer 51; and a fourth step of performing CVD.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hydrogen peroxide-decomposing composite material and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a hydrogen peroxide-decomposing composite material that exhibits sustained catalytic activity for decomposing hydrogen peroxide, along with suppressed decomposition in aqueous solutions and a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: A hydrogen peroxide-decomposing composite material includes a solid support and a composite bound to the solid support, wherein the composite is capable of catalyzing the reaction that decomposes hydrogen peroxide into oxygen and water, and wherein the composite is formed from a polyvinyl imidazole, where the nitrogen at the 3-position of the imidazole ring is unsubstituted, or in some imidazole rings, the nitrogen at the 3-position is bound to an alkyl group or an alkenyl group, which is complexed with a metal porphyrin compound, where the central metal of the porphyrin structure is a manganese atom, an iron atom, a copper atom, or a selenium atom.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Lithium metal complex oxide, cathode active material for lithium secondary battery, cathode for lithium secondary battery, and lithium secondary battery
abstract_en: To provide a lithium metal complex oxide capable of improving a discharge capacity at a high rate.SOLUTION: In a lithium metal complex oxide having a pore, a relation dV1≤1.00×10-4 is satisfied by a maximum value dV1 of dVp/ddp, being a ratio of an increment of a pore volume Vp of the pore to an increment of a pore size dp within a range where a relation "dap/ddp≤0.10" is satisfied by a ratio dap/ddp of an increment of a pore surface area ap of a pore to an increment of a pore size dp of the pore. A relation dV2≥1.00×10-4 is satisfied by a maximum value dV2 of dVp/ddp within a range where a relation of "dap/ddp>0.10" is satisfied.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for producing hydraulic hardening body
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a hydraulic hardening body that has a high level of CO2 fixation and excellent workability.SOLUTION: A method of the present invention for producing a hydraulic hardening body includes: a mixing step of mixing water, blended cement, carbonate, and an organic retarder to obtain a fluid composition; and a hardening step of hardening the fluid composition obtained in the mixing step to obtain the hydraulic hardening body, wherein: the blended cement includes cement, and one or more selected from the group consisting of a blast furnace slag fine powder, γ-C2S and fly ash; and in the fluid composition, a content ratio of the carbonate to the blended cement ((content of carbonate)×100/( content of blended cement)) is 8.0% or more and 60.0% or less, and a content ratio of the organic retarder to the blended cement ((content of organic retarder)×100/( content of blended cement)) is 0.05% or more and 2.00% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Stainless steel material
abstract_en: To provide a stainless steel material which has good penetration property, can suppress occurrence of slag spots and has an inclusion form suitable for weldability.SOLUTION: A stainless steel material has a predetermined component composition and satisfies the following Expression A and Expression B, wherein an average composition of an oxide-based inclusion of a surface layer satisfies Expression C and Expression D, thereby stabilizes a cathode point, and adopts a method for controlling amounts of MgO, Al2O3, CaO and Ti2O3 of the whole stainless steel material in such a way that the amounts are constant amounts or less, and thereby prevents a slag spot and has good penetration property. Expression A: Ca/(Mg+Al/5)≥0.3, Expression B: Ti/10+Al/5+Ca+Mg/2≤0.003, Expression C: 0.20≤CaO/(CaO+MgO+Al2O3)≤0.80, and Expression D: (MgO+Al2O3+CaO+Ti2O3)/(MgO+Al2O3+SiO2+CaO+Ti2O3+Cr2O3+MnO)≤0.50.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Material for aluminum alloy forging, aluminum alloy forged product and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a material for aluminum alloy forging with superior mechanical properties at room temperature, an aluminum alloy forged product and a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: An aluminum alloy forged product has an alloy composition where the ratio (Fe/Mn) of Fe content to Mn content is from 0.3 to 1.2 in mass ratio, with the balance being Al and unavoidable impurities. The cross section of the longitudinal boundary between a long part and a connection part is free of AIFeSi(Mn) compounds with average crystal grain sizes in the alloy structure ranging from 5 μm to 60 μm and average particle sizes of at least 2.0 μm. For fatigue characteristics at room temperature, the fatigue limit at 107 cycles of fracture repetition is at least 150 MPa.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Quality determination method of mixed cement for low carbon type concrete, and method for manufacturing mixed cement for low carbon type concrete
abstract_en: To provide a quality determination method capable of confirming 28-day mortar compression strength of mixed cement for low carbon type concrete within a short period, and a method for manufacturing mixed cement for low carbon type concrete using the quality determination method.SOLUTION: A quality determination method of mixed cement for low carbon type concrete having a content of Portland cement in mixed cement of more than 0 mass% and 55 mass% or less, in which the mixed cement contains Portland cement and a mixed material, and has a correlation between 28-day mortar compression strength (Y) of a plurality of mixed cement for a calibration curve having a changed content ratio of the mixed material and 28-day mortar compression strength (Y) of the mixed cement for the calibration curve, wherein the method previously determines a relational expression with a physical property value (X) of the mixed cement for the calibration curve accelerated and cured by heating, and determines a physical property value (X) of mixed cement for low carbon type concrete of a sample to be inspected.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method of measuring equilibrium distribution coefficient of alloy with component that undergoes peritectic reaction during solidification
abstract_en: To enable determination of an equilibrium distribution coefficient of an alloy with a component that undergoes a peritectic reaction during solidification.SOLUTION: A method of determining an equilibrium distribution coefficient is provided, comprising melting an alloy that undergoes a peritectic reaction during solidification, unidirectionally solidifying the alloy into the state with a solid phase region, liquid phase region, and a region being solidified, cooling the alloy to fix its structure, and deriving the equilibrium distribution coefficient corresponding to a solid phase ratio for each of a solidified structure before the peritectic reaction and a solidified structure after the peritectic reaction in the fixed structure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title_en: Paving block including improved illumination
abstract_en: To provide a manufacturing method of photoluminescent paving block including improved illumination.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method for paving block including an embedded photoluminescent material comprises the steps of: (A) combining sand, aggregate, water, and cement to form uncured concrete; (B) providing polyester resin combined with photoluminescent pigment; (C) preparing randomly sized chips or particulates by crushing the polyester resin after being cured to form photoluminescent polyester resin mixture fragments; (D) combining the resin mixture fragments, cement, and water to form uncured photoluminescent mixture; (E) providing a paving block mold; (F) charging the uncured concrete formed in step (A) to the paving block mold to obtain a concrete base layer; and (G) charging the uncured photoluminescent mixture formed in step (D) to the paving block mold so as to substantially fill it to obtain a photoluminescent layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Titanium sheet and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a titanium sheet made of industrial pure titanium that exhibits both excellent Young's modulus and formability.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a titanium sheet, wherein the chemical composition is, in mass%, O: 0.20% or less, Fe: 0.20% or less, N: 0.08% or less, C: 0.08% or less, H: 0.015% or less, balance: Ti and impurities; and the metal structure includes T-texture and Split-TD-Texture, with an area ratio of T-texture being 5-30%, and an area ratio of Split-TD-Texture being 30% or more.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Fe-BASED ALLOY POWDER FOR LAMINATE MOLDING AND LAMINATE MOLDED OBJECT
abstract_en: To provide an Fe-based alloy powder for laminate molding which has excellent crack resistance and mold performance by further improving thermal conductivity of a maraging steel.SOLUTION: An Fe-based alloy powder for laminate molding is formed of an Fe-based alloy that includes, by mass% and as essential components, 10.0 to 16.0% of Ni, 6.0% or less of Mo, 0.5 to 2.5% of Ti, 0.01 to 1.0% of Al, 0.8% or less of Si, and 0.8% or less of Mn, and further includes, as optional additional components, 6.0% or less of Cr and other elements, with the balance being Fe and unavoidable impurities, wherein a value of M1 in formula (1): M1=Ni+0.8Cr+0.6Mo-0.3Ti is 13.0 or more, and a value of M2 in formula (2): M2=41.9-0.9Ni-2.0Mo-2.1Cr is 17.0 or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing molten steel and arc furnace
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing molten steel by which a denitrification reaction can efficiently be caused when an oxygen jet flow is injected to molten iron in an arc furnace and a carbonaceous material is supplied.SOLUTION: A method for producing molten steel according to the present disclosure includes injecting an oxygen jet flow from oxygen feeding means to molten iron in an arc furnace, and supplying a carbonaceous material from carbonaceous material supplying means toward a position P1. The central axis of the oxygen jet flow is inclined with respect to the horizontal plane including the stationary molten iron surface. The position P1 is on the horizontal plane and outside a collision surface between the oxygen jet flow and the horizontal plane. An angle θ1 formed by a line segment P1 P3 connecting the position P1 and an intersection point P3 and a line segment P2 P3 connecting an intersection point P2 and an intersection point P3 is 0° or more and 90° or less. The intersection point P2 is an intersection point between a perpendicular line drawn from the tip of the oxygen feeding means to the horizontal plane and the horizontal plane, and the intersection point P3 is an intersection point between the central axis of the oxygen jet flow and the horizontal plane.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Co2 fixation equipment and co2 fixation method
abstract_en: To provide CO2 fixation equipment and a CO2 fixation method, each enabling reduction of cost related to equipment and energy associated with CO2 fixation, and furthermore enabling improvement of the precipitation efficiency of alkaline earth metal carbonates.SOLUTION: One or more decompression tanks and a crystallization tank connected in series are arranged in downstream side of an extraction tank that extracts alkaline earth metals. Alkaline earth metal carbonates are precipitated while performing stepwise decompression in the decompression tanks and the crystallization tank. The alkaline earth metal carbonates precipitated in the decompression tank are supplied to the crystallization tank as seed crystals. CO2 gas generated in the decompression tanks and the crystallization tank is pressurized and supplied to the extraction tank.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hollow silica particles containing aluminum atoms and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a hollow silica sol for mixing hollow silica particles with good compatibility with organic solvents and resins, where aluminum atoms are bound to the surface of the hollow silica particles in a specific proportion in terms of Al2O3.SOLUTION: The invention provides hollow silica particles having a space inside an outer shell. The hollow silica particles contain aluminum atoms forming aluminosilicate sites. According to measurements by a leaching method, the aluminum atoms are bound to the surface of the hollow silica particles in a proportion (A) of 100 to 20000 ppm/SiO2 per gram of SiO2 in terms of Al2O3 of the hollow silica particles. The leaching method calculates the proportion (A) of compounds containing aluminum atoms bound to the surface of the hollow silica particles, where the particles have been leached using an aqueous solution of at least one mineral acid selected from the group consisting of sulfuric acid, nitric acid and hydrochloric acid, expressed as Al2O3 per gram of SiO2 of the hollow silica particles.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for producing inorganic oxide hollow particles
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing inorganic oxide hollow particles capable of efficiently producing fine particles while suppressing generation of coarse particles.SOLUTION: A method for producing inorganic oxide hollow particles comprises sending a raw material compound-containing solution to a spray apparatus, spraying droplets of the raw material compound-containing solution from the spray apparatus, and thermally decomposing the same, the method further comprising adjusting a surface tension of the raw material compound-containing solution to 25 to 55 mN/m.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Mold flux for continuous casting of steel and continuous casting method
abstract_en: To disclose a mold flux capable of reducing enlargement of a rim during continuous casting of steel.SOLUTION: In a base material of the present disclosure which constitutes the mold flux: a SiO2 concentration WSiO2 is 20.0 mass% or more and 45.0 mass% or less; a CaO concentration WCaO is 30.0 mass% or more and 55.0 mass% or less; a Li2O concentration WLi2O is less than 2.0 mass%; a Na2O concentration WNa2O is 4.0 mass% or more and 10.0 mass% or less; a K2O concentration WK2O is 1.0 mass% or less; a total of WLi2O, WNa2O, and WK2O is 4.0 mass% or more and 10.0 mass% or less; a MnO concentration WMnO is 2.0 mass% or less; an F concentration WF is 5.0 mass% or more and 15.0 mass% or less; and a total concentration of other components is 10.0 mass% or less, wherein the base material also satisfies 1.6≤WCaO/WSiO2<1.8. A ratio of a premelted base material to the base material is less than 30 mass% or 70 mass% or more.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Liquid dispersion and powder of cerium-based core-shell particles, method for producing same and use thereof in polishing
abstract_en: To provide a dispersion of cerium-based core-shell particles having improved polishing characteristics when used in a chemical mechanical polishing process.SOLUTION: A dispersion of cerium-based core-shell particles in a liquid, each cerium-based core-shell particle having a core particle made of cerium oxide optionally doped with at least one metal (M) and a shell consisting of a plurality of nanoparticles of cerium oxide optionally doped with at least one metal (M '), said nanoparticles being formed on the surface of said core particle, wherein the ratio of the average particle size of said core-shell particles as measured by TEM to the average particle size of said core-shell particles as measured by BET is at least 1.5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Surface-modified inorganic oxide powder and process for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a powder having both of a good spacer effect and proper electrostatic charge characteristics while maintaining excellent characteristics of an inorganic oxide powder by a fumed method.SOLUTION: The powder has the following physical properties: (1) a mean particle size of 0.1 to 1 μ m, (2) a bulk density of 20 to 100g / L, (3) a hydrophobicity of 60% or more, (4) a water adsorption at a water vapor relative pressure of 0.8 to 0.95 of 2 to 5%, (5) a BET specific surface area of 25 to 150m2 / g, and (6) a carbon atom content of 0.5 to 8% by weight. (7) a nitrogen content of 0.1 to 0.75% by weight, and (8) a triboelectric charge amount of 20 to 300 μ C / g SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Process for producing sodium hydrogencarbonate
abstract_en: To provide a method for efficiently producing sodium hydrogencarbonate from the viewpoint of energy saving and effective utilization of resources.SOLUTION: A method for producing sodium hydrogen carbonate, comprising: supplying water, carbon dioxide, and a solid sodium-based carbonate to a first aqueous slurry containing solid sodium hydrogen carbonate or a first aqueous sodium hydrogen carbonate solution to produce a second aqueous slurry containing solid sodium hydrogen carbonate.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Carbon manufacturing apparatus using silk balls
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a carbon manufacturing apparatus using a silk ball for manufacturing a carbon body which generates a high added value by carbonizing the silk ball at a high temperature and, more specifically, to a carbon manufacturing apparatus using a silk ball, comprising: a glass tube (10) in a form of a circular tube; a kiln (20); a vacuum suction unit (31); and a nitrogen gas injector (35).

title_en: Latex modified ultra quick-hardening concrete composition having improved durability with graphite and maintenance and construction method of bridge deck and road pavement surface using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a latex-modified fast-hardening concrete composition having improved durability, and a method for repairing bridges and roads using the same, wherein the latex-modified fast-hardening concrete composition comprises 20 to 55 wt% of a coarse aggregate, 30 to 65 wt% of a fine aggregate, 10 to 30 wt% of a fast-hardening cement binder, 1 to 10 wt% of a latex modifier, and 1 to 10 wt% of mixed water. The curing speed of concrete is significantly improved, and thus high strength performance is secured while a traffic control time is minimized.

title_en: Method for manufacturing ball wire for jewelry using shape memory alloy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ball wire for jewelry, and more particularly, to a method for manufacturing a ball wire for jewelry using a shape memory alloy, the method which, when manufacturing a ball wire by forming a plurality of balls continuously using a mold on a wire that is a shape memory alloy heat-treated into a desired shape, winds the wire on a frame according to a diameter to be formed and evenly heat-treats the inner and outer sides of the winding during a heat-treatment process so as to obtain a uniform shape of the shape memory alloy and thereby manufacture the ball wire capable of maintaining the shape while minimizing slack when worn. To this end, the method for manufacturing a ball wire for jewelry using a shape memory alloy according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a wire manufacturing step for manufacturing a wire out of a shape memory alloy material; a heat-treating step for fixing the wire to a mold frame and applying heat to heat-treat the wire to be formed into the shape of the mold frame; a washing step for washing off foreign materials such as soot on the wire formed through the heat-treating step; a plate supply step for supplying a plate to the outside of the wire; a drawing step for drawing the plate to wrap around the wire; and a ball forming step for pressing the plate wrapping around the wire in a tubular form so that a ball shape is gradually formed and separated.

title_en: Eco-friendly pedestrian road block with improved far-infrared radiation, antibacterial properties and rigidity and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a block for an environmentally friendly pedestrian road and a manufacturing method thereof. More specifically, according to the present invention, the block for a pedestrian road satisfies a waste material usage rate to accord with environmental label certification standards, thereby being environmentally friendly and enhancing far-infrared radioactivity, antibacterial properties and rigidity such as bending strength or the like.

title_en: Equipment operation system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an equipment operating system. The equipment operating system comprises: a hyper-connected collaboration platform that manages a plurality of projects related to mold manufacturing and monitors a mold manufacturing production status; a big data platform that matches similar design drawings between design drawing images included in the plurality of mold manufacturing projects stored in the hyper-connected collaboration platform and design drawing images included in a new mold manufacturing project to generate estimate information for the new mold manufacturing project; and an IoT model factory platform that acquires sensor data collected from a plurality of sensors provided in mold manufacturing equipment and considers analysis results of predicting a failure of the mold manufacturing equipment using the sensor data to control an operation of the mold manufacturing equipment. The equipment operating system can support corporates to improve competitiveness by increasing collaboration efficiency and supporting decision-making.

title_en: Carbon dioxide reduction device
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a carbon dioxide reduction device which comprises: an absorption tower with an exhaust port formed at the top and an internal space; a treated water distribution unit installed in the absorption tower and having an inlet and an outlet through which the treated water containing carbon dioxide flows through the side of the absorption tower; a solution injection unit installed on the upper side of the treated water distribution unit of the absorption tower to spray a reaction solution containing calcium ions into gas containing carbon dioxide that evaporates and rises from the treated water; a reaction solution supply unit supplying the reaction solution to the injection unit; a reaction tank connected to the outlet of the treated water distribution unit, wherein the treated water and mixed water containing the treated water and the reaction solution that falls after reacting with the gas flow thereinto; and a precipitation unit installed in the reaction tank and immersed in the mixed water to precipitate calcium carbonate obtained by reaction between carbon dioxide and calcium ions contained in the mixed water. Accordingly, carbon dioxide included in water subjected to sewage treatment is reduced and at the same time, malodorous gas or harmful gas is reduced or removed.

title_en: Method for efficient leaching of valuable metal from copper anode slime by addition of graphite and valuable metal recovered therefrom
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for efficient leaching of valuable metals from copper anode slime by addition of graphite and valuable metals recovered thereby, wherein, when leaching valuable metals including copper (Cu), nickel (Ni), tellurium (Te), selenium (Se), or silver (Ag) contained in anode slime generated in a copper electrolytic refining process, manganese dioxide is used as an oxidizing agent and graphite is used as a leaching enhancing catalyst to significantly improve the leaching efficiency of the valuable metals.

title_en: High-efficiency lithium recovery method from low-concentration lithium waste liquid through process improvement and lithium carbonate manufactured thereby
abstract_en: The present invention provides a high-efficiency method for recovering lithium from a low-concentration lithium waste solution and lithium carbonate manufactured thereby, wherein the method comprises the steps of: (S10) adsorbing lithium-containing metal ions from a lithium waste solution to an electrode in an electrical adsorption system, and desorbing the metal ions adsorbed to the electrode with a desorption solution; (S20) manufacturing an insoluble lithium compound by injecting an aluminum supply source into the desorption solution; (S30) manufacturing a leachate by acid-leaching or roasting/water-leaching the insoluble lithium compound; and (S40) manufacturing at least one of lithium phosphate, lithium sulfate, and lithium carbonate from the leachate.

title_en: Compositions for thixotropic grout injection comprising cement with plasticity and grouting process by using the same
abstract_en: One aspect of the present invention relates to a thixotropic grout injection composition comprising: (i) a liquid A including bentonite, water, and plasticized cement; and (ii) a liquid B including an aqueous sodium silicate solution. According to the present invention, the grout composition shortens a gelation time while extending a plastic state and has excellent strength, thereby exhibiting excellent durability and constructability. In addition, properties of dilution or release upon contact with groundwater are improved, thereby greatly enhancing water resistance, and little volume change occurs even over time, thereby significantly improving long-term durability. Furthermore, the grout composition exhibits excellent resistance to chloride ion penetration and prevents efflorescence.

title_en: Sliding member
abstract_en: An issue is to provide a sliding member having a stronger bond with a sliding layer and a back metal layer than before. To solve the issue, the sliding member includes a back metal layer, and a sliding layer made of a copper alloy, provided on a bonding surface of the back metal layer. The composition of the copper alloy includes 0.5-12 mass% of Sn, 0.5-15 mass% of Ni, 0.06-0.2 mass% of P, and the remaining of Cu and inevitable impurities. The back metal layer is made of hypoeutectoid steel containing 0.07-0.35 mass% of carbon, and has a structure made of a ferrite phase and perlite. The back metal layer has a vacancy containing area extended inwards from the bonding surface, and, when seen from a cross section vertical to a sliding surface of the sliding layer, a plurality of closed vacancies, which are not open to the bonding surface, exist in the vacancy containing area, an average diameter of the closed vacancies is 5-15 μm, and the thickness of the vacancy containing area is 10-60 μm. A ratio of the total volume V2 of the closed vacancies with respect to the volume V1 of the vacancy containing area is V2/V1=0.05-0.1.

title_en: Polarity control method of MXene through surface functional group control
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polarity control method of MXene through surface functional group control which comprises a step of preparing MXene represented by chemical formula 1: M_(n+1)X_nT_x, and a step of dispersing the MXene in an amine solution to obtain surface-treated MXene, wherein the surface-treated MXene is dispersed in a non-polar solvent (In the chemical formula 1, the definitions of M, X, T_X and n are as defined in the specification).

title_en: Admixture Composition for General Strength High Flowing Concrete
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an admixture composition for general-strength and high-fluidity concrete containing additives to improve resistance to material separation or the like, mainly based on polycarboxylic acid to secure fluidity. The admixture composition for general-strength and high-fluidity concrete is mainly based on polycarboxylic acid to secure fluidity, and contains additives including polyethylene oxide and magnesium aluminum silicate.

title_en: Ultra_high performance fiber reinforced cementitious composites and manufacturing
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an ultra-high-performance fiber-reinforced cement composite including 7 to 30 parts by weight of a filling mixture, 100 to 130 parts by weight of sand, and 15 to 25 parts by weight of steel fiber, with respect to 100 parts by weight of cement. Crystalline SiO_2 powder and micro glass powder are mixed in the filling mixture.

title_en: Composite Materials Manufacturing Method for Viruses Adsorption - Blocking and Apoptosis-Inactivation Function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a complex having virus adsorption and apoptosis functions, and more particularly, to a method for manufacturing a composite material of hydroxyapatite having virus adsorption characteristics and copper or platinum having virus killing characteristics. In order to solve the above problems in a virus blocking composite material according to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a calcium salt-containing material, a phosphate-containing material, and a metal salt; (2) adding an aqueous solution strongly alkaline in slightly acid to the mixture; (3) reacting the mixture in the step (2) by ball milling; and (4) drying and pulverizing the reactant in the step (3).

title_en: High strength and low density steel plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-strength low-specific gravity steel plate with excellent strength and ductility, and a manufacturing method thereof. More specifically, the high-strength low-specific gravity steel plate is composed of 0.4-0.8 wt% of C, 10-15 wt% of Mn, 0.02 wt% or less of P, 0.015 wt% or less of S, 6-8 wt% of Al, 0.01 wt% or less of N, 0.05-0.1 wt% of Ce, 0.06 wt% or less of La, and the remaining of Fe and other impurities. A final microstructure comprises a two-phase structure composed of 40% or more and less than 70% of retained austenite and the remaining ferrite by area fraction.

title_en: Positive active material having hetero atoms for sodium secondary battery and the sodium secondary battery comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a positive electrode active material for a sodium secondary battery including secondary particles consisting of a group of a plurality of primary particles, wherein at least one of the primary particles includes a primary particle coating layer including heterogeneous elements on the grain boundary of the primary particles, and a doping region in which the heterogeneous elements are diffused into the primary particles.

title_en: Hydrogen-floating production and treatment system
abstract_en: A floating hydrogen production and management system is disclosed. The floating hydrogen production and management system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a storage tank for accommodating liquefied natural gas and boil-off gas generated therefrom; a reformer for producing hydrogen gas by receiving at least one of vaporized natural gas and boil-off gas from the storage tank; a hydrogen liquefaction line that liquefies the hydrogen gas produced by the reformer; a regasification device that regasifies the liquefied natural gas in the storage tank and supplies the same to an onshore power plant; and a steam supply line for supplying some of the steam generated using waste heat generated in the power plant to the reformer, thereby capable of reducing the construction cost and maintenance cost of boiler facilities mounted on floating offshore structures.

title_en: Method of manufacturing composite for anode material prepared carbon nanotube, composite for anode material prepared therefrom, and secondary battery comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a composite for a negative electrode material including a pre-treated carbon nanotube, a composite for a negative electrode material prepared thereby, and a secondary battery including the same. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: preparing a mixed solution including graphene oxide, a silicon-based particle, a carbon nanotube, and a solvent; spraying and drying the mixed solution to coat the graphene oxide on the silicon-based particle while the solvent evaporates, and preparing a composite particle where a carbon nanotube is bound to the graphene oxide; and thermally treating the composite particle to perform the reduction of the graphene oxide and the carbon nanotube.

title_en: Recovery method of valuable metal from waste of desulfurization catalyst
abstract_en: In a recovery method of valuable metals from a spent desulfurization catalyst of the present invention, a spent desulfurization catalyst is cleaned with a hydrocarbon-based solvent, the cleaned spent desulfurization catalyst is roasted in an oxidizing atmosphere, and valuable metals are leached from the roasted spent desulfurization catalyst. Accordingly, high-purity valuable metals can be recovered with high efficiency.

title_en: hydrophobic aerogel and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aerogel and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein aerogel particles can be formed in an emulsion, so that the size of the particles can be made very small and uniform, accordingly, the size of pores forming the aerogel can also be manufactured uniformly, and furthermore, an additional post-processing process is not required, thereby improving utilization in various industrial fields by fully utilizing the excellent properties of the aerogel without mechanical deformation of the aerogel.

title_en: Laying-pipe segment, laying-pipe holder and arrangement of a laying-pipe holder and a laying pipe
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laying pipe segment, a layering pipe holder, and the arrangement of the layering pipe holder and a layering pipe. The present invention provides a layering pipe segment having a layering pipe segment length, a layering pipe segment shaft out of a straight line along the layering pipe segment length, outer and inner diameters determining a thickness of a wall with a difference therebetween, and a layering pipe segment cross section formed along the layering pipe segment shaft so as to individually configure a wear area of a layering pipe or to be simply applied to a course of a very complicated layering pipe shaft, as a portion of a layering pipe for depositing a workpiece guided through the layering pipe segment. The thickness of the wall is determined at a specific height of the layering pipe segment shaft of the layering pipe segment, and the layering pipe segment is produced by an additive manufacturing method.

title_en: Fuel reforming device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fuel reforming device. According to the present invention, the fuel reforming device comprises: a pre-reformer which reacts raw material gas and water to convert the raw material into methane; a reformer which reacts the raw material gas pretreated in the preprocessor with water to produce a mixed gas containing hydrogen; a reformer burner which supplies heat to the reformer; and an exhaust gas supply line, as a heat source for the reaction of the preprocessor, supplying the exhaust gas discharged from the reformer burner to the preprocessor.

title_en: Electrically-heating type smoking articles
abstract_en: The present invention relates to heating type smoking articles, and more specifically, to heating type smoking articles comprising a ceramic moisture absorbent that is easy to manufacture and has improved aerosol generation efficiency. The heating type smoking articles according to an embodiment of the present invention comprise: a filter rod; a cooling tube rod stacked at the bottom of the filter rod and having a hollow shape in an upward and downward direction; an aerosol medium rod stacked at the bottom of the cooling tube rod and containing a gel-like aerosol medium; a ceramic moisture absorber stacked on the bottom of the aerosol media rod; and a wrapping paper wrapping the filter rod, the cooling tube rod, the aerosol medium rod, and the ceramic moisture absorber to maintain a laminated structure, wherein the ceramic moisture absorber comprises: a nicotine gel; and a plurality of porous granules with micropores formed on the surface or inside, and the macropores are formed between the plurality of porous granules, and the nicotine gel is accommodated in the micropores and the macropores.

title_en: Composite Transition Metal Precursor for Cathode Active Material and Cathode Active Material for Secondary Battery Prepared from the Same
abstract_en: The present invention includes ni and one or more transition metals, wherein the content of ni is 60% or more based on the total amount of the transition metals in a molar ratio, and the intensity ratio (i<sub>101</sub>/i<sub>001</sub>) of a (101) plane and a (001) plane in xrd analysis is 0. 7-1. Provided is a composite transition metal precursor for a positive electrode active material, wherein the composite transition metal precursor is in the range of 1.

title_en: Intelligent cnc based printer having calibration function of printed shapes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent CNC-based stacking device having a stacking shape correction function and a control method thereof. The intelligent CNC-based stacking device compares and analyzes NC data for stacking with modeling information on a workpiece as a stacking result while monitoring an actually stacked shape, and at the same time, checks an error of the NC data and the modeling information and the actually stacked shape to correct the error in the next stacked layer. When the NC data for stacking and the modeling information of the workpiece are input, the actually stacked shape is monitored during stacking, and correction is performed in the next stacked layer when comparing with the actual modeling and checking the error, thereby having high precision.

title_en: Non-oriented electrical steel sheet and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-oriented electrical steel sheet and a manufacturing method thereof. The non-oriented electrical steel sheet may have a sum of an area fraction having a {100}<001> orientation and an area fraction having a {100}<025> orientation among crystal grains of 3.0% to less than 50%.

title_en: Reformer burner for uniform gas blending
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a burner for a hydrogen extractor, which is configured to uniformly mix an anode off-gas and a fuel gas to be combusted. The burner for a hydrogen extractor comprises: a main body extended in one direction; an anode off-gas supply unit provided on one side of the main body and supplying the anode off-gas; a fuel gas supply unit provided on the opposite side of the side provided with the anode off-gas supply unit on the main body and supplying the fuel gas; a separation member provided inside the main body; and a nozzle unit provided in the chamber and spraying a flame. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the anode off-gas and the fuel gas can be uniformly mixed and used for combustion using a mechanical structure and a flow of a fluid without a separate mixing device.

title_en: Negative electrode active material, non-aqueous electrolyte secondary battery, and method of producing negative electrode active material
abstract_en: The anodal active material comprises the graphite, and the low crystalline carbon, and carbon black Graphite forms secondary particles. The second particle comprises a plurality of first particles As to the inside of the secondary particle, the low crystalline carbon adheres to the surface of the primary particle. The carbon black surrounds with a plurality of primary particles.

title_en: Fuel Supply System For LNG Carrier
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fuel supply system for an LNG carrier. According to the present invention, the fuel supply system for an LNG carrier comprises: a cargo tank for storing LNG transported to a cargo of a ship; a reforming unit for receiving methane, carbon dioxide, and water to generate synthetic gas containing hydrogen and carbon monoxide; an FT process unit for receiving the synthetic gas generated in the reforming unit to convert the same into liquid hydrocarbon; and a gas supply line connected from the cargo tank to the reforming unit, wherein boil-off gas generated from the LNG of the cargo tank is discharged to the reforming unit through the gas supply line, and the liquid hydrocarbon generated in the FT process unit is supplied to a fuel of a consumer in a ship.

title_en: Manufacturing method of rare earth sintered magnet
abstract_en: Provided is a method for manufacturing a rare earth permanent magnet, which comprises the steps of: sintering rare earth alloy powder to manufacture a sintered body; cleaning the sintered body; forming a low melting point metal layer on the surface of the cleaned sintered body; forming a heavy rare earth metal compound coating layer by applying slurry obtained by milling a heavy rare earth metal compound with a liquid solvent; charging the sintered body into a heating furnace and diffusing heavy rare earths into a grain boundary phase of the sintered body in a vacuum or inert gas atmosphere; a stress removal heat treatment step of charging the sintered body in which the heavy rare earth metal is diffused into the grain boundary phase of the alloy into the heating furnace, and performing stress removal heat treatment in a vacuum or inert gas atmosphere; and a final heat treatment step of performing heat treatment. According to the method for manufacturing a rare earth permanent magnet of the present invention, the low melting point metal layer is uniformly present in a liquid phase on the surface of the sintered body at the sintering temperature, such that the diffusion of heavy rare earth metal to the grain boundary phase of the sintered body becomes uniform over the entire surface of the sintered body.

title_en: Magnetocaloric alloy and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a magnetocaloric alloy having improved relative cooling efficiency and corrosion resistance, while implementing a magnetocaloric effect in a room temperature region by controlling the curie temperature through the composition control of the magnetocaloric alloy. The magnetocaloric alloy has the composition of a chemical formula MnFe1-xCrxP0.5-ySi0.5+y, wherein x is more than 0 and no more than 0.04, and y is no less than -0.05 and no more than 0.05. Moreover, the magnetocaloric alloy has a curie temperature of 273K to 345K, and the magnetocaloric alloy has a relative cooling power of 150 J/kg to 200 J/kg in a 2T magnetic field.

title_en: Semiconductor Chemical Mechanical Polishing Sludge Recycling Method
abstract_en: Provided is a method for recycling the semiconductor chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) sludge. In the method for recycling the semiconductor CMP sludge the present invention, the semiconductor CMP sludge is a sludge having a moisture content of 30 % to 80 %, and the method for recycling a CMP sludge comprises: (1) a drying step; (2) a calcination step; (3) an immersion step; (4) a separation step; (5) a concentration step; (6) a washing step; and (7) a dehydration step, wherein (8) a solid obtained through dehydration is a product containing silicon dioxide, and the sum of silicon dioxide and aluminum oxide of the product, based on the dry weight, is greater than 94 %.

title_en: Composition for coating having high light transmittance, coating glass and method for preparation thereof, cooking appliance using thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a coating composition, a coating glass and manufacturing method thereof, and a cooking appliance using the same. More specifically, the coating composition according to the present invention comprises: 20-40 wt% of P_2O_5; 10-25 wt% of Al_2O_3; 1-5 wt% of ZrO_2; 10-30 wt% as a sum of 1 type or more among Na_2O and K_2O; 5-20 wt% of B_2O_3; 5-15 wt% of ZnO; and 3-10 wt% of SiO_2, thereby exhibiting high permeability and having excellent cleaning performance.

title_en: Metal separator and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a metal separator having excellent electrical conductivity and corrosion resistance, and a manufacturing method thereof. The metal separation plate includes a first base material including a first manifold part, a second manifold part, and a reaction part provided between the first manifold part and the second manifold part. The first manifold part and the second manifold part include a plurality of opening parts and a surface layer part existing between the plurality of opening parts.

title_en: Electrode for lithium metal battery and lithium metal battery including the same
abstract_en: An electrode for a lithium metal battery according to example embodiments may include a lithium metal storage layer including silicon oxide particles. The silicon oxide particles have a porous structure, and a molar ratio of oxygen to silicon included in the silicon oxide particles is 1. Over 5 and 2. It may be less than zero. The lithium metal can be uniformly desorbed in the surface of the silicon oxide particle with electrodeposition. Provided is the lithium metal battery in which the lithium resin phase growth is controlled, and the electrochemical stability, and the capacity and output characteristic are improved.

title_en: Moisture-Induced Power Generator and Its Manufacturing Method
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a moisture-induced power generation device that maintains long-term power generation at low humidity. A moisture induced power generation device comprises: a hydrogel; and an active material layer stacked on the hydrogel and functioning as a power generator. According to the present invention, a water-induced power generation device having high output in a wide range of humidity ranges can be provided, and the water-induced power generation device can be applied to a wearable device in various environments in the future.

title_en: Roller-type spreader powder application device with spring plunger for powder blocking
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a roller-type spreader powder application device to which a spring plunger for blocking powder is applied. More specifically, the roller-type spreader powder application device comprises: a base frame; a transfer stage provided to be movable along the base frame; a product molding unit provided in the base frame; a powder supply unit provided in the transfer stage to supply powder to the product molding unit; and a flat pressing unit provided in the transfer stage and disposed on one side of the powder supply unit to flatly press the powder supplied to the product molding unit. The powder supply unit includes: a hopper into which powder flows and a discharge unit is formed at a lower end; a pair of supply rollers rotatably provided under the hopper to supply the powder discharged from the discharge unit to the product molding unit; an opening and closing member for opening and closing the discharge unit; and an elastic plunger that exerts elasticity when the discharge unit is opened and closed by the opening and closing member to be withdrawn and inserted. That is, the present invention proposes a roller-type spreader powder application device applying a spring plunger for powder blocking, which allows the powder discharged from a hopper containing the powder to be supplied or blocked by the elastic force of the elastic plunger, that is, the spring plunger, and enables a pair of supply rollers to implement uniform application of the powder through engagement rotation.

title_en: Gold nanoparticle comprising camellia sinensis extract and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to gold nanoparticles comprising a green tea extract and a method for manufacturing the same. The gold nanoparticles comprising a green tea extract according to the present invention exhibit excellent elastase inhibitory activity, and thus can be usefully utilized for preventing or alleviating skin aging. Furthermore, the manufacturing method of the present invention requires a relatively low synthesis temperature and a short synthesis time, making it an energy-efficient, economical, and eco-friendly green synthesis process. The method reduces the toxicity of metal particles and increases the absorption rate of the extract, thereby enabling the production of biocompatible gold nanoparticles highly suitable for the human body and useful in related industries.

title_en: Manufacturing Method Of Ultra High Performance Concrete Using Indirect Carbon Curing Technology
abstract_en: The present invention is to solve a problem in a manufacturing method of ultra-high performance concrete which cannot use a conventional carbon curing method using a gas due to a dense microstructure and low porosity in an early stage of curing. The present invention is solved by a method of changing carbon dioxide, which is a gas, into a solid calcium carbonate form and adding the same to mortar. According to the manufacturing method of the present invention, carbon dioxide and calcium hydroxide are reacted to convert carbon dioxide, which is a gas, into calcium carbonate, which is a solid, and then used, and manufacturing conditions are optimized, thereby reducing carbon dioxide and maintaining the performance of ultra-high performance concrete.

title_en: Hydrogen generation system
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a hydrogen generation system using NaBH_4 comprises: a reaction container in which a hydrogen generation reaction occurs; a nozzle disposed on an upper portion of the reaction container and connected to a first pump to spray a NaBH_4 aqueous solution toward a lower portion; a catalyst unit disposed at a position corresponding to the NaBH_4 aqueous solution sprayed through the nozzle and configured to promote a hydrogen generation reaction rate of the NaBH_4 aqueous solution; a storage container coupled to a lower portion of the reaction container and configured to store a product other than the hydrogen; and a supply unit connected to the reaction container and configured to supply the hydrogen to a fuel cell through a second pump.

title_en: Highly thermally insulating and electrically conductive graphene aerogel and method of manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a graphene aerogel, a method of manufacturing the same, and a method of increasing the electrical conductivity while decreasing the thermal conductivity thereof. The graphene aerogel according to the present invention is a porous carbon material that is mechanically stable, elastic, and has damping and non-flammable properties. The aerogel comprises two-dimensional carbon materials that are interconnected via covalent and van der Waals bonds to form a three-dimensional porous structure. The electrical conductivity is from 50 to 400 S/m, when the aerogel is compressed. Furthermore, the thermal conductivity of the graphene aerogel is from 10-3 to 10-1 W m-1K-1, when the graphene aerogel is compressed to at least 5% of strain. The method of manufacturing is characterized in that, it comprises the steps of forming three-dimensional structures of the aerogel, wherein the three-dimensional structures comprise covalently cross-linked two-dimensional carbon materials, thereby forming a free-standing aerogel; and compressing of the free-standing aerogel to at least 5% of strain; and fixing the compression of the graphene aerogel.

title_en: Process for cultivation of microalga Porphyridium cruentum CNMN-AR-01
abstract_en: The invention refers to biotechnology, namely to a process for cultivation of microalga Porphyridium cruentum in order to obtain the biomass with high lipid content. The process for cultivation of microalga Porphyridium cruentum CNMN-AR-01 comprises cultivation on a nutrient medium containing, g/L: KCl 16.04; NaCl 12.52; KNO3 1.24; MgSO4·7H2O 2.5; CaCl2 0.118; K2HPO4·3H2O 0.5; KI 0.05; KBr 0.05; 1 mL/L solution containing, mg/L: H3BO3 2.86; MnCl2·4H2O 1.81; CuSO4·5H2O 0.08; MoO3 0.015, FeEDTA 0.5 mL, Au nanoparticles of 10 nm stabilized in citrate 0.023-0.027nM and disstiled water the rest, at a temperature of 25-28°C, pH 6.8-7.2, constant lighting of 50-57 µM photons/m2/s, for 14 days. The result of the invention consists in increasing the biosynthesis of lipids and their accumulation in the biomass of tmicroalga Porphyridium cruentum.

title_en: Steel sheet.
