The film is such that it comprises at least one poly(ether ketone ketone) (PEKK) polymer and at least one nucleating agent. The assembly has an improved fracture toughness and overall good mechanical properties.

title_en: Elektrolyzer, use for an elektrolyzer, feed pipe for an electrolyzer and discharge pipe for an electrolyzer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrolyzer (2) with a plurality of cell elements (4), and with a feed pipe (6) and a discharge pipe (8) for feeding and discharging electrolyte to and from the cell elements (4), wherein the feed pipe (6) and/or the discharge pipe (8) have, at least in some sections, at least two electrically isolated part-lines (12a, 12b, 12c, 12d, 12e), wherein the part-lines (12a, 12b, 12c, 12d, 12e) extend in the feed pipe (6) over a predetermined length (L) in the opposite direction to the direction of electrolyte flow (E) and/or extend in the discharge pipe (8) over a predetermined length (L) in the same direction as the direction of electrolyte flow (E).

title_en: Electrolyzer, insert for an electrolyzer, supply pipe for an electrolyzer and discharge pipe for an electrolyzer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrolyser (2) comprising a plurality of cell elements (4) and comprising a supply pipe (6) and a discharge pipe (8) for supplying and discharging an electrolyte to and from the cell elements (4), wherein, at least in sections, the supply pipe (6) and/or the discharge pipe (8) have at least two sub-lines (12a to 12t) that are galvanically isolated from one another, wherein the sub-lines (12a-12t) are designed an eccentric sub-lines (12a-12t).

title_en: Labels with adhesive patch patterns optimized for printer applications
abstract_en: Linerless labels with adhesive patches arranged in optimal adhesive patch patterns are provided. The adhesive patch patterns mitigate adhesive buildup on components of a printer when a roll of linerless labels is fed through a printer by minimizing the adhesive coverage area on the backside of the linerless labels without altering the adhesive bonding characteristics of the individual linerless labels dispensed from the printer.

title_en: Solution dispensing device
abstract_en: A solution dispensing device including a housing that has an interior volume.  The housing holds a solution reservoir and an actuator body that is movably mounted to the housing. The actuator body is operably connected to a dispensing assembly. The dispensing assembly includes a solution chamber disposed within the actuator body. The solution chamber has an interior volume with a first inlet and a first outlet. The first outlet is in fluid communication with a dispensing passageway. When in the dispensing position the actuator body is moved toward a surface of a material positioned adjacent the dispensing passageway.  A material sensing trigger is connected to the actuator body and the trigger is configured to sense a targeted material by pressing against the material. The material sensing trigger is further configured to allow the dispensing assembly to dispense a measured amount of solution onto the targeted material through the dispensing passageway.

title_en: Metrology device, system and method
abstract_en: 18 Abstract A MEMS hotplate is used as a test substrate for characterizing a temperature-dependent fabrication process. According to a variant, an array of MEMS hotplates is used to provide multiple test substrates which can be simultaneously heated to different temperatures to provide multiple different temperature-dependent characterizations of the process. Fig. 1C to be published with the abstract Date Recue/Date Received 2020-04-24

title_en: System and method for laying up a composite laminate having integrally laminated filler elements
abstract_en: A manufacturing system for laying up a stringer laminate includes a lamination surface and a plurality of lamination heads including a frame filler outer ply lamination head for laying up (e.g., laminating) frame filler bottom ply at a plurality of frame filler locations. Also included is at least one frame filler inner ply lamination head for laying up one or more frame filler inner plies over a protruding portion of the frame filler bottom ply at each frame filler location. Further included is at least one stringer body lamination head laying up one or more stringer body plies defining a stringer body portion extending along the lamination surface. A  frame filler outer ply lamination head is configured to lay up a frame filler top ply at each frame filler location such that the frame filler inner plies are captured between a frame filler bottom ply and a frame filler top ply.

title_en: Composite structures with embedded veils for anchoring fasteners
abstract_en: ABSTRACT A composite structure of a cargo body and a method of making the same are disclosed. The composite structure includes at least one anchor embedded between fiber- reinforced polymer (FRP) layers. The embedded anchor includes a porous veil of nonwoven fibers in a polymer-rich matrix. Accessories may be coupled to the composite structure by anchoring mechanical fasteners into the embedded anchor. Date Recue/Date Received 2020-1 2-1 1

title_en: Heat transfer fluids containing synergistic blends of corrosion inhibitor formulations
abstract_en: Corrosion inhibitor formulations for use in heat transfer fluids include: (a) an optionally substituted benzoic acid or a salt thereof; (b) at least a first n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or a salt thereof and a second n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or a salt thereof, the first nalkyl monocarboxylic acid and the second n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid being different; and (c) an azole compound. A ratio of weight percent of the first n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or the salt thereof to weight percent of the second n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or the salt thereof ranges from about 1:0.75 to about 1:2.00. A ratio of weight percent of the benzoic acid or the salt thereof to combined weight percent of the first n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or the salt thereof and the second n-alkyl monocarboxylic acid or the salt thereof ranges from about 1:0.30 to about 1:2.25.

title_en: Piezoelectric materials and structures based on cellulose nanocrystals
abstract_en: This invention describes a type of all-organic piezoelectric material based on cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs). This type of material is flexible and transparent, and its properties can be tuned by adjusting the composition and ionic strength. The fabrication of this type of piezoelectric material can be carried out entirely in an aqueous medium and does not require high temperature poling and stretching treatment. It renders possible a commercially viable route to producing inexpensive, sustainable, eco-friendly high piezoelectric-response organic materials for sensors, transducers, actuators, and energy harvest applications.

title_en: Bipolar plate and production
abstract_en: A bipolar plate that is configured for electrolysis has a lower metal sheet and an upper metal sheet. The lower and upper metal sheets are interlinked and the materials of the metal sheets are distinctly different from each other, meaning that one of them is iron-based or nickel-based and the other is not, or an alloying element is present to a greater or lesser degree, or a proportion of an alloying element differs between the materials of the two metal sheets.

title_en: Oxide and method for producing same
abstract_en: An oxide having a novel crystal structure is provided. Alternatively, an oxide having high crystallinity is provided. Alternatively, an oxide having a low impurity concentration is provided. An oxide having a hexagonal atomic arrangement in the case of a single crystal, the oxide having a homologous structure of indium, an element M (aluminum, gallium, yttrium, or tin), and zinc, and a lattice point group observed by analyzing a first region in a transmission electron microscope image of a top surface of the oxide, wherein in a Voronoi diagram having a plurality of Voronoi regions obtained by Voronoi analysis of the lattice point group, a ratio of Voronoi regions having a hexagonal shape in all Voronoi regions is 78% or more and 100% or less.

title_en: Electric diffusion treatment method for optical quartz crystal and holder assembly used in same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric diffusion method of an optical quartz crystal, which comprises the following steps: the upper and lower surfaces of the optical quartz crystal to be electrically diffused are both subjected to finish and parallelism treatment, then subjected to cleaning treatment, and then placed into a holder assembly for electrically diffusion: firstly, calculating the intensity of a direct current electric field at 1500+/-100V/cm, then opening a direct current high-voltage electric field, then heating to a constant temperature at a rate of 40+/-5 ℃ per hour, preserving heat for 12+/-1 hours, and then switching off the direct current high-voltage electric field when cooling to room temperature at a rate of 40+/-5 ℃ per hour; the constant temperature is 520-570 ℃. The invention also discloses the clamp holder assembly.

title_en: Goods tray packing pile up neatly anti-skidding spreading machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antiskid gumming machine for packing and stacking cargo pallets, which comprises a case, a filtering device arranged in the case, a liquid level alarming device connected with the filtering device, a quantitative supply device connected with the liquid level alarming device and used for controlling the single output quantity of antiskid glue, an air inlet used for introducing air, a pressure regulating valve used for regulating internal pressure, and a gumming device arranged on a cargo transportation assembly line and used for gumming a cargo package. The automatic coating machine is fully automatically operated under the control of an electric control system, can accurately coat the anti-skid glue on each goods package through the inductive switch of the roller, and can ensure the consistent use amount of each coating under the action of the quantitative supply device. On the other hand, the invention can detect and adjust the working state through the liquid level alarm device and the pressure regulating valve, thereby ensuring that the gluing operation is normally and orderly carried out.

title_en: Method for preparing rare earth doped gadolinium gallium aluminum single crystal raw material by multi-step repeated synthesis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing rare earth doped gadolinium gallium aluminum monocrystal raw material by multi-step repeated synthesis, which comprises the following operations: 1) weighing rare earth for doping and raw materials for preparing gadolinium gallium aluminum single crystal, and putting the raw materials into a crucible for presintering; 2) uniformly mixing the pre-sintered powder; 3) putting the uniformly mixed powder into a crucible, and sintering at 1300-1600 ℃; 4) grinding the sintered mixed material by using a ceramic mortar, sieving the ground mixed material, and then mixing the mixed material for 5 to 10 hours; 5) repeating for 2-5 times; 6) and putting the powder into an isostatic pressing die, and pressing and forming. According to the method provided by the invention, the mixed material is prepared by repeatedly grinding, sintering and mixing, so that polycrystalline materials with consistent components can be more fully obtained, and an important guarantee is provided for the subsequent growth of high-quality single crystals. The isostatic pressing is used for pressing and forming, so that the consistency of each part of the pressing block is better, the pressing block can be quickly melted during the synthesis of the single crystal, and the volatilization and decomposition of raw materials are reduced.

title_en: Enamel glaze, enamel glaze layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enamel materials, and particularly relates to an enamel glaze, an enamel glaze layer and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides an enamel glaze material for overcoming the defects of bubbles, scale explosion and the like of a glaze layer prepared by using Q235 carbon steel as a substrate, and the enamel glaze material is prepared from quartz sand, feldspar, borax, sodium nitrate, sodium carbonate and NaVO 3 、Li 2 CO 3 Fluorite, cryolite, calcium carbonate, sodium fluosilicate and TiO 2 、Co 2 O 3 And NiO is prepared by mixing and melting. And then adding auxiliary materials and water into the enamel glaze to prepare enamel slurry, coating the enamel slurry on the Q235 carbon steel after heat treatment, wherein the Q235 carbon steel enamel layer prepared by enamel firing has the advantages of good surface gloss, good adherence of the enamel surface and a steel plate matrix, no bubble, no scale explosion and the like.

title_en: Adjustable multi-path powder feeding frame for thermal spraying and spraying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable multi-path powder feeding frame for thermal spraying and spraying equipment, which solves the problem that the position of the powder feeding frame can not be adjusted, and can change the distance between a powder feeding part and the center of flame flow and the position in the flame flow by arranging an axial adjusting mechanism and a radial adjusting mechanism, thereby reducing the melting state difference of ceramic/metal materials and improving the comprehensive performance of a functionally gradient coating, and the technical scheme is as follows: the spray gun comprises a main frame connected with a spray gun, wherein the main frame is connected with a plurality of axial adjusting mechanisms, the axial adjusting mechanisms are connected with radial adjusting mechanisms through connecting rods, the radial adjusting mechanisms are connected with powder feeding components, the axial adjusting mechanisms can drive the radial adjusting mechanisms to axially move along the thermal spraying spray gun so as to change the positions of the powder feeding components in flame flow, and the radial adjusting mechanisms can drive the powder feeding components to radially move along the thermal spraying spray gun so as to change the distance between the powder feeding components and the center of the flame flow.

title_en: Computer type HMDS glue spreader
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computerized HMDS glue spreader, which comprises a box body, a box door, a cavity, a controller, a vacuum system, a liquid medicine supply system, a temperature control system, a normally closed relay, a photoelectric switch, a heating element, a temperature measuring element, a touch screen, a buzzer and an indicator lamp, wherein the vacuum system comprises a vacuum pump, an inflator pump and a vacuum degree detecting element, the liquid medicine supply system comprises a liquid medicine steam tank, and the temperature control system comprises a temperature controller. The invention has the safety protection function, and by setting the oven and setting parameters such as working temperature, treatment time, holding time during treatment and the like in the HMDS pretreatment process of the oven, a layer of HMDS can be uniformly coated on the surfaces of the silicon wafer and the substrate, so that the contact angle of the silicon wafer after the HMDS treatment is reduced, the use amount of photoresist is reduced, and the adhesiveness between the photoresist and the silicon wafer is improved.

title_en: Modified nylon film, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery flexible package aluminum plastic film
abstract_en: The invention provides a modified nylon membrane, which is prepared by coating modified polycarbonate type waterborne polyurethane emulsion on the surface of a nylon membrane; the modified polycarbonate type waterborne polyurethane emulsion is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: carbon dioxide copolymer polyol: 50-100 parts; small molecule aqueous monomer: 2-10 parts; isocyanate: 20-30 parts of a solvent; catalyst: 0.02-0.3 part; neutralizing agent: 1-5 parts; small-molecule chain extender: 0.05-5 parts; nano-cellulose aqueous dispersion: 1-20 parts. The invention utilizes the aqueous polyurethane solution modified by the nano-cellulose to modify the nylon membrane, plays a role in reinforcing and toughening to a certain extent, and improves the strength and acid resistance of the nylon membrane. The invention also provides a preparation method of the modified nylon film and a flexible packaging aluminum plastic film of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Aqueous dispersion, coating film, and laminate
abstract_en: The present invention provides an aqueous dispersion containing: (A) a highly modified polyolefin obtained from a polyolefin (a) using an α, β -unsaturated carboxylic acid, the polyolefin (a) having a structural unit derived from ethylene and a structural unit derived from propylene, and having a melting peak observed by differential scanning calorimetry; (B) a polyolefin (B-1) and/or a low-modified polyolefin (B-2), wherein the polyolefin (B-1) has a structural unit derived from at least 1 olefin selected from the group consisting of ethylene and alpha-olefins having 3 to 20 carbon atoms, and the low-modified polyolefin (B-2) is obtained from the polyolefin (B-1) using an alpha, beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid; and (C) a basic compound, wherein the mass ratio of the component (A) to the component (B) ((A)/(B)) is 60/40-97.5/2.5.

title_en: Liquid crystal dimming member, light-transmitting conductive film, and liquid crystal dimming element
abstract_en: The liquid crystal dimming member is provided with: transparent substrate, light transmissivity conducting layer and liquid crystal dimming layer, the light transmissivity conducting layer possesses in proper order: a 1 st inorganic oxide layer, a metal layer, and a 2 nd inorganic oxide layer.

title_en: Composite material and power transmission belt
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composite material comprising: at least one reinforcing element (10); an adhesive layer (14) made of an adhesive composition and coating the reinforcing element (10); and an elastomer body made of an elastomer matrix comprising at least one elastomer selected from the group consisting of ethylene/alpha-olefin type elastomers, polychloroprene elastomers and mixtures thereof, and having embedded therein a reinforcing element (10) coated with an adhesive layer (14). The adhesive composition comprises a phenolic resin comprising: at least one aromatic polyphenol comprising at least one aromatic ring bearing at least two hydroxyl functional groups in the meta position relative to each other, at least one of the hydroxyl functional groups being unsubstituted in both ortho-positions; and an aromatic aldehyde bearing at least one aldehyde functional group and comprising at least one aromatic ring.

title_en: Preparation method of metallic lithium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of metallic lithium, and particularly provides a preparation method of metallic lithium, which comprises the following steps: preparing lithium phosphate; a step of preparing a mixture by adding a chloride to the lithium phosphate; a step of heat-treating the mixture; a step of obtaining lithium chloride by a reaction of lithium phosphate and a chloride in the mixture; a step of preparing molten metal lithium by electrolyzing the lithium chloride; and a step of recovering the molten metallic lithium.

title_en: Full-automatic pickling line for hot galvanizing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic hot galvanizing pickling line, which comprises a pre-cleaning tank, a pickling tank, a cleaning tank and a leaching tank which are sequentially arranged, and is characterized in that the pickling tank is provided with an acid mist collector, the acid mist collector is connected with an exhaust gas purification system through a draught fan of an induced draft device, the exhaust gas purification device is connected with an exhaust device through wind, the exhaust gas purification device comprises a flat-mouth air suction device and a movable tank cover, the draught system is provided with a movable closed tank cover at the upper part of the pickling tank, and meanwhile, the two sides of the long side of the pickling tank are provided with flat-mouth air suction devices, the pickling tank is an anti-corrosion pipeline, the exhaust gas purification system is a filler absorption tower, and the exhaust system is a 20m high anti-corrosion exhaust chimney. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the device has reasonable design, the hydrochloric acid of the shaking device is used for thoroughly removing ferric oxide, the treatment effect is improved, meanwhile, the emission concentration of acid mist is reduced, the operation cost is reduced, HCL in waste gas is condensed to form condensed acid liquor for recycling, the heat of the waste gas is recycled, and the investment can be recovered in a short period.

title_en: Dispensing mechanism of storage battery power supply interface welding equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispensing mechanism of battery power supply interface welding equipment, which is characterized by comprising a frame, a battery conveying device, a positioning device and a dispensing device, wherein the dispensing device comprises a laterally moving rubber tube seat and a rubber storage tube arranged on the rubber tube seat, the lower end of the rubber storage tube is provided with a dispensing head, and the battery conveying device, the positioning device and the dispensing device are all connected with an electric controller. According to the storage battery conveying device, the storage battery is conveyed to the dispensing station, the storage battery is positioned through the positioning device, the storage battery is prevented from being shifted, the dispensing head moves to the upper side of the storage battery, glue is injected into the mounting groove, sealing is achieved, and electrolyte in the storage battery is prevented from leaking.

title_en: Truncated bead membrane construction and method of making same
abstract_en: Described herein is a construction comprising a microsphere layer comprising a plurality of microspheres, wherein the microspheres comprise glass, ceramic, and combinations thereof; a bead bond layer, wherein a plurality of microspheres are partially embedded in the bead bond layer, thereby forming a first surface comprising exposed microspheres, wherein the plurality of microspheres on the first surface are truncated. Also disclosed herein are articles comprising the constructions and methods of making the same.

title_en: High-strength hollow composite material building template and processing method and recycling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength hollow composite material building template, which consists of a surface layer and a honeycomb core layer wrapped in the surface layer; the honeycomb core layer is formed by melt extrusion of the following components in parts by mass: 70-80 parts of polypropylene; 15-20 parts of talcum powder; 1-2 parts of a silane coupling agent; 3-5 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer and 1-5 parts of modified master batch; the surface layer is formed by melt extrusion of the following components in parts by mass: 100 parts of polyvinyl chloride, 8-10 parts of plasticizer, 5-6 parts of heat stabilizer, 2-3 parts of lubricant, 8-10 parts of toughening agent, 10-15 parts of filler, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-2 parts of ultraviolet absorber, 0.1-0.2 part of colorant and 5-10 parts of interfacial compatilizer. The building template provided by the invention adopts the honeycomb-shaped foaming core layer, so that the obtained building template is low in density, low in thermal expansion rate, high in bending modulus and impact strength, and the comprehensive cost for preparing the template is reduced.

title_en: 3D pattern laser carving spraying process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D pattern laser carving spraying process, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting a three-dimensional file; s2, processing a three-dimensional file; s3, laser engraving: the three-dimensional model after the data meeting the requirements is obtained by feedback modification according to algorithm processing and display, the three-dimensional model data is transmitted to a lower PCI bus-based laser engraving card, the laser engraving card carries out related processing, and the surface of the material is enabled to present a pattern with three-dimensional concave-convex through laser depth laser engraving; s4, spraying: spraying gloss oil on the surface of the material, and simultaneously, matching a linear array CCD technology with an on-line thickness measuring device of an optical system and a spraying device which is controlled by a singlechip to accurately control the thickness of the gloss oil; s5, drying and molding. According to the invention, the 3D pattern is subjected to slitting and positioning processing through the set three-dimensional deep carving algorithm, so that the information in the three-dimensional viewing area is ensured to be correctly carved, and omission cannot occur, thereby effectively ensuring the three-dimensional viewing of the 3D pattern.

title_en: Pipeline transportation cathodic protection and anticorrosion intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline transportation cathodic protection and corrosion prevention intelligent management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a monitoring center server and a control center server, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data of a potentiostat, a control cabinet, a potential acquisition unit and an intelligent test pile, and uploading the encrypted data to the monitoring center server; the communication service module is used for receiving the data uploaded to the monitoring center server, decrypting the data and submitting the decrypted data to the monitoring center database server; and the communication log module is used for recording the communication success or failure between the monitoring center server and all the communication log modules and submitting the recorded log data to the monitoring center database. The invention reduces the cost of data acquisition, realizes the intelligent monitoring of the pipeline and improves the safety and reliability of pipeline transportation.

title_en: Aluminum-plastic film, preparation method thereof and anti-falling lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum-plastic film for improving the falling-resisting performance of a lithium battery, a preparation method of the aluminum-plastic film and the corresponding lithium battery. The aluminum-plastic film comprises an aluminum-plastic film substrate and a polymer layer, wherein the polymer layer is mainly made of polymethacrylate compounds, and the polymer layer is used for isolating the aluminum-plastic film substrate from a battery cell. The polymethacrylate compound material is positioned on the inner surface of the aluminum-plastic film to form a stable protective layer, has good thermal stability, hardness and rigidity, can play good buffering and protecting roles when the lithium battery is impacted by a heavy object, falls at a low height and the like on the basis of ensuring that the electrical property of the lithium battery is not influenced, and effectively improves the safety performance of the lithium battery.

title_en: Alloy coating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alloy coating device, belongs to the technical field of vacuum coating, and solves the problems that the coating is not uniform and multiple-component coating cannot be produced at one time in the continuous vacuum coating process of a steel plate. The device comprises an evaporation device, wherein the evaporation device comprises a vacuum cavity; a conveying roller is arranged on the side of the vacuum cavity and used for conveying the steel plate; at least two metal melting containers are arranged in the vacuum cavity; the metal melting container is respectively connected with the mixed steam box through a main steam pipeline; the mixed steam box is provided with an air nozzle with an adjustable opening size, and the air nozzle is used for coating a steel plate. The device can be used for continuously producing the alloy coated steel plate with different element contents in vacuum coating.

title_en: Silicon carbide-based self-lubricating composite coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide-based self-lubricating composite coating and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lubricating coatings. According to the invention, an in-situ porous carbon coating is generated on the surface of a silicon carbide substrate through high-temperature chlorination treatment, then polytetrafluoroethylene composite liquid is used for vacuum impregnation, the polytetrafluoroethylene composite liquid with self-lubricating property is immersed into a porous structure of the in-situ porous carbon coating, and then the self-lubricating composite coating is obtained through vacuum heat treatment. The preparation process is simple, the self-lubricating property of the composite coating is good, and the friction coefficient of the composite coating is lower than 0.1 when the composite coating is ground with steel under the dry friction condition. The composite lubricating coating solves the lubricating problem of the silicon carbide workpiece and provides lubricating protection for the silicon carbide-based sliding workpiece.

title_en: Method for manufacturing image display device, and dispenser for resin
abstract_en: In a method for manufacturing an image display device (1) in which an image display member (2) and a light-transmitting cover member (6) having a light-shielding layer (3) formed on a peripheral portion thereof and a step portion (5) formed between the peripheral portion and a main surface portion (4) are laminated via a light-transmitting resin layer (8) formed from a liquid optical resin composition (7) such that a surface of the light-shielding layer (3) of the light-transmitting cover member (6) is disposed on the image display member (2), a dispenser (10) for resin is moved from one end side to the other end side of a surface of the light-shielding layer (3) forming surface of the light-transmitting cover member (6) and the liquid optical resin composition (7) is applied to the surface of the light-shielding layer (3) forming surface of the light-transmitting cover member (6), the liquid optical resin composition (7) is applied to the main surface portion (4) of the light-shielding layer (3) forming surface of the light-transmitting cover member (6) and to the light-shielding layer (3), the coating amount of the optical resin composition (7) was changed.

title_en: Black liquid crystal polymer film and multilayer substrate
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a black liquid crystal polymer film, a laminated plate, an electronic circuit substrate and a multilayer substrate which contain the black liquid crystal polymer film and have the same characteristics. The black liquid crystal polymer film is black due to the inclusion of a sufficient amount of a black pigment, and has a significant difference in light reflectance from the metal foil, while the high concentration point of the black pigment is significantly suppressed, and the black liquid crystal polymer film has excellent dielectric properties and insulating properties. The black liquid crystal polymer film of the present invention is characterized by containing a black pigment and a liquid crystal polymer, having a lightness of 45 or less, a dielectric loss tangent of 0.0035 or less, a minimum value of dielectric breakdown strength of 60kV/mm or more, and a ratio of a maximum value to a minimum value of a coefficient of thermal linear expansion in the plane direction of 1.0 or more and 2.5 or less.

title_en: High temperature CMP compositions and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: CMP compositions and methods of use thereof are disclosed that provide stable and robust polishing performance at elevated pad or wafer surface temperatures. The compositions of the present disclosure comprise Reaction Rate Optimization (RRO) compounds that optimize various chemical reactions occurring in slurry chemistry at elevated polishing temperatures on the wafer surface such that the removal rate within a single wafer varies by < 10%.

title_en: Reaction products of catechol compounds with functionalized co-reactive compounds for metal pretreatment applications
abstract_en: An aqueous acidic anti-corrosion conversion coating composition for metal substrates (in particular, an aqueous acidic group IV metal-containing anti-corrosion conversion coating composition) comprising as an additive a catechol compound and/or a reaction product of at least one catechol compound with at least one co-reactive compound having one or more functional groups reactive with the at least one catechol compound, preferably a reaction product of a catechol with a polyamine (e.g. polyethyleneimine), the additive enhancing the anti-corrosion effect of the conversion coating composition; methods of making and applying the conversion coating compositions, and coated metal substrates. The catechol-containing conversion coating composition may be applied to a metal substrate surface at a temperature as low as less than 40 ℃ and with an exposure time of 5 minutes or less. The catechol compound or reaction product thereof may be incorporated into a conversion coating formed on a metal substrate.

title_en: Bi for photoproduction cathode protection in splash zone of ocean spray2O2CO3/TiO2Composite material and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photoanode composite material, in particular to Bi for photoproduction cathodic protection and photoproduction cathodic protection in a spray splashing region 2 O 2 CO 3 /TiO 2 A preparation method of a photo-anode composite material. The composite material is TiO obtained by anodic oxidation treatment 2 The substrate is put into a solution which takes bismuth nitrate pentahydrate as a bismuth source, urea as a carbon source and water as a solvent for hydrothermal reaction, and then Bi is obtained 2 O 2 CO 3 /TiO 2 A composite material. The composite material photo-anode prepared by the invention is opposite to TiO under the irradiation of visible light 2 The matrix has larger photo-generated current density and more negative open-circuit potential, and effectively blocks the corrosion of the 304 stainless steel.

title_en: Evaporation source with catalytic cracking function
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaporation source with a catalytic cracking function, which is used for solving the technical problems of poor coating quality, low raw material utilization rate and high energy consumption of a single-atom coating technology in the prior art, and comprises the following steps: an evaporation module and a catalytic cracking module; the evaporation module comprises a crucible, a heating piece and a supporting barrel, wherein raw materials to be evaporated are contained in the crucible, the supporting barrel supports the crucible and the heating piece, and an opening is formed in the supporting barrel; the catalytic cracking module comprises a catalytic tube and a steam guide piece, the catalytic tube is arranged on the steam guide piece, the steam guide piece is arranged on the supporting barrel, and the steam guide piece seals the opening; according to the technical scheme, the catalytic cracking module is arranged to prepare monoatomic steam, so that high-purity monoatomic steam can be obtained, and the utilization rate of raw materials is improved; the evaporation module and the catalytic cracking module are independently heated, and the catalytic cracking module is provided with a heat insulation layer, so that the catalytic cracking efficiency of large atomic groups can be improved, and the whole energy consumption of the device can be reduced.

title_en: Hot-dip galvanized strip steel post-plating cooling system and method with external electrostatic field
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooling system and a cooling method for hot-dip galvanized strip steel with an external electrostatic field, belongs to the technical field of metallurgical engineering, and solves the problems that liquid droplets in the existing spray cooling heat dissipation are difficult to reach the surface of a coating layer to contact with the coating layer for heat exchange, the heat dissipation effect is poor, and the product quality is poor. The cooling system for the hot-dip galvanized strip steel with the external electrostatic field after plating comprises a spraying device, a high-voltage device, a liquid supply device and an air supply device; the spraying device comprises a nozzle used for spraying fog drops to the strip steel, the nozzle is connected with a liquid supply device and an air supply device, the high-voltage device is used for electrifying the fog drops generated by the spraying device, the liquid supply device is used for supplying liquid capable of generating the fog drops to the spraying device, and the air supply device is used for supplying air for enabling the liquid to be changed into the fog drops to the spraying device. The invention realizes the contact heat exchange between the charged fog drops and the surface of the coating, greatly improves the cooling speed, and improves the coating quality and the anti-corrosion performance of the strip steel.

title_en: Steel structure spraying system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spraying systems, and discloses a steel structure spraying system. The main technical characteristics are as follows: comprises a conveying mechanism, a spraying mechanism, a drying mechanism and a control mechanism; the spraying mechanism comprises a three-dimensional scanner positioned at the front end and a spraying machine positioned at the rear end, the spraying machine comprises a cover body, a lower beam and an upper beam which are positioned in the cover body, a plurality of lower spraying seats capable of transversely moving are arranged on the lower beam, a plurality of upper spraying seats capable of transversely and vertically moving are arranged on the upper beam, and the control mechanism is in control connection with the three-dimensional scanner, an upper spraying control valve, a lower spraying control valve, an upper motor, a vertical motor and a lower motor; the welded steel structure scans the shape of the steel structure above the conveying mechanism through the three-dimensional scanner, the control mechanism controls the upper motor and the lower motor to drive the upper spraying frame and the lower spraying frame to move left and right respectively, controls the vertical motor to drive the upper spraying frame to move up and down, and opens and closes corresponding upper nozzles and lower nozzles according to the surface shape of the steel structure, so that the paint quality is good, and the corrosion resistance of the steel structure is strong.

title_en: Aramid 1313 reticular fiber and preparation method thereof, aramid epoxy resin adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides aramid 1313 reticular fiber, wherein the aramid 1313 fiber is flocculent fiber bulk aramid 1313 fiber; the aramid fibers 1313 are interwoven to form a three-dimensional net structure. The aramid fiber 1313 fiber obtained by the invention has the appearance of flocculent fiber bulk, and aramid fiber 1313 fiber yarns are interwoven to form a three-dimensional net structure and are used in epoxy resin glue to obtain the aramid fiber epoxy resin glue which is a flame-retardant epoxy resin structural glue series and has good bonding performance, and the aramid fiber epoxy resin glue can be used for edge sealing and molding by adjusting components and physical parameters, so that various requirements are met. The aramid fiber epoxy resin adhesive can be cured at normal temperature, has better performance and can meet the relevant standards of aramid fiber paper honeycomb composite products, thereby overcoming the defects of complicated process, high production cost and the like in the prior preparation of the aramid fiber honeycomb composite products.

title_en: Substrate rack and substrate processing system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate rack and a substrate processing system for processing substrates in a reaction chamber. The substrate holder may be used to introduce a plurality of substrates into the reaction chamber. The substrate frame may have a plurality of spaced apart substrate holders configured to hold the substrates in a spaced apart relationship. The gantry may have an illumination system to impinge radiation having a range of 100 to 500 nanometers onto a top surface of the substrate.

title_en: Graphene mask cloth and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses graphene mask cloth and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of mask base cloth. The biomass graphene mask cloth comprises an inner layer, a middle layer and an outer layer, wherein the inner layer is a liquid storage layer, the middle layer is a graphene fiber layer, and the outer layer is an impermeable layer. The invention solves the problems that the existing mask base cloth has weak adsorption capacity on residual dust on the face and cosmetics and has poor antibacterial effect.

title_en: Method for in-situ modification of three-dimensional nickel-iron hydrotalcite electrocatalytic oxygen evolution electrode by aid of cerium ions on surface of foamed nickel substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for in-situ modification of a three-dimensional nickel-iron hydrotalcite electrocatalytic oxygen evolution electrode by the aid of cerium ions on the surface of a foamed nickel substrate, which respectively takes nickel nitrate hexahydrate and ferric nitrate nonahydrate as an iron source and a nickel source, cerium nitrate hexahydrate as an auxiliary synthetic agent, urea as a hydrolytic agent and foamed nickel as a conductive substrate, and adopts a hydrothermal method to synthesize a three-dimensional nickel-iron hydrotalcite nanosheet-shaped material on the surface of the foamed nickel conductive substrate in situ in one step. Due to the surface coordination of cerium ions in the synthesis process, a thin nickel-iron hydrotalcite nano flaky material is formed, and the number of oxygen vacancies on the surface of the material is increased, so that the coordination number of catalytic active centers (nickel and iron) is reduced, the activity is increased, and the electrocatalytic oxygen evolution capability of the nickel-iron hydrotalcite nano flaky material is greatly improved.

title_en: Surface treatment device, surface treatment method and blade
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface treatment device, a surface treatment method and a blade. The invention aims to provide a surface treatment device and a blade which can uniformly stir surface treatment liquid near a plated object to ensure uniform plating thickness and improved strength, and a surface treatment method which can uniformly stir the plating thickness and improve the strength of the blade and can stir for a long time. The surface treatment device is characterized in that a plurality of square bars arranged along the depth direction of the surface treatment liquid are integrally formed on the blade at constant intervals along the object to be plated, and the square bars are provided with curved surfaces facing the object to be plated in the section of the thickness direction of the square bars.

title_en: Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition (PEALD) of SiN using a silicon hydrohalide precursor
abstract_en: A method for forming a silicon nitride film is provided. In some embodiments, the silicon nitride may be deposited by Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), such as plasma enhanced ALD. The one or more silicon nitride deposition cycles comprise a sequential plasma pretreatment phase in which the substrate is sequentially exposed to a hydrogen plasma and then to a nitrogen plasma in the absence of the hydrogen plasma, and a deposition phase in which the substrate is exposed to a silicon precursor. In some embodiments, silicon nitride is deposited using a silicon hydrohalide precursor. The silicon nitride film may have high sidewall conformality, and in some embodiments, the silicon nitride film may be thicker at the bottom of the sidewalls than at the top of the sidewalls in the trench structure. The silicon nitride deposition process may reduce or eliminate voids and seams during the gap fill process.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaning apparatus and ultrasonic cleaning method
abstract_en: The ultrasonic waves are more efficiently propagated to the whole treatment tank, and the object to be cleaned is more efficiently cleaned. An ultrasonic cleaning device (1) is provided with: a treatment tank (10) which contains a cleaning liquid for cleaning an object to be cleaned, and in which the object to be cleaned is immersed (immersed) in the treatment tank (10); an ultrasonic wave applying mechanism (20) for applying an ultrasonic wave to the held cleaning liquid; and a curved surface member (30) which faces the vibration surface of the ultrasonic wave application means and is positioned within a range defined by a predetermined inclination angle to the outside from the normal direction at the end of the vibration surface, and which holds the curved surface member (30) on the wall surface and/or the bottom surface of the treatment tank, wherein the curved surface member has a convex curved surface (31), the convex curved surface (31) has at least a convex curved portion (33) having a spherical or aspherical surface shape, the convex curved portion protrudes toward the vibration surface side from a portion other than the convex curved portion, and the curved surface member (30) is held in a state in which the convex curved surface faces the vibration surface so that at least a part of the first sound wave, which is the sound wave irradiated from the ultrasonic wave application means and is not reflected, reaches the convex curved portion of the convex curved surface.

title_en: Control method for surface appearance of hot-galvanized ultra-deep drawing steel for automobile panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the surface appearance of hot-dip galvanized ultra-deep drawing steel for an automobile panel, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: less than or equal to 0.0025 percent of C, less than or equal to 0.020 percent of Si, and the weight ratio of Mn: 0.10-0.15%, P is less than or equal to 0.012%, S is less than or equal to 0.010%, Als: 0.020 to 0.050%, Ti: 0.055-0.080%, N is less than or equal to 0.0040%, and the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities. The manufacturing method comprises the working procedures of smelting, continuous casting, hot rolling, acid continuous rolling, hot galvanizing and the like. By controlling the production process, especially the process conditions of cold continuous rolling and hot galvanizing stages, the hot galvanizing ultra-deep drawing steel has good tensile property, and the surface roughness and the waviness can meet the requirements of automobile factories.

title_en: Liquid supply pipeline, vertical roller coater and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of strip steel hot galvanizing post-treatment processes, in particular to a liquid supply pipeline, a vertical roller coater and a use method thereof. The invention discloses a novel liquid supply pipeline for a strip steel vertical roller coater, which can supply liquid to two liquid supply trays in the vertical roller coater according to selection through the arrangement of two liquid supplementing mechanisms, so that the sides of strip steel which need to be coated with the coating liquid can be coated according to the needs.

title_en: Hot-pressing curing method for photovoltaic module and pressing equipment for hot-pressing curing
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a pressing device and a hot-pressing curing method of a photovoltaic module, aiming at the defects that when the viscosity of an adhesive is high, cavities are easily generated at the corners of the photovoltaic module when the photovoltaic module is packaged by the packaging method and the packaging device of the photovoltaic module in the prior art, so that the performance of the photovoltaic module is affected, the pressing device and the hot-pressing curing method of the photovoltaic module are provided, the laminated member which completes the vacuum heating and pressurizing step is transferred into a second lower cavity, after the cavity of a curing cavity is closed, compressed gas is filled into the second upper cavity, so that the flexible pressing member is pressed against the upper surface of the photovoltaic module to heat and pressurize the photovoltaic module for curing, the method and the device are adopted to heat, pressurize and cure the photovoltaic module, the compressed gas is filled into the upper cavity in a non-vacuum state, the compressed gas applies positive pressure to the flexible pressing member from the upper part of the flexible pressing member, and the adhesive slowly moves when the photovoltaic module is pressed, the edge cavity can be reduced, and the generation of cavities can be reduced.

title_en: Method for mounting suspended bubble for automobile glass
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for mounting suspended bubbles for automobile glass, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: pre-cutting a glass film; step 2: suspending and cutting bubbles: and step 3: cleaning the inner side glass; and 4, step 4: attaching the glass film processed in the step 2; and 5: spraying lubricating liquid on the surface of the glass film, and discharging excessive water by adopting a water squeezing tool; step 6: and (5) finishing the glass film. The film pasting method adopting the mode can effectively improve the working efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method of composite material containing PVC pre-coating film with super wear resistance and easy cleaning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of floor composite materials, and particularly provides a composite material containing a PVC (polyvinyl chloride) pre-coating film and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of a composite material containing a PVC pre-coating film, which comprises the steps of preparing a PVC pre-coating film by utilizing a PVC transparent film layer and a radiation curing coating; laminating the PVC pre-coating film, the substrate material and the printed decorative layer at high temperature; and cooling and forming to obtain the composite material containing the PVC pre-coated film which is super wear-resistant and easy to clean. The method utilizes the PVC pre-coating film material, the substrate material and the printing decoration layer to improve the anti-deformation capability of the obtained composite floor material and avoid adverse phenomena such as warping and the like in a high-temperature pressing mode, solves the problem of uneven luster of a coating obtained by the traditional preparation method, is simple, saves equipment and labor cost, is beneficial to realizing full-line automatic production, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Dinuclear complex and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a binuclear complex and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the binuclear complex comprises a structure shown as a formula I or a structure shown as a formula II, wherein M is a cobalt atom or a nickel atom; the invention provides a binuclear complex water oxidation catalyst with a novel structure, which does not contain noble metals, and the prepared catalyst has good catalytic activity while avoiding the use of the noble metals; has good application prospect in the aspect of water oxidation catalysis.

title_en: Roller conveying type heavy metal contaminated soil continuous restoration and heavy metal recovery device
abstract_en: The invention provides a roller conveying type heavy metal polluted soil continuous restoration and heavy metal recovery device, which comprises a conveying belt, a cylinder body and a polluted soil restoration and heavy metal recovery mechanism, wherein the cylinder body penetrates through the polluted soil restoration and heavy metal recovery mechanism and is fixed on the conveying belt, and a plurality of through holes are uniformly formed in the cylinder body; the contaminated soil restoration and heavy metal recovery mechanism comprises a box body, the barrel penetrates through the box body to divide the box body into an anode chamber and a cathode chamber, and the anode chamber and the cathode chamber are respectively positioned on two sides of the barrel body. The roller conveying type heavy metal contaminated soil continuous restoration and heavy metal recovery device disclosed by the invention can restore the soil polluted by various heavy metal mixtures, is suitable for various soil properties, can restore the contaminated soil in situ, is backfilled in situ after restoration, is not limited by the soil pollution depth, and has the advantages of good restoration effect, high speed, low cost, controllable restoration quality and the like.

title_en: Laser cladding process for die
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser cladding process for a die, which comprises the following process steps: stirring raw materials, wherein the step a comprises a stirring piece, and cladding coating materials are uniformly stirred by the stirring piece; b, moving a unit, wherein the step b comprises a base, pushing the base, and pushing the cladding material to a set position for subsequent coating work; c, coating transmission, wherein the mixed cladding coating material is transmitted to a workpiece to be coated in the step c; d, coating, wherein the step d comprises a discharging part, coating materials are conveyed to the surface of a workpiece, the discharging part is moved by pushing the base, and the coating materials are coated on the surface of the workpiece by the discharging part.

title_en: Gold paper's preparation facilities
abstract_en: The golden paper preparation device comprises a frame, a golden paper transmission mechanism, a hot pressing mechanism and a winding device, wherein the golden paper transmission mechanism comprises golden paper and a golden paper roller which is rotatably arranged on the frame and is used for installing the golden paper; the gilt paper drive mechanism comprises gilt paper and a mounting rack arranged on the frame and used for mounting the gilt paper; the hot pressing mechanism comprises a first hot pressing roller rotatably arranged on the frame and a second hot pressing roller rotatably arranged above the first hot pressing roller, the outer peripheral surfaces of the first hot pressing roller and the second hot pressing roller are coated with high-temperature-resistant gummed paper, and a composite channel for compositing the gilding paper and the yellow paper is formed between the first hot pressing roller and the second hot pressing roller; the winding device comprises a winding roller which is rotatably arranged on the rack and used for winding the gold paper, and a first driving device which is used for driving the winding roller to rotate, and the high-temperature-resistant gummed paper is arranged to ensure that the gold paper cannot be damaged due to high temperature of the hot pressing roller when the gold paper is hot-stamped on the gold paper, so that the yield is improved.

title_en: Growth method for effectively reducing defects of silicon carbide single crystal and high-quality silicon carbide single crystal
abstract_en: The invention provides a growth method for effectively reducing defects of a silicon carbide single crystal and a high-quality silicon carbide single crystal, and the method comprises the following steps: and arranging a silicon carbide crystal block between the silicon carbide powder and the seed crystal, heating, crystallizing the silicon carbide powder at the silicon carbide crystal block after sublimation to generate a silicon carbide transition layer, and crystallizing the silicon carbide transition layer at the seed crystal after sublimation to grow the silicon carbide single crystal. According to the method, the silicon carbide crystal block is arranged, so that the growth of the silicon carbide single crystal is not directly from the sublimation of the silicon carbide powder, but from the gas phase sublimation of the transition layer of the source silicon carbide, fine graphite particles formed after the silicon carbide powder is carbonized can be effectively eliminated, and the impurities in the silicon carbide powder can be effectively prevented from entering the silicon carbide single crystal along with the gas flow brought into the crystal; and the more proper Si/C ratio in the growth chamber is ensured, and the defects of inclusions, micropipes, dislocation and the like generated in the growth process of the silicon carbide single crystal are reduced, so that the high-quality silicon carbide single crystal is obtained.

title_en: Mask plate assembly and evaporation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mask plate component which comprises a metal frame and mask strips arranged on the metal frame, wherein the mask strips comprise evaporation areas provided with a plurality of evaporation holes and four edge areas positioned around the evaporation areas, and at least one edge area is provided with a plurality of through holes. On the premise of not reducing the width of the edge area of the mask strip, the through holes are arranged in the edge area, so that the weight is reduced, the sagging amount of the mask strip is reduced, and the warping amount of the frame is also reduced.

title_en: Copper surface micro-etching roughening solution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a copper surface microetching coarsening liquid which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 5-50 g/L of divalent copper ions from a copper ion source, 20-150 g/L of organic acid, 3-105 g/L of chloride ions from a chloride ion source, 0.0005-2 g/L of water-soluble polymer and 0.001-10 g/L of pyridine derivative, wherein the solvent is water; wherein the organic acid is at least one of formic acid, acetic acid, malic acid, citric acid, tartaric acid, ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid, iminodisuccinic acid, monochloroacetic acid, dichloroacetic acid and trichloroacetic acid; the water-soluble polymer is a polymer with a molecular chain containing an imidazole or ammonium salt structure. The copper surface roughening liquid can form uniform roughening on the surface of copper, is not influenced by the crystal structure of the copper surface, and can effectively improve the adhesive force of a solder resist coating coated on the copper surface in a subsequent process.

title_en: Graphene-aluminum composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a graphene-aluminum composite material, which comprises the following steps: providing graphene aerogel, and forming an aluminum film on the surface of the graphene aerogel by adopting a vacuum evaporation method; stirring the graphene aerogel with the aluminum film formed on the surface to obtain graphene powder with the aluminum film formed on the surface; and compounding the graphene powder with the aluminum film formed on the surface and the aluminum matrix by adopting a stirring casting method. The invention further relates to a graphene-aluminum composite material and a cable or wire comprising the graphene-aluminum composite material.

title_en: Normal-temperature nickel-free sealing liquid for aluminum and aluminum alloy anodic oxidation and sealing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a normal temperature nickel-free sealing liquid for aluminum and aluminum alloy anodic oxidation and a sealing method, wherein aluminum or aluminum alloy is subjected to anodic oxidation treatment and water washing and then is immersed in the nickel-free sealing liquid for sealing treatment, and the formula of the nickel-free sealing liquid is as follows: the concentration of zirconium salt is 10-25g/L, the concentration of lithium salt is 5-10g/L, the concentration of polycarboxylic acid is 1.5-3g/L, the concentration of surfactant is 0.1-0.5g/L, and the balance is water. The pH value of the nickel-free sealing liquid is 3.1-4.1, the temperature is 15-30 ℃, and the sealing speed of the anodic oxide film is 1-2 min/mu m; and after the sealing is finished, putting the aluminum or the aluminum alloy in an atmospheric environment for aging for more than 5 days. The sealing liquid and the sealing method provided by the invention can realize high-quality normal-temperature sealing, and the sealing liquid does not contain heavy metal nickel ions harmful to human bodies and the environment, thereby being beneficial to the health and the environment of operators.

title_en: Structure and method for reducing aluminum electrolysis cell shutdown voltage drop
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structure and a method for reducing the pressure drop of an aluminum electrolysis cell during cell shutdown, wherein the structure comprises a plurality of temporary buses arranged between a bus bar and short-circuit buses at each short-circuit port position, the short-circuit buses at each short-circuit port position are connected to first temporary buses at two ends of an upright post bus, and the first temporary buses at two ends are connected with the bus bar; and the cell stopping current inlet end bus bar is connected with the previous electrolysis bus bar through a second temporary bus bar. The invention has simple and easy installation operation and less cost investment; the effect is obvious after the implementation, and the pressure drop of the shutdown tank can be greatly reduced.

title_en: High-speed high-power-density motor rotating shaft and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-speed high-power-density motor rotating shaft and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) pouring molten steel into a steel ingot, and forging to obtain a steel bar; (2) roughly processing the steel bar obtained in the step (1) to obtain a blank rotating shaft, and repeatedly performing heat treatment on the blank rotating shaft to obtain a heat-treated blank rotating shaft; (3) and (3) under the protection of inert gas, spraying multi-element nickel-based alloy powder, molybdenum powder and cobalt powder on the surface of the blank rotating shaft obtained in the step (2), preparing a wear-resistant cladding layer, and finally performing finish machining until the size and the precision meet the requirements, so as to obtain the high-speed high-power-density motor rotating shaft. According to the preparation method, the strength and the toughness of the rotating shaft are greatly improved by adding trace alloy elements, and on the basis, the wear-resistant coating is laser-clad on the working surface of the rotating shaft, so that the surface hardness of the rotating shaft is greatly improved, and the wear resistance of the rotating shaft is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped heterogeneous catalyst for oxygen production by electrolyzing water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nitrogen-doped heterogeneous catalyst for oxygen production by electrolyzing water, which comprises the following steps: dissolving cobalt acetate, thiourea and ammonium fluoride in a mixed solvent consisting of deionized water and ethylene glycol to obtain a precursor solution, transferring the precursor solution into a hydrothermal kettle, adding foamed nickel, carrying out solvothermal one-pot reaction, and carrying out twice temperature rise to grow Co of a heterostructure on the foamed nickel in situ Co-production manner 4 S 3 /Ni 3 S 2 After the solvothermal reaction of the nano-sheet composite material is finished, the foamed nickel-based composite material is subjected to high-temperature nitridation treatment, and finally the foamed nickel-based nitrogen-doped oxygen production heterogeneous catalyst by water electrolysis is obtained. The invention adopts the nano-sheet composite material which grows on the foam nickel in situ as the catalyst for preparing oxygen by electrolyzing water, reduces the cost of the catalyst compared with the catalyst for preparing oxygen by electrolyzing water by noble metal and oxide thereof, and improves the intrinsic catalytic activity of the catalyst for preparing oxygen by electrolyzing water compared with the transition metal sulfide nano-sheet catalyst which has single component and is not doped and modified.

title_en: Electrochemical synthesis method of 2-substituted benzothiazole compound
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrochemical synthesis method of a 2-substituted benzothiazole compound, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding electrolyte, manganese salt catalyst, electrolytic solvent, benzyl ether compound and o-aminothiophenol into a diaphragm-free electrolytic cell, inserting into an anode and a cathode, and performing electrochemical reaction under the conditions of stirring, electrifying and constant current; (2) and after the reaction is finished, extracting, separating and purifying the solution after the reaction to obtain the 2-substituted benzothiazole compound. The invention takes benzyl ether compound and o-aminobenzenethiol as raw materials in a diaphragm-free single-chamber electrolytic cell to obtain the 2-substituted benzothiazole compound under the conditions of normal temperature, normal pressure and constant current, wherein, the manganese salt has low price, no extra hyperoxidant is needed to be added in the synthetic process, the reaction conditions are mild and safe, the product yield is high, the production cost is low, the environmental pollution is small, the green chemical requirement is met, and a feasible practical scheme is provided for the industrialization of the 2-substituted benzothiazole compound.

title_en: Feeding device of automatic production equipment for sponge nail files and process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feeding device of automatic sponge nail file production equipment, which belongs to the field of production of products for medical care and comprises a first support frame, a discharging frame, a limiting component, an anti-blocking component, a detection component, a receiving component, a feeding conveying belt, a dust removal component and a feeding component, wherein the first support frame and the feeding component are arranged at intervals, the discharging frame, the receiving component and the feeding conveying belt are sequentially arranged at the top of the first support frame along a straight line, the limiting component is arranged on the outer wall of the discharging frame, the anti-blocking component is arranged at the bottom of the discharging frame, the dust removal component is positioned right above the feeding conveying belt, a discharging port of the discharging frame is provided with a connecting discharging channel, the receiving component is positioned right below the connecting discharging channel, and the detection component is arranged on the connecting discharging channel. The automatic feeding device realizes automatic feeding operation of the file body and the connecting sheet for processing the sponge nail file, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Automatic antirust paint brushing device for motor rotor assembly line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic antirust paint brushing device for a motor rotor assembly line, which has the technical scheme that the device comprises a conveying mechanism, a painting mechanism and a transfer mechanism, wherein the conveying mechanism comprises a conveying gear, a stepping motor and a conveying chain, the conveying chain is provided with a placing plate, the placing plate is provided with a placing groove, the placing groove is arranged in a step-shaped structure, the side wall of the placing groove is provided with rotating wheels, the placing plate is arranged in an equidistant mode along the length direction of the conveying chain, an in-place inductive switch is arranged in the placing groove, the painting mechanism comprises a driving part, the transfer mechanism comprises a driving wheel, a driving motor and a transmission chain, a shifting plate is arranged on the transmission chain, the length dimension of the shifting plate is smaller than the distance dimension between two placing plates in the same group, and a horizontal retaining part is arranged on. This automatic brush anti-rust paint device can carry out mechanized mopping operation to the electric motor rotor of different specifications, reduces the human cost, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Steel backing glue spreader
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glue spreader, in particular to a steel backing glue spreader. The technical problem is how to provide a steel backing glue spreader capable of automatically spreading glue in batches. A steel backing glue spreader comprises a frame, a conveying limit plate, a first rotating shaft, a glue spreading wheel, a first bracket, a glue tank and the like; the frame top is equipped with a pair of conveying limiting plate, and two conveying limiting plates form steel backing spacing spout and promote the groove, and two conveying limiting plate one sides all are opened the opening, and the rubber coating wheel setting is in the spout that two conveying limiting plates formed, and first pivot is connected with the rubber coating wheel through the opening and the rubber coating wheel rigid coupling of both sides conveying limiting plate, first pivot and rubber coating wheel rigid coupling. According to the automatic steel back feeding device, an operator only needs to put the steel back into the feeding barrel, the automatic feeding can be realized by starting the device, the function of automatically pushing the steel back to be coated is realized, and glue is coated by the coating wheel and is evenly scraped by the scraper.

title_en: Lift pin system and lift pin assembly for wafer processing
abstract_en: The application discloses a lifting pin system and a lifting pin assembly. In one or more methods, the lift pin system includes: a wafer support, such as an electrostatic chuck or platen; and a lift pin assembly coupled to the wafer support. The lift pin assembly may include a plurality of pins. Each of the plurality of pins may include: a tip extending through the housing; a spring is located within the housing, wherein the spring springs against the tip and the support arm is coupled to the housing. In some approaches, the housing and support arm may be coupled by threads to enable access to the tips of each pin above the top surface of the wafer support for easy replacement. The replaceable pin tips also allow for easier customized placement of pin tip geometry, materials, spring forces depending on the particular process and/or wafer characteristics.

title_en: Treatment system and treatment method for waste tire cracking carbon black
abstract_en: The invention provides a waste tire pyrolysis carbon black treatment system which comprises a steam stripping and oil removing device and a zinc recovery device, wherein the steam stripping and oil removing device and the zinc recovery device are sequentially connected, the steam stripping and oil removing device is used for utilizing superheated steam to steam a slurry containing waste tire pyrolysis carbon black so as to remove oil in the waste tire pyrolysis carbon black, and the zinc recovery device is used for recovering zinc from the steam-stripped waste tire pyrolysis carbon black. According to the invention, through the steam stripping oil removal device and the zinc recovery device which are sequentially connected, oil in the waste tire cracking carbon black is effectively removed, the hydrophobicity of the waste tire cracking carbon black is reduced, the waste tire cracking carbon black can be fully mixed with an aqueous solution, and the subsequent zinc recovery efficiency is improved. At the same time, the performance of the cracked carbon black is also greatly improved due to the reduction of oil content.

title_en: Quartz-based composite material, preparation method and antenna housing prepared from quartz-based composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a quartz-based composite material, which comprises the following steps of 1, preparing a quartz fiber reinforced foam material; step 2, weaving a quartz fiber preform on the surface of the foaming material to obtain a fabric A; step 3, circularly adopting a silica sol dipping and drying mode to circularly operate the fabric A to constant weight, heating in an oxidizing atmosphere to remove the foaming material, and firing a blank; and 4, filling aerogel into the blank to obtain the quartz-based composite material reinforced by the quartz fiber. The purpose that the broadband of the antenna housing penetrates through electromagnetic waves is ideally achieved by utilizing a non-single-layer housing wall structure.

title_en: Polyphenylene ether-containing resin composition
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a polyphenylene ether-containing resin composition having excellent electrical characteristics, and an electronic circuit board material, a resin film, a prepreg, and a laminate each formed using the same. The solution is to provide a resin composition comprising: (a) The polyphenylene ether component has a structure represented by the following formula (1) and has a number average molecular weight of 500 to 8,000{ wherein X, a, R  5  K, Y, n, A and L are as defined in the specification; (b) a cross-linking agent; and (c) an organic peroxide. (1)

title_en: Plasma spray gun
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plasma spray gun, which comprises a gun body, wherein a cooling water channel is arranged in the gun body, the cooling water channel comprises a cathode cooling water channel and an anode cooling water channel, water inlets and water outlets of the cathode cooling water channel and the anode cooling water channel are respectively converged, and the water inlets and the water outlets are positioned at the end parts of a gun base extending out of a sealing cover; the anode cooling water channel penetrates through the gun base, the connecting sleeve, the protruding ring of the insulating sleeve, the anode sheath and the wall body of the anode nozzle; the cathode cooling water channel is positioned in the gun base and the copper sleeve; the wall body of the anode nozzle far away from one end of the cathode head is also provided with a powder injection port. In the invention, the traditional two-stage serial cooling mode is changed into a one-stage parallel cooling mode. Namely, after cooling water enters the spray gun, the spray gun is immediately divided into two paths of pipelines which respectively flow through the anode and the cathode, so that the anode and the cathode can be sufficiently cooled; the traditional gun external powder spraying mode is changed into powder which is directly injected into the nozzle.

title_en: Method for manufacturing recording medium and image recording method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a recording medium and an image recording method, the method for manufacturing the recording medium includes: the method for manufacturing a recording medium includes a step of preparing a liquid A containing at least 1 flocculant selected from the group consisting of acids, polyvalent metal compounds, and metal complexes and water, a step of preparing a liquid B containing a resin and water, a step of mixing the liquid A and the liquid B at an ambient temperature of 5 to 40 ℃ to obtain a mixed liquid, a step of storing the mixed liquid at an ambient temperature of 5 to 40 ℃, and a step of applying the stored mixed liquid to an impermeable base within 30 days from the start of mixing the liquid A and the liquid B to obtain a recording medium.

title_en: Wear-resistant iron-based high-speed laser cladding coating material and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant iron-based high-speed laser cladding coating material and application thereof, wherein the material is suitable for a high-speed laser cladding process and an iron-based base material and comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 60-80% of iron-based alloy powder, 6-20% of silicon carbide powder and 10-30% of titanium powder; the iron-based alloy powder is Fe-Cr-Ni-Mo alloy, wherein the mass fraction of Cr is 15-20%, the mass fraction of Ni is 1-5%, the mass fraction of Mo is 1-2%, and the balance is Fe; or the iron-based alloy powder is Fe-Ni-Mo alloy, wherein the mass fraction of Ni is 20-30%, the mass fraction of Mo is 1-2%, and the balance is Fe; the silicon carbide is in an alpha crystal form. The coating obtained by the high-speed laser cladding process has excellent hardness, wear resistance, impact resistance and corrosion resistance, is particularly suitable for working conditions with strict requirements on wear resistance, such as mine rock drilling, engineering tunneling, steel conveying, rollers and the like, and has extremely high application value.

title_en: Electrode for electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide and application thereof
