abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrode for electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is an ordered core-shell catalyst; the preparation method of the electrode comprises the following steps: pretreating a substrate, immersing the substrate in a certain amount of mixture of sodium hydroxide and oxide, and preparing CuO by chemical oxidation method x A nanowire/Cu substrate; adding a reducing agent and an additive into copper salt, mixing in a certain proportion, carrying out Cu deposition by using variable current density, washing, drying, and placing into CO 2 Reducing, washing and drying the saturated electrolyte at constant potential; and soaking the prepared gas diffusion electrode in a concentrated hydrochloric acid solution with the concentration of 36-38% to prepare the electrode. The invention utilizes vacancy copper with more active area, defect sites and coupling synergistic effect among components to improve the selectivity and activity of hydrocarbon; using Cu + Interacts with each metal to convert CO 2 The electro-reduction is limited in the functional structure domain, and the catalyst is prevented from being in CO 2 Loss in the reduction process and improvement of the stability of the catalyst.

title_en: Foamed sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides a foamed sheet which can exert excellent impact absorbability even if the thickness is very thin and has excellent heat resistance. The foamed sheet of the present invention is composed of a foam having an average cell diameter of 10 to 200 μm, and has a compression set at 80 ℃ of 80% or less and an impact absorption change rate defined by the following formula of ± 20% or less. Impact absorption change rate (%) = { (impact absorption rate after high-temperature compression b-initial impact absorption rate a)/initial impact absorption rate a } × 100 initial impact absorption rate a: impact absorption rate (%) of test piece a impact absorption rate b (%) after high-temperature compression: the test piece a was stored at 80 ℃ for 72 hours in a state of being compressed by 60% relative to the initial thickness of the test piece a, and then released from the compressed state, and the impact absorption (%) was measured after 24 hours at 23 ℃.

title_en: Intelligent coating colloid tool device for wind power generation blade production
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent coating colloid tool equipment that wind power generation blade production was used, relates to wind power blade manufacturing technical field, including backup pad, coating colloid mechanism and intelligent data control system, coating colloid mechanism is equipped with glue inlet and laser locator including the rectangular equipment framework of inside for the cavity in equipment framework top central point put, and the bottom of equipment framework is equipped with out the glue inlet and the locating rod, and the locating rod is fixed in equipment framework bottom central point put, is equipped with longitudinal rail and along longitudinal rail vertical valve block that slides from top to bottom respectively on the left and right sides of equipment framework; the bottom surface of the equipment frame body is provided with a transverse guide rail and 2 transverse valve plates sliding left and right along the transverse guide rail. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the invention, different colloid coating widths and thicknesses are controlled at different positions, so that the colloid is accurately used, a colloid coating tool does not need to be repeatedly replaced, the process flow is optimized, the manual operation is reduced, the colloid coating time is accelerated, and the cementing quality is improved.

title_en: Ternary high-entropy foam for high-activity hydrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ternary high-entropy foam for high-activity hydrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of micro-nano material preparation, and comprising Ni, Co and Cu, wherein the Ni content is 30-35 at%, the Co content is 30-35 at%, and the Cu content is 30-35 at%. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the composition. The ternary high-entropy foam for high-activity hydrolysis hydrogen production has the catalytic agent loading capacity of 1.2-10mg/cm 2 The loading capacity is far higher than the effective loading capacity of most nano catalysts, and when the NiCuCo high-entropy alloy foam is used as a hydrolysis hydrogen production catalyst, the hydrogen evolution overpotential on the surface of the NiCuCo high-entropy alloy foam can be as low as 65-100 mV, which is far lower than the level of a common high-entropy alloy strip or film; meanwhile, the preparation method does not need harsh environments such as high temperature, vacuum and the like, and is simple and easy to implement, and the raw materials are low in price.

title_en: Plywood production and processing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plywood production and processing technology which comprises a bottom plate, an adhesive device and a glue solution box, wherein the adhesive device is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the bottom plate, the glue solution box is arranged at the upper end of the adhesive device, and the glue solution box is communicated with the adhesive device. The gluing device can solve the problems that when the existing device is used for processing plywood, the gluing effect of the board is poor, the gluing is not uniform, the phenomenon that gaps are easily generated in the glued board is caused, the using effect of the board is influenced, the glued board cannot be quickly glued, the processing efficiency of the plywood is influenced, and meanwhile, when the existing device is used for gluing the board, the glue solution in the glue solution box cannot be quickly stirred, the phenomenon that the glue solution in the glue solution box is easily solidified, the subsequent coating processing of the glue solution is influenced, and the like.

title_en: Method and device for controlling local temperature gradient of large-mass crystal growth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a local temperature gradient for large-mass crystal growth, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step one, installing a crystal growth furnace, and carrying out heating, material melting, temperature adjustment and seed melting treatment; step two, adjusting the temperature of each temperature zone of the crystal growth furnace after the seeds are melted in the step one, and gradually reducing the shoulder temperature to finish the shouldering process of the crystal; keeping the support tube and the quartz tube of the crystal growth furnace still, moving the transmission device of the crystal growth furnace upwards to drive the furnace body to move, moving the crystal growth interface upwards, and realizing the growth of the crystal; step four: the furnace body moves and simultaneously gradually descends the furnace core of the crystal growth furnace, so that the furnace core of the crystal growth furnace and the supporting tube move relatively; or adjusting the fluid material and the fluid speed in the heat dissipation channel, changing the heat taken away by the heat dissipation channel, and controlling the temperature gradient. The temperature gradient in the crystal growth process is adjusted in a targeted manner by adjusting the heat-insulating material and the relative position in the growth process.

title_en: Electrochemical fluorination external circulation electrolysis system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrochemical fluorination external circulation electrolysis system which comprises an electrolytic bath, an anode cooler, an anode gas-liquid separator, a total cooler, an anode condenser, a cathode cooler, a cathode gas-liquid separator and a cathode condenser, wherein an anode liquid outlet of the electrolytic bath is connected with a liquid inlet of the anode cooler by a pipeline, and a liquid outlet of the anode cooler is connected with a liquid inlet at the upper part of the anode gas-liquid separator by a pipeline; and a liquid outlet at the bottom of the anode gas-liquid separator is connected with a liquid inlet at the top of the main cooler by a pipeline, and a liquid outlet at the bottom of the main cooler is connected with a liquid inlet of the electrolytic bath by a pipeline. The invention is convenient for the miniaturization of the electrolytic cell, can eliminate the risks of refrigerant and electrolyte cross-linking and negative and positive gas mixing explosion, obviously improves the energy efficiency ratio of the electrolytic cell, is safe and reliable, completes heat management by the cooler, can accurately control the electrolysis temperature, and can fully obtain high-purity product gas by gas-liquid separation.

title_en: On-line self-cleaning device for evacuation pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-line self-cleaning device for an evacuating pipeline, which is arranged on a vacuum evacuating pipeline of a silicon single crystal furnace, is close to an inlet of the vacuum evacuating pipeline, is provided with an penetrating hole, and comprises a stirring cleaning device penetrating into the vacuum evacuating pipeline through the penetrating hole and a driving mechanism arranged outside the vacuum evacuating pipeline and driving the stirring cleaning device to work. According to the invention, under the normal running state of the silicon single crystal furnace, the speed reducing motor is driven to drive the stirring and cleaning device to rotate, and impurities or volatile matters adhered to the inner wall of the inlet section of the vacuum evacuation pipeline are cut and stirred, so that the impurities or volatile matters are separated from the inner wall of the vacuum evacuation pipeline and subjected to the evacuation negative pressure action of the vacuum pump set, and the impurities or volatile matters flow to the filter and the vacuum pump set and are far away from the vacuum furnace chamber, so that the online self-cleaning function is realized.

title_en: Production method of waterproof coiled material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of a waterproof coiled material, which comprises the following steps: s1, spreading and drying the tyre fabric; s2, sizing materials are coated on the tyre fabrics, and a scraping roller is pressed and formed; s3, coating a film; s4, cooling; s5, rolling; the tyre fabric in S1 is a long-fiber polyester tyre, and the method provided by the invention can ensure that the produced coiled material has good long-term stability and low water absorption rate, and reduces the technical risk of using the coiled material in a long-term humid environment.

title_en: Composite sheet, system and method for preparing composite sheet
abstract_en: A system and associated method for making a composite sheet is provided. The system comprises: a source of non-woven fabric; a collection surface having a nonwoven fabric deposited thereon; a carding unit disposed downstream of a nonwoven web source above a collection surface, the carding unit including a main cylinder; an air source configured to provide an air flow; an air manifold having an air inlet in communication with an air source, an air outlet, a fiber inlet, an internal passage, and a fiber outlet. The air outlet is positioned to direct a flow of air onto the drum surface to dislodge the fibers from the drum surface. The dislodged fibers enter the fiber inlet and flow to the fiber outlet where they are deposited onto the surface of the nonwoven fabric. The fabric is then bonded to form a coherent sheet.

title_en: Functionalized polystyrene microsphere and infrared invisible anti-glare film material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functionalized polystyrene microsphere and an infrared stealth anti-glare film material. The functionalized polystyrene microsphere comprises a polystyrene microsphere and a metal coating coated outside the polystyrene microsphere. The infrared stealth anti-glare film material comprises a polymer film and functionalized polystyrene microspheres fixed on the surface of the polymer film through an adhesive. The outer layer of the functionalized polystyrene microsphere is wrapped with the metal layer, so that the infrared reflectivity is high, the infrared radiance is low, the infrared stealth anti-glare film material prepared from the functionalized polystyrene microsphere is low in infrared radiance and free of glare, can be used for infrared stealth of fighters, armors and vehicles at night, and can also be used for identification of enemy identity and search of night air-dropped supplies.

title_en: Method for solving problem of bonding of SMD tube shell with gold-aluminum system
abstract_en: The method for solving the problem of the SMD tube shell bonding point gold aluminum system is characterized by comprising the following steps: manufacturing a copper-aluminum transition piece; respectively placing lead-indium-silver solder sheets with corresponding sizes at the chip bonding area and the bonding point of the SMD tube shell, placing required chips on the lead-indium-silver solder sheets positioned at the chip bonding area, and placing cut copper-aluminum transition sheets on the lead-indium-silver solder sheets positioned at the bonding point; placing the SMD tube shell, the chip and the copper-aluminum transition piece into a eutectic soldering furnace for soldering; and after welding, introducing nitrogen to start cooling, and opening a chamber door of the eutectic soldering furnace when the temperature is reduced to below 70 ℃ to take out the welded device. The method solves the problem of a gold-aluminum system when the SMD tube shell is bonded with aluminum wires; the method has the characteristics of good stability, good repeatability, good uniformity, high yield and high reliability; reasonable process and simple operation, is suitable for industrial production, and greatly improves the quality reliability and the service life of military products.

title_en: Heat insulation film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat insulation film and a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, the present invention provides a composite heat insulating film comprising: the heat insulation film comprises more than two superposed single-layer heat insulation films and an outer layer film wrapping the superposed single-layer heat insulation films in plastic package, wherein the single-layer heat insulation films are integrally formed by heat insulation materials through pressing, and one side of each film is provided with a plurality of convex rough surfaces and/or has a porous structure. The heat insulating film of the present invention is used for a battery module or a battery pack to prevent occurrence of heat propagation. When the battery enters thermal runaway, the material has extremely high heat-insulating property, blocks heat transfer between the battery core and the battery core, and can greatly improve the safety of the battery.

title_en: Hydrogel-based sustained-release mask and preparation method and use method thereof
abstract_en: The hydrogel-based slow-release mask comprises a back lining layer and non-woven fibers which are sequentially arrangedA dimensional layer A, a hydrogel layer, a non-woven fiber layer B and a hydrogel layer. The hydrogel in the hydrogel layer comprises (1) a compound of the general formula R- (EO) n ‑(PO) m ‑(EO) n An aqueous block copolymer of the formula (2) HO- (EO) a ‑(PO) b ‑(EO) a -poloxamer of H, (3) an auxiliary gel-sol agent, (4) a skin care ingredient, (5) balance water. The aqueous block copolymer used is a poloxamer-based derivative, with the general structural formula HO- (EO) using amino acid pairs n ‑(PO) m ‑(EO) n -H poloxamer is esterified and capped, and then the structural general formula is HO- (EO) a ‑(PO) b ‑(EO) a -H poloxamer, which can control the gel-solution transition temperature of the hydrogel between 30-35 ℃, while allowing the hydrogel to assume a transparent gel form between 0-20 ℃. The hydrogel of the invention has particular application advantages in maintenance masks.

title_en: Sand blasting phosphating production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand blasting phosphating production line which comprises an automatic feeding system, wherein the automatic feeding system is provided with a wet sand blasting system through a feeding lifting mechanism, the discharge end of the wet sand blasting system is provided with a cleaning phosphating line, the discharge end of the cleaning phosphating line is provided with an automatic discharging system, one side of the cleaning phosphating line is provided with an electric control system and an overhauling platform, the other side of the cleaning phosphating line is provided with a full-automatic phosphating slag remover and a phosphating liquid storage tank, and one end of the phosphating liquid storage tank is provided with a quantitative adding mechanism; and the sealed barrel is adopted for drying, so that the temperature can reach the requirement in a short time, and the sealed barrel is favorable for drying the product in a short time, thereby reducing the energy consumption.

title_en: Electroplating clamping device and method for preparing patterned nanowire by using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electroplating clamping device which comprises a mandril, a first clamping piece arranged below the mandril, a second clamping piece arranged below the first clamping piece, a base arranged below the second clamping piece, and a clamping area arranged between the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece. An external pressure is applied to the first and second clamps through the lift pins and the base. An external pressure is applied to the first and second clamps through the lift pins and the base. The electroplating clamping device can increase the binding force between the anodic aluminum oxide membrane and the substrate, and reduce the gap between the anodic aluminum oxide template and the substrate, so that the electrodeposited metal can smoothly enter the holes of the anodic aluminum oxide template to form the nanowires. The invention also discloses a method for preparing the patterned nanowire by using the electroplating clamping device. The patterned metal nanowire can be prepared by the method.

title_en: Light wave-proof sleeve for aviation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light wave-proof sleeve for aviation, which comprises a wave-proof sleeve body, a heat dissipation layer, an anti-interference layer, a wear-resistant layer and a flame-retardant layer; the wave-proof sleeve body is formed by weaving a plurality of strands of tinned copper-clad aluminum wires, the surface of each strand of tinned copper-clad aluminum wire is coated with a heat dissipation layer, the surface of the heat dissipation layer is coated with an anti-interference layer, the surface of the anti-interference layer is coated with a wear-resistant layer, and the surface of the wear-resistant layer is coated with a flame-retardant layer; according to the invention, the first motor is controlled to rotate, the angle of the crank rod is changed, so that the vertical distance between the second wire wheels is changed, the copper-clad aluminum wire can be changed in the tin plating liquid transmission time, and the copper-clad aluminum wires with different thicknesses can be subjected to zinc plating treatment; the solidification equipment who sets up improves UV lamp to copper clad aluminum wire surface tin cladding material solidification efficiency, and simultaneously, rotatory barrel drives electrical heating board and UV lamp and heats and the solidification treatment to the copper clad aluminum wire of multiunit simultaneously, and simultaneously, the electrical heating board also makes the tin coating shaping, has improved the efficiency of light-duty ripples cover preparation technology of preventing greatly.

title_en: Ultra-high smooth polyamide master batch, polyamide film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrahigh smooth polyamide master batch, a polyamide film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ultrahigh smooth polyamide film is sequentially provided with an upper surface layer, a core layer and a lower surface layer from top to bottom; the upper surface layer and the lower surface layer comprise 3-6 parts of ultra-high smooth polyamide master batch and 94-97 parts of polyamide resin by mass part; the core layer is composed of polyamide resin; wherein the ultra-high smooth polyamide master batch comprises, by mass, 0.5-10 parts of silicon-acrylic acid microspheres formed by copolymerizing organic silicon and acrylic acid, 0-10 parts of an opening agent and 80-99.5 parts of polyamide resin. The polyamide master batch and the polyamide film have lower friction coefficient, overcome the problem that the common slipping agent is easy to migrate, expand the application field of the polyamide film and have wide application prospect.

title_en: Hot-dip coating device for copper wire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of copper wires, in particular to a hot-dip coating device for copper wires, which comprises a processing table, a cooling table and a winding table, wherein a hydrochloric acid cleaning tank, a water passing cleaning tank and a constant-temperature crucible tank which are distributed in an equidistant structure are respectively arranged at the center of the outer wall of the top of the processing table, the hydrochloric acid cleaning tank, the water passing cleaning tank and the constant-temperature crucible tank are in inverted trapezoid structures, and the bottoms of the centers of the inner walls of the adjacent sides of the hydrochloric acid cleaning tank, the water passing cleaning tank and the constant-temperature crucible tank are movably connected with wire pressing. The copper wire coating machine has the beneficial effects that hydrochloric acid cleaning, water washing, hot dipping, shaping, cooling and drying are integrated to perform coating treatment on copper wires, so that the copper wire coating treatment is more convenient and faster, the processing efficiency of the copper wire coating treatment is greatly improved, and the locking screw rod fixes the rotating shafts of the unwinding roller and the winding roller in the positioning cylinder through the locking clamping plate, so that the unwinding roller and the winding roller are more convenient to disassemble and replace.

title_en: Composite corrosion inhibitor and method for inhibiting carbon steel corrosion in Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction water by using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon steel corrosion prevention, and discloses a composite corrosion inhibitor and a method for inhibiting carbon steel corrosion in Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction water by using the composite corrosion inhibitor. When the composite corrosion inhibitor is used for treating Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction water, the corrosion of the Fischer-Tropsch synthesis reaction water to carbon steel equipment can be remarkably inhibited, and the composite corrosion inhibitor is simple to operate, convenient, rapid, safe and effective.

title_en: Manufacturing process of super-wear-resistant sound-absorbing soft floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a super wear-resistant sound-absorbing soft floor, and belongs to the technical field of plate processing. The method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing materials: mixing the straw sections, the glue solution, the additive and other components uniformly; s2, heating: transferring the uniformly mixed materials into a heating tank body to be heated into a semi-fluid molten state; s3, extrusion: transferring the semifluid into an extruder to be extruded into a strip-shaped body; s4, primary rolling: directly connecting the strip-shaped body into a press roller unit to be rolled into a sheet-shaped soft substrate; s5, secondary rolling: the press roll unit respectively rolls the cloth fiber layer and the sound absorption layer on the upper surface and the lower surface of the soft substrate to form a soft roll-formed glue permeating plate; s6, stacking: sequentially stacking the soft roll-formed glue-impregnated plate, the decorative layer and the wear-resistant layer; s7, pressing: after being stacked, the materials are placed into a press to be pressed and compounded, and the super wear-resistant sound-absorbing soft floor is manufactured. Under the buffer type synergistic effect of the soft substrate and the wear-resistant layer, the wear resistance of the whole plate is improved, and the technical effect of super wear resistance is achieved.

title_en: Optics nickel plating machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nickel plating equipment, in particular to an optical nickel plating machine which comprises a shell, wherein a conversion mechanism is arranged in the middle of the lower end of the shell, a plurality of liquid storage barrels and supporting blocks are arranged on the conversion mechanism, a through hole is formed in the side wall of one side of the upper end of the shell in a penetrating mode, a sealing shell is arranged at the upper end of the through hole, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the sealing shell, a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the lower end of the shell, the sliding groove is of an annular structure and is located on the same central line with the shell, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the outer. The shell is provided with the switching mechanism, and the fixing ring of the switching mechanism is provided with the liquid storage barrels, so that different cleaning solutions and nickel solutions can be respectively filled into the liquid storage barrels during use, then the fixing ring is rotated through the servo motor, the liquid storage barrel below the through hole is replaced, the parts can be conveniently cleaned and plated with nickel, the parts do not need to be frequently transferred, and the convenience is realized.

title_en: Rust prevention method for aluminum alloy part
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-rust method for an aluminum alloy part, which comprises the following steps: in the machining process, for the aluminum alloy part cast with the cooling liquid, after one part is machined, the cooling liquid drops on the surface of the part are blown off; placing the aluminum alloy part subjected to cooling liquid drop blowing-off into clear water to be soaked for a preset time, and completely immersing the aluminum alloy part in the clear water; after soaking, the parts are taken out and dried, and the cleaning and rust-preventing method is adopted for the aluminum alloy parts needing to be poured with cooling liquid in the machining process, so that coolant stains remained on the surface of the aluminum alloy due to pouring of the cooling liquid in the machining process can be thoroughly removed, and the aim of preventing the parts from rusting is fulfilled.

title_en: Method for preparing ultra-nano diamond film
abstract_en: The application provides a method for preparing an ultra-nano diamond film, and relates to the field of diamond films. The preparation method of the ultra-nano diamond film comprises the following steps: substrate processing, substrate cleaning and film deposition. The whole method is simple in flow and high in preparation efficiency, and compared with the traditional preparation method, the temperature required by film deposition is reduced, so that the method is more convenient to apply in industry and is convenient to use.

title_en: A online fat liquoring equipment for steel strand wires
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal cables, and discloses an online oiling device for steel strands, which comprises a bottom plate and a shell, wherein the shell is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, supporting seats are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate and on two sides of the interior of the shell, limiting rings are fixedly arranged on the upper surfaces of the two supporting seats, fixed blocks and movable blocks are respectively arranged on two sides of the interior of each limiting ring, pressing wheels are rotatably arranged on the inner sides of the fixed blocks and the movable blocks through first shaft pins, threaded rods are respectively arranged above the two movable blocks, the upper ends of the two threaded rods are respectively in threaded connection with the side walls of the corresponding limiting rings, and the lower ends of the two threaded rods are respectively in rotatable connection with the upper surfaces of the corresponding movable blocks through first rolling bearings. This an online fat liquoring equipment for steel strand wires can carry out even comprehensive fat liquoring work to the steel strand wires of different diameters.

title_en: Exhaust system and exhaust method suitable for large-size single crystal
abstract_en: The invention provides an exhaust system suitable for large-size single crystals, which comprises a single crystal furnace bottom plate, an exhaust pipeline, an exhaust port and an exhaust port plugging device, wherein the exhaust pipeline is connected with the single crystal furnace bottom plate; the air outlet plugging device is rotationally connected with the air outlet, and the air outlet plugging device opens or closes the air outlet to control the quantity of the opened air outlets of the air exhaust system. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient maintenance, and the device is provided with the exhaust port plugging device and the pipeline plugging device, can plug the exhaust port and the pipeline, and leads the exhaust port to be opened and closed in batches, the exhaust pipeline is internally provided with the self-purification device, and oxides which are continuously deposited in the furnace are cleaned in the process of ensuring the normal operation of the furnace platform, thus leading the furnace platform to normally operate, opening the exhaust port in batches, reducing the power consumption, lowering the power consumption cost and ensuring the quality of single crystals.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon wafer surface textured structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a silicon wafer surface textured structure, which comprises the following steps: providing a silicon wafer, and carrying out pretreatment of maskless etching and/or maskless ion implantation on the surface of the silicon wafer to roughen the surface of the silicon wafer; and performing alkali texturing on the roughened surface of the silicon wafer to form a pyramid textured structure on the roughened surface of the silicon wafer. The silicon wafer is pretreated to roughen the surface of the silicon wafer, so that the subsequent alkali texturing process is facilitated, and more pyramid textured structures are formed on the roughened surface of the silicon wafer; and finally forming a pyramid textured structure on the roughened surface of the silicon wafer through anisotropic etching of alkali texturing and alkali etching. The method of the invention does not need a mask, simplifies the process, forms uniform suede structures, has more prepared pyramid structures and good light absorption effect, and is suitable for large-scale mass production.

title_en: Heat-shrinkable multilayer film and heat-shrinkable label
abstract_en: The present invention provides a heat-shrinkable multilayer film which can prevent wrinkles and sagging after assembly when assembled as a heat-shrinkable label for dry heat shrinkage in a container, and a heat-shrinkable label using the heat-shrinkable multilayer film as a base film. The present invention is a heat-shrinkable multilayer film having a surface back layer containing a polyester resin and an intermediate layer containing a polystyrene resin, wherein the amount of dimensional change in the TD direction represented by formula (1) measured by thermomechanical analysis (TMA) is from-55 to-1000 [ mu ] m when a load of 0.10N is applied and the film is heated from 30 ℃ to 60 ℃ at a heating rate of 5 ℃/min and then cooled from 60 ℃ to 10 ℃ at a cooling rate of 5 ℃/min. The dimensional change was 20 ℃ dimension in the TD direction-60 ℃ dimension (1).

title_en: Method and system for manufacturing electronic equipment shell
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, and discloses a method for manufacturing a shell of electronic equipment, which comprises the following steps: heating the raw materials to a molten raw material; injecting the molten raw materials into a material preparation mold and cooling to obtain a preparation material; extruding the prepared material by using a processing die to form a convex part; wherein the projections comprise a base layer projection and a top layer projection connected to each other; the base layer protrusion has a chamfer. The electronic equipment shell manufactured by the method of the embodiment of the disclosure has the advantages that the chamfer exists on the protrusion of the base layer, so that when the redundant top layer protrusion is cut off by the high-ray machine and the top surface of the protrusion of the base layer is processed or after the processing is finished, the hand of a user can be prevented from being scratched by the protrusion of the base layer, and the safety is improved. The present application further discloses a system for making an electronic device housing.

title_en: V-shaped moving mechanism with saddle always horizontal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a V-shaped moving mechanism with a saddle always horizontal, which comprises a fixed main board, a moving rack and a saddle arranged on the moving rack, wherein a V-shaped guide groove is formed in the fixed main board, guide wheels matched with the V-shaped guide groove are arranged on the moving rack, a driving connecting rod driven by a driving eccentric wheel is arranged on the moving rack, and the driving connecting rod is hinged with the moving rack and the driving eccentric wheel. According to the invention, the guide wheel and the V-shaped guide groove are adopted to realize V-shaped movement, so that the traditional single displacement is eliminated or multiple directions are required to drive to realize multiple displacements, and the single drive is adopted to realize the bidirectional displacement, so that the structure is more simplified, the installation space is more saved, and the maintenance is easier.

title_en: Stainless steel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses stainless steel and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the stainless steel comprises the following components: the sealing agent comprises a stainless steel substrate, a passivation layer and a sealing agent, wherein the passivation layer is arranged on at least one part of the stainless steel substrate; the sealing layer is arranged on the passivation layer and fills and/or seals the pores of the passivation layer. The stainless steel adopts the sealing layer to fill and/or plug the pores of the passivation layer, so that the density of the passivation layer can be enhanced while the exposure of the active crystal face of the stainless steel matrix is reduced, and the passivation layer forms a film protection layer which is as close to a sheet as possible on the surface of the stainless steel matrix, thereby obviously improving and strengthening the corrosion resistance of the stainless steel.

title_en: Boiler flue equal-life high-temperature anti-corrosion coating composite material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating composite material for long-life high-temperature corrosion prevention of boiler flues and the like, which comprises a nickel-based self-fluxing alloy coating material I, a nickel-based self-fluxing alloy coating material II, a nickel-based self-fluxing alloy coating material III, a medium-temperature medium-pressure composite coating material, a medium-temperature sub-high-pressure or sub-high-temperature sub-high-pressure composite coating material, a high-temperature high-pressure composite coating material, a cold-spraying glass fiber reinforced plastic coating and a polyurethane high-molecular coating, wherein the coating materials can be independently or compositely used for preparing high-temperature corrosion prevention coatings in different corrosion areas of the boiler flues, and the long-life high-temperature corrosion prevention boiler flues are obtained. The high-temperature corrosion-resistant coating for the boiler flue prepared from the coating composite material can provide a high-cost-performance equal-service-life corrosion protection method under the condition of not reducing the service life aiming at the specific precise construction of the boiler type, and simultaneously keeps the process realizability.

title_en: Device for automatically generating surface whitening and random speckles of tested piece in DIC technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic generating device for whitening the surface of a tested piece and generating random speckles in DIC technology, which comprises the following parts: a whitening chamber, a drying chamber and a random light spot preparation chamber. The method is convenient to operate and use, can greatly improve the efficiency of random light spot preparation work in the DIC technology, and ensures the quality.

title_en: Low-friction diamond-like coating piston ring with texture structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-friction diamond-like coating piston ring with a texture structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the piston ring comprises a piston ring substrate, and the outer circle surface of the piston ring substrate is a barrel surface or a partial barrel surface; two rows of texture micro-pits which are arranged on two sides of the top point of the barrel surface of the outer circular surface are mutually parallel, and the positions of the upper row and the lower row of the texture micro-pits are mutually staggered; the transition layer and the diamond-like coating are sequentially arranged on the texture micro-pits and the surface of the outer circular surface; a contact band formed at the apex of the diamond-like coating that continuously encircles the piston ring. The invention directly carries out texturing treatment on the outer circle surface of the piston ring substrate, so that a too thick hard wear-resistant layer is not needed, the coating cost is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the hard wear-resistant layer adopts a diamond-like coating, so that the piston ring has the characteristics of low friction and high wear resistance under the condition of a thinner hard wear-resistant layer, the wear of the piston ring is further reduced, and the friction power loss of an engine is reduced.

title_en: Epitaxial device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an epitaxial device. The epitaxial equipment comprises a base ring, an upper top cover and a lower top cover; the base ring comprises a first surface and a second surface which are opposite to each other, the upper top cover and the lower top cover are respectively connected with the first surface and the second surface in a sealing mode, the upper top cover and the lower top cover form a closed space, a base is arranged in the closed space, and the base is used for placing a substrate; the base ring is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the closed space is internally provided with a baffle piece which is of an annular structure and used for shielding the base ring, a gap is reserved between the baffle piece and the upper top cover, the baffle piece is provided with an air inlet channel and an air outlet channel, the air inlet channel is communicated with the air inlet, and the air outlet channel is communicated with the air outlet; the upper top cover comprises a top cover and an upper flange, the top cover is connected with the upper flange, the upper flange is connected with the first surface in a sealing mode, a clean gas containing shell is arranged on the upper flange and connected with a clean gas storage piece, a gas channel is formed in the upper flange, and the clean gas containing shell is communicated with the gap through the gas channel.

title_en: Silicon wafer processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides silicon wafer processing equipment. The silicon wafer processing equipment comprises a reaction tank, an electromagnetic controller and a stirring and heating rotor; the electromagnetic controller is arranged outside the reaction tank, the stirring and heating rotor is arranged in the reaction tank, and the position of the stirring and heating rotor is arranged corresponding to the electromagnetic controller so as to control the stirring and heating rotor through the electromagnetic controller; the stirring heating rotor includes stirring portion and heating portion, and the stirring portion includes the permanent magnet, and the heating portion includes metal material. The electromagnetic controller and the stirring heating rotor are arranged, the electromagnetic controller is matched with the stirring part of the stirring heating rotor, so that the reaction liquid in the reaction tank is stirred, the electromagnetic controller is matched with the heating part of the stirring heating rotor, so that the reaction liquid in the reaction tank is heated, the uniformity of the heating of the reaction liquid in the reaction tank is improved, two functions of heating and stirring are realized through a group of equipment, and the cost of the equipment is reduced.

title_en: Automobile handle gear block press-fitting oil injection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses automobile handle gear block press-fitting and oil-injecting equipment which comprises a bottom plate, an oil-injecting mechanism, a pressing-down mechanism, a handle carrier, an assembling mechanism and a gear block press-fitting mechanism, wherein the handle carrier is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, a product handle gear block is arranged on the handle carrier, a top plate parallel to the bottom plate is arranged above the handle carrier, a vertical plate is arranged between the top plate and the bottom plate, the pressing-down mechanism is arranged on the top plate, and the assembling mechanism comprises a screw-driving mechanism and a screw-driving flip-cover mechanism. The automobile gear block assembling device has the advantages that the assembling process of the automobile central shaft and the gear block is integrated into one device by the aid of the structures such as the bottom plate, the oil injection mechanism, the pressing mechanism, the handle carrier, the assembling mechanism and the gear block press-fitting mechanism, equipment cost and occupied area are reduced, the gear block press-fitting mechanism, the oil injection mechanism and the assembling mechanism are integrated, and production efficiency and product quality are effectively improved.

title_en: Method and equipment for automatically controlling air inflow of MTS (methanol to sulfur) process
abstract_en: The application discloses MTS technology air intake flow automatic control method and equipment, MTS flow measurement only need utilize the electron balance outside the MTS storage tank, temperature measurement only need utilize the thermocouple in the MTS storage tank, has avoided the strong corrosivity of MTS to the damage of flowmeter, has reduced the device cost, need not frequent maintenance to the regulation MTS flow that can implement has improved MTS technology stability. The method comprises the following steps: the controller sets the preset mold temperature machine temperature of the mold temperature machine through the preset MTS flow; the controller detects the current MTS temperature in the MTS storage tank through the thermocouple, so that the liquid MTS in the MTS storage tank is volatilized into gaseous MTS, and the gaseous MTS is taken out through overload gas; the controller obtains the current MTS flow through the detection of an electronic scale; the controller calculates a deviation value between the current MTS flow and a preset MTS flow; the controller adjusts the preset temperature of the mold temperature controller according to the deviation value, so that the temperature of the MTS in the MTS storage tank is adjusted, and the adjusted MTS flow is equal to the preset MTS flow.

title_en: Laminate, organic electroluminescent device, and liquid crystal display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a laminate having a polarizer and an optically anisotropic layer and having excellent thermal durability, an organic electroluminescent device having the laminate, and a liquid crystal display device. The laminate of the present invention is a laminate comprising 2 substrates and a polarizing plate disposed between the 2 substrates, wherein the polarizing plate comprises an optically anisotropic layer and a polarizer, the optically anisotropic layer is a layer formed using a composition comprising a polymerizable liquid crystal compound represented by formula (I), the polarizer comprises a polyvinyl alcohol-based resin, and the substrates have a moisture permeability of 10 ‑3 g/m 2 Day or less.

title_en: Method for improving binding force between different metal films through magnetron sputtering coating machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving binding force between different metal films by a magnetron sputtering coating machine, which belongs to the technical field of magnetron sputtering coating and comprises the following processing steps: (1) cleaning the surface of a substrate, drying, and placing in a magnetron sputtering coating machine; (2) setting the vacuum degree and power of a magnetron sputtering coating machine, and sputtering the metal A on the base material to the required thickness in a full-power state; (3) sputtering metal A for t1 time and sputtering metal B for t2 time in a 50% full power state; (4) sputtering metal A for t3 time by 30% of full power, and sputtering metal B for t4 time by 70% of full power; (5) then sputtering the metal B to the required thickness in a full power state; (6) and naturally cooling to room temperature after sputtering is finished, and taking out the product. According to the method, a plurality of transition layers are added between two metal film layers through a magnetron sputtering coating machine, so that the binding force between the metal film layers can be improved.

title_en: Automatic painting and drying equipment for roadblock isolation steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic painting and drying equipment for a roadblock isolation steel pipe, which comprises an automatic painting device and an automatic drying device, wherein the automatic painting device comprises a painting rack, a roller painting mechanism and a painting carrying mechanism, and the painting carrying mechanism comprises a painting butt-clamping mechanism, a rotary driving mechanism and a transverse moving trolley; the painting butt-clamping mechanism comprises two painting butt-jacking columns and a butt-clamping driving mechanism which are oppositely arranged; the automatic drying device comprises a drying box and a drying and carrying mechanism, the drying and carrying mechanism comprises a transverse moving mechanism and a drying butt-clamping mechanism, the transverse moving mechanism comprises a drying transverse driving motor and two groups of synchronous transmission assemblies, and the drying butt-clamping mechanism comprises a butt-clamping module and an inclined top assembly; the butt clamp modules are provided with a plurality of pairs and are uniformly distributed on a transmission chain of the synchronous transmission assembly. This automatic mopping drying equipment can accomplish the mopping and the stoving work of steel pipe automatically, effectively improves the efficiency of mopping and stoving.

title_en: Magnesium-zirconium environment-friendly film forming agent, aluminum material and surface film treatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a magnesium-zirconium environment-friendly film forming agent, an aluminum material and a surface film forming treatment method thereof. The magnesium-zirconium environment-friendly film forming agent is used for surface pretreatment of aluminum materials and comprises the following components in parts by weight in 1000 parts: 5-50 parts of magnesium nitrate, 2-20 parts of potassium fluozirconate, 2-10 parts of hydrofluoric acid, 2-10 parts of nickel nitrate and the balance of water. The film formed by the environment-friendly magnesium-zirconium film forming agent has good corrosion resistance, particularly has good adhesive force when being used as a coating treatment bottom layer, can be used in a soaking and spraying mode when being applied to treating aluminum products, is very convenient to use, does not contain chromium ions and other heavy metals which damage the environment, and is an environment-friendly product.

title_en: PET silica gel protection film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of protective films, and particularly relates to a PET (polyethylene terephthalate) silica gel protective film which comprises a film main body, wherein a silica gel layer is arranged at the top end of the film main body, sealing sheets are arranged on two sides of the film main body, a refrigerating layer is arranged at the bottom end of the film main body, an oxygen removing layer is arranged between the refrigerating layer and the silica gel layer, an oxygen removing working layer is arranged in the oxygen removing layer, an oxygen removing interlayer is arranged between the oxygen removing working layers in the oxygen removing layer, an iron layer is arranged at the top end in the oxygen removing working layer, a carbon layer is arranged at the bottom end in the oxygen removing working layer, oxygen removing holes are arranged on the two side walls of the oxygen removing working layer in a penetrating manner, a refrigerating working layer is arranged in the. The sealing sheet, the oxygen removing layer and the refrigerating layer are arranged, so that an oxygen-free environment can be provided for an object to be protected by the protective film package, and a low-temperature environment can be provided for the object to be protected by the protective film package.

title_en: Epidermis is carried rubber coating line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skin conveying gluing line which comprises a skin feeding trolley, a trolley lifting platform, a skin feeding mechanism, a skin conveying platform, a skin gluing mechanism, a skin turning mechanism and a buffer platform, wherein the skin feeding trolley is used for stacking skin workpieces, the trolley lifting platform drives the skin feeding trolley to lift, the skin feeding mechanism conveys the skin workpieces to the skin conveying platform one by one from the skin feeding trolley, the skin conveying platform drives the skin workpieces to be glued through the skin gluing mechanism and to the skin turning mechanism, the skin turning mechanism drives the skin workpieces to be turned and to be conveyed to the buffer platform, and the processes of skin feeding, gluing and turning are fully automatic, do not need manual intervention, reduce manpower and improve machining efficiency.

title_en: Hot-galvanized 420 MPa-grade low-alloy high-strength steel for automobiles and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses hot-galvanized 420 MPa-grade low-alloy high-strength steel for automobiles and a production method thereof. The hot-galvanized 420 MPa-grade low-alloy high-strength steel for the automobile comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: c: 0.06-0.08%, Si: less than or equal to 0.04 percent, Mn: 1.15-1.25%, P: less than or equal to 0.018%, S: less than or equal to 0.005 percent, Alt: 0.020 to 0.050%, Nb: 0.040-0.055%, Ti: 0.020-0.030%, Ca: 0.0010-0.0030%, and the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities. The high-strength steel meets the requirements of 449MPa or more and 520MPa or less of yield strength, 0.90 or more of yield ratio, higher strength and yield ratio, and can meet the requirements of the automobile industry on weight reduction, safety, energy conservation, environmental protection, corrosion resistance and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing coating on inner surface of spray pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a coating on the inner surface of a spray pipe. The invention places the spray pipe which needs to prepare the coating in the reaction chamber, alternately introduces the gas phase precursor into the reactor in a pulse form, the first precursor reaches the spray pipe to form a single adsorption layer by chemical adsorption on the inner surface of the spray pipe; and introducing a second precursor, reacting with the first precursor, and generating a coating with a monoatomic layer on the inner surface of the spray pipe. And (3) cleaning the reactor by using inert gas between each precursor pulse, and repeating the adsorption and reaction processes to generate the coating layer by layer. The method realizes the preparation of the coating on the inner surface of the spray pipe by combining gas adsorption and reaction, solves the problem that the coating cannot be prepared on the inner surface of the spray pipe by adopting a vacuum coating method at present, can prepare various coating materials such as metal, oxide and the like on the surfaces of different materials, and meets different requirements.

title_en: Mobile intermediate frequency furnace silicon controlled rectifier cooling bottom plate pickling device and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile intermediate frequency furnace silicon controlled rectifier cooling bottom plate pickling device and a using method thereof, wherein the device comprises a mobile trolley, the front end of the mobile trolley is provided with a water pump and a motor, the middle part of the mobile trolley is provided with an acid storage tank and a water storage tank, the rear end of the mobile trolley is provided with an electric cabinet, and the water pump and the motor are respectively controlled and driven by the electric cabinet; the movable trolley is provided with a first liquid outlet pipeline and a second liquid outlet pipeline from bottom to top through a support; a pump shaft of the water pump is connected with an output shaft of the motor, and a water inlet of the water pump is respectively connected with an outlet of the acid storage tank and an outlet of the water storage tank; the water outlet of the water pump is connected with a first liquid outlet pipeline, and a second liquid outlet pipeline is respectively connected with the inlet of the acid storage tank and the inlet of the water storage tank; the first liquid outlet pipeline is provided with a quick connector used for being connected with a compressor air pipe connector. The device is integrally movable, can be quickly switched, can realize acid washing without detaching the cooling bottom plate, has high flexibility and greatly reduces the labor cost.

title_en: Reinforced film
abstract_en: The reinforcing film (10) is provided with a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (2) which is fixedly laminated on a film base material (1). The adhesive layer is a photocurable composition comprising a (meth) acrylic base polymer, (meth) acrylic oligomer, and a polyfunctional compound. It is preferable that: when the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer is trisected in the thickness direction and the region farthest from the substrate side is defined as the surface region, the amount of the polyfunctional compound present in the surface region is 50% or more of the amount of the polyfunctional compound present in the entire thickness direction, and the amount of the (meth) acrylic oligomer present in the surface region is 31% or less of the amount of the (meth) acrylic oligomer present in the entire thickness direction.

title_en: Metal product paint spraying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal product paint spraying device. The invention relates to paint spraying equipment for metal products, which comprises a conveying belt, a paint spraying device and a paint spraying drying chamber; the paint spraying device is arranged on one side of the front end of the conveyer belt and is used for spraying paint and printing the metal products on the conveyer belt, and the rear end of the conveyer belt penetrates through the paint spraying drying chamber to dry the painted metal products on the conveyer belt; the paint spraying drying chamber is provided with an inlet and an outlet through which the conveying belt passes, a heater is arranged in the paint spraying drying chamber, and the conveying belt in the paint spraying drying chamber is in a circuitous and curved curve shape. The conveyor belt of the painting equipment of the invention in the painting drying chamber is of a circuitous curved shape, so that the painted metal product has enough time to be dried in the drying chamber. The metal product paint spraying equipment provided by the invention has the advantages that the paint spraying operation and the drying operation after paint spraying are completed on the metal product by adopting one production line, the operation is simple, and the paint spraying efficiency is high.

title_en: Screen protector comprising glass-based substrate and adhesive
abstract_en: A screen protector includes a glass-based substrate and an adhesive. The glass-based substrate includes a first major surface, a second major surface, a thickness, and an edge. The first major surface includes a first planar portion and a peripheral portion extending outwardly from the first planar portion. The second major surface includes a second planar portion opposite and parallel to the first planar portion. The edge includes an outer peripheral surface that intersects a peripheral portion of the first major surface. The adhesive includes a first major surface, a second major surface, a thickness, and an edge. The first major surface of the adhesive is adhered to the second major surface of the glass-based substrate.

title_en: Preparation method of combined gas rudder component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a combined gas rudder component, belongs to the technical field of rocket attitude control, and aims to solve the problem that a rudder shaft of an existing gas rudder is bent and deformed due to the influence of high temperature. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, processing a rudder body, a rudder shaft and a bolt according to the shape of an actual component; secondly, carrying out sand blasting treatment on the rudder shaft; thirdly, sequentially spraying a transition layer and a heat insulation layer on the surface of the sandblasted rudder shaft by adopting a plasma spraying method; fourthly, assembling the rudder body, the rudder shaft and the plug pin into a gas rudder combined member and then putting the gas rudder combined member into the graphite fetal membrane; and fifthly, infiltrating the alloy into the gas rudder combined member by using a pressure infiltration method, and demolding after cooling to obtain the combined gas rudder member. The thermal barrier coating is prepared on the surface of the metal rudder shaft by using a plasma spraying method, and the thermal barrier coating can inhibit the temperature rise of the metal rudder shaft due to low thermal conductivity and prevent the intensity from being greatly reduced due to overhigh temperature.

title_en: Laser surface cladding metal heat pipe material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal heat pipe material for laser surface cladding and a preparation method thereof, wherein the prepared metal heat pipe material is a double-layer structure heat pipe material, the inner layer is a porous structure liquid absorption core, and the thickness is 0.2-2 mm; the outer layer is a compact shell prepared by using a laser surface cladding technology, the thickness is 0.5-5mm, the pore structure of the liquid absorption core is a three-dimensional reticular communicated structure, the pore diameter is 10-200 microns, and the porosity is 20-80%. The method firstly prepares the porous structure liquid absorption core, and then prepares a compact cladding layer tube shell on the surface of the porous material by utilizing the laser surface cladding technology. The preparation process is simple, the large-scale production is easy, the production cost is reduced, the prepared liquid absorption core is excellent in quality, the heat pipe shell and the liquid absorption core are well combined, and the defects of obvious cracks, impurities and the like do not exist between the heat pipe shell and the liquid absorption core, so that the heat pipe is beneficial to improving the heat transfer performance and prolonging the service life, and has wide application prospects in the fields of aerospace, energy, electronics and the like.

title_en: Preparation and application of nanocrystalline graphite/boron-doped diamond composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a nanocrystalline graphite/boron-doped diamond composite material, belonging to the technical field of functional composite structures and preparation and application thereof. The technical scheme of the invention is that a CVD method is adopted to grow a nanocrystalline graphite/boron-doped diamond (NG/BDD) composite electrode in one step, and the electrode is used as an electrochemical electrode to detect trace molecules. NG is formed by reconstructing the surface of the diamond (111) surface under the action of B doping at a higher temperature. According to the invention, a large amount of NG is formed on the (111) surface of the BDD, so that the conductivity is increased, the adsorption of a detection substance is promoted, the detection sensitivity of the electrochemical electrode is improved, and various trace chemical and biological molecules can be detected. The electrode of the invention has simple preparation process, is convenient for large-scale preparation, and has important significance for detecting low-concentration and trace chemical and biological molecules of the diamond sensor.

title_en: Regional densification forming method for variable-cross-section three-dimensional composite material preform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for forming a variable-section three-dimensional composite material preform by regional densification, and belongs to the field of composite materials. The method comprises the following steps: designing three-dimensional weaving data of a target workpiece according to the CAD model of the component and the performance requirement; designing a main compression plate and an auxiliary compression plate, and combining the sub-compression parts into the auxiliary compression plate; preparing a variable cross-section three-dimensional composite material prefabricated body; and installing a main compaction plate and an auxiliary compaction plate, and applying compaction force by a compaction mechanism to obtain the final variable cross-section three-dimensional composite material prefabricated body. The sub-compaction part used in the invention has universality, so that the problem of repeated manufacture of compaction plates caused by preparation of a plurality of size variable-section three-dimensional composite material prefabricated bodies is avoided, and the manufacturing cost is reduced; the sub-compaction part group is used for combining the sub-compaction part group into the sub-compaction plate, so that the installation is convenient, and the intervention of the guide rod array on the preform densification compaction process is avoided; the proposed method makes it possible to obtain three-dimensional composite preforms with different density of the fibre layers in the regions.

title_en: Continuous automatic construction device with roller coating for composite coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous and automatic construction device for composite coating with roller coating, which comprises: the device comprises a vehicle body, a discharging device, a feeding device, a stirring device, a discharging device, a coating material scraping device and a roller coating device; the vehicle body is provided with four omnidirectional wheels; the discharging device is fixedly arranged on the vehicle body; the feeding device is positioned in front of the discharging device and is fixedly arranged on the vehicle body; the stirring device is fixedly arranged on the vehicle body; the discharging device is fixedly arranged below the stirring device; the coating material scraping device and the roller coating device are respectively and fixedly arranged on the left side plate and the right side plate of the vehicle body; the invention replaces manual work to complete stirring, feeding and construction of outdoor large-area roller coating work, has the obvious advantages of stable work, convenient operation and good stability, is closely connected with each device, has clear labor division and high automation level, and can obviously improve the roller coating work efficiency.

title_en: Method for preparing nickel-cobalt-silicon carbide composite coating by electrodeposition
abstract_en: A method for preparing a Ni-Co-SiC composite coating by electrodeposition comprises the following steps: and (3) in a fume hood, putting PEI and weighed SiC into a beaker filled with deionized water, and performing pre-coating by utilizing magnetic stirring and ultrasonic dispersion for 10-120 minutes respectively. And pouring the weighed nickel chloride, nickel sulfate, cobalt sulfate and boric acid into a beaker, and dispersing in a magnetic stirrer and ultrasonic waves for 10-120 minutes respectively. The concentrations of PEI and SiC were controlled at 0.02g/L-0.2 g/L and 2g/L-6 g/L, respectively. Using nickel plate as anode and copper plate as cathode, controlling current density to 1-5A/dm 2 And the temperature is 30-60 ℃, and the Ni-Co-SiC composite coating with uniform SiC distribution and smaller crystal grains can be obtained after electrodeposition is carried out for 1-2 hours. The method uses PEI to pre-coat easily-agglomerated nanometer SiC particles, so that PEI is preferentially and fully adsorbed on the surfaces of the SiC particles, and surfactants and other additives in a groove are avoidedThe agent competes for adsorption on the particle surface to improve SiC nanoparticle dispersibility. The method has low requirement on equipment, simple process and low cost, and the prepared composite plating layer is compact and flat, has small average crystal grains and has good plating layer quality.

title_en: Crucible cover for physical vapor transport method and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crucible cover for a physical vapor transport method and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor material preparation. A crucible cover for physical vapor transport method comprises a graphite layer, a silicon layer and a seed crystal layer which are arranged in sequence; the preparation method of the crucible cover for the physical vapor transport method comprises the following steps: s1, taking a silicon layer as a substrate, and epitaxially growing a transition silicon layer; s2, epitaxially growing a carbon-doped silicon layer; s3, carrying out heat treatment on the material obtained in the step S2 to obtain a composite layer; and S4, bonding and compounding the surface of one side, far away from the seed crystal layer, of the composite layer with the graphite layer. In the invention, the seed crystal layer is close to one side of the silicon layer, the carbon concentration is lower, and the carbon concentration is higher when the seed crystal layer is far from one side of the silicon layer, so that the lattice mismatch between the seed crystal layer and the silicon layer and the lattice mismatch between the seed crystal layer and the silicon carbide single crystal generated by a subsequent physical vapor transport method are lower.

title_en: Display substrate, display device and high-precision metal mask
abstract_en: The display substrate, the display device and the high-precision metal mask provided by the disclosure comprise a substrate; a plurality of mutually independent first electrodes positioned on the substrate base plate; the pixel defining layer is positioned on one side, away from the substrate, of the layer where the first electrodes are positioned, the pixel defining layer comprises a plurality of pixel openings, the pixel openings and the first electrodes are provided with overlapped parts and non-overlapped parts, the non-overlapped parts surround the overlapped parts, and the pixel defining layer covers the non-overlapped parts and gaps among the first electrodes; the light-emitting material layer is positioned on one side of the pixel defining layer, which is far away from the substrate, and comprises a plurality of light-emitting parts which extend from the pixel openings to the pixel defining layer; and a support layer which is located above the pixel defining layer and is in direct contact with the light emitting section, wherein an orthogonal projection of the support layer on the substrate base and an orthogonal projection of gaps between the plurality of first electrodes on the substrate base overlap each other.

title_en: UV (ultraviolet) film-coated three-gloss matte surface-cleaning coating construction process for wood veneer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coating construction process of a wood veneer UV-coated three-gloss matte surface cleaning, belonging to the technical field of coating construction methods, wherein technical wood veneers and natural wood veneers are firstly adhered to the front and back surfaces of a medium density fiberboard and a splint, non-woven fabrics are adhered to the back of the wood veneers used as edge sealing strips, the wood veneers are adhered to a coating template, then UV putty is roll-coated, a paint film sander is used for sanding and dust removal, then UV putty is roll-coated, UV curing technology is used for drying, then a paint film sander is used for sanding and dust removal, finally a roller-coated UV color trimming bottom and a roller-coated UV-coated surface cleaning are used, and a protective film is coated and then packaged. The UV roller is coated on the surface of the base material, and a paint film is uniformly and flatly coated, and has strong adhesive force and good effect.

title_en: Broadband composite sound insulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband composite sound insulation device which comprises an inner sound insulation layer, a sound absorption layer, a sound insulation layer and an outer sound insulation layer, wherein the inner sound insulation layer is close to a sound source, two adjacent layers in the inner sound insulation layer, the sound absorption layer, an extruded polystyrene board and the outer sound insulation layer are tightly attached to each other, the inner sound insulation layer and the outer sound insulation layer are made of metal plates, the sound absorption layer is made of PU foam boards, and the sound insulation layer is made of extruded polystyrene boards; the thicknesses of the sound absorption layer and the sound insulation layer are larger than those of the inner sound insulation layer and the outer sound insulation layer; have very excellent sound insulation performance in the low frequency range, be half of conventional sound arrester in the thickness direction, and the quality is lighter than current sound arrester, has better plasticity in comparison in conventional sound arrester, can be applicable to more operating modes, be convenient for install moreover, overhaul, high frequency performance also more excellent than conventional sound insulation structure, and have fine plasticity.

title_en: Composite component
abstract_en: A composite structural member comprising a plate-like structural member and a bonding member bonded to the plate-like structural member, the plate-like structural member comprising a first skin substrate, a second skin substrate, and an intermediate core material between the first skin substrate and the second skin substrate, the composite structural member being provided with an edge notch connected to the intermediate core material in a thickness direction, the edge notch penetrating the first skin substrate in the thickness direction but not penetrating the second skin substrate, the bonding member being filled in the edge notch and the bonding member being located on only one side of the second skin substrate. With the arrangement, the surface of the second surface layer base material of the composite member does not have a combined member, so that the aesthetic degree is improved.

title_en: Micro electrochemical reactor based on micro-fluidic technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro electrochemical reactor based on a microfluidic technology, which comprises a cathode assembly; an anode assembly facing the cathode assembly; the insulating piece is used for isolating the cathode assembly and the anode assembly by the insulating piece; wherein, runners are respectively formed in the anode assembly and the cathode assembly and are respectively communicated with the inlet runner and the outlet runner; when the anode assembly and the cathode assembly face each other, the flow channels are superposed with each other; wherein, the flow channels are separated by a proton exchange membrane. Compared with the traditional H-type electrolytic cell, the reactor disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the internal resistance is greatly reduced, and the lower ohmic loss provides a better choice for realizing the industrial-grade current-mode electrochemical catalysis application.

title_en: Detection system for producing hydrogen and oxygen by photoelectrocatalysis decomposition of water and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy test equipment, in particular to a detection system for producing hydrogen and oxygen by photoelectrocatalysis decomposition of water and a using method thereof, which are used for solving the problems that the best mode and the highest hydrogen evolution efficiency are selected for obtaining an anode, a cathode, electrolyte and a photocatalyst, data in the electrolytic reaction process are mastered, and materials of various electrolytic reactions and the hydrogen and oxygen evolution speed are effectively analyzed. Comprises a first container and a second container; the container for testing consists of an intermediate connecting pipe, and a photocatalytic electrolysis reaction is formed by matching a power supply of direct current and a catalytic light source; the gravity detection unit is used for independently recording the weights of the first container and the second container, generating oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution along with the continuous advancing of the reaction, collecting gas by the guide unit and respectively guiding the gas to the oxygen detection chamber and the hydrogen detection chamber, and measuring the total amount of the electrolyte, wherein the recording unit is used for stably recording each time; thus, reciprocation is performed.

title_en: Surface treatment process for improving corrosion resistance of V150 high-strength drill rod
abstract_en: The invention relates to a surface treatment process for improving corrosion resistance of a V150 high-strength drill rod, wherein the V150 drill rod comprises a V150 steel-grade pipe body, and male joints and female joints at two ends of the V150 steel-grade pipe body. Through carrying out sandblast and shot blasting to the body, carry out the nitridation to the public female joint, obtain the even corrosion-resistant V150 high strength drilling rod in surface. The invention adopts a simple and convenient method to carry out surface treatment on the V150 high-strength drill rod, slows down the local corrosion and the stress corrosion degree in the environment of the highly corrosive drilling fluid, prolongs the service life of the drill rod in the harsh environment and reduces the drilling cost.

title_en: Silicon carbide nano heat-insulation wave-absorbing composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide nanometer heat-insulating wave-absorbing composite material and a preparation method thereof, which comprises a carbon foam substrate template, a silicon carbide coating reinforced interface and a silicon carbide nanowire network structure, wherein incompletely decomposed carbon foam is used as the substrate template to form the silicon carbide coating reinforced interface with discontinuous and discontinuous distribution on the surface, initial silicon carbide nanowires are prepared by adopting a first ventilation and then heating technology in the chemical vapor infiltration process and form a T-shaped pinning structure with the silicon carbide coating reinforced interface, then residual catalyst is removed by adopting high-temperature oxidation and high-speed carrier gas flow, the prepared secondary silicon carbide nanowires and the initial silicon carbide nanowires form the T-shaped pinning structure and are mutually interwoven to form the silicon carbide nanowire network structure, thereby avoiding continuous fusion of the silicon carbide coating reinforced interface and penetration of the silicon carbide nanowires through pores, and effectively prolonging the heat transmission path, meanwhile, the reflection and absorption of electromagnetic waves are promoted, and the heat insulation performance is improved cooperatively.

title_en: Electroplating solution applied to display panel technology and through hole filling method
