abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of immune systems, in particular to electroplating solution applied to a display panel technology and a through hole filling method, wherein the electroplating solution comprises the following components with the concentration prepared by using ultrapure water: copper methylsulfonate: 260-320g/L, methanesulfonic acid: 10-30g/L, chloride ion: 50-90mg/L, fluorine-containing glycerol ether: 3-10mg/L, 2-thiazolinyl sodium dithiopropane sulfonate: 2-10 mg/L; the through hole filling technology adopts high-copper low-acid electrolytic copper plating solution of a copper methylsulfonate system and an electroplating technology to ensure that copper is filled in the middle part of the inside of the through hole in advance in a connected mode, then the copper is gradually and synchronously filled in the orifices on the two sides, a metal copper layer is deposited in an X-like growth mode, and finally a copper material which is efficient, sealed and conducted is formed, so that the pore-free metallization manufacturing of the through hole is realized.

title_en: Reduced coenzyme and analogue regeneration catalyst thereof, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application discloses a regenerated catalyst of reduced coenzyme and analogues thereof, a regeneration method and application. The reduced coenzyme regeneration catalyst comprises a metal sulfide. The catalyst has high activity and selectivity in the process of regenerating NADH, NADPH and the like.

title_en: Tuned multilayer material system and method of manufacture
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to tuned multilayer material systems and methods of manufacture. A graded multilayer composite (1100) includes a metal matrix material (1110), the metal matrix material (1110) having a first side (1112) and a second side (1114) opposite the first side (1112). A first microsphere layer (1120) is dispersed on the first side (1112) of the metal matrix material (1110). A second layer of microspheres (1122) is dispersed on the second side (1114) of the metal matrix material (1110).

title_en: Rare earth magnesium alloy metallographic corrosive agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rare earth magnesium alloy metallographic corrosive agent and application thereof, wherein the rare earth magnesium alloy metallographic corrosive agent comprises chloride, boric acid and the following components in parts by volume: 16-24 parts of glycerol, 50-70 parts of absolute ethyl alcohol and 14-26 parts of distilled water. The corrosive can prepare high-quality metallographic pictures of magnesium alloys with different rare earth contents, and provides convenience for subsequent analysis of the relation between alloy structure and performance.

title_en: Semiconductor material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor material, a preparation method and application thereof. The semiconductor material comprises a silicon substrate, a buffer layer and an epitaxial layer which are sequentially stacked; the buffer layer comprises one or more IIA-VIA element layers, and each IIA-VIA element layer comprises IIA and VIA elements; the epitaxial layer includes group IIIA and VA elements. A method of making a semiconductor material comprising: and heating the silicon substrate for pretreatment, and then sequentially growing the buffer layer and the epitaxial layer on the silicon substrate. The application of the semiconductor material is used for lasers and detectors. The semiconductor material provided by the application is used for simultaneously solving the problems of lattice mismatch and thermal expansion coefficient difference.

title_en: Vacuum bonding method and vacuum bonding apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vacuum lamination, in particular to a vacuum lamination method and vacuum lamination equipment. The vacuum bonding method comprises the following steps: step a, placing unsealed bagged products on a jig seat; b, inflating the air bag by the inflating element so as to extrude air bubbles between the sealing bag and the product by the air bag; c, pumping the gas in the sealing bag by a vacuum pumping mechanism; d, sealing the opening of the sealing bag by a heat sealing mechanism; and e, stopping inflating the inflating element, then releasing the air in the air bag by the air releasing element, and resetting the vacuumizing mechanism and the heat sealing mechanism. The vacuum laminating equipment comprises a jig seat, an air bag, an inflating element, an air leaking element, a vacuumizing mechanism and a heat sealing mechanism. According to the vacuum laminating method and the vacuum laminating equipment provided by the invention, air pockets are not formed between the product and the sealing bag, and the film laminating requirement can be met.

title_en: Preparation method of silver-polyaniline composite material for solar cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a silver-polyaniline composite material for a solar cell, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking silver nitrate solution as electrolyte, taking two Pt nets as an anode and a cathode respectively, and carrying out electrochemical deposition to obtain the Pt net deposited with Ag; (2) adding deionized water into sulfuric acid to prepare a sulfuric acid solution, adding aniline, uniformly stirring, and then recovering to room temperature to obtain an aniline sulfuric acid solution; (3) and (2) taking the Pt net deposited with Ag in the step (1) as an anode, taking Pt as a cathode, taking aniline sulfuric acid solution as electrolyte, and continuing to perform secondary deposition to obtain the target product. Compared with the prior art, the PANI conductive film is attached to the surface of the micron-sized silver powder commonly used in the solar cell through an electrochemical deposition method, so that the transmission of electrons in the composite material is improved, the impedance of the composite material is reduced, and the conductivity is improved.

title_en: Fragrance-releasing decorative artificial board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention claims a fragrance-releasing type decorative artificial board and a preparation method thereof, wherein the fragrance-releasing type decorative artificial board comprises the following steps: the decorative base paper is completely dipped in the formaldehyde-free adhesive for 20-40s and dried at 80-100 ℃, and the gluing amount of the dry glue is 30-50 percent of the base paper ration based on no redundant glue solution and no hand sticking on the paper surface. After drying, sizing by adopting a mode of separating surface coating and back coating, wherein the back adhesive is an aldehyde-free adhesive, and the total sizing amount is 20-50% of the base paper weight; the surface glue is an aldehyde-free adhesive added with essence slow-release microcapsules, and adopts a mode of multiple ultrathin coating, the thickness of each dry coating is 0.5-1 mu m, and the total gluing amount of the surface glue is 20% -30% of the base paper ration. Completely drying at 90-100 deg.C. Hot pressing the impregnated bond paper on the formaldehyde-free artificial board for 4-6min under the pressure of 4-6Mpa and the temperature of 90-140 ℃. The fragrance-releasing type veneer artificial board prepared by the method has the effects of no formaldehyde, fragrance release and guarantee of the requirement of the physical strength of the veneer.

title_en: Folding air knife and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding air knife and a use method thereof, wherein the folding air knife comprises a base and an air knife main body, the air knife main body is rotationally connected to the base, and a positioning structure is arranged on the contact surface of the base and the air knife main body; after the base is fixed in the installation, when welding the area and connecting the circulation to the air knife edge of a knife, rotate the air knife main part and can supply to weld the area and connect and pass through, weld the area and connect and pass through the back, the cyclone air knife main part is fixed a position the air knife main part by location structure for the accurate return of air knife main part physical stamina need not many times the debugging position, has effectively improved and has welded the coated production efficiency of area.

title_en: Method for extracting and separating rare earth and preparing multi-element rare earth alloy by molten salt pulse electrolysis of Pb-Bi alloy cathode
abstract_en: A method for extracting and separating rare earth and preparing a multi-element rare earth alloy by molten salt pulse electrolysis of a Pb-Bi alloy cathode. The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear fuel dry post-processing. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low extraction efficiency and low separation efficiency of the existing method for extracting and separating actinides and rare earth elements. The method comprises the following steps: silver/silver chloride is used as a reference electrode, a spectral pure graphite rod is used as an anode, a liquid Pb-Bi alloy is used as a cathode, cyclic voltammetry is carried out in an electrochemical workstation, the reduction peak potential of rare earth ions on the Pb-Bi alloy cathode is obtained, the reduction potential of rare earth can be changed by changing the composition of the alloy, the electrochemical workstation or a pulse power supply is used for carrying out electrolytic extraction and separation on rare earth under different set pulse conditions, and the uniform segregation-free lead-bismuth-rare earth multi-element alloy is obtained. The method has the advantages of simple cathode preparation, high extraction and separation efficiency, high rare earth extraction rate up to 98.9 percent and high two rare earth separation factors up to 786.

title_en: Method for manufacturing electrical steel sheet product
abstract_en: The method for manufacturing an electrical steel sheet product according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a step of preparing a cohesive coating composition; a step of forming a bond coating layer by applying the bond coating composition to the surface of the electrical steel sheet and then curing the bond coating composition; a step of forming a heat-welded layer by laminating and heat-welding a plurality of electrical steel sheets forming a bond coat; and a step of cooling the thermally welded electrical steel sheet at a cooling rate of 0.05 to 20 ℃/min.

title_en: Laser cladding equipment for cylindrical workpiece
abstract_en: The invention discloses laser cladding equipment for a cylindrical workpiece, which relates to the technical field of laser processing, and comprises a rack and a workbench, wherein the workbench is fixedly connected to the top of the rack; the clamping assembly is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench and used for assembling a workpiece to be cladded; the adjusting rod is connected to the outer side wall of the rack; the driving source is fixedly connected to the adjusting end of the adjusting rod; the mechanical clamping jaw is connected to the driving end of the driving source and used for clamping a workpiece to be clad; the mounting seat is connected to the top of the workbench in a sliding manner; the limiting strip frame is fixedly connected to the top of the mounting seat; the mounting frame is connected in the limiting strip frame in a sliding manner; the electric push rod is connected between the bottom of the mounting frame and the inner side wall of the bottom of the limiting strip frame; one end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected in the mounting frame, and the other end of the supporting plate is arranged in a workpiece to be clad. The invention has simple structure, has the function of pre-treating the inner hole of the cylindrical workpiece, and can realize the function of automatic progression while cladding.

title_en: Sphere-like alumina and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a sphere-like alumina and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of non-metallurgical alumina, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an aluminum hydroxy oxalate solution; adding a precipitator into the aluminum hydroxy oxalate solution for precipitation, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain an aluminum oxide precursor; the precipitator is urea, and the addition amount of the urea is 110-130% of the aluminum hydroxy oxalate by mass; drying and roasting the alumina precursor to obtain spheroidal alumina; the high-purity aluminum hydroxy oxalate is adopted to prepare the spheroidal alumina, the preparation process of the aluminum hydroxy oxalate solution is a simple physical dissolution process, the precursor is a simple chemical precipitation process, and the process is simple and easy to operate; no harmful gas is generated in the reaction, no metal impurity element is introduced, the stability of the purity index of the alumina product is ensured, the environment is not polluted, the prepared alumina is in a sphere-like shape, the product quality is stable, and the purity is higher.

title_en: Automatic device for producing metal powder non-electrolytic composite coating
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic production device for a metal powder non-electrolytic composite coating, which relates to the field of coating production and aims to solve the problems that the existing automatic production device for the metal powder non-electrolytic composite coating cannot automatically enhance the odor purification effect, cannot mix odor particles with water and has poor odor purification effect when in use, and comprises a main body; the main part is the coating production automation equipment body, and the bottom of main part is the rectangle structure. Activated carbon and filter pulp are installed and are being filtered inside after, can move the stopper through the deflector and move down together, and then make internals can be with activated carbon plate and filter pulp compression, make its inner structure can be compacter, and then make smell when adsorbing the purification, purifying effect is better, the spring in the removal rod outside continuously receives spring power and moves down simultaneously, and then makes internals can be in the state of moving down always, and then continuously presses the activated carbon and filter pulp.

title_en: Robot spraying system and method for automobile brake drum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot spraying system and a method for an automobile brake drum, wherein the system can detect the position, shape and size information of the brake drum based on a two-classifier automobile brake drum detection system of machine learning, can judge whether the brake drum on a station is lost or not, and has strong adaptability to environmental change; the 6-dimensional torque sensor is additionally arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm, so that the manual dragging teaching of the spraying path can be realized, the teaching difficulty is reduced, meanwhile, the teaching path optimization method based on Kalman filtering can ensure the stability and the high efficiency of the spraying process, the spraying quality is improved, and the service life of equipment is prolonged; the automatic spraying control of the multi-station multi-brake drum is realized on the premise of ensuring the movement precision by adopting the structural design of the mobile robot, the spraying efficiency is improved, less manual intervention is required, the whole spraying system meets the development requirements of automation and intellectualization, and the intelligent transformation and upgrading of enterprises and even the spraying industry are facilitated.

title_en: Manufacturing method of neodymium iron boron
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of neodymium iron boron, which relates to the technical field of neodymium iron boron magnetic materials, and aims to obtain a neodymium iron boron product with the advantages of salt resistance, moisture resistance, pressure resistance, less thermal demagnetization and the like through an environment-friendly method; the method comprises the steps of mixing and smelting two or more metals, preparing alloy powder through atomization, preparing the alloy powder into slurry, uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of a neodymium iron boron blank in a spraying mode, and drying; putting the neodymium iron boron blank coated with the slurry into an annealing furnace for annealing, and performing heat treatment for 3-7 h at the temperature of 450-550 ℃; grinding the product after being discharged from the furnace to a required size by a grinder, and drying after pickling to obtain a finished product; the manufacturing method of the invention not only has no waste water and gas production, but also is more environment-friendly, and has better salt resistance, moisture resistance, pressure resistance and thermal magnetism reduction performance compared with the conventional nickel-copper-nickel electroplating method.

title_en: Rotatory spraying system of solar energy crucible
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar crucible rotary spraying system which comprises a placing table, wherein a placing frame is arranged at the top end of the placing table, and a hydraulic cylinder is arranged inside the placing table; a material spraying barrel is arranged on one side of the placing table, and a fixing rod and a liquid pump are arranged at the top end of the material spraying barrel; an electric telescopic rod is vertically arranged at the top end of the fixed rod, an installation plate is arranged at the top end of the electric telescopic rod, and a plurality of circular spray heads are arranged on one side of the installation plate close to the placing table; the inlet and the outlet of the liquid pump are both provided with a first connecting pipe, the first connecting pipe at the outlet of the liquid pump is arranged on the side surface of the fixed rod, and the top end of the first connecting pipe is provided with a second connecting pipe. This kind of rotatory spraying system of solar crucible's one side that the mounting panel is close to the rack is fixed to be provided with the circular shower nozzle of a plurality of, and accessible electric telescopic handle drives mounting panel and shower nozzle and moves to the inside of rack one side, and the spraying to each face of solar crucible can be realized to the design of circular shower nozzle and mounting bracket, and spraying efficiency is higher.

title_en: Semiconductor wafer surface treatment device
abstract_en: A semiconductor wafer surface treatment apparatus comprising: the device comprises a main frame, a conveying mechanism and a surface treatment mechanism. The conveying mechanism is used for conveying the wafer and comprises a pair of conveying rails and an adjusting mechanism, and the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the distance between the conveying rails. The surface treatment mechanism comprises a bearing component and an execution component. The bearing part is arranged below the conveying mechanism and comprises an accommodating barrel and a bearing plate, and the bearing plate is perpendicular to the conveying track and can rotate around an axis. The actuating unit is arranged above the conveying mechanism and comprises a sealing cover used for sealing the top of the containing barrel, a linear moving mechanism is arranged on the top surface of the sealing cover, a nozzle is arranged on a movable block of the linear moving mechanism and used for spraying glue solution, a strip-shaped hole is formed in the sealing cover and used for penetrating through the nozzle, a liquid outlet of the nozzle is located below the sealing cover, and the sealing cover is arranged in a moving mode along the direction perpendicular to the bearing plate. The surface treatment device has higher surface treatment efficiency, can avoid damaging the surface of the wafer, can avoid the splashing of glue solution, and is convenient for cleaning equipment.

title_en: PECVD gas homogenizing device capable of controlling gas inflow and proportion in a partitioned manner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PECVD gas homogenizing device capable of controlling gas inflow and proportion in a partitioned manner, which comprises an upper layer gas inlet disc, a middle layer gas homogenizing disc and a lower layer gas homogenizing disc, wherein: the three disks are sequentially overlapped up, middle and down, a convex wall-groove matching connection structure is arranged between the contact surfaces of the upper layer air inlet disk and the lower layer air homogenizing disk, and the contact surfaces of the upper layer air inlet disk and the lower layer air homogenizing disk are matched and fixedly connected with a screw hole through a screw; the three disks are uniformly divided into three circles, namely a central ring, a secondary inner ring and an outer ring, the area formed by the central ring on the three disks in the axial direction is used for central gas homogenizing, the area formed by the inner ring on the three disks in the axial direction last time is used for middle gas homogenizing, the area formed by the outer ring on the three disks in the axial direction is used for edge gas homogenizing, and the central gas homogenizing, the middle gas homogenizing and the edge gas homogenizing are coaxial; the gas homogenizing device is divided into three independent gas inlet areas, namely, central gas homogenizing, middle gas homogenizing and edge gas homogenizing, and a more uniform film is obtained by adjusting the gas inlet amount and the gas inlet proportion of each gas inlet area.

title_en: Bismuth vanadate/sodium phytate/iron oxyhydroxide composite photoelectrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bismuth vanadate/sodium phytate/iron oxyhydroxide composite photoelectrode and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of functional materials. The preparation method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: providing BiVO 4 Photoelectrode of said BiVO 4 The photoelectrode comprises a substrate and BiVO loaded on the surface of the substrate 4 Thin film, BiVO 4 The film is made of BiVO 4 Nanoparticle formation; mixing inorganic ferric salt, sodium phytate and water to obtain an inorganic ferric salt-sodium phytate mixed solution; dropping inorganic ferric salt-sodium phytate mixture on BiVO 4 Drying the surface of the photoelectrode, immersing the surface of the photoelectrode in an alkaline solution for precipitation reaction to obtain bismuth vanadate/phytic acidSodium/iron oxyhydroxide composite photoelectrode. BiVO prepared by the method provided by the invention 4 The sodium phytate/FeOOH composite photoelectrode has better photoelectrocatalysis water decomposition performance.

title_en: Metal ceramic powder material for wear-resistant layer of section steel conveying roller and manufacturing method of wear-resistant layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal ceramic powder material for a wear-resistant layer of a section steel conveying roller, which comprises 60-70% of nickel-based alloy and 30-40% of NiCr-Cr  3  C  2  A cermet composition; the nickel-based alloy comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: 7 to 10% of Cr, 3 to 5% of Mo, 3 to 4% of Si, 1.5 to 2.0% of B,<0.1% of C, the balance being Ni; niCr-Cr  3  C  2  25% of NiCr and 75%  3  C  2  And (4) forming. The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a wear-resistant layer of a section steel conveying roller, which comprises the following steps: (1) machining; (2) performing front flaw detection; (3) laser cladding: the cladding layer comprises two layers, wherein the transition layer is iron-based alloy powder, the wear-resistant layer is clad on the transition layer, and the wear-resistant layer is made of the metal ceramic powder; (4) grinding; (5) and (5) performing post flaw detection. The section steel conveying roller processed by the material and the method of the invention has obviously improved high temperature resistance, abrasion resistance, impact resistance and other performances, and the corresponding service life is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength erosion-resistant polyurea composite coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyurea composite coating with high strength and erosion resistance, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing BNNSs, a polyurea A component and a polyurea B component respectively, then mixing BNNSs into the B component to be uniformly dispersed to prepare a mixture, and then spraying the A component and the mixture on the surface of a metal substrate through spraying equipment to obtain a composite coating after solidification; the BNNSs inherits the good thermal property and excellent lubricating property of h-BN, and has high strength, high temperature resistance, insulation and chemical stability, so that the composite coating has a wider application range. The strength of the polyurea composite coating is improved by introducing BNNSs, when the composite coating is impacted by external force, impact energy can be consumed by boron nitride particles, so that the impact resistance of the coating is enhanced, and when the composite coating is eroded by external force, the laminated BNNSs in the polyurea coating system can be used as a reinforcement body to bear part of load and can be used as a lubricant to play a role in reducing erosion.

title_en: High-wear-resistance pressing nut with gradient coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-wear-resistance pressing nut with a gradient coating and a preparation method thereof. The high-wear-resistance screw-down nut with the gradient coating comprises a screw-down nut body and the gradient coating sprayed on the surface of the screw-down nut body through a cold spraying technology; the gradient coating comprises manganese brass powder and matrix steel powder which is the same as the material of the screw nut body; in the gradient coating, the mass proportion of the manganese brass powder is gradually increased and the mass proportion of the matrix steel powder is gradually decreased from inside to outside along the coating thickness direction. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) spraying a gradient coating on the surface of the screw-down nut body by adopting a cold spraying technology; (2) and (3) carrying out air atmosphere stress relief annealing heat treatment on the sprayed screw down nut, wherein the annealing temperature is 500 ℃, and the screw down nut is cooled along with a furnace after heat preservation for one hour to obtain the high-wear-resistance screw down nut with the gradient coating.

title_en: Structurally colored articles and methods of making and using structurally colored articles
abstract_en: The present application relates to structurally colored articles and methods of making and using structurally colored articles. One or more aspects of the present disclosure provide a component for an article of manufacture, the component having a film with an optical element that imparts a structural color to the component. The present disclosure also provides methods for manufacturing a component having a film and an optical element, and articles of manufacture including the component.

title_en: Curable silicone composition, cured product thereof, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a curable granular silicone composition and the like having excellent workability and curing characteristics such as hot-melt property and secondary molding, and providing a cured product having excellent flexibility and stress relaxation property and a small thermal expansion coefficient even when a large amount of filler is blended. A curable silicone composition comprising a polyorganosiloxane resin containing SiO in an amount of at least 20 mol% or more of all siloxane units, and one or more functional fillers, and use thereof  4/2  The siloxane unit(s) represented by (i) a vinyl group (CH) in a curing reactive functional group containing a carbon-carbon double bond per 100g of the silicone component in the composition  2  The content of the = CH-) moiety is 0.05 to 1.50 mol%, and the entire composition has a hot-melt property.

title_en: Wear-resistant NbMoWTa/Ag multilayer film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wear-resistant metal films, and relates to a wear-resistant NbMoWTa/Ag multilayer film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1: putting the substrate, NbMoWTa and Ag into a vacuum deposition environment, and inputting ionized gas into the deposition environment; s2: turning on a first power supply, depositing NbMoWTa on the substrate by using the power supply power of 90-100W, the substrate bias voltage of-75-85V, the substrate rotation speed of 3-4 rpm and the deposition rate of 7.23-7.55 nm/s to obtain an NbMoWTa layer, and turning off the first power supply after the NbMoWTa layer is deposited to the thickness of 4-5 nm; s3: turning on a second power supply, depositing Ag on the NbMoWTa layer at a power supply power of 90-100W, a matrix bias voltage of-75-85V, a matrix rotation speed of 3-4 rpm and a deposition rate of 18.55-18.95 nm/s to obtain an Ag layer, and turning off the second power supply after the Ag layer is deposited to a thickness of 4-5 nm; s4: NbMoWTa was deposited on Ag as per S2; s5: and repeating the steps of S3-S4 to obtain the wear-resistant NbMoWTa/Ag multilayer film. The preparation method provided by the invention improves the integral wear resistance of the membrane material, and simultaneously can ensure that the membrane material has a compact structure, greatly reduces the friction coefficient and has better comprehensive performance.

title_en: Flexible production method and device for aluminum electrolysis series
abstract_en: A flexible production method and device for aluminium electrolysis series are disclosed, wherein the aluminium electrolysis series electrolytic cells are evenly distributed in two rows of parallel plants, and the positions of the electrolytic cells are in one-to-one correspondence. Determining the number X of the to-be-stopped cells according to the power load or the demand condition, starting from the rear end of the power-in side factory building, connecting X/2 electrolytic cells with the power-in side factory building bus at the power-in side, correspondingly connecting the power-out side factory building bus with the power-out side factory building bus, and then electrically connecting the power-out side factory building bus with the power-out side factory building bus; when slotting is needed, the slotting quantity Z is determined, Z/2 electrolytic cells are backwards counted from the position of the power-in side workshop bus close to the power-in end and are connected with the power-in side workshop bus, the power-out side workshop is correspondingly connected with the power-out side workshop bus, and after the power-out side workshop bus is electrically connected, other power-in side workshop buses in the power-in side direction are removed. The method realizes the shutdown and startup of the electrolytic cells in any section of the aluminum electrolysis series in batches, and realizes flexible production by adjusting the number of the electrolytic cells put into production in time and time in a time-saving, labor-saving and efficient manner according to the market demands such as electricity load, selling price of the electrolytic aluminum and the like.

title_en: Device capable of improving quality of aluminum oxidation surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device capable of improving the quality of an aluminum oxidation surface, which belongs to the technical field of aluminum oxidation equipment and comprises a chemical combination bin, a heating plate, a coating bin and a workpiece, wherein the coating bin is positioned at the upper end of the chemical combination bin, the workpiece is positioned in the coating bin, the outer wall of the chemical combination bin is connected with an aluminum gas pipe and an oxygen pipe in a penetrating way, the lower side wall of the chemical combination bin is provided with an exhaust port, an annular air bag is arranged in the chemical combination bin, and the air inlet is communicated with the coating bin, so that carbon reserved in the chemical combination bin can be completely combusted before the chemical combination bin prepares aluminum oxide gas, the problem of generating toxic aluminum nitride and carbon monoxide gas during preparing the aluminum oxide gas is effectively avoided, meanwhile, the air bag in the chemical combination bin can expand along with the rise of temperature, the gas can only pass through the inner side of the air bag, the temperature rises, the space between the inner sides of the air bags is reduced, and the gas throughput is reduced, the problem that the quality of the surface of the workpiece is reduced due to excessive sprayed alumina gas is effectively avoided.

title_en: Flexible photo-thermal absorption material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible photo-thermal absorption material and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of photo-thermal materials. The method comprises the following steps: 1) cleaning the polymer substrate to obtain a clean polymer substrate; removing impurities on the clean polymer substrate by using Ar as a sputtering gas; carrying out pre-sputtering treatment on the Ag target and the Zn target to obtain an Ag target and a Zn target with oxide layers on the surface of the target removed; 2) on a clean polymer substrate, firstly sputtering an Ag target under the condition of a direct current power supply, and then sputtering a Zn target under the condition of a radio frequency power supply to prepare the flexible photo-thermal absorption material. The flexible photo-thermal absorption material prepared by the invention has an excellent spectrum selective absorption function, realizes the synergistic effect of high absorption rate and low thermal radiation, and can be applied to seawater desalination.

title_en: High-reflection aluminum plating scratch-resistant coating device and coating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-reflection aluminum plating scratch-resistant coating device, which is characterized in that an electron gun evaporation system, a coating disc, a constant-temperature heating system and a film thickness monitoring system are sequentially arranged in a vacuum chamber body from bottom to top, parts to be coated are arranged on the coating disc and are opposite to the electron gun evaporation system, the integral coating adopts the condition of heating at constant temperature of 150 ℃, a base priming material and an aluminum coating layer are added to the parts to be coated, and then a dielectric layer is sealed and coated on the outer layer of a metal film, so that the performance of the parts to be coated is greatly improved, the scratch resistance of high-low temperature environment measurement, the adhesive tape sticking and pulling and other tests are not problematic, and the performance is far higher than other common aluminum plating performances.

title_en: Method for simultaneously preparing and regulating three types of single-layer copper selenide superstructures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simultaneously preparing and regulating three types of single-layer copper selenide superstructures. According to the method, high-purity selenium powder is evaporated and deposited on a clean copper single crystal substrate by utilizing an eccentric deposition strategy in an ultrahigh vacuum environment, then a sample is heated to a growth temperature and then is subjected to annealing treatment, and then three samples with single-layer copper selenide superstructures (the three superstructures are respectively a periodic nano hole structure, a periodic petal structure and a one-dimensional Moire fringe structure) coexisting are obtained on the surface of the sample. In addition, the area of the three single-layer copper selenide superstructures on the surface of the sample is accurately regulated and controlled by increasing the time for eccentrically depositing the selenium powder. The method provides a new path and method for structure transformation of other single-layer two-dimensional materials, and has high scientific research value and wide application potential.

title_en: Flocking equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment manufacturing, and particularly discloses flocking equipment, which comprises: the flocking device comprises a closed flocking box, wherein a feed inlet for feeding a workpiece to be flocked into and out of the flocking box is formed in the side wall of the flocking box, and the flocking box further comprises a bottom plate which is arranged at an angle of 90 degrees with the side wall; the fluff plate is arranged in parallel with the bottom plate and is close to the bottom plate and used for bearing fluff for flocking; and the screen plate is arranged in parallel with the fluff plate and is used for connecting high-voltage electricity so as to form an electrostatic field in the flocking box. The flocking machine has the advantages that the flocking machine receives the implantation of the fluff by rotating the workpiece, the flocking process is continuous, and the situation that the fluff at the joint is too concentrated or too little due to the need of turning over in the prior art can not occur, so that the flocking effect is more uniform.

title_en: Digital printing register floor structure and production method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital printing patterned floor structure and a production method thereof, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a mixed ink printing layer, a substrate layer and a protective layer, wherein the mixed ink printing layer is prepared from stripped ink mixed UV ink or water-based ink mixed UV ink, the stripped ink mixed UV ink and the water-based ink mixed UV ink printing layer are arranged on the upper layer of the substrate layer, and the protective layer is arranged on the upper layer; the mixed ink printing layer is formed by spraying patterns on the substrate layer in a mode of digital spray printing UV ink multicolor and stripping ink or digital spray printing UV multicolor and water-based ink; the protective layer is a UV coating layer, and the invention has the advantages of better integrity of the floor structure, more compact combination of patterns and the floor, more vivid effect and low production cost.

title_en: Automatic powder scraping device for electrolytic copper powder
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic powder scraping device for electrolytic copper powder, and relates to the technical field of electrolytic copper powder. An automatic scraping device for electrolytic copper powder is used for scraping the copper powder on a negative plate, and comprises: the cathode plate is arranged on the lifting mechanism, and the lifting mechanism is used for driving the cathode plate to lift from the electrolytic bath; the powder scraping mechanism comprises a plurality of groups of powder scraping assemblies, and each group of powder scraping assemblies comprises two powder scraping parts which are parallel to each other and are arranged at intervals; the powder scraping mechanism further comprises a moving assembly, the powder scraping assembly is installed on the moving assembly, the moving assembly enables the powder scraping assembly to horizontally move to the lower side of the cathode plate, and the lifting mechanism drives the cathode plate to move downwards and penetrate through gaps between the powder scraping components of each group. The automatic powder scraping device for the electrolytic copper powder provided by the invention can realize simultaneous powder scraping of a plurality of negative plates, so that the production efficiency is improved, and the quality of the copper powder is improved.

title_en: Gluing mechanism of plate edge bonding machine with buffering performance
abstract_en: The invention provides a gluing mechanism of a plate edge bonding machine with buffering performance, which comprises an installation seat and a sliding frame, wherein the sliding frame is connected with the gluing mechanism in a sliding mode along the Z-axis direction, and the gluing mechanism is movably arranged in the sliding frame through a spring capable of balancing the gravity of the gluing mechanism. According to the invention, the glue coating mechanism is arranged in the sliding frame in a floating manner through the spring, and when a plate just touches the glue coating roller, the glue coating mechanism rapidly moves upwards, so that the plate is prevented from being damaged by collision; according to the invention, the pressing beam and the gluing mechanism are connected together through the connecting rod, the plate to be glued is pressed on the pressing beam, the height of the pressing beam can be adjusted according to different thicknesses of the pressing plate, and the gluing mechanism is connected to the pressing beam, so that the gluing mechanism moves together, and finally, the distance between the surface of the plate and the gluing roller of the gluing mechanism is unchanged, so that when the plate with different thicknesses is replaced, the height of the gluing roller of the gluing mechanism does not need to be adjusted, the time for adjusting the gluing roller is greatly saved, and the gluing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method for preparing pitcher plant bionic super-lubricating surface by using laser etching method
abstract_en: A method for preparing a pitcher plant bionic super-lubricating surface by using a laser etching method comprises the following steps: 1) Cutting, grinding and polishing the aluminum plate into a mirror surface; ultrasonic cleaning in deionized water for 15min; drying at 80 ℃ for 30 minutes; 2) Placing the aluminum plate on the lower surface of the nanosecond laser for etching; respectively irradiating the laser beams moving in a line-by-line scanning mode along two vertical directions to form micron-sized square column columns; 3) Ultrasonic cleaning and drying are carried out after laser etching, the glass is immersed into a mixed solution of heptadecafluorodecyltriethoxysilane (PFDTES) and absolute ethyl alcohol with the volume ratio of 1; washing with distilled water, and drying at 80 deg.C for 30min; 4) The dried aluminum plate is immersed into perfluoropolyether lubricating oil at an inclination angle of 45 degrees and a speed of 3 mm/s; after the aluminum plate is completely immersed in the lubricating oil, horizontally standing for 30min, taking out the aluminum plate, and standing for 30min at an inclination angle of 15 degrees with the horizontal plane; then vertically placing the plate, removing excessive lubricating oil and obtaining the super-lubricating surface with excellent hydrophobicity and long-term effect.

title_en: Container, cooking utensil and manufacturing method of container
abstract_en: The invention discloses a container, a cooking utensil and a manufacturing method of the container, wherein the container comprises a body and a magnetic conduction layer, and the body is a heat conduction piece; the magnetic conduction layer is arranged on the outer surface of the body, at least one part of the magnetic conduction layer is positioned on the bottom surface of the body, the magnetic conduction layer comprises a first magnetic conduction layer and a second magnetic conduction layer which are overlapped, the second magnetic conduction layer is positioned on one side, far away from the body, of the first magnetic conduction layer, and the porosity of the second magnetic conduction layer is larger than that of the first magnetic conduction layer. According to the container, the magnetic conduction layer is arranged on the outer surface of the body, so that the electromagnetic heating function of the container is realized, the second magnetic conduction layer with high porosity is arranged on the outer side of the first magnetic conduction layer, the electromagnetic heating power of the container can be improved, the second magnetic conduction layer with high porosity also has a good heat insulation and storage effect and a good noise reduction effect, so that the heat loss during the electromagnetic heating of the container can be reduced, and the power attenuation caused by the long-term use of the container can be reduced due to the high compactness of the first magnetic conduction layer.

title_en: Application of metallic aerogel catalytic material in preparation of anion membrane electrolytic cell for electrocatalytic reduction of CO2 reaction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical catalysis, and discloses application of a metal aerogel catalytic material in preparation of an anion membrane electrolytic cell for electrocatalytic reduction of CO 2 The use of the reaction. The method comprises the following steps: fresh is preparedQuickly adding the aqueous solution of the reducing agent into the metal precursor solution, continuously stirring for one minute, standing at room temperature for reaction to obtain hydrogel, and then freeze-drying to obtain the metal aerogel; and then preparing a cathode gas diffusion electrode by using metal aerogel, assembling an anion membrane electrolytic cell, and performing electrocatalysis carbon dioxide reduction reaction by using the anion membrane electrolytic cell, wherein the cathode chamber and the anode chamber of the electrolytic cell are separated by using an anion membrane, a cathode flow field plate is a snake-shaped flow field, and an anode flow field plate is a net-shaped flow field. The cathode gas diffusion electrode using the metal aerogel shows excellent catalytic activity and stability in an anion membrane electrolytic cell, and realizes Faraday efficiency and current density of 80% of C1 products (HCOOH or CO)>100mA cm ‑2 And has industrial prospect.

title_en: Single crystal high temperature alloy rotor blade and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single crystal high-temperature alloy rotor blade and a preparation method thereof, aiming at solving the defect of mixed crystals on a blade edge plate and obviously reducing the risk of recrystallization formation caused by the access of a seeding strip. To this end, in a method for manufacturing a single crystal superalloy rotor blade according to an aspect of an embodiment of the present invention, when a wax tree is assembled, a seed-guiding strip is attached to a wax mold of the blade, a bottom end of a blade body is connected to a flange plate at an upper portion of the blade body by the seed-guiding strip, and then the preparation of the blade is completed through shell making, dewaxing, shell baking, casting, shelling, heat treatment, and cutting, the seed-guiding strip has a horizontal section and an inclined section which are sequentially connected, the horizontal section is vertically connected to a side portion of the flange plate and extends outward parallel to the flange plate, one end of the inclined section is connected to one end of the horizontal section, which is far away from the flange plate, and the other end of the inclined section extends obliquely downward and inward until being connected to the bottom end of the blade body.

title_en: Electronic components rubber coating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gluing device for electronic components, which comprises a fixed protective body, a supporting plate, a glue supplementing assembly and a multi-channel pressing glue discharging mechanism, wherein the fixed protective body is arranged in a hollow cavity, the supporting plate is arranged on one side of the bottom of the fixed protective body and is arranged in an L shape with the fixed protective body, the glue supplementing assembly is arranged in the fixed protective body, the multi-channel pressing glue discharging mechanism is arranged on the supporting plate and comprises a supporting rod, a motor protective body, a rotating motor, a rotating supporting shaft, a pressing cam and a glue discharging assembly, the supporting rod is symmetrically arranged on two sides of the supporting plate, and the motor protective body is arranged on one side of the supporting rod. The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic components, and particularly relates to a glue coating device for electronic components, which can carry out controllable glue filling and glue discharging, can realize glue discharging and coating of a plurality of channels, improves the glue discharging efficiency, can ensure consistent force of pressing glue discharging, ensures consistency of glue filling amount, has a stable integral structure, and is high in glue discharging and coating efficiency.

title_en: Assembly type building module and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building modules, and particularly relates to an assembly type building module and a manufacturing method thereof, and the invention provides a manufacturing method of the assembly type building module, which comprises the following steps: i: putting the steel plate on a forming part and punching the steel plate into a corrugated plate; II: the wave plate falls into the extrusion part and is extruded into an arc wave plate with gradually changed radian; III: the spraying part sprays heat insulation materials on the arc-shaped upper surface of the arc-shaped wave plate; IV: opening the slot plate after drying and discharging; the building module is a radian-gradient wave plate with the upper surface provided with heat insulation paint; the device can process the radian-gradient wave plate with the upper surface provided with the heat-insulating paint, and is convenient to use on various special-shaped buildings.

title_en: Nozzle arrangement
abstract_en: The application proposes a nozzle device, which comprises a nozzle mechanism, wherein the nozzle mechanism is provided with an upper nozzle fixing plate; the lower nozzle fixing plate is hinged with the upper nozzle fixing plate; the upper nozzle is detachably arranged on the upper nozzle fixing plate; the lower nozzle is detachably arranged on the lower nozzle fixing plate, when the upper nozzle fixing plate and the lower nozzle fixing plate are closed, the lower nozzle and the upper nozzle form a box-shaped nozzle for the longitudinal passing of the wire, the inner cavity of the nozzle is connected with the spray coating source in a communicating manner, and a passing hole for the passing of the wire is arranged on the nozzle; the first end of nozzle is provided with presss from both sides the wire subassembly, it is provided with the hole of holding with that what the wire that is used for that the longitudinal direction runs through to press from both sides on the wire subassembly passes, and this nozzle device is used for setting up on spraying robot, follows spraying robot motion to carry out the spraying to the circuit, in order to improve spraying efficiency, simultaneously, this spraying device can adopt direct contact coating spraying material, and the spraying is of high quality, and application scope is wide.

title_en: High-performance multi-element alloy surface treatment process
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-performance multi-element alloy surface treatment process, which relates to the technical field of alloy treatment, wherein the alloy is subjected to acid pickling treatment, cleaning treatment and passivation treatment respectively; the pickling treatment, the cleaning treatment and the passivation treatment are respectively carried out in a pickling tank, a cleaning tank and a passivation tank, the pickling tank, the cleaning tank and the passivation tank are separated from each other by a rolling door, pickling solution is placed in the pickling tank, distilled water is placed in the cleaning tank, and passivation solution is placed in the passivation tank; the transfer trolley is placed in the operating room, a pair of slide rails is arranged on the bottom surface of the operating room, the roller wheels on the transfer trolley are placed on the slide rails, and the transfer trolley moves on the slide rails; the transfer trolley sequentially passes through the pickling tank, the cleaning tank and the passivation tank to treat the alloy to be treated, and the separation and sealing among all the working procedures are realized through the opening and closing of the rolling door when the alloy to be treated passes through the pickling tank, the cleaning tank and the passivation tank. The device has high processing efficiency and is safer.

title_en: Efficient conveying equipment for magnetic steel spraying
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating equipment, in particular to high-efficiency conveying equipment for magnetic steel spraying. The invention provides a high-efficiency conveying device for magnetic steel spraying, which comprises: the cooling device comprises a workbench, a cooling box body, a first discharging plate, a second discharging plate, a cold air pipe, a driving motor, a linkage shaft, a belt and a lifting assembly; after the workpiece is placed on the workpiece placing station of the first material placing plate, the belt can drive the workpiece to rotate circumferentially and slide towards the lifting assembly; the lifting assembly can drive the workpiece to move downwards until the lower end face of the lifting assembly abuts against the second discharging plate so that the workpiece slides to a workpiece receiving station; the cold air pipe blows cold air to the workpiece to cool and solidify glue on the workpiece. Through the arrangement of the belt, the driving motor and the linkage shaft, the workpiece is driven to rotate circumferentially from the workpiece placing station to the workpiece receiving station in a conveying process, and the surface of the workpiece is uniformly dried by the cold air pipe. After the workpiece is blown and dried, the workpiece is transferred from the first material placing plate to the second material placing plate.

title_en: Resin composition with UV shielding effect and application thereof in copper-clad plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resin composition with a UV shielding effect and application thereof in a copper-clad plate, which is used for solving the problems that the total yield of epoxy resin with four functional groups is insufficient, so that the resin is in shortage in the busy production season of the copper-clad plate, and in addition, the optical detection efficiency and accuracy are low and the peel strength is low in the existing resin composition. The resin composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-120 parts of phenolic epoxy resin, 30-50 parts of high-bromine epoxy resin, 5-15 parts of bisphenol A epoxy resin, 20-100 parts of phenolic resin, 3-10 parts of tetraphenylethane resin, 100-200 parts of filler, 0.01-0.5 part of interface bonding agent, 40-80 parts of solvent A and 60-100 parts of solvent B. The resin composition has the advantages of UV shielding effect, excellent anti-ghost effect, argon laser absorption effect, optical detection efficiency and accuracy improvement, glass transition temperature improvement, and high peel strength when the resin composition is applied to a copper-clad plate.

title_en: Method for preparing ZnAl-LDHs film on surface of titanium alloy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of materials, and discloses a method for preparing a ZnAl-LDHs film on the surface of a titanium alloy. The method comprises the following steps: and (3) placing the titanium alloy base material in an alkaline solution, carrying out alkaline heat treatment to obtain a titanium alloy sample containing a titanate layer, and then carrying out hydrothermal reaction. In addition, it contains C 10‑18 Alkyl siloxane solution, immersing the titanium alloy with ZnAl-LDHs film layer into C 10‑18 And heating in alkyl siloxane solution to obtain the surface modified titanium alloy. The preparation method provided by the invention utilizes the alkali-thermal reaction to form titanate, the titanate layer rich in hydrophilic groups provides a large number of nucleation sites, and the defect that a ZnAl-LDHs film layer is formed on the surface of the titanium alloy is overcomeThe amount is small. The contact angle of the surface modified titanium alloy is more than 100 degrees, even more than 130 degrees, and the surface modified titanium alloy has excellent hydrophobicity, so that the antifouling property in seawater is obviously improved.

title_en: Liquid discharge device and liquid discharge system
abstract_en: A liquid discharging device (100) to which a container with a wireless tag can be attached, the liquid discharging device comprising: a plurality of container storage sections that store the containers; a reading device (190) for reading information of the wireless tag of the container stored in the container storage unit; and a device control unit (141) that stores, in the wireless tag, a liquid material type of a product to be filled in the container, the liquid material type being classified into a plurality of liquid material groups, wherein, when a product of the liquid material type of the wireless tag stored in the container storage unit read by the reading device is not a product corresponding to the liquid material group corresponding to the container storage unit, the device control unit notifies that the product is not the corresponding product.

title_en: Distributed continuous laminating extrusion molding device for composite material processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed continuous laminating extrusion molding device for processing a composite material, which is provided with at least one feeding extrusion pair roller and one receiving roller; the forming device is provided with a conveying roller which is arranged close to the end of the receiving roller, and is also provided with a feeding extrusion pair roller, a hot pressing device, an automatic stamping device and a receiving roller which are independent movable units, and extrusion forming channels for feeding the multi-layer adjustable belt composite raw material layer to extrude through are penetrated among the feeding extrusion pair roller, the hot pressing device, the automatic stamping device, the receiving roller and the conveying roller; the conveying rollers are connected with and drive the conveying belt to drive in the extrusion forming channel, and the conveying belt is attached to the extrusion belt type composite material and drives the belt type composite material to drive. The forming device provided by the invention is provided with independent movable devices, and the shape and the size of the field where the devices are installed are arranged at will, so long as the requirements of smooth transmission and sliding in the extrusion process of the composite material can be met; the occupied space and the occupied area can be effectively saved.

title_en: Strip steel continuous annealing and pre-coating backwashing iron and oil removing cleaning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip steel continuous annealing and pre-coating backwashing iron and oil removing cleaning system, which comprises a water cooling tank, a precipitation water cooling pipeline, a water cooling clapboard, a sedimentation tank, a waste water tank, a soaking roller, a water replenishing pipe, a water cooling front steering roller, a water cooling rear steering roller, a flushing nozzle, a high-pressure cleaning water knife, a squeezing roller and a strip steel dryer, wherein the water cooling clapboard is arranged in the water cooling tank and divides the water cooling tank into a soaking water cooling area and an overflow area, the sedimentation tank is communicated with the bottom of the soaking water cooling area, the waste water tank is respectively communicated with the bottom of the overflow area and the bottom of the sedimentation tank, the soaking roller is arranged in the soaking water cooling area, the water replenishing pipe is arranged above the soaking water cooling area, the water cooling front steering roller and the water cooling rear steering roller are respectively arranged at two sides of the soaking roller, the flushing nozzle is arranged between the water cooling front steering roller and the soaking roller, the high-pressure cleaning water knife, the squeezing roller and the strip steel dryer are sequentially arranged between the water cooling rear steering roller and the soaking roller, the top end of the water cooling clapboard is lower than the top end of the water cooling tank, one end of the precipitation water cooling pipeline is communicated with the middle upper part of the sedimentation tank, the flushing nozzle, and a precipitation water-cooling circulating pump and a coarse filter are arranged on the precipitation water-cooling pipeline, and a cooling water heat exchanger is arranged between the coarse filter and the nozzle.

title_en: Curtain coating dip-coating batch production equipment of complex film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of composite film processing, in particular to a casting micro-dip coating batch production device for a composite film, which comprises a shell, wherein two ends of the shell are symmetrically provided with cleaning devices, a storage box is arranged in the shell, the back surface of the storage box is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the shell, the bottom of the storage box is uniformly provided with transmission pipes, the top parts of the transmission pipes are fixedly connected with the bottom of the storage box, the bottom parts of the transmission pipes are provided with mounting plates, the top parts of the mounting plates are fixedly connected with the bottom parts of the transmission pipes, coating devices are uniformly arranged at the bottom parts of the mounting plates, the top parts of the coating devices are fixedly connected with the bottom parts of the mounting plates, a conveyor belt is arranged right below the coating devices, the front end and the rear end of the conveyor belt are movably connected with the inner wall of the shell, aiming at the defects of the prior art, the invention provides the casting micro-dip coating batch production device for the composite film, the problem of coating the effect not good when the complex film is processed is solved.

title_en: White packaging container
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plastic container for packaging, and particularly provides a white packaging container, wherein the container wall of the white packaging container comprises a first light-blocking layer and a second light-blocking layer, the first light-blocking layer is an outer layer, the raw material of the first light-blocking layer comprises polyethylene glycol terephthalate and a first light-blocking agent, the first light-blocking agent is selected from at least one of white color master batch, white color oil and grey color master batch, the raw material of the second light-blocking layer comprises polyethylene glycol terephthalate and a second light-blocking agent, the first light-blocking agent and the second light-blocking agent are arranged in two layers, the first light-blocking agent is added into the first light-blocking layer, the second light-blocking agent is added into the second light-blocking layer, the utilization rate and the distribution uniformity of the light-blocking agent can be improved, most importantly, the using amount of the whole light-blocking agent is obviously reduced while the same light-blocking effect is achieved, the whiteness of the wall of the container is obviously improved, and the aesthetic property of the white packaging container is improved.

title_en: Space nuclear power circulation system based on integration of pulse heat exchange and water-oxygen decarbonization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space nuclear power circulation system based on integration of pulse heat exchange and water-oxygen carbon removal, which comprises an inner circulation loop and an outer circulation loop, wherein the inner circulation loop is connected with the outer circulation loop through a water pipe; high-temperature liquid metal flowing out of the nuclear reactor in the internal circulation loop exchanges heat with helium in the external circulation loop in the pulse heat exchanger; the helium enters a turbine to generate power after being heated, and flows to the water oxygen and carbon removal integrated device through a heat regenerator; after further heat dissipation of the cooler, the helium gas flowing out enters a compressor, flows into a heat regenerator from the compressor, is preheated to a fixed temperature, and then enters a pulse heat exchanger to perform next round of heat exchange; the invention also provides a heat exchange medium pulsation device and a control module, which periodically adjust the opening of the valve through self-defined parameters to enable the heat exchange medium to generate periodic pulsation and further improve the heat exchange efficiency; the water-oxygen decarbonization integrated device is introduced, so that the utilization of wastewater and the preparation of oxygen are realized, carbon dioxide is removed, and the living environment in a space system is maintained.

title_en: RFID label shielding device film-shaped metal paper processing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radio frequency, in particular to a film-shaped metal paper processing device of an RFID label shielding device. The technical problems to be solved by the invention are as follows: residual air bubbles exist between the metal film and the medium plate, and grid lines of the cut metal shielding paper cannot be accurately positioned at the central position, so that the shielding strength of the metal shielding paper is influenced. The technical scheme is as follows: a RFID label shielding device film-shaped metal paper processing device comprises a conveying assembly, a clamping assembly, a rotating assembly, a main power assembly, an upper stamping assembly, a lower stamping assembly and the like; an upper electric pressing plate is fixedly connected to the rear upper part of the main bracket; a lower electric pressing plate is fixedly connected with the rear lower part of the main bracket. Compared with the prior art, the device has the advantages that the device is designed to be capable of sequentially carrying out multiple processing items on two groups of metal films at the same position synchronously, and accurate positioning of metal film processing is realized.

title_en: Continuous anode aluminum electrolysis anode lifting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anode lifting of continuous anode aluminum electrolysis, in particular to a continuous anode aluminum electrolysis anode lifting device, which comprises: a first power assembly; the transmission assembly is connected to the first power assembly through a transmission shaft; the transmission assembly includes: the input end of the worm gear hoister is connected to the transmission shaft, and one end of the screw rod is connected to the output end of the worm gear hoister; and the clamping assembly is connected to the other end of the screw rod and used for clamping the anode. The power is provided for the transmission assembly through the first power assembly, so that the transmission assembly drives the anode clamped by the clamping assembly to move, and the position of the anode is accurately controlled. And in the transmission assembly, the rotation of a worm wheel in the worm wheel elevator is converted into the kinetic energy of the displacement of the screw rod in the vertical direction, so that the anode is driven to move up and down, the occupation of most of the space above the electrolytic cell is avoided, most of working environments are met, and the applicability is improved.

title_en: Plated steel sheet
abstract_en: A plated steel sheet according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: the galvanized steel sheet has a galvanized layer formed on the surface of the base steel sheet, and a colored resin layer formed on the galvanized layer, wherein a plated texture is formed on the surface of the galvanized layer, the colored resin layer contains a coloring agent, the plated texture comprises a plurality of convex portions and a plurality of concave portions, the three-dimensional average roughness Sas of the bottom of the concave portions is greater than 200nm and less than 2000nm, the DKmin x CK is less than 15.0, and the DKmax-DKmin x CK is greater than 1.0. A plated steel sheet according to another aspect of the present invention includes: the galvanized steel sheet has a texture extending in one direction, and the colored resin layer contains a coloring agent, has a three-dimensional average roughness Saave 'of more than 5nm and 200nm or less, has a DKMin' xCK 'of 15.0 or less, and has a DKMax' -DKMin ') xCK' of more than 1.0.

title_en: Detection device convenient for detecting performance of electrode or diaphragm in water electrolysis hydrogen production device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device convenient for detecting the performance of an electrode or a diaphragm in a water electrolysis hydrogen production device, which comprises: the two ends of the test electrolytic tank are connected with a power supply, and the oxygen alkali treatment unit and the hydrogen alkali treatment unit are connected with the power supply; an oxygen side alkali liquor backflow pipeline in the oxygen alkali treatment unit and a hydrogen side alkali liquor backflow pipeline in the hydrogen alkali treatment unit are both communicated with a circulating pump, and the circulating pump is communicated with a cathode area of the test electrolytic cell through a pipeline; a water replenishing mechanism is also arranged; the oxygen separator and the hydrogen separator are respectively provided with a transparent section which can observe the liquid level in the corresponding container, and the transparent section arranged on the oxygen separator and the transparent section arranged on the hydrogen separator are positioned at the same height; the hydrogen regulating valve and the oxygen regulating valve are both manual stop valves; an oxygen side liquid level meter is arranged on the oxygen separator, a hydrogen side liquid level meter is arranged on the hydrogen separator, and the oxygen side liquid level meter, the hydrogen side liquid level meter and the power supply are all in electric signal connection with the controller. The detection device is suitable for frequent operation and debugging in a laboratory, can work under normal pressure and is not easy to cause potential safety hazards.

title_en: Wafer electroplating hanger
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer electroplating hanger which comprises a bottom plate and a rear cover, wherein an opening is formed in the bottom plate, a first sealing ring surrounding the opening is arranged on the bottom plate, the edge of the surface to be electroplated of a wafer is attached to the first sealing ring, a plurality of conductive elastic sheets are further arranged on the bottom plate in the peripheral area of the first sealing ring, and the conductive elastic sheets are in conductive contact with the edge of the surface to be electroplated of the wafer; a second sealing ring is arranged between the rear cover and the bottom plate; the rear cover is provided with a circle of elastic body, and the elastic body is attached to the edge of the back of the wafer. Compared with the prior art, the wafer surface contact device has the advantages that the first sealing ring and the elastic body are respectively in soft contact with the two surfaces of the wafer, so that the pressure on the wafer is reduced, and the fragments are effectively prevented.

title_en: Waste soil recycling heat preservation brick and production device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production device for spoil recycling heat preservation brickwork, which comprises a mechanical module and a detection module, the mechanical module comprises a stacker crane, a control box is arranged on the stacker crane, a conveying shell is arranged on one side of the stacker crane, a conveying belt is arranged in the conveying shell, a frame body is arranged above the conveying belt, the frame body is connected with the conveying shell, one side of the conveying shell is provided with a chute, a slide block is arranged in the chute, the other end of the sliding block is connected with a fixed block, the sliding block is matched and slidably connected with the sliding chute, the fixed block is provided with a threaded rod in a penetrating way, one side of the threaded rod is connected with a motor which drives the threaded rod, the other end of the threaded rod is rotationally connected with the outer side wall of the conveying shell through a bearing, the mechanical claw is controlled by the control system to sort and reject the bricks, so that the production quality of the bricklaying is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Laminated glass and head-up display system
abstract_en: The application relates to laminated glass and a head-up display system. The laminated glass comprises a first transparent substrate, a second transparent substrate and an adhesive film; the laminated glass is provided with a light-transmitting area and a light blocking area surrounding at least part of the periphery of the light-transmitting area; the bonding film is positioned between the first transparent substrate and the second transparent substrate and used for bonding the first transparent substrate and the second transparent substrate; the visible light projection rate of the light transmission area is greater than or equal to 70%, the visible light transmission rate of the light blocking area is less than or equal to 5%, the light blocking area comprises a first area located at the bottom of the light transmission area, and the first area is provided with one or more functional display areas to display images. The laminated glass can weaken or even eliminate two double images which are mutually interfered and formed by the deviation of the reflected images of the first transparent substrate and the second transparent substrate.

title_en: Liquid metal cooling blade system and anti-corrosion method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid metal corrosion protection of an aircraft engine blade cooling system, in particular to a liquid metal cooling blade system, which comprises a separator, a pipeline A, a pipeline B, an electromagnetic pump, a pipeline C, an expansion joint, a pipeline D, a heat exchanger, a pipeline F, a pipeline G, a collector and blades, wherein the separator is arranged on the pipeline A; a pipeline E is arranged on the heat exchanger; cooling channels are arranged in the blades; the cooling channel, the pipeline A, the separator, the pipeline B, the electromagnetic pump, the pipeline C, the expansion joint, the pipeline D, the pipeline E, the pipeline F, the collector and the pipeline G are sequentially communicated to form a circulation passage; liquid metal is stored in the circulation passage; the pipeline A, the pipeline B, the pipeline C, the pipeline D, the pipeline F and the pipeline G are made of quartz materials, graphite materials or aluminum carbide materials; the inner walls of the circulation passages are provided with protective layers. The invention also provides an anti-corrosion method of the liquid metal cooling blade system. The invention can effectively solve the problem that the liquid metal corrodes the cooling system at high temperature.

title_en: Optical lens scribbles black device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ink coating device, in particular to an ink coating device for an optical lens. The technical problem of the invention is to provide a device which is faster and can be uniformly coated, when an optical lens is coated, the coating is uniformly coated, and the optical lens ink coating device has high working efficiency. An optical lens inking device comprising: the front part of the mounting rack is provided with a speed reducing motor; two vertical rods are arranged and are respectively and rotatably arranged on the left side and the right side of the front part of the mounting frame; the gears are arranged on the upper part of the vertical rod and an output shaft of the speed reducing motor, and two adjacent gears are meshed with each other; the placing seat is installed on the top of the vertical rod and an output shaft of the speed reducing motor. The measuring lamp can irradiate and penetrate through the lens, so that a worker can observe the light transmittance and judge the thickness of the coated ink.

title_en: Surface treatment method for battery aluminum shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface treatment method of a battery aluminum shell, which comprises the following steps: conveying the battery aluminum shell into a degreasing station through a first conveying device for degreasing; sending the deoiled battery aluminum shell into a polishing work station through a second conveying device, wherein the polishing work station is provided with a plurality of polishing wheels; and controlling the polishing wheel to sequentially polish a plurality of surfaces of the battery aluminum shell positioned on the second conveying device. The surface treatment method for the battery aluminum shell provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the aesthetic property of the battery aluminum shell by automatically removing oil and polishing the battery aluminum shell.

title_en: Novel high-performance antistatic flame-retardant composite material and preparation method thereof
