abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel high-performance antistatic flame-retardant composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the novel high-performance antistatic flame-retardant composite material comprises 60-80% by mass of unsaturated orthoester flame-retardant resin, 16-35% by mass of alkali-free glass fiber, 3-10% by mass of conductive glass fiber, 5-11% by mass of functional filler, 0.1-0.5% by mass of accelerator and 0.8-3% by mass of curing agent. According to the novel high-performance antistatic flame-retardant composite material and the preparation method thereof, unsaturated orthoester flame-retardant resin, alkali-free glass fiber and conductive glass fiber are adopted for composite molding and are divided into three layers, namely an antistatic upper coating layer, an antistatic glass fiber wall-increasing unsaturated resin layer and an antistatic lower coating layer, so that the novel high-performance antistatic flame-retardant composite material has good antistatic and flame-retardant effects, the service performance of the material is improved, and the molding and processing are facilitated.

title_en: Glue coating quality detection and automatic glue supplementing system based on vision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gluing, and particularly relates to a visual-based gluing quality detection and automatic glue supplementing system. The data interface of the host system is interactively connected with the industrial camera and the mechanical arm, gluing measurement is carried out according to data recorded by the industrial camera, the measurement result is interactively communicated with the host system, if the deviation is within a preset qualified glue type data threshold range, the gluing quality is considered to be unqualified, and glue supplementing operation is started. The invention is mainly oriented to the quality detection of the gluing process in the automobile production line, and can detect the quality of the gluing process in real time. The invention is suitable for popularization and application in the related technical field.

title_en: Composite film electrode for electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite film electrode for electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide and a preparation method thereof. The composite film electrode takes a lead sheet as a substrate; the substrate is attached with a halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework film layer. A halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework film formed by applying a halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework slurry to a substrate and then calcining the applied slurry. The composite film has stable electrode performance, and does not generate decomposition and reduction phenomena of a halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework film layer in the working range of-0.19V to-0.98V vs. In the electrochemical reduction process of carbon dioxide, divalent lead in the halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework film layer and zero-valent lead on the lead sheet can form an oxidation-reduction pair, so that the halogenated nicotinic acid-lead organic framework film layer can be kept stable in the reduction process, and can not fall off from the lead sheet or be reduced into zero-valent lead, thereby having excellent stability.

title_en: Wafer conveying mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer conveying mechanical arm, relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and is used for reducing the temperature change rate of a wafer, inhibiting stress generated inside the wafer and improving the quality of the wafer. The wafer transfer robot comprises: a front arm and a thermoelectric assembly. The front arm is provided with a bearing part for bearing the wafer. The thermoelectric assembly is disposed on the carrier portion of the front arm, and the thermoelectric assembly is used for reducing the temperature change rate of the wafer. The wafer transfer robot is applied to the manufacturing of semiconductor devices.

title_en: Integrated processing equipment for tinning through holes of circuit boards
abstract_en: The invention discloses integrated processing equipment for tinning a through hole of a circuit board, which comprises a processing table, wherein two opposite supporting seats are arranged on the processing table, one side of the processing table is provided with a conversion table connected through a horizontal cylinder, the bottom of the conversion table is provided with a drilling device and a tinning chamber, a central control cavity is formed in the tinning chamber, a vertical cylinder is arranged on the conversion table, the vertical cylinder is connected with an abutting inner plate positioned in the central control cavity through an up-and-down moving assembly, the abutting inner plate is connected with a tinning column through a rotating assembly, a hollow channel is formed in the tinning column, a guide column is arranged in the hollow channel, the outer side wall of the guide column is provided with a plurality of guide rings for guiding tin bars, and the top of the guide column is provided with a tin feeding device for conveying the tin bars. The invention integrates drilling, cleaning and tinning of the circuit boards, can quickly and effectively tin-plate the through holes on a plurality of circuit boards, can ensure consistent tin-plating effect of the through holes, reduces the working procedures and can obviously improve the production efficiency.

title_en: High-ductility artificial leather
abstract_en: A high-ductility artificial leather belongs to the technical field of artificial leather and comprises a substrate and a decorative layer coated on the upper surface of the substrate; the base body is provided with a plurality of penetrating and wiping holes in an array manner, extending belts are inserted into the plurality of penetrating and wiping holes according to the extending direction, the edge of the base body is fixedly provided with a telescopic strip, and a locking assembly for locking the telescopic strip is fixedly arranged on the telescopic strip; the artificial leather disclosed by the invention has better ductility and simple structure, and the product can be adjusted within a range according to the actual requirements of users by virtue of the telescopic strips, the extension belts and the locking assemblies.

title_en: Aluminum nitride copper-clad AMB method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aluminum nitride copper-clad AMB method, which comprises the following steps: s1: ceramic substrate preparation→s2: transition metal layer evaporation→s3: sputtering Cu, coating a brazing material on a bonding area of a ceramic substrate, opening cooling water of a magnetron sputtering table, opening all air inlet valves, and putting a copper target and the substrate into a reaction cavity for sputtering. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the formation of intermetallic compound and interface product greatly improves the bonding strength between metal layers, so as to improve the adhesion strength of the whole metal layer on the ceramic substrate.

title_en: Slurry coating device for preparing composite material coating by laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slurry coating device for preparing a composite material coating by laser, which relates to the technical field of experimental instruments and comprises a group of symmetrically arranged stainless steel plates, a stainless steel backing plate, a full-thread hexagon head bolt and a butterfly nut matched with the full-thread hexagon head bolt, wherein screw holes are formed in the corresponding positions of the two sides of the bottom of each stainless steel plate, the diameter of each screw hole is matched with the nominal diameter of the full-thread hexagon head bolt, when the stainless steel backing plate and a sample are clamped and fixed, the two stainless steel plates are fixedly connected through the full-thread hexagon head bolt, scale stripes are marked above the side surfaces of the two stainless steel plates, the inner sides of the two stainless steel plates are respectively provided with a bearing assembly, and the top of each stainless steel plate is provided with a pressing assembly; according to the invention, the bearing assembly and the pressing assembly are arranged on the two stainless steel plates, so that the stainless steel base plate and the sample which are placed in advance can be ensured to be horizontal without deflection, and the slurry can be ensured to be uniformly coated and compacted on the upper surface of the sample.

title_en: Anti-static composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-static composite material (IPC classification number: C08L23/12), in particular to an anti-static composite material and a preparation method thereof. The anti-static composite material comprises a first anti-static layer, a strength enhancement layer and a second anti-static layer from top to bottom in sequence. The antistatic composite material prepared by the invention takes polyolefin, inorganic filler and coupling agent as a strength enhancement layer, takes polypropylene copolymer and conductive master batch as an antistatic layer, and has the characteristics of antistatic function and high strength; in addition, the antistatic composite material has simple preparation process, is convenient for industrial production, can be widely used in petrochemical industry, military industry, aerospace industry and IT (information electronics) industry, and has antistatic devices and tools for semiconductor, antistatic production technical equipment and products, production and life.

title_en: Photoresist suck-back device, photoresist coating equipment and photoresist coating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoresist resorption device, photoresist coating equipment and a photoresist coating method, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, wherein the photoresist resorption device comprises a monitor, an on-off resorption mechanism and a controller, wherein the monitor is arranged on the photoresist coating equipment and is used for monitoring a photoresist liquid column in a photoresist nozzle in the photoresist coating equipment; the on-off resorption mechanism is arranged on a photoresist pipeline of the photoresist coating equipment, and an adjusting component in the on-off resorption mechanism is used for adjusting the resorption amount of photoresist in the photoresist pipeline so as to control the position of a photoresist liquid column in a photoresist nozzle communicated with the photoresist pipeline; the controller is respectively in signal connection with the monitor and the on-off suckback mechanism and is used for receiving the signal fed back by the monitor and controlling the on-off suckback mechanism to be opened and closed. The photoresist suck-back device disclosed by the invention can prevent the photoresist from being condensed or dropped due to the fact that the photoresist is too close to the opening of the photoresist nozzle.

title_en: Galvanizing air knife process optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a galvanizing air knife process optimization method, which comprises the following steps: establishing an acquisition platform, and acquiring the galvanizing production process data in real time through a communication interface; preprocessing the data of the galvanizing production process; processing the galvanizing production process data by adopting a big data analysis model, and sending an air knife control value to an upper computer; reconstructing a feedforward control model, and predicting an air knife position value according to a plating control value; the air knife position setting is transmitted to the feedback control mode by the AI control mode. Has the advantages that: according to the invention, through a big data intelligent analysis modeling method, the corresponding relation between the air knife position and the zinc layer thickness is found out, a big data zinc layer model is established, and the existing feed-forward control model is replaced at the belt head part, so that the accuracy of air knife position setting is improved, the manual intervention rate is reduced, and the yield of the galvanized steel coil head part is improved during steel coil switching.

title_en: Stud/nut grounding device with tin-zinc coating
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a grounding device comprising an aluminium nut (16) having an internal thread and adapted to clamp eyelets (28) of electrical conductors on respective contact areas of a stud (12), wherein the nut (16) has at least one coating (30) comprising at least zinc, characterized in that the coating further comprises tin, characterized in that the coating consists of acidic tin-zinc electroplated on the aluminium nut (16) and such that tin constitutes 60 to 80 wt.% of the coating, and the tin-zinc coating forms a layer having an average thickness of about 5 to 16 μm, and the grounding device.

title_en: Method for manufacturing articles using foam particles
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method of manufacturing an article using foam particles. Methods for manufacturing an article of footwear are provided. In various aspects, the method includes an additive manufacturing method that utilizes foam particles. In some aspects, an additive manufacturing method includes increasing a temperature of a plurality of foam particles with actinic radiation under conditions effective to fuse a portion of the plurality of foam particles including one or more thermoplastic elastomers. Raising the temperature of the foam particles may be performed in one or more iterations. The disclosed method may be used to manufacture articles having sub-regions that exhibit different degrees of fusion between foam particles, thereby producing sub-regions having different properties such as density, elasticity, and/or flexural modulus. This abstract is intended as a browsing tool for purposes of searching in the particular art and is not intended to be limiting of the present disclosure.

title_en: Preparation method of tungsten-titanium alloy tube target
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a tungsten-titanium alloy tube target, which comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out degassing treatment and hot isostatic pressing treatment on tungsten-titanium mixed powder and a stainless steel inner tube, and obtaining the tungsten-titanium alloy tube target taking the stainless steel inner tube as a back tube without carrying out cold isostatic pressing treatment before the degassing treatment, so that the compactness and the uniformity of the organization structure of the tungsten-titanium tube target for a semiconductor can be improved, the production efficiency can be improved, and the production cost can be reduced.

title_en: Hole sealing process for pump body of stainless steel vacuum pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vacuum pump sealing, in particular to a hole sealing process for a pump body of a stainless steel vacuum pump, which aims at the problem that a sealing ring in the vacuum pump gradually loses the sealing effect under the long-time oxidation effect, the hole sealing process carries out hole sealing treatment on a product pump body through sealing treatment equipment, and a sealing processor comprises a processing tank, a vacuumizing assembly and a clamping claw; the hole sealing process comprises the following steps: heating and curing the stainless steel shell of the vacuum pump; placing the assembled pump body in the processing tank; the interior of the processing tank is vacuumized by a vacuumizing assembly; opening a liquid inlet valve to fill an impregnant IM4500K and CC-10P methacrylate into the processing tank, and soaking the pump body through the impregnant IM4500K and CC-10P methacrylate; the pump body is taken out from the processing tank, and through the arrangement of the equipment, the realization of a hole sealing process can be carried out on the pump body, so that the generation of pores at the joint of the pump body is avoided, the sealing performance is reduced, and the durability of the sealing degree is improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing optical member and optical member
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing an optical component (1) for a lighting device of a vehicle, wherein a base body (4) is produced from a translucent or transparent material, a light-shielding coating (8) is applied to an outer surface (7) of the base body (4) by evaporation or by sputtering of a coating material, the light-shielding coating (8) is applied as a reflective coating (8), during the application process, a first reflective layer (11) having a low reflectivity is applied first and a second reflective layer (12) having a high reflectivity is applied subsequently.

title_en: Corrosion inhibition type foaming agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrosion inhibition type foaming agent which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-30 parts of diethylenetriamine, 40-60 parts of lauric acid, 15-25 parts of 3-chloro-2-hydroxypropanesulfonic acid sodium salt, 20-30 parts of isopropanol and 20-30 parts of distilled water. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the corrosion inhibition type foaming agent, which specifically comprises the steps of selecting raw materials, heating to obtain liquid lauric acid, generating lauric acid imidazoline, and finally preparing the corrosion inhibition type foaming agent.

title_en: Zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy plated steel containing V, Ce, La and Mn and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy plated steel containing V, Ce, La and Mn and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of ferrous metallurgy production. The invention provides a zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy plating steel containing V, Ce, La and Mn, which comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass: 0.5-5% of aluminum, 0.5-3.0% of magnesium, 0.05-1% of vanadium, 0.01-0.50% of cerium, 0.01-0.30% of lanthanum, 0.025-1.0% of Mn0.025%, and the balance of zinc and inevitable impurities; wherein Al/Mg is 1.0-1.5, and the total amount of vanadium, cerium and lanthanum is 0.03-1.0%. The zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy coated steel provided by the invention not only meets the requirement of users on high corrosion resistance of the steel, but also meets the requirement of users on excellent stamping formability or high-strength steel, is especially suitable for the fields of household appliances and automobiles, and has good popularization and application prospects.

title_en: Compression fittings is used in production of fire prevention building material battenboard
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressing device, in particular to a pressing device for producing fireproof building material sandwich boards. The invention provides a pressing device for producing a fireproof building material sandwich board, which can automatically glue and fill, can automatically press and is convenient to collect. The invention provides a pressing device for producing a fireproof building material sandwich board, which comprises: the first fixing frame is arranged between the two sides of the base; the first rotating shafts are rotatably arranged between two sides of the two first fixing frames; the first lead screw is arranged on the first fixing frame in a symmetrical and rotary mode. The conveying mechanism rotates to drive the sandwich board to move leftwards, the sandwich board moves leftwards to be in contact with the adhesive brushing mechanism, then the adhesive brushing mechanism rotates to glue the sandwich board, the sandwich board moves leftwards to the rolling shaft, and the rolling shaft rotates to press the sandwich board and the thin steel plate.

title_en: Method for preparing hydrogen by coupling photovoltaic power generation and electrolyzed water
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydrogen production method by coupling photovoltaic power generation and electrolyzed water, which comprises the following steps: the photovoltaic power generation storage stores the electric quantity supplied by photovoltaic power generation through a solar storage battery; the rectification voltage-regulating circuit works to regulate each corresponding electrical equipment; electrolytic hydrogen production, wherein the electrolytic hydrogen production equipment performs water electrolysis work in the electrolytic cell, and the electrolytic hydrogen production equipment performs electrolysis work to generate hydrogen and oxygen. The photovoltaic power generation and electrolyzed water coupling hydrogen production method can effectively complete solar photovoltaic electrolyzed water hydrogen production, is convenient for filtering impurities in the electrolyzed water, improves the electrolysis effect of the electrolyzed water, reduces the production cost, improves the production efficiency, can generate good economic and social benefits, is convenient for collecting hydrogen and oxygen, and meets the use requirements of workers.

title_en: Method for preparing large-area high-performance n-type two-dimensional molybdenum telluride field effect transistor array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a large-area high-performance n-type two-dimensional molybdenum telluride field effect transistor array. Firstly, growing a semiconductor phase molybdenum telluride film on a substrate, patterning the semiconductor phase molybdenum telluride film and growing a tungsten film to obtain a film with metal tungsten and semiconductor phase molybdenum telluride being interphase, and then changing the tungsten film into a semi-metal phase tungsten telluride film by a chemical vapor deposition method; patterning again to obtain a discrete device array which takes the semiconductor phase molybdenum telluride as a channel and the semimetal phase tungsten telluride as an electrode; and finally, realizing n-type doping on the device by depositing a hafnium oxide film through an atomic layer, and preparing a patterned top gate metal electrode to obtain the large-area high-performance n-type two-dimensional molybdenum telluride field effect transistor array. The method has ideal n-type doping effect on the two-dimensional molybdenum telluride, the doping degree is adjustable, and meanwhile, the contact resistance of the source electrode and the drain electrode of the prepared device is low, so that the device performance is improved, and a foundation is provided for the application of the two-dimensional semiconductor material in the fields of integrated circuits and the like.

title_en: High-temperature protective coating for jet pipe of aerospace vehicle engine as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-temperature protective coating for an engine jet pipe of an aerospace vehicle, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the high-temperature protective coating comprises a multiphase composite transition buffer layer (1), an intermediate support layer (2) positioned on the multiphase composite transition buffer layer (1) and a strengthening main body layer (3) positioned on the intermediate support layer (2), and the multiphase composite transition buffer layer (1) is made of (Nb, W, mo, zr and Ti)  5  Si  3  The material of the middle supporting layer (2) is boron element modified (Nb, ti, cr) Si  2  The material of the strengthening main body layer (3) is hafnium, zirconium and boron element modified (Nb, ti, cr) Si  2  . The engine spray pipe can stably work for a long time at the temperature of 25-1700 ℃, and the service life and the working reliability of the engine are improved.

title_en: Deposition substrate for growing single crystal diamond and method for producing single crystal diamond
abstract_en: The application discloses a deposition substrate for single crystal diamond growth and a method for manufacturing single crystal diamond, wherein the deposition substrate for single crystal diamond growth comprises the following structures: the first layer is a patterned silicon substrate; the second layer is a transition layer; the third layer is a metal iridium layer. Secondly, the application discloses a pretreatment method of the substrate for growing the single crystal diamond, which comprises the following steps: a. etching the silicon substrate with the pattern; b. magnetron sputtering: sputtering the transition layer, wherein the sputtering thickness is 40nm-0.2 mu m, and sputtering the metal iridium, and the thickness is 50-200 nm; c. polishing, namely mechanically polishing the metal iridium layer to remove the metal iridium at the convex part; and d, cleaning, namely ultrasonically cleaning for 5-10min by using acetone, absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water in sequence. In addition, the manufacturing of the single crystal diamond is performed on the pretreated deposition substrate for single crystal diamond growth, including the steps of: step one, bias enhancement nucleation; and step two, growing the single crystal diamond.

title_en: Cold-rolled steel strip alkali washing defoaming system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold-rolled steel strip alkali washing defoaming system which comprises an online tank body, an alkali liquor circulating tank, an ultrasonic bubble breaking mechanism, a thermal bubble breaking box and a negative pressure foam flow device, wherein an alkali liquor outlet of the online tank body is connected with a liquid inlet of the alkali liquor circulating tank through an alkali liquor conveying pipeline, the ultrasonic bubble breaking mechanism is connected to the alkali liquor conveying pipeline, a foam inlet is formed in the thermal bubble breaking box and is connected with the alkali liquor circulating tank, an outlet of the thermal bubble breaking box is connected with the negative pressure foam flow device through a foam drainage pipeline, and a heating element is arranged in the thermal bubble breaking box. The invention adopts the alkali liquor circulating tank, the ultrasonic bubble breaking mechanism, the thermal bubble breaking box and the negative pressure foam flow device, combines various physical modes such as ultrasound, heating, negative pressure and the like to realize low-consumption and high-efficiency defoaming, completely abandons a chemical method of adding a defoaming agent into the alkali liquor, achieves the purposes of environmental protection and emission reduction, does not pollute the original alkali liquor, can realize the recycling of the alkali liquor, and is suitable for eliminating the foams in the cleaning process sections of cold-rolled silicon steel, continuous annealing and galvanizing units.

title_en: Coating gasket and coating die head
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coating gasket and coating die head, including the main part gasket, the main part gasket includes base member and two at least extension blocks, two extension blocks all set up in the same one side edge of base member, and be provided with the interval between two extension blocks, the base member is close to the lateral wall that extends the block and encloses into the slurry tank jointly with the lateral wall that extends the block, in arbitrary one extension block, detachably sets up a dog on the lateral wall that extends the block and is close to the slurry tank, the dog extends toward the slurry tank, so, when the thick limit of coating needs to be cut down, only need to change the dog with the width that changes the slurry stream can, thereby can cut the thick limit of pole piece fast accurately, effectively improve the quality of cutting thin.

title_en: Gas introduction structure and processing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas introduction structure and a processing apparatus. Provided is a technique capable of uniformly supplying a gas to a substrate arranged in a plurality of layers. A gas introduction structure according to an aspect of the present disclosure is a gas introduction structure that extends in a longitudinal direction of a substantially cylindrical processing container and supplies a gas into the processing container, the gas introduction structure including: an introduction section which defines an introduction chamber; a discharge unit that defines a plurality of discharge chambers each including a plurality of gas holes for discharging a gas into the processing container; and a branching portion connected to the introduction chamber, branching in a branching shape in accordance with the number of the plurality of discharge chambers, and dividing a branching chamber connected to the plurality of discharge chambers.

title_en: Cathode electrophoretic coating smearing and recycling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cathode electrophoretic coating smearing and recycling system which comprises a machine shell, wherein a placing cavity is formed in the machine shell, a lifting plate is arranged in the placing cavity, a moving device and a clamping device are arranged in the lifting plate, and a sealing device, a drying device and a recycling device are arranged on the bottom wall of the placing cavity; the electrophoresis cleaning, drying and coating device can perform a cleaning, drying and electrophoresis coating work flow on electrophoresis, the whole process is completed through machinery, manual assistance or intervention is not needed, the labor cost of a factory is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the coating remained on the electrophoresis can be recovered into the coating shell through the recovery shell, the recovered coating is used for the second time, the waste of production raw materials is avoided, in addition, the electrophoresis cleaning, drying and coating work flow can be integrated through the cleaning shell and the drying shell, the complex work flow is avoided, and the production efficiency of the factory is improved.

title_en: Processing method for bicolor seamless combined spraying of anodic oxidation and nano injection molding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method for bicolor seamless combined spraying of anodic oxidation and nanometer injection molding, which comprises the following steps: step A: the method comprises the following steps of carrying out preliminary spot check on client materials to be processed, wherein the factors of focusing on defective products in the spot check comprise: product bruise, hard mark, three-damage, pin hole, protective film adhesive residue, heterochrosis and product end surface fracture; and B: after the sampling inspection is finished, the client materials are subjected to full inspection, poor materials need to be picked out independently in the full inspection process, and the poor materials are subjected to field confirmation by quality engineers, project engineers and client factory resident personnel and then flow into the next procedure; and C: printing shielding paint on the material qualified by full inspection, printing the single product material twice, wherein the thickness of the printing ink is 2-3 mu m, standing for 10-15min after printing, and naturally drying. The invention adopts a spraying clamp and multiple full detection to apply the double-color seamless combination line process to shells such as smart phones, computers, intelligent wearing and the like.

title_en: Water-washing-free process for coating metal surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal coating, and discloses a water-washing-free process for coating a metal surface, which solves the problems of poor coating quality, long time consumption and much waste water which is not environment-friendly in the prior art, and mainly comprises the following steps: cleaning with mixed liquid, namely using mixed liquid synthesized by organic pickling solution, corrosion inhibitor and cleaning solution to remove rust and prevent corrosion on the surface of a metal workpiece, wherein the formula of the cleaning solution used in the mixed liquid is as follows: 55% of citric acid, 25% of tartaric acid, 15% of sulfonic acid and 5% of EDTA disodium, polishing the metal workpiece, soaking the polished metal workpiece in the mixed solution, activating the soaked metal, activating the activated metal workpiece again, performing silane treatment on the metal workpiece, drying and coating. The invention has the advantages of compact and uniform film layer, strong corrosion resistance, no bubbling and shedding of the coating under the condition of damp and hot, and simultaneously avoids rusty spots generated at the seam welding position.

title_en: Ingot growing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ingot growing apparatus. An ingot growth apparatus of an embodiment of the present invention may include: a growth furnace in which a main crucible that contains molten silicon and rotates the molten silicon in a clockwise direction or a counterclockwise direction by rotating the main crucible in the clockwise direction or the counterclockwise direction is disposed to grow an ingot; a susceptor formed so as to surround an outer surface of the main crucible and rotating in the same direction as the main crucible; and a preliminary melting section for receiving a solid silicon material to melt the silicon material into molten silicon and supplying the molten silicon to the main crucible, wherein a preliminary crucible for accommodating the molten silicon is provided in the preliminary melting section, and the preliminary crucible is configured to supply the molten silicon accommodated in the preliminary crucible to the main crucible in a direction in which the molten silicon accommodated in the main crucible rotates.

title_en: Powder coating machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a powder coat machine, it includes: the feeding device comprises a powder inlet nozzle for conveying coating powder and/or medicinal powder and a spray gun for spraying adhesive; the powder wrapping device comprises a pot body and a material tray for placing powder, wherein a wrapping space is arranged in the pot body, the wrapping space is positioned on the material tray, the material tray is rotationally arranged on the pot body, an air passage is formed between the outer edge of the material tray and the inner wall of the pot body, and the discharge end of the spray gun and the discharge end of the powder inlet nozzle are both positioned in the wrapping space; the air blowing piece comprises a first fan for driving the powder on the material tray to float upwards; the powder sizing device comprises a sizing screen for receiving floating powder and a feeding paddle for conveying powder on the sizing screen outwards, the sizing screen is positioned above the material tray, and the feeding paddle is positioned in the sizing screen and is in rotary connection with the sizing screen; the driving piece is used for driving the material tray and the material feeding paddle to rotate. The application makes the powder material exist singly and can not be adhered to each other after the powder material is coated with the medicine bag.

title_en: Glue spreading device for wafer mounting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gluing device for wafer mounting, which comprises a table top for placing a silicon wafer and a gluing mechanism arranged above the table top, wherein the gluing mechanism comprises a gluing head, a gluing frame body, a transverse screw rod assembly, a longitudinal screw rod assembly and a rotating mechanism for driving the gluing head to rotate, the rotating axis of the gluing head is vertical to the table top, and the rotating mechanism comprises an outer sleeve and an inner sleeve which are connected through a pivot, a first motor which is fixedly arranged on the outer sleeve and is in transmission connection with the inner sleeve, an output shaft which is fixed on the axis of the inner sleeve, a first bearing which is connected between the outer peripheral surface of the inner sleeve and the inner peripheral surface of the outer sleeve and a grating graduator. Utilize the grating gradiometer of installing between interior sleeve pipe and outer tube to realize the accurate control of turned angle between interior sleeve pipe and the outer tube to realize the accurate control of rubber coating head rotation angle, and then guaranteed rubber coated homogeneity, the outer tube is located to motor and output shaft and the shared space of slewing mechanism has been saved to the same one side is effectual, makes whole structure more compact.

title_en: Multilayer co-extrusion transparent high-impact-resistance antistatic polycarbonate composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multilayer co-extrusion transparent high-impact-resistance antistatic polycarbonate composite material and a preparation method thereof. The composite material comprises two surface layers of an outermost layer and a core layer between the two surface layers, wherein the two surface layers are static dissipation layers, and the core layer is a polycarbonate layer; the static dissipative layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 50-95 parts of copolymerized PC resin; 5-40 parts of an antistatic auxiliary agent; the polycarbonate layer is pure polycarbonate or functional polycarbonate. The composite material has good antistatic property, high transparency, high strength and high impact property.

title_en: Preparation method of bamboo-wood fiber heat-insulation composite decorative plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plate production, and particularly discloses a preparation method of a bamboo-wood fiber heat-insulation composite decorative plate, which comprises the following steps: weighing 40-50 parts of PVC resin, 10-20 parts of fir fiber, 5-7 parts of paraffin, 8-12 parts of foaming agent, 6-8 parts of adhesive, 10-12 parts of flame retardant and 3-5 parts of hardener, and performing first comprehensive treatment to obtain a foaming plate; weighing 30-40 parts of phenolic resin, 10-20 parts of bamboo-wood fiber powder, 7-11 parts of calcium powder, 10-14 parts of magnesium chloride, 9-13 parts of industrial salt, 10-12 parts of quicklime and 6-8 parts of leavening agent, and performing secondary comprehensive treatment to obtain a bamboo-wood fiber board; and (4) carrying out hot pressing, cooling and plate cutting on the foaming board and the bamboo-wood fiber board to obtain the bamboo-wood fiber heat-insulation composite decorative board. The bamboo-wood fiber heat-insulation composite decorative board prepared by the method has better product quality and better market competitiveness.

title_en: Preparation method of Zn-Cu-Ti-Mg alloy for thermal spraying
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of Zn-Cu-Ti-Mg alloy for thermal spraying, which is characterized in that a resistance furnace is used for smelting and preparing Zn-10Cu, Zn-3Ti and Zn-5Mg intermediate alloy, an induction smelting furnace is used for smelting and preparing Zn-0.75Cu-0.15Ti- (0.1-0.2) Mg alloy, and an extrusion and 7-pass rolling process is adopted to prepare Zn-0.75Cu-0.15Ti- (0.1-0.2) Mg alloy wire with the diameter of 3 mm. The invention has the advantages that: on one hand, a small amount of Mg element is added into the Zn-Cu-Ti alloy to improve the corrosion resistance of the alloy, and on the other hand, the problem that the Zn-Cu-Ti alloy wire is difficult to industrialize is solved.

title_en: Colored paint automatic spraying production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic colored paint spraying production line which comprises a rail conveying device for conveying square plates, a dust removal cabinet for removing dust from the square plates, an automatic grabbing device for grabbing the square plates, a paint spraying device for spraying paint on the square plates, a drying tunnel furnace conveying device for heating the square plates, a lower piece conveying device for conveying the heated square plates, an air cooling device for cooling the square plates and a control device, wherein the control device is in signal connection with the rail conveying device, the dust removal cabinet, the automatic grabbing device, the paint spraying device, the drying tunnel furnace conveying device, the lower piece conveying device and the air cooling device respectively. The application provides a production line is automatic production line, and reducible personnel flow guarantees the production productivity.

title_en: Electrolyte for realizing high-concentration output of NO, electrolytic cell adopting same and electrolytic method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrolyte for realizing high-concentration output of NO, an electrolytic cell adopting the electrolyte and an electrolysis method, wherein the electrolyte comprises a buffer solution, a nitrogen source and a catalyst, and the catalyst comprises a metal-based complex; the central atom of the metal-based complex is a metal-based atom, and the ligand of the metal-based complex is a nitrogen-containing multi-site ligand. The invention provides an electrolyte for realizing high-concentration output of NO, which can effectively improve the concentration of NO generated by electrolysis by adding a metal-based complex catalyst into the electrolyte, and the generated gas does not contain nitrogen dioxide and other byproducts.

title_en: Automatic galvanizing system and galvanizing process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of galvanization, and discloses an automatic galvanization system and a galvanization process, wherein the automatic galvanization system comprises a galvanization system, a master station and a slave station; the master station comprises a PC, an RS-232 and a ZigBee; the slave station comprises a controller with an AT89S52 singlechip as a core. In the invention, a two-stage control structure is adopted, and an automatic control system for the hot galvanizing process, which comprises 1 master station and 5 slave stations, is designed. The slave station 1 and the slave station 5 are matched with the master station to complete the mechanical control part of the whole galvanizing production line, so that equipment on the whole production line can smoothly complete operation through tacit cooperation; and the slave station 2, the slave station 3 and the slave station 4 realize the monitoring and control of core process parameters in the galvanizing process so as to ensure the product quality and effectively reduce the zinc consumption.

title_en: Organic polymer film surface modification device and modification method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic polymer film surface modification device and a modification method thereof, and the device comprises a base, wherein two first fixing frames which are symmetrically distributed are arranged at the top of the base, winding drums are arranged inside the two first fixing frames, two second fixing frames which are symmetrically distributed are arranged at the top of the base, two rollers which are symmetrically distributed are arranged inside the second fixing frames, a third fixing frame is arranged at one side, close to one of the second fixing frames, of the top of the base, two symmetrical adjusting pieces are arranged inside the third fixing frame, a plurality of movable plates which are uniformly distributed are movably connected to one sides of the two adjusting pieces, and a gluing assembly is arranged at one side, far away from the adjusting pieces, of each movable plate. According to the invention, double-sided modification of the film material can be continuously completed at one time, so that the production efficiency is improved, and the consistency of the modification quality is better due to simultaneous double-sided modification.

title_en: Atomic layer deposition device and atomic layer deposition method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and particularly relates to an atomic layer deposition device and an atomic layer deposition method. The atomic layer deposition device comprises a reaction chamber, a wafer carrier and a plurality of nozzles, wherein the wafer carrier is arranged in the reaction chamber and is used for carrying a plurality of wafers in the same plane, and the nozzles are arranged on the side wall or the top wall of the reaction chamber above the wafer carrier and are used for introducing a first precursor, a second precursor and a purifying gas into the reaction chamber. According to the atomic layer deposition device, atomic layers can be formed on the surfaces of a plurality of wafers at the same time, so that the wafer production efficiency is improved, the uniformity of the deposition thickness and range of the atomic layers is ensured, and the wafer quality is improved.

title_en: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automatic system and hydrogen production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis, and discloses an automatic system for water electrolysis of a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane and a hydrogen production method. The system comprises an electrolytic cell, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, wherein oxygen generated by the electrolytic cell is discharged outside after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is firstly subjected to secondary treatment by a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, and then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then output to form a differential pressure type system at two sides of hydrogen and oxygen; but the raw materials water tank automatic feed in the moisturizing unit, and the start-stop of circulating pump and electrolysis trough in the moisturizing unit receives the liquid level control in the raw materials water tank, has realized full automatization feeding, circulation and electrolysis control, has improved the intelligent degree of brineelectrolysis hydrogen manufacturing greatly, has reduced the risk of artificial regulation and control, reaches the miniaturized effect of hydrogen manufacturing equipment simultaneously.

title_en: Laminate body
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laminate. A laminate comprising an electrode for electrolysis and a separator or a power supply body in contact with the electrode for electrolysis, wherein the separator or the power supply body has a force applied per unit mass/unit area of the electrode for electrolysis of less than 1.5N/mg/cm  2 .

title_en: Laminated glazing
abstract_en: A laminated glazing pane is described comprising first and second sheets of glazing material joined by an interlayer structure comprising at least a sheet of adhesive interlayer material. Each glazing material has respective first and second major surfaces, and the laminated glazing is arranged such that the second major surface of the first sheet of glazing material faces the first major surface of the second sheet of glazing material. The lighting device is arranged to emit light towards the second main surface of the first sheet of glazing material relative to the first sheet of glazing material. The first and/or second major surface of the first sheet of glazing material has an array of dots thereon for diffusely reflecting light emitted by the lighting device, the light being transmitted through the first sheet of glazing material and out the first major surface thereof.

title_en: Waterproof and heat-preservation integrated modified asphalt coiled material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof and heat-insulation integrated modified asphalt coiled material and a preparation method thereof. Through being provided with first isolation layer, high temperature resistant ceramic coating, basalt fiber layer, first modified asphalt layer, child basic unit, the modified asphalt layer of second, high temperature resistant ceramic fiber layer and second isolation layer, thereby not only can promote waterproofing membrane's heat resistance, thermal insulation performance, corrosion resisting property, mechanical strength and compressive strength, but also can promote waterproofing membrane's oxidation resistance, radioresistance, thermal insulation and sound insulation performance, wear resistance and pliability, and then can prolong waterproofing membrane's life effectively, satisfy in people's user demand better.

title_en: Processing device and epitaxial reactor with storage chamber
abstract_en: A processing device (900) for an epitaxial reactor (1000) comprises: a reaction chamber (100) for processing a substrate; a transfer chamber (200) adjacent to the reaction chamber (100) for transferring a substrate placed on the substrate supporting apparatus; a load/unload group (300) at least partially adjacent the transfer chamber (200) arranged to accommodate a substrate support apparatus having one or more substrates; a load/unload chamber (400) at least partially adjacent to the load/unload group (300) and having a first storage area (410) for processed and/or unprocessed substrates and a second storage area (420) for substrate support apparatus devoid of any substrates; at least one external robot (500) for transferring processed substrates, unprocessed substrates and substrate supporting devices without any substrates between the load/unload chamber (400) and the load/unload group (300); at least one internal robot (600) for transferring a substrate support device having one or more substrates between the loading/unloading group (300) and the reaction chamber (100) via the transfer chamber (200); wherein the external robot (500) comprises an articulated arm (510) arranged to manipulate both processed and unprocessed substrates and a substrate support apparatus.

title_en: Vehicle seat comprising fibrous composite material and expanded thermoplastic
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seat for a vehicle, preferably for a land, waterway and/or aircraft vehicle, comprising at least one multi-layer structural component (1) comprising at least one first composite layer (6) and at least one second composite layer (5) each containing fibres embedded in a thermoplastic, and a layer (7) made of at least one foamed thermoplastic arranged therebetween; to a method of manufacturing the same, comprising at least the steps of (a) providing at least one first composite layer and at least one second composite layer, which in each case contain fibers embedded in a thermoplastic, (B) thermoforming the first composite layer to form a lower seat shell, (C) thermoforming the second composite layer to form an upper seat shell, (D) arranging the lower seat shell and the upper seat shell in a tool to form a gap between the two seat shells, (E) introducing foamed particles made of thermoplastic into the gap, and (F) compacting the two seat shells and the foamed particles to obtain the seat; and to the use of said seat in a vehicle, preferably in a land, waterway and/or aviation vehicle.

title_en: Laminating device for PVC floor production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laminating device for PVC floor production, which belongs to the technical field of laminating equipment and comprises a laminating seat, a first clamping block, a second clamping block, a pushing plate, a placing space, a translation unit, a lifting plate, a lifting unit, a buffer unit and a laminated plate. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: through the removal of push pedal, and then support tightly placing the PVC floor in placing the space for the PVC floor receives first fixture block, second fixture block and push pedal support tightly spacingly jointly, and then make the PVC floor be in spacing state in the lamination in-process, guarantee lamination precision and reduce the lamination dead angle, through setting up translation unit to by the lifter plate and move down, make first rack and second gear engagement, the meshing transmission in-process drives the pivot and rotates, make first gear and second rack engagement, and then drive the direction removal of push pedal towards first fixture block, with make the push pedal support tightly the PVC floor, need not the manual mode to press from both sides tightly, easy and simple to handle.

title_en: Diamond-like thick film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surface engineering, in particular to a preparation method of a diamond-like thick film. The preparation method of the diamond-like thick film comprises the steps of firstly removing pollutants and an oxidation layer on the surface of a substrate by ultrasonic cleaning and gas ion beam cleaning, then depositing a transition layer on the substrate by using a plasma-assisted magnetron sputtering deposition mode, etching a microstructure on the transition layer by using ultrafast laser, and finally depositing a DLC film layer on the microstructure by using an ultrafast laser cathode arc deposition mode, so that the high-efficiency preparation of the DLC wear-resistant lubricating coating with high quality, excellent performance and large thickness is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of self-supporting electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a self-supporting electrode, which comprises the following steps: s10, dissolving metal salt in deionized water to obtain a solution A, and dissolving phosphorus-containing salt and tungsten-containing salt in the solution A to obtain a mixed salt solution, wherein the metal salt comprises at least one of nickel salt, iron salt, cobalt salt and manganese salt; s20, placing a metal substrate in a mixed salt solution, and introducing oxygen-containing gas into the mixed salt solution for reaction to obtain an electrode precursor; and S30, performing heat treatment on the electrode precursor to obtain the self-supporting electrode. According to the invention, through in-situ growth of phosphorus and tungsten co-doped layered metal hydroxide on the metal substrate and a heat treatment step, the prepared self-supporting electrode has OER and HER double-catalysis functions, has excellent catalytic activity and stability, and can be widely applied to the fields of electrocatalytic hydrogen precipitation, oxygen precipitation and full water decomposition; the preparation method is simple and controllable in operation, low in cost, good in reproducibility and easy for industrial production.

title_en: Processing technology of high-strength and high-toughness automobile flexible gauge aluminum alloy section bar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of aluminum alloy section flexible inspection tools, in particular to a processing technology of a high-strength and high-toughness automobile flexible inspection tool aluminum alloy section. According to the invention, the water guide plate, the water collecting frame and the filter screen are arranged, the water above the water guide plate is driven by the rotation of the bristles, the water is scattered above the water guide plate, the cleaned sewage is guided into the water collecting frame through the water guide plate, the inclined filter screen carries out hierarchical filtration on the sewage, the filtration effect of the filter screen is improved, meanwhile, the inclined filter screen can avoid the blocking of the filter holes, the collection and filtration of the water are realized, the water can be reused, and the loss of water resources is reduced.

title_en: Vanadium-tungsten alloy target material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vanadium-tungsten alloy target material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the vanadium-tungsten alloy target material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: more than or equal to 60 percent of tungsten and the balance of vanadium; the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing vanadium powder and tungsten powder according to the formula amount, and performing ball milling to obtain mixed powder; (2) carrying out vacuum hot-pressing sintering treatment on the mixed powder obtained in the step (1) at the sintering temperature of 1300-; (3) machining the vanadium-tungsten alloy target blank obtained in the step (2) to obtain a vanadium-tungsten alloy target; and (3) performing vacuum hot-pressing sintering treatment in the step (2) by sequentially performing first heat preservation treatment, second heat preservation treatment and heat preservation and pressure preservation treatment. According to the invention, the internal organization structure of the target is improved by optimizing the sintering process, the purity and the density of the target are improved, and the sputtering stability and the coating quality are further improved.

title_en: Cu/Ti-W/ceramic composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Cu/Ti-W/ceramic composite material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of initiating explosive devices. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the ceramic substrate is subjected to ion bombardment, so that the activity of the surface of the ceramic substrate can be effectively improved, and the combination of the metal thin film layer is facilitated; then, the bombarded ceramic substrate is plated with a Ti-W transition layer in advance through one-time magnetron sputtering, so that the bonding force between the metal exploding foil, namely the pure copper layer, and the ceramic substrate can be effectively improved. The experimental result shows that the film-substrate binding force is tested by a multi-time grid-marking method, the cut edge of the Cu/Ti-W/ceramic composite material is completely smooth, and the grid edge does not have any phenomena of peeling, curling and the like; the thin film does not fall off after being adhered for 10 times by the 3M adhesive tape, the binding force of the thin film meets the requirement of preparing the explosive foil by a subsequent photoetching process, the thin film can be normally used under the severe condition, and the binding force of the explosive foil and ceramics is greatly improved.

title_en: Nickel-iron bimetallic coordination polymer catalyst for water electrolysis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-iron bimetallic coordination polymer catalyst for water electrolysis and a preparation method thereof. The chemical composition formula of the catalyst is Ni  x  Fe  1‑x  (L  ‑  )  y  Wherein 0 is<x<1，0<y is less than or equal to 1. The preparation method of the invention comprises the following steps: the ferronickel bimetal coordination polymer catalyst is prepared by taking a solution containing iron ions, nickel ions, nitrate ions and a rigid aromatic polycarboxylic acid ligand as a working electrolyte, adopting a three-electrode system to carry out electrochemical deposition, washing a working electrode obtained by the electrochemical deposition, and oxidizing and drying; it still maintains high catalytic activity after multiple CV cycles; meanwhile, the effect of constant current electrolysis of water also shows that the catalyst obtained by the invention has extremely high catalytic stability and catalytic activity.

title_en: PE pipe and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PE pipe and an installation method thereof, relates to the technical field of PE pipes, and solves the problems that the existing PE pipe is easy to wear and bend when being subjected to external force in the application process, so that the medium is leaked, only the PE pipe is laid when grooving is carried out on the surface of a building, the waste is caused, and the like. The utility model provides a PE pipe and installation method thereof, includes inlayer pipe mechanism, coupling mechanism is installed in the outside of inlayer pipe mechanism, coupling mechanism's outside fixed mounting has outer pipe mechanism, outer pipe mechanism includes first wearing layer, the wear-resisting strip of spiral, first supporting layer, spiral support bar, first fire-retardant layer, first heat insulation layer, first antibiotic layer and weaves the supporting network, the outside fixed mounting of first wearing layer has the wear-resisting strip of spiral. The PE pipe is protected in multiple ways, so that the PE pipe can meet the use requirements of different environments and different media, and meanwhile, the cable can be installed, the installation requirement is convenient to reduce, and the utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Membrane-free method water electrolysis hydrogen production-reductive wastewater degradation coupling device and process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy preparation and environmental purification, and particularly relates to a coupling device and a coupling process for hydrogen production by water electrolysis in a membrane-free method and reductive wastewater degradation. The invention utilizes Ni (OH) 2 The reversible redox reaction of the buffer medium separates the hydrogen evolution reaction of the cathode and the oxidation reaction of the reducing substance of the anode in time and space, so that high-purity hydrogen can be obtained, and the hydrogen production and the synergistic treatment of the reducing wastewater are realized. Multiple buffer electrodesAnd when the hydrogen production device is used, the charge storage capacity of the buffer medium can be greatly increased, and the continuous hydrogen production time and the hydrogen production quantity are improved. The buffer medium in high valence state can react with the reductive wastewater under the condition of no power supply, so that the wastewater is oxidized and degraded, and the buffer medium is reduced and restored to the initial state, thereby providing enough buffer capacity for the second round of hydrogen production reaction. The invention has the characteristics of high efficiency, low energy consumption, low cost and simple process, and avoids the use of the traditional expensive diaphragm.

title_en: Manufacturing method of die-cut piece containing acetate cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a die-cut piece containing acetate cloth, wherein the acetate cloth (3) comprises well-shaped knitting lines which are arranged horizontally and vertically, and the manufacturing method is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) attaching a first-stage material belt; (2) a die cutting waste; (3) cutting and discharging waste by a double die: carrying out secondary punching die cutting on the secondary material belt in a secondary punching die cutting machine, discharging secondary waste materials to form a finished product containing acetate cloth die cutting pieces, wherein a cutter line b matched with a secondary punching die cutting pattern is arranged on the secondary punching die cutting machine, the cutter line b comprises a cutter line b  3  which forms an included angle of 30-60 degrees with the running direction of the material belt, and the cutter line b  3  is positioned on one side of waste discharge firstly; and (4) rolling the die-cut piece product. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of no formation of fuzzing on the product, low product reject ratio and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing high-speed copper-clad plate by using bismaleimide modified hydrocarbon resin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of high-frequency copper-clad plates, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a high-speed copper-clad plate from bismaleimide modified hydrocarbon resin. Mixing 1,2-polybutadiene resin with a mixture of 4,4' -bismaleimide diphenylmethane and dimethylformamide to prepare a prepolymer; mixing calcium carbonate and montmorillonite to prepare inorganic filler powder; mixing azodiisobutyronitrile with the prepolymer, and then adding inorganic filler powder for dissolving to prepare a glue solution; spraying the glue solution on a base material, sintering, curing and cutting to obtain a prepreg; and (3) covering copper foils on two sides of the prepreg after laminating, cooling and taking out to prepare the high-speed copper-clad plate. The method for preparing the high-speed copper-clad plate by using the bismaleimide modified hydrocarbon resin has the advantages that the dielectric property of the modified hydrocarbon resin is not greatly influenced, dk is less than 3.5, df is less than 0.0025, the heat resistance of the substrate material is improved, and the Tg is more than or equal to 250 ℃.

title_en: Cabin pipeline using super heat insulation material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cabin pipeline using super heat insulation materials and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of marine oil and gas pipelines. The cabin pipeline using the super heat insulation material has strong impact resistance, long service life and excellent mechanical property and heat insulation property. The conductive inner pipe is adopted, so that the liquefied natural gas in the pipeline has excellent corrosion resistance, and compared with a conventional steel pipe, the quality of the pipe is obviously reduced, so that the cost of carrying and installing is saved, and the efficiency is improved; the protective layer formed by the anti-corrosion coating and the resin sealing layer can prevent the conductive inner tube from being directly exposed to the environment due to long-time infiltration of seawater or accidental damage of the outer layer, avoid electrochemical corrosion and further improve corrosion resistance.

title_en: Plasma nano polishing solution and polishing method of cast aluminum alloy workpiece
abstract_en: The invention provides a plasma nano polishing solution and a polishing method of a cast aluminum alloy workpiece. The plasma nano-polishing solution comprises solvent water, and further comprises 3-5% of methyl acetate, 1-2% of sodium nitrite and 0.1-0.3% of negative ion polyacrylamide in percentage by mass. The components of the plasma nano polishing solution provided by the invention can conveniently and quickly finish polishing of the metal workpiece without changing the natural color of the metal on the surface of the metal workpiece, and improve the surface glossiness of the metal workpiece. Meanwhile, the plasma nano polishing solution is used for polishing the cast aluminum alloy workpiece, and the polishing parameters in the polishing process are set, so that the surface roughness of the cast aluminum alloy workpiece can be efficiently reduced, and the original metal color of the cast aluminum alloy workpiece can be reserved.

title_en: Method for electrocatalytic synthesis of alkyl borate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing an alkyl borate compound based on electrocatalysis, and belongs to the field of compound preparation. The method takes aryl alkene compound and pinacol borane as raw materials, and under the action of rated current, the raw materials react in the presence of electrolyte and N, N-diisopropylethylamine to selectively obtain two alkyl boric acid esters shown in structural formulas I and II respectively. The invention takes low-cost and easily available electricity as energy for the first time, and provides a new scheme for preparing alkyl borate by using acetonitrile solvent under the assistance of N, N-diisopropylethylamine by utilizing the characteristics that acetonitrile solvent can be electrolyzed with high efficiency and hydrogen protons are released.

title_en: Method for reducing iron content in electrolytic aluminum liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing the iron content in electrolytic aluminum liquid, which comprises the steps of automatically batching raw materials according to the iron content, ensuring that the iron element in the raw materials does not exceed the control standard, and reducing the labor intensity; a three-high three-low production process system with high lithium salt content, high polar distance, high aluminum level, low electrolyte temperature, low electrolyte level and low alumina concentration is established, the convection stirring effect of the melt is weakened, the thickness of the diffusion layer is promoted to be increased, the stability of the electrolytic cell is improved, the probability of melting of an anode steel claw and generation of iron by iron ion discharge is reduced, and the quality of the aluminum liquid is improved; cleaning residual electrode electrolyte, separating fine powder in the broken carbon block, and reducing the content of impurities in the recovered carbon block; the material feeding and recycling process of the 'second-stage crushing and third-stage iron removal' comprises the steps of secondary crushing and third-stage iron removal, wherein the particle size of the anode covering material is less than or equal to 5mm, and the iron removal strength is enhanced. According to the invention, through related technological innovation, the influence of raw materials on the product quality is reduced, the stability of the electrolysis process is improved, the anode scrap and impurities brought by cyclic utilization of the anode materials are reduced, and the continuous and stable production of high-quality low-iron aluminum products is realized.

title_en: Food-grade air-resistance light-transmitting multilayer film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a food-grade air-resistance light-transmitting multilayer film and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the food-grade air-resistance light-transmitting multilayer film comprises a copolyester inner layer, a PET/MXD6 blending core layer and a glass fiber reinforced outer layer. The raw materials of the copolyester inner layer comprise: the modified copolyester slice, the deoxidizer, the optical opening master batch and the crystallization nucleating agent are obtained by copolymerizing terephthalic acid, ethylene glycol and a third monomer; the PET/MXD6 blend core layer comprises the following raw materials: PET, MXD6, an oxygen scavenger and a compatilizer; the raw materials of the glass fiber reinforced outer layer comprise: PET, MXD6, superfine glass fiber and a toughening agent; the deoxidizer is a combination of an oxidizable polyether matrix and a cobalt salt catalyst. The invention further uses the high-efficiency deoxidizer on the basis of selecting polymer materials such as PET, MXD6 and the like with good air resistance, so that the product has good light transmittance, heat resistance and mechanical property, and simultaneously has ultrahigh air resistance, and can be applied to packaging in the fields of food, medicine, medical appliances and the like.

title_en: Organometallic precursor compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to organometallic precursor compounds. The specification provides an organic group 4 metal precursor compound and a method for forming a thin film using the organic group 4 metal precursor compound.

title_en: Spin coater and spin coating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a spin coater and a spin coating method, which can inhibit bubbles from mixing in a formed coating layer. A spin coater (1) for applying a liquid onto a substrate to form a coating layer on the substrate with the liquid, the spin coater comprising: a rotating table (30) including a holding surface (31) that rotatably holds the substrate; a liquid supply nozzle (50) having an ejection port (51) that ejects liquid onto the substrate held by the rotating table (30); and a swing motor (60) which moves the liquid supply nozzle (50) between a position where the ejection port (51) faces the substrate held by the rotary table (30) and a position where the ejection port (51) is located outside the substrate held by the rotary table (30), and performs the ejection start and the ejection stop of the liquid in a state where the ejection port (51) is located outside the substrate held by the rotary table (30).

title_en: Halogen-free flame-retardant resin composition, prepreg prepared from same and laminated board for printed circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a halogen-free flame-retardant resin composition and a prepreg and a printed circuit laminated board prepared from the same, wherein the halogen-free flame-retardant resin composition comprises the following components in parts by weight: (A) 1-30 parts of epoxy resin; (B) 1-35 parts by weight of a hydroxyl-containing polyphosphonate and/or a hydroxyl-containing polyphosphonate-carbonate copolymer; (C) 30-100 parts by weight of maleimide compound; (D) 0.5-300 parts by weight of filler, wherein D10 is 0.9-1.5 μm, median particle diameter D50 is 1.8-3.5 μm, and maximum particle diameter D100 is 5-10 μm. The resin composition disclosed by the invention has high Tg and high heat resistance, and simultaneously effectively improves the dielectric property; and the prepreg and the laminated board for the printed circuit have excellent performance and excellent dimensional stability.

title_en: Calendering roller for manufacturing skin-feel leather and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calendering roller for manufacturing skin-feel leather as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of leather manufacturing. The surface of the calendering roller blank is preheated, so that the powder with the micro-nano dual-scale structure passing through the cylindrical flow nozzle is accelerated and heated, when the powder collides with the surface of the heated calendering roller blank, kinetic energy of the powder is converted into internal energy, and then the contact surface of the powder with the micro-nano dual-scale structure and the roller blank is melted and welded on the surface of the calendering roller blank. When a large amount of powder is welded on the surface of the roller blank, a micro-nano structure coating is formed on the surface of the roller blank. The leather surface prepared by the coating forms a structure with micro-nano two-dimensional scale, and the skin touch feeling of the leather is optimized.

title_en: Copper monoatomic loaded titanium dioxide nanosheet, preparation method, application and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper monoatomic load titanium dioxide nanosheet, a preparation method, application and a method. Firstly preparing titanium dioxide nano-sheets, then dispersing the titanium dioxide nano-sheets in deionized water, stirring and adding (NH)  4  )  2  CO  3  Solution and CuCl  2  ·2H  2  And (3) placing the mixed solution in a low-temperature constant-temperature bath, irradiating with 365nm ultraviolet light, centrifugally separating, and drying at normal temperature to obtain the copper monoatomic load titanium dioxide nanosheets. Cu SAs/TiO prepared by the invention  2  The nano-sheet has a single-atom structure, has good catalytic stability and definite active center, and is helpful for further deep research on the catalytic mechanism. Cu SAs/TiO prepared by the invention  2  When the nanosheets are used for synthesizing ammonia by photoenhanced electrocatalytic nitrogen reduction, under the condition of introducing optical fields, the photoelectrochemistry enhances the electron conduction capacity of the catalyst, and the synergistic organic combination of the single atomic-level catalyst and the optical field effect is beneficial to the electrocatalytic nitrogen reduction process.

title_en: Automatic testing method for proportional valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic testing method of a proportional valve, which comprises the following steps: a. placing the tested valve on the tool fixing block; b. the air inlet pressure tapping pipe and the air outlet pressure tapping pipe on the two sides of the automatic positioning device are connected to a test air path and are compressed and sealed with the interface of the valve to be tested; c. a first air cylinder of a probe and a first air cylinder of the probe on the automatic positioning device are respectively connected to a control switch of the valve to be tested, and the probe is moved to displace the first air cylinder to block a small air port on the valve to be tested; d. test gas is introduced, the automatic pressure regulating device automatically controls the pressure regulating valve to regulate pressure through a set pressure value, if pressure fluctuates in the test process, the automatic pressure regulating device regulates pressure in real time through rotation of a third motor below the automatic pressure regulating device, and stability of the test pressure is guaranteed; e. the second motor on the automatic regulating device rotates the sliding block on the electric cylinder and moves the chuck to the appointed position, the screw rod on the valve to be tested is clamped, in the test process, the chuck rotates the driving gear and the first gear through the first motor, and the chuck rotates the regulating screw rod.

title_en: Luminescent crystals and their manufacture
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of Luminescent Crystals (LC), and more specifically to formula A 1   a M 2   b X c The Quantum Dot (QD) of (1), wherein the substituents are as defined in the specification. The invention provides a method for producing such luminescent crystals, in particular by dispersing suitable starting materials in the presence of a liquid and with the aid of milling balls; to compositions comprising luminescent crystals and to electronic devices, decorative coatings; and to assemblies comprising luminescent crystals.

title_en: Method for prolonging service life of high-temperature alloy through prefabricated oxide film
