abstract_en: The invention provides a method for prolonging service life of a superalloy through a prefabricated oxide film, which comprises the following steps: preparing a first metal film on the surface of the high-temperature alloy, oxidizing the first metal film, and converting the first metal film into a first porous oxide film; after the superalloy is in service, the surface of the superalloy is provided with an oxide film with coarse columnar crystals; preparing a second metal film on the surface of the oxide film of the coarse columnar crystal, oxidizing the second metal film, and converting the second metal film into a second porous oxide film. According to the invention, the protective and porous oxide film is prepared on the surface of the alloy and the surface of the coarse columnar crystal oxide, so that the purposes of improving the oxidation resistance of the high-temperature alloy and blocking the epitaxial growth of the coarse columnar crystal are realized, and the service life of the high-temperature alloy can be further prolonged.

title_en: Sandwich structure and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a sandwich structure having both excellent heat dissipation and excellent mechanical properties. In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a sandwich structure having the following constitution. Specifically, a sandwich structure comprising a core material (I) and fiber-reinforced materials (II) disposed on both sides of the core material (I), wherein at least one of the fiber-reinforced materials (II) comprises a sheet-like heat-conductive material (III) having an in-plane thermal conductivity of 300W/mK or more.

title_en: Radiation-proof multi-gradient antiknock composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radiation-proof multi-gradient antiknock composite material which sequentially comprises an aramid fiber-epoxy resin layer, a polydopamine coated particle layer, a type I porous foam aluminum layer, a polyurea coating layer, a type II porous foam aluminum layer and an STF-aramid fiber composite material layer from top to bottom. The composite material can resist external strong impact force while resisting radiation, absorb energy and reduce peak value.

title_en: Aluminum-based alloy-plated steel sheet having excellent workability and corrosion resistance, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aluminum-based alloy-plated steel sheet having excellent workability and corrosion resistance and a method for manufacturing the same, and more particularly, to an aluminum-alloy-plated steel sheet having excellent adhesion and corrosion resistance while suppressing the occurrence of microcracks generated during hot forming and a method for manufacturing the same.

title_en: Chemical treatment, deposition and/or infiltration apparatus and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a chemical deposition, treatment and/or infiltration apparatus for providing a chemical reaction on and/or in a surface of a substrate. The apparatus may have: a top reaction chamber portion and a bottom reaction chamber portion together forming a closable reaction chamber; and an actuator constructed and arranged for moving the top reaction chamber portion and the bottom reaction chamber portion relative to each other from a closed position to an open position so as to allow access to the interior of the reaction chamber. A top substrate holder is connected to the top reaction chamber portion to hold a substrate at least when the reaction chamber is in an open position, and a bottom substrate holder is connected to the bottom reaction chamber portion to hold the substrate when the reaction chamber is in a closed position.

title_en: Cluster well casing pulse current cathodic protection remote monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oilfield casing cathodic protection, and particularly relates to a cluster well casing pulse current cathodic protection remote monitoring system and method. The monitoring system at least comprises an oil-water well casing, a control terminal unit, a reference electrode potential measuring unit, a deep anode well, a shunt unit, a pulse current monitoring unit and a remote monitoring unit. The remote monitoring system realizes remote adjustment of the pulse current value according to the cathode protection potential requirement value by detecting the cathode protection potential value of the field cluster well group sleeve and outputting the electric parameter by the pulse current output control unit, so as to reach the cathode protection potential value required by the cluster well group sleeve. The adoption of the technical scheme of the invention ensures that the distribution of the protection points is more uniform, the total current demand is lower, the protection depth is deeper, the consumption of anode materials is lower, and the development demands of oil fields are realized and met.

title_en: Wood floor back paint production process and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of floor production, and discloses a production process of wood floor back paint, which mainly comprises the following steps of firstly polishing the back surface of the whole floor base material for roughening treatment, firstly polishing the back surface of the floor base material by using a steel wire brush during roughening treatment, brushing loose wood on the back surface of the floor base material, exposing the texture of the wood plate, realizing roughening treatment on the floor base material, then polishing the back surface of the floor base material by using coarse abrasive paper, and cleaning up scraps and burrs to prepare a construction surface. The production process and the device of the wood floor back paint can manufacture the moisture-proof layer on the substrate at the back of the floor, and harden the moisture-proof layer, so that the moisture-proof layer can not be damaged and fall off, and the waterproof and moistureproof performances at the back of the floor are further improved.

title_en: Implanted wireless nerve sensor for recording brain electrical signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an implanted wireless nerve sensor for recording brain electrical signals, belonging to the fields of medical appliances, nerve biological materials and micro-electronic micromachining. The invention comprises a flexible chessboard-format brain electrode, an outer lead, a connector, a wireless signal amplifier and a battery. The flexible chessboard-type brain electrode is a double-sided electrode and comprises a first flexible substrate layer, a first metal layer, a first flexible insulating layer, a second flexible substrate layer, a second metal layer and a second flexible insulating layer. The surface of the metal site is not provided with a flexible insulating layer, the metal connecting wire extends out from the side surface and is led out from the metal site in a bundle; the flexible substrate layer and the flexible insulating layer are both selected from biocompatible materials. The flexible chessboard-formatted electroencephalogram electrode is prepared by adopting a flexible micro-nano processing method, and polyethylene glycol packaging is adopted for assisting implantation. The invention has the advantages of small electrode size, multiple sites, easy implantation and small damage to brain tissues.

title_en: Protective coating for optical module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical module air tightness, in particular to a protective coating for an optical module and a preparation method thereof, wherein the protective coating comprises at least one of the following coatings formed on the surface of an optical module assembly: SiMO  x  A gas barrier layer, a chemical protective layer and a water vapor barrier layer; wherein M is any one of Al, Ti, Nb, Ta and P, and x is more than or equal to 1.5 and less than or equal to 2.0; SiMO  x  The gas barrier layer, the chemical protection layer and the water vapor barrier layer are all manufactured by adopting the chemical vapor deposition technologyAnd (4) preparing. The protective coating is prepared by adopting a chemical vapor deposition technology, is more environment-friendly than a liquid-phase-method three-proofing coating method, and has strong controllability of the structure and components of the coating and high selectivity of monomers; the optical component is coated in a low-pressure and near-room-temperature environment, so that the air tightness of the optical component and the protection capability of chemicals are effectively improved under the condition of not influencing the reliability of a product; in addition, the protective coating has the advantages of simple preparation process, continuous film coating, easily obtained raw materials, low cost and the like.

title_en: Two-dimensional monocrystalline ferroferric oxide nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-dimensional monocrystalline ferroferric oxide nano material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the steps are as follows: (1) Horizontally placing a growth substrate in a high-temperature tube furnace, and mixing an iron source with a molecular sieve below the growth substrate; (2) Under the conditions of a certain pressure and carrier gas, heating the tube furnace and maintaining a certain temperature, then introducing oxygen and maintaining for a certain time, and enabling an iron source volatilized to the surface of the substrate to react with the oxygen source to grow so as to obtain the two-dimensional monocrystal ferroferric oxide nano-sheet. The preparation method has the advantages of simplicity, short time consumption, batch preparation, uniform and controllable thickness dimension and the like. The sample is determined to be a high-quality two-dimensional ferroferric oxide nano-sheet by data such as an optical microscope, a Raman spectrum characterization, a scanning electron microscope, an atomic force microscope and the like.

title_en: Automatic glue supply system for silicon steel sheet stamping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic glue supply system for a silicon steel sheet stamping device, which comprises a plunger pressure plate pump, a pressure reducing valve, a heat preservation feeding pipeline, a glue barrel and a glue dispensing module, wherein the glue barrel is connected with the plunger pressure plate pump, glue liquid in the glue barrel is sent into the pressure reducing valve by the plunger pressure plate pump, the pressure reducing valve is communicated with the glue dispensing module, the glue liquid is conveyed to the glue dispensing module by the pressure reducing valve, the heat preservation feeding pipeline is communicated and arranged between the plunger pressure plate pump and the pressure reducing valve as well as between the pressure reducing valve and the glue dispensing module, and the plunger pressure plate pump comprises a cylinder assembly, a lower pump body, a glue barrel pressure plate, a glue barrel positioning jig and a movable support. The invention belongs to the technical field of glue supply systems, and particularly provides a method for keeping a feeding signal of a glue supply system synchronous with stamping so as to ensure the accuracy of a glue discharging time point; the heat-preservation feeding pipeline keeps a positive pressure state to ensure the sufficiency of feeding; the two-stage pressure reducing valve can ensure the stability of the pressure of the glue solution, so that the glue dispensing module can keep a high-precision automatic glue supply system for the silicon steel sheet stamping device.

title_en: Method for preparing L-xylose by isomerism method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological sugar, and relates to a method for preparing L-xylose by an isomerism method, which comprises the following steps: s1: taking L-arabinose, ammonium molybdate and acetic acid, adding water to dissolve and react to be neutral; s2: decoloring, filtering and concentrating; s3: separating by an ion exchange column; s4: crystallizing and filtering the collected liquid; s5: obtaining a set amount of crystals by a quantifying device; s6: drying the crystals by adopting a sectional type crystal suspension drying method; according to the invention, L-arabinose is taken as a raw material, a target product is obtained by screening a large amount of heterogeneous auxiliary materials and using a novel isomerism method of adding acetic acid into amine molybdate, the product obtained after isomerism is very simple and convenient to post-treat and easy to obtain, in addition, the crystals are subjected to final drying by adopting sectional suspension drying, and a large gap exists between each crystal in the suspension drying process, so that the water of the crystals can be quickly dried, and therefore, the crystals are quickly dried and the required heat energy is small.

title_en: Cooling method for hot galvanizing aluminum magnesium product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling method of a hot galvanizing aluminum magnesium product, which comprises the following steps: s1, naturally cooling; s2, placing the strip steel in a movable cooling bellows, and cooling at a set cooling rate to completely solidify an alloy coating on the surface of the strip steel; s3, forced cooling. According to the cooling method for the hot dip galvanized aluminum magnesium product, through different cooling rate control modes, different types of phase change rates are controlled to occur at different stages in the hot dip galvanized surface solidification process of the hot dip galvanized aluminum magnesium (Zn-Al-Mg) ternary alloy coating product, the volume change amount in the Zn-Al-Mg ternary eutectic precipitation process is reduced, and the stripe defects generated in the surface solidification shrinkage process are controlled.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified copper hydroxide material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a modified copper hydroxide material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing Cu (OH)  2  Dispersed in a solvent containing isopropyl alcohol (C) 2 Adding Nafion (perfluorosulfonic acid) into a mixed solution of PrOH, Tetrahydrofuran (THF) and multi-wall Carbon Nanotubes (CNTs) for physical mixing to obtain the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH)  2  @ Nafion). Using the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH)  2  @ Nafion) for catalyzing CO in a fluidized electrolytic cell  2  The reduction reaction shows higher multi-carbon product selectivity (the faradaic efficiency of ethylene reaches 44 percent) and better catalytic stability (the stable running time is up to 8000 s), and solves the problem of hydrophilicityThe copper hydroxide material can not be well utilized in the flowing electrolytic bath.

title_en: Full-automatic electroplating gripping device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic electroplating gripping device and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of electroplating tools.

title_en: Propeller device in cathode protection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a propeller arrangement for use in a cathodic protection system of a marine vessel (100) having a marine propulsion system, the cathodic protection system comprising a direct current power supply (110; 210) having a positive terminal (111; 211). The propulsion system includes: at least one drive train housing (101; 201) at least partially submerged in water; a torque transfer drive shaft (106; 232, 233) extending out of the driveline housing (101; 201); and at least one propeller (102, 103;202, 203) mounted on the drive shaft (106, 232, 233). According to the invention, the at least one propeller (102, 103;202, 203) is electrically insulated from its drive shaft (106; 232, 233). Each electrically insulated propeller (102, 103;202, 203) is electrically connected to a slip ring connector (313 a, 313 b), which slip ring connector (313 a, 313 b) is electrically connected to the positive terminal (111; 211). The invention also relates to a vessel provided with such a propeller arrangement.

title_en: Automatic processing device for solid lithium battery pole piece
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manufacturing and processing of solid lithium battery pole pieces, in particular to an automatic processing device of a solid lithium battery pole piece, which comprises a processing base, a vertical plate, a coating mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein in the coating mechanism designed by the invention, when copper foil passes through a smoothing roller, the tensioning spring rod is mutually matched with the smoothing roller through the fixed block to drive the copper foil to be in a tensioned state, the smoothing roller can drive the copper foil to be unfolded, meanwhile, the smoothing roller is driven to rotate in the moving process of the copper foil, so that the copper foil is driven to unfold in the rotation process of the smoothing roller, the uneven position on the surface of the copper foil can be smoothed, the smoothness of the surface of the copper foil is improved, the slurry is more uniformly distributed on the surface of the copper foil, the problems of poor contact, battery pole piece failure and the like of the subsequent battery pole piece in the battery conducting process are reduced, and the conductivity of the battery pole piece is improved.

title_en: Hydraulic cylinder piston rod nut tightening device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic cylinder piston rod nut screwing device which comprises a rack, a working platform arranged on the rack, a clamping mechanism, a glue dispensing mechanism and a screwing mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism, the glue dispensing mechanism and the screwing mechanism are arranged on the working platform; the tightening mechanism is arranged on the side of the tail end of the clamping mechanism, and the glue dispensing mechanism is arranged right above the tail portion of the clamping mechanism. The invention is provided with the glue dispensing mechanism, the glue dispensing mechanism is used for dispensing glue at the external thread of the piston rod, and after the nut is in threaded connection with the piston rod, the nut and the piston rod are bonded and fixed by the thread locking glue, so that the stability of the structure after the piston rod and the nut are screwed up is ensured. The automatic screw-tightening mechanism is integrated on a working platform, the clamping and dispensing of the piston rod and the screw-tightening operation of the nut are realized in a mechanical automation mode, the labor intensity of operators is reduced, and meanwhile the screw-tightening torque is guaranteed to meet the design requirements.

title_en: Bionic cilium micro-flow sensor, preparation method and preparation device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic cilium micro-flow sensor, a preparation method and a preparation device thereof, aiming at solving the problem that most of the existing MEMS flow sensors developed by the bionic cilium adopt the traditional micro-processing technology and are relatively complex to operate, and the MEMS flow sensors comprise a resistance strain gauge, a metal substrate and metal bionic cilium; the metal substrate is in a metal foil sheet shape, and one end of the metal substrate is fixed and forms a cantilever beam structure; one end fixed on the metal substrate is a fixed end of the metal substrate, and the other end of the metal substrate is a free end of the metal substrate. Combining the unique advantages of the MCED provided by the application in preparing large-scale and high-length-diameter ratio metal cilia (copper wires), the inventor provides a bionic cilia array micro-flow sensor adopting a resistance strain type cantilever beam structure. The application provides a large-scale and high-length-diameter-ratio cilium array manufactured by an MCED method, the cilium array and a substrate are integrally formed, and a bionic cilium type micro-flow sensor is manufactured based on a resistance strain principle and a cantilever beam structure.

title_en: Anticorrosion process for factory prefabricated corrosion-resistant alloy inner joint coating of fluid conveying pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline corrosion prevention, in particular to a corrosion prevention process for an industrial prefabricated corrosion-resistant alloy inner joint coating of a fluid conveying pipeline, which comprises the following steps: firstly, a pipeline machine is used for driving a polishing and rust removing structure to enter the inner side of a pipeline, then a pipeline welding part is polished and cleaned, so that the welding part of the inner side of the pipeline is flush with other parts of the pipeline, and polished welding slag and rust slag are cleaned after polishing is finished; the inner repaired mouth of a tiny pipeline can be better constructed by the technical process, so that the stability of use is ensured, a better anti-corrosion effect can be achieved, and the stable use of the pipeline is ensured.

title_en: Electric arc spraying cylinder sleeve and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric arc spraying cylinder sleeve and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the electric arc spraying cylinder sleeve comprises the steps of carrying out electric arc spraying on an iron-based bottom layer on the peripheral surface of a mold core, carrying out electric arc spraying on an aluminum-silicon surface layer on the surface of the iron-based bottom layer, and then removing the mold core. The bonding strength of the iron-based bottom layer and the aluminum-silicon surface layer of the electric arc spraying cylinder sleeve prepared by the method is more than 30 MPa. The wall thickness of the electric arc spraying cylinder sleeve becomes thinner, the weight of the cylinder sleeve is reduced, the heat conduction efficiency of the cylinder sleeve is improved, and a better cooling effect is realized.

title_en: Product imaging control device and control method for vapor deposition furnace
abstract_en: The invention provides a product imaging control device and a control method for a vapor deposition furnace, wherein the product imaging control device comprises a laser measuring window arranged on the side wall of the vapor deposition furnace; the laser emission port of the laser measuring device is arranged opposite to the laser measuring window to collect product data in the vapor deposition furnace, the lifting device is connected with the laser measuring device, the data imaging device is used for carrying out graphic imaging according to the product data collected by the laser measuring device, and the PLC control module is respectively connected with the laser measuring device, the lifting device and the data imaging device. The invention can accurately measure the products in the vapor deposition furnace by the laser measuring device to obtain real-time specific measurement data, thereby adjusting the process, stabilizing the process, further improving the yield of the products, and having the characteristics of small error and high reliability.

title_en: Shell assembly, preparation method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a shell subassembly, including transparent casing and setting up the inside flashing layer of transparent casing, have the granule of flashing in the flashing layer. This application housing assembly has three-dimensional flash of light effect, has greatly promoted housing assembly's outward appearance. The application also relates to a preparation method of the shell assembly and an electronic device.

title_en: Coating cloth production equipment with uniform coating thickness
abstract_en: The invention discloses coating cloth production equipment with uniform coating thickness, and relates to the technical field of coating cloth production. In the invention, the first scraping plate and the second scraping plate push the paint on the cloth in two staggered Z-shaped paths on the cloth, and the third scraping plate perpendicular to the second scraping plate pushes the paint in two staggered Z-shaped paths on the cloth further, so that the thickness of the coating cloth is uniform.

title_en: Glue dispensing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of loudspeaker production and manufacturing, and discloses a glue dispensing device. The glue dispensing device comprises a feeding transmission mechanism, a discharging transmission mechanism, a rotary supporting mechanism, a glue dispensing mechanism and a transfer mechanism; the feeding and conveying mechanism is used for conveying the workpieces to be subjected to glue dispensing; the blanking transmission mechanism is used for transmitting the workpieces subjected to dispensing; the transfer mechanism is configured to transfer the workpieces subjected to glue dispensing on the rotary supporting mechanism to the blanking transmission mechanism and simultaneously transfer the workpieces to be subjected to glue dispensing on the feeding transmission mechanism to the rotary supporting mechanism; the glue dispensing mechanism is positioned on one side of the rotary supporting mechanism and is configured to perform glue dispensing operation on a workpiece to be subjected to glue dispensing on the rotary supporting mechanism. The dispensing device can simultaneously realize the feeding and discharging operations of workpieces, has small volume and small occupied area, and can reduce the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Sub-nanometer-thickness NiCoP two-dimensional ultrathin film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a sub-nanometer NiCoP two-dimensional ultrathin film, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1, preparing NiCo (OH) with sub-nanometer grade thickness by using cobalt chloride hexahydrate and nickel chloride hexahydrate as raw materials under the action of ultrasonic waves  2  A two-dimensional film; step 2, mixing NiCo (OH)  2  The phase of the two-dimensional film is heated and decomposed and is synchronously converted into a NiCoP phase, and the NiCoP two-dimensional film with the sub-nanometer level thickness is obtained.

title_en: Tin telluride film/germanium heterojunction wide-spectrum photoelectric detector and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A tin telluride film/germanium heterojunction based wide-spectrum photoelectric detector and a preparation method thereof relate to the field of wide-spectrum photoelectric detection of visible to near-infrared bands, and particularly relate to a photoelectric detector with high detection rate and high response rate based on a novel two-dimensional semiconductor material and a preparation method thereof. The method adopts a two-dimensional semiconductor material tin telluride film as a p-type material for constructing the heterojunction, and adopts a germanium substrate as a substrate. And directly sputtering the tin telluride film on the cleaned and pre-masked germanium substrate by adopting a one-step direct current sputtering method to prepare the tin telluride film/germanium heterojunction. And after removing the mask, thermally evaporating the metal Al electrode to prepare the prototype device of the photovoltaic detector. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method is simple, efficient, low in cost and low in power consumption, and realizes the preparation of the tin telluride film/germanium heterojunction wide-spectrum photoelectric detector working at room temperature in a visible-near infrared band (400-. The preparation process is efficient and simple, and the response rate and the detection rate of the device at room temperature are high.

title_en: Welding wire preparation method and method for online repairing 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N substrate surface cracks by using welding wire
abstract_en: The application provides a welding wire preparation method and a method for online repairing of surface cracks of a 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N matrix by using the welding wire, wherein the method comprises the following two parts of preparation of the welding wire and online repairing of surface cracks of the 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N matrix by using the welding wire, and the welding wire preparation method comprises the following steps: sequentially annealing and solution-treating a 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N round bar; cutting the processed 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N round bar wire into strips, and performing primary dehydrogenation treatment after cutting; polishing the strips after dehydrogenation to remove edges and corners, and then grinding the surface oxide through centerless grinding to form round wires; and carrying out secondary dehydrogenation treatment on the obtained round wire to obtain the welding wire. This application adopts the 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N round bar of the same material with 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N base member to make the welding wire, and through the restoration of this technology, 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N base member can reach the equal strength repair welding, satisfies or is close to the design standard of this 1Cr15Ni4Mo3N base member after the welding.

title_en: Cutting tool
abstract_en: Provided is a cutting tool which can have a long tool life, particularly when used for cutting soft metals. The cutting tool comprises a base material and a hard carbon film disposed on the base material, wherein the hard carbon film comprises an amorphous phase and a graphite phase, the density of the hard carbon film is 2.5g/cm  3  -3.5 g/cm  3 , the crystallinity of the hard carbon film is 6.5% or less, and the average coordination number of the amorphous phase is 2.5-4.

title_en: Heating square tube calibration arrangement structure of Teflon belt type compounding machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating square tube calibration arrangement structure of a Teflon belt type compound machine, which comprises a main body, clamping jaws and a mounting disc, wherein the clamping jaws are movably arranged below the main body, lower end induction holes and side induction holes are formed in the clamping jaws, the mounting disc is arranged above the main body, a rotary disc, a tightening disc and an induction processor are arranged on the mounting disc, a rotating shaft is connected below the rotary disc, the clamping jaws are controlled by the rotating shaft to tighten once, a rotating column is connected below the tightening disc, the clamping jaws are controlled by the rotating column to tighten for the second time, a buzzer is arranged on the induction processor, the lower end induction holes and the side induction holes are respectively connected with the induction processor, the heating square tube calibration arrangement structure further comprises square tubes, the square tubes are fixed in the clamping jaws, the square tubes heated in the compound machine are prevented from being offset and shaking during working, and the square tubes heated during the two fixing are monitored in real time to generate bending and deformation, so that the bending square tubes are effectively prevented from being heated unevenly, the temperature difference between the left and right sides is large, and the technical problem of low control precision is solved.

title_en: Sulfur ion doped cuprous selenide honeycomb-shaped flexible nanosheet array structure material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sulfur ion doped cuprous selenide honeycomb flexible nanosheet array structure material, a preparation method and application thereof  2‑  Anion-doped cuprous selenide cross-linked nanosheet array structure material. Compared with the prior art, S is doped into the cuprous selenide cross-linked nanosheet array structure  2‑  Can effectively adjust the electronic structure of the catalyst after the anion, increase the exposure of active sites and improve the catalysisThe conductivity of the catalyst, the optimization of intermediate species and adsorption behavior thereof, the acceleration of catalytic kinetics, and the improvement of the activity, selectivity and stability of the catalyst for electrocatalysis of carbon dioxide reduction to a single liquid product, namely formic acid. And the method has the characteristics of simple preparation process, environmental friendliness, low cost, no need of heating to consume energy, simultaneous batch production and no interference from reaction kettles and the like. Is valuable in the practical application of electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction.

title_en: Graphite boat suitable for conductive film deposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphite boat suitable for conductive film deposition, which belongs to the technical field of solar cell production and comprises a graphite boat piece, graphite clamping points and a connecting structure, wherein the graphite boat piece comprises an outer graphite boat piece and a middle graphite boat piece; the middle graphite boat piece comprises a boat piece body and an electrode connecting plate, wherein the boat piece body comprises a bearing part and a connecting part; the connecting part is provided with a connecting hole and a clearance hole; the insulating sleeve comprises an inner layer sleeve, a middle layer sleeve and an outer layer sleeve, wherein the inner layer sleeve comprises a mounting hole, a connecting outer wall and a limiting convex ring; the middle-layer sleeve comprises a first sleeve hole and a first accommodating hole, the diameter of the first accommodating hole is larger than that of the limiting convex ring, the length of the first accommodating hole is smaller than that of the limiting convex ring, and the inner end surface of the first accommodating hole abuts against one end of the limiting convex ring; the outer layer sleeve comprises a second sleeve hole and a second accommodating hole, the diameter of the second accommodating hole is larger than the outer diameter of the middle layer sleeve, and the inner end face of the second accommodating hole abuts against the other end of the limiting convex ring. The graphite boat is suitable for conductive and non-conductive film deposition.

title_en: Graphite composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphite composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the graphite composite material comprises a graphite substrate and a complex phase coating arranged on the surface of the graphite substrate, the complex phase coating comprises a silicon carbide layer, a whisker toughening layer and a tantalum carbide-silicon carbide composite layer which are sequentially connected from inside to outside, the whisker toughening layer is composed of tantalum carbide whiskers, and at least part of the tantalum carbide whiskers in the whisker toughening layer extend into the tantalum carbide layer and the tantalum carbide-silicon carbide composite layer. According to the invention, the silicon carbide layer is prepared by using chemical vapor deposition, the whisker toughening layer is prepared by using a carbothermic reduction reaction method, and the tantalum carbide-silicon carbide composite layer is prepared by using chemical vapor codeposition, so that each layer has uniform thickness, controllable structure, high phase purity, simple process and short period; the graphite composite material coating has high thermal matching degree, good combination effect, good use stability and long service life, and can meet the use condition of high-temperature working condition of over 2000 ℃.

title_en: N, S Co-doped Co 9 S 8 Method for producing materials and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses N, S Co-doped Co  9  S  8  A method for preparing the material and application thereof. Adopting a chemical modification method, obtaining imidazole modified lignin by utilizing a sulfydryl-acetylene click reaction, and obtaining N, S Co-doped flower-shaped Co through three steps of coordination with cobalt salt, preoxidation and carbonization  9  S  8  A material. Compared with the raw material based on petroleum, the lignin which is the main raw material for preparing the material has rich sources, can obviously reduce the production cost and has excellent social and economic benefits; the material has better full-hydrolytic property and better application prospect in the field of electrocatalysis.

title_en: Vacuum treatment method and device for glue-homogenizing bubbles of embedded chip packaging substrate
abstract_en: The invention provides a vacuum treatment method and a device for glue homogenizing bubbles of an embedded chip packaging substrate. The invention can realize the demand of the subsequent process on the photoresist only by coating the photoresist once, does not need to coat the photoresist for multiple times, greatly simplifies the process steps, has a corresponding vacuum processing method for the photoresist with different viscosities, is beneficial to the subsequent operations of metal wiring and the like, and effectively improves the success rate and the performance of packaging.

title_en: Upper and lower die accurate detection system based on mechanical vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise upper and lower die detection system based on mechanical vision, relates to the technical field of precise upper and lower die detection, and particularly relates to a visual detection frame and a bottom cabinet. This accurate detection detecting system of upper and lower mould based on machine vision, the design through first electronic slide rail can drive the collection board and carry out the removal of upper and lower position at vertical horizontal position, can carry out the removal of synchronous position to first CCD camera and first light filling lamp through the upper and lower position removal to the collection board, thereby can carry out visual outward appearance to placing the upper and lower mould edgewise on placing the board surface and detect, be convenient for detect size and defective condition from the die body side, the design that utilizes second CCD camera and second light filling lamp simultaneously is to carrying out visual inspection to placing the upper and lower mould on placing the board surface with overlooking the angle from the top of placing the board, effectively reduce the blind area to upper and lower mould visual inspection.

title_en: Closed-loop control system and closed-loop control method for coating machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed-loop control system and a closed-loop control method of a coating machine, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, wherein the system comprises a coating mechanism, an area density meter, a CCD (charge coupled device) camera and a control system; the coating mechanism, the surface densimeter and the CCD camera are provided with two groups, wherein the first group of coating mechanism, the surface densimeter and the CCD camera correspond to the front surface of the pole piece, and the second group of coating mechanism, the surface densimeter and the CCD camera correspond to the back surface of the pole piece; and each coating mechanism, the surface densitometer and the CCD camera are all connected with the control system. The invention has the advantages that: the comprehensive closed-loop control of the surface density and the coating width of the coating machine is realized, the manual lazy property is reduced, the equipment automation is improved, and the coating yield is improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly flame-retardant high-toughness PVC insulating electrical sleeve
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly flame-retardant high-toughness PVC insulating electrical bushing, which comprises: an inner pipe body; the outer-layer pipe body is coaxially arranged with the inner-layer pipe body, and the inner-layer pipe body is fixedly connected with the outer-layer pipe body; the net layer is positioned between the inner layer pipe body and the outer layer pipe body; the coating is coated on the outer side wall of the outer layer pipe body and the inner side wall of the inner layer pipe body; wherein the coating comprises the following raw material components in parts by weight: 180-220 parts of bisphenol A epoxy resin, 9-11 parts of dicyandiamide curing agent, 0.8-1.2 parts of 2-methylimidazole, 1.8-2.2 parts of flatting agent, 90-110 parts of silicon micropowder, 14-16 parts of flame retardant and 10-12 parts of heat-conducting filler. The invention can effectively solve the problems of poor toughness and easy abrasion of the existing electrical casing.

title_en: Wafer distal edge temperature measurement system with lamp bank alignment
abstract_en: A reactor system is designed to provide accurate monitoring of wafer temperature during a deposition step. The reactor system includes a pyrometer mounting assembly that supports and positions three or more pyrometers (e.g., infrared (IR) pyrometers) relative to the reaction chamber to measure center and edge wafer temperatures and the reaction chamber temperature. The pyrometer mount assembly provides a small spot size or temperature sensing area for the edge pyrometer to accurately measure the edge wafer temperature. A fixture assembly and mounting method for each tool setup is provided for achieving precise alignment of the IR pyrometer sensing spot (and the edge pyrometer) relative to the wafer when the pyrometer mounting assembly is mounted on a lamp bank in a reactor system or tool setup. Wafer edge temperature sensing with reactor systems assembled in proper alignment ensures accurate and repeatable measurement of wafer temperature.

title_en: Light dredging heat-proof and heat-insulating composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light dredging heat-proof and insulating composite material, which comprises a reinforcement body and an ablation-resistant matrix, wherein the reinforcement body comprises a high-temperature-resistant inorganic fiber fabric layer and a high-heat-conductivity carbon fiber fabric layer, and each high-heat-conductivity carbon fiber fabric layer is sandwiched between two high-temperature-resistant inorganic fiber fabric layers; the ablation resistant matrix comprises an ablation resistant resin and inorganic particles. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the composite material, which comprises the steps of needling high-temperature-resistant inorganic fibers layer by layer to form inorganic fiber fabric layers, sandwiching the carbon fiber fabric between the two inorganic fiber fabric layers to obtain a sandwich structure reinforcement, and finally adopting a solution gel and vacuum impregnation resin transfer molding method to prepare the composite material. The composite material has low density and heat conductivity, has extremely low line ablation rate in an aerothermic environment for a long time and good heat insulation and mechanical property, and can be used for large-area heat insulation of an aerospace vehicle and heat insulation structures with high heat insulation and bearing requirements and urgent weight reduction requirements.

title_en: Raw material processing apparatus and processing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique for treating a raw material such as combustible waste, and more particularly to a technique for combustion, pyrolysis and gasification treatment without releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. The processing device is provided with: a fluidized bed furnace (1) having a pyrolysis chamber (6) and a combustion chamber (7) partitioned by a partition wall (10) inside; an electrolysis device (2) that electrolyzes water to generate hydrogen and oxygen; a methanation reactor (3) that generates methane from hydrogen and carbon dioxide discharged from the combustion chamber (7); a first fluidizing gas supply line (11) which supplies a first fluidizing gas into the pyrolysis chamber (6); and a second fluidizing gas supply line (12) which introduces a portion of the carbon dioxide and oxygen as second fluidizing gases to the combustion chamber (7).

title_en: Method for manufacturing sheet for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for manufacturing a sheet for manufacturing a semiconductor device, the sheet for manufacturing a semiconductor device comprising a base material, an adhesive layer, an intermediate layer, a film-like adhesive, and a second release film, the method comprising: a first processing step of removing at least a part of the intermediate layer and the film-like adhesive from a second intermediate laminate provided with the intermediate layer, the film-like adhesive, and the first release film to obtain a second intermediate laminate processed product; a laminating step of laminating a first intermediate laminate provided with a base material and an adhesive layer to a second intermediate laminate processed product to obtain a first laminate; a replacing and attaching step of removing the first release film of the first laminate and replacing and attaching the second release film to obtain a second laminate; and a second processing step of removing at least a part of the base material and the adhesive layer from the second laminate to obtain a sheet for manufacturing a semiconductor device, wherein the peeling force between the first release film and the film-like adhesive is larger than the peeling force between the second release film and the film-like adhesive.

title_en: Measuring device with marking function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a measuring device with a marking function, and relates to the technical field of measuring robots; to implement the functionality of the marker; the method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a device main body, wherein two sides of the device main body are rotatably provided with running wheels through wheel shafts, and the wheel shafts are provided with angle sensors; the marking wheel is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of one side of the device main body through a rotating shaft, and the circumferential outer wall of the marking wheel is provided with accommodating cavities which are uniformly distributed; the transmission shaft is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of one side of the device main body. By arranging the structures such as the feeding barrel and the marking wheel, the powder storage cavity can convey the powder to the ground when the powder storage cavity rotates to the lower part based on the running of the running wheel, so that the purpose of marking is achieved; in the mode, the diameters of the running wheel and the marking wheel are fixed, and the transmission ratios of the gear transmission assembly and the toothed chain transmission assembly are fixed, so that the purpose of equidistant marking can be achieved.

title_en: Compounding method of polycrystalline diamond compact
abstract_en: The invention provides a compounding method of a polycrystalline diamond compact, which comprises the following steps: s1, respectively preparing a cobalt-containing hard alloy matrix and a diamond layer S2, and performing preorder heat treatment: carrying out heat treatment on the hard alloy matrix containing cobalt in the step S1 to enable the cobalt in the hard alloy matrix to permeate the surface of the hard alloy matrix; s3, cobalt removal treatment: removing the cobalt penetrating to the surface of the hard alloy substrate in the step S2; s4, synthesizing the polycrystalline diamond compact: and adding a layer of metal binder cobalt sheet between the diamond layer obtained in the step S1 and the hard alloy substrate subjected to cobalt removal in the step S3, and then compounding. The hard alloy matrix is subjected to cobalt removal treatment, and then when the polycrystalline diamond compact is synthesized, cobalt is added to complement the original missing cobalt, and high-melting-point metal and metal compounds are also added, so that the technical problem that the toughness and the machinability of the finished polycrystalline diamond compact are influenced by the existing synthesis method of the polycrystalline diamond compact is solved, and the toughness of the polycrystalline diamond compact is effectively improved.

title_en: Early warning system and early warning method for detecting gluing weight of battery cell in real time
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method for detecting gluing weight of a battery cell in real time, which comprises the following steps: s1: detecting the weight of the battery cell or the battery cell carrier when the glue is not applied; s2: detecting the weight of the battery cell or the battery cell carrier when the gluing is finished; s3: and calculating the weight difference value of the battery cell or the battery cell carrier when the glue is not applied and when the glue is applied, and giving an early warning if the weight difference value is not within the standard weight range of the glue. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method can perform early warning after detecting the abnormal condition of the glue amount in the gluing process of the battery core.

title_en: Cooling liquid for wind generating set and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooling liquid for a water cooling system of a wind generating set, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.20-2.00% of polyetheramine, 0.01-0.05% of azole organic compound, 0.01-0.20% of organosilicon, 0.01-0.10% of stabilizer, 30-60% of antifreezing agent and the balance of water. The components selected by the invention are basically not ionized or slowly dissociated in the aqueous solution, so that the cooling liquid has lower conductivity, and the conductivity can be smaller than 150 mu s/cm. The cooling liquid provided by the invention also solves the corrosion prevention problems of pitting corrosion, crevice corrosion and the like of various aluminum alloys such as 3003, 4043, 4104, 5052, 6061 and the like which are special to the wind generating set system, and can realize the long-acting corrosion prevention protection effect on the wind generating set.

title_en: Carbonized magnesium hydroxide produced by electrolysis of magnesium-containing industrial wastewater and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to carbonized magnesium hydroxide produced by electrolyzing magnesium-containing industrial wastewater and a preparation method thereof, which concretely comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing an electrolytic cell provided with a cathode and an anode, and arranging an ion exchange membrane between the cathode and the anode in the electrolytic cell; (2) Introducing filtered magnesium-containing industrial wastewater into an electrolytic cell, electrifying and then electrolyzing to ionize the magnesium-containing industrial wastewater, and enriching Mg at a cathode through the filtering action of an ion filtering membrane  2+  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the (3) Regulating the pH of the cathode region so that Mg  2+  Completely precipitating to obtain magnesium hydroxide slurry; (4) And (3) pressing and forming the obtained magnesium hydroxide slurry, and then placing the magnesium hydroxide slurry into a carbonization reaction kettle for carbonization treatment to obtain the target product carbonized magnesium hydroxide. Compared with the prior art, the invention not only realizes the recycling utilization of the magnesium-containing industrial wastewater, but also can seal a large amount of carbon dioxide in the preparation process of the product, thereby being beneficial to promoting the realization of double carbon targets in China.

title_en: Method for improving transparency of silicon carbide crystal surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the transparency of the surface of a silicon carbide crystal, which comprises the following steps of providing a silicon carbide crystal, preparing a resin solution matched with the refractive index of the silicon carbide crystal, coating the resin solution on the surface of the silicon carbide crystal, forming a resin layer on the surface of the silicon carbide crystal, and curing the resin layer to form a transparent resin film on the surface of the silicon carbide crystal. According to the invention, the transparent resin film is prepared on the surface of the silicon carbide crystal, so that the fine polishing operation on the silicon carbide crystal is avoided, the conditions of microtubes, impurity wrappers and polytype embedding of the silicon carbide are conveniently detected, and the processing cost is saved.

title_en: Carbon fiber automobile tail fin bonding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon fiber automobile tail fin bonding device which comprises a gluing manipulator and a positioning tool, wherein the positioning tool comprises a frame, a lower main body, an upper main body and a positioning assembly, the frame comprises an upper frame and a lower frame, the upper frame is connected above the lower frame through a support frame, the lower main body is arranged at the top of the lower frame and can move along the horizontal direction, the upper main body is connected on the support frame and can move along the vertical direction, the positioning assembly comprises an inner plate upper positioning piece, an inner plate lower positioning piece, an outer plate upper positioning piece and an outer plate lower positioning piece, the inner plate upper positioning piece and the outer plate upper positioning piece are distributed at the bottom of the upper main body along the horizontal direction, the inner plate lower positioning piece and the outer plate lower positioning piece are arranged at the top of the lower main body, and the inner plate lower positioning piece is matched with the inner plate upper positioning piece, and the outer plate lower positioning piece and the outer plate upper positioning piece in position. The invention can ensure the positioning precision of the carbon fiber automobile tail fin during gluing, improves the product qualification rate, has simple structure, is convenient to install and operate, improves the working efficiency and reduces the labor cost.

title_en: Mars surface carrier rocket propellant in-situ preparation integrated system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ preparation integrated system and method for a Mars surface carrier rocket propellant. The invention prepares the methane propellant by utilizing carbon dioxide in the Mars atmosphere, prepares the liquid oxygen propellant and oxygen required by a life support system by utilizing water electrolysis in the Mars water-containing mineral, and has high compliance with requirements of liquid oxygen methane carrier rockets and Mars detection tasks. The invention conveys the product water of the liquid methane preparation process to an electrolytic water system, so that the exploitation amount of water-containing mineral substances can be reduced by half, namely, oxygen element in Mars carbon dioxide is used as an important source of liquid oxygen propellant.

title_en: Scale prevention layer, PE-RT (polyethylene-reverse transcription) floor heating pipe and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-scale layer, a PE-RT (polyethylene-reverse transcription) ground heating pipe and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of ground heating pipes; the scale prevention layer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 90-100 parts of PE-RT; 11-16 parts of organic silicone master batch; 2-8 parts of nano silicon dioxide; 2-8 parts of modified graphene oxide; the modified graphene oxide is modified by a surface modifier. The anti-scaling layer provided by the invention has the advantages of preventing and cleaning dirt and high heat conductivity.

title_en: Processing method of nano-coating ecological composite board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of a nano-coating ecological composite board, which comprises the following steps: s1, covering a decorative pattern surface layer on the surface of a substrate, and sanding the decorative pattern surface layer; s2, carrying out plasma surface treatment on the sanded wood grain finish coat; s3, covering a UV shadow coating on the wood grain finish coat subjected to the plasma surface treatment; s4, covering a UV photocuring transparent layer on the UV shadow coating; and S5, coating a nano corrosion-resistant layer on the UV photocuring transparent layer to obtain the nano coating ecological composite board. The pattern facing layer and the UV light shadow coating of the ecological composite board processed by the processing method have high bonding strength, do not need to be glued by an adhesive, and do not influence the appearance of the ecological composite board.

title_en: Ferritic steel alloy powder for laser additive repair of shaft parts and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ferritic steel alloy powder for laser additive repair of shaft parts and an application method thereof, wherein the alloy powder is designed by adjusting the types and mass percentages of C, cr, si, mn, mo, V, cu and Fe elements through element action analysis and metallurgical design to obtain a repair layer of a ferritic structure; the alloy powder has the advantages of good adaptability of a laser cladding repair process, fine and dense tissue after repair, no defects such as pores and cracks, capability of bearing complex stress on a repair layer and matching mechanical properties with parts; the invention also provides an application method of the ferritic steel alloy powder for laser additive repair of the shaft parts, and the application method can be used for preparing the additive repair layer which has high strength and good plasticity and toughness and can bear various stress conditions so as to effectively repair surface damage, the mechanical property after repair meets the use requirement, and resources and energy can be greatly saved.

title_en: Hard alloy valve seat ring material treated by steam and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard alloy valve seat ring material treated by water vapor and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein the hard alloy valve seat ring material is prepared from the following element raw materials in percentage by mass: 0.7-1.3% of C, 0.7-1.2% of S, V:1 to 3.0 percent of Mo, 4 to 7 percent of W, 2 to 5.2 percent of W, 11.0 to 18.5 percent of Co, 4 to 6.2 percent of Cr, 0.8 to 1.3 percent of Mn, 1.5 to 3.0 percent of O, the balance of Fe and inevitable impurities; the valve seat ring has a metallographic structure which comprises a hard alloy phase, and an oxide protective layer is formed on the surface of the valve seat ring through a water vapor treatment process after the valve seat ring material is sintered. According to the invention, through steam treatment, pores on the surface of the valve seat ring are filled with oxides, a stable oxide film protective layer is formed on the surface of the valve seat ring, the surface hardness can be improved by more than 50%, the effect of 'soft landing' of the valve on the valve seat ring is achieved, and the direct impact and shearing action of the valve on a valve seat ring matrix are avoided.

title_en: Carrier plate and method for prolonging service life of carrier plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carrier plate and a method for prolonging the service life of the carrier plate. The method for prolonging the service life of the carrier plate comprises the following steps: obtaining a carrier plate which is used for a preset number of times on a production line; heating the carrier plate to release the water vapor adsorbed by the carrier plate; and arranging a waterproof protective layer on the surface of the heated carrier plate. The carrier plate and the method for prolonging the service life of the carrier plate reduce the carrier plate water vapor, inhibit the release and absorption of the carrier plate water vapor, recycle the carrier plate which needs to be replaced due to the deposition of the over-thick ITO film layer, and prolong the service life of the carrier plate.

title_en: Fe-doped Co applied to electrocatalytic decomposition of water3O4Ru-loaded bifunctional catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a Fe-doped Co  3 O 4  -supported Ru bifunctional catalyst applied to electrocatalytic decomposition of water, and belongs to the technical field of supported metal catalysts. The method is divided into two parts, firstly preparing a required Fe doped Co  3 O 4  carrier by a template method; and then uniformly loading Ru nano particles on the Fe doped Co  3 O 4  carrier by an impregnation method to obtain the final Ru/Fe-Co  3 O 4  catalyst. The Fe-doped Co  3 O 4  loaded Ru prepared by the method is applied to electrochemical water decomposition reaction, and effectively regulates and controls hydrogen evolution reaction and oxygen evolution reaction performance by utilizing metal-carrier interaction, so that the Fe-doped Co  3 O 4  loaded Ru is a high-efficiency stable difunctional electrocatalyst. The invention provides a simple and economical strategy for preparing the supported metal catalyst.

title_en: Preparation method of double-layer co-extrusion foaming rubber roller and material for preparing rubber roller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a double-layer co-extrusion foaming rubber roller and a material for preparing the rubber roller. The preparation method of the rubber roller comprises the following steps: (1) Placing the foamed rubber material into a first extruder, and obtaining an inner layer rubber tube through an extrusion process; (2) Foaming the inner layer rubber tube to obtain an inner layer foamed rubber tube; (3) Putting the non-foaming rubber material into a second extruder, and extruding the non-foaming rubber material out of the inner layer foaming rubber pipe by an extrusion process to form a non-foaming rubber layer; (4) And inserting the metal roller core into the inner layer rubber tube to obtain the rubber roller. The rubber roller prepared by the method has no joint line, no air bubble is introduced into the rubber roller, and the yield is high; in addition, the method also overcomes the problem of insufficient thickness precision existing in two times of die pressing; particularly, the metal roller core is inserted into the inner layer rubber tube finally, so that the problem that the roller core is easy to deform due to twice die pressing is avoided.

title_en: Raw material supply apparatus for single crystal growth
abstract_en: A source material supply apparatus for single crystal growth, according to an embodiment of the present invention, includes: a feeding unit that stores a polycrystalline raw material and supplies the polycrystalline raw material in a predetermined amount; a dust removing unit including a ramp having one end disposed below the feeding unit and having a dust suction port for filtering dust in the polycrystalline raw material supplied from the feeding unit; and a transfer unit disposed below the other end of the ramp to automatically transfer the polycrystalline raw material having passed through the ramp to the charge hopper.

title_en: Closed-loop dispensing monitoring alarm device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed-loop dispensing monitoring alarm device and a closed-loop dispensing control system.A closed-loop dispensing control module is used for converting an error value between an input dispensing target value and a dispensing output value into a dispensing valve control value so as to drive a dispensing valve to dispense; the output detection module is used for respectively detecting the valve torsion value, the valve position value and the valve pressure value and feeding back any one or more of the valve torsion value, the valve position value or the valve pressure value as dispensing output values to the closed-loop dispensing control module; and the output alarm module alarms when any one of the valve torsion value, the valve position value (or the valve rotating speed value) and the valve pressure value is detected to be abnormal. Therefore, the closed-loop dispensing control mode is adopted, and the relationship among the valve torsion, the valve position and the valve pressure is monitored. When the dispensing valve has a valve blockage fault or the sensor has a fault, the dispensing valve can detect and alarm in time, and the dispensing of the dispensing valve can be more accurate and stable through closed-loop control.

title_en: Waterproof sock with long-acting waterproof function and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a waterproof sock with a long-acting waterproof function and a manufacturing method thereof. The invention provides a waterproof sock cover with a long-acting waterproof function and a manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: Rock wool strip forming method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rock wool strip forming equipment, and particularly relates to rock wool strip forming equipment, which comprises a machine base, wherein a rock wool strip is placed in the middle of the machine base, a sliding seat is slidably arranged on one side of the rock wool strip, a drill rod is rotatably arranged in the sliding seat, a second gear is fixedly arranged at one end of the drill rod, which is far away from the rock wool strip, a first motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the sliding seat, a first gear is fixedly arranged at the output end of the first motor, the first gear and the second gear are in meshed transmission, a drill bit is fixedly arranged at one end of the drill rod, which is far away from the second gear, a valve plate is slidably arranged at one end, which is close to the drill bit, of the drill rod, the valve plate is connected with the drill rod through an eighth spring, through holes are respectively formed in two side walls, which are positioned at the eighth spring, an infusion rod is slidably arranged in the drill rod, and a mildew-proof rod can be installed in the rock wool strip and is fixedly bonded.

title_en: Glue joint deformation control method for composite material sandwich structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling the gluing deformation of a composite material sandwich structure, which comprises the following steps: placing a support core mold and a positioning stop block at one side of a composite material sandwich structure beam, one side of an end rib and one side of a side rib, placing a slidable limiting block at one side of a rear edge strip of the composite material sandwich structure, bonding the slidable limiting block on a bonding tool through a double-sided adhesive tape, bonding the slidable limiting block to the bonding tool, and performing limiting control on deformation of one side of the rear edge strip of the composite material sandwich structure in the bonding process. The glue joint deformation control method for the composite material sandwich structure can effectively inhibit the glue joint deformation of the composite material sandwich structure, is simple to operate and obvious in effect, does not cause internal glue joint defects caused by excessive inhibition of the appearance, and finally realizes good internal quality and high dimensional accuracy of a part formed by glue joint.

title_en: Method for preparing aerogel by using mold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing aerogel by using a mould, which comprises the following steps: hydrolyzing to obtain a modifier; hydrolyzing to prepare a sol solution; fully mixing the sol solution with a modifier and a water-soluble phenolic resin solution to prepare a silicon dioxide aerogel glue solution; forging the alloy material required by the preparation of the die; carrying out annealing treatment; carrying out precision turning; carrying out quenching operation, and carrying out hot cleaning after quenching; tempering, grinding and polishing the die original; after the gelation treatment is finished, aging and ageing treatment are carried out to prepare the silicon dioxide aerogel material; according to the method for preparing the aerogel by using the die, the high-precision die preparation is carried out, the conventional one-time die is used for preparing the aerogel instead of the conventional one-time die, and the relatively strict turning, heat treatment and grinding and polishing are carried out in the die preparation process, so that the preparation precision of the method is improved, the prepared die has reusability, and the consumption of materials is reduced.

title_en: Golden composite coating prepared by physical vapor deposition method and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a golden composite coating prepared by a physical vapor deposition method and a preparation process thereof. The buffer layer prepared by the invention enhances the bonding strength in the composite coating, the wear-resistant layer improves the bonding force and the wear resistance of the film layer, the color layer has strong acid resistance and alkali resistance, and the protective layer has a protective film layer with high compactness, thereby effectively preventing discoloration and corrosion; the preparation process realizes the voltage-on color-change-resistant golden film layer of the MIM component, prevents the color change condition after voltage is applied, prolongs the service life of the product, and has the advantages of novel design, simple structure, high hardness and high corrosion resistance, simple production process and low production cost.

title_en: Water solution electrolysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical care, and discloses an aqueous solution electrolysis system which comprises an electrolysis power supply, an electrolysis bath, an electrolysis water tank, a condensing device, an activated carbon filter element, a primary filter tank and a secondary filter tank, wherein the water outlet of the electrolysis water tank is communicated with the water inlet of the electrolysis bath, and the water inlet of the electrolysis water tank is communicated with the water outlet of the electrolysis bath to form a circulating water path; the electrolysis water tank gas outlet communicates with condensing equipment, active carbon filter core, level filtering case and second grade rose box in proper order, and the level filtering case includes filter rod and level filtering solution, and during the filter rod soaked level filtering solution, the gas outlet and the filter rod intercommunication of active carbon filter core, and the second grade rose box includes cassette and second grade filtering solution, and during the cassette soaked level filtering solution, the gas outlet and the cassette intercommunication of level filtering case. The invention has the beneficial effects that: harmful gas and impurities in the mixed gas of hydrogen and oxygen are removed by adopting a multi-layer filtering mode and then are inhaled by a human body, so that better treatment and health care effects are achieved.

title_en: Metal material electroplating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal material electroplating device, which comprises a protection machine body, wherein an electroplating pool is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the protection machine body, a support frame is arranged in the protection machine body and close to the inner wall, a synchronous driving roller is arranged on the surface of the support frame and positioned at a corner position, a conveyor belt is arranged on the surface of the synchronous driving roller, self-locking hooks are arranged on the surface of the conveyor belt and uniformly distributed on the surface of the conveyor belt, a pressing device is arranged on the surface of the support frame and close to the top position, and a processing device is arranged in the protection machine body and close to the pressing device. This metal material electroplating device has reached the effect of quick clearance, adaptable batch electroplating, and strong adaptability has reduced the limitation, and can in time clear up the electroplating component, reduces the adhesion of plating solution, and accelerated drying, labour saving and time saving has improved work efficiency and performance.

title_en: Construction device for polishing steel template and coating release agent and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction device and a construction method for polishing a steel template and coating a release agent, which replace the traditional manual handheld polishing operation mode, realize the integration of polishing and brushing the release agent, greatly improve the operation efficiency, optimize the operation environment of workers. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency of polishing and coating of the steel template by adopting traditional manual polishing and coating.

title_en: Automatic uniform strengthening device for porous membrane on surface skin layer of yarn and yarn processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic uniform strengthening device for a porous membrane on the surface skin layer of yarn and a yarn processing method, wherein the device comprises a yarn surface porous membrane detection device, an antistatic device, a porous membrane homogenizing device, a porous membrane strengthening device and a yarn conveying device; the porous membrane detection device mainly comprises a yarn porous membrane uniformity detection device and a yarn breakage automatic stop device; the antistatic device mainly comprises an antistatic agent spraying device, a liquid pressurizing device, an antistatic agent storage box and a wind shield; the porous membrane homogenizing device mainly comprises a hot air preheating device, a cold air cooling device, an air inlet device, an air exhaust device and a porous membrane smoothing device. Compared with the prior art, the device can detect the uniformity of the porous membrane on the surface skin layer of the yarn on line, feed back and correct the porous membrane in real time when the porous membrane is damaged or uneven, and adjust the thickness of the porous membrane while the porous membrane is uniform, smooth and porous, so that the subsequent weaving processing is facilitated, and the requirements on fabrics with different structures or functional fabrics are met.

title_en: Composite material with modified polypropylene foaming formed body as core layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foaming materials, in particular to a composite material taking a modified polypropylene foaming formed body as a core layer and a preparation method thereof. The invention has simple process, utilizes the compatilizer, the compound nucleating agent and the antioxidant to modify the polypropylene, can improve the adhesiveness of the surface of the polypropylene resin foaming material, and enhances the compounding capability of the polyethylene resin sheet, so that the composite material has high strength performance; the invention uses special mould to polymerize polyethylene resin sheet, and the prepared composite material has smooth surface, no obvious air lock mark and beautiful appearance.

title_en: Gold nanoparticle two-dimensional material surface Raman enhanced substrate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surface Raman enhancement detection, and discloses a gold nanoparticle two-dimensional material surface Raman enhancement substrate, a preparation method and application thereof. The method adopts a proper etching process, can prepare the gold nanoparticle two-dimensional material composite structure at one time, and has simple operation method and high repeatability. The surface Raman enhanced substrate of the gold nanoparticle two-dimensional material prepared by the method can damage the two-dimensional material, and uniform gold nanoparticles are prepared on the surface of the two-dimensional material, and the gold nanoparticles are also prepared while stripping the material in the preparation process. The prepared gold nanoparticle two-dimensional material has the advantages of high sensitivity, good uniformity and the like when being used as a surface Raman enhanced substrate.

title_en: Process for rapidly producing hydrogen in large quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process for rapidly producing hydrogen in large quantity, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a solution, namely selecting sodium hydroxide as a solute and clear water as a solvent, wherein the concentration of the sodium hydroxide solution is 40%; s2, preparing a tool, namely installing two metal plates above and below the container, and manufacturing a plurality of metal mesh blocks as electrode plates in reaction; s3, replacing nitrogen, namely performing gas replacement on the reaction container and a subsequent gas collecting pipeline by using pure nitrogen; s4, injecting a solution; s5, applying an electric field; s6, electrifying for electrolysis. On the basis of preparing hydrogen by the original water electrolysis method, an electric field is applied to the solution, ions of the solution become orderly by the electric field, so that the electrolysis reaction becomes faster, the electrolysis reaction area is increased to meet the requirement of rapidly manufacturing a large amount of hydrogen and oxygen, and a large amount of oxygen with the same volume as the hydrogen can be rapidly generated, thereby simultaneously meeting the requirement of preparing the oxygen.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor element
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to a method of optimizing a thickness of a target material film deposited on a semiconductor substrate in a semiconductor processing chamber, wherein the semiconductor processing chamber includes a magnetic assembly located on the semiconductor processing chamber, the magnetic assembly including a plurality of magnetic pillars within the magnetic assembly.
