The method comprises the following steps: operating a semiconductor processing chamber to deposit a target material film on a semiconductor substrate located within the semiconductor processing chamber; measuring the uniformity of the deposited film; adjusting the position of one or more magnetic columns in the magnetic assembly; and operating the semiconductor processing chamber to deposit a film of the target material after adjusting the position of the one or more magnetic pillars.

title_en: Aluminum-plastic film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an aluminum plastic film and a preparation method thereof, which sequentially comprises the following steps from inside to outside: the adhesive comprises a CPP film layer, an adhesive layer, a Ti-O film layer, an aluminum foil layer, a Ti-O film layer, an adhesive layer and a PET film layer; wherein: the adhesive layer comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 60-70 parts of polyurethane acrylic resin, 10-15 parts of acrylate monomer, 5-15 parts of alpha-cyanoacrylate, 0.5-2 parts of stabilizer and 1-5 parts of photoinitiator; the Ti-O film layer is grafted with acrylic groups. In the application, from the aspect of film layer structure, a Ti-O network structure film layer containing acrylic acid groups is prepared on both surfaces of an aluminum foil layer, so that the corrosion resistance of the aluminum foil can be further improved, and the acrylic acid groups can perform a crosslinking action on groups in an adhesive under ultraviolet light, so that the bonding force between the aluminum foil and a polymer film layer is improved; thereby promoting the comprehensive performance of the aluminum plastic film on the whole.

title_en: Heat treatment method for eliminating quenching residual stress of super martensitic stainless steel and improving surface hardness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat treatment method for eliminating quenching residual stress of super martensitic stainless steel and improving surface hardness, which is completed by placing quenched super martensitic stainless steel in a nitriding furnace for chemical heat treatment on the surface of gas nitriding. Compared with the prior art, after the quenching state super martensitic stainless steel is subjected to heat treatment by adopting the method, the quenching residual stress on the surface of the material is fully eliminated and is completely converted into compressive stress, a stable nitrided layer can be generated on the surface of the material, the hardness of the carburized layer can reach 1300HV, the surface hardness of the material can be greatly improved and can reach 300HV to the maximum extent, the surface hardness and the wear resistance are remarkably improved, the strength and the plasticity are kept excellent, and the service life of the material can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Repairing method of degreasing electrolytic tank
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a repairing method of a degreasing electrolytic cell, which relates to the technical field of steel cold rolling and comprises the following steps: 1) Dismantling the mechanical part of the electrolytic cell; 2) Building a scaffold; 3) Removing the old rubber plate in the electrolytic cell; 4) Cutting the electrode plate clamping groove at the bottom of the electrolytic cell, and then welding a new clamping groove lined with glue; 5) Repairing a matrix seriously corroded in the electrolytic cell; 6) Carrying out sand blasting and bottom material spraying on the electrolytic cell; 7) Brushing an adhesive in the electrolytic cell, and then carrying out rubber lining construction; 8) And (5) detecting the electrolytic cell, and finishing repairing after the electrolytic cell is detected to be qualified. The degreasing electrolytic tank can be systematically repaired, and the problem of liquid leakage caused by aging of lining glue of the electrolytic tank is effectively solved.

title_en: Polyurethane-based polymer, preparation method and application thereof, and water-based LED photocuring finish paint
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyurethane-based polymer, a preparation method and application thereof, and a water-based LED photocuring finish paint, and belongs to the technical field of photocuring paint coating. According to the invention, ionic liquid groups are introduced into the epoxy resin-based polymer and the polyurethane-based polymer, so that the water solubility of the epoxy resin-based polymer and the polyurethane-based polymer can be improved, and the epoxy resin-based polymer and the polyurethane-based polymer are respectively used as the components of the primer and the finish of the waterborne LED photocureable coating, so that the hardness, the adhesion resistance and the solvent resistance of the coating can be effectively improved; according to the invention, ionic liquid groups are introduced into the structure of the photoinitiator, so that the water solubility of the photoinitiator can be improved; meanwhile, the initiator can be used as a polymerizable component to participate in curing in the LED photocuring process, the migration resistance is high, and the safety of the water-based LED photocuring coating can be effectively improved.

title_en: Thermoplastic polymer composition with reduced stabilizer migration
abstract_en: A thermoplastic polymer composition (A) which results in reduced migration of stabilizers or other components (I) comprises 50 to 90% by weight, based on the polymer composition (A), of a thermoplastic (P) having migration barrier properties and at least one stabilizer component (S) and/or other component (I), wherein for the polymer composition (A) a) the glass transition temperature T of the thermoplastic polymer (P) is greater than the use temperature, b) the polymer specific constant (A  p ) of the polymer of the thermoplastic polymer (P) is less than 1;c) the mineral oil diffusion coefficient (D  p ) of the thermoplastic polymer (P) is less than 10  ‑12 cm 2 /S at 20 ℃, and D) the morphology of the thermoplastic polymer (P) is single-phase homogeneous or two-phase heterogeneous.

title_en: Method for coating an object, use of nanoparticles and object having a coated surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for coating an object, in particular a building fitting, equipped with a building (1), comprising at least the following steps: a) Providing an object (1); and b) coating the surface (2) of the object (1) with a layer (3), wherein the coating is carried out by means of a PVD method, wherein the antimicrobial or antiviral nanoparticles (4) are at least partially encapsulated in the layer (3). The invention further relates to the use of nanoparticles, in particular for PVD methods for coating a surface (2) of an object (1), and to an object (1) having a coated surface (2).

title_en: Hot-pressing device is used in preparation of compound science and technology board based on grape vine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a hot pressing device is used in preparation of composite technology board based on grape vine relates to the hot pressing device field. A composite technology board preparation based on grape vine uses hot press unit includes: inside track that can supply the removal of hot press unit and the removal frame that the track top set up, and the inside of a pair of removal frame is provided with the gasbag of expandable compression, be provided with the roof simultaneously at the top of gasbag, upper end one side of its roof is provided with the holding down plate that can return along with gasbag decline, the relative lateral wall that removes the frame is seted up and is supplied the lifting chute that holding down plate one end was stretched out, make holding down plate upper end receive behind the pressure slow descent and return and contract, can realize the slab material at the unloading in-process through gasbag and holding down plate, can slow down, prevent that it from appearing the paper fold.

title_en: Preparation method and application of cerium-doped lead dioxide electrode
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a cerium-doped lead dioxide electrode, wherein the method comprises the following steps: polishing a titanium plate by using abrasive paper, then ultrasonically cleaning, carrying out alkali cleaning and oil removal in a NaOH solution, then soaking the titanium plate into an oxalic acid solution for acid etching, taking out the titanium plate, and cleaning the titanium plate by using deionized water to obtain a Ti substrate; taking a Ti substrate as an anode and a titanium plate with the same area as a cathode, dissolving lead monoxide in NaOH solution to obtain an electrodeposition solution, and preparing the alpha-PbO  2  An intermediate layer; the prepared pole plate of the middle layer is taken as an anode, the titanium plate with the same area size is taken as a cathode,so as to contain Pb (NO)  3  )  2  、Cu(NO  3  )  2  、Ce(NO  3  )  2  The mixed solution of the beta-PbO and NaF is used as an electrodeposition solution to prepare the beta-PbO  2  An active layer. The invention adopts an electrodeposition method to prepare the cerium-doped lead dioxide electrode with high efficiency, high stability and low cost, and the lead dioxide electrode is suitable for the treatment of tetracycline hydrochloride-containing wastewater.

title_en: Super-weather-resistant white polyester film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultra-weather-resistant white polyester film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ultra-weather-resistant white polyester film consists of a core layer, an upper surface layer and a lower surface layer, wherein the core layer is prepared from a tackifying polyester slice, an anti-hydrolysis master batch and a white master batch according to the mass ratio of 82 to 95 to 2 to 8; the preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively and uniformly mixing the raw materials of the core layer and the raw materials of the surface layer, then carrying out melt extrusion, carrying out cast sheet casting after the melt is extruded by a three-layer co-extrusion die head, and then carrying out biaxial tension to obtain the super-weather-resistant white polyester film. The light transmittance of the super-weather-resistant white polyester film prepared by the invention is less than or equal to 30%, the transmittance at the ultraviolet wavelength of 380nm is less than or equal to 5%, the elongation at break is more than or equal to 40% after PCT 72 hours, and the delta b is less than or equal to 3 after ultraviolet irradiation of 200kWh, which is obviously superior to the prior art.

title_en: CuO-CeO rich in oxygen vacancies2Nano catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxygen vacancy-rich (X2 & H2) nano catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction. Firstly, dropwise adding citric acid monohydrate into a solution containing copper salt and cerium salt, evaporating and concentrating the solution to form sol, drying to obtain gel, and then annealing in a tube furnace to prepare the oxygen vacancy-enriched & X2& H2 nano catalyst. The catalyst can be applied to electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide to generate a high-carbon product (& gt). The method has the characteristics of simple preparation operation, low cost and excellent performance (high selectivity) for electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide into ethylene and ethanol.

title_en: Recovery method of aluminum electrolyte slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recycling method of aluminum electrolyte slag, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, mixing sodium carbonate, aluminum electrolyte slag and water, then autoclaving, S2, cooling the mixture obtained in the step S1 to be less than or equal to 30 ℃ and performing solid-liquid separation, S3, heating the liquid phase obtained in the step S2 to 75-95 ℃ and crystallizing to separate out lithium carbonate, mixing sodium hydroxide, the solid phase obtained in the step S2 and water, then autoclaving and performing solid-liquid separation to obtain calcium fluoride and clear liquid, and crystallizing sodium aluminate from the clear liquid.

title_en: Coated cutting tool and cutting tool provided with same
abstract_en: The coated tool of the present disclosure has a substrate and a diamond coating on the substrate. The coated cutting tool has a cutting edge. The region from the cutting edge to 300 μm in the direction of separation from the cutting edge is defined as a first region, and the region from the cutting edge to a distance of 300 μm or more and 800 μm or less is defined as a second region. A plurality of dome-shaped protrusions are present on the surface of the diamond coating. The first protrusions were set to have an equivalent circle diameter of 6 μm or more in the first region when viewed from directly above the first region, and the number of protrusions per 1mm  2  was set to be the first protrusion number. The number of projections per 1mm  2  of the second projections is set to be the second projection number, and the projections having an equivalent circle diameter of 6 μm or more in the second region are set to be the second projections when viewed from directly above the second region. The first number of protrusions is 30 or less, and the second number of protrusions is greater than the first number of protrusions.

title_en: Environment-friendly anti-oxidation solution and process for copper and copper alloy electrolytic polishing post-treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly anti-oxidation solution for copper and copper alloy electrolytic polishing post-treatment and a process, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: comprises 0.01 to 1 percent of benzotriazole, 0.02 to 1 percent of disodium lauroamphodiacetate and 0.01 to 0.5 percent of ethylenediamine by weight. The process has the following advantages: the anti-oxidation solution is used at room temperature, heating is not needed, the operation is simple, and the cost is low; the solution composition is simple, the cost is low, and the operation is easy; the anti-oxidation post-treatment effect is good; the solution does not contain Cr  6+  And is safe and environment-friendly.

title_en: Equipment for hydrogen production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolysis methods, in particular to hydrogen production equipment which comprises a rectangular protective frame, wherein a base is fixedly arranged in the rectangular protective frame, a first aeration tank and a second aeration tank are arranged in the rectangular protective frame, the first aeration tank and the second aeration tank are both arranged on the upper surface of the base, a wave pipe is arranged between the first aeration tank and the second aeration tank, a support is fixedly arranged between the first aeration tank and the second aeration tank, the support is fixedly arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the first aeration tank and the second aeration tank, a water storage tank is also fixedly arranged on the base, the water storage tank and the second aeration tank are also connected through the wave pipe, and the second aeration tank and the water storage tank are also provided with supports for fixing the wave pipe.

title_en: Filled membranes
abstract_en: A filler-containing film having a filler dispersed in a resin layer suppresses unnecessary flow of the filler caused by unnecessary flow of the resin layer when the filler-containing film is pressure-bonded to an article. The filler-containing film 10A has a filler dispersion layer 3 in which a filler 1 is dispersed in a resin layer 2. In the filler dispersion layer 3, the surface of the resin layer in the vicinity of the filler 1 has an inclination 2b or undulation 2c with respect to the tangent plane 2p of the resin layer at the central portion between adjacent fillers. The CV value of the particle diameter of the filler 1 is 20% or less.

title_en: Industrial board is with supplementary mopping equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to painting equipment, in particular to auxiliary painting equipment for an industrial board. The invention provides an industrial board auxiliary painting device capable of automatically turning and uniformly painting. The utility model provides an industrial board is supplementary mopping equipment, includes base, support frame, slide bar, puts thing board and first slide rail etc. and the support frame rigid coupling is on the base, and the slide bar is vertical to be set up in the support frame lower part, puts thing board sliding connection on the slide bar, and the symmetry rigid coupling has first slide rail around the support frame top. Through setting up the first slide rail that the middle part was buckled, make the paint roller can be accurate carry out the mopping to the board for industry, be aided with the grip block again and carry out the centre gripping to the board for industry, then overturn the board for industry through rotating the runner to this carries out two-sided mopping process, realizes the accurate efficient mopping to the board for industry, has improved the excellent rate of the board quality for industry.

title_en: Adhesive glue post-treatment device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bonding adhesive post-processing device which comprises a frame body and a replaceable cutter head, wherein a direct-current power supply, a control circuit board and a direct-current motor are arranged in the frame body, a temperature sensor and a pressure sensor are arranged on the replaceable cutter head, an output shaft of the direct-current motor is connected with a transmission rod, the transmission rod penetrates out of the upper end of the frame body and is rotatably connected with the frame body, a transmission rod connecting hole matched with the transmission rod is formed in the replaceable cutter head, the surface of the replaceable cutter head is coated with fluorine paint, the good non-adhesiveness is achieved, the problem that the replaceable cutter head is adhered by colloid in the using process and after the using process is finished is avoided, the replaceable cutter head is divided into a cutting cutter head and a trimming cutter head, the appearance, the temperature mode and the cutting frequency of the cutter head can be adjusted and set, the bonding adhesive post-processing device can be used for bonding adhesives with various forms of objects, can be suitable for bonding adhesives with different softening points and objects with different temperature tolerance capabilities, and is wide in application scenes.

title_en: Flexible composite material for improving back surface reflectivity of double-glass photovoltaic panel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of reflecting materials, and particularly relates to a flexible composite material for improving the back surface reflectivity of a double-glass photovoltaic panel and a preparation method thereof. The method specifically comprises the following steps: s1, taking polyester yarns as raw materials, obtaining basic screen cloth through warp knitting or weaving, coating polyvinyl chloride paste resin coating on the basic screen cloth, and shaping to obtain base cloth; s2, rolling to produce a polyvinyl chloride film of 0.20mm-0.24mm → embossing, and rolling to obtain the polyvinyl chloride film after cooling; s3, compounding the polyvinyl chloride film of the S2 with the base fabric of the S1, embossing, cooling and rolling to obtain a composite material; and S4, performing PVDF gravure printing surface treatment on the front film of the composite material obtained in the step S3, drying, cooling and rolling to obtain a product. The surface brightness of the flexible composite material is still over 80 percent after the surface brightness of the product is reduced along with the prolonging of time; the flexible composite material has good self-cleaning property.

title_en: Preparation method of ceramic matrix composite wave-absorbing honeycomb
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon carbide ceramic matrix composite honeycomb with high-temperature electromagnetic wave absorption performance and a preparation method thereof. Weaving silicon carbide fibers into corrugated plate-shaped fiber preformed bodies by using a die, preparing and depositing a boron nitride interface layer on the surfaces of the silicon carbide fibers by using a chemical vapor infiltration process, depositing a composite material matrix on the surfaces of the boron nitride interface layer by using the chemical vapor infiltration process, bonding the corrugated plates of the silicon carbide ceramic matrix composite material into honeycomb preformed bodies by using a ceramic slurry adhesive, and finally depositing the matrix to obtain the silicon carbide ceramic matrix composite material wave-absorbing honeycomb. The prepared wave-absorbing honeycomb has good high temperature resistance, high strength and excellent room temperature and high temperature wave-absorbing performance, and has potential application prospect in the field of high temperature wave absorption.

title_en: Sacrificial anode protection device and method for foundation concrete pipe pile in saline-alkali area
abstract_en: A sacrificial anode protection device for a foundation concrete pipe pile in a saline-alkali area is characterized in that the concrete pipe pile is composed of a pile body and a lower pile head, a sacrificial anode is arranged on the lower pile head, one end of the sacrificial anode is fixedly connected to an end plate of the lower pile head through welding, and the other end of the sacrificial anode extends into the pile body. Selection method of sacrificial anode: determining five influence factors influencing the soil resistivity according to the soil environment of the foundation concrete pipe pile in the saline-alkali area, evaluating the soil corrosivity, and determining the soil grade; selecting a material of the sacrificial anode; determining the specific shape and the specific number of the sacrificial anodes; and selecting the mounting position of the sacrificial anode according to the shape of the protected concrete pipe pile, and mounting. The method uses an analytic hierarchy process to synthesize various evaluation indexes, combines the formulated grading rule, and uses a sacrificial anode method to effectively protect the ground concrete pipe piles in the saline-alkali soil area from corrosion. The design is reasonable, the operability is strong, and a good method and means are provided for the anticorrosion protection of the foundation concrete pipe pile.

title_en: Black aluminum profile electrolytic coloring additive and coloring process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material surface treatment, and discloses an electrolytic coloring additive for black aluminum profiles and a coloring process thereof. The electrolytic coloring additive for the black aluminum profile comprises coloring main salt, coloring auxiliary salt, a dispersing agent, a complexing agent, conductive salt and a penetrating agent; the coloring main salt is selected from copper sulfate, the coloring auxiliary salt is selected from ferrous sulfate and/or manganese sulfate, and the complexing agent comprises organic phosphonic acid compounds. The electrolytic coloring additive for the black aluminum profile, disclosed by the invention, takes copper sulfate as a coloring main salt and ferrous sulfate and/or manganese sulfate as a coloring auxiliary salt, can replace the traditional nickel tin salt, is low in cost, environment-friendly and good in stability, can accelerate the electrolytic coloring reaction speed and shorten the time required by electrolytic coloring, can be colored black in 6-8min, and is obviously superior to the traditional coloring time (over 12 min) of stannous sulfate and nickel sulfate.

title_en: Quaternary manganese-based infrared nonlinear optical crystal, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of inorganic nonlinear optical crystal materials, and particularly discloses a quaternary manganese-based infrared nonlinear optical crystal, a preparation method and application thereof. The molecular formula of the optical crystal is AMn  3 Ga 5 S 11 ; wherein A is an alkali metal element selected from K, rb or Cs, the crystal structure of which belongs to monoclinic system, and the space group is Pc. The optical crystal has excellent second-order nonlinear optical property, can realize phase matching in an infrared band, has wide optical band gap (E  g  is more than 3.0 eV), has powder frequency multiplication intensity which can reach 0.8-1.5 times of that of a commercial material AgGaS  2 , has a laser damage threshold which is 30-35 times of that of the AgGaS  2  crystal, and has important application value in the high-tech fields such as laser frequency conversion, near infrared probes, photorefractive information processing and the like, and is particularly used for infrared detectors and infrared lasers.

title_en: Filter assembly and curing bed
abstract_en: The present application relates specifically to a filter assembly and a curing bed, including: the folding plate comprises a first folding part and a second folding part which are connected in a rotating mode, the first folding part and the second folding part respectively comprise a first side and a second side, at least one of the first folding part and the second folding part is provided with a filtering hole penetrating through the first side and the second side, and the filtering hole is used for filtering copper foil electrolyte; and at least one of the first fold and the second fold is a powered portion; the driving structure, the driving structure with power portion sliding connection, the driving structure includes connecting portion and relative the first bulge that the connecting portion protrusion set up, first bulge is located the first side of power portion, in order to be used for when connecting portion slide along the first direction to thrust is applyed to the first side of power portion, makes first folding portion with the rotation is folded each other to the second folding portion emergence. This scheme can get in the casing more easily through drive structure and put the folded sheet.

title_en: Degradable breathable shower curtain and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of plastic bath curtains, in particular to a degradable breathable bath curtain and a preparation method thereof. Mixing 50-65% of polylactic acid particles, 15-25% of calcium carbonate, 5-15% of starch, 1-5% of plasticizer and 1-6% of color master batch according to the mass ratio, stirring and enabling the mixture to reach a semi-gelled state; and carrying out three-screw three-layer co-extrusion casting on the mixture, then stretching, carrying out corona forming, and slitting to obtain the degradable breathable bath curtain. The process breaks through the limit that the air permeability and the degradability are difficult to be considered at the same time, and the bath curtain prepared according to different raw material proportions can be decomposed into powder fragments in different time and then automatically disappear in the soil, and the pH value of the soil is not influenced. Therefore, the invention completely avoids the harm that the residual film affects the growth of crops, makes soil hardened and the water permeability worsen after similar products are discarded, and is beneficial to environmental protection.

title_en: Infrared filter of integrated heating device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared filter of an integrated heating device and a manufacturing method thereof. The infrared filter of the integrated heating device comprises a substrate, and a filter layer and a heating layer which are arranged on the substrate; the filter layer is used for filtering light irradiated to the surface of the thermopile chip; the heating layer is used for heating the cold end of the thermopile chip. Compared with the mode that the heating device is integrated on the thermopile chip in the prior art, the infrared filter integrated with the heating device has the advantages that the structure is simple, the preparation process cost is low, and the overall cost of the sensor is reduced; when the infrared filter is used, the infrared filter is only required to be installed above the thermopile chip and connected with a control circuit, and the cold end of the infrared filter can be heated while the light rays irradiated to the thermopile chip are filtered, so that the temperature of the cold end of the thermopile chip can reach the ambient temperature in a short time.

title_en: Liquid coating device
abstract_en: The liquid agent application device is provided with: the liquid supply device includes an application nozzle that is movable up and down with respect to a substrate and is relatively movable in a horizontal plane direction, an application valve that switches between a first state in which supply of a liquid agent to the application nozzle is performed and a second state in which supply of the liquid agent to the application nozzle is stopped, and a control device that controls these. The control device controls the coating nozzle to descend from the upper part of the substrate to a preset position of the substrate, controls the coating valve to be switched to the second state after waiting for a preset time after the coating valve is switched to the first state at a preset supply starting timing, and controls the coating nozzle to ascend after the timing when the front end of the coating nozzle reaches the descending end and the coating valve is switched to the second state. The supply start timing is arbitrarily set by an operator and/or a control device.

title_en: Silver-coated copper powder, preparation method, application in silver-coated copper slurry and method for detecting compactness of silver-coated layer in silver-coated copper powder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal powder, and provides silver-coated copper powder, a preparation method, application in silver-coated copper slurry and a method for detecting compactness of a silver-coated layer in the silver-coated copper powder, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing silver salt, ligand, surface modifier and solvent to obtain silver complex solution; (2) Mixing the copper powder solution with the silver complexing solution in the step (1), reacting, and drying to obtain the silver-coated copper powder; wherein the surface modifier contains a lipophilic group. The method provided by the invention is simple in process, the prepared silver-coated copper powder has oleophylic and hydrophobic characteristics and excellent conductivity, and the silver-coated layer has high compactness. The silver-coated copper slurry prepared based on the method has lower cost and excellent performance. In addition, the method for detecting the compactness of the silver coating can quantitatively analyze the compactness of the silver coating, is simple, and has transverse contrast for the compactness of different samples.

title_en: Insulating paint for new energy automobile battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses an insulating paint for a new energy automobile battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the insulating paint adopts a cationic photoinitiator to initiate alicyclic epoxy resin to carry out polymerization reaction, and UV curing is carried out at normal temperature, so that the insulating paint has the characteristics of high efficiency, energy saving and environmental protection, and the alicyclic epoxy resin has the characteristics of good adhesive force due to low curing shrinkage rate and small shrinkage stress, and can still ensure the adhesive force of a coating to a base material under the condition of high film thickness, and the alicyclic epoxy resin has good insulating property, so that the thickness of a paint film sprayed by the insulating paint at one time can reach 80 microns, and the insulating property of the insulating paint coating is greatly improved; in addition, the insulating coating does not contain volatile solvent based on the characteristics of the active monomer, and the problem of environmental pollution does not exist.

title_en: High-entropy alloy catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-entropy alloy catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a carbon material with a metal salt solution to obtain a mixture; drying, grinding and thermally shocking the mixture to obtain the high-entropy alloy catalyst; the temperature of the thermal shock is 700-1000 ℃; the thermal shock time is 8-40s. According to the invention, the thermal shock method is utilized to prepare the high-entropy alloy catalyst, the time of the whole process is less than 1 minute, the agglomeration of alloy particles can be effectively prevented, the structural uniformity of the high-entropy alloy catalyst is kept to the maximum extent, and the occurrence of phase segregation is avoided; in the thermal shock process, the carbon material is used as a carrier, so that the conductivity of the high-entropy alloy catalyst can be improved, and is also used as a reducing agent, so that metal salt is reduced into a metal simple substance, the metal simple substance is diffused at high temperature to form an alloy, and finally the high-entropy alloy catalyst is generated; the process is simple, easy to control and short in flow, and is beneficial to realizing large-scale production of the high-entropy alloy catalyst.

title_en: Superfine COP film copper plating process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a superfine COP film copper plating process, which comprises the following steps: s1: selecting materials; s2: removing oil; s3: coarsening; s4: neutralizing; s5: cleaning; s6: immersing the COP film after being soaked and cleaned into a pre-plating copper solution for electroplating, controlling the electroplating time to be 5-20min, and obtaining a copper plating layer with the thickness of 2-5 mu m on the surface of the COP film substrate; s7: then putting the COP film into a pre-plating solution containing metal cations containing iron, nickel, chromium and aluminum for pulse plating to obtain an iron-nickel-chromium-aluminum composite film; s8: finally, the COP film is put into an acid copper sulfate solution for direct current copper plating; the COP film copper plating method adopts degreasing, coarsening and neutralizing, and then forms a copper plating layer in the surface of the COP film through the processes of pre-plating copper and re-plating, the COP film copper plating aims at being developed for a future 5G,6G substrate to be used as a fine 1-2 mu m line material, and is a mode of directly using chemical medicines as electrolytic copper plating, the copper foil has better bonding fastness than splashing effect, and the copper plating layer has better bonding force.

title_en: Bismuth halide methylamine scintillation crystal with ultra-fast decay time and growth method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth halide methylamine scintillation crystal with ultra-fast decay time and a growth method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high-energy particle/ray detection. The chemical formula of the scintillation crystal related by the invention is as follows: MA  3 Bi 2 (Cl x Br y I 1‑x‑y ) 9 , wherein MA  + ＝CH 3 NH 3   + , 0.ltoreq.x.ltoreq.1, 0.ltoreq.y.ltoreq.1, 0.ltoreq.x+y.ltoreq.1. The crystal has nanosecond and subnanosecond attenuation time, has two main emission bands of 400-500nm and 600-700nm, and can be made into a scintillation crystal device for an ultrafast scintillation detector; the crystal growth method provided by the invention has the advantages of easy realization of required conditions, simple operation, no foreign elements except target crystals in a growth system, easily available raw materials, low price and mild growth conditions. The scintillation crystal can also be used as a semiconductor crystal and is used in the fields of light emitting diodes, semiconductor type photoelectric detectors and the like.

title_en: Take-up lubricating device for large-scattering-disc precise copper pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-loose-coil precise copper pipe take-up lubricating device which comprises a main seat component, a rotary driving component, an oil coating component, an oil injection component and a lubricating uniform-coating component, wherein a rotary base can automatically rotate under the condition that a double-track belt wheel drives a rotary driving gear to be matched with a main rotary gear, a coating ring and an oil distribution component are arranged in the rotary base and are integrally sealed in a closed space formed by a rear sealing ring, a front sealing ring, the rotary base and an inner rotary position, and lubricating oil can be injected into the closed space through an oil injection tank; meanwhile, the double-track belt wheel drives the stirring belt wheel and the stirring shaft to rotate through the stirring belt, so that the activity of lubricating oil in the oil injection tank can be improved; and through the friction transmission fit of the stirring belt and the uniformly wiping inner shaft, a plurality of groups of uniformly wiping pieces can be driven to uniformly wipe the surface of the copper pipe coated with the lubricating oil for the second time, and the copper pipe cleaning device has the advantages of lubricating oil saving and good lubricating effect.

title_en: High-hardness wear-resistant ball for ball mill and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-hardness wear-resistant ball for a ball mill and a preparation process thereof. And (3) adding the materials in proportion, heating to a molten state, stirring, deoxidizing, slagging off and pouring to obtain a wear-resistant ball blank, quenching the wear-resistant ball blank, heating, performing laser cladding on the surface of the wear-resistant ball blank to form a cladding layer, and annealing and cleaning to obtain a finished product. The invention can overcome the defects of the prior wear-resistant ball such as rough crystal structure, lower hardness, poor wear resistance, heat resistance, corrosion resistance and the like, and has simple process flow and prolonged service life of workpieces.

title_en: Coarse gallium purifying device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coarse gallium purification, in particular to a coarse gallium purification device, an anode rod is connected with a balancing weight through a first traction component, the balancing weight can pull the anode rod with the solid coarse gallium on the surface to perform lifting action which is separated from an electrolytic cell after the electrolysis is completed, an electromagnet is arranged at the end point of a traction path of the balancing weight, two groups of condensing tanks are connected with a driving plate through a second traction component, the driving plate is positioned on the traction path of the balancing weight, and the two groups of condensing tanks perform similar action under the traction of the driving plate so as to form a condensing cavity covered on the outer side of the anode rod in a involution way; the device also comprises a separation component for guiding the two groups of condensation tanks to separate so as to lead the anode rod of the outside solidified coarse gallium to fall back to the electrolytic cell; according to the invention, the liquid coarse gallium solution is poured on the outer side of the anode rod and is solidified and adhered on the anode rod, so that the coarse gallium block at the anode is safely and stably replaced, safety accidents are avoided, and a precondition for smooth production of electrolytic reaction is provided.

title_en: Grading tip cuprous oxide single crystal material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of catalytic materials, and relates to a graded tip cuprous oxide single crystal material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The primary structure of the material is a regular octahedron, the secondary structure is pyramid-shaped tips uniformly distributed on the primary structure, wherein the tip size is between 40 and 180 and nm, and the surface coverage is between 10 and 100 percent. The preparation method comprises the step of precipitating seed crystals in advance from a mixed solution of copper soluble salt, concentrated brine and strong alkali to obtain a suspension. And adding a reducing agent into the suspension to perform seed crystal induction growth, adding excessive distilled water to dissolve the seed crystal, filtering, washing and drying to obtain the graded tip cuprous oxide single crystal material. The invention realizes the construction of the grading tip morphology by one step of seed crystal induced nucleation growth, and simplifies the synthesis process. The seed crystal is cheap and high-yield salt, and a template and a surfactant are not needed, so that gram-scale macro preparation can be realized. The material can improve the selectivity of electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction to multi-carbon products, and has the prospect of large-scale production and application.

title_en: Preparation method of super-crosslinked polymer modified foam copper catalyst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of foam copper modification, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a super-crosslinked polymer modified foam copper catalyst, which uses concentrated sulfuric acid as a catalyst and 1,2-dichloroethane as a solvent, and transfers an obtained super-crosslinked polymer film to pretreated foam copper through Friedel-Crafts reaction of a monomer and a crosslinking agent on a catalyst/solvent interface to obtain the super-crosslinked polymer modified foam copper catalyst with good chemical stability, and combines the advantages of modified foam copper and a super-crosslinked polymer: the modified foam copper has rich porous structure, the variety of catalytic products is rich, the structure of the super-crosslinked polymer is adjustable, the specific surface area is large, the stability is good, the structure is various, the functional group is adjustable, the price is low, and other metals can be loaded; the method has the advantages of scientific and reliable principle, simple process operation and mild reaction conditions, can use various aromatic ring-containing compounds as monomers, does not need special reaction equipment and expensive catalysts, and has low production cost.

title_en: Assembled external corner wallboard and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled external corner wallboard and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of indoor decoration. The assembled external corner wallboard comprises two wallboards which are arranged side by side, wherein each wallboard comprises an inner board layer and an outer board layer which are tightly connected in the thickness direction, the adjacent positions of the inner board layers of the two wallboards are respectively provided with a vacant position, the two vacant positions are communicated to form a bending profile placing groove together, and a bending profile is embedded in the bending profile placing groove; the bending section bar is of a long frame structure, an open slot is formed in the inner side of the bending section bar, connecting concave platforms are arranged on two edges of the open slot, and connecting threaded holes are formed in the connecting concave platforms; and the connection concave table is provided with a connection reinforcing plate and is fixed by matching a screw with the connection threaded hole. The integral external corner wallboard can be integrally transported, can be directly used on site, is simple to prepare and convenient to operate, and the formed external corner is attractive and has higher quality.

title_en: Ultraviolet-proof high-shading five-layer co-extrusion heavy-load packaging film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultraviolet-proof high-shading five-layer co-extrusion heavy-duty packaging film, which is characterized in that through different raw material selections, a mixed interlayer of black master batches and white master batches is added for co-extrusion to realize an ultraviolet-proof high-shading heavy-duty package keeping white appearance; the invention solves the problem of light shielding and ultraviolet ray limitation of the traditional three-layer co-extrusion heavy-load packaging film, greatly improves the ultraviolet ray shielding and high light shielding performance of the heavy-load packaging film, keeps white and tidy appearance and expands the use space of the heavy-load packaging film.

title_en: Foam core metal composite plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal composite plate with a foaming core material and a preparation method thereof. The foamed core material metal composite board is obtained by taking foamed low-density polyethylene-linear low-density polyethylene-random copolymerized polypropylene as a core material, and performing hot-pressing compounding on the core material, a high-molecular adhesive film and an aluminum coil. The composite board has excellent physical properties, high bending strength, elastic modulus, penetrating strength and shearing strength, high peeling strength and good weather resistance. Therefore, the foam core material metal composite board is a composite board with good performance and can be used in various occasions such as advertising boards, showcases, mobile houses, caravans and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of antistatic coating of rubber product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an antistatic coating of a rubber product. The invention adopts a vacuum coating process to form a nickel layer on the surface of the rubber product and then form a nickel-tin alloy layer on the surface of the nickel layer, thus obtaining the antistatic coating. The invention can form an antistatic coating with good uniformity and stable performance on the surface of the rubber product, and endows the rubber product with good electromagnetic shielding effect; compared with the traditional preparation method of the anti-static rubber sole, the anti-static coating is prepared on the surface of the rubber sole by applying the technology disclosed by the invention, so that the electromagnetic shielding effect of the rubber sole is obviously improved.

title_en: Incomplete polar plate tears to shreds and adds pot device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lead electrolytic refining, in particular to a residual polar plate shredding and pot adding device which is arranged outside a lead pot and comprises a shredder, a lifting belt, a conveying belt and an unloading belt, wherein two ends of the lifting belt are respectively matched with the shredder and the conveying belt, one end of the conveying belt, far away from the lifting belt, is matched with the unloading belt, the unloading belt is provided with an unloading mechanism, and the upper end of the lead pot is covered with an environment-friendly pot cover.

title_en: Infrared curing device for repairing non-excavation pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline repair, in particular to an infrared curing device for repairing a trenchless pipeline. Including the fixed disk, the fixed disk right-hand member is fixed with square pipe, and the fixed disk right side is provided with rather than endocentric movable plate, and square pipe runs through the square hole on the movable plate, and square intraductal drive movable plate that is provided with is along the drive arrangement of the length direction motion of square pipe, and a plurality of recesses have been seted up to fixed disk right-hand member outside equipartition, rotates through the round pin axle in the recess and is connected with the bull stick, is fixed with the lamp stand on the bull stick, installs the infrared lamp pipe in the lamp stand, sets up the draw-in groove that corresponds with the recess on the movable plate. When the movable disc is arranged in the inner lining pipe, the movable disc can move towards the fixed disc, so that the overall volume of the curing device is reduced, a constructor can conveniently move the curing device in the inspection well, and enough space is provided for the constructor to move the curing device in the inspection well.

title_en: TPO (thermoplastic polyolefin) skin produced by calendering method and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses a TPO (thermoplastic polyolefin) skin produced by a calendering method and a preparation method thereof, wherein the TPO skin comprises a coating, a TPO glue layer and a PPF (polypropylene) layer which are arranged from top to bottom; the thickness of the TPO glue layer is 0.6-0.8mm, the thickness of the PPF layer is 2.5-3.0mm, and the residual thickness of the TPO glue layer after laser weakening is 0.2 +/-0.02 mm; the TPO skin covers the surface of the instrument panel above the airbag. The elongation at break of the TPO skin is more than or equal to 300 percent, and after laser weakening, the surface can not have weakening marks visible to naked eyes. The invention provides a preparation method of TPO skin produced by a calendering method, and the TPO film prepared by the calendering method has the advantages of uniform thickness, small internal stress, consistent expansion rate and high tensile strength, and is more suitable for automobile interior decoration.

title_en: Method for preparing titanium alloy multi-element ceramic modified high-temperature oxidation resistant layer by laser
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a titanium alloy multielement ceramic modified high-temperature-resistant oxidation layer by laser, which mainly comprises the steps of coating a preset coating on the surface of a substrate, and then forming the high-temperature-resistant oxidation layer on the surface of the preset coating by laser melting deposition, wherein the preset coating consists of raw materials of Ni625 and SiC in a mass ratio of 92:8, the high-temperature-resistant oxidation layer consists of raw materials of Ni625, ni-coated WC and SiC in a mass ratio of 86:6:8, and Ni accounts for 15wt% in the Ni-coated WC. According to the invention, ni625 (Ni-coated WC) SiC is deposited on the surface of the preset coating by laser melting deposition to form a high-temperature oxidation resistant layer, so that the TA1 titanium alloy with good surface morphology and strong high-temperature oxidation resistance can be obtained. The method has the characteristics of simple and convenient process, strong practicability, convenient popularization and application and the like.

title_en: Water electrolysis oxygen evolution catalyst, preparation method thereof and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrolytic water oxygen evolution catalyst, a preparation method thereof and an alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production device, wherein the electrolytic water oxygen evolution catalyst is a spherical catalyst containing nickel and iron, the surface of the spherical catalyst is provided with a porous structure with nanoscale pores, and the molar ratio of nickel to iron is 1 (0.1-0.5). The preparation method of the electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalyst comprises the following steps: dissolving a nickel precursor and an iron precursor in a solvent, adding a spherical template agent, a surfactant and a precipitator, then carrying out hydrothermal reaction, separating a solid-phase product and sintering; the spherical template agent is polystyrene microsphere and/or inorganic carbon microsphere. The electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalyst is hollow spherical, the surface of the electrolyzed water oxygen evolution catalyst has a porous structure, the specific surface area of the catalyst is large, the catalytic activity is high, and the current density and the oxygen evolution performance of an electrolytic cell are obviously improved.

title_en: Production process for improving bubble yarn of lithium electric copper foil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process for improving bubble yarns of lithium electric copper foil, which relates to the technical field of lithium electric copper foil and comprises the following steps: s1, preparing electrolyte: mixing sulfuric acid and lead carbonate solution to prepare electrolyte, heating and preserving the electrolyte; s2, preparing an additive: preparing a grain refiner, a wetting agent and a high leveling agent, and mixing and stirring the grain refiner, the wetting agent and the high leveling agent according to the installation proportion to form a mixed additive; s3, cutting the Harlin groove into pieces: adding the electrolyte and the mixed additive into a Halin tank, and tabletting the electrolyte in the Halin tank; s4, electroplating a lithium electric copper foil; s5, detecting a finished product; by adding the grain refiner, the wetting agent and the high-order leveling agent into the electrolyte, the copper foil is uniform and consistent in the continuous production process of the copper foil, no color difference stripes are formed, and from the microstructure, after the additive process is adjusted, the overall grain size of the copper foil is reduced, the foil surface is smoother, and the uniformity of the foil surface is increased.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: Provided is a polycrystalline diamond substrate which can reduce the cost for suppressing warpage. For this purpose, the polycrystalline diamond substrate is a polycrystalline diamond substrate having a1 st main surface and a2 nd main surface, and a surface having a smaller average particle diameter than the average particle diameters of the 1 st main surface and the 2 nd main surface is located between the 1 st main surface and the 2 nd main surface.

title_en: Automatic grease injection machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the oil blanket grease filling technology and specifically relates to an automatic grease filling machine is related to, it includes the workstation, be connected with material feeding unit, grease filling device and unloading subassembly on the workstation, grease filling device includes mounting bracket and grease ration valve, the mounting bracket is connected on the workstation, vertical direction sliding connection is followed on the mounting bracket to the grease ration valve, can dismantle on the grease ration valve and be connected with the grease filling pipe that is used for annotating fat to the oil blanket lip, the axial of grease filling pipe sets up along vertical direction, material feeding unit is used for transferring the oil blanket to under the grease filling pipe, the unloading subassembly is used for shifting out under the oil blanket of accomplishing the grease filling from the grease filling pipe, and this application has the effect that improves the oil blanket and annotates fat efficiency.

title_en: AED molding method for magnesium alloy pen electric case and molded product corresponding to AED molding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming method of an AED (electro-optic device) of a magnesium alloy pen electric case and a corresponding formed product thereof, wherein the forming method comprises the following steps: performing film treatment after the magnesium alloy product is preliminarily processed; spraying a conductive paint layer, and selecting the film thickness of the coating according to the selected conductive paint; the product after the conductive paint layer is sprayed is pretreated and cleaned by pure water, and is immersed into an AED (anodic electrophoretic coating) bath solution for color processing; after the product is processed by an AED, pure water is used for cleaning, and the product is sent into an oven for constant temperature baking; cooling and inspecting the product, and packaging; the molded product is an electronic product manufactured according to the process method. The invention has the beneficial effects that the color unevenness of the magnesium alloy coating layer can be shielded, the purpose of electric conduction can be achieved, and the AED processing treatment is convenient.

title_en: Novel electrolytic tank structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel electrolytic tank structure, which relates to the technical field of electrolytic equipment and comprises a front cover, a rear cover and an electrode plate module arranged in a cavity formed by surrounding the front cover and the rear cover, wherein the front cover is provided with a liquid inlet or a liquid outlet, the rear cover is provided with a liquid outlet or a liquid inlet, and the rear cover or the front cover is also provided with an air outlet. The electrode plate module comprises a plurality of electrode plate mechanisms, the electrode plate mechanisms comprise the spacers, the spacers are arranged on the spacers, and the distance between two adjacent electrode plates can be accurately controlled by changing the thickness of the spacers, so that the space utilization in the electrolytic tank is more reasonable, the electrode plates can be prevented from being mutually clung, and the electrolytic efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Cleaning, air drying and spraying device and method for post insulators of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cleaning, air drying and spraying device for a post insulator of a transformer substation, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged on a moving mechanism, one ends of a first telescopic mechanical arm and a second telescopic mechanical arm are both arranged on the lifting mechanism in a sliding mode and are respectively connected with a sliding driving mechanism, a cleaning mechanism is arranged at the other end of the first telescopic mechanical arm, an air drying and spraying mechanism is arranged at the other end of the second telescopic mechanical arm, a control module is arranged on the moving mechanism, and the lifting mechanism, the first telescopic mechanical arm, the second telescopic mechanical arm, the air drying and spraying mechanism and the cleaning mechanism are all in signal connection with the control module. The invention also discloses a method for cleaning, air-drying and spraying the post insulator of the transformer substation, which comprises the following steps: moving; lifting; alignment; cleaning; retracting; removing the abdication; aligning and extending, and air-drying the spraying mechanism to be in place; air-drying and spraying. The device and the method for cleaning, air-drying and spraying the post insulator of the transformer substation are good in operation efficiency and operation effect, high in safety and capable of improving the automation degree and the intelligent level.

title_en: Supported iridium catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supported iridium catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst comprises a titanium oxide carrier and iridium metal supported on the carrier; the XRD spectrum of the catalyst has characteristic peaks of metallic iridium and no characteristic peaks of titanium oxide. When the catalyst is used for catalyzing the anodic oxygen evolution reaction, the catalyst has high catalytic activity and good stability, and can obviously reduce the iridium consumption. The catalyst of the invention has simple preparation process and convenient control, and is beneficial to mass production.

title_en: Reaction cavity
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of semiconductors and discloses a reaction chamber, including the cavity with be located the heating device in the cavity, heating device includes microscope carrier, heating module, lifting unit and sweeps the module. The carrier is provided with a bearing surface, and the central part of the bearing surface is used for placing a wafer to be heated. The lifting assembly is used for driving the wafer to move relative to the carrier so as to enable the wafer to be arranged at intervals or contacted with the bearing surface. The heating module is used for heating the bearing surface so as to raise the temperature of the bearing surface. The purging module comprises a plurality of purging holes, the plurality of purging holes are distributed at the edge of the carrying platform along the circumferential direction of the carrying surface, the plurality of purging holes are protruded out of the carrying surface of the carrying platform, the purging holes are used for purging gas to the central part of the carrying surface of the carrying platform, and the gas flows back to the carrying surface. The reaction cavity disclosed by the application can enable the wafer to be heated more uniformly, so that the risk of wafer deformation is reduced.

title_en: Adsorption mechanism and dispensing carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adsorption mechanism and a dispensing carrier, and relates to the technical field of display screen production. The adsorption mechanism comprises a bearing table and an adjusting assembly, wherein a negative pressure cavity is formed in the bearing table, a plurality of adsorption holes are formed in the table top of the bearing table and are arranged at intervals along a first direction, the bearing table is also provided with an air suction hole, and the air suction hole and the adsorption holes are communicated with the negative pressure cavity; the adjusting component comprises a sliding block, the sliding block is arranged in the negative pressure cavity along the first direction in a sliding manner and is in sealing butt with the inner wall of the negative pressure cavity, one side of the sliding block is provided with a negative pressure space in the negative pressure cavity, the air suction hole is communicated with the negative pressure space, and the sliding block can adjust the number of the adsorption holes communicated with the negative pressure space through sliding. The adsorption mechanism can reduce project cost, save time for readjusting the parallelism of the dispensing carrier and the dispensing head, and improve production efficiency.

title_en: Ceramic wafer laminating shaping device, production line and shaping method
abstract_en: The invention provides a ceramic wafer laminating shaping device, a production line and a shaping method, which comprise a shaping base, an extrusion unit, a negative pressure grabbing unit, a laminating unit and a carrying unit; the method comprises the steps of firstly extruding and shaping a plurality of ceramic plates on the surface of a shaping base through an extruding unit, then carrying a shaping film to a preset position through a carrying unit, finally coating the shaping film through a film covering unit, and coating the shaping film on the surfaces of the ceramic plates at one time to position the ceramic plates at one time and finish the gluing process. The invention can solve the problems of low production efficiency and poor quality of finished products in the traditional gluing process of ceramic plates.

title_en: Medical packaging film with high flatness and high barrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-flatness high-barrier medical packaging film which sequentially comprises a sealing layer, a resin bonding layer, a barrier layer, a resin bonding layer and a sealing layer from outside to inside. The production process adopts an extrusion coating mode, does not use an adhesive or a solvent, and has extremely high compatibility of the packaging material.

title_en: Intelligent workshop silicon wafer production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of new energy silicon wafer materials, and discloses an intelligent workshop silicon wafer production method, which comprises the following steps: s1: preparing materials, namely cutting off two ends of a wafer rod, and grinding and polishing the end face and the outer wall; s2: classifying and storing, namely dividing the prepared wafer rod into N small cylinders, and classifying the marks according to the conductivity; s3: cutting, namely cutting the classified small cylinders into small cuboids and polishing; s4: and (3) the finished product is manufactured, the materials obtained in the step (S3) are glued and adhered together by the glass, then the glass is cut and not cut through, the glass and the materials are always connected together, the finished product manufacturing is completed, the production efficiency is improved through automatically completing the control of the materials and equipment in a plurality of production procedures, the human error probability is reduced, and the production process of the current silicon wafer can be automatically controlled on line.

title_en: Multilayer coating using digital printing
abstract_en: A multilayer coating system for a metal substrate is described. The coating system includes a digitally printed coating applied to the substrate and a clear coating applied over the digitally printed coating. The digitally printed coating is applied using a spray process and the ink used is an inorganic ink. The described multilayer coating system exhibits a color change (Δe) of no more than 5 units.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant white chromium circulation process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of white chromium electroplating technology, and discloses a high Wen Baige cycle resistant technology, which comprises the following steps: dewaxing the workpiece stainless steel; removing wax by ultrasonic wave; removing oil from stainless steel; electrolytic degreasing; acid activation; impact nickel; activating; copper acid; semi-bright nickel; bright nickel; nickel sealing; activating chromium; washing with hot water; and (5) drying. The release agent has certain interface fluidity, can reduce the interface strength, and can obtain a more complete coverage of the copper mold surface. After acid copper, a one-time demoulding process is added, and the acid copper oxide layer can be effectively removed and the oxidation of the acid copper oxide layer can be restrained by soaking the acid copper in a tank with a mould release agent, so that a semi-bright nickel layer is effectively attached, and through experiments, the product is excellent in performance, and decorative white chromium can be kept at a high temperature of 600 ℃ without popping and foaming, so that the quality of the product is greatly improved.

title_en: Hydrogen energy distributed cogeneration system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen energy distributed cogeneration system, which comprises a hydrogen production system and a fuel cell system, wherein hydrogen provided by the hydrogen production system is introduced into the fuel cell system, hydrogen ions pass through a fuel cell in the fuel cell system to reach a cathode, electrons reach the cathode through an external circuit, the electrons form current in the external circuit, and the electrons are connected to output electric energy to a load through a connecting wire; oxygen or air reaches the cathode through a pipeline or an air guide plate at the other end of the fuel cell, and under the action of a cathode catalyst, the oxygen reacts with hydrogen ions and electrons to generate water; the water and heat formed by the fuel cell are connected with a hot water tank through a preheating recovery pipeline, and the hot water tank provides warm water for the pipe network; the hydrogen production system comprises a natural gas hydrogen production system and an electrolytic water hydrogen production system, and hydrogen generated by the natural gas hydrogen production system and the electrolytic water hydrogen production system is reused through the fuel cell.

title_en: Cage-shaped organic-inorganic hybrid polyiodine crystal material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cage-shaped organic-inorganic hybrid polyiodine crystal material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to a new material technology, which is characterized in that the molecular formula is [ (C)  6  H  21  I  26  O  3  S  3  )2]n, wherein n is a natural number greater than or equal to 1, and the monomer molecular structural formula is The name is: 52 dimethyl sulfonium iodide; which is a triclinic system with space group of The material has stable thermochemical and electrochemical properties, is more stable when applied to a battery anode material, overcomes the defects of insufficient iodine content, low energy density and the shuttle effect of the traditional I3-ion, and has potential application prospect in the field of energy storage batteries.

title_en: Full-automatic coating and automatic slitting device for gel patch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic coating and automatic slitting device for gel patches, which comprises a conveying assembly, wherein a rotating roller is rotatably arranged on the conveying assembly, and a plurality of rectangular frame cutters are arranged on an outer array of the rotating roller; the fixed frame, fixed frame and conveying component fixed connection, the inside of fixed frame is equipped with initiative drive assembly, be equipped with drive assembly between rotor and the initiative drive assembly, be equipped with the movable plate on the drive assembly, the top fixedly connected with movable seat of movable plate, one side fixedly connected with glue section of thick bamboo of movable seat, the bottom of glue section of thick bamboo is equipped with the rubber coating brush board. The invention not only drives the glue cylinder to reciprocate to carry out gluing, but also drives the rectangular frame cutter to rotate to cut, so that the cutting can be carried out in place at one time, the processing efficiency of products is greatly improved, the glue can be stirred during gluing, the smooth blanking of the glue is facilitated, and the uniformity of the glue spreading of the adhesive cloth is facilitated.

title_en: Bismuth sulfide nano hollow sphere catalyst for producing formic acid by carbon dioxide reduction, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a bismuth sulfide nano hollow sphere catalyst for producing formic acid by reducing carbon dioxide, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrochemistry. The invention synthesizes the bismuth sulfide nano hollow sphere with uniform shape by using the zinc sulfide nano sphere as a template through a hydrothermal method and an oil bath method, and is used for reducing cathode carbon dioxide to realize the purpose of high-efficiency formic acid production. The electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction catalyst is used for electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction reaction, and has the advantages of high efficiency, good selectivity, stable performance and good application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength and impact-resistant rubber material for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber, in particular to a preparation method of a high-strength and impact-resistant rubber material for a vehicle. Firstly preparing irregular alumina powder by hot pressing and crushing, then preparing a high-strength layer by adding irregular alumina, preparing an impact-resistant layer by a supercritical technology, and finally bonding the high-strength layer and the impact-resistant layer to obtain the vehicle rubber material. Compared with the traditional process, the preparation method of the vehicle rubber material with high strength and impact resistance improves the strength, friction resistance and impact resistance of the vehicle rubber material, has outstanding advantages, and is suitable for industrial popularization.

title_en: Organic crystal material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic semiconductors, in particular to an organic crystal material, a preparation method of the organic crystal material and application thereof, wherein the organic crystal material comprises a host material and a guest material, and the structure of the host material is shown as a general formula (I): the structure of the guest material is shown as a general formula (II): (II). The invention discloses a novel organic crystal material, which is obtained by mixing common thermally activated delayed fluorescence organic small molecules and metal complexes as main guest materials, preparing an amorphous film by a solution method, and then heating and annealing. The preparation method of the organic crystal material is simple and efficient. The TADF organic micromolecule used in the invention has the advantages of mature synthesis process and low synthesis cost.

title_en: Preparation process of high-punching-depth corrosion-resistant aluminum plastic film
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation process of a high-punching-depth corrosion-resistant aluminum plastic film in the technical field of lithium battery flexible packaging. The preparation process comprises the following steps: s1, raw material pretreatment: passivating pretreatment is carried out on the aluminum foil layer by adopting a passivating agent, so that an anti-corrosion aluminum foil layer is obtained; carrying out plasma pretreatment on the nylon layer to obtain a rough nylon layer; corona pretreatment is carried out on the polypropylene layer to obtain a rough polypropylene layer; s2, smearing an adhesive between the rough nylon layer and the anti-corrosion aluminum foil layer and between the anti-corrosion aluminum foil layer and the rough polypropylene layer, and pressing to prepare an aluminum-plastic film; wherein, the passivating agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of fluorozirconic acid, 1-5 parts of molybdate, 15-40 parts of titanate coupling agent modified nano titanium dioxide, 0.5-3 parts of corrosion inhibitor and 30-60 parts of deionized water. The aluminum plastic film prepared by the method has the properties of high punching depth and electrolyte corrosion resistance, and has wide prospects in the market of lithium battery flexible packages.

title_en: Evaluation method for silicon carbide substrate
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a novel evaluation method suitable for evaluating a large-caliber SiC substrate. The invention is a method for evaluating a SiC substrate, which is characterized by comprising an image acquisition step of acquiring an image I by entering an electron beam PE at an incidence angle theta inclined with respect to a normal N of a {0001} plane of the SiC substrate (10), wherein the incidence angle theta is 10 DEG or less.

title_en: Steam-water separation device for preparing nitrogen trifluoride and preparation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a steam-water separation device for preparing nitrogen trifluoride, which comprises a steam-water separator, a cyclone separator and a freeze dryer; wherein the steam-water separator comprises: a container; a first air inlet arranged at the top of the container; the water-vapor separation pipelines are vertically arranged at the middle upper part of the container in parallel, wherein each water-vapor separation pipeline is further provided with a plurality of water-vapor separation cavities along the height direction of the water-vapor separation pipeline, and the water-vapor separation cavities are staggered; a water storage part formed at the middle and lower parts of the container and used for receiving the water of the water-vapor separation pipeline; an air outlet pipe penetrates through the water-vapor separation pipeline from the top of the container, and the air outlet pipe is communicated with the water storage part; the first air outlet is communicated with the air outlet pipe; and a water outlet arranged at the bottom of the container. The invention can reduce the water vapor in the nitrogen trifluoride to below 300ppmv through three-stage linkage control, thereby reducing the influence of the water vapor on the adsorbent in the subsequent adsorption device to the greatest extent.

title_en: Multi-atom doped surface platinum-rich catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyatomic doped surface platinum-rich catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of functional material preparation. The preparation method of the polyatomic doped surface platinum-rich catalyst comprises the steps of dispersing carbon black in a polyol solution, adding a platinum salt solution and a metal salt for solvothermal reaction, calcining a solid product obtained by the solvothermal reaction, and dissolving non-platinum metals on the surface of the solid product after the calcining is finished to obtain the polyatomic doped surface platinum-rich catalyst. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, is universally applicable to various metal types, and can adjust the metal types according to the reaction requirement to obtain the high-performance catalyst for corresponding reaction.

title_en: Production device for preparing nitrogen trifluoride gas by long-term continuous electrolysis and application
