abstract_en: The invention discloses a production device for preparing nitrogen trifluoride gas by long-term continuous electrolysis, which comprises a raw material tank, a first pump body, an electrolytic tank, a sedimentation tank, a second pump body, a filter and a collecting tank which are sequentially connected through pipelines, wherein the third pump body is also connected with the top of the raw material tank, the electrolytic tank comprises a tank body, a cathode cover is arranged at the upper end of the tank body, an anode cover is arranged in the middle of the cathode cover, the anode cover and the cathode cover are in sealing connection, one end of the anode cover is provided with an air outlet pipe in a penetrating way, the other end of the anode cover is provided with an anode inert gas inlet in a penetrating way, and a cathode air outlet and a cathode inert gas inlet are arranged in the cathode cover in a penetrating way. The invention utilizes the electrolyte circulation to achieve the self-purification effect, solves the problem that the traditional electrolytic tank terminates the electrolysis due to the deposition of electrolytic solid wastes in the electrolyte, can directly replace the anode, and solves the problem that the traditional electrolytic tank terminates the electrolysis due to the expiration of the anode.

title_en: Stabilization treatment agent for promoting formation of compact and stable rust layer of weathering steel
abstract_en: A stabilizing agent for promoting formation of compact stable rust layer of weathering steel comprises an accelerator and a slow-release agent, wherein the accelerator comprises Cu  2+  0.5 to 5 weight percent of salt and Fe  2+  0.5 to 5 weight percent of salt and SO4  2‑  0.5 to 10 weight percent of salt and Cl  ‑  0.01 to 15 percent by weight of salt; the slow release agent comprises MoO  4   2‑  0 to 4wt% of salt, HPO  4   2‑  0 to 3wt% of salt and CaCl  2  0 to 4wt% of one or more, the balance being solvent. The first pass in the present invention comprises Cu  2+  Salts, fe  2+  Salts, SO4  2‑  Salts, cl  ‑  The salt accelerator promotes the rapid generation of rust layer on the surface of weathering steel, and MoO is added  4   2‑  Salt, HPO  4   2‑  Salts or CaCl  2  The corrosion inhibitor can form insoluble precipitate in the rust layer with the accelerator added in the earlier stage, and the insoluble precipitate can fill the defect of the rust layer and promote the rust layer to be moreDensification is carried out to accelerate densification of the rust layer. Therefore, under the synergistic effect of the accelerator and the soluble salt of the slow-release agent, the surface of the weathering steel can be promoted to be uniformly corroded, a compact and stable protective rust layer can be rapidly formed, and the problems that the stability of the weathering steel rust layer is poor, the formation requirement of the rust layer is high and the preparation of the stabilizing agent is complex in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant flame-retardant PETG (polyethylene terephthalate glycol) floor film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrosion-resistant flame-retardant PETG (polyethylene terephthalate glycol) floor film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PETG floor film sequentially comprises a PETG base layer, a first bonding layer, a functional film layer, a second bonding layer, a PETG white film layer, a third bonding layer, a printing layer and a transparent film layer from bottom to top; the functional film layer comprises a flame retardant layer and an anticorrosive layer from bottom to top. The beneficial effects are that: according to the invention, the flame-retardant layer and the anti-corrosion layer are arranged, so that the PETG floor film has flame retardance and anti-corrosion property, and in order to make up the characteristic that the PETG floor film is not easy to attach, an adhesive layer is added between the PETG base layer and the PETG white film layer when the PETG base layer and the PETG white film layer are adhered to other coatings, so that the adhesion between the PETG base layer and the PETG white film layer and the other coatings is reinforced, the coatings are not easy to peel off, the phase change can improve the flame retardance and the anti-corrosion property of the PETG floor film, and finally, the transparent film layer is adhered to protect the printing layer.

title_en: CPGA tube shell electroplating method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lead electroplating, and discloses a CPGA shell electroplating method, which changes an internal circuit of CPGA by design, distributes a summarized line for electroplating into CPGA which can be broken off, connects a plurality of CPGAs together, can perform uniform electroplating processing, is simple and easy to implement, can greatly improve the electroplating efficiency, saves the production cost, can be finished after the electroplating is finished, improves the CPGA winding electroplating process, ensures that the winding is uniformly and precisely wound on the lead, avoids forming a 'bulge' between wires, ensures that the electroplating liquid is more uniform in adhesion, improves the performance and quality of processed products, ensures that the electroplating liquid circularly flows in the electroplating process, ensures that the electroplating liquid in electroplating equipment is uniformly mixed, keeps the concentration balance of the electroplating liquid in different distribution areas, ensures that the electroplating work is more stable, and ensures that the electroplating layer distribution is more uniform.

title_en: Color-changing breathable mesh cloth and production equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a color-changing breathable mesh cloth, which comprises a color-changing mesh cloth layer and a breathable flexible layer, wherein the color-changing mesh cloth layer is fixedly connected with the breathable flexible layer. According to the color-changing breathable mesh, the three color-changing yarns are wound on the elastic core wire to form the cored wire, compared with the color-changing powder which is coated on the surface of the fabric through the powder, the color-changing breathable mesh has the advantages that the fabric is endowed with excellent color-changing effect through the color-changing performance of the fiber, the color-changing breathable mesh has lasting and efficient performance, and the extensibility is good. A color-changing breathable mesh production device comprises a double needle bar warp knitting machine, two wire feeding machines and two mesh winding machines. According to the color-changing breathable mesh production equipment, old yarns and new yarns are butted by the wiring assembly and the winding assembly, so that time is wasted by stopping wiring when the yarns are insufficient in weaving, and three color-changing yarns are stably wound on the surface of an elastic core wire through the winding assembly to form a core-spun wire for weaving.

title_en: Plasma spraying method of roller surface resistance coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plasma spraying method of a roller surface resistance coating, which comprises the following steps: spraying the bottom layer of the roller body; spraying a resistance coating on the surface of the bottom layer of the roller body: preparing a resistor coating material: selecting titanium oxide powder (TiO ₂) and alumina powder (AL ₂ O ₃), and adjusting the mass ratio of the titanium oxide powder (TiO ₂) to the alumina powder (AL ₂ O ₃) according to the requirement of the resistivity of the resistance coating; plasma spraying by a spray gun; hole sealing treatment; baking: after hole sealing treatment, the roller body is put into a baking oven for baking; grinding and polishing to obtain the resistive coating with the required resistivity. This patent can be according to market customer resistance coating resistivity's specific demand, through the preparation to two kinds of coating materials, regulates and control the size of resistance coating resistivity, not only satisfies and has realized the individual case customization demand of roll body resistance coating resistivity, has still ensured resistance coating's wear resistance and corrosion resistance moreover.

title_en: Conductive material for FPC (Flexible printed Circuit) and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation of a conductive material, in particular to a conductive material for FPC (flexible printed circuit) and a preparation method thereof, wherein the device comprises the following steps: step one: placing a conductive film between the sealing belt and the supporting belt, wherein the contact wheel I and the contact wheel II are contacted with the conductive film; step two: the contact wheel II or the contact wheel I is connected with the cathode of the power supply, and the electroplating anode is connected with the anode of the power supply; step three: the liquid spraying cavity sprays electroplating liquid on the conductive film, the sealing belt shields the conductive film, and copper foil is formed on the conductive film by electroplating; copper foils of different widths can be prepared.

title_en: Preparation method of titanium-based anode material with iridium-tantalum coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a titanium-based anode material with an iridium tantalum coating. According to the method, iridium metal salt solution and tantalum metal chloride alcohol solution are mixed uniformly in a specific proportion, brush-coated on the surface of a metal plate subjected to sand blasting, acid pickling and surface treatment for multiple times, and sintered for multiple times to form the anode material for electrolysis. The anode material obtained by the method has the characteristics of high electrolysis efficiency and stable and controllable voltage of the electrolytic tank in the electrolysis process; the manufacturing process of the electrode material has high controllability, the anode material with the unit area precious metal coating amount interval of 5-100 g can be prepared according to the application requirement of the electrode material, and the anode material can be used for manufacturing electrolytic processes such as aluminum foils, copper foils, degradable plastics, oxygen production, new energy batteries, automobile appearance and the like.

title_en: Recyclable high-barrier multilayer heat-shrinkable film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a recyclable full PO high-barrier multilayer heat-shrinkable film, a preparation method, application and a recycling method thereof, relates to the technical field of packaging materials, and relates to recycling of plastic resources. The total polyolefin content of the recyclable full PO high-barrier multilayer heat-shrinkable film provided by the invention is more than 90 wt%. The film leftover materials generated in the process of preparing the multilayer heat-shrinkable film or the waste film after consumption and use can smoothly enter a recycling-sorting-regenerating-applying system for recycling, and meanwhile, the multilayer heat-shrinkable film has high oxygen resistance, can prolong the shelf life of the product to the greatest extent, and effectively prevents the loss of aroma and quality.

title_en: High-conductivity copper graphene composite material and continuous preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-conductivity copper graphene composite material, which comprises a copper substrate and a graphene layer, wherein the graphene layer comprises a graphene bottom layer and a plurality of graphene units, the graphene bottom layer is covered on the surface of the copper substrate, the plurality of graphene units are continuously or intermittently distributed on the surface of the graphene bottom layer, each graphene unit comprises a plurality of graphene unit layers which are sequentially stacked from bottom to top and have the same area or sequentially reduced, the graphene coverage rate of the surface of the copper substrate is more than or equal to 96%, the characteristic peak of a graphene Raman spectrum comprises a D peak and a G peak, and the intensity ratio I of the D peak to the G peak  D  /I  G  0 to 0.55. The invention can obtain a high-quality graphene layer, provide a continuous transmission path for electrons, reduce the scattering of electrons,and the copper base material is prevented from being oxidized or corroded, the conductivity and the conductivity stability of the copper graphene composite material are improved, the conductivity of the high-conductivity copper graphene composite material is not lower than 103% IACS, and the performance requirement of the related technical field on the high conductivity is met.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant treatment device for processing metal ship pipe fittings
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-corrosion treatment device for processing metal ship pipe fittings, which relates to the technical field of pipe fitting corrosion prevention and comprises an electroplating pool and a bracket, wherein one end of the electroplating pool is fixedly connected with a water outlet pipe. According to the utility model, when the electroplating liquid contains impurities, the electroplating liquid is pumped out through the water outlet pipe, impurities in the electroplating liquid can be filtered through the filter screen, the first extrusion block can be driven to impact the second extrusion block in the rotating process of the mounting block, the filter screen can be enabled to vibrate repeatedly and rapidly through spring rebound, impurities can be prevented from accumulating on the surface of the filter screen, the filter screen can be prevented from being blocked, the water spray pipe can be enabled to rotate subsequently, the electroplating liquid and additives can be fully mixed, the safety of equipment is ensured, the mixing quality between the electroplating liquids can be improved, and the electroplating efficiency and quality of the equipment can be improved.

title_en: Pure electric multifunctional train carriage plugging vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pure electric multifunctional train carriage plugging vehicle, which comprises an electric vehicle body, wherein a control device is arranged on the vehicle body, a swing arm device is rotatably arranged on the vehicle body, and the swing arm device is in transmission connection with a rotary driving device; the automobile body rear portion is provided with the system of gluing, the system of gluing is connected with first glue spraying device through first defeated rubber tube, first defeated rubber tube can swing under the drive of swing arm device, the system of gluing is still connected with the second through the second defeated rubber tube and spouts the gluey device, the system of gluing still is connected with high-pressure air source and takes place the system, controlling device connects rotary driving device. The invention realizes the simultaneous operation and leakage stoppage of side doors, holes and other positions on two sides of the train carriage, reduces the manual consumption, saves the leakage stoppage raw materials, avoids the man-machine crossing risk, improves the safety, has low labor intensity, is simple to operate, is environment-friendly and has high intelligent efficiency, and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: Fe-based WC/TiN/ZrO for sealing element 2 /CeO 2 Wear-resistant coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Fe-based WC/TiN/ZrO for a sealing element  2  /CeO  2  The wear-resistant coating comprises the following components in percentage by mass: WC 12-16%, nano TiN 5-15%, nano ZrO  2  /CeO  2  3.5% -7.5% of rare earth compound and the balance of Fe-based alloyAnd (3) powder. The preparation method comprises the following steps: WC powder, nano TiN powder and nano ZrO  2  /CeO  2  Mixing the rare earth compound powder and the Fe-based alloy powder uniformly by adopting a mode of combining ultrasonic waves and ball milling to prepare a cladding raw material, cladding the cladding raw material on the surface of the sealing ring by utilizing a laser cladding technology to obtain the Fe-based WC/TiN/ZrO for the sealing member  2  /CeO  2  And (3) a wear-resistant coating. The wear-resistant coating prepared by the method has the advantages of good toughness, good corrosion resistance and difficult spalling.

title_en: Laser processing system of integrated MBE device
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser processing system of an integrated MBE device, which comprises an MBE growth chamber, a sample table, an optical path mechanism, a heat insulation mechanism and a cooling mechanism, wherein one side of the MBE growth chamber is provided with an opening; the sample platform is fixed in the MBE growth chamber and corresponds to the position of the opening, and the sample platform is used for placing a substrate sample material; the light path mechanism is relatively arranged on one side of the MBE growth chamber, the light emitting end is arranged on the light path mechanism, one side of the light emitting end penetrates through the opening of the MBE growth chamber and stretches into the interior of the MBE growth chamber and is arranged at a relative interval with the sample table, the light path mechanism is in sealing connection with the opening of the MBE growth chamber, the light path mechanism is integrated in the MBE device, the sample is processed in a short distance by adopting a laser direct writing mode, the laser focusing capability is improved, and the precision and quality of laser processing are effectively ensured.

title_en: Hot galvanizing groove
abstract_en: The application relates to a hot galvanizing bath, which comprises a galvanizing bath body, wherein one side of the galvanizing bath body is an overflow side, the other side of the galvanizing bath body is a fluid supplementing side, the height of the side wall of the overflow side is smaller than that of the side wall of the fluid supplementing side, the overflow side is provided with an overflow groove for collecting liquid flowing out of the galvanizing bath body, a zinc guide pipe is communicated between the overflow groove and the galvanizing bath body, the communicating part of the zinc guide pipe and the galvanizing bath body is positioned at the fluid supplementing side, the communicating part of the zinc guide pipe and the overflow groove is positioned at the bottom side of the overflow groove, and a zinc pumping pump for pumping zinc liquid in the overflow groove into the galvanizing bath body is arranged on the zinc guide pipe; during galvanization, the scum on the surface of the zinc liquid does not need to be salvaged by additional tools of workers, so that the potential safety hazard of workers in working is reduced, and the surface quality of a galvanized part is improved during galvanization because the scum continuously enters the overflow groove, so that the quality of a product is improved, the product does not need to be subjected to additional process local treatment in the later stage, and the product production is more energy-saving.

title_en: Vertical liquid medicine soaking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical liquid medicine soaking device, which comprises a frame, a liquid medicine tank, a conveying device and a clamp module, wherein the liquid medicine tank is arranged on the frame and is provided with an inlet end and an outlet end, liquid medicine for soaking plate-shaped materials can be stored in the liquid medicine tank, the conveying device is arranged on the frame and extends at least from the inlet end to the outlet end, the conveying device is arranged above the liquid medicine tank, the clamp module is arranged on the conveying device and is provided with a clamping space for placing the plate-shaped materials, the clamp module can move in the liquid medicine tank along a first direction under the driving of the conveying device and can submerge the plate-shaped materials in the liquid medicine tank, the clamp module is provided with a plurality of clamp modules which are distributed at intervals along the first direction, and the thickness direction of the clamping space extends along the first direction. The technical scheme of the invention can reduce the production cost.

title_en: New energy battery surface spraying ultraviolet curing system
abstract_en: The application relates to a new energy battery surface spraying ultraviolet curing system which comprises a base, a conveying assembly, a first curing unit and a second curing unit, wherein the base is provided with a first curing station and a second curing station; the conveying component is arranged on the base; the first curing unit is arranged at the first curing station and comprises a first light source component, the first light source component emits light from top to bottom to irradiate the upper side surface of the new energy battery and two edges of the upper side surface which are oppositely arranged along the second direction, and the first direction and the second direction are mutually perpendicular; the second curing unit is arranged at the second curing station and comprises a second light source component, and the second light source component is used for radiating rays to the rest side surfaces and edges of the new energy battery. According to the application, the surface of the new energy battery can be sprayed and cured through the first light source assembly and the second light source assembly, the new energy battery does not need to be frequently moved, the curing process is simple, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Complete and cracking-free terbium scandium aluminum garnet magneto-optical crystal and method for avoiding crystal cracking
abstract_en: The invention provides a complete and cracking-free terbium scandium aluminum garnet magneto-optical crystal and a method for avoiding crystal cracking, the molecular formula is (RE)  x  Tb  1‑x  )3Sc  2  Al  3  O  12  ，0<x<1, RE is rare earth element, the invention adopts melt pulling method to grow crystal by rare earth ion doping, the doped rare earth ion occupies twelve-face physical positions preferentially, the doping of rare earth ion can improve melt property, reduce distortion stress, avoid accumulating thermal stress during the growth process of crystal, effectively solve the cracking problem of TSAG magneto-optical crystal, and avoid the cracking problem during the later processing and use process of crystal,in addition, the doped ions and Tb of the invention  3+  The super-exchange effect occurs between the crystals, so that the crystal ratio Faraday effect is enhanced, and the magneto-optical performance of the crystals is further improved. The prepared terbium scandium aluminum garnet magneto-optical crystal is complete, has no cracking, good processing performance and excellent magneto-optical performance, and is expected to realize commercial application.

title_en: Substrate accommodating device and mask supporting and aligning equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display technology and mask preparation of microelectronic devices, and provides a substrate accommodating device and mask supporting and aligning equipment, wherein the substrate accommodating device comprises a base, an accommodating structure, a supporting member and a compressible member, the substrate accommodating device is provided with a first side surface of the supporting member at least under the pressure exerted by the substrate, the supporting member is suitable for approaching the base under the action of the pressure to compress and deform a space so as to increase the expansion state of the space of a mounting cavity, the substrate can compress and deform the space through the supporting member, thereby increasing the space of the mounting cavity, realizing the effect of accommodating substrates with different thicknesses on the basis of not replacing the accommodating member, simultaneously, the supporting member can drive the substrate to approach a mask plate without excessively exerting excessive pressure on the mask plate and the device where the mask plate is positioned, and the substrate can be stably kept in the mounting cavity under the common action of the device where the mask plate is positioned.

title_en: Fireproof structure, method for manufacturing same, and battery module
abstract_en: The invention provides a fireproof structure, a manufacturing method thereof and a battery module, wherein the fireproof structure not only has more excellent heat insulation effect and fireproof effect, but also improves the joint strength of a battery shell and a heat insulation member, has less ageing of the joint strength, has excellent reliability, and has excellent following performance to the internal shape of the battery shell. The fireproof structure (1) is composed of a metal base material (20) and a heat insulating material (10) containing inorganic fibers or non-melting fibers, and in a joint layer (30) formed by joining the metal base material (20) and the heat insulating material (10), the forming material of the metal base material (20) is integrated by penetrating into the gap of the forming material of the heat insulating material. The fireproof structure (1) is obtained by casting a metal base material (20) forming material with a heat insulating material as an insert. The battery module (100) further comprises: a battery (110); and a battery case that accommodates the secondary battery, wherein at least 1 of the top cover, the side wall, and the bottom wall is the fireproof structure.

title_en: Antibacterial sofa cover and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibacterial sofa cover and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fabrics, comprising an inner layer and an outer layer, wherein the outer layer is formed with a plurality of light-transmitting areas for light to pass through, a plurality of photocatalysis antibacterial pieces are arranged at intervals on one side of the inner layer and the outer layer facing each other, a photocatalysis antibacterial member is arranged between two adjacent light transmission areas, and a light guide member for transmitting light rays of the light transmission areas to the photocatalysis antibacterial member is arranged between the inner layer and the outer layer. According to the antibacterial sofa cover, the photocatalysis antibacterial piece irradiated to light is increased, the overall antibacterial effect is improved, the probability of direct contact between an object and the photocatalysis antibacterial piece is reduced, and the service life of the antibacterial effect is prolonged.

title_en: Arc spraying rolling short-process aluminum-steel composite board material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metallurgy, and particularly relates to an arc spraying rolling short-process aluminum steel composite plate material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: polishing oxide layers and impurities on the surface of the steel plate by corundum sand; step 2: cleaning the surface of the steel plate by using alcohol, and spraying an aluminum coating on the surface of the steel plate by using an arc spraying gun; step 3: and rolling the obtained aluminum-steel composite plate through a cold rolling process, and then performing heat treatment to eliminate internal stress. The coating obtained by the invention is more uniform and compact, has stronger bonding performance and improves the corrosion resistance of the composite material; the production cost can be reduced, the operation flow is simplified, and the production efficiency is improved; the equipment requirement is low, the influence by the equipment is small, and the occupied space is small.

title_en: Laser cladding feeding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser cladding materials, in particular to a laser cladding feeding device which comprises a shell, a laser generating part and a feeding part, wherein the laser generating part is arranged at the upper part of the shell, the feeding part is connected to the middle part of the shell, a feeding channel is arranged at the lower part of the shell, the laser generating part comprises a laser generator and a guiding part, the guiding part is arranged between the laser generator and the feeding part, the guiding part is arranged at the lower part of the laser generator, and is used for transmitting and guiding laser beams, so that the laser beams are equally divided into one beam which is vertically downward and laser beams which are reflected towards two sides, and the laser beams are contacted with metal powder for multiple times through a plurality of laser beams, so that the contact efficiency between the laser beams and the metal powder is improved, and the melting effect of the metal powder is ensured.

title_en: Nickel-based coating cathode structure for producing lithium hydroxide by electrolytic method and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-based coating cathode structure for producing lithium hydroxide by an electrolytic method and a preparation process thereof. The nickel-based coating cathode structure comprises a nickel screen, and a first layer of metal oxide coating, a second layer of metal oxide coating and a third layer of metal oxide coating which are sequentially arranged on the surface of the nickel screen; the preparation process comprises the processes of nickel base material processing and forming, nickel material surface treatment, coating preparation, sintering annealing and the like, and a plurality of noble metal elements and rare earth elements are added for compounding to prepare a coating cathode with higher hydrogen evolution electro-catalytic activity.

title_en: FPEA for oxalic acid assisted growth2SnI4-FPEA2PbI4Single crystal heterojunction X-ray detector and preparation
abstract_en: A FPEA  2 SnI 4 -FPEA 2 PbI 4  monocrystal heterojunction X-ray detector with oxalic acid for auxiliary growth and a preparation thereof belong to the technical field of X-ray detection. The invention uses oxalic acid reducer to assist in preparing FPEA  2 SnI 4  single crystal, which improves the quality and stability obviously and reduces the defect density by one order of magnitude. The FPEA  2 SnI 4 -FPEA 2 PbI 4  single crystal heterojunction X-ray detector provided by the invention can be used for X-ray detection of 80 kV. Due to the energy level matching between FPEA  2 PbI 4  and FPEA  2 SnI 4 , the X-ray detector combines the good charge transmission performance of tin perovskite and the relative stability of lead perovskite, so that the sensitivity of the single crystal heterojunction X-ray detector is improved to 1.7X10. 10  5 μC·Gy ‑1 ·cm ‑2 . The novel X-ray detector combines the advantages of tin perovskite and lead perovskite, and provides new opportunities and challenges for next-generation products.

title_en: Dispensing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glue dispenser, which comprises a table top, wherein a turntable mechanism is arranged on the table top, a plurality of stations which are arranged at intervals are arranged on the table top, the stations are arranged around the turntable mechanism, a plurality of positioning jigs which are arranged at intervals are arranged on the turntable mechanism, a feeding mechanism, a discharging mechanism, a glue dispensing mechanism and a feeding mechanism are sequentially arranged on the outer side of the turntable mechanism, the glue dispensing mechanism comprises a first screw rod device and a glue dispensing bracket, the first screw rod device is arranged on the table top, the first screw rod device is connected with a second screw rod device in a sliding manner, the second screw rod device is connected with a third screw rod device in a sliding manner, the glue dispensing bracket is connected with the third screw rod device in a sliding manner, a glue dispensing barrel is rotationally connected with the glue dispensing bracket, a first adjusting mechanism is arranged on the glue dispensing bracket, and the first screw rod device, the second screw rod device and the third screw rod device are sequentially arranged above the adjacent positioning jigs. The invention provides a dispensing machine, which reduces the pollution to lenses during assembly.

title_en: Ti (titanium) 2 AlC-Fe-based wear-resistant self-lubricating coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a Ti  2  AlC-Fe based wear-resistant self-lubricating coating and a preparation method thereof. The wear-resistant self-lubricating coating comprises the following component raw materials in percentage by mass: 80 to 95 percent of Fe and 5 to 20 percent of Ti  2  AlC; wherein the Fe and Ti  2  The sum of the components of AlC is 100 percent. The wear-resistant self-lubricating coating directly adopts the existing raw material powder on the market as the raw material, has the characteristics of simple raw material obtaining mode, low cost and self-repairing and recycling. The preparation method of the wear-resistant self-lubricating coating is simple and easy to operate and is suitable for industrial production by optimizing the inner hole rotating plasma spraying process and the raw material powder proportion.

title_en: Laminate and molded body
abstract_en: A laminate comprising a base layer and a coating layer laminated on at least one surface of the base layer, wherein the coating layer contains a poly (3-hydroxybutyrate) resin, and the coating layer has at least 1 peak top temperature (Tma) in the range of 100-150 ℃ and at least 1 peak top temperature (Tmb) in the range of 150-170 ℃ in a crystalline melt curve obtained by differential scanning calorimetric analysis, and the temperature difference between Tma and Tmb is 10 ℃ or more.

title_en: Fuel cell composite gas diffusion layer microporous layer spraying equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses fuel cell composite gas diffusion layer microporous layer spraying equipment, which belongs to the technical field of gas diffusion layer microporous layer spraying, and comprises a base, wherein a heating table is fixedly arranged on the base, a bracket which is driven by a first power device and moves along the X-axis direction is arranged on the base, a spraying platform which is driven by a second power device and moves along the Y-axis direction is arranged on the bracket, at least two storage chambers are fixedly arranged on the spraying platform, each storage chamber is connected with an inlet of a booster pump through a shunt pipeline, an outlet of the booster pump is connected with a main pipeline, the main pipeline is connected with an atomization nozzle, and an outlet of the atomization nozzle faces the heating table. The invention also discloses a fuel cell composite gas diffusion layer microporous layer spraying method, which solves the technical problems of difficult control of MPL spraying thickness and uneven slurry dispersion, and is widely applied to gas diffusion layer microporous layer spraying.

title_en: Composite material intelligent repair structure and preparation and health self-detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material intelligent repair structures, in particular to a composite material intelligent repair structure and a preparation and health self-detection method thereof. The epoxy resin and carbon black composite film comprises an insulating matrix and an epoxy resin and carbon black composite film sensing element, and the epoxy resin and carbon black composite film sensing element is distributed along three different directions at each measuring point and has a strain resistance effect. Due to the strain resistance effect, when the composite material repair structure is deformed under external load or the structure is damaged such as layering, debonding and the like, the resistance of the health detection element is changed, and the strain data of the health detection point can be obtained by utilizing the Wheatstone bridge and calibration experimental data and outputting voltage through the bridge. The main strain of each measuring point can be obtained by utilizing the line strain of each measuring point along three directions.

title_en: System and method for processing a substrate
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a system for treating a magnesium or magnesium alloy substrate, the system comprising: a first pretreatment composition comprising a fluorometallic acid and free fluoride in an amount of 10ppm to 500ppm based on the total weight of the first pretreatment composition, and a pH of 1.0 to 4.0; and a second pretreatment composition comprising a lanthanide metal, the second pretreatment composition being substantially free of peroxide. Methods of treating magnesium or magnesium alloy substrates are also disclosed. Treated magnesium and magnesium alloy substrates are also disclosed.

title_en: Polyester/low-density polyethylene medicinal composite hard sheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical packaging materials, and particularly relates to a polyester/low-density polyethylene medicinal composite hard sheet, and a preparation method and application thereof. The polyester/low-density polyethylene medicinal composite hard sheet is obtained by compositing a polyester sheet with the thickness of 0.2-0.3mm and a low-density polyethylene film with the thickness of 0.03-0.05mm through a bi-component adhesive; the surface dyne value of the polyester sheet and the low-density polyethylene film is more than or equal to 38 dynes. The polyester/low-density polyethylene medicinal composite hard sheet has the advantages of safe and environment-friendly raw materials, simple structure, good barrier property and excellent heat sealing formability, and is suitable for medicinal oral liquid filling packaging materials.

title_en: Ferrite or martensite steel surface modification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ferrite or martensite steel surface modification method, which comprises the following working steps: step one: processing high-entropy alloy powder; step two: treating the surface of a substrate; step three: further processing the substrate; step four: roughening the surface of a substrate; step five: preparing a high-entropy alloy coating; step six: further processing of the high entropy alloy coating. The invention has the beneficial effects that the high-entropy alloy coating is formed on the surface of the ferrite/martensitic steel by mainly utilizing the technologies of electron beam roughening, plasma spraying, laser remelting and the like, so that the hardness and oxidation resistance of the steel are improved, the surface coating is compact and uniform, cracks and pores are few, the component segregation is little, the ferrite/martensitic steel matrix is metallurgically bonded, the bonding strength is very high, and the ferrite/martensitic steel matrix is not easy to peel off.

title_en: Sacrificial anode pool filler and use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cathodic protection of metal corrosion and protection research in soil environment, and particularly relates to a sacrificial anode pool filler, a using method and application thereof. The sacrificial anode pool filler comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 95% of sand, 5% of sodium sulfate and 5% of bentonite, wherein the resistivity of the sacrificial anode cell filler is 40-2.2 omega-m when the water content of the sacrificial anode cell filler is 3-13%. The filler is favorable for fully playing the cathode protection function of the sacrificial anode, can reduce the grounding resistance of the sacrificial anode, increases the output current of the sacrificial anode, is not hardened after long-term use, and is convenient for extraction.

title_en: Portable nuclear power site laser cladding prosthetic devices
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable nuclear power site laser cladding repairing device, and belongs to the technical field of laser cladding. The laser cladding device comprises a container functional box and a container auxiliary box, wherein a laser cladding unit, a motion deflection unit and a control unit are integrated in the container functional box, an auxiliary unit is integrated in the container auxiliary box, the laser cladding unit is used for carrying out laser cladding on parts to be repaired, the motion deflection unit is used for placing the parts to be repaired and linking with the robot, the control unit comprises a controller, the path planning and the control are carried out on the robot through offline programming software, and the auxiliary unit is used for maintaining the stability and the safety in a laser cladding head repairing environment. The device provided by the invention has the advantages of mobility, convenience and safety in transportation, and capability of being quickly calibrated, installed and debugged on the nuclear power site, and the limitation of nuclear power site maintenance of nuclear components is solved.

title_en: Proton exchange membrane electrolysis Chi Guangre electric coupling hydrogen production system and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proton exchange membrane electrolysis Chi Guangre electric coupling hydrogen production system and a working method thereof, belonging to the hydrogen production technology. According to the method, a solar cell, a frequency division heat collector, a cooling heat exchange tank and a proton exchange membrane cell are coupled together, the frequency division heat collector is connected with a high-temperature water storage tank and used for storing solar heat, the cooling heat exchange tank is communicated with a low-temperature water storage tank and used for reducing the heat of the solar cell at the upper part of the low-temperature water storage tank.

title_en: Preparation method of coating with high resistance to marine microorganisms
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal surface treatment, relates to a preparation method of a coating with high resistance to marine microorganism erosion, and particularly relates to a preparation method of an Ag2O2 oxide film coating with high bactericidal property on the surface of plain carbon steel by utilizing a nano graphene material, agNO3 solution and KH570 silane coupling agent through an anodic oxidation method in electrochemistry. The invention is based on an electrochemical anodic oxidation method, carbon steel is used as a working electrode to etch the surface of the carbon steel, so that the surface roughness of the carbon steel is increased, the specific surface area is also increased simultaneously, and then nano graphene and Ag are introduced  +  Experimental tests show that the sterilization effect of the coating is very obvious, and the corrosion resistance of the high-strength material in the service process can be greatly improved; in additionBecause the antibacterial coating has better combination property with the metal matrix and the graphene is added, the wear resistance of the enamel coating and the related mechanical properties of the enamel coating are greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of CPET sheet with multilayer structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a CPET sheet material with a multilayer structure, comprising the following steps: step 1, extruding and molding a CPET material to obtain a CPET outer layer, wherein a containing groove is formed in the CPET outer layer; step 2, extruding and molding the CPET material to obtain a CPET inner layer; and step 3, placing the CPET inner layer above the CPET outer layer, and extruding and repeating to obtain the CPET sheet with the multilayer structure. The CPET sheet with the multilayer structure is prepared by combining the modified polyether-ether-ketone support body, the CPET inner layer and the CPET outer layer, the modified polyether-ether-ketone support body plays a role in supporting a framework, the integral mechanical property of the CPET sheet is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the CPET sheet has excellent high-temperature resistance.

title_en: Soft and hard integrated wear-resistant self-lubricating nickel-based composite coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soft and hard integrated wear-resistant self-lubricating nickel-based composite coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein a gear and bearing material 20CrMo steel is mainly used as a matrix material, ni20-WC composite powder is used as a hard wear-resistant coating material, the hard wear-resistant coating is clad on the surface of the matrix, the soft antifriction coating is combined on the surface of the hard wear-resistant coating through a heat curing process, the soft antifriction coating is prepared by spraying a modified polytetrafluoroethylene composite solution on the surface of the hard wear-resistant coating, and the modified polytetrafluoroethylene composite solution is prepared by adding molybdenum disulfide and a silane coupling agent into polytetrafluoroethylene emulsion. The soft and hard integrated wear-resistant self-lubricating nickel-based composite coating has excellent wear-resistant performance, can effectively improve the tribological performance of a 20CrMo steel material, and has the advantages of simple and convenient preparation method and easily-controlled preparation process.

title_en: Ceramic pressure sensor and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application discloses a ceramic pressure sensor and a manufacturing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrical elements. The ceramic pressure sensor includes: a ceramic base and a membrane; the front surface of the ceramic base is provided with a cavity, the back surface of the ceramic base is provided with a ventilation cavity, and the cavity is communicated with the ventilation cavity through a ventilation hole; the surface of the cavity of the ventilation cavity is covered with a first metallization layer; the front surface of the ceramic base is connected with one surface of the diaphragm provided with the strain circuit in an adhesive mode. The ceramic pressure sensor provided by the application has higher universality, can be packaged into pressure sensors with various pressure types, and has wider application scenes.

title_en: Clamping mechanism for anodic oxidation equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of anodic oxidation equipment, in particular to a clamping mechanism for anodic oxidation equipment, which comprises a clamping assembly, wherein the clamping assembly comprises a bearing piece, a driving part arranged on the bearing piece and a special-shaped piece connected with the driving part, a positioning piece and a clamping piece connected with the special-shaped piece are arranged on the bearing piece, the fixing assembly comprises a butt joint piece and a fixing piece corresponding to the butt joint piece, and a guide piece is arranged between the butt joint piece and the fixing piece. Starting the second motor, the second motor drives the dwang to rotate, and the dwang drives the dysmorphism piece and rotates for both sides dysmorphism piece contact first contact surface and second contact surface, thereby drive buffer spring and take place deformation, reverse through control second motor, make dysmorphism piece drive bracing piece slip in the arc inslot, simultaneously through the spacing of straight line groove, drive both sides clamp splice and fix the work piece when making the dysmorphism piece rotate, so guaranteed the stability when the work piece is processed.

title_en: Selective deposition of noble metal containing materials
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for fabricating semiconductor devices. In the present disclosure, a noble metal-containing material is selectively deposited on a substrate by a cyclical deposition process. The deposition method includes providing a substrate in a reaction chamber, wherein the substrate includes a first surface comprising a first material and a second surface comprising a second material. A noble metal precursor comprising a noble metal beta-diketone compound is provided in a gas phase in the reaction chamber, and a reactant is provided in the gas phase in the reaction chamber to deposit a noble metal-containing material on a first surface opposite a second surface.

title_en: Method for preparing high-wear-resistance aluminum alloy micro-arc oxidation composite coating by laser cladding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high wear-resistant aluminum alloy micro-arc oxidation composite coating by laser cladding, which comprises the following steps: immersing the aluminum alloy with the ceramic film layer on the surface prepared by the micro-arc oxidation process into the attapulgite suspension, standing, taking out and drying, and carrying out laser cladding treatment to prepare the high-wear-resistance aluminum alloy micro-arc oxidation composite coating. The friction coefficient of the composite coating prepared by the invention is obviously reduced, the average friction coefficient is smaller than that of a single micro-arc oxidation ceramic film coating, the abrasion rate of a composite coating sample is obviously reduced, and the abrasion resistance of the aluminum alloy is improved.

title_en: Method for improving diamond growth quality by metal or metal oxide auxiliary etching
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving the growth quality of diamond by metal or metal oxide auxiliary etching, which comprises the steps of grinding and polishing the surface of a diamond monocrystal, wherein the roughness of the polished diamond monocrystal is 10-100 nm; h, polishing the surface of the diamond monocrystal  2  ‑O  2  After etching, forming a large number of etching pits in the shape of inverted pyramids on the surface, wherein the diameter of each etching pit is 5-10 mu m; metal or metal oxide powder (Fe, ni, co, fe) with granularity of 100 nm-1 μm  2  O  3  、MnO  2  NiO, etc.) are filled in the etching pits, at H  2  Etching in plasma for 5-20 h, and finally adopting a microwave plasma chemical vapor phase method to treat the diamondAnd growing a diamond monocrystal epitaxial layer on the surface of the monocrystal wafer. The defect density of the diamond epitaxial layer prepared by the method is obviously lower than that of the substrate, and polycrystalline particles are not generated on the growth surface.

title_en: Crystal growth control system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crystal growth, in particular to a crystal growth control system and a working method thereof; the invention provides a crystal growth control system, comprising: the heating furnace comprises a heating cylinder, a graphite pot, a furnace main body, an upper furnace cover and a soft and hard shaft structure, wherein the graphite pot is fixed in the furnace main body through a graphite rod; the heating cylinder is fixed outside the graphite pot and is suitable for heating the growth solution in the graphite pot; the upper furnace cover is covered at the upper end of the furnace main body; the soft and hard shaft structure is arranged on the upper furnace cover in a lifting manner, and the lower end of the soft and hard shaft structure is close to the growth solution; by arranging the soft and hard structures, the graphite hard shaft is prevented from being corroded by silicon steam and cosolvent; the buffer guide piece plays a role in slowing down the shaking generated in the downward movement process of the heavy hammer, so that the service life of equipment is prolonged, and the stability of single crystal growth is improved.

title_en: Hydride vapor phase epitaxy device for preparing gallium nitride and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydride vapor phase epitaxy device for preparing gallium nitride, which comprises: the gallium boat comprises a cavity and a gallium boat arranged in the cavity, wherein the cavity comprises an air inlet area, a gallium reaction area, a growing area, a sample changing area and a sample loading area which are sequentially connected, the gallium boat is arranged in the gallium reaction area, the air inlet area comprises a first air inlet pipe and a second air inlet pipe, the tail end of the first air inlet pipe is communicated with the gallium reaction area, the tail end of the second air inlet pipe is communicated with the growing area, the growing area comprises a seed crystal support and a tail gas discharge pipe, the sample changing area is a temperature buffer area and comprises four areas, the temperature is gradually reduced, the sample changing area comprises a sample changing driving motor and a sample changing rod, and the sample loading area comprises a sample loading driving motor and a sample loading rod. According to the invention, the sample changing area and the sample loading area are added, seed crystals are conveyed through the sample changing rod and the sample loading rod, and the next furnace growth can be carried out by loading samples without cooling, so that the production efficiency of gallium nitride is greatly improved.

title_en: Indium phosphide monocrystal production temperature control method based on fuzzy control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indium phosphide monocrystal production temperature control method based on fuzzy control, which can automatically adjust the temperature according to real-time data analysis and prediction and realize optimal temperature control, and comprises the following steps: acquiring temperature deviation e detected by a sensor in an indium phosphide single crystal furnace and a change rate ec of the temperature deviation; fuzzification processing is carried out on the temperature deviation and the change rate of the temperature deviation, and a membership function is applied to formulate a fuzzy control rule table between fuzzy reasoning input and fuzzy reasoning output parameters; performing fuzzy reasoning according to the fuzzy control rule table to obtain fuzzy reasoning output control parameters; performing defuzzification processing on the fuzzy reasoning output parameters to obtain control real numbers after defuzzification; and driving an actuating mechanism according to the real numbers after deblurring to realize the temperature self-adaptive control of the indium phosphide single crystal furnace.

title_en: Wear-resistant superhydrophobic heat-conducting anti-icing coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wear-resistant super-hydrophobic heat-conducting anti-icing coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the wear-resistant super-hydrophobic heat-conducting anti-icing coating is prepared by coating a hydrophobic wear-resistant heat-conducting coating on a high-porosity structural coating, the high-porosity structural coating is prepared by a structural coating, and the structural coating is compounded by a telechelic hydrophobic resin, a first type of silane coupling agent activator, a solvent and an auxiliary agent; the hydrophobic wear-resistant heat-conducting paint is prepared by compounding hydrophobic resin, a first class of silane coupling agent activators, a second class of silane coupling agent activators, a solvent and an auxiliary agent. The coating has the advantages of wear resistance, heat conductivity, superhydrophobicity, electrical insulation, good anti-icing property and the like, and can be used in the fields of building, wind power, anti-icing of power transmission lines and the like.

title_en: Strip steel passivation device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a belted steel passivating device and control method thereof, belted steel passivating device includes at least one passivation groove, actuating mechanism and control unit, be equipped with two pairs of passivation polar plates and sink roll in the passivation groove, two pairs of passivation polar plates are placed perpendicularly, belted steel penetrates from a pair of passivation polar plates, wears out from another pair of passivation polar plates after going on the steering through the sink roll again, and both ends correspond respectively about the inboard of every pair of passivation polar plates are equipped with insulating baffle. The edge effect can be effectively improved, and the electric field concentration at the edge of the strip steel is reduced, so that the requirement of stable control of the thickness of the edge passivation film in the strip steel production process with different widths is met, the problem of thickening of the edge passivation film caused by the concentration of the edge electric field lines is avoided, and the defect of poor adhesive force of the edge of the strip steel is further avoided.

title_en: Matrix temperature control method based on cold spraying
abstract_en: The invention provides a matrix temperature control method based on cold spraying, which comprises the following steps: immersing the piece to be repaired into film forming paint, forming a film by the film forming paint, repairing the piece to be repaired by adopting a cold spraying technology, and tearing off the film after spraying is finished to finish repairing. Wherein the film-forming paint comprises a component A, a component B and a curing agent according to the mass ratio of 60:40:0.8 to 1.5; the component A mainly comprises fluororesin, fluoroalkyl silane, fluorine-containing acrylic ester and the like; the component B mainly consists of metal fluoride. The film-forming paint prepared by the invention has good film-forming performance, good cohesion, good compatibility, low viscosity (50 g-300 g/25 mm), certain adhesive force and easy stripping after finishing spraying; on one hand, the base body can be protected, on the other hand, the heat energy emitted by the base body can be converted into light energy, and the cooling effect is realized, so that a coating with better spraying quality is obtained.

title_en: Flexible graphene conductive film preparation device and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation process of a flexible graphene conductive film, wherein the preparation device and the preparation process are arranged on an external rack and comprise a hot pressing assembly, a discharging wheel, a feeding wheel, a separating assembly, a graphene regeneration assembly and a receiving wheel; the graphene regeneration assembly is arranged between the separation assembly and the feeding wheel, and the graphene is sprayed on the copper foil base layer through the matching of the graphene spray gun and the ionization gauge in the graphene regeneration assembly, so that the composite layer of the graphene and the copper foil is regenerated, the regeneration process is realized, the new composite layer of the graphene and the copper foil is not required to be continuously conveyed, and the copper foil is not required to be received by an additional mechanism, so that the whole structure is simpler, the processed copper foil can be recycled, the waste of materials is avoided, the processing cost is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the processing efficiency is also greatly improved.

title_en: Dual carburization process for G13Cr4Mo4Ni4V steel sleeve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double carburization process of a G13Cr4Mo4Ni4V steel sleeve ring, and relates to the field of double carburization processes of G13Cr4Mo4Ni4V steel bearing rings. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the hardness and the wear resistance of the existing G13Cr4Ni4Mo4V steel bearing ring are to be improved. The method comprises the steps of performing first carburization treatment by adopting a vacuum carburizing furnace, performing second high-temperature tempering treatment, performing carburization treatment again, performing high-temperature tempering treatment again, turning, and performing heat treatment. The G13Cr4Ni4Mo4V steel bearing ring obtained by the invention has high hardness, high wear resistance and high fatigue performance after vacuum carburization heat treatment, meets the use requirement of products, and simultaneously ensures good toughness of the core part of the material and the size and shape of the carburized carbide. The process of the invention is used for preparing bearing parts.

title_en: Preparation method of energy-saving filler in building coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of energy-saving filler in building coating, which synthesizes modified VO of tungsten fluoride through electrochemistry in one step  2  The phase transition temperature is effectively reduced, ionic liquid is used as electrolyte, the reducibility is compounded and prepared by alcohol, ascorbic acid and oxalic acid, and the modified VO of the fluorotungsten is synthesized by electrochemical one-step  2­  ，VO  2  Is pure M phase and has lower phase transition temperature.

title_en: High-efficient automatic dispensing device based on rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary-based efficient automatic dispensing device which comprises a rotary chain and a driving piece arranged at the upper end of the rotary chain, wherein a plurality of fixing frames are arranged on the periphery of the rotary chain, an expansion assembly is arranged on the fixing frames, a feeding assembly for sleeving parts on the expansion assembly is arranged on the right side of the rotary chain, a guide rail is arranged below the expansion assembly and used for driving the expansion assembly to expand the parts, the parts sleeved on the expansion assembly pass through the dispensing assembly in a path along with the rotation of the rotary chain, a rack is arranged on the left side of the rotary chain and used for driving the expansion assembly to realize autorotation on the fixing frames, and a discharging assembly for taking out the parts is arranged at the left end part of the dispensing assembly. The device can carry out continuity to part tracking formula point and glue the processing, lets the part spin when the point is glued simultaneously, has realized the processing of all-round point and has glued, avoids the condition emergence of product leak the glue, and the device degree of automation is high simultaneously, promotes the point and glues efficiency.

title_en: Environment-friendly paint decorative building wall and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of buildings, in particular to an environment-friendly coating decorative building wall and a preparation method thereof. The environment-friendly coating decorative building wall adopts the structure, has good water-repellent and anti-pollution capabilities and decorative effects, the decorative layer is reinforced by the reinforcing layer, the service life of the decorative layer is prolonged, the falling risk is reduced, and the heat preservation effect in the wall can be further improved by the arrangement of the heat preservation layer.

title_en: Hot-dip galvanizing aluminum magnesium plating assistant and galvanizing process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hot dip galvanizing aluminum magnesium plating assistant and a galvanizing process, which is prepared by taking zinc chloride, stannous chloride, potassium chloride, bismuth chloride and an activator AEO9 as components, adding hydrochloric acid with the concentration of 1-2% into the prepared solution to enable the mixture to be fully dissolved to form the plating assistant, wherein each 1L of the plating assistant comprises the following components in parts by weight: 200-300g of zinc chloride, 10-20g of stannous chloride, 20-40g of potassium chloride, 0.5-1g of bismuth chloride, 0.4-1g of AEO9 and the balance of water; the hot dip galvanizing magnesium aluminum plating assistant agent can obtain a zinc aluminum magnesium alloy plating layer with better quality on the surface of steel, solves the problem that steel such as a batch galvanized structural part and a standard part in the prior art is easy to generate plating omission in the zinc aluminum magnesium hot dip plating process, and realizes the zinc aluminum magnesium alloy plating layer with better quality on the surface of steel by optimizing the plating assistant agent formula and the galvanizing process.

title_en: Preparation method of novel etching substrate with induction effect
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrode material preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a novel etching substrate with an induction effect. The preparation method of the novel etching substrate with the induction effect comprises the following steps: s1, cleaning a metal mesh substrate; s2, preparing a pre-reaction solution of precipitated hydroxide; s3, preparation of M (OH)  x  A NF nanoarray electrode; s4Etching the metal mesh substrate. The invention firstly induces and grows a layer of hydroxide nano-sheet array on a metal net, and then dissolves the hydroxide on the surface by using a mixed solution of formamide and alkali to obtain a novel etched foam metal net substrate. The substrate can be used for inducing subsequent growth substances, is favorable for preventing oxidation of a foam metal net, and improves the adhesion effect of the substrate and an active material, so that the conductivity of an electrode is improved, the resistance is reduced, the capacitance is increased and the circulation stability is promoted.

title_en: Continuous manufacturing equipment of waterproof moisture-permeable fabric of high ventilative PTFE nanofiber
abstract_en: The invention relates to continuous manufacturing equipment of a waterproof and moisture permeable fabric of high-permeability PTFE nanofibers, which comprises a base fabric unreeling device, a film coating device, a coagulation tank, a water washing device, a first tension control device, a drying device, a cooling roller, a glue applying roller, a pre-pressing device, a second tension control device, a hot pressing device, a moisture spraying device, a curing device and a fabric reeling device which are sequentially arranged along the material direction; the stirring device is used for stirring the PTFE high-viscosity microemulsion to obtain uniform coating liquid and inputting the uniform coating liquid into the coating device; the gluing device further comprises a gluing assembly, wherein the gluing assembly is used for being matched with the gluing roller to carry out a gluing process. Compared with the prior art, the invention can realize the continuous production of the PTFE waterproof moisture-permeable membrane based on the advantages of the high-viscosity microemulsion phase separation method.

title_en: Silicon carbide coating process for third-generation semiconductor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide coating process for a third-generation semiconductor, and particularly relates to the technical field of semiconductor coatings, which comprises the steps of S1, surface preparation, S2, pretreatment, S3, microscopic detection, S4, coating preparation and selection, S5, coating process, S6, molding and shaping, S7, solidification, S8, surface treatment, coating solidification, and coating impact by using a polishing solution and abrasive particle mixed solution. According to the invention, a roughness stamping method is adopted, the forward stamping angle is 30 degrees, the stamping and polishing are carried out for 5 times, the reverse stamping angle is 30 degrees, the spraying angle of a spraying machine in the coating process is 30 degrees according to the forward spraying angle, the spraying and polishing are carried out for 5 times, the spraying angle of the reverse spraying is 30 degrees, the spraying machine is required to vertically spray the lower surface position of a base material at 0 degree after the spraying is finished, the spraying is carried out for 5 times, the silicon carbide coating and the third-generation semiconductor substrate are subjected to cross impact contact forming, the third-generation semiconductor silicon carbide coating is not easy to fall off, and the silicon carbide coating has better impact strength.

title_en: Impregnated graphite curing device and curing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphite products, in particular to an impregnated graphite curing device and a curing method, which solve the problems that graphite to be impregnated and cured in the prior art needs to be placed in the curing device for contact positioning, then the impregnated liquid is used for impregnating the graphite, the situation has a certain contact area, and then the impregnation liquid is used for impregnating the graphite, so that the impregnation is inconvenient to ensure the overall impregnation, and the impregnation permeability is greatly reduced, and the impregnated graphite curing device and the curing method comprise a curing cylinder, a bottom supporting frame, a curing cavity and a liquid inlet and outlet component, wherein the curing cavity is provided with a plurality of components, and the invention can realize: a non-contact dipping platform is created by using a magnetic suspension technology, so that graphite is dipped and solidified in a suspension state, any possible physical stress and thermal stress are eliminated, and the graphite is always in a suspension fixed rotation state, so that the graphite is prevented from tilting or colliding, and the graphite is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Large-caliber optical film deposition method and coating equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical coating, in particular to a large-caliber optical film deposition method and coating equipment, which comprise the following steps: selecting the shape and size of a deposition source according to the shape of an optical element to be deposited; determining a moving track of a deposition source according to the shape of an optical element to be deposited and the shape and the size of the deposition source; the moving track is formed by performing first relative movement on the deposition source and the optical element to be deposited, and the first relative movement direction of the deposition source and the optical element to be deposited is perpendicular to the normal line of the optical element to be deposited and is used for traversing the surface of the optical element to be deposited; the deposition process also comprises a second relative motion which occurs cooperatively with the first relative motion, and the second relative motion direction of the deposition source and the optical element to be deposited is parallel to the normal line of the optical element to be deposited, so as to realize the sagittal height compensation of the optical element to be deposited; and the deposition of the large-caliber optical film layer is completed through the first relative movement and the second relative movement of the deposition source and the optical element to be deposited.

title_en: Three-dimensional dispensing equipment, three-dimensional dispensing system and assembly production line
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional point gum equipment, three-dimensional point gum system and assembly production line relates to the technical field of point gum. The device comprises a device bottom plate, an X-axis driving part, a Y-axis driving part, a Z-axis driving part, a first rotating part and a second rotating part; the X-axis driving part is connected to the side wall of the first rotating part and used for driving the first rotating part to move along the X axis; the first rotating part comprises a first rotating shaft and is used for driving the Z-axis driving part to rotate around the first rotating shaft; the Z-axis driving part is connected with a product placement jig which is used for receiving a product to be processed; the Y-axis driving part is connected with a dispensing part, the dispensing part is used for dispensing a product to be processed, and the Y-axis driving part can drive the dispensing part to move along the Y axis; the second rotation part includes the second axis of rotation, and Y axle drive division sets up on the second rotation part to realize that second rotation part drive Y axle drive division is rotatory around the second axis of rotation this application can realize gluing the point of the multi-planar and multi-angle of product, improves the point and glues efficiency.

title_en: Iridium-based carrier interface modification composite catalyst suitable for acidic water and electricity oxygen analysis, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an iridium-based carrier interface modification composite catalyst suitable for acidic water and electricity oxygen analysis, which consists of iridium and a carrier, wherein the carrier is at least two of oxides of niobium, tin, manganese, zirconium, tantalum, zinc, copper, scandium, titanium and tungsten; the iridium accounts for 0.5-2% of the carrier by mass. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a preparation method of the catalyst and application of the catalyst in oxygen analysis of acidic water and electricity. The catalyst is compatible with existing IrO  2  Compared with the catalyst, the catalyst can reduce the use amount of iridium and has the advantages of good catalytic activity and good durability.

title_en: Coating installation for coating a planar object and method for coating a planar object
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coating installation (1) for coating a planar object (2), such as a strip. The strip is transported by means of transport rollers (3 a, 3 b). The coating facility (1) has: -a vacuum chamber (4), -a material vapour deposition device (6) having an evaporation section (7) and a nozzle section (8), wherein the nozzle section (8) has a nozzle (9) with a nozzle outlet. The nozzle outlet may have an extension (D0). The nozzle (9) is rotatably supported in a direction (10). Another concept is a method for coating a planar object.

title_en: Scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite material preparation, and particularly relates to a scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal, and a preparation method and application thereof. The scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal provided by the invention has the advantages of high glossiness, uniform components, no flaws, no growth stripes and no crack generation, and solves the problems that the lithium niobate crystal can not be used as a laser crystal material and the lithium niobate crystal has low photodamage resistance. The scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal provided by the invention has no macroscopic defect, uniform components, satisfies the service performance, and has better holographic storage performance. The scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal prepared by the invention has the advantages of high photorefractive response speed, high sensitivity, low doping threshold, good crystal optical quality and the like, and is an ideal three-dimensional volume holographic storage material. The scandium cerium iron doped lithium niobate crystal provided by the invention has important positions in the application fields of holographic optical storage, optical waveguide amplifier, integrated optics and the like, and is particularly suitable for optical volume holographic storage.

title_en: Composite material for bathroom products and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite material for bathroom products, and a preparation method and application thereof. The antibacterial filler is filled in the composite material or is used as an antibacterial intermediate layer of the composite material, and the antibacterial filler comprises far infrared radiation type antibacterial agent; the far infrared radiation type antibacterial agent comprises a far infrared radiation type antibacterial agent prepared by modifying an external coherent field; the far infrared radiation type antibacterial agent is subjected to surface treatment by a surfactant and then is used for preparing the antibacterial filler; the antibacterial filler also comprises a carrier material I; the preparation raw materials of the carrier material I comprise acrylic resin and isocyanate. According to the invention, the antibacterial performance of the bathroom product is realized by utilizing the composite material, the carrier material has high bonding strength and stripping resistance, and the composite material is applied to the bathroom product (such as a bathtub), so that the composite material is stable in a hot water environment, has a durable antibacterial effect and a long effective period, and meets the demands of wide consumer markets.

title_en: Automatic crystal taking process
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic crystal picking process, which comprises the following steps: placing the crystal taking barrel at the position of a movable platform, detecting the length of single crystals, and selecting the descending distance of the movable platform according to the length of the single crystals; lifting a furnace table auxiliary chamber to an upper limit, rotating the auxiliary chamber, and then lowering single crystals into the crystal taking barrel after rotating the auxiliary chamber to the upper part of the crystal taking barrel; when the single crystal descends to a certain distance, shearing seed crystals, and moving the single crystal along with the descending of the moving platform; until all the single crystals are taken out; and after all the single crystals are taken out, the moving platform drives the crystal taking cylinder and the single crystals in the crystal taking cylinder to rise to the target position, and the crystal taking is completed.
