The invention has the beneficial effects that the problems of time waste and the like caused by the fact that the traditional single crystal taking process is completely finished by manpower are solved; and an automatic program is used for control, so that the auxiliary chamber is automatically lifted and rotated to take single crystals, and the crystal taking barrel is automatically lifted, positioned and lowered.

title_en: Preparation method of 8-inch silicon epitaxial wafer for IGBT
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an 8-inch silicon epitaxial wafer for an IGBT, which comprises the following steps: loading the cleaned substrate into an etched epitaxial furnace reaction chamber, baking the epitaxial furnace, and then introducing hydrogen to purge the epitaxial furnace reaction chamber; then growing an epitaxial layer on the substrate sheet; the epitaxial layer growth process is as follows: the first stage: growing at 1050-1060 deg.c at 5-6 microns/min; and a second stage: continuously growing an epitaxial layer at 1040-1050 ℃ at a growth speed of 2-3 mu m/min; and a third stage: continuing to grow the complementary epitaxial layer to the target thickness at the temperature of 1030-1040 ℃ and at a growth speed of less than 1 mu m/min; and cooling after the epitaxial layer growth is finished, and taking out the epitaxial wafer. The preparation method of the invention can ensure the thickness and resistivity controllability of the epitaxial wafer and effectively reduce the generation of splinters and slip lines while improving the epitaxial growth rate of silicon.

title_en: Spraying method for reducing crucible sticking rate of polycrystalline ingot silicon ingot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of polycrystalline silicon, and particularly relates to a spraying method for reducing crucible sticking rate of a polycrystalline ingot silicon ingot; the method comprises the steps of pouring 800-1000 g of silicon nitride powder, 2000-3000 ml of deionized pure water, 300-400 g of silica sol and 5-10 g of polyvinyl alcohol binder into a measuring barrel, and mixing to prepare a silicon nitride spraying solution; placing the measuring barrel of the prepared solution on a stirring table bracket, inserting a stirrer, opening a pneumatic valve to start stirring for at least 20 minutes, wherein the prepared silicon nitride solution is required to be in a stirring state all the time; and (3) lifting the qualified quartz crucible on a crucible heating table for heating, and starting spraying operation when the temperature of the inner wall of the quartz crucible reaches 50-70 ℃, wherein the spraying process comprises spraying from a transverse path and spraying from a longitudinal path. The invention adopts a spraying process path to carry out independent spraying, increases the thickness of the silicon nitride coating in the area, resists the scouring of silicon liquid and reduces the crucible-sticking rate of the silicon ingot.

title_en: Coating method of part
abstract_en: The coating method of the part comprises the following steps: forming a metal transition layer on the surface of the part; forming a stress release layer on the metal transition layer; and forming a diamond-like carbon (DLC) film on the stress releasing layer. The method forms a multi-layer structure on the surface of the part to prevent the DLC film with the surface layer as a protective layer from peeling off from the surface of the part, thereby improving the wear resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of ceramic oxide film thermocouple for aeroengine temperature measurement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a ceramic oxide film thermocouple for measuring temperature of an aeroengine, wherein two thermoelectric arms forming the film thermocouple are composed of an ITO X film and an In2O3 film, the ITO X film is composed of three layers of films of ITO C, ITO: N, ITO:N and Ni from the bottom to the top, and the films are prepared by adopting a magnetron sputtering method. The preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following specific steps of: firstly, preprocessing a workpiece, secondly, depositing a film on the preprocessed workpiece by adopting a magnetron sputtering co-sputtering deposition process, firstly depositing a thermoelectric arm In2O3 film, and then depositing thermoelectric arms consisting of three layers of different ITO (indium tin oxide) X films layer by layer; the first layer is deposited with ITO C film with thickness not more than 1 μm; the second layer is deposited with ITO, wherein the thickness of the ITO is not more than 800nm; depositing ITO, N and Ni film with thickness not greater than 600nm; and the three layers of films all show preferential growth of crystal faces (222). The ITO/In2O3 film thermocouple prepared by the method can effectively improve the thermoelectric performance and high-temperature stability of the film thermocouple, and further realizes accurate measurement of the transient temperature of the film thermocouple on the surface of a high-temperature component.

title_en: Method for preparing electrocatalyst from electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an electrocatalyst by using electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon, which comprises the steps of mixing overhaul slag waste cathode carbon powder with a mixed salt, carrying out heat treatment, removing part of ash content in the electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon by using the mixed salt, pore-forming, and then washing and drying a series of the porous carbon electrocatalyst. The mesoporous carbon material prepared by the method can be applied to the field of electrochemical synthesis chemicals, realizes the harmlessness and recycling of the electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon, and shows great green and environment-friendly benefits and application prospects.

title_en: Charging prompt information determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining charging prompt information. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a melt image of a Czochralski single crystal device, identifying a melted region in the melt image, calculating the circularity of the melted region, determining charging prompt information of the Czochralski single crystal device according to the change rate of the circularity and a preset charging rule, so that charging is automatically prompted in a charging stage, no whole-course intervention of an operator is needed, the problem of more working hours of the operator is avoided, the working efficiency is improved, the operator can be prevented from missing charging time by real-time automatic detection, and the accuracy of determining the charging time is improved.

title_en: High-service-life silicon wafer and silicon wafer gettering method
abstract_en: The application relates to a silicon wafer, wherein the concentration of antimony element in the silicon wafer is 4E+14cm  ‑3  To 2E+16cm  ‑3  Preferably 4.30E+14cm  ‑3  To 1.9E+16cm  ‑3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Further preferably 4.45E+14cm  ‑3  To 1.87E+16cm  ‑3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The minority carrier lifetime of the silicon chip is more than or equal to 200 microseconds; preferably 300 microseconds or more; more preferably 500 microseconds or more. Still another silicon wafer is also disclosed, wherein the concentration of antimony element in the silicon wafer is 4E+14cm  ‑3  To 2E+16cm  ‑3  Preferably 4.30E+14cm  ‑3  To 1.9E+16cm  ‑3  Further preferably 4.45E+14cm  ‑3  To 1.87E+16cm  ‑3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The minority carrier lifetime of the silicon chip is more than or equal to 300 microseconds; preferably 400 microseconds or more; further preferably 600 microseconds or more.

title_en: Thermal field of single crystal furnace
abstract_en: The application discloses single crystal growing furnace thermal field, including bear the weight of the device, set up in bear the device on be used for providing the first crucible in thermal field and set up in be used for holding the second crucible of fuse-element in the first crucible, wherein, first crucible with the second crucible is cylindrical barreled. Above-mentioned single crystal growing furnace thermal field can avoid the gathering of heat, and oxygen in the crucible is difficult for decomposing more, can reduce the oxygen content of the silicon chip of making, promotes the quality of silicon chip, finally alleviates solar cell's decay, promotes solar cell's quality.

title_en: Laser anti-corrosion wear-resistant material for repairing impulse turbine and repairing process method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal materials, and relates to a laser corrosion-resistant wear-resistant material for repairing an impulse turbine and a repairing process method. The material comprises the following components ：Cr：10~20%;Co:10~20%;Nd：1.5~2.5%;Ni：3~8%;C：0.01~0.2%;Nb：0.1~1%;W：1~5%;V：0.1~1%;Mo：0.8~1.2%;Mn：≤3%;Ti：0.01~0.1%;N：0.10~0.5%;Si：0.1~0.2%;P:0.01~0.05;Fe： by mass percent and the balance. The repairing method shortens the labor time of programming the part of the irregular shape one by one, simplifies the complex programming process and greatly improves the production efficiency. After the hydraulic turbine is repaired by laser, flaw detection, hardness detection and actual operation detection prove that the erosion resistance and corrosion resistance degree of the material meet the normal use requirements, and the repair part is free from damage conditions such as cracks, cavitation, abrasion, meat deficiency and the like.

title_en: In-situ annealing device, control method and operation steps of in-situ annealing
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ annealing device which is used with a growing device in a matching way, wherein the growing device comprises a hollow furnace body, a thermal field with an open cavity, a crucible and a seed rod, the thermal field is accommodated in the hollow furnace body and is used for providing a gradient heat source in the growing direction, the crucible is accommodated in the open cavity of the thermal field, the seed rod is used for providing a cold source, the seed rod is connected with the crucible and is used for enabling the crucible to move in the growing direction so as to realize crystal growth, the in-situ annealing device comprises a base part and a lifting part, the base part is accommodated in the open cavity and is used for selectively supporting the crucible, the lifting part is used for driving the base part to move in the growing direction, the seed rod is detachably connected with the crucible, a protruding part is arranged on the inner wall of the thermal field and is used for being abutted with the base part to form an annealing space, and when the growing device is in a crystal growing state, the lifting part is used for controlling the base part to move back in the growing direction of the crystal so as to separate the crucible from the seed rod until the base part and the protruding part are contacted with the protruding part to form an annealing space for completing annealing.

title_en: Method for improving surface quality and performance of laser cladding NiCrSiBC-WC composite coating
abstract_en: A method for improving the surface quality and performance of a laser cladding NiCrSiBC-WC composite coating relates to the technical field of composite coating surface processing and is used for solving the problem that a coating prepared by single laser cladding is easy to crack. The method comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing a matrix material; s2, preparing laser cladding powder; s3, performing laser cladding treatment; s4, auxiliary treatment of a temperature field; s5, auxiliary treatment of a laser remelting composite temperature field. The laser remelting composite temperature field auxiliary technology of the invention gets rid of the limit of WC material addition amount to the coating performance, and can obtain the high-hardness crack-free NiCrSiBC-WC composite coating with low WC mass fraction. By improving the structural compactness of the NiCrSiBC-WC coating, the surface hardness and the binding force of the coating are improved.

title_en: Impact forced-soaking reflective heat-insulating paint attaching equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat-insulating coating production, in particular to reflection heat-insulating coating attaching equipment with forced impact soaking, which comprises a base, wherein a stirring barrel is fixed on the base, a soaking pipe is fixed on the side wall of the stirring barrel and is communicated with the stirring barrel through a conveying pipe, a stirring assembly is arranged on the stirring barrel, a lifting mechanism is arranged in the soaking pipe and is connected with the stirring assembly, a movable disc is connected to the lifting mechanism, a first through hole is formed in the movable disc, a receiving disc is movably arranged in the soaking pipe and is connected with the lifting mechanism, a second through hole is formed in the receiving disc, a conduction regulating mechanism connected with the lifting mechanism and the receiving disc is arranged in the soaking pipe, and a pumping mechanism is arranged on the base and is connected with the lifting mechanism and the soaking pipe.

title_en: Preparation method of diffraction optical waveguide and diffraction optical waveguide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a diffraction optical waveguide and the diffraction optical waveguide. According to the preparation method, the optical adhesive is sprayed on different areas to be sprayed through the ink-jet equipment to form the optical adhesive layer, and the thickness of the optical adhesive layer of different areas to be sprayed is different by controlling the spraying amount of the ink-jet equipment. And imprinting the optical adhesive layers of different areas to be subjected to ink jet through the imprinting template so as to form a grating structure on the optical adhesive layers. And exposing and separating the film from the wafer substrate to form the diffraction optical waveguide. Therefore, the material can be saved and the transmittance of the diffraction optical waveguide can be increased by spraying the optical adhesive on the area to be sprayed by the ink-jet equipment, and in addition, the thickness of the adhesive layer can be controlled by the ink-jet equipment, so that the different thicknesses of the adhesive layers of the optical adhesive layers of the area to be sprayed are different to match grating structures with different depths, the heights of the residual adhesive layers of the area to be sprayed after stamping are uniform, and the light efficiency stability of the diffraction optical waveguide is improved.

title_en: Zinc oxide aluminum target and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and discloses a preparation method of a zinc oxide aluminum target, which comprises the following steps: step 1: mixing alumina powder, a first dispersing agent and water for pulping and grinding to obtain a first slurry; step 2: mixing the first slurry, zinc oxide powder and a second dispersant for pulping and grinding to obtain a second slurry; step 3: spraying and granulating the second slurry to obtain bulk density of 0.8-1g/cm  3  Is a powder of (2); step 4: molding and cold isostatic pressing are carried out on the powder obtained in the step 3, and a zinc oxide aluminum target blank is obtained; step 5: and sintering the zinc-aluminum oxide target blank to obtain the zinc-aluminum oxide target material. The invention prepares powder with certain bulk density by controlling the grain diameter of spray granulation, and can prepare target materials with large relative density and low resistivity without using a binder. At the same time, the invention also providesThe zinc oxide aluminum target is provided.

title_en: Combined coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined coating, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of automobile coatings. The combined coating provided by the invention comprises a primer and a finish; the primer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 25-35% of acrylic resin, 15-20% of acrylic monomer, 3-8% of photoinitiator, 0.1-0.3% of auxiliary agent and the balance of solvent; the finishing paint comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 20-35% of solvent type modified acrylic ester, 8-15% of polyurethane acrylic resin, 5-15% of active monomer, 2-5% of photoinitiator, 0.1-0.3% of auxiliary agent and the balance of solvent. The combined coating provided by the invention can be applied to a nickel plating process, improves the adhesive force of a nickel coating on a substrate, protects the nickel coating, improves weather resistance, avoids fogging, and has high value in plastic metallization and automobile light-weight processes.

title_en: Selective copper and copper alloy etching solution
abstract_en: The invention provides a selective copper and alloy etching solution thereof, which comprises 3-12% of hydrogen peroxide, 4-8% of organic acid, 2-6% of compound nonionic surfactant, 0.05-0.3% of complexing agent and the balance of deionized water. The organic acid may provide an acidic environment and may also act as a chelating agent to coordinate with copper ions generated by etching to form a stable chelate, so that the etching rate and etching lifetime are more stable, which is preferably citric acid. The compound surfactant with a specific proportion can reduce the surface tension of etching liquid, enhance the wettability to the surface of a test piece, ensure that the etching effect is uniform and has no residue, and can keep the original substrate pattern so as to achieve a good etching effect.

title_en: Platinum crucible for lead-based relaxor ferroelectric monocrystal growth and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present application provides a method for preparing a platinum crucible for lead-based relaxor ferroelectric single crystal growth, comprising the steps of: smelting platinum in a smelting crucible, then introducing oxygen for 5-30 min until casting, stopping introducing oxygen, and casting into a platinum ingot; and carrying out hot forging, sheet rolling, primary annealing, rough spinning, secondary annealing, rough spinning and tertiary annealing on the platinum ingot to prepare the platinum crucible for the growth of the lead-based relaxor ferroelectric single crystal. The platinum crucible prepared by the preparation method has the advantages of smooth surface, uniform wall thickness, one-step molding of the plate material and no seam of the whole crucible, so that the temperature field of a crystal growth furnace is easy to control, and a necessary condition is provided for growing high-quality lead-based relaxation ferroelectric single crystals; the platinum is smelted and purified in the smelting process, so that the material leakage rate of the platinum crucible in the crystal growth process is reduced, and the smelting spinning can be repeatedly performed to prepare the platinum crucible, so that the platinum can be recycled.

title_en: Adhesive layer powder material suitable for atmospheric plasma spraying preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a bonding layer powder material suitable for atmospheric plasma spraying preparation and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of high-temperature protective coatings, wherein the bonding layer powder material consists of 3.5-7.5 wt% of carbon element and an MCrAlYX alloy matrix phase; the MCrAlYX alloy matrix phase consists of alloy elements Ni, co, cr, al, Y and X, wherein X is Ta or Hf; wherein, the Ni content is 30 to 70wt%, the Co content is 0 to 30wt%, the Cr content is 20 to 30wt%, the Al content is 10 to 15wt%, the Y content is 0.5 to 1wt%, and the X content is 0 to 3wt%. The bonding layer powder material provided by the invention not only can be used for preparing a thermal barrier coating bonding layer by atmospheric plasma spraying, but also can be used as a high-temperature oxidation corrosion resistant coating and the like.

title_en: Processing apparatus and method for processing a workpiece
abstract_en: In order to provide a processing apparatus which is simple in construction and capable of realizing energy-efficient workpiece processing, it is proposed that the processing apparatus comprises: a process chamber comprising a plurality of process chamber sections, each of the process chamber sections being assigned to one of a plurality of separate circulating air modules of the process apparatus; heating apparatus comprising a heating gas duct, wherein a plurality of circulating air modules are coupled to the heating gas duct, in particular for heating gas directed through the process chamber section.

title_en: Curable composition, prepreg, resin sheet, metal foil-clad laminate, and printed wiring board
abstract_en: A curable composition comprising an alkenylphenol A, an epoxy-modified silicone B, an epoxy compound C other than the epoxy-modified silicone B, and an acid anhydride D.

title_en: High-temperature antioxidant coating for steel billets and coating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature antioxidation coating for a steel billet and a coating method thereof. The coating consists of 30-60 parts by weight of SiO  2  3-20 parts by weight of Al  2  O  3  5-18 parts by weight of ZrO  2  1 to 12 parts by weight of SiC,1 to 8 parts by weight of C and 1 to 3 parts by weight of B  4  And C, 2-16 parts by weight of binder and solvent. The coating method comprises the steps of adopting a spray gun with the caliber of 0.3-1.5 mm to spray the coating on the surface of a steel billet, wherein the air pressure of the spray gun is 0.5-0.8 MPa, the spray angle is 25-40 ℃ with the surface of the steel billet, the distance between a nozzle and the surface of the steel billet is 20-35 cm, and the spray width is 20-45 cm; the superposition rate of two adjacent spraying widths is 30-40%. The coating disclosed by the invention can reduce the viscosity of the oxide skin generated by high-temperature heating, so that the oxide skin is easy to remove in the subsequent descaling process, and the component is safe and has no secondary pollution risk.

title_en: Film forming apparatus and method
abstract_en: A thin film forming apparatus and method are provided. The thin film forming apparatus includes: a chamber configured to hold a vacuum formed in the chamber; a deposition object placed at a set position inside the chamber; a sputter target disposed inside the chamber and containing particles for deposition; a gas supply module configured to supply a gas for forming a plasma state inside the chamber; a step coverage control module located inside the chamber and facing the deposition object; and a voltage supply module located inside the chamber and configured to supply a current to the sputtering target, wherein the deposition object is deposited with particles supplied from the sputtering target based on the current, and wherein the step coverage control module is configured to control the step coverage of the deposition object by adjusting an amount of particles moving toward the deposition object through the repositioning action.

title_en: Method and device for preparing epoxy compound from liquid olefin
abstract_en: The invention provides the use of alkali metal halides and/or alkaline earth metal halides for the electrochemical preparation of epoxy compounds from liquid olefins. The invention also provides a device and a method for preparing the epoxy compound by the liquid olefin electrochemical method. The invention provides energy by clean electric energy, the Faraday efficiency of generating the epoxy compound is 40-80%, the effective current density reaches ampere level/square centimeter, the rate of generating the epoxy compound can reach gram level/square centimeter/hour, the selectivity of the epoxy compound in the product is more than 60%, and the Faraday efficiency, selectivity and reaction rate are higher; no halogen-containing waste water and waste residue are generated, the electrolyte can be recycled, the atomic utilization rate can reach 100%, and hydrogen can be co-produced as an energy substance, so that the method is environment-friendly and low in cost. The method can produce the epoxy compound in a green, high-selectivity and low-cost way, and has important significance for promoting the production and the industrialized development of the epoxy compound.

title_en: Pd nano-film hydrogen sensor based on porous Pt substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The Pd nano-film hydrogen sensor based on the porous Pt substrate and the preparation method thereof are provided, wherein the sensor comprises conductive glass FTO, a substrate layer and a gas-sensitive layer which are sequentially arranged, the substrate layer is the porous Pt substrate, and the gas-sensitive layer is a Pd nano-film; preparing a porous Pt substrate on conductive glass FTO; preparing a Pd nano-film layer on the obtained porous Pt substrate to obtain a Pd nano-film hydrogen sensor based on the porous Pt substrate; the invention solves the defects of high working temperature and complex process in the prior art, and has the advantages of simple preparation, low response concentration and room temperature detection.

title_en: High-performance reflector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance reflector, and a preparation method and application thereof. The high performance mirror includes a Ti  49 Zr 23 Cu 12 Ni 8 Nb 6 Hf 2  (at.%) amorphous alloy substrate, an Ag  82.66 Zr 12.64 Ni 4.66 Y 0.04  (at.%) reflective film. The high-performance reflecting mirror is formed by depositing Ag  82.66 Zr 12.64 Ni 4.66 Y 0.04  (at.%) reflecting film on the surface of the Ti  49 Zr 23 Cu 12 Ni 8 Nb 6 Hf 2  (at.%) amorphous alloy substrate by PEPVD. The high-performance reflecting mirror provided by the invention has excellent optical, mechanical and other properties, can be applied to the fields of biomedical, machine vision, illumination engineering and the like with integrated structural functions, and has wide application prospects in radar, optical imaging and metering detection.

title_en: Laminated polyester film, laminate, and method for producing laminated polyester film
abstract_en: Disclosed are a laminated polyester film which is excellent in coating uniformity and adhesion of an aqueous coating material, a laminate using the laminated polyester film, and a method for producing the laminated polyester film. The laminated polyester film of the present invention has an easy-to-adhere layer (X) on the outermost surface of at least one side of a polyester substrate, and the ratio (γh/γd) of the hydrogen bonding force (γh) to the dispersion force (γd) in the surface free energy of the easy-to-adhere layer (X) is 0.250 or less. In addition, another embodiment of the present invention provides a laminated polyester film comprising a polyester substrate, an adhesive layer (X) on at least one outermost surface of the polyester substrate, wherein the adhesive layer (X) has a water advance angle θa of 75.0 ° or more and 110.0 ° or less and a water retreat angle θr of 5.0 ° or more and 40.0 ° or less.

title_en: High-barrier polyglycolic acid multilayer composite film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-barrier polyglycolic acid multilayer composite film and a preparation method thereof. Mainly solves the problems that the PGA melt strength is low, the single-layer pure PGA film has poor toughness and is easy to hydrolyze and difficult to meet the application requirement of a barrier material in the prior art, and comprises a barrier layer, a protective layer and an adhesive layer by adopting a high-barrier polyglycolic acid multi-layer composite film; the protective layer is at least an outermost layer, the bonding layer is at least positioned between the barrier layer and the protective layer, and the barrier layer at least contains the technical scheme of poly-glycolic acid with multimodal molecular weight distribution, so that the problem is well solved, and the protective layer can be used in the industrial production of high-barrier poly-glycolic acid films.

title_en: Extruder speed reducer shell sand core brushing equipment and process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sand core brushing, and discloses equipment and a process for brushing sand cores of a speed reducer shell of an extruder, wherein the equipment comprises a dip coating pool, a clamp and a dryer, a shaft lever is arranged at the outer side of the clamp, a gear and a bearing are sleeved at the middle part of the shaft lever, a first tooth bar and a second tooth bar are arranged in a dip coating manner Chi Waice, a sleeve is sleeved at the outer side of the bearing, a first telescopic piece is connected at the outer side of the sleeve, a third sliding block is arranged at the end part of the shaft lever, a first track, a second track and a third track which are mutually communicated are arranged at the outer side of the dip coating pool, and a brushing assembly is arranged at the lower end of the dryer; the lower end of the sand core moves down to dip coating in the dip coating pool, the gear is alternately meshed with the first tooth bar and the second tooth bar when the sand core moves up, so that the sand core swings and throws off redundant dip coating liquid, the lower end of the sand core which is dip coated is turned upwards and sent to a dryer for drying, the sand core is brushed by the brush sweeping component, the clamp is clamped at one end of the sand core which is coated, the rest part is coated by repeating the steps, and the uniformity of the sand core coating is improved as much as possible.

title_en: BOPP extinction film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of films, in particular to a BOPP extinction film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the extinction film comprises an upper surface extinction layer, a middle core layer and a lower surface extinction layer which are sequentially arranged, the upper surface extinction layer comprises 40-50wt% of high-density polyethylene, 10-25wt% of block polypropylene, 8-20wt% of cycloolefin block polymer and 12-40wt% of random copolymer polypropylene, and the middle core layer and the lower surface extinction layer both comprise homopolypropylene. The BOPP extinction film disclosed by the invention not only ensures a certain extinction effect, but also improves the overall hardness and yield strength of an extinction layer material, thereby improving the scratch resistance of the extinction film. The invention also provides a preparation method of the BOPP extinction film, which has simple process and high efficiency.

title_en: Complete equipment for synthesizing ALD (atomic layer deposition) material special for electronics
abstract_en: The application discloses complete equipment for synthesizing an ALD material special for electronics, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a first reactor, a second reactor, a first dripping control device, a first quantitative feeding device, a second quantitative feeding device and a second dripping control device; the first dropwise adding control device is used for dropwise adding a first liquid-phase reactant into the first reactor, the first quantitative adding device is used for dropwise adding a second liquid-phase reactant into the first reactor, the first liquid-phase reactant and the second liquid-phase reactant generate a liquid-phase intermediate in the first reactor, and the liquid-phase intermediate is pressed into the second reactor through inert gas; the third liquid phase reactant is added into the second reactor through the second quantitative feeding device and the second dripping control device to react with the liquid phase intermediate to generate a product; the first liquid phase reactant comprises: a metal alkyl compound; the second liquid phase reactant comprises: an organic amine; the third liquid phase reactant comprises: a transition metal-containing feedstock. The application improves the synthetic yield of ALD material by 10-15%.

title_en: Multi-point liquid taking ultrafiltration pump for electrophoresis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipoint liquid taking ultrafiltration pump for electrophoresis, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top outer wall of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a box body and a mounting frame, the circumferential inner wall of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a pump body, two sides of the pump body are respectively provided with a liquid suction pipe and a liquid discharge pipe, one end of the liquid suction pipe is fixedly connected with a second liquid taking pipe, the circumferential outer wall of the second liquid taking pipe is fixedly connected with a first liquid taking pipe, the first liquid taking pipe and the second liquid taking pipe are both communicated with the liquid suction pipe, ultrafiltration membrane bodies distributed at equal intervals are arranged in the box body, and the outer walls of two sides of the box body are respectively inserted with a first liquid outlet pipe and a second liquid outlet pipe. According to the invention, two liquid taking points are arranged on one side of the pump body, so that half of the running time of the ultrafiltration pump can be saved, the quality of ultrafiltration water can be always kept, the surface quality of a product can be effectively improved, and the condition of electric energy waste caused by paint settlement hardening waste or circulation is avoided.

title_en: Detection method, detection device and coating system
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method, a detection device and a coating system, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: measuring the temperatures of a plurality of different positions of a to-be-detected area of the pole piece conveyed by the drying device by using a detection device arranged on the outlet side of the drying device so as to obtain temperature data of the to-be-detected area, and sending the temperature data to a control component; the control component analyzes the temperature data to obtain whether the baking uniformity of the sizing agent in the area to be detected and the drying degree of the sizing agent are qualified; utilize temperature data to come the thick liquids baking uniformity and the thick liquids stoving degree on side reflection foil surface in the testing process, and temperature detection can accomplish fast when the pole piece passes through detection device, therefore whole testing process in, coating device and drying device need not shut down, and then can guarantee production efficiency, avoid scrapping because of shutting down, and then reduction in production cost.

title_en: Honeycomb interlayer interior decoration plate for cargo hold and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a honeycomb interlayer internal decorative plate for a cargo hold and a preparation method thereof; the method comprises the following steps: mixing phenolic resin and epoxy resin, stirring for 10-30 min at 40-55 ℃ to obtain a mixed resin base, adding a flame retardant, a toughening agent and an antioxidant into the mixed resin base, and stirring for 3-6 h at 50-60 ℃ to obtain a modified hot melt resin; compounding glass fibers with the prepared hot melt resin to obtain a prepreg; sequentially applying an epoxy adhesive film, prepreg and a surface film on the upper end face and the lower end face of the honeycomb core from inside to outside, heating, curing and demolding to obtain a honeycomb interlayer internal decorative plate; the technical problems of low flame retardance, poor toughness, poor interface matching degree with an epoxy adhesive film and the like of the traditional phenolic aldehyde panel honeycomb sandwich plate in the prior art are solved by the preparation method of the honeycomb sandwich plate for the cargo hold, and the problem that the honeycomb sandwich plate serving as the interior decoration is easy to oxidize is solved by using the surface film.

title_en: Target binding and bonding promotion method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target binding and bonding promotion method, which belongs to the technical field of targets and comprises the following steps of (1) taking a stainless steel pipe as an inner lining pipe, cleaning the inner lining pipe, carrying out sand blasting on the stainless steel pipe to form a sand-blasting layer, (2) spraying alloy wires on the sand-blasting layer by adopting an electric arc spraying method to form an alloy layer, (3) carrying out plasma treatment on the stainless steel pipe, (4) heating the stainless steel pipe, coating solder on the alloy layer to form a solder-bonding layer, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment. According to the invention, the sand-spraying layer, the alloy layer and the welding material layer are formed on the stainless steel tube, and plasma treatment and ultrasonic treatment are carried out on the sand-spraying layer, the alloy layer and the welding material layer, so that the combination of the lining tube and the target material matrix is effectively improved, and the binding and combining rate of the target material is effectively improved.

title_en: WS (WS)2/N-V2CTxElectrolytic water hydrogen evolution electrocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WS  2 /N-V 2 CT x  electrolyzed water hydrogen evolution electrocatalyst and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of catalysis. The preparation method of the WS  2 /N-V 2 CT x  electrolyzed water hydrogen evolution electrocatalyst provided by the invention comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out solvothermal reaction on ammonium tungstate and V  2 CT X  in an alcohol solvent to obtain WO  3 /N-V 2 CT X ; s2, vulcanizing the WO  3 /N-V 2 CT X  by using a vulcanizing reagent. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and easy to realize, and the obtained WS  2 /N-V 2 CT x  electrolyzed water hydrogen evolution electrocatalyst has excellent catalytic activity. The invention also provides the WS  2 /N-V 2 CT x  electrolyzed water hydrogen evolution electrocatalyst prepared by the preparation method.

title_en: Deplating method for nickel alloy coating on copper alloy surface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surface treatment, and particularly relates to a method for stripping a nickel alloy coating on a copper alloy surface, which uses an electrolytic method to carry out stripping, wherein an anode is a workpiece to be stripped, and a cathode is a stainless steel plate or a copper plate; hexamethylenetetramine, hydrochloric acid and copper chloride are used as stripping solution; the current density is 15-20A/dm  2 , and the working temperature is room temperature; generating a dark red passivation film on the surface of the copper alloy to show that the nickel alloy plating layer is removed; and finally, cleaning the workpiece and drying. The method for stripping the nickel alloy coating on the surface of the copper alloy can greatly improve the repairing times of the nickel-plated product of the copper alloy, reduce the scrapping loss, save the cost of raw materials and improve the repairing efficiency. The high-corrosion-resistance plating layer which cannot be plated by the conventional means can be efficiently and rapidly plated with the high-phosphorus nickel alloy plating layer with the phosphorus content more than 10%, and the size and the surface roughness of the copper alloy substrate are not changed after the plating and the repair are performed.

title_en: Sanitary cotton sliver outer catheter frosted tube body and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sanitary silver outer catheter frosted tube body, which is formed by spraying frosted paint on the surface of the sanitary silver outer catheter body, and then enabling the tube body of the sanitary silver outer catheter body to be covered with the frosted paint by ultraviolet curing. According to the invention, the frosted particles are added on the outer catheter body of the tampon, so that when the outer catheter is placed in a vagina, air between the outer catheter and the vaginal wall is easy to enter, and the smoothness of the catheter during placement is increased, so that uncomfortable feeling caused by increased sliding due to negative pressure between the outer catheter and the vaginal wall during placement is avoided; on the other hand, the frosted particles are used for replacing lubricating substances, so that the use of the lubricating substances is avoided, the adverse effect on human bodies is avoided, and meanwhile, the manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Sinking type offshore hydrogen production device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a submerged offshore hydrogen production device, which comprises a jacket assembly, a sea water desalination unit and a hydrogen production unit; the jacket assembly comprises a jacket, a supporting piece arranged in the jacket, a limiting piece arranged at an interval relative to the supporting piece, and a bearing platform arranged at the top of the jacket; the jacket is used for being inserted into seawater, and the limiting piece is flush with the seawater plane or is positioned below the seawater plane; the sea water desalination unit and the hydrogen production unit are both arranged on the supporting piece, and are both positioned between the limiting piece and the supporting piece, and an outlet of the sea water desalination unit is communicated with an inlet pipeline of the hydrogen production unit. Through setting up sea water desalination unit and hydrogen manufacturing unit in the jacket, can effectively utilize jacket empty part, solve the problem that the loading platform area is too big, equipment is arranged crowdedly, reduce operation cost.

title_en: Pearlescent master batch for biaxially oriented polypropylene film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pearlescent master batch for a biaxially oriented polypropylene film, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pearlescent master batches. The invention provides a pearlescent master batch for biaxially oriented polypropylene film, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by mass: 10-25 parts of polypropylene, 60-85 parts of calcium carbonate, 0.5-2 parts of surface modifier and 0.01-0.08 part of initiator, wherein the initiator can generate a large amount of free radicals under certain conditions, so that the surface modifier and the calcium carbonate are coated on the surface of the calcium carbonate through a melt grafting reaction in advance when being blended, modified calcium carbonate particles are easier to enter a polypropylene molecular chain, thereby achieving the aim of good dispersion of the calcium carbonate, and meanwhile, fewer auxiliary agents are used in the invention, and the problem of precipitation of the auxiliary agents is little or basically avoided. The prepared pearlescent master batch has the advantages of high dispersion and low precipitation.

title_en: Substrate treating agent and metal material
abstract_en: The invention provides a substrate treating agent which can endow a metal material with preferable adhesion, acid resistance and alkali resistance to a laminated film. The concentration of the water-soluble metal compound in the substrate treating agent is 500 to 200,000 mass ppm in terms of metal atom, the number average molecular weight of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 70,000 ～ 500,000, the acid value of the solid content is 150 to 740mgKOH/g, the hydroxyl value of the solid content is 40 to 350mgKOH/g, the glass transition temperature of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is in the range of 63 to 100 ℃, the concentration of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 500 to 200,000 mass ppm in terms of the solid content, and the ratio of the metal atom-converted concentration of the water-soluble metal compound to the concentration of the water-soluble or water-dispersible acrylic resin is 3/97 to 91/9. Substrate treating agents are used in the manufacture of laminated metallic materials.

title_en: Control method for controlling thirteen-roller mark defects of push-pull type pickling line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method for controlling thirteen-roller mark defects of a push-pull type pickling line, which comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing before production, confirming the equipment state, and zeroing the thirteen rollers to ensure the zero position to be accurate; and 2, realizing automatic control of tension of the thirteen rollers through an L2 process control system model, and step 3, enabling the thirteen rollers to enter a tension control mode, and step 4, when the unit enters a tail-flick mode, cutting off the tension of the thirteen rollers, and enabling the thirteen rollers to be changed into a speed control mode. According to the technical scheme, stable production of push-pull pickling products is realized, thirteen-roller marks are effectively controlled, the degradation rate of the thirteen-roller marks is reduced from 0.62% to 0.07%, and the product benefit is improved; the production failure time and times are reduced.

title_en: Electrolytic water catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrolyzed water catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) subjecting the metal substrate to pretreatment such as degreasing; (2) Placing the treated metal substrate in alkaline nickel salt solution, reacting, washing and drying to obtain Ni (OH)  2 /metal substrate electrode; (3) The Ni (OH)  2 /metal substrate electrode is used as an anode, the cathode adopts one of graphite or nickel plates, the electrolyte is alkaline platinum-containing electroplating solution, the applied voltage is applied to strip, electroplate, and the final product is obtained after washing and drying. The method realizes the high dispersion of Pt nanocrystalline, and avoids or slows down the performance reduction of the catalyst caused by the agglomeration of noble metal grains after long-term use.

title_en: Production process of ionic membrane caustic soda
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of ionic membrane caustic soda, which relates to the technical field of caustic soda production and comprises the following steps: step one: initializing an electrolytic cell, and adjusting the temperature and current of the electrolytic cell; step two: inputting the sodium chloride solution prepared by primary electrolysis into a purification device, and removing impurities by means of filtration, suction and the like; the ion exchange membrane technology adopted by the invention replaces the traditional electrolytic tank polluting the environment, improves the production efficiency of caustic soda, reduces the pollution to the environment, and simultaneously can realize the current efficiency of 97 percent and improve the yield and purity of caustic soda by using specific ion membrane materials and optimized operation conditions. Stable operation for a long time: the ionic membrane material has good chemical corrosion resistance and stability, can run for a long time and maintain high current efficiency, and reduces downtime and energy consumption in production. High purity product: by optimizing the structure and the operation parameters of the electrolytic cell, the caustic soda product with high purity can be obtained, and the requirements of different industries are met.

title_en: Double-layer lithium ion sieve fiber material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer lithium ion sieve fiber material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of lithium resources. The double-layer lithium ion sieve fiber material comprises a core layer and a coating layer, wherein the core layer comprises a flexible carrier and a manganese ion sieve dispersed in the flexible carrier, the flexible carrier comprises soft polyvinyl chloride and hydrophilic polyethersulfone, a plurality of first holes are formed in the flexible carrier, the coating layer comprises a rigid carrier and a titanium ion sieve dispersed in the rigid carrier, the components of the rigid carrier comprise poly (p-phenylene terephthalamide) and poly (hexamethylene adipamide), and a plurality of second holes are formed in the flexible carrier. The double-layer lithium ion sieve fiber material provided by the disclosure is rigid outside and flexible inside, has good water pressure resistance and fracture performance, has less dissolution loss of the manganese ion sieve, has excellent cycle performance and lithium ion adsorption performance, and can be widely applied to extracting lithium from brine.

title_en: Ferritic stainless steel and method for producing same
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are a ferritic stainless steel and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the elongation can be improved even when the hood annealing is omitted. In the ferritic stainless steel according to an embodiment of the present invention, the ferritic stainless steel may include, in weight-%: c:0.01% or more and 0.1% or less, si:0.01% or more and 1.0% or less, mn:0.01% or more and 1.5% or less, P: more than 0% and 0.05% or less, S: more than 0% and 0.005% or less, cr:13.0% or more and 18.0% or less, N:0.005% or more and 0.1% or less, al:0.005% or more and 0.2% or less, ni:0.05% to 0.25%, the balance being iron (Fe) and other unavoidable impurities.

title_en: Electrical instrument packaging structure and packaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric instrument packaging structure and packaging equipment, comprising an electric instrument shell structure, wherein the electric instrument shell structure comprises a shell body, a clamping strip is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the shell body, and a gluing groove is formed in the top of the clamping strip. According to the invention, the sealant is smeared in the gluing groove through the gluing structure, the sealing plate body moves downwards to be attached to the top of the shell body, so that the sealant is connected with the sealing plate body, the sealing plate body and the shell body can be sealed, external water vapor and the like are prevented from entering the electric instrument, a circuit in the electric instrument is directly connected with a conductive structure in the positioning groove, then when the sealing plate body is attached to the shell body, the conductive column drives the rotating strip to be inserted into the positioning groove, and the plane scroll spring drives the rotating strip to be outwards unfolded, so that conduction is realized, and the sealing plate body and the shell body can be fixed.

title_en: Heat resistant film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a heat-resistant film suitable for protecting the surface state of plastic products, glass products, ceramic products, etc. which is conductive, decorated, etc. [ solution ] A heat-resistant film comprising: a thermoplastic polyester elastomer comprising a hard segment and a soft segment bonded to each other, wherein the hard segment has a polyester unit comprising an aromatic dicarboxylic acid and an aliphatic diol or an alicyclic diol, and the soft segment is formed from an aliphatic diol or an alicyclic diol or an aliphatic polycarbonate, the soft segment is present in an amount of 30 mass% or more based on 100 mass% of the thermoplastic polyester elastomer, the thermoplastic polyester elastomer has a melting point of 150 ℃ or more, the heat-resistant film has a tensile modulus of 30 to 500MPa, a tensile elongation at break of 200 to 700%, and a ratio F50/F25 of a stress F50 at 50% elongation to a stress F25 at 25% elongation of 1.10 or more.

title_en: Adhesive, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the adhesive comprises nitrile rubber, epoxy resin and a coupling agent, and the functional groups of the coupling agent comprise at least two of amino, epoxy and mercapto. The adhesive has excellent adhesive property and damping property, and is favorable for wide industrial application.

title_en: Substrate, single crystal diamond laminate substrate, and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing a substrate for a single crystal diamond laminated substrate, comprising: preparing an initial substrate; and forming an intermediate layer composed of a single layer or a laminated film including at least a single crystal Ir film or a single crystal MgO film on the starting substrate, wherein the single crystal Ir film or the single crystal MgO film constituting the intermediate layer is formed by an aerosol CVD method. Thus, a method for producing a substrate, which can form a high-quality single crystal diamond layer having a large area (large diameter), high crystallinity, high protrusions, few abnormal growth particles, few dislocation defects, and the like, high purity, and low stress, which is suitable for electric/magnetic equipment, can be provided.

title_en: System and method for thinning wafer substrate
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a wafer processing system comprising a processing tool including at least one polishing member for removing material from a wafer substrate; an electrolyte supply line for supplying an electrolyte to the wafer substrate; a holding module for holding a wafer substrate, the holding module comprising a conductive base and a conductive porous member positioned on a top surface of the conductive base, a vacuum source in fluid communication with a fluid channel formed in the conductive base to create a vacuum to hold the wafer substrate on the conductive porous member; an actuator module for driving rotation of the polishing member and rotation of the conductive base; and a power supply module for applying a current to the polishing member and the conductive porous member through the conductive base. Since the material on the wafer substrate is removed by the polishing member after being converted into the oxide layer, the wafer substrate quality can be improved and the polishing member lifetime can be prolonged.

title_en: Titanium-containing metal etching solution and application method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a titanium-containing metal etching solution and an application method thereof, wherein the titanium-containing metal etching solution comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-50 parts of alkali, 0.1-20 parts of compound containing phenolic hydroxyl and 30-90 parts of water. The titanium-containing metal etching solution can remove the compact titanium dioxide layer on the surface layer of the titanium-containing metal and successfully etch the titanium-containing metal on the lower layer, and has low toxicity and is friendly to human body and environment.

title_en: Zinc-aluminum-magnesium weld bead anti-corrosion coating, composite coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a zinc-aluminum-magnesium weld bead anti-corrosion coating, a composite coating and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of coatings. The weld bead anti-corrosion coating comprises a first anti-corrosion layer which covers at least part of the surface of the zinc-aluminum-magnesium weld bead; the second anti-corrosion layer is covered on at least part of the surface of the first anti-corrosion layer; and a third anti-corrosion layer covering at least part of the surface of the second anti-corrosion layer; wherein, the melting point of the first anti-corrosion layer is less than the melting point of the second anti-corrosion layer is less than the melting point of the third anti-corrosion layer. By controlling the melting point of the three anti-corrosion layers, the elements of the three anti-corrosion layers are mutually penetrated, and the anti-corrosion coating has the advantages of uniform elements, high binding force, low porosity, high corrosion resistance, low cost and the like. The upper anticorrosive layer provides preheating for the lower anticorrosive layer, and the latter anticorrosive layer provides heat treatment and mechanical impact for the former anticorrosive layer, so that the binding force can be greatly improved, and the porosity can be reduced. Thereby improving the protection effect of the zinc-aluminum-magnesium welding bead.

title_en: Silicon photoelectric anode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon photo-anode and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein an amorphous WS  x (a-WS x ) film is controllably grown to the silicon photo-anode through liquid phase chemical self-deposition, and then a FeNi catalyst layer is grown on the amorphous WS  x  film through cyclic linear scanning electro-deposition, so that the FeNi/WS  x /Si photo-anode with excellent photo-catalytic water splitting performance is successfully prepared. The WS  x  layer separates the silicon anode from the electrolyte, so that the stability of the silicon anode is improved; the separation of photo-generated electrons and holes is promoted, and the photo-generated current density is improved; and rich FeNi layer deposition nucleation sites are provided, and the deposition uniformity of the promoter layer is improved. The obtained FeNi layer and WS  x  layer cooperate to reduce the recombination rate of photo-generated electrons and holes, and eliminate the photo-corrosion effect of the silicon anode, thereby improving the catalytic oxidation and the service stability of the silicon anode in a strong alkaline environment.

title_en: Photochromic light-adjusting glass and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a photochromic light-adjusting glass and a vehicle, wherein the photochromic light-adjusting glass comprises: the first glass plate, the photochromic layer and the second glass plate are sequentially overlapped. The first glass plate is for facing the external environment and the second glass plate is for facing the internal environment. In addition, the photochromic dimming glass further comprises an ultraviolet light eliminator. The ultraviolet eliminating piece is made of transparent materials, the ultraviolet eliminating piece is arranged on one side of the photochromic layer facing the first glass plate, and the area of a forward projection area of the ultraviolet eliminating piece on the photochromic layer is smaller than that of the photochromic layer. Under the scene with enough light, such as sunny days or cloudy days, the color and the transmittance of the non-adjustable color zone still remain unchanged, and the rest areas of the ultraviolet eliminating piece on the photochromic layer darken along with the irradiation of light intensity or strong ultraviolet rays, so that the visual perception of the photoinduced dimming change is facilitated under the contrast of the non-adjustable color zone, and the product performance is enriched.

title_en: Method for increasing adhesive force of sandwich panel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sandwich panel gluing, and particularly discloses a method for increasing the adhesive force of a sandwich panel. The invention takes polyethylene glycol as an initiator to prepare polyether, and introduces piperazine groups, sulfonic acid groups and Si-O groups into the polyether to obtain modified polyether, and prepares polyether polyol by high molecular weight PEG and low molecular weight PEG. Polyether polyol, castor oil, modified polyether, calcium carbonate and pentane are mixed according to a certain proportion to prepare a mixture; uncoiling the upper and lower layers of steel plates to form and preheating; mixing the mixture with isocyanate, foaming under high pressure, uniformly pouring between the upper and lower layers of preheated steel plates, heating and hot-pressing in a double-track machine, and cutting into corresponding sizes to obtain the sandwich plate.

title_en: Method for setting technological parameters of continuous hot galvanizing air knife of strip steel based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data-driven strip steel continuous hot galvanizing air knife process parameter setting method which comprises the steps of classifying according to the coating type, coating thickness specification, substrate mark, thickness and width of strip steel, establishing an air knife parameter formula, calculating air knife parameter formula data initial values by utilizing production process historical data, optimizing air knife parameter formula data on line by utilizing production process data, calculating air knife pressure compensation by utilizing the air knife parameter formula according to actual coating thickness deviation, realizing air knife pressure setting on-line correction, adopting the data-driven strip steel continuous hot galvanizing air knife process parameter setting method to replace manual experience setting, realizing manual experience extraction, storage and optimization, ensuring production process consistency and stability, effectively preventing quality defects such as zinc flow ripple, air knife streak, edge thickening and the like by reasonably setting the air knife process parameters, and being beneficial to further improving coating thickness quality and control precision, and having good application and popularization prospects.

title_en: Laminated structure and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a laminated structure with high adhesion between a resin base material and a metal layer, which can be manufactured without using a chemical agent with strong oxidizing property. A laminated structure (10) is provided with a resin base (20), a barrier film (30) that is positioned on the resin base (20) and contains a first metal element, and a metal layer (40) that is positioned on the barrier film (30) and contains a second metal element, wherein a part of the metal layer (40) penetrates the barrier film (30) and extends into the resin base (20).

title_en: Vinyl chloride resin composition, vinyl chloride resin molded body, and laminate
abstract_en: The invention provides a vinyl chloride resin composition capable of forming a vinyl chloride resin molded body capable of inhibiting crack welding. The vinyl chloride resin composition of the present invention comprises a vinyl chloride resin, a plasticizer and starch. In addition, the vinyl chloride resin composition is preferably used for powder slush molding.

title_en: Winding type coating detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lithium battery coating processing, relates to a data analysis technology, and aims to solve the problem that a winding type coating detection system in the prior art cannot optimize equipment operation control parameters according to real-time detection results, and in particular relates to a winding type coating detection system which comprises a coating detection platform, wherein the coating detection platform is in communication connection with a real-time detection module, a stability analysis module, a control optimization module and a storage module, and the real-time detection module comprises a thickness detection unit and a size detection unit; the thickness detection unit is used for detecting and analyzing the thickness of the coating in the coating process; the invention can detect and analyze the coating thickness of the coating processing, acquire the thickness value of the foil coating in a timing detection mode, then analyze and calculate the thickness value of the same group of coating to obtain the thickness representation value and the thickness deviation value, and feed back the abnormal state of the thickness of the foil coating according to the thickness representation value and the thickness deviation value.

title_en: Liquid crystal polymer film, laminate provided with same, and method for producing liquid crystal polymer film
abstract_en: The liquid crystal polymer film (10) according to the present disclosure comprises a liquid crystal polymer (1) and an inorganic filler (2), has a relative dielectric constant of 5 to 10, and has an average value of distances between barycentric coordinates of particles of the inorganic filler (2) in the liquid crystal polymer film (10) of 0.5 to 2.0 [ mu ] m.

title_en: Method for producing n-type monocrystalline silicon
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing n-type single crystal silicon. An n-type single crystal silicon is produced by melting a polycrystalline silicon raw material containing a plurality of polycrystalline silicon blocks, the production method comprising the steps of: an n-type single crystal silicon having a resistivity of 10000 Ω cm or more is produced without adding a dopant when the polycrystalline silicon raw material is melted, and the following polycrystalline silicon raw material is used as the polycrystalline silicon raw material: assuming that the total concentration of donor elements existing in the main body of the polycrystalline silicon raw material is Cd1[ ppta ], the total concentration of acceptor elements existing in the main body of the polycrystalline silicon raw material is Ca1[ ppta ], the total concentration of donor elements existing on the surface of the polycrystalline silicon raw material is Cd2[ ppta ], and the total concentration of acceptor elements existing on the surface of the polycrystalline silicon raw material is Ca2[ ppta ], the Cd1, ca1, cd2 and Ca2 satisfy the following relationship: the ratio of Cd1+Cd2 to Ca1+Ca2 is less than or equal to 2[ ppta ] and less than or equal to 8[ ppta ].

title_en: Electrolytic copper dissolving tank with uniform spraying
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrolytic copper dissolving tank with uniform spraying, which belongs to the technical field of copper dissolving equipment, and comprises a tank body which is vertically arranged, wherein the upper end of the tank body is provided with a tank cover, the inner wall of the upper part of the tank body is fixedly provided with a baffle plate with an annular structure, the inner side of the baffle plate is rotatably provided with a holding net barrel, and the tank body and the tank cover are connected through a circulating pipe; further comprises: the central tube is rotationally connected to the upper end of the circulating tube, the lower end of the central tube is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor, the outer side of the lower end of the central tube is connected with the branch tube, and the spray assemblies are arranged on the outer sides of the central tube and the branch tube; the transmission assembly is arranged between the holding net drum and the branch pipe; and the inflation assembly is arranged on the inner side of the lower end of the tank body. The electrolytic copper dissolving tank with uniform spraying can effectively turn copper materials, adopts multi-angle constant-pressure spraying flushing, can realize heating and filling of gas, and effectively improves copper dissolving efficiency.

title_en: Samarium-doped high-entropy garnet structure aluminate ceramic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a samarium-doped high-entropy garnet structure aluminate ceramic material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the chemical structural general formula is Re  3‑x Sm x Al 5 O 12 , re comprises at least 5 trivalent rare earth elements, sm is doped ion, the valence state is +3, and x is less than 0.2. In addition, the preparation method is simple and easy to realize, and the preparation method has the characteristics that the reaction sintering time of the material at high temperature is short, a large amount of energy consumed by maintaining a high temperature field for a long time can be saved, meanwhile, in the application preparation process of the thermal barrier coating, the maintenance time of a thermal field is very short, so that the preparation method of the in-situ rapid reaction sintering is very similar to the condition of industrial preparation, the thermal barrier coating material prepared by the method has the properties similar to those of actual production, and in addition, the in-situ reaction sintering can ensure that the samarium doped high-entropy garnet structure aluminate ceramic has high density and high quantum efficiency.

title_en: Silicone oil paper and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of paper manufacture, and particularly relates to silicone oil paper, which comprises the following components: a central base paper layer, which is kraft paper; further comprises: the composite filling layer comprises a hot melt adhesive layer and a grid layer; the outer base paper layers are arranged on two sides of the central base paper layer, and a coating layer is arranged on the outer surface of the outer base paper layer; wherein, compound filling layer sets up between outer base ply and central base ply, compound filling layer and outer base ply each other fixed connection, can effectively improve the high temperature resistance and the structural strength of silicone oil paper through the setting of compound filling layer for the silicone oil paper is difficult to appear damaging and can use repeatedly, has improved the life of silicone oil paper, has satisfied the production transportation and the user demand of silicone oil paper.

title_en: Preparation process of high Jiang Mofeng steel pipe perforating plug
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal materials, and discloses a preparation process of a high Jiang Mofeng steel pipe perforating plug, wherein a large number of mechanical non-uniformities of hard particles are distributed on a ceramic reinforcing agent matrix, and contact and friction are generated between the ceramic reinforcing agent matrix and a crack surface, so that a crack generates a closing effect and a crack tip is passivated, and the tendency of cracking of the plug is reduced; rare earth elements in the fine-grain strengthening agent are dispersed and distributed in the crystal and at the grain boundaries, so that dislocation movement can be effectively hindered, impurity elements such as inter-crystal oxygen, sulfur and the like are adsorbed, the grain boundary is purified, the strength of the alloy is improved, and a pinning effect is achieved on the dislocation during deformation; ion soft nitriding can increase dislocation density of the material and improve hardness; the silicon-zirconium coating has excellent wear resistance, the silicon-zirconium coating material is sputtered on the surface of the plug base body by magnetron sputtering, and the silicon-zirconium coating with diffusion blocking effect is formed by the silicon-zirconium coating material and nitrogen element on the surface of the base body, so that the strength and wear resistance of the piercing plug material are improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly acrylic rust treatment material and rust removal method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an environment-friendly acrylic rust treatment material and a rust removal method thereof, wherein the environment-friendly acrylic rust treatment material comprises an acrylic monomer A component, a nanofiller B component and a photoinitiator C component: wherein the acrylic monomer A component solution is prepared from acrylic acid, acrylic acid derivatives and cross-linking agent according to the mass ratio of 2-10:1-8:0.1-0.6; the nano filler B component is prepared from deionized water, polyvinylpyrrolidone, hydrazine hydrate and a copper source according to the mass ratio of 150-250:2-5:0.02-0.1:2-5. The nano filler B component and the photoinitiator C component are added according to the mass ratio of 0.1:10-50 and 0.1:2.5-10 with the A component respectively; further optimizing parameters such as reaction solvent, reaction atmosphere, reaction temperature, reaction time and the like. The invention takes the rusted Q235 carbon steel substrate as a test object, proves that the environment-friendly acrylic material has excellent rust treatment performance, can effectively remove rusted traces on the surface of the Q235 carbon steel, and has important significance for the subsequent protection of the metal substrate. The rust removing capability of the system is improved through the reaction of acrylic acid and rust, the adsorption of acrylic acid-based hydrogel and the addition of filler; a rust removing formula with higher performance improvement is selected through parallel experiments, and a new rust treatment strategy is provided for the rust removing field.

title_en: Metal deposition in recessed features using halogen-containing deposition inhibitors
abstract_en: In a deposition process that is tuned by the addition of a halogen-containing compound (e.g., an alkyl halide), a metal film, such as a molybdenum film, is deposited into a semiconductor substrate having one or more recessed features. In certain embodiments, the substrate is pretreated with a halogen-containing compound prior to contacting the substrate with the metal-containing precursor and the reducing agent. In certain embodiments, the pretreatment is performed such that the halogen-containing compound modifies the surface of the substrate field region and the surface near the opening of the recessed feature to a greater extent than the bottom of the recessed feature, wherein the modified substrate inhibits metal deposition. Thus, a metal deposition with improved step coverage can be obtained. In certain embodiments, deposition modulated by halogen-containing compounds is used to achieve bottom-up metal growth in recessed features.

title_en: Flame-retardant PE film bag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant PE film bag and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of PE films, wherein the flame-retardant PE film bag sequentially comprises a core layer, a middle layer and a surface layer, the core layer comprises linear low-density polyethylene, a composite antibacterial agent, a plasticizer, a composite flame retardant a and montmorillonite, the middle layer comprises linear low-density polyethylene, high-pressure low-density polyethylene, calcium carbonate and an antistatic agent, the surface layer comprises linear low-density polyethylene, an antioxidant, an ultraviolet resistance agent, a color agent, a composite flame retardant b and a toughening agent, the composite flame retardant a and the composite flame retardant b can greatly improve the flame retardant performance of the PE film, the PE film can be extinguished immediately after being released from fire, no dripping phenomenon exists after being ignited, the preparation method of the flame-retardant PE film bag comprises the steps of mixing, extruding, stretching, cooling and winding, and the flame-retardant PE film can effectively improve the strength and toughness of the flame-retardant PE film after being molded by bidirectional stretching, and the problem of breakage is not easy to occur due to poor mechanical performance in the use process.

title_en: Foldable substrate and method of manufacture
abstract_en: The foldable substrate includes a first portion, a second portion, and a central portion positioned therebetween. The central portion includes a first central surface region recessed a first distance from the first major surface and a second central surface region. The second major surface includes a second central surface region. The passivation edge extends around the entire perimeter of the foldable substrate. The passivating edge includes a first passivating surface region where the passivating edge meets the first major surface and a second passivating surface region where the passivating edge meets the second major surface. The method includes laminating the foldable substrate and the support layer prior to removing a peripheral portion of an initial edge of the foldable substrate to form an intermediate edge. The intermediate edge is contacted with an etchant to form a passivated edge. The method further includes removing the support layer from the foldable substrate.

title_en: Preparation method and application of alloy monocrystal with efficient hydrogen evolution catalytic performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an alloy monocrystal with high-efficiency hydrogen evolution catalytic performance. The method prepares the CoSi single crystal by a pulling method, the preparation process comprises the process steps of preparing a polycrystalline precursor, seeding, necking, shouldering, and equal-diameter growth, and the like, and the CoSi alloy single crystal material with high efficiency and high hydrogen evolution catalytic performance and high quality is prepared by controlling the pulling speed and the rotation speed of a seed rod in different steps. The CoSi single crystal prepared by the method has higher purity and better hydrogen production efficiency and economic benefit.

title_en: MCrAlX alloys, powders, coatings and components for corrosion and oxidation protection and for bonding ceramic insulation coatings
abstract_en: A Ni-based NiCoCrAlY coating comprising: 24.5 to 26.5% of cobalt (Co), 14.5 to 16.5% of chromium (Cr), 11.6 to 12.6% of aluminum (Al), 0.3 to 0.5% of yttrium (Y), 4.0 to 5.0% of iron (Fe), 0.6 to 0.8% of tantalum (Ta), 0.4 to 0.6% of molybdenum (Mo), and 0.4 to 0.6% of silicon (Si).

title_en: Preparation method and application of Ce-doped single-phase complex spinel
